en: Abu Bakr ibn Ali was a son of Ali ibn Haditha of the Al Fadl and father of Muhammad ibn Abu Bakr; some historians say he led the Bedouin of Syria just before the Mamluk conquest of 1260.
zh: 阿布·伯克尔·本·阿里是法德勒部族的阿里·本·哈迪塔之子，穆罕默德·本·阿布·伯克尔之父。有史家认为，1260年马穆鲁克夺取叙利亚之前的几年里，出任贝都因“阿拉伯人埃米尔”的是他，而不是他的父亲。

en: Muhammad ibn Abu Bakr was a grandson of Ali ibn Haditha and belonged to the Al Ali branch of the Al Fadl, the Bedouin house that held the office of amir al-ʿarab, commander of the tribes of the Syrian desert, under the Mamluks. After Sultan Qalawun took the throne in 1279, he punished Isa ibn Muhanna for joining the revolt of Sunqur al-Ashqar and named Muhammad in his place, though the appointment was only nominal. In 1293 al-Ashraf Khalil imprisoned Isa's son Muhanna in Cairo, and Muhammad led the Bedouin until Muhanna was restored in 1295. He received the post again in 1320, when an-Nasir Muhammad banished Muhanna.
zh: 穆罕默德·本·阿布·伯克尔是阿里·本·哈迪塔之孙，出身法德勒部族的阿里支系。该部族在马穆鲁克治下世袭“阿拉伯人埃米尔”一职，统领叙利亚沙漠的各个贝都因部落。1279年嘉拉温登上苏丹之位后，惩罚参与辛库尔·阿什卡尔叛乱的伊萨·本·穆哈纳，改任穆罕默德接替其职，但这一任命只是名义上的。1293年，阿什拉夫·哈利勒将伊萨之子穆哈纳囚于开罗，穆罕默德统领贝都因诸部，直到1295年穆哈纳复职。1320年，纳西尔·穆罕默德放逐穆哈纳，穆罕默德再度获任此职。

en: Abaqa Khan (1234–1282) was the second Ilkhan of Iran, succeeding his father Hulagu in 1265. He fixed the Ilkhanate capital at Tabriz and married Maria Palaiologina, daughter of the Byzantine emperor Michael VIII. His reign was spent fighting fellow Mongols: the Golden Horde in the Caucasus and the Chagatai Khanate under Baraq in the east. His armies raided Syria but were beaten by the Mamluks at the Second Battle of Homs in 1281. He died at Hamadan in 1282, and his brother Tekuder succeeded him; his own sons Arghun and Gaykhatu later ruled.
zh: 阿八哈（1234—1282）是伊儿汗国第二任伊儿汗，1265年继其父旭烈兀即位。他定都大不里士，并迎娶拜占庭皇帝米哈伊尔八世之女玛丽亚·巴列奥略。他在位期间不断与同宗的蒙古政权交战：北方是高加索方向的金帐汗国，东方是八剌率领的察合台汗国。他的军队曾攻略叙利亚，但于1281年在第二次霍姆斯战役中被马穆鲁克击败。1282年他死于哈马丹，弟贴古迭儿继位；其子阿鲁浑、海合都后来也都成为伊儿汗。

en: Abu Sa'id Bahadur Khan (1305–1335) was the ninth Ilkhan of Persia, succeeding his father Öljaitü in 1317 as a boy. The emir Chupan long ruled in his name; in 1319 they crushed Irinjin's revolt at Mianeh and repelled Özbeg of the Golden Horde, earning Abu Sa'id the title Bahadur. In 1327 the Ilkhan overthrew Chupan, who was strangled at Herat, and married his daughter Baghdad Khatun. In 1320 he signed a commercial treaty with Venice and a separate peace treaty with Mamluk Egypt. Marching against another Özbeg invasion, he died in Karabakh in December 1335 without an heir, and the Ilkhanate fell apart.
zh: 不赛因（1305—1335）是伊儿汗国第九任伊儿汗，1317年幼龄继承其父完者都之位。异密出班长期以他的名义掌权；1319年，他们在米亚内平定伊林真的叛乱，击退钦察汗国月即别的进犯，不赛因由此获称八哈都儿。1327年，他推翻出班，出班兵败后在赫拉特被缢杀，他随后纳出班之女巴格达·哈敦为妻。1320年，他同威尼斯签订商约，另与马穆鲁克埃及签订和约。1335年12月，他在迎击月即别再度入侵时死于卡拉巴赫，未留继承人，伊儿汗国随之瓦解。

en: Acciaiolo Acciaiuoli (died 1349) was a Florentine banker and politician of the Acciaiuoli family, the illegitimate son of Niccolò Acciaiuoli il Vecchio and father of Niccolò Acciaiuoli, the future grand seneschal of Naples. He took the family bank south. He founded branches at Naples, which proved especially important to the family's fortune, and at Barletta, in Greece, the Levant and Barbary, and lent large sums to King Robert of Naples, who named him chamberlain and counsellor in 1333. From 1335 until his death he was the Angevin king's perpetual vicar at Prato. At home he was prior of liberty in 1322 and 1333, served among the war magistrates in 1336, was charged with rebuilding the bridges destroyed by the flood of 1334, and commanded the fortress of Pistoia in 1339. He died in Florence in 1349.
zh: 阿恰约洛·阿恰约利（？—1349）是佛罗伦萨阿恰约利家族的银行家、政治家，老尼科洛·阿恰约利的私生子，也是后来的那不勒斯大总管尼科洛·阿恰约利之父。他把家族银行的生意带向南方：分号开到那不勒斯、巴列塔、希腊、黎凡特和柏柏尔，其中那不勒斯的分号对家族的发迹尤为重要；他还向那不勒斯国王罗贝托贷出巨款，后者于1333年任命他为侍从长兼顾问。1335年至去世，他担任那不勒斯安茹国王驻普拉托的终身代理人。在佛罗伦萨本城，他于1322年和1333年两度出任自由长官，1336年进入战争六署，1334年洪灾后受命重建被毁的桥梁，1339年出任皮斯托亚堡垒长官。他于1349年在佛罗伦萨去世。

en: Leone Acciaiuoli (c. 1220–1300), born at Ortona, was a knight and politician of the Florentine Acciaioli family. He sat in the magistracy of the Quattordici Buonomini set up by Cardinal Malabranca Orsini in 1280, and served as capitano del popolo at Pistoia in 1296. Abruzzese tradition remembers him as the sea captain who, sailing for King Manfred, landed on Chios and on 6 September 1258 brought the relics of Saint Thomas back to Ortona Cathedral. He died in Florence in 1300.
zh: 莱昂内·阿恰约利（约1220—1300）生于奥托纳，是佛罗伦萨阿恰约利家族的骑士与政治家。他进入1280年由枢机马拉布兰卡·奥尔西尼设立的十四人政务会，1296年出任皮斯托亚人民长官。阿布鲁佐的传统把他记作一位航海统帅：他受国王曼弗雷迪差遣航行至希俄斯岛，于1258年9月6日将圣多马的遗骸迎回奥托纳主教座堂。1300年，他在佛罗伦萨去世。

en: Anthony le Flamenc, a Frankish knight of Flemish descent, was lord of Karditsa (now Akraifnio) in Boeotia, Duchy of Athens. He is first mentioned in 1303, when Duke Guy II de la Roche named him deputy over Thessaly. Guy had taken the young ruler John II Doukas under his tutelage after the death of John's father. In 1308 Venice accused Anthony and others of plotting to seize its colony of Negroponte. He remained loyal to Matilda of Hainaut and attended her second betrothal to Charles of Taranto at Thebes on 2 April 1309. On 15 March 1311 he fought at the Battle of Halmyros against the Catalan Company. He was one of the few survivors, but was captured and held for ransom. After his return he built the Church of Saint George at Karditsa, which bears a donor's inscription.
zh: 安托内·勒弗拉芒是一位有佛兰德血统的法兰克骑士，任雅典公国维奥蒂亚地区卡尔迪察（今阿克赖夫尼奥）的领主。1303年，雅典公爵居伊二世·德拉罗什任命他为色萨利的代理人，这是他首次见于史料。色萨利年幼的统治者约翰二世·杜卡斯在父亲去世后受居伊监护。1308年，威尼斯指控安托内等人密谋夺取其殖民地内格罗蓬特。他忠于埃诺的玛蒂尔达，1309年4月2日在底比斯出席了她与塔兰托的查理的第二次订婚。1311年3月15日，他在哈尔米罗斯战役中与加泰罗尼亚公司交战，是为数不多的幸存者之一，但被俘并被扣押索取赎金。回国后，他在卡尔迪察建造了圣乔治教堂，教堂留有捐建者的题铭。

en: Catherine of Valois-Courtenay (c. 1303–1346) was a Latin empress without an empire. The eldest daughter of Charles of Valois and Catherine of Courtenay, she inherited her mother's claim to Constantinople in 1307, though the city had fallen to the Empire of Nicaea in 1261 and she lived in exile, with authority only over the Crusader states in Greece. In July 1313 she married Philip I of Taranto, brother of King Robert of Naples. After Philip's death in 1332, their thirteen-year-old son Robert received Achaea in 1333 from his uncle John of Gravina, and Catherine governed it for him until 1341. In summer 1338 she mustered a fleet and took her household to Achaea. There she sheltered Nikephoros II Orsini of Epirus and backed his bid against the Byzantine emperor Andronikos III. In 1341 she became governor of Cephalonia, a post she held until her death at Naples in October 1346.
zh: 瓦卢瓦-库尔特内的凯瑟琳（约1303—1346）是一位没有帝国的拉丁女皇。她是瓦卢瓦伯爵查理与库尔特内的凯瑟琳的长女，1307年继承母亲对君士坦丁堡的皇位主张，但该城早在1261年就落入尼西亚帝国之手，她流亡在外，权力只及于希腊的十字军国家。1313年7月，她嫁给那不勒斯国王罗伯特的弟弟塔兰托亲王腓力一世。1332年腓力去世后，十三岁的儿子罗伯特于1333年从叔父格拉维纳的约翰手中获得亚该亚，凯瑟琳代他治理至1341年。1338年夏，她集结舰队，带着全家前往亚该亚。她在那里庇护了伊庇鲁斯的尼基弗鲁斯二世·奥尔西尼，支持他对抗拜占庭皇帝安德罗尼卡三世。1341年起，她出任凯法洛尼亚总督，直至1346年10月在那不勒斯去世。

en: Centurione I Zaccaria (1336–1382) was one of the most powerful barons of the Frankish Principality of Achaea, the eldest son of Martino Zaccaria and Jacqueline de la Roche, heiress of the Burgundian ducal house of Athens. After his father's death in 1345 he held the Barony of Damala and half of Chalandritsa, acquiring the other half in 1359. Around 1370 he became Grand Constable of Achaea and received the Barony of Estamira. He married Asenina, daughter of Andronikos Asen, in a Greek Orthodox ceremony; their son, named Andronikos for his Greek grandfather, held Chalandritsa and Arcadia. Centurione served three times as bailli, or viceroy, for the principality's Angevin overlords and died in 1382 during his third term. His daughter Maria later ruled Achaea as regent in 1402–1404, and his grandson Centurione II was Prince of Achaea from 1404 to 1432.
zh: 琴图廖内一世·扎卡里亚（1336—1382）是法兰克人的亚该亚亲王国最有权势的贵族之一，为马蒂诺·扎卡里亚与出身勃艮第雅典公爵家族的女继承人雅克丽娜·德拉罗什的长子。1345年父亲死后，他领有达马拉男爵领地和哈兰德里察的一半，1359年取得哈兰德里察的另一半。约1370年，他成为亚该亚大统帅，并受封埃斯塔米拉男爵领地。他按希腊正教仪式迎娶了安德罗尼科斯·阿森之女阿塞尼娜；他们的儿子以希腊外祖父的名字取名安德罗尼科斯，后来领有哈兰德里察和阿卡迪亚。琴图廖内三次担任安茹籍宗主的巴伊，即副王，1382年在第三任内去世。女儿玛丽亚于1402—1404年摄政亚该亚，孙子琴图廖内二世于1404—1432年任亚该亚亲王。

en: Florent of Hainaut (c. 1255–1297) was the son of John I of Avesnes, Count of Hainaut, and Adelaide of Holland. From his father he received the stadholdership of Zeeland, but he left the Low Countries to serve Charles II of Naples as constable of the kingdom. In 1289 he married Isabella of Villehardouin, heiress of Achaea, and ruled the principality in her right. He negotiated the Treaty of Glarentsa with Byzantium in 1290. When the Greeks retook Kalamata in 1293, he protested rather than reopening the war. He died in 1297 while besieging the castle of Saint George in Arcadia, leaving a daughter, Matilda, as heir.
zh: 埃诺的弗洛朗（约1255—1297）是埃诺伯爵约翰一世与荷兰的阿德莱德之子。他从父亲那里获得泽兰省督之职，之后离开低地，效力于那不勒斯国王查理二世，担任王国大元帅。1289年，他与亚该亚女继承人维拉杜安的伊莎贝拉结婚，以其丈夫身份统治亚该亚侯国。1290年，他与拜占庭谈判，签订格拉伦察条约。1293年希腊人夺回卡拉马塔后，他选择抗议，而没有重开战端。1297年，他在围攻阿卡狄亚的圣乔治城堡时去世，由女儿玛蒂尔达继承。

en: Giovanni Orsini (c. 1321–?), also called Tsafas, was the son of Guido Apostolico Orsini, count palatine and first constable of the Principality of Achaea, who died in 1336. He inherited the lordship of Leucadia from his father, but later lost it and returned to the family's fief at Nocera in the Kingdom of Naples. In 1361 he was confirmed as an imperial prince by Simeon Palaiologos, who styled himself king and emperor of the Greeks and Serbs. He married Beatrice Griffi of Nocera and was buried in Naples.
zh: 乔瓦尼·奥尔西尼（约1321年生），又称查法斯，是亚该亚侯国首席骑兵统帅、帕拉丁伯爵圭多·奥尔西尼的儿子，父亲卒于1336年。他继承了莱夫卡达的领主之位，后来失去该地，回到那不勒斯王国诺切拉的家族封地。1361年，他获得自称希腊人与塞尔维亚人国王兼皇帝的西门·帕莱奥洛格确认为帝国亲王。他娶诺切拉的比阿特丽丝·格里菲，死后葬于那不勒斯。

en: Guido Orsini was a son of John I Orsini, count palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynthos, and Maria Komnene Doukaina. He served as Constable of the Principality of Achaea.
zh: 圭多·奥尔西尼是凯法洛尼亚与扎金索斯的宫廷伯爵约翰一世·奥尔西尼与玛丽亚·科穆宁·杜卡伊娜之子，曾任亚该亚侯国的总管。

en: William I of Champlitte (1160s–1209) was a French knight, the second son of Odo I, viscount of Dijon. He married Elisabeth of Mount-Saint-Jean, but they divorced in 1199. He joined the Fourth Crusade, and in April 1203 he was among the leaders who signed a letter to Pope Innocent III written after the capture of Zara. He became the first prince of Achaea in 1205 and held the title until his death in 1209.
zh: 纪尧姆一世·德尚普利特（约1160—1209）是法国骑士，第戎子爵奥多一世的次子。他与蒙圣让的伊丽莎白结婚，但二人于1199年离婚。他参加了第四次十字军东征，1203年，他与其他领袖联名写信给教皇英诺森三世，这封信写于攻占扎拉之后。1205年，他成为亚该亚侯国的首任亲王，直至1209年去世。

en: Louis of Burgundy (1297–1316) was a younger son of Duke Robert II of Burgundy and Agnes of France. In 1313 he married Matilda of Hainaut, heir to the Villehardouin claims on Achaea, and ruled the principality jointly with her under the overlordship of Philip of Taranto. Louis gave up his claims to the family lands in Burgundy to his elder brother Hugh, who ceded him the claim to the Kingdom of Thessalonica. Louis travelled to Greece by way of Venice, seeking aid from the republic. He defeated Ferdinand of Majorca at Manolada in July 1316 but died about four weeks later. Accounts of his death disagree: the Chronicle of the Morea blames a fever, while a Catalan source accuses John of Cephalonia of poisoning him.
zh: 路易·德勃艮第（1297—1316）是勃艮第公爵罗贝尔二世与法兰西的阿涅丝年幼的儿子之一。1313年，他与埃诺的玛蒂尔达结婚，在塔兰托亲王腓力一世的宗主权下与妻子共同统治亚该亚。他将自己对勃艮第家族领地的权利让给兄长于格，于格则将塞萨洛尼卡王国的主张让给他。路易经威尼斯前往希腊，向共和国寻求援助。1316年7月，他在马诺拉达战役中击败马略卡的斐迪南，但约四周后便去世。关于他的死因，记载不一：《莫雷亚编年史》称是热病，而一份加泰罗尼亚文献则指控凯法洛尼亚伯爵约翰·奥尔西尼下毒。

en: Martino Zaccaria was the Genoese lord of Chios from 1314 to 1329 and a feared enemy of the Turkish corsairs in the Aegean. In 1319 he brought seven ships to a Hospitaller fleet that crushed an Aydinid fleet from Ephesus, and Gregoras called him the terror of the Turks of Asia Minor. The titular Latin emperor Philip II named him ‘King and Despot of Asia Minor’ in 1325, a mostly symbolic title; he also held the Achaean baronies of Veligosti–Damala and Chalandritsa. In 1329 Andronikos III sailed against Chios with 105 ships; Martino held his citadel with 800 men until his brother gave up a fort, then lived as a prisoner in Constantinople until 1337. He became Genoese envoy to the Holy See and in 1343 commanded the papal galleys in the crusade that stormed Smyrna. The Turks killed him on 17 January 1345, during mass in the city's old cathedral.
zh: 马蒂诺·扎卡里亚是热那亚人，1314年至1329年任希俄斯领主，也是爱琴海上令土耳其海盗忌惮的对手。1319年，他率七艘船加入医院骑士团舰队，大败来自以弗所的艾登舰队，格里高拉斯称他是小亚细亚土耳其人的恐怖。1325年，拉丁名义皇帝腓力二世授予他“亚细亚王与专制公”的头衔，多半只是象征；他还持有亚该亚的韦利戈斯蒂—达马拉和哈兰德里察男爵领。1329年，安德罗尼卡三世率105艘船进攻希俄斯；马蒂诺带着800人固守城堡，直到兄弟交出要塞。他被囚多年，1337年获释后，他出任热那亚驻教廷的使节，1343年受命指挥教皇桨帆船队，参与攻占士麦那的十字军。1345年1月17日，土耳其人在城内旧主教座堂的弥撒中发起袭击，他因此丧生。

en: Matilda of Hainaut (1293–1331) was the only child of Florent of Hainaut and Isabella of Villehardouin. In 1307 she unsuccessfully claimed Achaea after King Charles II of Naples revoked her mother's rights. In 1313 she married Louis of Burgundy, and they received the principality. They landed in Achaea in early 1316 and secured it after Ferdinand of Majorca was defeated and killed at Manolada. Louis died in 1316. In 1318 King Robert of Naples had Matilda abducted to Naples and forced her into a ceremony with his brother John of Gravina, which she refused to recognise. In 1321 she refused the pope's order to marry John and admitted a secret marriage to the knight Hugh de la Palisse. Robert revoked her rights to Achaea and imprisoned her, first in Naples and then at Aversa, where she died in 1331.
zh: 埃诺的玛蒂尔达（1293—1331）是埃诺的弗洛朗与维拉杜安的伊莎贝拉的独生女。1307年，那不勒斯国王查理二世剥夺了她母亲对亚该亚的权利，她提出继承要求，但未获接受。1313年，她与勃艮第的路易结婚，二人获封亚该亚侯国。1316年初，他们在亚该亚登陆；马略卡的斐迪南在马诺拉达战败身亡后，二人取得侯国的控制权。1316年，路易去世。1318年，那不勒斯国王罗伯特将她劫往那不勒斯，并逼她与其弟格拉维纳的约翰举行婚礼，她拒不承认这段婚姻。1321年，她拒绝教皇要她嫁给约翰的命令，并承认与骑士于格·德拉帕利斯秘密结婚。罗伯特剥夺了她对亚该亚的权利并将她囚禁，先在那不勒斯，后在阿韦尔萨，她于1331年死于阿韦尔萨的囚禁之中。

en: Robert of Taranto (1319 or 1326–1364), of the Capetian House of Anjou, was the eldest surviving son of Philip I of Taranto and Catherine of Valois. In 1332 his uncle John, Duke of Durazzo, arranged for him to take the Principality of Achaea in exchange for his rights to the Kingdom of Albania. Robert was still a boy, so his mother governed Achaea in his name until her death in 1346. That year he inherited the Latin imperial title and was recognised as Emperor Robert II by the Latin states of Greece, though his real power rested on Achaea alone. He married Marie of Bourbon at Naples in 1347, but the marriage was childless. He died in Naples in September 1364. His widow tried to keep the principality for herself and her son by an earlier marriage, but his younger brother Philip II succeeded him.
zh: 塔兰托的罗伯特（1319或1326—1364）出身卡佩王朝的安茹家族，是塔兰托亲王菲利波一世与瓦卢瓦的凯瑟琳在世诸子中的长子。1332年，他的叔父杜拉佐公爵乔凡尼安排他接管亚该亚亲王之位，条件是他放弃阿尔巴尼亚王国的权利。罗伯特当时年幼，亚该亚由母亲以他的名义主政，直至1346年凯瑟琳去世。同年，他继承了拉丁皇帝的头衔，被希腊的拉丁各国承认为皇帝罗伯特二世，但他的实际权力仍只在亚该亚。1347年，他在那不勒斯迎娶波旁的玛丽，二人无子。1364年9月，他在那不勒斯去世。他的遗孀试图为自己和前夫所生的儿子保住亚该亚，但继位的是他的弟弟菲利波二世。

en: Baramaraja, a mixed Mon–Chinese prince, was one of the princes produced by a marriage alliance between the Siamese dynasty of Ayodhya and the Mon house of Haripuñjaya at Chaliang. He was first a prince of Si Satchanalai before he took the throne of Ayodhya. In 1344 his son Ramathibodi I succeeded him, and in 1351 Ramathibodi founded Ayutthaya on an island in the Chao Phraya River.
zh: 波隆玛拉差是混合孟族与华人血统的亲王，出身于阿踰陀王室与驻查良的孟族哈利奔猜王室的联姻。他早年为斯沙查纳莱亲王，后即位为阿踰陀国王。1344年，他的儿子拉玛铁菩提一世继承王位；1351年，拉玛铁菩提在湄南河的一座小岛上建立阿瑜陀耶城。

en: Chaisen, or Jayasena, was a Tai prince who married a princess of the Ayodhya ruling line and succeeded his father-in-law as king of Ayodhya, reigning from 1253 to 1289 by one reckoning.
zh: 猜森是一位泰族王子，娶了阿踰陀王族的公主，继岳父之后成为阿踰陀国王，一说在位时间为1253—1289年。

en: Dhammikaraja was a son of Sai Nam Peung and a king of Ayodhya in the late 12th century, said to have founded Wat Dhammikaraja in the old city.
sources: https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/วัดธรรมิกราช
zh: 达摩迦罗阇是赛南蓬之子，12世纪后期的阿踰陀国王，相传在旧城中建造了达摩迦罗阇寺。

en: Phra Chao Luang won the throne of Ayodhya by prevailing in the two-year war of succession that followed the death of the childless King Narai in 1087. He had no son, and married his only daughter to Sai Nam Peung, a prince of Chaliang and Chiang Saen descent whose father Kesariraja took the seat at Lavapura in 1106. Through that marriage the line known as the Uthong dynasty came to hold Ayodhya, and its descendants ruled there until Ayutthaya was founded in 1351.
zh: 1087年无嗣的那莱国王去世后，阿踰陀爆发了为期两年的王位之争，銮王在这场内战中获胜，登上王位。他没有儿子，把独生女嫁给了赛南蓬。赛南蓬出身柴立与清盛的王族血统，其父克赖松拉于1106年入主罗涡城。通过这桩婚姻，后来被称为乌通王朝的这一支掌握了阿踰陀，其后裔在当地统治，直到1351年大城建立。

en: Narai was king of Lavo in the late 11th century. In the 1080s he moved the royal seat from Lavapura (Lopburi) to Ayodhya on the lower Chao Phraya, a move the chronicles credit to him. In 1087 Pagan invaded Lavo, but the dispute ended in negotiation. Narai died that same year without an heir. The nobles of Ayodhya then fought a two-year civil war over the throne, and the winner, Phra Chao Luang, took the crown.
zh: 那莱是11世纪后期的罗涡国王。1080年代，他把王都从罗涡城（华富里）迁到湄南河下游的阿踰陀，编年史把这次迁都记在他名下。1087年，蒲甘入侵罗涡，双方最终通过谈判了结。同年，那莱去世，没有留下子嗣。阿踰陀的贵族随后为王位打了两年内战，胜出的銮王登上王位。

en: Ramathibodi I (1314–1369), also known as Uthong, was the founder and first king of Ayutthaya, reigning from 1351 to 1369. He was the son of Baramaraja, a former prince of Si Satchanalai who became king of Ayodhya. He succeeded his father in 1344. In 1351 he founded Ayutthaya on an island in the Chao Phraya River, bringing the power centers of Lopburi and Suphan Buri under one state. Between 1350 and 1359 he codified laws based on traditional Tai customs. After his death in 1369, the throne changed hands repeatedly between his son and his brother-in-law, a ruler of the Suphannaphum line.
zh: 拉玛铁菩提一世（1314—1369），又称乌通，是阿瑜陀耶王国的开创者和首位君主，在位1351—1369年。他是波隆玛拉差之子，父亲原为斯沙查纳莱亲王，后即位为阿踰陀国王。1344年，他继承父位。1351年，他在湄南河的一座小岛上建立阿瑜陀耶城，将华富里与素攀府两个权力中心合为一国。1350—1359年间，他以泰人的传统习俗为基础整理成文法典。1369年他去世后，王位在他的儿子与他的姻亲（素攀王室的统治者）之间反复易手。

en: Sai Nam Peung was a king of Ayodhya in the 12th century, the son of Kesariraja and son-in-law of Phra Chao Luang, whose only daughter he married. Before taking Ayodhya he ruled Si Satchanalai, from 1106, and he is dated as king of Ayodhya from 1111 to 1165. The Northern Chronicle makes him the hero of a famous tale: he took a Chinese princess, Soi Dok Mak, as his queen. His son Dhammikaraja founded Wat Dhammikaraja.
sources: https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/พระนางสร้อยดอกหมาก
https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/วัดธรรมิกราช
zh: 赛南蓬是12世纪的阿踰陀国王，克赖松拉之子，娶了銮王的独生女，是銮王的女婿。他在入主阿踰陀之前，自1106年起治理西萨查那莱，在阿踰陀的在位时间定为1111—1165年。北方编年史把他写成一则著名故事的主角：他迎娶中国公主索伊·多克·马克为王后。他的儿子达摩迦罗阇建造了达摩迦罗阇寺。

en: Suwanracha was the ninth king of Xiān, dated 1289 to 1301. A princess of his court, Sunandhadevi, became the mother of Ramathibodi I, founder of the Ayutthaya Kingdom.
zh: 素旺拉差是暹国第九位君主，在位时间定为1289—1301年。他宫中的公主苏南塔提毗，后来成为大城王国开国君主拉玛铁菩提一世的母亲。

en: Thammaracha was a king of Ayodhya who reigned from 1301 to 1310, after Suwanracha and before Boromracha.
zh: 昙摩罗阇是阿踰陀国王，在位时间为1301—1310年，上承素旺拉差，下启波隆拉差。

en: Uthong II was a king of Ayodhya in the early 13th century, dated 1205 to 1253, who had earlier ruled the town of Uthong. He belonged to the Uthong line that later produced Ramathibodi I, founder of Ayutthaya.
zh: 乌通二世是13世纪前期的阿踰陀国王，在位时间定为1205—1253年，此前曾治理乌通城。他属于乌通王朝，后来建立大城的拉玛铁菩提一世就出自这一脉。

en: Agha Muhammad Khan Qajar (1742–1797) founded the Qajar dynasty of Iran. Born in Astarabad to a chieftain of the Turkoman Qajar tribe, he was captured and castrated as a boy by the Afsharid ruler Adel Shah, then held hostage for sixteen years at Karim Khan Zand's court in Shiraz. Escaping in 1779, he fought his brothers and rival Zand claimants in a long struggle to reunify Iran and made Tehran his capital in 1786. In 1794 he defeated the Zand ruler Lotf Ali Khan and devastated Kerman after taking it. He sacked Tbilisi in 1795 and was crowned shahanshah in 1796. During another South Caucasus campaign in 1797, he was assassinated and succeeded by his nephew Fath-Ali Shah.
zh: 阿迦·穆罕默德汗·卡扎尔（1742—1797）是伊朗卡扎尔王朝的开国之君。他生于阿斯塔拉巴德，出身突厥蛮卡扎尔部首领家族，幼年被阿夫沙尔王朝统治者阿德尔沙俘获并阉割，随后又在设拉子的卡里姆汗·赞德宫廷中当了十六年人质。1779年他逃脱，与兄弟和赞德王位争夺者长期交战以重新统一伊朗，1786年定德黑兰为都。1794年他击败赞德统治者卢特夫·阿里汗，攻陷克尔曼后大肆破坏。1795年他洗劫第比利斯，1796年加冕为沙汗沙。1797年，他再次远征南高加索时遇刺身亡，由侄子法塔赫·阿里沙继位。

en: Agostino Barelli (1627–c. 1697) was an Italian High Baroque architect, born in Bologna, where he built the Theatine church of San Bartolomeo e Gaetano. He helped introduce Italian Baroque architecture to Bavaria. In 1662 Electress Henriette Adelaide of Savoy summoned him to Munich to design the Theatinerkirche; modeled on Rome's Sant'Andrea della Valle and founded in 1663, it became one of the first High Baroque churches north of the Alps. In 1664 he also drafted the plans for Nymphenburg Palace. During construction he clashed with the Theatine Antonio Spinelli, the supervisor of the work. He was replaced by Enrico Zuccalli in 1674 and returned to Bologna, where he served as city architect from 1676.
zh: 阿戈斯蒂诺·巴雷利（1627—约1697）是意大利鼎盛巴洛克风格建筑师，生于博洛尼亚，曾在当地修建基耶蒂修会的圣巴托洛梅奥与加埃塔诺教堂。他将意大利巴洛克建筑引入巴伐利亚。1662年，选帝侯夫人萨伏依的亨丽埃特·阿德莱德召他前往慕尼黑设计剧院教堂；该堂以罗马的圣安德烈亚·德拉·瓦莱教堂为蓝本，1663年奠基，是阿尔卑斯山以北最早的鼎盛巴洛克教堂之一。1664年他还绘制了宁芬堡宫的设计图。施工期间他与工程监督、基耶蒂会士安东尼奥·斯皮内利发生冲突。1674年他被恩里科·祖卡利取代，返回博洛尼亚，并于1676年出任该市的官方建筑师。

en: Aqruqchi (died soon after 1306), a son of Kublai Khan, was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiping in 1269. In 1272 he led Mongol princes and Tibetan tribal troops against the Jiandu tribes on the Tibetan border, capturing their chiefs and taking their surrender in 1273. In 1275 he led a campaign into Tibet, and in 1285 he fought the rebel Chagatai khan Duwa without success, marching against him again in 1293. In 1303 the emperor Chengzong granted him more than thirteen thousand households as an appanage. He died shortly after 1306, leaving a son, Temür Buqa.
zh: 奥鲁赤（？—约1306）是元世祖忽必烈之子，1269年受封西平王。1272年，他统领蒙古诸王与吐蕃部族军队征讨边地的建都蛮，1273年擒获其首领、接受投降。1275年他又率军进入吐蕃；1285年抵御叛王笃哇，作战失利，1293年再度西征笃哇。1303年，元成宗赐他一万三千六百余户为食邑。约1306年之后不久去世，子铁木儿不花。

en: Ahmed Tekuder (c. 1246–1284), a son of Hulagu and brother of Abaqa, was Ilkhan of Iran from 1282 to 1284. Baptized a Nestorian Christian in childhood with the name Nicholas, he had converted to Islam by his accession and ruled as Sultan Ahmad. He reversed Abaqa's pro-Christian policies and sought an alliance with the Mamluk sultan Qalawun. His purges drove his nephew Arghun, Abaqa's son, into revolt. Arghun surrendered in 1284 but was freed by Buqa; Tekuder fled, was captured and handed over to Arghun, and was executed on 10 August. Arghun took the Ilkhanid throne.
zh: 艾哈迈德·贴古迭儿（约1246—1284）是旭烈兀之子、阿八哈之弟，1282至1284年任伊儿汗。他幼年受景教洗礼、教名尼古拉，即位前已改宗伊斯兰教，以“算端艾哈迈德”之名统治。他一改阿八哈亲基督教的政策，转而谋求与马穆鲁克苏丹嘉拉温结盟。他的整肃迫使侄子阿鲁浑（阿八哈之子）起兵。1284年阿鲁浑投降后获不花解救；贴古迭儿逃亡途中被捕，交给阿鲁浑，并于8月10日被处死。阿鲁浑继承了伊儿汗位。

en: Sukhaangphaa was the fourth swargadeo, or king, of the Ahom kingdom in Assam, and the eldest son of King Subinphaa. He came to the throne at Charaideo in 1293. Around 1324 he began his realm's first major war against a neighbour, invading the Kamata kingdom of King Durlabh Narayan. The long struggle ended without a clear victory: Durlabh Narayan sued for peace and gave his daughter Rajani to Sukhaangphaa in marriage, sealing a truce. After a reign of thirty-nine years, Sukhaangphaa died in 1332.
zh: 苏汉法是阿萨姆阿豪姆王国第四任国王（斯瓦尔加德奥），老国王苏宾法的长子，1293年在查莱碉即位。约1324年，他发动阿豪姆人对邻邦的第一场大战，入侵卡马塔国王杜尔拉布·纳拉扬的国土。这场旷日持久的战争未分胜负：杜尔拉布·纳拉扬求和，把女儿拉贾尼嫁给苏汉法，双方缔结盟约。苏汉法在位39年，于1332年去世。

en: Sukhrangpha, also called Tao Shukhampha, was king of the Ahom kingdom from 1332 to 1364. Early in his reign his youngest brother Chao Pulai plotted against him and fled to Kamata, where their maternal uncle, the king, sent troops to back him. Sukhrangpha avoided battle and reconciled with his brother by making him Charing Raja, a post that later went to the heir apparent. The rest of his reign was peaceful. He died in 1364 after thirty-two years on the throne, and some historians hold that the throne then stood vacant until 1369.
zh: 苏克朗帕，又称道·舒卡姆帕，于1332—1364年为阿洪姆王国国王。即位初期，他最小的弟弟召普莱图谋推翻他，逃往卡马塔王国，其舅父卡马塔国王派兵支持。苏克朗帕避免交战，与弟弟和解，任命他为新设的恰林王，此职之后通常授予王储。他在位的其余时间平静无事。他于1364年去世，在位三十二年，一些史家认为此后王位空缺至1369年。

en: Sutuphaa, a younger brother of Sukhrangpha, was king of the Ahom kingdom from 1369 to 1376, after an interregnum (some historians date his accession to 1364). He wanted to expand his kingdom, and his reign was marked by frequent conflict with the neighbouring Sutiya kingdom. In 1376 the Sutiya king invited him to a regatta on the Safrai river, lured him onto his own barge without attendants, and had him murdered there. The Ahom escort returned to the capital with the news.
zh: 苏图帕是苏克朗帕的弟弟，1369—1376年为阿洪姆王国国王，在此之前有一段空位期（有史家认为他在1364年即位）。他想扩张疆土，在位期间与邻国苏提亚王国屡有交战。1376年，苏提亚国王邀他到萨弗莱河上参加划船竞赛，把他引上自己的船，没有随从，并在船上将他杀害。护送他的阿洪姆士兵返回都城报讯。

en: Tyao Khamti, a younger brother of Sutuphaa, became king of the Ahom kingdom in 1380, ending an interregnum that followed Sutuphaa's murder. He was brave and led his army against the Chutia kingdom himself. However, he was too much under the influence of his elder queen. She had his favourite younger queen falsely accused and ordered her execution, but ministers set her adrift on the Brahmaputra instead. Believing her executed, he did not act against the elder queen. Later the nobles had him assassinated, and the elder queen was put to death as well.
zh: 召坎提是苏图帕的弟弟，1380年即位为阿洪姆王国国王，结束了苏图帕遇害后的空位期。他勇武，曾亲自率军攻打苏提亚王国。但他过分受长王后左右。长王后诬陷他宠爱的年轻王后并下令处决，但大臣将她放逐于布拉马普特拉河上。召坎提以为年轻王后已被处死，却没有对长王后采取行动。之后，贵族将他刺杀，长王后也被处死。

en: Kamal al-Din al-Damiri (1341–1405) was a Shafi'i Sunni scholar of Cairo, trained in jurisprudence, hadith and theology at al-Azhar under masters such as Baha al-Din al-Subki. In his youth he worked with his father in a sewing shop before pursuing religious studies. He taught at al-Azhar and the Rukniyya school and gave lessons in the mosque of al-Zahir Baybars; the historian al-Maqrizi was among his students. Known as an ascetic Sufi, he made the pilgrimage to Mecca more than six times. Around 1371 he completed the Ḥayāt al-ḥayawān al-kubrā, the first systematic Arabic work on zoology, arranging animal lore together with law, proverbs and medicine.
zh: 卡迈勒丁·达米里（1341—1405）是开罗的沙斐仪派逊尼学者，在爱资哈尔清真寺随巴哈丁·苏卜基等大师学习教法、圣训与教义学。青年时他曾与父亲在裁缝铺工作，后来才研习宗教。他在爱资哈尔和鲁克尼耶学堂授课，也在扎希尔·拜伯尔斯清真寺讲学，史家马克里齐是他的学生之一。他以苦行的苏菲修士闻名，曾六次以上前往麦加朝觐。约1371年，他完成《动物生活》，这是第一部系统的阿拉伯语动物学著作，将动物知识与教法、谚语和医药编排在一起。

en: Taqi al-Din al-Maqrizi (1364–1442) was the leading Egyptian historian of the Mamluk age, born in Cairo to a family of Damascene origin and a direct student of Ibn Khaldun. Trained in Hanafi law, he later followed the Shafi'i and then the Zahiri school. After serving as a secretary, in 1399 he became inspector of markets for Cairo and northern Egypt, then preacher at the Mosque of Amr ibn al-As and head of the al-Hakim Mosque; in 1408 he took a lectureship in Damascus. In 1430 he went on pilgrimage with his family and travelled for some five years, afterwards devoting himself to historical and biographical works, with a particular interest in the Fatimid era and earlier Egyptian history.
zh: 塔基丁·马克里齐（1364—1442）是马穆鲁克时代首屈一指的埃及史家，生于开罗，家族来自大马士革，曾直接受教于伊本·赫勒敦。他研习哈乃斐派教法，后来转奉沙斐仪派，最终改宗宰希里派。他先任文书，1399年出任开罗与北埃及的市场监察官，随后任阿慕尔·本·阿斯清真寺讲道师和哈基姆清真寺住持，1408年前往大马士革讲学。1430年他携家朝觐并在外游历约五年，此后潜心撰写历史与传记作品，尤其关注法蒂玛王朝与埃及早期历史。

en: Agnes of Périgord (died 1345) was the wife of John of Gravina, Duke of Durazzo and brother of King Robert of Naples. Robert arranged the match in 1321 to win papal and French support for his designs in northern Italy. Her sister Rosemburge had married a grand-nephew of Pope John XXII, and her brother Hélie de Talleyrand-Périgord became a cardinal and a major figure of the Avignon papacy. She bore three sons, Charles, Louis and Robert. Widowed in 1335, she became a political force at court, and after King Robert's death in 1343 she married her eldest son Charles to Maria of Calabria, the late king's granddaughter, to draw the Durazzo line nearer the throne. Her meddling in papal diplomacy in 1345 turned Queen Joanna further against her. She died that May, reportedly poisoned by Joanna's ladies, though the tale may be fiction. Charles was executed in 1348, but her grandson Charles of Durazzo seized the crown in 1382.
zh: 佩里戈尔的阿格妮丝（?—1345）是杜拉佐公爵、格拉维纳的约翰之妻，约翰是那不勒斯国王罗贝托的弟弟。1321年，罗贝托撮合了这门亲事，想借此争取教廷与法国对他经营意大利北部的支持。阿格妮丝的姐妹罗桑布尔热嫁给教皇若望二十二世的侄孙，她的兄弟埃利·德·塔列朗-佩里戈尔后来升任枢机，是阿维尼翁教廷里的头面人物。她与约翰生下查理、路易吉、罗贝托三个儿子。1335年守寡后，她成为宫廷中的一股政治力量；1343年国王罗贝托驾崩，她随即安排长子查理迎娶老王的孙女卡拉布里亚的玛丽亚，想让杜拉佐一系更接近王位。1345年，她插手与教廷有关的外交，使乔万娜女王对她更为不满。同年5月她去世，传说是被乔万娜身边的女眷毒杀，不过这一说法可能出于虚构。查理于1348年被处死，但她的孙子杜拉佐的查理在1382年夺取了王位。

en: Charles of Durazzo (1323–1348), eldest son of John, Duke of Durazzo, and Agnes of Périgord, led the Anjou-Durazzo faction against his cousin, Queen Joanna I of Naples. He succeeded his father as Duke of Durazzo and Count of Gravina in 1336. In April 1343 he and his mother abducted Maria of Calabria, Joanna's younger sister, who had been meant for Louis I of Hungary or John of France, and he married her at Naples to move closer to the throne. He kept carefully aloof from the plot that murdered Joanna's husband Andrew, but opposed the queen and Louis of Taranto and sought support from the Hungarian court. When Louis of Hungary invaded in 1348 and Joanna fled, Charles hoped to turn it to his own ends; instead the Hungarians seized him and beheaded him at Aversa. His daughter Margaret later married Charles III of Naples.
zh: 杜拉佐公爵卡洛（1323—1348）是杜拉佐公爵乔凡尼与佩里戈尔的阿格妮丝的长子，领导安茹—杜拉佐一系对抗他的堂亲、那不勒斯女王乔万娜一世。1336年父亲死后，他继任杜拉佐公爵和格拉维纳伯爵。1343年4月，他与母亲劫持了乔万娜的妹妹、卡拉布里亚的玛丽亚——她原本被许配给匈牙利的拉约什一世或法国的让——并在那不勒斯娶她为妻，借此更接近王位。乔万娜之夫安德拉什遇害的阴谋，他小心置身事外，却反对女王与塔兰托的路易吉，并向匈牙利宫廷寻求支持。1348年匈牙利国王拉约什一世入侵、乔万娜出逃时，卡洛想把局面为己所用，结果被匈牙利人抓住，在阿韦尔萨斩首。他的女儿玛格丽塔后来嫁给了那不勒斯国王卡洛三世。

en: Philip I of Taranto (1278–1331), younger son of Charles II of Naples, was made Prince of Taranto in 1294. He married Thamar, daughter of Nikephoros, Despot of Epirus, receiving Achaea and Albania; around 1297 he claimed Epirus itself as Despot of Romania. Captured by the Aragonese at La Falconara in 1299, he was later freed. After divorcing Thamar in 1309, he married the titular Latin Empress Catherine of Valois in 1313 and claimed Constantinople through her. He gave Achaea first to Matilda of Hainaut, then in 1318 to his brother John of Gravina, and died in December 1331.
zh: 塔兰托亲王菲利波一世（1278—1331）是那不勒斯国王卡洛二世的幼子之一，1294年受封塔兰托亲王，同年娶伊庇鲁斯专制君主尼基弗鲁斯一世之女塔玛尔，获得亚该亚和阿尔巴尼亚；约1297年他自称罗马尼亚专制君主，进而宣称伊庇鲁斯。1299年，他在拉法尔科纳拉被阿拉贡人俘获，后获释。1309年他与塔玛尔离婚，1313年娶名义上的拉丁女皇瓦卢瓦的凯瑟琳，并借她声称拥有君士坦丁堡。他先把亚该亚交给埃诺的玛蒂尔德，1318年又转给弟弟杜拉佐的乔凡尼，1331年12月去世。

en: John of Gravina (1294–1336), youngest son of Charles II of Naples, was a prince of the Capetian House of Anjou. In 1315 he succeeded his brother Peter, killed at Montecatini, as Count of Gravina. In 1318 his brother Philip I of Taranto forced Matilda of Hainaut, Princess of Achaea, to marry him. Matilda refused to surrender her rights and secretly married Hugh de La Palice; Philip stripped her of Achaea and granted it to John, and their marriage was annulled. A 1325 expedition to the Morea failed to retake Skorta from Byzantium. In 1332 John, unwilling to swear fealty to his nephew Robert of Taranto, exchanged Achaea for claims to Albania and ruled as Duke of Durazzo until his death in April 1336.
zh: 杜拉佐的乔凡尼（1294—1336）是那不勒斯国王卡洛二世的幼子，出身卡佩安茹家族。1315年，其兄皮耶特罗在蒙特卡蒂尼被杀，他继任格拉维纳伯爵。1318年，其兄塔兰托的菲利波一世强迫亚该亚女亲王埃诺的玛蒂尔德嫁给他。玛蒂尔德拒绝交出自己的权利，并秘密嫁给于格·德·拉帕利斯；菲利波剥夺了她的亚该亚领地，将其赐给乔凡尼，两人的婚姻也被废除。1325年他远征摩里亚，未能从拜占庭手中夺回斯科塔。1332年，他不愿向侄子塔兰托的罗贝托宣誓效忠，以亚该亚换取对阿尔巴尼亚的权利，此后以杜拉佐公爵的身份统治，直至1336年4月去世。

en: Thamar Angelina Komnene (died c. 1311), daughter of Nikephoros I Komnenos Doukas, Despot of Epirus, and Anna Palaiologina Kantakouzene, married Charles II of Naples' fourth son Philip I of Taranto at L'Aquila in August 1294, bringing four southern Epirote castles as dowry. When Philip was captured by the Aragonese in 1299, she pawned her coronet to raise his ransom and did not see him again until 1302. Despite the marriage terms she was forced to convert to Catholicism. In 1309 Philip accused her of adultery and divorced her; she died around 1311, either as a nun or in prison.
zh: 塔玛尔（约1311年卒）是伊庇鲁斯专制君主尼基弗鲁斯一世·科穆宁·杜卡斯与安娜·巴列奥略·坎塔库泽内之女。1294年8月，她在阿布鲁佐的拉奎拉下嫁卡洛二世第四子、塔兰托亲王菲利波一世，以伊庇鲁斯南部四座城堡为嫁妆。1299年菲利波被阿拉贡人俘获，她典押后冠筹集赎金，直到1302年才与他重聚。尽管婚约有过承诺，她仍被迫改宗天主教。1309年，菲利波指控她通奸并将她休弃；她此后或为修女，或遭囚禁，约1311年去世。

en: Aldus Manutius (c. 1449–1515) was an Italian humanist and printer, born at Bassiano near Rome. After studying in Rome and Ferrara and tutoring the Pio princes of Carpi, he settled in Venice in 1490 and founded the Aldine Press with Andrea Torresano. He devoted it to accurate editions of Greek and Latin classics from Aristotle to Virgil. Greek texts had rarely been printed because of the difficulty of producing a standard typeface, but his editions appeared in the original language. He commissioned the first italic typeface, helped standardize the comma and semicolon, and issued cheap pocket-sized octavos under his dolphin-and-anchor mark, pioneering the portable book. Erasmus was among his authors.
zh: 阿尔杜斯·马努提乌斯（约1449—1515）是意大利人文主义者与印刷商，生于罗马附近的巴西亚诺。他曾在罗马和费拉拉求学，并担任卡尔皮的皮奥家族亲王的教师，1490年定居威尼斯，与安德烈亚·托雷萨诺共同创办阿尔丁出版社，致力于刊印从亚里士多德到维吉尔等希腊语、拉丁语经典的精校本。由于标准希腊字模难以制作，希腊语书籍此前很少付印，而他的版本使用原文。他委托匠人创制了最早的斜体活字，推动了逗号与分号用法的规范化，并以“海豚与锚”为标志发行廉价便携的八开本，开便携书籍之先河；伊拉斯谟也曾在他的出版社出书。

en: Amaury III de Craon (c. 1280–1333), lord of Craon, Créon, Mareuil and Sablé, served the English crown as Seneschal of Gascony in 1313–1316 and again in 1320–1322, and in 1315 obtained leave from Edward II to found the bastide of Créon. He held the hereditary seneschalties of Anjou, Maine and Touraine, which the French crown bought back in 1323 and 1331 amid the creation of lieutenants-general to protect the frontier provinces. By Isabelle de Sainte-Maure he had a son, Maurice VII; by his second wife Béatrice de Roucy he had Pierre de La Suze, Guillaume I and Jean III, Archbishop of Reims. Amaury died in 1333 and was buried at the Cordeliers convent in Angers.
zh: 阿马尔里克三世·德·克朗（约1280—1333）领有克朗、克雷永、马勒伊和萨布莱。他于1313年至1316年、1320年至1322年两度代表英格兰王室出任加斯科涅总管，1315年获英王爱德华二世特许，在克雷永兴建防御城镇巴斯蒂德。他还世袭安茹、曼恩和图赖讷的总管职位；为保卫边境省份而设立总督之际，法兰西王室在1323年和1331年赎回了这些职位。他与第一任妻子伊莎贝尔·德·圣莫尔生子莫里斯七世；与第二任妻子贝阿特丽丝·德·鲁西生子皮埃尔·德·拉叙兹、纪尧姆一世，以及后来成为兰斯大主教的让三世。阿马尔里克于1333年去世，葬于昂热方济各会修院。

en: Amaury IV de Craon (1326–1373) was a powerful Angevin baron, son of Maurice VII de Craon and Marguerite de Mello, whose family were hereditary seneschals of Anjou and Maine. In 1345 he married Péronnelle, viscountess of Thouars. Captured at the Battle of Poitiers in 1356, he became one of Charles V's leading captains. As vicomte consort of Thouars he later defected to the English, leading the Anglo-Poitevin coalition against Bertrand du Guesclin. Besieged at Thouars in 1372, he surrendered and swore fealty to Charles V. He died on 30 May 1373 and was buried at Angers.
zh: 阿马尔里克四世·德·克朗（1326—1373）是安茹的权势男爵，莫里斯七世·德·克朗与玛格丽特·德·梅洛之子，其家族世袭安茹与曼恩总管之职。1345年，他娶图阿尔女子爵佩罗内勒为妻。1356年他在普瓦捷战役中被俘，其后成为查理五世在法兰西部最重要的统兵官之一。他以图阿尔子爵配偶的身份倒向英格兰，率领英格兰—普瓦图联军对抗贝特朗·杜·盖克兰；1372年图阿尔遭围攻，他投降并向查理五世宣誓效忠，1373年5月30日去世，葬于昂热。

en: Béatrice de Roucy-Pierrepont (c. 1285–1328) was a daughter of Jean IV, Count of Roucy, and Jeanne de Dreux. In 1312 she became the second wife of Amaury III de Craon, and bore him Guillaume I de Craon and Jean III, Archbishop of Reims.
zh: 贝阿特丽丝·德·鲁西（约1285—1328）是鲁西伯爵让四世与让娜·德·德勒之女。1312年，她嫁给阿马尔里克三世·德·克朗为第二任妻子，生子纪尧姆一世·德·克朗和后来成为兰斯大主教的让三世。

en: Charles II, called the Magnanimous (1297–1346), was Count of Alençon and Perche, second son of Charles of Valois and younger brother of Philip VI, who took the French throne in 1328. He first fought in Guyenne under his father; when his father died in December 1325 he received Alençon and lands including Champrond and Senonches. He fought at Cassel in 1328. When Edward III of England challenged Philip's crown and refused homage, the king made Charles lieutenant general of the kingdom and sent him against an English-stirred revolt at Saintes, where he retook several strongholds. After war over the Breton succession broke out, Philip gave him L'Aigle, confiscated from Jean de Montfort. At Crécy on 26 August 1346 he commanded the vanguard and was killed; his eldest son Charles III succeeded him in Alençon.
zh: 查理二世绰号“宽宏者”（1297—1346），是阿朗松伯爵兼佩尔什伯爵，瓦卢瓦的查理的次子，也是1328年登上法国王位的腓力六世之弟。他早年随父亲在吉耶讷作战；1325年12月父亲去世，他继承阿朗松以及尚普龙、瑟农什等领地。1328年他参加卡塞尔战役。英王爱德华三世挑战腓力的王位，并拒绝行臣服礼，国王便任命查理为王国中将，派他去镇压英国人煽动的桑特叛乱，他夺回了数处要塞。布列塔尼继承战争爆发后，腓力把从让·德·蒙福尔手中没收的莱格勒交给了他。1346年8月26日，他在克雷西战役中率领前锋，战死沙场；长子查理三世继承阿朗松。

en: Charles III of Alençon (1337–1375) inherited the counties of Alençon and Perche as a boy after his father Charles II was killed at Crécy in 1346. In 1361 he renounced his titles, entered the Dominican convent in Paris, and with King John II's approval left Alençon to his brother Peter and Perche to Robert. At the insistence of his kinsman King Charles V, he was made archbishop of Lyon on 13 July 1365. The cathedral chapter, intent on protecting its right to elect an archbishop independently, agreed to him only after three rounds of voting. As primate he fiercely defended the see's rights; when a royal official tried to deprive him of his temporal power in 1372, he imposed an interdict that lasted until his death on 5 July 1375.
zh: 阿朗松的查理三世（1337—1375）在父亲查理二世于1346年克雷西战死后，幼年继承阿朗松与佩尔什两地伯国。1361年，他放弃爵位，进入巴黎的多明我会修道院；经法王约翰二世批准，他将阿朗松留给弟弟皮埃尔，佩尔什留给罗贝尔。1365年7月13日，在亲属法王查理五世的力主下，他出任里昂大主教。主教座堂参事会为维护独立选举大主教的权利，经过三轮投票才同意他的任命。任内他极力维护教区权利；1372年，一名王室官员试图剥夺他的世俗权力，他遂颁布禁罚令，直到1375年7月5日去世才解除。

en: Guillaume I de Craon, called the Great (c. 1318–1388), was the second son of Amaury III de Craon by Béatrice de Roucy and the founder of the Châteaudun branch of his house. Around 1337 he traded his inherited one-sixth share of Château-du-Loir to a distant cousin, Pierre de Dreux, for Domart-en-Ponthieu and Bernaville. On 4 May 1341 he married Marguerite of Flanders-Termonde, Viscountess of Châteaudun, and held the viscounty through her. In 1345 he inherited La Ferté-Bernard from his brother-in-law Ingelger of Amboise. He served as a royal chamberlain. Not every day went well: in early 1361 he rode with Bertrand du Guesclin to fight Hugh Calveley at Juigné-sur-Sarthe, and in the middle of the fight he and eighty of his men-at-arms fled, leaving Du Guesclin to be captured. Of his eight children, the sons Guillaume II, Pierre and Jean I carried the Châteaudun line forward.
zh: 纪尧姆一世·德·克朗，号称“伟大者”（约1318—1388），是阿马尔里克三世·德·克朗与贝阿特丽丝·德·鲁西的次子，克朗家族沙托丹支系的始祖。约1337年，他以继承的沙托迪卢瓦六分之一份额，与远房表亲皮埃尔·德·德勒交换了多马尔昂蓬蒂约和贝尔纳维尔。1341年5月4日，他娶沙托丹女子爵玛格丽特·德·佛兰德-泰尔蒙德为妻，凭借妻权领有沙托丹子国。1345年，他从姻兄昂布瓦斯的英热尔热继承拉费泰贝尔纳。他曾任王室侍从。但他也有难堪的一天：1361年初，他与贝特朗·杜·盖克兰在于尼耶苏尔萨尔特迎战休·卡尔弗利，战斗正酣时，他带着八十名重装骑兵临阵逃走，丢下杜·盖克兰被俘。八个子女中，儿子纪尧姆二世、皮埃尔和让一世延续了沙托丹支系。

en: Isabeau de Craon (c. 1330–1394), daughter of Maurice VII de Craon and Marguerite de Mello, was the sister and sole heiress of Amaury IV de Craon, inheriting the barony of Craon in 1373. Betrothed as a child to Guy XI de Laval in 1339, she was assigned dower lands at Acquigny after his death in 1348, although it is uncertain whether their marriage took place. She then married Louis de Sully, an English partisan, against whom she sought the protection of Louis I, Duke of Anjou, in 1376. Her daughter Marie de Sully inherited Craon and in 1383 married Guy VI de La Trémoïlle. Isabeau died in February 1394 and was buried at Angers.
zh: 伊莎博·德·克朗（约1330—1394）是莫里斯七世·德·克朗与玛格丽特·德·梅洛之女，也是阿马尔里克四世·德·克朗的姐姐和唯一继承人，于1373年承袭克朗男爵领。她于1339年幼时与拉瓦勒的居伊十一世订婚，居伊1348年去世后，她获分阿基尼的寡妇产，两人是否完婚则存疑。其后她嫁给亲英的路易·德·叙利，1376年曾被迫请求安茹公爵路易一世庇护以对付丈夫。她的女儿玛丽·德·叙利承袭克朗，于1383年嫁给居伊六世·德·拉特雷穆瓦耶。伊莎博于1394年2月去世，葬于昂热。

en: Jean III de Craon (1329–26 March 1373) was a French prelate, the son of Amaury III de Craon and Béatrice de Roucy-Pierrepont. He became Bishop of Le Mans in 1350 and in 1355 was promoted Archbishop of Reims, the see whose archbishops crowned the kings of France, with the rank of Peer of France. With his brother Pierre I de Craon and Marshal Boucicaut he negotiated the Treaty of Guérande, ending the Breton Succession War in favour of the House of Montfort. He died on 26 March 1373.
zh: 让三世·德·克朗（1329—1373年3月26日）是14世纪的法兰西高级教士，阿马尔里克三世·德·克朗与贝阿特丽丝·德·鲁西-皮埃尔蓬之子。他于1350年任勒芒主教，1355年升任兰斯大主教，该教座的大主教负责为法兰西国王加冕，他本人位列法兰西重臣。他与兄弟皮埃尔一世·德·克朗、元帅布锡考特一同谈判《盖朗德条约》，结束了布列塔尼继承战争，确认蒙福尔家族的公爵地位。1373年3月26日去世。

en: Jeanne de Craon, also called Aliénor, was the daughter of Maurice VII de Craon and Marguerite de Mello. She married Renaud Savary, lord of Montbazon, and their daughter and heiress Jeanne de Montbazon married Guillaume II de Craon, Viscount of Châteaudun, in 1372.
zh: 让娜·德·克朗，又名阿莉埃诺，是莫里斯七世·德·克朗与玛格丽特·德·梅洛之女。她嫁给蒙巴宗领主勒诺·萨瓦里，其独女兼继承人让娜·德·蒙巴宗于1372年嫁给沙托丹子爵纪尧姆二世·德·克朗。

en: Margaret of Dampierre (c. 1320–1387) was a Flemish noblewoman of the Dampierre-Flanders-Dendermonde branch, granddaughter of William of Dendermonde, and daughter of John of Dampierre and Béatrix de Châtillon. In her own right she was viscountess of Châteaudun. On 4 May 1341 she married Guillaume I de Craon, known as Guillaume le Grand, a royal chamberlain, carrying the viscounty of Châteaudun into the Craon family. They had eight children, among them Guillaume II de Craon and Pierre de Craon, called le Grand.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·当皮埃尔（约1320—约1387）是佛兰德贵族女性，出身当皮埃尔—佛兰德—登德尔蒙德支系，为登德尔蒙德的威廉之孙女、让·德·当皮埃尔与贝阿特丽丝·德·沙蒂永之女，本人是沙托丹女子爵。1341年5月4日，她嫁给人称“大纪尧姆”的王室侍从官纪尧姆一世·德·克朗，沙托丹子爵领由此随她转入克朗家族。两人育有八名子女，包括纪尧姆二世·德·克朗和人称“大者”的皮埃尔·德·克朗。

en: María de la Cerda y de Lara (1319–1375) was a Castilian noblewoman, the youngest daughter of Fernando de la Cerda and Juana Núñez de Lara. In April 1335 she married Charles d'Évreux at Poissy; he died in September 1336, leaving her with twin sons, Louis and Jean. Three months later she married Charles II, Count of Alençon, becoming countess of Alençon. Her second husband was killed at the Battle of Crécy in 1346. She died in Paris on 13 March 1375 and was buried in the church of the Couvent des Jacobins.
zh: 玛丽亚·德·拉·塞尔达·伊·德·拉腊（1319—1375）是卡斯蒂利亚贵族女性，费尔南多·德·拉·塞尔达与胡安娜·努涅斯·德·拉腊的幼女。1335年4月，她在普瓦西嫁给埃夫勒的查理；丈夫于1336年9月去世，留下她与一对双胞胎儿子路易和让。三个月后她改嫁阿朗松伯爵查理二世，成为阿朗松伯爵夫人。1346年，第二任丈夫在克雷西战役中阵亡。1375年3月13日她在巴黎去世，葬于雅各宾修道院教堂。

en: Maurice VII de Craon (c. 1304–8 August 1330) was the only son of Amaury III de Craon and his first wife Isabelle de Sainte-Maure. His mother's death in December 1310 made him lord of Sainte-Maure and Marcillac, and through his marriage to Marguerite de Mello in 1323 he also held Bois-Pouvreau, Sanxay and her other fiefs. An earlier betrothal to Jeanne de Conflans, who had been raised by his father, had been broken off before 1320; Marguerite too was placed in Amaury's care. Maurice predeceased his father, dying on 8 August 1330, so he never ruled Craon itself; his son Amaury IV succeeded Amaury III as lord in 1333. Maurice was buried in the family chapel at the Cordeliers convent in Angers.
zh: 莫里斯七世·德·克朗（约1304—1330年8月8日）是阿马尔里克三世·德·克朗与第一任妻子伊莎贝尔·德·圣莫尔的独子。1310年12月母亲去世后，他成为圣莫尔和马西亚克的领主；1323年娶玛格丽特·德·梅洛，又借妻权领有布瓦普夫罗、桑赛等封地。此前他与让娜·德·孔夫朗的婚约在1320年之前解除；让娜曾由他的父亲抚养，玛格丽特也被托付给阿马尔里克抚养。他先于父亲在1330年8月8日去世，从未成为克朗本地的领主；其子阿马尔里克四世于1333年承袭祖父的地位。莫里斯葬于昂热方济各会修院的家族礼拜堂。

en: Peter I of Alençon (29 June 1251 – 6 April 1283) was a son of Louis IX of France and Margaret of Provence, born at Château Pèlerin in the Kingdom of Jerusalem during the Seventh Crusade. In 1268 his father gave him Alençon and Perche in appanage, and he joined the Eighth Crusade to Tunis in 1270. His marriage to Joan of Châtillon in 1272 brought him Blois, Chartres and Guise. After the Sicilian Vespers he led troops to aid his uncle Charles I of Anjou, and died at Salerno in 1283 without surviving sons, so Alençon reverted to the crown.
zh: 阿朗松的皮埃尔一世（1251年6月29日—1283年4月6日）是法兰西国王路易九世与普罗旺斯的玛格丽特之子，生于第七次十字军东征期间耶路撒冷王国的朝圣者城堡。1268年，父亲将阿朗松与佩尔什作为封邑封给他；1270年他参加远征突尼斯的第八次十字军。1272年，他与沙蒂永的让娜结婚，获得布卢瓦、沙特尔和吉斯三地。西西里晚祷事件后，他率军支援叔父安茹的查理一世，1283年在萨莱诺去世，未留存活子嗣，阿朗松封邑由此收归王室。

en: Pierre I de Craon (c. 1315–1376), lord of La Suze, was the elder son of Amaury III de Craon by Béatrice de Roucy. He fought for Charles de Blois in the Breton Succession War, the contest between Blois and the Montfort claimant for the duchy. At the siege of La Roche-Derrien in 1350, his men lacking ardour, he hung his purse from a pole and promised it to the first soldier into the town; the place was taken. In 1356 he shut himself into Romorantin with Boucicaut to hold off the Black Prince. The defenders beat back several assaults before English engineers set up cannon, the first use of artillery in a French siege, and Craon surrendered. Taken at Poitiers that year, he was among the hostages Edward III demanded for King John II's ransom. With his brother Archbishop Jean III de Craon and Boucicaut he later negotiated the Treaty of Guérande, which recognised Montfort as Duke of Brittany.
zh: 皮埃尔一世·德·克朗（约1315—1376），拉叙兹领主，是阿马尔里克三世·德·克朗与贝阿特丽丝·德·鲁西的长子。他在布列塔尼继承战争中为夏尔·德·布卢瓦效力，这场战争的双方是布卢瓦与争夺公爵之位的蒙福尔。1350年围攻拉罗什德里安时，士兵士气低落，他把钱袋挂在一根杆子上，许诺赏给第一个入城的人，城随即被攻下。1356年，他与布锡考特一同困守罗莫朗坦，抵挡黑太子的进攻。守军顶住了数次猛攻，直到英军工兵架起火炮，这是火炮首次用于法兰西的围城战，克朗随后投降。同年他在普瓦捷战役中被俘，成为爱德华三世要求交出的人质之一，用以抵偿约翰二世的赎金。后来他与兄弟、兰斯大主教让三世·德·克朗和布锡考特一同谈判达成《盖朗德条约》，承认蒙福尔为布列塔尼公爵。

en: Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Abi Dabbus was an Almohad prince descended from Abu Dabbus Idris II, last Almohad caliph, killed by the Marinids at Marrakesh in 1269. After his family failed to claim the Hafsid throne and was exiled to Egypt in 1344, he returned to Ifriqiya and settled in Tozeur, working as a tailor. In 1348, while Arab tribes in revolt were defeating the Marinid sultan Abu al-Hasan near Kairouan, the Ku'ub and their allies found the tailor and proclaimed him sultan. With Ibn Tafragin he besieged the citadel of Tunis, but his allies deserted him; he was handed to Abu al-Hasan and later went to Spain.
zh: 阿布·阿巴斯·艾哈迈德，世称伊本·阿比·达布斯，是穆瓦希德王公，祖上是末代穆瓦希德哈里发阿布·达布斯·伊德里斯二世，此人于1269年马林人攻占马拉喀什时被杀。其家族争夺哈夫斯王位失败，1344年被流放埃及，他后来返回伊夫里奇亚，定居托泽尔，以裁缝为生。1348年，阿拉伯部落起兵，在凯鲁万附近击败马林王朝苏丹阿布·哈桑；库卜卜等部落找到这位裁缝，拥立他为苏丹。他与伊本·塔夫拉金一同围攻突尼斯城堡，却被盟友抛弃，遭交给阿布·哈桑，后来前往西班牙。

en: Berthold von Buchegg, who ruled as Berthold II, came from the comital family of Buchegg near Solothurn, the son of Count Heinrich, landgrave of Burgundy. A Teutonic Order commander at Koblenz and an opponent of Louis the Bavarian, he became Pope John XXII's candidate when the see of Speyer fell vacant on Emich of Leiningen's death in April 1328. The cathedral canons ignored a papal warning and elected Walram von Veldenz, a relative of Emich and a supporter of the Wittelsbachs; Berthold failed to prevail even by force and soon yielded the bishopric. The pope's attempt to make him archbishop of Mainz after his brother Matthias died in September also failed. Berthold was then installed at Strasbourg, where he was bishop from 1328 until his death. In 1329 he took the chronicler Matthias von Neuenburg into his service as legal adviser. He died at Molsheim on 25 November 1353.
zh: 贝特霍尔德·冯·布赫格（教名贝特霍尔德二世）出身于索洛图恩附近的布赫格伯爵家族，是勃艮第领地伯爵海因里希之子。他曾任条顿骑士团驻科布伦茨指挥官，反对巴伐利亚的路德维希；1328年4月莱宁根的埃米希去世、施派尔主教之位出缺时，他成了教皇约翰二十二世属意的人选。主教座堂参事会无视教皇的警告，选出埃米希的亲戚、维特尔斯巴赫家族的支持者瓦尔拉姆·冯·韦尔登茨；贝特霍尔德诉诸武力仍未能取胜，不久便让出主教领地。9月其兄弟马蒂亚斯去世后，教皇让他继任美因茨大主教的尝试同样失败。此后他被任命为斯特拉斯堡主教，自1328年任职到去世。1329年，他聘请编年史家马蒂亚斯·冯·诺因堡担任法律顾问。1353年11月25日，他卒于莫尔塞姆。

en: Lamprecht von Brunn, in French Lambert de Buren, was born around 1320–1330 into a lower noble family of northern Alsace and owed his career to his own ability rather than his family's standing. From 1354 he was abbot of Gengenbach, then bishop in turn of Brixen (1363–1364), Speyer (1364–1371) and Strasbourg (1371–1374). At Speyer he first had to reach an agreement with the elected cathedral dean Eberhard von Randeck before taking office in 1365. In 1374 he moved to Bamberg as prince-bishop, became a close adviser of Emperor Charles IV and later chancellor of King Wenceslaus. He founded Nuremberg's Carthusian monastery in 1381, and in 1390 ended the Giechburg inheritance dispute, the last major enlargement of the Bamberg bishopric. His beer tax, the Bierpfennig, was known as the Lambertiner for centuries. In 1395 he founded a hospital at Scheßlitz and gave it his library. He resigned in January 1399 and died at Forchheim on 17 July.
zh: 兰普雷希特·冯·布龙（法语称朗贝尔·德·比伦）约于1320至1330年间生于阿尔萨斯北部的下层贵族家庭，仕途靠的是个人能力，而非家族声望。他自1354年起任根根巴赫修道院院长，此后先后担任布里克森主教（1363—1364）、施派尔主教（1364—1371）和斯特拉斯堡主教（1371—1374）。在施派尔，他先与获选的主教座堂主任司铎埃伯哈德·冯·兰德克达成协议，才于1365年就任。1374年他调任班贝格采邑主教，成为皇帝查理四世的亲信顾问，后任国王文策尔的掌玺大臣。他于1381年在纽伦堡建立加尔都西会修道院，1390年了结吉希堡继承纠纷，这是班贝格主教区最后一次明显扩张。他开征的啤酒税“啤酒芬尼”此后数百年一直被称为“兰贝蒂纳”。1395年，他在舍斯利茨创办医院并捐出藏书。1399年1月辞职，同年7月17日卒于福希海姆。

en: Ala al-Din bin Yusuf was the second bey of the Alaiye beylik, succeeding his father Yusuf, its founder, around the 1350s; Ibn Battuta recorded that the dynasty was of Karamanid descent. His reign was dominated by the coastal campaigns of Peter I of Cyprus, who seized Korikos in 1360 and took Antalya from the Teke bey Mehmet in 1361. Ala al-Din joined Mehmet and the Karamanid bey of the same name against the Cypriots, at one point acknowledging Peter's overlordship. He died in 1364 and was entombed in Alanya's Gülevşen Mosque; his son Mahmud succeeded him.
zh: 阿拉丁·本·优素福是阿拉耶贝伊国第二代贝伊，约1350年代继承其父、开国贝伊优素福之位；伊本·白图泰曾记载该家族出自卡拉曼王族。他在位时主要面对塞浦路斯国王彼得一世的海上攻势：后者1360年夺取科里科斯，1361年又从泰凯贝伊穆罕默德手中攻占安塔利亚。阿拉丁与穆罕默德贝伊及同名的卡拉曼贝伊阿拉丁联合抗敌，并一度承认彼得的宗主权。据阿拉尼亚居莱夫申清真寺的陵墓铭文，他于1364年去世，其子马哈茂德继位。

en: Hüsameddin Mahmud bin Ala al-Din ruled the Alaiye beylik from 1364 until at least 1374, succeeding his father. His reign was spent fighting Peter I of Cyprus: in 1364 a Cypriot force raided the coast to Alanya and stormed the harbor, whereupon Mahmud retaliated by landing on Cyprus and carrying off many captives. In 1366 Peter attacked Alanya with twenty-two ships but was repulsed at the fortress by Turkmen archers. In 1374 Mahmud built Alanya's Gülevşen Mosque to mark the 1373 reconquest of Antalya.
zh: 胡萨姆丁·马哈茂德·本·阿拉丁是阿拉丁贝伊之子，1364年继位，统治阿拉耶至少到1374年。他在位期间持续与塞浦路斯国王彼得一世作战：1364年塞浦路斯军队劫掠沿海直至阿拉尼亚并攻入港口，马哈茂德随即反击，登陆塞浦路斯，掳走大量俘虏。1366年彼得率二十二艘战船来攻阿拉尼亚，在城堡下被土库曼弓箭手击退。1373年泰凯贝伊“断链者”穆罕默德收复安塔利亚，马哈茂德于1374年在阿拉尼亚修建居莱夫申清真寺以资纪念。

en: Yusuf Bey was the founder of the Turkmen beylik of Alaiye, at modern Alanya on the southern Anatolian coast, and a prince of Karamanid descent. Alanya had been conquered from the Franks in 1293 by Bedreddin Mahmud Bey, under whom Yusuf governed the city. By the time the Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta visited him, he ruled as an independent bey, his reign dated 1330–1337. He was the father of Alâeddin bin Yusuf, who held Alaiye from the 1350s until 1364.
zh: 优素福贝伊是安纳托利亚南部海岸今阿拉尼亚一带的土库曼政权阿拉耶贝伊国的开创者，出身卡拉曼家族。1293年，贝德尔丁·马哈茂德贝伊从法兰克人手中攻取阿拉尼亚，优素福曾在其治下管理该城。摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰造访时，他已是独立的贝伊，在位时间为1330至1337年。其子阿拉丁·本·优素福于1350年代至1364年统治阿拉耶。

en: David Mageraghty was an Irish cleric who became Dean of Armagh in 1330 and was consecrated Archbishop of Armagh at Avignon in 1334, holding the see until his death on 16 May 1346.
zh: 大卫·杰拉蒂是爱尔兰教士，1330年获任阿马总铎，1334年在阿维尼翁被祝圣为阿马大主教，在任至1346年5月16日去世。

en: Arnaud Odon (died between 1264 and 1267) was Viscount of Lomagne and, by marriage, Count of Armagnac and Fézensac. The son of Odon V of Lomagne, he wed his cousin Mascarose I, and the couple succeeded her brother Bernard V in 1243. A cousin, Géraud of Fézensaguet, denied the counties could pass through women and made war with Toulouse's backing, while Henry III of England supported Arnaud Odon. After Mascarose died in 1246 he ruled the counties as regent for their daughter Mascarose II, handing them over when she married. The dispute ended with her childless death in 1254. By his second wife Escarone he fathered Vezian III, later Viscount of Lomagne; a third marriage to Marie of Anduze produced a daughter, Philippa.
zh: 阿尔诺·奥东（卒于1264至1267年间）是洛马涅子爵，并因婚姻成为阿马尼亚克与费藏萨克伯爵。他是洛马涅子爵奥东五世之子，娶表亲马斯卡罗斯一世为妻，1243年妻子的兄弟贝尔纳五世死后，两人一同继位。亲族费藏萨盖子爵热拉尔声称伯国不能经女性传承，起兵相争，并得到图卢兹伯爵支持，阿尔诺·奥东则获得英格兰国王亨利三世援助。1246年马斯卡罗斯死后，他以摄政身份为女儿马斯卡罗斯二世保住两个伯国，在女儿成婚时交给她。1254年马斯卡罗斯二世无嗣去世，争端才告结束。第二任妻子埃斯卡龙生有一子韦齐安三世，后来袭任洛马涅子爵；他第三次与安迪兹的玛丽结婚，生有一女菲利帕。

en: Béatrice de Clermont (January 1311–1364), countess of Charolais and a great-granddaughter of King Louis IX of France, married Jean I, Count of Armagnac, by contract in May 1327. She brought him Charolais and bore four children, including Jean II and Martha, queen of Aragon.
zh: 贝娅特丽丝·德·克莱蒙（1311—1364）是沙罗勒女伯爵、法王路易九世曾孙女，1327年5月签约嫁给阿马尼亚克伯爵让一世，带去沙罗勒，生有让二世与阿拉贡王后玛莎等四个子女。

en: Bernard d'Armagnac (1336–1357/1359) was the second son of Jean I, Count of Armagnac, and his wife Béatrice de Clermont, heiress of Charolais. He was the younger brother of Jean II, Count of Armagnac.
zh: 贝尔纳·德·阿马尼亚克（1336—1357/1359）是阿马尼亚克伯爵让一世与妻子、沙罗勒女继承人贝娅特丽丝·德·克莱蒙的次子，也是伯爵让二世的弟弟。

en: Bernard I (died 995), called the Cross-Eyed, was the first Count of Armagnac and the second son of William Garcés, Count of Fézensac. When his father died in 960, his lands were divided: the eldest son Odo received Fézensac, Bernard received Armagnac, and the youngest son Fredelon received Gaure. To atone for his misdeeds Bernard vowed a pilgrimage to Jerusalem but never undertook it, founding instead the basilica of Saint Orens at Auch. By his wife Emerine he had a son, Gerald I Trancaléon, who succeeded him. He died in Normandy in 995.
zh: 贝尔纳一世（？—995），绰号“斜眼者”，是第一代阿马尼亚克伯爵、费藏萨克伯爵纪尧姆·加尔塞斯的次子。960年父亲去世后，领地被一分为三：长子奥多得到费藏萨克，贝尔纳得到阿马尼亚克，幼子弗雷德隆得到戈尔。为赎罪愆，他立誓前往耶路撒冷朝圣却始终未成行，转而在欧什修建了圣奥朗斯圣殿。他与妻子埃梅里纳生有一子，即继位的热拉尔一世·特朗卡莱翁。995年，他在诺曼底去世。

en: Bernard of Fézensaguet (c. 1155–c. 1191), also called Bernard de Lomagne, was the eldest son of Odon de Lomagne, lord of Firmacon, and Mascarose, daughter of Count Géraud III of Armagnac. Around 1172 he married Géralda, possibly a daughter of Roger-Bernard I, Count of Foix. In 1184 his uncle Count Bernard IV adopted him, named him heir to Armagnac and Fézensac should the count have no children, and enfeoffed him with the viscounty of Fézensaguet. Bernard IV was succeeded by his son Géraud IV, but Bernard's own son Géraud V inherited the counties in 1215 and began the second House of Armagnac.
zh: 费藏萨盖的贝尔纳（约1155—约1191），又称贝尔纳·德·洛马涅，是菲尔马孔领主奥东·德·洛马涅与阿马尼亚克伯爵热罗三世之女玛斯卡罗斯的长子。约1172年，他娶热拉尔德为妻，后者可能是富瓦伯爵罗歇-贝尔纳一世之女。1184年，他的舅父贝尔纳四世伯爵收养了他，指定他在伯爵无子女的情况下继承阿马尼亚克与费藏萨克，并把费藏萨盖子爵领封给他。贝尔纳四世由其子热罗四世继承，但贝尔纳之子热罗五世最终于1215年继承两个伯国，开创了阿马尼亚克第二王朝。

en: Bernard II Tumapaler (c. 1020 – 1064/1090) succeeded his father Girard I Trancaleon as Count of Armagnac around 1020, and through his grandmother Prisca, daughter of William II of Gascony, was recognised Duke of Gascony in 1039. His authority probably extended mainly over the south, rather than the Bordeaux region. His uncle Guy Geoffrey disputed the duchy and defeated him at the Battle of La Castelle, after which Bernard surrendered Gascony for fifteen thousand sous before May 1052. Much of the duchy had already been divided among local counts. He also warred on the archbishop of Auch and abdicated Armagnac by 1061, possibly entering a monastery. In May 1063 he led a Gascon baronial revolt against Guy Geoffrey, by then Duke of Aquitaine, and was again defeated; Gascony was firmly bound to Aquitaine.
zh: 伯纳德二世·图马帕勒（约1020年生，1064至1090年间卒）约于1020年继承父亲热拉尔一世·特兰卡莱翁的阿马尼亚克伯爵之位，并凭借祖母普里斯卡（加斯科涅公爵威廉二世之女）的血统，于1039年被承认为加斯科涅公爵。他的权威可能主要限于南部，而未及波尔多地区。他的叔父居伊·若弗鲁瓦争夺公国，在拉卡斯泰勒战役中将他击败，他被迫在1052年5月前以15000苏的代价让出加斯科涅。公国的大部分领地当时已分给各地伯爵。他还与欧什大主教交战，1061年前退离阿马尼亚克，可能进了修道院。1063年5月，他率领加斯科涅贵族反抗已继承阿基坦公国的居伊·若弗鲁瓦，再度兵败；加斯科涅从此牢牢归属于阿基坦。

en: Bernard III (c. 1071–1110) succeeded his father Géraud II as Count of Armagnac around 1103. Charters show him acting as early as 1084 beside his mother Azivelle de Lomagne, and in 1090 he confirmed his family's grants to Saint-Mont priory. In 1103 he followed Duke William IX of Aquitaine to La Réole, and in 1104 he subscribed the Truce of God proclaimed after the Lateran council. With his wife Alpais of Turenne he donated to Auch cathedral in August 1110; he died later that year and was succeeded by his son Géraud III.
zh: 贝尔纳三世（约1071—约1110）约在1103年继其父热罗二世成为阿马尼亚克伯爵。1084年的特许状已记载他与母亲阿齐韦勒·德·洛马涅一同签署文书，1090年他确认了家族对圣蒙修道院的各项捐赠。1103年，他随阿基坦公爵纪尧姆九世前往拉雷奥勒；1104年，他在拉特兰会议倡导的“天主休战”文告上署名。1110年8月，他与妻子蒂雷纳的阿尔佩丝向欧什圣母教堂捐赠，同年晚些时候去世，其子热罗三世继位。

en: Bernard IV (1136–1193) was Count of Armagnac and Fézensac from 1160, succeeding his father Géraud III. His rule was marked by conflict with Géraud de la Barthe, the powerful archbishop of Auch. Around 1150 he married Étiennette. He designated his nephew Bernard de Lomagne as heir in case he had no children and in 1184 gave him the viscounty of Fézensaguet as appanage. His son Géraud IV succeeded when Bernard died in 1193.
zh: 贝尔纳四世（1136—1193）自1160年继父热罗三世成为阿马尼亚克与费藏萨克伯爵。他统治期间与权势极大的欧什大主教热罗·德·拉巴特争斗不止。约1150年他娶艾蒂安内特为妻。他指定外甥贝尔纳·德·洛马涅在自己无子女的情况下继承伯国，并于1184年将费藏萨盖子爵领作为封邑赐给他。1193年贝尔纳去世后，其子热罗四世继位。

en: Bernard V (c. 1212–1245) was Count of Armagnac and Fézensac from 1242, when he succeeded his brother Pierre-Géraud. In 1242 he joined Henry III of England, Hugh X of Lusignan and Raymond VII of Toulouse in their coalition against Alphonse of Poitiers; after its defeat Henry III summoned him to Bordeaux in August 1243. He died in 1245 without children by his wife Agnes. His sister Mascarose, wife of Arnaud Odon of Lomagne, inherited the county, at once claimed by their cousin Géraud of Fézensaguet.
zh: 贝尔纳五世（约1212—1245）于1242年继兄长皮埃尔—热罗之后任阿马尼亚克与费藏萨克伯爵。1242年，他加入英王亨利三世、于格十世·德·吕西尼昂与图卢兹伯爵雷蒙七世反对阿尔方斯·德·普瓦捷的同盟；同盟失败后，亨利于1243年8月召他前往波尔多。1245年他去世，与妻子阿涅丝没有留下子嗣。他的妹妹玛斯卡罗斯——洛马涅的阿诺·奥东之妻——继承了伯国，他们的堂弟、费藏萨盖的热罗随即便对继承权提出要求。

en: Bernard VI (c. 1270–1319), Count of Armagnac and Fezensac from 1285, was the son of Géraud VI and Mathe de Béarn, daughter of the viscount of Béarn. His first wife Isabella d'Albret was a daughter of Bernard Ezy IV, lord of Albret, and Jeanne de Lusignan. Through that marriage Bernard held the title of lord of Albret until Isabella's death in 1294. In 1298 he married Cecilia de Rodez, heiress of Count Henri II of Rodez. Their children included his successor John I, Mathe, who married a lord of Albret, and Isabella, lady of Beras.
zh: 贝尔纳六世（约1270年生，1319年卒）自1285年起任阿马尼亚克与弗藏萨克伯爵，是热拉尔六世与贝阿恩子爵之女玛特·德·贝阿恩之子。他的首任妻子伊莎贝拉·德·阿尔布雷是阿尔布雷领主贝尔纳·埃齐四世与让娜·德·吕西尼昂之女。凭借这桩婚姻，贝尔纳拥有阿尔布雷领主的头衔，直到伊莎贝拉于1294年去世。1298年，他娶罗德斯伯爵亨利二世的继承人塞西尔。他们的子女包括继承人约翰一世、嫁给阿尔布雷领主的玛特，以及贝拉斯女领主伊莎贝拉。

en: Gaston d'Armagnac (c. 1275–1320) was the younger son of Count Géraud VI of Armagnac and Mathe de Béarn. When his elder brother Bernard VI inherited the family counties in 1285, Gaston received Fézensaguet as his share and became the founder of its junior viscomital branch. His first marriage, to Marquise de Périgord, remained childless and ended in repudiation; in 1298 he married Valpurge de Rodez, Viscountess of Creyssel and daughter of Count Henri II of Rodez, who bore his heir Géraud III in 1299. Gaston died in 1320 and was succeeded in Fézensaguet by Géraud III.
zh: 加斯东·德·阿马尼亚克（约1275—1320）是阿马尼亚克伯爵热罗六世与玛特·德·贝阿恩的儿子。1285年其兄贝尔纳六世继承家族各伯国时，加斯东分得费藏萨盖，成为该地支系的始祖。他先娶佩里戈尔的玛基兹，婚姻无出并以休妻告终；1298年又娶罗德兹伯爵亨利二世之女、克雷塞尔女子爵瓦尔皮尔格，后者于1299年生下继承人热罗三世。1320年加斯东去世，热罗三世继领费藏萨盖。

en: Géraud I, called Trancaléon (c. 958–c. 1020), was the only recorded son of Bernard I le Louche and Emerina, and he succeeded his father as Count of Armagnac in 995, the second ruler of that Gascon county. By his wife Adalais he had a son, Bernard II Tumapaler, who followed him as count, and a daughter, Galdis, who married Adhemar of Polestron and received the viscounty of Corneilhas. Géraud died around 1020, and his widow then married Arnaud II, Viscount of Lomagne.
zh: 热罗一世，绰号“特兰卡莱翁”（约958—约1020），是绰号“斜眼”的贝尔纳一世与埃梅里娜唯一见于记载的儿子，995年继其父任阿马尼亚克伯爵，为这个加斯科涅伯国的第二任统治者。他与妻子阿代莱丝生子贝尔纳二世·图马帕勒（后继位为伯爵）和女加尔迪丝；加尔迪丝嫁给阿德马尔·德·波勒斯特龙，得到科尔内亚子爵领。热罗约1020年去世，遗孀随后改嫁洛马涅子爵阿尔诺二世。

en: Géraud II (died 1095) was Count of Armagnac from 1063, the son of Bernard II Tumapaler and Ermengarde. His father, defeated in rebellion in 1063, abdicated and retired to Cluny and then Saint-Mont, leaving Géraud to rule under the overlordship of William VIII of Aquitaine. From 1072 to 1080 his brother Arnaud-Bernard was apparently associated with him in governing the county, and in 1073 the brothers fought Centule, viscount of Lescar. His wife Azivelle de Lomagne, daughter of Viscount Odon II, had been married to Géraud I, lord of Aubeissan. She bore him his successor Bernard III and two other sons; widowed, he then married Sancha, widow of the viscount of Corneillan.
zh: 热拉尔二世（卒于1095年）自1063年起任阿马尼亚克伯爵，是伯纳德二世·图马帕勒与埃芒加德之子。他的父亲在1063年叛乱失败后退隐克吕尼，随后迁至圣蒙，留他在阿基坦公爵威廉八世的宗主权下统治。1072至1080年间，兄弟阿诺—伯纳德似乎与他共同治理伯国；1073年，兄弟二人与莱斯卡尔子爵桑蒂尔作战。他的妻子阿济韦尔·德·洛马涅是子爵奥东二世之女，曾嫁给奥贝桑领主热拉尔一世。她为他生下继承人伯纳德三世和另外两个儿子；丧妻后他续娶科尔内扬子爵的遗孀桑莎。

en: Géraud III (c. 1096–1160) succeeded his father Bernard III as Count of Armagnac in 1110 and ruled for half a century. In 1119 he married Anicelle, Countess of Fézensac and widow of the Count of Bigorre; when her father Astanove II died in 1140, Géraud added Fézensac to his own lands, joining the two Gascon counties after two centuries of separation. By Anicelle he had a son, Bernard IV, who succeeded him, and a daughter, Mascarose, who married Odon de Lomagne and became ancestress of the second House of Armagnac.
zh: 热罗三世（约1096—1160）于1110年继其父贝尔纳三世成为阿马尼亚克伯爵，统治长达半个世纪。1119年，他迎娶费藏萨克女伯爵阿妮塞勒——比戈尔伯爵的遗孀；1140年阿妮塞勒之父阿斯塔诺夫二世去世后，热罗取得费藏萨克，使分离两个世纪的两个加斯科涅伯国合而为一。他与阿妮塞勒生子贝尔纳四世，即后来的继位者；女玛斯卡罗斯嫁给奥东·德·洛马涅，是阿马尼亚克第二王朝的女始祖。

en: Géraud III d'Armagnac (1299–1339), a Gascon noble of the House of Armagnac, held the vicomtés of Fézensaguet and Creyssel. The son of Gaston of Fézensaguet, he married Jeanne, daughter of the Count of Comminges, and was succeeded by his son Jean I.
zh: 热罗三世·德·阿马尼亚克（1299—1339）是阿马尼亚克家族的加斯科涅贵族，领有费藏萨盖与克雷塞尔子爵领地；他是加斯东子爵之子，娶科曼日伯爵之女让娜，死后由子让一世继位。

en: Géraud IV, nicknamed Trencaléon (c. 1170–1215), was Count of Armagnac and Fézensac from 1193, the long-awaited son of Bernard IV. In 1202 King John of England granted him lands in Gascony, and in 1204 he witnessed the peace between the Viscount of Lomagne and Toulouse. During the Albigensian Crusade he did homage to Simon de Montfort for his counties and in 1213 joined the siege of Toulouse with his brother Roger. He died childless in 1215, having adopted his cousin Géraud V de Lomagne, who succeeded him and began the second House of Armagnac.
zh: 热罗四世，绰号“特兰卡莱翁”（约1170—1215），是贝尔纳四世盼望已久的儿子，1193年起担任阿马尼亚克与费藏萨克伯爵。1202年，英格兰国王约翰在加斯科涅封赐他土地；1204年，他为洛马涅子爵与图卢兹之间的和约作证。阿尔比十字军期间，他为自己的两个伯国向西蒙·德·孟福尔行臣服礼，并于1213年与弟弟罗歇一同参加围攻图卢兹。1215年他无嗣而终，此前已收养表侄热罗五世·德·洛马涅为继承人；后者继位，开创了阿马尼亚克第二王朝。

en: Géraud V d'Armagnac (c. 1150–1219), son of Bernard, viscount of Fezensaguet, unexpectedly inherited the counties of Armagnac and Fezensac in 1215 when his childless kinsman Géraud IV Trenqueléon died. During the Albigensian Crusade, on 8 June 1215 he submitted to Simon de Montfort to avoid the fate of Count Raymond VI of Toulouse. In 1217 Toulouse rose against Montfort and Raymond returned; summoned to Montfort's aid, Géraud joined the siege of Toulouse and was entrusted with L'Isle-Jourdain. Montfort was killed during the siege. His family's claims then passed to the future Louis VIII, making the French crown suzerain of Armagnac. Géraud died on 30 September 1219, leaving the counties to his son Pierre-Gérard.
zh: 热拉尔五世·德·阿马尼亚克（约1150年生，1219年卒）是阿马尼亚克与洛马涅的贝尔纳（弗藏萨盖子爵）之子。1215年，无嗣的族人热拉尔四世·特兰卡莱翁去世，他意外继承阿马尼亚克与弗藏萨克伯国。阿尔比十字军期间，为免遭图卢兹伯爵雷蒙六世的下场，他于1215年6月8日归顺西蒙·德·孟福尔。1217年，图卢兹起兵反抗孟福尔，雷蒙重返领地；热拉尔应召援助孟福尔，参加图卢兹围城，并受托保管利勒茹尔丹。孟福尔在围城中毙命，其家族的权利随后转归后来的路易八世，法国王室遂成为阿马尼亚克的宗主。他于1219年9月30日去世，伯国传给儿子皮埃尔—热拉尔。

en: Géraud VI (1235–1285), son of Roger I of Fézensaguet and Pincelle d'Albret, was Viscount of Fézensaguet before becoming Count of Armagnac and Fézensac. From 1246 he warred on Arnaud Odon of Lomagne over the two counties; captured and ransomed though backed by Raymond VII of Toulouse, he secured them only in 1256 after Mascarose II died childless. In 1260 he married Mathe de Béarn, mother of Bernard VI, Gaston and Roger. After two years' imprisonment at Péronne for quarrels with the seneschal of Languedoc, he did homage to Edward I of England. He died in 1285.
zh: 热罗六世（1235—1285）是费藏萨盖的罗歇一世与潘塞尔·德·阿尔布雷之子，先任费藏萨盖子爵，后成为阿马尼亚克与费藏萨克伯爵。1246年起，他为两个伯国与洛马涅的阿诺·奥东交战；虽有图卢兹的雷蒙七世支持，他仍兵败被俘，缴纳赎金后获释，直到1256年玛斯卡罗斯二世无嗣而终才取得两伯国。1260年他娶玛特·德·贝阿恩，生下贝尔纳六世、加斯东和罗歇。后因与朗格多克总督多次冲突，他被囚禁于佩罗讷城堡两年，获释后向英王爱德华一世行臣服礼。1285年，热罗去世。

en: Jean I of Armagnac (1306–1373) succeeded his father Bernard VI in 1319 as Count of Armagnac, Fezensac and Rodez, the last through his mother Cécile, heiress of Rodez. His 1327 marriage to Béatrice de Clermont brought Charolais. On 28 July 1340 he destroyed Robert III of Artois's Anglo-Flemish army near Saint-Omer, but in 1355, with the Black Prince raiding through the south, he held Toulouse and avoided battle. The Treaty of Brétigny in 1360 handed Rouergue to England. On 5 December 1362 Gaston Fébus of Foix, Armagnac's old rival, captured him at Launac, and he paid three hundred thousand gold florins to go free. English troops meanwhile held Rodez until he beat them at Mondalazac on 17 January 1369, where Count Jean de La Panouse's arrival turned the victory into a triumph. He died on 16 May 1373 and left the county to his son John II.
zh: 约翰一世·德·阿马尼亚克（1306—1373）于1319年继承父亲贝尔纳六世，成为阿马尼亚克、弗藏萨克和罗德斯伯爵，罗德斯是母亲塞西尔作为女继承人带来的。1327年，他娶克莱蒙的贝阿特丽丝，获得沙罗莱。1340年7月28日，他在圣奥梅尔附近歼灭阿图瓦的罗贝尔三世率领的英佛联军；但1355年黑太子纵兵劫掠南方时，他驻守图卢兹，避而不战。1360年的《布雷蒂尼条约》把鲁埃格割让给英国。1362年12月5日，阿马尼亚克的宿敌、富瓦的加斯东·费比斯在洛纳克将他俘获，他付三十万金弗罗林才获释。英军则一直占据罗德斯，直到1369年1月17日他的军队在蒙达拉扎克将其击败，拉帕努斯伯爵让的援军使这场胜利成为大捷。他于1373年5月16日去世，伯国传给儿子约翰二世。

en: Jean I of Fezensaguet (died 1390), a Gascon noble of the House of Armagnac, was vicomte of Fézensaguet from 1339. The son of Géraud III and Jeanne de Comminges, he married Marguerite Duèze, the vicomte of Carmain's daughter; his son Géraud succeeded him.
zh: 让一世（卒于1390年）是阿马尼亚克家族的加斯科涅贵族，1339年起任费藏萨盖子爵。他是热罗三世与让娜·德·科曼日之子，娶卡尔曼子爵之女玛格丽特·迪埃兹，由子热罗继位。

en: Jean II, called the Hunchback (c. 1333–1384), was the son and heir of Jean I of Armagnac. He held Charolais from 1364, administered Lomagne as an appanage, and later inherited Armagnac, Fezensac and Rodez. He fought in the Hundred Years' War from 1351, in Provence in 1358 and Castile in 1361. He was the first, and for long the only, lord to back his father's appeal to Charles V against the Black Prince, which in the end freed Gascony from English rule, and he was put in charge of Languedoc. In 1379 he ended an eighty-nine-year feud between the two most powerful families of the Midi by marrying his daughter Béatrix to the son of Gaston Fébus of Foix. In 1380 he supported a revolt by the nobles of Comminges and seized their countess Jeanne. Summoned to Paris on charges of plotting with England, he died at Avignon on 26 May 1384 before trial.
zh: 约翰二世绰号“驼背”（约1333年生，1384年卒），是约翰一世·德·阿马尼亚克的儿子和继承人。他自1364年起领有沙罗莱，受封洛马涅管理，后来继承了阿马尼亚克、弗藏萨克和罗德斯。他自1351年投身百年战争，曾于1358年和1361年分别参加普罗旺斯与卡斯蒂利亚远征。他是第一个、也是长期唯一一个支持父亲向查理五世申诉黑太子行径的领主，这最终使加斯科涅摆脱了英格兰的统治，他本人也受命管理朗格多克。1379年，他将女儿贝阿特丽丝嫁给富瓦的加斯东·费比斯之子，结束了南方两大强族之间长达八十九年的仇杀。1380年，他支持科曼日贵族叛乱，俘获他们的女伯爵让娜。他被控勾结英格兰而被传唤至巴黎，1384年5月26日卒于阿维尼翁，未及受审。

en: Jeanne de Comminges was the daughter of Pierre-Raimond I, Count of Comminges, and Françoise de Fezensac. She married Géraud III, vicomte of Fézensaguet, and was the mother of Jean I of Fezensaguet and Mathe, countess of Astarac.
zh: 让娜·德·科曼日是科曼日伯爵皮埃尔-雷蒙一世与弗朗索瓦丝·德·费藏萨克之女，嫁给费藏萨盖子爵热罗三世，生有费藏萨盖的让一世和阿斯塔拉克伯爵夫人玛特。

en: Mascarose of Armagnac (c. 1134–c. 1184) was the daughter of Géraud III, Count of Armagnac, and Anicelle of Fézensac. She married Odon de Lomagne, lord of Firmacon; their son Bernard de Lomagne fathered Géraud V, founder of the second House of Armagnac.
zh: 玛斯卡罗斯·德·阿马尼亚克（约1134—约1184）是阿马尼亚克伯爵热罗三世与费藏萨克的阿妮塞勒之女，嫁给菲尔马孔领主奥东·德·洛马涅。她的儿子贝尔纳·德·洛马涅生下热罗五世，即阿马尼亚克第二王朝的开创者。

en: Mascarose I (c. 1214–before 25 March 1246) was suo jure Countess of Armagnac and Fézensac in 1245–1246, the daughter of Count Géraud V. She married her cousin Arnaud Odon, Viscount of Lomagne, by whom she had a daughter, Mascarose II. On the death of her brother Bernard V in 1245 she inherited the counties, but their cousin Géraud, Viscount of Fézensaguet, argued that a woman could not hold them and made war on the couple; Raymond VII of Toulouse and Alphonse of Poitiers backed Géraud, while Henry III of England supported Mascarose.
zh: 玛斯卡罗斯一世（约1214—1246年3月25日前）于1245至1246年以自身权利任阿马尼亚克与费藏萨克女伯爵，是伯爵热罗五世之女。她嫁给堂亲、洛马涅子爵阿诺·奥东，生女玛斯卡罗斯二世。1245年其兄弟贝尔纳五世去世，她继承两个伯国，但堂弟、费藏萨盖子爵热罗认为女子不能领有伯国，向夫妇二人开战：图卢兹的雷蒙七世与阿尔方斯·德·普瓦捷支持热罗，英王亨利三世则支持玛斯卡罗斯。

en: Mascarose II (died 1254) ruled Armagnac and Fézensac as countess in her own right from 1246. The daughter of Arnaud Odon, viscount of Lomagne, and Countess Mascarose I, she received the two counties from her father on her marriage to Eschivat de Chabanais. Their cousin Géraud, viscount of Fézensaguet, contested the succession, arguing the counties could not pass through women; Raymond VII of Toulouse backed him while Henry III of England supported Mascarose. She died childless in 1254, and Géraud succeeded as Géraud VI.
zh: 玛斯卡罗斯二世（？—1254）自1246年起以本人身份统治阿马尼亚克与费藏萨克两个伯国。她是洛马涅子爵阿尔诺·奥东与女伯爵玛斯卡罗斯一世之女，在嫁给埃斯希瓦·德·沙巴奈时，父亲将两个伯国交给了她。同族的费藏萨盖子爵热罗声索继承权，声称伯国不能经女性传承，图卢兹伯爵雷蒙七世支持热罗，英王亨利三世则支持玛斯卡罗斯。1254年她无嗣而终，热罗继位为热罗六世。

en: Mathe d'Armagnac was the daughter of Géraud, vicomte of Fézensaguet, and Jeanne de Comminges; a dispensation for her marriage to Centulle IV, Count of Astarac, was granted in 1331, and their son Jean I succeeded as count.
zh: 玛特·德·阿马尼亚克是费藏萨盖子爵热罗与让娜·德·科曼日之女，1331年获准与阿斯塔拉克伯爵桑蒂尔四世结婚，其子让一世后来继任伯爵。

en: Odo IV was Viscount of Lomagne and Auvillars in Gascony, attested in charters of 1160 and 1178. He was the son of Vezian I and Béatrix, and father of Vezian II, his successor, and Odo, lord of Fimarcon, ancestor of the later counts of Armagnac.
zh: 奥东四世是加斯科涅的洛马涅兼欧维拉尔子爵，见于1160年和1178年的特许状。他是韦齐安一世与贝阿特丽丝之子，生子继承人韦齐安二世和菲马尔孔领主奥东；第二个阿马尼亚克伯爵家族即出自奥东一系。

en: Odo of Lomagne, lord of Fimarcon, was a son of Odo IV, Viscount of Lomagne, and brother of Vezian II. He married Mascarose d'Armagnac, sister of Count Bernard IV; their son Bernard was adopted by the count in 1184 and made Viscount of Fézensaguet.
zh: 菲马尔孔领主奥东·德·洛马涅是洛马涅子爵奥东四世之子、韦齐安二世的兄弟。他娶阿马尼亚克的玛斯卡罗斯——伯爵贝尔纳四世的姐妹；1184年，他们的儿子贝尔纳被伯爵收养，并受封费藏萨盖子爵。

en: Odo V was viscount of Lomagne in Gascony. A son of Vezian II of Lomagne, he married a lady of the de Pins family and was the father of Arnaud Odon, who succeeded him as viscount of Lomagne.
zh: 奥东五世是加斯科涅的洛马涅子爵，韦济安二世·德·洛马涅之子，娶德潘家族的女子为妻。其子阿尔诺·奥东后来袭任洛马涅子爵。

en: Pierre-Géraud (c. 1210–c. 1242) was Count of Armagnac and Fézensac from 1219, the eldest son of Count Géraud V. Still a child at his father's death, he was placed under the tutelage of his uncle Arnaud-Bernard, who usurped the comital title and was styled count in charters from 1222 until his death. Pierre-Géraud recovered his counties only in 1226. He married Mascarose de La Barthe but died without legitimate children around 1242, and the county passed to his younger brother Bernard V.
zh: 皮埃尔—热罗（约1210—约1242）自1219年起任阿马尼亚克与费藏萨克伯爵，是伯爵热罗五世的长子。父亲去世时他尚在幼年，由叔父阿尔诺—贝尔纳监护，后者篡夺了伯爵头衔，自1222年起在特许状中自称伯爵，一直掌权到去世。皮埃尔—热罗直到1226年才收回伯国。他娶玛斯卡罗斯·德·拉巴特为妻，约1242年去世时没有婚生子女，伯国由其弟贝尔纳五世继承。

en: Roger I of Fézensaguet (c. 1190–22 March 1245) was Viscount of Fézensaguet in Gascony, the son of Bernard I, Viscount of Fézensaguet and Lomagne, and Geralda de Foix. He married Pincelle d'Albret, daughter of Amanieu IV, Lord of Albret. Their eldest son, Géraud, born in 1235, succeeded him in Fézensaguet and became Count Géraud VI of Armagnac in 1256. His other sons included Roger, founder of the Armagnac-Termes line, and Amanieu, later Archbishop of Auch. Roger died on 22 March 1245.
zh: 罗歇一世·德·费藏萨盖（约1190—1245年3月22日）是加斯科涅的费藏萨盖子爵，为费藏萨盖兼洛马涅子爵贝尔纳一世与热拉尔德·德·富瓦之子。他娶阿尔布雷领主阿马纽四世之女潘塞尔·德·阿尔布雷为妻。长子热罗生于1235年，先承袭费藏萨盖，后于1256年成为阿马尼亚克伯爵热罗六世。他的其他儿子还包括开创阿马尼亚克—泰尔姆支系的罗歇，以及后来出任欧什大主教的阿马纽。1245年3月22日，罗歇去世。

en: Vezian II was Viscount of Lomagne and Auvillars in Gascony, the son of Odon IV, and appears in charters of 1204 and 1221. He was father of Odo V, his successor, and of Ispan, founder of the lords of Gimat branch.
zh: 韦齐安二世是加斯科涅的洛马涅兼欧维拉尔子爵，奥东四世之子，见于1204年和1221年的特许状。他生子继承人奥东五世，以及伊什庞——日马领主支系的始祖。

en: Shihab al-Din Ahmad ibn Hajji (c. 1235–1282) was emir of the Al Mira, the dominant Bedouin tribe of the Hauran in southern Syria. He challenged the Mamluk-backed amir al-arab Isa ibn Muhanna and, as Ibn Khaldun records, drove the rival Al Fadl out of the Hauran; Sultan Baybars then recognized his tribe as practically independent. In the late 1260s he raided Najd and the Hejaz, extorting thousands of camels from Medina, which he restored under sultanic order in 1268. After backing the rebel Sunqur al-Ashqar, he rejoined the Mamluks with some four thousand horsemen at Homs in 1281.
zh: 希哈卜丁·艾哈迈德·本·哈吉（约1235—1282）是叙利亚南部豪兰地区最强大的贝都因部落米拉的埃米尔。他挑战马穆鲁克册封的“阿拉伯人埃米尔”伊萨·本·穆汉纳；据伊本·赫勒敦记载，他将敌对的法德勒部落逐出豪兰，拜巴尔苏丹随后承认米拉部落实际独立。1260年代末，他劫掠内志与汉志，向麦地那强索数千峰骆驼，1268年奉苏丹之命归还。他曾支持叛将孙库尔·艾什盖尔，1281年又率约四千骑兵在霍姆斯重归马穆鲁克阵营。

en: Anqa ibn Shati was a Bedouin emir of the Al Mira, the tribe that dominated the Hauran in southern Syria under Mamluk rule. Around 1389 he had become emir and joined Nu'ayr ibn Hayar of the Al Fadl in backing the rebel Mamluk emir Mintash against Sultan Barquq. The rebel allies besieged Aleppo but were driven off by Barquq's forces. In 1390 or 1391 Anqa was killed by the Assassins, after which the Al Mira returned to the sultan's allegiance.
zh: 安卡·伊本·沙提是米拉部的贝都因埃米尔；马穆鲁克统治时期，米拉部称雄叙利亚南部的豪兰地区。约1389年他已出任埃米尔，与法德勒部的努艾尔·伊本·哈亚尔联手支持叛乱的马穆鲁克埃米尔明塔什，对抗苏丹拜尔古格。叛军围攻阿勒颇，但被拜尔古格的军队击退。1390或1391年，安卡被阿萨辛派刺杀，米拉部随后重新归顺苏丹。

en: Hajji ibn Burayd was a member of the ruling family of the Al Mira, the leading Bedouin tribe of the Hauran in southern Syria. He was the son of Burayd ibn Shibl ibn Mira and the father of the emir Shihab al-Din Ahmad ibn Hajji.
zh: 哈吉·本·布雷德是叙利亚南部豪兰地区首屈一指的贝都因部落米拉的统治家族成员，为布雷德·本·希卜勒·本·米拉之子、埃米尔希哈卜丁·艾哈迈德·本·哈吉之父。

en: Shati was the father of Anqa ibn Shati, who became emir of the Al Mira around 1389.
zh: 沙提是安卡·伊本·沙提的父亲，后者约于1389年成为米拉部埃米尔。

en: Ludwig of Arnsberg (c. 1245–1313) ruled the County of Arnsberg from 1282, after years as co-ruler with his father Gottfried III. By his wife Petronella of Jülich he had thirteen children; his son William succeeded him and another son, Gottfried, became bishop of Osnabrück. He compromised with the expansionist archbishops of Cologne, allying with them in the Limburg succession war of 1280 but avoiding open war. His main work was internal: he exchanged outlying estates, recovered alienated lands and founded Sundern, Hagen and Langscheid through forest clearance. He died on 2 May 1313.
zh: 阿恩斯贝格的路德维希（约1245—1313）自1282年起统治阿恩斯贝格伯国，此前曾与父亲戈特弗里德三世共同执政多年。他娶于利希的佩特罗内拉，育有十三个子女；儿子威廉继位，另一子戈特弗里德成为奥斯纳布吕克主教。对外，他对扩张中的科隆大主教采取妥协，1280年在林堡继承战争中与其结盟却避免公开交战。他主要致力于内部经营：交换边远领地、收回此前封出的地产，并通过开垦森林建立了松德恩、哈根和朗沙伊德等村庄。1313年5月2日，路德维希去世。

en: William of Arnsberg (c. 1277–1338) succeeded his father Louis as count of Arnsberg in 1313. A settlement mediated by his uncle Gerhard of Jülich confirmed him as sole heir, and he then held a court registering 261 fiefs. Unlike the archbishop of Cologne, he backed Louis of Bavaria for the German crown after Henry VII's death and was often at the emperor's court, gaining Soest's advocacy and ducal rights in his county. In advanced age he joined John of Luxembourg's campaign with the Teutonic Order against the Lithuanians, founding Arensburg on Ösel in 1337. He died in 1338.
zh: 阿恩斯贝格的威廉（约1277—1338）于1313年继其父路德维希之后成为阿恩斯贝格伯爵。他的叔父于利希的格哈德调解达成继承协议，确认他为唯一继承人；随后他召开封臣会议，登记了261处封地。亨利七世去世后，他与科隆大主教立场不同，支持巴伐利亚的路德维希争夺德意志王位，时常出入皇帝宫廷，由此获得索斯特的监护权以及伯国境内的公爵权利。晚年他随卢森堡的约翰参加条顿骑士团对立陶宛人的远征，于1337年在厄塞尔岛建立阿伦斯堡，1338年去世。

en: André-Hercule de Fleury (1653–1743) was a French cardinal and chief minister to Louis XV. Born in Lodève, the son of a tax farmer, he became bishop of Fréjus in 1698 and tutor to the future Louis XV in 1715. In June 1726 he ousted the duke of Bourbon and took power, and was made a cardinal later that year. For seventeen years his prudent, peace-loving ministry stabilized the currency and restored the finances, although he harshly enforced the anti-Jansenist bull Unigenitus. Regular interest payments on the national debt helped restore credit, while forced peasant labour improved roads at the cost of popular resentment. He sought peace, but France later entered the wars of the Polish and Austrian successions. He died in office in 1743.
zh: 安德烈·埃居尔·德·弗勒里（1653—1743）是法国枢机主教、路易十五的首席大臣。他生于洛代沃，父亲是包税人，1698年任弗雷瑞斯主教，1715年成为年幼的路易十五的教师。1726年6月，他逐走波旁公爵、亲自掌权，同年晚些时候获封枢机主教。在长达十七年的谨慎执政中，他稳定币制、整顿财政，施政以和平为宗旨，但严厉推行谴责詹森派的《唯一圣子》诏书。定期支付国债利息帮助恢复了信用，而强征农民劳役修路则激起民怨。他力求和平，但法国后来仍卷入波兰及奥地利王位继承战争。1743年，他卒于任上。

en: Albert I (c. 1258–1316) of the House of Ascania was the second Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst, ruling after his father Siegfried's abdication in 1290 and formally from 1298. In 1291 he joined the siege of Harly Castle against Duke Henry I of Brunswick-Grubenhagen, and in 1293 he abolished Polabian as a court language. From 1295 he was the first Ascanian prince to reside at Köthen Castle, and around 1307 he secured the Brandenburg-held part of Zerbst as a fief. After King Albert I's murder in 1308, Margrave Waldemar of Brandenburg proposed him as King of the Romans, in vain.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特一世（约1258—1316）出身阿斯坎尼家族，是第二任安哈尔特-采尔布斯特亲王，1290年父亲西格弗里德退位后开始执政，1298年正式继位。1291年他参加围攻哈尔利城堡、讨伐韦尔夫家族的不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根公爵亨利一世；1293年他在领地内废除波拉布语作为宫廷语言。1295年他成为首位入住克滕城堡的阿斯坎尼亲王，约1307年以封邑形式取得勃兰登堡占据的采尔布斯特部分城区。1308年国王阿尔布雷希特一世遇刺后，勃兰登堡藩侯瓦尔德马曾推举他为罗马人的国王，但未能成功。

en: Albert II (1306–1362) was an Ascanian prince of Anhalt-Zerbst, the eldest son of Albert I's marriage to Agnes of Brandenburg. Under age at his father's death in 1316, he and his brother Waldemar I were raised by their maternal uncle, Margrave Waldemar of Brandenburg-Stendal, and later ruled jointly, at Zerbst and Dessau. When the Ascanian line of Brandenburg died out in 1320, the brothers secured Zerbst, the margraviate of Landsberg and the Palatine County of Saxony, and in 1323 Albert received the title Prince of Ascania. About 1337 he married Beatrix of Saxe-Wittenberg, and he died 17 July 1362.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特二世（1306—1362）是阿斯坎尼家族的安哈尔特-采尔布斯特亲王，阿尔布雷希特一世与勃兰登堡的阿格尼丝所生的长子。1316年父亲去世时他尚未成年，与弟弟瓦尔德马一世由舅父勃兰登堡-施滕达尔藩侯瓦尔德马监护，后来两人共同统治，分别驻于采尔布斯特和德绍。1320年勃兰登堡的阿斯坎尼支系绝嗣，兄弟俩取得了采尔布斯特、兰茨贝格藩侯国和萨克森行宫伯国的完整权利；1323年阿尔布雷希特获封阿斯坎尼亲王头衔。约1337年他与萨克森-维滕贝格的贝娅特丽克丝结婚，1362年7月17日去世。

en: Beatrix of Saxe-Wittenberg (died after 26 February 1345) was an Ascanian princess, the daughter of Duke and Elector Rudolf I of Saxe-Wittenberg and his first wife Jutta of Brandenburg. On 27 January 1337 she became the second wife of Albert II, Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst, while her sister Elisabeth married Albert's younger brother and co-ruler Waldemar I. The couple had five children, among them Albert III and John II, who both ruled Anhalt-Zerbst, and Rudolph, bishop of Schwerin. Beatrix died at Coswig convent after 26 February 1345.
zh: 萨克森-维滕贝格的贝娅特丽克丝（1345年2月26日后去世）是阿斯坎尼家族的公主，萨克森-维滕贝格公爵兼选侯鲁道夫一世与首任妻子勃兰登堡的尤塔之女。1337年1月27日，她成为安哈尔特-采尔布斯特亲王阿尔布雷希特二世的第二任妻子；她的姊妹伊丽莎白则嫁给阿尔布雷希特的弟弟兼共治者瓦尔德马一世。两人生有五个子女，包括先后统治安哈尔特-采尔布斯特的阿尔布雷希特三世与约翰二世，以及什未林主教鲁道夫。贝娅特丽克丝于1345年2月26日之后在科斯维希修道院去世。

en: Henry I (c. 1170–1252), of the House of Ascania, was Count of Anhalt from 1212 and its first ruling prince from 1218. On his father Bernhard's death in 1212 he received the old Ascanian lands in the Schwabengau around Ballenstedt, while his brother Albert took the Saxon ducal title. He styled himself prince from about 1215 and was raised to princely rank by Emperor Frederick II, whom he backed against the rebel King Henry (VII) in 1234 and at the Siege of Brescia in 1238. Around 1245 he retired and divided Anhalt among his sons Henry II, Bernhard and Siegfried.
zh: 亨利一世（约1170—1252）出身阿斯坎尼家族，自1212年起为安哈尔特伯爵，1218年成为安哈尔特第一位亲王。1212年父亲伯恩哈德去世后，他分得家族在巴伦施泰特周围施瓦本高的旧有领地，弟弟阿尔布雷希特则取得萨克森公爵头衔。他约1215年起自称亲王，后被皇帝腓特烈二世正式册立；1234年支持皇帝讨伐叛王海因里希七世，1238年参加布雷西亚围城战。约1245年他退隐，将安哈尔特分给儿子亨利二世、伯恩哈德和西格弗里德。

en: Luitgarde of Holstein-Itzehoe (c. 1251–after 1289), daughter of Count Gerhard I, married John, Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg, in 1265 and bore five children, including his heir Otto II the Strict. After John's death in 1277 she married Prince Albert I of Anhalt-Zerbst.
zh: 柳特加德（约1251—1289年后）是荷尔施泰因伯爵格哈德一世之女，1265年嫁不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵约翰，育有五名子女，包括继承人奥托二世；1277年约翰死后改嫁安哈尔特-采尔布斯特亲王阿尔布雷希特一世。

en: Siegfried I (c. 1230–1298) was the youngest son of Prince Henry I of Anhalt. In 1247 he joined the War of the Thuringian Succession, occupying the County Palatine by his mother's right before surrendering his claim to Margrave Henry III of Meissen. When the brothers divided Anhalt in 1252, he became the first Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst, receiving the eastern estates around Köthen and Dessau. In 1273 he stood for the German crown, which instead went to Rudolf of Habsburg.
