In 1290 he abdicated to enter the Dominican Order, leaving rule to his son Albert I, and died at Köthen Castle in 1298.
zh: 西格弗里德一世（约1230—1298）是安哈尔特亲王亨利一世的幼子。1247年他介入图林根继承战争，凭母亲的权利占据行宫伯爵领地，后将权利让给迈森藩侯亨利三世。1252年兄弟分割安哈尔特时，他成为第一任安哈尔特-采尔布斯特亲王，分得克滕与德绍一带的东部领地。1273年他曾参选德意志国王，诸侯最终选出哈布斯堡的鲁道夫。1290年他退位加入多明我会，由儿子阿尔布雷希特一世执政，1298年在克滕城堡去世。

en: Waldemar I (died 7 January 1368) was an Ascanian prince of Anhalt-Zerbst, the youngest son of Prince Albert I and Agnes of Brandenburg. After his father died in 1316, he and his brother Albert II were raised by their maternal uncle, Margrave Waldemar of Brandenburg-Stendal, and on coming of age ruled the principality jointly, Waldemar holding his court at Dessau. In 1344 he married Elisabeth of Saxe-Wittenberg, the sister of his brother's wife. When Albert II died in 1362, Waldemar continued as co-ruler with his nephew John II. At his death he was succeeded by his son Waldemar II.
zh: 瓦尔德马一世（1368年1月7日去世）是阿斯坎尼家族的安哈尔特-采尔布斯特亲王，阿尔布雷希特一世与勃兰登堡的阿格尼丝的幼子。1316年父亲去世后，他与兄长阿尔布雷希特二世由舅父勃兰登堡-施滕达尔藩侯瓦尔德马监护；成年后两人共同统治公国，瓦尔德马驻跸德绍。1344年他迎娶萨克森-维滕贝格的伊丽莎白，即他嫂嫂的姊妹。1362年阿尔布雷希特二世去世，瓦尔德马继续与侄子约翰二世共治。他去世后由儿子瓦尔德马二世继位。

en: Geoffrey V (24 August 1113 – 7 September 1151), called the Fair or Plantagenet, was Count of Anjou and Maine from 1129 and Duke of Normandy from 1144. The elder son of Count Fulk V and Ermengarde of Maine, he was knighted in 1128 by Henry I of England and married the king's daughter, the Empress Matilda. Their marriage was intended to secure peace between England, Normandy and Anjou. Matilda returned to her father's court after a few months, but Henry intervened and she went back to Geoffrey. During the ensuing civil war he conquered Normandy and entered Rouen in 1144. His son by Matilda became Henry II of England, founder of the Plantagenet dynasty named from Geoffrey's broom-plant byname. Geoffrey died of fever at Château-du-Loir and was buried at Le Mans.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/安茹伯爵若弗鲁瓦五世
zh: 若弗鲁瓦五世（1113年8月24日—1151年9月7日），绰号“美男子”或“金雀花”，自1129年起任安茹与曼恩伯爵，1144年起任诺曼底公爵。他是富尔克五世伯爵与曼恩的埃芒加德的长子，1128年由英格兰国王亨利一世册封为骑士，并迎娶国王之女玛蒂尔达皇后。这场婚姻旨在巩固英格兰、诺曼底与安茹之间的和平。几个月后玛蒂尔达回到父亲的宫廷，亨利出面干预，她才回到若弗鲁瓦身边。此后的内战年间，他攻取诺曼底，于1144年进入鲁昂。他与玛蒂尔达之子后来成为英格兰国王亨利二世，开创金雀花王朝——王朝名便得自若弗鲁瓦的金雀花绰号。他在卢瓦堡染热病去世，葬于勒芒。

en: John Tristan (1219–1232), fourth son of King Louis VIII of France and Blanche of Castile, held Anjou as Count John I and Maine as John II from his birth on 21 July 1219, and died in 1232 aged thirteen.
zh: 约翰·特里斯坦（1219—1232）是法兰西国王路易八世与卡斯蒂利亚的布朗什的第四子。他从1219年7月21日出生起便受封安茹伯爵（称约翰一世）和曼恩伯爵（称约翰二世），1232年夭折，年仅十三岁。

en: Robert the Strong (c. 830 – 2 July 866) was a Frankish noble and ancestor of the Capetian dynasty. A Rhineland Frank, he was made missus dominicus over Maine, Anjou and Touraine by Charles the Bald in 853, to defend Neustria against Viking and Breton raids. He rebelled with the Bretons in 858, was reconciled and named Count of Anjou in 861, and later became lay abbot of Saint Martin at Tours. In 866 he fought a Breton-Viking raiding force at Brissarthe. The Viking commander took refuge in a church, and Robert removed his armour to begin a siege; the Vikings then attacked by surprise and killed him. His sons Odo and Robert I became kings of West Francia, and his great-grandson was Hugh Capet.
zh: 强者罗贝尔（约830年—866年7月2日）是法兰克贵族、卡佩王朝的先祖。作为来自莱茵兰的法兰克人，他于853年被西法兰克国王秃头查理任命为曼恩、安茹和图赖讷的钦差，负责抵御维京人和布列塔尼人对纽斯特里亚的袭掠。858年他联合布列塔尼人反叛，后与国王和解，861年被任命为安茹伯爵，后来又出任图尔圣马丁修道院的在俗修道院长。866年，他在布里萨尔特与布列塔尼—维京劫掠部队交战。维京首领躲进一座教堂，罗贝尔卸甲准备围攻，维京人却突然出击，将他杀死。他的儿子厄德和罗贝尔一世都成为西法兰克国王，曾孙是于格·卡佩。

en: Arnau de Llordà (died 1346) was a Catalan cleric who became bishop of Urgell in 1326, and with that see the fourth episcopal co-prince of Andorra, ruling alongside the French co-prince Gaston II, Count of Foix. His years at La Seu d'Urgell saw renewed quarrels with the counts of Foix over jurisdiction in Andorra, and he was forced to withdraw from the diocese for several years. Transferred to Tortosa in 1341, he held a synod there in April 1343 and died on 5 May 1346.
zh: 阿尔瑙·德·略尔达（？—1346）是加泰罗尼亚教士，1326年出任乌赫尔主教，并以此身份成为安道尔第四位教权方面的共同亲王，与法方共同亲王、富瓦伯爵加斯顿二世共事。他驻塞奥德乌赫尔期间，乌赫尔教会与富瓦伯爵围绕安道尔的管辖权重启争端，他一度被迫离开主教区数年。1341年他调任托尔托萨主教，1343年4月在当地主持教区会议，1346年5月5日去世。

en: Agnes von Schlüsselberg was a daughter of the Franconian lord Konrad II von Schlüsselberg. She married Heinrich von Plauen zu Mühltroff and, after his death, Hermann von Beichlingen.
zh: 阿格内丝·冯·施吕塞尔贝格是法兰克尼亚领主康拉德二世·冯·施吕塞尔贝格之女，先嫁海因里希·冯·普劳恩·楚·米尔特罗夫，丈夫死后改嫁赫尔曼·冯·拜希林根。

en: Agnes of Württemberg (c. 1305–1373), daughter of Count Ulrich of Württemberg, was widowed from Count Ulrich IV of Helfenstein and became the second wife of the Franconian lord Konrad II von Schlüsselberg, by whom she had a daughter, Hildegard.
zh: 符腾堡的阿格内丝（约1305—1373）为符腾堡伯爵乌尔里希之女，在丈夫黑尔芬施泰因伯爵乌尔里希四世死后改嫁法兰克尼亚领主康拉德二世·冯·施吕塞尔贝格，生女希尔德加德。

en: Albert the Handsome (1319–1361), a Hohenzollern burgrave of Nuremberg, was the fourth son of Burgrave Frederick IV and Margaret of Carinthia and married Sophie of Henneberg.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特“美男子”（1319—1361）是霍亨索伦家族的纽伦堡城堡伯爵，为城堡伯爵腓特烈四世与克恩滕的玛格丽特所生第四子，娶亨讷贝格的索菲。

en: Anna of Nuremberg (died 27 July 1383) was a daughter of Burgrave John II of Nuremberg and Elisabeth of Henneberg and a sister of Burgrave Frederick V. She became abbess of the convent of Birkenfeld, and from 1370 until her death she was abbess of Himmelkron near Kulmbach, a house founded by the counts of Orlamünde, whose Plassenburg lands her father had inherited. Her epitaph survives set into the wall of the abbey church.
zh: 安娜·冯·纽伦堡（1383年7月27日卒）是纽伦堡城堡伯爵约翰二世与亨讷贝格的伊丽莎白之女、城堡伯爵腓特烈五世的姐妹。她出家修道，曾任比肯费尔德修道院院长，1370年起出任库尔姆巴赫附近希默尔克龙修道院的院长，直至去世。该修道院由奥拉明德伯爵家族创立，她的父亲正是从该家族继承了普拉森堡一带的领地。她的墓志铭至今嵌在修道院教堂的墙壁中。

en: Anna von Schlüsselberg (died 1379), daughter of Konrad II, was abbess of Schlüsselau Abbey from 1339 until her death. After her father fell in 1347 as the last male Schlüsselberg, she used the family inheritance settlement to win further estates for the abbey and completed the church endowed by her great-uncle Gottfried. In 1356 she secured an imperial charter of protection from Charles IV, confirming the abbey's rights and its high jurisdiction. Remembered as Schlüsselau's most important abbess, she gave the house a sound economic and legal basis and died in 1379.
zh: 安娜·冯·施吕塞尔贝格（？—1379）是康拉德二世之女，1339年起担任施吕瑟尔奥修道院院长，直到去世。1347年她的父亲作为施吕塞尔贝格家族最后一名男性战死后，她借家族遗产分割为修道院争得更多地产，并完成了由叔祖父戈特弗里德捐资修建的修道院教堂。1356年，她从皇帝卡尔四世手中取得帝国保护诏书，确认了修道院的各项权利及其高级裁判权。她被视为该修道院最重要的院长，为修院奠定了稳固的经济与法律基础，1379年去世。

en: Beatrix von Schlüsselberg (died 1355) was a daughter of the Franconian lord Konrad II von Schlüsselberg. She married Count Ulrich V of Helfenstein-Blaubeuren and became countess of Helfenstein-Blaubeuren, mother of his successor Ulrich VII.
zh: 贝娅特丽克丝·冯·施吕塞尔贝格（？—1355）是法兰克尼亚领主康拉德二世·冯·施吕塞尔贝格之女，嫁给黑尔芬施泰因-布劳博伊伦伯爵乌尔里希五世，成为伯爵夫人，育有继承人乌尔里希七世。

en: Berthold von Zollern (1320–1365) was the second son of Burgrave Frederick IV of Nuremberg and Margaret of Görz. He joined the Teutonic Order at thirteen in 1333 and rose to Landkomtur of Franconia and Prussia. In 1351 Pope Clement VI named him Prince-Bishop of Eichstätt before he was even ordained; he received minor orders, then the diaconate and priesthood, within three weeks. Bishop Albrecht of Hohenfels still held the see, so the two divided the work until Albrecht resigned in 1353. An Eichstätt synod in 1354 adopted statutes for the clergy. Berthold enlarged the bishopric's lands and began the Willibaldsburg, moving in during 1355; his successors lived there until 1725. A councillor of Emperor Charles IV, he went with him to Avignon in 1365, fell ill on the way home, and died that September at Eichstätt. He was buried at Heilsbronn Abbey.
zh: 贝特霍尔德·冯·措伦（1320—1365）是纽伦堡城堡伯爵腓特烈四世与格尔茨的玛格丽特的次子。他13岁时的1333年加入条顿骑士团，后升任骑士团法兰克尼亚与普鲁士的地区长官。1351年，教皇克雷芒六世在他尚未受圣职时就任命他为艾希施泰特亲王主教，他在三周内先后领受低级圣职、执事和司铎圣职。当时霍恩费尔斯的阿尔布雷希特仍在位，二人分工共治，直至阿尔布雷希特于1353年逊位。1354年，艾希施泰特教区会议为神职人员制定了规章。贝特霍尔德扩充了主教区的领地，主持修建维利巴茨堡，1355年迁入，其后继者在此居住到1725年。作为皇帝查理四世的顾问，他于1365年随皇帝前往阿维尼翁，归途中染病，同年9月在艾希施泰特病逝，葬于海尔斯布隆修道院。

en: Elisabeth of Henneberg (c. 1318 – 6 December 1377), also called Elsbeth, was a German countess and burgravine of Nuremberg. She was the daughter of Berthold VII, Count of Henneberg-Schleusingen, and Adelheid of Hesse. She married John II the Acquirer, the Hohenzollern Burgrave of Nuremberg, and bore his only son, Frederick V, who succeeded as burgrave in 1357. Two of their daughters, Anna and Adelheid, became abbesses of Birkenfeld Abbey. Elisabeth died in 1377, surviving her husband by twenty years.
zh: 亨讷贝格的伊丽莎白（约1318年—1377年12月6日），又称埃尔斯贝特，是德意志女伯爵、纽伦堡城堡伯爵夫人。她是亨讷贝格-施莱辛根伯爵贝尔托德七世与黑森的阿德尔海德之女。她嫁给霍亨索伦家族的纽伦堡城堡伯爵、绰号“整合者”的约翰二世，为他生下独子腓特烈五世；约翰二世1357年去世后，腓特烈五世继任城堡伯爵。他们的两个女儿安娜和阿德尔海德先后出任比肯费尔德修道院院长。伊丽莎白于1377年去世，比丈夫多活了二十年。

en: Frederick I (c. 1139–1201), born Frederick III of Zollern, was a younger son of Count Frederick II of Zollern and the first Hohenzollern to hold Nuremberg. From 1171 he was a loyal partisan of the Hohenstaufen, serving Emperor Frederick Barbarossa, including the 1180 campaign against Henry the Lion. Around 1184 he married Sophie of Raabs, heiress of the Nuremberg burgraviate, and after her father's death Henry VI enfeoffed him with it around 1191. He thereby founded the Franconian line of the Hohenzollern; his sons Conrad I and Frederick IV took the Franconian and Swabian inheritances.
zh: 腓特烈一世（约1139—1201），即索伦伯爵腓特烈三世，是索伦伯爵腓特烈二世的幼子，也是霍亨索伦家族首任纽伦堡城堡伯爵。自1171年起，他坚定追随霍亨斯陶芬家族，在皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨麾下效力，包括1180年讨伐狮子亨利的行动。约1184年，他迎娶纽伦堡城堡伯国的女继承人索菲·冯·拉布斯；岳父死后，皇帝亨利六世约于1191年把城堡伯国封赐给他，霍亨索伦的法兰克尼亚支系由此开创。他的儿子康拉德一世与腓特烈四世分别承受法兰克尼亚与士瓦本两支家业。

en: Frederick III (c. 1220 – 14 August 1297) was Burgrave of Nuremberg, son of Conrad I and Adelheid of Frontenhausen. Around Cadolzburg he held the western Hohenzollern lands, receiving Bayreuth in 1248 through the Meranian inheritance, which brought him into conflict with other claimants. He succeeded his father in 1261 and contested the Main region with the bishops of Würzburg and Bamberg. In 1273 his deciding vote elected Rudolf of Habsburg King of the Romans, and Rudolf raised him to Prince-Elector and entrusted him with the royal district court of Franconia. Frederick fought at Dürnkrut against Ottokar of Bohemia in 1278, gaining Wunsiedel and Erlangen. By his second wife Helene of Saxony he fathered his successor Frederick IV.
zh: 腓特烈三世（约1220年—1297年8月14日）是纽伦堡城堡伯爵，康拉德一世与弗龙滕豪森的阿德尔海德之子。他以卡多尔茨堡为中心领有霍亨索伦家族在纽伦堡以西的土地，1248年通过梅拉讷遗产获得拜罗伊特，也因此与其他继承权主张者发生争执。1261年他袭父职为城堡伯爵，在美因河流域与维尔茨堡和班贝格的主教相争。1273年，他在罗马人的国王选举中把决定性一票投给哈布斯堡的鲁道夫，鲁道夫随即晋封他为选帝侯，并将法兰克尼亚皇家地区法院交由他掌管。1278年他在迪恩克鲁特迎战波希米亚的奥托卡，又取得温西德尔和埃尔朗根。第二任妻子萨克森的海伦生有继位者腓特烈四世。

en: Frederick IV (c. 1287 – 19 May 1332) was Burgrave of Nuremberg from 1300, succeeding his elder brother John I; he was the younger son of Frederick III and Helene of Saxony. In 1307 he and King Albert I of Germany led an imperial army against the Wettin margraves Frederick of Meissen and Dietrich of Lusatia, but were defeated at Lucka. Fighting for Louis the Bavarian at Mühldorf in 1322, he helped capture the Habsburg claimant Frederick the Fair. In 1331 he bought the town of Ansbach, nucleus of the later Hohenzollern principality. His wife Margaret of Görz-Tyrol bore him many children, including his successor John II; their sons Frederick and Berthold became bishops. Frederick died in 1332.
zh: 腓特烈四世（约1287年—1332年5月19日）自1300年起任纽伦堡城堡伯爵。他是腓特烈三世与萨克森的海伦的幼子，因兄长约翰一世去世而袭职。1307年，他与德意志国王阿尔布雷希特一世率帝国军队迎战韦廷家族的迈森藩侯腓特烈和卢萨蒂亚藩侯迪特里希，在卢卡战败。1322年，他在米尔多夫之战中为巴伐利亚人路易作战，参与俘获哈布斯堡家族的对立国王“美男子”腓特烈。1331年，他购得安斯巴赫城，此地后来成为霍亨索伦安斯巴赫亲王国的核心。妻子戈里齐亚-蒂罗尔的玛格丽特为他生育众多子女，继位者约翰二世即其中之一；他们的儿子腓特烈和贝尔托德后来成为主教。腓特烈于1332年去世。

en: Frederick V (before 3 March 1333 – 21 January 1398), of the House of Hohenzollern, was the elder son of Burgrave John II of Nuremberg and Elisabeth of Henneberg. Succeeding in 1357, he was responsible for protecting the strategic imperial castle of Nuremberg. He served Emperor Charles IV, who in 1363 made him the first burgrave of princely rank. In 1356 he married Elisabeth of Meissen; their daughters wed Rupert, King of the Romans, and Duke Albert III of Austria. After he died in 1398 his sons divided his lands: John III received Kulmbach and Frederick VI received Ansbach. Frederick VI later became the first Hohenzollern Elector of Brandenburg.
zh: 腓特烈五世（1333年3月3日前—1398年1月21日）出身霍亨索伦家族，是纽伦堡城堡伯爵约翰二世与亨讷贝格的伊丽莎白的长子。1357年袭爵后，他扼守战略要冲纽伦堡皇家城堡，效力于皇帝查理四世，1363年成为首位晋封诸侯等级的城堡伯爵。1356年他娶迈森的伊丽莎白为妻，女儿们分别嫁给罗马人的国王鲁普雷希特和奥地利公爵阿尔布雷希特三世。1398年他去世后，儿子们瓜分领地：约翰三世取得库尔姆巴赫，腓特烈六世取得安斯巴赫；腓特烈六世后来成为霍亨索伦家族首位勃兰登堡选帝侯。

en: Frederick of Zollern, born before 1325, was Prince-Bishop of Regensburg from 1340 to 1365, a son of Burgrave Frederick IV of Nuremberg and Margaret of Görz-Tyrol; with his brothers John as burgrave and Berthold as Bishop of Eichstätt, the family's influence in the south grew sharply. As provost of St Gumbert's at Ansbach he was chosen by most of the cathedral chapter after Bishop Nicholas of Ybbs died, but Emperor Louis the Bavarian and most of the ministerials backed a rival, Heinrich of Stein. Frederick had Pope Benedict XII and the council of Regensburg behind him. Both claimants pledged castles and borrowed to win ground, and the bishopric was left deeply in debt. Heinrich withdrew in 1345 and the emperor accepted Frederick. He later gave Donaustauf Castle to Emperor Charles IV, over the chapter's protests, and in 1349 saw plague empty villages across his diocese. He resigned in 1365 and died before February 1368.
zh: 索伦的腓特烈（1325年前生）于1340年至1365年任雷根斯堡采邑主教，是纽伦堡城堡伯爵腓特烈四世与戈里齐亚-蒂罗尔的玛格丽特之子；兄弟约翰任城堡伯爵、贝特霍尔德任艾希施泰特主教，家族在南方的影响力大增。他曾任安斯巴赫圣贡伯特修道院教长。伊布斯的尼古拉主教去世后，多数主教座堂教士选他继任，但皇帝巴伐利亚人路易和多数家臣官员支持对立主教施泰因的海因里希。腓特烈得到教宗本笃十二世和雷根斯堡议会的支持。两位主教都靠抵押城堡、举债来争夺地盘，主教区因此债台高筑。1345年海因里希放弃，皇帝转而接受腓特烈。此后他把多瑙施陶夫城堡转给皇帝查理四世，教士会为此大为不满；1349年黑死病使教区内许多村庄人口死绝。他于1365年辞职，1368年2月前去世。

en: Hildegard von Schlüsselberg was a daughter of the Franconian lord Konrad II von Schlüsselberg and his second wife, Agnes of Württemberg. She is said to have married Count Eitel Friedrich von Zollern.
zh: 希尔德加德·冯·施吕塞尔贝格是法兰克尼亚领主康拉德二世·冯·施吕塞尔贝格与继室符腾堡的阿格内丝之女，相传嫁给了佐勒恩伯爵艾特尔·弗里德里希。

en: John I (c. 1279–1300) was a Hohenzollern burgrave of Nuremberg, the elder son of Burgrave Frederick III and his second wife Helen of Saxony. On his father's death in 1297 he succeeded to the burgraviate and ruled it jointly with his younger brother Frederick IV. In the same year he married Agnes of Hesse, daughter of Landgrave Henry I of Hesse. He died childless in 1300 after a reign of three years, leaving Frederick IV to rule alone.
zh: 约翰一世（约1279—1300）是霍亨索伦家族的纽伦堡城堡伯爵，为城堡伯爵腓特烈三世与第二任妻子萨克森的海伦娜所生的长子。1297年父亲去世后，他继承城堡伯国，与弟弟腓特烈四世共同统治；同年，他迎娶黑森方伯亨利一世之女阿格妮丝。1300年，他在统治三年后无子而终，腓特烈四世自此独掌城堡伯国。

en: John II (c. 1309 – 1357), called the Acquirer, was Burgrave of Nuremberg and elder son of Frederick IV and Margarete of Görz-Tyrol. Succeeding in 1332, he earned his byname by enlarging the Hohenzollern lands in Franconia, chiefly through an inheritance treaty that brought him Plassenburg Castle and Kulmbach in 1340, when the counts of Orlamünde died out. In 1345 he briefly governed the March of Brandenburg as steward for the Wittelsbach margrave Louis, the first Hohenzollern to act there. When plague reached Nuremberg in his time, the city's Jews were massacred and the burgrave did not intervene. By Elisabeth of Henneberg he left an only son, Frederick V, who succeeded him; two daughters, Anna and Adelheid, became abbesses of Birkenfeld.
zh: 约翰二世（约1309年—1357年），绰号“整合者”，是纽伦堡城堡伯爵，腓特烈四世与戈里齐亚-蒂罗尔的玛格丽特的长子。他1332年袭位，因扩张霍亨索伦家族在法兰克尼亚的领地而得此绰号，最重要的是凭借继承条约，在1340年奥拉明德伯爵家族绝嗣时获得普拉森堡城堡和库尔姆巴赫。1345年，他曾短暂为维特尔斯巴赫家族的路易藩侯代管勃兰登堡藩侯国，是最早在当地任事的霍亨索伦成员。他在位时瘟疫袭来纽伦堡，城中犹太人遭屠杀，他并未干预。他与亨讷贝格的伊丽莎白只留下独子腓特烈五世，由其继位；女儿安娜和阿德尔海德先后出任比肯费尔德修道院院长。

en: Catherine of Nuremberg (c. 1323 – after 1373) was a Hohenzollern princess of the burgraves of Nuremberg. Her father, Frederick IV, fought beside Louis the Bavarian at Mühldorf in 1322 and captured the Habsburg rival Frederick the Fair; in 1331 he bought the town of Ansbach, the seed of the later Hohenzollern principality there, and died the next year. Her mother was Margaret of Görz-Tyrol, granddaughter of Duke Meinhard II. Catherine was betrothed at Würzburg on 29 June 1335 and married before June 1338 Eberhard I, eldest son of Count Rudolf IV of Wertheim. As countess she bore at least thirteen children, including John I, who succeeded as count, and Albert, bishop of Bamberg from 1398. Two of her brothers also became bishops: Frederick of Regensburg and Berthold of Eichstätt. She is last recorded alive on 11 March 1373.
zh: 卡塔琳娜·冯·纽伦堡（约1323年生，1373年3月11日后卒）是霍亨索伦家族纽伦堡城堡伯爵一系的公主。她的父亲腓特烈四世1322年在米尔多夫与国王路易（巴伐利亚人）并肩作战，俘获哈布斯堡的对手“美男子”腓特烈；1331年他买下安斯巴赫城，这里后来成为霍亨索伦家族安斯巴赫侯国的起点，他本人次年去世。母亲是格尔茨-蒂罗尔的玛格丽特，迈因哈德二世公爵的孙女。卡塔琳娜1335年6月29日在维尔茨堡订婚，1338年6月前嫁给韦尔特海姆伯爵鲁道夫四世的长子埃伯哈德一世。作为伯爵夫人，她至少育有十三个子女，其中包括袭爵为伯爵的约翰一世和1398年出任班贝格主教的阿尔布雷希特。她的两位兄弟同样成了主教：雷根斯堡的腓特烈和艾希施泰特的贝特霍尔德。她在1373年3月11日之后再无记载。

en: Conrad I (c. 1186 – 1261) was a Hohenzollern Burgrave of Nuremberg. The elder son of Burgrave Frederick I and Sophie of Raabs, he first held the Swabian county of Zollern, receiving the Franconian lands and burgraviate in a family partition of 1218. A loyal Hohenstaufen partisan, he backed Emperor Frederick II even in exile and in 1219 took military protection of Nuremberg after its freedom charter. In 1237–1239 he administered Austria alongside the counts of Henneberg and Andechs. He enlarged his lands with the Rangau and Ansbach, gained control of major trade routes to Nuremberg and fought marauding knights. He died in 1261 and was succeeded by his son Frederick III.
zh: 康拉德一世（约1186年—1261年）是霍亨索伦家族出身的纽伦堡城堡伯爵。他是城堡伯爵腓特烈一世与拉布斯的索菲的长子，起初领有士瓦本的索伦伯爵领地，1218年家族分产时得到法兰克尼亚的领地和城堡伯爵之位。作为霍亨斯陶芬家族的忠实党羽，他在皇帝腓特烈二世被放逐期间仍予支持；1219年纽伦堡获得自由特许状后，由他承担城市的军事护卫。1237—1239年他与亨讷贝格和安德克斯伯爵共同掌管奥地利。他取得兰高与安斯巴赫扩张领地，控制了通往纽伦堡的重要商路，并抵御劫掠骑士。他于1261年去世，子腓特烈三世继位。

en: Konrad II von Schlüsselberg (c. 1277–1347) was the most powerful and last lord of the Franconian noble house of Schlüsselberg. As royal champion and Reichssturmfähnrich he held the imperial battle-standard fief from 1322 to 1336. He enlarged his domains, securing town rights for Waischenfeld (1315), Ebermannstadt (1323) and Schlüsselfeld (1336) and holding seventeen castles. A feud in 1347 with the bishops of Würzburg and Bamberg and Burgrave John II of Nuremberg ended when a catapult stone killed him at the siege of Neideck on 14 September. His lands were divided among the victors, as he left no son.
zh: 康拉德二世·冯·施吕塞尔贝格（约1277—1347）是法兰克尼亚贵族施吕塞尔贝格家族最有权势、也是最后的领主。他担任国王先锋官兼帝国战旗旗手，于1322至1336年领有帝国战旗封地。他在法兰克尼亚扩张领地，先后为魏申费尔德（1315年）、埃伯曼施塔特（1323年）和施吕瑟尔费尔德（1336年）取得城市权，坐拥十七座城堡。1347年，他与维尔茨堡、班贝格两位主教及纽伦堡城堡伯爵约翰二世结仇开战，9月14日在奈戴克城堡围攻战中被投石机弹石击中身亡。因身后无子，他的领地被胜利者瓜分。

en: Conrad I of Schlüsselberg (died 1308), son of Eberhard II of Schlüsselberg and Elisabeth of Hohenzollern-Nuremberg and father of Conrad II, was a co-founder of Schlüsselau Abbey.
zh: 康拉德一世·冯·施吕塞尔贝格（卒于1308年）是埃伯哈德二世与伊丽莎白·冯·霍亨索伦-纽伦堡之子、康拉德二世之父，为施吕瑟尔奥修道院的共同创建者之一。

en: Margaret of Görz-Tyrol (c. 1291–1348) was the daughter of Albert II of Gorizia-Tyrol and Agnes of Hohenberg, and a granddaughter of Meinhard, Duke of Carinthia. Before August 1307 she married Frederick IV, Burgrave of Nuremberg. She was the mother of his ten children, among them John II, who succeeded as burgrave in 1332, Frederick, bishop of Regensburg, and Berthold, bishop of Eichstätt and chancellor to Emperor Charles IV. Margaret herself died in 1348.
zh: 格尔茨-蒂罗尔的玛格丽特（约1291—1348）是格尔茨-蒂罗尔的阿尔布雷希特二世与霍亨贝格的阿格尼丝之女，也是克恩滕公爵迈因哈德的孙女。1307年8月之前，她嫁给纽伦堡城伯腓特烈四世。她为丈夫生下十个子女，包括1332年继位为城伯的约翰二世、雷根斯堡主教腓特烈，以及艾希施泰特主教、皇帝查理四世的首相贝特霍尔德。玛格丽特于1348年去世。

en: Sophia von Schlüsselberg (died after 1360) was a daughter of the Franconian lord Konrad II von Schlüsselberg and was said to have married Friedrich III von Hohenzollern-Schalksburg, known as the Old Knight.
zh: 索菲娅·冯·施吕塞尔贝格（1360年后去世）是法兰克尼亚领主康拉德二世·冯·施吕塞尔贝格之女，相传嫁给绰号“老骑士”的弗里德里希三世·冯·霍亨索伦-沙尔克斯堡。

en: George Arianiti was an Albanian nobleman of the Arianiti family of central Albania. In March 1373 he and Bishop Kalist commissioned the Epitaph of Gllavenica, a liturgical cloth embroidered in silk and silver-gilt thread by the monk Savia at Gllavenica.
zh: 乔治·阿里亚尼蒂是阿尔巴尼亚中部阿里亚尼蒂家族的贵族。1373年3月，他与卡利斯特主教共同订制了格拉韦尼察祭幛：这幅礼仪用布以丝绸和镀金银线绣成，由修士萨维亚在格拉韦尼察制作。

en: Gulielm Arianiti was an Albanian nobleman of the Arianiti family. Angevin documents of 1304 name him as protolegator, and a papal bull of 1319 lists him among Albanian barons allied with Philip I, Prince of Taranto.
zh: 古列尔莫·阿里亚尼蒂是阿尔巴尼亚阿里亚尼蒂家族贵族。1304年的安茹文献以“首席特使”头衔记载其名，1319年的教宗诏书把他列为与塔兰托亲王腓力一世结盟的阿尔巴尼亚男爵之一。

en: Antonello da Messina (c. 1425–1430 – 1479) was a Sicilian painter of the Early Renaissance, born in Messina. Around 1450 he trained in Naples under Niccolò Colantonio, where he absorbed Netherlandish oil technique, probably through contact with Jan van Eyck's follower Petrus Christus. He became a master painter at Messina. His earliest documented commission, in 1457, was a banner for a confraternity in Reggio Calabria, where he established a workshop. His early paintings combined Flemish influences with Italian attention to the volume of figures. During a stay in Venice from 1475 to 1476, he painted the San Cassiano Altarpiece, the Condottiero and St. Sebastian, passing on oil-painting methods to Giovanni Bellini and the Venetian school. He died at Messina in February 1479.
zh: 安东内洛·达·梅西纳（约1425—1430年生，1479年卒）是文艺复兴早期的西西里画家，生于墨西拿。约1450年，他在那不勒斯师从尼科洛·科兰托尼奥，并很可能通过接触扬·凡·艾克的弟子彼得吕斯·克里斯蒂掌握了尼德兰油画技法。他在墨西拿成为画师。1457年，他接受了现存记录中最早的一项委托，为雷焦卡拉布里亚的一个兄弟会绘制旗帜，并在当地开设画坊。他的早期作品融合了佛兰德斯的影响和意大利画家对人物体积的重视。1475至1476年居留威尼斯期间，他创作了《圣卡夏诺祭坛画》《佣兵队长肖像》和《圣塞巴斯蒂安》，把油画技法传给了乔瓦尼·贝利尼和威尼斯画派。1479年2月，他在墨西拿去世。

en: António Fernandes (died 1520) was a Portuguese carpenter turned explorer, the first European known to have entered the Zimbabwean interior. Condemned to death for an unknown reason, he had his sentence commuted to exile in Africa. He arrived on the East African coast in 1501 and settled at Sofala in 1504. From 1511 to 1514 he explored the Zambezi and the inland region, reaching the court of the Mwenemutapa ruler Chikuyo Chisamarengu. In 1515–1516 he travelled up the Buzi River, and he died at Sofala in 1520.
zh: 安东尼奥·费尔南德斯（？—1520）是葡萄牙木匠出身的探险家，也是已知最早进入津巴布韦内陆的欧洲人。他因不明原因被判死刑，后获改判流放非洲，1501年抵达东非海岸，1504年定居索法拉。1511至1514年间，他探查赞比西河与内陆地区，抵达姆韦尼穆塔帕君主奇库约·奇萨马伦古的宫廷；1515至1516年又溯布济河而上，1520年卒于索法拉。

en: Henry I of Schönecken was a member of the lordly family of Schönecken in the Eifel, hereditary advocates of the imperial abbey of Prüm. He ruled as prince-abbot of Prüm from 1322 until his death in 1342, succeeding Walter of Blankenheim.
zh: 亨利希一世·冯·舍内肯出身艾费尔的舍内肯领主家族，该家族世代担任普吕姆帝国修道院的保护官。他于1322年接替瓦尔特·冯·布兰肯海姆出任普吕姆修道院长，以帝国诸侯身份统治普吕姆，直至1342年去世。

en: Amanieu d'Albret was the eldest son of Bernard Ezi V, lord of Albret, and Mathe d'Armagnac, born around 1331. Listed as the eldest son in 1341, he died before 1351; his younger brother Arnaud-Amanieu later succeeded their father.
zh: 阿马尼厄·德·阿尔布雷是阿尔布雷领主贝尔纳·埃齐五世与玛特·德·阿马尼亚克的长子，约1331年出生。1341年他被列为长子，1351年前去世；他的弟弟阿尔诺·阿马尼厄后来继承了父亲的领地。

en: Amanieu VII d'Albret (died 1326), one of the most powerful lords in Gascony, held the lordship of Albret from 1298. A kinsman of the Plantagenets and Pope Martin IV, he sat on the English King's Council under Edward I and Edward II. In 1286 he ended a private war with the English seneschal of Gascony in return for a payment from Edward I. During the French occupation of Aquitaine from 1294 to 1303, he expanded his authority at the expense of the ducal administration. In 1302 he was appointed to negotiate the Treaty of Paris that restored Gascony to England. He then courted both crowns, taking his quarrels to the Parlement of Paris and in 1324 joining the French in the War of Saint-Sardos. His son Bernard Ezi V succeeded him.
zh: 阿马尼厄七世·德·阿尔布雷（1326年卒）是加斯科涅最有权势的领主之一，自1298年起统治阿尔布雷领地。他与金雀花王室和教皇马丁四世都有亲谊，在英格兰国王爱德华一世、爱德华二世两朝出任国王会议成员。1286年，他接受爱德华一世的赔款，结束了与英方加斯科涅总督的私人战争。1294至1303年法军占领阿基坦期间，他削弱公国行政机构，扩大自身权力。1302年，他获任谈判代表，商议使加斯科涅归还英格兰的《巴黎条约》。此后他周旋于两顶王冠之间：把争端上诉到巴黎高等法院，更在1324年的圣萨尔多战争中倒向法兰西。其子贝尔纳·埃齐五世继立。

en: Bernard Ezi d'Albret, born before 24 January 1338, was the second son of Bernard Ezi V, lord of Albret, and Mathe d'Armagnac. In 1351 he was betrothed to Isabella, eldest daughter of Edward III of England, but they never married. He died that December.
zh: 贝尔纳·埃齐·德·阿尔布雷（1338年1月24日前出生）是阿尔布雷领主贝尔纳·埃齐五世与阿马尼亚克的玛特的次子。1351年，他与英王爱德华三世的长女伊莎贝拉订婚，但婚礼始终没有举行，同年12月他便去世。

en: Bernard Ezi V d'Albret (c. 1290–1358), son of Amanieu VII and Rose de Bourg, was Lord of Albret from 1324 and Viscount of Tartas, and one of the Gascon barons who stood by the English crown. In 1321 he married Mathe, daughter of Bernard VI of Armagnac, and they had twelve children. In 1330, when Edward III sent a mission to win over local nobles, he tried to marry his heir Arnaud Amanieu to a daughter of Edmund of Woodstock; the plan failed, but he still came away with money and lands. In 1337 Edward made him joint lieutenant of Aquitaine with Oliver Ingham, and he refused Philip VI's bribes. In 1340 he received Auribat and other lands in exchange for Montendre and Blaye. A 1351 betrothal of his son Bernard to Edward's daughter Isabella came to nothing. Arnaud Amanieu succeeded him.
zh: 贝尔纳·埃齐五世·德·阿尔布雷（约1290—1358）是阿马尼厄七世与罗丝·德·布尔之子，1324年起任阿尔布雷领主，兼塔尔塔斯子爵，是始终站在英格兰一边的加斯科涅男爵之一。1321年他娶阿马尼亚克的贝尔纳六世之女玛特为妻，育有十二个子女。1330年，爱德华三世遣使拉拢当地贵族，他试图为继承人阿尔诺·阿马尼厄求娶伍德斯托克的埃德蒙之女；婚事未成，他却由此得到了钱财和土地。1337年，爱德华三世任命他与奥利弗·英厄姆共同出任阿基坦公国副长官，他拒绝了腓力六世的贿赂。1340年，他以蒙唐德尔和布莱换得奥里巴等领地。1351年，其子贝尔纳与爱德华三世之女伊莎贝拉订婚，但婚约最终取消。他死后由阿尔诺·阿马尼厄继位。

en: Blanche de Ventadour was the daughter of Hélie, vicomte of Ventadour, and Marguerite de Beaujeu, and sister of Bernard I, who became count of Ventadour in 1350. She married Guichard de Comborn, seigneur of Treignac. Their children were Guichard and Sibylle.
zh: 布朗什·德·旺塔杜尔是旺塔杜尔子爵埃利与玛格丽特·德·博热之女，也是1350年成为旺塔杜尔伯爵的贝尔纳一世之妹。她嫁给特雷尼亚克领领主吉沙尔·德·孔博恩，子女为吉沙尔和西比勒。

en: Guichard II de Comborn (c. 1260–1330) was a Limousin lord, son of Hélie de Comborn, seigneur of Chamberet. He founded the Treignac branch of the House of Comborn, holding Treignac, and married Marie, daughter of Guy, vicomte of Comborn.
zh: 吉沙尔二世·德·孔博恩（约1260—1330）是利穆赞贵族、尚伯雷领主埃利·德·孔博恩之子。他创立了孔博恩家族的特雷尼亚克支系，领有特雷尼亚克，并娶孔博恩子爵居伊之女玛丽。

en: Guichard de Comborn, seigneur of Treignac (last recorded on 25 November 1366), was the son of Guichard de Comborn and Blanche de Ventadour. He was the father of Guichard V.
zh: 特雷尼亚克领领主吉沙尔·德·孔博恩（1366年11月25日最后见于记载）是吉沙尔·德·孔博恩与布朗什·德·旺塔杜尔之子，也是吉沙尔五世的父亲。

en: Hugh, called le Brun (the Brown), was a Poitevin baron of the Lusignan family, eldest son of Hugh VIII of Lusignan and Burgundia of Rancon, and elder brother of Aimery and Guy, later kings of Jerusalem and Cyprus. He helped administer the family estates and appears as lord of Lusignan while his father was on crusade after 1163. In the Aquitanian revolt of 1168 Henry II Plantagenet took and dismantled Lusignan castle, which the brothers rebuilt. Hugh died before his father in April 1169 and was buried at Lusignan, leaving by Aurengarde of Exoudun three underage children, including Hugh IX.
zh: 于格，绰号“棕发者”，是吕西尼昂家族的普瓦图男爵，吕西尼昂的于格八世与朗孔的勃艮第的长子，也是后来成为耶路撒冷和塞浦路斯国王的艾默里与居伊的兄长。他协助管理家族产业，1163年父亲东征期间，以吕西尼昂领主的身份出现在特许状中。1168年阿基坦诸侯叛乱期间，英格兰的亨利二世攻占并拆毁吕西尼昂城堡，吕西尼昂兄弟随后将其重建。1169年4月，于格先于父亲去世，葬在吕西尼昂；他与埃克苏丹的奥朗加德留下三个年幼子女，其中包括于格九世。

en: Hugh VIII, called the Old, of Lusignan was a Poitevin baron, eldest son of Hugh VII of Lusignan and Sarracena of Lezay. On his father's death in 1151 he inherited Lusignan, Couhé and Château-Larcher, and through his wife Burgundia of Rancon, lady of Fontenay, he gained further castles in Poitou and Saintonge. He took the cross in 1163 and led a crusader contingent to the Holy Land. In 1164 his troops joined a surprise attack on Nur ad-Din's camp at the plain of La Bocquée. Nur ad-Din captured him at the Battle of Harim on 11 August 1164 and took him to Aleppo. His sons included Guy and Aimery, future rulers of Jerusalem and Cyprus.
zh: 吕西尼昂的于格八世，世称“老者”，是普瓦图贵族，吕西尼昂的于格七世与勒泽的萨拉瑟娜的长子。1151年父亲去世后，他继承吕西尼昂、库埃和夏特拉尔谢等领地，又通过妻子、丰特奈女主人朗孔的勃艮第，在普瓦图和圣通日掌握更多城堡。1163年他领取十字，率一支十字军前往圣地。1164年，他的部队参与突袭努尔丁在博凯平原的营地。同年8月11日，他在哈里姆之战中被努尔丁俘获，押往阿勒颇。他的儿子居伊和艾默里后来相继成为耶路撒冷与塞浦路斯的统治者。

en: Guichard de Comborn, seigneur of Treignac (last recorded on 24 October 1346), was the son of Guichard II and Marie de Comborn. He married Blanche, daughter of Hélie, vicomte of Ventadour. Their children included Guichard, who inherited Treignac, and Sibylle, wife of Aymeric de Bonneval.
zh: 特雷尼亚克领领主吉沙尔·德·孔博恩（1346年10月24日最后见于记载）是吉沙尔二世与玛丽·德·孔博恩之子。他娶旺塔杜尔子爵埃利之女布朗什，子女包括承袭特雷尼亚克的吉沙尔，以及嫁给艾默里·德·博纳瓦尔的西比勒。

en: Jeanne d'Albret was the eldest daughter of Bernard Ezi V d'Albret, Lord of Albret, and Mathe of Armagnac. On 8 July 1350 she married Jean-Jourdain I, Count of L'Isle-Jourdain, and she died before 15 July 1359.
zh: 让娜·德·阿尔布雷是阿尔布雷领主贝尔纳·埃齐五世与阿马尼亚克的玛特的长女。1350年7月8日，她嫁给利勒茹尔丹伯爵让-茹尔丹一世，于1359年7月15日前去世。

en: Mathe d'Armagnac (1302–1364) was the daughter of Bernard VI, Count of Armagnac, and Cécile de Rodez. On 21 May 1321 she married Bernard Ezi V, lord of Albret, as his second wife. He became one of the Gascon barons most faithful to Edward III of England and in 1337 was named joint lieutenant of the Duchy of Aquitaine. The marriage produced twelve children, including Arnaud-Amanieu, who inherited Albret, and Jeanne and Rose, married in 1350 to the count of L'Isle and to Jean III de Grailly, captal de Buch.
zh: 玛特·德·阿马尼亚克（1302—1364）是阿马尼亚克伯爵贝尔纳六世与塞西尔·德·罗代斯之女。1321年5月21日，她作为继室嫁给阿尔布雷领主贝尔纳·埃齐五世。其夫是最忠于英王爱德华三世的加斯科涅贵族之一，1337年受命共同代理阿基坦公国。两人育有十二个子女，包括继承阿尔布雷领地的阿尔诺·阿马尼厄，以及1350年分别嫁给利勒伯爵和比什卡普塔尔让三世·德·格拉伊的让娜与罗丝。

en: Rose d'Albret was the second daughter of Bernard Ezi V, lord of Albret, and Mathe d'Armagnac. On 27 November 1350 she married Jean III de Grailly, captal de Buch, a Gascon commander in the Hundred Years' War; the marriage was childless.
zh: 罗莎·德·阿尔布雷是阿尔布雷领主贝尔纳·埃齐五世与阿马尼亚克的玛特的次女。1350年11月27日，她嫁给加斯科涅名将、布赫领主让三世·德·格拉伊，两人没有子女。

en: Bertrand of Saint-Geniès (c. 1260 – 6 June 1350), a Gascon law professor at Toulouse and papal chaplain, was already old when he became Patriarch of Aquileia in 1334, yet he came to Friuli with a full programme of reform and ruled its powerful patriarchal state as a prince. Allied with Venice and the Duke of Austria, he defeated Rizzardo da Camino in 1335, pressed the counts of Gorizia into a truce in 1341 and recovered the Cadore in 1347. He and the abbot of Moggio once celebrated Christmas mass in armour, a scene Udine re-enacted until 1848. He curbed the Friulian feudal lords, built Rocca Bertranda to hold the Alpine passes and founded the university of Cividale in 1344. The nobles allied against him in 1348, and on 6 June 1350, in his nineties, he was ambushed and killed by Enrico da Spilimbergo at San Giorgio della Richinvelda. The Church venerates him as a blessed martyr.
zh: 圣热涅的贝特朗（约1260—1350年6月6日）是加斯科涅出身的法学家，曾任图卢兹大学法学教授和教皇专职司铎。1334年出任阿奎莱亚牧首时他已年事很高，却带着一整套改革方案来到弗留利，以君主的身份治理这个强大的牧首国。他联合威尼斯与奥地利公爵，1335年击败里扎尔多·达·卡米诺，1341年迫使格尔茨伯爵们休战，1347年收复卡多雷。他与摩焦修道院院长曾披甲主持一次圣诞弥撒，乌迪内直到1848年仍重演这一幕。他压制弗留利的封建领主，修建贝尔特兰达要塞扼守阿尔卑斯山口，并于1344年创办奇维达莱大学。1348年贵族们结盟反对他；1350年6月6日，年过九旬的他在圣乔治-德拉里金韦尔达遭恩里科·达·斯皮林贝戈伏击身亡。天主教会尊他为真福殉道者。

en: Cassone della Torre, or Gastone (c. 1269–1318), was a Torriani churchman, son of Corrado 'Mosca' della Torre. Canon of Cividale from 1296, he returned to Milan in 1302 and became archbishop in 1308. Driven out by his cousin Guido in 1309, he returned to crown Henry VII as King of Italy on 6 January 1311. Forced to leave Milan again in 1311, he excommunicated Matteo I Visconti in 1314 and was made Patriarch of Aquileia by John XXII in 1316. He died in a fall from his horse at Florence on 20 August 1318 and was buried in Santa Croce under a monument attributed to Tino da Camaino.
zh: 卡索内·德拉·托雷，一称加斯通（约1269—1318），是托里亚尼家族教士，科拉多·“莫斯卡”·德拉·托雷之子。1296年他成为奇维达莱的大教堂教士，1302年返回米兰，1308年出任米兰大主教。1309年堂兄圭多将他驱逐，他后来返回米兰，于1311年1月6日为皇帝亨利七世加冕意大利国王。1311年他再次被迫离开米兰，1314年绝罚马泰奥一世·维斯孔蒂，1316年被教皇约翰二十二世任命为阿奎莱亚牧首。1318年8月20日，他在佛罗伦萨坠马身亡，葬于圣十字教堂，墓冢传为蒂诺·达·卡马伊诺所作。

en: Febo I della Torre, called Febosino (c. 1261–1329), was a Milanese nobleman of the Torriani, son of Lombardo della Torre, who perished in the Baradello prison after the defeat at Desio. In 1274 he settled on the Tagliamento under his great-uncle Raimondo, Patriarch of Aquileia, and with his brother Raimondo held the fief of Flambro from the counts of Gorizia. As castellan of Tolmino he was captured by the men of Cividale through treason in 1292. Freed, he became the patriarch's vicedominus in 1298, and served as podestà of Treviso in 1321 and of Trieste in 1328 and 1329.
zh: 费博一世·德拉·托雷，绰号小费博（约1261—1329），米兰托里亚尼家族贵族，伦巴多·德拉·托雷之子，其父在代西奥战败后死于巴拉德罗监狱。1274年，他在叔祖父、阿奎莱亚牧首雷蒙多的庇护下定居塔利亚门托河畔，并与兄弟雷蒙多一同从戈里齐亚伯爵手中受封弗拉姆布罗。他担任托尔米诺城堡总管时，于1292年因叛变被奇维达莱人俘虏。获释后，他于1298年成为牧首副摄政，又在1321年出任特雷维索执政官，1328—1329年出任的里雅斯特执政官。

en: Giovanni della Torre, known as Gian Furiano (c. 1291–1345), was the only son of Febo I della Torre and the first of his line born in Friuli, which gave him his nickname. He followed Patriarch Pagano della Torre in the Torriani wars against the Visconti of Milan: he fought at Solicino, entered Monza and was defeated at Vaprio in 1324. Back in Friuli, after Pagano's death, he and his cousin Ermacora joined the enemies of the new patriarch Bertrando, backing Rizzardo da Camino's invasion and feuding with the Savorgnano. After a clash with Udine's forces near Flambro, the patriarch had the stronghold dismantled and the Torriani stripped of their fiefs. Gian Furiano still grew in power through gifts from the counts of Gorizia, who made him captain of Latisana. He died in 1345, before the league against Bertrando ended in the patriarch's murder.
zh: 乔瓦尼·德拉·托雷，人称詹·富里亚诺（约1291—1345），是费博一世·德拉·托雷的独子，也是家族这一支中第一个生于弗留利的人，故得绰号“弗留利人”。他随牧首帕加诺·德拉·托雷参加托里亚尼家族对米兰维斯孔蒂家族的战争，转战索利奇诺、进入蒙扎，1324年在瓦普里奥战败。回到弗留利后，帕加诺已死，他与堂兄埃尔马科拉站到新牧首贝尔特兰多的敌人一边，支持里扎尔多·达·卡米诺入侵，并与萨沃尔尼亚诺家族争斗。托里亚尼派在弗拉姆布罗附近与乌迪内军队交战后，牧首下令拆毁要塞，剥夺其封地。詹·富里亚诺仍靠戈里齐亚伯爵的赠予壮大势力，并被任命为拉蒂萨纳统领。他于1345年去世，没有看到反对贝尔特兰多的同盟以牧首被害收场。

en: Ludovico della Torre (died 30 July 1365) belonged to the Torriani, a family that had already given Friuli three patriarchs. The son of Raimondo II della Torre, he began as a canon of Aquileia, became bishop of Trieste in 1346, later bishop of Olena and Coron, and was named Patriarch of Aquileia by Innocent VI on 10 May 1359. In June 1361 Duke Rudolf IV of Austria invaded; Aquileia fell almost without a fight, and Ludovico was taken hostage to Vienna and pressed to accept harsh terms. Freed in 1362, he faced a second Habsburg invasion in 1363, but this time won the backing of his old enemy Charles IV, who wanted Friuli for a planned trade route from Venice to Prague, and of the da Carrara of Padua. Rudolf's forces were beaten in 1364. Ludovico died of a sudden fever at Soffumbergo on 30 July 1365, three days after Rudolf died in Milan.
zh: 卢多维科·德拉·托雷（？—1365年7月30日）出身托里亚尼家族，这个家族此前已为弗留利出过三位牧首。他是雷蒙多二世·德拉·托雷之子，起初是阿奎莱亚咏礼司铎，1346年成为的里雅斯特主教，后历任奥莱纳、科罗尼主教，1359年5月10日被教皇英诺森六世任命为阿奎莱亚牧首。1361年6月奥地利公爵鲁道夫四世入侵，阿奎莱亚几乎不战而降，卢多维科被掳往维也纳为人质，被迫接受苛刻条件。1362年获释后，1363年哈布斯堡军队再度来犯，这次他得到昔日对手查理四世的支持——后者想借弗留利打通从威尼斯到布拉格的商路——也得到帕多瓦卡拉雷塞家族的支持。1364年，鲁道夫的军队被击败。1365年7月30日，卢多维科在索丰贝戈死于急性热病，三天前鲁道夫刚在米兰去世。

en: Pagano della Torre (died 18 December 1332) was an Italian prelate of the Milanese della Torre family, which had settled in Friuli after the Visconti drove his kin from Milan. Bishop of Padua from 1302, he succeeded his uncle Cassone della Torre as Patriarch of Aquileia in 1319. He joined the della Torre crusade against the Visconti, financed by the sale of indulgences, but was beaten at Bassignana in 1322 and Vaprio in 1324, abandoning hopes of retaking Milan. War debts forced him to sell his mitre and library. Heavy taxation pushed Rovigno (1330), Pola (1331) and other Istrian towns to surrender to Venice, and he died soon after Pope John XXII mediated peace in 1332.
zh: 帕加诺·德拉·托雷（？—1332年12月18日）出身米兰德拉·托雷家族；该家族被维斯孔蒂家族逐出米兰后迁居弗留利。他自1302年起任帕多瓦主教，1319年继叔父卡索内·德拉·托雷之后成为阿奎莱亚牧首。他参与了家族反攻米兰、对抗维斯孔蒂家族的十字军，军费来自出售赎罪券，却于1322年在巴西尼亚纳、1324年在瓦普里奥接连战败，放弃收复米兰的打算。战争债务迫使他卖掉主教冠和藏书。沉重赋税迫使罗维尼奥、波拉等伊斯特里亚城市于1330年、1331年先后投奔威尼斯，1332年教皇约翰二十二世出面调停媾和后不久，他便去世。

en: Raimondo della Torre (c. 1230 – 23 February 1299) was a cleric of the Guelph della Torre family, son of Pagano I of Milan and brother of Napo. As bishop of Como he was captured in 1269 and publicly displayed in a cage at Sondalo in the Valtellina until della Torre troops freed him in 1273. Appointed Patriarch of Aquileia in 1273, he sheltered kinsmen exiled after the battle of Desio. He fought Venice for Capodistria and Trieste, storming Moccò in 1289 and annexing Trieste by the 1291 Peace of Treviso. He repelled an attack by the da Camino of Treviso, crushed revolts by his vassals and the counts of Gorizia and was buried in Aquileia Basilica.
zh: 雷蒙多·德拉·托雷（约1230—1299年2月23日）出身教皇派的德拉·托雷家族，是米兰统治者帕加诺一世之子、纳波·德拉·托雷之弟。他任科莫主教期间于1269年被俘，在瓦尔泰利纳的松达洛被关进笼子示众，直到1273年家族军队将他救出。同年他被任命为阿奎莱亚牧首，收留代西奥之战后流亡的族人；他为卡波迪斯特里亚和的里雅斯特与威尼斯交战，1289年攻克莫科要塞，依据1291年的《特雷维索和约》吞并的里雅斯特。他击退特雷维索的达·卡米诺家族的进攻，平定封臣和格尔茨伯爵的叛乱，死后葬于阿奎莱亚大教堂。

en: Raimondo II della Torre (c. 1267–1323) was a Milanese Torriani nobleman who, with his brother Febo, held the fief of Flambro from the counts of Gorizia and feuded with the Savorgnano. He was the father of Ludovico della Torre, Patriarch of Aquileia from 1359.
zh: 雷蒙多二世·德拉·托雷（约1267—1323）是米兰托里亚尼家族贵族，与兄弟费博一同从戈里齐亚伯爵手中受封弗留利的弗拉姆布罗，并与萨沃尔尼亚诺家族结怨。他是1359年就任阿奎莱亚牧首的卢多维科·德拉·托雷之父。

en: Alfonso II (25 March 1157 – 25 April 1196), called the Chaste, was the first king of Aragon to rule as count of Barcelona. His father Ramon Berenguer IV died in 1162; his mother Petronilla abdicated the Aragonese throne in his favour in 1164 and acted as his regent. He allied with Castile, marrying Sancha, sister of Alfonso VIII, in 1174, and pushed the Reconquista to Teruel and Caspe in 1171; the Treaty of Cazorla in 1179 fixed Aragon's southern claims. He held Provence from 1166 to 1173, when he ceded it to his brother, and added Cerdanya and Roussillon. A patron of troubadours, he died at Perpignan in 1196.
zh: 阿方索二世（1157年3月25日—1196年4月25日），绰号“纯洁者”，是第一位同时以巴塞罗那伯爵身份统治的阿拉贡国王。他的父亲拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世于1162年去世；母亲佩特罗尼拉于1164年将阿拉贡王位让给他，并为他摄政。他与卡斯蒂利亚结盟，1174年娶阿方索八世之妹桑恰为后，1171年攻取特鲁埃尔和卡斯佩，把收复失地运动向南推进，1179年的《卡索拉条约》划定了阿拉贡的南方势力范围。他1166年起领有普罗旺斯，1173年将其让给弟弟，又取得塞尔达尼亚与鲁西永。他以庇护游吟诗人著称，1196年在佩皮尼昂去世。

en: Alfonso III the Liberal (4 November 1265 – 18 June 1291), son of Peter III and Constance of Sicily, became King of Aragon in 1285. He moved at once against his uncle James II of Majorca: his troops took Majorca in 1285, Ibiza in 1286 and, on 17 January 1287, Menorca, until then an autonomous Muslim island. At home he was forced to grant the Privilege of the Union to the Aragonese nobility, surrendering important royal powers. He initially supported his brother James's claim to Sicily, but withdrew that support shortly before his death and sought peace with the papacy and France. Betrothed to Eleanor, daughter of Edward I of England, he died in Barcelona on 18 June 1291 before the marriage, aged 25.
zh: 阿方索三世（慷慨者）（1265年11月4日—1291年6月18日）是佩德罗三世与西西里的科斯坦察之子，1285年即位为阿拉贡国王。他随即出兵征讨其叔马略卡国王海梅二世：1285年攻占马略卡，1286年攻取伊维萨，1287年1月17日攻克当时仍是穆斯林自治岛屿的梅诺卡。在国内，他被迫向阿拉贡贵族颁布《联盟特权令》，让出多项重要王权。他起初支持弟弟海梅对西西里的主张，临终前却撤回支持，寻求与教廷和法国议和。他与英格兰国王爱德华一世之女埃莉诺订有婚约，却于1291年6月18日在巴塞罗那未婚而卒，年仅25岁。

en: Alfonso de Aragón y Foix, called the Old (1332–1412), was the eldest son of Count Peter of Ribagorza and Joanna of Foix, a grandson of James II of Aragon and a cousin of Peter IV. He married Violante Díaz de Arenós in 1355, the year he became Count of Dénia. He added Ribagorza in 1361 and the marquisate of Villena in 1366, served as the first Constable of Castile, and was made the first Duke of Gandía in 1399. His chance came in 1410, when King Martin died childless and left the Crown of Aragon without a direct heir. As the senior male-line descendant of James II, Alfonso put in a claim, but he died at Gandía in March 1412, before the Compromise of Caspe settled the succession. His brother Juan inherited the claim, and his son Alfonso inherited Gandía, Ribagorza and Dénia.
zh: 阿方索·德·阿拉贡-富瓦（1332—1412），人称“老者”，是里瓦戈萨伯爵彼得与富瓦的胡安娜的长子，阿拉贡国王海梅二世之孙，佩德罗四世的堂兄弟。1355年，他娶比奥兰特·迪亚斯·德·阿雷诺斯为妻，同年成为德尼亚伯爵；1361年袭任里瓦戈萨伯爵，1366年成为比列纳侯爵，曾任卡斯蒂利亚首任统帅，1399年又被封为首任甘迪亚公爵。机会出现在1410年：马丁国王无嗣而终，阿拉贡王位没有直系继承人。阿方索作为海梅二世最年长的男系后裔，提出了王位主张，却在1412年3月于甘迪亚去世，没能等到卡斯佩妥协方案解决继承问题。他的弟弟胡安继承了这一主张，儿子阿方索则继承了甘迪亚、里瓦戈萨和德尼亚。

en: Alfonso I, called the Battler (c. 1073–1134), ruled as king of Aragon and Navarre from 1104, succeeding his brother Peter I. Raised at the monastery of Siresa, he learned both letters and military arts, and joined his brother in taking Huesca in 1096. In 1109 he married Urraca, queen of Castile and León, and claimed the title Emperor of Spain, but the marriage collapsed into years of civil war. His greatest successes came in the Reconquista: he took Zaragoza in 1118, then seized Tudela, Tarazona, Calatayud and Daroca in the middle Ebro valley. He died after his defeat at Fraga in 1134, leaving his kingdoms to the military orders, a will his nobility rejected. Aragon and Navarre chose separate kings.
zh: 阿方索一世，绰号“战士”（约1073—1134），自1104年起继兄长佩德罗一世之后任阿拉贡与纳瓦拉国王。他在锡雷萨修道院长大，学习读写和军事技艺，1096年随兄长攻取韦斯卡。1109年，他与卡斯蒂利亚和莱昂女王乌拉卡结婚，自称“全西班牙皇帝”，但婚姻最终演变为连年内战。他最大的功业在收复失地运动：1118年攻克萨拉戈萨，随后夺取埃布罗河中游的图德拉、塔拉索纳、卡拉泰乌德和达罗卡。1134年他在弗拉加战败后去世，临终把王国留给各军事修会，这份遗嘱被贵族们否决。阿拉贡和纳瓦拉各自选立了国王。

en: Alfonso IV the Kind (2 November 1299 – 24 January 1336) was born in Naples, the second son of James II and Blanche of Anjou. In 1314 he married Teresa d'Entença, heiress to the County of Urgell, which thereby joined the Crown lands; he became heir when his elder brother James renounced the throne in 1319. He led the 1323–1324 conquest of Sardinia and succeeded as king in November 1327. His reign added the Duchies of Athens and Neopatria and brought a long war with Genoa from 1329. That year he married Eleanor of Castile; his grants of land to their sons divided the court and provoked opposition in Valencia. He died aged 36, leaving the crown to his son Peter IV.
zh: 阿方索四世（友善者）（1299年11月2日—1336年1月24日）出生于那不勒斯，是海梅二世与安茹的布朗什的次子。1314年，他与乌尔赫尔伯国的女继承人特蕾莎·德恩滕萨结婚，乌尔赫尔由此并入阿拉贡王室领地；1319年其兄海梅放弃王位出家，他成为王储。他曾率军在1323—1324年征服撒丁，1327年11月即位。他在位期间，雅典公国和新帕特里亚公国并入阿拉贡联合王国，1329年起又与热那亚陷入长期战争。同年他迎娶卡斯蒂利亚的埃莉诺，为二人的儿子分封土地，引发宫廷分裂和巴伦西亚人的反对。他36岁时去世，王位传给其子佩德罗四世。

en: Antonio Beccadelli (1394–1471), known as Il Panormita from his native Palermo, was an Italian humanist poet, canon lawyer and chronicler. After studying in Florence, Padua, Siena and Rome, he taught eloquence at Pavia and served as court poet to Filippo Maria Visconti of Milan. In 1425 he published Hermaphroditus, a Latin collection of erotic epigrams that made his name. From 1442 he served Alfonso V of Aragon at Naples as counsellor and panegyrist, and in 1448 founded the Porticus Antoniana, the humanist academy later named after Giovanni Pontano. He died at Naples on 19 January 1471.
zh: 安东尼奥·贝卡代利（1394—1471），人称“帕诺尔米塔”，意为“巴勒莫人”，是意大利人文主义诗人、教会法学家和编年史家。他曾在佛罗伦萨、帕多瓦、锡耶纳和罗马求学，后在帕维亚教授雄辩术，并担任米兰的菲利波·马里亚·维斯孔蒂的宫廷诗人。1425年，他出版拉丁语艳情警诗集《赫耳玛佛洛狄托斯》，由此成名。1442年起，他在那不勒斯效力于阿拉贡的阿方索五世，任顾问和颂辞作者；1448年他创办人文主义学园“安东尼门廊”，该园后来以乔瓦尼·蓬塔诺的名字命名。1471年1月19日，他在那不勒斯去世。

en: Bahya ben Asher ibn Halawa (1255–c. 1340) was a rabbi and biblical commentator in Zaragoza, in the Crown of Aragon. A pupil of Solomon ibn Aderet, known as the Rashba, he served his native city as a darshan, an expounder of scripture. He belonged to the circle of Kabbalists of Girona and is counted among the most distinguished Hebrew Bible exegetes of medieval Spain. Unlike his master, he wrote no Talmud commentary and devoted himself to interpreting the Torah.
zh: 巴赫亚·本·阿舍尔·伊本·哈拉瓦（1255—约1340）是阿拉贡王冠领地萨拉戈萨的拉比与《希伯来圣经》注释家。他是什洛莫·伊本·阿德列特（拉什巴）的弟子，在家乡担任讲解经文的“讲道人”。他属于赫罗纳的卡巴拉学者圈子，被视为中世纪西班牙最杰出的《圣经》释经家之一。与老师不同，他没有撰写《塔木德》注疏，而是以阐释《托拉》为业。

en: Blanche of Empúries (born 1334) was the daughter of Ramon Berenguer I, count of Empúries, and Blanche of Taranto. She married Hugh II, viscount of Cardona, who fought for King Peter IV of Aragon and became the first count of Cardona in 1375.
zh: 安普里亚斯的布朗什（1334年生）是安普里亚斯伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔一世与塔兰托的布朗什之女。她嫁给卡尔多纳子爵乌戈二世；乌戈为阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世作战，于1375年成为第一代卡尔多纳伯爵。

en: Blanche of Anjou (1280–1310), also called Blanche of Naples, was the daughter of Charles II of Naples and Mary of Hungary, and queen of Aragon as the second wife of James II. Once betrothed to John I of Montferrat, she married James at Vilabertran on 29 October 1295 under the Treaty of Anagni, negotiated by Pope Boniface VIII between Aragon and Naples. She governed Aragon as queen-lieutenant during her husband's absence in 1310, dying on 14 October, probably after the birth of her daughter Violante. She was buried at Santes Creus; her son Alfonso IV later became king of Aragon.
zh: 安茹的布朗什（1280—1310），又称那不勒斯的布兰卡，是那不勒斯国王查理二世与匈牙利的玛丽亚之女，作为海梅二世的第二任妻子成为阿拉贡王后。她曾与蒙费拉侯爵乔瓦尼一世订婚，后依据教皇博义八世调停阿拉贡与那不勒斯签订的《阿纳尼条约》，于1295年10月29日在比拉韦尔特兰嫁给海梅。1310年丈夫外出期间，她以“王后摄政”身份治理阿拉贡，同年10月14日去世，疑与生下女儿约兰德有关，葬于桑特斯克雷乌斯修道院。其子阿方索四世后来成为阿拉贡国王。

en: Blanche de Foix was a daughter of Roger Bernard III, Viscount of Castelbon, and Constance de Luna. She married Lluís Cornell i Cardona and then Hug Roger II, Count of Pallars Sobirà, by whom she bore Roger Bernat I, later count of Pallars Sobirà.
zh: 布朗什·德·富瓦是卡斯泰尔邦子爵罗歇-贝尔纳三世与卢纳的康斯坦萨之女。她先嫁柳伊斯·科尔内利·伊·卡多纳，后改嫁帕利亚尔斯-索比拉伯爵乌格·罗歇二世，为其生子罗歇·贝尔纳特一世，即后来的帕利亚尔斯-索比拉伯爵。

en: Blanche of Taranto (1309–1337) was the daughter of Philip I of Anjou, prince of Taranto and Achaea and titular Latin emperor of Constantinople, by his first wife Thamar Angelina Komnene, daughter of the despot of Epirus. In 1327 she married her first cousin Ramon Berenguer of Aragon, count of Prades, who later exchanged Prades for the County of Empúries. Her two daughters were Joanna, wife of Fernando Manuel of Villena, and Blanche, who married Hugh II of Cardona. Blanche died in 1337, ten years after her wedding.
zh: 塔兰托的布朗什（1309—1337）是塔兰托和亚该亚亲王、君士坦丁堡名义拉丁皇帝菲利波一世·德安茹与第一任妻子、伊庇鲁斯专制君主之女塔玛尔·安杰利娜·科穆宁的女儿。1327年，她嫁给表兄、普拉德斯伯爵阿拉贡的拉蒙·贝伦格尔；拉蒙后来以普拉德斯换得安普里亚斯伯国。她的两个女儿分别是嫁给比列纳的费尔南多·曼努埃尔的乔瓦娜，以及嫁给卡尔多纳的乌戈二世的布朗什。布朗什于婚后十年、1337年去世。

en: Cécile de Comminges (c. 1320–1384) was the eldest daughter of Bernard VIII, Count of Comminges, and Mathe de l'Isle-Jourdain. In 1336 she married James I, Count of Urgell, and from 1339, when her little brother Jean died, she held the viscounty of Turenne in her own right. Her uncle Pierre-Raymond denied that women could inherit Comminges; a settlement, helped by the Archbishop of Toulouse, gave him the county and her Turenne. At Avignon she became a friend and adviser of Pope Clement VI, so close that rumour made her his mistress, and Petrarch called her ‘Semiramis with her quiver’. Widowed in 1347, she was regent of Urgell for her young son Peter II until 1360. In 1349 she sold Turenne to the pope for 145,000 gold florins, to pay her husband's debts and build a church at Balaguer among other works. She died at Balaguer Castle on 16 June 1384.
zh: 塞西尔·德·科曼日（约1320—1384）是科曼日伯爵贝尔纳八世与马特·德·利勒茹尔丹的长女。1336年，她嫁给乌拉尔伯爵海梅一世，1339年幼弟让夭折后，她以本人身份领有蒂雷纳子爵领。她的叔父皮埃尔-雷蒙以女性不能继承科曼日为由与她争夺继承权；在图卢兹大主教的斡旋下，叔父取得科曼日，她取得蒂雷纳。她在阿维尼翁成为教皇克雷芒六世的密友与顾问，亲近到传出她是教皇情妇的流言，彼特拉克称她为“带着箭袋的塞米拉米斯”。1347年丈夫去世后，她为年幼的儿子彼得二世摄政乌拉尔伯国，直到1360年。1349年，她以145,000金弗罗林将蒂雷纳卖给教皇，用来偿还丈夫的债务并兴建包括巴拉格尔一座教堂在内的建筑。1384年6月16日，她在巴拉格尔城堡去世。

en: Constance de Luna (c. 1310–1353) was the daughter of Artal III of Luna and Constanza Pérez de Aragón. She married Roger Bernard IV of Foix, viscount of Castelbon, youngest son of Gaston I of Foix, and bore him Roger Bernard V, Marguerite and Blanche.
zh: 康斯坦丝·德·卢纳（约1310—1353）是阿塔尔三世·德·卢纳与康斯坦萨·佩雷斯·德·阿拉贡之女。她嫁给富瓦伯爵加斯东一世的幼子、卡斯特尔邦子爵罗歇·贝尔纳四世，生下罗歇·贝尔纳五世、玛格丽特和布朗什。

en: Francesc Eiximenis (c. 1330–1409) was a Catalan Franciscan writer, probably born at Girona. He studied at Paris and Oxford and took his theology doctorate at Toulouse in 1374 with Peter IV's support. From 1382 to 1408 he lived in Valencia, advising its council; his works, above all Lo Crestià, were widely read, making him one of the most successful medieval Catalan writers. Peter IV, John I and Martin I of Aragon, Queen Maria de Luna and the Avignon pope Benedict XIII all read him. In 1408 Benedict XIII made him patriarch of Jerusalem and administrator of Elna; he died at Perpignan in April 1409.
zh: 弗朗塞斯克·埃希梅尼斯（约1330—1409）是加泰罗尼亚方济各会作家，可能生于赫罗纳。他曾在巴黎和牛津求学，1374年在佩德罗四世资助下于图卢兹取得神学博士学位。1382年至1408年他住在瓦伦西亚，为市议会担任顾问；他的著作，尤其是《基督徒》，广受阅读，使他成为中世纪最成功的加泰罗尼亚作家之一。阿拉贡的佩德罗四世、胡安一世、马丁一世，玛丽亚·德·卢纳王后以及阿维尼翁教宗本笃十三世都读过他的作品。1408年，本笃十三世任命他为耶路撒冷宗主教兼埃尔讷教区署理；1409年4月他在佩皮尼昂去世。

en: Eleanor of Aragon (1333–1417), daughter of Peter, count of Ribagorza, and Joan of Foix, was queen of Cyprus through her marriage in 1353 to Peter I, arranged by Peter IV of Aragon. She held the regency in 1366 while her husband campaigned against Alexandria. After Peter I was murdered in January 1369, she ruled as regent for her son Peter II, called in the Genoese to avenge him and arranged the killing of John in 1374. She later returned to Catalonia as lady of Valls and died at the castle of Falset.
zh: 阿拉贡的埃莉诺（1333—1417）是里瓦戈萨伯爵佩德罗与富瓦的胡安娜之女。1353年，经阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世安排，她嫁给塞浦路斯国王彼得一世，成为塞浦路斯王后。1366年丈夫远征亚历山大港期间，她出任摄政；1369年1月彼得一世遇害后，她为儿子彼得二世摄政，召来热那亚人复仇，并于1374年安排除掉小叔约翰。后来她回到加泰罗尼亚，成为巴尔斯的女领主，最终在法尔塞特城堡去世。

en: Ferdinand of Aragon (11 December 1329 – 16 July 1363) was the elder son of Alfonso IV and his second wife Eleanor of Castile, and half-brother of Peter IV. Alfonso's plan to grant him Valencian lands angered the heir and the Valencians and was dropped, as was a marquisate of Tortosa. In 1335 Eleanor fled with her sons to Castile. Peter IV confiscated their possessions after succeeding Alfonso, but restored them in 1338. After James of Urgell died in 1347, Ferdinand took over the Valencian opposition to the king and won recognition as governor of Valencia, but he was wounded, defeated and captured at Epila in 1348, and freed at Castile's request. In 1357 Peter made him lieutenant general and later gave him command of his army in the War of the Two Peters. The king then suspected treason. On 16 July 1363, after dining with Peter at Burriana, Ferdinand refused arrest, drew his sword and was killed.
zh: 阿拉贡的费尔南多（1329年12月11日—1363年7月16日）是阿方索四世与第二任妻子卡斯蒂利亚的埃莉诺的长子，佩德罗四世的异母弟。阿方索打算把巴伦西亚的部分领地分给他，王储与巴伦西亚人都为此不满，计划作罢，托尔托萨侯爵之位也被撤销。1335年，埃莉诺带着两个儿子逃往卡斯蒂利亚。佩德罗四世继位后没收了他们的财产，1338年才归还。1347年乌赫尔的海梅去世后，费尔南多接过巴伦西亚反对国王的旗帜，获得巴伦西亚总督的名位，但1348年在埃皮拉之战中受伤兵败被俘，应卡斯蒂利亚之请获释。1357年佩德罗授他副将军之职，后来又让他统率两个佩德罗战争中的军队，随后却渐起疑心，认为他通敌。1363年7月16日，费尔南多在布里亚纳与国王共进晚餐后拒绝被捕，拔剑抵抗，被杀。

en: Francesco of Arborea was a son of Judge Hugh II of Arborea and Benedetta, and a brother of Judges Peter III and Marianus IV. He entered the Church and became a canon of Urgell in Catalonia.
zh: 阿尔博雷亚的弗朗切斯科是阿尔博雷亚执政官乌戈内二世与贝内代塔之子、执政官彼得罗三世与马里亚诺四世的兄弟。他进入教会，在加泰罗尼亚的乌赫尔大教堂任法政牧师。

en: Baltasar Gracián (1601–1658) was a Spanish Jesuit, Baroque writer and philosopher, born at Belmonte near Calatayud in Aragon. Ordained in 1627, he made his name as a preacher and became rector of the Jesuit college at Tarragona, and in 1646 served as army chaplain when the French siege of Lleida was lifted. At Huesca he befriended the scholar Vincencio Juan de Lastanosa, who helped shape his intellectual development. His books on courtly conduct include The Hero and The Art of Worldly Wisdom (1647), and his allegorical novel El Criticón appeared from 1651 to 1657. Publishing without his order's leave, he was exiled to Graus in 1658 and died at Tarazona that December.
zh: 巴尔塔沙·葛拉西安（1601—1658）是西班牙耶稣会士、巴洛克作家与哲学家，生于阿拉贡卡拉塔尤德附近的贝尔蒙特。1627年晋铎，以讲道闻名，后任塔拉戈纳耶稣会学院院长；1646年他在为莱里达解围的西班牙军队中任随军神父。他在韦斯卡结识学者文森西奥·胡安·德·拉斯塔诺萨，后者帮助他发展学识。他著有《英雄》《智慧书》（1647）等探讨宫廷立身之道的作品，寓言小说《批评大师》于1651至1657年问世。因未经修会许可出书，他于1658年被流放格劳斯，同年12月卒于塔拉索纳。

en: James I the Conqueror (2 February 1208 – 27 July 1276) succeeded his father Peter II as King of Aragon in 1213. After Peter fell at Muret, Simon de Montfort held the young king until Pope Innocent III demanded his release in 1214. He was raised by the Knights Templar at Monzón during a turbulent minority. Taking power in 1227, he led the Crown of Aragon southwards: he conquered Majorca in 1229 and founded the Kingdom of Majorca, then captured Valencia in 1238 after a five-year campaign. With the Treaty of Corbeil in 1258, Louis IX of France gave up all claims over the Catalan counties. He sponsored Catalan letters and dictated the chronicle of his reign, the Llibre dels fets.
zh: 海梅一世（征服者）（1208年2月2日—1276年7月27日）于1213年继其父佩德罗二世为阿拉贡国王。佩德罗在米雷阵亡后，年幼的海梅受到西蒙·德·蒙特福特控制，直到1214年教宗诺森三世要求蒙特福特交还他。他幼年政局动荡，由圣殿骑士团在蒙松抚养。1227年亲政后，他率领阿拉贡联合王国向南扩张：1229年征服马略卡岛，建立马略卡王国；经过五年征战，于1238年攻取巴伦西亚。1258年，他与法兰西国王路易九世签订《科尔贝条约》，使法王放弃对加泰罗尼亚诸伯国的一切宗主权。他扶持加泰罗尼亚语文学，口授了记述自身统治的《海梅一世编年史》。

en: James I (1321–1347), infante of Aragon and count of Urgell, was born in Zaragoza, a son of King Alfonso IV of Aragon and Teresa d'Entença, countess of Urgell. His mother died in 1327, shortly before his father became king, and James inherited the County of Urgell, with the viscounty of Àger and the baronies of Entenza and Antillón, after his father renounced it. In 1336 he married Cecilia, daughter of Bernard VIII of Comminges; they had a daughter, Isabella, and a son, Peter, who succeeded him. His brother Peter IV had no son, which made James heir presumptive. When the king tried to put his own daughter in James's place, James fled to Zaragoza and won over nobles eager to reassert their power, and Peter had to restore him as procurator general. James died suddenly in Barcelona on 15 November 1347, widely believed poisoned on Peter's orders. Without him the Union of Aragon was crushed at Epila in 1348.
zh: 乌赫尔伯爵海梅一世（1321—1347）是阿拉贡亲王，生于萨拉戈萨，为阿拉贡国王阿方索四世与乌赫尔女伯爵特蕾莎·德·恩滕萨之子。母亲于1327年去世，不久父亲即位；父亲放弃继承权后，海梅继承乌赫尔伯国，兼领阿赫尔子爵领以及恩滕萨、安蒂利翁男爵领。1336年，他与科曼日伯爵贝尔纳八世之女塞西莉亚结婚，两人育有女儿伊莎贝拉和儿子佩德罗，佩德罗后来继袭爵位。兄长佩德罗四世没有儿子，海梅因此成为王位的推定继承人。国王想让自己的女儿取代他时，海梅逃往萨拉戈萨，争取到想重振权力的贵族，佩德罗被迫让步，恢复他的总代理官之职。1347年11月15日海梅在巴塞罗那突然去世，普遍认为他是被兄长下令毒杀。失去首领的阿拉贡联盟，1348年在埃皮拉被击溃。

en: James II the Just (10 April 1267 – 2 November 1327), second son of Peter III and Constance II of Sicily, was crowned King of Sicily in 1286 and in 1291 succeeded his brother Alfonso III as King of Aragon. By the Treaty of Anagni in 1295 he gave up Sicily to the papacy and restored the Balearics to his uncle James II of Majorca; the Sicilians instead placed his brother Frederick on the island's throne. Pope Boniface VIII called on James to fight Frederick alongside Naples. Boniface also granted him rights to Sardinia and Corsica; James conquered Sardinia in 1324. He also held Murcia from 1296 to 1304.
zh: 海梅二世（公正者）（1267年4月10日—1327年11月2日）是佩德罗三世与西西里的科斯坦察的次子，1286年加冕为西西里国王，1291年继其兄阿方索三世为阿拉贡国王。1295年，他依《阿纳尼条约》将西西里交还教廷，并把巴利阿里群岛归还其叔马略卡国王海梅二世；西西里人转而拥立其弟费德里科为西西里国王。教宗卜尼法斯八世要求海梅与那不勒斯共同对付费德里科，也授予他撒丁与科西嘉的统治权；海梅于1324年征服撒丁。1296至1304年间，他还一度占据穆尔西亚。

en: John of Aragon and Foix (Joan de Prades, 1335–1414) was a younger son of Peter IV of Ribagorza and Joanna of Foix, and a grandson of James II of Aragon. In 1358 he became Count of Prades and Baron of Entença, and he served the Crown as seneschal of Catalonia. After the death of his elder brother Alfonso, Duke of Gandia, he was one of the claimants to the Aragonese throne following Martin I's death, but his candidacy at the Compromise of Caspe won little support. In 1412 he recognized Ferdinand of Antequera as Ferdinand I.
zh: 阿拉贡与富瓦的胡安（1335—1414），又称胡安·德·普拉德斯，是里瓦戈萨伯爵佩德罗四世与富瓦的乔安娜之子、阿拉贡国王海梅二世之孙。1358年，他成为普拉德斯伯爵兼恩滕萨男爵，并担任加泰罗尼亚王室总管。兄长甘迪亚公爵阿方索去世后，他在马丁一世死后成为阿拉贡王位的竞争者之一，但在卡斯佩妥协会议上支持者寥寥。1412年，他承认安特克拉的费尔南多为合法国王费尔南多一世。

en: Joana of Empúries (1330–1395) was the elder daughter of Ramon Berenguer I, Count of Empúries, and Blanche of Taranto, and a granddaughter of King James II of Aragon. Her brother John would later hold the county and serve as fifth President of the Generalitat of Catalonia. In 1346 she married Fernando Manuel at Castelló d'Empúries. He was a son of the Castilian writer Juan Manuel and held Escalona, Peñafiel and Cuéllar from 1348 until his death in 1351. Their daughter Blanca Manuel, born in 1348, inherited his lordships of Escalona, Villena and Peñafiel, but died in 1361. Joana herself died at Toledo in 1395.
zh: 安普里亚斯的胡安娜（1330—1395）是安普里亚斯伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔一世与塔兰托的布朗什的长女，阿拉贡国王海梅二世的孙女。她的弟弟胡安后来继承了伯爵领，并出任加泰罗尼亚自治政府的第五任主席。1346年，她在安普里亚斯的卡斯特利翁嫁给费尔南多·曼努埃尔。他是卡斯蒂利亚作家胡安·曼努埃尔之子，1348年起领有埃斯卡洛纳、佩尼亚菲耶尔和奎利亚尔，1351年去世。两人的女儿布兰卡·曼努埃尔生于1348年，继承了父亲的埃斯卡洛纳、比列纳和佩尼亚菲耶尔领地，却于1361年早逝。胡安娜本人于1395年在托莱多去世。

en: Joan of Foix (c. 1310–1358) was a daughter of Count Gaston I of Foix and Joan of Artois, and sister of Gaston II. On 12 May 1331, at Castelló d'Empúries, she married Peter of Aragon, Count of Ribagorza and Empúries and seneschal of Catalonia, a son of James II of Aragon. When her husband exchanged Empúries for Prades with his brother in 1341, she became Countess of Prades and lady of Dénia and Gandia. Her children included Eleanor, queen of Cyprus, Alfonso the Elder, Duke of Gandia, and John, later Count of Prades.
zh: 富瓦的让娜（约1310—1358）是富瓦伯爵加斯东一世与阿图瓦的让娜之女、加斯东二世的妹妹。1331年5月12日，她在安普里亚斯堡嫁给阿拉贡国王海梅二世之子、里瓦戈萨兼安普里亚斯伯爵、加泰罗尼亚王室总管佩德罗。1341年丈夫与兄弟交换领地，以安普里亚斯换取普拉德斯，她随之成为普拉德斯伯爵夫人，以及德尼亚和甘迪亚的领主夫人。她的子女包括塞浦路斯王后埃莉诺、甘迪亚公爵“长者”阿方索和后来的普拉德斯伯爵胡安。

en: Violant of Hungary (c. 1215–1251), also called Yolanda, was queen of Aragon and the only child of King Andrew II of Hungary and Yolanda of Courtenay. Born at Esztergom, she married King James I of Aragon in 1235 as his second wife; his first marriage had been annulled in 1229 on grounds of consanguinity. She became his trusted advisor and accompanied him on campaign, entering Valencia at his side after its conquest in 1238. Of her ten children, Peter III inherited Aragon and James II received Majorca, while daughters Violant and Isabella became queens of Castile and France. She died in 1251 after making her will at Huesca and was buried at Vallbona Abbey.
zh: 匈牙利的维奥朗（约1215—1251），亦名约朗德，是阿拉贡王后，匈牙利国王安德烈二世与库特奈的约朗德的独女。她生于埃斯泰尔戈姆，1235年作为第二位妻子嫁给阿拉贡国王海梅一世；海梅的前一次婚姻于1229年因近亲关系被撤销。她成为丈夫信任的顾问并随军出征；1238年巴伦西亚攻克后，她随丈夫一同入城。她生有十个子女，其中佩德罗三世继承阿拉贡，海梅二世获得马略卡，女儿维奥朗和伊莎贝拉分别成为卡斯蒂利亚和法兰西的王后。1251年她在韦斯卡立下遗嘱后去世，葬于巴尔沃纳修道院。

en: John of Aragon (1330–1358), born in Valencia, was an infante of Aragon, the younger son of King Alfonso IV and Eleanor of Castile. After his father's death his half-brother Peter IV seized his inheritance, but restored the lordship of Elche to him in 1338. He spent much of his life at the Castilian court, and in 1354 King Peter I of Castile married him to Isabel Díaz de Haro, heiress of Biscay. John served Peter as his standard-bearer in the War of the Two Peters, until Peter had him killed at Bilbao in 1358.
zh: 胡安·德·阿拉贡（1330—1358）生于巴伦西亚，是阿拉贡国王阿方索四世与卡斯蒂利亚的埃莱奥诺拉的幼子。父亲去世后，异母兄佩德罗四世没收了他的产业，但在1338年把埃尔切领地归还给他。他长期在卡斯蒂利亚宫廷生活，1354年卡斯蒂利亚国王佩德罗一世安排他迎娶比斯开女继承人伊莎贝尔·迪亚斯·德·阿罗。他在“两佩德罗战争”中担任佩德罗一世的掌旗官，1358年被后者派人杀死于毕尔巴鄂。

en: Eleanor of Castile (1307–1359) was the eldest daughter of Ferdinand IV of Castile and Constance of Portugal, and a sister of Alfonso XI. Her first marriage, to the Aragonese heir James, was annulled after he took holy orders; in 1329 she married his brother, King Alfonso IV of Aragon, and was queen until his death in 1336. She was the mother of the infantes Ferdinand and John, and stepmother of Peter IV of Aragon. Back in Castile, she was killed at Castrojeriz Castle in 1359 on the order of her nephew, King Peter I of Castile.
zh: 卡斯蒂利亚的埃莉诺（1307—1359）是卡斯蒂利亚国王费尔南多四世与葡萄牙的康斯坦莎的长女，阿方索十一世的姐姐。她先与阿拉贡继承人海梅成婚，海梅出家修道后婚姻被取消；1329年，她改嫁海梅之弟阿拉贡国王阿方索四世，成为王后，直至1336年阿方索四世去世。她是王子费尔南多和胡安的生母，也是阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世的继母。回到卡斯蒂利亚后，她于1359年在卡斯特罗赫里斯城堡被其侄卡斯蒂利亚国王佩德罗一世下令杀害。

en: Ausiàs March (c. 1400–1459) was a Valencian poet and knight from Gandia, born into a noble family of poets. His father Pere and uncle Jaume were poets too; on Pere's death in 1413, Ausiàs became head of the family while still young. Knighted young, he joined Alfonso the Magnanimous on Mediterranean expeditions to Sardinia, Corsica and Djerba between 1420 and 1425, then settled at Gandia. He was twice married, first to Isabel Martorell, sister of Joanot Martorell, and later to Joana Escorna. In 1450 he moved to Valencia, where he died on 3 March 1459. One of the greatest poets of the Valencian Golden Century, he wrote in Valencian rather than Occitan; 128 of his poems survive, on love, death and morality.
zh: 奥西亚斯·马尔希（约1400—1459）是甘迪亚出身的巴伦西亚诗人、骑士，生于一个爱好诗歌的小贵族家庭。父亲佩雷与叔父雅乌梅也是诗人；1413年父亲去世后，年少的奥西亚斯成为家族之主。他很年轻便受封骑士，1420至1425年间随宽宏的阿方索远征地中海，先后出征撒丁岛、科西嘉和杰尔巴岛，之后定居甘迪亚。他两度结婚，先娶祖亚诺·马杜尼的妹妹伊莎贝尔·马杜尼，后娶霍阿娜·埃斯科尔纳。1450年他迁居巴伦西亚，1459年3月3日在当地去世。他是巴伦西亚文学黄金世纪最重要的诗人之一，不用奥克语而用巴伦西亚语写作，现存128首诗，主题围绕爱情、死亡与道德。

en: Marguerite de Foix-Castelbon was a daughter of Roger Bernard III, Viscount of Castelbon, and Constance de Luna, and a sister of Roger Bernard IV. She married Bernat III de Cabrera, Count of Osona, who died in 1368; their children included Bernardo de Cabrera.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·富瓦-卡斯泰尔邦是卡斯泰尔邦子爵罗歇-贝尔纳三世与卢纳的康斯坦萨之女、罗歇-贝尔纳四世的姐妹。她嫁给于1368年去世的奥索纳伯爵贝尔纳特三世·德·卡布雷拉，子女中有贝尔纳多·德·卡布雷拉。

en: Nissim ben Reuven of Gerona (c. 1315–1376), known by the Hebrew acronym the RaN, was a Catalan rabbi, talmudist and authority on Jewish law, born in Barcelona. He earned his living as a physician and also knew astronomy. He served the Barcelona community as judge and teacher and founded a yeshiva there; after he criticized its wealthy leaders, he and fellow rabbis were slandered to the government and imprisoned for five months before being cleared. His pupils included Isaac ben Sheshet and Hasdai Crescas.
zh: 赫罗纳的尼西姆·本·雷乌文（约1315—1376）以希伯来语缩写“拉恩”著称，是生于巴塞罗那的加泰罗尼亚拉比、《塔木德》学者与犹太律法权威。他以行医为生，也通晓天文学。他在巴塞罗那犹太社区担任法官和教师，并创办了一所经学院；因批评社区的富人首领，他与几位拉比同侪被告到官府，关押五个月后才获洗清。他的学生包括伊萨克·本·舍什特和哈斯戴·克雷斯卡斯。

en: Peter I (c. 1068–1104), eldest son of Sancho Ramírez and Isabella of Urgell, ruled Sobrarbe and Ribagorza as a sub-king from 1085 before succeeding his father as king of Aragon and Pamplona in 1094. He pressed the Reconquista south: he took Estada (1087), Montearagón (1088), Monzón (1089) and Almenar (1093), routed the Taifa of Zaragoza at Alcoraz and captured Huesca in 1095. Beside El Cid he defeated an Almoravid army at Bairén in 1096, took Barbastro in 1100 and campaigned before Zaragoza in 1101. He died on 28 December 1104, and his brother Alfonso the Battler succeeded him.
zh: 佩德罗一世（约1068—1104）是桑乔·拉米雷斯与乌拉尔的伊莎贝拉的长子。1085年起，他以副王身份统辖索夫拉韦和里瓦戈萨，1094年继承父位，成为阿拉贡和潘普洛纳国王。他向南推进收复失地运动：1087年取埃斯塔达，1088年取蒙特阿拉贡，1089年取蒙松，1093年取阿尔梅纳尔；1095年在阿尔科拉斯击溃萨拉戈萨泰法的援军，攻占韦斯卡。1096年，他与熙德并肩在拜伦击败穆拉比特军队；1100年攻取巴尔瓦斯特罗，1101年兵临萨拉戈萨城下。1104年12月28日去世，弟弟阿方索一世“斗士”继位。

en: Peter of Narbonne was a son of Amalric II, Viscount of Narbonne, and Joanna of l'Isle-Jourdain. In 1341 he became Bishop of Urgell, and with that see the fifth episcopal Co-Prince of Andorra, sharing the rule of Andorra with the lay co-prince, the Count of Foix: first Gaston II, from 1341 to 1343, then Gaston III, from 1343 to 1348. He died around 1347 or 1348.
zh: 纳博讷的彼得是纳博讷子爵阿马里克二世与让娜·德·利勒茹尔丹之子。1341年，他成为乌拉尔主教，并随该主教区出任第五任安道尔宗教方面的共治亲王，与世俗一方的共治亲王富瓦伯爵共同治理安道尔：先是加斯东二世（1341—1343年在位），后是加斯东三世（1343—1348年在位）。他约在1347至1348年间去世。

en: Pere de Thous (c. 1295–1374) was a Valencian friar of the Order of Montesa, born at Peñíscola, who became its third grand master in 1327. The order was a young one, founded in 1317 by James II of Aragon. In August 1330, during the War of the Strait, he and Arnau d'Alós led the heavy cavalry on a raid launched from Lorca into Granada, taking a separate route through Huércal and Zurgena before rejoining the other column at Almanzora. He remained loyal to Peter IV of Aragon in the War of the Union, when much of the Maestrat rose against him. A notable builder, he fortified San Mateo, founded the Dominican convent there in 1360, and promoted works at the order's castles until his death in 1374.
zh: 佩雷·德·图斯（约1295—1374）生于佩尼斯科拉，是蒙特萨骑士团的巴伦西亚修士，1327年成为该团第三任大团长。这个骑士团还很年轻，1317年由阿拉贡国王海梅二世创立。1330年8月海峡战争期间，他与阿尔瑙·达洛斯率领重骑兵，参加了从洛尔卡出发、深入格拉纳达的突袭，单独取道韦尔卡尔和苏尔赫纳，随后在阿尔曼索拉与另一路会合。联盟战争期间，马埃斯特拉特大部地区起兵反抗，他始终效忠阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世。他以营建著称，修筑圣马特奥城防，1360年在当地创建多明我会修道院，并在骑士团各城堡推动工程，直至1374年去世。

en: Peter II the Catholic (1178–1213) was King of Aragon and Count of Barcelona from 1196. Born at Huesca, the eldest son of Alfonso II, he married Marie of Montpellier in 1204, who bore him his heir James I. Peter soon repudiated Marie, who died in Rome in 1213. In 1205 he was crowned in Rome by Pope Innocent III, the first Aragonese king to receive papal coronation, and placed Aragon under the Holy See. He fought at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212, then intervened against Simon de Montfort's Albigensian Crusade to protect his vassal Raymond VI of Toulouse, and was killed at Muret on 12 September 1213.
zh: 佩德罗二世（1178—1213），1196年起为阿拉贡国王兼巴塞罗那伯爵。他出生于韦斯卡，是阿方索二世的长子，1204年迎娶蒙彼利埃的玛丽，二人的儿子海梅是他的继承人。佩德罗不久便抛弃了玛丽，后者于1213年在罗马去世。1205年，他在罗马由教宗诺森三世加冕，成为首位由教宗加冕的阿拉贡国王，并将阿拉贡置于教廷治下。1212年他参加拉斯纳瓦斯·德·托洛萨会战，随后出兵对抗西蒙·德·蒙特福特率领的阿尔比十字军，以庇护附庸图卢兹伯爵雷蒙六世，最终于1213年9月12日在米雷之战中阵亡。

en: Peter III the Great (c. 1240 – 11 November 1285), son of James I and Yolande of Hungary, ruled as King of Aragon and Count of Barcelona from 1276. In 1280 he defeated a Catalan noble revolt after a month-long siege of Balaguer. After the Sicilian Vespers uprising in 1282, he invaded Sicily on the Hohenstaufen claim of his wife Constance II, drove out Charles I of Anjou and was crowned king of the island. In 1283 he was forced to grant the General Privilege to the Aragonese Union. Pope Martin IV thereupon proclaimed an Aragonese Crusade, and the French invasion of Catalonia in 1285 collapsed by land and sea. Peter died at Vilafranca del Penedès on 11 November 1285.
zh: 佩德罗三世（伟大者）（约1240—1285年11月11日）是海梅一世与匈牙利的尤兰德之子，1276年起为阿拉贡国王兼巴塞罗那伯爵。1280年，他围攻巴拉格尔一个月，击败了加泰罗尼亚贵族的叛乱。1282年西西里晚祷起义爆发后，他凭借妻子科斯坦察二世的霍亨斯陶芬家族继承权进军西西里，驱逐安茹的查理一世并加冕为西西里国王。1283年，他被迫向阿拉贡联盟颁布《大特权令》。教宗马丁四世随即宣布发动阿拉贡十字军，1285年法兰西军队入侵加泰罗尼亚，却在海陆两线均告溃败。1285年11月11日，佩德罗在比利亚夫兰卡·德尔佩内德斯去世。

en: Peter of Aragon and Anjou (1305 – 4 November 1381), son of James II and Blanche of Anjou, was an infante of Aragon who served three kings as soldier, diplomat and counsellor. Count of Ribagorza from 1322, Empúries from 1325 and Prades from 1341, he also held the lordship of Gandia. In 1328 he went to Avignon to mediate between Sicily and Naples, and in 1343 he joined Peter IV's Majorca expedition. He was chief counsellor of Alfonso IV and Peter IV, king's lieutenant in the Sardinian campaign of 1354–1355, and regent during Peter IV's absence in 1354–1356. In 1358 he gave up his counties and entered the Franciscans, advocating an end to the Avignon papacy in a prophetic tract. His son Alfonso became duke of Gandia, John was a candidate for the Aragonese crown before the Compromise of Caspe, and James rose to cardinal. Peter died at Pisa in 1381.
zh: 佩德罗·德·阿拉贡-安茹（1305—1381年11月4日）是阿拉贡王子，海梅二世与安茹的布朗什之子，历事三位国王，是军人、外交官和谋臣。他于1322年受封里瓦戈萨伯爵，1325年兼领安普里亚斯，1341年改领普拉德斯，还持有甘迪亚领地。1328年他前往阿维尼翁，调停西西里与那不勒斯的争端；1343年参加佩德罗四世的马略卡远征。他是阿方索四世与佩德罗四世两朝的首席谋臣，在1354—1355年撒丁战役中担任国王的副手，1354—1356年佩德罗四世离境期间摄政。1358年他放弃伯爵领，加入方济各会，主张结束阿维尼翁教廷，并为此写了一部预言性的论著。其子阿方索成为甘迪亚公爵，胡安在卡斯佩妥协之前是阿拉贡王位的候选人，海梅升任枢机。1381年佩德罗在比萨去世。

en: Peter IV the Ceremonious (5 September 1319 – 6 January 1387), son of Alfonso IV and Teresa d'Entença, ruled the Crown of Aragon from 1336 and spent his reign fighting the noble unions that limited the crown. In 1344 he deposed James III of Majorca and took over his kingdom; James died trying to win it back at Llucmajor in 1349. With no son, Peter tried to name his daughter Constance heir over his brother James of Urgell, and the nobles forced him to back down; when James died suddenly in 1347, many suspected poison. The Valencian Union then held Peter under guard, until the Black Death struck the city in May 1348 and he escaped. On 21 July 1348 he crushed the unionists at Epila, and had the Union's meeting bell melted down and poured down its leaders' throats. From 1356 to 1375 he fought Castile in the War of the Two Peters, which ended without a winner, and in 1381 became Duke of Athens and Neopatria. He died in Barcelona, aged 67.
zh: 佩德罗四世（守礼者）（1319年9月5日—1387年1月6日）是阿方索四世与特蕾莎·德恩滕萨之子，1336年起统治阿拉贡联合王国，在位期间一直与限制王权的贵族联盟周旋。1344年他废黜马略卡国王海梅三世并接管其王国；海梅三世1349年为夺回王国，在柳奇马约尔之战中败死。佩德罗没有儿子，想立女儿康斯坦萨为继承人，取代弟弟乌赫尔的海梅，遭贵族逼迫而退让；1347年海梅突然去世，许多人怀疑是毒杀。随后巴伦西亚联盟将佩德罗置于看管之下，直到1348年5月黑死病袭击该城，他才趁乱逃脱。1348年7月21日，他在埃皮拉之战中击溃联盟，并熔毁联盟用来召集会议的钟，把铜汁灌进联盟首领的喉咙。1356至1375年，他与卡斯蒂利亚进行两个佩德罗之战，未分胜负；1381年又成为雅典与新帕特里亚公爵。他在巴塞罗那去世，终年67岁。

en: Petronilla (1136–1173), queen of Aragon, was the only child of King Ramiro II and Agnes of Aquitaine. Her father had taken the throne after his brother Alfonso I died childless in 1134, leaving his kingdom to military orders. Aragonese nobles rejected a Castilian proposal to marry Petronilla to Alfonso VII's son Sancho. In August 1137, when little over a year old, she was betrothed at Barbastro to Count Ramon Berenguer IV of Barcelona, joining Aragon and the County of Barcelona into the Crown of Aragon. Ramiro withdrew to his monastery the same year. After her husband died in 1162 and she abdicated in 1164, she ruled as regent for her young son Alfonso II until her death, and was the last ruler of Aragon's Jiménez dynasty.
zh: 阿拉贡女王佩德罗尼拉（1136—1173）是国王拉米罗二世与阿基坦的艾格尼丝的独女。1134年，她的伯父阿方索一世去世，没有子嗣，将王国留给军事修会，此后拉米罗继位。阿拉贡贵族拒绝了卡斯蒂利亚提出的婚约，即让佩德罗尼拉嫁给阿方索七世之子桑乔。1137年8月，刚满周岁的她在巴尔瓦斯特罗与巴塞罗那伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世订婚，这桩婚姻把阿拉贡和巴塞罗那伯国合并为阿拉贡联合王国；同年拉米罗退回修道院。1162年丈夫去世、1164年她退位后，以摄政身份为年幼的儿子阿方索二世主持国政，直至1173年去世。她是阿拉贡希梅纳王朝最后一位统治者。

en: Ramiro I (before 1007–1063) was the illegitimate son of King Sancho III of Pamplona by his mistress Sancha de Aibar. When Sancho III divided his realm in 1035, Ramiro received the county of Aragon and ruled it as its first king, though he styled himself only son of King Sancho. He challenged his half-brother García of Navarre and, despite defeat at Tafalla, gained territory including Sangüesa. In 1043 he annexed Sobrarbe and Ribagorza, fixed his capital at Jaca and granted the town its pioneering charter. He advanced toward Huesca and Zaragoza. He married Ermesinda of Bigorre, and their son Sancho Ramírez succeeded him. Ramiro was killed attacking Graus on 8 May 1063 and was buried at San Juan de la Peña.
zh: 拉米罗一世（1007年前—1063）是潘普洛纳国王桑乔三世与情妇桑查·德·艾瓦尔的私生子。1035年桑乔三世分封领地时，拉米罗得到阿拉贡伯国，成为阿拉贡的第一代国王，尽管他在文书中只自称“国王桑乔之子”。他向同父异母兄弟纳瓦拉国王加西亚发起挑战，虽在塔法利亚战败，仍获得了包括桑圭萨在内的领地。1043年，他兼并索夫拉韦和里瓦戈萨，定都哈卡，并向该城颁布了具有开创意义的城市特许状。他向韦斯卡和萨拉戈萨推进。他娶比戈尔的埃尔梅辛达为妻，儿子桑乔·拉米雷斯继位。1063年5月8日，他在攻打格劳斯时战死，葬于圣胡安-德拉佩尼亚修道院。

en: Ramiro II, called the Monk (1086–1157), was a son of King Sancho Ramírez of Aragon and Felicia of Roucy who became a monk and served as abbot at Sahagún and Huesca. His brother Alfonso the Battler blocked his election as bishop of Burgos and later of Pamplona. When Alfonso died in 1134, the Aragonese nobility took Ramiro from the cloister and made him king, while Navarre chose García Ramírez, separating the two realms. Ramiro married Agnes of Aquitaine, and their daughter Petronilla was betrothed in 1137 to Count Ramon Berenguer IV of Barcelona, uniting Aragon and Catalonia. He withdrew to a monastery soon after, keeping the royal title until his death.
zh: 拉米罗二世，绰号“修士”（1086—1157），是阿拉贡国王桑乔·拉米雷斯与鲁西的费利西亚之子，出家为僧，曾任萨阿贡和韦斯卡的修道院院长。其兄阿方索一世曾阻止他当选布尔戈斯和潘普洛纳主教。1134年阿方索去世，阿拉贡贵族把拉米罗从修道院请出立为国王，纳瓦拉则选出加西亚·拉米雷斯，两国从此分立。拉米罗与阿基坦的艾格尼丝结婚，女儿佩德罗尼拉于1137年与巴塞罗那伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世订婚，阿拉贡与加泰罗尼亚由此联合。此后不久他退回修道院，直至去世仍保留国王头衔。

en: Ramiro Sánchez of Monzón (c. 1070–1129/1130) was a Navarrese noble, the son of Sancho Garcés, an illegitimate son of King García Sánchez III of Navarre. After his uncle Sancho IV was killed in 1076 and Navarre was partitioned between Castile and Aragon, he was raised at the Aragonese court. As a royal tenente he held Urroz, Monzón, Tudela and Erro between 1104 and 1129. Around 1098 he married Cristina Rodríguez, a daughter of El Cid, and in 1099 escorted the Cid's body to Cardeña. He began construction of the church of Santa María de La Piscina, consecrated in 1137. His son García Ramírez succeeded him at Monzón and became king of Navarre.
zh: 蒙松的拉米罗·桑切斯（约1070—1129/1130）是纳瓦拉贵族，为纳瓦拉国王加西亚·桑切斯三世的私生子桑乔·加尔塞斯之子。1076年他的叔父桑乔四世被杀，纳瓦拉被卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡瓜分，他便在阿拉贡宫廷长大。作为王室封臣，他在1104至1129年间领有乌罗斯、蒙松、图德拉和埃罗。约1098年，他与熙德的女儿克里斯蒂娜·罗德里格斯结婚，1099年护送熙德的灵柩前往卡尔德尼亚。他开始兴建圣玛丽亚·德·拉·皮西纳教堂，该堂于1137年祝圣。他的儿子加西亚·拉米雷斯继承蒙松，后来成为纳瓦拉国王。

en: Ramon Berenguer of Aragon (1308 – c. 1366) was the youngest son of James II and Blanche of Anjou. Raised at Alicante, he received the County of Prades and the barony of Entença from his father in 1324. In 1334 his brother Alfonso IV gave him Elche, where in 1337 he allowed a tower on Santa Pola island to guard the port against raiders. In 1341 he exchanged Prades with his brother Peter for the County of Empúries. He first quarrelled with his nephew Peter IV, but Peter's mediation made him one of the king's closest men. He helped put down the Valencian revolts of 1347–1348, joined the 1349 Roussillon campaign against James III of Majorca, went to Pope Innocent VI in 1356 as envoy over Sardinia, and in 1363 defended Valencia against Peter of Castile. In 1364 he gave Empúries to his son John, who forced him into the Dominican order. He died at Barcelona around 1366.
zh: 阿拉贡的拉蒙·贝伦格尔（1308—约1366）是海梅二世与安茹的布朗什的幼子。他在阿利坎特长大，1324年从父亲手中得到普拉德斯伯爵领和恩滕萨男爵领。1334年，兄长阿方索四世把埃尔切赐给他；1337年，他准许在圣波拉岛上修建一座塔楼，保护港口免受袭扰。1341年，他与兄长佩德罗交换领地，改任安普里亚斯伯爵。他起初与侄子佩德罗四世不睦，经兄长佩德罗调解，成为国王最亲近的臣属之一。他协助佩德罗四世平定1347—1348年的巴伦西亚叛乱，参与1349年远征鲁西永、对抗马略卡国王海梅三世的战争；1356年作为使节前往教皇英诺森六世处商议撒丁岛事务，1363年又抵御卡斯蒂利亚国王佩德罗对巴伦西亚的进攻。1364年，他把安普里亚斯让给儿子胡安，却被胡安强迫加入多明我会，约1366年在巴塞罗那去世。

en: Roger Bernard III of Foix-Castelbon (1310–1350) was the younger son of Count Gaston I of Foix and Joan of Artois. On his father's death in 1315 the County of Foix passed to his elder brother Gaston II, while Roger Bernard received the Catalan viscounty of Castelbon and the family's other Catalan lands, holding them as his brother's vassal. By his wife Constance de Luna he fathered Roger Bernard IV, Marguerite and Blanche, and founded the Foix-Castelbon line from which sprang the later counts Matthew and Isabella of Foix.
zh: 罗歇-贝尔纳三世·德·富瓦-卡斯泰尔邦（1310—1350）是富瓦伯爵加斯东一世与阿图瓦的让娜年纪较小的儿子。1315年父亲去世后，富瓦伯国传给其兄加斯东二世，罗歇-贝尔纳则得到加泰罗尼亚的卡斯泰尔邦子国和家族在当地的其他领地，并作为兄长的封臣持有这些土地。他与卢纳的康斯坦萨结婚，生下罗歇-贝尔纳四世、玛格丽特和布朗什，开创了富瓦-卡斯泰尔邦支系，后来的富瓦伯爵马蒂厄与伊莎贝尔即出自该支。

en: Roger Bernard IV of Foix-Castelbon (c. 1333–1381) inherited the viscounty of Castelbon and the family's Catalan lands from his father, Roger Bernard III, and like him held them as vassal of the ruling counts of Foix. He married Géraude de Navailles, who bore him a son, Matthew, and a daughter, Isabella. Long overshadowed by the senior Foix line, his children inherited the County of Foix itself: Matthew succeeded Count Gaston III Fébus in 1391, and Isabella followed her brother as countess and, with Archambaud de Grailly, founded the Foix-Grailly branch.
zh: 罗歇-贝尔纳四世·德·富瓦-卡斯泰尔邦（约1333—1381）从父亲罗歇-贝尔纳三世手中继承了卡斯泰尔邦子国和家族在加泰罗尼亚的领地，并与父亲一样作为富瓦执政伯爵的封臣持有这些土地。他娶热罗德·德·纳瓦耶为妻，生子马蒂厄、女伊莎贝尔。卡斯泰尔邦支系长期屈居富瓦长支之下，他的子女却最终继承了富瓦伯国本身：马蒂厄于1391年继加斯东三世·费比斯之后成为富瓦伯爵，伊莎贝尔随后继兄长之位成为女伯爵，并与阿尔尚博·德·格拉伊共同开创富瓦-格拉伊支系。

en: Sancho Ramírez (c. 1042–1094) succeeded his father Ramiro I as king of Aragon in 1063. In the War of the Three Sanchos (1067–1068) he and Sancho IV of Navarre lost to Sancho II of Castile. After Sancho IV was murdered by his siblings in 1076, Sancho Ramírez was elected king of Pamplona, ruling both crowns but ceding Navarre's western lands to Alfonso VI of Castile. He took Barbastro (1064), Graus (1083) and Monzón (1089), but was routed by El Cid near Morella. He fell besieging Huesca on 4 June 1094, leaving the crown to his son Peter I.
zh: 桑乔·拉米雷斯（约1042—1094）于1063年继父亲拉米罗一世之后成为阿拉贡国王。在1067至1068年的“三桑乔战争”中，他与纳瓦拉的桑乔四世联手，却负于卡斯蒂利亚的桑乔二世。1076年，桑乔四世被自己的兄弟谋杀，桑乔·拉米雷斯被推举为潘普洛纳国王，身兼两顶王冠，但把纳瓦拉西部领地让给卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索六世。他攻取了巴尔瓦斯特罗（1064）、格劳斯（1083）和蒙松（1089），却在莫雷利亚附近被熙德击败。1094年6月4日，他在围攻韦斯卡时阵亡，王位传给儿子佩德罗一世。

en: Sibilla de Montcada, daughter of Ot de Montcada, baron of Aitona, married Giovanni, younger son of Judge Hugh II of Arborea. After her husband was seized by his brother Marianus IV in 1349, she escaped by a ruse and vainly reclaimed his Sardinian estates.
zh: 西比尔·德·蒙特卡达是艾托纳男爵奥特·德·蒙特卡达之女，嫁给阿波利亚法官乌戈二世的幼子乔万尼。1349年丈夫被其兄马里亚诺四世囚禁后，她设计逃脱，却未能讨回丈夫在撒丁的领地。

en: Teresa d'Entença (c. 1300–1327) was the eldest daughter of Gombau d'Entença and Constança d'Antilló, and countess of Urgell in her own right. When her granduncle Ermengol X, count of Urgell, lay dying without children, he named the infante Alfonso of Aragon his heir, on condition that Alfonso marry Teresa as his rightful successor. The wedding was celebrated at Lleida Cathedral in 1314. She died at Zaragoza on 20 October 1327 giving birth to her son Sancho, only days before her husband ascended the throne as Alfonso IV. Her son Peter IV later ruled Aragon, while James inherited Urgell.
zh: 特蕾莎·德·恩滕萨（约1300—1327）是贡包·德恩滕萨与孔斯坦萨·德安蒂永的长女，本人即拥有乌赫尔伯国的继承权。她的叔祖父、乌赫尔伯爵埃尔蒙戈尔十世无嗣，临终前立阿拉贡王子阿方索为继承人，条件是阿方索必须迎娶自己的合法继承人特蕾莎。两人于1314年在莱里达主教座堂举行婚礼。1327年10月20日，她在萨拉戈萨生下儿子桑乔时离世，距丈夫以阿方索四世之名登基只有几天。她的儿子佩德罗四世后来成为阿拉贡国王，海梅则继承了乌赫尔伯国。

en: Vincent Ferrer (1350–1419) was a Dominican friar born in Valencia, ordained priest at Barcelona in 1379 and later a master of theology at Lleida. During the Western Schism he backed the Avignon antipope Benedict XIII, once his confessor. After a vision in 1398 he spent two decades as an itinerant preacher, drawing crowds across Spain, France, Italy and Britain; his missions converted many Jews, sometimes through coercion. In 1412 he was decisive at the Compromise of Caspe, which placed Ferdinand of Antequera on the throne of Aragon. He died at Vannes in 1419 and was canonized in 1455.
zh: 文森特·费雷尔（1350—1419）是生于瓦伦西亚的多明我会修士，1379年在巴塞罗那受任神父，后来成为莱里达的神学硕士。西方教会大分裂期间，他支持阿维尼翁的对立教宗本笃十三世，并曾任其告解神父。1398年一次神视之后，他在二十年间四处巡回布道，在西班牙、法国、意大利和不列颠群岛吸引大批信众；他的传教使许多犹太人改宗，其中不乏胁迫之举。1412年，他在决定阿拉贡王位的卡斯佩妥协中起了关键作用，使安特克拉的费尔南多当选。1419年他在瓦讷去世，1455年被封圣。

en: Violante of Aragon (October 1310–1353), born in Barcelona, was the youngest daughter of King James II of Aragon and Blanche of Anjou, who died after giving her birth. Plans to marry her to Charles IV of France or Alfonso XI of Castile came to nothing. In February 1328 she married Philip of Anjou, despot of Romania, a son of the prince of Taranto; after Philip was assassinated in May 1330 she returned to Catalonia. In 1339 she married Lope de Luna, lord of Segorbe, becoming countess of Luna, and died at Pedrola in 1353.
zh: 薇尔兰特·德·阿拉贡（1310年10月—1353）生于巴塞罗那，是阿拉贡国王海梅二世与安茹的布朗什的幼女，母亲在生下她后去世。法国国王查理四世、卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十一世都曾是她的联姻人选，却均未成功。1328年2月，她嫁给塔兰托亲王之子、罗马专制君主腓力·德·安茹；1330年5月腓力遇刺后，她返回加泰罗尼亚。1339年，她改嫁塞戈尔韦领主洛佩·德·卢纳，成为卢纳伯爵夫人，1353年在佩德罗拉去世。

en: Andreotto of Arborea (died 1308) was the elder illegitimate son of Judge John of Arborea and his mistress Vera Cappai. On his father's death in 1304 he succeeded as Judge of Arborea, ruling jointly with his brother Marianus III but holding supremacy under the title autocrator basileus. In 1308, shortly before he died, he bought the castles of Serravalle di Bosa, Planargia and Costaville from the Malaspina family, and their revenues financed the administration of the giudicato's demesne.
zh: 安德烈奥托·迪·阿尔博雷阿（？—1308）是阿尔博雷阿法官乔万尼与情妇薇拉·卡帕伊的长子，为私生子。1304年父亲去世后，他继位为阿尔博雷阿法官，与弟弟马里亚诺三世共同执政，本人则以“独裁君主”的称号保有最高权力。1308年，即他去世前不久，他从马拉斯皮纳家族手中购得塞拉瓦莱迪博萨、普拉纳尔贾和科斯塔维尔三座城堡，其收入用于支应法官国领地的行政开支。

en: Benedetta was the wife of Ugone II, judge of Arborea, and the mother of his nine children, including the judges Peter III and Marianus IV. She died around 1345.
zh: 贝内代塔是阿尔博雷阿执政官乌戈内二世之妻，为他生下九个子女，其中包括后来继位的彼得罗三世和马里亚诺四世。她约于1345年去世。

en: Brancaleone Doria (1337–1409), a Genoese Doria born illegitimate in Sardinia, lived between the two powers contesting the island: Aragon and Arborea. In 1357 Peter IV of Aragon legitimised him and granted him his ancestral lands, including Castelgenovese and Monteleone. In 1376 he married Eleanor of Arborea, sister of Hugh III, a political match with the Bas-Serra family, who opposed Barcelona's royal claims. After Hugh's murder in 1383, Eleanor ruled for their son Frederick, while Brancaleone went to Barcelona to negotiate peace, was granted the title of count of Monteleone, and was arrested and held at Cagliari until 1390. Freed, he turned against Aragon: in 1391 he and his son Mariano took Sassari and Osilo, and by February 1392 he announced that every territory held in 1388 was recovered. After Mariano died in 1407 he withdrew to Castelgenovese, where he was killed in 1409, before the Battle of Sanluri.
