Around 1000 he and his wife Umberga made donations for the souls of their children. Of these, Robert I succeeded as count, Stephen became bishop of Clermont, and their daughter Ermengarde married in 1005 Odo II, count of Blois and Chartres.
zh: 威廉四世（约950—1016）于989年兄长居伊一世无嗣而终后成为奥弗涅伯爵。他是子爵克莱蒙的罗伯特二世与昂加尔贝尔加之子，起初在文书中以伯爵之弟的身份副署赠予布里乌德和索克西朗日的契据。约1000年前后，他与妻子翁贝尔加为子女的灵魂多次向教会捐赠。子女中，罗伯特一世继任伯爵，艾蒂安成为克莱蒙主教，女儿埃芒加德于1005年嫁给布卢瓦与沙特尔伯爵厄德二世。

en: William IX was count of Auvergne in the late twelfth century, the son of Count Robert IV and Mahaut of Burgundy. The chronicle of Alberic of Trois-Fontaines names him together with his brothers Guy II and Robert. He is mentioned in an entry of 1199 and died without known issue around that year, when his brother Guy II succeeded him as count.
zh: 威廉九世是12世纪末的奥弗涅伯爵，伯爵罗伯特四世与勃艮第的马奥之子。特鲁瓦方丹的阿尔贝里克所著编年史将他与兄弟居伊二世、罗伯特并提。1199年的一条记载仍提到他，他约于同年无已知后嗣而终，兄弟居伊二世继任伯爵。

en: William V (c. 1000–1064), son of Count Robert I of Auvergne and Ermengarde, became count in the 1030s. He married Philippa, daughter of Stephen, Count of Gévaudan, who bore his heir Robert II and Stephen, bishop of Clermont. In 1030 and 1034 he made donations to the church of Clermont, and at Pentecost 1059 he attended the coronation of the young King Philip I. He died in 1064, and Robert II succeeded him.
zh: 威廉五世（约1000—1064）是奥弗涅伯爵罗贝尔一世与埃芒加德之子，于1030年代成为伯爵。他娶热沃当伯爵艾蒂安之女菲莉帕为妻，生下继承人罗贝尔二世和克莱蒙主教艾蒂安。他曾于1030年和1034年向克莱蒙教会捐赠，并于1059年五旬节出席年幼法王腓力一世的加冕礼。他于1064年去世，罗贝尔二世继位。

en: William VI (c. 1069–1136) succeeded his father Robert II as count of Auvergne. He joined the First Crusade, and in 1102 led Auvergne's nobles to the Holy Land, besieging Tripoli with Raymond of Saint-Gilles. He founded the fortified town of Montferrand to overawe the bishop's city of Clermont. His attacks on the Clermont clergy brought Louis VI's army south in 1122 to ravage the Limagne and take Pont-du-Château, forcing William to return what he had seized. In 1126 the king besieged Montferrand until William's overlord, the Duke of Aquitaine, intervened and paid homage to the king for his vassal's lands. By Emma, daughter of Roger I of Sicily, his sons were Robert III and William VIII, both later counts.
zh: 威廉六世（约1069—1136）在父亲罗贝尔二世之后成为奥弗涅伯爵。他参加第一次十字军东征，1102年率领奥弗涅贵族前往圣地，加入圣吉尔的雷蒙围攻的黎波里。他修建要塞城镇蒙费朗，用以威慑主教控制的克莱蒙城。他对克莱蒙教士动武，招致路易六世于1122年率军南下，蹂躏利马涅并攻占蓬迪沙托，迫使威廉归还掠夺物。1126年法王围攻蒙费朗，威廉的宗主阿基坦公爵出面干预，并为其封臣的土地向国王效忠。他娶西西里的罗杰一世之女埃玛，儿子罗贝尔三世和威廉八世后来都成为奥弗涅伯爵。

en: William VII, called the Young (c. 1130–1169), became the legitimate count of Auvergne when his father Robert III died on crusade in 1147. Around 1150 he married Marquise d'Albon of Viennois, whose family's Dauphin title passed to his heirs. After a long feud his uncle William VIII the Old seized the county around 1155, but William retained part of it, including Beaumont, Chamalières and Montferrand. Louis VII once imprisoned both rival counts, who were released only in 1164. William died in 1169, and his son Robert IV founded the Dauphin line of Auvergne.
zh: 威廉七世绰号“年轻者”（约1130—1169），1147年父亲罗伯特三世死于十字军途中后，成为合法的奥弗涅伯爵。约1150年他迎娶维埃努瓦的玛尔基斯·达尔邦，妻家的“多芬”头衔后来传给他的继承人。与叔父“年长者”威廉八世长期争斗后，叔父约于1155年夺取伯国，但威廉保住了其中一部分，包括博蒙、沙马利耶尔和蒙费朗。路易七世曾把对立的两位伯爵一同下狱，两人直到1164年才获释。威廉于1169年去世，儿子罗伯特四世开创了奥弗涅的多芬世系。

en: William VIII, called the Old (c. 1100–1182), was count of Auvergne, a son of Count William VI and brother of Robert III. In 1155, after a long quarrel with his nephew William VII the Young, he seized part of the county and ruled as count from Clermont. His nephew retained lands including Vodable, which became his residence. Louis VII intervened and briefly imprisoned both claimants; they were freed in 1164 after swearing to leave the churches in peace. When Henry II arbitrated in 1167, William VIII refused his judgment and did homage to Louis VII instead, while his nephew paid homage to Henry. He married Anne of Nevers and died in 1182, leaving the county to his son Robert IV.
zh: 威廉八世，绰号“老者”（约1100—1182），是奥弗涅伯爵威廉六世之子、罗贝尔三世的弟弟，也成为奥弗涅伯爵。1155年，他与侄子“幼者”威廉七世长期争执后夺取伯国的一部分，以克莱蒙为据点自行称伯。侄子保留的领地包括沃达布勒，并以此为驻地。法王路易七世出兵干预，曾将两位争夺者一并短期囚禁；两人发誓不再侵扰教会，于1164年获释。1167年英格兰国王亨利二世出面仲裁，威廉八世拒绝其裁决，转而向路易七世行臣服礼，而他的侄子向亨利效忠。他娶讷韦尔的安妮为妻，1182年去世，伯国由儿子罗贝尔四世继承。

en: William X (c. 1195–1247), count of Auvergne, was the son of Count Guy II and Péronnelle de Chambon. He was eighteen when he helped defend Tournoël, Auvergne's last free fortress, against Philip Augustus in 1213. His father had been captured after Riom fell; William himself was taken in a failed sortie, and the castle's commander surrendered after seeing him captured and the defenders defeated. He succeeded his father in 1222 as count of the remnant of Auvergne, ruling from Vic-le-Comte, and in 1229 or 1230 Louis IX restored several of his father's confiscated lordships to him as crown fiefs. He married Adelaide of Brabant and died in 1247, leaving the county to his son Robert V.
zh: 威廉十世（约1195—1247）是奥弗涅伯爵，居伊二世伯爵与佩罗内勒·德·尚邦之子。1213年，年方十八的他参加守卫奥弗涅最后一座自由要塞图尔诺埃勒，抵抗腓力二世·奥古斯都。此前他的父亲在里永陷落后被俘；威廉本人也在一次失败的出击中被擒，守将见他被俘、守军受挫，便交出了城堡。1222年他继承父亲，成为残存奥弗涅领地的伯爵，驻于维克勒孔特；1229或1230年，路易九世把他父亲被没收的多处领地归还给他，条件是向王室行臣服礼。他娶布拉班特的阿德莱德，1247年去世，伯国传给儿子罗贝尔五世。

en: William XI was count of Auvergne and Boulogne from 1277, when his father Robert V died after naming William his heir to both counties in a will of 11 January. His mother was Éléonore de Baffie. An arrêt of the Parlement of Paris in 1276 already styles him count. After about three years he died in 1280. He married an unnamed daughter of Humbert V of Beaujeu, constable of France, and was buried at Bouschet Abbey. His brother Robert VI succeeded him.
zh: 威廉十一世1277年起任奥弗涅与布洛涅伯爵：父亲罗伯特五世在1277年1月11日所立遗嘱中把两个伯国都传给他，母亲是埃莱奥诺尔·德·巴菲。巴黎高等法院1276年的一份判决已称他为伯爵。在位约三年后，他于1280年去世。他娶了法国王室统帅博热的安贝尔五世之女，葬于布谢修道院，由弟弟罗伯特六世继位。

en: William XII (c. 1300–6 August 1332) succeeded his father Robert VII as count of Auvergne and Boulogne in 1325. His mother was Blanche of Clermont, daughter of the Capetian prince Robert, count of Clermont. In 1325 he married Margaret of Évreux, daughter of Louis, count of Évreux; her brother Philip was crowned king of Navarre in 1328. William died on 6 August 1332, leaving a single child, Joan, who succeeded as countess of Auvergne and Boulogne and later became queen of France through her marriage to John II.
zh: 威廉十二世（约1300—1332年8月6日）于1325年继承父亲罗伯特七世，成为奥弗涅与布洛涅伯爵。母亲是卡佩王族克莱蒙伯爵罗伯特之女布朗什·德·克莱蒙。1325年他迎娶埃夫勒伯爵路易之女、埃夫勒的玛格丽特；1328年，妻子的兄弟腓力加冕为纳瓦拉国王。威廉于1332年8月6日去世，只留下独女让娜。让娜继位为奥弗涅与布洛涅女伯爵，后来嫁给法王约翰二世，成为法国王后。

en: Hugues de Clermont was a younger son of Dauphin Béraud I of Auvergne and Marie de Villemur, and a brother of Béraud II. In 1390 he accompanied his brother on the Barbary Crusade organised by Genoa.
zh: 于格·德·克莱蒙是奥弗涅多菲安贝罗一世与玛丽·德·维尔米尔之子、贝罗二世的弟弟。1390年，他随兄长参加了热那亚组织的柏柏尔十字军。

en: John I, called Dauphinet (c. 1280–1351), was the sixth Dauphin of Auvergne and Count of Clermont, ruling from 1324. He was the son of Robert IV Dauphin and Alix of Mercœur, and on 27 May 1313 married Anne of Poitiers-Valentinois, widow of Henry II, Count of Rodez. In 1340, after making his testament in favour of his eldest son Béraud, he followed Philip VI to Flanders, governed Saint-Omer and defeated the Flemings there. In 1345 he campaigned in Gascony with the Duke of Normandy against the Earl of Derby. He died on 10 March 1351.
zh: 让一世，绰号“小多菲安”（约1280—1351），1324年起为第六代奥弗涅多菲安兼克莱蒙伯爵。他是罗贝尔四世多菲安与梅克尔的阿莉克斯之子，1313年5月27日娶普瓦捷-瓦朗蒂努瓦的安娜，即罗德兹伯爵亨利二世的遗孀。1340年，他立下以长子贝罗为继承人的遗嘱，随后随腓力六世出征佛兰德，镇守圣奥梅尔并击败佛兰德人。1345年，他随诺曼底公爵赴加斯科涅，与德比伯爵麾下的英军作战。1351年3月10日去世。

en: Joan I of Auvergne (8 May 1326 – 29 September 1360) inherited the counties of Auvergne and Boulogne as a child, when her father William XII died in 1332. Her first husband, Philip of Burgundy, son of Duke Odo IV, fell at the siege of Aiguillon in 1346; their infant son Philip inherited the Duchy of Burgundy in 1349 under her regency. On 9 February 1350 she married John, Duke of Normandy, a second marriage for both. His first wife, Bonne of Bohemia, had died of the Black Death leaving eight children, so there was little pressure on Joan to produce an heir. When John succeeded as John II that August, she became queen of France. Her three children with him all died young, and her son Philip became a ward of the king. She died at the Château d'Argilly in 1360. Philip inherited her counties but died the next year, aged fifteen.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/奧弗涅女伯爵讓娜一世
zh: 让娜一世（1326年5月8日—1360年9月29日）年幼时，父亲威廉十二世于1332年去世，她继承了奥弗涅与布洛涅两个伯国。她的第一任丈夫、勃艮第公爵厄德四世之子菲利普于1346年在艾吉永围城战中阵亡；1349年两人年幼的儿子继承勃艮第公国，由让娜摄政。1350年2月9日她改嫁诺曼底公爵约翰，两人都是再婚。约翰的前妻波希米亚的博娜死于黑死病，留下八个孩子，因此让娜并不承受生下继承人的压力。同年8月约翰即位为法王约翰二世，她随之成为法国王后。她与约翰所生的三个孩子都早夭，儿子菲利普则成为国王的被监护人。1360年她在阿尔日伊城堡去世，两个伯国由菲利普继承，而他次年便夭折，年仅十五岁。

en: Joan of Clermont, daughter of John of Charolais and Joan of Dargies, married John I, Count of Auvergne and Boulogne, in 1328. Her son John II inherited both counties; her daughter Joan married the Dauphin Béraud II.
zh: 克莱蒙的让娜是沙罗勒的约翰与达尔日的让娜之女，1328年嫁给奥弗涅兼布洛涅伯爵约翰一世。她的儿子约翰二世继承了两处伯国，女儿让娜嫁给多菲安贝罗二世。

en: John I of Auvergne (died 24 March 1386) was the eldest son of Count Robert VII of Auvergne and Boulogne by his second wife, Marie de Dampierre. In 1328 he married Joan of Clermont, daughter of the lord of Charolais. He held the county of Montfort and served as governor of the Dauphiné in 1355–1356. When his grandnephew Duke Philip I of Burgundy died in a riding accident in 1361, John inherited Auvergne and Boulogne and ruled both counties until his death. His son John II succeeded him.
zh: 让一世·德·奥弗涅（1386年3月24日卒）是奥弗涅与布洛涅伯爵罗贝尔七世与第二任妻子当皮埃尔的玛丽的长子。1328年，他迎娶沙罗莱领主之女克莱蒙的让娜。他领有蒙福尔伯国，并于1355至1356年担任多菲内总督。1361年，他的侄外孙、勃艮第公爵腓力一世因坠马事故早逝，让一世随即继承奥弗涅与布洛涅，统治两伯国直至去世，其子让二世继位。

en: Margaret of Évreux (c. 1307–1350) was a Capetian princess, daughter of Louis, Count of Évreux, and Margaret of Artois, and sister of Philip III of Navarre. In 1325, at the castle of Busséol, she married William XII, Count of Auvergne and Boulogne, and was countess of both until 1332. Their daughter Joan I, born in 1326, inherited the two counties.
zh: 埃夫勒的玛格丽特（约1307—1350）是卡佩王朝公主，埃夫勒伯爵路易与阿图瓦的玛格丽特之女、纳瓦拉国王腓力三世的妹妹。1325年，她在比塞奥勒城堡嫁给奥弗涅与布洛涅伯爵纪尧姆十二世，并成为两地伯爵夫人，直至1332年。两人的女儿让娜一世生于1326年，后来继承两个伯国。

en: Marie de Termonde, also called Marie de Dampierre, married Robert VII, Count of Auvergne, as his second wife in 1312. Daughter of William of Termonde, she was the mother of Count John I of Auvergne and Cardinal Guy de Boulogne.
zh: 泰尔蒙德的玛丽（又称当皮埃尔的玛丽）是奥弗涅伯爵罗贝尔七世的第二任妻子，两人于1312年成婚。她是泰尔蒙德的纪尧姆之女，育有奥弗涅伯爵让一世和枢机主教布洛涅的居伊。

en: Marie de La Vie de Villemur (c. 1315), daughter of Pierre II de La Vie and great-niece of Pope John XXII, married Dauphin Béraud I at Avignon on 14 June 1333, and was mother of Béraud II.
zh: 玛丽·德·拉维·德·维尔米尔（约1315年生）是皮埃尔二世·德·拉维之女、教皇若望二十二世的侄孙女，1333年6月14日在阿维尼翁嫁给奥弗涅多菲安贝罗一世，是贝罗二世的母亲。

en: Robert, called the Young, was viscount of Auvergne in the mid-tenth century, the son of Viscount Robert I. In 936 he appears with his father among the founders of Chanteuges Abbey. Charters style him viscount from 947, and he succeeded his father around 950. Cartularies of Brioude and Sauxillanges show him acting beside his brother Stephen, bishop of Clermont, and later beside his sons Robert and Guy. He died between 970 and 980, and his son Guy succeeded him in the viscounty.
zh: 罗伯特绰号“年轻者”，是10世纪中叶的奥弗涅子爵，子爵罗伯特一世之子。936年，他与父亲一同作为尚特日修道院的创立者出现在文书中。947年的特许状已称他为子爵，约950年继任父职。布里乌德与索克西朗日的契据集显示，他与担任克莱蒙主教的兄弟艾蒂安共同行事，后来又和儿子罗伯特、居伊一同签署文书。他于970—980年间去世，儿子居伊继任子爵。

en: Robert I (c. 970–c. 1032) succeeded his father William IV as count of Auvergne around 1016, the year he subscribed the foundation of the church of Saint-Genès. His piety did not stop him seizing the property of the church of Aydat, which he was forced to restore in 1022. He married Ermengarde of Arles, daughter of William I of Provence and Blanche of Anjou. Their son William V succeeded to the county, while their daughter Ermengarde married Odo II, count of Blois.
zh: 罗伯特一世（约970—约1032）约于1016年继承父亲威廉四世，成为奥弗涅伯爵，同年他在圣热内教堂的奠基文书上副署。他虽以虔诚闻名，却曾侵占艾达教堂的产业，1022年被迫归还。他娶普罗旺斯伯爵威廉一世与安茹的布朗什之女、阿尔勒的埃芒加德为妻。儿子威廉五世继承伯国，女儿埃芒加德嫁给布卢瓦伯爵厄德二世。

en: Robert II was count of Auvergne from about 1060, succeeding his father William V. By his first marriage to Bertha, daughter of Hugh, count of Rouergue and Gévaudan, he ruled Rouergue jure uxoris. After Bertha died childless around 1065 he lost Rouergue but kept the county of Gévaudan. He last appears in a Cluny charter of 1095 and died around that year. By his second wife Judith of Melgueil he left a son, William VI, who succeeded him in Auvergne.
zh: 罗伯特二世约于1060年继承父亲威廉五世，成为奥弗涅伯爵。他先娶鲁埃格与热沃当伯爵于格之女贝尔特，凭妻权成为鲁埃格伯爵；贝尔特约1065年无嗣而终后，他失去鲁埃格，却保留了热沃当伯国。1095年他仍见于克吕尼修道院的一份特许状，约于同年去世。第二任妻子梅格伊的朱迪斯为他生下儿子威廉六世，后来继承奥弗涅。

en: Robert III was count of Auvergne from about 1136, succeeding his father William VI. His dispute with the church of Brioude was settled by a treaty involving the archbishops of Bourges and Lyon. He joined Louis VII of France on the Second Crusade, perhaps to atone for his wrongs against the church. He took his son William the Young with him and entrusted his possessions to his brother William the Elder. Robert died on the expedition around 1147, and his brother seized the county as William VIII.
zh: 罗伯特三世约于1136年继承父亲威廉六世，成为奥弗涅伯爵。他与布里乌德教会的争执通过布尔日与里昂大主教参与订立的条约解决。他随法王路易七世参加第二次十字军东征，或许是为了弥补对教会的过错。他带着儿子“年轻者”威廉同行，将产业托付给弟弟“年长者”威廉。罗伯特约于1147年死于途中，弟弟夺取伯国，称威廉八世。

en: Robert IV (c. 1130–1194), count of Auvergne from 1182 until his death, was the son of William VIII the Old and Anne of Nevers. In 1183 Brabançon mercenaries raided Auvergne; Robert gathered the Auvergne nobility and destroyed the raiders. In 1192 he founded the Cistercian abbey of Bouschet-Vauluisant, designing it as the burial church of his dynasty. By his wife Matilda of Burgundy, daughter of Duke Odo II, he left sons William IX, who briefly held the county, and Guy II, who succeeded as count, as well as Robert, bishop of Clermont and later archbishop of Lyon.
zh: 罗贝尔四世（约1130—1194）1182年起担任奥弗涅伯爵直至去世，他是“老者”威廉八世与讷韦尔的安妮之子。1183年布拉班特雇佣军入侵奥弗涅，罗贝尔集结奥弗涅贵族将其歼灭。1192年他创立西多会的布谢—沃吕桑修道院，想把它建成家族的陵寝之地。妻子是勃艮第公爵厄德二世之女玛蒂尔德，子女有短暂袭爵的威廉九世、后继任伯爵的居伊二世，以及历任克莱蒙主教、里昂大主教的罗贝尔。

en: Robert V (c. 1225–1277) succeeded his father William X as count of Auvergne in 1247, ruling the reduced county around Vic-le-Comte. Through his mother Adelaide of Brabant he also received the County of Boulogne in 1260. He married Eleanor of Baffie before 1250. After he imprisoned a monk over Saint-Germain-Lembron abbey, Pope Alexander IV excommunicated him, and in 1253 the Auvergne bishops called in Alphonse of Poitiers against him. Robert assembled an embassy of nobles to protest the resulting royal investigations; he accepted a mediated settlement in 1254. He made his will on 11 January 1277 and died days later, leaving Auvergne and Boulogne to his elder son William XI.
zh: 罗贝尔五世（约1225—1277）1247年继父亲威廉十世之后成为奥弗涅伯爵，统治以维克勒孔特为中心、已大为缩小的伯国。他还凭借母亲布拉班特的阿德莱德的权利，于1260年获得布洛涅伯国。1250年前他娶巴菲的埃莉奥诺尔为妻。他因圣日耳曼—朗布龙修道院之争囚禁一名修士，被教宗亚历山大四世开除教籍；1253年奥弗涅诸主教又请普瓦捷的阿方斯出面对付他。罗贝尔召集贵族使团，抗议随之而来的王家调查，并于1254年接受调停和解。他于1277年1月11日立下遗嘱，数日后去世，把奥弗涅和布洛涅留给长子威廉十一世。

en: Robert VI (1250–1314) inherited the lordship of Combrailles under his father Robert V's will of 1277 and succeeded his brother William XI as count of Auvergne and Boulogne in 1280. Before 1282 he married Beatrice of Montgascon, lady of Pontgibaud, who bore him his heir Robert VII. A soldier-count, he served Philip IV in the Franco-Flemish War from 1297, fought inside Courtrai on 11 July 1302 and again at Mons-en-Pévèle in 1304. In 1308 he escorted the future Louis X to Pamplona for the succession to Navarre.
zh: 罗伯特六世（1250—1314）依父亲罗伯特五世1277年的遗嘱继承孔布拉耶领地，1280年继兄长威廉十一世之后成为奥弗涅与布洛涅伯爵。1282年之前，他迎娶蓬日博的女领主蒙加斯科的贝阿特丽丝，儿子罗伯特七世是他的继承人。作为戎装伯爵，他1297年起随腓力四世投入佛兰德战争，1302年7月11日在科特赖克城内作战，1304年又参加蒙桑佩韦勒战役。1308年，他护送后来的路易十世前往潘普洛纳，接手纳瓦拉的继承权。

en: Robert VII of Auvergne (c. 1282–1325) was count of Auvergne and Boulogne from 1317 until his death. In 1297 he served under King Philip IV of France and his own father Robert VI in the Franco-Flemish War, fighting within the walls of Courtrai in 1302 and at Mons-en-Pévèle in 1304. In 1303 he married Blanche of Clermont, and after her death Marie of Dampierre, whose sons included John, later count of Boulogne and Auvergne, and Guy, cardinal archbishop of Lyon. In 1314 his father named his wife Beatrice of Montgascon sole heir; she later named Robert as her own heir. He died on 13 October 1325 and was succeeded by his son William.
zh: 罗贝尔七世·德·奥弗涅（约1282—1325）自1317年起任奥弗涅与布洛涅伯爵，直至去世。1297年，他随法国国王腓力四世及其父罗贝尔六世参加佛兰德战争，1302年在科特赖克城内作战，1304年又参加蒙桑佩韦勒战役。1303年他娶克莱蒙的布朗什，妻子死后续娶当皮埃尔的玛丽；后妻所生诸子中，约翰后来成为奥弗涅与布洛涅伯爵，居伊官至里昂大主教兼枢机。1314年，他的父亲指定妻子蒙加斯孔的贝娅特丽丝为唯一继承人，贝娅特丽丝后来又指定罗贝尔为自己的继承人。他于1325年10月13日去世，由儿子威廉继位。

en: Alix of Burgundy, lady of Montfleur, was the daughter of Reginald, Count of Montbéliard, and Guillemette of Neufchâtel. In 1317 she married John II of Chalon, Count of Auxerre, as his second wife; their son John III inherited Auxerre.
zh: 勃艮第的阿莉克斯是蒙弗勒尔女领主，蒙贝利亚尔伯爵雷诺与讷沙泰勒的吉耶梅特之女。1317年，她嫁给欧塞尔伯爵沙隆的让二世为继室，其子让三世后来继承欧塞尔。

en: Alix of Burgundy, also called Adelaide (c. 1251–1290), was ruling countess of Auxerre. She was a daughter of Odo of Burgundy, count of Nevers, Auxerre and Tonnerre, and Matilda II of Bourbon. After her father died on crusade in 1266, a Parlement of Paris ruling in 1273 divided his lands among the three sisters, giving Auxerre to Alix, Nevers to Yolande and Tonnerre to Margaret. On 1 November 1268 she married John I of Chalon, lord of Rochefort, at Lantenay. Their son William succeeded her in Auxerre.
zh: 阿莉克丝·德·勃艮第（又称阿德莱德，约1251—1290）是欧塞尔的执政女伯爵。她是勃艮第的厄德（兼领讷韦尔、欧塞尔与托内尔伯爵）与波旁的玛蒂尔德二世之女。1266年父亲在十字军途中阵亡后，巴黎高等法院于1273年裁定将其领地分给三姐妹：阿莉克丝得欧塞尔，约朗德得讷韦尔，玛格丽特得托内尔。1268年11月1日，她在朗特奈嫁给罗什福尔领主沙隆的约翰一世，生子威廉，后来继承了欧塞尔。

en: Beatrice of Chalon, daughter of Count John II of Auxerre and Alix of Burgundy, was lady of Montgeffon in the County of Burgundy and the second wife of Humbert VI of Thoire-Villars.
zh: 沙隆的贝娅特丽克丝是欧塞尔伯爵让二世与勃艮第的阿莉克斯之女，身为勃艮第伯国的蒙热丰女领主，嫁给安贝尔六世·德·图瓦尔-维拉尔为继室。

en: William of Chalon (died 1360), younger son of Count John II of Auxerre and Alix of Burgundy, was lord of Chavannes and Dramelay and governor of Auxerre. He married the heiress Joan of Châteauvillain but died without children.
zh: 沙隆的纪尧姆（1360年卒）是欧塞尔伯爵让二世与勃艮第的阿莉克斯之子、让三世之弟，受封沙瓦讷与德拉姆莱，曾任欧塞尔总督。他迎娶女继承人沙托维兰的让娜，但没有留下子女。

en: William of Chalon, called the Great (c. 1270–1304), was count of Auxerre and Tonnerre and lord of Rochefort. The only son of John I of Chalon and the heiress Alix of Burgundy, he succeeded his mother in Auxerre, while in 1292 his aunt Margaret of Burgundy granted him part of her rights over Tonnerre and property in Berry, retaining control over the lands granted. In 1302 he attended the first Estates General summoned by Philip IV, and he married Eleanor, daughter of Count Amadeus V of Savoy. He fought in Philip IV's Flemish war and fell at the battle of Mons-en-Pévèle on 18 July 1304, leaving a minor son, John II.
zh: 沙隆的纪尧姆（绰号“伟人”，约1270—1304）是欧塞尔与托内尔伯爵、罗什福尔领主。他是约翰一世与女继承人阿莉克丝·德·勃艮第的独子，继承了母亲的欧塞尔；1292年姨母勃艮第的玛格丽特将托内尔的部分权利及贝里的财产授予他，但保留对所授土地的控制权。1302年，他出席腓力四世召集的首次三级会议，并娶萨伏依伯爵阿梅代奥五世之女埃莱奥诺尔为妻。后参加腓力四世发动的佛兰德斯战争，于1304年7月18日在蒙斯昂佩韦勒战役阵亡，留下幼子约翰二世。

en: Henrietta of Chalon, lady of Binans, was a daughter of Count John II of Auxerre by Alix of Burgundy. In May 1357, while her father was imprisoned in England, he appointed representatives to attend her wedding to Hugh of Vienne, lord of Pagny in Burgundy.
zh: 沙隆的亨丽埃塔是比南女领主，欧塞尔伯爵让二世与勃艮第的阿莉克斯之女。1357年5月，其父仍被囚于英格兰，委托他人代表他参加她与勃艮第的帕尼领主维埃纳的于格的婚礼。

en: John I of Chalon (c. 1243–1309), lord of Rochefort and Châtelbelin in the county of Burgundy, became count of Auxerre through his marriage to its heiress Alix of Burgundy, confirmed by a Parlement of Paris ruling in 1273. From 1294 to 1301, with his half-brother John I of Chalon-Arlay, he led Comtois barons resisting Philip IV, who had bought the county from Otto IV. In 1293 he also took the title of count of Tonnerre. After his son William fell at Mons-en-Pévèle in 1304, William's widow guarded their son John II until her remarriage in 1308; John I then became his guardian until his own death in October 1309.
zh: 沙隆的约翰一世（约1243—1309）是勃艮第伯国的罗什福尔与沙泰勒布兰领主。他娶欧塞尔女继承人阿莉克丝·德·勃艮第为妻，经1273年巴黎高等法院裁决成为欧塞尔伯爵。1294至1301年，他与异母弟沙隆-阿莱的约翰一世一同率领弗朗什孔泰诸侯联盟，在法王腓力四世向奥托四世购得伯国后起而反抗。1293年，他又取得托内尔伯爵头衔。1304年其子威廉在蒙斯昂佩韦勒战役阵亡，威廉的遗孀监护儿子约翰二世，直至1308年再婚；此后约翰一世接任监护人，直至1309年10月去世。

en: John II of Chalon (1292–c. 1362), son of William the Great and Eleanor of Savoy, was a count who kept minting his own coin against the wishes of the French crown. He became count of Auxerre on his father's death in 1304, inherited Tonnerre in 1308 and ruled in his own right from 1314. After the royal ordinance of 1315 ended his right to mint in those two counties, he is said to have struck coin at Orgelet instead, and the archbishop of Besançon excommunicated him. He minted again at Châtelbelin in 1343 and repented the same year. The emperor lifted the excommunication in 1351 and two years later granted him the right to mint at Orgelet in perpetuity. In the Hundred Years' War he was a prisoner in London in 1346 and still in captivity in 1357; older writers wrongly had him die at Crécy. His second wife Alix of Burgundy bore his successor John III.
zh: 让二世·德·沙隆（1292—约1362）是“大帝”威廉与萨伏依的埃莉诺之子，是一位不顾法国王室禁令、坚持自行铸币的伯爵。1304年父亲去世后，他承袭欧塞尔伯爵之位，1308年又继承托内尔伯国，1314年起亲政。1315年王室敕令剥夺了他在这两处伯国的铸币权，据载他转而在奥尔热莱铸币，因此被贝桑松大主教处以绝罚。1343年他又在沙泰尔贝兰铸币，当年即悔过。1351年皇帝解除绝罚，两年后授予他在奥尔热莱永久铸币的权利。百年战争中，他1346年被囚于伦敦，1357年仍在狱中；旧时著作曾误称他战死于克雷西。继任伯爵的让三世是他与第二任妻子勃艮第的阿莉克斯所生。

en: John III of Chalon, called the White Knight (c. 1318–1379), was Count of Auxerre and Tonnerre, the son of John II of Chalon and Alix of Burgundy. Married in 1333 to Marie Crespin du Bec, he served as grand butler of France and was captured in 1356 shortly before Poitiers, freed only by the Treaty of Brétigny in 1360. He inherited Tonnerre in 1360 and Auxerre in 1361. Broken by captivity, he sold Auxerre to King Charles V and died in 1379 under his children's guardianship.
zh: 沙隆的让三世，绰号‘白衣骑士’（约1318—1379），是欧塞尔与托内尔伯爵，沙隆的让二世与勃艮第的阿莉克斯之子。1333年，他娶玛丽·克雷斯潘·迪贝克为妻，曾任法兰西大酒政，1356年在普瓦捷战役前不久被俘，直到1360年《布雷蒂尼条约》签订后才获释。他于1360年继承托内尔、1361年继承欧塞尔。囚禁生涯使其心智衰退，他后来把欧塞尔伯国卖给法王查理五世，1379年在子女的监护下离世。

en: Joan of Chalon (died c. 1342) was a daughter of John II of Chalon, Count of Auxerre and Tonnerre, by his second wife Alix of Burgundy. She married Thibaut V of Neuchâtel-en-Bourgogne, a lord of the Franche-Comté.
zh: 沙隆的让娜（约1342年卒）是欧塞尔与托内尔伯爵沙隆的让二世与第二任妻子勃艮第的阿莉克斯之女，嫁给弗朗什孔泰的领主讷沙泰勒-勃艮第的蒂博五世。

en: Peter of Courtenay (c. 1218–1250), lord of Conches and Mehun, was the eldest son of Robert I of Courtenay, lord of Champignelles, and Mahaut of Mehun. He ruled his Norman and Berry lordships from 1239. On 25 August 1248 he sailed from Aigues-Mortes with his cousin Louis IX on the Seventh Crusade to Egypt. Most historians place his death at Mansurah on 8 February 1250, when Robert I of Artois led a vanguard into a Mamluk trap. The chronicler Joinville instead placed his death in a night attack on the crusader camp outside Damietta. His daughter Amicia by Pétronille of Joigny married Robert II of Artois.
zh: 库尔特奈的皮埃尔（约1218—1250）是孔什与默安领主，尚皮涅勒领主库尔特奈的罗贝尔一世与默安的玛奥的长子，1239年起统治其在诺曼底与贝里的领地。1248年8月25日，他随表兄路易九世从艾格莫尔特登船，参加远征埃及的第七次十字军。多数史家认为他于1250年2月8日在曼苏拉阵亡，当时阿图瓦的罗贝尔一世率前锋陷入马穆鲁克人的伏击。编年史家茹安维尔则称他死于杜姆亚特城外十字军营地遭受的一次夜袭。他与茹瓦尼的佩特罗妮耶所生之女阿米茜，后来嫁给阿图瓦的罗贝尔二世。

en: Robert I of Courtenay (c. 1168–1239), lord of Champignelles, was a grandson of King Louis VI and a trusted knight of Philip II Augustus. He fought at the siege of Château-Gaillard in 1204 and was rewarded with the Norman lordships of Conches and Nonancourt. He served on the Albigensian Crusade in 1209 and 1226, and followed Prince Louis into England in 1216. Louis VIII made him grand butler of France in 1223. After taking the cross in 1235 he joined the Barons' Crusade and died at Acre in 1239.
zh: 库尔特奈的罗贝尔一世（约1168—1239）是尚皮涅勒领主，法王路易六世之孙，也是腓力二世·奥古斯都信任的骑士。他参加1204年的加亚尔城堡围城战，受封诺曼底的孔什与诺南库尔领地。他先后于1209和1226年参加阿尔比十字军，并于1216年随路易王子进军英格兰。1223年路易八世任命他为法国大酒政。1235年宣誓加入十字军后，他随1239年的男爵十字军东征，最终于阿卡去世。

en: Tristan of Chalon (assassinated 1369), son of Count John II of Auxerre, held the Franche-Comté lordships of Rochefort, Orgelet and Châtelbelin and married Joan of Vienne.
zh: 沙隆的特里斯坦（1369年遇刺）是欧塞尔伯爵让二世之子，在弗朗什孔泰领有罗什福尔、奥尔热莱和沙泰尔伯兰等地，娶维埃纳的让娜为妻。

en: Chimbo Orma, daughter of the lord of Anta and wife of the Ayarmaca ruler Tocay Cápac, was said to have arranged the release of the captive Inca prince Titu Cusi Hualpa with the help of her kinsmen.
zh: 琴博·奥尔马是安塔首领之女、阿亚尔马卡统治者托凯·卡帕克之妻；相传她与族人合谋救出了被囚禁的印加王子蒂图·库西·瓦尔帕。

en: Curi Hilpay was an Ayarmaca princess, daughter of the sinchi Tocay Cápac, sent to Cusco to marry the Sapa Inca Cápac Yupanqui as the Ayarmaca sought Inca help against the Chanka; her son Quispe Yupanqui was his named heir.
zh: 据西班牙编年史记载，库里·希尔派是阿亚尔马卡辛奇托凯·卡帕克之女，被送往库斯科嫁给萨帕·印卡卡帕克·尤潘基，以结盟对抗昌卡人；其子基斯佩·尤潘基是他所立的继承人。

en: Curi Ocllo was, in the Spanish chronicles, an Inca princess of Cusco, given by the Sapa Inca Inca Roca as wife to Tocay Cápac, sinchi of the Ayarmaca, to seal peace; in return, Tocay's daughter Mama Chiquia married Inca Roca's heir Yáhuar Huácac.
zh: 据西班牙编年史记载，库里·乌克柳是库斯科的印加公主，被萨帕·印卡印卡·罗卡嫁给阿亚尔马卡辛奇托凯·卡帕克，以缔结和平；作为交换，托凯之女玛玛·奇基亚嫁给印卡·罗卡的继承人亚瓦尔·瓦卡克。

en: Mama Chiquia was a daughter of Tocay Cápac, sinchi of the Ayarmaca. She married the Inca prince Titu Cusi Hualpa, later the Sapa Inca Yáhuar Huácac, when Cusco and the Ayarmaca made peace, and was mother of the future Inca Viracocha.
zh: 玛玛·奇基亚是阿亚尔马卡辛奇托凯·卡帕克之女。库斯科与阿亚尔马卡议和时，她嫁给印加王子蒂图·库西·瓦尔帕，即后来的萨帕·印卡亚瓦尔·瓦卡克，也是后来的印卡王维拉科查·印卡的母亲。

en: Tocay Cápac was, in the Spanish chronicles of Inca history, the sinchi, or war leader, of the Ayarmaca people around Cusco. When the Huallacanes gave Mama Micay to Inca Roca after first promising her to Tocay, he felt insulted and conspired with them to seize her young son Titu Cusi Hualpa. Legend says the boy wept blood and was spared; he later became known as Yáhuar Huácac, the one who weeps blood. Around 1350 peace was sealed when Inca Roca sent him his daughter Curi Ocllo and Tocay's own daughter Mama Chiquia married the Inca prince. Another daughter, Curi Hilpay, married Cápac Yupanqui.
zh: 托凯·卡帕克是西班牙编年史所记载的阿亚尔马卡人辛奇，即军事首领，称雄于库斯科一带。瓦亚坎部族原本把女子玛玛·米凯许配给他，后来却将她嫁给印卡·罗卡；托凯视为羞辱，串通瓦亚坎人劫走印卡·罗卡的幼子蒂图·库西·瓦尔帕。相传王子啼哭流血，得以保全性命，他后来得名亚瓦尔·瓦卡克，意为“泣血者”。约1350年双方和亲：印卡·罗卡把女儿库里·乌克柳嫁给托凯，托凯之女玛玛·奇基亚则嫁给印加王子；他的另一女库里·希尔派嫁给了卡帕克·尤潘基。

en: Khidr Beg (died c. 1360) was the third ruler of the Aydınid beylik in western Anatolia. A son of Mehmed Bey and elder brother of Umur Beg, he succeeded in 1348 after Umur's death at Smyrna during the Latin crusade. On 18 August 1348 he was forced to accept a twenty-article treaty with the Latins, surrendering half the customs revenue and opening Aydınid ports to Christian ships. He soon recovered, concluding agreements with the Hospitallers and Genoa and, in April 1353, with Venice and Crete. He died around 1360 and was followed by İsa Bey.
zh: 希兹尔·贝伊（约1360年卒）是安纳托利亚西部艾登王朝的第三位统治者。他是穆罕默德·贝伊之子、乌穆尔·贝伊的兄长，1348年乌穆尔在士麦那死于拉丁人的十字军后继位。1348年8月18日，他被迫接受与拉丁人的二十款条约：让出半数关税，并向基督教船只开放艾登港口。他很快恢复国力，先后与医院骑士团、热那亚缔约，又于1353年4月与威尼斯和克里特达成和约。他约于1360年去世，伊萨·贝伊继位。

en: Mubariz al-Din Gazi Mehmed Bey (died 1334) was the founder of the Aydınid principality in western Anatolia. A Turkish commander, or subaşı, serving the Germiyan ruler Yakub Bey, he first campaigned in the Aydın region alongside Sasa Bey, then seized the lands for himself in 1308 and made Birgi his capital. He took Ayasuluk, Tire and Sultanhisar, built a fleet at Ayasuluk, raided Chios in 1319 and captured the harbour of Smyrna from Martino Zaccaria in 1328–1329. On his death in 1334 his son Umur succeeded him.
zh: 穆巴里祖丁·加齐·穆罕默德贝伊（？—1334）是安纳托利亚西部艾登埃米尔国的建立者。他原在格尔米扬君主雅各布贝伊麾下任军队统领，先随萨萨贝伊攻略艾登地区，继而于1308年从其手中夺取这些土地自立，定都比尔吉。他攻取阿亚苏鲁克、蒂雷和苏丹希萨尔，在阿亚苏鲁克建立舰队，1319年袭击希俄斯岛，并于1328—1329年从马蒂诺·扎卡里亚手中夺取士麦那港。1334年他去世后，儿子乌穆尔继位。

en: Umur Ghazi (c. 1309–1348), called Umur the Lion, was the second bey of Aydın, the Turkish beylik on the Aegean coast of Anatolia, ruling from 1334. His power was his navy: at its height Aydın had 350 ships and 15,000 men, and his raids on Christian shipping led Pope Clement VI to proclaim the Smyrniote Crusade against him in 1343. He was also a patron of letters, and the Pañcatantra was first translated into Turkish in his reign. A loyal friend of the Byzantine emperor John VI Cantacuzenus in the civil war of 1341–1347, he sent as many as 380 ships and 28000 men to his aid and besieged Demotika in Thrace. In 1348 a Venetian, Hospitaller and Cypriot fleet destroyed his navy, and Umur was killed by arrows while climbing the walls of Smyrna castle in an attempt to retake it. John mourned him, and Umur's elder brother Hızır succeeded him.
zh: 加齐·乌穆尔（约1309—1348），人称“狮子乌穆尔”，是土耳其人的艾登侯国第二任贝伊，该国位于安纳托利亚的爱琴海沿岸，他自1334年起统治。他的力量在海军：鼎盛时艾登拥有350艘战船和15000名士兵，他对基督教船只的袭掠促使教宗克雷芒六世于1343年发动士麦那十字军。他也是文学的赞助者，印度的《五卷书》首次被译成土耳其语就在他在位期间。1341—1347年拜占庭内战期间，他是皇帝约翰六世（坎塔库泽努斯）的忠实朋友，派出多达380艘船和28000人相助，并围攻色雷斯的季莫蒂卡。1348年，威尼斯、医院骑士团与塞浦路斯的联合舰队摧毁了他的海军，乌穆尔在攀登士麦那城堡城墙、试图夺回该城时中箭身亡。约翰为他哀悼，继位的是他的兄长赫兹尔。

en: Aylangir was a 13th-century Mongol amir of the Barlas tribe in the Chagatai Khanate, the son of Ichil and father of Burgul. Yazdi's Zafarnama relates that Aylangir took over Ichil's duties in the khanate after his father moved to Persia; Hafiz-i Abru instead says that Ichil's other son Qutlugh Qiya moved there. Both writers say the khanate flourished under Aylangir. Through Burgul, father of Taraghai, he was the great-grandfather of Timur, the future conqueror.
zh: 爱兰吉儿是13世纪察合台汗国巴鲁剌思部的蒙古异密，伊奇勒之子、巴儿古勒之父。亚兹德《武功纪》记载，伊奇勒迁往波斯后，爱兰吉儿接掌其父在汗国的职务；哈菲兹·阿不鲁则称迁往波斯的是伊奇勒的另一子忽都鲁·乞牙。两人都记载察合台汗国在爱兰吉儿治下兴盛。其子巴儿古勒生塔剌海，故他是后来的征服者帖木儿的曾祖父。

en: Ayurbarwada (1285–1320), titled Buyantu Khan and Emperor Renzong of Yuan, was the second son of Darmabala and a pupil of the Confucian Li Meng. He helped his brother Khayishan seize power in 1307, became crown prince and succeeded peacefully in 1311. He reversed his brother's free-spending ways and in 1313 restored the Confucian civil service examinations, first held in 1315; a new law code was completed in 1316. A 1314 cadastral survey failed amid revolts, and he fought Chagatai khan Esen Buqa until the latter's death in 1318. Renzong died in 1320, leaving the throne to his son Shidibala.
zh: 爱育黎拔力八达（1285—1320），号普颜笃汗，庙号仁宗，答剌麻八剌次子，曾从儒士李孟学习。1307年他助兄长海山夺取帝位，被立为皇太子，1311年平稳继位。他一改兄长挥霍之政，于1313年下诏恢复儒家科举，1315年首次开科；新律典也于1316年编纂完成。1314年的田土经理在民变中失败，他还与察合台汗也先不花交战，直到后者于1318年死去。仁宗于1320年去世，皇位传给儿子硕德八剌。

en: Acamapichtli (died 1395) was the first tlatoani of the Mexica of Tenochtitlan and founder of its royal dynasty. His father was a Mexica leader and his mother Atotoztli I, princess of Culhuacan. The elders of the young city wanted a ruler linked to powerful neighbors; they chose him for his Culhua, and hence Toltec, bloodline, and he married Ilancueitl and entered the island city as its ruler in the 1370s. Tenochtitlan paid tribute to the Tepanec city of Azcapotzalco and fought its wars before being allowed its own. Acamapichtli preferred alliances to war and paid what was demanded: when Tezozomoc asked for a chinampa of beautiful flowers, the Mexica planted one and floated it across the lake to him. At home he extended the chinampa fields, divided the city into four calpullis and issued its first laws. Crowned at Huitzilopochtli's altar in 1382, he died in 1395 and his son Huitzilihuitl succeeded him.
zh: 阿卡马皮奇特利（？—1395）是墨西加人在特诺奇蒂特兰的首任特拉托阿尼，也是当地王朝的奠基者。他的父亲是墨西加首领，母亲是库瓦坎公主阿托托斯特利一世。这座新城的长老们是外来者，想要一位与强邻有血缘联系的统治者；他因母系的库瓦坎血统（库瓦坎贵族自称托尔特克人后裔）而被选中，娶伊兰奎特尔为妻，于1370年代进入这座岛城执政。特诺奇蒂特兰向特帕内克城市阿斯卡波察尔科纳贡，并为其征战，后来才获准自行征战。阿卡马皮奇特利宁可结盟而不轻启战端，对索要的贡赋照付：特索索莫克想要一块种满鲜花的奇南帕田，墨西加人就种出一块，从湖面上浮送过去。在城内，他扩展奇南帕田、将城市划为四个卡尔普里并颁布首批法律。1382年他在维齐洛波奇特利祭坛前加冕，1395年去世，其子维齐利维特尔继位。

en: Atotoztli I was a Colhua princess of Culhuacan, a daughter of King Coxcoxtli and sister of King Huehue Acamapichtli. She married Opochtli Iztahuatzin, a Mexica leader, in one of the unions between the two peoples during their association at Tizaapan. The Colhua nobility claimed descent from the Toltecs of Tula, giving her bloodline particular prestige. After Tenoch's death, the Mexica elders sought a ruler who could strengthen their new city's ties to powerful neighbours. They chose her son Acamapichtli, who was then living with her in Texcoco. He became the first tlatoani of Tenochtitlan and founded its royal dynasty; the Codex Aubin dates his accession to 1376, while other chronicles give different dates.
zh: 阿托托斯特利一世是库尔瓦坎的科尔瓦公主，国王科什科什特利之女、国王韦韦·阿卡马皮奇特利的姐妹。她嫁给墨西卡首领奥波奇特利·伊斯塔瓦钦，是两族在蒂萨潘交往时通婚的例子之一。科尔瓦贵族自称是图拉特尔特克人的后裔，因此她的血统格外显贵。特诺奇去世后，墨西卡长老希望为新城选出一位能够加强与强邻联系的统治者，选中了当时正随她住在特斯科科的儿子阿卡马皮奇特利。他成为特诺奇蒂特兰第一代特拉托阿尼，开创了当地的王朝；《奥班手抄本》记载他于1376年即位，其他编年史则有不同纪年。

en: Opochtli Iztahuatzin was a Mexica leader and the husband of Atotoztli I, a princess of Culhuacan and daughter of King Coxcoxtli. Their son Acamapichtli became the first tlatoani of Tenochtitlan, and his grandsons Huitzilihuitl and Itzcoatl also ruled the Mexica.
zh: 奥波克利·伊斯塔瓦钦是墨西加首领，娶库瓦坎国王科克斯科斯特利之女阿托托斯特利一世为妻。其子阿卡马皮奇特利是特诺奇蒂特兰首任特拉托阿尼，孙子维齐利维特尔、伊茨科阿特尔后来亦相继在位。

en: Tenoch (c. 1299–1363) was the Mexica war leader, or cuauhtlahtoani, raised to power by the council of elders. His people were then in Azcapotzalco's grip: beaten in war, they paid heavier tribute and from 1318 had to fight in Tepanec campaigns. In 1344, with Azcapotzalco's support, he made Culhuacan the Mexica's first tributary, and he rose to Huitznahuatl, the highest military rank open to a priest. After Ilancueitl's death in 1347 he was chosen as leader; he replaced Achitomecatl II at Culhuacan with Nauhyotl, who was more loyal to the Mexica, and in 1351 he led the first New Fire ceremony at the Hill of the Star. He reorganized the island settlement in Lake Texcoco, began its central sacred precinct and gave the nobles privileges, laying the ground for a lasting royal line. He died in 1363; one account says Acamapichtli renamed the city Tenochtitlan in his honour in 1376.
zh: 特诺奇（约1299—1363）是墨西卡人的军事首领“夸乌特拉托阿尼”，由长老会议推举掌权。当时墨西卡人受制于阿斯卡波察尔科：战败后贡赋加重，自1318年起还要参加特帕内克人的战争。1344年，他在阿斯卡波察尔科支持下使库尔瓦坎成为墨西卡的首个纳贡城邦，并晋升为祭司所能达到的最高军职“威兹纳瓦特尔”。1347年伊兰奎特尔去世后，他被推举为首领；他在库尔瓦坎以更忠于墨西卡的瑙约特尔取代阿奇托梅卡特尔二世，1351年又在星之山主持首次新火典礼。他整顿了特斯科科湖中的岛城，开始营建城中心的祭祀区，并为贵族设立特权，为日后稳固的王室世系打下基础。他于1363年去世；一种记载称，阿卡马皮奇特利于1376年为纪念他将该城改名为特诺奇蒂特兰。

en: Tlacaelel (1397–1487) was the chief architect of the Aztec Empire, son of the Mexica ruler Huitzilihuitl and brother of emperors Chimalpopoca and Moctezuma I. Under his uncle Itzcoatl he held the military office of tlacochcalcatl. During the war against the Tepanecs in the late 1420s he became cihuacoatl and held the office under four successive tlatoque. He recast the Mexica as a chosen people, raised Huitzilopochtli to the head of the pantheon, used the flower wars against Tlaxcala and other Nahuan city-states for sacrificial captives, imposed noble sumptuary laws and burned the histories of conquered peoples. He dedicated the seventh rebuilding of the Templo Mayor at Tenochtitlan in 1484 and died in 1487.
zh: 特拉卡埃莱尔（1397—1487）是阿兹特克帝国的主要缔造者，为墨西加统治者维齐利维特尔之子，也是奇马尔波波卡和蒙特苏马一世两位君王的兄弟。他在叔父伊茨科亚特尔治下担任特拉科奇卡尔卡特尔军职。1420年代末对特帕内克人的战争中，他出任西瓦科瓦特尔即首席顾问，并连续辅佐四代特拉托阿尼。他把墨西加人塑造为神选之民，将维齐洛波奇特利抬到众神之首；发动对特拉斯卡拉等纳瓦城邦的荣冠战争以获取献祭俘虏，颁布巩固贵族的奢侈禁令，并焚毁被征服民族的史书。1484年他主持特诺奇蒂特兰大神庙第七次重建的落成典礼，1487年去世。

en: Baba Bahadur was a Mongol chieftain of the Chete tribe, descended from Genghis Khan's brother Qasar. He led the Chete to the lands east of the Gorgan river, where his grandson Togha Temür later built his power base. His son was Suri.
zh: 巴巴·巴哈杜尔是蒙古切特部首领，出自成吉思汗之弟合撒儿一系。他率部迁居戈尔甘河以东，其孙脱合帖木儿后来在这一地区崛起，子名苏里。

en: Tradition makes Ananga Deva a nephew of the Raja of Keonjhar of Odisha's Bhanj dynasty. Adopted by a childless Brahmin chieftain at Baudh, he took the name Ananga Deva and founded the Baudh state in the fourteenth century.
zh: 相传，阿能伽·提婆是奥里萨班吉家族盖翁切尔罗阇的侄子，被包特一位无嗣的婆罗门酋长收养。他改名阿能伽·提婆，于14世纪建立包特邦，开创了班吉家族在当地的统治。

en: Leopold II of Egloffstein (died 27 June 1343), born into the Frankish knightly family of Egloffstein in Franconian Switzerland, served as prince-bishop of Bamberg from 1335 until his death. Appointed under Pope Benedict XII and Emperor Louis IV, he inherited a deeply indebted bishopric yet still acquired the castles of Marloffstein, Theisenort and Greifenstein. In 1340 he confirmed Bamberg's new Poor Clares convent, the first religious foundation endowed by a patrician family of the city.
zh: 利奥波德二世·冯·埃格洛夫施泰因（1343年6月27日卒）出身法兰克瑞士的埃格洛夫施泰因骑士家族，1335年起任班贝格采邑主教，直至去世。他在教皇本笃十二世与皇帝路易四世在位时获任命，接手的虽是负债累累的主教区，却仍购得马洛夫施泰因、泰森奥尔特和格赖芬施泰因三座城堡。1340年，他批准班贝格新建的贫穷修女会修道院，这是当地首个由城市贵族家族捐资设立的宗教机构。

en: Beatrice of Bar (1310–1350) was a French noblewoman of the house of Montbéliard, the third child of Count Edward I of Bar, lord of Mousson, and Mary of Burgundy. She married Guido Gonzaga as his third wife. Guido (1290–1369) was a condottiero of the Gonzaga family that ruled Mantua: podestà of Mantua in 1328, lord of Reggio from 1335, and in 1360, at seventy, second capitano del popolo of the city. Beatrice died in Mantua in 1350, ten years before he took that office; their son Ludovico II took over the government of Mantua after Guido's death in 1369.
zh: 巴尔的贝亚特丽切（1310—1350）是蒙贝利亚尔家族的法国贵族女子，巴尔伯爵兼穆松领主爱德华一世与勃艮第的玛丽的第三个孩子。她嫁给圭多·贡扎加，是他的第三任妻子。圭多（1290—1369）是统治曼托瓦的贡扎加家族的雇佣兵首领：1328年当选曼托瓦波德斯塔，1335年成为雷焦的领主，1360年七十岁时出任曼托瓦第二任人民统领。贝亚特丽切1350年在曼托瓦去世，比他出任此职早十年；1369年圭多去世后，他们的儿子卢多维科二世接掌曼托瓦政权。

en: Edward I (c. 1295–1336) became count of Bar in 1302 on the death of his father Henry III; his uncles were regents until his 1310 marriage to Mary of Burgundy, despite his maternal grandfather Edward I of England seeking custody of the county. Captured at Frouard by Frederick IV of Lorraine in 1313, he was freed in 1314 after the treaty of Bar-sur-Aube fixed a ransom of ninety thousand livres. In 1324 he joined the War of the Four Lords against Metz, seeking both to cancel debts incurred for his ransom and to assert his seigneurial rights. He fought for Philip VI at Cassel in 1328. He died at Famagusta in November 1336 while on crusade, and his son Henry IV succeeded him.
zh: 愛德華一世（約1295—1336）於1302年父親亨利三世去世後成為巴爾伯爵，由諸叔父攝政，直到1310年他與勃艮第的瑪麗結婚；他的外祖父英王爱德华一世曾试图取得伯国监护权。1313年他在弗魯阿爾被洛林公爵腓特烈四世俘虜，1314年依《奧布河畔巴爾條約》繳付9萬里弗爾的巨額贖金後才獲釋。1324年他參加針對梅斯的“四大領主戰爭”，既想免除支付赎金所欠债务，也想维护领主权利。1328年他在卡塞爾為腓力六世作戰。1336年11月他在十字軍途中死於法馬古斯塔，子亨利四世繼位。

en: Eleanor of England (1269–1298) was the eldest surviving daughter of King Edward I and Eleanor of Castile. While her parents were on crusade from 1270 to 1274, she grew close to her grandmother Eleanor of Provence. For years she was betrothed to Alfonso III of Aragon, but Edward I withheld her while Alfonso's parents were under papal interdict over their claim to Sicily, and Alfonso died before the wedding. In September 1293 she instead married Count Henry III of Bar, bearing him two children, Edward I of Bar and Joan, later Countess of Surrey. She died at Ghent on 29 August 1298 and was buried in Westminster Abbey.
zh: 英格兰的埃莉诺（1269—1298）是英格兰国王爱德华一世与埃莉诺·德·卡斯蒂利亚在世的长女。1270至1274年父母参加十字军期间，她与祖母普罗旺斯的埃莉诺关系亲近。她曾长期与阿拉贡国王阿方索三世订有婚约，但阿方索的父母因主张西西里王位遭教皇绝罚，爱德华一世迟迟不送女出嫁，阿方索未及成婚便去世。1293年9月，她转而嫁给巴尔伯爵亨利三世，生下巴尔伯爵爱德华一世和日后的萨里伯爵夫人琼两个孩子。1298年8月29日她在根特去世，葬于威斯敏斯特教堂。

en: Éléonore de Poitiers, a daughter of Count Aymar IV of Valentinois, was the second wife of Pierre de Bar, seigneur of Pierrefort, a son of Count Thiébaut II of Bar who died before 1349. She had no children of her own.
zh: 埃莉诺·德·普瓦捷是瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵艾马尔四世之女，嫁给巴尔伯爵蒂博二世之子、皮埃尔福尔领主皮埃尔·德·巴尔为继室；皮埃尔于1349年前去世，她本人没有子嗣。

en: Gillette of Bar (died c. 1360) was the daughter of Pierre I of Bar, lord of Pierrefort, and the wife of John II of Saarbrücken, lord of Commercy-Château-Bas. Their daughter Joan married Count John I of Nassau-Weilburg in 1353.
zh: 巴尔的吉勒特（约1360年卒）是皮尔福领主皮埃尔一世·德·巴尔之女，嫁给科梅尔西下堡领主、萨尔布吕肯的约翰二世。他们的女儿让娜·德·萨尔布吕肯于1353年嫁给拿骚-威尔堡伯爵约翰一世。

en: Henry I (1158–1190) was count of Bar and lord of Mousson from 1170. Succeeding his father Reginald II as a minor, he ruled under the regency of his mother Agnes of Champagne, whose 1172 claim to the county of Verdun led her to ravage its diocese; both were excommunicated and submitted in 1177. The bishop of Toul entrusted him with the construction of the fortress of Liverdun, which Henry retained the use of without damaging relations with the duke of Lorraine. A first cousin of Philip II Augustus, he attended the king's coronation at Reims in 1179. He joined the Third Crusade after Jerusalem fell in 1187, and at the siege of Acre was mortally wounded fighting Saladin's army on 4 October 1190, dying later that month.
zh: 亨利一世（1158—1190）自1170年起任巴爾伯爵、穆松領主。他幼年繼承父親雷諾二世之位，由母親香檳的阿格尼絲攝政；母親於1172年替他主張凡爾登伯國的繼承權，縱兵蹂躪凡爾登主教區，母子同被絕罰，1177年被迫歸順。图勒主教将利韦尔丹堡垒的修建工作交给他，他保有堡垒使用权，同时维持了与洛林公爵的良好关系。他是法王腓力二世·奧古斯都的表親，1179年出席後者在蘭斯的加冕禮。1187年耶路撒冷陷落後他參加第三次十字軍東征，在阿卡圍城戰中于1190年10月4日與薩拉丁的軍隊交鋒時受致命傷，當月晚些時候死去。

en: Henry II (1190–1239) was count of Bar from 1214, son of Theobald I and Ermesinde of Bar-sur-Seine. He fought for Philip II Augustus at Bouvines and supported Count Theobald IV in the Champagne war of 1216–1221. In 1227 he rose with Theobald IV against the regent Blanche of Castile, then submitted; after quarrelling with Theobald, he raided Lorraine in 1230. Theobald's forces ravaged the Barrois in turn, and Blanche intervened to restore peace in 1232. By his 1219 marriage to Philippa of Dreux he fathered his successor Theobald II and Margaret, wife of Henry V of Luxembourg. He took the cross in 1239 and was killed at Gaza on 13 November.
zh: 亨利二世（1190—1239）自1214年起任巴爾伯爵，是蒂博一世與巴爾塞納河畔的埃爾梅辛德之子。他在布汶戰役中為腓力二世·奧古斯都作戰，又在1216—1221年的香檳戰爭中支持蒂博四世。1227年他與蒂博四世一同起兵反抗攝政卡斯蒂利亞的布朗什，隨後歸順；他后来与蒂博决裂，于1230年劫掠洛林。蒂博的军队随即劫掠巴鲁瓦，布朗什出面调停，双方于1232年议和。1219年他娶德勒的菲莉帕為妻，生子繼承人蒂博二世和嫁給盧森堡亨利五世的瑪格麗特。1239年他參加十字軍，11月13日戰死於加沙。

en: Henry III (1259–1302) was count of Bar from 1291, son of Theobald II and Joan of Toucy. To balance the power of France on his border, in 1293 he married Eleanor, daughter of Edward I of England. Pressed by Edward to invade Champagne during the Anglo-French war, he was defeated and captured by the lord of Châtillon. He only regained freedom under the Treaty of Bruges in 1301, surrendering fortresses, doing homage to Philip IV for the western Barrois mouvant and pledging to crusade. At Naples he helped Charles II against Frederick II of Sicily, was mortally wounded in battle, and died in September 1302.
zh: 亨利三世（1259—1302）自1291年起任巴爾伯爵，是蒂博二世與圖西的讓娜之子。為制衡邊境上日益強大的法國，他於1293年迎娶英格蘭國王愛德華一世之女埃莉諾。英法战争中，爱德华敦促他入侵香槟，他却被沙蒂永领主击败俘虏。他直到1301年依《布鲁日条约》才获释，条件是割让数座堡垒，为西部巴鲁瓦向法王腓力四世行臣服礼，并立誓参加十字军。他在那不勒斯協助查理二世抵禦西西里的腓特烈二世時受致命傷，1302年9月死於當地。

en: Henry of Bar (c. 1316–1380), lord of Pierrefort, was a son of Peter I of Bar and Joan of Vienne and a captain of the king of France. On 15 April 1342 he married Isabella of Vergy. In October 1353 he arrested and imprisoned Philip of Navarre, new husband of the regent Yolande of Flanders, after which Yolande gave up the regency of Bar. In 1369 he supported his son Peter when the Lorrains and Messins besieged Pierrefort, forcing them to raise the siege. He died early in 1380.
zh: 皮尔福领主巴尔的亨利（约1316—1380）是皮埃尔一世·德·巴尔与维埃纳的让娜之子，法兰西国王麾下的统领。1342年4月15日，他娶韦尔吉的伊莎贝尔为妻。1353年10月，他逮捕并囚禁了摄政约兰德的新婚丈夫纳瓦拉的腓力，此后约兰德放弃了巴尔的摄政权。1369年洛林人与梅斯人围攻皮尔福城堡，亨利支持儿子皮埃尔作战，迫使敌军撤围。他于1380年初去世。

en: Henry IV (c. 1315–1344) became count of Bar in 1336, succeeding his father Edward I; his aunt Joan of Bar, Countess of Surrey, governed during his minority. In 1337 he warred with Raoul, Duke of Lorraine, until Philip VI of France arbitrated, and in 1339–1340 he served in Philip's army against Edward III of England. He married Yolande of Dampierre, granddaughter of the count of Flanders; their sons Edward II and Robert I later ruled Bar. In 1344 he joined a French embassy to Pope Clement VI, fell ill and died on 24 December.
zh: 亨利四世（约1315—1344）1336年继父爱德华一世成为巴尔伯爵，未成年时由姑母萨里伯爵夫人让娜·德·巴尔摄政。1337年他与洛林公爵拉乌尔交战，直到封君法王腓力六世出面仲裁；1339至1340年又加入腓力六世的军队，对抗英王爱德华三世。他娶佛兰德斯伯爵的孙女约兰德·德·当皮埃尔，其子爱德华二世与罗贝尔一世后来相继统治巴尔。1344年他随法国使团觐见教皇克雷芒六世，在疫病中染病，于12月24日去世。

en: Hugh of Bar (1318–1361) was a son of Peter I, lord of Pierrefort, and Joan of Vienne, and a grandson of Count Theobald II of Bar. On 28 January 1329 he was made a canon of Verdun Cathedral, and on 4 July 1351 he was appointed bishop of Verdun, being consecrated before 26 May 1352. He maintained good relations with the Holy See throughout his episcopate. In 1361 he set out on pilgrimage to the Holy Land, but died in the Sinai on 13 August 1361 before returning.
zh: 凡尔登主教巴尔的于格（1318—1361）是皮尔福领主皮埃尔一世·德·巴尔与维埃纳的让娜之子，巴尔伯爵蒂博二世之孙。1329年1月28日，他被任命为凡尔登主教座堂的议事司铎；1351年7月4日出任凡尔登主教，1352年5月26日前完成祝圣。任内他与圣座保持良好关系。1361年他启程前往圣地朝圣，却于同年8月13日在西奈半岛去世，未能返回。

en: Yolande of Dampierre (1326–1395), also called Yolande of Flanders, was the daughter of Robert of Cassel and a great-granddaughter of Count Guy of Flanders. She inherited Cassel after her brother John's death in 1332, and in 1338 married Henry IV, Count of Bar. After Henry died in 1344 she was left with two small sons and took the regency of Bar for Edward II. Peter and Theobald of Pierrepont claimed it too; she made them back down by allying with Philip VI of France and Duke Rudolph of Lorraine, and Edward was declared of age in 1349, at ten. He died in 1352, and Yolande kept the regency for her younger son Robert against his grandaunt Joan of Bar. King John II forced her out in 1353. His capture at Poitiers in 1356 removed Joan's royal backing, and Yolande ruled again until Robert came of age in 1359. She died in 1395.
zh: 约朗德·德·当皮埃尔（1326—1395），又称佛兰德的约朗德，是罗贝尔·德·卡塞勒之女、佛兰德伯爵居伊的曾孙女。1332年兄长让去世后，她继承卡塞勒，1338年嫁给巴尔伯爵亨利四世。1344年亨利去世，留下两个年幼的儿子，她出任巴尔摄政，辅佐爱德华二世。皮埃尔蓬的彼得和蒂博也主张摄政权，她与法兰西国王腓力六世、洛林公爵拉乌尔结盟，迫使二人退让；1349年，年仅十岁的爱德华被宣布成年。1352年爱德华去世，约朗德继续为幼子罗贝尔摄政，与罗贝尔的姑祖母巴尔的让娜相争。1353年国王让二世迫使她再度交出摄政权。1356年让二世在普瓦捷被俘，让娜失去王室支持，约朗德重新执政，直到1359年罗贝尔成年。她于1395年去世。

en: Joan of Bar, called Jeannette, was a daughter of Peter I of Bar, lord of Pierrefort, and Joan of Vienne. She married Walram II, count of Zweibrücken and imperial lieutenant in Lorraine, and was the mother of Eberhard II, the last count of Zweibrücken.
zh: 巴尔的让娜（小名让内特）是皮尔福领主皮埃尔一世·德·巴尔与维埃纳的让娜之女。她嫁给茨韦布吕肯伯爵、皇帝在洛林的代理人瓦勒拉姆二世，生子末代茨韦布吕肯伯爵埃伯哈德二世。

en: Marie of Burgundy (c. 1298–1323/1336) was the youngest daughter of Robert II, Duke of Burgundy, and Agnes of France, daughter of Louis IX. On 11 February 1310 she married at Montbard Edward I, Count of Bar, becoming countess of Bar. Her children included Henry IV, who succeeded as count of Bar, and Eleanor, who married Duke Rudolph of Lorraine in 1330. She was last recorded in 1323 and was buried at Saint-Maxe in Bar-le-Duc.
zh: 勃艮第的玛丽（约1298—1323/1336）是勃艮第公爵罗贝尔二世与法兰西的阿格妮丝（路易九世之女）最小的女儿。1310年2月11日，她在蒙巴尔嫁给巴尔伯爵爱德华一世，成为巴尔伯爵夫人。子女包括后来继位的巴尔伯爵亨利四世，以及1330年嫁给洛林公爵拉乌尔的埃莱奥诺尔。她最后见于记载是1323年，葬于巴勒迪克的圣马克斯教务会教堂。

en: Peter I of Bar (c. 1272–1347), lord of Pierrefort, was a younger son of Count Theobald II of Bar and Joan of Toucy and founder of the Pierrefort branch of his house. He married Joan of Vienne and later Eleanor of Poitiers; his children included Henry, Hugh, Gillette and Joan. After Count Henry IV died in 1344, Peter and his kinsman Theobald of Pierrepont claimed seats on the regency council for the young Edward II, but the regent Yolande of Flanders, allied with King Philip VI, confined them to minor roles. Peter died on 30 November 1347.
zh: 皮尔福领主皮埃尔一世·德·巴尔（约1272—1347）是巴尔伯爵蒂博二世与图西的让娜之子，巴尔家族皮尔福支的始祖。他先后娶维埃纳的让娜与普瓦捷的埃莉诺，子女有亨利、于格、吉勒特和让娜。1344年巴尔伯爵亨利四世去世后，他与族人皮埃尔蓬的蒂博要求参加年幼的爱德华二世的摄政会议，但摄政佛兰德的约兰德联合法王腓力六世，把他们排挤到次要位置。皮埃尔于1347年11月30日去世。

en: Reginald I, called the One-Eyed (c. 1080–1149), ruled as count of Bar from 1105, inheriting Bar and Mousson from his father Theodoric of Montbéliard. In the Investiture Controversy he sided with the pope; in 1113 Emperor Henry V stormed Bar castle and held him prisoner until he swore homage. He also held the county of Verdun but, after repeated quarrels with its bishop, renounced it in 1134, the year he stormed Bouillon. Claiming Bouillon as an heir of its former lord, he took it from the bishop of Liège but had to return it in 1140. He joined the Second Crusade with his sons and drowned in the Mediterranean on the voyage home, before 10 March 1149.
zh: 雷諾一世（約1080—1149），綽號“獨眼”，自1105年起任巴爾伯爵，從父親蒙貝利亞爾的蒂埃里手中繼承巴爾與穆松。在主教敘任權之爭中他站在教宗一方；1113年皇帝亨利五世攻占巴爾城堡，將他囚禁，直到他宣誓效忠才獲釋。他還曾領有凡爾登伯國，但在與凡爾登主教反覆衝突後，於1134年放棄該伯國，同年他強攻布永。他以布永原领主继承人的身份向列日主教索取此地，攻占后却在1140年被迫归还。後來他攜諸子參加第二次十字軍東征，歸國途中溺亡於地中海，時為1149年3月10日之前。

en: Reginald II (c. 1122–1170) was count of Bar and lord of Mousson from 1149, succeeding his father Reginald I, with whom he had gone on the Second Crusade in 1147. Earlier, in 1135, he had attended the Council of Metz with his father and brother Hugh. He resumed Bar's feud with the duke of Lorraine and the bishop of Metz. In 1152 he attacked the abbey of Saint-Mihiel and was excommunicated, making public amends to be absolved. He subsequently made numerous donations to various abbeys. By his marriage in 1155 to Agnes of Champagne, daughter of Count Theobald of Blois and Champagne, he fathered Henry I and Theobald I, who each in turn ruled Bar. He died on 25 July 1170.
zh: 雷諾二世（約1122—1170）自1149年起任巴爾伯爵、穆松領主。他曾隨父親雷諾一世參加1147年的第二次十字軍東征，父親在歸途溺亡後繼位。更早的1135年，他曾与父亲和兄弟于格一同出席梅斯宗教会议。他重開與洛林公爵和梅斯主教的夙怨。1152年他襲擊聖米耶勒修道院，被處以絕罰，只得公開賠罪才獲赦免。此后他向多座修道院作出捐赠。1155年他迎娶布盧瓦與香檳伯爵蒂博之女、香檳的阿格尼絲，生子亨利一世和蒂博一世，二人先後統治巴爾。他於1170年7月25日去世。

en: Theobald I (c. 1158–1214) became count of Bar in 1190 after his brother Henry I died at the siege of Acre. Through his third marriage in 1197 to Ermesinde, heiress of Luxembourg, he also ruled Luxembourg; with Philip of Swabia's approval, he besieged Namur to make good her claims. Philip of Namur and his brother Baldwin renounced the disputed lands, and the Treaty of Dinant confirmed the settlement in 1199. In June 1211 he led troops to reinforce Simon de Montfort at the siege of Toulouse during the Albigensian Crusade. He died on 13 February 1214 and was buried at Saint-Mihiel, leaving Bar to his son Henry II.
zh: 蒂博一世（約1158—1214）於1190年兄長亨利一世死於阿卡圍城戰後成為巴爾伯爵。1197年他第三次結婚，娶盧森堡女繼承人埃爾梅辛德，由此統治盧森堡伯國；他得到士瓦本的腓力认可，围攻那慕尔以落实妻子的继承权。那慕尔的腓力及其兄弟博杜安放弃争议领地，1199年《迪南条约》确认了这一协议。1211年6月阿爾比十字軍期間，他率軍在圖盧茲圍城戰中增援西蒙·德·孟福爾。他於1214年2月13日去世，葬於聖米耶勒，巴爾伯國傳給兒子亨利二世。

en: Theobald II (c. 1221–1291) became count of Bar in 1239 after his father Henry II died on the Barons' Crusade, with his mother Philippa of Dreux acting as regent until 1242. While he was young, Matthew II of Lorraine sought to recover lands lost to his father, and Theobald built a border fortress near Neufchâteau. In 1245 he made peace with Matthew, beginning decades of peace between their lands. Fighting for his brother-in-law Guy of Dampierre in the Flanders succession war, he was captured at Westkapelle in 1253 and ransomed in September 1254, composing poetry while imprisoned. By charter on 21 April 1261 he founded the town of Pont-à-Mousson. He died in October 1291 and was succeeded by his son Henry III.
zh: 蒂博二世（約1221—1291）於1239年父親亨利二世死於男爵十字軍後成為巴爾伯爵，母親德勒的菲莉帕攝政至1242年。洛林公爵马蒂厄二世趁他年幼谋求收复被其父夺去的土地，蒂博在讷沙托附近的边境筑堡。1245年他與洛林公爵馬蒂厄二世議和，两地此后和平相处数十年。他在佛蘭德繼承戰爭中為妻舅當皮埃爾的居伊作戰，1253年在韋斯特卡佩勒被俘，1254年9月繳納贖金獲釋，獄中作詩自遣。1261年4月21日他頒賜特許狀，建立穆松橋鎮。他於1291年10月去世，子亨利三世繼位。

en: Baraq, who on converting to Islam took the name Ghiyas-ud-din, was a great-grandson of Chagatai Khan and the father of Duwa. Raised at Kublai Khan's court, he seized the Chagatai throne by deposing Mubarak Shah in September 1266 and soon rejected Kublai's overlordship. He defeated Kaidu on the Jaxartes but lost near Khujand, then made peace at Talas in 1269, receiving two-thirds of Transoxiana. Invading the Ilkhanate for pasture, he won in Khurasan but was routed by Abaqa near Herat on 22 July 1270. Wounded, he died at Bukhara on 9 August 1271 as Kaidu's army closed in.
zh: 八剌皈依伊斯兰教后取名吉亚斯丁，是察合台汗的曾孙、笃哇之父。他在忽必烈汗的宫廷长大，1266年9月废黜木八剌沙，夺得察合台汗位，随即否认忽必烈的大汗权威。他与海都交战，先在锡尔河畔设伏获胜，后在苦盏附近战败，1269年双方在怛罗斯议和，他分得河中地区三分之二的土地。此后他为夺取牧场入侵伊儿汗国，先在呼罗珊取胜，1270年7月22日在赫拉特附近被阿八哈击溃。他负伤逃回布哈拉，于1271年8月9日海都大军逼近时死去。

en: Bartan Baghatur was a Mongol prince of the Borjigin in the twelfth century, the second son of Khabul Khan, founder of the Khamag Mongol. He never held the khanship: after Khabul died in 1148 the succession passed first to his cousin Ambaghai of the Taichuud and then to Khabul's fourth son Hotula. Bartan remained chief of the Khiyad clan, bearing the warrior title baghatur. His sons included Yesugei and Daritai Otchigin, and through Yesugei, the father of Genghis Khan, he was the great conqueror's grandfather.
zh: 八哩丹（又译把儿坛·把阿秃儿）是12世纪蒙古孛儿只斤氏王公，蒙兀国创建者合不勒汗的次子。他从未称汗：1148年合不勒死后，汗位先传给泰赤乌部的从弟俺巴孩，后来又落到合不勒第四子忽图剌手中。八哩丹只担任乞颜部首领，拥有勇士称号“把阿秃儿”。诸子中有也速该和答里台·斡惕赤斤；也速该是成吉思汗之父，因此八哩丹是成吉思汗的祖父。

en: Blanche of Savoy-Vaud (died 1323) was a daughter of Louis I of Savoy, baron of Vaud, and the wife of Peter II of Grandson, lord of Grandson in the Vaud.
zh: 萨伏依-沃的布朗什（卒于1323年）是沃男爵萨伏依的路易一世之女，嫁给沃地区的格朗松领主皮埃尔二世·德·格朗松。

en: Gerhard von Wippingen (c. 1262–1325) was a cleric from the Vuippens nobility near Fribourg, whose uncle Otton de Grandson brought him to the English court. After serving Edward I on missions to Philip IV and Pope Boniface VIII, he became bishop of Lausanne in 1302 and bishop of Basel by papal appointment in 1309. A two-year schism with a rival candidate ended in 1311, and he ruled the see from Delémont, prosecuting beguines in Basel in 1320 and losing the lordship of Pfirt to Habsburg in 1324. He died on 17 March 1325 and was buried in Basel Minster.
zh: 格哈德·冯·维平根（约1262—1325）出身弗里堡附近的维庞贵族家庭，叔父格朗松的奥托把他引荐到英格兰宫廷。他受爱德华一世派遣出使腓力四世与教皇卜尼法斯八世；1302年成为洛桑主教，1309年被教皇任命为巴塞尔主教。与对立候选人造成的两年分裂于1311年结束。他主要在德莱蒙城堡理政，1320年在巴塞尔追查贝居安派异端，1324年把费雷特的宗主权丢给哈布斯堡。1325年3月17日去世，葬于巴塞尔大教堂。

en: William of Grandson, called the Great (died 1386), was a Vaudois knight and the younger son of Peter II of Grandson and Blanche of Savoy. A knight by 1346, he succeeded his father in 1348 as lord of Sainte-Croix, Cudrefin and Grandcour, and became one of the favourites and councillors of Count Amadeus VI. In 1364 he was among the first fifteen knights of the Order of the Collar, which the count had just created, and in 1365 he gained rights over Aubonne and Coppet. He served in Savoyard campaigns in the Valais and Italy, and in 1366–1367 went with the count to Greece and Bulgaria. In 1376 he founded a chapel of Saint George in the church at Ressudens. In 1383 he was an executor of Amadeus VI's will, and in 1384 he knighted the young Amadeus VII at the siege of Sion, two years before his death in 1386.
zh: 纪尧姆·德·格朗松，绰号“伟大者”，是沃地区骑士，皮埃尔二世·德·格朗松与萨伏依的布朗什之幼子。1346年他已是骑士，1348年继承父亲的圣克鲁瓦、屈德勒凡和格朗库尔领地，成为萨伏依伯爵阿梅代六世身边的近臣与顾问。1364年，他是伯爵新创的项圈骑士团最早的十五名骑士之一；1365年取得奥博讷与科佩的领地权利。他随萨伏依军队在瓦莱和意大利作战，1366至1367年又随伯爵远征希腊与保加利亚。1376年，他在勒叙当的教堂建立圣乔治礼拜堂。1383年，他是阿梅代六世遗嘱的执行人之一；1384年，他在锡永围城战中为年轻的阿梅代七世授予骑士衔，两年后的1386年去世。

en: Hartung Münch von Landskron (c. 1265–1332) was a Basel cleric from one of the city's leading ministerial families, the son of mayor Heinrich I Münch. He was a canon at Basel Minster in 1298 and 1299, held ten prebends in Baden by 1303, served as a canon at Strasbourg and became archdeacon of Basel in 1321. After Gerhard von Wippingen died, the chapter elected him bishop on 22 March 1325. He resigned the see in 1328 and died on 25 October 1332, buried in the minster chapel he had founded.
zh: 哈通·明希·冯·兰茨克龙（约1265—1332）是巴塞尔教士，出身城中最显赫的家臣家族之一，父亲是市长海因里希一世·明希。他于1298年和1299年任巴塞尔大教堂座堂教士，1303年在巴登藩侯国领有十份圣俸，后任斯特拉斯堡座堂教士，1321年成为巴塞尔大助祭。格哈德·冯·维平根去世后，座堂于1325年3月22日推举他为主教。他于1328年辞职，1332年10月25日去世，葬在他自己捐资修建的大教堂小堂中。

en: Jacques de Grandson (died 1381) was the son of Othon II de Grandson and Jeanne de Pesmes, through whom he inherited the lordship of Pesmes in the Franche-Comté on her death in 1349. He married Marguerite de Vergy, who bore him four sons and three daughters. His career was less distinguished than his father's: he was captured by the free companies and was remembered for plundering the treasury of Vergy. After his death in 1381, his widow had the Saint-Jean-Baptiste chapel built at Pesmes.
zh: 雅克·德·格朗松（1381年卒）是奥东二世·德·格朗松与让娜·德·佩姆之子，1349年母亲去世后继承弗朗什孔泰的佩姆领地。他娶玛格丽特·德·韦尔日为妻，生有四子三女。他的生涯不如其父显赫：曾被大佣兵团俘虏，还因劫掠韦尔日的财宝而留名。他于1381年去世，遗孀随后在佩姆修建了圣洗者若翰礼拜堂。

en: John of Chalon-Arlay (c. 1300–1335) was a Burgundian churchman from the Chalon-Arlay line, son of Lord John I of Arlay and nephew of Archbishop Hugh of Chalon. A canon at Langres, Besançon and Paris, he was appointed bishop of Basel by Pope John XXII on 30 March 1325, overriding the chapter's election of Hartung Münch. Backed by Philip of Valois, he won the see only in 1328 after Hartung's resignation, becoming bishop of Langres and administrator of Basel. He first entered Basel in 1330 and died in May or June 1335.
zh: 沙隆-阿莱的约翰（约1300—1335）是勃艮第教会人士，出身沙隆-阿莱支系，父亲是阿莱领主约翰一世，叔父是大主教沙隆的于格。他历任朗格勒、贝桑松和巴黎的座堂教士。1325年3月30日，教皇约翰二十二世不顾巴塞尔座堂已选出哈通·明希，任命他为巴塞尔主教。在瓦卢瓦的腓力支持下，他直到1328年哈通辞职才取得教区，同时担任朗格勒主教并代管巴塞尔。他1330年才首次进入巴塞尔，1335年五六月间去世。

en: Jeanne de Pesmes was the only child of Guillaume VIII, lord of Pesmes in the Franche-Comté. Betrothed in 1324 to Othon II de Grandson, she inherited Pesmes in 1327 and carried it into the house of Grandson. She died in 1349, leaving a son, Jacques.
zh: 让娜·德·佩姆是弗朗什孔泰的佩姆领主纪尧姆八世的独女。1324年她与奥东二世·德·格朗松订婚，1327年继承佩姆，将其带入格朗松家族。她于1349年去世，留下儿子雅克。

en: Johann II Senn von Münsingen (c. 1308–1365) trained in canon law at Bologna before the Basel chapter elected him bishop in 1335; Pope Benedict XII confirmed him at Avignon in 1336. He rebuilt a diocese ruined by his predecessors' wars and in 1337 admitted Basel's craftsmen to the city council, in a charter that first mentioned the city's guilds. Charles IV's visit in 1347 ended the interdict on Basel. His long rule also saw the plague of 1348, a Jewish pogrom in 1349 and the great earthquake of 1356. He died on 30 June 1365 and was buried in Basel Minster.
zh: 约翰二世·森·冯·明辛根（约1308—1365）曾在博洛尼亚学习教会法，1335年被巴塞尔主教座堂选为主教，1336年由教皇本笃十二世在阿维尼翁批准。他重建因前任的战争而破败的教区；1337年他颁布特许状，准许巴塞尔工匠进入市议会，其中首次提及该城的行会。1347年查理四世到访，解除了对巴塞尔的禁罚。他任内还经历1348年瘟疫、1349年屠犹事件和1356年大地震。1365年6月30日他去世，葬于巴塞尔大教堂。

en: Othon II of Grandson (c. 1305–1374) was a Vaudois knight, lord of Grandson and Belmont, whose career ran between Vaud, the Franche-Comté and the court of Burgundy. He became lord of Pesmes in 1327 through his wife Joan of Pesmes. In 1336 he stayed loyal to Duke Odo IV when the leading Franche-Comté barons rebelled, and in 1346–1347 he guarded the county against a second revolt led by John II of Chalon-Arlay. He became a chief councillor of Odo and of his successor Philip of Rouvres. He inherited Grandson and Belmont in 1343 and joined the Prussian crusade of 1357–1358. After Philip of Rouvres died in 1361 he refused to serve Philip the Bold and took Edward III of England as his lord, doing homage for Belmont in 1362; only in 1366 did he return to Burgundy. In 1367 he freed the people of Suchy from mortmain. He died in autumn 1374, and his son Hugues succeeded him.
zh: 奥东二世·德·格朗松（约1305—1374）是沃地区骑士，格朗松和贝尔蒙的领主，一生周旋于沃地区、弗朗什-孔泰与勃艮第宫廷之间。1327年，他通过妻子让娜·德·佩姆获得佩姆领地。1336年，弗朗什-孔泰的主要贵族起兵反叛，他仍忠于公爵厄德四世；1346至1347年，他又在让二世·德·沙隆-阿尔莱领导的第二次叛乱中守卫伯国。他成为厄德四世及其继任者菲利普·德·鲁夫尔的首席顾问之一。1343年他继承格朗松和贝尔蒙，1357至1358年参加普鲁士十字军。1361年菲利普·德·鲁夫尔去世后，他不肯为勇敢者菲利普效力，转而奉英格兰国王爱德华三世为主，1362年为贝尔蒙向他行臣服礼，直到1366年才回到勃艮第一边。1367年，他解除了叙希居民的身后财产领主继承权。1374年秋去世，其子于格继位。

en: Peter II of Grandson (c. 1280–1342) was a Vaudois baron, first documented in 1291. His marriage in 1303 to Blanche of Savoy-Vaud, daughter of Baron Louis I of Vaud, brought him Cudrefin, Grandcour and Bellerive, and he later gained Sainte-Croix from his Champvent cousins. In 1328 he inherited all the Vaudois estates of his uncle Otto I, companion of Edward I of England, and was enfeoffed with them by the count of Savoy in 1329. In 1330 Bern admitted him to its burgher right. He died around 1342 and was buried in the Franciscan church at Grandson.
zh: 皮埃尔二世·德·格朗松（约1280—约1342）是沃州贵族，1291年首次见于文献。1303年他娶沃男爵路易一世之女布朗什·德·萨伏依-沃，由此获得屈德勒凡、格朗库尔和贝勒里沃，后来又从尚旺的堂亲手中取得圣克鲁瓦。1328年，他继承叔父奥东一世——英王爱德华一世的同伴——在沃州的全部地产，1329年由萨伏依伯爵重新册封。1330年，他取得伯尔尼市民权。他约于1342年去世，葬于格朗松的方济各会教堂。

en: Batu Khan (c. 1205–1255), a son of Jochi, founded the Golden Horde, ruling the Jochid lands west of the Volga. In 1236 Ögedei put him in command of the European invasion: Subutai led his armies through Volga Bulgaria, sacked Ryazan and Vladimir in 1237–1238, stormed Kiev in 1240 and defeated the Hungarians at Mohi and the Poles at Legnica in 1241, withdrawing in 1242 after Ögedei's death. From Sarai Batu made the Rus' princes his vassals, and in 1250–1251 he secured Möngke's election as great khan. He died in 1255 and was succeeded by his son Sartaq.
zh: 拔都（约1205—1255）是术赤之子、金帐汗国的创建者，领有伏尔加河以西的术赤兀鲁思。1236年，窝阔台命他统领蒙古大军西征：速不台在前线指挥，大军先征服伏尔加保加利亚，1237至1238年焚掠梁赞、弗拉基米尔，1240年攻陷基辅，1241年在赛约河击败匈牙利人、在莱格尼察击败波兰人，1242年因窝阔台死讯撤军。他在萨莱建立汗廷，使罗斯诸王公称臣纳贡，又于1250至1251年扶保蒙哥当选大汗。1255年他去世，其子撒里答继位。

en: Agnes of the Palatinate (1201–1267) was a daughter of the Welf Count Palatine Henry V and Agnes of Hohenstaufen. In 1222 she married Otto II Wittelsbach at Worms, a marriage through which the Wittelsbachs inherited the Palatinate and adopted the Palatine lion. When Otto's father Louis I died in 1231, she became duchess of Bavaria. Her five children included Louis II, father of Emperor Louis IV, Henry XIII of Lower Bavaria, and Elizabeth, who married King Conrad IV in 1246. Widowed in 1253, Agnes died in 1267 and was buried at Scheyern Abbey.
zh: 普法尔茨的阿格尼丝（1201—1267年）是韦尔夫家族的莱茵行宫伯爵海因里希五世与霍亨斯陶芬的阿格尼丝之女。1222年，她在沃尔姆斯嫁给奥托二世·冯·维特尔斯巴赫；凭借这场婚姻，维特尔斯巴赫家族继承了普法尔茨，并采用了普法尔茨之狮的纹章。1231年奥托的父亲路易一世去世，她成为巴伐利亚公爵夫人。她生有五个子女，包括皇帝路易四世之父路易二世、下巴伐利亚公爵亨利十三世，以及1246年嫁给国王康拉德四世的伊丽莎白。1253年她守寡，1267年去世，葬于沙伊恩修道院。

en: Elisabeth of Gorizia-Tyrol (c. 1262–1312) was the eldest daughter of Count Meinhard of Gorizia-Tyrol and Elisabeth of Bavaria, widow of King Conrad IV; through her mother she was half-sister of Conradin. In 1274 she married Albert of Habsburg, becoming duchess of Austria in 1282 and queen of Germany after Albert took the crown in 1298. She bore him at least twelve children, including Frederick the Fair and Albert II. After Albert was murdered by his nephew John Parricida in 1308, she founded the Poor Clare monastery of Königsfelden on the spot, where she died and was buried in 1312.
zh: 提洛的伊莉莎白（约1262—1312年）是格尔茨-蒂罗尔伯爵迈因哈德与德意志国王康拉德四世的遗孀巴伐利亚的伊莉莎白的长女，按母系是康拉丁同母异父的妹妹。1274年，她嫁给哈布斯堡的阿尔布雷希特，1282年成为奥地利公爵夫人，1298年阿尔布雷希特取得王位后成为德意志王后。她为丈夫生下至少十二个子女，包括美男子腓特烈和阿尔布雷希特二世。1308年阿尔布雷希特被侄子弑亲者约翰刺杀后，她在遇刺地点修建了贫穷修女会的克尼希斯费尔登修道院，并于1312年在那里去世安葬。

en: Henry IX the Black (c. 1075–1126), second son of Duke Welf I of Bavaria, administered the family's Este estates in Italy before his marriage to Wulfhilde of Saxony around 1095 brought him Billung lands around Lüneburg. In 1106 he sought to succeed his father-in-law as Duke of Saxony, but King Henry V granted the duchy to Lothair of Supplinburg. He joined Emperor Henry V's Italian campaign of 1116 and succeeded his childless brother Welf II as duke in 1120, helping to bring about the Concordat of Worms in 1122. In the 1125 royal election he backed Lothair of Saxony over his own Hohenstaufen son-in-law. Abdicating in 1126 for his son Henry the Proud, he retired to Weingarten Abbey and died there on 13 December.
zh: “黑者”亨利九世（约1075—1126）是巴伐利亚公爵韦尔夫一世的次子，早年掌管家族在意大利的德斯特产业；约1095年娶萨克森的武尔夫希尔德为妻，由此获得吕讷堡一带的比隆家族领地。1106年他谋求继承岳父的萨克森公爵位，国王亨利五世却将公爵领封给了叙普林堡的洛泰尔。1116年他随皇帝亨利五世出征意大利，1120年继无嗣的兄长韦尔夫二世成为公爵，并促成1122年的《沃尔姆斯宗教协定》。1125年国王选举中，他转而支持萨克森公爵洛泰尔，而非自己的霍亨斯陶芬家族女婿。1126年他让位给儿子“骄傲者”亨利，退隐魏恩加滕修道院，同年12月13日死于那里。

en: Louis I Wittelsbach (1173–1231), called the Kelheimer, ruled as Duke of Bavaria from 1183 and, from 1214, as Count Palatine of the Rhine. The only surviving son of Duke Otto I, he inherited as a child, with his mother Agnes acting as regent. He backed the Hohenstaufen emperors, accompanying Henry VI on his expedition to Sicily in 1194, and was rewarded by Frederick II with the Rhenish Palatinate in 1214; his son Otto's marriage to Agnes of the Palatinate secured the electorate for the Wittelsbach. He founded Straubing in 1218. In 1221 he joined the Fifth Crusade at Damietta and was held hostage after the defeat at Mansurah. He was murdered on a bridge at Kelheim in 1231.
zh: 路易一世·维特尔斯巴赫（1173—1231），绰号“凯尔海姆人”，1183年起任巴伐利亚公爵，1214年起任莱茵行宫伯爵。他是奥托一世唯一存活的儿子，幼年继位，由母亲阿格尼丝摄政。他支持霍亨斯陶芬家族的皇帝，1194年随亨利六世远征西西里，1214年被腓特烈二世授予莱茵行宫伯爵领；其子奥托与行宫的阿格尼丝联姻，为维特尔斯巴赫家族保住了选侯领地。他于1218年建立施特劳宾城。1221年他参加第五次十字军，在达米埃塔作战，曼苏拉战败后被留作人质。1231年，他在凯尔海姆的一座桥上遇刺身亡。

en: Otto I Wittelsbach (c. 1117–1183), called the Redhead, was the first Wittelsbach Duke of Bavaria. Son of Count Palatine Otto IV of Wittelsbach and Heilika of Pettendorf-Lengenfeld, he succeeded his father as Count Palatine of Bavaria in 1156 and became a trusted military ally of Emperor Frederick Barbarossa, campaigning with him in Italy. In 1155 he captured a position above a defile near Verona, securing the imperial army's return across the Alps. After Henry the Lion was deposed, Barbarossa enfeoffed Otto with Bavaria at Altenburg in 1180. That year Styria was separated from the duchy. Backed by the emperor, he overcame the wary Bavarian nobility, and died suddenly at Pfullendorf in 1183 after the Peace of Constance. His son Louis succeeded him.
zh: 奥托一世（约1117—1183），绰号“红首”，是维特尔斯巴赫家族的首任巴伐利亚公爵。他是行宫伯爵奥托四世与佩滕多夫-伦根费尔德的海莉卡之子，1156年承袭父职任巴伐利亚行宫伯爵，并成为皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨信赖的军事盟友，随皇帝在意大利征战。1155年，他夺取维罗纳附近一处隘口上方的阵地，保障皇帝的军队安全翻越阿尔卑斯山返回。1180年狮子亨利被废黜后，巴巴罗萨在阿尔滕堡将巴伐利亚公国封给奥托。同年，施蒂利亚从公国分离。他凭借皇帝的支持压服了心存疑虑的巴伐利亚贵族，1183年在《康斯坦茨和约》签订后猝死于普富伦多夫，其子路易继位。

en: Otto II Wittelsbach (1206–1253) was Duke of Bavaria from 1231 and Count Palatine of the Rhine from 1228. In 1222 he married Agnes of the Palatinate at Worms, through whom the Wittelsbach inherited the Rhenish Palatinate. He enlarged his Bavarian domains by acquiring Bogen in 1240, with its white-and-blue lozenge arms that became Bavaria's colours, and Andechs and Ortenburg in 1248. Reconciled with Emperor Frederick II in 1241, he married his daughter Elisabeth to the future Conrad IV and was excommunicated by the pope. He died at Landshut in 1253, leaving sons Louis II and Henry XIII.
zh: 奥托二世·维特尔斯巴赫（1206—1253），1231年起任巴伐利亚公爵，1228年起任莱茵行宫伯爵。1222年他在沃尔姆斯与行宫的阿格尼丝成婚，维特尔斯巴赫家族由此继承莱茵行宫伯爵领。他扩张在巴伐利亚的领地，1240年取得博根，获得其白蓝菱形纹章，即后来巴伐利亚标志色的由来，1248年又取得安德克斯和奥滕堡。1241年他与皇帝腓特烈二世和解，将女儿伊丽莎白嫁给后来的康拉德四世，因此被教皇开除教籍。1253年他卒于兰茨胡特，留下路易二世和亨利十三世两个儿子。

en: Otto IV of Scheyern (c. 1083–1156), second son of Count Eckhard I of Scheyern, accompanied Henry V on his Italian campaign of 1110–1111 and took part in the seizure of Pope Paschal II to force him to crown Henry emperor. Otto was excommunicated for his part. After his family moved its seat to Wittelsbach Castle near Aichach, he styled himself Otto of Wittelsbach from 1116, giving the dynasty its name. That year he married Heilika of Lengenfeld. He became Count Palatine of Bavaria in 1120 and founded Indersdorf Abbey to atone for the papal kidnapping and seek removal of his excommunication. His son Otto the Redhead became the first Wittelsbach Duke of Bavaria.
zh: 奥托四世·冯·沙伊恩（约1083—1156）是沙伊恩伯爵埃克哈特一世的次子。1110—1111年他随亨利五世远征意大利，参与劫持教皇帕斯加尔二世，以迫使教皇为亨利加冕为皇帝。奥托因此被开除教籍。家族将居城迁到艾夏附近的维特尔斯巴赫城堡后，他从1116年起自称“冯·维特尔斯巴赫”，这个王朝由此得名。同年他与伦根费尔德的海利卡成婚。1120年他成为巴伐利亚行宫伯爵，并兴建因德斯多夫修道院，为劫持教皇一事赎罪，寻求解除绝罚。他的儿子“红发”奥托成为维特尔斯巴赫家族的首任巴伐利亚公爵。

en: Welf I (c. 1035/1040–1101) was the son of Albert Azzo II of Este and Kunigunde of Altdorf, and founder of the younger House of Welf. Inheriting his childless uncle Welf III of Carinthia's lands in 1055, he was made Duke of Bavaria by Emperor Henry IV in 1070 after divorcing his first wife. In the Investiture Controversy he backed Pope Gregory VII and the anti-king Rudolf of Rheinfelden. Henry declared him deposed in 1077, but Welf maintained his position with Bavarian and Italian support. He reconciled with Henry in 1095 and was confirmed as duke. By Judith of Flanders he fathered Welf II and Henry IX. His Bavarians were ambushed in Anatolia during the Crusade of 1101; Welf escaped but died on Cyprus while returning.
zh: 韦尔夫一世（约1035/1040—1101）是阿尔贝托·阿佐二世·德斯特与阿尔特多夫的库尼贡德之子，小韦尔夫家族的始祖。1055年他继承了无嗣舅父克恩滕公爵韦尔夫三世的产业，1070年与发妻离婚后被皇帝亨利四世封为巴伐利亚公爵。主教叙任权之争中，他支持教皇格列高利七世和对立国王莱茵费尔登的鲁道夫。亨利于1077年宣布剥夺他的公爵领地，但韦尔夫在巴伐利亚人和意大利方面的支持下保住了地位。1095年他与亨利和解，公爵地位得到确认。他与佛兰德的朱迪丝生下韦尔夫二世和亨利九世。1101年十字军东征时，他的巴伐利亚军队在安纳托利亚遭伏击；韦尔夫逃脱，却在归途中死于塞浦路斯。

en: Welf II the Fat (1072–1120), eldest son of Duke Welf I of Bavaria and Judith of Flanders, was still a teenager when he married the much older Countess Matilda of Tuscany in 1088 or 1089, binding his family to the papal side in the Investiture Controversy. He fought Henry IV in Italy in 1090, then separated from Matilda around 1095 and made peace with the emperor alongside his father. Succeeding as duke in 1101, he remained married to Matilda until her death in 1115, died childless at Kaufering on 24 September 1120 and was buried at Weingarten Abbey.
zh: “胖子”韦尔夫二世（1072—1120）是巴伐利亚公爵韦尔夫一世与佛兰德的朱迪丝的长子。1088或1089年，尚是少年的他娶了年长二十多岁的托斯卡纳女伯爵玛蒂尔达，借此在主教叙任权之争中把家族与教皇阵营绑在一起。1090年他在意大利与亨利四世作战，约1095年与玛蒂尔达分居，并随父亲同皇帝和解。1101年他继位为公爵，与玛蒂尔达的婚姻维持到1115年她去世为止。1120年9月24日他无嗣而终于考弗灵，葬在魏恩加滕修道院。

en: Albert II of Regenstein (c. 1293–1349), son of Count Ulrich III, became regent of the county in 1310 and later married Oda of Falkenstein and Jutta of Anhalt-Zerbst. His feud with the bishop of Halberstadt over the Falkenstein inheritance turned violent in 1336, when he raided Quedlinburg's lands and seized its new town; captured that July, legend keeps him for twenty months in a wooden chest in Quedlinburg's town hall. The 1338 peace made him accept the bishop as the town's protector. In 1349 he was murdered by assassins hired by Bishop Albert II of Halberstadt.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特二世·冯·雷根施泰因（约1293—1349）是伯爵乌尔里希三世之子，1310年成为伯国摄政，后来先后娶奥达·冯·法尔肯施泰因和尤塔·冯·安哈尔特-采尔布斯特为妻。他与哈尔伯施塔特主教因法尔肯施泰因遗产结仇，1336年冲突激化：他洗劫奎德林堡乡野并占据新城，同年7月被俘。相传他被关在奎德林堡市政厅的一个木箱里长达二十个月。1338年双方和解，他承认主教为该城保护者。1349年，他被哈尔伯施塔特主教阿尔布雷希特二世雇凶刺杀。

en: Ulrich III of Regenstein-Heimburg (c. 1287–1322/23) was a count of the Regenstein line in the Harz, holding the county of Heimburg and the lordship of Derenburg, now part of Blankenburg. He was the son of Count Albert I of Regenstein and Sophie of Lippe. On 1 July 1308 he married Sophie of Anhalt-Aschersleben, daughter of Prince Otto I of Anhalt. Their marriage produced sixteen children, including his successors Bernhard I and Albert II of Regenstein. He died between September 1322 and March 1323.
zh: 乌尔里希三世·冯·雷根施泰因-海姆堡（约1287—1322/1323）出身哈茨山区的雷根施泰因伯爵家族，领有海姆堡伯国和德伦堡领地，德伦堡今属布兰肯堡。他是阿尔布雷希特一世·冯·雷根施泰因伯爵与利珀的索菲之子。1308年7月1日，他娶安哈尔特亲王奥托一世之女、安哈尔特-阿舍斯莱本的索菲为妻，两人育有十六名子女，包括继承人伯恩哈德一世和阿尔布雷希特二世。他于1322年9月至1323年3月间去世。

en: Johannes I Pfefferhard (born before 1300, died 23 May 1331), a cleric from a wealthy patrician family of Konstanz, served as bishop of Chur from 1325 until his death. He studied at Bologna and was parish priest at Steffisburg, a canon of Chur and Konstanz, and provost of Würzburg. In the conflict between Emperor Louis IV and the papacy he took the pope's side. Consecrated at Avignon in 1330, he was seized on his way home by the barons of Grünenberg and held in a castle called Tüfelsruggen; he died in captivity and was buried at Binzen.
zh: 约翰内斯一世·普费弗哈德（1300年前出生，卒于1331年5月23日）出身康斯坦茨富裕的城市贵族家庭，1325年起任库尔主教，直至去世。他曾在博洛尼亚求学，历任施特菲斯堡本堂神父、库尔与康斯坦茨法政牧师、维尔茨堡座堂主任司铎。在皇帝路易四世与教廷的冲突中，他站在教皇一边。1330年他在阿维尼翁晋牧，返程途中被格林根贝格男爵袭击，囚禁于名为蒂费尔斯鲁根的城堡，最终死于囚禁，葬于宾岑。

en: Rudolf III of Montfort (born 1260–1275, died 27 or 28 March 1334) was a Swabian count's son who became bishop of Chur and Konstanz. A canon at Chur from 1283 and its provost from 1307, he was elected its bishop in 1322, but Pope John XXII made him bishop of Konstanz; he kept administering Chur until 1325. In the German throne dispute he backed the Habsburgs, yet sided with the pope against Emperor Louis IV, whose regalia he accepted in 1332. The pope excommunicated him in 1333, and he died at Arbon in 1334, buried in unconsecrated ground.
zh: 鲁道夫三世·冯·蒙特福特（生于1260至1275年间，卒于1334年3月27或28日）是施瓦本伯爵之子，后成为库尔与康斯坦茨主教。他自1283年任库尔法政牧师，1307年起任座堂主任司铎，1322年当选库尔主教，但教皇约翰二十二世随即任命他为康斯坦茨主教，他仍代管库尔教区至1325年。在德意志王位之争中他支持哈布斯堡家族，又站在教皇一边反对皇帝路易四世；1332年他接受皇帝授予的王权象征，遂于1333年被教皇革出教门。1334年他卒于阿尔邦，被葬在未祝圣的土地中。

en: Ulrich of Lenzburg, also called Ulrich Ribi (died at Sargans on 25 March 1355), was an Augustinian hermit in Mainz before becoming bishop of Chur in 1331. As a papal penitentiary he had opposed Emperor Louis IV, and in 1338 the Synod of Speyer sent him to Avignon to mediate with Benedict XII. In the wars over Tyrol he allied with Charles IV of Bohemia; in 1347 Louis of Brandenburg captured him and seized Chur's Tyrolean lands, and he later sought Charles IV's court in Prague. In 1352 and 1354 he backed Albert II of Austria against the Swiss.
zh: 乌尔里希·冯·伦茨堡，又名乌尔里希·里比（1355年3月25日卒于萨尔甘斯），本是美因茨的奥斯定会隐修士，1331年成为库尔主教。他曾任教皇赦罪司铎，反对皇帝路易四世；1338年，施派尔宗教会议派他前往阿维尼翁，向教皇本笃十二世斡旋。在争夺蒂罗尔的战乱中，他与波希米亚国王查理四世结盟；1347年被勃兰登堡的路易俘虏，库尔在蒂罗尔的领地也被占领，此后他多次前往布拉格的查理四世宫廷。1352和1354年，他支持奥地利的阿尔布雷希特二世对抗瑞士邦联。

en: Frederick II of Baden (died 22 June 1333) ruled as margrave from 1291, when his father Herman VII died, until his own death. He first governed jointly with his brother Rudolf IV; after the margraviate was partitioned, Frederick held Baden-Baden and Eberstein while Rudolf kept Pforzheim. He married Agnes of Weinsberg before 1312 and, after her death in 1320, Margaret of Vaihingen. His son by the first marriage, Herman IX, succeeded him in Eberstein.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/腓特烈二世_(巴登-埃博斯泰因)
zh: 巴登的腓特烈二世（卒于1333年6月22日）自1291年父亲赫尔曼七世去世后担任巴登藩侯，统治直至本人去世。他起初与兄弟鲁道夫四世共同执政，后来藩侯国分家，腓特烈分得巴登-巴登和埃伯施泰因，鲁道夫分得普福尔茨海姆。1312年前他娶魏因斯贝格的阿格尼丝，后者1320年去世后又娶法伊欣根的玛格丽特。第一次婚姻所生之子赫尔曼九世在埃伯施泰因继其位。

en: Frederick III, called the Peaceful (1327 – 2 September 1353), was Margrave of Baden from 1348 until his death. The elder son of Margrave Rudolf IV and Marie of Oettingen, he and his brother Rudolf V took power together after their father's death and divided the inheritance: Frederick made Baden-Baden his residence while Rudolf ruled Baden-Pforzheim. Around 1345 he married Margareta, daughter of Margrave Rudolf Hesso of Baden-Baden. Their son Rudolf VI later reunited the margraviate, and their daughter Margareta married Count Gottfried II of Leiningen-Rixingen. Frederick died on 2 September 1353.
zh: 巴登藩侯腓特烈三世（1327—1353年9月2日），绰号“和平者”，1348年起任藩侯直至去世。他是藩侯鲁道夫四世与厄廷根伯爵之女玛丽亚的长子，1348年父亲死后与弟弟鲁道夫五世共同掌权并分割遗产：他以巴登-巴登为驻地，鲁道夫五世统治巴登-普福尔茨海姆。约1345年他与巴登-巴登藩侯鲁道夫·赫索之女玛加丽塔结婚，生子鲁道夫六世（后来重新统一藩侯领地），女儿玛加丽塔嫁给莱宁根-里克辛根伯爵戈特弗里德二世。1353年9月2日腓特烈去世。

en: Herman V (c. 1180–16 January 1243) was Margrave of Baden from 1190, making Pforzheim the margraviate's seat in 1219. The son of Margrave Herman IV and Bertha of Tübingen, he married Countess Palatine Irmengard of the Rhine in 1217. In the German throne dispute he backed Philip of Swabia and Otto IV before becoming a loyal follower of Emperor Frederick II, joining the Fifth Crusade, where he was captured in Egypt in 1221, and the Sixth Crusade in 1228. He founded Stuttgart, Backnang and Pforzheim and fought the Mongols at Liegnitz in 1241.
zh: 赫尔曼五世（约1180—1243年1月）自1190年起任巴登藩侯，1219年将普福尔茨海姆定为藩侯国治所。他是藩侯赫尔曼四世与蒂宾根的贝尔塔之子，1217年娶莱茵行宫伯爵之女伊尔门加德。在德意志王位之争中，他先支持施瓦本的菲利普和奥托四世，后来成为皇帝腓特烈二世的忠实追随者，参加第五次十字军东征并于1221年在埃及被俘，又随皇帝参加1228年的第六次十字军东征。他建立了斯图加特、巴克南和普福尔茨海姆，并于1241年在莱格尼察抗击蒙古人。

en: Hermann IX of Baden-Eberstein (died 13 April 1353) was the son of Margrave Frederick II of Baden-Eberstein and Agnes of Weinsberg. On his father's death in 1333 he succeeded to the Eberstein share of the margraviate. In 1344 he gave the Iburg to his uncle Rudolf IV of Baden-Pforzheim, but in 1350 King Charles IV enfeoffed him with it again, and that year he bought back the village of Mörsch from Herrenalb Abbey. In 1341 he married Matilda of Vaihingen; their son Frederick IV died before him, so when Hermann died in 1353 his first cousin once removed Rudolf VI inherited Eberstein.
zh: 巴登-埃伯施泰因藩侯赫尔曼九世（1353年4月13日卒）是巴登-埃伯施泰因藩侯腓特烈二世与阿格妮丝·冯·魏因斯贝格之子。1333年父亲去世后，他继承藩侯领地中的埃伯施泰因部分。1344年他把伊堡交给叔父、巴登-普福尔茨海姆藩侯鲁道夫四世，1350年国王查理四世又将伊堡重新封赐给他；同年他从黑雷纳尔布修道院购回默尔施村。1341年他与玛蒂尔德·冯·法英根结婚，二人之子腓特烈四世先他而死，因此1353年赫尔曼去世后由堂侄鲁道夫六世继承埃伯施泰因。

en: Herman VII of Baden, called the Rouser (1266–12 July 1291), ruled as Margrave of Baden from 1288 until his early death. The son of Margrave Rudolf I and Kunigunde of Eberstein, he married Agnes of Truhendingen before October 1278, and their children included Frederick II, Rudolf IV and Herman VIII. In 1291 he acquired Weißenburg Monastery lands around Bietigheim. He died on 12 July 1291 and was buried in Lichtenthal Abbey, leaving the margraviate to his young sons.
zh: 巴登的赫尔曼七世，绰号“唤醒者”（1266—1291年7月12日），自1288年起任巴登藩侯，直至早逝。他是藩侯鲁道夫一世与埃伯施泰因的库妮贡德之子，1278年10月前娶特鲁亨丁根的阿格尼丝，子女包括腓特烈二世、鲁道夫四世和赫尔曼八世。1291年，他取得魏森堡修道院在比蒂希海姆一带的地产。他于1291年7月12日去世，葬于利希滕塔尔修道院，藩侯国由年幼的诸子继承。

en: Kunigunde of Zollern (died 1381) was the daughter of Count Frederick VI of Zollern and Kunigunde of Baden, herself a daughter of Margrave Rudolf I of Baden. She became a Cistercian nun at Lichtenthal Abbey near Baden-Baden and served as its abbess from 1367 until her death. She first appears in an abbey document in 1368 and is last attested in October 1380; the convent's necrology records her death on 12 August, placed in 1381. An older abbess list that credited her with office there in 1295–1310 confuses her with her mother of the same name.
zh: 索伦的库妮贡德（?—1381）是索伦伯爵腓特烈六世与巴登的库妮贡德之女，其母是巴登藩侯鲁道夫一世的女儿。她在巴登-巴登附近的利希滕塔尔修道院成为西多会修女，1367年起担任院长直到去世。她最早见于1368年的修道院文书，最后一次有记载是1380年10月；修道院亡名录记其卒于8月12日，学界推定年份为1381年。旧院长名录把1295至1310年的在任院长也记作她，实为与同名的母亲混淆。

en: Rudolf IV of Baden-Pforzheim (died 25 June 1348) was a younger son of Margrave Hermann VII of Baden. Destined for the church, he became a canon at Speyer until his father's death in 1291, when the margraviate was divided and he received Baden-Pforzheim, ruling with his brother Hermann VIII until 1300 and then alone. He left Duke Leopold I of Austria for Emperor Louis IV, who in 1334 mortgaged Ortenburg Castle, Offenburg, Gengenbach and the Ortenau to him, and in 1335 he inherited Baden-Baden from his cousin Rudolf Hesso. His sons Frederick III and Rudolf V divided his lands.
zh: 巴登-普福尔茨海姆藩侯鲁道夫四世（1348年6月25日卒）是巴登藩侯赫尔曼七世的儿子，因排行居幼，原本被安排投身教会，在施派尔任法政牧师。1291年父亲去世，藩侯领地被分割，他分得巴登-普福尔茨海姆，先与兄长赫尔曼八世共治至1300年，此后独自统治。他后来脱离奥地利公爵利奥波德一世、转投皇帝路易四世，皇帝于1334年把奥尔滕堡城堡、奥芬堡、根根巴赫和奥特瑙地区抵押给他；1335年他又从堂亲鲁道夫·赫索手中继承巴登-巴登。他死后，儿子腓特烈三世与鲁道夫五世瓜分了领地。

en: Rudolf V of Baden-Pforzheim (died 28 August 1361) was a younger son of Margrave Rudolf IV. In 1348 he succeeded his father in Baden-Pforzheim while his brother Frederick III took Baden-Baden. Emperor Charles IV could not redeem the Ortenau lands held in pledge by his father, so Rudolf kept Ortenburg Castle, Offenburg and Gengenbach, and the emperor also mortgaged him the Strasbourg toll. In 1347 he married Adelaide, daughter of Margrave Rudolf Hesso; the marriage was childless, so in 1356 he made his nephew Rudolf VI his heir. On his death in 1361 Baden-Pforzheim passed to Baden-Baden, reuniting Baden.
zh: 巴登-普福尔茨海姆藩侯鲁道夫五世（1361年8月28日卒）是藩侯鲁道夫四世之子。1348年父亲死后，他继位统治巴登-普福尔茨海姆，兄长腓特烈三世分得巴登-巴登。皇帝查理四世无力赎回鲁道夫之父持有的奥特瑙抵押领地，鲁道夫便保有奥尔滕堡城堡、奥芬堡和根根巴赫，皇帝还把斯特拉斯堡关税抵押给他。1347年他与藩侯鲁道夫·赫索之女阿德尔海德结婚，二人无嗣，遂于1356年立侄子鲁道夫六世为继承人。1361年他去世后，巴登-普福尔茨海姆并入巴登-巴登，巴登重新统一。

en: Rudolf I (1230–19 November 1288), son of Margrave Herman V of Baden, acted as regent for his nephew Margrave Frederick I from 1250 to 1267 and ruled Baden as margrave from 1268 until his death. After his brother Herman VI married into the Austrian ducal family, Rudolf ruled Baden-Baden alone. In 1257 he married Kunigunde of Eberstein; her family bequeathed him half of Eberstein Castle, and he bought the other half in 1283. In 1250 he began building Hohenbaden Castle. He quarrelled with the counts of Württemberg and the bishops of Strasbourg over Rhine tolls, patronized churches and abbeys, and was buried at Lichtenthal Abbey.
zh: 鲁道夫一世（1230—1288年11月19日）是巴登藩侯赫尔曼五世之子，1250至1267年为侄子藩侯腓特烈一世摄政，1268年起亲任巴登藩侯，直至去世。其兄赫尔曼六世入赘奥地利公爵家族后，鲁道夫独掌巴登-巴登。1257年他娶埃伯施泰因的库妮贡德；她的家族将埃伯施泰因城堡的一半遗赠给他，他于1283年购得另一半。1250年他动工兴建霍亨巴登城堡。他为莱茵河通行税与符腾堡伯爵和斯特拉斯堡主教争执，广建教堂与修道院，死后葬于利希滕塔尔修道院。

en: Fakhr al-Dawla Shah-Ghazi was the Baduspanid ustandar of Rustamdar who succeeded his brother Jalal al-Dawla Iskandar in 1360 and ruled until his death in 1379. As a prince he had held Natelrustaq under Iskandar, and as ruler he is chiefly remembered for patronising the scholar Awliya Allah Amuli, who at his request composed the Tarikh-i Ruyan, a chronicle of the Ruyan region and its Baduspanid rulers. He died in 1379 and was succeeded by his son Adud al-Dawla Qubad.
