zh: 法赫尔·道拉·沙阿·加齐是巴杜斯潘王朝统治鲁斯塔姆达尔的乌斯坦达尔，1360年继兄长贾拉勒·道拉·伊斯坎达尔之位，统治至1379年去世。他身为王子时曾受伊斯坎达尔委任管辖纳特尔鲁斯塔克；在位时最知名的事迹是资助学者奥利亚·安拉·阿穆利，后者奉他之命撰写《鲁扬史》，记述鲁扬地区与巴杜斯潘历代君主。他于1379年去世，其子阿杜德·道拉·库巴德继位。

en: Jalal al-Dawla Iskandar was ustandar of the Baduspanids of Rustamdar from 1333 to 1360. A son of Taj al-Dawla Ziyar, he secured his father's accession by murdering their uncle Nasir al-Din Shahriyar, and received Kalarrustaq to rule. Exploiting the Ilkhanate's collapse after 1335, he expanded into the southern Alborz as far as Qazvin and Simnan; in 1344 he and the Bavandid Hasan II destroyed a Sarbadar army and executed its leader Mas'ud. He founded Kojur in 1346 and conquered Daylam. In 1360 his bodyguard fatally wounded him at a drinking party, and his brother Fakhr al-Dawla Shah-Ghazi succeeded him.
zh: 贾拉勒·道拉·伊斯坎达尔是1333至1360年统治鲁斯塔姆达尔的巴杜斯潘王朝乌斯坦达尔，即君主。他是塔季·道拉·齐亚尔之子，因亲手杀死叔父、乌斯坦达尔纳西尔丁·沙赫里亚尔而帮助父亲夺得王位，受封统治卡拉尔鲁斯塔克。他乘1335年后伊利汗国崩溃之机扩张至厄尔布尔士山脉南麓，疆域从加兹温延伸至塞姆南；1344年他与巴文德王朝的哈桑二世联手歼灭萨尔巴达尔军队，处死其首领马斯乌德。1346年他兴建科朱尔城并征服德莱木。1360年他在酒宴上被侍卫刺成致命伤，其弟法赫尔·道拉·沙阿·加齐继位。

en: Taj al-Dawla Ziyar was the Baduspanid ustandar of Rustamdar and Ruyan on the southern Caspian coast from 1325 until his death, and the first of his line to take the title Malik. In 1325 he seized the throne after instigating his son Iskandar to murder his brother, the ruling ustandar Nasir al-Din Shahriyar. When another brother, Izz al-Dawla, challenged him with support from the Ilkhan Abu Sa'id Bahadur Khan, Ziyar defeated him and consolidated his rule over Ruyan. He died at Kavir in 1333, leaving four sons, among them Jalal al-Dawla Iskandar and Fakhr al-Dawla Shah-Ghazi.
zh: 塔季·道莱·齐亚尔是里海南岸巴杜斯潘王朝的鲁斯塔姆达尔与鲁扬的乌斯坦达尔，1325年至去世为止在位，也是家族中第一个采用“马利克”称号的统治者。1325年，他指使儿子伊斯坎达尔谋杀在位的兄长纳西尔丁·沙赫里亚尔，随即夺取王位。另一个兄弟伊兹·道莱在伊利汗阿布·赛义德·巴哈都尔汗支持下起兵争位，被他击败，齐亚尔由此巩固了对鲁扬的统治。他于1333年卒于卡维尔，留下四个儿子，包括贾拉勒·道莱·伊斯坎达尔和法赫尔·道莱·沙赫·加齐。

en: Awang Alak Betatar, who as Sultan Muhammad Shah (died c. 1402) founded the Sultanate of Brunei, was, in Brunei tradition, a son of Dewa Emas Kayangan. Ruling first as raja from Kota Batu with his brothers, including Awang Semaun, he cast off Majapahit overlordship and campaigned against the Melanau lands around Igan and Tutong. In 1363 or 1368 he converted to Islam and took the name Muhammad Shah, becoming Brunei's first sultan, and in 1371 he received a Ming embassy sent by the Hongwu Emperor. He died around 1402.
zh: 阿旺·阿拉克·贝塔塔尔即苏丹马合谟沙（约1402年卒），相传为德瓦·埃马斯·卡扬安之子，是文莱苏丹国的创立者。他最初以拉者身份在哥打巴都与包括阿旺·塞穆恩在内的诸兄弟共同执政，摆脱满者伯夷的宗主权，并出兵攻打伊甘、都东一带的马兰诺人地区。1363或1368年他皈依伊斯兰教，改名马合谟沙，成为文莱第一位苏丹；1371年他接见了明朝洪武帝派来的使团。约1402年他去世。

en: The Brunei epic Syair Awang Semaun presents Awang Semaun as the half-brother of Awang Alak Betatar, founder and first sultan of Brunei, and as one of the fourteen children of Dewa Emas Kayangan by a Murut woman from Limbang and wives in four villages. Tradition places him among the new raja's chief ministers, holding Kota Batu, and he marched with Alak Betatar and the ministers Awang Jeramabak and Pateh Damang Sari against the Melanau stronghold of Igan during Brunei's early conquests. The Malay poem recounting Brunei's founding bears his name.
zh: 文莱史诗《阿旺·塞穆恩叙事诗》把阿旺·塞穆恩称作文莱创立者、第一位苏丹阿旺·阿拉克·贝塔塔尔的异母兄弟，也是德瓦·埃马斯·卡扬安与林梦穆鲁特女子及四个村庄的妻子所生十四兄妹之一。相传他是新拉者的重臣之一，驻守哥打巴都，并在文莱早期扩张中，随阿拉克·贝塔塔尔与大臣阿旺·杰拉马巴克、帕泰·达芒·萨里一同攻打马兰诺人的要塞伊甘。这部讲述文莱建国的马来叙事诗即以他的名字命名。

en: Brunei tradition, preserved in the epic Syair Awang Semaun, names Dewa Emas Kayangan as the father of fourteen siblings, born to a Murut woman from Limbang and to wives in four villages. His sons included Awang Alak Betatar, the first sultan Muhammad Shah, Awang Semaun and Pateh Berbai, later Sultan Ahmad. The tale makes him set out to find tembadau wild cattle for his pregnant wife; after finding the animal he ascended to the sky, where he was called Batara Kala di Kayangan.
zh: 文莱史诗《阿旺·塞穆恩叙事诗》所传的德瓦·埃马斯·卡扬安是十四兄妹之父：这些孩子为他与林梦的一名穆鲁特女子及沿途四个村庄的妻子所生。他的儿子包括文莱第一位苏丹阿旺·阿拉克·贝塔塔尔（马合谟沙）、阿旺·塞穆恩，以及后来成为艾哈迈德苏丹的帕泰·贝尔拜。相传他为满足怀孕妻子的愿望外出寻找坦巴道野牛，找到野牛后便升天而去，在天界被称为巴塔拉·卡拉·迪·卡扬安。

en: Berke Khan (c. 1208–1266) was a son of Jochi and a grandson of Genghis Khan who ruled the Golden Horde from 1257, succeeding Ulaghchi. He was the first Mongol ruler to establish Islam officially in a khanate, and his reign brought the Blue and White Hordes under firm central rule. After his cousin Hulagu sacked Baghdad in 1258, Berke allied with the Egyptian Mamluks against the Ilkhanate and fought Hulagu in the Caucasus. He supported Ariq Böke against Kublai but did not join the fighting, and fell ill and died on campaign near the Kura river in 1266 or 1267.
zh: 别儿哥（约1208—1266）是术赤之子、成吉思汗之孙，1257年继乌剌黑赤统治金帐汗国。他是第一位在汗国正式确立伊斯兰教的蒙古统治者，在位期间将蓝帐与白帐牢固置于中央治下。1258年堂兄弟旭烈兀洗劫巴格达后，别儿哥与埃及马穆鲁克结盟对抗伊儿汗国，并在高加索与旭烈兀交战。他在拖雷家族内战中支持阿里不哥对抗忽必烈，但未直接参战，于1266或1267年在库拉河畔出征途中病逝。

en: Bernt Notke (c. 1440–1509) was the leading late Gothic sculptor and painter of the Baltic region. He may have trained in Flanders before settling in Lübeck in the early 1460s, where he ran a workshop producing altarpieces and painted wood sculpture. His works include the triumphal cross in Lübeck Cathedral (1470–1478), the Aarhus altarpiece inaugurated in 1479, and the Holy Ghost altarpiece in Tallinn finished in 1483. In 1489 his Saint George and the Dragon, commissioned by Sten Sture the Elder after Brunkeberg, was unveiled in Stockholm. He lived in Stockholm in 1491–1497, serving for three years as Sweden's mint master, and died in Lübeck in 1509.
zh: 伯恩特·诺特克（约1440—1509）是波罗的海地区最重要的晚期哥特式雕塑家兼画家。他早年可能在佛兰德学艺，1460年代初定居吕贝克，经营作坊，制作祭坛与彩绘木雕。代表作包括1470至1478年吕贝克主教座堂的凯旋十字架、1479年祝圣的奥胡斯祭坛，以及1483年完成的塔林圣灵教堂祭坛。1489年，老斯滕·斯图雷在布伦克贝格之战后委托他创作的《圣乔治与龙》在斯德哥尔摩揭幕。1491至1497年他居于斯德哥尔摩，其间担任三年瑞典铸币官，1509年在吕贝克去世。

en: Bertrand du Guesclin (c. 1320–1380) was a Breton knight, nicknamed the Eagle of Brittany, who fought for Charles of Blois in the Breton War of Succession, defending Rennes against the English in 1356–1357. He routed an Anglo-Navarrese army at Cocherel in 1364 and was captured at Auray later that year. In 1366 he led free companies from France to Castile to support Henry of Trastámara. Defeated and captured at Nájera in 1367, he was ransomed and helped Henry seize the throne at Montiel in 1369. Appointed constable of France by Charles V in 1370, he avoided pitched battles while reconquering Poitou and Saintonge. He died on campaign at Châteauneuf-de-Randon in 1380 and was buried at Saint-Denis.
zh: 贝特朗·杜·盖克兰（约1320—1380）是布列塔尼骑士，绰号“布列塔尼之鹰”。他在布列塔尼继承战争中为布卢瓦的夏尔效力，1356—1357年坚守雷恩、抵御英军；1364年在科舍雷勒击溃英格兰与纳瓦拉联军，同年在欧赖战役被俘。1366年，他率自由佣兵团从法国赴卡斯蒂利亚，支持特拉斯塔马拉的恩里克。1367年他在纳赫拉战败被俘，获赎后于1369年在蒙铁尔帮助恩里克夺得王位。1370年被查理五世任命为法兰西王室统帅，他力避正面会战，逐步收复普瓦图和圣通日。1380年他在征战中病逝于朗东新堡，葬于圣但尼。

en: Ualgarg Mór Ó Ruairc (died 1346), a son of Domhnall Carrach, ruled the Irish kingdom of West Breifne from 1316. Inaugurated with the backing of Fedlim Ó Conchobair of Connacht, he fought beside him at the Second Battle of Athenry the same year. In 1318 he joined the king of Moylurg in supporting Toirdelbach Ó Conchobair's claim to Connacht, and in 1343 he expelled the occupying Clan Muircheartaigh from Breifne. He was killed in a sudden fight at Calry in 1346. His thirty-year reign restored Ó Ruairc power, and the rival Carrigallen, Dromahair and Carha O'Rourke branches that emerged in the 15th century traced their descent to him.
zh: 瓦尔加格·莫尔·奥鲁克（？—1346）是多姆纳尔·卡拉赫之子，自1316年起统治爱尔兰王国西布雷夫讷。他在康诺特国王费德利姆·奥康纳的支持下即位，同年随其参加第二次阿森赖战役。1318年，他与莫伊勒格国王联手支持托伊尔德尔巴赫·奥康纳争夺康诺特王位；1343年，他将占据布雷夫讷的穆伊尔赫尔塔氏族驱逐出去。1346年，他在卡尔里的一场突发冲突中被杀。他在位约三十年，重振了奥鲁克家族的势力；15世纪出现的卡里加伦、德罗马黑尔和卡哈三个相互争斗的奥鲁克支系都追溯至他。

en: Sohag Deo was an early Baghela raja who ruled from Bandhogarh in Bagelkhand, succeeding Karan Deo. Baghela tradition credits him with founding the town of Sohagpur.
zh: 苏诃格提婆是早期巴格拉王公，在巴格尔坎德的班达迦堡执政，继迦罗德婆之后在位。相传索哈格布尔镇由他建立。

en: Eustace IV (c. 1129–1153) was the eldest son of King Stephen of England and Matilda I of Boulogne, and ruled the County of Boulogne from 1146. After his father took the English throne in 1135, Eustace was heir apparent through the civil war of the Anarchy, in which Empress Matilda also claimed the crown. In 1137 he did homage for Normandy to King Louis VII of France, and in 1140 married Louis's sister Constance; he was knighted in 1147. During the war he demanded contributions from religious houses. He died suddenly on 17 August 1153 while raiding church lands near Bury St Edmunds, clearing the way for Henry Plantagenet's succession, and was buried at Faversham Abbey.
zh: 尤斯塔斯四世（约1129—1153）是英格兰国王斯蒂芬与布洛涅女伯爵玛蒂尔达一世的长子，1146年起统治布洛涅伯国。1135年父亲夺取英格兰王位后，他在“无政府时期”的内战中成为王储，玛蒂尔达皇后也主张王位。1137年他就诺曼底向法兰西国王路易七世宣誓效忠，1140年娶路易七世之妹康斯坦丝，1147年受封骑士。战争期间，他向宗教机构征款。1153年8月17日，他在劫掠贝里圣埃德蒙兹附近的教会土地时暴毙，为亨利·金雀花继位扫清了道路，葬于法弗舍姆修道院。

en: William I of Boulogne, also called William of Blois (c. 1137–1159), was the second son of King Stephen of England and Matilda I of Boulogne. In 1148 he married Isabel de Warenne, Countess of Surrey. In 1153 Stephen agreed to recognize Henry Plantagenet as his heir instead of William's brother Eustace IV. After Eustace died, the Treaty of Wallingford ending the Anarchy left William Boulogne and the lands intended for both brothers. Henry II initially allowed him to retain the earldom of Surrey by right of his wife. William was suspected of knowing of a Flemish plot to kill Henry and fled to Normandy. He died of disease near Toulouse on 11 October 1159, childless, and was buried at Montmorel Abbey; his sister Marie I succeeded him.
zh: 威廉一世（约1137—1159），又称布卢瓦的威廉，是英格兰国王斯蒂芬与布洛涅女伯爵玛蒂尔达一世的次子。1148年他娶第四代萨里女伯爵伊莎贝尔·德·瓦雷纳。1153年斯蒂芬同意承认亨利·金雀花为继承人，而非威廉的兄长尤斯塔斯四世。尤斯塔斯死后，结束“无政府时期”的《沃灵福德条约》将布洛涅和原定由兄弟二人继承的领地留给威廉。亨利二世起初允许他凭妻子的权利保有萨里伯爵领。威廉涉嫌事先知晓佛兰德雇佣兵刺杀国王的阴谋，逃往诺曼底。1159年10月11日他在图卢兹附近染病去世，无嗣，葬于蒙莫雷尔修道院，由姐妹玛丽一世继位。

en: Ida of Boulogne (c. 1160–1216) ruled the county of Boulogne in her own right from 1173, when her father Matthew of Alsace died, until her death. The elder daughter of Matthew and Countess Marie I, she married Gerard of Guelders in 1181, and after his death that same year Duke Berthold IV of Zähringen, who died in 1186. In 1190 Count Reginald I of Dammartin abducted her and carried her to Lorraine; she became his wife and bore him Matilda, the future Countess Matilda II of Boulogne. Ida died in 1216.
zh: 布洛涅的伊达（约1160—1216）自1173年父亲阿尔萨斯的马修去世后，以自身权利统治布洛涅伯国，直至去世。她是马修与女伯爵玛丽一世的长女，1181年嫁给海尔德的格拉尔，丈夫同年去世，后改嫁策林根公爵贝特霍尔德四世，后者于1186年亡故。1190年，当马尔坦伯爵勒纳尔一世将她劫持到洛林，她成为他的妻子，生下女儿玛蒂尔德，即后来的布洛涅女伯爵玛蒂尔德二世。伊达卒于1216年。

en: Marie of Boulogne (1136–1182), also called Mary of Blois, was the youngest daughter of King Stephen of England and Matilda of Boulogne. Dedicated to the Church as a child, she became prioress of Higham and, in the late 1150s, abbess of Romsey. When her brother William died in 1159, she inherited the County of Boulogne. In 1160 Matthew of Alsace removed her from her abbey and married her to claim the county; the Church forced the couple to separate in 1169. She then returned to religious life, leaving two daughters, Ida and Matilda.
zh: 布洛涅的玛丽（1136—1182），又称布卢瓦的玛丽，是英格兰国王斯蒂芬与布洛涅女伯爵玛蒂尔达最小的女儿。她自幼被献入教会，成为海厄姆小修道院院长，1150年代末出任拉姆西修道院院长。1159年其兄威廉去世，她继承布洛涅伯国。1160年，阿尔萨斯的马修将她带离修道院并成婚，借此据有伯国；在教会施压下，两人于1169年分离。她此后重返修道生活，留下两个女儿艾达和玛蒂尔达。

en: Matthew of Alsace (c. 1137–1173) was a younger son of Thierry of Flanders and Sibylla of Anjou. In 1160 Henry II of England arranged his marriage to Mary of Blois, abbess of Romsey and heiress of Boulogne, making him count of Boulogne; because Mary was a nun, he was excommunicated. His father and brother invaded Boulogne and Lens over the marriage; a reconciliation in 1161 left Lens to his father. Henry's refusal to cede Mortain led Matthew to ally with Louis VII of France. Separated from Mary in 1170, he ruled through their daughters Ida and Matilda and married Eleanor of Vermandois in 1171. In 1173 he joined Henry the Young King's revolt and, invading Normandy with his brother Philip of Flanders, was mortally wounded by a crossbow at Driencourt on 25 July.
zh: 阿尔萨斯的马修（约1137—1173）是佛兰德伯爵蒂埃里与安茹的西比拉之幼子。1160年，英格兰国王亨利二世安排他娶了罗姆西修道院女院长、布洛涅女继承人布卢瓦的玛丽，他就此成为布洛涅伯爵；因玛丽是修女，他被开除教籍。父亲和兄长因这桩婚事入侵布洛涅与朗斯，1161年和解后朗斯归其父。亨利拒绝交出莫尔坦，促使马修与法王路易七世结盟。1170年他与玛丽分居，以两个女儿伊达和玛蒂尔达的名义统治，1171年续娶韦芒杜瓦的埃莉诺。1173年他参加幼王亨利的叛乱，与兄长佛兰德伯爵菲利普一世一同入侵诺曼底，7月25日在德朗库尔被弩箭重伤，随后去世。

en: Matilda II of Dammartin (1202–1259) inherited Boulogne (1216) from her mother Ida and Dammartin (1227) from her father Reginald. In 1223 she married Philip Hurepel, son of Philip II of France and her co-ruler until he died in 1234, after which she reigned alone. Her second marriage, to the Portuguese infante Afonso in 1238, made her queen of Portugal when he became Afonso III in 1248 and renounced Boulogne. They had no surviving children, and she reportedly was not allowed to follow him to Portugal. They divorced in 1253. In 1258 she charged Afonso with bigamy before Pope Alexander IV over his marriage to Beatrice of Castile. She died in January 1259.
zh: 达马尔坦的玛蒂尔达二世（1202—1259）于1216年从母亲伊达手中继承布洛涅，1227年从父亲勒诺手中继承达马尔坦。1223年她嫁给法国国王腓力二世之子菲利普·于雷佩尔，他作为共同执政者与她一同统治，直至1234年去世，此后她独自执政。1238年她改嫁葡萄牙王子阿方索，1248年阿方索即位为阿方索三世并放弃布洛涅，她成为葡萄牙王后。两人没有存活的子女，据记载她未获准随丈夫前往葡萄牙。两人于1253年离婚。1258年因阿方索另娶卡斯蒂利亚的比阿特丽斯，她向教皇亚历山大四世控告他重婚。1259年1月她去世。

en: Renaud of Dammartin (c. 1165–1227) was the eldest son of Alberic III of Dammartin and Matilda of Clermont, and a childhood friend of Philip Augustus. In 1191 his father abducted Ida, Countess of Boulogne, and had Renaud marry her, making him count of Boulogne. In 1203 Renaud and Ida granted a charter to the merchants of Boulogne; Philip made him count of Aumale the following year. In 1212, after Philip seized his lands, Renaud allied with King John at Lambeth and joined the 1214 invasion of France. He commanded the Brabançons at Bouvines, where he was captured, and spent the rest of his life chained at Péronne, dying in 1227. His daughter Matilda II inherited Boulogne.
zh: 雷诺·德·达马尔坦（约1165—1227）是阿尔贝里克三世·德·达马尔坦与克莱蒙的玛蒂尔达之长子，与腓力·奥古斯都自幼交好。1191年，父亲绑架布洛涅女伯爵伊达并让雷诺娶她，他因而成为布洛涅伯爵。1203年雷诺与伊达向布洛涅商人颁发特许状，次年腓力封他为欧马勒伯爵。1212年腓力没收其领地后，雷诺在兰贝斯与英格兰国王约翰结盟，加入1214年入侵法国的联军。他在布汶战役中指挥布拉班特人，被俘后一直被锁链锁在佩罗讷，1227年死于狱中。其女玛蒂尔达二世继承了布洛涅伯国。

en: Alγuncha was a Mongol prince descended from Belgutei, Genghis Khan's half-brother, and son of Cherik Temür. The Yuan court made him Prince of Guangning in 1330, a title he held until his death in 1353. His son Temür Buqa succeeded him.
zh: 按浑察是蒙古宗室，为成吉思汗异母弟别勒古台的后裔、彻里帖木儿之子。1330年，元朝封他为广宁王，他保有此爵直至1353年去世，由其子帖木儿不花袭封。

en: Belgutei (c. 1161–c. 1271) was a son of Yesugei and Sochigel and a half-brother of Genghis Khan. In youth he and his brother Begter clashed with Temujin over hunting spoils; after Temujin killed Begter, Belgutei became his loyal follower. He served the future khan as a general and envoy, and once dissuaded him from pursuing a man who had slashed his arm at a banquet, fearing strife. After the Mongol Empire was proclaimed in 1206, he was enfeoffed as prince with three thousand households. Tradition credits him with extraordinary longevity.
zh: 别勒古台（约1161—约1271）是也速该与速赤吉勒之子、成吉思汗铁木真的异母弟。少年时，他与兄长别克帖儿因争夺猎物和铁木真失和；铁木真刺杀别克帖儿后，别勒古台便忠心追随。他担任铁木真的大将与使者，曾在宴会上被人砍伤臂膀，却劝铁木真不要追究凶手，以免挑起不和。1206年蒙古帝国建立后，他受封王爵，领三千户。相传他极为长寿。

en: Cherik Temür was a Mongol prince of the Borjigin clan, a great-grandson of Belgutei and son of Onggiradai. His son Alguncha was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangning in 1330.
zh: 彻里帖木儿是孛儿只斤氏的蒙古宗王，别勒古台的曾孙、翁吉剌台之子。其子按浑察于1330年受封广宁王。

en: Kumun Buqa was a Borjigin prince, the second son of Belgutei and a nephew of Genghis Khan. In 1230 he campaigned with Ögedei Khan against the Jin dynasty, fighting at Luzhou and Fengxiang. In spring 1232 he crossed the Yellow River at Baipo and joined Tolui's army at the Battle of Sanfengshan, where the Mongols destroyed the pick of the Jin forces and captured the Jin general Yila Pu'a. From 1235 he led armies against the Southern Song, taking Zaoyang, Guanghua, Guangzhou and Huangzhou. Chinese literati praised him as a disciplined commander who spared the populace.
zh: 口温不花，孛儿只斤氏，是别勒古台的次子、成吉思汗的侄子。1230年，他随窝阔台汗攻金，战于潞州、凤翔。1232年春，他从白坡渡过黄河，与拖雷会师三峰山；蒙古军在三峰山之战中全歼金军精锐，擒获金将移剌蒲阿。1235年起，他率军攻打南宋，连克枣阳、光化军、光州、黄州。他善于带兵、较少扰民，被汉族士大夫称为蒙古人中的贤者。

en: Onggiradai was a Mongol prince of the Borjigin clan, a son of Kumun Buqa and a grandson of Belgutei, half-brother of Genghis Khan. Yuan imperial genealogies record him as the father of Cherik Temür, who was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangning.
zh: 翁吉剌台（又译甕吉剌歹）是孛儿只斤氏的蒙古宗王，口温不花之子、成吉思汗异母弟别勒古台之孙。元代谱系记载，他是广宁王彻里帖木儿之父。

en: Temür Buqa, son of the Yuan prince Alγuncha, inherited his father's title of Prince of Guangning in 1354 and received a thousand ding of paper currency from Emperor Toghon Temür.
zh: 帖木儿不花是元朝宗室按浑察之子，1354年袭封其父的广宁王爵位，并获元顺帝赐钞一千锭。

en: Bhanji Jethwa was the Jethwa Rajput rana of Ghumli in Saurashtra, the last Jethwa ruler to hold that ancient capital. In 1309 he repulsed an attack on Ghumli by Jam Unad of the Jadeja clan, who had invaded from Sindh. In 1313 Unad's son Jam Barmaniya returned, stormed the city and drove Bhanji out; he fled with his court to Ranpur, and Ghumli was left in ruins. Bardic tradition blamed its fall on the curse of the sati Sone, whose lover Bhanji had killed. His widow Rani Kalabai later retook the lost lands as far as Ranpur.
zh: 班吉·杰特瓦是索拉什特拉古姆利的杰特瓦拉杰普特拉纳，也是最后一位据守这座古都的杰特瓦君主。1309年，他击退了自信德入侵的贾德贾氏族首领贾姆·乌纳德对古姆利的进攻。1313年，乌纳德之子贾姆·巴尔马尼亚卷土重来，攻破城池，班吉出逃，率部退往兰布尔，古姆利沦为废墟。诗人传说将城破归因于萨蒂索妮的诅咒——班吉曾害死她的情郎。他的遗孀卡拉巴伊后来起兵收复失地，兵锋直至兰布尔。

en: Frederick VII was Count of Beichlingen in Thuringia, born before 1301 and dead after 1342 or 1343. The eldest son of Count Henry I of Beichlingen-Lohra, he married Sophie of Weimar-Orlamünde; their son Henry IV held the county until his death in 1386.
zh: 弗里德里希七世是图林根的拜希林根伯爵，生于1301年之前，卒于1342或1343年之后。他是拜希林根-洛拉伯爵亨利一世的长子，娶魏玛-奥拉明德的索菲为妻；其子亨利四世继承伯爵之位，1386年去世。

en: Dinabandhu Malla, also known as Dinu, was the thirty-ninth king of Mallabhum from 1334 to 1345 and is credited with installing an image of Vishnu Vasudeva at Lochanpur.
zh: 迪纳班杜·摩罗又名迪努，1334至1345年在位，是马拉布姆第三十九代国王，相传他在洛钱布尔供奉了一尊毗湿奴·婆苏提婆像。

en: 'Izz al-Din Ahmad al-Bukhti was emir of the Kurdish Bohtan principality, ruling from its new centre at Jazirat ibn Umar, modern Cizre. In 1336 or 1337 his Bohtan tribesmen seized Cizre with the military help of al-Ashraf, the Ayyubid emir of Hisn Kayfa, whose daughter he married. Hisn Kayfa sought to control the city through this alliance, but Bohtan consolidated its rule and developed Cizre. 'Izz al-Din reigned from 1335 to 1362, when the Bohtan rulers still followed Yazidism, and was succeeded by his son Sayf al-Din Isa.
zh: 伊兹丁·艾哈迈德·布赫提是库尔德博赫丹公国的埃米尔，以吉兹雷（贾齐拉特·伊本·欧麦尔）为新的统治中心。1336或1337年，博赫丹部在哈桑凯伊夫的阿尤布埃米尔阿什拉夫出兵相助下夺取吉兹雷，他随后娶阿什拉夫之女为妻。哈桑凯伊夫试图通过这一联盟控制该城，但博赫丹巩固了统治并发展了吉兹雷。伊兹丁于1335至1362年在位，当时博赫丹的统治者仍信奉雅兹迪派，身后由其子赛夫丁·伊萨继位。

en: Engelbert von Dolen was a Baltic German churchman from a vassal family long settled in Livonia. First documented in 1323 as provost of Dorpat cathedral, he was elected bishop of Dorpat that year and won papal confirmation at Avignon in November 1323. In 1326 he mediated between the city of Riga and its cathedral chapter, and in 1336 he crowned King Magnus Eriksson of Sweden. A consistent opponent of the Teutonic Order, he was transferred to the archbishopric of Riga in October 1341. He stayed at the papal court in Avignon, where he died on 3 September 1347.
zh: 恩格尔贝特·冯·多伦是波罗的海德意志教士，出身于久居利沃尼亚的封臣家族。1323年，他首次见于记载，时任多尔帕特座堂主任，同年当选多尔帕特主教，11月在阿维尼翁获得教皇确认。1326年，他在里加城与里加座堂之间调解争端；1336年，他为瑞典国王马格努斯·埃里克松加冕。他一贯与条顿骑士团为敌，1341年10月调任里加大主教，此后留在阿维尼翁教廷，1347年9月3日在当地去世。

en: Shap was the earliest known emir of the Kurdish Suwaydi dynasty, which ruled the Emirate of Çapakçur, later called Bingöl, in eastern Anatolia after the collapse of Ayyubid rule in the region.
zh: 沙普是库尔德人苏韦迪王朝已知最早的埃米尔；阿尤布王朝在当地的势力瓦解后，该王朝统治着安纳托利亚东部的恰帕克丘尔埃米尔国，即后来的宾格尔埃米尔国。

en: Jakob (died 1337), also called Jacques, was bishop of Ösel-Wiek from 1322, when Pope John XXII appointed him at Avignon and Cardinal Bérenger de Frédol consecrated him. A former scholasticus of the Tartu cathedral chapter, he paid 1300 florins for his confirmation, almost as much as the bishops of Riga, Tartu, Tallinn and Courland combined, marking him as perhaps the richest man in Livonia. In 1323 he fixed the bounds of the town territory of Haapsalu with the vassals of Läänemaa, and in 1326 he fell into dispute with the archbishop of Riga. He died at Lübeck in 1337.
zh: 雅各布（？—1337），又名雅克，自1322年起担任厄塞尔-维克主教，当年由教宗约翰二十二世在阿维尼翁任命，并由枢机主教贝朗热·德·弗雷多尔祝圣。他原是塔尔图主教座堂的掌校司铎，为确认任职向教廷缴纳1300弗罗林，几乎相当于里加、塔尔图、塔林和库尔兰四位主教所缴之和，可能是利沃尼亚最富有的人。1323年，他与莱内马的封臣划定哈普萨卢城镇辖地的边界；1326年与里加大主教发生争执。1337年，他在吕贝克去世。

en: Sayf al-Din Abu Abdallah Muhammad, known as Kanz al-Dawla, was emir of the Banu Kanz of Aswan and a son of Shuja al-Din Nasr. In 1316 his maternal uncle Karanbas, ruler of Nubia, proposed him as a Muslim successor, but the Mamluk sultan detained him and sent Barshanbu to take the throne. Released after Karanbas fell, Muhammad travelled south and won Nubian support; Barshanbu was killed in the ensuing struggle in 1317. Muhammad initially deferred the crown to his uncles, but after his uncle Abram arrested him and died shortly afterwards, he was proclaimed king and crowned in 1318. He still claimed the throne in a marriage contract of 1333.
zh: 赛夫丁·阿布·阿卜杜拉·穆罕默德号坎兹·道拉，是阿斯旺巴努-坎兹的埃米尔、舒贾丁·纳斯尔之子。1316年，他的舅父、努比亚统治者克兰巴斯提名他作为穆斯林继承人，但马穆鲁克苏丹扣留了他，派巴尔尚布夺取王位。克兰巴斯失势后，穆罕默德获释南行，赢得努比亚人的支持；巴尔尚布在1317年随后的争斗中被杀。穆罕默德最初为舅父们保留王冠，但舅父阿布拉姆拘捕他后不久便去世，他随即被拥立为王，并于1318年加冕。在1333年的一份婚约中，他仍主张王位。

en: Shuja al-Din Nasr ibn Fakhr al-Din Malik was the father of Kanz al-Dawla, who claimed the Nubian throne through his mother and became king at Dongola in 1317.
zh: 舒贾丁·纳斯尔·本·法赫尔丁·马利克是坎兹·道拉之父；其子凭母系血统主张努比亚王位，1317年在栋古拉称王。

en: Stefan II (died 1345) was bishop of Lebus from 1316, though his position was confirmed by the pope only in 1326 during a long stay at Avignon. A former canon and dean of the Lebus chapter, he saw his episcopal seat at Göritz destroyed by Brandenburg troops in 1326 and sought the protection of the Polish kings Władysław I and Casimir III, whose coronation he attended in 1333. Driven from his diocese in 1339, he became suffragan bishop at Wrocław and sat as a papal commissioner in the Warsaw trial against the Teutonic Order. He died at Wrocław in 1345.
zh: 斯特凡二世（？—1345）自1316年起担任莱布斯主教，但其职位直到1326年他长期逗留阿维尼翁期间才获教宗确认。他原是莱布斯教区的咏礼司铎兼总铎，1326年驻古日察的主教驻地被勃兰登堡军队摧毁，便转而寻求波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫一世和卡齐米日三世的庇护，并出席了1333年卡齐米日三世的加冕礼。1339年他被逐离教区，出任弗罗茨瓦夫辅理主教，还在华沙审判中作为教宗专员审理波兰控告条顿骑士团一案。1345年，他在弗罗茨瓦夫去世。

en: Alidosio Alidosi, known as Alidosio della Massa, founded the Castel del Rio branch of the Alidosi, the dynasty that ruled Imola. He was the first signore of Castel del Rio, then called the Massa di Sant'Ambrogio, a fief granted to his ancestors by Emperor Otto IV in 1209, and he also held the lordship of Osta. In 1304 he served the Florentine Republic as capitano del popolo. He died at Castel del Rio after 1304 and was succeeded by his son Gentile; another son, Guido, carried on the line.
zh: 阿利多西奥·阿利多西，人称阿利多西奥·德拉马萨，是统治伊莫拉的阿利多西家族卡斯泰尔德尔里奥支系的始祖。他是卡斯泰尔德尔里奥的第一任领主——该地当时称圣安布罗焦马萨，1209年由皇帝奥托四世封授给他的先人，他还领有奥斯塔。1304年，他出任佛罗伦萨共和国的人民领袖。1304年后他在卡斯泰尔德尔里奥去世，其子真蒂莱继任领主，另一个儿子圭多延续了这一支系。

en: Amurat della Torre was the eldest son of Guido della Torre, the Guelph lord of Milan from 1302 to 1312, and of Beatrice Guidi di Battifolle. As part of his father's marriage alliances, he married Margherita di Ceva.
zh: 阿穆拉特·德拉·托雷是1302至1312年统治米兰的圭尔夫派僭主圭多·德拉·托雷与贝阿特丽切·圭迪·迪·巴蒂福莱的长子。作为父亲联姻策略的一环，他娶了玛格丽塔·迪·切瓦。

en: Andrea Pepoli (born c. 1294) was a Bolognese noble, a son of the banker Romeo Pepoli and a brother of Signore Taddeo. He married Ricciarda da Camino, daughter of Rizzardo VI da Camino, lord of Treviso, and of Verde della Scala, tying the Pepoli to the Scaliger-led houses of the Veneto. In May 1368 Andrea's wife appeared at the Visconti court in Milan with eighty other ladies in scarlet robes to welcome Lionel of Antwerp before his wedding to Violante Visconti.
zh: 安德烈亚·佩波利（约1294年生）是博洛尼亚贵族，银行家罗梅奥·佩波利之子、领主塔代奥之弟。他娶特雷维索领主里扎尔多六世·达·卡米诺与维尔德·德拉·斯卡拉之女里恰尔达为妻，使佩波利家族与斯卡拉家族主导的威尼托诸望族联姻。1368年5月，他的妻子在米兰的维斯孔蒂宫廷与另外八十名身着猩红礼服的贵妇一起，迎接前来迎娶维奥兰特·维斯孔蒂的安特卫普的莱昂内尔。

en: Bartolomea Samaritani was a Bolognese noblewoman who in 1308 married the banker Taddeo Pepoli, signore of Bologna from 1337. Her brother Bornio Samaritani was one of Taddeo's closest political allies in the Guelph regime that governed the city.
zh: 巴托洛梅娅·萨马里塔尼是博洛尼亚的贵族女子，1308年嫁给银行家塔代奥·佩波利——后者自1337年起为博洛尼亚领主。她的兄弟博尔尼奥·萨马里塔尼是塔代奥在统治该城的圭尔夫派政权中最亲密的政治盟友之一。

en: Bornio Pepoli (born c. 1318) was a Bolognese noble, a son of Signore Taddeo Pepoli and Bartolomea Samaritani, and a brother of the joint lords Giacomo and Giovanni Pepoli.
zh: 博尔尼奥·佩波利（约1318年生）是博洛尼亚贵族，领主塔代奥·佩波利与巴尔托洛梅亚·萨马里塔尼之子，共同领主贾科莫与乔瓦尼·佩波利的兄弟。

en: Bornio Samaritani was a Bolognese politician and diplomat, with a brilliant career in the commune's service, and a leader of the Scacchesi, the Guelph faction around the Pepoli. In 1306 he and the banker Romeo Pepoli led a piazza rising against the moderate Guelph government; it failed and Romeo was briefly imprisoned. In 1308 his sister Bartolomea married Romeo's son Taddeo, binding the two houses. The papal legate Bertrando del Poggetto taxed the city hard and denied it self-government. In December 1332 he jailed Bornio, Taddeo and Brandelisio Gozzadini in the Castel Galliera, and a popular revolt forced him to free them within hours. The legate was driven out in 1334; in May 1336 Bornio sat with Taddeo and Brandelisio on the extraordinary balìa that governed the city, where the three houses ruled unchallenged. His brother-in-law Taddeo became lord of Bologna in 1337.
zh: 博尔尼奥·萨马里塔尼是博洛尼亚政治家、外交家，为公社效力，外交生涯出色，也是以佩波利家族为核心的圭尔夫派系斯卡凯西派的首领之一。1306年，他与银行家罗梅奥·佩波利共同领导广场起义，反抗温和派圭尔夫政府；起义失败，罗梅奥一度下狱。1308年，他的妹妹巴尔托洛梅亚嫁给罗梅奥之子塔代奥，两族结为姻亲。教皇特使贝尔特拉多·德尔·波杰托对城市课税苛重，又剥夺其自治。1332年12月，特使把博尔尼奥、塔代奥和布兰达利西奥·戈扎迪尼囚禁于加列拉城堡，民众暴动迫使他在数小时内放人。1334年特使被逐；1336年5月，博尔尼奥与塔代奥、布兰达利西奥同在治理全城的非常市政委员会任职，三家的统治无人能撼。1337年，他的妹夫塔代奥成为博洛尼亚领主。

en: Brandelisio Gozzadini was chief of the Gozzadini, a leading Guelph house of Bologna, and for years an ally of Taddeo Pepoli against the papal legate. In December 1332 Bertrando del Poggetto invited him to the palace and had him jailed in the Castel Galliera with Taddeo and Bornio Samaritani; a revolt freed them within hours. The legate's later war against the Este drained the city, and in 1334 Brandelisio led the rising that forced him to barricade himself in Galliera until Florentine troops escorted him out of Bologna. He also helped the Pepoli and their Scacchesi drive out the rival Maltraversi. Where Taddeo relied on law, diplomacy and money, Brandelisio relied on force, and their rivalry ended on 7 July 1337: after street fighting he was talked into disarming, then attacked in his own palace and driven out, never to return. A plot of March 1338 to kill Taddeo and hand Bologna to him was crushed.
zh: 布兰达利西奥·戈扎迪尼是博洛尼亚圭尔夫望族戈扎迪尼家族的首领，多年来与塔代奥·佩波利联手对抗教皇特使。1332年12月，特使贝尔特拉多·德尔·波杰托请他入宫，随即把他和塔代奥、博尔尼奥·萨马里塔尼一同关进加列拉城堡，民众暴动在数小时内迫使特使放人。特使随后对埃斯特家族的战争耗尽了城市的资源。1334年，布兰达利西奥领导起义，特使被迫困守加列拉城堡，直到佛罗伦萨军队护送他出城。他还协助佩波利家族及其斯卡凯西派驱逐敌对的马尔特拉韦尔西派。塔代奥靠法律、外交和钱财，布兰达利西奥靠武力，二人的对立终结于1337年7月7日：巷战之后他被劝说解除武装，随即在自己的宅邸遇袭，出逃后再未回城。1338年3月，一场要杀死塔代奥、把博洛尼亚交给他的阴谋被粉碎。

en: Brunissenda Langosco was the daughter of Filippo (Filippone) di Langosco, Count Palatine of Lomello and Guelph signore of Pavia. After the death of his first wife in 1302, she became the second wife of Guido della Torre, Guelph lord of Milan.
zh: 布鲁尼森达·兰戈斯科是洛梅洛宫廷伯爵、帕维亚圭尔夫派领袖菲利波（菲利波内）·迪·兰戈斯科之女。1302年圭多·德拉·托雷的首任妻子去世后，她成为这位米兰圭尔夫派统治者的续弦。

en: Gentile Alidosi was the second signore of Castel del Rio in the Santerno valley, succeeding his father Alidosio della Massa in 1304 as head of the Castel del Rio branch of the Alidosi of Imola.
zh: 真蒂莱·阿利多西是萨泰尔诺河谷卡斯泰尔德尔里奥的第二任领主，1304年继其父阿利多西奥·德拉马萨之位，统领伊莫拉阿利多西家族的卡斯泰尔德尔里奥支系。

en: Ghixia Azzoguidi, daughter of Bliobarigi Azzoguidi, married Giovanni Pepoli, son of Taddeo Pepoli of Bologna, in 1332.
zh: 吉克西娅·阿佐圭迪是布利奥巴里吉·阿佐圭迪之女，1332年嫁给博洛尼亚的塔代奥·佩波利之子乔瓦尼·佩波利。

en: Giacomo Pepoli (c. 1315–1367), third son of Signore Taddeo, was the family's fighter and its man of property. In 1336, after a violent quarrel with Bologna's bishop over a parish, he came back at the head of his men, wrecked the bishop's palace and drove the bishop out. Once his father ruled, he led a campaign in the Ravenna country in 1338, held the Apennine border against the Great Company in 1342 and was knighted by the Dauphin Humbert II in 1345. Freed from his father's authority in 1338, he ran the family estates: he bought Castiglione dei Gatti castle in 1340 and oversaw the family palace begun in 1344. He ruled Bologna jointly with his brother Giovanni from 1347, until on 16 October 1350 they sold the signoria to Giovanni Visconti for 170,000 florins. Accused in 1351 of plotting with Florence, he was jailed in Milan until pardoned in 1354, and died at Forlì on 23 September 1367.
zh: 贾科莫·佩波利（约1315—1367）是领主塔代奥的第三子，家族里能打仗的人，也是管产业的人。1336年，他因一座堂区教堂的任命与博洛尼亚主教大吵一场，随即率人闯回，捣毁主教宫，逼得主教出逃。父亲掌权后，他在1338年率军远征拉文纳一带，1342年据守亚平宁边境，抵御大佣兵团，1345年又被维埃纳王太子翁贝托二世封为骑士。1338年脱离父亲的监护后，他打理家族产业：1340年买下卡斯蒂廖内德加蒂城堡，并经手1344年开工的家族大宅。1347年起他与兄长乔瓦尼共同统治博洛尼亚，1350年10月16日兄弟二人以170,000弗罗林将领主权卖给乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂。1351年他被控与佛罗伦萨密谋，囚于米兰，1354年获赦，1367年9月23日在弗利去世。

en: Giovanna Pepoli (born c. 1322) was a Bolognese noblewoman, a daughter of Signore Taddeo Pepoli and Bartolomea Samaritani, and a sister of the joint lords Giacomo and Giovanni Pepoli.
zh: 乔万娜·佩波利（约1322年生）是博洛尼亚贵族女子，领主塔代奥·佩波利与巴尔托洛梅亚·萨马里塔尼之女，共同领主贾科莫与乔瓦尼·佩波利的姐妹。

en: Giovanni Pepoli (c. 1310–1367), eldest son of Signore Taddeo, was the family's envoy: in 1336 he was sent to the Ferrara conference on the quarrel between Venice and the Scaligers. When Taddeo died in September 1347, Giovanni and his brother Giacomo inherited a signoria already tied to the Visconti, just as the Black Death killed some 40 percent of Bologna's people. Pope Clement VI asked the brothers to back his rector Astorgio di Durfort against Visconti expansion; their answer was lukewarm, and in July 1350 the rector lured Giovanni into a trap at Solarolo and captured him. Freed, he fled to Milan in late August, and the talks there ended on 16 October 1350 with the sale of Bologna to Giovanni Visconti for 170,000 gold florins, the family keeping its castles. Unlike Giacomo, jailed in 1351, Giovanni entered Visconti service and died as their vicar at Pavia on 28 August 1367.
zh: 乔瓦尼·佩波利（约1310—1367）是领主塔代奥的长子，家族的外交使者：1336年他被派往费拉拉，出席调解威尼斯与斯卡拉家族纷争的会议。1347年9月塔代奥去世，乔瓦尼与弟弟贾科莫继承了一个已与维斯孔蒂家族结盟的领主国，黑死病恰在此时袭来，夺走博洛尼亚约四成人口。教皇克雷芒六世要兄弟二人支持教皇辖区长官阿斯托尔焦·迪迪尔福尔，遏制维斯孔蒂的扩张，二人反应冷淡；1350年7月，长官在索拉罗洛设下圈套，俘获了乔瓦尼。获释后他8月底逃往米兰，谈判于1350年10月16日以博洛尼亚卖给乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂告终，价格170,000金弗罗林，家族保留了自己的城堡。1351年贾科莫入狱，乔瓦尼却转而效力维斯孔蒂家族，作为其在帕维亚的代理人于1367年8月28日去世。

en: Giovanni Pepoli (born c. 1290) was a Bolognese banker, a son of Romeo Pepoli and younger brother of Taddeo. Romeo had been the real master of Bologna since 1307, until the rival Maltraversi faction rose and drove the family out on 17 July 1321. The Pepoli found refuge first in Ferrara and then in Romagna. In 1323 the papal legate Bertrando del Poggetto captured Giovanni together with Taddeo, but the brothers escaped. In 1325 Giovanni fought beside the Modenese at Zappolino, where the exiles tried to force their way home; the Modenese crushed Bologna's army, yet the attempt still failed. The Pepoli were readmitted in March 1328, when the legate, hoping to win over the city, let many exiles return.
zh: 乔瓦尼·佩波利（约1290年生）是博洛尼亚银行家，罗梅奥·佩波利之子、塔代奥之弟。罗梅奥自1307年起实际掌控博洛尼亚，直到敌对的马尔特拉韦尔西派起事，于1321年7月17日把全家逐出城。佩波利家族先到费拉拉避难，后转往罗马涅。1323年，教皇特使贝尔特拉多·德尔·波杰托俘获乔瓦尼和塔代奥，兄弟二人后来逃脱。1325年，流亡者试图武力打回博洛尼亚，乔瓦尼随摩德纳人在扎波利诺作战；摩德纳人大败博洛尼亚军队，返城的尝试仍告失败。1328年3月，特使为争取城中民心，允许众多流亡者返回，佩波利家族得以归乡。

en: Guido Alidosi was a son of Alidosio della Massa, the first signore of Castel del Rio and founder of the Castel del Rio line of the Alidosi of Imola, and brother of Gentile, who succeeded their father in 1304.
zh: 圭多·阿利多西是卡斯泰尔德尔里奥第一任领主、伊莫拉阿利多西家族卡斯泰尔德尔里奥支系始祖阿利多西奥·德拉马萨之子，也是1304年继任领主的真蒂莱的兄弟。

en: By Tasso family tradition, Lamoral Torriani, also called Lamorale della Torre, was a son of Guido della Torre, the Guelph lord of Milan. After Guido was driven from Milan in 1311, tradition relates that Lamoral took refuge in 1313 in the Brembana valley near Bergamo, at a place named Monte Tasso for its badgers, where he hunted and was buried at Cornello. Early-modern genealogists claimed him as ancestor of the Tasso family, builders of the Habsburg postal service, who became princes of Thurn und Taxis. The tale first appeared in 1645, and no document records his existence.
zh: 按塔索家族的谱系传说，拉莫拉尔·托里亚尼（又称拉莫拉莱·德拉·托雷）是米兰圭尔夫派僭主圭多·德拉·托雷之子。圭多于1311年被逐出米兰；相传拉莫拉尔于1313年避居贝加莫附近的布伦巴纳河谷，在一处因獾群得名塔索山的地方以狩猎为生，身后葬于科尔内洛。近代早期的谱系学家把他奉为塔索家族的始祖；该家族经营哈布斯堡王朝的邮政，后成为图恩和塔克西斯亲王。这一说法1645年才首次刊印，其生平并无文献可考。

en: Margherita di Ceva was the wife of Amurat della Torre, eldest son of Guido della Torre, the Guelph lord of Milan. Her marriage was one of the alliances Guido arranged for his children after his family returned to Milan in 1302.
zh: 玛格丽塔·迪·切瓦是米兰圭尔夫派僭主圭多·德拉·托雷的长子阿穆拉特·德拉·托雷之妻。1302年家族重返米兰后，圭多为子女安排联姻，这桩婚事便是其中之一。

en: Nanne Pepoli (born c. 1292) was a Bolognese notary, a son of the banker Romeo Pepoli and a younger brother of Signore Taddeo Pepoli. He and his brother Giovanni were trained for the notarial profession while Taddeo studied civil law.
zh: 南内·佩波利（约1292年生）是博洛尼亚公证人，银行家罗梅奥·佩波利之子、领主塔代奥·佩波利之弟。他与兄弟乔瓦尼一同被培养从事公证职业，塔代奥则学习民法。

en: Ricciarda da Camino (born c. 1320) was the daughter of Rizzardo VI da Camino, lord of Treviso, and Verde della Scala, daughter of Alboino I della Scala of Verona. Ricciarda married the Bolognese noble Andrea Pepoli, while her sister Beatrice married Aldobrandino III d'Este. In May 1368 she appeared at the Visconti court in Milan with eighty other ladies in scarlet robes to welcome Lionel of Antwerp before his marriage to Violante Visconti.
zh: 里恰尔达·达·卡米诺（约1320年生）是特雷维索领主里扎尔多六世·达·卡米诺与维尔德·德拉·斯卡拉之女，其母为维罗纳的阿尔博伊诺一世·德拉·斯卡拉之女。里恰尔达嫁给博洛尼亚贵族安德烈亚·佩波利，她的姐妹贝阿特丽切则嫁给阿尔多布兰迪诺三世·德埃斯特。1368年5月，她在米兰的维斯孔蒂宫廷与另外八十名身着猩红礼服的贵妇一起，迎接前来迎娶维奥兰特·维斯孔蒂的安特卫普的莱昂内尔。

en: Romeo Pepoli (c. 1250–1322) was a Bolognese banker whose financial dealings made him the wealthiest private individual in fourteenth-century Italy. After marrying Azzolina Tettalasini in 1280, he placed his children in both Guelph and Ghibelline houses; his daughter Giacoma wed Obizzo III d'Este in 1317. His estates grew from 200 hectares in 1296 to over 2600 by 1315, making him Bologna's greatest landowner and, through the commune's war and finance councils, its de facto signore. A July 1321 revolt drove him into exile, and he died at Avignon in 1322, summoned before Pope John XXII.
zh: 罗梅奥·佩波利（约1250—1322）是博洛尼亚银行家，凭借金融交易成为14世纪意大利最富有的私人。1280年他娶阿佐利娜·泰塔拉西尼为妻，把子女安排进圭尔夫派与吉伯林派家族，女儿贾科马于1317年嫁给奥比佐三世·埃斯特。1296至1315年间，他的地产从约200公顷增至2600多公顷，成为博洛尼亚最大地主，并借公社的战争与财政委员会成为城市的实际领主。1321年7月起义迫使他流亡，他于1322年在阿维尼翁接受教宗若望二十二世传唤期间去世。

en: Romeo Pepoli (born c. 1291) was a Bolognese banker, a son of Romeo Pepoli and Azzolina Tettalasini and a younger brother of Signore Taddeo Pepoli.
zh: 罗梅奥·佩波利（约1291年生）是博洛尼亚银行家，罗梅奥·佩波利与阿佐利娜·泰塔拉西尼之子，领主塔代奥·佩波利之弟。

en: Romeo Pepoli (c. 1314–1339) was a son of Signore Taddeo Pepoli of Bologna and Bartolomea Samaritani. He died of illness on 6 July 1339 and was buried in Bologna's basilica of San Domenico.
zh: 罗梅奥·佩波利（约1314—1339）是博洛尼亚领主塔代奥·佩波利与巴尔托洛梅亚·萨马里塔尼之子。1339年7月6日他病故，葬于博洛尼亚的圣多梅尼科教堂。

en: Bartolomeo Samaritani was a Bolognese citizen whose daughter Bartolomea married Taddeo Pepoli in 1308; Pepoli became signore of Bologna in 1337. His son Bornio was a diplomat of the commune and an ally of the Pepoli.
zh: 巴尔托洛梅奥·萨马里塔尼是博洛尼亚市民，其女巴尔托洛梅亚于1308年嫁给塔代奥·佩波利，后者于1337年成为博洛尼亚僭主。他的儿子博尔尼奥是博洛尼亚公社的外交官、佩波利家族的盟友。

en: Taddeo Pepoli (1285/1290–1347), eldest son of the Bolognese banker Romeo, was a jurist who became the first open signore of Bologna. His civil-law degree of 1320 was marked by such lavish public celebrations that they aroused suspicion, and the family was driven out in 1321. He returned in 1328 under the papal legate, and in 1334 he and his allies helped drive the legate out. After crushing the rival Gozzadini, he had his men occupy the main square without bloodshed on 28 August 1337, and the People's Council named him perpetual conservator and governor. Pope Benedict XII excommunicated him and in 1338 laid Bologna under interdict; Taddeo held out, keeping part of the university at Castel San Pietro, until a settlement in 1340 made him papal vicar. His rule gave Bologna a rare decade of peace at the cost of the commune's independence. He died on 29 September 1347, leaving power to his sons Giacomo and Giovanni.
zh: 塔代奥·佩波利（1285/1290—1347）是博洛尼亚银行家罗梅奥的长子，法学家出身，成为博洛尼亚第一位公开的领主。1320年他获民法学位，庆祝的公开典礼极为铺张，引起了猜疑，1321年家族被逐。1328年他在教皇使节治下返回，1334年又与盟友一道把使节赶出了城。击败对手戈扎迪尼家族后，他于1337年8月28日派人兵不血刃占领主广场，人民会议任命他为终身守护者兼总督。教皇本笃十二世将他绝罚，1338年又对博洛尼亚下达禁令；塔代奥不肯让步，把部分大学留在卡斯泰尔圣彼得罗，直到1340年达成和解，被任命为教皇代理人。他的统治给博洛尼亚带来少有的和平，代价是公社失去独立。1347年9月29日他去世，权力传给儿子贾科莫与乔瓦尼。

en: Francesco Pepoli, called Tarlato (born c. 1293), was a Bolognese banker, a son of Romeo Pepoli and brother of Taddeo. He married Besia Galluzzi, of a family that stood with the Pepoli in exile. When a revolt drove the Pepoli out of Bologna in 1321 they sought refuge in Ferrara and then Romagna, and in those years Tarlato seized a castle in the city's contado to harry the commune. In 1325 the brothers and Testa Gozzadini tried again to force their way home. The Galluzzi and Pepoli had made the castle of Monteveglio rebel, and the fighting there ran on to Zappolino, where the Modenese crushed Bologna's army but the exiles still failed. The Pepoli were readmitted in March 1328.
zh: 弗朗切斯科·佩波利，绰号塔拉托（约1293年生），是博洛尼亚银行家，罗梅奥·佩波利之子、塔代奥之弟。他娶贝西娅·加卢齐为妻，加卢齐家族在佩波利家族流亡期间站在他们一边。1321年起义将佩波利家族逐出博洛尼亚，他们先到费拉拉，后转往罗马涅；流亡期间，塔拉托夺取博洛尼亚辖区内的一座城堡，在乡间牵制公社。1325年，兄弟几人与泰斯塔·戈扎迪尼再度尝试武力返城。加卢齐家族与佩波利家族先已使蒙泰韦廖城堡反叛，战斗由此蔓延到扎波利诺；摩德纳人大败博洛尼亚军队，流亡者仍未得手。1328年3月，佩波利家族获准返回。

en: Zanna Chiara Pepoli (born c. 1320) was a Bolognese noblewoman, a daughter of Signore Taddeo Pepoli and Bartolomea Samaritani, and a sister of the joint lords Giacomo and Giovanni Pepoli.
zh: 赞娜·基娅拉·佩波利（约1320年生）是博洛尼亚贵族女子，领主塔代奥·佩波利与巴尔托洛梅亚·萨马里塔尼之女，共同领主贾科莫与乔瓦尼·佩波利的姐妹。

en: Zanna Pepoli (born c. 1316) was a Bolognese noblewoman, a daughter of Signore Taddeo Pepoli and Bartolomea Samaritani, and a sister of the joint lords Giacomo and Giovanni Pepoli.
zh: 赞娜·佩波利（约1316年生）是博洛尼亚贵族女子，领主塔代奥·佩波利与巴尔托洛梅亚·萨马里塔尼之女，共同领主贾科莫与乔瓦尼·佩波利的姐妹。

en: Zerra Pepoli (c. 1289–?), also spelled Gerra, was a Bolognese banker, son of Romeo Pepoli and younger brother of Taddeo, the man who would make himself lord of Bologna. While Taddeo managed politics, Zerra ran the family's finances and spent its fortune for the Scacchesi, the faction named for the Pepoli arms. Driven out in 1321 and readmitted in 1328, the family was soon back at the centre of power: in May 1336 Zerra sat on the extraordinary balìa that governed the city, and that August he and Taddeo won the rare privilege of entering the communal palace under arms. On 7 July 1337, when the Scacchese militias and the Gozzadini fought in the piazza, the two brothers stepped in to make peace and escorted Brandelisio Gozzadini home. On 28 August Pepoli troops took the piazza, and Taddeo became lord of Bologna.
zh: 泽拉·佩波利（约1289—？），一译格拉，是博洛尼亚银行家，罗梅奥·佩波利之子，也是后来自立为博洛尼亚领主的塔代奥之弟。塔代奥主理政治，泽拉掌管家族财务，并为斯卡凯西派动用家产，这一派系因佩波利家族的盾徽得名。佩波利家族1321年被逐，1328年获准返回，不久重回权力中心：1336年5月，泽拉进入治理全城的非常市政委员会；同年8月，他与塔代奥获准武装进入公社宫，这一特权极为罕见。1337年7月7日，斯卡凯西派民兵与戈扎迪尼家族在广场开战，兄弟二人出面劝和，护送布兰达利西奥·戈扎迪尼回府。8月28日，佩波利家族的军队占领广场，塔代奥成为博洛尼亚领主。

en: Sri Astasura Ratna Bumi Banten, also called Sri Gajah Waktra, was the last raja of the Bedahulu kingdom of ancient Bali, ruling from about 1332 to 1343. Pasung Grigis and Kebo Iwa were famed generals during his reign. His reign ended in 1343, when Gajah Mada's Majapahit expedition conquered Bali and brought native Bedahulu rule to a close.
zh: 斯里·阿斯塔苏拉·拉特纳·布米·万丹，又称斯里·加贾·瓦克特拉，是古代巴厘岛贝达胡卢王国的末代国王，约于1332年至1343年在位。帕松·格里吉斯和克博·伊瓦是他在位时期的名将。1343年，加札·马达率领满者伯夷大军征服巴厘，贝达胡卢的本土统治告终，他的在位也随之结束。

en: Mongondow tradition makes Mokodoludut the first ruler of Bolaang, the maritime kingdom of the Mongondow people of northern Sulawesi. In the thirteenth century the bogani, local warrior chiefs, united and in a bakid council agreed to raise Mokodoludut, a bogani of Molantud, as their king under the title Punu. Local king lists date his reign from 1280 to 1376, with his seat at Dumoga in the Mongondow highlands, naming him king at Manado and ruler of nine territories.
zh: 蒙贡多的口传传统把莫科杜鲁杜特视为北苏拉威西海上王国博朗的开国之君。13世纪，各地方军事首领博加尼联合起来，经巴基德议事会一致推举出身莫兰图德的莫科杜鲁杜特为王，王号称普努。当地王谱把他的在位年代定为1280年至1376年，王庭设在蒙贡多山区的杜莫加，称他在万鸦老为王，统辖九个地区。

en: Fyodor Romanovich was appanage prince of Beloozero from 1339 until his death, the elder son of Roman Mikhailovich. He married Feodosia, a daughter of Ivan Kalita of Moscow, while his younger brother Vasily took the eastern Sugorsky appanage. In 1375 he joined Dmitry Donskoy's campaign against Tver and the siege of the city. In September 1380 he fought in the vanguard regiment at the Battle of Kulikovo and was killed there together with his son Ivan; Beloozero then passed to his nephew Yury Vasilyevich.
zh: 费奥多尔·罗曼诺维奇是别洛奥泽罗的封邑王公，1339年起在位直至去世，为罗曼·米哈伊洛维奇的长子。他娶莫斯科的伊凡·卡利塔之女费奥多西娅为妻，幼弟瓦西里分得东部的苏戈尔斯克封邑。1375年，他参加德米特里·顿斯科伊讨伐特维尔的远征并参与围城。1380年9月，他在库里科沃战役的先锋团中作战，与儿子伊凡一同阵亡；别洛奥泽罗随后由其侄尤里·瓦西里耶维奇继承。

en: Fyodor Mikhailovich (c. 1286–1314) was prince of Beloozero from 1293, succeeding his father Mikhail Glebovich. His mother was a daughter of Prince Fyodor the Black of Yaroslavl. In 1302 he married in the Golden Horde a daughter of a certain Velblasmysh, possibly Ilbasmysh, son of Khan Toqta. In 1314 he took a second wife, a daughter of Dmitry Zhidimirich, thought to be a Novgorod boyar. Most genealogies make him childless.
zh: 费奥多尔·米哈伊洛维奇（约1286—1314）是别洛奥泽罗王公，1293年父亲米哈伊尔·格列博维奇去世后继位；母亲是雅罗斯拉夫尔王公“黑费奥多尔”·罗斯季斯拉维奇的女儿。1302年，他在金帐汗国娶一位名叫韦尔巴斯梅什者之女（可能是脱脱汗之子亦勒巴思迷失）；1314年又娶德米特里·日季米里奇之女，后者可能是诺夫哥罗德的波雅尔。多数家谱认为他没有子嗣。

en: Mikhail Glebovich (1263–1293) was prince of Beloozero, the son of Prince Gleb Vasilkovich and a baptized daughter of the Mongol khan Sartak. In 1277 he campaigned with Khan Mengu-Timur against the Alans of the Caucasus, and in 1278 married a daughter of Prince Fyodor the Black of Yaroslavl. He inherited Beloozero that year, but his cousin Dmitry of Rostov seized it in 1279; he recovered it only in 1286, at the partition of Rostov. In 1293 he went to the Golden Horde to accuse Grand Prince Dmitry before the khan, and died there that summer.
zh: 米哈伊尔·格列布维奇（1263—1293）是别洛奥泽罗王公，别洛奥泽罗与罗斯托夫王公格列布·瓦西里科维奇之子，母亲是蒙古汗撒里答的女儿（受洗名费奥多拉·萨尔塔科夫娜）。1277年，他随忙哥帖木儿汗出征高加索的阿兰人；1278年娶雅罗斯拉夫尔王公“黑费奥多尔”·罗斯季斯拉维奇之女，并在同年继位。1279年，罗斯托夫的堂兄德米特里·鲍里索维奇夺去封邑，他直到1286年罗斯托夫公国瓜分时才收回别洛奥泽罗。1293年，他前往金帐汗国，向汗控告大公德米特里，同年夏在汗国去世。

en: Roman Mikhailovich, nicknamed Romanchuk, was appanage prince of Beloozero from 1314 to about 1339, the younger son of Prince Mikhail Glebovich. He received the principality only in mature age, after the death of his elder brother Fyodor. The chronicles mention him once: in 1339 he and Vasily Davydovich of Yaroslavl travelled to the Golden Horde to complain to Öz Beg Khan of Ivan Kalita of Moscow's encroachments, and he probably perished there. His sons Fyodor and Vasily succeeded to a Beloozero that soon began to split; Fyodor fell at Kulikovo in 1380.
zh: 罗曼·米哈伊洛维奇，绰号罗曼丘克，是别洛奥泽罗的封邑王公，1314年至约1339年在位，为米哈伊尔·格列布维奇王公的幼子。他成年后才在兄长费奥多尔去世后领有该公国。编年史只提到他一次：1339年，他与雅罗斯拉夫尔的瓦西里·达维多维奇同赴金帐汗国，向月即别汗控告莫斯科的伊凡·卡利塔侵夺土地，他很可能就死在汗廷。他的两个儿子费奥多尔和瓦西里继位后，别洛奥泽罗开始分裂，费奥多尔后来于1380年在库里科沃战役中阵亡。

en: Vasily Romanovich, called Sugorsky, was a Rurikid prince of Beloozero and the younger son of Roman Mikhailovich. When his father died in 1339 the Beloozero principality was divided: his elder brother Fyodor kept the western part around Belozersk, while Vasily received the eastern appanage that became the Sugorsky principality, and he founded the Sugorsky line of princes. His son Yury Vasilyevich inherited Belozersk after Fyodor fell at Kulikovo in 1380 and became its last appanage prince.
zh: 瓦西里·罗曼诺维奇，绰号苏戈尔斯基，是别洛奥泽罗的留里克系王公，罗曼·米哈伊洛维奇的幼子。1339年父亲去世后，别洛奥泽罗公国一分为二：兄长费奥多尔保有别洛奥泽尔斯克一带的西部，瓦西里分得东部封邑，即后来的苏戈尔斯克公国，他也成为苏戈尔斯克王公一系的始祖。1380年费奥多尔在库里科沃阵亡后，他的儿子尤里·瓦西里耶维奇继承别洛奥泽尔斯克，成为别洛奥泽罗末代封邑王公。

en: Adela (c. 1067–1137), a daughter of William the Conqueror and Matilda of Flanders, married Count Stephen-Henry of Blois around 1083. She ruled Blois, Chartres and Meaux as regent while her husband campaigned on the First Crusade, and after Stephen fell at Ramla in 1102 continued ruling for her son Theobald until 1107. In 1105 she helped arrange a truce between her brother Henry I of England and Pope Paschal II over lay investiture. From 1107 she governed jointly with Theobald until her retirement. She placed her sons Stephen and Henry at her brother's court; Stephen seized the English crown in 1135. A learned patron of church reform, she retired to Marcigny Priory around 1120 and died there on 8 March 1137.
zh: 阿德拉（约1067—1137）是征服者威廉与佛兰德的玛蒂尔达之女，约1083年嫁给布卢瓦伯爵斯蒂芬-亨利。丈夫参加第一次十字军期间，她以摄政身份统治布卢瓦、沙特尔和莫城；1102年斯蒂芬在拉姆拉战死后，她继续为儿子蒂博执政至1107年。1105年，她帮助兄长英格兰国王亨利一世与教皇帕斯卡尔二世就世俗叙任权争端达成休战。1107年起，她与蒂博共同治理伯国，直至退隐。她把儿子斯蒂芬和亨利托付给兄长的宫廷，其中斯蒂芬于1135年夺取英格兰王位。她博学多才，是教会改革的赞助者，约1120年退隐马尔西尼修道院，1137年3月8日在那里去世。

en: Alix of Brittany (6 June 1243 – 2 August 1288), dame de Pontarcy in her own right, was the eldest daughter of John I, duke of Brittany, and Blanche of Navarre. After a marriage contract of December 1254 she married John I of Châtillon, count of Blois, bringing Pontarcy and Brie-Comte-Robert as her dowry; their daughter was Joan, suo jure countess of Blois. With her husband she founded several religious houses, including La Guiche Abbey near Blois in 1277. Widowed in 1279, she travelled to the Holy Land in 1287 and built two towers at Acre before her death in 1288.
zh: 布列塔尼的阿利克斯（1243年6月6日—1288年8月2日）本身受封蓬塔尔西女领主，是布列塔尼公爵约翰一世与纳瓦拉的布朗什的长女。1254年12月签订婚约后，她嫁给布卢瓦伯爵让一世·德·沙蒂永，以蓬塔尔西和布里孔特罗贝尔作为嫁妆；女儿即布卢瓦女伯爵让娜。她与丈夫创办多处宗教机构，包括1277年在布卢瓦附近建立的拉吉什修道院。1279年守寡后，她于1287年前往圣地，在阿卡修建了两座塔楼，随后于1288年去世。

en: Beatrice of Dampierre (died 1307) was a daughter of Guy of Dampierre, count of Flanders, and Isabelle of Luxembourg. Around 1287 she married Hugh II of Châtillon, count of Blois. Her son Guy I succeeded as count of Blois in 1307.
zh: 当皮埃尔的贝娅特丽克丝（1307年去世）是佛兰德斯伯爵当皮埃尔的居伊与卢森堡的伊莎贝尔之女，约1287年嫁给布卢瓦伯爵于格二世·德·沙蒂永，儿子居伊一世于1307年继位为布卢瓦伯爵。

en: Stephen Henry (c. 1045–1102) was Count of Blois and Chartres from 1089 and a leader of the First Crusade. He commanded a major crusader army, was present at the siege of Nicaea and wrote to his wife Adela about the expedition's progress. He directed the siege of Antioch, but on 2 June 1098 he retreated and persuaded Emperor Alexios I Komnenos to turn back rather than relieve the city. Disgraced and urged on by Adela, daughter of William the Conqueror, he took the cross again in 1101 and reached Jerusalem. In 1102 he fought for Baldwin I at the Second Battle of Ramla, was captured, and executed on 19 May, probably at Ascalon.
zh: 艾蒂安二世（约1045—1102）自1089年起任布卢瓦与沙特尔伯爵，是第一次十字军东征的领袖之一。他指挥一支十字军主力，参加尼西亚围城，并向妻子阿德拉写信讲述远征进展。他主持安条克围城战，却在1098年6月2日临阵撤退，还劝说拜占庭皇帝阿历克塞一世回师、不要救援该城。他颜面尽失，在征服者威廉之女阿德拉的催促下，于1101年再次领取十字，抵达耶路撒冷。1102年，他为鲍德温一世出战第二次拉姆拉战役，兵败被俘，于5月19日被处死，地点可能是阿什凯隆。

en: Odo I (c. 950–996) succeeded his father Theobald the Trickster around 977 as count of Blois, Chartres, Châteaudun and Reims, and was made count palatine by the Carolingian king Lothair. In the 970s he subjugated Rennes during the struggle for control of Brittany. He supported Charles of Lorraine against Hugh Capet in 987, and in June 991 seized Melun before a royal coalition retook it months later. Later he warred on Fulk Nerra of Anjou, with allies from Aquitaine, Flanders and Normandy; while besieging Langeais in the winter of 995–996 he fell ill and died at Marmoutier Abbey near Tours on 12 March 996. By Bertha of Burgundy he fathered his successors Theobald II and Odo II.
zh: 厄德一世（约950—996）约977年继承父亲“欺诈者”蒂博，成为布卢瓦、沙特尔、沙托丹和兰斯伯爵，并被加洛林王朝国王洛泰尔封为行宫伯爵。970年代，他在争夺布列塔尼控制权的战争中征服了雷恩。他987年支持洛林的查理对抗于格·卡佩，991年6月夺取默伦，数月后被王室联军夺回。后来他与阿基坦、佛兰德和诺曼底的盟友共同对抗安茹的富尔克·内拉，995年至996年冬围攻朗盖时染病，996年3月12日卒于图尔附近的马尔穆捷修道院。他与勃艮第的贝尔特生下继承人蒂博二世和厄德二世。

en: Guy I of Châtillon (c. 1298–1342) succeeded his father Hugh II in 1307 as count of Blois, Dunois and Fréteval and lord of Avesnes. In 1310 he married Margaret of Valois, sister of the future Philip VI, which tied his house to the Valois. Their children were Louis II, Marie, and Charles of Blois, who would later fight the Montfort party and the English in the Breton War of Succession. Guy campaigned with Louis X against the Flemings in 1315 and ceded his coinage rights to Philip VI in 1328. He became lord of Château-Renault in 1332 and obtained a general exemption from war taxes for his subjects. From 1336 he backed the French crown against Edward III as the Hundred Years' War began. He died on 12 August 1342 and was buried beside his wife at La Guiche Abbey near Blois.
zh: 居伊一世·德·沙蒂永（约1298—1342）1307年继承父亲于格二世，成为布卢瓦、迪努瓦和弗雷特勒瓦尔伯爵及阿韦讷领主。1310年他娶后来的腓力六世之妹瓦卢瓦的玛格丽特，使家族与瓦卢瓦王室结成姻亲。子女有路易二世、玛丽，以及日后在布列塔尼继承战争中同蒙福尔一派和英格兰人作战的布卢瓦的夏尔。1315年他随路易十世出征佛兰德，1328年把铸币权让予腓力六世。1332年他成为沙托雷诺领主，并为臣民争取到战争税的普遍豁免。1336年起，他在百年战争伊始支持法兰西王室对抗爱德华三世。1342年8月12日他去世，与妻子合葬于布卢瓦附近的拉吉什修道院。

en: Hugh I of Châtillon (c. 1198–1248), son of Walter III of Châtillon and Elisabeth, heiress of Saint-Pol, became count of Saint-Pol in 1226. His first wife was Agnes of Bar, whom he married in 1216. In 1226 he married Marie of Avesnes, heiress of the old line of Blois counts, and ruled Blois jure uxoris from 1230 until 1241, founding the Châtillon dynasty there. He founded Cistercian nunneries at Pont-aux-Dames (1226) and L'Amour-Dieu in Troissy (1232). His sons included John I, his successor in Blois, and Guy III of Saint-Pol. After Marie's death he married Mahaut of Guînes. He planned to join Louis IX's Seventh Crusade but died on 9 April 1248.
zh: 于格一世·德·沙蒂永（约1198—1248）是沙蒂永的戈谢三世与圣波勒女继承人伊丽莎白之子，1226年成为圣波勒伯爵。他于1216年娶第一任妻子巴尔的阿涅丝。1226年，他娶布卢瓦旧朝伯爵世系的女继承人、阿韦讷的玛丽为妻，1230年至1241年妻权统治布卢瓦伯国，开创沙蒂永王朝。他于1226年创建蓬托达姆西多会女修院，1232年又在特鲁瓦西创建“天主之爱”女修院。其子包括布卢瓦继承人让一世和圣波勒的居伊三世。玛丽去世后，他娶吉讷的玛奥。他本打算参加路易九世的第七次十字军，却于1248年4月9日去世。

en: Hugh II of Châtillon (9 April 1258–1307) was the son of Guy III, count of Saint-Pol, and Matilda of Brabant. On his father's death in 1289 he succeeded as count of Saint-Pol, but in 1292 he inherited the county of Blois from his cousin Joan, who had died without issue, and surrendered Saint-Pol to his younger brother Guy. He ruled Blois until his death in 1307 and was buried at La Guiche Abbey near Blois. Around 1287 he married Beatrice of Dampierre, daughter of Guy of Flanders; their son Guy I succeeded them.
zh: 于格二世·德·沙蒂永（1258年4月9日—1307）是圣波勒伯爵居伊三世与布拉班特的玛蒂尔德之子。1289年父亲去世后，他继位为圣波勒伯爵；1292年堂姐让娜无嗣而终，他继承布卢瓦伯国，随即将圣波勒让给弟弟居伊四世。他统治布卢瓦直至1307年去世，葬于布卢瓦附近的拉吉什修道院。约1287年，他娶佛兰德斯伯爵居伊之女、当皮埃尔的贝娅特丽克丝为妻，儿子居伊一世后来继位。

en: John I of Châtillon (c. 1225–1279) inherited Blois and Dunois from his mother Marie of Avesnes in 1241 and the lordships of Avesnes and Guise from his father Hugh I in 1248. In 1254 he married Alix of Brittany, and in 1256 the will of his cousin Matilda of Amboise reunited the County of Chartres with Blois. In 1260 he granted the parish of Chouzy the right to hold a ball game at Whitsun. Louis IX named him lieutenant general of France in 1270, and in 1273 he founded the Dominican convent of Blois and the abbey of La Guiche. His daughter Joan married Peter of France, count of Alençon. He passed his lands to her before his death at Chambord in 1279.
zh: 让一世·德·沙蒂永（约1225—1279）1241年从母亲阿韦讷的玛丽处继承布卢瓦和迪努瓦，1248年又从父亲于格一世处继承阿韦讷和吉兹领地。1254年他娶布列塔尼的阿莉克斯为妻；1256年，依堂姊昂布瓦斯的玛蒂尔德遗嘱，沙特尔伯国重新并入布卢瓦。1260年，他赋予舒济教区在圣灵降临节举办球赛的权利。1270年法王路易九世任命他为法兰西副将；1273年他创建布卢瓦多明我会修道院和拉吉什修道院。他的女儿让娜嫁给阿朗松伯爵、法兰西的皮埃尔。1279年他卒于尚博尔，生前已将领地传给女儿。

en: Jeanne de Beaumont, also called Jeanne of Hainault (1323–1350), was ruling countess of Soissons from 1344, the daughter of John of Beaumont of the House of Avesnes and Margaret of Soissons. In 1340 she married Louis of Châtillon, heir to the County of Blois; her three sons Louis, John and Guy all later became counts of Blois, and Louis and Guy also held Soissons. Louis was killed at Crécy in 1346, after which Jeanne remarried William I, Marquis of Namur; they had no children. She ruled Soissons until her death in December 1350, when she died of the Black Death.
zh: 让娜·德·博蒙特，又称埃诺的让娜（1323—1350），1344年起为在任的苏瓦松女伯爵，是阿韦讷家族博蒙特领主约翰与苏瓦松的玛格丽特之女。1340年，她嫁给布卢瓦伯国的继承人沙蒂永的路易；三个儿子路易、约翰和居伊后来都成为布卢瓦伯爵，路易和居伊还拥有苏瓦松伯爵头衔。1346年路易在克雷西战死后，让娜改嫁那慕尔侯爵威廉一世，二人没有生育。她统治苏瓦松直至1350年12月死于黑死病。

en: Joan of Châtillon (c. 1253–1292) was countess of Blois, Chartres and Châteaudun, the daughter of Count John I of Blois and Alix of Brittany. Betrothed in 1263 and married in 1272 to Peter of Alençon, fifth son of King Louis IX, she was widowed in 1283 with no surviving children. In 1286 she sold the county of Chartres to Philip IV of France. She is remembered for benefactions to monasteries and hospitals and for opening hunting in the county to all inhabitants. She died at Blois on 29 January 1292, leaving Blois to her cousin Hugh II of Châtillon.
zh: 布卢瓦-沙蒂永的让娜（约1253—1292）是布卢瓦、沙特尔和沙托丹女伯爵，为布卢瓦伯爵让一世与布列塔尼的阿利克斯之女。1263年她被许配给法兰西国王路易九世的第五子阿朗松伯爵皮埃尔，1272年成婚，1283年守寡，子女均早夭。1286年，她把沙特尔伯国卖给法兰西国王腓力四世。她以向修道院和医院慷慨捐赠闻名，并开放伯国狩猎权，允许所有居民狩猎。1292年1月29日她在布卢瓦去世，布卢瓦由堂兄于格二世·德·沙蒂永继承。

en: Louis I of Blois (1172–1205), son of Theobald V and Alix of France, was count from 1191 and joined his father's Third Crusade as a teenager. He married Catherine, Countess of Clermont, and their son Theobald VI succeeded him. In 1196 he freed his serfs. At Écry on 28 November 1199 he and his cousin Theobald III of Champagne became the first nobles to take the cross for the Fourth Crusade. He commanded a division at Constantinople in 1203, but fever kept him from its 1204 sack, and he never occupied the Nicaean duchy granted him. Pursuing Kaloyan's Cumans too far at Adrianople, he was killed on 14 April 1205.
zh: 路易一世（1172—1205）是蒂博五世与法兰西的艾莉克丝之子，1191年继位为布卢瓦伯爵，少年时随父参加第三次十字军东征。他娶克莱蒙伯爵夫人卡特琳娜，其子蒂博六世继承了他的爵位。1196年，他解放了自己的农奴。1199年11月28日，在埃克里比武大会上，他与表兄香槟伯爵蒂博三世率先领取十字，发起第四次十字军东征。1203年他在君士坦丁堡之围中指挥一个分队，却因热病错过1204年破城，受封的尼西亚公爵领也始终未能实际领有。阿德里安堡一役中，他追击卡洛扬的库曼人过远，于1205年4月14日战死。

en: Louis of Châtillon, numbered Louis I of Blois-Châtillon, was the eldest son of Count Guy I of Blois and Margaret of Valois, sister of King Philip VI. In 1340 he married Jeanne of Avesnes, Countess of Soissons, and from 1342 he ruled Blois and Dunois, holding Soissons through his wife. When the Breton succession war broke out in 1341, he backed his brother Charles of Blois as one of his chief lieutenants and helped take Rennes on 15 April 1342. He was killed at the Battle of Crécy on 26 August 1346.
zh: 沙蒂永的路易，即路易一世·德·布卢瓦-沙蒂永，是布卢瓦伯爵居伊一世与法王腓力六世之姊瓦卢瓦的玛格丽特的长子。1340年，他娶苏瓦松女伯爵阿韦讷的让娜为妻，1342年起统治布卢瓦和迪努瓦，并以妻子的权利领有苏瓦松。1341年布列塔尼继承战争爆发后，他作为弟弟布卢瓦的夏尔的主要副手之一支持其诉求，并于1342年4月15日协助攻下雷恩。1346年8月26日，他在克雷西战役中阵亡。

en: Margaret of Blois (1170–1230) was the daughter of Count Theobald V of Blois and Alix of France. She married first Hugh III of Oisy, viscount of Cambrai, and after his death in 1190 Otto I of Hohenstaufen, count of Burgundy. Widowed in 1200, she ruled Burgundy as regent for her daughters until 1208; Joan I and Beatrice II both succeeded as countesses. Her third husband was Walter II of Avesnes. In 1218 her nephew Theobald VI died and she became suo jure countess of Blois and Châteaudun, succeeded on her death in 1230 by her daughter Mary.
zh: 布卢瓦的玛格丽特（1170—1230）是布卢瓦伯爵蒂博五世与法兰西的阿利克斯之女。她先嫁康布雷子爵于格三世·德瓦西；1190年于格死后改嫁勃艮第伯爵、霍亨斯陶芬家族的奥托一世。1200年奥托去世，她以摄政身份为女儿们治理勃艮第伯国直至1208年；两个女儿让娜一世与贝娅特丽克丝二世后来都继位为勃艮第女伯爵。她的第三任丈夫是阿韦讷的戈蒂埃二世。1218年侄子蒂博六世去世，她袭封布卢瓦与沙托丹女伯爵。她死后布卢瓦伯国由女儿玛丽继承。

en: Margaret of Valois (1295–1342) was a French princess of the Valois line, daughter of Charles, Count of Valois, and Margaret of Anjou, and elder sister of King Philip VI. On 18 July 1311 at Senlis she married Guy I de Châtillon, Count of Blois, tying the Blois comital house to the Valois branch of the French royal family. Her three children were Louis, who succeeded as Count of Blois and fell at Crécy in 1346, Charles of Blois, duke of Brittany and a beatified leader in the Breton succession war, and Marie, who married Rudolf, Duke of Lorraine.
zh: 瓦卢瓦的玛格丽特（1295—1342）是法国瓦卢瓦王族的公主，瓦卢瓦伯爵查理与安茹的玛格丽特之女，法王腓力六世的姐姐。1311年7月18日，她在桑利斯嫁给布卢瓦伯爵居伊一世·德·沙蒂永，使布卢瓦伯爵家族与法国王室的瓦卢瓦支系联姻。她生有三个子女：路易，后继任布卢瓦伯爵，1346年战死于克雷西；布卢瓦的夏尔，在布列塔尼继承战争中成为布列塔尼公爵，身后被列为真福；女儿玛丽，则嫁给洛林公爵拉乌尔。

en: Mary of Avesnes (c. 1200–1241), countess of Blois, was the only child of Walter II d'Avesnes and Margaret of Blois. In 1225 she married Hugh I of Châtillon; in 1226 the couple founded the Cistercian nunnery of Pont-aux-Dames at Couilly, where both were later buried. On her mother's death in 1230 she inherited the County of Blois, holding also Avesnes, Bohain and Guise as her parents' sole heiress; Hugh ruled Blois at her side. She died in 1241 leaving five children, and Blois passed to her eldest son John I. Her son Guy became count of Saint-Pol.
zh: 阿韦讷的玛丽（约1200—1241）是布卢瓦女伯爵，戈蒂埃二世·德阿韦讷与布卢瓦的玛格丽特的独女。1225年，她嫁给于格一世·德沙蒂永；1226年，夫妇在库伊创立西多会的蓬托达姆修女院，两人后来都安葬于此。1230年母亲去世后，她继承布卢瓦伯国，并作为父母唯一继承人领有阿韦讷、布安和吉斯；于格在她身边共治布卢瓦。她于1241年去世，留下五个子女，布卢瓦传给长子让一世，儿子居伊成为圣波勒伯爵。

en: Theobald I, called the Trickster, was the son of Theobald the Elder and founder of the comital House of Blois. Around 940 he became count of Blois, Tours, Chartres and Châteaudun, the chief lieutenant of Hugh the Great, duke of the Franks. About 944 he married Luitgarde of Vermandois, widow of William Longsword of Normandy, and in 945 held the captured King Louis IV in his custody. After Hugh's death in 956, Theobald exercised a near regency in Neustria during the minority of Hugh Capet. From 960 he warred on the Normans, attacking Évreux and Rouen, until they burned Chartres and killed his eldest son in 962. Hugh Capet disapproved of the war, and Theobald sought the support of the Carolingian king Lothair. By his death around 977 he ruled a vast Loire principality.
zh: 蒂博一世，绰号“欺诈者”，是图尔子爵蒂博·老大人之子，也是布卢瓦伯爵家族的奠基者。约940年，他作为法兰克人公爵于格大帝最得力的封臣，成为布卢瓦、图尔、沙特尔和沙托丹伯爵。约944年，他娶诺曼底的威廉·长剑的遗孀韦尔芒杜瓦的留特加德为妻；945年，被俘的国王路易四世曾交由他看管。956年于格大帝去世后，蒂博在于格·卡佩未成年时近乎摄政，掌管纽斯特里亚。960年起他与诺曼人长期交战，先后攻打埃夫勒和鲁昂，962年诺曼人焚毁沙特尔并杀死他的长子。于格·卡佩反对这场战争，蒂博转而寻求加洛林王朝国王洛泰尔的支持。到约977年去世时，他已在卢瓦尔河流域建立起幅员辽阔的领地。

en: Theobald II (c. 983–1004) was the eldest son of Count Odo I of Blois and Bertha of Burgundy. When his father died in 996 he succeeded as count of Blois, Châteaudun, Chartres, Provins and Reims, ruling under the regency of his mother, who had married King Robert II of France as her second husband; Robert retook Tours from Fulk III of Anjou. Theobald died of exhaustion on his way back from Rome on 11 July 1004, leaving no heir. His lands passed to his younger brother Odo II.
zh: 布卢瓦的蒂博二世（约983—1004）是布卢瓦伯爵奥多一世与勃艮第的伯莎的长子。996年父亲去世后，他继位为布卢瓦、沙托丹、沙特尔、普罗万和兰斯伯爵，由母亲摄政；伯莎改嫁法兰西国王罗贝尔二世，罗贝尔从安茹的富尔克三世手中收复了图尔。1004年7月11日，蒂博在从罗马返回途中力竭而亡，没有子嗣，领地由弟弟奥多二世继承。

en: Theobald V the Good (1130–1191) was Count of Blois and Chartres from 1151, second son of Theobald the Great and Matilda of Carinthia; his elder brother Henry took Champagne. His first marriage, to Sybil of Chateaurenault, made him lord of that place. In 1164 he married Alix of France, daughter of Louis VII and Eleanor of Aquitaine, who bore his heir Louis I. In 1171 he staged the first blood-libel trial in continental Europe, burning thirty Jews. He lived at Chartres and renewed its walls. After opposing the young Philip II he reconciled with him, joined the Third Crusade in 1190, and died at the siege of Acre on 20 January 1191.
zh: 蒂博五世，绰号“好人”（1130—1191），1151年起任布卢瓦与沙特尔伯爵，是蒂博四世（大帝）与卡林西亚的玛蒂尔达的次子，其兄亨利继承香槟。他初娶沙托勒诺的西比勒，因婚姻成为当地领主。1164年，他娶路易七世与阿基坦的埃莉诺之女、法兰西的艾莉克丝，生下继承人路易一世。1171年，他制造了欧洲大陆第一起血祭诽谤审判，将三十名犹太人烧死。他常住沙特尔并修缮城墙。他曾与年轻的腓力二世为敌，后与之和解，1190年参加第三次十字军东征，1191年1月20日死于阿卡围城战。

en: Theobald VI, called the Younger, was count of Blois, Chartres and Clermont-en-Beauvaisis from 1205, the son of Count Louis I of Blois and Catherine of Clermont. Before 1213 he married Matilda, daughter of Robert of Alençon; his second wife was Clemence, daughter of William des Roches, seneschal of Anjou. He campaigned against the Muslims in Spain, where he contracted leprosy, and afterwards lived withdrawn in his castle at La Ferté-Villeneuil. A patron of Chartres Cathedral, he also built the great hall of the castle of Blois. He died childless in April 1218, leaving Blois to his aunt Margaret and Chartres to his aunt Isabelle, while Clermont was sold to the French crown.
zh: 蒂博六世，绰号“年轻者”，1205年起为布卢瓦、沙特尔和克莱蒙-昂博韦西伯爵，是路易一世·德·布卢瓦与卡特琳·德·克莱蒙之子。1213年以前，他娶阿朗松的罗贝尔之女玛蒂尔德；第二任妻子是安茹总管纪尧姆·德罗什之女克莱芒丝。他曾赴西班牙与穆斯林作战，在那里染上麻风病，回国后隐居于拉费泰-维勒讷伊城堡。他资助沙特尔大教堂，并主持修建布卢瓦城堡的大厅。1218年4月他无嗣而终，布卢瓦传给姑母玛格丽特，沙特尔传给姑母伊莎贝尔，克莱蒙则被卖给法兰西王室。

en: Withego II of Colditz (died 26 July 1342), born into the noble Colditz family, was bishop of Meissen from 1312 until his death. A nephew of the preceding bishop Albert III of Leisnig, he had been a canon of Meissen Cathedral and provost of St Mary's at Wurzen. As bishop he enlarged the diocese's lands, purchasing the town of Nossen in 1335 and acquiring the lordship of Liebethal from the king of Bohemia in 1336, and strengthened his jurisdiction over the cathedral chapter by establishing the officialate.
zh: 维特戈二世·冯·科尔迪茨（1342年7月26日卒）出身科尔迪茨贵族家族，1312年起任迈森主教，直至去世。他是前任主教阿尔布雷希特三世·冯·莱斯尼希的外甥，此前曾任迈森主教座堂法政牧师和武尔岑圣母堂教长。任内他扩大教区领地，1335年买下诺森城，1336年从波希米亚国王手中取得利伯塔尔领地，并设立主管教会司法的代牧官署，强化了主教对座堂圣职团的权力。

en: Adelheid of Anhalt-Bernburg (born c. 1337) was a daughter of Prince Bernhard III of Anhalt-Bernburg and Agnes of Saxe-Wittenberg.
zh: 安哈尔特-贝恩堡的阿德莱德（约1337年生）是安哈尔特-贝恩堡亲王伯恩哈德三世与萨克森-维滕贝格的阿格内丝之女。

en: Agnes of Saxe-Wittenberg (c. 1310 – 4 January 1338) was an Ascanian princess, the daughter of Elector Rudolph I of Saxony and his first wife Jutta of Brandenburg, and a granddaughter of Agnes of Habsburg. On 8 May 1328 she married Bernhard III of Anhalt-Bernburg, becoming his first wife. Their children included the future princes Bernhard IV and Henry IV.
zh: 萨克森-维滕贝格的阿格内丝（约1310—1338年1月4日）是阿斯坎尼家族的公主，萨克森选帝侯鲁道夫一世与第一任妻子勃兰登堡的尤塔之女，也是哈布斯堡的阿格内丝的孙女。1328年5月8日，她嫁给安哈尔特-贝恩堡亲王伯恩哈德三世，成为他的第一任妻子。他们的子女包括后来的亲王伯恩哈德四世与亨利四世。

en: Bernhard I (c. 1218–1287) was a prince of the House of Ascania and the second son of Henry I, prince of Anhalt, by Irmgard, daughter of Landgrave Hermann I of Thuringia. On Henry's death in 1252 the surviving brothers divided Anhalt under the house law, and Bernhard received Bernburg, founding the Anhalt-Bernburg line. On 3 February 1258, in Hamburg, he married Sophie, daughter of King Abel of Denmark. Their sons included John I, who succeeded him, Albert, bishop of Halberstadt, and Bernhard II.
zh: 伯恩哈德一世（约1218—1287）是阿斯坎尼家族的王公，安哈尔特亲王亨利一世与图林根领地伯爵赫尔曼一世之女伊尔姆加德的次子。1252年父亲去世后，在世的兄弟们依家族家规瓜分安哈尔特，伯恩哈德分得贝恩堡，开创安哈尔特-贝恩堡支系。1258年2月3日，他在汉堡迎娶丹麦国王阿贝尔之女索菲。诸子中有继位的约翰一世、哈尔伯施塔特主教阿尔布雷希特以及伯恩哈德二世。

en: Bernhard II (c. 1260–after 1323) was the third son of Bernhard I of Anhalt-Bernburg and Sophie, daughter of King Abel of Denmark. He succeeded in 1287 and ruled jointly with his elder brother John I until John died in 1291, then reigned alone. In 1300 he took the title count of Bernburg, and when the Anhalt-Aschersleben line died out in 1315 he inherited its princely title, though the bishopric of Halberstadt took the lands in payment of the late Prince Otto's debts. At Frankfurt in 1320 he was made count palatine of Saxony and count of Brehna. In 1302 he married Helene of Rügen; their son Bernhard III succeeded.
zh: 伯恩哈德二世（约1260—1323年后）是安哈尔特-贝恩堡的伯恩哈德一世与丹麦国王阿贝尔之女索菲的第三子。1287年继位后，他与兄长约翰一世共治；1291年约翰去世，他成为唯一统治者。1300年他采用贝恩堡伯爵头衔，1315年安哈尔特-阿舍斯莱本支系绝嗣，他承袭其亲王头衔，但领地被哈尔伯施塔特主教区收取，以抵偿已故奥托亲王的债务。1320年，他在美因河畔法兰克福受封萨克森行宫伯爵与布雷纳伯爵。1302年他娶吕根的海伦，儿子伯恩哈德三世继位。

en: Bernhard III (died 20 August 1348) was a German prince of the House of Ascania who ruled Anhalt-Bernburg from 1323, when he succeeded his father Bernhard II. His two younger brothers renounced their claims to enter the Church, leaving him sole ruler, and he also styled himself Count of Askanien and Lord of Bernburg. In 1328 he married Agnes, daughter of Elector Rudolph I of Saxony, who bore him five children, including his successors Bernhard IV and Henry IV; after her death in 1338 he married twice more. Bernhard died in 1348.
zh: 伯恩哈德三世（1348年8月20日卒）是阿斯坎尼家族的德意志王公，1323年继承父亲伯恩哈德二世，统治安哈尔特-贝恩堡。他的两个弟弟放弃继承权进入教会，他因而成为唯一统治者，并自称阿斯卡尼亚伯爵与贝恩堡领主。1328年，他娶萨克森选帝侯鲁道夫一世之女阿格内丝为妻；阿格内丝1338年去世前为他生下五个子女，包括继承人伯恩哈德四世与亨利四世，此后他又两次结婚。伯恩哈德于1348年去世。

en: Bernhard IV (died 28 June 1354) was a German prince of the House of Ascania and ruler of Anhalt-Bernburg. The eldest son of Bernhard III and Agnes of Saxe-Wittenberg, he succeeded his father as sole ruler in 1348, bypassing his younger brothers Henry and Otto. He also styled himself Margrave of Landsberg, although the Wettins had bought the margraviate back in 1347. Betrothed to Beatrix, daughter of Margrave Frederick II of Meissen, but never married, he died without issue in 1354 and was succeeded by his brother Henry.
zh: 伯恩哈德四世（1354年6月28日卒）是阿斯坎尼家族的德意志王公，安哈尔特-贝恩堡的统治者。他是伯恩哈德三世与萨克森-维滕贝格的阿格内丝的长子，1348年作为唯一继承人继位，绕开了弟弟亨利与奥托的权利。他还自称兰茨贝格藩侯，尽管该藩侯国已于1347年被韦廷家族购回。他与迈森藩侯腓特烈二世之女贝阿特丽克丝订有婚约却终未成婚，1354年无嗣而终，由弟弟亨利继位。

en: Henry IV (died 7 July 1374) was a German prince of the House of Ascania who ruled Anhalt-Bernburg from 1354. The second son of Bernhard III and Agnes of Saxe-Wittenberg, he was at first bypassed in the succession by his elder brother Bernhard IV, and only took power when Bernhard died without issue. He also styled himself Lord of Bernburg. By his wife Sophie, possibly of the Stolberg family, he left three children, including his son Bernhard V and Rudolf, later bishop of Halberstadt. On his death in 1374 he was succeeded by his half-brother Otto.
zh: 海因里希四世（1374年7月7日卒）是阿斯坎尼家族的德意志王公，1354年起统治安哈尔特-贝恩堡。他是伯恩哈德三世与萨克森-维滕贝格的阿格内丝的次子，起初在继承中被兄长伯恩哈德四世越过，直到伯恩哈德无嗣而死才掌权，他还自称贝恩堡领主。妻子索菲娅可能出身施托尔贝格家族，两人留有三个子女，包括儿子伯恩哈德五世和后来出任哈尔伯施塔特主教的鲁道夫。1374年他去世后，继位的是他的异母弟奥托。

en: Helena of Rügen (c. 1270/1272 – 9 August 1315) was the daughter of Wizlaw II, Prince of Rügen, and Agnes of Brunswick-Lüneburg. On 3 November 1288 she married John III, Lord of Mecklenburg; their daughter Luitgard was born around 1289. John drowned near Poel on 27 May 1289, after only seven months of marriage. On 27 December 1302 she married Bernhard II, Prince of Anhalt-Bernburg, becoming princess of Anhalt-Bernburg. She bore him three sons, including his successor Bernhard III, and died in 1315.
zh: 吕根的海伦（约1270或1272年—1315年8月9日）是吕根亲王维祖拉夫二世与不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的阿格妮丝之女。1288年11月3日，她嫁给梅克伦堡领主约翰三世，女儿卢伊特加德约于1289年出生；婚后仅七个月，约翰于1289年5月27日在珀尔岛附近溺亡。1302年12月27日，她改嫁安哈尔特-贝恩堡亲王伯恩哈德二世，成为安哈尔特-贝恩堡亲王妃，为他生下三个儿子，其中包括继承人伯恩哈德三世。她于1315年去世。

en: Catherine of Anhalt-Bernburg (c. 1330 – 30 January 1390) was a princess of the House of Ascania, the daughter of Bernhard III of Anhalt-Bernburg and Agnes of Saxe-Wittenberg. On 6 October 1356 she married Magnus II, Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg, to whom she bore numerous children, including the future Brunswick dukes Henry the Mild, Frederick I and Bernard I. Magnus lost Lüneburg to Albert of Saxe-Wittenberg and his uncle in 1370 and died in battle in 1373 during the ensuing war of succession. On 11 May 1374 Catherine married his rival Albert, Duke of Lüneburg. She died in 1390.
zh: 安哈尔特-贝恩堡的卡塔琳娜（约1330—1390年1月30日）是阿斯坎尼家族的公主，安哈尔特-贝恩堡亲王伯恩哈德三世与萨克森-维滕贝格的阿格内丝之女。1356年10月6日，她嫁给不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵马格努斯二世，生下众多子女，包括后来的不伦瑞克公爵温和者亨利、腓特烈一世与伯恩哈德一世。1370年，马格努斯失去吕讷堡，萨克森-维滕贝格的阿尔布雷希特及其叔父夺得了这片领地；1373年，马格努斯在随后的继承战争中阵亡。1374年5月11日，卡塔琳娜改嫁他的对手、吕讷堡公爵阿尔布雷希特。她于1390年去世。

en: Sophie of Anhalt-Bernburg (died 18 December 1362) was a princess of the House of Ascania, the daughter of Bernhard III of Anhalt-Bernburg and Agnes of Saxe-Wittenberg. On 12 March 1346 she married William II, Prince of Lüneburg, becoming his third wife and princess consort of his Welf principality. The marriage produced a daughter. Sophie died in 1362, seven years before William.
zh: 安哈尔特-贝恩堡的索菲娅（1362年12月18日卒）是阿斯坎尼家族的公主，安哈尔特-贝恩堡亲王伯恩哈德三世与萨克森-维滕贝格的阿格内丝之女。1346年3月12日，她嫁给吕讷堡亲王威廉二世，成为他的第三任妻子、韦尔夫家族领地的亲王夫人。婚姻留有一女。索菲娅于1362年去世，比威廉早七年。

en: The Bone chronicle names Manurung ri Matajang, also called La Ubbi, as the first ruler, or Arumpone, of Bone in southern Sulawesi, where he founded a Bugis kingdom in 1330.
zh: 马努伦格·里·玛塔章又名拉·乌比，据波尼编年史记载，是苏拉威西南部波尼的首位统治者（阿尔姆波内），于1330年在当地建立布吉人王国。

en: John II (c. 1283–1333) was Count of Bentheim, succeeding his father Eckbert I early in the fourteenth century. In 1305 he allied with Simon I, Lord of Lippe, and married Simon's daughter Mechthild, who bore him five children, among them his successors Simon I and Otto III. In 1312 he added the castle of Uelsen and its lands to the county. To guard the trade road from Münster to Amsterdam, he founded the town of Neuenhaus around Dinkelrode Castle in 1317. He died in 1333.
zh: 约翰二世（约1283—1333）是本特海姆伯爵，于14世纪初继承父亲埃克伯特一世之位。1305年，他与利珀领主西蒙一世结盟，并迎娶西蒙之女梅希蒂尔德，两人生有五个子女，包括继任伯爵的西蒙一世与奥托三世。1312年，他将于尔森城堡及其周边土地并入伯国。为扼守明斯特通往阿姆斯特丹的商路，他于1317年在丁克尔罗德城堡旁兴建诺伊恩豪斯城，最终于1333年去世。

en: Simon I (c. 1310–1344) was Count of Bentheim from 1333 until his death. The eldest son of Count John II and Mechthild of Lippe, he was born at Bentheim Castle and succeeded on his father's death in 1333. He allied with the County of Tecklenburg, then ruled by his kinsmen, and waged feuds against the Bishopric of Münster. He married Catherine, daughter of Count Ludolf VI of Steinfurt, but the marriage produced no children. On his death in 1344 the county passed to his younger brother Otto III.
zh: 西蒙一世（约1310—1344）于1333年至1344年担任本特海姆伯爵。他是伯爵约翰二世与利珀的梅希蒂尔德的长子，出生于本特海姆城堡，1333年父亲去世后继位。他与由亲族统治的泰克伦堡伯国结盟，并同明斯特主教区兵戎相向。他娶施泰因富特伯爵鲁道夫六世之女卡塔琳娜为妻，却没有子嗣。1344年他去世后，伯国传给弟弟奥托三世。

en: Albert Pallavicini was the fifth marquess of Bodonitsa, succeeding his father Thomas. He married Maria dalle Carceri, a Venetian noblewoman of Euboea, and through her held a sixth of that island. He loyally served the princes of Achaea, attending Philip of Savoy's tournament and parliament on the Isthmus of Corinth in 1305 and a like summons of Philip I of Taranto in 1307. On 15 March 1311 he followed Walter V of Brienne against the Catalan Company at the Battle of Halmyros and was killed. By the Assizes of Romania his widow and daughter Guglielma inherited Bodonitsa.
zh: 阿尔贝托·帕拉维奇尼是博多尼察第五代侯爵，在父亲托马斯死后继位。他娶了出身埃维亚岛的威尼斯贵族女子玛丽亚·达莱卡尔切里，并通过她占有该岛六分之一的份额。他忠心侍奉亚该亚诸亲王：1305年参加萨伏依的腓力在科林斯地峡举办的比武大会与议会，1307年又应塔兰托的腓力一世同样的召集前往。1311年3月15日，他随布列讷的戈蒂埃五世在哈尔米罗斯战役中迎战加泰罗尼亚公司，兵败身亡。依照《罗马尼亚宪章》，他的遗孀与女儿古列尔玛继承了博多尼察。

en: Bartolomeo Zaccaria (c. 1305–1334) was the eldest son of Martino Zaccaria, of the Genoese Zaccaria family that ruled Chios. In 1327 he married Guglielma Pallavicini, Marchioness of Bodonitsa, and ruled her march as her consort, holding in addition the Barony of Damala. As a young man he helped raise the ransom after his father's capture in 1329. During a Catalan invasion he was seized and imprisoned in Sicily, winning release only through the intercession of Pope John XXII. He died young in 1334, leaving one daughter, Marulla.
zh: 巴尔托洛梅奥·扎卡里亚（约1305—1334）是统治希俄斯的热那亚扎卡里亚家族成员马蒂诺·扎卡里亚的长子。1327年，他迎娶博多尼察侯爵夫人古列尔玛·帕拉维奇尼，作为她的丈夫统治该侯爵领地，并领有达马拉男爵领地。年轻时，他曾在父亲于1329年被俘后协助筹集赎金。在一次加泰罗尼亚人的入侵中，他被俘虏、囚禁于西西里，只因教皇约翰二十二世出面说情才获释。1334年他英年早逝，留下女儿马鲁拉。

en: Francis Zorzi, called Marchesotto (1337–1388), was a Zorzi marquess of Bodonitsa, a Venetian march in Central Greece. The son of Guglielma Pallavicini and Niccolò Zorzi, he became his mother's co-ruler in 1354 and ruled alone from 1358. A vassal of the Catalan Duchy of Athens paying an annual tribute of four war horses, he nonetheless kept his independence and backed Maria of Sicily against Peter IV of Aragon. He took part in the Council of Thebes in 1373 and died around 1388, leaving Bodonitsa to his young son Jacob under the regency of his widow Euphrosyne Sommaripa.
zh: 弗朗切斯科·佐尔齐（1337—1388）绰号“马尔凯索托”，是佐尔齐家族的博多尼察侯爵，该藩侯国是威尼斯人在中希腊统治的领地。他是古列尔玛·帕拉维奇尼与尼科洛·佐尔齐之子，1354年父亲死后被立为母亲的共治者，1358年母亲去世后独自执政。作为加泰罗尼亚雅典公国的附庸，他每年进贡四匹战马，却始终力图保持独立，并支持西西里的玛丽亚对抗阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世。1373年他出席底比斯会议，约1388年去世，博多尼察传给幼子雅各布，由遗孀埃芙罗西妮·索马里帕摄政。

en: Guglielma Pallavicini (c. 1300–1358), the Lady of Thermopylae, was the last Pallavicini ruler of the March of Bodonitsa in Frankish Greece. On her father Albert's death in 1311 she inherited the march, ruling first with her mother Maria dalle Carceri and later with her stepfather Andrea Cornaro. In 1327 she married the Genoese Bartolomeo Zaccaria, by whom she had a daughter, Marulla; widowed in 1334, she married the Venetian Niccolò Zorzi. Her long quarrel with Zorzi over Larena Castle drew in Venice and the Catalans. After his death in 1354 she ruled with their son Francis until 1358.
zh: 古列尔玛·帕拉维奇尼（约1300—1358）人称“温泉关夫人”，是法兰克希腊土地上博多尼察藩侯国最后一位帕拉维奇尼家族统治者。1311年父亲阿尔贝托去世后，她继承藩侯国，先与母亲玛丽亚·达莱卡尔切里共同执政，后来继父安德烈亚·科尔纳罗也参预国政。1327年，她嫁给热那亚人巴尔托洛梅奥·扎卡里亚，生女马鲁拉；1334年丈夫死后，她改嫁威尼斯人尼科洛·佐尔齐。她与佐尔齐围绕拉雷纳城堡长期争执，威尼斯与加泰罗尼亚人都被卷入。佐尔齐1354年死后，她与儿子弗朗切斯科共同执政，直至1358年去世。

en: Guy Pallavicini (died 1237), a Lombard noble from the Parma region, joined the Fourth Crusade in 1203. In 1204 Boniface of Montferrat made him warden of Thermopylae, and Guy made Bodonitsa his seat as its first marquess, building a castle on the ruins of an ancient acropolis. In 1208–1209 he joined the Lombard barons' revolt against King Demetrius of Thessalonica, but by 1221 he was the kingdom's bailli and defended Thessalonica until he surrendered it to the Epirote Theodore Komnenos Doukas in December 1224. A delayed crusading force helped save his own fief from the Epirotes. Released, he returned to Bodonitsa, made his will on 2 May 1237, and died soon after, leaving the mark to his son Ubertino.
zh: 圭多·帕拉维奇尼（卒于1237年）是出身帕尔马地区的伦巴第贵族，1203年参加第四次十字军。1204年，蒙费拉的博尼法斯任命他镇守温泉关，圭多遂以博多尼察为治所，成为首任博多尼察侯爵，并在古卫城遗址上筑堡。1208至1209年，他参与伦巴第男爵反对塞萨洛尼基国王德米特里的叛乱；但到1221年，他已成为王国的摄政（巴伊），坚守塞萨洛尼基，直至1224年12月向伊庇鲁斯君主狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯献城。一支迟到的十字军帮助他保住了领地，免遭伊庇鲁斯攻占。获释后他返回博多尼察，1237年5月2日立遗嘱，不久后去世，领地传给儿子乌贝蒂诺。

en: Isabella Pallavicini (died 1286) was sovereign marchioness of Bodonitsa, a Frankish lordship in Greece and the premier barony of the Principality of Achaea. A daughter of the first margrave Guy, she succeeded her brother Ubertino in 1278 and also inherited her elder sister Mabilia's lands near Parma in Italy. Already old when she inherited Bodonitsa, Isabella was summoned that year by her new overlord Charles of Anjou to do homage to his bailli at Glarentsa. She did not attend, and her absence was the chief reason the other Achaean barons refused homage to the bailli. She died childless in 1286, and William I of Athens arbitrated the succession in favour of her cousin Albert.
zh: 伊莎贝拉·帕拉维奇尼（？—1286）是博多尼察侯国的女性领主；博多尼察是希腊境内的法兰克人领地，位列亚该亚亲王国诸男爵领地之首。她是第一代侯爵圭多的女儿，1278年继兄长乌贝蒂诺之位，还继承了姐姐马比利亚在意大利帕尔马附近的地产。继承博多尼察时她已年老，同年新封君安茹的查理召她到格拉伦察，向他的总督行效忠礼。她没有前往，她的缺席是亚该亚其他男爵拒绝向总督效忠的主要原因。1286年她无嗣而终，雅典的威廉一世出面仲裁继承权，将侯国判给她的堂亲阿尔贝托。

en: Marulla Zaccaria was a daughter of Bartolomeo Zaccaria, Lord of Damala, and Guglielma Pallavicini, Marchioness of Bodonitsa. After her father died in 1334, Damala passed to her uncle Centurione Zaccaria under the Zaccaria family's male-only succession custom.
zh: 马鲁拉·扎卡里亚是达马拉领主巴尔托洛梅奥·扎卡里亚与博多尼察侯爵夫人古列尔玛·帕拉维奇尼的女儿。1334年父亲死后，达马拉依家族只传男嗣的惯例由叔父琴图廖内·扎卡里亚继承。

en: Nicholas I Zorzi (Italian: Niccolò) was the first Venetian of the Zorzi family to rule Bodonitsa, a Frankish march in Greece set up after the Fourth Crusade in 1204 to guard the pass of Thermopylae. In 1335 he married Guglielma Pallavicini, its heiress and the widow of Bartolommeo Zaccaria, and ruled jointly with her. Next door lay the Duchy of Athens, governed by the Catalan Company; Nicholas stayed on good terms with it but objected to its annual tribute of four war horses. His wife grew tired of him, yet he held the march until his death in 1345. His three sons, Francis, James and Nicholas, each ruled it in turn, and the Zorzi kept it until the Ottomans conquered it in 1414.
zh: 尼科洛一世·佐尔齐（意大利语作尼科洛）是威尼斯佐尔齐家族中第一个统治博多尼察的人。这个希腊的法兰克人侯国设立于1204年第四次十字军之后，用来守卫温泉关隘口。1335年，他娶了侯国的继承人、巴尔托洛梅奥·扎卡里亚的遗孀古列尔玛·帕拉维奇尼，与她共同统治。邻近的雅典公国由加泰罗尼亚公司执掌，尼科洛与其大体保持友好，却不肯接受它索要的每年四匹战马的贡赋。他的妻子逐渐厌倦了他，但他仍统治侯国直到1345年去世。他的三个儿子弗朗切斯科、贾科莫和尼科洛先后都统治过侯国，佐尔齐家族一直守到1414年奥斯曼人攻占此地。

en: Rubino Pallavicini was a Lombard noble from the Parma region, son of Guglielmo Pallavicini and younger brother of Guy, the first marquess of Bodonitsa. After the death of King Boniface of Thessalonica in 1207, Rubino and Guy joined the Lombards under Oberto II of Biandrate in opposition to Boniface's young successor Demetrius. The brothers submitted to the Latin emperor Henry in 1209.
zh: 鲁比诺·帕拉维奇尼是出身帕尔马地区的伦巴第贵族，为古列尔莫·帕拉维奇诺之子、首任博多尼察侯爵圭多的弟弟。1207年塞萨洛尼基国王博尼法斯去世后，鲁比诺与圭多加入比安德拉特的奥贝托二世麾下的伦巴第人，反对博尼法斯年幼的继承人德米特里。兄弟二人于1209年向拉丁皇帝亨利投降。

en: Thomas Pallavicini (Italian: Tommaso Pallavicini) was marquess of Bodonitsa, the Frankish march in northern Greece, and founder of its second ruling line. He was a grandson of Rubino, younger brother of Guy, the first margrave. When his kinswoman Marchioness Isabella died childless in 1286, Thomas claimed the marquisate against her widower. While the feudal court of Achaea, presided over by its bailli William I of Athens, delayed its verdict, Thomas seized the castle of Bodonitsa and installed himself. He ruled unchallenged, perhaps beyond 1300, and passed the march to his son Albert.
zh: 托马斯·帕拉维奇尼（意大利语作托马索）是希腊北部法兰克人领地博多尼察侯国的侯爵，也是该领地第二统治支系的开创者。他是第一代侯爵圭多之弟鲁比诺的孙子。1286年，同族女侯爵伊莎贝拉无嗣而终，托马斯与她的鳏夫争夺侯国继承权。亚该亚的封建法庭在总督、雅典的威廉一世主持下迟迟未作裁决，托马斯便夺取博多尼察城堡，自行即位。他统治期间无人挑战，可能在位至1300年以后，最终将侯国传给儿子阿尔贝托。

en: Ubertino Pallavicini (c. 1210–1278) succeeded his father Guy as marquess of Bodonitsa in 1237. Although Bodonitsa was a vassal of Achaea, he aided his cousin Guy I de la Roche of Athens against Prince William II of Villehardouin, fighting at Karydi in 1258 and retreating to Thebes. In 1259 he joined William and Michael II of Epirus against Nicaea and was defeated at Pelagonia, and in 1263 he campaigned with his Achaean liege against the Morea. During his rule, pirates based on Atalanta disrupted food supplies to his people and castles. In 1264 he inherited estates near Parma from his sister Mabilia; when he died in 1278 the mark passed to his sister Isabella.
zh: 乌贝蒂诺·帕拉维奇尼（约1210—1278）1237年继承父亲圭多，成为博多尼察侯爵。博多尼察本是亚该亚公国的附庸，他却援助表亲雅典公爵居伊一世·德·拉罗什，对抗亚该亚亲王威廉二世·德·维尔阿杜安，1258年参加卡里迪战役，随后随公爵退回底比斯。1259年他加入威廉与伊庇鲁斯君主米哈伊尔二世一方对尼西亚作战，在佩拉戈尼亚战败；1263年又随亚该亚宗主征伐摩里亚专制国。他在位期间，以阿塔兰蒂岛为据点的海盗阻断了臣民和城堡的粮食供应。1264年，他依姐妹玛比利亚的遗嘱继承帕尔马附近的地产；1278年他去世后，侯爵领地由姐妹伊莎贝拉继承。

en: Anne of Bohemia (1323–1338), also called Anna of Luxembourg, was a daughter of John of Bohemia and his first wife Elizabeth of Bohemia, born at Cham in 1323 during her mother’s exile. She was a younger sister of Emperor Charles IV. Two earlier betrothals, to Ladislaus of Hungary and Louis the Roman, came to nothing. On 16 February 1335 she was married at Znojmo to Otto the Merry, Duke of Austria, Styria and Carinthia, becoming stepmother to his young sons. She died childless on 3 September 1338, aged fifteen, and was buried at Neuberg Abbey.
zh: 波希米亚的安娜（1323—1338），又称卢森堡的安娜，是波希米亚国王约翰与第一任妻子波希米亚的伊丽莎白之女。1323年她生于母亲的流放地卡姆，是皇帝查理四世的妹妹。她此前两度订婚，先许配给匈牙利的拉迪斯劳斯，后许配给罗马人路易，均未成婚。1335年2月16日，她在兹诺伊莫嫁给奥地利、施蒂利亚和克恩滕公爵奥托“快活者”，成为他两个年幼儿子的继母。1338年9月3日她去世，年仅十五，没有子女，葬于诺伊贝格修道院。

en: Anne of Bohemia (15 October 1290 – 3 September 1313) was the eldest daughter of Wenceslaus II and Judith of Habsburg, sister of Wenceslaus III and Elizabeth. In 1306 she married Henry of Carinthia, who was elected king of Bohemia after her brother's murder, but the couple were driven out by Rudolf of Habsburg and fled to Carinthia. Henry recovered the throne after Rudolf's death in 1307 but lost it again in 1310, when John of Luxembourg and Anne's sister Elizabeth seized Prague. Anne died in exile at Ljubljana in 1313, aged twenty-two and childless, and was buried at Bolzano.
zh: 安娜·普热米斯洛娃（1290年10月15日—1313年9月3日）是瓦茨拉夫二世与哈布斯堡的茱蒂丝的长女，瓦茨拉夫三世的妹妹和伊丽莎白的姐姐。1306年她嫁给克恩滕的海因里希；其兄遇刺后，海因里希被推举为波希米亚国王，但夫妇二人被哈布斯堡的鲁道夫逐走，逃往克恩滕。1307年鲁道夫死后海因里希复位，却在1310年妹妹伊丽莎白与卢森堡的约翰夺取布拉格后再度失国。1313年安娜于流放中在卢布尔雅那去世，年仅22岁，无子女，葬于博尔扎诺。

en: Beatrice of Bourbon (1320–1383), daughter of Louis I, Duke of Bourbon, married King John of Bohemia at Vincennes in December 1334, a match arranged by Philip VI of France, and reached Prague in 1335. Her only son, Wenceslaus, was born there in February 1337, and she was crowned queen that May; but alienated from Bohemia, she withdrew to Luxembourg in June.
