Widowed when John fell at Crécy in 1346, she kept her dower towns from her stepson Charles IV and in 1347 married Eudes II, Lord of Grancey. She died at Paris on 23 December 1383, outliving her son.
zh: 波旁的比阿特丽斯（1320—1383）是波旁公爵路易一世之女。1334年12月，她在万塞讷嫁给波希米亚国王约翰，这桩婚事由法王腓力六世撮合，1335年她抵达布拉格。她唯一的儿子瓦茨拉夫于1337年2月出生，同年5月她加冕为王后；但她与波希米亚格格不入，6月便退居卢森堡。1346年约翰在克雷西阵亡后，继子卡尔四世保留了她的寡居领地，1347年她改嫁格朗塞领主厄德二世。1383年12月23日她在巴黎去世，死时儿子已先她而去。

en: Blanche of Valois (1317–1348) was the youngest daughter of Charles of Valois and a sister of Philip VI of France. In 1323 she was betrothed to Charles, eldest son of John of Bohemia, who was being educated at the French court and had taken the king's name in place of Wenceslaus. They married at Prague in May 1329 but lived apart until 1334, when she entered Prague with her French household as Margravine of Moravia. She learned Czech and German and stayed on in Bohemia when Charles travelled, proving more popular than John's second wife, Beatrice of Bourbon. With no living son, she came under pressure from John and moved to Brno in 1337; she bore two daughters, Margaret and Katherine. John, allied with her brother Philip, fell at Crécy in 1346, and she became queen of Bohemia. She died on 1 August 1348 and was buried in St Vitus Cathedral; Charles became emperor seven years later.
zh: 瓦卢瓦的布朗歇（1317—1348）是瓦卢瓦的查理最小的女儿，法王腓力六世的妹妹。1323年，她与波希米亚国王约翰的长子查理订婚；这位王子当时在法国宫廷受教育，已用法王之名取代原名文塞斯劳。两人1329年5月在布拉格成婚，却分居数年，直到1334年才团聚，布朗歇带着法国随从进入布拉格，成为摩拉维亚藩侯夫人。她学会了捷克语和德语，丈夫出国时仍留在波希米亚，比约翰的第二任妻子波旁的贝娅特丽丝更得人心。因没有在世的儿子，她受到约翰施压，1337年迁居布尔诺；她生下玛格丽特和凯瑟琳两个女儿。约翰与她的兄长腓力结盟，1346年战死克雷西，查理继位为波希米亚国王，她成为王后。1348年8月1日她病逝，葬于圣维特主教座堂；七年后，查理成为神圣罗马帝国皇帝。

en: Charles (1316–1378), born Václav in Prague, was the eldest son of John of Bohemia and Elizabeth of the Přemyslid dynasty. Raised at the French court, he took the name Charles at his confirmation, became Margrave of Moravia in 1334 and administered Bohemia while his father was abroad and going blind. In July 1346 electors allied with Pope Clement VI chose him King of the Romans against Emperor Louis IV; he had conceded much to the pope, and rivals mocked him as the ‘Priests' King’. That August his father fell at Crécy, where Charles left the field wounded, and he inherited Bohemia and Luxembourg. Louis died in 1347, and Charles was elected again in 1349. He made Prague his capital, laid out its New Town, founded the university in 1348 and built Karlštejn Castle. Crowned emperor at Rome in 1355, he stayed only a few hours; he issued the Golden Bull in 1356 and in 1365 was crowned King of Burgundy at Arles. He died in 1378, succeeded by his son Wenceslaus.
zh: 查理（1316—1378）出生于布拉格，原名瓦茨拉夫，是波希米亚国王约翰与普热米斯尔王朝的伊丽莎白的长子。他在法国宫廷长大，坚信礼时取名查理，1334年受封摩拉维亚藩侯，并在父亲常年在外、渐渐失明期间摄理波希米亚政务。1346年7月，与教宗克雷芒六世结盟的选帝侯推举他为罗马人的国王，与皇帝路易四世对立；他向教宗作出大幅让步，对手讥他为“教士之王”。同年8月，约翰战死于克雷西，查理负伤离开战场，继承了波希米亚与卢森堡。路易1347年去世，查理于1349年再次当选。他以布拉格为都，兴建新城，1348年创办大学，并修建卡尔施泰因城堡。1355年他在罗马加冕为皇帝，只停留了几个小时；1356年颁布《金玺诏书》，1365年在阿尔勒加冕为勃艮第国王。1378年他去世，其子瓦茨拉夫继位。

en: Elizabeth of Bohemia, in Czech Eliška (20 January 1292 – 28 September 1330), was a daughter of Wenceslaus II and Judith of Habsburg. She married John of Luxembourg, son of Emperor Henry VII, on 1 September 1310; John later took Prague, driving her sister Anne and Henry of Carinthia into exile. The couple were crowned in February 1311. Her son Charles, the future Emperor Charles IV, was born in 1316. After an alleged plot against John in 1319 she lost custody of her children, endured exile in Bavaria, returned to Bohemia in 1325, and died of tuberculosis in 1330, aged thirty-eight.
zh: 伊丽莎白（捷克语称埃莉什卡，1292年1月20日—1330年9月28日）是瓦茨拉夫二世与哈布斯堡的茱蒂丝之女。1310年9月1日，她嫁给神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利七世之子卢森堡的约翰；约翰随后攻取布拉格，迫使她的姐姐安娜与克恩滕的海因里希出逃。二人于1311年2月加冕。1316年她生下后来成为皇帝的查理四世。1319年一场针对约翰的所谓阴谋败露后，她失去了子女的监护权，又在巴伐利亚流亡，1325年才返回波希米亚，1330年死于肺结核，年仅38岁。

en: Judith of Habsburg, in Czech Guta (13 March 1271 – 21 May 1297), was the youngest daughter of King Rudolf I of Germany and Gertrude of Hohenberg. As a child she was betrothed to Wenceslaus II of Bohemia to seal her father's peace with King Ottokar II; renewed at Jihlava in 1279, the wedding was held at Cheb in January 1285, making her queen of Bohemia. She bore Wenceslaus ten children, among them Wenceslaus III, Anna, Elizabeth and Margareta, and died in May 1297 giving birth to her last daughter; only four of the children reached adulthood.
zh: 哈布斯堡的茱蒂丝（捷克语称古塔，1271年3月13日—1297年5月21日）是罗马人的国王鲁道夫一世与霍恩贝格的格特鲁德最小的女儿。幼年时，为巩固父亲与波希米亚国王奥托卡二世的和约，她被许配给瓦茨拉夫二世；婚约于1279年在伊赫拉瓦续订，1285年1月在海布举行婚礼，她由此成为波希米亚王后。她为瓦茨拉夫生育十个子女，包括瓦茨拉夫三世、安娜、伊丽莎白和玛克塔，1297年5月在生下最后一个女儿时去世；十名子女中只有四人长大成人。

en: Henry II of Rosenberg (born between 1318 and 1330, died 26 August 1346) was probably the eldest son of the powerful Bohemian magnate Peter I of Rosenberg and his wife Kateřina of Vartenberk. He followed King John of Luxembourg to France and fell beside him at the Battle of Crécy on 26 August 1346, along with many other Bohemian lords. He was buried in the Benedictine Abbey of Our Lady in Luxembourg.
zh: 罗森贝格的因德日赫二世（生于1318至1330年间，逝于1346年8月26日）大约是捷克大贵族彼得一世与妻子卡特日娜·冯·瓦尔滕贝格的长子。他随卢森堡的约翰国王出征法兰西，1346年8月26日在克雷西战役中与国王及众多捷克贵族一同战死，葬于卢森堡的圣母本笃会修道院。

en: Henry I of Rosenberg (c. 1262–4 July 1310), Wok I's son, was a Vítkovci noble. He ceded Raabs Castle to Albert of Habsburg in 1282 after the defeat on the Marchfeld. After backing Záviš of Falkenstein he made his peace with Wenceslaus II, becoming Supreme Chamberlain of Bohemia in 1301. When the Krumlov line of the Vítkovci died out c. 1302, the king granted him Český Krumlov, seat of his descendants for three centuries. He supported Rudolf of Habsburg's claim to the crown in 1306 and died at Prague Castle in July 1310, succeeded by his son Peter I.
zh: 罗森贝格的因德日赫一世（约1262—1310年7月4日）是维特科夫齐家族的波希米亚贵族，沃克一世之子。马希费尔德战败后，他于1282年把拉布斯城堡割让给哈布斯堡的阿尔布雷希特。他曾支持扎维什·冯·法尔肯施泰因，后与瓦茨拉夫二世和解，1301年出任波希米亚最高宫廷大臣。约1302年维特科夫齐家族的捷克克鲁姆洛夫支绝嗣，国王把捷克克鲁姆洛夫赐给他，此后三个世纪里那里都是其后代的府邸。1306年他支持哈布斯堡的鲁道夫争夺王位，1310年7月死于布拉格城堡，儿子彼得一世继位。

en: Hynek Berka of Dubá (died 1348) was a Bohemian nobleman of the Ronovci clan and founder of the Berka of Dubá family. He joined the revolt against King John after Henry of Lipá's arrest and was one of seven hostages for the settlement. He became the king's trusted servant, serving as supreme burgrave of Prague from c. 1319 until his death and twice as provincial governor during John's absences. After 1333 he founded the town of Hradčany below Prague Castle. By his wife Agnes he left two sons, who began the two branches of his house.
zh: 杜贝的希内克·贝尔卡（1348年卒）是罗诺夫齐家族出身的波希米亚贵族，也是贝尔卡·兹·杜贝支系的始祖。利帕的海因里希被捕后，他参加反对国王卢森堡的约翰的贵族叛乱，并作为担保和解的七名人质之一。此后他成为国王倚重的近臣，约1319年起担任布拉格最高城堡长官直至去世，并在国王出国期间两度受命署理国政。1333年后，他在布拉格城堡西侧脚下兴建城堡区城镇。他与妻子阿涅日卡生有两子，后来分别开创该家族的两大支系。

en: Hynek Berka the Younger of Dubá (died 1361) was a Bohemian nobleman of the Berka z Dubé family and founder of its Hohnstein branch. The elder son of the Supreme Burgrave Hynek Berka z Dubé, he received the Lipá and Sloup estates in the family division, and Emperor Charles IV enfeoffed him with Hohnstein Castle in Upper Lusatia. In 1331 King John of Luxembourg appointed him royal governor of the Duchy of Głogów. He succeeded his father as Supreme Burgrave of Bohemia in 1348 and joined Charles IV's coronation expedition to Rome in 1355.
zh: 小海内克·贝尔卡·兹·杜贝（逝于1361年）是捷克贵族、贝尔卡·兹·杜贝家族霍恩施泰因支系的始祖。他是最高城堡长官海内克·贝尔卡·兹·杜贝的长子，在家族分封中得到利帕与斯劳普领地，皇帝查理四世又把上卢萨蒂亚的霍恩施泰因城堡封给他作采邑。1331年，卢森堡的约翰国王任命他为格沃古夫公国的王室总督。1348年他接替父亲出任波希米亚最高城堡长官，并于1355年随查理四世远征罗马参加加冕。

en: John IV of Dražice (Czech: Jan IV. z Dražic, c. 1260–1343) was Bishop of Prague from 1301 until his death. A Prague canon from a noble Bohemian family, in 1310 he backed John of Luxembourg's seizure of the Bohemian crown with troops and money. In 1318 Pope John XXII suspended him on Dominican charges, and he spent eleven years at Avignon before being restored in 1329. Restored, he became a lavish builder, founding an Augustinian monastery and a stone bridge over the Elbe at Roudnice nad Labem. He died in 1343 and was buried at St Vitus.
zh: 德拉日采的扬四世（约1260—1343）于1301年至1343年任布拉格主教。他出身波希米亚旧贵族家庭，当选主教前已是布拉格法政牧师；1310年出兵出资支持卢森堡的约翰夺取波希米亚王位。1318年，教宗约翰二十二世因多明我会修士提出的指控将他停职，他在阿维尼翁滞留十一年，直到1329年才官复原职。回国后他大兴土木，尤其在拉贝河畔罗乌德尼采修建奥斯定会修道院，并建造横跨拉贝河的石桥。他于1343年去世，葬于圣维特大教堂。

en: Jan Hus (c. 1370–1415) was a Czech theologian and the leading voice of the Bohemian Reformation. Born at Husinec to peasant parents, he studied in Prague, was ordained, and became rector of Charles University in 1409. From 1402 he preached at Bethlehem Chapel. Influenced by John Wycliffe, he denounced simony and indulgences and upheld the Bible as the supreme authority. Excommunicated and exiled for two years, he continued to preach and write in the countryside. He attended the Council of Constance under Sigismund's safe conduct, only to be arrested and burned at the stake on 6 July 1415 for refusing to recant. His followers, the Hussites, defended his reforms in the Hussite Wars (1420–1431).
zh: 扬·胡斯（约1370—1415）是捷克神学家、波希米亚宗教改革的领袖人物。他生于胡西内茨的农民家庭，在布拉格求学并领受神父职，1409年出任查理大学校长。他自1402年起在伯利恒礼拜堂传教。受威克里夫影响，他抨击圣职买卖和赎罪券，坚持《圣经》才是最高权威。他被开除教籍并流亡两年，在乡间继续传教和写作。后来他持西吉斯蒙德颁发的安全通行令出席康斯坦茨会议，却遭到逮捕，因拒绝放弃主张，于1415年7月6日被处以火刑。他的追随者胡斯派在1420—1431年的胡斯战争中捍卫了他的改革主张。

en: John I of Rosenberg was the youngest son of Peter I of Rosenberg and Catherine of Vartenberk, of a leading Bohemian noble house. After his father died in 1347 his elder brothers ruled the family lands. In 1367 the brothers founded the Augustinian monastery at Třeboň, and when the estates were divided in 1374 John took over their administration, residing at Třeboň and Český Krumlov. In 1376 he and his brother Peter granted Třeboň town privileges, and in 1384 they founded a Pauline monastery and a home for poor priests. He died childless on 1 September 1389, never becoming regent.
zh: 扬一世·罗森贝格是彼得一世·罗森贝格与瓦尔滕贝格的卡特琳娜最小的儿子，出身波希米亚头等贵族世家。1347年父亲去世后，家族领地由其兄长们执掌。1367年，众兄弟在特热邦建立奥斯定会修道院；1374年家族析产，扬接掌产业管理，辗转居住于特热邦与捷克克鲁姆洛夫。1376年，他与兄长彼得授予特热邦城市特权；1384年，二人又建立保禄会修道院及贫神父之家。他于1389年9月1日去世，无子嗣，终生未成为家族摄政。

en: Jan Volek (c. 1290–1351) was the illegitimate son of King Wenceslaus II of Bohemia and the last male Přemyslid. Though not yet ordained a priest, he was a canon at Prague and Olomouc, and from 1319 served as provost of Vyšehrad and chancellor to his half-brother-in-law, King John of Luxembourg. In April 1334 Pope John XXII named him Bishop of Olomouc; he was ordained a priest the following month. He was a councillor to his half-sister Queen Elizabeth and deputy governor of Moravia under his nephew Charles IV, and in 1340 he founded a Benedictine nunnery at Pustiměř. He died at Olomouc on 27 September 1351.
zh: 扬·沃莱克（约1290—1351）是波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫二世的私生子，也是最后一位男性普热米斯尔王族。他虽尚未领受司铎圣职，却身兼布拉格与奥洛穆茨的法政牧师，1319年起出任维谢赫拉德教长，并担任姻兄国王卢森堡的约翰的掌玺大臣。1334年4月，教宗约翰二十二世任命他为奥洛穆茨主教；次月他领受司铎圣职。他是异母妹伊丽莎白王后的顾问，又被外甥卡尔四世任命为摩拉维亚副长官，并于1340年在普斯蒂梅尔日创建一座本笃会修女院。1351年9月27日，他在奥洛穆茨去世。

en: Jindřich Berka z Dubé, called the One-Eyed (died 1404), was a Bohemian nobleman and the younger son of the Supreme Burgrave Hynek Berka z Dubé. When the family estates were divided with his elder brother Hynek after 1352, his share included Dubá, Kuřívody, Jestřebí, Houska, Frýdlant and Mšeno, and Emperor Charles IV later redeemed Mšeno from his pledge. He bought Jablonné from Hašek of Lemberk and built the castles Milčany, Hrádek and Čáp. His seven sons founded the Kuřívody branch of the Berka family.
zh: 因德日赫·贝尔卡·兹·杜贝，绰号独眼（逝于1404年），是捷克贵族、最高城堡长官海内克·贝尔卡·兹·杜贝的次子。1352年后他与兄长海内克分割家产，分得杜贝、库日沃迪、耶斯特热比、豪斯卡、弗里德兰特和姆谢诺，姆谢诺后来由查理四世出资从抵押中赎回。他从伦贝克的哈谢克手中买下亚布隆内，并修建了米尔恰尼、赫拉代克和恰普三座城堡。他的七个儿子开创了贝尔卡家族的库日沃迪支系。

en: George of Poděbrady (1420–1471) led the moderate Utraquist party and fought at Lipany in 1434. He seized Prague in 1448, and in 1451 Frederick III made him administrator of Bohemia. On 2 March 1458 the estates unanimously elected him king. Ruling tolerantly under the Compacta of Prague to keep Hussites and Catholics at peace, he was called the King of two peoples. Pope Pius II declared the Compacta void in 1462, but George rejected his demand to accept this. In 1464 he proposed common European institutions in his peace treaty against the Turks. Excommunicated by Pope Paul II in 1466, he fought Matthias Corvinus, who occupied much of Moravia and was elected rival king in 1469. George died in Prague on 22 March 1471.
zh: 波杰布拉德的伊日（1420—1471）是胡斯运动中温和圣杯派的领袖，1434年参加过利帕尼战役。他于1448年夺取布拉格，1451年被腓特烈三世委任为波希米亚摄政。1458年3月2日，波希米亚各等级一致选举他为国王。他依据《布拉格协定》实行宽容统治，维系胡斯派与天主教徒之间的和平，被称为“两个民族的国王”。1462年教皇庇护二世宣布协定无效，伊日拒绝接受这一决定。1464年他在对抗土耳其人的和平条约草案中提出建立欧洲共同机构。1466年他被教皇保罗二世革除教籍，随后与马加什·科尔温交战；马加什占领摩拉维亚大片地区，并于1469年被拥立为对立国王。伊日于1471年3月22日在布拉格去世。

en: John of Luxembourg (1296–1346), called the Blind, was the eldest son of Emperor Henry VII and Margaret of Brabant. In 1310 he married Elizabeth of Bohemia, drove Henry of Carinthia from Prague, and was crowned king in 1311; from 1313 he also held Luxembourg. The Czech nobility saw an ‘alien king’, and he was often abroad. He backed Louis IV at Mühldorf in 1322 and received the Egerland, and in 1335 sold his claim to the Polish crown to Casimir III. Crusading in Lithuania, he lost his sight to ophthalmia in 1336. When the Hundred Years' War began he joined Philip VI, who made him governor of Languedoc in 1338. At Crécy on 26 August 1346 he commanded the French vanguard; Froissart tells how his knights tied their bridles together and led him into the English line, where he struck several blows before he was killed. His son Charles IV succeeded him in Bohemia.
zh: 卢森堡的约翰（1296—1346），绰号“盲人”，是神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利七世与布拉班特的玛格丽特的长子。1310年，他娶波希米亚的伊丽莎白为妻，把克恩滕的海因里希赶出布拉格，1311年加冕为波希米亚国王；1313年起又兼领卢森堡伯国。捷克贵族视他为“外来的国王”，他常年在国外。1322年他在米尔多夫战役中支持路易四世，获赐埃格尔地区；1335年，他把对波兰王位的宣称卖给了卡齐米日三世。他赴立陶宛参加十字军，1336年因眼疾双目失明。百年战争爆发后，他投向法王腓力六世，1338年受任为朗格多克总督。1346年8月26日，他在克雷西指挥法军前锋；据弗鲁瓦萨尔记述，骑士们把各自的缰绳系在一起，带着他冲入英军阵中，他挥剑砍了数下，战死沙场。其子查理四世继承波希米亚王位。

en: Jošt I of Rosenberg (Latin Jodocus, died 24 June 1369) was the third son of Peter I of Rosenberg and Kateřina of Vartenberk, and husband of Anežka of Wallsee. After his father died in 1347 he succeeded him as Supreme Chamberlain of Bohemia, holding the office until 1351. With his mother and brothers he founded a Minorite monastery in Český Krumlov. In the 1360s he and his brothers had long, bitter power struggles with Emperor Charles IV.
zh: 罗森贝格的约什特一世（拉丁名作约多库斯，逝于1369年6月24日）是彼得一世与卡特日娜·冯·瓦尔滕贝格的第三子，娶阿内日卡·冯·瓦尔塞为妻。1347年父亲去世后，他接任波希米亚最高宫廷大臣，任职至1351年。他与母亲和兄弟们一起在捷克克鲁姆洛夫创立了小兄弟会修道院。1360年代，他与兄弟们同查理四世皇帝发生长期而激烈的权力之争。

en: Catherine of Vartenberk (died 1355), traditionally of the Vartenberk family, was the second wife of the Bohemian lord Peter I of Rosenberg, whom she married in 1318. She bore him five sons and three daughters, among them Henry II, Oldřich I and Peter II of Rosenberg. In 1347 she helped her husband found a hospital and was widowed that autumn. In 1350 she and her sons founded Franciscan monasteries for friars and sisters at Krumlov. She donated vestments she had made and a reliquary to Vyšší Brod Abbey in 1354, and was buried there after her death.
zh: 瓦尔滕贝克的卡塔琳娜（1355年卒）相传出身瓦尔滕贝克家族，1318年嫁给波希米亚贵族罗日姆贝克的彼得一世，成为他的第二任妻子。她生下五个儿子和三个女儿，其中包括亨里克二世、奥尔德里希一世和彼得二世。1347年，她与丈夫共同创办医院，同年秋天守寡。1350年，她与儿子们在克鲁姆洛夫创办了方济各会男女修道院。1354年，她向维希布罗德修道院捐赠亲手制作的礼服和一座圣髑匣，去世后葬于该修道院。

en: Margaret of Bohemia (24 May 1335–1349), also called Margaret of Luxembourg, was the second child of Charles IV, later Holy Roman Emperor, and his first wife Blanche of Valois, born while her father ruled as Margrave of Moravia. In 1338 she was betrothed at age two to Amadeus VI, Count of Savoy, but the contract was broken and he married her cousin Bonne of Bourbon. In 1342, aged seven, she married Louis I of Hungary and became his queen. The marriage produced no children, and she died in 1349 at about fourteen, probably buried in Székesfehérvár Basilica.
zh: 卢森堡的玛格丽特（1335年5月24日—1349年）是后来成为神圣罗马帝国皇帝的查理四世与第一任妻子瓦卢瓦的布朗歇的第二个孩子，出生时其父正以摩拉维亚藩侯身份执政。1338年，年仅两岁的她与萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥六世订婚，但婚约后来作废，阿梅迪奥改娶她的表亲波旁的邦妮。1342年，七岁的她嫁给匈牙利国王拉约什一世，成为匈牙利王后。这段婚姻没有子嗣，她于1349年去世，年仅约十四岁，可能葬于塞克什白堡大教堂。

en: Oldřich I of Rosenberg (died 4 March 1390) was the fourth son of Peter I of Rosenberg and Kateřina of Vartenberk. As a young man he joined his mother and brothers in endowing the Minorite monastery in Český Krumlov. When his brother Jošt died in 1369 he became head of the family, but kept out of public life because of the Rosenbergs' quarrel with the crown. In 1381–1382 he and his brothers joined Jindřich of Hradec in aiding Jindřich of Schaunberg against Duke Albert III of Austria, a dispute King Wenceslas IV mediated.
zh: 罗森贝格的奥尔德日赫一世（逝于1390年3月4日）是彼得一世与卡特日娜·冯·瓦尔滕贝格的第四子。年轻时他参与母亲和兄弟们在捷克克鲁姆洛夫捐建小兄弟会修道院的善举。1369年兄长约什特去世后，他成为罗森贝格家族的首领，但因家族与王室的矛盾而不问政务。1381至1382年，他与兄弟们联合因德日赫·兹·赫拉代茨出兵，支援沙恩贝格的因德日赫对抗奥地利公爵阿尔布雷希特三世，最终由国王瓦茨拉夫四世出面调停。

en: Ottokar II of Bohemia (c. 1233–26 August 1278), the Iron and Golden King, held Moravia from 1247 and was elected Duke of Austria in 1251, succeeding his father Wenceslaus I as king of Bohemia in 1253. He defeated Béla IV of Hungary at Kressenbrunn in 1260, securing Styria, and inherited Carinthia and Carniola in 1269, raising Bohemia to the height of its power. Rudolf of Habsburg, elected German king in 1273, forced him to surrender the Alpine lands in 1276; Ottokar fell fighting to regain them at the Battle on the Marchfeld in August 1278.
zh: 奥托卡二世（约1233—1278年8月26日），绰号“铁与金之王”，1247年起领有摩拉维亚，1251年被推举为奥地利公爵，1253年继父亲瓦茨拉夫一世之后成为波希米亚国王。1260年他在克雷森布伦击败匈牙利国王贝拉四世，取得施蒂利亚，1269年又继承克恩滕和克拉尼斯卡，把波希米亚推向权势顶峰。1273年当选罗马人的国王的哈布斯堡的鲁道夫，于1276年迫使他交出阿尔卑斯诸领地；1278年8月，奥托卡在马希费尔德战役中为夺回这些领地战死。

en: Peter II of Rosenberg (1326–1384) was a Bohemian churchman, the second son of Peter I of Rosenberg and Kateřina of Vartenberk, born at Český Krumlov. He became a canon at Passau, Olomouc and Regensburg, and from 1355 served until his death as provost of All Saints' College at Prague Castle. In 1384 Pope Urban VI offered him a cardinal's hat, which he refused, apparently aware that his death was near. He died at Vyšší Brod on 16 November 1384 and helped run the Bohemian hospice in Rome with his brothers.
zh: 罗森贝格的彼得二世（1326—1384）是捷克教士，彼得一世与卡特日娜·冯·瓦尔滕贝格的次子，生于捷克克鲁姆洛夫。他先后在帕绍、奥洛穆茨和雷根斯堡担任法政牧师，1355年起出任布拉格城堡诸圣参事会会长，直到去世。1384年教皇乌尔班六世要封他为枢机主教，他辞谢了这一职位，显然是意识到死期将近。他还与兄弟们一起经营罗马的捷克朝圣者招待所，1384年11月16日逝于上布罗德。

en: Peter I of Rosenberg (c. 1282–1347) was a Bohemian nobleman who inherited the office of Supreme Chamberlain on his father Jindřich's death in 1310. After breaking his betrothal to a daughter of Jindřich of Lipá in 1315, he married Viola of Teschen, widow of King Wenceslas III, and later Kateřina of Vartenberk, who bore him five sons. He joined the baronial revolt against John of Luxembourg in 1317, losing his office from 1319 to 1325, and took part in John's Lithuanian crusade in 1329. His name is linked to the Rosenberg Book, the oldest record of Czech land law.
zh: 罗森贝格的彼得一世（约1282—1347）是捷克贵族，1310年父亲因德日赫去世后接掌王国最高宫廷大臣一职。1315年他解除与因德日赫·兹·利佩之女的婚约，先娶瓦茨拉夫三世的遗孀切申的薇奥拉，后娶卡特日娜·冯·瓦尔滕贝格，后者为他生下五个儿子。1317年他参与反对卢森堡的约翰的贵族叛乱，1319至1325年间被免去官职；1329年随约翰远征立陶宛。他的名字与最古老的捷克地方法成文记录《罗森贝格书》联系在一起。

en: Rudolf I of Habsburg (c. 1281–3 July 1307), called the Good, was the eldest son of King Albert I of Germany and Elizabeth of Gorizia-Tyrol. From 1298 he ruled the Austrian and Styrian duchies as his father's co-ruler and acted as regent for his younger brothers. His first wife Blanche of France died in 1305, after their two children had died young. In 1304 he accompanied his father on an expedition against Bohemia. After King Wenceslaus III of Bohemia was murdered in August 1306, Albert seized Bohemia and had Rudolf crowned king, marrying him to Elizabeth Richeza, widow of Wenceslaus II. Many Bohemian nobles rejected him and rose in favour of Henry of Carinthia. While besieging the rebel castle of Horažďovice, Rudolf died of dysentery in July 1307, leaving no heir.
zh: 鲁道夫一世（约1281—1307年7月3日），绰号“好人”，是罗马人的国王阿尔布雷希特一世与戈里茨-蒂罗尔的伊丽莎白的长子。1298年起，他作为父亲的共治者统治奥地利与施蒂利亚公国，并为年幼的弟弟们摄政。他的第一任妻子法国的布朗歇于1305年去世，两人的一对子女也早夭。1304年，他随父出征波希米亚。1306年8月，波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫三世遇刺，阿尔布雷希特占领波希米亚，将鲁道夫立为国王，并让他迎娶瓦茨拉夫二世的遗孀伊丽莎白·里基莎。许多波希米亚贵族拒不承认他，转而拥立克恩滕的海因里希。鲁道夫在围攻叛军城堡霍拉日焦维采时染上痢疾，于1307年7月死在当地，身后无嗣。

en: Rudolf II of Habsburg (c. 1270–10 May 1290), called the Debonair, was the youngest son of King Rudolf I of Germany and Gertrude of Hohenberg, born at Rheinfelden. In December 1282 his father enfeoffed him and his elder brother Albert with Austria and Styria jointly, but under the Treaty of Rheinfelden in June 1283 Rudolf surrendered his share to Albert, receiving instead the honorific title Duke of Swabia. In 1289 he married Agnes, daughter of King Ottokar II of Bohemia. He died in Prague in May 1290, aged twenty; his son John Parricida later murdered Albert in 1308.
zh: 鲁道夫二世（约1270—1290年5月10日），绰号温文尔雅者，是罗马人的国王鲁道夫一世与霍恩贝格的格特鲁德最小的儿子，生于莱茵费尔登。1282年12月，父亲将奥地利与施蒂利亚公国封给他和兄长阿尔布雷希特共同统治；但依1283年6月的《莱茵费尔登条约》，鲁道夫把自己的份额让给阿尔布雷希特，改领近乎荣衔的施瓦本公爵称号。1289年，他迎娶波希米亚国王奥托卡二世之女阿格尼丝。1290年5月他死于布拉格，年仅20岁；其子约翰，即弑亲者，后来于1308年刺杀了阿尔布雷希特。

en: Smil z Ledenic, also called Smil z Landštejna (died c. 1358), was a Bohemian nobleman, the eldest son of Vítek z Landštejna. In 1312 he inherited the Ledenice estate, while Landštejn went to his brother Vilém. His daughter Keruše married Přibík ze Stráže.
zh: 斯米尔·兹·莱登尼采，一称斯米尔·兹·兰德施泰因（约逝于1358年），捷克贵族，维捷克·兹·兰德施泰因长子。1312年继承莱登尼采，兰德施泰因归其弟威廉；女儿凯鲁谢嫁给普日比克·兹·斯特拉热。

en: Vilém z Landštejna (died 1356) was one of the most powerful Bohemian lords under King John of Luxembourg and later a loyal supporter of Emperor Charles IV. The son of Vítek z Landštejna, he inherited Třeboň and Landštejn and added Nové Hrady, Sviny, Lomnice and Hluboká. In 1316 he helped free the imprisoned Jindřich of Lipá. He served as royal sub-chamberlain (1333–1336), Moravian Land Hejtman (1345–1351) and Supreme Burgrave of Bohemia (1351–1356). He died of wounds from a duel with his kinsman Jindřich of Hradec over a trade route.
zh: 威廉·兹·兰德施泰因（逝于1356年）是卢森堡的约翰国王治下最有权势的捷克大贵族之一，后来成为查理四世的忠实支柱。他是维捷克·兹·兰德施泰因之子，继承了特热博尼和兰德施泰因，又取得新赫拉迪、斯维尼、洛姆尼采和赫卢博卡。1316年，他参与营救被囚禁的因德日赫·兹·利佩。他历任王室副司库（1333—1336）、摩拉维亚地方长官（1345—1351）和波希米亚最高城堡长官（1351—1356），最终因商路争执在与亲属因德日赫·兹·赫拉代茨的决斗中伤重而死。

en: Vítek z Landštejna (died 1312) was a Bohemian nobleman of the Landštejn branch of the Vítkovci clan, son of Ojíř z Lomnice. Czech sources remember him and his father as fearless warriors who made their names at the turn of the fourteenth century. He held Landštejn Castle from about 1302 until 1311, together with the Třeboň estate. After his death in 1312 his lands were divided between his sons Smil, who received Ledenice, and Vilém, who inherited Třeboň and Landštejn.
zh: 维特克·兹·兰德施泰因（？—1312）是波希米亚贵族，出自维特科夫齐家族的兰德施泰因支，为奥伊尔日·兹·洛姆尼采之子。捷克史料把他与父亲并称为14世纪前后成名的勇猛武士。约1302年至1311年间，他领有兰德施泰因城堡及特热博尼地产。1312年他死后，产业分给诸子：斯米尔得到莱登尼采，威廉继承特热博尼与兰德施泰因。

en: Wenceslaus II (27 September 1271 – 21 June 1305), son of Ottokar II of Bohemia, inherited the crown when his father fell at the Battle on the Marchfeld in 1278. After years under Brandenburg regency he returned to Prague in 1283, married Judith of Habsburg in 1285, and took power in person after executing his stepfather Záviš of Falkenstein in 1290. Wealth from the Kutná Hora silver mines produced the Prague groschen, and he founded Plzeň in 1295. Crowned king of Poland at Gniezno in 1300, he accepted the Hungarian crown for his son after the Árpád male line died out in 1301. In 1304 he marched to Buda and brought his son and the crown back to Bohemia. He died in 1305, aged thirty-three.
zh: 瓦茨拉夫二世（1271年9月27日—1305年6月21日）是奥托卡二世之子，1278年父亲在马希费尔德战役战死后继承波希米亚王位。他在勃兰登堡摄政者控制下度过数年，1283年回到布拉格，1285年娶哈布斯堡的茱蒂丝，1290年处死继父扎维什·冯·法尔肯施泰因后开始亲政。库特纳霍拉银矿的财富催生了布拉格格罗申银币，他还于1295年建立了比尔森城。1300年他在格涅兹诺加冕为波兰国王；1301年阿尔帕德王朝男系绝嗣后，他为儿子接受了匈牙利王冠。1304年，他率军前往布达，将儿子和王冠带回波希米亚。1305年他去世，年仅33岁。

en: Wenceslaus III (6 October 1289 – 4 August 1306) was the last ruler of Bohemia's Přemyslid dynasty, the son of Wenceslaus II and Judith of Habsburg. Betrothed to a daughter of Andrew III, he was crowned king of Hungary in August 1301, but his rule there was nominal and his father brought him home in 1304. Succeeding to Bohemia and Poland in June 1305, he ceded his Hungarian claim to Otto III of Bavaria. After Władysław Łokietek took Kraków in 1306, Wenceslaus prepared a Polish campaign, but was stabbed to death at Olomouc on 4 August 1306, his assassin never identified.
zh: 瓦茨拉夫三世（1289年10月6日—1306年8月4日）是波希米亚普热米斯尔王朝的末代君主，瓦茨拉夫二世与哈布斯堡的茱蒂丝之子。他自幼与安德烈三世之女订婚，1301年8月被加冕为匈牙利国王，但统治仅有名义，1304年被父亲带回波希米亚。1305年6月他继承波希米亚与波兰王位，随即将匈牙利王位的继承权让给巴伐利亚的奥托三世。1306年瓦迪斯瓦夫一世夺取克拉科夫后，瓦茨拉夫准备远征波兰，却于8月4日在奥洛穆茨遇刺身亡，凶手始终没有查明。

en: Wenceslaus I (25 February 1337 – 7 December 1383), first Duke of Luxembourg, was the son of John the Blind of Bohemia and Beatrice of Bourbon. In 1352 he married Joanna, heiress of Brabant, and in 1353 his half-brother Charles IV made him Count of Luxembourg, which became a duchy in 1354. After Joanna inherited Brabant in 1355 he confirmed its liberties in the Joyous Entry and warred with Flanders. Captured at Baesweiler in 1371, he spent eleven months a prisoner. He died in 1383 and was buried at Orval Abbey; a poet and patron of Froissart, he left seventy-nine poems.
zh: 温塞斯拉斯一世（1337年2月25日—1383年12月7日）是第一代卢森堡公爵，波希米亚国王盲人约翰与波旁的贝阿特丽丝之子。1352年，他与布拉班特女继承人让娜结婚；1353年，异母兄查理四世将卢森堡伯国交给他，该地于1354年升为公国。1355年让娜继承布拉班特后，他以《欢乐入城》确认当地自由特权，并与佛兰德交战。1371年他在巴斯韦勒被俘，囚禁十一个月。1383年去世，葬于奥尔瓦勒修道院；他本人是诗人、傅华萨的赞助人，留有诗作79首。

en: Wok I of Rosenberg (c. 1210–3 June 1262) was a Bohemian nobleman of the Vítkovci clan and the first of his line to style himself after Rožmberk Castle. First documented in a charter of 1250, he was made court marshal by King Ottokar II in 1255 and accompanied the king's Prussian crusade. He fought in the victory at Kressenbrunn over Hungary in 1260, receiving the Raabs lordship and appointment as captain of Styria. In 1259 he founded Vyšší Brod Monastery. Wok died at Graz in 1262 and was buried in its family vault; his son Jindřich succeeded him.
zh: 罗森贝格的沃克一世（约1210—1262年6月3日）是波希米亚维特科夫齐家族的贵族，也是家族中第一个以罗森贝格城堡为姓氏的人。1250年的一份文书首次记载了他；1255年国王奥托卡二世任命他为宫廷元帅，他还随国王参加了征讨普鲁士人的十字军。1260年他在克雷森布伦击败匈牙利人的战役中作战，受封拉布斯领地，并被任命为施蒂利亚长官。1259年他创立维希布罗德修道院。1262年6月沃克死于格拉茨，葬在该修道院的家族墓室，儿子因德日赫继位。

en: Zbyněk z Ledenic, also called Zbyněk z Landštejna (died c. 1346), was a Bohemian nobleman, a younger son of Vítek z Landštejna and brother of Vilém z Landštejna. He took his predicate from the family's Ledenice estate.
zh: 兹比涅克·兹·莱登尼采，一称兹比涅克·兹·兰德施泰因（约逝于1346年），捷克贵族，维捷克·兹·兰德施泰因之子、威廉·兹·兰德施泰因之弟，名号来自家族的莱登尼采领地。

en: Bolot was a Yuan imperial prince, son of Esen Temür and younger brother of Tughluq, whom the Chinese sources call Aru. During the Zhizheng reign of Toghon Temür he succeeded as Prince of Yunnan. In 1346, when Si Kefa of Luchuan broke away and seized Ludian, Bolot campaigned against him together with the Yunnan pingzhang Yituhun, and presented captives at the capital Dadu in 1347. In 1355 he was raised to Prince of Liang for his merits. His son was Basalawarmi, the last Yuan ruler of Yunnan.
zh: 孛罗是元朝宗室，也先帖木儿之子、阿鲁之弟。元顺帝至正年间，他袭封云南王。1346年，麓川的思可法割据自立、攻下路甸，孛罗偕云南行省平章政事亦秃浑率军讨伐，于1347年赴大都献俘报捷。1355年，他以功进封梁王。其子把匝剌瓦尔密后来成为元朝在云南的最后统治者。

en: Jelena Šubić (died c. 1378) was the daughter of George II Šubić, Count of Klis. Her marriage at Klis Fortress in late 1337 or early 1338 to Vladislav, brother of Ban Stephen II of Bosnia, sealed her brother Mladen III's alliance with Bosnia against the Hungarian king. When Stephen died in autumn 1353, her son Tvrtko, about fifteen, became ban. Jelena and Vladislav, who was excluded from the succession for reasons unknown, governed in his name; Vladislav was dead within a year, and she ruled alone until 1357. She first travelled to the court of the overlord, Louis I of Hungary, to win his consent. At an assembly in Mile she confirmed the nobles' privileges, and in May 1355 she marched to Duvno to settle the Šubić inheritance dispute open since Mladen's death. In 1374 she organized Tvrtko's wedding to Dorothea of Bulgaria. Three years later Tvrtko was crowned king.
zh: 耶莱娜·舒比奇（约1378年卒）是克利什伯爵乔治二世·舒比奇之女。1337年底或1338年初，她在克利什要塞嫁给波斯尼亚班斯特凡二世之弟弗拉迪斯拉夫，这桩婚事巩固了她的兄长姆拉登三世与波斯尼亚结成的、对抗匈牙利国王的同盟。1353年秋斯特凡去世，她约十五岁的儿子特夫尔特科继任班。耶莱娜与因不明原因被排除在继承之外的弗拉迪斯拉夫以少主的名义执政；一年内弗拉迪斯拉夫去世，她独自执政至1357年。她首先前往宗主匈牙利国王拉约什一世的宫廷，请求他认可儿子的继位。她在米莱召开会议，确认贵族的特权；1355年5月，她进军杜夫诺，了结自姆拉登去世以来悬而未决的舒比奇家族遗产之争。1374年，她筹办了特夫尔特科与保加利亚的多萝泰娅的婚礼。三年后，特夫尔特科加冕为王。

en: Catherine of Bosnia (Katarina Kotromanić, born c. 1336) was a princess of the Kotromanić dynasty, held to be a daughter either of Ban Stephen II or of his brother Vladislav. In 1361 she married Hermann I, Count of Celje. Her son Hans, born in 1362, died young, while Hermann II, born in 1365, succeeded as count and in 1427 was recognized as heir presumptive to the Bosnian throne. Through Hermann’s daughter Barbara, wife of the Emperor Sigismund, Catherine was an ancestress of later European royal houses. She died after 1400.
zh: 波斯尼亚的卡塔琳娜（卡塔琳娜·科特罗马尼奇，约1336年生）是科特罗马尼奇王朝的公主，一说为波斯尼亚班斯蒂芬二世之女，一说为其弟弗拉迪斯拉夫之女。1361年，她嫁给采列伯爵赫尔曼一世。其子汉斯生于1362年，早夭；其子赫尔曼二世生于1365年，后来承袭伯爵，并于1427年被认定为波斯尼亚王位的推定继承人。凭借赫尔曼二世之女、皇帝西吉斯蒙德之妻芭芭拉，卡塔琳娜成为后世欧洲各王室的祖先。她于1400年后去世。

en: Catherine Kotromanić was a Bosnian princess, the daughter of Ban Stephen I of Bosnia and Elizabeth Nemanjić, and a sister of Ban Stephen II. Born around 1294, she was raised at the courts of Srebrenik and Jajce. About 1310 she married Nicholas, the župan of Hum, and made her home at Blagaj, the seat of Zahumlje, bearing him two sons, Vladislav and Bogiša. Some accounts hold that after Nicholas died around 1340 she remarried a nobleman named Vukac and became the mother of the vojvoda Hrvoje. She died at Birbir in 1355.
zh: 卡塔琳娜·科特罗马尼奇是波斯尼亚公主，波斯尼亚班斯蒂芬一世与伊丽莎白·内马尼奇之女、波斯尼亚班斯蒂芬二世之妹，约1294年生，在斯雷布雷尼克和亚伊采的宫廷长大。约1310年，她嫁给扎胡姆列的茹潘尼古拉，定居于扎胡姆列治所布拉加伊，生有弗拉迪斯拉夫和博吉沙两子。有说法称尼古拉约1340年死后，她改嫁贵族武卡茨，成为伏伊伏达赫尔沃耶的母亲。1355年她卒于比尔比尔。

en: Kotroman, called Kotroman the Goth or the German in Ragusan writings, is the legendary forefather of the Bosnian Kotromanić dynasty. In 1432 the Ragusan government described him as a knight, a kinsman of the Hungarian king, who came from Hungary and took possession of the banate of Bosnia. The chronicler Mavro Orbini, citing an earlier source, presents him as a warrior appointed ban after the death of Ban Kulin about 1204. Genealogical reconstructions make him the grandfather of Bans Matej Ninoslav and Prijezda I, by two different sons.
zh: 科特罗曼，拉古萨文献中又称“哥特人科特罗曼”或“德意志人科特罗曼”，是波斯尼亚科特罗马尼奇王朝传说中的始祖。1432年，拉古萨政府的文献称他是一名骑士、匈牙利国王的亲属，从匈牙利前来取得了波斯尼亚的班之位。编年史家马夫罗·奥尔比尼引用更早的史料，把他写成约1204年班库林死后被匈牙利国王任命为班的武士。后世谱系考证认为，他的两个儿子分别生下了班马特伊·尼诺斯拉夫和普里耶兹达一世。

en: Maria Kotromanić (born around 1308) was a daughter of Ban Stephen I of Bosnia and Elizabeth Nemanjić, a sister of Ban Stephen II, and the wife of a certain Louis.
zh: 玛丽亚·科特罗马尼奇（约1308年生）是波斯尼亚班斯蒂芬一世与伊丽莎白·内马尼奇之女、波斯尼亚班斯蒂芬二世的姐妹，嫁给一名叫路德维希的人。

en: Maria of Bosnia (Marija Kotromanić, born after 1333, died 27 April 1403) was a Kotromanić princess, likely a younger daughter of Ban Stephen II, though her father has also been identified as his brothers Vladislav or Ninoslav. In 1352 Emperor Charles IV arranged her marriage to Ulrich V, Count of Helfenstein; she travelled to Passau and wed him on 9 May. A supporter of the emperor, she bore six sons and three daughters. Widowed when Ulrich was killed in 1372, she spent her later years at Bühringen and was probably buried at Überkingen, having founded a hospital in Swabia.
zh: 波斯尼亚的玛丽亚（玛丽亚·科特罗马尼奇，1333年后生，1403年4月27日卒）是科特罗马尼奇王朝的公主，可能是波斯尼亚班斯蒂芬二世的幼女，但也有说法称其父为斯蒂芬二世之弟弗拉迪斯拉夫或尼诺斯拉夫。1352年，皇帝查理四世安排她嫁给黑尔芬施泰因伯爵乌尔里希五世；她前往帕绍，于5月9日成婚。她是皇帝的支持者，生有六子三女。1372年丈夫被杀后她守寡，晚年居于比林根，可能葬于于伯金根，并曾在士瓦本捐资建立医院。

en: Matej Ninoslav (died 1250) was ban of Bosnia from 1232, when he replaced Stjepan Kulinić with the backing of the Bosnian Church. In 1233 he swore to Pope Gregory IX to remain a Catholic, while his cousin Prijezda gave his son as a hostage to seal his conversion. Gregory nonetheless proclaimed the Bosnian Crusade in 1234, and the Hungarian king granted Ninoslav's title to Coloman. Hungarian armies overran the country for years; after the Mongol invasion of 1241 Ninoslav restored his rule. He served as prince of Split from 1242 to 1244 and issued trade charters to Ragusa; his 1240 charter also promised protection against a Serbian attack. On his death in 1250 his cousin Prijezda succeeded him.
zh: 马特伊·尼诺斯拉夫（？—1250）自1232年起任波斯尼亚班，在波斯尼亚教会支持下取代了斯捷潘·库利尼奇。1233年，他向教宗格列高利九世宣誓继续信奉天主教；他的堂亲普里耶兹达交出儿子作为人质，为自己改宗作保。尽管如此，格列高利九世仍于1234年宣布发动波斯尼亚十字军，匈牙利国王也将尼诺斯拉夫的头衔授予科洛曼。匈牙利军队连年攻占波斯尼亚；1241年蒙古人入侵后，尼诺斯拉夫恢复了统治。1242至1244年他还出任斯普利特的领主，并向拉古萨颁发贸易特许状；他在1240年的特许状中还承诺保护拉古萨免受塞尔维亚进攻。1250年他去世，堂亲普里耶兹达继位。

en: Mladen II Šubić of Bribir (c. 1270–c. 1341) was the eldest son of Paul I Šubić, the most powerful Croatian noble of his day, who named him Ban of Bosnia in 1305. When Paul died in May 1312, Mladen inherited a dominion covering Croatia, Bosnia and the Dalmatian cities. He ruled Bosnia through Stephen Kotromanić as his vassal, bought off Venice's mercenary leader at Zadar, then returned the city to Venice in 1313 in return for autonomy. In 1315 he backed the exiles of Trogir and demanded that the city send him a blank sheet on which he would write his terms, settling for a heavy fine. After risings at Šibenik and Trogir in 1321–1322, Dalmatian cities and Croatian nobles turned on him, and King Charles Robert of Hungary, whom the Šubići had helped to his throne, came to defeat him at Bliska. Taken to Hungary, he died in prison around 1341; the family lost Bosnia and its dominance.
zh: 布里比尔的姆拉登二世·舒比奇（约1270—约1341）是保罗一世·舒比奇的长子，其父是当时克罗地亚最有权势的贵族，1305年立他为波斯尼亚班。1312年5月保罗去世，姆拉登继承了囊括克罗地亚、波斯尼亚和达尔马提亚诸城的领地。他通过封臣斯特凡·科特罗马尼奇统治波斯尼亚，收买了威尼斯在扎达尔的雇佣兵首领，又在1313年让该城以自治为条件回归威尼斯。1315年他支持特罗吉尔的流亡者，要求该城送来一张白纸，由他写下条件，最后以课以重罚了结。1321—1322年希贝尼克和特罗吉尔起事后，达尔马提亚诸城与克罗地亚贵族纷纷反对他；舒比奇家族曾帮助匈牙利国王查理·罗伯特登上王位，此时他亲自出兵，在布利斯卡击败姆拉登。姆拉登被带往匈牙利，约1341年死于狱中，家族也失去了波斯尼亚和昔日的主导地位。

en: Ninoslav Kotromanić, also called Miroslav, was a Bosnian prince born at Jajce around 1288, a son of Ban Stephen I of Bosnia and Elizabeth Nemanjić and brother of Ban Stephen II. When his father died around 1314 and the Šubić seized power, the chronicler Mavro Orbini records that Ninoslav and his brother Vladislav took refuge at Medvedgrad in Croatia rather than fleeing to Ragusa with their mother. He died before the autumn of 1353. Orbini notes that he left illegitimate sons barred from succession, and later tradition names Maria of Helfenstein and King Stephen Dabiša as his children.
zh: 尼诺斯拉夫·科特罗马尼奇，又名米罗斯拉夫，是波斯尼亚王公，约1288年生于亚伊采，为波斯尼亚班斯蒂芬一世与伊丽莎白·内马尼奇之子、波斯尼亚班斯蒂芬二世的兄弟。约1314年父亲去世、舒比奇家族掌权时，编年史家马夫罗·奥尔比尼记载，尼诺斯拉夫与兄弟弗拉迪斯拉夫没有随母亲逃往拉古萨，而是到克罗地亚的梅德韦德格勒避难。他在1353年秋前去世。奥尔比尼称他留有不能继承家业的私生子；后世传说则把黑尔芬施泰因伯爵夫人玛丽亚和波斯尼亚国王斯特凡·达比沙算作他的子女。

en: Paul I Šubić of Bribir (c. 1245–1312), head of the leading Croatian noble house, became Ban of Croatia in 1275. With his brothers he brought most Dalmatian coastal cities under his rule and fought Venice until peace in 1294. During the succession crisis he was the chief ally of the Angevins against the Árpáds, and escorted Charles Robert from Split to Zagreb in 1300. He conquered the Banate of Bosnia in 1299 and Hum in 1301. In 1304 he quelled a Bosnian rebellion after his brother Mladen was killed and made his son Mladen ban. He minted his own coin and founded three dioceses. He took Zadar from Venice in 1311 and died on 1 May 1312, leaving his domains to his son Mladen II.
zh: 布里比尔的保罗一世·舒比奇（约1245—1312）是克罗地亚头号贵族家族的首领，1275年出任克罗地亚班。他与兄弟们把达尔马提亚沿海多数城市置于统治之下，与威尼斯交战直至1294年议和。在王位继承危机中，他是安茹家族对抗阿帕德王朝的首要盟友，1300年护送查理·罗伯特从斯普利特前往萨格勒布。1299年他征服波斯尼亚班领地，1301年又攻取胡姆。1304年兄弟姆拉登被杀后，他平定波斯尼亚叛乱，任命儿子姆拉登为班。他自铸钱币，还设立了三个新教区。1311年他从威尼斯手中夺取扎达尔，1312年5月1日去世，领地传给儿子姆拉登二世。

en: An unnamed Kotromanić nobleman, reconstructed by genealogists as a son of the forefather Kotroman and as the father of Ban Prijezda I, who ruled Bosnia from about 1250.
zh: 一位佚名的科特罗马尼奇贵族，谱系考证认为他是始祖科特罗曼之子、约1250年起统治波斯尼亚的班普里耶兹达一世的父亲。

en: Prijezda I Kotromanić (fl. 1233–1287) was ban of Bosnia. His origins are disputed, though some historians regard him as the first known member of the Kotromanić dynasty. A kinsman of Ban Matej Ninoslav, he appears in 1233 as his vice-ban, newly returned to Catholicism from the Bosnian Church, and by 1240 had sided with Hungary against Ninoslav. With Hungarian backing he secured the banate by 1255, when King Béla IV granted him Bosnia proper; he received Podravina lands that year and campaigned against Bohemia in 1260. In 1284 his son Stephen married a daughter of the Serbian king Stefan Dragutin, and in 1287 he died in office.
zh: 普里耶兹达一世·科特罗马尼奇（活跃于1233—1287年）是波斯尼亚班。他的出身尚有争议，一些史学家将他视为科特罗马尼奇王朝首位有记载的成员。他是马特伊·尼诺斯拉夫的亲属，1233年以副班身份出现，当时刚从波斯尼亚教会重归天主教；到1240年又站在匈牙利一边反对尼诺斯拉夫。凭借匈牙利支持，他在1255年前坐稳班位，匈牙利国王贝拉四世将波斯尼亚本土封给他；同年他获封波德拉维纳的地产，1260年参加对波希米亚的战争。1284年，他的儿子斯捷潘娶塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·德拉古廷之女为妻；1287年，普里耶兹达死于任上。

en: Prijezda II Kotromanić (1242–1290) was a son of Ban Prijezda I of Bosnia. In the old ban's last surviving charter, issued in 1287, he granted a district in the Donji Kraji with the consent of his sons Stephen, Prijezda and Vuk. When Prijezda I died that year, the brothers divided Bosnia: Prijezda II took the western lands while Stephen I, called Kotroman, held the east. In 1290 the pope addressed a letter to Stephen and Prijezda as joint bans of Bosnia. Prijezda II died later that year, and his lands passed to his brother.
zh: 普里耶兹达二世·科特罗马尼奇（1242—1290）是波斯尼亚班普里耶兹达一世之子。1287年，老班在现存最后一份特许状中，经儿子斯捷潘、普里耶兹达和武克同意，把下克拉伊纳的一个茹帕封出。同年普里耶兹达一世去世，兄弟瓜分波斯尼亚：普里耶兹达二世领有西部，人称科特罗曼的斯捷潘一世领有东部。1290年，教宗致信“斯捷潘与普里耶兹达两位波斯尼亚班”，可见二人共同执政。普里耶兹达二世于同年去世，领地归于其兄。

en: The late sixteenth-century Ohmućević genealogy names Radingost Ohmućević as a son of Grgur Ohmutina and a kinsman of Hrelja Ohmućević, the protosebastos who ruled Strumica until his death in 1342.
zh: 16世纪末编成的《奥赫穆切维奇家谱》将拉迪戈斯特·奥赫穆切维奇列为格尔古尔·奥赫穆蒂纳之子，算作割据斯特鲁米察、1342年去世的普罗托塞巴斯托斯赫雷利亚·奥赫穆切维奇的族人。

en: Radivoj Kotromanić is named in Bosnian genealogical tradition as the father of Matej Ninoslav, ban of Bosnia from 1232 to 1250, and is reconstructed as a son of the dynasty's forefather Kotroman.
zh: 拉迪沃伊·科特罗马尼奇在波斯尼亚谱系传统中被记为1232至1250年在位的波斯尼亚班马特伊·尼诺斯拉夫之父，并被考证为王朝始祖科特罗曼之子。

en: The late sixteenth-century Ohmućević genealogy names Sanko Ohmućević as a son of Grgur Ohmutina, a brother of Radingost and a kinsman of the Strumica lord Hrelja Ohmućević. The same genealogy gives him two sons, Tvrtko and Dobroslav.
zh: 16世纪末的《奥赫穆切维奇家谱》将桑科·奥赫穆切维奇列为格尔古尔·奥赫穆蒂纳之子、拉迪戈斯特的兄弟、斯特鲁米察领主赫雷利亚的族人，家谱还载有其子特弗尔特科和多布罗斯拉夫。

en: An unnamed daughter or kinswoman of Tsar Michael Shishman of Bulgaria, she was married to Stephen II Kotromanić, Ban of Bosnia, in 1329 as his second wife and was still recorded as his consort in 1339.
zh: 她是保加利亚沙皇米哈伊尔·希什曼之女（一说亲属），1329年作为第二任妻子嫁给波斯尼亚班斯捷潘二世·科特罗马尼奇，1339年时仍为其妻，名字失载。

en: Stephen II Kotromanić (c. 1292–1353), Ban of Bosnia from 1314, was the son of Ban Stephen I and Elizabeth Nemanjić. After his father died the family fled to Ragusa, until the Croatian magnate Mladen II Šubić, who dominated Bosnia, installed him as a vassal. Stephen turned on Mladen with King Charles I of Hungary, whose victory in 1322 left him ruling in person. He annexed Usora and Soli in 1324, took Hum from Serbia, and ceded Ston and Pelješac to Ragusa in 1333. Playing Hungary and Venice against each other, in 1340 he persuaded the pope of his Catholic loyalty. In October 1350 Stefan Dušan invaded with a far larger army; Stephen blocked the roads and held Bobovac, and when Dušan gave up he retook the lost lands. His daughter Elizabeth went to Hungary to marry Louis I, but Stephen, ill, missed the wedding and died in September 1353, buried at Mile near Visoko. His young nephew Tvrtko succeeded.
zh: 斯特凡二世·科特罗曼尼奇（约1292—1353）自1314年起担任波斯尼亚班，是班斯特凡一世与伊丽莎白·尼曼吉奇之子。父亲死后，全家逃往拉古萨，直到支配波斯尼亚的克罗地亚大贵族姆拉登二世·舒比奇把他扶上去作附庸。斯特凡转而联合匈牙利国王查理一世反对姆拉登，1322年姆拉登败亡，他由此开始亲政。他于1324年吞并乌索拉和索利，又从塞尔维亚手中夺取胡姆，1333年将斯通和佩列沙茨割让给拉古萨。他让匈牙利与威尼斯互相牵制，1340年又说服教皇相信自己忠于天主教。1350年10月，斯特凡·杜尚率远多于他的大军入侵；斯特凡封锁道路，守住博博瓦茨，杜尚放弃后，他收复了失地。他的女儿伊丽莎白被送往匈牙利，要嫁给拉约什一世，但斯特凡病重，未能出席婚礼，于1353年9月去世，葬在维索科附近的米莱。年幼的侄子特夫尔特科继位。

en: Stephen I Kotromanić, called Kotroman (1242–1314), was ban of Bosnia and father of Ban Stephen II. From 1287 he ruled eastern Bosnia jointly with his brother Prijezda II, and alone from 1290. In 1284 he married Elizabeth, daughter of Stefan Dragutin, king of Syrmia, and fell under his influence. Amid Hungary's succession wars the Croatian Šubić family supported the Angevin claimants and overran most of his lands: by 1302 Mladen I Šubić held nearly all of Bosnia, and in 1305 Paul Šubić claimed all Bosnia. Mladen's persecution of the Bosnian Church drove some of its adherents to Kotroman's side. Kotroman nonetheless held out, but died in 1314, two years after Paul, before he could recover his realm.
zh: 斯蒂芬一世·科特罗马尼奇，人称“科特罗曼”（1242—1314），是波斯尼亚班，也是后来的班斯蒂芬二世之父。1287年起，他与兄弟普里耶兹达二世分治波斯尼亚，领有东部；1290年起独自统治。1284年，他娶斯雷姆国王斯特凡·德拉古廷之女伊丽莎白为妻，深受岳父影响。在匈牙利王位继承战争中，克罗地亚的舒比奇家族支持安茹王朝的王位要求者，攻占了他的大部分领地：到1302年，姆拉登一世·舒比奇已控制几乎整个波斯尼亚，1305年帕奥·舒比奇更自称全波斯尼亚之主。姆拉登迫害波斯尼亚教会，使部分信徒转而支持科特罗曼。科特罗曼坚持未降，但在帕奥死去两年后于1314年去世，未来得及收复领地。

en: Vladislav Kotromanić (1295–1354) was a younger son of Ban Stephen I of Bosnia and Elizabeth of Serbia, and younger brother of Ban Stephen II. As a child he fled the Šubić takeover into exile, Orbini placing him at Medvedgrad in Croatia. From 1326, titled knez, he jointly issued his brother’s charters. In late 1337 or early 1338 he married Jelena, daughter of George II Šubić, and had two sons, Tvrtko and Vuk. When Stephen II died in 1353 the title of Ban passed to the young Tvrtko, and Vladislav ruled Bosnia as regent until his own death in 1354.
zh: 弗拉迪斯拉夫·科特罗马尼奇（1295—1354）是波斯尼亚班斯蒂芬一世与塞尔维亚的伊丽莎白之子、波斯尼亚班斯蒂芬二世之弟。幼年时为躲避舒比奇家族夺权而流亡，编年史家奥尔比尼记载他避居克罗地亚的梅德韦德格勒。1326年起，他以“克奈兹”头衔与兄长联合签发文书。1337年底或1338年初，他娶乔治二世·舒比奇之女耶莱娜，生有特弗尔特科和武克两子。1353年斯蒂芬二世去世，班位传给年幼的特弗尔特科，弗拉迪斯拉夫以摄政身份统治波斯尼亚，直至1354年去世。

en: Archambaud IX, called the Young (1212–1249), was seigneur of Bourbon, Dampierre, Saint-Just and Saint-Dizier, the son of Archambaud VIII and Beatrice of Montluçon. He married Yolande I, Countess of Nevers; their daughters were Matilda II, Countess of Nevers, and Agnes, lady of Bourbon, who married John of Burgundy, Count of Charolais. In 1242 he revised the town taxes of Moulins, remitting its annual rent in exchange for a citizenship levy of two to six sols per person, graded by wealth. In 1248 he joined Louis IX's Seventh Crusade, but at the fleet's stopover in Cyprus an epidemic carried him off; he died there in January 1249.
zh: 阿尔尚博九世，绰号“年轻者”（1212—1249），是波旁、当皮埃尔、圣瑞斯特和圣迪济耶的领主，阿尔尚博八世与蒙吕松的贝阿特丽斯之子。他娶讷韦尔女伯爵约朗德一世为妻，两个女儿分别是讷韦尔女伯爵玛蒂尔德二世，以及波旁女主阿涅斯——后者嫁给了沙罗莱伯爵勃艮第的让。1242年，他调整穆兰的城镇税赋：免除市民的年租，改征按贫富分为每人二至六苏的“市民税”。1248年他随路易九世参加第七次十字军东征，舰队在塞浦路斯停留时爆发瘟疫，他于1249年1月病亡于该岛。

en: Archambaud VIII, called the Great (c. 1189–1242), was seigneur of Bourbon from 1216, succeeding his father Guy II of Dampierre; his mother was Mathilde I of Bourbon, heiress of the lordship. After Philip II Augustus confiscated Auvergne in 1213, he was made its guardian and in 1223 constable of Auvergne. His childhood marriage to Alix of Forez was annulled around 1211, and about 1215 he married Beatrice of Montluçon, mother of his heir Archambaud IX. In 1232 he granted a charter of liberties to the town of Moulins, clarifying and supplementing earlier privileges. The inhabitants undertook to pay the lords of Bourbon 200 livres annually in return. He died at the Battle of Taillebourg in 1242.
zh: 阿尔尚博八世，绰号“大帝”（约1189—1242），1216年继父亲居伊二世·德·当皮埃尔之后成为波旁领主；母亲是波旁领地的女继承人玛蒂尔德一世。腓力二世·奥古斯都于1213年没收奥弗涅后，他被任命为该地的监护人，1223年成为奥弗涅统帅。他幼年与福雷的阿莉克斯的婚姻约于1211年被取消，约1215年又娶蒙吕松的贝阿特丽斯，继承人阿尔尚博九世即其所生。1232年，他向穆兰镇颁发自由特许状，明确并补充了先前的特权。作为交换，居民承诺每年向波旁领主支付200里弗尔。1242年，他死于塔耶堡战役。

en: Beatrice of Burgundy (1257–1310) was ruling Lady of Bourbon suo jure from 1288, when she inherited the Bourbon estates through her mother, Agnes of Dampierre. Her father was John of Burgundy, a son of Duke Hugh IV of Burgundy. In 1272 she married Robert, Count of Clermont. Their eldest son, Louis I, called the Lame, became the first Duke of Bourbon; her other children included John, baron of Charolais, Blanche, who married the Count of Auvergne, and Margaret, who married the Marquis of Namur. Beatrice died on 1 October 1310.
zh: 勃艮第的比阿特丽斯（1257—1310）自1288年起凭自身身份统治波旁，经母亲阿涅丝·德·当皮埃尔继承了波旁的全部领地。她的父亲让·德·勃艮第是勃艮第公爵于格四世之子。1272年，她嫁给克莱蒙伯爵罗贝尔。长子路易一世人称“跛子”，成为第一代波旁公爵；其他子女还有沙罗莱男爵让、嫁给奥弗涅伯爵的布朗什，以及嫁给那慕尔侯爵的玛格丽特。比阿特丽斯于1310年10月1日去世。

en: Isabella of Valois (1313–1383) was the daughter of Charles of Valois and Mahaut of Châtillon, and half-sister of King Philip VI of France. On 25 January 1336 she married Peter I, Duke of Bourbon, and bore him eight children, including Louis II, Duke of Bourbon; Joanna, who married the future King Charles V in 1350; and Blanche, wife of King Peter of Castile. After Peter was killed at Poitiers in 1356 she took the veil. In 1369 mercenary captains seized her at Belleperche Castle; Charles V ransomed her in 1372. She died in Paris in 1383.
zh: 瓦卢瓦的伊莎贝拉（1313—1383）是瓦卢瓦的查理与沙蒂永的马奥之女，法兰西国王腓力六世的同父异母妹妹。1336年1月25日，她嫁给波旁公爵皮埃尔一世，生下八名子女，包括波旁公爵路易二世、1350年嫁给日后成为法王查理五世的让娜，以及卡斯蒂利亚国王佩德罗之妻布朗什。1356年皮埃尔在普瓦捷战死后，她出家修道。1369年，佣兵团首领在贝勒佩什城堡劫持了她，查理五世于1372年将她赎回。1383年她在巴黎去世。

en: James I of Bourbon (1319–1362), son of Duke Louis I and Mary of Avesnes, was Count of La Marche from 1341 and founder of the line that, seven generations on, gave France Henry IV. He fought for Charles de Blois in Brittany in 1341–1342 and was wounded at Crécy in 1346. Closeness to King John II brought him the county of Ponthieu in 1351 and the office of Constable of France in 1354–1356. At Poitiers in 1356 he was wounded again and captured. The 1360 Treaty of Brétigny freed him but cost him Ponthieu, returned to the English. Discharged mercenaries, the Free Companies, were now ravaging the countryside, and John ordered James and Jean de Tancarville to raise an army against them. On 6 April 1362 the companies surprised and routed it at Brignais; James and his eldest son died of their wounds at Lyon.
zh: 波旁的雅各一世（1319—1362）是波旁公爵路易一世与阿韦讷的玛丽之子，1341年起封拉马什伯爵，他开创的这一支，传了七代后出了法王亨利四世。1341至1342年，他在布列塔尼为夏尔·德·布卢瓦作战，1346年在克雷西负伤。他与国王约翰二世关系亲近，1351年得到蓬蒂厄伯爵领，1354至1356年任法兰西统帅。1356年在普瓦捷再度负伤并被俘。1360年《布雷蒂尼条约》使他获释，蓬蒂厄却被归还给英国人。被遣散的佣兵组成自由佣兵团，劫掠乡村，约翰二世命雅各与让·德·唐卡维尔集军讨伐。1362年4月6日，佣兵团在布里涅突袭并击溃这支军队；雅各与长子负伤，死于里昂。

en: Jeanne of Châtillon (1320–1371) was the daughter of Hugh of Châtillon, Lord of Leuze, and Joan of Argies. In 1335 she married James I of Bourbon, Count of La Marche from 1341, and was mother of his successor John I.
zh: 沙蒂永的让娜（1320—1371）是勒兹领主于格·德·沙蒂永与阿尔日的让娜之女。1335年她嫁给1341年成为拉马尔什伯爵的詹姆斯一世·德·波旁，是继任伯爵约翰一世的母亲。

en: Louis I, called the Lame (1279–1341), was the first Duke of Bourbon and a grandson of King Louis IX. Through his mother Beatrix of Burgundy he inherited the lordship of Bourbon. He fought at the Golden Spurs in 1302 and Mons-en-Pévèle in 1304 and became Grand Chamberlain of France in 1310. Crusading was his cause: he took the cross in 1316, and in 1318 he was named captain-general of a planned expedition, until Genoa destroyed the fleet assembling for it in 1319. In 1327 Charles IV had him give up Clermont for La Marche and raised Bourbon to a duchy-peerage; his support for Philip VI's claim to the throne won Clermont back in 1331. A further crusade plan was cancelled in 1336 as war with England loomed. Chroniclers report spells of severe mental infirmity, which some historians trace through his granddaughter Joanna to her son Charles VI. He died in 1341 and his son Peter succeeded him.
zh: 路易一世，绰号“跛子”（1279—1341），是第一代波旁公爵，法王路易九世之孙。他通过母亲勃艮第的贝阿特丽斯继承波旁领地，参加过1302年的金马刺战役和1304年的蒙桑佩韦勒战役，1310年出任法国宫廷总管。十字军是他一生的事业：1316年他立下十字军誓约，1318年被任命为筹备中的远征统帅，但集结中的舰队于1319年被热那亚人摧毁。1327年，查理四世让他交出克莱蒙，换取拉马什，并把波旁升格为公爵兼法兰西贵族领；他支持腓力六世继承王位，国王于1331年将克莱蒙归还给他。随着英法战争迫近，另一项十字军计划于1336年取消。编年史家记载他曾有严重的精神失常，一些史家认为这一病症经孙女让娜传到她的儿子查理六世身上。1341年他去世，儿子皮埃尔继位。

en: Mary of Avesnes (1280–1354), also called Marie of Hainaut, was a daughter of John II, Count of Holland and Hainaut, and Philippa of Luxembourg. In 1310 she married Louis I, Duke of Bourbon, and bore him eight children. Among them were Peter I, Duke of Bourbon, and James I, Count of La Marche, who were killed after her death at Poitiers in 1356 and Brignais in 1362 respectively; and Beatrice, who in 1334 married King John of Bohemia. Through her brother William I of Hainaut she was aunt to Philippa of Hainault, queen of Edward III of England.
zh: 阿韦讷的玛丽（1280—1354），又称埃诺的玛丽，是荷兰与埃诺伯爵约翰二世和卢森堡的菲莉帕之女。1310年她嫁给波旁公爵路易一世，共育有八名子女，其中包括波旁公爵皮埃尔一世和拉马尔什伯爵詹姆斯一世，他们在她去世后分别于1356年战死于普瓦捷、1362年战死于布里涅；还有1334年嫁给波希米亚国王约翰的比阿特丽丝。经由兄长埃诺伯爵威廉一世，她是英格兰国王爱德华三世王后埃诺的菲莉帕的姑母。

en: Marie de Bourbon (c. 1315–1387) was a daughter of Louis I, Duke of Bourbon and Mary of Avesnes. In 1329 she reached Cyprus to marry Guy of Lusignan, titular Prince of Galilee and son of King Hugh IV; their wedding was held at Santa Sophia in Nicosia in 1330, and their son Hugh was born around 1335. Left a widow in 1343, she was forbidden by her father-in-law to leave Cyprus until 1346. At Naples in 1347 she married Robert of Taranto, Prince of Achaea and titular Latin Emperor. When Robert died childless in 1364 she refused to accept his brother Philip II as heir. Holding sixteen castles in Achaea, she kept the title of princess and put forward Hugh, who invaded the Peloponnese in 1366 with 12,000 mercenaries. The war ended in 1370, when she sold her rights to Philip for 6,000 gold pieces and kept only Kalamata. She named her nephew Louis II of Bourbon her heir.
zh: 玛丽·德·波旁（约1315—1387）是波旁公爵路易一世与阿韦讷的玛丽之女。1329年她抵达塞浦路斯，嫁给名义上的加利利亲王、国王于格四世之子吕西尼昂的居伊；婚礼于1330年在尼科西亚的圣索菲亚教堂举行，儿子于格约生于1335年。1343年居伊去世后，公公禁止她离开塞浦路斯，直到1346年才准许。1347年，她在那不勒斯改嫁亚该亚亲王、名义上的拉丁帝国皇帝塔兰托的罗伯特。1364年罗伯特无嗣而终，她拒不承认其弟腓力二世继位，凭借在亚该亚拥有的十六座城堡，保留亲王头衔，推举于格争位；于格1366年率一万两千名雇佣兵入侵伯罗奔尼撒。战争于1370年结束，她以六千金币把权利卖给腓力，只保留卡拉马塔。她指定侄子波旁公爵路易二世为继承人。

en: Matilda II of Bourbon (1234–1262), also called Mahaut of Dampierre, was countess of Nevers, Auxerre and Tonnerre. She was the elder daughter of Archambaud IX, lord of Bourbon, and Yolande of Châtillon. In February 1248 she married Odo of Burgundy, eldest son of Duke Hugh IV, while her sister Agnes married Odo's brother John the same year. On the death of her great-grandmother Matilda of Courtenay in 1257 she entered into the three counties. She died in 1262 aged 28, and they were divided among her daughters: Yolande received Nevers, Margaret Tonnerre and Alix Auxerre.
zh: 玛蒂尔德二世·德·波旁（1234—1262），一称当皮埃尔的玛霍，是讷韦尔、欧塞尔和托内尔女伯爵。她是波旁领主阿尔尚博九世与沙蒂永的约兰德的长女。1248年2月，她嫁给勃艮第公爵于格四世的长子厄德；同年，妹妹阿涅丝嫁给厄德的弟弟让。1257年外曾祖母库特奈的玛蒂尔德去世后，她取得讷韦尔、欧塞尔和托内尔三个伯国。1262年她去世，年仅28岁，三个伯国由女儿们瓜分：约兰德得讷韦尔，玛格丽特得托内尔，阿莉克斯得欧塞尔。

en: Pierre d'André (c. 1300–1368), born at Clermont, rose from Keeper of the Seals of France and bishop of Noyon in 1339 to the sees of Clermont in 1342 and Cambrai in 1350. At Clermont, Pope Clement VI issued an indulgence bull in 1344 for those who helped complete the cathedral, yet in 1347 the bishop was fined for setting up a market without royal authority. At Cambrai his vicar general was Guillaume de Grimoard, the future Pope Urban V, and he is credited with building the palace clock and establishing the feast of Saint Martial. He died at Cambrai on 13 September 1368.
zh: 皮埃尔·德·安德烈（约1300—1368）生于克莱蒙，1339年出任法国掌玺大臣兼努瓦永主教，1342年调任克莱蒙主教，1350年调任康布雷主教。在克莱蒙，教皇克雷芒六世于1344年颁布赎罪券诏书，惠及捐助大教堂完工的人；但1347年，这位主教又因未经国王许可设立集市而被罚款。在康布雷，他的副主教是后来成为教皇乌尔班五世的纪尧姆·德·格里马尔，他还被认为主持修建了主教宫时钟，并设立了圣马夏尔节。1368年9月13日，他卒于康布雷。

en: Peter I (1311–1356) was the second Duke of Bourbon, succeeding his father Louis I in 1342 as duke and Grand Chamberlain of France. In 1336 he married Isabella of Valois, sister of King Philip VI. He fought in Brittany in 1341 under the future John II, helping the French claimant Charles de Blois take possession of the duchy. In August 1345 he was made lieutenant in Languedoc against Henry of Derby, later of Lancaster, who had already landed at Bordeaux, taken Bergerac and destroyed the French army there. Peter raised a new army at Angoulême, but Derby won at Auberoche in October and took La Réole in January 1346. He was wounded at Crécy in August. From 1347 he led peace embassies, all fruitless. On 19 September 1356 he was killed at Poitiers, shielding King John II with his body; his daughters Joanna and Blanche had married Charles V of France and Peter the Cruel of Castile.
zh: 皮埃尔一世（1311—1356）是第二代波旁公爵，1342年继承父亲路易一世的公爵之位，并接任法国宫廷总管。1336年他娶法王腓力六世之妹瓦卢瓦的伊莎贝拉为妻。1341年，他在未来的约翰二世麾下于布列塔尼作战，协助法方继承人夏尔·德·布卢瓦接管公国。1345年8月，他被任命为朗格多克督军，对手是德比的亨利，即后来的兰开斯特的亨利；后者已在波尔多登陆，攻克贝尔热拉克，并击溃当地的法军。皮埃尔在昂古莱姆募集新军，但德比10月在欧贝罗什获胜，1346年1月又拿下拉雷奥勒。8月，他在克雷西负伤。1347年起他多次率团进行和谈，均无结果。1356年9月19日，他在普瓦捷战役中为护卫国王约翰二世而阵亡；他的女儿让娜和布朗什分别嫁给了法王查理五世与卡斯蒂利亚的残忍者佩德罗。

en: Robert, Count of Clermont (1256–1317), was the youngest son of King Louis IX of France and Margaret of Provence, created count in 1268. A head injury in youth left him handicapped, so he played little part in public affairs. In 1272 he married Beatrice of Burgundy, heiress to the lordship of Bourbon. Through their son Louis I, the first Duke of Bourbon, Robert became the founder of the House of Bourbon, which inherited the French throne in 1589 when the other Capetian male lines failed. He died on 7 February 1317 and was buried in Paris's Jacobins convent.
zh: 克莱蒙伯爵罗贝尔（1256—1317）是法王路易九世（圣路易）与普罗旺斯的玛格丽特的幼子，1268年受封为伯爵。他年轻时头部受伤致残，因此很少参与政务。1272年他与波旁领地的女继承人勃艮第的贝阿特丽斯成婚。凭借其子、第一代波旁公爵路易一世，罗贝尔成为波旁家族的始祖；1589年卡佩王朝其他男系绝嗣后，正是这一支继承了法国王位。他于1317年2月7日去世，葬于巴黎的雅各宾修道院。

en: Yolande of Châtillon (c. 1221–1254) was the daughter of Guy II, Count of Saint-Pol, and Agnes II of Donzy, heiress of Nevers, Tonnerre and Auxerre. Her mother died in 1225 and her father was killed at the siege of Avignon in 1226; her grandmother Matilda of Courtenay raised her. She married Archambaud IX, lord of Bourbon, and in 1248 followed him on the Seventh Crusade; he died in an epidemic in Cyprus in 1249 and she brought his body home. When her brother Gaucher died in 1250 she inherited the three counties; at her death in 1254 they went to her daughter Matilda and Bourbon to Agnes.
zh: 沙蒂永的约兰德，又称讷韦尔的约兰德（约1221—1254），是圣波勒伯爵居伊二世与讷韦尔、托内尔和欧塞尔女伯爵阿涅丝二世·德·栋济之女。1225年母亲去世，1226年父亲死于阿维尼翁围城战，她幼年成孤，由外祖母玛蒂尔德·德·库特奈抚养。她嫁给波旁领主阿尔尚博九世，1248年随他参加路易九世的第七次十字军；1249年他在塞浦路斯染病身亡，她将遗体运回法国。1250年兄弟戈谢死后，她继承讷韦尔、托内尔和欧塞尔；1254年去世后，这些领地归女儿玛蒂尔达，波旁则归女儿阿涅丝。

en: Atula Dewi (born 1266), personal name Min Hla Myat, was the chief queen consort of Thihathu, Viceroy of Prome, in the final years of the Pagan Empire. She was the youngest and only sister of Athinkhaya, Yazathingyan and Thihathu, the three brothers who founded the Myinsaing Kingdom after Pagan's collapse. In 1287 her husband murdered his own father, King Narathihapate, and was himself killed at Pegu in 1288 before he could seize the throne. Her daughter Shin Myat Hla became the mother of King Swa Saw Ke of Ava, who came to the throne in 1367.
zh: 阿杜拉·代维（1266年生），本名敏拉妙，是蒲甘王朝末期卑谬总督梯诃都的首席王后。她是蒲甘崩溃后建立敏象王国的阿丁克亚、亚扎丁坚和梯诃都三兄弟唯一的妹妹，年纪最幼。1287年，她的丈夫毒杀生父、国王那腊底哈勃德，1288年在勃固尚未夺位便丧命。她的女儿欣妙拉生下了阿瓦国王苏绍基，后者于1367年登上王位。

en: Min Shin Saw was governor of Thayet, a vassal state of the Pinya Kingdom in Upper Burma. A son of King Kyawswa of Pagan, he married Shin Myat Hla, niece of King Thihathu of Pinya. In January 1334, Arakanese raiders sacked Thayet and carried his whole family off to the Arakanese capital Launggyet, where they were held for nearly a decade and the children were educated. Allowed to return in 1343 or 1344, he was reappointed to his old governorship. His sons included Swa Saw Ke, founder of the Ava Kingdom, and Saw Yan Naung of Prome.
zh: 敏欣绍是上缅甸彬牙王国属邦德耶的总督，为蒲甘国王觉苏瓦之子，娶彬牙国王底哈都的侄女欣妙拉为妻。1334年1月，若开军队劫掠德耶，将他全家掳往若开都城隆邑，扣押近十年，孩子们在那里受教育。1343或1344年，一家人获准返回，他被重新任命为德耶总督。他的儿子中有阿瓦王朝的实际奠基人明基苏瓦绍盖，以及卑谬总督绍扬南。

en: Saw Myat (born 1332), also called Saw Myat Ke, was a daughter of Governor Min Shin Saw of Thayet and a younger sister of King Swa Saw Ke of Ava. Still an infant, she was carried off with the whole family to the Arakanese capital Launggyet after the January 1334 sack of Thayet, and returned with them in 1343 or 1344. From the 1360s to the 1390s she was duchess of the town of Sagu. She was the paternal grandmother of Shin Bo-Me, who became a principal queen of Ava.
zh: 绍妙（1332年生），又名绍妙基，是德耶总督敏欣绍之女、阿瓦国王明基苏瓦绍盖的妹妹。1334年1月德耶陷落时她尚在襁褓，随全家被掳往阿腊干都城隆邑，1343或1344年才一同返回。1360年代至1390年代，她是萨古城的总督夫人。她的孙女是后来成为阿瓦首席王后的信菩弥。

en: Saw Omma (born c. 1333), originally named Ommadanti, was the youngest child of Governor Min Shin Saw of Thayet and Shin Myat Hla, and sister of King Swa Saw Ke of Ava. She spent her childhood in Arakanese captivity at Launggyet after the January 1334 sack of Thayet, returning around 1343. Her beauty made her chief queen to the last three kings of Pinya, Kyawswa II, Narathu and Uzana II, and then to King Thado Minbya of Ava. After Thado Minbya died in 1367, she and commander Nga Nu failed to seize the throne, and her brother Swa pardoned her.
zh: 绍翁玛（约1333年生），原名翁玛丹蒂，是德耶总督敏欣绍与欣妙拉最小的孩子、阿瓦国王明基苏瓦绍盖的妹妹。1334年1月德耶陷落后，她的童年在阿腊干隆邑的扣留岁月中度过，约1343年返回。凭借美貌，她先后成为彬牙末代三位国王觉苏瓦艾、那罗多和乌者那二世，以及阿瓦国王德多明帕耶的首席王后。1367年德多明帕耶死后，她与禁军统领鄂努图谋篡位失败，其兄明基苏瓦绍盖赦免了她。

en: Saw Pale (born 1331) was a daughter of Governor Min Shin Saw of Thayet and Shin Myat Hla, and the eldest younger sister of King Swa Saw Ke of Ava. She was carried to Arakan with her family in the 1334 sack of Thayet and returned in 1343 or 1344. She married Thilawa, governor of Yamethin, the commander who in 1367 declined the Ava throne himself and recommended her brother as king. She was duchess of Yamethin from about 1351 to 1395 or 1396, mother of Queen Min Hla Myat and maternal grandmother of King Kale Kye-Taung Nyo.
zh: 绍布莱（1331年生）是德耶总督敏欣绍与欣妙拉之女、阿瓦国王明基苏瓦绍盖的大妹。1334年德耶陷落时她随家人被掳往阿腊干，1343或1344年返回。她嫁给央米丁总督梯罗伐；1367年，正是这位名将自己辞让王位，转而推举她的兄长登上阿瓦王位。约1351—1395或1396年间她身为央米丁总督夫人，是阿瓦王后敏拉妙之母、国王格礼杰当纽的外祖母。

en: Saw Yan Naung (1323/24–1377/78) held Prome, on the Irrawaddy, for over three decades. A grandson of King Kyawswa of Pagan, he was born to Governor Min Shin Saw of Thayet. In 1334 Arakanese raiders carried his family off to Launggyet, where a learned monk educated the children until their release in 1343–1344. Kyawswa I of Pinya then made him governor of Prome. As Pinya's authority collapsed in the late 1350s he ruled like a sovereign, though he never declared independence as Toungoo did. He joined his younger brother Swa Saw Ke, the new king of Ava, in 1367–1368. In 1375 Swa, unwilling to fight Hanthawaddy over Toungoo, enlisted him against Pyanchi I, Toungoo's viceroy, who had allied with Hanthawaddy. Saw Yan Naung proposed a marriage between his daughter and Pyanchi's son, to be held at Prome; Pyanchi came with a small force and was ambushed and killed. Swa made his brother viceroy, and he died in 1377 or 1378.
zh: 绍扬南（1323/24—1377/78）在三十余年间执掌伊洛瓦底江畔的卑谬。他是蒲甘国王憍苴之孙，父亲是德耶总督敏欣绍。1334年，若开人袭击德耶，将他全家掳往隆吉，一位博学的僧人教导诸子女，直到1343至1344年获释。彬牙国王憍苴一世随即任命他为卑谬总督。1350年代末彬牙中央权力崩塌，他像独立君主般统治卑谬，却不曾像东吁那样正式宣布独立。1367至1368年，他投奔弟弟、阿瓦新王斯伐修寄。1375年，斯伐不愿为东吁与汉达瓦底开战，便让他对付已与汉达瓦底结盟的东吁副王般师一世。绍扬南提议让自己的女儿与般师之子联姻，婚礼在卑谬举行；般师率小队人马前来，被伏击身亡。斯伐因此将兄长升为副王；他于1377或1378年去世。

en: Shin Myat Hla was a Pagan princess born around 1288, the only daughter of Viceroy Thihathu of Prome and Atula Dewi, herself sister of the three founders of the Myinsaing Kingdom. Through her father she was a granddaughter of King Narathihapate, the last ruler of the Pagan Empire. She married Min Shin Saw, governor of Thayet, and in January 1334 was carried off with her whole family to the Arakanese capital Launggyet after a raid on Thayet; they returned in 1343 or 1344. Her six children included King Swa Saw Ke of Ava and Queen Saw Omma of Pinya.
zh: 欣妙拉约生于1288年，是蒲甘王朝的公主，为卑谬总督底哈都与阿杜拉·黛维之女；其母是后来创建敏象王国的三兄弟的姐妹，其父则是蒲甘帝国末代国王那罗梯诃波帝之子。她嫁给德耶总督敏欣绍，1334年1月德耶遭若开军队袭破后，与全家一同被掳往若开都城隆邑，至1343或1344年才返回。她生有六个子女，其中包括阿瓦国王明基苏瓦绍盖和彬牙王后绍翁玛。

en: Shwe Nan Shin (born 1322) was the eldest child of Governor Min Shin Saw of Thayet and his wife Shin Myat Hla, and the elder brother of King Swa Saw Ke of Ava. In January 1334, Arakanese raiders sacked Thayet and carried him off with the rest of his family to Launggyet in Arakan, where they were held until 1343 or 1344. The family was treated well at court, and the children were taught by an Arakanese monk. After their return to the Pinya Kingdom, his father was reappointed at Thayet, while he and his brother Saw Yan Naung became governors of Myinsaing and Prome respectively.
zh: 瑞南欣（1322年生）是德耶总督敏欣绍与欣妙拉的长子，也是阿瓦国王明基苏瓦绍盖的长兄。1334年1月，若开军队攻破德耶，他与全家一同被掳往若开隆邑，直到1343或1344年才获释。一家人在宫廷受到善待，孩子们由一位若开僧人教导。返回彬牙王国后，父亲复任德耶总督，他与弟弟绍扬南则分别出任敏象和卑谬总督。

en: Mingyi Swa Saw Ke (16 July 1330 – April 1400) ruled Ava from 1367 to 1400 and founded its power. A son of Governor Min Shin Saw of Thayet, he spent his youth in Arakanese captivity after the 1334 sack of Thayet, then governed Talok and Yamethin. Chosen to succeed Thado Minbya, he reunified Upper Burma, checked Maw raids, brought Toungoo and Prome under Ava, and in 1373 placed his nominee on the Arakanese throne. His invasions of Pegu from 1385 opened the Forty Years' War, ending in a 1391 truce. He died in April 1400, succeeded by his son Tarabya.
zh: 明基苏瓦绍盖（1330年7月16日—1400年4月）是阿瓦王朝实际的奠基人，1367—1400年在位。他是德耶总督敏欣绍之子，1334年德耶被阿腊干军队攻破后自幼在隆邑为质，其后先后受封达洛与央米丁。被群臣推举继德多明帕耶之后即位后，他重新统一上缅甸，遏制麓川侵扰，使东吁与卑谬臣服，并于1373年把属意的人选扶上阿腊干王位。1385年起他多次南征勃固，开启阿瓦与勃固的四十年战争，最终于1391年停战。1400年4月驾崩，其子德勒帕耶继位。

en: Thihathu (d. 1288) was a son of King Narathihapate, the last sovereign ruler of the Pagan Empire, and served as viceroy of Prome from 1275. During the Mongol invasion of 1283–1285 his father fled Pagan and submitted to the Mongols in 1287; when the king passed through Prome on his way back, Thihathu seized him on 1 July 1287 and forced him to swallow poison. He then murdered a rival half-brother, Uzana of Pathein, and marched on Dala and Pegu, where in 1288 he accidentally killed himself with his own crossbow bolt.
zh: 梯诃都（？—1288）是蒲甘帝国末代国王那腊底哈勃德之子，1275年起任卑谬总督。1283至1285年蒙古入侵期间，其父逃离蒲甘，并于1287年向蒙古称臣；国王返回途中经过卑谬，梯诃都于1287年7月1日将他拘捕，逼他服毒自尽。随后他杀害了与自己争位的异母兄弟勃生总督乌扎那，又进军达拉和勃固，1288年在勃固被自己的弩箭误杀身亡。

en: Fayid ibn Muqaddam was an Arab amir of the Banu Hayb, a branch of the Banu Sulaym that dominated Barqa in modern Libya under Mamluk overlordship. During the third reign of Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad he was the recognized muqaddam, or chief, of the Arabs of Barqa. In 1319 he and Sulayman, both of the Banu Muqaddam, led tribal auxiliaries from al-Buhayra in the sultan's expedition against the rebel amir Ja'far ibn Umar of the Ja'afira.
zh: 法伊德·本·穆卡丹是巴努海卜部的阿拉伯埃米尔；该部是巴努苏莱姆人的分支，在马穆鲁克宗主权下据有今利比亚的拜尔盖。在苏丹纳绥尔·穆罕默德第三次在位期间，他是拜尔盖阿拉伯人公认的首领（阿拉伯语称穆卡丹）。1319年，他与同属巴努穆卡丹部的苏莱曼一起，率领来自布海拉的部落辅助军，参加苏丹征讨贾法拉部反叛埃米尔贾法尔·本·欧麦尔的战役。

en: Agnes of Bavaria (1276–1345) was a daughter of Duke Louis II of Upper Bavaria and Matilda of Habsburg. In 1290, at Donauwörth, she married Henry the Younger of Hesse, son of Landgrave Henry I of Hesse; their daughter Agnes became the wife of Count Gerlach I of Nassau. After Henry's death in 1298, she married Margrave Henry I of Brandenburg-Stendal of the House of Ascania in 1303. This marriage produced Henry II, Sophia, who married Duke Magnus of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel, and Judith, wife of Duke Henry II of Brunswick-Grubenhagen. She died in 1345.
zh: 巴伐利亚的阿格尼丝（1276—1345）是上巴伐利亚公爵路易二世与哈布斯堡的玛蒂尔达之女。1290年，她在多瑙沃特嫁给黑森领地伯爵亨利一世之子“小亨利”，两人的女儿阿格尼丝后来成为拿骚伯爵格拉赫一世之妻。1298年丈夫去世后，她于1303年改嫁阿斯坎尼家族的勃兰登堡-施滕达尔藩侯亨利一世，生下亨利二世、索菲亚和尤迪特：索菲亚嫁给不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔公爵马格努斯，尤迪特嫁给不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根公爵亨利二世。她于1345年去世。

en: Albert the Bear (Albrecht der Bär, c. 1100–1170), son of Count Otto of Ballenstedt, was the first margrave of Brandenburg and founder of Ascanian rule in the mark. King Lothair enfeoffed him with the Northern March in 1134, and from 1138 to 1142 he briefly held the Duchy of Saxony. He joined the Wendish Crusade in 1147 and in 1150 inherited Brandenburg from the Wendish prince Pribislav-Henry, founding the Margraviate of Brandenburg in 1157. He promoted Dutch and German settlement east of the Elbe, accompanied Frederick Barbarossa to Italy in 1162, and died in November 1170, buried at Ballenstedt.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿尔布雷希特一世_(勃兰登堡)
zh: 绰号“熊”的阿尔布雷希特一世（约1100—1170）是巴伦施泰特伯爵奥托之子，勃兰登堡第一位藩侯，阿斯坎尼家族在该地区统治的开创者。1134年，洛泰尔国王将北边区封给他；1138至1142年间他一度领有萨克森公国。1147年他参加文德十字军，1150年从文德王公普里比斯拉夫—亨利处继承勃兰登堡，并于1157年建立勃兰登堡藩侯国。他鼓励荷兰与德意志移民在易北河以东定居垦殖，1162年随腓特烈一世出征意大利，1170年11月去世，葬于巴伦施泰特。

en: Albert II (c. 1177–1220), youngest son of Margrave Otto I and Ada of Holland, ruled Brandenburg from 1205 as the fourth Ascanian margrave. He joined the German Crusade of 1197 and attended the Teutonic Knights' founding in Acre in 1198. At first he supported Philip of Swabia, but after Philip's murder in 1208 he turned to Emperor Otto IV, who confirmed the margraviate in 1212. He secured Teltow, Prignitz and parts of the Uckermark, though Pomerania was lost to the Griffins. When he died in 1220 his young sons John I and Otto III succeeded under a regency.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿爾布雷希特二世_(勃蘭登堡)
zh: 阿尔布雷希特二世（约1177—1220）是藩侯奥托一世与爱达的幼子，1205年继位为阿斯坎尼王朝第四代勃兰登堡藩侯。他参加了1197年的德意志十字军，1198年在阿卡出席条顿骑士团的成立大会。继位之初他支持士瓦本的菲利普，1208年菲利普遇刺后转而投靠皇帝奥托四世，后者于1212年以诏书确认勃兰登堡的地位。他稳固了泰尔托、普里格尼茨和部分乌克马克，波美拉尼亚却被格芬家族夺去。1220年他去世时，两个儿子约翰一世与奥托三世尚年幼，由他人摄政。

en: Albert III (c. 1250–1300) was an Ascanian margrave of Brandenburg-Salzwedel, son of Margrave Otto III and Beatrice of Bohemia. He was a co-ruler while his cousin Otto IV 'with the Arrow' held power. He administered Stargard, acquired from Pomerania in 1236, and was lord of Stargard and Lychen from 1284. After his sons died around 1299, he sold Stargard to his son-in-law Henry II of Mecklenburg, who held it as a Brandenburg fief under the 1304 Treaty of Vietmannsdorf. In 1299 he founded the Cistercian Coeli Porta monastery at Lychen. After his death in 1300 he was buried at Lehnin Abbey, and in 1309 his body was transferred to Coeli Porta.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿爾布雷希特三世_(勃蘭登堡-薩爾茲維德爾)
zh: 阿尔布雷希特三世（约1250—1300）是阿斯坎尼家族勃兰登堡-萨尔茨韦德尔支系的边境侯爵，为奥托三世侯爵与波希米亚的贝阿特丽切之子。他仅为共治者，实权掌握在堂兄“持箭者”奥托四世手中。他管理1236年从波美拉尼亚取得的施塔加德领地，1284年起成为施塔加德和利兴的领主。诸子约于1299年死后，他把施塔加德卖给女婿梅克伦堡的亨利二世；1304年的《菲特曼斯多夫条约》确认亨利以勃兰登堡采邑的形式持有该地。1299年他在利兴创立西多会“天门”修道院。1300年死后他先葬于莱宁修道院，1309年遗体迁至天门修道院。

en: Anna of Austria (1275/1280–1327) was born in Vienna, a daughter of Albert I of Germany and Elisabeth of Tirol. In 1295 at Graz she married Herman, Margrave of Brandenburg-Salzwedel, and bore him four children, including his heir John. Herman died in 1308 and their young son succeeded him; when John died in 1317, the Brandenburg-Salzwedel line of the Ascanians became extinct. In 1310 Anna married Henry VI the Good, Duke of Wrocław, by whom she had three daughters. She died at Legnica in 1327.
zh: 奥地利的安娜（1275/1280—1327）生于维也纳，是德意志国王阿尔布雷希特一世与蒂罗尔的伊丽莎白之女。1295年，她在格拉茨嫁给勃兰登堡-萨尔茨韦德尔藩侯赫尔曼，生下包括继承人约翰在内的四个子女。赫尔曼于1308年去世，年幼的约翰继位；约翰1317年夭亡后，阿斯坎尼家族的勃兰登堡-萨尔茨韦德尔支系绝嗣。1310年，安娜改嫁弗罗茨瓦夫公爵“善人”亨里克六世，又生三女。她于1327年在莱格尼察去世。

en: Frederick I (1371–1440) was a Hohenzollern prince, born in Nuremberg, who ruled as Burgrave Frederick VI of that city. A trusted servant of King Sigismund, he fought at Nicopolis in 1396 and represented him in the disputed imperial election of 1410. In 1411 Sigismund made him captain and administrator of Brandenburg, where he crushed the rebellious nobility led by the Quitzow family. At the Council of Constance on 30 April 1415 Sigismund made him Margrave and Elector of Brandenburg, with formal enfeoffment in April 1417, founding Hohenzollern rule there. Frederick withdrew to Cadolzburg in 1425 and transferred the regency of Brandenburg to his son John in 1426, while remaining elector until his death in 1440.
zh: 腓特烈一世（1371—1440）是生于纽伦堡的霍亨索伦家族王公，在该城称伯爵腓特烈六世。他深受国王西吉斯蒙德信任，1396年参加尼科波利斯之战，1410年在有争议的帝国选举中代表西吉斯蒙德投票。1411年，西吉斯蒙德任命他为勃兰登堡最高长官兼摄政，他镇压了以奎措家族为首的叛乱贵族。1415年4月30日，西吉斯蒙德在康斯坦茨会议上封他为勃兰登堡藩侯兼选帝侯，1417年4月正式授封，开创了霍亨索伦家族在勃兰登堡的统治。1425年腓特烈退居卡多尔茨堡，1426年将勃兰登堡摄政权交给儿子约翰，但仍保有选帝侯之位，直至1440年去世。

en: Henry I, called Lackland (1256–1318), was an Ascanian margrave of Brandenburg-Stendal, a younger son of Margrave John I and Jutta of Saxony. Long excluded from government by his older brothers, he only received Delitzsch in Landsberg as his seat in 1294. He feuded with neighbouring princes, losing the County Palatine of Saxony to Duke Rudolf I of Saxony in 1311. After Emperor Henry VII's death, his nephew Waldemar proposed him as King of the Romans, but Henry declined and in 1314 voted for Louis IV of Bavaria. By Agnes of Bavaria he fathered Henry II, Brandenburg's last Ascanian margrave.
zh: 亨利一世，绰号“无地者”（1256—1318），阿斯坎尼家族的勃兰登堡-施滕达尔边境侯爵，是约翰一世侯爵与萨克森的尤塔之子。他长期被兄长们排除在统治之外，直到1294年才得到位于兰茨贝格边区的德利奇作为自己的驻地。他与邻邦诸侯争斗，1311年败于萨克森公爵鲁道夫一世，失去萨克森行宫伯爵领。皇帝亨利七世死后，他的侄子瓦尔德马曾推举他为罗马人的国王候选人，亨利辞而不受，1314年转而投票支持巴伐利亚的路易四世。他与巴伐利亚的阿格尼丝生有亨利二世，即勃兰登堡最后一位阿斯坎尼家族边境侯爵。

en: Henry II, called the Child (c. 1308 – July 1320), was the last margrave of Brandenburg from the House of Ascania, the son of Margrave Henry I Lackland and Agnes of Bavaria. In 1319, aged eleven, he succeeded his childless cousin Waldemar. Duke Wartislaw IV of Pomerania seized the regency until Rudolph I of Saxe-Wittenberg intervened; King Louis IV, his mother's half-brother, then declared Henry of age without enfeoffing him. He died in July 1320 before ruling in person. His death ended Ascanian rule, and in 1323 Louis IV enfeoffed his son Louis V with Brandenburg.
zh: 亨利二世，绰号“孩童”（约1308—1320年7月），勃兰登堡最后一位阿斯坎尼家族边境侯爵，是“无地者”亨利一世与巴伐利亚的阿格尼丝之子。1319年，无嗣的堂兄瓦尔德马去世，年仅十一岁的亨利继位。波美拉尼亚公爵瓦季斯瓦夫四世趁机自任摄政，直到萨克森-维滕贝格公爵鲁道夫一世出面干预；亨利母亲的同母异父兄长、国王路易四世随后宣布亨利成年，却没有把勃兰登堡正式封给他。他于1320年7月早逝，始终未能亲政。他的死标志着阿斯坎尼家族统治的终结，1323年路易四世把勃兰登堡封给自己的儿子路易五世。

en: Herman, called the Tall (the Long) (c. 1275 – 1 February 1308), was an Ascanian margrave of Brandenburg-Salzwedel, son of Margrave Otto V and Judith of Henneberg. From 1299 he ruled Brandenburg as co-ruler with his cousin Otto IV of Brandenburg-Stendal, and guarded the children of the Piast duke Bolko I of Jawor after his death. In 1308 Brandenburg fought Mecklenburg in the North German Margrave War; Herman died on 1 February while besieging Lübz. Buried at Lehnin Abbey, he left by his wife Anne of Austria, daughter of King Albert I of Germany, a son and successor, John V.
zh: 赫尔曼，绰号“高个子”（约1275—1308年2月1日），阿斯坎尼家族勃兰登堡-萨尔茨韦德尔支系的边境侯爵，奥托五世侯爵与亨讷贝格的尤迪特之子。1299年起，他与堂兄勃兰登堡-施滕达尔的奥托四世共同治理勃兰登堡，并在皮亚斯特系的亚沃尔公爵布尔科一世死后担任其子女的监护人。1308年，勃兰登堡在北德边境侯爵战争中对梅克伦堡作战，赫尔曼在围攻吕布茨时于2月1日去世，葬于莱宁修道院。妻子是德意志国王阿尔布雷希特一世之女、奥地利的安娜，其子约翰五世继位。

en: Alexander von Humboldt (1769–1859), younger brother of Wilhelm, was a Prussian polymath, geographer and naturalist born in Berlin. From 1799 to 1804 he travelled across the Spanish Americas with the French botanist Aimé Bonpland, tracing the source of the Orinoco and in 1802 climbing Ecuador's Mount Chimborazo to a record altitude for a Westerner. His account of the journey appeared in several volumes over 21 years. Drawing on observations made during his travels, he described local climatic changes caused by human development in 1800 and again in 1831. His quantitative work on plant distribution by altitude and climate founded biogeography, and he pioneered systematic geomagnetic and meteorological observation. His later multi-volume Kosmos presented nature as one interacting whole, making him a founder of ecology.
zh: 亚历山大·冯·洪堡（1769—1859），普鲁士博学家、地理学家、博物学家，生于柏林，是威廉·冯·洪堡的弟弟。1799至1804年，他与法国植物学家埃梅·邦普兰游历西属美洲，探查到奥里诺科河源头，并于1802年攀登厄瓜多尔的钦博拉索山，创下当时西方人登山海拔的最高纪录。他的旅行记历时21年分卷出版。他依据旅途中的观察，于1800年和1831年论述了人类开发活动造成的地方气候变化。他对植物随海拔和气候分布的定量研究奠定了生物地理学的基础，又推动了地磁与气象的长期系统观测。他晚年的多卷本《宇宙》把自然界描绘为相互联系的统一整体，被视为生态学的奠基人之一。

en: John I (c. 1213–1266) was the elder son of Margrave Albert II and ruled Brandenburg jointly with his brother Otto III the Pious from 1220, in person after 1225. Their reign enlarged the margraviate with remaining Teltow and Barnim, the Uckermark, Stargard, the Lubusz Land and first Neumark lands beyond the Oder. They promoted Cölln and Berlin and made Spandau Castle their residence. In 1230 he married Sophie, daughter of King Valdemar II of Denmark, and between 1261 and 1264 held King Eric V of Denmark prisoner. In 1258 the brothers founded Mariensee Abbey for John's line, and in 1266 they founded Chorin Abbey.
zh: 约翰一世（约1213—1266）是藩侯阿尔布雷希特二世的长子，1220年起与弟弟“虔诚者”奥托三世共同统治勃兰登堡，1225年后亲政。兄弟二人在位期间大幅扩张，取得泰尔托和巴尔尼姆的残余地区、乌克马克、施塔加德领地、卢布斯领地，以及奥得河以东新马克的首批土地。他们推动克尔恩与柏林的发展，把施潘道城堡扩为居所。1230年，他娶丹麦国王瓦尔德马二世之女苏菲亚为妻，1261至1264年间曾囚禁丹麦国王埃里克五世。1258年，兄弟二人为约翰一系创建马里恩塞修道院，1266年又创建科林修道院。

en: John II (1237–1281) was the eldest son of Margrave John I and Sophie of Denmark, and from 1266 co-ruler of the Brandenburg-Stendal line alongside his brothers Otto IV and Conrad I, overshadowed politically by Otto IV and also holding the title Lord of Krossen. In 1269 he was a co-signatory of the Treaty of Arnswalde with Duke Mestwin II of Pomerelia. Much of his surviving record concerns Chorin Abbey, the Cistercian house founded by his father: in 1273 the three brothers confirmed moving it from Mariensee to Chorin, where John was buried after his death in 1281.
zh: 约翰二世（1237—1281）是勃兰登堡藩侯约翰一世与丹麦的苏菲亚的长子，1266年起与弟弟奥托四世、康拉德一世共同统治勃兰登堡-施滕达尔一系，在政治上不及奥托四世显眼，还领有克罗森领主的头衔。1269年，他联署了与波美雷利亚公爵梅斯特温二世订立的《阿恩斯瓦尔德条约》。他存世的事迹多与科林修道院有关：1273年，三兄弟共同确认将这座其父创建的熙笃会修道院从马里恩塞迁至科林；1281年他去世后葬于该院。

en: John V, whose Latin nickname was Illustris (1302 – 26 March 1317), was an Ascanian margrave of Brandenburg-Salzwedel, the son of Margrave Herman the Tall and Anne of Austria, daughter of King Albert I of Germany. Six years old when his father died during the siege of Lübz in 1308, he succeeded him as margrave and co-ruler of Brandenburg. He married Catherine, a daughter of Duke Henry III of Glogau and Sagan, but died on 26 March 1317 as a teenager. With his early death the Brandenburg-Salzwedel line of the House of Ascania became extinct, and his cousin Waldemar ruled the margraviate alone.
zh: 约翰五世，绰号“杰出者”（1302—1317年3月26日），阿斯坎尼家族勃兰登堡-萨尔茨韦德尔支系的边境侯爵，是“高个子”赫尔曼侯爵与德意志国王阿尔布雷希特一世之女、奥地利的安娜之子。1308年父亲在围攻吕布茨期间去世时他年仅六岁，随后继位为勃兰登堡共治边境侯爵。他娶了格沃古夫-萨根公爵亨利三世之女卡塔琳娜，却于1317年3月26日夭折。他一死，阿斯坎尼家族的勃兰登堡-萨尔茨韦德尔支系便告绝嗣，勃兰登堡由堂兄瓦尔德马独自统治。

en: Conrad I (c. 1240–1304) was a son of Margrave John I and Sophie of Denmark, and from 1266 co-ruler of Brandenburg-Stendal with John II and Otto IV, taking the newly won Neumark east of the Oder as his share. In 1260 he married Constance, daughter of Duke Przemysł I of Greater Poland, a match securing the Neumark frontier. Under the 1269 Treaty of Arnswalde he helped Otto IV occupy Gdańsk and win the Rügenwalde region from Pomerelia. He died in 1304 and was buried beside his wife in Chorin Abbey; his son Waldemar later reunited the Brandenburg lines.
zh: 康拉德一世（约1240—1304）是勃兰登堡藩侯约翰一世与丹麦的苏菲亚的儿子，1266年起与约翰二世、奥托四世共同统治勃兰登堡-施滕达尔，分得奥得河以东新得的新马克。1260年，他娶大波兰公爵普热梅斯瓦夫一世之女康斯坦丝为妻，以巩固新马克的东部边界。根据1269年的《阿恩斯瓦尔德条约》，他协助奥托四世占领格但斯克，并从波美雷利亚取得达尔沃沃一带的土地。1304年他去世，葬于科林修道院妻子身旁；其子瓦尔德马后来重新统一了勃兰登堡各支系。

en: Louis V, called the Brandenburger (May 1315–1361), was the eldest son of Emperor Louis IV, who set him over Brandenburg as a boy. In 1323 the eight-year-old was enfeoffed with the march against the claims of the Ascanian Rudolf, ending the Brandenburg Interregnum. Defeat at Kremmer Damm in 1332 forced him to give up Pomerania. In 1342 he married the Tyrolean heiress Margaret before her first marriage was dissolved, winning Tyrol but drawing excommunication and an interdict. In 1347, while he was away on an expedition to Prussia, Margaret beat back Charles IV's attack on Schloss Tirol. That year he inherited Upper Bavaria; in 1351, at odds with Brandenburg's nobles, he ceded the march to his half-brothers by the Treaty of Luckau. The Golden Bull of 1356 gave his Bavarian line no electoral vote. He died at Zorneding in 1361 and was buried in Munich.
zh: 路易五世绰号“勃兰登堡人”（1315—1361），是皇帝路易四世的长子，少年时就被父亲派去治理勃兰登堡。1323年，年仅八岁的他不顾阿斯卡尼家族的萨克森人鲁道夫的主张，受封勃兰登堡藩侯领地，结束了勃兰登堡空位期。1332年克雷门堤战败，他被迫放弃对波美拉尼亚的主张。1342年，他在蒂罗尔女继承人玛格丽特的第一段婚姻尚未解除时便与她成婚，因而取得蒂罗尔，却被开除教籍，领地也遭禁罚。1347年他远赴普鲁士时，玛格丽特击退了查理四世对蒂罗尔城堡的进攻。同年他继承上巴伐利亚；1351年，他与勃兰登堡贵族不睦，依《卢考条约》把勃兰登堡让给异母弟弟。1356年的金玺诏书没有把选侯资格授予他的巴伐利亚支系。1361年他卒于措内丁，葬于慕尼黑。

en: Margaret of Denmark (c. 1305–1340) was the eldest daughter of King Christopher II of Denmark and Euphemia of Pomerania. To build an alliance with the German king Louis IV, who in 1323 enfeoffed his son Louis V with the margraviate of Brandenburg, Christopher married her to Louis at Vordingborg Castle in December 1324, promising a dowry of 12000 silver marks. The dowry was never paid, and the claim was eventually settled when her brother King Valdemar IV offered Danish Estonia to Brandenburg instead. Margaret died in 1340; two years later Louis married Margaret Maultasch of Tyrol.
zh: 丹麦的玛格丽特（约1305—1340）是丹麦国王克里斯托弗二世与波美拉尼亚的欧菲米娅的长女。为与德意志国王路易四世结盟——后者已于1323年把空缺的勃兰登堡藩侯国封给儿子路易五世——克里斯托弗于1324年12月在沃尔丁堡城堡将她嫁给路易五世，许以12000马克白银的嫁妆。这笔嫁妆始终没有支付，最终由她的弟弟瓦尔德马四世国王以把丹麦属爱沙尼亚让予勃兰登堡的方式了结。玛格丽特于1340年去世，两年后路易五世迎娶蒂罗尔的玛格丽特·莫塔什。

en: Otto I (c. 1128–1184) was the second Margrave of Brandenburg, ruling from 1170 as the eldest son of Albert the Bear, who had founded the margraviate in 1157. He was already active in his father's government by 1144, and after 1157 the two shaped the Ascanian policy that guided Brandenburg for centuries. Around 1148 he married Judith, daughter of the Polish duke Bolesław III. As margrave he focused on settling and securing the young territory rather than expanding it, and was buried at Lehnin Abbey, whose foundation he had supported.
zh: 奥托一世（约1128—1184）是阿斯坎尼王朝第二代勃兰登堡藩侯，1170年继位。他是1157年建立勃兰登堡藩侯国的“大熊”阿尔布雷希特一世的长子，早在1144年便已参与父亲领地的事务，1157年后父子二人共同奠定了阿斯坎尼家族此后数百年的治国方针。约1148年，他娶波兰公爵波列斯瓦夫三世之女朱迪斯为妻。在位期间他注重移民垦殖、稳固新得领地，而非对外扩张，死后葬于自己资助修建的莱宁修道院。

en: Otto II (after 1147–1205), called the Generous, was the third Margrave of Brandenburg from 1184, succeeding his father Otto I. He strengthened the settlement and defences of the margraviate and campaigned against the Slavs and King Canute VI of Denmark; in the winter of 1198–1199 he ravaged Danish-held Pomerania and the following year advanced as far as Rügen and threatened Hamburg. Between 1200 and 1203 he backed the Hohenstaufen Philip of Swabia against King Otto IV. His marriage to his stepmother Ada of Holland was childless, so his half-brother Albert II succeeded him in 1205.
zh: 奥托二世（1147年后—1205），绰号“慷慨者”，1184年继承父亲奥托一世之位，为阿斯坎尼王朝第三代勃兰登堡藩侯。他加强了藩侯国的防务与垦殖，并对斯拉夫人和丹麦克努特六世作战；1198至1199年冬天，他蹂躏了丹麦占据的波美拉尼亚，次年进军至吕根岛一带，威胁汉堡。1200至1203年间，他支持霍亨斯陶芬王朝士瓦本的菲利普对抗国王奥托四世。他娶继母荷兰的爱达为妻却无子嗣，1205年死后由异母弟阿尔布雷希特二世继位。

en: Otto III the Pious (1215–1267), younger son of Margrave Albert II, ruled Brandenburg jointly with his elder brother John I from 1225 until John died in 1266, and then alone for a year. Together they won the Uckermark and Lubusz Land and carried Ascanian rule beyond the Oder into the Neumark, while developing Cölln and Berlin. In 1255 he joined King Ottokar II of Bohemia on the Prussian Crusade and helped found Königsberg, and in 1256 he was a candidate for King of the Romans. In 1244 he married Božena, daughter of Wenceslaus I of Bohemia.
zh: 奥托三世（1215—1267），绰号“虔诚者”，是藩侯阿尔布雷希特二世的次子，1225年起与兄长约翰一世共治勃兰登堡，1266年约翰一世死后独自统治一年。兄弟二人共同取得乌克马克和卢布斯领地，把阿斯坎尼家族的势力越过奥得河推进到新马克，并发展了克尔恩与柏林。1255年，他随波希米亚国王奥托卡二世参加普鲁士十字军，参与修建柯尼斯堡；1256年，他被推举为罗马人的国王候选人。1244年，他娶波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫一世之女鲍日娜为妻。

en: Otto IV (c. 1238–1308), called Otto with the Arrow, was the foremost of the three sons of John I ruling Brandenburg-Stendal jointly from 1266. The 1269 Treaty of Arnswalde made Duke Mestwin II of Pomerelia their vassal. Feuding with Magdeburg, he was captured and caged at the Battle of Fohse and freed for four thousand pounds of silver; an arrow wound at Staßfurt in 1280 gave him his nickname. He joined Ottokar II's 1278 Hungarian campaign, helped hold young Wenceslaus II at Spandau until 1283, and as elector backed Adolf of Nassau in 1292.
zh: 奥托四世（约1238—1308），人称“持箭的奥托”，是约翰一世三个儿子中最有权势的一个，自1266年起与兄弟共治勃兰登堡-施滕达尔。1269年的《阿恩斯瓦尔德条约》使波美雷利亚公爵梅斯特温二世成为他们的封臣。他与马格德堡争权，在弗瑟战役中被俘并关入笼中，后来靠四千磅白银赎金获释；1280年他在施塔斯富特中箭，由此得到绰号。1278年他随奥托卡二世远征匈牙利，又参与在施潘道拘押年幼的瓦茨拉夫二世直至1283年。作为选侯，他在1292年支持拿骚的阿道夫。

en: Otto V the Tall (c. 1246–1298) was a son of Otto III the Pious and Božena of Bohemia, and from 1267 margrave of the Brandenburg-Salzwedel line, ruling jointly with his cousin Otto IV. He spent years at the Prague court of his uncle Ottokar II, and after the king fell at the Marchfeld in 1278 became regent for his seven-year-old cousin Wenceslaus II, outmaneuvering Kunigunda and the Bohemian nobles and making him renounce Upper Lusatia. He also pressed Brandenburg's claims to Pomerania against Poland. He married Judith of Henneberg, and his son Herman succeeded him in 1298.
