zh: 奥托五世（约1246—1298），人称“高个子奥托”，是“虔诚者”奥托三世与波希米亚的鲍日娜之子，1267年起任勃兰登堡-萨尔茨韦德尔一系藩侯，与堂兄奥托四世共治。他长年在舅父波希米亚国王奥托卡二世的布拉格王廷效力；1278年奥托卡二世在马希费尔德战死后，他成为七岁表弟瓦茨拉夫二世的摄政，与王太后库尼贡达及波希米亚贵族周旋，并迫使瓦茨拉夫放弃对上卢萨蒂亚的领土要求。他还坚持勃兰登堡对波美拉尼亚的主张，对抗波兰。他娶亨讷贝格的茱蒂丝为妻，1298年死后由儿子赫尔曼继位。

en: Waldemar the Great (c. 1280 – 14 August 1319), son of Margrave Conrad, was Brandenburg's last effective Ascanian margrave, ruling from 1308 and alone from 1317. By the 1309 Treaty of Soldin he sold his Pomerelian claims to the Teutonic Order; he captured Frederick I of Meissen in 1312, gaining the March of Lusatia. He backed Louis IV of Bavaria in 1314, but after defeat near Gransee in 1316 he ceded Stargard to Mecklenburg by the 1317 Treaty of Templin. His marriage to Agnes, daughter of Margrave Herman, was childless, and his ward Henry II died in 1320, ending Ascanian rule.
zh: 瓦尔德马大帝（约1280—1319年8月14日）是康拉德侯爵之子，勃兰登堡最后一位真正掌权的阿斯坎尼家族边境侯爵，1308年起执政，1317年起独掌大权。根据1309年的《索尔丁条约》，他把对波美雷利亚的权利卖给条顿骑士团；1312年俘获迈森侯爵腓特烈一世，取得卢萨蒂亚边区。1314年他支持巴伐利亚的路易四世，但1316年在格兰塞附近战败，依1317年的《滕普林条约》把施塔加德割让给梅克伦堡。他与赫尔曼侯爵之女阿格尼丝的婚姻没有子嗣，受其监护的亨利二世于1320年夭折，阿斯坎尼家族的统治就此终结。

en: Samuel von Cocceji (1679–1755) was a Prussian jurist born in Heidelberg, the son of the legal scholar Heinrich von Cocceji. He took his doctorate in 1699 and became a law professor at Frankfurt an der Oder in 1702, rising by 1731 to president of Prussia's highest court of appeal in Berlin. As Grand Chancellor from 1747 under Frederick II, he reorganised justice in conquered Silesia and then across all Prussia, clearing court backlogs, requiring trained judges and issuing the Codex Fridericianus Pomeranicus in 1747 and the Codex Fridericianus Marchicus in 1748.
zh: 塞缪尔·冯·科克采伊（1679—1755）是普鲁士法学家，生于海德堡，父亲是法学学者海因里希·冯·科克采伊。他1699年取得博士学位，1702年成为奥得河畔法兰克福的法学教授，1731年升任设在柏林的普鲁士最高上诉法院院长。1747年起，他在腓特烈二世治下出任大首相，先在被征服的西里西亚、继而在全普鲁士整顿司法：清理积案、要求法官受过专业训练，并促成1747年《波美拉尼亚腓特烈法典》与1748年《勃兰登堡腓特烈法典》的颁布。

en: Georg Wenzeslaus von Knobelsdorff (1699–1753) was a Prussian officer turned architect and the favourite builder of Frederick the Great. He left the army as a captain in 1729, trained as a painter under Antoine Pesne, and from 1732 advised Crown Prince Frederick on art and architecture, enlarging Rheinsberg Palace and helping to shape the Frederician Rococo style. In 1740, after Frederick took the Prussian throne, he travelled to Paris and Italy at the king's expense to study architecture. He designed the Berlin Opera House (1741–1743), the new wing of Charlottenburg Palace, and the palace of Sanssouci at Potsdam, begun in 1745. Dismissed in 1746, he died in Berlin in 1753.
zh: 格奥尔格·文策斯劳斯·冯·克诺贝尔斯多夫（1699—1753）原是普鲁士军官，后来成为建筑师，是腓特烈大帝最倚重的营造者。1729年他以上尉军衔退役，随宫廷画家安托万·佩内学画，1732年起为王储腓特烈在艺术与建筑方面出谋划策，扩建莱茵斯贝格宫，参与奠定腓特烈式洛可可风格。1740年腓特烈登上普鲁士王位后，他奉王命赴巴黎和意大利考察建筑。他设计了柏林歌剧院（1741—1743）、夏洛滕堡宫新翼以及1745年动工的波茨坦无忧宫。1746年他被解职，1753年在柏林去世。

en: Carl von Clausewitz (1780–1831) was a Prussian officer and military theorist born at Burg bei Magdeburg. He enlisted at twelve as a lance corporal and fought in the Rhine campaigns of 1793–1794, including the siege of Mainz. In 1801 he entered the War Academy, where Scharnhorst became his patron; captured at Jena-Auerstedt in 1806, he helped reform the Prussian army. Opposed to Prussia's forced alliance with Napoleon, he entered Russian service in 1812; he later served in the Waterloo campaign and directed the War Academy until 1830. His unfinished treatise On War, published by his widow Marie in 1832, calls war the continuation of policy by other means. He emphasized the uncertainty of war, in which commanders must make decisions amid incomplete and often mistaken information.
zh: 卡尔·冯·克劳塞维茨（1780—1831），普鲁士军官、军事理论家，生于马格德堡附近的布尔格。他十二岁以代理下士身份入伍，参加了1793至1794年的莱茵战役，包括美因茨围城战。1801年他进入柏林军官学校，得到沙恩霍斯特的赏识；1806年在耶拿-奥尔施泰特战役中被俘，获释后参与普鲁士军事改革。他反对普鲁士被迫与拿破仑结盟，1812年转入俄军服役，后又参加滑铁卢战役，此后主持军官学校直至1830年。他的未竟之作《战争论》由遗孀玛丽于1832年出版，书中提出战争是政治以其他手段的延续。他强调战争中充满变数：指挥官须在情报不完整且常有错误的情况下作出决断。

en: Adelaide of Burgundy (c. 1233 – 23 October 1273), daughter of Hugh IV of Burgundy and Yolande of Dreux, married Henry III, Duke of Brabant, in 1251. After his death in 1261 she ruled as regent for their young son Henry, despite opposition from her husband's cousin Hendrik of Gaasbeek. In 1262 she founded Val-Duchesse, the first Dominican priory for women in the Low Countries. When her eldest son proved mentally and physically unfit, she replaced him in 1267 with her second son John, handing over power in 1268. She died in 1273; her daughter Marie married King Philip III of France.
zh: 勃艮第的阿德莱德（约1233—1273年10月23日）是勃艮第公爵于格四世与德勒的约朗德之女，1251年嫁给布拉班特公爵亨利三世。1261年丈夫死后，她为年幼的儿子亨利摄政，尽管遭到丈夫的堂兄弟加斯贝克的亨德里克反对。1262年她创立瓦勒迪谢斯女修道院，这是低地国家第一座遵行多明我会会规的女子修道院。长子身心俱残、无力执政，她便于1267年改立次子约翰，并于1268年交权。她于1273年去世；女儿玛丽后来嫁给法兰西国王腓力三世。

en: Godfrey of Brabant was the youngest son of John III, Duke of Brabant, and Marie of Évreux. Made Lord of Aarschot in 1346, he was alive in February 1352 but died young soon afterwards and was buried at Tervuren.
zh: 布拉班特的戈弗雷是布拉班特公爵让三世与埃夫勒的玛丽的幼子。他于1346年受封阿尔斯霍特领主，1352年2月仍在世，但不久便青年早逝，葬于泰尔菲伦。

en: Godfrey of Brabant (died 11 July 1302) was the third son of Henry III of Brabant and Adelaide of Burgundy. He married Jeanne of Vierzon in 1277, holding Vierzon, and became Lord of Aarschot in 1284. A trusted soldier of his brother John I, he fought at Worringen in 1288 and captured Reginald I of Guelders. In 1292 he mediated peace between France and Flanders, and later supported his nephew John II. He and his son died fighting for France at the Battle of the Golden Spurs in 1302, and his lands passed to his daughters.
zh: 布拉班特的戈弗雷（1302年7月11日卒）是布拉班特公爵亨利三世与勃艮第的阿德莱德的第三子。1277年他迎娶维耶尔宗的让娜，领有维耶尔宗；1284年，他成为阿尔斯霍特领主。他是兄长让一世倚重的战将，1288年战于沃林根，俘获海尔德的赖纳德一世。1292年他调解法兰西与佛兰德之间的和约，后来又辅佐侄子让二世。1302年，他与儿子在金马刺战役中为法兰西作战时双双阵亡，领地由女儿们继承。

en: Henry I, called the Courageous (c. 1165–1235), son of Count Godfrey III of Leuven, became the first Duke of Brabant in 1183. After his father's death in 1190, King Henry VI confirmed Brabant's elevation. Henry joined the emperor's crusade in 1197, helping to retake Beirut and serving as regent in Acre. In the German throne quarrel he backed Otto IV, switched to Philip of Swabia in 1204, then returned to Otto, fighting at Bouvines in 1214. He took part in the Fifth Crusade in 1217–1218, granted city rights to 's-Hertogenbosch and Eindhoven, and joined the Stedinger Crusade in 1234. He died at Cologne in 1235 escorting Isabella of England to Emperor Frederick II.
zh: 亨利一世绰号“勇敢者”（约1165—1235），是鲁汶伯爵戈弗雷三世之子，1183年成为第一位布拉班特公爵。1190年父亲去世后，国王亨利六世确认了布拉班特的晋升。1197年，他参加皇帝的十字军，协助收复贝鲁特，并在阿卡担任摄政。在德意志王位之争中，他先支持奥托四世，1204年转投士瓦本的腓力，后又回到奥托阵营，1214年战于布汶。1217—1218年他参加第五次十字军东征；他还向斯海尔托亨博斯和埃因霍温颁授城市特许状，1234年参加施泰丁十字军。1235年，他护送英格兰的伊莎贝拉前往皇帝腓特烈二世处，途中卒于科隆。

en: Henry II of Brabant (1207–1248), called the Magnanimous, succeeded Henry I as duke in 1235. Continuing Brabant's expansion, he intervened in disputes between the bishop of Liège and his towns and gained the County of Dalhem in 1244 through his alliance with Emperor Frederick II. During the minorities of his nephews Otto II of Guelders and William II of Holland he dominated their lands, and in 1247 he refused the German kingship in William's favour. His son by Sophie of Thuringia, Henry the Child, founded the House of Hesse. In January 1248 he granted Brabant its first land charter, promising legal protections to ease the succession of his young son Henry III. He died weeks later at Leuven.
zh: 亨利二世（1207—1248），绰号“宽宏大度者”，1235年继父亲亨利一世之后成为布拉班特公爵。他延续布拉班特的扩张政策，干预列日主教与其教区城市之间的争端，并凭与皇帝腓特烈二世结盟于1244年取得达尔赫姆伯国。在外甥海尔德的奥托二世与荷兰的威廉二世未成年期间，他左右两地的事务；1247年他辞让德意志王位，成全了威廉。他与图林根的索菲所生的儿子“孩童”亨利开创了黑森家族。1248年1月，他颁授布拉班特的第一份土地特权状，承诺司法保障，以便利年幼的儿子亨利三世继位。数周后他卒于鲁汶。

en: Henry III of Brabant (c. 1231–1261) succeeded his father Henry II as duke in 1248. In 1251 he married Adelaide of Burgundy. He backed Alfonso X of Castile for the German crown, who in 1257 named him imperial vicar in the western Empire and granted him disputed Lothier. Himself a trouvère, he kept the poet Adenet le Roi at court and wrote French courtly verse. He died at Leuven in 1261, after issuing a charter to ease his under-age sons' succession. His will threatened to banish Jews unless they gave up moneylending at interest, but Adelaide did not enforce the clause as regent. His children included John I, Godfrey of Aarschot and Maria, wife of Philip III of France.
zh: 亨利三世（约1231—1261）于1248年继父亲亨利二世成为布拉班特公爵。1251年，他迎娶勃艮第的阿德莱德。他支持卡斯蒂利亚的阿方索十世竞选德意志国王，阿方索于1257年任命他为帝国西部的帝国代理官，并把有争议的洛捷领地封给他。他本人是游吟诗人，在宫中供养诗人阿德内·勒鲁瓦，还创作法语宫廷诗篇。1261年他卒于鲁汶，死前数日颁下特权状，为年幼诸子的继位铺平道路。他的遗嘱威胁驱逐不放弃收息放贷的犹太人，但阿德莱德摄政时并未执行这一条款。子女包括约翰一世、阿尔斯霍特的戈弗雷，以及嫁给腓力三世的玛丽亚。

en: Henry IV of Brabant (1251/1252 – after 1272) became duke in 1261 as the eldest son of Henry III and Adelaide of Burgundy, succeeding his father at about the age of ten under a regency. He was judged infirm in mind and body, and in 1267 he was deposed in favour of his younger brother John I. He then became a novice at Saint Bénigne Abbey in Dijon. Nothing certain is recorded of him after April 1272, and the date of his death is unknown.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/布拉班特公爵亨利四世
zh: 布拉班特公爵亨利四世（1251/1252—1272年后）是公爵亨利三世与勃艮第的阿德莱德的长子，约10岁时于1261年继位，由摄政团辅政。他被认为身心羸弱，1267年遭废黜，由其弟约翰一世继位。此后他进入第戎的圣贝尼涅修道院任初学修士。1272年4月之后，史籍中再无他的确切记载，卒年不详。

en: Henry of Brabant (c. 1330–1349), a younger son of Duke John III of Brabant, was made Duke of Limburg and Lord of Mechelen in 1347. He died on 29 October 1349 and was buried at Tervuren.
zh: 布拉班特的亨利（约1330—1349）是布拉班特公爵让三世较年幼的儿子之一，1347年受封林堡公爵和梅赫伦领主。他于1349年10月29日去世，葬于蒂尔弗伦。

en: Hugh of Châtillon (1270–1329), son of Jacques I de Châtillon, held the lordship of Condé on the Scheldt. By his wife Joan of Argies he left a daughter, Joan, who inherited Condé in 1329 and married Count James I of La Marche.
zh: 沙蒂永的于格（1270—1329）为雅克一世·德·沙蒂永之子，领有斯海尔德河畔孔代领地。其妻让娜·达尔日生女让娜，于1329年继承孔代，嫁拉马尔什伯爵詹姆斯一世。

en: Jacques de Châtillon (15 May 1256–11 July 1302), lord of Leuze and Condé, was a son of Guy III, Count of Saint-Pol, and Matilda of Brabant. He married Catherine of Condé and had children. After imprisoning Count Guy of Dampierre, Philip IV of France made him governor of Flanders in 1300 to press the French annexation. Heavy taxes, extortion by pro-French nobles and Philip's visit to Bruges in 1301 angered the townspeople. On 18 May 1302 they massacred the French garrison in the Bruges Matins, part of the Flemish uprising. Jacques escaped, but was killed less than two months later at the Battle of the Golden Spurs.
zh: 沙蒂永的雅各（1256年5月15日—1302年7月11日）是勒兹和孔代的领主，圣波勒伯爵居伊三世与布拉班特的玛蒂尔德之子。他娶孔代的凯瑟琳为妻，育有子女。法王腓力四世囚禁佛兰德伯爵当皮埃尔的居伊后，于1300年任命他为佛兰德总督，以推进兼并。重税、亲法贵族的勒索和腓力1301年访问布鲁日激怒了当地市民。1302年5月18日，市民在“布鲁日晨祷”中屠杀法国驻军，这是佛兰德起事的一部分。雅各逃出布鲁日，但不到两个月便在金马刺战役中被杀。

en: John I, called the Victorious (1252/1253–1294), became Duke of Brabant in 1267 after his infirm brother Henry IV was set aside. In 1270 he married Margaret, daughter of Louis IX of France; she and their infant son died shortly after the boy's birth. In 1273 he married Margaret of Flanders, who bore his successor John II. In the War of the Limburg Succession he defeated Rainald I of Guelders and the archbishop of Cologne at Worringen in 1288, winning Limburg for Brabant. A famed patron of poets, he was mortally wounded in May 1294 in a melee at the wedding feasts of Bar-le-Duc and was buried in Brussels.
zh: 让一世绰号“胜利者”（1252/1253—1294），1267年在患病的兄长亨利四世被废后成为布拉班特公爵。1270年他迎娶法王路易九世之女玛格丽特；她与两人的幼子在孩子出生后不久相继去世。1273年他再娶佛兰德的玛格丽特，后者生下继承人让二世。在林堡继承战争中，他率领联军对抗海尔德的赖纳德一世和科隆大主教，1288年在沃林根大破敌军，林堡此后并入布拉班特。他是著名的诗歌庇护者，1294年5月在巴勒迪克的婚宴比武中受致命伤，葬于布鲁塞尔。

en: Jan II Berthout van Berlaer (1280–1328) was a Brabantine nobleman of a wealthy Mechelen family and lord of Helmond from 1314 until his death. He was the son of Jan I Berthout van Berlaer and Maria van Mortagne. On 13 July 1314 he received Helmond in fief from the fourteen-year-old Duke John III of Brabant, advised by Floris Berthout, lord of Mechelen. He also held Keerbergen and Berlaar, near Lier. His son by Elisabeth van den Berghe, Lodewijk III, succeeded him when he died in 1328. He was buried at Binderen Abbey.
zh: 扬二世·贝尔豪特·范·贝尔拉尔（1280—1328）出身梅赫伦的富裕家族，是布拉班特贵族，1314年至去世任海尔蒙德领主。他是扬一世·贝尔豪特·范·贝尔拉尔与玛丽亚·范·莫尔塔涅之子。1314年7月13日，他从年仅十四岁的布拉班特公爵约翰三世手中受封海尔蒙德为采邑，年幼的公爵由梅赫伦领主弗洛里斯·贝尔豪特辅政。他还领有凯尔贝亨以及利尔附近的贝尔拉尔。他与伊丽莎白·范登贝赫所生之子勒德韦克三世在他1328年死后继位。他葬于宾德伦修道院。

en: John II, called the Peaceful (1275–1312), succeeded John I as Duke of Brabant in 1294. With his uncle Godfrey of Aarschot he put down early revolts, and with Edward I of England and the Count of Flanders formed an anti-French league that broke up in 1300. A 1303 attack on Count John II of Holland failed. In 1309 his army crushed the Crusade of the Poor after it besieged Genappe castle, where Jews had taken shelter. Suffering from kidney stones and seeking a peaceful succession for his son, he granted the Charter of Kortenberg, Brabant's constitution, on his deathbed in 1312. Married to Margaret of England in 1290, he died at Tervuren, leaving the duchy to John III.
zh: 让二世绰号“和平者”（1275—1312），1294年继让一世之后成为布拉班特公爵。他在叔父阿尔斯霍特的戈弗雷帮助下平定了即位初年的叛乱，又与英王爱德华一世、佛兰德伯爵结盟反法，同盟却于1300年瓦解。1303年，他进攻荷兰伯爵约翰二世失败。1309年，“贫民十字军”围攻收容犹太人的热纳普城堡，他派军将其击溃。他患有肾结石，希望儿子平稳继位，1312年在病榻上颁行《科滕贝赫宪章》，作为布拉班特的根本大法。他于1290年迎娶英格兰的玛格丽特，1312年卒于泰尔菲伦，把公国留给让三世。

en: John III (1300–1355) was Duke of Brabant and Limburg from 1312, the last man of his line to rule them. He inherited debts: creditors of his predecessors had seized Brabantine property abroad, and the towns agreed to pay the duke's debts only if he honoured the Charter of Kortenberg and granted them new privileges. He married Marie of Évreux in 1311. Brabant's trade clashed with France's wish to isolate Flanders, and at the start of the Hundred Years' War he backed Edward III. Philip VI answered by seizing Brabantine goods in France; Brussels rose against its duke, and John put the revolt down and had a ringleader beheaded. From 1340 he turned to France, marrying his daughters to the rulers of Luxembourg, Flanders and Guelders. All three sons died before him, so he named his daughter Joanna heiress. His death in 1355 brought a succession crisis, and he was buried at Villers Abbey.
zh: 让三世（1300—1355）自1312年起担任布拉班特与林堡公爵，是这个家系最后一位统治这两块领地的男性。他继承的是一个负债的公国：前几任公爵的债务让布拉班特人在国外的财产被扣押，各城市答应偿还公爵的债务，条件是他遵守《科滕贝格宪章》并给予城市新的特权。1311年他迎娶埃夫勒的玛丽。布拉班特的商业利益与法国孤立佛兰德的企图相冲突，百年战争初期他站到英格兰国王爱德华三世一边。腓力六世以扣押布拉班特人在法国的财产作为报复，布鲁塞尔市民起而反抗；让三世平息了暴动，并砍下一名领袖的头。1340年起他转向法国，将女儿们分别嫁给卢森堡、佛兰德和海尔德的统治者。三个儿子都先他而死，他于是立女儿让娜为继承人。1355年他去世，引发了继承危机，他葬于维莱尔修道院。

en: John of Brabant (1327–1335) was the eldest son of John III, Duke of Brabant, and Marie of Évreux. Married as a child to Marie of France, daughter of King Philip VI, he died young without issue and was buried at Tervuren.
zh: 布拉班特的约翰（1327—1335年）是布拉班特公爵约翰三世与埃夫勒的玛丽的长子。他幼年与法兰西国王腓力六世之女法兰西的玛丽成婚，后早逝无子，葬于泰尔菲伦。

en: Joan of Argies (1290–1334) was a French noblewoman, daughter of the lord of Dargies in Picardy. Her first husband was Hugh of Soissons, by whom she had a daughter, Margaret. She then married John of Charolais, son of Robert of Clermont; their daughters were Beatrice (1311–1364), lady of Charolais, who married Count John I of Armagnac, and Joan, lady of Saint-Just, who married Count John I of Auvergne. Widowed in 1316, she later took a third husband, Hugh of Châtillon, by whom she had a daughter Joan. She died in 1334.
zh: 让娜·达尔日（1290—1334）是法国贵族女子，皮卡第地区达尔日领主之女。她先嫁给苏瓦松的于格，生下女儿玛格丽特；第二任丈夫是克莱蒙的罗贝尔之子沙罗莱的让，两人生有两女：贝阿特丽丝（1311—1364），沙罗莱女领主，嫁给阿马尼亚克伯爵让一世；以及圣朱斯特女领主让娜，嫁给奥弗涅伯爵让一世。1316年守寡后，她第三度出嫁，嫁给沙蒂永的于格，生下女儿让娜。她于1334年去世。

en: Joanna of Brabant (1322–1406), daughter of Duke John III of Brabant and Marie of Évreux, inherited the duchy in 1355 and faced invasion within a year. In 1334 she married William II of Hainaut, a match that could have joined their lands; he was killed fighting the Frisians in 1345. Her second husband was Wenceslaus of Luxembourg. In January 1356 she granted the Joyous Entry charter, limiting ducal power and settling the succession on her sisters, whom the burghers preferred to Luxembourg rule. That year Louis II of Flanders, who claimed Brabant through his wife, Joanna's sister Margaret, overran the duchy and forced the humiliating Treaty of Ath, which ceded Mechelen and Antwerp. At Maastricht, Emperor Charles IV had parts of the charter annulled to satisfy the Luxembourgs. Wenceslaus was captured at Baesweiler in 1371. On Joanna's death in 1406 Brabant passed to her great-nephew Anthony of Burgundy.
zh: 布拉班特的让娜（1322—1406）是布拉班特公爵约翰三世与埃夫勒的玛丽之女，1355年继承公国，一年之内就遭到入侵。1334年她嫁给埃诺的威廉二世，这桩婚事本可把两家的领地合在一起；1345年威廉在与弗里斯兰人作战时阵亡。她的第二任丈夫是卢森堡的文策尔。1356年1月，她颁布《欢乐入口》宪章，限制公爵权力，并确定由她的姐妹继承公国，市民宁可接受她们，也不愿接受卢森堡家族的统治。同年，以妻子——让娜的妹妹玛格丽特——的名义主张布拉班特的佛兰德伯爵路易二世侵占公国，迫使她签下屈辱的《阿特条约》，割让梅赫伦和安特卫普。皇帝查理四世在马斯特里赫特出面调停，《欢乐入口》的部分条款被废除，以满足卢森堡家族。1371年文策尔在巴斯韦勒战败被俘。1406年让娜去世后，布拉班特传给她的甥外孙勃艮第的安托万。

en: Johanna van Dinther married, around 1320, Lodewijk III Berthout van Berlaer, lord of Helmond in the Duchy of Brabant. She was the mother of Walraven van Berlaer, who succeeded his father as lord of Helmond in 1346.
zh: 约翰娜·范丁特尔约于1320年嫁给布拉班特公国的海尔蒙德领主洛德韦克三世·贝尔陶特·范贝尔拉尔，是1346年继任海尔蒙德领主的瓦尔拉芬·范贝尔拉尔之母。

en: Lodewijk III Berthout van Berlaer (1310–1346) was a Brabantine nobleman, the son of Jan II Berthout van Berlaer and Elisabeth van den Berghe. He succeeded his father as lord of Helmond in 1328 and ruled until his death. Around 1320 he married Johanna van Dinther, who bore him his heir Walraven around 1330. He was probably the founder of Helmond Castle, work on which is thought to have begun between 1331 and 1335; he raised a loan on the security of the castle to pay for the building. He died in 1346 and was buried at Roosendaal.
zh: 洛德韦克三世·贝尔陶特·范贝尔拉尔（1310—1346）是布拉班特贵族，扬二世·贝尔陶特·范贝尔拉尔与伊丽莎白·范登贝赫之子。1328年他继承父亲之位成为海尔蒙德领主，在任直至去世。约1320年，他娶约翰娜·范丁特尔为妻，约1330年生下继承人瓦尔拉芬。他很可能是海尔蒙德城堡的兴建发起者，工程估计在1331至1335年间动工；为筹集工程款，他以城堡作抵押举债。他于1346年去世，葬于罗森达尔。

en: Margaret of England (1275 – after 1333) was a daughter of King Edward I of England and Eleanor of Castile, born at Windsor Castle. In 1290 she married John II, Duke of Brabant, becoming duchess consort of Brabant and Limburg; their only son was the future John III. Her husband issued the Charter of Kortenberg in 1312 and died later that year, but Margaret was excluded from the regency for the minor John III, which was led by Louis of Évreux. She died in Brabant and was buried in the Cathedral of St Michael and St Gudula in Brussels.
zh: 英格兰的玛格丽特（1275—约1333年）是英格兰国王爱德华一世与卡斯蒂利亚的埃莉诺之女，生于温莎城堡。1290年，她嫁给布拉班特公爵约翰二世，成为布拉班特和林堡公爵夫人，独子即后来的约翰三世。1312年，其夫颁布《科滕贝格宪章》，并于同年晚些时候去世，但玛格丽特被排除在幼主约翰三世的摄政团之外，摄政由埃夫勒的路易主持。她在布拉班特去世，葬于布鲁塞尔的圣弥额尔圣古都勒主教座堂。

en: Margaret of Brabant (9 February 1323–1380) was a daughter of Duke John III of Brabant and Mary of Évreux, born in Brussels. In 1347 she married Louis II, Count of Flanders, known as Louis de Mâle. Their only surviving child, Margaret III, baptized on 13 April 1350, married Philip the Bold, Duke of Burgundy, a match through which Brabant later came under Burgundian influence. Margaret was the only one of Duke John's children to leave offspring. From 1371 she lived apart from Louis in the county of Rethel, where she died in April 1380.
zh: 布拉班特的玛格丽特（1323年2月9日—1380）是布拉班特公爵让三世与埃夫勒的玛丽之女，生于布鲁塞尔。1347年，她嫁给佛兰德斯伯爵路易二世，即路易·德·马尔。两人唯一长大成人的孩子玛格丽特三世于1350年4月13日受洗，后来嫁给勃艮第公爵大胆的腓力，布拉班特由此受到勃艮第的影响。她也是让三世子女中唯一留下后代的一位。1371年起她与丈夫分居，长住勒泰勒伯国，1380年4月在当地去世。

en: Margaret of Flanders, or Margaret of Dampierre (c. 1251 – 3 July 1285), was duchess consort of Brabant, the daughter of Guy of Dampierre, Count of Flanders, and his first wife Matilda of Béthune. In 1273 she married John I, Duke of Brabant. Their children were Godfrey, born in 1273 or 1274, who died after 13 September 1283; John II, born in 1275, who succeeded his father as duke of Brabant; Margaret, born in 1276, who married Henry VII, Holy Roman Emperor, in 1292; and Marie, who married Count Amadeus V of Savoy. Margaret herself died on 3 July 1285.
zh: 佛兰德斯的玛格丽特，亦称当皮埃尔的玛格丽特（约1251—1285年7月3日），布拉班特公爵夫人，是佛兰德斯伯爵居伊·德·当皮埃尔与第一任妻子贝蒂讷的玛奥之女。1273年，她嫁给布拉班特公爵约翰一世。子女包括：1273或1274年出生、1283年9月13日后去世的戈弗雷；1275年出生、后来继任布拉班特公爵的约翰二世；1276年出生、1292年嫁给神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利七世的玛格丽特；以及嫁给萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥五世的玛丽。玛格丽特本人于1285年7月3日去世。

en: Mary of Brabant (1325–1399) was the third daughter of Duke John III of Brabant and Mary of Évreux. In 1347 she married Reginald III the Fat, Duke of Guelders. When her brother-in-law Edward seized Guelders and imprisoned Reginald in 1361, she bought the lordship of Oijen and settled at her dower castle of Turnhout. Reginald was freed in 1371 but died afterwards. Mary founded Corsendonk Priory in 1395 and the chapter of Saint Peter's Church at Turnhout in 1398. Her claims to Brabant were settled by the Peace of Ath, and she died at Turnhout in 1399.
zh: 布拉班特的玛丽亚（1325—1399）是布拉班特公爵让三世与埃夫勒的玛丽的第三个女儿。1347年，她嫁给海尔德公爵雷纳尔三世“胖子”。1361年，夫弟爱德华夺取海尔德并囚禁雷纳尔，她随后买下奥延领地，定居在自己的嫁妆城堡蒂伦豪特。雷纳尔于1371年获释但不久去世。她于1395年创立科尔塞东克修道院，1398年建立蒂伦豪特圣彼得教堂的教士会。她对布拉班特的继承权要求经《阿特和约》解决，1399年在蒂伦豪特去世。

en: Marie of Évreux (1303–1335) was the eldest child of Louis, Count of Évreux, and Margaret of Artois, and an elder sister of Philip III of Navarre and Jeanne d'Évreux, queen of France. In 1311 she married John III, Duke of Brabant, sealing a rapprochement between Brabant and the French crown. She was the mother of Duchess Joanna of Brabant and of Margaret, who married Louis II of Flanders, along with three sons who all died before their father. Marie died on 31 October 1335, aged about thirty-two.
zh: 埃夫勒的玛丽（1303—1335年）是埃夫勒伯爵路易与阿图瓦的玛格丽特的长女，也是纳瓦拉国王腓力三世和法兰西王后让娜·德埃夫勒的姐姐。1311年，她嫁给布拉班特公爵约翰三世，以巩固布拉班特与法兰西王室的和解。她是布拉班特女公爵让娜以及嫁给佛兰德斯伯爵路易二世的玛格丽特的母亲，另有三子均先于父亲去世。1335年10月31日玛丽去世，年约32岁。

en: Walraven Berthout van Berlaer (1330–1361) was lord of Helmond and Keerbergen in the Duchy of Brabant, the son of Lodewijk III Berthout van Berlaer and Johanna van Dinther. He succeeded his father in 1346. Around 1348 he married Elisabeth van Utenhove, widow of Willem van Herlaer, through whom he gained the lordship of Herlaar at Herenthout. Their son Jan was born in 1350 and succeeded him as Jan III in 1361. Walraven died at Helmond in 1361, and his widow married Dirk van Batenburg the following August.
zh: 瓦尔拉芬·贝尔陶特·范贝尔拉尔（1330—1361）是布拉班特公国海尔蒙德与凯尔贝亨领主，洛德韦克三世·贝尔陶特·范贝尔拉尔与约翰娜·范丁特尔之子。1346年父亲去世后他继任领主。约1348年，他娶威廉·范赫尔拉尔的遗孀伊丽莎白·范于滕霍弗为妻，由此获得海伦特豪特的赫尔拉尔领地。两人的儿子扬于1350年出生，即1361年继他之后任领主的扬三世。瓦尔拉芬于1361年在海尔蒙德去世，遗孀次年8月改嫁德克·范巴滕堡。

en: Henry IV (d. 1351) was provost of the Augustinian foundation of Berchtesgaden from 1333 until his death, succeeding Conrad IV. He drew the provostry closer to the Habsburgs and enjoyed free production and export of Schellenberg salt through the territory of the Archbishopric of Salzburg, a concession his predecessor had obtained from Archbishop Frederick III. In his last months he contested the advocacies of Jettenstetten and Weidenbach, a suit referred by Pope Clement VI to the Abbot of Tegernsee in October 1350. Henry died before 1 April 1351, before judgement gave the advocacies to his church against compensation.
zh: 海因里希四世（？—1351）于1333年继任康拉德四世，担任贝希特斯加登奥古斯丁修道院教长，直至去世。他在任内密切了修道院与哈布斯堡家族的关系，并得以自由生产、经萨尔茨堡大主教区的领地出口谢伦贝格食盐，这一许可是其前任从大主教腓特烈三世手中争取到的。去世前半年，他为耶滕施泰滕和魏登巴赫的代管权发生诉讼，教宗克雷芒六世于1350年10月将案件交给泰根湖修道院院长裁决。海因里希于1351年4月1日前去世，未能看到判决：两处代管权最终判归修道院，由修道院支付补偿金。

en: Andrea di Gualtieri de' Bardi (c. 1300–1368) was a Florentine merchant, knight and statesman of the Bardi banking family. He fought against John of Bohemia and the Scaligeri and served as captain of the people and then podestà of San Miniato in 1333 and 1336. In 1332 he bought the county of Mangona, which Florence forced him to surrender in 1341 after the magnate conspiracy led by his brother Pietro failed. He helped Walter of Brienne seize power in 1342 and helped expel him in 1343. Later he served as ambassador to Avignon in 1351 and signed the peace with Pisa in 1364.
zh: 安德烈亚·迪·瓜尔蒂耶里·德·巴尔迪（约1300—1368）出身佛罗伦萨巴尔迪银行家族，是商人、骑士与政治家。他参加过对波希米亚国王约翰和德拉·斯卡拉家族的战争，1333年和1336年先后出任圣米尼亚托人民队长和最高长官。1332年他买下曼戈纳伯国；其弟皮耶罗领导的大贵族密谋失败后，佛罗伦萨于1341年迫使他交出该地。他曾在1342年帮助布里耶讷的沃尔特夺权，又于1343年参与将其驱逐。后来他于1351年出使阿维尼翁，并在1364年签署与比萨的和约。

en: Costanza de' Bardi was a daughter of the Florentine magnate and diplomat Andrea di Gualtieri de' Bardi, who bought the county of Mangona in 1332 and served the Republic as ambassador to Avignon.
zh: 科斯坦扎·德·巴尔迪是佛罗伦萨大贵族、外交家安德烈亚·迪·瓜尔蒂耶里·德·巴尔迪之女；其父1332年买下曼戈纳伯国，曾代表共和国出使阿维尼翁。

en: Francesco de' Bardi was a son of the Florentine magnate and diplomat Andrea di Gualtieri de' Bardi, who in 1340 revealed his own brother Pietro's plot against the Republic and later served Florence as ambassador to Avignon.
zh: 弗朗切斯科·德·巴尔迪是佛罗伦萨大贵族、外交家安德烈亚·迪·瓜尔蒂耶里·德·巴尔迪之子；1340年，安德烈亚曾告发亲弟皮耶罗反对共和国的密谋，后来又代表佛罗伦萨出使阿维尼翁。

en: Gualtiero de' Bardi was a member of the Florentine Bardi banking family whose son Pietro bought the county of Mangona in 1332.
zh: 瓜尔蒂耶罗·德巴尔迪是佛罗伦萨巴尔迪银行家族的成员，其子彼得罗于1332年买下曼戈纳伯国。

en: Notto de' Bardi was a son of Piero di Gualterotto of the Florentine Bardi family and an ancestor of branches of the Bardi of Vernio.
zh: 诺托·德·巴尔迪是佛罗伦萨巴尔迪家族的皮耶罗·迪·瓜尔泰罗托之子，也是韦尔尼奥巴尔迪家族若干支系的祖先。

en: Piero di Gualtieri de' Bardi (c. 1290–1345) was a Florentine knight, magnate and partner in the Bardi banking company. A veteran of the battle of Altopascio in 1325, he bought the county of Vernio in 1332 and issued it new statutes in 1338. He led the magnate conspiracy against Florence's popular government, uncovered in November 1340; denounced by his brother Andrea, he was exiled and condemned to death, and the Republic bought Vernio in 1341. Restored under Walter of Brienne in 1342, he helped expel the Duke in 1343, then fled to Vernio, where he died suddenly in 1345.
zh: 皮耶罗·迪·瓜尔蒂耶里·德·巴尔迪（约1290—1345）是佛罗伦萨骑士、大贵族，也是巴尔迪银行公司的合伙人。他曾参加1325年阿尔托帕肖战役，1332年买下韦尔尼奥伯国，1338年为其颁布新法规。1340年11月，他领导反对平民政府的大贵族密谋；其兄安德烈亚告发后，他被流放并判处死刑，韦尔尼奥也于1341年被共和国购走。1342年布里耶讷的沃尔特执政后他恢复领地，1343年又参与驱逐这位公爵，随后逃回韦尔尼奥，1345年在那里暴卒。

en: Sozzo de' Bardi was a Florentine nobleman and the father of Alessandro de' Bardi, count of Vernio. Through Alessandro he was grandfather of Contessina de' Bardi, who married Cosimo de' Medici around 1415, linking the Bardi to the rising Medici.
zh: 索佐·德·巴尔迪是佛罗伦萨贵族，韦尔尼奥伯爵亚历山德罗·德·巴尔迪之父。他的孙女孔泰西娜·德·巴尔迪约于1415年嫁给科西莫·德·美第奇，使巴尔迪家族与崛起中的美第奇家族联姻。

en: Burchard Grelle (c. 1260–1344) was Archbishop of Bremen from 1327 until his death. Born into a Bremen citizen family, he studied at the University of Paris, became a canon and then archdeacon of Rüstringen, and represented the archdiocese at the papal court. After Archbishop Jens Grand died, Pope John XXII appointed him to Bremen in September 1327; he was consecrated at Avignon the following year. One of only two commoners ever to hold the see, Grelle maintained unusually good relations between the city and the archbishopric, and politically aligned himself with the Curia against Emperor Louis IV.
zh: 布尔夏德·格雷勒（约1260—1344）1327年起任不来梅大主教，直至去世。他出身不来梅市民家庭，曾在巴黎大学求学，先任教士，后任吕斯特林根会吏长，并曾在教廷代表大主教区。前任大主教延斯·格朗德去世后，教宗约翰二十二世于1327年9月任命他出掌不来梅，次年他在阿维尼翁祝圣。他是仅有的两位出身平民的不来梅大主教之一，任内城市与大主教区关系异常融洽；政治上则与教廷站在一起，共同对付皇帝路易四世。

en: Adolf IX (c. 1280–1348) was Count of Berg from 1308, succeeding his childless uncle William I. The eldest son of Henry, Lord of Windeck, he married Agnes of Cleves in 1312, gaining the Duisburg Rhine customs as her dowry. A loyal supporter of Emperor Louis IV from 1314, he attended his coronation in Rome in 1328 and joined the English alliance against France in 1337. He continued Berg's feuds with the Archbishops of Cologne and minted silver at Wipperfürth. He died childless in 1348, and Berg passed to his niece Margaret of Ravensberg and her Jülich husband.
zh: 阿道夫六世（约1280—1348）1308年继承无嗣的伯父威廉一世，成为贝格伯爵。他是温德克领主海因里希的长子，1312年娶克莱沃的阿格尼丝，得到杜伊斯堡的莱茵河关税作为嫁妆。自1314年起他坚定支持皇帝路易四世，1328年随皇帝赴罗马参加加冕，1337年加入对法作战的英格兰同盟。他延续贝格与科隆大主教的长期纷争，并在维珀菲尔特铸造银币。1348年他无嗣而终，贝格伯爵领由外甥女拉文斯贝格的玛格丽特和她出身于利希家族的丈夫继承。

en: Henry of Berg, called Heinrich von Windeck (before 1247 – probably 1298), was a younger son of Count Adolf VII of Berg. From 1271 to 1281 he served his brother Count Adolf VIII as stadholder, later holding Windeck Castle, one of Berg's four chief fortresses. With his brother he backed John I of Brabant in the War of the Limburg Succession and fought at the Battle of Worringen in 1288. By his wife Agnes of the Mark he fathered Count Adolf IX of Berg and Margaret, wife of Otto IV of Ravensberg. He is buried at Altenberg Cathedral.
zh: 温德克的海因里希（1247年前—约1298年）是贝格伯爵阿道夫七世较年幼的儿子。1271至1281年间，他担任兄长阿道夫八世伯爵的地方长官，后来驻守贝格四座主要城堡之一的温德克城堡。他与兄长一同支持布拉班特公爵约翰一世争夺林堡，参加了1288年的沃林根战役。他与妻子马克的阿格尼丝生有贝格伯爵阿道夫九世和嫁给拉文斯贝格伯爵奥托四世的玛格丽特，死后葬于阿尔滕贝格大教堂。

en: Alix of Thouars (1200–1221) became duchess of Brittany as an infant in 1203, after her captive half-brother Arthur disappeared in John of England's prisons and Breton barons set aside the claim of her half-sister Eleanor. Her father Guy of Thouars ruled as regent until 1206, when Philip II of France took the regency and in 1213 married her to his cousin Peter of Dreux, called Mauclerc, who governed the duchy in her name and paid homage to Paris. Recognised as countess of Richmond in 1218, Alix died in 1221, leaving the duchy to her infant son John I.
zh: 图阿尔的阿丽丝（1200—1221）于1203年在襁褓中成为布列塔尼女公爵：此前她被囚禁的同母异父兄长阿蒂尔一世在英格兰国王约翰的牢中失踪，布列塔尼贵族便排除了其姐埃莉诺的继承权。其父图阿尔的居伊先任摄政，1206年法王腓力二世接管摄政权，并于1213年将她嫁给卡佩王室支系的皮埃尔·德勒（人称‘莫克莱尔’），由皮埃尔以她的名义统治公国并向法王宣誓效忠。1218年她被承认为里奇蒙女伯爵。阿丽丝于1221年去世，公国留给年幼的儿子约翰一世。

en: Arthur II (1261–1312) was Duke of Brittany from 1305, eldest son of John II and Beatrice of England. In 1275 he married Marie, Viscountess of Limoges, mother of his heir John III; after her death he married Yolande of Dreux, widow of Alexander III of Scotland, in 1292, and this marriage produced John of Montfort, future claimant to the duchy. After Arthur inherited the duchy, his brother John became Earl of Richmond. Arthur kept Brittany independent of the French crown, divided it into eight military districts, or battles, and in 1309 summoned the first Estates of Brittany, the first French assembly including the third estate. He died on 27 August 1312 and was buried in the Cordeliers convent at Vannes.
zh: 阿蒂尔二世（1261—1312）于1305年起任布列塔尼公爵，是约翰二世与英格兰的贝阿特丽丝的长子。1275年他娶利摩日子爵夫人玛丽为妻，生下继承人约翰三世；玛丽去世后，他于1292年再娶曾为苏格兰王后的德勒的约兰德，即亚历山大三世的遗孀，生下日后争夺公国继承权的蒙福尔的约翰。阿蒂尔继承公国后，他的弟弟约翰成为里士满伯爵。阿蒂尔使布列塔尼保持对法国王室的独立，把公国划分为八个军区，并于1309年首次召集布列塔尼三级会议，这是法国首个有第三等级代表参加的会议。他于1312年8月27日去世，葬于瓦讷的方济各会修道院。

en: Béatrix of Brittany (1295–1384), Lady of Laval, Vitré and Hédé, was a daughter of Arthur II, Duke of Brittany, and Yolande of Dreux. In March 1315 she married Guy X de Laval; their three children included Guy XII de Laval and Catherine, later wife of Olivier V de Clisson. Her husband was killed and her son captured at the battle of La Roche-Derrien in June 1347, where Charles de Blois was also taken prisoner, and Béatrix raised the large ransom that freed him. She died in 1384 and was buried in Clermont Abbey.
zh: 贝阿特丽丝·德·布列塔尼（1295—1384）是拉瓦勒、维特雷和埃代的女领主，布列塔尼公爵阿蒂尔二世与德勒的约朗德之女。1315年3月，她嫁给拉瓦勒领主居伊十世，育有三个子女，其中包括居伊十二世和卡特琳；卡特琳后来嫁给奥利维耶五世·德·克利松。1347年6月的拉罗什-德里安战役中，她的丈夫战死、儿子被俘，夏尔·德·布卢瓦也在此役被擒；贝阿特丽丝筹措巨款将其赎回。她于1384年去世，葬于克莱蒙修道院。

en: Blanche of Navarre, also called Blanche of Champagne (1226–1283), was the daughter of Theobald I, King of Navarre and Count of Champagne, by Agnes of Beaujeu. Betrothed as a child to Otto III, Count of Burgundy, she was instead married in 1236 to John I, Duke of Brittany, a match that briefly made John heir to the throne of Navarre. She bore eight children, of whom only John II, Peter and Alix reached adulthood. In 1270 she founded the Abbey of La Joie near Hennebont, where she was buried after her death on 12 August 1283.
zh: 纳瓦拉的布朗什（1226—1283年），又称香槟的布朗什，是纳瓦拉国王兼香槟伯爵特奥巴尔多一世与博热的艾格尼丝之女。她幼年曾许配给勃艮第伯爵奥托三世，1236年转而嫁给布列塔尼公爵约翰一世，这桩联姻一度使约翰成为纳瓦拉王位继承人。她共生八名子女，仅约翰二世、彼得和阿莉克丝长大成人。1270年，她在埃讷邦附近兴建喜悦修道院，1283年8月12日去世后葬于该院。

en: Catherine de Laval (c. 1329 – before 1378) was the daughter of Guy X de Laval and Beatrice of Brittany, herself a daughter of Duke Arthur II. About 1370 she married the Breton captain Olivier V de Clisson, a match that made him cousin to both claimants John IV de Montfort and Joan of Penthièvre. She bore two daughters: Marguerite, who married John of Châtillon, Count of Penthièvre, and Béatrix, wife of Viscount Alan VIII of Rohan. While her husband campaigned, she ran his estates from Josselin Castle.
zh: 卡特琳·德·拉瓦勒（约1329—1378年前）是拉瓦勒领主居伊十世与布列塔尼公爵阿蒂尔二世之女贝阿特丽丝的女儿。约1370年，她嫁给布列塔尼名将奥利维耶五世·德·克利松，这桩婚事使丈夫与继承权交战双方的让四世·德·蒙福尔和让娜·德·庞蒂耶夫尔都成了表亲。她生有两女：玛格丽特嫁给庞蒂耶夫尔伯爵让·德·沙蒂永，贝阿特丽丝嫁给罗昂子爵阿兰八世。丈夫在外征战期间，她在若瑟兰城堡打理家族产业。

en: Charles of Blois-Châtillon (1319–1364), called the Saint, was a son of Guy de Châtillon, Count of Blois, and nephew of King Philip VI of France. In 1337 he married Joan of Penthièvre, niece and heiress of John III of Brittany, and claimed the duchy on the duke's death in 1341, fighting John of Montfort with French backing in the Breton War of Succession. A devout ascetic who is said to have put pebbles in his shoes and worn a hairshirt under his armour, he still ordered the massacre of 1,400 civilians after the siege of Quimper. Captured by the English in 1347, he spent nine years in captivity and was released in 1356 for a ransom of about half a million écus. He resumed the war and was killed at Auray on 29 September 1364, a defeat that, with the 1381 treaty of Guérande, ended the war in the Montforts' favour. He was beatified in 1904.
zh: 夏尔·德·布卢瓦-沙蒂永（1319—1364），人称“圣人”，是布卢瓦伯爵居伊·德·沙蒂永之子、法王腓力六世的外甥。1337年，他迎娶布列塔尼公爵让三世的侄女兼继承人让娜·德·庞蒂耶夫尔，并在1341年让三世去世后主张公国继承权，在法国王室支持下与让·德·蒙福尔展开布列塔尼继承战争。他虔诚苦修，相传在鞋里放小石子，铠甲下穿苦衣，却仍在坎佩尔围城后下令屠杀1,400名平民。1347年他被英军俘虏，囚禁九年，1356年交付约五十万埃居赎金获释。他重启战事，1364年9月29日在欧赖战死；这一败，加上1381年的盖朗德条约，使战争以蒙福尔家获胜告终。他于1904年被宣福。

en: Guy of Thouars (died 13 April 1213) was a Poitevin noble of the House of Thouars and the third husband of Constance, Duchess of Brittany, whom he married at Angers in 1199. He was Duke of Brittany as her husband until Constance died giving birth to twin daughters in 1201. After her son Arthur I disappeared in English captivity in 1203, Guy served as regent of Brittany for his own daughter Alix until 1206. In 1204 he besieged and burned Mont Saint-Michel in Normandy. In 1206 Philip II of France took the regency himself, to the dismay of the Breton nobles. Guy died at Chemillé in 1213 and was buried beside Constance at Villeneuve Abbey.
zh: 图阿尔的居伊（1213年4月13日卒）是图阿尔家族的普瓦图贵族，也是布列塔尼女公爵康斯坦丝的第三任丈夫，两人于1199年在昂热成婚。他以康斯坦丝丈夫的身份成为布列塔尼公爵，直到她1201年产下双胞胎女儿时去世。1203年康斯坦丝之子阿蒂尔一世在英格兰人的囚禁中失踪后，居伊为亲生女儿阿丽丝摄政布列塔尼，直至1206年。1204年他围攻并焚毁了诺曼底的圣米歇尔山。1206年，法国国王腓力二世亲自接管摄政，引起布列塔尼贵族不满。1213年他死于谢米耶，与康斯坦丝合葬于新城修道院。

en: Guy de Bretagne, also Guy VII of Limoges (1287–1331), was the second son of Duke Arthur II of Brittany and Marie of Limoges. In 1314 his brother John III invested him with the viscounty of Limoges, but after a papal bull that September Duke John's wife Isabella recovered it in 1317, and Guy was compensated with the county of Penthièvre. In 1318 he married Jeanne d'Avaugour, lady of Goëlo, building a strong lordship in northern Brittany; their daughter Jeanne de Penthièvre inherited his claims. He died suddenly on 27 March 1331 and was buried at Guingamp.
zh: 布列塔尼的居伊，又称利摩日子爵居伊七世（1287—1331年），是布列塔尼公爵阿蒂尔二世与利摩日的玛丽的次子。1314年，其兄约翰三世封他为利摩日子爵，但在当年9月教皇诏书的干预下，公爵夫人伊莎贝拉于1317年收回该领地，居伊则得到庞蒂耶夫尔伯国作为补偿。1318年，他娶戈埃洛女领主阿沃古尔的让娜为妻，在布列塔尼北部建立起强大的领地，女儿让娜·德·庞蒂耶夫尔继承了他的权利。1331年3月27日他突然去世，葬于甘冈。

en: Guy X de Laval (c. 1300–1347) was a Breton baron: lord of Laval and Acquigny, baron of Vitré, viscount of Rennes and count of Caserta in the kingdom of Naples. The son of Guy IX de Laval and Béatrix de Gavre, he married Béatrix of Brittany, daughter of Duke Arthur II, on 2 March 1315, which made Duke John III his brother-in-law. Their children included Guy XI, Jean (later Guy XII) and Catherine, who in 1361 married the constable Olivier de Clisson. On 18 June 1347 he fought at La Roche-Derrien in the Breton War of Succession, the battle in which Charles of Blois was taken prisoner. Guy X was killed there, and his son Guy XI, who fought beside him, was captured.
zh: 居伊十世·德·拉瓦勒（约1300—1347）是布列塔尼贵族，身兼拉瓦勒与阿基尼领主、维特雷男爵、雷恩子爵，并在那不勒斯王国领有卡塞塔伯爵衔。他是居伊九世·德·拉瓦勒与贝阿特丽丝·德·加夫尔之子，1315年3月2日娶布列塔尼公爵阿蒂尔二世之女贝阿特丽丝为妻，公爵让三世因此成为他的内兄。子女包括居伊十一世、让（即后来的居伊十二世），以及1361年嫁给王室统帅奥利维耶·德·克利松的卡特琳。1347年6月18日，他在布列塔尼继承战争的拉罗什德里安战役中作战，夏尔·德·布卢瓦就在此战被俘。居伊十世战死，随他出战的儿子居伊十一世则被俘。

en: Guy XI de Laval (c. 1316–1348), eldest son of Guy X and Béatrix of Brittany, held his inheritance for little more than a year. In 1338 his father married him to Isabeau, heiress of Craon. On 18 June 1347 he fought beside his father at La Roche-Derrien, where Guy X was killed and Charles of Blois was taken; Guy XI was captured by the English as well, and his mother then arranged the ransom. As lord of Laval and Vitré, viscount of Rennes and count of Caserta, he was summoned that July by John, Duke of Normandy, to do homage for Laval. He died at the Château de Vitré on 22 September 1348, never having recovered from his wounds, and was buried beside his father. He left no children, and his brother succeeded him as Guy XII.
zh: 居伊十一世·德·拉瓦勒（约1316—1348）是居伊十世与布列塔尼的贝阿特丽丝的长子，继承家业不过一年有余。1338年，父亲为他聘定克朗领地的女继承人伊莎博。1347年6月18日，他随父亲在拉罗什德里安作战，居伊十世战死，夏尔·德·布卢瓦被俘；居伊十一世同样被英军俘虏，他的母亲后来出面安排赎金。作为拉瓦勒与维特雷领主、雷恩子爵和卡塞塔伯爵，他在当年7月被诺曼底公爵约翰召去，就拉瓦勒领地宣誓效忠。他于1348年9月22日在维特雷城堡去世，伤势始终未能痊愈，葬在父亲身旁。他没有子嗣，由弟弟继为居伊十二世。

en: Guy XII de Laval (c. 1327–1412), second son of Guy X and Béatrix of Brittany, was baptised Jean by his uncle Duke John III and took the name Guy only in 1348, when he succeeded his brother Guy XI as baron of Laval and Vitré. He stood close to Bertrand du Guesclin and to Olivier de Clisson, his brother-in-law from 1361. In 1356 he shut himself into Rennes when the Duke of Lancaster besieged it. After Auray in 1364, du Guesclin was captured and his ransom set at 100,000 livres; Charles V raised 40,000 and Guy paid the rest. In 1370 he was among the commanders who beat Robert Knolles' English at Pontvallain. He helped broker the second Treaty of Guérande in 1381 and in 1382 governed Brittany as lieutenant-general. In 1384 he married du Guesclin's widow, Jeanne de Laval; their daughter Anne inherited Laval and Vitré when he died in 1412.
zh: 居伊十二世·德·拉瓦勒（约1327—1412）是拉瓦勒的居伊十世与布列塔尼的贝阿特丽丝之次子，由舅父布列塔尼公爵让三世施洗，取名让，直到1348年继兄居伊十一世为拉瓦勒与维特雷男爵之后，才按家族惯例改名居伊。他与贝特朗·杜·盖克兰往来密切，又自1361年起是奥利维耶·德·克利松的妹夫。1356年，兰开斯特公爵围攻雷恩，他入城与守军共进退。1364年欧赖战役后，杜·盖克兰被俘，赎金定为十万里弗尔：查理五世出了四万，其余由居伊付清。1370年，他是在蓬瓦兰击败罗贝尔·诺尔斯所率英军的统帅之一。他促成了1381年的第二次《盖朗德条约》，1382年又以副摄政王身份治理布列塔尼。1384年，他迎娶杜·盖克兰的遗孀让娜·德·拉瓦勒；1412年他去世后，两人的女儿安妮继承了拉瓦勒与维特雷。

en: Joan of Penthièvre (c. 1319–1384), called Joan the Lame, was the only child of Guy of Penthièvre, younger brother of John III of Brittany, and Joan of Avaugour. In 1337 she married Charles of Blois, and on her uncle's death in 1341 the couple claimed Brittany, fighting the House of Montfort in the Breton War of Succession. After Charles was killed at Auray in 1364, the First Treaty of Guérande in 1365 left her Countess of Penthièvre with a life right to the ducal title. She ratified the Second Treaty of Guérande in 1381.
zh: 让娜·德·庞蒂耶夫尔（约1319—1384），绰号“跛子让娜”，是布列塔尼公爵让三世之弟居伊·德·庞蒂耶夫尔与让娜·达沃古尔的独女。1337年她嫁给夏尔·德·布卢瓦，1341年伯父去世后，夫妇二人主张继承布列塔尼公国，与蒙福尔家族展开布列塔尼继承战争。1364年夏尔在欧赖战役战死后，1365年的第一次《盖朗德条约》确认她为庞蒂耶夫尔女伯爵，并终身保留公爵头衔。1381年，她批准了第二次《盖朗德条约》。

en: Joan of Savoy (c. 1310–1344) was the only child of Edward, Count of Savoy, and Blanche of Burgundy. In 1329 she married John III, Duke of Brittany, his third wife. When her father died the same year, she claimed Savoy, but her uncle Aymon, backed by the nobility under semi-Salic law, succeeded instead. Allied with the Dauphin de Viennois, she pressed her claim until, on 22 November 1339, she renounced it for a pension of 6000 livres. Her childless marriage left the Breton succession disputed when John III died in 1341. She died on 29 June 1344.
zh: 萨伏依的让娜（约1310—1344）是萨伏依伯爵爱德华与勃艮第的布朗什的独女。1329年，她嫁给布列塔尼公爵让三世，成为其第三任妻子。同年父亲去世，她主张继承萨伏依，但叔父艾蒙依据半萨利克法得到贵族支持而继位。让娜与维埃纳的王太子结盟，继续争取继承权，最终于1339年11月22日放弃主张，换取每年6000里弗尔的年金。她与让三世没有子嗣，1341年丈夫去世后布列塔尼的继承陷入争端。她于1344年6月29日去世。

en: Marie of Limoges (1260–1290) was the only child and heiress of Viscount Guy VI of Limoges and Margaret of Burgundy. Succeeding at the age of three in 1263 under her mother's tutelage, she was the last of the viscountal line. Betrothed in 1269 to Robert of Clermont, son of Louis IX, she was instead married at Tours in 1275 to Arthur, heir to Brittany and later Duke Arthur II, bringing the viscounty of Limoges into the Breton ducal house as her dowry. She was the mother of Duke John III and Guy, Count of Penthièvre, and died in 1290.
zh: 利摩日的玛丽（1260—1290年）是利摩日子爵居伊六世与勃艮第的玛格丽特唯一的女儿和继承人。1263年她3岁继位，由母亲监护，是古老的利摩日子爵家族最后一位传人。1269年她曾许配给法兰西国王路易九世之子罗贝尔·德·克莱蒙，后作罢；1275年在图尔嫁给布列塔尼继承人阿蒂尔，即后来的阿蒂尔二世，利摩日子爵领地作为嫁妆并入布列塔尼公爵家族。她是公爵约翰三世与庞蒂耶夫尔伯爵居伊的母亲，于1290年去世。

en: Peter I of Brittany, called Peter Mauclerc (c. 1187–1250), was a younger son of Robert II of Dreux. In 1213 Philip II of France chose him to replace the young Henry of Avaugour as Alix of Thouars's betrothed; Peter married the Duchess of Brittany in 1214. He ruled at her side and then served as regent for his son John I until 1237. He clashed with the bishop of Nantes over church land needed for the city's new walls. Earl of Richmond from 1218, he led the barons opposing Blanche of Castile before submitting in 1234. He joined the Barons' Crusade in 1239 and Louis IX's Seventh Crusade in 1249; wounded and captured at Mansourah in 1250, he died at sea returning home and was buried at Braine.
zh: 布列塔尼的皮埃尔一世，绰号“恶教士”莫克莱尔（约1187—1250），是德勒的罗贝尔二世的幼子之一。1213年，法王腓力二世选他取代年幼的阿沃古尔的亨利，与爱丽丝·德·图阿尔订婚；他于1214年迎娶这位布列塔尼女公爵。他先与妻子共同治国，之后为儿子约翰一世摄政至1237年。他因南特新城墙所需的教会土地与南特主教冲突。他自1218年成为里士满伯爵，曾领导贵族对抗卡斯蒂利亚的布朗什，1234年归顺朝廷。他参加了1239年的男爵十字军和1249年路易九世发起的第七次十字军；1250年在曼苏拉受伤被俘，于归国途中死于海上，葬于布赖讷。

en: John I the Red (c. 1217–1286), named for the colour of his beard, was Duke of Brittany from 1221, succeeding his mother Alix of Thouars under the regency of his father Peter Mauclerc until 1237. In 1236 he married Blanche, daughter of King Theobald I of Navarre, who bore his successor John II. He clashed repeatedly with the bishop of Nantes and in 1240 expelled the Jews from the duchy and cancelled debts owed to them. Henry III made him Earl of Richmond in 1268, and he joined Louis IX on the Eighth Crusade in 1270, surviving the plague that killed the king. He died on 8 October 1286.
zh: “红发”约翰一世（约1217—1286）因胡须的颜色得名，自1221年起任布列塔尼公爵，继承母亲爱丽丝·德·图阿尔，先由父亲皮埃尔·莫克莱尔摄政至1237年。1236年，他娶纳瓦拉国王蒂博一世之女布朗什为妻，后者生下继承人约翰二世。他屡次与南特主教冲突，1240年下令驱逐公国境内的犹太人，并取消欠他们的债务。1268年亨利三世封他为里士满伯爵，1270年他随路易九世参加第八次十字军，在夺去国王性命的瘟疫中幸存，于1286年10月8日去世。

en: John II (1239–1305), eldest son of John I the Red, was Duke of Brittany from 1286 and Earl of Richmond. In 1260 he married Beatrice, daughter of Henry III of England, and in 1271 joined Edward I on the Ninth Crusade. He fought alongside Philip III of France in the Aragonese Crusade in 1285. In the 1294 Gascon War he first aided Edward, but after English troops sacked Saint-Mathieu Abbey in 1296 he turned to Philip IV of France, who made him a peer of France in 1297. Edward deprived him of Richmond, and John helped negotiate the peace for Philip. He fought at Mons-en-Pévèle and in 1305 attended Clement V's coronation at Lyon, where a collapsing wall crushed him; he died on 18 November.
zh: 约翰二世（1239—1305）是“红发”约翰一世的长子，1286年起任布列塔尼公爵，兼领里士满伯爵。1260年，他娶英王亨利三世之女贝阿特丽丝为妻，1271年随爱德华一世参加第九次十字军，1285年又随法王腓力三世参加阿拉贡十字军。1294年加斯科涅战争爆发后，他先助爱德华作战，但1296年英军劫掠圣马修修道院后转投法王腓力四世，1297年受封法国贵族。爱德华剥夺了他的里士满伯爵领，他则为腓力参与和约谈判。他参加了蒙桑佩韦勒战役。1305年，他赴里昂出席教宗克雷芒五世的加冕庆典，被坍塌的城墙压中，于11月18日伤重而亡。

en: John III the Good (1286–1341), son of Arthur II and Marie of Limoges, became Duke of Brittany in 1312 and ruled through nearly thirty years of peace and prosperity. He was a loyal ally of the French crown: he brought fifteen Breton banners to Philip VI at Cassel in 1328 and was wounded there, and in 1340 his fleet joined the French at Sluys and was destroyed with them. Yet as Earl of Richmond from 1334 he had sworn homage to Edward III of England, so the Hundred Years' War found him holding land under both kings. He resented his stepmother Yolande of Dreux and her son John of Montfort, whom he would not accept as heir. All three of his marriages were childless, and he considered leaving the duchy to the French crown. He died at Caen on 30 April 1341, and his death opened the Breton War of Succession.
zh: “好人”约翰三世（1286—1341）是阿蒂尔二世与利摩日的玛丽之子，1312年成为布列塔尼公爵，在位近三十年，公国安定繁荣。他是法国王室的忠实盟友：1328年他带着十五面布列塔尼军旗随腓力六世出征卡塞尔并负伤；1340年他的舰队与法军会合于斯勒伊斯，与法军一同被英军摧毁。可是1334年起他兼任里士满伯爵，曾向英王爱德华三世宣誓效忠，百年战争爆发时，他在两位国王名下都有领地。他厌恶继母德勒的约兰德及其子蒙福尔的约翰，不肯接受后者做继承人。他的三次婚姻都没有子嗣，曾考虑把公国留给法国王室。1341年4月30日，他在卡昂去世，随即引发布列塔尼继承战争。

en: Arnaud-Guilhem de Béarn (c. 1330–c. 1391) was the illegitimate son of Gaston II, Count of Foix, by his mistress Marie Sans de Roncevaux. Born shortly before his half-brother Gaston III Fébus, he became Fébus's closest collaborator. By 1353 he was lieutenant-general of Béarn, left with wide powers whenever the count was away; he lived in the Château de Moncade at Orthez and that October had to put down a revolt of the Orthez townsmen. Through Fébus's reign he led the armies and directed the fortifications. In 1362 Fébus charged him with repudiating Agnes of Navarre, just after she had borne the heir. He married the heiress of Morlanne, to Fébus's advantage, and the Château de Morlanne was built there to complete Fébus's defensive system. He died around 1390, shortly before Fébus.
zh: 阿尔诺·吉耶姆·德·贝阿恩（约1330—约1391）是富瓦伯爵加斯东二世与情妇玛丽·桑斯·德·龙塞沃的私生子。他比异母弟加斯东三世·费比斯略早出生，后来成为费比斯最亲近的帮手。1353年，他已是贝阿恩的副摄政王，费比斯外出时由他全权代理；他驻在奥尔泰兹的蒙卡德城堡，当年10月须应付奥尔泰兹市民的叛乱。费比斯在位期间，他统领军队、主持要塞修筑。1362年，费比斯在王妃纳瓦拉的阿涅丝刚生下继承人后，命他将其休弃。他娶了莫尔拉讷领地的女继承人，此举对费比斯有利，莫尔拉讷城堡也修建于此，用来补全费比斯的防御体系。他约在1390年去世，略早于费比斯。

en: Agnes of Brunswick (1317 – 2 June 1371) was the only child of Duke Otto the Mild of Brunswick-Lüneburg by his first wife Jutta of Hesse.
zh: 阿格内丝（1317—1371年6月2日）是不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵奥托“温和者”与第一任妻子黑森的尤塔的独女。

en: Albert II, called the Fat (c. 1268–1318), was the second son of Duke Albert I of Brunswick-Lüneburg and Adelaide of Montferrat. The brothers ruled jointly after their father's death in 1279. In 1284 Albert married Rixa of Werle, granddaughter of Birger Jarl. When the inheritance was divided in 1286, Albert received Göttingen, Northeim and the lands around Hanover and made Bollruz Castle in Göttingen his seat. After his brother William died in 1292, a seven-year dispute with his brother Henry ended in Albert's favour, with Brunswick's support; Henry kept his new principality of Grubenhagen. In 1303 he acquired Nienover.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿爾布雷希特二世_(布倫瑞克)
zh: 阿尔布雷希特二世，绰号‘胖子’（约1268—1318），是不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的韦尔夫王公，阿尔布雷希特一世公爵与蒙费拉托的阿德莱德的次子。1279年父亲去世后，兄弟数人共同统治。1284年，阿尔布雷希特娶比尔耶尔·亚尔的孙女里克莎·冯·维勒为妻。1286年兄弟分割遗产，阿尔布雷希特分得哥廷根、诺特海姆和汉诺威一带，以哥廷根的博尔鲁茨城堡为居所。1292年弟弟威廉去世后，他与兄长海因里希爆发长达七年的遗产之争，最终在不伦瑞克城支持下获胜，海因里希保有其新建的格鲁本哈根侯国。1303年他取得尼诺弗。

en: Ernest I (c. 1305–24 April 1367) was a son of Albert II the Fat of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel and Rixa of Werle. When his childless brother Otto the Mild died in 1344, he and Magnus I divided the Welf lands, and Ernest took the Principality of Göttingen, the poorest of the Welf domains: the old Northeim holdings, with Göttingen, Uslar, Dransfeld, Münden and half of Moringen. The split parted Göttingen from Brunswick for a long time, though the city of Brunswick itself stayed with the whole house. Ernest ruled Göttingen until his death. In 1339 he married Elizabeth, daughter of Landgrave Henry II the Iron of Hesse; she bore him six children, including his successor Otto I, to whom he handed some government business around 1364. He is believed to have fought alongside local cities against the robber barons around Göttingen, and in 1364 he joined Mainz, Hesse, Waldeck and Hohnstein in a war on the Bishopric of Hildesheim.
zh: 恩斯特一世（约1305—1367年4月24日）是不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔的“胖子”阿尔布雷希特二世与韦尔勒的里克莎之子。1344年，无嗣的兄长“温和者”奥托去世，他与马格努斯一世瓜分韦尔夫家族领地，恩斯特分得哥廷根亲王国，那是韦尔夫诸领地中最贫瘠的一块，由诺特海姆家族的旧产构成，包括哥廷根、乌斯拉尔、德兰斯费尔德、哈恩明登和半个莫林根。这次分割使哥廷根与不伦瑞克长期分离，不伦瑞克城本身仍归全家族共有。恩斯特统治哥廷根直至去世。1339年，他娶黑森领地伯爵“铁人”亨利二世之女伊丽莎白为妻，育有六名子女，其中包括继承人奥托一世；约1364年，他把部分政务交给奥托。据推测，他曾与当地城市共同对抗哥廷根周边的强盗骑士；1364年，他还与美因茨、黑森、瓦尔德克和霍恩施泰因一道，对希尔德斯海姆主教区用兵。

en: Jutta of Hesse (c. 1289–1317) was the youngest daughter of Henry I, the first Landgrave of Hesse and founder of the Hessian princely house, and Mechthild of Cleves. In 1311 she married Duke Otto of Brunswick-Göttingen, known as Otto the Mild. Jutta died in 1317, the year her only child, Agnes, was born, and was buried in Brunswick Cathedral. In 1329 the widowed Otto endowed an altar in Göttingen where masses were to be said for her.
zh: 黑森的尤塔（约1289—1317）是黑森首任领地伯爵、黑森诸侯家族开创者亨利一世与克莱沃的梅希蒂尔德的幼女。1311年，她嫁给不伦瑞克-哥廷根公爵、绰号“温和者”的奥托。尤塔于1317年去世，同年她唯一的孩子阿格妮丝出生，她葬于不伦瑞克大教堂。1329年，鳏居的奥托在哥廷根捐资设立一座祭坛，命人为她举行弥撒。

en: Magnus I, called the Pious (1304–1369), was a Welf prince and the first duke to rule Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel as a principality of its own. The son of Duke Albert the Fat, he came under his brother Otto's guardianship in 1318. His wife Sophia of Brandenburg was a niece of Emperor Louis IV on her mother's side, and in 1333 Louis made Magnus margrave of Landsberg. When Otto died childless in 1344, Magnus and Ernest divided the Welf lands; Magnus took Wolfenbüttel in 1345, while the city of Brunswick stayed the property of the whole house. War with the Archbishop of Magdeburg forced him in 1347 to sell Landsberg and cede territory, and the ruined duke could not stop towns, Brunswick above all, from winning more rights. His claims to Lüneburg helped spark the Lüneburg Succession War. In 1367 he plundered the lands of the Bishop of Hildesheim, was beaten and captured at Dinklar, and died in summer 1369 after paying ransom.
zh: 马格努斯一世，绰号“虔诚者”（1304—1369），是韦尔夫家族的王公，也是第一位把不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔作为独立公国来统治的公爵。他是公爵“胖子”阿尔布雷希特之子，1318年起由兄长奥托监护。他的妻子勃兰登堡的索菲按母系是皇帝路易四世的侄女，1333年路易封马格努斯为兰茨贝格藩侯。1344年奥托无嗣而终，马格努斯与恩斯特瓜分韦尔夫家族领地，1345年他分得沃尔芬比特尔，不伦瑞克城则仍归全家族共有。1347年，在与马格德堡大主教的战争中，他被迫卖掉兰茨贝格并割让部分领地；财政破产的他无力阻止城镇，尤其是不伦瑞克城，取得更多权利。他对吕讷堡的继承权主张促成了吕讷堡继承战争。1367年，他劫掠希尔德斯海姆主教的领地，在丁克拉尔兵败被俘，缴纳赎金获释，于1369年夏去世。

en: Magnus II, called Torquatus or Magnus of the Silver Chain (1328–25 July 1373), was the Welf duke of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel and, briefly, Lüneburg. The eldest son of Magnus the Pious, he served as an administrator at Sangerhausen before inheriting Wolfenbüttel in 1369. Within months Duke William II of Lüneburg died too, having named Magnus his heir, and Welf house law backed the claim, since Magnus the Pious had been William's second cousin. Emperor Charles IV instead treated Lüneburg as an imperial fief that had fallen vacant and granted it to the Ascanian duke Albert of Saxe-Wittenberg and his uncle Wenzel, igniting the Lüneburg Succession War. Magnus's repeated demands for money drove the town of Lüneburg to side with his rivals, and his attempt to take it failed. On 25 July 1373 he died of a wound received in a duel with his brother-in-law Count Otto I of Schaumburg at the Battle of Leveste.
zh: 马格努斯二世，绰号“佩银链者”托尔夸图斯（1328—1373年7月25日），是韦尔夫家族的不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔公爵，并曾短暂领有吕讷堡。他是“虔诚者”马格努斯的长子，曾在桑格豪森任管理人，1369年继承沃尔芬比特尔。数月之内，吕讷堡公爵威廉二世也去世，此前已指定马格努斯为继承人；依韦尔夫家族的家法，这一主张站得住脚，因为“虔诚者”马格努斯是威廉的再从兄弟。但皇帝查理四世视吕讷堡为已收归帝国的空置采邑，转封给阿斯坎尼家族的萨克森-维滕贝格公爵阿尔贝特及其叔父文策尔，吕讷堡继承战争由此爆发。马格努斯反复征款，致使吕讷堡城倒向他的对手，他试图攻占该城却告失败。1373年7月25日，他在莱韦斯泰战役中与姻亲绍姆堡伯爵奥托一世决斗，受伤致死。

en: Otto I, called the Child (c. 1204–9 June 1252), was the only son of William of Winchester and Helena, daughter of King Valdemar I of Denmark. He inherited the Welf estates around Lüneburg as a minor in 1213. When Emperor Frederick II tried to seize Brunswick after his uncle's death, Otto, backed by the town and the estates, drove the imperial forces out. Around 1228 he married Matilda of Brandenburg, mother of his successors Albert I and John. In 1235 Frederick enfeoffed him as first duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg. He died in 1252 and was buried in Brunswick Cathedral.
zh: 奥托一世，绰号“孩童”（约1204—1252年6月9日），是温彻斯特的威廉与丹麦国王瓦尔德马一世之女海伦娜的独子。1213年他幼年继承韦尔夫家族在吕讷堡一带的领地。皇帝腓特烈二世企图夺取不伦瑞克，奥托在城市和各等级支持下击退皇军。约1228年他娶勃兰登堡的玛蒂尔达，继承人阿尔布雷希特一世和约翰皆为她所生。1235年，腓特烈封他为第一代不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵。他于1252年去世，葬于不伦瑞克大教堂。

en: Otto the Mild (24 June 1292 – 30 August 1344), Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg, was the eldest son of Albert II and Rixa of Werle. He succeeded his father in 1318 and ruled as guardian to his brothers. In 1311 he married Jutta of Hesse, who bore him a daughter Agnes, and in 1319, after her death, Agnes of Brandenburg, through whom he claimed the Altmark. Unable to master the Brandenburg nobility, he sold his rights there for 3000 marks in 1343. He died at Göttingen in 1344; his brothers Ernest and Magnus split the duchy into Göttingen and Wolfenbüttel.
zh: 奥托“温和者”（1292年6月24日—1344年8月30日）是不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵，阿尔布雷希特二世与韦尔勒的里克莎的长子。1318年父亲去世后他继位，并担任诸弟的监护人。他于1311年娶黑森的尤塔，生有一女阿格内丝；尤塔死后，1319年续娶勃兰登堡的阿格内丝，并凭借她主张阿尔特马克的继承权。由于无法压服勃兰登堡贵族，他于1343年以3000银马克出让了在当地的权利。1344年他在哥廷根去世，弟弟恩斯特与马格努斯将公国分为哥廷根与沃尔芬比特尔两支。

en: Rixa of Werle (c. 1270–26 November 1317) was the daughter of Henry I, Prince of Werle, and Rikissa Birgersdotter. Rixa was a granddaughter of the Swedish jarl Birger Magnusson of Bjälbo. On 10 January 1284 she married Albert II, Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg, founder of the Göttingen line. She bore Albert thirteen children, among them Otto the Mild, Magnus I of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel, Ernest I of Göttingen, Albert, Bishop of Halberstadt, and Henry, Bishop of Hildesheim. Rixa died in 1317, ten months before her husband.
zh: 韦尔勒的里克莎（约1270—1317年11月26日）是韦尔勒亲王亨利一世与里基莎·比耶尔斯多塔之女，也是瑞典雅尔、比耶博的比尔耶·马格努松的外孙女。1284年1月10日，她嫁给不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵阿尔布雷希特二世，即哥廷根支系的开创者。她为丈夫生下十三个子女，其中包括“温和者”奥托、不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔的马格努斯一世、哥廷根的恩斯特一世、哈尔伯施塔特主教阿尔布雷希特以及希尔德斯海姆主教亨利。里克莎于1317年去世，比丈夫早十个月。

en: William I (1270–1292) was the third son of Duke Albert I of Brunswick and Adelaide of Montferrat. After their father died in 1279, the brothers fought Bishop Otto I of Hildesheim and took Campen Castle. In the 1286 partition William received Brunswick itself and its surrounding lands, while Henry and Albert took Grubenhagen and Göttingen; open war between the brothers followed in 1288. He married Elisabeth, daughter of Landgrave Henry I of Hesse, probably without children. William died at Brunswick on 30 September 1292, his lands passing to Albert after an inheritance dispute with Henry.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/威廉一世_(不倫瑞克-沃爾芬比特爾)
zh: 威廉一世（1270—1292）是不伦瑞克公爵阿尔布雷希特一世与蒙费拉托的阿德莱德的第三子。1279年父亲去世后，他与兄弟们一同对抗希尔德斯海姆主教奥托一世，夺得坎彭城堡。1286年瓜分遗产时，威廉分得不伦瑞克本城及周边土地，海因里希与阿尔布雷希特分别得到格鲁本哈根和哥廷根；1288年兄弟间公开开战。他娶黑森方伯海因里希一世之女伊丽莎白为妻，可能没有子女。1292年9月30日威廉卒于不伦瑞克，围绕遗产再起争端，他的领地最终落入阿尔布雷希特之手。

en: Dmitry Romanovich (c. 1290–after 1352), a Rurikid prince, ruled Bryansk from about 1314, although chronicles variously style him Romanovich or Alexandrovich. In 1333 or 1334 he marched with Tatar murzas against Smolensk, then made a sham of the campaign and concluded peace with Prince Ivan Alexandrovich, whereupon Moscow's Ivan Kalita had him replaced by Gleb Sviatoslavich. After the Bryansk veche killed Gleb in December 1340, Dmitry regained his throne and in 1341 married his daughter Fedosia to Ivan II of Moscow. Around 1352 Ivan of Smolensk deposed him again; he is said to have died of plague soon after.
zh: 德米特里·罗曼诺维奇（约1290—1352年后）是出身留里克家族的王公，约1314年起统治布良斯克，编年史对其父名有罗曼诺维奇与亚历山德罗维奇两说。1333或1334年，他随鞑靼木儿咱出征斯摩棱斯克，却虚与周旋，同斯摩棱斯克王公伊凡·亚历山德罗维奇议和，莫斯科的伊凡·卡利塔随即将他排挤下台，扶植格列布·斯维亚托斯拉维奇。1340年12月，布良斯克市民在维彻上杀死格列布，德米特里复位，并于1341年将女儿费多西娅嫁给莫斯科的伊凡二世。约1352年，他被斯摩棱斯克的伊凡再度废黜，相传不久死于瘟疫。

en: Gleb Svyatoslavich (died 6 December 1340) was a Rurikid prince of the Smolensk branch and son of Svyatoslav Glebovich, Prince of Bryansk. In 1333 the Smolensk prince Ivan Alexandrovich secured his installation on the Bryansk throne, although the townspeople of Bryansk disliked both Gleb and his father. He ruled Bryansk for at least seven years. In 1340, after the death of Ivan I of Moscow, the citizens gathered in veche and killed him, ignoring the warnings of Metropolitan Theognostus.
zh: 格列布·斯维亚托斯拉维奇（1340年12月6日卒）是斯摩棱斯克支系的留里克王公，布良斯克王公斯维亚托斯拉夫·格列博维奇之子。1333年，经斯摩棱斯克王公伊凡·亚历山德罗维奇运作，他被扶上布良斯克公位，但布良斯克市民对他和他的父亲都心怀敌意。他统治布良斯克至少七年。1340年莫斯科王公伊凡一世去世后，布良斯克市民召开维切，不顾费奥格诺斯特都主教的劝阻将他杀死。

en: Oleg Romanovich, later revered as Saint Oleg of Bryansk, was the younger son of Roman the Old and succeeded him as prince of Bryansk and grand prince of Chernigov after 1288. The Galician-Volhynian Chronicle names him in 1274 among the princes taking part in the campaign against Lithuania, and in 1285 he joined his father's unsuccessful attack on Smolensk. He died in 1290 or 1307. Canonised by the Russian Orthodox Church, his feast is 20 September.
zh: 奥列格·罗曼诺维奇，后被尊为圣徒‘布良斯克的奥列格’，是‘老者’罗曼的幼子，1288年后继承父位，任布良斯克王公兼切尔尼戈夫大公。《加里西亚-沃伦编年史》在1274年条下提到他参加了对立陶宛的征战；1285年他又随父亲出征斯摩棱斯克，无果而返。他于1290年或1307年去世。俄罗斯正教会将他尊为圣徒王公，纪念日为9月20日。

en: Roman Mikhailovich, called the Old, was prince of Bryansk and, from 1263, grand prince of Chernigov, a son of Mikhail Vsevolodovich of Chernigov. When Lithuanians seized Chernigov in 1263, he retook the city and was wounded defeating troops sent by King Mindaugas to the Dnieper's left bank. In 1274–1275 he joined the campaign against Lithuania organised by the Mongol khan Mengu-Timur, and in 1285 he led an unsuccessful attack on Smolensk. His daughter Olga married Vladimir Vasilkovich of Volhynia. He died after 1288 and was succeeded at Bryansk by his son Oleg.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/罗曼·米哈伊洛维奇_(切尔尼戈夫-布良斯克王公)
zh: 罗曼·米哈伊洛维奇，人称‘老者’，是布良斯克王公，1263年起任切尔尼戈夫大公，为切尔尼戈夫的米哈伊尔·弗谢沃洛多维奇之子。1263年立陶宛人攻占切尔尼戈夫，罗曼将其收复，并在击败国王明道加斯派往第聂伯河左岸的军队时负伤。1274—1275年，他参加蒙古汗忙哥帖木儿组织的对立陶宛的联军；1285年进攻斯摩棱斯克，无功而返。其女奥莉加嫁给沃伦的弗拉基米尔·瓦西里科维奇。他于1288年后去世，布良斯克公位由其子奥列格继承。

en: Svyatoslav Glebovich (died 1310) was the youngest son of Gleb Rostislavich of Smolensk and held Mozhaysk until 1303, when Daniil of Moscow absorbed the principality. The Smolensk Rostislavichi had claimed Bryansk through a dynastic marriage, and in 1309 Svyatoslav expelled his nephew Vasily, whom the Smolensk prince had installed on the Bryansk throne, and seized the town himself. In 1310 Vasily returned and stormed Bryansk; the Nikon Chronicle says a Golden Horde detachment accompanied him. The Bryansk regiment hung back and Svyatoslav was defeated and killed, only his own retinue fighting to the end. His sons Gleb and Fyodor later held Bryansk and Rzhev respectively.
zh: 斯维亚托斯拉夫·格列博维奇（？—1310）是斯摩棱斯克王公格列布·罗斯季斯拉维奇的幼子，起初领有莫扎伊斯克，1303年莫斯科王公丹尼尔兼并莫扎伊斯克公国后失去领地。斯摩棱斯克的罗斯季斯拉维奇一支凭借联姻取得布良斯克的继承权；1309年，斯维亚托斯拉夫逐出其侄、被斯摩棱斯克王公扶上布良斯克公位的瓦西里，自据布良斯克。1310年瓦西里率军反攻布良斯克（尼科诺夫编年史称有金帐汗国援军），布良斯克军团作战消极，唯有斯维亚托斯拉夫的亲随卫队死战，他最终兵败被杀。其子格列布、费奥多尔后来分别领有布良斯克和勒热夫。

en: Vasily Alexandrovich (died 1314) was prince of Bryansk, traditionally held to be a son of Alexander Glebovich of Smolensk, installed there after the local Olgovichi line ended with Oleg Romanovich. In 1309 his uncle Sviatoslav Glebovich, formerly of Mozhaysk, expelled him and took Bryansk. In 1310, the Nikon Chronicle says, Vasily returned with a Golden Horde detachment and stormed the town; the Bryansk regiment fought reluctantly and Sviatoslav was killed. That same year Vasily and his Tatars overran Karachev and killed its prince Sviatoslav Mstislavich. He died in 1314, and his brother Dmitry eventually succeeded at Bryansk.
zh: 瓦西里·亚历山德罗维奇（?—1314）是布良斯克王公，传统说法认为他是斯摩棱斯克王公亚历山大·格列博维奇之子，在当地奥利戈维奇王朝随奥列格·罗曼诺维奇而终后被扶上布良斯克公位。1309年，他的叔父、原莫扎伊斯克王公斯维亚托斯拉夫·格列博维奇将他逐走，夺占布良斯克。据尼科诺夫编年史记载，1310年瓦西里带着金帐汗国援军反攻并攻陷布良斯克，布良斯克军团作战不积极，斯维亚托斯拉夫兵败被杀。同年瓦西里又与鞑靼人攻入卡拉切夫，杀死当地王公斯维亚托斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇。他于1314年去世，后来由其兄弟德米特里继承布良斯克。

en: Sampurn Chand was a raja of the Chandel Rajput dynasty of Kahlur, the Himalayan hill state later called Bilaspur, reigning from 1317 to 1355.
zh: 桑普尔纳·昌德是喜马拉雅山地土邦卡卢尔（后改称比拉斯布尔）钱代尔拉杰普特王朝的罗阇，1317—1355年在位。

en: Annam Deo, also called Annamaraja, was a Telugu warrior traditionally described as a member of the Kakatiya house of Warangal and a brother of its last king, Prataparudra II. Chronicles say that after anointing Prataparudra's son as king he left Warangal for the forests to the north-east and around 1324 founded a kingdom at Bastar, placing it under the goddess Danteshwari, whose shrine at Dantewada became the dynasty's tutelary temple. Ruler lists give his reign as 1313 to 1358 and name Hamir Deo his successor.
zh: 安南·提乌，又称安纳马罗阇，是一位泰卢固武士，传统上被视为瓦朗加尔卡卡提亚家族成员、末代国王普拉塔普·鲁陀罗二世之弟。据记载，他在为普拉塔普·鲁陀罗之子灌顶立王后离开瓦朗加尔，前往东北山地，约于1324年在巴斯德尔建立王国，并奉当地女神丹泰什瓦里为保护神，丹泰瓦达的神庙由此成为王朝的守护神庙。统治者年表记其1313—1358年在位，继位者为哈米尔·提乌。

en: Massaniaga Maratung was a ruler of Bantaeng, recorded in a local list of kings as reigning from 1332 to 1362.
zh: 马萨尼亚加·马拉通是班塔恩的统治者，当地君主表记载他于1332至1362年在位。

en: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, known as Ibn Talis, founded the Hawwara Berber dynasty of Banu Talis. Born in al-Andalus and raised in Ifriqiya, he was also known as al-Qayrawani. His dynasty appeared in Libya in 1228 and made Talis, the city now known as Bani Walid, its capital.
zh: 艾哈迈德·本·穆罕默德，世称伊本·泰利斯，建立了豪瓦拉柏柏尔人的贝尼泰利斯王朝。他生于安达卢斯，成长于伊夫里基亚，也被称为凯鲁万尼。其王朝于1228年出现在利比亚，以泰利斯城，即今拜尼沃利德为都。

en: Adelheid of Hanau (born 1311–1313, died after 1378) was a daughter of Ulrich II, Lord of Hanau, and Agnes of Hohenlohe. She was first married to Count Eberhard II of Katzenelnbogen, who died soon after the wedding in 1329 leaving no children. On 29 July 1332 she was betrothed to Henry II of Isenburg-Büdingen, with her dowry handed over that September; among their children were John I of Isenburg-Büdingen and Adelheid, abbess of Quedlinburg. She was buried at Arnsburg Abbey.
zh: 哈瑙的阿德莱德（1311至1313年间生，1378年后去世）是哈瑙领主乌尔里希二世与霍恩洛厄的阿格尼丝之女。她先嫁给卡岑埃尔恩博根伯爵埃伯哈德二世，伯爵于1329年成婚后不久去世，二人无嗣。1332年7月29日，她与伊森堡-比丁根的海因里希二世订婚，同年9月交割嫁资；子女包括伊森堡-比丁根的约翰一世，以及后来出任奎德林堡修道院女院长的阿德莱德。她安葬于阿恩斯堡修道院。

en: Henry II of Isenburg-Büdingen (c. 1300–1378/1379) was a lord of the Büdingen line of the Isenburg family and burgrave of Gelnhausen, the son of Lothar of Isenburg-Cleeberg and Isengard of Falkenstein. On 29 July 1332 he was betrothed to Adelheid of Hanau, daughter of Ulrich II, Lord of Hanau. He succeeded to his father's lands around 1340 and ruled at Büdingen until 1378, by which time his house had made good its inherited claims to the lordship. His son John I succeeded him, while a daughter, Adelheid, became abbess of Quedlinburg.
zh: 伊森堡-比丁根的海因里希二世（约1300—1378/1379）是伊森堡家族比丁根支系的领主，兼任盖尔恩豪森城堡伯爵，为伊森堡-克莱贝格的洛塔尔与法尔肯施泰因的伊森加德之子。1332年7月29日，他与哈瑙领主乌尔里希二世之女哈瑙的阿德莱德订婚。约1340年他继承父领，统治比丁根至1378年，任内其家族通过婚姻继承所得的比丁根领主权最终得到确立。其子约翰一世继位，女儿阿德莱德后来成为奎德林堡修道院女院长。

en: Chwa I Nabakka was the second Kabaka, or king, of Buganda, ruling in the mid-fourteenth century after the death of his father, Kato Kintu, the kingdom's first Kabaka. His mother was Nambi Nantuttululu of the Ngeye clan, and he established his capital at Bigo Hill. He married Naabakyaala Nakku, daughter of Walusimbi of the Ffumbe clan, and Nakiwala of the Ngonge clan, who bore him Prince Kalemeera. After him the kingdom was ruled by regents Walusimbi and Sebwaana until 1374.
zh: 奇瓦一世·纳巴卡是布干达王国的第二位卡巴卡（国王），14世纪中叶在其父、开国卡巴卡卡托·金图去世后继位。他的母亲是恩盖氏族的南比·南图图卢卢，都城设在比戈山。他娶富姆贝氏族瓦卢辛比之女纳巴基亚拉·纳库，以及恩贡盖氏族的纳基瓦拉；纳基瓦拉为他生下王子卡莱梅拉。他之后王国由瓦卢辛比和塞布瓦纳两位摄政治理，直至1374年。

en: Gguluddene is named in Ganda royal tradition as one of the three children of Kato Kintu, the first Kabaka of Buganda; the others were Chwa I Nabakka, who succeeded Kintu as Kabaka, and Wakayima.
zh: 据布干达王室口传传统，古卢登内是布干达开国卡巴卡卡托·金图的三个孩子之一；另外两人是后来继位为卡巴卡的奇瓦一世·纳巴卡，以及瓦卡伊马。

en: Prince Kalemeera was the son of Kabaka Chwa I Nabakka of Buganda by Nakiwala of the Ngonge clan. Ganda tradition relates that his father drove him out of Buganda, and he took refuge in Bunyoro at the court of his uncle, Omukama Winyi I. There he had an affair with Wannyana, the Omukama's chief wife, daughter of the Muhima leader Mugalula Buyonga. She bore him a son, Kimera Walusimbi. The boy was raised in Bunyoro and in 1374 returned to Buganda to become its third Kabaka, while Kalemeera spent the rest of his life in exile.
zh: 卡莱梅拉王子是布干达卡巴卡奇瓦一世·纳巴卡与恩贡盖氏族纳基瓦拉之子。布干达口传传统称，他被父亲逐出布干达，前往布尼奥罗，投奔他的叔伯或舅父、奥穆卡马温尼一世。在那里，他与温尼的正妻瓦尼亚娜私通；瓦尼亚娜是穆希马酋长穆加卢拉·布永加之女。她为卡莱梅拉生下儿子基梅拉·瓦卢辛比。基梅拉在布尼奥罗长大，1374年返回布干达，成为第三位卡巴卡；卡莱梅拉则终老于流亡之中。

en: Kato Kintu Kakulukuku (fl. c. 1300), called Kato Kimera in Bunyoro, was the first Kabaka, or king, of the Kingdom of Buganda. Born at Bukasa in the Ssese Islands on Lake Nalubaale, he adopted the by-name Kintu after the first man in Ganda mythology and may have renamed his wife Nambi after that figure's wife. He set his capital at Nnono in Busujju County and fathered three children: Gguluddene, Chwa and Wakayima. Ganda oral tradition holds that he died at thirty, some traditions placing his burial at Nnono; his son Chwa I succeeded him.
zh: 卡托·金图·卡库卢库（约1300年前后在世）在布尼奥罗被称作卡托·基梅拉，是布干达王国的第一位卡巴卡（国王）。他出生在纳卢巴莱湖塞塞群岛的布卡萨村，以布干达神话中第一个人的名字自取别号“金图”，并可能把妻子改名为南比——神话中金图之妻即叫此名。他在布苏朱县的诺诺建立都城，生有古卢登内、奇瓦、瓦卡伊马三个孩子。布干达口传传统称他三十岁而终，一说葬于诺诺；其子奇瓦一世继位。

en: Naabakyaala Nakku, titled Kaddulubaale, was a wife of Chwa I Nabakka, the second Kabaka of Buganda, and the daughter of Walusimbi of the Ffumbe clan. After Chwa's death she married Sebwaana, who ruled Buganda as regent during the interregnum.
zh: 纳巴基亚拉·纳库，封号卡杜卢巴莱，是布干达第二位卡巴卡奇瓦一世·纳巴卡的妻子，富姆贝氏族瓦卢辛比之女。奇瓦死后，她改嫁空位期以摄政身份治理布干达的塞布瓦纳。

en: Nakiwala was a wife of Chwa I Nabakka, the second Kabaka of Buganda. She was the daughter of Semwanga of the Ngonge clan and the mother of Prince Kalemeera, who was driven into exile in Bunyoro on his father's orders.
zh: 纳基瓦拉是布干达第二位卡巴卡奇瓦一世·纳巴卡的妻子，恩贡盖氏族塞姆万加之女，王子卡莱梅拉的生母；卡莱梅拉后来被其父下令逐出布干达，流亡布尼奥罗。

en: Nambi Nantuttululu was the wife of Kato Kintu, the first Kabaka of Buganda, who may have renamed her Nambi after the wife of the mythical first man.
zh: 南比·南图图卢卢是布干达开国卡巴卡卡托·金图之妻；卡托可能因神话中第一个人金图之妻名叫南比，而为她改名南比。

en: Ganda royal tradition names Wakayima as one of the three children of Kato Kintu, the first Kabaka of Buganda; the others were Gguluddene and Chwa I Nabakka, who succeeded Kintu as Kabaka.
zh: 据布干达王室口传传统，瓦卡伊马是布干达开国卡巴卡卡托·金图的三个孩子之一；另外两人是古卢登内，以及后来继位为卡巴卡的奇瓦一世·纳巴卡。

en: Aldimir, also called Eltimir, was a Bulgarian noble of Cuman origin, a younger brother of Tsar George Terter I and despot of Kran south of the Balkan Mountains. After George abdicated in 1292 he took refuge with the Golden Horde, returning in 1298 as ally of the regent Smiltsena, whose daughter Marina he married. In 1300 he captured and blinded the pretender Radoslav, submitting to his nephew Tsar Theodore Svetoslav and winning new lands around Yambol. When he defected to Byzantium in 1305, Theodore Svetoslav overran Kran; Aldimir is not recorded thereafter and may have been killed in the campaign.
zh: 阿尔迪米尔（又名埃尔蒂米尔）是库曼裔保加利亚贵族，沙皇格奥尔基·捷尔捷尔一世之弟，也是巴尔干山脉以南克兰的专制君主。1292年其兄退位后，他投奔金帐汗国避难，1298年回国与摄政斯米尔察娜结盟，并娶其女玛琳娜为妻。1300年，他俘获并弄瞎僭位者拉多斯拉夫，归附外甥沙皇托多·斯维托斯拉夫，得以将延博尔一带并入封地。1305年他叛投拜占庭，斯维托斯拉夫出兵攻占克兰；此后阿尔迪米尔不见记载，可能死于这场战事。

en: Alexander Asen was the second son of Tsar Ivan Asen I and Empress Elena, and younger brother of Ivan Asen II. After the usurper Boril seized power in 1207, he fled with his brother first to the Cumans and then to Galicia, returning in 1217. In 1218, after Rus' mercenaries toppled Boril, Ivan Asen II made Alexander sebastokrator with Sofia as his appanage. In 1232 he stopped a Hungarian raid on the Belgrade region, and in 1233 defeated the Hungarians near Vidin, in Oltenia and at Braničevo, restoring Bulgarian control over the occupied lands. His son Kaliman Asen II briefly held the throne in 1256.
zh: 亚历山大·阿森是保加利亚沙皇伊凡·阿森一世与皇后叶莲娜的次子、伊凡·阿森二世之弟。1207年僭主博里尔夺权后，他随兄长先逃往库曼人处，再转赴加利奇，1217年回国。1218年罗斯雇佣兵推翻博里尔，伊凡·阿森二世封他为至尊者，以索非亚为封地。1232年，他挡住匈牙利人对贝尔格莱德地区的进犯；1233年又在维丁附近、奥尔泰尼亚和布拉尼切沃连挫匈军，收复失地。其子卡里曼·阿森二世曾于1256年短暂在位。

en: The father of Theodor-Peter, Ivan Asen and Kaloyan — the brothers who led the Bulgarian revolt of 1185 — was described by historian Alexandru Madgearu as a wealthy shepherd from the Balkan Mountains; Madgearu considered the brothers' estates most likely to have been near Tarnovo.
zh: 特奥多尔-彼得、伊凡·阿森与卡洛扬三兄弟领导了1185年保加利亚起义；历史学家亚历山德鲁·马杰阿鲁认为他们的父亲是海穆斯山（即巴尔干山脉）的富裕牧人，三兄弟的家产最可能位于特尔诺沃附近。

en: Balik (fl. c. 1320, died 1347) was a Bulgarian noble who built the Principality of Karvuna into a virtually independent state in the region later called Dobrudja, ruling from the fortress of Kaliakra. After he broke with Tarnovo in the 1340s, the dioceses in his region came under the Patriarchate of Constantinople. In the Byzantine civil war of 1341–1347 he backed the regent Anna of Savoy against John VI Kantakouzenos. He died in 1347, either in the Black Death or in a retaliatory campaign led by the Turkish emir Umur Beg that destroyed Dobrudja's seaports. His brother Dobrotitsa succeeded him after recapturing Karvuna in 1354.
zh: 巴利克（约1320年前后在世，1347年卒）是保加利亚贵族，他以卡利阿克拉要塞为据点，把卡尔武纳公国经营成后世称为多布罗加地区的实际独立政权。1340年代他与特尔诺沃决裂后，其辖区内的教区转归君士坦丁堡牧首管辖。1341—1347年拜占庭内战期间，他支持摄政萨伏依的安娜，对抗约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯。他于1347年去世，或死于黑死病，或死于土耳其埃米尔乌穆尔贝伊的报复性远征；这次远征摧毁了多布罗加的海港。其弟多布罗蒂察于1354年收复卡尔武纳后继立。

en: Boril was tsar of Bulgaria from 1207 to 1218. A nephew of Kaloyan through a sister of the three Asen brothers, he seized the throne after Kaloyan died besieging Thessaloniki in October 1207 and married his Cuman widow. His cousin Ivan Asen fled abroad while kinsmen including Strez and Alexius Slav rebelled. In July 1208 the Latin emperor Henry defeated him near Philippopolis. In early 1211 Boril held a church council at Tarnovo that condemned the Bogomils, and with Hungarian aid crushed a revolt at Vidin. He made peace with the Latin Empire in late 1213 or early 1214. In 1218 Ivan Asen returned, captured him at Tarnovo and blinded him.
zh: 博里尔（1207—1218年在位）是保加利亚沙皇。其母是彼得二世、伊凡·阿森一世与卡洛扬三兄弟的姐妹。1207年10月卡洛扬围攻塞萨洛尼基时暴卒，博里尔夺取皇位并娶其库曼遗孀。表亲伊凡·阿森出逃国外，斯特雷兹、阿列克修斯·斯拉夫等亲属则举兵反叛。1208年7月，拉丁帝国皇帝亨利在腓力波波利附近将他击败。1211年初，他在特尔诺沃召开宗教会议谴责波格米勒派，又借匈牙利援军镇压维丁叛乱。1213年末或1214年初，他与拉丁帝国议和。1218年伊凡·阿森归国，在特尔诺沃擒获博里尔并将其弄瞎。

en: The mother of Tsar Boril of Bulgaria was an unnamed sister of the three Asen brothers, Peter II, Ivan Asen I and Kaloyan, who restored the Bulgarian Empire in 1185; through her Boril laid claim to the throne after Kaloyan died in 1207.
zh: 保加利亚沙皇博里尔的母亲，是1185年复兴保加利亚的阿森三兄弟彼得二世、伊凡·阿森一世与卡洛扬的姐妹，名字无载；博里尔正是凭借这一血统，在1207年卡洛扬死后争夺皇位。

en: Chaka (died 1300) was a Mongol prince, son of the Golden Horde strongman Nogai Khan. After 1285 he married Elena, daughter of Tsar George Terter I of Bulgaria. In the late 1290s he fought at his father's side against Khan Toqta, who defeated and killed Nogai in 1299. Chaka then led his followers into Bulgaria, drove out Ivan II's regency, and established himself at Tarnovo, reigning from 1299 to 1300. Toqta's army pursued him and besieged the capital; his brother-in-law Theodore Svetoslav plotted against him, had him strangled in prison, and sent his head to the khan.
zh: 恰卡（1300年卒）是蒙古宗王，金帐汗国权臣那海汗之子。1285年后，他娶保加利亚沙皇乔治·捷尔捷尔一世之女伊莲娜为妻。1290年代末，他随父亲与脱脱汗交战，那海于1299年兵败被杀。恰卡随即率部众进入保加利亚，驱逐伊凡二世的摄政势力，于1299—1300年统治特尔诺沃。脱脱的大军随后追至并围攻首都，他的妻舅托多·斯维托斯拉夫发动密谋，将他在狱中缢杀，首级被送往脱脱汗处。

en: Constantine Tih Asen was a wealthy Bulgarian boyar with estates around Skopje, kin to the Serbian Nemanjić dynasty. Elected tsar at Tarnovo in 1257 on the Asen dynasty's extinction, he married Irene Laskarina, daughter of Nicaean emperor Theodore II, and took the name Asen. He fought Hungary for Vidin and seized Philippopolis in Thrace in 1262, only to lose it to Michael VIII Palaiologos. Paralyzed in a riding accident, he left the government to his wife Maria Palaiologina while Nogai's Tatars ravaged the country. In 1277 the swineherd Ivaylo rebelled; Constantine marched against him and was killed in his chariot.
zh: 君士坦丁·提赫·阿森是斯科普里一带有封地的富有保加利亚贵族，与塞尔维亚尼曼雅王朝有亲缘。1257年阿森王朝男系绝嗣，他在特尔诺沃被推举为沙皇，娶尼西亚皇帝塞奥多尔二世之女伊琳娜·拉斯卡里娜，并改用阿森之名。他为维丁与匈牙利交战，1262年夺取色雷斯的菲利波波利，不久又被米哈伊尔八世·巴列奥略夺回。他因坠马事故瘫痪，将朝政交给妻子玛丽亚·巴列奥略吉娜，听任那海的鞑靼人蹂躏国土。1277年牧猪人伊瓦伊洛起义，君士坦丁率军征讨，最终在自己的战车中被杀。

en: Elena was a Bulgarian princess, daughter of Tsar George Terter I and his wife Maria. Sent to the Golden Horde after 1285, she married Chaka, son of Nogai Khan, and followed him to Tarnovo when he seized power in 1299.
zh: 海伦是保加利亚公主，沙皇乔治·捷尔捷尔一世与妻子玛丽亚之女。1285年后她被送往金帐汗国，嫁给那海汗之子恰卡，并于1299年随他前往特尔诺沃夺权。

en: George Terter I (died 1308 or 1309), a Bulgarian boyar of Cuman descent, was tsar from 1280 to 1292. Ivan Asen III made him despot during Ivaylo's revolt; he divorced his wife to marry the emperor's sister Kira Maria. His first wife and their son Theodore Svetoslav were sent as hostages to Byzantium. When Ivan Asen fled in 1280, George seized the throne, but Mongol raids under Nogai Khan and his failed anti-Byzantine coalition weakened his rule. Around 1292, after Nogai attacked Bulgaria, George was deposed and went into exile in Byzantium, where he lived for years in want. In 1301 his son Theodore Svetoslav, now tsar, ransomed him for thirteen captured Byzantine officers; George ended his days in Bulgaria.
zh: 乔治·捷尔捷尔一世（1308或1309年卒）是库曼裔保加利亚贵族，1280—1292年任沙皇。伊瓦伊洛起义期间，伊凡·阿森三世封他为专制公，他休弃原配，娶皇帝的姐妹基拉·玛丽亚为妻。原配和他们的儿子狄奥多尔·斯维托斯拉夫被送往拜占庭做人质。1280年伊凡·阿森出逃，乔治夺取皇位，但那海汗麾下蒙古人的袭掠和反拜占庭同盟的失败削弱了他的统治。约1292年，那海进攻保加利亚后，乔治被废，随后流亡拜占庭，长年困顿潦倒。1301年，已身为沙皇的儿子狄奥多尔·斯维托斯拉夫用十三名被俘的拜占庭军官将他赎回，乔治最终在保加利亚终老。

en: George Terter II was the son of Tsar Theodore Svetoslav and Euphrosyne, named for his grandfather George Terter I, and reigned as tsar of Bulgaria from 1322 to 1323. Succeeding his father in 1322, he exploited the Byzantine civil war between Andronikos II and Andronikos III to invade Thrace, capturing Philippopolis and installing a garrison under Ivan the Russian. Later that year he reduced several fortresses around Adrianople, but Andronikos III rallied and drove the Bulgarians back. As the Byzantines prepared a counter-invasion, George died young, apparently of natural causes, leaving no known heir; Michael Shishman succeeded him.
zh: 乔治·捷尔捷尔二世是沙皇托多·斯维托斯拉夫与叶芙弗罗西娜之子，名字袭自祖父乔治·捷尔捷尔一世，1322—1323年任保加利亚沙皇。1322年父亲去世后，他利用安德洛尼卡二世与安德洛尼卡三世之间的拜占庭内战入侵色雷斯，攻占菲利波波利，并由俄罗斯人伊凡率军驻守。同年晚些时候，他又降服阿德里安堡附近多处要塞，但安德洛尼卡三世重整旗鼓，将保加利亚军击退。正当拜占庭准备反攻时，年轻的乔治猝然去世，似为自然死亡，没有留下已知继嗣，由米哈伊尔·希什曼继位。

en: Irene Palaiologina was the eldest daughter of Emperor Michael VIII Palaiologos and Empress Theodora. In 1277 or 1278 her father married her to the Bulgarian exile Ivan Asen III, whom he titled despot, and sent armies to place him on the throne at Tarnovo during Ivaylo's revolt. Irene was crowned Bulgarian empress in 1279, but in 1280 the couple fled Tarnovo with palace treasure and returned to Constantinople. In 1305 she plotted a mutiny against her brother Andronikos II to avenge her son-in-law Roger de Flor; the plot failed and she was placed under house arrest.
zh: 伊琳娜·巴列奥略吉娜是皇帝米海尔八世与皇后狄奥多拉的长女。1277或1278年，父亲将她嫁给流亡在拜占庭的保加利亚贵族伊凡·阿森三世，封他为专制公，并乘伊瓦伊洛起义之机出兵，要把他扶上特尔诺沃的王位。1279年伊琳娜成为保加利亚皇后，但1280年夫妇二人便携宫中财宝逃出特尔诺沃，返回君士坦丁堡。1305年，她为给女婿罗杰·德·弗洛尔报仇，密谋发动兵变推翻其兄安德洛尼卡二世；事败后被软禁。

en: Irene Palaiologina (1327 – c. 1377), also called Maria, was a Byzantine princess, daughter of Emperor Andronikos III Palaiologos and Anna of Savoy, and a younger sister of Emperor John V. Betrothed at the age of five, she married Tsar Michael Asen IV of Bulgaria in 1336. In 1355 Michael was killed fighting the Ottoman Turks near Sofia, and by 1356 she had married the Genoese Francesco I Gattilusio, to whom she bore three sons. She died around 1377 and was buried at Mesembria on the Black Sea coast.
zh: 伊琳娜·巴列奥略（1327—约1377），又称玛丽亚，是拜占庭公主，皇帝安德洛尼卡三世·巴列奥略与萨伏依的安娜之女、皇帝约翰五世的妹妹。她五岁时与保加利亚沙皇米哈伊尔·阿森四世订婚，1336年成婚。1355年米哈伊尔在索非亚附近与奥斯曼土耳其人作战时阵亡，1356年前她改嫁热那亚人弗朗切斯科一世·加蒂卢西奥，为他生下三个儿子。她约于1377年去世，葬于黑海沿岸的梅塞姆布里亚。

en: Ivan Alexander (died 17 February 1371), nephew of Michael Shishman, was tsar of Bulgaria from 1331 to 1371. As despot of Lovech he fought at Velbazhd in 1330, where Serbia crushed Bulgaria; the defeat and a Byzantine invasion set off a crisis at court, and a coup in 1331 ousted Ivan Stefan and put him on the throne. He retook northeastern Thrace and secured the Serbian border by marrying his sister Helena to Stefan Dušan at Easter 1332. That summer he caught Andronikos III at Rusokastro and, reinforced by Mongol cavalry, overwhelmed the smaller Byzantine army. Around 1332 he crowned his eldest son Michael Asen IV co-emperor. His long reign brought economic recovery and a cultural and religious revival, but Ottoman raids, Hungarian attacks and the Black Death wore Bulgaria down. He divided the realm among his sons, leaving it split when the Ottomans advanced.
zh: 伊凡·亚历山大（1371年2月17日卒）是米哈伊尔·希什曼的外甥，1331—1371年任保加利亚沙皇。他原是洛维奇的专制公，参加了1330年塞尔维亚大败保加利亚的维尔巴日德战役；战败加上拜占庭入侵引发宫廷危机，1331年的政变驱逐了伊凡·斯特凡，把他推上皇位。他收复色雷斯东北部，1332年复活节把妹妹海伦娜嫁给斯特凡·杜尚，稳住了与塞尔维亚的边界。同年夏天，他在鲁索卡斯特罗追上安德洛尼卡三世，借助蒙古骑兵的增援，击溃了人数较少的拜占庭军队。约1332年，他为长子米哈伊尔·阿森四世加冕为共治皇帝。漫长的统治带来了经济复苏与文化、宗教复兴，但奥斯曼人袭扰、匈牙利入侵和黑死病拖垮了保加利亚。他把国土分封给诸子，致使国家在奥斯曼人推进时已陷于分裂。

en: Ivan Asen IV (c. 1326 – 1349) was a Bulgarian prince, the third son of Tsar Ivan Alexander and Theodora of Wallachia. In 1349 he led Bulgarian forces against an Ottoman army of some twenty thousand men under Süleyman, elder brother of the future Sultan Murad I, in a fierce battle near Sofia. Both sides suffered heavy losses and Ivan Asen was killed in the fighting; the Bulgarians appear to have beaten off the raid, as the next recorded Ottoman incursion came in 1355, after his death. He had married a Wallachian princess of the Basarab dynasty and left two daughters.
zh: 伊凡·阿森四世（约1326—1349）是保加利亚王子，沙皇伊凡·亚历山大与瓦拉几亚的狄奥多拉的第三子。1349年，他率军在索非亚附近迎战奥斯曼军队；这支约两万人的大军由后来的苏丹穆拉德一世的长兄苏莱曼率领。战斗惨烈，双方伤亡惨重，伊凡·阿森战死；保加利亚人似乎击退了这次入侵，因为下一次有记载的奥斯曼进犯发生在他死后的1355年。他娶了巴萨拉布王朝的一位瓦拉几亚公主，留下两个女儿。

en: Ivan Asen I (died 1196), a founder of the Second Bulgarian Empire, ruled as tsar from 1187 or 1188, at first with his elder brother Peter II. In 1185, after the Byzantine emperor Isaac II Angelos refused and humiliated the brothers' demand for lands in the Balkan Mountains, Asen and Peter roused the Bulgarians and Vlachs to revolt. Peter was crowned before the end of that year. Defeated in 1186, they fled across the Danube and returned with Cuman allies, capturing Paristrion and raiding nearby Byzantine lands. Asen received Tarnovo when the realm was divided around 1192 and extended Bulgarian rule to the Struma valley. The boyar Ivanko stabbed him to death in 1196.
zh: 伊凡·阿森一世（1196年卒）是保加利亚第二帝国的缔造者之一，1187或1188年起称沙皇，最初与兄长彼得二世共治。1185年，兄弟二人向拜占庭皇帝伊萨克二世·安格洛斯请求巴尔干山区的封地，遭拒并受辱，遂号召保加利亚人与瓦拉几亚人起兵，彼得于当年年底前加冕。1186年兵败后他们渡过多瑙河，引库曼援军重返，夺取帕里斯特里翁并袭击附近的拜占庭领土。约1192年二人分国，阿森领有特尔诺沃，并把统治扩展到斯特鲁马河谷。1196年，贵族伊凡科将他刺死。

en: Ivan Asen II (1190s–1241), son of Ivan Asen I, was tsar of Bulgaria from 1218 to 1241. He fled to the Rus' principalities after Boril usurped the throne in 1207, but returned in 1218, took Tarnovo and blinded Boril. At Klokotnitsa in 1230 he crushed Theodore Komnenos Doukas of Thessalonica and took Macedonia, Thessaly and much of Thrace. He controlled the Via Egnatia, built in Tarnovo and minted gold at Ohrid. In 1235 his alliance with the Nicaean emperor John III Vatatzes restored the Bulgarian patriarchate. They attacked Constantinople together, but Ivan Asen broke with Nicaea in 1237. He died in 1241, leaving the throne to his young son Kaliman.
zh: 伊凡·阿森二世（1190年代—1241）是伊凡·阿森一世之子，1218—1241年任保加利亚沙皇。1207年博里尔篡位后，他逃往罗斯诸公国，1218年回国攻克特尔诺沃，弄瞎博里尔。1230年，他在克洛科特尼察战役中击溃塞萨洛尼基的狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯，夺取马其顿、色萨利和色雷斯大部。他控制厄纳齐雅大道，在特尔诺沃大兴土木，并在奥赫里德铸造金币。1235年，他与尼西亚皇帝约翰三世·瓦塔泽斯结盟，保加利亚牧首区得以恢复。两人联军进攻君士坦丁堡，但伊凡·阿森于1237年与尼西亚决裂。他于1241年去世，皇位传给年幼的儿子卡里曼。

en: Ivan Asen III (c. 1259–1303), son of Tsar Mitso Asen and a daughter of Ivan Asen II, claimed Bulgaria with Byzantine backing. In 1277 or 1278 Michael VIII Palaiologos made him despotēs and married him to his daughter Irene Palaiologina. While Ivaylo's rebels were blockaded at Silistra, a Byzantine army besieged Tarnovo; hearing a rumour of Ivaylo's death, the nobles surrendered and accepted Ivan Asen as emperor in 1279. He married his sister Maria to George Terter to strengthen his position. Ivaylo returned and routed two relief armies; in 1280 the tsar fled the capital with the palace treasure and sailed to Constantinople. He sought Nogai Khan's aid in vain and died on his Troad estates in 1303.
zh: 伊凡·阿森三世（约1259—1303）是沙皇米措·阿森之子，母亲为伊凡·阿森二世之女，在拜占庭支持下争夺保加利亚皇位。1277或1278年，米哈伊尔八世·巴列奥略封他为专制公，并把女儿伊琳妮·巴列奥略娜嫁给他。趁伊瓦伊洛的起义军被围困在锡利斯特拉之机，拜占庭军队围困特尔诺沃；城中贵族听闻伊瓦伊洛阵亡的谣言后投降，于1279年拥立伊凡·阿森为沙皇。他将妹妹玛丽亚嫁给乔治·特尔特，以巩固自己的地位。伊瓦伊洛返回后击溃两支援军；1280年，他携宫中珍宝逃出首都，渡海前往君士坦丁堡。他向那海汗求援未果，1303年死于特洛阿德的封地。

en: Ivan II Smilets (born c. 1290, died before 1330) reigned as tsar of Bulgaria from 1298 to 1299. A child when he succeeded his father Smilets at Tarnovo, he ruled under the regency of his mother Smiltsena, a niece of Michael VIII Palaiologos, who defeated the claims of Smilets' brothers and tried to ally with Stefan Milutin of Serbia.
