In 1299 the Mongol prince Chaka seized Tarnovo, and Ivan fled into exile, eventually settling in Byzantium, where he lived under the surname Komnenos Doukas Angelos Branas Palaiologos. He became a monk as Joasaph and died in exile before 1330.
zh: 伊凡二世·斯米列茨（约1290年生，1330年前卒）于1298至1299年任保加利亚沙皇。他在特尔诺沃继父斯米列茨之位时年幼，由母亲斯米尔察娜摄政：她是米海尔八世·巴列奥略的外甥女，曾挫败斯米列茨诸兄弟的夺位企图，并试图与塞尔维亚的斯特凡·米卢廷结盟。1299年蒙古宗王恰卡攻占特尔诺沃，伊凡流亡国外，最终定居拜占庭，以科穆宁·杜卡斯·安格洛斯·布拉纳斯·巴列奥略的长姓生活。他后来出家，教名约阿萨夫，1330年以前在流亡中去世。

en: Ivan Asen III (c. 1259–1303), son of Tsar Mitso Asen and a daughter of Ivan Asen II, claimed Bulgaria with Byzantine backing. In 1277 or 1278 Michael VIII Palaiologos made him despotēs and married him to his daughter Irene Palaiologina. While Ivaylo was blockaded at Silistra, a Byzantine army took Tarnovo and enthroned him in 1279. He wed his sister to George Terter, but Ivaylo returned and routed two relief armies; in 1280 he fled with the palace treasure, sailing from Mesembria to Constantinople. He sought Nogai Khan's aid in vain and died on his Troad estates in 1303.
zh: 伊凡·阿森三世（约1259—1303）是沙皇米措·阿森与伊凡·阿森二世之女的儿子，在拜占庭支持下争夺保加利亚皇位。1277或1278年，米哈伊尔八世·巴列奥略封他为专制公，将女儿伊琳妮·巴列奥略娜嫁给他。趁伊瓦伊洛被围困在锡利斯特拉之机，拜占庭军队攻克特尔诺沃，于1279年拥立他为沙皇；他把姐妹嫁给格奥尔基·捷尔捷尔以巩固地位。伊瓦伊洛返回后击溃两支援军，1280年他携宫中珍宝逃出首都，从内塞伯尔渡海前往君士坦丁堡。他向那海汗求援未果，1303年死于特洛阿德的封地。

en: Ivan Sratsimir (1324 or 1325 – c. 1397), born in Lovech, was a son of Tsar Ivan Alexander of Bulgaria and Theodora of Wallachia. Proclaimed co-emperor in 1337 with Vidin as his appanage, he was disinherited in favour of his half-brother Ivan Shishman and in 1356 declared himself emperor at Vidin. After his father's death in 1371 he broke with Tarnovo and placed his archbishop under Constantinople. He joined King Sigismund's crusade against the Ottomans, but after their victory at Nicopolis in 1396 they seized Vidin and took him to Bursa, where he was probably strangled, last ruler of medieval Bulgaria.
zh: 伊凡·斯拉齐米尔（1324或1325—约1397），生于洛维奇，是保加利亚沙皇伊凡·亚历山大与瓦拉几亚的狄奥多拉之子。1337年他被宣布为共治皇帝，领有维丁作为封地；后来被剥夺继承权，其父改立同父异母弟伊凡·希什曼为储君，他遂于1356年在维丁自立为帝。1371年父亲死后，他与特尔诺沃决裂，将维丁大主教改隶君士坦丁堡牧首。他参加了匈牙利国王西吉斯蒙德讨伐奥斯曼人的十字军，但1396年尼科波利斯战败后，奥斯曼人攻占维丁，把他押往布尔萨，可能遭绞杀，是中世纪保加利亚最后的统治者。

en: Ivan Stefan was the eldest surviving son of Tsar Michael Asen III Shishman of Bulgaria and Ana-Neda, daughter of King Stefan Uroš II Milutin of Serbia. After his father died of wounds fighting the Serbs at Velbazhd in 1330, he was placed on the throne at Tarnovo with his uncle Belaur's backing, ruling only eight months while his mother governed in his name. In March 1331 a palace coup overthrew them and raised his cousin Ivan Alexander to power. Ivan Stefan fled through Serbia into exile at Dubrovnik, where he was recorded with his mother as early as 1332; he was dead by 1357.
zh: 伊凡·斯蒂芬是保加利亚沙皇米哈伊尔·阿森三世·希什曼与塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·乌罗什二世·米卢廷之女安娜-内达幸存的长子。1330年父亲在维尔巴日德战役中受塞尔维亚人之伤而死后，他在叔父贝劳尔支持下即位于特尔诺沃，仅在位八个月，由母亲以他的名义执政。1331年3月，一场宫廷政变将母子废黜，表亲伊凡·亚历山大登位。伊凡·斯蒂芬经塞尔维亚流亡杜布罗夫尼克，早在1332年便与母亲一同见于当地记载，1357年之前去世。

en: Ivaylo (died 1281), nicknamed Lakhanas or ‘the Cabbage’, was a rebel who ruled Bulgaria as tsar in 1278–1279. In 1277 he led a peasant uprising and forced the nobility to accept him. He married the widowed empress Maria Kantakouzena and was recognized as emperor in 1278, defending the Balkan passes against Byzantine armies and winning the Battle of Devina. In 1279 Mongol forces blockaded him at Silistra for three months and Tarnovo accepted the Byzantine-backed Ivan Asen III. After George Terter I seized the throne in 1280, Ivaylo sought Nogai Khan's aid, but Nogai had him killed in 1281.
zh: 伊瓦伊洛（1281年卒），绰号拉哈纳斯（意为“卷心菜”），本为起义军首领，1278—1279年称保加利亚沙皇。1277年，他发动农民起义，迫使贵族承认其地位。他娶守寡的皇后玛丽亚·坎塔库泽娜为妻，1278年被承认为皇帝，随后据守巴尔干山口，抗击拜占庭派来的军队，并在代维纳战役中取胜。1279年，蒙古军队将他围困在锡利斯特拉达三个月，特尔诺沃转而接受拜占庭支持的伊凡·阿森三世。1280年格奥尔基·捷尔捷尔一世夺取皇位后，伊瓦伊洛向那海汗求援，那海却于1281年将他杀死。

en: Kaliman Asen I (1234–1246) was tsar of Bulgaria from 1241, succeeding his father Ivan Asen II at seven; his mother was Anna Maria of Hungary. One or more regents ruled during his minority, and early in his reign Bulgaria, the Latin Empire and Nicaea made a two-year truce. In March 1242 the Mongol prince Kadan invaded Bulgaria; during the invasion, Tarnovo and other fortresses were destroyed, and Bulgaria later paid an annual tribute. In 1245 Pope Innocent IV wrote urging him to unite the Bulgarian Church with Rome. He died at twelve in August or September 1246, amid rumors of poisoning, and Patriarch Vissarion died the same month.
zh: 卡里曼·阿森一世（1234—1246）是伊凡·阿森二世与匈牙利的安娜·玛丽亚之子，1241年七岁时继承父位为保加利亚沙皇，年幼时由一名或多名摄政者主政。他在位初年，保加利亚与拉丁帝国、尼西亚订立了为期两年的停战协定。1242年3月，蒙古宗王卡丹率军入侵保加利亚；入侵期间，特尔诺沃等要塞遭毁，保加利亚此后年年纳贡。1245年，教皇英诺森四世致书，劝他让保加利亚教会与罗马合一。1246年8月或9月，年仅十二岁的卡里曼死去，坊间传说是被毒杀；牧首维萨里翁也于同月去世。

en: Kaliman Asen II ruled as tsar of Bulgaria for a few months in 1256. He was the son of sebastokrator Alexander, younger brother of Ivan Asen II. That year he murdered his cousin Tsar Michael II Asen at a hunting party near Tarnovo, seized the throne and married the dead tsar's widow, a daughter of Rostislav Mihailovich. Her father then marched on Tarnovo from Belgrade, forcing Kaliman to flee; Mitso Asen took the throne, and Kaliman was murdered after his supporters deserted him.
zh: 卡里曼·阿森二世于1256年短暂称保加利亚沙皇。他是伊凡·阿森二世之弟、至尊者亚历山大之子。同年，他在特尔诺沃附近的一次狩猎中杀死堂兄沙皇米哈伊尔二世·阿森，篡夺皇位，并娶寡后——罗斯季斯拉夫·米哈伊洛维奇之女为妻。她的父亲随即从贝尔格莱德进军特尔诺沃，卡里曼弃城出逃；米措·阿森登上皇位，众叛亲离的卡里曼随后被杀。

en: Kaloyan the Roman-Slayer (c. 1170–October 1207), youngest of the Asen brothers, was tsar of restored Bulgaria from 1197. Once a hostage in Constantinople, he seized sole power when Asen and Peter were murdered in 1196–1197. After capturing Varna in 1201 he styled himself the Roman-Slayer, in imitation of Basil II the Bulgar-Slayer. Seeking an imperial title, he corresponded with Pope Innocent III and offered to acknowledge papal primacy. A papal legate crowned him king at Tarnovo in 1204, though he still called himself tsar. On 14 April 1205 he captured the Latin Emperor Baldwin I at Adrianople. He died in uncertain circumstances in October 1207 while besieging Thessalonica.
zh: “罗马屠夫”卡洛扬（约1170—1207年10月）是阿森兄弟中最幼者，1197年起成为复兴保加利亚的沙皇。他曾在君士坦丁堡充当人质，1196—1197年阿森与彼得先后遇刺后独掌大权。1201年攻克瓦尔纳后，他效仿“保加尔屠夫”巴西尔二世，自称“罗马屠夫”。他为取得皇帝称号与教皇英诺森三世通信，提出承认教皇的首位权。1204年，教皇使节在特尔诺沃为他加冕称王，但他仍以沙皇自称。1205年4月14日，他在阿德里安堡生擒拉丁皇帝鲍德温一世。1207年10月，他在围攻塞萨洛尼基期间去世，死因不明。

en: Keratsa Petritsa (born c. 1280) was a Bulgarian noblewoman, a daughter of Despot Shishman of Vidin and sister of Tsar Michael Shishman. Around 1300 she married the sebastokrator Sratsimir, lord of Kran or Karvuna, and through her mother she traced descent from Tsar Ivan Asen II. Her children included Ivan Alexander, who seized the Bulgarian throne in 1331, Helena, who married the Serbian king Stefan Dušan in 1332, and the despot John Komnenos Asen. In 1337 Pope Benedict XII wrote urging her to draw her son toward Catholicism. Late in life she returned to Orthodoxy and took the veil as Theophana.
zh: 凯拉察·彼得丽察（约1280年生）是保加利亚贵族女性，维丁专制公希什曼之女、沙皇米哈伊尔·希什曼的姐妹。约1300年，她嫁给克兰或卡尔武纳的领主、至尊者斯拉齐米尔，并通过母系承袭沙皇伊凡·阿森二世的血统。她的子女包括1331年夺取保加利亚皇位的伊凡·亚历山大、1332年嫁给塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·杜尚的海伦娜，以及专制公约翰·科穆宁·阿森。1337年，教宗本笃十二世曾致信，劝她引导儿子皈依天主教。晚年她重归东正教，出家为修女，取教名狄奥法娜。

en: Maria Asenina (born between 1238 and 1241) was a Bulgarian princess, daughter of Emperor Ivan Asen II and his third wife Irene Komnene Doukaina, and a granddaughter of Theodore Komnenos Doukas of Thessalonica. She was the full sister of Emperor Michael Asen. Bulgarian historiography traditionally identifies her as the wife of Emperor Mitso Asen, who ruled in 1256–1257, making her briefly empress consort. On that view she was the mother of Emperor Ivan Asen III (r. 1279–1280) and ancestress of the Byzantine branch of the Asen dynasty.
zh: 玛丽亚·阿森尼娜（1238—1241年间出生）是保加利亚公主，为沙皇伊凡·阿森二世与第三任妻子伊琳娜·科穆宁·杜卡伊娜之女，也是萨洛尼卡皇帝狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯的外孙女，与沙皇米哈伊尔·阿森为亲兄妹。保加利亚史学界传统上认为她嫁给了1256—1257年在位的沙皇米措·阿森，曾短时间身为皇后；据此说，她是沙皇伊凡·阿森三世（1279—1280年在位）之母，也是阿森王朝拜占庭支系的先妣。

en: Michael II Asen (c. 1239–1256/1257), son of Ivan Asen II, was tsar of Bulgaria from 1246, when he succeeded his half-brother Kaliman I as a child of seven. Early in his minority Nicaea and Epirus overran the Vardar valley and western Macedonia. In 1254 he allied with Ragusa against Serbia and marched as far as Bijelo Polje without taking Serbian territory. After the Nicaean emperor John III Vatatzes died, Michael retook most of the lost Macedonian lands with local support. Vatatzes' son Theodore II Laskaris counter-attacked in 1255 and forced Michael to make peace. Shortly afterward discontented boyars murdered him, and his cousin Kaliman II seized the throne.
zh: 米哈伊尔二世·阿森（约1239—1256/1257）是伊凡·阿森二世之子，1246年继位为保加利亚沙皇，接替异母兄卡里曼一世，年仅七岁。他年幼在位初期，尼西亚与伊庇鲁斯攻占了瓦尔达尔河谷和西马其顿。1254年，他与拉古萨结盟对抗塞尔维亚，进军至比耶洛波列，却未能占领塞尔维亚领土。尼西亚皇帝约翰三世·瓦塔泽斯去世后，他在当地人支持下收复马其顿大部分失地。瓦塔泽斯之子狄奥多尔二世·拉斯卡里斯于1255年反攻，迫使他议和。不久，心怀不满的贵族将他杀害，其亲族卡里曼二世夺取皇位。

en: Michael Tih, also called Michael Asen II, was the son of Tsar Constantine Tih and Maria Palaiologina Kantakouzene, born around 1270. Crowned co-emperor before 1273, he became legitimate emperor when his father fell fighting Ivaylo's rebels in 1277, ruling under his mother's regency at Tarnovo. In spring 1278 Maria married Ivaylo, who reigned as Michael's co-emperor. When the city nobles admitted the Byzantines in February 1279, Michael was dethroned and carried captive to Byzantium. Around 1302 or 1303 a boyar faction backed his return against Theodore Svetoslav, but he could not establish himself and vanishes from the sources.
zh: 米哈伊尔·提赫（又称米哈伊尔·阿森二世）是沙皇君士坦丁·提赫与玛丽亚·巴列奥略·坎塔库泽娜之子，约1270年出生。他在1273年前加冕为共治皇帝，1277年父亲在与伊瓦伊洛起义军作战时阵亡后，成为合法皇帝，由母亲在特尔诺沃摄政。1278年春，玛丽亚改嫁伊瓦伊洛，后者以米哈伊尔共治皇帝的身份执政。1279年2月特尔诺沃贵族放拜占庭军入城，米哈伊尔被废，押往拜占庭囚禁。约1302或1303年，一派贵族支持他回国对抗托多·斯维托斯拉夫，但他未能立足，此后便从史料中消失。

en: Michael Shishman (c. 1286–1330), son of the Vidin despot Shishman, ruled Bulgaria as tsar from 1323 and founded the Shishman dynasty, last dynasty of the Second Bulgarian Empire. On his accession he took the name Asen to link himself to the earlier Asenids. He married first Ana of Serbia and then the Byzantine princess Theodora Palaiologina. He pursued an aggressive, shifting diplomacy against Byzantium and Serbia and was the last medieval Bulgarian ruler to attempt the capture of Constantinople. On 28 July 1330 King Stefan Dečanski of Serbia defeated him at Velbazhd; Michael died shortly afterward. His son Ivan Stephen and later his nephew Ivan Alexander succeeded him.
zh: 米哈伊尔·希什曼（约1286—1330）是维丁专制公希什曼之子，1323年起任保加利亚沙皇，建立了第二帝国最后一个王朝——希什曼王朝。即位后他改用“阿森”之名，以标榜自己与阿森王朝的联系。他先后娶塞尔维亚的安娜和拜占庭公主狄奥多拉·巴列奥略为妻。他对拜占庭和塞尔维亚奉行强硬而多变的外交，是中世纪最后一位试图攻取君士坦丁堡的保加利亚君主。1330年7月28日，塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·德钱斯基在维尔巴日德将他击败，米哈伊尔不久后去世。皇位先后由其子伊凡·斯特凡和外甥伊凡·亚历山大继承。

en: Michael Asen IV (c. 1322–1355) was the eldest son of Tsar Ivan Alexander of Bulgaria and Theodora of Wallachia, and the pride of the royal family. Soon after his father took the throne in 1331, the boy was crowned co-emperor and designated heir, said to possess every virtue. In 1339 he married Maria, renamed Irene, daughter of the Byzantine emperor Andronikos III Palaiologos. When the Ottomans invaded Bulgaria in 1354–1355, heading for Plovdiv and Sofia, Michael gathered the Bulgarians and met the Turks near Sofia. An anonymous Bulgarian chronicle records heavy Bulgarian losses, Michael among the dead. The Ottomans took neither city and left Bulgaria alone until 1370, and folklore remembers the emperor's son as one of the brave who fell.
zh: 米哈伊尔·阿森四世（约1322—1355）是保加利亚沙皇伊凡·亚历山大与瓦拉几亚的狄奥多拉的长子，是王室的骄傲。父亲1331年即位后不久，他便被加冕为共治皇帝、立为储君，时人称他具备一切美德。1339年，他娶拜占庭皇帝安德罗尼卡三世·巴列奥略之女玛丽亚（婚后改名伊琳娜）为妻。1354—1355年，奥斯曼人入侵保加利亚，直取普罗夫迪夫和索非亚，米哈伊尔集结保加利亚人，在索非亚附近迎战土耳其人。一部佚名的保加利亚编年史记载，保加利亚军伤亡惨重，米哈伊尔本人也在阵亡者之中。奥斯曼人没有攻下两城，直到1370年都未再进犯保加利亚，民间传说也把这位皇帝之子记作阵亡勇士中的一员。

en: Michael was a Bulgarian nobleman, a son of the Despot Sratsimir of Kran and Keratsa Petritsa, and a brother of Tsar Ivan Alexander of Bulgaria. He is recorded with the title of Despot of Vidin.
zh: 米哈伊尔是保加利亚贵族，克兰专制公斯拉齐米尔与克拉察·佩特里察之子，保加利亚沙皇伊凡·亚历山大的兄弟，史载拥有维丁专制公的头衔。

en: Mitso Asen was tsar of Bulgaria from 1256 to 1257, taking the throne through his marriage to a daughter of Tsar Ivan Asen II and Irene Komnene of Epirus. After Kaliman Asen II was murdered in 1256 he claimed the crown, but the nobility opposed him and a failed campaign against Theodore II Lascaris of Nicaea cost him his support. When Constantine Asen I was proclaimed in 1257, he fled the capital and attempted to resist first from Preslav and then Mesembria, which around 1263 he surrendered to Michael VIII Palaiologos for lands in the Troad. His son Ivan Asen III later claimed the Bulgarian throne.
zh: 米措·阿森于1256至1257年任保加利亚沙皇，他因娶沙皇伊凡·阿森二世与伊庇鲁斯的伊琳娜·科穆宁之女而登上王位。1256年卡里曼·阿森二世遇刺后，他宣称皇位，但贵族群起反对，对尼西亚的狄奥多尔二世·拉斯卡里斯用兵失利又使他失去支持。1257年康斯坦丁·阿森一世被拥立为沙皇后，他逃离首都，先后在普雷斯拉夫和梅塞姆布里亚试图抵抗，约1263年把后者交给米哈伊尔八世·帕里奥洛格斯，以换取特洛阿德的封地。他的儿子伊凡·阿森三世后来争夺保加利亚皇位。

en: Sarah-Theodora was the second wife of Tsar Ivan Alexander of Bulgaria, who ruled from 1331 to 1371. Said to come from a Jewish family of Tarnovo, she converted to Eastern Orthodoxy, took the name Theodora, and married the tsar in the late 1340s after he divorced Theodora of Wallachia. A fierce patron of her adopted faith, she instigated a church council against the Jews, restored churches and built monasteries. She pressed the claim of her purple-born son Ivan Shishman over the elder Ivan Sratsimir. Ivan Alexander crowned Shishman co-emperor and made Sratsimir despot of Vidin. After the tsar died in 1371, Shishman succeeded him at Tarnovo while Sratsimir declared Vidin a separate empire.
zh: 萨拉·狄奥多拉是保加利亚沙皇伊凡·亚历山大（1331—1371年在位）的第二任皇后。相传她出身特尔诺沃的犹太家庭，皈依东正教后改名狄奥多拉，在1340年代末沙皇与瓦拉几亚的狄奥多拉离婚后成为皇后。她热忱护持皈依的信仰，发起针对犹太人的宗教会议，又主持修复教堂、兴建修道院。她力主自己“紫衣所生”的儿子伊凡·希什曼优先于年长的伊凡·斯拉齐米尔继位。伊凡·亚历山大加冕希什曼为共治皇帝，封斯拉齐米尔为维丁专制公。1371年沙皇去世后，希什曼在特尔诺沃继位，斯拉齐米尔则宣布维丁为独立帝国。

en: Shishman (fl. from the 1270s, died before 1313) was a Cuman boyar in Bulgaria who ruled a semi-independent realm from the Danubian fortress of Vidin. He may have held Vidin as early as the 1270s and was made despot by Tsar George Terter I. In 1291 he accepted Golden Horde suzerainty, and in 1292 he led an unsuccessful invasion of Serbia; the Serbs retaliated by taking Vidin, but he was restored as a Serbian vassal, perhaps through Tatar influence. He kept his lands effectively independent until his death. Through his son Michael Shishman, who seized the Bulgarian throne in 1323, he was the progenitor of the Shishman dynasty.
zh: 希什曼（1270年代起在世，1313年前卒）是保加利亚的库曼裔贵族，以多瑙河畔的维丁要塞为中心，统治一个半独立政权。他可能早在1270年代已统治维丁，并获沙皇乔治·捷尔捷尔一世封为专制公。1291年他接受金帐汗国的宗主权；1292年率军入侵塞尔维亚失利，塞尔维亚人反攻夺取维丁，他后来复位成为塞尔维亚的附庸，可能受到鞑靼人的影响，却始终保持实际独立。其子米哈伊尔·希什曼于1323年登上保加利亚皇位，希什曼也因此成为希什曼王朝的始祖。

en: Smilets was tsar of Bulgaria from 1292 to 1298. His boyar clan held broad lands between the Balkan Mountains and Sredna Gora, and he replaced George Terter I with the backing of Nogai Khan, crowned by Patriarch Joachim III; his reign is seen as the height of Mongol overlordship over Bulgaria. Early on he fought an unsuccessful war against Byzantium, and around 1296 or 1297 he married his daughter Theodora to the future Serbian king Stefan Dečanski. In 1298, during Chaka's invasion, Smilets vanishes from the records, perhaps killed; his young son Ivan II briefly succeeded him.
zh: 斯米莱茨于1292—1298年任保加利亚沙皇。他的贵族家族在巴尔干山脉与斯雷德纳戈拉山之间拥有大片领地。他在那海汗的支持下取代乔治·捷尔捷尔一世，由牧首约阿基姆三世加冕；他的统治被视为蒙古宗主权在保加利亚的顶峰。即位之初他与拜占庭交战失利，约1296或1297年将女儿狄奥多拉嫁给后来的塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·德昌斯基。1298年恰卡入侵之际，斯米莱茨从史籍中消失，可能遇害，年幼的儿子伊凡二世短暂继位。

en: Sratsimir was a Bulgarian magnate who held the title of despot, ruling either Kran in the Balkan Mountains or the coastal region of Karvuna. Possibly of the Terter house, he was already in possession of his lands before his son Ivan Alexander seized the Bulgarian throne in 1331. He married Keratsa Petritsa, sister of Tsar Michael Shishman, and founded the Sratsimir dynasty. Their children included Ivan Alexander, Helena who married the Serbian king Stefan Dušan in 1332, John Komnenos Asen, despot of Valona, and Michael, later despot of Vidin. A papal letter of 1337 refers to his wife Keratsa.
zh: 斯拉齐米尔是保加利亚大贵族，拥有专制公头衔，其封地或为巴尔干山脉中的克兰，或为沿海的卡尔武纳地区。他可能出身捷尔捷尔家族，在儿子伊凡·亚历山大于1331年夺取保加利亚皇位之前已保有这些领地。他娶沙皇米哈伊尔·希什曼的姐妹凯拉察·彼得丽察为妻，开创了斯拉齐米尔王朝。子女包括伊凡·亚历山大、1332年嫁给塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·杜尚的海伦娜、发罗拉专制公约翰·科穆宁·阿森，以及后来的维丁专制公米哈伊尔。1337年的一封教宗书信提到了他的妻子凯拉察。

en: Theodora of Wallachia was a daughter of Basarab I, prince of Wallachia from 1310 to 1352, and his wife Margareta. Her father fought beside her husband Ivan Alexander at Velbazhd in 1330, the year before Ivan Alexander took the Bulgarian throne. As his first wife she bore him four children, Michael Asen, Ivan Sratsimir, Ivan Asen and Vasilisa. In 1345 Ivan Alexander divorced her and had her shut in a monastery, where she took the nun's name Teofana. She is counted the first nun known in Romanian history, and the Romanian Orthodox Church canonised her in 2022.
zh: 瓦拉几亚的狄奥多拉是瓦拉几亚王公巴萨拉布一世（1310—1352年在位）与妻子玛格丽塔之女。1330年，她的父亲在维尔巴日德与她的丈夫伊凡·亚历山大并肩作战，次年伊凡·亚历山大登上保加利亚皇位。作为他的第一任皇后，她生下米哈伊尔·阿森、伊凡·斯拉齐米尔、伊凡·阿森和瓦西丽莎四个子女。1345年，伊凡·亚历山大与她离婚，将她送入修道院，她取修女名狄奥法娜。她被视为罗马尼亚历史上第一位可考的修女，罗马尼亚正教会于2022年将她封圣。

en: Theodora was a Bulgarian princess, the youngest daughter of Despot Sratsimir of Kran and Keratsa Petritsa, and a sister of Tsar Ivan Alexander and of Helena, wife of the Serbian emperor Stefan Dušan. First recorded at the Serbian court in 1352, she was to marry Emperor John V Palaiologos under Dušan's plan to split him from John VI Kantakouzenos, but the scheme fell through. After Dušan's death the Epirote ruler Nikephoros II Orsini meant to put aside his wife and marry her, but abandoned the plan before being killed in battle in 1359, after which nothing more is recorded.
zh: 狄奥多拉是14世纪中期的保加利亚公主，克兰专制公斯拉齐米尔与克拉察·佩特里察最小的女儿，沙皇伊凡·亚历山大和塞尔维亚皇后叶连娜的妹妹。1352年她首次见于记载，时在塞尔维亚宫廷；按照斯特凡·杜尚的安排，她本应嫁给拜占庭皇帝约翰五世·巴列奥略，以离间他与约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯，但计划落空。杜尚死后，伊庇鲁斯统治者尼基弗鲁斯二世·奥尔西尼打算休妻再娶她，却在1359年战死前夕放弃了这桩婚事，此后她便不见于记载。

en: Theodor-Peter Asen, who ruled as Tsar Peter IV (died 1197), was the eldest of the Asen brothers who restored Bulgaria. In 1185 the Byzantine emperor Isaac II Angelos refused his and Asen's request for land in the Balkan Mountains, and the emperor's uncle John Doukas ordered Asen struck. The brothers exploited discontent over a new tax to rouse the Bulgarians and Vlachs to revolt, and Peter was crowned tsar before year's end. Defeated in 1186, he fled to the Cumans and returned with Cuman troops to secure the new state. He took Preslav in the brothers' partition around 1192; after Asen's murder in 1196 he made Kaloyan co-ruler, but was himself killed in 1197.
zh: 特奥多尔-彼得·阿森，加冕后称沙皇彼得四世（1197年卒），是复兴保加利亚的阿森三兄弟中的长兄。1185年，拜占庭皇帝伊萨克二世·安格洛斯拒绝了他与弟弟阿森在巴尔干山区索要一处庄园的请求，皇帝的叔父约翰·杜卡斯还下令掌掴阿森。兄弟二人利用民众对新税的不满，鼓动保加利亚人与瓦拉几亚人起义，彼得在当年年底前加冕为沙皇。1186年兵败后，他逃往库曼人处，随后率库曼军队卷土重来，巩固了新生的帝国。约1192年兄弟分国，他得到普雷斯拉夫；1196年阿森遇刺后，他立卡洛扬为共治君主，本人也于1197年被杀。

en: Theodora Palaiologina (fl. 1308–1330) was a Byzantine princess, daughter of Emperor Michael IX and Rita of Armenia and sister of Andronikos III. In spring 1308 she married Tsar Theodore Svetoslav of Bulgaria to seal the peace ending his war with Byzantium; Bulgaria retained the Black Sea ports of Messembria and Anchialus. Widowed in 1321, she stayed at Tarnovo and in 1324 married the new tsar Michael Shishman after he set aside his first wife. When Michael fell at Velbazhd in July 1330 and his ex-wife returned, Theodora left Bulgaria for Constantinople, where she became a nun named Theodosia.
zh: 狄奥多拉·巴列奥略娜（活跃于1308—1330年）是拜占庭公主，皇帝米海尔九世与亚美尼亚的丽塔之女、安德洛尼卡三世的姐妹。1308年春，她嫁给保加利亚沙皇托多·斯维托斯拉夫，为结束两国战争的和约背书，保加利亚由此保住黑海港口梅塞姆布里亚和安希亚洛斯。1321年守寡后她留居特尔诺沃，1324年新沙皇米哈伊尔·希什曼休弃原配后娶她为妻。1330年7月米哈伊尔战死维尔巴日德，其原配回国掌权，狄奥多拉被迫离开保加利亚前往君士坦丁堡，后出家为修女，取修道名狄奥多西娅。

en: Theodosius II was Patriarch of Bulgaria, with his see at Tarnovo, from 1348 to 1363, during the Second Bulgarian Empire. A monk of the Zografou Monastery on Mount Athos before his election, he led the Bulgarian Church under Tsar Ivan Alexander. He took part in two church councils convened at Tarnovo, in 1350 and in 1359–1360, which condemned the Messalian, Bogomil and Adamite heresies and moved against Judaizers. He died in 1363 and was succeeded by Joannicius II.
zh: 狄奥多西二世是第二保加利亚帝国时期的保加利亚牧首，1348至1363年间驻节特尔诺沃。当选牧首前，他是阿索斯山佐格拉夫修道院的修士，在沙皇伊凡·亚历山大治下主持保加利亚教会。他参加了分别于1350年和1359—1360年在特尔诺沃召开的两次宗教会议；会议谴责梅萨利安派、博格米尔派和亚当派异端，并打击犹太化者。他于1363年去世，约安尼基二世继任牧首。

en: Theodore Svetoslav, son of Tsar George Terter I, spent his youth as a hostage in Byzantium and the Golden Horde. After his father divorced his mother Maria, they were sent to Nicaea; Patriarch Joachim III arranged Theodore's release in 1285. In 1299 he backed the Mongol prince Chaka's seizure of Tarnovo, but in 1300 he strangled Chaka and seized the crown. As tsar he ended Mongol suzerainty, executed Patriarch Joachim III for treason, captured the Black Sea ports Mesembria and Anchialos in 1304, and routed Michael IX Palaiologos at the Skafida river. The peace of 1307 was sealed by his marriage to Theodora, Michael IX's daughter. He died in 1322, leaving the throne to George Terter II, his son by his first wife Euphrosyne.
zh: 托多·斯维托斯拉夫是沙皇格奥尔基·捷尔捷尔一世之子，早年曾在拜占庭和金帐汗国充当人质。父亲与母亲玛丽亚离异后，他和母亲被送往尼西亚；1285年，牧首约阿基姆三世促成他获释。1299年，他支持蒙古宗王恰卡攻占特尔诺沃，却于1300年废黜并缢杀恰卡，自立为保加利亚沙皇。在位期间，他摆脱了蒙古的宗主权，以叛国罪处死牧首约阿基姆三世，1304年夺取黑海港口梅塞姆布里亚和安希亚洛斯，并在斯卡菲达河击溃米哈伊尔九世·巴列奥略率领的拜占庭军。1307年双方议和，他迎娶米哈伊尔九世之女狄奥多拉以巩固和约。他于1322年去世，王位由他与第一任妻子欧芙洛绪涅所生的儿子格奥尔基·捷尔捷尔二世继承。

en: Agnes of Dampierre (1237–1288) was Lady of Bourbon in her own right, the younger daughter of Lord Archambaud IX of Bourbon and Yolande of Châtillon, heiress of the counties of Nevers, Auxerre and Tonnerre. In 1248 she married John of Burgundy, a younger son of Duke Hugh IV. When her elder sister Mahaut died in 1262, Agnes inherited the lordship of Bourbon. Her only child, Beatrice, married Robert, Count of Clermont, son of Louis IX, in 1272. After John's death she remarried in 1277, taking Robert II, Count of Artois, as her husband.
zh: 当皮埃尔的阿涅丝（1237—1288）是凭自身身份受封的波旁女爵，波旁领主阿尔尚博九世与讷韦尔、欧塞尔、托内尔女继承人沙蒂永的约朗德的次女。1248年她嫁给勃艮第公爵于格四世之子勃艮第的约翰。1262年姐姐玛奥去世，阿涅丝继承波旁领地。她的独女比阿特丽斯于1272年嫁给路易九世之子、克莱蒙伯爵罗贝尔。丈夫死后，她于1277年改嫁阿图瓦伯爵罗贝尔二世。

en: Agnes of France (1260 – 19 December 1325) was the youngest daughter of King Louis IX of France and Margaret of Provence. Betrothed by her brother Philip III to Duke Robert II of Burgundy, she married him in 1279 and became duchess. On Robert's death in 1306 she ruled Burgundy as regent for her under-age son Hugh V until 1311; on the king's orders she confiscated Jewish property during her regency. She arranged prestigious marriages for her children, among them Margaret, wife of Louis X, and Joan, wife of Philip VI. In 1316 she defended her granddaughter Joan's claim to the French throne. She made her will at Arcenant in 1323, died in 1325 and was buried at Cîteaux Abbey.
zh: 法兰西的艾格妮丝（1260年—1325年12月19日）是法王路易九世与普罗旺斯的玛格丽特最小的女儿。她由兄长腓力三世许配给勃艮第公爵罗贝尔二世，1279年成婚，成为公爵夫人。1306年罗贝尔去世后，她为年幼的儿子于格五世摄政勃艮第，直到1311年；摄政期间她奉国王之命没收犹太人的财产。她为子女安排显贵联姻，其中女儿玛格丽特嫁给路易十世，约娜嫁给后来的腓力六世。1316年，她维护外孙女让娜对法国王位的继承权。1323年她在阿尔瑟南立遗嘱，1325年去世，葬于西多修道院。

en: Blanche of Burgundy (1288 – July 1348), daughter of Duke Robert II of Burgundy and Agnes of France, was married in 1307 to Edward, heir to Savoy. The match was arranged by her mother and signed at the Paris court of her uncle the French king; the contract secured Edward's place in the succession, and the wedding followed at the Château de Montbard. After he became count in 1323, she commissioned the Hours of Savoy, a book of hours now kept at Yale. Edward died in 1329, and Blanche bargained with his brother and successor Aymon over her dower until 1330, when she received Bourg, Treffort and other lands in Bresse. In 1346–1347, with the Dauphiné about to be sold to France, she used her influence at the court of her nephew Amadeus VI to draw Savoy closer to Burgundy, which led to his brief engagement to Joan of Burgundy. She died in 1348, perhaps of the Black Death.
zh: 勃艮第的布朗什（1288年—1348年7月）是勃艮第公爵罗贝尔二世与法兰西的艾格妮丝之女，1307年嫁给萨伏依继承人爱德华。婚事由母亲一手安排，在她舅父法王的巴黎宫廷签约；婚约确认了爱德华的继承权，婚礼随后在蒙巴尔城堡举行。1323年爱德华继位为伯爵后，她订制了《萨伏依时祷书》，今藏耶鲁大学。1329年爱德华去世，布朗什与继位的小叔艾蒙谈判寡妇产，1330年获封布雷斯的布尔、特雷福等地。1346—1347年，多菲内眼看要售予法国，她利用自己在侄子阿梅代奥六世宫廷中的影响力，推动萨伏依向勃艮第靠拢，促成他与勃艮第的让娜短暂订婚。她于1348年去世，可能死于黑死病。

en: Odo of Burgundy (1230–1266), count of Nevers, Auxerre and Tonnerre, was the eldest son of Duke Hugh IV of Burgundy and Yolande of Dreux. In 1265 he was among the last European barons to lead a crusading force to the Holy Land. At Acre he helped defend the city when Sultan Baybars I harassed it in June 1266 before besieging Safad. He died at Acre that August, leaving his wealth to his followers and to hospitals; the Templar of Tyre called him a holy man, and the poet Rutebeuf mourned him in his Lament for Count Odo.
zh: 勃艮第的厄德（1230—1266）是讷韦尔、欧塞尔和托内尔伯爵，勃艮第公爵于格四世与约朗德·德·德勒的长子。1265年，他率军前往圣地，是最后一批率十字军东征的欧洲贵族之一。1266年6月，苏丹拜巴尔斯一世在围攻萨法德之前袭扰阿卡，厄德参与守城。同年8月他在阿卡去世，遗产留给随从并用于资助医院；提尔的圣殿骑士称他为圣人，诗人吕特伯夫也作《厄德伯爵哀歌》悼念他。

en: Henry I, called the Great or Odo-Henry (946 – 15 October 1002), was a younger son of Hugh the Great and Hedwig of Saxony and the younger brother of Hugh Capet. He entered the church young and was a cleric when, in 965, he was elected Duke of Burgundy after his brother Otto's death, taking the name Henry. His marriage in 972 to Gerberga, widow of Adalbert II of Italy, brought him Nevers and a stepson, Otto-William, whom he adopted. In 978 he joined the invasion of Lotharingia and the defence of Paris. He died in 1002 without a legitimate heir, sparking a succession war between Otto-William and his nephew King Robert II.
zh: 亨利一世，世称“伟大者”，又称厄德-亨利（946年—1002年10月15日），是伟大的于格与萨克森的哈德维希的儿子，也是于格·卡佩的弟弟。他年轻时进入教会；965年其兄奥东死后，身为教士的他被勃艮第伯爵们推举继任公爵，并改名亨利。972年，他娶意大利的阿达尔贝托二世的遗孀格贝尔加，由此得到讷韦尔伯国和继子奥特-威廉，后来收养了继子。978年，他参加入侵洛塔林吉亚和保卫巴黎的战事。1002年他去世，没有合法继承人，奥特-威廉与他的侄子法王罗贝尔二世之间随即爆发继承战争。

en: Odo I Borel, called the Red (c. 1058–1103), was the second son of Henry of Burgundy and became duke in 1079 when his elder brother Hugh I retired to Cluny. Chroniclers call him a violent brigand who ransomed travelers through his lands; he helped King Philip I against Hugh du Puiset in 1078 and campaigned against the Moors in Spain in 1087. In 1080 he married Sibylle of Burgundy. In 1098 he granted land for the founding of Cîteaux Abbey. He joined the Crusade of 1101 and died at Tarsus in Cilicia on 23 March 1103, leaving the duchy to his son Hugh II. His body was brought back to Cîteaux for burial, as he had requested before departing.
zh: 厄德一世·博雷尔，绰号“红发”（约1058—1103），是勃艮第的亨利次子，1079年兄长于格一世退隐克吕尼后接任公爵。编年史家称他凶暴如强盗，向取道自己领地的旅人勒索赎金；1078年他帮助法王腓力一世讨伐皮塞的于格，1087年又前往西班牙与摩尔人作战。1080年他娶勃艮第的西比拉为妻。1098年，他捐地兴建西多修道院。他参加1101年十字军，1103年3月23日死于奇里乞亚的塔尔苏斯，公爵之位传给儿子于格二世。按照他出发前的遗愿，遗体被运回西多修道院安葬。

en: Odo II (1118–27 June 1162), eldest son of Duke Hugh II the Pacific and Matilda of Mayenne, ruled Burgundy from 1143. He is said to have fought the Moors in Portugal, but earned a name as a plundering lord, and at the accession of Louis VII in 1137 he refused the king homage until a ruling of Pope Adrian IV compelled him. To atone for his violence he set out on pilgrimage to the Holy Land and died on the journey. In 1145 he had married Marie of Champagne, daughter of Count Theobald of Blois and Champagne and sister-in-law of Louis VII. Their son Hugh III succeeded him.
zh: 厄德二世（1118—1162年6月27日）是于格二世“和平者”与马耶讷的玛蒂尔德的长子，1143年起统治勃艮第。相传他曾在葡萄牙与摩尔人作战，却以劫掠成性闻名；1137年路易七世即位时他拒绝向国王行臣服礼，直到教皇阿德里安四世作出裁决才被迫从命。为赎自己的暴行，他启程前往圣地朝圣，最终死在途中。1145年他娶香槟的玛丽为妻；她是布卢瓦及香槟伯爵蒂博之女，也是路易七世的姻亲。两人的儿子于格三世后来继位。

en: Odo III (1166 – 6 July 1218) was Duke of Burgundy from 1192, succeeding his father Hugh III. Unlike his father he was a loyal ally of Philip II of France, fighting King John of England and Emperor Otto IV; at the Battle of Bouvines in 1214 chroniclers record two horses killed beneath him. He led the 1209 Albigensian campaign against the Cathar strongholds after Philip refused to join, supported by his bishops and vassals, and pledged a castle and village to the Templars. He married Theresa of Portugal in 1194 but repudiated her in 1195. In 1199 he married Alice of Vergy, who bore his heir Hugh IV in 1213. He died in 1218.
zh: 厄德三世（1166年—1218年7月6日）1192年继父于格三世成为勃艮第公爵。他一改父亲与法国为敌的做法，成为法王腓力二世的忠实盟友，与英王约翰和皇帝奥托四世作战；在1214年的布汶战役中，据编年史家记载他连折两匹坐骑。腓力二世拒绝出兵阿尔比十字军时，厄德于1209年在主教和封臣支持下组织了进攻卡特里派据点的远征，行前还将一座城堡和一个村庄抵押给圣殿骑士团。1194年他娶葡萄牙的特蕾莎，1195年休妻。1199年他娶维吉的艾丽斯，1213年得继承人于格四世，1218年去世。

en: Odo IV (1295 – 3 April 1349), second son of Robert II and Agnes of France, became Duke of Burgundy in 1315, succeeding his brother Hugh V. In 1316 he defended his niece Joan's rights against her uncle Philip the Tall, and in 1318 he married Philip's eldest daughter, Joan III, Countess of Burgundy. When she inherited Artois and the County of Burgundy in 1330, Robert of Artois, a friend of Philip VI, contested Artois until the documents behind his claim were found to be forged on his orders. Odo was one of Philip VI's trusted advisers: wounded at Cassel in 1328, he held Saint-Omer against Robert of Artois in July 1340, sallying out and barely regaining the walls before the Flemings broke. A patron of artists and the church, he died of plague in 1349; his son Philip had died in 1346, so a four-year-old grandson succeeded as Philip I.
zh: 厄德四世（1295年—1349年4月3日）是罗贝尔二世与法兰西的艾格妮丝的次子，1315年继兄于格五世成为勃艮第公爵。1316年，他维护外甥女让娜的继承权，对抗她的叔父高个子腓力；1318年，他娶腓力的长女、勃艮第女伯爵让娜三世。1330年让娜继承阿图瓦和勃艮第伯国，腓力六世的好友阿图瓦的罗贝尔对阿图瓦提出争夺，直到作为依据的文件被查出是奉他之命伪造的。厄德是腓力六世信任的谋臣：1328年他在卡塞尔负伤；1340年7月，他坚守圣奥梅尔，抵御阿图瓦的罗贝尔，曾冲出城外，险些没能退回城墙之内，随后佛兰德军溃逃。他赞助艺术家与教会，1349年死于瘟疫；儿子腓力已在1346年去世，年仅四岁的孙子继位为腓力一世。

en: Henry of Burgundy, called the Gallant (c. 1035–1070/1074), was the eldest surviving son of Duke Robert I the Old and Helie of Semur, and heir to the Duchy of Burgundy. He died before his father and never ruled as duke, so the duchy passed first to his son Hugh I and then to his second son Odo I. Another son, Henry, became count of Portugal in 1093 and fathered Afonso I, the first king of Portugal.
zh: 勃艮第的亨利，绰号“英勇者”（约1035—1070/1074），是勃艮第公爵罗贝尔一世“老者”与瑟米尔的埃莉在世诸子中最年长者，身兼公国继承人。他先于父亲去世，终生未即公爵位，公国先由他的儿子于格一世、再由次子厄德一世继承。他的另一个儿子亨利于1093年成为葡萄牙伯爵，是葡萄牙第一位国王阿方索一世的父亲。

en: Hugh of Vaucemain (died 1341) was a Burgundian Dominican elected Master General of the Order of Preachers in 1333. His tenure was marked by a quarrel with Pope Benedict XII, a Cistercian who set out to reform the religious orders. Hugh was not against reform itself, but he feared it would undermine the position of the mendicant orders, and he resisted. A census taken in 1337 put the Dominicans at roughly twelve thousand members, a decade before the Black Death caused a general fall in population. He remained Master General until his death in 1341.
zh: 于格·德·沃塞曼（？—1341年）是勃艮第出身的多明我会士，1333年当选传道兄弟会（多明我会）总会长。他任内与教皇本笃十二世发生冲突：这位教皇出身西多会，着手改革各修会。于格并非反对改革本身，却担心改革会动摇托钵修会的地位，因而加以抵制。1337年的一次普查显示，修会约有12000名会士，十年后黑死病才使人口普遍下降。他担任总会长直至1341年去世。

en: Hugh I (1057–1093) was duke of Burgundy from 1076 to 1079, the son of Henry of Burgundy and grandson of Duke Robert I, from whom he inherited after his father's early death. With Sancho I of Aragon he campaigned against the Moors in the Iberian Peninsula. Worn by wounds and illness, in 1079 he abdicated in favor of his brother Odo I and entered Cluny Abbey, a move Pope Gregory VII criticized for leaving the duchy unsettled. He later became prior of Cluny and died there on 29 August 1093.
zh: 于格一世（1057—1093）于1076—1079年任勃艮第公爵，是勃艮第的亨利之子、罗贝尔一世公爵之孙。因父亲早逝，他从祖父手中继承公爵之位。他曾随阿拉贡国王桑乔一世在伊比利亚半岛与摩尔人作战。1079年，因战伤与疾病缠身，他让位给弟弟厄德一世，进入克吕尼修道院为修士，教宗额我略七世批评他此举令公国陷入动荡。他后来担任克吕尼修道院副院长，于1093年8月29日在该院去世。

en: Hugh II, called the Pacific (c. 1085–1143), was the eldest son of Duke Odo I Borel and Sibylle of Burgundy. He was raised by Jarenton, who became abbot of Saint-Bénigne at Dijon. Regent when his father left on crusade in 1100, he inherited the duchy in March 1103. He fought for King Louis VI against Henry I of England in 1109 and commanded the vanguard in Champagne when Emperor Henry V invaded in 1124. His reign was otherwise largely peaceful, earning his nickname; he even pardoned a subject condemned for insulting him. Around 1116 he married Matilda of Mayenne, who bore his successor Odo II. He donated property to Cîteaux Abbey in 1119 and died in February 1143.
zh: 于格二世，绰号“和平者”（约1085—1143），是公爵厄德一世·博雷尔与勃艮第的西比拉的长子。他幼时由后来出任第戎圣贝尼涅修道院院长的雅朗通教养。1100年父亲东征前已任命他为摄政，1103年3月他正式继承公国。1109年他随法王路易六世与英王亨利一世作战，1124年德意志皇帝亨利五世入侵香槟时又指挥前锋。除此之外，他的统治大体安宁，“和平者”的绰号由此而来；他甚至赦免了一个因辱骂他而被判死罪的臣民。约1116年他娶马耶讷的玛蒂尔德，继承人厄德二世即其所出。1119年他向西多修道院捐赠财产，1143年2月去世。

en: Hugh III (c. 1142 – 25 August 1192) was Duke of Burgundy from 1162, succeeding his father Odo II with his mother Marie of Champagne as regent. In 1165 he married Alice of Lorraine, whom he repudiated in 1183 before marrying Beatrice of Albon. His reign ended a period of peace: he fought Louis VII and Philip II of France over border vassals, and in 1186 Philip captured Châtillon and his heir Odo, forcing him to ransom his son and abandon claims on French lands. In 1187 he moved the capital to Dijon and fostered trade. He joined the Third Crusade, led the French after Philip sailed home, fought at Arsuf, and died at Acre in 1192.
zh: 于格三世（约1142年—1192年8月25日）1162年继父厄德二世成为勃艮第公爵，由母亲香槟的玛丽摄政。1165年，他娶洛林的艾丽斯，1183年休妻后再娶阿尔邦的贝亚特丽丝。他的统治结束了公国的和平时期：为争夺边境封臣，他先后与法王路易七世和腓力二世交战；1186年腓力二世攻陷沙蒂永，连他的继承人厄德也一并俘虏，于格被迫重金赎回儿子，并放弃对法国领土的要求。1187年，他把首府迁至第戎并推动贸易。后来他参加第三次十字军东征，在腓力二世回国后统领法军，转战阿尔苏夫，于1192年在阿卡去世。

en: Hugh IV (9 March 1213 – 27 October 1272) was Duke of Burgundy from 1218, succeeding his father Odo III, and titular King of Thessalonica from 1266. In 1229 he attacked Theobald IV of Champagne, opposing Blanche of Castile's regency, but the regent countered him. In 1237 he acquired the counties of Chalon and Auxonne from John of Chalon, expanding the duchy along the wine trade. He crusaded in the Holy Land in 1238–1241, then joined Louis IX's Seventh Crusade, commanding a division at Mansurah in 1250 and sharing the king's captivity that year. Emperor Baldwin II granted him the Thessalonican claim in 1266. In 1269 he agreed to protect the future regent of the Dauphiné and her children.
zh: 于格四世（1213年3月9日—1272年10月27日）1218年继父厄德三世成为勃艮第公爵，1266年成为塞萨洛尼卡名义国王。1229年，他进攻香槟伯爵蒂博四世，反对卡斯蒂利亚的布朗什摄政，却遭到摄政者反击。1237年，他从沙隆的约翰手中取得沙隆和欧克索讷伯国，借葡萄酒贸易壮大公国。他1238年前往圣地参加十字军，1241年返回；后随路易九世参加第七次十字军东征，1250年在曼苏拉之战中指挥一个军团，同年与国王一同被俘。1266年，被废黜的君士坦丁堡皇帝鲍德温二世将塞萨洛尼卡王国的权利授予他。1269年，他同意保护未来的多菲内摄政及其子女。

en: Hugh V (1294–1315) was Duke of Burgundy and titular King of Thessalonica, the eldest surviving son of Duke Robert II and Agnes of France, a daughter of King Louis IX. He succeeded his father in 1306 while still a child and ruled under his mother's regency. Betrothed young to Catherine of Valois-Courtenay, heiress to the Latin Empire of Constantinople, he renounced the match in 1312, and in 1313 sold his Thessalonican claim to his brother Louis. Knighted by Philip IV in 1313, he died at Argilly in May 1315 and was succeeded by his brother Odo IV.
zh: 于格五世（1294—1315）是勃艮第公爵兼名义上的塞萨洛尼基国王，公爵罗贝尔二世与法兰西的阿涅丝在世子女中的长子，母亲为法王路易九世之女。1306年父亲去世时他尚年幼，由母亲摄政。他幼年与君士坦丁堡拉丁帝国女继承人瓦卢瓦-库特奈的卡特琳订婚，1312年放弃这门婚事，1313年把塞萨洛尼基的王位宣称卖给弟弟路易。1313年腓力四世册封他为骑士，他于1315年5月在阿尔日伊去世，弟弟厄德四世继位。

en: John of Burgundy (1231–1268) was Count of Charolais and a younger son of Duke Hugh IV of Burgundy and Yolande of Dreux. In February 1248 he married Agnes of Dampierre, daughter of Lord Archambaud IX of Bourbon. In 1262 Agnes inherited Bourbon after the death of her sister Mathilde. The couple had one daughter, Beatrice, who in 1272 married Robert, Count of Clermont, a son of King Louis IX; the Capetian House of Bourbon descends from her.
zh: 勃艮第的约翰（1231—1268）是夏洛莱伯爵，勃艮第公爵于格四世与德勒的约朗德的幼子之一。1248年2月，他娶波旁领主阿尔尚博九世之女当皮埃尔的阿涅丝为妻。1262年，阿涅丝的姐姐玛蒂尔德去世，阿涅丝继承了波旁。两人只有一女比阿特丽斯，于1272年嫁给法王路易九世之子、克莱蒙伯爵罗贝尔，波旁卡佩家族即出自比阿特丽斯一系。

en: John of Charolais (1283 – 1316), also called John of Clermont, was a French baron, younger brother of Louis I, Duke of Bourbon, and son of Robert, Count of Clermont, and Beatrice of Burgundy, Lady of Bourbon. He held Charolais and Saint-Just and fought the Flemings under Philip IV the Fair, at Furnes in 1297, Courtrai in 1302 and Mons-en-Pévèle in 1304. Around 1309 he married Joanna of Dargies and Catheux; their daughter Beatrice succeeded him in Charolais and married John I, Count of Armagnac. Another daughter, Joanna, married John I, Count of Auvergne. He died in 1316 while preparing to crusade in the Holy Land.
zh: 沙罗莱的让（1283年—1316年），又称克莱蒙的让，是法兰西贵族，克莱蒙伯爵罗贝尔与波旁女领主勃艮第的贝亚特丽丝之子，波旁公爵路易一世的弟弟。他领有沙罗莱和圣瑞斯特，在美男子腓力四世麾下参加佛兰德战争，先后战于1297年的弗尔讷、1302年的科特赖克和1304年的蒙桑佩韦勒。约1309年，他娶达尔日和卡特厄的让娜；女儿贝亚特丽丝后来继承沙罗莱，嫁给阿马尼亚克伯爵约翰一世。另一个女儿让娜嫁给奥弗涅伯爵约翰一世。1316年，他正准备前往圣地参加十字军时去世。

en: Jean de Chaudenay was a Burgundian noble, sire de Chaudenay, who died in 1356. By his wife Marguerite de Lignières he had a daughter, Agnès de Chaudenay, who married Robert de Beaujeu, sire d'Arcinnes.
zh: 让·德·肖德奈是勃艮第贵族、肖德奈领主，1356年去世。他与妻子玛格丽特·德·利尼耶尔育有一女阿涅丝·德·肖德奈，后者嫁给阿尔辛讷领主罗贝尔·德·博热。

en: John I of Noyers (c. 1247–1300) was a Burgundian noble of the House of Noyers, a son of Miles VII, lord of Noyers and cupbearer of Burgundy, by Hélisende des Barres. He held the lordships of Maisey, Courgis, Saint-Cyr-les-Colons, Chitry, Augy and Quenne, and like his father served as cupbearer to the duke of Burgundy. In 1285 he married Margaret of Durnay, lady of Vendeuvre-sur-Barse and Courgis, founding with her the Maisey cadet branch of his house.
zh: 努瓦耶的让一世（约1247—1300）是勃艮第贵族努瓦耶家族成员，努瓦耶领主、勃艮第司酒官米莱七世与巴雷家族的埃利桑德之子。他领有迈塞、库尔日、圣西尔莱科隆、希特里、奥日和凯讷等地，并和父亲一样担任勃艮第公爵的司酒官。1285年他娶旺德夫尔叙尔巴尔斯与库尔日女领主迪尔奈的玛格丽特，由此开创家族的迈塞支系。

en: John II of Noyers was a Burgundian lord of the Maisey branch of the House of Noyers, son and heir of John I and Margaret of Durnay, holding Saint-Cyr-les-Colons, Courgis, Chitry and Épineuil. After 1302 he went to Frankish Greece, and in 1307 married Beatrice da Verona, widow of Grappola dalle Carceri and heiress of the southern third of Euboea. As her husband he ruled as triarch of southern Negroponte from 1307 until his death, which came before June 1324.
zh: 努瓦耶的让二世是努瓦耶家族迈塞支系的勃艮第领主，让一世与迪尔奈的玛格丽特之子和继承人，领有圣西尔莱科隆、库尔日、希特里和埃皮讷伊。1302年后他前往法兰克人统治下的希腊，1307年娶维罗纳的贝阿特丽切为妻。贝阿特丽切是格拉波拉·达莱·卡尔切里的遗孀、埃维亚岛南部三分之一领地的女继承人，让二世凭借丈夫身份自1307年起担任内格罗蓬特南部的三头领主，直至1324年6月之前去世。

en: Jeanne de Châtillon was a daughter of Guy IV of Châtillon, Count of Saint-Pol and Grand Butler of France, and Marie of Brittany. She married Miles I de Noyers-Maisey, Lord of Maisey, who served as captain of Calais and died in 1354.
zh: 让娜·德·沙蒂永是圣波勒伯爵、法兰西大酒政官居伊四世·德·沙蒂永与布列塔尼的玛丽之女，嫁给曾任加来守城长官、1354年去世的迈塞领主米隆一世·德·努瓦耶-迈塞。

en: Joan III (1308–1347) was the reigning Countess of Burgundy and Artois from 1330 and Duchess consort of Burgundy by marriage. The eldest daughter of King Philip V of France and Countess Joan II of Burgundy, she was wed in 1318 to Odo IV, Duke of Burgundy, sealing a settlement over the French succession. When her mother died in 1330, Joan inherited the counties of Burgundy, or Franche-Comté, and Artois and ruled them in her own right. Her only surviving son Philip died in 1346, so at her death her lands passed to her grandson Philip I.
zh: 让娜三世（1308—1347）是1330年起当政的勃艮第与阿图瓦女伯爵，并因婚姻成为勃艮第公爵夫人。她是法兰西国王腓力五世与勃艮第女伯爵让娜二世的长女，1318年嫁给勃艮第公爵厄德四世，这桩婚事为法兰西王位继承之争画上了句号。1330年母亲去世后，让娜以本人权利继承勃艮第伯国（即弗朗什-孔泰）与阿图瓦伯国。她唯一长大成人的儿子菲利普于1346年先她而逝，因此她去世后领地传给孙子菲利普一世。

en: Marguerite de Melun was a French noblewoman, the wife of Miles II de Noyers-Maisey, Lord of Vendeuvre in Burgundy. She died in 1398.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·默伦是法国贵族女子，嫁给勃艮第的旺德夫尔领主米隆二世·德·努瓦耶-迈塞。她于1398年去世。

en: Miles I de Noyers-Maisey (died 1354) was Lord of Maisey in Burgundy, son of Jean I de Noyers and Marguerite de Durnay. He served as captain of Calais and, in 1320, as seneschal of Beaucaire, and married a daughter of Guy IV, Count of Saint-Pol.
zh: 米隆一世·德·努瓦耶-迈塞（1354年卒）是勃艮第的迈塞领主，让一世·德·努瓦耶与玛格丽特·德·迪尔奈之子。他曾任加来守城长官，1320年任博凯尔司法总管，娶圣波勒伯爵居伊四世之女为妻。

en: Miles (Milon) de Noyers, seigneur de Joigny and son of Jean I de Noyers, comte de Joigny, died at the Château de Grancey in October 1376.
zh: 米隆·德·努瓦耶是茹瓦尼领主、茹瓦尼伯爵让一世·德·努瓦耶之子，1376年10月在格朗塞城堡去世。

en: Otto of Burgundy (c. 945–965) was Duke of Burgundy and Count of Auxerre, the second son of Hugh the Great, duke of the Franks, and Hedwig of Saxony, sister of Emperor Otto I; Hugh Capet was his elder brother. Before Easter 955 his father married him to Liutgarde, heiress of Gilbert of Chalon, and on Gilbert's death in 956 Otto succeeded him. King Lothair challenged his rule during his minority by occupying Dijon, but recognized him as duke in 960. Otto died in February 965 without children and was buried at Saint-Germain d'Auxerre; his brother Henry succeeded him.
zh: 勃艮第的奥东（约945—965）是勃艮第公爵兼欧塞尔伯爵，法兰克人公爵伟大的于格与萨克森的哈德维希的次子，母亲是皇帝奥托一世的姐妹，于格·卡佩是他的兄长。955年复活节前，父亲安排他娶掌管勃艮第事务的沙隆的吉尔贝尔之女、女继承人柳特加德为妻，956年吉尔贝尔死后奥东接掌勃艮第。法兰西国王洛泰尔趁他年幼侵占第戎，直到960年才承认他的公爵地位。965年2月奥东无嗣而终，葬于欧塞尔圣日耳曼修道院，弟弟亨利继位。

en: Philip of Burgundy (10 November 1323 – 10 August 1346) was the only surviving son and heir of Duke Odo IV of Burgundy and Joan III, Countess of Burgundy, herself a daughter of King Philip V of France. Around 1338 he married Joan I, Countess of Auvergne and Boulogne, and held those counties in her right. In 1340 he and his father held Saint-Omer against Robert III of Artois. He campaigned with the Duke of Normandy in the Hundred Years' War and died at the siege of Aiguillon after falling from his horse, leaving his infant son Philip to inherit Burgundy.
zh: 勃艮第的菲利普（1323—1346）是勃艮第公爵厄德四世与勃艮第女伯爵让娜三世唯一长大成人的儿子和继承人，其母为法王腓力五世之女。约1338年，他娶奥弗涅与布洛涅女伯爵让娜一世，以妻子的权利领有这两个伯国。1340年，他与父亲一同在圣奥梅尔抵御罗贝尔三世·德·阿图瓦的进攻。他随诺曼底公爵参加百年战争，1346年8月10日在艾吉永围城战中坠马身亡，年幼的儿子菲利普随后继承勃艮第。

en: Robert I the Old (1011–1076) was the third son of King Robert II of France and Constance of Arles. In 1025 he and his brother Henry rebelled against their father and forced him back to Paris. After rebelling against King Henry I in 1031 with his mother's support, Robert received the Duchy of Burgundy in 1032, founding the ducal House of Burgundy. His long reign was marked by violence: he plundered Church lands around Autun and Dijon and the abbey of Saint-Germain at Auxerre. In 1048 he repudiated his wife Helie of Semur and killed her father Lord Dalmas with his own hands. His sons Hugh and Henry both died before him, so in 1076 he was succeeded by his grandson Hugh I.
zh: 罗贝尔一世“老者”（1011—1076）是法兰西国王罗贝尔二世与阿尔勒的康斯坦丝的第三子。1025年，他与兄长亨利反叛父王，迫使父王退回巴黎。1031年他在母亲支持下起兵反叛国王亨利一世，1032年受封勃艮第公国，由此开创勃艮第公爵支系。他统治残暴，长期劫掠欧坦和第戎一带的教会地产以及欧塞尔的圣日耳曼修道院。1048年他休弃妻子瑟米尔的埃莉，并亲手杀死岳父达尔马爵士。他的儿子于格和亨利都先他而死，1076年他去世后由孙子于格一世继位。

en: Robert II (1248 – 21 March 1306) was Duke of Burgundy from 1272 and titular King of Thessalonica, succeeding his father Hugh IV. In 1279 he married Agnes, daughter of Louis IX of France; their daughters married Louis X and Philip VI of France, and their son Odo IV inherited the duchy. In 1284 his brother-in-law Rudolf I of Germany invested him with the Dauphiné, but two years of war ended when Philip IV bought his claim for twenty thousand livres. He helped negotiate the 1303 Treaty of Paris ending the Gascon War, and ended the partition of the duchy, imposing primogeniture. Earlier dowries had already diminished the ducal lands.
zh: 罗贝尔二世（1248年—1306年3月21日）1272年继父于格四世成为勃艮第公爵，也是名义上的塞萨洛尼卡国王。1279年，他娶法王路易九世之女艾格妮丝；两个女儿后来分别嫁给路易十世和腓力六世，儿子厄德四世继承了公国。1284年，他的妹夫德意志国王鲁道夫一世把多菲内封赐给他，随后爆发两年战争，最终腓力四世以20000图尔里弗尔买下他的宣称，战事方告结束。他参与谈判1303年结束加斯科涅战争的《巴黎条约》，并终止分割公国的做法，确立长子继承制；此前的嫁妆已使公国领地缩小。

en: Yolande of Dreux (c. 1212–1248) was Duchess of Burgundy as the first wife of Duke Hugh IV. The daughter of Count Robert III of Dreux and Aénor, Lady of Saint-Valery, she married Hugh in 1229. Her children included Odo, Count of Nevers and Auxerre; John, lord of Bourbon and Charolais; Adelaide, who married Henry III, Duke of Brabant; and Robert II, later Duke of Burgundy. She died on 30 October 1248 while Hugh was away on crusade in the Holy Land, and was buried at Cîteaux Abbey.
zh: 德勒的约朗德（约1212—1248）是勃艮第公爵于格四世的首任妻子、勃艮第公爵夫人。她是德勒伯爵罗贝尔三世与圣瓦勒里女领主埃诺尔之女，1229年嫁给于格。她的子女包括讷韦尔与欧塞尔伯爵厄德、波旁与夏洛莱领主约翰、嫁给布拉班特公爵亨利三世的阿德莱德，以及后来的勃艮第公爵罗贝尔二世。1248年10月30日，于格正在圣地参加十字军期间，约朗德去世，葬于西多修道院。

en: Burgul Noyan was a chieftain of the Mongol Barlas tribe in the Chagatai Khanate, recorded in Timurid genealogies as the son of Aylangir Noyan and the father of Amir Taraghai of Kish; through Taraghai he was the grandfather of the conqueror Timur.
zh: 不儿赫勒是察合台汗国境内蒙古巴鲁剌思部的那颜（首领）。据帖木儿朝谱系记载，他是亦连吉儿那颜之子、渴石的埃米尔塔剌海之父，也就是征服者帖木儿的祖父。

en: Matthäus an der Gassen (c. 1300–1363) was Prince-Bishop of Brixen from 1336 until his death. Born near Meran into a Tyrolean ministerialis family, he was a Brixen canon and chaplain to John Henry of Luxembourg when the future Emperor Charles IV arranged his election in November 1336. In the Luxemburg–Wittelsbach war over Tyrol he trod cautiously, accepting a 1353 treaty that made Brixen part of the County of Tyrol. In December 1350 he declined a cardinal's hat. When Tyrol passed to Rudolf IV in 1363, he went over to the Habsburgs, dying at Brixen on 27 October 1363.
zh: 马特乌斯·安·德·加森（约1300—1363）1336年至1363年任布里克森采邑主教。他出身梅拉诺附近的蒂罗尔家臣家族，本是布里克森大教堂参事、卢森堡的约翰·海因里希的私人神父；1336年11月，经后来的皇帝查理四世安排，获主教座堂选举为主教。卢森堡家族与维特尔斯巴赫家族争夺蒂罗尔期间，他行事审慎，1353年接受条约，使布里克森成为蒂罗尔伯国的一部分。1350年12月他被任命为枢机主教却辞而不受。1363年蒂罗尔归属鲁道夫四世后，他转投哈布斯堡家族，同年10月27日在布里克森去世。

en: Bolesław of Bytom (1330–1355) was a Silesian Piast, Duke of Koźle from 1347 and of Bytom from 1352. Eldest son of Władysław and Ludgarda of Mecklenburg, he succeeded his half-brother Casimir at Koźle in 1347 and inherited Bytom on his father's death in 1352. He married Margareta of Sternberg by 1347, having three daughters. In 1354 he accompanied King Charles of Bohemia to Rome for the imperial coronation, and died late in 1355 and was buried at Venzone Cathedral. Leaving no son, he ended the Bytom–Koźle Piast line; Oleśnica and Cieszyn divided his lands in 1357.
zh: 比托姆的波列斯瓦夫（1330—1355）是西里西亚皮亚斯特家族公爵，1347年起任科兹莱公爵，1352年起任比托姆公爵。他是瓦迪斯瓦夫与第二任妻子梅克伦堡的卢加尔达所生的长子，1347年继异母兄卡齐米日领有科兹莱，1352年父亲去世后又得到比托姆。1347年他已与斯滕贝格的玛克塔结婚，生有三个女儿。1354年他随波希米亚国王查理前往罗马参加皇帝加冕，1355年末去世，葬于文佐内大教堂。他没有儿子，比托姆—科兹莱一系的皮亚斯特男系就此断绝，其领地于1357年由奥莱希尼察与切申的公爵瓜分。

en: Casimir of Bytom (1253/1257–1312) was a Silesian Piast, the second son of Duke Władysław of Opole-Racibórz. After their father's death in 1282 he ruled Opole jointly with his brother Bolko I until 1284, when he took Bytom, Koźle, Toszek, Gliwice and Siewierz and founded the Bytom line of the Piasts. In January 1289 he became the first Silesian duke to pay homage at Prague to King Wenceslaus II of Bohemia. In 1303 he granted Koźle and Toszek to his sons, and in 1306 married his daughter Maria to Charles Robert of Hungary. He died on 10 March 1312.
zh: 比托姆的卡齐米日（1253/1257—1312）是西里西亚皮亚斯特家族成员，奥波莱-拉齐布日公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫的次子。1282年父亲死后，他与兄长波尔科一世共同统治奥波莱，直到1284年分家：他取得比托姆、科兹莱、托谢克、格利维采和谢维日，开创皮亚斯特家族的比托姆支系。1289年1月，他成为第一位在布拉格向波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫二世行臣服礼的西里西亚公爵。1303年他把科兹莱和托谢克分封给儿子们，1306年将女儿玛丽亚嫁给匈牙利国王查理·罗贝尔。1312年3月10日卡齐米日去世。

en: Casimir of Koźle (c. 1312–1347) was Duke of Koźle in Upper Silesia from 1336 until his death. The eldest son of Władysław of Bytom and Beatrix of Brandenburg, he received the district from his father in 1336, after the death of Duke Leszek of Racibórz, to whom Władysław had pledged it two years earlier. Burdened by heavy debts, he stopped paying Peter's Pence, for which the Church excommunicated him. He died unmarried and childless before 2 March 1347, and Koźle passed to his younger brother Bolesław.
zh: 科兹莱的卡齐米日（约1312—1347）1336年至去世任上西里西亚的科兹莱公爵。他是比托姆的瓦迪斯瓦夫与勃兰登堡的碧翠克丝的长子；1336年拉齐布日公爵莱谢克死后，父亲便将这块两年前抵押出去的领地交给他。他负债累累，停止缴纳彼得便士，被教会处以绝罚。1347年3月2日前他未婚而终，没有子嗣，科兹莱转由其弟波列斯瓦夫继承。

en: Ludgarda of Mecklenburg (c. 1310 – between 1362 and 1369) was Duchess of Bytom and Koźle, wife of the Piast duke Władysław of Bytom. Her parentage is known only from papal bulls of 1328 and 1342: she was probably a daughter of Henry II of Mecklenburg and Anna of Saxe-Wittenberg, though another account makes her a daughter of Pribislav II of Mecklenburg and Catherine of Pomerania. Around 6 April 1328 she married Władysław, a match likely promoted by King Władysław I Łokietek of Poland, who was then drawing closer to the princes of western Pomerania and Mecklenburg. She bore Władysław five children, among them Bolesław, who succeeded his father in 1352. Widowed that year, she kept her duchess's title and lived on, respected, in Bytom. Last recorded alive on 3 June 1362, she was dead by 26 January 1369.
zh: 梅克伦堡的卢德加尔达（约1310年—1362年至1369年间）是比托姆和科兹莱公爵夫人，皮雅斯特公爵比托姆的瓦迪斯瓦夫之妻。她的身世仅见于1328年和1342年的两道教皇诏书：多半是梅克伦堡的海因里希二世与萨克森-维滕贝格的安娜之女，另一说认为她是梅克伦堡的普日比斯瓦夫二世与波美拉尼亚的卡塔琳娜之女。1328年4月6日前后她嫁给瓦迪斯瓦夫，婚事可能由绰号“矮子”的波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫一世促成，当时这位国王正与西波美拉尼亚和梅克伦堡的诸侯走近。她为瓦迪斯瓦夫生下五个子女，其中波列斯瓦夫在1352年继承父亲的爵位。她同年守寡，保留公爵夫人头衔，在比托姆受人尊敬地度过余生。1362年6月3日是她最后一次见于记载，1369年1月26日前已去世。

en: Władysław of Bytom (1277/83–1352) was a Silesian Piast duke who ruled Koźle from 1303 and Bytom from 1316, adding Siewierz in 1328 and Toszek in 1329. The second son of Casimir I of Bytom, he reunited his father's scattered lands, yet money troubles forced him to sell Siewierz to Cieszyn in 1337 and pledge Koźle to Racibórz. In 1327 he did homage to King John of Bohemia at Opava, but during the Polish–Bohemian war of 1345–1348 he fought on Poland's side. He died by 8 September 1352, leaving Bytom to his son Bolesław.
zh: 比托姆的瓦迪斯瓦夫（约1277—1352）是西里西亚皮亚斯特家族公爵，1303年起领有科兹莱，1316年起统治比托姆，1328年得到谢维日、1329年得到托谢克。他是比托姆公爵卡齐米日一世的次子，重新统一了父亲散出的领地，却因财政拮据，1337年将谢维日卖给切申，又把科兹莱抵押给拉齐布日。1327年他在奥帕瓦向波希米亚国王约翰行臣服礼；但在1345—1348年的波兰—波希米亚战争中，他站在波兰一方作战。1352年9月8日前他去世，比托姆传给儿子波列斯瓦夫。

en: Alexander (870–913), third son of Basil I, was Byzantine emperor from May 912 after his brother Leo VI's death, ruling jointly with his young nephew Constantine VII. Co-emperor since 879, he used the title autocrator on his coins after becoming senior emperor. He dismissed Leo's closest advisers, shut Constantine's mother Zoe Karbonopsina in a nunnery, and restored Nicholas Mystikos as patriarch. Nicholas had been removed for opposing Leo's fourth marriage. In the east he faced attacks by the Abbasid caliph al-Muqtadir, and by refusing the customary tribute he provoked Simeon I of Bulgaria to war. He died in June 913, reportedly from gluttony and drink, leaving Constantine VII under Nicholas Mystikos's regency amid a Bulgarian invasion.
zh: 亚历山大（870—913）是巴西尔一世的第三子，912年5月兄长利奥六世去世后继任拜占庭皇帝，与年幼的侄子君士坦丁七世共治。他自879年起即为共治皇帝，成为首席皇帝后在钱币上使用独裁者称号。他斥退利奥六世的近臣，把君士坦丁的生母佐伊·卡波诺普西娜关进修道院，并恢复尼古拉·米斯蒂科斯的牧首之位。尼古拉曾因反对利奥的第四次婚姻而被罢黜。东线他遭到阿拔斯哈里发穆克塔迪尔进攻，又因拒绝按惯例纳贡而招致保加利亚的西美昂一世开战。913年6月他死去，据称死于暴食酗酒，把处于保加利亚入侵威胁下的君士坦丁七世留给尼古拉·米斯蒂科斯摄政。

en: Severus Alexander (208–235), born at Arca Caesarea in Syria, was the last emperor of the Severan dynasty. Julia Maesa's grandson and Elagabalus's cousin, he was adopted as heir at Maesa's urging and, aged thirteen, hailed emperor in March 222 after the Praetorians murdered Elagabalus. The Senate confirmed his elevation the following day. His early reign was guided by his mother Julia Mamaea, and the peaceful years brought prosperity, but Rome faced threats from the rising Sassanid Empire and Germanic incursions. Alexander checked the Sassanid threat in the east, while on the Rhine his bribes to Germanic tribes enraged the army. In March 235 soldiers killed Alexander and his mother near Mogontiacum, opening the Crisis of the Third Century under Maximinus Thrax.
zh: 亚历山大·塞维鲁（208—235）生于叙利亚的阿尔卡·凯撒里亚，是塞维鲁王朝末代皇帝。他是尤利亚·玛伊莎的外孙、埃拉伽巴路斯的表弟，在玛伊莎推动下被收养为继承人；222年3月禁卫军杀害埃拉伽巴路斯后，十三岁的他被拥立为帝，次日元老院确认了他的帝位。他统治前期由母亲尤利亚·玛麦亚辅政，太平年月带来繁荣，但罗马面临新兴萨珊帝国与日耳曼人入侵的威胁。亚历山大遏制了东方萨珊波斯的威胁，在莱茵河前线却以金钱贿买日耳曼部落，激起军队愤怒。235年3月，士兵在莫贡提亚库姆附近杀死亚历山大和他的母亲，马克西米努斯·色雷克斯由此开启三世纪危机。

en: Alexios Apokaukos (c. 1295–1345) was born humble in Bithynia and rose through the tax offices. He joined John Kantakouzenos in the plot to replace Andronikos II with his grandson Andronikos III, and when Andronikos III became sole emperor in 1328 he was given charge of state finances. Early in 1341 he became megas doux, head of the navy, and re-equipped the fleet with a hundred thousand hyperpyra of his own money. When Andronikos died that year, he turned on his patron and, with Patriarch John XIV Kalekas and the dowager empress Anna of Savoy, led the regency for John V in the civil war of 1341–1347. As city prefect he became the champion of townsmen, merchants and sailors against Kantakouzenos and his aristocrats. In June 1345 he inspected a new prison for his political prisoners without a bodyguard, and they lynched him. The regency began to fray, and Kantakouzenos entered Constantinople in 1347.
zh: 阿历克塞·阿波考寇斯（约1295—1345）出身比提尼亚的卑微之家，以税务官起家。他参与约翰·坎塔库泽努斯的密谋，要以安德洛尼卡二世之孙安德洛尼卡三世取代祖父；1328年安德洛尼卡三世成为唯一皇帝后，他掌管国家财政。1341年初他出任大都督，统率海军，并自掏十万海珀派龙重新装备舰队。同年安德洛尼卡三世死后，他背离恩主，与普世牧首约翰十四世·卡莱卡斯及皇太后萨伏依的安娜共同主持约翰五世的摄政政府，在1341—1347年的内战中对抗坎塔库泽努斯。他任首都行政长官，成为市民、商人和水手对抗坎塔库泽努斯及其贵族的旗手。1345年6月，他未带卫队便去视察关押政治犯的新监狱，被囚犯私刑处死。摄政一方由此人心浮动，1347年坎塔库泽努斯进入君士坦丁堡。

en: Alexios I Komnenos (c. 1057–1118) was Byzantine emperor from 1081 to 1118 and architect of the Komnenian restoration. A nephew of Isaac I, he seized the throne from Nikephoros III in 1081 after campaigning against rebels and Turks. Initially defeated by Robert Guiscard's Normans in the Balkans, he allied with Holy Roman Emperor Henry IV and checked the invasion by 1085. He crushed the Pechenegs at Levounion in 1091 with Cuman help. His envoys appealed to Pope Urban II against the Seljuks at Piacenza in 1095, helping trigger the First Crusade and the recovery of much of western Anatolia. He died in 1118, succeeded by his son John II; his daughter Anna Komnene wrote the Alexiad.
zh: 阿历克塞一世·科穆宁（约1057—1118）1081至1118年任拜占庭皇帝，是“科穆宁中兴”的缔造者。他是伊萨克一世的侄子，在长年征讨叛军与突厥人之后，于1081年从尼基弗鲁斯三世手中夺取皇位。他在巴尔干初败于罗贝尔·吉斯卡尔的诺曼人，随后与神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利四世结盟，到1085年遏制了入侵。1091年他借库曼人之力在莱翁尼翁歼灭佩切涅格人。1095年他的使节在皮亚琴察向教皇乌尔班二世求援以对抗塞尔柱人，促成第一次十字军东征，帝国得以收复小亚细亚西部大片土地。1118年他去世，其子约翰二世继位；女儿安娜·科穆宁娜撰写了《阿历克塞传》。

en: Alexios II Komnenos (1169–1183), the only son of Emperor Manuel I and Maria of Antioch, was born in the purple at Constantinople. Crowned co-emperor in 1171, he married Agnes, daughter of King Louis VII of France, in March 1180 and succeeded his father that September aged eleven. His mother and the prōtosebastos Alexios Komnenos ruled as regents, draining the treasury while Hungary and the Seljuks raided the borders. In 1182 Andronikos Komnenos seized the capital amid the massacre of the Latins, and in September 1183 he had Alexios strangled with a bowstring and thrown into the Bosporos.
zh: 阿历克塞二世·科穆宁（1169—1183）是皇帝曼努埃尔一世·科穆宁与安条克的玛丽之子，生于君士坦丁堡紫室。他于1171年加冕为共治皇帝，1180年3月娶法兰西国王路易七世之女艾格尼丝，同年9月父亲去世、年仅11岁继位。生母与“首席至尊者”阿历克塞·科穆宁摄政，国库空虚，匈牙利人与塞尔柱人又侵扰边境。1182年，安德洛尼卡·科穆宁趁拉丁人大屠杀之机入主京城，1183年9月命人用弓弦勒死阿历克塞，将尸体投入博斯普鲁斯海峡。

en: Alexios III Angelos (c. 1153–1211) was Byzantine emperor from 1195 to 1203. His brother Isaac II made him sebastokrator, but in 1195 Alexios seized Isaac at Stagira, blinded and imprisoned him. His reign saw lavish gifts that emptied the treasury, plundered imperial tombs for tribute, and unchecked Turkish and Bulgarian raids. The tribute was demanded by Emperor Henry VI, but his death in 1197 meant the gold was never sent. When the Fourth Crusade stormed Constantinople for Alexios IV in July 1203, he fled by night. He blinded Alexios V at Mosynopolis, fell captive to Boniface of Montferrat, and in 1211 was taken at Antioch on the Meander fighting his son-in-law Theodore I Laskaris; he died in a Nicaean monastery.
zh: 阿历克塞三世·安格洛斯（约1153—1211）于1195—1203年任拜占庭皇帝。其弟伊萨克二世封他为至尊者，他却在1195年于斯塔吉拉擒获伊萨克，刺瞎双目后囚禁。他在位时滥施赏赐耗尽国库，为凑贡金甚至盗掘皇陵，放任突厥人与保加利亚人四处侵扰。贡金是皇帝亨利六世索要的，但亨利于1197年去世，黄金最终没有送出。1203年7月，第四次十字军为拥立阿历克塞四世猛攻君士坦丁堡，他连夜出逃。他在莫西诺波利斯刺瞎阿历克塞五世，自己随后被蒙费拉托的博尼法乔俘获；1211年他在门德雷斯河畔安条克与女婿狄奥多尔一世·拉斯卡里斯作战时被擒，最终死于尼西亚的一所修道院。

en: Alexios IV Angelos (c. 1182–1204), son of the blinded Emperor Isaac II Angelos, was imprisoned when his uncle Alexios III seized the throne in 1195. Smuggled out of Constantinople in 1201, he fled to his brother-in-law Philip of Swabia and diverted the Fourth Crusade to his cause with promises of pay, troops and church union. Isaac II was restored in July 1203, and Alexios was crowned co-emperor in August, but he soon clashed with both the Latins and the city's populace. Alexios Doukas Mourtzouphlos seized him on 27 January 1204 and had him strangled around 8 February.
zh: 阿历克塞四世·安杰洛斯（约1182—1204）是被刺瞎的皇帝伊萨克二世·安杰洛斯之子，1195年叔父阿历克塞三世篡位后被囚禁。1201年他被偷偷送出君士坦丁堡，投奔姐夫施瓦本的菲利普，以军饷、援军和东西教会合并为许诺，说动第四次十字军助他复位。1203年7月伊萨克二世复位，阿历克塞于8月加冕为共治皇帝，但他很快与拉丁人和君士坦丁堡市民双双反目。1204年1月27日，阿历克塞·杜卡斯·穆尔楚弗洛斯将他逮捕，约于2月8日把他缢杀。

en: Alexios Palaiologos (born c. 1140) was a Byzantine megas doux. He married Irene Komnene, daughter of John Kantakouzenos, and was the paternal grandfather of the emperor Michael VIII.
zh: 阿莱克修斯·巴列奥略（约1140年生）是拜占庭贵族，官至大都督，娶约翰·坎塔库泽努斯之女伊琳娜·科穆宁，是皇帝米海尔八世的祖父。

en: Alexios Doukas Palaiologos was the third son of the sebastos George Palaiologos and Anna Doukaina. He married Anna Komnene Doukaina, granddaughter of Adrianos Komnenos and Zoe, daughter of Emperor Constantine X Doukas. Their son George became megas hetaireiarches.
zh: 阿历克塞·杜卡斯·巴列奥略是至尊者乔治·巴列奥略与安娜·杜卡伊娜的第三子。他娶阿德里亚诺斯·科穆宁与皇帝君士坦丁十世·杜卡斯之女佐薇的孙女安娜·科穆宁·杜卡伊娜为妻，其子乔治后来官至大赫塔里亚里斯。

en: Alexios Palaiologos (died 1203) was a Byzantine nobleman, son of the megas hetaireiarches George Palaiologos. In spring 1199 Emperor Alexios III Angelos, who had no son, married him to his widowed eldest daughter Irene Angelina and named him despot and heir apparent. Alexios helped lure the rebel Ivanko to his execution in 1200, suppressed the Constantinople prison riots, crushed the coup of John Komnenos the Fat in July 1201, and subdued John Spyridonakes' revolt in Macedonia. He died young in 1203, before the Fourth Crusade reached Constantinople; through his daughter Theodora he was an ancestor of the Palaiologan dynasty.
zh: 阿列克修斯·巴列奥略（？—1203）是拜占庭贵族，大亲卫官乔治·巴列奥略之子。1199年春，无子的皇帝阿历克塞三世·安格洛斯把守寡的长女伊琳娜·安格琳娜嫁给他，封他为专制公，立为皇储。1200年，他设计将叛将伊万科诱入军营处死，又镇压君士坦丁堡的监狱暴动；1201年7月平定“胖子”约翰·科穆宁的政变，并平定约翰·斯皮里多纳克斯在马其顿的叛乱。他于1203年早逝，时值第四次十字军兵临君士坦丁堡之前；其女狄奥多拉使他成为巴列奥略王朝的先祖。

en: Alexios V Doukas, called Mourtzouphlos for his bushy brows, seized the Byzantine throne in February 1204 by a palace coup against Alexios IV while the Fourth Crusade camped outside Constantinople. He organized the city's defence and its defenders repelled an assault on 9 April. Three days later the crusaders breached the walls and sacked it; Alexios fled by night to Thrace with Eudokia Angelina, whom he married. Her father Alexios III had him blinded at Mosynopolis. Captured by the Latins in November 1204, he was tried for Alexios IV's death and thrown from the Column of Theodosius. He was the last Byzantine emperor to rule the city before its recapture in 1261, long after his death.
zh: 阿莱克修斯五世·杜卡斯绰号“穆尔楚夫洛斯”，得名于浓密的眉毛。1204年2月，第四次十字军兵临君士坦丁堡城下时，他发动宫廷政变推翻阿莱克修斯四世夺取皇位，并全力组织城防，守军于4月9日击退了一次进攻。三天后十字军破城洗劫，阿莱克修斯携欧多基娅·安杰利娜夜间逃往色雷斯，并与她成婚。在莫西诺波利斯，他的岳父阿莱克修斯三世命人刺瞎了他。1204年11月他被拉丁人俘获，以谋害阿莱克修斯四世之罪受审，最终被从狄奥多西纪功柱顶端掷下处死。他是拜占庭于1261年收复君士坦丁堡之前最后一位在该城执政的拜占庭皇帝，收复发生在他死后多年。

en: Anastasius I (c. 430–518), nicknamed Dicorus for his mismatched eyes, was Eastern Roman emperor from 491 to 518. A former silentiary from Dyrrachium, he was chosen at sixty by Zeno's widow Ariadne, who married him. In the Isaurian War of 492–497 he faced supporters of Zeno's brother Longinus and other rebels. Though defeated at Cotyaeum in 492, they fought on in the mountains for years. He fought Persia in 502–505, buying back Amida and building the fortress of Daras. Against Bulgar raids he raised the Long Wall west of Constantinople. His financial and monetary reforms left a vast treasury surplus, though his Monophysite sympathies embittered religious politics. He died in July 518; Justin I succeeded him.
zh: 阿纳斯塔修斯一世（约430—518）因双眼瞳色不同而得绰号“双瞳者”，是491年至518年在位的东罗马帝国皇帝。他出身都拉斯，本是宫廷侍从官，约六十岁时被芝诺的遗孀阿里阿德涅选中登基，随后与她成婚。他在492—497年的伊苏利亚战争中对抗芝诺之弟隆吉努斯的支持者及其他叛军。叛军于492年在科提亚埃姆战败，却继续在山区抵抗多年。他在502—505年与波斯交战，以黄金赎回阿米达，随后修筑达拉要塞。为抵御保加尔人袭扰，他在君士坦丁堡以西修建长城。他的财政与币制改革为国库留下巨额盈余，但基督一性论倾向使宗教斗争日趋激烈。518年7月他去世，查士丁一世继位。

en: Artemius, who took the name Anastasius II (died 719), was a senior imperial secretary when the Opsikion army blinded the Monothelete emperor Philippicus in 713 and raised him to the throne. He had the officers who plotted against Philippicus blinded and exiled. He restored Orthodoxy by replacing patriarch John VI with Germanus I and repaired relations with Pope Constantine, while rebuilding the fleet against an expected Umayyad attack. In 715 the fleet mutinied off Rhodes and proclaimed Theodosius III; Anastasius abdicated. In 719 he rebelled against Leo III with Bulgar support, but the Bulgars handed him over and he was executed.
zh: 阿特米奥斯即位后改名阿纳斯塔修斯二世（？—719），本是皇帝的高级秘书。713年，奥普西金军区的军队弄瞎基督一志论派皇帝腓利皮科斯，拥立他为帝。他将密谋推翻腓利皮科斯的军官弄瞎并流放。他废黜牧首约翰六世、代之以日耳曼努斯一世，恢复正统教义，修复与教宗君士坦丁的关系，并重整舰队防备倭马亚王朝来攻。715年舰队在罗得岛哗变，拥立狄奥多西三世，阿纳斯塔修斯退位。719年他在保加利亚人支持下起兵反对利奥三世，却被保加利亚人交出，最终被处死。

en: Andreas Ritzos (1421–1492) was a Greek icon painter born in Candia, modern Heraklion, in Venetian-ruled Crete. First recorded as a painter in 1451 and documented as active until 1492, he is counted among the founding fathers of the Cretan School alongside Angelos Akotantos and Andreas Pavias. Akotantos influenced Ritzos, while Ritzos and Pavias influenced each other. Working chiefly in the traditional maniera greca with rich gold backgrounds, he signed his icons both in Greek and as Andreas Rico de Candia. His Ascension of Christ separates its scenes into compartments. About sixty of his works survive, shaping later Cretan masters from Georgios Klontzas to Theophanes the Cretan and El Greco; his sons and grandsons also became painters.
zh: 安德烈亚斯·里佐斯（1421—1492）是希腊圣像画家，生于威尼斯治下克里特岛的干地亚（今伊拉克利翁）。他1451年首次以画家身份见诸记载，创作活动有据可查持续至1492年；他与安耶洛斯·阿科坦托斯、安德烈亚斯·帕维亚斯并称克里特画派的奠基人。阿科坦托斯影响了里佐斯，里佐斯与帕维亚斯则互相影响。他主要沿用传统的“希腊样式”，喜用华丽金底，签名时既用希腊文，也写作“干地亚的安德烈亚斯·里科”。他的《基督升天》以分格安排各个场景。他存世的作品约六十幅，影响了格奥尔吉奥斯·克伦扎斯、克里特人狄奥法内斯乃至埃尔·格列柯等后世克里特大师；他的儿孙也多以绘画为业。

en: Andronikos Angelos Doukas (c. 1133–before 1185) was a Byzantine aristocrat, the third son of Constantine Angelos and Theodora Komnene, and father of the emperors Isaac II and Alexios III. He led a division in the defeat at Myriokephalon in 1176 and an embassy to Jerusalem in 1177 to renew an alliance with King Baldwin IV. At Charax in 1179 he fled his own army, fearing he was surrounded by Turks. Sent against the rebel Andronikos I in 1182, he was beaten and defected, then joined a failed plot against the new emperor. Escaping with his sons, he found refuge with Saladin in Damascus and Baghdad and died at Acre before 1185.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/安德洛尼卡·杜卡斯·安格洛斯
zh: 安德洛尼卡·杜卡斯·安格洛斯（约1133—1185年前）是拜占庭贵族，君士坦丁·安格洛斯与狄奥多拉·科穆宁娜的第三子，也是后来伊萨克二世、阿历克塞三世两帝之父。他在1176年密列奥塞法隆战败时指挥一路军队，1177年出使耶路撒冷，与国王鲍德温四世重订同盟。1179年他在卡克斯以为被突厥人包围，弃军而逃。1182年他受命讨伐起兵的安德洛尼卡一世，兵败后倒戈，旋又参与推翻新帝的密谋；事泄后携子出逃，在大马士革和巴格达得到萨拉丁的接济，最终客死阿卡，时在1185年之前。

en: Andronikos Asanes Palaiologos (c. 1330–after 1356) was a Byzantine commander, son of the despot Manuel Komnenos Raoul Asanes and great-grandson of Tsar Ivan Asen III of Bulgaria. After civil war broke out in 1342, John VI Kantakouzenos placed him with his maternal grandfather Theodore Synadenos in zealot-held Thessalonica; he later joined his father at Bizye. In 1351, as panhypersebastos, he attended the Second Palamite Council in Constantinople. He led troops from Bizye to John VI's aid in December 1354, too late to save the throne, and Matthew Kantakouzenos promoted him to sebastokrator. He is last documented in 1356.
zh: 安德罗尼科斯·阿萨尼斯·巴列奥略（约1330—1356年后）是拜占庭军事将领，专制公曼努埃尔·科穆宁·拉乌尔·阿森之子、保加利亚沙皇伊凡·阿森三世的曾孙。1342年内战爆发后，约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯把年幼的他托付给外祖父狄奥多尔·西纳德诺斯，带往狂热党控制的塞萨洛尼基；后来他回到身在比兹耶的父亲身边。1351年，他以全至尊者的身份出席君士坦丁堡第二次帕拉马斯宗教会议。1354年12月，他从比兹耶率军驰援约翰六世，却未能挽救其帝位，马修·坎塔库泽努斯在色雷斯的战事中升他为至尊者。1356年后再无记载。

en: Andronikos Asen (c. 1279–c. 1322) was the son of Tsar Ivan Asen III of Bulgaria and Irene Palaiologina, sister of Emperor Andronikos II. His parents fled to Byzantium in 1280, and he entered Byzantine service. In 1316 Andronikos II named him epitropos, or governor, of the imperial province in the Morea, succeeding Michael Kantakouzenos. The province then occupied a small part of the southeastern Morea. Exploiting strife within the Frankish Principality of Achaea, he conquered much of the central Morea and in 1320 seized Akova, Karytaina and Saint George in Skorta, defeating a Frankish army nearby in September. He died about 1322; his daughter Irene married the future emperor John VI Kantakouzenos.
zh: 安德罗尼科斯·阿森（约1279—约1322）是保加利亚沙皇伊凡·阿森三世与皇帝安德洛尼卡二世之妹伊琳妮·巴列奥略娜之子。1280年父母流亡拜占庭，他遂入仕拜占庭。1316年，安德洛尼卡二世任命他接替米哈伊尔·坎塔库泽努斯，出任摩里亚帝国行省总督。当时该省仅占摩里亚东南部一小块地区。他利用法兰克人的亚该亚侯国内讧，征服摩里亚中部大片土地，1320年夺取斯科塔的阿科瓦、卡里泰纳和圣乔治城堡，并于9月在圣乔治附近击败一支法兰克军队。他约于1322年去世；女儿伊琳妮嫁给后来的皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯。

en: Andronikos Doukas (c. 980–c. 1029) was a Paphlagonian Byzantine nobleman who served Basil II as strategos of Preslav, governor of the theme of Bulgaria. Scholars take him to be the father of Emperor Constantine X Doukas and the caesar John Doukas.
zh: 安德罗尼科斯·杜卡斯（约980—约1029）是帕夫拉戈尼亚的拜占庭贵族，曾任普雷斯拉夫将军、保加利亚军区总督，被学者推定为皇帝君士坦丁十世·杜卡斯与凯撒约翰·杜卡斯之父。

en: Andronikos Doukas (died 1077) was the son of the Caesar John Doukas and a cousin of Emperor Michael VII. In 1071 he commanded the Byzantine rearguard under Romanos IV at Manzikert; announcing that the emperor had fallen, he deserted the field, and was widely blamed for the catastrophic defeat. In 1072 he and his brother Constantine hunted the deposed Romanos IV down in Cilicia and took his surrender. He reportedly opposed the blinding of Romanos that followed. In 1074 he and his father fought the rebel Roussel de Bailleul, but their own rearguard abandoned them. Captured and badly wounded, Andronikos was released for treatment in Constantinople, where he died on 14 October 1077. His daughter Irene married Alexios I Komnenos.
zh: 安德洛尼卡·杜卡斯（?—1077）是凯撒约翰·杜卡斯之子、皇帝米哈伊尔七世的堂兄弟。1071年，他在罗曼努斯四世麾下指挥曼齐刻尔特战役的拜占庭军后卫，却宣称皇帝已战死并撤离战场，被普遍视为这场惨败的祸首。1072年，他与兄弟君士坦丁在奇里乞亚追擒被废黜的罗曼努斯四世并受其投降。相传他反对随后弄瞎罗曼努斯。1074年，他与父亲讨伐叛将鲁塞尔·德·巴约勒，却遭己方后卫抛弃。他被俘且身负重伤，获释后在君士坦丁堡接受治疗，1077年10月14日卒于该城。其女伊琳娜嫁给阿莱克修斯一世·科穆宁。

en: Andronikos I Komnenos (c. 1118–1185), son of the sebastokrator Isaac Komnenos, long intrigued against his cousin Emperor Manuel I and spent years in exile. In 1151–1152 Manuel sent him against Thoros II of Armenian Cilicia, but Andronikos was defeated. After Manuel's death in 1180 he marched on Constantinople as protector of the young Alexios II, seized the capital in 1182, and eliminated the regent Maria of Antioch. In September 1183 he was crowned co-emperor and then had Alexios murdered. As emperor (1183–1185) he curbed the aristocracy with brutal reforms that benefited common citizens, but the Norman sack of Thessaloniki in 1185 provoked an uprising in which he was overthrown and killed, the last emperor of the Komnenian dynasty.
zh: 安德洛尼卡一世·科穆宁（约1118—1185）是至尊者伊萨克·科穆宁之子，长期与表兄曼努埃尔一世皇帝明争暗斗，流亡多年。1151—1152年曼努埃尔派他讨伐亚美尼亚奇里乞亚的索罗斯二世，他却遭到击败。1180年曼努埃尔死后，他以保护年幼的阿莱克修斯二世为名进军君士坦丁堡，1182年控制首都，铲除摄政安条克的玛丽。1183年9月他加冕为共治皇帝，随后命人杀害阿莱克修斯。在位期间（1183—1185）他以严酷手段打击贵族，改革使平民受益；1185年诺曼人洗劫塞萨洛尼基激起民变，他被推翻并杀害，是科穆宁王朝末代皇帝。

en: Andronikos II Palaiologos (1259–1332) became sole emperor in 1282 and at once repudiated Michael VIII's Union of Lyons. Faced with financial difficulties, he disbanded the imperial fleet in 1285, increasing his dependence on Genoa at sea, and devalued the hyperpyron. In 1298 he wed his five-year-old daughter Simonis to King Stefan Milutin of Serbia. The defeat at Bapheus in 1302 opened Anatolia to the Ottoman Turks. The Catalan Company he hired under Roger de Flor turned on Byzantium after de Flor's murder in 1305. Civil war with his grandson Andronikos III forced his abdication in 1328, and he died a monk on 13 February 1332.
zh: 安德洛尼卡二世·巴列奥略（1259—1332）于1282年成为独自执政的皇帝，随即废除其父米海尔八世与罗马教廷达成的里昂教会联合。面对财政困难，他于1285年解散帝国舰队，使海上防务更依赖热那亚，并让海佩皮伦金币贬值。1298年，他把年仅五岁的女儿西莫妮达嫁给塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·米卢廷。1302年巴菲乌斯战败后，安纳托利亚向奥斯曼土耳其人敞开。他雇佣罗杰·德·弗洛率领的加泰罗尼亚佣兵团，结果弗洛于1305年被杀，佣兵团倒戈祸害帝国。与孙子安德洛尼卡三世的内战迫使他于1328年退位，1332年2月13日以修士身份去世。

en: Andronikos III Palaiologos (1297–1341) was the last soldier-emperor of the Palaiologan dynasty, and under him the empire came closer than at any time since the Fourth Crusade to regaining a footing in the Balkans and Greece. The son of Michael IX and Rita of Armenia, he was co-emperor before 1313. In 1320 he accidentally caused the death of his brother Manuel, and that scandal, together with the wild ways of his circle of young aristocrats, split him from his grandfather Andronikos II. He rebelled in 1321, and intermittent civil war ended in 1328 with the old emperor retiring to a monastery. Orhan beat his relief of Nicaea at Pelekanon in 1329 and the Bulgarians beat him at Rusokastro in 1332, yet he recovered Chios, Lesbos, Phocaea, Thessaly and Epirus. He died in 1341, aged forty-four. The quarrel over the regency between his widow Anna of Savoy and his closest friend John VI Kantakouzenos then became the civil war that opened the way to the Serbian Empire and the Ottomans in Europe.
zh: 安德洛尼卡三世·巴列奥略（1297—1341）是巴列奥略王朝最后一位军人皇帝，在他治下，帝国在巴尔干和希腊半岛上的地位，是第四次十字军东征以来最接近恢复的时候。他是米海尔九世与亚美尼亚的丽塔之子，1313年前被立为共治皇帝。1320年他意外导致弟弟曼努埃尔之死，这桩丑闻连同他与一群年轻贵族的放纵作风，使他与祖父安德洛尼卡二世彻底决裂。他于1321年起兵反叛，断续的内战在1328年以老皇帝退隐修道院告终。1329年他驰援尼西亚，在佩勒卡农败给奥尔汗；1332年又在鲁斯卡斯特罗败于保加利亚人，但他收复了希俄斯、莱斯沃斯、福西亚、色萨利和伊庇鲁斯。1341年他去世，终年44岁。遗孀萨伏依的安娜与他最亲密的朋友约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯为摄政权争执，演变成内战，为塞尔维亚帝国的崛起和奥斯曼人进入欧洲打开了通路。

en: Andronikos Kantakouzenos (c. 1334–1347) was the third and youngest son of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos and Irene Asanina. His approximate birth year is inferred from his father's History, which notes that in 1345 Andronikos was not yet twelve. When the civil war broke out in the autumn of 1341, the boy was in Constantinople with his grandmother Theodora Palaiologina; the regency first placed him under house arrest and later imprisoned him on Alexios Apokaukos's orders. He died in 1347 during Constantinople's first outbreak of plague, shortly after the civil war ended.
zh: 安德罗尼科斯·坎塔库泽努斯（约1334—1347）是皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯与伊琳妮·阿森尼娜的第三子、幼子。大致生年据其父所著《历史》推断：书中提到1345年时安德罗尼科斯还不满十二岁。1341年秋内战爆发时，年幼的他身在君士坦丁堡，由祖母狄奥多拉·巴列奥略吉娜照看；摄政团先将他软禁，后又按阿历克塞·阿波考寇斯的命令把他下狱。1347年内战刚结束不久，他在君士坦丁堡第一次瘟疫流行中病死。

en: Andronikos Palaiologos Angelos was a son of Konstantinos Palaiologos Angelos (died 1345), a grandson of Demetrios Koutroules, and the husband of a daughter of Alexios Apokaukos, the megas doux.
zh: 安德洛尼卡·巴列奥略·安格洛斯是君士坦丁·巴列奥略·安格洛斯（1345年卒）之子、德米特里奥斯·库特鲁莱斯之孙，娶大公爵阿莱克修斯·阿波考科斯之女为妻。

en: Andronikos Doukas Komnenos Palaiologos (c. 1190–1248/1252) was megas domestikos, or commander-in-chief, of the Empire of Nicaea and the father of Michael VIII, founder of the Palaiologan dynasty. In 1224 he organised the newly recovered lands along the Scamander river, and in 1233 he led the expedition against the Caesar Leo Gabalas of Rhodes, forcing him to acknowledge Nicaean suzerainty. He campaigned with John III Vatatzes in Macedonia and at the siege of Thessalonica in 1241, but a Mongol invasion of Asia Minor cut the campaign short. After the city fell in 1246 he governed it as praitor of all Nicaean Macedonia, where his son Michael served under him at Serres and Melenikon.
zh: 安德洛尼卡·杜卡斯·科穆宁·巴列奥略（约1190—1248/1252）是尼西亚帝国大统帅，也是巴列奥略王朝开创者米海尔八世之父。1224年，他受命整顿刚收复的斯卡曼德罗斯河流域；1233年率军讨伐割据罗得岛的凯撒莱昂·加瓦拉斯，迫使其承认尼西亚的宗主权。1241年，他随约翰三世·瓦塔采斯征战马其顿、围攻塞萨洛尼基，但蒙古人入侵小亚细亚使远征中断。1246年该城陷落后，他出任塞萨洛尼基总督，统领尼西亚在马其顿的新获领土，其子米海尔曾在塞雷和梅尔尼克于他麾下效力。

en: The unnamed daughter of Isaac Angelos Doukas married the Byzantine commander Basil Vatatzes around 1187. She was likely the mother of the future Nicaean emperor John III Doukas Vatatzes and of the sebastokrator Isaac Doukas Vatatzes.
zh: 她是伊萨克·安杰洛斯·杜卡斯的女儿，名字无载，约1187年嫁给拜占庭将领瓦西里·瓦塔特泽斯，一般认为是尼西亚皇帝约翰三世·杜卡斯·瓦塔特泽斯与至尊者伊萨克·杜卡斯·瓦塔特泽斯之母。

en: Anna of Hungary (c. 1260–1281) was a princess of the Árpád dynasty, daughter of King Stephen V of Hungary and Elizabeth the Cuman, and granddaughter of Béla IV. On 8 November 1273 she married Andronikos II Palaiologos, then co-emperor to Michael VIII. She bore him two sons, the future emperor Michael IX and the despotes Constantine, and died in 1281, shortly before Andronikos succeeded to the throne. Every Palaiologan emperor down to the fall of Constantinople in 1453 descended from her through Michael IX.
zh: 匈牙利的安娜（约1260—1281）是阿帕德王朝公主，匈牙利国王伊什特万五世与库曼人伊丽莎白之女、贝拉四世的孙女。1273年11月8日，她嫁给当时与米哈伊尔八世共治的安德洛尼卡二世·巴列奥略，生下后来的皇帝米哈伊尔九世和专制公君士坦丁两个儿子。她于1281年去世，不久安德洛尼卡便继位为帝。此后直至1453年君士坦丁堡陷落，每一位巴列奥略朝皇帝都是她经米哈伊尔九世传下的后裔。

en: Anna Doukaina (born c. 1068) was a Byzantine aristocrat, the second daughter of the protvestiarios Andronikos Doukas and Maria of Bulgaria, and a younger sister of the empress Irene Doukaina. Before 1081 she married the sebastos George Palaiologos, and with her mother persuaded him to side with Alexios I Komnenos against Nikephoros III Botaneiates. She bore four sons, among them Andronikos and the general Alexios Palaiologos. She was still living around 1118 and had died by 1136.
zh: 安娜·杜卡伊娜（约1068年生）是拜占庭贵族女子，为首席衣橱官安德罗尼科斯·杜卡斯与保加利亚的玛丽亚的次女，皇后伊琳娜·杜卡伊娜之妹。1081年之前，她嫁给贵族塞瓦斯托斯·乔治·巴列奥略，并与母亲一同劝说他投效阿莱克修斯一世·科穆宁、反对尼基弗鲁斯三世·博塔尼亚特斯。她生有四子，其中包括安德罗尼科斯与将领阿莱克修斯·巴列奥略。她约1118年仍在世，到1136年已故。

en: Anna Komnene Angelina (c. 1176–1212) was a daughter of Emperor Alexios III Angelos and Euphrosyne Doukaina Kamatera. Her first husband, the sebastokrator Isaac Komnenos Vatatzes, was captured fighting Asen and Peter's Bulgarian revolt in 1195 and died in prison. In late 1199 she married Theodore Laskaris in a double wedding with her elder sister Irene. In autumn 1203 she fled the Fourth Crusade with Theodore to Asia Minor. When Theodore founded the Empire of Nicaea in 1205 she became its empress. She died in 1212; her daughters Irene and Maria married John III Vatatzes and Béla IV of Hungary.
zh: 安娜·科穆宁·安杰丽娜（约1176—1212）是皇帝阿历克塞三世·安杰洛斯与欧芙洛绪涅·杜卡伊娜·卡玛特拉之女。首任丈夫至尊者伊萨克·科穆宁·瓦塔特泽斯1195年在讨伐阿森与彼得的保加利亚起义时被俘，死于狱中。1199年末，她与姐姐伊琳娜同日举行婚礼，嫁给狄奥多尔·拉斯卡里斯。1203年秋第四次十字军兵临君士坦丁堡，她随狄奥多尔逃往小亚细亚。1205年狄奥多尔建立尼西亚帝国，她成为皇后。她于1212年去世，女儿伊琳娜与玛丽亚分别嫁给约翰三世·瓦塔特泽斯和匈牙利国王贝拉四世。

en: Anna Komnene Palaiologina (1260–1300) was a Byzantine princess, a daughter of Emperor Michael VIII Palaiologos and Empress Theodora Vatatzaina. Michael VIII first betrothed her to Stefan Uroš II Milutin of Serbia. When Anna arrived with the Byzantine envoys, the Serbian king responded to her rich clothes and jewels by showing them a poorly dressed local woman; the match collapsed amid disagreements over life at the Serbian court. In 1278 she instead married Demetrios Doukas Komnenos Koutroules, a son of Michael II of Epirus, who received the rank of despot from the emperor; Anna thus became despoina of Epirus. They had two sons, Andronikos and Constantine.
zh: 安娜·科穆宁娜·巴列奥略吉娜（1260—1300）是拜占庭公主，皇帝米海尔八世与皇后狄奥多拉·瓦塔采娜之女。米海尔八世起初将她许配给塞尔维亚的斯特凡·乌罗什二世·米卢廷。安娜随拜占庭使团抵达后，塞尔维亚国王看到她华丽的衣饰，便向使团展示一名衣着简朴的当地女子；双方对塞尔维亚宫廷生活方式产生分歧，婚事告吹。1278年，她改嫁给伊庇鲁斯统治者米海尔二世之子德米特里·杜卡斯·科穆宁·库特鲁利斯；皇帝授予女婿专制公头衔，安娜就此成为伊庇鲁斯的女专制者。两人生有安德洛尼卡和君士坦丁两个儿子。

en: Anna of Savoy (1306–1365), born Giovanna, was a daughter of Amadeus V, Count of Savoy. In October 1326 she married Andronikos III Palaiologos, and took the Orthodox name Anna. When Andronikos III died in June 1341, she became regent for their young son John V. With Alexios Apokaukos she fought the 1341–1347 civil war against John VI Kantakouzenos, and in 1343 pawned the crown jewels to Venice for thirty thousand ducats; the 1347 settlement left John V junior co-emperor. From 1351 she held her own court at Thessalonica, where she died after becoming a nun named Anastasia.
zh: 萨伏依的安娜（1306—1365），原名乔万娜，是萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥五世之女。1326年10月，她嫁给安德洛尼卡三世·巴列奥略，皈依东正教并改名安娜。1341年6月安德洛尼卡三世去世，她为年幼的儿子约翰五世摄政。她与阿历克塞·阿波考寇斯联手，在1341—1347年的内战中对抗约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯，并于1343年把皇冠珠宝抵押给威尼斯，换取三万杜卡特；1347年和议规定约翰五世为共治皇帝。1351年起她在塞萨洛尼基自立朝廷，约1365年在当地去世，去世前出家为修女，取修道名阿纳斯塔西娅。

en: Anna Angelina Palaiologina married John II Orsini, ruler of Epirus, and later John Komnenos Asen, brother of Tsar Ivan Alexander of Bulgaria; accounts differ on whether her father was Constantine or Andronikos Palaiologos Angelos and on when she died.
zh: 安娜·安杰利娜·巴列奥略娜先嫁伊庇鲁斯统治者乔瓦尼二世·奥尔西尼，后嫁保加利亚沙皇伊凡·亚历山大之弟约翰·科穆宁·阿森；她的父亲是君士坦丁还是安德洛尼卡·巴列奥略·安格洛斯，以及卒年，记载各异。

en: Anna Palaiologina (c. 1302–1320) was a Byzantine princess, daughter of co-emperor Michael IX Palaiologos and Rita of Armenia. In 1304 the Epirote regent Anna Palaiologina Kantakouzene sought her hand for her son Thomas I Komnenos Doukas, and the marriage was celebrated around 1307, tying the Despotate of Epirus to Constantinople. Sources hint that Thomas treated her badly. In 1318 Thomas was murdered by his nephew Nicholas Orsini, count of Cephalonia, who seized Epirus and, though she was technically his aunt, took Anna as his wife. She died two years later, in 1320.
zh: 安娜·巴列奥略娜（约1302—1320）是拜占庭公主，共治皇帝米海尔九世·巴列奥略与亚美尼亚的里塔之女。1304年，伊庇鲁斯摄政安娜·巴列奥略娜·坎塔库泽努娜为其子托马斯一世·科穆宁·杜卡斯求娶她，婚礼约于1307年举行，伊庇鲁斯专制国由此与君士坦丁堡走近。有记载暗示托马斯待她不善。1318年，托马斯被外甥、凯法利尼亚伯爵尼古拉斯·奥尔西尼杀害，后者夺取伊庇鲁斯，并娶安娜为妻，而按辈分她本是他的舅母。她于两年后的1320年去世。

en: Anna Synadene was a daughter of the Byzantine noble John Synadenos, megas konostaulos, and his wife Thomais Komnene Doukaina Laskarina Kantakouzene. She appears to have married Michael Laskaris Bryennios Philanthropenos and had a daughter, Eudoxia.
zh: 安娜·西纳齐妮是拜占庭贵族、“梅加斯·科诺斯陶洛斯”约翰·西纳齐诺斯之女，母为托玛伊斯·坎塔库泽内。她似乎嫁给了米哈伊尔·拉斯卡里斯·布里尼奥斯·菲兰斯罗佩诺斯，生有一女埃夫多克西娅。

en: Antoninus Pius (86–161), born near Lanuvium, was Roman emperor from 138 to 161, the fourth of the Five Good Emperors. Married to Hadrian's niece Faustina, he was adopted as heir in 138; he may have won the name Pius by securing Hadrian's deification. His reign was largely peaceful: a Scottish campaign produced the Antonine Wall, while he improved water supplies across the provinces and left a large treasury surplus. He also encouraged legal conformity and helped freed slaves gain citizenship. When Faustina died in 141 he had her deified, built a temple to her in the Roman Forum and founded a charity for poor girls. He died in 161, leaving the empire to his adopted sons Marcus Aurelius and Lucius Verus.
zh: 安敦宁·毕尤（86—161）生于拉努维乌姆附近，138—161年为罗马皇帝，是五贤帝中的第四位。他娶哈德良的侄女大福斯蒂娜为妻，138年被收为继承人；他可能因促成哈德良封神而得到“毕尤”（虔敬）之名。他统治期间帝国大体太平：一次苏格兰战事之后修筑了安多宁长城，他还改善各行省供水，留下充盈的国库。他也促进法律协调，帮助获释奴隶取得公民权。141年大福斯蒂娜去世，他将她封神，在罗马广场为她建庙，并设立救助贫女的慈善机构。161年他病逝，帝国传给养子马可·奥理略与卢基乌斯·维鲁斯。

en: Arcadius (c. 377–408), eldest son of Theodosius I, was proclaimed augustus in 383 and inherited the eastern empire in 395, his brother Honorius taking the west. A passive ruler, he was dominated in turn by the prefect Rufinus, the eunuch Eutropius, and his wife Aelia Eudoxia, whom he married in April 395. Rufinus had hoped to marry his own daughter to the emperor, but Eutropius arranged the marriage to Eudoxia. Alaric's Goths ravaged Greece, Eutropius fell in 399, and in 400 the Gothic general Gainas lost his followers in a massacre at Constantinople and was killed after fleeing. Eudoxia died in 404 after securing the exile of John Chrysostom. Arcadius died on 1 May 408, leaving the throne to his seven-year-old son, Theodosius II.
zh: 阿卡狄乌斯（约377—408）是狄奥多西一世的长子，383年被宣布为奥古斯都，395年继承东部帝国，其弟霍诺留领有西部。他性情文弱，先后受制于权臣鲁菲努斯、宦官欧特罗皮乌斯和皇后艾莉娅·欧多西亚，395年4月与欧多西亚成婚。鲁菲努斯曾希望皇帝迎娶自己的女儿，欧特罗皮乌斯却促成了皇帝与欧多西亚的婚事。他在位期间，阿拉里克率领的哥特人蹂躏希腊；欧特罗皮乌斯于399年倒台，400年哥特将领盖纳斯的部众在君士坦丁堡遭屠戮，盖纳斯逃亡后被杀。欧多西亚在促成约翰·屈梭多模遭放逐后于404年去世。408年5月1日阿卡狄乌斯病逝，皇位传给七岁之子狄奥多西二世。

en: Ariadne (c. 450–515) was the elder daughter of Emperor Leo I and Verina. In 467 she married the Isaurian officer Tarasicodissa, who took the name Zeno; their son Leo II was born the same year. After Leo I died in 474, she and Verina had the child emperor crown Zeno co-emperor, and when Leo II died that November Zeno became sole emperor with Ariadne as his empress. On Zeno's death in 491 she chose the silentiary Anastasius as his successor and married him, securing the throne for Anastasius I. She died in 515 and is venerated as an Orthodox saint on 22 August.
zh: 阿里阿德涅（约450—515）是皇帝利奥一世与维里娜的长女。467年，她嫁给伊苏里亚军官塔拉西科迪萨，此人改名芝诺；同年儿子利奥二世出生。474年利奥一世去世后，她与维里娜促使幼帝加冕芝诺为共治皇帝；同年11月利奥二世夭折，芝诺成为独自执政的皇帝，阿里阿德涅为皇后。491年芝诺去世，她选出宫廷侍卫官阿纳斯塔修斯继位并下嫁于他，为阿纳斯塔修斯一世稳住帝位。她于515年去世，被东正教尊为圣人，瞻礼日为8月22日。

en: Aurelian (214–275), born Lucius Domitius Aurelianus, probably in Moesia Superior, rose to command Gallienus' cavalry and served Claudius II, and seized power after Quintillus in 270. The empire faced invasions and the separation of its eastern and western provinces. He routed the Juthungi and Alemanni in Italy, drove back the Goths and abandoned Dacia. In 272–273 he reconquered the East, capturing Queen Zenobia and sacking rebellious Palmyra; in 274 he overthrew Tetricus and the Gallic Empire at Châlons, reuniting the empire and earning the title Restitutor Orbis.
