He built Rome's Aurelian Walls and reformed the debased coinage. In 275, marching against Persia, he was murdered by his officers at Caenophrurium in Thrace.
zh: 奥勒良（214—275），全名鲁奇乌斯·多米提乌斯·奥勒里安努斯，可能生于上梅西亚，在军中崛起，曾任加里恩努斯的骑兵统帅，效力于克劳狄二世，270年昆提卢斯死后夺取帝位。当时帝国面临外敌入侵，东西部行省也已分离。他在意大利击溃裘通吉人和阿勒曼尼人，击退哥特人并放弃达契亚。272至273年，他收复东方，俘获女王芝诺比阿并洗劫再度叛乱的帕米拉；274年在沙隆推翻泰特里库斯和高卢帝国，重新统一帝国，赢得“世界光复者”的称号。他修建了环绕罗马的奥勒良城墙，整顿贬值的货币。275年，他在进军波斯途中，于色雷斯的凯诺弗里乌姆被部下军官杀害。

en: Balbinus (c. 178–238) was a wealthy Roman patrician, son of a Cappadocian legate and a Salian priest. Twice consul, in 213 he held the office with Caracalla, and won fame as an orator. He served on the Senate's committee of twenty against Maximinus. After the deaths of the Gordians in Africa, the Senate elected Balbinus and Pupienus joint emperors in April 238, though Rome forced the young Gordian III upon them. Balbinus stayed in the capital while Pupienus campaigned against Maximinus, but failed to keep public order. After his return they fell to mutual suspicion, and in July or August 238 Praetorians murdered both after ninety-nine days.
zh: 巴尔比努斯（约178—238）是富有的罗马贵族，父亲曾任卡帕多细亚副将，他本人也是萨利祭司团成员。他两度出任执政官，213年与卡拉卡拉同僚，并以演说家闻名。他参与元老院设立的二十人委员会，对抗马克西米努斯。戈尔迪安父子在阿非利加败亡后，元老院于238年4月推举巴尔比努斯与普皮恩努斯共同称帝，但罗马城方面迫使他们接纳年幼的戈尔迪安三世为共治皇帝。普皮恩努斯出征马克西米努斯期间，巴尔比努斯留守首都，却未能维持治安。普皮恩努斯凯旋后二人互生猜忌；238年7月或8月，禁卫军将二人一同杀害，他们共在位九十九天。

en: Barlaam of Seminara (c. 1290–1348), born Bernardo Massari in Greek-speaking Calabria, was a Basilian monk who came to Constantinople in the 1320s and taught at the university under Andronikos III. Learned in the classics, astronomy and mathematics, he had a sarcasm that put off even his friends. In 1333–1334 he negotiated church union with envoys of Pope John XXII, writing twenty-one treatises against the Latins that rejected papal primacy and the Filioque. In 1339 he went to Benedict XII at Avignon to propose a crusade against the Turks, without success, and gave Petrarch his first Greek lessons there. His attack on Gregory Palamas and Hesychast prayer ended in 1341, when two synods ruled against him. He joined the Latin Church at Avignon in 1342, became bishop of Gerace and died there in 1348. A third synod condemned him again in 1351.
zh: 塞米纳拉的巴拉姆（约1290—1348）俗名贝尔纳多·马萨里，生于卡拉布里亚讲希腊语的家庭，是巴西略会修士。他于1320年代来到君士坦丁堡，在安德洛尼卡三世治下的大学任教。他通晓古典、天文与数学，言辞尖刻，连朋友也被得罪。1333至1334年，他与教皇约翰二十二世的使节谈判教会合一，写了二十一篇反拉丁人的论文，反对教皇首席权和“和子句”。1339年他前往阿维尼翁觐见教皇本笃十二世，建议组织十字军对抗土耳其人，未获成功，并在当地向彼特拉克传授希腊语入门。他抨击格里高利·帕拉马斯和静修派祈祷，1341年两次主教会议裁定他理亏。1342年，他在阿维尼翁加入拉丁教会，出任杰拉切主教，1348年死于该地。1351年，又一次主教会议再度对他定罪。

en: Basil I the Macedonian (811–886) ruled Byzantium from 867 to 886 and founded the Macedonian dynasty. A peasant from the theme of Macedonia, he became Michael III's favourite and married the emperor's mistress on his orders. He was named co-emperor in 866 and murdered Michael in 867 to rule alone. His legal reforms became the sixty-book Basilika under Leo VI, and his army crushed the Paulicians at Tephrike in 872. He restored Ignatios as patriarch, improving relations with Rome. In Italy he allied with Louis II against the Arabs, taking Bari in 876 and Taranto in 880, though Syracuse fell in 878. He died after a hunting accident in August 886 and was succeeded by Leo VI.
zh: 巴西尔一世，绰号“马其顿人”（811—886），867年至886年为拜占庭皇帝，是马其顿王朝的开创者。他出身马其顿军区的农民家庭，成为米海尔三世的宠臣，并奉皇帝之命娶其情妇。866年他被立为共治皇帝，867年弑杀米海尔以独掌大权。他的立法成果在利奥六世时期编成六十卷的《巴西利卡法典》；872年其军队在特夫里卡攻灭保罗派政权。他恢复伊格纳提奥斯的牧首之位，改善了与罗马的关系。在意大利，他与路易二世结盟对抗阿拉伯人，876年取得巴里，880年取得塔兰托，但叙拉古于878年失守。886年8月他在狩猎事故后伤重而死，利奥六世继位。

en: Basil II (958–1025), called the Bulgar-Slayer, was senior Byzantine emperor from 976 until his death. Crowned co-emperor in 960, he was joined by his brother Constantine VIII in 962 or 963. Two generals, Nikephoros Phokas and John Tzimiskes, held the throne before him, and he escaped the regent Basil Lekapenos only in 985. He crushed the revolts of Bardas Skleros and Bardas Phokas by 989 and, after long warfare, annexed the First Bulgarian Empire. He married his sister Anna to Vladimir I of Kiev in exchange for military support, forming the Varangian Guard; their marriage led to the conversion of Rus'. He curbed the great landowning families and campaigned against Georgia, leaving Byzantium at its greatest extent in four centuries.
zh: 巴西尔二世（958—1025），绰号“保加利亚屠夫”，976年起担任拜占庭首席皇帝，直至去世。他在960年被加冕为共治皇帝，弟弟君士坦丁八世于962或963年加冕。尼基弗鲁斯·福卡斯和约翰·齐米斯西斯两位将军先后主政，他直到985年才摆脱摄政巴西尔·勒卡潘诺斯。到989年，他平定了巴尔达斯·斯科莱鲁与巴尔达斯·福卡斯的叛乱，又经长期战争吞并第一保加利亚帝国。他把妹妹安娜嫁给基辅的弗拉基米尔一世以换取军事援助，并组建瓦兰吉卫队；这桩婚姻促成罗斯皈依基督教。他限制大地产家族的势力，出征格鲁吉亚，去世时帝国疆域达到四个世纪以来的顶峰。

en: Basil Vatatzes (died 1194) was a Byzantine commander from the Adrianople region. Of humble birth, he rose under Manuel I Komnenos and c. 1187 married a cousin of Isaac II Angelos, becoming sebastos. By 1189 he was governor of Mylasa and Melanoudion, before his promotion to command in the Thracesian Theme. There he crushed the rebel Theodore Mankaphas near Philadelphia c. 1192 and drove him to the Seljuks at Iconium. As Domestic of the West, he was tasked with confronting the Bulgarian rebellion and refused to back his brother-in-law Constantine Angelos Doukas's revolt in 1193. In 1194 he was killed fighting the Bulgarians at the Battle of Arcadiopolis. He was likely the father of the Nicaean emperor John III Vatatzes.
zh: 瓦西里·瓦塔泽斯（？—1194）是拜占庭军事将领，出身阿德里安堡一带的寒门。他在曼努埃尔一世·科穆宁朝从军，约1187年娶伊萨克二世·安格洛斯的表妹为妻，获授“至尊者”头衔。到1189年他已任米拉萨和梅拉努迪翁总督，此后升任色雷斯西亚军区统帅，约1192年在费城附近平定义首狄奥多尔·曼加法斯的叛乱，将其逐往伊科尼翁的塞尔柱人处。出任西部陆军长官后，他负责应对保加利亚叛乱，1193年拒绝支持妻舅君士坦丁·安格洛斯·杜卡斯称帝。1194年他在阿尔卡迪奥波利斯战役中与保加利亚人作战时阵亡。一般认为他就是尼西亚皇帝约翰三世·瓦塔泽斯的父亲。

en: Gaius, nicknamed Caligula (AD 12–41), was the third Roman emperor, ruling 37–41. Born in Antium to Germanicus and Agrippina the Elder, he was dubbed Caligula, 'little boot', by soldiers on his father's German campaigns. After Germanicus died in 19 and his family was purged, he survived at Tiberius's court on Capri and succeeded as emperor in 37. He annexed Mauretania and began two aqueducts, the Aqua Claudia and Anio Novus, while sources portray him as a tyrant who demanded worship as a god. He sought to increase his personal power, but abandoned plans to invade Britain and place his statue in the Temple in Jerusalem. In January 41 Praetorian officers and senators killed him and raised his uncle Claudius.
zh: 盖乌斯绰号卡利古拉（公元12—41年），是罗马帝国第三任皇帝，37至41年在位。他生于安提乌姆，为日耳曼尼库斯与大阿格里皮娜之子，幼年随父在日耳曼尼亚军中，被士兵戏称为“卡利古拉”，意为“小军靴”。日耳曼尼库斯于19年去世、家族遭清洗后，他在卡普里岛的提比略宫廷中幸存，37年继位。他在位时吞并毛里塔尼亚，开工修建克劳狄亚水道和新阿尼奥水道；古代史料把他描绘成要求被当作神崇拜的暴君。他力图扩大个人权力，却放弃了入侵不列颠和在耶路撒冷圣殿树立自己雕像的计划。41年1月，禁卫军军官与元老将他杀死，拥立其叔克劳狄。

en: Caracalla (188–217), born Lucius Septimius Bassianus at Lugdunum in Gaul, was the elder son of Septimius Severus and Julia Domna. Proclaimed Augustus in 198, he ruled with his father and then briefly with his brother Geta after Severus died at Eboracum in 211, before having Geta murdered by the Praetorian Guard. In 202 he had been forced to marry Fulvia Plautilla, daughter of the prefect Plautianus. In 212 his Antonine Constitution granted Roman citizenship to nearly all free people of the empire. He built the Baths of Caracalla in Rome and introduced the antoninianus coin. He began a campaign against Parthia in 216, but was assassinated near Carrhae in April 217 and succeeded by Macrinus.
zh: 卡拉卡拉（188—217）本名卢基乌斯·塞普蒂米乌斯·巴西亚努斯，生于高卢的卢格杜努姆，是塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁与尤利亚·多姆娜的长子。他于198年被立为奥古斯都，先随父亲共治，211年塞维鲁死于艾伯拉肯后又与弟弟盖塔短暂共治，随后命禁卫军杀害盖塔。此前他于202年被迫迎娶长官普劳提阿努斯之女富尔维娅·普劳提拉。212年他颁布安东尼努斯敕令，将罗马公民权授予帝国境内几乎所有自由民。他在罗马修建宏大的卡拉卡拉浴场，并发行安敦尼尼安努斯银币。他于216年开始征讨安息，却在217年4月于卡雷附近遇刺，马克里努斯继位。

en: Catherine Tarchaneiotes is known to history only as a Tarchaneiotissa: a daughter of the protostrator Glabas Tarchaneiotes and wife of Andronikos Asen, Byzantine governor of the Morea. Her daughter Irene Asanina married the future emperor John VI Kantakouzenos.
zh: 凯瑟琳在史料中只留下家族名“塔尔哈尼奥提莎”。她是首席马夫长格莱巴斯·塔尔哈尼奥蒂斯之女、拜占庭摩里亚总督安德罗尼卡·阿森之妻；其女伊琳娜·阿萨尼娜嫁给后来的皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯。

en: Chandrenos was a Byzantine general from a landowning family in Asia Minor who fought the Turks until his ancestral lands were lost. He fought in the defeat by the Catalan Company at the Battle of Apros on 10 July 1305, then served in Macedonia under Angelos Palaiologos: he helped save Thessalonica from siege, confined the Catalans to Kassandreia, drove them into Thessaly, and in 1309 repelled a Serbian invasion aided by Turks under the renegade Malik. Around 1310–1311 he was accused of treason in Constantinople, where the scholar Thomas Magistros defended him before Andronikos II.
zh: 汉兹里诺斯是出身小亚细亚地主家庭的拜占庭将领，曾抗击突厥人，在祖传领地沦陷后离开小亚细亚。1305年7月10日，他作为统兵官之一在阿普鲁斯战役中被加泰罗尼亚佣兵团击败。他在安盖洛斯·巴列奥略麾下转战马其顿：协助解了塞萨洛尼基之围，把加泰罗尼亚人围困在卡桑德里亚并逐入色萨利，又于1309年击退一场由叛逃者马利克所率突厥人协助的塞尔维亚入侵。约1310至1311年，他在君士坦丁堡被控叛国，学者托马斯·马吉斯特罗斯在安德洛尼卡二世面前为他辩护。

en: Claudius II Gothicus (214–270), born Marcus Aurelius Claudius, was a senior officer under Decius and Gallienus. After Gallienus was murdered by his officers in 268, Claudius was proclaimed emperor as the empire faced invasions and the breakaway Gallic Empire held western provinces. With his cavalry leader Aurelian he destroyed the Gothic host at the Battle of Naissus (268–269), earning the surname Gothicus, and that autumn routed the Alemanni at Lake Benacus. He also recovered Hispania and the Rhône valley from the Gallic Empire. While preparing a campaign against the Vandals at Sirmium he died of plague in 270. The Senate deified him, and Aurelian succeeded him after the brief reign of Claudius' brother Quintillus.
zh: “哥特征服者”克劳狄二世（214—270），全名马尔库斯·奥列里乌斯·克劳狄，是在德西乌斯和加里恩努斯麾下晋升的高级将领。268年加里恩努斯被军官杀害后，军队拥立克劳狄为帝，当时帝国面临外敌入侵，分离出去的高卢帝国占据西部行省。他与骑兵统帅奥勒良在纳伊苏斯战役（268—269）中击溃哥特大军，因此得到“哥特库斯”（哥特征服者）的称号，同年秋又在贝纳库斯湖战役大败阿勒曼尼人，并从高卢帝国手中收复西班牙与罗讷河谷。270年，他在西尔米乌姆筹备远征汪达尔人时死于瘟疫。元老院将他神化，他的弟弟昆提卢斯短暂称帝后，奥勒良继位。

en: Commodus (161–192) was Roman emperor from 177, with his father Marcus Aurelius and alone from 180, the first emperor born in the purple. Born at Lanuvium, he joined the Marcomannic campaign in 172. In 176 he toured the eastern provinces with his father and celebrated a joint triumph with him in Rome. In 180 he made peace on the Danube and returned to Rome. His rule brought conspiracies, favourites Saoterus, Perennis and Cleander, debased coinage, gladiatorial appearances in the Colosseum, and claims of his own divinity. On 31 December 192 his inner circle had him strangled by the wrestler Narcissus, ending the Nerva–Antonine dynasty and opening the Year of the Five Emperors under Pertinax.
zh: 康茂德（161—192）于177年成为罗马皇帝，先与父亲马可·奥勒留共治，180年起独自执政，是第一位“生于紫室”的皇帝。他出生于拉努维乌姆，172年随父参加马科曼尼战争。176年他随父巡视东方诸行省，并在罗马与父亲共同举行凯旋式。180年他在多瑙河议和后返回罗马。他统治期间阴谋不断，宠信萨奥特鲁斯、佩雷尼斯、克里安德等近臣，货币贬值，他还亲自到斗兽场登场角斗，并神化自身。192年12月31日，身边人派角力士纳尔基索斯将他勒死，安敦尼王朝就此终结，随后佩蒂纳克斯登基，开启“五帝之年”。

en: Constans I (c. 323–350), youngest son of Constantine the Great and Fausta, was educated at Constantinople, where he was made caesar in 333. He became augustus in 337, receiving Italy, Illyricum and Africa. He defeated the Sarmatians in 338, and in 340 his troops ambushed and killed the invading Constantine II near Aquileia, seizing Gaul, Spain and Britain. He later quarrelled with his surviving brother Constantius II over the exiled bishop Athanasius of Alexandria. He campaigned against the Franks in 341–342 and crossed to Britain in 343, the last legitimate emperor to visit it for a millennium. In January 350 the general Magnentius was proclaimed emperor at Autun; Constans fled toward the Pyrenees and was hunted down and killed.
zh: 君士坦斯一世（约323—350）是君士坦丁大帝与福斯塔的幼子，在君士坦丁堡受教育，333年在那里被立为凯撒。337年他成为奥古斯都，领有意大利、伊利里库姆和阿非利加。338年他击败萨尔马提亚人；340年其兄君士坦丁二世入侵意大利，他的军队在阿奎莱亚附近设伏将其杀死，夺取高卢、西班牙和不列颠。此后，他与在世的兄长君士坦提乌斯二世因流亡的亚历山大主教亚他那修发生争执。341至342年他征讨法兰克人，343年渡海前往不列颠，是此后千年间最后一位到访该岛的正统皇帝。350年1月，将领马格嫩提乌斯在欧坦称帝；君士坦斯逃往比利牛斯山方向，终被追兵捕杀。

en: Constans II (630–668), son of Constantine III, was crowned Byzantine co-emperor in 641 and became sole emperor after Heraklonas was deposed later that year. Egypt was finally lost in 642, though his fleet briefly recovered Alexandria in 645. In 655 the Arabs crushed his fleet at the Battle of the Masts off Lycia. His Typos of 648 sought a compromise in the religious dispute by forbidding debate over Christ's natures, and in 653 he had Pope Martin I arrested and exiled. After campaigning against the Lombards in Italy, in 663 he became the first emperor to visit Rome since 476. He was murdered in his bath at Syracuse by his chamberlain on 15 July 668 and was succeeded by his son Constantine IV.
zh: 君士坦斯二世（630—668）是君士坦丁三世之子，641年加冕为拜占庭共治皇帝，同年赫拉克洛纳斯被废后独掌帝位。他在位时埃及于642年彻底沦丧，尽管他的舰队曾于645年短暂收复亚历山大港。655年阿拉伯人在吕基亚外海的桅杆之战歼灭其舰队。648年他颁布《提波斯》敕令，禁止争论基督的本性，试图调和宗教争议；653年又下令逮捕教皇马丁一世并将其流放。他在意大利征讨伦巴第人，663年成为476年以来首位访问罗马的皇帝。668年7月15日，他在叙拉古的浴室中被侍从官刺杀，其子君士坦丁四世继位。

en: Constantine I, called the Great (c. 272–337), was the first Roman emperor to favour Christianity and founder of Constantinople. Born at Naissus, son of Constantius Chlorus and Helena, he served under Diocletian and Galerius before joining his father in Britain. His father's army hailed him emperor at Eboracum in 306. After a vision, he defeated Maxentius at the Milvian Bridge in 312 and in 313 issued the Edict of Milan with Licinius, tolerating Christians. He overthrew Licinius in 324, convoked the Council of Nicaea in 325, introduced the gold solidus and dedicated Constantinople in 330. Baptized on his deathbed, he died on 22 May 337, leaving the empire to his three sons.
zh: 君士坦丁一世，世称君士坦丁大帝（约272—337），是第一位扶持基督教的罗马皇帝，也是君士坦丁堡的建立者。他生于奈苏斯，为君士坦提乌斯·克洛鲁斯与海伦娜之子，曾在戴克里先和伽列里乌斯麾下服役，后赴不列颠与父亲会合。306年父亲死后，他在埃伯拉肯被军队拥立为帝。312年他在米尔维安桥战役前得到异象，击败马克森提乌斯；313年与李锡尼颁布《米兰敕令》，宽容基督教。324年他推翻李锡尼独掌大权，325年召集尼西亚会议，推行金质索利都斯货币，330年为君士坦丁堡揭幕。他临终前才受洗，337年5月22日去世，把帝国分给三个儿子。

en: Constantine II (316–340), second son of Constantine the Great and eldest by Fausta, was born at Arelate in Gaul and made caesar in 317 as an infant. His court at Trier from 328 won him victory titles against the Sarmatians, Alamanni and Goths, notably in 332. In 337 he allowed the exiled bishop Athanasius to return to Alexandria, in his brother Constantius's territory. After Constantine I died that year, he and his brothers divided the empire, Constantine taking Gaul, Spain and Britain. Claiming seniority over his younger brother Constans, he invaded Italy in 340 and was trapped and killed near Aquileia, after which Constans seized his lands and his memory was condemned.
zh: 君士坦丁二世（316—340）是君士坦丁大帝的次子，也是福斯塔所生的长子，生于高卢的阿雷拉特，317年尚在襁褓中便被立为凯撒。328年起他以特里尔为宫廷，因对萨尔马提亚人、阿勒曼尼人和哥特人的战功获得胜利头衔，尤以332年之役著称。337年他允许流亡主教亚他那修返回弟弟君士坦提乌斯治下的亚历山大城。同年君士坦丁一世死后，他与两个弟弟瓜分帝国，分得高卢、西班牙和不列颠。他以长兄身份向幼弟君士坦斯争权，340年入侵意大利，在阿奎莱亚附近中伏被杀；君士坦斯吞并其领地，他还被判处记录抹杀刑。

en: Constantine III (3 May 612 – 25 May 641), born Heraclius Constantine, was the eldest son of Heraclius and Fabia Eudokia. Crowned Augustus on 22 January 613, he helped defend Constantinople against the Avar and Persian siege of 626 while his father campaigned in the East. He married Gregoria, and their son Constans II was born in 630. The rising prominence of his stepmother Martina and her children weakened his position. When Heraclius died on 11 February 641, Constantine ruled jointly with his half-brother Heraklonas. While dying, he sent money for the soldiers to secure his sons' succession. He died of tuberculosis on 25 May. Rumours that Martina had poisoned him provoked the army to overthrow her and enthrone Constans II.
zh: 君士坦丁三世（612年5月3日—641年5月25日）原名希拉克略·君士坦丁，是希拉克略与法比娅·欧多基娅的长子。他于613年1月22日加冕为奥古斯都，626年父亲东征期间协助守卫君士坦丁堡，抵御阿瓦尔人与波斯人围城。他娶格雷戈里娅为妻，630年生下儿子君士坦斯二世。继母玛蒂娜及其子女地位上升，使他的地位逐渐削弱。641年2月11日希拉克略去世后，他与异母弟赫拉克洛纳斯共同执政。临终时，他送出钱款给士兵，以确保儿子们的继承权。他于5月25日因肺结核病逝。玛蒂娜毒杀他的传言激起军队发难，玛蒂娜一党被推翻，君士坦斯二世登上帝位。

en: Constantine IV (c. 650–685) was Byzantine emperor from 668, the eldest son of Constans II. He first crushed the Sicilian usurper Mezezius. Arab fleets based at Cyzicus from 670 assaulted Constantinople, but his defence forced Caliph Mu'awiya I to sue for peace, the first major Arab reverse in fifty years. In 680 he convened the Sixth Ecumenical Council, which condemned monothelitism. That year he besieged Khan Asparukh's Bulgars in their fortified camp, but illness forced him to leave the army, which panicked and was defeated. In 681 he recognized their state in Moesia and paid them tribute. He died of dysentery on 10 July 685 and was succeeded by his son Justinian II.
zh: 君士坦丁四世（约650—685）668年登基，是君士坦斯二世的长子。他首先平定了西西里僭位者梅泽齐乌斯。阿拉伯舰队自670年起以基齐库斯为基地进攻君士坦丁堡，但被他的守御击退，哈里发穆阿维叶一世被迫求和，这是阿拉伯人五十年来首次重大挫败。680年他召开第六次大公会议，会议谴责基督一志论。同年他围攻阿斯巴鲁赫汗的保加利亚人的设防营地，却因病离开军队，军队随即惊慌溃败。681年他被迫承认其在默西亚建立的国家并缴纳岁币。685年7月10日他死于痢疾，其子查士丁尼二世继位。

en: Constantine IX Monomachos (c. 1000–1055) became Byzantine emperor in June 1042 by marrying Empress Zoë, sharing the throne with her and her sister Theodora. Previously exiled to Lesbos by Michael IV, he was recalled after Michael V's overthrow. He won two civil wars and repelled a Kievan Rus' raid, and his reign saw the annexation of the Armenian kingdom of Ani, but he was humiliated by the Pechenegs and could not check the rising Seljuq Turks. His lavish spending and the first permanent debasement of the gold coinage since Constantine the Great emptied the treasury. He also attempted legal reform, founding a law school headed by a nomophylax. In 1054 the Great Schism split Rome and Constantinople during his reign. He died in January 1055.
zh: 君士坦丁九世·莫诺马科斯（约1000—1055）于1042年6月迎娶女皇邹伊，与邹伊及其妹狄奥多拉共掌皇权，由此成为拜占庭皇帝。他先前被米哈伊尔四世流放到莱斯博斯岛，米哈伊尔五世被推翻后获召回。他两度赢得内战，击退基辅罗斯人的袭扰，在位期间吞并亚美尼亚阿尼王国，但败于佩切涅格人，也无力阻挡崛起的塞尔柱突厥人。他挥霍无度，并自君士坦丁大帝以来首次持续贬值金币，耗尽国库。他还尝试改革法律，创办法学院，任命法律监护人主持。1054年，东西教会大分裂发生在他治下。他于1055年1月病逝。

en: Constantine Palaiologos (1278/1281–1334/1335) was the second son of Emperor Andronikos II and Anna of Hungary, a purple-born prince made Despot in 1294 on his marriage to Eudokia, daughter of Theodore Mouzalon. In 1305 he fought under his brother Michael IX at the rout of Apros against the Catalan Company, and in 1317 he turned back his half-sister Simonis when she fled Serbia for a monastery. Around that time he married a second Eudokia; both marriages were childless, though he had an illegitimate son, Michael. He governed Avlona in 1319 and Thessalonica in 1321–1322, until his nephew Andronikos III imprisoned him at Didymoteichon in 1322. He died as the monk Kallistos in 1334 or 1335.
zh: 君士坦丁·巴列奥略（1278/1281—1334/1335）是皇帝安德洛尼卡二世与匈牙利的安娜的次子，是“生于紫室”的皇子。1294年，他娶狄奥多尔·穆扎隆之女欧多基娅，受封专制君主。1305年，他在兄长米海尔九世麾下参加了对加泰罗尼亚佣兵团的阿普罗斯惨败；1317年，异母妹妹西莫妮达想出家、离开塞尔维亚，被他截下送回。约在此时，他再娶另一位欧多基娅；两次婚姻均无子女，但他有一个非婚生子米海尔。他1319年任阿夫洛纳总督，1321—1322年任塞萨洛尼基总督，1322年在内战中被侄子安德洛尼卡三世囚于迪迪莫蒂霍，后出家，取教名卡利斯托，1334或1335年去世。

en: Constantine Palamas was a Byzantine courtier who served Emperor Andronikos II Palaiologos in Constantinople. He died when his son Gregory, the future theologian and archbishop of Thessalonica, was still young, after which the emperor himself took part in the boy's upbringing.
zh: 君士坦丁·帕拉马斯是在君士坦丁堡侍奉安德洛尼卡二世·帕里奥洛格斯皇帝的拜占庭朝臣。他在儿子——日后的神学家、塞萨洛尼基大主教格雷格利乌斯——尚幼时去世，此后皇帝亲自参与了这个男孩的抚养。

en: Constantine V (718–775), son of Leo III, became emperor in June 741 and immediately faced the usurpation of his brother-in-law Artabasdos. While Artabasdos held Constantinople, Constantine won the support of the Anatolic and Thracesian themes; he defeated his rival at Sardis in 743 and later blinded him. In 746 he captured Germanikeia and recovered Cyprus, where his fleet destroyed the Arab navy in 747. His iconoclast council at Hieria in 754 condemned icon veneration and unleashed persecution of monks. He created the professional tagmata regiments and waged repeated wars on Bulgaria, crushing Khan Telets at Anchialus in 763. He settled Christians from the Arab frontier in Thrace, strengthening Byzantine control in the Balkans. He died campaigning in September 775, leaving a strengthened empire to his son Leo IV.
zh: 君士坦丁五世（718—775）是利奥三世之子，741年6月即位，随即面临姐夫阿尔塔瓦兹德篡位。阿尔塔瓦兹德占据君士坦丁堡时，君士坦丁得到安纳托利亚和色雷西亚军区的支持；743年他在萨第斯击败对手，后来将其刺瞎。746年他攻取日耳曼尼基亚、收复塞浦路斯，747年舰队在塞岛外歼灭阿拉伯海军。754年，他在希里亚召开圣像破坏派主教会议，定圣像崇拜为异端，大肆迫害修士。他组建精锐的职业中央军塔格马塔，连年征伐保加尔，763年在安基阿卢斯大破汗王捷列茨。他把阿拉伯边境的基督徒迁至色雷斯，巩固了拜占庭在巴尔干的控制。775年9月他在征战途中病逝，把更为强盛的帝国留给儿子利奥四世。

en: Constantine VI (771–c. 798), only child of Leo IV and Irene, was crowned co-emperor in 776 and became sole emperor in 780, at the age of nine, with his mother as regent. A revolt of the Armeniac troops enabled him to take power himself in 790, but in 792 he restored Irene as co-ruler and suffered a humiliating defeat by the Bulgars at Marcellae. He blinded the general Alexios Mosele and crushed a revolt of his former Armeniac supporters in 793. He divorced his wife Maria to marry his mistress Theodote, alienating the church. On 19 August 797 Irene's supporters seized and blinded him; he died before 805, possibly soon after from his wounds, the last emperor universally recognized as Roman.
zh: 君士坦丁六世（771—约798）是利奥四世与伊琳娜的独子，776年被立为共治皇帝，780年九岁时成为唯一皇帝，由母亲摄政。790年亚美尼亚军区士兵的叛乱使他亲掌大权，但792年他恢复伊琳娜的共治者地位，又在马塞莱惨败于保加尔。他刺瞎将领阿列克修斯·穆瑟尔，并于793年镇压昔日支持他的亚美尼亚军区士兵的叛乱。他与妻子玛丽亚离婚、改娶情妇狄奥多蒂，因而与教会交恶。797年8月19日，伊琳娜的党羽将他拘捕并刺瞎双眼，他在805年之前去世，可能不久后便因伤而死，是最后一位被普遍承认的罗马皇帝。

en: Constantine VII Porphyrogenitus (905–959) was Byzantine emperor from 913 to 959, ruling alone only after 944. Son of Leo VI and Zoe Karbonopsina, he was born in the Purple Room and crowned co-emperor at two. His parents were unmarried at his birth, but his birthplace helped him assert his legitimacy. Regents ruled for him: Patriarch Nicholas Mystikos, his mother, then from 920 Romanos Lekapenos, whose daughter Helena he married. After Romanos fell in 944, he removed the Lekapenoi and ruled alone. A scholar-emperor, he wrote De Administrando Imperio and De Ceremoniis and sponsored the Geoponika. He ordered peasant lands restored in 947 and died in November 959; his son Romanos II succeeded him.
zh: 君士坦丁七世，绰号“生于紫室者”（905—959），913年至959年为拜占庭皇帝，但直到944年后才独自掌权。他是利奥六世与佐伊·卡波诺普西娜之子，生于宫中紫室，两岁即被加冕为共治皇帝。父母在他出生时尚未成婚，但他借出生地点强调自己的合法地位。长期由他人代掌国政：先是牧首尼古拉·米斯蒂科斯，其后是生母佐伊，920年起则是他的岳父罗曼努斯·利卡潘努斯，他娶了其女海伦娜。944年罗曼努斯倒台后，他清除利卡潘努斯家族，开始独掌大权。作为学者型皇帝，他撰写《帝国行政论》和《典仪论》，并主持编纂《农事志》。947年他下令归还农民土地。959年11月他去世，其子罗曼努斯二世继位。

en: Constantine VIII (960–1028) was de jure Byzantine emperor for sixty-six years, yet ruled in his own right only from 1025. The younger son of Romanos II and Theophano, he was crowned co-emperor in 962 and spent his life as the nominal colleague of Nikephoros II Phokas, John I Tzimiskes and, above all, his brother Basil II. Little interested in government, he enjoyed wrestling and riding in his youth, but suffered from gout in later life. When Basil died childless in 1025, the elderly Constantine's three-year sole reign saw Basil's land laws abandoned under aristocratic pressure and a string of cruel purges. On his death in 1028 he was succeeded by his daughter Zoe's husband, Romanos III Argyros.
zh: 君士坦丁八世（960—1028）名义上做了六十六年拜占庭皇帝，但直到1025年才独自掌权。他是罗曼努斯二世与赛奥法诺的小儿子，962年被加冕为共治皇帝，此后一直挂名在尼基弗鲁斯二世·福卡斯、约翰一世·齐米斯西斯，尤其是兄长巴西尔二世之下。他对政务兴趣寥寥，年轻时喜爱摔跤和骑马，晚年却饱受痛风折磨。1025年巴西尔无嗣而终后，年迈的君士坦丁独自统治三年：他在贵族压力下废除巴西尔的土地法，还屡次残酷整肃异己。他于1028年去世，由女儿佐伊的丈夫罗曼努斯三世·阿吉罗斯继位。

en: Constantius I, nicknamed Chlorus (c. 250–306), was a Roman emperor of the Tetrarchy and father of Constantine the Great. A career soldier from Moesia Superior, he rose to govern Dalmatia and became Maximian's praetorian prefect. He divorced Helena to marry Theodora, daughter of Maximian, and in 293 was made caesar of the western provinces. From Gaul he overthrew the British usurpers Carausius and Allectus and campaigned against the Alamanni and Franks on the Rhine. In the persecution of 303 he only demolished churches. He became augustus in 305, marched against the Picts in Britain, and died at Eboracum on 25 July 306, where his army proclaimed Constantine emperor, contributing to the Tetrarchy's collapse.
zh: 君士坦提乌斯一世绰号克洛鲁斯（约250—306），是罗马帝国四帝共治时期的皇帝，也是君士坦丁大帝之父。他生于上默西亚，以军功起家，升任达尔马提亚总督和马克西米安的禁卫军长官。他与海伦娜离婚，另娶马克西米安之女狄奥多拉，293年被立为西部凯撒。他以高卢为基地，消灭了不列颠的篡位者卡劳修斯和阿莱克图斯，又在莱茵河征讨阿勒曼尼人和法兰克人。303年大迫害开始后，他境内仅拆毁教堂，并不搜捕基督徒。305年他成为奥古斯都，赴不列颠征讨皮克特人，306年7月25日卒于埃伯拉肯，军队随即拥立君士坦丁为帝，加速了四帝共治的瓦解。

en: Constantius II (317–361), son of Constantine the Great, was born at Sirmium and made caesar in 324. In 337, after his father's death and a massacre of kinsmen, he took the East as augustus. Years of costly, inconclusive war with Persia followed, while his brothers fought over the western provinces. After Magnentius killed Constans in 350, he crushed the usurper at Mursa in 351 and Mons Seleucus in 353, becoming sole emperor. He made Gallus and then Julian caesar, promoted Arianism, banned pagan sacrifices and campaigned on the Danube. In 359 war with Persia resumed and several frontier fortresses fell. Julian's revolt in 360 drew him west, but fever killed him at Mopsuestia on 3 November 361.
zh: 君士坦提乌斯二世（317—361）是君士坦丁大帝之子，生于西尔米乌姆，324年被立为凯撒。337年父亲去世、宗室成员遭屠杀后，他成为奥古斯都，领有帝国东部。此后他与波斯进行多年代价高昂而未决胜负的战争，其兄弟则在西部争夺领地。350年马格嫩提乌斯杀害君士坦斯，他于351年穆尔萨战役、353年塞琉古山战役击败篡位者，成为唯一皇帝。他先后立加卢斯和朱利安为凯撒，扶持阿里乌派，禁止异教献祭，并在多瑙河征战。359年与波斯的战争再起，数座边境要塞失守。360年朱利安起兵促使他西返，他却于361年11月3日在莫普苏埃斯蒂亚染热病而死。

en: Decius (c. 201–251), born at Budalia in Pannonia, was among the first emperors from the Danubian provinces. Consul in 232, he governed Moesia and Hispania Tarraconensis before serving as urban prefect under Philip the Arab. Sent in 249 to put down the Danube revolt of Pacatian, he was hailed emperor by his troops and defeated and killed Philip near Verona that year. In 250 his edict ordering sacrifice to the Roman gods launched the first empire-wide persecution of Christians, martyring Pope Fabian. After Cniva's Goths captured Philippopolis, Decius returned with a reorganized army. In June 251 he and his son Herennius Etruscus fell against the Goths at the Battle of Abritus, making him the first Roman emperor slain fighting a foreign foe.
zh: 德西乌斯（约201—251）生于潘诺尼亚的布达里亚，是最早一批出身多瑙河行省的皇帝之一。他曾于232年任执政官，担任梅西亚和塔拉科西班牙总督，后在阿拉伯人菲利普治下任罗马城行政长官。249年，他奉命平定多瑙河前线帕卡提亚努斯的叛乱，军队却拥立他为帝；同年他在维罗纳击败并杀死菲利普。250年，他颁布敕令要求全体居民向罗马诸神献祭，由此掀起第一次遍及全帝国的基督徒迫害，教宗法比安殉道。哥特王尼瓦攻陷菲利波波利斯后，德西乌斯率重组的军队返回。251年6月，他与儿子赫伦尼乌斯·埃特鲁斯库斯在阿伯里图斯战役中迎战哥特人，双双战死，他也成为第一位在抗击外敌的战役中阵亡的罗马皇帝。

en: Demetrios Koutroules (fl. 1278–1304), born Demetrios Doukas Komnenos and later renamed Michael, was the third son of Michael II of Epirus and Theodora of Arta. In 1278 he married Anna Palaiologina, daughter of Emperor Michael VIII, who raised him to the rank of despot; their sons were Andronikos and Constantine Palaiologos. He served in the Byzantine army at the siege of Berat against Charles of Anjou and later campaigned against the Alans. In 1304 he was accused of plotting against Andronikos II and imprisoned, after which nothing more is heard of him.
zh: 德米特里·库特鲁莱斯（活动于1278—1304年）原名德米特里·杜卡斯·科穆宁，后改名米哈伊尔，是伊庇鲁斯君主米哈伊尔二世与阿尔塔的狄奥多拉的第三子。1278年他迎娶拜占庭皇帝米哈伊尔八世之女安娜·巴列奥略娜，受岳父封为专制君主；两人之子为安德洛尼卡和君士坦丁·巴列奥略。他随拜占庭军在培拉特之围中抗击安茹的查理，后来又参加征讨阿兰人的战役。1304年他被控密谋反对安德洛尼卡二世，被捕入狱，此后下落不明。

en: Demetrios Palaiologos (c. 1295 – after 1343) was the youngest son of Emperor Andronikos II and his second wife, Irene of Montferrat. Around 1304 he was briefly sent to the court of the Serbian king Stefan Uroš II Milutin as his intended heir, and in 1306 he received the title of despot. In the civil war of 1321–1328 he backed his father against his nephew Andronikos III, governing Thessalonica in 1327–1328 before fleeing to Serbia. Reconciled after the war, he was accused of conspiracy in 1336–1337, but Andronikos III dropped the charges. He was also a noted theologian and miniature painter.
zh: 德米特里奥斯·巴列奥略（约1295—1343年后）是皇帝安德洛尼卡二世与第二任妻子蒙费拉的伊琳娜最小的儿子。约1304年，他被短暂送往塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·乌罗什二世·米卢廷的宫廷，预定为其继承人；1306年获封专制君主。1321—1328年内战中，他支持父亲对抗侄子安德洛尼卡三世，于1327—1328年任塞萨洛尼基总督，后被迫逃往塞尔维亚。战后他与皇帝和解，1336—1337年被控谋反，但安德洛尼卡三世撤销了指控。他还是颇有造诣的神学家和细密画画家。

en: Didius Julianus (133–193) was a Roman senator from Mediolanum who governed Dalmatia and Germania Inferior, defeated the Chauci and Chatti, and held the consulship in 175. After the Praetorian Guard murdered Pertinax in March 193, Julianus bought the throne at their auction of the empire. His purchase made him deeply unpopular in Rome, and he reduced the silver content of the denarius. His reign, lasting barely nine weeks, was immediately challenged by Pescennius Niger in Syria, Clodius Albinus in Britain and Septimius Severus in Pannonia. Severus marched on Rome, gathering support along the way; abandoned by the guard and the Senate, Julianus was killed in the palace on 2 June 193.
zh: 狄狄乌斯·尤利安努斯（133—193）出身梅迪奥拉努姆的罗马元老家庭，曾治理达尔马提亚和下日耳曼尼亚，击败考基人与查蒂人，并于175年就任执政官。193年3月禁卫军杀害佩蒂纳克斯后，尤利安努斯在禁卫军拍卖帝国的竞价中买下皇位。买官之举令他在罗马极不得人心，他还降低了第纳尔的含银量。他在位仅约九周，随即面临叙利亚的佩森尼乌斯·尼格尔、不列颠的克洛狄乌斯·阿尔比努斯和潘诺尼亚的塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁三方起兵。塞维鲁进军罗马，沿途争取支持；尤利安努斯被禁卫军与元老院抛弃，于193年6月2日在宫中被杀。

en: Diocletian (242/245–311/312), born Diocles to a humble family in Dalmatia, rose as a cavalry officer and was proclaimed emperor after the death of Numerian in 284, defeating his rival Carinus at the Margus in 285. In 286 he made Maximian co-emperor, and in 293 created the Tetrarchy with Galerius and Constantius as Caesars. His reign stabilized the empire after the Crisis of the Third Century; he defeated the Alamanni in 288 and suppressed usurpers in Egypt in 297–298. He reformed taxation and the provinces, issued the Edict on Maximum Prices in 301, and in 303 launched the Great Persecution of Christians. The edict failed to curb inflation and was quickly ignored. In 305 he became the first Roman emperor to abdicate voluntarily, retiring to his palace at Salona, where he died.
zh: 戴克里先（242/245—311/312）出身达尔马提亚的卑微家庭，本名戴克里，由骑兵军官发迹，284年努梅里安死后被军队拥立为帝，285年在马尔古斯河击败竞争者卡里努斯。286年他立马克西米安为共治皇帝，293年又以伽列里乌斯与君士坦提乌斯为凯撒，创立四帝共治制。他的统治使帝国在三世纪危机后趋于稳定；他于288年击败阿勒曼尼人，又在297—298年平定埃及的篡位者。他改革税制与行省制度，301年颁布《最高价格敕令》，303年发动对基督徒的大迫害。敕令未能抑制通胀，很快便无人理会。305年，他成为第一位主动退位的罗马皇帝，退居萨罗纳的宫殿，直至去世。

en: Domitian (AD 51–96), younger son of Vespasian, was the last Flavian Roman emperor, ruling from 81 to 96. Under his father and his brother Titus he held only a ceremonial role until the Praetorian Guard proclaimed him emperor on Titus' death. He revalued the coinage, expanded frontier defences and launched a vast building programme in Rome; his general Agricola campaigned deep into Caledonia, while wars against the Dacian king Decebalus brought no decisive victory. He curtailed the Senate's powers and made himself perpetual censor, seeking to control public and private morals. His autocratic rule alienated the Senate, though he was popular with the people and the army. Assassinated by court officials on 18 September 96, he was succeeded by Nerva, and the Senate condemned his memory.
zh: 图密善（51—96）是韦斯帕西安的幼子、弗拉维王朝末代罗马皇帝，81年至96年在位。父亲与兄长提图斯在位时，他只担任礼仪性职务，提图斯死后由禁卫军拥立为帝。他改革币制、扩建边境防线，在罗马大兴土木；部将阿格里科拉远征喀里多尼亚腹地，对达契亚国王德塞巴鲁斯的战争却未取得决定性胜利。他削弱元老院的权力，自任终身监察官，试图管控公共与私人道德。他的独裁统治激怒了元老院，但受到民众和军队拥护。96年9月18日，他被宫廷官员刺杀，皇位由涅尔瓦继承，元老院随后对他施以记忆抹杀。

en: Irene Angelina was the eldest daughter of Emperor Alexios III Angelos and Euphrosyne Doukaina Kamatera. First married to the droungarios Andronikos Kontostephanos, who died around 1196, she was wed in the summer of 1199 to the sebastokrator Alexios Palaiologos, whom her sonless father made despot and heir. Crowned basilissa, she bore Alexios a daughter, Theodora Angelina Palaiologina, whose marriage to Andronikos Palaiologos in 1216 made her the mother of Michael VIII. Irene outlived her husband, who died in 1203, and ended her life in exile.
zh: 伊琳娜·安杰丽娜是皇帝阿历克塞三世·安杰洛斯与欧芙洛绪涅·杜卡伊娜·卡玛特拉的长女。她先嫁舰队司令安德洛尼卡·孔托斯特法诺斯，丈夫约1196年去世；1199年夏她改嫁至尊者阿历克塞·帕里奥洛格斯，没有子嗣的父皇封他为专制公与皇位继承人，伊琳娜本人则受封皇后。她与阿历克塞生有一女狄奥多拉·安杰丽娜·帕里奥洛吉娜，后者1216年嫁给安德洛尼卡·帕里奥洛格斯，是米哈伊尔八世的母亲。伊琳娜在1203年丧夫，后于流亡中去世，卒年不详。

en: Irene of Montferrat (c. 1274–1317), born Yolande at Casale, was the daughter of William VII, Marquess of Montferrat, and Beatrice of Castile. In 1284 she married Emperor Andronikos II Palaiologos as his second wife and was renamed Eirene, bringing her family's claim to the Kingdom of Thessalonica. When her brother John I died without male heirs in 1305, her son Theodore inherited the Margraviate of Montferrat. She left Constantinople in 1303, kept her own court in Thessalonica, and died of fever at Drama in 1317. Her daughter Simonis married King Stefan Milutin of Serbia.
zh: 蒙费拉托的伊琳娜（约1274—1317）原名约兰达，生于卡萨莱，是蒙费拉托侯爵威廉七世与卡斯蒂利亚的贝亚特丽丝之女。1284年，她作为续弦嫁给安德洛尼卡二世·帕里奥洛格斯皇帝并改名伊琳娜，同时带来家族对塞萨洛尼基王国的宣称权。1305年其弟约翰一世无男性继承人去世后，她的儿子狄奥多尔承袭蒙费拉托侯国。她于1303年离开君士坦丁堡，在塞萨洛尼基自立宫廷，1317年在兹拉马死于热病。女儿西蒙尼达嫁给塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·米卢廷。

en: Irene Doukaina (c. 1066–1138), empress of Alexios I Komnenos, was the daughter of Andronikos Doukas and Maria of Bulgaria. She married Alexios in 1078, and her Doukas kin backed his 1081 seizure of the throne and secured her coronation. Long overshadowed by her mother-in-law Anna Dalassene, she accompanied the emperor on campaign and acted as regent. She pressed Alexios to set aside their son John in favour of Anna Komnene and Nikephoros Bryennios. After Alexios died in 1118 her plot against John II failed, and she ended her life in the nunnery she founded, dying in February 1138.
zh: 伊琳娜·杜卡伊娜（约1066—1138）是阿莱克修斯一世·科穆宁的皇后，安德罗尼科斯·杜卡斯与保加利亚的玛丽亚之女。她于1078年嫁给阿莱克修斯，杜卡斯家族支持他在1081年夺取皇位，并促成她加冕。她长期受婆婆安娜·达拉瑟内压制，曾随皇帝出征，并在君士坦丁堡摄政。她一再劝说阿莱克修斯废黜亲子约翰，改立女儿安娜·科穆宁与女婿尼基弗鲁斯·布里尼奥斯。1118年阿莱克修斯死后，她反对约翰二世的密谋失败，最终在自己创立的凯卡瑞托梅内修女院度过余生，于1138年2月去世。

en: Irene Palaiologina (died after 1356) was the daughter of Despot Demetrios Palaiologos, a son of Emperor Andronikos II, and likely Theodora Komnene. In 1340 she married Matthew Kantakouzenos, eldest son of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos. When Matthew was proclaimed co-emperor in April 1353, Irene became Byzantine empress. In February 1356 she and Matthew were captured by Serbian raiders in Thrace; handed over to John V in December 1357, Matthew was forced to abdicate and Irene lost her title. She and Matthew had at least five children, including Demetrios Kantakouzenos, later briefly ruler of the Morea.
zh: 伊琳娜·巴列奥略娜（1356年后卒）是专制君主德米特里奥斯·巴列奥略之女，祖父为皇帝安德洛尼卡二世，母亲可能是狄奥多拉·科穆宁。1340年，她嫁给皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯的长子马修·坎塔库泽努斯。1353年4月马修被宣布为共治皇帝，伊琳娜随之成为拜占庭皇后。1356年2月，她与马修在色雷斯被塞尔维亚人俘获；1357年12月二人被移交约翰五世，马修被迫退位，伊琳娜也失去皇后头衔。她与马修至少有五个子女，其中季米特里奥斯·坎塔库泽努斯后来曾短暂统治摩里亚。

en: Eirene Komnene Kantakouzene Palaiologina Asanina, born Eirene Synadene, was a Byzantine aristocrat of the fourteenth century, the younger daughter of the megas konostaulos John Synadenos and Thomais Komnene Doukaina Laskarina. By about 1330 she had married Michael Komnenos Tornikes Asanes, a grandson of the Bulgarian tsar Ivan Asen III and later governor of Lesbos. The couple appear together in a miniature in the typikon of the Bebaia Elpis convent, founded by Eirene's grandmother Theodora Synadene. Their children died young. After Michael's death, Eirene commissioned the scholar Nikephoros Gregoras to compose an epitaph in his memory.
zh: 艾琳·科穆宁·坎塔库泽内·巴列奥略吉娜·阿萨尼娜，本姓西纳齐妮，是14世纪的拜占庭贵族女子，为“梅加斯·科诺斯陶洛斯”约翰·西纳齐诺斯与托玛伊斯·科穆宁·杜卡伊娜·拉斯卡里娜的幼女。约1330年，她已嫁给米哈伊尔·科穆宁·托尔尼基斯·阿萨尼斯；后者是保加利亚沙皇伊凡·阿森三世之孙，后来出任莱斯沃斯岛总督。夫妻二人的形象一同出现在艾琳祖母塞奥多拉·西纳齐娜创办的“坚定希望”修道院规章的细密画中。他们的子女均夭折。米哈伊尔死后，艾琳请学者尼基弗罗斯·格列戈拉斯为亡夫撰写了一篇悼诗。

en: Doménikos Theotokópoulos, known as El Greco (1541–1614), was a Greek painter born in Venetian Crete who trained as an icon painter of the Cretan School and was recorded as a master in 1563. Around 1567 he left for Venice, learning from Titian and Tintoretto. He moved to Rome in 1570 and opened a workshop there in 1572. In 1577 he settled in Toledo, where he received major commissions and lived until his death. His best-known works include View of Toledo and the Opening of the Fifth Seal. His flame-like, elongated figures, blending Byzantine tradition with Mannerism, baffled contemporaries but later made him a precursor of Expressionism and Cubism.
zh: 多米尼克·塞奥托科普洛斯，通称埃尔·格列柯（1541—1614），是生于威尼斯治下克里特岛的希腊画家，早年接受克里特画派的圣像画训练，1563年已有文献称他为“师傅”。约1567年他前往威尼斯，学习提香与丁托列托的画风。1570年他迁至罗马，1572年在那里开设画室。1577年他定居西班牙托莱多，接受重要委托，在此终其一生。他最著名的作品包括《托莱多风景》和《揭开第五印》。他画中火焰般拉长的人物融合拜占庭传统与样式主义，令同代人困惑，却在后世被视为表现主义与立体主义的先驱。

en: Elagabalus (c. 204–222), born Varius Avitus Bassianus at Emesa in Syria, was hereditary high priest of the sun god Elagabal before his grandmother Julia Maesa overthrew Macrinus and placed the fourteen-year-old on the throne in 218 through an army revolt. His mother Julia Soaemias supported a rumour that he was the son of the emperor Caracalla. He brought the god's sacred stone to Rome, where he gave pride of place to his Syrian god, paraded the stone and forced officials to take part in eastern rites, and he even married a Vestal Virgin. These scandals alienated the Praetorian Guard and Senate; in March 222 Maesa had him murdered, aged eighteen, and replaced by her other grandson, Severus Alexander.
zh: 埃拉伽巴路斯（约204—222）本名瓦瑞乌斯·阿维图斯·巴西安努斯，生于叙利亚的埃梅萨，原是太阳神埃拉伽巴路斯的世袭大祭司。他的祖母尤利亚·玛伊莎策动军队哗变，于218年推翻马克里努斯，把十四岁的他扶上皇位。他的母亲尤利亚·索艾米亚斯公开支持他是皇帝卡拉卡拉之子的传言。他将神的圣石带到罗马，把所信奉的叙利亚太阳神置于至尊地位，抬着圣石游行，强令官员参加东方祭仪，甚至娶一名维斯塔贞女为妻。这些丑闻激怒了禁卫军和元老院；222年3月，玛伊莎策划阴谋将十八岁的他杀害，改立另一个外孙亚历山大·塞维鲁。

en: Syrgiannes was a Cuman leader, originally named Sytzigan, who was baptized and took the Hellenized name Syrgiannes. Under Emperor Andronikos II he rose to become megas domestikos, the Byzantine army's commander-in-chief. He was the father or possibly grandfather of the general Syrgiannes Palaiologos.
zh: 西尔吉安原名瑟特兹甘，为库曼人首领，受洗后改用希腊化名字西尔吉安。他在安德洛尼卡二世朝升任大统帅，即拜占庭军队最高指挥官；他是将领西尔吉安·帕里奥洛格斯的父亲，也可能是其祖父。

en: Eudokia Angelina (c. 1173–c. 1211) was a daughter of Emperor Alexios III Angelos. Around 1190 she married Stefan, son of Serbian grand župan Stefan Nemanja and ruler of Serbia from 1196, bearing two Serbian kings. Her uncle Isaac II arranged the marriage while her father was in exile. Banished around 1200 over mutual adultery accusations, she found refuge with Stefan's brother Vukan in Zeta and fled via Dyrrachium to Constantinople. There she took Alexios V Doukas as her lover, fled with him on 12 April 1204 and married him at Mosynopolis; her father soon had him blinded, to her fury. She then married Leo Sgouros, lord of Corinth, who killed himself under siege on Acrocorinth in 1207 or 1208.
zh: 欧多基娅·安格利娜（约1173—约1211年）是皇帝阿历克塞三世·安格洛斯之女。约1190年，她嫁给塞尔维亚大茹潘斯特凡·尼曼雅之子斯特凡，后者1196年成为塞尔维亚统治者，她为他生下两位后来的塞尔维亚国王。这桩婚事由她的叔父伊萨克二世安排，当时她的父亲正在流亡。约1200年，夫妻互相指控通奸，她被逐出塞尔维亚，在泽塔得到斯特凡的兄弟武坎庇护，随后经都拉斯回到君士坦丁堡。她在那里与阿历克塞五世·杜卡斯相好，1204年4月12日随他出逃并在莫西诺波利斯成婚，她的父亲不久便将他刺瞎，令她大为愤怒。她随后改嫁科林斯领主利奥·斯古罗斯，后者被围困于科林斯卫城时于1207或1208年自杀。

en: Eudokia Angelina, daughter of John Komnenos Angelos, married John Doukas Vatatzes, sebastokrator and nephew of Emperor John III. Their daughter Theodora, born around 1240, married Michael VIII Palaiologos in 1253. Acropolites records that Eudokia died in the early 1250s.
zh: 欧多基娅·安格利娜是约翰·科穆宁·安格洛斯之女，嫁给至尊者、皇帝约翰三世之侄约翰·杜卡斯·瓦塔采斯。女儿狄奥多拉生于约1240年，1253年嫁给米海尔八世·巴列奥略。阿克罗波利特斯记载，欧多基娅于1250年代初去世。

en: Eudokia Makrembolitissa (born c. 1030) was the daughter of John Makrembolites and niece of Patriarch Michael I Cerularius. She married the future emperor Constantine X Doukas, and when he died in 1067 she took supreme power, appearing with her sons Michael VII and Konstantios on the coinage of 1067. Though she had sworn at Constantine's deathbed not to remarry, she chose the general Romanos IV Diogenes, who was popular with the army, and made him emperor. After Manzikert in 1071 she briefly resumed power before being forced aside by Michael VII. She later retired from court and died sometime after 1081.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/欧多西亚·玛克勒姆玻利提萨
zh: 欧多西亚·玛克勒姆玻利提萨（约1030年生）是约翰·马克伦博利蒂斯之女、牧首米哈伊尔一世·凯鲁拉里奥斯的外甥女。她嫁给后来成为皇帝的君士坦丁十世·杜卡斯；1067年君士坦丁十世死后，她总揽大权，1067年的钱币上铸有她与儿子米哈伊尔七世、孔斯坦提奥斯的形象。她虽曾在君士坦丁临终时发誓不再改嫁，仍选择深受军队拥戴的将领罗曼努斯四世·第欧根尼，嫁给他并立他为帝。1071年曼齐刻尔特战役后，她短暂重掌政权，旋即被米哈伊尔七世逼迫退位，晚年退出宫廷，1081年后去世。

en: Eudokia Palaiologina Tzamplakonissa was a fourteenth-century Byzantine noblewoman, the daughter of Constantine Palaiologos. She married Demetrios Tzamplakon, who held the high military office of megas stratopedarches; the Tzamplakons were landowners around Serres, where Eudokia probably first lived. In 1345 she was with her husband at Serres, and after the city fell to the Serbs she followed him to Chrysoupolis, where Demetrios remained until 1360. In 1362 the couple donated part of an estate near the Gallikos river to Vatopedi monastery; the surviving charter carries her signature as Eudokia Palaiologina Tzamplakonissa.
zh: 欧多基娅·巴列奥略娜·察穆普拉科尼萨是14世纪拜占庭贵妇，君士坦丁·巴列奥略之女。她嫁给官至大军营长官的季米特里奥斯·察穆普拉孔；察穆普拉孔家族是塞雷一带的地主，欧多基娅早年可能住在塞雷。1345年她随丈夫驻留塞雷，城陷于塞尔维亚人后又随他迁往赫里苏波利斯，季米特里奥斯在那里一直住到1360年。1362年，夫妇二人把加利科斯河附近一处庄园的份额捐给瓦托佩迪修道院，保存至今的特许状上留有她的签名——欧多基娅·巴列奥略娜·察穆普拉科尼萨。

en: Eugenia Palaiologina Kantakouzene (1255–1329) was a Byzantine noblewoman of the Palaiologos and Kantakouzenos houses. Her mother Irene Palaiologina was a sister of Emperor Michael VIII, making Eugenia the emperor's niece. She married Syrgiannes, a Cuman chieftain baptized at the Byzantine court who rose to megas domestikos under Andronikos II and governed in Macedonia and Thrace. Their son Syrgiannes Palaiologos became the turncoat general of the Byzantine civil wars of the 1320s and 1330s, while their daughter Theodora married Guy de Lusignan and became queen of Armenian Cilicia. Eugenia ended her life as a nun.
zh: 尤金尼娅·巴列奥略吉娜·坎塔库泽尼（1255—1329）是出身巴列奥略与坎塔库泽努斯两大家族的拜占庭贵族女子。她的母亲伊琳娜·巴列奥略吉娜是皇帝米海尔八世的姐妹，因此尤金尼娅是皇帝的外甥女。她嫁给库曼人首领西尔吉安：此人在拜占庭宫廷受洗，在安德洛尼卡二世麾下升任大统帅，出镇马其顿与色雷斯。其子西尔吉安·巴列奥略是1320至1330年代拜占庭内战中反复倒戈的将领，女儿狄奥多拉嫁给吕西尼昂的居伊，成为奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王后。尤金尼娅晚年出家为修女。

en: Euphrosyne Synadene, in full Euphrosyne Komnene Doukaina Palaiologine, was a fourteenth-century Byzantine noblewoman, daughter of the megas stratopedarches John Synadenos and Theodora Palaiologina, a niece of Michael VIII. Her brother Theodore was a general in the civil wars of the age, but she was pledged to the church from infancy. After her father's death between 1310 and 1328, her mother became a nun under the name Theodoule and founded the Convent of the Theotokos Bebaia Elpis, ‘Certain Hope’, in Constantinople; Euphrosyne took vows with her and became its co-founder. Theodora drew up the convent's first typikon, or rule, between 1327 and 1347. After her death in the second quarter of the century, Euphrosyne wrote a second rule and appended it to the first, largely revising what her mother had set down.
zh: 尤芙洛西妮·西纳德妮，全名尤芙洛西妮·科穆宁内·杜凯娜·巴列奥略吉娜，是14世纪拜占庭贵族女子，大都官约翰·西纳德诺斯与狄奥多拉·巴列奥略吉娜之女，母亲是米海尔八世的侄女。她的兄长狄奥多尔是那个时代内战中的将领，她自己却从襁褓时起就被许给教会。父亲于1310至1328年间去世后，母亲在君士坦丁堡创立天主之母贝瓦亚·埃尔皮斯修道院（意为“可靠的希望”），以狄奥杜蕾之名成为修女；尤芙洛西妮随母出家，成为修道院的共同创立者。狄奥多拉于1327至1347年间编写了修道院的第一部典章。她在14世纪第二个四分之一世纪去世后，尤芙洛西妮撰写第二部典章，附在第一部之后，内容主要是对母亲所写规章的修订。

en: Galerius (c. 258–311), born near Serdica and nicknamed Armentarius, the herdsman, rose through the army and married Diocletian's daughter Valeria. When the Tetrarchy was created in 293 he became Caesar in charge of Illyricum, defeated the Persian king Narseh at Satala in 298, and may have sacked Ctesiphon in 299. He also crossed the Danube to fight the Carpi, defeating them in 297 and 300. After Diocletian's abdication in 305 he ruled as senior Augustus, contending with Constantine and Maxentius and raising Licinius at Carnuntum in 308. A fierce persecutor of Christians, he nonetheless issued the Edict of Serdica in 311 ending the persecution, and died that May at his palace of Felix Romuliana.
zh: 伽列里乌斯（约258—311）出生于塞尔迪卡一带，绰号“牧人”阿门塔里乌斯，行伍出身，娶戴克里先之女瓦莱里娅为妻。293年四帝共治制建立时，他被任命为凯撒，管辖伊利里库姆，298年在萨塔拉击败波斯国王纳塞赫，299年可能劫掠了萨珊都城泰西封。他还渡过多瑙河征讨卡尔皮人，于297年和300年击败他们。305年戴克里先退位后，他以资深奥古斯都执政，与君士坦丁、马克森提乌斯周旋，308年在卡农图姆擢升李锡尼为帝。他虽残酷迫害基督徒，却于311年颁布《塞尔迪卡敕令》终止迫害，同年5月在菲利克斯·罗慕里亚纳宫去世。

en: Gallienus (c. 218–268), son of Valerian, ruled the West as Augustus from 253 while his father held the East. He crushed the usurper Ingenuus around 258–260 and routed the Alemanni near Mediolanum in 259. Valerian's capture at Edessa in 260 made him sole emperor and plunged the empire into civil war. He overthrew the eastern usurpers Macrianus and Aemilianus but could not stop Postumus founding the Gallic Empire; his son Saloninus was killed by Postumus' army. His 260 edict granted Christians their first imperial toleration; he built a cavalry field army and barred senators from military commands. In 268, while besieging the rebel Aureolus at Mediolanum, he was killed in an officers' plot.
zh: 加里恩努斯（约218—268）是瓦勒良之子，253年升为奥古斯都，与父亲分治帝国，负责西方。约258至260年他平定僭帝因格努乌斯，259年在梅蒂奥拉努附近击溃阿勒曼尼人。260年瓦勒良在埃德萨被俘后，他成为唯一的皇帝，帝国陷入内战。他消灭东方的僭帝马克里亚努斯和埃米利亚努斯，却未能阻止波斯图穆斯建立高卢帝国；他的儿子萨洛尼努斯被波斯图穆斯的军队杀害。他260年颁布敕令，首次在帝国境内宽容基督教；又建立以骑兵为核心的机动野战军，并禁止元老担任军职。268年，他在梅蒂奥拉努围攻叛将奥雷奥路斯时，死于一场军官策划的阴谋。

en: Georgios Gemistos Plethon (c. 1355–1454) was among the last great philosophers of Byzantium. Born in Constantinople, he studied there and in the Ottoman capital Adrianople. Before 1410 Emperor Manuel II sent him to Mystra in the Morea, where he taught philosophy, sat as a judge and advised the despot Theodore II. At the Council of Florence in 1438–1439, convened to reconcile the Eastern and Western churches, he lectured on Plato, reintroducing Platonic thought to Western Europe and inspiring Cosimo de' Medici's Platonic Academy. In his Book of Laws, circulated only among close friends, he rejected Christianity for the worship of the classical Hellenic gods. He was later called the last Hellene.
zh: 格弥斯托士·卜列东（约1355—1454）是拜占庭最后几位大哲学家之一。他生于君士坦丁堡，曾在当地和奥斯曼首都阿德里安堡求学。1410年前，曼努埃尔二世皇帝派他前往摩里亚的米斯特拉，在当地讲授哲学、担任法官，并为专制君主狄奥多尔二世出谋划策。1438—1439年，旨在调和东西教会的佛罗伦萨公会议召开期间，他讲授柏拉图，把柏拉图哲学重新引入西欧，启发科西莫·德·美第奇创办了柏拉图学院。在只向密友传阅的《法律篇》中，他摒弃基督教，主张回归对古希腊众神的崇拜。他后来被称为“最后的希腊人”。

en: George Palaiologos (fl. 1078–1110) was a Byzantine general and one of the earliest known members of the Palaiologos family. The son of Nikephoros Palaiologos, he married Anna Doukaina, sister of Alexios I Komnenos's empress Irene. In 1080 he took command of an army in Asia Minor and brought it back in good order after attacks by the Turks. He joined the Komnenian coup only at the last moment: his negotiation of the garrison's defection let Alexios enter Constantinople unopposed on 1 April 1081. He then secured the fleet's allegiance and fought at Dyrrhachium against the Italo-Normans and at Levounion against the Pechenegs. His career is recorded chiefly in Anna Komnene's Alexiad, where he appears as a trusted commander.
zh: 乔治·巴列奥略（活跃于1078—1110年）是拜占庭将领，也是巴列奥略家族最早见诸记载的成员之一。他是尼基弗鲁斯·巴列奥略之子，娶阿历克塞一世·科穆宁的皇后伊琳娜的妹妹安娜·杜卡伊娜为妻。1080年，他在小亚细亚接管一支军队，遭突厥人袭击后率军有序撤退。他在最后一刻才加入科穆宁政变：经他策反城门守军，阿历克塞于1081年4月1日兵不血刃进入君士坦丁堡。此后他争取舰队效忠，又先后在都拉基乌姆迎战意大利诺曼人、在莱沃尼翁迎战佩切涅格人。他的事迹主要见于安娜·科穆宁的《阿历克塞传》，是书中深受倚重的将领。

en: George Palaiologos (c. 1125–1167/68), sebastos and megas hetaireiarches under Manuel I Komnenos, was a diplomat rather than a soldier. Related to the imperial Komnenos family through both parents, he also used its name. In 1162 he went to Hungary to arrange the marriage of Manuel's daughter Maria to Prince Béla and escort him to Constantinople, and in 1167 he led the mission taking Manuel's niece Maria Komnene to Jerusalem to marry King Amalric. He attended the Council of Blachernae in 1166 and founded a lavishly decorated monastery, with portraits of his imperial kin and paintings of Manuel's victories over the Hungarians. Taken ill at Adrianople returning from Hungary, he died in 1167 or 1168; his great-grandson Michael VIII founded the Palaiologan dynasty.
zh: 乔治·巴列奥略（约1125—1167/1168）在曼努埃尔一世·科穆宁朝内拥有“至尊者”头衔并担任近卫军队长“大赫塔里亚尔赫斯”，但主要以外交官身份活动。他的父母双方都与科穆宁皇室有亲缘，他也使用科穆宁之名。1162年他出使匈牙利，安排曼努埃尔之女玛利亚与贝拉王子的婚事，并护送王子前往君士坦丁堡；1167年他又率使团护送曼努埃尔的侄女玛利亚·科穆宁娜前往耶路撒冷，嫁给国王阿马尔里克。他出席了1166年的布拉赫奈会议，还修建了一座装饰华美的修道院，院中有他皇室亲族的肖像和曼努埃尔战胜匈牙利人的画作。他在从匈牙利返程时病倒于阿德里安堡，于1167或1168年去世；其曾孙米海尔八世后来开创了巴列奥略王朝。

en: Publius Septimius Geta (189–211) was the younger son of Septimius Severus and Julia Domna, born at Rome or Mediolanum. Raised to Caesar in 198, he was made Augustus in late 209 and ruled jointly with his father and elder brother Caracalla. During the British campaign, Geta handled administrative duties while Caracalla served as their father's second-in-command. Imperial propaganda presented a harmonious family, but the brothers remained rivals. When Severus died at Eboracum in February 211, the two brothers inherited the empire together, but their bitter rivalry made joint rule unworkable. In December 211 Caracalla had Geta cut down by centurions in their mother's apartments at a staged reconciliation, then imposed damnatio memoriae and purged some twenty thousand of his followers.
zh: 普布利乌斯·塞普提米乌斯·盖塔（189—211）是塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁与尤利亚·多姆娜的幼子，生于罗马或梅蒂奥拉努。他于198年受封凯撒，209年年末成为奥古斯都，与父亲和兄长卡拉卡拉共治。不列颠战役期间，盖塔负责行政事务，卡拉卡拉则担任父亲的副手。帝国宣传塑造了家庭和睦的形象，但兄弟二人仍彼此敌视。211年2月塞维鲁死于艾伯拉肯后，兄弟二人共承帝位，但积怨甚深，共治难以为继。211年12月，卡拉卡拉安排和解会面，让百夫长在母亲的寝宫中将盖塔砍杀，随后对他施以除忆诅咒，并清洗约两万名追随者。

en: Gordian I (c. 158–238) was a Roman senator who had commanded Legio IV Scythica in Syria and governed Roman Britain in 216. He became a consul under Elagabalus and gained popularity for the lavish games he held as aedile. He was serving as proconsul of Africa when landowners at Thysdrus revolted against Maximinus Thrax early in 238. Proclaimed emperor at about eighty, he ruled jointly with his son Gordian II and was recognised by the Senate. Within weeks Capellianus, governor of Numidia, marched on Carthage and killed Gordian II in battle. On hearing the news Gordian I took his own life, after a reign of just twenty-two days.
zh: 戈尔迪安一世（约158—238）是罗马元老，曾在叙利亚统率第四斯基泰军团，216年任罗马不列颠总督。他在埃拉伽巴路斯治下担任执政官，并因担任市政官时举办的盛大竞技会而受到欢迎。238年初他正担任阿非利加总督时，蒂斯德鲁斯的地主起兵反抗马克西米努斯。年约八旬的他被拥立为帝，与儿子戈尔迪安二世共同统治，并得到元老院承认。不出数周，努米底亚总督卡佩利亚努斯进军迦太基，在战斗中杀死戈尔迪安二世。戈尔迪安一世闻讯自尽，在位仅二十二天。

en: Gordian II (c. 192–238), the only known son of Gordian I, briefly ruled with his father during the Year of the Six Emperors. His early offices as quaestor and praetor are recorded only in the unreliable Historia Augusta. In 237 or 238 he accompanied his father, the proconsular governor of Africa, as his legate. In March 238 a provincial revolt against the exactions of Maximinus Thrax brought father and son to the throne; the Senate subsequently recognized them. Gordian II led untrained militia against Capelianus, governor of neighboring Numidia, and was defeated and killed outside Carthage. His reign of about twenty-two days was the shortest recorded of any Roman emperor; his father committed suicide shortly after.
zh: 戈尔迪安二世（约192—238）是戈尔迪安一世唯一为人所知的儿子，曾在六帝之年与父亲短暂共治。他早年担任财务官和裁判官的经历仅见于不可靠的《奥古斯都史》。237或238年，他以副将身份随出任阿非利加总督的父亲赴任。238年3月，行省居民起兵反抗马克西米努斯·色雷克斯的盘剥，拥立戈尔迪安父子为帝，元老院随后予以承认。戈尔迪安二世率未经训练的民兵迎战邻近的努米底亚总督卡佩里亚努斯，在迦太基城外战败身亡。他在位约二十二天，是有记载的罗马皇帝中在位最短的一位，他的父亲不久后也自杀身亡。

en: Gordian III (225–244) was the grandson of Gordian I through his daughter Maecia Faustina and nephew of Gordian II. In 238, after the violent deaths of the two Gordians and of the senatorial emperors Pupienus and Balbinus, the praetorians acclaimed the thirteen-year-old emperor. The government ran through the Senate, and Sabinianus' revolt in Africa was suppressed in 240. From 241 Gordian's praetorian prefect and father-in-law Timesitheus held power. After Shapur I invaded Mesopotamia, Gordian joined the eastern campaign, which defeated the Persians at Resaena in 243. Timesitheus died and Philip the Arab became prefect. Gordian died during the Persian campaign around February 244, possibly at the Battle of Misiche; the circumstances remain disputed. Philip succeeded him.
zh: 戈尔迪安三世（225—244）是戈尔迪安一世之女迈奇娅·福斯蒂娜的儿子，即戈尔迪安二世的外甥。238年，戈尔迪安父子以及元老院拥立的普皮恩努斯、巴尔比努斯先后死于非命，近卫军拥立年仅十三岁的他为帝。朝政由元老院主持，240年阿非利加的萨宾尼亚努斯叛乱被平定。241年起，他的岳父、近卫军长官提梅西图斯掌握实权。沙普尔一世入侵美索不达米亚后，戈尔迪安随军东征，于243年在雷塞纳击败波斯军。提梅西图斯死后，阿拉伯人菲利普出任近卫军长官。约244年2月，戈尔迪安在对波斯的战事中身亡，可能死于米西切战役，具体经过仍有争议；菲利普继位。

en: Gregory Palamas (c. 1296–1359) was a Byzantine monk and theologian. His father, a courtier, died young, and Emperor Andronikos II helped raise the gifted boy in Constantinople, hoping he would enter government service; instead, in 1316, barely twenty-one, Gregory withdrew to Mount Athos. Turkish raids drove him to Thessalonica in 1326, where he was ordained priest. From 1336 he defended Hesychast teaching on the uncreated light and the distinction between God's essence and energies against Barlaam of Calabria, Gregory Akindynos and Nikephoros Gregoras. Patriarch John XIV imprisoned him in 1344. Released in 1347 and made archbishop of Thessalonica, he was refused by the city's people and could take his see only in 1350. In 1354 Turkish pirates captured his ship, and he spent a year at the Ottoman court, where he was well treated, before his ransom was paid. His last words were recorded as “To the heights!”. He died in 1359 and was canonized in 1368.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/格雷格利乌斯·帕拉玛斯
zh: 格里高利·帕拉马斯（约1296—1359）是拜占庭修士、神学家。他的父亲是宫廷侍臣，早逝，皇帝安德洛尼卡二世参与抚养这个天资出众的孩子，希望他从政；但1316年，年仅21岁的格雷格利乌斯却退隐阿索斯山。1326年因土耳其人袭扰，他转往塞萨洛尼基，并在那里受任神父。1336年起，他为静修派关于“非受造之光”以及上帝本质与能量之别的教义辩护，先后同卡拉布里亚人巴拉姆、格列高利·阿金戴诺斯和尼基弗鲁斯·格雷戈拉斯论战。牧首约翰十四世于1344年将他下狱。1347年他获释并出任塞萨洛尼基大主教，当地居民却拒绝接纳他，直到1350年才得以就任。1354年土耳其海盗俘获了他乘坐的船，他在奥斯曼宫廷羁留一年，受到善待，之后赎金付清。史载他的临终之言是“向着高处！”。他于1359年去世，1368年被尊为圣徒。

en: Hadrian (76–138), born at Italica in Hispania, ruled as Roman emperor from 117 to 138, the third of the Five Good Emperors. Succeeding his kinsman Trajan, he abandoned Trajan's conquests in Mesopotamia and Armenia and chose stable, fortified frontiers, visiting nearly every province of the empire. In Britain he built Hadrian's Wall; in Rome he rebuilt the Pantheon and raised the Villa Adriana at Tivoli. A philhellene, he promoted Athens and, after Antinous died in Egypt, spread the youth's cult. He crushed the Bar Kokhba Revolt of 132–135. In 138 he adopted Antoninus Pius on condition that Antoninus adopt Marcus Aurelius and Lucius Verus; Hadrian died that year at Baiae.
zh: 哈德良（76—138）生于西班牙的意大利迦，117—138年为罗马皇帝，是五贤帝中的第三位。他继表亲图拉真之后登基，放弃图拉真在美索不达米亚和亚美尼亚的征服所得，转而经营稳固设防的边界，足迹几乎遍及帝国各行省。他在不列颠修建哈德良长城，在罗马重建万神殿，并在蒂沃利兴建哈德良别墅。他热爱希腊文化、扶持雅典；安提诺乌斯在埃及死后，他为这位青年广立崇拜。他镇压132—135年的巴尔·科赫巴起义。138年他收安敦宁·毕尤为养子，条件是安敦宁再收养马可·奥理略和卢基乌斯·维鲁斯；同年哈德良在巴亚去世。

en: Helena Kantakouzene (1333–1396), a daughter of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos, was the empress of John V Palaiologos. Her marriage in May 1347, when she was about thirteen, sealed the settlement that ended the civil war of 1341–1347 and made her father senior co-emperor over her husband. The peace held until 1352, when she went with John V and their son Manuel to Thrace to take over the cities allotted to him, and war with her father resumed. When her son Andronikos IV deposed John V in 1376, she failed to reconcile them. After John V escaped prison in 1379 she was thought responsible, and Andronikos held her, her aged father and her two sisters hostage at Galata until the treaty of May 1381, enduring strict confinement and a siege. After John V died in 1391 she became the nun Hypomone, and in 1393 she was regent for Manuel II. She died in 1396.
zh: 海伦娜·坎塔库泽努斯（1333—1396）是皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯之女，约翰五世·巴列奥略的皇后。1347年5月，年约13岁的她嫁给约翰五世，这桩婚姻为1341至1347年的内战画上句号，其父得以资深共治皇帝的身份压过她的丈夫。和平维持到1352年，她随约翰五世和儿子曼努埃尔前往色雷斯，接管分配给他的城镇，对她父亲的战事也随之重启。1376年儿子安德洛尼卡四世推翻约翰五世，她调解无果。1379年约翰五世越狱，她被怀疑是主谋，安德洛尼卡便把她、年迈的父亲和两个姐妹扣在加拉塔为质，直到1381年5月双方订约，期间受到严密看管，还经历围城。1391年约翰五世去世后，她出家为尼，改名希波莫尼，1393年曾为曼努埃尔二世摄政。她于1396年去世。

en: Heraclius (c. 575–641) was Byzantine emperor from 610. In 608 he and his father, Heraclius the Elder, exarch of Africa, rebelled against the emperor Phocas, whom Heraclius overthrew and succeeded. After his defeat at Antioch in 613 the Persians seized Syria and Egypt, but he rebuilt the army, advanced deep into Persian territory and crushed them at Nineveh in 627. He devastated Mesopotamia, and after Shah Khosrow II was overthrown, his successor sought peace and agreed to withdraw from the occupied lands. From 636 Arab armies overran Syria, Armenia and Egypt. He promoted monothelitism to heal the Chalcedonian schism and made Greek the empire's official language. He died on 11 February 641.
zh: 希拉克略（约575—641）610年起任拜占庭皇帝。608年，他与任阿非利加总督的父亲老希拉克略起兵反叛皇帝福卡斯，最终推翻福卡斯并取而代之。613年他在安条克战败后，波斯人攻占叙利亚与埃及，但他重建军队，深入波斯境内，于627年在尼尼微大破敌军。他蹂躏美索不达米亚，波斯沙阿霍斯劳二世被推翻后，其继任者求和并同意撤出占领的土地。636年起，阿拉伯军队连陷叙利亚、亚美尼亚与埃及。他推行基督一志论以弥合迦克墩分裂，并将希腊语定为帝国官方语言，641年2月11日去世。

en: Heraklonas (626–642), son of Heraclius and the empress Martina, was briefly Byzantine emperor in 641. His parents' marriage was unpopular because Martina was Heraclius' niece. Made caesar in 632 and crowned co-emperor in 638, he succeeded jointly with his half-brother Constantine III when Heraclius died in February 641. Many objected that Constantine's son Constans had not been elevated alongside them, fearing his exclusion from the succession. Constantine's death in May left Heraklonas sole ruler under Martina's regency. The Arab conquest of Egypt, Martina's monothelite policy and rumours that Constantine had been poisoned turned Constantinople against them. In autumn 641 the general Valentinus deposed Heraklonas, had his nose cut off and exiled him to Rhodes, placing Constans II on the throne. Heraklonas died there in 642.
zh: 赫拉克洛纳斯（626—642）是希拉克略与皇后玛蒂娜之子，641年短暂在位的拜占庭皇帝。玛蒂娜是希拉克略的侄女，父母的婚姻因此不受欢迎。他632年受封凯撒，638年加冕为共治皇帝，641年2月希拉克略去世后与异母兄君士坦丁三世共同继位。许多人反对君士坦丁之子君士坦斯未同时升为皇帝，担心他失去继承权。5月君士坦丁三世去世，赫拉克洛纳斯成为唯一皇帝，由玛蒂娜摄政。阿拉伯人进攻埃及、玛蒂娜推行基督一志论，加上毒杀君士坦丁三世的传言，使君士坦丁堡朝野群起反对。641年秋，将领瓦伦丁努斯废黜赫拉克洛纳斯，割去他的鼻子，将他流放罗得岛，另立君士坦斯二世。赫拉克洛纳斯于642年死于流放地。

en: John Apokaukos (died 1345) was the eldest son of the Byzantine megas doux Alexios Apokaukos, a chief instigator of the civil war of 1341–1347. In 1343 he was named megas primikerios and governor of Thessalonica, although real power in the city rested with the anti-Kantakouzenist Zealot faction. After his father was lynched by political prisoners in Constantinople in June 1345, John switched sides and declared for John VI Kantakouzenos, attempting to seize Thessalonica. The Zealots crushed his coup, and he was captured and executed later that year.
zh: 约翰·阿波考库斯（?—1345）是拜占庭海军大统帅阿历克塞·阿波考库斯的长子，其父是1341至1347年内战的主要挑起者之一。1343年，他被授予大首席官头衔，出任塞萨洛尼基总督，但城中实权掌握在反对坎塔库泽努斯的狂热派手中。1345年6月父亲在君士坦丁堡被政治犯私刑处死后，约翰倒向约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯，试图夺取塞萨洛尼基；狂热派平息了他的政变，他被俘并于同年被处决。

en: John Asanes, elder son of Andronikos Asen and grandson of Tsar Ivan Asen III of Bulgaria, was a Byzantine commander whose grandfather had fled Bulgaria for the empire in 1280. His father governed the Morea from 1316 to 1322 and took Akova and Karytaina from the Franks of Achaea. In 1335 John and his brother Manuel were imprisoned at Vira on a charge of conspiring against Andronikos III, and were released in 1341. Joining their brother-in-law John VI Kantakouzenos in the civil war, John campaigned in the west and was appointed governor of Melenikon in 1341 and of Morrha in 1343. He became sebastokrator in 1347 and despot at Peritheorion in 1355. He married a daughter of Alexios Apokaukos, Kantakouzenos's great rival in the war and the widow of Andronikos Palaiologos. His niece Helena later married John V, and her descendants wore the imperial crown.
zh: 约翰·阿萨尼斯是拜占庭军事将领，安德罗尼科斯·阿森的长子、保加利亚沙皇伊凡·阿森三世之孙，其祖父于1280年自保加利亚逃入帝国。他的父亲1316至1322年治理摩里亚，从亚该亚的法兰克人手中夺取了阿科瓦和卡里泰纳。1335年，约翰与弟弟曼努埃尔被控阴谋反对安德洛尼卡三世，囚于维拉，1341年获释。内战中他投身妹夫约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯一方，随军西征，1341年被任命为梅尔尼克长官，1343年改任莫拉长官。1347年他获授至尊者头衔，1355年在佩里塞奥里昂受封专制公。他娶了阿历克塞·阿波考寇斯之女为妻，阿波考寇斯是坎塔库泽努斯在内战中的大对头；她此前是安德罗尼科斯·巴列奥略的遗孀。他的外甥女海伦娜后来嫁给约翰五世，她的后裔日后成为拜占庭皇帝。

en: John Doukas (c. 1126–c. 1200), eldest son of Constantine Angelos and Alexios I's daughter Theodora Komnene, took his grandmother's surname Doukas. A regiment commander under Manuel I, he fought at Myriokephalon in 1176. In 1185 he backed his nephew Isaac Angelos' revolt against Andronikos I; when Isaac hesitated to take the crown, the elderly John offered his bald head, but the crowd rejected him; Isaac II made him sebastokrator. He led troops against the Vlach-Bulgarian revolt in 1186, but Isaac suspected him of seeking the throne and removed him from command. John took the field again in 1191. His sons by Zoe Doukaina founded the Despotate of Epirus.
zh: 约翰·杜卡斯（约1126—约1200）是君士坦丁·安格洛斯与阿莱克修斯一世之女狄奥多拉·科穆宁娜的长子，随祖母姓杜卡斯。他在曼努埃尔一世麾下任团长，1176年参加密列奥塞法隆战役。1185年他支持侄子伊萨克·安格洛斯起兵反抗安德洛尼卡一世；伊萨克犹豫是否称帝时，年迈的约翰露出光头请求加冕，被民众拒绝，伊萨克二世遂封他为至尊者。1186年他率军征讨瓦拉几亚—保加利亚叛乱，但伊萨克疑心他觊觎皇位，解除了他的指挥权。1191年约翰再次出征。他与佐薇·杜卡伊娜所生的儿子们后来建立了伊庇鲁斯专制国。

en: John Doukas Angelos Palaiologos Raoul Laskaris Tornikes Philanthropenos Asanes was a Byzantine noble child of the fourteenth or fifteenth century who died young. He is known only from his funerary portrait icon, preserved in a monastery in the Peloponnese. His extraordinary string of family names proclaims direct descent from eight of the greatest Byzantine aristocratic houses: the Doukas, Angelos, Palaiologos, Raoul, Laskaris, Tornikes, Philanthropenos and Asen families. The portrait marks him as a kinsman of a Byzantine empress.
zh: 约翰·杜卡斯·安盖洛斯·巴列奥略·拉乌尔·拉斯卡里斯·托尔尼基斯·菲兰斯罗佩诺斯·阿萨尼斯是14或15世纪的拜占庭贵族孩童，幼年夭折。世人仅从保存在伯罗奔尼撒一座修道院里的葬仪肖像知道他。他那一长串罕见的家姓表明，他同时出自杜卡斯、安盖洛斯、巴列奥略、拉乌尔、拉斯卡里斯、托尔尼基斯、菲兰斯罗佩诺斯和阿森八家拜占庭名门。肖像还标明，他是某位拜占庭皇后的亲族。

en: John Doukas (died c. 1088), son of Andronikos Doukas and elder brother of Constantine X, was a general made caesar by his brother. A landowner in Thrace and Bithynia and friend of Psellos, he championed his nephew Michael VII after Constantine's death in 1067 and opposed Romanos IV Diogenes. His intrigues forced him to retire to Bithynia for much of Romanos's reign. Following Manzikert in 1071 he returned to court and, with Psellos, forced the empress Eudokia into a nunnery. He sent his sons to capture Romanos and ordered him blinded, securing Michael's sole rule. The eunuch Nikephoritzes ousted him around 1073, but in 1081 he helped his grandson-in-law Alexios I Komnenos seize the throne.
zh: 约翰·杜卡斯（约1088年卒）是安德罗尼库斯·杜卡斯之子、君士坦丁十世之兄，行伍出身，被弟弟授予凯撒头衔。他在色雷斯和比提尼亚拥有大片地产，与普塞洛斯交好。1067年君士坦丁十世死后，他维护侄子米哈伊尔七世的继承权，与罗曼努斯四世·第欧根尼为敌。他的政治活动使他在罗曼努斯统治的大部分时间里退居比提尼亚。1071年曼齐刻尔特战役后他重返宫廷，与普塞洛斯一起逼迫皇后欧多西亚出家为尼；他又派儿子们擒获罗曼努斯，下令将其刺瞎，保住米哈伊尔的独统地位。约1073年，宦官尼基福里采斯将他排挤下台；1081年，他帮助孙女婿阿莱克修斯一世·科穆宁夺取皇位。

en: John II Komnenos (1087–1143), the Good (Kaloïōannēs), was Byzantine emperor from 1118 to 1143 and the eldest son of Alexios I. Crowned co-emperor in 1092, he married the Hungarian princess Piroska, renamed Irene, in 1104, sealing an alliance that strengthened Byzantium's position in the Balkans. In a quarter-century of sieges and annual campaigns he defeated the Pechenegs, Hungarians and Serbs in the Balkans, allied with the Holy Roman Empire, drove the Turks back across Anatolia from the Maeander to Cilicia, and campaigned in Syria beside unreliable Crusader allies. Preparing another move on Antioch, he died of a hunting wound in Cilicia on 8 April 1143, leaving the throne to his younger son Manuel.
zh: 约翰二世·科穆宁（1087—1143），绰号“好人约翰”（卡洛伊奥安尼斯），1118至1143年任拜占庭皇帝，阿历克塞一世的长子。1092年他被加冕为共治皇帝，1104年娶匈牙利公主皮罗什卡（后改名伊琳娜），这桩婚姻巩固了联盟，加强了拜占庭在巴尔干的地位。在25年的围城与连年征战中，他在巴尔干击败佩切涅格人、匈牙利人和塞尔维亚人，与神圣罗马帝国结盟，把突厥人沿安纳托利亚从门德雷斯河逐回至奇里乞亚，并与反复无常的十字军盟友一同进军叙利亚。1143年4月8日，他正准备再次进攻安条克时，在奇里乞亚因狩猎受伤去世，传位给幼子曼努埃尔。

en: John III Doukas Vatatzes (c. 1192–1254) was born at Didymoteicho, probably the son of the general Basil Vatatzes. Theodore I Laskaris married him to his daughter Irene, and he took the Nicaean throne in December 1221. He defeated rival claimants and their Latin allies at Poimanenon in 1224, seizing Adrianople, but lost it to Theodore Komnenos Doukas in 1227. Allied with Bulgaria, he besieged Latin Constantinople in 1235–1236. He imposed his suzerainty on Thessalonica in 1242 and annexed it and much of Thrace in 1246, encircling the Latin Empire. Interested in collecting and copying manuscripts, he died at Nymphaion on 3 November 1254 and was later venerated as Saint John the Merciful. His son Theodore II succeeded him.
zh: 约翰三世·杜卡斯·瓦塔泽斯（约1192—1254）生于季季莫蒂霍，可能是将领瓦西里·瓦塔泽斯之子。狄奥多尔一世·拉斯卡里斯把女儿艾琳嫁给他，1221年12月他登上尼西亚皇位。1224年他在波伊马农击败争位者及其拉丁帝国援军，夺取阿德里安堡，1227年却被狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯夺走。他与保加利亚结盟，于1235—1236年围攻拉丁人占据的君士坦丁堡。1242年他迫使塞萨洛尼基承认其宗主权，1246年兼并该城和色雷斯大片土地，将拉丁帝国团团包围。他热衷于收藏和抄写手稿，1254年11月3日卒于尼姆法伊翁，后被尊为“仁慈者”圣约翰。其子狄奥多尔二世继位。

en: John IV Laskaris (1250–c. 1305) became emperor of Nicaea in August 1258, aged seven, on the death of his father Theodore II. The regent George Mouzalon was murdered by the nobility, and Michael Palaiologos seized the regency, crowning himself co-emperor as Michael VIII in January 1259. After recovering Constantinople in 1261, Michael left John at Nicaea and on 25 December 1261, the boy's eleventh birthday, had him blinded and imprisoned in Bithynia, where he lived as a monk. In 1290 Andronikos II visited him to seek forgiveness. He died around 1305 and was venerated as a saint.
zh: 约翰四世·拉斯卡里斯（1250—约1305）于1258年8月父亲狄奥多尔二世去世后即位，年仅7岁。摄政乔治·穆扎隆被贵族杀害，米海尔·巴列奥略攫取摄政之位，1259年1月加冕为共治皇帝，即米海尔八世。1261年收复君士坦丁堡后，米海尔把约翰留在尼西亚，并于1261年12月25日、约翰11岁生日当天下令将他刺瞎，囚禁于比提尼亚，他在那里出家为修士。1290年安德洛尼卡二世登门求他宽恕。他约于1305年去世，后被尊为圣人。

en: John Komnenos (c. 1015–1067) was a Byzantine general and the younger brother of Emperor Isaac I Komnenos. A doux at the time of Isaac's 1057 revolt against Michael VI, he was rewarded with the title of kouropalates and the post of Domestic of the Schools of the West. The chronicler Nikephoros Bryennios wrote that John refused the crown when Isaac abdicated in 1059, though this account has been questioned. He withdrew from public life under Constantine X Doukas and died as a monk on 12 July 1067. By his wife Anna Dalassene he was the father of Emperor Alexios I.
zh: 约翰·科穆宁（约1015—1067）是拜占庭将领，皇帝伊萨克一世·科穆宁的弟弟。1057年伊萨克起兵反对米哈伊尔六世时，他正担任督军；兄长获胜后，他受封库罗帕拉特斯头衔，出任西部禁军统帅。尼基弗鲁斯·布吕恩尼奥斯记载，1059年伊萨克退位时皇位曾让给约翰，被他拒绝，但这一说法受到质疑。君士坦丁十世·杜卡斯在位时他退隐政坛，1067年7月12日以僧侣身份去世。他与妻子安娜·达拉瑟娜生下了后来的皇帝阿历克塞一世。

en: John Komnenos Angelos was a Nicaean aristocrat, son of Isaac Komnenos Doukas, who served as megas primikerios and doux of the Thrakesion theme. His daughter Eudokia married John Doukas Vatatzes, nephew of Emperor John III; their daughter Theodora married Michael VIII Palaiologos.
zh: 约翰·科穆宁·安格洛斯是尼西亚贵族，伊萨克·科穆宁·杜卡斯之子，官至首席司仪兼色雷斯西亚总督。其女欧多基娅嫁给约翰三世皇帝之侄约翰·杜卡斯·瓦塔采斯，外孙女狄奥多拉后为米海尔八世·巴列奥略的皇后。

en: John Komnenos Doukas Palaiologos Synadenos was a Byzantine nobleman of the early fourteenth century who held the court rank of megas konostaulos. A son of the megas stratopedarches John Synadenos and Theodora Palaiologina, he commonly used the surname Palaiologos inherited from his mother. He married Thomais Komnene Doukaina Laskarina Kantakouzene, of the Laskaris and Palaiologos lineages, and had two daughters, Anna and Eirene. During the closing stage of the civil war of 1321–1328, he served as an envoy of Andronikos III to the aged Andronikos II.
zh: 约翰·科穆宁·杜卡斯·巴列奥略·西纳齐诺斯是14世纪初的拜占庭贵族，拥有“梅加斯·科诺斯陶洛斯”宫廷头衔。他是“梅加斯·斯特拉托佩达尔赫斯”老约翰·西纳齐诺斯与塞奥多拉·巴列奥略娜之子，常使用从母亲那里继承的“巴列奥略”姓氏。他娶出身拉斯卡里斯与巴列奥略皇室的托玛伊斯·科穆宁·杜卡伊娜·拉斯卡里娜·坎塔库泽内为妻，生有安娜和艾琳两个女儿。1321—1328年内战末期，他作为安德洛尼卡三世的使节，出使年迈的安德洛尼卡二世。

en: John Doukas Vatatzes was a Byzantine aristocrat, son of the sebastokrator Isaac Doukas Vatatzes and nephew of Emperor John III. He married Eudokia Angelina and died young; their daughter Theodora, born c. 1240, married Michael VIII Palaiologos and became Byzantine empress.
zh: 约翰·杜卡斯·瓦塔齐斯是拜占庭贵族，至尊者伊萨克·杜卡斯·瓦塔齐斯之子、尼西亚皇帝约翰三世的侄子。他娶优多基娅·安格琳娜，壮年早逝；其女狄奥多拉约1240年生，后嫁米海尔八世，成为拜占庭皇后。

en: Irene of Athens (c. 752–803) married Leo IV in Constantinople in December 769 and became empress in 775. Though her husband opposed icons, Irene favored their veneration. From 780 she ruled as regent for her son Constantine VI, and in 787 convened the Second Council of Nicaea, which restored icon veneration and ended the first iconoclast period. In 790 a military revolt enabled Constantine to take power; Irene returned as co-ruler in 792 and in 797 had Constantine blinded, ruling alone as empress until 802, when Nikephoros I overthrew her and exiled her to Lesbos. She died there on 9 August 803. Her usurpation helped prompt Charlemagne's coronation as emperor at Rome in 800.
zh: 雅典的伊琳娜（约752—803）769年12月在君士坦丁堡与利奥四世成婚，775年成为皇后。丈夫反对圣像，她却支持圣像崇拜。780年起她为儿子君士坦丁六世摄政，787年召开第二次尼西亚公会议，恢复圣像崇拜，结束了第一阶段的圣像破坏运动。790年军队叛乱使君士坦丁得以掌权；她于792年重新成为共治者，797年命人刺瞎君士坦丁，以女皇身份独掌大权。802年尼基弗鲁斯一世将她推翻、流放至莱斯沃斯岛，她于803年8月9日死在那里。她的篡位也成为800年查理曼在罗马加冕称帝的口实。

en: Irene Asanina (died after 1354), daughter of Andronikos Asen, was the empress of John VI Kantakouzenos and took part in war and diplomacy to a degree uncommon for a Byzantine empress. In the civil war of 1341–1347 she held Didymoteicho while her husband was driven into Serbia. When the Bulgarians she had appealed to moved to take the city for themselves, she wrote to Umur of Smyrna; her brother Manuel carried the letter, and Umur's landing on the Maritsa sent the Bulgarians away. She helped win the Serbs and Turkish beyliks for her husband and helped secure the peace that married her daughter Helena to John V. As empress she organised Constantinople's defence against the Genoese in 1348 and against John V's forces in 1353. When Kantakouzenos abdicated in December 1354 she retired to Hagia Martha convent as the nun Eugenia. In 1356 and 1357 she rejected an offer to free her imprisoned son Matthew and restore him as emperor.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/曼努埃尔·科穆宁·拉乌尔·阿森
zh: 伊琳妮·阿森尼娜（1354年后卒）是安德罗尼科斯·阿森之女，约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯的皇后，参与战事与外交的程度在拜占庭皇后中罕见。1341—1347年内战中，丈夫败退塞尔维亚，她坚守季季莫蒂霍。她求援的保加利亚人转而想占领该城，她便写信给士麦那的乌穆尔，由兄长曼努埃尔送去；乌穆尔的土耳其人在马里查河登陆，保加利亚人随之退去。她还协助争取塞尔维亚人与土耳其诸贝伊国站到丈夫一边，并参与促成把女儿海伦娜嫁给约翰五世的和议。成为皇后之后，她于1348年组织君士坦丁堡防务抵御热那亚人，1353年又抵御约翰五世的军队。1354年12月坎塔库泽努斯退位后，她进入圣玛尔塔修道院出家，法名尤金尼娅。1356和1357年，她拒绝了一项释放被囚的儿子马修并让他复位为皇帝的提议。

en: Irene Angelina was the eldest daughter of the Byzantine emperor Alexios III Angelos and Euphrosyne Doukaina Kamatera. She was already married to the commander Andronikos Kontostephanos when her father seized the throne in 1195. Andronikos retired to a monastery shortly before his death around 1196. In the summer of 1199 Irene married Alexios Palaiologos; her father, who had no sons, raised him to despot and heir and crowned Irene basilissa. Her only daughter, Theodora Angelina Palaiologina, married the grand domestic Andronikos Palaiologos in 1216 and became the mother of Emperor Michael VIII Palaiologos. Irene died in exile after 1203.
zh: 伊琳娜·安杰丽娜是拜占庭皇帝阿历克塞三世·安杰洛斯与欧芙洛绪涅·杜卡伊娜·卡玛特拉的长女。1195年父亲夺取皇位时，她已嫁给将领安德洛尼卡·孔托斯特法诺斯。安德洛尼卡约1196年去世，不久前曾退入修道院。1199年夏伊琳娜改嫁阿历克塞·帕里奥洛格斯；没有儿子的父皇将女婿升为专制公与继承人，并封伊琳娜为皇后。她唯一的女儿狄奥多拉·安杰丽娜·帕里奥洛吉娜1216年嫁给大宫内侯安德洛尼卡·帕里奥洛格斯，即皇帝米哈伊尔八世·帕里奥洛格斯的母亲。1203年后，伊琳娜在流亡中去世。

en: Irene Laskarina (c. 1194–1240) was a daughter of Theodore I Laskaris, founder of the Empire of Nicaea, and Anna Angelina. She was first married to the general Andronikos Palaiologos, and after his death her father wedded her in 1212 to his designated successor, the future John III Vatatzes. She became empress of Nicaea when John succeeded her father in 1221. Their son was Theodore II Laskaris. Badly injured in a fall from a horse after his birth, she could bear no more children, withdrew to a convent under the name Eugenia, and died there in the summer of 1240.
zh: 伊琳妮·拉斯卡丽娜（约1194—1240）是尼西亚帝国缔造者狄奥多尔一世·拉斯卡里斯与安娜·安格琳娜之女。她先嫁给将领安德洛尼卡·巴列奥略，丈夫死后，父亲于1212年将她改嫁指定继承人、后来的约翰三世·瓦塔泽斯。1221年约翰继承她父亲的皇位后，她成为尼西亚皇后。两人之子即狄奥多尔二世·拉斯卡里斯。生下儿子后她坠马重伤，无法再生育，便退隐修道院，取教名尤金妮娅，于1240年夏在院中去世。

en: Isaac Angelos Doukas was a twelfth-century Byzantine nobleman and commander, a son of Constantine Angelos and of Theodora Komnene, daughter of Emperor Alexios I Komnenos. His brother Andronikos fathered Emperor Isaac II Angelos, who as his nephew appointed Isaac strategos of the theme of Cilicia in Asia Minor. A daughter of Isaac married the commander Basil Vatatzes, domestikos of the West. His son Constantine Angelos Doukas became megas doux of the fleet and was blinded after a failed bid for the throne in 1193.
zh: 伊萨克·安杰洛斯·杜卡斯是12世纪的拜占庭贵族与将领，君士坦丁·安格洛斯与阿历克塞一世·科穆宁之女狄奥多拉·科穆宁娜之子。他的兄弟安德洛尼卡是皇帝伊萨克二世·安格洛斯之父；侄子即位后任命他为小亚细亚奇里乞亚军区的督军。他的一个女儿嫁给西方宫内侯瓦西里·瓦塔特泽斯。儿子君士坦丁·安杰洛斯·杜卡斯官至舰队大公，1193年因夺位失败被刺瞎。

en: Isaac I Komnenos (c. 1007–1060), the first Komnenian Byzantine emperor, reigned from 1057 to 1059. Son of the general Manuel Erotikos Komnenos, he was placed in Basil II's care and educated at the Stoudion monastery. He commanded the eastern field army before leading the 1057 revolt against Michael VI, winning the Battle of Hades and forcing Michael's abdication. As emperor he cut salaries and confiscated Church lands to rebuild the army and treasury. These measures provoked opposition, especially from Patriarch Michael Keroularios, whom he exiled in 1058. After campaigning against the Pechenegs in 1059, he fell ill and abdicated in favour of Constantine X Doukas, dying as a monk in 1060.
zh: 伊萨克一世·科穆宁（约1007—1060）是科穆宁王朝第一位拜占庭皇帝，1057至1059年在位。他是将领曼努埃尔·埃罗提科斯·科穆宁之子，由瓦西里二世照管，在斯图狄乌斯修道院受教育。他曾任东方野战军统帅；1057年他领导众将起兵反叛米哈伊尔六世，在哈迪斯之战获胜，迫使米哈伊尔六世退位。即位后他削减俸禄、没收教会地产以充实军队和国库。这些措施引起反对，牧首米哈伊尔·凯鲁拉里奥斯尤为不满，伊萨克于1058年将他放逐。1059年他出征佩切涅格人，随后患病，让位给君士坦丁十世·杜卡斯，出家后于1060年去世。

en: Isaac II Angelos (1156–1204) was Byzantine emperor from 1185 to 1195 and again in 1203–1204. In September 1185 he slew Stephen Hagiochristophorites and took refuge in the Hagia Sophia, sparking the revolt that toppled Andronikos I. In 1186 he married Margaret, daughter of King Béla III of Hungary. His increased taxes provoked a Bulgarian and Vlach revolt, leading to the Second Bulgarian Empire; his reign also saw the loss of Cyprus, defeats at Tryavna in 1190 and Arcadiopolis in 1194, and the Third Crusade's passage. In April 1195 his brother Alexios III blinded and imprisoned him. Restored by the Fourth Crusade in 1203 with his son Alexios IV, he died in January 1204, weeks before the city was sacked.
zh: 伊萨克二世·安格洛斯（1156—1204）两度为拜占庭皇帝，分别在1185—1195年与1203—1204年。1185年9月，他斩杀权臣斯蒂芬·哈吉奥赫里斯托弗里特斯，避难圣索菲亚大教堂，由此引发推翻安德洛尼卡一世的暴动。1186年他迎娶匈牙利国王贝拉三世之女玛尔吉特。他增税激起保加利亚人与瓦拉几亚人起义，促成保加利亚第二帝国建立；他在位期间，塞浦路斯脱离掌控，1190年特里亚夫纳、1194年阿卡迪奥波利斯两度败于保加利亚，第三次十字军又取道其境。1195年4月，其兄阿历克塞三世将他刺瞎囚禁。1203年第四次十字军拥立他与儿子阿历克塞四世复位，他于1204年1月去世，数周后君士坦丁堡即遭洗劫。

en: Isaac Komnenos (1093–after 1152), third son of Emperor Alexios I and Irene Doukaina, was born a porphyrogennetos in Constantinople. He helped his brother John II take the throne in 1118 and became sebastokrator, but conspired against John from 1130 and spent years exiled in Asia Minor and the Levant. Pardoned in 1138, he was exiled again to Heraclea Pontica in 1139 after his son defected to the Seljuk Turks, and in 1143 backed the losing claimant against Manuel I. Forced into retirement in 1150, he founded the Kosmosoteira Monastery in Thrace and wrote its charter in 1152. He also rebuilt the Chora Church in Constantinople and patronized learning; his son Andronikos I later seized the throne.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/伊萨克·科穆宁_(阿莱克修斯一世之子)
zh: 伊萨克·科穆宁（1093—1152年后）是皇帝阿莱克修斯一世与伊琳娜·杜卡伊娜的第三子，生于君士坦丁堡，身为紫衣贵族。1118年他帮助兄长约翰二世夺得皇位，受封至尊者；但1130年起参与反对约翰的阴谋，流亡小亚细亚和黎凡特多年。1138年获赦，1139年因子叛投塞尔柱突厥而再度被流放至赫拉克利亚·庞蒂卡；1143年他在继位之争中支持落败的候选人，与曼努埃尔一世为敌。1150年被迫退隐，在色雷斯修建救世诞神女修道院，并于1152年亲撰院规。他还重修君士坦丁堡的霍拉教堂，资助学术；其子安德洛尼卡一世后来篡夺皇位。

en: Isaac Komnenos Doukas (c. 1155–1203) was the eldest son of the sebastokrator John Doukas and Zoe Doukaina, and an elder brother of Michael I and Theodore Komnenos Doukas, founders of the Epirote state. In September 1185 he joined his father at the Hagia Sophia in backing Isaac II Angelos' uprising against Andronikos I. Around 1187 he married a daughter of the general Alexios Branas, a match arranged shortly before Branas revolted against Isaac II. He was probably killed fighting the Fourth Crusade at Constantinople in 1203.
zh: 伊萨克·科穆宁·杜卡斯（约1155—1203）是至尊者约翰·杜卡斯与佐薇·杜卡伊娜的长子，也是伊庇鲁斯国家缔造者米海尔一世和狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯的长兄。1185年9月，他与父亲在圣索菲亚大教堂支持伊萨克二世·安格洛斯起兵反抗安德洛尼卡一世。约1187年，他娶名将阿莱克修斯·布拉纳斯之女，婚事安排在布拉纳斯反叛伊萨克二世前不久。1203年，他可能在君士坦丁堡抗击第四次十字军的战斗中阵亡。

en: Isaac Doukas Vatatzes (c. 1188–1261) was the elder brother of the Nicaean emperor John III Doukas Vatatzes, probably the eldest son of the general Basil Vatatzes. Little is recorded of his career. He held the high court title of sebastokrator by 1253, and in 1261, as a senior palace official and keeper of the imperial seal, he witnessed the Treaty of Nymphaeum with Genoa. Sent to Genoa to ratify it, he died during the negotiations and was buried in Genoa Cathedral. His son John, who died young, married Eudokia Angelina and fathered Theodora, wife of Michael VIII Palaiologos.
zh: 伊萨基奥斯·杜卡斯·瓦塔泽斯（约1188—1261）是尼西亚皇帝约翰三世·杜卡斯·瓦塔泽斯之兄，一般认为是将领瓦西里·瓦塔泽斯的长子。其生平记载甚少，到1253年已拥有“塞巴斯托克拉托”高级宫廷头衔；1261年，他以宫廷重臣兼御玺掌管者的身份见证了与热那亚签订的《尼姆法伊翁条约》。他奉命赴热那亚批准条约，却在谈判期间去世，葬于热那亚主教座堂。其子约翰早逝，娶优多基娅·安格丽娜，生女狄奥多拉，即米海尔八世·巴列奥略的皇后。

en: Isabelle de Lusignan (born c. 1333) was the daughter of Guy de Lusignan, a prince of the Cypriot Lusignan dynasty at Constantinople, and the Byzantine noblewoman Theodora Syrgiannaina. Her father was crowned king of Armenian Cilicia as Constantine II in 1342 but was murdered at Adana in November 1344 in an anti-Latin rising, while Isabelle stayed at the Byzantine court. In 1349 she married Manuel Kantakouzenos, son of Emperor John VI and despot of the Morea at Mystras, becoming its despoina and holding lands including Aradippou on Cyprus. She died after 1387 and was buried at Mystras.
zh: 伊莎贝尔·德·吕西尼昂（约1333年生）是留居君士坦丁堡的塞浦路斯吕西尼昂家族王公居伊·德·吕西尼昂与拜占庭贵妇狄奥多拉·叙尔吉安奈娜之女。1342年，她的父亲在奇里乞亚亚美尼亚加冕为国王，称康斯坦丁二世，但1344年11月在阿达纳的一场反拉丁人暴动中遇害，伊莎贝尔则留在拜占庭宫廷。1349年，她嫁给皇帝约翰六世之子曼努埃尔·坎塔库泽努斯；后者以米斯特拉斯为治所担任摩里亚专制君主，她遂成为摩里亚专制君主夫人，并领有塞浦路斯的阿拉迪普等地。她于1387年后去世，葬于米斯特拉斯。

en: Ivan Rostyslavych Berladnik (c. 1112–1162) was a Rurikid prince, son of Rostyslav Volodarevych of Peremyshl and grandson of Volodar. He held Zvenyhorod from 1129 and briefly claimed Halych in 1144, when the town's boyars tried to raise him to the throne against Prince Volodymyrko. Defeated, he fled to Berlad, among the Berladnici, from whom he took his nickname. After years at the Kyiv court and renewed wars against Yaroslav Osmomysl, who allied Hungary and Poland against him, he was driven into Byzantine exile and died at Thessaloniki in 1162, reputedly poisoned.
zh: 伊凡·罗斯季斯拉维奇·贝尔拉德尼克（约1112—1162）是留里克王朝王公，普热梅希尔的罗斯季斯拉夫·沃洛达列维奇之子、沃洛达尔之孙。他自1129年起领有兹韦尼哥罗德，1144年加利奇的贵族试图推翻王公弗拉基米尔科、将他拥上王公之位，事败后他逃往贝尔拉德，投奔贝尔拉德尼克流民，绰号即由此而来。他在基辅的宫廷客居多年，后来又与雅罗斯拉夫·奥斯莫梅斯尔交战，后者联合匈牙利与波兰将他逐走，他被迫流亡拜占庭，1162年死于塞萨洛尼基，相传是被毒杀。

en: John I Tzimiskes (c. 925–976) was an Armenian-born Byzantine commander who helped murder his uncle Nikephoros II in 969 and seized the crown. He married Theodora, Constantine VII's daughter, and crushed Bardas Phokas's revolt. In 971 he besieged Sviatoslav of Kiev at Dorostolon for sixty-five days, negotiated the departure of the Rus', and proclaimed Bulgaria annexed. On his return to Constantinople he stripped the captive Bulgarian emperor Boris II of his imperial insignia. In 972–975 he campaigned through Mesopotamia and Syria to the coast, but failed to take Jerusalem. He died on his return in January 976, supposedly poisoned by Basil Lekapenos, and Basil II succeeded him.
zh: 约翰一世·齐米斯西斯（约925—976）是亚美尼亚出身的拜占庭将领，969年参与谋杀舅父尼基弗鲁斯二世后夺取皇位。他迎娶君士坦丁七世之女塞奥多拉，镇压了巴尔达斯·福卡斯的叛乱。971年，他在多罗斯托隆围困基辅大公斯维亚托斯拉夫六十五天，议定罗斯人撤离，并宣布吞并保加利亚。返回君士坦丁堡后，他剥夺了被俘的保加利亚皇帝鲍里斯二世的帝号。972—975年，他转战美索不达米亚和叙利亚，直抵海岸，却未能攻下耶路撒冷。976年1月他在班师途中暴卒，传为巴西尔·利卡潘努斯毒杀，皇位由巴西尔二世继承。

en: John VI Kantakouzenos (1292–1383) was a Byzantine statesman and emperor. The closest friend of Andronikos III, whom he backed against Andronikos II in the civil war of the 1320s, he became grand domestic, chief minister and general, and was entrusted with the empire's administration when Andronikos took sole power in 1328. At Pelekanon in 1329 he covered the retreat after the emperor was wounded. In 1341 he became regent for the nine-year-old John V. While he was away from the capital preparing an army, his court rivals, Anna of Savoy, Patriarch John XIV Kalekas and Alexios Apokaukos, overthrew the regency and imprisoned or exiled his relatives. His army proclaimed him emperor at Didymoteichon on 26 October 1341, and he was crowned in Constantinople in May 1347, ruling until 1354. The civil wars let his former ally Stefan Dušan seize the Balkan provinces, and the Ottoman Turks occupied Gallipoli in 1354. Deposed by John V, he became the monk Joasaph and wrote a major history covering 1320 to 1354. He died at about 91.
zh: 约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯（1292—1383）是拜占庭政治家、皇帝。他是安德洛尼卡三世最亲密的朋友，1320年代祖孙内战中支持安德洛尼卡三世对抗安德洛尼卡二世，后任大将军，成为首席大臣与统兵之将；1328年安德洛尼卡三世独掌大权，将帝国政务托付给他。1329年在佩勒卡农，皇帝负伤后由他掩护撤退。1341年他为年仅九岁的约翰五世摄政。他离开首都筹备军队时，朝中政敌萨伏依的安娜、牧首约翰十四世·卡莱卡斯和阿莱克修斯·阿波考库斯推翻了摄政政府，将他的亲属囚禁或流放。1341年10月26日，他在季季莫蒂霍被军队拥立为帝，1347年5月在君士坦丁堡加冕，在位至1354年。连年内战使昔日盟友斯特凡·杜尚夺取巴尔干诸省，奥斯曼土耳其人也于1354年占领加利波利。他被约翰五世废黜后出家，改名约阿萨夫，写下一部记述1320至1354年的重要史著，享年约91岁。

en: John Koukouzelis Papadopoulos (born c. 1270) was a Byzantine composer, singer and reformer of Byzantine chant, probably born at Dyrrhachium in the late thirteenth century. Educated in the imperial school at Constantinople, he became a principal choir chanter and a favourite of the emperor before withdrawing to the Great Lavra on Mount Athos, where he took the monastic name Ioannikios.
