Celebrated for his voice as Angel-voiced, he composed and annotated chants that shaped later Byzantine music, and the Orthodox Church later honoured him as a saint with feast day on 1 October.
zh: 约翰·库库泽利斯·帕帕佐普洛斯（约1270年生）是拜占庭作曲家、歌唱家与拜占庭圣歌的改革者，可能于13世纪末出生在都拉基乌姆。他在君士坦丁堡的宫廷学校受教育，成为首席唱诗班歌手，深受皇帝宠信，后来退隐阿索斯山的大劳拉修道院，取法号约安尼基奥斯。他以歌喉被誉为“天使之声”，创作并校注的圣歌塑造了后世拜占庭音乐；东正教会后来尊他为圣徒，纪念日为10月1日。

en: John Palaiologos (1286–1307) was a son of Emperor Andronikos II and his second wife, Irene of Montferrat. He was made Despot on 22 May 1295 and in 1303 married Irene Choumnaina, daughter of the scholar-minister Nikephoros Choumnos; the marriage was childless. From 1304 he governed Thessalonica and endowed the Hodegon Monastery. When the March of Montferrat fell vacant in 1305, his mother wanted him to claim it, but Patriarch Athanasius I blocked the plan and his younger brother Theodore went instead. John died in Thessalonica in 1307 and was buried in Constantinople's Pantokrator Monastery in 1321.
zh: 约翰·巴列奥略（1286—1307）是皇帝安德洛尼卡二世与第二任妻子蒙费拉的伊琳娜之子。1295年5月22日他受封专制君主，1303年娶学者重臣尼基弗鲁斯·胡姆诺斯之女伊琳娜·胡姆妮娜，两人无子女。1304年起他出任塞萨洛尼基总督，曾向霍德贡修道院捐赠地产。1305年蒙费拉侯国爵位空缺，其母想让他前往继承，因牧首阿塔纳修斯一世反对而作罢，改由幼弟狄奥多尔前往。1307年他死于塞萨洛尼基，1321年灵柩迁葬君士坦丁堡的潘托克拉托修道院。

en: John V Palaiologos (1332–1391), son of Andronikos III and Anna of Savoy, inherited the Byzantine throne at nine in 1341 and spent a long reign watching the empire slide toward vassalage to the Ottomans. In the regency civil war, Anna pawned the crown jewels to Venice in 1343 for 30,000 ducats. The peace of 1347 made John VI Kantakouzenos senior emperor and gave John his daughter Helena as wife. War resumed in 1352, with John seeking Serbian help against Kantakouzenos's son Matthew and his Ottoman allies, who used the chaos to win their first European territory. John took real power in 1354. Seeking Western help, he became a Catholic in Rome in 1369, but Venice detained him for debt; in 1371 he accepted Sultan Murad I as suzerain. His son Andronikos IV deposed him in 1376 and his grandson John VII in 1390. That year Bayezid I, threatening to blind his hostage son Manuel, made him pull down the Golden Gate he had just strengthened. John died soon after, in February 1391, and Manuel succeeded him.
zh: 约翰五世·巴列奥略（1332—1391）是安德洛尼卡三世与萨伏依的安娜之子，1341年年方九岁继承拜占庭皇位，在漫长的在位期间眼看帝国一步步滑向对奥斯曼人的臣属。摄政内战中，安娜于1343年以3万杜卡特把皇冠珠宝典当给威尼斯。1347年媾和，约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯成为资深皇帝，约翰五世则娶了他的女儿海伦娜。1352年战事再起，约翰五世向塞尔维亚求援，对抗坎塔库泽努斯之子马修及其奥斯曼盟军，奥斯曼人趁乱夺得第一块欧洲领土。1354年他才真正掌权。为争取西方援助，他于1369年在罗马皈依天主教，却因债务被威尼斯扣押；1371年承认苏丹穆拉德一世的宗主权。1376年他被儿子安德洛尼卡四世推翻，1390年又被孙子约翰七世推翻。同年，巴耶济德一世以刺瞎人质曼努埃尔的双眼相威胁，迫使他拆除刚刚加固的金门。不久后的1391年2月他去世，由曼努埃尔继位。

en: John XIV Kalekas (c. 1282–1347), patriarch of Constantinople from 1334, came from a modest Thracian family and had a wife and children before he was ordained. John Kantakouzenos, chief minister of Andronikos III, carried his election as metropolitan of Thessalonica and then patriarch over the resistance of the patriarchal synod. After Andronikos died in June 1341, Kalekas became that patron's enemy: Anna of Savoy, the emperor's widow, made him a regent for the child John V Palaiologos, and with Alexios Apokaukos he led the regency side in the 1341–1347 civil war against Kantakouzenos. He also opposed Hesychasm, and his synod of 1345 excommunicated Gregory Palamas and had him jailed for three years. By then Kantakouzenos, helped by the Ottoman emir Orhan and Apokaukos's murder, had dealt the regency a heavy blow. In February 1347 a synod deposed Kalekas and exiled him to Didymoteicho; days later Kantakouzenos entered Constantinople and confirmed the sentence. Kalekas died on 29 December 1347.
zh: 约翰十四世·卡莱卡斯（约1282—1347）自1334年起任君士坦丁堡牧首，出身色雷斯贫寒家庭，受神职前已娶妻生子。安德洛尼卡三世的首席大臣约翰·坎塔库泽努斯不顾牧首会议的反对，扶他先后当选塞萨洛尼基都主教和牧首。1341年6月安德洛尼卡三世去世，卡莱卡斯成了这位恩主的对手：皇帝的遗孀萨伏依的安娜让他出任年幼的约翰五世·巴列奥略的摄政，他与阿莱克修斯·阿波考科斯在1341至1347年的内战中领导摄政一方对抗坎塔库泽努斯。他同时反对静修派，1345年他主持的宗教会议将格里高利·帕拉马斯革出教会，并关押三年。此时坎塔库泽努斯借助奥斯曼埃米尔奥尔汗的援军，又逢阿波考科斯被杀，已给了摄政一方沉重一击。1347年2月宗教会议废黜卡莱卡斯，将他流放季季莫蒂霍；数日后坎塔库泽努斯进入君士坦丁堡，确认了这一裁决。卡莱卡斯于1347年12月29日去世。

en: Jovian (331–364), born at Singidunum in Moesia Superior, was a senior guard officer on Julian's Persian campaign of 363. After Julian was mortally wounded at Samarra in June, the retreating army proclaimed Jovian emperor. Unable to bridge the Tigris and reach Roman territory, he bought his army's safety by a thirty-year peace with Shapur II that ceded five provinces, the fortress of Nisibis and Roman influence in Armenia. The people of Nisibis had three days to leave before the city was handed over. A Christian, he ended Julian's revival of pagan worship. On his return journey he received petitions from bishops at Edessa. On 17 February 364 he was found dead in his tent at Dadastana, aged thirty-three, after a reign of eight months.
zh: 约维安（331—364）出生于上默西亚的辛吉杜努姆，363年以禁军高级军官的身份参加尤利安的波斯战争。6月尤利安在萨马拉受致命伤后，撤退中的军队拥立约维安为帝。由于无法在底格里斯河上架桥返回罗马领土，他以与沙普尔二世缔结三十年和约、割让五个行省和尼西比斯要塞、放弃罗马在亚美尼亚的影响为代价，换取军队安全撤退。尼西比斯移交前，居民只有三天时间离城。他是基督徒，终止了尤利安复兴异教的政策；返程途中，他在埃德萨接见主教，听取他们的请求。364年2月17日，他被发现死于达达斯塔纳的营帐中，年仅三十三岁，在位八个月。

en: Julian, called the Apostate (331–363), was the last non-Christian Roman emperor and a Greek author. A nephew of Constantine, he survived the 337 massacre in which his father Julius Constantius died; raised Christian, he embraced Neoplatonic paganism. He studied in the Greek-speaking East while living under the close supervision of his cousin Constantius II. Caesar in Gaul from 355, he defeated Germanic raiders across the Rhine, and in 360 his Lutetia troops proclaimed him augustus. When Constantius died in 361 he ruled alone, revived pagan worship and barred Christians from teaching classics. In 363 he invaded Persia and reached Ctesiphon, but supply problems forced his retreat. Mortally wounded at Samarra, he died on 26 June; Jovian succeeded and ceded Nisibis.
zh: 尤利安，世称背教者尤利安（331—363），是罗马帝国最后一位非基督教皇帝，也是一位希腊语著作家。他是君士坦丁大帝的侄子，在337年的屠杀中幸存，生父尤利乌斯·君士坦提乌斯遇害；他自幼受基督教教育，后来却皈依新柏拉图派的异教。他在堂兄君士坦提乌斯二世的严密监视下，于讲希腊语的东方求学。355年他出任高卢凯撒，在莱茵河击败日耳曼入侵者，360年卢泰西亚的军队拥立他为奥古斯都。361年君士坦提乌斯死后他独掌大权，恢复异教崇拜，禁止基督徒讲授古典典籍。363年他远征波斯，兵临泰西封，却因补给困难被迫撤退，在萨迈拉之战中受重伤，6月26日去世；约维安继位并割让尼西比斯。

en: Flavius Julius Constantius (died 337) was a son of Emperor Constantius Chlorus and Flavia Maximiana Theodora, and a younger half-brother of Constantine the Great. Long kept away from court, he was summoned to Constantinople only after the empress Helena's death, and in 335 Constantine made him patricius and consul. By his second wife Basilina he fathered the future emperor Julian, while an earlier son, Gallus, became Caesar under Constantius II. In the purges that followed Constantine's death in 337, Julius Constantius and his eldest son were executed on Constantius II's orders.
zh: 弗拉维乌斯·尤利乌斯·君士坦提乌斯（卒于337年）是皇帝君士坦提乌斯·克洛卢斯与弗拉维娅·马克西米安娜·狄奥多拉之子、君士坦丁大帝的异母弟。他长期被置于宫廷之外，直到皇后海伦娜去世后才应召前往君士坦丁堡，君士坦丁于335年授他贵族衔并任其为执政官。他与继室巴西利娜生下后来的皇帝尤利安，前妻所生的加卢斯则被君士坦提乌斯二世立为恺撒。337年君士坦丁死后的大清洗中，他与长子一同被君士坦提乌斯二世下令处死。

en: Justin I (c. 450–527) was born a peasant in Bederiana near Naissus and reached Constantinople illiterate. He and two companions had fled poverty with little more than a sack of bread. He enlisted in the palace guard, the excubitors, campaigned against Isaurians and Persians, and rose to become their commander under Anastasius I. When Anastasius died in July 518, Justin outmaneuvered his rivals and secured election as emperor. A firm Chalcedonian, he healed the Acacian schism with Rome in 519 and issued edicts against non-Orthodox groups. In his later years his nephew Justinian increasingly directed policy; on 1 April 527 Justin crowned him co-emperor, and when Justin died on 1 August, Justinian succeeded, founding the Justinianic dynasty.
zh: 查士丁一世（约450—527）出身农家，生于纳伊苏斯附近的贝德里亚纳，到君士坦丁堡时目不识丁。他与两名同伴为逃避贫困离乡，随身几乎只有一袋面包。他加入宫廷卫队“执盾军”，参加对伊苏里亚人和波斯人的战争，在阿纳斯塔修斯一世麾下逐步升为卫队统领。518年7月阿纳斯塔修斯去世，查士丁计胜政敌，被拥立为帝。他坚守迦克墩正统，519年结束了与罗马之间的阿卡西乌分裂，并颁布敕令镇压非正统教派。晚年政务多由外甥查士丁尼主持；527年4月1日他立查士丁尼为共治皇帝，8月1日去世，查士丁尼继位，开创查士丁尼王朝。

en: Justin II (c. 520–578), nephew of Justinian I and husband of Sophia, the niece of Empress Theodora, served as curopalates at his uncle's court. He succeeded the childless Justinian in November 565, inheriting an enlarged but overextended empire. He stopped paying subsidies to the Avars and Persians: in 568 the Lombards invaded Italy and overran the Po valley, and in 572 his refusal of tribute to Khosrow I reopened war with Persia; the fall of Dara in 573 helped drive him mad. In 574 he adopted the general Tiberius and named him Caesar, after which Tiberius ruled with Empress Sophia. In 578, in a lucid moment, Justin crowned Tiberius co-emperor and died on 4 October.
zh: 查士丁二世（约520—578）是查士丁尼一世的外甥，娶狄奥多拉皇后的侄女索菲亚为妻，曾在舅父的宫廷中任宫廷总管。565年11月他继承无嗣舅父的皇位，接掌了扩张过度的庞大帝国。他停止向阿瓦尔人和波斯人输送贡金：568年伦巴第人入侵意大利、席卷波河平原；572年他拒绝向霍斯劳一世纳贡，重启对波斯战争，573年达拉陷落更促使他精神失常。574年，他收将领提比略为养子并立为凯撒，此后由提比略与索菲亚皇后共同执政。578年，查士丁在神志清明的片刻立提比略为共治皇帝，随后于10月4日去世。

en: Justinian I (482–565), born a Latin-speaking peasant at Tauresium, Dardania, was adopted by his uncle, the emperor Justin I, whom he succeeded in August 527. He sought to restore the Roman Empire, while also fighting the Sasanian Persians in the east. He survived the Nika riots of 532, and his general Belisarius conquered the Vandal kingdom in North Africa and took Ostrogothic Ravenna in 540. Belisarius, Narses and other generals went on to conquer the Ostrogothic kingdom and recover Italy. His jurist Tribonian compiled the Corpus Juris Civilis, basis of later civil law, while Justinian built the Hagia Sophia, dedicated in 537. His later years were darkened by the plague of 542 and Empress Theodora's death in 548. He died on 14 November 565.
zh: 查士丁尼一世（482—565）是达尔达尼亚的陶雷西乌姆一个拉丁语农家之子，被舅父查士丁一世收养，527年8月继位。他志在恢复罗马帝国，同时在东方与萨珊波斯交战。他挺过了532年的尼卡暴动；麾下将领贝利撒留征服北非的汪达尔王国，540年攻占东哥特都城拉文纳。贝利撒留、纳尔西斯等将领随后征服东哥特王国，收复意大利。法学家特里波尼安在他主持下编成《国法大全》，成为后世民法的基础；他又修建圣索菲亚大教堂，537年落成。晚年帝国遭542年大瘟疫打击，皇后狄奥多拉也于548年去世，他于565年11月14日驾崩。

en: Justinian II (668/669–711), last emperor of the Heraclian dynasty, succeeded his father Constantine IV in 685. In 688 he agreed with Caliph Abd al-Malik to divide the tax revenue of Cyprus. He defeated the Slavs of Macedonia in 688–689 and resettled many in Anatolia, but was later defeated by the Arabs after Slav troops defected. His Quinisext Council of 692 estranged Rome, and in 695 the general Leontius overthrew him, slit his nose and exiled him to Cherson. In 705 he returned with an army from Bulgar khan Tervel, wearing a golden nose, and executed the usurpers Leontius and Tiberius III. His vengeful second reign ended in 711 when a Cherson revolt raised Philippicus; Justinian was beheaded and his young son Tiberius murdered, ending the Heraclian line.
zh: 查士丁尼二世（668/669—711）是希拉克略王朝末代皇帝，685年继承父亲君士坦丁四世的皇位。688年，他与哈里发阿卜杜勒-马利克商定平分塞浦路斯税收。他于688—689年击败马其顿的斯拉夫人，将许多人迁至安纳托利亚，后来却因斯拉夫士兵倒戈而败于阿拉伯人。692年召开的五六会议使罗马离心；695年将领列昂提乌斯将他推翻，割去他的鼻子并流放至赫尔松。705年，他借保加尔汗特尔维尔的军队复位，戴着黄金假鼻处死了列昂提乌斯和提比略三世两位篡位者。711年赫尔松起兵拥立菲利皮科斯，他兵败被杀，幼子提比略一同遇害，希拉克略王朝就此终结。

en: Kalloni (also called Kale), wife of the senator Constantine Palamas at the court of Andronikos II and mother of Gregory Palamas, embraced the monastic life.
zh: 卡洛内（一称卡莱）是安德洛尼卡二世宫廷中的元老院成员君士坦丁·帕拉马斯之妻、格列高利·帕拉马斯之母，她出家修道。

en: Constantine Angelos (c. 1093–after 1166) was a Byzantine noble from Philadelphia who in c. 1122 married Theodora Komnene, a daughter of Emperor Alexios I. Her mother Empress Irene apparently disapproved of their marriage, which raised Constantine to the rank of sebastohypertatos. He became a trusted commander of Manuel I Komnenos: he campaigned in Dalmatia in 1149 and led the fleet against the Sicilians in 1154, but disobeyed orders, lost the battle and was held captive in Palermo until 1158. In 1166 he refortified Zemun, Belgrade and Niš against Hungary and organized the resettlement of Braničevo. Through his sons he founded the Angelos line, which produced the emperors Isaac II and Alexios III.
zh: 君士坦丁·安格洛斯（约1093—1166年后）是出身菲拉德尔菲亚的拜占庭贵族，约1122年迎娶阿莱克修斯一世之女狄奥多拉·科穆宁娜。她的母亲伊琳娜皇后似乎反对这桩婚事，君士坦丁则凭此成为“至尊可敬者”。他成为曼努埃尔一世·科穆宁倚重的将领：1149年随征达尔马提亚，1154年统率舰队迎战西西里人，却因违抗军令大败被俘，囚于巴勒莫直至1158年。1166年他受命加固泽蒙、贝尔格莱德和尼什的城防，遏制匈牙利，并组织重新定居布兰尼切沃。他的子嗣开创安格洛斯家族，伊萨克二世与阿历克塞三世两位皇帝皆为其孙辈。

en: Constantine Palaiologos (c. 1230–1271) was a younger son of the megas domestikos Andronikos Palaiologos and the half-brother of Emperor Michael VIII. After Michael's accession he was made Caesar in 1259 and sebastokrator in 1260. Around 1259 or 1260 he married Irene Komnene Laskarina Branaina, with whom he appears to have had five children. He led the Byzantine army into the Morea against the Latin Principality of Achaea. His campaign ended in defeat at the Battle of Prinitza, and he had left the region before the rout at Makryplagi in 1263 or 1264. He later became a monk under the name Kallinikos and died in 1271.
zh: 君士坦丁·巴列奥略（约1230—1271）是大统帅安德洛尼卡之子、皇帝米海尔八世的异母弟。米海尔即位后，他于1259年受封凯撒，1260年晋封至尊者。约1259或1260年，他娶伊琳娜·科穆宁·拉斯卡里娜·布拉奈娜，似乎与她育有五个子女。他率军进入摩里亚，攻打拉丁人的亚该亚侯国。他的征战以普林尼察之战失利告终；1263或1264年马克里普拉吉之役惨败时，他已离开当地。后来他出家为修士，取教名卡利尼科斯，于1271年去世。

en: Constantine Angelos Palaiologos (born c. 1284) was a Byzantine aristocrat, a son of Despot Demetrios Doukas Komnenos Koutroules, who came from the ruling family of Epirus, and Anna Palaiologina, daughter of Emperor Michael VIII.
zh: 君士坦丁·安格洛斯·巴列奥略（约1284年生）是拜占庭贵族，出身伊庇鲁斯统治家族的专制君主德米特里·库特鲁莱斯与米海尔八世之女安娜的儿子。

en: Constantine Palaiologos Asen was a Byzantine aristocrat and officer, a son of Bulgarian Tsar Ivan Asen III and Irene Palaiologina, probably born in exile in the late thirteenth century. In 1324 he and his brother Andronikos Asen signed Byzantium's treaty with Venice. During the civil war between the two Andronikoi he served Andronikos II as strategos and was captured in the defeat at the River Melas in Thrace in 1328. In 1342, supporting John V Palaiologos, he signed another Venetian treaty but was soon arrested with his son on Alexios Apokaukos' orders and vanished from the sources.
zh: 康斯坦丁·巴列奥略·阿森是拜占庭贵族兼军官，保加利亚沙皇伊凡·阿森三世与拜占庭公主伊琳娜·巴列奥略娜之子，约13世纪后期生于流亡之中。1324年，他与兄弟安德罗尼卡·阿森一同签署帝国与威尼斯的条约。安德罗尼卡二世与安德罗尼卡三世内战期间，他以将军身份效力于老皇帝，1328年在色雷斯梅拉斯河之战惨败后被俘。1342年他支持约翰五世·巴列奥略，签署对威尼斯的新条约，不久便与儿子一同被阿历克塞·阿波考库斯下令逮捕，此后不知所终。

en: Constantine Palaiologos (1261–1306) was the third son of Emperor Michael VIII and Theodora Palaiologina, born in Constantinople just after its recovery from the Latins, a porphyrogennetos or purple-born prince. His father reportedly gave him honours above those of a despot. He married Irene Palaiologina Raoulaina, with whom he had a son, John. In 1280 he fought the Serbs in Macedonia and then campaigned in Asia Minor, clearing Turkish raiders from the Maeander valley, and he rebuilt the Monastery of Stoudios. In 1293 he was slandered to his brother Emperor Andronikos II and imprisoned; he later became a monk named Athanasios. He died in Constantinople on 5 May 1306 and was buried at the Lips Monastery.
zh: 君士坦丁·巴列奥略（1261—1306）是皇帝米海尔八世与狄奥多拉·巴列奥略吉娜的第三子，生于君士坦丁堡从拉丁人手中收复之后，是“生于紫室”的皇子。据称其父给予他的荣誉甚至高于专制君主。他娶伊琳娜·巴列奥略吉娜·拉乌莱娜，育有一子约翰。1280年，他先在马其顿与塞尔维亚人作战，继而转战安纳托利亚，肃清迈安德河谷的土耳其袭扰者，后来还主持重建了斯图狄奥斯修道院。1293年，他遭人向兄长安德洛尼卡二世进谗而被囚禁，之后出家为修士，取教名阿塔纳修斯。1306年5月5日他在君士坦丁堡去世，葬于利普斯修道院。

en: Constantine X Doukas (c. 1006–1067) founded the Doukid dynasty and ruled Byzantium from 1059 to 1067. A scholar-aristocrat connected by marriage to Patriarch Michael Keroularios, he backed Isaac I Komnenos in 1057, later opposed his reforms and succeeded him in 1059 at Psellos's urging. As emperor he favoured bureaucrats over soldiers, cut army funding, disbanded his fifty-thousand-strong Armenian militia and left frontier forts unrepaired. Military aristocrats tried to assassinate him in 1061, while his taxes to pay the army made him unpopular. The Normans under Robert Guiscard took Calabria, Alp Arslan stormed Ani in 1064, the Oghuz raided the Balkans in 1065 and Hungary took Belgrade. He died on 23 May 1067, leaving his widow Eudokia ruling for his young sons.
zh: 君士坦丁十世·杜卡斯（约1006—1067）是杜卡斯王朝的建立者，1059至1067年为拜占庭皇帝。他是学者型贵族，与牧首米哈伊尔·凯鲁拉里奥斯联姻，1057年支持伊萨克一世·科穆宁夺权，后来反对其改革，1059年经普塞洛斯劝说而被指定继位。在位时他重用文官、轻视武将，削减军费，解散五万人的亚美尼亚地方军，又不修缮边境要塞。1061年军方贵族试图刺杀他，而他为支付军费而加税，也失去了民心。罗伯特·吉斯卡尔麾下的诺曼人夺取卡拉布里亚，阿尔普·阿尔斯兰于1064年攻陷阿尼，乌古斯人1065年袭扰巴尔干，匈牙利则占领贝尔格莱德。他于1067年5月23日去世，遗命皇后欧多西亚·玛克勒姆玻利提萨为年幼的儿子们守护皇位。

en: Leo I the Thracian (c. 401–474) was Eastern Roman emperor from 457 to 474. A Thraco-Roman officer placed on the throne by the general Aspar, he gradually shook off his patron. His 457 coronation was the first where the Patriarch of Constantinople crowned the emperor himself. To check Aspar he allied with the Isaurians, marrying his daughter Ariadne to their leader Tarasicodissa, the future Zeno, and in 471 had Aspar and his son Ardabur killed. In 467 he appointed Anthemius emperor in the West. His 468 expedition against the Vandals ended in defeat, draining the empire of men and money. He died in January 474, leaving the throne to his grandson Leo II.
zh: 利奥一世，绰号“色雷斯人”（约401—474），是457年至474年在位的东罗马帝国皇帝。他是色雷斯—罗马血统的军官，被名将阿斯帕尔扶上皇位，却逐渐摆脱了这位靠山。457年的加冕首次由君士坦丁堡牧首亲自为皇帝戴冠。为制衡阿斯帕尔，他与伊苏利亚人结盟，把女儿阿里阿德涅嫁给其首领塔拉西科迪萨，也就是后来的芝诺，并于471年诛杀阿斯帕尔及其子阿尔达布尔。467年他任命安特米乌斯为西罗马皇帝。468年远征汪达尔人的行动以惨败告终，耗费了帝国大量人力和财力。474年1月他去世，皇位传给外孙利奥二世。

en: Leo II (c. 467–474), called the Younger, was Eastern Roman emperor for barely a year, the only son of the Isaurian general Zeno and Ariadne, daughter of Emperor Leo I. On 17 November 473 his grandfather crowned him co-emperor, and on Leo I's death on 18 January 474 the seven-year-old became sole emperor. On 29 January the Byzantine Senate made Zeno co-emperor. Leo II died in November 474, after which Zeno ruled alone.
zh: 利奥二世（约467—474），史称幼者，是在位仅约一年的东罗马幼帝。他是伊苏里亚将领芝诺与皇帝利奥一世之女阿里阿德涅的独子。473年11月17日，外祖父利奥一世立他为共治皇帝；474年1月18日利奥一世病逝，7岁的利奥成为唯一皇帝。1月29日，元老院立芝诺为共治皇帝。利奥二世于474年11月夭折，芝诺随后独掌帝位。

en: Leo III the Isaurian (c. 685–741) was born Konon in Germanikeia, Syria, and rose to command the Anatolic Theme. He allied with Artabasdos, commander of the Armeniac Theme, before forcing Theodosius III to abdicate in March 717, ending the Twenty Years' Anarchy and founding the Isaurian dynasty. In 717–718 he withstood the Umayyad siege of Constantinople; in 719 his government suppressed an attempt by the deposed Anastasius II to regain the throne. His edicts of 726–729 against icon veneration opened the iconoclast controversy and estranged the papacy. He issued the law code Ecloga in 726 and destroyed an Arab army at Akroinon in 740. He died in 741 and was succeeded by his son Constantine V.
zh: 利奥三世（约685—741）生于叙利亚的日耳曼尼基亚，原名科农，后来执掌安纳托利亚军区。他与亚美尼亚军区统帅阿尔塔瓦兹德结盟，717年3月逼迫狄奥多西三世退位，结束二十年混乱，开创伊苏里亚王朝。717—718年他顶住了倭马亚王朝对君士坦丁堡的围攻；719年，他的政府平定了废帝阿纳斯塔修斯二世的复辟企图。他在726—729年颁布反对圣像崇拜的法令，开启圣像破坏之争，并与罗马教廷交恶。他于726年颁布法典《法律选编》，740年在阿克罗伊农歼灭一支阿拉伯军队。741年他去世，儿子君士坦丁五世继位。

en: Leo IV the Khazar (750–780), son of Constantine V by the Khazar princess Tzitzak, was crowned co-emperor in 751 and married Irene of Athens in 769. He succeeded his father in September 775, already suffering from tuberculosis. His illness and the youth of his son gave his half-brothers Nikephoros and Christopher hope of the throne. In 776 he named his young son Constantine VI heir and pardoned his half-brothers after their failed plot, though he exiled other conspirators to Cherson. His armies raided Abbasid Syria and defeated the caliph's forces at Germanikeia in 778, then repelled another invasion in 779. When Leo died on 8 September 780, the nine-year-old Constantine became emperor under the regency of Irene.
zh: 利奥四世（750—780）绰号“可萨人”，是君士坦丁五世与可萨公主齐齐克之子，751年被立为共治皇帝，769年娶雅典的伊琳娜。775年9月他继承父位，当时已患有肺痨。他的病情和儿子的年幼使异母兄弟尼基弗鲁斯和克里斯托弗萌生了夺位的希望。776年，他立幼子君士坦丁六世为继承人，又在二人谋反失败后赦免了他们，但将其他密谋者流放至赫尔松。778年，他的军队攻入阿拔斯王朝治下的叙利亚，在日耳曼尼基亚击败哈里发军队，779年再度击退入侵。780年9月8日利奥去世，年仅九岁的君士坦丁即位，由伊琳娜摄政。

en: Leo V (c. 775–25 December 820), called the Armenian, was a Byzantine general of Armenian descent commanding the Anatolic Theme. After the rout at Versinikia in 813, he forced Emperor Michael I Rangabe to abdicate and took the throne. He endured Krum of Bulgaria's blockade of Constantinople and attempted to kill the khan at a parley. The attempt failed, and Krum ravaged southern Thrace; after Krum's death Leo made a thirty-year peace with his successor Omurtag. In 815 Leo deposed Patriarch Nikephoros and launched the second period of Byzantine iconoclasm. On Christmas Day 820 conspirators serving Michael the Amorian murdered him during the dawn liturgy, and Michael became emperor.
zh: 利奥五世（约775—820年12月25日），人称“亚美尼亚人”，是亚美尼亚血统的拜占庭将领，官至安纳托利亚军区将军。813年韦尔西尼基阿之战溃败后，他逼迫皇帝米海尔一世·兰加贝退位，自立为帝。他顶住保加利亚汗克鲁姆对君士坦丁堡的封锁，并试图在谈判时刺杀克鲁姆。刺杀失败后，克鲁姆劫掠色雷斯南部；克鲁姆死后，利奥与其继承者奥莫尔塔格订立三十年和约。815年，利奥废黜牧首尼基弗鲁斯，发起拜占庭第二波圣像破坏运动。820年圣诞节，效忠阿摩里亚人米海尔的密谋者在黎明礼拜时将他杀害，米海尔随后称帝。

en: Leo VI the Wise (866–912) was Byzantine emperor from 886 to 912. Reputedly Michael III's son by Eudokia Ingerina, Basil I's wife, his paternity was uncertain. His relationship with Basil deteriorated, and an accusation of conspiracy nearly cost him his sight. He completed the Basilika law code and wrote the military treatise Tactica. War with Simeon I of Bulgaria brought defeat at Boulgarophygon in 896 and annual tribute. Leo of Tripoli sacked Thessalonica in 904, and the last Sicilian foothold, Taormina, fell in 902. His four marriages to secure an heir pitted him against Patriarch Nicholas Mystikos, whom he replaced. He died in May 912, leaving young Constantine VII to his brother Alexander.
zh: 利奥六世，绰号“智者”（866—912），886年至912年为拜占庭皇帝。相传他是米海尔三世与巴西尔一世之妻欧多基亚·英格里娜之子，生父是谁始终成谜。他与巴西尔的关系恶化，因被指控参与阴谋而险遭弄瞎。他在位期间完成《巴西利卡法典》，并亲撰军事著作《战术》。与保加利亚的西美昂一世交战，896年在保加罗菲古战败，被迫年年纳贡。的黎波里的利奥于904年洗劫塞萨洛尼基，拜占庭在西西里最后的据点陶尔米纳则于902年失守。他为求得继承人四度娶妻，与牧首尼古拉·米斯蒂科斯对立，后来将其撤换。912年5月他去世，将年幼的君士坦丁七世托付给弟弟亚历山大。

en: Leontius, born in Isauria, was strategos of the Anatolic Theme who campaigned against the Umayyads in Armenia and forced the caliph Abd al-Malik to make peace in 688. He may have fought in the Byzantine defeat at Sebastopolis in 692; Justinian II imprisoned him around that time but released him in 695 to lead the Theme of Hellas. He rebelled at once with wide aristocratic support, seized Constantinople, mutilated and exiled Justinian to Cherson, and ruled as Emperor Leo until 698, when Carthage was lost. An expedition he sent to recover the city failed, and its officers rebelled. Overthrown in 698 by the officer Apsimar (Tiberius III), he was beheaded alongside Tiberius after Justinian II returned to power, on 15 February 706.
zh: 利昂提奥斯出生于伊苏利亚，曾任安纳托利亚军区将军，与倭马亚人在亚美尼亚作战，688年迫使哈里发阿卜杜勒—马利克求和。692年拜占庭在塞巴斯托波利斯战败，他可能参加了此战；查士丁尼二世在前后将他下狱，695年释放他并任命他统领希腊军区。他随即起兵，得到贵族广泛支持，攻占君士坦丁堡，割去查士丁尼的鼻子并将其流放至赫尔松，以“利奥”为帝号统治至698年，任内迦太基失守。他派出的收复迦太基远征军失败，军官随后哗变。698年他被军官阿普西玛尔（即提比略三世）推翻；查士丁尼二世复位后，他与提比略于706年2月15日一同被斩首。

en: Licinius (c. 265–325), born to a Dacian peasant family in Moesia Superior, was a friend of Galerius, who made him Augustus in 308 with charge of the Balkan provinces. He had accompanied Galerius on the Persian expedition of 298 and defeated the Sarmatians in 310. After Galerius died in 311, Licinius and Maximinus Daza divided the eastern provinces between them. In 313 he married Constantine's half-sister Constantia at Milan and jointly issued the Edict of Milan granting toleration to Christians, then defeated his rival Maximinus Daza at Tzirallum and became Augustus of the East. He and Constantine later fell into civil war; he was finally defeated at Chrysopolis in 324, surrendered, and was executed the following year.
zh: 李锡尼（约265—325）出身上默西亚的达契亚农民家庭，是伽列里乌斯的挚友，308年被后者立为奥古斯都，管辖巴尔干诸行省。他曾于298年随伽列里乌斯远征波斯，310年击败萨尔马提亚人。311年伽列里乌斯去世后，李锡尼与马克西米努斯·戴亚瓜分东方诸行省。313年，他在米兰迎娶君士坦丁的异母妹君士坦提娅，共同颁布准许基督徒信仰自由的《米兰敕令》，随即在齐拉鲁姆击败政敌马克西米努斯·戴亚，成为东方奥古斯都。后来他与君士坦丁爆发内战，324年在克里索波利斯战败投降，次年被处死。

en: Lucius Aurelius Verus (130–169) was Roman emperor from 161 until his death, ruling jointly with his adoptive brother Marcus Aurelius—Rome's first two simultaneous emperors. The son of Hadrian's heir Lucius Aelius Caesar, he was adopted by Antoninus Pius in 138. He studied under Fronto, served as quaestor in 153 and became consul in 154, before holding the consulship again with Marcus in 161. He directed the Parthian war of 162–166 in the East, which ended in Roman victory and territorial gains, and wed Marcus' daughter Lucilla. In 168 the Marcomanni crossed the Danube; returning from that front he fell ill and died in early 169, probably of the Antonine Plague. The Senate deified him as Divus Verus.
zh: 卢基乌斯·维鲁斯（130—169）于161年至去世任罗马皇帝，与养兄马可·奥勒留共同主政，是罗马史上第一对同时在位的皇帝。他是哈德良继承人卢基乌斯·埃利乌斯·凯撒之子，138年被安东尼·庇护收养。他师从弗龙托，153年任财务官，154年任执政官，161年又与马可共同担任执政官。他在东方指挥162—166年的帕提亚战争，罗马取胜并取得新领土；他还娶了马可的女儿露西拉。168年马科曼尼人渡过多瑙河，他从前线返回后病倒，于169年初去世，或死于安东尼大瘟疫。元老院将他神化，尊为“神维鲁斯”。

en: Macrinus (c. 165–218), born at Caesarea in Mauretania to a Berber equestrian family, was a lawyer who became praetorian prefect under Caracalla. He had Caracalla stabbed near Carrhae on 8 April 217 and was proclaimed emperor three days later, the first ruler from outside the senatorial class; he never visited Rome during his reign. He ruled jointly with his young son Diadumenianus and made peace with Parthia, Armenia and Dacia, but his fiscal cuts angered the army. In 218 Julia Maesa raised a revolt for her grandson Elagabalus, defeating Macrinus at Antioch on 8 June. Captured at Chalcedon and executed in Cappadocia, he suffered damnatio memoriae by the Senate.
zh: 马克里努斯（约165—218）出生于毛里塔尼亚的凯撒里亚，出身柏柏尔骑士家庭，早年以法律才干入仕，后在卡拉卡拉麾下任禁卫军长官。他于217年4月8日派人在卡雷附近刺死卡拉卡拉，三天后被军队拥立为帝，是第一位非元老院阶层出身的皇帝，在位期间从未到过罗马。他与年幼的儿子狄亚杜门尼安共治，并与帕提亚、亚美尼亚和达契亚议和，但财政紧缩引起军队不满。218年，尤利亚·梅萨为外孙埃拉伽巴路斯发动叛乱，叛军于6月8日在安条克击败马克里努斯。他在卡尔西顿被俘，在卡帕多细亚被处死，随后被元老院处以记录抹杀之刑。

en: Manuel Erotikos Komnenos (c. 955/960–c. 1020) was a Byzantine general under Emperor Basil II and first securely attested ancestor of the Komnenian dynasty. In 978 he led the defence of Nicaea against the rebel Bardas Skleros, bluffing him into letting the starving city withdraw to Constantinople, and in 989 he persuaded the rebel to surrender as imperial envoy. He held the ranks of patrikios and anthypatos and owned estates around Kastamon in Paphlagonia. When he died around 1020 his young sons were entrusted to Basil II; Isaac took the throne in 1057 and John's son became Alexios I.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/曼努埃尔·厄洛提科斯·科穆宁
zh: 曼努埃尔·厄洛提科斯·科穆宁（约955/960—约1020）是巴西尔二世麾下的拜占庭将领，也是科穆宁王朝第一位有可靠记载的先祖。978年，他率军坚守尼西亚，抵御叛将巴尔达斯·斯科莱鲁，用计骗过对方，让断粮的全城军民撤往君士坦丁堡；989年他作为皇帝使节再面见斯科莱鲁，劝其投降。他拥有贵族、执政官等头衔，在帕夫拉戈尼亚的卡斯塔莫努拥有田庄。约1020年去世时，年幼的诸子被托付给巴西尔二世；伊萨克于1057年称帝，约翰之子即阿莱克修斯一世。

en: Manuel I Komnenos (1118–1180), fourth son of John II and Irene of Hungary, was proclaimed emperor in Cilicia in 1143 after his father's death. He led the Komnenian restoration to its height: he managed the passage of the Second Crusade, invaded Norman Italy without lasting success, established a protectorate over the Crusader states of Outremer, entered Antioch in 1159, and defeated Hungary at Sirmium in 1167, extending Byzantine power over the Balkans. He also joined the Kingdom of Jerusalem in an invasion of Fatimid Egypt. In the east his ambitions suffered a serious setback against the Seljuk Turks at Myriokephalon in 1176, though he later concluded peace with Sultan Kilij Arslan II. He died in 1180, succeeded by his young son Alexios II.
zh: 曼努埃尔一世·科穆宁（1118—1180）是约翰二世与匈牙利的伊琳娜的第四子，1143年父亲死后在奇里乞亚被拥立为帝。他将科穆宁复兴推向顶峰：妥善安排第二次十字军过境，出兵诺曼人治下的意大利却未能取得持久成果，在海外建立对十字军国家的保护权，1159年进驻安条克，1167年在锡尔米乌姆击败匈牙利，把拜占庭势力扩展到巴尔干。他还与耶路撒冷王国联合进攻法蒂玛王朝的埃及。1176年他在密列奥塞法隆败于塞尔柱突厥，东方扩张遭受重大挫折，后来又与苏丹基利杰·阿尔斯兰二世议和。他于1180年去世，幼子阿莱克修斯二世继位。

en: Manuel Kantakouzenos (c. 1326–1380) was the second son of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos and Irene Asanina, and the first of the long-ruling despots of the Morea who were close kin of the emperors in Constantinople. His father made him governor of Veria in 1343; when Stefan Dušan took it in 1347, Manuel took refuge in Thessaly. He led Constantinople's defense against the Genoese in 1348–1349, then reached the Morea on 25 October 1349 and crushed the opposition of the local archontes. When John V forced John VI to abdicate, Manuel resisted the emperor's appointees until the new regime recognized him. Peace with his Latin neighbors, an alliance against Murad I's raids in the 1360s, and Albanian settlers for the depopulated land gave the peninsula a long period of prosperity, though an army he led in the mid-1370s, in a dispute over Gardiki, was crushed by Francesco Sansverino. He died at Mistra in 1380, succeeded by his elder brother Matthew.
zh: 曼努埃尔·坎塔库泽努斯（约1326—1380）是皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯与伊琳娜·阿萨妮娜之子中的次子，也是摩里亚历任长期在位的专制君主中的第一位，这些专制君主都是君士坦丁堡皇室的近亲。1343年父亲任命他为维里亚总督；1347年斯特凡·杜尚夺取该城后，他避往色萨利。他在1348至1349年指挥君士坦丁堡抵御热那亚人，随后于1349年10月25日抵达摩里亚，镇压了反叛的当地显贵。约翰五世迫使约翰六世退位后，曼努埃尔抵制皇帝派来的接任者，直到新政权承认他的地位。他与拉丁邻邦保持和平，1360年代又与对方结盟抵御穆拉德一世的袭掠，并引入阿尔巴尼亚人定居荒芜的土地，使伯罗奔尼撒长期繁荣；不过1370年代中期，他因加尔迪基之争率领的一支军队被弗朗切斯科·桑塞韦里诺击溃。1380年他在米斯特拉斯去世，由其兄马修继任。

en: Manuel Komnenos (1145–after 1185), eldest son of Andronikos I, was the ancestor of the Grand Komnenoi of Trebizond. Under his uncle Manuel I he served as envoy to the Russian principalities and Jerusalem, and in 1164 helped his imprisoned father escape from Constantinople. Jailed for opposing the regent Maria of Antioch, he was freed in April 1182 as his father prepared to seize power. He condemned Andronikos' persecution of the aristocracy and refused to oversee Maria's execution. Passed over for the succession, he was made sebastokrator while his younger brother John became co-emperor. In 1185 Isaac II Angelos had him blinded; his sons Alexios and David founded the Empire of Trebizond in 1204.
zh: 曼努埃尔·科穆宁（1145—1185年后）是安德洛尼卡一世的长子，特拉布宗大帝科穆宁王朝的先祖。他在叔父曼努埃尔一世麾下出使罗斯诸公国和耶路撒冷，1164年帮助被囚禁的父亲逃出君士坦丁堡。他因反对摄政安条克的玛丽而入狱，1182年4月父亲准备夺权时获释。他谴责父亲迫害贵族，并拒绝监督处决玛丽。他被剥夺继位资格，受封至尊者，其弟约翰则成为共治皇帝。1185年伊萨克二世·安格洛斯将他刺瞎；其子阿莱克修斯与大卫于1204年建立特拉布宗帝国。

en: Manuel Apokaukos was a Byzantine official, a son of the megas doux Alexios Apokaukos, the regency's chief minister during the civil war of 1341–1347. After Adrianople declared for the regency in 1341, his father sent him to govern the city. When John Kantakouzenos captured Adrianople, Manuel took refuge in the nearby fortress of Boukelo. After Alexios retook the city, Manuel defected to Kantakouzenos in 1344, although the townspeople refused to follow him.
zh: 曼努埃尔·阿波考库斯是14世纪拜占庭官员，海军大统帅阿历克塞·阿波考库斯之子，其父在1341至1347年内战中担任摄政派的首席大臣。1341年阿德里安堡宣布归附摄政派后，父亲派他出掌该城。约翰·坎塔库泽努斯攻占阿德里安堡时，曼努埃尔逃入附近的布凯洛斯要塞；父亲收复该城后，他却于1344年投奔坎塔库泽努斯，而城中居民不肯追随。

en: Manuel Komnenos Raoul Asanes (born c. 1298), second son of Andronikos Asen and grandson of Ivan Asen III, was a Byzantine general and John VI Kantakouzenos's brother-in-law. In 1329 Andronikos III entrusted the imperial standard to him at Pelekanos, and in 1332 at Rusokastro he commanded the imperial detachment. Accused of plotting against the emperor in 1335, he was held at Vira until 1341. In the civil war Kantakouzenos left him commanding Didymoteicho in 1342 and marched west, only to be driven into Serbia. When the Bulgarians who came to help turned out to want the city for themselves, Manuel carried his sister Irene's letter to Umur at Smyrna; Umur's Turks landed on the Maritsa and the Bulgarians withdrew. From 1344 he governed Bizye. Kantakouzenos made him sebastokrator in 1347 and despot in 1351, when he led the army and navy with the Venetians against Genoese Galata. In 1356 he backed his nephew Matthew Kantakouzenos against John V.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/曼努埃尔·科穆宁·拉乌尔·阿森
zh: 曼努埃尔·科穆宁·拉乌尔·阿森（约1298年生）是安德罗尼科斯·阿森的次子、伊凡·阿森三世之孙，拜占庭将领，也是约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯的大舅子。1329年佩勒卡农战役中，安德洛尼卡三世把皇家军旗交给他；1332年鲁斯卡斯特罗战役中，他统领皇家分队。1335年他被控阴谋反对皇帝，囚于维拉直到1341年。内战中，坎塔库泽努斯1342年留他统率季季莫蒂霍守军，自己西征，结果兵败退入塞尔维亚。前来相助的保加利亚人竟想夺取该城，曼努埃尔便带着妹妹伊琳妮的求援信去士麦那见乌穆尔；乌穆尔的土耳其人在马里查河登陆，保加利亚人撤走。1344年起他任比兹耶长官。坎塔库泽努斯于1347年封他为至尊者，1351年升为专制公；同年他率领陆军和海军，联合威尼斯人进攻热那亚人的加拉塔。1356年，他支持外甥马修·坎塔库泽努斯对抗约翰五世。

en: Manuel Palaiologos (1297–1320) was a Byzantine prince and despot, the younger son of co-emperor Michael IX Palaiologos and Rita of Armenia, and grandson of Andronikos II. In 1320, during an affair of his elder brother Andronikos with a woman of humble birth, Manuel went to her house at night; the brother's retainers, mistaking him for a rival in the dark, killed him on 1 October 1320. His father Michael IX died of grief only days later, and the murder helped drive the rift that ignited the civil war between Andronikos II and Andronikos III.
zh: 曼努埃尔·巴列奥略（1297—1320）是拜占庭皇子、专制公，共治皇帝米海尔九世·巴列奥略与亚美尼亚的里塔的幼子，安德洛尼卡二世之孙。1320年，其兄安德洛尼卡与一名出身低微的女子私通；某夜曼努埃尔前往该女住处，兄长的扈从在黑暗中把他误认为情敌，于10月1日将他杀害。父亲米海尔九世悲痛过度，几天后便去世；这桩误杀也激化了皇室裂痕，成为安德洛尼卡二世与安德洛尼卡三世祖孙内战的诱因之一。

en: Marcian (c. 392–457) was Eastern Roman emperor from 450 to 457. A Thracian or Illyrian soldier who served the general Aspar for fifteen years, he was captured by the Vandals while campaigning in North Africa. He took the throne after Theodosius II died, legitimised by marrying the late emperor's sister Pulcheria. He ended the tribute paid to Attila and in 452 sent armies across the Danube into the Huns' lands. After Attila died, he settled Germanic tribes in imperial territory as military allies. In 451 he convened the Council of Chalcedon, whose teaching on Christ's two natures alienated Syria and Egypt. He died in January 457 leaving a treasury surplus of seven million solidi; Aspar then secured the crown for Leo I.
zh: 马尔西安（约392—457）是450年至457年在位的东罗马帝国皇帝。他出身色雷斯或伊利里亚，在名将阿斯帕尔帐下效力十五年，曾在北非征战时被汪达尔人俘虏。狄奥多西二世去世后他被扶上皇位，并娶皇帝之姊普尔喀丽娅以正名分。他停止向阿提拉纳贡，452年派兵渡过多瑙河攻入匈人腹地。阿提拉死后，他将日耳曼部族安置在帝国境内作为军事盟友。451年他召开迦克墩公会议，会议关于基督二性的主张激怒了叙利亚和埃及的信徒。457年1月他去世时，国库盈余达七百万索利都斯金币，阿斯帕尔随后把皇冠交给了利奥一世。

en: Marcus Aurelius (121–180) ruled the Roman Empire from 161 until his death, the last of the Five Good Emperors. In 138 Hadrian chose his uncle Antoninus Pius as heir, and Antoninus adopted Marcus and Lucius Verus. Marcus studied Greek and Latin under tutors including Herodes Atticus and Fronto. He married Pius' daughter Faustina in 145 and succeeded in 161, raising his adoptive brother Lucius Verus as co-emperor. His reign brought the Parthian war in the East, the Marcomannic wars against the Marcomanni, Quadi and Iazyges, and the Antonine Plague that killed millions after 165. He wrote his Stoic Meditations on campaign. He died in 180 and was succeeded by his son Commodus.
zh: 马可·奥勒留（121—180）于161年至去世统治罗马帝国，是“五贤帝”中的最后一位。138年，哈德良选定他的舅父安东尼·庇护为继承人，安东尼收养了马可和卢基乌斯·维鲁斯。马可师从希罗德·阿提库斯、弗龙托等人学习希腊文和拉丁文。他145年娶庇护之女福斯蒂娜，161年继位，并立养弟卢基乌斯·维鲁斯为共治皇帝。他在位时，东方有帕提亚战争，北方有与马科曼尼人、夸迪人、雅兹吉斯人交战的马科曼尼战争，165年后又暴发安东尼大瘟疫，死者数以百万计。他在军旅中写下斯多葛派哲学著作《沉思录》，180年去世后由儿子康茂德继位。

en: Maria Doukaina Komnene Branaina Palaiologina was a Byzantine noblewoman of Palaiologan Constantinople and the wife of the general Michael Doukas Glabas Tarchaneiotes, who rose to the rank of protostrator under Michael VIII and Andronikos II. Together the couple restored the monastery church of the Pammakaristos, which they handed over to Patriarch John XII in 1293. After Glabas died around 1305 to 1308, Maria became a nun under the name Martha and buried him in its side chapel. A probable daughter, Theodote, married the general Chandrenos.
zh: 玛丽亚·杜卡伊娜·科姆内纳·布拉奈纳·巴列奥洛吉娜是巴列奥略朝君士坦丁堡的贵族女性，嫁给了在米哈伊尔八世和安德洛尼卡二世两朝累官至首席马夫的名将米哈伊尔·杜卡斯·格拉巴斯·塔卡尼奥特斯。夫妇二人共同修复了帕马卡里斯托斯修道院教堂，并于1293年将其移交牧首约翰十二世。约1305至1308年格拉巴斯去世后，玛丽亚出家为尼，取修道名玛尔莎，并将丈夫安葬在教堂的侧礼拜堂中。她可能还有一女名叫狄奥多忒，嫁给了将军汉兹雷诺斯。

en: Maria Kantakouzene (born c. 1329) was probably the eldest daughter of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos and Irene Asanina. In 1340 she was betrothed to Nikephoros II Orsini, the deposed ruler of Epirus, and she married him around 1342, amid the civil war that would make her father emperor. From 1351 the couple governed Ainos. When Nikephoros sailed for Thessaly in 1356, Maria held Ainos and refused to surrender its fortress to the rebellious naval commander Libidarios, who had to make terms. Later Nikephoros, urged to cast her off for a Serbian marriage, put her under guard at Arta. She escaped on a ship sent by her brother Manuel, helped by Acarnanians and Albanians among whom she was popular, and the Albanians rose against Nikephoros until he broke with the Serbs and recalled her. Before she returned he fell fighting them at the Achelous in 1359. She ended her life as a nun in Constantinople.
zh: 玛丽亚·坎塔库泽努斯（约1329年生）是皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯与伊琳娜·阿萨妮娜之女，可能是长女。1340年，她与被废黜的伊庇鲁斯君主尼基弗鲁斯二世·奥尔西尼订婚，约1342年，在那场将使她父亲称帝的内战中成婚。1351年起夫妇二人治理埃诺斯。1356年尼基弗鲁斯乘船前往色萨利，玛丽亚留守埃诺斯，拒绝向叛乱的舰队指挥官利比达里奥斯交出城堡，迫使对方谈判让步。后来，尼基弗鲁斯受人怂恿，想抛弃她另娶塞尔维亚人，将她软禁在阿尔塔。她在阿卡纳尼亚人和阿尔巴尼亚人（她在后者中很得人心）的帮助下，乘兄弟曼努埃尔派来的船逃走；阿尔巴尼亚人起而反抗尼基弗鲁斯，迫使他与塞尔维亚人断绝关系，召她回来。她尚未返回，他便于1359年在阿刻罗俄斯河与阿尔巴尼亚人作战阵亡。她最终在君士坦丁堡出家为尼。

en: Maria of Alania (1053–1118), born Martha, was daughter of the Georgian king Bagrat IV and the only foreign-born Byzantine empress of the eleventh century. Sent to Constantinople as a hostage in 1056, she returned to Georgia after Empress Theodora died that year. She married Michael VII Doukas in 1065 and became empress in 1071. When Michael was overthrown in 1078 she married his successor, Nikephoros III Botaneiates. She backed Alexios I Komnenos's coup of 1081, and her son, the co-emperor Constantine Doukas, was betrothed to Alexios's daughter Anna. After Constantine lost his place as heir in 1087, Maria was forced into a monastery; she later held court at Mangana and patronised Theophylact of Ohrid. Constantine died in 1096 and Maria in 1118.
zh: 阿兰的玛丽亚（1053—1118）原名玛尔塔，是格鲁吉亚国王巴格拉特四世之女，也是11世纪唯一一位外国出身的拜占庭皇后。1056年她被作为人质送往君士坦丁堡，同年狄奥多拉女皇去世后返回格鲁吉亚。她于1065年嫁给米哈伊尔七世·杜卡斯，1071年成为皇后。1078年米哈伊尔被废后，她改嫁继位者尼基弗鲁斯三世·沃塔尼亚蒂斯。她支持阿莱克修斯一世·科穆宁1081年的政变；她的儿子、共治皇帝君士坦丁·杜卡斯与阿莱克修斯之女安娜订婚。1087年君士坦丁失去继承人地位后，玛丽亚被迫退入修道院；后来她在芒加纳另立宫廷，庇护奥赫里德的狄奥菲拉克特。君士坦丁于1096年去世，玛丽亚于1118年去世。

en: Matthew Asen Kantakouzenos (c. 1325–June 1383) was the son of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos and Irene Asanina. In 1347 his father gave him a Thracian appanage for his support against John V, and in 1353 he was proclaimed co-emperor as civil war broke out again. From Thrace he warred repeatedly on the Serbs, but in late 1356 or early 1357 he was defeated and captured by Vojvoda Vojihna; John V ransomed him, held him on Tenedos and Lesbos, and forced him to renounce the throne. In 1361 he retired to the Morea, ruling it briefly as despot after his brother Manuel's death in 1380.
zh: 马修·阿森·坎塔库泽努斯（约1325—1383年6月）是皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯与伊琳妮·阿森尼娜之子。1347年，因在内战中支持父亲对抗约翰五世，他受封色雷斯为领地；1353年内战再度爆发，他被拥立为共治皇帝。他从色雷斯屡次进攻塞尔维亚人，却在1356年底或1357年初被督军沃伊赫纳击败俘获；约翰五世出钱把他赎走，先后囚禁于忒涅多斯岛和莱斯沃斯岛，逼迫他放弃帝号。1361年他退居摩里亚，1380年其弟曼努埃尔去世后，以专制公身份短暂统治摩里亚。

en: Matthew Blastares (c. 1290–c. 1360) was a Byzantine Greek hieromonk and canonist active in Thessalonica. In 1335 he compiled his best-known work, the Syntagma kata stoicheion, an alphabetically ordered collection of church canons and imperial laws that circulated widely across the Orthodox world. A scholar of the Monastery of Kyr Isaac, he opposed any doctrinal reconciliation with Rome, and he died in Thessalonica after 1346.
zh: 马太·布拉斯塔雷斯（约1290—约1360）是拜占庭希腊裔修士兼教会法学家，主要活动于塞萨洛尼基。1335年，他编成最负盛名的著作《按字母排列的教会法汇编》，按字母顺序汇辑教会法规与帝国法律，在整个东正教世界广泛流传。他在基尔·伊萨克修道院治学，反对与罗马教会在教义上和解，于1346年后在塞萨洛尼基去世。

en: Maurice (539–602), born at Arabissus in Cappadocia, was Eastern Roman emperor from 582 and the last ruler of the Justinian dynasty. A successful general under Tiberius II, who made him his heir and son-in-law, he brought the long war with Sasanian Persia to a victorious close, expanding the eastern frontier in the South Caucasus. By 599 he had driven the Avars back across the Danube, campaigning beyond it himself. He founded the Exarchates of Italy in 584 and Africa in 591. His unpopular efforts to remedy financial difficulties alienated soldiers and civilians. In 602 a mutiny led by the officer Phocas overthrew him; Maurice and his six sons were executed. The military manual Strategikon is attributed to him.
zh: 莫里斯（539—602）生于卡帕多西亚的阿拉比苏斯，582年登基为东罗马皇帝，是查士丁尼王朝末代君主。他本是提比略二世麾下名将，被后者选为继承人并招为女婿；即位后赢得了与萨珊波斯的长期战争，扩大了帝国在南高加索的东部边界。到599年，他将阿瓦尔人逐回多瑙河以北，并亲自渡河北伐。他于584年和591年先后设立意大利总督区与阿非利加总督区。他为解决财政困难采取的措施不得人心，使军民离心。602年，军官福卡斯率众哗变推翻了他，莫里斯与六个儿子一同被处死。兵书《战略论》相传出自他之手。

en: Maximinus Thrax (c. 173–238) was a Thracian-born Roman commander of Legio IV Italica under Severus Alexander. After the army murdered Alexander in 235, the Pannonian legions made Maximinus emperor, the first non-senatorial, non-equestrian emperor; his accession opens the Crisis of the Third Century. He defeated the Alemanni across the Rhine, took the title Germanicus Maximus and raised his son Maximus to Caesar, then fought Dacians and Sarmatians from Sirmium. In 238 the African revolt of the Gordians and the senatorial emperors Pupienus and Balbinus turned Rome against him. He marched on Rome, but his siege of Aquileia stalled, and in May or June 238 his own soldiers killed him with his son Maximus.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/馬克西米努斯·色雷克斯
zh: 马克西米努斯·色雷克斯（约173—238）是色雷斯出身的罗马军人，在塞维鲁·亚历山大麾下升任第四意大利军团统帅。235年军队杀害亚历山大后，潘诺尼亚军团拥立马克西米努斯为帝，使他成为第一位非元老院、非骑士阶层出身的皇帝；他的登基标志着三世纪危机的开始。他在莱茵河彼岸击败阿勒曼尼人，获称“伟大的日耳曼征服者”，并立儿子马克西姆斯为凯撒，随后以西尔米乌姆为基地征伐达契亚人与萨尔马提亚人。238年，戈尔迪安父子在阿非利加起兵，普皮恩努斯与巴尔比努斯又被元老院立为皇帝，罗马群起反对他。他向罗马进军，却围攻阿奎莱亚不下，238年五六月间被自己的士兵所杀，其子马克西姆斯同时遇害。

en: Michael Doukas Glabas Tarchaneiotes (c. 1235–1308) was a leading Byzantine general under Michael VIII and Andronikos II. In 1263 he defeated the Bulgarians in Thrace and took several Black Sea fortresses, and in 1279 he captured Tarnovo, the Bulgarian capital, backing Ivan Asen III's claim. From 1284 to 1291 he recovered Dyrrhachion, Kruja and Kanina in Albania from the Angevins. Unable to overcome Serbian guerrilla tactics, he advised peace, leading to the 1299 treaty sealed by Simonida's marriage to Stefan Uroš II. He was promoted protostrator between 1297 and 1304. In 1304 he retook Mesembria from the Bulgarians but fell ill and returned to Constantinople. He restored the Pammakaristos Church, where he was buried.
zh: 米哈伊尔·杜卡斯·格拉瓦斯·塔恰尼奥提斯（约1235—1308）是米哈伊尔八世与安德洛尼卡二世两朝的拜占庭名将。1263年他在色雷斯击败保加利亚人，连克黑海沿岸多座堡垒；1279年他扶持伊凡·阿森三世争夺王位，攻占保加利亚首都特尔诺沃。1284至1291年间，他从安茹家族手中收复阿尔巴尼亚的都拉佐、克鲁亚与卡尼纳。他对塞尔维亚作战时受游击战术所阻，建议议和，促成1299年的和约，以西莫妮达嫁给斯特凡·乌罗什二世联姻修好。他在1297至1304年间升任首席马夫。1304年他从保加利亚手中收复墨森布里亚，但患病返回君士坦丁堡。他还重修了帕玛卡里斯托斯教堂，身后即葬于该处。

en: Michael I Rangabe (c. 770–844) was Byzantine emperor from 811 to 813. A courtier married to Prokopia, daughter of Nikephoros I, he took the throne on 2 October 811 when senior officials forced the dying Staurakios to abdicate. He dropped Nikephoros's harsh taxes and distributed money generously to the army, bureaucracy and church. He leaned on the iconodule clergy and recalled Theodore the Stoudite, and in 812 recognised Charlemagne as emperor in exchange for the return of Venice and Istria. After his army fled the Battle of Versinikia in 813, Leo the Armenian seized the throne; Michael abdicated into a monastery, where he died in 844. His sons were castrated to prevent the continuation of his dynasty.
zh: 米海尔一世·兰加贝（约770—844）于811至813年担任拜占庭皇帝。他本是宫廷重臣，娶尼基弗鲁斯一世之女普罗科皮娅为妻；811年10月2日，元老重臣逼迫奄奄一息的斯陶拉基奥斯退位，米海尔登基。他废除尼基弗鲁斯的苛税，向军队、官僚和教会慷慨分发钱财。他倚重圣像派教士，召回斯图狄乌斯的狄奥多尔，又于812年承认查理曼的皇帝称号，换回威尼斯与伊斯特拉。813年他的军队在维尔西尼基亚战役溃败，亚美尼亚人利奥夺取皇位，米海尔退位进入修道院，于844年在院中去世。他的儿子遭到阉割，以阻止其王朝延续。

en: Michael II (770–829), called the Amorian and the Stammerer, was the Amorium-born soldier who founded the Amorian dynasty and helped Leo V take power in 813 and commanded the Excubitors. Sentenced to death for plotting in late 820, he had Leo murdered at the Christmas liturgy and was crowned that same day, still in chains. He crushed Thomas the Slav's long revolt only in 823–824. In the later years of his reign Andalusian exiles seized Crete, and Muslim armies landed in Sicily in 827. He eased Leo's persecution of icon venerators and allowed exiles to return, died on 2 October 829, and left the throne to his son Theophilos.
zh: 米海尔二世（770—829），绰号“阿摩里亚人”和“结巴者”，是生于弗里吉亚阿莫利翁的军人，阿摩里亚王朝的开创者。他曾助利奥五世在813年夺权，统领禁卫军。820年末他因谋反被判死刑，却派人在圣诞节礼拜时刺杀利奥，自己当天戴着镣铐加冕。直到823—824年，他才镇压托马斯的长期叛乱。在其统治后期，安达卢西亚流亡者占领克里特岛，穆斯林军队又于827年登陆西西里。他放宽了对圣像崇拜者的迫害，允许流亡者返回，于829年10月2日去世，皇位传给儿子狄奥菲洛斯。

en: Michael III (840–867) became Byzantine emperor at age two in 842, the last ruler of the Amorian dynasty. His mother Empress Theodora's regency ended iconoclasm with the Triumph of Orthodoxy in 843. In 855 Michael and his uncle Bardas overthrew the regency, and in 857 Theodora was sent to a monastery. Bardas became Caesar in 862: the Byzantines slew the emir of Melitene at Lalakaon in 863, imposed baptism on Boris I of Bulgaria in 864, and sent Cyril and Methodius to Great Moravia. Michael's favourite Basil the Macedonian murdered Bardas in 866 and became co-emperor, then on 24 September 867 killed the drunken Michael in his bedchamber, founding the Macedonian dynasty.
zh: 米海尔三世（840—867）于842年两岁时即位，是阿摩里亚王朝末代皇帝。他的母亲狄奥多拉皇后摄政，于843年以“正教胜利”终结了圣像破坏运动。855年，米海尔与舅父巴尔达斯推翻摄政政府，857年狄奥多拉被送入修道院。巴尔达斯于862年受封恺撒：拜占庭军于863年在拉拉卡翁击斩马拉蒂亚埃米尔，864年迫使保加利亚的鲍里斯一世受洗，并派遣西里尔与美多德前往大摩拉维亚。米海尔的宠臣马其顿人巴西尔于866年杀害巴尔达斯、成为共治皇帝，又于867年9月24日趁米海尔醉酒在寝宫将他刺杀，建立马其顿王朝。

en: Michael IV the Paphlagonian (c. 1010–1041) was a peasant's son from Paphlagonia who worked as a money changer in Constantinople before his brother John the Orphanotrophos placed him at court. He became Empress Zoë's lover, and on 11 April 1034 her husband Romanos III was found dying in his bath; Michael married Zoë that day and was crowned emperor the next. Plagued by epilepsy, he left most government to John, whose heavy taxes stirred revolts. Michael distrusted Zoë and took precautions against suffering the same fate as her previous husband. In 1041 he took the field against Bulgarian rebels and returned victorious, only to die on 10 December 1041.
zh: 帕夫拉戈尼亚人米哈伊尔四世（约1010—1041）出身帕夫拉戈尼亚农家，本在君士坦丁堡做换钱商，经兄长“孤儿院长”约翰引荐入宫。他成为女皇邹伊的情夫；1034年4月11日，邹伊的丈夫罗曼努斯三世被发现奄奄一息地躺在浴池中，米哈伊尔当天便与邹伊成婚，次日加冕为帝。他受癫痫困扰，将朝政大多托付给约翰，而约翰的重税激起多处叛乱。米哈伊尔不信任邹伊，采取防备措施，以免遭遇她前夫的命运。1041年他亲征保加利亚叛军并奏凯而归，数月后于12月10日病逝。

en: Michael IX Palaiologos (1277–1320), eldest son of Andronikos II and Anna of Hungary, was crowned his father's co-emperor at Hagia Sophia on 21 May 1294, ruling as his equal. That January he married Rita of Armenia, renamed Maria, who bore him Andronikos III and Manuel. A brave soldier willing to spend his own money to encourage his troops, he nevertheless suffered repeated defeats. He failed to stem the Turkish advance in Asia Minor in 1302, lost Skafida to the Bulgarians in 1304 and was routed by the Catalans at Apros in 1305. He died on 12 October 1320, aged 43, grieving for his son Manuel, accidentally killed by retainers of the future Andronikos III.
zh: 米海尔九世·巴列奥略（1277—1320）是安德洛尼卡二世与匈牙利的安娜的长子，1294年5月21日在圣索菲亚大教堂加冕为共治皇帝，与父亲平等执政。同年1月，他娶亚美尼亚公主丽塔，婚后改名玛丽亚，生下安德洛尼卡三世和曼努埃尔。他作战勇敢，愿意自掏钱财鼓舞军队，却屡遭败绩：1302年未能阻挡土耳其人在安纳托利亚推进，1304年斯卡菲达河之战败于保加利亚人，1305年在阿普罗斯被加泰罗尼亚佣兵团击溃。1320年10月12日他去世，终年43岁；幼子曼努埃尔被日后安德洛尼卡三世的随从误杀，他哀伤成疾，因此早逝。

en: Michael Kantakouzenos (c. 1264–1316) was a Byzantine governor and the father of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos. In 1308 Emperor Andronikos II Palaiologos ended the practice of naming a new governor of the Morea each year and appointed Michael as the province's first long-term epitropos, or steward. During his eight years in office he curbed official corruption and stabilized the finances of the impoverished province, enabling his successor Andronikos Asen to launch wars of conquest. He married Theodora Palaiologina Angelina and died in 1316; his son John took the throne in 1347.
zh: 米哈伊尔·坎塔库泽努斯（约1264—1316）是拜占庭官员，皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯之父。1308年，皇帝安德洛尼卡二世废止摩里亚总督每年一换的做法，任命米哈伊尔为该省首任长期在任的总管。在八年任期内，他遏制官员贪腐，稳定了这个贫瘠行省的财政，使继任者安德洛尼卡·阿森得以发动扩张战争。他娶狄奥多拉·巴列奥略·安杰琳娜为妻，1316年去世；其子约翰于1347年登上帝位。

en: Michael Komnenos Tornikes Palaiologos Asanes, also called Michael Asen, was a fourteenth-century Byzantine aristocrat and administrator, the only known son of Constantine Palaiologos Asen and grandson of Bulgarian Tsar Ivan Asen III. Born in the opening years of the fourteenth century, he married Irene Komnene Kantakouzene Palaiologina Asenina; the couple appears in a miniature in the 1330 typikon of the Theotokos Bebaia Elpis convent in Constantinople. Arrested with his father by Alexios Apokaukos in 1342, he later served as governor of Lesbos, probably around 1347. Nikephoros Gregoras composed an elegy on his death.
zh: 米哈伊尔·科穆宁·托尔尼基斯·巴列奥略·阿森（一称米哈伊尔·阿森）是14世纪拜占庭贵族与行政官员，康斯坦丁·巴列奥略·阿森唯一可考的儿子、保加利亚沙皇伊凡·阿森三世之孙，生于14世纪初年。他娶伊琳娜·科穆宁·坎塔库泽娜·巴列奥略娜·阿塞尼娜为妻，二人的形象出现在1330年君士坦丁堡“稳望圣母”修道院规章的细密画中。1342年他与父亲一同被阿历克塞·阿波考库斯逮捕，后来约1347年出任莱斯沃斯岛总督。尼基弗鲁斯·格里戈拉斯曾为他的去世写下挽诗。

en: Michael Palaiologos Doukas (died 1156) was a Byzantine general, likely the son of Nikephoros Palaiologos and grandson of George Palaiologos. Exiled by his cousin Emperor John II, he was recalled on the accession of Manuel I in 1143, and by 1147 held the rank of sebastos, when he supplied the Second Crusade near Sardica and welcomed Louis VII of France. In 1155 he and John Doukas led the Italian expedition that seized Bari, Trani and Andria from the Normans and negotiated with Genoa. He fell ill at Bari, was tonsured as the monk Moses, and died there in spring 1156.
zh: 米海尔·巴列奥略·杜卡斯（？—1156）是拜占庭将领，一般认为是尼基弗鲁斯·巴列奥略之子、乔治·巴列奥略之孙。他遭堂兄约翰二世皇帝流放，1143年曼努埃尔一世即位后被召回，1147年已身为至尊者，奉命在塞尔迪卡附近为第二次十字军东征筹措补给，并迎接法兰西国王路易七世。1155年，他与约翰·杜卡斯共同率军远征意大利，从诺曼人手中夺取巴里、特拉尼和安德里亚，并与热那亚谈判。他在巴里病倒，出家取法名摩西，1156年春在当地去世。

en: Michael Palaiologos (born 1337) was the second son of Byzantine emperor Andronikos III Palaiologos and Anna of Savoy, and a younger brother of John V. Born a porphyrogennetos while his father reigned, he was raised to the rank of Despot sometime before Andronikos III died in 1341. In 1351 or 1352, while John V fought Matthew Kantakouzenos for the throne and sought help from Serbian emperor Stephen Dušan, Michael was sent to the Serbian court as a hostage. Nothing further is recorded of him.
zh: 米海尔·巴列奥略（1337年生）是拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡三世与萨伏依的安娜的次子，约翰五世之弟。他生于父皇在位时期，是紫衣贵族，在1341年安德洛尼卡三世去世前受封专制公。1351或1352年，约翰五世与马太·坎塔库泽努斯争夺皇位并向塞尔维亚皇帝斯特凡·杜尚求援，米海尔被送往塞尔维亚宫廷充当人质，此后事迹无闻。

en: Michael V Kalaphates (c. 1015–1042), nicknamed for his father's trade as a caulker, was the nephew of Michael IV, adopted as son and heir by Empress Zoë and made caesar in 1035. He succeeded Michael IV in December 1041 but soon banished his uncle John the Orphanotrophos. He recalled exiles including the general George Maniakes, whom he sent to southern Italy against the Normans. On 18 April 1042 he exiled Zoë to the island of Principo. Constantinople rose in revolt; Zoë's sister Theodora was proclaimed empress and Michael fled to the Stoudion monastery. Dragged from sanctuary, he was blinded and confined to a monastery, where he died the same year after a four-month reign.
zh: 米哈伊尔五世·卡拉法蒂斯（约1015—1042）的绰号来自其父填缝工的职业，他是米哈伊尔四世的外甥，被女皇邹伊收为养子和继承人，1035年受封凯撒。1041年12月他继位，不久便流放了舅父“孤儿院长”约翰。他召回包括将领乔治·马尼亚克斯在内的流亡者，并派马尼亚克斯到意大利南部抵御诺曼人。1042年4月18日夜，他把邹伊放逐到普林基波岛。君士坦丁堡随即爆发民变，邹伊之妹狄奥多拉被拥立为女皇，米哈伊尔逃入斯图狄翁修道院。他被人拖出圣所、刺瞎双目，关进修道院，同年死去，在位仅四个月。

en: Michael VI Bringas (died c. 1057), called Stratiotikos and the Old, was an elderly former military finance minister whom the dying Empress Theodora's advisors chose as her successor in 1056. He foiled one palace plot but enraged the army by restoring General Nikephoros Bryennios's rank without returning his estates. On 8 June 1057 the generals proclaimed Isaac Komnenos emperor in Paphlagonia; on 20 August Isaac routed Michael's army at Petroe near Nicaea. Michael offered through Michael Psellos to adopt Isaac and make him caesar, but the offer was publicly rejected. Riots swept Constantinople, and Patriarch Michael Cerularius persuaded Michael to abdicate on 30 August; he became a monk and died soon after.
zh: 米海尔六世·布林加斯（？—约1057），绰号“军人”和“老人”，本是年迈的前军务财政大臣，1056年被临终的塞奥多拉女皇的近臣选为继承人。他挫败过一起宫廷阴谋，却因恢复将领尼基弗鲁斯·布里尼乌斯的军职而不归还其地产，激怒了军队。1057年6月8日，将领们在帕夫拉戈尼亚拥立伊萨克·科穆宁为帝；8月20日，伊萨克在尼西亚附近的佩特罗战役击溃米海尔的军队。米海尔通过米海尔·普塞洛斯提出收养伊萨克并授予其凯撒头衔，但遭到公开拒绝。君士坦丁堡爆发骚乱，牧首米海尔·凯鲁拉里乌斯劝米海尔退位；他遂于8月30日退位出家，不久后去世。

en: Michael VII Doukas (c. 1050–c. 1090), nicknamed Parapinakes, meaning minus a quarter, after the coinage devaluation of his reign, was the eldest son of Constantine X Doukas and senior Byzantine emperor from 1071 to 1078. He left government to his finance minister Nikephoritzes while the empire lost Bari to Robert Guiscard in 1071, faced Georgi Voyteh's Bulgarian revolt, and gave way across Asia Minor after Manzikert. Married to Maria of Alania, daughter of the Georgian king Bagrat IV, he was forced to abdicate in 1078 by Nikephoros Botaneiates, retiring to the Stoudios monastery and later becoming metropolitan of Ephesus.
zh: 米海尔七世·杜卡斯（约1050—约1090）是君士坦丁十世·杜卡斯的长子，1071—1078年为拜占庭正位皇帝，因任内货币贬值得到绰号‘帕拉皮纳基斯’，意为少四分之一。他将政事交给财政大臣尼基弗里齐斯；帝国于1071年被罗贝尔·吉斯卡尔夺去在意大利的最后据点巴里，又遭遇格奥尔基·沃伊特赫领导的保加利亚人叛乱，曼齐科特战役后在小亚细亚节节败退。他娶格鲁吉亚国王巴格拉特四世之女玛丽亚为后，1078年被尼基弗鲁斯·博塔尼亚特斯逼迫退位，隐入斯图狄乌斯修道院，后来出任以弗所都主教。

en: Michael VIII Palaiologos (1224–1282), son of the megas domestikos Andronikos, became regent for Nicaea's boy emperor John IV Laskaris and was crowned co-emperor in 1259, when his army defeated the Epirote-Achaean coalition at Pelagonia. On 25 July 1261 his general Alexios Strategopoulos seized Constantinople from the Latins; Michael entered on 15 August, restored the Byzantine Empire and founded the Palaiologan dynasty. In December 1261 he had John IV blinded. He rebuilt Constantinople and expanded the army and navy, but his attention to the European provinces left the Anatolian frontier exposed. Against Charles of Anjou he promoted the Union of Lyons in 1274 and supported the Sicilian Vespers of 1282, dying in Thrace on 11 December.
zh: 米海尔八世·巴列奥略（1224—1282）是大统帅安德洛尼卡之子，成为尼西亚幼帝约翰四世·拉斯卡里斯的摄政，1259年加冕为共治皇帝，同年其军队在佩拉戈尼亚击败伊庇鲁斯与亚该亚的联军。1261年7月25日，他的将领阿莱克修斯·斯特拉泰戈普洛斯从拉丁人手中夺取君士坦丁堡；米海尔于8月15日入城，恢复拜占庭帝国，开创巴列奥略王朝。1261年12月，他下令刺瞎约翰四世。他重建君士坦丁堡、扩充陆海军，但对欧洲领土防务的重视使安纳托利亚边境空虚。为对抗安茹的查理，他推动1274年的里昂教会联合，支持1282年的西西里晚祷起义，同年12月11日死于色雷斯。

en: Nero (AD 37–68), born Lucius Domitius Ahenobarbus, was the last Julio-Claudian Roman emperor, ruling from 54. His mother Agrippina the Younger married the emperor Claudius, who adopted him as heir; with Praetorian backing he took power in 54. After early guidance from Agrippina, Seneca and Burrus, he had his mother and wife Octavia killed. He appeared publicly as a musician and actor, scandalizing aristocrats but gaining popularity among ordinary citizens. His reign brought the Parthian War of 58–63, Boudica's revolt in Britain, the Great Fire of Rome in 64 and first persecution of Christians. When Vindex and Galba rebelled in 68 he killed himself on 9 June, opening the Year of the Four Emperors.
zh: 尼禄（公元37—68年），原名卢基乌斯·多米提乌斯·阿赫诺巴尔布斯，是儒略-克劳狄王朝最后一位罗马皇帝，54年起在位。其母小阿格里皮娜改嫁皇帝克劳狄，克劳狄收他为继承人；在禁卫军支持下，他于54年登基。执政初期受阿格里皮娜、塞内卡和布鲁斯辅佐，后来他下令杀死母亲与妻子屋大维娅。他公开演奏音乐、登台表演，使贵族震惊，却受到平民欢迎。他在位期间爆发58至63年的帕提亚战争、不列颠的布狄卡起义，64年罗马大火，随后发生对基督徒的第一次帝国迫害。68年温代克斯与加尔巴起兵，尼禄于6月9日自杀，随后进入“四帝之年”。

en: Nerva (30–98) was Roman emperor from 96 to 98, the first of the Five Good Emperors. Born at Narni into a prominent Italian family, he became a veteran courtier. He helped expose the Pisonian conspiracy against Nero in 65, receiving triumphal honours, and was consul under Vespasian in 71 and Domitian in 90. After Domitian's murder in 96, the Senate made Nerva emperor, and he restored liberties curbed under Domitian. Financial strain and a Praetorian mutiny in October 97 forced him to adopt the popular general Trajan as heir. He died in January 98 after a stroke and was deified; his adoption of Trajan founded the Nerva–Antonine dynasty, which ruled Rome until 192.
zh: 涅尔瓦（30—98）于96—98年任罗马皇帝，是“五贤帝”之首。他出生于纳尔尼的意大利显贵家族，成为历事尼禄与弗拉维王朝的老臣。他于65年协助揭发反对尼禄的皮索阴谋，获得凯旋荣誉，71年在韦斯巴芗、90年在图密善治下两任执政官。96年图密善遇刺后，元老院拥立涅尔瓦为帝，他恢复了图密善时代被削减的各项自由。财政困难，加上97年10月禁卫军哗变，迫使他收颇受欢迎的将领图拉真为继承人。他于公元98年1月中风后病逝，被追尊为神；过继图拉真开启的安敦尼王朝一直延续到192年。

en: Nikephoros Gregoras (c. 1295–c. 1360), born at Heraclea Pontica, was a Byzantine astronomer, theologian and historian. His uncle, the local bishop, took him to Constantinople, where Andronikos II made him chartophylax, keeper of the archives. In 1326 he wrote a treatise proposing calendar reform; the emperor shelved it for fear of unrest, and Gregory XIII adopted almost the same reform more than two centuries later. He fell with Andronikos II in 1328, but a public contest with Barlaam, whom he bested, drew many pupils, and he predicted the total solar eclipse of 16 July 1330 exactly. In 1333 he took part in the failed church-union talks with envoys of John XXII. From 1346 he opposed Gregory Palamas in the Hesychast dispute; the synod of 1351 declared his views heretical, he refused to recant and was confined at the Chora Monastery until 1354. Two of the 37 books of his Roman History, a primary source for the century, argue against Palamas.
zh: 尼基弗鲁斯·格雷戈拉斯（约1295—约1360）出生于本都的赫拉克利亚，是拜占庭的天文学家、神学家和史家。担任当地主教的叔父带他到君士坦丁堡，安德洛尼卡二世任命他为掌卷官。1326年他写成历法改革的论文，皇帝怕引起骚乱而搁置，两百多年后格里高利十三世几乎照同样思路推行了改历。1328年安德洛尼卡二世被废，他也随之失势；但他在公开论战中击败了巴拉姆，由此门生云集，1330年7月16日的日全食被他精确预测。1333年，他参加了与教皇约翰二十二世使节的教会合一谈判，谈判无果。1346年起，他在静修派之争中反对格里高利·帕拉马斯；1351年的主教会议宣布他的观点为异端，他拒绝悔改，被关在科拉修道院直至1354年。他所著三十七卷《罗马史》中有两卷反驳帕拉马斯，这部书是研究十四世纪的主要史料。

en: Nikephoros I (c. 750–811) was Byzantine emperor from 802 to 811. As General Logothete, the empire's finance minister, under Empress Irene, he deposed her in 802 and seized the throne. He reorganised imperial finances and military settlement, moving impoverished soldiers and peasants from Asia Minor to the Balkans. He crowned his son Staurakios co-emperor on Christmas Day 803 and put down the revolts of Bardanes Tourkos in 803 and Arsaber in 808. His strict financial discipline brought him hostility among his subjects. He clashed with Charlemagne over Venice and with the Abbasid caliph Harun al-Rashid, and was killed on 26 July 811 while invading Bulgaria, in the disaster of the Battle of Pliska.
zh: 尼基弗鲁斯一世（约750—811）于802至811年担任拜占庭皇帝。他本是伊琳娜女皇手下的财政大臣，802年废黜女皇、夺取皇位。他整顿财政与军事屯垦，将贫困的士兵和农民从小亚细亚迁往巴尔干。他于803年圣诞节给儿子斯陶拉基奥斯加冕为共治皇帝，并平定了803年巴尔达内斯·图尔科斯和808年阿萨贝尔的叛乱。他严厉的财政纪律招致臣民的敌意。他围绕威尼斯与查理曼相争，又与阿拔斯哈里发哈伦·拉希德交战。811年7月26日，他率军入侵保加利亚，在普利斯卡战役的惨败中阵亡。

en: Nikephoros II Phokas (c. 912–969) was a Cappadocian general of the Phokas clan whose troops stormed Chandax in March 961 after a nine-month siege and reconquered Crete from the Muslims. His army had endured winter supply shortages during the siege. With John Tzimiskes he sacked Aleppo in 962 and broke Hamdanid power. After Romanos II died in 963, he seized the throne and married Empress Theophano. He completed the conquest of Cilicia, took Tarsus in 965, recovered Cyprus, and in 969 his forces took Antioch, earning him the name Pale Death of the Saracens. That December Theophano admitted Tzimiskes to his chamber and the conspirators killed him.
zh: 尼基弗鲁斯二世·福卡斯（约912—969）是卡帕多细亚福卡斯家族的将领。961年3月，他的军队围城九个月后攻占汉达克斯，从穆斯林手中收复克里特岛；围城期间，军队熬过了冬季补给短缺。962年，他又与约翰·齐米斯西斯联手洗劫阿勒颇，重创哈姆丹王朝。963年罗曼努斯二世死后，他夺取皇位，娶皇后塞奥法诺为妻。他完成了对奇里乞亚的征服，965年攻取塔尔苏斯，收复塞浦路斯，969年部下攻占安条克，因而得到“萨拉森人的苍白死神”之名。同年12月，塞奥法诺把齐米斯西斯放进他的寝宫，密谋者将他杀害。

en: Nikephoros III Botaneiates (1002–1081) was a general from a military family of the Anatolic Theme. He fought in the Pecheneg revolt of 1048–1053 and helped Isaac I Komnenos overthrow Michael VI at the Battle of Petroe in 1057, later serving as doux of Thessalonica and Antioch. At Antioch he repelled incursions from the Emirate of Aleppo. In 1078 he rose against Michael VII and entered Constantinople with the backing of the Senate and people. As emperor he crushed revolts by Bryennios, Basilakes and Constantine Doukas. He also forgave debts in arrears and gave lavishly to the army and his supporters. In April 1081 Alexios I Komnenos seized the capital; Nikephoros abdicated, took the monastic habit and died the same year.
zh: 尼基弗鲁斯三世·沃塔尼亚蒂斯（1002—1081）出身安纳托利亚军区的武将世家。他参加1048至1053年平定佩切涅格人叛乱的战争，1057年在彼得罗战役助伊萨克一世·科穆宁推翻米哈伊尔六世，此后历任塞萨洛尼基和安条克都督。在安条克，他击退了来自阿勒颇埃米尔国的入侵。1078年，他起兵反对米哈伊尔七世，在元老院与君士坦丁堡民众支持下入主京城。在位期间他平定了布里尼奥斯、瓦西拉基斯和君士坦丁·杜卡斯的叛乱，还免除积欠的债务，向军队和支持者大加赏赐。1081年4月，阿莱克修斯一世·科穆宁攻占首都，尼基弗鲁斯退位出家，同年去世。

en: Nikephoros Kallistos Xanthopoulos (c. 1256–1335) was a Byzantine priest of Hagia Sophia and ecclesiastical historian born in Constantinople. Granted access to the patriarchal library, he began his twenty-three-book Church History around 1310 and completed it after 1317, dedicating it to Andronikos II Palaiologos. The surviving eighteen books run from the time of Christ to the death of Emperor Phokas in 610, drawing on Eusebios and other earlier historians. A friend of Theodore Metochites, he also taught rhetoric and wrote saints' lives, synaxaria and religious poems.
zh: 尼基福罗斯·卡利斯托斯·克桑索普洛斯（约1256—1335）是出生于君士坦丁堡的拜占庭圣索菲亚大教堂神父、教会史家。他获准使用牧首图书馆，约于1310年开始撰写二十三卷本《教会史》，1317年后完成，并题献给安德洛尼卡二世·帕里奥洛格斯。传世的十八卷从基督时代记述到610年皇帝福卡斯之死，大量取材于优西比乌等前辈史家。他与狄奥多尔·梅托希特斯交好，还教授修辞学，并撰写圣徒传、圣徒历和宗教诗歌。

en: Nikephoros Kantakouzenos (c. 1300–after 1355) was a Byzantine aristocrat and governor, a cousin of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos. In October 1341, at the start of the civil war, Alexios Apokaukos had him imprisoned in Constantinople with other members of the family; he was freed only when John VI entered the city in March 1347. By 1351 he held the rank of sebastokrator and governed Adrianople, defending its citadel with Matthew Kantakouzenos against John V in 1352. After John VI's fall in December 1354 he kept Adrianople for Matthew. His daughter Theodora married Alexios III of Trebizond in 1351.
zh: 尼基弗鲁斯·坎塔库泽努斯（约1300—1355年后）是拜占庭贵族、地方长官，皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯的表亲。1341年10月内战爆发时，阿历克塞·阿波考寇斯下令把他与坎塔库泽努斯家族其他成员一同囚禁在君士坦丁堡；直到1347年3月约翰六世入城，他才获释。至迟1351年，他已受封至尊者并出任阿德里安堡长官，1352年与马修·坎塔库泽努斯共同守卫该城要塞，抵御约翰五世。1354年12月约翰六世倒台后，他为马修保住阿德里安堡。其女狄奥多拉于1351年嫁给特拉比松皇帝阿历克塞三世。

en: Nikephoros Doukas Palaiologos, eldest son of the sebastos George Palaiologos and Anna Doukaina, may have fought the Turks near Philomelion in 1116 or 1117. Michael, a Byzantine general in Italy, was likely his son, and Nikephoros was likely an ancestor of the Palaiologan emperors.
zh: 尼基弗鲁斯·杜卡斯·巴列奥略是至尊者乔治·巴列奥略与安娜·杜卡伊娜的长子，可能于1116或1117年在菲洛梅利翁附近与突厥人作战。出征意大利的拜占庭将领米海尔很可能是他的儿子，而他很可能是巴列奥略王朝诸帝的祖先。

en: Orbán, also called Urban (died 1453), was an iron founder and engineer from Brassó in Transylvania, in the Kingdom of Hungary. In 1452 he offered his services to the Byzantine emperor Constantine XI, who could neither pay his salary nor supply the metal for a giant siege gun, so Orbán turned to Sultan Mehmed II. He claimed his weapon could destroy even the walls of Babylon, and the sultan supplied funds and materials. At Adrianople he cast the colossal Basilic bombard in three months; sixty oxen dragged it to the 1453 siege of Constantinople, where his guns battered the Theodosian Walls. He also made smaller cannons for the besiegers. He is said to have been killed that year when one of his own cannons burst.
zh: 乌尔班（1453年卒）是匈牙利王国特兰西瓦尼亚地区布拉索夫的铸铁师兼工程师。1452年他投奔拜占庭皇帝君士坦丁十一世，但皇帝既付不起他的薪俸，也凑不齐铸造巨型攻城炮所需的金属，乌尔班便转投苏丹穆罕默德二世。他声称自己的火炮甚至能够摧毁巴比伦城墙，苏丹于是提供资金和物料。在阿德里安堡，他用三个月铸成巨型“巴塞利卡”臼炮，由六十头公牛拖到1453年的君士坦丁堡围城战场，他的炮群猛轰狄奥多西城墙。他还为围城军铸造了较小的火炮。相传同年他因自己铸造的一门大炮炸膛而丧命。

en: Otho (32–69), born into a noble Etruscan family, was a companion of the emperor Nero until Nero took his wife Poppaea Sabina and made him governor of Lusitania in 58. He proved a capable governor, but never forgave Nero for marrying Poppaea. He joined Galba's revolt in 68 and marched on Rome, but on 15 January 69 the praetorians murdered Galba and proclaimed him emperor, the second ruler of the Year of the Four Emperors. The German legions had hailed Vitellius. At Bedriacum on 14 April his forces were defeated in a battle that caused 40,000 casualties on both sides; he then stabbed himself at Brixellum rather than renew civil war, after a reign of ninety-one days.
zh: 奥托（32—69）出身伊特鲁里亚贵族家庭，本是皇帝尼禄的近臣，直到尼禄夺走他的妻子波培娅·萨宾娜，并于58年外放他为卢西塔尼亚总督。他治理有方，却始终不肯原谅尼禄娶走波培娅。68年他加入加尔巴的叛乱，进军罗马，但69年1月15日禁卫军杀死加尔巴，拥立他为帝，他由此成为四帝之年的第二位皇帝。日耳曼军团此时已拥立维特里乌斯。4月14日，他的军队在贝德里亚库姆战败，双方共约40,000人伤亡；他不愿内战延续，在布里克塞鲁姆拔剑自刎，在位仅九十一天。

en: Publius Helvius Pertinax (126–193) was the son of a freedman from Alba Pompeia who rose through the army, winning distinction in the Parthian War of 161–166 and later governing Moesia, Dacia, Syria and Britain. In Britain his strict discipline provoked a mutiny, and he resigned in 187; he later served as prefect of Rome. After Commodus was murdered on the last day of 192, Pertinax became emperor, the first ruler of the Year of the Five Emperors. He tried to restore discipline and the coinage, raising the denarius's silver content, but his economies enraged the Praetorian Guard. After only 87 days they stormed the palace and killed him on 28 March 193. Septimius Severus later had him deified.
zh: 普布利乌斯·赫尔维乌斯·佩蒂纳克斯（126—193）是阿尔巴·蓬佩亚一名获释奴之子，行伍出身：在161至166年的帕提亚战争中崭露头角，此后历任默西亚、达契亚、叙利亚和不列颠总督。在不列颠，他严整军纪引发兵变，于187年辞职，后来出任罗马城监。192年最后一天康茂德遇刺后，佩蒂纳克斯登基，成为“五帝之年”的第一位皇帝。他试图整顿军纪、改良币制，提高第纳里乌斯银币的含银量，但紧缩开支激怒了禁卫军。在位仅87天，禁卫军便在193年3月28日冲入皇宫将他杀死。塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁后来追尊他为神。

en: Philip the Arab (c. 204–249), born Marcus Julius Philippus at Philippopolis in Arabia Petraea, rose to be praetorian prefect under the young emperor Gordian III. After Gordian died following the Battle of Misiche in 244, Philip was proclaimed emperor and made peace with Shapur I, then returned to Rome for the Senate's confirmation. He rebuilt his home town as Philippopolis, but the cost and tribute to Persia strained his finances and he raised taxes. His five-year reign was a rare interval of stability in the third-century crisis: in 246 he drove back the Carpi on the Danube, and in 248 he celebrated the thousandth anniversary of Rome with the Secular Games. Rebellions then brought Decius into Italy, and Philip was defeated and killed at Verona in September 249.
zh: 阿拉伯人菲利普（约204—249），全名马尔库斯·尤利乌斯·菲利普，生于佩特拉阿拉伯的菲利普波利斯，在年轻的皇帝戈尔迪安三世麾下升任近卫军长官。244年戈尔迪安三世在米西切战役后死去，菲利普被拥立为帝，与沙普尔一世议和，随后返回罗马获得元老院承认。他将故乡重建为菲利普波利斯，但营建费用与对波斯的贡金令财政吃紧，他因此提高赋税。他在位五年，是三世纪危机中少有的安定时期：246年他在多瑙河击退卡尔皮人，248年又举办盛大的百年祭典，庆祝罗马建城千年。随后各地叛乱使德西乌斯进军意大利，249年9月菲利普在维罗纳战败被杀。

en: Philippicus, born Bardanes in Constantinople to a family whose roots lay in Pergamum, was twice exiled, by Tiberius III and by Justinian II. His first exile followed a dream in which an eagle shaded his head, interpreted as a sign of imperial ambition. At Cherson he won the Khazars, and in 711 the city and the fleet proclaimed him emperor; after he took Constantinople, Justinian II and his young son Tiberius were killed. He deposed Patriarch Cyrus, imposed monothelitism and annulled the Sixth Ecumenical Council, which Rome rejected. In 712 the Bulgar Tervel raided to the city walls while the Arabs entered Asia Minor. On 3 June 713 Opsician rebels blinded him in the hippodrome; he died later that year.
zh: 菲利皮科斯本名巴尔达内斯，生于君士坦丁堡，家族源自帕加马，曾先后被提比略三世和查士丁尼二世流放。他第一次被流放前梦见一只鹰在头顶投下阴影，这被视为他觊觎帝位的征兆。在流放地赫尔松，他得到可萨人支持，711年赫尔松城与舰队拥立他为帝；他攻占君士坦丁堡后，查士丁尼二世及其幼子提比略被杀。他废黜牧首居鲁士，强制推行基督一志论，废除第六次大公会议的决议，罗马方面不予承认。712年，保加利亚汗特尔维尔洗劫至君士坦丁堡城下，阿拉伯人则攻入小亚细亚。713年6月3日，奥普西金军区的叛军在赛马场将他刺瞎，他于同年死去。

en: Phocas (547–610), a centurion in the Thracian army, led the mutinous troops during the Danube campaign of 602 that overthrew the emperor Maurice. The soldiers had rebelled after Maurice ordered them to continue campaigning north of the Danube through the winter. Crowned on 23 November 602, he executed Maurice and his sons and tried to rule through his relatives, but met every challenge with purges that widened revolt. While the Sasanians under Khusrow II overran the eastern provinces, the African exarch Heraclius the Elder rose against him. In 607 he recognized the pope in Rome as head of all churches. Heraclius the Younger took Constantinople on 5 October 610 and beheaded Phocas the same day.
zh: 福卡斯（547—610）原是色雷斯军团的百夫长，602年多瑙河战役期间率领哗变军队推翻皇帝莫里斯。莫里斯下令军队在多瑙河北岸继续作战过冬，士兵因而哗变。同年11月23日他加冕称帝，处死莫里斯父子，并试图依靠亲族治国，却以清洗应对一切反抗，使叛乱愈演愈烈。当萨珊国王霍斯劳二世大举攻陷东方行省时，阿非利加总督老希拉克略起兵讨伐。607年，他承认罗马教宗为“所有教会之首”。610年10月5日，小希拉克略攻占君士坦丁堡，同日将福卡斯斩首。

en: Probus (232–282), a Pannonian soldier from Sirmium, rose to high command under Aurelian, and Tacitus appointed him commander in the East. The eastern army made him emperor in 276 after Tacitus' death. Rival Florian perished at Tarsus; the Senate confirmed him. In 277–278 he cleared Gaul of Alemanni, Franks and other raiders, crossed the Rhine, rebuilt Hadrian's Rhine–Danube forts and defeated Goths, Vandals and Blemmyes. He settled people taken from the defeated Germans in depopulated provinces and strengthened frontier defenses. In 280–281 he crushed usurpers Saturninus, Proculus and Bonosus and triumphed at Rome. Peacetime found his soldiers planting vineyards and draining marshes. In 282, preparing a Persian war at Sirmium, he was killed in a mutiny that brought Carus to power.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/马库斯·奥里利乌斯·普罗布斯
zh: 普罗布斯（232—282）是出身西尔米乌姆的潘诺尼亚军人，在奥勒良麾下升至高位，塔西佗任命他统领东方。塔西佗死后的276年，他被东方军队拥立为帝。竞争者弗洛里安努斯在塔尔苏斯败亡，元老院予以承认。277至278年，他肃清高卢的阿勒曼尼人、法兰克人等入侵者，渡过莱茵河，修复哈德良时期连接莱茵河与多瑙河的防线，并击败哥特人、汪达尔人和布莱米人。他将战败日耳曼人提供的人口安置在人烟稀少的行省，并加强边防。280至281年，他平定萨图尔尼努斯、普罗库卢斯和博诺苏斯三个僭帝，在罗马举行凯旋式。和平时期，他让士兵种植葡萄、排干沼泽。282年，他在西尔米乌姆筹备波斯战争时死于兵变，卡鲁斯随之掌权。

en: Pupienus (c. 164–238) was a Roman general and senator who won victories over the Sarmatians and German tribes, held the consulship around 207 and again in 234, and served as urban prefect of Rome, where he gained a reputation for severity. He joined the Senate's committee of twenty appointed to coordinate resistance to Maximinus Thrax. When the Gordians died in Africa, the Senate made Pupienus and Balbinus joint emperors in April 238. Pupienus took charge at Ravenna, and Maximinus was murdered by his own troops outside Aquileia. Back in Rome, the two emperors quarrelled; in July or August 238 disaffected Praetorians seized both and killed them in the guard barracks, after a reign of ninety-nine days.
zh: 普皮恩努斯（约164—238）是罗马将领与元老，曾战胜萨尔马提亚人和日耳曼诸部，约207年、234年两度任执政官，并出任罗马城市长官，以严厉著称。他加入元老院设立的二十人委员会，负责协调对马克西米努斯的抵抗。戈尔迪安一世与戈尔迪安二世在阿非利加败亡后，元老院于238年4月推举普皮恩努斯与巴尔比努斯共同称帝。普皮恩努斯坐镇拉文纳指挥战事，马克西米努斯最终在阿奎莱亚城外被自己的士兵所杀。回到罗马后，两位皇帝反目；238年7月或8月，心怀不满的禁卫军拘捕二人并在军营中将他们处死，他们共在位九十九天。

en: Rita (10/11 January 1278 – July 1333) was a daughter of King Leo II of Armenian Cilicia and Queen Keran, twin of Theophane. In January 1294 she married the Byzantine co-emperor Michael IX Palaiologos and took the name Maria, serving as junior empress until Irene of Montferrat died in 1317. In 1320 her son Manuel was slain by mistake at the orders of his brother Andronikos, and Michael IX died soon after. Widowed, Rita retired to a convent as the nun Xene and died there in July 1333, five years after Andronikos III defeated Andronikos II.
zh: 丽塔（1278年1月10/11日—1333年7月）是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王莱翁二世与王后克朗之女，与狄奥法内是孪生姐妹。1294年1月，她嫁给拜占庭共治皇帝米哈伊尔九世·巴列奥略，改名玛丽亚；1317年蒙费拉的伊琳娜去世前，她一直是位次在后的皇后。1320年，她的儿子曼努埃尔被兄长安德洛尼卡下令误杀，米哈伊尔九世不久亦去世。丧夫后她退入修道院，取修道名克塞妮，1333年7月在院中去世，距安德洛尼卡三世战胜安德洛尼卡二世仅五年。

en: Romanos I Lekapenos (c. 870–948) was the son of an Armenian peasant who rose from imperial fleet commander to rule as the young Constantine VII's regent and senior co-emperor. In 919 he married his daughter Helena to Constantine, taking the title basileopator; he was crowned co-emperor in December 920. In 927 his granddaughter Maria wed Peter I of Bulgaria, sealing peace with the Bulgars. After his heir Christopher died in 931, he kept Constantine above his other sons. In December 944 sons Stephen and Constantine deposed him and forced him into a monastery. When they threatened Constantine VII, the people of Constantinople revolted and the brothers were exiled to their father, who died in 948.
zh: 罗曼努斯一世·利卡潘努斯（约870—948）是一名亚美尼亚农民之子，从帝国舰队指挥官起家，以摄政和首席共治皇帝的身份代年幼的君士坦丁七世执政。919年，他把女儿海伦娜嫁给君士坦丁，受封“皇丈”，920年12月加冕为共治皇帝。927年，他的孙女玛丽亚与保加利亚皇帝彼得一世成婚，与保加利亚人缔结和平。931年继承人克里斯托弗死后，他仍让君士坦丁的位次高于其余诸子。944年12月，儿子斯蒂芬和君士坦丁将他废黜，逼他出家为僧。两人威胁君士坦丁七世的地位时，君士坦丁堡民众起事，兄弟二人被流放到父亲身边；罗曼努斯于948年去世。

en: Romanos II (938–963) became Byzantine emperor in 959, succeeding his father Constantine VII. Crowned co-emperor in 945, he married Theophano in 956 after his first bride Bertha of Italy died young. After his accession he sent his mother away from court and forced his five sisters into convents. He left government to the eunuch Joseph Bringas and warfare to the Phokas brothers: Nikephoros reconquered Crete in 960–961 after the nine-month siege of Chandax, then seized Cilicia and sacked Aleppo in 962. Romanos's reliance on his wife and officials caused resentment among the military nobility. He died suddenly after a hunt in March 963, leaving young sons Basil II and Constantine VIII.
zh: 罗曼努斯二世（938—963）于959年继承父皇君士坦丁七世，成为拜占庭皇帝。他于945年被加冕为共治皇帝；第一任妻子意大利的贝尔塔早逝后，他在956年迎娶赛奥法诺。即位后，他遣母亲离开宫廷，迫使五个姐妹进入修道院。他把政务交给宦官约瑟夫·布林加斯，军事托付福卡斯兄弟：尼基弗鲁斯经九个月的坎达克斯围城战，于960—961年收复克里特岛，又在962年夺取奇里乞亚、洗劫阿勒颇。罗曼努斯倚重妻子和官僚，引起军事贵族不满。963年3月，他在一次狩猎后暴毙，留下年幼的儿子巴西尔二世与君士坦丁八世。

en: Romanos III Argyros (968–11 April 1034) was a senior judge and urban prefect of Constantinople when the dying Constantine VIII made him divorce his wife and marry his daughter Zoë in November 1028; three days later he was emperor. He aspired to emulate Marcus Aurelius as a philosopher king and Trajan as a commander. He cut the aristocracy's taxes, spent heavily on churches, and in 1030 led a disastrous campaign against Aleppo, routed at Azaz in August. His general George Maniakes took Edessa in 1032. Estranged from Zoë and her lover Michael the Paphlagonian, Romanos died in his bath on 11 April 1034, widely believed murdered at her order, and Michael IV succeeded him.
zh: 罗曼努斯三世·阿居罗斯（968—1034年4月11日）本是君士坦丁堡的高级法官兼首都行政长官。1028年11月，临终的君士坦丁八世逼他与妻子离婚，改娶公主佐伊；三天后君士坦丁八世去世，他登上帝位。他希望效仿哲人皇帝马可·奥勒留和善战的图拉真。他削减贵族赋税，斥巨资修建教堂，1030年亲征阿勒颇，8月在阿扎兹惨败；部将乔治·马尼阿凯斯于1032年攻占埃德萨，多少挽回颜面。他与佐伊失和，佐伊的情夫是帕夫拉戈尼亚人米海尔。1034年4月11日，罗曼努斯死在浴室中，时人多认为他是奉佐伊之命遇害，米海尔四世随后即位。

en: Romanos IV Diogenes (c. 1030–1072), son of the general Constantine Diogenes, was a Cappadocian commander on the Syrian and Danubian frontiers. In 1068 he was crowned Byzantine emperor after marrying the dowager empress Eudokia Makrembolitissa. Determined to halt the decline of the army and Turkish incursions, he campaigned repeatedly against the Seljuk Turks in Anatolia and Syria amid rivalry with the Doukas family. In 1071 Alp Arslan defeated his army at Manzikert and took him prisoner, a blow that weakened Byzantine authority in Anatolia. The Doukai then proclaimed Michael VII emperor; defeated in Cilicia and promised his life, Romanos was blinded, exiled to Prote, and died of his wounds in 1072.
zh: 罗曼努斯四世·第欧根尼（约1030—1072）是将领君士坦丁·第欧根尼之子，出身卡帕多西亚军事贵族，曾在叙利亚和多瑙河边境统兵。1068年，他与守寡的女皇欧多基娅·马克伦博利蒂萨成婚并加冕为拜占庭皇帝。他决心遏止军队衰败和突厥人的入侵，在与杜卡斯家族的争斗中多次出征小亚细亚和叙利亚，抗击塞尔柱突厥人。1071年，他的军队在曼齐刻尔特被阿尔普·阿尔斯兰击败，他本人被俘；这场战败削弱了拜占庭在小亚细亚的统治。他被扣期间杜卡斯家族拥立米哈伊尔七世；他在奇里乞亚兵败，虽获免死承诺，仍被刺瞎、放逐到普罗特岛，于1072年伤重而亡。

en: Lucius Septimius Severus (145–211) was born at Leptis Magna in the Roman province of Africa, the first emperor born into a provincial family of non-Italian origin. Seizing power in 193, the Year of the Five Emperors, he overthrew Didius Julianus and defeated the rival generals Pescennius Niger at Issus in 194 and Clodius Albinus at Lugdunum in 197. He annexed Osroene in 194, sacked the Parthian capital Ctesiphon in 197, and in 202 campaigned against the Garamantes in Africa. With Julia Domna he fathered two heirs, Caracalla and Geta. He died at Eboracum in 211 after invading Caledonia, founding the Severan dynasty.
zh: 卢基乌斯·塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁（145—211）生于阿非利加行省的大莱普提斯，是首位出身非意大利裔行省家族的罗马皇帝。193年佩蒂纳克斯被杀，即五帝之年，他起兵夺取罗马、推翻尤利安努斯，又于194年在伊苏斯击败佩斯切尼乌斯·奈哲尔，197年在卢格杜努姆击败克洛狄乌斯·阿尔拜努斯。194年他吞并奥斯若恩，197年劫掠安息都城泰西封，202年在阿非利加征讨加拉曼特人。他与尤利亚·多姆娜生下卡拉卡拉和盖塔两位继承人，在入侵喀里多尼亚后于211年死于不列颠的艾伯拉肯，开创塞维鲁王朝。

en: Shishman was a younger son of Tsar Michael Shishman of Bulgaria and his Serbian wife Ana, named after his grandfather Shishman of Vidin. After his father fell at Velbazhd in 1330, his brother Ivan Stephen briefly held the Bulgarian throne before being overthrown by Ivan Alexander in 1331. While the rest of his family fled to Serbia and Dubrovnik, Shishman took refuge with the Mongol Golden Horde for about a decade. In 1341 he appeared in Constantinople, whose regent John Kantakouzenos refused Bulgarian demands to surrender him and armed to defend him. His later fate is unknown.
zh: 希什曼是保加利亚沙皇米哈伊尔·希什曼与塞尔维亚妻子安娜较年幼的儿子之一，名字来自祖父维丁的希什曼。1330年其父在维日布尔德战役战死后，其兄伊凡·斯特凡短暂继位，1331年被伊凡·亚历山大推翻。家人逃往塞尔维亚和杜布罗夫尼克，希什曼却投奔蒙古金帐汗国，在那里逗留约十年。1341年他出现在君士坦丁堡，摄政约翰·坎塔库泽努斯拒绝了保加利亚的引渡要求，还以武力相护。此后他的下落便不见记载。

en: Staurakios (died 11 January 812) was the shortest-reigning of all Byzantine emperors, ruling for just sixty-eight days. The only son of Nikephoros I, he was crowned co-emperor on Christmas Day 803 and in 807 married Theophano of Athens, chosen in a palace bride show. He fought beside his father in the invasion of Bulgaria and survived the Battle of Pliska on 26 July 811, but with a severed spine. He was carried back to Constantinople on a litter and proclaimed emperor to preserve the succession's legitimacy. His grave wounds made the question of his successor a matter of dispute. On 2 October his brother-in-law Michael I Rangabe deposed him; Staurakios was forced into a monastery and died there three months later.
zh: 斯陶拉基奥斯（812年1月11日卒）是在位时间最短的拜占庭皇帝，仅统治六十八天。他是尼基弗鲁斯一世的独子，803年圣诞节被加冕为共治皇帝，807年在宫中的选秀中娶雅典的赛奥法诺为妻。811年他随父出征保加利亚，在7月26日的普利斯卡战役中幸存，脊柱却被斩断。他被担架送回君士坦丁堡并被拥立为帝，以维持继承的合法性；他的重伤使继承人问题引发争议。10月2日，他被姐夫米海尔一世·兰加贝废黜，被迫进入修道院，三个月后在院中去世。

en: Syrgiannes Palaiologos Philanthropenos (c. 1290–1334) was a Byzantine general, born to a Cuman chief and Eugenia Palaiologina, niece of Michael VIII. In the civil war between Andronikos II and Andronikos III, he backed the grandson in 1321, helped force the June partition, defected that December, and was jailed for plotting to seize the throne. Pardoned, he governed Thessalonica from 1329, fled to Stefan Dušan of Serbia in 1334, and led Serbian troops that overran Ohrid, Prilep and much of Macedonia. On 23 August 1334 he was lured from his camp and murdered by the Byzantine agent Sphrantzes Palaiologos.
zh: 西尔吉安·巴列奥略·菲兰特罗佩诺斯（约1290—1334）是拜占庭将领，父亲为库曼人首领，母亲尤金尼娅·巴列奥略吉娜是米海尔八世的外甥女。安德洛尼卡二世与安德洛尼卡三世间的内战中，他于1321年支持皇孙，促成当年6月的分治协议，12月即倒戈，后因阴谋篡位被监禁。获赦后他于1329年出镇塞萨洛尼基，1334年逃往塞尔维亚的斯特凡·杜尚处，率塞军连克奥赫里德、普里莱普及马其顿大片土地。1334年8月23日，他被诱出营地，遭拜占庭密使斯法兰策·巴列奥略刺杀。

en: Tarchaneiotissa, whose first name is unrecorded, was a daughter of the Byzantine protostrator Michael Doukas Glabas Tarchaneiotes and the wife of Andronikos Asen, governor of the Morea. Her daughter Irene Asanina married Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos.
zh: 塔尔哈尼奥提萨是拜占庭首席马夫米哈伊尔·杜卡斯·格拉巴斯·塔尔哈尼奥提斯之女，本名无记载，嫁给摩里亚总督安德洛尼卡·阿森；其女伊琳娜·阿森尼娜后为皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯的皇后。

en: Theodora, possibly surnamed Komnene, was the wife of the despot Demetrios Palaiologos, governor of Thessalonica. When Demetrios fled to Serbia in 1328, she and her children were captured by Andronikos III. Her daughter Irene married Matthew Kantakouzenos and became a Byzantine empress.
zh: 狄奥多拉可能姓科穆宁，是专制公德米特里·巴列奥略之妻，其夫任塞萨洛尼基总督。1328年德米特里在内战中逃往塞尔维亚，她与子女被安德罗尼卡三世俘获。其女伊琳娜嫁给马修·坎塔库泽努斯，成为拜占庭皇后。

en: Theodora Angelina Palaiologina (born c. 1200) was a Byzantine noblewoman, the only daughter of the despot Alexios Palaiologos and Irene Angelina, herself a daughter of Emperor Alexios III Angelos. She married Andronikos Palaiologos, megas domestikos of the Empire of Nicaea. Their four children included Michael VIII, born in 1223, who became Nicaean emperor in 1259 and recovered Constantinople in 1261 as founder of the Palaiologan dynasty, as well as the sebastokrator John Palaiologos and two daughters who took monastic names. Theodora thus linked the Angeloi to the last Byzantine imperial house.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/狄奥多拉·安格利娜·巴列奥略
zh: 狄奥多拉·安格利娜·巴列奥略（约1200年生）是拜占庭贵族女子，专制公阿历克修斯·巴列奥略与伊琳娜·安格琳娜的独女，其母是皇帝阿历克塞三世·安格洛斯之女。她嫁给尼西亚帝国大统帅安德洛尼卡·巴列奥略，育有四名子女，其中包括1223年出生的米海尔八世：他于1259年成为尼西亚皇帝，1261年收复君士坦丁堡，建立巴列奥略王朝；另有至尊者约翰·巴列奥略，以及两名出家后取教名的女儿。狄奥多拉由此将安格洛斯家族与拜占庭末代王朝联系在一起。

en: Theodora Palaiologina (c. 1240–1303), or Theodora Vatatzaina, was the daughter of John Doukas and Eudokia Angelina and great-niece of the Nicaean emperor John III Vatatzes, who raised her and in 1253 married her to the rising general Michael Palaiologos. She became empress when Michael VIII recovered Constantinople in 1261, and with Patriarch Arsenios's help she foiled his plan to divorce her for Anna-Constance of Hohenstaufen. She arranged her daughters' marriages, sought clemency for disgraced courtiers and patronized monasteries, including Patmos. Initially sympathetic to opponents of the 1274 Union of Lyons, she apparently later supported Michael's policy and was forced to recant that position publicly in 1283. As dowager empress she restored Constantinople's Lips monastery. She died on 4 March 1303.
