zh: 狄奥多拉·巴列奥略（约1240—1303），又称狄奥多拉·瓦塔泽娜，是约翰·杜卡斯与优多基娅·安格丽娜之女、尼西亚皇帝约翰三世·瓦塔泽斯的侄孙女。约翰三世将她抚养成人，1253年把她嫁给崭露头角的将领米海尔·巴列奥略。1261年米海尔八世收复君士坦丁堡，她成为皇后；同年她借助牧首阿尔塞尼奥斯之力，挫败了米海尔为霍亨斯陶芬的安娜-康斯坦丝而休弃她的打算。她为女儿们安排婚事，为失宠的廷臣求情，并庇护包括帕特摩斯在内的修道院。她起初同情反对1274年里昂公会议教会合并的人，后来似乎转而支持米海尔的政策，1283年被迫公开撤回这一立场。成为皇太后之后，她重修君士坦丁堡的利普斯修道院。她于1303年3月4日去世。

en: Theodora Porphyrogenita (c. 980–1056) was the last sovereign of Byzantium's Macedonian dynasty and the youngest daughter of Constantine VIII. In 1028 she refused to marry Romanos Argyros, arguing that he was already married and too closely related to her. Accused of conspiracy, she was forced into the Petrion monastery as a nun in 1031. The 1042 uprising against Michael V brought her out to rule jointly with her sister Zoe until Zoe married Constantine IX. When Constantine died in January 1055, the aged Theodora took sole power despite opposition from court officials and military claimants. She reigned until her death on 31 August 1056, the end of the Macedonian line.
zh: 生于紫室者狄奥多拉（约980—1056）是拜占庭马其顿王朝的末代君主，君士坦丁八世的幼女。1028年她拒绝嫁给罗曼努斯·阿吉罗斯，理由是他已有妻室，且与她的血缘过近。她被控参与阴谋，于1031年被迫进入佩特里昂修道院为修女。1042年反对米海尔五世的起义把她接出修道院，与姐姐佐伊共同执政，直到佐伊嫁给君士坦丁九世。1055年1月君士坦丁去世后，年迈的狄奥多拉不顾宫廷官员与军方觊觎者的反对独自掌权，统治至1056年8月31日去世，马其顿王朝世系也随她而终。

en: Theodora Kantakouzene (c. 1330–c. 1396) was a daughter of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos and Irene Asanina. In January 1346 she was betrothed to the Ottoman ruler Orhan Gazi to seal her father's alliance during the Byzantine civil war; that summer she was received by his envoys at Selymbria and escorted to Bithynia, where the wedding took place. Unusually, she kept her Christian faith and worked to protect Christians under Ottoman rule. Halil Bey, often considered her son although his parentage is disputed, was executed by his half-brother Murad I after Orhan died in 1362. Theodora spent her later years in Constantinople, held at Galata by Andronikos IV in 1379–1381.
zh: 狄奥多拉·坎塔库泽努斯（约1330—约1396）是皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯与伊琳妮·阿森尼娜之女。1346年1月，为在内战中巩固父亲与奥斯曼埃米尔国的同盟，她被许配给奥斯曼统治者奥尔汗·加齐；同年夏，奥尔汗的使节在塞林布里亚迎接她，并护送她前往比提尼亚完婚。她婚后仍保持基督教信仰，致力保护奥斯曼统治下的基督徒。1362年奥尔汗死后，哈利勒贝伊被异母兄穆拉德一世处死；哈利勒常被认为是狄奥多拉之子，但其母系身份存疑。狄奥多拉晚年回到君士坦丁堡，1379至1381年被安德洛尼卡四世囚禁在加拉塔。

en: Theodora Komnene (born 15 January 1096) was a Byzantine princess, the fourth daughter of Emperor Alexios I Komnenos and Irene Doukaina. Born in Constantinople, she was married first around 1111 to the nobleman Constantine Kourtikes, who died childless before 1118, and then, about 1122, to Constantine Angelos of Philadelphia. By Angelos she had seven children, including John Doukas and Andronikos Angelos Doukas. Her grandsons Isaac II and Alexios III Angelos both became emperors, making her ancestress of the Angelos dynasty. She is last attested in October 1136.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/狄奥多拉·科穆宁娜_(阿莱克修斯一世之女)
zh: 狄奥多拉·科穆宁娜（1096年1月15日生）是拜占庭公主，阿莱克修斯一世·科穆宁与伊琳娜·杜卡伊娜的第四女，生于君士坦丁堡。她约1111年先嫁贵族君士坦丁·库尔提基斯，无子女，1118年之前丧夫；约1122年改嫁来自费拉德尔菲亚的君士坦丁·安格洛斯。她与安格洛斯生有七名子女，包括约翰·杜卡斯和安德罗尼科斯·安格洛斯·杜卡斯。她的孙辈伊萨克二世与阿莱克修斯三世·安格洛斯都登上皇位，她也因此成为安格洛斯王朝的先妣。1136年10月是她最后一次见载的时间。

en: Theodora Palaiologina Angelina Kantakouzene was the wife of Michael Kantakouzenos, epitropos of the Morea, and mother of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos. After John's regency was overthrown at Constantinople in 1341, she was held under house arrest and died from mistreatment in confinement.
zh: 狄奥多拉·巴列奥略·安杰琳娜是摩里亚总管米哈伊尔·坎塔库泽努斯之妻、皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯之母。1341年约翰的摄政局面在君士坦丁堡被政敌推翻后，她遭到软禁，因在囚禁中受虐待而死。

en: Theodora Syrgiannaina (c. 1305–1347 or 1349) was a Byzantine noblewoman of the Syrgiannes family who became queen consort of Armenian Cilicia. In 1330–1332 she married Guy de Lusignan, Byzantine governor of Serres, as his second wife. Elected king of Cilician Armenia in 1342 as Constantine II, her husband was killed in a baronial uprising in April 1344. Their daughter Isabella of Lusignan later married Manuel Kantakouzenos, Despot of the Morea. Theodora died in Constantinople in 1347 or 1349.
zh: 狄奥多拉·西尔伊安奈娜（约1305—1347或1349年）是西尔伊安诺斯家族的拜占庭贵妇，后成为奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王后。1330至1332年间，她嫁给时任塞雷总督的吕西尼昂的居伊，为其第二任妻子。1342年居伊被拥立为奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王，称康斯坦丁二世，1344年4月在贵族叛乱中被杀。两人的女儿吕西尼昂的伊莎贝拉后来嫁给摩里亚专制公曼努埃尔·坎塔库泽努斯。狄奥多拉于1347或1349年在君士坦丁堡去世。

en: Theodore I Laskaris (c. 1175–1221) founded the Empire of Nicaea after the Fourth Crusade. In 1200 he married Anna, daughter of Emperor Alexios III Angelos; when the crusaders seized Constantinople in 1203 he was imprisoned but escaped to Bithynia and organized Greek resistance in his father-in-law's name. His position improved after Bulgaria defeated the Latins at Adrianople in 1205, and he gained the support of most Bithynian nobles. He took imperial titles in 1205 and was crowned by a new patriarch at Nicaea in 1208. In 1211 he routed a Seljuk invasion and captured Alexios III, and in 1212 made peace with the Latin emperor Henry of Flanders. He died in November 1221, succeeded by his son-in-law John III Vatatzes.
zh: 狄奥多尔一世·拉斯卡里斯（约1175—1221）在第四次十字军之后建立尼西亚帝国。1200年他娶皇帝阿莱克修斯三世·安格洛斯之女安娜；1203年十字军攻占君士坦丁堡时他被囚禁，随后逃到比提尼亚，以岳父的名义组织希腊人抵抗。1205年保加利亚人在阿德里安堡击败拉丁人后，他的处境得到改善，并争取到多数比提尼亚贵族的支持。1205年他采用皇帝头衔，1208年在尼西亚由新选出的牧首加冕。1211年他击溃塞尔柱人的入侵并俘获阿莱克修斯三世，1212年与拉丁帝国皇帝佛兰德斯的亨利议和。1221年11月去世，由女婿约翰三世·瓦塔泽斯继位。

en: Theodore II Doukas Laskaris (1221/1222–1258) ruled the Empire of Nicaea from 1254. The only son of John III Vatatzes and Irene Laskarina, he was schooled by Nikephoros Blemmydes and George Akropolites, and in 1235 married Elena Asenina, daughter of Bulgaria's Ivan Asen II. From 1241 he governed in Asia Minor during his father's Balkan campaigns. In 1254 he allied with the Sultan of Rum against the Mongols. As emperor he repelled a Bulgarian invasion in 1256 and forced Michael II of Epirus to cede Dyrrachium, reforming the army around native Anatolian soldiers. He died in August 1258, leaving George Mouzalon as regent for his young son John IV; within days Mouzalon was murdered and Michael Palaiologos seized the throne.
zh: 狄奥多尔二世·杜卡斯·拉斯卡里斯（1221/1222—1258）于1254年成为尼西亚帝国皇帝。他是约翰三世·瓦塔泽斯与伊琳妮·拉斯卡琳娜的独子，师从尼基弗鲁斯·布勒米德斯和乔治·阿克罗波利特斯，1235年娶保加利亚沙皇伊凡·阿森二世之女埃列娜·阿森妮娜。自1241年起，他在父亲远征巴尔干时留守小亚细亚。1254年，他与罗姆苏丹结盟对抗蒙古人。在位期间，他于1256年击退入侵色雷斯和马其顿的保加尔军队，迫使伊庇鲁斯的米哈伊尔二世割让都拉斯，并以安纳托利亚本地士兵为兵源改革军队。1258年8月他病逝，遗命乔治·穆扎隆辅佐幼子约翰四世；不出十天穆扎隆即遭杀害，米哈伊尔·巴列奥略夺取皇位。

en: Theodosius I (347–395), known as the Great, was born at Cauca in Hispania, son of General Theodosius the Elder. He fought the Sarmatians in Moesia in 374, then was forced into retirement around the time his father was executed. After Valens fell at Adrianople, Gratian made him eastern augustus in 379. His depleted armies could not drive out the Goths, and in 382 he settled them south of the Danube as autonomous allies. The Edict of Thessalonica (380) and Council of Constantinople (381) made Nicene Christianity orthodoxy, and in 386 he partitioned Armenia with Persia. He defeated the usurpers Magnus Maximus in 388 and Eugenius in 394, becoming the last emperor of the whole Roman Empire. He died at Milan on 17 January 395, leaving east and west to Arcadius and Honorius.
zh: 狄奥多西一世（347—395），后世称狄奥多西大帝，生于西班牙的考卡，是大将老狄奥多西之子。374年他在默西亚抗击萨尔马提亚人，此后被迫退隐，其父也在前后不久被处死。瓦伦斯战死于阿德里安堡后，格拉提安于379年立他为东部奥古斯都。他兵力不足，无法驱逐哥特人，382年将他们安置在多瑙河以南，作为自治的同盟者。380年的《萨洛尼卡敕令》与381年的君士坦丁堡公会议将尼西亚基督教定为正统，386年他又与波斯瓜分亚美尼亚。388年、394年他先后平定马格努斯·马克西穆斯与尤吉尼厄斯的叛乱，成为最后一位统治整个罗马帝国的皇帝。395年1月17日他卒于米兰，东部传予阿卡狄乌斯，西部传予霍诺留。

en: Theodosius II (401–450), called the Calligrapher, was the only son of Arcadius and Aelia Eudoxia. Made co-augustus in January 402 at nine months old, he became sole eastern emperor in May 408. Early government fell to the prefect Anthemius, who built the Theodosian Walls, and from 414 to his elder sister Pulcheria. In 421 he married Aelia Eudocia, who came from Athens. In 425 he founded the University of Constantinople and installed Valentinian III as western emperor. The Codex Theodosianus, published in 438, collected imperial edicts issued since Constantine I. His reign saw the Council of Ephesus (431) and heavy tribute to Attila's Huns. He died on 28 July 450 after a riding accident.
zh: 狄奥多西二世（401—450），人称“书法家”，是阿卡狄乌斯与欧多西亚的独子。402年1月，年仅九个月的他被立为共治奥古斯都，408年5月父亲去世后成为东部唯一皇帝。朝政早年由主持修建狄奥多西城墙的安特米乌斯执掌，414年起由其姊普尔喀丽亚监护。421年他娶来自雅典的艾莉娅·欧多基娅为妻。425年他创办君士坦丁堡大学，并扶立瓦伦提尼安三世为西部皇帝。438年颁行的《狄奥多西法典》汇集了君士坦丁一世以来的皇帝敕令。他在位期间还经历了431年以弗所公会议，以及向阿提拉的匈人缴纳巨额贡金。450年7月28日他因坠马伤重而死。

en: Theodosius III (died c. 754) was a tax collector at Adramyttium when the Byzantine navy and Opsician troops mutinied against Anastasius II in 715 and proclaimed the reluctant official emperor. His forces took Constantinople late that year. He restored the image of the Sixth Ecumenical Council in the Great Palace, but the Anatolic and Armeniac themes rejected him as an Opsician puppet. He bought Bulgar aid from Khan Tervel, ceding Zagoria and paying tribute, to face Leo the Isaurian's revolt and an Umayyad invasion. After Leo captured his son at Nicomedia, Theodosius abdicated on 25 March 717 and spent his remaining years as a monk.
zh: 狄奥多西三世（？—约754）本是阿德拉米蒂姆的税务官。715年，拜占庭海军与奥普西金军区军队起兵反对阿纳斯塔修斯二世，逼迫不愿称帝的他登上皇位。他的军队于当年末攻占君士坦丁堡。他恢复了大皇宫中第六次大公会议的图像，但安纳托利亚和亚美尼亚军区拒绝承认，视其为奥普西金人的傀儡。他向保加利亚汗特尔维尔割让扎戈里亚、缴纳贡金以换取援助，应对利奥三世的叛乱和倭马亚人的入侵。利奥在尼科米底亚俘获他的儿子后，狄奥多西于717年3月25日退位，在修道院中度过余生。

en: Theodote Glabaina Tarchaneiotissa was probably a daughter of the Byzantine general Michael Doukas Glabas Tarchaneiotes. She is identified as the wife of the general Chandrenos and mother of Theodora Palaiologina Angelina, making her the maternal grandmother of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos.
zh: 塞奥多塔·格拉瓦伊娜·塔尔哈尼奥蒂莎可能是拜占庭将领米哈伊尔·杜卡斯·格拉瓦斯·塔尔哈尼奥蒂斯之女，被认定为将领汉德雷诺斯之妻、狄奥多拉·巴列奥略吉娜·安格丽娜之母，即皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽诺斯的外祖母。

en: Theophilos (c. 812–842), Amorian emperor, was crowned co-emperor by his father Michael II in 821 and ruled alone from 829. Educated by John the Grammarian, he executed his father's accomplices in Leo V's murder to prove his justice. His 832 edict banning icon veneration made him Byzantium's last iconoclast ruler, and he persecuted defiant clerics. He won at Charsianon in 831 and took Melitene in 837, but Caliph al-Mu'tasim sacked Amorion, the ancestral home of his dynasty, in 838; Palermo also fell to the Arabs after a year-long siege in 831. He died on 20 January 842, and his widow Theodora soon restored the icons.
zh: 狄奥菲洛斯（约812—842）是阿摩里亚王朝皇帝，821年被父亲米海尔二世加冕为共治皇帝，829年开始亲政。他师从文法家约翰，即位后处死参与谋杀利奥五世的父亲旧党，以彰显正义。832年他下诏禁止崇拜圣像，成为拜占庭最后一位推行圣像破坏政策的皇帝，并迫害抗命的教士。他在831年的哈西安农之战获胜，837年攻取梅利蒂尼，但哈里发穆阿台绥姆于838年攻陷了其王朝祖籍地阿莫利翁；巴勒莫也在被围一年后于831年落入阿拉伯人之手。842年1月20日狄奥菲洛斯去世，遗孀塞奥多拉很快恢复了圣像崇拜。

en: Tiberius II Constantine (c. 535–582), a Thracian commander of the Excubitor guard, was the trusted friend of Justin II. In 569 Justin sent him to negotiate with the Avars, but rejected the agreement he reached. Justin adopted him and named him Caesar in 574 during his madness. Tiberius governed with Empress Sophia, and in September 578 the dying Justin crowned him Augustus before his death on 4 October. Sophia later plotted to overthrow Tiberius after he refused to marry her; the conspiracy failed. A generous ruler, he gave away thousands of pounds of gold and ended Monophysite persecution. His general Maurice raided into Persia, but in 582 the Avars seized Sirmium and Slavs overran the Balkans. Dying, he made Maurice co-emperor on 13 August 582 and died the next day.
zh: 提比略二世·君士坦丁（约535—582）出身色雷斯，曾任执盾军统领，是查士丁二世信赖的挚友。569年查士丁派他与阿瓦尔人谈判，却否决了他达成的协议。574年，精神失常的查士丁收他为养子、立为凯撒，提比略于是与索菲亚皇后共同理政；578年9月，弥留之际的查士丁加冕他为奥古斯都，10月4日查士丁去世后他独掌大权。索菲亚后来因他拒绝与她成婚而谋划推翻他，但密谋失败。他以慷慨闻名，散发数千磅黄金，并停止迫害基督一性论派。将领莫里斯深入波斯作战，但582年阿瓦尔人夺取锡尔米乌姆，斯拉夫人涌入巴尔干。临终时，他于582年8月13日立莫里斯为共治皇帝，次日去世。

en: Tiberius III, born Apsimar, a droungarios in the Cibyrrhaeot Theme, served in the failed expedition sent by Leontius to recover Carthage from the Umayyads in 696. On Crete the mutineers killed their commander John and hailed him emperor; he sailed to Constantinople and deposed Leontius in 698. He repaired the sea walls, reorganized the naval themes, and let his brother Heraclius raid Cilicia and Syria, winning a victory at Sisium in 704. In 698–699 Tiberius negotiated the return of displaced Cypriots from Cyzicus and Syria to their island. In 705 Justinian II returned with a Bulgar and Slav army and retook the city. Tiberius was captured in Bithynia and beheaded with Leontius on 15 February 706.
zh: 提比略三世本名阿普西玛尔，是基比拉奥特军区的舰队指挥官，696年参加利昂提奥斯收复迦太基的远征，行动失败。退守克里特岛时，哗变官兵杀死指挥官约翰，拥立他为帝；他率舰队驶往君士坦丁堡，于698年推翻利昂提奥斯。他修复海墙、整顿海军军区，并派弟弟希拉克略深入奇里乞亚与叙利亚袭扰，704年在西西乌姆取胜。698—699年，提比略通过谈判使迁往基济科斯和被掳至叙利亚的塞浦路斯人得以返回故岛。705年，查士丁尼二世率保加利亚人与斯拉夫人的军队返回，夺回都城。提比略在比提尼亚被俘，706年2月15日与利昂提奥斯一同被斩首。

en: Titus (AD 39–81), eldest son of Vespasian, was Roman emperor from 79 to 81. He served as a military tribune in Germania and also served in Britain. Serving under his father in the First Jewish–Roman War, he took command when Vespasian seized power in 69 and in 70 captured Jerusalem and destroyed the Second Temple, a victory commemorated by the Arch of Titus. Under Vespasian he became prefect of the Praetorian Guard and had a controversial relationship with the Jewish queen Berenice. As emperor he inaugurated the Colosseum and aided victims of the Vesuvius eruption of 79 and the great fire of Rome in 80. He died of fever on 13 September 81 after two years' rule, was deified by the Senate, and was succeeded by his brother Domitian.
zh: 提图斯（39—81）是韦斯帕西安的长子，79年至81年任罗马皇帝。他曾在日耳曼尼亚担任军团护民官，也曾在不列颠服役。第一次犹太战争中他随父出征，69年韦斯帕西安称帝后由他继续指挥平叛，于70年攻占耶路撒冷并摧毁第二圣殿，提图斯凯旋门即为纪念此役而建。父亲在位时，他担任禁卫军长官，与犹太女王贝勒尼基的关系也引起争议。在位期间，他为罗马斗兽场举行落成典礼，并赈济79年维苏威火山喷发与80年罗马大火的灾民。他在位仅两年有余，于81年9月13日病逝，被元老院神化，皇位由其弟图密善继承。

en: Trajan (53–117), born Marcus Ulpius Traianus at Italica in Hispania, was Roman emperor from 98 to 117, the second of the Five Good Emperors. In 89 he supported Domitian against a revolt on the Rhine and later governed Germania and Pannonia. After a revolt by the Praetorian Guard, the childless Nerva adopted him as heir in 97. As princeps he expanded the alimenta welfare scheme and built Trajan's Forum and Column in Rome. His armies annexed Nabataea in 106, conquered Dacia in 101–106, and after 115 overran Parthian Armenia and Mesopotamia, carrying the empire to its greatest extent. He died at Selinus in 117 and was deified; Hadrian succeeded him.
zh: 图拉真（53—117）原名马库斯·乌尔皮乌斯·图拉真，生于西班牙的意大利迦，98—117年为罗马皇帝，是五贤帝中的第二位。89年他支持图密善镇压莱茵河地区的叛乱，后来总督日耳曼尼亚与潘诺尼亚。近卫军叛乱后，无嗣的涅尔瓦于97年收他为继承人。在位期间他扩大“养育金”福利制度，在罗马修建图拉真广场与图拉真纪功柱。他的军队于106年吞并纳巴泰，101—106年征服达契亚，115年后又攻占帕提亚的亚美尼亚与美索不达米亚，使帝国版图达到极盛。117年他病逝于塞利努斯并被神化，哈德良继位。

en: Trebonianus Gallus (c. 206–253), from a senatorial family of Etruscan ancestry and a former suffect consul, was governing Moesia Superior when Decius fell at Abritus in June 251, whereupon his army proclaimed him emperor. He recognized Decius' surviving son Hostilian as co-emperor and bought peace from the Goths with an annual subsidy. When Hostilian died of plague, Gallus made his own son Volusian his colleague. In 253 Shapur I destroyed a Roman army at Barbalissos and sacked Antioch; raiders also burned the Artemis temple at Ephesus. The Danubian victor Aemilianus was proclaimed emperor and marched on Italy. Gallus summoned Valerian with reinforcements, but he did not arrive in time; Gallus and Volusian were killed at Interamna in August 253.
zh: 特雷伯尼阿努斯·加卢斯（约206—253）出身伊特鲁里亚裔元老家族，曾任补任执政官，251年6月正出任上梅西亚总督，德西乌斯在阿伯里图斯阵亡后，他的军队随即拥立他为帝。他承认德西乌斯在世的儿子霍斯蒂利安为共治皇帝，又以每年向哥特人支付补助金为代价换取和约。霍斯蒂利安死于瘟疫后，加卢斯改立自己的儿子沃鲁西安努斯为共治皇帝。253年，沙普尔一世在巴尔巴利苏斯歼灭一支罗马军队并洗劫安条克；蛮族海寇还焚毁了以弗所的阿耳忒弥斯神庙。多瑙河前线的胜利者埃米利亚努斯被拥立为帝，进军意大利。加卢斯召瓦勒良率援军前来，却未及抵达；253年8月，加卢斯与沃鲁西安努斯在因特兰纳遇害。

en: Valens (328–378) ruled the eastern Roman Empire as augustus from 364, when his brother Valentinian I made him co-emperor at Constantinople. He suppressed the usurpation of Procopius in 366 and campaigned across the Danube against the Goths in 367 and 369, before spending years on the Persian frontier in Armenia. In Constantinople he inaugurated the aqueduct that bears his name. After he allowed fleeing Goths to cross the Danube in 376, their mismanaged settlement in the Balkans led to war. Valens returned from the east to fight them, but failed to coordinate with his nephew Gratian, the western emperor. At Adrianople on 9 August 378, Valens and much of his army perished.
zh: 瓦伦斯（328—378）于364年成为统治罗马帝国东部的奥古斯都，其兄瓦伦提尼安一世在君士坦丁堡立他为共治皇帝。366年他平定普罗科皮乌斯叛乱，367年和369年两度渡过多瑙河征讨哥特人，此后长年驻守亚美尼亚一带的波斯边境。他在君士坦丁堡主持落成了以他命名的水道。376年他允许逃难的哥特人渡过多瑙河，在巴尔干安置失当引发战争。瓦伦斯从东线返回迎敌，却未能与侄子、西部皇帝格拉提安协调行动。378年8月9日阿德里安堡一役中，瓦伦斯与麾下大军一同覆灭。

en: Valentinian I (321–375), born at Cibalae in Pannonia to an Illyro-Roman military family, rose in rank under Constantius II, Julian and Jovian, and after Jovian's death was proclaimed emperor in February 364. Weeks later he made his brother Valens co-emperor at Constantinople, keeping the Western provinces for himself. The Alamanni invaded Gaul in 365; Valentinian fought them again at Solicinium in 368. He campaigned successfully against the Alamanni, Quadi and Sarmatians, strengthened the Rhine and Danube frontiers, and sent Theodosius the Elder to restore Roman rule in Britain and Africa. On 17 November 375, enraged by Quadi envoys at Brigetio, he died of a stroke; his sons Gratian and Valentinian II succeeded him.
zh: 瓦伦提尼安一世（321—375）出生于潘诺尼亚的齐巴莱，属伊利里亚—罗马军人家庭，在君士坦提乌斯二世、尤利安与约维安麾下逐级升迁，约维安死后于364年2月被拥立为帝。数周后，他在君士坦丁堡立弟弟瓦伦斯为共治皇帝，自己管辖西部诸行省。阿勒曼尼人于365年入侵高卢；瓦伦提尼安于368年在索利基尼乌姆再次与他们交战。他屡次击败阿勒曼尼人、夸迪人与萨尔马提亚人，加固莱茵河与多瑙河边防，并派老狄奥多西恢复罗马在不列颠与阿非利加的统治。375年11月17日，他在布里格提奥怒斥夸迪使者时中风而死，其子格拉提安与瓦伦提尼安二世继位。

en: Valerian (c. 199–260 or 264), born Publius Licinius Valerianus into a noble senatorial family, was princeps senatus in 238 and a senior general under Decius and Trebonianus Gallus. In 253 Gallus summoned him against the rebel Aemilianus, but was killed before he arrived. Valerian's soldiers proclaimed him emperor, and Aemilianus was killed by his own troops. Valerian at once made his son Gallienus co-emperor, taking the eastern frontier for himself while his son held the West. He recovered Antioch from the Persians and in 257–258 issued edicts persecuting the Christians. After plague weakened his army at Edessa, Shapur I of Persia defeated and captured him in 260, the first Roman emperor taken prisoner. He died in Persian captivity.
zh: 瓦勒良（约199—260或264），全名普布里乌斯·利奇尼乌斯·瓦勒里安努斯，出身显贵的元老家族，238年任首席元老，后在德西乌斯和特雷伯尼阿努斯·加卢斯麾下为大将。253年加卢斯召他讨伐叛将埃米利亚努斯，却在他抵达前被杀。瓦勒良的士兵拥立他为帝，埃米利亚努斯也被自己的士兵杀死。瓦勒良随即立儿子加里恩努斯为共治皇帝，自己负责东方边防，儿子则负责西方。他从波斯人手中收复安条克，又于257至258年颁布迫害基督徒的敕令。后来瘟疫在埃德萨重创他的军队，260年他被波斯国王沙普尔一世击败俘虏——首位被俘的罗马皇帝，最终客死波斯。

en: Vespasian (AD 9–79) was Roman emperor from 69 to 79 and founder of the Flavian dynasty. He commanded Legio II Augusta in the invasion of Britain in 43 and later suppressed the Jewish revolt of 66–70. Nero's death in 68 plunged Rome into civil war. In the Year of the Four Emperors his legions proclaimed him emperor at Alexandria on 1 July 69. He allied with Mucianus, governor of Syria, and took control of Egypt while his forces advanced on Rome and overthrew Vitellius that December. As emperor he restored state finances, began the Flavian Amphitheatre, the Colosseum, and extended Roman rule in Britain through Agricola. He died on 23 June 79 and was succeeded by his son Titus.
zh: 韦斯帕西安（9—79）69年至79年任罗马皇帝，是弗拉维王朝的开创者。他于43年罗马入侵不列颠时指挥第二奥古斯塔军团成名，其后领兵镇压66—70年的犹太人起义。68年尼禄去世后，罗马陷入内战。四帝之年，他的军团于69年7月1日在亚历山大拥立他称帝。他与叙利亚总督穆基安努斯结盟并控制埃及，其军队则进军罗马，于同年12月推翻维特里乌斯。在位期间他整顿财政，动工兴建弗拉维圆形剧场，即罗马斗兽场，并派阿格里科拉扩展罗马在不列颠的统治。79年6月23日去世，其子提图斯继位。

en: Vitellius (AD 15–69) was a Roman noble from Campania who befriended Caligula on Capri. He was consul in 48 and proconsul of Africa around 60–61, and Galba appointed him to command the army of Germania Inferior in 68. In January 69 the Rhine legions proclaimed him emperor, and in April he defeated Otho at the first Battle of Bedriacum and gained the Senate's recognition. The eastern armies then declared for Vespasian, whose general Antonius Primus crushed Vitellius at the second Battle of Bedriacum. His attempt to abdicate was blocked by his guard; Vespasian's troops stormed Rome, and Vitellius was killed there on 20 December 69 after an eight-month reign.
zh: 维特里乌斯（公元15—69年）是坎帕尼亚出身的罗马贵族，曾在卡普里岛与卡利古拉结为朋友。他于48年任执政官，约60至61年任阿非利加总督，68年被加尔巴任命为下日耳曼尼亚军队统帅。69年1月，莱茵军团拥戴他称帝；4月，他在第一次贝德里亚库姆战役中击败奥托，得到元老院承认。东方军团则拥立韦斯巴芗，其部将安东尼·普里姆斯在第二次贝德里亚库姆战役中击溃维特里乌斯。他试图退位，却被禁卫军阻止；韦斯巴芗的军队攻陷罗马，维特里乌斯于69年12月20日在城中被杀，在位八个月。

en: Zeno (c. 425–491), born Tarasicodissa in Isauria, was Eastern Roman emperor in 474–475 and again from 476. In 466 he married Leo I's daughter Ariadne; their son Leo II made him emperor but died within months. He made peace with the Vandals early in his reign. Driven out by Basiliscus in 475, he retook Constantinople in 476 after the general Illus defected. Odoacer deposed Romulus Augustulus, sending the Western regalia to Zeno and gaining recognition in Italy. Zeno later suppressed a revolt by Illus. He directed Theodoric the Great against Odoacer, and his 482 Henotikon failed to heal the Chalcedonian rift, provoking the Acacian schism. He died in April 491; Ariadne then chose Anastasius I.
zh: 芝诺（约425—491）是东罗马帝国皇帝，474年至475年首次在位，476年复辟。他生于伊苏利亚，原名塔拉西科迪萨，466年娶利奥一世之女阿里阿德涅；二人之子利奥二世使他成为皇帝，但孩子数月后夭折。他在位初期与汪达尔人议和。475年他被巴西利斯库斯逐走，476年因将领伊卢斯倒戈而收复君士坦丁堡。同年奥多亚塞废黜罗慕路斯·奥古斯图卢斯，把西罗马帝徽送往芝诺处，芝诺则承认其在意大利的统治。芝诺后来平定了伊卢斯的叛乱。他派狄奥多里克大王前去对付奥多亚塞；482年颁布的《合一诏书》未能平息迦克墩派争端，反而引发阿卡西乌分裂。491年4月他去世，阿里阿德涅选定阿纳斯塔修斯一世继位。

en: Zoe Porphyrogenita (c. 978–1050) was a Macedonian-dynasty Byzantine empress, the second daughter of Constantine VIII. Her planned marriage to Emperor Otto III collapsed at his death in 1002, and she spent decades confined to the palace women's quarters. In 1028 her dying father married her to Romanos III Argyros. When Romanos was found dead in his bath in 1034, she wed Michael IV the same day. In 1041 she adopted her dying husband's nephew, the future Michael V, who later exiled her. A popular rising against him in 1042 placed Zoe and her sister Theodora on the throne as joint empresses; two months later she married Constantine IX Monomachos and remained Augusta until her death.
zh: 生于紫室者佐伊（约978—1050）是马其顿王朝的拜占庭女皇，君士坦丁八世的二女儿。她与神圣罗马皇帝奥托三世的联姻因后者于1002年去世而落空，此后被长年安置在皇宫后宫。1028年，临终的父亲把她嫁给罗曼努斯三世·阿吉罗斯。1034年罗曼努斯被发现死在浴池中，她当天便改嫁米海尔四世。1041年，她收养了垂死的丈夫的侄子，即后来的米海尔五世；米海尔随后流放了她。1042年，一场反对米海尔的民众起义把她与妹妹狄奥多拉推上皇位共同执政；两个月后她嫁给君士坦丁九世·莫诺马霍斯，并以奥古斯塔的身份直至去世。

en: Madana Varman was a raja of Chamba, a Rajput kingdom in the Punjab Himalaya, named in the genealogy of the state's Varman rulers several generations before Vairasi Varman (r. 1330–1370); his own dates and deeds are unrecorded.
zh: 摩陀那·跋摩是旁遮普山区印度教拉杰普特王国昌巴的拉贾，名字保存在昌巴跋摩王族的传世谱系中，在1330至1370年在位的瓦伊拉西·跋摩之前数代，其生卒年与在位事迹均无记载。

en: Cesare Borgia (1475–1507) was the illegitimate son of Cardinal Rodrigo Borgia, later Pope Alexander VI. Made archbishop of Valencia after his father's election in 1492 and cardinal in 1493, he resigned in 1498 after his brother's murder and became Duke of Valentinois under Louis XII of France. Commanding papal armies, he took Imola, Forlì and Faenza, became Duke of Romagna in 1501, and seized Urbino in 1502 before executing his condottieri at Senigallia. His father's death in 1503 left him exposed to Pope Julius II; imprisoned in Spain, he escaped to Navarre and was killed at Viana in 1507. His career inspired Machiavelli's The Prince.
zh: 切萨雷·波吉亚（1475—1507）是枢机罗德里戈·波吉亚（后来的教宗亚历山大六世）的私生子。1492年父亲当选教宗后他出任瓦伦西亚大主教，1493年升为枢机，1498年在兄长乔瓦尼遇刺后辞职，被法王路易十二封为瓦伦蒂诺公爵。他统率教皇军队，连克伊莫拉、弗利和法恩扎，1501年受封罗马涅公爵，1502年用计夺取乌尔比诺，随后在塞尼加利亚处死谋反的雇佣军首领。1503年父亲去世后，他失势于教宗儒略二世，被囚于西班牙，后逃到纳瓦拉，1507年在比亚纳被杀。他的经历启发了马基雅维利写作《君主论》。

en: Guy de Lévis de Ventadour (c. 1302–1352) was a French prelate, a son of Hélie VIII, Viscount of Ventadour in the Limousin, and Marguerite de Beaujeu, from a family rich in bishops: his brothers Élie and Guillaume both held the see of Tournai. He became bishop of Cambrai in 1342 and found a diocese in crisis, where many priests ignored the duty to reside in their parishes and left poorly trained substitutes, called deservitors, in their place. In 1345 he issued a statute ordering the deservitors to present themselves to him on pain of excommunication, and allowing priests to leave their parishes only with his permission. The reform did not last. Transferred to the see of Vabres in 1349, he soon saw the Cambrai chapter undo his measures. He remained bishop of Vabres until his death in 1352.
zh: 居伊·德·勒维·德·旺塔杜尔（约1302—1352）是法国高级教士，为利穆赞的旺塔杜尔子爵埃利八世与玛格丽特·德·博热之子，出自一个多出主教的家族，兄弟埃利和纪尧姆都做过图尔奈主教。1342年他出任康布雷主教，接手的是一个陷入危机的教区：许多神父不履行驻堂义务，把教务交给被称为“代牧”的训练不足者顶替。1345年他颁布规章，勒令代牧到主教面前报到，违者处以绝罚，神父离开教区须获主教许可。这些改革没能持久。1349年他调任瓦布尔主教，康布雷教士团很快废除了他的措施。他一直担任瓦布尔主教，直至1352年去世。

en: Guillaume d'Avesnes (1254–1296) was a French prelate and bishop of Cambrai, a son of John I of Avesnes, Count of Hainaut, and Adelaide of Holland. Provost of Cambrai when he was elected bishop in 1286 after the death of Enguerrand de Créqui, he quarrelled bitterly with his cathedral chapter, which was at war with his brother John II, Count of Hainaut. In 1288 Guillaume himself disputed the village of Blarignies with John; their brother Bouchard intervened, and the count recovered the village. In 1291 Guillaume helped John put down the townsmen's revolt at Valenciennes. He died in 1296 while journeying to Jerusalem.
zh: 纪尧姆·德·阿韦讷（1254—1296）是法国高级教士、康布雷主教，为埃诺伯爵约翰一世·德·阿韦讷与荷兰的阿德莱德之子。1286年昂盖朗·德·克雷基去世后，时任康布雷教务长的他当选主教。他与主教座堂教士团关系恶劣，教士团当时正与他的兄长、埃诺伯爵约翰二世交战。1288年，纪尧姆自己也因布拉里尼村与约翰发生争执；他们的兄弟布沙尔出面调停，伯爵收回了村庄。1291年，他协助约翰镇压了瓦朗谢讷市民的起义。1296年，他在前往耶路撒冷的途中去世。

en: William II d'Auxonne was a French prelate born at Avesnes. A canon of Paris, he was made bishop of Cambrai in 1336, taking over a border city that both Edward III and Philip VI wanted once the Hundred Years' War began. He sided with France. Edward's siege failed in 1339, but his army devastated the Cambrésis on its retreat and left a garrison at Thun-l'Évêque, whose raids drove the citizens to appeal to the Duke of Normandy. William secured papal intervention against the hostile count of Hainaut, and in January 1339 Pope Benedict XII annulled the proceedings Edward had begun against him. The townsmen won the right to import French goods duty-free, a privilege that lasted until Louis XI. Leaving the ravaged Cambrésis, William moved to the see of Autun in August 1342. He helped found the Collège de Cambrai in Paris with two other prelates, and died at Autun on 30 March 1344 or 1345.
zh: 纪尧姆二世·多克松是14世纪的法国高级教士，生于阿韦讷。他本是巴黎教堂的咏礼司铎，1336年出任康布雷主教，接手的是一座百年战争爆发后英王爱德华三世与法王腓力六世都想夺取的边境城市。他倒向法国。1339年爱德华攻城不克，撤军时蹂躏了康布雷西斯，并在蒂安莱韦克堡留下驻军，其劫掠逼得康布雷居民向诺曼底公爵求援。纪尧姆争取教宗干预，遏制怀有敌意的埃诺伯爵；1339年1月，教宗本笃十二世下诏撤销爱德华对他提起的诉讼。市民获准免税从法国输入所需物资，这一权利一直延续到路易十一时期。1342年8月，他离开残破的康布雷西斯，改任欧坦主教。他还与另外两位高级教士在巴黎创办了康布雷学院，1344或1345年3月30日卒于欧坦。

en: Jules Mazarin, born Giulio Mazzarino (1602–1661), was an Italian prelate and diplomat from Pescina in the Abruzzo. After serving Pope Urban VIII he joined Cardinal Richelieu in 1640, became a cardinal in 1641, and in 1642 chief minister of Louis XIII and Louis XIV, ruling with the regent Anne of Austria. He secured the Peace of Westphalia in 1648 and weathered the Fronde revolts of 1648–1653, moving his base to Germany before returning to Paris in 1653. He allied with England in 1657 and, after Turenne's victory at the Dunes in 1658, signed the Treaty of the Pyrenees in 1659 and arranged Louis XIV's Spanish marriage in 1660. He died at Vincennes on 9 March 1661.
zh: 儒勒·马萨林，本名朱利奥·马扎里诺（1602—1661），是生于阿布鲁佐佩希纳的意大利教士与外交官。他曾在乌尔班八世麾下为教廷效力，1640年转投红衣主教黎塞留，1641年成为枢机，1642年黎塞留去世后出任路易十三及幼王路易十四的首席大臣，与摄政奥地利的安妮共同执政。他促成1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》，度过了1648至1653年的投石党叛乱，期间曾将活动中心转至德意志，1653年重返巴黎。他于1657年与英格兰结盟，又借蒂雷纳1658年沙丘战役的胜利，于1659年签订《比利牛斯条约》，并在1660年安排路易十四迎娶西班牙公主。1661年3月9日他在万塞讷去世。

en: Armand Jean du Plessis, Cardinal Richelieu (1585–1642), born in Paris, was consecrated Bishop of Luçon in 1607 and made cardinal in 1622. From 1624 he was chief minister of Louis XIII. He broke Huguenot political power at the siege of La Rochelle (1627–1628), curbed the great nobles, and survived the Day of the Dupes in 1630. After La Rochelle fell, the Huguenots retained freedom of worship but lost their fortified towns and political privileges. Abroad he subsidized Gustavus Adolphus and brought France into the Thirty Years' War in 1635 against the Habsburgs. He founded the Académie Française in 1635 and the Company of New France, dying in Paris in 1642; Mazarin succeeded him.
zh: 阿尔芒·让·迪普莱西，即红衣主教黎塞留（1585—1642），是生于巴黎的法国教士与政治家，1607年受祝圣为吕松主教，1622年成为枢机。1624年起他担任路易十三的首席大臣。他通过1627至1628年的拉罗谢尔围城战摧毁了胡格诺派的政治势力，压制了大贵族，并在1630年的愚人日危机中保住权位。拉罗谢尔陷落后，胡格诺派保留了信仰自由，却失去了设防城镇和政治特权。对外他资助古斯塔夫·阿道夫，于1635年推动法国加入三十年战争、对抗哈布斯堡家族。他在1635年创立法兰西学院，并组建新法兰西公司；1642年他在巴黎去世，马萨林接掌其职位。

en: Alfonso de la Cerda, called the Disinherited (1270–1333), was the elder son of Ferdinand de la Cerda, heir of Alfonso X, and Blanche of France. When his father died in 1275 his uncle Sancho IV seized the succession. Taken to Aragon by his grandmother Violant, he was kept in the fortress of Xàtiva for thirteen years. Proclaimed king by Alfonso III of Aragon in 1288, he struggled in vain for the crown. Under the 1304 Treaty of Torrellas he gave up his claim to León in return for Alba, Béjar, Gibraleón and other scattered possessions, distributed to prevent him forming an independent dominion. Charles IV of France later made him Baron of Lunel. He swore fealty to Alfonso XI in 1331 and died at Ávila in 1333.
zh: 阿方索·德·拉·塞尔达，绰号“被废嗣者”（1270—1333），是阿方索十世的继承人费尔南多·德·拉·塞尔达与法兰西的布朗什的长子。1275年父亲死后，他的王位继承权被叔父桑乔四世夺走。祖母阿拉贡的维奥兰特把他带往阿拉贡，他在哈蒂瓦城堡被看管了十三年。1288年他被阿拉贡国王阿方索三世拥立为国王，此后为夺回王位徒劳征战。依照1304年《托雷利亚斯条约》，他放弃莱昂王位主张，换得阿尔瓦、贝哈尔、希夫拉莱翁等领地；这些领地分散各处，以防他建立独立势力。后来法王查理四世封他为吕内尔男爵。1331年他向阿方索十一世宣誓效忠，1333年卒于阿维拉。

en: Alfonso of Molina (1202–1272) was an infante of León, son of Alfonso IX and Berengaria of Castile, and younger brother of Ferdinand III. In 1230 he waived his claim to León, leaving it to Ferdinand under the Treaty of Benavente. He fought for his brother in the Reconquista, helping take Córdoba in 1236 and Seville in 1248, where he seized the Torre de Oro. By marrying Mafalda González de Lara in 1240 he became lord of Molina in 1243. His daughter María de Molina married Sancho IV. He died at Salamanca in January 1272.
zh: 莫利纳的阿方索（1202—1272）是莱昂王子，莱昂国王阿方索九世与卡斯蒂利亚的贝伦加利亚之子，费尔南多三世的弟弟。1230年他放弃对莱昂王位的主张，由费尔南多凭《贝纳文特条约》取得莱昂。他随兄长投身收复失地运动，1236年参与攻取科尔多瓦，1248年参与围攻塞维利亚并夺取黄金塔。1240年他娶马法尔达·冈萨雷斯·德·拉腊，1243年成为莫利纳领主。女儿玛丽亚·德·莫利纳嫁给了桑乔四世。1272年1月，他卒于萨拉曼卡。

en: Alfonso VII, called the Emperor (1 March 1105–21 August 1157), was the son of Queen Urraca of León and Raymond of Burgundy, and the first king of the Castilian House of Burgundy. He became king of Galicia in 1111 and succeeded Urraca in León and Castile in 1126. On 26 May 1135 he was crowned Emperor of All Spain in León Cathedral, asserting his claim to authority across the peninsula. He took Coria in 1142 and Almería in 1147, though Portugal's independence was recognized at Zamora in 1143. In 1151 he agreed with Ramon Berenguer IV of Barcelona on their respective zones of conquest. He died in 1157 returning from an expedition against the Almohads, leaving Castile to Sancho III and León to Ferdinand II.
zh: 阿方索七世，人称“皇帝”（1105年3月1日—1157年8月21日），是莱昂女王乌拉卡与勃艮第的雷蒙之子，也是卡斯蒂利亚勃艮第王朝的开国君主。他1111年成为加利西亚国王，1126年在母亲去世后继承莱昂与卡斯蒂利亚王位。1135年5月26日，他在莱昂大教堂加冕为“全西班牙皇帝”，宣示对整个半岛的权威。他于1142年攻取科里亚，1147年攻取阿尔梅里亚，但葡萄牙的独立也在1143年的《萨莫拉条约》中得到承认。1151年，他与巴塞罗那伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世划定各自的征服区域。1157年他在征讨穆瓦希德人的归途中去世，卡斯蒂利亚传给桑乔三世，莱昂传给费尔南多二世。

en: Alfonso VIII, called the Noble (1155–1214), became king of Castile at the age of two in 1158; during his minority his uncle Sancho VI of Navarre seized much of La Rioja. In 1170 he married Eleanor of England, daughter of Henry II and Eleanor of Aquitaine. In 1176 he asked Henry to arbitrate the disputed Navarrese border, recovering much of the territory in return for substantial compensation. After defeat by the Almohads at Alarcos in 1195, he led the Christian coalition that broke Almohad power at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212, turning the tide of the Reconquista. He founded Spain's first university at Palencia and was succeeded by his young son Henry I.
zh: 阿方索八世（1155—1214），绰号“高贵者”，1158年两岁时即位为卡斯蒂利亚国王；在他幼年期间，舅父纳瓦拉国王桑乔六世侵扰卡斯蒂利亚并夺取拉里奥哈大片土地。1170年，他娶英格兰国王亨利二世与阿基坦的埃莉诺之女埃莉诺为妻。1176年，他请亨利仲裁与纳瓦拉的边界争端，以大笔赔偿换回大部分失地。1195年他在阿拉科斯被阿尔摩哈王朝重创，1212年率领基督教联军在纳瓦斯德托洛萨战役击溃阿尔摩哈大军，扭转了收复失地运动的大势。他创办了西班牙第一所大学帕伦西亚学校，死后由幼子恩里克一世继位。

en: Alfonso X, called the Wise (1221–1284), ruled Castile, León and Galicia from 1252. In the 1240s he joined his father in conquering Muslim strongholds including Murcia. Through his Hohenstaufen mother he claimed the German crown and was elected king of the Romans by a rival faction in 1257 against Richard of Cornwall, though he never went to Germany and abandoned the claim in 1275. He debased the coinage to finance his claim. A patron of learning, he sponsored the Alfonsine Tables of astronomy, introduced Castile's first vernacular law code, the Siete Partidas, and founded the Mesta sheep-owners' guild. His later reign was torn by civil war against his son Sancho, who succeeded him as Sancho IV.
zh: 阿方索十世（1221—1284），绰号“智者”，1252年起统治卡斯蒂利亚、莱昂和加利西亚。1240年代，他随父亲征服穆尔西亚等穆斯林据点。他凭借母系霍亨斯陶芬家族的血统主张德意志王位，1257年被一派选侯选为罗马人的国王，与康沃尔的理查对立；但他从未前往德意志，于1275年放弃这一王位要求。他为筹措争夺王位的费用降低了铸币成色。他奖掖学术，主持编纂天文学著作《阿方索星表》，推出卡斯蒂利亚第一部方言法典《七章法典》，还创立了牧羊主行会梅斯塔。他统治末年与儿子桑乔爆发内战，桑乔后来继位为桑乔四世。

en: Alfonso XI (1311–1350), called the Avenger, was king of Castile and León. Born at Salamanca to Ferdinand IV and Constance of Portugal, he inherited the throne at the age of one in 1312, and regents and nobles divided a kingdom the Moors were raiding. The Vega disaster of 1319 killed two of his regents; his grandmother María de Molina, the last, died in 1321. Declared of age at the Cortes of Valladolid in 1325, he set about breaking the nobles; in 1326 he lured Juan the One-eyed to Toro with promises of reconciliation and had him killed. His victory over the Marinid invasion at Río Salado in 1340 and the conquest of Algeciras in 1344 carried Castile to the Strait of Gibraltar. He neglected his queen, Maria of Portugal, for Eleanor of Guzmán, who bore him ten children, among them the future Henry II. He died of plague besieging Gibraltar in March 1350, and Yusuf I of Granada ordered his men not to attack the funeral procession. His son Peter succeeded him.
zh: 阿方索十一世（1311—1350），绰号“复仇者”，是卡斯蒂利亚与莱昂国王。他生于萨拉曼卡，为费尔南多四世与葡萄牙的康斯坦萨之子，1312年一岁即位，摄政者和贵族瓜分王国，摩尔人又趁机劫掠。1319年韦加惨败，两位摄政亲王战死；最后一位摄政、祖母玛丽亚·德·莫利纳于1321年去世。1325年他在巴利亚多利德议会被宣布成年，随即着手压制贵族；1326年他以和解为饵，把“独眼”胡安诱至托罗杀害。1340年，他在里奥萨拉多击败马林王朝的入侵，1344年攻克阿尔赫西拉斯，把卡斯蒂利亚的疆界推到直布罗陀海峡。他冷落王后葡萄牙的玛丽亚，宠爱埃莉诺·德·古斯曼，后者为他生了十个子女，其中就有日后的恩里克二世。1350年3月，他在围攻直布罗陀时染鼠疫去世，格拉纳达的优素福一世下令部下不得袭击送葬的队伍。其子佩德罗继位。

en: Gabriel Alonso de Herrera (1470–1539) was a Spanish agronomist and cleric, born at Talavera de la Reina, who became chaplain to Cardinal Cisneros. After studying in Granada, where he ran market gardens praised as early as 1502, he travelled through Italy and France gathering agricultural knowledge. Commissioned by Cisneros, his Obra de Agricultura was printed at Alcalá de Henares in 1513, blending classical authorities such as Columella and Palladius with Muslim farming practices he had learned in Granada. It covered crops, livestock, veterinary medicine and weather, and examined the effects of food on health. The work ran through many editions and remained a standard handbook into the twentieth century.
zh: 加夫列尔·阿隆索·德·埃雷拉（1470—1539）是西班牙农学家、教士，生于塔拉韦拉·德拉雷纳，后来成为西斯内罗斯枢机的小堂神父。他在格拉纳达求学，1502年便因经营的菜园广受赞誉，此后游历意大利和法国搜集农耕知识。他受西斯内罗斯委托，于1513年在阿尔卡拉·德·埃纳雷斯刊印《农业全书》，把科卢梅拉、帕拉迪乌斯等古典权威的学说与他在格拉纳达学到的穆斯林农耕技术融为一体。该书内容涵盖作物、畜牧、兽医与气象，还探讨饮食对健康的影响。该书多次再版，直到20世纪仍是权威农书手册。

en: Alvar Pérez de Guzmán was a Castilian ricohombre of the House of Guzmán who served as alcalde mayor of Seville. With his wife María Girón he had a son, Pedro Núñez de Guzmán, later mayordomo mayor of Ferdinand IV of Castile.
zh: 阿尔瓦尔·佩雷斯·德·古斯曼是古斯曼家族出身的卡斯蒂利亚高级贵族，曾任塞维利亚市政长官。他娶玛丽亚·希龙为妻，生子佩德罗·努涅斯·德·古斯曼，后来出任卡斯蒂利亚国王费尔南多四世的王室总管。

en: Asher ben Jehiel (c. 1250–1327), known by the Hebrew acronym Rosh, was a German-born Talmudist who became rabbi of Toledo. Probably born in Cologne, he studied under Meir of Rothenburg; after Meir was imprisoned in 1286 Asher raised the ransom he refused and succeeded him in Worms. Driven into exile by official extortion, he settled in Toledo on Solomon ben Aderet's recommendation. His concise abstract of Talmudic law became a cornerstone of halakhah; his son Jacob wrote the Arba'ah Turim. Opposed to Greek philosophy, Asher died in poverty in 1327.
zh: 亚设·本·耶希埃尔（约1250—1327）是生于德意志的塔木德学者，后来出任托莱多拉比，常以希伯来语缩写‘罗什’（意为‘我们的拉比亚设’）为人所知。他可能生于科隆，师从罗滕堡的迈尔；1286年迈尔被囚后，他筹措赎金却被恩师拒绝，随后接任其沃尔姆斯的拉比之职。因遭官府勒索流亡，他经所罗门·本·阿德雷推荐定居托莱多。他的塔木德律法节要是犹太教法的基石之一，其子雅各著有律法经典《四类书》。他反对希腊哲学，1327年在贫困中去世。

en: Martín de Azpilcueta (1492–1586), called Doctor Navarrus, was a Navarrese canonist, theologian and economist, born at Barásoain into a noble family related to Francis Xavier. After studies at Alcalá and Toulouse, he held canon-law chairs at Salamanca from 1524 and taught at Coimbra from 1538 to 1555. With Francisco de Vitoria and Domingo de Soto he was a leading light of the School of Salamanca, and in 1556 he first formulated the quantity theory of money. Philip II entrusted him with the defence of Archbishop Bartolomé Carranza before the Inquisition; Azpilcueta followed the case to Rome in his eighties. He spent his final years in Rome, where Pope Pius V made him counsellor of the Apostolic Penitentiary.
zh: 马丁·德·阿斯皮利奎塔（1492—1586），人称“纳瓦鲁斯博士”，是纳瓦拉的教会法学家、神学家和经济学家，生于巴拉斯奥因的贵族家庭，与方济各·沙勿略是亲戚。他在阿尔卡拉和图卢兹求学后，自1524年起在萨拉曼卡大学担任教会法教席，1538至1555年在科英布拉任教。他与维多利亚、索托同为萨拉曼卡学派的核心人物，1556年率先提出货币数量论。腓力二世委托他为宗教裁判所面前的巴托洛梅·卡兰萨大主教辩护；他八十多岁时为此案赴罗马。他晚年居留罗马，教皇庇护五世任命他为使徒忏悔院顾问。

en: Domingo Báñez (1528–1604) was a Dominican theologian of the later School of Salamanca and its foremost defender of strict Thomism. Born at Valladolid, he entered the Dominicans at Salamanca in 1547, studied under Melchor Cano, taught at Ávila and Alcalá, and in 1577 won the chair of Durandus and in 1581 the university's first chair of theology. He was confessor to Teresa of Ávila. In 1582 a public disputation involving Báñez and the Jesuit Prudencio de Montemayor grew into a debate over free will and predestination. In 1588 he censured the Jesuit Luis de Molina's Concordia on grace and free will, then led the Dominican side until the dispute went before Rome's Congregation of Auxiliis. He died at Medina del Campo.
zh: 多明戈·巴涅斯（1528—1604）是后期萨拉曼卡学派的多明我会神学家，也是严格托马斯主义最主要的捍卫者。他生于巴利亚多利德，1547年在萨拉曼卡进入多明我会，师从梅尔希奥·卡诺，后在阿维拉和阿尔卡拉任教，1577年取得杜兰铎讲席，1581年登上大学首席神学讲席。他曾担任亚维拉的德兰的告解神父。1582年，他与耶稣会士普鲁登西奥·德·蒙特马约尔参与的一场公开辩论演变为关于自由意志与预定的论争。1588年，他斥责耶稣会士路易斯·德·莫利纳论恩典与自由意志的《和谐论》，随后率领多明我会一方论战，直至争端提交罗马的恩助委员会。他逝于梅迪纳德尔坎波。

en: Elisabeth of Swabia, known in Castile as Beatrice (1205–1235), was a Hohenstaufen princess born at Nuremberg, daughter of the German king Philip of Swabia and Irene Angelina, herself a Byzantine emperor's daughter. After her father's murder and her mother's death in 1208, she came under the guardianship of her cousin Frederick. He arranged her marriage to Ferdinand III of Castile at Burgos on 30 November 1219. She became queen of Castile and, in 1230, of León. She bore ten children, including Alfonso X the Wise and Manuel, lord of Villena. She died at Toro on 5 November 1235, probably in childbirth; first buried at Las Huelgas, she was later moved by Alfonso X to Seville Cathedral.
zh: 士瓦本的伊丽莎白，在卡斯蒂利亚称贝娅特丽克丝（1205—1235），是生于纽伦堡的霍恩施陶芬公主，德意志国王士瓦本的腓力与拜占庭皇帝之女伊琳妮·安格洛斯的女儿。1208年父亲遇刺、母亲去世后，她由表兄腓特烈监护。他安排她于1219年11月30日在布尔戈斯嫁给卡斯蒂利亚国王费尔南多三世。她成为卡斯蒂利亚王后，1230年又成为莱昂王后，共生十个子女，包括“智者”阿方索十世和比列纳领主曼努埃尔。1235年11月5日她卒于托罗，死因很可能与分娩有关；她最初葬于拉斯韦尔加斯修道院，阿方索十世后来将她的灵柩迁往塞维利亚大教堂。

en: Berengaria (1179 or 1180–1246), called the Great, was the eldest daughter of Alfonso VIII of Castile and Eleanor of England. Betrothed to Conrad of Swabia, son of Emperor Frederick I, she married her cousin Alfonso IX of León in 1197; Pope Innocent III annulled the union after five children, including the future Ferdinand III. She served as regent for her young brother Henry I after their father's death. When Henry died in 1217, she succeeded as queen of Castile but within months abdicated in favor of her son. In 1230 she secured his accession to León, reuniting Castile and León, and remained his chief counselor until her death. She supported his campaigns in the Reconquista and patronized religious institutions.
zh: 贝伦加利亚（1179或1180—1246），史称“贝伦加利亚大帝”，是卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索八世与英格兰的埃莉诺的长女。她幼年曾与神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈一世之子士瓦本的康拉德订婚，1197年嫁给堂兄莱昂国王阿方索九世；两人生下包括后来的斐迪南三世在内的五个子女后，婚姻被教皇英诺森三世宣布无效。父亲去世后，她为年幼的弟弟恩里克一世摄政。1217年恩里克去世，她继位为卡斯蒂利亚女王，但数月后便让位于儿子。1230年，她促成儿子继承莱昂王位，使卡斯蒂利亚与莱昂重新统一，此后一直是儿子最重要的谋臣，直至去世。她支持儿子的收复失地战争，也资助宗教机构。

en: Pedro Berruguete (c. 1450–c. 1504) was a Castilian painter, born at Paredes de Nava near Palencia, whose work bridges the Gothic and Renaissance styles in Spain. Around 1480 he is thought to have worked in Urbino for Duke Federico da Montefeltro, where a Spaniard named Pietro Spagnuolo is documented, absorbing Italian Renaissance forms and Flemish technique. Back in Castile by 1483, he painted in Toledo and Ávila, producing altarpieces and scenes of the early Inquisition for churches such as Santo Tomás in Ávila. He may have established a studio in Ávila in the 1490s, where many of his paintings were found. Called the first Renaissance painter of Spain, he was the father of sculptor Alonso Berruguete.
zh: 佩德罗·贝鲁格特（约1450—约1504）是卡斯蒂利亚画家，生于帕伦西亚附近的帕雷德斯德纳瓦，画风介于哥特式与文艺复兴之间。约1480年，据信他曾在乌尔比诺为费代里科·达·蒙泰费尔特罗公爵作画——当地文献记载有一位名叫西班牙人皮埃特罗的画师——在那里汲取意大利文艺复兴的造型手法与佛兰德斯技法。1483年前后返回卡斯蒂利亚后，他在托莱多和阿维拉作画，为阿维拉圣托马斯修道院等教堂绘制祭坛画和宗教裁判所早期场景。他可能于1490年代在阿维拉设立画坊，那里留有他的许多画作。他被称为西班牙第一位文艺复兴画家，是雕刻家阿隆索·贝鲁格特之父。

en: Blanca de la Cerda (1311–1347), also Blanca Núñez de Lara, was a Castilian noblewoman, daughter of Fernando de la Cerda and Juana Núñez de Lara, la Palomilla. Through her father she was great-granddaughter of Alfonso X and descendant of Louis IX. In January 1329 she became the third wife of Juan Manuel, Prince of Villena, author of El conde Lucanor. Their son Fernando Manuel de Villena, born in 1332, inherited Escalona, Peñafiel and Villena and served as adelantado mayor of Murcia. Their daughter Juana Manuel married Henry II in 1350 and became Castile's queen.
zh: 布兰卡·德·拉·塞尔达（1311—1347），又称布兰卡·努涅斯·德·拉腊，是卡斯蒂利亚贵妇，费尔南多·德·拉·塞尔达与绰号“飞蛾”的胡安娜·努涅斯·德·拉腊之女。父系上，她是阿方索十世的曾孙女、法兰西国王路易九世的后裔。1329年1月，她嫁给比列纳亲王、《卢卡诺尔伯爵》的作者堂胡安·曼努埃尔，是其第三任妻子。儿子费尔南多·曼努埃尔·德·比列纳生于1332年，后来继承埃斯卡洛纳、佩尼亚菲耶尔和比列纳，任穆尔西亚边防总长；女儿胡安娜·曼努埃尔于1350年嫁给恩里克二世，成为卡斯蒂利亚王后。

en: Blanche of France (1253–c. 1320) was a daughter of Louis IX of France and Margaret of Provence, born at Jaffa in the Kingdom of Jerusalem during her father's Seventh Crusade. On 30 November 1268 she married at Burgos Ferdinand de la Cerda, heir of Alfonso X of Castile, and bore him two sons, Alfonso and Ferdinand. After Ferdinand died in 1275, her sons were displaced in the succession and exiled. The dispute brought France and Castile into conflict: her brother Philip III launched an expedition in 1276, but his army turned back before crossing the Pyrenees. Blanche returned to France and later instigated Guillaume de Saint-Pathus's life of Saint Louis. She retired near a convent in Paris, where she died around 1320.
zh: 法兰西的布朗什（1253—约1320）是法兰西国王路易九世与普罗旺斯的玛格丽特之女，在父亲发动第七次十字军东征期间生于耶路撒冷王国的雅法。1268年11月30日，她在布尔戈斯嫁给卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十世的继承人费尔南多·德·拉塞尔达，生有阿方索、费尔南多二子。1275年丈夫去世后，她的儿子被剥夺继承权并流亡。继承争端引发法兰西与卡斯蒂利亚的冲突：她的兄长腓力三世于1276年发动远征，但法军未越过比利牛斯山便折返。布朗什返回法兰西，晚年推动纪尧姆·德·圣帕蒂撰写圣路易传记。她隐居在巴黎一座修道院附近，约1320年在巴黎去世。

en: Melchor Cano (c. 1509–1560) was a Dominican theologian and a central figure of the School of Salamanca. Born at Tarancón, he entered the Dominicans of Salamanca in 1523 as a pupil of Francisco de Vitoria, taught at Valladolid and Alcalá, and succeeded Vitoria in the chair of theology at Salamanca. There his rivalry with fellow Dominican Bartolomé Carranza divided the university, and Cano took part in his condemnation for heresy. At the Council of Trent he debated the Eucharist, penance and indulgences. In 1552 his Jesuit opponents had him made bishop of the Canary Islands to remove him from Spain; he resigned the see a year later. His De locis theologicis, systematizing theological argument, appeared posthumously in 1563.
zh: 梅尔希奥·卡诺（约1509—1560）是多明我会神学家、萨拉曼卡学派的核心人物。他生于塔兰孔，1523年在萨拉曼卡进入多明我会，师从弗朗西斯科·德·维多利亚，后在巴利亚多利德和阿尔卡拉任教，并接替维多利亚出任萨拉曼卡神学教授。他与同会的巴托洛梅·卡兰萨彼此争斗，使大学分成两派，卡诺还参与了对卡兰萨的异端定罪。特伦托公会议上，他参与圣体、告解与赎罪券之争。1552年，与他敌对的耶稣会士推他出任加那利群岛主教，把他排挤出西班牙，一年后他便辞去主教之职。其《神学论题》系统整理了神学论证方法，于1563年在他身后出版。

en: Francisco Jiménez de Cisneros (1436–1517) was a Franciscan friar who became Queen Isabella I's confessor in 1492 and Archbishop of Toledo in 1495, the richest see in Spain. He reformed the religious orders, founded the University of Alcalá in 1499, and financed the Complutensian Polyglot Bible. He also published the first printed Mozarabic missal and breviary in 1500 and 1502, and established a chapel in Toledo Cathedral for the rite. Made cardinal and Grand Inquisitor in 1507, he led the 1509 conquest of Oran in North Africa. He twice governed Castile as regent, in 1506–1507 and after Ferdinand II's death in 1516, and died at Roa in November 1517 as Charles I arrived from Flanders.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/弗朗西斯科·希梅内斯·德·西斯内罗斯
zh: 弗朗西斯科·希梅内斯·德·西斯内罗斯（1436—1517）原为方济各会修士，1492年成为卡斯蒂利亚女王伊莎贝拉一世的忏悔神父，1495年出任西班牙最富庶的托莱多总教区总主教。他改革各修会，1499年创办阿尔卡拉大学，并出资刊印《康普鲁顿合参本圣经》。他还于1500年和1502年首次印行莫扎拉布礼弥撒经书与日课经，并在托莱多主教座堂设立礼拜堂举行这一礼仪。1507年他成为枢机兼宗教裁判所大裁判长，1509年亲自领军远征北非、攻取奥兰。他两度以摄政身份治理卡斯蒂利亚：1506—1507年，以及1516年斐迪南二世去世之后；1517年11月查理一世从佛兰德抵达之际，他在罗阿病逝。

en: Pedro González de Mendoza (1428–1495), fifth son of Castile's powerful Mendoza house, was a cardinal, statesman and soldier. He studied civil and canon law at Salamanca and was selected as bishop of Calahorra in 1453. He fought for Henry IV at Olmedo in 1467, became bishop of Sigüenza in 1468, and in 1473 cardinal, archbishop of Seville and chancellor of Castile. Backing Isabella, he fought at Toro in 1476 and became archbishop of Toledo and Primate of Spain in 1482. For twenty years he led the royal council, funded the Granada war and entered Granada in 1492. His sway over the Catholic Monarchs earned him the name the Third King; he died at Guadalajara in 1495.
zh: 佩德罗·冈萨雷斯·德·门多萨（1428—1495）是卡斯蒂利亚权门门多萨家族的第五子，集枢机主教、政治家与军人于一身。他在萨拉曼卡学习民法与教会法，1453年获选为卡拉奥拉主教。1467年他在奥尔梅多第二次战役中为恩里克四世作战，1468年任锡古恩萨主教，1473年成为枢机主教、塞维利亚大主教兼卡斯蒂利亚首相。他支持伊莎贝拉，1476年参加托罗战役，1482年出任托莱多大主教、西班牙首主教。他主持御前会议长达二十年，资助格拉纳达战争并于1492年进入攻陷的格拉纳达城。他在天主教双王朝中权势极盛，被称为“第三位国王”，1495年卒于瓜达拉哈拉。

en: Constance of Portugal (1290–1313) was queen of Castile and León as the wife of Ferdinand IV. Eldest child of Denis of Portugal and Elizabeth of Aragon, she was betrothed to Ferdinand under a 1291 treaty, the match ratified at Alcañices in 1297, and married him at Valladolid in January 1302. Her children included Eleanor, later queen of Aragon, and Alfonso XI, born at Salamanca in August 1311. When Ferdinand died at Jaén in September 1312, she escorted his body to Córdoba for burial amid regency quarrels over her infant son. She died at Sahagún in November 1313, aged twenty-three.
zh: 葡萄牙的康斯坦莎（1290—1313）是卡斯蒂利亚与莱昂国王费尔南多四世的王后。她是葡萄牙国王迪尼什与阿拉贡的伊莎贝尔的长女，依1291年的条约与费尔南多订婚，婚约在1297年的《阿尔卡尼塞斯条约》中再获确认，1302年1月两人于巴利亚多利德成婚。她的子女包括后来成为阿拉贡王后的莱昂诺尔，以及1311年8月生于萨拉曼卡的阿方索十一世。1312年9月费尔南多卒于哈恩，她护送灵柩前往科尔多瓦安葬，当时幼子即位，摄政之争正酣。1313年11月她卒于萨阿贡，年仅23岁。

en: Constanza Manuel (c. 1318–1345/1349) was the daughter of the Castilian magnate and writer Juan Manuel and Constance of Aragon. In 1325 her father wedded her to Alfonso XI, who repudiated her in 1327 to marry Maria of Portugal. Betrothed in 1335 to the Portuguese heir Pedro, she was imprisoned by Alfonso in the Alcázar of Toro to block the match; the proxy wedding nonetheless took place at Évora on 28 February 1336. Once in Portugal, she bore Pedro a daughter, Maria, in 1342, and the future Ferdinand I in 1345. She died in childbirth.
zh: 康斯坦莎·曼努埃尔（约1318—1345或1349）是卡斯蒂利亚大贵族兼作家堂胡安·曼努埃尔与阿拉贡的康斯坦莎之女。1325年，父亲把她嫁给阿方索十一世；1327年国王为娶葡萄牙的玛丽亚而将她休弃。1335年她与葡萄牙王储佩德罗订婚后，阿方索把她囚禁在托罗城堡以阻止这桩婚事，但代理婚礼仍于1336年2月28日在埃武拉举行。到葡萄牙后，她于1342年为佩德罗生下女儿玛丽亚，1345年生下后来的费尔南多一世，最终因分娩而死。

en: Hernán Cortés (c. 1485–1547) was a Spanish conquistador born at Medellín in Extremadura. He spent two years at Salamanca before returning home and later trained as a notary. He reached Hispaniola in 1504, fought in the conquest of Cuba and became a magistrate. In 1519 he led an expedition to Mexico, ignored Velázquez's recall order, founded Veracruz and, with Doña Marina as interpreter, won Tlaxcalan allies against the Aztecs. He entered Tenochtitlan in 1519 and held Moctezuma II captive; after a retreat in 1520 he destroyed the city in the 1521 siege, overthrowing the Aztec Empire. Granted the Valley of Oaxaca marquessate in 1529, he explored Baja California and died near Seville in 1547.
zh: 埃尔南·科尔特斯（约1485—1547）是西班牙征服者，生于埃斯特雷马杜拉的麦德林。他在萨拉曼卡待了两年后回乡，后来接受公证人训练。1504年他抵达伊斯帕尼奥拉岛，参加了征服古巴的战争并担任地方官。1519年他率远征队前往墨西哥，违抗贝拉斯克斯的召回令，建立韦拉克鲁斯，并以堂娜·玛琳娜为译员，联合特拉斯卡拉人对抗阿兹特克。他1519年进入特诺奇蒂特兰，囚禁蒙特祖马二世；1520年撤退受挫后，又在1521年的围城战中摧毁该城，灭亡阿兹特克帝国。1529年他受封瓦哈卡谷地侯爵，后来探索下加利福尼亚，1547年死于塞维利亚附近。

en: Diego de Covarrubias y Leyva (1512–1577) was a jurist and prelate of the School of Salamanca, born in Toledo. He studied under Azpilcueta, Vitoria and Soto, and at twenty-one held a canon-law chair at Salamanca, where he was hailed as the Bartolus of Spain. He later drew up reforms for the university whose provisions remained in force long after his time. In 1556 he was designated archbishop of Santo Domingo, but never went there. As bishop of Ciudad Rodrigo from 1560, he attended the Council of Trent and drafted its decrees on reform. He became bishop of Segovia in 1564 and president of the Council of Castile in 1572. He died in Madrid in 1577 shortly after nomination as bishop of Cuenca.
zh: 迭戈·德·科瓦鲁维亚斯（1512—1577）是萨拉曼卡学派的法学家与高级教士，生于托莱多。他师从阿斯皮利奎塔、维多利亚和索托，二十一岁便在萨拉曼卡担任教会法教席，时人称他为“西班牙的巴尔多鲁”。他后来为大学制定改革规章，长久施行。1556年他获提名为圣多明各大主教，却从未赴任。他于1560年被祝圣为罗德里戈城主教，出席特伦托公会议并起草公会议的改革法令。1564年改任塞哥维亚主教，1572年出任卡斯蒂利亚政务会主席。1577年他刚获提名为昆卡主教便在马德里去世。

en: Juan de Herrera (1530–1597) was a Spanish architect, mathematician and geometrician, and the foremost architect of the Spanish Renaissance under Philip II. After serving Charles V on campaign in Germany, Flanders and Italy, he turned to architecture in 1561 at the palace of Aranjuez, and from 1563 worked under Juan Bautista de Toledo at El Escorial. On Toledo's death in 1567 he took charge of the works, enlarging the plan and building the western façade and central basilica. He gave the monastery-palace its sober granite façades and saw it completed in 1584. His austere manner became known as the Herrerian style, and he also designed Valladolid Cathedral and Madrid's Plaza Mayor.
zh: 胡安·德·埃雷拉（1530—1597）是西班牙建筑师、数学家与几何学家，也是腓力二世治下西班牙文艺复兴建筑的代表人物。他曾随查理五世出征德意志、佛兰德和意大利，1561年在阿兰胡埃斯王宫转向建筑，1563年起在埃斯科里亚尔修道院师从胡安·包蒂斯塔·德·托莱多。1567年托莱多去世后他主持工程，扩大了原有规划，建造西立面与中央大教堂。他为这座王宫修道院定下素朴的花岗岩立面风格，工程于1584年完工。他的庄重风格被称为埃雷拉式，他还设计了巴利亚多利德大教堂和马德里的马约尔广场。

en: Juan de la Cosa (c. 1450–1510) was a Castilian navigator and cartographer from Santoña. He owned and sailed the Santa María, Columbus's flagship on the first voyage of 1492, and joined the second voyage too. In 1499 he was chief pilot with Alonso de Ojeda on the South American coast, and around 1500 he drew the earliest surviving European world map showing the New World. He later joined Rodrigo de Bastidas's voyage and the 1508 board of pilots at Burgos. He also served the Crown as a spy in Lisbon. In 1509 he returned with Ojeda to Colombia and was killed by poison arrows near Cartagena in February 1510.
zh: 胡安·德拉科萨（约1450—1510）是卡斯蒂利亚航海家、制图师，生于桑托尼亚。他是哥伦布1492年首次远航时旗舰圣玛利亚号的船主兼船长，还参加了哥伦布的第二次远航。1499年，他以首席领航员身份随阿隆索·德·奥赫达到达南美海岸；约1500年，他绘出现存最早的标有新大陆的欧洲世界地图。此后他又参加罗德里戈·德·巴斯蒂达斯的远航和1508年的布尔戈斯领航员会议。他还曾为王室在里斯本执行间谍任务。1509年他随奥赫达再赴哥伦比亚，1510年2月在卡塔赫纳附近中毒箭身亡。

en: Garcilaso de la Vega (c. 1501–1536) was a Toledo-born soldier and poet, the son of a courtier of the Catholic Monarchs. He entered Charles V's guard in 1520, joined the Order of Santiago in 1523, and fought in the emperor's campaigns in Italy, Tunis and France. In 1525 he married Elena de Zúñiga, a lady-in-waiting to the king's sister Leonor, at his family's estate in Toledo. In 1532 he was briefly exiled to an island in the Danube, and in 1536 he died at Nice of a wound received at Le Muy in Provence. He naturalized Italian Renaissance verse forms in Castilian through his sonnets and eclogues, and his friend Juan Boscán published his poetry posthumously in 1543.
zh: 加尔西拉索·德·拉·维加（约1501—1536）是生于托莱多的军人与诗人，为天主教双王廷臣之子。他于1520年成为查理五世的侍卫，1523年加入圣地亚哥骑士团，随皇帝出征意大利、突尼斯和法国。1525年，他在托莱多的家族庄园迎娶埃莱娜·德·苏尼加；她是国王妹妹莱奥诺尔的侍女。1532年他被短期流放至多瑙河上的一座小岛；1536年，他因在普罗旺斯的勒米伊受伤而死于尼斯。他以十四行诗和牧歌把意大利文艺复兴诗体引入卡斯蒂利亚语，友人胡安·博斯坎于1543年在其身后出版了他的诗作。

en: Luis de León (1527–1591) was an Augustinian friar, theologian and lyric poet of the School of Salamanca. Born at Belmonte in Cuenca, he entered the Augustinians as a youth and from 1561 held a series of theology chairs at Salamanca, where his Hebrew scholarship and Spanish version of the Song of Songs angered Dominican rivals. In 1572 the Inquisition imprisoned him at Valladolid; acquitted in 1576, he returned to his lecture hall and, as tradition has it, began: ‘As I was saying the other day…’ He won the chair of Holy Scripture in 1579. His treatise The Names of Christ began to appear in 1583, and in 1588 he published the first collected edition of Teresa of Ávila's writings. He died in 1591.
zh: 路易斯·德·莱昂（1527—1591）是奥斯定会修士、神学家，也是萨拉曼卡学派的抒情诗人。他生于昆卡的贝尔蒙特，青年时入奥斯定会，1561年起历任萨拉曼卡大学多个神学讲席；他钻研希伯来文，又将《雅歌》译成西班牙文，招致多明我会对手的嫉恨。1572年宗教裁判所将他囚于巴利亚多利德，1576年无罪获释；相传他重返讲堂时开口便道：‘正如我们前几天所说……’1579年他获得圣经讲席，1583年其《基督之名》开始出版，1588年他出版了亚维拉的德兰著作的首部合集。他于1591年去世。

en: Bartolomé de Medina was a Spanish Dominican theologian of the School of Salamanca. Born at Medina de Rioseco in 1527, he joined the Dominicans and studied at Salamanca under Francisco de Vitoria, Domingo de Soto and Melchor Cano. He spent most of his teaching career there, winning the chair of Durandus and then, in a public contest against the Augustinian Juan de Guevara, the university's principal chair of theology. Well versed in Greek and Hebrew, he left theological writings chiefly in the form of commentaries on Aquinas's Summa Theologica. In these he formulated probabilism, which permits following a solidly probable opinion even when the contrary seems more probable. He died at Salamanca around 1580.
zh: 巴托洛梅·德·梅迪纳是西班牙多明我会神学家，属萨拉曼卡学派。他于1527年生于里奥塞科城，加入多明我会后在萨拉曼卡攻读神学，师从弗朗西斯科·德·维多利亚、多明戈·德·索托与梅尔希奥·卡诺。他的教学生涯大部分在该校度过，先任杜兰铎讲席，后在与奥斯定会士胡安·德·格瓦拉的公开竞试中胜出，登上首席神学讲席。他通晓希腊文与希伯来文，传世神学著作主要是对托马斯·阿奎那《神学大全》的注释。他在注释中阐述了伦理神学中的或然论：在道德疑难中，即便相反意见看似更为可能，人仍可遵从依据充分的或然意见。约1580年，他在萨拉曼卡去世。

en: Domingo de Soto (1494–1560) was a Dominican theologian born in Segovia and a founder of the School of Salamanca. After studies at Alcalá and Paris he joined the Dominicans at Burgos in 1524 and took a theology chair at Salamanca in 1532. Charles V sent him as imperial theologian to the Council of Trent (1545–1547), where he defended Catholic tradition on questions including original sin and justification, then made him his confessor for two years; Soto refused the bishopric of Segovia. At the Valladolid debate of 1550 he condemned the enslavement of Native Americans against Sepúlveda. His De iustitia et iure (1553) shaped later theories of international law.
zh: 多明戈·德·索托（1494—1560）是生于塞哥维亚的多明我会神学家，萨拉曼卡学派的奠基人之一。他在阿尔卡拉和巴黎求学后，于1524年在布尔戈斯加入多明我会，1532年取得萨拉曼卡大学的多明我会神学教席。查理五世派他以皇帝神学家的身份出席特伦托公会议（1545—1547），他在原罪和称义等问题上维护天主教传统；此后他又担任皇帝的告解神父两年，并拒绝了塞哥维亚主教之职。在1550年的巴利亚多利德辩论中，他驳斥塞普尔韦达，谴责奴役美洲原住民。他的《论正义与法律》（1553年）影响了后世的国际法理论。

en: Francisco de Vitoria (c. 1483–1546) was a Dominican theologian and jurist, born in Burgos, who founded the School of Salamanca. Educated in Paris, he held Salamanca's prima chair of theology from 1524 until his death. He had returned to Spain in 1523 to teach at the College of San Gregorio in Valladolid, where young Dominicans prepared for missions in the New World. His posthumous Relectiones Theologicae, above all De Indis and De iure belli of 1539, argued that the American peoples were true owners of their lands, could not be forcibly converted, and could be fought only under strict just-war conditions. His theory of the law of nations earned him the title father of international law. He published nothing himself and died at Salamanca in 1546.
zh: 弗朗西斯科·德·维多利亚（约1483—1546）是多明我会神学家、法学家，生于布尔戈斯，为萨拉曼卡学派的创立者。他在巴黎受教育，1524年起任萨拉曼卡大学首席神学讲席教授，直至去世。此前他于1523年回到西班牙，在巴利亚多利德的圣格雷戈里奥学院任教，年轻的多明我会士在那里为前往新大陆传教做准备。他身后结集的《神学讲义》，尤其是1539年的《论印第安人》和《论战争法》，主张美洲原住民是自身土地的真正主人，不得被强迫改宗，对他们动武必须符合严格的正义战争条件。他的万民法理论为他赢得了国际法之父的称号。他生前未出版任何著作，1546年卒于萨拉曼卡。

en: Juan Sebastián Elcano (c. 1486–1526) was a Basque sailor from Getaria who completed the first circumnavigation of the globe. He joined Magellan's expedition to the Spice Islands in 1519, and after Magellan was killed in the Philippines in April 1521 the crew elected him captain in September 1521. The expedition had orders to return across the Pacific, but Elcano chose to sail west across the Indian Ocean. He brought the sole surviving ship, the Victoria, home to Sanlúcar de Barrameda in September 1522, and Charles V granted him a globe crest with the motto Primus circumdedisti me. In 1525 he sailed as chief pilot of the Loaísa expedition and died of scurvy in the Pacific in 1526.
zh: 胡安·塞巴斯蒂安·埃尔卡诺（约1486—1526）是赫塔里亚的巴斯克水手，完成了人类历史上首次环球航行。1519年他加入麦哲伦前往香料群岛的远航；1521年4月麦哲伦在菲律宾被杀后，船员于同年9月推举他为船长。远征队原奉命横渡太平洋返回，埃尔卡诺却决定向西穿越印度洋。他率领唯一幸存的维多利亚号，于1522年9月返回桑卢卡尔-德巴拉梅达，查理五世赐他带有地球图案的纹章，铭言为“你是环绕我航行的第一人”。1525年，他以首席领航员身份随洛艾萨远征队再度出航，1526年在太平洋上死于坏血病。

en: Henry I of Castile (14 April 1204 – 6 June 1217) was the youngest son of Alfonso VIII and Eleanor of England, born in Valladolid. He became heir in 1211 and king in October 1214, aged ten. His sister Berengaria ruled as regent until the Lara faction forced her to hand the boy and government to Count Álvaro Núñez de Lara in 1215. Álvaro arranged his marriage to Mafalda of Portugal, which Berengaria had annulled. In June 1217 Henry was killed at Palencia by a falling tile loosened by a playmate, aged thirteen; Berengaria then took the throne.
zh: 恩里克一世（1204年4月14日—1217年6月6日）生于巴利亚多利德，是卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索八世与英格兰的埃莉诺的幼子。1211年他成为王储，1214年10月父王去世时年仅10岁的他登基，由姐姐贝伦加利亚摄政。1215年，拉腊家族迫使她把幼王和朝政交给阿尔瓦罗·努涅斯·德·拉腊伯爵；阿尔瓦罗安排他迎娶葡萄牙的玛法尔达，被贝伦加利亚设法废除。1217年6月，恩里克在帕伦西亚被玩伴碰落的屋瓦砸中身亡，年仅13岁，贝伦加利亚继位。

en: Henry II of Castile (1334–1379), called the Fratricidal, was an illegitimate son of Alfonso XI and Leonor de Guzmán and twin of Fadrique. His father made him Count of Trastámara, and the favour shown to Leonor's sons angered the queen, María of Portugal, and her son Peter. When Alfonso died in 1350, Henry and his brothers rebelled against the new king, Peter the Cruel. Leonor was executed in 1351 and Henry fled to Portugal, later entering French service and fighting for Peter IV of Aragon against Castile. With Aragonese and French support he was proclaimed king at Burgos in 1366, and the titles he handed out to allies earned him the nickname ‘of the favours’. Defeated at Nájera by the Black Prince in 1367, he returned with Bertrand du Guesclin's French companies, won Montiel on 14 March 1369 and killed Peter himself, founding the Trastámara dynasty. He then fought Portugal in the Fernandine Wars and backed France against England, and died in 1379, succeeded by his son John I.
zh: 恩里克二世（1334—1379），绰号“弑兄者”，是阿方索十一世与莱昂诺尔·德·古斯曼的私生子，法德里克的孪生兄弟。父亲封他为特拉斯塔马拉伯爵；国王对莱昂诺尔诸子的厚待，激怒了王后葡萄牙的玛丽亚和她的儿子佩德罗。1350年阿方索去世后，恩里克兄弟起兵反叛新王“残忍者”佩德罗。1351年母亲被处死，恩里克逃往葡萄牙，后来为法兰西效力，又随阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世对抗卡斯蒂利亚。1366年，他在阿拉贡与法兰西支持下于布尔戈斯被拥立为王，因大封盟友，得了“施恩者”的外号。1367年他在纳赫拉败于黑太子，后借贝特朗·杜·盖克兰的法兰西雇佣兵团之力卷土重来，1369年3月14日赢得蒙铁尔战役，亲手杀死佩德罗，建立特拉斯塔马拉王朝。此后他在费尔南多战争中与葡萄牙交战，并联合法兰西对抗英格兰，1379年去世，其子胡安一世继位。

en: Fadrique Alfonso of Castile (1334–1358), born at Seville, was an illegitimate son of Alfonso XI and Eleanor of Guzmán and twin brother of Henry of Trastámara. While the king lived, favour to Eleanor's children paid off: in 1342, still a child, Fadrique succeeded his maternal uncle Alonso Meléndez de Guzmán as master of the Order of Santiago. He held Haro and served as adelantado mayor of the Andalusian frontier and the king's chief chamberlain. In 1353 he escorted Peter I's bride Blanche of Bourbon back from France, and gossip later said he had been too close to her on the road. Joining his half-brothers' revolt in the war with Aragon, he was murdered at Seville on 29 May 1358 on Peter's orders. Chroniclers later gave him the story of being thrown from a window, which really belongs to another victim, Prince John of Aragon. The Enríquez admirals descended from him.
zh: 法德里克·阿方索·德·卡斯蒂利亚（1334—1358）生于塞维利亚，是阿方索十一世与埃莉诺·德·古斯曼的私生子、特拉斯塔马拉的恩里克的孪生兄弟。国王在世时，对埃莉诺诸子的恩宠带来实利：1342年他尚在幼年，便继任舅父阿隆索·梅伦德斯·德·古斯曼，成为圣地亚哥骑士团团长。他领有阿罗，并任安达卢西亚边境的边防总长和国王内廷总管。1353年他赴法国，将佩德罗一世的新娘波旁的布朗什护送回国，后来坊间传言他在路上与她过从太近。他在对阿拉贡战争中加入异母兄弟的叛乱，1358年5月29日在塞维利亚奉佩德罗之命被杀。后世编年史家又把被抛出窗外的故事安在他头上，那其实是另一位受害者、阿拉贡亲王胡安的下场。恩里克斯家族的历代海军统帅皆为其后裔。

en: Fernando Alfonso of Castile (1334–1350) was an illegitimate son of Alfonso XI and Eleanor de Guzmán, born after his half-brother Peter I in 1334. From 1335 he confirmed royal charters as the king's son, and in 1338 his father gave him Ledesma and the estates of his half-brother Sancho Alfonso, including Béjar, Galisteo and Salvatierra. In 1342 he received Haro on Fadrique Alfonso becoming master of Santiago, but in 1344 the king transferred Ledesma to his younger brother Juan Alfonso. A planned Aragonese marriage in 1348 came to nothing; he died unmarried in 1350.
zh: 费尔南多·阿方索·德·卡斯蒂利亚（1334—1350）是阿方索十一世与埃莉诺·德·古斯曼的私生子，1334年生于异母兄佩德罗一世之后。1335年起，他以“国王之子”的身份副署王家特状；1338年，父亲把莱德斯马连同异母兄桑乔·阿方索的产业一并赐给他，包括贝哈尔、加利斯特奥和萨尔瓦铁拉。1342年法德里克·阿方索出任圣地亚哥骑士团团长，阿罗转封给他；但1344年国王又把莱德斯马转交给他的弟弟胡安·阿方索。1348年筹划的阿拉贡联姻无果而终，他于1350年未婚而终。

en: Fernando de Herrera (c. 1534–1597), known as El Divino, was a Sevillian poet of Spain's Golden Age. An admirer of Italian poetry, the classics and the Bible, he found inspiration in the verse of Garcilaso de la Vega. He took minor orders and held a benefice in the parish of San Andrés, yet from around 1559 frequented the literary circle of the Count of Gelves, whose wife Leonor de Milán inspired his Petrarchan love poetry. His patriotic canciones celebrated contemporary Spanish commanders and campaigns, and he published an influential commentary on Garcilaso de la Vega's verse. After Leonor's death in 1581 he turned to prose, writing a world history and a life of Thomas More until his death.
zh: 费尔南多·德·埃雷拉（约1534—1597），绰号“神人”，是西班牙黄金时代的塞维利亚诗人与文人。他喜爱意大利诗歌、古典作品与《圣经》，也从加尔西拉索·德·拉·维加的诗歌中汲取灵感。他领受低级神职，在圣安德烈斯堂区享有圣俸，又从约1559年起出入赫尔维斯伯爵的文学沙龙，伯爵之妻莱昂诺尔·德·米兰成为他彼特拉克式情诗的灵感源泉。他的爱国诗作歌颂当时的西班牙将领与战事，还出版了影响深远的加尔西拉索·德·拉·维加诗作评注。1581年莱昂诺尔去世后他转向散文，撰写一部世界史和托马斯·莫尔传，直到去世。

en: Ferdinand III, called the Saint (1199 or 1201–1252), was the son of Alfonso IX of León and Berengaria of Castile. After his parents' marriage was annulled in 1204, his mother took him to the Castilian court. In 1217 his mother, queen of Castile, abdicated in his favor, and he fought his father and a faction of Castilian nobles. In 1230 he inherited León, uniting the two crowns. Exploiting Muslim disarray after Las Navas de Tolosa, he led Castile's greatest southward expansion, conquering the Guadalquivir valley with Córdoba, Jaén and Seville; Pope Gregory IX named him Athleta Christi, Champion of Christ. He married Elisabeth of Swabia in 1219 and was succeeded by his son Alfonso X. Canonized in 1671, he is buried in Seville Cathedral.
zh: 斐迪南三世（1199或1201—1252），绰号“圣人”，是莱昂国王阿方索九世与卡斯蒂利亚的贝伦加利亚之子。1204年父母婚姻被宣布无效后，母亲带他前往卡斯蒂利亚宫廷。1217年，身为卡斯蒂利亚女王的母亲让位于他，他与父亲及一派卡斯蒂利亚贵族交战；1230年他继承莱昂王位，使两个王国合并。他乘纳瓦斯德托洛萨战役后穆斯林政权陷入混乱之机，发动卡斯蒂利亚规模最大的南征，征服瓜达尔基维尔河流域，夺取科尔多瓦、哈恩和塞维利亚，教皇格列高利九世授予他“基督斗士”称号。他于1219年娶士瓦本的伊丽莎白，死后由儿子阿方索十世继位。他于1671年被封圣，葬于塞维利亚大教堂。

en: Ferdinand IV, called the Summoned (1285–1312), became king of Castile and León in 1295, aged nine. His mother María de Molina held the regency, defending his throne against revolts led by his uncle John of Castile and Juan Núñez II de Lara; his granduncle Henry served as his tutor. Pope Boniface VIII legitimized him in 1301, when he came of age. In 1302 he married Constance of Portugal. Continuing the Reconquista, he failed before Algeciras in 1309 but captured Gibraltar that year and took Alcaudete in 1312. At the Cortes of Valladolid in 1312 he promoted reform of justice and sought to strengthen royal authority. He died at Jaén in September 1312, aged 26, leaving the crown to his infant son Alfonso XI.
zh: 斐迪南四世（1285—1312），绰号“受召者”，1295年九岁时即位为卡斯蒂利亚与莱昂国王。母亲玛丽亚·德·莫利纳为他摄政，抵御叔父胡安和小胡安·努涅斯·德·拉腊领导的贵族叛乱；叔祖恩里克担任他的监护人。1301年教皇卜尼法斯八世承认他的合法身份，他也在同年亲政。1302年，他娶葡萄牙的康斯坦萨为妻。他延续收复失地运动，1309年攻打阿尔赫西拉斯未果，但同年夺取直布罗陀，1312年攻占阿尔考德特。同年在巴利亚多利德议会上，他推动司法改革，试图加强王权。1312年9月他在哈恩去世，年仅26岁，王位传给幼子阿方索十一世。

en: Ferdinand de la Cerda (1255–1275), eldest son of Alfonso X of Castile and Violant of Aragon, was heir apparent to the Castilian throne. His name de la Cerda meant “of the bristle”; accounts differ over whether it referred to his hair at birth or a hairy mole. In November 1268 he married Blanche, daughter of Louis IX of France; their two sons, Alfonso and Fernando, began the Infantes de la Cerda line. He ruled Castile as regent from November 1274 while his father pursued the German crown. In May 1275 Marinid troops, called in by Muhammad II of Granada, invaded; Ferdinand raised troops and marched south from Burgos but died at Villa Real on 25 June 1275. His brother Sancho seized the throne, disinheriting his sons.
zh: 费尔南多·德·拉·塞尔达（1255—1275）是卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十世与阿拉贡的比奥兰特的长子、卡斯蒂利亚王储。他的名字“德·拉·塞尔达”意为“鬃毛”，其由来有不同说法，或称与他出生时的头发有关，或称源于一颗长毛的痣。1268年11月，他娶法国国王路易九世之女布朗什，两子阿方索与费尔南多开创了“塞尔达诸子”世系。1274年11月起，父亲为谋求德意志王位外出，他以摄政身份治理卡斯蒂利亚。1275年5月，马林王朝的军队应格拉纳达的穆罕默德二世之请入侵，费尔南多召集军队从布尔戈斯南下御敌，却于6月25日在比利亚雷亚尔猝然去世。他的弟弟桑乔夺取王位，剥夺了他诸子的继承权。

en: Fernando de la Cerda (1275–1322) was the younger son of the Castilian heir Ferdinand de la Cerda and Blanche of France, a grandson through them of Alfonso X of Castile and Louis IX. Born after his father's death in 1275, he grew up while his elder brother Alfonso, called the Disinherited, pressed the family's claim to the Castilian throne. Fernando served Alfonso XI as mayordomo mayor, or high steward. By his marriage to Juana Núñez de Lara, known as la Palomilla, he was lord consort of Lara. Their daughter Blanche married the prince and writer Juan Manuel, while their son Juan Núñez married María Díaz de Haro and their daughter María married Charles II of Alençon.
zh: 费尔南多·德·拉·塞尔达（1275—1322）是卡斯蒂利亚王储费尔南多·德·拉·塞尔达与法兰西的布朗什的幼子，祖父是卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十世，外祖父是法国国王路易九世。他是遗腹子，1275年父亲死后才出生；兄长阿方索绰号“被剥夺继承权者”，一直谋求卡斯蒂利亚王位，费尔南多则担任阿方索十一世的王室大总管。他娶绰号“小飞蛾”的胡安娜·努涅斯·德·拉腊为妻，以此成为拉腊的共治领主。女儿布朗什嫁给了比列纳亲王、作家胡安·曼努埃尔，儿子胡安·努涅斯娶玛丽亚·迪亚斯·德·阿罗，女儿玛丽亚嫁给阿朗松的夏尔二世。

en: Fernando Manuel de Villena (c. 1332–1351) was the only legitimate son of the writer Juan Manuel and his third wife, Blanca de la Cerda. In 1346 he married Juana de Ampurias, granddaughter of James II of Aragon, and on his father's death in 1348 he inherited Villena, Escalona and Peñafiel. He served at the 1350 siege of Gibraltar with Alfonso XI and became adelantado of Murcia under Peter I, but he fled the court after Peter recovered from illness, was dismissed in February 1351 and died later that year, aged nineteen, leaving a daughter, Blanca Manuel.
zh: 费尔南多·曼努埃尔·德·比列纳（约1332—1351）是作家堂胡安·曼努埃尔与第三任妻子布兰卡·德·拉·塞尔达唯一的嫡子。1346年，他娶了阿拉贡国王海梅二世的孙女胡安娜·德·安普里亚斯；1348年父亲去世后，他继承比列纳、埃斯卡洛纳和佩尼亚菲耶尔。1350年他随阿方索十一世参加直布罗陀围城战，佩德罗一世即位后被任命为穆尔西亚边防总长。佩德罗病愈后他逃离宫廷，1351年2月被解职，同年去世，年仅十九岁，留下女儿布兰卡·曼努埃尔。

en: Alonso III de Fonseca (c. 1475–1534) was a Galician churchman and statesman, son of Archbishop Alonso II. He became Archbishop of Santiago de Compostela in 1507, led the Galician nobility's fight for a seat in the Cortes and mediated in the War of the Germanías. Charles V appointed him to the royal council, and he presided over an assembly at Melide that sought representation for Galicia and a trading house at A Coruña. A Renaissance humanist in touch with Erasmus, he made the University of Santiago de Compostela a major center of learning and founded the college named for him. In 1523 promoted to Archbishop of Toledo, primate of Spain, in 1527 he baptized the future Philip II, and died at Alcalá de Henares in 1534.
zh: 阿方索三世·德·丰塞卡（约1475—1534）是加利西亚教士与政治家，大主教阿方索二世之子。1507年他就任圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉大主教，率领加利西亚贵族争取在议会中的席位，并在兄弟会战争中居中调停。查理五世任命他为王室会议成员，他还主持梅利德会议，争取加利西亚的代表权及在拉科鲁尼亚设立贸易机构。作为与伊拉斯谟有交往的文艺复兴人文主义者，他把圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉大学建成重要学府，还创办了后来以他命名的学院。1523年，他升任西班牙首席主教驻地托莱多大主教，1527年为后来的腓力二世施洗，1534年卒于埃纳雷斯堡。

en: Nuño Freire de Andrade, called the Bad (el Malo), was a Galician noble of the late Middle Ages, born around 1374. He held the lordships of Andrade, Pontedeume, Ferrol and Vilalba in the kingdom of Galicia. His harsh rule so enraged his vassals that in 1431 they banded together between Pontedeume and Betanzos as the Mad Brotherhood, the first Irmandiño revolt. The rising formed part of a wider struggle against the Galician nobility's claims over peasants and townspeople. Led by the hidalgo Roi Xordo, it spread across the bishoprics of Lugo, Mondoñedo and Santiago. Nuño died in 1431, the year of the rising, and was succeeded by his son Pedro Fernández de Andrade II.
zh: 努尼奥·弗雷里·德·安德拉德绰号“恶人”，约生于1374年，是中世纪后期的加利西亚贵族，领有安德拉德、蓬特德乌梅、费罗尔和比拉尔瓦等地。他统治极为严酷，1431年，封地上的封臣在蓬特德乌梅与贝坦索斯之间结成“狂人兄弟会”，即第一次伊尔曼迪尼奥起义。这场起义是反抗加利西亚贵族对农民和市民权利的更广泛斗争的一部分。起义由乡绅罗伊·肖尔多领导，蔓延至卢戈、蒙多涅多和圣地亚哥三个主教区。努尼奥于起义爆发的1431年去世，其子佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·安德拉德二世继位。

en: Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba, called El Gran Capitán (1453–1515), was a Castilian general born at Montilla near Córdoba. He served Isabella the Catholic in the Castilian succession war, winning praise for leading 120 lancers against the Portuguese in 1479. He fought in the Granada War of 1482–1492, then led Spanish armies in Italy. Reforming infantry around pikes and arquebuses, he defeated the French at Cerignola in April 1503 and on the Garigliano that December, conquering Naples and serving as its viceroy from 1504 until Ferdinand recalled him in 1507. He ended his days as governor of Loja and died at Granada in 1515; his reforms inspired the later tercios.
zh: 贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦（1453—1515），绰号“大将军”，是卡斯蒂利亚名将，生于科尔多瓦附近的蒙蒂利亚。他追随天主教徒伊莎贝拉参加卡斯蒂利亚王位继承战争，1479年率领120名枪骑兵对阵葡萄牙军队，因战功受到称赞。他参加了1482至1492年的格拉纳达战争，此后率领西班牙军队征战意大利。他以长枪与火绳枪改革步兵，1503年4月在切里尼奥拉、同年12月又在加里利亚诺击败法军，征服那不勒斯王国，1504年起出任那不勒斯总督，1507年被费尔南多召回。他晚年担任洛哈地方长官，1515年死于格拉纳达；他的军制改革为后来的西班牙方阵奠定了基础。

en: Gonzalo Martínez de Oviedo (died 1340) was a nobleman from Oviedo who rose at the court of Alfonso XI of Castile as chief steward of the royal pantry and a tax collector. In 1337 the king pressed the Order of Alcántara to elect him master, an irregular choice. He then opposed the appointment of Alfonso Meléndez de Guzmán as master of the Order of Santiago. Defying a royal summons, he fled to Valencia de Alcántara and offered the Order's border towns to Portugal's king. Abandoned by his companions, he was captured, condemned as a traitor, and executed in 1340.
zh: 贡萨洛·马丁内斯·德·奥维耶多（卒于1340年）出身奥维耶多的贵族，在卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十一世的宫廷中升任王室膳食总管，并兼管税收。1337年，国王施压让阿尔坎塔拉骑士团选他为团长，此次选举并不合规。此后他反对阿方索·梅伦德斯·德·古斯曼出任圣地亚哥骑士团团长。他拒不应召，退守瓦伦西亚-德阿尔坎塔拉，又把骑士团的边境城镇献给葡萄牙国王。他被同伴抛弃，后被俘，以叛徒罪名判处死刑，并于1340年被处决。

en: Gonzalo Núñez de Lara (c. 1165 – after 1230) was a Castilian-Leonese count, third son of Count Nuño Pérez de Lara and stepson of Ferdinand II of León. Raised at the Leonese court, he governed the frontier tenencias of Sarria, Lemos and Aguilar de Campoo. At Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212 he commanded the central division alongside the military orders. Made count in 1215, he supported his brother Álvaro's regency and received Belorado and Grañón, then submitted to Ferdinand III after the Laras' defeat. By María Díaz de Haro he fathered Nuño González ‘the Good’.
zh: 贡萨洛·努涅斯·德·拉腊（约1165—1230年后）是卡斯蒂利亚—莱昂的伯爵，努诺·佩雷斯·德·拉腊伯爵的第三子，莱昂国王费尔南多二世的继子。他在莱昂宫廷长大，相继管辖萨里亚、莱莫斯和阿吉拉尔-德坎波等边疆领地。1212年他参加拉斯纳瓦斯-德托洛萨战役，与各军事骑士团共同统率中军。1215年他受封伯爵，支持其兄阿尔瓦罗摄政，得到贝洛拉多和格拉尼翁，拉腊家族失败后向费尔南多三世投降。他与妻子玛丽亚·迪亚斯·德·阿罗生有‘好人’努诺·冈萨雷斯。

en: Henry of Burgundy (c. 1066–1112), Count of Portugal, was a younger son of Burgundy's ducal house, born at Dijon. He came to Iberia to fight the Almoravids for Alfonso VI and married the king's illegitimate daughter Teresa around 1095, receiving the county of Portugal between the Minho and the Tagus. Between 1096 and 1105 he made a pact with his kinsman Raymond of Burgundy to share power and the royal treasury and support each other after Alfonso's death. After Alfonso's death he exploited the wars between Queen Urraca and Alfonso I of Aragon to enlarge his lands. He died of wounds at the siege of Astorga on 22 May 1112 and was buried at Braga. His son Afonso Henriques became Portugal's first king.
zh: 勃艮第的亨利（约1066—1112）是葡萄牙伯爵，生于第戎，为勃艮第公爵家族的幼子。他前往伊比利亚，为阿方索六世与穆拉比特人作战，约1095年娶国王的私生女特蕾莎为妻，受封米尼奥河与塔霍河之间的葡萄牙伯国。1096至1105年间，他与亲属勃艮第的雷蒙多订约，约定在阿方索死后分享权力与王室财宝、互相支持。阿方索死后，他利用女王乌拉卡与阿拉贡的阿方索一世之间的战争扩张领地。1112年5月22日，他在阿斯托尔加之围中伤重而死，葬于布拉加。他的儿子阿方索·恩里克斯后来成为葡萄牙第一位国王。

en: Inês de Castro (c. 1320–1355) was a Galician noblewoman, natural daughter of Pedro Fernández de Castro and Aldonça Lourenço de Valadares. In the household of Constance of Castile, she became the lover of Constance's husband Infante Pedro, heir to Afonso IV of Portugal. After Constance died in 1349 Inês lived openly with him and bore four children; Pedro refused the new marriages his father proposed. Her brothers Fernando and Álvaro de Castro gained growing influence over the prince, which threatened Portugal's neutrality in the Castilian civil war; Afonso IV ordered her killed. She was beheaded at Santa Clara-a-Velha in Coimbra on 7 January 1355. Pedro rebelled but was beaten within a year. As king from 1357 he hunted her killers, who had fled to Castile, and had two executed; in 1360 he declared that he had married her secretly in 1353. The tale that he crowned her exhumed corpse is probably a myth, first told in a 1577 play.
zh: 伊内斯·德·卡斯特罗（约1320—1355）是加利西亚贵族女子，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·卡斯特罗与阿尔东萨·洛伦索·德·瓦拉达雷斯的私生女。她在卡斯蒂利亚的康斯坦萨的家中任职，成为康斯坦萨之夫、葡萄牙王储佩德罗（阿方索四世之子）的爱人。1349年康斯坦萨去世后，伊内斯与佩德罗公开同居，生下四个子女；佩德罗拒绝了父亲提出的新婚事。她的兄弟费尔南多与阿尔瓦罗·德·卡斯特罗对王子的影响与日俱增，威胁到葡萄牙在卡斯蒂利亚内战中的中立，阿方索四世遂下令杀她。1355年1月7日，她在科英布拉的旧圣克拉拉修道院被斩首。佩德罗起兵反父，不到一年即告失败。1357年即位后，他追捕逃往卡斯蒂利亚的凶手，处决了其中两人，并于1360年宣称自己早在1353年就与她秘密成婚。相传他还掘出她的遗体为其加冕，这个故事很可能出于后人编造，最早见于1577年的一出戏剧。

en: Jacob ben Asher (c. 1269–1340), called Ba'al ha-Turim, was a German-born rabbinic authority active in Castile. Third son of the rabbi Asher ben Jehiel, the Rosh, he was born at Cologne and in 1303 moved with his family to Toledo after his father fled worsening persecution in Germany. Schooled by his father, he lived in poverty. His legal code Arba'ah Turim, the Four Columns, arranged Jewish law in four parts and gave him his byname; he also wrote a gematria and masorah commentary on the Torah. He died about 1340, at Toledo, or on a journey at Chios.
zh: 雅各·本·亚设（约1269—1340）是生于德意志、活跃于卡斯蒂利亚的拉比律法权威。他是拉比亚设·本·耶希埃尔（“罗什”）的第三子，生于科隆；1303年父亲为躲避德意志日甚一日的迫害而出走，他随全家迁居托莱多。他主要师从父亲，一生清贫。所著律法汇编《四列》把犹太律法分为四部分，他也由此得绰号“《图林》作者”；他还著有以数字解经和马所拉传统注释《托拉》的经注。约1340年他卒于托莱多，一说卒于旅途中的希俄斯岛。

en: Don Juan Manuel (1282–1348), Prince of Villena, was born at Escalona, a grandson of Ferdinand III and nephew of Alfonso X of Castile. One of the richest and most powerful men of his time, he coined his own money like a king, negotiated with James II of Aragon for the queen mother María de Molina in 1304, and later tutored the young Alfonso XI. When the king imprisoned Juan Manuel's daughter Constanza at Toro, he rebelled, allying with Granada and Aragon. He escaped Alfonso's siege at Garci-Nuñez on 30 July 1336 and fought on from exile until 1338. A reconciliation brokered by the pope was complete only in 1340, when he fought beside the king at Río Salado and Algeciras. He then retired to Castillo de Garcimuñoz to write El conde Lucanor, a celebrated story collection; some thought literature beneath a man of his rank. He died at Córdoba in 1348.
zh: 堂胡安·曼努埃尔（1282—1348），比列纳亲王，出生于埃斯卡洛纳，是卡斯蒂利亚国王费尔南多三世之孙、阿方索十世之侄。他是当时最富有、最有权势的人物之一，像国王一样自铸钱币；1304年，王太后玛丽亚·德·莫利纳委托他与阿拉贡的海梅二世谈判，后来他又担任年幼的阿方索十一世的导师。国王把他的女儿康斯坦莎囚禁在托罗，他随即起兵反叛，联合格拉纳达与阿拉贡对抗国王。1336年7月30日，他从阿方索围攻的加尔西·努涅斯逃脱，流亡在外继续作乱，直到1338年。在教皇斡旋下，双方直到1340年才完全和解，他随后与国王并肩参加萨拉萨多河战役和攻取阿尔赫西拉斯之役。此后他退隐加尔西穆尼奥斯城堡，写成著名故事集《卢卡诺尔伯爵》；当时有人认为，以他的身份不该以文学为业。他于1348年卒于科尔多瓦。

en: Juan Núñez de Prado (died 1355) was an illegitimate son of Infanta Blanche of Portugal and the Portuguese nobleman Pedro Nunes Carpinteyro, and a knight of the Order of Calatrava. He joined a revolt against Master Garci López de Padilla, discredited by his poor showing against Granada; the rebels charged that he had fled the field at Baena, leaving his friars. The rebels made Villarreal their stronghold and defeated Garci at Malas Tardes. In 1325 they took four charges, among them abandoned fortresses and cruelty toward his friars, to Alfonso XI at Valladolid, and the king backed Núñez de Prado as Master, though a long dispute followed. Under Peter the Cruel he opposed the crown. Peter had him arrested at Almagro in 1355; he did not resist, though he had men enough to fight. Diego García de Padilla, brother of the king's mistress María de Padilla, replaced him. Núñez de Prado was sent to Maqueda Castle and murdered there.
zh: 胡安·努涅斯·德·普拉多（?—1355）是葡萄牙公主布兰卡与葡萄牙贵族佩德罗·努内斯·卡平特罗的私生子，卡拉特拉瓦骑士团骑士。他参加了反对团长加尔西·洛佩斯·德·帕迪利亚的起事；后者对格拉纳达作战表现不佳而声名扫地，起事者还指控他在巴埃纳战场上丢下修士逃走。起事者以比利亚雷亚尔为据点，在马拉斯塔德斯击败加尔西。1325年，他们到巴利亚多利德向阿方索十一世控诉四项罪名，包括放弃要塞和虐待修士；国王支持推举努涅斯·德·普拉多为团长，但争议持续了很久。到“暴君”佩德罗在位时，他反对王室。1355年他在阿尔马格罗被捕，虽有足够人手却没有抵抗。团长一职由国王情妇玛丽亚·德·帕迪利亚的兄弟迭戈·加西亚·德·帕迪利亚接替。努涅斯·德·普拉多被押往马克达城堡，在那里遇害。

en: Juan Núñez I de Lara, called el Gordo (died 1294), headed the noble House of Lara in Castile, holding Lerma, Amaya and Albarracín. Son of Nuño González de Lara el Bueno, he joined Louis IX of France on the Eighth Crusade at Tunis in 1270. In the revolts of 1272–1273 against Alfonso X he followed his father into exile in Granada and Navarre before reconciliation. Under Sancho IV he rebelled again, fled to France in 1292, and was captured by the infante John. Sent to defend the Andalucían frontier against Granada, he died at Córdoba in April 1294.
zh: 胡安·努涅斯一世·德·拉腊，绰号“胖子”（？—1294），是卡斯蒂利亚拉腊家族的族长，领有莱尔马、阿马亚和阿尔瓦拉辛等地。他是努尼奥·冈萨雷斯·德·拉腊“好人”之子，1270年随法兰西国王路易九世参加第八次十字军东征，兵至突尼斯。1272—1273年贵族起兵反对阿方索十世，他随父亲流亡格拉纳达和纳瓦拉，后来与国王和解。桑乔四世在位时他再度反叛，1292年逃往法兰西，并被王子胡安俘虏。获释后他被派往安达卢西亚边境抵御格拉纳达，1294年4月卒于科尔多瓦。

en: Juana de Castro, called the Unloved (died 21 August 1374), was the second wife of Peter I of Castile and half-sister of Inês de Castro, the lover of the Portuguese heir. Her father was Pedro Fernández de Castro, lord of Lemos, her mother Isabel Ponce de León, and through her grandmother Violante Sánchez she was a great-granddaughter of Sancho IV. She had a son with her first husband Diego López de Haro. After his death she met Peter; the chronicler Pero López de Ayala wrote that she demanded he have his marriage to Blanche of Bourbon annulled before she would marry him. Peter complied, and they wed at Cuéllar in April 1354, but he abandoned her the day after the wedding, leaving her only the castle of Dueñas. There she gave birth to their son John. She died at Dueñas in 1374 and was buried at Santiago de Compostela.
zh: 胡安娜·德·卡斯特罗，人称“不被爱者”（?—1374年8月21日），是卡斯蒂利亚国王佩德罗一世的第二任王后，也是葡萄牙王储的爱人伊内斯·德·卡斯特罗的同父异母姐妹。她的父亲是莱莫斯领主佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·卡斯特罗，母亲是伊莎贝尔·庞塞·德莱昂；经由祖母维奥兰特·桑切斯，她是桑乔四世的曾孙女。她与第一任丈夫迭戈·洛佩斯·德·阿罗育有一子。丈夫去世后她结识佩德罗；编年史家佩罗·洛佩斯·德·阿亚拉记载，她要求佩德罗先宣布他与波旁的布朗什的婚姻无效，才肯嫁给他。佩德罗照办，两人于1354年4月在奎利亚尔成婚，他却在次日便将她抛弃，只留给她杜埃尼亚斯城堡，她在那里生下他们的儿子胡安。1374年她于杜埃尼亚斯去世，葬于圣地亚哥—德孔波斯特拉。

en: Juana Núñez de Lara, called la Palomilla (1286–1351), was the daughter of Juan Núñez de Lara the Fat and Teresa Díaz de Haro, heiress of Biscay. Her first husband, Infante Henry of Castile, a son of Ferdinand III, died in 1304 without children and left her a young widow. She then married Fernando de la Cerda, a grandson of Alfonso X whose mother Blanche was a daughter of Louis IX of France; he died in 1322. Their children included Juan Núñez III de Lara; Blanche, who married the prince and writer Juan Manuel and whose daughter Juana Manuel became queen of Castile as wife of Henry II and mother of John I; and María, wife of Charles II of Alençon. Juana died at Palencia in 1351.
