zh: 胡安娜·努涅斯·德·拉腊，绰号“飞蛾”（1286—1351），是“胖子”胡安·努涅斯·德·拉腊与比斯开女继承人特蕾莎·迪亚斯·德·阿罗之女。她的第一任丈夫、卡斯蒂利亚的恩里克亲王是费尔南多三世之子，1304年去世，二人无子女，她年纪轻轻便成了寡妇。此后她改嫁费尔南多·德·拉·塞尔达，此人是阿方索十世之孙，其母布兰卡又是法王路易九世之女；他于1322年去世。两人的子女包括胡安·努涅斯三世·德·拉腊；嫁给亲王兼作家胡安·曼努埃尔的布兰卡，她的女儿胡安娜·曼努埃尔后来成为恩里克二世的王后、胡安一世之母；以及阿朗松伯爵夏尔二世之妻玛丽亚。1351年，胡安娜卒于帕伦西亚。

en: Judah ben Asher (1270–1349) was a German Talmudist and later rabbi of Toledo. Son of the rabbi Asher ben Jehiel, the Rosh, and brother of Jacob, he left Germany for Spain in July 1283 and reached Toledo in April 1285. In 1305 he preceded his father to prepare his settlement in Castile. After the Rosh died in 1321 or 1328, Toledo's community chose Judah as its rabbi. When he planned to move to Seville after a quarrel, his congregation doubled his salary; he nevertheless urged his sons to return to Germany. He died at Toledo in July 1349.
zh: 犹大·本·亚设（1270—1349）是德意志塔木德学者，后来出任托莱多拉比。他是拉比亚设·本·耶希埃尔（“罗什”）之子、雅各的兄弟。1283年7月他离开德意志前往西班牙，1285年4月抵达托莱多；1305年又先行一步，为父亲赴卡斯蒂利亚安顿做准备。罗什于1321或1328年去世后，托莱多社区推举他继任拉比。一次争执后他打算迁居塞维利亚，信众将他的俸禄加倍挽留，但他仍嘱咐儿子们返回德意志。1349年7月，他卒于托莱多。

en: Eleanor de Guzmán (1310–1351) was a Castilian noblewoman, daughter of Pedro Núñez de Guzmán and Juana Ponce de León, who outshone the queen at the court of Alfonso XI. Her husband Juan de Velasco died in 1328, and soon afterwards she met the king at Seville. She became his long-term mistress and bore him ten children, among them Henry of Trastámara, the future Henry II, and Fadrique Alfonso. Alfonso had married Maria of Portugal in 1328, but after their son Peter was born in 1334 he left the queen and lived with Eleanor. He gave her Huelva, Tordesillas and Medina-Sidonia and set up her household at Seville, where she heard political matters. The queen resented the open preference. When Alfonso died in March 1350, Maria, regent for her son Peter, had Eleanor imprisoned and in 1351 executed at Talavera de la Reina. The killing widened the rift: Henry and Peter fought for Castile until Henry won the crown.
zh: 埃莉诺·德·古斯曼（1310—1351）是卡斯蒂利亚贵妇，佩德罗·努涅斯·德·古斯曼与胡安娜·庞塞·德·莱昂之女，在阿方索十一世的宫廷里，她的风头盖过了王后。1328年丈夫胡安·德·贝拉斯科去世后不久，她在塞维利亚结识国王，成为他长期的情妇，为他生下十个子女，包括特拉斯塔马拉的恩里克（后来的恩里克二世）和法德里克·阿方索。阿方索1328年娶了葡萄牙的玛丽亚，但1334年儿子佩德罗出生后，他便离开王后，与埃莉诺同住。他赐她韦尔瓦、托德西利亚斯和梅迪纳-西多尼亚，并在塞维利亚为她设立府邸，让她在那里听取政务。王后对国王的公开偏爱怨恨在心。1350年3月阿方索去世后，为儿子佩德罗摄政的玛丽亚将埃莉诺囚禁，并于1351年在塔拉韦拉-德拉雷纳将她处死。这一杀戮加深了王室的裂痕：恩里克与佩德罗争夺卡斯蒂利亚，最终恩里克夺得王位。

en: Pedro López de Ayala (1332–1407), born at Vitoria, was a Castilian statesman and chronicler. Educated by his great-uncle, Cardinal Barroso, he served Pedro I, then defected to Henry of Trastámara and fought at Nájera in 1367, where the Black Prince captured him. In 1378 he negotiated a French alliance against England and Portugal. Captured by the Portuguese at Aljubarrota in 1385, in his iron prison he wrote a falconry treatise and part of his satirical Rimado de Palacio. His wife and the kings of Castile and France were among those who interceded for his ransom. Ransomed around 1388, he resumed his diplomacy in France, became grand chancellor under Henry III and chronicled four Castilian kings; he died at Calahorra in 1407.
zh: 佩德罗·洛佩斯·德·阿亚拉（1332—1407）生于维多利亚，是卡斯蒂利亚政治家与编年史家。他由叔公、枢机主教巴罗索教养，先效力于佩德罗一世，后转投特拉斯塔马拉的恩里克，1367年在纳赫拉战役中被黑太子俘虏。1378年他出使法国，促成结盟以对抗英格兰与葡萄牙。1385年他在阿尔茹巴罗塔战役中被葡萄牙人俘获，在铁牢中写出一部鹰猎著作和讽刺长诗《宫廷韵文》的部分篇章。他的妻子以及卡斯蒂利亚和法国国王都曾为赎回他出力。约1388年获赎后，他再赴法国从事外交，后来出任恩里克三世的御前大臣，撰有四位卡斯蒂利亚国王的编年史，1407年卒于卡拉奥拉。

en: Manrique Pérez de Lara (died 3 June 1164) was a Castilian magnate and son of Count Pedro González de Lara. Royal alférez from 1134, he received Atienza in 1143 and Toledo in 1144 and was made a count in 1145. He fought at the taking of Calatrava in 1147 and the conquest of Almería, and became the first lord of Molina. After Sancho III died in 1158 he held the regency for the child Alfonso VIII, waged civil war against the Castro family, and was killed by Fernando Rodríguez de Castro at the Battle of Huete.
zh: 曼里克·佩雷斯·德·拉腊（?—1164年6月3日）是卡斯蒂利亚权臣、拉腊家族首领，佩德罗·冈萨雷斯·德·拉腊之子。他1134年起任王室掌旗官，1143年受封阿蒂恩萨，1144年兼领托莱多，1145年被阿方索七世册封为伯爵，1147年参加攻取卡拉特拉瓦和阿尔梅里亚的战役，并成为莫利纳的首任领主。1158年桑乔三世去世后，他为幼王阿方索八世摄政，与卡斯特罗家族进行内战，1164年6月3日在韦特战役中被费尔南多·罗德里格斯·德·卡斯特罗击杀。

en: María de Molina (c. 1265–1321), lady of Molina from 1292, was queen of Castile as the wife of Sancho IV. Because the couple were related and lacked a papal dispensation, their children were at first deemed illegitimate. On Sancho's death in 1295 she became regent for her nine-year-old son Ferdinand IV, defending his crown against his uncle John and the de la Cerda claimants; in 1301 Pope Boniface VIII legitimized the marriage. At the Cortes of Medina del Campo in 1302, nobles accused her of misusing royal funds, but an examination of her accounts showed that she had contributed her own income to the monarchy. After Ferdinand died in 1312 she again held the regency for her grandson Alfonso XI, until her death at Valladolid in 1321.
zh: 玛丽亚·德·莫利纳（约1265—1321），1292年起为莫利纳女领主，作为桑乔四世的妻子成为卡斯蒂利亚王后。由于夫妇二人有血缘关系且未获教皇特许，他们的子女起初被视为私生子。1295年桑乔去世后，她为九岁的儿子斐迪南四世摄政，抵御小叔胡安和拉塞尔达系争夺者对王位的要求；1301年教皇卜尼法斯八世颁布诏书，承认其婚姻合法。1302年在梅迪纳德尔坎波议会上，贵族指控她挪用王室资金，账目审查却表明她以自己的收入支持王室。1312年斐迪南去世后，她再次为孙子阿方索十一世摄政，直至1321年在巴利亚多利德去世。

en: Maria of Portugal (1313–1357), eldest daughter of Afonso IV, became queen of Castile in 1328 by marrying Alfonso XI. The marriage was unhappy from the start: Alfonso kept Leonor de Guzmán, who bore him ten children, and Maria spent long periods secluded in the monastery of San Clemente in Seville. In 1335 she went home to her father, who demanded that Alfonso give Leonor up. In 1340 Alfonso promised to send Leonor to a convent, winning Portuguese support at Río Salado, but once the battle was won he went back to her. After Alfonso died in 1350, Maria gained influence over the head of her son Peter's council, and in spring 1351 she had Leonor killed at Talavera de la Reina. She joined the revolt against Peter in 1354; in January 1356 he entered the Alcázar of Toro and had several nobles of her household killed, and she returned to Portugal. She died at Évora in 1357.
zh: 葡萄牙的玛丽亚（1313—1357）是葡萄牙国王阿方索四世的长女，1328年嫁给卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十一世，成为王后。这场婚姻从一开始就不幸福：阿方索十一世宠爱情妇莱昂诺尔·德·古斯曼，后者为他生下十个孩子；玛丽亚长期避居塞维利亚的圣克莱门特修道院。1335年她回到父亲身边，父亲要求阿方索与莱昂诺尔断绝关系。1340年，阿方索答应把莱昂诺尔送入修道院，换得葡萄牙在萨拉多战役中的支援，战事一了却又回到情妇身边。1350年阿方索去世后，玛丽亚通过影响儿子佩德罗的议事会首脑取得权势，1351年春下令在塔拉韦拉德拉雷纳杀死莱昂诺尔。1354年她参与反对佩德罗的叛乱；1356年1月，佩德罗闯入托罗的王宫，杀死她随从中的数名贵族，她随后返回葡萄牙。1357年她卒于埃武拉。

en: Matilda of Brienne was the daughter of John I of Brienne, Count of Eu, and Beatrice de Châtillon. In 1290 she married Alfonso de la Cerda, the disinherited Castilian claimant, and bore him seven children, including Luis de la Cerda and Alfonso ‘of Spain’.
zh: 布列讷的玛蒂尔德是厄镇伯爵约翰一世·德·布列讷与贝亚特丽丝·德·沙蒂永之女。1290年她嫁给卡斯蒂利亚王位觊觎者阿方索·德·拉塞尔达，生下七名子女，包括路易斯·德·拉塞尔达和‘西班牙人’阿方索。

en: Luis de Molina (1535–1600) was a Spanish Jesuit theologian of the School of Salamanca. Born in Cuenca, he studied law at Salamanca before encountering Ignatius of Loyola's Spiritual Exercises and joining the Society of Jesus in 1553. He studied at Coimbra, and taught philosophy and theology at Coimbra and Évora. In 1588 he published the Concordia, arguing through his theory of middle knowledge that divine foreknowledge leaves human free will intact; this system became known as Molinism. Dominicans under Domingo Báñez denounced him to the Inquisition, and Rome examined the dispute in the Congregatio de Auxiliis from 1597. His later work De iustitia et iure also dealt with law and economics.
zh: 路易斯·德·莫林纳（1535—1600）是萨拉曼卡学派的西班牙耶稣会神学家。他生于昆卡，曾在萨拉曼卡学习法律，接触伊尼戈·德·洛约拉的《神操》后，于1553年加入耶稣会。他在科英布拉求学，后在科英布拉与埃武拉教授哲学和神学。1588年他出版《和谐论》，以“中介知识”学说论证上帝的预知并不妨碍人的自由意志，这套体系后来被称为莫林纳主义。以多明戈·巴涅斯为首的多明我会士向西班牙宗教裁判所告发他，罗马自1597年起以“恩助会议”审查这场争论。他的晚年著作《论法律与正义》还涉及法律与经济问题。

en: Nuño González de Lara, called el Bueno ‘the Good’ (c. 1220 – 8 September 1275), head of the House of Lara, was the closest friend of Alfonso X of Castile, with whom he grew up. He defeated the rebellious infante Henry near Lebrija in 1255, suppressed Mudéjar revolts at Jerez, Écija and Matrera, and became the first castellan of Jerez in 1261. In 1272 he led the nobles' revolt and fled to Granada, but was reconciled in 1273 and granted Écija. He fell defending it against the Marinids in September 1275; his recovered head was buried with his body at Palencia.
zh: 努诺·冈萨雷斯·德·拉腊（约1220—1275年9月8日）绰号‘好人’，是拉腊家族族长，与卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十世自幼一同长大，是国王最亲密的朋友。1255年他在莱布里亚附近击败叛乱的王子恩里克，又先后在赫雷斯、埃西哈、马特雷拉平定穆德哈尔人起义，1261年成为赫雷斯要塞的首任城防长官。1272年他率领贵族叛乱、逃亡格拉纳达，1273年获赦并受封埃西哈。1275年9月，他在抵御马林王朝入侵、守卫埃西哈的战役中阵亡；其首级后来被寻回，与遗体合葬于帕伦西亚。

en: Nuño Pérez de Lara (died 3 August 1177) was a Castilian nobleman, son of Count Pedro González de Lara. Alfonso VII made him alférez in 1145; he was probably captured defending Montoro against the Almohads in 1156 and was ransomed in 1157. Captured again by the Castros at Lobregal in 1160, he became count by 1162 and guardian of Alfonso VIII. After his brother Manrique died in 1164, Nuño held the regency until 1169 and remained dominant until 1176. He founded monasteries, promoted the cult of Thomas Becket in Spain, and was killed at the siege of Cuenca in 1177.
zh: 努诺·佩雷斯·德·拉腊（?—1177年8月3日）是卡斯蒂利亚贵族，佩德罗·冈萨雷斯·德·拉腊之子。1145年他被阿方索七世任命为掌旗官；1156年在蒙托罗抵御穆瓦希德人时很可能被俘，1157年才被赎回。1160年他在洛夫雷加尔战役中再次被卡斯特罗家族俘虏，1162年成为伯爵并出任阿方索八世的监护人。1164年其兄曼里克死后，他继任摄政直至1169年，此后仍主持朝政到1176年。他创立多所修道院，推动托马斯·贝克特崇拜传入西班牙，1177年在昆卡围城战中阵亡。

en: Pedro de Aguilar (1331–1338) was an illegitimate son of Alfonso XI of Castile and his mistress Eleanor de Guzmán, born at Valladolid amid public celebrations. In January 1332 the king granted the infant the vast lordships formerly held by Infante Pedro, including Aguilar de Campoo, Liébana, La Pernía, Paredes de Nava, Orduña, Baena, Luque and Zuheros. From 1333 he confirmed royal charters as son of the king and lord of Aguilar, and in May 1335 Alfonso made him chancellor mayor of Castile, replacing the archbishop of Toledo. He died at Guadalajara in 1338, still a child.
zh: 佩德罗·德·阿吉拉尔（1331—1338）是卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十一世与情妇埃莉诺·德·古斯曼的私生子，生于巴利亚多利德，出生时国王大办庆典。1332年1月，国王把已故佩德罗亲王的大片领地赐给襁褓中的他，包括阿吉拉尔-德坎波奥、列瓦纳、拉佩尔尼阿、帕雷德斯-德纳瓦、奥尔杜尼亚、巴埃纳、卢克和苏埃罗斯。1333年起，他以“国王之子”和“阿吉拉尔领主”的身份副署王家特状；1335年5月，阿方索任命他接替托莱多大主教出任卡斯蒂利亚大法官。1338年他在瓜达拉哈拉夭折。

en: Pedro Fernández de Castro, called o da Guerra (c. 1290–1342), was a Galician noble of the House of Castro and mayordomo mayor of Alfonso XI of Castile. After his father was killed in battle in 1304, he was raised at the Portuguese court, returning to Galicia about 1319, when the king restored Lemos and Sarria to him. He led the assault at Teba in 1330, refused to fight the Portuguese king when he invaded Castile in 1334, received Trastámara from Alfonso XI, and fought at Río Salado in 1340. He died in an epidemic at the siege of Algeciras in 1342.
zh: 佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·卡斯特罗，绰号“好战者”（约1290—1342），是加利西亚卡斯特罗家族的贵族、阿方索十一世的宫廷总管。1304年其父战死，他被送往葡萄牙宫廷抚养；约1319年返回加利西亚，国王把莱莫斯和萨里亚两处祖产发还给他。1330年他在格拉纳达战事中率部攻打特巴；1334年葡萄牙国王入侵卡斯蒂利亚时，他拒绝与之作战，此后获阿方索十一世封赐特拉斯塔马拉；1340年参加萨拉萨多河战役。1342年，他在阿尔赫西拉斯围城战期间死于疫病。

en: Pedro González de Lara (died 16 October 1130) was a Castilian magnate and the first of his family to call himself de Lara. First recorded as royal alférez in 1088 under Alfonso VI, he may have followed Raymond IV of Toulouse on the First Crusade, earning the nickname el Romero. Under Queen Urraca, whose lover he became, he was Castile's most powerful subject between 1120 and 1127. He resisted Alfonso VII's accession and rebelled in 1130, seizing Palencia; captured and exiled, he was killed in a duel with Alfonso Jordan of Toulouse at the Bayonne siege.
zh: 佩德罗·冈萨雷斯·德·拉腊（?—1130年10月16日）是卡斯蒂利亚权臣，也是家族中第一个以‘德·拉腊’为姓的人。他1088年首次在阿方索六世麾下任掌旗官，可能追随图卢兹伯爵雷蒙四世参加第一次十字军东征，因而得到‘朝圣者’的绰号。在女王乌拉卡治下，他身为女王的情人，于1120—1127年成为卡斯蒂利亚最有权势的臣属。他抵制阿方索七世继位，1130年举兵反叛、攻占帕伦西亚，兵败被俘流放，最终在巴约讷围城战中与图卢兹伯爵阿方斯·若尔当决斗身亡。

en: Peter I (1334–1369), called the Cruel or the Just, was king of Castile and León from 1350, the last ruler of the senior House of Ivrea. Born at Burgos to Alfonso XI and Maria of Portugal, he lost his intended bride, Joan, daughter of Edward III of England, to plague in 1348. He came to the throne at almost sixteen, married Blanche of Bourbon in 1353 and left her two days later for María de Padilla. His long feud with his half-brother Henry of Trastámara plunged Castile into civil war; he took refuge with the Black Prince, who restored him after Nájera in 1367. Henry returned in 1368 and defeated Peter at Montiel in March 1369. Du Guesclin led Peter into his tent, where Henry himself killed him and left the body unburied for three days. The chronicler Ayala, who ended up serving the Trastámaras, drew Peter as a tyrant; the English remembered him kindly, and Chaucer lamented his fall.
zh: 佩德罗一世（1334—1369），绰号“残酷者”或“公正者”，1350年起为卡斯蒂利亚与莱昂国王，也是伊夫雷亚家族主支的最后一位君主。他生于布尔戈斯，为阿方索十一世与葡萄牙的玛丽亚之子，原定的新娘、英王爱德华三世之女琼于1348年染疫而亡。他即位时年近十六岁；1353年迎娶波旁的布朗什，两天后便抛下王后，转投玛丽亚·德·帕迪利亚。他与异母兄特拉斯塔马拉的恩里克长期反目，使卡斯蒂利亚陷入内战；他投奔黑太子，后者于1367年在纳赫拉战役后助他复位。恩里克于1368年返回，1369年3月在蒙铁尔击败佩德罗。杜·盖克兰把佩德罗引入自己的营帐，恩里克亲手将他杀死，尸体三日未葬。编年史家阿亚拉后来效力于特拉斯塔马拉家，笔下的佩德罗是个暴君；英格兰人却对他心存好感，乔叟还为他的陨落而哀叹。

en: Pedro Manrique de Lara (c. 1140–1202), second lord of Molina, was the leading Castilian magnate of the House of Lara under Alfonso VIII. Son of Count Manrique Pérez de Lara and Ermessende of Narbonne, he is first documented in 1158 and helped guard the young king. He defended Toledo and Extremadura against the Almohads, fought around Cuenca, briefly served Ferdinand II of León in 1185–1186, and from 1192 held the viscounty of Narbonne by inheritance. A patron of the monastery of Huerta, he donated saltworks to it with his brother in 1172. The first Spanish noble whose seal survives, he died in January 1202, leaving a son Aimerico by his wife Sancha Garcés of Navarre.
zh: 佩德罗·曼里克·德·拉腊（约1140—1202），第二代莫利纳领主，是阿方索八世朝拉腊家族的首席权贵。他是伯爵曼里克·佩雷斯·德·拉腊与纳博讷的埃尔梅森德之子，1158年首次见于特许状，曾参与守护年幼的国王。他抵御穆瓦希德王朝，保卫托莱多与埃斯特雷马杜拉，在昆卡一带作战，1185—1186年曾短暂效力莱昂国王费尔南多二世，1192年起凭母系继承权领有纳博讷子爵领。他资助韦尔塔修道院，1172年与兄弟向修道院捐赠盐场。他是现存印章最早的西班牙贵族，1202年1月去世，留下与纳瓦拉公主桑查·加塞斯所生的儿子埃梅里科。

en: Pedro Núñez de Guzmán (born c. 1250) was a Leonese-Castilian noble, lord of Puebla de Asturias, Cangas and Tineo. Son of Álvaro Pérez de Guzmán, alcaide of Seville, and María Girón, he served Ferdinand IV as steward major of the royal household and as adelantado mayor of the Andalusia and Galicia frontiers. By his wife Juana Ponce de León he fathered Alonso Meléndez de Guzmán, master of the Order of Santiago, and Eleanor de Guzmán, who became Alfonso XI's all-powerful mistress. He had died before 1324.
zh: 佩德罗·努涅斯·德·古斯曼（约1250年生）是莱昂—卡斯蒂利亚贵族，领有普埃夫拉-德阿斯图里亚斯、坎加斯和蒂内奥。他是塞维利亚城防长官阿尔瓦罗·佩雷斯·德·古斯曼与玛丽亚·希龙之子，曾任费尔南多四世的宫廷总管，并担任安达卢西亚与加利西亚边境的边防总长。他与妻子胡安娜·庞塞·德·莱昂生下阿隆索·梅伦德斯·德·古斯曼（圣地亚哥骑士团团长）和埃莉诺·德·古斯曼，后者后来成为阿方索十一世权倾一时的情妇。他在1324年之前便已去世。

en: Francisco Pizarro (c. 1478–1541), an illegitimate soldier from Trujillo, conquered Peru for Spain. He reached the New World in 1509 and crossed the Isthmus of Panama with Balboa in 1513, later mayor of Panama City. After two failed expeditions, the Crown authorised his conquest of Peru in 1529. He founded San Miguel de Piura, the first Spanish settlement in Peru. Exploiting an Inca civil war, he seized Emperor Atahualpa at Cajamarca in November 1532, took a room filled with gold as ransom and executed him in 1533 before occupying Cuzco. He founded Lima in 1535, became Marquess of the Conquest in 1537, and was assassinated in Lima in June 1541.
zh: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗（约1478—1541）是出身特鲁希略的私生子，后为西班牙征服秘鲁。他1509年前往新大陆，1513年随巴尔沃亚穿越巴拿马地峡，后来担任巴拿马城市长。两次远征失败后，王室于1529年授权他征服秘鲁。他建立了秘鲁首个西班牙人定居点圣米格尔·德皮乌拉。他乘印加内战之机，于1532年11月在卡哈马卡俘获皇帝阿塔瓦尔帕，收下堆满一屋的黄金赎金后仍于1533年将其处死，随后占领库斯科。1535年他建立利马城，1537年受封征服侯爵，1541年6月在利马遇刺身亡。

en: Ruy, or Rodrigo, Pérez Maldonado was Grand Master of the Order of Alcántara from 1335 to 1337, succeeding his brother Suero Pérez Maldonado. He fought the Portuguese at Villanueva de Barcarrota in 1336 and resigned the maestrazgo on 26 May 1337.
zh: 鲁伊·佩雷斯·马尔多纳多（即罗德里戈·佩雷斯）1335年继其兄苏埃罗·佩雷斯·马尔多纳多任阿尔坎塔拉骑士团大团长，1336年在巴尔卡罗塔新镇与葡萄牙军作战，1337年5月26日辞去团长之职。

en: Bernardino de Sahagún (c. 1499–1590) was a Franciscan friar and pioneering ethnographer born at Sahagún in León. He reached New Spain in 1529, mastered Nahuatl, and spent more than fifty years documenting Aztec religion, society and history with native assistants. His research accompanied his missionary work, and he developed methods to collect and check the information he gathered. He translated the Psalms, the Gospels and a catechism into Nahuatl and compiled the General History of the Things of New Spain, preserved as the bilingual and richly illustrated Florentine Codex, whose twelfth book recounts the fall of Tenochtitlan from the Aztec point of view. Native artists drew its illustrations using indigenous and European techniques. His methods later earned him the title of first anthropologist of America.
zh: 贝尔纳迪诺·德萨阿贡（约1499—1590）是方济各会修士、开创性的民族志学者，生于莱昂的萨阿贡。他于1529年抵达新西班牙，掌握纳瓦特尔语，与本土助手一道用五十多年时间记录阿兹特克人的宗教、社会与历史。他在传教之余开展研究，发展出收集和核验资料的方法。他把《诗篇》、福音书和一部教理问答译成纳瓦特尔语，并编纂《新西班牙事物通史》，其传世本即双语且插图丰富的《佛罗伦萨手抄本》，第十二卷从阿兹特克人的视角叙述特诺奇蒂特兰的陷落。本土画师运用原住民和欧洲技法绘制了手抄本的插图。他的方法后来为他赢得“美洲第一位人类学家”的称号。

en: Samuel ha-Levi Abulafia (c. 1320–1360), born at Úbeda into the powerful Abulafia family, was treasurer to Peter the Cruel of Castile. His family had led the Jewish community of Toledo and Castile since about 1200. He began as administrator to the Portuguese knight Juan Alfonso de Alburquerque, then rose at Peter's court from chamberlain to almojarife and judge. When Henry of Trastámara's supporters staged a pogrom against Toledo's Jews and took the royal treasures, Samuel went with the king to Toro to demand them back, then helped him reclaim Toledo and make peace with Portugal at Évora in 1358. With the wealth Peter gave him he founded the Synagogue of El Tránsito in Toledo between 1355 and 1357, its Hebrew and Arabic inscriptions and Moorish features echoing the king's palace in Seville; the church objected, but Peter allowed it. In 1360, suspected of embezzlement, Samuel was imprisoned and tortured, and died under torture.
zh: 塞缪尔·哈列维·阿布拉菲亚（约1320—1360）生于乌韦达，出身显赫的阿布拉菲亚家族，是卡斯蒂利亚国王“暴君”佩德罗的财政大臣。这个家族自1200年前后起就领导着托莱多乃至卡斯蒂利亚的犹太社群。他先为葡萄牙骑士胡安·阿方索·德·阿尔布开克管理事务，后在佩德罗的宫廷中由宫廷长升任阿尔莫哈里费和法官。特拉斯塔马拉的恩里克的支持者袭击托莱多犹太人并夺走王室财宝后，塞缪尔随国王赶往托罗索还，之后又协助国王收复托莱多，并促成1358年与葡萄牙在埃武拉缔约。他用国王赐予的财富，于1355至1357年间在托莱多修建埃尔特兰西托犹太会堂，会堂刻有希伯来文和阿拉伯文铭文，带有与国王塞维利亚宫殿相近的摩尔式特征；教会强烈反对，佩德罗仍予准许。1360年，他因涉嫌侵吞公款被捕受刑，死于酷刑之下。

en: Sancho Alfonso of Castile, called the Mute (Valladolid, c. 1332–1342), was one of the ten children Alfonso XI had with his mistress Eleanor of Guzmán, a brother of Henry II of Castile and a half-brother of Peter I. Described as mute and feeble-minded, he nonetheless held the lordships of Ledesma, Béjar, Granadilla, Montemayor, Galisteo, Salvatierra and Valdecorneja, and served briefly as alférez del rey, the king's standard-bearer. He died about 1342, still a boy. A younger brother of the same name, born in 1343, later became Count of Alburquerque.
zh: 桑乔·阿方索·德·卡斯蒂利亚，绰号“哑巴”（约1332—1342，巴利亚多利德），是阿方索十一世与情妇埃莉诺·德·古斯曼所生十个子女之一，恩里克二世的兄弟，佩德罗一世的异母兄弟。史籍称他又哑又愚钝，却领有莱德斯马、贝哈尔、格拉纳迪利亚、蒙特马约尔、加利斯泰奥、萨尔瓦铁拉和巴尔德科内哈等地，并曾短暂担任国王的执旗官。他约于1342年夭折，仍是个孩子。1343年出生的同名幼弟日后成为阿尔布开克伯爵。

en: Sancho II the Strong (1036/1038–1072), born at Zamora, was the eldest son of Ferdinand the Great and Sancha of León. On Ferdinand's death in 1065 Castile passed to Sancho, León to Alfonso and Galicia to García; Sancho was also assigned the tribute of the taifa of Zaragoza. In 1068 he won the War of the Three Sanchos against Navarre and Aragon, gaining Bureba, Alta Rioja and Álava, then defeated Alfonso at Llantada. In 1071 the brothers seized and divided Galicia. With his alférez El Cid he beat Alfonso at Golpejera in January 1072 and united the three kingdoms. He took his sister Elvira's city of Toro, but while besieging Urraca at Zamora he was murdered by Vellido Adolfo, and Alfonso recovered the throne.
zh: 桑乔二世，绰号“强者”（1036/1038—1072），出生于萨莫拉，是费尔南多大帝与莱昂的桑查的长子。1065年费尔南多死后，卡斯蒂利亚归桑乔，莱昂归阿方索，加利西亚归加西亚；桑乔还获得了萨拉戈萨泰法的贡赋。1068年他在“三桑乔战争”中战胜纳瓦拉与阿拉贡，取得布雷瓦、上里奥哈和阿拉瓦，又在利安塔达击败阿方索。1071年兄弟二人夺取并瓜分了加利西亚。1072年1月，他在御旗官熙德辅佐下于戈尔佩赫拉击败阿方索，统一三国。他夺取了姐妹埃尔维拉的托罗城，却在萨莫拉围攻乌拉卡时被贝利多·阿道尔夫刺杀，阿方索重登王位。

en: Sancho III, called the Desired (c. 1134–1158), ruled Castile and Toledo from 1157 until his death. The eldest son of Alfonso VII of León and Castile and Berengaria of Barcelona, he received Castile while his brother Ferdinand II took León under their father's will. His nickname reflected his birth after eight years of childless marriage. In May 1158 the brothers signed the Treaty of Sahagún, partitioning their conquests against al-Andalus. Their proposed division of Portugal came to nothing after Sancho's early death. Sancho granted the castle of Calatrava to the monk Raymond of Fitero, giving rise to the Order of Calatrava. He married Blanche of Navarre in 1151 and was succeeded by their son Alfonso VIII.
zh: 桑乔三世（约1134—1158），绰号“渴望者”，1157年起统治卡斯蒂利亚与托莱多，直至去世。他是莱昂兼卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索七世与巴塞罗那的贝伦加利亚的长子；依父亲遗嘱，卡斯蒂利亚归他，莱昂归弟弟斐迪南二世。他的绰号源于父母婚后八年无子，直到他出生。1158年5月，兄弟二人签订《萨阿贡条约》，划分了对安达卢斯的征服范围；他们瓜分葡萄牙的计划则因桑乔早逝而落空。桑乔把卡拉特拉瓦城堡交给修士菲特罗的雷蒙驻守，卡拉特拉瓦骑士团由此诞生。他于1151年娶纳瓦拉的布兰卡，死后由其子阿方索八世继位。

en: Sancho IV, called the Brave (1258–1295), was the second son of Alfonso X of Castile. After his elder brother Ferdinand de la Cerda died in 1275, Sancho contested the succession against Ferdinand's infant son Alfonso. Backed by nobles, he rebelled in 1282 and was crowned at Toledo after his father's death in 1284. He married María de Molina in 1282 without the necessary papal dispensation. He crushed constant revolts, executing the lord of Biscay, Lope Díaz de Haro, and imprisoning his brother John. After his release, John rebelled again and brought in the Marinids; in 1291 Sancho relieved Tarifa, where Guzmán the Good had resisted their siege. He died in 1295, leaving María as regent for his nine-year-old son Ferdinand IV.
zh: 桑乔四世（1258—1295），绰号“勇敢者”，是阿方索十世的次子。1275年兄长费尔南多·德·拉·塞尔达死后，他与费尔南多年幼之子阿方索争夺继承权，在贵族支持下于1282年举兵反叛，1284年父亲去世后在托莱多加冕。他于1282年迎娶玛丽亚·德·莫利纳，却未取得必要的教皇特许。他不断镇压叛乱，处死比斯开领主洛佩·迪亚斯·德·阿罗，囚禁弟弟胡安。胡安获释后再次叛乱，引来马林王朝军队；1291年桑乔解塔里法之围，好人古斯曼此前在那里死守。1295年桑乔去世，遗命玛丽亚为九岁的儿子斐迪南四世摄政。

en: Sancho Manuel de Villena (1320–1347) was a Castilian nobleman, the natural son of the prince and writer Juan Manuel by Inés de Castañeda. His father made him first lord of Carcelén and Montealegre, and through his wife María de Castañeda he held Coy and Celdá. A ricohombre of Castile, he served as warden of Lorca and adelantado mayor of the kingdom of Murcia. He left four children, Sancho, Luis, Fernando and Constanza Manuel, and died in 1347.
zh: 桑乔·曼努埃尔·德·比列纳（1320—1347）是卡斯蒂利亚贵族，为比列纳亲王、作家堂胡安·曼努埃尔与伊内斯·德·卡斯塔涅达的私生子。父亲封他为卡塞伦和蒙特阿莱格雷的第一代领主；他又凭借妻子玛丽亚·德·卡斯塔涅达成为科伊和塞尔达的共治领主。身为卡斯蒂利亚高级贵族，他曾任洛尔卡城守和穆尔西亚王国边防总长，身后留下桑乔、路易斯、费尔南多和康斯坦莎·曼努埃尔四个子女，于1347年去世。

en: Michael Servetus (1509 or 1511–1553) was an Aragonese theologian, physician and Renaissance humanist, born at Villanueva de Sigena near Huesca. He took part in the Protestant Reformation and rejected the doctrine of the Trinity and mainstream Catholic teaching about Christ. He studied medicine in France, edited Ptolemy's Geography at Lyon and served as personal physician to the Archbishop of Vienne. His Restoration of Christianity (1553) contained the first correct European description of pulmonary circulation. Arrested by the Catholic Inquisition in April 1553, he escaped to Geneva, where John Calvin denounced him; the city council condemned him and burned him at the stake on 27 October 1553.
zh: 米格尔·塞尔韦特（1509或1511—1553）是阿拉贡的神学家、医生与文艺复兴人文主义者，生于韦斯卡附近的比利亚努埃瓦-德锡赫纳。他参与了新教改革，反对三位一体教义和天主教关于基督的主流教导。他在法国学医，在里昂编辑托勒密的《地理学》，并担任维埃纳大主教的私人医生。他的《基督教的复兴》（1553年）包含欧洲人对肺循环的首次正确描述。1553年4月他被天主教宗教裁判所逮捕，逃脱后前往日内瓦，在那里受到约翰·加尔文检举；市政会将他定罪，于1553年10月27日处以火刑。

en: Francisco Suárez (1548–1617) was a Spanish Jesuit philosopher and theologian, a leading figure of the School of Salamanca. Born at Granada, he entered the Society of Jesus in 1564 after studying law at Salamanca. He began teaching philosophy in 1570 and was ordained in 1572 at Segovia, later teaching theology at Valladolid. He taught at Rome, Alcalá and Salamanca before taking the principal chair of theology at Coimbra in 1597. His Disputationes metaphysicae were read across seventeenth-century Europe, while his treatises on law and church and state earned him the title godfather of international law. Doctor Eximius, he refuted James I of England at Pope Paul V's request, and influenced Grotius and Leibniz.
zh: 弗朗西斯科·苏亚雷斯（1548—1617）是西班牙耶稣会哲学家与神学家，萨拉曼卡学派的代表人物。他生于格拉纳达，先在萨拉曼卡学习法律，1564年加入耶稣会。他于1570年开始教授哲学，1572年在塞哥维亚晋铎，后来在巴利亚多利德教授神学。他先后在罗马、阿尔卡拉和萨拉曼卡任教，1597年出任科英布拉大学首席神学教授。他的《形而上学论辩》风行17世纪的欧洲，其法律与政教关系论著使他被誉为“国际法之父”。他号称“杰出博士”，应教宗保禄五世之命驳斥英王詹姆斯一世，并影响了格劳秀斯与莱布尼茨。

en: Vasco Rodríguez de Coronado was a Castilian knight who served as Grand Master of the Order of Santiago from 1327 until his death around 1338.
zh: 瓦斯科·罗德里格斯·德·科罗纳多是卡斯蒂利亚骑士，1327年至约1338年去世前任圣地亚哥骑士团大团长。

en: Gabriel Vásquez (1549 or 1551–1604), called Bellomontanus, was a Spanish Jesuit scholastic theologian, born near Belmonte in Cuenca. At Alcalá he began studying law before turning to philosophy, which he learned under Domingo Báñez, and entered the Society of Jesus in 1569. After teaching theology at Ocaña, Madrid and Alcalá, he was summoned to Rome in 1585 to succeed Francisco Suárez in the Roman College's theology chair, returning to Alcalá in 1591. In 1593 he joined a commission examining the Jesuit plan of studies. He became Suárez's foremost academic critic, disputing his accounts of natural law and the jus gentium, and his disciples carried on a famous school until his death in 1604.
zh: 加布里埃尔·巴斯克斯（1549或1551—1604），人称贝洛蒙塔努斯，是西班牙耶稣会经院神学家，生于昆卡省贝尔蒙特附近。他在阿尔卡拉先学法律，后转学哲学，师从多明戈·巴涅斯，1569年加入耶稣会。他先后在奥卡尼亚、马德里和阿尔卡拉教授神学，1585年奉召前往罗马，接替弗朗西斯科·苏亚雷斯出任罗马学院神学教授，1591年返回阿尔卡拉。1593年他加入审查耶稣会教学计划的委员会。他成为苏亚雷斯最主要的学术论敌，就自然法与万民法问题与他反复辩难，其弟子形成的学派名噪一时；他于1604年去世。

en: Violant of Aragon (8 June 1236–1301) was queen of Castile and León as the wife of Alfonso X the Wise, whom she married at Burgos in January 1249. A daughter of James I of Aragon and Violant of Hungary, she founded the convent of San Pablo in Valladolid in 1276. After her eldest son Ferdinand de la Cerda died in 1275, Alfonso initially named their second son Sancho as heir. Violant defended the rights of Ferdinand's sons, placing them under the protection of her brother Peter III at Játiva in Aragon. She later lived mostly in Aragon and continued to support her grandson Alfonso de la Cerda's claim. She died at Roncesvalles in 1301 while returning from Rome.
zh: 阿拉贡的比奥兰特（1236年6月8日—1301）是卡斯蒂利亚—莱昂王后，1249年1月在布尔戈斯嫁给“贤者”阿方索十世。她是阿拉贡国王海梅一世与匈牙利的比奥兰特之女，1276年在巴利亚多利德创建圣巴勃罗修道院。1275年长子费尔南多·德·拉塞尔达早逝后，阿方索最初立次子桑乔为继承人。比奥兰特维护费尔南多两个儿子的继承权，把他们托付给兄长阿拉贡国王佩德罗三世，安置在哈蒂瓦。她后来长居阿拉贡，继续支持孙子阿方索·德·拉塞尔达的王位主张。1301年她从罗马返回途中，在龙塞斯瓦列斯去世。

en: Roi Xordo (died 1437) was a Galician hidalgo from the lands of the House of Andrade, by tradition a native of Ferrol or A Coruña. In 1431 he led the Irmandade Fusquenlla, or Mad Brotherhood, in revolt against the harsh lord Nuno Freire de Andrade, called the Evil One. Rising between Pontedeume and Betanzos, his followers took the castle of Moeche and attacked other strongholds as far as Santiago de Compostela, in the first of the Irmandiño revolts. His force was said to number three thousand men and attacked fortresses at Pontedeume and Monforte de Lemos. The brotherhood was defeated at Pontedeume in 1437, where Roi Xordo was killed.
zh: 罗伊·肖尔多（？—1437）是加利西亚小贵族，出身安德拉德家族领地，相传来自费罗尔或拉科鲁尼亚。1431年，他率领“疯人兄弟会”起事，反抗以暴虐闻名的领主努尼奥·弗雷雷·德·安德拉德，此人绰号“恶人”。起义在蓬特德乌梅与贝坦索斯之间爆发，部众攻下莫切城堡，又攻打远至圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉的多处要塞，是为第一次伊尔马迪尼奥起义。相传他的队伍有三千人，还进攻了蓬特德乌梅和蒙福尔特德莱莫斯的要塞。1437年兄弟会在蓬特德乌梅被击败，罗伊·肖尔多兵败被杀。

en: César-François Cassini de Thury (1714–1784), known as Cassini III, was a French astronomer and cartographer. Born at Thury-sous-Clermont, he was the second son of Jacques Cassini and grandson of Giovanni Domenico Cassini, founder of the Paris Observatory. He entered the Academy of Sciences in 1739 and the Royal Society in 1751. In 1744 he began a trigonometric survey of France, which produced the 180-sheet Cassini map, the kingdom's first complete topographical map, completed by his son in 1793. In 1756 he succeeded to his father's official position and continued the family's surveying work. Appointed the Paris Observatory's first director in 1771, he proposed a survey linking it with the Greenwich observatory and died of smallpox in 1784.
zh: 塞萨尔-弗朗索瓦·卡西尼·德·蒂里（1714—1784），又称卡西尼三世，是法国天文学家、地图学家。他生于蒂里苏克莱蒙，是雅克·卡西尼的次子、巴黎天文台创立者乔瓦尼·多梅尼科·卡西尼之孙。1739年他进入法兰西科学院，1751年当选英国皇家学会会员。1744年，他开始以三角测量绘制法国全图，最终成果是180幅图版的“卡西尼地图”——法国第一幅完整的全国地形图，由他的儿子于1793年完成。1756年他继承父亲的官职，继续家族的测绘工作。1771年他被任命为巴黎天文台首任台长，后来提议开展连接巴黎与格林尼治天文台的测量，1784年因天花去世。

en: Berenguer Ramon I, called the Hunchback (c. 1005–1035), inherited the counties of Barcelona, Girona and Ausona in 1018, son of Ramon Borrell and Ermesinde of Carcassonne. A minor until 1023, he long ruled beside his forceful mother. His reign was peaceful: he brought Ermengol II of Urgell to heel, befriended the neighbouring Catalan counts, accepted the suzerainty of Sancho the Great of Navarre and made a pilgrimage to Rome in 1032. His peace with the Muslim taifas angered the nobility, and some nobles acted against his wishes. Ermesinde sought to impose Barcelona's authority on them. He died in 1035 and was buried at Ripoll, leaving his counties divided among his sons.
zh: 贝伦格尔·拉蒙一世，绰号“驼背”（约1005—1035），是拉蒙·博雷利与卡尔卡松的埃尔梅辛德之子，1018年继承巴塞罗那、赫罗纳和奥索纳三个伯国。1023年之前他因年幼，长期与强势的母亲共同执政。他的统治总体和平：迫使乌赫尔伯爵埃尔门戈尔二世臣服，与加泰罗尼亚诸邻邦伯爵修好，接受纳瓦拉的桑乔大帝宗主权，并于1032年前往罗马朝圣。他与穆斯林泰法诸国保持和平，引起贵族不满，一些贵族违背他的意愿自行行动。埃尔梅辛德则试图对他们施加巴塞罗那的权威。1035年他去世，葬于里波尔，伯国被分给几个儿子。

en: Berenguer Ramon II (c. 1053–1097/1099), called the Fratricide, was count of Barcelona from 1076. The son of Ramon Berenguer I and Almodis of La Marche, he first ruled jointly with his twin brother Ramon Berenguer II. Pope Gregory VII appealed for their reconciliation in 1079, but the twins partitioned Catalonia against their father's will and agreed to alternate residence in the Barcelona palace. After Ramon Berenguer II was killed hunting in December 1082, suspicion of murder sparked civil war, weakening Barcelona's authority over Carcassonne and Razès. A settlement of 1086 left Berenguer Ramon ruling as regent for his young nephew Ramon Berenguer III. Twice captured fighting El Cid, he resigned in 1097 and went to Jerusalem, possibly dying on the First Crusade.
zh: 贝伦格尔·拉蒙二世（约1053—1097/1099），绰号“弑亲者”，1076年起任巴塞罗那伯爵。他是拉蒙·贝伦格尔一世与拉马什的阿尔莫迪斯之子，起初与孪生兄长拉蒙·贝伦格尔二世共同统治。1079年教皇格列高利七世呼吁两人和解，但兄弟俩违背父亲遗愿瓜分加泰罗尼亚，并约定轮流居住在巴塞罗那宫殿。1082年12月拉蒙·贝伦格尔二世在林中狩猎时被杀，嫌疑集中在贝伦格尔·拉蒙身上，内战随之爆发，削弱了巴塞罗那对卡尔卡松和拉泽的权威。1086年双方达成妥协，由他为年幼的侄子拉蒙·贝伦格尔三世执政。他在与熙德的交战中两度被俘，1097年退位后前往耶路撒冷，可能死于第一次十字军东征期间。

en: Borrell II (927/928–993) was count of Barcelona, Girona and Ausona from 947 and added Urgell in 948, ruling alone after his brother Miro died in 966. More diplomat than soldier, he exchanged embassies with the caliph of Córdoba in 950 and did homage to al-Hakam II in 966, and he invited the scholar Gerbert of Aurillac, later Pope Sylvester II, to Catalonia. In 970 he and Bishop Ató of Vic went to Rome to seek a separate Catalan church province. The pope approved it, but Ató's murder soon afterwards ended the plan. In July 985 Almanzor sacked Barcelona after defeating Borrell at Rovirans. His appeals to the Frankish crown unanswered, in 988 he refused homage to Hugh Capet, leaving his counties de facto independent.
zh: 博雷尔二世（927/928—993）947年起任巴塞罗那、赫罗纳和奥索纳伯爵，948年又领有乌赫尔，966年兄弟米罗死后独自统治。他外交重于武功：950年与科尔多瓦哈里发互派使节，966年向哈卡姆二世称臣，还邀请学者欧里亚克的热贝尔（即后来的教皇西尔维斯特二世）前来加泰罗尼亚。970年，他与维克主教阿托前往罗马，争取设立独立的加泰罗尼亚教省。教皇批准了计划，但阿托不久遇刺，计划随之落空。985年7月，曼苏尔在罗维兰斯击败博雷尔后洗劫巴塞罗那。他向法兰克王室求援未果，遂于988年拒绝向于格·卡佩行臣服礼，治下诸伯国由此事实上独立。

en: Wilfred the Hairy (Catalan Guifré el Pilós; died 11 August 897) built the fortunes of the early House of Barcelona. He held Urgell and Cerdanya from 870 and received Barcelona, Girona and Besalú in 878, adding the frontier county of Ausona in 886. He repopulated the deserted lands around Vic, on the frontier between Christians and Muslims, restored its bishopric and founded the monastery of Santa Maria de Ripoll. His southern castles provoked the Muslim lords of Lleida; after a failed assault on Lleida he fell defending Barcelona against Lubb ibn Muhammad al-Qasawi in 897. He was buried at Ripoll, and his counties passed to his son Wilfred Borrell.
zh: 威尔弗雷德（加泰罗尼亚语作吉弗雷·埃尔·皮洛斯，绰号“多毛者”，897年8月11日卒）奠定了巴塞罗那家族早期的基业。他自870年起领有乌赫尔和塞尔达尼亚，878年得到巴塞罗那、赫罗纳和贝萨卢，886年又领有边疆伯国奥索纳。他重新开垦基督徒与穆斯林边界上维克一带荒芜的土地，恢复维克主教区，并创立里波尔的圣玛利亚修道院。他在南方修建城堡，触怒了莱里达的穆斯林领主；攻打莱里达失败后，他于897年抵御卢卜·伊本·穆罕默德·卡赛维进犯巴塞罗那时战死。他葬于里波尔，诸伯国由其子威尔弗雷德·博雷利继承。

en: Wilfred II Borrell (Catalan Guifré II Borrell; c. 874 – 26 April 911) succeeded his father Wilfred the Hairy in 897 as count of Barcelona, Girona and Ausona. His father's lands were divided among his sons, and Wilfred governed his three counties with his younger brother Sunyer, who was then a minor under his guardianship. He was the last Catalan count to swear vassalage to a Frankish king. In 898 he married Gersenda, daughter of Odo of Toulouse, by whom he left a daughter but no son. He founded the monastery of Sant Pau del Camp in Barcelona and was buried there after his death in 911, when his counties passed to Sunyer. Bishop Idalguer of Vic executed his will.
zh: 威尔弗雷德二世·博雷利（加泰罗尼亚语作吉弗雷二世·博雷利，约874—911年4月26日）于897年继父亲“多毛者”威尔弗雷德之后，成为巴塞罗那、赫罗纳和奥索纳伯爵。父亲的领地由诸子分领，他与弟弟苏涅尔共同治理自己的三个伯国；当时苏涅尔尚未成年，受他监护。他也是最后一位向法兰克国王宣誓效忠的加泰罗尼亚伯爵。898年他娶图卢兹的厄德之女热尔桑达为妻，只留下一女，没有儿子。他在巴塞罗那创立圣保德尔坎普修道院，911年去世后葬于该院，诸伯国传给苏涅尔。维克主教伊达尔格尔执行了他的遗嘱。

en: Miro (926–966) was count of Barcelona, Girona and Ausona from 947, jointly with his brother Borrell II after their father Sunyer retired to monastic life. The brothers divided the work: Borrell handled military and foreign affairs while Miro took charge of domestic government and the city of Barcelona. He made grants to the monasteries of Sant Cugat del Vallès and Ripoll, and the Rec Comtal canal, which carried water from the Besòs river to the city, is thought to have been built under him. He died at Barcelona in 966.
zh: 米罗（926—966）于947年父亲苏涅尔退隐修道院后，与兄长博雷尔二世共同担任巴塞罗那、赫罗纳和奥索纳伯爵。兄弟二人分工：博雷尔掌管军事与外交，米罗负责内政和巴塞罗那城务。他向圣库加特-德尔巴列斯和里波尔等修道院捐赠，将贝索斯河水引入巴塞罗那的孔塔耳渠，据信也是在他治下修建。966年他死于巴塞罗那。

en: Pau Claris i Casademunt (1586–1641) was a Catalan lawyer and churchman from Barcelona who became the 94th president of the Deputation of the General of Catalonia. A doctor of civil and canon law, he was made a canon of Urgell in 1612 and represented the church arm at the Catalan parliament of 1626, where resistance gathered against Philip IV's taxes. He supported protests against a church tax in Vic in 1634 and secured a provision for sermons in Catalan in 1636. Elected ecclesiastical deputy in July 1638, he led Catalonia through the Reapers' Revolt and, on 16 January 1641, proclaimed the Catalan Republic under French protection. He died in Barcelona the following month, on 27 February 1641.
zh: 保·克拉里斯-卡萨德蒙特（1586—1641）是出身巴塞罗那的加泰罗尼亚律师与教士，曾任第94任加泰罗尼亚总议会主席。他拥有民法与教会法博士头衔，1612年成为乌赫尔教区法政牧师，1626年作为教会等级代表出席加泰罗尼亚议会，当时议会正聚集力量抵制腓力四世的征税。1634年，他支持维克反对教会税的抗议；1636年，他促成了以加泰罗尼亚语布道的规定。1638年7月他当选教会代表、主持总议会，领导加泰罗尼亚度过“收割者起义”，并于1641年1月16日宣布成立受法国保护的加泰罗尼亚共和国。一个多月后，他于1641年2月27日在巴塞罗那去世。

en: Ramon Berenguer I, called the Old (c. 1023–1076), succeeded his father Berenguer Ramon I as Count of Barcelona in 1035. He campaigned against the Muslim taifas, raiding as far as Barbastro and drawing tributes that brought Catalonia its first prosperity, and built Catalan sea power in the western Mediterranean. He acquired Carcassonne and Razès beyond the Pyrenees and began codifying the Usages of Barcelona, seeking to shape and control the spread of feudalism. He scandalised the papacy by marrying Almodis de la Marche, wife of the Count of Toulouse, and both were excommunicated. Together they founded the Romanesque cathedral of Barcelona. He died in 1076, leaving twin heirs.
zh: 拉蒙·贝伦格尔一世，绰号“老者”（约1023—1076），1035年继其父贝伦格尔·拉蒙一世之位成为巴塞罗那伯爵。他出征穆斯林泰法诸国，兵锋远至巴尔瓦斯特罗，索取的大量贡金促成了加泰罗尼亚历史上的第一次繁荣；他还在西地中海建立起加泰罗尼亚的海上势力。他取得比利牛斯山以北的卡尔卡松和拉泽斯，并开始编纂《巴塞罗那习惯法》，试图推动并控制封建化的进程。他娶图卢兹伯爵之妻阿尔莫迪斯·德·拉马什为妻，令教廷震怒，二人被处以绝罚。二人共同创建了巴塞罗那的罗曼式主教座堂。1076年他去世，遗下一对双子继承人。

en: Ramon Berenguer II, called the Towhead for his thick fair hair (1053/1054–1082), was a twin son of Ramon Berenguer I of Barcelona and Almodis de la Marche. On their father's death in 1076 he and his twin Berenguer Ramon II ruled jointly, but they soon quarrelled and partitioned the counties against their late father's will. In December 1082 he was murdered while hunting in the woods; public opinion blamed his brother, who ruled alone and became known as the Fratricide. His son by Mahalta of Apulia, daughter of Robert Guiscard, later ruled as Ramon Berenguer III.
zh: 拉蒙·贝伦格尔二世（1053/1054—1082），因一头浓密的浅色头发得绰号“黄头”，是巴塞罗那伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔一世与阿尔莫迪斯·德·拉马什的双胞胎之子。1076年父亲死后，他与孪生兄弟贝伦格尔·拉蒙二世共同执政，但二人很快反目，违背先父遗愿瓜分了诸伯国。1082年12月，他在林中狩猎时遇害；舆论将此事归咎于他的兄弟，后者独自执政并由此得到“弑兄者”的绰号。他与阿普利亚的马哈尔塔（罗贝尔·吉斯卡尔之女）所生的儿子后来继位，即拉蒙·贝伦格尔三世。

en: Ramon Berenguer III the Great (1082–1131) was count of Barcelona from 1086, at first under his uncle Berenguer Ramon II, ruling alone from 1097. In 1102 he counter-attacked the Almoravids but was defeated at Mollerussa. He absorbed Besalú in 1111 and Cerdanya in 1117, and by marrying Douce, heiress of Provence, in 1112 carried Catalan power east as far as Nice. With a Pisan fleet he raided Muslim Mallorca and Ibiza in 1114 and 1115 and freed Christian captives. In 1116 he sought papal support for a crusade to Tarragona, which he retook and rebuilt by 1118 as the seat of Catalonia's restored archbishopric. He died in 1131, leaving Barcelona to his son Ramon Berenguer IV and Provence to Berenguer Ramon.
zh: 拉蒙·贝伦格尔三世（1082—1131），绰号“伟大者”，1086年起任巴塞罗那伯爵，最初由叔父贝伦格尔·拉蒙二世共同执政，1097年开始独自统治。1102年他反击阿尔摩拉维德人，却在莫列鲁萨战败。他于1111年并吞贝萨卢、1117年并吞塞尔达尼亚，又在1112年迎娶普罗旺斯女继承人杜丝，使加泰罗尼亚势力向东延伸至尼斯。1114至1115年，他联合比萨舰队袭击穆斯林统治的马略卡岛和伊维萨岛，解救基督教囚徒。1116年他请求教皇支持远征塔拉戈纳，至1118年收复并重建该城，使之成为恢复的加泰罗尼亚大主教区驻地。1131年他去世，巴塞罗那传给儿子拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世，普罗旺斯传给贝伦格尔·拉蒙。

en: Ramon Berenguer IV (c. 1114–1162), sometimes called the Saint, inherited the county of Barcelona from his father Ramon Berenguer III in 1131. In August 1137 he was betrothed to Petronilla, the infant heiress of Aragon; her father Ramiro II sought Barcelona's help against Alfonso VII of León. When Ramiro withdrew to a monastery that November, Ramon Berenguer took charge of Aragon as prince, forging the dynastic union of Barcelona and Aragon that became the Crown of Aragon. The two lands retained their own laws and institutions. He usually styled himself count of Barcelona and prince of the Aragonese, though he used the title of king on at least one occasion. He died in Piedmont in August 1162, leaving his son Alfonso II to inherit both Aragon and Barcelona.
zh: 拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世（约1114—1162），有时被称为“圣人”，1131年从父亲拉蒙·贝伦格尔三世手中继承巴塞罗那伯国。1137年8月，他与尚在襁褓的阿拉贡女继承人佩德罗尼拉订婚；她的父亲拉米罗二世寻求巴塞罗那的援助，以对抗莱昂国王阿方索七世。同年11月拉米罗退隐修道院，拉蒙·贝伦格尔遂以亲王身份执掌阿拉贡，促成巴塞罗那与阿拉贡的王朝联合，即后来的阿拉贡联合王国。两地保留各自的法律和制度。他通常使用巴塞罗那伯爵和阿拉贡人亲王的头衔，但至少有一次使用过国王的头衔。1162年8月他死于皮埃蒙特，其子阿方索二世后来同时继承阿拉贡与巴塞罗那。

en: Ramon Borrell (972–1017), son of Borrell II, was count of Barcelona, Girona and Ausona from 992. Surviving Almanzor's last raids, he counter-raided Lleida in 1003 and helped defeat them at Torà. In 1010, during the civil war in the Caliphate of Córdoba, he joined Muhammad II to defeat Caliph Sulayman II and sack Córdoba, though his ally Ermengol I of Urgell was killed. Raids later reached the Ebro and Segre in 1015–1016, and their wealth helped him maintain his barons' loyalty. He repopulated the Camp de Tarragona and was the first Catalan count to mint coinage. He died in 1017, leaving his son Berenguer Ramon to the regency of his wife Ermesinde of Carcassonne.
zh: 拉蒙·博雷利（972—1017）是博雷尔二世之子，992年起任巴塞罗那、赫罗纳和奥索纳伯爵。他顶住曼苏尔最后的几次进攻，1003年回攻莱里达，并在托拉协助击败敌军。1010年，科尔多瓦哈里发国内战期间，他联合穆罕默德二世，击败苏莱曼二世哈里发并洗劫科尔多瓦，但盟友乌赫尔伯爵埃尔蒙戈尔一世战死。1015至1016年，兵锋远达埃布罗河与塞格雷河，所得财富帮助他维系男爵的忠诚。他重新垦殖塔拉戈纳平原，也是第一位自铸钱币的加泰罗尼亚伯爵。1017年他去世，其子贝伦格尔·拉蒙由妻子卡尔卡松的埃尔梅辛达摄政。

en: Sunyer (c. 890–950), the youngest son of Wilfred the Hairy, was count of Barcelona, Girona and Ausona from 911 to 947. He took the offensive against the Muslims of Lleida: in 912 the wali Muhammad al-Tawil routed his army near Tàrrega, but a counter-raid in 914 killed him. Around 920 he disputed Besalú with his brother Miro, who received it in return for renouncing his claim to Barcelona. With the count of Empúries he raided Tortosa and Valencia in 936, killing the qadi of Valencia and forcing Tortosa to pay tribute, and he acknowledged Louis IV of France as his overlord. From 929 he repopulated the Penedès south to Olèrdola. He abdicated in 947 and died three years later.
zh: 苏涅尔（约890—950）是“多毛者”威尔弗雷德的幼子，911年至947年任巴塞罗那、赫罗纳和奥索纳伯爵。他对莱里达的穆斯林转取攻势：912年，莱里达总督穆罕默德·塔维勒在塔雷加附近击败他的军队，但914年的反击将其击杀。约920年，他与兄长米罗争夺贝萨卢，最终米罗得到该地，作为交换放弃对巴塞罗那的主张。936年，他与安普里亚斯伯爵联手袭击托尔托萨和瓦伦西亚，杀死瓦伦西亚的卡迪，迫使托尔托萨纳贡，并承认法兰西的路易四世为宗主。929年起，他向南重新开垦佩内德斯直至奥莱尔多拉。他于947年退位，三年后去世。

en: He Zhen (1321–1388) was a Yuan commander from Dongguan who became the effective ruler of Guangdong. He left office to raise militia against bandits, seized Huizhou and Xunzhou in 1354 and rose to Guangdong's top military post. In 1362 he retook the provincial capital Guangzhou from the strongman Shao Zongyu and beat off Chen Youliang's invading general. Shao besieged Guangzhou again in 1365 and forced He Zhen out, but He rallied his troops and retook the city the following year. When the Ming general Liao Yongzhong marched south in 1368, He Zhen surrendered, helped him defeat Shao and served the new dynasty as a provincial administrator. Ennobled as Count of Dongguan in 1387, he died in 1388 and was posthumously named Zhongjing.
zh: 何真（1321—1388）是元末实际据有广东的元朝将领，东莞人。他弃官回乡组织乡兵抵御盗寇，1354年攻取惠州、循州，升任广东最高军职。1362年，他从豪强邵宗愚手中收复省府广州，又击退陈友谅派来进攻广东的将领。1365年邵宗愚再围广州，迫使何真突围；次年何真重整兵马，夺回广州。1368年，明将廖永忠南下，何真归顺并助他消灭邵宗愚，此后在新朝出任数省地方长官。1387年他受封东莞伯，1388年病逝，谥号忠靖。

en: John I Orsini (Italian Giovanni, died 1317) succeeded his father Richard as count palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynthos in 1303/1304. In 1292 he married Maria, daughter of Despot Nikephoros I of Epirus, and spent a decade at the Epirote court, receiving the island of Leucas. After his father's death, he settled a dispute over the inheritance by paying his stepmother Margaret twenty thousand hyperpyra. As an Achaean vassal he joined the failed siege of Arta in 1304 and the unsuccessful invasion of Epirus in 1307, when disease struck the Latin troops. At Manolada in 1316 he led the loyalist first line against Ferdinand of Majorca, who was routed and killed. John died in 1317; a year later his son Nicholas murdered Despot Thomas and seized Epirus.
zh: 约翰一世·奥尔西尼（意大利语名乔瓦尼，卒于1317年）于1303/1304年继承父亲理查，成为凯法洛尼亚与扎金索斯宫廷伯爵。1292年，他娶伊庇鲁斯专制公尼基弗鲁斯一世之女玛丽亚，并在伊庇鲁斯宫廷生活十年，获赐莱夫卡达岛。父亲去世后，他向继母玛格丽特支付两万海帕皮拉，解决了遗产争端。作为亚该亚侯国的封臣，他参加了1304年对阿尔塔的失败围攻和1307年对伊庇鲁斯的入侵，后一次入侵因拉丁军队爆发疾病而失败。1316年马诺拉达战役中，他率忠军第一线迎击马略卡的斐迪南，后者兵败被杀。约翰于1317年去世，一年后他的儿子尼古拉斯杀害专制公托马斯，夺取伊庇鲁斯。

en: John II Orsini, also John Komnenos Doukas (died 1335), was the second son of Count John I Orsini of Cephalonia and Maria, daughter of the Epirote despot Nikephoros I. In 1323 he murdered his brother Nicholas, who had seized Epirus five years earlier, and succeeded him as count palatine and despot. In 1324 John of Gravina annexed Cephalonia, so John submitted to Emperor Andronikos II, adopted Orthodoxy and married Anna Palaiologina. The emperor granted him the title of despot. When Walter of Brienne besieged Arta in 1331, John accepted Angevin suzerainty; this was reversed after Walter returned to Italy. In 1332 he annexed Thessaly, but Emperor Andronikos III soon took at least its eastern part. John died suddenly in 1335, perhaps poisoned by Anna.
zh: 约翰二世·奥尔西尼，又称约翰·科穆宁·杜卡斯（卒于1335年），是凯法洛尼亚宫廷伯爵约翰一世与伊庇鲁斯专制公尼基弗鲁斯一世之女玛丽亚的次子。1323年，他杀害五年前夺取伊庇鲁斯的兄长尼古拉斯，继任宫廷伯爵兼专制公。1324年格拉维纳的约翰吞并凯法洛尼亚，他只得归顺皇帝安德罗尼卡二世，皈依东正教并娶安娜·帕莱奥洛吉娜。皇帝授予他专制公头衔。1331年布里埃纳的沃尔特围攻阿尔塔时，约翰被迫承认安茹宗主权；沃尔特返回意大利后，这一局面才得以逆转。1332年他吞并色萨利，但皇帝安德罗尼卡三世很快夺取了至少该地区的东部。1335年约翰暴卒，可能被安娜毒杀。

en: Maio I Orsini, also called Matthew de Monopoli, was count palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynthos after the Fourth Crusade. Probably an Apulian from Monopoli, he made himself master of the Ionian islands around 1206. The partition of Byzantine lands had assigned the islands to Venice, which occupied Corfu in 1205; Maio placed his domains under Pope Innocent III in 1207 and for a time acknowledged Venetian suzerainty before turning to the Latin Empire. After Emperor Henry died in 1216, he again sought papal protection. In 1227 he married a sister of the Epirote ruler Theodore Komnenos Doukas, and after Theodore's defeat at Klokotnitsa in 1230 became a vassal of Achaea in 1236. He is last attested in January 1238, when Pope Gregory IX urged him to defend Constantinople.
zh: 马约一世·奥尔西尼，又称莫诺波利的马修，是第四次十字军东征后凯法利尼亚与扎金索斯的行宫伯爵。他很可能是出身莫诺波利的普利亚人，约1206年成为伊奥尼亚群岛的主人。瓜分拜占庭领土时，群岛被划给威尼斯，后者于1205年占领科孚；马约于1207年将领地置于教皇英诺森三世保护之下，一度承认威尼斯的宗主权，后来转投拉丁帝国。皇帝亨利于1216年去世后，他再次寻求教皇保护。1227年，他娶伊庇鲁斯统治者狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯的姐妹为妻；1230年狄奥多尔在克洛科特尼察战败后，他于1236年成为亚该亚侯国的封臣。1238年1月，教皇格列高利九世敦促他出兵保卫君士坦丁堡，这是关于他最后的记载。

en: Maio II Orsini (c. 1228–c. 1260) may be identified with Count Theodore, a little-documented count palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynthos whom a historian places between Maio I and Richard. In this reconstruction, he was likely the son of Maio I and a sister of the Epirote ruler Theodore Komnenos Doukas. A Greek church document of 1264 mentions a count Theodore, apparently after his death, and an eighteenth-century bishop of Cephalonia records a now-lost charter placing another count between Maio I and Richard. He is thought to have died around 1260; in 1262 William II of Villehardouin, prince of Achaea, became guardian of Richard, identified in this reconstruction as his underage son.
zh: 马约二世·奥尔西尼（约1228—约1260）可能就是狄奥多尔伯爵，一位记载稀少的凯法洛尼亚和扎金索斯宫廷伯爵；一位史家认为他统治于马约一世与里卡尔多之间。按照这一推断，他可能是马约一世与伊庇鲁斯君主狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯的姊妹所生之子。1264年的一份希腊教会文书提到狄奥多尔伯爵，当时他似乎已经去世；18世纪的一位凯法洛尼亚主教还记载过一份今已佚失的特许状，指出马约一世与里卡尔多之间另有一位伯爵。他被认为约于1260年去世；1262年，亚该亚亲王威廉二世·维尔阿杜安成为里卡尔多的监护人，而这一推断认为里卡尔多是他的幼子。

en: Maria Komnene Doukaina was an Epirote princess, the only child of Despot Nikephoros I Komnenos Doukas of Epirus and his wife Maria Laskaris, daughter of the Nicaean emperor Theodore II Laskaris. In 1291, during a Byzantine invasion, her father sent her as hostage to Count Richard Orsini of Cephalonia to secure Latin aid. In 1292 Richard married her to his son John I without Nikephoros' leave; the despot forgave them only in 1295, when the couple settled at his court. She became countess palatine when John succeeded in 1303 or 1304. Her sons Nicholas and John II ruled Epirus.
zh: 玛丽亚·科穆宁·杜凯娜是伊庇鲁斯公主，伊庇鲁斯专制君主尼基弗鲁斯一世·科穆宁·杜卡斯与妻子玛丽亚·拉斯卡丽丝（尼西亚皇帝狄奥多尔二世·拉斯卡里斯之女）的独女。1291年拜占庭入侵时，父亲将她送往凯法洛尼亚伯爵里卡尔多·奥尔西尼处为质，以换取拉丁诸邦援助。1292年，里卡尔多未经尼基弗鲁斯同意便将她嫁给其子乔瓦尼一世；专制君主直到1295年夫妇二人移居其宫廷后才予宽恕。1303或1304年乔瓦尼继位，她成为宫廷伯爵夫人。她的儿子尼古拉斯和乔瓦尼二世后来统治伊庇鲁斯。

en: Maria Laskaris Vatatzaina was a Nicaean princess, the daughter of Emperor Theodore II Laskaris and Elena Asenina of Bulgaria and granddaughter of Emperor John III Doukas Vatatzes. Around 1249 her family betrothed her at Pegai to Nikephoros, son of Despot Michael II of Epirus, on whom John III conferred the title of despotes. The wedding was celebrated at Thessalonica in October 1256, sealing Nicaea's alliance with Epirus. Maria died in 1258, leaving a daughter, Maria Komnene Doukaina, later countess of Cephalonia.
zh: 玛丽亚·拉斯卡里斯·瓦塔泽娜是尼西亚公主，皇帝狄奥多尔二世·拉斯卡里斯与保加利亚的埃列娜·阿森妮娜之女，皇帝约翰三世·杜卡斯·瓦塔泽斯的孙女。约1249年，双方在佩盖将她许配给伊庇鲁斯专制君主米海尔二世之子尼基弗鲁斯，约翰三世并授予他专制君主之衔。婚礼于1256年10月在塞萨洛尼基举行，缔结了尼西亚与伊庇鲁斯的同盟。她于1258年去世，留下女儿玛丽亚·科穆宁·杜凯娜，即后来的凯法洛尼亚宫廷伯爵夫人。

en: Richard I Orsini (1165–1197) was an Italian nobleman and the forefather of the Apostolico Orsini, later called the Orsini of Epirus to distinguish them from their Roman cousins. From 1194 he was count of Cephalonia and Zakynthos, ruling the islands through the dowry of his wife, a daughter of the Norman admiral Margaritus of Brindisi. In the same year Emperor Henry VI enfeoffed him as a vassal of the abbey of Materdomini at Nocera. He died at Cephalonia in 1197 and was succeeded by his son Maio I.
zh: 里卡尔多一世·奥尔西尼（1165—1197）是意大利贵族，阿波斯托利科·奥尔西尼支系的始祖，其后人被称为伊庇鲁斯奥尔西尼，以与罗马的同族相区别。1194年起，他凭借妻子——诺曼海军上将布林迪西的马加里托之女——带来的嫁妆成为凯法洛尼亚和扎金索斯伯爵。同年，皇帝亨利六世封他为诺切拉马泰尔多米尼修道院的封臣。1197年他卒于凯法洛尼亚，由其子马约一世继位。

en: Richard Orsini (Italian Riccardo, died 1303/1304) ruled as count palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynthos from before 1260, and also held the County of Gravina in 1284–1291. Around 1262, while he was still a minor, William II of Villehardouin acted as regent. As an Angevin vassal he served as captain-general of Corfu in 1286–1290 and as bailli of the Principality of Achaea in 1297–1300. In 1291/1292 he aided Despot Nikephoros I of Epirus against the Byzantine forces besieging Ioannina, and married his heir John I to the despot's daughter Maria without consulting her father, paving the way for the Orsini takeover of Epirus. As bailli he proposed the betrothal of the Achaean heiress Matilda to Guy II of Athens. He was accidentally killed by one of his own knights.
zh: 理查·奥尔西尼（意大利语名里卡尔多，卒于1303/1304年）自1260年以前起担任凯法洛尼亚与扎金索斯宫廷伯爵，1284—1291年还领有格拉维纳伯国。约1262年，他尚未成年，由维勒阿杜安的纪尧姆二世摄政。作为安茹王朝的封臣，他于1286—1290年任科孚岛总司令，1297—1300年任亚该亚侯国的巴伊。1291/1292年，他出兵救援被拜占庭军队围困于约阿尼纳的伊庇鲁斯专制公尼基弗鲁斯一世，未经专制公同意便让继承人约翰一世娶其女玛丽亚，为奥尔西尼家族后来夺取伊庇鲁斯铺路。他担任巴伊时提议让亚该亚女继承人玛蒂尔达与雅典的居伊二世订婚。他最终意外被自己麾下的一名骑士杀死。

en: Cassandra della Faggiola married the condottiere Ramberto I Malatesta, count of Giaggiolo, and was the mother of Niccolò, Francesco, Margherita and Isotta Malatesta.
zh: 卡桑德拉·德拉·法焦拉嫁给雇佣兵首领、贾焦洛伯爵兰贝托一世·马拉泰斯塔，是尼科洛、弗朗切斯科、玛格丽塔、伊索塔四名子女的母亲。

en: Francesco II Ordelaffi (c. 1310–1374), called the Great, was Ghibelline lord of Forlì from 1331, initially ruling with his uncle Francesco. Driven out by a papal army in 1332, he re-established his rule the next year and gained Cesena and Bertinoro. In 1337 he imprisoned the archbishop of Ravenna and was excommunicated, yet the pope then made him papal vicar for an annual payment. To escape the tribute he sided with Emperor Louis IV and took the title of imperial vicar. Around 1347 he hosted Giovanni Boccaccio in Forlì. His refusal to submit brought on Cardinal Albornoz, who was restoring the Papal State, and a crusade preached against him in 1355–1356. Cesena fell despite the resistance of his wife Cia and son Ludovico, and Forlì fell on 4 July 1359, leaving him only Forlimpopoli and Castrocaro. He later fought for Bernabò Visconti and died in Venice in 1374; his son Sinibaldo succeeded him.
zh: 弗朗切斯科二世·奥尔德拉菲（约1310—1374），绰号“伟大者”，自1331年起任弗利的吉伯林派领主，最初与叔父弗朗切斯科共治。1332年他被教皇军队驱逐，次年重建统治，并获得切塞纳与贝尔蒂诺罗。1337年他囚禁拉文纳大主教，被处以绝罚，随后教皇任命他为教皇代理人，条件是每年缴款。为逃避贡赋，他转而支持皇帝路易四世，成为帝国代理人。约1347年，他在弗利接待薄伽丘。他拒不臣服，引来正在收复教皇国的枢机主教阿尔沃诺斯，教会还在1355—1356年发起针对他的十字军。尽管他的妻子奇娅和儿子卢多维科奋力抵抗，切塞纳仍告陷落；1359年7月4日弗利也陷落，他只保住福利姆波波利和卡斯特罗卡罗。他后来为贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂作战，1374年死于威尼斯，儿子西尼巴尔多继位。

en: Francesco Malatesta was a son of the condottiere Ramberto I Malatesta, count of Ghiaggiolo, and Cassandra della Faggiola, and a brother of Niccolò I Malatesta, who inherited the county of Ghiaggiolo.
zh: 弗朗切斯科·马拉泰斯塔是贾焦洛伯爵、雇佣兵首领兰贝托一世·马拉泰斯塔与卡桑德拉·德拉·法焦拉之子，也是后来继承贾焦洛封邑的尼科洛一世·马拉泰斯塔的兄弟。

en: Giovanni II Malatesta (died 20 September 1299), first count of Sogliano, was the son of Ramberto di Giovanni Malatesta and Rengarda Malabocca of Bagnacavallo. He belonged to the Ghibelline Malatesta branch that opposed Malatesta da Verucchio's hold on Rimini. A knight of the golden spur, he served as podestà of Rimini in 1276 and was among the signatories of the Romagna peace. In 1287 he made peace with Verucchio, but the Romagna rector Pietro Stefaneschi, unable to capture Verucchio, seized Giovanni and held him at Cesena. Released in 1288, he followed the Malatesta into exile. After the 1290 peace he returned home still hostile to his kinsmen, and died in 1299.
zh: 乔瓦尼二世·马拉泰斯塔（1299年9月20日卒）是首任索利亚诺伯爵，父亲是兰贝托·迪·乔瓦尼·马拉泰斯塔，母亲是巴尼亚卡瓦洛的伦加尔达·马拉博卡。他属马拉泰斯塔家族的吉伯林支派，反对马拉泰斯塔·达·韦鲁基奥控制里米尼。他是金马刺骑士，1276年任里米尼最高行政官，并在罗马涅诸城的和约上署名。1287年他与韦鲁基奥和解，但罗马涅督主教彼得罗·斯特凡内斯基未能抓住韦鲁基奥，便将乔瓦尼拘捕、押往切塞纳。他于1288年获释，随后随马拉泰斯塔家族流亡。1290年和议后他返乡，仍敌视同族，1299年去世。

en: Giovanni Malatesta, also called Gianne, was an Italian noble of the Sogliano branch of the Malatesta, the son of Malatestino da Sogliano. He made his home in Rimini: in January 1352 he renewed a lease on a house in the city with the syndic of the Hospital of the Holy Spirit, and on 22 April 1352 he renewed another at Monte San Giuliano. He married a woman named Margherita and died around 1358, leaving as his heir his son Malatesta; he also had a son Ramberto.
zh: 乔瓦尼·马拉泰斯塔，又作詹内，是意大利贵族，属马拉泰斯塔家族的索利亚诺支系，马拉泰斯蒂诺·达·索利亚诺之子。他在里米尼定居：1352年1月，他与圣灵医院的代表续签了里米尼一处房屋的租约，同年4月22日又在蒙特圣朱利亚诺续签了另一份租约。他娶玛格丽塔为妻，约1358年去世，继承人是儿子马拉泰斯塔，另有一子兰贝托。

en: Isotta Malatesta (died 1363) was a daughter of the condottiere Ramberto I Malatesta, count of Ghiaggiolo, and Cassandra della Faggiola. She married Matteo Bianchetti and died in 1363.
zh: 伊索塔·马拉泰斯塔（1363年卒）是贾焦洛伯爵、雇佣兵首领兰贝托一世·马拉泰斯塔与卡桑德拉·德拉·法焦拉之女，嫁给马泰奥·比安凯蒂，1363年去世。

en: Malatesta II Malatesta of Sogliano (died c. 1380) was the son of Giovanni Malatesta, called Gianne, and Margherita. With his brother Ramberto II he ruled as sovereign count of Sogliano from 1358, holding castles from Verucchio and Roncofreddo to Strigara and Montecodruzzo. Still a minor under his mother's regency, he saw Count Lando's mercenary company storm Sogliano in November 1358. He married Agnesina Faetani, leaving five children.
zh: 索利亚诺的马拉泰斯塔二世（约1380年卒）是乔瓦尼·马拉泰斯塔（又名詹内）与玛格丽塔之子。1358年起，他与兄弟兰贝托二世同为索利亚诺宗主伯爵，领有韦鲁基奥、龙科弗雷多、斯特里加拉、蒙特科德鲁佐等多座城堡。他幼年丧父，由母亲摄政；1358年11月，兰多伯爵的雇佣兵连攻占索利亚诺。他娶阿涅西娜·法埃塔尼为妻，身后留下五个子女。

en: Malatestino Malatesta, known as Malatestino da Sogliano, was an Italian condottiero of the Ghibelline Malatesta branch and a son of Giovanni II Malatesta, first count of Sogliano. Orphaned in 1299, he was recorded in 1305 buying the castle of Strigara with his brothers Guglielmo and Ramberto. In 1317 the Guelph Malatesta of Rimini took Sogliano, after which he and his family took refuge with his cousin Ramberto, count of Giaggiolo; together they occupied Forlì and drove out Ferrantino Malatesta. In 1334, with Ramberto and Malatesta Guastafamiglia, he retook Sogliano and rebuilt its walls. He is last documented in 1334; his son Giovanni is attested in 1352.
zh: 马拉泰斯蒂诺·马拉泰斯塔，又称马拉泰斯蒂诺·达·索利亚诺，是意大利雇佣兵首领，属马拉泰斯塔家族吉伯林派，首任索利亚诺伯爵乔瓦尼二世之子。1299年丧父，1305年有他与兄弟古列尔莫、兰贝托共同购置斯特里加拉城堡的记载。1317年，据守里米尼的圭尔夫派马拉泰斯塔攻占索利亚诺，他与家人投靠堂亲贾焦洛伯爵兰贝托，随后双方合作占领弗利，逐走费兰蒂诺·马拉泰斯塔。1334年，他与兰贝托及马拉泰斯塔·瓜斯塔法米利亚联手收复索利亚诺并重修城墙。他本人最后见于1334年的记载，其子乔瓦尼在1352年已有活动记录。

en: Margherita Malatesta was a daughter of the condottiere Ramberto I Malatesta, count of Ghiaggiolo, and Cassandra della Faggiola. She married Pazzino Strozzi.
zh: 玛格丽塔·马拉泰斯塔是贾焦洛伯爵、雇佣兵首领兰贝托一世·马拉泰斯塔与卡桑德拉·德拉·法焦拉之女，嫁给帕齐诺·斯特罗齐。

en: Cia Ordelaffi, born Marzia degli Ubaldini (1317–1381), was the daughter of Vanni Ubaldini, lord of Susinana, and in 1334 married Francesco II Ordelaffi, Ghibelline lord of Forlì. In May 1351 her intervention to relieve her son Ludovico was decisive in winning the Battle of Dovadola. In 1357, with a papal crusade preached against the Forlivesi, her husband entrusted Cesena to her. She held out against Cardinal Gil de Albornoz until, on her father's advice, she surrendered on 21 June; Villani records that she asked safe passage for her soldiers and nothing for herself. Albornoz had her and her relatives imprisoned at Ancona, and she was released in July 1359, when Forlì fell and Francesco renounced his claims to it. She died at Forlì in 1381 and was buried beside her husband. She is remembered as one of Italy's best-known women warriors, and Caterina Sforza's stand at Ravaldino later renewed her legend.
zh: 奇娅·奥尔德拉菲本名马尔齐娅·德利·乌巴尔迪尼（1317—1381），是苏西纳纳领主万尼·乌巴尔迪尼之女，1334年嫁给弗利的吉伯林派领主弗朗切斯科二世。1351年5月，她出兵援救儿子卢多维科，对多瓦多拉战役的胜利起了决定性作用。1357年，教皇方面对弗利人发动十字军，丈夫把切塞纳托付给她。她抵抗枢机主教希尔·德·阿尔沃诺斯，最终听从父亲劝告，于6月21日投降；据维拉尼记载，她只为部下请求安全通行，自己别无所求。阿尔沃诺斯把她和亲属关押在安科纳，1359年7月弗利陷落、弗朗切斯科放弃对该城的主张后，她才获释。1381年她在弗利去世，与丈夫合葬。她是意大利最著名的女战士之一，后来卡泰丽娜·斯福尔扎在拉瓦尔迪诺的抵抗重燃了她的传说。

en: Niccolò I Malatesta (died 1374) was a condottiere, son of Ramberto I Malatesta, count of Ghiaggiolo, and Cassandra della Faggiola. In 1355 he fought for the Church, helping to take Santarcangelo and Verucchio. In 1356 he took the field against Francesco Ordelaffi, defending Savignano, but was captured near Cesena and held in a harsh prison for over two years, until Count Lando freed him. Hired by Florence during the Pisan war, he recovered the castles of Sambuceto, Palazzuolo and Montevecchio from the people of Cesena, who had usurped them, in 1363. In 1367 his father granted him the county of Ghiaggiolo; he is thought to have died in 1374.
zh: 尼科洛一世·马拉泰斯塔（1374年卒）是意大利雇佣兵首领，贾焦洛伯爵兰贝托一世·马拉泰斯塔与卡桑德拉·德拉·法焦拉之子。1355年他为教会作战，参与攻占圣阿尔坎杰洛与韦鲁基奥。1356年他起兵对抗弗朗切斯科·奥尔德拉菲，守卫萨维尼亚诺，却在切塞纳附近兵败被俘，在严酷的牢狱里被关押两年多，最终由兰多伯爵救出。比萨战争期间他受雇于佛罗伦萨，1363年收回被切塞纳人侵占的圣布切托、帕拉佐洛和蒙特韦基奥三座城堡。1367年其父把贾焦洛封邑赠予他；他约于1374年去世。

en: Niccolò da Montefeltro (died 1348) was a natural son of Federico I da Montefeltro, count of Urbino.
zh: 尼科洛·达·蒙泰费尔特罗（卒于1348年）是乌尔比诺伯爵费德里科一世·达·蒙泰费尔特罗的私生子。

en: Onestina dei Calboli was a noblewoman of the Guelph Calboli family of Romagna who married the Ghibelline Sinibaldo I Ordelaffi. She was the mother of Francesco II Ordelaffi, who ruled Forlì from 1331.
zh: 奥内斯蒂娜·德·卡尔博利出身罗马涅的圭尔夫派卡尔博利家族，嫁给吉伯林派的西尼巴尔多一世·奥尔德拉菲，是1331年起统治弗利的弗朗切斯科二世·奥尔德拉菲之母。

en: Onestina Ordelaffi was a daughter of Francesco II Ordelaffi, Ghibelline lord of Forlì, and his wife Cia degli Ubaldini. She married Gentile da Mogliano of Fermo.
zh: 奥内斯蒂娜·奥尔德拉菲是弗利的吉伯林派领主弗朗切斯科二世·奥尔德拉菲与妻子奇娅·德利·乌巴尔迪尼之女，嫁给费尔莫的真蒂莱·达·莫利亚诺。

en: Paolo Malatesta, known as il Bello (c. 1246–c. 1284), was the third son of Malatesta da Verucchio, lord of Rimini. In 1265 he fought alongside his father against Guido da Montefeltro. In 1269 he married Orabile Beatrice, heiress of the counts of Ghiaggiolo, founding the Malatesta di Giaggiolo line. The marriage advanced his father's ambitions in the Ghibelline county, whose rulers had opposed the Guelph Malatesta. In March 1282 Pope Martin IV made him Captain of the People in Florence. He is famous for his affair with Francesca da Polenta, wife of his brother Gianciotto, whom he had represented at her proxy wedding. The lovers were slain by Gianciotto around 1284, traditionally at Gradara, an episode Dante immortalized in Inferno, Canto V.
zh: 保罗·马拉泰斯塔，绰号美男子（约1246—约1284），是里米尼领主马拉泰斯塔·达·韦鲁基奥的第三子。1265年，他随父亲对抗圭多·达·蒙泰费尔特罗。1269年，他娶贾焦洛伯爵家族的女继承人奥拉比莱·贝阿特丽丝，开创马拉泰斯塔·迪·贾焦洛支系。这场婚姻有助于他父亲在贾焦洛扩张势力：该伯国属吉伯林派，其统治者与圭尔夫派的马拉泰斯塔家族为敌。1282年3月，教皇马丁四世任命他为佛罗伦萨人民长官。他最著名的事迹是与兄长詹乔托之妻弗朗切斯卡·达·波伦塔的恋情——当初他曾代表兄长出席她的代理婚礼。约1284年，两人被詹乔托杀死，相传遇害地点在格拉达拉；但丁在《神曲·地狱篇》第五章中使这段故事不朽。

en: Ramberto I Malatesta (1302–1367), son of Uberto, count of Giaggiolo, belonged to the Giaggiolo branch of the Malatesta and spent his life in arms, always trying to harm his kinsmen in Rimini. Small of stature, he was called il contino di Ghiaggiolo. Though a Ghibelline, he served the Church when Cardinal Bertrando del Poggetto forced Ferrantino to give Rimini up to the pope. Beaten under the walls of Ferrara in 1333, he escaped by swimming the Po. He helped the Ordelaffi retake Forlì, then raised Cesena in revolt and became its podestà, which set him against Francesco Ordelaffi for good. He later served Florence against Mastino della Scala and Pisa, and Cardinal Albornoz against the Ordelaffi. In 1356 Francesco's wife Cia caught him on the road toward Cesena and put him to flight. In 1360 his own sons shut him in a dungeon, and he died there in 1367, having given Giaggiolo to his son Niccolò.
zh: 兰贝托一世·马拉泰斯塔（1302—1367）是贾焦洛伯爵乌贝托之子，属于马拉泰斯塔家族的贾焦洛支系，一生戎马，总想着给里米尼的族亲添乱。他身材矮小，人称贾焦洛小伯爵。他虽是吉伯林派，却在枢机主教贝尔特兰多·德尔·波杰托逼迫费兰蒂诺把里米尼交还教皇时为教会效力。1333年在费拉拉城下战败，泅渡波河逃生。他帮助奥尔德拉菲家族收复弗利，又策动切塞纳叛乱并出任其最高行政官，从此与弗朗切斯科·奥尔德拉菲势不两立。后来他受雇于佛罗伦萨，对抗马斯蒂诺·德拉·斯卡拉和比萨，又为枢机主教阿尔沃诺斯攻打奥尔德拉菲家族。1356年，弗朗切斯科之妻奇娅在他进军切塞纳途中突袭，将他击溃。1360年，亲生儿子们把他关进地牢，他于1367年死于狱中，死前把贾焦洛封邑授予儿子尼科洛。

en: Ramberto II Malatesta was an Italian condottiero of the Ghibelline branch of the Malatesta and a son of Giovanni II Malatesta, first count of Sogliano, by Sofia Silighini, whose dowry had brought the family the Sogliano lands in 1255. In 1305 he bought Strigara castle with his brothers Guglielmo and Malatestino. In 1334 he and Malatestino retook Sogliano with the help of Malatesta Guastafamiglia and rebuilt its walls. Ramberto died in 1348.
zh: 兰贝托二世·马拉泰斯塔是意大利雇佣兵首领，属马拉泰斯塔家族的吉伯林派索利亚诺支系，是首任索利亚诺伯爵乔瓦尼二世·马拉泰斯塔与索菲娅·西利吉尼之子，其母于1255年携索利亚诺领地作为嫁妆嫁入。1305年，他与兄弟古列尔莫和马拉泰斯蒂诺共同购置斯特里加拉城堡。1334年，他与马拉泰斯蒂诺在马拉泰斯塔·瓜斯塔法米利亚帮助下收复索利亚诺，重修城墙。兰贝托于1348年去世。

en: Ramberto II Malatesta of Sogliano (died 1379) was the son of Giovanni Malatesta, called Gianne. From 1358 he ruled as sovereign count of Sogliano jointly with his brother Malatesta II, holding castles including Verucchio, Roncofreddo, Strigara and Montecodruzzo.
zh: 兰贝托二世·马拉泰斯塔（1379年卒）是乔瓦尼·马拉泰斯塔（又名詹内）之子，1358年起与兄弟马拉泰斯塔二世同为索利亚诺宗主伯爵，领有韦鲁基奥、龙科弗雷多、斯特里加拉、蒙特科德鲁佐等城堡。

en: Sinibaldo Ordelaffi (died 1337) was a Forlì nobleman of the Ordelaffi family, son of Teobaldo and brother of Scarpetta Ordelaffi, first lord of Forlì. His son by Orestina Calboli was Francesco II Ordelaffi, later Ghibelline lord of Forlì and Cesena.
zh: 西尼巴尔多·奥尔德拉菲（1337年卒）是弗利奥尔德拉菲家族贵族，泰奥巴尔多之子、弗利首任领主斯卡尔佩塔之弟。他与奥雷斯蒂娜·卡尔博利所生之子弗朗切斯科二世后来成为吉伯林派的弗利和切塞纳领主。

en: Sinibaldo I Ordelaffi (1336–1386), son of Francesco II Ordelaffi and the warrior Cia degli Ubaldini, was Ghibelline lord of Forlì. On 6 January 1376 he exploited the city's revolt against papal rule to recover the seigniory. In 1377 he helped Astorre I Manfredi against Cardinal Robert of Geneva and took Cesena. In 1379 Pope Urban VI made him papal vicar of Forlì, Forlimpopoli and Castrocaro. In 1382, with Alberico da Barbiano, he repelled Louis of Anjou's assault. In December 1385 his nephews Pino and Cecco imprisoned him in Ravaldino castle, where he died the next year, possibly poisoned.
zh: 西尼巴尔多一世·奥尔德拉菲（1336—1386）是弗朗切斯科二世·奥尔德拉菲与女战士奇娅·德利·乌巴尔迪尼之子，吉伯林派的弗利领主。1376年1月6日，他趁弗利起兵反抗教皇统治之机重建领主政权。1377年他协助阿斯托雷一世·曼弗雷迪对抗日内瓦枢机主教罗贝尔，并攻取切塞纳。1379年，教皇乌尔班六世任命他为弗利、福利姆波波利和卡斯特罗卡罗的教皇代理人。1382年，他在阿尔贝里科·达·巴尔比亚诺协助下击退安茹的路易的进攻。1385年12月，侄子皮诺和切科把他囚禁在拉瓦尔迪诺城堡，他于次年死去，可能死于毒杀。

en: Uberto Malatesta (c. 1270–1324), count of Giaggiolo, was the eldest son of Paolo il Bello and Orabile Beatrice, raised at Rimini by his uncle Gianciotto, who had murdered his father. In 1297 he fled to the Ghibellines and became their captain-general in Romagna. In 1300 he seized Cesena from his uncle Malatestino, and in 1302 took Roversano castle from the Polentani. He became podestà of Cesena in 1303, only to be expelled for authoritarian rule. Tradition says he killed Gianciotto in 1313 to avenge his father. In 1321 he joined the Montefeltro in an unsuccessful attack on Rimini. In 1324 his cousin Ramberto betrayed his plot against Pandolfo I, who had Uberto slain at a banquet.
zh: 乌贝托·马拉泰斯塔（约1270—1324）是贾焦洛伯爵、保罗·美男子与奥拉比莱·贝阿特丽丝的长子，由杀害其父的伯父詹乔托在里米尼抚养成人。1297年他投奔吉伯林派，成为该派在罗马涅的总司令。1300年他从伯父马拉泰斯蒂诺手中夺取切塞纳，1302年又从波伦塔家族手中攻取罗韦尔萨诺城堡。1303年他出任切塞纳最高行政官，不久便因专横被市民驱逐。相传他在1313年杀死詹乔托，为父报仇。1321年他与蒙泰费尔特罗家族联手进攻里米尼，却遭击退。1324年，他的堂兄弟兰贝托出卖了他反对潘多尔福一世的密谋，潘多尔福设下宴席将他杀死。

en: Anselmo of Ceva was a son of Bonifacio del Vasto, lord of Savona and western Liguria, and Agnes de Vermandois. His father's testament of 1125 named him among the sons sharing the family patrimony in southern Piedmont. Anselmo was associated with Ceva and Clavesana, which his sons later held separately: Guglielmo I became the first documented marchese of Ceva, and Bonifacio the first marchese of Clavesana. Anselmo died in 1178.
zh: 安塞尔莫·迪·切瓦是萨沃纳及西利古里亚之主博尼法乔·德尔·瓦斯托与阿涅丝·德·韦芒杜瓦之子。1125年父亲立遗嘱时，把他列入共享皮埃蒙特南部家族领地的诸子之中。安塞尔莫与切瓦和克拉韦萨纳两地有关，他的儿子后来分别领有两地：古列尔莫一世成为第一位有文书可考的切瓦侯爵，博尼法乔则成为首位克拉韦萨纳侯爵。安塞尔莫于1178年去世。

en: Benedetto di Ceva was a son of Guglielmo I, first marquis of Ceva, and one of the brother marquises who held the marquisate jointly in the early thirteenth century.
zh: 贝内德托·迪·切瓦是切瓦首任侯爵古列尔莫一世之子，是13世纪前期诸兄弟共治的切瓦侯爵之一。

en: Bonifacio di Ceva was a son of Guglielmo I and ruled the marquisate jointly with his brothers. In 1222 he joined their exchange of Boves for Mombasiglio; he was still living on 11 November 1243, his last known appearance.
zh: 博尼法乔·迪·切瓦是古列尔莫一世之子，与诸兄弟共同统治切瓦侯国。1222年他参与以博韦斯交换蒙巴西廖的交易；1243年11月11日他仍在世，这是他最后一次见载。

en: Bonifacio di Ceva was a marquis of Ceva from 1324 to 1326, the son of Giorgio III di Ceva and a grandson of Marquis Giorgio II il Nano. His father died before his grandfather, and on 29 June 1324 Bonifacio and his brother Oddone appear among the Ceva lords who concluded a convention with the Scarelli of Pornasio. He died after 22 April 1328.
zh: 博尼法乔·迪·切瓦是1324—1326年的切瓦侯爵，乔治三世·迪·切瓦之子、侯爵“矮子”乔治二世之孙。父亲先于祖父去世，1324年6月29日，博尼法乔与兄弟奥多内作为切瓦诸侯，与波尔纳西奥的斯卡雷利家族签订协约。他在1328年4月22日之后去世。

en: Federico di Ceva was a son of Guglielmo IV of the Aleramici marquises of Ceva. On 30 December 1329 Arnaldo, bishop of Asti, invested him and his brother Emerico with the shares held by their family in the feuds of Lesegno, Mombasiglio and Montegrosso. In May 1349 he swore fealty to bishop Baldracco Malabayla of Asti, receiving in fee a quarter of Lesegno and Montegrosso and an eighth of Mombasiglio, part of the Church's drive to recover rights over feudal lordships in the region.
zh: 费代里科·迪·切瓦是切瓦阿勒拉米奇家族侯爵古列尔莫四世之子。1329年12月30日，阿斯蒂主教阿尔纳尔多把家族世代持有的莱塞尼奥、蒙巴锡利奥和蒙特格罗索封地的相应份额封授给他与兄弟埃梅里科。1349年5月，他向阿斯蒂主教巴尔德拉科·马拉巴伊拉宣誓效忠，获封莱塞尼奥和蒙特格罗索各四分之一以及蒙巴锡利奥八分之一的份额；这是教会收回地方封建领主权行动的一部分。

en: Giorgio II di Ceva, called il Nano (before 1268 – shortly after 29 June 1324), was marquis of Ceva; after his death the marquisate gradually fragmented in the fourteenth century. He consistently backed Asti against Charles of Anjou; Asti and its allies won at Roccavione in 1275, and Giorgio joined the peace of 1282. On 22 October 1295 he sold Ceva and all his lands to Asti for a hundred thousand lire, receiving them back as a fief. He defeated his rival cousin Guglielmo IV and in 1309 aided Asti's Guelph Solaro against the Ghibellines.
zh: 乔治二世·迪·切瓦，绰号“侏儒”（1268年前—1324年6月29日后不久），是切瓦侯爵；他死后，侯国在14世纪逐渐分裂。他始终支持阿斯蒂对抗安茹的查理；阿斯蒂及其盟友于1275年在罗卡维奥内获胜，乔治也参与了1282年的和约。1295年10月22日，他以十万阿斯蒂里拉把切瓦及全部领地卖给阿斯蒂，再以封臣身份领回。他击败了争夺侯国的堂亲古列尔莫四世，并于1309年协助阿斯蒂的归尔夫派索拉罗家族对抗吉伯林派。

en: Giorgio I di Ceva was a mid-thirteenth-century marquis of Ceva, allied with Asti against Charles of Anjou. His daughter Luigia married Thomas I of Saluzzo and mothered Manfred IV; his son Giorgio II il Nano succeeded him, first appearing in documents in 1268.
zh: 乔治一世·迪·切瓦是13世纪中叶的切瓦侯爵，与阿斯蒂结盟对抗安茹的查理。其女路易莎嫁萨卢佐侯爵托马索一世，生曼弗雷迪四世；其子“侏儒”乔治二世继位，1268年首见文献。

en: Giorgio III di Ceva was a son of the marquis Giorgio II of Ceva; invested with his father's lands by Asti in 1295, he and his brother ratified their sale in 1296, and he died before his father, leaving sons Bonifacio and Oddone.
zh: 乔治三世·迪·切瓦是切瓦侯爵乔治二世之子；1295年阿斯蒂公社将其父的领地册封给他，1296年他与弟弟追认了领地的出售，此后先于父亲去世，留下博尼法乔、奥多内两子。

en: Guglielmo V of Ceva was a son of Giorgio II “the Dwarf”, marchese of Ceva in southern Piedmont. In February 1296 he and his brother Giorgio III joined their father in ratifying the sale of the town and castle of Ceva to the commune of Asti. When Giorgio II died in 1324, Guglielmo's elder brother had already predeceased him, leaving the young nephews Bonifacio and Oddone. On 30 May 1326 the heirs partitioned the marquisate: Guglielmo took Priero, Malpotremo, Nucetto, Viola and Lisio, while his nephews received Battifollo and neighbouring lordships.
zh: 古列尔莫五世·迪·切瓦是皮埃蒙特南部切瓦侯爵乔治二世“矮子”之子。1296年2月，他与兄长乔治三世随父亲一同批准把切瓦城和城堡卖给阿斯蒂公社。1324年乔治二世去世时，其兄已先他而亡，留下年幼的侄子博尼法乔和奥多内。1326年5月30日，继承人瓜分侯国：古列尔莫得到普列罗、马尔波特雷莫、努切托、维奥拉和利肖，两个侄子则分得巴蒂福洛及邻近领地。

en: Guglielmo I of Ceva (before 1170–before 1222) was the first marquess of Ceva and founder of the Ceva line of the Aleramici, son of Anselmo and grandson of Bonifacio del Vasto; his brother Bonifacio founded the Clavesana branch. First documented in 1170 treating with Albenga, he swore the cittadinatico oath at Savona in 1188. In 1190 Asti forced him to surrender Montezemolo and Murialdo, returned as fiefs, and in 1191 he was podestà of Asti. In 1214 the bishop of Asti enfeoffed him with Boves. He died before 1222, succeeded by his sons under Guglielmo II.
zh: 切瓦的古列尔莫一世（1170年前—1222年前）是第一代切瓦侯爵、阿莱拉米奇家族切瓦支系的始祖，安塞尔莫之子、博尼法乔·德尔瓦斯托之孙；其弟博尼法乔开创了克拉韦萨纳支系。现存文献中，他最早于1170年与阿尔本加缔约，1188年在萨沃纳作市民宣誓。1190年，阿斯蒂迫使他割让蒙特泽莫洛和穆里亚尔多，再将两地作为封邑封还；1191年他出任阿斯蒂长官。1214年，阿斯蒂主教将博韦斯封给他。他于1222年前去世，诸子在古列尔莫二世主导下继立。

en: Guglielmo II di Ceva (died after 25 November 1228) ruled the marquisate of Ceva jointly with his brothers after their father Guglielmo I died around 1224. In 1218 he was sent to Alba to swear a stricter citizenship pact, binding the family to serve the city with ten knights and two hundred foot soldiers. He fought with Alba against Enrico del Carretto in 1223–1224, and in the War of Capraia backed Genoa in 1225 before switching to Asti in 1227, helping cut Alba and Alessandria off from Liguria. He married a daughter of Manfredo II of Saluzzo.
zh: 古列尔莫二世·迪·塞瓦（1228年11月25日后去世）在父亲古列尔莫一世约1224年去世后，与诸兄弟共同统治切瓦侯国。1218年，他被派往阿尔巴宣誓订立更严苛的公民盟约，家族须出十名骑士和二百名步兵为该城服役。1223—1224年，他与阿尔巴联手对抗恩里科·德尔·卡雷托；卡普拉亚战争中，他先于1225年支持热那亚，1227年转投阿斯蒂，协助切断阿尔巴和亚历山德里亚通往利古里亚的联系。他娶了萨卢佐侯爵曼弗雷迪二世的一个女儿。

en: Guglielmo III di Ceva was a thirteenth-century marquis of Ceva who, with Giorgio I, led the house at the height of its power. He married Sofia, daughter of Enrico II del Carretto, marquis of Savona.
zh: 古列尔莫三世·迪·切瓦是13世纪的切瓦侯爵，与乔治一世共同执掌家族，使侯国处于鼎盛时期。他娶萨沃纳侯爵恩里科二世·德尔·卡雷托之女索菲娅为妻。

en: Guglielmo IV di Ceva was a Ceva marquis who contested control of the marquisate with his kinsman Giorgio II il Nano in the 1290s, in a war that devastated the family lands. Allied with the commune of Mondovì and Emanuele di Clavesana, he tried to supplant Giorgio, who seized Nucetto from Guglielmo's son Bonifacio. Although Count Giorgio of Biandrate arbitrated a settlement, the dispute ended in Guglielmo's defeat: in 1297 Mondovì agreed to exile him and his Clavesana allies, while in 1295 Ceva itself had been sold to Asti.
zh: 古列尔莫四世·迪·切瓦是切瓦侯爵，1290年代与亲属“侏儒”乔治二世争夺侯国，战争使家族领地残破。他联合蒙多维城邦和埃马努埃莱·迪·克拉韦萨纳，企图压倒乔治；乔治则从古列尔莫之子博尼法乔手中夺取努切托。尽管比安德拉特伯爵乔治出面仲裁和解，争端仍以古列尔莫失败告终：1297年蒙多维同意将他及克拉韦萨纳同盟者逐出城邦，而切瓦本土已于1295年售予阿斯蒂。

en: Leone di Ceva was a son of Guglielmo I and one of the Ceva marquises ruling jointly with his brother Guglielmo II. In 1221 he joined Guglielmo II in renewing the family's citizenship pact with Alba, and in 1227 both brothers switched from Genoa to Asti, fielding a hundred knights against Alba and Alessandria. In 1243 he served as imperially appointed podestà of Alba. He died before 1252, leaving four young sons, including Andrea, under the guardianship of their uncle Giorgio.
zh: 莱昂内·迪·切瓦是古列尔莫一世之子，是与兄长古列尔莫二世共同执政的切瓦侯爵之一。1221年，他与古列尔莫二世一同向阿尔巴续订公民盟约；1227年，兄弟二人脱离热那亚转投阿斯蒂，率一百名骑士对阿尔巴和亚历山德里亚作战。1243年，他出任由皇帝任命的阿尔巴行政长官。他于1252年前去世，留下四个年幼的儿子，其中包括安德烈亚，由叔父乔治监护。

en: Manuele di Ceva was a son of Guglielmo I, first marquis of Ceva, and ruled the marquisate jointly with his brothers under the preeminence of Guglielmo II. In 1211 he joined his father and Guglielmo II in authorizing Ottone di Carassone's gift of a chestnut grove to the Casotto charterhouse. In 1222 he and his brothers exchanged Boves for Mombasiglio and its castle: Boves was distant from their main lands and difficult to defend, while Mombasiglio lay closer. He is last documented on 12 June 1256.
zh: 曼努埃莱·迪·切瓦是切瓦首任侯爵古列尔莫一世之子，在古列尔莫二世居长的诸兄弟共治格局中统治切瓦侯国。1211年，他与父亲及古列尔莫二世一同批准奥托尼·迪·卡拉索内向卡索托加尔都西会修道院捐赠一片栗树林。1222年，他与诸兄弟以博韦斯交换蒙巴西廖及其城堡：博韦斯远离家族主要领地，难以防守，蒙巴西廖则更近。1256年6月12日是他最后一次见于文献。

en: Maria del Vasto was a daughter of Manfred II, marquess of Saluzzo, and Azalaïs of Montferrat. She married Guglielmo II, marchese of Ceva, linking the two Aleramic houses. Her son Giorgio I ruled Ceva and was the father of Giorgio II “the Dwarf”.
zh: 玛丽亚·德尔·瓦斯托是萨卢佐侯爵曼弗雷迪二世与蒙费拉托的阿扎莱斯之女，嫁给切瓦侯爵古列尔莫二世，联姻阿勒拉米奇家族的两支。她的儿子乔治一世统治切瓦，是乔治二世“矮子”的父亲。

en: Menzia d'Este was the wife of Giorgio I, marchese of Ceva, and the mother of Aloisia, wife of Tommaso I of Saluzzo.
zh: 门齐亚·埃斯特是切瓦侯爵乔治一世之妻，也是萨卢佐侯爵托马索一世之妻阿洛伊西亚的母亲。

en: Oddone di Ceva, also spelled Ottone, was a son of Giorgio III di Ceva and a grandson of Marquis Giorgio II il Nano of the Piedmontese marquisate of Ceva. On 29 June 1324 he and his brother Bonifacio appear among the Ceva lords concluding a convention with the Scarelli of Pornasio. Oddone married Eleonora, daughter of Marquis Manfredo IV of Saluzzo and Isabella Doria. He died after 1 January 1332.
zh: 奥多内·迪·切瓦（又作奥托内）是乔治三世·迪·切瓦之子、皮埃蒙特切瓦侯国侯爵“矮子”乔治二世之孙。1324年6月29日，他与兄弟博尼法乔作为切瓦诸侯，与波尔纳西奥的斯卡雷利家族签订协约。奥多内娶萨卢佐侯爵曼弗雷多四世与伊莎贝拉·多里亚之女埃莱奥诺拉为妻，在1332年1月1日之后去世。

en: Fang Guozhen (1319–1374), a native of Huangyan in Zhejiang, was the leading coastal rebel of the late Yuan. In 1348 he formed a pirate band among the offshore islands and preyed on the grain ships feeding the Yuan capital Dadu. Yuan forces failed to defeat him, and official titles secured only his nominal submission; he continued to intercept grain. By 1356 he ruled the coastal prefectures of Qingyuan, Taizhou and Wenzhou with a thousand-ship fleet, and from 1357 he helped Zhang Shicheng ship grain north to Dadu. Zhu Yuanzhang's generals seized his ports in 1367 and Fang surrendered that December. Zhu needed his fleet and granted him favorable terms; Fang died in Nanjing in 1374.
zh: 方国珍（1319—1374），浙江黄岩人，是元末东南沿海最有势力的海上叛首。1348年，他在沿海岛屿聚众为盗，劫掠供给元朝都城大都的粮船。元军未能击败他，以官爵招抚也只换来名义上的归顺；他继续拦截粮船。到1356年，他已据有庆元、台州、温州三路沿海州郡，部众拥有上千艘船只；1357年起，他又替张士诚向大都海运粮食。1367年，朱元璋的部将连下他的港口，方国珍于同年十二月投降。朱元璋需要他的船队，给予他优厚条件；1374年方国珍在南京去世。

en: Guo Zixing (1302–1355) was a wealthy White Lotus notable from Dingyuan and an early Red Turban rebel leader. In February 1352 he and his allies seized Haozhou with several thousand followers. The young Zhu Yuanzhang joined him that April and rose quickly; Guo gave him his adopted daughter, the future Empress Ma, in marriage. Feuds divided the commanders at Haozhou, and Zhu rescued Guo after Sun Deya and Zhao Junyong's faction seized him. Guo later left Zhao and joined Zhu at Chuzhou. After Guo died in 1355, Han Lin'er confirmed his son Guo Tianxu and brother-in-law Zhang Tianyou as successors; Zhu gradually consolidated his leadership. In 1370 Zhu posthumously named Guo Prince of Chuyang.
zh: 郭子兴（1302—1355）是濠州定远的富豪、白莲教首领，也是早期红巾军起事者之一。1352年二月，他与同盟率数千人袭取濠州。年轻的朱元璋于同年四月投奔其麾下，迅速得到提拔；郭子兴把养女、后来的马皇后许配给他。濠州诸将争斗不止，郭子兴被孙德崖、赵均用一派扣押后，朱元璋将他救出。郭子兴后来离开赵均用，在滁州与朱元璋会合。1355年他去世后，韩林儿确认其子郭天叙和妻弟张天祐继承其地位；朱元璋逐渐巩固了领导权。1370年，朱元璋追封郭子兴为滁阳王。

en: Indravarman V, originally named Harideva, was a king of Champa. In 1257 he assassinated his uncle Jaya Indravarman VI, but waited until 1266 for his coronation. He refused Kublai Khan's demand of personal submission, and in 1282–1283 Sogetu's Yuan army seized Vijaya, driving Indravarman and his son Harijit into the mountains to wage guerrilla war. Disease and supply shortages wore the invaders down, and after Sogetu fell in battle in 1285, Champa was delivered. He sent an embassy to Kublai that October, died in 1288, and was succeeded by Harijit, the future Chế Mân.
zh: 因陀罗跋摩五世（原名诃梨提婆）是占城国王。1257年他刺杀舅父阇耶因陀罗跋摩六世上台，却迟至1266年才正式加冕。他拒绝元世祖忽必烈亲自入朝称臣的要求；1282—1283年，唆都率领的元军攻占毗阇耶，把他和太子诃梨吉特（即日后的制旻）逼入山区开展游击战。元军饱受疫病和补给不足之苦，1285年唆都战死，占城得以解脱。同年10月他遣使忽必烈，1288年去世，诃梨吉特继位，即制旻。

en: Jamo, called Chế Mỗ in Vietnamese annals (制某), was a Cham prince and the son of King Jaya Ananda of Champa. His father invested him with the rank of Bố điền, or great king, as royal heir, and appointed his son-in-law Maha Sawa as minister. When Jaya Ananda died in May 1342, Maha Sawa drove Jamo out and seized the throne. Jamo fled to Đại Việt, where the Trần dynasty ruled.
zh: 制某是占城王子，国王制阿难之子。父亲封他为布田，即大王、王位继承人，又任命女婿茶和布底为宰相。1342年五月制阿难死后，茶和布底驱逐制某，自立为王。制某出奔由陈朝统治的大越。

en: Jaya Ananda, called Chế A Nan in Vietnamese records, founded the thirteenth dynasty of Champa and ruled from 1318 to 1342. Born in the southern marches of Đại Việt, he was a commander under the Cham king Chế Năng. When the Trần dynasty drove Chế Năng into exile in Java in 1318, the Vietnamese installed Jaya Ananda as a vassal king. Cham tradition expected the leader of the five-state alliance to come from the Areca or Coconut tribe, which he did not, and Cham nobles opposed him from 1323 to 1326. In 1323 he sent tribute to the Yuan court to seek recognition. Emperor Trần Minh Tông, fearing Champa would slip away under Chinese protection, invaded in 1326 but was repelled, and Champa stood independent thereafter. On his death in 1342 his son-in-law Maha Sawa seized the throne from his heir Jamo, who fled to Vietnam.
zh: 制阿难（梵名贾亚·阿难陀，？—1342）是占城第十三王朝的建立者，1318—1342年在位。他出生于大越南部边陲，原为占城国王制能麾下将领。1318年，陈朝军队迫使制能流亡爪哇，越人立制阿难为附庸国王。按占城传统，五国联盟的首领应出自槟榔或椰子部族，他并不符合，因此1323年至1326年间一直受到占族贵族的反对。1323年他遣使向元朝进贡，以求得到承认。陈明宗担心占城得到中国庇护后脱离控制，1326年出兵进攻，却被击退，此后占城保持独立。1342年他去世后，女婿茶和布底从继承人制某手中夺取王位，制某逃往安南。

en: Jaya Simhavarman III (Chế Mân), son of Indravarman V, ruled Champa from 1288 to 1307. As crown prince Harijit he led Cham resistance to the Mongol invasion of 1282–1283, holding a wooden stockade before fleeing with his father into the mountains. A patron of Hindu temples, he added buildings to Po Nagar in 1277, endowed Po Klaung Garai, and built Yang Prong Tower. In 1306 he married Princess Huyền Trân of Đại Việt, ceding the provinces of Ô and Lý as bride price. He died in 1307, and her refusal of sati kindled war with the Vietnamese.
zh: 阇耶僧伽跋摩三世（制旻）是因陀罗跋摩五世之子，1288—1307年为占城国王。他为太子时称诃梨吉特，1282—1283年率军抵抗元军，据守木城，兵败后随父逃入山区。他崇奉印度教，1277年为芽庄的婆那加塔增建殿宇，又赞助潘郎的波克朗加莱塔，并主持修建扬普龙塔。1306年，他迎娶大越陈朝的玄珍公主，以乌、里二州为聘礼；1307年他去世，玄珍拒绝按萨蒂习俗殉葬而归国，由此引发占越之间的战争。

en: Jaya Simhavarman IV (Chế Chí), son of Chế Mân and his first queen Bhaskaradevi, was born in 1284 and ruled Champa from 1307 to 1312. Resenting the loss of the provinces of Ô and Lý ceded to Đại Việt for his father's Vietnamese bride, he stirred the Cham of Thuận and Hóa to revolt. In 1312 Emperor Trần Anh Tông invaded with three armies; Chế Chí surrendered with his family and was carried off to the Trần court, where he died in captivity in 1313. His brother Chế Năng replaced him under Annamese control.
zh: 阇耶僧伽跋摩四世（制至）是制旻与首后巴斯卡拉黛维之子，生于1284年，1307—1312年为占城国王。他不甘乌、里二州因父亲迎娶玄珍而割让给大越，煽动顺州、化州的占人造反。1312年，陈英宗亲率三路大军南征，制至携家属出降，被掳往陈朝京师，1313年在囚禁中死去。其弟制能在安南摆布下继位。

en: Maha Sawa, known in Vietnamese records as Trà Hòa Bố Để, was king of Champa from 1342 to 1360; Bố Để renders the Cham potih, meaning chancellor. A son-in-law of King Jaya Ananda, he seized the throne when the old king died in 1342, driving out Jaya Ananda's son Jamo, the legitimate heir, who fled to the Trần dynasty of Đại Việt and asked for an invasion. In 1353 a large Trần army came to put Jamo on the throne, and Maha Sawa defeated it. In his later years he launched repeated raids north into the Vietnamese borderlands. He died in 1360 and was succeeded by Po Binasuor.
zh: 摩诃茶和（越南史籍称茶和布底，？—1360）是占城第十三王朝国王，1342—1360年在位；“布底”在占语中意为宰相。他是国王制阿难的女婿，1342年制阿难死后，他驱逐制阿难之子、合法继承人制某而自立，制某出奔大越陈朝，请求出兵讨伐。1353年陈朝大军进攻占城，欲送制某回国即位，被摩诃茶和击败。晚年他数次北伐安南，骚扰其边境。1360年去世，由制蓬峩继位。

en: Po Binasuor (Chế Bồng Nga; died 1390) was the last powerful king of Champa, ruling from about 1360. He united the Cham lands and repeatedly attacked Đại Việt, sacking the capital Thăng Long in 1371, 1377 and 1383 and killing King Trần Duệ Tông before Vijaya in 1377. In 1372 he sought Ming support against Đại Việt, and in 1378 wed his daughter to the captive prince Trần Húc. Stopped by Hồ Quý Ly after 1380, he fell to a firearms volley on his barge in 1390; Ko Cheng seized the throne and his sons fled to Đại Việt.
zh: 制蓬峩（？—1390）是占城最后一位强势国王，约1360年即位。他统一占人诸地，连年北伐大越，曾于1371年、1377年和1383年攻陷越都升龙，并于1377年在毗阇耶击杀陈睿宗。1372年他遣使向明朝求援以制衡大越，1378年将女儿嫁给被俘的越南亲王陈勖。1380年后他被胡季犛阻遏，1390年在乘战船进军时遭火枪齐射击毙；部将罗皑随即篡位，他的儿子们投奔大越。

en: Simhavarman, better known as Chế Năng, was a son of Chế Mân by the Javanese queen Tapasi and the last king of Champa's twelfth dynasty. After the Annamese captured his half-brother Chế Chí in 1312, the Trần court installed him as a vassal ruler. He tried to recover the lost provinces of Ô and Lý. In 1318 Trần generals Trần Quốc Chẩn and Phạm Ngũ Lão routed his army; Chế Năng fled with his family to Java, opening the way for the Annamese-backed Chế A Nan.
zh: 僧诃跋摩（通称制能，又作制陀阿婆粘）是制旻与爪哇王后塔帕西之子，占婆第十二王朝的末代国王。1312年其异母兄制至被大越陈朝俘虏后，陈朝立他为臣属国君。他试图夺回失去的乌、里二州。1318年，陈朝将领陈国瑱、范五老大破占军，制能携王族逃往爪哇，第十二王朝就此灭亡，陈朝随后改立制阿难，开启第十三王朝。

en: Chagatai (1183–1242) was the second son of Genghis Khan and Börte and the founder of the Chagatai Khanate.
