He campaigned against the Jin dynasty in 1211 and the Khwarazmian Empire from 1219, feuding with his elder brother Jochi at the siege of Gurganj. He received vast appanages between the Altai and the Amu Darya. Genghis excluded him from the imperial succession because of his inflexible character, notably his refusal to accept Jochi's legitimacy. After Genghis died in 1227 he secured Ögedei's enthronement in 1229 and remained his chief counsellor until his own death in 1242.
zh: 察合台（1183—1242）是成吉思汗与孛儿帖的次子，察合台汗国的开创者。他1211年随军攻金，1219年起参加征伐花剌子模，在玉龙杰赤围城战中与长兄术赤不和。战后他分得阿尔泰山至阿姆河之间的广阔领地。成吉思汗因他性格刚硬，尤其是不承认术赤的合法地位，将他排除在汗位继承之外。1227年成吉思汗死后，他稳定大局，促成窝阔台于1229年登基，并始终是窝阔台最得力的辅佐者，直至1242年去世。

en: Charles-François de Broglie, marquis de Ruffec (1719–1781), was a French general and diplomat, second son of the first duc de Broglie. He fought in the War of the Austrian Succession and the Seven Years' War, serving alongside his brother at Minden in 1759. As ambassador to Poland from 1752 he secretly sought to place the prince de Conti on the Polish throne, but the Anglo-Prussian alliance of 1756 overturned his plans. From 1767 he headed Louis XV's private intelligence network, the Secret du Roi. Exiled to Ruffec in 1771, he continued to advise the king in secret. With Beaumarchais he organized covert French aid to the American insurgents, helping finance La Fayette's voyage in 1777. He died in 1781 and was buried in Angoulême Cathedral.
zh: 夏尔-弗朗索瓦·德·布罗伊，吕费克侯爵（1719—1781），是法国将领与外交家，第一代布罗伊公爵的次子。他参加过奥地利王位继承战争和七年战争，1759年与兄长并肩参加明登战役。1752年起他出任驻波兰大使，暗中谋划让孔蒂亲王登上波兰王位，但1756年英普结盟打乱了他的计划。1767年起，他主管路易十五的私人情报网“国王密档”。1771年被流放至吕费克后，他仍秘密向国王献策。他与博马舍合作，组织法国对美洲起义者的秘密援助，并于1777年资助拉法耶特渡海赴美洲。1781年他去世，葬于昂古莱姆大教堂。

en: Amir Chupan (c. 1262–1327) was a Mongol noble of the Sulduz clan who became commander-in-chief and power behind the Ilkhanid throne, founder of the Chupanid dynasty. After quelling Gilan in 1307 he was made amir al-umara by Il-Khan Öljeitü, whose daughter he married. Under Abu Sa'id he crushed Amir Irinjin's revolt near Mianeh in 1319 and married the Il-Khan's sister Sati Beg, setting his sons over the provinces. In August 1327 Abu Sa'id killed his son Demasq Kaja; Chupan's army deserted and he fled to Herat, where the Kartid ruler Ghiyath al-Din had him strangled that November.
zh: 埃米尔·出班（约1262—1327）是苏勒都斯部的蒙古贵族，官至伊儿汗国全军统帅，是王座背后的实际掌权者，出班王朝的开创者。1307年平定吉兰后，完者都汗任命他为大异密，并以女儿下嫁。不赛因汗在位时，他于1319年在米亚内附近平定异密伊邻真的叛乱，又娶汗的妹妹撒迪别，诸子分领各地。1327年8月，不赛因处死其子达马斯科斯·霍贾；出班大军离散，逃往赫拉特，被卡尔提德统治者吉亚斯丁奉汗命于同年11月缢杀。

en: Demasq Kaja (c. 1300–1327), third son of Amir Chupan, was born during Ghazan's siege of Damascus, which gave him his name. Through his father's power he became viceroy of Azerbaijan and Iraq, and from 1325 he wielded the vizier's authority; with Chupan campaigning in Khurasan in 1326–1327, he effectively ruled the Ilkhanid capital Sultaniya. Abu Sa'id, resentful of the Chupanids, used Demasq's affair with a former concubine of the late Öljeitü as a pretext to move against him. He was captured and killed on 25 August 1327, the first Chupanid to fall, and was buried at Tabriz.
zh: 达马斯科斯·霍贾（约1300—1327）是埃米尔·出班的第三子，生于合赞汗围攻大马士革期间，并以该城得名。凭借父亲的权势，他受任阿塞拜疆与伊拉克总督，1325年起又掌握维齐尔大权；1326至1327年出班远征呼罗珊时，他实际主持伊儿汗都城苏丹尼耶。不赛因汗久已忌恨出班家族，便以他与完者都的旧妾私通为借口动手。1327年8月25日，他被俘处死，是第一个倒下的出班家族成员，葬于大不里士。

en: Hasan Kuchak (c. 1319–1343), ‘the Little’, was a Chupanid prince who rebuilt his family's power from the wreck of the Ilkhanate. His father Timurtash had been executed by the Mamluks in 1328, while Hasan Buzurg's Jalayirids held western Persia behind a puppet Ilkhan. He reunited the Chupanids by claiming his father was still alive and presenting a slave as Timurtash, even marrying him to the dead man's widows. On 16 July 1338 he defeated Hasan Buzurg near Van and, aged nineteen, took Tabriz. As kingmaker he raised Sati Beg to the throne, offered her hand to the rival claimant Togha Temur to split his enemies, then installed Suleiman Khan and forced Sati Beg to marry the new khan. He defeated the Jalayirids again near Maraga in 1340 and put down revolts by his uncle Surgan and other kinsmen. His wife Izzat Malik murdered him in December 1343; he left no heir, and the Chupanid lands were divided.
zh: 哈桑·库楚克（约1319—1343），绰号“小哈桑”，是出班家族王公，在伊利汗国的废墟上重建了家族势力。父亲帖木儿塔什于1328年被马穆鲁克人处死，而哈桑·布祖格的札剌亦儿人则扶植傀儡伊利汗，掌控波斯西部。哈桑声称父亲仍在人世，让一名奴隶假扮帖木儿塔什，甚至让他迎娶亡父的遗孀，借此重新团结出班宗室。1338年7月16日，他在凡城附近击败哈桑·布祖格，十九岁便夺取大不里士。他拥立撒迪别为汗，又把她的婚约许给对立的汗位觊觎者脱合帖木儿，借以离间对手，随后改立苏莱曼汗，并迫使撒迪别嫁给苏莱曼汗。1340年他在马拉盖附近再败札剌亦儿人，并镇压叔父苏尔甘等同族叛乱。1343年12月，妻子伊扎特·马利克将他杀害；他没有继承人，出班家族的领地被瓜分。

en: Malek Ashraf (c. 1318–1357), regnal name Ghiyath al-Din Shah Malek Ashraf, was the second son of the Chobanid commander Timurtash and the last Chobanid to hold real power in the Ilkhanate. After his brother Hasan Kucek's death in 1343 he defeated his uncles Surgan and Yagi Basti, had Yagi Basti murdered in 1344, and raised Anushirwan as his own puppet Ilkhan in Arran before marching to Tabriz in 1346. A harsh and suspicious ruler, he failed to take Baghdad in 1347 and Isfahan in 1350. His rule ended in 1357, when the Golden Horde khan Jani Beg conquered Tabriz.
zh: 马利克·阿什拉夫（约1318—1357），即位后称吉亚斯·丁·沙·马利克·阿什拉夫，是楚邦系将领帖木儿塔失的次子，也是伊儿汗国境内最后一位掌有实权的楚邦系统治者。1343年其兄小哈散死后，他击败叔父苏尔甘与亚吉·巴斯提，于1344年杀死亚吉·巴斯提，在阿兰拥立阿努失儿万为自己的傀儡伊儿汗，随后于1346年进军大不里士。他为政残暴多疑，1347年攻取巴格达失败，1350年又未能拿下伊斯法罕。1357年金帐汗札尼别攻陷大不里士，他的统治随之终结。

en: Sati Beg (fl. 1316–1345) was an Ilkhanid princess, daughter of Il-Khan Öljaitü and sister of Abu Sa'id. In 1319 she married the powerful amir Chupan, executed after falling out with her brother in 1327; her son by him was Surgan. After Abu Sa'id's death she married in turn the il-khans Arpa and then Suleiman Khan. In 1338 the Chobanid leader Hasan Kucek, Chupan's grandson, set her on the Ilkhanid throne as a puppet queen, and she struck coins in her own name as sultan. Deposed by 1339, she vanishes from the records after 1345.
zh: 撒迪别（活跃于1316—1345年）是伊儿汗国公主，完者都之女、不赛因之妹，也是伊儿汗国唯一的女性君主。1319年她嫁给权倾朝野的异密出班；1327年出班与她的兄长反目被杀，她为出班生有一子速儿罕。不赛因死后，她先后改嫁伊儿汗阿儿巴和速来蛮汗。1338年，出班之孙、楚邦王朝王公小哈散在大不里士拥立她为傀儡可汗，她以自己的名义铸币、自称苏丹。1339年她被废黜，1345年后不见记载。

en: Suleiman Khan (birth name Ilyas; died c. 1345) was a Genghisid prince descended from the Ilkhan Hülegü. Around May 1339 the Chobanid commander Hasan Kucek enthroned him as a puppet Ilkhan, and he married the former puppet ruler Sati Beg. In June 1340 he fought with the Chobanids against the Jalayirid leader Hasan Buzurg at the battle of the Jaghatu, and he was later defeated by Eretna near Sivas. After Hasan Kucek's murder in 1343 he fled to Diyarbakir, where coins were still struck in his name until 1345.
zh: 速来蛮（本名伊利亚斯，约1345年卒）是伊儿汗旭烈兀的玄孙，蒙古宗室成员。约1339年5月，楚邦王公小哈散拥立他为傀儡伊儿汗，他又娶了曾被拥立为汗的撒迪别。1340年6月，他随楚邦军在札哈图之战中与札剌亦儿首领大哈散交战，后来又在锡瓦斯附近被埃雷特纳击败。1343年小哈散遇刺后，他逃往迪亚巴克尔，当地以他的名义铸币直至1345年。

en: Surgan (c. 1320–1345) was a Chobanid prince, son of Amir Chupan and the princess Sati Beg. As governor of Karabakh he backed his nephew Hasan Kucek against the Jalayirids at Ala Tagh in 1338 and the Zarrinarud in 1340, receiving the government of Persian Iraq. Angry at Hasan Kucek's treatment of his mother, he defected to Hasan Buzurg; defeated and imprisoned in Anatolia in 1341, he was released after Hasan Kucek's murder in 1343. He then fought Malek Ashraf for the Chobanid lands, lost in 1345, and was executed after fleeing to Baghdad.
zh: 速儿罕（约1320—1345）是楚邦系蒙古王公，异密出班与公主撒迪别之子。他任卡拉巴赫长官时，支持侄子小哈散对抗札剌亦儿人，参加了1338年的阿拉塔格之战和1340年的扎里纳鲁德之战，战后受命掌管波斯伊拉克。因不满小哈散薄待其母，他投奔大哈散，兵败后于1341年被囚禁在安纳托利亚。1343年小哈散遇刺后他获释，随后与马立克·阿什拉夫争夺楚邦领地，1345年战败，逃往巴格达后被处死。

en: Ala al-Din Timurtash (c. 1298–1328) was the second son of Amir Chupan and Chupanid governor of Anatolia from 1319. In 1321–1322 he declared independence and allied with the Mamluks, but submitted when his father marched against him and was kept in office. From 1324 he attacked the Anatolian beyliks, killing the Hamidid Dündar and, around 1326, the Eşrefid Süleyman II, throwing his body into Lake Beyşehir. After Chupan's fall in 1327 he fled to Mamluk Egypt, where Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad welcomed him, then had him executed on 12 August 1328 and sent his head to Abu Sa'id.
zh: 阿拉丁·帖木儿·塔什（约1298—1328）是埃米尔·出班的次子，出班王朝治下安纳托利亚的总督，1319年受任此职。1321至1322年，他宣布独立并与马穆鲁克结盟，其父率兵来讨，他投降后获赦并留任原职。1324年起，他连年征讨安纳托利亚诸贝伊国，杀死哈米德王朝的丁达尔，又在约1326年攻灭埃什雷夫的苏莱曼二世，将其尸体投入贝伊谢希尔湖。1327年出班败亡后，他逃往马穆鲁克埃及，苏丹纳绥尔·穆罕默德起初厚待于他，最终于1328年8月12日将他处死，首级送与不赛因汗。

en: Chen Youliang (1320–1363) was the founder of the Chen Han regime and Zhu Yuanzhang's greatest rival. A fisherman's son from Mianyang in Hubei, he served as a district official before rising under Red Turban commander Ni Wenjun. In 1357 he killed Ni Wenjun for plotting against Xu Shouhui, then overran Anqing, Jiangxi and Fujian. In 1360 he murdered Xu at Caishi and proclaimed himself emperor of Great Han, holding the strongest upper-Yangtze fleet. His long war with Zhu Yuanzhang culminated in the 1363 Battle of Lake Poyang, where Zhu's smaller fleet defeated his after three days of fighting. Trapped in a month-long blockade, Chen was killed by an arrow to the head breaking out.
zh: 陈友谅（1320—1363）是陈汉政权的建立者，也是朱元璋最强大的对手。他是湖北沔阳的渔民之子，曾任县吏，后来在红巾军将领倪文俊麾下崛起。1357年，倪文俊图谋杀害徐寿辉，陈友谅趁机杀死倪文俊，随后连下安庆、江西、福建。1360年，他在采石杀死徐寿辉，自立为大汉皇帝，掌握长江上游最强大的水军。他与朱元璋连年交战，1363年鄱阳湖水战中，朱元璋较小的船队经过三天交战击败陈军。陈友谅被封锁一个多月，突围时头部中箭而死。

en: Alghu (died 1266) was a son of Baidar and a grandson of Chagatai Khan. In 1260, during the Toluid civil war, Ariq Böke made him ruler of the Chagatai ulus against the child khan Mubarak Shah, and Alghu married Mubarak Shah's mother Orghana. He seized Transoxiana, taking Samarkand and Bukhara, but turned against Ariq Böke in 1262, killing his general Qara Buqa before Ariq Böke ravaged the Ili valley and drove him south. In 1263 he submitted to Kublai, gained the vizier Mas'ud Beg, and defeated Kaidu near Otrar. He died in 1266 and was buried at Almaliq.
zh: 阿鲁忽（？—1266年）是贝达儿之子、察合台之孙。1260年拖雷家族内战时，阿里不哥扶立他为察合台汗国之汗，与年幼的木八剌沙及其母兀鲁忽乃对抗，他随后娶兀鲁忽乃为妻以安定汗国。他掌控河中，夺取撒马尔罕与布哈拉，却于1262年起兵反叛阿里不哥，斩杀其大将哈剌不花；阿里不哥随即洗劫伊犁河流域，把他逼退到喀什、于阗一带。1263年他归附忽必烈，得到异密马思忽惕辅佐，又与海都交战，在讹答剌附近取胜。1266年他去世，葬于阿力麻里。

en: Ali Khalil, better known as Ali-Sultan, was a descendant of Kadan and thus of the house of Ögedei. In 1339 he attacked the camp of the Chagatai khan Yesun Temur and seized the throne at Almalik, the only Ögedeid restoration over the Chagatai ulus since Kaidu's day. A Muslim ruler, he pressed Islam on the Chagatai Mongols and persecuted other faiths; in 1339 he ordered six Franciscan friars put to death at Almalik. He reigned until about 1342.
zh: 阿里·哈利勒，通称阿里算端，是合丹的后裔，属窝阔台一系。1339年，他攻打察合台汗也孙帖木儿的斡耳朵，在阿力麻里夺取汗位，这是海都时代以后窝阔台系唯一一次复辟察合台兀鲁思。他以穆斯林君主的身份在察合台蒙古人中强力推行伊斯兰教，迫害其他信仰，并于1339年下令在阿力麻里处死六名方济各会修士。他约在1342年之前在位。

en: Baidar, also called Peta, was the sixth son of Chagatai Khan and a grandson of Genghis Khan. From 1235 to 1241 he joined the Mongol campaign into Europe alongside his nephew Büri, commanding the detachment sent into Poland with Kadan and probably Orda Khan. His troops crossed the frozen Vistula in February 1241, sacked Sandomierz and Kraków, and on 9 April crushed a Polish, German and Templar army under Duke Henry II the Pious at Legnica, where Henry was killed. After ravaging Moravia he rode south to join Batu in Hungary. His son Alghu later ruled the Chagatai ulus.
zh: 贝达儿（又作拜答儿、伯达）是察合台第六子、成吉思汗之孙。1235—1241年，他随侄子不里参加蒙古西征欧洲，与合丹共同统率攻入波兰的偏师，斡儿答也可能参与统军。1241年2月，蒙古军渡过冰封的维斯瓦河，洗劫桑多梅日与克拉科夫；4月9日在列格尼卡战役击溃波兰、德意志军队与圣殿骑士的联军，公爵亨里克二世阵亡。此后他纵兵蹂躏摩拉维亚，再南下匈牙利与拔都的主力会合。他的儿子阿鲁忽后来成为察合台汗。

en: Bayan Qulï (died 1358), a grandson of Duwa Khan, was the puppet khan of the Western Chagatai ulus from 1348 to 1358. In 1348 the Qara'unas amir Qazaghan, effective master of Transoxiana, raised him to the throne after executing Danishmendji, and for a decade he reigned without real authority. When Qazaghan was assassinated in 1358 his son 'Abdullah succeeded him and soon had Bayan Qulï killed. A pious Muslim and disciple of the Khorasani sheikh Saif ed-Din Boharsi, he was buried opposite the sheikh's grave at Bukhara, where a mausoleum was raised over him that same year.
zh: 拜延忽里（？—1358）是笃哇汗之孙，1348—1358年任西察合台兀鲁思的傀儡汗。1348年，实际掌控河中地区的合剌乌纳思部异密加兹罕处死答失蛮察后将他扶上汗位，此后十年间他毫无实权。1358年加兹罕遇刺，其子阿卜杜拉继位，不久便将拜延忽里杀死。他是虔诚的穆斯林，师从呼罗珊谢赫赛夫丁·巴哈尔兹，死后葬于布哈拉的谢赫墓对面，同年墓上建起了陵寝。

en: Buqa Temür was a great-great-grandson of Chagatai Khan and a son of Qadaqchi. Around 1272 he killed Negübei, who had rebelled against Kaidu, and Kaidu rewarded him with the Chagatai throne. Soon after his enthronement he fell seriously ill, and for the rest of his reign he could not make his authority effective. He proved helpless against raids by the sons of Alghu and Baraq and against attacks from the Ilkhanate. In 1282 the descendants of Alghu and Baraq overthrew him, and Baraq's son Duwa succeeded him.
zh: 不合帖木儿是察合台汗的玄孙、揩打密之子。约1272年，他杀死起兵反叛海都的聂古伯，海都随即立他为察合台汗国可汗。即位不久他便重病缠身，在位期间始终无法树立权威，既无力抵御阿鲁忽和八剌诸子的袭扰，也挡不住伊儿汗国的进攻。1282年，阿鲁忽和八剌的后裔合谋将他推翻，八剌之子笃哇继位。

en: Büri (died 1252) was a son of Mutukan and a grandson of Chagatai Khan, who raised him after Mutukan was killed at Bamyan in 1221; his Turkic name means wolf. Brave, hot-tempered and quarrelsome in drink, he joined Batu's western campaign from 1236, fighting in Volga Bulgaria, Russia and the siege of Maghas, but he and Güyük mocked Batu, and Ögedei recalled him in disgrace. In 1241 he ravaged Wallachia and Transylvania, and later settled German miners on his appanage near Talas. After backing the regent Oghul Qaimish against Möngke, he was handed to Batu and executed in 1252.
zh: 不里（？—1252年）是抹土干之子、察合台之孙，1221年抹土干死于巴米扬围城战后由察合台抚养，他的名字在突厥语中意为“狼”。拉施德丁称他勇敢而性急，醉酒后尤其好争吵。1236年起他随拔都西征，转战伏尔加保加利亚、罗斯并参与围攻篾怯思，却与贵由公然羞辱拔都，被窝阔台召回问罪。1241年他蹂躏瓦拉几亚与特兰西瓦尼亚，后来把俘获的德意志矿工安置在怛逻斯附近的封地。贵由死后他支持摄政斡兀立海迷失、反对蒙哥，终被交给拔都，于1252年处死。

en: Buzan (died c. 1335), the son of Duwa Temür, was briefly khan of the Chagatai Khanate in 1334–1335. In 1334 he rose against his uncle Tarmashirin, whose conversion to Islam and settlement in Transoxiana had alienated the Mongol princes, and killed him. Buzan then took the throne; sources call him a Muslim himself, yet he ruled in favour of the traditional Mongol Yassa. His reign lasted less than a year before his cousin Changshi overthrew him.
zh: 不赞（？—约1335）是笃来帖木儿之子，1334至1335年短暂在位为察合台汗国可汗。1334年，他的叔父答儿麻失里因皈依伊斯兰教、定居河中而招致蒙古宗王敌视，不赞起兵将其杀死，随后登上汗位。史籍称他本人也是穆斯林，执政却倚重传统的蒙古《大扎撒》。他在位不到一年，便被堂弟敞失推翻。

en: Changshi (r. 1335–1338) was one of the last effective khans of the Chagatai Khanate, a grandson of Khan Duwa through his father Ebugen. In 1335 he seized the throne from Buzan and reasserted the importance of Almaliq and the Ili valley. Favourably disposed toward Nestorian Christians, he allowed missionaries to preach, repaired churches and granted land for a friary, earning a letter of thanks from Pope Benedict XII in 1338. That year the pope also appointed a bishop to Almaliq. Changshi strengthened relations with the Yuan emperor Toghon Temür by sending him 170 Russian captives as tribute. Chinese accounts say he was murdered in 1338 by his younger brother Yesun Temur, who succeeded him.
zh: 敞失（？—1338）是察合台汗国后期可汗，察合台汗笃哇之孙，父亲是也不干。1335年他从不赞手中夺取汗位，重新强调首都阿力麻里与伊犁河流域的重要性。他优待聂斯脱里派基督徒，允许传教士布道、修缮教堂并拨地修建修道院，1338年教皇本笃十二世为此致函致谢，同年还任命了一位驻阿力麻里的主教。敞失向元顺帝进贡170名俄罗斯俘虏，加强与元朝的关系。中文史籍记载，1338年他被弟弟也孙帖木儿谋杀，后者继承汗位。

en: Danishmendji was a prince of the house of Ögedei whom the Qara'unas amir Qazaghan placed on the Chagatai throne in 1346, after Qazaghan had defeated and killed Khan Qazan. As the first khan of the Western Chagatai ulus set up by the tribal amirs, he ruled only as Qazaghan's puppet from his seat in Transoxiana. He was executed by Qazaghan in 1348 and replaced by Bayan Qulï.
zh: 答失蛮察是窝阔台系宗王。1346年合剌乌纳思部异密加兹罕攻杀合赞汗后，将他扶上察合台汗位，立都于河中地区。他是西察合台兀鲁思第一位由部落异密拥立的汗，实权尽归加兹罕。他于1348年被加兹罕处死，汗位由拜延忽里继承。

en: Duwa Temür (died c. 1331), a son of Duwa, was khan of the Chagatai Khanate in 1329–1330. In 1313, during Esen Buqa I's revolt against the Yuan emperor Ayurbarwada, he surrendered to Yuan forces. He seized power by overthrowing his brother Eljigidey in 1329. The Yuanshi and the 1330 Jingshi Dadian show him still ruling then: with Öz Beg of the Golden Horde and Abu Sa'id of the Ilkhanate he presented a map of his realm to the Yuan court, which listed the Chagatai ulus beside theirs. Muslim writers claim his brother Tarmashirin soon deposed him.
zh: 笃来帖木儿（？—约1331）是察合台汗笃哇之子，1329至1330年为察合台汗国大汗。1313年也先不花起兵反抗元仁宗爱育黎拔力八达时，他曾向元朝军队投降。1329年，他推翻兄弟燕只吉台夺取汗位。《元史》与1330年成书的《经世大典》表明他当时仍在位：他与钦察汗月即别、伊儿汗不赛因一同向元朝进献本藩地图，察合台兀鲁思因此与两大汗国并列。穆斯林史家称他不久即被兄弟答儿麻失里废黜。

en: Ebugen was a Chagatai prince, a son of Duwa Khan. He never occupied the throne himself, but his sons Changshi and Yesun Temur each reigned as khans of the Chagatai Khanate between 1335 and 1339.
zh: 额不坚是察合台系宗王，笃哇汗之子。他本人未曾即位，他的两个儿子敞失和也孙帖木儿在1335—1339年间先后做过察合台汗国的可汗。

en: Eljigidey (died 1329), a son of Duwa, succeeded his brother Kebek as khan of the Chagatai Khanate in 1326. During the Yuan succession struggle of 1328–1329 he backed his ally Kusala, who was enthroned at the Yuan court in 1329 but died in suspicious circumstances within months. The new Yuan emperor, Tugh Temür, sent Naimantai, a descendant of Muqali, with an imperial seal to appease him. Eljigidey's brief reign ended in 1329 when another brother, Duwa Temür, overthrew him.
zh: 燕只吉台（？—1329）是察合台汗笃哇之子，1326年其兄怯别去世后继位为察合台汗国大汗。在1328至1329年元朝皇位之争中，他支持盟友和世㻋；和世㻋于1329年登基为元明宗，数月后便蹊跷死去。新帝元文宗图帖睦尔为安抚他，派木华黎后裔乃蛮台携印玺前往。1329年，他的另一个兄弟笃来帖木儿将他推翻，短暂统治就此结束。

en: Esen Buqa I (died c. 1318), a son of Duwa, spent his early years at the Yuan capital of Dadu. After his brother Kebek overthrew Taliqu in 1308 or 1309, a quriltai in 1310 proclaimed him Chagatai khan. He began on good terms with the Yuan, sending jewels and horses as tribute in 1312 and 1313, but border quarrels brought war in 1314 with both the Yuan and the Ilkhan Öljeitü. Yuan forces defeated him at Chimaigan in 1315, and in 1316 Samarqand and Bukhara were ravaged. He died around 1318, and Kebek returned to the throne.
zh: 也先不花（？—约1318）是笃哇之子，早年留居大都。1308或1309年其弟怯别推翻塔里忽后，1310年的忽里台大会推举他为察合台汗。他起初与元朝修好，1312、1313年进贡珠宝和驼马；后因边界争端，于1314年同时与元朝和伊儿汗国的完者都开战，1315年元军在赤麦干将他击败。1316年撒马尔罕和布哈拉遭到劫掠。约1318年他去世，怯别复位。

en: Kadan, also called Qadan, was a son of Ögedei Khan by a concubine and a grandson of Genghis Khan, raised in Chagatai's ordo. He campaigned west with Batu against the Qipchaqs and Rus', and in 1241, with Baidar and Orda, led a diversionary army through Poland, helping defeat the Silesians at Legnica. He then ravaged Moravia and Hungary, sacking Buda, and pursued King Béla IV into Croatia and Dalmatia until Ögedei's death recalled the Mongols in 1242. He backed Möngke's election in 1251 and later supported Kublai against Ariq Böke, holding his appanage around Beshbalik.
zh: 合丹是窝阔台汗庶出之子、成吉思汗之孙，幼年在察合台的宫帐中长大。他早年随拔都西征奇卜察克与斡罗思，1241年与拜答儿、斡儿答一同率领偏师攻入波兰，参与了在莱格尼察击破西里西亚军队的战役。此后他纵掠摩拉维亚与匈牙利，焚破布达，并追击匈牙利国王贝拉四世至克罗地亚和达尔马提亚，直至1242年窝阔台死讯传来才随军东返。1251年他拥戴蒙哥即位，后来又支持忽必烈对抗阿里不哥，其封地在别失八里一带。

en: Kaidu (c. 1235–1301), a posthumous son of Qashi and grandson of the Great Khan Ögedei, led the House of Ögedei. In 1252 Möngke enfeoffed him at Qayaliq near Lake Balkhash. He defeated the Chagatai khan Baraq on the Jaxartes and divided Transoxiana with him at the Talas kurultai of 1269; in 1271 another Talas assembly invested him as ruler of the reconstituted Ulus of Ögedei. From 1282 he controlled the Chagatai khan Duwa and waged decades of war against his cousin Kublai's Yuan dynasty. Wounded fighting Qayishan at Mount Tiejiangu on 3 September 1301, he died late that year.
zh: 海都（约1235—1301）是大汗窝阔台之孙、合失的遗腹子，后来成为窝阔台家族的领袖。1252年蒙哥将巴尔喀什湖一带的海押立封给他。他在锡尔河畔击败察合台汗八剌，并于1269年塔拉斯忽里勒台与八剌瓜分河中地区；1271年又在塔拉斯的集会上被拥立为重建的窝阔台兀鲁思之主。1282年起，他扶立都哇为察合台汗并加以控制，同堂叔忽必烈建立的元朝进行了数十年战争。1301年9月3日，他在帖坚古山与海山作战时负伤，同年年底死去。

en: Kebek, a younger son of Duwa, overthrew Taliqu in 1308 or 1309 and became Chagatai khan. Near Almaliq he defeated the invading sons of Kaidu, ending the Ögedeid threat, but at a quriltai in 1310 he yielded the throne to his brother Esen Buqa, back from the Yuan court. When Esen Buqa died around 1320, Kebek ruled again and in June 1320 killed the rebel prince Yasa'ur. He kept peace with the Yuan, sending tribute from 1323, standardized the coinage, promoted agriculture, and built Qarshi as a settled capital. He died around 1326, succeeded by his brother Eljigidey.
zh: 怯别是笃哇较年幼的儿子之一。1308或1309年他推翻塔里忽，成为察合台汗，在阿力麻里附近击败来犯的海都诸子，终结了窝阔台系复国的威胁。1310年他在忽里台大会上把汗位让给从中原归来的兄长也先不花。约1320年也先不花死后，怯别再度执政，于1320年6月攻杀反叛宗王牙撒兀儿。他与元朝保持和平，自1323年起进贡，统一币制、扶持农业，并营建卡尔希作为定居都城。他约于1326年去世，弟燕只吉台继位。

en: Khabul Shah was the nominal khan of the Western Chagatai ulus from about 1364, a Chagatai prince descended from Khan Eljigidey. Before his enthronement he lived as a Sufi dervish in a mountain cave and wrote poetry. In 1364 the emirs Husayn and Timur, having seized Transoxiana, raised him from his dervish's rags to the throne in a ceremony built around the royal cup. He ruled as Amir Husayn's puppet. One account says he was deposed in 1366; another holds that Timur had him executed in 1370 after taking power in Transoxiana.
zh: 合不勒沙是约1364年起的西察合台兀鲁思名义可汗，为察合台汗燕只吉台的后裔。即位之前，他是隐居山洞的苏菲派托钵僧，还擅长写诗。1364年，攻占河中地区的异密忽辛与帖木儿把他从托钵僧的破衣烂衫中扶出，在以授予御杯为核心的仪式上将他立为汗。他在位期间只是异密忽辛的傀儡。一说他于1366年被废；另一说认为帖木儿于1370年在河中掌权后下令处死了他。

en: Khashin, also called Qashi (c. 1215–c. 1236), was the fifth son of Ögedei Khan by Empress Anghui and a grandson of Genghis Khan. His name came from Hexi, the Mongol name for the Tangut kingdom of Western Xia, against which Genghis was campaigning at his birth. Like his father he was a heavy drinker and died young while Ögedei still lived; after his death his name became taboo and the Hexi lands were called only Tangut. His son Kaidu, born around 1235, later led the House of Ögedei in its long wars against Kublai.
zh: 合失（约1215—约1236）是窝阔台大汗第五子，昂灰皇后所生，成吉思汗之孙。他出生时正值成吉思汗出征西夏，其名便来自蒙古人对西夏的称呼“河西”（音近合失）。他与父亲一样嗜酒，年少而亡，时窝阔台仍在位；他死后名字成为忌讳，河西之地只改称唐兀。其子海都约生于1235年，后来统领窝阔台一系，长期与忽必烈争战。

en: Könchek (died 1308), a son of Duwa, succeeded his father as khan of the Chagatai Khanate in 1307 with the recognition of the Yuan court, which he had visited at Dadu in 1306. He kept the peace with the Yuan after decades of war, and in 1308 his envoys presented the Great Khan with old census registers of Samarkand and other cities, offering three years of tribute as a sign of submission. During his short reign the Delhi Sultanate recovered Lahore. He ruled little more than a year and died in 1308, after which Taliqu seized the throne.
zh: 宽阇（？—1308）是笃哇之子，1306年曾奉父命前往大都朝贺，1307年初笃哇死后经元朝册封继位为察合台汗。他与元朝结束数十年战端、保持友好，1308年向元朝进献撒马尔罕等地的旧户口清册，并请以三年贡赋上交，以示恭顺。他在位期间，德里苏丹国收复了拉合尔。宽阇在位仅一年有余，于1308年去世，此后塔里忽夺取了汗位。

en: Mubarak Shah (died 1276), son of Qara Hülegü and Orghana, was the first Chagatai khan to convert to Islam. He succeeded his father in 1252 as a child under his mother's regency, until Ariq Böke replaced him with Alghu in 1260. After Alghu's death Orghana restored him in the spring of 1266 without Kublai Khan's approval; Kublai backed Baraq, who won over the army and drove Mubarak Shah from the throne that September. He later supported Kaidu against Baraq in 1271, then defected to the Ilkhan Abaqa and led the Qara'unas, dying on campaign in south-eastern Persia in 1276.
zh: 木八剌沙（？—1276年）是哈剌旭烈与兀鲁忽乃之子，也是第一位皈依伊斯兰教的察合台汗。1252年父亲去世后他幼年继位，由母亲摄政，1260年阿里不哥改立阿鲁忽而被取代。阿鲁忽死后，兀鲁忽乃于1266年春未经大汗忽必烈同意将他重新扶上汗位；忽必烈转而支持八剌，八剌收买军队，在当年9月逼迫他退位。1271年他先助海都攻打八剌，随后转投伊儿汗阿八哈，统领合剌乌纳思人，1276年在攻略波斯东南部时病死于军中。

en: Muhammad ibn Pulad was a Khan of the Chagatai Khanate who reigned in 1342–1343. A Chinggisid prince of the Chagatai line, he was a grandson of the former khan Könchek through his son Pulad. The genealogical chronicle Shajrat ul Atrak credits him with trying to halt the political dissolution of the ulus during his brief reign. Apparently a Muslim, judging by his name, he was succeeded on the throne by Qazan ibn Yasaur.
zh: 麻哈没的（穆罕默德·伊本·不剌）是1342—1343年在位的察合台汗。他是察合台系的成吉思汗后裔，为前汗宽阇之孙、不剌之子。谱系编年史《突厥世系》记载，他在短暂的统治期间力图遏止兀鲁思的政治瓦解。从名字判断他应是穆斯林，继他之后登上汗位的是牙撒吾儿之子合赞。

en: Negübei was a grandson of Chagatai Khan and a son of Sarban, installed as khan of the Chagatai Khanate by Kaidu in 1271 after the death of Baraq. Unwilling to rule as Kaidu's puppet, he rebelled within a year, possibly in concert with revolts raised by the sons of Alghu and Baraq. Kaidu sent an army against him and defeated his forces. Negübei fled eastward but was killed late in 1271 or in 1272, and Kaidu replaced him with Buqa Temür.
zh: 聂古伯是察合台汗之孙、撒班之子。1271年八剌死后，海都拥立他为察合台汗国可汗。他不愿充当海都的傀儡，即位不到一年便起兵反叛，可能与阿鲁忽和八剌诸子发动的叛乱相呼应。海都发兵讨伐，将其击败。聂古伯东逃后于1271年底或1272年被杀，海都随后改立不合帖木儿为汗。

en: Ögedei Khan (c. 1186–11 December 1241), third son of Genghis Khan, was the second khan of the Mongol Empire. He took sole command at Gurganj in 1221 after his brothers quarrelled, becoming heir. Elected in 1229 after Tolui's two-year regency, he sent Chormaqan against Jalal al-Din in Persia from 1230, invaded Korea in 1231 and destroyed the Jin dynasty in 1234. Batu and Subutai won at Legnica and Mohi in 1241. With Yelü Chucai he reformed taxation and founded Karakorum. He died after a drinking bout on 11 December 1241; his widow Töregene then ruled as regent until Güyük was elected in 1246.
zh: 窝阔台汗（约1186—1241年12月11日）是成吉思汗第三子、大蒙古国第二位大汗。1221年花剌子模战争中，因术赤与察合台争执，他受命独掌全军，攻克玉龙杰赤，由此被立为继承人。经幼弟拖雷两年监国，他于1229年即位。1230年他派绰儿马罕西征波斯的札兰丁，1231年出兵高丽，1234年攻灭金朝。1241年，拔都与速不台在列格尼卡和穆希连战连捷。他任用耶律楚材整顿赋税，并营建都城哈剌和林。他酗酒无度，1241年12月11日一夜狂饮后死去，遗孀脱列哥那随后摄政，直到贵由于1246年当选大汗。

en: Örüg Temür was a Chagatai prince, a son of Buqa Temür, who ruled the Chagatai Khanate as khan from 1272 to 1282. The genealogy compiled by Rashid al-Din lists him with a brother named Öljei among the descendants of Büri.
zh: 兀鲁克·帖木儿是察合台系宗王，1272—1282年在位的察合台汗不合帖木儿之子。拉施特丁编纂的系谱把他和兄弟完泽列入不里的后裔之中。

en: Pulad was a Chagatai prince, or oglan, and a son of Khan Könchek. He is known from the genealogical chronicle Shajrat ul Atrak only as the father of Muhammad ibn Pulad, who occupied the Chagatai throne in 1342–1343.
zh: 不剌是察合台系宗王（斡兀兰），宽阇汗之子。他仅见于谱系编年史《突厥世系》的记载，身份是麻哈没的之父，后者于1342—1343年登上察合台汗位。

en: Qadaqchi, also called Qadaqai Setsen, was a Chagataid prince whom the genealogies generally identify as the eldest son of Büri and great-grandson of Chagatai Khan, though some manuscripts of Rashid al-Din make him Chagatai's own son. He served the Great Khan Möngke, who once ordered him to shave his head in the manner of a cleric, and he accompanied Möngke's campaign against the Southern Song, dying on the march. His sons Buqa Temür and Taliqu both later occupied the Chagatai throne, reigning in 1272–1282 and 1308–1309.
zh: 合答乞（又称合答乞·薛禅）是察合台系宗王，诸谱系一般认为他是不里的长子、察合台的曾孙，但《史集》部分写本把他记成察合台之子。他效力于大汗蒙哥，曾奉蒙哥之命像僧侣一样剃发，后随蒙哥亲征南宋，在途中去世。他的儿子不合帖木儿和塔里忽后来都登上了察合台汗位，分别于1272—1282年和1308—1309年在位。

en: Qara Hülegü (died 1252) was the youngest son of Mutukan and the heir chosen by Chagatai to rule the Chagatai ulus in 1242. While he was still young his mother Ebuskun governed as regent. In 1246 the Great Khan Güyük, favouring his friend Yesü Möngke, deposed Qara Hülegü and gave the throne to his uncle. He then backed Möngke Khan against the Ögedeids, and after Möngke's election in 1251 was restored and sent home with an army. He died on the road in 1252, leaving his widow Orghana to rule as regent for their son Mubarak Shah.
zh: 哈剌旭烈（？—1252年）是抹土干的幼子，1242年由察合台本人生前指定为察合台汗国继承人。因他年纪尚轻，由母亲埃布斯昆临朝摄政。1246年，大汗贵由偏宠亲信也速蒙哥，废黜哈剌旭烈，把汗位交给了这位叔父。此后他在汗位之争中支持拖雷系的蒙哥对抗窝阔台系；1251年蒙哥即位后恢复他的汗位，派他率军回国。1252年他在途中去世，遗孀兀鲁忽乃为儿子木八剌沙摄政。

en: Qazan (died 1346), son of the Chagatayid prince Yasa'ur, was khan of the Chagatai ulus from about 1343, with his seat at Qarshi. He moved to curb the Turkic nobility of Transoxiana, whose leaders rallied behind the Qara'unas amir Qazaghan. In a battle of 1345 north of the Iron Gates, Qazan routed Qazaghan and put out one of his eyes, but then withdrew to winter at Qarshi instead of pursuing. Qazaghan rebuilt his forces, counterattacked in 1346 and killed Qazan. With his death the Chagatai khans lost real power in Transoxiana and the ulus split in two.
zh: 合赞（？—1346），又称合赞算端，是察合台宗王牙撒吾儿之子，约1343年成为察合台兀鲁思的汗，都城在卡尔施。他着手压制河中地区的突厥贵族，贵族们便聚集在合剌乌纳思部异密加兹罕周围。1345年在铁门以北的会战中，合赞击溃加兹罕并射瞎他一只眼睛，却没有乘胜追击，而是返回卡尔施过冬。加兹罕重整军力，于1346年反攻并杀死合赞。他死后，察合台汗在河中地区丧失实权，兀鲁思分裂为东西两部。

en: Sarban was a son of Chagatai Khan and a grandson of Genghis Khan, born to a mother whose name and rank are unrecorded. Most manuscripts of Rashid al-Din's Jami' al-tawarikh place him fourth among Chagatai's sons, ahead of Yesü Möngke and Baidar, while other chapters place Yesü Möngke third; the distinction between sons of principal wives and concubines suggests Sarban's mother may have been a concubine of low standing. His son Negübei briefly headed the Chagatai ulus in 1271–1272 and was killed after rebelling against Kaidu; another son, Qushqi, served on Möngke Khan's campaign against the Southern Song.
zh: 撒儿班（《新元史》作撒巴）是察合台之子、成吉思汗之孙，生母的名位均不见于记载。拉施德丁《史集》多数写本把他列为察合台第四子，排在也速蒙哥、拜答儿之前，另一些章节却将也速蒙哥列为第三子；结合嫡庶排序的区别，由此推测撒儿班的母亲可能是身份较低的侧室。儿子聂古伯于1271—1272年短暂统领察合台汗国，因反抗海都兵败战死；另一子忽失乞曾随蒙哥征伐南宋。

en: Shah Temur was a son of the Chagatai khan Yesun Temur and a descendant of Genghis Khan through Chagatai. In 1358 the powerful amir 'Abdullah, son of Qazaghan, murdered the reigning puppet khan Bayan Quli in Transoxiana and raised Shah Temur to the throne of the western Chagatai Khanate. 'Abdullah's rule was weak, and tribal chiefs Hajji Beg of the Barlas and Buyan Suldus rose against him, drove him out, and killed Shah Temur later that same year, leaving the western khanate without a khan.
zh: 铁穆尔沙是察合台汗也孙帖木儿之子，为成吉思汗次子察合台的后裔。1358年，权臣异密阿布达拉赫（异密加兹罕之子）在河中地区杀死在位的傀儡汗拜延忽里，拥立铁穆尔沙为西察合台汗国新汗。阿布达拉赫的统治并不稳固，巴鲁剌思部首领哈吉与速勒都思部的巴颜起兵反抗，将他赶跑，并于同年杀死铁穆尔沙，西察合台汗国一时没有了汗。

en: Surgu was a Chagatai prince, or oglan, and a son of Duwa Khan. He is known from genealogical records only as the father of Bayan Qulï, who was raised to the Chagatai throne by the Qara'unas amir Qazaghan in 1348.
zh: 速儿忽答是察合台系宗王（斡兀兰），笃哇汗之子。他仅见于世系记载，身份是拜延忽里之父——后者于1348年被合剌乌纳思部异密加兹罕拥立为察合台汗。

en: Taliqu (also called Naliqo'a) was a grandson of Büri and a son of Qadaqchi and a Qutlugh-Khanid princess of Kerman. After Könchek died in 1308, he seized the Chagatai throne. A Muslim, he pressed Islam on his Mongol subjects, and his rule was resented both for this and because he was not a descendant of Duwa. The sons of Duwa revolted and chose Kebek as khan. Taliqu was killed in 1309, one account saying that Kebek assassinated him at a banquet.
zh: 塔里忽是不里之孙、合答海之子，母亲是起儿漫忽都鲁汗王朝的公主。1308年宽阇死后，他夺取了察合台汗位。他信奉伊斯兰教，极力向蒙古部众推行，加之他并非笃哇的后裔，统治遭到笃哇一系的仇视。笃哇诸子起兵反叛，拥立怯别为汗。塔里忽于1309年被杀，一说他是在宴会上被怯别暗杀。

en: Ala-ad-din Tarmashirin (died 1334), a son of Duwa, ruled the Chagatai Khanate from 1331. Before his enthronement he led a plundering raid into the Delhi Sultanate in 1327, sacked Lahore in 1329, and later campaigned without success against the Ilkhanate. One of the first Chagatai khans to embrace Islam, he took the name Ala-ad-din, but his faith and preference for the cities of Transoxiana angered his Tengriist and Buddhist nobles, who charged him with abandoning the Yassa. Deposed at a kurultai, he was overtaken and killed near Samarkand by the eastern princes under Buzan, son of Duwa Temür.
zh: 答儿麻失里（？—1334）是察合台汗笃哇之子，1331年起统治察合台汗国。继位前，他于1327年对印度德里苏丹国发动大规模掠夺性远征，1329年洗劫拉合尔，后来又进攻伊儿汗国但未能取胜。他是最早皈依伊斯兰教的察合台汗之一，改名阿拉丁，但他的信仰和偏爱河中地区城市的做法引起信奉腾格里与佛教的蒙古宗王不满，被指背弃《大扎撒》。他在忽里勒台大会上被废，1334年在撒马尔罕附近被笃来帖木儿之子不赞率领的东部宗王追及杀害。

en: Taraghai (c. 1290–1360) was a minor emir of the Turkified Mongol Barlas confederation in Transoxiana, serving the khans of the Chagatai Khanate around Kish. Unlike his militarised kinsmen he lived as a pious Muslim drawn to Sufism and the Naqshbandi order. By his wife Tekina Khatun, whom Timurid tradition made a descendant of Genghis Khan, he fathered several children, including Timur, born near Kish in 1336. He died on 12 March 1360, and the Zafarnama records Timur returning home to settle his estate.
zh: 塔剌海（约1290—1360）是河中地区突厥化蒙古巴鲁剌思部落的小埃米尔，在渴石一带臣事察合台汗国的汗。与尚武的同族不同，他是虔诚的穆斯林，倾心苏非主义和纳克什班迪教团。他的妻子特金娜·可敦据帖木儿朝传统说是成吉思汗的后裔；子女众多，1336年在渴石附近生下帖木儿。塔剌海于1360年3月12日去世，《帖木儿武功记》记载帖木儿当时返回家乡料理父亲的遗产。

en: Timur (8 April 1336 – 18 February 1405), known to Europeans as Tamerlane, was a conqueror and founder of the Timurid Empire, born near Kish in Transoxiana into the Turkified Mongol Barlas confederation, the son of the emir Taraghai. Wounds suffered around 1363 left him lame, giving him the name Timur the Lame. By 1370 he was master of the western Chagatai Khanate, and from Samarkand he conquered Persia, defeated Tokhtamysh of the Golden Horde in 1395, sacked Delhi in 1398, and crushed the Ottoman army at Ankara on 20 July 1402. He died in February 1405 marching on Ming China, and his empire soon split apart.
zh: 帖木儿（1336年4月8日—1405年2月18日），西方人称塔梅尔兰，是征服者和帖木儿帝国的建立者，出身于河中渴石附近的突厥化蒙古巴鲁剌思部落，是埃米尔塔剌海之子。约1363年他受箭伤，从此跛足，得名“跛子帖木儿”。到1370年他已成为西察合台汗国之主，以撒马尔罕为基地征服波斯，1395年击败金帐汗脱脱迷失，1398年洗劫德里，1402年7月20日在安卡拉击溃奥斯曼大军。1405年2月，他在出征明朝途中去世，帝国不久便陷入分裂。

en: Tughlugh Timur (1312/13–1363) was the first khan of the Eastern Chagatai khanate, or Moghulistan. In 1347–1348 the Dughlat amir Bulaji brought the young Chagatai prince to power at Almalik, after more than a decade without a khan. Persuaded by the khoja Jamal ad-Din, he embraced Islam and in 1353 made his faith public; Mirza Haydar recorded that one hundred and sixty thousand Moghuls converted with him. Seeking to reunite the ulus, he invaded Transoxiana in 1360 and again in 1361, and in 1362 left his son Ilyas Khoja as viceroy there. He died in 1363 and the reunification collapsed.
zh: 秃忽鲁帖木儿（1312/13—1363）是东察合台汗国（蒙兀儿斯坦）第一代可汗。汗位空悬十余年后，杜格拉特部异密播鲁只于1347—1348年在阿力麻里拥立这位年轻的察合台宗王即位。他受和卓札马鲁丁感召皈依伊斯兰教，1353年公开宣布入教；据米儿咱·海答儿记载，十六万蒙兀儿人随他一同入教。为重新统一兀鲁思，他于1360年和1361年两度进兵河中，1362年留其子也里牙思火者为河中总督。他于1363年去世，汗国的统一随即瓦解。

en: Yasa'ur (died 1320) was a Chagatai prince, the son of Chübei and father of the future khan Qazan. In 1314 he campaigned against the Ilkhanate with Kebek, defeating an Ilkhan army on the Murgab before Esen Buqa recalled the Chagatai forces. Accused by Kebek of colluding with the enemy, he defected to Ilkhan Öljeitü, who settled him in the Badghis pastures. After Öljeitü's death he rebelled against Abu Sa'id in 1319, raiding Mazandaran while Öz Beg invaded simultaneously. Driven back from Herat, he was killed in 1320 by Kebek, now khan, who still saw him as a threat.
zh: 牙撒吾儿（？—1320）是察合台宗王，出伯之子，后来的可汗合赞之父。1314年，他与怯别一同出征伊儿汗国，在穆尔加布河畔击败伊儿汗军队，随后也先不花将察合台军队召回。他被怯别指控通敌，遂投奔伊儿汗完者都，获准在巴德吉斯草原游牧。完者都死后，他于1319年起兵反叛不赛因，趁月即别入侵之机攻掠马赞达兰；在赫拉特受阻后撤走。1320年，已成为察合台汗的怯别视他为心腹之患，将他杀死。

en: Yesü Möngke (died 1252) was the fifth son of Chagatai Khan and the third ruler of the Chagatai ulus. Around 1246 his friend the Great Khan Güyük deposed Chagatai's chosen heir Qara Hülëgü and made him khan instead. He gave himself up to drinking and pleasure, leaving affairs to his wife and vizier Baha al-Din Marghinani. After Güyük's death he backed the Ögedeid princes against Möngke and boycotted the quriltai that elected him in 1251. Möngke then restored Qara Hülëgü, who died on the journey; his widow Orghana seized power and had Yesü Möngke executed in 1252.
zh: 也速蒙哥（？—1252年）是察合台第五子，察合台汗国第三任汗。约1246年，与他亲善的大汗贵由废黜了察合台遗命继位的哈剌旭烈，改立他为汗。他沉湎酒色、贪图享乐，把国事托付给妃子和异密巴哈丁·马尔吉纳尼处理。贵由死后，他附和窝阔台系宗王反对拖雷系的蒙哥即位，也没有出席拥戴蒙哥的忽里台大会。1251年蒙哥继位后支持哈剌旭烈回国夺回汗位，哈剌旭烈中途病死，其妻兀鲁忽乃抵达虎牙思后将也速蒙哥处死。

en: Yesun Temur (r. 1338–1339) was khan of the Chagatai Khanate, a son of Prince Ebugen and younger brother of Changshi Khan. His grandfather was Duwa, a Chagatai khan, and his own Mongolian name meant “Nine Iron”. He came to power after Changshi's death, whose circumstances remain unclear. Chinese annals say he murdered his brother, was rebuked by his mother and drank heavily thereafter. His short reign was marked by strife between traditional Mongol factions and the spread of Islam. In 1339 he was overthrown by Ali-Sultan, a prince of the House of Ogedei.
zh: 也孙帖木儿（1338—1339年在位）是察合台汗国可汗，宗室也不干之子、敞失汗之弟。他的祖父是察合台汗笃哇，他自己的蒙古名字意为“九铁”。他在敞失死后继位，敞失的死因并不明确。中文史籍记载他谋杀兄长，受到母亲责备，此后常常酗酒。他在位短暂，汗国内传统蒙古势力与日益扩张的伊斯兰教势力冲突不断。1339年，他被窝阔台系宗王阿里算端推翻。

en: Chen Zuyi (died 1407) was a Chinese pirate chief from Chaozhou in Guangdong. During the Hongwu reign his family fled the Ming sea ban and settled in Palembang in Sumatra, the old Srivijaya, where he became a local strongman who plundered every passing ship and dominated the Strait of Malacca. He commanded ten ships and five thousand men at Palembang. Shi Jinqing, a Hui Chinese, reported the pirates' abuses and asked for help against him. On Zheng He's first treasure voyage, Chen feigned surrender while plotting to seize the Ming fleet. In 1407 Zheng He destroyed his pirate band, captured him at Palembang, and took him back to China, where he was beheaded.
zh: 陈祖义（？—1407），广东潮州人，明初海盗首领。洪武年间，他全家为避海禁逃到苏门答腊的旧港，即三佛齐故地，在那里成为地方豪强，凡有船只经过即行劫掠，称雄马六甲海峡。他在旧港拥有十艘船和五千部众；回人施进卿告发海盗的暴行，请求援助以铲除他。郑和第一次下西洋时，陈祖义诈降，暗中却图谋袭击宝船船队。1407年郑和剿灭其党羽，在旧港将他生擒，押回国内问斩。

en: Han Yong (1422–1478) was a Ming dynasty official born in Changzhou County, Suzhou, with his family registered in Wanping near Beijing. He became a jinshi in 1442 and served as a censor. As provincial inspector of Jiangxi from 1452 he rebuilt the famous Tengwang Pavilion at Nanchang. After he impeached the Prince of Ning, the prince retaliated and Han was imprisoned and dismissed in 1457. Restored to office, he became governor of Xuanfu and Datong in 1460. In 1465, as military inspector, he took part in Zhao Fu's campaign against the Miao and Yao rising at Datengxia in Guangxi; the leader Hou Dagou was captured and killed, and Han was appointed Viceroy of Liangguang, stationed at Wuzhou. Attacks by subordinates and colleagues forced him into retirement in 1473, and he died in 1478.
zh: 韩雍（1422—1478）是明代大臣，生于南直隶苏州府长洲县，户籍在顺天府宛平县。他于1442年考中进士，任监察御史。1452年起以右佥都御史巡抚江西，在南昌重建名楼滕王阁。他弹劾宁王后遭到报复，于1457年被下狱夺官，复职后于1460年巡抚宣府、大同。1465年，他以赞理军务的身份随赵辅出征广西大藤峡，镇压瑶、苗等族起事，擒杀起事首领侯大苟，随后出任两广总督，驻扎梧州。1473年，他因下属和同僚攻讦被迫辞官，1478年去世。

en: Li Zicheng (1606–1645) was the peasant rebel leader who overthrew the Ming dynasty and founded the short-lived Shun. Born to a poor family in Shaanxi, he served in the army before entering the postal service in 1626. A post-station attendant from Mizhi, he lost his post in Ming courier cuts and joined the revolts in 1629. After his uncle Gao Yingxiang was executed, Li inherited the title Dashing King and built an army in Henan promising equal land and no taxes. He proclaimed the Shun at Xi'an in early 1644 and entered Beijing that April, driving the Chongzhen Emperor to suicide. Defeated at Shanhai Pass by Qing forces, he retreated and died in Hubei in 1645.
zh: 李自成（1606—1645）是推翻明朝、建立短命政权大顺的明末农民军领袖。他出身陕西贫苦人家，曾从军，1626年进入驿站。他是陕北米脂人，本为驿卒，明朝裁撤驿站后失业，于1629年投身起义。舅父“闯王”高迎祥被杀后，他袭称闯王，在河南以“均田免赋”号召饥民、壮大兵力。1644年初他在西安称帝，国号大顺，同年4月攻入北京，崇祯帝自缢，明朝灭亡。不久他在山海关被清军击败，一路撤退，1645年死于湖北。

en: Peng Yingyu (died 1353), called the Monk Peng, was a Yuan rebel preacher from Yuanzhou, Jiangxi, founder of the southern Red Turbans. A monk at Cihua Temple, he took up Maitreya worship and wandered healing the poor as he preached. In 1338 he and his disciple Zhou Ziwang raised more than five thousand followers, writing Buddha on their backs in the belief that it would protect them from weapons. He made Zhou a king, but the rising failed and Zhou was killed. Peng fled to Huaixi, where he continued preaching and gathered Maitreya devotees for worship. In August 1351 he joined Zou Pusheng and cloth peddler Xu Shouhui in the Qizhou rising, enthroning Xu as Tianwan emperor. He died fighting the Yuan when Qishui fell in 1353.
zh: 彭莹玉（?—1353），人称彭和尚，江西袁州人，是元末民变领袖、南派红巾军的开山始祖。他本在慈化寺出家，后改信弥勒教，四方行走，免费为人治病传教。1338年，他与弟子周子旺在袁州聚众五千余人起事，命士兵背心皆书“佛”字，以为可避刀兵。他扶周子旺称王，起义失败、周子旺被杀后，彭莹玉逃亡淮西，继续传教并召集弥勒信众礼拜。1351年八月，他联合邹普胜与布贩徐寿辉在蕲州起兵，扶徐寿辉称帝、建立天完政权；1353年蕲水失陷时，他在与元军作战中战死。

en: Yu Qian (1398–1457) was a Ming dynasty official born in Qiantang, Hangzhou. He became a jinshi in 1421, won the Xuande Emperor's favour helping suppress the rebellion of Zhu Gaoxu in 1426, and was appointed Grand Coordinator of Shanxi and Henan. He later offended the powerful eunuch Wang Zhen and was imprisoned, but was released and restored to office. After the Oirat Mongols captured Emperor Yingzong at the Tumu Crisis in 1449, he became Minister of War and organised the defense of Beijing, then remained the leading figure of the Jingtai Emperor's government for eight years. When Yingzong regained the throne in a coup in January 1457, Yu was accused of treason and executed, and later rehabilitated.
zh: 于谦（1398—1457）是明代大臣，杭州钱塘人。他于1421年考中进士，1426年参与平定朱高煦叛乱，受到明宣宗赏识，出任山西、河南巡抚。后来他因得罪权势显赫的宦官王振而被囚，获释后复职。1449年土木堡之变中英宗被瓦剌蒙古俘获，他升任兵部尚书，主持北京保卫战，此后八年一直是明代宗朝廷的核心人物。1457年1月明英宗发动政变复辟，他被以谋反罪处死，后来获得平反。

en: Zheng He (1371–1433), born Ma He into a Muslim family in Kunyang, Yunnan, was a eunuch admiral and diplomat of the early Ming. Captured and castrated during the 1381 Ming conquest of Yunnan, he was assigned to Zhu Di, Prince of Yan, fought for him in the Jingnan Campaign of 1399–1402, and was granted the surname Zheng by the Yongle Emperor in 1404. Between 1405 and 1433 he commanded seven treasure voyages through the South China Sea and Indian Ocean, reaching Southeast Asia, India, Arabia and the East African coast and projecting Ming power across the seas. His fleet encouraged state-controlled trade networks reaching the Swahili coast, and Zheng also served as commander of the southern capital, Nanjing.
zh: 郑和（1371—1433），原姓马，小名三保，云南昆阳人，明代初年的宦官、航海家与外交家。1381年明军平定云南时他被俘受宫刑，送入燕王朱棣府中；靖难之役（1399—1402）中他为朱棣征战，1404年被即位的明成祖赐姓郑。1405至1433年间，他奉命七次率领宝船船队下西洋，遍历东南亚、印度、阿拉伯直至东非沿岸，使明朝的声威远播印度洋。他的船队促进了远达斯瓦希里海岸的官营贸易网络，郑和还曾出任南京守备。

en: Chosbal was a Yuan imperial prince, a great-grandson of Kublai and son of Temür Buqa, whom he succeeded in 1297 as Prince Zhenxi Wujing, holding Tibet as his hereditary appanage. He led a large army into Ü-Tsang and defeated west Mongol troops below Gyantse during the Drikung disturbances, and in 1306 moved against revolts across Tibet. He received the submission of Maozhou in 1309 and campaigned against the Chagatai prince Kebek in 1319. In 1330 he helped crush Tughan's rebellion in Yunnan and died soon afterwards. His daughter married the king of Goryeo.
zh: 搠思班是元朝宗王，忽必烈曾孙、铁木儿不花之子，1297年袭父爵为镇西武靖王，以吐蕃为世袭领地。他曾率大军进入乌思藏，在江孜山下击败卷入止贡之变的西蒙古军，并于1306年讨伐吐蕃各地叛乱。1309年他招降茂州，1319年征讨察合台后王怯别。1330年他协助平定云南秃坚之乱，不久后去世。其女亦怜真班封德宁公主，嫁给高丽忠惠王为妃。

en: Blanche of Navarre (c. 1177–1229), daughter of King Sancho VI and Sancha of Castile, married Count Theobald III of Champagne on 1 July 1199. Widowed on 24 May 1201 while pregnant, she bore Theobald IV days later and ruled Champagne as regent until 1222. She at once paid homage to Philip II at Sens, the first countess to render homage, securing her son's rights. In 1212 she convened her barons and established procedures allowing daughters to inherit castles when their fathers left no son. In 1215 Philippa of Champagne and Erard of Brienne-Ramerupt made war on her claim; backed by Pope Innocent III, Blanche forced Erard to renounce it in 1221 and Philippa in 1222. She died in 1229.
zh: 纳瓦拉的布兰卡（约1177—1229）是纳瓦拉国王桑乔六世与卡斯蒂利亚的桑查之女，1199年7月1日嫁给香槟伯爵蒂博三世。1201年5月24日丈夫去世时她正怀有身孕，数日后生下蒂博四世，并以摄政身份统治香槟至1222年。为保住儿子的继承权，她随即在桑斯向腓力二世行臣服礼，是第一位行臣服礼的女伯爵。1212年她召集男爵，确立父亲死后无子时女儿继承城堡的程序。1215年，香槟的菲莉帕与布里耶纳-拉默吕的埃拉尔对她的继承权开战；在教皇英诺森三世支持下，布兰卡迫使埃拉尔于1221年、菲莉帕于1222年放弃主张。她于1229年去世。

en: Érard II of Brienne (c. 1130–1191), son of Count Gautier II and Humbeline de Baudement, ruled the county of Brienne from 1161. He accompanied his father on the Second Crusade, staying in the Holy Land until 1151. His brothers often appeared with him in his charters, and in 1178 he witnessed Count Henry I of Bar pay homage to Emperor Frederick at Besançon. In 1188 he and his brother André took the cross with Henry II of Champagne and reached the Siege of Acre by September 1189, ahead of the Third Crusade. André fell that October, and Érard died at the siege on 8 February 1191, probably of famine or disease. His son Walter III succeeded him; another son, John, later governed Brienne during his nephew's minority and became king of Jerusalem.
zh: 埃拉尔二世（约1130—1191）是戈蒂埃二世伯爵与安贝尔莉娜·德·博德蒙之子，1161年起统治布里耶纳伯国。他曾随父亲参加第二次十字军东征，在圣地停留至1151年。他的兄弟常与他一同出现在其宪章中；1178年，他在贝桑松见证巴尔伯爵亨利一世向皇帝腓特烈行臣服礼。1188年，他与弟弟安德烈随香槟伯爵亨利二世领取十字，1189年9月便抵达阿卡围城战场，早于第三次十字军的主力。安德烈于同年10月战死，埃拉尔本人则于1191年2月8日在围城中死去，可能死于饥荒或疾病。其子戈蒂埃三世继承伯国；另一子约翰后来在侄子年幼时掌管布里耶纳，并成为耶路撒冷国王。

en: Stephen II of Troyes was the younger son of Odo II, Count of Blois, and Ermengarde of Auvergne. After his father died in 1037, he ruled as Count of Troyes and Meaux until his own death in 1047, founding the Troyes line of the House of Blois while his brother Theobald III held Blois. By his wife Adèle he left a son, Odo III, who succeeded him in Troyes and Meaux.
zh: 艾蒂安二世·德·特鲁瓦是布卢瓦伯爵奥多二世与奥弗涅的埃尔芒加德的幼子。1037年父亲去世后，他受封特鲁瓦与莫城伯爵，开创布卢瓦家族的特鲁瓦支系，其兄蒂博三世则领有布卢瓦；他本人于1047年去世。他与妻子阿代尔育有一子厄德三世，后来继承了特鲁瓦与莫城。

en: Odo II (c. 985–1037), son of Count Odo I of Blois and Bertha of Burgundy, ruled Blois and Chartres from 1004. After his first wife Maud died childless, he fought her brother Richard II of Normandy over her dowry at Dreux. Defeated by Fulk Nerra of Anjou at Pontlevoy in 1016, he seized Troyes, Meaux and Champagne without royal approval when his cousin Stephen I died heirless around 1020, uniting Blois and Champagne under one lord. He was later offered the Lombard crown and invaded Burgundy in 1032, but withdrew before an imperial and French royal coalition. In 1037 he attacked Lorraine and fell on 15 November at the Battle of Bar-le-Duc against Duke Gothelo. His sons by Ermengarde of Auvergne were Theobald and Stephen.
zh: 厄德二世（约985—1037）是布卢瓦伯爵厄德一世与勃艮第的贝尔特之子，1004年起统治布卢瓦和沙特尔。首任妻子玛蒂尔达死后无嗣，他与她的兄弟诺曼底的理查二世争夺她在德勒的嫁妆。1016年他在蓬特勒瓦被安茹的富尔克·内拉击败；约1020年其表亲斯蒂芬一世死后无嗣，他未经王室批准便夺取特鲁瓦、莫城和香槟，首次将布卢瓦与香槟置于一人治下。后来伦巴第贵族向他献上伦巴第王冠，1032年他入侵勃艮第，却在皇帝与法王的联军面前撤退。1037年他进攻洛林，11月15日在巴勒迪克战役中与洛林公爵戈特隆作战时阵亡。他与奥弗涅的埃芒加德生有蒂博和斯蒂芬二子。

en: Odo, called Eudes III of Troyes (c. 1062–c. 1093), was a son of Count Theobald III of Blois and Adele of Valois. On his father's death in 1089 the inheritance was divided: his half-brother Stephen-Henry took Blois and Chartres while Odo received the county of Troyes. During his brief rule he proved a generous patron, granting lands to the abbeys of Molesme and Montier-en-Der and to Saint-Quentin priory in Troyes, and in 1090 he witnessed a charter of King Philip I at Paris. He died around 1093, apparently unmarried, and Troyes passed to his younger brother Hugh.
zh: 厄德，即特鲁瓦的厄德三世（约1062—约1093），是布卢瓦伯爵蒂博三世与瓦卢瓦的阿黛尔之子。1089年父亲去世时分家，异母兄长艾蒂安-亨利分得布卢瓦和沙特尔，厄德得到特鲁瓦伯国。他在位虽短，却以慷慨著称，曾向莫莱姆修道院、蒙捷昂代尔修道院和特鲁瓦的圣康坦修道院捐赠地产，1090年还在巴黎见证了法王腓力一世的一份特许状。他约于1093年去世，似未娶妻，特鲁瓦遂由弟弟于格继承。

en: Gaucher IV de Châtillon (died c. 1261–1265) was the third son of Hugh I of Châtillon, count of Saint-Pol, and Mary of Avesnes, countess of Blois. In the inheritance settlement laid down by his father in 1246, he received the family seat of Châtillon-sur-Marne with the lordships of Crécy, Crèvecœur and Troissy. By 1258 he had married Isabella of Lezinnes, of the Villehardouin family. He is last recorded in December 1260, when he and his wife made a donation to the nuns of Pont-aux-Dames; his son Gaucher V became constable of France and count of Porcien.
zh: 戈谢四世·德·沙蒂永（约1261至1265年间去世）是圣波勒伯爵于格一世·德·沙蒂永与布卢瓦女伯爵阿韦讷的玛丽的第三子。在1246年父亲定下的遗产安排中，他分得家族祖宅马恩河畔沙蒂永以及克雷西、克雷沃克尔、特鲁瓦西等领地。最迟在1258年，他娶了维尔阿杜安家族的莱济讷的伊莎贝拉。史料最后一次提到他是1260年12月，他与妻子向蓬欧达姆修女院捐赠；其子戈谢五世后来成为法兰西王室统帅和波尔西安伯爵。

en: Guy II de Dampierre (c. 1155–1216), son of Guillaume I de Dampierre and Ermengarde de Toucy, inherited the family lands around 1174 and held the office of constable of Champagne, as his father had before him. By marrying Mathilde I of Bourbon he became lord of Bourbon, one of France's most powerful barons. He joined the Third Crusade at the Siege of Acre and fought at Arsuf. In 1194 he helped cover Philip Augustus's retreat at Fréteval; he later fought for the king in the conquest of Normandy and at Bouvines in 1214. He backed Countess Blanche of Navarre through the Champagne succession war. He died on 18 January 1216, leaving Bourbon to his son Archambaud and Dampierre to Guillaume.
zh: 居伊二世·德·当皮埃尔（约1155—1216）是纪尧姆一世·德·当皮埃尔与埃芒加德·德·图西之子，约1174年继承家族领地，并如其父一般担任香槟统帅。他娶波旁的玛蒂尔德一世为妻，成为波旁领主，跻身法兰西最有权势的男爵之列。他参加第三次十字军东征，在阿卡围城和阿尔苏夫战役中作战。1194年，他在弗雷特瓦勒掩护腓力·奥古斯特撤退；他后来为国王攻取诺曼底，并于1214年征战布汶。在香槟继承战争中，他始终支持纳瓦拉的布兰卡伯爵夫人。1216年1月18日他去世，波旁由儿子阿尚博继承，当皮埃尔则由纪尧姆继承。

en: Henry I (1127–1181), called the Liberal, ruled Champagne from 1152 as the eldest son of Count Theobald II and Matilda of Carinthia. He joined Louis VII on the Second Crusade and attended the assembly at Acre in 1148. On his father's death he kept Champagne, leaving Blois and Chartres to his brothers; he established order among his nobles and could count on some 2000 vassals. Under his protection the Champagne Fairs became a centre of European trade, and his court at Troyes became known for literature. In 1164 he married Marie of France, who bore Henry II and Theobald III. Captured in Anatolia returning from Jerusalem in 1179 and ransomed by the Byzantine emperor, he died in 1181.
zh: 亨利一世（1127—1181），绰号宽宏者，是蒂博二世伯爵与克恩顿的玛蒂尔达之长子，1152年起统治香槟。他随法兰西国王路易七世参加第二次十字军东征，1148年出席阿卡会议。父亲去世后，他选择继承香槟，将布卢瓦、沙特尔留给弟弟们；他整顿贵族秩序，能倚靠约2000名封臣。在他的保护下，香槟集市成为欧洲贸易的中心，他在特鲁瓦的宫廷也以文学闻名。1164年他娶法兰西的玛丽为妻，生下亨利二世与蒂博三世。1179年他从耶路撒冷返程途中在小亚细亚被俘，由拜占庭皇帝出资赎身，1181年去世。

en: Hugh I (c. 1074–after 1130), a younger son of Count Theobald III of Blois and Adele of Valois, inherited Troyes from his brother Odo in 1093 and added Bar-sur-Aube and Vitry, becoming the first count of Champagne. He journeyed several times to the Holy Land, where his vassal Hugh de Payns founded the Knights Templar in his following. In 1115 he gave a wild valley to Bernard of Cîteaux to found Clairvaux Abbey. In 1125, leaving his pregnant wife and refusing to acknowledge her child, he abdicated to his nephew Theobald and joined the Templars, dying in the East after 1130.
zh: 于格一世（约1074—1130年后）是布卢瓦伯爵蒂博三世与瓦卢瓦的阿黛尔较年幼的儿子之一，1093年从兄长厄德手中继承特鲁瓦，又先后取得奥布河畔巴尔和维特里，将这些领地合并为香槟伯国，时人开始称他为第一位香槟伯爵。他多次前往圣地，他的封臣于格·德·帕英正是随他东行期间创立了圣殿骑士团。1115年，他把一处荒僻河谷赠予西多会的伯尔纳，用以创建明谷修道院。1125年，他离开怀孕的妻子，拒绝承认她的孩子，将爵位传给侄子蒂博，自己加入圣殿骑士团东行，1130年后卒于东方。

en: Jean II de Châteauvillain (born after 1285, died 1312) was lord of Châteauvillain, Arc-en-Barrois and Pleurs in Champagne. Eldest son of Simon II de Châteauvillain and Marie de Dampierre, he succeeded his father in 1306, his grandfather Jean I, called the Blind, being still alive. That year he married Marie de Roucy, who bore him Jean and Guillaume. In 1308 he enfranchised the inhabitants of Giey by charter. He died in 1312 leaving two young children and appointed Simon de Choiseul their guardian. At the request of relatives, Philip the Fair instead named their maternal uncle Jean V de Pierrepont, Count of Roucy, and their paternal cousin Guillaume de Châteauvillain as guardians in March 1313.
zh: 让二世·德·沙托维兰（1285年后生，1312年卒）是香槟的领主，领有沙托维兰、阿尔克昂巴尔鲁瓦和普勒尔。他是西蒙二世·德·沙托维兰与玛丽·德·当皮埃尔的长子，1306年父亲去世后继任，当时祖父让一世（盲人）仍然在世。同年他娶玛丽·德·鲁西为妻，生下让和纪尧姆。1308年，他发布特许状解放日埃居民。他于1312年去世，留下两个年幼的孩子，并指定西蒙·德·舒瓦瑟为监护人。应亲属请求，美男子腓力于1313年3月改指定孩子的舅父鲁西伯爵让五世·德·皮埃尔蓬与父系堂亲纪尧姆·德·沙托维兰为监护人。

en: Jean II de Trie (c. 1225–1302), son of Mathieu I de Trie and Marsilie de Montmorency, succeeded his father in 1272 as Count of Dammartin and lord of Trie and Mouchy. He married first Ermengarde, then Yolande, daughter of John I, Count of Dreux; by Yolande his children were Renaud, his heir, and Mahaut, who married Henry de Vergy in 1298. He is also identified with the trouvère Jehan de Trie, to whom two surviving courtly chansons are attributed. One is undisputed, while the other has also been attributed to Theobald I of Navarre or Gace Brulé. Fighting for Philip the Fair against the Flemings, he was killed on 11 July 1302 at the Battle of the Golden Spurs.
zh: 让二世·德·特里（约1225—1302）是马蒂厄一世·德·特里与马西莉·德·蒙莫朗西之子，1272年继承父亲，成为达马尔坦伯爵及特里、穆希领主。他先娶埃芒加德，后娶德勒伯爵让一世之女约朗德，与约朗德育有继承人雷诺和女儿玛奥，玛奥于1298年嫁给亨利·德·韦尔吉。他也被认为就是特罗维尔诗人让·德·特里，有两首存世的宫廷香颂归于其名下。其中一首归属无争议，另一首也被认为是纳瓦拉的蒂博一世或加斯·布吕莱的作品。1302年7月11日，他在为美男子腓力与佛兰德人作战时，阵亡于金马刺战役。

en: Mathieu I de Trie (c. 1192–1272) was a French baron, son of Jean I de Trie, lord of Trie and Mouchy, and Aélis de Dammartin, daughter of Count Aubry III. He appears as castellan of Mouchy in 1224, lord of Trie by 1241, and lord of Plessis-Billebaut in 1251. His mother's family gave him a claim to Dammartin. When his cousin Matilda, Countess of Dammartin, died without children, the Parlement of Paris settled the disputed succession in his favour in 1262, making him Count of Dammartin. He married Marsilie de Montmorency and was succeeded at his death in 1272 by his son Jean II.
zh: 马蒂厄一世·德·特里（约1192—1272）是法兰西男爵，特里与穆希领主让一世·德·特里和达马尔坦伯爵奥布里三世之女阿埃莉斯·德·达马尔坦之子。1224年他已称穆希城堡主，1241年成为特里领主，1251年领有普莱西比约博。他通过母族获得了对达马尔坦的继承权。他的表亲达马尔坦女伯爵玛蒂尔德死后无嗣，巴黎高等法院于1262年裁定有争议的继承权归他，他由此成为达马尔坦伯爵。他娶马西莉·德·蒙莫朗西为妻，1272年去世后由儿子让二世继位。

en: Theobald III (c. 1019–1089), also called Theobald I of Champagne, succeeded his father Odo II in 1037 as count of Blois, Meaux and Troyes. In 1044 he was defeated and captured at Nouy by Geoffrey Martel of Anjou, who freed him only in exchange for the county of Touraine. Theobald used his nephew's involvement in the Norman invasion of England to strengthen his authority in Champagne, building up his power east of Paris and overawing the local barons. After his death at Épernay on 30 September 1089, following a fifty-two-year rule, King Philip I arranged the division of Blois and Champagne between his sons Stephen, Odo and Hugh. Odo's Champagne lands passed to Hugh on his death in 1093.
zh: 蒂博三世（约1019—1089），又称香槟的蒂博一世，1037年继承父亲厄德二世，成为布卢瓦、莫城和特鲁瓦伯爵。1044年，他在努伊被安茹伯爵若弗鲁瓦·马特尔击败俘虏，对方以交出图兰纳伯国为条件才将他释放。他利用外甥参与诺曼征服英格兰的机会增强对香槟的控制，在巴黎以东扩张势力，压服当地贵族。1089年9月30日他卒于埃佩尔奈，在位长达五十二年；法王腓力一世随后安排将布卢瓦和香槟分给他的儿子艾蒂安、厄德和于格。厄德于1093年去世，他在香槟的领地传给了于格。

en: Theobald the Great (1090–10 January 1152) was the son of Count Stephen-Henry of Blois and Adela of Normandy, and brother of King Stephen of England. He succeeded to Blois and Chartres in 1102 and often accompanied his mother through their domains. In 1123 he married Matilda of Carinthia; their children included Henry I of Champagne and Adela, wife of King Louis VII. When his uncle Hugh abdicated in 1125, Theobald added Champagne and Brie, reuniting the family lands. The scholar Peter Abelard sought asylum in Champagne during his rule. War over his sister Eleanor's marriage in 1142–1144 saw royal troops burn Vitry-en-Perthois, where hundreds died in the burning church. Theobald died on 10 January 1152.
zh: “伟大的”蒂博（1090—1152年1月10日）是布卢瓦伯爵艾蒂安-亨利与诺曼底的阿德拉之子，英格兰国王斯蒂芬的兄长。他1102年继承布卢瓦与沙特尔，常随母亲巡视领地。1123年他娶克恩顿的玛蒂尔达为妻，子女包括香槟伯爵亨利一世和法王路易七世的王后阿德拉。1125年叔父于格退位后，他又取得香槟与布里，重新统一了家族领地。学者彼得·阿伯拉尔在他统治期间到香槟寻求庇护。为妹妹埃莉奥诺拉的婚变，他在1142—1144年与路易七世交战两年，王军焚毁维特里昂佩尔图瓦，数百人烧死在教堂中。蒂博于1152年1月10日去世。

en: Theobald III (1179–1201), younger son of Count Henry I of Champagne and Marie of France, became count in 1197 after his brother Henry II died in the Holy Land. Henry had designated him heir before departing on the Third Crusade. He worked closely with his suzerain Philip II of France; in 1198 they issued charters regulating rights over Jews and debts owed by the king. In 1199 he married Blanche of Navarre at Chartres. At a tournament at Écry on 28 November 1199, Fulk of Neuilly preached the Fourth Crusade; the nobles present took the cross and elected Theobald their leader. He died on 24 May 1201 before the crusade sailed, succeeded by a posthumous son, Theobald IV, whose mother Blanche ruled Champagne as regent.
zh: 蒂博三世（1179—1201）是香槟伯爵亨利一世与法兰西的玛丽之幼子，1197年其兄亨利二世在圣地去世后继任香槟伯爵。亨利出发参加第三次十字军东征前已指定他为继承人。他与封君法兰西国王腓力二世密切合作；1198年，两人颁布宪章，规定各自对犹太人的权利及国王所欠债务。1199年他在沙特尔娶纳瓦拉的布兰卡为妻。1199年11月28日，在埃克里的一次比武大会上，纳伊的福尔克布道宣扬第四次十字军东征，在场贵族领取十字并推举蒂博为领袖。1201年5月24日，他在十字军出征前去世，由遗腹子蒂博四世继位，其母布兰卡摄政统治香槟。

en: Yolande of Dreux (c. 1243–1313), daughter of John I, Count of Dreux, and Marie of Bourbon-Dampierre, married first Amaury II of Craon and then John I, Count of Dammartin. Her son Renaud succeeded John after he fell at the Golden Spurs in 1302.
zh: 约朗德·德·德勒（约1243—1313）是德勒伯爵让一世与玛丽·德·波旁-当皮埃尔之女，先嫁阿马里克二世·德·克朗，后嫁当马尔坦伯爵让一世·德·特里；其子雷诺在父亲于1302年金马刺战役阵亡后继为伯爵。

en: Christopher Columbus (1451–1506) was a Genoese navigator who proposed sailing west across the Atlantic to reach the East Indies. He presented his plan to King John II of Portugal in 1485 and again in 1488, but was refused both times after Portuguese experts rejected his distance calculations. Turning to Castile, he won the backing of Queen Isabella and King Ferdinand, sailed from Palos in August 1492 with three ships, and on 12 October made landfall in the Bahamas, opening the way for widespread European exploration and colonization of the Americas. He made three more voyages, reaching the northern coast of South America and the eastern coast of Central America. Accused of brutality as governor, he was arrested and removed from Hispaniola in 1500. He died at Valladolid in 1506.
zh: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布（1451—1506）是热那亚航海家，主张向西横渡大西洋前往东印度群岛。他于1485年向葡萄牙国王若昂二世提出这一计划，1488年再次尝试，但葡萄牙专家认定他对航程的计算有误，两度遭拒。他转而求助卡斯蒂利亚，得到伊莎贝拉女王与斐迪南国王的资助，1492年8月率三艘船从帕洛斯启航，10月12日在巴哈马群岛登陆，为欧洲大规模探索和殖民美洲打开了道路。此后他又完成三次航行，抵达南美洲北岸与中美洲东岸。他担任总督时被指控施政残暴，1500年被捕并被带离伊斯帕尼奥拉岛。1506年卒于巴利亚多利德。

en: Christophe de Longueil (1488 or 1490–1522), Latin name Christophorus Longolius, was a humanist born at Mechelen in Brabant and raised in France. He studied law at Valence, became a lawyer in 1511 and held office in Paris from 1513. He also tutored the young King Francis I, and gave up law to study classical literature. Moving to Rome in 1517, he joined the Ciceronian circle of Pietro Bembo and Jacopo Sadoleto and obtained Roman citizenship in 1519, despite a campaign against him over an early speech praising the Franks above the Romans. Harassed, he withdrew to Venice and Padua, where he died on 11 September 1522.
zh: 克里斯托夫·德·隆格伊（1488或1490—1522），拉丁名作克里斯托弗鲁斯·隆戈利乌斯，是生于布拉班特梅赫伦、长于法国的人文主义者。他在瓦朗斯学习法律，1511年成为律师，自1513年起在巴黎任职。他还曾教导年轻的国王弗朗索瓦一世，后来放弃法律转而研究古典文学。1517年他移居罗马，加入彼得罗·本博和雅各布·萨多莱托的西塞罗派圈子，1519年获罗马公民权；此前他因一篇称颂法兰克人胜过罗马人的旧演说遭到攻讦。备受排挤的他退往威尼斯，再赴帕多瓦，1522年9月11日在当地去世。

en: Seii (1328–1349), fifth and last king of the Eiso dynasty of Chūzan, is known from the Ryukyuan royal chronicles, the Chūzan Seikan and Chūzan Seifu. He succeeded his father Tamagusuku in 1337 at about ten years of age, and his mother ran the government in his name. The Seifu condemns her rule in a line: the hen crows in place of the cock, worthy men withdraw and petty men push forward. Meanwhile Satto, the aji of Urasoe, was winning standing among the aji for his talent and virtue. When Seii died in 1349, the regional lords set aside his heir and enthroned Satto, ending Eiso rule.
zh: 西威（1328—1349）是琉球中山英祖王朝第五代、也是末代国王，事迹见于《中山世鉴》《中山世谱》等琉球史书。1337年他继承父亲玉城之位，年仅约十岁，朝政由母后执掌。《中山世谱》以一句话斥责这段朝政：牝鸡乱政，贤者退隐，小人争进。与此同时，浦添按司察度因才德著称，在各地按司中渐有威望。1349年西威去世，诸按司废黜他的世子，拥立察度为王，英祖王朝就此灭亡。

en: Tamagusuku (1296–1336) is recorded in the Ryukyu chronicles Chūzan Seikan and Chūzan Seifu as the fourth king of the Eiso dynasty from 1314. The third son of King Eiji, he succeeded at Urasoe after his two elder brothers died following their father in death. He could not command the loyalty of the territorial lords, the anji, and chiefs of the outlying islands ceased paying tribute. During his reign the lord of Ōzato withdrew south to found the kingdom of Nanzan and the lord of Nakijin proclaimed Hokuzan in the north, leaving Tamagusuku ruler of Chūzan and opening the Three Kingdoms era. He died of illness on 22 April 1336, leaving his son Seii as the last Eiso king.
zh: 玉城（1296—1336），据琉球史书《中山世鉴》《中山世谱》记载，是英祖王朝第四代国王，1314年即位。他是前代国王英慈的第三子，两位兄长为父殉死后，他在浦添继位。他无法使各地按司臣服，外岛酋长也停止朝贡。他在位期间，大里按司南下建立南山国，今归仁的领主在北方自立北山国，玉城仅保有中山，三山时代由此开始。1336年4月22日他病逝，其子西威继位，是英祖王朝末代国王。

en: Alice of Korikos (c. 1305–1329) was queen of Armenian Cilicia and the only daughter of Oshin of Korikos, regent for the young King Leo IV, by his first wife Margaret of Ibelin. To secure his hold on power, Oshin forced Alice to marry Leo IV; the wedding took place around the end of 1320 with a papal dispensation dated August 1321. She bore Leo one son, Hethum, who died young around 1331. When Leo took power into his own hands in 1329, he had Oshin and Oshin's brother Constantine killed and ordered Alice murdered as well.
zh: 科里科斯的艾丽斯（约1305—1329）是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王后，摄政奥欣·科里科斯与原配伊贝林的玛格丽特的独女。为巩固权势，奥欣强迫艾丽斯嫁给年幼的国王莱翁四世，婚礼约在1320年底举行，教宗特许状日期为1321年8月。她为莱翁生下一子海屯，约1331年夭折。1329年莱翁亲政，处死奥欣及其弟君士坦丁，并下令将艾丽斯一并杀害。

en: Alix was born on 7 February 1312, the daughter of Baldwin, lord of Neghir and marshal of Armenia, and Marie of Barbaron. She was the elder sister of King Constantine III.
zh: 阿莉克丝生于1312年2月7日，是内吉尔领主、亚美尼亚统帅博杜安与巴尔巴龙的玛丽之女，国王君士坦丁三世的姐姐。

en: Baldwin of Ibelin (c. 1250–1313), son of John of Ibelin and Isabelle du Rivet, was lord of Korakou and Vitzada in Cilician Armenia. He married Marguerite Embriaco of Giblet; their daughter Isabella (died 1315) married Guy of Ibelin.
zh: 鲍德温·德·伊贝林（约1250—1313）是让·德·伊贝林与伊莎贝尔·迪·里韦之子，受封小亚美尼亚的科拉库与维察达领主；他娶吉布莱的玛格丽特·恩布里亚科，其女伊莎贝尔（卒于1315年）嫁给居伊·德·伊贝林。

en: Bohemond of Lusignan (1307/1309–1344) was a Cypriot royal prince, the son of Amalric of Lusignan, Lord of Tyre, and the Armenian princess Isabella. After his father's murder in 1310 he grew up in Cilician Armenia, where he became Lord of Korikos in 1336. In 1340 he married Euphemia of Neghir, who bore him Barthelemy, later regent of Armenia. His brothers included King Constantine II and John, regent of Armenia; he was also the uncle of the future King Leo V. Bohemond was murdered by Armenian barons at Adana on 17 November 1344.
zh: 吕西尼昂的博希蒙德（1307/1309—1344）是塞浦路斯王室成员，父亲为提尔领主阿马尔里克，母亲为亚美尼亚公主伊莎贝拉。1310年父亲遇刺后，他在奇里乞亚亚美尼亚长大，1336年成为科里科斯领主。1340年他娶内吉尔的尤菲米娅为妻，生子巴泰勒米，后者后来出任亚美尼亚摄政。他的兄弟包括亚美尼亚国王君士坦丁二世与摄政约翰，他也是后来国王莱昂五世的叔父。1344年11月17日，博希蒙德在阿达纳被亚美尼亚贵族杀害。

en: Baldwin (died 12 December 1336) was an Armenian noble of the Hetumid house, lord of Neghir and Pertzerpert in the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia. The son of Constantine of Neghir and grandson of Constantine the Constable, he rose to the kingdom's highest military rank, the sparapet, or commander-in-chief, and also bore the title of marshal. Baldwin did not live to wear a crown, but after his death his son was chosen king as Constantine III in 1344. His daughter Euphemia became lady of Korikos as the wife of Bohemond of Lusignan.
zh: 鲍德温（卒于1336年12月12日）是海屯家族的亚美尼亚贵族，领有奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国内的内吉尔与佩尔策佩特。他是内吉尔的君士坦丁之子、统帅君士坦丁之孙，官至王国最高军职“斯帕拉佩特”，即全军统帅，并拥有元帅称号。鲍德温生前未能登上王位，但在他死后，他的儿子于1344年被拥立为国王，即君士坦丁三世。其女尤菲米娅嫁给吕西尼昂的博希蒙德，成为科里科斯女主人。

en: Geoffroy (1323 – shortly before 21 May 1357) was the elder son of Hethum, lord of Neghir, by his Cypriot wife, and the elder brother of King Constantine IV of Cilician Armenia. A poem made by his brother on 21 May 1357 mourns his recent death.
zh: 若弗鲁瓦（1323—1357年5月21日稍前）是内吉尔领主海屯与塞浦路斯妻子所生的长子，也是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王君士坦丁四世之兄。1357年5月21日，他的弟弟赋诗一首，悼念他不久前离世。

en: Euphemia of Neghir (7 May 1325 – after 1381) was the daughter of Baldwin, lord of Neghir and marshal of Armenia, and sister of King Constantine III. In 1340 a papal dispensation allowed her to marry Bohemond of Lusignan, lord of Korikos; he was murdered with King Constantine II in 1344, leaving her a childless widow. On the coronation day of Leo V in September 1374 she married her second husband, the French soldier Sohier Doulçart, whom the king made lord of Korikos. She later died in Jerusalem.
zh: 内吉尔的尤菲米娅（1325年5月7日—1381年后）是内吉尔领主、亚美尼亚统帅博杜安之女，国王君士坦丁三世的妹妹。1340年，教皇特许她嫁给克里克斯领主、吕西尼昂家族的博希蒙德；1344年博希蒙德与君士坦丁二世一同遇刺，她无子守寡。1374年9月莱翁五世加冕当日，她改嫁法国军人索希耶·迪尔萨，国王封他为克里克斯领主。她后来在耶路撒冷去世。

en: Joan of Taranto (died 1323), also called Joan of Anjou, was a daughter of Philip I of Taranto and Thamar Angelina Komnene of the Capetian House of Anjou. In February 1316 she married King Oshin of Cilician Armenia at Tarsus, taking the name Eirene, and bore him a son, George. Widowed in July 1320, when Oshin died amid rumours of poison, she was forced to marry his cousin Oshin of Korikos, who had seized the regency for the young Leo IV. She died in March 1323, leaving a daughter Maria who later married two Armenian kings.
zh: 让娜·德·塔朗托（卒于1323年），又称安茹的让娜，是卡佩安茹家族塔兰托亲王腓力一世与塔玛尔·安杰利娜·科穆宁·杜卡斯之女。1316年2月，她在塔尔苏斯嫁给奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王奥欣，改名伊琳娜，并为他生下儿子乔治。1320年7月奥欣在中毒传言中去世，她随后被迫嫁给掌控幼王莱翁四世摄政权的堂亲科里科斯的奥欣。她于1323年3月去世，留下女儿玛丽亚，后来先后嫁给两位亚美尼亚国王。

en: Hethum (born c. 1322) was the only son of King Leo IV of Armenian Cilicia and Alice of Korikos, and heir to the throne. He died in childhood before 1331.
zh: 海屯（约1322年生）是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王莱翁四世与阿莉斯的独子、王位继承人，1331年前幼年夭折。

en: Hethum I (1213–1270) founded the Hethumid dynasty of Cilician Armenia. His father, Constantine of Baberon, was regent for Queen Isabella and arranged the removal of her first husband Philip. On 14 June 1226 Constantine forced Isabella to marry Hethum, making them co-rulers. Hethum accepted Mongol suzerainty, and in 1254–1255 travelled through Central Asia to the Great Khan's court at Karakorum; his journey was recorded by his companion Kirakos Gandzaketsi. He encouraged other Crusader states to ally with the Mongols and joined them in war against the Mamluks, who in 1266 killed his son Thoros at the Battle of Mari. In 1270 he abdicated in favour of his son Leo and died on 21 October.
zh: 海屯一世（1213—1270）是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚海屯王朝的开创者。其父巴巴伦的康斯坦丁曾任女王伊莎贝拉的摄政，安排除掉了她的首任丈夫腓力。1226年6月14日，康斯坦丁逼迫伊莎贝拉嫁给海屯，使二人成为共治君主。海屯接受蒙古的宗主权，并于1254—1255年经中亚前往哈拉和林的大汗宫廷，随行者乞剌可斯·甘扎克齐将这段旅程写入《亚美尼亚历史》。他劝其他十字军国家与蒙古结盟，并联合蒙古对抗马穆鲁克，1266年其子多罗斯在马里战役中战死。1270年他禅位于儿子莱翁，同年10月21日去世。

en: Hethum II (1266–1307), son of Leo II and Keran, was three times king of Armenian Cilicia. After the Mamluks sacked Hromgla in 1292 he ceded Marash and Behesni, then abdicated in 1293 to join the Franciscans. Restored in 1295, he renewed the Mongol alliance, but his brother Sempad seized the throne, partially blinded him by cauterization, and had Thoros III killed. Freed in 1299, he joined Ilkhan Ghazan to win at Wadi al-Khazandar, before defeat at Homs in 1303. Abdicating again, he ruled as regent for his nephew Leo III, until Mongol Bilarghu murdered them both at Anazarbus in November 1307.
zh: 海屯二世（1266—1307）是莱翁二世与克兰之子，曾三度登上奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王位。1292年马穆鲁克军队攻陷赫罗姆格拉，他割让马拉什、贝赫尼等地，1293年退位加入方济各会。1295年他复位并续订与蒙古人的盟约，却遭兄弟斯姆巴特篡位、灼伤眼睛，部分失明，索罗斯三世也被杀害。1299年获释后，他联合伊儿汗合赞在瓦迪哈赞达尔取胜，1303年在霍姆斯战败。他再次退位，以摄政身份辅佐侄儿莱翁三世，最终于1307年11月在阿纳扎尔布斯与莱翁三世一同被蒙古将领比拉尔古杀害。

en: Hethum of Korikos, called the Historian (c. 1240–c. 1310), was an Armenian nobleman and chronicler of the Hethumid house. The son of Oshin, prince of Korikos, he governed that city until he conspired against King Hethum II and was exiled in 1294. In 1299 he made a pilgrimage to Paris, and in 1305 entered the Premonstratensian order at Bellapais Abbey in Cyprus. In 1307, as prior at Poitiers, he dictated his Flower of the Histories of the East at Pope Clement V's request; Nicolas Faulcon recorded the influential account of the Mongols and the East. At Poitiers he sought support for Amalric of Tyre and advocated a crusade allied with the Mongols. After Hethum II's murder he returned to Armenia as constable, last recorded alive in 1309.
zh: 科律克索的海屯，人称“历史学家”（约1240—约1310），是海屯家族的亚美尼亚贵族与编年史家。他是科律克索王公奥辛之子，曾任该城长官，1294年因反叛国王海屯二世而被流放。1299年他赴巴黎朝圣，1305年在塞浦路斯贝拉佩斯修道院加入普利孟特瑞会。1307年他以普瓦捷修院院长的身份，应教宗克雷芒五世之请口授《东方史之花》，由尼古拉·法尔孔笔录；这部讲述蒙古与东方的著作在中世纪后期广为流传。他在普瓦捷为提尔的阿马尔里克争取支持，并倡议联合蒙古发动十字军。海屯二世遇刺后他返回亚美尼亚出任统帅，1309年以后事迹不见记载。

en: Hethum, lord of Neghir in Cilician Armenia, was a son of Constantine, lord of Neghir, and brother of Baldwin, the kingdom's marshal. He married a woman from Cyprus and fathered King Constantine IV (born 1324). A colophon records his death in 1356.
zh: 海屯是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国内吉尔领主，为内吉尔领主君士坦丁之子、王国统帅博杜安之弟，娶塞浦路斯女子为妻。他是1324年出生的国王君士坦丁四世之父；一则题记记载他卒于1356年。

en: John of Lusignan (c. 1306–1343) was a Poitiers-Lusignan prince who served the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia as constable and then regent. He was born in Nicosia, a son of Amalric, Lord of Tyre, and the Armenian princess Isabella; his sister Agnes married King Leo III. When the barons murdered Leo IV, the last Hethumid king, in 1341, the crown was offered to John, who urged his elder brother Guy to accept it; Guy reigned as King Constantine II. John married Soldane Bagrationi, daughter of King George V of Georgia. He was murdered in Cilicia on 7 August 1343, eight months before Guy was killed in an uprising. His son Leo, born in 1342, became the last Lusignan king of Armenian Cilicia, reigning in 1374–1375.
zh: 吕西尼昂的约翰（约1306—1343）是普瓦捷-吕西尼昂家族的亲王，在奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国历任统帅与摄政。他生于尼科西亚，是提尔领主阿马尔里克与亚美尼亚公主伊莎贝拉之子；他的姐妹阿格尼丝嫁给了国王莱翁三世。1341年，贵族杀害末代海屯王朝国王莱翁四世，王冠被送到约翰面前，他却劝兄长居伊接受，居伊遂以康斯坦丁二世之名为王。约翰娶格鲁吉亚国王吉奥尔基五世之女索尔达娜。1343年8月7日，他在奇里乞亚遇刺身亡，八个月后，居伊也在叛乱中被杀。他生于1342年的儿子莱翁是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚最后一位吕西尼昂系国王，1374至1375年在位。

en: Guy de Lusignan, who reigned as Constantine II, was elected the first Latin king of Armenian Cilicia. Son of Amalric, Lord of Tyre, and Isabella, daughter of Leo II of Armenia, he governed Serres from 1328 to 1341. In 1341 the barons murdered his cousin Leo IV, the last Hethumid king, and the crown was offered to Guy's younger brother John, who urged Guy to take it instead. Guy was reluctant: the regent Oshin of Corycos had murdered his mother and two of his brothers. He accepted in 1342 and took the name Constantine. He had married twice; his second wife Theodora Syrgiannaina bore him a daughter, Isabella. He was killed in an uprising on 17 April 1344, and a distant cousin, Constantine III, succeeded him.
zh: 居伊·德·吕西尼昂后改名康斯坦丁，称康斯坦丁二世，是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚第一位当选的拉丁礼国王。他是提尔领主阿马尔里克与亚美尼亚的伊莎贝拉（莱翁二世之女）之子，1328年至1341年担任塞雷总督。1341年，贵族杀害了他的表亲、末代海屯王朝国王莱翁四世，王冠先被送到居伊的弟弟约翰面前，约翰却劝居伊接受。居伊起初不愿：摄政科里科斯的奥辛曾杀害他的母亲和两个兄弟。1342年他终于接受，取名康斯坦丁。他结过两次婚，第二任妻子狄奥多拉·西尔吉安娜为他生下女儿伊莎贝拉。1344年4月17日，他在一场叛乱中被杀，远亲康斯坦丁三世继位。

en: Constantine of Baberon (died c. 1263), called the Grand Baron, was a powerful noble of the Hethumid house in Cilician Armenia and holder of the castle of Baberon. As guardian of Queen Isabella, he engineered the murder in 1226 of her husband, Philip of Antioch. He tricked Philip's father Bohemond IV into looking for his son at Amouda while Philip was held at Sis, then forced the Frankish garrison at Silifke to surrender the queen and married her to his own son Hethum I, founding the Hethumid royal line. He began building baronial apartments at Baberon and built a chapel near Gösne dated 1241. By his third wife Biatr he fathered Constantine, lord of Neghir, ancestor of later Armenian kings.
zh: 巴巴伦的康斯坦丁（约1263年卒），人称“大男爵”，是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚海屯家族的权臣，领有巴巴伦城堡。作为女王伊莎贝拉的监护者，他在1226年策划谋杀了女王的丈夫安条克的腓力。腓力被囚于锡斯时，康斯坦丁诱使其父博希蒙德四世前往阿穆达寻找儿子，随后逼迫锡利夫凯城堡的法兰克守军交出女王，将她嫁给自己的儿子海屯一世，由此开创海屯王朝。他开始在巴巴伦兴建男爵居所，还在格斯内附近修建了一座题记纪年为1241年的礼拜堂。他与第三任妻子比亚特生有内吉尔领主小康斯坦丁，即后来几位亚美尼亚国王的祖先。

en: Constantine I (1278–c. 1310), also numbered Constantine III, was a son of Leo II of Cilician Armenia and Keran of Lampron. In 1296 he helped his brother Sempad seize the throne from Hethum II, then turned on Sempad after the murder of their brother Thoros in July 1298 and took the crown himself while Hethum recovered from imprisonment. After Hethum resumed the throne in 1299, Constantine plotted to restore Sempad, and both were imprisoned for the rest of their lives.
zh: 康斯坦丁一世（1278—约1310，亦有称三世者）是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王莱翁二世与朗普龙的克朗之子。1296年，他协助兄长森帕德从海屯二世手中篡位；1298年7月兄弟托罗斯遇害后，他反戈对付森帕德，在海屯从囚禁中恢复期间自行登基。1299年海屯复位后，康斯坦丁谋划让森帕德复位，两人因而被囚禁终身。

en: Constantine III (17 April 1313 – 21 December 1362), son of Baldwin, Lord of Neghir, was king of Armenian Cilicia from 1344. The main Hethumid line had ended with the murder of Leo IV in 1341; his successor Constantine II, a second cousin of Constantine III, fell to an uprising in 1344, and Constantine III took the crown. He tried to wipe out rival claimants, ordering the deaths of Constantine II's nephews Bemon and Leo, but the boys escaped to Cyprus before the killings could be carried out. His reign was one of shrinkage under Mamluk pressure: they seized Ajazzo in 1347, then Tarsus and Adana in 1359, leaving the kingdom little more than Sis. He was the first husband of Maria, daughter of Oshin of Corycos. Both his sons died before him, and when he died of natural causes the crown passed to his cousin Constantine IV.
zh: 康斯坦丁三世（1313年4月17日—1362年12月21日）是内吉尔领主博杜安之子，自1344年起为奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王。1341年莱翁四世被杀，海屯王朝的正支就此断绝；继位的康斯坦丁二世是他的二代堂兄，在1344年的叛乱中被杀，康斯坦丁三世登上王位。他试图铲除所有王位竞争者，下令处死康斯坦丁二世的侄儿贝蒙和莱翁，但两个少年在动手之前逃到了塞浦路斯。他在位期间，王国在马穆鲁克人的压力下不断缩小：1347年阿亚斯陷落，1359年塔尔苏斯和阿达纳也被攻占，疆域只剩西斯一带。他是科里科斯的奥辛之女玛丽亚的第一任丈夫。他的两个儿子都先他而死，他自然死亡后，王位传给亲族康斯坦丁四世。

en: Constantine IV (1324–1373), son of Hethum of Neghir, inherited the throne of Armenian Cilicia in December 1362 from his cousin Constantine III, whose widow Maria, daughter of Oshin of Corycos, he married. The Mamluks had already taken Ajazzo, Tarsus and Adana. He allied with Peter I of Cyprus and gave him the port and castle of Corycus; after Peter's death in 1369 he turned to the sultan of Egypt and sought a treaty. His barons feared it would end in annexation by the sultan, and in March 1373 they murdered him. His distant cousin Leo V, of the Poitiers-Lusignan line, succeeded and became the last king of Armenian Cilicia.
zh: 康斯坦丁四世（1324—1373）是内吉尔的海屯之子。1362年12月，亲族康斯坦丁三世去世，他继承了奇里乞亚亚美尼亚的王位，并娶了寡后、科里科斯的奥辛之女玛丽亚。此时阿亚斯、塔尔苏斯和阿达纳已落入马穆鲁克人之手。他与塞浦路斯国王彼得一世结盟，把科里科斯港和城堡让给对方；1369年彼得死后，他又转向埃及苏丹，寻求订立条约。贵族们担心这会导致王国被苏丹吞并，1373年3月将他杀害。继位的是远亲、普瓦捷-吕西尼昂家族的莱翁五世，他成了奇里乞亚亚美尼亚的末代国王。

en: Constantine was lord of Neghir and Partzerpert in Cilician Armenia, the youngest son of the Grand Baron Constantine of Baberon by his third wife Biatr. His sons Baldwin and Hethum of Neghir were the fathers of the Armenian kings Constantine III and Constantine IV.
zh: 康斯坦丁是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚的内吉尔与帕尔采佩特领主，为“大男爵”巴巴伦的康斯坦丁与第三任妻子比亚特的幼子。他的儿子鲍德温和海屯分别是国王康斯坦丁三世、康斯坦丁四世的父亲。

en: Leo II (c. 1236–1289), eldest son of Hethum I and Isabella, ruled Cilician Armenia from 1269 to 1289. In 1262 he married Keran, daughter of Prince Hethum of Lampron. In 1266 he fought the Mamluks at the Battle of Mari, where his brother Thoros was killed and Leo captured; Sis was sacked. His father later ransomed him with money and fortresses, and Leo took the throne when Hethum abdicated in 1269. He fostered Italian and Catalan trade and upheld the Mongol alliance, but defeat with the Mongols at Homs in 1281 forced a ten-year truce and territorial concessions in 1285. He died of arsenic poisoning in 1289 and was succeeded by his son Hethum II.
zh: 莱翁（约1236—1289）是海屯一世与伊莎贝拉的长子，1269—1289年任奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王。1262年他迎娶拉姆普伦的海屯亲王之女凯兰。1266年他在马里战役抗击马穆鲁克，弟弟多罗斯战死，他本人被俘，都城锡斯遭洗劫。后来父亲以钱财和城堡等赎回了他；1269年海屯禅位，他登基为王。他鼓励与意大利和加泰罗尼亚通商，维持与蒙古的同盟，但1281年随蒙古在霍姆斯战败，被迫于1285年接受十年休战并割让土地。1289年他死于砷中毒，儿子海屯二世继位。

en: Leo III (1289–1307) was king of the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia, the son of Thoros III and Margaret of Lusignan, daughter of Hugh III of Cyprus. Crowned in 1303 while still a minor, he ruled with his uncle Hethum II, who acted as regent. In 1305 the two led the Armenian army to defeat a Mamluk raiding force near Bagras. On 17 November 1307, the Mongol general Bilarghu had Leo and Hethum massacred with their retinue at a banquet in Anazarbus. He was married to his cousin Marie of Lusignan and left no children; his uncle Oshin succeeded him.
zh: 莱翁三世（1289—1307）是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国国王，为多罗斯三世与塞浦路斯国王于格三世之女吕西尼昂的玛格丽特之子。1303年他幼年加冕，由叔父海屯二世摄政并共同执政。1305年，二人率军在巴格拉斯附近击败一支马穆鲁克袭扰部队。1307年11月17日，蒙古将领比剌儿古在阿纳扎尔布斯设宴，将莱翁、海屯及其随从一并杀害。他娶表妹吕西尼昂的玛丽为妻，无子嗣，王位由叔父奥欣继承。

en: Leo IV (1309–1341), son of King Oshin, was the last Hethumid king of Armenian Cilicia, a realm harried by Mamluks and Mongols throughout his reign. He came to the throne in 1320 under the regency of Oshin of Corycos, who in 1321 forced him to marry his daughter Alice and killed several members of the royal family to secure his own power. Reaching his majority in 1329, Leo answered in kind: Oshin, Oshin's brother Constantine and Alice were killed on his orders, Oshin's head sent to the Il-Khan and Constantine's to the Mamluk sultan. His pro-Western policy and his 1331 marriage to Constance of Sicily enraged the barons. After the Mamluks took Ayas in 1337 he bought a humiliating truce with territory and a large indemnity, and spent his last years in the citadel at Sis waiting for Western aid that never came. His barons murdered him on 28 August 1341 and chose his cousin Constantine II to succeed him.
zh: 莱翁四世（1309—1341）是国王奥欣之子，奇里乞亚亚美尼亚的末代海屯王朝国王，在位期间王国始终受马穆鲁克人和蒙古人侵扰。他1320年即位，由科里科斯的奥辛摄政；奥辛1321年逼他娶自己的女儿阿莉斯，并杀害了数名王室成员以巩固权力。1329年亲政后，莱翁以牙还牙：奥辛、奥辛之兄君士坦丁和阿莉斯都被他下令处死，奥辛的首级送往伊儿汗，君士坦丁的首级送往马穆鲁克苏丹。他的亲西方政策以及1331年与西西里的康斯坦斯的联姻激怒了贵族。1337年马穆鲁克人攻占阿亚斯后，他以割地和巨额赔款换来屈辱的休战，晚年困守西斯城堡，等待始终没有到来的西方援军。1341年8月28日，贵族将他杀害，改立他的堂兄弟康斯坦丁二世。

en: Leo I, called the Magnificent (1150–1219), was the tenth Roupenid lord of Armenian Cilicia and its first crowned king. After his father Stephen was murdered in 1165, Leo and his elder brother Roupen lived with their uncle. He succeeded Roupen III in 1187 and warred against Aleppo and Damascus, drawing Muslim forces away from the Crusader states. He aided the Third Crusade with provisions and guides, extended his rule over Isauria, and was consecrated king at Tarsus on 6 January 1199. His later reign was filled by a long feud over Antioch's succession. He died on 2 May 1219, leaving the crown to his young daughter Isabella.
zh: 被誉为“宏伟者”的莱翁（1150—1219）是鲁本王朝第十任奇里乞亚亚美尼亚领主，也是第一位加冕的国王。1165年父亲斯捷潘遇害后，莱翁与兄长鲁本投靠了舅父。1187年他继鲁本三世之后成为领主，随即与阿勒颇和大马士革的统治者交战，牵制穆斯林兵力，减轻了十字军国家承受的压力。他以粮草和向导支援第三次十字军，将统治拓展到伊苏利亚，并于1199年1月6日在塔尔苏斯加冕为王，晚年长期卷入安条克继承争端。1219年5月2日他去世，王位传给年幼的女儿伊莎贝拉。

en: Margaret of Ibelin (c. 1290–1320) was a daughter of Balian of Ibelin, seneschal of Cyprus, and Alice of Lampron. She married Oshin of Korikos, future regent of Cilician Armenia. Their daughter Alice was forced to marry Leo IV and slain with Oshin in 1329.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·伊贝林（约1290—1320）是塞浦路斯总管贝里昂·德·伊贝林与拉姆伦的阿丽克斯之女，嫁给后来任奇里乞亚亚美尼亚摄政的科里科斯领主奥辛。女儿阿丽丝被强嫁亚美尼亚国王莱翁四世，1329年与奥辛一同被杀。

en: Margaret of Poitiers-Lusignan (1276–1296) was a Cypriot princess of the French Lusignan dynasty who became queen of Cilician Armenia. Born in Nicosia, she was a daughter of King Hugh III of Cyprus and Isabella of Ibelin, and a sister of the Cypriot kings John I and Henry II. In 1293 she married King Thoros III of Armenia as his first wife. She left two sons, Leo III, who later wore the Armenian crown, and Bohemond, whose later fate is unknown. Margaret died in 1296 after three years as queen.
zh: 吕西尼昂的玛格丽特（1276—1296）是法兰西吕西尼昂家族的塞浦路斯公主，后成为奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王后。她生于尼科西亚，是塞浦路斯国王于格三世与伊贝林的伊莎贝拉之女，塞浦路斯国王约翰一世与亨利二世的姐妹。1293年她嫁给亚美尼亚国王多罗斯三世，成为他的第一任王后，留下两个儿子：后来登上亚美尼亚王位的莱翁，以及日后下落不详的波希蒙德。玛格丽特于1296年去世，仅做了三年王后。

en: Marie of Korikos (1321 – before 1405) was the daughter of Oshin of Korikos, regent of Cilician Armenia, and Joan of Taranto. In 1340 she married her cousin Constantine III and became queen when he ascended the throne in 1344; her two sons, Oshin and Lewon, died in childhood. After Constantine died in 1362, she married his successor, her cousin Constantine IV, and was again queen until his murder in 1373. From April 1373 she governed the shrunken kingdom as regent until Leo V of Lusignan was crowned on 14 September 1374.
zh: 克里克斯的玛丽（1321—1405年前）是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚摄政奥欣·德·克里克斯与塔兰托的乔万娜之女。1340年，她嫁给表亲君士坦丁三世，在他于1344年登基后成为王后；两个儿子奥欣和莱翁都幼年夭折。1362年君士坦丁去世后，她改嫁继位的表亲君士坦丁四世，在1373年国王遇刺前再度为后。自1373年4月起，她以摄政身份统治疆土日蹙的王国，直到1374年9月14日吕西尼昂的莱翁五世加冕。

en: Oshin (1282–1320), a son of Leo II of Armenia, seized the Cilician crown after the Mongol Bilarghu murdered his brother Hethum II and nephew Leo III in November 1307. He defeated Bilarghu and drove him out, while the Ilkhan Öljeitü confirmed his kingship and had the killer executed. In 1309 he executed the marshal Oshin for the murder of Thoros III. His pro-Roman church-union policy stirred discontent. By Isabel of Korikos he had Leo IV, and in 1316 married Joan of Taranto at Tarsus. He died on 20 July 1320, widely believed poisoned by Oshin of Corycos.
zh: 奥欣（1282—1320）是亚美尼亚国王莱翁二世之子。1307年11月蒙古人比拉尔古杀害他的兄长海屯二世和侄儿莱翁三世后，他夺取奇里乞亚王位，击败并逐走比拉尔古；伊儿汗完者都承认他的王位，并处死了凶手。1309年，他以谋杀索罗斯三世之罪处死军务长官奥欣。他推动与罗马教会合一，招致民间不满。他与科里科斯的伊莎贝尔生有莱翁四世，1316年在塔尔苏斯娶塔兰托的琼。他于1320年7月20日去世，时人普遍认为他是被科里科斯的奥辛毒杀的。

en: Oshin was the Hethumid lord of the port of Korikos in Cilician Armenia, son of Constantine of Barbaron and brother of King Hethum I and Sempad the Constable. By Alix of Lampron he fathered the chronicler Hayton of Corycus. He died on 15 January 1265.
zh: 奥欣是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚港口科里科斯的海屯家族领主，巴巴伦的康斯坦丁之子，亚美尼亚国王海屯一世与统帅森帕德的兄弟；他与朗普龙的阿丽克丝生下编年史家科律克索的海屯，于1265年1月15日去世。
