en: Oshin of Korikos (died 1329), son of the historian Hayton of Corycus, became regent of Armenian Cilicia for the young Leo IV after King Oshin died in July 1320, a death he was rumoured to have caused by poison. He probably had the king's sister Isabella and two of her sons murdered as rival claimants. He married first Margaret d'Ibelin, whose daughter Alice became Leo IV's queen, then King Oshin's widow Joan of Anjou, by whom he had Marie. When Leo came of age, the king had both Oshin and Alice killed in 1329.
zh: 科里科斯的奥辛（？—1329）是历史学家科律克索的海屯之子。1320年7月国王奥欣去世后，他成为年幼的莱翁四世的摄政，据传国王之死就是他下毒所致。他可能还命人杀害了国王的姐姐伊莎贝拉和她的两个儿子，以铲除王位竞争者。他先娶玛格丽特·德·伊贝兰，女儿阿莉斯后来成为莱翁四世的王后；又娶国王奥欣的遗孀安茹的琼，生下女儿玛丽。莱翁成年后，于1329年下令将奥辛和阿莉斯一并处死。

en: Sempad (1277 – c. 1310), a son of Leo II of Armenia, usurped the Cilician throne in 1296 while his brothers Hethum II and Thoros were escorting their sister to Constantinople. In 1297 he travelled to the Ilkhan Ghazan's court, winning Mongol recognition of his reign and a Mongol bride. When Hethum returned, Sempad had him partially blinded by cauterization and imprisoned at Partzerpert, where Thoros was strangled on his orders in July 1298. Their brother Constantine then turned against him and freed Hethum, who overthrew Sempad. After another plot with Constantine, Sempad spent his final years imprisoned, dying around 1310.
zh: 斯姆巴特（1277—约1310）是亚美尼亚国王莱翁二世之子。1296年，他趁兄弟海屯二世与索罗斯护送妹妹前往君士坦丁堡之际篡夺奇里乞亚王位。1297年，他亲赴伊儿汗合赞的宫廷，获得蒙古人对其王位的承认，并娶了一位蒙古新娘。海屯回国后，斯姆巴特命人灼伤他的眼睛，使其部分失明，将两兄弟囚于帕泽佩特，1298年7月索罗斯在那里被他下令绞死。随后兄弟君士坦丁倒戈，救出海屯并推翻斯姆巴特。他后来又与君士坦丁合谋复位，事败后被终身囚禁，约1310年死去。

en: Sibylla of Cyprus (1198–c. 1230) was the elder daughter of Aimery of Lusignan, king of Cyprus and Jerusalem, and Queen Isabella I of Jerusalem. Orphaned in 1205, she was raised at the Cypriot court, and in 1210 or 1211 her half-brother King Hugh I gave her in marriage to the aged Leo I, King of Cilician Armenia. She was queen until Leo died in 1219 and was the mother of his sole heir, Queen Isabella I of Armenia, born in 1216. Her Lusignan and Jerusalem blood gave her a claim to the throne of Jerusalem, which she never pursued.
zh: 塞浦路斯的西比拉（1198—约1230）是塞浦路斯与耶路撒冷国王艾默里·德·吕西尼昂与耶路撒冷女王伊莎贝拉一世的长女。1205年父母双亡后，她在塞浦路斯宫廷长大；1210或1211年，异母兄长于格一世将她嫁给年迈的奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王莱翁一世。1219年莱翁去世前她身为亚美尼亚王后，并于1216年生下他唯一的继承人——亚美尼亚女王伊莎贝拉一世。她本人也拥有耶路撒冷王位的继承权，但从未主张这一权利。

en: Thoros of Ibelin was the son of the Cypriot nobleman Guy of Ibelin and Maria of Armenia, a daughter of Hethum I, King of Cilician Armenia. Through his father he was a grandson of Baldwin of Ibelin, seneschal of Cyprus. He died after 1307.
zh: 托罗斯·德·伊贝林是塞浦路斯贵族居伊·德·伊贝林与奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王海屯一世之女玛丽亚之子，祖父为塞浦路斯元帅鲍德温·德·伊贝林，卒于1307年后。

en: Thoros III (c. 1271–1298), a son of Leo II of Armenia, became king of Armenian Cilicia when his brother Hethum II abdicated in 1293. In 1288 he married Margaret of Lusignan, daughter of King Hugh III of Cyprus; their son Leo III later inherited the crown. Uneasy ruling alone, Thoros recalled Hethum as co-ruler in 1295. In 1296 the brothers took their sister Rita to Constantinople to marry Michael IX Palaiologos, only to find Sempad had seized the throne. Imprisoned at Bardzrberd, Thoros was strangled there on 23 July 1298 on Sempad's orders.
zh: 索罗斯三世（约1271—1298）是亚美尼亚国王莱翁二世之子，1293年其兄海屯二世退位后继任奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王。1288年他娶塞浦路斯国王于格三世之女吕西尼昂的玛格丽特，二人之子莱翁三世后来继承王位。索罗斯不安于独自执政，于1295年召回海屯共治。1296年，兄弟二人护送妹妹丽塔前往君士坦丁堡嫁给米哈伊尔九世·巴列奥略，回来时斯姆巴特已篡夺王位。索罗斯被囚于巴兹尔伯德，1298年7月23日奉斯姆巴特之命被绞死。

en: Isabella of Armenia (c. 1280–1323), also called Zabel, was a daughter of Leo II and Keran and the twin sister of King Sempad. At Nicosia in 1292 or 1293 she married Amalric of Cyprus, Lord of Tyre, and bore him six children, including Guy, who later reigned in Cilicia as Constantine II, and Maria, who married Leo IV. When Oshin of Corycos ruled as regent for Leo IV, he sought to remove rival claimants: between 1320 and 1323 he imprisoned and murdered Isabella and her son Henry, before April 1323. Isabella was reportedly poisoned.
zh: 亚美尼亚的伊莎贝拉（约1280—1323），又名扎贝尔，是莱翁二世与克兰之女、斯姆巴德国王的孪生妹妹。1292至1293年间，她在尼科西亚嫁给提尔领主、塞浦路斯的阿马尔里克，生下六个子女，其中包括后来在奇里乞亚称康斯坦丁二世的居伊，以及嫁给莱翁四世的玛丽亚。科里科斯的奥辛为莱翁四世摄政时，决意铲除王位竞争者：1320至1323年间，他将伊莎贝拉和儿子亨利囚禁并杀害，时为1323年4月之前。据传伊莎贝拉是被毒杀的。

en: Isabella, also called Zabel (c. 1216–1252), was queen regnant of Armenian Cilicia from 1219 until her death. The only child of King Leo I and Sibylla of Cyprus, she succeeded at about three years old; the rival claimant Raymond-Roupen was defeated, captured and executed. Her first regent, Adam of Baghras, was assassinated, and Constantine of Baberon became her guardian. Constantine married her to Philip of Antioch in 1222, but Philip plundered the palace and was imprisoned and poisoned at Sis. Constantine then forced her to marry his own son, Hethum I, who ruled with her and founded the Hethumid dynasty. She died on 23 January 1252.
zh: 伊莎贝拉，又译扎贝尔（约1216—1252），自1219年起为奇里乞亚亚美尼亚女王，直至去世。她是国王莱翁一世与塞浦路斯的西比拉唯一的孩子，约三岁时继位；王位竞争者雷蒙-鲁本战败被俘，随后遭处决。她的首任摄政巴格拉斯的亚当遇刺后，巴巴伦的康斯坦丁接任监护人。康斯坦丁于1222年安排她嫁给安条克的腓力，但腓力劫掠王宫，被囚禁在锡斯并遭毒杀。康斯坦丁随后逼她改嫁自己的儿子海屯一世，二人共同统治，开创海屯王朝。1252年1月23日，伊莎贝拉去世。

en: Isabella of Ibelin, daughter of Guy of Ibelin and Maria of Armenia, married the chronicler Hayton, lord of Korikos. Their children included Isabel, King Oshin's first wife, and Oshin of Korikos, who became regent of Cilician Armenia in 1320 after her death.
zh: 伊莎贝尔·德·伊贝林是居伊·德·伊贝林与亚美尼亚的玛丽亚之女，嫁给科里科斯领主兼编年史家海屯；子女包括国王奥欣的元配伊莎贝尔，以及在她去世后的1320年成为奇里乞亚摄政的科里科斯的奥欣。

en: Isabel of Korikos (1282–1310), daughter of chronicler Hayton of Corycus and Isabella of Ibelin, married her cousin King Oshin of Cilician Armenia as first wife. In 1309 she bore his heir Leo IV, last king of the Hethumid line, and died the following year.
zh: 科里科斯的伊莎贝尔（1282—1310）是科里科斯领主、编年史家科律克索的海屯与伊莎贝尔·德·伊贝林之女，嫁给表亲奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王奥欣，为元配；1309年生下继承人莱翁四世，即海屯家族末代国王，次年便去世。

en: Jan I van Cuijk (c. 1230 – 13 July 1308) was a Brabantine noble, knight and diplomat, lord of Cuijk, Grave, Mierlo and Neerloon. He married Jutta of Nassau. In 1288 he fought for Duke John I of Brabant at the Battle of Worringen, where he was praised as one of the bravest knights. In 1294 King Adolf of Nassau sent him as envoy to Edward I of England to negotiate an alliance, and in 1296 he led the baronial conspiracy that overthrew Count Floris V of Holland. His son Jan II succeeded him, followed by his younger son Otto in 1319.
zh: 扬一世·范·克伊克（约1230—1308年7月13日）是布拉班特的贵族、骑士与外交家，克伊克、赫拉弗、米尔洛与尼尔洛恩的领主，娶拿骚的尤塔为妻。1288年，他随布拉班特公爵约翰一世征战沃林根战役，被誉为最英勇的骑士之一。1294年，德意志国王拿骚的阿道夫派他出使英格兰，与爱德华一世谈判结盟；1296年，他领导贵族密谋，推翻了荷兰伯爵弗洛里斯五世。他死后由儿子扬二世继位，1319年幼子奥托接续统治。

en: Jan II van Cuijk was a son of Jan I van Cuijk and Jutta of Nassau, and ruled as lord of Cuijk after his father's death in 1308. He died in 1319 leaving no lawful children, and the lordship passed to his brother Otto.
zh: 扬二世·范·克伊克是扬一世·范·克伊克与拿骚的尤塔之子，1308年父亲死后任克伊克领主。他卒于1319年，没有嫡子，领地传给兄弟奥托。

en: Otto van Cuijk (1270–1350) was a nobleman of the Duchy of Brabant, a son of Jan I van Cuijk and Jutta of Nassau. When his brother Jan II, lord of Cuijk, died in 1319 without lawful children and his other brothers had already died, Otto succeeded to the lordship of Cuijk; he also held Mierlo and Asten. He married three times, his wives being Aleidis of Diest, Johanna of Heverlee and Johanna of Flanders; his only known child, Adelise, was born of the second marriage. His nephew Jan III succeeded him in 1350.
zh: 奥托·范·克伊克（1270—1350）是布拉班特公国贵族，扬一世·范·克伊克与拿骚的尤塔之子。1319年，他的兄弟扬二世去世且无嫡子，其余兄弟也已亡故，奥托遂继承克伊克领地，并身兼米尔洛与阿斯滕领主。他先后娶迪斯特的阿德莱德、赫弗莱的约翰娜和佛兰德斯的约翰娜，唯一见于记载的女儿阿德丽丝出自第二次婚姻。1350年他去世后，侄子扬三世继位。

en: Köke Temür (d. 1375), also called Wang Baobao, was the foremost commander of the late Yuan and pillar of the Northern Yuan. In 1362 he inherited the army of his adoptive father Chaghan Temür after his assassination, storming Yidu to avenge him. In the struggle at the Yuan court he supported the crown prince against the general Bolad Temür, and was made Prince of Henan in 1365. He fought the Yuan generals in Guanzhong who refused his command. He resisted the Ming, but Xu Da defeated him at Taiyuan in 1368 and Shen'er Gorge in 1370, driving him north. In 1372 he crushed Xu Da's army near Karakorum, halting the Ming conquest of the steppe. He spurned every Ming surrender offer; Zhu Yuanzhang called him the extraordinary man of his age.
zh: 扩廓帖木儿（？—1375），汉名王保保，是元末最杰出的统帅，也是北元朝廷的支柱。1362年，其养父察罕帖木儿遇刺，他接管养父的军队，攻破益都为其报仇。在元廷的权力斗争中，他支持太子对抗将领孛罗帖木儿，1365年受封河南王。他与拒绝听命的关中元将交战，又抵抗明军，却先后于1368年在太原、1370年在沈儿峪被徐达击败，被迫退往漠北。1372年，他在哈拉和林附近大败徐达的军队，阻止了明朝对草原的征服。他拒绝明朝的一切劝降，朱元璋称他为‘天下奇男子’。

en: Hugh O'Neill (Irish: Aodh Ó Néill) was an uncle of Muirchertach Ceannfada O'Neill, lord of Clandeboye. In 1359, during the Clandeboye O'Neills' expansion into Uí Tuirtre in County Antrim, he killed Murtagh O'Lynn, tanist of Uí Tuirtre.
zh: 休·奥尼尔（爱尔兰语名艾德）是克兰迪博伊领主穆尔赫塔·坎法达·奥尼尔的叔伯或舅父。1359年，在克兰迪博伊奥尼尔家族向安特里姆郡的伊·图伊尔特雷扩张时，他杀死了伊·图伊尔特雷的塔尼斯特穆尔塔·奥林。

en: Henry O'Neill (Irish: Anrí Ó Néill; d. 1347), son of Brian O'Neill and grandson of Hugh Boy O'Neill, succeeded his kinsman Donnell O'Neill as king of Tyrone in 1325. In 1338 a peace treaty granted him war-ravaged lands in southern Antrim, where his descendants built up the lordship of Clandeboye. In 1345 the justiciar Ralph de Ufford deposed him partly for joining the Anglo-Norman rising against William Donn de Burgh, Earl of Ulster, and installed Áed Remar O'Neill instead. Henry died in 1347 and his son Muirchertach Ceannfada succeeded him in Clandeboye.
zh: 亨利·奥尼尔（？—1347年）是布莱恩·奥尼尔之子、休·博伊德·奥尼尔之孙，于1325年继同族唐纳尔·奥尼尔之后成为蒂龙国王。1338年，依据一项和约，他获得安特里姆南部遭战火破坏的土地，其后代在此建立克兰迪博伊领地。1345年，爱尔兰总督拉尔夫·德·厄福德将他废黜，部分原因是他参与了反对阿尔斯特伯爵威廉·唐·德·伯格的诺曼贵族叛乱；总督另立艾德·雷马尔·奥尼尔。他于1347年去世，其子穆尔赫塔·坎法达继领克兰迪博伊。

en: Duan Guang, also called Duan Xinguang, was the ninth hereditary zongguan of Dali under the Mongol Yuan dynasty, succeeding in 1333. His general Gao Peng routed rebel tribal troops at Hewei Pass near Xiaguan in a battle so bloody the river was said to run red. In 1334 Duan Guang fought the Mongol prince of Liang over their border, and in 1343 he defeated the prince's invading army at Kunmi Mountain, after which they divided the region at Luona Pass, the Duan ruling the south. He died in 1344 and was succeeded by his brother Duan Gong.
zh: 段光（？—1344），又称段信苴光，是元朝治下第九位世袭大理总管，1333年袭职。他派大将高蓬在河尾关（今下关）大破作乱的蕃兵，战况惨烈，史书称“河水尽赤，为之不流”。1334年，他因辖界划分与蒙古所封梁王动兵；1343年梁王来攻大理，段光亲自督师，在昆弥山将其击败，双方最终以罗那关为界分地而治，段氏领有其南。1344年段光去世，由其弟段功继位。

en: Anna of Celje (d. after 1354), daughter of Count Frederick I of Celje, married Count Otto VI of Ortenburg. Her son Frederick III was the last Count of Ortenburg; on his death in 1418 the Carinthian and Carniolan estates passed to the Counts of Celje.
zh: 采列的安娜（1354年后去世）是采列伯爵腓特烈一世之女，嫁给奥滕堡伯爵奥托六世。她的儿子腓特烈三世是末代奥滕堡伯爵；1418年他去世后，奥滕堡家族在克恩滕和卡尼奥拉的领地归于采列伯爵家族。

en: Diemut of Wallsee (d. 1353–1357), daughter of Ulrich I of Walsee, was the wife of Frederick I, first Count of Celje. Her children included Counts Ulrich I and Hermann I and daughters Anna and Catherine, married into the houses of Ortenburg and Gorizia.
zh: 瓦勒塞的迪穆特（1353—1357年间去世）是瓦勒塞的乌尔里希一世之女，嫁与第一代采列伯爵腓特烈一世。她的子女包括采列伯爵乌尔里希一世、赫尔曼一世，以及嫁入奥滕堡家族和戈里齐亚家族的安娜与卡特琳娜。

en: Frederick I (c. 1300–1359), born lord of Žovnek in the Savinja Valley, founded the house that would dominate Slovenian and Croatian history in the early fifteenth century. In 1322 the Counts of Heunburg died out in the male line, and he inherited their castles in Carinthia, Carniola and Styria, among them Celje, which guarded the main road from Lower Styria to Carniola. His cousin Ulrich V of Pfannberg and the widowed Countess Elizabeth contested the inheritance, but with the help of his brother-in-law Ulrich of Walsee he held nearly all of it by 1333. Like his father, he stayed loyal to the Habsburgs: as their captain of Carniola and the Windic March he smoothed their takeover of 1335 and fought Charles of Luxembourg's forces in Carinthia. In April 1341 Emperor Louis IV made him first Count of Celje at Munich. Shortly before his death he joined an embassy to Avignon. By Diemut of Wallsee he left sons Ulrich and Hermann.
zh: 腓特烈一世（约1300—1359）生于萨维尼亚河谷，世袭若夫内克领主，他创立的家族将在15世纪前期主导斯洛文尼亚和克罗地亚的历史。1322年，霍因堡伯爵家族男系绝嗣，他继承了其在克恩滕、卡尼奥拉和施蒂利亚的城堡，其中有采列城堡，它扼守下施蒂利亚通往卡尼奥拉的要道。表亲普凡贝格的乌尔里希五世和寡居的伊丽莎白伯爵夫人与他争夺遗产，他在姐夫瓦勒塞的乌尔里希的帮助下，至1333年得到几乎全部遗产。他和父亲一样效忠哈布斯堡：任哈布斯堡的卡尼奥拉与温德边区长官，使其于1335年顺利接管卡尼奥拉，并在克恩滕与卢森堡的查理的军队作战。1341年4月，皇帝路易四世在慕尼黑封他为第一代采列伯爵。临终前不久，他参加了赴阿维尼翁的使团。他与瓦勒塞的迪穆特生有乌尔里希与赫尔曼两子。

en: Hermann I (c. 1333–1385), Count of Celje, was the second son of Frederick I and Diemut of Wallsee. From his father's death in 1359 he ruled jointly with his elder brother Ulrich I, and alone after Ulrich's death in 1368, guarding the inheritance of his young nephew William. His marriage to Catherine Kotromanić of Bosnia linked the counts of Celje to the Hungarian and Bosnian royal houses. In 1377 he joined Duke Albert III of Austria on crusade against the Samogitians. He died in 1385, the greatest landowner in Slovenia, succeeded by his son Hermann II.
zh: 赫尔曼一世（约1333—1385）是采列伯爵腓特烈一世与瓦勒塞的迪穆特的次子。1359年父亲去世后，他与兄长乌尔里希一世共同治理家族；1368年乌尔里希死后独掌家政，并为年幼的侄子威廉保管遗产。他娶波斯尼亚的卡特琳娜·科特罗马尼奇为妻，使采列伯爵家族与匈牙利和波斯尼亚王室联姻。1377年，他随奥地利公爵阿尔伯特三世参加征讨萨莫吉希亚人的十字军。他于1385年去世，时为斯洛文尼亚境内最大的封建领主，由其子赫尔曼二世继位。

en: Catherine of Celje was a daughter of Count Frederick I of Celje and Diemut of Wallsee. In 1353 she became the second wife of Count Albert III of Gorizia; the marriage was childless. After Albert's death in 1374 she married Hans Truchsess von Waldburg.
zh: 采列的卡特琳娜是采列伯爵腓特烈一世与瓦勒塞的迪穆特之女。1353年，她成为戈里齐亚伯爵阿尔伯特三世的第二任妻子，这段婚姻没有子女。1374年阿尔伯特去世后，她改嫁汉斯·特鲁赫泽斯·冯·瓦尔德堡。

en: Catherine of Heunburg (died c. 1315), eldest daughter of Count Ulrich II of Heunburg and Agnes of Baden, was the second wife of Ulrich of Sanneck. Her son Frederick inherited the Heunburg estates including Celje Castle and in 1341 became the first Count of Celje.
zh: 霍恩堡的卡塔琳娜（约1315年卒）是霍恩堡伯爵乌尔里克二世与巴登的阿格尼丝的长女，嫁给桑内克的乌尔里克为续弦。她的儿子腓特烈继承了包括采列城堡在内的霍恩堡领地，并于1341年成为第一代采列伯爵。

en: Ulrich I (c. 1331–1368), eldest son of Frederick I of Celje and Diemut of Wallsee, was a condottiere from his teens. He first saw war in 1346 at King Louis the Great of Hungary's unsuccessful siege of Zadar, then fought for Louis V of Bavaria in 1348, for Emperor Charles IV on his Italian expedition of 1354, and for Louis of Hungary against Venice at Treviso in 1354–1355. From 1359 he headed the house with his brother Hermann. In 1362–1363 he fought for the Habsburg duke Rudolf IV in Friuli and Tyrol and received Kamnik, Žalec and Vojnik in pledge; from 1362 he also served as Habsburg governor of Carniola. The Austrian poet Peter Suchenwirt wrote a poem about him. His generalship is usually credited with bringing the Counts of Celje into the high nobility of Central Europe, and his son William, by Adelaide of Ortenburg, married Anna, daughter of Casimir III of Poland, tying the house to royalty.
zh: 乌尔里希一世（约1331—1368）是采列的腓特烈一世与瓦勒塞的迪穆特的长子。他少年时即成为雇佣军首领，1346年随匈牙利国王路易大王围攻扎达尔，未能攻克；此后他先后为巴伐利亚公爵路易五世（1348年）和皇帝查理四世（1354年远征意大利）作战，1354—1355年又为匈牙利的路易在特雷维索对抗威尼斯。1359年起，他与弟弟赫尔曼共同掌管家族。1362—1363年，他在弗留利和蒂罗尔为哈布斯堡公爵鲁道夫四世作战，得到卡姆尼克、扎莱茨和沃伊尼克作为抵押；1362年起，他还出任哈布斯堡治下的卡尼奥拉总督。奥地利诗人彼得·祖兴维特写过一首诗专咏他的事迹。一般认为，正是他的统兵才能让采列伯爵家族进入了中欧的高级贵族圈。他与奥滕堡的阿德莱德之子威廉娶波兰国王卡齐米日三世之女安娜，使这个家族与王室联姻。

en: Ulrich of Sanneck (c. 1255–1316) was a free noble and Lord of Žovnek in the March of Savinja. The son of Conrad I of Sanneck, he inherited the estates after his brothers' deaths. In 1278 he fought at the Battle of Marchfeld beside King Rudolf I against Ottokar II of Bohemia. In 1308 he surrendered his lands to the Habsburg dukes and received them back as a fief, bringing the Savinja Valley into Habsburg Styria. His marriage to Catherine of Heunburg gave their son Frederick the inheritance including Celje Castle and founded the House of Celje.
zh: 桑内克的乌尔里克（约1255—1316）是神圣罗马帝国萨维尼亚边区的自由贵族、若夫内克领主。他是桑内克的康拉德一世之子，在诸兄弟死后继承领地。1278年，他在马希费尔德战役中随国王鲁道夫一世对波希米亚国王奥托卡二世作战。1308年，他把领地献给哈布斯堡公爵，再作为封邑领回，使萨维尼亚河谷并入哈布斯堡治下的施蒂利亚。他娶霍恩堡的卡塔琳娜，使儿子腓特烈得到包括采列城堡在内的遗产，采列家族由此发端。

en: Ulrich of Sanneck (born c. 1302) was a son of Ulrich, Lord of Žovnek, and Catherine of Heunburg, and a brother of Frederick I, the first Count of Celje. He died after 1308.
zh: 绍内克的乌尔里希（约1302年生）是若夫内克领主乌尔里希与霍因堡的卡特琳娜之子，第一代采列伯爵腓特烈一世的兄弟。他卒于1308年后。

en: Richard Óg Burke (born c. 1330), second Clanricarde, was the son of Ulick Burke of Annaghkeen, founder of the Clanricarde lordship in County Galway. He ruled until his death in 1387, when his son Ulick an Fhiona succeeded him.
zh: 理查德·奥格·伯格（约1330年生）是第二代克兰里卡德，戈尔韦郡克兰里卡德领地开创者安纳基恩的尤利克·伯格之子。他统治至1387年去世，子尤利克·安菲奥纳继位。

en: Sir Uilleag, or Ulick, de Burgh, also called Ulick Burke of Annaghkeen, was an Anglo-Irish chieftain in County Galway. After the young Earl of Ulster was murdered at Carrickfergus in 1333, he led one of the three Burke factions in the civil war that followed, ruling south Connacht from Annaghkeen. By 1340 his branch had made itself the independent Clanricarde, or Upper Mac William lordship, the name Clanricarde first appearing in 1335. He died in 1343 or 1353 and was succeeded by his son Richard Óg.
zh: 尤利克·德·伯格爵士又称安纳基恩的尤利克·伯格，是戈尔韦郡的盎格鲁-爱尔兰酋长。1333年年轻的阿尔斯特伯爵在卡里克弗格斯遇害，伯格家族随后爆发内战，他是三派势力首领之一，以安纳基恩为据点统治康诺特南部。到1340年，他这一支已建立独立的克兰里卡德（即‘上麦克威廉’）领地，克兰里卡德之名最早出现于1335年。他于1343或1353年去世，子理查德·奥格继位。

en: Geoffroy V de Pons, son of Renaud III, lord of Pons, and Marguerite de Turenne, was lord of Pons and Ribérac. In 1290 at Figeac he married Isabelle de Rodez, heiress of the viscounty of Carlat; their son Renaud IV succeeded in Carlat.
zh: 若弗鲁瓦五世·德·蓬是蓬领主雷诺三世与蒂雷纳的玛格丽特之子，领有蓬与里贝拉克。1290年，他在菲雅克娶卡拉子爵国女继承人罗德兹的伊莎贝尔为妻；他们的儿子雷诺四世后来袭封卡拉。

en: Isabelle de Pons was a daughter of Renaud IV de Pons, viscount of Carlat, and Jeanne d'Albret, and married Arnaud Bertrand de Preissac, lord of Didonne.
zh: 伊莎贝尔·德·庞斯是卡拉子爵勒诺四世·德·庞斯与让娜·德·阿尔布雷之女，嫁给迪东领主阿尔诺·贝尔特朗·德·普雷萨克。

en: Jeanne d'Albret (born before 1306, died c. 1358) was a daughter of Amanieu VII d'Albret and Rose de Bourg. She married Renaud IV de Pons, lord of Pons and viscount of Carlat, whose son she bore, Renaud V de Pons.
zh: 让娜·德·阿尔布雷（1306年前生，约1358年卒）是阿马尼厄七世·德·阿尔布雷与罗丝·迪布尔之女，嫁给蓬斯领主、卡拉子爵勒诺四世·德·蓬，生子勒诺五世·德·蓬。

en: Mathe de Pons, daughter of Renaud de Pons, viscount of Carlat, and Jeanne d'Albret, married the knight Gilbert de Domme and made her will in 1384.
zh: 玛特·德·庞斯是卡拉子爵勒诺·德·庞斯与让娜·德·阿尔布雷之女，嫁给骑士吉尔贝·德·多姆，于1384年立下遗嘱。

en: Renaud IV de Pons (1291–1356), sire de Pons and viscount of Carlat in the Auvergne, was the son of Geoffroy de Pons and Isabelle of Rodez, from whom he inherited the viscounty. In 1319 he married Jeanne d'Albret, daughter of Amanieu VII. He fought for Philip VI at Montendre in 1338 with 210 sergeants-at-arms, but in 1340 secretly placed his lands under English protection before returning to the French banner in 1345 and campaigning in Languedoc and Saintonge. He and his son Renaud V were both killed at the Battle of Poitiers on 19 September 1356.
zh: 勒诺四世·德·庞斯（1291—1356）是庞斯领主、奥弗涅的卡拉子爵，为若弗鲁瓦·德·庞斯与罗德斯的伊莎贝尔之子，卡拉子爵领地由母系继承而来。1319年，他娶阿尔布雷的阿马尼厄七世之女让娜·德·阿尔布雷为妻。1338年，他率210名武装军士在蒙特德尔为腓力六世作战；1340年一度暗中将自己的领地置于英王保护之下，1345年重归法王麾下，转战朗格多克与圣通日。1356年9月19日，他与儿子勒诺五世同在普瓦捷战役中阵亡。

en: Renaud V de Pons (born c. 1330) was the son of Renaud IV de Pons and Jeanne d'Albret, and heir to the lordship of Pons and the viscounty of Carlat. He served the French crown as royal captain in Périgord and the Limousin. He married a daughter of Guillaume de Flotte, lord of Ravel, who bore him two sons, Renaud VI and Hélie, later bishop of Angoulême. In 1356, before marching to the army, he made his will naming guardians for his young son. He fell beside his father at the Battle of Poitiers on 19 September 1356.
zh: 勒诺五世·德·庞斯（约1330年生）是勒诺四世·德·庞斯与让娜·德·阿尔布雷之子，庞斯领地与卡拉子爵领的继承人。他作为佩里戈尔与利穆赞的王室军事长官为王室效力，娶拉韦尔领主纪尧姆·德·弗洛特之女为妻，生有两子：继承人勒诺六世，以及后来出任昂古莱姆主教的埃利。1356年出征前，他立下遗嘱，为年幼的儿子指定监护人。1356年9月19日，他与父亲一同战死于普瓦捷战役。

en: Yolande de Pons, daughter of Renaud IV de Pons, viscount of Carlat, and Jeanne d'Albret, married Arnaud de Vareze, lord of Montferrand, before 1332.
zh: 约朗德·德·庞斯是卡拉子爵勒诺四世·德·庞斯与让娜·德·阿尔布雷之女，1332年前嫁给蒙费朗领主阿尔诺·德·瓦雷兹。

en: Brian Ó Flaithbheartaigh (died 1377) was an Irish chieftain of the O'Flaherty family who may have held the lordship, or taoiseach, of Iar Connacht, the Gaelic territory west of Lough Corrib in County Galway. His obituary in 1377 does not explicitly style him taoiseach.
zh: 布莱恩·奥弗莱厄蒂（？—1377）是奥弗莱厄蒂家族的爱尔兰酋长，可能领有戈尔韦郡科里布湖以西的盖尔人领地西康诺特的首领之位（塔伊塞赫），但1377年的讣闻并未明确以此头衔称呼他。

en: Mao Gui (died 1359) was a leading general of the northern Red Turban Song state. After helping take Huai'an in 1356, he was driven back by Yuan forces and sailed north from Haizhou to Shandong in 1357. He seized Yidu and Jinan and overran most of the peninsula. At Yidu he set up civil administration, recruited former Yuan officials and founded 360 military-farming colonies. In 1358 Liu Futong sent him against the Yuan capital Dadu; his force neared the capital, panicking the court before being repulsed and retreating to Shandong. In 1359 his nominal superior Zhao Junyong murdered him and seized Shandong; Mao's officers killed Zhao in revenge three months later. The infighting helped Yuan forces retake the peninsula.
zh: 毛贵（？—1359年）是北方红巾军韩宋政权的重要将领。1356年他参与攻克淮安，随后被元军击退，于1357年从海州乘船北上山东。他攻占益都、济南，控制了山东大半，在益都建立民政，招募元朝旧吏，设立360处屯田。1358年，刘福通派他北伐元朝都城大都，所部一度逼近大都、震动元廷，最终被击退，退回山东。1359年，名义上地位更高的赵均用杀害毛贵、吞并其地；三个月后，毛贵的部将为他报仇，杀死赵均用。这场内斗有利于元军收复山东。

en: Angelo da Varano was a son of Gentile II da Varano, the Guelph lord of Camerino, and a brother of Berardo II. Unlike Berardo, who held the lordship of Camerino, Angelo entered the Church and is recorded as a religious.
zh: 安杰洛·达瓦拉诺是卡梅里诺圭尔夫派领主真蒂莱二世·达瓦拉诺之子，贝拉尔多二世的兄弟。与领有卡梅里诺的贝拉尔多不同，安杰洛进入教会，家族谱系只记其为神职人员。

en: Bellafiore Brunforte was the daughter of Gualtiero Brunforte and the wife of Berardo II da Varano, lord of Camerino. Her sons Rodolfo, Giovanni and Gentile III each ruled Camerino; a fourth son was Venanzio.
zh: 贝拉菲奥雷·布伦福尔特是瓜尔蒂耶罗·布伦福尔特之女，卡梅里诺领主贝拉尔多二世·达瓦拉诺之妻。她的儿子鲁道夫、乔瓦尼、真蒂莱三世相继统治卡梅里诺，另有一子韦南齐奥。

en: Berardo I da Varano (d. 1329) was the second lord of Camerino, ruling from his father Gentile I's death in 1284, jointly with his brother Rodolfo until 1316. A Guelph condottiere, he fought for Perugia against Foligno in 1288 and served as capitano del popolo of Perugia, Pistoia, Florence and Bologna before entering Pope Boniface VIII's service in 1297. He was elected podestà of San Ginesio in 1300 and held the office five times; in 1316 he was podestà of Macerata. In 1319 Pope John XXII named him Marquis of Ancona to defend the Papal States in the Marche; he took part in the capture of Recanati in 1322 but was defeated by the Ghibellines outside Osimo. The jurist and poet Cino da Pistoia found refuge at his court.
zh: 贝拉尔多一世·达瓦拉诺（？—1329）是卡梅里诺的第二代领主，1284年父亲真蒂莱一世死后继位，与兄弟鲁道夫共同统治至1316年。作为圭尔夫派雇佣军首领，他于1288年助佩鲁贾攻打福利尼奥，先后出任佩鲁贾、皮斯托亚、佛罗伦萨和博洛尼亚的人民统领，1297年转而为教皇卜尼法斯八世效力。1300年他当选圣吉内西奥行政长官，曾五次担任此职；1316年又任马切拉塔行政长官。1319年教皇若望二十二世封他为安科纳侯爵，以捍卫教会国在马尔凯的领地；1322年他参与攻取雷卡纳蒂，却在奥西莫城下被吉伯林派击败。法学家兼诗人奇诺·达皮斯托亚曾在他的宫廷避难。

en: Berardo II da Varano was an Italian condottiere and lord of Camerino, a son of Gentile II da Varano. A Guelph like his father, he served the papal cause alongside him in the wars of Umbria and the March of Ancona against the Ghibellines. He held the lordship of Camerino from 1335 to 1341. By his wife Bellafiore, daughter of Gualtiero Brunforte, he had a son, Gentile III. Berardo died at Camerino in 1350, predeceasing his father.
zh: 贝拉尔多二世·达瓦拉诺是意大利佣兵首领、卡梅里诺领主，真蒂莱二世·达瓦拉诺之子。他与父亲同属圭尔夫派，在翁布里亚和安科纳边区讨伐吉伯林派的战争中随父为教廷效力，1335—1341年领有卡梅里诺。他的妻子贝拉菲奥雷是瓜尔蒂耶罗·布伦福尔特之女，真蒂莱三世是两人的儿子之一。贝拉尔多于1350年在卡梅里诺去世，先于其父而亡。

en: Gentile I da Varano (d. 1284), a Guelph leader, was the first lord of Camerino in the Marche. When the mercenary Percivalle Doria, vicar of King Manfred of Sicily, sacked the town, Gentile fled with its people and obtained help from Pope Alexander IV; in 1259 he recovered Camerino and was proclaimed its lord. He repelled a second attack by Doria in 1264, and two years later was named podestà of Camerino and Rocca Contrada.
zh: 真蒂莱一世·达瓦拉诺（？—1284）是圭尔夫派领袖，也是马尔凯地区卡梅里诺的第一代领主。西西里国王曼弗雷迪的代理人、雇佣军首领佩尔奇瓦莱·多里亚洗劫该城时，真蒂莱随居民出逃，并向教皇亚历山大四世求援；1259年他收复卡梅里诺，被拥立为领主。1264年他击退多里亚的第二次进攻，两年后出任卡梅里诺与罗卡孔特拉达的行政长官。

en: Gentile II da Varano (d. 1355), fourth lord of Camerino, was the son of Berardo I. His family held the rocca of Varano, which controlled a pass between Umbria and the Marche on the road from Rome to the Adriatic. A Guelph, he was podestà of Florence in 1312 and fought alongside his father, the Church's captain general, against the Ghibellines of Umbria and the March of Ancona. He stormed Matelica for Pope John XXII in 1322. When Emperor Louis the Bavarian came down into Italy to support the Ghibellines, he offered Gentile the imperial vicariate, but Gentile declined; Pope Clement VI, seeking to win him over, made him vicar of the Church for Camerino. He received Cardinal Gil de Albornoz in the city with full honours. His son Berardo predeceased him, and Rodolfo II took over Camerino in 1355.
zh: 真蒂莱二世·达瓦拉诺（？—1355）是卡梅里诺的第四代领主，贝拉尔多一世之子。家族据有瓦拉诺要塞，扼守翁布里亚与马尔凯之间的山口，这是从罗马通往亚得里亚海岸的要道。他属圭尔夫派，1312年任佛罗伦萨行政长官，随任教会总司令的父亲在翁布里亚和安科纳边区与吉伯林派作战。1322年，他为教皇若望二十二世攻克马泰利卡。皇帝路易（巴伐利亚人）南下意大利支援吉伯林派时，向他提出帝国代理人之职，被他拒绝；教皇克雷芒六世为拉拢他，任命他为教会驻卡梅里诺代理人。他在城中隆重接待了埃吉迪奥·阿尔沃诺斯枢机。其子贝拉尔多先他而死，1355年由鲁道夫二世接掌卡梅里诺。

en: Gentile III da Varano was an Italian condottiero, son of Berardo II da Varano and Bellafiore Brunforte, who ruled Camerino from 1385 until his death in 1399. Pope Urban V named him senator of Rome in 1368, and in 1375 he was podestà of Lucca. Loyal to Pope Gregory XI, he was confirmed in Tolentino and San Ginesio in 1377, the year his brother Rodolfo drove him out of Camerino. As lord he expelled his brother Venanzio's sons and captured papal commander Andrea Tomacelli, so Pope Boniface IX granted the Da Varano the vicariate of Camerino and neighbouring towns.
zh: 真蒂莱三世·达·瓦拉诺是意大利佣兵首领，1385年至1399年统治卡梅里诺，为贝拉尔多二世·达·瓦拉诺与贝拉菲奥雷·布伦福尔特之子。1368年教宗乌尔班五世任命他为罗马元老，1375年他出任卢卡最高行政官。他忠于教宗格列高利十一世，1377年获确认保有托伦蒂诺和圣杰内肖；同年他被兄弟鲁道夫逐出卡梅里诺。成为领主后，他驱逐了兄弟韦南齐奥的儿子们，还俘虏了教宗军队统帅安德烈亚·托马切利，教宗卜尼法斯九世随即将卡梅里诺及邻近城镇的代牧职权授予瓦拉诺家族。

en: Gentile da Varano was a son of Gentile II da Varano, the Guelph lord of Camerino, and a brother of Berardo II da Varano and of Angelo, who entered the clergy.
zh: 真蒂莱·达瓦拉诺是卡梅里诺圭尔夫派领主真蒂莱二世·达瓦拉诺之子，贝拉尔多二世与进入教会的安杰洛的兄弟。

en: Giovanni I da Varano was an Italian condottiero and lord of Camerino, a son of Berardo II da Varano and Bellafiore Brunforte. In 1350 he served as podestà of San Ginesio. While his brothers Rodolfo and Venanzio joined the 1375 league against Pope Gregory XI, Giovanni stayed loyal to the Church and took part in the unsuccessful defence of Fabriano. When Gregory XI returned to Rome from Avignon in 1377, he confirmed Giovanni and his brother Gentile in possession of Tolentino and San Ginesio. Giovanni built the rocca Varano and ruled Camerino from 1384 until his death in 1385.
zh: 乔瓦尼一世·达·瓦拉诺是意大利佣兵首领、卡梅里诺领主，贝拉尔多二世·达·瓦拉诺与贝拉菲奥雷·布伦福尔特之子。1350年，他出任圣杰内肖的最高行政官。兄弟鲁道夫与韦南齐奥于1375年加入反对教宗格列高利十一世的同盟，乔瓦尼却忠于教会，参加了法布里亚诺未果的守城战。1377年格列高利十一世从阿维尼翁返回罗马后，将托伦蒂诺与圣杰内肖的领有权确认给乔瓦尼及其兄弟真蒂莱。他修建了瓦拉诺要塞，1384年起统治卡梅里诺，1385年去世。

en: Rodolfo I da Varano (d. 1316), son of Gentile I, ruled Camerino jointly with his brother Berardo I from their father's death in 1284. A Guelph like the rest of his house, he was capitano del popolo of Lucca in 1284, podestà of San Ginesio in 1299 and of Rocca Contrada in 1301, and capitano del popolo of Perugia from 1301. He was present at the Perugia conclave of June 1305 that elected Pope Clement V. He enriched himself with property confiscated from Camerino's Ghibellines, and on his death in 1316 the signoria passed to Berardo alone.
zh: 鲁道夫一世·达瓦拉诺（？—1316）是真蒂莱一世之子，1284年父亲死后与兄弟贝拉尔多一世共同统治卡梅里诺。他与家族同为圭尔夫派，1284年任卢卡的人民统领，1299年任圣吉内西奥行政长官，1301年任罗卡孔特拉达行政长官，同年出任佩鲁贾的人民统领。1305年6月，他在佩鲁贾出席了选举克雷芒五世的秘密会议。他靠没收卡梅里诺吉伯林派的财产致富，1316年去世后，领主权归于贝拉尔多一人。

en: Rodolfo II da Varano (d. 1384), lord of Camerino, was the son of Berardo and succeeded Gentile II in 1355. He had already made his name at the Christian capture of Smyrna in 1344. In 1355 he defeated Galeotto Malatesta near Paderno, seized Recanati and took Galeotto prisoner at Castelfidardo; the peace that followed was sealed by Galeotto's marriage to Rodolfo's daughter Elisabetta. As papal gonfaloniere he reconquered Rimini, Fano and Pesaro for the Church. He then served Florence against Pisa in 1362 and against Bernabò Visconti in 1370. In 1377 Pope Gregory XI made him commander-in-chief against Florence, and the Florentines painted him on a public building as a traitor, hanging upside down from a gallows. He died at Tolentino in 1384.
zh: 鲁道夫二世·达瓦拉诺（？—1384）是卡梅里诺领主，贝拉尔多之子，1355年继真蒂莱二世之位。1344年基督徒夺取士麦那之战中，他已凭战功成名。1355年，他在帕代尔诺附近击败加莱奥托·马拉泰斯塔，攻占雷卡纳蒂，又在卡斯泰尔菲达尔多俘获加莱奥托；其后的和约以加莱奥托迎娶鲁道夫之女伊丽莎白为凭。他任教皇旗官时，为教会收复里米尼、法诺和佩萨罗。此后他先后受雇于佛罗伦萨，1362年对比萨作战，1370年对贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂作战。1377年教皇格列高利十一世任命他为对抗佛罗伦萨的总司令，佛罗伦萨人便把他画成叛徒，倒吊在绞架上，绘在一座公共建筑的墙上。1384年他卒于托伦蒂诺。

en: Venanzio da Varano was a son of Berardo II da Varano, lord of Camerino, and brother of Rodolfo II, Giovanni I and Gentile III. In 1375 he and Rodolfo joined the league that warred on Pope Gregory XI; he died between 1377 and 1380.
zh: 韦南齐奥·达·瓦拉诺是卡梅里诺领主贝拉尔多二世之子，鲁道夫二世、乔瓦尼一世、真蒂莱三世的兄弟。1375年他与鲁道夫加入反对教宗格列高利十一世的同盟，约1377至1380年间去世。

en: Naghachu (d. 1388) was a Mongol general of the Northern Yuan who held out in Liaodong after the Yuan collapse. A descendant of Muqali and a myriarch at Taiping, captured in 1355, he refused to defect to Zhu Yuanzhang and was freed. As grand commandant he gathered Mongol forces in the northeast, holding Jinshan with some two hundred thousand men and raiding the Ming frontier. His influence extended over much of Rehe and Liaoning. In 1387 a two-hundred-thousand-strong Ming army under Feng Sheng and Fu Youde advanced, and he surrendered. His officers and relatives were sent to Nanjing, and he received estates in Jiangxi. Made Marquis of Haixi, he died at Wuchang in 1388 on the Yunnan campaign, reportedly from overdrinking.
zh: 纳哈出（？—1388）是北元蒙古将领，元朝灭亡后坚守辽东。他是名将木华黎的后裔，任太平路万户时于1355年被俘，拒绝归顺朱元璋而被释放。官至太尉后，他在东北聚集蒙古部众，拥众二十万据守金山一带，屡次进犯明朝边境，势力遍及热河和辽宁大部。1387年，冯胜、傅友德率二十万明军进逼，纳哈出投降，部将和亲属被送往南京，他获赐江西田产并受封海西侯。1388年他随军征讨云南，途中在武昌去世，相传因饮酒过度而死。

en: Ali was a son of Süleyman I Pasha, bey of Candar, who granted him rule of the western town of Safranbolu after seizing it.
zh: 阿里是詹达尔贝伊苏莱曼一世·帕夏之子，父亲夺取西部城镇萨夫兰博卢后，将该城交给他治理。

en: Gülçiçek Hatun was a Greek woman from Bithynia who entered the Ottoman palace and became a concubine of Sultan Murad I around 1359. She bore him the future Sultan Bayezid I, later called Yıldırım, and also Yahşi Bey. As the mother of a sultan she established a pious foundation and used its revenues to build a mosque and raise her own tomb at Bursa. She was the first Ottoman concubine to build a mosque. She died around 1400 and was buried in that tomb.
zh: 居尔奇切克哈屯是出身比提尼亚的希腊女子，进入奥斯曼宫廷后，约于1359年成为苏丹穆拉德一世的妃嫔。她为穆拉德生下后来的苏丹、绰号‘闪电’的巴耶济德一世，另有一子亚赫希贝伊。作为苏丹之母，她设立宗教慈善基金会，以其收入修建清真寺，并在布尔萨为自己修建陵墓。她是第一位修建清真寺的奥斯曼妃嫔。她约于1400年去世，葬于该陵墓。

en: Ghiyath al-Din İbrahim I was bey of Candar from 1341 until his death around 1345, the eldest son of Süleyman I Pasha. His father first entrusted him with governing Sinop, annexed in 1322, but later named İbrahim's youngest brother Çoban heir, so around 1340 İbrahim rebelled and took Kastamonu. In 1340 he commissioned an illuminated copy of Rumi's Divan-i Kabir in Konya. In 1341 he captured about ten Genoese vessels in a clash over Genoa's trading post near Sinop. In 1346 his cousin Adil came to the throne.
zh: 吉亚斯丁·易卜拉欣一世是詹达尔贝伊，1341年至约1345年在位，苏莱曼一世·帕夏的长子。父亲先派他治理1322年并入的锡诺普，后来却打算立幼弟丘班为继承人，易卜拉欣遂于1340年前后起兵，夺取卡斯塔莫努。1340年，他在科尼亚命人制作了一部带泥金装饰的鲁米《大迪万》抄本。1341年，围绕热那亚在锡诺普附近的商站发生冲突，他俘获约十艘热那亚船只。1346年，他的堂弟阿迪勒登上君位。

en: Süleyman I Pasha was the second bey of Candar, succeeding his father Şemseddin Yaman Candar. On 16 July 1309 he seized Kastamonu, killed Mahmud of the Chobanids and made the city his capital. He ruled under Ilkhanid suzerainty until the death of Abu Sa'id, took direct control of Sinop in 1322 and later seized Safranbolu, declared independence in 1327 and minted his own coins from 1335. He kept peace with his neighbours but went on raiding Byzantium. When he named his youngest son Çoban heir, his son İbrahim revolted and took Kastamonu; Süleyman died in 1340, aged over eighty.
zh: 苏莱曼一世·帕夏是詹达尔王朝第二代贝伊，继其父谢姆塞丁·亚曼·詹达尔而立。1309年7月16日，他攻取卡斯塔莫努，杀死丘班王朝的马哈茂德，并定该城为都。他先在伊利汗国宗主权下统治，直至大汗不赛因去世；1322年直接接管锡诺普，后又夺取萨夫兰博卢，1327年宣布独立，1335年起自铸钱币。他与邻邦相安，却继续袭掠拜占庭。他原想立幼子丘班为继承人，儿子易卜拉欣便起兵夺取卡斯塔莫努。苏莱曼于1340年去世，享年八十余岁。

en: Şemseddin Yaman Candar was a Turkish commander of the Kayı Oghuz line and the founder of the Candar principality in northern Anatolia. He was rewarded with the Eflani region for distinguished service to Sultan Mesud II of Rum. He established himself there as an independent bey, founding the Candaroğulları dynasty. He ruled until his death in 1309 and was succeeded by his son Süleyman I.
zh: 谢姆塞丁·亚曼·詹达尔出身乌古斯突厥人的凯伊支系，是安纳托利亚北部詹达尔侯国的创建者、第一代贝伊。他效力于鲁姆苏丹梅苏德二世，因功受封埃夫拉尼地区，在当地自立为贝伊，开创詹达尔王朝，统治至1309年去世，由其子苏莱曼一世继位。

en: Aedh mac Tairdelbach Ó Conchobair, a son of Toirdelbach Ó Conchobair, claimed the kingship of Connacht after his father's death in 1345. His reign was spent warring with his cousin Aedh mac Feidlimid. In 1350, after he had Ruaidrí son of Cathal killed, MacWilliam Burke and the lords of Connacht deposed him, but he returned in 1351 and retook the kingship by force in 1352. In 1356 he was killed at Balloughdacker by Donnchad Carrach Ó Cellaig and the Clan an Baird.
zh: 艾德·麦克·泰尔代尔巴赫·奥康诺尔是泰尔代尔巴赫·奥康诺尔之子，1345年父亲死后争得康诺特王位。他在位期间一直与堂亲艾德·麦克·费德利米德交战。1350年，他派人杀死卡扎尔之子鲁艾德里后，被麦克威廉·伯克与康诺特诸领主废黜；他于1351年返回，1352年以武力夺回王位。1356年，他在巴洛达克被敦哈德·卡拉赫·奥凯莱格与巴德氏族杀死。

en: Ruaidrí Ua Conchobair (c. 1116–1198), anglicised Rory O'Conor, succeeded his father Tairrdelbach as king of Connacht in 1156 and was inaugurated High King of Ireland at Dublin in 1166, the first high king to rule without opposition. He expelled Diarmait Mac Murchada from Leinster, but the exiled king's Norman allies invaded from 1169. Ruaidrí united the Irish kings, besieged Dublin in 1171 and won at Thurles, yet the invasion ended his supremacy. The 1175 Treaty of Windsor made him Henry II's subordinate king; he abdicated in 1183 and died in 1198, the last Gaelic High King of Ireland.
zh: 罗艾德里·奥康却拜尔（约1116—1198，英姓罗里·奥康纳）于1156年继其父托尔德巴赫之后成为康诺特国王，1166年在都柏林即位为爱尔兰最高国王，也是首位未遇反抗的最高国王。他把迪尔梅德·麦克穆尔查达逐出伦斯特，但这位流亡国王引来诺曼盟友，于1169年入侵。罗艾德里联合爱尔兰诸王，1171年围攻都柏林，并在瑟勒斯取胜，仍无法挽回大局。1175年的《温莎条约》使他成为亨利二世治下的藩属国王；他于1183年退位，1198年去世，是最后一位盖尔人的爱尔兰最高国王。

en: Toirdelbach Ó Conchobair, anglicised Turlough O'Conor, was a king of Connacht and a son of Aedh mac Eogain Ó Conchobair. In 1317, in the succession crisis after the Second Battle of Athenry, he displaced Ruaidri na Fed and seized the kingship, only to be deposed by Cathal mac Domnaill in 1318. He won back Connacht in 1324, lost it to Aedh mac Aedh Breifneach in 1342, and recovered it in 1343. On 15 October 1345 he was killed by an arrow fighting the Clan Murtagh Ó Conchobair and allies, after a longer reign than any Connacht king of his generation.
zh: 托尔德尔巴赫·奥康纳（英化作特洛·奥康纳）是爱尔兰康诺特国王，艾德·麦克·尤甘·奥康纳之子。1317年，在第二次阿森赖战役后的继承混乱中，他排挤鲁艾德里·纳·费德夺得王位，却于1318年被卡哈尔·麦克·多姆纳尔废黜。1324年他重夺康诺特，1342年败于艾德·麦克·艾德·布雷夫内赫，1343年再度复辟。1345年10月15日，他在与奥康纳家族穆尔塔支派及其盟友作战时中箭身亡，是同代康诺特国王中在位最久的一位。

en: Tairrdelbach Mór Ua Conchobair (1088–1156), anglicised Turlough O'Conor, became king of Connacht in 1106 after deposing his brother Domnall, and was recognised as High King of Ireland from about 1120. He broke the power of the Ua Briain dynasty of Munster by partitioning the province and crushing its army at the Battle of Móin Mór in 1151. He campaigned across Ireland, rebuilt Cong Abbey, and died in 1156 after a reign of fifty years. His son Ruaidrí, first his deputy, succeeded him in Connacht and later became High King.
zh: 托尔德巴赫·莫尔·奥康却拜尔（1088—1156）于1106年废黜兄长多姆纳尔，成为康诺特国王，约1120年起被承认为爱尔兰最高国王。他通过分裂芒斯特，并于1151年在莫因莫尔战役击溃芒斯特军队，摧毁了乌阿·布里安王朝的势力。他征战爱尔兰各地，重建康格修道院，1156年去世，在位长达五十年。其子罗艾德里曾任他的副手，继位康诺特，后来也成为最高国王。

en: Chen Youding (d. 1368) was a Yuan loyalist general who held Fujian during the dynasty's collapse. Orphaned and impoverished, he had worked as a farm labourer and in a salt shop at Qingliu. Enlisting as a postal soldier, he won promotion from 1352 by crushing revolts and defeated Chen Youliang's general Deng Keming. In 1364 he lured Zhu Yuanzhang's officer Hu Shen into an ambush at Jinjiang and killed him. He suppressed the Ispah rebellion in coastal Fujian, rose to Pingzhang, the province's highest official, and shipped grain by sea to the Yuan capital Dadu. When Ming armies invaded in 1367 and took his stronghold Yanping, he attempted suicide, was captured and taken to Nanjing, refused to submit, and was executed in 1368.
zh: 陈友定（？—1368）是元末忠于元朝的将领，在王朝崩溃之际掌控福建。他幼年父母双亡，因贫困流落清流，务农并在盐店做工。他从军当驿卒，1352年起以镇压叛乱之功不断升迁，击败过陈友谅的部将邓克明。1364年，他在锦江设伏诱杀朱元璋部将胡深。他平定福建沿海的亦思巴奚兵乱，官至福建行省平章政事，为一省最高官员，还经海路将粮食运往元大都。1367年明军攻入福建，夺取他的据点延平，他自杀未遂被俘，押往南京后拒降，于1368年被处决。

en: Palladio Avogadro came from the noble Avogadro family of Vercelli, which supplied many bishops to the Piedmontese church. On 20 October 1326 he became bishop of Ivrea, the diocese covering the Canavese. The episcopal castle of Albiano d'Ivrea had belonged to his see since Emperor Otto III granted it to the bishop in the year 1000; Palladio now invested it to Philip I of Savoy-Acaia, lord of Piedmont. After wars broke out in the Canavese in the second half of the century, the castle went back to the bishops. In 1329 he toured his diocese on a pastoral visit. On 25 August he described the church of San Michele at Parella, finding it in good repair but poorly adorned, and he also visited San Costanzo at Pont Canavese. He remained bishop until his death around 1346.
zh: 帕拉迪奥·阿伏伽德罗出身韦尔切利的阿伏伽德罗贵族家族，该家族为皮埃蒙特教会出过多位主教。1326年10月20日，他就任管辖卡纳韦塞的伊夫雷亚主教。阿尔比亚诺-迪夫雷亚的主教城堡自皇帝奥托三世于1000年授予主教以来一直属于该教区，帕拉迪奥这时把它封赐给皮埃蒙特领主萨伏依-阿卡亚的腓力一世。十四世纪后半叶卡纳韦塞战事四起，城堡又回到主教手中。1329年他巡访教区，8月25日记述了帕雷拉圣米迦勒教堂，认为建筑状况良好，装饰却欠佳；他还视察了蓬特卡纳韦塞的圣科斯坦佐教堂。他担任伊夫雷亚主教直至约1346年去世。

en: Cola di Rienzo (1313–1354), born Nicola di Lorenzo Gabrini, was a Roman notary who championed the Roman people against the city's barons. A nobleman had killed his brother, sharpening his desire to restore order in Rome. A mission to Pope Clement VI at Avignon in 1343 won him papal favour, and on 20 May 1347 he led a rising on the Capitol, taking the title of tribune. He reformed justice, cleared robbers from the roads and summoned Italian cities to federate under Rome, but was driven from power within months. After years of imprisonment in Prague and Avignon he returned to Rome in August 1354 as papal senator, only to be murdered by a mob on 8 October.
zh: 柯拉·迪·里恩佐（1313—1354），本名尼古拉·迪·洛伦佐·加布里尼，是罗马的一名公证人，曾领导罗马民众对抗城中贵族。他的兄弟被一名贵族杀害，更加激起了他整顿罗马秩序的愿望。1343年，他出使阿维尼翁觐见教皇克雷芒六世，赢得教廷好感；1347年5月20日，他在卡皮托利山发动民众起事，取得“保民官”的称号。他整顿司法，清剿道路上的盗匪，并召集意大利各城市组建以罗马为首的联盟，但不出数月便被赶下台。此后他在布拉格和阿维尼翁被囚禁多年，1354年8月以教皇册封的元老身份回到罗马，10月8日即被暴民杀死。

en: Aliénor de Comminges (1329–1402) was the fourth daughter of Count Bernard VIII of Comminges and Mathe de l'Isle-Jourdain. Clement VI bought the viscounty of Turenne from her sister Cécile as a gift for her marriage to his nephew Guillaume III Roger de Beaufort, contracted in 1349 and celebrated on 7 February 1350. As viscountess of Turenne and lady of Meyrargues in Provence, Aliénor held the strong castle of Meyrargues and exercised justice there from 1370. Mother of the mercenary captain Raymond de Turenne, she backed his private war against the Anjou rulers of Provence and the Avignon papacy. In 1385 she sent a barge across the Durance to supply opponents of Marie of Blois at Aix, and she reportedly forced fishmongers carrying Angevin banners as passes to swallow them. She submitted to Marie in 1388 only after a siege, was seized by Marshal Boucicaut in 1399 and held at Aix until 1401. She died in 1402 and was buried there.
zh: 阿莉埃诺·德·科曼日（1329—1402）是科曼日伯爵贝尔纳八世与马特·德·利勒茹尔丹的第四个女儿。教皇克雷芒六世从她姐姐塞西尔手中买下蒂雷纳子爵领，作为她与教皇侄子纪尧姆三世·罗歇·德·博福尔的结婚礼物；婚约订于1349年，两人于1350年2月7日成婚。作为蒂雷纳子爵夫人兼普罗旺斯的梅拉尔格女领主，她坐镇坚固的梅拉尔格城堡，自1370年起在当地行使司法权。她是雇佣军首领蒂雷纳的雷蒙之母，支持儿子对统治普罗旺斯的安茹家族和阿维尼翁教廷发动私战。1385年，她派驳船横渡杜朗斯河，向艾克斯反对布卢瓦的玛丽的势力运送补给；相传她还逼迫举着安茹旗帜当通行证的鱼贩把旗帜吞下去。1388年她在遭围攻后才向玛丽臣服，1399年被布锡考元帅俘获，在艾克斯关到1401年。她于1402年去世，葬于艾克斯。

en: Arnaud de Comminges was a son of Roger I of Comminges. By his wife Adélaïde he is considered the father of Arnaud II, Eudes and Roger II, who each ruled Comminges; Adélaïde later married Roger I the Old, count of Carcassonne.
zh: 阿尔诺·德·科曼日是科曼日的罗歇一世之子。后世推定他与妻子阿黛拉伊德生下阿尔诺二世、厄德和罗歇二世，三人先后统治科曼日；阿黛拉伊德后来改嫁卡尔卡松伯爵长者罗歇一世。

en: Arnaud I (c. 900–957) was count of Comminges and Couserans from about 940. One disputed hypothesis holds that his wife Arsinde was a daughter of Count Acfred II of Carcassonne and brought him Carcassonne and Razès. Modern genealogists regard him as a son of Count Aznar III. He and his brother Roger I ruled Comminges and Couserans jointly, and he appears with Arsinde in donations to the abbeys of Lézat in 944 and Montolieu in 949. He died before 27 November 957, when a charter names only his widow and sons; his lands were divided among Roger of Carcassonne, Eudes and Raymond.
zh: 阿尔诺一世（约900—957）约自940年起任科曼日与库兹朗伯爵。一种有争议的假说认为，他的妻子阿尔桑德是卡尔卡松伯爵阿克弗雷德二世之女，为他带来了卡尔卡松和拉泽斯。近代系谱学者认为他是伯爵阿兹纳尔三世之子。他与兄弟罗歇一世共同统治科曼日与库兹朗，并在944年、949年与阿尔桑德共同出现在向莱扎修道院、蒙托利厄修道院捐赠的文书中。957年11月27日的特许状只出现他的遗孀与诸子，他当已在此前去世，领地由儿子罗歇、厄德和雷蒙瓜分。

en: Arnaud II was count of Comminges around 979. He was the son of Adélaïde, later the wife of Count Roger I the Old of Carcassonne, and probably of Arnaud de Comminges. He died before 988, when his likely brother Eudes appears as count.
zh: 阿尔诺二世约于979年任科曼日伯爵。他是阿黛拉伊德——后来改嫁卡尔卡松伯爵长者罗歇一世——之子，父亲可能是阿尔诺·德·科曼日。他于988年前去世，此后可能由其兄弟厄德继任伯爵。

en: Arnaud III was count of Comminges in the later eleventh century, son of Count Roger II and his wife Aldana. He died after 1070 and was the probable father or grandfather of his successor, Roger III.
zh: 阿尔诺三世是11世纪后期的科曼日伯爵，伯爵罗歇二世与妻子阿尔达娜之子。他卒于1070年后，其继任者罗歇三世可能是他的儿子或孙子。

en: Aznar III (died 940) was count of Comminges, the son of Loup Aznar, whose lineage was traced back to the dukes of Gascony. He bore the title of viscount of Comminges during his father's lifetime and succeeded as count after his death. A charter of 915 records that, returning from a pilgrimage to Rome, he founded the monastery of Peyrisse. Arnaud I and Roger I, thought to have been his sons, divided the county between them; Roger's line kept Comminges and ruled it until the fourteenth century.
zh: 阿兹纳尔三世（?—940）是科曼日伯爵，洛普·阿兹纳尔之子，其世系相传可追溯至加斯科涅公爵。他在父亲生前领有科曼日子爵之衔，父亲死后继任伯爵。915年的一份特许状记载，他从罗马朝圣归来后修建了佩里斯修道院。阿尔诺一世与罗歇一世被认为可能是他的儿子，二人瓜分了伯国；罗歇一系保有科曼日，统治一直延续至14世纪。

en: Bernard I (d. between 1145 and 1154) was the first great count of Comminges, succeeding his father Roger III before 1105 and ruling lands on both sides of the Pyrenees. He joined the Aragonese Reconquista, fighting at the capture of Tudela in August 1114 and under Gaston IV of Béarn at the taking of Zaragoza in December 1118. Around 1120 he married Dias de Samatan, heiress of Muret and Samatan, drawing Comminges into the orbit of Toulouse. He contested the Val d'Aran with Aragon, whose king asserted overlordship in 1131 and 1132. In 1134 Bernard went to Zaragoza to meet Alfonso VII of Castile, probably seeking support; in 1143 he sought an agreement with the Count of Barcelona and apparently secured the valley by 1144.
zh: 贝尔纳德一世（1145—1154年间卒）是科曼日第一位强权伯爵，1105年前继其父罗歇三世之位，统治比利牛斯山南北两侧的土地。他投身阿拉贡的收复失地运动，1114年8月参加攻取图德拉，1118年12月又在贝阿恩子爵加斯东四世麾下参加攻占萨拉戈萨。约1120年，他娶米雷与萨马唐的女继承人迪亚斯·德·萨马唐，使科曼日进入图卢兹的势力圈。他为阿兰山谷与阿拉贡争执，阿拉贡国王于1131年和1132年宣称对该地的宗主权。1134年贝尔纳德前往萨拉戈萨会见卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索七世，很可能是为了寻求支持；1143年他寻求与巴塞罗那伯爵达成协议，至1144年似乎已取得山谷。

en: Bernard II of Comminges (died between 1149 and 1153) was the eldest son of Count Bernard I and Dias, heiress of Muret and Samatan. He succeeded his father after 1145 and ruled only briefly. In 1149–1150 he granted the lands of Quérillac, Brogal and La Rue to the young Cistercian abbey of Bonnefont. He probably died young and childless; he was the first count of the dynasty known to be buried at Bonnefont, and his brother Dodon succeeded him as Bernard III.
zh: 科曼日的贝尔纳二世（1149—1153年间卒）是伯爵贝尔纳一世与米雷和萨马唐女继承人迪亚斯的长子，1145年后继承父位，在位时间很短。1149至1150年，他把凯里拉克、布罗加尔和拉吕的土地赠予新建的西多会博纳丰修道院。他可能早逝且无子嗣，是该王朝已知首位安葬在博纳丰的伯爵，由其弟多东继位，即贝尔纳三世。

en: Bernard III of Comminges, born Dodon de Samatan (c. 1120–1176/1183), was a son of Count Bernard I and Dias de Samatan, and lord of Saves, Samatan and Muret from 1145. When his brother Bernard II died around 1153, Dodon inherited the county and took the name Bernard. He enlarged Muret and built its church of Saint-Jacques. In 1176 he abdicated, granting Couserans as a viscounty to his son Roger and Saves to his son Guy. He married Laurence, daughter of Count Alphonse Jourdain of Toulouse, and his heir was Bernard IV.
zh: 科曼日的贝尔纳三世原名多东·德·萨马唐（约1120—1176/1183），是伯爵贝尔纳一世与迪亚斯·德·萨马唐之子，1145年起为萨夫、萨马唐和米雷的领主。兄长贝尔纳二世约1153年去世后，他继承伯国并改名贝尔纳。他扩建米雷城，修建了城中的圣雅克教堂。1176年他退位，把库斯朗作为子爵领封给儿子罗歇，把萨夫封给儿子居伊。他娶图卢兹伯爵阿尔方斯·茹尔丹之女洛朗斯，继承人是贝尔纳四世。

en: Bernard IV (died 22 February 1225) succeeded his father Bernard III Dodon as count of Comminges in May 1176, sharing the family lands with his brother Roger, who received the viscounty of Couserans. From 1180 to 1195 he occupied Saint-Lizier and expelled successive bishops until the pope intervened. Neutral during the sieges of Béziers and Carcassonne, he joined Count Raymond VI of Toulouse against Simon de Montfort in the Albigensian Crusade, fighting at Castelnaudary and Muret. Montfort occupied Comminges in 1212, but the Fourth Lateran Council restored the county to Bernard in 1216, on condition that his daughter Pétronille marry Guy de Montfort. He later helped defend Toulouse and Marmande before making peace in 1220.
zh: 贝尔纳四世（？—1225年2月22日）于1176年5月继承父亲贝尔纳三世·多东的科曼日伯国，并与弟弟罗歇分家，后者分得库瑟朗子爵领。1180年至1195年，他占据圣利济耶，逐出历任主教，直到教皇介入。阿尔比十字军围攻贝济耶和卡尔卡松时，他保持中立，后来与图卢兹伯爵雷蒙六世联手对抗西蒙·德·孟福尔，转战卡斯泰尔诺达里和米雷。1212年孟福尔占领科曼日，1216年第四次拉特朗公会议将伯国归还给他，条件是女儿佩特罗妮拉嫁给孟福尔之子居伊。此后他又参与保卫图卢兹和马尔芒德，1220年停战。

en: Bernard V (1196–30 November 1241) was the son of Count Bernard IV of Comminges and Comtors de La Barthe. During the Albigensian Crusade he fought beside his father against Simon de Montfort, and in September 1212 was sent to Aragon to persuade King Peter II to aid the southern lords against the crusaders. In 1224 he married Cécile, daughter of Count Raymond-Roger of Foix, and succeeded his father as count of Comminges on 22 February 1225. He died at Lanta on 30 November 1241 and was buried at Bonnefont Abbey, leaving the county to his only son Bernard VI.
zh: 贝尔纳五世（1196—1241年11月30日）是科曼日伯爵贝尔纳四世与孔托尔·德·拉巴特之子。阿尔比十字军期间，他随父亲对抗西蒙·德·孟福尔，1212年9月奉命出使阿拉贡，游说国王佩德罗二世援助南方诸侯。1224年，他娶富瓦伯爵雷蒙—罗歇之女塞西尔为妻，并于1225年2月22日父亲去世后继任科曼日伯爵。1241年11月30日他在朗塔去世，葬于博讷丰修道院，伯国由独子贝尔纳六世继承。

en: Bernard VI (c. 1224–before March 1300) was the only son of Count Bernard V of Comminges and Cécile de Foix. He succeeded his father on 30 November 1241 and did homage to Count Raymond VII of Toulouse a few days later. His reign of more than fifty years was marked by the foundation of numerous comital bastides, including Lestelle-de-Saint-Martory in 1243, Boussens in 1269 and Montesquieu-Avantès in 1272. In 1295 he retired, donating all his lands at Muret to his eldest son Bernard VII and asking King Philip IV the Fair in writing to approve the transfer and receive his successor's homage. He was buried at Bonnefont Abbey.
zh: 贝尔纳六世（约1224—1300年）是科曼日伯爵贝尔纳五世与塞西尔·德·富瓦的独子。1241年11月30日父亲去世后继位，数日后向图卢兹伯爵雷蒙七世行臣服礼。他在位逾半个世纪，以兴建大批伯爵领巴斯蒂德新城著称，如1243年的莱斯泰勒—德圣马托里、1269年的布桑斯和1272年的孟德斯鸠—阿旺泰斯。1295年他退隐，在米雷将全部领地封让给长子贝尔纳七世，并书面请求法王美男子腓力四世批准转让、接受继承人的臣服。死后他葬于博讷丰修道院。

en: Bernard VII (1245/1246–1312) was count of Comminges, the eldest son of Count Bernard VI and Thérèse. Around 1280 he married Laure de Montfort, daughter of Philippe II de Montfort of Castres. On 20 March 1295 his father made over all his lands to him at Muret and asked King Philip IV the Fair to receive his homage. He granted the village of Cambernard to the Hospitallers. His children included Bernard VIII, Cardinal Jean-Raymond de Comminges, and Éléonore, wife of Gaston II of Foix. He died at Buzet on 21 July 1312 and was buried at Bonnefont Abbey.
zh: 贝尔纳七世（1245/1246—1312）是科曼日伯爵，伯爵贝尔纳六世与泰蕾丝的长子。约1280年，他迎娶卡斯特尔的腓力二世·德·蒙福尔之女洛尔·德·蒙福尔。1295年3月20日，其父在米雷将全部领地移交给他，并请国王美男子腓力四世接受他的臣服。他曾把康贝尔纳村授予医院骑士团。子女包括贝尔纳八世、枢机主教让·雷蒙·德·科曼日，以及嫁给富瓦伯爵加斯东二世的埃莱奥诺尔。1312年7月21日，他卒于比泽，葬于博讷丰修道院。

en: Bernard VIII (1280–1336) ruled Comminges from 1312, succeeding his father Bernard VII; his mother was Laure de Montfort, daughter of the lord of Castres. Through his marriage in 1305 to Marguerite, only daughter of Viscount Raymond VII of Turenne, he became viscount of Turenne, retaining it under her will after Marguerite and their infant daughter died in 1314. He built marriage alliances with Astarac and Foix, and in 1335 married his daughter Cécile to the Count of Urgell, brother of Peter IV of Aragon. He died in 1336 leaving only daughters; a posthumous son, Jean I, succeeded but died in infancy.
zh: 贝尔纳八世（1280—1336）是贝尔纳七世与卡斯特尔领主之女洛尔·德·蒙福尔之子，1312年起袭任科曼日伯爵。1305年他娶蒂雷纳子爵雷蒙七世的独生女玛格丽特，由此成为蒂雷纳子爵；1314年玛格丽特与襁褓中的女儿先后去世，他凭妻子的遗嘱保住蒂雷纳。他通过联姻结交阿斯塔拉克与富瓦家族，1335年又把女儿塞西尔嫁给阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世之弟、乌拉尔伯爵，与阿拉贡结盟。他于1336年去世，只留下女儿，遗腹子让一世继位后幼年夭折。

en: Eudes was count of Comminges from before 988 until around 1035. He was a son of Arnaud de Comminges and probable brother of Count Arnaud II. His brother Roger II also held the county, followed by Roger's son Arnaud III.
zh: 厄德在988年之前至约1035年间任科曼日伯爵。他是阿尔诺·德·科曼日之子，可能是阿尔诺二世的兄弟。他的兄弟罗歇二世也领有该伯国，继位者是罗歇之子阿尔诺三世。

en: Françoise de Fésenzac was a daughter of Bernard VI, Count of Armagnac, and the wife of Pierre-Raimond I, Count of Comminges. She was the mother of his heir Pierre-Raimond II, count from 1341, and of Jeanne and Éléonore de Comminges.
zh: 弗朗索瓦丝·德·费桑萨克是阿马尼亚克伯爵贝尔纳六世之女，嫁给科曼日伯爵皮埃尔·雷蒙一世。她生有继承人皮埃尔·雷蒙二世（1341年继位为伯爵），以及让娜和埃莱奥诺尔。

en: Jean I of Comminges (May 1336–1339) was the posthumous only son of Count Bernard VIII and Mathe de l'Isle-Jourdain, born after his father's death. Under Bernard's will he was recognized from birth as count of Comminges and viscount of Turenne, under his mother's guardianship. The will had named his eldest sister Cécile as heir if the unborn child was not a boy. He died in early 1339 and was buried at the Poor Clares' monastery of Samatan. His death opened a violent succession dispute between his mother and sisters and his uncle Pierre-Raymond, who denied women the right to inherit. After months of war and years of legal disputes Pierre-Raymond secured Comminges, while Cécile was recognized as viscountess of Turenne.
zh: 科曼日的让一世（1336年5月—1339年）是贝尔纳八世与马特·德·利勒茹尔丹的遗腹独子，在父亲去世后出生。按父亲遗嘱，他一出世就被承认为科曼日伯爵兼蒂雷纳子爵，由母亲监护。遗嘱规定，若遗腹子不是男孩，则由长女塞西尔继承。1339年初他夭折，葬于萨马坦的贫穷修女会修道院。他的死引发激烈的继承争端：母亲和姐姐们与叔父皮埃尔—雷蒙争夺伯国，后者否认女性的继承权。经过数月战争和多年法律争执，皮埃尔—雷蒙取得科曼日，塞西尔则被承认为蒂雷纳女子爵。

en: Jeanne de Comminges (c. 1332–1398) was a daughter of Count Bernard VIII of Comminges and Mathe de l'Isle-Jourdain. After her cousin Pierre-Raymond II inherited the county in 1341, she claimed Comminges with the backing of the lords of l'Isle-Jourdain. Hostilities followed, and the quarrel ended in 1350 when she married her rival, who fought for the French king in the Hundred Years' War. When he died around 1376 she ruled the county as regent for their daughters. Gaston Fébus, Count of Foix, then claimed Comminges as a relative, but the Count of Armagnac opposed him and Gaston renounced his claim under the peace of 1379. Their elder daughter Éléonore died before her mother, so the younger, Marguerite, became countess. Jeanne died in 1398.
zh: 让娜·德·科曼日（约1332—1398）是科曼日伯爵贝尔纳八世与马特·德·利勒茹尔丹之女。1341年堂兄皮埃尔—雷蒙二世继位后，她在利勒茹尔丹诸侯支持下主张伯国继承权。双方爆发敌对行动，争端于1350年以她嫁给对手皮埃尔—雷蒙告终，后者在百年战争中追随法王作战。约1376年丈夫去世后，她以摄政身份为女儿们治理伯国。富瓦伯爵加斯东·费比斯随后以亲属身份主张继承科曼日，遭到阿马尼亚克伯爵反对，最终依照1379年和约放弃要求。长女埃莉诺先于母亲去世，小女玛格丽特成为科曼日女伯爵。让娜于1398年去世。

en: Laure de Montfort (c. 1262–1300) was the second daughter of Philippe II de Montfort, lord of Castres, and Jeanne de Lévis, daughter of the lord of Mirepoix. After 1277 she married Bernard VII, count of Comminges. In May 1290, at the castle of Roquecourbe in the Albigeois, she was represented by Bernard when she and her siblings Jean de Montfort, count of Squillace, and Éléonore divided their parents' inheritance. She died before 1 December 1300, leaving at least eight children, including Bernard VIII, the cardinal Jean-Raymond, and Aliénor, wife of Gaston II of Foix.
zh: 洛尔·德·蒙福尔（约1262—1300年前）是卡斯特尔领主腓力二世·德·蒙福尔与米尔普瓦领主之女让娜·德·莱维的次女。1277年后，她嫁给科曼日伯爵贝尔纳七世。1290年5月，在阿尔比日瓦的罗克库尔布城堡，她由贝尔纳代表，与兄弟斯奎拉切伯爵让·德·蒙福尔及姊妹埃莱奥诺尔分割了父母的遗产。她于1300年12月1日前去世，留下至少八个子女，包括贝尔纳八世、枢机主教让·雷蒙，以及嫁给富瓦伯爵加斯东二世的埃莱奥诺尔。

en: Mathe de L'Isle-Jourdain (died 1352), a daughter of Bernard IV, lord of L'Isle-Jourdain, and Marguerite de Foix, married Count Bernard VIII of Comminges in 1315. When he died in 1336 she was pregnant; per his will the county, together with the viscounty of Turenne, passed to her posthumous son Jean, and Mathe ruled as regent from 1336 to 1339. Jean died at age three, and the inheritance passed to her daughter Cécile, wife of James I of Aragon, Count of Urgell.
zh: 玛特·德·利勒茹尔丹（?—1352）是利勒茹尔丹领主贝尔纳四世与玛格丽特·德·富瓦之女，1315年嫁给科曼日伯爵贝尔纳八世。1336年丈夫去世时她正有孕；按其遗嘱，伯国连同蒂雷纳子国都由遗腹子让继承，玛特于1336至1339年任摄政。让三岁夭折，领地由她的女儿塞西尔继承，后者嫁给了乌尔赫尔伯爵海梅一世。

en: Pierre-Raimond I (c. 1295–1341), the second son of Count Bernard VII of Comminges and Laure de Montfort, inherited the lordship of Serrières. When his nephew, the child count Jean, died in 1339, the boy's sisters claimed Comminges; Pierre-Raimond denied that women could inherit the county, won the French king's backing, and made himself count. The dispute also aimed to keep Comminges from the Crown of Aragon, since the elder claimant Cécile was married to James I of Urgell. He fell gravely ill and died in April 1341, shortly after taking power.
zh: 皮埃尔·雷蒙一世（约1295—1341）是科曼日伯爵贝尔纳七世与洛尔·德·蒙福尔的次子，继承了塞里耶尔领地。1339年，他的侄子、年幼的科曼日伯爵让夭折，死者的姐妹们要求继承伯国；皮埃尔·雷蒙以女子不得继承科曼日为由，在法王支持下自立为伯爵。这场争端也意在阻止科曼日落入阿拉贡王室之手，因为年长的主张者塞西尔嫁给了乌尔赫尔伯爵海梅一世。他于1341年4月即位后不久病死。

en: Pierre-Raimond II (died 1375) was Count of Comminges and Viscount of Serrières from 1341, succeeding his father Pierre-Raimond I. His cousin Jeanne, daughter of Count Bernard VIII and Mathe de L'Isle-Jourdain, contested the county with the backing of the lords of L'Isle-Jourdain; the quarrel was settled by their marriage in 1350. He fought for the king of France in the Hundred Years' War. His will was made in October 1375, and he died soon after, leaving the county first to his widow as regent and then to his daughter Marguerite.
zh: 皮埃尔·雷蒙二世（?—1375）于1341年继其父皮埃尔·雷蒙一世之位，任科曼日伯爵兼塞里耶尔子爵。他的堂亲让娜——贝尔纳八世伯爵与玛特·德·利勒茹尔丹之女——在利勒茹尔丹领主们支持下争夺伯国，争端以两人于1350年成婚告终。他曾随法王参加百年战争。1375年10月他立下遗嘱，不久后去世，伯国先由遗孀摄政，后由女儿玛格丽特继位。

en: Roger I of Comminges, possibly Count Aznar III's son, ruled Comminges jointly with his likely brother Arnaud I. He died before 7 April 949. His son Arnaud fathered counts Roger II and Odo; his descendants ruled the county until the fourteenth century.
zh: 科曼日的罗歇一世被认为可能是伯爵阿兹纳尔三世之子，与可能是其兄弟的阿尔诺一世共同统治科曼日伯国，于949年4月7日前去世。他的儿子阿尔诺是伯爵罗歇二世与厄德的父亲，罗歇一系统治科曼日直至14世纪。

en: Roger I (c. 930–1012) was a son of Count Arnaud I of Comminges and Arsinde of Carcassonne. From 957 he was associated with the rule of Comminges, and in 983 he inherited Couserans on his father's death; around 1000 he also received Carcassonne from his mother, uniting three counties in the Pyrenean foothills. In 969 he married Adelaide of Rouergue. Their daughter Ermesinde married Count Ramon Borrell of Barcelona, and their son Bernard-Roger became Count of Bigorre. Roger shared the rule of Carcassonne and parts of Couserans and Razès with his son Ramon Roger, and that of Couserans with Bernard-Roger. He died in 1012 and was succeeded by his nephew William I of Carcassonne.
zh: 罗歇一世（约930—1012）是科曼日伯爵阿尔诺一世与卡尔卡松的阿尔桑德之子。957年起他参与治理科曼日，983年父亲去世后继承库瑟朗，约1000年又从母亲处获得卡尔卡松伯国，身兼比利牛斯山北麓三个伯国。969年他娶鲁埃格的阿德莱德为妻，女儿埃尔梅辛迪嫁给巴塞罗那伯爵拉蒙·博雷尔，儿子贝尔纳—罗歇成为比戈尔伯爵。他与儿子拉蒙·罗歇共同治理卡尔卡松以及部分库瑟朗和拉泽斯，又与贝尔纳—罗歇共同治理库瑟朗。罗歇一世于1012年去世，由侄子卡尔卡松的纪尧姆一世继承。

en: Roger II was count of Comminges from about 1003 until his death around 1035. He was a son of Arnaud de Comminges and brother of Count Eudes. His son Arnaud III succeeded him and ruled the county until about 1070.
zh: 罗歇二世约自1003年起任科曼日伯爵，约1035年去世。他是阿尔诺·德·科曼日之子、伯爵厄德的兄弟。其子阿尔诺三世继位，统治科曼日至约1070年。

en: Roger III was count of Comminges around 1100, usually regarded as the son or grandson of Arnaud III. He is thought to have died about 1105, and Bernard I, killed at the Battle of Saint-Gaudens in 1145, was probably his son.
zh: 罗歇三世约于1100年前后任科曼日伯爵，通常被视为阿尔诺三世之子或孙。据信他约于1105年去世；1145年在圣戈当战役中战死的贝尔纳一世可能是他的儿子。

en: Corfitz Ulfeldt (1606–1664) was Denmark's most notorious traitor. The son of Chancellor Jacob Ulfeldt, he studied abroad, including a year under Cesare Cremonini at Padua, and returned to Denmark in 1629. He married Christian IV's daughter Leonora Christina in 1636 and became steward of the realm in 1643. Suspected of embezzlement after Frederick III's accession, he fled to Sweden in 1651, and in the war of 1657–1658 guided Charles X Gustav's army across the frozen Belts and negotiated for Sweden the Treaty of Roskilde. Later condemned by Sweden too, he died a hunted fugitive on the Rhine near Basel in 1664; his wife then spent twenty-two years in Copenhagen's Blue Tower.
zh: 科尔费茨·乌尔费尔特（1606—1664）是丹麦贵族，被后世视为丹麦最臭名昭著的叛国者。他是首相雅各布·乌尔费尔特之子，曾在国外求学，在帕多瓦师从切萨雷·克雷莫尼尼一年，1629年返回丹麦。他于1636年迎娶克里斯蒂安四世之女莱奥诺拉·克里斯蒂娜，1643年出任王国宫廷总管。腓特烈三世即位后，他因涉嫌贪渎在1651年逃奔瑞典；1657—1658年战争中，他引导卡尔十世·古斯塔夫的军队越过冰封的贝尔特海峡，并代表瑞典谈成《罗斯基勒条约》。后来他又被瑞典定罪，1664年作为被追捕的逃客死于巴塞尔附近的莱茵河上；他的妻子随后在哥本哈根的蓝塔被囚禁了二十二年。

en: Alberto Casali was a son of Ranieri II Casali, the first signore of Cortona, and a brother of Bartolomeo, the second signore, and of the condottiere Jacopo Casali.
zh: 阿尔贝托·卡萨利是科尔托纳首任领主拉涅里二世·卡萨利之子，是第二代领主巴尔托洛梅奥与佣兵队长雅各布·卡萨利的兄弟。

en: Bartolomeo Casali (c. 1315–1363) succeeded his father Ranieri II as signore of Cortona in 1351. In 1352, serving the Ghibelline archbishop Giovanni Visconti of Milan, he and Pier Saccone Tarlati invaded Perugian territory and seized the fortress of Bettona by bribing its podestà; besieged by Perugia, Siena and Florence, he escaped in disguise, and in February 1353 publicly begged Perugia's pardon with a rope around his neck. Emperor Charles IV confirmed him as imperial vicar in 1355, and he became a Sienese citizen in 1357. Perugia besieged Cortona that year, and in 1358 Bartolomeo allied with Siena. He died of plague in 1363 and was succeeded by his son Francesco I.
zh: 巴尔托洛梅奥·卡萨利（约1315—1363）于1351年继承父亲拉涅里二世，成为科尔托纳领主。1352年，他效力于米兰的吉伯林派大主教乔瓦尼·维斯康蒂，与皮尔·萨科内·塔尔拉蒂联手入侵佩鲁贾领地，收买贝托纳的行政长官夺取要塞；佩鲁贾、锡耶纳和佛罗伦萨联兵围困后，他乔装逃走，1353年2月又颈系绳索，当众向佩鲁贾请罪求和。1355年，神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理四世确认他为帝国代理人，1357年他成为锡耶纳市民。同年佩鲁贾围攻科尔托纳，1358年巴尔托洛梅奥与锡耶纳结盟。1363年他死于瘟疫，儿子弗朗切斯科一世继位。

en: Dianora Casali, also called Diora, was a daughter of Ranieri Casali, lord of Cortona, and married Marquis Rigone del Monte Santa Maria.
zh: 迪亚诺拉·卡萨利，又称迪奥拉，是科尔托纳领主拉涅利·卡萨利之女，嫁给侯爵里戈内·德尔蒙泰·圣玛丽亚。

en: Franceschino Casali was a son of Ranieri II Casali, the first signore of Cortona, and a brother of Bartolomeo, the second signore, and of the condottiere Jacopo Casali.
zh: 弗兰切斯基诺·卡萨利是科尔托纳首任领主拉涅里二世·卡萨利之子，是第二代领主巴尔托洛梅奥与佣兵队长雅各布·卡萨利的兄弟。

en: Ranieri II Casali (c. 1280–22 January 1351) was a condottiero and the first signore of Cortona, founder of the Casali lordship that held the city until 1409. Son of Guglielmino di Uguccio, he drove the counts of Petrella out in July 1324 when they tried to seize Cortona. As one of the Three Consuls he became de facto lord in 1325; that year Pope John XXII made Cortona a bishopric. In 1332 his brother Uguccio stormed the town hall to kill him, his son Bartolomeo and the bishop and hand the city to the Tarlati of Arezzo. Ranieri fought them off, then allied with Florence. In July 1336, backed by Perugia and with Bartolomeo beside him, he laid waste the country up to the walls of Arezzo. In 1342 he backed the Tarlati's attempt to recover Arezzo, when Florence had put itself in the hands of Walter of Brienne. He died in 1351, and Bartolomeo succeeded him.
zh: 拉涅里二世·卡萨利（约1280—1351年1月22日）是雇佣兵首领、科尔托纳的首任领主，开创了此后统治该城直到1409年的卡萨利领主家系。他是古列尔米诺·迪·乌乔之子。1324年7月，彼得雷拉伯爵企图夺取科尔托纳，被他赶出城去。1325年，他作为“三执政官”之一成为事实上的统治者；同年教皇约翰二十二世将科尔托纳升为主教区。1332年，他的弟弟乌乔攻入市政厅，要杀死他、他的儿子巴尔托洛梅奥和主教，把城市献给阿雷佐的塔尔拉蒂家族。拉涅里奋力抵抗，将叛军逐出，随后与佛罗伦萨结盟。1336年7月，他在佩鲁贾支持下，与儿子巴尔托洛梅奥并肩，把阿雷佐城下的乡野劫掠一空。1342年，佛罗伦萨落入布里埃纳的瓦尔特手中，他转而支持塔尔拉蒂家族夺回阿雷佐。1351年他去世，巴尔托洛梅奥继位。

en: Giovanna, called Vanna, was a daughter of Ranieri II Casali, the first signore of Cortona, and a sister of Bartolomeo Casali, who succeeded their father as signore in 1351.
zh: 焦万娜（人称梵娜）是科尔托纳首任领主拉涅里二世·卡萨利之女，也是1351年继父任领主的巴尔托洛梅奥·卡萨利的姐妹。

en: Local tradition remembers Kriznook as a Kalasha ruler in southern Chitral in the early fourteenth century. He commanded the valleys of Shishi Kuh, Drosh, Jinjeret Kuh, Nagar and Urtsun, and Chitrali accounts also place several valleys of Bashgal under his rule, ranking him above the northern Kalasha chief Bulasing in power. Around 1320 Shah Nadir Rais, founder of the Rais dynasty, killed Bulasing and overran upper Chitral; he raided Kriznook's lands too, but could not take them.
zh: 相传克利兹努克是14世纪前期吉德拉尔南部的卡拉什人首领，统辖希希库赫、德罗什、金杰雷特库赫、讷格尔和乌尔孙诸谷；据吉德拉尔学者扎法尔·阿里·贝格记载，他还控制着巴什加尔的数个山谷，势力强于北部卡拉什首领布拉辛。约1320年，赖斯王朝的建立者沙阿·纳迪尔·赖斯杀死布拉辛、攻占上吉德拉尔，随后也进犯克利兹努克的领地，却始终未能将其征服。

en: Guido della Torre (27 September 1259 – summer 1312) was the Guelph lord of Milan from 1302 to 1312. After his father was killed in the Visconti victory at Desio in 1277, he was captured with his uncle Napoleone and spent seven years imprisoned in the Baradello castle near Como before escaping in 1284 with the help of the lord of Como and the marquess of Montferrat. He became podestà of Treviso in 1287. In 1302 a Guelph coalition drove the Visconti from Milan, ending twenty-five years of exile, and in 1307 he became capitano del popolo, then perpetual captain in 1308. After a failed rising against Emperor Henry VII in 1311, he fled to Cremona, where he died.
zh: 圭多·德拉·托雷（1259年9月27日—1312年夏）是1302至1312年间的米兰圭尔夫派领主。1277年维斯孔蒂家族在代西奥战役中取胜，他的父亲战死，他与叔父纳波莱奥内一同被俘，在科莫附近的巴拉德罗城堡被囚禁七年，1284年在科莫领主和蒙费拉托侯爵帮助下逃脱。1287年他出任特雷维索执政官。1302年，圭尔夫联盟将维斯孔蒂家族逐出米兰，结束了他二十五年的流亡；1307年他出任人民领袖，1308年成为终身人民领袖。1311年反抗皇帝亨利七世失败后，他逃往克雷莫纳，并在该地去世。

en: Božidar Šubić, also called Deodat, was a son of the Croatian nobleman George II Šubić of Bribir and count of Bribir from 1345 to 1347; he died in 1348.
zh: 博日达尔·舒比奇，又称戴奥德，是克罗地亚贵族尤拉伊二世·舒比奇之子，1345至1347年任布里比尔伯爵，1348年去世。

en: Elizabeth Frankopan was a daughter of Count Duym of Krk and the wife of Paul II Šubić of Bribir, Croatian count of Ostrovica. Her son George III Šubić became the first of the Zrinski counts.
zh: 伊丽莎白·弗兰科潘是克尔克伯爵杜伊姆之女、奥斯特罗维察伯爵帕瓦奥二世·舒比奇之妻；她的儿子尤拉伊三世·舒比奇是第一代兹林斯基伯爵。

en: Gregory V Šubić of Bribir (Grgur, c. 1300–c. 1374) was a son of Ban Paul I Šubić and brother of Mladen II, George II and Paul II. In 1312 he received Šibenik and the family seat of Bribir, and he later held the counties of Bužani and Rab. Appointed guardian of his underage nephew George III after Paul II's death in 1346, he in 1347 surrendered Ostrovica and the county of Luka to King Louis I, receiving in exchange the fortress of Zrin and its neighbourhood. He settled at Zrin with his nephew, founding the Zrinski branch.
zh: 格尔古尔五世·舒比奇（约1300—约1374）是克罗地亚班帕瓦奥一世之子，姆拉登二世、尤拉伊二世和帕瓦奥二世的兄弟。1312年他分得希贝尼克和家族旧地布里比尔，后来又领有布扎尼和拉布伯国。1346年帕瓦奥二世去世后，他被指定为年幼侄子尤拉伊三世的监护人；1347年，他以奥斯特罗维察和卢卡县向匈牙利国王拉约什一世换取兹林要塞及周边土地，与侄子迁居兹林，开创了兹林斯基支系。

en: George II Šubić of Bribir (c. 1290–1328) was a Croatian magnate, the second son of Ban Paul I Šubić. First attested as count of Split in 1300, he inherited his uncle's Dalmatian towns in 1303 and in 1315 issued privileges regulating Omiš piracy. When his brother Mladen II fell in 1322, George became head of the Šubić clan. His forces were defeated near Knin in 1324, and Duke Nelipac captured him some time after the battle; his wife Lelka held his lands until his release in 1326. He died at Klis on 15 December 1328. His daughter Jelena was the mother of King Tvrtko I of Bosnia.
zh: 布里比尔的尤拉伊二世·舒比奇（约1290—1328）是克罗地亚大贵族，巴昂保罗一世·舒比奇的次子。他1300年首次见于记载，身份为斯普利特伯爵，1303年继承叔父的达尔马提亚诸城，1315年颁布特许状规范奥米什的海盗活动。1322年其兄姆拉登二世倒台后，尤拉伊成为舒比奇家族首领。1324年，他的一方在克宁附近战败，战后一段时间他被内利帕茨公爵俘虏；妻子莱尔卡为他守住领地，直至他1326年获释。1328年12月15日，他卒于克利斯。女儿耶莱娜是波斯尼亚国王特夫尔特科一世的母亲。

en: George I Zrinski, also numbered George III Šubić of Bribir (c. 1330–1361), was a Croatian count and the founder of the Zrinski family. He was the son of Paul II Šubić, count of Trogir and Ostrovica, and Elizabeth Frankopan of Krk. Still underage at his father's death in 1346, he and his guardian, his uncle Gregory, in 1347 gave Ostrovica and the county of Luka to King Louis I and received instead the fortress of Zrin with neighbouring estates; he was the first of his line to call himself Zrinski, and was succeeded by his son Paul I.
zh: 尤拉伊一世·兹林斯基，在舒比奇家族中排行尤拉伊三世（约1330—1361），是克罗地亚伯爵、兹林斯基家族的始祖，特罗吉尔和奥斯特罗维察伯爵帕瓦奥二世·舒比奇与克尔克的伊丽莎白·弗兰科潘之子。1346年父亲去世时他尚未成年，由叔父格尔古尔监护；1347年，二人以奥斯特罗维察和卢卡县向匈牙利国王拉约什一世换取兹林要塞及周边地产。他是家族中第一个以兹林斯基为姓的人，死后由儿子帕瓦奥一世继位。

en: Catherine Šubić was a daughter of the Croatian count Paul II Šubić of Bribir and Elizabeth Frankopan of Krk, sister of the first Zrinski count George III and of Pribko. She became a nun.
zh: 卡塔琳娜·舒比奇是克罗地亚伯爵帕瓦奥二世·舒比奇与克尔克的伊丽莎白·弗兰科潘之女，第一代兹林斯基伯爵尤拉伊三世和普里布科的姐妹，后成为修女。

en: Charles Martel of Anjou (1271–1295) was the eldest son of Charles II of Naples and Maria of Hungary. After his maternal uncle Ladislaus IV was killed in 1290, Pope Nicholas IV backed him as titular King of Hungary against Andrew III of the Árpád dynasty. Charles Martel won recognition in Croatia but never ruled Hungary itself. He was personally acquainted with Dante, who later portrayed a meeting with his spirit in the Heaven of Venus in the Divine Comedy. By his wife Clemence of Habsburg, daughter of King Rudolph I of Germany, he left a son, Charles Robert, who later won the Hungarian crown as Charles I, and a daughter Clementia who married Louis X of France. He died of plague at Naples in August 1295.
zh: 安茹的卡洛·马特罗（1271—1295）是那不勒斯国王卡洛二世与匈牙利的玛丽亚的长子。1290年舅父拉斯洛四世遇刺后，教皇尼古拉四世支持他为名义上的匈牙利国王，与阿尔帕德王朝的安德拉什三世对抗。卡洛·马特罗在克罗地亚获得承认，却始终未能统治匈牙利本土。他与但丁相识，但丁后来在《神曲》中写到在金星天与他的灵魂相会。他的妻子哈布斯堡的克莱芒丝是德意志国王鲁道夫一世之女，二人的儿子卡罗伊·罗伯特后来夺得匈牙利王位，称卡罗伊一世；女儿克莱门西娅嫁给法王路易十世。1295年8月，他在那不勒斯死于瘟疫。

en: Mladen III Šubić (c. 1315–1348) was a grandson of Pavao I, the most powerful Croatian noble at the turn of the fourteenth century, and by his time almost the last man left to defend the family. From Klis Fortress he held Klis, Omiš and Skradin. His mother Lelka controlled the lands until he came of age in 1332. He fought the coalition of Split, Trogir and Šibenik under Venice and the nobles led by Ivan Nelipić, forcing the return of Ostrovica in 1335, and by 1344 was the chief opponent of the Hungarian king. Against Louis I he allied with Bosnia in 1338, sealed by his sister Jelena's marriage to Vladislav Kotromanić, and in 1347 married Jelena Nemanjić, half-sister of Serbia's Stefan Dušan. In 1348 he took the title Marquess of Slavonia, aiming to end Louis's rule over the rest of Croatia, but plague killed him that May. He was buried in Trogir Cathedral, where his epitaph called him the Shield of the Croats.
zh: 姆拉登三世·舒比奇（约1315—1348年）是帕沃一世的孙子，后者是13、14世纪之交克罗地亚最有权势的贵族；到他这一代，家族几乎只剩他一人撑持。他以克利斯要塞为中心，统治克利斯、奥米什和斯克拉丁。母亲莱尔卡在他1332年成年之前掌管领地。他击败了威尼斯支持下的斯普利特、特罗吉尔、希贝尼克三城联军和伊万·内利皮奇率领的贵族，1335年迫使对方归还奥斯特罗维察，到1344年已是匈牙利国王的主要对手。为对抗拉约什一世，他于1338年与波斯尼亚结盟，并让妹妹耶莱娜嫁给弗拉迪斯拉夫·科特罗曼尼奇以巩固盟约；1347年迎娶塞尔维亚斯特凡·杜尚的异母妹埃列娜·尼曼伊奇。1348年他起用斯拉沃尼亚侯爵称号，意在推翻拉约什对克罗地亚其余地区的统治，却在当年5月死于瘟疫。他葬于特罗吉尔主教座堂，墓志称他为‘克罗地亚人之盾’。

en: Paul II Šubić of Bribir (c. 1295–1346) was the third son of Paul I Šubić, Ban of Croatia. Recorded from 1301 as a prince of Tropolje, he later held Trogir and Skradin as his counties. He joined Croatian nobles in rebelling against his eldest brother Mladen II, defeated at Bliska in 1322, and afterwards supported his brother George II and nephew Mladen III against Duke Nelipac II, receiving Ostrovica for his aid. He died there in August 1346, leaving the fortress to his underage son George III, ancestor of the Zrinski counts, under the guardianship of his brother Gregory.
zh: 帕瓦奥二世·舒比奇（约1295—1346）是克罗地亚班帕瓦奥一世·舒比奇的第三子。1301年的史籍已提到他与兄弟同为特罗波利耶伯爵，后来他领有特罗吉尔和斯克拉丁。他联合克罗地亚贵族反叛长兄姆拉登二世，后者于1322年在布利斯卡之役战败；此后他支持兄长尤拉伊二世，又支持侄子姆拉登三世对抗内利帕茨二世公爵，因功得到奥斯特罗维察。1346年8月他在该地去世，把城堡留给幼子尤拉伊三世——兹林斯基伯爵家族的祖先，并指定弟弟格尔古尔为监护人。

en: Paul III Šubić of Bribir (died 1356) was a Croatian nobleman, son of George II Šubić and husband of the Venetian Catherine Dandolo, who was probably buried in the cathedral of St Lawrence at Trogir.
zh: 帕瓦奥三世·舒比奇（1356年卒）是克罗地亚贵族，尤拉伊二世·舒比奇之子，娶威尼斯女子卡塔琳娜·丹多洛为妻，可能葬于特罗吉尔的圣劳伦斯大教堂。

en: Pribko Šubić was a son of the Croatian count Paul II Šubić of Bribir and his wife Elizabeth Frankopan of Krk, and a brother of George III Šubić, the first Zrinski count.
zh: 普里布科·舒比奇是克罗地亚伯爵帕瓦奥二世·舒比奇与妻子、克尔克的伊丽莎白·弗兰科潘之子，第一代兹林斯基伯爵尤拉伊三世的兄弟。

en: Agnese di Valperga was a Piedmontese noblewoman of the Valperga family of the Canavese who became the wife of Antonio del Carretto, marquess of Finale, and mother of his successor Giorgio and of Antonio, who founded the family's Sicilian branch.
zh: 阿格内塞·迪·瓦尔佩加是出身卡纳韦塞瓦尔佩加家族的皮埃蒙特贵族女子，嫁给菲纳莱侯爵安东尼奥·德尔·卡雷托，是继承人乔治和安东尼奥的母亲，后者开创了德尔·卡雷托家族的西西里支系。

en: Antonio I del Carretto (1260–1313), marquess of Finale, was the son of Giacomo del Carretto and Caterina da Marano, Frederick II's natural daughter. As a minor under Nicola Doria's tutelage he divided the lands with his brothers, keeping Finale, Calizzano and Bardineto. A Ghibelline, he helped Conradin cross Liguria in 1268 and made peace with Charles of Anjou in 1270. His refusal in 1280 to swear the oath to Genoa opened his margraviate's war with the republic, to which he submitted in 1292. He fought Asti in 1293, issued statutes for Finale in 1311, and died in 1313.
zh: 安东尼奥一世·德尔·卡雷托（1260—1313）是菲纳莱侯爵，贾科莫·德尔·卡雷托与腓特烈二世私生女卡泰丽娜·达·马拉诺之子。他幼年继位，由尼古拉·多里亚监护，与诸弟瓜分领地，自己领有菲纳莱、卡利扎诺和巴尔迪内托。他与父亲一样是吉伯林派，1268年协助科拉迪诺取道利古里亚，1270年与安茹的查理议和。1280年，他拒绝按惯例向热那亚宣誓，引发侯国与共和国的长期冲突，直到1292年才臣服。1293年他对阿斯蒂作战，1311年为菲纳莱颁布成文法令，1313年去世。

en: Antonio II del Carretto (1284–1321), younger son of the marquess of Finale Antonio del Carretto and Leonora Fieschi, settled in Sicily early in the fourteenth century. His family was among the leading Ghibellines of northern Italy. In 1307 he married Costanza Chiaromonte, daughter of Federico Chiaromonte, baron of Racalmuto and a leader of the Sicilian Ghibellines. Through her he held the baronies of Calatabiano and Siculiana; Racalmuto passed to his wife in 1313 and later to their son. He drew little profit from his claims to Finale, then caught in Genoese internal struggles, and died in Palermo in 1321, leaving a Sicilian line that lasted until the eighteenth century.
zh: 安东尼奥二世·德尔·卡雷托（1284—1321）是菲纳莱侯爵安东尼奥与莱奥诺拉·菲耶斯基的幼子，14世纪初迁居西西里。他的家族是北意大利主要的吉伯林派家族之一。1307年，他迎娶拉卡尔穆托男爵、西西里吉伯林派领袖费德里科·基亚罗蒙特之女科斯坦扎·迪·基亚罗蒙特，凭借她领有卡拉塔比亚诺和锡库利亚纳男爵领；拉卡尔穆托于1313年归妻子所有，后来传给他们的儿子。他对菲纳莱的继承权所获甚微，当时菲纳莱卷入热那亚的内部斗争；他于1321年卒于巴勒莫，留下的西西里支系一直延续到18世纪。

en: Beatrice del Monferrato (c. 1142–1228), daughter of William V, Marquess of Montferrat, and Judith of Babenberg, married in 1155 Guigues V, Dauphin of the Viennois and Count of Albon, who died at Vizille in 1162. Around 1165 her cousin Frederick Barbarossa gave the widow to Enrico I del Carretto, called il Guercio, marquess of Savona; their children included Ottone and Enrico II. Widowed again in 1185, she returned to Montferrat, where around 1197 the troubadour Raimbaut de Vaqueiras loved her and made her the subject of several songs. She died in 1228 and was buried at Grenoble Cathedral.
zh: 贝亚特丽切·迪·蒙费拉托（约1142—1228）是蒙费拉托侯爵威廉五世与巴本贝格的尤蒂特之女、腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的表亲。1155年，她嫁给维埃纳王太子、阿尔邦伯爵吉格五世，丈夫1162年卒于维济耶。约1165年，巴巴罗萨把寡居的贝亚特丽切许配给萨沃纳侯爵、绰号‘圭尔乔’的恩里科一世·德尔·卡雷托，她为他生下奥托内和恩里科二世。1185年再度丧夫后她回到蒙费拉托，约1197年游吟诗人兰博·德·瓦凯拉斯对她倾心，为她写下多首歌曲。她于1228年去世，葬于格勒诺布尔主教座堂。

en: Carlo I del Carretto was a son of Giorgio del Carretto and founder of the Zuccarello branch of his house. Under doge Antoniotto Adorno's family settlement of 1385, confirmed when he ceded his share of Finale to his brother Lazzarino I in 1390, Carlo kept the Clavesana lands around Zuccarello. A close ally of Gian Galeazzo Visconti, duke of Milan, he was in 1397 invested as the first marquis of Zuccarello. By Pomellina Adorno he fathered Ilaria, born in 1379, who in 1403 married Paolo Guinigi of Lucca; her tomb there was carved by Jacopo della Quercia.
zh: 卡洛一世·德尔·卡雷托是乔治·德尔·卡雷托之子，德尔·卡雷托家族祖卡雷洛支系的始祖。在1385年热那亚总督安托尼奥托·阿多尔诺主持的家族分割仲裁中，以及1390年他把自己在菲纳莱的份额让给兄长拉扎里诺一世之后，卡洛保留了祖卡雷洛一带的克拉韦萨纳遗产。作为米兰公爵吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂的亲密盟友，他于1397年获封，成为第一代祖卡雷洛侯爵。他娶波梅利娜·阿多尔诺，女儿伊拉里亚于1379年出生，1403年嫁给卢卡领主保罗·圭尼吉，其在卢卡的陵墓由雅各布·德拉·奎尔恰雕刻。

en: Costanza Chiaramonte was the only daughter of Federico Chiaramonte, lord of Sutera, and sister of Manfredi I, Count of Modica. In 1296 her father received the barony of Siculiana from King Frederick III of Sicily and built the Castello di Chiaramonte there; on his death in 1311 she inherited the barony. She first married Antonio del Carretto, margrave of Finale, who held Calatabiano, Siculiana and Racalmuto through her. Widowed, she married the Genoese nobleman Brancaleone Doria, appointed governor of Sardinia in 1335. Her son Antonio del Carretto Chiaramonte later inherited Siculiana.
zh: 科斯坦扎·迪·基亚罗蒙特是苏泰拉领主费德里科·基亚罗蒙特的独女、莫迪卡伯爵曼弗雷迪一世的姐妹。1296年，父亲从西西里国王费德里科三世手中受封锡库利亚纳男爵领，并在当地修建基亚罗蒙特城堡；1311年父亲去世后，她继承了该男爵领。她先嫁菲纳莱侯爵安东尼奥·德尔卡雷托，后者凭借她领有卡拉塔比亚诺、锡库利亚纳和拉卡尔穆托；丧夫后改嫁热那亚贵族布兰卡莱奥内·多里亚，此人于1335年被任命为撒丁岛总督。她的儿子安东尼奥·德尔卡雷托·基亚罗蒙特后来继承了锡库利亚纳。

en: Enrichetto del Carretto, or Enrico di Calizzano, was a son of the marquis Giorgio del Carretto. He died before 1385, when doge Antoniotto Adorno's arbitration led Genoa to grant its share of Finale to his son Giorgino and his brothers Lazzarino and Carlo.
zh: 恩里凯托·德尔·卡雷托，又称恩里科·迪·卡利扎诺，是菲纳莱侯爵乔治之子。他在1385年前去世；总督安托尼奥托·阿多尔诺的仲裁使热那亚将其所得菲纳莱份额授予他的儿子乔治诺及他的兄弟拉扎里诺和卡洛。

en: Enrico I del Carretto, also called il Guercio (died 1185), was a nobleman of the Aleramici dynasty and marquess of Savona, the fifth son of Bonifacio del Vasto. He earned his nickname on the Second Crusade and later fought alongside Frederick Barbarossa, who in 1162 confirmed his fiefs around Savona, Noli and Finale and his lands in the Langhe. As the communes of Savona and Noli gained autonomy, Enrico consolidated his family's remaining position at Finale. As imperial chancellor he negotiated the Peace of Constance with the Lombard League in 1183. He founded the hospital of Santa Maria e San Lazzaro at Cosseria in 1179, and from his son Ottone sprang the del Carretto line, which later made Finalborgo its seat.
zh: 恩里科一世·德尔·卡雷托（卒于1185年），绰号‘圭尔乔’，是阿莱拉米奇家族贵族、萨沃纳侯爵，博尼法乔·德尔·瓦斯托的第五子。他在第二次十字军东征中得到了绰号，后来随腓特烈·巴巴罗萨作战，后者于1162年确认了他在萨沃纳、诺利和菲纳莱一带的封地及朗格地区的领地。随着萨沃纳和诺利公社逐渐获得自治，恩里科巩固了家族在菲纳莱的剩余势力。作为皇帝的宰相，他于1183年与伦巴第同盟谈判达成《康斯坦茨和约》。1179年，他在科塞里亚创立圣马利亚与圣拉撒路医院；其子奥托内一支发展为德尔·卡雷托家族，后来以菲纳尔博尔戈为治所。

en: Enrico II del Carretto (c. 1170–1231), marquess of Savona, was the second son of Enrico il Guercio and Beatrice del Monferrat. Succeeding around 1185, he divided the family lands with his brother Ottone, taking the western portion from Finale towards Alba. In 1188 he founded the Burgus Finarii, later Finalborgo, and by 1196 had sold his lordship over Noli. He married Simona Guercio and then Agata of Geneva. He backed Otto IV before siding with Frederick II, who in 1226 confirmed his rights to the march, but defeat at Savona in 1227 forced him to swear fealty to Genoa.
zh: 恩里科二世·德尔·卡雷托（约1170—1231）是萨沃纳侯爵，‘圭尔乔’恩里科一世与蒙费拉托的贝亚特丽切的次子。约1185年继位后，他与兄长奥托内瓜分家族领地，取得从菲纳莱伸向阿尔巴的西部地带。1188年他兴建后来的菲纳尔博尔戈堡镇，并在1188至1196年间出售对诺利的领主权。他先后迎娶西莫娜·圭尔乔与日内瓦的阿加塔。他先支持奥托四世，后倒向腓特烈二世，后者于1226年确认他对侯爵领地的权利；1227年萨沃纳战败后，他被迫向热那亚宣誓效忠。

en: Giacomo del Carretto (c. 1215–1268) was marquess of Finale, succeeding his father Enrico II around 1233. A loyal Ghibelline of his kinsman Frederick II, he fought Genoa at the sieges of Segno and Noli in 1241 and led the defence of Savona in 1243. In 1247 he married Caterina da Marano, a natural daughter of Frederick II, and became imperial vicar in the region north of Asti. After the emperor's death he made peace with Genoa at Varazze in 1251, surrendering Segno but keeping Finale. In 1256 he was entrusted with negotiating the release of Thomas II of Savoy, which he secured in February 1257. His lands were divided among his sons in 1268.
zh: 贾科莫·德尔·卡雷托（约1215—1268年）是菲纳莱侯爵，约1233年继其父恩里科二世之位。作为亲属腓特烈二世的忠实吉伯林派，他在1241年的塞尼奥和诺利围城战中与热那亚作战，1243年指挥萨沃纳保卫战。1247年，他迎娶腓特烈二世的私生女卡泰丽娜·达·马拉诺，并成为阿斯蒂以北地区的帝国代理人。皇帝死后，他于1251年在瓦拉泽与热那亚议和，交出塞尼奥但保住了菲纳莱。1256年，他受托谈判释放萨伏依的托马索二世，并于1257年2月促成其获释。他死后，领地于1268年由诸子瓜分。

en: Giorgio del Carretto (1280–c. 1359) was marquis of Finale in Liguria, eldest son of Antonio del Carretto. A leader of the Ghibelline exiles, he reduced the Guelph stronghold of Noli in February 1322 and in 1324 signed a commercial treaty with Savona. After he ravaged the territory of Albenga in 1341, the Genoese doge Simone Boccanegra seized him under a safe conduct and confined him in a wooden cage until his escape at Christmas 1344. He made peace with Genoa in 1345, joined its Corsica expedition in 1347, and received imperial investiture from Charles IV in 1355.
zh: 乔治·德尔·卡雷托（1280—约1359）是利古里亚的菲纳莱侯爵，安东尼奥·德尔·卡雷托的长子。作为流亡的皇帝派领袖，他于1322年2月攻克教皇派据点诺利，1324年与萨沃纳签订商约。1341年他劫掠阿尔本加一带后，热那亚总督西蒙尼·波卡内格拉背信将他拘捕，关入木笼，直到1344年圣诞节他才越狱逃脱。1345年他与热那亚议和，1347年参加热那亚远征科西嘉，1355年获皇帝查理四世正式封授领地。

en: Lazzarino I del Carretto (died 1392), son of Giorgio del Carretto, inherited the marquisate of Finale and its long feud with Genoa. On 21 March 1385 Genoa demanded he do vassal homage; he refused, invoking his house's imperial investitures of 1162, 1226 and 1355. On 20 April doge Antoniotto Adorno's troops occupied Finale and forced him to swear fealty. In 1390 his brother Carlo ceded him his share, and Lazzarino lifted old bans on settling by the coast. By his kinswoman Marietta del Carretto he left a successor, Lazzarino II.
zh: 拉扎里诺一世·德尔·卡雷托（卒于1392年）是乔治·德尔·卡雷托之子，继承了菲纳莱侯国以及与热那亚的世仇。1385年3月21日，热那亚共和国要求他行封臣效忠礼，他援引家族于1162年、1226年和1355年获得的皇帝授封予以拒绝。4月20日，总督安托尼奥托·阿多尔诺的军队占领菲纳莱，迫使他宣誓效忠。1390年，弟弟卡洛把自己的份额让给他，拉扎里诺还废除了早先禁止在海边定居的法令。他娶亲属玛丽埃塔·德尔·卡雷托，继承人是儿子拉扎里诺二世。

en: Albertino Morosini (c. 1240–1305) was a Venetian nobleman and statesman. As Count of Zara from 1274 to 1276, he promoted agricultural reform and the cultivation of abandoned land. While serving as bailo in Acre in 1277–1278, he concluded a treaty with Tyre restoring Venetian privileges there. As podestà of Pisa he commanded its fleet against Genoa and was wounded and captured at the Battle of Meloria in 1284. He became Duke of Crete in 1287, facing the revolt of Alexios Kallergis. After his nephew Andrew III became king of Hungary in 1290, Morosini was made Duke of Slavonia and Count of Požega in 1297. He returned to Venice after Andrew's death in 1301 and died there in 1305.
zh: 阿尔贝蒂诺·莫罗西尼（约1240—1305年）是威尼斯贵族与政治家。1274至1276年担任扎拉伯爵时，他推行农业改革，鼓励耕种荒地。1277至1278年任威尼斯驻阿卡代表期间，他与提尔签订条约，恢复威尼斯人在当地的特权。担任比萨执政官时，他率比萨舰队与热那亚作战，1284年在梅洛里亚海战中负伤被俘。1287年他出任干地亚公爵，任内面对阿莱克修斯·卡莱尔吉斯起义。1290年他的外甥安德拉什三世成为匈牙利国王后，莫罗西尼于1297年受封斯拉沃尼亚公爵兼波热加伯爵。1301年安德拉什三世去世后，他返回威尼斯并于1305年在该地去世。

en: Cirillo Venier was a member of the Venier family on Crete. The Venetian chronicler Caroldo recorded that he was beheaded at Candia on 26 July 1364, in the aftermath of the revolt of Saint Titus.
zh: 奇里洛·韦涅尔是克里特韦涅尔家族的一员。威尼斯编年史家卡罗尔多记载，圣提多叛乱后，他于1364年7月26日在干地亚被斩首。

en: Giovanni Morosini was a Venetian nobleman of the Morosini family who served the Republic of Venice as Duke of Crete (Duke of Candia) from 1327 to 1329.
zh: 乔瓦尼·莫罗西尼是莫罗西尼家族的威尼斯贵族，1327至1329年代表威尼斯共和国出任克里特公爵（干地亚公爵）。

en: Iacopo II Barozzi (died 1308) was a Venetian colonial administrator and the first Barozzi lord of Santorini. He was rector of Chania in Crete, Bailo of Negroponte from 1295 to 1297, and Duke of Candia from 1301 to 1303. Venice's 1302 treaty with Emperor Andronikos II recognized his seizure of Santorini and Thirasia, and he acknowledged only the Republic as his suzerain. William I Sanudo, Duke of Naxos, captured him in transit, until Venice's Great Council forced his release. Barozzi temporarily occupied Nisyros in 1306, retired to Candia in 1308, and died there.
