zh: 雅各波二世·巴罗齐（1308年卒）是威尼斯殖民地官员，也是巴罗齐家族的第一位圣托里尼领主。他曾任克里特的哈尼亚长官，1295至1297年任内格罗蓬特的威尼斯长官，1301至1303年任干地亚公爵。1302年威尼斯与皇帝安德洛尼卡二世签订的条约承认他占取圣托里尼和锡拉夏岛，他只承认威尼斯为宗主。纳克索斯公爵威廉一世·萨努多在他途经时将其拘捕，威尼斯大议事会出面迫使对方放人。巴罗齐于1306年短暂占据尼西罗斯岛，1308年退居干地亚并于同年去世。

en: Marco Venier (died 1311) was a Venetian noble of the Venier family and Lord of Cerigo, the island of Kythera off the southern Greek coast. He was the son of Bartolomeo Venier and of a daughter of Nikolaos Evdaimogiannis, the Greek lord of Kythera. In 1310 the Venetians and the Venier clan, allied with the local Evdaimogiannis family, retook the island, which Byzantium had held since 1269. Marco died the following year, in 1311. His son Pietro Venier continued the line of Cerigo governors.
zh: 马尔科·韦涅尔（1311年卒）是威尼斯韦涅尔家族贵族，切里戈（希腊南端外海的基西拉岛）领主。他是巴尔托洛梅奥·韦涅尔与基西拉希腊人领主尼古劳斯·埃夫代莫吉安尼斯之女所生之子。1310年，威尼斯人与韦涅尔家族联合当地的埃夫代莫吉安尼斯家族，夺回了自1269年起被拜占庭占据的该岛。马尔科于次年，即1311年去世。其子彼得罗·韦涅尔延续了切里戈统治者一系。

en: Marino Badoer was a Venetian nobleman of the Badoer family who served as Duke of Crete (Duke of Candia) from 1313 to 1315.
zh: 马里诺·巴多埃尔是巴多埃尔家族的威尼斯贵族，1313至1315年出任克里特公爵（干地亚公爵）。

en: Marino Morosini was a Venetian nobleman of the Morosini family who served the Republic of Venice as Duke of Crete (Duke of Candia) from 1274 to 1276.
zh: 马里诺·莫罗西尼是莫罗西尼家族的威尼斯贵族，1274至1276年代表威尼斯共和国出任克里特公爵（干地亚公爵）。

en: Mario Morosini was a Venetian nobleman of the Morosini family who served as Duke of Candia, the Republic of Venice's governor on Crete, from 1329 to 1331.
zh: 马里奥·莫罗西尼出身威尼斯贵族莫罗西尼家族，于1329至1331年担任干地亚公爵，即威尼斯共和国驻克里特岛的总督。

en: Michel Vitali was a Venetian nobleman who served as Duke of Crete (Duke of Candia) for the Republic in 1299. On 28 April 1299 he signed the Peace of Alexios Kallergis with the leaders of the great Cretan rebellion that had broken out in 1282. Its thirty-three articles proclaimed a general amnesty, restored confiscated lands and privileges, granted the rebel leaders a two-year tax exemption, recognized the courts they had set up, and lifted the ban on mixed Cretan–Venetian marriages. The treaty ended seventeen years of war and left Alexios Kallergis as the recognized head of the Orthodox Cretans.
zh: 米凯莱·维塔利是威尼斯贵族，1299年代表威尼斯共和国出任克里特公爵（干地亚公爵）。1299年4月28日，他与1282年爆发的克里特大起义的首领签订“阿历克塞奥斯·卡列尔吉斯和约”。和约共33条，宣布大赦，归还被没收的土地与特权，给予起义首领两年免税，承认他们在起义期间设立的法庭，并解除克里特人与威尼斯人通婚的禁令。条约结束了长达17年的战争，阿历克塞奥斯·卡列尔吉斯由此成为正教克里特人公认的领袖。

en: Nicolò Zani was a Venetian nobleman of the Zani (Zane) family who served the Republic of Venice as Duke of Crete (Duke of Candia) in 1317.
zh: 尼科洛·扎尼是扎尼（扎内）家族的威尼斯贵族，1317年代表威尼斯共和国出任克里特公爵（干地亚公爵）。

en: Tito Venier was a Venetian feudatory on Crete and a leader of the 1363 Revolt of Saint Titus, the first Cretan rising in which Venice's own Latin colonists took part. When the Senate pressed new taxes on the island in August 1363, the Venier and Gradenigo families stood at the head of the feudatories, who arrested the Duke of Candia, Leonardo Dandolo, made Marco Gradenigo governor, set up the Commune of Crete and raised the banner of Saint Titus, the island's patron. Venice answered with an army under Luchino dal Verme, which retook Candia in May 1364. Tito and his brother Teodorello were among the proscribed rebels who renewed the rising in western Crete that August. When the other Venetian rebel chiefs were captured and tortured to death after the famine of 1365, Tito alone escaped by leaving the island.
zh: 蒂托·韦涅尔是克里特岛上的威尼斯封臣，也是1363年圣提多起义的领袖之一，这是克里特岛上第一次有威尼斯自己的拉丁殖民者参加的起义。1363年8月，元老院向该岛加征新税，韦涅尔与格拉德尼戈两家站在封臣的前列。封臣们逮捕干地亚公爵莱奥纳尔多·丹多洛，推举马尔科·格拉德尼戈为总督，建立克里特公社，并举起岛上主保圣人圣提多的旗帜。威尼斯派出卢基诺·达尔·韦尔梅率领的军队，1364年5月收复干地亚。蒂托与兄弟泰奥多雷洛作为被通缉的叛乱者，于当年8月在克里特西部重新起事。1365年饥荒过后，其余威尼斯叛党首领均被捕并处以酷刑而死，唯有蒂托离岛逃脱。

en: Teodorello Venier was a Venetian feudal noble on Crete and brother of Tito Venier. In 1363 he was among the leaders of the revolt of Saint Titus against Venice, which overthrew the island's government and set up the rebel Republic of Saint Titus. After a Venetian army under Luchino dal Verme retook Candia in May 1364, Teodorello and Tito carried on the rising from western Crete. The last rebel leaders were taken through treason and killed in 1366; only Tito escaped the island.
zh: 泰奥多雷洛·韦涅尔是克里特的威尼斯封建贵族，蒂托·韦涅尔的兄弟。1363年，他是反对威尼斯的圣提多叛乱首领之一；叛军推翻岛上政府，建立圣提多共和国。1364年5月，卢基诺·达尔韦尔梅率领威尼斯军队收复干地亚后，泰奥多雷洛与蒂托在克里特西部继续抵抗。1366年，最后的叛乱首领被出卖抓获并处死，只有蒂托逃离该岛。

en: Viago Zeno was a Venetian noble of the Zeno family who served as Duke of Crete (Candia), the Republic's governor of the island, in 1333. In 1333 he ordered new taxes to build more galleys against the piracy and raiding spreading along the Cretan coasts. The exactions broke the Peace of Alexios Kallergis of 1299: protest began at Mylopotamos, and by September 1333 western Crete had risen under Vardas Kallergis. With the help of Cretan allies the Venetians suppressed the uprising in 1334; its leaders were executed and their families exiled.
zh: 维亚戈·泽诺是威尼斯泽诺家族的贵族，1333年出任威尼斯领地克里特（干地亚）的总督。1333年，为应对克里特沿海日益猖獗的海盗劫掠，他下令加征新税，以建造更多桨帆船。此举打破了1299年的“阿历克塞奥斯·卡列尔吉斯和约”：米洛波塔莫斯首先爆发抗议，到1333年9月，瓦尔达斯·卡列尔吉斯领导的起义已蔓延至克里特西部。凭借克里特本地盟友的协助，威尼斯于1334年镇压起义，首领被处决，其家族遭流放。

en: Li Siqi (1323–1374) was a Yuan warlord from Luoshan in Henan who ruled Shaanxi. He raised militia with Chaghan Temur against the Red Turbans, and after clearing Shaanxi of rebels in 1357 built his own power base there. After Chaghan's death in 1362, Li refused orders to obey his son Köke Temür and joined former supporters of Bolad Temür against him, holding Chang'an against Köke's attacks. The Yuan court named him Duke of Xu in 1365. He surrendered to the Ming in 1369 and took a senior post. The Hongwu Emperor later sent him to win over Köke Temür; Köke's horsemen demanded an arm as a parting gift, and Li Siqi died of the wound in 1374.
zh: 李思齐（1323—1374），河南罗山人，是元末据有陕西的军阀。他起初与察罕帖木儿组织武装镇压红巾军，1357年协同把红巾军逐出陕西后，便在当地建立自己的势力。1362年察罕帖木儿死后，李思齐拒绝服从其子扩廓帖木儿，联合孛罗帖木儿旧部与之对抗，固守长安，数次击退扩廓的进攻。1365年，元廷封他为许国公。1369年他投降明朝，受任高职。后来洪武帝派他去招降扩廓帖木儿，对方的骑兵要他留下一只手臂作为告别之物；李思齐断臂交给骑士，回去不久便在1374年因伤重而死。

en: Liu Futong (1321–1363) was the dominant leader of the Northern Red Turbans in the late Yuan uprisings. In 1351 he and White Lotus preacher Han Shantong rebelled among Yellow River labourers, many of whom Liu recruited after they were mobilized to redirect the river. After Han was executed, Liu fought on and in 1355 installed Han's son Han Lin'er at Bozhou as emperor of a restored Song. Han's claim helped unite the northern rebels. Liu's men took the old Song capital Kaifeng in 1358 and sent Mao Gui raiding toward the Yuan capital Dadu. Yuan forces under Chaghan Temur retook Kaifeng in 1359, forcing Liu back to Anfeng. In 1363 Zhang Shicheng's troops captured Anfeng and killed him; Zhu Yuanzhang rescued Han Lin'er.
zh: 刘福通（1321—1363）是元末北方红巾军的主要领袖。1351年，他与白莲教首领韩山童起兵，招募了许多被征发治理黄河的民夫。韩山童被捕杀后，刘福通继续率部作战，于1355年在亳州拥立韩山童之子韩林儿为帝，国号宋。韩林儿的帝号有助于凝聚北方红巾军。1358年，刘福通攻取北宋故都汴梁，并派毛贵北上，兵锋逼近元朝都城大都。1359年，元将察罕帖木儿反攻夺回汴梁，刘福通退守安丰。1363年，张士诚所部攻破安丰，刘福通被杀；朱元璋救出了韩林儿。

en: Han Lin'er (1339–1367), son of the executed White Lotus rebel Han Shantong, was the nominal emperor of the late-Yuan Red Turban movement. After his father's arrest he went into hiding. In 1355 Liu Futong enthroned him as emperor of a restored Song, with the reign title Longfeng and the style Young King of Ming. Liu held power at his court, while Song forces extended their reach across much of the North China Plain. Red Turban forces seized Kaifeng as their capital in 1358 but lost it in 1359. In 1363 Zhu Yuanzhang rescued him from the siege of Anfeng and installed him at Chuzhou. In 1367, while being escorted to Zhu's domains, he drowned crossing the Yangtze at Guabu, perhaps murdered on Zhu's orders.
zh: 韩林儿（1339—1367）是元末红巾军拥立的皇帝，白莲教首领韩山童之子。父亲被捕后，他一度躲藏。1355年刘福通奉他为帝，国号“宋”，年号“龙凤”，号“小明王”。刘福通掌握朝政，宋军的势力扩展至华北平原大片地区。红巾军于1358年攻取汴梁并定都于此，1359年又兵败弃城。1363年，朱元璋在安丰之围中将他救出，安置于滁州。1367年，他在被迎往朱元璋辖地途中，于瓜步渡长江时溺死，或说系朱元璋授意谋害。

en: Han Shantong (died 1351) was a White Lotus preacher and a founder of the Red Turban rebellion against the Yuan dynasty. From Luancheng in modern Hebei, he taught that the Maitreya Buddha and the King of Light would soon appear and claimed descent from the Song emperors. In 1351, when the Yuan conscripted a hundred and fifty thousand men to repair Yellow River dikes, he and Liu Futong buried a one-eyed stone man on the works with an inscribed prophecy and plotted revolt at Yingshang. The plot was discovered and Han was captured and executed. Liu continued to lead the rebellion, while Han's son Han Lin'er became its figurehead, the Young King of Ming.
zh: 韩山童（？—1351）是元末白莲教首领、红巾军起义的发起人之一。他是赵州栾城（今河北栾城）人，宣扬“弥勒佛降生、明王出世”，自称是宋朝皇室后裔。1351年，元朝强征15万民工修筑黄河堤坝，他与刘福通在工地埋下一尊独眼石人、散布相应谶语，并在颍州颍上筹划起义。计划败露后，他被俘遇害。刘福通继续领导起义，其子韩林儿成为运动的象征，称“小明王”。

en: Chronicles record Curu Yaya as a daughter of the early Inca ruler Lluq'i Yupanki of Cuzco and a sister of Mayta Qhapaq. They relate that Mayta Qhapaq formed a union with her in his youth — whether she was his concubine is uncertain — and that their son was Qhapaq Yupanki, the fifth ruler of Cuzco and the last of the Hurin dynasty.
zh: 据西班牙编年史记载，库鲁·亚亚是库斯科早期印加君主略克·尤潘基之女、迈塔·卡帕克的姐妹。史书记载，迈塔·卡帕克年轻时与她结合（她是否为其侧室，各书说法不一），两人之子卡帕克·尤潘基是库斯科第五位统治者，也是乌林王朝的最后一位统治者。

en: Chronicles describe Cusi Chimbo as a daughter of an Ayarmaca lord, who was given to the Sapa Inca Cápac Yupanqui as a concubine and became his second wife. She was the mother of Inca Roca. The same chronicles relate that around 1350 she poisoned Cápac Yupanqui at Cusco: his death let the Hanan Cusco faction led by her son storm the Inticancha palace, overthrow the Hurin dynasty and place Inca Roca on the throne, founding the Hanan dynasty.
zh: 编年史记载，库西·钦博是阿亚尔马卡一位首领的女儿，被献给萨帕·印卡卡帕克·尤潘基为妾，后成为他的第二位妻子，并生下印卡·罗卡。相传约1350年，她在库斯科毒杀卡帕克·尤潘基；他死后，其子率领的哈南·库斯科一派突袭印蒂坎查宫，推翻乌兰王朝，拥立印卡·罗卡继位，开创了哈南王朝。

en: Inca Roca (Inka Ruq'a, c. 1330–1380) is presented in the chronicles as the sixth ruler of Cusco and the first Sapa Inca of the Hanan Cusco dynasty, and he reached the throne by a coup. After Cápac Yupanqui's death the Hanan faction rebelled against the Hurin, killed the designated heir Quispe Yupanki and placed Inca Roca, the son of another of the late ruler's wives, on the throne. The old order was not swept away: a Hurin chief stayed at the Inticancha as high priest of the Sun while the Hanan took secular power, and Roca moved his palace into the Hurin part of the city. Chronicles credit him with founding the Yachaywasi, the school where Inca noble boys learned Quechua, religion, quipus and warfare. Legend gives him victories over the Chancas, who kept troubling his successors; more soberly, he seems to have improved the irrigation works around Cusco. His younger son Yáhuar Huácac succeeded him.
zh: 编年史中的印卡·罗卡（约1330—1380年）是库斯科的第六位统治者，也是哈南·库斯科王朝的第一位萨帕·印卡，他是靠一场政变登上王位的。卡帕克·尤潘基死后，哈南派反抗乌兰派，杀死指定继承人基斯佩·尤潘基，拥立先王另一位妻子所生的印卡·罗卡。旧秩序并未被一扫而空：一名乌兰首领留驻印蒂坎查，担任太阳最高祭司，哈南一派则执掌世俗权力，罗卡自己把宫殿迁入城中的乌兰区。编年史把创办‘雅奇瓦西’归于他：贵族少年在这所学校学习克丘亚语、宗教、奇普与军事。传说他战胜了昌卡人，但昌卡人仍不断困扰他的继任者；较为可信的是，他似乎改善了库斯科周边的灌溉工程。他去世后，较年幼的儿子亚瓦尔·瓦卡克继位。

en: Lluq'i Yupanki (Lloque Yupanqui, c. 1260–c. 1290) was the third Sapa Inca of the Kingdom of Cusco and a member of the Hurin dynasty, succeeding his father Sinchi Roca; chronicles call him the first Inca ruler born in Cusco itself. His reign brought almost no territorial expansion, as the Incas fought constantly to keep their hold on the Cusco valley, and writers disagree over whether he made small conquests or merely put down rebellions. He is credited with establishing the market in Cusco and building the Acllahuasi, the house of chosen women. His son Mayta Qhapaq succeeded him.
zh: 略克·尤潘基（约1260—约1290）是库斯科王国第三位萨帕·印卡，属乌林王朝，继承父亲辛奇·罗卡之位；编年史称他是第一位出生在库斯科本地的印卡统治者。他统治期间几乎没有扩张领土，因为印加人不断征战才保住对库斯科河谷的控制，各家记载对他究竟是略有征伐还是仅平定了叛乱说法不一。相传他在库斯科设立市场，并修建了阿克利阿瓦西，即选拔少女的“选女之屋”。其子迈塔·卡帕克继位。

en: Manco Qhapaq (Manco Cápac, also Ayar Manco; died c. 1230) is remembered as the founder and first ruler of Cusco and ancestor of the Inca dynasty. Inca oral tradition recorded by Spanish chronicles tells how he led his ayllu from Tamputoco into the Cusco valley, defeated the Sahuares, Huallas and Alcahuisas, and settled the swampy ground that became the city's main plaza, dividing the town into four districts. With his chief wife and sister Mama Uqllu he fathered his successor Sinchi Ruq'a and founded the Qhapaq Ayllu royal lineage; after a natural death he was mummified.
zh: 曼科·卡帕克（又名阿亚尔·曼科，约1230年卒）相传是库斯科的建立者、首任统治者，也是印加王朝的始祖。据西班牙编年史收录的印加口述传统，他率领自己的氏族从坦普托科进入库斯科河谷，击败萨瓦雷、瓦利亚和阿尔卡维萨诸部，在后来成为城市主广场的沼泽地上定居，并把城池分为四个区。他的正妻兼姐妹玛玛·奥克略生下继承人辛奇·罗卡，他还开创了卡帕克·艾柳王族世系；他寿终后被制成木乃伊。

en: Mayta Qhapaq (Mayta Cápac, c. 1290–c. 1320) was the fourth ruler of the early Inca polity of Cuzco and a member of the Hurin dynasty, succeeding his father Lluq'i Yupanki. Spanish chronicles record that he was still a child at his accession, so his uncle governed as regent until he came of age. He was remembered as a reformer of the calendar and is said to have subdued the Alcabisa and Culunchima peoples near Cuzco; later writers also credited him with conquests reaching Lake Titicaca and Arequipa. His heir was Qhapaq Yupanki.
zh: 迈塔·卡帕克（约1290—约1320）是库斯科早期印加政权的第四位统治者，属乌林王朝，继承父亲略克·尤潘基之位。西班牙编年史记载，他即位时年纪尚幼，由叔父摄政，成年后才亲政。他被后世称为历法改革者，相传降服了库斯科附近的阿尔卡比萨人和库伦奇马人；后世史家还把远抵的的喀喀湖和阿雷基帕的征服归功于他。他的继承人是卡帕克·尤潘基。

en: Cápac Yupanqui (Quechua Qhapaq Yupanki, c. 1320–1350) was the fifth Sapa Inca of the small Kingdom of Cusco and the last ruler of the Hurin dynasty, succeeding his father Mayta Cápac. His elder brother Cunti Mayta became high priest, and his chief wife, Mama Cusi Hilpay, was the daughter of the lord of Anta, formerly a great enemy of the Incas. In legend he is a conqueror: the chronicler Juan de Betanzos calls him the first Inca to take land beyond the valley of Cusco, where he subdued the Cuyumarca and Ancasmarca peoples. Garcilaso de la Vega credits him with new buildings, bridges, roads and aqueducts in the city. His death in 1350 brought the Hurin line down with it: the Hanan faction rebelled, killed his designated heir Quispe Yupanki, and gave the throne to Inca Roca, his son by another wife, Cusi Chimbo.
zh: 卡帕克·尤潘基（约1320—1350）是小小的库斯科王国的第五位萨帕·印卡，也是乌林王朝末代君主，继承父亲迈塔·卡帕克之位。他的兄长昆蒂·迈塔成为大祭司，正妻玛玛·库西·希尔佩是安塔首领之女，安塔此前曾是印卡人的大敌。传说中他是一位征服者：编年史家胡安·德·贝坦索斯称他是第一位夺取库斯科河谷以外土地的印卡，降服了库尤马卡和安卡斯马卡人。加西拉索·德·拉·维加则记他在城中兴建了许多建筑、桥梁、道路和引水渠。1350年他去世，乌林王朝也随之终结：哈南派起而反叛，杀死他指定的继承人基斯佩·尤潘基，把王位交给他与另一位妻子库西·钦博所生的印卡·罗卡。

en: Sinchi Ruq'a (Sinchi Roca, c. 1230–c. 1260) was the second Sapa Inca of the Kingdom of Cusco, of the Hurin dynasty, succeeding his father Manco Qhapaq. Chronicles present him as the first Inca to wear the borla of the maskaypacha, the emblem of supreme rule. He is credited with dividing the land into districts, holding the first Inca census, and ordering ear-piercing as a mark of nobility. Chronicles also attribute to him campaigns toward Collasuyo and Antisuyo and alliances with neighboring peoples. He was succeeded by his son Lluq'i Yupanki.
zh: 辛奇·罗卡（约1230—约1260）是库斯科王国第二位萨帕·印卡，属乌林王朝，继承父亲曼科·卡帕克之位。编年史称他是第一位佩戴马斯卡帕查缨穗的印卡君主，那是最高统治权的标志。相传他把国土划分为各区、举行印加第一次人口普查，并下令穿耳作为贵族的标志。编年史还把向科利亚苏尤和安蒂苏约方向的征战、以及与邻族结盟归功于他。其子略克·尤潘基继位。

en: Tarco Huamán (fl. c. 1320) was a short-reigned Inca ruler of Cusco, the favorite son of Mayta Qhapaq by his qoya Mama Tancaray, born of the Incas' alliance with the Collaguas. He succeeded his father around 1320 but was overthrown by his cousin Qhapaq Yupanki, who killed nine of Tarco's brothers and made the rest swear loyalty, and is absent from the official list of Sapa Incas. After Qhapaq Yupanki conquered Cuyumarca near Cusco, he appointed Tarco its kuraka, or governor, charging him with a yearly tribute of a thousand cages of birds from the Andes and the puna.
zh: 塔尔科·瓦曼（约1320年前后在世）是库斯科一位统治短暂的印卡君主，是迈塔·卡帕克与王后玛玛·坦卡雷伊所宠爱的儿子，生于印加人与科利亚瓜人结盟之时。约1320年他继承父位，旋即被堂兄卡帕克·尤潘基推翻：新君杀死他的九个兄弟，逼其余兄弟宣誓效忠，他也因此未被列入萨帕·印卡的正式世系。卡帕克·尤潘基征服库斯科附近的库尤马卡后，任命塔尔科为当地酋长库拉卡，规定他每年进贡一千笼安第斯山区和普纳高原的禽鸟。

en: Chitrali tradition remembers Shah Nadir Rais as the founder of the Rais dynasty that ruled Chitral in the Hindu Kush. The Nai Tarikh-i-Chitral relates that he was a foreign chief, presumably from Turkestan, who arrived in 1320 and brought the pre-Islamic Kafir period to an end, when lower Chitral was held by Kalasha rulers. The later Tarikh-i-Gilgit instead makes him a prince of the Trakhan dynasty of Gilgit. He is counted as the first of nine Rais rulers, a line later displaced by the Kator dynasty.
zh: 吉德拉尔的传统将沙·纳迪尔·赖斯铭记为赖斯王朝的开创者，该王朝曾统治兴都库什山区的吉德拉尔。《新吉德拉尔史》记载，他是外来首领，可能来自突厥斯坦，于1320年到来，终结了当地的前伊斯兰“卡菲尔时期”，当时下吉德拉尔处在卡拉什人统治者治下。后世的《吉尔吉特史》则称他本是吉尔吉特特拉汉王朝的王公。他被列为九代赖斯统治者之首，这一世系后被卡托尔王朝取代。

en: Zou Pusheng was a blacksmith from Macheng in Hubei who became a chief leader of the southern Red Turbans. In 1351 the cloth peddler Xu Shouhui brought iron to his home and asked him to make implements. Zou replied that the world needed a sword rather than farm tools, and the two planned a revolt under the sign of the red turban. They rose at Qizhou, and when Xu was enthroned at Qishui as emperor of the Tianwan state late in 1351, Zou became its Grand Preceptor. He retained the title when Chen Youliang held Xu under his control and proclaimed himself King of Han; Zou's subsequent fate is unknown.
zh: 邹普胜是湖北麻城人，以炼铁为生，后成为南派红巾军的主要首领之一。1351年，布贩徐寿辉携铁到他家中，请他打造器具；邹普胜答称天下需要的是剑而非锄锹，二人遂共谋大举，以红巾为号，在蕲州起兵。1351年末徐寿辉在蕲水称帝、建立天完政权，邹普胜受封太师。后来陈友谅挟持徐寿辉、自称汉王，邹普胜仍称太师，此后下落不明。

en: Xu Shouhui (1320–1360) was a cloth peddler from Luotian in Hubei who became emperor of the southern Red Turbans. In August 1351 he joined Peng Yingyu and Zou Pusheng's rising at Qizhou, which rallied followers with the promise of Maitreya's coming. That October, after Qishui was taken, he was proclaimed emperor of a Song regime with era name Zhiping, later called Tianwan. Yuan troops destroyed Qishui in 1353, but his forces recovered Jiangxi and Hunan and moved the capital to Hanyang in 1356. His minister Ni Wenjun held real power and attempted to kill him in 1357; Chen Youliang killed Ni and took control. Chen later held Xu captive at Jiangzhou, murdered him at Caishi in 1360 and made himself emperor of Han.
zh: 徐寿辉（1320—1360），湖北罗田人，原是布贩，后来成为南方红巾军拥立的皇帝。1351年八月，他参加彭莹玉、邹普胜在蕲州的起事，起义军以弥勒降生号召群众。同年十月蕲水攻克后，他被拥立为帝，国号宋，年号治平，该政权后世多称天完。1353年元军攻破蕲水，但所部后来收复江西、湖南，并于1356年迁都汉阳。丞相倪文俊把持实权，1357年谋杀徐寿辉未遂；陈友谅杀死倪文俊，夺取实权。陈友谅后来在江州挟持徐寿辉，1360年在采石将他杀死，自立为汉帝。

en: Ni Wenjun (died September 1357), nicknamed Manzi, was a fisherman from Mianyang in Hubei who moved to Huangpi and became a top commander of the southern Red Turbans. Joining Xu Shouhui's rising, he was made marshal and then Grand Commandant of the Tianwan court. In 1355 he destroyed at Hanchuan the river fleet of the Yuan Prince of Weishun; he retook Mianyang in January 1356, where Chen Youliang entered his service, and captured Yuezhou in December that year, killing the prince's son. In September 1357, after his plot to murder Xu Shouhui failed, he fled to Huangzhou and was killed by Chen Youliang.
zh: 倪文俊（?—1357），号蛮子，湖北沔阳人，后迁居黄陂，以捕鱼为业，是南派红巾军的重要将领。他随徐寿辉起兵，任元帅，天完建国后受封太尉。1355年，他在汉川大破元朝威顺王宽彻普化的水军；1356年一月攻占沔阳，陈友谅于此时投入他麾下，同年十二月攻克岳州，杀死威顺王之子歹帖木儿。1357年九月，他谋害徐寿辉未成，逃奔黄州，被陈友谅袭杀。

en: Achitomecatl Teomecatl II was tlatoani of Culhuacan from 1336 to 1347. The Anales de Cuauhtitlan record that he took the throne in 1336 after killing its ruler Huehue Acamapichtli, and ruled until 1347, when Nauhyotzin III succeeded him.
zh: 阿奇托梅卡特·特奥梅卡尔二世于1336至1347年任库尔瓦坎的特拉托阿尼。据《夸乌蒂特兰编年史》记载，他在1336年杀害库尔瓦坎君主韦韦·阿卡马皮奇特利后夺取王位，统治至1347年，由纳乌约钦三世继位。

en: Coxcoxtli was a ruler of Culhuacan in the Valley of Mexico, father of Huehue Acamapichtli and Atotoztli I, whose son Acamapichtli became the first tlatoani of Tenochtitlan.
zh: 科什科什特利是墨西哥谷地库尔瓦坎的统治者，韦韦·阿卡马皮奇特利与阿托托斯特利一世的父亲；阿托托斯特利的儿子阿卡马皮奇特利成为特诺奇蒂特兰第一代特拉托阿尼。

en: Huehue Acamapichtli (Nahuatl for Acamapichtli the Elder, c. 1300–1336) was tlatoani, or king, of Culhuacan and the last ruler of its Chichimeca dynasty, succeeding his father Coxcoxtli. The Anales de Cuauhtitlan place his enthronement in 1324. His relative Acamapichtli later became the first tlatoani of Tenochtitlan. In 1336 he was killed by Achitomecatl, who at once seized the throne of Culhuacan, whereupon the young Acamapichtli fled with Ilancueitl to Cohuatlinchan.
zh: 韦韦·阿卡马皮奇特利（纳瓦特尔语意为“老阿卡马皮奇特利”，约1300—1336）是库尔瓦坎的特拉托阿尼（即国王），也是当地奇奇梅卡王朝的末代君主，继承父亲科克斯科斯特利之位。《夸乌蒂特兰编年史》记载他于1324年登位。他的亲属阿卡马皮奇特利后来成为特诺奇蒂特兰的首位特拉托阿尼。1336年，他被阿奇托梅卡特杀害，凶手随即篡夺库尔瓦坎王位，年轻的阿卡马皮奇特利遂与伊兰奎特尔逃往科瓦特林昌。

en: Risdeard O'Reilly (Risderd Ó Raghallaigh) was king of East Breifne, the O'Reilly kingdom in what is now County Cavan, from about 1328 until his death around 1349. He was the second son of Giolla Iosa Ruaidh, who had established the O'Reilly seat at Cavan and founded its Franciscan friary before retiring about 1327. When Risdeard's elder brother Maelseachleann died in 1328, after briefly being counted as king, Risdeard took the kingship. His long reign brought decades of stable O'Reilly succession, and when he died his brother Cu Chonnacht succeeded him.
zh: 里斯德阿德·奥赖利是东布雷夫讷的国王；东布雷夫讷是奥赖利家族的王国，位于今卡文郡一带。他约1328年继位，约1349年去世。他是吉奥拉·伊萨·鲁艾什的次子；其父把奥赖利家族的驻地设在卡文，修建了方济各会修道院，并于约1327年隐退。兄长梅尔谢赫莱恩于1328年去世，此前曾短暂被认作国王，里斯德阿德随后继位。他在位长久，奥赖利家族的继承在此后数十年保持稳定；他死后，兄弟库·乔赫纳赫特继位。

en: Sir Edmond de Burgh (1298–1338), also called Edmond of Clanwilliam, was an Anglo-Irish knight and a son of Richard Óg de Burgh, second Earl of Ulster, and Margery de Burgh. He married Sláine O'Brien and was ancestor of the Burkes of Clanwilliam. In 1338, while visiting the Augustinian friars at Ballinrobe, he was seized at the friary by his cousin Edmond Albanach Burke and his men after a short resistance, carried to Earls Island, and drowned in Lough Mask with a stone fastened to his neck. The killing is recorded in the Annals of the Four Masters.
zh: 埃德蒙·德·伯格爵士（1298—1338），又称克兰威廉的埃德蒙，是盎格鲁—爱尔兰骑士，第二代阿尔斯特伯爵理查德·奥格·德·伯格与妻子马杰里之子。他娶斯兰妮·奥布赖恩为妻，是克兰威廉伯克家族的始祖。1338年，他带着随从前往巴林罗布拜访奥斯定会修士时，堂兄弟埃德蒙·阿尔巴纳赫·伯克率人闯入修道院，经过短暂抵抗将他擒获，押到伯爵岛；他们在他脖子上拴了一块石头，把他溺死在马斯克湖中。此事见于《四大师年鉴》。

en: Sir David Burke was a son of the Irish knight Sir Edmond de Burgh (1298–1338) of County Limerick, and was still alive in 1387. He was the ancestor of the Burkes of Muskerryquirk, a branch of the Clanwilliam Burkes.
zh: 大卫·伯克爵士是利默里克郡爱尔兰骑士埃德蒙·德·伯格爵士（1298—1338）之子，1387年仍在世，为马斯克雷夸克伯克家族的始祖，该支属克兰威廉伯克家族。

en: Richard Burke (died 1365) was the eldest surviving son of Sir Edmond de Burgh of Clanwilliam and Sláine O'Brien, daughter of the king of Thomond, and a grandson of Richard Óg de Burgh, Earl of Ulster.
zh: 理查德·伯克（1365年去世）是克兰威廉的埃德蒙·德·伯格爵士与托蒙德国王之女斯兰妮·奥布赖恩的存活儿子中最年长者，也是阿尔斯特伯爵理查德·奥格·德·伯格之孙。

en: Ming Yuzhen (1328–1366) was a Red Turban rebel who founded the Xia state in Sichuan during the Yuan collapse. He joined Xu Shouhui's Tianwan Red Turban army around 1352, becoming grand marshal. In 1357 he led troops into Sichuan through the Wu Gorges, seized Chongqing, and subdued Yuan forces across Sichuan. He also defended the region against Li Xixi's Green Turban army, which invaded from Shaanxi in 1358. After Chen Youliang killed Xu in 1360, Ming refused allegiance, took the title King of Longshu in 1361, and in 1363 enthroned himself in Chongqing as emperor of Great Xia. His forces attacked Yunnan but were defeated and withdrew to Sichuan. On his death in 1366 his son Ming Sheng succeeded; Xia fell to the Ming in 1371.
zh: 明玉珍（1328—1366）是元末红巾军将领，在四川建立大夏政权。1352年前后他加入徐寿辉的天完红巾军，升任统军元帅。1357年，他率军经巫峡入蜀，攻占重庆，又平定川内元军。1358年李喜喜率绿巾军从陕西入侵，他也出兵抵御。1360年陈友谅杀害徐寿辉后，他拒不归附，1361年自称陇蜀王，1363年在重庆称帝，国号大夏。他的军队进攻云南，却遭击败，退回四川。他于1366年病逝，子明昇继位，大夏于1371年被明朝攻灭。

en: Alice of Ibelin (1304/1306–after 1386) was the only child of Guy of Ibelin, Lord of Nicosia, and Isabella of Ibelin, orphaned before she was eleven. A childhood betrothal to Henry of Lusignan was annulled in 1310, and on 17 September 1318 she married Hugh of Lusignan under a papal dispensation. When Hugh became King Hugh IV in 1324, she was crowned queen in Nicosia's Saint Sophia Cathedral. Two of her sons, Peter I and James I, later wore the Cypriot crown. After Hugh's death she married Philip of Brunswick-Grubenhagen in 1368, only to be widowed again in 1369.
zh: 伊贝林的艾丽斯（1304/1306—1386年后）是尼科西亚领主居伊·德·伊贝林与伊贝林的伊莎贝尔唯一的孩子，十一岁前便父母双亡。她幼年与吕西尼昂的亨利的婚约于1310年解除；1318年9月17日，她凭教皇特许嫁给吕西尼昂的于格。1324年于格成为于格四世，她在尼科西亚的圣索菲亚大教堂加冕为王后。她的两个儿子彼得一世与雅克一世后来相继成为塞浦路斯国王。于格死后，她于1368年改嫁不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的腓力，1369年即再度守寡。

en: Amalric of Lusignan (c. 1272–1310), Lord of Tyre, was a younger son of King Hugh III of Cyprus. He fought at the fall of Tripoli in 1289 and commanded the Accursed Tower during the siege of Acre in 1291, escaping its fall. In 1300 he sought to coordinate an attack on the Mamluks with Ghazan's Mongols and occupied Ruad, but the Mongols did not arrive. In April 1306, backed by the Templars and barons, he deposed his epileptic brother Henry II and governed Cyprus as governor and regent, mending relations with Venice and Genoa. A rising in Henry's favour collapsed in 1308, and Amalric exiled him to Armenia in February 1310. He was murdered at Nicosia in June 1310, after which Henry regained the throne.
zh: 吕西尼昂的阿马尔里克（约1272—1310）是塞浦路斯国王于格三世较年幼的儿子，受封提尔领主。他参加了1289年的的黎波里陷落之战，并在1291年阿卡围城战中指挥“诅咒之塔”，城破时逃出。1300年，他试图与合赞的蒙古军协同进攻马穆鲁克，占据鲁阿德岛，但蒙古军未到。1306年4月，他在圣殿骑士团和贵族支持下废黜患有癫痫的兄长亨利二世，以总督兼摄政的身份统治塞浦路斯，修复了与威尼斯和热那亚的关系。1308年一场拥护亨利的起事瓦解，阿马尔里克于1310年2月将他流放亚美尼亚。1310年6月他在尼科西亚遇刺，亨利随后复位。

en: Balian of Ibelin (1240–1302) was seneschal of the Kingdom of Cyprus. A son of Guy of Ibelin, constable of Cyprus, and Philippa Berlais, he married Alice of Lampron, of the Armenian Hetumid dynasty and a granddaughter of Raymond-Roupen. Their son Guy, born in 1286, became lord of Nicosia. Of their daughters, Maria married Rupen of Montfort in 1299, Isabelle married John, titular lord of Arsuf, and Margaret married Oshin of Korikos. Balian died in 1302.
zh: 伊贝林的巴利安（1240—1302）任塞浦路斯王国宫廷长。他是塞浦路斯统帅伊贝林的居伊与菲利帕·贝尔莱之子，娶出身亚美尼亚赫图米德王朝兰普龙家族的爱丽丝为妻，她是雷蒙-鲁本的外孙女。两人的儿子居伊生于1286年，后成为尼科西亚领主；女儿玛丽亚于1299年嫁给蒙福尔的鲁本，伊莎贝尔嫁给阿尔苏夫名义领主约翰，玛格丽特嫁给科里库斯的奥辛。巴利安于1302年去世。

en: Balian of Ibelin (c. 1321 – c. 1352), elder son of Hugh d'Ibelin, seneschal of Cyprus and titular count of Jaffa, succeeded his father as titular count of Jaffa and Ascalon in 1349. He died around 1352, when his brother Guy followed him.
zh: 伊贝林的巴利安（约1321—约1352）是塞浦路斯宫廷长、雅法名义伯爵于格·德·伊贝林的长子。1349年他继任雅法与亚实基伦名义伯爵，约1352年去世，由弟弟居伊承袭。

en: Baldwin of Ibelin (c. 1211–1267) was the fourth son of John of Ibelin, the Old Lord of Beirut, by his second wife Melisende of Arsuf. Around 1230 he married Alice of Bethsan. At the Battle of Agridi in 1232 he commanded the third division. In 1246 he became seneschal of Cyprus, and in 1250 he was taken prisoner at Mansurah in Egypt while serving in Louis IX of France’s crusade. His sons included Philip, later constable of Cyprus, and Hugh, regent of Cyprus in 1306. Baldwin died on 21 February 1267.
zh: 伊贝林的鲍德温（约1211—1267）是贝鲁特大老爷约翰·德·伊贝林与第二任妻子阿尔苏夫的梅利桑德所生之子，在兄弟中行四。约1230年他娶贝桑的爱丽丝为妻。1232年阿格里迪战役中他指挥第三阵。1246年他出任塞浦路斯宫廷总管，1250年在埃及曼苏拉随法兰西国王路易九世的十字军作战时被俘。他的儿子中包括后来任塞浦路斯统帅的腓力和1306年任塞浦路斯摄政的于格。鲍德温于1267年2月21日去世。

en: Eschiva of Ibelin (1253–1312) inherited the lordship of Beirut when her sister Isabella died in 1282, though after the Mamluk conquest of 1291 she held it in name only. The daughter of John II of Beirut and Alice de la Roche, she married first, in 1274, Humphrey de Montfort, lord of Tyre, who died in 1284 and by whom she had Amaury and Rupen de Montfort. In 1291 she married Guy of Lusignan, constable of Cyprus; their son became King Hugh IV. She bore the title of Lady of Beirut until her death in 1312.
zh: 伊贝林的埃希芙（1253—1312）在姐姐伊莎贝拉于1282年去世后继承贝鲁特领地；1291年马穆鲁克人攻陷贝鲁特后，她仅保有领主名分。她是贝鲁特的约翰二世与阿丽克斯·德·拉罗什之女，1274年首次出嫁，嫁给泰尔领主昂夫鲁瓦·德·蒙特福特，丈夫于1284年去世，生子阿马尔里克和鲁本·德·蒙特福特。1291年她改嫁塞浦路斯统帅吕西尼昂的居伊，他们的儿子后来成为塞浦路斯国王于格四世。她直到1312年去世一直保有贝鲁特女领主的头衔。

en: Eschive de Lusignan (died 1363) was the eldest daughter of King Hugh IV of Cyprus and his second wife Alice of Ibelin. She married Ferdinand of Majorca, Viscount of Omélas, a grandson of King James II of Majorca. After a violent quarrel Hugh IV expelled Ferdinand from Cyprus and held Eschive captive at court. The king accused Ferdinand's mother, Isabella of Ibelin, of practising sorcery. Eschive was still captive when her only child, Alice, was born in 1341; Ferdinand died in exile at Omélas before 1347. Eschive died during an outbreak of plague in 1363.
zh: 埃希芙·德·吕西尼昂（1363年卒）是塞浦路斯国王于格四世与第二任妻子伊贝林的艾丽斯的长女。她嫁给马略卡国王海梅二世之孙、奥梅拉斯子爵费尔南·德·马略卡。一场激烈争吵之后，于格四世将费尔南逐出塞浦路斯，并把埃希芙幽禁在宫中。国王指控费尔南的母亲伊贝林的伊莎贝拉施行巫术。1341年，她唯一的孩子阿莉西亚出生时，埃希芙仍被幽禁；费尔南则于1347年前客死流放地奥梅拉斯。埃希芙于1363年鼠疫流行期间去世。

en: Guy of Lusignan (1316–1343) was the eldest son of King Hugh IV of Cyprus and his first wife Maria of Ibelin. Around 1320 he inherited the titular principality of Galilee from his mother's family, and in 1324 his father took the Cypriot crown. Betrothed to Maria of Bourbon in 1328, he married her in Nicosia's Saint Sophia Cathedral after she reached the island in January 1330. Appointed constable of Cyprus in 1338, he died in the summer of 1343, leaving one son, Hugh, later titular prince of Galilee and prince of Achaea.
zh: 吕西尼昂的居伊（1316—1343）是塞浦路斯国王于格四世与第一任妻子伊贝林的玛丽亚的长子。约1320年，他从母家继承了名义上的加利利亲王国，1324年其父加冕为塞浦路斯国王。1328年他与波旁的玛丽亚订婚，后者于1330年1月抵岛后，两人在尼科西亚的圣索菲亚大教堂成婚。1338年他被任命为塞浦路斯统帅，1343年夏去世，遗下一子于格，后来成为名义上的加利利亲王和亚该亚亲王。

en: Guy of Lusignan (c. 1150–1194), a Poitevin knight and youngest son of Hugh VIII of Lusignan, married Sibylla, sister of King Baldwin IV of Jerusalem, in 1180. Baldwin appointed him regent in 1183 but resumed power that year. In 1186 Sibylla became queen and chose to crown Guy beside her. He led the Christian army to catastrophe at Hattin in July 1187, where Saladin captured him, and Jerusalem fell three months later. Released in 1188, he opened the siege of Acre in 1189. Deprived of the Jerusalem crown in 1192, he received Cyprus from Richard I of England and ruled the island until his death in 1194, when his brother Aimery succeeded him.
zh: 吕西尼昂的居伊（约1150—1194）是普瓦图骑士、吕西尼昂家族于格八世的幼子。他来到耶路撒冷王国后，于1180年娶国王鲍德温四世之姐西比拉为妻。鲍德温于1183年任命他为摄政，同年又收回权力。1186年西比拉成为女王，选择让居伊与她一同加冕为王。1187年7月，他率基督教军队在哈丁战役中惨败，本人被萨拉丁俘虏，三个月后耶路撒冷陷落。1188年获释后，他于1189年发起阿卡围城战。1192年他失去耶路撒冷王位，英格兰国王理查一世将塞浦路斯补偿给他；他统治该岛至1194年去世，由其兄艾默里继位。

en: Guy of Ibelin (1215/1218 – after 1255) was the fifth son of John of Ibelin, the Old Lord of Beirut, and Melisende of Arsuf. He served King Henry I as marshal and then constable of Cyprus, witnessed two royal decrees and was probably an executor of the king's will. With his brother Baldwin he led Cypriot knights at the 1249 siege of Damietta on Louis IX’s crusade; Joinville called him one of the finest knights of his age and recounted their capture alongside him. He married Philippa Barlais; their daughter Isabella married King Hugh III, while their sons Balian and Philip each became seneschal of Cyprus. He founded the Ibelins’ Cypriot branch and died after May 1255.
zh: 伊贝林的居伊（1215/1218—1255年后）是贝鲁特大老爷约翰·德·伊贝林与阿尔苏夫的梅利桑德的第五子。他在国王亨利一世麾下历任塞浦路斯马政官与统帅，见证过国王的两道诏令，并可能是其遗嘱执行人。1249年，他与兄长鲍德温率领塞浦路斯骑士参加路易九世十字军的达米埃塔围城战；编年史家茹安维尔称他是当时最出色的骑士之一，并记载了他们与自己一同被俘的经历。他娶巴莱的菲利帕为妻，女儿伊莎贝拉嫁给于格三世国王，儿子巴利安和腓力则先后出任塞浦路斯宫廷总管。他开创了伊贝林家族的塞浦路斯支系，于1255年5月之后去世。

en: Guy of Ibelin (1286–1308) was lord of Nicosia in the Kingdom of Cyprus. The son of Balian of Ibelin, the kingdom's seneschal, and Alice of Lampron, he obtained a papal dispensation in 1303 to marry his cousin Isabella, daughter of Baldwin of Ibelin, lord of Korakou. Their daughter Alix became the second wife of King Hugh IV of Cyprus, while another daughter, Margaret, married Guy of Ibelin, seneschal of Cyprus. Guy died on 8 September 1308 and was buried at Bellapais Abbey near Kyrenia.
zh: 伊贝林的居伊（1286—1308）是塞浦路斯王国的尼科西亚领主。他是塞浦路斯宫廷长伊贝林的巴利安与兰普龙的爱丽丝之子，1303年获得教皇特许，与堂亲伊莎贝尔成婚；伊莎贝尔是科拉库领主伊贝林的博杜安之女。两人的女儿爱丽丝成为塞浦路斯国王于格四世的第二任王后，另一个女儿玛格丽特嫁给塞浦路斯宫廷长伊贝林的居伊。1308年9月8日居伊去世，葬于凯里尼亚附近的贝拉派斯修道院。

en: Guy d'Ibelin (born c. 1237) was a Cypriot nobleman, a son of Baldwin d'Ibelin, seneschal of Cyprus, and Alix de Bethsan. In 1266 he married Maria, daughter of Hethum I, king of Cilician Armenia, and Queen Isabella, allying the Ibelins with the Armenian Hethumid dynasty.
zh: 居伊·德·伊贝林（约1237年生）是塞浦路斯贵族，塞浦路斯总管鲍德温·德·伊贝林与阿丽克斯·德·贝桑之子。1266年，他娶奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王海屯一世与伊莎贝拉女王之女玛丽亚为妻，使伊贝林家族与亚美尼亚海屯王朝联姻。

en: Guy of Ibelin, younger son of the Cypriot seneschal Hugh d'Ibelin, succeeded his brother Balian as titular count of Jaffa and Ascalon around 1352. His children included John, who died in 1375, after Guy's own death.
zh: 伊贝林的居伊是塞浦路斯宫廷长于格·德·伊贝林较年幼的儿子，约1352年继兄巴利安任雅法与亚实基伦名义伯爵。他的子女中有约翰，约翰在居伊去世后于1375年去世。

en: Guy of Ibelin (1250–1304) held the title of count of Jaffa and Ascalon after his elder brother James died in 1276, though Baibars had conquered Jaffa in 1268, leaving him count in name only. In 1299 he briefly seized Byblos with a Genoese fleet, and in 1301 he met the Mongol commander Kutlushah to plan action against the Mamluks. Pirates captured Guy and his family at Episcopia in Cyprus in 1302. He died on 14 February 1304 and was buried, at his own wish, in a pauper's grave in Nicosia.
zh: 伊贝林的居伊（1250—1304）在兄长雅克于1276年去世后承袭雅法与亚实基伦伯爵头衔，但雅法已于1268年被拜巴尔攻占，他只是名义上的伯爵。1299年，他率热那亚舰队一度攻占比布鲁斯，1301年又与蒙古将领忽都鲁沙会面，商议共同对付马穆鲁克人。1302年，他与家人在塞浦路斯的埃皮斯科皮亚被海盗掳走。他于1304年2月14日去世，遵照自己的誓愿葬在尼科西亚的贫民墓地中。

en: Guy of Poitiers-Lusignan (1275–1303) was the youngest son of King Hugh III of Cyprus and Isabella of Ibelin. He held the office of constable of Cyprus from 1291, or by another account 1298, and married Eschiva of Ibelin, lady of Beirut. In 1303 he joined a conspiracy against his brother King Henry II; the plot was uncovered and Guy was executed that same year. His son by Eschiva later inherited the crown as Hugh IV in 1324, and a daughter, Isabel, married Eudes de Dampierre, constable of Jerusalem.
zh: 塞浦路斯的居伊（1275—1303）是塞浦路斯国王于格三世与伊贝林的伊莎贝拉最小的儿子。他于1291年（一说1298年）出任塞浦路斯统帅，娶贝鲁特女领主伊贝林的埃希芙为妻。1303年，他参与反对兄长亨利二世的密谋，事泄后于同年被处死。他与埃希芙所生的儿子后来于1324年继承王位，即于格四世；女儿伊莎贝尔嫁给耶路撒冷统帅厄德·德·当皮埃尔。

en: Henry I of Cyprus, called the Fat (1217–1253), succeeded his father Hugh I as king in 1218 while still an infant. During his minority his mother Alice of Champagne was regent and the Ibelin lords held power. Emperor Frederick II also claimed the right to govern Cyprus during Henry's minority, leading to war with the Ibelins. Their victory over imperial forces at Agridi in 1232 secured his throne, and he came of age that year. In 1246 he became regent of Jerusalem for King Conrad II and appointed Balian of Ibelin to govern there for him. He joined Louis IX's Seventh Crusade in 1248 but soon returned to Cyprus, dying there in 1253; his infant son Hugh II succeeded him.
zh: 塞浦路斯的亨利一世，绰号“胖子”（1217—1253），于1218年幼年继承父亲于格一世的王位。他未成年期间，母亲香槟的阿丽丝摄政，实权由伊贝林家族的领主掌握。皇帝腓特烈二世也主张在亨利未成年时统治塞浦路斯的权利，因而与伊贝林家族开战。1232年，伊贝林一派在阿格里迪战役中击败皇帝的军队，保住了他的王位，他也在这一年亲政。1246年，他为国王康拉德二世出任耶路撒冷摄政，任命伊贝林的巴利安代为治理。1248年他加入路易九世的第七次十字军东征，但很快返回塞浦路斯，1253年在岛上去世，幼子于格二世继位。

en: Henry II (1270–1324) was a son of Hugh III and succeeded his brother John I as king of Cyprus in 1285, crowned at Nicosia. In 1285 he retook Acre from the Angevins and in 1286 was crowned king of Jerusalem at Tyre, the last ruler to hold that coronation. During the Mamluk siege of Acre in 1291 he fled to Cyprus; the city subsequently fell, ending the mainland kingdom. He later sought to coordinate operations with the Mongol ruler Ghazan and twice asked Pope Clement V for a new crusade. In Cyprus he had the High Court keep written records and extended its judicial role. Epileptic, he was deposed in 1306 by his brother Amalric and exiled to Armenia, returning in 1310 after Amalric's murder to rule until his death. Childless, he was succeeded by his nephew Hugh IV.
zh: 亨利二世（1270—1324）是于格三世之子，1285年继兄长约翰一世之后成为塞浦路斯国王，在尼科西亚加冕。1285年他从安茹家族手中收复阿卡，并于1286年在提尔加冕为耶路撒冷国王，是最后一位举行该加冕礼的君主。1291年马穆鲁克围攻阿卡时，他逃回塞浦路斯；城池随后陷落，大陆王国就此终结。他后来寻求与蒙古统治者合赞协同作战，并两次请求教皇克勉五世发动新的十字军。在塞浦路斯，他命高等法院保存书面记录，并扩大其司法职权。他患有癫痫，1306年被弟弟阿马尔里克废黜并流放亚美尼亚，1310年阿马尔里克遇刺后回国复位，统治直至去世。他没有子嗣，由侄子于格四世继位。

en: Hugh I of Cyprus (1195–1218) succeeded his father Aimery as king in 1205 aged nine; his brother-in-law Walter of Montbéliard governed as regent. He married Alice of Champagne between 1208 and 1211 and took personal power in 1210. Hugh fell out with Walter, who fled to Jerusalem, and reversed his policies, making peace with the Seljuqs of Rum and backing the Armenians in the War of the Antiochene Succession. Pope Innocent III rebuked him for hostility to the king of Jerusalem and interference in church appointments. Hugh joined the Fifth Crusade in 1217 but fell ill and died at Tripoli on 10 January 1218, leaving the crown to his infant son Henry I under Alice's regency.
zh: 塞浦路斯的于格一世（1195—1218）于1205年九岁时继承父亲艾默里的王位，由姐夫蒙贝利亚尔的沃尔特摄政。他在1208至1211年间娶香槟的阿丽丝为妻，1210年亲政。于格与沃尔特失和，后者逃往耶路撒冷；于格改变了他的政策，与罗姆塞尔柱人讲和，并在安条克继承战争中支持亚美尼亚人。教宗英诺森三世因他敌视耶路撒冷国王及干预教会任命而斥责他。1217年末于格加入第五次十字军东征，却染病于1218年1月10日在的黎波里去世，王位传给幼子亨利一世，由阿丽丝摄政。

en: Hugh of Ibelin, born around 1295, was the son of Guy of Ibelin, titular Count of Jaffa. He became Count of Jaffa and seneschal of Jerusalem, and was the second husband of Isabella of Ibelin, widow of Ferdinand of Majorca. He died before May 1349.
zh: 伊贝林的于格约生于1295年，是名义上的雅法伯爵居伊·德·伊贝林之子。他本人承袭雅法伯爵头衔，曾任耶路撒冷总管，也是马略卡的费尔南多遗孀伊贝林的伊莎贝尔的第二任丈夫，1349年5月前去世。

en: Hugh II (c. December 1252 – December 1267) became king of Cyprus as an infant when his father Henry I died, his mother Plaisance of Antioch governing as regent. In 1258 the barons at Acre recognized him as heir presumptive to Conrad III of Jerusalem. After Plaisance's death in 1261, his cousin Hugh of Antioch took over the regency. A marriage to Isabella of Ibelin, lady of Beirut, was arranged with a papal dispensation in 1265, but Hugh died before reaching his majority in 1267, ending the first Lusignan line; Hugh of Antioch succeeded him.
zh: 于格二世（1252年12月—1267年12月）在父亲亨利一世去世时还是襁褓中的婴儿，就此成为塞浦路斯国王，由母亲安条克的普莱桑斯摄政。1258年，阿卡的贵族承认他为耶路撒冷的康拉丁的推定继承人。1261年普莱桑斯去世后，他的表兄安条克的于格接掌摄政权。1265年，他与贝鲁特女领主伊贝林的伊莎贝拉的婚事得到教宗特许，但他于1267年成年之前去世，吕西尼昂家族的长系统治告终，安条克的于格继位。

en: Hugh III (c. 1235–1284) was the son of Henry of Antioch and Isabella of Lusignan. He governed Cyprus as regent for the young Hugh II and succeeded him in 1267, crowned in Nicosia. After Conrad III of Jerusalem was executed in 1268, Hugh claimed Jerusalem too, taking residence in the mainland kingdom for the first time in decades. He tried to rebuild royal authority and check the Mamluks. Marriage alliances secured the loyalty of the Ibelin and Montfort families, but the Templars and Venetian merchants opposed him. His aunt Maria of Antioch sold her claim to Charles I of Anjou, who seized Acre in 1277. Hugh twice failed to recover the city and died at Tyre in 1284, succeeded by his son John I.
zh: 于格三世（约1235—1284）是安条克的亨利与吕西尼昂的伊莎贝拉之子。他先以摄政身份代年轻的于格二世治理塞浦路斯，并于1267年继位，在尼科西亚加冕。1268年耶路撒冷国王康拉丁被处死后，他又取得耶路撒冷王位，数十年来首次常驻大陆王国。他力图重振王权、遏制马穆鲁克。联姻为他赢得伊贝林和蒙福尔家族的忠诚，但圣殿骑士团和威尼斯商人反对他。姨母安条克的玛丽把继承权卖给安茹的查理，后者于1277年攻占阿卡。于格两次收复阿卡未果，于1284年死于提尔，其子约翰一世继位。

en: Hugh IV (1293/1296–1359) was the son of Guy, constable of Cyprus, and Eschiva of Ibelin. He succeeded his father as constable in 1318, and on 31 March 1324 inherited the Cypriot throne from his uncle Henry II, who left no sons; he also claimed the title of king of Jerusalem. He seems to have been content with Cyprus and prevented his son Peter from going to western Europe to seek help to reconquer Jerusalem. In 1344 he joined the Venetians and Hospitallers in capturing Smyrna, and renewed the alliance in the early 1350s. Cyprus reached its peak of power and prosperity under him and Peter I. When his eldest son Guy died leaving a son, Hugh passed over his grandson and on 24 November 1358 had his second son Peter crowned, the first Cypriot king to crown his successor in his lifetime. He died on 10 October 1359.
zh: 于格四世（1293/1296—1359）是塞浦路斯统帅居伊与伊贝林的埃施娃之子。1318年他继任统帅，1324年3月31日又从没有儿子的叔父亨利二世手中继承塞浦路斯王位，同时自称耶路撒冷国王。他似乎满足于守住塞浦路斯，阻止儿子彼得前往西欧寻求援助、收复耶路撒冷。1344年，他与威尼斯人和医院骑士团联手夺取士麦那，并在14世纪50年代初续订同盟。塞浦路斯的国力与富庶在他和彼得一世治下达到顶峰。长子居伊死后留下一子，于格越过孙子，于1358年11月24日为次子彼得加冕，成为第一位生前为继承人加冕的塞浦路斯国王。他于1359年10月10日去世。

en: Hugh of Lusignan (c. 1335–1385?) was the only son of Guy of Lusignan and Marie of Bourbon. When Guy died in 1343, Hugh became the designated heir of his grandfather Hugh IV to the throne of Cyprus. His mother, on bad terms with the king, wanted to take him back to the West, and after papal pressure they left in 1347. In 1358 the old king had his own younger son Peter crowned instead. Hugh carried the dispute to the pope with the backing of the French court, and served as senator of Rome in 1361. At Avignon in 1362 Peter I bought his renunciation with an annual pension of 50,000 bezants, making him the richest lord on the island after the king. Hugh fought at Alexandria in 1365, where Peter named him prince of Galilee; after campaigns in Achaea, he and his mother ceded their claim there to Philip of Taranto in 1370. He died childless in Cyprus.
zh: 吕西尼昂的于格（约1335—约1385）是居伊·德·吕西尼昂与波旁的玛丽的独子。1343年居伊去世后，于格成为祖父于格四世指定的塞浦路斯王位继承人。他的母亲与国王交恶，想带他回西方；经教皇施压，母子于1347年离岛。1358年，老国王却为自己较年幼的儿子彼得加冕。于格在法国宫廷的支持下向教皇申诉，1361年任罗马元老。1362年，彼得一世在阿维尼翁以每年50,000拜占特的年金换取他放弃权利，使他成为岛上仅次于国王的富有领主。1365年于格参加亚历山大之役，彼得封他为加利利亲王；他在亚该亚作战多年后，于1370年与母亲把当地的权利让予塔兰托的腓力。他死于塞浦路斯，没有子嗣。

en: Isabella of Ibelin (died 1315) was the daughter of Baldwin d'Ibelin, lord of Korakou in Cilician Armenia, and Margaret Embriaco of Giblet. In 1303 she married Guy d'Ibelin, lord of Nicosia, who died in 1308. Their daughter Alix became the second wife of Hugh IV.
zh: 伊莎贝拉·德·伊贝林（卒于1315年）是奇里乞亚的科拉库领主鲍德温·德·伊贝林与吉布莱的玛格丽特·恩布里亚科之女。1303年嫁尼科西亚领主居伊·德·伊贝林，1308年守寡，女儿阿丽克斯后为于格四世的第二任妻子。

en: Isabella of Ibelin (1241–1324) was queen of Cyprus and Jerusalem by marriage to Hugh III. The daughter of Guy d'Ibelin, marshal and constable of Cyprus, she wed Hugh of Antioch on 23 January 1255; her kinsmen helped him succeed the childless Hugh II in 1267, and he claimed Jerusalem in 1268. Widowed in 1284, she saw her sons John I and Henry II crowned. When Amalric deposed Henry in 1306, she and her brother Philip backed the king; after Amalric's murder in 1310 she secured Henry's restoration and thereafter dominated his court.
zh: 伊莎贝拉·德·伊贝林（1241—1324）嫁与塞浦路斯的于格三世，成为塞浦路斯与耶路撒冷王后。她是塞浦路斯王国元帅兼统帅居伊·德·伊贝林之女，1255年1月23日嫁给安条克的于格；凭借伊贝林家族的支持，于格于1267年继承无嗣的于格二世之位，并于1268年取得耶路撒冷王位。1284年守寡后，她的儿子约翰一世与亨利二世相继即位。1306年阿马尔里克废黜亨利，她与弟弟腓力仍支持国王；1310年阿马尔里克遇刺后，她促成亨利复位，此后左右着亨利的宫廷。

en: Isabella of Cyprus (before 1216–1264), daughter of King Hugh I of Cyprus and Alice of Champagne, in 1233 married Henry of Antioch, son of Prince Bohemond IV; their son Hugh, born around 1235, later ruled Cyprus and Jerusalem as Hugh III. While her young nephew Hugh II was king, she was heir presumptive to Cyprus but yielded the regency to her son. In 1263 she claimed the regency of the Kingdom of Jerusalem at Acre, but its High Court granted her limited powers. She returned to Cyprus in 1264 after Hugh was made its bailli. She died later that year and was buried in Nicosia.
zh: 吕西尼昂的伊莎贝尔（1216年前—1264）是塞浦路斯国王于格一世与香槟的阿丽丝之女。1233年，她嫁给安条克亲王博希蒙德四世之子安条克的亨利；儿子于格约生于1235年，后来成为统治塞浦路斯和耶路撒冷的于格三世。她的年幼侄子于格二世在位期间，伊莎贝尔是塞浦路斯的推定继承人，但把摄政权让给了儿子。1263年，她在阿卡主张耶路撒冷王国的摄政权，但王国高级法院只授予她有限的权力。1264年于格被任命为该王国的巴伊后她返回塞浦路斯，同年晚些时候去世，葬于尼科西亚。

en: James I of Lusignan (1334–1398), a younger son of King Hugh IV of Cyprus and Alice of Ibelin, held the title of constable of Jerusalem by 1369. When the Genoese invaded Cyprus in 1373 he successfully defended Kyrenia; the next year he left the island under a treaty and was captured at Rhodes and taken to Genoa, where his son Janus was born. Chosen as king after his nephew Peter II died in 1382, he agreed to Genoese terms for his release in 1383, but was returned to captivity after opposition in Cyprus. He returned and was crowned at Nicosia in 1385, was crowned King of Jerusalem in 1389, and assumed the title of King of Armenia in 1393. He died at Nicosia in 1398 and Janus succeeded him.
zh: 雅克一世·德·吕西尼昂（1334—1398）是塞浦路斯国王于格四世与伊贝林的艾丽斯的小儿子，至迟于1369年拥有耶路撒冷统帅的头衔。1373年热那亚人入侵塞浦路斯，他在凯里尼亚成功抵抗；次年依和约离岛后，他在罗得岛被捕并押往热那亚，儿子雅努斯即出生在囚禁之中。1382年侄子彼得二世去世后，他被推选为国王，1383年接受热那亚人的释放条件，却因塞浦路斯的反对而再次被押回。1385年，他返国在尼科西亚加冕，1389年加冕为耶路撒冷国王，1393年又采用亚美尼亚国王的头衔。1398年他在尼科西亚去世，雅努斯继位。

en: John of Lusignan (1329–1375), a son of King Hugh IV of Cyprus and Alice of Ibelin, married Constance of Sicily in 1343. He became titular Prince of Antioch in 1345 and later served as constable and regent of Cyprus. In 1350 he married Alice of Ibelin. In 1369 he led the Cypriot fleet against Mamluk ports, sacking Botron and Tartus, raiding as far as Latakia and Alexandria and storming Sidon before returning to Famagusta. Implicated in the murder of his brother King Peter I, he was killed in Nicosia in 1375 at the urging of Queen Eleanor and the Genoese.
zh: 吕西尼昂的约翰（1329—1375）是塞浦路斯国王于格四世与伊贝林的艾丽斯之子，1343年娶西西里的科斯坦察。他于1345年成为名义上的安条克亲王，后任塞浦路斯统帅与摄政。1350年，他再娶伊贝林的艾丽斯。1369年，他率领塞浦路斯舰队袭击马穆鲁克人的港口，洗劫巴特伦和塔尔图斯，北上劫掠至拉塔基亚，随后袭击亚历山大港，并攻占西顿，最后返回法马古斯塔。因卷入兄长彼得一世遇刺案，1375年他在埃莉诺王后和热那亚人的指使下于尼科西亚被杀。

en: John I (c. 1268 – 20 May 1285) was the eldest surviving son of King Hugh III of Cyprus and Isabella of Ibelin. When his father died on 3 March 1284 he succeeded to the crowns of Cyprus and Jerusalem and was crowned in Nicosia on 11 May, aged about seventeen. On the mainland only Tyre, held by his aunt Margaret, and Beirut, held by his brother Guy, recognized him; Acre still favored Charles I of Anjou. John died on 20 May 1285, barely a year after his coronation, and his younger brother Henry II succeeded him.
zh: 约翰一世（约1268—1285年5月20日）是塞浦路斯国王于格三世与伊贝林的伊莎贝拉在世的长子。1284年3月3日父亲去世后，他继承塞浦路斯和耶路撒冷两顶王冠，于5月11日在尼科西亚加冕，时年约十七岁。在大陆，只有姑母玛格丽特掌管的提尔和弟弟居伊掌管的贝鲁特承认他的地位，阿卡仍支持安茹的查理。约翰于1285年5月20日去世，距加冕仅约一年，弟弟亨利二世继位。

en: John of Ibelin (c. 1231 – after 1250) was a crusader noble of the House of Ibelin in the Kingdom of Cyprus, the son of Baldwin of Ibelin, seneschal of Cyprus, and Alice of Bethsan. On 17 July 1247 he married Isabelle du Rivet, daughter of Aimery du Rivet and Eschiva of Saint-Omer. Their sons were Gautier and Baldwin, who became lord of Korakou and Vitzada and died in 1313.
zh: 约翰·德·伊贝林（约1231年生，1250年后卒）是伊贝林家族成员、塞浦路斯王国的十字军贵族，为塞浦路斯宫廷总管伊贝林的鲍德温与贝桑的爱丽丝之子。1247年7月17日，他娶艾默里·迪里韦与圣奥梅尔的埃希芙之女伊莎贝尔·迪里韦为妻。两个儿子分别是戈蒂埃和鲍德温；鲍德温后来受封科拉库与维察扎，于1313年去世。

en: John of Ibelin (1215–1266), count of Jaffa and Ascalon, was the son of Philip of Ibelin, bailli of Cyprus, and Alice of Montbéliard. He fled Cyprus in 1229 after Frederick II seized the Ibelin fiefs. He was present at the Battle of Casal Imbert in 1232 and married Maria of Barbaron, sister of King Hethum I of Armenia, around 1240. In 1241 he probably drafted an unfulfilled compromise between his family and the emperor, and he helped take Tyre in 1242. He became count of Jaffa in 1246, joined Louis IX’s crusade at the taking of Damietta in 1249, and as bailli of Jerusalem repulsed an Egyptian attack on Jaffa. In the War of Saint Sabas he backed Venice. He wrote the Livre des assises de Jérusalem, the crusader kingdom’s longest surviving legal treatise. He died in December 1266.
zh: 伊贝林的约翰（1215—1266），雅法-亚实基伦伯爵，是塞浦路斯摄政腓力·德·伊贝林与蒙贝利亚尔的爱丽丝之子。1229年腓特烈二世没收伊贝林家族领地后，他逃离塞浦路斯。他参加了1232年卡萨尔安贝尔战役，约1240年娶亚美尼亚国王海屯一世的姐妹巴巴龙的玛丽亚。1241年他可能起草了家族与皇帝之间的一项妥协方案，但未能实行；1242年他参与攻取提尔。1246年他成为雅法伯爵，1249年随路易九世的十字军参加攻打达米埃塔，后任耶路撒冷摄政，击退了埃及人对雅法的进攻。圣萨巴斯战争中他支持威尼斯。他撰写的《耶路撒冷法令集》是这个十字军王国留存最长的法学著作。他于1266年12月去世。

en: Margaret of Lusignan was a daughter of King Hugh IV of Cyprus and Alice of Ibelin. In 1347 or 1349 she married Gautier de Dampierre-sur-Salon, seneschal of Cyprus, who was still alive after 1373.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·吕西尼昂是塞浦路斯国王于格四世与伊贝林的艾丽斯之女，于1347或1349年嫁给塞浦路斯总管戈蒂埃·德·当皮埃尔-叙萨隆，此人1373年后仍在世。

en: Maria d'Ibelin (1294–before 1318), daughter of Guy d'Ibelin, titular count of Jaffa, married Hugh of Lusignan, later Hugh IV of Cyprus, about 1307, but died before he took the throne. Her son Guy of Lusignan became constable of Cyprus and titular prince of Galilee.
zh: 玛丽亚·德·伊贝林（1294—1318年前）是雅法名义伯爵居伊·德·伊贝林之女，约1307年嫁给后来的塞浦路斯国王于格四世，在他即位前便已去世。她的儿子吕西尼昂的居伊曾任塞浦路斯统帅、名义上加利利亲王。

en: Maria d'Ibelin (born c. 1272) was the daughter of Philip d'Ibelin, constable of Cyprus, and Simone de Montbéliard, whose father Eudes de Montbéliard was bailli and constable of Jerusalem. In 1290 Maria married Guy d'Ibelin, titular count of Jaffa and Ascalon, and was styled lady of Ascalon and Naumachia. Her children included Philip and John, who died at Kyrenia in 1316, Hugh, later seneschal of Jerusalem, and Maria, the first wife of King Hugh IV of Cyprus.
zh: 玛丽亚·德·伊贝林（约1272年生）是塞浦路斯统帅腓力·德·伊贝林与西蒙娜·德·蒙贝利亚尔之女，其外祖父厄德·德·蒙贝利亚尔曾任耶路撒冷代政官兼统帅。1290年，玛丽亚嫁给雅法与亚实基伦名义伯爵居伊·德·伊贝林，号亚实基伦与瑙马基亚女领主。她的子女包括1316年卒于凯里尼亚的腓力与约翰、后来官至耶路撒冷总管的于格，以及塞浦路斯国王于格四世的第一任妻子玛丽亚。

en: Mary of Lusignan (Marie de Lusignan, 1215–1251) was the eldest daughter of King Hugh I of Cyprus and Alice of Champagne, and a granddaughter of Queen Isabella I of Jerusalem. A betrothal to Peter I of Brittany was called off in 1229 because of their kinship, and in 1233 she married Count Walter IV of Brienne, becoming countess of Brienne. Her husband was captured leading the crusader army at La Forbie and murdered in Cairo in October 1244, leaving their sons John and Hugh. Mary retired to the Cypriot court and died there on 5 July 1251.
zh: 吕西尼昂的玛丽（1215—1251）是塞浦路斯国王于格一世与香槟的阿丽丝的长女，也是耶路撒冷女王伊莎贝拉一世的外孙女。1229年，她与布列塔尼公爵皮埃尔一世的婚约因血亲关系被取消；1233年她嫁给布列讷伯爵沃尔特四世，成为布列讷伯爵夫人。1244年10月，沃尔特率领十字军在拉佛比战败被俘，在开罗遇害，遗下儿子约翰和于格。玛丽此后长居塞浦路斯宫廷，于1251年7月5日去世。

en: Maria of Armenia (died around 1310) was a daughter of Hethum I, king of Cilician Armenia, and Queen Isabella. In 1266 she married Guy d'Ibelin, son of Baldwin d'Ibelin, seneschal of Cyprus, linking the Armenian royal house with the leading Frankish noble family of Cyprus.
zh: 亚美尼亚的玛丽亚（约卒于1310年）是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王海屯一世与伊莎贝拉女王之女。1266年，她嫁给塞浦路斯总管鲍德温·德·伊贝林之子居伊·德·伊贝林，使亚美尼亚王室与塞浦路斯首屈一指的法兰克贵族家族联姻。

en: Philip of Ibelin (1253–1318) was seneschal of the Kingdom of Cyprus from 1302 and also held the seneschalcy of Jerusalem. A son of Guy of Ibelin, constable of Cyprus, and Philippa Barlais, he married Maria of Hamousse around 1280; their marriage produced no children. Around 1295 he married Maria Embriaco, lady of Gibelet and daughter of Guy II Embriaco. His son Guy by the second marriage succeeded him as seneschal, his daughter Isabella married Ferdinand of Majorca, titular prince of Achaea, in 1315, and his daughter Helvis married Duke Henry II of Brunswick-Grubenhagen in 1330. He died at Nicosia on 25 November 1318.
zh: 伊贝林的菲利普（1253—1318）于1302年起任塞浦路斯王国宫廷长，并兼领耶路撒冷宫廷长之职。他是塞浦路斯统帅伊贝林的居伊与菲利帕·贝尔莱之子，约1280年迎娶哈穆塞的玛丽亚，两人没有子嗣。约1295年，他续娶朱拜勒女领主玛丽亚·恩布里亚科，她是居伊二世·恩布里亚科之女。第二任妻子所生的儿子居伊承袭宫廷长；女儿伊莎贝尔于1315年嫁给亚该亚名义亲王马略卡的费尔南多，女儿埃尔维丝于1330年嫁给不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根公爵亨利二世。1318年11月25日，他在尼科西亚去世。

en: Philip of Ibelin (c. 1233–1304) was constable of the crusader Kingdom of Cyprus. The son of Baldwin of Ibelin, the kingdom's seneschal, and Alice of Bethsan, he married around 1253 Simone of Montbéliard, whose father Odo of Montbéliard was bailli and constable of Jerusalem and whose mother Echive of Saint-Omer held the principality of Galilee. Their son Balian bore the titular title prince of Galilee until his death in 1315, and their daughter Maria married Guy of Ibelin, count of Jaffa and Ascalon. Philip died in 1304.
zh: 伊贝林的菲利普（约1233—1304）任十字军国家塞浦路斯王国的统帅。他是塞浦路斯宫廷长伊贝林的博杜安与贝桑的爱丽丝之子，约1253年迎娶蒙贝利亚尔的西蒙娜；西蒙娜之父厄德·德·蒙贝利亚尔曾任耶路撒冷王国摄政兼统帅，其母埃斯基夫·德·圣奥梅尔领有加利利亲王国。两人的儿子巴利安保有加利利亲王的虚衔，直至1315年去世；女儿玛丽亚嫁给雅法与亚实基伦伯爵伊贝林的居伊。菲利普于1304年去世。

en: Philip of Ibelin (1180–1227) was a younger son of Balian of Ibelin and Maria Komnene, widow of King Amalric. First recorded in 1206 escorting his niece Alice to Cyprus for her wedding to King Hugh I, he settled on the island with his brother John of Beirut before 1217, probably after quarrelling with John of Brienne. When Hugh I died in 1218, Philip became bailli, or regent, for the infant King Henry I, and built Ibelin power on the island. By his wife Alice of Montbéliard he fathered John, the future count of Jaffa, and died in 1227.
zh: 伊贝林的腓力（1180—1227）是伊贝林的贝里昂与国王阿马尔里克遗孀玛利亚·科穆宁娜较年幼的儿子。史书最早于1206年提到他：他护送侄女爱丽丝前往塞浦路斯与国王于格一世成婚。1217年之前，他和兄长贝鲁特的约翰一同定居该岛，可能是因为与布里耶纳的约翰发生争执。1218年于格一世去世，腓力出任幼王亨利一世的摄政（巴伊），借此奠定伊贝林家族在岛上的权势。他与妻子蒙贝利亚尔的爱丽丝生下后来成为雅法伯爵的约翰，于1227年去世。

en: Philip d'Ibelin (died 1315 or 1316) was the eldest son of Guy d'Ibelin, titular count of Jaffa and Ascalon, and Maria d'Ibelin. He succeeded as count in 1304 and died at Kyrenia in 1315 or 1316, the title passing to his brother Hugh.
zh: 腓力·德·伊贝林（卒于1315或1316年）是雅法与亚实基伦名义伯爵居伊·德·伊贝林与玛丽亚·德·伊贝林的长子，1304年袭爵，1315或1316年卒于凯里尼亚，爵位转归弟弟于格。

en: Peter I (1328–1369) was the king of Cyprus who spent his reign trying to raise a crusade for Jerusalem. Son of Hugh IV and Alice of Ibelin, he was made titular count of Tripoli in 1346 and, after his elder brother Guy died, was crowned at Nicosia on 24 November 1358 in his father’s lifetime, passing over Guy’s son. He was crowned titular king of Jerusalem at Famagusta in 1360, and in 1361 took Attaleia from the Turks. In 1363 he went to Avignon, where Urban V made John II of France captain general of a new crusade, and he persuaded them to aim at Alexandria rather than Adrianople. His fleet of 165 ships took the city in October 1365 and plundered it for a week before withdrawing. His quarrels with the nobles ended on 17 January 1369, when three knights killed him at Nicosia. His son Peter II succeeded him.
zh: 彼得一世（1328—1369）是塞浦路斯国王，在位期间一直奔走筹划夺回耶路撒冷的十字军。他是于格四世与伊贝林的爱丽丝之子，1346年受封名义上的的黎波里伯爵；兄长居伊去世后，他于1358年11月24日在父亲生前于尼科西亚加冕，居伊之子因此落选。1360年，他在法马古斯塔加冕为名义上的耶路撒冷国王；1361年从突厥人手中夺取安塔利亚。1363年他前往阿维尼翁，乌尔班五世任命法王约翰二世为新十字军的总指挥，彼得说服他们把目标定在亚历山大而非阿德里安堡。1365年10月，他的165艘战船攻占该城，洗劫一周后撤军。他与贵族积怨甚深，1369年1月17日，三名骑士在尼科西亚将他杀害。其子彼得二世继位。

en: Bolesław II (c. 1253–1313), younger son of Siemowit I of Masovia, ruled Masovia jointly with his brother Konrad II after 1262 and received Płock in 1275. In 1279 he married Sophia, daughter of the Lithuanian grand duke Traidenis. After Leszek II the Black died in 1288 he seized Kraków and Sandomierz and claimed the senioral throne, but withdrew after the Battle of Siewierz in 1289. On Konrad II's death in 1294 he reunited all Masovia, later promoted Warsaw, and in 1310 enfeoffed his sons Siemowit II with Warsaw and Trojden I with Czersk.
zh: 波列斯瓦夫二世（约1253—1313）是马佐夫舍的谢莫维特一世幼子。1262年父亲死后，他与兄长康拉德二世共治马佐夫舍，1275年分得普沃茨克；1279年娶立陶宛大公特莱德尼斯之女索菲亚。1288年莱谢克二世死后，他一度夺取克拉科夫和桑多梅日，争夺大公之位，但在1289年谢维日战役后退回领地。1294年康拉德二世去世，他重新统一整个马佐夫舍。晚年他扶持华沙发展，1310年将华沙和切尔斯克分别封给儿子谢莫维特二世与特罗伊登一世。

en: Casimir I of Warsaw (1329/1331 – November/December 1355) was a Piast prince, traditionally the youngest son of Trojden I of Czersk and Maria of Galicia. After Trojden's death in 1341 he ruled Czersk jointly with his brother Siemowit III, and the brothers inherited Rawa in 1345. In 1349 Casimir received Warsaw as his own duchy, and in 1351 he gained Sochaczew and did homage to Casimir III of Poland. He died unmarried in 1355 and was buried in Płock Cathedral, whereupon Warsaw reverted to the Polish crown.
zh: 华沙公爵卡齐米日一世（1329/1331—1355年11至12月间）是皮亚斯特家族王公，传统上被视为切尔斯克的特洛杰登一世与加利奇的玛丽亚的幼子。1341年父亲去世后，他与兄长谢莫维特三世共治切尔斯克，1345年兄弟俩一同继承拉瓦。1349年分家，卡齐米日得到华沙；1351年他又获得索哈切夫，并向波兰国王卡齐米日三世行臣服礼。他1355年未婚而卒，葬于普沃茨克主教座堂，华沙随即收归波兰王室。

en: Maria of Galicia (before 1293 – 11 January 1341) was a Rurikid princess, the daughter of Yuri I, King of Galicia-Volhynia, and Euphemia of Kuyavia. Before 1310 she married Trojden I of Masovia, to whom she traditionally bore Yuri II Boleslav, Euphemia, Siemowit III and Casimir I of Warsaw. When her brothers Andrew and Leo II were killed in 1323, she and her niece Euphemia inherited their claims, and she later helped her son Yuri II Boleslav rule Galicia. She died in January 1341, two months before her husband.
zh: 加利奇的玛丽亚（1293年前—1341年1月11日）是留里克王朝公主，加利奇-沃伦国王尤里一世与库亚维的尤菲米娅之女。1310年之前，她嫁给马佐夫舍公爵特洛杰登一世，传统记载两人生有尤里二世·波列斯瓦夫、尤菲米娅、谢莫维特三世和华沙的卡齐米日一世四个子女。1323年她的兄弟安德烈和列夫二世战死，她与侄女尤菲米娅继承了他们的权利，后来她辅佐儿子尤里二世·波列斯瓦夫统治加利奇。她于1341年1月去世，比丈夫早两个月。

en: Siemowit I (c. 1215–1262) was a Piast prince, the sixth son of Konrad I of Masovia. He held Czersk from 1247 and inherited Masovia from his brother Bolesław I in 1248. To counter Baltic raiders he allied with Daniel of Halych, married Daniel's daughter Pereyaslava, and joined campaigns against the Yotvingians in 1248, 1253 and 1255–1256, while also backing the Teutonic Order. In spring 1262 Lithuania and Rus' invaded under King Mindaugas; on 23 June 1262 the fortress of Jazdów fell through betrayal and Siemowit was killed, his son Konrad II taken captive.
zh: 谢莫维特一世（约1215—1262）是皮亚斯特王朝王公，马佐夫舍的康拉德一世第六子。他自1247年起领有切尔斯克，1248年继承兄长波列斯瓦夫一世的马佐夫舍。为抵御波罗的海部族袭扰，他与加利奇的达尼洛夫结盟，娶其女佩列亚斯拉娃，并于1248、1253和1255至1256年参加征讨约特温吉亚人的战事，同时支持条顿骑士团。1262年春，立陶宛与罗斯在明道加斯率领下入侵；1262年6月23日，亚兹杜夫城堡因内应陷落，谢莫维特被杀，其子康拉德二世被俘。

en: Siemowit III (c. 1320 – 16 June 1381) was a Piast duke of Masovia, the second son of Trojden I and Maria of Galicia. In 1341 he and his brother Casimir inherited Czersk, adding Rawa in 1345; in 1349 he kept Czersk, Liw and Rawa while Casimir took Warsaw. In 1351 the brothers recognized Casimir III of Poland as suzerain, and in 1355 the king granted him Warsaw. When Casimir III died in 1370, Masovia regained its independence and its lost western lands; Siemowit issued a customary law code in 1377 and reformed its coinage. He died in 1381.
zh: 谢莫维特三世（约1320—1381年6月16日）是马佐夫舍的皮亚斯特公爵，特洛杰登一世与加利奇的玛丽亚之次子。1341年他与弟弟卡齐米日继承切尔斯克公国，1345年又继承拉瓦；1349年兄弟分家，他领有切尔斯克、利夫和拉瓦，卡齐米日得到华沙。1351年兄弟俩承认波兰国王卡齐米日三世为宗主，1355年国王又把华沙交给他。1370年卡齐米日三世去世后，马佐夫舍重获独立并收回西部失地；谢莫维特于1377年颁布习惯法典，改革货币。他于1381年去世。

en: Trojden I (1284/1286 – 13 March 1341) was a Piast duke who ruled Czersk from 1310 and, after his father Bolesław II of Płock died in 1313, Warsaw and Liw as well, giving him all of eastern Masovia. Around 1310 he married Maria, daughter of Yuri I of Halych-Volhynia. When the Rurikid line ended in 1323, he placed his son Bolesław on the Ruthenian throne as Yuri II. He maneuvered between Poland and the Teutonic Order, joining the Order at Brodnica in 1326, and in 1340 sold his Ruthenian claim to Casimir III after Yuri II was poisoned.
zh: 特洛杰登一世（1284/1286—1341年3月13日）是皮亚斯特家族的公爵，1310年受封切尔斯克，1313年父亲普沃茨克的波列斯瓦夫二世去世后又得到华沙和利夫，领有整个东马佐夫舍。约1310年，他娶加利奇-沃伦国王尤里一世之女玛丽亚。1323年鲁塞尼亚的留里克世系断绝，他把儿子波列斯瓦夫扶上鲁塞尼亚王位，称尤里二世。他在波兰与条顿骑士团之间周旋，1326年在布罗德尼察加入骑士团一方，1340年尤里二世被毒杀后把对鲁塞尼亚的继承权卖给卡齐米日三世，次年去世。

en: Anh Tư, posthumously honoured as Consort Dowager Minh Từ (died 1365), was a consort of the Trần emperor Trần Minh Tông and the mother of two emperors. Born of the Lê clan, she was titled Anh Tư Nguyên phi. She bore Minh Tông's second and third sons: Trần Vượng in 1319, who took the throne in 1329 as Hiến Tông, and Trần Phủ in 1321, the future Nghệ Tông. When Hiến Tông died in 1341, though, Minh Tông enthroned the son of his empress Hiến Từ, Dụ Tông. Anh Tư shared a mother with that empress and was the aunt of Hồ Quý Ly. She died in the eleventh lunar month of 1365; once Nghệ Tông took the throne in 1370, he posthumously honoured her early in 1371.
zh: 英姿，即明慈皇太妃黎氏（？—1365），是陈朝陈明宗的妃嫔，生育了两位皇帝。她本姓黎，受封英姿元妃，生下明宗的次子和三子：1319年生陈旺，1329年即位为宪宗；1321年生陈暊，即后来的艺宗。1341年宪宗去世后，明宗却立皇后宪慈所生的裕宗为帝。英姿与宪慈皇后同母，也是胡季犛的姑母。1365年十一月去世；1370年艺宗即位后，于1371年正月追尊生母为明慈皇太妃。

en: Trần Thái Tông (Trần Cảnh; 17 July 1218 – 5 May 1277) was the founding emperor of Vietnam's Trần dynasty. In 1226 his uncle Trần Thủ Độ arranged his marriage to the last Lý ruler, Empress Lý Chiêu Hoàng, who abdicated to him. In 1257 Mongol envoys demanded passage through Đại Việt to attack the Song; after they were imprisoned, Uriyangkhadai invaded. The emperor led his army from an elephant, but was defeated. Uriyangkhadai forced the court to abandon Thăng Long and held the capital nine days before withdrawing, after which Thái Tông agreed to triennial tribute. A learned Buddhist writer, he authored the Khóa Hư Lục. He abdicated in 1258 for his son Trần Hoảng and died as retired emperor.
zh: 陈太宗，名陈煚（1218年7月17日—1277年5月5日），是越南陈朝的开国皇帝。1226年，叔父陈守度安排他迎娶李朝末代君主李昭皇，李昭皇随即禅位，陈朝由此建立。1257年蒙古使者要求借道大越攻宋，使者被囚后，兀良合台率军入侵。陈煚骑象领兵，最终战败。兀良合台的军队迫使朝廷撤离升龙，占领都城九天后撤兵，陈煚此后同意三年一贡。他精通佛学，著有《课虚录》。1258年他禅位给儿子陈晃，以太上皇身份度过余生，直至去世。

en: Trần Dụ Tông (personal name Trần Hạo, 22 November 1336 – 25 May 1369) was the seventh Trần emperor of Đại Việt, reigning from 1341 to 1369. The tenth son of Trần Minh Tông, he was only five when chosen after his brother Hiến Tông died without an heir, and his father ruled as retired emperor until 1357, with government at first running well. Once he governed himself, the Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư records, Dụ Tông was keen on affairs of state but fonder of pleasure: he built palaces, gambled and kept exotic birds and beasts. He died without a son in 1369, and his will named Trần Nhật Lễ, adopted son of his late brother Prince Cung Túc, as successor. When Nhật Lễ tried to take the surname Dương, he was overthrown by Minh Tông’s third son, Trần Phủ.
zh: 陈裕宗（讳暭，1336年11月22日—1369年5月25日）是大越陈朝第七位皇帝，1341—1369年在位。他是陈明宗第十子，兄宪宗无嗣而终后被选中继位，年仅五岁，1357年之前朝政由太上皇裁决，政局起初安定。亲政后，据《大越史记全书》记载，裕宗虽热衷政事，却更爱享乐：大兴宫殿，沉迷赌博，四处豢养珍禽异兽。1369年他无嗣而终，遗诏传位给已故兄长恭肃王的养子陈日礼。日礼企图改姓杨，被明宗的第三子陈暊推翻。

en: Empress Hiến Từ (born 1299, died in the twelfth lunar month of 1369), also called the Lệ Thánh empress, belonged to the main ruling line of the Trần and was the chief consort of Trần Minh Tông and mother of Emperor Trần Dụ Tông. At court she was known for her kindness and tact, and was counted among those praised as ‘a Yao and Shun among women’. Made empress in 1323, she became empress dowager in 1342 and bore the princes Trần Nguyên Dục and Trần Hạo, as well as Princess Ngọc Tha. After Minh Tông died in 1357, she followed his wish that she remain at the Thánh Từ palace. After Dụ Tông died in 1369, she supported the accession of his adopted heir Dương Nhật Lễ; when she came to regret it, Nhật Lễ had her poisoned.
zh: 宪慈皇后（1299年生，卒于1369年农历十二月），又称俪圣皇后，出身陈朝的正统统治家系，是陈明宗的皇后、陈裕宗的生母。她在宫中以仁厚和处世得体著称，被誉为“女中尧舜”。1323年她被册立为皇后，1342年尊为皇太后，生下陈元昱、陈暭以及公主玉瑳。1357年明宗去世后，她遵从其遗愿，居住在圣慈宫。1369年裕宗死后，她支持其养子杨日礼继位；待她心生悔意，杨日礼便将她毒杀。

en: Hồ Quý Ly (1336–?) was a Trần-dynasty official and general from Thanh Hóa who founded Vietnam's short-lived Hồ dynasty. He rose through royal marriages and command in the wars against Champa, becoming chief minister in 1387 and dominating young Trần emperors. In 1388, after a court plot against him was exposed, he persuaded the senior king to depose Trần Phế Đế. His reforms changed the civil service examinations and introduced paper banknotes and a new capital at Tây Đô. In 1400 he deposed the last Trần ruler, took the throne and renamed the kingdom Đại Ngu, then abdicated to his son Hồ Hán Thương in 1401. The Ming invasion of 1406–1407 overthrew him; he was captured and exiled to China.
zh: 胡季犛（1336—？）是越南陈朝的大臣与将领，清化人，后建立短命的胡朝。他凭借与王室联姻和对占城战争中的军功崛起，1387年受命辅政，接连掌控幼主。1388年，朝中谋除他的计划泄露后，他说服上皇废黜陈废帝。他推行改革，改订科举、发行纸币，并营建新都西都。1400年他废黜陈朝末帝自立，改国号为大虞，1401年传位于儿子胡汉苍。1406—1407年明朝出兵攻灭胡朝，他被俘后押送中国。

en: Trần Thánh Tông (Trần Hoảng; 12 October 1240 – 3 July 1290) was the second emperor of Vietnam's Trần dynasty, ruling Đại Việt from 1258 to 1278. As crown prince he witnessed the first Mongol invasion in 1257. His father Thái Tông enthroned him after the invasion and continued to govern with him as retired emperor until 1277. Thánh Tông abdicated in 1278 for his son Trần Khâm (Nhân Tông). As retired emperor he and his son were supreme commanders against the second and third Yuan invasions: after early defeats in 1285 they won at Hàm Tử and Chương Dương and retook Thăng Long; on 8 March 1288 the Yuan fleet was destroyed at Bạch Đằng. He died in 1290.
zh: 陈圣宗，名陈晃（1240年10月12日—1290年7月3日），越南陈朝第二位皇帝，1258年至1278年统治大越。1257年第一次蒙古入侵时，他还是太子。入侵结束后，父亲太宗将皇位传给他，并以太上皇身份与他共同治理，直至1277年。1278年，圣宗禅位给儿子陈昑，即后来的仁宗。成为太上皇后，他与儿子在第二、第三次元朝入侵时同为最高统帅：1285年越军先败后胜，在咸子关和章阳获胜、收复升龙；1288年3月8日，元朝水师在白藤江覆灭。他于1290年去世。

en: Trần Nhân Tông (Trần Khâm; 7 December 1258 – 16 December 1308), the third Trần emperor, ruled Đại Việt from 1278 to 1293. As the Yuan threat grew after the fall of the Song, he and retired emperor Thánh Tông gathered the court at Bình Than in 1282 to discuss war and appointed Trần Quốc Tuấn commander-in-chief in 1283. They led resistance to the Yuan invasions: after initial defeats in 1285, their forces defeated Sogetu at Hàm Tử and Chương Dương and retook Thăng Long, and in March 1288 Trần Quốc Tuấn destroyed the Yuan fleet at Bạch Đằng. After abdicating to his son Trần Thuyên in 1293 he became a monk in 1295 and founded the Trúc Lâm school at Yên Tử. In 1306 his daughter Huyền Trân married the Champa king for two provinces.
zh: 陈仁宗（陈昑；1258年12月7日—1308年12月16日）是陈朝第三位皇帝，1278年至1293年统治大越。宋朝灭亡后元朝威胁日增，他与太上皇圣宗于1282年召集朝臣在平滩议战，1283年任命陈国峻为统帅。他们一同指挥了两次抗元战争：1285年越军先败后胜，在咸子关和章阳击败唆都，重返升龙；1288年3月，陈国峻在白藤江歼灭元朝水师。1293年他禅位给儿子陈烇，1295年出家，在安子山创立竹林禅派。1306年，他将女儿玄珍公主嫁给占城国王，换得两处州郡。

en: Lê Văn Hưu (1230–1322) was a Trần-dynasty official and historian from Đông Sơn in Thanh Hóa. Placing second in the 1247 civil service examination at seventeen, he rose to minister of war and head of the national history office. In 1272 he presented the Đại Việt sử ký, a thirty-chapter annalistic history from Triệu Đà to Empress Lý Chiêu Hoàng modeled on the Spring and Autumn Annals, Vietnam's first official history. Though since lost, its text and comments survive in Ngô Sĩ Liên's Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư and other later works.
zh: 黎文休（1230—1322）是越南陈朝官员、史学家，清化东山县人。1247年，他十七岁便科举及第，高中榜眼，后官至兵部尚书、国史院监修。1272年，他奉敕编成《大越史记》三十卷，记事上起赵武帝、下至李昭皇，体例仿中国《春秋》，是越南第一部编年体正史。原书后来散佚，但其内容与史评赖吴士连《大越史记全书》等后世史籍得以保存。

en: Trần Minh Tông (personal name Trần Mạnh, 1300–1357) was the fifth Trần emperor of Đại Việt, who reigned over the dynasty's high summer. The fourth son of Trần Anh Tông, he was named crown prince in 1305 and enthroned at fourteen in 1314. Chronicles praise him for trusting able Confucian officials such as Trương Hán Siêu and Phạm Sư Mạnh; he kept Đại Việt prosperous and on stable terms with the Yuan, although Champa shook off his overlordship in 1326. In 1329 he abdicated to his son Trần Vượng (Hiến Tông) but as retired emperor still settled court affairs. When Hiến Tông died in 1341 he placed another son, Trần Hạo (Dụ Tông), on the throne, and spent years driving back Ai Lao and Ngưu Hống raids on the western frontier. He also wrote poetry, but ordered most of it burned as he lay dying in 1357. Dụ Tông then neglected government, and Đại Việt began to decline.
zh: 陈明宗（讳奣，1300—1357）是大越陈朝第五位皇帝，在位时正值陈朝的鼎盛期。他是陈英宗第四子，1305年被立为皇太子，1314年年方十四岁登基。史书称赞他重用张汉超、范师孟等有才干的儒臣，维持了国内的兴盛，与元朝保持稳定关系，但占城于1326年摆脱了大越的臣属地位。1329年他禅位给儿子陈旺（宪宗），以太上皇身份继续裁断朝政。1341年宪宗去世，他又立另一子陈暭（裕宗）为帝，并花了多年工夫抵御西部边境哀牢和牛吼的入侵。他也写诗，1357年临终时却下令烧毁大部分诗稿。其后裕宗荒废朝政，大越国势转衰。

en: Princess Ngọc Tha, titled Princess Thiên Ninh and also Princess Quốc Hinh, was a daughter of Emperor Trần Minh Tông and Empress Hiến Từ and a sister of the emperor Trần Dụ Tông. She received the title Thiên Ninh in 1342 and married Trần Kham. After Dương Nhật Lễ took the throne, he killed her mother. In the ninth lunar month of 1370, her two sons joined a failed attempt by Trần kinsmen to kill Nhật Lễ and were themselves killed. The following month she met her half-brother Prince Cung Định Trần Phủ and urged him to raise an army against Nhật Lễ. Her stand helped bring about his fall and her brother's accession as Trần Nghệ Tông.
zh: 玉瑳，封天宁公主，又称国馨公主，是陈明宗与宪慈皇后之女、陈裕宗的同母姐妹。她于1342年受封天宁公主，嫁给陈堪。杨日礼即位后杀害了她的母亲。1370年农历九月，她的两个儿子随陈朝宗室谋杀日礼，事败被杀。次月她与异母兄恭定王陈暊会合，劝他起兵讨伐日礼。她的推动促成了杨日礼的倒台，其兄陈暊随后即位，是为陈艺宗。

en: Trần Nguyên Dục (died 1364), titled Prince Cung Túc, was the eldest legitimate son of Emperor Trần Minh Tông and Empress Hiến Từ, and an elder brother of Emperor Trần Dụ Tông. His extravagance displeased his father, who passed him over for the throne when Hiến Tông died. Nguyên Dục took the wife of an entertainer named Dương as a concubine and adopted her son Dương Nhật Lễ, raising him inside the imperial family. Nguyên Dục died before the crisis: when Dụ Tông died without an heir in 1369, his will gave the throne to Nhật Lễ. The adopted outsider ruled little more than a year before the Trần clan overthrew him in 1370.
zh: 陈元昱（？—1364），封恭肃王，是陈明宗与宪慈皇后的嫡长子，陈裕宗的同母兄长。他奢侈浪费，不得父亲欢心，宪宗去世后未获继位。元昱纳优伶杨姜之妻为妾，收养她的儿子杨日礼，养于宫中。元昱在危机爆发前便已去世：1369年裕宗无嗣而终，依遗诏由日礼继位。这位外姓养子在位仅一年有余，1370年即被陈朝宗室推翻。

en: Trần Nguyên Trác (1319–1370), titled Prince Cung Tĩnh, was a son of Emperor Trần Minh Tông. After the childless Dụ Tông died in 1369 and Dương Nhật Lễ took the throne, Nhật Lễ made Nguyên Trác his thái tể in charge of the court's troops. When the new ruler moved to change the imperial surname back to Dương, Nguyên Trác and his son Trần Nguyên Tiết plotted to kill him. Exposed, both were executed in the ninth lunar month of 1370. His brother Trần Phủ and Trần Kính withdrew to Đà Giang and gathered forces for another attempt; two months after the failed plot, Phủ overthrew Nhật Lễ and restored the Trần.
zh: 陈元晫（1319—1370），封恭靖王，是陈明宗之子。1369年陈裕宗无嗣而终、杨日礼入继后，新君任他为太宰，执掌朝中兵权。杨日礼企图把皇姓由陈改回杨，元晫便与儿子陈元节密谋将其刺杀。密谋败露，父子二人于1370年农历九月被杀。其弟陈暊与陈曔退往沱江，聚集力量再次起事；密谋失败两个月后，陈暊推翻杨日礼，复兴陈朝。

en: Trần Nghệ Tông (personal name Trần Phủ, 20 December 1321 – 6 January 1395) was the ninth Trần emperor of Đại Việt. A son of Trần Minh Tông and the consort Anh Tư, he was Prince Cung Định and a senior minister under Dương Nhật Lễ, the adopted outsider who meant to restore the surname Dương. In the ninth lunar month of 1370 a plot by Trần princes against Nhật Lễ failed, and Phủ withdrew to Đà Giang with Trần Kính to raise forces. His half-sister Princess Thiên Ninh urged him on and joined his march on the capital. Within two months Nhật Lễ was deposed, imprisoned and beaten to death, and Phủ took the throne. He abdicated in 1372, yet as retired emperor ruled through three successors for over twenty years. His favour to his maternal kinsman Hồ Quý Ly let him build the power that destroyed the Trần in 1400, after Nghệ Tông’s death.
zh: 陈艺宗（讳暊，1321年12月20日—1395年1月6日）是大越陈朝第九位皇帝。他是陈明宗与英姿元妃之子，原封恭定王，在杨日礼朝中位居太师。杨日礼是被收养入宫的外姓人，企图恢复杨姓。1370年农历九月，陈朝宗室谋杀日礼失败，陈暊与陈曔退往沱江聚集力量。异母妹妹天宁公主劝他起兵，并与他一同进军京城。两个月内，杨日礼被废黜、囚禁，随后被打死，陈暊登基。他在位不足两年，1372年便禅位，却以太上皇身份历经三任君主、执掌朝政二十余年。他重用外戚胡季犛，使其势力坐大，最终在艺宗去世后的1400年灭亡陈朝。

en: Trần Quốc Chẩn (19 February 1281 – 1328), titled Huệ Vũ đại vương, was a Trần general and the second son of Emperor Nhân Tông. In 1318 retired emperor Anh Tông sent him with Phạm Ngũ Lão to campaign against Champa. His daughter married his nephew Emperor Minh Tông as the Hiến Từ empress, making him both the emperor's uncle and father-in-law. In 1328, when he opposed naming a crown prince before his own grandson was born, a bribed retainer falsely accused him of treason, and Minh Tông had him imprisoned without food at Tư Phúc temple, where he died.
zh: 陈国瑱（1281年2月19日—1328年），封号惠武大王，是陈朝大将、陈仁宗次子。1318年，太上皇陈英宗命他与范五老出征占城。他的女儿嫁给侄子陈明宗，即宪慈宣圣皇后，他因此身兼明宗的叔父与岳父。1328年，他反对外孙出生前另立太子，被受贿的家臣诬告谋反，明宗将他关入资福寺、断绝饮食，他最终饿死。

en: Trần Anh Tông (Trần Thuyên; 17 September 1276 – 12 December 1320) was the fourth emperor of the Trần dynasty, ruling Đại Việt from 1293 to 1314. Made crown prince in 1292, he succeeded his father Nhân Tông and kept the peace with the Yuan dynasty, while his general Phạm Ngũ Lão defeated Ai Lao raiders on the western border. Once, too drunk to receive his visiting father, he sought the young scholar Đoàn Nhữ Hài's help in writing a petition for forgiveness; he then appointed Đoàn as a court counselor and gave up drinking. He mounted several campaigns against Champa, and his sister Huyền Trân's marriage to the Champa king extended Đại Việt southward. In 1314 he abdicated to his son Trần Mạnh (Minh Tông) and remained retired emperor until his death.
zh: 陈英宗（陈烇；1276年9月17日—1320年12月12日）是陈朝第四位皇帝，1293年至1314年统治大越。他于1292年被立为太子，次年继承父亲仁宗的皇位，对元朝长期维持和平；西部边境上，名将范五老击败了哀牢的入犯。有一次，他因醉酒未能迎接来访的父亲，便请年轻士人段汝谐代拟请罪表；事后他任命段汝谐为谏官，并戒了酒。他数次对占城用兵，妹妹玄珍公主嫁给占城国王后，大越南疆向南拓展。1314年他禅位给儿子陈奣（陈明宗），以太上皇身份度过余生，直至去世。

en: Trần Hiến Tông (personal name Trần Vượng, 17 May 1319 – 11 June 1341) was the sixth Trần emperor of Đại Việt, reigning from 1329 to 1341. A son of Trần Minh Tông and the consort Anh Tư, he was put on the throne at ten when his father abdicated, but he ruled in name only: the retired emperor settled every matter of state. It was Minh Tông who took the field against the Ngưu Hống rebels in the Đà Giang region and drove back Ai Lao raiders on the western border. Hiến Tông died in 1341 aged twenty-two, without an heir. His father then raised his younger brother Trần Hạo, a boy of five, to the throne and kept control of the court.
zh: 陈宪宗（讳旺，1319年5月17日—1341年6月11日）是大越陈朝第六位皇帝，1329—1341年在位。他是陈明宗与英姿元妃之子，1329年父亲禅位时年仅十岁登基，却只是名义上的君主，朝政大事都由太上皇裁决。出兵沱江镇压牛吼蛮、击退哀牢对西部边境进犯的，正是明宗本人。1341年宪宗以二十二岁之龄无嗣而终，父亲随即立他五岁的幼弟陈暭为帝，朝政仍握在自己手中。

en: Abel Valdemarsen (c. 1218–1252), son of Valdemar II and Berengaria of Portugal, became Duke of Schleswig in 1232 and married Matilda of Holstein in 1237. As duke he fought a long civil war against his brother Eric IV, and after Eric's murder in 1250 Abel cleared himself by a public oath and was elected king at Viborg on 1 November. After only eighteen months he campaigned against tax-rebelling Frisian peasants and was killed on 29 June 1252 on Husum Bridge near Eiderstedt by a wheelwright named Henner. His son held hostage in Cologne, his brother Christopher I succeeded him.
zh: 阿贝尔·瓦尔德马森（约1218—1252）是瓦尔德马二世与葡萄牙的贝伦加丽亚之子，1232年受封石勒苏益格公爵，1237年娶荷尔斯泰因的玛蒂尔达为妻。他任公爵时与兄长埃里克四世长期内战；1250年埃里克四世遇害后，阿贝尔公开发誓洗清嫌疑，于11月1日在维堡被拥立为王。他仅在位一年半便出征拒不纳税的弗里斯兰农民，1252年6月29日在艾德施泰特附近的胡苏姆桥上被一个名叫亨纳的车轮匠杀死。他的儿子正被扣押在科隆作人质，王位由弟弟克里斯托弗一世继承。

en: Adelaide of Holstein-Rendsburg (c. 1299–January 1350) was the daughter of Count Henry I of Holstein-Rendsburg and Helwig of Bronckhorst. In 1313 she married Duke Eric II of Schleswig, who died in 1325, and after his death she married Count Dietrich V of Hohnstein-Heringen. By Eric she was the mother of Valdemar III, king of Denmark from 1326 to 1329 and later duke of Schleswig, and of Helvig, who married King Valdemar IV in 1340; both her son and her son-in-law therefore wore the Danish crown.
zh: 荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡的阿德莱德（约1299—1350年1月）是荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡伯爵亨利一世与布龙克霍斯特的海尔维希之女。1313年她嫁给石勒苏益格公爵埃里克二世（1325年卒），丈夫死后改嫁霍恩施泰因-黑林根伯爵迪特里希五世。她与埃里克的儿子瓦尔德马三世于1326至1329年任丹麦国王，之后担任石勒苏益格公爵；女儿赫尔维于1340年嫁给丹麦国王瓦尔德马四世，她的儿子和女婿都曾登上丹麦王位。

en: Buris Henriksen (c. 1130–c. 1167) was a son of Prince Henrik Skadelår and a descendant of Sweyn II Estridsson. During the Danish civil war he and his brother Canute backed Canute V before going over to Valdemar the Great after the Bloodfeast of Roskilde in 1157. In 1162 he inherited his brother's Duchy of Southern Jutland and accompanied Valdemar to Frederick Barbarossa's court at Dole, and in 1163 he founded Tvis Abbey. In 1167 Valdemar had him imprisoned at Søborg Castle on charges of conspiring with Norwegian earl Erling Skakke to seize the throne; his fate thereafter is unknown, though he may not have survived long in captivity.
zh: 鲍里斯·亨里克森（约1130—约1167）是王子亨里克·斯卡德洛之子，斯文二世·埃斯特里德松的后裔。丹麦内战期间，他与兄长克努特支持克努特五世，1157年罗斯基勒“流血晚宴”后转投瓦尔德马大帝。1162年他继承兄长的石勒苏益格公国，并随瓦尔德马前往多勒的红胡子腓特烈一世宫廷，1163年创立特维斯修道院。1167年，瓦尔德马指控他勾结挪威雅尔厄尔林·斯卡克图谋篡位，将他囚禁于索堡城堡；此后他的下落不明，可能未在狱中活很久。

en: Tycho Brahe (1546–1601) was the greatest astronomer of the pre-telescopic age, born at Knutstorp in Scania into the Danish nobility. His observations of the new star of 1572, set out in De nova stella (1573), showed that the heavens could change beyond the Moon, shattering Aristotelian doctrine. Frederick II gave him the island of Hven, where from 1576 he built Uraniborg and Stjerneborg and made unprecedentedly precise observations of planets and stars, and proposed the geo-heliocentric Tychonic system. Driven from Denmark by Christian IV in 1597, he became imperial astronomer in Prague. Johannes Kepler assisted him there before his death and later used his data to develop laws of planetary motion.
zh: 第谷·布拉赫（1546—1601）是望远镜发明前最伟大的天文学家，生于斯科讷的克努茨托普，出身丹麦贵族。他对1572年新星的观测成果写成1573年的《论新星》，证明月球轨道之外的天界也会变化，动摇了亚里士多德的学说。腓特烈二世将汶岛赐给他，他从1576年起在岛上建造天堡和星堡，对行星与恒星进行前所未有的精密观测，并提出地心与日心混合的第谷体系。1597年他被克里斯蒂安四世逐出丹麦，前往布拉格任御用天文学家。约翰内斯·开普勒在他去世前曾在布拉格协助他，后来利用他的数据推导出行星运动定律。

en: Canute Henriksen (c. 1110–1162) was a son of Prince Henrik Skadelår and great-grandson of Sweyn II Estridsson. During the Danish civil war he fought for Canute V and helped drive Sweyn Grathe and Valdemar out of Schleswig around 1150. After Canute V was murdered at the Bloodfeast of Roskilde in 1157, he and his brother Buris switched sides; their backing helped Valdemar win at Grathe Heath and become sole king. Rewarded with the Duchy of Schleswig, Canute ruled it as duke until he died suddenly on 12 March 1162. He left no children and was succeeded by Buris.
zh: 克努特·亨里克森（约1110—1162）是王子亨里克·斯卡德洛之子，即斯文二世·埃斯特里德松之曾孙。丹麦内战期间，他为克努特五世作战，约1150年参与将斯文·格拉特和瓦尔德马逐出石勒苏益格。1157年克努特五世在罗斯基勒“流血晚宴”被杀后，克努特与弟弟鲍里斯转投瓦尔德马一方；他们的支持帮助瓦尔德马赢得格拉特希夫战役，成为唯一国王。作为奖赏，克努特受封石勒苏益格公爵，统治该地，直至1162年3月12日突然去世。他没有子嗣，由弟弟鲍里斯继任。

en: Canute IV, later called the Holy (c. 1042–1086), a son of Sweyn II Estridsson, was king of Denmark from 1080. He had led raids on England and married Adela of Flanders. As king he enforced tithes, enriched Lund Cathedral with a donation in 1085 and founded its school, while tightening royal law over nobles and peasants. In 1085 he gathered a fleet at the Limfjord to invade England, but it never sailed. A peasant revolt drove him to Odense, where rebels slew him in St. Alban's Priory on 10 July 1086. Canonized in 1101, he became Denmark's patron saint.
zh: 克努特四世，后称圣王（约1042—1086），是斯文二世·埃斯特里德森之子，1080年起为丹麦国王。他曾率军侵袭英格兰，娶佛兰德斯的阿德拉为妻。在位期间他强征什一税，1085年向隆德大教堂大量捐赠地产并创办附属学校，同时以王法约束贵族与农民。1085年他在利姆海峡集结舰队，准备入侵英格兰，却终未成行。农民起义迫使他逃往欧登塞，1086年7月10日被反叛者杀死在圣阿尔班修道院中。1101年他被追封圣徒，成为丹麦的主保圣人。

en: Canute Lavard (1096–1131) was the only legitimate son of Eric I of Denmark. In 1115 his uncle King Niels enfeoffed him with the Duchy of Schleswig to defend the border against the Slavic Obotrites. He pacified it so well that he became Duke of Holstein and a vassal of Emperor Lothair III, who recognized him as lord over the western Wends. His German connections and standing made him a possible successor to Niels but alarmed the king's son Magnus the Strong, who on 7 January 1131 trapped and slew him in Haraldsted Forest near Ringsted. His posthumous son, Valdemar I, secured his canonization in 1170.
zh: 克努特·拉瓦德（1096—1131）是丹麦国王埃里克一世唯一的嫡子。1115年，叔父尼尔斯国王将石勒苏益格公国封给他，命他抵御斯拉夫人的奥博特里特部落。他成功平定边疆，还成为荷尔斯泰因公爵，并被神圣罗马帝国皇帝洛泰尔三世承认为西文德人的封君，身兼丹麦与帝国两重封臣。他的德意志背景和声望使他成为尼尔斯可能的继承人，却令王子马格努斯不安。1131年1月7日，马格努斯在灵斯泰兹附近的哈拉尔斯泰兹森林设伏将他杀害。他的遗腹子即瓦尔德马一世，后来于1170年促成他封圣。

en: Canute V Magnussen (c. 1129–1157) was the son of Magnus the Strong of Sweden and Richeza of Poland. After Eric III abdicated in 1146, Jutland's magnates proclaimed Canute king while Zealand and Scania crowned Sweyn III, opening years of civil war. Canute joined Sweyn on the Wendish Crusade in 1147 but was defeated by him in Jutland in 1150 and fled to King Sverker I of Sweden. A 1152 settlement under Frederick Barbarossa left him Sweyn's inferior co-ruler, and a 1157 tripartition gave him Zealand. On 9 August 1157 Sweyn's men killed him at the Bloodfeast of Roskilde.
zh: 克努特五世·马格努森（约1129—1157）是瑞典国王强人马格努斯与波兰的里切扎之子。1146年埃里克三世退位后，日德兰半岛的贵族拥立克努特为王，西兰岛和斯科讷则为斯文三世加冕，丹麦陷入连年内战。1147年克努特与斯文共同参加文德十字军，但1150年在日德兰被斯文击败，逃奔瑞典国王斯渥克尔一世。1152年在红胡子腓特烈一世调停下达成的协议使他成为斯文之下的共治国王，1157年的三分方案将西兰岛划给他。1157年8月9日，斯文的手下在罗斯基勒流血晚宴上将他杀害。

en: Canute VI (1163–1202), eldest son of Valdemar the Great and Sophia of Minsk, was made co-king in 1170 and ruled Denmark alone from 1182. In 1177 he married Gertrude of Bavaria, daughter of Henry the Lion. When Emperor Frederick Barbarossa demanded homage in 1184, Canute defied him; Absalon's fleet shattered the invasion fleet of Bogislaw I of Pomerania, and by 1185 Bogislaw acknowledged Canute as overlord, after which Danish kings bore the title King of the Wends. Canute crusaded against the pagan Estonians in 1197. He died childless in 1202 and the crown passed to his brother Valdemar II.
zh: 克努特六世（1163—1202）是瓦尔德马大帝与明斯克的索菲亚的长子，1170年被立为共治国王，1182年开始亲政。1177年他娶狮子亨利之女巴伐利亚的格特鲁德为妻。1184年皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨要求他称臣，克努特予以拒绝；阿布萨隆率舰队击溃波美拉尼亚公爵博古斯瓦夫一世的入侵舰队，博古斯瓦夫于1185年承认克努特为宗主，丹麦国王此后兼称“文德人的国王”。1197年他亲征信奉异教的爱沙尼亚人。1202年克努特去世，身后无嗣，王位由弟弟瓦尔德马二世继承。

en: Christopher II (1276–1332), a younger son of Eric V, was elected king of Denmark in 1320 after his brother Eric VI died, but only by accepting a charter stripping the crown of taxation and patronage. His attempts to rule without the charter and to wage war in Germany ended in 1326, when Gerhard III of Holstein-Rendsburg drove him into exile and set Valdemar III on the throne. Restored in 1329 as a puppet, he found most of Denmark mortgaged to German counts.
