He died in August 1332, leaving the kingdom dissolved; his son Valdemar IV became king in 1340 and gradually reunited Denmark.
zh: 克里斯托弗二世（1276—1332）是埃里克五世年纪较小的儿子，1320年其兄埃里克六世死后被推举为丹麦国王，前提是接受一份剥夺王室征税权与任免权的加冕约章。他试图无视约章进行统治，并在德意志发动战争，最终于1326年被荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡伯爵格哈德三世赶下王位、流亡国外，瓦尔德马三世被立为王。1329年他作为傀儡复位，发现丹麦大部分土地已抵押给德意志诸伯爵。1332年8月2日他去世，丹麦王国随之瓦解；其子瓦尔德马四世于1340年即位，随后逐步重新统一丹麦。

en: Christopher I (1219–1259), son of Valdemar II and Berengaria of Portugal, held Lolland and Falster until he was elected king after Abel's death and crowned at Lund on Christmas Day 1252. He enfeoffed Abel's son Valdemar as Duke of Schleswig in 1253, but his reign was spent fighting the Abel family, the Holsteiners and Jacob Erlandsen, Archbishop of Lund, whom he seized and imprisoned in 1259. After Jaromar II of Rügen invaded Zealand and took Copenhagen in 1259, Christopher died suddenly at Ribe on 29 May, rumoured poisoned at mass; his son Eric V succeeded him.
zh: 克里斯托弗一世（1219—1259）是瓦尔德马二世与葡萄牙的贝伦加丽亚之子，原领有洛兰岛和法尔斯特岛。阿贝尔死后，他被推举为国王，1252年圣诞节在隆德加冕。1253年他封阿贝尔之子瓦尔德马为石勒苏益格公爵，但他的统治始终在与阿贝尔家族、荷尔斯泰因人以及拒不驯服的隆德大主教雅各·埃兰森争斗；1259年他将埃兰森逮捕囚禁。1259年吕根亲王亚罗米尔二世入侵西兰岛并占领哥本哈根，克里斯托弗于同年5月29日在里伯暴卒，传闻是在圣餐礼上被毒酒所害，其子埃里克五世继位。

en: Christopher Valdemarsen (c. 1150–1173) was a Danish duke, the illegitimate son of King Valdemar the Great and his mistress. His father saw to his education, and while still young he joined Bishop Absalon on the campaigns against the Wends. Around 1167 he was made governor in Sønderjylland and led the fighting against the Wagrians. He died on 15 June 1173 and was buried beside his father in St. Bendt's Church at Ringsted in Zealand.
zh: 克里斯托弗·瓦尔德马森（约1150—1173）是丹麦公爵，瓦尔德马大帝与情妇的私生子。父亲重视他的教育，他年轻时便随阿布萨隆主教参加征讨文德人的战争。约1167年，他受命出任南日德兰长官，率军与瓦格里文德人作战。他于1173年6月15日去世，葬于西兰岛灵斯泰德的圣本特教堂，墓在父亲身旁。

en: Jens Dinesen Jersin (1588–1634) was a Danish Lutheran bishop. Educated at Herlufsholm and Wittenberg, he became rector of Sorø in 1611, professor of metaphysics at Copenhagen in 1619, tutor to Christian IV's illegitimate sons, and from 1626 parish priest of the Church of Our Lady in Copenhagen before becoming bishop of Ribe. A Ramist, he issued the Latin grammars Epitome (1623) and Grammatica Latina (1624), explaining Latin partly in Danish; his teaching method met fierce opposition from professors and schoolmen. As bishop he fought superstition, publishing On Miracles, Signs and Revelations and their Explanation (1631), the first Danish work to argue that many reported wonders were imagination or fraud.
zh: 延斯·迪内森·耶尔辛（1588—1634）是丹麦路德宗主教。他在海卢夫斯霍尔姆和维滕贝格求学，1611年任索勒学校校长，1619年任哥本哈根大学形而上学教授，还曾担任克里斯蒂安四世私生子的教师，1626年起任哥本哈根圣母堂教区牧师，后来成为里伯主教。他信奉拉米斯学说，1623年和1624年先后出版拉丁文语法《摘要》和《拉丁语语法》，部分语法解释用丹麦语写成；他的教学方法遭到教授和学校人士的激烈反对。任主教期间他抵制迷信，1631年出版《论奇迹、征兆与启示及其解释》，是丹麦第一部主张许多所谓奇事多出于想象或骗局的著作。

en: Eric Christoffersen (c. 1307–1332), eldest son of Christopher II of Denmark and Euphemia of Pomerania, was elected king in 1321 and crowned beside his father on 15 August 1324 as junior co-ruler. In 1325, sent against the Holstein counts, he was deserted by his troops and captured at Haderslev. Released in 1330 after marrying Elizabeth of Holstein-Rendsburg, sister of Gerhard III, he fought again when war resumed. Defeated at the Danevirke on 30 November 1331, he escaped wounded to Kiel and died soon after, being buried first at Sorø Abbey and later at St Bendt's Church in Ringsted.
zh: 埃里克·克里斯托弗森（约1307—1332）是丹麦国王克里斯托弗二世与波美拉尼亚的尤菲米娅的长子，1321年被选为国王，1324年8月15日与父亲一同加冕，为共治的幼王。1325年他被派去抵御荷尔斯泰因诸伯爵，却被部下抛弃，在哈泽斯莱乌被俘。1330年他在娶了格哈德三世之妹、荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡的伊丽莎白后获释，战火重燃后再度出征。1331年11月30日他在丹麦墙战败，带伤逃到基尔，不久死去，先葬于索勒修道院，后改葬灵斯泰兹的圣本特教堂。

en: Eric I, called the Good (c. 1056–1103), a son of Sweyn II Estridsson, was king of Denmark from 1095. He backed Canute IV, fled the 1086 rising into Scania, and was elected at the landsting assemblies after Olaf Hunger's death as the long famines ended. Popular and diplomatic, he secured from the Pope Canute's canonization in 1101 and an independent archbishopric at Lund, freeing the Danish church from Hamburg-Bremen. In 1103 he set out on pilgrimage to Jerusalem via Russia and Constantinople, but died at Paphos in Cyprus in July. His queen Bodil reached Jerusalem but died there.
zh: 埃里克一世，绰号“好人”（约1056—1103），是斯文二世·埃斯特里德森之子，1095年起为丹麦国王。他支持克努特四世，1086年叛乱时逃入斯科讷；奥拉夫·饥饿者死后，他在各郡集会上被推举为王，连年饥荒也随之结束。他深得人心、处事圆融，在罗马从教宗处争取到1101年追封克努特为圣徒，并使隆德成为独立大主教区，丹麦教会由此脱离汉堡-不来梅大主教区管辖。1103年他启程经罗斯和君士坦丁堡前往耶路撒冷朝圣，7月病逝于塞浦路斯的帕福斯；王后博迪尔抵达耶路撒冷后在当地去世。

en: Eric II the Memorable (c. 1090–1137) was an illegitimate son of Eric I and jarl of Møn, Lolland and Falster. After his half-brother Canute Lavard was murdered in 1131, he rose against King Niels and was proclaimed antiking in Scania. Mocked as Harefoot after early defeats, he returned in 1134 and, with German mounted mercenaries, crushed Niels at Fotevik. As king he killed his rival Harald Kesja and in 1136 crusaded against pagan Rügen, forcing Arkona to surrender by cutting off its water. On 18 September 1137 the nobleman Sorte Plov slew him with a spear at the Urnehoved assembly.
zh: “难忘者”埃里克二世（约1090—1137）是埃里克一世的私生子，曾任默恩、洛兰和法尔斯特等岛的雅尔。1131年异母兄克努特·拉瓦德遇害后，他起兵反抗尼尔斯国王，在斯科讷被拥立为对立国王。他曾因撤退被讥为“兔足”，但1134年卷土重来，依靠德意志雇佣骑兵在福泰维克战役击溃尼尔斯。即位后他杀死竞争者哈拉尔·克舍，并于1136年征讨信奉异教的吕根岛，切断水源迫使阿科纳投降。1137年9月18日，贵族索尔特·普洛夫在乌讷霍韦德集会上用长矛将他刺杀。

en: Eric II Valdemarsen (c. 1288–1325) was Duke of Schleswig from 1312 until his death, the only legitimate son of Duke Valdemar IV and Elisabeth of Saxe-Lauenburg. He already ruled jointly with his father before succeeding him. In 1313 he married Adelaide of Holstein-Rendsburg, daughter of Count Henry I. Their son Valdemar, underage when Eric died on 12 March 1325, later ruled Schleswig and was king of Denmark in 1326–1329; their daughter Helvig married King Valdemar IV of Denmark. Eric was buried in Schleswig Cathedral.
zh: 埃里克二世·瓦尔德马森（约1288—1325）是石勒苏益格公爵，1312年至去世在位。他是瓦尔德马四世公爵与萨克森-劳恩堡的伊丽莎白唯一的嫡子，在父亲生前已参与共治。1313年，他娶荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡伯爵亨利一世之女阿得海德为妻。1325年3月12日他去世时，儿子瓦尔德马尚未成年，后来成为石勒苏益格公爵，并于1326—1329年出任丹麦国王；女儿海尔维格嫁给了丹麦国王瓦尔德马四世。埃里克葬于石勒苏益格主教座堂。

en: Eric III Lamb (c. 1120–1146) was the son of Ragnhild, a daughter of Eric I, and the noble Hakon Sunnivasson. He fought for his uncle Eric II at Fotevik in 1134 and took the throne after Eric II's murder in 1137. His cousin Olaf Haraldsen seized Scania in 1139, but Eric defeated and slew him near Helsingborg in 1141. Wendish raids went largely unanswered under him, while he richly favoured the Church, especially Odense's St Canute's Abbey. In 1146 he became the first Danish king to abdicate voluntarily, retiring to St Canute's Abbey, where he died on 27 August.
zh: “羔羊”埃里克三世（约1120—1146）是埃里克一世之女朗希尔德与贵族哈康·孙尼瓦松之子。1134年他随舅父埃里克二世参加决定性的福泰维克战役，1137年埃里克二世遇刺后继承王位。表亲奥拉夫·哈拉尔森于1139年占据斯科讷争夺王位，埃里克于1141年在赫尔辛堡附近将其击败击杀。他在位期间，文德人屡屡劫掠丹麦海岸却几乎无人抵御；他则大力厚待教会，尤其优待欧登塞的圣克努特修道院。1146年他成为第一位主动退位的丹麦国王，进入圣克努特修道院，于8月27日在那里去世。

en: Eric IV, called Plovpenning (c. 1216–1250), son of Valdemar II and Berengaria of Portugal, was Duke of Schleswig and crowned co-king at Lund in 1232, succeeding his father in 1241. His reign was consumed by civil war with his brother Abel of Schleswig, backed by the Holstein counts, and by a Scanian peasant revolt against his plough tax, which earned him his nickname. On 10 August 1250, while Abel's guest at Gottorf, he was seized by Abel's steward Lave Gudmundsen, beheaded and thrown into the Schlei. Abel succeeded him after swearing his innocence before twenty-four nobles.
zh: 犁地金王埃里克四世（约1216—1250）是瓦尔德马二世与葡萄牙的贝伦加丽亚之子，初封石勒苏益格公爵，1232年在隆德加冕为共治国王，1241年继承父位。他在位期间内战不断：弟弟石勒苏益格公爵阿贝尔在荷尔斯泰因伯爵们支持下与他争战，斯堪尼农民也因反抗犁地金税而起兵，他的绰号便由此而来。1250年8月10日，他在戈托尔夫城堡做客时被阿贝尔的管家莱夫·吉蒙臣擒获，斩首后抛尸施莱湾。阿贝尔随后在二十四名贵族面前发誓与此事无关，登上王位。

en: Eric I Abelsøn (c. 1241–1272), second son of King Abel, claimed Schleswig after his brother Valdemar III's death in 1257, but his uncle Christopher I withheld the duchy. In 1259 he joined Bishop Peder Bang and Jaromar II of Rügen in taking Copenhagen, and married Jaromar's daughter Margaret. Made duke in 1260, he defeated Queen Regent Margaret Sambiria at Lohede on 28 June 1261, capturing the young Eric V; the 1264 peace granted him all crown lands in Schleswig and Als. He died on 27 May 1272, leaving Gottorp and the duchy to his son Valdemar IV.
zh: 埃里克一世·阿贝尔森（约1241—1272）是丹麦国王阿贝尔的次子。1257年兄长瓦尔德马三世死后，他要求继承石勒苏益格公国，叔父克里斯托弗一世却拒绝授予。1259年，他联合罗斯基勒主教佩德·邦和吕根亲王亚罗米尔二世攻克哥本哈根，并娶亚罗米尔的女儿玛格丽特为妻。1260年他受封为公爵。1261年6月28日，他在洛海德战役中击败摄政太后玛格丽特·桑比利亚，俘虏年幼的埃里克五世；1264年的和约将石勒苏益格的全部王室领地和阿尔斯岛都封赐给他。1272年5月27日他去世，把戈托尔夫和公国留给儿子瓦尔德马四世。

en: Eric V Klipping (1249–1286) became king of Denmark in 1259 on the death of his father Christopher I; his mother Margaret Sambiria acted as regent until 1266. Captured by the Holsteiners in 1261, he was held for a time at the Brandenburg court, and in 1273 married Agnes of Brandenburg. He curbed the church but antagonised the nobles, who in 1282 forced him at Nyborg to accept Denmark's first coronation charter limiting royal power. On 22 November 1286 he was hacked to death in a barn at Finderup near Viborg; Stig Andersen Hvide and other magnates were outlawed.
zh: 埃里克五世（削剪王，1249—1286）在父亲克里斯托弗一世去世后于1259年成为丹麦国王，由母亲玛格丽特·桑比利亚摄政至1266年。1261年他被荷尔斯泰因人俘获，之后被软禁在勃兰登堡宫廷，1273年在石勒苏益格与勃兰登堡的阿格尼丝成婚。亲政后他压制了教会，却激怒了贵族，1282年被迫在尼堡接受限制王权的丹麦第一部加冕约章。1286年11月22日，他在维堡附近芬讷鲁普的一座谷仓中被乱刀砍死；斯蒂格·安德森·维德等大贵族因这起谋杀被宣布为法外之徒。

en: Eric VI Menved (1274–1319) became king of Denmark in 1286 at twelve after his father Eric V was murdered, and his mother Agnes of Brandenburg was regent until 1294. Arresting Archbishop Jens Grand of Lund in 1294 brought a papal interdict, lifted only in 1303 after he submitted to Boniface VIII. Lavish tournaments and wars in Germany and Sweden drained the treasury, so he mortgaged royal lands; famine and continued taxation provoked a revolt on Zealand in 1312, and he crushed a rebellion in Jutland with German mercenaries in 1313. All his children died before him, and on his death in 1319 his brother Christopher II inherited a bankrupt kingdom.
zh: 埃里克六世（带来不幸之人，1274—1319）在父亲埃里克五世被弑后于1286年十二岁即位，母亲勃兰登堡的阿格尼丝摄政至1294年。1294年他囚禁隆德大主教詹斯·格兰德，招致教皇禁令，直到1303年向卜尼法斯八世屈服才得以解除。奢侈的骑士比武和在德意志、瑞典进行的战争耗尽国库，他只得把王室领地一块块抵押出去；饥荒和持续征税引发1312年西兰岛起义，1313年他又用德意志雇佣军镇压了日德兰的起义。他的孩子全部先他而死，1319年去世后由弟弟克里斯托弗二世继位，接下一个破产的王国。

en: Estrid Svendsdatter (born c. 990, died after 1057) was a Danish princess, daughter of Sweyn Forkbeard and half-sister of Cnut the Great. She married the Anglo-Danish magnate Ulf Jarl, who ruled Denmark as regent until Cnut had him killed at Roskilde in 1026. Her son by Ulf, Sweyn Estridsson, became king in 1047 and named the Estridsen dynasty after her. Given great estates in Scania and Zealand, she was one of the richest women in the North; tradition credits her with replacing the timber church at Roskilde with its first stone church, where she was later buried.
zh: 埃斯特里德·斯文德斯多塔（约990年生，1057年后去世）是丹麦公主，八字胡斯文之女、克努特大帝同父异母的姐妹。她嫁给英丹血统的大贵族乌尔夫·雅尔，后者以摄政身份治理丹麦，1026年在罗斯基勒被克努特下令诛杀。她与乌尔夫所生的儿子斯文·埃斯特里德松于1047年成为丹麦国王，埃斯特里德王朝即以她的名字命名。她获赐斯科讷和西兰岛的大片地产，是当时北欧最富有的女性之一；传统认为她以石教堂取代了罗斯基勒的木制教堂，身后即葬于此。

en: Gorm the Old (born before 900, died c. 958) was the first ruler recognised as king of all Denmark, reigning from Jelling from about 936. He married Queen Thyra, whom medieval tradition credits with strengthening the Danevirke border rampart, and raised the older Jelling Stone and a great burial mound in her honour, calling her Denmark's salvation. Gorm remained a pagan, and Denmark's conversion came only under his son Harald Bluetooth. Tree-ring dating places his death in the winter of 958–959; some scholars have suggested that Harald later moved his remains from the Jelling mound into the first wooden church there.
zh: 老戈姆（900年之前出生，约958年去世）是第一位被公认为全丹麦之王的统治者，约936年起以耶灵为都进行统治。他娶提拉王后为妻，中世纪的传统认为她主持加固了边境防御工事丹麦墙；戈姆为她立起耶灵石中较早的一块，还修建了巨大的坟冢，铭文称她为“丹麦的拯救者”。戈姆终生信奉异教，丹麦直到其子蓝牙哈拉尔在位时才皈依基督教。树木年轮测定将他的去世时间定在958—959年冬；有学者推测哈拉尔后来把他的遗骨从耶灵坟冢迁葬到当地第一座木制教堂。

en: Peder Griffenfeld (1635–1699), born Peder Schumacher into a wealthy Copenhagen trading family, was the leading Danish statesman of his age. After eight years studying in the Netherlands, England, France and Spain, he returned in 1662, became royal librarian in 1663, and helped draft the absolutist King's Law of 1665. During his travels he spent three years at Oxford, where events in England helped convince him to enter politics. From Christian V's accession in 1670 he was the king's chief minister, and in 1673 he became Chancellor of Denmark and a count. Arrested in 1676 on a treason charge now considered false, he spent 22 years in prison, mostly at Munkholmen in Norway.
zh: 佩德·格里芬费尔德（1635—1699），原名佩德·舒马赫，生于哥本哈根一个富商家庭，是那个时代丹麦最有权势的政治家。他曾在尼德兰、英国、法国和西班牙求学八年，1662年回国，1663年任王室图书馆馆长，并参与起草1665年确立专制王权的《国王法》。游学期间他在牛津待了三年，英国的政局变化促使他投身政治。1670年克里斯蒂安五世即位后，他成为国王的首席大臣，1673年受封伯爵、出任丹麦首相。1676年他以叛国罪被捕，后世认为指控不实，随后被囚禁22年，大部分时间关押在挪威的蒙克霍尔门。

en: Harald Bluetooth Gormsson (died c. 985/86), son of Gorm the Old and Thyra, ruled Denmark from about 958. Around 965 he raised the larger Jelling Stone, whose inscription boasts that he unified Denmark and made the Danes Christian. He backed conversion with a wave of building, expanding the Danevirke, constructing the Trelleborg-style ring fortresses and the Ravning Bridge, and issuing Denmark's first nationwide coinage. He held power briefly in Norway in the 970s and fought the German emperors on his southern border. Deposed by his son Sweyn Forkbeard, he died of his wounds around 986 and was buried at Roskilde.
zh: 蓝牙哈拉尔·高姆松（约985/986年去世）是老戈姆与提拉之子，约958年起统治丹麦。约965年，他立起耶灵石中较大的那块，铭文宣称他统一了丹麦、使丹麦人皈依基督教。他以大规模建设推动改宗：扩建丹麦墙，修建特雷勒堡式环形堡垒群和拉文桥，还发行了丹麦最早的全国性货币。970年代他还一度控制挪威，并在南部边境与德意志皇帝交战。最终他被儿子八字胡斯文起兵推翻，约986年伤重而死，葬于罗斯基勒。

en: Harald II Svensen (c. 997–1018) was king of Denmark from 1014 until his death. A younger son of Sweyn Forkbeard, he ruled Denmark as regent while his father campaigned in England against Æthelred the Unready. After Sweyn died in 1014, the Danes elected Harald their king, while his brother Cnut led the army in England and took the English throne in 1016. Harald died around 1018, and Cnut succeeded him in Denmark, uniting the two kingdoms.
zh: 哈拉尔二世·斯文松（约997—1018）自1014年起为丹麦国王，直至去世。他是八字胡斯文的幼子，父亲出征英格兰、与决策无方者埃塞尔雷德交战期间，他以摄政身份留守丹麦。1014年斯文死后，丹麦人推举哈拉尔为王，其兄弟克努特则率军在英格兰作战，于1016年登上英格兰王位。约1018年哈拉尔去世，克努特又继任丹麦国王，将两顶王冠合而为一。

en: Harald III, called Hen (c. 1040–1080), an illegitimate son of Sweyn II Estridsson, was king of Denmark from 1076. He joined his father's 1069 English raid and was elected king at the Isøre assembly over his brother Canute after promising to uphold the law. A peaceful ruler, he standardized Danish coinage with mints at Ribe, Viborg, Lund and Schleswig, and sought to reform trial by combat and red-hot iron ordeals by introducing sworn oath-helpers after the English custom. He died on 17 April 1080 and was buried at Dalby in Scania, leaving no heirs; Canute IV succeeded him.
zh: 哈拉尔三世，绰号“磨石”（约1040—1080），是斯文二世·埃斯特里德森的私生子，1076年起为丹麦国王。他曾参加父亲1069年侵袭英格兰的行动，1076年在伊瑟勒集会上因承诺维护法律而胜过弟弟克努特，被推举为王。他治世平和，统一丹麦币制，在里伯、维堡、隆德和石勒苏益格设立造币厂，并引入英格兰式的代誓制度，试图改革决斗裁判与手持热铁的神判。1080年4月17日他去世，葬于斯科讷的达尔比，没有子嗣，由克努特四世继位。

en: Christian Frederik Hansen (1756–1845), known as C. F. Hansen, was the leading Danish architect of his age, called Denmark's Palladio for the austere neoclassicism of his buildings. Trained at the Royal Danish Academy under Harsdorff, he studied Roman architecture in Italy in 1782–1784, then spent eighteen years in Altona as regional architect for Schleswig and Holstein. There he also designed houses for wealthy clients in town and country. Recalled to Copenhagen in 1804 and made Chief Building Director in 1808, he built the City Hall and Courthouse on Nytorv (1805–1815), rebuilt the Church of Our Lady (1811–1829) after the British bombardment of 1807, and reconstructed Christiansborg Palace. He was elected director of the Academy eight times.
zh: 克里斯蒂安·弗雷德里克·汉森（1756—1845），常称C.F.汉森，是那个时代丹麦首屈一指的建筑师，因冷峻的新古典主义风格而被称为“丹麦的帕拉第奥”。他在丹麦皇家美术学院师从哈斯多夫，1782—1784年赴意大利考察古罗马建筑，随后作为石勒苏益格与荷尔斯泰因的地区建筑师在阿尔托纳度过了十八年，期间还为富裕客户设计城内和乡间住宅。1804年他被召回哥本哈根，1808年出任总营造总监，主持修建了新广场的市政厅与法院（1805—1815），在1807年英军炮轰城市之后重建圣母教堂（1811—1829），还主持重建了克里斯蒂安堡宫。他曾八次当选美术学院院长。

en: Hans Christian Andersen (1805–1875) was Denmark's most famous writer, born in Odense, the son of a shoemaker who read him the Arabian Nights and an illiterate washerwoman. After his father's death he attended a school for poor children and worked as an apprentice to a weaver and a tailor. He went to Copenhagen at fourteen to become an actor; his gift was noticed at the Royal Danish Theatre, whose director Jonas Collin secured him a royal-sponsored schooling. Though he also wrote novels, travelogues and plays, he is remembered for the 156 fairy tales published from 1835, among them The Little Mermaid, The Ugly Duckling and The Snow Queen, translated into more than 125 languages.
zh: 汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生（1805—1875）是丹麦最著名的作家，生于欧登塞，父亲是给他读《一千零一夜》的鞋匠，母亲是不识字的洗衣妇。父亲去世后，他在贫民学校读书，先后给织工和裁缝当学徒。十四岁时他前往哥本哈根想当演员；他的才华在丹麦皇家剧院被发现，院长约纳斯·科林为他争取到王室资助的教育。他也写小说、游记和戏剧，但最为人所知的是1835年起出版的156篇童话，《海的女儿》《丑小鸭》《白雪皇后》等作品被译成125种以上的语言。

en: Helvig of Schleswig (c. 1320–1374), daughter of Eric II, Duke of Schleswig, was queen of Denmark as the wife of Valdemar IV Atterdag, and her marriage was a piece of politics. Her brother Valdemar V of Schleswig had himself been king of Denmark from 1326 to 1329 under the guardianship of their maternal uncle, Gerhard III of Holstein-Rendsburg. In the late 1330s he allied with Christopher II's son Valdemar against Gerhard and sealed the pact by giving Helvig to him. They wed at Sønderborg Castle in 1340; she brought the pawned province of Nørrejylland as her dowry. She bore Margaret, the future Margaret I, in 1353, and after that year is no longer documented as living with the king. She spent her last years at Esrum Abbey in Zealand, where she died in 1374 as a lay sister and was buried in the abbey church. A year later her daughter became regent of Denmark.
zh: 石勒苏益格的黑尔维希（约1320—1374）是石勒苏益格公爵埃里克二世之女，丹麦国王瓦尔德玛四世·阿道戴的王后，她的婚姻是一桩政治安排。她的兄长石勒苏益格的瓦尔德玛五世曾在1326至1329年间做过丹麦国王，由舅父荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡的格哈德三世监护。1330年代末，兄长与克里斯托弗二世之子瓦尔德玛结盟对抗格哈德，并把黑尔维希许配给他以巩固盟约。1340年两人在森讷堡城堡成婚，她带来被抵押的北日德兰领地作为嫁妆。1353年她生下后来的玛格丽特一世，此后便不再有她与国王同住的记载。她晚年住在西兰岛的埃斯鲁姆修道院，1374年以世俗修女身份在院中去世，葬于修道院教堂。一年后，她的女儿成为丹麦摄政。

en: Henrik Skadelår, or Henrik the Lame (c. 1090–1134), was a Danish prince, the son of Svend Tronkræver and grandson of Sweyn II Estridsson. Through Queen Margaret Fredkulla's diplomacy he married Ingrid Ragnvaldsdotter, a granddaughter of King Inge I of Sweden; Saxo Grammaticus calls it unhappy. After his cousin Canute Lavard was killed in 1131, Henrik was put forward as a possible king of Denmark. He never pressed the claim: on 4 June 1134 he fell at the Battle of Fotevik fighting for King Niels. His sons included Magnus Henriksen, briefly king of Sweden, and Buris and Canute Henriksen.
zh: 亨里克·斯卡德洛，即“跛子”亨里克（约1090—1134），是丹麦王子，斯文·特龙克雷弗之子、斯文二世·埃斯特里德松之孙。在玛格丽特·弗雷德库拉王后的安排下，他娶了瑞典国王英格一世的孙女英格丽·朗瓦尔兹多塔；萨克索·格拉玛提库斯记载这段婚姻并不和睦。1131年堂兄克努特·拉瓦德遇害后，他一度被提名为丹麦王位人选，但尚未付诸行动便于1134年6月4日在福泰维克战役中为尼尔斯国王作战时阵亡。他的儿子包括曾短暂登上瑞典王位的马格努斯·亨里克森，以及鲍里斯与克努特·亨里克森。

en: Poul Laxmand (c. 1450–1502), the greatest Danish landowner of his age, served as rigshofmester from 1489. He belonged to a group of high nobles who held royal power in check. He became lensmand at Krogen in 1482 and later at Sølvitsborg in Blekinge, was knighted and joined the rigsråd in 1483, and in 1487 helped negotiate Gotland's surrender to Denmark. About 900 tenant farms made up his estates, mostly in Skåne. After taking part in King Hans's failed relief of Stockholm in 1502, he was stabbed to death on the Højbro bridge in Copenhagen on 22 June, after which the crown condemned him for treason and seized his lands.
zh: 保罗·拉克斯曼（约1450—1502）是他那个时代丹麦最大的地主，1489年起任里格斯霍夫梅斯特。他属于牵制王权的大贵族集团。1482年他成为克罗根的封地长官，后来又受封布莱金厄的瑟尔维茨堡，1483年受封骑士并进入国务会议，1487年参与谈判，促成哥得兰交还丹麦。他的地产约有900处佃农农庄，大部分位于斯科讷。1502年他参加国王汉斯解围斯德哥尔摩失败的行动后，于6月22日在哥本哈根的霍伊布罗桥遇刺身亡，随后王室以叛国罪追判他并没收其土地。

en: Ludvig Holberg (1684–1754) was a Danish-Norwegian writer, historian and playwright, born in Bergen and active in Copenhagen. A scholar of European reputation, he brought Enlightenment thought to Denmark-Norway and is regarded as the founder of modern Danish and Norwegian literature, publishing works of history, law, geography and philosophy. His works on natural and common law were read by Danish law students for two centuries. He is best known for the comedies written in 1722–1723 for Copenhagen's Lille Grønnegade Theatre, including Jeppe on the Hill, Jean de France and Erasmus Montanus, whose characters became archetypes in Danish. In 1747 he founded the Barony of Holberg on his estates and died in Copenhagen in 1754.
zh: 路维·郝尔拜（1684—1754）是丹麦-挪威作家、历史学家与剧作家，生于卑尔根，主要活动于哥本哈根。他是享誉欧洲的学者，把启蒙思想引入丹麦-挪威，被视为现代丹麦与挪威文学的奠基人，著作遍及历史、法学、地理和哲学。他有关自然法与普通法的著作在两个世纪里一直为丹麦法律学生所阅读。他最著名的是1722—1723年为哥本哈根里尔剧院创作的喜剧，《山上的耶比》《让·德·法郎士》和《伊拉斯莫斯·孟塔努斯》等作品中的人物成为丹麦语中的经典典型。1747年，他以自己的地产创立郝尔拜男爵领，1754年在哥本哈根去世。

en: Magnus Olafsson, called the Good (1024–1047), was the illegitimate son of St. Olaf of Norway. When Cnut the Great deposed his father in 1028, he took refuge at the court of Yaroslav the Wise in Kiev, returning in 1035 to be crowned king of Norway at eleven. In 1042 he also became king of Denmark and fought Sven Estridsson for the kingdom. In 1046 he accepted his uncle Harald Hardrada as co-king of Norway. Magnus died in Denmark on 25 October 1047, and the two crowns passed to Harald and Sven.
zh: 马格努斯·奥拉夫松，人称善良王（1024—1047），是挪威国王圣奥拉夫二世的私生子。1028年克努特大帝废黜其父后，他避居基辅的智者雅罗斯拉夫宫廷，1035年回国，年仅十一岁便加冕为挪威国王。1042年他又成为丹麦国王，与斯文二世争夺丹麦。1046年，他接受叔父哈拉尔三世为挪威共治国王。1047年10月25日，马格努斯在丹麦去世，挪威与丹麦两顶王冠分别归于哈拉尔与斯文。

en: Niels (c. 1063–1134), youngest son of Sweyn II Estridsson, was elected king of Denmark in 1104 after his brother Eric Evergood died on pilgrimage. In 1105 he married Margaret Fredkulla, daughter of King Inge I of Sweden, who held strong influence at court. He backed the canonization of Canute IV the Holy and ruled with the clergy's support. After his son Magnus murdered the popular prince Canute Lavard in 1131, Niels supported him, sparking civil war. Defeated at Fotevik in 1134, he fled to Schleswig and was killed there on 25 June.
zh: 尼尔斯（约1063—1134）是斯文二世·埃斯特里德松的幼子，1104年在兄长埃里克一世朝圣途中去世后被推举为丹麦国王。1105年他娶瑞典国王英格一世之女玛格丽特·弗雷德库拉为妻，王后在宫廷中影响很大。他支持将克努特四世封圣，并在教会支持下统治。1131年，他的儿子马格努斯杀害了深得人心的王子克努特·拉瓦德，尼尔斯却予以袒护，国家由此陷入内战。1134年他在福泰维克战役中战败，逃往石勒苏益格，于6月25日在当地被杀。

en: Niels Juel (1629–1697) was a Dano-Norwegian admiral born in Christiania. He learned seamanship in the Dutch navy under Maarten Tromp and Michiel de Ruyter during the First Anglo-Dutch War, joined Danish service, and became an admiral in 1657, helping defend Copenhagen in 1658–1660. Given supreme command in the Scanian War after Cort Adeler's death in 1675, he fought at Jasmund and Öland, then defeated the Swedes at Møn and at Køge Bay in 1677; Køge Bay was the greatest victory in Danish naval history. At Jasmund he broke through the enemy line and cut off five ships. Cornelis Tromp superseded him shortly afterward, but Juel regained supreme command in 1678. From 1683 he headed the admiralty and expanded the fleet into a blue-water navy.
zh: 尼尔斯·尤尔（1629—1697）是出生于克里斯蒂安尼亚的丹麦-挪威海军上将。第一次英荷战争期间，他在荷兰海军名将特龙普和德·鲁伊特麾下习得海战，随后加入丹麦海军，1657年晋升上将，并在1658—1660年的丹瑞战争中参与守卫哥本哈根。1675年科特·阿德勒去世后，他在斯科讷战争中出任舰队最高指挥，先后在亚斯蒙德和厄兰岛作战，1677年又在默恩和克厄湾击败瑞典人；克厄湾之战是丹麦海军史上最辉煌的胜利。在亚斯蒙德，他突破敌军战线，截断了五艘敌舰。不久科内利斯·特龙普接替了他的最高指挥权，但尤尔于1678年重新掌权。1683年起他主管海军部，将舰队扩建为一支远洋海军。

en: Peter Wessel Tordenskiold (1690–1720) was a Norwegian-born vice-admiral in the Dano-Norwegian navy and a daring raider of the Great Northern War. After going from Trondheim to Copenhagen in 1704, he joined the navy and harassed Swedish shipping. In 1714 he fought a Swedish privateer and asked his opponent for ammunition when his own ran low. Frederick IV ordered a court-martial over the risks he had taken and the disclosure of his shortage; he was acquitted after citing the naval code and promoted. Ennobled as Tordenskiold in 1716, he captured or destroyed most of the Swedish transport fleet at Dynekilen, forcing Charles XII to abandon Norway, and in 1719 took Marstrand and Carlsten fortress, ending the war a vice-admiral. In November 1720 he was killed in a duel near Hanover.
zh: 彼得·韦塞尔·托登肖尔（1690—1720）是出生于挪威的丹挪海军中将，也是大北方战争中大胆的海上袭击者。1704年他从特隆赫姆前往哥本哈根，随后加入海军，袭扰瑞典航运。1714年他与一艘瑞典私掠舰交战，弹药不足时向对方索取弹药。腓特烈四世因他冒险作战并泄露弹药不足而下令军事审判；他援引海军法典为自己辩护，最终无罪开释并获晋升。1716年他受封贵族、得姓托登肖尔，随后在迪内基伦俘获或摧毁大部分瑞典运输船，迫使卡尔十二世放弃挪威；1719年他攻克马斯特兰德和卡尔斯滕要塞，战争结束时已是海军中将。1720年11月，他在汉诺威附近的一场决斗中身亡。

en: Olaf I Hunger (c. 1050–1095), a son of Sweyn II Estridsson, was king of Denmark from 1086. In 1085, as spokesman of the fleet mustered against England, he drew Canute IV's suspicion, was chained and exiled to Flanders. After Canute was killed, Olaf was proclaimed king at the Viborg assembly. His reign brought harvest failures and famine, whence his nickname, widely seen as punishment for Canute's murder. Royal power ebbed to the magnates, though in 1089 he secured Asser Svendsen's appointment as bishop of Lund. He died in August 1095 and was succeeded by Eric the Good.
zh: 奥拉夫一世，绰号“饥饿者”（约1050—1095），是斯文二世·埃斯特里德森之子，1086年起为丹麦国王。1085年，他作为征英舰队的代言人遭克努特四世猜忌，被戴上镣铐流放佛兰德斯。克努特被杀后，他在维堡集会上被拥立为王。他在位时连年歉收、饥荒蔓延，由此得到“饥饿者”的绰号，时人视之为弑杀克努特的天谴。王权旁落于大贵族之手，但他于1089年促成阿塞尔·斯文森出任隆德主教。1095年8月他去世，由“好人”埃里克继位。

en: Otte Rud (1520–1565) was a Danish fleet commander in the Northern Seven Years' War. As a young man he served abroad, fighting for Saxony in its war against Brunswick. He returned home in 1543, married Pernille Oxe, Peder Oxe's sister, in 1549, and held royal fiefs including Dragsholm, Gotland and Korsør. In 1563 he won fame on land at Mared and then at sea, helping to destroy the Swedish flagship Makalös off Gotland in May 1564. He succeeded Herluf Trolle as fleet commander in 1565, was taken by a stronger Swedish fleet off Bornholm, and died of plague in captivity at Svartsjö on 11 October 1565.
zh: 奥特·鲁德（1520—1565）是北方七年战争中的丹麦舰队司令。他年轻时在国外从军，曾为萨克森作战，参加对不伦瑞克的战争。1543年他回国，1549年娶佩德·奥克塞之妹佩妮莱·奥克塞，先后领有德拉格斯霍尔姆、哥得兰和科尔瑟等王室封地。1563年他在马雷德的陆战中成名，随后转战海上，1564年5月参与在哥得兰外海摧毁瑞典旗舰‘马卡勒斯号’。1565年他接替海卢夫·特罗勒出任舰队司令，在博恩霍尔姆外海被占优势的瑞典舰队俘虏，1565年10月11日在斯瓦茨约的囚禁中死于瘟疫。

en: Otto of Denmark, Otto Christoffersen (c. 1310 – after 1346), was the second son of King Christopher II and Euphemia of Pomerania, created Duke of Lolland and Estonia. When Christopher died in 1332 after his elder brother Eric, Otto claimed the crown, but Count Gerhard III of Holstein defeated and captured him at Taphed near Viborg on 7 October 1334; he was imprisoned at Segeberg. Released after his younger brother Valdemar IV took the throne in 1340, Otto renounced his claim, went to Germany and joined the Teutonic Order in 1346, which bought his duchy that year.
zh: 丹麦的奥托·克里斯托弗森（约1310—1346年后）是国王克里斯托弗二世与波美拉尼亚的尤菲米娅的次子，受封洛兰与爱沙尼亚公爵。长兄埃里克去世、父亲于1332年去世后，他争夺丹麦王位，1334年10月7日在维堡附近的塔弗德被荷尔斯泰因伯爵格哈德三世击败俘虏，关押在塞格贝格城堡。1340年幼弟瓦尔德马四世即位后他获释，放弃王位要求，前往德意志，1346年加入条顿骑士团，其公国也于同年被骑士团买下。

en: Peder Oxe (1520–1575) was Denmark's leading financier of the century. He joined the rigsråd in 1552, governed Copenhagen in 1554 and shared charge of the treasury. That year he also mediated a dispute between the electors of Saxony and Brandenburg. In 1557 he quarrelled with the king over a property exchange and in 1558 fled to Germany, where he intrigued with Wilhelm von Grumbach against Frederick II. Financial difficulties during the Northern Seven Years' War led Frederick to recall him in 1566 and restore his estates. As rigshofmester he raised the Sound Dues, reformed the coinage, cut the national debt, redeemed crown lands and promoted trade and agriculture, dying the wealthiest landowner in Denmark on 24 October 1575.
zh: 佩德·奥克塞（1520—1575）是那个世纪丹麦首屈一指的理财家。他1552年进入国务会议，1554年任哥本哈根长官并与人共同掌管国库，同年还调解了萨克森与勃兰登堡选帝侯之间的争端。1557年他与国王因地产交换发生争执，1558年逃往德意志，在那里与威廉·冯·格鲁姆巴赫合谋反对腓特烈二世。北方七年战争期间的财政困难促使腓特烈于1566年将他召回并归还其地产。任里格斯霍夫梅斯特期间，他提高松德海峡税、改革币制、削减国债、赎回王室土地并推动商贸与农业，1575年10月24日去世时是丹麦最富有的地主。

en: Ragnhild Eriksdatter was a daughter of King Eric I of Denmark who married the Danish nobleman Hakon Sunnivasson, called Hakon Jyde. Her son Eric, known as Eric III Lamb, was king of Denmark from 1137 to 1146.
zh: 朗希尔德·埃里克丝达特是丹麦国王埃里克一世之女，嫁给丹麦大贵族哈康·孙尼瓦松（又称哈康·于德）。她的儿子埃里克即“羔羊”埃里克三世，于1137年至1146年任丹麦国王。

en: Saxo Grammaticus (c. 1150–c. 1220) was a Danish historian and cleric, born on Zealand and probably educated outside Denmark. He served Archbishop Absalon of Lund, chief adviser to Valdemar I, as clerk and secretary, and may earlier have soldiered in the royal retinue alongside the chronicler Sven Aggesen. Under Absalon's patronage he composed the Gesta Danorum, a Latin history of the Danes in sixteen books, from their earliest legends to his own day. It is the first full history of Denmark, and its tale of Amleth later inspired Shakespeare's Hamlet.
zh: 萨克索·格拉玛提库斯（约1150—约1220）是丹麦史学家、教士，生于西兰岛，可能曾在丹麦以外受教育。他担任隆德大主教、瓦尔德马一世首席顾问阿布萨隆的文书与秘书，早年或曾与编年史家斯文·阿格森同在国王扈从队中服役。在阿布萨隆庇护下，他以拉丁文写成《丹麦人的事迹》，共十六卷，自丹麦人最古老的传说叙述到他所处的时代，是丹麦第一部完整通史；书中阿姆雷特的故事后来启发了莎士比亚的《哈姆雷特》。

en: Anders Sørensen Vedel (1542–1616) was a Danish priest and historian. Born in Vejle and educated at Ribe and Copenhagen, he accompanied Tycho Brahe on his European tour as tutor in 1562, forming a lasting friendship with him, and studied at Wittenberg before becoming priest at Copenhagen Castle in 1568. Encouraged by Peder Oxe, he translated Saxo Grammaticus's Latin chronicle Gesta Danorum into Danish, publishing Den danske Krønicke in 1575. Appointed royal historian in 1584, he failed to complete a continuation of Saxo, but his Hundredvisebogen of 1591, a hundred Danish ballads, preserved the older Danish tradition. He died at Ribe on 13 February 1616.
zh: 安诺斯·瑟伦森·韦泽尔（1542—1616）是丹麦牧师、历史学家。他生于瓦埃勒，在里伯和哥本哈根求学，1562年作为第谷·布拉赫的导师陪其游历欧洲，与他结下长久友谊，后入维滕贝格大学学习，1568年任哥本哈根城堡牧师。在佩德·奥克塞的鼓励下，他将萨克索·格拉玛提库斯的拉丁文编年史《丹麦人的事迹》译成丹麦语，1575年出版《丹麦编年史》。1584年他被任命为王室史官，未能完成续写萨克索的计划，但1591年问世的《百歌集》收录一百首丹麦民谣，保存了古老的丹麦文学传统。1616年2月13日卒于里伯。

en: Svend Tronkræver, or Svend Svendsen (died 1104), was an illegitimate son of King Sweyn II Estridsson of Denmark, sharing his name with his brother Sweyn the Crusader. When Eric Evergood died in Cyprus in July 1103, Svend claimed the crown. Traveling to the royal election at the Viborg landsting he fell ill, yet pressed on lest rivals arrive first, and died of the hardships in 1104; his younger brother Niels was elected king instead. His son was Henrik Skadelår, and his grandson Magnus Henriksen ruled briefly as king of Sweden in 1160–1161.
zh: 斯文·特龙克雷弗，绰号“争位者”，又称斯文·斯文森（？—1104），是丹麦国王斯文二世·埃斯特里德森的私生子，与兄弟“十字军”斯文同名。1103年7月埃里克一世在塞浦路斯去世后，斯文争夺王位。他在赶往维堡郡集会参加国王选举的途中病倒，为不让竞争者抢先仍抱病赶路，终因劳顿于1104年死去，王位由弟弟尼尔斯获得。他的儿子是亨里克·斯卡德洛，孙子马格努斯·亨里克松曾于1160—1161年短暂做过瑞典国王。

en: Sweyn II Estridsson (c. 1019–1076), born in England to Ulf Thorgilsson and Estrid, sister of Canute the Great, ruled Denmark as king from 1047. He fought long wars to hold the crown against Magnus I of Norway and Harald Hardrada, who defeated him at sea off Niså in 1062 before recognizing him in 1064. In 1069 he allied with Edgar Ætheling and sent a force to England that took York; he then accepted payment from William the Conqueror to abandon Edgar. He organized the Danish church into eight bishoprics, died in 1076 and was buried at Roskilde; five of his sons followed him on the throne.
zh: 斯文二世·埃斯特里德森（约1019—1076）生于英格兰，是乌尔夫·索尔吉尔森与克努特大帝之妹埃斯特丽德之子，1047年起为丹麦国王。为保住王位，他长期同挪威国王马格努斯一世和哈拉尔·哈德拉达作战，1062年在尼萨近海海战中战败，1064年哈拉尔才承认他的王位。1069年，他与显贵者埃德加结盟，派兵入侵英格兰并攻占约克；随后他收受征服者威廉的钱款，抛弃了埃德加。他将丹麦教会划分为八个主教区，1076年去世，葬于罗斯基勒；他有五个儿子先后登上丹麦王位。

en: Sweyn III Grathe (c. 1125–1157) was the illegitimate son of Eric II the Memorable. When Eric III abdicated in 1146, Zealand's magnates elected Sweyn king while Jutland's crowned Canute V, opening a long civil war. Sweyn held on through shifting alliances with Canute V and his cousin Valdemar, son of Canute Lavard, and in 1152 married Adela of Meissen. In 1157 the three agreed to partition Denmark, but at a peace banquet in Roskilde Sweyn's men murdered Canute V while Valdemar escaped. Valdemar raised an army and defeated Sweyn at the Battle of Grathe Heath on 23 October 1157; Sweyn was killed after the battle.
zh: “格拉特”斯文三世（约1125—1157）是“难忘者”埃里克二世的私生子。1146年埃里克三世退位后，西兰岛的贵族拥立斯文为王，日德兰半岛的贵族则加冕克努特五世，丹麦由此陷入长期内战。斯文在与克努特五世、堂亲瓦尔德马（克努特·拉瓦德之子）反复离合的同盟中维持王位，并于1152年迎娶迈森的阿德拉。1157年三人同意瓜分丹麦，但在罗斯基勒的和平晚宴上，斯文的手下杀死克努特五世，瓦尔德马逃脱。瓦尔德马随即起兵，于1157年10月23日在格拉特希夫战役击败斯文；斯文在战后被杀。

en: Bertel Thorvaldsen (1770–1844) was Denmark's first internationally celebrated sculptor, born in Copenhagen to an Icelandic wood-carver. As a student at the Royal Danish Academy he assisted his father, won a gold medal in 1793 and received a stipend to study in Rome. He reached Rome in 1797 and worked there for forty-one years. His Jason of 1801, praised by Antonio Canova, established him as Canova's heir in heroic neoclassicism, and his patrons spanned Europe; his monuments include the Copernicus statue in Warsaw and the tomb of Pope Pius VII in St Peter's. When he returned in 1838 he was hailed as a national hero, and the Thorvaldsen Museum was built beside Christiansborg to house his work.
zh: 贝特尔·托瓦尔森（1770—1844）是第一位享誉国际的丹麦雕塑家，生于哥本哈根，父亲是冰岛籍木雕工匠。他在丹麦皇家美术学院求学时协助父亲工作，1793年获得金奖和赴罗马深造的津贴。他于1797年抵达罗马，在那里创作了四十一年。他1801年的《伊阿宋》受到安东尼奥·卡诺瓦赞赏，使他成为卡诺瓦在英雄式新古典主义领域的传人，主顾遍及全欧；作品包括华沙的哥白尼雕像和圣彼得大教堂里的庇护七世墓。1838年回国时他被当作民族英雄受到欢迎，人们在克里斯蒂安堡旁修建托瓦尔森博物馆收藏他的作品。

en: Valdemar IV, called Atterdag for the lands he gradually won back (c. 1320–1375), grew up at the Bavarian court of Emperor Louis IV while Count Gerhard III of Holstein-Rendsburg ruled a Denmark pledged away in pieces. After Niels Ebbesen killed Gerhard in 1340, Valdemar was acclaimed king at Viborg. He redeemed the pawned lands and taxed hard, even through the Black Death of 1349–1350; uprisings followed. In 1361 he conquered Gotland and, at Visby, ordered three beer barrels filled with gold and silver within three days or the town would be pillaged; they were full before the first night. In 1362 the Hanseatic towns, Sweden and Norway allied against him, and with Jutland's nobles in revolt they forced him abroad in 1368. The Treaty of Stralsund in 1370 gave the Hansa its trading rights and let him return, still holding Gotland. He died at Gurre Castle in 1375, buried at Sorø Abbey; his daughter was Margaret I.
zh: 瓦尔德玛四世，绰号“阿道戴”（中文通称再兴王），因逐步收回失地而得名（约1320—1375）。他早年大半时间在神圣罗马皇帝路易四世位于巴伐利亚的宫廷度过，此时荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡伯爵格哈德三世统治着被一块块抵押出去的丹麦。1340年，尼尔斯·埃勃森杀死格哈德，瓦尔德玛在维堡被拥立为王。他赎回被抵押的土地，并不断加税，1349—1350年黑死病期间也不松手，随后起义四起。1361年他征服哥得兰岛，在维斯比下令三天内用金银装满三只啤酒桶，否则纵兵洗劫，结果第一天夜里桶就满了。1362年汉萨诸城与瑞典、挪威结盟对抗他，加上日德兰贵族叛乱，1368年他被迫离开丹麦。1370年订立《施特拉尔松德条约》，汉萨同盟取得贸易权利，他得以返国，哥得兰仍在他手中。1375年他死于古勒城堡，葬在索勒修道院；其女即后来的玛格丽特一世。

en: Valdemar I, called the Great (1131–1182), was the son of the murdered Danish prince Canute Lavard. After Eric III abdicated in 1146 he fought a ten-year civil war against rival kings Sweyn III and Canute V, holding Schleswig as his base. When Sweyn murdered Canute at a feast in Roskilde in 1157, Valdemar avenged his kinsman, defeating and killing Sweyn at the Battle of Grathe Heath later that year and uniting Denmark. Aided by Bishop Absalon, he rebuilt the kingdom, warred down the Wends, and in 1168 stormed Arkona on Rügen, imposing Christianity and Danish overlordship in Pomerania.
zh: 瓦尔德马一世，被尊为瓦尔德马大帝（1131—1182），是遇害的丹麦王子克努特·拉瓦德之子。1146年埃里克三世退位后，他以石勒苏益格为根据地，与争位的斯文三世和克努特五世进行了十年内战。1157年斯文三世在罗斯基勒的宴会上杀害克努特五世，瓦尔德马起兵报仇，于同年的格拉特希夫战役击败并杀死斯文三世，统一丹麦。在主教阿布萨隆辅佐下，他重建国家，征讨文德人，1168年攻克吕根岛上的阿科纳，迫使文德人皈依基督教，并在波美拉尼亚建立丹麦的宗主权。

en: Valdemar II, called the Victorious (1170–1241), succeeded his brother Canute VI as king of Denmark in 1202 and conquered Holstein and Lübeck. On 15 June 1219 his crusading army defeated the Estonians at the Battle of Lindanise, where legend says the Danish flag, the Dannebrog, fell from the sky. In 1223 he and his son were seized on Lyø by Count Henry of Schwerin and freed only for a heavy ransom; his defeat at Bornhöved in 1227 lost Denmark's north German lands. His Code of Jutland was enacted in 1241, shortly before he died at Vordingborg.
zh: 瓦尔德马二世，被称为胜利王（1170—1241），于1202年继兄长克努特六世之后登上丹麦王位，征服了荷尔斯泰因和吕贝克。1219年6月15日，他率领的十字军在林达尼萨战役中击败爱沙尼亚人，相传丹麦国旗丹尼布洛就在此役中从天而降。1223年，他与儿子在吕岛被什未林伯爵亨利掳走，付出巨额赎金后才获释；1227年在博恩赫沃德战败，丧失了丹麦在北德意志的领地。1241年他颁布《日德兰法典》，不久后在沃尔丁堡去世。

en: Valdemar III (1314–1364), son of Duke Eric II of Schleswig and Adelaide of Holstein, was placed on the Danish throne in 1326 when Holstein and Danish nobles deposed Christopher II; as he was only eleven, his maternal uncle Gerhard III of Holstein ruled as regent. The Constitutio Valdemariana barred any one man from holding Denmark and Schleswig together, so Valdemar enfeoffed Schleswig to his uncle. Peasant revolts in Zealand in 1328 and Jutland in 1329 weakened the regime, and in 1329 Christopher II returned to the throne while Valdemar resumed rule as Duke of Schleswig until his death.
zh: 瓦尔德马三世（1314—1364）是石勒苏益格公爵埃里克二世与荷尔斯泰因的阿德莱德之子。1326年，荷尔斯泰因与丹麦贵族废黜克里斯托弗二世，把年仅十一岁的瓦尔德马扶上丹麦王位，由舅父荷尔斯泰因的格哈德三世摄政。《瓦尔德马宪章》规定任何人不得同时兼有丹麦与石勒苏益格，瓦尔德马遂将石勒苏益格封给舅父。1328年西兰岛、1329年日德兰半岛相继爆发农民起义，局势动摇；1329年克里斯托弗二世复位，瓦尔德马退回石勒苏益格继续担任公爵，直至1364年去世。

en: Valdemar III Abelsøn (1238–1257) was the eldest son of King Abel of Denmark and Matilda of Holstein and Duke of Schleswig from 1253. When Abel was killed in Frisia in 1252, Valdemar was a hostage of the Archbishop of Cologne and could not claim the crown, so his uncle Christopher I became king. His mother's Holstein kinsmen freed him, and Christopher invested him with Schleswig in 1253; his short rule was spent warring against the king. He died in 1257, leaving the duchy to his brother Eric.
zh: 瓦尔德马三世·阿贝尔森（1238—1257）是丹麦国王阿贝尔与荷尔斯泰因的玛蒂尔达的长子，1253年起任石勒苏益格公爵。1252年阿贝尔在弗里斯兰被杀时，瓦尔德马正被科隆大主教扣作人质，无法争夺王位，王位落入叔父克里斯托弗一世之手。靠母亲一方的荷尔斯泰因亲戚营救，他才得以脱身，并于1253年受封石勒苏益格；他短暂的公爵任内始终在与国王交战。1257年他去世，公爵之位由弟弟埃里克继承。

en: Valdemar IV Eriksøn (c. 1262–1312) was Duke of Schleswig from 1283, the eldest son of Duke Eric I of Schleswig and Margaret of Rugia. When his father died in 1272 Valdemar was only about ten, and Eric V of Denmark withheld the duchy for a decade until the Danehof meeting at Vordingborg forced his installation in 1283. The next year he granted city rights to Flensburg, and in 1287 he married Elisabeth of Saxe-Lauenburg, who bore his heir Eric II. He died in the spring of 1312 and was buried in Schleswig Cathedral, with Eric II succeeding him.
zh: 瓦尔德马四世·埃里克松（约1262—1312）于1283年成为石勒苏益格公爵，是公爵埃里克一世与吕根的玛格丽特的长子。1272年父亲去世时他年仅十岁左右，丹麦国王埃里克五世将公国扣押了十年，直到1283年沃尔丁堡的丹麦政务会议迫使国王立他为公爵。次年他授予弗伦斯堡城市权，1287年娶萨克森-劳恩堡的伊丽莎白，她生下继承人埃里克二世。他于1312年春去世，葬于石勒苏益格主教座堂，由埃里克二世继位。

en: Valdemar the Young (c. 1209–1231) was the only child of King Valdemar II of Denmark and his first queen, Dagmar of Bohemia. In 1215 he was made co-king beside his father, entrenching the new hereditary kingship, though he never reigned alone. In 1223 he was seized together with his father by Count Henry of Schwerin during the hunt on Lyø and shared his captivity. On 28 November 1231 he was accidentally killed by an arrow while hunting at Refsnæs, dying before his father.
zh: 年轻者瓦尔德马（约1209—1231）是丹麦国王瓦尔德马二世与第一任王后波希米亚的达格玛唯一的孩子。1215年他被立为父亲的共治国王，巩固了新生的世袭王统，但从未独自执政。1223年，他在吕岛打猎时与父亲一同被什未林伯爵亨利掳走，一同遭到囚禁。1231年11月28日，他在雷夫斯奈斯打猎时被箭误中身亡，死在父亲之前。

en: Darmabala (1264–1292) was the second son of Crown Prince Zhenjin and a grandson of Kublai Khan, wedded to Dagi of the Khongirad. After Zhenjin's death in 1286 Kublai saw him as a likely heir and gave him an army command, though Marco Polo called him rickety. In 1291 Kublai sent him to govern Huaizhou, but he fell ill on the way, returned to Khanbaliq, and died there in May 1292. His sons Khayishan and Ayurbarwada both became Yuan emperors; when Khayishan took the throne in 1307 he posthumously honoured Darmabala as Emperor Shunzong.
zh: 答剌麻八剌（1264—1292）是太子真金的次子、忽必烈之孙，娶弘吉剌部的答己为妃。1286年真金死后，忽必烈视他为可能的继承人，授以兵权，马可·波罗却称他体弱。1291年，忽必烈派他出镇怀州，他途中病倒，返回大都后于1292年5月病逝。他的两个儿子海山和爱育黎拔力八达后来都成为元朝皇帝；1307年海山即位，当天追尊父亲答剌麻八剌为顺宗皇帝。

en: Andrew Guigues (1184–1237), born André of Burgundy, was a son of Duke Hugh III of Burgundy and Béatrice of Albon, through whom he inherited the Dauphiné of Viennois in 1228, ruling as Dauphin Guigues VI. He enlarged his lands chiefly by diplomacy and patronage rather than war, favouring monasteries and founding the collegiate church of Saint-André in Grenoble, where he was buried. In 1228 he backed Turin against Count Thomas I of Savoy over trade duties. He married Beatrice of Sabran, countess of Gap and Embrun, in 1202 and divorced her in 1215. By his second wife, Beatrice of Montferrat, whom he married in 1219, he left a son and heir, Guigues VII.
zh: 安德鲁·吉格（1184—1237）本名勃艮第的安德烈，是勃艮第公爵于格三世与贝娅特丽克丝·德·阿尔邦之子。他通过母系于1228年继承维埃努瓦多芬领地，称多芬吉格六世。他扩张领地主要依靠外交和庇护而非战争，扶持修道院，并在格勒诺布尔创建圣安德烈协同教堂，身后即葬于此。1228年，他在贸易关税问题上支持都灵对抗萨伏依伯爵托马斯一世。1202年他娶加普与昂布兰女伯爵萨布朗的贝娅特丽克丝，1215年与她离婚。他于1219年娶第二任妻子蒙费拉的贝娅特丽克丝，生子继承人吉格七世。

en: Anne of Viennois (died 1299) was countess of Albon and Viennois suo jure, the daughter of Dauphin Guigues VII of Viennois and Béatrice of Faucigny. In September 1273 she married Humbert, baron of La Tour-du-Pin. When her brother John I died in a riding accident in 1282, Anne inherited the Dauphiné, which through her marriage passed to the House of La Tour-du-Pin, whose members ruled as dauphins for the next century. She bore nine children, among them the future dauphin John II, and was buried in the Carthusian monastery of Salette.
zh: 维埃努瓦的安娜（卒于1299年）是凭自身权位在位的阿尔邦与维埃努瓦女伯爵，维埃努瓦王太子吉格七世与福西尼的贝阿特丽丝之女。1273年9月，她嫁给拉图尔-迪潘男爵安贝尔。1282年其兄弟让一世坠马身亡后，安娜继承多菲内，领地也借由这场婚姻转入拉图尔-迪潘家族，该家族在此后一个世纪里世袭王太子之位。她育有九个子女，其中包括后来的王太子让二世，死后葬于萨莱特的加尔都西会修道院。

en: Beatrice of Montferrat (c. 1210–1274) was the eldest daughter of William VI, Marquess of Montferrat, and Berta of Clavesana, and younger sister of Boniface II. On 21 November 1219, aged about nine, she married Guigues VI of Viennois, more than twenty years her senior, as his third wife. From 1228 she was dauphine of Viennois and countess of Albon. When Guigues died in March 1237 she became regent for their young son Guigues VII, guiding his reign until 1243. The troubadour Gauseran de Saint-Leidier made her the idealised lady of his love songs.
zh: 蒙费拉托的贝娅特丽克丝（约1210—1274）是蒙费拉托侯爵古列尔莫六世与克拉韦萨纳的贝尔塔的长女，波尼法乔二世的妹妹。1219年11月21日，年约九岁的她嫁给年长二十余岁的维埃努瓦的吉格六世，为其第三任妻子。1228年起，她成为维埃努瓦多芬夫人、阿尔邦伯爵夫人。1237年3月吉格六世去世后，她为年幼的儿子吉格七世摄政，辅佐其统治直到1243年。游吟诗人戈瑟兰·德·圣莱迪耶把她奉为情歌中理想化的爱慕对象。

en: Béatrice of Albon (1161–1228) inherited Albon, Grenoble and the Dauphiné of Viennois as an infant on the death of her father Guigues V in 1162, with her grandmother Margaret acting as regent. Aged three she was married to Albéric Taillefer of Toulouse, a nephew of King Louis VII of France, bringing her lands in the Empire closer to the French kingdom. Albéric died without issue in 1183. That year she married Hugh III, Duke of Burgundy, who ruled her lands as her husband and joined the Third Crusade, dying at Acre in 1192. Her son by Hugh, André, succeeded as Dauphin Guigues VI. She later married Hugh of Coligny and died at Vizille on 16 December 1228.
zh: 贝娅特丽克丝·德·阿尔邦（1161—1228）在1162年父亲吉格五世去世时年幼，继承了阿尔邦、格勒诺布尔和维埃努瓦多芬领地，由祖母玛格丽特摄政。她三岁时嫁给图卢兹的阿尔贝里克·塔耶费尔，后者是法王路易七世的外甥；这桩婚姻使她在帝国内的领地与法兰西王国逐渐接近。阿尔贝里克于1183年无嗣而终。同年她嫁给勃艮第公爵于格三世，于格以丈夫身份治理她的领地，并参加第三次十字军东征，1192年卒于阿卡。她与于格所生之子安德鲁后来以吉格六世之名继位。她之后改嫁科利尼的于格，1228年12月16日卒于维济耶。

en: Beatrice of Hungary (1290 – 1343 or 1354) was the elder daughter of Charles Martel of Anjou, titular King of Hungary, and Clemence of Habsburg, and sister of Charles I of Hungary. In 1296, aged six, she was married at Naples to the ten-years-older John II of Viennois, Dauphin of Viennois. She bore him two sons, Guigues VIII and Humbert II, both later dauphins. After John died in 1319 she became a nun at Cîteaux, moving in 1340 to Saint-Just-de-Claix Abbey, which her son Humbert had founded for her. She died there in 1343 or 1354.
zh: 匈牙利的贝娅特丽克丝（1290—1343或1354）是匈牙利名义国王安茹的查理·马特尔与哈布斯堡的克莱门丝的长女，匈牙利国王查理一世之妹。1296年，年仅六岁的她在那不勒斯嫁给比她年长十岁的维埃努瓦王太子让二世，生下吉格八世和安贝尔二世两个儿子，两人后来都成为王太子。1319年让二世去世后，她入西多修道院为修女，1340年转入儿子安贝尔为她修建的圣朱斯特-德-克莱修道院，于1343年或1354年在那里去世。

en: Guigues I, called the Old (c.995–1070), was a minor noble of the Kingdom of Arles who founded the line of the counts of Albon, the future dauphins of Viennois. Attested at Moirans in a charter of 1016, he built a domain between the Rhône and the Alps, holding Champsaur by 1027 and appearing as count in Oisans from 1035, then Grésivaudan, the Briançonnais and the Oulx valley. His lands lay in the Kingdom of Arles, incorporated into the Holy Roman Empire in 1033. He placed kinsmen in the bishoprics of Grenoble and Valence. With his wife Adelaide he had a son, Guigues II, and died a monk at Cluny about 1070.
zh: 吉格一世绰号“老者”（约995—约1070），是阿尔勒王国的小贵族，开创了阿尔邦伯爵家族，即后来维埃努瓦多芬的世系。1016年的一份特许状已记载他在穆瓦朗拥有地产；此后他在罗讷河与阿尔卑斯山之间建立领地，1027年据有尚索，1035年起以伯爵身份出现在瓦桑，随后又取得格雷西沃当、布里扬索内和乌尔克斯河谷。他的领地位于阿尔勒王国境内，该国于1033年并入神圣罗马帝国。他把亲族安插进格勒诺布尔和瓦朗斯的主教区。他与妻子阿德莱德生有一子吉格二世，最后在克吕尼出家为修士，约1070年卒于该地。

en: Guigues II d'Albon, called the Fat (Guigo Pinguis, c. 1025–c. 1079), was a noble of the Kingdom of Arles and the son of Count Guigues I and Adelaide. Before April 1052 he married Pétronille, likely a daughter of Artaud de Royans, who bore his heir Guigues III. His scattered estates ran from Albon and the Grésivaudan around Grenoble to the Briançonnais. From 1070 he was styled count in the Grésivaudan and Briançonnais; that year monks of La Chaise-Dieu founded Saint-Robert priory at Saint-Égrève under him. He is first styled count of Albon in 1079 and died soon after.
zh: 吉格二世·德阿尔邦绰号“胖子”（约1025—约1079），是阿尔勒王国的贵族，吉格一世伯爵与阿德莱德之子。1052年4月之前，他娶了很可能是阿尔托·德·鲁瓦扬之女的佩特罗妮拉，后者生下继承人吉格三世。他的地产彼此分散，从阿尔邦、格勒诺布尔周边的格雷西沃当一直延伸到布里扬索内。1070年起，他的头衔为格雷西沃当与布里扬索内伯爵；同年，拉谢斯迪约修道院的修士在他治下的圣埃格雷夫建立圣罗贝尔小修道院。1079年的文书首次称他为阿尔邦伯爵，此后不久他便去世。

en: Guigues III, called the Old (c. 1050–1133), ruled as count of Albon from 1079, when the County of Vienne was split between him and Humbert I of Savoy. From the Grésivaudan north of Grenoble he long disputed church estates with Hugh of Châteauneuf, bishop of Grenoble, who accused him of usurping them. An accord in 1099 had Guigues return church lands, while Hugh recognised the count's authority around the city. In 1095 he married Matilda, likely a daughter of Roger I of Sicily. The 1129 partition of the Viennois with Amadeus III of Savoy enlarged his lands, and on his death in 1133 his son Guigues IV inherited the county.
zh: 吉格三世，号“长者”（约1050—1133），1079年起任阿尔邦伯爵，当时维埃纳伯国由他与萨伏依的翁贝托一世瓜分。他立足格勒诺布尔以北的格雷西沃当，长期与格勒诺布尔主教沙托讷夫的于格争夺教产，于格指控他侵占这些土地。1099年双方达成协议，吉格归还教产，于格则承认伯爵在格勒诺布尔一带的权威。1095年他与玛蒂尔德成婚，后者很可能是西西里伯爵罗杰一世之女。1129年他与萨伏依的阿梅迪奥三世瓜分维埃努瓦，领地随之扩大；1133年去世后，伯国由儿子吉格四世继承。

en: Guigues IV, called le Dauphin, was count of Albon from 1133. The eldest son of Guigues III and Matilda, he was the first of his family to bear the name Dauphin, which became the title of the Viennois rulers. He married Margaret, daughter of Count Stephen I of Burgundy. In 1140 the first war broke out between Albon and Savoy, probably over the dowry of his sister Matilda, who had married Count Amadeus III of Savoy. Guigues invaded Savoy and besieged Montmélian, but was ambushed and wounded near La Buissière, dying on 28 June 1142. His son Guigues V succeeded him.
zh: 吉格四世绰号“多芬”，自1133年起任阿尔邦伯爵。他是吉格三世与玛蒂尔达的长子，也是家族中第一个使用“多芬”之名的人，这个名字后来成为维埃努瓦统治者的头衔。他娶勃艮第伯爵艾蒂安一世之女玛格丽特为妻。1140年，阿尔邦与萨伏依之间爆发第一次战争，起因很可能是他嫁给萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥三世的妹妹玛蒂尔达的嫁妆。吉格入侵萨伏依并围攻蒙梅利扬，却在拉比西耶尔附近遭伏击受伤，于1142年6月28日去世，其子吉格五世继位。

en: Guigues V (c.1125–1162), count of Albon and Grenoble from 1142, was the first to take the title Dauphin du Viennois. He succeeded his father Guigues IV as a minor under his mother Margaret's regency until 1153. Seeking to avenge his father, who had been killed during a siege of Montmélian, he renewed the war with Savoy and besieged the castle again, until Humbert III's relief army drove him off; the bishop of Grenoble made peace. In 1155 at Rivoli he did homage to the Emperor Frederick Barbarossa, who confirmed his lands and granted him minting rights at Râme and Cesana, the latter in competition with Savoy's mint at Susa. He died at Vizille on 29 July 1162, leaving a daughter, Beatrice.
zh: 吉格五世（约1125—1162）自1142年起任阿尔邦与格勒诺布尔伯爵，是第一个采用“维埃努瓦多芬”头衔的人。他幼年继承父亲吉格四世之位，由母亲玛格丽特摄政至1153年。为给围攻蒙梅利扬时丧生的父亲报仇，他重启与萨伏依的战争，再次围攻该城，却被安贝尔三世的援军击退，最终由格勒诺布尔主教促成和约。1155年，他在里沃利向皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨行臣服礼，皇帝确认了他的领地，并赐他在拉姆和切萨纳的铸币权；切萨纳的铸币厂与萨伏依在苏萨的铸币厂竞争。1162年7月29日他卒于维济耶，留下女儿贝娅特丽克丝。

en: Guigues VII (1225–1269) of the House of Burgundy succeeded his father Andrew Guigues VI as dauphin of Viennois in 1237, initially under the guidance of his mother Beatrice of Montferrat. He disputed the counties of Embrun and Gap, the dowry of his father's first wife, with Charles of Anjou until a compromise left him Embrun while Charles took Gap. In 1247 Emperor Frederick II summoned him to join an army intended to attack the pope at Lyon, though Frederick was drawn away by fighting in Italy. In 1253 he married Beatrice of Savoy, whose dowry brought him Faucigny, an enclave bordering Savoy that drew his successors into repeated wars. He was succeeded by his son John I, then by his daughter Anne, wife of Humbert de la Tour du Pin.
zh: 吉格七世（1225—1269）出身勃艮第家族，1237年继承父亲安德鲁·吉格六世的维埃努瓦多芬之位，最初由母亲蒙费拉的贝娅特丽克丝辅佐。他与安茹的查理争夺昂布兰和加普两个伯国，这两地是他父亲首任妻子的嫁妆；最终双方达成妥协，吉格保有昂布兰，查理取得加普。1247年，皇帝腓特烈二世征召他加入准备进攻里昂教宗的军队，但皇帝后来被意大利的战事牵制。1253年他娶萨伏依的贝娅特丽克丝，妻子的嫁妆带来了福西尼，一块与萨伏依接壤的飞地，使他的继承人屡屡卷入战争。他先后由儿子让一世和女儿安娜继位，安娜嫁给了安贝尔·德·拉图尔迪潘。

en: Guigues VIII (1309–1333) succeeded his father John II as dauphin of Viennois in 1318, under the regency of his uncle Henri, bishop-elect of Metz, until 1323. In 1323 he married Isabelle, daughter of Philip V of France, strengthening French influence in his lands. A bold soldier, Guigues won a victory over the Savoyards at the Battle of Varey in 1325. In 1328 he led the Seventh Corps under Philip VI at the Battle of Cassel against the Flemings, and was rewarded for his courage with the Maison aux Piliers in Paris. He was killed in 1333 besieging the Savoyard castle of La Perrière, and was buried in Grenoble, leaving the Dauphiné to his brother Humbert II.
zh: 吉格八世（1309—1333）于1318年继承父亲让二世的维埃努瓦多芬之位，由叔父、当选梅斯主教的亨利摄政至1323年。1323年他娶法王腓力五世之女伊莎贝尔，加强了法国在其领地的影响。吉格作战勇猛，1325年在瓦雷战役中击败萨伏依人。1328年，他在卡塞尔战役中隶属腓力六世麾下，率领第七军与佛兰德斯人作战，并因勇敢获赐巴黎的柱廊宅邸。1333年，他在围攻萨伏依的拉佩里耶尔城堡时阵亡，葬于格勒诺布尔，维埃努瓦多芬领地传给弟弟安贝尔二世。

en: Henri de la Tour du Pin (1296–1328), also called Henri Dauphin, was the fourth son of Humbert I, Dauphin of Viennois, and Anne of Burgundy. Destined for the church but never ordained a priest, he became bishop of Passau in 1317 and was named bishop of Metz by Pope John XXII on 4 May 1319. From 1319 to 1323 he ruled the Dauphiné as regent for his nephew Guigues VIII. In 1323 he pledged Condé castle to the count of Bar against debts incurred by his predecessor. His constant demands for money angered the people of Metz, and on 25 August 1325 he resigned his see, returned to lay life, and died there in 1328.
zh: 亨利·德·拉图尔迪潘（1296—1328），别称亨利·多芬，是维埃纳多芬安贝尔一世与勃艮第的安妮的第四子。他自幼投身教会，却从未受任司铎，1317年成为帕绍主教，1319年5月4日被教皇约翰二十二世任命为梅斯主教。1319至1323年，他又以摄政身份替侄子居伊八世统治多菲内。1323年，他将孔代城堡抵押给巴尔伯爵，以偿还前任所欠债务。他不断敛财，激起梅斯民众不满，遂于1325年8月25日辞去主教之职，重归世俗生活，1328年在多菲内去世。

en: Humbert I (c.1240–1307), baron of La Tour-du-Pin, married Anne, daughter of Dauphin Guigues VII, in 1273, and from 1282 ruled the Dauphiné of Viennois in her right, uniting his barony with the county. The union cut the Savoyard lands in two and brought war with Count Philip I of Savoy. In 1283 Humbert acknowledged that he and Anne held the counties of Vienne and Albon as fiefs of the archbishop of Vienne. He later ambushed and routed Amadeus V near Barraux. In 1294 he became a vassal of King Philip IV of France in exchange for an annual pension, preparing the later French annexation of the Dauphiné. He died in April 1307, leaving the Dauphiné to his son John II.
zh: 安贝尔一世（约1240—1307）是拉图尔迪潘男爵，1273年娶多芬吉格七世之女安娜，1282年起以妻子的权位统治维埃努瓦多芬领地，将自己的男爵领地与伯国合并。这次合并割裂了萨伏依的领地，引发与萨伏依伯爵腓力一世的战争。1283年，安贝尔承认他与安娜持有的维埃纳和阿尔邦伯国是维埃纳大主教的封地。后来安贝尔在巴罗附近伏击并击溃阿梅迪奥五世。1294年，他以领取年金为条件成为法王腓力四世的封臣，为日后法国吞并维埃努瓦多芬领地铺平道路。1307年4月他去世，把领地留给儿子让二世。

en: Humbert II (1312–1355), the last dauphin of Viennois, was abroad at the courts of Hungary and Naples when he was recalled in 1333 to replace his brother Guigues VIII, killed assaulting a castle. His lavish court at Beauvoir-en-Royans outran his means, yet he was a notable administrator: the Conseil delphinal in 1337, Grenoble University in 1339, and in 1343 the Charter of the Escartons, which gave the Briançonnais self-rule. After his only son André died in 1335 he tried to sell his lands, offering them to Robert of Naples in 1337, who refused the price. He led a papal crusade to relieve Smyrna in 1345, beat the besieging Turks in 1346, and came home ruined in 1347. By the Treaty of Romans in 1349 he sold the Dauphiné to Philip VI, and on 16 July invested the king's grandson Charles, the first French dauphin. Humbert became a Dominican and Latin patriarch of Alexandria, and died in 1355.
zh: 安贝尔二世（1312—1355）是末代维埃努瓦多芬。1333年，他还在匈牙利和那不勒斯的宫廷间游历，就被召回接替攻城时阵亡的兄长吉格八世。他在鲁瓦扬的博瓦尔维持的奢华宫廷入不敷出，却是出色的行政者：1337年设立多芬会议，1339年创办格勒诺布尔大学，1343年颁布《埃斯卡尔通宪章》，授予布里扬索内地区自治权。1335年独子安德烈夭折后，他开始设法出售领地，1337年向那不勒斯的罗贝托提出，对方嫌价钱太高而拒绝。1345年，他率领一支教宗十字军前往救援士麦那，1346年击败围城的土耳其人，1347年他破产归国。1349年，他通过《罗芒条约》将多菲内卖给法王腓力六世，并于7月16日为法王的孙子查理授封，查理成为第一位法国多芬。此后安贝尔加入多明我会，任拉丁礼亚历山大宗主教，1355年去世。

en: John I (1264–1282) was dauphin of Viennois and count of Albon from 1269, succeeding his father Guigues VII when he was only five. His mother Béatrice of Faucigny, known as the Grande Dauphine, ruled as regent, and a convention of 1270 named Duke Robert II of Burgundy as the boy's tutor. When his mother married Gaston VII of Béarn in 1273, Robert became regent of the Dauphiné. John died on 24 September 1282 at Bonneville castle after a fall from his horse, aged eighteen and without an heir, so his lands passed to his sister Anne.
zh: 让一世（1264—1282）是维埃努瓦王太子、阿尔邦伯爵，1269年父亲吉格七世去世时年仅五岁，随即继位。他的母亲福西尼的贝阿特丽丝号称“大王太子妃”，代为摄政；1270年的协议指定勃艮第公爵罗贝尔二世担任幼主的监护人。1273年母亲改嫁贝阿恩子爵加斯东七世后，罗贝尔成为多菲内摄政。1282年9月24日，让一世在博讷维尔城堡坠马身亡，年仅十八岁且没有子嗣，领地由其姐妹安娜继承。

en: John II (1280–1319) succeeded his father Humbert I as dauphin of Viennois in 1306. In 1296 he married Beatrice of Hungary, daughter of Charles Martel, titular king of Hungary; their sons Guigues VIII and Humbert II both became dauphin. His reign was dominated by rivalry with the counts of Savoy: he secured the frontier by chartering walled towns at La Buissière and Avalon. He offered settlers land and rights of use in return for maintaining walls and joining short military expeditions. On 10 June 1314 he made peace with Count Amadeus V at Villard-Benoît. War resumed in 1318. John died on 5 March 1319 at Pont de Sorgues near Avignon, returning from the papal court.
zh: 让二世（1280—1319）于1306年继承父亲安贝尔一世的维埃努瓦多芬之位。1296年他娶匈牙利的贝娅特丽克丝为妻，她是名义上的匈牙利国王卡洛·马特洛之女；他们的儿子吉格八世和安贝尔二世后来都成为多芬。他统治期间主要忙于与萨伏依诸伯爵的对抗：他授予拉比西耶尔、阿瓦隆等边境筑墙城镇特许状以巩固边防。他向居民提供土地和使用权，换取他们维护城墙并参加短途军事行动。1314年6月10日，他在维拉尔伯努瓦与阿梅迪奥五世伯爵缔结和约。1318年战火重燃。1319年3月5日，让在从教宗宫廷返回途中，卒于阿维尼翁附近的索尔格桥。

en: Marie des Baux (c. 1319 – March 1347) was the daughter of Bertrand III des Baux, Count of Andria in the Kingdom of Naples, and Beatrice of Anjou, niece of King Robert the Wise. In July 1332 she married Humbert II of Viennois, dowered by her uncle Robert. Their only son, André, born in 1333 and betrothed to Blanche of Navarre in 1335, died later that year. After Humbert became dauphin the couple settled at Beauvoir-en-Royans. Marie died at Rhodes in March 1347; Pope Clement VI sent Humbert a letter of condolence that May.
zh: 玛丽·德·博（约1319—1347年3月）是那不勒斯王国安德里亚伯爵贝特朗三世·德·博与安茹的贝亚特丽斯之女，国王罗贝托一世的外甥女。1332年7月她嫁给维埃努瓦的安贝尔二世，由舅父罗贝托赐予嫁妆；两人的独子安德烈生于1333年，1335年与纳瓦拉的布兰卡订婚，同年夭折。安贝尔成为王太子后，夫妇迁居鲁瓦扬地区博瓦尔。1347年3月玛丽在罗得岛去世，教皇克雷芒六世于同年5月致信安贝尔吊唁。

en: David Hume (1711–1776) was a Scottish philosopher, historian and essayist born in Edinburgh. After studying at the city's university, he spent the 1730s in France writing A Treatise of Human Nature, published in 1739–1740, which argued that all knowledge comes from experience and that reason is the slave of the passions. He argued that belief in cause and effect arose from habit rather than proof from experience. The book made little stir at first, so he recast its arguments in the two Enquiries (1748, 1751) and found fame with his six-volume History of England (1754–1762). His empiricism and scepticism deeply influenced Immanuel Kant. He died in Edinburgh in August 1776.
zh: 大卫·休谟（1711—1776）是苏格兰哲学家、历史学家和散文家，生于爱丁堡。他在爱丁堡大学求学后，于1730年代旅居法国，写成《人性论》（1739—1740年出版），主张一切知识源于经验，理性只是激情的奴隶。他认为人们对因果关系的信念源于习惯，而非经验所能提供的证明。该书起初反响平平，他便把其中论点改写为两部《研究》（1748、1751年），又凭六卷本《英格兰史》（1754—1762年）赢得盛名。他的经验主义和怀疑论深刻影响了伊曼努尔·康德。1776年8月他在爱丁堡去世。

en: Vijayabahu V, also called Savulu Vijayabahu, was the last king of Dambadeniya in fourteenth-century Sri Lanka. A son of Chandrabhanu, he succeeded Bhuvanaikabahu III in 1325 or 1326 and kept his capital at Kurunegala. His reign ended in 1344 or 1345, when Bhuvanaikabahu IV succeeded him and the seat of power moved to Gampola. The Arab traveller Ibn Battuta visited the island's northern port of Puttalam either late in his predecessor's reign or early in his own.
zh: 维阇耶巴忽五世（别称萨乌鲁·维阇耶巴忽）是14世纪斯里兰卡丹巴德尼亚王国的末代国王，旃陀罗巴忽之子。他于1325/1326年继布伐奈迦巴忽三世即位，定都库鲁内加拉。1344/1345年他的统治结束，布伐奈迦巴忽四世继位，权力中心随之转到甘波罗。阿拉伯旅行家伊本·白图泰在其前任统治末年或其本人统治初年到访岛屿北部的普塔勒姆港。

en: Ahmed Shihabuddine was Sultan of the Maldives from 1341 to 1347, succeeding his father Sultan Omar I. His reign ended in 1347 when his elder sister Khadijah deposed him and seized the throne. He was banished to Haddhunmathi Atoll, where he was assassinated. With him gone, Khadijah became the first woman to rule the Theemuge dynasty and held power for most of the next thirty years.
zh: 艾哈迈德·希哈卜丁是马尔代夫苏丹，1341年继承父亲奥马尔一世之位，统治至1347年。他在位末期，姐姐哈迪杰将他废黜并夺取王位。他被流放至哈敦马蒂环礁，并在那里遇刺身亡。他死后，哈迪杰成为提穆格王朝第一位女性统治者，并在此后近三十年间大体掌握政权。

en: Khadijah (died 1379 or 1380) was Sultana regnant of the Maldives and the eldest daughter of Sultan Omar I. In 1347 she deposed and had her brother Sultan Ahmed Shihabuddine assassinated and seized the throne, the first woman to rule the Theemuge dynasty. Deposed by her vizier-husband Muhammad el-Jameel around 1363, she soon had him killed and ruled again, then lost power to a second husband, Abdullah I, before assassinating him in 1376 and beginning her third reign. Ibn Battuta described her court. She ruled for nearly thirty years and was succeeded by her sister Raadhafathi.
zh: 哈迪杰（？—1379或1380年）是马尔代夫女苏丹，奥马尔一世的长女。1347年，她废黜并派人刺杀兄长艾哈迈德·希哈卜丁苏丹，自立为王，成为提穆格王朝第一位女性统治者。约1363年，她被身兼丈夫的维齐尔穆罕默德·贾米勒废黜，但随即将其处死并再度执政；此后她又被第二任丈夫阿卜杜拉一世夺权，1376年刺杀阿卜杜拉，开始第三次统治。伊本·白图泰曾记述她的宫廷。她前后执政近三十年，死后由妹妹拉达法蒂继位。

en: Omar I was Sultan of the Maldives from 1306 until his death in 1341, succeeding his father Sultan Salis. The Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta records that Salis was a Bengali who founded a new ruling dynasty. Omar ruled the islands for thirty-five years and was succeeded on his death by his son Ahmed Shihabuddine. His two daughters, Khadijah and Raadhafathi, also later took the throne, so that all three of his children ruled the Maldives.
zh: 奥马尔一世（？—1341）是马尔代夫苏丹，1306年继承父亲苏丹萨利斯之位。摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰记载，萨利斯来自孟加拉，开创了新的统治王朝。奥马尔统治群岛三十五年，1341年去世后由儿子艾哈迈德·希哈卜丁继位。他的两个女儿哈迪杰和拉达法蒂后来也相继登位，三个子女都成了马尔代夫的君主。

en: Raadhafathi was Sultana regnant of the Maldives from 1379 or 1380 to 1383, the third daughter of Sultan Omar I and a younger sister of the long-ruling Khadijah. She ascended after Khadijah's death, and her husband Mohamed of Maakurath directed affairs as her vizier. On her death in 1383 Mohamed took the throne himself, succeeding his wife as ruler of the islands.
zh: 拉达法蒂是1379或1380年至1383年在位的马尔代夫女苏丹，奥马尔一世的三女儿，也是长期执政的哈迪杰的妹妹。她在哈迪杰死后即位，丈夫马库拉特的穆罕默德以维齐尔身份主持政务。1383年她去世后，穆罕默德亲自登上王位，继妻子之后统治群岛。

en: Dungarpur genealogical tradition names Bhoo Chand as the son of Maharawal Virasimhadeva, who ruled from Baroda between 1287 and 1302, and as the father of Dungarasimha, the grandson of Virasimhadeva who founded the city of Dungarpur.
zh: 栋格尔布尔家族的谱系相传，菩乌·钱德是摩诃罗瓦尔维尔辛格·提乌之子、栋格拉辛哈之父；维尔辛格于1287—1302年间在巴罗达在位，而栋格拉辛哈作为其孙建立了栋格尔布尔城。

en: Devapaladeva, also called Deda or Dedu, was a Guhila Maharawal of the Vagad region, ruling from Baroda, the early capital of the Dungarpur line, known in Sanskrit as Vatapadraka. A Sanskrit inscription dated April 1287 from his successor Virasimhadeva names him as the previous maharajakula of Vatapadraka and records a grant of land made for the spiritual welfare of the dead Devapaladeva.
zh: 德奥帕利·提乌（梵语作提婆波罗提婆，又名德达或德杜）是婆迦尔地区的古希拉罗瓦尔，以栋格尔布尔支系的早期都城巴罗达（梵语称瓦塔帕德拉卡）为治所。继任者维尔辛哈·提乌在1287年4月的一篇梵语铭文中称他为瓦塔帕德拉卡的前任罗瓦尔，并记载了为已故的德奥帕利祈求冥福而施舍土地之事。

en: Maharawal Dungar Singh ruled the Rajput principality of Dungarpur in southern Rajasthan in the years after 1302. He was a grandson of Maharawal Vir Singh, and the town of Dungarpur was named after him.
zh: 敦格尔·辛格是1302年之后在位的拉杰普特王公，称马哈劳尔，统治今拉贾斯坦南部的栋格尔布尔。他是马哈劳尔·维尔·辛格之孙，栋格尔布尔城即以他的名字命名。

en: Dungarpur genealogical tradition makes Jay Singh Deo a Guhila Rawal of the Vagad line, the son of Sinhat Deo and the brother of Devapaladeva, whose successor Virasimhadeva is attested by inscriptions from 1287 onward.
zh: 栋格尔布尔家族的谱系将杰伊·辛格·提乌列为婆迦尔古希拉支系的罗瓦尔，辛哈特·提乌之子、德奥帕利·提乌的兄弟；德奥帕利的继任者维尔辛哈·提乌有1287年起的铭文可考。

en: Dungarpur genealogical tradition names Jayat Singh as a Guhila Rawal of the Vagad principality, the son of Samantasimha, who founded the line, and brother of Sinhat Deo.
zh: 栋格尔布尔家族的谱系相传，贾亚特·辛格是婆迦尔古希拉政权的罗瓦尔，为开创该支系的萨曼塔辛哈之子、辛哈特·提乌的兄弟。

en: Kshemasimha was a Guhila Rawal of Mewar who ruled in the mid-twelfth century. He succeeded his father Ranasimha, also called Karna, at a time when the Guhilas were overshadowed by the Chaulukyas of Gujarat; by 1151 the Chaulukya king Kumarapala held Chittor. Kshemasimha was the father of Samantasimha and Kumarasimha.
zh: 克谢马辛哈是12世纪中叶梅瓦尔的古希拉王朝罗瓦尔，继父亲罗那辛哈（又名卡尔纳）之位。当时古希拉人受古吉拉特的乔卢基王朝压制，到1151年，乔卢基国王库马拉波罗已经控制奇托尔。克谢马辛哈是萨曼塔辛哈和库摩罗辛哈的父亲。

en: Samantasimha, also called Samant Singh, was a Guhila ruler of Mewar in the later twelfth century, succeeding his father Kshemasimha. After the death of the Chaulukya king Kumarapala of Gujarat he invaded Gujarat, but was then driven from Mewar by Kirtipala, the Chahamana chief of Nadol. He withdrew to Vagad and founded a new Guhila principality there in 1177, with its seat at Baroda, the nucleus of Dungarpur. He later joined Prithviraja III of Ajmer and may have fallen fighting at the Second Battle of Tarain in 1192, as the historian G. H. Ojha proposed.
zh: 萨曼塔辛哈又称萨曼特·辛格，是12世纪后期梅瓦尔的古希拉首领，继父亲克谢马辛哈之位。古吉拉特的乔卢基国王库马拉波罗死后，他入侵古吉拉特，随后被纳多尔的查哈马纳首领基尔蒂波罗逐出梅瓦尔。他退入婆迦尔，于1177年在当地建立新的古希拉政权，都城设在巴罗达，成为栋格尔布尔的雏形。后来他投奔阿杰梅尔的普利色毗罗阇三世；历史学家G·H·奥贾认为他可能在1192年的第二次塔拉因战役中阵亡。

en: Sinhat Deo, recorded in inscriptions as Sihadadeva, was a Rawal of Vagad in the thirteenth century. An inscription at Jagat bears his name in 1220. Another, dated 1234, records that Vaja, son of Mahilana, rebuilt a temple of the goddess Vindhyavasini at Vinjhalpur while Sihadadeva ruled at Vatapadraka, or Baroda. His son Jayasimghadeva is named in an inscription of 1249.
zh: 辛哈特·提乌是13世纪婆迦尔的罗瓦尔，铭文中称作西哈达提婆。贾加特一篇1220年的铭文记有他的名字。另一篇1234年的铭文记载，他在瓦塔帕德拉卡，即巴罗达统治时，马希拉纳之子瓦贾重建了温贾尔普尔的温地耶瓦西尼女神庙。1249年的铭文提到他的儿子杰亚辛哈提婆。

en: Virasimhadeva was a Guhila Maharawal of Vagad in the Dungarpur line, ruling from its early capital Baroda. Sanskrit inscriptions style him maharajakula of Vatapadraka; the earliest, dated April 1287, records a land grant for his predecessor Devapaladeva, and the last is dated 1302. Later tradition holds that he killed Dungaria, an independent Bhil chieftain, and founded the town named after him, Dungarpur. His grandson Dungarasimha, who gave the state its name, succeeded him as Rawal.
zh: 维尔辛格·提乌（梵语作维拉辛哈提婆）是婆迦尔栋格尔布尔支系的古希拉罗瓦尔，以早期都城巴罗达为治所。梵语铭文称他为瓦塔帕德拉卡的罗瓦尔：最早的一篇刻于1287年4月，记载他为前任德奥帕利·提乌施舍土地，最晚的一篇刻于1302年。后世传说他诛杀了独立的比尔人首领栋格里亚，并建立以其名字命名的栋格尔布尔城。继他为罗瓦尔的是其孙栋格拉辛哈，土邦即得名于栋格拉辛哈。

en: Al-Mughith ibn al-Faiz was a sultan of Dhofar and a kinsman of the ruler of Yemen. The traveller Ibn Battuta recorded that his father al-Faiz had governed Dhofar on the Yemeni ruler’s behalf and sent him a yearly gift. Al-Mughith ruled in his own right and stopped sending it. The ruler of Yemen planned to fight him, but abandoned the attempt after the commander appointed for it was killed by a falling wall. Ibn Battuta described al-Mughith’s palace opposite the great mosque, where musicians played at its gate each afternoon and troops assembled twice a week.
zh: 穆吉斯·本·法伊兹是佐法尔苏丹，也是也门统治者的堂亲。旅行家伊本·白图泰记载，他的父亲法伊兹曾代表也门统治者治理佐法尔，每年向其进献礼物。穆吉斯自行统治后，停止了进献。也门统治者打算征讨他，但所任命的统帅被倒塌的墙压死后，便放弃了计划。伊本·白图泰还描述了穆吉斯位于大清真寺对面的宫殿：每天下午，乐师在宫门前演奏，军队每周两次在门前集结。

en: Al-Wathiq Ibrahim, formally Abu'l-Muzaffar Ibrahim Nur al-Din, was a Rasulid prince of Yemen, a son of Sultan al-Muzaffar Yusuf I. Born in 1261, he studied Islamic jurisprudence, grammar and language. In 1284 his father made him governor of Sanaa, and he was later posted to Fashal. In 1293 the sultan enfeoffed him with Dhofar in southern Arabia, where he settled and ruled the frankincense-producing region until his death in 1311 or 1312. His sons kept Dhofar as a hereditary appanage.
zh: 瓦西格·易卜拉欣，全名阿布·穆扎法尔·易卜拉欣·努尔丁，是也门拉苏勒王朝苏丹穆扎法尔·优素福一世之子。他生于1261年，曾研习伊斯兰教法、语法与语言。1284年，父亲任命他为萨那总督，后来又出镇费沙勒。1293年，苏丹将阿拉伯半岛南部的佐法尔封给他作采邑，他便定居于此，统治这一乳香产地，直至1311至1312年间去世。他的子孙将佐法尔作为世袭领地继续统治。

en: Richard de Bury (1287–1345), born Richard Aungerville near Bury St Edmunds, was an English churchman, royal servant and book collector. He tutored the future Edward III, backed Queen Isabella and Roger Mortimer in 1325, and after Edward's accession rose to be Lord Privy Seal and twice ambassador to the papal court at Avignon, where he met Petrarch in 1330. In 1333 he was made Bishop of Durham against the monks' own choice, and served as Lord Treasurer and Lord Chancellor. His Latin treatise Philobiblon, completed before his death in 1345, celebrates the love and care of books.
zh: 理查德·德·伯里（1287—1345），生于贝里圣埃德蒙兹附近，本名理查德·昂格维尔，是英格兰教士、王室官员与藏书家。他曾任后来的爱德华三世的师傅，1325年资助王后伊莎贝拉与罗杰·莫蒂默，爱德华三世上台后官至掌玺大臣，并两度出使阿维尼翁教廷，1330年在那里结识彼特拉克。1333年，他不顾达勒姆修士的选择被任命为达勒姆主教，又历任财政大臣和大法官。他用拉丁文写成的《书之爱》在1345年去世前夕完成，通篇畅谈对书籍的热爱与护惜。

en: Jansi Deo, also listed as Jonsi, was a Kachhwaha Rajput raja of Amber in the Dhundhar region, ruling from 1317 until his death in 1366, between Raja Kuntal and Raja Udaikaran.
zh: 詹西·德奥（世系表中又作琼西）是敦达尔地区安泊尔的卡奇瓦哈拉其普特罗阇，1317年即位，1366年去世，上承昆塔尔，下传乌代卡兰。

en: Gerhard VI (c. 1298–1343) was Count of Diez, a small county in the Lahn valley known to contemporaries as the Golden County. The son of Count Gottfried III, who was judged unfit to rule, he governed Diez from 1332 during his father's long incapacity. He married Jutta of Nassau-Hadamar, who bore his successor Gerhard VII. Gerhard was killed on 17 October 1343 in a feud against the nearby city of Limburg, and was the penultimate count of the Diez line.
zh: 格哈德六世（约1298—1343）是兰河谷小国迪茨的伯爵，时人将其领地称为“黄金伯国”。其父戈特弗里德三世被认定无力执政，他自1332年起代父统治。他娶拿骚-哈达玛的尤塔为妻，继承人格哈德七世即其所生。1343年10月17日，他在与邻近城市林堡的仇杀交战中身亡，是迪茨家族世系的倒数第二位伯爵。

en: Gerhard VII was the last Count of Diez, succeeding his father Gerhard VI after the latter was killed fighting Limburg in 1343. His family's influence had declined since the fall of the Hohenstaufen dynasty, and in 1302 Weilnau had been separated from Diez for another branch of the family. By Gerhard's time the once Golden County had been heavily pledged to creditors to settle debts. He married Gertrud of Westerburg, and their daughter Jutta became his heiress. When Gerhard died in 1388 without a male heir, the County of Diez passed through Jutta to her husband, Adolf I, Count of Nassau-Siegen, ending Diez rule.
zh: 格哈德七世是迪茨的末代伯爵，1343年其父格哈德六世在与林堡交战中被杀后继位。霍亨斯陶芬王朝覆灭后，他的家族影响力衰落，1302年韦尔瑙从迪茨分出，成为家族另一支系的领地。到格哈德这时，昔日的“黄金伯国”已为偿债大量抵押给债权人。他娶韦斯特堡的格特鲁德为妻，女儿尤塔是继承人。1388年格哈德去世，没有男嗣，迪茨伯国经尤塔传给其夫锡根伯爵阿道夫一世，迪茨家族的统治至此终结。

en: Malik Kebir Imad al-Din Devletshah was a Dilmaçid bey of Erzen in the Siirt region, ruling in the early fourteenth century. He succeeded Malik Salih and was followed by Izz al-Din Muhammad.
zh: 马利克·凯比尔·伊马德丁·德夫莱特沙是锡尔特地区埃尔曾的迪尔马奇贝伊，14世纪初在位。他在马利克·萨利赫之后统治，其后继者为伊兹丁·穆罕默德。

en: Izz al-Din Muhammad was a Dilmaçid bey of Erzen in the Siirt region, one of the beylik's known rulers after 1310. He succeeded Imad al-Din Devletshah and was followed by Malik Jalal al-Din, the fourth bey in the restored sequence.
zh: 伊兹丁·穆罕默德是锡尔特地区埃尔曾的迪尔马奇贝伊，是1310年以后可考的该贝伊国统治者之一。他在伊马德丁·德夫莱特沙之后统治，其后继者为该序列中的第四位贝伊——马利克·贾拉尔丁。

en: Melik Celaleddin was a ruler of the Dilmaçid principality of Erzen, succeeding Izzeddin Muhammad after his death in 1334.
zh: 梅利克·杰拉莱丁是埃尔赞迪尔马奇贝伊国的统治者，1334年伊兹丁·穆罕默德去世后继位。

en: Malik Salih was a Dilmaçid bey who ruled Erzen, a town in the Siirt region, from 1310, after the Mongol invasion. He was followed by Imad al-Din Devletshah.
zh: 马利克·萨利赫是迪尔马奇王朝的贝伊，蒙古入侵后，自1310年起统治锡尔特地区的埃尔曾城。继他之后在位的是伊马德丁·德夫莱特沙。

en: The unnamed father of Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq served Sultan Balban and married a Jat woman of the Punjab. Their son Ghiyath al-Din seized Delhi in 1320 and founded the Tughluq dynasty.
zh: 吉亚斯丁·图格鲁克的父亲效力于苏丹巴勒班，娶旁遮普的贾特女子为妻。他的名字没有流传下来；其子吉亚斯丁于1320年夺取德里，建立图格鲁克王朝。

en: Firuz Shah Tughlaq (1309–1388), born Nasir al-Din Firuz Shah, became sultan of Delhi in 1351 after the death of his cousin Muhammad bin Tughluq. The son of Sipahsalar Rajab and a Punjabi Hindu princess, he had been raised by his uncle Ghiyath al-Din. His long reign brought campaigns in Bengal (1353, 1358), Odisha (1360), Kangra and Thatta, but he is best remembered as a builder: he founded Hisar, Fatehabad, Firozabad and Jaunpur and dug irrigation canals. He abdicated in 1387 and died in 1388 after a rule of thirty-seven years.
zh: 菲鲁兹·沙·图格鲁克（1309—1388），全名纳西尔·丁·菲鲁兹·沙，1351年堂兄穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克死后成为德里苏丹。他是军元帅拉杰卜与旁遮普印度教公主之子，由伯父吉亚斯丁抚养。他长期在位，曾出征孟加拉（1353、1358年）、奥里萨（1360年）、坎格拉和特达，但最以营建闻名：兴建希萨尔、法塔哈巴德、菲罗扎巴德和江布尔，并开凿灌溉渠。他于1387年退位，1388年去世，在位37年。

en: Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq, born Ghazi Malik, was the founder and first sultan of the Tughluq dynasty, ruling Delhi from 1320 until his death. Of humble Qara'unas origin, described by historians as Turk or Mongol, he rose under the Khaljis and helped defeat the Mongols at Amroha in 1305. After the Khalji collapse he took Delhi in 1320 and built the fortress city of Tughlaqabad. In 1323 his son Muhammad bin Tughluq overthrew the Kakatiyas of Warangal, and the 1324 Bengal campaign made West Bengal tributary and annexed the east. In February 1325 a reception pavilion collapsed on him at Kara; Ibn Battuta suspected murder.
zh: 吉亚斯丁·图格鲁克原名加齐·马利克，是图格鲁克王朝的开创者与第一代苏丹，1320年起统治德里直至去世。他出身卑微的喀喇乌那斯部族，史家称他为突厥人或蒙古人；他在卡尔吉王朝下发迹，1305年参与在阿姆罗哈击败蒙古人。卡尔吉王朝崩溃后，他于1320年夺取德里，兴建城堡城市图格鲁克巴德。1323年，其子穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克攻灭瓦朗加尔的卡卡蒂亚王朝；1324年的孟加拉之役使西孟加拉称臣、东孟加拉被吞并。1325年2月，他在卡拉因迎宾亭坍塌而死，伊本·白图泰怀疑他是被谋害的。

en: Razia Sultana (c. 1205–1240) was the only woman ever to rule the Delhi Sultanate, a daughter of the Mamluk sultan Iltutmish. She administered Delhi during her father's 1231 Gwalior campaign, and in 1236, after the brief reign of her half-brother Ruknuddin Firuz, she seized the throne with popular support in the city. Her promotion of non-Turkic officers alienated the Turkic nobility, who deposed her in April 1240. She married the rebel governor Ikhtiyaruddin Altunia and marched on Delhi, but was defeated by her half-brother Bahram and killed in October 1240.
zh: 拉齐娅苏丹（约1205—1240）是德里苏丹国唯一的女性统治者，奴隶王朝苏丹伊勒杜迷失之女。1231年父亲远征瓜廖尔期间，她受命主持德里政务；1236年异母兄弟鲁克丁·菲鲁兹短暂在位后，她依靠德里民众的支持登位。她提拔非突厥裔军官，招致突厥贵族不满，于1240年4月被废。她嫁给起兵的总督伊赫蒂亚尔丁·阿尔图尼亚并进军德里，却被异母兄弟巴赫拉姆击败，于1240年10月被杀。

en: Fakhr-ud-Din Muhammad Shah, known as Muhammad bin Tughluq (1290–1351), was Sultan of Delhi from 1325, eldest son of Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq, who founded the Tughlaq dynasty. Sent to the Deccan in 1321, he took the Kakatiya capital Warangal in 1323 and ended that dynasty. As sultan he moved the capital from Delhi to Daulatabad in 1327, and in 1330 he issued brass and copper tokens valued as silver; both schemes failed disastrously. He read Persian, Arabic and Sanskrit and took an interest in medicine, the Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta wrote of his years at the court, and later historians nicknamed him the Wisest Fool. Under him the sultanate began to fall apart: Rana Hammir Singh won back Rajputana at Singoli in 1336, Harihara and Bukka founded Vijayanagara in the south, and his general Hasan Gangu founded the Bahmani Sultanate in the Deccan. He died in 1351 on campaign in Sindh, on the road to Thatta.
zh: 法赫尔丁·穆罕默德沙，通称穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克（1290—1351），1325年起为德里苏丹，是图格鲁克王朝创建者吉亚斯丁·图格鲁克的长子。1321年他被派往德干，1323年攻陷卡卡提亚王朝都城瓦朗加尔，灭亡该王朝。即位后，他于1327年把首都从德里迁往德干的道拉塔巴德，1330年又发行与银币等值的黄铜和铜质代用币；两项举措都惨败收场。他通晓波斯语、阿拉伯语和梵语，对医学有兴趣；摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰记述了自己在他宫廷中的岁月，后世史家称他为“最聪明的蠢人”。在他治下，苏丹国开始崩解：1336年，拉那哈米尔·辛格在辛古利一役后收复拉杰普塔纳；哈里哈拉与布卡在南方建立毗奢耶那伽罗；他的将领哈桑·甘古在德干建立巴赫曼尼苏丹国。1351年，他在信德征战途中去世，当时正赶往特达。

en: Bibi Naila was a Bhatti Rajput lady of Dipalpur in Punjab, said to be a daughter of the Rai Rana Mall Bhatti. Pressured by Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq, she married his brother Sipahsalar Rajab and in 1309 bore Firuz Shah Tughlaq, future sultan of Delhi.
zh: 比比·娜伊拉是旁遮普迪巴尔布尔的巴蒂拉其普特女子，相传为当地罗阇拉纳·马尔·巴蒂之女。受吉亚斯丁·图格鲁克施压，她嫁给其弟拉杰卜，1309年生下后来的德里苏丹菲鲁兹·沙·图格鲁克。

en: Qutb ud-Din Aibak (c. 1150–1210) was a Turkic mamluk general of the Ghurid ruler Muhammad of Ghor. Sold into slavery in childhood, he rose to command the Ghurid armies in India after the Second Battle of Tarain in 1192, capturing Delhi and campaigning through the Ganges valley. After Muhammad of Ghor was assassinated in 1206, Aibak set up his own rule at Lahore, founding the Delhi Sultanate. He began the Qutb Minar and died at Lahore in November 1210, killed in a polo accident.
zh: 库特布丁·艾伊拜克（约1150—1210）是古尔王朝的突厥裔马穆鲁克将领，效命于古尔的穆罕默德。他幼年被卖为奴，1192年第二次塔拉因战役后统领古尔王朝驻印度的军队，攻占德里并征战恒河流域。1206年古尔的穆罕默德遇刺后，艾伊拜克在拉合尔自立，建立德里苏丹国。他主持开工顾特卜塔，1210年11月在拉合尔打马球时发生意外，坠马身亡。

en: Rajab, titled Sipahsalar, was a younger brother of Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq, founder of the Tughlaq dynasty. He married Bibi Naila of Dipalpur, and their son Firuz Shah was born in 1309. Rajab died when Firuz was seven, and the boy was raised by his uncle.
zh: 受称“军元帅”的拉杰卜是德里图格鲁克王朝建立者吉亚斯丁·图格鲁克的弟弟。他娶迪巴尔布尔的比比·娜伊拉，1309年生子菲鲁兹·沙。拉杰卜在菲鲁兹七岁时去世，孩子由伯父抚养。

en: Boris Davydovich was a Rurikid prince, a son of Davyd Konstantinovich of Galich and Dmitrov and a grandnephew of Alexander Nevsky. In 1280, after his uncle Vasily Konstantinovich died, the family principality was divided: his elder brother Fyodor took Galich, while Boris received Dmitrov as his appanage. He ruled Dmitrov for more than half a century and died in the Golden Horde in 1334, after which his son Dmitry probably succeeded him.
zh: 鲍里斯·达维多维奇是留里克家族王公，加利奇-德米特罗夫王公达维德·康斯坦丁诺维奇之子、亚历山大·涅夫斯基的侄孙。1280年叔父瓦西里·康斯坦丁诺维奇去世后，家族公国被瓜分：兄长费奥多尔分得加利奇，鲍里斯分得德米特罗夫为封邑。他统治德米特罗夫半个多世纪，1334年死于金帐汗国，此后可能由其子德米特里继位。

en: Dmitry Borisovich was the second prince of Dmitrov, succeeding his father Boris, the first known prince of the town, after 1334. Around 1360 Moscow absorbed Dmitrov, but the Golden Horde secured him the throne of Galich. In 1363 he supported Dmitry Konstantinovich of Suzdal against Dmitry Ivanovich of Moscow in their struggle for the grand principality of Vladimir. That same year the prince of Galich was expelled from his inheritance, and Moscow annexed the town and its surrounding lands.
zh: 德米特里·鲍里索维奇是德米特罗夫的第二任王公，1334年后继承其父、当地已知的首任王公鲍里斯。约1360年莫斯科吞并德米特罗夫，金帐汗国却助他取得加利奇公位。1363年，苏兹达尔的德米特里·康斯坦丁诺维奇与莫斯科的德米特里·伊万诺维奇争夺弗拉基米尔大公位时，他支持前者。同年，这位加利奇王公被逐出其世袭领地，莫斯科吞并了加利奇及周边土地。

en: John FitzThomas, 1st Baron Desmond (died 1261), was a Norman-Irish magnate and head of the Desmond line of the FitzGerald dynasty, the son of Thomas FitzMaurice, Lord OConnello. In 1259 he received a royal grant of Desmond and west Waterford, provoking Fineen MacCarthy, King of Desmond, who gathered the MacCarthys, O'Sullivans and O'Donoghues against him. At the Battle of Callann in July 1261 the Gaelic army routed the Normans, and John was killed together with his son Maurice FitzJohn. His infant grandson Thomas inherited the barony.
zh: 第一代德斯蒙德男爵约翰·菲茨托马斯（？—1261）是诺曼裔爱尔兰显贵、菲茨杰拉德家族德斯蒙德支系的首领，奥康内洛勋爵托马斯·菲茨莫里斯之子。1259年他获王室封赏德斯蒙德与西沃特福德，激起德斯蒙德国王芬恩·麦卡锡联合麦卡锡、奥沙利文和奥多诺霍诸族起兵对抗。1261年7月的卡兰之战中，盖尔军队击溃诺曼人，约翰与儿子莫里斯·菲茨约翰双双战死，爵位由年幼的孙子托马斯继承。

en: Maurice FitzThomas FitzGerald, called Maurice the Great (1293–1356), was an Anglo-Irish magnate who succeeded as Baron Desmond in 1307 and was created 1st Earl of Desmond in 1329. In 1331 the Crown imprisoned him for over eighteen months amid rumours that he meant to make himself king of Ireland. In 1345 he led an open rebellion of Anglo-Irish lords and attacked Nenagh, until he surrendered and forfeited his lands. Pardoned in 1349, he was made Lord Justice of Ireland for life in July 1355 and died in Dublin Castle the following January.
zh: 莫里斯·菲茨托马斯·菲茨杰拉德，人称“大莫里斯”（1293—1356），是盎格鲁—爱尔兰大贵族，1307年袭任德斯蒙德男爵，1329年被封为第一代德斯蒙德伯爵。1331年，因有传言称他意图自立为爱尔兰国王，英格兰王室将他囚禁一年半以上。1345年，他公开率领盎格鲁—爱尔兰贵族叛乱，攻打尼纳，最终投降并被没收领地。1349年他获赦免，1355年7月被任命为终身爱尔兰总督，次年1月卒于都柏林城堡。

en: Maurice FitzJohn FitzGerald (c. 1240–1261), son of John FitzThomas, 1st Baron Desmond, married Matilda de Barry and was killed with his father at the Battle of Callann in July 1261. His infant son Thomas later succeeded as 2nd Baron Desmond.
zh: 莫里斯·菲茨约翰·菲茨杰拉德（约1240—1261）是第一代德斯蒙德男爵约翰·菲茨托马斯之子，娶玛蒂尔达·德·巴里为妻，1261年7月在卡兰之战中与父亲一同战死。他尚在襁褓中的儿子托马斯后来继位为第二代德斯蒙德男爵。

en: Maurice FitzMaurice FitzGerald, called Maurice Óg or young Maurice (died 1358), was the only son of Maurice FitzGerald, 1st Earl of Desmond, by his first wife Catherine de Burgh, daughter of the Earl of Ulster. He succeeded his father as 2nd Earl of Desmond in January 1356. He married Beatrice de Stafford, daughter of Ralph de Stafford, 1st Earl of Stafford, but left no male heirs. He died at Castle Maine in 1358 and was buried at Tralee Abbey, the earldom passing to his half-brother Gerald, called the Poet.
zh: 莫里斯·菲茨莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德，又称小莫里斯（？—1358），是第一代德斯蒙德伯爵莫里斯与首任妻子、阿尔斯特伯爵之女凯瑟琳·德·伯格的独子。1356年1月，他承袭父位成为第二代德斯蒙德伯爵。他娶第一代斯塔福德伯爵拉尔夫·德·斯塔福德之女比阿特丽斯·德·斯塔福德为妻，但没有留下男性后嗣。1358年，他卒于梅恩城堡，葬于特拉利修道院，伯爵爵位由异母弟、人称“诗人”的杰拉尔德继承。

en: Thomas FitzMaurice FitzGerald, 2nd Baron Desmond (c. 1261–1298), inherited the title in infancy after his father Maurice FitzJohn and grandfather John FitzThomas were killed at the Battle of Callann in 1261; only after a long minority did he enter his lands in 1282. Family legend nicknamed him Thomas an-Apa, the ape, after an ape carried the baby along the battlements of Traly monastery and brought him safely back. In 1294 he served as deputy justiciar of Ireland, and he was summoned to Parliament in 1295. He died in 1298 and was buried at North Abbey in Youghal.
zh: 第二代德斯蒙德男爵托马斯·菲茨莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德（约1261—1298）尚在襁褓中便继承爵位——1261年他的父亲莫里斯·菲茨约翰与祖父约翰·菲茨托马斯同死于卡兰之战；经过漫长的幼年期，他迟至1282年才正式领受封地。据德斯蒙德谱系记载，一只猿猴曾把婴儿时的他抱上特拉利修道院的雉堞间游荡又平安送回，他因此得到“猿猴托马斯”的绰号。1294年他出任爱尔兰副司法官，1295年获召出席议会，1298年去世，葬于约尔的北修道院。

en: Domenico Ghirlandaio (1448–1494), born Domenico Bigordi in Florence, was a leading painter of the Florentine Renaissance. His early fame came from the Santa Fina chapel frescoes at San Gimignano (1477–1478), depicting miracles associated with the saint's death. In 1481 Pope Sixtus IV summoned him to Rome, where he painted the Vocation of the Apostles in the new Sistine Chapel. Back in Florence he completed the Sassetti Chapel cycle in Santa Trinita (1482–1485) and, from 1485 to 1490, the Tornabuoni Chapel in Santa Maria Novella, crowded with portraits of Medici Florence. His large workshop included his brothers Davide and Benedetto and trained Michelangelo. He died of pestilential fever in January 1494.
zh: 多梅尼科·吉兰达约（1448—1494）出生于佛罗伦萨，原名多梅尼科·比戈尔迪，是佛罗伦萨文艺复兴的重要画家。他早年因1477至1478年在圣吉米尼亚诺绘制圣菲纳礼拜堂湿壁画成名，画中描绘了与圣女之死有关的奇迹。1481年，教宗西斯都四世召他前往罗马，在新建的西斯廷礼拜堂绘制《使徒蒙召》。回到佛罗伦萨后，他于1482至1485年完成圣三一教堂萨塞蒂礼拜堂的壁画组画，又在1485至1490年完成新圣母教堂托尔纳布奥尼礼拜堂的壁画，其中画满了美第奇时代佛罗伦萨名流的肖像。他的庞大作坊包括兄弟达维德和贝内代托，并培养出了米开朗琪罗。1494年1月，他死于瘟疫般的热病。

en: Jutta of Oldenburg-Delmenhorst was the wife of Rudolf III, Lord of Diepholz, and mother of his successor Conrad VI. Genealogies make her a daughter of Count Otto II of Oldenburg-Delmenhorst; she is last documented alive in 1331.
zh: 奥尔登堡-德尔门霍斯特的尤塔是迪普霍尔茨领主鲁道夫三世之妻、继位者康拉德六世之母。据谱系记载，她是奥尔登堡-德尔门霍斯特伯爵奥托二世之女，1331年仍见于记载。

en: Conrad V, numbered Conrad I in some genealogies, was Lord of Diepholz, the son of Lord John I of Diepholz and Hedwig of Roden and a grandson of Kuno III. He married Hedwig of Rietberg, daughter of Count Conrad I of Rietberg. On 15 September 1298 their daughter Hedwig married Count John II of Oldenburg. Their son Rudolf III, born around 1300, succeeded as Lord of Diepholz and was still alive after 1350. Conrad died after 1302.
