zh: 康拉德五世（部分谱系称康拉德一世）是迪普霍尔茨领主，迪普霍尔茨领主约翰一世与黑德维希·冯·罗登之子、库诺三世之孙。他娶里特贝格伯爵康拉德一世之女黑德维希·冯·里特贝格为妻。1298年9月15日，他们的女儿黑德维希嫁给奥尔登堡伯爵约翰二世；儿子鲁道夫三世约1300年出生，后来继任迪普霍尔茨领主，1350年后仍在世。康拉德卒于1302年之后。

en: Konrad of Diepholz (died before 14 February 1379) was Edler Herr of Diepholz from 1350, succeeding his father Rudolf. In May 1342 he married Armgard, daughter of Count Heinrich IV of Waldeck, as his second wife. His son Johann III succeeded him in 1378.
zh: 迪普霍尔茨的康拉德（1379年2月14日前去世）自1350年起在父亲鲁道夫之后任迪普霍尔茨自由领主。1342年5月，他娶瓦尔德克伯爵海因里希四世之女阿姆加德·冯·瓦尔德克，这是他的第二次婚姻。1378年，其子约翰三世继任领主。

en: Rudolf of Diepholz was Edler Herr of Diepholz from 1300, succeeding his father Konrad. He married Jutta of Oldenburg. His daughter Hedwig married Count Heinrich III of Sternberg before February 1330, and his son Konrad succeeded him in 1350.
zh: 迪普霍尔茨的鲁道夫自1300年起在父亲康拉德之后任迪普霍尔茨自由领主。他娶奥尔登堡的尤塔为妻；女儿黑德维希于1330年2月前嫁给施特恩贝格伯爵海因里希三世，其子康拉德于1350年继任领主。

en: John I of Dreux (1215–1249) was the son of Count Robert III and Aénor of Saint-Valery. Knighted by Louis IX, he followed the king against the English in Poitou, fighting at Taillebourg in 1242, and then accompanied him on the Seventh Crusade in 1249. The expedition stopped in Cyprus on its way to Egypt, and John died there at Nicosia before reaching the fighting. In 1240 he had married Marie of Bourbon, daughter of Archambaud VIII, seigneur of Bourbon; their son Robert IV succeeded him.
zh: 约翰一世（1215—1249）是德勒伯爵罗贝尔三世与圣瓦勒里的艾诺尔之子。他由路易九世册封为骑士，随这位国王在普瓦图与英格兰人作战，1242年参加塔耶堡战役，1249年又随其参加第七次十字军东征。远征军在前往埃及时停靠塞浦路斯，约翰未及参战便在尼科西亚去世。1240年，他娶波旁领主阿尔尚博八世之女波旁的玛丽为妻，其子罗贝尔四世继位。

en: John II of Dreux, called the Good (1265–1309), succeeded his father Robert IV as Count of Dreux in 1282. Under King Philip IV the Fair he served through the long Flemish wars: he was at the taking of Furnes, Cassel, Bergues and Lille in 1297, survived the disastrous battle of Courtrai in 1302, and fought at Mons-en-Pévèle and the renewed siege of Lille in 1304, after which he helped negotiate the peace with Flanders. In 1292 he married Jeanne of Beaujeu, lady of Montpensier, who bore him three successive counts, Robert V, John III and Peter I.
zh: 约翰二世（1265—1309），绰号“好人”，1282年继父罗贝尔四世为德勒伯爵。在国王腓力四世（美男子）治下，他参加了旷日持久的佛兰德战争：1297年参与攻取弗尔讷、卡塞尔、贝尔格和里尔，1302年亲历惨败的科特赖克战役，1304年又战于蒙斯昂佩韦勒并再围里尔，战后参与对佛兰德的和谈。1292年他娶蒙庞西耶女领主博热的让娜，让娜所生的罗贝尔五世、约翰三世和皮埃尔一世先后继任伯爵。

en: John III (c. 1295–1331) was Count of Dreux and Braine, the second son of Count John II of Dreux and Jeanne of Beaujeu, lady of Montpensier. He succeeded his elder brother Robert V in 1329. Around that time he married Ida, daughter of Guy II, lord of Rosny, and his wife Laura of Ponthieu. The marriage was childless, and when John died in 1331 the county of Dreux passed to his younger brother Peter.
zh: 约翰三世（约1295—1331）为德勒与布赖讷伯爵，是德勒伯爵约翰二世与蒙庞西耶女领主博热的让娜的次子。他于1329年继承兄长罗贝尔五世之位，约在此时娶罗斯尼领主居伊二世与妻子蓬蒂厄的洛尔之女伊达为妻。二人没有子女，约翰于1331年去世后，德勒伯国由其弟皮埃尔继承。

en: Marie de Bourbon-Dampierre (1220–1274) was the daughter of Archambaud VIII of Bourbon, called the Great, and Beatrice of Montluçon. In 1240 she married John I, Count of Dreux and Braine, whose Capetian line descended from Robert I, son of King Louis VI of France. Her husband died in 1249, leaving three children: Robert IV, who succeeded as count of Dreux, Yolande, countess of Braine, who married first the lord of Craon and then the count of Dammartin, and John, who became a Templar. Marie died in 1274 and was buried by her husband's heart in the abbey church of Saint-Yved at Braine.
zh: 玛丽·德·波旁-当皮埃尔（1220—1274）是号称“伟大者”的阿尔尚博八世·德·波旁与贝阿特丽丝·德·蒙吕松之女。1240年，她嫁给德勒与布拉讷伯爵让一世；德勒伯爵一支是卡佩王室旁支，出自法王路易六世之子罗贝尔一世。1249年丈夫去世，留下三个子女：继位为德勒伯爵的罗贝尔四世、布拉讷女伯爵约兰德（先嫁克朗领主，后嫁达马尔坦伯爵），以及成为圣殿骑士的让。玛丽于1274年去世，葬于布拉讷的圣伊韦德修道院教堂，紧邻丈夫的心脏安葬处。

en: Péronelle de Sully (1285–1338), daughter of Henri III de Sully and Marguerite de Bommiers, was the sister of royal treasurer Henri IV. In 1308 she married John II, Count of Dreux, as his second wife; their daughter Joan II inherited the county in 1345.
zh: 佩罗内勒·德·叙利（1285—1338）是亨利三世·德·叙利与玛格丽特·德·博米耶之女、王室财政官亨利四世的姐妹。1308年她作为续弦嫁给德勒伯爵约翰二世；其女让娜二世于1345年继承德勒伯国。

en: Peter I of Dreux (1298–1345) was the youngest son of Count John II and Jeanne of Beaujeu, lady of Montpensier, and inherited her lordship. In 1328 he fought for Philip VI of Valois against the Flemish rebels at Cassel. The county of Dreux came to him only in 1331, after his elder brothers Robert V and John III had both died without heirs. In 1341 he married Isabeau of Melun, lady of Houdain. He died on 3 November 1345, and the infant daughter Joan he left behind died the next year, so the county passed to his sister Joan II.
zh: 皮埃尔一世（1298—1345）是德勒伯爵约翰二世与蒙庞西耶女领主博热的让娜的幼子，继承了母亲的蒙庞西耶领地。1328年，他在卡塞尔战役中为瓦卢瓦的腓力六世讨伐佛兰德叛军。直到两位兄长罗贝尔五世和约翰三世先后无嗣而终，德勒伯国才在1331年落到他手中。1341年，他娶乌丹女领主默伦的伊莎博。1345年11月3日去世，留下的幼女让娜次年夭折，伯国随后转归其妹让娜二世。

en: Robert I of Dreux, called the Great (c. 1123–1188), was the fifth son of King Louis VI of France and Adelaide of Savoy. In 1137 his brother Louis VII granted him the county of Dreux as an appanage. He joined the Second Crusade in 1147, fighting at the failed siege of Damascus, then returned early and plotted against Louis VII, a conspiracy checked by Abbot Suger. In 1152 his marriage to Agnes of Baudement brought him Braine and other lordships. He fought the English during their civil war and joined the siege of Sées in Normandy in 1154. He chartered Dreux in 1180, founded Brie-Comte-Robert, and ceded his county to his son in 1184.
zh: 罗贝尔一世（约1123—1188），绰号“伟大的”，是法兰西国王路易六世与萨伏依的阿德莱德的第五子。1137年，其兄路易七世将德勒伯国作为封禄赐给他。1147年他参加第二次十字军东征，在失利的大马士革之围中作战，随后提前回国图谋推翻路易七世，被修道院长叙热挫败。1152年，他与博德曼的阿涅丝成婚，获得布赖讷等多处领地。他在英格兰内战期间与英格兰人作战，并于1154年参与围攻诺曼底的塞埃。1180年他授予德勒城市特许状，兴建布里孔特罗贝尔，并于1184年把伯国交给儿子。

en: Robert II of Dreux, called the Young (c. 1154–1218), succeeded his father Robert I as Count of Dreux in 1184. He took the cross with Philip Augustus in 1190 and fought at the siege of Acre and the battle of Arsuf on the Third Crusade. Back in France he campaigned against the English in 1195–1198 and in Normandy in 1202. In 1206 he had the castle of Fère-en-Tardenois built, then joined the Albigensian Crusade in 1209, serving at the siege of Termes. He commanded the left wing of the army at the victory of Bouvines in 1214. By his wife Yolande of Coucy he left sons Robert III and Peter Mauclerc, later Duke of Brittany.
zh: 罗贝尔二世（约1154—1218），绰号“年轻者”，1184年继父罗贝尔一世成为德勒伯爵。1190年他随腓力·奥古斯都参加第三次十字军东征，参与阿卡围城战和阿尔苏夫战役。回国后他于1195—1198年与英格兰人作战，1202年又在诺曼底交战。1206年他下令修建费尔昂塔尔德努瓦城堡，1209年又加入阿尔比十字军，参与围攻泰尔姆。1214年布汶大捷中，他指挥王室军队的左翼。他与妻子库西的约兰德生有罗贝尔三世和后来成为布列塔尼公爵的皮埃尔·莫克莱尔。

en: Robert III of Dreux, called Gasteblé or Wheat-Spoiler (1185–1234), was Count of Dreux and Braine and the eldest son of Robert II and Yolande of Coucy. His nickname came from a youthful hunt when he destroyed a field of wheat. In 1212 he fought under Prince Louis against the English, defending Nantes until he was captured during a sortie; after Bouvines he was exchanged for the Earl of Salisbury. He joined the Albigensian Crusade at the siege of Avignon in 1226, then supported Blanche of Castile's regency, and built the castle of Dannemarche at Dreux in 1229. He was buried in the family necropolis at Braine in 1234.
zh: 罗贝尔三世（1185—1234），绰号“毁麦者”，是德勒和布赖讷伯爵，也是罗贝尔二世与库西的约兰德的长子。他的绰号来自年轻时一次狩猎：他毁坏了一片麦田。1212年，他在路易王子麾下与英格兰人作战，守卫南特时出城作战被俘；布汶战役后，他以索尔兹伯里伯爵为交换获释。1226年他参加阿尔比十字军，围攻阿维尼翁，后来支持卡斯蒂利亚的布朗什摄政，并于1229年在德勒修建达讷马什城堡。1234年，他被安葬在布赖讷的家族墓地。

en: Robert IV of Dreux (1241–1282) was the son of John I and Marie of Bourbon and held the counties of Dreux and Braine and, through his wife, Montfort-l'Amaury. In 1260 he married Beatrice, heiress of Count John I of Montfort, joining the Montfort inheritance to his own lands. He campaigned with King Philip III the Bold in Languedoc in 1272 and was present at the capture of Foix. His daughter Yolande married King Alexander III of Scotland, and his son John II succeeded him as count when Robert died in 1282.
zh: 罗贝尔四世（1241—1282）是约翰一世与波旁的玛丽之子，领有德勒、布赖讷伯国，并因妻子而领有蒙福尔拉莫里。1260年，他娶蒙福尔伯爵约翰一世的女继承人比阿特丽丝，把蒙福尔的遗产并入自己的领地。1272年，他随国王腓力三世（勇敢者）出征朗格多克，参加攻取富瓦之役。其女约兰德嫁给苏格兰国王亚历山大三世；1282年罗贝尔去世后，其子约翰二世继位为伯爵。

en: Robert V (1293–1329) was Count of Dreux and Braine, the eldest son of Count John II of Dreux and Jeanne of Beaujeu, lady of Montpensier. He succeeded his father in 1309 and supported King Philip V of France, husband of Joan II of Burgundy. In April 1321 he married Marie, daughter of Walter II, lord of Enghien. Robert died at Braine without children, and his brother John III succeeded him as count.
zh: 罗贝尔五世（1293—1329）为德勒与布赖讷伯爵，是德勒伯爵约翰二世与蒙庞西耶女领主博热的让娜之长子。他于1309年继承父位，曾支持法兰西国王腓力五世，即勃艮第的让娜二世之夫。1321年4月，他娶昂吉安领主瓦尔特二世之女玛丽为妻。罗贝尔在布赖讷去世，身后无嗣，其弟约翰三世继位为德勒伯爵。

en: Simon de Dreux was a son of John II, Count of Dreux, and Jeanne de Beaujeu, Lady of Montpensier. The genealogies of the Capetian House of Dreux record him only as a priest, while his brothers succeeded in turn as counts of Dreux.
zh: 西蒙·德·德勒是德勒伯爵让二世与蒙庞西耶女领主博热的让娜之子。卡佩家族德勒支系的谱系只记载他成为神父，他的兄弟则先后袭任德勒伯爵。

en: Arisimha, also called Ari Singh, was the eldest son of Rana Laksha of Sisoda in Mewar and married Urmila, a Chauhan lady of Unnava near Kelwara; their only child was Hammir Singh, who in 1326 became the first Sisodia Maharana of Mewar.
zh: 阿里辛哈又称阿里·辛格，是梅瓦尔西索达拉纳·拉克沙的长子，娶凯尔瓦拉附近温纳瓦村的乔汉女子乌尔米拉为妻；二人独子即哈米尔·辛格，他于1326年成为梅瓦尔第一位西索迪亚系拉纳。

en: Bhimasimha was a Rana of the Sisoda branch of the Guhilas of Mewar, named in the Eklingji inscription genealogy between his father Bhuvanasimha and his son Jayasimha, in the line that led to Hammir Singh.
zh: 比马辛哈是梅瓦尔古希罗王朝西索达拉纳支系的首领，埃克林吉铭文谱系将他列在父亲布瓦纳辛哈与儿子贾亚辛哈之间，是哈米尔·辛格一系的先祖。

en: Bhuvanasimha was a Rana of the junior Guhila branch holding the village of Sisoda in Mewar, named in the genealogy preserved by the later 1652 Eklingji inscription. Rana Kumbhakarna's 1439 Ranpur inscription, also made long after Bhuvanasimha's lifetime, hails him as the conqueror of Sultan Alauddin Khalji: around 1299, when the Delhi army crossed Mewar on its march against Gujarat, a column raiding Guhila lands met fierce resistance, which Bhuvanasimha may have led as a feudatory of the Rawal Samarasimha. He was an ancestor of Maharana Hammir Singh.
zh: 布瓦纳辛哈是梅瓦尔古希罗王朝拉纳支系的首领，领有西索达村，后世1652年埃克林吉铭文保存的谱系中列有他的名字。拉纳·昆巴卡尔纳1439年的兰布尔铭文同样刻于布瓦纳辛哈身后很久，称他为“战胜苏丹阿拉乌德丁·卡尔吉之人”：约1299年德里军队取道梅瓦尔进军古吉拉特时，一支深入古希罗领地劫掠的分队遭到顽强抵抗，布瓦纳辛哈可能以拉瓦尔·萨马拉辛哈封臣的身份指挥了这次作战。他是拉纳·哈米尔·辛格的先祖。

en: Dinakara was a chief of the junior Rana branch of the Guhilas of Mewar, named between Narapati and Jasakarna in an ancestry of Hammir Singh and, centuries later, in the 1652 Eklingji inscription among Rahapa's successors.
zh: 迪纳卡拉是梅瓦尔古希拉王朝幼支拉纳支系的首领，汉米尔·辛格的祖先名录将他列在纳拉帕蒂与贾萨卡纳之间；数百年后的1652年，埃克林吉铭文也将他列于二人之间，作为拉哈帕的继承者之一。

en: Jasakarna was a chief of the junior Rana branch of the Guhilas of Mewar, named between Dinakara and Nagapala in an ancestry of Hammir Singh and, centuries later, in the 1652 Eklingji inscription among Rahapa's successors.
zh: 贾萨卡纳是梅瓦尔古希拉王朝幼支拉纳支系的首领，汉米尔·辛格的祖先名录将他列在迪纳卡拉与纳加帕拉之间；数百年后的1652年，埃克林吉铭文也将他列于二人之间，作为拉哈帕的继承者之一。

en: Jayasimha was a Rana of the Sisoda branch of the Guhilas of Mewar, named in the Eklingji inscription genealogy as the son of Bhimasimha and father of Lakhanasimha, an ancestor of Hammir Singh.
zh: 贾亚辛哈是梅瓦尔古希罗王朝西索达拉纳支系的首领，埃克林吉铭文谱系载他为比马辛哈之子、拉卡纳辛哈之父，是哈米尔·辛格的先祖。

en: Karnapala was a chief of the junior Rana branch of the Guhilas of Mewar, named between Nagapala and Prithvipal in Hammir Singh's ancestry; the 1652 Eklingji inscription, made centuries later, lists Bhuvanasimha directly after him among Rahapa's successors.
zh: 卡尔纳帕拉是梅瓦尔古希拉王朝幼支拉纳支系的首领，汉米尔·辛格的祖先名录将他列在纳加帕拉与普里特维帕尔之间；数百年后的1652年，埃克林吉铭文在拉哈帕继承者中将布瓦纳辛哈紧列于他之后。

en: Lakhanasimha, also called Rana Laksha or Lakshman Singh, was Thakur of the village of Sisoda near Nathdwara in Mewar and a chief of the Guhila Rana branch, the son of Jayasimha in the Eklingji genealogy. When Alauddin Khalji besieged Chittorgarh in 1303, he led his sons into the garrison; the 1460 Kumbhalgarh inscription records that after the Rawal Ratnasimha abandoned the field, Lakshmasimha died fighting to defend the fort. He and seven sons perished in the final saka while their women perished in jauhar. Through his son Arisimha he was grandfather of Hammir Singh.
zh: 拉卡纳辛哈又称拉纳·拉克沙或拉克什曼·辛格，是梅瓦尔纳特德瓦拉附近西索达村的塔库尔，也是古希罗拉纳支系的首领，埃克林吉铭文谱系载他为贾亚辛哈之子。1303年阿拉乌德丁·卡尔吉围攻奇托尔堡时，他率诸子加入守军；1460年昆巴加尔铭文记载，拉瓦尔·拉特纳辛哈离开战场后，拉卡纳辛哈战死守城。他与七个儿子在最后的萨卡殉死中阵亡，家中女眷则行乔哈尔自焚。其子阿里辛哈是哈米尔·辛格之父。

en: Nagapala was a chief of the junior Rana branch of the Guhilas of Mewar, named between Jasakarna and Karnapala in Hammir Singh's ancestry and, centuries later, in the 1652 Eklingji inscription among Rahapa's successors.
zh: 纳加帕拉是梅瓦尔古希拉王朝幼支拉纳支系的首领，汉米尔·辛格的祖先名录将他列在贾萨卡纳与卡尔纳帕拉之间；数百年后的1652年，埃克林吉铭文也将他列于二人之间，作为拉哈帕的继承者之一。

en: Narapati was a chief of the junior Rana branch of the Guhilas of Mewar, named between Rahapa and Dinakara in an ancestry of Hammir Singh; centuries later, the 1652 Eklingji inscription also listed him among Rahapa's successors.
zh: 纳拉帕蒂是梅瓦尔古希拉王朝幼支拉纳支系的首领，在汉米尔·辛格的祖先名录中位于拉哈帕与迪纳卡拉之间；数百年后的1652年，埃克林吉铭文也将他列为拉哈帕的继承者之一。

en: Prithvipal was a chief of the junior Rana branch of the Guhilas of Mewar, named between Karnapala and Bhuvanasimha among Rahapa's successors in the ancestry of Hammir Singh, founder of the Sisodia dynasty.
zh: 普里特维帕尔是梅瓦尔古希拉王朝幼支拉纳支系的首领，在西索迪亚王朝开创者汉米尔·辛格的祖先名录中，他位于拉哈帕继承者卡尔纳帕拉与布瓦纳辛哈之间。

en: Rahapa was the second son of Ranasimha, the Guhila rawal of Mewar, and founder of the dynasty's junior Rana branch. Around 1168, when the Guhila lands were divided between Ranasimha's sons, he established his base at the village of Sisoda near Nathdwara, after which his descendants were called Sisodias. The 1652 Eklingji inscription names his son Narapati as his successor. Through this line Rahapa was the ancestor of Hammir Singh, who re-established the dynasty's rule over Mewar in 1326.
zh: 拉哈帕是梅瓦尔古希拉拉瓦拉拉纳西姆哈的次子，也是古希拉拉纳幼支的开创者。约1168年古希拉领地在拉纳西姆哈诸子间分立时，他在纳特德瓦拉附近的锡索达村建立据点，后人遂以西索迪亚为姓。据1652年的埃克林吉铭文记载，继他而立的是其子纳拉帕蒂。1326年重建梅瓦尔统治的哈米尔·辛格，就是拉哈帕这一支的后裔。

en: Ranasimha, also called Karna, was a Guhila rawal of the Kingdom of Mewar during the later twelfth century. Succeeding his father Vikramsimha, he ruled from Chittor in about 1158–1168. After his death his son Kshemasimha carried on the senior Rawal line, while his second son Rahapa founded the junior Rana branch from the village of Sisoda. From Rahapa descended the later Sisodia maharanas, and Ranasimha's own name became the hereditary title Rana borne by that branch.
zh: 拉纳西姆哈又名卡尔纳，是12世纪后期梅瓦尔王国的古希拉拉瓦尔。他继承父亲维克拉姆辛哈之位，约1158—1168年以奇陶尔加尔为都。他死后，其子克谢马辛哈延续拉瓦尔长支，次子拉哈帕则从锡索达村起家，另立拉纳幼支。后世的西索迪亚马哈拉那均出自拉哈帕一系，而拉纳西姆哈的名字也成为该支世代袭用的“拉纳”称号。

en: Boris was prince of Drutsk from the 1180s until at least 1196, a ruler of the Polotsk branch of the Rurikids whose exact parentage is uncertain; one scholar considers him more likely a son of Vseslav Rogvolodich. In 1196 he joined the Chernigov princes and Prince Vasilko Volodarevich in a campaign against Vitebsk, then subject to Smolensk. In the battle that routed the Smolensk army, Boris struck the Smolensk forces from the rear, captured their commander Mstislav Romanovich, and handed the prince over to the ruler of Chernigov. The historian Nikolai Yermalovich regarded his Polotsk alliance as evidence of Drutsk's return to Polotsk's influence.
zh: 鲍里斯于1180年代至不早于1196年担任德鲁茨克王公，属留里克王朝波洛茨克支系，确切出身不详，有学者认为他更可能是弗谢斯拉夫·罗格沃洛多维奇之子。1196年，他联合切尔尼戈夫诸王公与瓦西里科·沃洛达列维奇王公，出征当时依附斯摩棱斯克的维捷布斯克。在击溃斯摩棱斯克军队的战役中，鲍里斯自后方突袭，俘虏斯摩棱斯克统帅姆斯季斯拉夫·罗曼诺维奇，并应切尔尼戈夫王公之请将其交出。历史学家尼古拉·叶尔马洛维奇认为，他与波洛茨克结盟表明德鲁茨克重回波洛茨克势力范围。

en: Davyd Vseslavich (born between 1047 and 1057, died after 1129) was a son of Vseslav Briachislavich and prince of Polotsk in 1128–1129; he may also have ruled there in 1101–1127. In 1103 he joined Vladimir Monomakh in defeating the Polovtsians at Suteni, and in 1106 he campaigned against the Zemgallans with his brothers. In 1127 the Polotsk veche drove him out in favour of his nephew Rogvolod. After he refused Mstislav the Great's summons to a Polovtsian campaign in 1129, Mstislav's governors seized him; in 1130 he was exiled with his family to Byzantium. He never returned and may have died there.
zh: 达维德·弗谢斯拉维奇（生于1047—1057年间，1129年后卒）是弗谢斯拉夫·布里亚奇斯拉维奇之子，1128—1129年担任波洛茨克王公，也可能曾于1101—1127年统治该地。1103年，他随弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫在苏捷尼击败波洛伏齐人，1106年又与诸弟出征泽姆加尔人。1127年，波洛茨克市民大会将他驱逐，改立其侄罗格沃洛德。1129年他拒绝奉姆斯季斯拉夫大帝之召参加对波洛伏齐人的征战，姆斯季斯拉夫的将领随即将他擒获；1130年他合家被流放拜占庭。他此后未再返回，可能客死于拜占庭。

en: Gleb Rogvolodich (died c. 1186) was a prince of Drutsk from the Polotsk branch of the Rurikids, son of Prince Rogvolod Borisovich, and may have ruled Drutsk as early as 1144–1151 and again in the 1170s and 1180s. In 1180 the Hypatian Chronicle names him as the ally of Smolensk prince Davyd Rostislavich against the Chernigov princes. In 1181 Yaroslav Vsevolodovich and Igor Sviatoslavich, hero of the Tale of Igor's Campaign, besieged Davyd in Drutsk; after Davyd fled to Smolensk the attackers burned the outer town, and Gleb may have lost his throne.
zh: 格列布·罗格沃洛多维奇（约1186年卒）是留里克王朝波洛茨克支系的德鲁茨克王公、罗格沃洛德·鲍里索维奇之子，可能早在1144—1151年以及1170—1180年代已统治德鲁茨克。《伊帕季耶夫编年史》记载，1180年他与斯摩棱斯克王公达维德·罗斯季斯拉维奇结盟，对抗切尔尼戈夫诸王公。1181年，雅罗斯拉夫·弗谢沃洛多维奇与《伊戈尔远征记》的主人公诺夫哥罗德-谢韦尔斯基王公伊戈尔·斯维亚托斯拉维奇将达维德围困于德鲁茨克；达维德逃奔斯摩棱斯克后，联军焚毁外城，格列布可能因此失去公位。

en: Gleb Rostislavich was the son of Rostislav Glebovich, prince of Minsk, and Sofia of Turov. When the Polotsk townsmen deposed Rogvolod Borisovich in 1151 and made his father prince of Polotsk, Gleb was installed in Rogvolod's ancestral town of Drutsk. He ruled there until 1158, when pro-Rogvolod citizens drove him out as Rogvolod returned with an army granted in Chernigov, and his father's attempt to retake the town failed.
zh: 格列布·罗斯季斯拉维奇是明斯克王公罗斯季斯拉夫·格列波维奇与图罗夫的索菲娅之子。1151年波洛茨克市民驱逐罗格沃洛德·鲍里索维奇、迎立其父后，格列布被安插在罗格沃洛德的祖地德鲁茨克。他统治该地至1158年，罗格沃洛德借切尔尼戈夫之兵返回时，亲罗格沃洛德的德鲁茨克市民将他驱逐，其父起兵攻城也告失败。

en: Rogvolod, baptised Vasily and also called Rogvolod Borisovich (c. 1110 – after 1171), was the son of Rogvolod-Boris Vseslavich of the Drutsk line. He may have first received Drutsk in 1127, shared his family's exile to Byzantium after 1129, and returned in 1140. He held Polotsk in 1144–1151 until the townsmen handed him to Rostislav of Minsk, regained Drutsk in 1158 and Polotsk in 1159, but lost the city after his defeat at Gorodets in 1162. The Rogvolod Stone of 1171 near Orsha preserves his name, and his son Gleb later ruled Drutsk.
zh: 罗格沃洛德教名瓦西里，又称罗格沃洛德·鲍里索维奇（约1110年生，1171年后卒），是德鲁茨克支系罗格沃洛德-鲍里斯·弗谢斯拉维奇之子。他可能于1127年首获德鲁茨克，1129年后随全家流放拜占庭，1140年返回。1144—1151年他据有波洛茨克，后被市民交给明斯克的罗斯季斯拉夫囚禁；1158年收复德鲁茨克，1159年再登波洛茨克之位，但1162年在戈罗杰茨战败后失去该城。奥尔沙附近刻于1171年的“罗格沃洛德石”留存有他的名字，其子格列布后来统治德鲁茨克。

en: Roman Vseslavich (died c. 1114 or 1116) was a son of Vseslav Briachislavich, prince of Polotsk. After his father's death in 1101 he held an appanage in the Polotsk land, possibly Drutsk, which later genealogies name as his seat and where legend makes him the first prince. He may have lost his domain in a family feud and died in exile: one chronicle places his death at Ryazan in 1114, another at Murom in 1116. He died childless, and his widow took the veil in Polotsk, copying books and aiding the poor; the young Euphrosyne of Polotsk may have lived near her in the same monastery.
zh: 罗曼·弗谢斯拉维奇（约1114或1116年卒）是波洛茨克王公弗谢斯拉夫·布里亚奇斯拉维奇之子。1101年父亲死后，他在波洛茨克领地领有封邑，可能即德鲁茨克——后世的德鲁茨克王公谱系将他奉为当地首任王公。他可能在家族内讧中失去封地，死于流亡途中：两部编年史分别记载他于1114年卒于梁赞、1116年卒于穆罗姆。他身后无嗣，遗孀在波洛茨克出家，以抄书济贫度日；年轻的波洛茨克的叶芙罗西尼娅可能曾住在同一修道院内她的近旁。

en: Vasily Tatishchev's account of the Polotsk chronicle names Vladimir-Vojtech as a son of Boris Davidovich, prince of Polotsk, and his second wife Svyatokhna.
zh: 据瓦西里·塔季谢夫转述的波洛茨克编年史，弗拉基米尔-沃伊捷赫是波洛茨克王公鲍里斯·达维多维奇与继妻斯维亚托赫娜之子。

en: Vseslav Rogvolodich (died between 1186 and 1196) was a prince of Drutsk from the Polotsk branch of the Rurikids, a son of Rogvolod Borisovich. The Hypatian Chronicle may name him in 1160 among the princes who joined Chernigov prince Sviatoslav Olgovich's campaign against Vshchizh. In 1186 the Laurentian Chronicle lists a Vseslav of Drutsk in the Smolensk Rostislavichi campaign against Polotsk, and historians identify him as the successor of the deceased Gleb Rogvolodich in Drutsk. He died by 1196, when Boris is recorded as prince of Drutsk.
zh: 弗谢斯拉夫·罗格沃洛多维奇（1186—1196年间卒）是留里克王朝波洛茨克支系的德鲁茨克王公、罗格沃洛德·鲍里索维奇之子。《伊帕季耶夫编年史》1160年条可能记载了他：一位波洛茨克的弗谢斯拉夫随切尔尼戈夫王公斯维亚托斯拉夫·奥尔戈维奇远征弗希日。1186年，《拉夫连季编年史》在斯摩棱斯克的罗斯季斯拉维奇联军进攻波洛茨克的名单中提到来自德鲁茨克的弗谢斯拉夫，史家认为他在格列布死后继任德鲁茨克王公。他不晚于1196年去世，该年鲍里斯已被记为德鲁茨克王公。

en: Raja Motay Rao was a Chauhan Rajput ruler of Dadrewa. His son Karamchand converted to Islam under Sultan Firuz Shah Tughluq around 1352, taking the name Qaim Khan, and became progenitor of the Qaimkhani lineage.
zh: 拉贾·摩泰·拉奥是乔诃那族拉杰普特人，为陀多瓦的统治者。其子卡拉姆昌德约于1352年在苏丹菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克时期皈依伊斯兰教，改名凯姆汗，成为凯姆卡尼家族的始祖。

en: Qaim Khan was the son of Motay Rao Chauhan, Rajput ruler of Dadrewa. Around 1353 he and his brothers embraced Islam during the reign of Firuz Shah Tughlaq, and in 1359 the Sultan appointed him governor of Hisar Feroza with the title Khan-i Jahan. He held the post under Mahmud Shah Tughlaq and the Sayyid ruler Khizr Khan, and guarded the captive former sultan Daulat Khan Lodi at Hisar. In 1419 Khizr Khan had him seized by treachery and killed on the banks of the Yamuna.
zh: 卡伊姆·汗是陀多瓦的拉杰普特统治者莫泰·拉奥·乔汉之子。约1353年，他与诸弟在菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克在位时皈依伊斯兰教；1359年被苏丹任命为希萨尔·菲鲁扎总督，赐号“汗·吉汉”。他在马哈茂德沙·图格鲁克和赛义德王朝的希兹尔汗治下留任，并在希萨尔看管被废的苏丹道拉特汗·洛迪。1419年，希兹尔汗设计将他擒杀于亚穆纳河畔。

en: Ghars al-Din Khalil Beg (d. 1386) was the second ruler of the Dulkadirid Turkoman principality, reigning from 1353. As a prince he took Elbistan from the rival chief Taraqlu and fought the Mamluks beside his father Qaraja. Before his recognition as ruler he sought to expand towards the Euphrates and took Zamantu. He retook Harpoot in 1378 and allied with Kadi Burhan al-Din of Sivas, marrying his heir Mehmed to Burhan al-Din's daughter. His raids around Aleppo prompted Sultan Barquq to incite Khalil's brother Ibrahim against him; he was killed in an ambush in April 1386 and succeeded by his brother Suli.
zh: 加尔斯丁·哈利勒贝伊（卒于1386年）是土库曼杜尔卡迪尔侯国第二代君主，1353年继位。他做公子时便从敌对首领塔拉克鲁手中夺取埃尔比斯坦，并随父亲卡拉贾与马穆鲁克作战。获承认为统治者之前，他试图向幼发拉底河方向扩张，夺取了扎曼图。1378年他重新攻占哈尔普特，还与锡瓦斯的卡迪·布尔汉丁结盟，让继承人穆罕默德迎娶其女。他在阿勒颇附近的袭扰促使苏丹巴尔库克挑动其弟易卜拉欣与他反目；1386年4月他遇伏身亡，其弟苏利继位。

en: Zayn al-Din Qaraja Beg (c. 1279–1353) was the Turkoman chieftain who founded the Dulkadirid principality in southern Anatolia. After his father's death in 1310 or 1311 he led the Bozok tribal confederation on the Mamluk frontier, and his rivalry with the warlord Taraqlu ended when Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad recognized him as client ruler of the Marash–Elbistan region in 1337. As Mamluk power faltered he expanded against neighbouring governors and declared independence in 1348. The Mamluks captured and executed him in 1353. His son Khalil succeeded him.
zh: 扎因丁·卡拉贾贝伊（约1279—1353）是在安纳托利亚南部建立杜尔卡迪尔侯国的土库曼首领。1310年或1311年父亲死后，他统领马穆鲁克边境的博佐克部落联盟，与军阀塔拉克鲁相争；1337年，马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德承认他为马拉什至埃尔比斯坦一带的附庸统治者。随着马穆鲁克势力动摇，他对抗各地总督、四处扩张，于1348年宣布独立。1353年他被马穆鲁克人俘获处决，其子哈利勒继位。

en: Wirich II von Daun (c. 1251 – 14 April 1299) was a German nobleman of the Daun-Oberstein branch, lord of Nanstein and Oberstein-Landstuhl near Idar-Oberstein. He married Kunigunde, daughter of Raugraf Heinrich I of Neuenbaumburg and sister of Emich I, bishop of Worms. Their son Heinrich III was elected bishop of Worms in 1318, while another son, Wirich III, carried on the family line.
zh: 维里希二世·冯·道恩（约1251年—1299年4月14日）是道恩—奥伯施泰因支系的德意志贵族，为伊达尔—奥伯施泰因附近南施泰因与奥伯施泰因—兰施图尔的领主。他娶诺因鲍姆堡伯爵海因里希一世之女、沃尔姆斯主教埃米希一世的姐妹库妮贡德为妻。其子海因里希三世于1318年当选沃尔姆斯主教，另一子维里希三世延续了家族血脉。

en: Duwa (died 1307), second son of Baraq, was made Chagatai khan by Kaidu in 1282 and became the khanate's longest-reigning ruler. For decades he joined Kaidu's wars against the Yuan, besieging Qocho in 1275 and briefly taking Karakorum in 1289. In 1297 he sacked Lahore and installed his son Qutlugh Khwaja there. Paralyzed by an arrow wound in 1301, he set Kaidu's son Chapar over the Ögedeids, made peace with the Yuan in 1303, and with Yuan support crushed Chapar by 1306, recovering lost lands. He died in 1307, and his son Könchek succeeded him.
zh: 笃哇（？—1307）是八剌的次子，1282年被海都立为察合台汗，是该汗国在位时间最长的君主。他长期追随海都与元朝作战，1275年围攻火州，1289年与海都一度攻占和林。1297年他南下劫掠德里苏丹国的拉合尔，封其子忽都鲁火者镇守其地。1301年他中箭瘫痪，随后立海都之子察八儿为窝阔台系之汗，1303年与元成宗讲和，又在元朝支持下于1306年击垮察八儿，收复失地。1307年他去世，其子宽阇继位。

en: Heinrich V Schenk von Reicheneck (d. 1344) was Prince-Bishop of Eichstätt from 1329 to 1344. A canon of Regensburg, he fought for Frederick the Fair at the battles of Gammelsdorf and Mühldorf before Pope John XXII, whose loyal partisan he was, appointed him to Eichstätt in 1329. He reconciled with Emperor Lewis the Bavarian in 1330 and received the regalia from him in 1334, for which the Pope excommunicated him. He reduced the bishopric's debts, pledging Schweinfurt and Abenberg, and around 1340 walled the town of Herrieden. He died at Nuremberg in 1344 and was buried at Engelthal Abbey.
zh: 海因里希五世·申克·冯·赖谢内克（卒于1344年）是1329至1344年间的艾希施泰特亲王主教。他原为雷根斯堡法政牧师，曾在加默尔斯多夫和米尔多夫战役中为美男子腓特烈作战。作为教皇约翰二十二世的亲信，他于1329年被教皇任命到艾希施泰特，1330年与皇帝巴伐利亚人路易和解，1334年从皇帝手中接受主教属地权，随即被教皇处以绝罚。他致力偿还教区债务，先后抵押施韦因富特和阿本贝格，约1340年为黑里登修筑城墙。1344年他卒于纽伦堡，葬于恩格塔尔修道院。

en: Abraham Darby (1677–1717) was an English Quaker ironmaster, born near Dudley in Staffordshire. After an apprenticeship in Birmingham making malt mills, he settled in Bristol in 1699 and developed casting iron pots in sand moulds. In 1709, at his Coalbrookdale furnace in Shropshire, he became the first to smelt pig iron successfully using coke instead of charcoal, a breakthrough that supplied cheap iron for the machinery, engines and bridges of the Industrial Revolution. He died at Madeley in 1717, aged forty.
zh: 亚伯拉罕·达比（1677—1717）是英格兰贵格会的炼铁厂主，生于斯塔福德郡达德利附近。他在伯明翰学做麦芽磨坊出师后，于1699年定居布里斯托尔，并研发出以砂模铸造铁锅的工艺。1709年，他在什罗普郡煤溪谷的炼铁炉首次成功用焦炭而非木炭冶炼生铁，这一突破为工业革命中的机械、蒸汽机和桥梁提供了廉价铁料。1717年，他在马德利去世，终年四十岁。

en: Sir Aymer de Strathbogie, also recorded as Adomar de Atholl, was the second son of David II Strathbogie, Earl of Atholl, and Joan Comyn. His father had rebelled against Robert the Bruce in 1307, lost his Scottish lands, and been compensated in England, where he was made warden of Northumberland in 1322. In 1324 Joan became co-heiress of her uncle Aymer de Valence, Earl of Pembroke, which brought Ponteland and other Northumberland manors into the family. While Aymer's elder brother David kept up the claim to the earldom of Atholl as a leading supporter of Edward Balliol, Aymer made his life in England, holding Jesmond, Ponteland and Felton. In 1381 he was returned to parliament as Knight of the Shire for Northumberland. He married Mary, said to have been a daughter of Walter the Steward, and the couple were buried together in the chancel of St Andrew's church in Newcastle upon Tyne. He died on 14 April 1402.
zh: 艾马尔·德·斯特拉斯博吉爵士，史书又作阿多马尔·德·阿瑟尔，是阿瑟尔伯爵大卫二世·斯特拉斯博吉与琼·科明的次子。其父1307年起兵反抗罗伯特·布鲁斯，失去苏格兰的领地，在英格兰得到补偿，并于1322年出任诺森伯兰守卫官。1324年，琼与人共同继承了舅父彭布罗克伯爵艾马尔·德·瓦朗斯的遗产，庞特兰等诺森伯兰地产由此归入这个家族。长兄大卫作为爱德华·巴里奥的主要支持者，继续坚持对阿瑟尔伯爵位的主张；艾马尔则在英格兰安身，领有杰斯蒙德、庞特兰和费尔顿。1381年，他作为诺森伯兰的郡骑士被选入议会。他娶玛丽为妻，玛丽据称是总管沃尔特之女；夫妇二人合葬于泰恩河畔纽卡斯尔的圣安德鲁教堂圣坛。他卒于1402年4月14日。

en: Agnes FitzAlan (1298–1348), daughter and co-heiress of Bryan FitzAlan, Lord FitzAlan of Bedale, by Maud de Balliol, was eight when her marriage was granted in 1306 for Gilbert Stapleton, with whom she had Garter knights Miles and Bryan Stapleton.
zh: 阿格尼丝·菲茨艾伦（1298—1348）是比代尔的菲茨艾伦勋爵布莱恩·菲茨艾伦与莫德·德·巴里奥之女，也是共同继承人；1306年她八岁时，她的婚姻被许给吉尔伯特·斯特普尔顿，二人的儿子迈尔斯与布莱恩均成为嘉德骑士。

en: Agnes Mortimer, Countess of Pembroke (1317–25 July 1368), was a daughter of Roger Mortimer, 1st Earl of March, and Joan de Geneville. In 1328 or 1329 she married Laurence Hastings, the future Earl of Pembroke and her father's ward, at Hereford; Edward III and Queen Isabella attended. Her only surviving son, the 2nd Earl of Pembroke, was born in August 1347, and Laurence died the next year. Agnes then married John de Hakelut, without further children. She made her will in October 1367, died the following July, and was buried at the Minoresses convent outside Aldgate in London.
zh: 彭布罗克伯爵夫人阿格尼丝·莫蒂默（1317—1368年7月25日）是第一代马奇伯爵罗杰·莫蒂默与琼·德·热内维尔之女。1328或1329年，她在赫里福德嫁给父亲的被监护人、后来的彭布罗克伯爵劳伦斯·黑斯廷斯，爱德华三世与伊莎贝拉王后出席婚礼。她唯一存活的儿子、第二代彭布罗克伯爵约翰·黑斯廷斯生于1347年8月，劳伦斯翌年去世。阿格尼丝后改嫁约翰·德·哈克卢特，未再生育。她于1367年10月立下遗嘱，1368年7月25日去世，葬于伦敦阿尔德门外的贫穷修女会修道院。

en: Alfred the Great (c. 849 – 26 October 899), youngest son of King Æthelwulf of Wessex, became king in 871 as Viking armies overran England. In 878 he defeated Guthrum's Danish force at Edington, then made peace by which England was divided between his realm and the Viking Danelaw and Guthrum accepted baptism. After reoccupying London in 886 he styled himself king of the Anglo-Saxons. Alfred reorganised defence and the law and founded a court school for nobles and commoners, promoting learning in English and Latin. He was called 'the Great' as early as the 13th century.
zh: 阿尔弗雷德大帝（约849—899年10月26日）是威塞克斯国王埃塞尔伍尔夫的幼子，871年维京人横扫英格兰之际即位。878年，他在埃丁顿击败古思伦率领的丹麦军队，随后议和：英格兰划分为他的领地与维京人的丹麦法区，古思伦并接受洗礼。886年收复伦敦后，他自称盎格鲁-撒克逊人的国王。他重整军备与法律，开办面向贵族与平民的宫廷学校，推行英语和拉丁语教育。早在13世纪，他便被称为“大帝”。

en: Alice of Norfolk (c. 1324–1352) was the younger daughter of Thomas of Brotherton, Earl of Norfolk and eldest son of Edward I. Her father died in August 1338, and in March 1339 Edward III ordered Alice's share of his lands delivered to her and her husband Edward Montagu, 1st Baron Montagu. Her husband fought at Crécy in 1346 and was summoned to Parliament as Lord Montagu from 1348. Alice died at Bungay in Suffolk shortly before 30 January 1352 after being assaulted by Montagu, who was indicted for her death.
zh: 诺福克的艾丽斯（约1324—1352）是诺福克伯爵、爱德华一世长子托马斯·布拉泽顿的幼女。其父于1338年8月去世，1339年3月，爱德华三世下令把她应得的遗产份额交给她和丈夫第一代蒙塔古男爵爱德华·蒙塔古。蒙塔古1346年征战克雷西，1348年起奉召进入议会，称蒙塔古勋爵。1352年1月30日前不久，艾丽斯在萨福克郡邦吉遭丈夫蒙塔古殴打，伤重而死，蒙塔古因此被起诉。

en: Alice de Warenne (1287–1338) was the daughter of William de Warenne and Joan de Vere, born in Sussex after her father's death in a tournament. In 1305 she married Edmund FitzAlan, 2nd Earl of Arundel, who stayed loyal to Edward II when Queen Isabella and Roger Mortimer invaded in 1326. Captured by the queen's party, Arundel was beheaded at Hereford in November 1326 and his lands were forfeited. Alice lived to see their eldest son Richard FitzAlan restored to the earldom of Arundel; she died in 1338. Through her, Richard also inherited the earldom of Surrey in 1361.
zh: 阿丽丝·德·瓦伦（1287—1338）是威廉·德·瓦伦与琼·德·维尔之女，在父亲于比武中身亡后出生于萨塞克斯。1305年，她嫁给第二代阿伦德尔伯爵埃德蒙·菲茨艾伦；1326年伊莎贝拉王后与罗杰·莫蒂默入侵时，阿伦德尔是少数仍忠于爱德华二世的贵族之一。他被王后一派俘获，1326年11月在赫里福德被斩首，领地被没收。阿丽丝生前看到长子理查德·菲茨艾伦恢复了阿伦德尔伯爵爵位，她于1338年去世。凭借她的血统，理查德又于1361年继承萨里伯爵爵位。

en: Aline FitzAlan (1314–1386) was a daughter of Edmund FitzAlan, Earl of Arundel, and Alice de Warenne. She married Roger le Strange, 5th Baron Strange of Knockin in Shropshire; their son John succeeded as the 6th Lord Strange.
zh: 阿琳·菲查伦（1314—1386）是阿伦德尔伯爵埃德蒙·菲查伦与爱丽丝·德瓦伦之女，嫁给什罗普郡诺金的第五代斯特兰奇男爵罗杰·勒斯特兰奇，其子约翰袭封第六代斯特兰奇男爵。

en: Alice de Lusignan (c. 1229 – 9 February 1256) was Countess of Surrey and a uterine half-sister of Henry III: her mother was Isabella of Angoulême, King John's widow, by Hugh X of Lusignan, Count of La Marche. In 1247 she followed her Lusignan brothers to England, where Henry III married her in August to John de Warenne, 6th Earl of Surrey. Her children were Eleanor, wife of Henry de Percy, Isabella, wife of King John Balliol of Scotland, and William. She died in Sussex on 9 February 1256 after giving birth to William.
zh: 艾丽斯·德·吕西尼昂（约1229年—1256年2月9日）是萨里伯爵夫人，也是亨利三世同母异父的妹妹：她的母亲是英格兰国王约翰的遗孀昂古莱姆的伊莎贝拉，父亲是拉马什伯爵于格十世·德·吕西尼昂。1247年，她随吕西尼昂家族的兄弟们来到英格兰，同年8月亨利三世将她嫁给第六代萨里伯爵约翰·德·瓦伦。子女有嫁给亨利·德·珀西的埃莉诺、嫁给苏格兰国王约翰·巴里奥的伊莎贝拉，以及儿子威廉。1256年2月9日，她在萨塞克斯生下威廉后去世。

en: Alasia di Saluzzo, in England called Alice (c. 1268–1292), was a daughter of Thomas I, Margrave of Saluzzo, and Aloisia di Ceva, born into the Aleramici dynasty of Piedmont. Through the intervention of Queen Eleanor of Provence, she came to England and married before 1285 Richard Fitzalan, who succeeded as Earl of Arundel in 1289. Their household was based at Marlborough Castle, and she was the mother of Edmund FitzAlan, the next earl, among others. She died on 25 September 1292 and was buried at Haughmond Abbey in Shropshire, where her husband was laid beside her.
zh: 阿洛伊西亚·迪·萨卢佐（在英格兰称艾丽斯，约1268—1292）是萨卢佐侯爵托马索一世与切瓦的阿洛伊西亚之女，出身皮埃蒙特的阿勒拉米奇家族。经普罗旺斯的埃莉诺王后安排，她来到英格兰，在1285年前嫁给理查德·菲茨艾伦；后者于1289年成为阿伦德尔伯爵，她也成为伯爵夫人。他们一家主要住在莫尔伯勒城堡，她生有多个子女，包括下一代伯爵埃德蒙·菲茨艾伦。她于1292年9月25日去世，葬于什罗普郡的霍蒙德修道院，丈夫也葬在她身旁。

en: Amaury IV of Évreux, also numbered Amaury VI de Montfort, was Count of Évreux in Normandy and later Earl of Gloucester in England. The son of Count Amaury III and Mabel, eldest daughter of Earl William of Gloucester, he inherited Évreux after his father died on the Third Crusade. Still a minor in 1198, he also inherited his mother's claim to Gloucester that year. In 1199 Philip II of France overran Évreux, and by the Treaty of Le Goulet in 1200 King John ceded it to France; Amaury surrendered it and was compensated with the earldom of Gloucester. When war resumed in 1202, he initially supported John, but revolted in 1203. He died around 1213.
zh: 埃夫勒的阿马尔里克四世在法式世系中称蒙福尔的阿马尔里克六世，领有诺曼底的埃夫勒伯国，后又成为英格兰的格洛斯特伯爵。他是伯爵阿马尔里克三世与格洛斯特伯爵威廉长女梅布尔之子，父亲死于第三次十字军东征后继承埃夫勒。1198年他尚未成年，又继承了母亲对格洛斯特的主张。1199年法王腓力二世攻占埃夫勒，1200年依《勒古莱条约》英王约翰将其割让法国，阿马尔里克放弃故土，以格洛斯特伯爵领作为补偿。1202年战事再起时，他起初支持约翰，1203年却起兵反叛。他约于1213年去世。

en: Anne Boleyn (c. 1501 or 1507–1536) was the second wife of Henry VIII and queen of England from 1533 to 1536. Educated in the Netherlands and France, she entered Catherine of Aragon's service in 1522. Her secret betrothal to Henry Percy was broken off in 1524. Henry VIII pursued her from 1526, and her refusal to become his mistress drove his campaign to annul his marriage, splitting the English Church from Rome. They married in 1533, and Archbishop Cranmer declared Henry's marriage to Catherine void. Crowned in June 1533, Anne gave birth that September to the future Elizabeth I. After later pregnancies ended in miscarriage, she was convicted of treason and beheaded at the Tower of London on 19 May 1536.
zh: 安妮·博林（约1501或1507—1536）是英格兰国王亨利八世的第二任王后，1533至1536年在位。她曾在尼德兰和法国接受教育，1522年入宫侍奉阿拉贡的凯瑟琳。她与亨利·珀西的秘密婚约于1524年解除。亨利八世自1526年起追求她，她拒绝只做国王的情妇，促使国王推动废除婚姻，最终令英格兰教会与罗马决裂。两人于1533年结婚，大主教克兰麦宣布亨利与凯瑟琳的婚姻无效。1533年6月安妮加冕为后，同年9月生下日后的伊丽莎白一世。此后几次怀孕均以流产告终，她最终被判叛国罪，于1536年5月19日在伦敦塔被斩首。

en: Anthony Babington (1561–1586) was a Derbyshire Catholic gentleman who had served as a page in the household of the Earl of Shrewsbury, keeper of the imprisoned Mary, Queen of Scots. Around 1580 he met Thomas Morgan, who persuaded him to carry letters to Mary. In 1586 he led a group of young Catholic conspirators planning to murder Elizabeth I and free Mary. On 6 July he wrote to Mary seeking her approval; their letters, smuggled in beer barrels, were intercepted by Sir Francis Walsingham's agents. Babington was arrested in August, hanged, drawn and quartered on 20 September 1586. His plot supplied the treason charge that led to Mary's execution the following year.
zh: 安东尼·巴宾顿（1561—1586）是德比郡的天主教乡绅，年轻时曾在看管苏格兰女王玛丽的什鲁斯伯里伯爵府当侍童。约1580年他结识托马斯·摩根，受其劝说为玛丽传递信件。1586年，他带领一群年轻的天主教徒密谋刺杀伊丽莎白一世、救出玛丽。7月6日他写信征求玛丽的同意，而这些藏在啤酒桶中偷运的信件被弗朗西斯·沃尔辛厄姆的密探截获。巴宾顿于8月被捕，9月20日被处以绞刑、开膛和车裂。他策划的阴谋为次年处死玛丽提供了叛国罪的依据。

en: Anton van den Wyngaerde (c. 1525–1571) was a Flemish topographical artist, born in Antwerp, who made panoramic views of cities across northern Europe. Around 1544 he produced a fourteen-sheet panorama of London, including a plan of Whitehall Palace drawn for Henry VIII. After Italian travels he recorded the sieges of Saint-Quentin and Ham during Philip II's 1557 campaign in northern France. He visited England in 1558–1559 to draw Dover, London and the royal palaces. From about 1562 he worked in Spain, where Philip commissioned at least sixty-two city views, among them Barcelona, Seville, Toledo and Madrid. He also decorated palace walls and painted scenery for court theatre. He died in Madrid on 7 May 1571.
zh: 安东尼·范·登·韦恩加德（约1525—1571）是佛兰芒地形景观画家，生于安特卫普，擅长绘制北欧诸城全景。约1544年，他绘成十四幅连张的伦敦大观，其中包括为亨利八世绘制的白厅宫平面图。他游历意大利后，在腓力二世1557年于法国北部的战役中记录了圣康坦与阿姆之围。1558至1559年他访问英格兰，描绘多佛尔、伦敦及各处王宫。约1562年起他在西班牙工作，受腓力二世委托绘制了至少六十二幅城市景观，包括巴塞罗那、塞维利亚、托莱多和马德里；他还装饰王宫墙壁，为宫廷戏剧绘制布景。1571年5月7日，他在马德里去世。

en: Sir Anthony van Dyck (1599–1641) was a Flemish painter born in Antwerp. A Guild of Saint Luke master by 1617, he worked in Rubens's studio, then spent 1621 to 1627 in Italy, chiefly in Genoa. In the late 1620s he produced a series of etched portraits of artists and other prominent contemporaries, known as the Iconography. From 1630 he served the Archduchess Isabella in Flanders, until Charles I brought him to London as principal court painter in 1632 and knighted him. His portraits of the king, Queen Henrietta Maria and the aristocracy set British portraiture for over a century, and the Van Dyck beard is named after him. He died in London in 1641 and was buried at St Paul's.
zh: 安东尼·范戴克爵士（1599—1641）是生于安特卫普的佛兰德画家。他在1617年成为圣路加行会画师，曾进入鲁本斯的画室，1621至1627年间游历意大利，主要住在热那亚。1620年代末，他创作了一组描绘艺术家和其他著名同时代人的蚀刻肖像，称为《肖像集》。1630年起他在佛兰德为伊莎贝拉女大公作画，1632年应查理一世之召前往伦敦出任首席宫廷画师，并受封爵士。他为国王、亨利埃塔·玛丽亚王后和英格兰贵族绘制的肖像，在一个多世纪里奠定了英国肖像画的范式，范戴克式胡须也以他命名。1641年他在伦敦去世，葬于圣保罗座堂。

en: Aphra Behn (baptised 1640–1689) was an English playwright, poet and prose writer of the Restoration era, and one of the first English women to earn a living by writing. Charles II employed her as a spy in Antwerp; back in London she was probably briefly imprisoned for debt and then turned to the stage. Under the pastoral pen name Astrea she found fame with the comedy The Rover and later the short novel Oroonoko, or the Royal Slave. During the Exclusion Crisis, a prologue and an epilogue brought her legal trouble, after which she devoted most of her writing to prose and translation. A loyal Stuart supporter, she refused to write a poem welcoming William III, died in April 1689 and was buried in Westminster Abbey.
zh: 阿芙拉·贝恩（1640年受洗—1689）是英国复辟时期的女剧作家、诗人与散文作家，也是英国最早以写作为生的女性之一。她引起查理二世的注意，被派往安特卫普充当密探；回到伦敦后可能曾因债务短暂入狱，此后投身戏剧创作。她以田园笔名“阿斯特蕾娅”写作，以喜剧《流浪者》成名，后来又创作了小说《奥鲁诺可：皇家奴隶》。排斥危机期间，她写的序幕和尾声给她带来法律麻烦，此后她主要从事散文写作和翻译。她始终忠于斯图亚特王室，拒绝赋诗迎立威廉三世，1689年4月去世，葬于威斯敏斯特教堂。

en: Æthelstan (c. 894 – 27 October 939), son of Edward the Elder, became king of the Anglo-Saxons in 924 and was crowned in September 925. In 927 he conquered the Viking kingdom of York, becoming the first ruler of a united England, and in 934 he invaded Scotland and received Constantine II's submission. When Scots and Vikings invaded together in 937 he crushed them at Brunanburh, a victory famed across Europe. A pious lawmaker who founded churches and married his sisters to continental rulers, he died childless in 939 and was succeeded by his half-brother Edmund.
zh: 埃塞尔斯坦（约894—939年10月27日）是长者爱德华之子，924年成为盎格鲁-撒克逊人的国王，925年9月加冕。927年他征服维京人的约克王国，成为统一英格兰的第一位统治者；934年入侵苏格兰，接受君士坦丁二世的臣服。937年苏格兰人与维京人联手来犯，他在布鲁南堡大败敌军，此战威名传遍欧洲。他虔诚敬教，修建教堂、制定法律，还将众妹嫁给欧洲大陆的统治者。939年他无嗣而终，异母弟埃德蒙继位。

en: Albéric de Clermont (1222–1284) was Count of Clermont-en-Beauvaisis from 1234 to 1252. The son of Philip Hurepel and Matilda II of Boulogne, he was a grandson of King Philip II Augustus of France. In 1252 he surrendered all his lands to his sister Joan, Countess of Boulogne, and settled in England. When Joan died later that same year, Clermont escheated to the French crown, and Louis IX granted it to his own son Robert of Clermont. Albéric died in 1284.
zh: 阿尔贝里克·德·克莱蒙（1222—1284）于1234至1252年任克莱蒙伯爵。他是克莱蒙伯爵菲利普·于尔佩尔与布洛涅女伯爵玛蒂尔达二世之子，即法王腓力二世·奥古斯都之孙。1252年，他把全部领地让给姐姐、布洛涅女伯爵让娜，自己迁居英格兰。让娜于同年去世，克莱蒙伯国收归法国王室，路易九世将它封给自己的儿子克莱蒙的罗贝尔。阿尔贝里克于1284年去世。

en: Avice Marmion (c. 1309 – after 1379) was the daughter of John Marmion, Baron of Winteringham, and Maud de Furnival. She was the second wife of John de Grey, 1st Baron Grey of Rotherfield, and mother of John and Robert Grey, who took the Marmion name.
zh: 阿维斯·马米恩（约1309—1379年后）是温特灵厄姆男爵约翰·马米恩与莫德·德·弗尼瓦尔之女，为第一代罗瑟菲尔德格雷男爵约翰·德·格雷的第二任妻子，生子约翰·格雷与罗伯特·格雷，二子后来改用马米恩之姓。

en: Bartholomew Burghersh, called the elder (died 1355), was an English soldier, a younger son of Robert Burghersh, 1st Baron Burghersh. He married Elizabeth de Verdun, co-heiress of Theobald de Verdun, 2nd Baron Verdun. In 1321 he was captured at Leeds Castle and held in the Tower of London. Under Edward III he served until his death as constable of Dover Castle and warden of the Cinque Ports, undertook embassies to France and the Avignon papacy, and went to Gascony with the Earl of Lancaster in 1349. Named a guardian of the realm in 1355, he died at Dover that August.
zh: 巴塞洛缪·伯格斯（史称长者，？—1355）是英格兰军人，第一代伯格斯男爵罗伯特·伯格斯较年幼的儿子之一。他娶第二代弗登男爵西奥博尔德·德·弗登的女继承人伊丽莎白·德·弗登为妻，1321年在利兹城堡被俘，关押于伦敦塔。爱德华三世在位时，他担任多佛城堡总管和五港总督直至去世，曾出使法国和阿维尼翁教廷，1349年随兰开斯特伯爵前往加斯科涅。1355年他被任命为王国摄政之一，同年8月在多佛去世。

en: Bartholomew Burghersh, 2nd Baron Burghersh (before 1329–1369), called the younger, was an English soldier and son of Bartholomew Burghersh the elder. He fought at Crécy in 1346 in the Black Prince's retinue and at the siege of Calais, and in 1348 was among the first Knights of the Garter. After a pilgrimage to Jerusalem in 1354, he served under the Black Prince in the south-west, playing a leading part at Poitiers in 1356, and joined Edward III's 1359 campaign that ended with the Treaty of Brétigny in 1360. He died in 1369 and was buried at Walsingham Abbey.
zh: 巴塞洛缪·伯格斯，第二代伯格斯男爵（1329年前—1369），史称幼者，是长者巴塞洛缪·伯格斯之子、英格兰军人。1346年他随黑王子参加克雷西战役，又参与加来围城战；1348年成为嘉德骑士团的创始骑士之一。1354年他赴耶路撒冷朝圣还愿，归国后在西南战场追随黑王子，在1356年普瓦捷战役中发挥重要作用，后又参加爱德华三世1359年的远征，最终以1360年《布雷蒂尼条约》收尾。他于1369年去世，葬于沃尔辛厄姆修道院。

en: Blanche of Lancaster (c. 1305 – c. 1380) was the eldest daughter of Henry, 3rd Earl of Lancaster, and Maud Chaworth, named after her grandmother Blanche of Artois. Before October 1316 she married Thomas Wake, 2nd Baron Wake of Liddell, a ward of her father; the marriage was childless. After Thomas died in 1349, the Bishop of Ely burned some of her houses and had her servant William Holm murdered, until Edward III confiscated his goods. She was an executor of her brother Henry of Grosmont's will and was buried at Greyfriars, Stamford.
zh: 兰开斯特的布兰奇（约1305—约1380）是第三代兰开斯特伯爵亨利与莫德·德·查沃思的长女，以祖母阿图瓦的布朗什之名命名。1316年10月之前，她嫁给受父亲监护的第二代利德尔的韦克男爵托马斯·韦克；两人没有子女。1349年托马斯去世后，伊利主教烧毁了她的部分房屋，还指使人杀害她的仆人威廉·霍尔姆，直到爱德华三世没收他的财产才罢休。她是弟弟亨利·格罗斯蒙特遗嘱的执行人之一，死后葬于斯坦福的方济各会教堂。

en: Blanche of Lancaster (1342–1368) was the younger daughter of Henry of Grosmont, 1st Duke of Lancaster. On 19 May 1359 she married John of Gaunt, son of Edward III, at Reading Abbey; the great Lancaster inheritance she brought him became the foundation of his power and of the Duchy of Lancaster. She bore seven children, including the future Henry IV. She died at Tutbury Castle on 12 September 1368, probably of the Black Death, while Gaunt was overseas. He held annual commemorations of her death and in 1374 commissioned a joint tomb for them at St Paul's Cathedral. Geoffrey Chaucer's The Book of the Duchess is generally thought to have been written in her memory.
zh: 兰开斯特的布兰奇（1342—1368）是第一代兰开斯特公爵格罗斯蒙特的亨利的小女儿。1359年5月19日，她在雷丁修道院嫁给爱德华三世之子冈特的约翰；她带来的巨额兰开斯特遗产成为冈特的约翰权势的根基，也奠定了兰开斯特公国的基础。她共生育七个子女，其中包括日后的亨利四世。1368年9月12日冈特的约翰身在海外时，她在塔特伯里城堡去世，很可能死于黑死病。冈特每年纪念她的忌日，并于1374年委托人在圣保罗座堂为两人建造合葬墓。一般认为杰弗雷·乔叟的《公爵夫人之书》即为悼念她而作。

en: Sir Bryan Stapleton (c. 1322–1394) was a Yorkshire knight, third son of Sir Gilbert Stapleton of Bedale and Agnes FitzAlan, and brother of Sir Miles. His wars began at Tournai in 1340, and by his own later account he fought in all the great battles and expeditions of Edward III's reign, among them Crécy and the siege of Calais in 1346–1347. He served under the Earl of Salisbury in France in 1359–1360, joined the force sent in 1369 to relieve the Black Prince in Aquitaine, and in 1373 sailed with Salisbury to raid the Breton coast and helped defend Brest. Captain of Calais Castle from 1380 and of Guînes from 1381, he became a Knight of the Garter in 1382, and in 1383 escorted Richard II's young bride, Anne of Bohemia, to Calais. He bought Wighill in 1376 and died there in 1394, asking in his will to be buried beside his wife at Helaugh Priory.
zh: 布莱恩·斯特普尔顿爵士（约1322—1394）是约克郡骑士，比代尔的吉尔伯特·斯特普尔顿爵士与阿格尼丝·菲茨艾伦的第三子，迈尔斯·斯特普尔顿爵士的弟弟。他的战争生涯始于1340年的图尔奈围城战；据他后来自述，爱德华三世在位时的各场大战和远征他都参加过，其中包括1346—1347年的克雷西战役和加来围城战。1359—1360年他在索尔兹伯里伯爵麾下于法兰西作战，1369年参加前往阿基坦援助黑太子的远征军，1373年随索尔兹伯里伯爵的舰队袭击布列塔尼海岸，并参与保卫布雷斯特。1380年他出任加来城堡长官，1381年出任吉讷长官，1382年获封嘉德骑士；1383年他与索尔兹伯里伯爵护送理查二世年轻的新娘波希米亚的安妮前往加来。1376年他买下威格尔，1394年卒于此地，遗嘱要求葬在赫劳修道院，与亡妻相伴。

en: Bryan FitzAlan, Lord FitzAlan, was a Yorkshire landowner, lord of Bedale, Askham Bryan and other manors, and the son of Sir Alan FitzBryan. In 1290 he founded a chantry at Bedale for prayers for his parents, his first wife Muriel and their three sons, among others. Muriel and the three sons had died by then. In 1291 he received licence to crenellate his house at Killerby and was appointed one of the guardians of Scotland. By his second wife Maud de Balliol, sister of King John Balliol, he was the Scottish king's brother-in-law. He died on 1 June 1306 and was buried at Bedale, his estates passing to his daughters Agnes and Katherine, his co-heiresses.
zh: 菲茨艾伦勋爵布莱恩·菲茨艾伦是约克郡大地主，领有比代尔、阿斯克姆布赖恩等庄园，为艾伦·菲茨布赖恩爵士之子。1290年他在比代尔捐资设立追思小堂，为父母、首任妻子穆里尔和他们的三个儿子等人祈祷；穆里尔和三个儿子此前均已去世。1291年他获准在基勒比的宅邸修筑雉堞，并被任命为苏格兰护国主之一。他续娶苏格兰国王约翰·巴里奥之妹莫德·德·巴里奥，与国王结为郎舅。他卒于1306年6月1日，葬于比代尔，地产由共同继承人——女儿阿格尼丝与凯瑟琳继承。

en: Catherine Grandison (c. 1304-1349) was an English noblewoman, the daughter of William de Grandison, 1st Baron Grandison, and Sibyl de Tregoz. Around 1320 she married William Montagu, the future 1st Earl of Salisbury and king of Man. The chronicler Jean le Bel claimed that Edward III assaulted her at Wark Castle in 1341 while her husband was abroad, a story modern scholars regard as French propaganda. She is also a candidate for the countess whose dropped garter inspired Edward III to found the Order of the Garter around 1348. She died in November 1349.
zh: 凯瑟琳·格兰迪森（约1304—1349）是英格兰贵族女子，为第一代格兰迪森男爵威廉·德·格兰迪森与西比勒·德·特雷戈兹之女。约1320年，她嫁给后来成为第一代索尔兹伯里伯爵兼马恩岛国王的威廉·蒙塔古。编年史家让·勒贝尔称，1341年丈夫身在国外期间，爱德华三世在沃克城堡侵犯了她，现代学者认为这一说法是法国方面的宣传。她也被认为可能是袜带掉落、促使爱德华三世约在1348年创立嘉德骑士团的那位索尔兹伯里伯爵夫人。她于1349年11月去世。

en: Catherine of Aragon (1485–1536), daughter of Ferdinand II of Aragon and Isabella I of Castile, married Arthur, Prince of Wales, in 1501 but was widowed within months. In 1507 she served as Aragonese ambassador in London, and in 1509 she married Arthur's brother Henry VIII. She was regent in 1513, when England defeated the Scots at Flodden. Her failure to bear a surviving son left their daughter Mary as heir presumptive and led Henry to seek an annulment; the pope's refusal prompted England's break with Rome. The marriage was declared invalid in 1533. Catherine refused to recognise Henry as head of the English Church and died at Kimbolton Castle in 1536, still calling herself his true wife.
zh: 阿拉贡的凯瑟琳（1485—1536）是阿拉贡国王费尔南多二世与卡斯蒂利亚女王伊莎贝拉一世之女。1501年她先嫁给威尔士亲王亚瑟，数月后便守寡。1507年她在伦敦担任阿拉贡驻英格兰大使，1509年改嫁亚瑟之弟亨利八世。1513年她摄政时，英格兰在弗洛登击败苏格兰。她未能为国王留下存活的王子，女儿玛丽成为推定继承人，亨利八世因此寻求废除婚姻；教皇拒绝批准，促使英格兰与罗马决裂。1533年婚姻被宣布无效。凯瑟琳拒绝承认亨利为英格兰教会首脑，1536年在金博尔顿城堡去世，至死仍坚持自己是国王的合法妻子。

en: Catherine of Braganza (1638–1705), daughter of John IV of Portugal, married Charles II of England in 1662. Their wedding included a secret Catholic ceremony and a public Anglican service. Her dowry brought England Tangier, Bombay and trading privileges in the Portuguese Indies, sealing an alliance backing Portugal's independence from Spain. She suffered at least three miscarriages and bore no surviving children, placing her position under strain. A Catholic, she was accused of treason during the Popish Plot of 1678–1679, but Charles defended her and she was never tried. After his death she returned to Portugal and twice served as regent for her brother Peter II, in 1701 and 1704–1705. She died in Lisbon, credited with popularising tea in England.
zh: 布拉干萨的凯瑟琳（1638—1705）是葡萄牙国王若昂四世之女，1662年嫁给英格兰国王查理二世。婚礼包括秘密举行的天主教仪式和公开的英国国教仪式。她的嫁妆把丹吉尔、孟买以及葡属印度的贸易特权带给英格兰，巩固了支持葡萄牙脱离西班牙独立的同盟。她至少流产三次，没有留下存活的子嗣，地位因此受到压力。作为天主教徒，她在1678—1679年的“教皇阴谋”中被控叛国，但查理二世力保于她，最终未受审判。丈夫死后她返回葡萄牙，于1701年和1704—1705年两度为弟弟佩德罗二世摄政，最后在里斯本去世，相传饮茶在英格兰的流行也得益于她。

en: Charles Beauclerk, 1st Duke of St Albans (1670–1726), was the elder son of Charles II and the actress Nell Gwyn. Created Earl of Burford in 1676 and Duke of St Albans in 1684, he became a cavalry colonel in 1687 and served Emperor Leopold I at the siege of Belgrade in 1688. In 1694 he married Lady Diana de Vere, heiress of the 20th Earl of Oxford, and had twelve children. William III made him a gentleman of the bedchamber in 1697. A Whig out of favour under Queen Anne, he regained favour under George I, received the Garter in 1718 and died at Bath in 1726.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/第一代聖奧爾本斯公爵查爾斯·博克萊爾
zh: 第一代圣奥尔本斯公爵查尔斯·博克莱尔（1670—1726）是查理二世与女演员内尔·格温的长子。1676年他被封为伯福德伯爵，1684年晋封圣奥尔本斯公爵。1687年他出任骑兵团上校，1688年随皇帝利奥波德一世的军队参加贝尔格莱德围城战。1694年他娶第二十代牛津伯爵的继承人黛安娜·德维尔为妻，育有十二个子女。1697年威廉三世任命他为寝宫内侍。他身为辉格党人，在安妮女王一朝失势，乔治一世即位后重新受宠，1718年获授嘉德勋章，1726年在巴斯去世。

en: Charles Brandon, Duke of Suffolk (c. 1484–1545), was Henry VIII's closest friend and a leading commander. His father died carrying Henry Tudor's standard at Bosworth in 1485, and Brandon was raised at court. He fought at Thérouanne and Tournai in 1513, became Master of the Horse, and was made a duke in March 1514. In 1515 he secretly married Henry's sister Mary Tudor, dowager queen of France, but was forgiven. In 1523 he led an English army into northern France, advancing towards Paris before withdrawing. He became Earl Marshal in 1524, helped dismiss Wolsey in 1529, led the 1544 invasion of France, and died on 22 August 1545.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/第一代薩福克公爵查爾斯·布蘭登
zh: 萨福克公爵查尔斯·布兰登（约1484—1545）是亨利八世最亲密的朋友和主要将领。他的父亲在1485年博斯沃思战役中擎着亨利·都铎的王旗战死，布兰登由此在宫中长大。他参加1513年的泰鲁阿讷和图尔奈围城战，出任御马长官，1514年3月受封公爵。1515年，他秘密娶了亨利的妹妹、法国前王后玛丽·都铎，但最终获得宽恕。1523年，他率英军进入法国北部，向巴黎推进后撤退。他1524年任宫廷典礼大臣，1529年参与罢黜沃尔西，1544年率军入侵法国，1545年8月22日去世。

en: Charles Neville, 6th Earl of Westmorland (1542–1601), was a Catholic nobleman of the Neville family of northern England. Allied to the Catholic Howards, he opposed Elizabeth I's Protestant policies. In November 1569 he and the Earl of Northumberland led the Rising of the North: the rebels seized Durham, celebrated mass, and marched to free Mary, Queen of Scots, before royal forces scattered them. Neville fled to Scotland and was attainted in 1571, forfeiting his estates. After Northumberland was captured and handed over in 1572, Neville feared betrayal and went into exile in the Spanish Netherlands, living on a pension from Philip II of Spain. In 1588 he mustered English Catholic exiles in Flanders for the Armada invasion. He died in poverty on 16 November 1601.
zh: 第六代威斯特摩兰伯爵查尔斯·内维尔（1542—1601）是英格兰北方内维尔家族的天主教贵族。他与天主教霍华德家族结盟，反对伊丽莎白一世的新教政策。1569年11月，他与诺森伯兰伯爵共同领导北方起义：起义者夺取达勒姆、举行弥撒，并进军解救被囚的苏格兰女王玛丽，最终被王军击溃。内维尔逃到苏格兰，1571年被褫夺公权，家产尽失。1572年诺森伯兰被捕并被引渡后，内维尔担心遭到出卖，逃往西属尼德兰，靠西班牙国王腓力二世的津贴度日。1588年，他在佛兰德召集英格兰天主教流亡者，准备配合无敌舰队入侵。1601年11月16日，他在贫困中客死他乡。

en: Christopher Marlowe (baptised 26 February 1564–30 May 1593) was an English playwright and a Canterbury shoemaker's son. He attended the King's School on a scholarship and gained a bachelor's degree at Corpus Christi College, Cambridge, in 1584. In 1587 the Privy Council intervened to secure his master's degree, citing undisclosed service to the queen. In London his Tamburlaine, Doctor Faustus, The Jew of Malta and Edward II made blank verse the standard form of Elizabethan tragedy and deeply influenced Shakespeare. The coroner's account recorded that on 30 May 1593, at a Deptford boarding house, he was stabbed above the right eye in a quarrel over the bill with Ingram Frizer, and died instantly. Frizer was pardoned on a plea of self-defence.
zh: 克里斯托弗·马洛（1564年2月26日受洗—1593年5月30日）是英格兰剧作家，坎特伯雷一名鞋匠之子。他靠奖学金就读于国王学校，1584年在剑桥大学基督圣体学院取得学士学位。1587年枢密院出面干预，以他曾为女王效力、任务保密为由，使他顺利取得硕士学位。在伦敦，他的《帖木儿》《浮士德博士》《马耳他的犹太人》《爱德华二世》使无韵诗体成为伊丽莎白时代悲剧的标准形式，并深刻影响了莎士比亚。据验尸记录，1593年5月30日，在德特福德的一间旅舍里，他与英格拉姆·弗里泽因账单发生争执，被刺中右眼上方当场身亡。弗里泽以正当防卫为由获赦。

en: Sir Christopher Wren (1632–1723) was an English architect and scientist born in Wiltshire. Astronomy professor at Gresham College from 1657 and at Oxford from 1661, he was a founder of the Royal Society and its president from 1680 to 1682. He also provided anatomical drawings for Thomas Willis's book on the brain, published in 1664. After the Great Fire of London in 1666 he was responsible for rebuilding more than fifty city churches, with architects in his office contributing to their designs. As Surveyor of the King's Works from 1669 he built the Royal Hospital Chelsea, Greenwich Hospital and his masterpiece, St Paul's Cathedral, completed in 1710. Knighted in 1673, he died in 1723 and was buried in St Paul's.
zh: 克里斯托弗·雷恩爵士（1632—1723）是生于威尔特郡的英格兰建筑师与科学家。他自1657年任格雷沙姆学院天文学教授，1661年起任牛津大学天文学教授，是英国皇家学会的创立者之一，并于1680至1682年担任会长。他还为托马斯·威利斯1664年出版的脑部著作绘制解剖图。1666年伦敦大火后，他负责重建五十余座城市教堂，其事务所的建筑师也参与了设计。1669年起他担任王室工程总监，建造了切尔西皇家医院、格林尼治医院以及他的代表作圣保罗大教堂（1710年完工）。他于1673年受封爵士，1723年去世，葬于圣保罗大教堂。

en: Cnut, called the Great (c. 995–1035), was the younger son of Swein Forkbeard. He invaded England in 1015, defeated Edmund Ironside at Assandun in October 1016, and became king on Edmund's death weeks later. In 1017 he married Æthelred's widow Emma of Normandy, inheriting Denmark in 1018. He defeated Norwegian and Swedish rivals at the Helgeå in 1026, took Norway in 1028, and in 1031 received Malcolm II of Scotland's submission. Ruler of England, Denmark and Norway, the core of the North Sea Empire, he died at Shaftesbury on 12 November 1035 and was buried at Winchester.
zh: 克努特，世称“大帝”（约995—1035），是八字胡斯文的幼子。他于1015年入侵英格兰，1016年10月在阿桑顿击败刚勇者埃德蒙，几周后埃德蒙去世，他成为全英格兰国王。1017年他迎娶埃塞尔雷德的遗孀诺曼底的爱玛，1018年继承丹麦王位。1026年他在海尔格河击败挪威与瑞典的敌手，1028年取得挪威，1031年接受苏格兰国王马尔科姆二世臣服。作为英格兰、丹麦和挪威——北海帝国核心——的统治者，他于1035年11月12日在沙夫茨伯里去世，葬于温切斯特。

en: Cornelis Drebbel (1572–1633) was a Dutch engineer and inventor born in Alkmaar. In 1598 he obtained a patent for a water-supply system and a type of perpetual clockwork. Around 1604 he moved to England, probably at the invitation of James I, astonishing the court at Eltham Palace with hydraulic automata, a perpetual-motion clock and optical instruments. In 1610 he entered Emperor Rudolf II's service in Prague, where he was imprisoned after the emperor's fall. Returning to London in 1613, he made optical instruments and compound microscopes. He returned to Prague in 1619 and was captured when the city fell in 1620. He built the first navigable submarine in 1620 and died in London in 1633.
zh: 科内利斯·德雷贝尔（1572—1633）是生于阿尔克马尔的荷兰工程师与发明家。1598年，他取得供水系统和一种永动钟装置的专利。约1604年，他前往英格兰，可能是应詹姆士一世之邀，在埃尔特姆宫以水力自动机械、永动钟和光学仪器惊艳宫廷。1610年他赴布拉格为神圣罗马帝国皇帝鲁道夫二世效力，皇帝失势后遭到囚禁。1613年回到伦敦后，他制造光学仪器和复合显微镜。1619年他重返布拉格，1620年城陷时被俘。他于1620年建成第一艘可航行的潜水船，1633年在伦敦去世。

en: Daniel Defoe (c. 1660–1731) was an English writer, journalist, merchant and government agent, born Daniel Foe in London. Educated at a dissenting academy, he joined Monmouth's rebellion in 1685 but gained a pardon. He became an ally and secret agent of William III, traded in hosiery and wine, and went bankrupt under heavy debts in 1692. His political pamphlets brought him into conflict with the authorities and he was imprisoned. His first novel, Robinson Crusoe (1719), ran through four editions before the year ended and gave its name to the Robinsonade genre. Moll Flanders and Colonel Jack followed in 1722 and Roxana in 1724, making him a founder of the realistic English novel. He died in London in April 1731.
zh: 丹尼尔·笛福（约1660—1731）是英国作家、记者、商人兼政府密探，生于伦敦，原名丹尼尔·福。他曾在非国教徒学院受教育，1685年参加蒙茅斯叛乱，但获得赦免。他成为威廉三世的盟友与密探，经营袜业与葡萄酒贸易，1692年因巨额债务破产。政论小册子使他与当局发生冲突，他曾因此入狱。他的第一部小说《鲁滨逊漂流记》（1719）在当年内连印四版，“鲁滨逊式故事”后来成为一种文学体裁的名称。此后他又写出《摩尔·弗兰德斯》（1722）、《杰克上校》（1722）与《罗克萨娜》（1724），成为英国现实主义小说的奠基人之一。1731年4月他在伦敦去世。

en: Eadred (c. 923 – 23 November 955), younger son of Edward the Elder, became king in 946, when his brother Edmund I was killed leaving the young princes Eadwig and Edgar. His reign was dominated by the long struggle with Viking York, and in 954 the York magnates expelled their last king, Erik Bloodaxe, after which Eadred made Osulf of Bamburgh the first ealdorman of all Northumbria. A friend of Dunstan of Glastonbury, he supported the early English Benedictine reform. He died unmarried in his early thirties in 955, and Eadwig and Edgar succeeded him in turn.
zh: 埃德雷德（约923—955年11月23日）是长者爱德华的幼子。946年其兄埃德蒙一世被杀，留下年幼的王子埃德威格和埃德加，埃德雷德即位。他在位期间主要与维京人的约克长期较量：954年约克贵族驱逐了末代国王血斧王埃里克，埃德雷德随任命班堡的奥斯伍尔夫为统辖整个诺森伯里亚的第一位郡长。他与格拉斯顿伯里的邓斯坦交好，支持早期的英格兰本笃会改革。955年他三十岁出头便未婚而终，埃德威格与埃德加相继继位。

en: Eadwig (c. 940–959), called All-Fair, was the elder son of King Edmund I and became king of England in November 955 after his uncle Eadred died. Crowned at Kingston upon Thames in January 956, he soon quarrelled with Dunstan, Abbot of Glastonbury, and drove him into exile in Flanders. In 957 his brother Edgar was made king north of the Thames, leaving Eadwig with only Wessex and the south. In 958 Archbishop Oda annulled his marriage to Ælfgifu because they were too closely related. Eadwig died on 1 October 959, aged about nineteen, and Edgar reunited the kingdom.
zh: 埃德威格（约940—959），人称“全美者”，是国王埃德蒙一世的长子，955年11月叔父埃德雷德死后成为英格兰国王。956年1月在泰晤士河畔金斯顿加冕后不久，他与格拉斯顿伯里修道院院长邓斯坦发生冲突，将其放逐到佛兰德。957年，其弟埃德加在泰晤士河以北被拥立为王，埃德威格仅保有威塞克斯及南部地区。958年，坎特伯雷大主教奥达以血缘过近为由，宣布他与艾尔弗吉夫的婚姻无效。959年10月1日埃德威格去世，年仅约十九岁，埃德加重新统一了王国。

en: Edgar, known as the Peaceful (c. 943–975), was the younger son of King Edmund I. In 957 the Mercians and Northumbrians made him king north of the Thames, and on Eadwig's death in 959 he took the throne of all England. His reign saw no Viking attacks; he backed the Benedictine Reform led by Dunstan and Bishop Æthelwold and standardised the kingdom's coinage. In 973 he received an imperial coronation at Bath, followed at Chester by homage from rulers including Kenneth II of Scotland. He died on 8 July 975, leaving the crown to his son Edward.
zh: 埃德加，世称“和平者”（约943—975），是国王埃德蒙一世的幼子。957年，麦西亚人与诺森伯里亚人拥立他为泰晤士河以北之王；959年埃德威格去世后，他成为全英格兰国王。他在位期间没有维京人来犯；他支持由邓斯坦和温切斯特主教埃塞尔沃尔德领导的本笃会改革，并统一了王国铸币。973年，他在巴斯举行帝国式加冕礼，随后在切斯特接受包括苏格兰国王肯尼思二世在内的诸君主臣服。975年7月8日他去世，王位传给儿子爱德华。

en: Sir Edmund FitzAlan (c. 1327/1329–1382), also called Edmund de Arundel, was the only son of Richard FitzAlan, Earl of Arundel, and Isabel le Despenser, and a great-great-grandson of Edward I. He was heir to the earldom until his parents' marriage was annulled on 4 December 1344 and he was declared illegitimate. Knighted in 1352, he made himself a soldier and royal envoy: he fought in France in 1359–1360, went to Flanders in 1364, carried Pope Urban V's report on the Roman church in Italy to Edward III in 1368, and fought under the Black Prince at Pontvallain in 1369–1370. After his father died in 1376 he quarrelled with his half-brother Richard over the earldom, was held in the Tower of London in 1377, and never won it back. He sailed for Gascony in February 1381 and was dead by February 1382. His three daughters by Sybil Montagu then sued their half-uncle, the Earl of Arundel, and failed.
zh: 埃德蒙·菲查伦爵士（约1327/1329—1382），又称埃德蒙·德·阿伦德尔，是阿伦德尔伯爵理查德·菲查伦与伊莎贝尔·勒德斯潘塞的独子，爱德华一世的玄孙。1344年12月4日父母婚姻被宣告无效，他也被判定为非婚生子，由此失去伯爵爵位继承人的身份。1352年受封骑士后，他做过军人，也当过王室使者：1359至1360年赴法兰西作战，1364年被派往佛兰德，1368年向爱德华三世转达教宗乌尔班五世关于意大利罗马教会现状的口信，1369至1370年又在黑太子麾下于蓬瓦兰作战。1376年父亲去世后，他与同父异母的兄弟理查德争夺伯爵领，1377年被关进伦敦塔，始终没能夺回。1381年2月他远赴加斯科涅，1382年2月前去世。他与西比尔·蒙塔古所生的三个女儿随后起诉父亲同父异母的兄弟阿伦德尔伯爵，但未获胜。

en: Edmund Crouchback (1245–1296) was the second surviving son of Henry III of England and founder of the House of Lancaster. In 1254 his father accepted a papal grant naming him king of Sicily, but the scheme collapsed for lack of funds. He fought in the Second Barons' War, and after the victory at Evesham in 1265 received the confiscated lands of Simon de Montfort, becoming Earl of Leicester, Lancaster and Derby. Through his marriage to Blanche of Artois he governed Champagne as count palatine from 1276. He died at Bayonne in 1296 while campaigning in Gascony against Philip IV.
zh: 驼背者埃德蒙（1245—1296）是英格兰国王亨利三世存活下来的次子，兰开斯特家族的创立者。1254年，父亲代他接受教皇授予的西西里王位，但因无力筹措经费而计划落空。他在第二次男爵战争中参战，1265年王军在伊夫舍姆取胜后，领有被没收的西蒙·德·孟福尔的地产，受封莱斯特、兰开斯特和德比伯爵。1276年，他凭借与阿图瓦的布朗什的婚姻，以宫伯身份治理香槟。1296年，他在加斯科涅与腓力四世交战期间病逝于巴约讷。

en: Edmund FitzAlan, Earl of Arundel (1285–1326), succeeded his father Richard in 1302 as a ward of the Earl of Surrey, whose granddaughter Alice he married. Knighted by Edward I in 1306, he fought in the Scottish wars and in 1311 joined the Lords Ordainers against Edward II; with Thomas of Lancaster he helped bring about Piers Gaveston's death in 1312. He later made his peace with the king and tied his heir to the Despenser family. He supported the suppression of rebellions by Mortimer and Lancaster, receiving lands and offices in return. Captured during Queen Isabella and Roger Mortimer's invasion, he was beheaded at Hereford on 17 November 1326. His title and lands were forfeited, but his son Richard recovered them in 1331.
zh: 阿伦德尔伯爵埃德蒙·菲查伦（1285—1326）于1302年继承父亲理查德，由萨里伯爵监护，并娶其孙女爱丽丝为妻。1306年他受爱德华一世册封为骑士，参加苏格兰战争，1311年加入反对爱德华二世的“敕令勋爵”集团，并与兰开斯特伯爵托马斯联手促成1312年皮尔斯·加韦斯顿之死。后来他与国王和解，让继承人与德斯潘塞家族联姻。他支持镇压莫蒂默和兰开斯特的叛乱，作为回报获得土地与官职。伊莎贝拉王后与罗杰·莫蒂默入侵时他被俘，1326年11月17日在赫里福德被斩首。他的爵位与领地被没收，其子理查德于1331年收回。

en: Edmund II, known as Ironside (c. 990–1016), was a son of King Æthelred the Unready. In 1015, after Sigeferth and Morcar were executed with his father's permission, he defied Æthelred, married Sigeferth's widow and made himself master of the Five Boroughs. On Æthelred's death in April 1016 he was elected king and led the resistance to Cnut's Danish army, fighting at Penselwood, Sherston and Brentford before his defeat at Assandun, where Eadric Streona's flight was decisive. He divided the kingdom with Cnut at Alney, keeping Wessex, but died on 30 November 1016 after seven months as king.
zh: 埃德蒙二世，世称“刚勇者”（约990—1016），是国王决策无方者埃塞尔雷德之子。1015年，贵族西格弗斯与莫卡在父王许可下被处死后，他起兵对抗埃塞尔雷德，娶西格弗斯的遗孀为妻，控制了丹麦法区的五座重镇。1016年4月埃塞尔雷德去世，他被拥立为王，率军抵抗克努特的丹麦大军，先后在彭塞尔伍德、舍斯顿和布伦特福德作战，最终在阿桑顿战败，埃德里克·斯特雷奥纳的临阵脱逃是败因。随后他在奥尔奈与克努特瓜分王国，自己保有威塞克斯，但1016年11月30日去世，在位仅七个多月。

en: Sir Edmund Mortimer (1302/1303 – 16 December 1331), eldest son of Roger Mortimer, 1st Earl of March, and Joan de Geneville, married Elizabeth de Badlesmere at Kinlet, Shropshire, in July 1316, when he was fourteen and she was three. During his father's exile he was imprisoned at Windsor and, from October 1326, in the Tower of London, and was knighted by Edward III in February 1327. After the Earl was attainted and hanged in 1330, Edmund recovered the Wigmore estates in October 1331 but died of fever on 16 December, leaving his son Roger, later 2nd Earl of March.
zh: 埃德蒙·莫蒂默爵士（1302或1303年—1331年12月16日）是第一代马奇伯爵罗杰·莫蒂默与琼·德·热纳维尔的长子。1316年7月，14岁的他在什罗普郡的金莱特与年仅3岁的伊丽莎白·德·巴德斯米尔成婚。父亲流亡期间，他被囚禁在温莎，1326年10月起转押伦敦塔，1327年2月被爱德华三世封为骑士。1330年其父被褫夺爵位并处以绞刑后，埃德蒙于1331年10月收回威格莫尔领地，却在12月16日死于热病，留下儿子罗杰，即后来的第二代马奇伯爵。

en: Edmund, 2nd Earl of Kent (c. 1326–1331), was the eldest son of Edmund of Woodstock, Edward I's son, by Margaret Wake. His father was executed for treason in March 1330, but after Edward III overthrew Roger Mortimer later that year the attainder was reversed and, on his mother's petition, the infant Edmund was recognised as Earl of Kent. He died on 5 October 1331, aged about five, and the earldom passed to his baby brother John.
zh: 第二代肯特伯爵埃德蒙（约1326—1331）是爱德华一世之子伍德斯托克的埃德蒙与玛格丽特·韦克的长子。1330年3月，他的父亲以叛国罪被处死；同年晚些时候爱德华三世推翻罗杰·莫蒂默后，撤销了夺爵判决，应其母亲请求，年幼的埃德蒙被承认为肯特伯爵。他于1331年10月5日夭折，年仅约五岁，伯爵爵位由襁褓中的弟弟约翰继承。

en: Edmund of Woodstock (1301–1330), 1st Earl of Kent, was a younger son of Edward I by Margaret of France and half-brother of Edward II. He was made Earl of Kent in 1321 and helped put down the baronial revolt of 1321–1322. In 1326 he joined Queen Isabella and Roger Mortimer in deposing the king, but soon fell out with their regime. In 1330 he was convicted of plotting to free Edward II and beheaded at Winchester. Edward III annulled the charges after seizing power, and Kent passed to his son.
zh: 伍德斯托克的埃德蒙（1301—1330），第一代肯特伯爵，是爱德华一世与法兰西的玛格丽特之子、爱德华二世的异母弟。他于1321年受封肯特伯爵，参与平定1321—1322年的贵族叛乱。1326年，他加入伊莎贝拉王后与罗杰·莫蒂默废黜国王的阵营，但很快与新政权反目。1330年，他被判图谋营救爱德华二世，在温切斯特被斩首。爱德华三世亲政后撤销了对他的指控，肯特伯爵爵位由其子继承。

en: Edmund I (920/921 – 26 May 946), elder son of Edward the Elder and Eadgifu, succeeded his childless half-brother Æthelstan as king of the English in 939. At first he lost the north to the Viking king Anlaf Guthfrithson, but after Anlaf's death in 941 he recovered the Five Boroughs in 942 and expelled the Viking kings of York in 944, reuniting England. In 945 he ravaged Strathclyde and ceded it to Malcolm I of Scotland. Edmund was killed in 946, aged about twenty-five, in a brawl with an outlaw at Pucklechurch, and was succeeded by his brother Eadred.
zh: 埃德蒙一世（920/921—946年5月26日）是长者爱德华与埃德吉芙的长子，939年在无嗣的异母兄埃塞尔斯坦之后继任英格兰人的国王。他起初把北方失于维京国王奥拉夫·古思弗里思森，941年奥拉夫死后，他于942年收复五镇，944年驱逐约克的维京诸王，重新统一英格兰。945年他洗劫斯特拉斯克莱德，将其让给苏格兰国王马尔科姆一世。946年，年约25岁的埃德蒙在帕克尔彻奇与一名歹徒争斗时被杀，其弟埃德雷德继位。

en: Edward I (1239–1307), called Longshanks and the Hammer of the Scots, was the eldest son of Henry III. He escaped rebel captivity and defeated Simon de Montfort at Evesham in 1265, then joined the Ninth Crusade in 1270 before succeeding his father in 1272. He conquered Wales in 1282–1283, ringed it with castles, and in 1290 expelled the Jews from England. Invited to judge the Scottish succession, he claimed overlordship of Scotland, provoking a long war; he defeated William Wallace at Falkirk in 1298. He died in 1307 marching north against Robert the Bruce.
zh: 爱德华一世（1239—1307）绰号“长腿”和“苏格兰之锤”，是亨利三世的长子。他从叛党拘押中逃脱，于1265年在伊夫舍姆击败西蒙·德·孟福尔，1270年参加第九次十字军东征，1272年继承父位。1282—1283年他征服威尔士，并在当地广建城堡；1290年下令将犹太人逐出英格兰。他受请裁决苏格兰王位继承之争，却趁机宣称对苏格兰的宗主权，引发长期战争，1298年在福尔柯克击败威廉·华莱士。1307年，他在北上征讨罗伯特·布鲁斯途中去世。

en: Edward II (1284–1327), Edward of Caernarfon, succeeded his father Edward I in 1307 and in 1308 married Isabella, daughter of Philip IV of France. Barons led by his cousin Thomas of Lancaster killed his favourite Piers Gaveston in 1312. In 1314 Robert the Bruce routed him at Bannockburn, ending English hopes in Scotland. He later ruled through the Despenser family and executed Lancaster in 1322. In 1326 Isabella and her lover Roger Mortimer invaded and forced him to abdicate in January 1327 in favour of his son Edward III. He died that year at Berkeley Castle, probably murdered on the orders of the new regime.
zh: 爱德华二世（1284—1327）又称卡那封的爱德华，1307年继承父亲爱德华一世的王位，1308年娶法兰西国王腓力四世之女伊莎贝拉为后。以表兄兰开斯特伯爵托马斯为首的贵族于1312年处死了他的宠臣皮尔斯·加韦斯顿。1314年，罗伯特·布鲁斯在班诺克本大败英军，粉碎了英格兰掌控苏格兰的企图。他后来倚仗德斯潘塞家族统治，于1322年处死兰开斯特。1326年，伊莎贝拉与情夫罗杰·莫蒂默起兵入侵，1327年1月迫使他让位给儿子爱德华三世。同年他死于伯克利城堡，可能是奉新政权之命遭谋杀。

en: Edward III (1312–1377) was crowned king of England at fourteen in 1327, after his mother Isabella and her ally Roger Mortimer forced his father Edward II from the throne. Mortimer then ruled in his name until October 1330, when Edward and a few trusted men, among them William Montagu, took him by surprise at Nottingham Castle and began the king's personal rule. He backed Edward Balliol's claim to Scotland and won at Halidon Hill in 1333. When Philip VI confiscated Gascony in 1337, Edward answered by claiming the French crown through his mother, opening the Hundred Years' War after creating six new earls to shore up the nobility. Victories at Sluys (1340) and Crécy (1346) and the capture of Calais (1347) led to the Treaty of Brétigny (1360), by which he gave up the French claim. He founded the Order of the Garter around 1348. War resumed in 1369, and by 1375 he had lost all his conquests but the Calais Pale. His eldest son, the Black Prince, died before him, and his grandson Richard II succeeded in 1377.
zh: 爱德华三世（1312—1377）于1327年十四岁时加冕为英格兰国王：此前，他的母亲伊莎贝拉与盟友罗杰·莫蒂默逼迫他的父亲爱德华二世退位。此后莫蒂默以他的名义当权，直到1330年10月，爱德华带着包括威廉·蒙塔古在内的少数亲信，在诺丁汉城堡出其不意地拿下莫蒂默，开始亲政。他支持爱德华·巴里奥对苏格兰王位的要求，1333年在哈利顿山取胜。1337年法王腓力六世没收加斯科涅，爱德华先册封六位新伯爵以稳住贵族，再以母系血统主张法国王位作为回应，百年战争由此开始。英军在斯勒伊斯（1340）和克雷西（1346）获胜，1347年攻取加来，最终促成1360年的《布雷蒂尼条约》，他也据此放弃了对法国王位的要求。约1348年，他创立了嘉德骑士团。1369年战争重启，到1375年，除加来周边地区外，他在法国征服的领地尽数丧失。长子黑太子先他去世，1377年由孙子理查二世继位。

en: Edward, 2nd Duke of York (c. 1373–1415), known as Edward of Norwich, was the eldest son of Edmund of Langley and a grandson of Edward III. Richard II made him Earl of Rutland in 1390 and appointed him admiral of the northern fleet in 1391. He accompanied Richard on campaign in Ireland in 1394–1395 and became Duke of Aumale in 1397, yet in 1399 he abandoned Richard for Henry Bolingbroke. A French chronicle credits him with revealing to Henry IV the Epiphany plot at Windsor in January 1400. He succeeded his father as Duke of York in 1402 and translated the hunting book The Master of Game. He died commanding the right wing at Agincourt in October 1415.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/第二代约克公爵诺里奇的爱德华
zh: 第二代约克公爵爱德华（约1373—1415），又称诺里奇的爱德华，是兰利的埃德蒙的长子、爱德华三世之孙。理查二世于1390年封他为拉特兰伯爵，1391年任命他为北方舰队司令。1394—1395年他随理查出征爱尔兰，1397年晋封奥马尔公爵；但1399年他背弃理查，转投亨利·博林布鲁克。一部法国编年史把1400年1月温莎主显节阴谋的告密之功记在他名下，称他向亨利四世揭发了这场图谋。1402年他承袭父爵成为约克公爵，还翻译了狩猎著作《狩猎能手》。1415年10月，他在阿金库尔战役中指挥右翼时战死。

en: Edward of Norfolk (c. 1313–1334), also called Edward of Brotherton, was the only son of Thomas of Brotherton, 1st Earl of Norfolk, and a grandson of Edward I. In 1328 at Hereford he married Beatrice Mortimer, daughter of Roger Mortimer, 1st Earl of March, in a double wedding attended by Edward III and Queen Isabella. The marriage produced no children. He died before 9 August 1334, predeceasing his father, so when Thomas of Brotherton died in 1338 the Norfolk earldom passed to Edward's elder sister Margaret.
zh: 诺福克的爱德华（约1313—1334），又称布拉泽顿的爱德华，是第一代诺福克伯爵托马斯·布拉泽顿的独子、爱德华一世之孙。1328年，他在赫里福德娶第一代马奇伯爵罗杰·莫蒂默之女比阿特丽斯·莫蒂默为妻，那是一场爱德华三世与伊莎贝拉王后均有出席的双重婚礼。两人没有子女。他于1334年8月9日之前去世，先于父亲而亡，因此1338年托马斯·布拉泽顿死后，诺福克伯爵爵位由他的姐姐玛格丽特继承。

en: Edward of Woodstock, the Black Prince (1330–1376), was the eldest son and heir of Edward III. Created Duke of Cornwall in 1337, the first dukedom in England, and Prince of Wales in 1343, he commanded the English vanguard at Crécy in 1346, aged sixteen. His chevauchées of 1355 and 1356 sacked Narbonne and ravaged Auvergne, Limousin and Berry, and at Poitiers in 1356 his army routed the French and captured King John II. English contemporaries saw him as a model of chivalry; French sources remember his brutality. He negotiated the Treaty of Brétigny in 1360 and ruled Aquitaine as prince from 1362. In 1367 he defeated Henry of Trastámara, the rival of Peter of Castile, at Nájera, but Peter never repaid the debt, and the hearth tax Edward secured in 1368 alienated Aquitanian nobles. In failing health he returned to England in 1371 and died on 8 June 1376; his son Richard II succeeded Edward III.
zh: 伍德斯托克的爱德华，即黑太子（1330—1376），是爱德华三世的长子和继承人。1337年他受封康沃尔公爵，这是英格兰的第一个公爵头衔；1343年受封威尔士亲王。1346年，十六岁的他在克雷西战役指挥英军前锋。1355年与1356年的骑兵劫掠战洗劫了纳博讷，蹂躏奥弗涅、利穆赞和贝里；1356年的普瓦捷战役中，他的军队击溃法军，俘获法王约翰二世。英格兰同时代人视他为骑士风范的典范，法国史料则记住了他的残酷。1360年他议定《布雷蒂尼条约》，1362年起以亲王身份统治阿基坦。1367年，他在纳赫拉战役击败卡斯蒂利亚国王佩德罗的对手特拉斯塔马拉的恩里克，但佩德罗始终未还债，爱德华于1368年争得的炉灶税又使阿基坦贵族离心。后来他身体抱恙，1371年返回英格兰，1376年6月8日病逝；其子理查二世继承了爱德华三世的王位。

en: Edward the Confessor (c. 1003 – 5 January 1066) ruled as king of the English from 1042, the son of Æthelred the Unready and Emma of Normandy. After spending much of his youth in Norman exile during the Danish conquest, he succeeded his half-brother Harthacnut, restoring the House of Wessex. His later reign saw the rise of Earl Godwin's family, who returned from exile in 1052. Edward rebuilt Westminster Abbey, and when he died childless in January 1066 Harold Godwinson took the throne, paving the way for the Norman Conquest. He was canonised in 1161.
zh: 忏悔者爱德华（约1003—1066年1月5日）是决策无方者埃塞尔雷德与诺曼底的爱玛之子，1042年起为英格兰人的国王。他年轻时在丹麦征服期间流亡诺曼底，后继承同母异父兄长哈德克努特的王位，恢复了威塞克斯王朝。他在位后期，戈德温伯爵家族于1052年结束流亡归来，势力日盛。爱德华重建了威斯敏斯特教堂，1066年1月无嗣而终，哈罗德·戈德温森继位，为诺曼征服铺平了道路。1161年他被教皇封圣。

en: Edward the Elder (c. 874 – 17 July 924), elder son of Alfred the Great, ruled as king of the Anglo-Saxons from 899. He first defeated a bid for the crown by his cousin Æthelwold, and in 910 a West Saxon and Mercian army crushed the Northumbrian Vikings. With his sister Æthelflæd, Lady of the Mercians, he then conquered Viking-held eastern and southern England, and in 918 he imposed direct rule on Mercia. After putting down a Mercian and Welsh revolt at Chester in 924, he died at Farndon and was succeeded by his son Æthelstan.
zh: 长者爱德华（约874—924年7月17日）是阿尔弗雷德大帝的长子，899年起任盎格鲁-撒克逊人的国王。他先挫败堂兄埃塞尔沃尔德争夺王位的图谋；910年，威塞克斯与麦西亚联军大破诺森伯里亚的维京人。此后他与姐姐、麦西亚女领主埃塞尔弗莱德联手攻取维京人占据的英格兰东部和南部，并于918年对麦西亚实行直接统治。924年他在切斯特平定麦西亚人与威尔士人的叛乱后，于法恩登去世，其子埃塞尔斯坦继位。

en: Edward, later called the Martyr (c. 962–978), was the eldest son of King Edgar and ruled the English from July 975. On Edgar's death his claim was disputed against his young half-brother Æthelred, but Archbishop Dunstan secured his succession. His short reign was dominated by an anti-monastic reaction, as nobles seized back lands granted to reformed monasteries. On 18 March 978 he was murdered at Corfe in Dorset while visiting Æthelred's household; later tradition blamed Æthelred's mother Ælfthryth. Buried first at Wareham, his body was translated to Shaftesbury Abbey in 979, and he was venerated as a saint.
zh: 爱德华，后称“殉教者”（约962—978），是国王埃德加的长子，975年7月起统治英格兰人。埃德加死后，他的继承权受到年幼异母弟埃塞尔雷德支持者的挑战，坎特伯雷大主教邓斯坦最终支持他继位。他短暂的统治笼罩在反修道院浪潮中，贵族们纷纷夺回被赠予改革派修道院的土地。978年3月18日，他在多塞特郡科夫拜访埃塞尔雷德的住处时遇害，后世传说归咎于埃塞尔雷德的母亲埃尔夫斯里斯。他先葬于韦勒姆，979年灵骸迁葬沙夫茨伯里修道院，被尊为圣徒。

en: Eleanor FitzAlan (c. 1284–1328) is recorded as a daughter of Richard FitzAlan, Earl of Arundel, and Alice of Saluzzo. She married Henry de Percy, 1st Baron Percy, and their son Henry succeeded as the 2nd Baron Percy.
zh: 埃莉诺·菲查伦（约1284—1328）被记载为阿伦德尔伯爵理查德·菲查伦与萨卢佐的爱丽丝之女。她嫁给第一代珀西男爵亨利·德·珀西，其子亨利后来袭封第二代珀西男爵。

en: Eleanor ‘Nell’ Gwyn (1650–1687) was one of the first actresses on the English stage and the best-known mistress of Charles II. Raised in a London slum, she sold oranges in the King's Company playhouse in Bridges Street before joining the company as an actress. Samuel Pepys praised her comic parts and called her ‘pretty, witty Nell’, and she won special acclaim in a breeches role in March 1667. She became the king's long-standing mistress and bore him two sons, Charles and James Beauclerk. Her elder son Charles was later made Earl of Burford and Duke of St Albans. Struck by two strokes in 1687, she died that November and was buried at St Martin-in-the-Fields.
zh: 埃莉诺·“奈尔”·圭恩（1650—1687）是英国舞台上最早的女演员之一，也是查理二世最著名的情妇。她自幼在伦敦贫民窟长大，先在国王剧团的布里奇斯街剧院卖橙子，随后登台演戏，塞缪尔·佩皮斯称赞她的喜剧表演，称她为“美丽机智的奈尔”；1667年3月她女扮男装的角色尤受好评。后来她成为查理二世的长期情妇，为他生下查尔斯·博克莱尔与詹姆斯·博克莱尔两个儿子。长子查尔斯后来受封伯福德伯爵和圣奥尔本斯公爵。1687年她两度中风，同年11月去世，葬于圣马田教堂。

en: Eleanor of Lancaster (1318–1372) was the fifth daughter of Henry, 3rd Earl of Lancaster, and Maud de Chaworth. In 1330 she married John de Beaumont, 2nd Baron Beaumont, killed at a tournament in 1342. As lady-in-waiting to Queen Philippa of Hainault she pilgrimaged to Santiago de Compostela in 1344. On 5 February 1345 she married Richard Fitzalan, 3rd Earl of Arundel, after the pope annulled his marriage; Edward III attended. Her children included the 4th Earl of Arundel and Thomas Arundel, Archbishop of Canterbury. Eleanor died on 11 January 1372 and was buried at Lewes Priory.
zh: 兰开斯特的埃莉诺（1318—1372）是第三代兰开斯特伯爵亨利与莫德·德·查沃斯的第五女。1330年，她嫁给第二代博蒙特男爵约翰·德·博蒙特，后者于1342年在一场骑士比武中丧生。作为埃诺的菲莉帕王后的侍女，她于1344年前往圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉朝圣。1345年2月5日，在教皇宣布理查德·菲茨艾伦的婚姻无效后，她嫁给第三代阿伦德尔伯爵理查德·菲茨艾伦，爱德华三世出席了婚礼。她的子女包括第四代阿伦德尔伯爵和坎特伯雷大主教托马斯·阿伦德尔。埃莉诺于1372年1月11日去世，葬于刘易斯小修道院。

en: Eleanor Percy was a daughter of Henry de Percy, 2nd Baron Percy, and Idonia Clifford. She married John FitzWalter, 2nd Baron FitzWalter, a turbulent Essex lord, and mothered his heir Walter. She died before him and was buried with him at Dunmow Priory.
zh: 埃莉诺·珀西是第二代珀西男爵亨利·德·珀西与伊多妮娅·克利福德之女，嫁给在埃塞克斯横行一时的第二代菲茨沃尔特男爵约翰·菲茨沃尔特，为他生下继承人沃尔特。她先于丈夫去世，与他合葬在邓莫修道院。

en: Eleanor de Warenne (1251–1282) was the daughter of John de Warenne, 6th Earl of Surrey, and Alice de Lusignan, half-sister of King Henry III. She married Sir Henry de Percy and was the mother of Henry de Percy, 1st Baron Percy of Alnwick.
zh: 埃莉诺·德瓦伦（1251—1282）是第六代萨里伯爵约翰·德瓦伦与亨利三世同母异父之妹爱丽丝·德·吕西尼昂的女儿，嫁与亨利·德珀西爵士，是第一代阿尼克的珀西男爵亨利·珀西之母。

en: Elizabeth Montagu (1325–1359), daughter of William Montagu, 1st Earl of Salisbury, was widowed by Giles, Lord Badlesmere, then married Hugh le Despenser, Baron le Despenser. After Hugh died in 1349 she wed Guy de Bryan, 1st Baron Bryan, and was buried at Tewkesbury Abbey.
zh: 伊丽莎白·蒙塔古（1325—1359年）是第一代索尔兹伯里伯爵威廉·蒙塔古之女。她先嫁巴德尔斯米尔男爵贾尔斯并守寡，后嫁勒德斯潘塞男爵休·勒德斯潘塞；1349年休死后，她再嫁第一代布莱恩男爵盖伊·德·布莱恩，葬于蒂克斯伯里修道院。

en: Elizabeth de Verdun (c. 1306–1360) was a daughter of Theobald de Verdun, 2nd Baron Verdun, and Maud Mortimer, and a co-heiress to her father's estates. She married Bartholomew Burghersh, 1st Baron Burghersh; their son Bartholomew Burghersh the younger succeeded his father as second baron.
zh: 伊丽莎白·德·凡尔登（约1306—1360）是第二代凡尔登男爵特奥巴尔德·德·凡尔登与莫德·莫蒂默之女，也是父亲领地的共同女继承人之一。她嫁给第一代伯格什男爵巴塞洛缪·伯格什，其子小巴塞洛缪·伯格什后来袭爵成为第二代男爵。

en: Elizabeth Montagu, née Robinson (1718–1800), was a British salon hostess, literary critic, writer and social reformer, born in Yorkshire. As a child she studied Latin, French, Italian and literature with her sister Sarah. In 1742 she married Edward Montagu, a wealthy Northumberland coal-owner, and used his fortune to patronise English and Scottish literature and relieve the poor. From the 1750s her London literary breakfasts, and after 1760 her evening assemblies where cards and strong drink were banned, formed the core of the Blue Stockings Society; by 1770 her Hill Street house was London's leading salon, gathering Samuel Johnson, Joshua Reynolds, Edmund Burke and David Garrick. She died in August 1800.
zh: 伊莉莎白·蒙塔古（1718—1800），本姓鲁宾逊，是英国沙龙女主人、文学评论家、作家与社会改革家，生于约克郡。她幼时与妹妹萨拉一起学习拉丁语、法语、意大利语和文学。1742年她嫁给拥有诺森伯兰大片煤矿的爱德华·蒙塔古，以其财富资助英格兰与苏格兰文学、赈济穷人。自1750年代起她在伦敦举办文学早餐会，1760年后改为禁止纸牌与烈酒的夜间聚会，成为蓝袜社的核心；到1770年，她在希尔街的宅邸已是伦敦首屈一指的沙龙，塞缪尔·约翰逊、约书亚·雷诺兹、埃德蒙·伯克与大卫·加里克皆是座上宾。1800年8月她去世。

en: Eleanor of Woodstock (18 June 1318–22 April 1355), an English princess and Countess of Guelders, was a daughter of Edward II and Isabella of France and a younger sister of Edward III. In May 1332 she married Reginald II, Count of Guelders. Legend records that in 1338 she was driven from court on a false charge of leprosy, only to disprove it at Nijmegen when her husband sought an annulment. After Reginald's death in October 1343 she ruled Guelders as regent for her young son Reginald III, but was forced from office the next year. She retired as Lady of Veluwe and died at Deventer in 1355.
zh: 伍德斯托克的埃莉诺（1318年6月18日—1355年4月22日）是英格兰公主、海尔德伯爵夫人，爱德华二世与法兰西的伊莎贝拉之女、爱德华三世的妹妹。1332年5月，她嫁给海尔德伯爵雷诺二世。相传1338年她被人以罹患麻风病的借口逐出宫廷，丈夫诉请废除婚姻时，她亲赴奈梅亨当庭证明自己无病。1343年10月雷诺去世后，她为年幼的儿子雷诺三世摄政海尔德，但次年即被迫去职。此后她以费吕沃领主夫人的身份退隐，1355年卒于代芬特尔。

en: Elizabeth Raffald, née Whitaker (1733–1781), was an English cookery writer and entrepreneur, born at Doncaster in Yorkshire and baptised on 8 July 1733. After fifteen years in service she became housekeeper at Arley Hall, Cheshire, then married the head gardener, John Raffald, in 1763 and settled in Manchester. There she ran a servants' register office, a cookery school and a confectionery business. In 1769 she published The Experienced English Housekeeper, with the earliest recognisable recipe for a modern wedding cake, and in 1772 issued Manchester's first trade directory, listing 1505 traders and civic leaders. The couple later ran post houses in Manchester and Salford. She died suddenly on 19 April 1781.
zh: 伊丽莎白·拉法尔德（本姓惠特克，1733—1781）是英国烹饪作家与女商人，生于约克郡的唐卡斯特，1733年7月8日受洗。她做了十五年家仆，最后在柴郡阿利府当女管家，1763年嫁给庄园首席园丁约翰·拉法尔德，随后定居曼彻斯特。她在那里经营佣工介绍所、烹饪学校和甜点生意。1769年她出版《经验丰富的英国家庭女管家》，书中收录了已知最早、已具备现代婚礼蛋糕形态的“新娘蛋糕”配方；1772年她又编印了曼彻斯特第一部商行名录，收录1505名商人与市政人士。夫妇二人后来在曼彻斯特和索尔福德经营驿站。1781年4月19日她猝然去世。

en: Elizabeth Woodville (c. 1437–1492) was queen of England as the wife of Edward IV. Her first husband, Lancastrian John Grey of Groby, died at the Second Battle of St Albans in 1461, leaving her with two sons. Her secret 1464 marriage to Edward IV—he married a subject, not a foreign princess—became a cause célèbre. The advancement of her relatives helped drive the Earl of Warwick to rebellion; in 1469 he had her father and brother executed. After Edward IV died in 1483, her son Edward V was deposed by Richard III and disappeared. Elizabeth helped secure Henry VII's accession in 1485. Her daughter Elizabeth of York married Henry in 1486, strengthening the Tudor dynasty.
