zh: 伊丽莎白·伍德维尔（约1437—1492）是英格兰国王爱德华四世的王后。她的第一任丈夫、兰开斯特派的格鲁比的约翰·格雷于1461年在第二次圣奥尔本斯战役中阵亡，给她留下两个儿子。1464年她与爱德华四世秘密成婚，国王迎娶臣民而非外国公主一事轰动一时。她的亲族得到提拔，促使沃里克伯爵起兵反叛；1469年，沃里克处决了她的父亲和兄弟。1483年爱德华四世去世后，她的儿子爱德华五世被理查三世废黜，随后下落不明。伊丽莎白助力亨利七世于1485年登上王位。她的女儿约克的伊丽莎白于1486年嫁给亨利，巩固了都铎王朝的统治。

en: Æthelred II, called the Unready (c. 968–1016), the younger son of King Edgar and Queen Ælfthryth, became king in March 978 after the murder of his half-brother Edward the Martyr. Viking raids resumed in the 980s, and after the defeat at Maldon in 991 he bought off the Danes with tribute. The St Brice's Day massacre of Danes in 1002 provoked retaliation, and in December 1013 Swein Forkbeard drove him into exile in Normandy. He returned in 1014 after Swein's death and died on 23 April 1016, leaving the war against Cnut to his son Edmund Ironside.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/决策无方者埃塞尔雷德
zh: 埃塞尔雷德二世，世称“决策无方者”（约968—1016），是国王埃德加与王后埃尔夫斯里斯的幼子，978年3月异母兄殉教者爱德华遇刺后登上王位。980年代维京人重启侵扰，991年莫尔登战败后，他以贡金收买丹麦人退兵。1002年的圣布赖斯日丹麦人大屠杀招致报复，1013年12月八字胡斯文将他逐往诺曼底流亡。1014年斯文死后他返回英格兰，1016年4月23日去世，对抗克努特的战争留给了儿子刚勇者埃德蒙。

en: Sir Francis Drake (c. 1540–1596) was a Devon-born seaman who became Elizabethan England's most famous privateer. He took part in early English slaving voyages with his cousin John Hawkins. In 1572 he led his first independent raid on the Spanish Main, and from 1577 to 1580 he commanded the Golden Hind on the second circumnavigation of the globe, claiming New Albion on the way; Elizabeth I knighted him aboard his ship in 1581. In 1585 he sacked Spanish ports in the Atlantic, and in 1588 he served as vice admiral and second-in-command against the Spanish Armada. In 1589 he led an unsuccessful expedition against the remaining Spanish fleet. He died of dysentery after a failed attack on Panama in January 1596.
zh: 弗朗西斯·德雷克爵士（约1540—1596）生于德文郡，由普通海员成长为伊丽莎白时代英格兰最著名的私掠船长。他曾与表亲约翰·霍金斯参加英格兰早期的贩奴航行。1572年他首次率队独立劫掠西班牙大陆沿岸；1577至1580年指挥“金鹿号”完成人类第二次环球航行，途中宣称新阿尔比恩为英格兰所有，1581年伊丽莎白一世在他的船上封他为爵士。1585年他洗劫大西洋沿岸的西班牙港口，1588年以副舰队司令、英军副统帅身份迎战西班牙无敌舰队。1589年他率军远征西班牙残余舰队，但未能成功。1596年1月他在攻打巴拿马失败后死于痢疾。

en: Sir Francis Walsingham (c. 1532–1590) was Queen Elizabeth I's principal secretary from 1573 until his death, her spymaster. A committed Protestant, he went into exile in Switzerland and Italy under Mary I, then served as English ambassador in Paris, where he witnessed the St Bartholomew's Day massacre of 1572. As secretary he built a network of agents across Europe that penetrated Spanish preparations for the Armada, exposed the Babington Plot against Elizabeth and gathered the evidence that sent Mary, Queen of Scots to the block in 1587. He also backed Drake's voyages and colonisation, supported the development of the English navy and worked to bring England and Scotland closer together. He died in 1590.
zh: 弗朗西斯·沃尔辛厄姆爵士（约1532—1590）自1573年起担任伊丽莎白一世的首席秘书，直至去世，素有女王“谍报首脑”之称。他是虔诚的新教徒，玛丽一世朝流亡瑞士和意大利，后任英格兰驻巴黎大使，亲历1572年圣巴多罗买大屠杀。任内他在欧洲各地布下密探网络，刺探西班牙无敌舰队的备战动向，揭破针对伊丽莎白的巴宾顿阴谋，并取得证据促使苏格兰女王玛丽于1587年被斩首处死。他还资助德雷克远航和海外殖民，支持发展英格兰海军，致力于推动英格兰与苏格兰接近。1590年他去世。

en: Geoffrey Chaucer (c. 1343–1400), son of a London vintner, was a royal servant and the leading English poet of the Middle Ages. Captured on Edward III's French campaign in 1360, he was ransomed by the king and became a courtier and diplomat: he visited Italy in 1373 and 1378, ran London customs from 1374, sat in Parliament for Kent in 1386, and was Clerk of the King's Works in 1389–1391. His works included Troilus and Criseyde and the Canterbury Tales, begun in the early 1380s. His writing helped establish Middle English as a literary language when French and Latin dominated. He died on 25 October 1400 and was buried in Westminster Abbey; his remains were later moved to what became Poets' Corner.
zh: 杰弗里·乔叟（约1343—1400）是伦敦酒商之子，在王室任职，也是中世纪最重要的英语诗人。1360年他随爱德华三世征法时被俘，由国王出资赎回，后来成为廷臣与外交官：1373年和1378年两度出使意大利，1374年起掌管伦敦关税，1386年代表肯特郡出席议会，1389至1391年任国王工程书记官。他的作品包括《特洛伊罗斯与克丽西德》和始于1380年代初的《坎特伯雷故事集》。在法语和拉丁语主导文坛的时代，他的创作帮助中古英语确立了文学语言的地位。他于1400年10月25日去世，葬于威斯敏斯特教堂；他的遗骨后来迁至日后的诗人角。

en: Sir Gilbert Stapleton (died 1321) was a Yorkshire knight who married Agnes, coheir of Lord Fitzalan of Bedale, and fathered two Knights of the Garter, Miles and Bryan Stapleton.
zh: 吉尔伯特·斯特普尔顿爵士（卒于1321年）是约克郡骑士，娶比代尔领主菲茨艾伦的女继承人阿格尼丝，生有迈尔斯与布莱恩两位嘉德骑士。

en: George del Vasto was a son of Thomas I, Marquess of Saluzzo, and Luisa di Ceva. He became a monk, like his brother Boniface, and was still alive after 1349.
zh: 乔治·德尔·瓦斯托是萨卢佐侯爵托马斯一世与切瓦的路易莎之子。他和兄弟博尼法乔一样成为修士，1349年以后仍有在世记录。

en: Sir Godfrey Kneller (1646–1723), born Gottfried Kniller in Lübeck, was the leading portrait painter in England under the later Stuarts and George I. After studying under Ferdinand Bol and Rembrandt in Amsterdam and working in Rome and Venice, he settled in London in 1676 and painted Charles II; after Peter Lely died in 1680 he became Principal Painter in Ordinary alongside John Riley. His studio produced portraits on a vast scale, using sketches of faces and a formula for the remaining details. His Hampton Court Beauties of 1690–1691 earned him a knighthood in 1692; he later painted the forty-eight Kit-Cat Club portraits, headed the Kneller Academy of Painting and Drawing in 1711–1716 and was created a baronet in 1715.
zh: 戈弗雷·内勒爵士（1646—1723）生于吕贝克，原名戈特弗里德·克内勒，是斯图亚特王朝后期至乔治一世时期英国首屈一指的肖像画家。他曾在阿姆斯特丹师从费迪南德·博尔与伦勃朗，又在罗马、威尼斯作画，1676年定居伦敦并为查理二世画像；1680年彼得·莱利去世后，他与约翰·赖利共同出任首席宫廷画师。他的画室以面部速写配合程式化的其他细节，大规模制作肖像。1690至1691年他绘制《汉普顿宫美女图》，1692年因此受封骑士，后来又创作四十八幅基特—卡特俱乐部成员肖像，1711至1716年主持内勒绘画学院，并于1715年获封从男爵。

en: William le Gros, or William of Aumale (died 20 August 1179), was Count of Aumale and Earl of York, the eldest son of Count Stephen of Aumale and Hawise de Mortimer. He fought for King Stephen at the Battle of the Standard in 1138 and was made Earl of York, then shared the king's defeat at Lincoln in 1141. He founded Thornton Abbey in 1139 and Meaux Abbey in 1150. Henry II seized his Scarborough Castle, built without permission during the Anarchy. His wife Cicely, Lady of Skipton, brought him extensive estates at Harewood. He left a daughter, Hawise, who inherited Aumale, and was buried at Thornton Abbey.
zh: 威廉·勒格罗，又称欧马勒的威廉（1179年8月20日卒），身兼欧马勒伯爵与约克伯爵，是欧马勒伯爵斯蒂芬与哈维丝·德·莫蒂默的长子。1138年他在军旗之战中为斯蒂芬国王作战，受封约克伯爵，1141年又随国王在林肯战败。他于1139年创建桑顿修道院，1150年创建莫修道院。亨利二世没收了他在无政府时期未经许可修建的斯卡伯勒城堡。妻子斯基普顿女领主塞西莉为他带来哈伍德的大片地产。他留下女儿哈维丝，由她继承欧马勒；他本人葬于桑顿修道院。

en: Guy I of Thouars (1183–1242) was a Poitevin nobleman of the house of Thouars, the second son of Viscount Aimery VII. He became lord of Vihiers in 1227 and in 1234 succeeded his uncle Raymond I as the twenty-first viscount of Thouars. In the struggles between the English and French crowns in western France, Guy stayed loyal to Henry III of England, whom he supported in Poitou. He died at the beginning of April 1242, as Hugh X of Lusignan, count of La Marche, rose in revolt against Capetian rule, and was succeeded by his brother Aimery VIII.
zh: 图阿尔的居伊一世（1183—1242）是13世纪上半叶的普瓦图贵族，出自图阿尔家族，为图阿尔子爵艾默里七世的次子。他于1227年成为维耶领主，1234年继叔父雷蒙一世之后任第二十一任图阿尔子爵。在英、法两国王室于法兰西西部的争夺中，居伊始终效忠英格兰国王亨利三世，在普瓦图支持英王。1242年4月初，拉马什伯爵于格十世·德·吕西尼昂起兵反叛卡佩王朝，居伊在叛乱爆发之际去世，其弟艾默里八世继任子爵。

en: Hans Holbein the Younger (c. 1497–1543) was a German painter and printmaker, born in Augsburg and trained in Basel, where his portraits of Erasmus made his name. He designed book illustrations for the printer Johann Froben and, as the Reformation reached Basel, worked for both reformist and traditional religious patrons. He first reached England in 1526 with Erasmus's recommendation and worked in Thomas More's humanist circle, then settled there from 1532 under the patronage of Anne Boleyn and Thomas Cromwell. By 1535 he was King's Painter to Henry VIII, portraying the court and designing royal jewellery, plate and festival decorations. He died in London late in 1543, leaving the defining image of the Tudor age.
zh: 小汉斯·霍尔拜因（约1497—1543）是德国画家与版画家，生于奥格斯堡，在巴塞尔学艺，为伊拉斯谟绘制的肖像令他声名远播。他为印刷商约翰·弗罗本设计书籍插图；宗教改革传到巴塞尔后，他既为改革派委托人工作，也继续为传统宗教赞助人效力。1526年，他持伊拉斯谟的推荐信首次前往英格兰，进入托马斯·莫尔的人文主义圈子；1532年起在安妮·博林与托马斯·克伦威尔的庇护下定居英格兰。1535年，他已成为亨利八世的御前画师，为宫廷人物绘制肖像，并设计王室珠宝、金银器与节庆装饰。1543年末，他在伦敦去世，为都铎时代留下了最具代表性的图像记录。

en: Harold Godwinson (c. 1022–1066), son of Earl Godwin of Wessex, became the most powerful noble in England and succeeded his childless brother-in-law Edward the Confessor, being crowned king on 6 January 1066. His reign opened with invasion: his exiled brother Tostig joined Harald Hardrada of Norway, whom Harold defeated and killed at Stamford Bridge near York on 25 September 1066 after a forced march north. He then hurried south to face William of Normandy, who had landed in Sussex, and fell at the Battle of Hastings on 14 October, the last crowned Anglo-Saxon king of England.
zh: 哈罗德·戈德温森（约1022—1066）是威塞克斯伯爵戈德温之子，后成为英格兰最有权势的贵族；无嗣的内兄爱德华忏悔者去世后，他于1066年1月6日加冕为英格兰国王。他即位之初便遭遇入侵：流亡的弟弟托斯蒂格联合挪威国王哈拉尔·哈德拉达来犯，哈罗德急行军北上，于9月25日在约克附近的斯坦福桥战役中将其击败击杀。随后他火速南下，迎战登陆萨塞克斯的诺曼底公爵威廉，于10月14日在黑斯廷斯战役中阵亡，是最后一位加冕的盎格鲁—撒克逊英格兰国王。

en: Harold I, called Harefoot (c. 1016–1040), was a son of Cnut the Great by Ælfgifu of Northampton. When Cnut died in 1035 he became regent for his half-brother Harthacnut, detained in Denmark, ruling north of the Thames. In 1036 the returning ætheling Alfred was seized, blinded and killed at Ely by Harold's followers. Backed by Earl Leofric, Harold was proclaimed king at Oxford in 1037, while Queen Emma was driven into exile in Flanders. He died at Oxford on 17 March 1040; Harthacnut succeeded him and had his body dug up and thrown into a fen.
zh: 哈罗德一世，绰号“飞毛腿”（约1016—1040），是克努特大帝与北安普顿的艾尔弗吉夫之子。1035年克努特去世后，他成为摄政，替留在丹麦的异母弟哈德克努特理政，统治泰晤士河以北地区。1036年，归国的王子艾尔弗雷德被哈罗德的手下俘获、弄瞎，最终死在伊利。在利奥弗里克伯爵支持下，哈罗德于1037年在牛津被拥立为王，王后爱玛则被放逐到佛兰德。1040年3月17日他死于牛津，哈德克努特继位后将他的遗体掘出扔进沼泽。

en: Harthacnut (c. 1018–1042), son of Cnut the Great and Emma of Normandy, became king of Denmark in 1035. Detained in Denmark, he saw England pass to his half-brother Harold Harefoot, but in 1039 he gathered a fleet at Bruges with his mother and, after Harold's death in March 1040, returned to England as king. He had Harold's body thrown into a fen, and a heavy fleet tax caused a rising at Worcester in 1041. On 8 June 1042 he collapsed and died while drinking at a wedding, the last Dane to rule England; Edward the Confessor succeeded him.
zh: 哈德克努特（约1018—1042）是克努特大帝与诺曼底的爱玛之子，1035年成为丹麦国王。由于羁留丹麦，他眼看英格兰落入异母兄飞毛腿哈罗德之手；但1039年他与母亲爱玛在布鲁日集结舰队，并于1040年3月哈罗德死后返回英格兰称王。他下令把哈罗德的遗体扔进沼泽，又因征收沉重的舰队税在1041年激起伍斯特起事。1042年6月8日，他在婚宴上饮酒时猝然倒地身亡，是统治英格兰的最后一位丹麦人；忏悔者爱德华继他为王。

en: Hawise (c. 1160 – 1214) was ruling Countess of Aumale, the daughter and heiress of William le Gros. In January 1180 she married William de Mandeville, 3rd Earl of Essex, who held Aumale until his death in 1189. Richard I then gave the wealthy widow to the Poitevin crusader William de Forz, a match she opposed. They had an heir, William de Forz, later Earl of Albemarle; after her husband died in 1195, she supported their son. Her third husband was Baldwin de Béthune. After Philip Augustus seized Aumale in 1196 and Baldwin died in 1212, she agreed to pay King John five thousand marks for her inheritance and dower lands and to avoid a forced marriage. She died in March 1214.
zh: 哈维丝（约1160—1214）是欧马勒女伯爵，威廉·勒格罗的女儿和继承人。1180年1月，她嫁给第三代埃塞克斯伯爵威廉·德·曼德维尔，后者在1189年去世前一直执掌欧马勒。随后理查一世将这位富有的寡妇改嫁给普瓦图出身的十字军军人威廉·德·福尔兹，她曾反对这门婚事。两人生下继承人威廉·德·福尔兹，即后来的阿尔伯马尔伯爵；丈夫于1195年去世后，她支持儿子。她的第三任丈夫是博杜安·德·贝蒂讷。1196年腓力·奥古斯特夺取欧马勒，1212年博杜安去世后，她同意向约翰王缴纳五千马克，以保有继承地产和寡妇份地，并免遭强迫改嫁。她于1214年3月去世。

en: Henry of Grosmont (c. 1310–1361), only son of Henry, 3rd Earl of Lancaster, and Maud Chaworth, was Edward III's leading captain in the early Hundred Years' War. Knighted in 1327 and created Earl of Derby in 1337, he won a striking victory over the French at Auberoche in Gascony in 1345. He was a founding knight of the Order of the Garter in 1348 and in 1351 became Duke of Lancaster. He wrote the devotional treatise Livre de Seyntz Medicines and died in March 1361, leaving daughters Maud and Blanche.
zh: 格罗斯蒙特的亨利（约1310—1361）是第三代兰开斯特伯爵亨利与莫德·德·查沃思唯一的儿子，也是百年战争初期爱德华三世麾下最得力的统帅。他1327年受封骑士，1337年受封德比伯爵，1345年在加斯科涅的欧贝罗什战役大败法军。1348年他成为嘉德骑士团的创始骑士之一，1351年受封兰开斯特公爵。他著有虔诚灵修著作《圣药书》，1361年3月去世，留下莫德和布兰奇两个女儿。

en: Henry Hudson (c. 1565–disappeared 1611) was an English navigator who in 1607 and 1608 twice sought a Northeast Passage above Russia for English merchants. In 1609, sailing for the Dutch East India Company in the Halve Maen, he crossed the Atlantic and sailed up the river later named after him past Manhattan, opening it to Dutch settlement. On his final expedition, seeking a Northwest Passage, he became the first European to see Hudson Strait and Hudson Bay. After wintering in James Bay, Hudson wanted to continue west, but the crew mutinied in June 1611 and cast him, his son and six others adrift in an open boat; they vanished without trace.
zh: 亨利·哈得孙（约1565—1611年失踪）是英格兰航海家，1607和1608年两度受英格兰商人派遣，试图开辟绕过俄罗斯北方的东北航道。1609年他受雇于荷兰东印度公司，驾“半月号”横渡大西洋，沿后来以他命名的哈得孙河上溯，经过今纽约所在地，为荷兰人在这一地区的殖民开辟了道路。最后一次航行中，他寻找西北航道，成为第一个见到哈得孙海峡和哈得孙湾的欧洲人。船队在詹姆斯湾过冬后，哈得孙想继续向西，但船员于1611年6月哗变，把他和儿子及另外六人放到一条敞篷船上任其漂流，他们从此下落不明。

en: Henry I, called Beauclerc (c. 1068 – 1 December 1135), fourth son of William the Conqueror, seized the crown in 1100 after William Rufus died hunting, and married Matilda of Scotland. When Robert Curthose invaded England in 1101, Henry answered by conquering Normandy, capturing Robert at Tinchebray in 1106; he defeated Louis VI at Brémule in 1119. He strengthened royal justice and the exchequer, but his only legitimate son William died in the White Ship wreck of 1120. Henry named his daughter Matilda his heir, yet on his death in 1135 his nephew Stephen took the crown, bringing on the Anarchy.
zh: 亨利一世（绰号博克莱尔，约1068年—1135年12月1日）是征服者威廉的第四子，1100年威廉·鲁弗斯狩猎身亡后夺取王位，并娶苏格兰的玛蒂尔达为妻。1101年罗贝尔·柯索斯入侵英格兰，亨利反攻取诺曼底，1106年在坦什布赖俘获罗贝尔，1119年在布雷穆勒击败法王路易六世。他整顿王室司法与财政署，但唯一的合法儿子威廉于1120年白船海难中溺亡。亨利立女儿玛蒂尔达为继承人，然而他1135年去世后，外甥斯蒂芬夺取王位，引发史称“无政府时期”的内战。

en: Henry II (1133–1189), eldest son of Geoffrey of Anjou and Empress Matilda, was recognised as heir to Stephen of Blois by the Treaty of Wallingford in 1153 and inherited the crown in 1154. Through his marriage to Eleanor of Aquitaine he ruled the Angevin Empire: England, Normandy, Anjou and Aquitaine. His legal reforms laid the basis of Common Law, while his quarrel with Archbishop Thomas Becket ended in Becket's murder in 1170. His wife and sons' great revolt began in 1173 and was crushed the following year, but in 1189 Richard and Philip II of France defeated him; he died at Chinon.
zh: 亨利二世（1133—1189）是安茹的若弗鲁瓦与玛蒂尔达皇后的长子，1153年依据《沃林福德条约》被英格兰国王斯蒂芬承认为继承人，1154年继位。他凭借与阿基坦的埃莉诺的婚姻，统治安茹帝国：英格兰、诺曼底、安茹和阿基坦。他推行的司法改革奠定了英格兰普通法的基础，而他与坎特伯雷大主教托马斯·贝克特的冲突以1170年贝克特遇刺告终。妻子和儿子们于1173年发动大叛乱，次年被他平定；但1189年他被理查与法兰西国王腓力二世联军击败，死于希农。

en: Henry III (1207–1272), son of King John, became king in 1216 during the First Barons' War; William Marshal's victory at Lincoln in 1217 secured his crown. He married Eleanor of Provence and rebuilt Westminster Abbey honouring Edward the Confessor. Defeat at Taillebourg in 1242 ended his attempts to reconquer the French lands. In 1258 barons led by Simon de Montfort imposed the Provisions of Oxford; Henry was captured at Lewes in 1264, but his son Edward freed him after victory at Evesham in 1265. He died in 1272.
zh: 亨利三世（1207—1272）是约翰国王之子，1216年第一次男爵战争期间即位；1217年威廉·马歇尔在林肯取胜，保住了他的王位。他娶普罗旺斯的埃莉诺为后，为纪念忏悔者爱德华而重建威斯敏斯特教堂。1242年塔耶堡之败终结了他收复法兰西失地的尝试。1258年，以西蒙·德·孟福尔为首的贵族迫使他接受《牛津条例》；1264年他在刘易斯被俘，其子爱德华在1265年伊夫舍姆获胜后将他救出。他于1272年去世。

en: Henry, 3rd Earl of Lancaster (c. 1281–1345), younger son of Edmund Crouchback, was summoned to Parliament in 1299 and took part in the siege of Caerlaverock in 1300. When his brother Earl Thomas was executed in 1322, he recovered Leicester in 1324 and Lancaster in 1327. In 1326 he joined Queen Isabella's invasion, captured Edward II near Neath and guarded him at Kenilworth, and in 1330 helped Edward III overthrow Mortimer. Blind from about 1330, he retired to Leicester, founded the Newarke hospital, and died on 22 September 1345, succeeded by his son Henry of Grosmont.
zh: 第三代兰开斯特伯爵亨利（约1281—1345）是埃德蒙·克劳奇贝克较年幼的儿子。1299年他奉召出席议会，1300年参加凯莱弗罗克城堡围城战。兄长托马斯伯爵于1322年被处死后，他于1324年收回莱斯特伯爵领，1327年收回兰开斯特伯爵领。1326年，他加入伊莎贝拉王后的入侵行动，在尼思附近擒获爱德华二世，并将其看押在凯尼尔沃思；1330年又协助爱德华三世推翻莫蒂默。约1330年他双目失明，退居莱斯特，创立纽瓦克济贫院，1345年9月22日去世，由儿子亨利·格罗斯蒙特继位。

en: Henry de Percy, 1st Baron Percy of Alnwick (1273–1314), was an English magnate who fought for Edward I in Wales and Scotland, earning large Scottish grants that Robert Bruce later reconquered. He acquired Alnwick Castle in Northumberland, making the Percys a dynasty of northern warlords. He married Eleanor FitzAlan, daughter of the Earl of Arundel, and they had two sons, Henry and William. Under Edward II he joined the barons against the king's favourite Piers Gaveston and was imprisoned for months. After his release he refused to serve at Bannockburn in 1314, remaining at Alnwick. He died there that October, leaving Henry to succeed him as 2nd baron.
zh: 阿尼克的第一代珀西男爵亨利·德·珀西（1273—1314）是英格兰大贵族，曾随爱德华一世征战威尔士和苏格兰，获封大片苏格兰土地，后被罗伯特·布鲁斯夺回。他购得诺森伯兰的阿尼克城堡，使珀西家族成为镇守北方的军阀世家。他娶阿伦德尔伯爵之女埃莉诺·菲查伦为妻，两人育有亨利和威廉两个儿子。爱德华二世在位时，他联合贵族反对国王的宠臣皮尔斯·加韦斯顿，被囚禁数月。获释后，他拒绝赴1314年的班诺克本战役，留在阿尼克，同年10月在此去世，其子亨利继任第二代男爵。

en: Henry Percy, 2nd Baron Percy (1301–1352), was thirteen when his father died in 1314 and left him the Alnwick barony, which the Crown first placed in the custody of John de Felton. In 1316 Edward II granted him the Earl of March's lands in Northumberland, and in 1322 made him governor of Pickering and Scarborough castles. He joined the barons who removed the king's favourites, the Despensers. After a disastrous war with the Scots, he and William Zouche negotiated the Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton, so unpopular in England that the peace lasted only five years. A member of Edward III's council from 1327, he received Skipton and then Warkworth Castle in 1328. He fought at Halidon Hill and the sieges of Dunbar and Berwick, and at Neville's Cross in 1346 commanded the English right wing. He married Idonia Clifford and was buried at Alnwick in 1352.
zh: 第二代珀西男爵亨利·珀西（1301—1352）十三岁时父亲去世，他于1314年继承阿尼克男爵领地，领地起初由王室交给约翰·德·费尔顿代管。1316年，爱德华二世赐予他马奇伯爵在诺森伯兰的土地，1322年又任命他为皮克林和斯卡伯勒城堡守官。他参加了贵族们除去国王宠臣德斯潘塞父子的行动。对苏格兰的战争惨败后，他与威廉·祖什一同出面谈判，签订《爱丁堡—北安普顿条约》；这份条约在英格兰极不得人心，和平只维持了五年。1327年他进入爱德华三世的议事会，获赐斯基普顿，1328年又得沃克沃思城堡。他先后在哈利登山战役及邓巴、特威德河畔贝里克围城战中作战，1346年在内维尔十字战役中指挥英军右翼。他娶伊多妮娅·克利福德为妻，1352年去世后葬于阿尼克。

en: Henry Percy, 3rd Baron Percy of Alnwick (c. 1321–1368), eldest son of the 2nd Baron and Idonia Clifford, was the father of two earls. He married Mary of Lancaster, daughter of Henry, 3rd Earl of Lancaster, and their sons were Henry, later 1st Earl of Northumberland, and Thomas, later 1st Earl of Worcester. After Mary died in 1362 he married Joan, daughter and sole heiress of John, Lord Orreby; their son died in his father's lifetime, and their daughter Mary (1367–1394) married John de Ros, 5th Baron de Ros. He served as High Sheriff of Northumberland and died around 18 May 1368, probably at Alnwick Castle, and was buried in Alnwick Abbey. His eldest son Henry succeeded him.
zh: 第三代阿尼克珀西男爵亨利·珀西（约1321—1368）是第二代男爵与伊多妮娅·克利福德的长子，也是两位伯爵的父亲。他娶第三代兰开斯特伯爵亨利之女、兰开斯特的玛丽为妻，两人的儿子是后来的第一代诺森伯兰伯爵亨利和第一代伍斯特伯爵托马斯。玛丽于1362年去世后，他续娶奥迪比勋爵约翰的独生女兼继承人琼；两人之子先于父亲去世，女儿玛丽（1367—1394）嫁给第五代德·罗斯男爵约翰·德·罗斯。他曾任诺森伯兰郡高等治安官，约于1368年5月18日去世，地点可能是阿尼克城堡，葬于阿尼克修道院，长子亨利继位。

en: Sir Henry de Percy (c. 1235 – 29 August 1272), eldest son of William de Percy and Elena de Balliol, offered £900 in 1249 for his father's lands and the right to marry, and was knighted by 1257, when he served Henry III in Wales. In the Second Barons' War he fought at Northampton in April 1264, defended Rochester Castle and was captured at Lewes in May, remaining a prisoner until Evesham in August 1265. In September 1268 he married Eleanor de Warenne, daughter of the Earl of Surrey and Alice de Lusignan. He died in 1272; his posthumous son became 1st Baron Percy.
zh: 亨利·德·珀西爵士（约1235年—1272年8月29日）是威廉·德·珀西与埃琳娜·德·巴利奥尔的长子。1249年，他出价900英镑以取得父亲的领地及婚姻权，1257年前已受封骑士，同年随亨利三世在威尔士作战。第二次男爵战争中，他于1264年4月参加北安普敦之战，随后守卫罗切斯特城堡，5月在刘易斯被俘，一直囚禁到1265年8月伊夫舍姆战役之后。1268年9月，他娶萨里伯爵与艾丽斯·德·吕西尼昂之女埃莉诺·德·瓦伦为妻。他于1272年去世，遗腹子后来成为第一代珀西男爵。

en: Henry Stafford, 2nd Duke of Buckingham (1455–1483), inherited the dukedom in 1460 at the age of four after his grandfather died at Northampton. In 1466 he married Katherine Woodville, sister of Edward IV's queen. In 1483 he supported the Duke of Gloucester's seizure of the crown as Richard III, displacing Edward's sons, but within months turned against him. With Margaret Beaufort and John Morton he raised a simultaneous rising across southern England and Wales in Henry Tudor's name; he gathered men from his Welsh and border estates, but flooding of the Severn scattered his army, and a retainer betrayed him near Wem. Richard III had him beheaded at Salisbury without trial on 2 November 1483. The plot is remembered as Buckingham's Rebellion.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/第二代白金汉公爵亨利·斯塔福德
zh: 第二代白金汉公爵亨利·斯塔福德（1455—1483）四岁时因祖父在北安普顿战死，于1460年袭封公爵。1466年他迎娶爱德华四世王后的妹妹凯瑟琳·伍德维尔。1483年他支持格洛斯特公爵取代爱德华的儿子夺取王位，是为理查三世，但不出数月便与之反目。他联合玛格丽特·博福特和约翰·莫顿，以亨利·都铎的名义在英格兰南部和威尔士同时举兵；他从威尔士及边境领地召集人马，却被塞文河洪水冲散军队，又在韦姆附近被随从出卖。1483年11月2日，理查三世未经审判便将他在索尔兹伯里斩首。这场举事史称白金汉叛乱。

en: Henry VII (1457–1509), born Henry Tudor at Pembroke Castle, founded the House of Tudor. After the Lancastrian defeat of 1471 he spent fourteen years exiled in Brittany. In August 1485 he landed in Wales and defeated Richard III, who was killed at Bosworth Field, claiming the crown on the battlefield. In 1486 he married Elizabeth of York, uniting Lancaster and York, and secured his reign by victory at Stoke Field in 1487, ending the Wars of the Roses. He used bonds to secure the loyalty of nobles and raised new taxes to restore the monarchy's finances and authority. He died in 1509, leaving the throne peacefully to his son Henry VIII.
zh: 亨利七世（1457—1509）生于彭布罗克城堡，原名亨利·都铎，是都铎王朝的开国君主。1471年兰开斯特一方战败后，他在布列塔尼流亡十四年。1485年8月他在威尔士登陆，于博斯沃思原野之战击败理查三世，理查战死，亨利在战场上取得王位。1486年他迎娶约克的伊丽莎白，使兰开斯特与约克两大家族合流，1487年又在斯托克原野之战取胜，结束玫瑰战争。他以保证金约束贵族的忠诚，增设税收以整顿财政、重振王权，1509年去世，将王位安稳传给儿子亨利八世。

en: Henry Yevele (c. 1320–1400) was England's royal master mason from 1360 until his death, serving Edward III and Richard II. He was probably born in Derbyshire to Roger and Marion Yevele; his father may have been a mason who taught him the trade. He refaced Westminster Hall at the Palace of Westminster and built the Bloody Tower at the Tower of London. His greatest surviving works are the naves of Westminster Abbey, begun in 1362, and Canterbury Cathedral, built from 1377 in an early Perpendicular Gothic style and finished only in 1400. He died that year and was buried at St Magnus the Martyr by London Bridge.
zh: 亨利·伊夫利（约1320—1400）自1360年起担任英格兰王家石匠大师，直至去世，历仕爱德华三世与理查二世。他可能出生于德比郡，父母是罗杰与玛丽昂·伊夫利；其父可能也是石匠，并将手艺传授给他。他主持重修威斯敏斯特宫的威斯敏斯特厅，并建造了伦敦塔的血腥塔。他存世最重要的作品是1362年动工的威斯敏斯特教堂中殿，以及1377年起以早期垂直哥特风格建造、1400年才完工的坎特伯雷大教堂中殿。他于1400年去世，葬在伦敦桥畔的殉道者圣马格努斯教堂。

en: Thomas Hobbes (1588–1679) was an English political philosopher born in Wiltshire. From 1608 he served the Cavendish family as tutor and secretary, meeting Galileo in 1636. During the English Civil War he lived in exile in Paris, where he published De Cive in 1642, taught mathematics to the future Charles II in 1647 and completed Leviathan (1651). The civil war helped shape his argument that men in a state of nature face a war of all against all, and need an absolute sovereign under a social contract. The book angered exiled royalists and clerics, and Hobbes returned to London in 1651. He died at Hardwick Hall in 1679.
zh: 托马斯·霍布斯（1588—1679）是生于威尔特郡的英格兰政治哲学家。自1608年起，他以教师和秘书身份侍奉卡文迪许家族，1636年会见过伽利略。英国内战期间他流亡巴黎，1642年在那里出版《论公民》，1647年为后来的查理二世讲授数学，并完成了1651年出版的《利维坦》。内战促使他在书中提出，自然状态中的人面临一切人反对一切人的战争，需要通过社会契约服从一位绝对主权者。此书触怒了流亡的王党和教士，霍布斯遂于1651年返回伦敦，1679年在哈德威克庄园去世。

en: Horatio Nelson (1758–1805) was a British admiral, born at Burnham Thorpe in Norfolk. He joined the Royal Navy in 1771 through his uncle Maurice Suckling and received his first command in 1778. Britain's entry into the French Revolutionary Wars returned him to active service in 1793. He partially lost the sight in his right eye at Corsica in 1794, distinguished himself at Cape St. Vincent in 1797 and lost his right arm at Tenerife that year. He annihilated the French fleet at the Nile in 1798 and defeated the Danes at Copenhagen in 1801. In 1805 he took command of the fleet blockading Cádiz. At Trafalgar on 21 October he crushed the combined Franco-Spanish fleet, but was mortally wounded aboard HMS Victory.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/第一代纳尔逊子爵霍雷肖·纳尔逊
zh: 霍雷肖·纳尔逊（1758—1805）是英国海军将领，生于诺福克郡的伯纳姆索普。1771年他靠舅父莫里斯·萨克林的关系加入皇家海军，1778年首次获得指挥权。1793年英国加入法国革命战争，他重返现役。1794年他在科西嘉作战时右眼视力部分丧失，1797年在圣文森特角立功，同年在特内里费失去右臂。1798年他在尼罗河河口海战中歼灭法国舰队，1801年在哥本哈根击败丹麦舰队。1805年他接掌封锁加的斯的舰队。10月21日，他在特拉法尔加海战击溃法西联合舰队，却在“胜利号”上阵亡。

en: Hugh le Despenser (c. 1308–1349), Lord of Glamorgan, was the son of Hugh Despenser the Younger and Eleanor de Clare. From 1326 he held Caerphilly Castle for the fugitive Edward II against Queen Isabella's forces, surrendering in 1327 on promise of his life, and remained imprisoned until 1331. Restored to favour under Edward III, he inherited Glamorgan in 1337, campaigned in Scotland, and was summoned to Parliament as Baron le Despenser in 1338. He fought at Sluys in 1340, Morlaix in 1342 and Crécy in 1346, and joined the siege of Calais. He died in 1349 without issue.
zh: 休·勒德斯潘塞（约1308—1349）是格拉摩根领主，小休·德斯潘塞与埃莉诺·德·克莱尔之子。1326年起，他为逃亡中的爱德华二世坚守卡菲利城堡，抵抗伊莎贝拉王后的军队，1327年在得到保命承诺后投降，随后被囚禁至1331年。爱德华三世亲政后他重获恩宠，1337年继承母亲的格拉摩根领地，参加苏格兰战争，并于1338年受召入议会，获封勒德斯潘塞男爵。他先后参加1340年斯勒伊斯海战、1342年莫尔莱战役和1346年克雷西战役，并随军围攻加来。1349年去世，无嗣。

en: Hugh le Despenser the Elder (1261–1326) served Edward I as soldier and diplomat and was made a baron in 1295. Loyal to Edward II through the Piers Gaveston crisis, he became the king's chief administrator after Gaveston's execution in 1312. Hatred of him and his son Hugh the Younger drove both into exile in 1321, but Edward recalled them and made the elder Despenser Earl of Winchester in 1322. When Queen Isabella and Roger Mortimer invaded in 1326, he was captured at Bristol and hanged in his armour on 27 October, then beheaded.
zh: 老休·勒德斯潘塞（1261—1326）曾以军人和外交家身份效力爱德华一世，1295年受召入议会成为男爵。皮尔斯·加韦斯顿危机中，他是少数忠于爱德华二世的贵族之一，1312年加韦斯顿被处死后，他成为国王的首席执政。贵族对他与其子小休的愤恨迫使父子俩于1321年流亡，但爱德华随即将他们召回，并于1322年封老德斯潘塞为温切斯特伯爵。1326年伊莎贝拉王后与罗杰·莫蒂默起兵，他在布里斯托尔围城战中被俘，10月27日身着铠甲被绞死，随后枭首。

en: Hugh O'Neill, Earl of Tyrone (c. 1550–1616), was the leading Gaelic Irish lord in the Nine Years' War against Elizabeth I. Raised in the English Pale, he built up power in Ulster, publicly appearing loyal while secretly supporting rebellions in the early 1590s. He adopted firearms and continental military tactics before his revolt in 1595, storming the Blackwater Fort and taking the O'Neill chieftaincy. Victory over Henry Bagenal at the Yellow Ford in 1598 won him much of Ulster, but Spanish aid ended in defeat at Kinsale in 1601, and he submitted under the Treaty of Mellifont in 1603. He fled in the 1607 Flight of the Earls and died in Rome on 20 July 1616.
zh: 蒂龙伯爵休·奥尼尔（约1550—1616）是爱尔兰盖尔贵族的领袖，领导了对抗伊丽莎白一世的九年战争。他自幼在英格兰管区佩尔长大，在阿尔斯特积蓄实力，1590年代初表面效忠，暗中支持叛乱。他采用火器和欧洲大陆的战术，于1595年公开举兵，攻占黑水堡，并就任奥尼尔家族首领。1598年他在黄福特之战击败亨利·巴奇纳尔，借此夺得阿尔斯特大部；但西班牙援军在1601年的金塞尔之战中败北，他于1603年据《梅利方特条约》投降。1607年他随“伯爵出逃”离开爱尔兰，1616年7月20日在罗马去世。

en: Humphrey de Bohun, fourth earl of Hereford (c. 1276–1322), succeeded his father in 1298 as earl of Hereford and Essex and hereditary Constable of England. In 1302 he married Elizabeth of Rhuddlan, daughter of Edward I. He fought repeatedly in the Scottish wars and was captured at Bannockburn in 1314, later exchanged for Robert Bruce's queen and daughter. A leader of the Ordainers who imposed the Ordinances of 1311 on Edward II, he turned against the Despensers and joined the earl of Lancaster's revolt. He was killed leading the rebel assault at Boroughbridge on 16 March 1322.
zh: 第四代赫里福德伯爵汉弗莱·德·博洪（约1276—1322）于1298年承袭父位，成为赫里福德与埃塞克斯伯爵及世袭的英格兰统帅。1302年，他娶爱德华一世之女伊丽莎白·勒·里兹兰为妻。他长年参加对苏格兰的战争，1314年在班诺克本战役中被俘，后来用以交换罗伯特·布鲁斯的王后与女儿。他是迫使爱德华二世接受1311年改革法令的贵族领袖之一，后来反对德斯潘塞父子，加入兰开斯特伯爵的叛乱。1322年3月16日，他在巴勒布里奇率叛军强攻桥梁时战死。

en: Humphrey de Bohun (6 December 1309 – 15 October 1361), 6th Earl of Hereford and 5th Earl of Essex, held Pleshey Castle in Essex and the hereditary office of Constable of England. As a captain in the Breton campaigns of the Hundred Years' War, he fought in the English victory at the Battle of Morlaix in 1342 and at the Battle of La Roche-Derrien in 1347. He died at Pleshey in 1361 and was buried at the Austin Friars in London; his earldoms passed to his nephew Humphrey, the 7th Earl.
zh: 汉弗莱·德·博洪（1309年12月6日—1361年10月15日）是第六代赫里福德伯爵、第五代埃塞克斯伯爵，居于埃塞克斯的普莱希城堡，世袭英格兰宫廷统帅之职。作为百年战争布列塔尼战场的英军将领，他参加了1342年英军获胜的莫尔莱战役，以及1347年的拉罗什德里安战役。1361年他在普莱希去世，葬于伦敦的奥斯定会修道院，两个伯爵头衔由侄子第七代伯爵汉弗莱继承。

en: Idonia de Clifford (c. 1300 – 1365) was the daughter of Robert de Clifford, 1st Baron Clifford, and Maud de Clare, and the wife of Henry de Percy, 2nd Baron Percy of Alnwick. Her son Henry succeeded his father as the 3rd Baron Percy.
zh: 伊多妮娅·德·克利福德（约1300—1365）是第一代克利福德男爵罗伯特·德·克利福德与莫德·德·克莱尔之女，嫁给第二代阿尼克珀西男爵亨利·德·珀西。她的儿子亨利后来袭爵，成为第三代珀西男爵。

en: Inigo Jones (1573–1652), an English architect, first made his name designing court masques for Queen Anne of Denmark from 1605, introducing movable scenery and the proscenium arch to the English stage in collaboration with Ben Jonson. In 1613 he toured Italy with the Earl of Arundel, studying the villas of Andrea Palladio, whose work influenced his architecture. He became Surveyor of the King's Works in 1615 and introduced pure classical architecture to England. His buildings include the Queen's House at Greenwich, the Banqueting House at Whitehall and the piazza at Covent Garden. Captured when Basing House fell in 1645 during the Civil War, he was later released and fined. He died in London in 1652.
zh: 伊尼戈·琼斯（1573—1652）是英格兰建筑师。他早年凭借为丹麦的安妮王后设计宫廷假面剧成名：自1605年起，他与本·琼森合作，将活动布景和台口拱门引入英格兰戏剧。1613年他随阿伦德尔伯爵游历意大利，考察安德烈亚·帕拉第奥的别墅，后者的作品影响了他的建筑风格。1615年他出任王室工程总监，把纯粹的古典建筑引入英格兰，代表作有格林尼治的王后宫、白厅的宴会厅和考文特花园广场。内战期间，1645年贝辛宫陷落时他被俘，后来获释并被罚款，1652年于伦敦去世。

en: Sir Isaac Newton (1643–1727) was an English mathematician and physicist, a central figure of the Scientific Revolution. A fellow of Trinity College, Cambridge, he became the university's second Lucasian Professor of Mathematics. His Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica, published in 1687, set out the laws of motion and universal gravitation, uniting terrestrial and celestial mechanics. His observation that a prism separates white light into colours underpinned his theory of colour; Opticks (1704) presented his work on light and the reflecting telescope. He developed infinitesimal calculus independently of Leibniz, sat as a Cambridge MP and was knighted by Queen Anne in 1705.
zh: 艾萨克·牛顿爵士（1643—1727）是英国数学家、物理学家，科学革命的核心人物。他任剑桥大学三一学院研究员，并成为该校第二任卢卡斯数学教授。1687年出版的《自然哲学的数学原理》提出运动定律与万有引力定律，统合了地上与天体的力学。他观察到棱镜能将白光分解为各种颜色，并以此建立颜色理论；1704年的《光学》介绍了他对光的研究及反射式望远镜。他还独立于莱布尼茨发展出微积分，曾任剑桥大学选区议员，1705年被安妮女王封为爵士。

en: Isabel de Atholl was a daughter of Sir Aymer de Strathbogie of Felton in Northumberland, a younger son of David II Strathbogie, Earl of Atholl. She married Sir Ralph Euer, a Northumberland knight, by whom she had a daughter Margaret, wife of John Pudsey.
zh: 伊莎贝尔·德·阿索尔是诺森伯兰费尔顿的艾马尔·德·斯特拉斯博吉爵士之女，其父为阿索尔伯爵大卫二世·斯特拉斯博吉的幼子。她嫁给骑士拉尔夫·尤尔，生女玛格丽特，嫁与约翰·帕德西。

en: Isabel of Beaumont (c. 1318–1361), youngest daughter of Henry de Beaumont, Earl of Buchan, and Alice Comyn, married Henry of Grosmont in 1330. She accompanied him on embassies to the Low Countries in 1341 and Gascony in 1345, and when he was made Duke of Lancaster in 1351 she became the first Englishwoman to bear the title of duchess. Her daughters Maud and Blanche married William V of Hainaut and John of Gaunt respectively, making her grandmother of Henry IV. She died of the plague at Leicester Castle in 1361, the same year as her husband.
zh: 伊莎贝尔·德·博蒙（约1318—1361）是巴肯伯爵亨利·德·博蒙与艾丽斯·科明最小的女儿。1330年她嫁给格罗斯蒙特的亨利。她曾随丈夫于1341年和1345年先后出使低地地区与加斯科涅；1351年亨利受封兰开斯特公爵，她也成为英格兰第一位获得公爵夫人头衔的女性。两个女儿莫德与布朗什分别嫁给埃诺伯爵威廉五世和冈特的约翰，英王亨利四世是她的外孙。1361年，她与丈夫双双死于瘟疫，她本人在莱斯特城堡离世。

en: Isabel le Despenser (born c. 1312) was the eldest daughter of Hugh le Despenser the Younger, Edward II's favourite, and Eleanor de Clare, which made her a great-granddaughter of Edward I. Her betrothal sealed an alliance between her father and Edmund FitzAlan, Earl of Arundel, a loyal supporter of the king. In February 1321, aged about eight, she married Edmund's seven-year-old heir Richard at Havering-atte-Bower. The marriage saved her when her father was executed for treason in November 1326: she and her youngest sister were the only daughters of the favourite who escaped confinement in a nunnery, Isabel because she was already a wife. Richard became earl in 1331 but later repudiated her. The marriage was annulled and their son Edmund was declared illegitimate, losing his claim to the earldom. Isabel was still living in 1356 and had died by 1375.
zh: 伊莎贝尔·德斯潘塞（约1312年生）是爱德华二世宠臣小休·德斯潘塞与埃莉诺·德·克莱尔的长女，按母系是爱德华一世的外曾孙女。她的婚约巩固了父亲与阿伦德尔伯爵埃德蒙·菲茨艾伦之间的联盟，这位伯爵一贯忠于国王。1321年2月，年仅约八岁的她在黑弗灵阿特鲍尔嫁给埃德蒙七岁的继承人理查德。1326年11月，父亲因叛国罪被处决，这桩婚姻保住了她：这位宠臣的女儿中，只有她和最小的妹妹免于被关进修道院，伊莎贝尔是因为已经嫁人。理查德于1331年袭伯爵位，后来却休弃她：婚姻被宣告无效，两人之子埃德蒙被定为私生子，失去伯爵爵位的继承权。伊莎贝尔1356年仍在世，1375年前去世。

en: Isabel de Percy was a daughter of Henry Percy, 2nd Baron Percy of Alnwick, and the wife of William de Aton, 2nd Baron Aton, by whom she had three daughters, Anastasia, Katherine and Elizabeth.
zh: 伊莎贝尔·珀西是第二代阿尼克珀西男爵亨利·珀西之女，嫁给第二代埃顿男爵威廉·德埃顿，生有阿纳斯塔西娅、凯瑟琳和伊丽莎白三个女儿。

en: Isabella of France (c. 1295–1358), later called the She-Wolf of France, was the daughter of Philip IV, and three of her brothers became kings of France. She married Edward II of England at Boulogne in 1308. Isabella could not tolerate Edward's favourite Hugh Despenser the Younger, and by 1325 the marriage was at breaking point. Sent to France on a diplomatic mission, she joined the exiled baron Roger Mortimer, and in 1326 she landed in England with a small mercenary army while the king's forces deserted him. Edward II was deposed in January 1327 and died at Berkeley Castle that September, a death historians still dispute. Isabella governed as regent for her son Edward III, amassing huge wealth with Mortimer and making an unpopular but successful peace with Scotland. On 19 October 1330 Edward III's men entered Nottingham Castle through a secret tunnel and seized Mortimer, who was executed at Tyburn. Isabella was kept under house arrest for two years, then moved to Castle Rising and lived richly until her death in 1358 as a Poor Clare.
zh: 法兰西的伊莎贝拉（约1295—1358），后世称为“法兰西母狼”，是法王腓力四世之女，她的三个兄弟先后成为法兰西国王。1308年她在布洛涅嫁给英格兰国王爱德华二世。伊莎贝拉无法容忍爱德华的宠臣小休·德斯潘塞，到1325年婚姻已濒临破裂。她以外交使命赴法，与流亡贵族罗杰·莫蒂默结盟，1326年率一支小规模雇佣军登陆英格兰，国王的军队纷纷弃他而去。爱德华二世于1327年1月被废，同年9月死于伯克利城堡，其死因史家仍有争论。伊莎贝拉以儿子爱德华三世的名义摄政，与莫蒂默聚敛了巨额财富，也缔结了不得人心却成功的对苏格兰和约。1330年10月19日，爱德华三世的人马经一条秘密地道进入诺丁汉城堡，抓获莫蒂默，他后来在泰伯恩被处决。伊莎贝拉被软禁两年，此后迁居卡斯尔赖辛，生活富足，1358年以贫穷克拉拉会修女的身份去世。

en: Isabella of England (16 June 1332 – 1379/1382) was the eldest daughter of Edward III and Philippa of Hainault, born at Woodstock Palace. On 27 July 1365 she married Enguerrand de Coucy, a French nobleman held as a hostage after Brétigny. De Coucy became Earl of Bedford in 1366, and her daughters Marie and Philippa were born in 1366 and 1367. She was made a Lady of the Garter in 1376. When de Coucy renounced England in 1377, she remained and petitioned Richard II's first Parliament as a deserted wife.
zh: 英格兰的伊莎贝拉（1332年6月16日—1379/1382年）是爱德华三世与埃诺的菲莉帕的长女，生于伍德斯托克宫。1365年7月27日，她嫁给《布雷蒂尼条约》后被扣为人质的法国贵族昂盖朗·德·库西。库西于1366年受封贝德福德伯爵，她的两个女儿玛丽和菲莉帕生于1366和1367年，她本人于1376年成为嘉德女骑士。1377年库西背弃英格兰后，她留在国内，以被遗弃妻子的身份向理查二世的首届议会请愿。

en: Jack Sharp (died 1431), whose real name was William Perkins, was a weaver and town bailiff of Abingdon. In the spring of 1431 he put himself at the head of the Lollards of the southern midlands against years of repression, circulating handbills under the name Jack Sharp of Wigmoreland that revived a scheme of 1410 to divert church endowments to secular uses. The proposal took the form of a petition to parliament. The council offered a reward for Sharp's capture, and the regent Humphrey, Duke of Gloucester, suppressed the movement. Sharp was seized at Oxford on 17 May 1431, condemned before the duke, and executed five days later, his head being set on London Bridge.
zh: 杰克·夏普（？—1431）本名威廉·珀金斯，是阿宾登的织工兼镇执行官。1431年春，他以“威格莫尔兰的杰克·夏普”之名率领米德兰南部的罗拉德派反抗多年的镇压，四处散发传单，重提1410年将教会产业改充世俗用途的方案。这项提议采取了向议会请愿的形式。枢密院悬赏捉拿夏普，摄政格洛斯特公爵汉弗莱镇压了这场运动。夏普于1431年5月17日在牛津被捕，在公爵面前被判罪，五天后处死，首级悬挂在伦敦桥上。

en: James Audley, 2nd Baron Audley (8 January 1312/13 – 1 April 1386), lord of Heighley Castle in Staffordshire, was an English peer and Marcher lord. He succeeded his father Nicholas Audley, 1st Baron Audley, and through his mother Joan Martin inherited the feudal barony of Barnstaple in Devon and the Marcher lordship of Kemes. Before June 1330 he married Joan Mortimer, daughter of Roger Mortimer, 1st Earl of March, who bore him his heir Nicholas and three other children. After her death he married Isabel LeStrange before December 1351.
zh: 第二代奥德利男爵詹姆斯·奥德利（1312/13年1月8日—1386年4月1日）是英格兰贵族、边疆领主，居于斯塔福德郡的黑利城堡。他承袭父亲第一代奥德利男爵尼古拉斯·奥德利的爵位，并通过母亲琼·马丁继承了德文郡的巴恩斯特珀尔封建男爵领地与凯迈斯边疆领。1330年6月前，他娶第一代马奇伯爵罗杰·莫蒂默之女琼·莫蒂默为妻，后者为他生下继承人尼古拉斯及另外三个子女。琼死后，他于1351年12月前续娶伊莎贝尔·勒斯特兰奇。

en: James Cook (1728–1779) was a British naval officer, explorer and cartographer, born at Marton in Yorkshire on 7 November 1728. He was a merchant navy apprentice before joining the Royal Navy in 1755. During the Seven Years' War he surveyed the St. Lawrence, and in the 1760s he mapped Newfoundland; his astronomical observations there helped bring him to the Admiralty's attention. From 1768 he commanded three Pacific voyages in HMS Endeavour and Resolution, circumnavigating New Zealand, charting Australia's east coast and reaching Hawaii. He made contact with many indigenous peoples and claimed territories for Britain. His measures against scurvy won him the Royal Society's Copley Medal. He was killed in Hawaii on 14 February 1779 during a quarrel with islanders.
zh: 詹姆斯·库克（1728—1779）是英国海军军官、探险家与制图师，1728年11月7日生于约克郡的马顿。他曾在商船当学徒，1755年加入皇家海军。七年战争期间他测绘了圣劳伦斯河航道，1760年代又绘制纽芬兰海岸图；他在当地的天文观测使他受到海军部的关注。1768年起，他指挥“努力号”“决心号”三度远航太平洋，环航新西兰，测绘澳大利亚东海岸，并抵达夏威夷。他与许多原住民接触，并为英国宣称领土。他预防坏血病的措施为他赢得皇家学会科普利奖章。1779年2月14日，他在夏威夷与岛民冲突时被杀。

en: Sir James Lancaster (c. 1554–1618) was an English privateer and pioneer of the East India trade. Raised in Portugal as a merchant and soldier, he returned to England in 1587. He commanded the Edward Bonaventure against the Spanish Armada in 1588. In 1591 he led England's first voyage to the East Indies, reaching Penang; only twenty-five officers and men survived the return to England. When the East India Company was chartered in 1600, he commanded its first fleet in the Red Dragon to Aceh and Bantam, where he founded its first factory; James I knighted him in 1603. On that voyage he showed that daily lemon juice prevented scurvy. He remained a chief director of the company until his death.
zh: 詹姆斯·兰开斯特爵士（约1554—1618）是英格兰私掠船长，也是东印度贸易的先驱。他在葡萄牙成长，经商并从军，1587年返回英格兰。1588年他指挥“爱德华·博纳文图尔号”参加抗击西班牙无敌舰队的战斗。1591年他率领英格兰第一支东印度远航船队，抵达槟城；返航时仅有25名军官和船员生还抵达英格兰。1600年东印度公司获特许成立后，他乘“红龙号”指挥公司首支船队驶往亚齐和万丹，在万丹建立了公司第一个商馆；1603年詹姆斯一世封他为爵士。这次航行中，他证明每日服用柠檬汁可以预防坏血病。此后他一直担任公司的主要董事，直至去世。

en: Jane Austen (1775–1817) was an English novelist, born at Steventon in Hampshire on 16 December 1775, the daughter of the local rector. Largely educated at home through her father's library, she began writing as a girl. Her six major novels—Sense and Sensibility (1811), Pride and Prejudice (1813), Mansfield Park (1814) and Emma (1815), followed after her death by Northanger Abbey and Persuasion—combine irony and realism in portraying the marriage market of the English gentry. Her plots explored women's dependence on marriage for social standing and financial security. Sense and Sensibility appeared under the name 'A Lady'; her novels published in her lifetime did not bear her name. She died unmarried at Winchester on 18 July 1817 and was buried in the cathedral.
zh: 简·奥斯汀（1775—1817）是英国小说家，1775年12月16日生于汉普郡的斯蒂文顿，父亲是当地教区长。她主要靠父亲的藏书在家自学，少女时代便开始写作。她的六部主要小说——1811年的《理智与情感》、1813年的《傲慢与偏见》、1814年的《曼斯菲尔德庄园》、1815年的《爱玛》，以及身后出版的《诺桑觉寺》和《劝导》——以讽刺与写实笔法刻画英国乡绅阶层的婚姻世态。她的故事探讨女性依靠婚姻争取社会地位和经济保障的处境。《理智与情感》以“一位女士”署名；她生前出版的小说均未署本人姓名。1817年7月18日她在温切斯特未婚而终，安葬于当地大教堂。

en: Lady Jane Grey (1536/1537–1554), known as the Nine Days' Queen, was a noblewoman with a claim to the Tudor throne through Mary Tudor, younger sister of Henry VIII. A committed Protestant with a humanist education, she was married in May 1553 to Lord Guildford Dudley, son of the Duke of Northumberland. The dying Edward VI named her heir, excluding his sisters Mary and Elizabeth; unlike the Catholic Mary, Jane would support the reformed Church. She was proclaimed queen on 10 July 1553. Support collapsed within days and the Privy Council proclaimed Mary I on 19 July. Jane was imprisoned in the Tower and, after her father joined Wyatt's rebellion, beheaded there with her husband on 12 February 1554.
zh: 简·格雷郡主（1536/1537—1554）世称“九日女王”，是一位贵族女子，因祖母玛丽·都铎是亨利八世的幼妹而拥有都铎王朝的王位继承权。她受过人文主义教育，是虔诚的新教徒，1553年5月嫁给诺森伯兰公爵之子吉尔福德·达德利勋爵。临终的爱德华六世指定她为继承人，排除了他的姐妹玛丽和伊丽莎白；与信奉天主教的玛丽不同，简会支持改革后的教会。1553年7月10日她被宣布为女王，但支持在几天内瓦解，枢密院于7月19日转而拥立玛丽一世。简被囚于伦敦塔，父亲参加怀亚特叛乱后，她于1554年2月12日与丈夫一同在塔中被斩首。

en: Joan of Bar (c. 1295–1361), daughter of Henry III, Count of Bar, and Eleanor of England, was a niece of Edward II. In May 1306 she married John de Warenne, 7th Earl of Surrey, who from 1313 vainly sought a divorce while openly keeping the mistress Maud of Nerford; Edward II lodged her at the Tower of London at his own expense. In 1352 John II of France made her regent of Bar for her young great-nephew Robert. She ruled until 1356, when defeat at Poitiers lost her support, then returned to England and died there in 1361.
zh: 让娜·德·巴尔（约1295—1361）是巴尔伯爵亨利三世与英格兰的埃莉诺之女，也就是爱德华二世的外甥女。1306年5月，她嫁给第七代萨里伯爵约翰·德·瓦雷纳；丈夫自1313年起屡次诉请离婚却始终未获批准，还公开与莫德·德·内尔福德同居，爱德华二世遂出资将她安置在伦敦塔。1352年，法王约翰二世把巴尔伯国的摄政权托付给她，代年幼的侄孙罗贝尔主政；她一直执政到1356年普瓦捷战败、失去王室支持为止。此后她返回英格兰，1361年卒于英格兰。

en: Joan of Lancaster (c. 1312–1349) was the third daughter of Henry, 3rd Earl of Lancaster, and Maud de Chaworth, and a granddaughter of Edmund Crouchback, Earl of Lancaster. On 28 February 1327 she married John de Mowbray, 3rd Baron Mowbray, by whom she had three children, including John de Mowbray, 4th Baron Mowbray. Her brother Henry of Grosmont was father of Blanche of Lancaster, wife of John of Gaunt and mother of Henry IV. Joan died of the plague in Yorkshire on 7 July 1349 and was buried at Byland Abbey.
zh: 兰开斯特的琼（约1312—1349）是第三代兰开斯特伯爵亨利与莫德·德·查沃斯的第三女，祖父为第一代兰开斯特伯爵埃德蒙·克罗奇贝克。1327年2月28日，她嫁给第三代莫布雷男爵约翰·德·莫布雷，育有三个子女，其中包括第四代莫布雷男爵约翰·德·莫布雷。她的兄弟格罗斯蒙特的亨利是兰开斯特的布兰奇之父，布兰奇后来嫁给冈特的约翰，是英格兰国王亨利四世的母亲。1349年7月7日，琼在约克郡死于瘟疫，葬于拜兰修道院。

en: Joan Mortimer (1311 or 1312 – between 1337 and 1351) was an English noblewoman, probably the third daughter of Roger Mortimer, 1st Earl of March. Betrothed in childhood to James Audley, her father's ward, she was arrested in 1324, after Mortimer fled into exile in August 1323, and was confined at Sempringham Priory on twelve pence a week. She was freed after her father seized power with Queen Isabella in 1326, and married Audley at Hereford in 1328 or 1329, at a double wedding with her sister Katherine. Her children included Nicholas Audley, later Baron Audley.
zh: 琼·莫蒂默（1311或1312—1337至1351年间）是英格兰贵族女子，可能是第一代马奇伯爵罗杰·莫蒂默的第三女。她幼年便许配给父亲的被监护人詹姆斯·奥德利；1323年8月莫蒂默逃亡海外后，她于1324年被捕，囚于森普林厄姆修道院，每周仅得十二便士生活费。1326年其父与伊莎贝拉王后夺权后她获释，并于1328或1329年在赫里福德与奥德利成婚，婚礼与妹妹凯瑟琳的婚礼同时举行。她的子女包括后来的奥德利男爵尼古拉斯·奥德利。

en: Joan of England (1333/1334–1348) was a daughter of Edward III and Philippa of Hainault, born in the Tower of London. Betrothed in 1336 to the son of Otto, Duke of Austria, she spent time at the imperial court before Edward III ended the match in 1340. In 1345 she was betrothed to Peter, heir to Castile, and in summer 1348 sailed with a great retinue to join him. The Black Death overtook her party at Bordeaux; she was probably moved to nearby Lormont, but died of plague on 2 September 1348. Some accounts say she was buried in Bordeaux Cathedral.
zh: 英格兰的琼（1333/1334—1348）是爱德华三世与埃诺的菲莉帕之女，生于伦敦塔。1336年她被许配给奥地利公爵奥托之子，曾在帝国宫廷生活，1340年爱德华三世解除这门婚事把她接回。1345年她与卡斯蒂利亚王位继承人佩德罗订婚，1348年夏率庞大随从队伍乘船前往成婚。黑死病在波尔多袭向她的队伍；她可能被转移到附近的洛尔蒙，仍于1348年9月2日染疫身亡。部分记载称她葬于波尔多主教座堂。

en: Joan of Kent (c. 1328–1385), the Fair Maid of Kent, was the daughter of Edmund of Woodstock, 1st Earl of Kent. In 1340 she secretly married Thomas Holland, but while he campaigned in France her family married her to William Montagu, Earl of Salisbury, a union the Pope annulled in 1349. She inherited the earldom of Kent in 1352, and after Holland's death married Edward the Black Prince at Windsor in 1361. Their younger son, born at Bordeaux in 1367, became Richard II. A Lady of the Garter from 1378, she died at Wallingford Castle in August 1385.
zh: 肯特的琼安（约1328—1385），人称“肯特的美少女”，是第一代肯特伯爵伍德斯托克的埃德蒙之女。1340年她秘密嫁给托马斯·霍兰；霍兰赴法国作战期间，家人又把她嫁给索尔兹伯里伯爵威廉·蒙塔古，教皇于1349年宣布这段婚姻无效。1352年她承袭肯特伯爵爵位，霍兰死后于1361年在温莎嫁给黑太子爱德华。幼子1367年生于波尔多，即后来的理查二世。1378年她成为嘉德女骑士，1385年8月在沃灵福德城堡去世。

en: Joan of the Tower (1321–1362), youngest daughter of Edward II of England and Isabella of France, was born in the Tower of London. Under the Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton she married David, son of Robert the Bruce, at Berwick in July 1328, and became queen of Scots when David II succeeded in 1329. After Edward III won at Halidon Hill in 1333, the couple took refuge at the French court until 1341. David was captured at Neville's Cross in 1346 and held in England eleven years. Joan died childless at Hertford Castle in 1362, long estranged from him.
zh: 伦敦塔的乔安（1321—1362）是英格兰国王爱德华二世与法兰西的伊莎贝拉的幼女，生于伦敦塔。根据《爱丁堡—北安普顿条约》，她于1328年7月在特威德河畔贝里克嫁给罗伯特·布鲁斯之子大卫，1329年大卫二世继位，她成为苏格兰王后。1333年爱德华三世在哈里顿山获胜后，夫妇二人到法兰西宫廷避难，直到1341年才返回苏格兰。1346年大卫在内维尔十字战役中被俘，在英格兰被囚禁十一年。乔安没有子女，1362年于赫特福德城堡去世，此前与丈夫早已疏远。

en: John I, called John of Aviz (1357–1433), was the illegitimate son of King Peter I of Portugal, born in Lisbon and made master of the Order of Aviz in 1364. When his half-brother Ferdinand I died in 1383 without a male heir, Beatrice's claim threatened Castilian annexation and the 1383–1385 interregnum began. John led the revolt, was acclaimed king at Coimbra in April 1385, and with Nuno Álvares Pereira won the Battle of Aljubarrota on 14 August 1385. He founded the Aviz dynasty, married Philippa of Lancaster in 1387, and conquered Ceuta in 1415, beginning Portugal's overseas expansion. His forces defended Ceuta against a Moroccan counterattack in 1419, securing a foothold on the African coast.
zh: 若昂一世（1357—1433），又称阿维斯的若昂，是葡萄牙国王佩德罗一世的私生子，生于里斯本，1364年被任命为阿维斯骑士团团主。1383年，他的同父异母兄费尔南多一世去世且无男性继承人，公主比阿特丽斯的王位主张使葡萄牙面临被卡斯蒂利亚吞并的危险，1383—1385年空位期由此爆发。若昂领导反抗，1385年4月在科英布拉被拥戴为王，并在努诺·阿尔瓦雷斯·佩雷拉辅佐下于1385年8月14日赢得阿勒祖巴洛塔战役。他开创阿维斯王朝，1387年迎娶兰开斯特的菲利帕，1415年征服休达，开启葡萄牙的海外扩张时代。1419年他的军队击退摩洛哥对休达的反攻，守住了这一非洲沿岸据点。

en: John Cabot, born Giovanni Caboto (c. 1450–c. 1499), was an Italian navigator who sailed for England. A Venetian citizen from 1476, he traded in the Mediterranean before debts drove him from Venice in 1488; after failed schemes in Spain and Portugal he reached London in 1495. In March 1496 Henry VII granted him letters patent to seek new lands. Sailing from Bristol in the Matthew on 2 May 1497, he made landfall in North America, probably Newfoundland, on 24 June and claimed it for England. In 1498 he sailed with five ships; one reached Ireland after a storm, while the others continued. His own fate and the expedition's final outcome remain unknown.
zh: 约翰·卡博托，本名乔瓦尼·卡博托（约1450—约1499），是为英格兰效力的意大利航海家。他1476年成为威尼斯公民，在地中海经商，1488年因负债逃离威尼斯；在西班牙和葡萄牙的筹划受挫后，于1495年来到伦敦。1496年3月，亨利七世颁给他探索新陆地的特许状。1497年5月2日，他乘“马修号”从布里斯托尔启航，6月24日在北美，很可能是纽芬兰，登陆，并以英格兰名义宣布占有。1498年他率五艘船出航，其中一艘遇风暴后驶抵爱尔兰，其余继续航行。他本人和远征队的最终结局不明。

en: John Capgrave (1393–1464) was an Augustinian friar, theologian and historian, born at Lynn in Norfolk. Ordained priest about 1417, he was studying in London in 1422. He later headed the Austin friary at Lynn, where he received Henry VI in 1446, and became provincial of the Augustinians in England. A prolific writer of biblical commentaries and saints' lives, he is best remembered for his English works: a metrical Life of St Katharine, the Life of St Gilbert of Sempringham, and a Chronicle of England running from the Creation to 1417. Humphrey, Duke of Gloucester, was his chief patron, and Capgrave dedicated biblical commentaries to him. He died at Lynn on 12 August 1464.
zh: 约翰·卡普格雷夫（1393—1464）是奥斯定会修士、神学家和历史学家，生于诺福克郡林恩。他约1417年受任神父，1422年在伦敦求学。后来他主持林恩的奥斯定会修道院，1446年在该院接待亨利六世，并出任奥斯定会英格兰会长。他著作宏富，写有大量圣经注释和圣徒传，最著名的是英文作品：诗体《圣凯瑟琳传》、《森普林厄姆的圣吉尔伯特传》，以及从创世写到1417年的《英格兰编年史》。格洛斯特公爵汉弗莱是他的主要庇护人，他将圣经注释献给了公爵。1464年8月12日，他在林恩去世。

en: John de Bohun, fifth earl of Hereford (1306–1336), was the eldest son of the fourth earl and Elizabeth of Rhuddlan, daughter of Edward I. His father's attainder after Boroughbridge in 1322 cost the family its lands, and John recovered the earldoms of Hereford and Essex and the hereditary Constableship after the Despensers' fall in 1326. In 1325 he married Alice FitzAlan, and after her death Margaret Basset, whose marriage was challenged on grounds of consanguinity. Frail and largely inactive, he died at Kirkby Thore on 20 January 1336, his titles passing to his brother Humphrey.
zh: 第五代赫里福德伯爵约翰·德·博洪（1306—1336）是第四代伯爵与爱德华一世之女伊丽莎白·勒·里兹兰的长子。1322年其父在巴勒布里奇战败被杀、家族领地遭没收，直到1326年德斯潘塞父子倒台后，约翰才得以继承赫里福德与埃塞克斯伯爵爵位及世袭英格兰统帅之职。他于1325年先娶艾丽斯·菲茨艾伦，妻子死后又娶玛格丽特·巴塞特，第二段婚姻因血亲关系遭到指控。他身体孱弱、很少参与公务，1336年1月20日卒于柯克比·索雷，爵位由弟弟汉弗莱继承。

en: John Charlton, 1st Baron Charlton of Powys (1268–1353), rose from a Shropshire landowning family through service in Edward II's household. On 26 July 1309 he married Hawys Gadarn, heiress of the Welsh lordship of Powys, gaining Welshpool and laying the foundations of Powis Castle. Summoned to Parliament as Lord Charlton on 26 July 1313, he fought the Scots, joined Lancaster's revolt against the Despensers in 1321 and was pardoned in 1322, and in 1326 executed the Earl of Arundel on Queen Isabella's orders. He served as Justiciar of Ireland from 1337, patronized Strata Marcella Abbey, and died in 1353.
zh: 约翰·查尔顿，第一代波伊斯查尔顿男爵（1268—1353），出身什罗普郡的小地主家庭，靠在爱德华二世宫廷中效力发迹。1309年7月26日，他娶威尔士波伊斯领地的女继承人哈维斯·加达尔恩为妻，得到威尔士浦，并着手营建日后的波伊斯城堡。1313年7月26日他奉召入议会，成为第一代查尔顿男爵；他曾对苏格兰作战，1321年参加兰开斯特伯爵反对德斯潘塞家族的叛乱，1322年获赦，1326年又奉伊莎贝拉王后之命处决了阿伦德尔伯爵。1337年起他短暂出任爱尔兰首席政法官，晚年资助斯特拉塔马塞拉修道院，1353年去世。

en: John Charlton, 2nd Baron Charlton (c. 1307–1360), was the son of John Charlton, 1st Baron Charlton, and Hawys Gadarn, heiress of the Welsh lordship of Powys. Before 1319 he married Maud Mortimer, daughter of Roger Mortimer, 1st Earl of March, who bore him his only son, the later 3rd baron. He campaigned in Gascony during the Hundred Years' War and, like his father before him, held the office of Lord Chamberlain of the Household. He succeeded his father as Lord Charlton of Powys in 1353 and died in 1360.
zh: 约翰·查尔顿（约1307—1360）为第二代查尔顿男爵，是第一代查尔顿男爵约翰·查尔顿与威尔士波伊斯领地女继承人哈维斯·加达恩之子。1319年前，他娶第一代马奇伯爵罗杰·莫蒂默之女莫德·莫蒂默为妻，育有独子，即后来的第三代男爵。他参加百年战争中的加斯科涅战事，并与父亲一样出任宫务大臣。1353年，他承袭父亲的波伊斯查尔顿勋爵之位，1360年去世。

en: John Charlton, 3rd Baron Charlton (c. 1336–1374), was the son of the 2nd baron and Maud Mortimer, and through his grandmother Hawys Gadarn an heir to the Welsh lordship of Powys. In 1343 his grandfather arranged his marriage to Joan de Stafford, daughter of Ralph Stafford, 1st Earl of Stafford. He succeeded his father as baron in 1360. Muster rolls for 1372 record him as a banneret leading 22 archers and men-at-arms on a naval expedition under Edward III. His sons John and Edward later became the 4th and 5th barons Charlton.
zh: 约翰·查尔顿（约1336—1374）为第三代查尔顿男爵，是第二代男爵与莫德·莫蒂默之子，凭借祖母哈维斯·加达恩的血统成为威尔士波伊斯领地的继承人。1343年，祖父安排了他与第一代斯塔福德伯爵拉尔夫·斯塔福德之女琼·德·斯塔福德的婚事。1360年，他承袭父爵。1372年的兵员名册记载，他以方旗骑士身份率二十二名弓箭手和披甲武士参加爱德华三世麾下的一次海上远征。他的儿子约翰和爱德华后来成为第四代、第五代查尔顿男爵。

en: John of Padua (active 1543–1557) was an Italian architect and musician employed at the courts of Henry VIII and Edward VI, one of the foreign craftsmen who brought Renaissance architecture to England. His name first appears in the royal Treasury accounts on 30 January 1544, and between 1543 and 1557 the Exchequer paid him fees and a pension. A Murano glassmaker's will made in London in 1551 describes him as architect and servant of the king. He disappears from the records after 1557.
zh: 约翰·迪·帕多瓦（活跃于1543—1557年）是效力于亨利八世与爱德华六世宫廷的意大利建筑师兼音乐家，也是把文艺复兴建筑带入英格兰的外来工匠之一。1544年1月30日，他的名字首次出现在王室财政账簿上；1543至1557年间，财政署向他支付酬金与年金。1551年，一位穆拉诺玻璃匠在伦敦所立的遗嘱称他为建筑师兼国王仆从。1557年后他便从记载中消失。

en: John FitzAlan (born 1287) was a son of Richard FitzAlan, Earl of Arundel, and Alice of Saluzzo, and he entered the Church as a priest.
zh: 约翰·菲查伦（1287年生）是阿伦德尔伯爵理查德·菲查伦与萨卢佐的爱丽丝的儿子，后来成为教士。

en: John de Grey, first Baron Grey of Rotherfield (1300–1359), was an English soldier and courtier, the son of Sir John de Grey and Margaret de Odingsells. He began soldiering in 1321 and served in Scotland and Gascony. He wanted to marry Eleanor de Clare, widow of Hugh le Despenser the Younger, but William la Zouche wanted her too. The quarrel put both men in prison, and after a papal inquiry the bishop of Coventry and Lichfield ruled for Zouche. Regularly summoned to parliament from 1338, Grey was one of the founding Knights of the Garter in 1348 and from December 1349 served as Lord Steward of Edward III's household, almost until his death. He married first Katherine FitzAlan of Bedale and then Avice Marmion, and died in September 1359; his son John, by Katherine, succeeded as second baron.
zh: 第一代罗瑟菲尔德的格雷男爵约翰·德·格雷（1300—1359）是英格兰军人与廷臣，约翰·德·格雷爵士与玛格丽特·德·奥丁泽尔斯之子。他1321年投身军旅，先后在苏格兰和加斯科涅作战。他想娶小休·德斯潘塞的遗孀埃莉诺·德·克莱尔，威廉·拉·祖什也有此意，两人相争，一度双双入狱；教宗下令调查后，考文垂和利奇菲尔德主教裁定祖什获胜。自1338年起他多次奉召进入议会，1348年成为嘉德骑士团创始骑士之一，1349年12月起担任爱德华三世的内廷大臣，一直任到去世前后。他先娶比代尔的凯瑟琳·菲茨艾伦，再娶阿维斯·马米恩，1359年9月去世；凯瑟琳所生之子约翰继位为第二代男爵。

en: John de Grey, second Baron Grey of Rotherfield (1319–1375), was the eldest son of the first baron, a founding Knight of the Garter, and Katherine FitzAlan. His family traced its descent to Anchetil de Grey, who took part in the Norman conquest of England. Born at Rotherfield in Oxfordshire, he succeeded his father in 1359, inheriting lands chiefly in Oxfordshire and Yorkshire, and married Maud de Burghersh, daughter of Bartholomew Burghersh, first Baron Burghersh. His son John died before him, so when John died at Rotherfield in June 1375 the barony passed to his grandson Bartholomew.
zh: 第二代罗瑟菲尔德的格雷男爵约翰·德·格雷（1319—1375）是第一代男爵、嘉德骑士团创始成员约翰·德·格雷与凯瑟琳·菲茨艾伦的长子。他的家族追溯至参与诺曼征服英格兰的安谢蒂尔·德·格雷。他生于牛津郡的罗瑟菲尔德，1359年父亲去世后继承主要分布在牛津郡和约克郡的家产与男爵爵位，并娶第一代伯格什男爵巴塞洛缪·伯格什之女莫德·德·伯格什为妻。他的儿子约翰先他而逝，因此1375年6月他在罗瑟菲尔德去世后，爵位由孙子巴塞洛缪继承。

en: Sir John Hawkins (1532–1595) was a Plymouth sea captain and naval administrator, born into a family of shipbuilders and captains. He worked with his elder brother William in shipping and privateering before their partnership ended around 1559. In the 1560s his voyages carried enslaved Africans to Spanish colonies in the Caribbean in defiance of Spain's embargo, making him the first English merchant to profit from the Atlantic slave trade. As Treasurer of the Navy he rebuilt Elizabeth's fleet for speed and firepower, and in 1588 he served as vice-admiral against the Spanish Armada, winning a knighthood in the victory. After his son Richard was captured by the Spanish, he raised a fleet with Drake to attack the Spanish West Indies. He died at sea off Puerto Rico on 12 November 1595.
zh: 约翰·霍金斯爵士（1532—1595）是普利茅斯的船长与海军事务官，出身于造船匠和船长的家族。他与兄长威廉合营航运和私掠事业，约1559年结束合作。1560年代，他的船队无视西班牙的贸易禁令，把被掳的非洲人贩运到加勒比海的西班牙殖民地，成为第一个从大西洋奴隶贸易中获利的英格兰商人。任海军财务官期间，他改造伊丽莎白一世的舰队，使船只更快、火力更强；1588年他以副海军上将身份迎战西班牙无敌舰队，因战功受封骑士。儿子理查德被西班牙人俘虏后，他与德雷克筹组舰队出击西属西印度群岛，于1595年11月12日在波多黎各附近海上去世。

en: John Holland, 1st Duke of Exeter and Earl of Huntingdon (c. 1352–1400), was a half-brother and loyal supporter of Richard II. Made a Knight of the Garter in 1381, he killed Ralph Stafford during the 1385 Scottish expedition and forfeited his lands, which were restored after a reconciliation in 1386. That year he married Elizabeth, daughter of John of Gaunt, and served as constable of Gaunt's army in Spain. He was created Earl of Huntingdon in 1388. After helping arrest the Duke of Gloucester in 1397 he received the dukedom of Exeter, only to lose it when Henry IV took the throne in 1399. In January 1400 he joined the Epiphany Rising to restore Richard; after its failure he was captured in Essex and beheaded on 16 January 1400.
zh: 第一代埃克塞特公爵兼亨廷登伯爵约翰·霍兰（约1352—1400）是理查二世同母异父的兄长，也是他忠实的支持者。1381年他成为嘉德骑士，1385年征讨苏格兰时杀死拉尔夫·斯塔福德，领地被没收，次年和解后才获归还。1386年他娶冈特的约翰之女伊丽莎白为妻，并在冈特远征西班牙时担任军队统帅。1388年他受封亨廷登伯爵。1397年他协助逮捕格洛斯特公爵，因而受封埃克塞特公爵；1399年亨利四世夺位后，他被剥夺公爵头衔。1400年1月，他参与意在使理查复辟的主显节起义，事败后在埃塞克斯被捕，于1月16日被斩首。

en: John (1166–1216), nicknamed Lackland, the youngest son of Henry II and Eleanor of Aquitaine, succeeded his brother Richard I as king in 1199. He was made Lord of Ireland in 1177 and rebelled while Richard was on crusade. Renewed war with Philip II of France cost him Normandy and most of his continental lands by 1204. His quarrel with Pope Innocent III brought an interdict on England in 1208 and excommunication in 1209. After his allies' defeat at Bouvines in 1214, rebel barons forced him to seal Magna Carta in 1215. He died of dysentery amid the civil war in 1216.
zh: 约翰（1166—1216）绰号“无地王”，是亨利二世与阿基坦的埃莉诺的幼子，1199年继兄长理查一世之后登上王位。1177年他被封为爱尔兰领主，理查参加十字军期间他曾起兵反叛。与法兰西国王腓力二世重启战端后，到1204年他丧失了诺曼底和大陆上的大部分领地。他与教皇英诺森三世相争，导致英格兰在1208年被施以禁罚，他本人也于1209年被革除教籍。1214年他的盟军在布汶战败后，叛乱贵族于1215年强迫他签署《大宪章》。他在内战中于1216年患痢疾而死。

en: John de Grey, called John Marmion after his mother's family, was a son of the first Baron Grey of Rotherfield by Avice Marmion. He married Elizabeth St Quintin and died without issue in 1385, his niece Elizabeth becoming his heiress.
zh: 约翰·德·格雷随母家姓氏又称约翰·马米恩，是第一代罗瑟菲尔德的格雷男爵与续弦阿维斯·马米恩之子。他娶伊丽莎白·圣昆廷为妻，1385年去世且无子嗣，侄女伊丽莎白成为他的继承人。

en: John Milton (1608–1674) was an English poet and republican pamphleteer educated at Christ's College, Cambridge. In Areopagitica (1644) he attacked pre-publication censorship, a landmark defence of press freedom. In 1649 he became the Commonwealth's Secretary for Foreign Tongues, but by 1652 he was totally blind and dictated his work to amanuenses. At the Restoration in 1660 he was arrested and briefly imprisoned, and his books were burned. In retirement he dictated his epic Paradise Lost, published in 1667, portraying the temptation of Adam and Eve and their expulsion from Eden. Paradise Regained and Samson Agonistes followed in 1671. He died in London in 1674.
zh: 约翰·弥尔顿（1608—1674）是英格兰诗人与共和派政论家，曾在剑桥大学基督学院求学。1644年他发表《论出版自由》，抨击事前审查，成为捍卫出版自由的里程碑之作。1649年他出任英格兰共和国的外文事务秘书，但到1652年已完全失明，只能向助手口述作品。1660年王政复辟时他被捕下狱，著作也被焚毁。晚年他口述完成史诗《失乐园》（1667年出版），描写亚当和夏娃受到诱惑并被逐出伊甸园；随后又有1671年的《复乐园》和《力士参孙》。1674年他在伦敦去世。

en: John Montagu, 3rd Earl of Salisbury (c. 1350–1400), was an English nobleman and one of the firmest partisans of Richard II. A prominent Lollard, he also supported Richard's marriage to Isabella of Valois. He succeeded his uncle as Earl of Salisbury in 1397, helped bring about the fall of the Duke of Gloucester, and became a Knight of the Garter in 1399. He accompanied Richard on his last expedition to Ireland and was sent to Wales to raise forces against Henry Bolingbroke, but his men deserted. He was imprisoned in the Tower after Henry IV seized the throne. Released, he joined the Epiphany Rising of January 1400 to restore Richard; he was captured by townspeople at Cirencester and beheaded without trial on 7 January 1400.
zh: 第三代索尔兹伯里伯爵约翰·蒙塔古（约1350—1400）是英格兰贵族，也是理查二世最坚定的支持者之一。他是著名的罗拉德派信徒，也支持理查与瓦卢瓦的伊莎贝拉联姻。1397年他继承叔父的索尔兹伯里伯爵之位，参与扳倒格洛斯特公爵，1399年成为嘉德骑士。他随理查参加最后一次爱尔兰远征，奉命赴威尔士召集军队对抗亨利·博林布鲁克，但部众溃散。亨利四世夺位后，他被囚于伦敦塔。获释后，他于1400年1月参与意在复辟理查的主显节起义，在赛伦塞斯特被市民俘获，未经审判即于1月7日被斩首。

en: John de Montagu, 1st Baron Montagu (c. 1330-c. 1390), was a younger son of William Montagu, 1st Earl of Salisbury, and Catherine Grandison, and brother of the 2nd earl. Froissart names him among the participants at the Siege of Calais in 1349. He was summoned to parliament as Baron Montagu in 1357. He married Margaret de Monthermer, heiress of Thomas, 2nd Baron Monthermer; their son John inherited the earldom of Salisbury from his uncle in 1397 and became the 3rd earl.
zh: 约翰·德·蒙塔古，第一代蒙塔古男爵（约1330—约1390），是第一代索尔兹伯里伯爵威廉·蒙塔古与凯瑟琳·格兰迪森之子，第二代伯爵的弟弟。编年史家傅华萨记载他参加了1349年的加来围城战。1357年，他奉召进入议会，成为蒙塔古男爵。他娶了第二代蒙泰默男爵托马斯的女继承人玛格丽特·德·蒙泰默；他们的儿子约翰于1397年从伯父手中继承索尔兹伯里伯国，成为第三代伯爵。

en: John de Mowbray, 3rd Baron Mowbray (1310–1361), was the only son of the 2nd Baron, who was hanged after the Battle of Boroughbridge in 1322 for opposing Edward II; John and his mother were held in the Tower of London until 1327. Restored under Edward III, he married Joan, youngest daughter of Henry, 3rd Earl of Lancaster. He served at the sieges of Nantes and Aiguillon in the War of the Breton Succession and fought at Neville's Cross in 1346. He died of plague at York in October 1361.
zh: 约翰·德·莫布雷（1310—1361），第三代莫布雷男爵，是第二代男爵的独子。其父因反对爱德华二世，在1322年巴勒布里奇战役后被处以绞刑，约翰与母亲被关进伦敦塔，1327年才获释。他在爱德华三世治下恢复爵位，娶第三代兰开斯特伯爵亨利的幼女琼为妻。他参加了布列塔尼继承战争中的南特围城战与阿吉永围城战，并在1346年征战内维尔十字。1361年10月，他在约克死于瘟疫。

en: John of Eltham (1316–1336), Earl of Cornwall, was the second son of Edward II and Isabella of France and the younger brother of Edward III. Born at Eltham Palace, he was created earl in 1328, and during Edward III's absences he served as Guardian of the Realm and Warden of the northern Marches. In 1333 he was a leading commander at Halidon Hill, where the Scots were crushingly defeated, and he later led troops in south-western Scotland on behalf of Edward Balliol. He died at Perth, probably of fever, just after turning twenty and was buried in Westminster Abbey.
zh: 埃尔瑟姆的约翰（1316—1336），康沃尔伯爵，是爱德华二世与法兰西的伊莎贝拉的次子、爱德华三世的弟弟。他出生于埃尔瑟姆宫，1328年受封伯爵，爱德华三世外出期间，他担任王国摄政和北方边境长官。1333年，他作为主要将领之一参加哈利敦山战役，苏格兰人在此战中惨败；此后他又代爱德华·巴里奥率军进入苏格兰西南部。他刚满二十岁便在珀斯去世，很可能死于热病，葬于威斯敏斯特教堂。

en: John, 3rd Earl of Kent (7 April 1330 – 26 December 1352), was the posthumous son of Edmund of Woodstock, 1st Earl of Kent, executed three weeks before his birth. When his elder brother Edmund died in October 1331, the infant John succeeded to the earldom. He took part in the 1346 Crécy campaign and received his full inheritance from Edward III in 1347. On 3 April 1348 he married Isabella of Jülich by papal dispensation, and in 1349 inherited the Wake estates. He died childless at Woking in December 1352, his titles passing to his sister Joan of Kent.
zh: 第三代肯特伯爵约翰（1330年4月7日—1352年12月26日）是第一代肯特伯爵伍德斯托克的埃德蒙的遗腹子，父亲在他出生三周前被处决。1331年10月其兄埃德蒙夭折，尚在襁褓中的约翰承袭伯爵爵位。他参加了1346年以克雷西战役告终的军事行动，1347年从爱德华三世手中领回全部遗产。1348年4月3日，他凭教皇特许娶于利希的伊莎贝拉，1349年又继承韦克家族产业。1352年12月他在沃金无嗣而终，爵位传给姐姐肯特的琼安。

en: Sir John Oldcastle (c. 1370–1417) was a Herefordshire knight and Lollard leader. He fought against Owain Glyndŵr in Wales, commanding Builth and Kidwelly castles, and represented Herefordshire in parliament in 1404. He served as sheriff of Herefordshire from 1406 to 1407, and after marrying the Cobham heiress Joan in 1408 sat in parliament as Lord Cobham. A trusted soldier of Henry V, he was convicted of heresy in 1413 and escaped from the Tower of London. On the night of 9–10 January 1414 he led a Lollard rising that was scattered at St Giles's Fields. Captured in Wales in November 1417, he was hanged and burnt in London on 14 December.
zh: 约翰·奥尔德卡斯尔爵士（约1370—1417）是赫里福德郡骑士、罗拉德派领袖。他曾在威尔士同欧文·格林杜尔作战，担任比尔斯和基德韦利城堡守将，1404年代表赫里福德郡进入议会。他于1406至1407年任赫里福德郡长，1408年娶科巴姆家族继承人琼为妻后以科巴姆勋爵身份进入议会。他虽深得亨利五世信任，仍于1413年被判异端，并从伦敦塔逃脱。1414年1月9日至10日夜，他领导罗拉德派起义，在圣贾尔斯田野被击溃。1417年11月他在威尔士被捕，12月14日在伦敦被处以绞刑并焚烧。

en: John de Stratford (c. 1275–1348) was a civil lawyer from Stratford-on-Avon who became Bishop of Winchester in 1323 and Archbishop of Canterbury in 1333. In 1326 he joined Queen Isabella against Edward II, helped draw up the charges against the king and urged him to abdicate at Kenilworth. Under Edward III he was three times chancellor and the king's leading councillor. His quarrel with Edward after the king's return in 1340 helped establish that peers should be tried only in parliament. Reconciled, he led the council in 1345–1346 and died at Mayfield on 23 August 1348.
zh: 约翰·德·斯特拉特福（约1275—1348）是埃文河畔斯特拉特福出身的民法学家，1323年任温彻斯特主教，1333年任坎特伯雷大主教。1326年他加入伊莎贝拉王后反对爱德华二世的阵营，参与起草对国王的指控，并在凯尼尔沃思敦促被俘的爱德华二世退位。爱德华三世在位时他三度出任大法官，是国王最倚重的谋臣。1340年爱德华突然回国后，他与国王发生冲突，这场争执推动确立了贵族只能在议会受审的原则。和解后他于1345—1346年主持御前会议，1348年8月23日在梅菲尔德去世。

en: John Thornton of Coventry (fl. 1405–1433) was the leading English stained-glass painter of the early fifteenth century. In 1405 he contracted with the dean of York Minster to glaze the choir east window, a project funded by Walter Skirlaw, a former bishop of Coventry. He completed the Great East Window three years later; at 1680 square feet, it is the largest expanse of medieval stained glass in the world. Thornton himself designed its histories and images, became a freeman of York in 1410, returned to Coventry by 1413, and was again paid by York Minster in 1433. His workshop spread the International Gothic style across northern England and the Midlands.
zh: 约翰·桑顿（活动于1405—1433年）是15世纪初英格兰首屈一指的彩色玻璃窗画家，来自考文垂。1405年，他与约克座堂教长签约，为唱诗班席东窗绘制玻璃，这项工程由前考文垂主教沃尔特·斯克劳资助。三年后他完成大东窗；该窗面积约1680平方英尺，是世界上面积最大的中世纪彩色玻璃窗。窗上的故事与形象由桑顿亲手设计。他于1410年成为约克自由民，1413年前回到考文垂，1433年仍领取约克座堂的报酬。他的作坊把国际哥特式风格传播到英格兰北部和米德兰。

en: John de Warenne, 6th Earl of Surrey (1231–1304), was an English commander under Henry III and Edward I. In 1247 he married Henry III's half-sister Alice of Lusignan, a match resented by English nobles. In the Second Barons' War he changed sides twice, fighting for the king at Lewes in 1264 and Evesham in 1265. After the defeat at Lewes he fled to the Continent for about a year, and his confiscated estates were later restored. After serving in the Welsh campaigns of 1277–1283, where he began Holt Castle, Edward I made him warden of Scotland. He commanded at Dunbar in 1296 but was routed by William Wallace at Stirling Bridge in 1297 and fought at Falkirk in 1298. He died on 27 September 1304, leaving the earldom to his grandson.
zh: 第六代萨里伯爵约翰·德·瓦雷纳（1231—1304）是亨利三世与爱德华一世麾下的英格兰军事统帅。1247年，他迎娶亨利三世同母异父的妹妹吕西尼昂的爱丽丝，这桩婚事引起英格兰贵族的不满。第二次诸侯战争中他两度改换阵营，1264年在刘易斯战役、1265年在伊夫舍姆战役均为国王一方作战。刘易斯战败后他逃往欧洲大陆约一年，被没收的地产后来得到归还。参加1277—1283年的威尔士战事期间，他动工修建霍尔特城堡，此后被爱德华一世任命为苏格兰护国主。1296年他指挥英军取得邓巴战役的胜利，却在1297年的斯特灵桥战役中被威廉·华莱士击溃，1298年又参加了福尔柯克战役。他卒于1304年9月27日，伯爵爵位由孙子继承。

en: John de Warenne, 7th Earl of Surrey (1286–1347), was the last Warenne earl of Surrey. A minor when his grandfather died in 1304, he became a royal ward, received his lands in 1306, was knighted at the Feast of the Swans and married Edward I’s granddaughter Joan of Bar. The marriage was childless, and his attempts at divorce failed. In 1312 he helped capture Edward II’s favourite, Piers Gaveston. A private war with Thomas, Earl of Lancaster, cost him much of his estates; he sat in judgment on Lancaster in 1322 and recovered his Yorkshire lands in 1326. He and Arundel were the last earls loyal to Edward II, but after Arundel's execution he went over to Queen Isabella and urged the king's abdication in 1327. As guardian of Edward Balliol he accompanied his Scottish campaign and was named earl of Strathearn. He died at Conisbrough Castle in 1347, and the earldom passed to his nephew Richard FitzAlan.
zh: 第七代萨里伯爵约翰·德·瓦雷纳（1286—1347）是瓦雷纳家族最后一位萨里伯爵。1304年祖父去世时他尚未成年，成为王室监护对象，1306年取得继承的地产。同年他在天鹅宴上受封骑士，并娶爱德华一世的外孙女巴尔的琼为妻。这桩婚姻没有子女，他几度设法离婚，都没有成功。1312年他参与擒获爱德华二世的宠臣皮尔斯·加韦斯顿。他与兰开斯特伯爵托马斯的私人战争使他失去大部分地产；1322年他参与判处兰开斯特死刑，1326年收回约克郡的地产。他与阿伦德尔伯爵是最后两位仍忠于爱德华二世的伯爵，但阿伦德尔被处决后，他转而投靠伊莎贝拉王后，并在1327年促使国王退位。作为爱德华·巴里奥的监护人，他随巴里奥出征苏格兰争夺王位，受封斯特拉森伯爵。1347年他卒于科尼斯伯勒城堡，萨里伯爵爵位传给外甥理查德·菲茨艾伦。

en: John Wycliffe (c. 1328–1384) was an Oxford theologian born near Richmond, who became Master of Balliol College in 1361 and held the living of Lutterworth from 1374. After talks with papal envoys at Bruges, he attacked clerical wealth, indulgences and papal authority in On Civil Dominion, for which Pope Gregory XI condemned his theses in 1377. He argued that the clergy should live in poverty and that men in mortal sin had no right to exercise authority or own property. He is traditionally linked with an English Bible, and his followers were known as Lollards. He died at Lutterworth in 1384. The Council of Constance declared him a heretic, and in 1428 his bones were burned and cast into the River Swift.
zh: 约翰·威克里夫（约1328—1384）是牛津大学的神学家，生于里士满附近，1361年成为巴利奥尔学院院长，1374年起领有拉特沃思的教士俸禄。在布鲁日与教皇使节谈判后，他在《论世俗统治》中抨击教会财富、赎罪券和教皇权威，教皇格列高利十一世因此于1377年谴责他的论点。他主张神职人员应当清贫生活，身负大罪的人无权行使权力或拥有财产。传统认为他与一部英文圣经有关，他的追随者被称为罗拉德派。1384年，他在拉特沃思去世。康斯坦茨公会议宣布他为异端，1428年，他的遗骨被掘出焚毁，骨灰撒入斯威夫特河。

en: Sir Joshua Reynolds (1723–1792) was the leading English portrait painter of the 18th century and theorist of the Grand Style, which sought to idealise the imperfect. Born at Plympton in Devon, he was apprenticed to portraitist Thomas Hudson in 1740 and in 1749 spent two years in Rome studying the Old Masters. His sister Mary helped finance both his apprenticeship and his Italian journey. His prolific London studio produced more than two thousand paintings. In 1768 he became the first president of the Royal Academy of Arts, was knighted by George III in 1769 and delivered his influential Discourses from 1769 to 1790. He died in February 1792 and was buried in St Paul's Cathedral.
zh: 约书亚·雷诺兹爵士（1723—1792）是当时英国首屈一指的肖像画家，也是“宏大风格”的理论家，主张将不完美之物理想化。他生于德文郡的普林普顿，1740年师从伦敦肖像画家托马斯·哈德森，1749年赴罗马游学两年，研习古典大师的作品。他的姐姐玛丽为他的学徒生涯和意大利之行提供了部分资助。回到伦敦后，他高产的画室创作了两千余幅画作。1768年他成为皇家艺术学院首任院长，1769年被乔治三世封为爵士，并于1769至1790年在学院发表影响深远的《艺术演讲录》。1792年2月他去世，葬于圣保罗大教堂。

en: Katherine FitzAlan (1300–1328) was a daughter and co-heiress of Bryan FitzAlan, Lord FitzAlan of Bedale, by Maud de Balliol. Before 1313 she married John de Grey, first Baron Grey of Rotherfield, and was mother of the second baron.
zh: 凯瑟琳·菲茨艾伦（1300—1328）是比代尔的菲茨艾伦勋爵布莱恩·菲茨艾伦与莫德·德·巴里奥之女，与姐姐同为继承人。1313年之前她嫁给第一代罗瑟菲尔德的格雷男爵约翰·德·格雷，是第二代格雷男爵的母亲。

en: Julian of Norwich (c. 1343–after 1416) was an English anchoress enclosed in a cell at St Julian's Church, Norwich. On 8 May 1373, gravely ill at thirty, she received sixteen visions of Christ's Passion; she recovered on 13 May and wrote them down first in a Short Text and, decades later, in the Long Text called Revelations of Divine Love, the earliest surviving book in English by a woman. Her longer work explored the meaning of her visions after years of reflection. She gave spiritual counsel to the pilgrim Margery Kempe, and the Long Text remained in manuscript until first printed in 1670, long after Julian's death.
zh: 诺里奇的朱利安（约1343—1416年后）是英格兰的一位女隐修者，曾长期隐居于诺里奇圣朱利安教堂附设的隐修室中。1373年5月8日，年约三十、病危的她见到基督受难的十六次异象；她于5月13日痊愈，先把这些经历写成短本，数十年后又扩充为长本《神圣之爱的启示》，这是现存最早由女性撰写的英语著作。她在多年反思后于长本中探讨异象的意义，曾为朝圣者玛格丽·肯佩提供灵性指导。长本以抄本流传，直到她去世多年后的1670年才首次刊印。

en: Sir Edmund Mortimer (1302/1303 – 16 December 1331) was the eldest son of Roger Mortimer, 1st Earl of March, and Joan de Geneville. He married Elizabeth de Badlesmere at Kinlet in 1316. During his father's exile, Edmund was imprisoned at Windsor and then in the Tower of London from 1326; Edward III knighted him in 1327. His father was executed in 1330 and his lands and titles forfeited. Edmund regained the family lands at Wigmore in October 1331, but died of fever that December, leaving a young son, Roger.
zh: 埃德蒙·莫蒂默爵士（1302或1303年—1331年12月16日）是第一代马奇伯爵罗杰·莫蒂默与琼·德·热纳维尔的长子。1316年，他在金莱特与伊丽莎白·德·巴德斯米尔成婚。父亲流亡期间，埃德蒙被囚禁在温莎，1326年起转押伦敦塔；1327年，爱德华三世封他为骑士。1330年，他的父亲被处决，领地与爵位被没收。埃德蒙于1331年10月收回威格莫尔的家族领地，却在同年12月死于热病，留下年幼的儿子罗杰。

en: Laurence Hastings, 1st Earl of Pembroke (1319–1348), born at Allesley in Warwickshire, was the son of John Hastings, 2nd Baron Hastings. Succeeding as Baron Hastings in 1325, he inherited Valence lands and in 1339 Edward III made him Earl of Pembroke. He campaigned in Flanders in 1338, and in the Hundred Years' War fought in Brittany and Aquitaine with Henry of Grosmont, took Bergerac in 1345, defended Aiguillon in 1346, joined the Calais siege and commanded a blockading fleet in 1347. He married Agnes Mortimer and died at Abergavenny on 20 August 1348, leaving his son John as heir.
zh: 劳伦斯·黑斯廷斯，第一代彭布罗克伯爵（1319—1348），生于沃里克郡奥勒斯利，是第二代黑斯廷斯男爵约翰·黑斯廷斯之子。1325年他袭封黑斯廷斯男爵，继承了瓦朗斯家族的领地，1339年爱德华三世封他为彭布罗克伯爵。他1338年征战佛兰德，百年战争中随格罗斯蒙特的亨利在布列塔尼和阿基坦作战，1345年攻取贝尔热拉克，1346年镇守艾吉永，随后参加加来围城战，1347年率舰队封锁法国港口。他娶阿格尼丝·莫蒂默，1348年8月20日卒于阿伯加文尼，由儿子约翰袭爵。

en: Eleanor of Castile (1241–1290), daughter of Ferdinand III of Castile and Joan of Ponthieu, married the future Edward I at Las Huelgas near Burgos in 1254. The marriage followed diplomacy to secure English sovereignty over Gascony. During the Second Barons' War, Simon de Montfort's government imprisoned her at Westminster Palace. She accompanied Edward on the Ninth Crusade in 1270–1271 and was with him when an assassin's dagger wounded him at Acre. From 1279 she held Ponthieu as countess suo jure and amassed large estates in England; her property dealings made her unpopular. She died at Harby near Lincoln in November 1290; the grieving Edward erected memorial crosses, later called the Eleanor crosses, at each place her funeral cortège stopped on its way to London.
zh: 卡斯蒂利亚的埃莉诺（1241—1290）是卡斯蒂利亚国王斐迪南三世与蓬蒂厄女伯爵让娜之女，1254年在布尔戈斯附近的拉斯韦尔加斯修道院嫁给后来的爱德华一世。这场婚姻是确保英格兰对加斯科涅主权的外交交涉的结果。第二次男爵战争期间，西蒙·德·蒙福尔的政府将她囚禁在威斯敏斯特宫。1270至1271年，她随爱德华参加第九次十字军东征，爱德华在阿卡遭刺客匕首所伤时她陪在身边。1279年起她以本人身份受封蓬蒂厄女伯爵，在英格兰积聚了大片地产；地产交易使她不受欢迎。1290年11月她逝于林肯附近的哈比；悲痛的爱德华在她灵柩运往伦敦途中的每一处停灵地竖立纪念十字架，后世称为“埃莉诺十字”。

en: Luisa Carvajal y Mendoza (1566–1614) was a Spanish noblewoman born at Jaraicejo in Extremadura. Orphaned young, she was cared for first by her aunt in Madrid and then raised by her uncle, the Marquis of Almazán. She studied literature and theology and in 1598 took a formal vow of martyrdom. In late 1605 she reached London to join the Catholic underground, teaching, tending the poor and visiting imprisoned priests. She was jailed in 1608 after preaching in Cheapside, and again in October 1613, when Archbishop George Abbot charged her with founding a convent. Released into Spanish custody and ordered expelled, she died of bronchial fever at the embassy on 2 January 1614.
zh: 路易莎·卡瓦哈尔（1566—1614）是西班牙贵族女子，生于埃斯特雷马杜拉的哈拉伊塞霍。她幼年父母双亡，先由马德里的姨母照料，后由叔父阿尔马桑侯爵抚养。她学习文学和神学，于1598年正式立下殉道誓愿。1605年底她前往伦敦加入天主教地下团体，在当地教书、救济穷人、探望入狱神父。1608年她因在奇普赛德街头传教被捕；1613年10月坎特伯雷大主教乔治·阿博特又以开办女修会为由将她逮捕。她获释后被交由西班牙使馆看管并被勒令离境，却在1614年1月2日因支气管热病死于使馆。

en: Lady Margaret Beaufort (1443–1509) was an English noblewoman of the Wars of the Roses and mother of Henry VII, founder of the Tudor dynasty. Daughter of John Beaufort, Duke of Somerset, she inherited a contested claim to the throne. She married Edmund Tudor, Earl of Richmond, and in 1457, aged thirteen, bore her only child, the future Henry VII, to whom she passed that claim. She conspired against Richard III, and her husband Thomas Stanley's intervention helped win Bosworth Field in 1485. Under her son's rule she wielded great influence, patronised printing and learning, founded Christ's College, Cambridge, in 1505 and began the foundation of St John's College. She died on 29 June 1509; her executors completed St John's in 1511.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/玛格丽特·博福特女领主
zh: 玛格丽特·博福特女领主（1443—1509）是玫瑰战争时期的英格兰贵族女性，也是都铎王朝开国君主亨利七世的母亲。她是萨默塞特公爵约翰·博福特之女，继承了有争议的王位宣称。她嫁给里士满伯爵埃德蒙·都铎，1457年年仅十三岁时生下独子，即后来的亨利七世，并将王位宣称传给他。她密谋反对理查三世，1485年博斯沃思原野战役中，她的丈夫托马斯·斯坦利出兵相助，帮助奠定胜局。儿子在位期间她权势很大，奖掖印书与学术，1505年创办剑桥大学基督学院，又着手创办圣约翰学院。她于1509年6月29日去世，遗嘱执行人于1511年完成圣约翰学院的创办。

en: Margaret of Kent (1327–1352) was the elder daughter of Edmund of Woodstock, 1st Earl of Kent, and a sister of Joan of Kent, the Fair Maid of Kent.
zh: 肯特的玛格丽特（1327—1352）是第一代肯特伯爵伍德斯托克的埃德蒙的长女，“肯特的美少女”琼安的姐姐。

en: Margaret of Norfolk (c. 1322–1399) was the daughter of Thomas of Brotherton, Earl of Norfolk and eldest son of Edward I. After her brother Edward died without issue in 1334, she and her sister Alice became their father's heirs; in 1338 Margaret succeeded to the earldom of Norfolk and the hereditary office of Earl Marshal. Married in 1335 to John de Segrave, 4th Baron Segrave, she sought an annulment in 1350 and crossed the Channel in disguise against Edward III's prohibition. After Segrave died in 1353 she married Walter Manny, 1st Baron Manny. In 1397 Richard II created her Duchess of Norfolk for life.
zh: 诺福克的玛格丽特（约1322—1399）是诺福克伯爵、爱德华一世长子托马斯·布拉泽顿之女。其兄爱德华于1334年无嗣而终后，她与妹妹艾丽斯成为父亲的继承人；1338年玛格丽特承袭诺福克伯爵爵位与世袭军务伯爵职衔。1335年她嫁给第四代西格雷夫男爵约翰·德·西格雷夫，1350年向教廷请求废除婚姻，并不顾爱德华三世禁令化装渡海前往大陆。1353年西格雷夫死后，她改嫁第一代曼尼男爵沃尔特·曼尼。1397年，理查二世封她为终身诺福克女公爵。

en: Margaret Percy was a daughter of Henry Percy, 2nd Baron Percy of Alnwick. In 1340 she married Sir Robert d'Umfraville, and later became the second wife of William Ferrers, 3rd Baron Ferrers of Groby. She died in 1375.
zh: 玛格丽特·珀西是第二代阿尼克珀西男爵亨利·珀西之女。1340年嫁给罗贝尔·德昂弗拉维尔爵士，后成为第三代格鲁比的费勒斯男爵威廉·费勒斯的第二任妻子，1375年去世。

en: Margaret of France (c. 1279 – 14 February 1318) was Queen of England as the second wife of Edward I, and a daughter of Philip III of France and Marie of Brabant. Treaties agreed in 1299 married the twenty-year-old Margaret to the sixty-year-old king on 10 September, returned Guyenne to England, and betrothed her niece Isabella to Edward's heir. For reasons of cost she was never crowned. She bore Thomas of Brotherton in 1300, Edmund of Woodstock in 1301 and Eleanor in 1306, never remarried after Edward I died in 1307, and died in 1318.
zh: 法兰西的玛格丽特（约1279年—1318年2月14日）是英格兰国王爱德华一世的第二任王后，法王腓力三世与布拉班特的玛丽之女。1299年的和约安排20岁的玛格丽特于9月10日嫁给60岁的爱德华一世，吉耶纳归还英格兰，她的侄女伊莎贝拉则许配给王储。因财政原因，她从未举行加冕礼。她于1300年生下布劳瑟顿的托马斯、1301年生下伍德斯托克的埃德蒙、1306年生下埃莉诺；1307年爱德华一世去世后她没有再嫁，1318年去世。

en: Mary Stewart, said to be a daughter of Walter the Steward of Scotland, married Sir Aymer de Strathbogie, who sat in the English Parliament of 1381 as Knight of the Shire for Northumberland. They had children and were buried together in Newcastle upon Tyne.
zh: 玛丽·斯图尔特相传是苏格兰王室总务官沃尔特·斯图尔特之女，嫁给艾梅·德·斯特拉斯博吉爵士；他于1381年任诺森伯兰郡选骑士。两人育有子女，合葬于纽卡斯尔。

en: Maud de Balliol (born 1257, alive after 1340) was a daughter of John I de Balliol and Dervorguilla of Galloway, and a sister of King John Balliol of Scots. She married Bryan FitzAlan, Lord FitzAlan of Bedale; their daughter Agnes married Sir Gilbert Stapleton.
zh: 莫德·德·巴利奥尔（1257年生，1340年后仍在世）是约翰一世·德·巴利奥尔与加洛韦的德沃尔吉拉之女，苏格兰国王约翰·巴利奥尔的姐妹。她嫁给比代尔的菲茨艾伦领主布赖恩·菲茨艾伦；女儿阿格尼丝嫁给吉尔伯特·斯特普尔顿爵士。

en: Maud de Chaworth (2 February 1282 – 3 December 1322) was the only child of Patrick de Chaworth, lord of Kidwelly in South Wales, and Isabella de Beauchamp. Her father died in 1283, leaving her a wealthy heiress and a ward of Queen Eleanor; in 1286 her mother married Hugh Despenser the Elder, making Hugh Despenser the Younger her half-brother. In 1292 Edward I granted her marriage to Edmund Crouchback, and before March 1297 she married Edmund's son Henry, later Earl of Lancaster. She bore seven children, among them Henry of Grosmont.
zh: 莫德·德·查沃思（1282年2月2日—1322年12月3日）是南威尔士基德韦利领主帕特里克·德·查沃思与伊莎贝拉·德·比彻姆唯一的孩子。1283年父亲去世后，她成为富有的女继承人，由埃莉诺王后监护；1286年母亲改嫁老休·德斯潘塞，因此小休·德斯潘塞是她的同母异父弟弟。1292年，爱德华一世把她的婚姻支配权授予埃德蒙·克劳奇贝克；1297年3月之前，她嫁给埃德蒙之子、后来的兰开斯特伯爵亨利。她生有七个子女，其中包括亨利·格罗斯蒙特。

en: Maud of Lancaster (c. 1310–1377) was a daughter of Henry, 3rd Earl of Lancaster, and Maud Chaworth. In 1327 she married William de Burgh, 3rd Earl of Ulster, and lived in Ireland, where their daughter Elizabeth was born. After William was murdered near Carrickfergus in 1333, she fled with her infant daughter to Edward III's court, where she long influenced Irish appointments. Her second husband, Ralph de Ufford, was Justiciar of Ireland until his death in 1346. Widowed again, she became a canoness at Campsey Priory, later a Poor Clare at Bruisyard Abbey, where she died 5 May 1377.
zh: 兰开斯特的莫德（约1310—1377）是第三代兰开斯特伯爵亨利与莫德·德·查沃思的女儿。1327年，她嫁给第三代阿尔斯特伯爵威廉·德·伯格，随丈夫住在爱尔兰，女儿伊丽莎白就出生在那里。1333年威廉在卡里克弗格斯附近遇害后，她带着襁褓中的女儿逃回英格兰，投奔爱德华三世的宫廷，并长期影响爱尔兰的官员任命。她的第二任丈夫拉尔夫·德·厄福德曾任爱尔兰总督，1346年去世。再次守寡后，她在坎普西修道院成为修女，后来转入布鲁西雅德修道院加入贫穷修女会，1377年5月5日在该院去世。

en: Maud Mortimer (c. 1307–after 1345) was an English noblewoman, probably the second daughter of Roger Mortimer, 1st Earl of March, and Joan de Geneville. Before 13 April 1319 she married John Charlton, heir to John Charlton, 1st Baron Charlton, Lord of Powys.
