When her father surrendered after his failed revolt against Edward II in January 1322, Maud, unlike several of her siblings, was not arrested, even though her father-in-law had joined the same rising; he was pardoned later that year. She was the mother of John Charlton, 3rd Baron Charlton.
zh: 莫德·莫蒂默（约1307—1345年后）是英格兰贵族女子，可能是第一代马奇伯爵罗杰·莫蒂默与琼·德·热内维尔的次女。1319年4月13日前，她嫁给波伊斯领主、第一代查尔顿男爵约翰·查尔顿的继承人约翰·查尔顿。1322年1月，其父起兵反抗爱德华二世失败投降，与几名兄弟姐妹不同，莫德没有被捕，尽管她的公公也参加了同一场叛乱；公公于同年获赦。她是第三代查尔顿男爵约翰·查尔顿的母亲。

en: Maud Percy (c. 1340–1379), a daughter of Henry de Percy, 2nd Baron Percy, and Idonia Clifford, married John Neville, 3rd Baron Neville, before 1362. She bore two sons and five daughters, including Ralph Neville, 1st Earl of Westmorland, and was buried at Durham Cathedral.
zh: 莫德·珀西（约1340—1379）是第二代珀西男爵亨利·德·珀西与伊多妮娅·克利福德之女，1362年前嫁给第三代内维尔男爵约翰·内维尔。她生下两个儿子、五个女儿，其中包括第一代威斯特摩兰伯爵拉尔夫·内维尔，身后葬于达勒姆大教堂。

en: Sir Miles Stapleton of Bedale (c. 1316–1364), eldest son of Sir Gilbert Stapleton and Agnes FitzAlan, was an English knight and a founder Knight of the Garter. Through his father he was a great-grandson of Dervorguilla of Galloway, mother of the Scottish king John Balliol. His father died in 1321 when Miles was an infant. He served at the siege of Tournai in 1340 with his younger brother Brian, fought in the Breton War of Succession, and was probably at Calais in 1347. In 1348 he took the seventeenth stall of the new Order of the Garter. In 1354 he joined an embassy to Pope Innocent VI asking for help in the Anglo-French war. In 1361 the crown granted him an annuity of £100 for his unwearied labours. He probably joined a Prussian crusade in 1363 and died in December 1364, perhaps of wounds from Auray.
zh: 比代尔的迈尔斯·斯特普尔顿爵士（约1316—1364）是吉尔伯特·斯特普尔顿爵士与阿格尼丝·菲茨艾伦的长子，英格兰骑士，也是嘉德骑士团的创始骑士之一。按父系，他是加洛韦的德沃吉拉的曾孙，德沃吉拉是苏格兰国王约翰·巴里奥之母。1321年父亲去世时，他还是个婴儿。1340年他与弟弟布赖恩一同参加图尔奈围城战，此后在布列塔尼继承战争中作战，1347年很可能参加了加来围城战。1348年嘉德骑士团创立时，他获得第17号席位。1354年他随使团觐见教宗英诺森六世，请求教廷介入英法战争。1361年，王室因他不知疲倦的辛劳，授予他每年100镑的年金。1363年他很可能参加了普鲁士十字军，1364年12月去世，可能因欧赖战役所受的伤而死。

en: Nicholas of Hereford (died 1420) was an Oxford theologian and a leading follower of John Wycliffe. Ordained a priest in 1370, he became a Doctor of Theology and briefly chancellor of the University of Oxford in 1382. He criticised the Church's luxury and defended the right of Christians to read the Bible for themselves. He helped produce Wycliffe's English Bible, translating much of the Old Testament by 1382. Condemned for heresy that same year, he appealed to Pope Urban VI in Rome and was imprisoned before escaping in 1385. Back in England he was jailed again, but recanted in 1391 and later held offices at Hereford and St Paul's, dying as a Carthusian in Coventry in 1420.
zh: 赫里福德的尼古拉斯（？—1420）是牛津神学家、约翰·威克里夫的主要追随者。他于1370年受任神父，1382年获神学博士学位，并短暂出任牛津大学校长。他批评教会生活奢华，维护基督徒自行阅读圣经的权利。他参与编写威克里夫英文圣经，到1382年译出《旧约》的大部分。同年他被判异端，前往罗马向教皇乌尔班六世申诉却被囚禁，1385年越狱。回到英格兰后他再度入狱，1391年宣布放弃原有主张，此后在赫里福德和圣保罗座堂任职，最终加入加尔都西会，1420年在考文垂去世。

en: Oliver Cromwell (1599–1658) was an English Puritan gentleman from Huntingdon who became the leading soldier and statesman of the Parliamentarian cause. He became a religious Independent in the 1630s and came to regard his successes as signs of divine providence. Returned to Parliament in 1640, he raised cavalry when the First English Civil War broke out in 1642 and commanded the New Model Army's cavalry under Thomas Fairfax from 1645. He helped defeat Charles I, whom he pressed to have executed in January 1649. His brutal conquest of Ireland followed the same year; further victories in Scotland secured the Commonwealth. He ruled as Lord Protector from December 1653 until his death in September 1658, when his son Richard succeeded him.
zh: 奥利弗·克伦威尔（1599—1658）是英格兰亨廷登的清教徒乡绅，后来成为议会阵营最重要的军人与政治家。1630年代他成为独立派信徒，此后将自己的成功视为上天眷顾的征兆。他在1640年当选议员，1642年第一次英国内战爆发后组建骑兵，1645年起在托马斯·费尔法克斯麾下指挥新模范军骑兵。他助力击败国王查理一世，并力主在1649年1月将其处死。同年，他以残酷手段征服爱尔兰；随后在苏格兰的胜利巩固了共和国。1653年12月，他就任护国公，直至1658年9月去世，由儿子理查继任。

en: Owain ap Thomas ap Rhodri, called Owain Lawgoch, ‘red-handed Owain’ (c. 1330–1378), was a Welsh soldier and the last male-line heir of the princely House of Aberffraw, a descendant of Llywelyn the Great and claimant to the title of Prince of Wales. As captain of a largely Welsh free company, known to the French as Yvain de Galles, he fought the English for Charles V. He lost his English lands in 1369, when war resumed after the truce. In a treaty with Charles he declared that English kings had slain or driven out his ancestors and wrongly held Wales, and the French king promised men and ships to win it back. No invasion ever landed: Owain attacked Guernsey, but Charles ordered him to seek ships in Castile. At Soubise he defeated an English and Gascon force and captured Thomas Percy and Jean de Grailly. An English agent assassinated him at the siege of Mortagne in July 1378.
zh: 欧文·阿普·托马斯·阿普·罗德里，人称欧文·劳戈赫，意为‘红手欧文’（约1330—1378），是威尔士军人，也是阿伯弗劳王公家族最后的男系继承人，为大卢埃林的后裔，并以威尔士亲王头衔的继承人自居。他作为一支以威尔士人为主的自由兵团的队长，被法国人称作‘伊万·德·加勒斯’，为法王查理五世对英作战。1369年休战结束、战事重开时，他失去了在英格兰的土地。他在与查理订立的条约中宣称，英格兰诸王杀害或驱逐了他的先祖，并非法占据威尔士，法王则许诺提供人马和舰船助他夺回。入侵却始终未能登陆：欧文进攻根西岛，查理却命他前往卡斯蒂利亚寻找船只。在苏比斯，他击败英格兰与加斯科涅联军，俘虏托马斯·珀西和让·德·格赖伊。1378年7月围攻莫尔塔涅时，他被英格兰刺客暗杀。

en: Philippa of Hainault (c. 1310–1369), daughter of William I, Count of Hainaut, and Joan of Valois, was engaged in 1326 to Edward, Prince of Wales, and married him at York Minster in January 1328, months after he took the throne in the wake of Queen Isabella's invasion. As queen she turned Edward's attention to England's commercial expansion, went with him to Scotland and France, served as regent in 1346 and was present at the victory of Neville's Cross. In 1347 she persuaded him to spare the Burghers of Calais, a mercy that won her the affection of the English. Her chaplain Robert de Eglesfield founded Queen's College, Oxford, in her honour. She died of an illness at Windsor Castle in August 1369, after a happy forty-year marriage, and was buried in Westminster Abbey, where Edward was laid beside her eight years later. She left thirteen children, whose descendants' rivalry later brought on the Wars of the Roses.
zh: 埃诺的菲莉帕（约1310—1369）是埃诺伯爵威廉一世与瓦卢瓦的让娜之女。1326年她与威尔士亲王爱德华订婚；1328年1月，在爱德华借王后伊莎贝拉入侵英格兰而登上王位数月之后，两人在约克大教堂成婚。作为王后，她促使丈夫关注英格兰的商业扩张，随他前往苏格兰和法兰西，1346年出任摄政，并亲临内维尔十字之战的胜利。1347年，她说服国王赦免加来义民，这份怜悯使她深得英格兰人的爱戴。她的随侍神父罗伯特·德·埃格尔斯菲尔德为纪念她创立了牛津王后学院。1369年8月她病逝于温莎城堡，结束了四十年美满的婚姻；她葬于威斯敏斯特教堂，八年后爱德华也安葬在她身旁。她留下十三个子女，后裔之间的争夺后来引发了玫瑰战争。

en: Ralph Neville, 2nd Baron Neville of Raby (c. 1291–1367), son of the first Lord Neville, was a leading soldier of the English north. In January 1326 he married Alice de Audley, who bore him thirteen children including his heir John and Alexander, Archbishop of York. He served as a warden of the Scottish marches and as Admiral of the North. His greatest feat came in 1346, when he led the English army to a crushing victory over a Scottish invasion at the Battle of Neville's Cross near Durham and captured King David II. He died on 5 August 1367.
zh: 第二代拉比的内维尔男爵拉尔夫·内维尔（约1291—1367）是第一代内维尔男爵之子，也是英格兰北部的重要将领。1326年1月，他娶艾丽斯·德·奥德利为妻，育有十三个子女，包括继承人约翰和后来的约克大主教亚历山大。他出任苏格兰边境的边防长官，还曾担任北方海军司令。他最显赫的战功在1346年：率英军在达勒姆附近的内维尔十字之战中大败入侵的苏格兰军队，并俘虏苏格兰国王大卫二世。他于1367年8月5日去世。

en: Pocahontas (c. 1596–1617), later baptized Rebecca, was the daughter of Powhatan, leader of the Powhatan Confederacy in Virginia. After the English founded Jamestown she became linked with the colony, and John Smith made their encounters famous. Seized for ransom by the colonists during hostilities in 1613, she converted to Christianity and in April 1614 married the tobacco planter John Rolfe. Their son Thomas was born in 1615. The couple travelled to London in 1616, where she was presented to English society to encourage investment in Jamestown. She was fêted at court and attended a masque at Whitehall. She died at Gravesend in March 1617, about to return to Virginia.
zh: 宝嘉康蒂（约1596—1617），受洗后取名丽贝卡，是弗吉尼亚波瓦坦联盟首领波瓦坦之女。英格兰人建立詹姆斯敦后，她与殖民地产生关联，约翰·史密斯让两人的交往广为人知。1613年，殖民者在敌对冲突中将她掳走勒索赎金；其间她皈依基督教，1614年4月嫁给烟草种植者约翰·罗尔夫，二人的儿子托马斯于1615年出生。1616年夫妇二人前往伦敦，她被介绍给英格兰社会，以吸引对詹姆斯敦的投资。她在宫廷受到款待，还出席了白厅宫的一场假面剧。1617年3月，即将返回弗吉尼亚之际，她在格雷夫森德去世。

en: Sir Richard Arkwright (1732–1792) was an English inventor and industrialist of the early Industrial Revolution, born at Preston on 23 December 1732. Starting as a barber and wig-maker, he used income from a waterproof wig dye to fund machinery. He turned to cotton spinning and in 1769 patented the spinning frame, later called the water frame, which produced strong thread suitable for warp. In 1771, with Jedediah Strutt and Samuel Need, he built a water-powered mill at Cromford in Derbyshire, combining mechanised carding and spinning under one roof and creating the model for the factory system. His patents were overturned in court in 1785, but he was knighted in 1786 and died on 3 August 1792.
zh: 理查德·阿克莱特爵士（1732—1792）是英国工业革命早期的发明家与实业家，1732年12月23日生于普雷斯顿。他早年做过理发师和假发匠，用防水假发染料的收入资助机械研制。他后来转而研究棉纺，1769年取得纺纱机（后称水力纺纱机）的专利，机器能纺出适合作经纱的坚韧棉线。1771年，他与杰迪代亚·斯特拉特、塞缪尔·尼德合作，在德比郡克罗姆福德建成水力纺纱厂，把机械化的梳棉与纺纱集中在同一厂房，开创了现代工厂制度的范本。他的专利于1785年被法庭推翻，但他在1786年受封爵士，1792年8月3日去世。

en: Richard Chancellor (c. 1521–1556) was a Bristol-born navigator who opened England's trade with Russia. In 1553 he sailed as second-in-command of Hugh Willoughby's expedition in search of a north-east passage to Asia; its London merchant backers also sought a market for English woollen cloth. Separated by storms, his ship the Edward Bonaventure reached the White Sea, and he travelled by sleigh to Moscow, where Tsar Ivan IV granted English merchants trading privileges. Willoughby and his men died on the Kola Peninsula. Chancellor returned in 1554 and helped form the Muscovy Company, revisiting Russia in 1555. Sailing home with Russia's first ambassador to England, he was drowned when his ship was wrecked off the Scottish coast on 10 November 1556.
zh: 理查德·钱塞勒（约1521—1556）是布里斯托尔出生的航海家，开启了英格兰与俄罗斯的贸易。1553年，他作为休·威洛比探险队的副指挥出航，寻找通往亚洲的东北航道；资助远航的伦敦商人也希望为英格兰毛呢寻找市场。风暴中船队失散，他的座船“爱德华·博纳文图尔号”驶入白海，他随后乘雪橇抵达莫斯科，沙皇伊凡四世赐予英格兰商人贸易特权。威洛比及其船员则死于科拉半岛。1554年钱塞勒回国，参与组建莫斯科公司，1555年再赴俄罗斯。1556年他携俄罗斯首位驻英使节返航，途中座船于11月10日在苏格兰近海失事，他溺水身亡。

en: Richard FitzAlan, Earl of Arundel (1267–1302), inherited the earldom and the Welsh Marcher lordships of Clun and Oswestry from his father John in 1272. Knighted by Edward I in 1289, the year he came of age and entered parliament, he fought through the Welsh wars of 1288–1294 and led a force to relieve Castell y Bere when Madog ap Llywelyn besieged it. His opposition to the king during the political crisis of 1295 left him heavily indebted and cost him part of his lands. He then campaigned in Gascony from 1295 to 1297 and in Edward's Scottish wars between 1298 and 1300. Before 1285 he married Alice of Saluzzo, daughter of the marquess of Saluzzo; their son Edmund succeeded him.
zh: 阿伦德尔伯爵理查德·菲查伦（1267—1302）于1272年继承父亲约翰的伯爵头衔，以及威尔士边境的克伦和奥斯沃斯特里领地。1289年他成年，受爱德华一世册封为骑士并进入议会。1288至1294年他参加威尔士战争，马多格·阿普·卢埃林围攻卡斯特尔伊贝尔城堡时，他率部解围。1295年政治危机中，他反对国王，结果负债累累，部分领地被没收。1295至1297年他转战加斯科涅，1298至1300年又投入爱德华一世的苏格兰战争。1285年前，他娶了萨卢佐侯爵之女萨卢佐的爱丽丝；他们的儿子埃德蒙继承了爵位。

en: Richard Fitzalan, earl of Arundel (c. 1313–1376), was the son of Edmund Fitzalan and Alice de Warenne. His father backed the Despensers, and Richard was married as a boy to Hugh the Younger’s daughter Isabel; the father was executed in 1326, and Richard inherited neither title nor estates. By 1330 politics had shifted, and he gradually recovered the earldom and the family holdings in Sussex and the Welsh Marches. He became a trusted commander of Edward III and justiciar of North Wales in 1334. As Admiral of the West he fought at Sluys in 1340 and was one of three principal commanders at Crécy in 1346, guarding the Black Prince in the rearguard and fought the Castilians off Winchelsea in 1350. In 1344 the pope annulled his Despenser marriage as one made underage and unwilling; in 1345 he married Eleanor of Lancaster, the king attending. He died at Arundel Castle on 24 January 1376, leaving sixty thousand pounds in cash.
zh: 阿伦德尔伯爵理查德·菲查伦（约1313—1376）是埃德蒙·菲查伦与艾丽斯·德·瓦伦之子。其父支持德斯潘塞父子，年幼的理查德还娶了小休·德斯潘塞之女伊莎贝尔；父亲却于1326年被处死，理查德既没有继承爵位，也没有继承地产。到1330年政局转向，他逐步夺回伯爵爵位以及家族在苏塞克斯和威尔士边境地区的地产。他成为爱德华三世信任的将领，1334年获任北威尔士司法长官。1340年他以西方舰队司令身份参加斯勒伊斯海战，1346年又作为英军三位主要指挥官之一在克雷西作战，于后军护卫年幼的黑太子，又于1350年在温切尔西外海与卡斯蒂利亚舰队交锋。1344年，教宗以婚时年幼、非出自本人意愿为由撤销了他与德斯潘塞之女的婚姻；1345年，他迎娶兰开斯特的埃莉诺，国王亲自出席婚礼。他于1376年1月24日卒于阿伦德尔城堡，留下六万英镑现金。

en: Richard I (1157–1199), called the Lionheart, third son of Henry II and Eleanor of Aquitaine, was king of England from 1189. By sixteen he was commanding troops against rebels in Poitou. He led the Third Crusade after Philip II of France left, winning victories over Saladin in 1191 but failing to retake Jerusalem. On his return he was captured near Vienna by Leopold of Austria in 1192 and held for ransom by Emperor Henry VI until 1194. He spent his remaining years defending his French lands against Philip, and in 1199 died while besieging Châlus in the Limousin.
zh: 理查一世（1157—1199），绰号“狮心王”，是亨利二世与阿基坦的埃莉诺的第三子，1189年起为英格兰国王。他十六岁便率军平定普瓦图针对父亲的叛乱。法兰西国王腓力二世回国后，他统领第三次十字军东征，1191年多次击败萨拉丁，但未能收复耶路撒冷。归途上他于1192年在维也纳附近被奥地利公爵利奥波德俘获，交由神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利六世囚禁，1194年才靠赎金获释。晚年他对腓力二世作战、保卫在法兰西的领地，1199年在利穆赞围攻沙吕时死去。

en: Richard of Cornwall (1209–1272), second son of King John and Isabella of Angoulême, was made Earl of Cornwall by his brother Henry III in 1225, and his Cornish revenues made him among Europe's richest men. His relations with Henry were often strained, and he rebelled against him three times. In 1231 he married Isabel Marshal, joining a powerful family that often opposed the king. He joined the Barons' Crusade in 1240, negotiating the release of Christian prisoners and refortifying Ascalon. In 1257 he bought election as King of the Romans for twenty-eight thousand marks, defeating Alfonso X of Castile, and was crowned at Aachen. Captured in a windmill after Lewes in 1264, he was held until September 1265 and died at Berkhamsted on 2 April 1272.
zh: 康沃尔的理查（1209—1272）是英格兰国王约翰与昂古莱姆的伊莎贝拉的次子。1225年，兄长亨利三世封他为康沃尔伯爵，来自康沃尔的收入使他成为欧洲最富有的人之一。他与亨利的关系常常紧张，曾三次反叛兄长。1231年，他迎娶伊莎贝尔·马歇尔，与这个常常反对国王的强大家族联姻。1240年他参加诸爵十字军，通过谈判解救基督徒战俘，并重新加固阿什凯隆城。1257年，他以两万八千马克收买选帝侯，在与卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十世的竞争中当选罗马人的国王，并在亚琛加冕。1264年刘易斯战役后他躲进一座风车被俘，关押至1265年9月，最终于1272年4月2日在伯克姆斯特德城堡去世。

en: Robert Aske (c. 1500–1537) was a Yorkshire barrister who led the Pilgrimage of Grace, the rising of 1536 against Henry VIII's dissolution of the monasteries. Returning from London when rebellion broke out, he took up the rebels' cause as the rising spread across Yorkshire and other northern counties. As chief captain from 10 October he headed nine thousand insurgents who occupied York, restored expelled monks and nuns to their houses, and demanded a parliament in the North. In November he negotiated with the Duke of Norfolk and went to London, where the king promised redress and safe passage. When fighting resumed, Henry had him seized; Aske was convicted of treason and executed at York on 12 July 1537.
zh: 罗伯特·阿斯克（约1500—1537）是约克郡的执业律师，领导了1536年反对亨利八世解散修道院的起义“求恩巡礼”。起义爆发时他正从伦敦返乡，随后加入起义者，起事蔓延至约克郡及北方其他郡。自10月10日起他被推为总首领，率九千人占领约克，把遭驱逐的修士、修女送回修道院，并要求在北方召开议会。11月，他与诺福克公爵谈判，随后前往伦敦，国王答应纠正弊政并保证他安全通行。战事再起后，亨利下令将他逮捕；阿斯克以叛国罪被定罪，于1537年7月12日在约克被处死。

en: Robert Blake (1598–1657) was an English naval commander born in Somerset. He studied at Wadham College, Oxford, before inheriting the family estate in 1625 and helping to raise his younger siblings. He fought for Parliament in the Civil War, holding Lyme Regis in 1644 and Taunton in 1645. Made a general at sea in 1649, he pursued Prince Rupert's fleet from Ireland to the Mediterranean, and fought the Dutch at Dungeness (1652) and the Gabbard (1653); the Fighting Instructions issued by Blake and fellow commanders in 1653 codified the line-ahead formation. He burned the corsair fleet at Porto Farina in 1655 and destroyed the Spanish treasure fleet at Santa Cruz de Tenerife in April 1657. He died off Plymouth in August 1657.
zh: 罗伯特·布莱克（1598—1657）是生于萨默塞特的英格兰海军将领。他曾在牛津大学瓦德汉学院求学，1625年继承家产后帮助抚养年幼的弟妹。内战期间他为议会军作战，1644年坚守莱姆里吉斯，1645年坚守汤顿。1649年他被任命为海上将官，随后追击鲁珀特亲王的舰队，从爱尔兰一直追到地中海；第一次英荷战争中，他先后在邓杰内斯（1652）和加巴德沙洲（1653）迎战荷兰人，他与其他将领于1653年颁布的《战斗条令》确立了单纵列战列线战术。1655年他在法里纳港焚毁海盗舰队，1657年4月在特内里费岛圣克鲁斯摧毁西班牙珍宝舰队，同年8月在普利茅斯外海去世。

en: Robert Boyle (1627–1691) was an Anglo-Irish natural philosopher, born at Lismore Castle in County Waterford, the seventh son of the Earl of Cork. Educated at Eton and on the continent, he joined the circle known as the Invisible College, which met to pursue the new philosophy. He settled at Oxford in 1654, and with Robert Hooke built an improved vacuum pump in 1659. His New Experiments of 1660 explored the spring of the air, and in 1662 he formulated Boyle's law on the inverse relation of gas pressure and volume at constant temperature in a closed system. The Sceptical Chymist (1661) helped found modern chemistry. A founder of the Royal Society and a devout Anglican, he died in London in 1691.
zh: 罗伯特·波义耳（1627—1691）是英裔爱尔兰自然哲学家，生于沃特福德郡的利斯莫尔城堡，是科克伯爵的第七子。他曾就读伊顿公学并在欧洲大陆游学，后来加入研讨新哲学的“无形学院”学术圈。1654年他定居牛津，1659年与罗伯特·胡克制成改进型真空泵。他在1660年的《关于空气弹性的物理力学新实验》中研究空气的弹性，1662年提出波义耳定律：在温度不变的封闭系统中，气体压强与体积成反比。1661年的《怀疑派化学家》奠定了现代化学的基础。他是英国皇家学会的创立者之一，也是虔诚的圣公宗信徒，1691年在伦敦去世。

en: Robert III of Artois (1287–1342) was the claimant whose lawsuit over the County of Artois helped push France and England into the Hundred Years' War. After his grandfather Robert II fell at Courtrai in 1302, the county went to his aunt Mahaut. In 1328 his brother-in-law Philip VI gave him Beaumont-le-Roger as compensation, but Robert reopened the question after Mahaut died in 1329. In 1331 he was convicted of using his father's forged will, supported by thirty-four false depositions and a document by Jeanne de Divion, who was burned at the stake. Sentenced in absentia in 1332, he fled to Namur, then Brabant, and at last to Edward III of England, joining his council and sharing what he knew of the French court. Philip cited Edward's refusal to expel him when he confiscated Guyenne in 1337. Robert commanded an Anglo-Flemish army at Saint-Omer in 1340 and died of dysentery after the retreat from Vannes in 1342.
zh: 阿图瓦的罗贝尔三世（1287—1342）是为争夺阿图瓦伯国而打官司、把法英两国推向百年战争的人。1302年祖父罗贝尔二世在科特赖克阵亡，伯国由姑母马奥继承。1328年，他的内兄腓力六世把博蒙勒罗歇封给他作补偿，但1329年马奥去世后，罗贝尔又重提继承之争。1331年，他因使用伪造的父亲遗嘱被判有罪，遗嘱背后是三十四份伪证和让娜·德·迪维翁伪造的文书，让娜后来被烧死。1332年他被缺席判处放逐，先逃往那慕尔，再到布拉班特，最后投奔英格兰国王爱德华三世，进入其会议，把法国宫廷的底细告诉他。1337年腓力没收吉耶讷，理由是爱德华不肯驱逐罗贝尔。罗贝尔于1340年在圣奥梅尔指挥英佛联军，1342年自瓦讷撤退后死于痢疾。

en: Robert Kett (c. 1492–1549) was a landowner of Wymondham in Norfolk, thought to have been a tanner, who led Kett's Rebellion against the enclosure of common lands during the Duke of Somerset's protectorate. With his brother William he led local men in tearing down John Flowerdew's fences on Hethersett common. After a riot at Wymondham in July 1549 he gathered some sixteen thousand followers on Mousehold Heath, enforced camp discipline, and presented twenty-nine demands to the crown. These sought to limit the power of the gentry and protect communal resources. His men took Norwich on 1 August, but he rejected a royal pardon. On 27 August John Dudley, Earl of Warwick, crushed the rebels at Dussindale. Kett was convicted of treason and hanged from Norwich Castle on 7 December 1549.
zh: 罗伯特·凯特（约1492—1549）是诺福克郡温登姆的地主，据信曾是制革匠，在萨默塞特公爵护政期间领导了反对圈占公地的凯特起义。他与兄弟威廉率领当地人拆毁了约翰·弗劳德在赫瑟塞特公地上竖起的围栏。1549年7月温登姆骚乱后，他在毛斯霍尔德荒野集结约一万六千人，整肃营规，并向王室提出二十九条诉求，要求限制乡绅权力、保护公共资源。8月1日，起义者攻占诺里奇，凯特拒绝了王室赦免。8月27日，沃里克伯爵约翰·达德利在杜辛德尔击溃起义军。凯特以叛国罪被定罪，于1549年12月7日被吊死于诺里奇城堡。

en: Robert Grey, called Robert Marmion, was the younger son of John de Grey, first Baron Grey of Rotherfield, by Avice Marmion. He married Lora St Quintin; their daughter Elizabeth married Henry FitzHugh, third Baron FitzHugh.
zh: 罗伯特·格雷又称罗伯特·马米恩，是第一代罗瑟菲尔德的格雷男爵约翰·德·格雷与续弦阿维斯·马米恩的幼子。他娶洛拉·圣昆廷为妻，女儿伊丽莎白嫁给第三代菲茨休男爵亨利·菲茨休。

en: Robert Shirley (c. 1581–1628) was an English traveller and adventurer, third son of Thomas Shirley of Wiston in Sussex. In 1598 he accompanied his brother Anthony to Safavid Persia, where he trained Shah Abbas I's army and reformed its artillery on the English model, helping Persia fight the Ottoman war of 1603–1612 on equal terms. In 1607 he married the Circassian Sampsonia, later Lady Teresa Shirley. From 1608 Abbas sent him on embassies to European courts to seek an alliance against the Ottomans. He visited Poland and Rome, and the emperor and pope made him a count. In 1627 he accompanied the English ambassador Dodmore Cotton on his third journey to Persia; he died at Qazvin in 1628.
zh: 罗伯特·雪莉（约1581—1628）是英格兰旅行家与冒险家，萨塞克斯郡威斯顿的托马斯·雪莉第三子。1598年，他随兄长安东尼前往萨法维波斯并留在当地，按英格兰模式训练阿拔斯一世的军队、改革炮兵，帮助波斯在1603—1612年对奥斯曼的战争中与对手势均力敌。1607年，他娶切尔克斯女子桑普索尼娅（即后来的特蕾莎·雪莉夫人）为妻。1608年起，阿拔斯派他出使欧洲各国宫廷，寻求结盟对抗奥斯曼人。他到访波兰和罗马，神圣罗马皇帝与教皇先后封他为伯爵。1627年，他陪同英格兰大使多德莫尔·科顿第三次前往波斯；1628年，他在加兹温去世。

en: Robert Walpole, 1st Earl of Orford (1676–1745), was a Norfolk Whig first elected to Parliament in 1701. From 1702 he represented King's Lynn, which returned him throughout the rest of his political career. He became Secretary at War in 1708, spent months in the Tower under Queen Anne, and returned to office with the Hanoverian succession in 1714. After the South Sea Bubble he became First Lord of the Treasury and Chancellor of the Exchequer in 1721, and for two decades dominated British politics, pursuing peace, low taxes and growing trade. He drew support from country gentlemen and combined the power of the crown with the growing influence of the Commons. Defeated in Parliament in 1742, he resigned and was made Earl of Orford, and is regarded as Britain's first prime minister.
zh: 第一代奥福德伯爵罗伯特·沃波尔（1676—1745）是诺福克乡绅出身的辉格党人，1701年首次当选议员。1702年起他代表金斯林选区，此后一直在该选区当选，直至结束政治生涯。1708年他升任军务大臣，在安妮女王末年一度被关进伦敦塔，1714年汉诺威王朝继位后重新得势。南海泡沫危机后，他于1721年出任第一财政大臣兼财政大臣，此后二十年间主导英国政坛，奉行和平、低税与扩张贸易的政策。他以乡绅为政治基础，将王权与下议院日益增长的影响结合起来。1742年他在议会败北后辞职，受封奥福德伯爵，被视为英国事实上的第一位首相。

en: Roger Mortimer, 1st Earl of March (25 April 1287 – 29 November 1330), was an English marcher lord. His 1301 marriage to Joan de Geneville won him Welsh March and Irish lands, and he became Lord Lieutenant of Ireland in 1316. He led the marcher lords against Edward II in the Despenser War and was imprisoned in the Tower in 1322, but escaped to France and allied with Queen Isabella. Their 1326 invasion deposed Edward, whose murder at Berkeley Castle Mortimer allegedly arranged. He ruled in young Edward III's name until seized at Nottingham in 1330 and hanged at Tyburn.
zh: 罗杰·莫蒂默，第一代马奇伯爵（1287年4月25日—1330年11月29日），是英格兰的边疆贵族。1301年他与琼·德·热纳维尔结婚，获得威尔士边疆和爱尔兰的大片领地，1316年出任爱尔兰总督。他率边疆贵族在“德斯潘塞战争”中反抗爱德华二世，1322年被囚于伦敦塔，随后逃往法国，与王后伊莎贝拉结盟。1326年两人入侵英格兰，废黜爱德华，国王随后在伯克利城堡遇害，莫蒂默被指是幕后主使。此后他以年幼的爱德华三世之名统治，1330年在诺丁汉被擒，最终被处死于泰伯恩。

en: Roger Mortimer, 2nd Earl of March (1328–1360), was grandson of the man who had ruled England in the name of the boy Edward III. That first earl was taken by surprise at Nottingham Castle on 19 October 1330 and executed, and the family estates were seized. Roger recovered the Mortimer lands and title and distinguished himself in the wars in France. The Black Prince knighted him at La Hogue in 1346, and he fought at Crécy and in the campaign of 1347. In 1348 he was among the founding knights of the Order of the Garter and was summoned to Parliament as a baron. He married Philippa, daughter of William Montagu, Earl of Salisbury, the companion who had helped Edward III seize his grandfather. Roger died in 1360, leaving his son Edmund as third earl.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/第二代边境伯爵罗杰·莫蒂默
zh: 罗杰·莫蒂默，第二代马奇伯爵（1328—1360），是那位曾以年幼的爱德华三世之名统治英格兰的人的孙子。这位第一代马奇伯爵于1330年10月19日在诺丁汉城堡被出其不意地拿下并处死，家族地产随之被没收。罗杰后来重获莫蒂默家族的地产与爵位，在法国战事中表现出色。1346年，黑太子爱德华在拉霍格封他为骑士，此后他参加了克雷西战役和1347年的战事。1348年，他成为嘉德骑士团的创始骑士之一，并以男爵身份获召出席议会。他娶了索尔兹伯里伯爵威廉·蒙塔古之女菲莉帕；正是这位蒙塔古当年协助爱德华三世擒住了罗杰的祖父。罗杰于1360年去世，其子埃德蒙继为第三代马奇伯爵。

en: Roger de Percy was a younger son of Henry Percy, 2nd Baron Percy of Alnwick, and Idonia Clifford, and a younger brother of the 3rd Baron.
zh: 罗杰·珀西是第二代阿尼克珀西男爵亨利·珀西与伊多妮娅·克利福德之子，第三代男爵的弟弟。

en: Samuel Pepys (1633–1703) was a London-born naval administrator and diarist. Through his cousin Edward Montagu he became Clerk of the Acts to the Navy Board in 1660, and later rose to Chief Secretary to the Admiralty under Charles II and James II, helping professionalise the Royal Navy. From 1660 to 1669 he kept a private diary recording the Restoration court, the Second Anglo-Dutch War, the Great Plague of 1665 and the Great Fire of 1666, until failing eyesight made him stop. He served as President of the Royal Society from 1684 to 1686.
zh: 塞缪尔·皮普斯（1633—1703）是生于伦敦的海军官员与日记作家。他靠表亲爱德华·蒙塔古提携，于1660年出任海军委员会文书官，后来在查理二世和詹姆斯二世治下官至海军部首席秘书，推动了皇家海军的专业化。1660至1669年间，他坚持撰写私人日记，记录了王政复辟时期的宫廷、第二次英荷战争、1665年伦敦大瘟疫和1666年伦敦大火，后因视力衰退而停笔。1684至1686年，他担任皇家学会会长。

en: Simon Sudbury (c. 1316–1381) was Bishop of London from 1361 and Archbishop of Canterbury from 1375, having earlier served the Avignon pope Innocent VI on a mission to Edward III. He crowned Richard II at Westminster Abbey in July 1377. In 1378 John Wycliffe appeared before him at Lambeth, though Sudbury proceeded against him only under great pressure. In January 1380 he became Lord Chancellor of England. Held responsible for the third poll tax, he was targeted in the Peasants' Revolt: rebels who had freed John Ball stormed the Tower of London, dragged Sudbury to Tower Hill and beheaded him on 14 June 1381. His body was buried at Canterbury Cathedral.
zh: 西蒙·萨德伯里（约1316—1381）自1361年任伦敦主教，1375年起任坎特伯雷大主教；此前他曾受阿维尼翁教皇英诺森六世派遣，出使爱德华三世。1377年7月，他在威斯敏斯特教堂为理查二世加冕。1378年，约翰·威克里夫在兰贝斯出庭受他审理，萨德伯里是在巨大压力下才对威克里夫采取行动的。1380年1月，他出任英格兰大法官。他被认为是第三次人头税的主要推手，因而在1381年农民起义中成为目标：释放了约翰·鲍尔的起义者冲入伦敦塔，把他拖到塔山，于1381年6月14日斩首。他的遗体葬于坎特伯雷大教堂。

en: Stephen of Blois (c. 1096 – 1154) was king of England from 1135. A nephew of Henry I, he held vast English estates through his wife Matilda, heiress of Boulogne. The death of Henry's son in the White Ship disaster of 1120 left the succession open to challenge. On Henry's death in 1135 Stephen seized the throne, breaking his oath to support the king's daughter, the Empress Matilda. Her 1139 invasion opened the long civil war known as the Anarchy; Stephen was captured at Lincoln in 1141 but freed after his wife and William of Ypres captured Robert of Gloucester at Winchester. After his son Eustace died, he recognised Matilda's son Henry as heir by the 1153 Treaty of Winchester, and died in October 1154.
zh: 布卢瓦的斯蒂芬（约1096—1154）自1135年起为英格兰国王。他是亨利一世的外甥，凭借妻子布洛涅女继承人玛蒂尔德而在英格兰拥有大片地产。1120年亨利之子在白船海难中丧生，王位继承因此面临争议。1135年亨利一世去世后，斯蒂芬违背支持国王之女玛蒂尔达皇后的誓言，夺取王位。1139年玛蒂尔达入侵，开启史称‘无政府时期’的长期内战；1141年斯蒂芬在林肯被俘，其妻与伊普尔的威廉在温彻斯特俘获格洛斯特的罗贝尔后，他才获释。其子尤斯塔斯死后，他于1153年签订《温彻斯特条约》，承认玛蒂尔达之子亨利为继承人，1154年10月去世。

en: Swein Forkbeard (died 1014), son of Harald Bluetooth, seized the Danish throne in 986, rebelling against his father, who died exiled. In 994 he joined Olaf Tryggvason raiding England until the English paid a tribute of sixteen thousand pounds, and around 1000 he defeated and killed Olaf at the Battle of Svold, making himself overlord of Norway. After campaigning in England in 1003–1005, he invaded to conquer in 1013: by December the English had accepted him as king and Æthelred fled to Normandy. He ruled only weeks, dying on 3 February 1014 and leaving the claim to his son Cnut.
zh: 八字胡斯文（？—1014）是蓝牙哈拉尔之子，986年起兵反叛父亲，夺取丹麦王位，哈拉尔被放逐后死去。994年，他与奥拉夫·特里格瓦松一起劫掠英格兰，直到英格兰人缴纳1.6万英镑贡金；约1000年，他在斯沃尔德海战中击败并杀死奥拉夫，成为挪威的宗主。1003—1005年他在英格兰作战，1013年发动全面征服：到12月英格兰人已承认他为王，埃塞尔雷德逃往诺曼底。他仅统治数周，1014年2月3日去世，把王位主张留给了儿子克努特。

en: Thomas de Beauchamp, 12th Earl of Warwick (1338–1401), was an English nobleman and chief opponent of Richard II. Knighted around 1355, he campaigned in France with John of Gaunt and became a Knight of the Garter. In the parliaments of 1376 and 1377 he was appointed to supervise government reform; he was Admiral of the North in 1377–1378 and brought soldiers and archers to Richard's Scottish campaign in 1385. In 1387 he was one of the Lords Appellant moving against the king's favourites. Lured to London in 1397, he was attainted and held in the Tower and on the Isle of Man. Freed when Henry Bolingbroke seized the throne in 1399, he was restored to his earldom and died in 1401.
zh: 第十二代沃里克伯爵托马斯·德·比彻姆（1338—1401）是英格兰贵族，也是理查二世的主要反对者之一。他约1355年受封骑士，曾随冈特的约翰出征法国，后成为嘉德骑士。1376年和1377年的议会任命他监督政府改革；1377—1378年他出任北方海军司令，1385年率领士兵和弓箭手随理查出征苏格兰。1387年，他作为“上诉贵族”之一，起兵反对国王的宠臣。1397年他被诱捕至伦敦，剥夺爵位与财产，先后囚禁于伦敦塔和曼岛。1399年亨利·博林布鲁克夺取王位后他获释，恢复伯爵爵位，1401年去世。

en: Thomas Cromwell (c. 1485–1540), a tradesman's son from Putney, rose through Cardinal Wolsey's service to become Henry VIII's chief minister from 1534. He helped engineer the annulment of Henry's marriage to Catherine of Aragon after the pope refused to approve it, and Parliament endorsed the king's claim to be Supreme Head of the Church of England. As royal vicar general he directed the dissolution of the monasteries, while as chief secretary he introduced new procedures that transformed government administration. He helped bring down Anne Boleyn in 1536 and was made Earl of Essex in 1540, but the failed match with Anne of Cleves destroyed him. He was beheaded on Tower Hill on 28 July 1540.
zh: 托马斯·克伦威尔（约1485—1540）是帕特尼一个商人之子，借枢机主教沃尔西的提携晋身，自1534年起任亨利八世的首席大臣。教皇拒绝批准亨利与阿拉贡的凯瑟琳解除婚姻后，他协助促成婚姻被宣告无效，议会也认可国王作为英格兰国教会最高首脑的主张。作为国王的总代理，他主持解散修道院；作为首席国务秘书，他推行新程序，改变了政府的行政运作。1536年他参与扳倒安妮·博林，1540年受封埃塞克斯伯爵，但与克利夫斯的安妮的联姻失败令他失势。1540年7月28日，他在塔山被斩首。

en: Sir Thomas Gresham (c. 1519–1579) was a London merchant and royal financier to Edward VI, Mary I and Elizabeth I. Appointed the crown's agent in Antwerp in 1551, he negotiated royal loans abroad and worked to support the pound after the Henrician debasements. He briefly lost favour when Mary succeeded in 1553, but was soon reinstated after his replacement's financial operations failed. Knighted in 1559, he served as envoy to Margaret of Parma in the Netherlands before unrest forced him to leave Antwerp in 1567; he continued his business from London. There he founded the Royal Exchange in 1565, opened by the queen in 1571, and his bequest established Gresham College. He died on 21 November 1579; Gresham's law is named for him.
zh: 托马斯·格雷沙姆爵士（约1519—1579）是伦敦商人兼王室金融家，历仕爱德华六世、玛丽一世与伊丽莎白一世三朝。1551年，他被任命为王室驻安特卫普代表，在海外为王室筹措贷款，并在亨利八世时代的货币贬值之后设法支撑英镑币值。1553年玛丽继位后他一度失宠，但继任者的金融运作失败，他很快又获任用。1559年他受封骑士，出任驻尼德兰、帕尔马的玛格丽特宫廷的使节；1567年动荡迫使他离开安特卫普，他此后在伦敦继续经营。1565年他在伦敦创办皇家交易所，交易所于1571年由女王揭幕；他留下的遗赠后来创办了格雷沙姆学院。1579年11月21日他去世，格雷沙姆定律即以他命名。

en: Thomas Harriot (c. 1560–1621) was an Oxford-educated mathematician, astronomer and navigator employed by Sir Walter Raleigh. After graduating in 1580, he tutored Raleigh in mathematics and advised him on navigation and ship design. He joined the 1585 expedition to Roanoke, learned Carolina Algonquian from Manteo and Wanchese, and published A Briefe and True Report of the New Found Land of Virginia in 1588, his only printed work. Under the Earl of Northumberland's patronage he was credited with discovering the law of refraction and devised binary arithmetic decades before Leibniz. On 5 August 1609 he made the first known drawing of the Moon through a telescope, preceding Galileo. He died in 1621, leaving most of his work unpublished.
zh: 托马斯·哈里奥特（约1560—1621）是牛津出身的数学家、天文学家和航海专家，受雇于沃尔特·罗利。1580年毕业后，他教授罗利数学，并为航海和船只设计提供建议。他参加1585年的罗阿诺克远征，向曼蒂奥和旺奇斯学会卡罗来纳阿尔冈昆语，并于1588年出版《弗吉尼亚新大陆见闻实录》，这是他生前唯一付印的著作。后来他受诺森伯兰伯爵资助，研究光学，被认为发现了折射定律，还比莱布尼茨早数十年提出二进制算术。1609年8月5日，他通过望远镜绘制了已知最早的月球素描图，早于伽利略。1621年他去世，大部分研究成果生前未曾发表。

en: Sir Thomas More (1478–1535) was an English lawyer, humanist and statesman, born in London on 7 February 1478. As a boy he served in the household of John Morton, Archbishop of Canterbury. Educated at Oxford and Lincoln's Inn, he entered Parliament in 1504 and became a friend of Erasmus. His dialogue Utopia (1516), describing an ideal commonwealth, won him European fame. After Wolsey's fall he served Henry VIII as Lord Chancellor from 1529 to 1532, but refused to accept the king as supreme head of the Church or the annulment of the marriage to Catherine of Aragon. Convicted of treason on perjured evidence, he was beheaded on Tower Hill on 6 July 1535.
zh: 托马斯·莫尔爵士（1478—1535）是英格兰律师、人文主义者和政治家，1478年2月7日生于伦敦。他少年时在坎特伯雷大主教约翰·莫顿家中服侍。他在牛津大学和林肯律师学院受教育，1504年进入议会，与伊拉斯谟结为好友。他的对话体著作《乌托邦》于1516年出版，描写一个理想国度，为他赢得全欧洲的声誉。沃尔西倒台后，他于1529至1532年任亨利八世的大法官，但拒绝承认国王为教会最高领袖，也不接受国王与阿拉贡的凯瑟琳的婚姻被判无效。他依据伪证被判叛国罪，1535年7月6日在塔山被斩首。

en: Thomas of Brotherton (1 June 1300–1338) was an English prince and Earl of Norfolk, the fifth son of Edward I and eldest child of his second queen Margaret of France, and a younger half-brother of Edward II. Created Earl of Norfolk in 1312 and Earl Marshal in 1316, he was despoiled of lands by the Despensers, joined Queen Isabella and Roger Mortimer in 1326, and sat in judgment on both Despensers and later counselled Edward III. As Lord Marshal he commanded the right wing at Halidon Hill in 1333. He died in 1338 and was buried at Bury St Edmunds Abbey, his titles passing to his daughter Margaret.
zh: 布罗瑟顿的托马斯（1300年6月1日—1338年）是英格兰王子、诺福克伯爵，爱德华一世第五子，也是第二任王后法兰西的玛格丽特所生的长子，即爱德华二世的异母弟。1312年他受封诺福克伯爵，1316年出任英格兰司礼官。德斯潘塞父子曾侵夺他的土地，他遂于1326年加入伊莎贝拉王后与罗杰·莫蒂默一方，并参与审判德斯潘塞父子，后来成为爱德华三世的核心顾问之一。1333年，他以军务统帅的身份在哈利敦山战役中指挥右翼。他于1338年去世，葬于贝里圣埃德蒙兹修道院，爵位由女儿玛格丽特继承。

en: Thomas Paine (1737–1809) was an English-born political writer and revolutionary, born at Thetford in Norfolk. In 1774 he sailed for America with Benjamin Franklin's backing. His pamphlet Common Sense (1776), written in plain language, argued for complete independence from Britain and helped prepare the Declaration of Independence; the American Crisis pamphlets followed from 1776. Back in England he published Rights of Man (1791) defending the French Revolution. After a warrant for his arrest, he fled to France in 1792 and was convicted of seditious libel in his absence in England. He sat in the French National Convention before imprisonment during the Terror. In The Age of Reason he advocated deism and criticised Christian doctrine. He returned to America in 1802 and died in New York in 1809.
zh: 托马斯·潘恩（1737—1809）是出生于英国的政治作家与革命者，生于诺福克郡的塞特福德。1774年，他在本杰明·富兰克林帮助下前往北美。1776年，他以浅白语言写成的小册子《常识》主张北美彻底脱离英国独立，为《独立宣言》铺平了道路；同年起他又发表《美国危机》系列小册子。回到英国后，他于1791年出版《人的权利》为法国大革命辩护。逮捕令发出后，他于1792年逃往法国，随后在英国被缺席判犯煽动诽谤罪。他入选法国国民公会，在恐怖统治时期入狱。他在《理性时代》中主张自然神论，批评基督教教义。1802年他返回美国，1809年在纽约去世。

en: Thomas Percy (c. 1332–1369) was a younger son of Henry Percy, 2nd Baron Percy of Alnwick, the commander of the English right wing at Neville's Cross, and of Idonia Clifford. While his elder brother carried on the barony, he entered the Church and was nominated Bishop of Norwich on 4 February 1355, then consecrated on 3 January 1356. He held the East Anglian see until his death on 8 August 1369, a little over a year after his brother, the 3rd Baron Percy.
zh: 托马斯·珀西（约1332—1369）是第二代阿尼克珀西男爵亨利·珀西与伊多妮娅·克利福德的一个小儿子，其父曾在内维尔十字战役中指挥英军右翼。兄长承袭男爵领地，他则投身教会，于1355年2月4日被提名出任诺里奇主教，1356年1月3日受祝圣。他主持这座东安格利亚教区直到1369年8月8日去世，比兄长第三代珀西男爵仅多活了一年有余。

en: Thomas Percy, 7th Earl of Northumberland (1528–1572), was an English Catholic nobleman whose father was executed after the Pilgrimage of Grace. Restored to his lands under Mary I, he retook Scarborough Castle from rebels in 1557, was created earl and became Warden General of the Marches. Elizabeth I made him a Knight of the Garter in 1563. In 1569 northern Catholics planned to free Mary, Queen of Scots and obtain freedom of worship. On 14 November Percy joined the Earl of Westmorland in raising the Rising of the North, occupying Durham and hearing Mass. He fled to Scotland, was captured and sold to the crown for two thousand pounds, and was beheaded at York on 22 August 1572 rather than renounce his faith. He was beatified in 1895.
zh: 第七代诺森伯兰伯爵托马斯·珀西（1528—1572）是英格兰天主教贵族，其父因参加求恩巡礼被处死。他在玛丽一世朝恢复家业，1557年从叛军手中夺回斯卡伯勒城堡，受封伯爵并出任边境总督。1563年伊丽莎白一世授予他嘉德骑士称号。1569年北方天主教徒谋求解救苏格兰女王玛丽，并争取礼拜自由。同年11月14日，珀西联合威斯特摩兰伯爵发动北方叛乱，占领达勒姆并在那里举行弥撒。兵败后他逃往苏格兰，被俘后以两千英镑的代价交给英格兰王室。1572年8月22日他在约克被斩首，宁死也不肯放弃信仰；1895年教会为他行宣福礼。

en: Thomas Farnolls Pritchard (baptised 1723–1777) was an English architect and interior decorator born in Shrewsbury. Trained as a joiner, he designed provincial churches and houses, created rococo interiors such as the drawing room at Tatton Hall and the ballroom at Powis Castle, and built the Shrewsbury foundling hospital in 1760. He specialised in chimney-pieces and funerary monuments, and worked closely with local architects and craftsmen. After moving to Eyton on Severn in 1769 he farmed while continuing his architectural work, and adapted timber-bridge principles to design a cast-iron arch over the Severn at Coalbrookdale. Cast in 1777–1779, the Iron Bridge was the world's first cast-iron bridge, but Pritchard died in December 1777 before its completion.
zh: 托马斯·法诺尔斯·普里查德（1723年受洗—1777）是英国建筑师与室内装饰师，生于什鲁斯伯里。他早年学做细木工，后来在地方上设计教堂与宅邸，创作了塔特恩厅洛可可客厅、波伊斯城堡舞厅等室内装饰，并于1760年主持建造什鲁斯伯里育婴堂。他擅长设计壁炉饰件和墓碑，并与当地建筑师及工匠密切合作。1769年他迁居塞文河畔艾顿，一边务农一边继续建筑工作，又将木桥原理用于设计一座横跨科尔布鲁克代尔塞文河的铸铁拱桥。该桥于1777至1779年浇铸，即世界上第一座铸铁桥“铁桥”，但普里查德已于1777年12月去世，未能见到它完工。

en: Thomas Savery (c. 1650–1715) was an English military engineer and inventor from Devon. A captain by 1702, he patented a glass-polishing machine in 1696 and a paddle-wheel device for driving ships, which the Admiralty rejected. On 2 July 1698 he patented the first commercially used steam-powered machine, a steam pump for draining mines and supplying towns with water, demonstrated to the Royal Society in June 1699 and described in his 1702 treatise The Miner's Friend. Its condensing steam created a partial vacuum to draw water up, but the pump wasted heat and had limitations in deep mines. Parliament extended his patent in 1699, and his work in Dartmouth probably brought him into contact with Thomas Newcomen.
zh: 托马斯·塞维利（约1650—1715）是英国德文郡出身的军事工程师与发明家。1702年他已获上尉军衔，1696年取得玻璃抛光机的专利，还发明了用明轮驱动船只的装置，却被海军部否决。1698年7月2日，他为第一台投入商业使用的蒸汽动力装置——用于矿井排水和城镇供水的蒸汽泵——取得专利，1699年6月向皇家学会演示，并在1702年的专著《矿工之友》中加以说明。蒸汽冷凝形成局部真空，将水吸上，但该泵浪费热量，在深矿使用也受到限制。议会于1699年延长了他的专利，他在达特茅斯的工作可能使他结识了托马斯·纽科门。

en: Sir Thomas Shirley (c. 1542–1612), of Wiston in Sussex, was an English landowner, Member of Parliament and courtier under Elizabeth I. Knighted in 1573 and appointed High Sheriff of Surrey and Sussex in 1576, he served as Treasurer-at-War with the English forces in the Netherlands from 1586, but speculation with army funds left him deep in debt to the Crown. His estate was sequestered in 1602. Arrested for debt in 1604 despite claiming parliamentary privilege, he was imprisoned in the Fleet; the House of Commons secured his release after a dispute with the warden. Parliament then passed an act confirming members' freedom from arrest. He was the father of the adventurers Thomas, Anthony and Robert Shirley; Anthony and Robert both served Shah Abbas I of Persia.
zh: 托马斯·谢利爵士（约1542—1612）是英格兰萨塞克斯郡威斯顿的地主、议员和伊丽莎白一世朝的廷臣。他1573年受封骑士，1576年任萨里与萨塞克斯郡长，1586年起随驻尼德兰的英军担任军费财务官，却因挪用军资投机而欠下王室巨额债务。他的地产于1602年被扣押。1604年，他虽主张议员特权，仍因债务被捕，关进弗利特监狱；下议院与监狱长争执后促成了他的释放。议会随后立法确认议员免遭逮捕的特权。他是探险家托马斯、安东尼和罗伯特·谢利之父，其中安东尼与罗伯特都曾效力于波斯沙阿阿拔斯一世。

en: Thomas Tallis (c. 1505–1585) was an English composer who served the Chapel Royal under Henry VIII, Edward VI, Mary I and Elizabeth I. After posts at Dover Priory from 1531, Waltham Abbey and Canterbury Cathedral, he joined the Chapel Royal around 1543 and shaped Tudor church music through decades of religious change. When Waltham Abbey was dissolved in 1540, he received a single payment of forty shillings and moved to the newly reorganised choir at Canterbury. In 1575 Elizabeth I granted him and his pupil William Byrd a monopoly on printing music, and they published the Cantiones sacrae that year. His works include the forty-voice motet Spem in alium and settings of the Lamentations. He died at Greenwich on 23 November 1585.
zh: 托马斯·塔利斯（约1505—1585）是英格兰作曲家，先后在亨利八世、爱德华六世、玛丽一世与伊丽莎白一世的王室礼拜堂供职。他自1531年起历任多佛尔修道院、沃尔瑟姆修道院与坎特伯雷大教堂的乐职，约1543年进入王室礼拜堂，在数十年宗教更迭中塑造了都铎教堂音乐。1540年沃尔瑟姆修道院解散时，他领到一次性支付的四十先令，转入坎特伯雷新近重组的唱诗班。1575年，伊丽莎白一世授予他与学生威廉·伯德印制乐谱的垄断权，两人同年出版了一部宗教经文歌集。他的作品包括一首四十声部经文歌和为《耶利米哀歌》谱写的乐曲。1585年11月23日，他在格林尼治去世。

en: Thomas Wake, second Baron Wake of Liddell (1297–1349), inherited his Lincolnshire barony as an infant in 1300; Piers Gaveston and Henry, Earl of Lancaster, were among his guardians, and before 1317 he married Lancaster's daughter Blanche. Opposed to Edward II's favourites, he joined Queen Isabella's invasion in 1326, then turned against Roger Mortimer and fled to France in 1330 after the execution of his brother-in-law Edmund of Woodstock, Earl of Kent. Restored under Edward III, he governed the Channel Islands, aided Edward Balliol's invasion of Scotland, and served in Brittany, dying childless in 1349. He founded Haltemprice Priory.
zh: 第二代利德尔的韦克男爵托马斯·韦克（1297—1349）于1300年在襁褓中继承林肯郡的男爵领地，皮尔斯·加韦斯顿和兰开斯特伯爵亨利都曾任他的监护人，1317年以前他娶亨利之女布兰奇为妻。他反对爱德华二世的宠臣，1326年加入伊莎贝拉王后的入侵，随后与罗杰·莫蒂默反目，1330年在妹夫肯特伯爵伍德斯托克的埃德蒙被处决后逃往法国。爱德华三世时期他获平反，曾任海峡群岛总督，协助爱德华·巴里奥入侵苏格兰，并在布列塔尼服役，1349年去世时无子嗣。他创立了约克郡的霍尔特普赖斯修道院。

en: Thomas Wolsey (c. 1473–1530) was Henry VIII's chief minister and a cardinal. Son of an Ipswich butcher, he was ordained in 1498 and rose to become the king's almoner in 1509. He organised supplies for the French campaign of 1513, became Archbishop of York in 1514, and was made cardinal and Lord Chancellor in 1515. He also served as papal legate, directed policy and organised the Field of the Cloth of Gold in 1520. He founded Cardinal College, but after failing to secure the king's annulment from Catherine of Aragon he fell from power in 1529, and died at Leicester Abbey on 29 November 1530 while taken to London on a treason charge.
zh: 托马斯·沃尔西（约1473—1530）是亨利八世的首席大臣、枢机主教。他是伊普斯威奇一个屠夫之子，1498年受任神父，在王室任职中步步高升，1509年成为国王的施赈官。他为1513年的法国战役组织补给，1514年出任约克大主教，1515年成为枢机主教和大法官。他又任教皇特使，主持政务，并组织了1520年的金帛盛会。他在牛津创立枢机主教学院，但因没能促成亨利与阿拉贡的凯瑟琳的婚姻无效之议，于1529年失势，1530年11月29日在被押往伦敦审理叛国罪途中死于莱斯特修道院。

en: Thomas of Woodstock, Duke of Gloucester (1355–1397), was the youngest son of Edward III, born at Woodstock Palace in Oxfordshire. In 1374 he married Eleanor de Bohun and became Constable of the Realm. Created Earl of Buckingham in 1377 and Duke of Gloucester in 1385, he campaigned in France before turning on his nephew Richard II. As leader of the Lords Appellant he defeated the king's favourite Robert de Vere at Radcot Bridge in December 1387 and dominated the Merciless Parliament of 1388, which purged Richard's circle. Richard took his revenge in 1397: Thomas was arrested and imprisoned at Calais, where he was smothered in September, probably on the king's orders.
zh: 伍德斯托克的托马斯，格洛斯特公爵（1355—1397），是爱德华三世最小的儿子，生于牛津郡伍德斯托克宫。1374年他迎娶埃莉诺·德·博亨，并出任王室统帅。1377年受封白金汉伯爵，1385年晋封格洛斯特公爵，曾在法兰西征战，后来与侄儿理查二世反目。作为“上诉贵族”的首领，他于1387年12月在拉德科特桥击败国王宠臣罗伯特·德维尔，并在1388年的“无情议会”中把持局面，清洗理查的近臣。1397年理查展开报复：托马斯被捕后囚禁于加来，9月间在狱中被人闷死，主使多半就是国王。

en: Thomas Holland, Duke of Surrey and 3rd Earl of Kent (1372–1400), was an English nobleman and a nephew of Richard II. In 1394 he accompanied his father and the king to Ireland. He succeeded his father as Earl of Kent in 1397, arrested his uncle the Earl of Arundel in the purge of the Lords Appellant, and was created Duke of Surrey that September. In 1398 he founded Mount Grace Priory in Yorkshire. After Henry IV deposed Richard in 1399 he lost the dukedom. He was a ringleader of the Epiphany Rising in January 1400, plotting to kill Henry and restore Richard; the rising failed and he was captured at Cirencester and beheaded without trial on 7 January 1400.
zh: 第一代萨里公爵、第三代肯特伯爵托马斯·霍兰（1372—1400）是英格兰贵族，理查二世的侄子。1394年他随父亲和国王前往爱尔兰。1397年他继承父亲的肯特伯爵之位，在清算上诉贵族时奉命逮捕母舅阿伦德尔伯爵，同年9月受封萨里公爵。1398年他在约克郡创建蒙特格雷斯修道院。1399年亨利四世废黜理查后，他被剥夺公爵头衔。1400年1月，他是主显节起义的主谋之一，图谋杀死亨利、复辟理查；起义失败后他在赛伦塞斯特被捕，未经审判即于1月7日被斩首。

en: Tomas ap Rhodri, or Thomas Rothery (c. 1300–c. 1363), was the only known son of Rhodri ap Gruffudd, youngest brother of the Welsh princes Llywelyn and Dafydd ap Gruffudd. He inherited his father's estates in Cheshire and at Tatsfield in Surrey, later exchanging the Cheshire lands for holdings at Bidfield in Gloucestershire and Dinas in Powys. As closest male heir of Owain Goch he made an unsuccessful claim to the lordship of Llŷn, though he never claimed Gwynedd itself. By his wife Cecilia he fathered Owain Lawgoch, who proclaimed himself Prince of Wales in 1369.
zh: 托马斯·阿普·罗德里，又名托马斯·罗瑟里（约1300—约1363），是罗德里·阿普·格鲁菲兹唯一见于记载的儿子，而罗德里是威尔士王公卢埃林与达菲德·阿普·格鲁菲兹的幼弟。他继承了父亲在柴郡和萨里郡塔茨菲尔德的地产，后来以柴郡的土地换得格洛斯特郡比德菲尔德和波伊斯迪纳斯的产业。作为欧文·戈赫最亲近的男性继承人，他曾主张利恩领主的继承权但未获成功，却从未对格温内思本身提出要求。他与妻子塞西莉娅生下欧文·阿普·托马斯，即后来的欧文·劳戈赫，后者于1369年自立为威尔士亲王。

en: Sir Walter Raleigh (c. 1552–1618) was a Devon-born courtier, explorer and writer, and a favourite of Elizabeth I. Knighted in 1585, he received a royal patent to colonise North America and sponsored the Roanoke settlements, naming the territory Virginia. He helped suppress the Desmond rebellions in Ireland and fought against the Spanish Armada in 1588. His secret marriage in 1591 to Elizabeth Throckmorton cost him the queen's favour and the Tower. In 1595 he sailed to Guiana in search of El Dorado. Imprisoned under James I from 1603 for involvement in the Main Plot, he was released in 1616 for a second Guiana voyage. His men attacked a Spanish outpost during the expedition, and he was executed in 1618.
zh: 沃尔特·罗利爵士（约1552—1618）生于德文郡，是廷臣、探险家和作家，也是伊丽莎白一世的宠臣。他1585年受封爵士，获得开拓北美殖民地的王室特许状，资助罗阿诺克定居点，并将那片土地命名为弗吉尼亚。他曾参与镇压爱尔兰的戴斯蒙德叛乱，1588年参加抗击西班牙无敌舰队的战斗。1591年他与伊丽莎白·斯罗克莫顿秘密结婚，因而失宠并被关入伦敦塔。1595年他远航圭亚那寻找黄金国。詹姆斯一世即位后，他因卷入“主要阴谋”自1603年起被囚禁，1616年获释再赴圭亚那。远征期间他的部下袭击了一个西班牙据点，他于1618年被处死。

en: Wat Tyler (1341–1381) was the Kentish leader of England's Peasants' Revolt. In June 1381, angered by the third poll tax, he led rebels from Canterbury to London, demanding economic and social reforms. There they burned John of Gaunt's Savoy Palace, stormed the Tower and executed the chancellor Simon Sudbury. On 14 June Richard II met the rebels at Mile End and granted their demands, but when Tyler parleyed with him at Smithfield the next day, the Lord Mayor William Walworth slashed him down; he was beheaded and his head displayed on London Bridge. Richard revoked the concessions and the revolt collapsed.
zh: 瓦特·泰勒（1341—1381）是英格兰农民起义的肯特领袖。1381年6月，为反抗第三次人头税并要求经济和社会改革，他率起义者从坎特伯雷进军伦敦，焚烧了冈特的约翰的萨伏依宫，冲入伦敦塔并处死大法官西蒙·萨德伯里。6月14日，理查二世在迈尔恩德会见起义者并答应他们的要求；但次日泰勒在史密斯菲尔德与他谈判时，伦敦市长威廉·沃尔沃思将他砍倒，他被送往一所济贫医院，随后又被带回史密斯菲尔德处决，首级悬于伦敦桥示众。理查收回许诺，起义随之瓦解。

en: William Caxton (c. 1422–c. 1491) was an English merchant who introduced printing to England. Apprenticed to a London mercer in 1438, he settled in Bruges by 1453 and became governor of the Merchant Adventurers. After learning the craft in Cologne, he set up a press in Bruges with Colard Mansion, and in 1473 printed his translation of the Recuyell of the Historyes of Troye, the first book printed in English. Margaret of York, Duchess of Burgundy, had encouraged him to complete the translation. In 1476 he established England's first press at Westminster, issuing Chaucer's Canterbury Tales, Malory's Le Morte d'Arthur in 1485, and many translations of his own. He died in 1491.
zh: 威廉·卡克斯顿（约1422—约1491）是把印刷术引入英格兰的商人。1438年他给伦敦一位绸布商当学徒，1453年前定居布鲁日，后来出任商人冒险公司的总督。他在科隆学会印刷术后，与科拉德·芒西翁在布鲁日开办印刷所，1473年印出自译的《特洛伊史汇》，这是第一本英文印刷书。勃艮第公爵夫人约克的玛格丽特曾鼓励他完成这部译作。1476年，他在威斯敏斯特建立英格兰第一家印刷所，刊行了乔叟的《坎特伯雷故事集》、1485年马洛礼的《亚瑟之死》以及大量自译作品。他于1491年去世。

en: William Cecil, 1st Baron Burghley (1520–1598), was the chief minister of Queen Elizabeth I for almost the whole of her reign. Born in Bourne, Lincolnshire, he first became Secretary of State under Edward VI in 1550 and returned to the office at Elizabeth's accession in 1558. Created Baron Burghley in 1571, he became Lord High Treasurer the following year. He sought a united Protestant British Isles, pursuing control of Ireland and an alliance with Scotland. To guard against invasion he strengthened the navy. In 1587 he persuaded the queen to order the execution of Mary, Queen of Scots, after she was implicated in a plot to assassinate Elizabeth. He died in 1598, leaving his son Robert Cecil to succeed to his power.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/第一代伯利男爵威廉·塞西尔
zh: 第一代伯利男爵威廉·塞西尔（1520—1598）几乎在伊丽莎白一世整个在位期间都是她的首席大臣。他出生于林肯郡的伯恩，1550年在爱德华六世朝中首次出任国务大臣，1558年伊丽莎白即位后重任此职。1571年受封伯利男爵，次年就任财政大臣。他谋求建立统一的新教不列颠群岛，力图控制爱尔兰并与苏格兰结盟；为抵御入侵，他扩充海军。1587年，苏格兰女王玛丽被牵涉进刺杀伊丽莎白的阴谋后，他劝说女王下令处决玛丽。他于1598年去世，其子罗伯特·塞西尔继承了他的权位。

en: William Gilbert (1544–1603) was a Colchester-born physician and natural philosopher educated at St John's College, Cambridge. Elected a fellow of the Royal College of Physicians in 1573 and its president in 1600, he served as physician to Elizabeth I from 1601 and was retained by James I. His six-volume De Magnete, published in 1600, described experiments with his terrella, a spherical lodestone model, and argued that the Earth itself is a great magnet, explaining why compasses point north. He argued that the Earth rotates daily and observed that a magnet cut in two forms two magnets, each with north and south poles. He also studied static electricity from amber, used electricus to describe similar attractive properties, and invented the versorium, the first electrical instrument.
zh: 威廉·吉尔伯特（1544—1603）生于科尔切斯特，是就读于剑桥大学圣约翰学院的医生与自然哲学家。他1573年当选皇家内科医学院院士，1600年出任院长，1601年起担任伊丽莎白一世的御医，詹姆斯一世继位后继续留用。1600年出版的六卷本《论磁》记载了他用球形磁石“小地球”所做的实验，提出地球本身就是一块大磁石，以此解释罗盘指北的原理。他主张地球每日自转，并指出磁铁切开后形成的两块磁铁各有南北极。他还研究琥珀摩擦产生的静电，用“如琥珀的”一词描述类似的吸引性质，并发明最早的验电器——一根可自由转动的指针。

en: William II Rufus (c. 1057 – 2 August 1100), third son of William the Conqueror, ruled England from 26 September 1087. He crushed the 1088 revolt led by Bishop Odo of Bayeux, forced homage from Malcolm III of Scotland in 1091, built Carlisle Castle in 1092 and saw Malcolm killed at Alnwick in 1093. His quarrel with Archbishop Anselm ended in the archbishop's exile in 1097. From 1096 he held Normandy in pledge while Robert Curthose went on crusade. On 2 August 1100 an arrow killed him hunting in the New Forest, and his brother Henry seized the crown.
zh: 威廉二世（绰号鲁弗斯，约1057年—1100年8月2日）是征服者威廉的第三子，自1087年9月26日起统治英格兰。他镇压了1088年巴约主教奥多领导的叛乱，1091年迫使苏格兰国王马尔科姆三世称臣，1092年修建卡莱尔城堡，1093年马尔科姆在阿尼克毙命。他与大主教安瑟伦长期冲突，最终安瑟伦于1097年流亡。1096年起，罗贝尔·柯索斯参加十字军，诺曼底抵押给他管辖。1100年8月2日，他在新森林狩猎时中箭身亡，其弟亨利随即夺取王位。

en: William Montagu, 1st Earl of Salisbury (1301-1344), born at Cassington in Oxfordshire, was the closest companion and servant of Edward III. In 1330 he helped the young king overthrow Roger Mortimer at Nottingham. He fought for Edward in the Scottish Wars, received the Isle of Man and ruled it as its king, and in 1337 was created Earl of Salisbury. Captured by the French in 1340 during the Hundred Years' War, he promised never to fight in France again. He died in January 1344 of wounds sustained at a tournament.
zh: 威廉·蒙塔古，第一代索尔兹伯里伯爵（1301—1344），生于牛津郡卡辛顿，是爱德华三世最亲密的近臣。1330年，他协助年轻的国王在诺丁汉推翻罗杰·莫蒂默。他在苏格兰战争中为国王作战，受封马恩岛并以国王身份统治该岛，1337年受封索尔兹伯里伯爵。百年战争期间，他于1340年被法军俘虏，获释时承诺不再在法国作战。1344年1月，他因比武中所受的伤去世。

en: William Montagu, 2nd Earl of Salisbury (1328-1397), born at Donyatt in Somerset, succeeded his father as earl and King of Mann in 1344 and was a founder knight of the Order of the Garter. As a boy he married Joan of Kent, whose earlier secret marriage to Thomas Holland was upheld; the pope annulled Montagu's marriage in 1349. He commanded the Black Prince's rearguard in 1355, fought at Poitiers in 1356, and helped negotiate the Treaty of Bretigny in 1360. He supported Richard II against Wat Tyler's revolt and sold the Isle of Man in 1393.
zh: 威廉·蒙塔古，第二代索尔兹伯里伯爵（1328—1397），生于萨默塞特郡多尼亚特，1344年继承父亲的伯爵爵位与马恩岛王位，是嘉德骑士团的创始骑士之一。他幼年娶肯特的琼安为妻，但琼安此前已与托马斯·霍兰德秘密成婚，教皇便于1349年宣布这段婚姻无效。他在1355年黑太子的远征中指挥后卫，参加1356年普瓦捷战役，1360年参与议定《布雷蒂尼条约》。后来他支持理查二世镇压瓦特·泰勒起义，1393年卖掉了马恩岛。

en: William de Percy (c. 1303–1355) was the younger son of Henry de Percy, 1st Baron Percy of Alnwick, and Eleanor FitzAlan, and brother of Henry, the second baron.
zh: 威廉·德·珀西（约1303—1355）是阿尼克的第一代珀西男爵亨利·德·珀西与埃莉诺·菲茨艾伦的幼子，第二代珀西男爵亨利之弟。

en: William Pitt the Elder, 1st Earl of Chatham (1708–1778), was the British Whig statesman called the Great Commoner for his long refusal to accept a title. A grandson of Thomas Pitt, governor of Madras, he won fame through his House of Commons oratory in the 1730s, denouncing Walpole's corruption and later the Hanoverian subsidies. As effective leader of the ministry from 1756 to 1761, with a brief interruption in 1757, he directed Britain's effort in the Seven Years' War, securing the conquest of Canada and dominance in India. He accepted an earldom in 1766 and served as prime minister until 1768, later defending the American colonies against coercion. He died in May 1778.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/第一代查塔姆伯爵威廉·皮特
zh: 老威廉·皮特，第一代查塔姆伯爵（1708—1778），是英国辉格党政治家，因长期拒绝接受爵位而被称为“伟大的平民”。他是马德拉斯总督托马斯·皮特之孙，1730年代以在下院的雄辩成名，抨击沃波尔的腐败，后来又反对汉诺威补贴。1756至1761年，他作为内阁实际领袖主持英国在七年战争中的战事，虽于1757年短暂离职，仍确保英军攻取加拿大并在印度取得优势。他1766年接受伯爵爵位，1766至1768年出任首相，后来为美洲殖民地辩护、反对高压政策，1778年5月去世。

en: William Shakespeare (1564–1616) was an English playwright, poet and actor, born at Stratford-upon-Avon and baptised there on 26 April 1564. In 1582 he married Anne Hathaway, with whom he had three children. By 1592 he was established in London as an actor and playwright. From 1594 he was a sharer in the Lord Chamberlain's Men, renamed the King's Men in 1603. Between about 1589 and 1613 he wrote some 39 plays and 154 sonnets, moving from histories and comedies to the great tragedies Hamlet, Othello, King Lear and Macbeth, and late romances such as The Tempest. He retired to Stratford around 1613 and died on 23 April 1616. In 1623 two fellow actors published the First Folio, collecting 36 of his plays.
zh: 威廉·莎士比亚（1564—1616）是英格兰剧作家、诗人和演员，生于埃文河畔斯特拉特福，1564年4月26日受洗。1582年他与安妮·海瑟薇结婚，婚后育有三个子女。到1592年，他已在伦敦站稳脚跟，身兼演员与剧作家。1594年起他成为宫内大臣剧团的股东；该剧团1603年更名为国王剧团。约1589至1613年间，他创作了约39部剧本和154首十四行诗，题材从历史剧、喜剧发展到《哈姆雷特》《奥赛罗》《李尔王》《麦克白》等伟大悲剧，以及《暴风雨》等晚期传奇剧。约1613年他退居斯特拉特福，1616年4月23日去世。1623年，两位演员同事出版《第一对开本》，收录了他的36部剧作。

en: William the Conqueror (c. 1028–1087), illegitimate son of Duke Robert I of Normandy, inherited the duchy in 1035. Norman nobles fought for control of the young duke, who put down a rebellion in 1047 and made his grip secure by about 1060. Claiming Edward the Confessor had promised him the crown, he invaded in 1066, killed Harold Godwinson at Hastings on 14 October and was crowned in London on Christmas Day. He suppressed subsequent English revolts, and his Norman Conquest planted castles and a new French-speaking aristocracy across England. In 1086 he ordered the Domesday survey. He died campaigning in France in 1087 and was buried at Caen, leaving England to William Rufus and Normandy to Robert Curthose.
zh: 征服者威廉（约1028—1087）是诺曼底公爵罗贝尔一世的非婚生子，1035年袭封公爵。诺曼贵族争夺对年幼公爵的控制，他于1047年平定一场叛乱，约1060年稳固了对公国的统治。他声称忏悔者爱德华曾将英格兰王位许给他，于1066年出兵入侵，10月14日在黑斯廷斯战役击杀哈罗德·戈德温森，圣诞节当天在伦敦加冕为王。他镇压了此后英格兰的叛乱；诺曼征服后，他在英格兰广建城堡、安插讲法语的新贵族。1086年他下令编纂《末日审判书》。1087年他在法兰西作战期间去世，葬于卡昂；英格兰传予威廉·鲁夫斯，诺曼底则归罗贝尔·柯索斯。

en: William de Warenne (9 February 1256 – 15 December 1286) was the only son of John de Warenne, 6th Earl of Surrey, and Alice de Lusignan, half-sister of King Henry III. He married Joan, daughter of Robert de Vere, 5th Earl of Oxford, who bore him a son, John de Warenne, later the 7th Earl of Surrey, and a daughter Alice, wife of Edmund FitzAlan, Earl of Arundel. In 1286 William was killed in a tournament at Croydon, predeceasing his father, and it was later suggested that his enemies had planned his death as murder.
zh: 威廉·德瓦伦（1256年2月9日—1286年12月15日）是第六代萨里伯爵约翰·德瓦伦与亨利三世同母异父之妹爱丽丝·德·吕西尼昂的独子。他娶第五代牛津伯爵罗伯特·德维尔之女琼，生有儿子约翰·德瓦伦（后为第七代萨里伯爵）和女儿爱丽丝，爱丽丝嫁给阿伦德尔伯爵埃德蒙·菲茨艾伦。1286年，威廉在克罗伊登的一场比武大赛中被杀，先于其父去世；后世有人认为他的死是仇人策划的谋杀。

en: William Zouche (1299–1352) was an English cleric and royal administrator who became Archbishop of York. Educated at Oxford, he served Edward III as Keeper of the Wardrobe from 1329, Lord Privy Seal from 1335, and Lord Treasurer in 1337–1338 and 1338–1340, and became Dean of York in 1336. In 1340 the canons of York elected him archbishop against the king's wishes, and he was consecrated at Avignon in 1342. As Warden of the Marches he led troops against the Scots at Neville's Cross in 1346. He died at Cawood in 1352 and was buried in York Minster.
zh: 威廉·拉朱什（1299—1352）是英格兰教士与王室行政官，后任约克大主教。他曾在牛津受教，1329年起任锦衣库主管，1335年任掌玺大臣，1337—1338年及1338—1340年两度出任财政大臣，1336年又出任约克座堂主任牧师。1340年，约克法政牧师违背国王意愿推举他为大主教，他于1342年在阿维尼翁祝圣就任。任边境守护期间，他在1346年的内维尔十字之战中率军迎击苏格兰人。1352年他在卡伍德去世，葬于约克大教堂。

en: Anna Komnene Doukaina Palaiologina Asanina was a Byzantine noblewoman of the early fourteenth century, a daughter of the protostrator Theodore Synadenos and Eudokia Doukaina Komnene. In December 1321, at Adrianople, she married Manuel Komnenos Raoul Asanes, grandson of the Bulgarian tsar Ivan Asen III and brother-in-law of John VI Kantakouzenos. She is portrayed beside her husband in a family miniature in the typikon of the Constantinople convent of Bebaia Elpis, founded by her grandmother Theodora Synadene. Her son Andronikos Asanes, raised by Kantakouzenos, later became sebastokrator.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/曼努埃尔·科穆宁·拉乌尔·阿森
zh: 安娜·科穆宁·杜卡伊娜·巴列奥略吉娜·阿萨尼娜是14世纪初的拜占庭贵族女子，为“普罗托斯特拉托”狄奥多尔·西纳齐诺斯与埃夫多基娅·杜卡伊娜·科穆宁之女。1321年12月，她在阿德里安堡嫁给曼努埃尔·科穆宁·拉乌尔·阿萨尼斯；后者是保加利亚沙皇伊凡·阿森三世之孙、约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯的内弟。在祖母塞奥多拉·西纳齐娜于君士坦丁堡创办的“坚定希望”修道院的规章手抄本中，绘有她与丈夫并立的家族细密画。她的儿子安德洛尼卡·阿萨尼斯由坎塔库泽努斯夫妇抚养，后来受封“塞瓦斯托克拉托”。

en: Anna Palaiologina was the daughter of the Byzantine aristocrat Andronikos Angelos Palaiologos, a grandson of Emperor Michael VIII. Around 1323 she married John II Orsini, Despot of Epirus, and bore him Nikephoros and Thomais. When John died suddenly in 1335, widely believed poisoned by Anna, she ruled as regent for the young Nikephoros. In 1338 Andronikos III annexed Epirus and imprisoned her at Thessalonica; escaping in 1341, she was confined at Arta by the governor John Angelos. Freed after the Serbian conquest c. 1347, she married John Komnenos Asen, lord of Valona, around 1350, and after 1363 went to live with her daughter Thomais at Trikala.
zh: 安娜·巴列奥略娜是拜占庭贵族安德洛尼卡·安格洛斯·巴列奥略之女，其父是皇帝米海尔八世的外孙。约1323年，她嫁给伊庇鲁斯专制公乔瓦尼二世·奥尔西尼，生下尼基弗鲁斯和托马伊斯。1335年乔瓦尼暴卒，时人多认为系安娜毒杀，她遂为年幼的尼基弗鲁斯摄政。1338年，安德洛尼卡三世吞并伊庇鲁斯，将她押往塞萨洛尼基囚禁；1341年她逃脱，抵达阿尔塔后又被总督约翰·安格洛斯软禁。约1347年塞尔维亚人征服伊庇鲁斯后她获释，约1350年改嫁发罗拉领主约翰·科穆宁·阿森，1363年后退居特里卡拉，与女儿托马伊斯一同生活。

en: Eudokia Doukaina Komnene was the daughter of Theodore Doukas Mouzakios and, sometime before 1320, the wife of the Byzantine general Theodore Synadenos. Her daughter Theodora probably married into the Raoul family, while her daughter Anna married into the Asen family.
zh: 欧多基娅·杜卡伊娜·科穆宁是狄奥多勒·杜卡斯·穆扎基奥斯之女，1320年以前嫁给拜占庭将领狄奥多尔·熏纳德诺斯。她的女儿狄奥多拉可能嫁入拉乌尔家族，女儿安娜则嫁入阿森家族。

en: John Komnenos Angelos Doukas Synadenos was a Byzantine noble who held the rank of megas stratopedarches under Michael VIII and Andronikos II. First attested in 1276 or 1277, he and Michael Kaballarios led an army against the independent ruler of Thessaly, John I Doukas. Routed at Pharsalus, Synadenos was captured, while Kaballarios was killed attempting to escape. Synadenos later regained his freedom. He fought in the victory over the Angevins at Berat in Albania in 1281, and in 1283 served under Michael Tarchaneiotes against Thessaly. He ended his life as the monk Joachim, dying between 1310 and 1328. By Theodora Palaiologina, niece of Michael VIII, he fathered John, Theodore and Euphrosyne.
zh: 约翰·科穆宁·安盖洛斯·杜卡斯·西纳德诺斯是拜占庭贵族，在米海尔八世与安德洛尼卡二世朝担任大都官。史载他最早于1276或1277年与米海尔·卡瓦拉里奥斯一同领兵，攻打独立的色萨利统治者约翰一世·杜卡斯。两人在法萨卢斯兵败，西纳德诺斯被俘，卡瓦拉里奥斯则在逃跑时被杀；西纳德诺斯后来获释。1281年他参加在阿尔巴尼亚培拉特击败安茹人的战役，1283年又在米海尔·塔尔哈内奥特斯麾下再征色萨利。他晚年出家，取法名约阿基姆，于1310至1328年间去世。妻子狄奥多拉·巴列奥略吉娜是米海尔八世的侄女，生有约翰、狄奥多尔和尤芙洛西妮。

en: Michael I Komnenos Doukas (c. 1170–1215), illegitimate son of the sebastokrator John Doukas and cousin of the Angeloi emperors, founded the Despotate of Epirus. A hostage to the Third Crusade in 1190, he later governed in Asia Minor and rebelled against Alexios III, fleeing to the Seljuks. After the Fourth Crusade sacked Constantinople in 1204, he first served Boniface of Montferrat, then established himself in Epirus as a centre of Greek resistance to the Latins. He ransomed the deposed Alexios III, made treaties with the Latin Empire and Venice, conquered most of Thessaly in 1212 and recovered Dyrrhachium and Corfu in 1213–1214. He was assassinated in his sleep in 1214/15 and succeeded by his half-brother Theodore.
zh: 米海尔一世·科穆宁·杜卡斯（约1170—1215）是至尊者约翰·杜卡斯的私生子，与安格洛斯王朝的皇帝们是表亲，也是伊庇鲁斯专制国的开创者。1190年他曾作第三次十字军的人质，后来在小亚细亚任总督，反叛阿历克塞三世失败后逃往塞尔柱人处。1204年第四次十字军洗劫君士坦丁堡后，他先追随蒙费拉的博尼法斯，随后在伊庇鲁斯自立，使其成为希腊人抵抗拉丁人的中心。他赎回被废的阿历克塞三世，与拉丁帝国和威尼斯缔约，1212年征服色萨利大部，1213至1214年收复都拉佐与科孚岛。1214/1215年，他在睡梦中遇刺，由同父异母弟狄奥多尔继位。

en: Michael II Komnenos Doukas (c. 1206–1268), illegitimate son of Michael I, ruled the Despotate of Epirus from 1230. Exiled after his father's murder in 1215, he returned after his uncle Theodore's defeat by Bulgaria at Klokotnitsa and married Theodora Petraliphaina, later Saint Theodora of Arta. He nominally accepted his uncle Manuel's suzerainty but ruled independently. He took Corfu by 1236, occupied Thessaly after Manuel died in 1241 and in 1249 received the despot title from John III Vatatzes. In 1259 his alliance with Manfred of Sicily and Achaea was routed at Pelagonia after his bastard John deserted. He recovered Epirus, accepted Michael VIII's suzerainty in 1264, and on his death Epirus went to Nikephoros and Thessaly to John.
zh: 米海尔二世·科穆宁·杜卡斯（约1206—1268）是米海尔一世的私生子，自1230年起统治伊庇鲁斯专制国。1215年父亲遇刺后他流亡在外，叔父狄奥多尔在克罗克特尼察败于保加利亚后，他返回伊庇鲁斯，娶了后来被尊为阿尔塔圣狄奥多拉的狄奥多拉·佩特拉利法伊娜。他名义上承认叔父曼努埃尔的宗主权，实际却独立统治。1236年前他夺取科孚岛，1241年曼努埃尔死后占领色萨利，1249年从尼西亚皇帝约翰三世·瓦塔基斯处获授专制公头衔。1259年，他与西西里的曼弗雷迪及亚该亚结盟，却因私生子约翰倒戈而在佩拉戈尼亚惨败。他收复伊庇鲁斯，1264年接受米海尔八世的宗主权；他死后，伊庇鲁斯归于尼基弗鲁斯，色萨利归于约翰。

en: Nikephoros I Komnenos Doukas (c. 1240–c. 1297), son of Michael II and Saint Theodora of Arta, ruled Epirus from 1267/8. The Nicaean John III Vatatzes made him despot around 1249, and in 1256 he married John's granddaughter Maria. After her death, he helped his father recover Epirus with Sicilian reinforcements and married Anna Kantakouzene, niece of Michael VIII. He swung between Constantinople and the Angevin kings, becoming vassal of Charles I in 1279 until the Sicilian Vespers of 1282 broke Angevin power. In 1294 he wed his daughter Thamar to Charles II's son Philip of Taranto, with coastal fortresses as dowry. He died c. 1297, leaving young Thomas under Anna's regency.
zh: 尼基弗鲁斯一世·科穆宁·杜卡斯（约1240—约1297）是米海尔二世与阿尔塔的圣狄奥多拉之子，1267/68年起统治伊庇鲁斯。尼西亚的约翰三世·瓦塔基斯约于1249年封他为专制公，1256年他迎娶约翰的孙女玛丽亚。玛丽亚死后，他借助西西里援军协助父亲收复伊庇鲁斯，并续娶米海尔八世的侄女安娜·坎塔库泽娜。他在君士坦丁堡与安茹诸王之间摇摆，1279年成为查理一世的封臣，直到1282年西西里晚祷摧垮安茹势力。1294年，他把女儿塔玛尔嫁给查理二世之子塔兰托的腓力，以沿海要塞为嫁妆。他约1297年去世，年幼的托马斯在安娜摄政下继位。

en: Nikephoros II Orsini (c. 1328–1359) was the child ruler of Epirus, a Greek despotate the Byzantine emperor meant to swallow. His father John Orsini died in 1335, allegedly poisoned by his mother Anna Palaiologina, who governed as regent for the seven-year-old. Emperor Andronikos III annexed the Epirote part of Thessaly in 1336 and in 1338 kept Anna hostage, refusing to accept her son as a vassal. Nobles smuggled Nikephoros to Catherine of Valois, titular Latin empress, at Taranto, and at her urging Arta rose in his name in late 1338. John Kantakouzenos crushed the revolt, married Nikephoros to his daughter Maria and took him to Constantinople; when Kantakouzenos became emperor in 1347, Nikephoros was made despot. In 1356 he seized Thessaly and drove Simeon Uroš out of Arta. He was killed fighting Albanian clans at the Battle of Achelous in 1359.
zh: 尼基弗鲁斯二世·奥尔西尼（约1328—1359）是伊庇鲁斯的幼年统治者，这个希腊专制公国正是拜占庭皇帝急于吞并的对象。1335年，其父约翰·奥尔西尼去世，据称是被他的母亲安娜·帕莱奥洛吉娜毒死，七岁的他继位，安娜摄政。1336年，拜占庭皇帝安德罗尼卡三世吞并了伊庇鲁斯在色萨利的领地；1338年又扣留安娜，不肯接受她的儿子为附庸。贵族们把尼基弗鲁斯偷偷送到塔兰托，投奔名义上的拉丁女皇瓦卢瓦的凯瑟琳，1338年底阿尔塔在她的怂恿下以他的名义起义。约翰·坎塔库泽诺斯平定叛乱，把女儿玛丽亚嫁给尼基弗鲁斯，并带他前往君士坦丁堡；1347年坎塔库泽诺斯称帝，尼基弗鲁斯获授专制公头衔。1356年，他夺取色萨利，逐走阿尔塔的西美昂·乌罗什。1359年，他在阿凯洛奥斯战役中与阿尔巴尼亚部族作战时阵亡。

en: Nicholas Orsini (Italian Nicolò, died 1323), eldest son of Count John I Orsini of Cephalonia, succeeded his father as count palatine in 1317. In 1318 he murdered his childless uncle, Despot Thomas Komnenos Doukas, seized Arta and southern Epirus, adopted Orthodoxy and married Thomas's widow Anna Palaiologina, daughter of Emperor Michael IX. In 1319 he refused to pay homage to the Angevins as ruler of Epirus. The Byzantines kept Ioannina, recognizing him only as despot in 1319/1320. In 1320 he offered Venice fishing grounds or sugarcane plantations in return for an alliance, but was refused. His siege of Ioannina failed, with its citizens joining the defence, and in 1323 he was killed by his own brother, the future John II.
zh: 尼古拉斯·奥尔西尼（意大利语名尼科洛，卒于1323年）是凯法洛尼亚宫廷伯爵约翰一世的长子，1317年继承父位。1318年，他杀害无嗣的舅父、专制公托马斯·科穆宁·杜卡斯，夺取阿尔塔和伊庇鲁斯南部，皈依东正教，并娶舅父的遗孀、皇帝米海尔九世之女安娜·帕莱奥洛吉娜。1319年，他拒绝以伊庇鲁斯统治者的身份向安茹王朝宣誓效忠。拜占庭保住了约阿尼纳，仅在1319/1320年承认他为专制公。1320年他提出以渔场或甘蔗种植园换取威尼斯结盟，却遭到拒绝。他围攻约阿尼纳时，市民加入守城，围攻最终失败；1323年他被亲弟弟、后来的约翰二世杀死。

en: Theodora Komnene Doukaina Raoulaina Palaiologina was a Byzantine noblewoman, a daughter of the general and governor Theodore Synadenos and his wife Eudokia Doukaina Komnene. She probably married into the Raoul family, from which she took the surname Raoulaina.
zh: 狄奥多拉·科穆宁·杜卡伊娜·拉乌拉伊娜·巴列奥略吉娜是拜占庭贵族女子，为将领兼总督狄奥多尔·西纳德诺斯与妻子欧多基娅·杜卡伊娜·科穆宁之女。她可能嫁入拉乌尔家族，并由此得到“拉乌拉伊娜”这一称谓。

en: Theodora Palaiologina Synadene was a Byzantine noblewoman, the daughter of Constantine Palaiologos and Irene Komnene Laskarina Branaina, and a half-niece of Emperor Michael VIII, who died in 1282 and became her guardian after both her parents died in her girlhood. She married John Angelos Doukas Synadenos and bore him three children, among them the cavalry commander Theodore Synadenos and a daughter, Euphrosyne, who became a nun. After her husband's death she founded the convent of Bebaia Elpis in Constantinople, entered it with Euphrosyne, and composed its typikon, a rule detailing the convent's organization and Palaiologan monastic life.
zh: 狄奥多拉·巴列奥略吉娜·西纳德妮是拜占庭贵族女子，君士坦丁·巴列奥略与伊琳娜·科穆宁娜·拉斯卡琳娜·布拉奈娜之女，皇帝米海尔八世的半侄女。她年少时父母双亡，由1282年去世的米海尔八世监护长大，后嫁给约翰·安格洛斯·杜卡斯·西纳德诺斯，育有三名见于记载的子女，包括骑兵统帅狄奥多尔·西纳德诺斯和出家为修女的女儿欧芙洛绪涅。丈夫死后，她在君士坦丁堡创立“确望”修道院，携欧芙洛绪涅一同入院修行，并为修道院撰写规章，详细记载了该院的组织与巴列奥略时代的修道生活。

en: Theodore Synadenos (c. 1277–1346), son of the megas stratopedarches John Synadenos, was one of the first and most committed supporters of the young Andronikos III against his grandfather Andronikos II. On Easter night 1321 he fled Constantinople with Andronikos and John Kantakouzenos to begin the revolt. He urged the old emperor's deposition, and on the night of 13 May 1328 the three led the army through a gate whose guard had been bribed and took the capital without a fight. As protostrator he governed Constantinople, then Mesembria around 1330 and Epirus from 1336; rebels for Nikephoros II Orsini captured him at Arta in 1338 and held him until 1340. In the civil war of 1341 he tried, as governor of Thessalonica, to hand it to his friend Kantakouzenos, but the Zealots drove him out. He then made terms with the regency, was given a high rank and put under house arrest, and died impoverished in 1345 or 1346.
zh: 狄奥多尔·熏纳德诺斯（约1277—1346）是大都官约翰·熏纳德诺斯之子，是年轻的安德洛尼卡三世对抗祖父安德洛尼卡二世时最早、最坚定的支持者之一。1321年复活节夜间，他与安德洛尼卡三世、约翰·坎塔库泽努斯一同逃出君士坦丁堡，起兵反叛。他力主废黜老皇帝，1328年5月13日夜里，三人买通守门士兵，率军从城门进入都城，兵不血刃。他官至第一司马，先后任君士坦丁堡长官、约1330年起的梅森布里亚总督和1336年起的伊庇鲁斯总督；1338年，尼基弗鲁斯二世·奥尔西尼的拥护者在阿尔塔俘获他，直到1340年才放人。1341年内战中，他以塞萨洛尼基总督的身份企图把城献给旧友坎塔库泽努斯，却被狂热党驱逐。此后他与摄政方议和，得到高官头衔，随即被软禁，于1345或1346年穷困而死。

en: Thomas I Komnenos Doukas (c. 1285–1318) was the son of Nikephoros I of Epirus and Anna Kantakouzene. In 1290 Andronikos II made him despot, and after his father's death around 1297 he inherited Epirus under his mother's regency, which thwarted the claim of his sister Thamar and her Angevin husband Philip of Taranto. Epirote troops recovered Butrinto and Naupaktos in 1304–1305, but a new Angevin invasion in 1307 ended in a compromise ceding many recovered fortresses to Philip. Thomas later married Anna Palaiologina, daughter of Emperor Michael IX. A quarrel with Byzantium brought a Byzantine raid on Arta in 1315; Thomas imprisoned his wife and negotiated with Philip. In 1318 he was murdered by his nephew, Nicholas Orsini of Cephalonia.
zh: 托马斯一世·科穆宁·杜卡斯（约1285—1318）是伊庇鲁斯的尼基弗鲁斯一世与安娜·坎塔库泽娜之子。1290年皇帝安德洛尼卡二世封他为专制公；约1297年父亲去世后，他在母亲摄政下继承伊庇鲁斯，使姐姐塔玛尔与其安茹出身的丈夫塔兰托的腓力的继位要求落空。伊庇鲁斯军队于1304至1305年收复布特林特和纳夫帕克托斯，但1307年安茹军再度入侵后双方妥协，将许多收复的要塞割让给腓力。托马斯后来娶皇帝米海尔九世之女安娜·帕莱奥洛吉娜为妻。1315年与拜占庭的冲突导致拜占庭军袭掠阿尔塔；托马斯囚禁妻子并与腓力谈判。1318年，他被外甥、凯法洛尼亚伯爵尼古劳斯·奥尔西尼杀害。

en: Thomais Komnene Angelina, better known as Thomais Orsini (c. 1330 – before 1385), was the daughter of John II Orsini, Despot of Epirus, and Anna Palaiologina. In 1335 her father died of poison, and in 1338 Emperor Andronikos III annexed Epirus, driving her family from Arta. Around 1348 she married the Serbian governor Simeon Uroš, half-brother of Stefan Dušan, to consolidate his position among the local population; after her brother Nikephoros II died in 1359, Simeon ruled both Epirus and Thessaly. Her children included John Uroš of Thessaly and Maria, wife of Thomas II Preljubović.
zh: 托马伊斯·奥尔西尼，本名托马伊斯·科穆宁·安杰利娜（约1330—1385年前），是伊庇鲁斯专制君主约翰二世·奥尔西尼与安娜·巴列奥略之女。1335年父亲被毒杀，1338年安德洛尼卡三世吞并伊庇鲁斯，她一家被逐出阿尔塔。约1348年，她嫁给塞尔维亚君主斯特凡·杜尚的异母弟、受命出任当地总督的西美昂·乌罗什，以巩固他在当地居民中的地位；1359年其兄尼基弗鲁斯二世战死后，西美昂统治伊庇鲁斯和色萨利。她的子女包括色萨利统治者约翰·乌罗什，以及嫁给托马斯二世·普雷柳博维奇的玛丽亚。

en: Desiderius Erasmus (c. 1466–1536), known as Erasmus of Rotterdam, was a Dutch humanist, Catholic priest and theologian, and an influential scholar of the Northern Renaissance. Orphaned young, he became an Augustinian canon before studying in Paris and visiting England, where he befriended Thomas More. He published the Adagia in 1500 and wrote The Praise of Folly around 1509–1510, including during a stay at More's house; it appeared in 1511. His 1516 edition of the Greek New Testament, with a new Latin translation and annotations, reshaped biblical scholarship and fed the Reformation, yet he stayed within the Catholic Church and argued against Martin Luther on free will in 1524. He died at Basel in 1536.
zh: 德西德里乌斯·伊拉斯谟（约1466—1536），通称鹿特丹的伊拉斯谟，是尼德兰人文主义者、天主教神父和神学家，也是北方文艺复兴有影响力的学者。他幼年成孤，成为奥古斯丁修会修士，后在巴黎求学并访问英国，与托马斯·莫尔结为挚友。他于1500年出版《箴言集》，约1509至1510年写作《愚人颂》，其中一部分是在莫尔家中完成的；该书于1511年出版。他1516年编订的希腊文《新约》附有新的拉丁文译本和注释，重塑了圣经研究，也为宗教改革提供了养分，但他始终留在天主教会内，并于1524年在自由意志问题上与马丁·路德论战。1536年他在巴塞尔去世。

en: Eberhard V von Erbach-Erbach (born before 1277, died before 1303) was Schenk, or hereditary cup-bearer and lord, of Erbach in the Odenwald, serving the Electors Palatine. He belonged to the Erbach-Erbach line headed by his father Konrad I and married Agnes Reiz von Breuberg. Their son Konrad III inherited the Erbach lordship, while another son, Gerlach, became a cathedral canon at Speyer and Worms and was elected bishop of Worms by the chapter in 1329, though the pope had already appointed a rival candidate.
zh: 埃伯哈德五世·冯·埃尔巴赫-埃尔巴赫（1277年前生，1303年前卒）是奥登林山埃尔巴赫的申克，即世袭掌酒官兼领主，效命于普法尔茨选侯。他出身父亲康拉德一世所领的埃尔巴赫-埃尔巴赫支系，娶阿格妮斯·赖茨·冯·布罗伊贝格为妻。其子康拉德三世继承埃尔巴赫领地；另一个儿子格拉赫在施派尔与沃尔姆斯任法政牧师，1329年被教区参议选为沃尔姆斯主教，但教皇此前已任命了他人。

en: Eberhard VIII von Erbach (before 1341 – 3 September 1373) was Schenk, the hereditary cup-bearer of Erbach in the Odenwald, and a son of Schenk Konrad III and Ida von Steinach. He is recorded as a knight in 1341 and in 1347 married Countess Elisabeth von Katzenelnbogen. Their children included Eberhard X, Ida and Margarethe. He died on 3 September 1373, while Elisabeth lived on until 1385.
zh: 埃伯哈德八世·冯·埃尔巴赫（1341年前—1373年9月3日）是奥登林山区埃尔巴赫的世袭司酒，为司酒康拉德三世与伊达·冯·施泰纳赫之子。1341年已有他身为骑士的记载，1347年他娶卡岑埃尔恩博根伯爵小姐伊丽莎白为妻。两人的子女有埃伯哈德十世、伊达和玛格丽特。他于1373年9月3日去世，妻子伊丽莎白则活到1385年。

en: Konrad III von Erbach (before 1296 – 5 June 1363) was Schenk, the hereditary cup-bearer and lord of Erbach in the Odenwald. He succeeded his father Eberhard V after the latter's death in 1303; his mother was Agnes von Breuberg. In 1335 and 1336 he enfeoffed the retainers Albrecht von Echter and Wortwin von Ungelaube with the tithe of Beerfurth. By his wife Ida von Steinach he left the sons Konrad V and Eberhard VIII, who carried on the Erbach-Erbach line. He died on 5 June 1363.
zh: 康拉德三世·冯·埃尔巴赫（1296年前—1363年6月5日）是奥登林山区埃尔巴赫的世袭司酒兼领主。父亲埃伯哈德五世于1303年去世后，他继任其职，母亲是阿格妮丝·冯·布罗伊贝格。1335至1336年，他将比尔富特的什一税分封给侍从阿尔布雷希特·冯·埃希特与沃特温·冯·翁格劳贝。他与妻子伊达·冯·施泰纳赫生有康拉德五世、埃伯哈德八世等子嗣，延续了埃尔巴赫—埃尔巴赫世系，本人于1363年6月5日去世。

en: Konrad V von Erbach, called the Younger (before 1335 – 1381), was Schenk, the hereditary cup-bearer of Erbach in the Odenwald, and the eldest son of Schenk Konrad III and Ida von Steinach. He held the Erbach lordship after his father's death in 1363. His younger brother Eberhard VIII married Countess Elisabeth von Katzenelnbogen. Konrad's own children included his heir Konrad VI and a daughter Anna. He died in 1381.
zh: 康拉德五世·冯·埃尔巴赫，绰号“年轻者”（1335年前—1381年），是奥登林山区埃尔巴赫的世袭司酒，为司酒康拉德三世与伊达·冯·施泰纳赫的长子。1363年父亲去世后，他执掌埃尔巴赫领地。他的弟弟埃伯哈德八世娶了卡岑埃尔恩博根伯爵小姐伊丽莎白。康拉德的子女包括继承人康拉德六世和女儿安娜。他于1381年去世。

en: Kadi Ahmad Burhan al-Din (1345–c. 1398) was a Turcoman judge, poet and ruler born at Kayseri. Trained in Islamic law in Damascus and Cairo, he became qadi of Kayseri in 1364 and later vizier to the Eretnid rulers. The ruler Muhammad Bey also arranged his marriage to his daughter. In 1381 he seized the Eretnid lands around Sivas and took the title sultan. For eighteen years he defended his principality against the Ottomans, Mamluks, Karamanids and Aq Qoyunlu. In 1398 he was captured and executed by the Aq Qoyunlu chief Qara Yuluk Osman, after which the Ottomans occupied Sivas. His Turkic collection is counted the first divan in the language; he also wrote in Persian and Arabic.
zh: 卡迪·艾哈迈德·布尔汉丁（1345—约1398）是出生于开塞利的土库曼法官、诗人与统治者。他曾在大马士革和开罗学习伊斯兰教法，1364年出任开塞利卡迪，后来成为埃尔特纳王朝的维齐尔。统治者穆罕默德贝伊还将女儿嫁给了他。1381年，他夺取锡瓦斯一带的埃尔特纳领地，自称苏丹。十八年间，他为保卫公国先后与奥斯曼、马穆鲁克、卡拉曼和白羊诸势力作战。1398年，他被白羊部首领卡拉·尤卢克·奥斯曼俘获处决，锡瓦斯随后被奥斯曼占领。他的突厥语诗集被视为该语言的第一部《迪万》，他也用波斯语和阿拉伯语写作。

en: Ala al-Din Eretna (died 1352), of Uyghur origin, founded the Eretnid sultanate in central and eastern Anatolia. An officer under the Ilkhanid commander Timurtash, he came to govern Anatolia for the Jalayirid leader Hasan Buzurg and balanced between Mamluk and Mongol overlords. In 1343 he declared himself sultan, later took Darende from the Mamluks and in 1350 seized Konya from the Karamanids. His realm stretched from Konya to Ankara and Erzurum, ruled from Kayseri. Known as Köse Peyghamber, 'the beardless prophet', for restoring order, he died in 1352.
zh: 阿拉丁·埃雷特纳（1352年卒）是维吾尔血统的安纳托利亚中东部埃雷特纳苏丹国的建立者。他本在伊儿汗国将领帖木儿塔失麾下任职，后替札剌亦儿部首领哈桑·布祖格治理安纳托利亚，在马穆鲁克与蒙古宗主之间周旋。1343年他自立为苏丹，其后从马穆鲁克手中夺取达伦代，1350年又从卡拉曼人手中攻取科尼亚。他的国家从科尼亚延伸到安卡拉和埃尔祖鲁姆，以开塞利为都。他因恢复秩序而被称为“无髭先知”（克瑟·佩甘贝尔），1352年去世。

en: Sheikh Hasan was the eldest son of Eretna, founder of the Eretnid Sultanate in central Anatolia, and he governed Sivas on his father's behalf. He died of illness in December 1347 or January 1348, shortly after marrying a princess of the Artuqid dynasty.
zh: 谢赫·哈桑是安纳托利亚中部埃尔特纳苏丹国建立者埃尔特纳的长子，曾代父镇守锡瓦斯。1347年12月或1348年1月，他在与阿尔图格王朝的一位公主成婚后不久便病故。

en: Isfahan Shah Khatun was one of the wives of Ala al-Din Eretna, founder of the Eretnid sultanate, and a relative of the Jalayirid ruler Hasan Buzurg. She was the mother of Eretna's youngest son and successor, Ghiyath al-Din Muhammad I, who became sultan in 1352.
zh: 伊斯法罕·沙·哈屯是埃雷特纳苏丹国建立者阿拉丁·埃雷特纳的妻子之一，也是札剌亦儿部首领哈桑·布祖格的亲属。她生下了埃雷特纳的幼子、后来的继承人吉亚斯·丁·穆罕默德一世，后者于1352年即位为苏丹。

en: Izz al-Din Jafar was a son of the Eretnid founder Ala al-Din Eretna and briefly ruled as the dynasty's sultan in central Anatolia. On Eretna's death in 1352 his younger brother Ghiyath al-Din Muhammad took the throne at Kayseri and imprisoned Jafar, who escaped to Mamluk Egypt. In 1354 the Eretnid emirs deposed the incompetent Muhammad and raised Jafar to the throne. He reigned for less than a year: in April 1355 Muhammad defeated and killed him at the Battle of Yalnızgöz and recovered the sultanate.
zh: 伊兹丁·贾法尔是埃尔特纳王朝建立者阿拉丁·埃尔特纳之子，曾短暂君临这一安纳托利亚中部王朝。1352年埃尔特纳去世，其弟吉亚斯丁·穆罕默德在开塞利继位，将贾法尔囚禁，贾法尔后来逃往马穆鲁克埃及。1354年，埃尔特纳的埃米尔们废黜施政无能的穆罕默德，拥立贾法尔登基。他在位不足一年：1355年4月，穆罕默德在耶尔讷兹格兹战役中将他击败并处死，夺回苏丹之位。

en: Kaluyan, called Kaluyan al-Qunawi in Arabic sources, was an architect active in medieval central Anatolia. His name appears on the Köşkmedrese near Kayseri, the khanqah built in 1339 by Eretna in memory of his consort Suli Pasha; he may have been Armenian. Turkish tradition also credits him with major Seljuk buildings, including the Gök Medrese at Sivas, founded by the vizier Sahip Ata Fahreddin Ali, along with caravanserais and mosques. He is said to have been born a Christian and a follower of the Sufi poet Rumi before converting to Islam.
zh: 卡卢扬在阿拉伯文献中被称为卡卢扬·库纳维，是中世纪活跃于安纳托利亚中部的建筑师。开塞利附近的科什克梅德雷斯留有他的名字：这座修行院由埃尔特纳于1339年为纪念王妃苏利帕夏而建，他可能是亚美尼亚人。土耳其传统还把多座塞尔柱重要建筑归于他名下，包括维齐尔萨希卜·阿塔·法赫雷丁·阿里敕建的锡瓦斯格克经学院，以及若干商队客栈和清真寺。相传他本是基督徒，曾追随苏菲派诗人鲁米，后来改宗伊斯兰教。

en: Ghiyath al-Din Muhammad I was the second sultan of the Eretnids, ruling in Anatolia from his father Eretna's death in 1352 until his murder. Enthroned young at Kayseri, he was deposed by his emirs in 1354 in favor of his brother Jafar, but killed Jafar at the Battle of Yalnızgöz in April 1355 and restored his rule. He lost Ankara to the Ottoman sultan Murad I in 1361. In October 1365, after suppressing a revolt by his vizier Khoja Ali Shah, he was murdered by his emirs at Kayseri, who placed his young son Ali on the throne.
zh: 吉亚斯丁·穆罕默德一世是埃尔特纳王朝第二代苏丹，自1352年父亲埃尔特纳去世起在安纳托利亚执政，直到遇害。他少年时在开塞利登基，1354年被手下埃米尔废黜，改立其兄贾法尔；1355年4月，他在耶尔讷兹格兹战役杀死贾法尔，复辟成功。1361年，安卡拉被奥斯曼苏丹穆拉德一世夺取。1365年10月，他在镇压维齐尔霍贾·阿里沙的叛乱后，于开塞利被埃米尔们杀害，众人拥立他年幼的儿子阿里继位。

en: Suli Pasha Khatun (died 1339) was a consort of Ala al-Din Eretna, founder of the Eretnid sultanate in central Anatolia. After her death in 1339, Eretna built the Köşkmedrese on Mount Köşk southeast of Kayseri in her memory; its lost inscriptions recorded her name, and the name Kaluyan, possibly that of an Armenian architect, also appears on the building. Originally a Sufi khanqah, it became her tomb and later the burial place of Eretna, his son Muhammad I and his grandson Ala al-Din Ali.
zh: 苏利·帕夏·哈屯（1339年卒）是安纳托利亚中部埃雷特纳苏丹国建立者阿拉丁·埃雷特纳的配偶。1339年她去世后，埃雷特纳在开塞利东南的克什克山为纪念她修建克什克麦德雷斯，已不存的原有铭文记载了她的名字，建筑上还出现了可能是亚美尼亚建筑师的“卡卢扬”之名。这座建筑最初是苏菲派修行的罕卡，后成为她的陵墓，埃雷特纳、其子穆罕默德一世和孙阿拉丁·阿里也先后葬于此地。

en: Togha Khatun was one of the wives of Ala al-Din Eretna, founder of the Eretnid sultanate in central Anatolia; his other wives included Suli Pasha and Isfahan Shah Khatun.
zh: 托加·哈屯是安纳托利亚中部埃雷特纳苏丹国建立者阿拉丁·埃雷特纳的妻子之一，他的其他妻子包括苏利·帕夏和伊斯法罕·沙·哈屯。

en: Hermann of Prague (c. 1280–1349) was a Bohemian canon lawyer who became prince-bishop of Warmia. Educated at Bologna, he served at Avignon from 1327 as papal chaplain and auditor of the Rota. In December 1337 Pope Benedict XII named him bishop of Warmia against the Teutonic Order's wishes, but the cathedral chapter barred him until 1340. He then settled the bishopric's borders, founded some seventy-five towns and villages, held the first diocesan synod at Frauenburg in 1343 and set up the collegiate church of St Salvator. He died on 31 December 1349 and was buried at Frauenburg.
zh: 布拉格的赫尔曼（约1280—1349）是波希米亚教会法学者，后来成为瓦尔米亚采邑主教。他曾在博洛尼亚求学，1327年起在阿维尼翁担任教宗司铎与圣轮法院审计员。1337年12月，教宗本笃十二世不顾条顿骑士团的反对任命他为瓦尔米亚主教，但主教座堂参事会拒绝他入境，直到1340年才得以就任。此后他划定教区边界，建立约七十五座城镇和村庄，1343年在弗龙堡召开首届教区会议，并设立圣救主协同教会。他于1349年12月31日去世，葬于弗龙堡。

en: Erumduli Barlas was a twelfth-century Mongol prince of the Borjigin and a military commander, holding the ranks of noyan and darughachi under the khans of the Khamag Mongol. He was a son of Khaduli Barlas and nephew of Khabul Khan, and he served under Khabul, who died in 1148, and later under Ambaghai and Hotula. His own son Suqu Sechen was also an officer of the confederation.
zh: 额鲁木笃里·巴鲁剌思是12世纪蒙古孛儿只斤氏王公、军事将领，在蒙兀国诸汗麾下拥有那颜与达鲁花赤的职衔。他是哈笃里·巴鲁剌思之子、合不勒汗之侄，曾侍奉1148年去世的合不勒，其后又侍奉俺巴孩与忽图剌。其子速忽赤臣也是联盟的将领。

en: Esen-Temür (died 29 February 1332) was a Mongol prince, the son of Hügechi and grandson of Kublai Khan. He was made Prince of Yunnan only in 1280, after Sayyid Ajall had reorganized the province following Hügechi's murder. From 1285 he led campaigns into Burma, sacking Pagan in 1287 and conquering northern Burma; in 1288 the new Burma province came under his supervision. In 1290 the senior title Prince of Liang went to Zhenjin's line; in 1308 he became Prince of Ying. He backed the losing Shangdu faction in the 1328 civil war, lost his seal, and died in 1332.
zh: 也先帖木儿（1332年2月29日卒）是蒙古宗王，忽哥赤之子、忽必烈之孙。父亲被毒杀后，忽必烈派赛典赤·赡思丁整顿云南，迟至1280年他才受封云南王。1285年起他率军征讨缅甸，1287年攻破蒲甘，征服缅甸北部；1288年新设的缅中行省归他节制。1290年，地位更高的梁王封号转入真金一系，他则于1308年受封为营王。1328年的内战中他依附失败的上都派，王印被夺，于1332年去世。
