zh: 富瓦的罗歇·贝尔纳二世，绰号“伟大者”（1195—1241年5月26日），自1223年起任富瓦伯爵，是雷蒙·罗歇与菲利帕之子。他1203年迎娶安道尔女领主、卡斯特尔邦的埃梅森德，为儿子罗歇四世带来卡斯特尔邦与安道尔。1217年，他坚守蒙加亚尔城堡六周，抵御西蒙·德·蒙福尔，随后参加图卢兹围城战。1220年，他协助父亲收复拉沃尔和皮洛朗。继位后，他于1224年协助图卢兹伯爵雷蒙七世攻取卡尔卡松。1226年法王路易八世拒绝他的求和使团，他便在1226—1227年以利穆为据点抵抗国王入侵朗格多克。被处绝罚后，他在1229年《莫城条约》之后议和，放弃米尔普瓦。

en: Roger-Bernard III (1243–1302) became Count of Foix in 1265, succeeding his father Roger IV. After wars among vassals, Philip III of France took Foix in 1272 and imprisoned him at Carcassonne. In 1278 his treaty with the bishop of Urgell set up joint rule of Andorra. Captured by Peter III of Aragon at Balaguer in 1280, he was held at Siurana until 1284, then joined the Aragonese Crusade. In 1290 he seized Béarn through his wife Margaret of Montcada. Her nephew Bernard VI of Armagnac contested the inheritance, beginning a long struggle between the two houses. He led French troops against the English at Saint-Sever (1295) and Bonnegarde (1297), died at Tarascon, and was a troubadour.
zh: 罗歇·贝尔纳三世（1243—1302）于1265年继其父罗杰四世为富瓦伯爵。他与其他封臣私战，法王腓力三世于1272年攻占富瓦，将他囚禁于卡尔卡松。1278年，他与乌赫尔主教立约，确立对安道尔的共同统治。1280年他在巴拉格尔被阿拉贡国王佩德罗三世俘获，囚于锡乌拉纳至1284年，获释后参加阿拉贡十字军。1290年，他凭借妻子玛格丽特·德·蒙卡达夺得贝阿恩。玛格丽特的外甥阿马尼亚克伯爵贝尔纳六世对继承权提出异议，两个家族由此展开长期争斗。他率法军在圣瑟韦（1295）和博讷加德（1297）与英军作战，后殁于塔拉斯孔，同时也是一位游吟诗人。

en: Roger I of Foix (died 1064), a younger son of Count Bernard-Roger and Gersende of Bigorre, succeeded his father around 1034 as the first ruler to call himself count of Foix, while Couserans went to his brother Peter Bernard. In 1034 he made a mutual inheritance pact with his uncle Peter Roger, bishop of Girona, who held the county of Carcassonne; when the bishop died in 1050 Roger added Carcassonne to his lands, and in 1064 his cousin Roger III confirmed his rights there. He left no children, so Foix passed to his brother Peter Bernard.
zh: 富瓦的罗歇一世（卒于1064年）是贝尔纳·罗歇伯爵与比戈尔的加尔森德之子，约1034年继承父亲，成为第一个自称富瓦伯爵的统治者，库瑟朗则归其弟皮埃尔·贝尔纳。1034年，他与担任赫罗纳主教、领有卡尔卡松伯国的叔父皮埃尔·罗歇订立互为继承人的约定；1050年主教去世，罗歇遂取得卡尔卡松，1064年其堂亲罗歇三世确认了他在当地的权利。他身后无嗣，富瓦由弟弟皮埃尔·贝尔纳继承。

en: Roger II (died 1124) was Count of Foix from 1064 and Count of Couserans from 1074, the son of Peter Bernard of Foix and Letgarde. He claimed Carcassonne after its comital line ended but failed to take the city by force, and a treaty of 21 April 1095 confirmed its cession to the Trencavels against a large payment. The money helped finance his participation in the First Crusade. He joined Raymond of Saint-Gilles' host, but delayed his departure so long that the pope excommunicated him. He reached the Holy Land after the fall of Jerusalem and returned in 1105. He then built a castle near Foix and founded the town of Pamiers, which he named after Apamea in Syria.
zh: 富瓦的罗歇二世（1124年卒）自1064年起任富瓦伯爵，1074年起兼库兹朗伯爵，是富瓦的皮埃尔·贝尔纳与莱加德之子。卡尔卡松伯爵世系断绝后，他主张对该城的权利，却未能武力攻取；1095年4月21日的条约确认他把卡尔卡松割让给特伦卡韦勒家族，换取大笔金钱。这笔钱为他参加第一次十字军东征提供了资金。他加入雷蒙·德·圣吉尔的军队，却一再推迟出发，以致遭教皇绝罚。他在耶路撒冷陷落后才抵达圣地，1105年返回。此后他在富瓦附近筑堡，并建立帕米耶镇，以叙利亚城市阿帕米亚命名。

en: Roger III (died 1148) was Count of Foix from 1124, the son of Roger II and Étiennette of Besalú. In 1117 he married Jimena of Barcelona, granddaughter of the Cid. He backed Bernard Aton IV Trencavel's claims to the viscounty of Carcassonne against Raymond Berengar III of Barcelona, and took Bernard Aton's children under his protection after his death in 1129. In 1134 he helped his suzerain Alphonse Jourdain of Toulouse broker peace between Alfonso VII of Castile and Ramiro II of Aragon. In the Baussenque wars over Provence between Toulouse and Barcelona, he remained loyal to Toulouse, unlike many other lords of Languedoc.
zh: 富瓦的罗歇三世（1148年卒）自1124年起任富瓦伯爵，是罗歇二世与贝萨吕的艾蒂安内特之子。1117年，他迎娶熙德的孙女希梅娜·德·巴塞罗那。他支持贝尔纳·阿东四世·特伦卡韦勒对卡尔卡松子爵国的主张，对抗巴塞罗那伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔三世，并在贝尔纳·阿东于1129年去世后庇护其子女。1134年，他协助封君图卢兹伯爵阿方斯·茹尔丹，在卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索七世与阿拉贡国王拉米罗二世之间斡旋议和。图卢兹与巴塞罗那为普罗旺斯而爆发博桑克战争时，他始终忠于图卢兹，不同于许多朗格多克领主。

en: Roger IV (died 24 February 1265) succeeded his mother Ermessinde as Viscount of Castelbon and lord of Andorra in 1237, and his father Roger Bernard II as Count of Foix in 1241. After the failed 1242 revolt of Pyrenean lords against Alphonse of Poitiers, he submitted, but the Count of Toulouse seized Saverdun from him. Roger sought royal aid in 1243, became a direct crown vassal and recovered Saverdun. In 1245 he issued measures abolishing serfdom in Foix. Unlike his father he was a loyal Catholic who favoured the Inquisition, though it suspected him because he refused to punish vassals accused of heresy. He founded Mazères in 1251 and created bastides including Le Mas-d'Azil. His dispute over Andorra with the bishop of Urgell was settled by his son in 1278.
zh: 富瓦的罗歇四世（1265年2月24日卒）于1237年继母亲埃梅森德之后成为卡斯特尔邦子爵、安道尔领主，1241年继父亲罗歇·贝尔纳二世成为富瓦伯爵。1242年，他参加比利牛斯贵族反对普瓦捷的阿方斯的叛乱，失败后归顺，但图卢兹伯爵夺取了他的萨韦尔登。1243年，他向国王求援，成为王室直属封臣并收回萨韦尔登。1245年，他颁布措施，在富瓦实际废除了农奴制。与父亲不同，他虔诚信奉天主教，支持宗教裁判所；但他拒绝惩治被指信奉异端的封臣，因而受到裁判所怀疑。1251年他建立马泽尔，又兴建勒马斯达济勒等新城。他与乌赫尔主教关于安道尔的争端，最终由其子在1278年以共管条约解决。

en: Aimery VII of Thouars (c. 1152–1226), eighteenth viscount of Thouars from 1173, was the eldest son of Geoffroy IV and Denise of Lusignan. He served as seneschal of Anjou and then of Poitou, and stood close to Eleanor of Aquitaine and her son Richard the Lionheart. After the Poitevin barons rose against John of England and Arthur of Brittany was killed in 1203, Philip Augustus made the seneschalcy of Poitou and Aquitaine hereditary in his favor. His son by Sibylle, Guy I, became viscount in 1234; Aimery died in 1226.
zh: 艾默里克七世·德·图阿尔（约1152—1226）是若弗鲁瓦四世与吕西尼昂的德尼丝的长子，自1173年起任第十八代图阿尔子爵。他先后担任安茹和普瓦图的总管，与阿基坦的埃莉诺及其子狮心王理查关系密切。普瓦图贵族起兵反对英王约翰、布列塔尼的阿蒂尔于1203年遇害后，法王腓力·奥古斯特将普瓦图与阿基坦总管一职特许其家族世袭。他与妻子西比勒所生之子居伊一世于1234年继任子爵，他本人于1226年去世。

en: Alfonso of Brienne, called Alphonse d'Acre (c. 1227–1270), was the eldest son of John of Brienne, king of Jerusalem and Latin emperor of Constantinople, and Berengaria of León, born at Acre. He spent his career at the court of Louis IX. By marrying Marie of Exoudun, heiress of Eu, he became count of Eu and served as Grand Chamberlain of France. In 1258 he represented Louis in negotiations with the envoys of Henry III of England for the Treaty of Paris. Widowed in 1260, he governed Eu during his son's minority. In 1265 he aided Alfonso X of Castile against the Moors of Africa, earning praise from Pope Clement IV. He joined the Eighth Crusade and died of dysentery at Tunis on 25 August 1270, the same day as Louis IX.
zh: 布列讷的阿方斯，人称“阿卡的阿方斯”（约1227—1270），是耶路撒冷国王、拉丁皇帝布里耶纳的约翰与莱昂的贝伦加利亚的长子，生于阿卡，成年后一直在路易九世宫廷效力。他娶厄镇伯国女继承人玛丽·德·埃克苏丹，成为厄镇伯爵，并任法兰西大宫廷总管。1258年，他代表路易与英王亨利三世的使者商谈《巴黎条约》。1260年丧妻后，他在儿子未成年期间摄理厄镇伯国。1265年，他援助卡斯蒂利亚的阿方索十世对抗非洲摩尔人，获教皇克莱孟四世褒奖。他随路易九世参加第八次十字军，1270年8月25日在突尼斯死于痢疾，与路易九世同日去世。

en: Alfonso de la Cerda, called of Spain (1289–1327), was the eldest son of the Castilian infante Alfonso de la Cerda, called the disinherited, and Matilda of Brienne. Born and raised in France, he served as archdeacon of Paris, became baron of Lunel in 1324 and lord of Tafalla and Caparroso in Navarre in 1325, and was governor of Languedoc. He married Isabelle of Antoing, viscountess of Ghent, and died at Gentilly on 15 April 1327. His son Charles de la Cerda later became count of Angoulême and constable of France.
zh: 阿方索·德·拉·塞尔达，绰号“西班牙人”（1289—1327），是卡斯蒂利亚王子、绰号“被剥夺者”的阿方索·德·拉·塞尔达与布里耶讷的玛蒂尔德的长子。他生于法国并长于法国，曾任巴黎总执事，1324年成为吕内尔男爵，1325年成为纳瓦拉的塔法利亚与卡帕罗索领主，并出任朗格多克总督。他娶根特女子爵、安图万的伊莎贝尔为妻，1327年4月15日卒于让蒂伊。其子夏尔·德·拉·塞尔达后来成为昂古莱姆伯爵与法兰西统帅。

en: Amaury de Mauvoisin (born c. 1311) was the fourth son of Guy VI de Mauvoisin, baron of Rosny-sur-Seine, and Laure de Ponthieu. He became a canon in Paris, while his brother Pierre was archdeacon of Brie. When their elder brother Guy VII died without male heirs, Amaury held the family lordship and on 29 April 1365 sold the castle and fortress of Rosny to Guy's daughter, his niece Béatrix, wife of Jean de La Ferté-Fresnel. In 1394 he and Pierre were still granting woodland in the forest of Chevry to another niece, Ide de Beaussart.
zh: 阿莫里·德·莫瓦桑（约1311年生）是塞纳河畔罗尼男爵居伊六世·德·莫瓦桑与洛尔·德·蓬蒂厄的第四子，在巴黎任咏礼司铎，其兄皮埃尔任布里总执事。长兄居伊七世无男嗣去世后，阿莫里接掌家族领地，并于1365年4月29日将罗尼城堡与要塞卖给居伊之女、他的侄女贝亚特丽斯，其丈夫是让·德·拉费泰-弗雷内勒。1394年，他仍与皮埃尔一同将舍夫里森林中的林地授予另一位侄女伊德·德·博萨尔。

en: Eudes Archambaud, also numbered Archambaud III, was a 12th-century French nobleman who ruled as lord of Sully in the Orléanais. The son of William of Blois and Agnes, Lady of Sully, he became his parents' sole secular heir after his brothers Ralph and Henry entered the Church, becoming abbot of Cluny and abbot of Fécamp. By his wife Matilda of Baugency he had three sons: his successor Giles, Henry, archbishop of Bourges, and Odo, bishop of Paris. He was still living in 1162.
zh: 厄德·阿尔尚博，又称阿尔尚博三世，是12世纪的法兰西贵族，担任奥尔良地区的叙利领主。他是布卢瓦的威廉与叙利女领主阿涅丝之子；兄弟拉乌尔和亨利都遁入教会，分别成为克吕尼修道院院长和费康修道院院长，他遂成为父母唯一的世俗继承人。他与妻子博让西的玛蒂尔达生有三子：继承人吉尔、布尔日大主教亨利和巴黎主教厄德。1162年时他仍在世。

en: Archambaud IV de Sully, son of Giles II and Luce de Charenton, was lord of Sully. In 1218 Philip Augustus seized Sully and built a keep, restoring it twelve years later. His sons John and Guy became archbishops of Bourges.
zh: 阿尔尚博四世·德·叙利是吉尔二世与吕斯·德·沙朗通之子，袭任叙利领主。1218年，腓力·奥古斯特没收叙利并修建主塔，十二年后才将领地归还。他的儿子让和居伊后来都成为布尔日大主教。

en: Aubert de Coucy (died 1388) was a younger son of Guillaume I de Coucy and Isabelle de Châtillon. He held Drosnay, Droizy and Romeny and married Jeanne de Villesavoir, heiress of Droisy; their daughter Marie inherited Droisy.
zh: 奥贝尔·德·库西（1388年卒）是纪尧姆一世·德·库西与伊莎贝尔·德·沙蒂永的幼子，领有德鲁奈、德鲁瓦齐和罗姆尼，娶德鲁瓦齐女继承人让娜·德·维勒萨瓦尔，女儿玛丽后来继承德鲁瓦齐。

en: Beatrice de Sully was a daughter of Jean II de Sully, lord of Sully-sur-Loire, and Margaret of Bourbon. She became the first wife of Aymeri VI, Viscount of Narbonne, the future Admiral of France, and died before his second marriage in 1360.
zh: 贝阿特丽斯·德叙利是卢瓦尔河畔叙利领主让二世·德叙利与波旁的玛格丽特之女，纳博讷子爵、后来的法兰西海军统帅艾默里六世的第一任妻子，在他于1360年再婚之前便已去世。

en: Béatrix de Mauvoisin (born c. 1331) was the second of three daughters of Guy VII de Mauvoisin, baron of Rosny, and Roberte de Beaumetz. In 1355 she married Jean III, seigneur of La Ferté-Fresnel, Neubourg and Gacé in Normandy. After her father died without a son, her uncle Amaury, a canon in Paris, sold her the castle and lordship of Rosny by a charter dated 29 April 1365. After Béatrix's death, Rosny passed to her younger sister Marguerite's son Robert V d'Harcourt and, when that line failed, to descendants of her elder sister Laure.
zh: 贝亚特丽斯·德·莫瓦桑（约1331年生）是罗尼男爵居伊七世·德·莫瓦桑与罗贝尔特·德·博梅三个女儿中的次女。1355年，她嫁给诺曼底的拉费泰-弗雷内勒、讷堡和加塞领主让三世。父亲无男嗣去世后，她的叔父、巴黎咏礼司铎阿莫里以1365年4月29日的特许状将罗尼城堡与领地出售给她。贝亚特丽斯死后，罗尼传给幼妹玛格丽特之子罗贝尔五世·德·阿库尔；该支断绝后，又归长姐洛尔的后裔。

en: Blanche of Brabant (c. 1287–1330), dame de Rochecorbon, was a younger daughter of Godfrey of Brabant, lord of Aerschot, and Jeanne de Vierzon. In 1307 she married John I, Viscount of Thouars, and bore three sons, including Louis I, who succeeded as viscount.
zh: 布拉班特的布朗什（约1287—1330），罗什科尔邦女领主，是阿尔斯霍特领主布拉班特的戈弗雷与让娜·德·维耶尔宗年纪较小的女儿。1307年，她嫁给图阿尔子爵让一世，生有三个儿子，其中路易一世后来承袭子爵之位。

en: Blanche of Castile (1188–1252), born at Palencia, was a daughter of Alfonso VIII of Castile and Eleanor of England, and in 1200 married the future Louis VIII of France. Her English ancestry helped bring Louis an offer of the English crown, and she backed his invasion of England in 1216. From Calais she organized fleets and an army to reinforce him. Left a widow in 1226, she ruled as regent for the young Louis IX, putting down the revolts of the great nobles, checking Peter of Brittany and forcing the Treaty of Paris on Raymond VII of Toulouse in 1229, which ended the Albigensian Crusade. She held a second regency from 1248 while Louis crusaded, dying at Melun in 1252.
zh: 卡斯蒂利亚的布兰卡（1188—1252）生于帕伦西亚，是卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索八世与英格兰的埃莉诺之女，1200年嫁给后来的法兰西国王路易八世。她的英格兰王室血统使路易获得英格兰王位的邀约，她也支持路易在1216年进军英格兰。她在加来组织舰队和军队，前去增援丈夫。1226年丈夫死后，她为年幼的路易九世摄政，平定大贵族的叛乱，遏制布列塔尼的皮埃尔，并于1229年迫使图卢兹伯爵雷蒙七世签订《巴黎条约》，结束了阿尔比十字军战争。1248年路易九世参加十字军东征，她再度摄政，1252年于默伦去世。

en: Blanche of France (1 April 1328 – 8 February 1393) was the posthumous daughter of Charles IV and Joan of Évreux, born at Châteauneuf-sur-Loire two months after her father's death; as the last direct Capetian, her birth allowed Philip VI of Valois to claim the throne. Her lingering claim to Navarre was bought out in 1342. On 18 January 1345 she married Philip, Duke of Orléans, younger son of Philip VI, a childless match. While Philip was held captive in England after Poitiers (1356–1360), Blanche administered his lands. She died at Vincennes in 1393 and was buried at Saint-Denis.
zh: 法兰西的布朗歇（1328年4月1日—1393年2月8日）是查理四世与埃夫勒的让娜的遗腹女，在父亲去世两个月后生于卢瓦尔河畔新堡，也是卡佩王朝直系最后一位成员；她的出生使瓦卢瓦的腓力六世得以登上王位。她对纳瓦拉的残存继承权于1342年被买断。1345年1月18日，她嫁给腓力六世的幼子奥尔良公爵腓力，婚姻没有子嗣。1356年普瓦捷战役后丈夫被英军囚禁至1360年，其间由布朗歇管理他的领地。她于1393年在万塞讷去世，葬于圣但尼圣殿。

en: Carloman II (c. 866–884), second son of Louis the Stammerer, succeeded to West Francia in 879 and ruled with his brother Louis. At Amiens in 880 the brothers divided their father's realm, Carloman taking Aquitaine; together they campaigned against Boso of Provence and in August 881 routed Viking raiders at Saucourt-en-Vimeu. After Louis's death in 882 Carloman ruled alone, facing Viking raids and restive Burgundian nobles. In December 884, hunting near Les Andelys, he was stabbed in the leg by his servant Bertoldus during a boar attack and died days later. His cousin Charles the Fat inherited his kingdom.
zh: 卡洛曼二世（约866—884）是口吃者路易的次子，879年与兄长路易共同统治西法兰克。880年，兄弟二人在亚眠瓜分父亲的王国，卡洛曼分得阿基坦；他们联手征讨普罗旺斯的博索，并于881年8月在索库尔昂维默击溃维京入侵者。882年路易死后，卡洛曼独自治国，面对维京人的袭扰和勃艮第贵族的抗命。884年12月，他在莱桑德利附近狩猎时，被仆人贝尔托尔德斯在野猪攻击中刺中腿部，数日后死去。他的堂亲胖子查理继承了王国。

en: Catherine of Courtenay (1274–1307) was the heiress of Philip of Courtenay, titular Latin emperor of Constantinople, and Beatrice of Sicily. On her father's death in 1283 she inherited his claim to the Latin Empire, lost to the Greeks in 1261, and was recognized as empress by the Latin states in Greece. Betrothals to Michael IX Palaiologos, Frederick of Aragon and James of Majorca all failed before she married Charles of Valois in February 1301; Charles then held the imperial title in her right. She died in Paris in 1307, leaving her claim to her daughter Catherine of Valois-Courtenay.
zh: 库尔特奈的凯瑟琳（1274—1307）是君士坦丁堡名义拉丁皇帝库尔特奈的腓力与西西里的贝亚特丽斯之女和继承人。1283年父亲去世后，她继承了对1261年已落入希腊人之手的拉丁帝国的权利主张，并得到希腊境内拉丁诸邦承认为女皇。她与米哈伊尔九世·巴列奥略、阿拉贡的腓特烈、马略卡的海梅的三次婚约先后告吹，1301年2月嫁给瓦卢瓦的查理，查理遂以妻权拥有皇帝头衔。1307年她在巴黎去世，继承权传给女儿瓦卢瓦-库尔特奈的凯瑟琳。

en: Charlemagne (747/748–814), eldest son of Pepin the Short, became King of the Franks in 768 and sole ruler after Carloman's death in 771. He conquered the Lombard kingdom in 774, waged decades of war to subdue and convert the Saxons, and annexed Bavaria, extending Frankish rule across much of Western and Central Europe. On Christmas Day 800 in Rome Pope Leo III crowned him emperor, reviving the imperial title in the West. His reforms in law, administration and education fostered the Carolingian Renaissance. He died at Aachen on 28 January 814 and was buried in the Palatine Chapel.
zh: 查理曼（747/748—814）是矮子丕平的长子，768年成为法兰克国王，771年卡洛曼去世后独掌王权。他于774年攻灭伦巴第王国，经数十年战争征服萨克森人并迫其改宗，又吞并巴伐利亚，把法兰克的统治扩展到西欧和中欧的大部分地区。800年圣诞节，教皇利奥三世在罗马为他加冕为帝，在西方恢复了皇帝称号。他在法律、行政和教育方面的改革促成了加洛林文艺复兴。814年1月28日他在亚琛去世，安葬于当地的行宫教堂。

en: Charles of Artois (1328–1385), count of Pézenas, was the youngest son of Robert III of Artois and Joan of Valois. In 1334 his uncle Philip VI shut him and his brothers in Château-Gaillard; John II freed him on his accession in 1350 and made him a councillor. In 1355 he swore to the Treaty of Valognes among the lords of the blood. In 1356 he received Longueville, confiscated from Philip of Navarre, on his marriage, and helped take Évreux and Breteuil from Charles the Bad. Captured at Poitiers, he spent four years in London. Longueville was taken back in 1360, and in 1362 Pézenas was raised to a county as compensation. Hoping to win Artois, he joined the Prince of Wales's companies in 1367; his exactions on the English side led Charles V to confiscate his property. Reconciled in 1375, he stirred up trouble again, and the Duke of Anjou arrested him at Agde. He died in 1385.
zh: 阿图瓦的查理（1328—1385），佩泽纳斯伯爵，是罗贝尔三世·德·阿图瓦与瓦卢瓦的让娜的幼子。1334年，舅父腓力六世把他和兄长们关进加亚尔堡；1350年让二世即位后将他释放，并让他进入御前会议。1355年，他作为王室血亲领主之一宣誓遵守《瓦洛涅条约》。1356年成婚时，他得到从纳瓦拉的腓力手中没收的隆格维尔伯国，并协助从纳瓦拉国王“恶人”查理手里夺取埃夫勒和布勒特伊。普瓦捷战败被俘后，他在伦敦被囚四年。1360年隆格维尔被收回，1362年佩泽纳斯升为伯国作为补偿。为争取阿图瓦，他于1367年投入威尔士亲王麾下的军团；他在英国一方的勒索，使查理五世没收了他的财产。1375年与国王和解，随后又生事端，安茹公爵在阿格德将他逮捕。1385年去世。

en: Charles the Bald (823–877), youngest son of Louis the Pious and grandson of Charlemagne, was born at Frankfurt. The civil wars of his father's reign ended with the Treaty of Verdun in 843, which gave him the empire's western third. He fought rebellious Aquitainians and Bretons, who defeated him at Ballon in 845, and Viking raiders, paying tribute after the sack of Paris that year; his Edict of Pistres of 864 created a cavalry force and fortified bridges. In 875 Pope John VIII crowned him emperor at Rome. He died in 877 at Avrieux while recrossing the Alps.
zh: 秃头查理（823—877）生于法兰克福，是路易一世的幼子、查理曼之孙。其父在位末年的内战以843年《凡尔登条约》告终，查理分得加洛林帝国的西部。他先后镇压阿基坦叛乱、征讨布列塔尼人——后者于845年在巴隆击败了他——并抗击维京人：845年巴黎遭洗劫后，他被迫支付赎金；864年他颁布《皮斯特敕令》，组建骑兵并下令在河流上修筑设防桥梁。875年，教宗若望八世在罗马为他加冕为帝。877年，他在翻越阿尔卑斯山途中于阿夫里约去世。

en: Charles III the Simple (879–929), posthumous son of Louis the Stammerer, was only five when nobles gave his crown to Charles the Fat in 884; after Odo of Paris died he was at last recognized as king in 898. In 911 he enfeoffed the Viking leader Rollo with lands around Rouen, the seed of Normandy, and annexed Lotharingia. Revolting nobles proclaimed Robert I king in 922; although Robert was killed at Soissons in 923, Charles was defeated. He was captured by Herbert II of Vermandois and died imprisoned at Péronne in 929. His son by Eadgifu of Wessex became Louis IV.
zh: 糊涂王查理（879—929）是口吃者路易的遗腹子。884年卡洛曼二世去世时他年仅五岁，贵族们把王位交给胖子查理；直到898年巴黎的厄德死后，他才被承认为国王。911年，他把鲁昂一带的土地封给维京人首领罗洛，诺曼底公国由此发端；同年他又吞并了洛塔林吉亚。922年，反叛的贵族推举罗贝尔一世为王；923年苏瓦松之战中，罗贝尔虽被杀，查理却遭到击败。他被韦尔芒杜瓦伯爵埃贝尔二世俘虏，929年死于佩罗讷的囚禁中。他与威塞克斯的埃德吉芙所生之子即路易四世。

en: Charles IV, called the Fair (1294–1328), third son of Philip IV, ruled France and Navarre from 1322, the last king of the direct Capetian line. His first wife Blanche of Burgundy was disgraced in the Tour de Nesle affair of 1314 and their marriage was annulled. From 1323 he faced a peasant revolt in Flanders, and in 1324 his bid for the imperial crown failed. That year his troops overran English-held Guyenne in the War of Saint-Sardos. In the ensuing peace Edward II accepted homage and a fine, recovering a reduced Guyenne. Charles died in 1328 leaving no son; France passed to his cousin Philip of Valois and Navarre to his niece Joan II. The French succession dispute fed the Hundred Years' War.
zh: “美男子”查理四世（1294—1328）是腓力四世第三子，1322年起统治法兰西与纳瓦拉，也是卡佩嫡系的末代国王。他的第一任妻子勃艮第的布朗奇卷入1314年的内斯勒塔事件，二人婚姻被废除。1323年起他面临佛兰德农民起义，1324年竞选神圣罗马帝位失败。同年，他的军队在圣萨尔多战争中攻占英格兰人据有的吉耶讷公国。随后的和约中，爱德华二世同意向他效忠并缴纳罚金，换回了领土缩小的吉耶讷。1328年查理去世时没有留下男嗣，法兰西王位传给堂弟瓦卢瓦的腓力，纳瓦拉王位归侄女胡安娜二世。法国王位的继承纠纷后来成为百年战争的导火索。

en: Charles de la Cerda (1327–1354), known as Charles of Spain, was a Franco-Castilian nobleman, a distant cousin and boyhood favourite of John II of France. In 1350 he commanded the Castilian galleys at L'Espagnols-sur-Mer off Winchelsea, where Edward III of England defeated him after a long, desperate struggle. Once John was king, Charles succeeded the executed Raoul II of Eu as Constable of France and was made Count of Angoulême. That county had been vacant since 1349, and Charles the Bad, king of Navarre, claimed it and bitterly resented the favourite's rise. In 1351 Charles married Marguerite, daughter of the Duke of Brittany. After a quarrel with Philippe, the Navarrese king's brother, he was killed in an inn at L'Aigle in Normandy on 8 January 1354 by Jean le Soult, called Le Bascon, a henchman of the king of Navarre. The murder left France unsettled until Charles V came to the throne in 1364.
zh: 夏尔·德·拉切尔达（1327—1354），人称“西班牙的夏尔”，是法兰西—卡斯蒂利亚血统的贵族，法王约翰二世的远亲，也是他自幼的宠臣。1350年，他率卡斯蒂利亚桨帆船队在温切尔西外海的“西班牙人海战”中与英王爱德华三世苦战，最终落败。约翰即位后，他接替被处决的欧伯爵拉乌尔二世出任法兰西王室统帅，并受封昂古莱姆伯爵。昂古莱姆自1349年起空缺，纳瓦拉国王“恶人”查理也主张拥有它，对这位宠臣的得势极为怨恨。1351年，夏尔迎娶布列塔尼公爵之女玛格丽特。1354年1月8日，他同纳瓦拉国王之弟菲利普争吵后，在诺曼底莱格勒的一家客栈被纳瓦拉国王的亲信、绰号“巴斯克人”的让·勒苏尔特杀死。此案使法国局势动荡，直到1364年查理五世即位才告平息。

en: Charles de Trie succeeded his father Jean III as Count of Dammartin in 1338 and ruled until 1394. In 1351 he married Jeanne d'Amboise, lady of Nesle and Mondoubleau; their daughter Blanche, dying about 1402 without issue, was the last Trie holder of Dammartin.
zh: 查理·德·特里1338年继父让三世之后成为达马尔坦伯爵，一直统治到1394年。1351年他娶内勒与蒙杜布洛女领主让娜·德·安布瓦斯；女儿布朗什约1402年无嗣而终，是特里家族最后一位达马尔坦伯国的持有者。

en: Charles of Valois (1270–1325), fourth son of Philip III and Isabella of Aragon, founded the House of Valois. He held Valois, Alençon and Perche in appanage. The 1285 Aragonese Crusade gave him a short-lived paper crown as king of Aragon. He became count of Anjou and Maine by his 1290 marriage to Margaret of Anjou and commanded in Flanders in 1297. He led a papal army into Italy in 1301–1302 and claimed the Latin Empire through Catherine of Courtenay. His Sicilian campaign ended in the Peace of Caltabellotta in 1302. In 1324 he overran Guyenne against Edward II. He died in 1325, three years before his son Philip VI took the French throne.
zh: 瓦卢瓦的查理（1270—1325）是腓力三世与阿拉贡的伊莎贝拉的第四子，瓦卢瓦王朝的开创者。他领有瓦卢瓦、阿朗松和佩尔什作为封禄。1285年阿拉贡十字军曾给他一顶有名无实的阿拉贡王冠，不久便放弃。1290年他与安茹的玛格丽特结婚，成为安茹和曼恩伯爵，1297年在佛兰德指挥作战。1301—1302年他率教皇军队进入意大利，并通过妻子库特奈的凯瑟琳主张拉丁帝国皇位。他的西西里远征以1302年的《卡尔塔贝洛塔和约》告终。1324年他对英格兰的爱德华二世作战，攻占吉耶讷。1325年他去世，三年后其子腓力六世登上法国王位。

en: Delphine Roger was a daughter of Guillaume II Roger, Count of Beaufort, and Marie de Chambon, and a niece of Pope Clement VI. She married Hugues de La Roche. Their daughter Marthe de La Roche married Louis, Baron of Montboissier.
zh: 德尔菲娜·罗歇是博福尔伯爵纪尧姆二世·罗歇与玛丽·德尚邦之女、教宗克雷芒六世的侄女。她嫁给于格·德拉罗什，女儿玛尔特·德拉罗什嫁给蒙布瓦西耶男爵路易。

en: Dreux VI de Mello (died c. 1320), also numbered IV or V, was sire de Lormes and Château-Chinon, a Burgundian baron. He left two heiresses: Jeanne, who married Raoul I of Brienne in 1315, and Marguerite.
zh: 德勒六世·德·梅洛（约1320年卒，亦被记作四世或五世）是勃艮第的洛尔姆与沙托希农领主；他的两个女继承人是让娜和玛格丽特，让娜于1315年嫁给拉乌尔一世·德·布里安。

en: Eleanor of Savoy (c. 1280–1324) was a daughter of Count Amadeus V of Savoy and Sibylle de Baugé. On 12 January 1292 she married in Paris William of Chalon, Count of Auxerre and Tonnerre, who was killed fighting for Philip IV at the battle of Mons-en-Pévèle in 1304. In 1305 she married Dreux IV de Mello, lord of Sainte-Hermine, and after his death in 1317 took a third husband, John I, Count of Forez. Her children by William included John II, Count of Auxerre, and Joan, Countess of Tonnerre.
zh: 萨伏依的埃莉诺（约1280—1324）是萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥五世与博热的西比耶之女。1292年1月12日，她在巴黎嫁给欧塞尔与托内尔伯爵沙隆的纪尧姆；后者于1304年为腓力四世作战，死于蒙斯昂佩韦勒战役。1305年她改嫁圣埃尔米纳领主德勒四世·德·梅洛，1317年丧夫后又嫁给福雷伯爵让一世。她与纪尧姆的子女包括欧塞尔伯爵让二世和托内尔女伯爵让娜。

en: Isabella of Aragon (c. 1247–1271) was the youngest daughter of King James I of Aragon and Violant of Hungary. Under the Treaty of Corbeil of 1258 she was betrothed to Philip, second son of Louis IX, and they married at Clermont in May 1262. She joined the Eighth Crusade against Tunis in 1270 and became queen of France when Louis IX died that August. On the journey home she fell from her horse while six months pregnant, gave birth prematurely, and died at Cosenza on 28 January 1271. Her sons included Philip IV and Charles of Valois.
zh: 亚拉冈的伊莎贝尔（约1247—1271）是亚拉冈国王海梅一世与匈牙利的维奥兰特最小的女儿。按1258年《科尔贝条约》的安排，她与法兰西国王路易九世的次子腓力订婚，两人于1262年5月在克莱蒙成婚。1270年她随第八次十字军出征突尼斯，同年8月路易九世去世，她成为法兰西王后。归途中她怀有六个月身孕时坠马，早产生下一子，于1271年1月28日在科森扎去世。她的儿子包括腓力四世和瓦卢瓦的查理。

en: Élisabeth de Courtenay (1140–1205) was the daughter and heiress of Renaud de Courtenay, lord of Courtenay, and Hedwige du Donjon. In 1150 she was married by proxy to Pierre de France, a son of King Louis VI, who through the wedding acquired the lordship of Courtenay; their descendants made up the Capetian House of Courtenay. Her son Pierre II was crowned Latin emperor of Constantinople in 1217, and her daughter Alix was the mother of Isabelle of Angoulême, queen of England. Élisabeth died in 1205.
zh: 伊丽莎白·德·库尔特奈（1140—1205）是库尔特奈领主雷诺·德·库尔特奈与埃德维格·迪东容之女及继承人。1150年，她以代理婚姻嫁给法兰西国王路易六世之子皮埃尔·德·法兰西，后者借此婚姻获得库尔特奈领地，二人的后代形成卡佩支系库尔特奈家族。她的儿子皮埃尔二世于1217年加冕为君士坦丁堡拉丁皇帝，女儿爱丽丝是英格兰王后昂古莱姆的伊莎贝尔之母。伊丽莎白于1205年去世。

en: Enguerrand V de Coucy (1243–after 1321), second son of Arnould III, Count of Guînes, and Alix de Coucy, sought fortune abroad after his father sold Guînes to France. In Scotland he married Christiana Lindsay, John Balliol's niece, their wedding arranged by their cousin Alexander III. He served Edward I of England from 1283 and sat in parliament as Lord Ghisnes; he attended the 1290 Treaty of Birgham. When his uncle Enguerrand IV died heirless in 1311, he inherited the barony of Coucy, and in 1318 supported Mahaut of Artois. He died after 1321 and was buried at Prémontré Abbey.
zh: 昂盖朗五世·德·库西（1243—1321年后）是吉讷伯爵阿尔努三世与库西的阿利克斯的次子。父亲把吉讷伯国卖给法国王室后，他赴海外自谋前程。在苏格兰，他娶了约翰·巴里奥的外甥女克里斯蒂娜·德·林赛，婚事由表兄亚历山大三世安排。1283年起他效力于英格兰国王爱德华一世，并以“吉讷勋爵”身份出席议会；他还出席了1290年的《布里格姆条约》。1311年舅父昂盖朗四世无嗣而终，他继承了库西男爵领；1318年他支持阿图瓦的玛奥。他在1321年后去世，葬于普雷蒙特雷修道院。

en: Enguerrand VI de Coucy (1313–1346) succeeded his father in 1335 as lord of Coucy, Marle, La Fère and Oisy, and spent his short rule in Philip VI's war against Edward III of England. In 1338 he married Catherine of Austria, daughter of Duke Leopold I, a match Philip VI arranged to draw the Habsburgs to the French side. In 1339 his men held the castle of Oisy against Jean de Beaumont, Edward's ally, who came with a force of five hundred lances; in 1340 he joined the relief of Tournai, and in January 1346 he distinguished himself in the Duke of Normandy's Gascon campaign. That August he was killed in a skirmish just before Crécy. His young son Enguerrand VII succeeded him and in 1360, after Poitiers, served as a hostage in exchange for King John II's freedom.
zh: 昂盖朗六世·德·库西（1313—1346）于1335年继承父亲之位，成为库西、马尔勒、拉费尔和瓦西的领主，短暂的一生都在腓力六世对英王爱德华三世的战争中度过。1338年，他娶奥地利公爵利奥波德一世之女奥地利的卡特琳为妻，这门亲事由腓力六世安排，意在拉拢哈布斯堡家族站到法兰西一边。1339年，爱德华的盟友让·德·博蒙率五百骑兵来攻，他的部下守住了瓦西城堡；1340年他随军驰援图尔奈，1346年1月又在诺曼底公爵让的加斯科涅远征中立下战功。同年8月，他在克雷西战役前夕的交战中阵亡。幼子昂盖朗七世继领其地，并在1360年普瓦捷战役之后充当人质，换取国王约翰二世的自由。

en: Eschivat IV of Chabanais (died 1283), son of Jordan of Chabanais and Alix de Montfort, countess of Bigorre, inherited Bigorre from his mother in 1255. His wife Mascarose II, countess of Armagnac and Fézensac, died childless in 1256. A quarrel with his aunt Martha, wife of Gaston VII of Béarn, brought Gaston's invasion; in 1256 Eschivat married Inès, daughter of Roger IV of Foix. In 1258 he entrusted Bigorre to Simon de Montfort, who kept it and soon rebelled against Henry III, after which Eschivat and Gaston reconquered the county. After his death, his aunt and his sister Laura disputed Bigorre.
zh: 沙巴内的埃希瓦特四世（卒于1283年）是沙巴内领主茹尔丹与比戈尔女伯爵阿丽克斯·德·蒙福尔之子，1255年继承母亲的比戈尔伯国。他的妻子、阿马尼亚克与费藏萨克女伯爵马斯卡罗斯二世于1256年无嗣而终。他与姨妈——贝阿恩子爵加斯东七世之妻玛特——发生争执，招致加斯东入侵；1256年他娶富瓦的罗歇四世之女伊内丝为妻。1258年他把比戈尔托付给西蒙·德·蒙福尔，西蒙却据为己有并很快起兵反叛英王亨利三世，埃希瓦特遂与加斯东联手收复伯国。他死后，姨妈与姊妹洛尔又为比戈尔争执不休。

en: François-Marie Arouet, known as Voltaire (1694–1778), was the leading French writer of the Enlightenment. Born in Paris and educated by the Jesuits, he spent eleven months in the Bastille for a satirical verse about the regent. He won fame with his tragedy Œdipe in 1718, but after a quarrel with a nobleman he was exiled to England (1726–1729). His Letters Concerning the English Nation (1733), published in French as Lettres philosophiques in 1734, praised British liberty and religious tolerance; it was publicly burned and he fled to Cirey. He wrote Candide in 1759, satirizing philosophical optimism, and, settled at Ferney, campaigned against intolerance, dying in Paris in 1778.
zh: 弗朗索瓦-马里·阿鲁埃，笔名伏尔泰（1694—1778），是法国启蒙时代最具代表性的作家。他生于巴黎，在耶稣会学校受教育，因讽刺摄政王的诗作被囚于巴士底狱十一个月。他于1718年以悲剧《俄狄浦斯王》成名，后因与一位贵族发生冲突，于1726—1729年流亡英国。他的《哲学通信》英文版于1733年出版，1734年以法文刊行，书中赞扬英国的自由与宗教宽容，结果被当众焚毁，他本人逃往西雷。1759年他写成讽刺哲学乐观主义的《老实人》，定居费尔后持续抨击宗教偏执，1778年在巴黎去世。

en: Gaucher V de Châtillon (c. 1249–1329), lord of Châtillon and count of Porcien, was named constable of Champagne by Philip III in 1284 and helped free Charles II of Naples from Aragonese captivity. In 1291 he drove the army of Count Henry III of Bar out of Champagne. He fought in Flanders in 1302, surviving the Bruges rising and the defeat at Courtrai, after which Philip IV made him constable of France; he shared in the victory of Mons-en-Pévèle in 1304. In 1316 he backed Philip of Poitiers' regency and moved that women be barred from the crown. Still campaigning at eighty, he fought at Cassel in 1328 and died in 1329.
zh: 戈谢·德·沙蒂永（约1249—1329）是沙蒂永领主、波尔西安伯爵，1284年被腓力三世任命为香槟统帅，并曾促成那不勒的查理二世脱离阿拉贡的囚禁。1291年，他将巴尔伯爵亨利三世的军队逐出香槟。1302年他在佛兰德作战，经历了布鲁日起义和科特赖克惨败，战后腓力四世升他为法兰西王室统帅；1304年他又参与蒙斯昂佩韦勒之战的胜利。1316年他支持普瓦捷的腓力摄政，并提议禁止女性继承王位。年届八旬时他仍在1328年的卡塞尔战役中出战，1329年去世。

en: Gaucher de Châtillon was the son of Jean II de Châtillon and Éléonore de Roye. He was lord of Châtillon-sur-Marne and Troissy, married Allemande de Flotte de Revel, and was the father of Gaucher VII de Châtillon. He died in 1377.
zh: 戈谢·德·沙蒂永是让二世·德·沙蒂永与埃莱奥诺尔·德·鲁瓦之子，领有沙蒂永-马恩和特鲁瓦西，娶阿勒芒德·德·弗洛特·德·勒韦勒为妻，生子戈谢七世，1377年去世。

en: Giles II (or Gilon), lord of Sully in the later 12th century, succeeded his father Eudes Archambaud. By his wife Luce de Charenton his sons included his heir Archambaud IV, the cardinal-archbishop Simon (died 1232) and Bernard, bishop of Auxerre.
zh: 吉尔二世（又作吉隆）是12世纪后期的叙利领主，袭父亲厄德·阿尔尚博之位。他与妻子吕斯·德·沙朗通生有继承人阿尔尚博四世、1232年去世的枢机兼大主教西蒙，以及欧塞尔主教贝尔纳。

en: William of Cremona (Guglielmo Amidano, c. 1270–1356) was an Italian Augustinian theologian born at Cremona. After teaching theology he became Prior General of the Order of Hermits of Saint Augustine in 1326, heading the order for sixteen years. On 17 July 1342 Pope Clement VI made him Bishop of Novara. As bishop he reorganised his diocese's estates and recorded them in a Latin register, the Consignationes, preserved among the cathedral archives. He died at Novara on 29 January 1356 and was buried in Pavia at San Pietro in Ciel d'Oro.
zh: 克雷莫纳的威廉（约1270—1356）是意大利奥斯定会神学家，生于克雷莫纳。他先教授神学，1326年出任圣奥斯定隐修会总会长，主持修会十六年。1342年7月17日，教皇克雷芒六世任命他为诺瓦拉主教。任内他整顿教区产业，并以拉丁文登记造册，这份《产业录》保存在大教堂档案中。1356年1月29日他卒于诺瓦拉，葬于帕维亚的金天圣伯多禄圣殿。

en: Guillaume I Roger was châtelain de Rosiers in the Limousin, and by his wife Guillemette de Mestre fathered three notable sons: Pierre Roger, who became Pope Clement VI in 1342, Guillaume II Roger, and Hugues Roger, cardinal of Tulle.
zh: 纪尧姆一世·罗歇是利穆赞地区罗西耶的城堡主，妻子为纪耶梅特·德·梅斯特尔；三个儿子声名显赫：皮埃尔·罗歇于1342年成为教宗克雷芒六世，另有纪尧姆二世·罗歇和蒂勒枢机于格·罗歇。

en: Guillaume II Roger (1290–1380) was a Limousin nobleman, born at Rosiers-d'Égletons, the elder brother of Pope Clement VI. After receiving the fief of Chambon through his first wife Marie de Chambon in 1331, he was ennobled in 1332 and bought his family's lands at Rosiers in 1333. Clement's election in 1342 brought him Beaufort, raised into a county in 1347; Queen Joanna of Naples granted him Pertuis and Saint-Rémy in 1353, and he inherited the county of Alès in 1362. By Marie de Chambon he fathered the future Pope Gregory XI. He died at Cornillon in 1380.
zh: 纪尧姆二世·罗歇（1290—1380）是利穆赞贵族，生于罗西耶-代格莱通，为教皇克雷芒六世之兄。1331年他因首任妻子玛丽·德·尚邦获得尚邦领地，1332年受封贵族，1333年购入罗西耶-代格莱通的家族土地。1342年克雷芒当选教皇后，他得到博福尔领地，该领地于1347年升为伯国；1353年那不勒斯女王乔万娜将佩尔蒂和圣雷米封赐给他，1362年他又继承阿莱斯伯国。他与玛丽·德·尚邦之子后来成为教皇额我略十一世。1380年他卒于科尔尼永。

en: Guillaume III Roger de Beaufort (1332–1395), vicomte de Turenne, was son of Guillaume II Roger and Marie de Chambon, nephew of Clement VI and brother of Gregory XI, two Avignon popes. On 7 February 1350 he married Aliénor de Comminges, and Clement VI gave the couple the vicomté of Turenne, one of the richest in the Limousin, as a wedding gift. In 1351 Joanna I of Naples named him Grand Chamberlain of her kingdom. The Treaty of Brétigny made Turenne English, and in 1361 he paid homage to the English king, though he remained a faithful Valois man. He crusaded at Alexandria in 1365, represented Gregory XI at the Bruges conference in 1375 and served as rector of the Comtat Venaissin from 1376. In 1383 he presided over the assembly at Alès whose peace ended the Tuchin revolt. He died in Paris on 28 March 1395 and was buried in Notre-Dame.
zh: 纪尧姆三世·罗歇·德·博福尔（1332—1395）是蒂雷纳子爵，纪尧姆二世·罗歇与玛丽·德·尚邦之子，是克雷芒六世的侄子、额我略十一世的兄长，两人都是阿维尼翁教宗。1350年2月7日，他与埃莉诺·德·科曼日成婚，克雷芒六世将利穆赞最富庶的子爵领地之一蒂雷纳作为新婚礼物赐给夫妇二人。1351年，那不勒斯女王乔万娜一世任命他为王国宫廷大总管。《布勒丁尼条约》将蒂雷纳划归英格兰后，他于1361年向英王行臣服礼，却始终效忠瓦卢瓦王室。1365年他参加远征亚历山大港的十字军，1375年代表额我略十一世出席布鲁日和谈，1376年起出任沃奈桑伯爵领地行政长官。1383年，他主持阿莱斯的城镇代表会议，会上缔结的和约平息了图钦人的起事。1395年3月28日，他在巴黎去世，葬于巴黎圣母院。

en: William the Simple (c. 1085–c. 1150) was the eldest son of Count Stephen Henry of Blois and Adela of Normandy, daughter of William the Conqueror. Designated Count of Blois and Chartres in 1102 before his father left on crusade, he intervened in his mother's dispute with the cathedral chapter, bursting into the church and demanding an oath against its canons. Around 1107 his mother set him aside in favour of his brother Theobald. In 1104 he married Agnes, heiress of Sully-sur-Loire, and retired to her estates as lord of Sully, supporting Theobald's family ambitions. Though the Conqueror's eldest legitimate grandson, he was never advanced for the English crown; King Stephen was his brother and Eudes Archambaud his son.
zh: 纪尧姆（天真者，约1085—约1150）是布卢瓦伯爵艾蒂安-亨利与“征服者”威廉之女诺曼底的阿德拉的长子。1102年父亲出征十字军前，他被指定为布卢瓦与沙特尔伯爵；母亲与主教座堂教士发生争端时，他闯入教堂，要求众人宣誓对付教士。约1107年，母亲阿德拉废黜他，改立其弟蒂博。1104年，他娶卢瓦尔河畔叙利的女继承人阿涅丝，退居妻家领地，成为叙利领主，并支持蒂博的家族抱负。他是征服者威廉最年长的合法外孙，却从未被推为英格兰王位候选人。他的弟弟包括英格兰国王斯蒂芬，儿子为叙利的厄德·阿尔尚博。

en: Guillaume de Châteauvillain (c. 1310 – 17 April 1352) was the younger son of Jean II de Châteauvillain and Marie de Pierrepont of the comital house of Roucy. When the family lands were divided he received the lordships of Pleurs, once held by his uncle Hugues, and Courcelles. In 1342 he and his elder brother Jean III, lord of Châteauvillain, marched armed onto the lands of Jean des Prez, bishop of Langres, after a quarrel, and the two had to beg the bishop's pardon that June. He married Blanche de Châtillon-en-Bazois, lady of Puits; their daughter Marie inherited Courcelles.
zh: 纪尧姆·德·沙托维兰（约1310年—1352年4月17日）是让二世·德·沙托维兰与鲁西伯爵家族的玛丽·德·皮埃尔蓬的幼子。分割家产时，他分得原为叔父于格所有的普勒尔领地和库尔塞勒领地。1342年，他与兄长、沙托维兰领主让三世因争端武装进入朗格勒主教让·德普雷的领地，兄弟二人不得不于当年6月向主教请求宽恕。他娶皮伊领地女继承人布朗什·德·沙蒂永-昂巴祖瓦为妻，女儿玛丽继承了库尔塞勒。

en: Guillaume I de Coucy (1288–1335) was a Picard baron, lord of Coucy, Oisy, Marle and Montmirail. The son of Enguerrand V de Coucy and Christine Lindsay, a niece of King John of Scotland, he married Isabelle de Châtillon, dame d'Encre, at Pontoise in May 1311 before Philip the Fair. He held Oisy through the marriage and succeeded his father at Coucy around 1323. Jeanne of Flanders, the widow of Enguerrand IV, disputed their possession of Coucy and Oisy. His claim was upheld in April 1329, when Philip VI settled the long family suit in his favour at Saint-Germain-en-Laye. He died in 1335 and was buried at Prémontré Abbey.
zh: 纪尧姆一世·德·库西（1288—1335）是皮卡第贵族，领有库西、瓦西、马尔勒和蒙米拉伊。他是昂盖朗五世·德·库西与克里斯蒂娜·林赛之子，母亲为苏格兰国王约翰的侄女。1311年5月，他在蓬图瓦兹当着腓力四世的面迎娶昂克尔女领主伊莎贝尔·德·沙蒂永-圣波勒。他因婚姻得到瓦西，约1323年父亲死后继承库西。昂盖朗四世的遗孀佛兰德的让娜与他们争夺库西和瓦西。1329年4月，腓力六世在圣日耳曼昂莱裁定持续多年的家族诉讼，确认了他的继承权。他于1335年去世，葬于普雷蒙特雷修道院。

en: Guillaume II de Coucy (died 6 February 1342) was the second son of Guillaume I de Coucy and Isabelle de Châtillon. He held Wyresdale and other lands in Lancashire, England, married Joan de Strother, and died without issue.
zh: 纪尧姆二世·德·库西（1342年2月6日卒）是纪尧姆一世·德·库西与伊莎贝尔·德·沙蒂永的次子，在英格兰兰开夏郡拥有怀尔斯代尔等领地，娶琼·德·斯特罗瑟为妻，死时无子嗣。

en: Guy II of Thouars (1246/1249–1308), son of Aimery IX and Marguerite of Lusignan, joined his uncle Savary IV and other Poitevin barons in a 1269 agreement with Alphonse of Poitiers on the redemption of fiefs. Around 1274 he succeeded Savary as viscount of Thouars under Poitou's viage custom, by which fiefs passed first through the late lord's brothers; the custom was abolished soon afterward. He then faced claims from kinswomen over pensions and lands. The Parlement of Paris ordered him to pay his aunt Eleanor of Soissons an annuity in return for her rights in Talmondais and the island of Ré. In 1283 his mother made him her universal heir, and in 1304 Philip IV summoned him for the Flanders war. He died on 21 September 1308, leaving the viscounty to his son Jean I.
zh: 居伊二世·德·图阿尔（1246/1249—1308）是艾默里克九世与吕西尼昂的玛格丽特之子。1269年，他与叔父萨瓦里四世及其他普瓦图男爵同普瓦捷的阿方斯达成封邑赎回协议。约1274年，他依普瓦图的“回归”惯例继萨瓦里为图阿尔子爵：按此惯例，封邑先传给已故领主的诸弟；该惯例不久后被废除。此后他面对女性亲族关于年金与土地的索求。巴黎高等法院判令他向婶母苏瓦松的埃莱奥诺尔支付年金，以换取她在塔尔蒙地区和雷岛的权利。1283年母亲立他为概括继承人，1304年腓力四世征召他参加佛兰德战争。他于1308年9月21日去世，子爵之位传给儿子让一世。

en: Guy de Thouars was a younger son of Jean I, Viscount of Thouars, and Blanche of Brabant, and brother of Viscount Louis I. He married Jeanne de Maulévrier and died in 1354.
zh: 居伊·德图阿尔是图阿尔子爵让一世与布拉班特的布朗什之子、子爵路易一世的弟弟。他娶让娜·德莫莱夫里耶为妻，于1354年去世。

en: Guy VI was Viscount of Limoges from 1230 until his death in August 1263. The son of Viscount Guy V and his second wife Ermengarde, he succeeded his father on 29 March 1230 as a child, and his mother governed as regent until he took power in the late 1230s. His first wife, a daughter of Thibaut de Blaison, died childless, and around 1258 he married Margaret of Burgundy, daughter of Duke Hugh IV. In 1263, after besieging Bourdeilles Castle in vain, he died at Brantôme Abbey and was buried at Saint-Martial in Limoges. His three-year-old daughter Marie succeeded him.
zh: 居伊六世于1230年至1263年8月任利摩日子爵。他是子爵居伊五世与第二任妻子埃尔芒加德之子，1230年3月29日父亲去世时年幼继位，由母亲摄政，直到13世纪30年代末才亲政。他的第一任妻子是蒂博·德·布莱松之女，死后无嗣；约1258年，他续娶勃艮第公爵于格四世之女勃艮第的玛格丽特。1263年，他围攻布尔德耶城堡不克，随后在布朗托姆修道院去世，葬于利摩日的圣马夏尔修道院。年仅3岁的女儿利摩日的玛丽继位。

en: Guy VI de Mauvoisin (born c. 1270) was seigneur de Rosny in the Île-de-France, succeeding his father Guy V, murdered at Mantes in 1311. He married Laure de Ponthieu, daughter of John I, Count of Aumale; their son was Guy VII, baron de Rosny.
zh: 居伊六世·德·莫瓦桑（约1270年生）是法兰西岛塞纳河畔罗尼的领主，承袭1311年在芒特遇刺的父亲居伊五世之位。他娶奥玛勒伯爵约翰一世之女洛尔·德·蓬蒂约为妻，儿子居伊七世后来成为罗尼男爵。

en: Guy VII de Mauvoisin (born c. 1307, died after 1360) was baron of Rosny-sur-Seine, the chief lordship of his house, and the eldest son of Guy VI de Mauvoisin and Laure de Ponthieu. Around 1328 he married Roberte de Beaumetz, châtelaine of Bapaume and widow of Louis de Marigny; the Artois lordships of Beaumetz, Croisilles and Boubers passed through her to their daughters. The marriage produced three daughters, Laure, Béatrix and Marguerite, but no son, and after Guy's death his brother Amaury sold Rosny to his daughter Béatrix in 1365.
zh: 居伊七世·德·莫瓦桑（约1307年生，1360年后卒）是家族主要领地塞纳河畔罗尼的男爵，居伊六世·德·莫瓦桑与洛尔·德·蓬蒂厄的长子。约1328年，他娶巴波姆城守夫人、路易·德·马里尼的遗孀罗贝尔特·德·博梅为妻；阿图瓦的博梅、克鲁瓦西耶、布贝尔等领地经她传给两人的女儿。两人只有洛尔、贝亚特丽斯、玛格丽特三个女儿而无男嗣，居伊死后其弟阿莫里于1365年将罗尼卖给女儿贝亚特丽斯。

en: Henry I (4 May 1008 – 4 August 1060) was king of the Franks from 1031. Born in Reims to King Robert II and Constance of Arles, he was crowned co-king in 1027. He settled his brother Robert's revolt by granting him the Duchy of Burgundy in 1032. In 1047 he helped the young William of Normandy win at Val-ès-Dunes, but later invaded Normandy twice, losing at Mortemer in 1054 and Varaville in 1057. In 1051 he married Anne of Kiev, mother of his heir. He acquired part of the County of Sens in 1055, but the royal demesne reached its smallest extent during his reign. He died at Vitry-en-Brie while besieging Thimert, and was buried at Saint-Denis.
zh: 亨利一世（1008年5月4日—1060年8月4日）自1031年起为法兰克人之王。他生于兰斯，为罗贝尔二世与阿尔勒的康斯坦丝之子，1027年被加冕为共治国王。1032年他以封赐勃艮第公国平息了弟弟罗贝尔的叛乱。1047年他协助年轻的诺曼底公爵纪尧姆在瓦勒迪恩获胜，后来却两度入侵诺曼底，先后于1054年在莫特梅、1057年在瓦拉维尔战败。1051年他娶基辅的安娜为妻，王后为他生下继承人。1055年他取得桑斯伯国的部分领地，但王室领地在他统治期间缩至最小。他在围攻蒂梅尔时死于维特里昂布里，葬于圣但尼。

en: Henri I de Sully, son of Archambaud IV, was lord of Sully after 1234, also holding La Chapelle and Les Aix d'Angillon. He married Marie de Dampierre, and their son Henri II died on Charles of Anjou's Sicilian campaign in 1269.
zh: 亨利一世·德·叙利是阿尔尚博四世之子，1234年后成为叙利领主，还领有拉沙佩勒和莱赛克斯-当日永。他娶玛丽·德·当皮耶尔为妻，生子亨利二世；后者于1269年随安茹的查理进行西西里之征时死去。

en: Henri II de Sully (1224–1269) was lord of Sully-sur-Loire after his father Henri I. By his wife Péronelle de Joigny he fathered Henri III, butler of France under Philip III, and a daughter Jeanne, wife of Adam IV, Viscount of Melun.
zh: 亨利二世·德·叙利（1224—1269）继父亨利一世为卢瓦尔河畔叙利领主。他与妻子佩罗内勒·德·茹瓦尼生有一子亨利三世（腓力三世朝的法兰西司酒官）和一女让娜，让娜嫁予默伦子爵亚当四世。

en: Henri III de Sully (died 1285) became lord of Sully-sur-Loire in 1269 and served as butler of France under Philip III the Bold. In 1282 he married Marguerite de Bommiers, lady of Brion and Châteaumeillant. Their children included Henri IV, later grand treasurer, and Péronelle, wife of Count John II of Dreux. Henri died in 1285 during Philip III's campaign in Aragon, and his son Henri succeeded him as lord of Sully.
zh: 亨利三世·德·叙利（1285年卒）于1269年成为卢瓦尔河畔叙利领主，在腓力三世（大胆者）朝任法兰西司酒官。1282年，他娶布里永与沙托梅扬女领主玛格丽特·德·博米耶，子女包括后来担任法兰西大财政官的亨利四世，以及嫁予德勒伯爵约翰二世的佩罗内勒。亨利于1285年随腓力三世远征阿拉贡时去世，其子亨利继任叙利领主。

en: Henri IV de Sully (1282–1336), lord of Sully-sur-Loire, was the son of Henri III de Sully and Marguerite de Bommiers. A councillor of Philip IV, he backed Philip of Poitiers's rise to the regency and the throne in 1316, becoming grand butler of France in 1317. Under Philip V he served as grand treasurer, reorganizing the royal treasury and presiding over the Chamber of Accounts founded in 1320; he submitted monthly treasury statements to the king. In 1318 he was sent as ambassador to Pope John XXII. Charles IV replaced him as treasurer in 1322. He became governor of Navarre in 1329, took part in plans for a crusade against Granada that came to nothing, led Navarre's defense against Aragon in 1335, and died in office in 1336.
zh: 亨利四世·德·叙利（1282—1336）是卢瓦尔河畔叙利的领主，亨利三世·德·叙利与玛格丽特·德·博米耶之子。他本是腓力四世的顾问，1316年支持普瓦捷伯爵腓力取得摄政权并登上王位，1317年出任法兰西大司酒官。腓力五世在位时他担任大财政官，整顿王室财政，并主持1320年设立的审计院；他每月向国王提交财政报告。1318年他出使教皇约翰二十二世。1322年查理四世撤换了他的财政官职务。1329年他出任纳瓦拉总督，参与筹划对格拉纳达的十字军，但计划未能实现；1335年他主持纳瓦拉对阿拉贡的防御，次年卒于任上。

en: Henriette de Sully was a daughter of Jean II de Sully and Margaret of Bourbon. About 1350 she married Jean de Melun, lord of La Salle and Marcheville. She held Cernoy and Autry as dower, and her daughter Alix married Geoffroi de Husson in 1374.
zh: 亨丽埃塔·德叙利是让二世·德叙利与波旁的玛格丽特之女，约1350年嫁给拉萨尔与马什维尔领主让·德默伦。她以寡妇产领有塞尔努瓦和欧特里，女儿阿莉克丝于1374年嫁给若弗鲁瓦·德于松。

en: Hugh of Blois (died 985/86) was a French prelate and archbishop of Bourges. The second son of Count Theobald I the Trickster of Blois and Liutgarde of Vermandois, he was the elder brother of Count Odo I. His elder brother Theobald died around 960–962 during the family's war with Normandy. Destined for the church while the comital inheritance passed to Odo, Hugh held charges attached to the abbey of Coulombs in the 950s and in 969 succeeded his uncle Richard as archbishop of Bourges. He may also have been castellan of Nogent. A rare recorded act of his episcopate, dated 983, was his seizure of the chapel of Saint-Sulpice at Jalvardan. He died in 985 or 986.
zh: 于格·德·布卢瓦（985/986年卒）是10世纪法国高级教士，曾任布尔日大主教。他是布卢瓦伯爵“骗子”蒂博一世与韦芒杜瓦的吕特加德的次子、伯爵厄德一世的兄长。约960—962年，家族与诺曼底交战期间，他的长兄蒂博去世。他自幼被安排走教会道路，伯爵继承权归于厄德；950年代他已掌管与库隆修道院相关的职务，969年继叔父理查之后出任布尔日大主教。他也可能曾任诺让城堡主。他任内留存极少的983年文书，记载了他夺取雅勒瓦尔当的圣叙尔皮斯小堂一事，本人于985或986年去世。

en: Hugh Capet (c. 941–996), duke of the Franks and son of Hugh the Great and Hedwige of Saxony, was elected king after the last Carolingian, Louis V, died in 987. Under Louis's father Lothair, Hugh had been a powerful figure: in 979 he supported the anointing of Louis as co-king, but later tensions grew between him and Lothair over relations with the emperor. Crowned at Noyon with the backing of Archbishop Adalberon of Reims, Hugh had his son Robert the Pious anointed co-king at Orléans the same Christmas, securing the succession for his line. He fought Charles of Lorraine for the city of Laon and, when Charles captured Reims, retook it with papal support. At his death in 996 he was buried at Saint-Denis as the founder of the Capetian dynasty.
zh: 于格·卡佩（约941—996）出身罗贝尔家族，是大于格与萨克森的海德维希之子，曾任法兰克人的公爵。路易五世的父亲洛泰尔在位时，于格已是一位有权势的人物：979年他支持路易受膏成为共治国王，后来却与洛泰尔在对皇帝的关系上日益紧张。987年末代加洛林国王路易五世死后，他在兰斯大主教阿达尔贝隆支持下被贵族推举为王，在努瓦永加冕；同年圣诞节又安排儿子“虔诚者”罗贝尔在奥尔良涂油，成为共治国王，确保了王位的世袭。他与下洛林公爵查理争夺拉昂，在查理攻占兰斯后又借教皇之力夺回该城。他于996年去世，葬于圣但尼圣殿，是卡佩王朝的开创者。

en: Hugh the Great (c. 898–956), duke of the Franks and count of Paris, was the son of King Robert I and father of Hugh Capet, founder of the Capetian dynasty. When his father fell at Soissons in 923 he let the crown pass to his brother-in-law Rudolph rather than claim it himself. The strongest magnate in West Francia, he recalled Louis IV from England in 936 and married Hedwig of Saxony, sister of Otto the Great, in 937. He later warred against Louis, holding him captive in 945–946 until he surrendered Laon. Excommunicated by a council in 948, Hugh made peace with Louis, the church and Otto in 953. He supported the succession of Louis's son Lothair and died on 16 June 956.
zh: 伟大的于格（约898—956）为法兰克人公爵、巴黎伯爵，是罗贝尔一世之子，也是卡佩王朝首任国王于格·卡佩的父亲。923年父亲在苏瓦松战死后，他没有自行称王，而让王位传给姐夫拉乌尔。作为西法兰克最有权势的大贵族，他于936年从英格兰迎回路易四世，又在937年迎娶奥托大帝之妹萨克森的海德薇希。后来他与路易四世交战，于945至946年间将其囚禁，直到对方交出拉昂才放人。948年教会会议将他绝罚，953年他与路易、教会及奥托和解。他支持路易之子洛泰尔继位，956年6月16日去世。

en: Ide de Mauvoisin (c. 1313–1375), daughter of Guy VI, lord of Rosny, married John III, Count of Dreux, around 1329 and was widowed childless in 1331. On 2 September 1332 she married Mathieu III de Trie, Marshal of France, who died in 1344.
zh: 伊德·德·莫瓦桑（约1313—1375）是罗尼领主居伊六世之女。约1329年，她嫁给德勒伯爵让三世，1331年丧夫且无子嗣。1332年9月2日，她改嫁法兰西元帅马蒂厄三世·德·特里，后者于1344年去世。

en: Isabeau de Châtillon (c. 1295 – 19 May 1360) was the daughter of Guy IV, Count of Saint-Pol, and Marie of Brittany, and sister of Mahaut, wife of Charles of Valois. As lady of Encre she married, in May 1311 at Pontoise before Philip the Fair, the Picard baron Guillaume I de Coucy, lord of Coucy, Oisy and Marle. Her children included Enguerrand VI, killed at Crécy in 1346, and Raoul, lord of Montmirail. Widowed in 1335, she kept Oisy as her dower and was styled its lady in 1351.
zh: 伊莎博·德·沙蒂永（约1295年—1360年5月19日）是圣波勒伯爵居伊四世与布列塔尼的玛丽之女，瓦卢瓦伯爵查理之妻玛特的妹妹。她本人是昂克尔女领主，1311年5月在蓬图瓦兹当着“美男子”腓力四世的面，嫁给皮卡第贵族、库西、瓦西和马勒领主纪尧姆一世·德·库西。子女包括1346年战死于克雷西的昂盖朗六世和蒙米拉伊领主拉乌尔。1335年守寡后，她以瓦西为寡妇产，1351年仍称瓦西女领主。

en: Isabeau de Thouars (died 1397) was a daughter of Louis I, Viscount of Thouars, and Joan II, Countess of Dreux. Her first husband was Guy II de Clermont-Nesle, lord of Mello and a marshal of France, who was killed at Mauron in 1352. In 1356 she married Ingelger I d'Amboise, by whom she had two sons, Pierre II and Ingelger II, and two daughters; her third husband was Guillaume d'Harcourt, lord of La Ferté-Imbault. When her sister Péronnelle died in 1397, Isabeau's Amboise sons carried on the Thouars succession, Pierre II ruling the viscounty until 1426.
zh: 伊莎博·德·图阿尔（?—1397）是图阿尔子爵路易一世与德勒女伯爵让娜二世之女。第一任丈夫是梅洛领主、法兰西元帅居伊二世·德·克莱蒙-内勒，1352年战死于莫龙；1356年她改嫁安热尔热一世·德·安布瓦斯，生有皮埃尔二世、安热尔热二世两个儿子和两个女儿；第三任丈夫是拉费尔泰-安博领主纪尧姆·德·阿库尔。1397年其姐佩罗内勒去世后，图阿尔子爵领由她的安布瓦斯系子孙继承，其子皮埃尔二世一直统治到1426年。

en: Isabelle d'Antoing, daughter of Hugh IV, lord of Antoing, married the Castilian prince Alfonso de la Cerda, who died in 1327. She was the mother of Charles de la Cerda, constable of France. She later married Jean I de Melun and died in 1354.
zh: 伊莎贝尔·德·昂图万是昂图万领主于格四世之女，嫁给卡斯蒂利亚王子阿方索·德·拉塞尔达，1327年丧夫，是法兰西统帅查理·德·拉塞尔达之母；后改嫁让一世·德·默伦，1354年去世。

en: Jacqueline de Trie (1325–c. 1388), daughter of Jean III de Trie, Count of Dammartin, and Jeanne de Sancerre, married about 1350 Jean de Châtillon, Count of Porcien. Her daughter Marguerite de Châtillon, wife of Guillaume du Fayel, inherited the Trie claim to Dammartin.
zh: 杰奎琳·德·特里（1325—约1388）是达马尔坦伯爵让三世·德·特里与让娜·德·桑塞尔之女，约1350年嫁给波尔西安伯爵让·德·沙蒂永。女儿玛格丽特·德·沙蒂永嫁给纪尧姆·迪·法耶尔，继承了特里家族对达马尔坦伯国的继承权。

en: James of Artois (1325–after 1347) was the third son of Robert III of Artois and Joan of Valois, sister of King Philip VI. After his father was convicted of forgery and driven into English exile, the king had his nephews taken into custody. James was confined at Nemours in 1342 and then moved with his mother and brother Robert to Château Gaillard. He died in prison after 1347, probably a victim of the Black Death, without posterity.
zh: 阿图瓦的雅克（1325—1347年后）是罗贝尔三世·德·阿图瓦与法王腓力六世之妹瓦卢瓦的让娜的第三子。父亲被判伪造文书罪、流亡英格兰后，法王下令拘押诸甥。雅克于1342年被囚于讷穆尔，随后与母亲和弟弟罗贝尔一同转押加亚尔堡。1347年之后他瘐死狱中，可能死于黑死病，无后嗣。

en: John of Artois (1321–1387), called Sans-Terre (the Landless), was the son of the disgraced Robert III of Artois and Joan of Valois, sister of Philip VI. His father's treason cost the family its lands, and in 1334 Philip shut John, his mother and his brothers in Château-Gaillard. John II freed him in 1350 and in February 1351 gave him the County of Eu, which the crown had just recovered by executing the constable Raoul de Brienne; the Artois family thereby joined the royal party against the Navarrese. As royal lieutenant in Normandy he helped seize the King of Navarre's lands there, including Évreux and Breteuil. He was at Bordeaux when the king was captured at Poitiers in 1356, and in 1357 carried truce letters to Paris, then left the city to join the dauphin Charles at Gisors. He served Charles V and led the rearguard at Roosebeke in 1382.
zh: 阿图瓦的让（1321—1387），绰号“无地者”，是失势的罗贝尔三世·德·阿图瓦与腓力六世之妹瓦卢瓦的让娜之子。因父亲的背叛，家族丧失了领地，1334年腓力把让、他的母亲和兄弟关进加亚尔堡。1350年让二世释放了他，1351年2月又把厄镇伯国封给他；王室刚刚处决大元帅拉乌尔·德·布里耶纳，收回了这块领地。阿图瓦家族由此站到王室一边，对抗纳瓦拉派。他任国王在诺曼底的副将，协助夺取纳瓦拉国王在当地的领地，包括埃夫勒和布勒特伊。1356年法王在普瓦捷被俘时，他身在波尔多；1357年他把停战文书送往巴黎，随后离开巴黎，到吉索尔投奔王太子查理。他后来效力于查理五世，1382年在罗斯贝克战役中指挥后军。

en: John of Beaumont (1288–1356), born John of Hainaut at Valenciennes, was the fourth son of Count John II of Hainaut and brother of Count William III of Holland. He became count of Soissons by marriage and often governed Holland for his brother. In 1326, when Queen Isabella sought refuge at William's court, John led an expedition to England that helped her and Mortimer depose Edward II, and in December 1327 he brought his niece Philippa over to marry the new king. In 1340 he was regent of Holland and Zeeland for his nephew William IV, who was killed at Warns in 1345 while John escaped. His claim to the succession lost to his niece Margaret, and he left for France. He sided with Philip VI in 1346 and at Crécy pulled the king out of the rout; his son-in-law Louis II of Blois died there. He died at Valenciennes in March 1356.
zh: 让·德·博蒙（1288—1356）原名让·德·埃诺，生于瓦朗谢讷，是埃诺伯爵约翰二世的第四子、荷兰伯爵威廉三世的弟弟。他因婚姻成为苏瓦松伯爵，常代兄长治理荷兰。1326年，王后伊莎贝拉到威廉宫中避难，他率军远征英格兰，协助她与莫蒂默废黜爱德华二世；1327年12月，他又把外甥女菲莉帕接去，嫁给新国王。1340年，他为侄儿威廉四世摄政荷兰与泽兰；1345年威廉在瓦恩斯战死，他侥幸逃生。他争夺继承权输给侄女玛格丽特，随后前往法国。1346年，他站到腓力六世一边，在克雷西战役中把国王从溃败的战场上带出；他的女婿布卢瓦的路易二世却在此阵亡。他于1356年3月在瓦朗谢讷去世。

en: Jean de Châtillon (1283–1363), second son of Gaucher V de Châtillon, Count of Porcien and Constable of France, and of Isabeau de Dreux, a princess of the royal blood. He was lord of Châtillon-sur-Marne and Gandelu, and held La Ferté-en-Ponthieu through his wife Éléonore de Roye. As grand queux of France he served Philip the Fair, who named him an executor of his will in 1314, and he represented the office at Philip VI's coronation in 1328. When war with England came, he went to Flanders with John, Duke of Normandy, in 1340 and defended Tournai against the English siege in 1341. Appointed grand maître de France in 1350, he was present at Poitiers in 1356. He died in 1363, very old, and was buried at the Mathurin convent of Cerfroy near Gandelu.
zh: 让·德·沙蒂永（1283—1363）是波尔西安伯爵、法兰西王室统帅戈谢五世·德·沙蒂永与王室血脉的公主伊莎博·德·德勒之子，排行第二。他领有沙蒂永-马恩和冈德吕，并凭借妻子埃莱奥诺尔·德·鲁瓦领有拉费尔泰昂蓬蒂厄。他以法兰西御膳总管之职侍奉腓力四世，1314年被指定为国王遗嘱执行人，1328年又代表该职出席腓力六世的加冕礼。英法开战后，他于1340年随诺曼底公爵让出征佛兰德，1341年在图尔奈抵御英军围攻。1350年他受任法兰西大总管，1356年亲历普瓦捷之战。他于1363年高龄去世，葬于冈德吕附近马图兰会的塞尔弗鲁瓦修道院。

en: Jean de Coucy (died 1354) was a son of Guillaume I de Coucy and Isabelle de Châtillon. He was castellan of Havrincourt and died without issue.
zh: 让·德·库西（1354年卒）是纪尧姆一世·德·库西与伊莎贝尔·德·沙蒂永之子，任阿夫兰古特的城堡总管，死时无子嗣。

en: John I, called the Posthumous (15–19 November 1316), was king of France and Navarre for the four days of his life. The posthumous son of Louis X and Clemence of Anjou, he was born king at the Louvre in Paris and died in his cradle on 19 November, while his uncle Philip of Poitiers held the regency. Buried at Saint-Denis, he was the youngest French king and the only one to reign from birth. His death broke three centuries of father-to-son Capetian succession, and Philip took the crown as Philip V. The dispute over Philip's legitimacy led to the reaffirmation of the exclusion of women from the French succession. Only later did chroniclers and historians acknowledge John's brief reign by numbering John II.
zh: “遗腹子”约翰一世（1316年11月15—19日）在世上仅活了四天，这四天里他都是法兰西与纳瓦拉国王。他是路易十世与安茹的克莱门斯的遗腹子，生于巴黎卢浮宫，出生即为王，11月19日夭折于襁褓之中，由叔父普瓦捷的腓力摄政。他葬于圣但尼圣殿，是法兰西年龄最小、也是唯一自出生起便在位的国王。他的死中断了卡佩王朝三个世纪以来的父死子继，腓力随后即位为腓力五世。对腓力继位合法性的争议促使法国重申女性不得继承王位。直到后世编年史家和史学家为约翰二世编号时，约翰的短暂统治才得到承认。

en: John I of Thouars (born after 1284, died 25 May 1332) was the twenty-seventh viscount of Thouars, the son of Guy II and Margaret of Brienne-Eu. In 1307 he married Blanche of Brabant, lady of Rochecorbon, a younger daughter of Godfrey of Brabant, lord of Aerschot. He succeeded his father, who died on 20 September 1308, and ruled the viscounty until his own death. Blanche died in 1330, leaving three sons: Louis I, who succeeded as viscount, John, lord of La Cheze-le-Vicomte, and Guy, who died in 1354.
zh: 让一世·德·图阿尔（1284年之后出生，1332年5月25日卒）是第二十七位图阿尔子爵，居伊二世与布列讷-厄镇的玛格丽特之子。1307年，他娶阿尔斯霍特领主戈德弗鲁瓦·德·布拉班特的幼女、罗什科尔邦女领主布拉班特的布朗什。其父于1308年9月20日去世，他遂继任子爵，统治子爵领直至去世。布朗什于1330年亡故，生有三子：继任子爵的路易一世、拉谢兹勒维孔特领主让，以及1354年去世的居伊。

en: Jean I de Trie was châtelain of Trie in the Vexin, son of Enguerrand Aiguillon de Trie. By his wife Alix of Dammartin he fathered Mathieu de Trie, later count of Dammartin, and Renaud de Trie, lord of Fontenay. He died before 1237.
zh: 让一世·德·特里是韦克桑的特里城堡领主，昂盖朗·艾吉永·德·特里之子。他娶达马尔坦的阿莉克斯，生下达马尔坦伯爵马蒂厄和丰特奈领主雷诺，1237年前去世。

en: Jean II de Sully, son of Henri IV de Sully, Grand Butler of France, married Margaret, daughter of Louis I, Duke of Bourbon, in 1320. He succeeded his father as lord of Sully-sur-Loire in 1336 and died about 1343, leaving his son Louis to succeed.
zh: 让二世·德叙利是法兰西大司酒官亨利四世·德叙利之子。1320年，他与波旁公爵路易一世之女玛格丽特成婚，1336年继父成为卢瓦尔河畔叙利领主，约1343年去世，由其子路易继位。

en: John II, called the Good (26 April 1319 – 8 April 1364), was the eldest son of Philip VI of France and Joan of Burgundy, made duke of Normandy and count of Anjou in 1332. He married Bonne of Luxembourg the same year and succeeded his father as king in 1350, amid the Black Death and the Hundred Years' War. Captured at Poitiers in 1356, he was released in an exchange of hostages under the Treaty of Brétigny in 1360 to raise a huge ransom. When his hostage son Louis escaped, John returned to English captivity in 1364 and died in London.
zh: 约翰二世，绰号“好人”（1319年4月26日—1364年4月8日），是法兰西国王腓力六世与勃艮第的让娜的长子，1332年受封诺曼底公爵兼安茹伯爵，同年与卢森堡的博内成婚。1350年，他在黑死病与百年战争的动荡中继位为法王。1356年，他在普瓦捷之战中被俘，1360年依《布雷蒂尼条约》以人质交换获释，回国筹措巨额赎金。后来充当人质的儿子路易逃走，他为信守约定于1364年主动返回英格兰为囚，不久在伦敦去世。

en: John III of Châteauvillain (c. 1310–1355) was lord of Châteauvillain, Arc-en-Barrois and Nully in Champagne, the eldest son of John II of Châteauvillain and Marie of Roucy, and spent much of his career in the service of the duke of Burgundy. Left fatherless in 1312, he received guardians named by Philip the Fair in 1313, among them his maternal uncle John V of Pierrepont, Count of Roucy. In 1326 he granted a charter of liberties to the people of Arc, which Duke Odo IV confirmed two years later, and in 1337 he sold his castle of Brémur to the duke. In 1342 he and his brother Guillaume entered the bishop of Langres's lands in arms, then admitted their fault and won his pardon. In June he fought beside the duke at Arras. A member of the duke's council, he was one of his eight testamentary executors in 1346. He died in 1355 and was succeeded by his son John IV.
zh: 让·德·沙托维兰（约1310—1355）是香槟地区沙托维兰、阿尔克昂巴鲁瓦和尼伊的领主，沙托维兰的让二世与鲁西的玛丽的长子，一生大部分时间效力于勃艮第公爵。父亲1312年去世时他尚年幼，1313年美男子腓力为他指定监护人，其中有舅父、鲁西伯爵让五世·德·皮埃尔蓬。1326年，他向阿尔克居民颁授自由特许状，两年后获公爵厄德四世确认；1337年，他把布雷米尔城堡卖给公爵。1342年，他与弟弟纪尧姆武装进入朗格尔主教的领地，随后承认过错，获得主教宽恕。同年6月，他随公爵在阿拉斯作战。他是公爵议事会成员，1346年又成为公爵的八位遗嘱执行人之一。他于1355年去世，由其子让四世继位。

en: Jean III de Trie succeeded his brother as Count of Dammartin in 1327 and died around 1337. Son of Renaud II de Trie and Philippe de Beaumont-en-Gâtinais, he married about 1331 Jeanne, daughter of John II of Sancerre, who bore his successor Charles and Jacqueline.
zh: 让三世·德·特里1327年继其兄之后成为达马尔坦伯爵，约1337年去世。他是雷诺二世·德·特里与菲利帕·德·博蒙-加蒂奈之子，约1331年娶桑塞尔伯爵让二世之女让娜，生下继承人查理和女儿杰奎琳。

en: Jean IV de Châteauvillain (born after 1326 – 19 September 1356), eldest son of Jean III de Châteauvillain and Marguerite de Noyers, succeeded his father as lord of Châteauvillain, Arc-en-Barrois and Nully in 1355; on 13 November he divided his father's movable goods with his sisters Jeanne and Marie. Called to the Hundred Years' War, he fought in the royal army at Poitiers and was killed in the battle on 19 September 1356, then buried at the Minims' convent in the town. He was the last male of his line, so his lordships were split between his two sisters.
zh: 让四世·德·沙托维兰（1326年后生—1356年9月19日）是让三世·德·沙托维兰与玛格丽特·德努瓦耶的长子，1355年父亲去世后继承沙托维兰、阿尔克昂巴鲁瓦和尼伊领主之位，同年11月13日与姐妹让娜、玛丽分割父亲的动产。百年战争中他随王军作战，1356年9月19日在普瓦捷战役中阵亡，葬于该城的最小兄弟会修道院。他是家族最后一位男性继承人，死后领地由两个姐妹瓜分。

en: Jean-Jacques Rousseau (1712–1778) was a Genevan philosophe whose works shaped modern political thought. A watchmaker's son born in the Calvinist republic of Geneva, he won the Dijon Academy's prize in 1750 with his Discourse on the Arts and Sciences. The Discourse on Inequality followed in 1755 and the novel Julie in 1761. In the former he argued that private property was the source of social inequality. In 1762 he published The Social Contract, founding legitimate government on the people's general will, and Émile, a treatise on education and the individual's place in society; condemned in Paris and Geneva, he fled into exile. He died at Ermenonville in 1778.
zh: 让-雅克·卢梭（1712—1778）是日内瓦启蒙哲士，其思想深刻影响了现代政治学说。他出身于加尔文派统治的日内瓦共和国，父亲是钟表匠；1750年，他以《论科学与艺术》赢得第戎科学院征文奖，一举成名。此后又写下《论人类不平等的起源和基础》（1755）和小说《新爱洛漪丝》（1761）。在前一部著作中，他认为私有财产是社会不平等的根源。1762年，他出版《社会契约论》，把合法统治建立在人民的“公意”之上，同年又出版探讨教育及个人在社会中地位的《爱弥儿》；两部书在巴黎和日内瓦均遭谴责，他被迫流亡。1778年，他在埃尔默农维尔去世。

en: Jean de Louvres (Latin Iohannes de Luperiis) was a French master mason of the fourteenth century, probably from the Paris region. From 1342 to 1351 he was master of the works at the papal palace of Avignon, succeeding Pierre Poisson. Under Clement VI he built the Great Chapel, called the Chapelle Clémentine, the Great Audience hall, and several towers of the Palais Neuf. He also served the pope as a serjeant-at-arms from 1345 until his death. He settled in Avignon and died between November 1357 and early January 1358.
zh: 让·德·卢夫尔（拉丁语作约翰内斯·德·卢佩里）是14世纪法兰西石匠大师，可能出身巴黎地区。1342至1351年，他接替皮埃尔·普瓦松主持阿维尼翁教皇宫工程，在教皇克雷芒六世治下修建了克莱孟大教堂、大裁判厅以及新宫的多座塔楼。1345年起他还担任教皇的武装侍从，直至去世。他后来定居阿维尼翁，于1357年11月至1358年1月初之间去世。

en: Jean de Thouars, elder son of Louis I, Viscount of Thouars, and Joan II, Countess of Dreux, died in 1355, the same year as his mother. Dreux passed to his younger brother Simon, and the viscounty of Thouars later to his sister Péronnelle.
zh: 让·德·图阿尔是图阿尔子爵路易一世与德勒女伯爵让娜二世的长子，1355年与母亲同年去世。德勒伯国由其弟西蒙继承，图阿尔子爵领后归其妹佩罗内勒。

en: Jean de Thouars was a younger son of Jean I, Viscount of Thouars, and Blanche of Brabant, and brother of Viscount Louis I. He held the lordship of La Cheze-le-Vicomte in Poitou and married Marguerite de Parthenay, of the great Poitevin baronial family.
zh: 让·德图阿尔是图阿尔子爵让一世与布拉班特的布朗什之子、子爵路易一世的弟弟。他领有普瓦图的拉谢兹勒维孔特领地，娶普瓦图名门帕尔特奈家族的玛格丽特·德帕尔特奈为妻。

en: Joan of Burgundy, called Joan the Lame (c. 1293–1349), was the daughter of Duke Robert II of Burgundy and Agnes of France, youngest daughter of Saint Louis. Promised to Philip of Valois in 1303, she married him only in July 1313; when he was crowned Philip VI in 1328 she became the first queen of the House of Valois. The Hundred Years' War kept him on campaign, and she governed France as regent in 1340, 1345–1346 and 1347, exercising judicial authority. The role earned her a bad reputation, sharpened by her lameness, which some took for a curse. A learned bibliophile, she commissioned French translations of Vincent de Beauvais's Miroir historial and Jacques de Cessoles's moralized chess book. She died on 12 December 1349, probably of the plague, a few months before her son John II became king; her heart went to Cîteaux, the burial place of the dukes of Burgundy.
zh: 勃艮第的让娜，世称“跛子让娜”（约1293—1349），是勃艮第公爵罗贝尔二世与法兰西的艾格妮丝之女，母亲是圣路易最小的女儿。1303年，她被许配给瓦卢瓦的腓力，直到1313年7月才完婚；1328年腓力加冕为腓力六世，她成为瓦卢瓦王朝第一位王后。百年战争使国王不得不四处征战，她于1340年、1345—1346年和1347年以摄政身份治理法国，行使司法权。这一角色给她招来恶名，她的跛足又被一些人视为诅咒。她博学爱书，曾命人将樊尚·德·博韦的《历史之镜》和雅克·德·塞索勒的《道德化的国际象棋》译成法语。1349年12月12日她去世，死因多半是鼠疫，数月后儿子约翰二世即位；她的心脏送往西多，那里是勃艮第公爵们的安息地。

en: Jeanne de Châteauvillain (c. 1330 – c. 1389), elder daughter of Jean III de Châteauvillain and Marguerite de Noyers, inherited Châteauvillain after her brother Jean IV fell at Poitiers in 1356, while her sister Marie received Arc-en-Barrois and Nully. She married five times: her husbands were Jean I de Thil, Constable of Burgundy; Guillaume de Chalon; Hugues VI de Vienne; the routier captain Arnaud de Cervole, called the Archpriest; and the royal chamberlain Enguerrand d'Eudin. In 1373 she recovered her late sister's lands, and when she died Châteauvillain passed to her eldest son Jean V de Thil-Châteauvillain.
zh: 让娜·德·沙托维兰（约1330年—约1389年）是让三世·德·沙托维兰与玛格丽特·德努瓦耶的长女。1356年其兄让四世在普瓦捷战死后，她继承沙托维兰，妹妹玛丽则得到阿尔克昂巴鲁瓦和尼伊。她一生五嫁：丈夫依次为勃艮第统帅让一世·德·蒂尔、纪尧姆·德·沙隆、于格六世·德·维埃纳、绰号“司铎”的佣兵团长阿尔诺·德·塞尔沃勒，以及王室侍从官昂盖朗·德丹。1373年她又收回亡妹的领地；她死后沙托维兰传给长子让五世·德·蒂尔-沙托维兰。

en: Joanna of Châtillon (c. 1285–1354), daughter of the Constable Gaucher V de Châtillon, married Walter V of Brienne in 1305 and became Duchess of Athens in 1308. Her rule there lasted three years. Walter was killed fighting the Catalan Company at Halmyros on 15 March 1311; she may have tried to hold the Acropolis before surrendering it, and went back to France with her infant son Walter VI, while her retainers kept Argos and Nauplia. In 1318 she and her father asked Venice for money and ships to send knights to Negroponte or Nauplia, but were refused. By constant petitions to Naples, France and the papacy she kept her son's claim to Athens alive until he was old enough to press it himself. In 1321 Philip V of France mediated a suit in which that son sued her over his father's debts. She kept her ducal title until her death, and her tomb at Troyes was inscribed Duchesse d'Athènes.
zh: 让娜·德·沙蒂永（约1285—1354）是法兰西王室统帅戈谢五世·德·沙蒂永之女，1305年嫁给布里耶纳的戈蒂埃五世，1308年成为雅典女公爵，在雅典的统治只维持了三年。1311年3月15日，戈蒂埃五世在阿尔米罗斯战役中被加泰罗尼亚佣兵团击杀；让娜可能曾试图据守雅典卫城，最终献城，带着幼子戈蒂埃六世返回法兰西，她的家臣则仍据守阿尔戈斯与纳夫普利翁。1318年，她与父亲向威尼斯请求金钱和船只，以便向内格罗蓬特或纳夫普利翁派兵，却遭到拒绝。她不断向那不勒斯、法兰西和教廷请愿，一直维系着儿子对雅典的权利，直到他长大后能亲自争取。1321年，儿子因父亲留下的债务起诉母亲，法王腓力五世出面调停。她终身保留女公爵头衔，特鲁瓦的墓碑上刻着“雅典女公爵”。

en: Jeanne de Coucy was possibly a daughter of Guillaume I de Coucy and Isabelle de Châtillon, and possibly the wife of Gaucher X de Châtillon of the house of Châtillon-sur-Marne and the mother of Marie and Jeanne de Châtillon.
zh: 让娜·德·库西可能是纪尧姆一世·德·库西与伊莎贝尔·德·沙蒂永之女，也可能嫁给沙蒂永-马恩家族的戈谢十世·德·沙蒂永，生女玛丽与让娜·德·沙蒂永。

en: Joan of Évreux (1310–1371), daughter of Louis, Count of Évreux, and Margaret of Artois, became the third wife of her cousin Charles IV of France in 1324; Pope John XXII granted a dispensation because they were cousins. She bore three daughters, Jeanne, Marie and Blanche, but no son, and Salic law barred the daughters from the throne, so when Charles died in 1328 the direct Capetian line ended and the crown passed to the Valois. Her book of hours, illuminated by Jean Pucelle, and her silver-gilt Virgin and Child are masterpieces of French Gothic art. The book was commissioned between 1324 and 1328, probably as a gift from Charles, and includes an office for her great-grandfather St Louis; Joan left the statue to the abbey of Saint-Denis. She died on 4 March 1371 at her château of Brie-Comte-Robert and was buried at Saint-Denis.
zh: 埃夫勒的让娜（1310—1371）是埃夫勒伯爵路易与阿图瓦的玛格丽特之女，1324年嫁给堂兄法王查理四世，成为他的第三任王后；因二人是堂兄妹，教皇约翰二十二世特颁婚姻特许。她生下让娜、玛丽、布朗什三个女儿，却没有儿子，而萨利克法使女儿不能继承王位，因此1328年查理去世后，卡佩直系绝嗣，王位转入瓦卢瓦支系。她的日课经由让·皮塞勒手抄彩绘，另有一尊银鎏金圣母圣婴像，二者都是法国哥特艺术的杰作。日课经于1324至1328年间委托制作，可能是查理送给她的礼物，其中收有她曾祖父圣路易的祷告日课；让娜将圣像留给了圣德尼修道院。1371年3月4日她在布里-孔特-罗贝尔的城堡去世，葬于圣德尼圣殿。

en: Joan I (1273–1305) inherited Navarre and Champagne as an infant in 1274, married the future Philip IV in 1284 and became queen of France in 1285. Born at Bar-sur-Seine to Henry I of Navarre and Blanche of Artois, she never visited Navarre, which French governors ruled in her name. She governed Champagne directly: in 1297 she raised an army against an invasion by Henry III of Bar and took the count prisoner. Her three sons all became kings of France and her daughter Isabella married Edward II. She founded the College of Navarre in Paris in 1305, the year she died.
zh: 胡安娜一世（1273—1305）于1274年幼年继承纳瓦拉王位与香槟伯国，1284年嫁给未来的腓力四世，1285年成为法兰西王后。她生于塞纳河畔巴尔，父亲是纳瓦拉国王恩里克一世，母亲是阿图瓦的布朗什。她从未到过纳瓦拉，当地由法兰西总督以她的名义治理。她则直接统治香槟：1297年巴尔伯爵亨利三世入侵时，她募兵迎战，并将伯爵俘获囚禁。她的三个儿子后来都成为法兰西国王，女儿伊莎贝拉嫁给了爱德华二世。1305年她在巴黎创办纳瓦拉学院，并于同年去世。

en: Joan II of Burgundy (c. 1291–1330), eldest daughter of Count Otto IV of Burgundy and Mahaut of Artois, inherited the County of Burgundy in 1303 and married the future Philip V of France at Corbeil in 1307. In the Tour de Nesle scandal of 1314 she was accused of covering for her sister and sister-in-law and held at Dourdan until the Parlement acquitted her. Queen from 1316 and crowned at Reims in 1317, she brought weavers and cloth makers from Paris to Marnay and Gray in 1318. After Philip's death she returned to Burgundy and inherited Artois in 1329. She commissioned the Ovide moralisé and provided in her will for the Collège de Bourgogne in Paris. She died at Roye in 1330.
zh: 勃艮第的让娜二世（约1291—1330）是勃艮第伯爵奥托四世与阿图瓦的玛奥的长女，1303年继承勃艮第伯国，1307年在科尔贝伊嫁给后来的法兰西国王腓力五世。1314年内斯勒塔事件中，她被控包庇妹妹和妯娌，囚禁于杜尔当，直到高等法院判其无罪。1316年她成为王后，1317年在兰斯加冕，1318年从巴黎引入织工和布商到马尔奈与格雷。腓力去世后她回到勃艮第，1329年继承阿图瓦伯国。她命人编写《奥维德道德释义》，并在遗嘱中安排于巴黎建立勃艮第学院。1330年，她卒于鲁瓦。

en: Joan II of Dreux (1309–1355) was the daughter of John II, Count of Dreux, and Péronnelle de Sully. In 1330 she married Louis I, Viscount of Thouars. When her half-brother Peter, the last male heir of the counts of Dreux, died in 1345, Joan inherited the county and ruled it as countess suo jure until her death. Her son Simon de Thouars succeeded her as count of Dreux but died in 1365; the county then passed to her daughters Péronnelle, Isabeau and Marguerite, who held it jointly.
zh: 让娜二世·德·德勒（1309—1355）是德勒伯爵让二世与佩罗内勒·德·叙利之女。1330年，她嫁给图阿尔子爵路易一世。1345年，她的异母兄长、德勒家族最后一位男性继承人皮埃尔去世，让娜遂以自身权利继承并统治德勒伯国，直至去世。其子西蒙·德·图阿尔继任德勒伯爵，1365年亡故；伯国随后由她的三个女儿佩罗内勒、伊莎贝尔和玛格丽特共同继承。

en: Jeanne de Vendôme (c. 1275–1309), daughter of Jean V, comte de Vendôme of the House of Montoire, and Éléonore de Montfort-Castres, married Henri IV de Sully, later Grand Butler of France, and bore him nine children, including his heir Jean II de Sully.
zh: 旺多姆的让娜（约1275—约1309）是蒙图瓦尔家族旺多姆伯爵让五世与埃莱奥诺尔·德·蒙福尔-卡斯特尔之女，嫁给后来出任法兰西大司酒官的亨利四世·德·叙利，为他生下九个子女，继承人让二世即其中之一。

en: Jeanne de Sancerre (1306–c. 1354), daughter of Count John II of Sancerre, married about 1331 John III de Trie, Count of Dammartin, and bore Charles, count from 1338 to 1394, and Jacqueline. She later married John II de Châtillon, grand master of France.
zh: 让娜·德·桑塞尔（1306—约1354）是桑塞尔伯爵让二世之女，约1331年嫁给达马尔坦伯爵让三世·德·特里，生下1338至1394年袭爵的夏尔与雅克琳。守寡后她改嫁法兰西宫廷总管让二世·德·沙蒂永。

en: Joan of Valois (1304–1363), known as Madame d'Artois, was the daughter of Charles, Count of Valois, by Catherine I of Courtenay, titular Latin Empress of Constantinople, and half-sister of King Philip VI. About 1320 she married Robert III of Artois, Count of Beaumont-le-Roger, who claimed Artois against his aunt Mahaut. After Robert used forged documents and fled in 1331, Joan and her children were seized and confined at Château Gaillard. Her husband died in England in 1342, but she remained a prisoner for years; she died on 9 July 1363 and was buried at the Augustins in Paris.
zh: 瓦卢瓦的让娜（1304—1363），人称“阿图瓦夫人”，是瓦卢瓦伯爵查理与名义上的君士坦丁堡拉丁女皇库尔特奈的凯瑟琳一世之女，也是法王腓力六世的异母妹。约1320年她嫁给博蒙勒罗歇伯爵阿图瓦的罗贝尔三世，罗贝尔与其姑母玛奥争夺阿图瓦伯国。1331年罗贝尔伪造文书败露后流亡国外，让娜与子女被拘捕，关押在加亚尔城堡。丈夫1342年死于英格兰，她仍被长年囚禁；1363年7月9日她离开人世，葬于巴黎奥古斯丁修会教堂。

en: Jean Roger de Beaufort was a son of Guillaume II Roger, Count of Beaufort, nephew of Pope Clement VI and brother of Pope Gregory XI. He became Bishop of Rieux in 1353 and was transferred to Carpentras in 1357, where he authorized the city's Jews to build a synagogue in 1361 and later a cemetery. After his brother's election as pope he was made Archbishop of Auch in 1371 and Archbishop of Narbonne in 1375, and took part in the negotiations with Florence at Sarzana in 1378. He died in 1391, loyal to the Avignon obedience during the Western Schism.
zh: 让·罗歇·德博福尔是博福尔伯爵纪尧姆二世·罗歇之子，教宗克雷芒六世的侄子、教宗额我略十一世的弟弟。他于1353年任里厄主教，1357年调任卡庞特拉主教，任内于1361年准许当地犹太人建造会堂，后来又准许他们设立墓地。其兄当选教宗后，他于1371年升任欧什大主教，1375年改任纳博讷大主教，并于1378年参与在萨尔扎纳与佛罗伦萨的谈判。他于1391年去世，在西方教会大分裂中始终忠于阿维尼翁教廷。

en: Bonne of Luxembourg, born Jutta (20 May 1315 – 11 September 1349), was a daughter of John the Blind of Bohemia and Elisabeth of the Přemyslid dynasty. On 28 July 1332 she married the thirteen-year-old John, duke of Normandy and future John II of France, becoming duchess of Normandy and countess of Anjou. She never became queen: she died of the Black Death at Maubuisson Abbey in 1349, a year before John became king. Her children included Charles V of France and Philip the Bold, first Valois duke of Burgundy, and she patronised Guillaume de Machaut.
zh: 卢森堡的博内，本名尤塔（1315年5月20日—1349年9月11日），是波希米亚国王“盲人”约翰与普舍美斯家族的伊丽莎白之女。1332年7月28日，她嫁给年方十三的诺曼底公爵、后来的法王约翰二世，成为诺曼底公爵夫人、安茹女伯爵。她始终未能成为王后：1349年她在莫比松修道院死于黑死病，比约翰继位早了一年。她的子女包括法王查理五世和瓦卢瓦家族第一代勃艮第公爵“大胆的”腓力，她还曾庇护纪尧姆·德·马肖。

en: Catherine of Austria (1320–1349) was the elder daughter of Leopold I, Duke of Austria, and Catherine of Savoy. In November 1338 her marriage to Enguerrand VI, Lord of Coucy, was contracted at Vincennes, binding the Habsburgs to the great Picard baron. Their son Enguerrand, the future Enguerrand VII, was born around 1340. Enguerrand VI was killed in fighting before the Battle of Crécy in 1346. In February 1348 Catherine married Konrad von Hardeck, Burgrave of Magdeburg. Both died of the Black Death in September 1349, she three days after her husband; Catherine was buried at Königsfelden.
zh: 奥地利的凯瑟琳（1320—1349）是奥地利公爵利奥波德一世与萨伏依的凯瑟琳的长女。1338年11月，她与库西领主昂盖朗六世在万塞讷订立婚约，哈布斯堡家族由此与这位皮卡第的显赫男爵联姻。她的儿子昂盖朗，即后来的昂盖朗七世，约生于1340年。1346年，昂盖朗六世在克雷西战役前的战事中阵亡。1348年2月，凯瑟琳改嫁马格德堡城堡伯爵康拉德·冯·哈德克。1349年9月，夫妇二人先后死于黑死病，凯瑟琳比丈夫晚三天离世，葬于柯尼希斯费尔登修道院。

en: Clementia of Hungary (1293–1328), daughter of Charles Martel of Anjou and his Habsburg wife Clemence, was raised at Naples but styled a Hungarian princess. Her parents died when she was young, and her grandmother Mary of Hungary brought her up. On 19 August 1315 she married Louis X of France and was crowned at Reims five days later. Widowed in June 1316, she gave birth in November to John I, king from birth, who lived only five days before her brother-in-law took the crown as Philip V. After disputing her dower with Philip she withdrew to Aix-en-Provence, returned to Paris in 1321, and died there on 13 October 1328, a patron of illuminated manuscripts.
zh: 匈牙利的克莱门西娅（1293—1328）是安茹的查理·马特与哈布斯堡家族的克莱门斯之女，生养于那不勒斯，却被视为匈牙利公主。父母在她幼年时去世，她由祖母匈牙利的玛丽抚养长大。1315年8月19日她嫁给法王路易十世，五天后在兰斯加冕为后。1316年6月路易十世去世，她于11月生下约翰一世：孩子出生即为王，仅存活五天，王位便由她的小叔腓力五世取得。她与腓力争执寡妇产之后，退居普罗旺斯地区艾克斯，1321年回到巴黎，1328年10月13日在巴黎去世，以赞助泥金手抄本闻名。

en: Laure de Mauvoisin (born c. 1329) was the elder daughter of Guy VII de Mauvoisin, baron of Rosny, and Roberte de Beaumetz. From her mother she inherited the châtellenie of Bapaume and the lordships of Beaumetz, Croisilles and Boubers in Artois, lands considered more valuable than Rosny itself. She married Robert de Beaussart, seigneur of Wingles and constable of Flanders. Their daughter Ide married Jean de Saquainville, seigneur of Blaru, while their younger daughter Béatrix married first Gauthier de Hondschoote and then Hugues de Melun, burgrave of Ghent.
zh: 洛尔·德·莫瓦桑（约1329年生）是罗尼男爵居伊七世·德·莫瓦桑与罗贝尔特·德·博梅的长女。她从母亲处继承阿图瓦的巴波姆城守领地及博梅、克鲁瓦西耶、布贝尔等领地，这些产业被认为比罗尼本身更丰厚。她嫁给万格勒领主、佛兰德统帅罗贝尔·德·博萨尔。女儿伊德嫁给布拉吕领主让·德·萨坎维尔；幼女贝亚特丽斯先嫁戈蒂埃·德·翁斯科特，后嫁根特城堡伯爵于格·德·默伦。

en: Laure de Ponthieu, also called Laure d'Aumale (c. 1275–1324), was the daughter of John I, Count of Aumale, who was killed at the Battle of the Golden Spurs in 1302, and Ide de Meulan. She married Guy VI Mauvoisin, lord of Rosny-sur-Seine.
zh: 蓬蒂约的劳拉（约1275—1324），又称欧马勒的劳拉，是欧马勒伯爵让一世与默朗的伊德之女；其父于1302年在金马刺战役中阵亡。她嫁给塞纳河畔罗尼的领主居伊六世·莫瓦桑。

en: Lothair (941–986), son of Louis IV and Gerberga, succeeded his father at thirteen in 954, crowned at Reims and guided first by Hugh the Great and later by his uncle Bruno of Cologne. In 978 he raided Lotharingia, nearly catching Otto II at Aachen and holding it five days; Otto ravaged to the walls of Paris, and by the 980 treaty of Margut Lothair renounced Lotharingia. His son Louis V was crowned co-king in 979, and after Otto II's death in 983 Lothair claimed guardianship of the young Otto III and custody of Lotharingia. He died at Laon in March 986, planning to attack Cambrai.
zh: 洛泰尔（941—986）是路易四世与格贝尔加之子，954年十三岁时继承父位，在兰斯加冕，先后受大于格和舅舅科隆大主教布鲁诺的监护。978年，他突袭洛塔林吉亚，在亚琛几乎俘获奥托二世，并占领该城五天；奥托二世反击，一路劫掠到巴黎城下，980年双方在希埃河畔的马尔久议和，洛泰尔放弃洛塔林吉亚。979年，其子路易五世被加冕为共治国王；983年奥托二世死后，洛泰尔提出监护年幼的奥托三世并掌管洛塔林吉亚的要求。986年3月，他正计划攻打康布雷时猝死于拉昂。

en: Louis the Pious (778–840), third son of Charlemagne, was made King of Aquitaine in 781 and crowned co-emperor in 813. In 801 he captured Barcelona from the Emirate of Córdoba, and in 812 asserted Frankish authority over Pamplona and the Basques. Succeeding Charlemagne in 814, he associated his sons Lothair, Pepin and Louis with his rule. Trying to provide a share for Charles, his son by his second wife, helped spark the civil wars of the 830s, and he was briefly deposed in 833–834. He died on 20 June 840; three years of civil war followed.
zh: 虔诚者路易（778—840）是查理曼的第三子，781年被封为阿基坦国王，813年与父亲一同加冕为共治皇帝。801年，他从科尔多瓦埃米尔国手中夺取巴塞罗那；812年，他使潘普洛纳和巴斯克人承认法兰克的权威。814年查理曼去世后他继位，并让儿子洛泰尔、丕平和路易参与执政。他试图为第二任妻子所生的儿子查理分出一份领地，加剧了830年代的内战，他本人也在833年至834年间一度被废黜。840年6月20日他去世，此后内战又持续了三年。

en: Louis I de Sully succeeded his father Jean II as lord of Sully-sur-Loire about 1343. He married Isabeau de Craon, heiress of her brother Amaury IV de Craon, and from 1373 held the barony of Craon in her right. In the Hundred Years' War he sided with the English, and in 1376 his wife sought the protection of Louis I, Duke of Anjou, against him. He died in 1382, leaving a single daughter, Marie, who brought Sully and Craon to the La Trémoïlle family by her marriage.
zh: 路易一世·德叙利约于1343年继父让二世成为卢瓦尔河畔叙利领主。他娶了其兄阿毛里四世·德克拉翁的继承人伊萨博·德克拉翁，自1373年起以妻子的名义领有克拉翁男爵领。百年战争中他倒向英格兰一方，1376年，他的妻子被迫向安茹公爵路易一世寻求庇护以对抗他。他于1382年去世，只留下一个女儿玛丽；玛丽后来通过婚姻把叙利和克拉翁带入拉特雷穆瓦耶家族。

en: Louis I of Thouars (c. 1310–1370), son of Jean I and Blanche of Brabant, succeeded his uncle Hugh II as viscount in 1333 and was also lord of Talmont and Mauléon. In 1330 he married Joan II of Dreux, and from 1345 to 1355 he held the county of Dreux in her right. He was an ally of Philip VI throughout the king's reign, serving as a banneret against Edward III in 1338–1341, the first stage of the Hundred Years' War, and he stood beside John the Good when the king was beaten at Poitiers in 1356. The Treaty of Brétigny in 1360 then placed Thouars under English control, and John Chandos took possession of the town on 3 November 1361. Louis died at Talmont on 7 April 1370. Both his sons were dead, Simon at a tournament on his wedding day in 1365, so the viscounty passed to his daughter Péronnelle.
zh: 路易一世·德·图阿尔（约1310—1370）是让一世与布拉班特的布朗什之子，1333年继叔父于格二世之后任图阿尔子爵，同时是塔尔蒙与莫莱翁的领主。1330年他娶德勒的让娜二世，1345至1355年凭妻权领有德勒伯国。腓力六世在位期间，他始终是国王的盟友：1338至1341年百年战争的第一阶段，他作为方旗骑士随腓力六世对英王爱德华三世作战；1356年好人约翰兵败普瓦捷，他就在国王身旁。1360年《布雷蒂尼条约》使图阿尔落入英格兰控制，约翰·钱多斯于1361年11月3日接管该城。1370年4月7日路易死于塔尔蒙，两个儿子均已先亡，其中西蒙于1365年在自己婚礼当天死于比武，子爵领便传给女儿佩罗内勒。

en: Louis the Stammerer (846–879), eldest son of Charles the Bald, was nicknamed for his stammer. In 866 he succeeded his brother Charles the Child as king of Aquitaine, and in 877 his father's death brought him the West Frankish throne; Hincmar of Reims crowned him at Compiègne. Pope John VIII crowned him again at Troyes in 878 and may have offered him the imperial crown, which was declined. In 878 he granted Barcelona, Girona and Besalú to Wilfred the Hairy. He died at Compiègne in 879 marching against Viking raiders, leaving his realm to sons Louis III and Carloman II.
zh: 口吃者路易（846—879）是秃头查理的长子，因口吃而得名。866年，其弟孩童查理去世，他继任阿基坦国王；877年父亲死后，他登上西法兰克王位，由兰斯大主教英克玛在贡比涅加冕。878年，教宗若望八世在特鲁瓦再次为他加冕，还可能提出立他为帝，但这一提议遭到拒绝。同年，他把巴塞罗那、赫罗那和贝萨鲁封给“多毛的”吉弗雷。879年，他在出征维京人途中死于贡比涅，王国由儿子路易三世与卡洛曼二世瓜分。

en: Louis III (863/865–882), eldest son of Louis the Stammerer, became king of West Francia in 879, his legitimacy disputed. In 880 he and his brother Carloman II divided the kingdom at Amiens, Louis taking Neustria, and by the Treaty of Ribemont ceded western Lotharingia to East Francia. He failed to take Vienne from Boso of Provence, but in August 881 he and Carloman crushed Viking raiders at Saucourt-en-Vimeu, a victory praised in the Ludwigslied. In August 882 he died at Saint-Denis after striking his head on a low lintel while chasing a girl on horseback.
zh: 路易三世（863/865—882）是口吃者路易的长子，879年成为西法兰克国王，其合法性一直存在争议。880年，他与弟弟卡洛曼二世在亚眠瓜分王国，路易分得纽斯特里亚；同年又依《里布蒙条约》把西洛塔林吉亚割让给东法兰克。他未能从普罗旺斯的博索手中夺取维埃纳，但在881年8月与卡洛曼在索库尔昂维默大败维京入侵者，这场胜利在古高地德语诗歌《路德维希之歌》中受到赞颂。882年8月，他骑马追逐一名少女时头撞低矮门楣，死于圣但尼。

en: Louis IV (920–954), called d'Outremer, was the son of Charles the Simple and Eadgifu of Wessex. After his father's capture in 923 he was raised in England at King Æthelstan's court. In 936 Hugh the Great recalled him and he was crowned at Laon. In 939 he invaded Lotharingia and married Gerberga of Saxony, sister of Otto I. Captured by Normans at Rouen in 945, he was handed to Hugh the Great and released in 946 after surrendering Laon. He died at Reims in 954 after falling from his horse while chasing a wolf; his son Lothair succeeded him.
zh: 路易四世（920—954）绰号“海外归来者”，是糊涂王查理与威塞克斯的埃德吉芙之子。923年父亲被俘后，他在英格兰的埃塞尔斯坦王宫廷长大。936年，大于格把他召回，他在拉昂加冕。939年，他入侵洛塔林吉亚，并娶了奥托一世的妹妹、萨克森的格贝尔加。945年，他在鲁昂被诺曼人俘获，交给大于格，946年以交出拉昂为代价获释。954年，他在追逐一匹狼时坠马，死于兰斯；其子洛塔尔继位。

en: Louis IX (1214–1270), known as Saint Louis, became King of France at twelve in 1226, ruling under the regency of his mother Blanche of Castile. She faced a rebellion by nobles during his minority. At Taillebourg he defeated Henry III of England's bid to recover the Angevin lands, and reformed royal justice by abolishing trials by ordeal and allowing appeals to the crown. The Sainte-Chapelle was consecrated in 1248 to house his Christian relics. Vowing crusade after a grave illness, he led the Seventh Crusade to Egypt, where he was captured and ransomed in 1250, and later the Eighth to Tunis, dying of dysentery in 1270. Louis was later canonised.
zh: 路易九世（1214—1270），世称圣路易，1226年年仅十二岁便成为法兰西国王，起初由母亲卡斯蒂利亚的布朗什摄政；他未成年时，母亲面临贵族叛乱。他在塔耶堡击败企图收复安茹故土的英格兰国王亨利三世，又改革王室司法，废除神判法，允许向国王上诉。1248年圣礼拜堂祝圣，用以安放他收藏的基督教圣物。大病之后他立誓参加十字军，率第七次十字军东征远征埃及，1250年被俘，靠赎金获释；后又率第八次十字军东征前往突尼斯，1270年在当地死于痢疾。路易后来被教会封圣。

en: Louis V (c. 967–987), called the Do-Nothing, was the son of Lothair and Emma of Italy. Crowned co-king in 979, he married Adelaide-Blanche of Anjou, a widow twice his age, in 982, but the childless marriage soon collapsed. He reigned alone after his father's death in March 986. His short reign was dominated by factions: Adalberon of Reims favored the Ottonians, while others pressed to recover Lotharingia. Louis died in May 987 after a hunting fall near Senlis. Dying without heirs, he ended the Carolingian line: Adalberon crowned Hugh Capet, elected king in his place.
zh: 路易五世（约967—987）绰号“懒王”，是洛泰尔与意大利的艾玛之子。979年被加冕为共治国王，982年娶了年长自己一倍有余的寡妇、安茹的阿德莱德-布朗什，但这段无子的婚姻很快破裂。986年3月父亲死后，他独自执政。他短暂的统治被派系左右：兰斯的阿达尔贝隆亲近奥托王朝，另一派则力主收复洛塔林吉亚。987年5月，路易在桑利斯附近的阿拉特森林狩猎坠马而死。他死后无嗣，加洛林王朝就此终结：阿达尔贝隆为当选继位的于格·卡佩加冕。

en: Louis VI (1081–1137), called the Fat, ruled as King of the Franks from 1108, succeeding his father Philip I. His half-brother prevented him from reaching Reims, so he was crowned at Orléans. Much of his twenty-nine-year reign was spent campaigning against the lawless robber barons of the Île-de-France and fighting Henry I of England for control of Normandy. He granted town charters to win urban support, was the first Capetian to issue ordonnances applying to the entire kingdom, and strengthened royal justice with the counsel of Abbot Suger of Saint-Denis.
