In 1115 he married Adelaide of Maurienne. Their eldest son Philip died after a fall from his horse in 1131, and Louis was succeeded in 1137 by their son Louis VII.
zh: 路易六世（1081—1137），绰号“胖子”，1108年继父腓力一世成为法兰克人之王。他的异母兄弟阻止他前往兰斯，他便在奥尔良加冕。他在位二十九年，大部分时间都在征讨法兰西岛内横行不法的割据贵族，并为争夺诺曼底与英格兰国王亨利一世交战。他向城市居民颁发特许状以争取市民支持，是首位颁布通行全国敕令的卡佩君主，在圣但尼修道院院长叙热的辅佐下强化了王室司法。1115年他娶莫里耶讷的阿德莱德，二人的长子腓力于1131年坠马身亡；1137年路易去世后，其子路易七世继位。

en: Louis VII (1120–1180), called the Young, became King of France in 1137, when his father Louis VI died days after marrying him to Eleanor, heiress of Aquitaine, briefly extending Capetian power to the Pyrenees. Originally intended for the Church, Louis had become heir and been crowned his father's co-ruler after his elder brother Philip died in 1131. In 1147 he joined the Second Crusade and the failed siege of Damascus, returning in 1149. His marriage to Eleanor was annulled in 1152; she then wed Henry II of England, carrying Aquitaine into the Angevin Empire. Louis later supported their sons in rebellion against Henry. His third wife Adela of Champagne bore Philip II Augustus in 1165. His reign saw the rise of the University of Paris and the building of Notre-Dame.
zh: 路易七世（1120—1180），绰号“年轻者”，1137年成为法兰西国王：当年他与阿基坦女继承人埃莉诺成婚，其父路易六世在婚后数日去世，这场婚姻一度把卡佩王室的势力扩展到比利牛斯山。路易原本准备投身教会，1131年兄长腓力去世后成为继承人，并加冕为父亲的共治国王。1147年他参加第二次十字军东征，参与了失败的大马士革围城战，1149年回国。他与埃莉诺的婚姻于1152年被废除，埃莉诺随后嫁给英格兰国王亨利二世，将阿基坦带入安茹帝国。路易后来支持他们的儿子反抗亨利。他的第三任妻子香槟的阿黛勒于1165年生下日后的腓力二世·奥古斯特。他在位期间巴黎大学兴起，巴黎圣母院也动工修建。

en: Louis VIII (1187–1226), called the Lion, son of Philip II Augustus and Isabella of Hainault, married Blanche of Castile in 1200. As prince he invaded England in 1216 and was proclaimed king by rebel barons in London, though never crowned; after King John's death he was defeated and withdrew under the Treaty of Lambeth. He fought in the Albigensian Crusade and, as king from 1223, seized Poitou, Saintonge and La Rochelle from the Angevins, leaving them only Gascony. In 1226 he led another crusade into Languedoc and besieged Avignon. He died of dysentery in 1226 returning from the crusade, leaving the crown to the young Louis IX.
zh: 路易八世（1187—1226），绰号“狮子”，是腓力二世·奥古斯特与埃诺的伊莎贝拉之子，1200年娶卡斯蒂利亚的布朗什。作为王子，他于1216年进军英格兰，被伦敦的叛乱贵族宣布为国王，但从未加冕；约翰王死后他战败，依《兰贝斯条约》撤军。他参加阿尔比十字军，1223年继位后又从安茹王朝手中夺取普瓦图、圣通日和拉罗谢尔，使其在大陆仅余加斯科涅。1226年他再次率十字军进军朗格多克，围攻阿维尼翁。同年他在十字军归途中死于痢疾，王位传给年幼的路易九世。

en: Louis X (1289–1316), called the Quarrelsome, was the eldest son of Philip IV and Joan I of Navarre, inheriting Navarre from his mother in 1305 and ruling France from 1314. His reign saw tensions with nobles over fiscal and centralising reforms begun under his father. He let serfs buy their freedom and readmitted the Jews. His queen Margaret of Burgundy, with whom he had a daughter Joan, was convicted of adultery in the 1314 Tour de Nesle affair and died imprisoned; he then wed Clementia of Hungary. Louis died in 1316 after a game of real tennis, leaving Clementia pregnant. Their posthumous son John I lived only five days, and a disputed succession followed; Louis's brother became Philip V.
zh: 路易十世（1289—1316），绰号“吵闹者”，是腓力四世与纳瓦拉的胡安娜一世的长子，1305年从母亲那里继承纳瓦拉，1314年起统治法兰西。他在位时，父王时期推行的财政与集权改革使王室与贵族关系紧张。他允许农奴出钱赎身、重新接纳犹太人。王后勃艮第的玛格丽特为他生下女儿胡安娜，在1314年的奈斯勒塔事件中被判通奸，最终死于狱中；他随后娶匈牙利的克莱门西娅。1316年路易在一场室内网球赛后暴病身亡，克莱门西娅当时正有孕在身。遗腹子约翰一世只活了五天，随后继承问题引起争议，路易的弟弟即位，是为腓力五世。

en: Mahaut of Châtillon (1293 – 3 October 1358), daughter of Guy IV, Count of Saint-Pol, and Marie of Brittany, in 1308 became the third wife of Charles, Count of Valois, brother of Philip IV and father of Philip VI, whose stepmother she was. Her children were Marie, wife of Charles, Duke of Calabria; Isabella, wife of Peter I, Duke of Bourbon and ancestress of the Bourbon kings; Blanche, wife of Charles IV, King of Germany and Bohemia; and Louis, Count of Chartres, who died in childhood. Widowed in 1325, she died on 3 October 1358 and was buried at the Cordeliers in Paris.
zh: 沙蒂永的玛特（1293年—1358年10月3日）是圣波勒伯爵居伊四世与布列塔尼的玛丽之女。1308年，她成为瓦卢瓦伯爵查理的第三任妻子；查理是腓力四世之弟、未来国王腓力六世之父，玛特因此是腓力六世的继母。她的子女有嫁给卡拉布里亚公爵查理的玛丽、嫁波旁公爵皮埃尔一世并成为波旁诸王先人的伊莎贝拉、嫁给德意志和波希米亚国王查理四世的布朗什，以及幼年夭折的沙特尔伯爵路易。1325年她守寡，1358年10月3日去世，葬于巴黎的科德利埃修道院。

en: Margaret of Anjou (1273–1299) was countess of Anjou and Maine in her own right. A daughter of Charles II of Naples and Mary of Hungary, she married Charles of Valois, son of King Philip III of France, at Corbeil in August 1290; her father ceded Anjou and Maine to Charles as her dowry. Her children included Philip VI, the first Valois king of France, Joan, wife of William I of Hainaut, Margaret, wife of Guy I of Blois, and Charles II of Alençon, killed at Crécy in 1346, long after her death on 31 December 1299.
zh: 安茹的玛格丽特（1273—1299）以本人身份为安茹与曼恩女伯爵。她是那不勒斯国王查理二世与匈牙利的玛丽亚之女，1290年8月在科尔贝伊嫁给法王腓力三世之子瓦卢瓦的查理，父亲将安茹和曼恩两个伯国作为她的嫁妆割给查理。她的子女包括瓦卢瓦王朝的第一位法兰西国王腓力六世、嫁给埃诺伯爵威廉一世的让娜、嫁给布卢瓦伯爵居伊一世的玛格丽特，以及阿朗松伯爵查理二世。玛格丽特于1299年12月31日去世，查理则在她去世多年后的1346年战死于克雷西。

en: Margaret of Burgundy (1290–1315) was the second daughter of Robert II, Duke of Burgundy, and Agnes of France, daughter of Louis IX. In 1305 she married Louis, king of Navarre and future Louis X; their daughter Joan became Joan II of Navarre. Early in 1314 she was accused of adultery in the Tour de Nesle affair, denounced by Isabella of France, and imprisoned at Château Gaillard alongside Blanche of Burgundy. When Louis inherited the French crown that November she became queen but stayed in prison, uncrowned. She died there on 30 April 1315, of illness or possibly by strangling.
zh: 勃艮第的玛格丽特（1290—1315）是勃艮第公爵罗贝尔二世与法兰西的阿涅斯的次女，阿涅斯是路易九世的女儿。1305年，她嫁给纳瓦拉国王路易，即后来的法兰西国王路易十世；两人的女儿让娜后来成为纳瓦拉女王胡安娜二世。1314年初，她在内斯勒塔事件中被控通奸，遭到法兰西的伊莎贝拉指证，与勃艮第的布朗什一同被囚禁在加亚尔城堡。同年11月路易继承法兰西王位，她虽成为王后却仍被关押，也从未加冕。1315年4月30日她死于狱中，一说病逝，一说可能被勒死。

en: Margaret of Bourbon (1313–1362) was a daughter of Louis I, Duke of Bourbon, and Mary of Avesnes. In 1320 she married Jean II de Sully, by whom she had Louis, Beatrice and Henriette, and in 1346 she married Hutin de Vermeilles.
zh: 波旁的玛格丽特（1313—1362）是波旁公爵路易一世与阿韦讷的玛丽之女，1320年嫁给让二世·德·叙利，生有路易、比阿特丽丝和亨利埃特，1346年改嫁于坦·德·韦尔梅耶。

en: Margaret of Burgundy (c. 1231–1277) was the second daughter of Hugh IV, Duke of Burgundy, and Yolande of Dreux. First married to Guillaume III, lord of Mont-Saint-Jean, she was widowed in 1256 and then married Guy VI, viscount of Limoges, around 1258. When Guy died in August 1263, their daughter Marie was only three, and Margaret ruled the viscounty as regent until 1275. With her counselor Géraud de Maulmont she consolidated the viscounts' authority during the conflict over Limoges, and in 1275 arranged Marie's marriage to Arthur, heir to the Duchy of Brittany. She died on 27 August 1277.
zh: 勃艮第的玛格丽特（约1231—1277）是勃艮第公爵于格四世与德勒的约兰德的次女。她先嫁给蒙圣让领主纪尧姆三世，1256年丧偶；约1258年改嫁利摩日子爵居伊六世。1263年8月居伊去世时，两人的女儿玛丽只有三岁，玛格丽特遂以摄政身份治理利摩日子爵领，直至1275年。她依靠顾问热罗·德·莫尔蒙，在围绕利摩日的冲突中巩固了子爵的权威，并于1275年安排玛丽与布列塔尼公国的继承人阿蒂尔成婚。她于1277年8月27日去世。

en: Marguerite de Mauvoisin de Rosny was the daughter of Guy VII de Mauvoisin, baron de Rosny, and Roberte de Beaumez. She married Robert IV d'Harcourt, seigneur de Beaumesnil.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·莫瓦桑·德·罗尼是罗尼男爵居伊七世·德·莫瓦桑与罗贝尔特·德·博梅之女，嫁给博梅尼勒领主罗贝尔四世·德·阿库尔。

en: Margaret of Soissons (1305–1344) was the only daughter of Hugh, Count of Soissons, and Johanna of Argies. In 1306 she succeeded her father as ruling countess of Soissons while still an infant. Shortly before 23 January 1317 she was married to John of Beaumont, a son of the count of Hainaut, who held the county as count jure uxoris. Their daughter Johanna of Beaumont (1323–1350) inherited Soissons. Margaret died in 1344.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·苏瓦松（1305—1344）是苏瓦松伯爵于格与让娜·达尔日的独生女，1306年尚在襁褓中便继承父亲之位成为苏瓦松女伯爵。1317年1月23日前不久，她嫁给埃诺伯爵之子让·德·博蒙特，后者以妻权受称苏瓦松伯爵。两人之女让娜·德·博蒙特（1323—1350）后来继承苏瓦松。玛格丽特于1344年去世。

en: Marguerite de Noyers (born c. 1309) was a daughter of Miles de Noyers, Marshal of France, and in 1326 married John III, lord of Châteauvillain in Champagne.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·努瓦耶（约1309年生）是法兰西元帅米隆·德·努瓦耶之女，1326年嫁给香槟的沙托维兰领主让三世。

en: Margaret of Thouars, daughter of Louis I, Viscount of Thouars, and Joan II, Countess of Dreux, held the title Countess of Dreux. She married Thomas de Chemillé and, after his death, Guy V Turpin, lord of Crissé, and was sister of Péronnelle, Viscountess of Thouars.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·图阿尔是图阿尔子爵路易一世与德勒女伯爵让娜二世之女，享有德勒女伯爵头衔。她先嫁托马·德·舍米耶，丈夫死后改嫁克里塞领主居伊五世·蒂尔潘，是图阿尔女子爵佩罗内勒的妹妹。

en: Marie Rogier de Beaufort was a daughter of Guillaume II Roger, comte de Beaufort, and Marie de Chambon, and sister of Pope Gregory XI. She married Guérin VII de Châteauneuf, seigneur d'Apchier, and later Raimond II de Nogaret.
zh: 玛丽·罗歇·德·博福尔是博福尔伯爵纪尧姆二世·罗歇与玛丽·德·尚邦之女、教皇额我略十一世的姐妹，先嫁阿普谢领主盖兰七世，后改嫁雷蒙二世·德·诺加雷。

en: Marie of Brabant (23 May 1254–12 January 1322), a daughter of Duke Henry III of Brabant, married Philip III of France in 1274 and was crowned queen at the Sainte-Chapelle in 1275. After the heir Louis died in 1276, she and the chamberlain Pierre de La Brosse accused each other in the ensuing court conflict. At her request Philip had him condemned without evidence or a confession, and he was executed without a trial by the Parlement. After the Sicilian Vespers of 1282 she pushed Philip to intervene for Charles I of Anjou, helping launch the Aragón Crusade. Widowed in 1285, she lived retired at Les Mureaux until her death. Her children included Louis, Count of Évreux, and Margaret, who married Edward I of England.
zh: 布拉班特的玛丽（1254年5月23日—1322年1月12日）是布拉班特公爵亨利三世之女，1274年嫁给法王腓力三世，1275年在圣礼拜堂加冕为王后。1276年王位继承人路易死后，她与宫廷侍从长皮埃尔·德·拉·布罗斯在随之而来的宫廷纷争中相互指责。应她的请求，腓力在没有证据或供认的情况下判处拉·布罗斯死刑，他未经巴黎高等法院审判便被处决。1282年西西里晚祷事件后，她力劝腓力出兵帮助安茹的查理一世，促成阿拉贡十字军。1285年守寡后，她退居莱米罗，直至去世。子女包括埃夫勒伯爵路易，以及嫁给英格兰国王爱德华一世的玛格丽特。

en: Marie of France (October 1326 – 6 October 1341) was a Capetian princess, the second daughter of King Charles IV of France and his third wife Joan of Évreux. When Charles died in February 1328, her mother was pregnant with Blanche, whose posthumous birth ended the direct Capetian line and let Philip VI of Valois take the crown. Joan of Évreux nonetheless pressed Marie's and Blanche's claims to Navarre, negotiating a buy-out of their rights with Queen Joan II. Marie died unmarried in Paris on 6 October 1341, aged about fifteen, before the dispute was settled.
zh: 法兰西的玛丽（1326年10月—1341年10月6日）是卡佩王朝公主，法兰西国王查理四世与第三任妻子埃夫勒的让娜的次女。1328年2月查理四世去世时，其母正怀着布朗歇；这个遗腹女的出生意味着卡佩直系绝嗣，瓦卢瓦的腓力得以继位，称腓力六世。尽管如此，让娜仍为玛丽和布朗歇主张纳瓦拉王位，与纳瓦拉女王让娜二世商谈买断她们继承权的条件。1341年10月6日，玛丽在巴黎未婚早逝，年仅约十五岁，纠纷仍未了结。

en: Marie de Châteauvillain (c. 1330 – 1366 or 1367) was the younger daughter of Jean III de Châteauvillain and Marguerite de Noyers. Still unmarried at her father's death in 1355, she inherited Arc-en-Barrois and Nully when her brother Jean IV was killed at Poitiers in 1356; her elder sister Jeanne took Châteauvillain. Marie married Jean II de Bourgogne of the Chalon comital house and became lady of Montaigu. She made her will on 22 October 1366, and her son Jean, born soon afterwards, died in infancy. Leaving no surviving children, she left Arc and Nully to Jeanne and was buried in the church of Arc-en-Barrois.
zh: 玛丽·德·沙托维兰（约1330年—1366或1367年）是让三世·德·沙托维兰与玛格丽特·德努瓦耶的幼女。1355年父亲去世时她尚未出嫁；1356年兄长让四世在普瓦捷战死后，她继承阿尔克昂巴鲁瓦和尼伊，姐姐让娜则继承沙托维兰。玛丽嫁给沙隆伯国家族的让二世·德·勃艮第，成为蒙泰居女领主。她于1366年10月22日立遗嘱，此后不久生下一子让，但孩子夭折。她没有存活的继承人，便将阿尔克和尼伊留给姐姐让娜，死后葬于阿尔克昂巴鲁瓦的教堂。

en: Marie de Chambon (1310–1345), heiress of Chambon in Combraille, was the first wife of Guillaume II Roger, count of Beaufort, and mother of Pope Gregory XI. She died at Avignon around 1345.
zh: 玛丽·德·尚邦（1310—约1345）是孔布拉耶尚邦封地的女继承人，博福尔伯爵纪尧姆二世·罗歇的第一任妻子，教宗额我略十一世之母，约1345年在阿维尼翁去世。

en: Marie de Roucy was the daughter of Jean IV, comte de Roucy, and Jeanne de Dreux, comtesse de Braine. In 1306 she married Jean II de Châteauvillain, seigneur of Châteauvillain and Arc-en-Barrois, and was widowed in 1312 with two young sons, Jean III and Guillaume.
zh: 鲁西的玛丽是鲁西伯爵让四世与布赖讷女伯爵让娜·德·德勒之女，1306年嫁给沙托维兰与阿尔克昂巴鲁瓦领主让二世·德·沙托维兰，1312年守寡，留下让三世和纪尧姆两个年幼的儿子。

en: Marthe Rogier de Beaufort was a daughter of Guillaume II Roger, comte de Beaufort, and Marie de Chambon. She married Guy de La Tour, seigneur de La Tour, who died in 1375; their son Bertrand IV married the Countess of Auvergne.
zh: 玛尔特·罗歇·德·博福尔是博福尔伯爵纪尧姆二世·罗歇与玛丽·德·尚邦之女，嫁给拉图尔领主居伊·德·拉图尔（1375年卒）；他们的儿子贝尔特朗四世娶了奥弗涅女伯爵。

en: Mathieu III de Trie (d. 26 November 1344), lord of Araines and Vaumain, was marshal of France as the Valois came to the throne and war with England began. Eldest son of Renaud de Trie, he led a battalion at Courtrai in 1302, where his father fell. He succeeded Jean de Beaumont as marshal around 1320, attended Charles IV's coronation at Reims in 1322, accompanied Charles of Valois in the conquest of Guyenne in 1324 and commanded troops against the Flemings in 1325. In 1328 his brother Guillaume, archbishop of Reims, crowned Philip VI. In 1339 Mathieu, a member of the league of Norman lords, offered Philip an army for the invasion of England. In the Flanders campaign of 1340 he commanded under the king, ravaged the country, then shut himself in Tournai, which Edward III was besieging, until peace ended the siege. Lieutenant-general on the Flemish frontier from 1342, he died childless in 1344, full of honours.
zh: 马蒂厄三世·德·特里（1344年11月26日卒）是阿莱讷与沃曼的领主，在瓦卢瓦家登上王位、对英战争爆发的年头担任法兰西元帅。他是雷诺·德·特里的长子，1302年率一个军阵参加科特赖克之战，父亲在此役阵亡。约1320年他继让·德·博蒙之后出任元帅，1322年出席查理四世在兰斯的加冕礼，1324年随瓦卢瓦的查理征服吉耶讷，1325年统军对抗佛兰德人。1328年，他的兄弟、兰斯大主教纪尧姆为腓力六世加冕。1339年，他作为诺曼贵族同盟的一员，向腓力六世提出出兵征服英格兰。1340年的佛兰德战役中，他在国王麾下统军，蹂躏当地后退守被爱德华三世围攻的图尔奈，直到停战结束围城。1342年起他任佛兰德边境的国王副将，1344年去世，无嗣，身后荣誉满身。

en: Napoleon Bonaparte (1769–1821) was a French general and emperor, born on Corsica and commissioned an artillery officer in 1785. He won fame at Toulon in 1793 and crushed a royalist rising in Paris with cannon on 13 Vendémiaire 1795, then led the Army of Italy to victory in 1796. He invaded Egypt and Syria in 1798 before the Coup of 18 Brumaire in 1799 made him First Consul. His reforms included the Napoleonic Code, and he crowned himself emperor in 1804. Austerlitz (1805) marked his zenith, but the Russian campaign of 1812 broke his army. He abdicated in 1814, returned from exile for the Hundred Days and lost Waterloo in 1815. He died in exile on Saint Helena in 1821.
zh: 拿破仑·波拿巴（1769—1821）是法国将领和皇帝，生于科西嘉岛，1785年被任命为炮兵军官。他1793年在土伦围城战中成名，1795年葡月13日用大炮镇压了巴黎的王党起义，随后于1796年率意大利军团取胜。他1798年入侵埃及和叙利亚，1799年雾月政变后出任第一执政。他的改革包括制定《拿破仑法典》，1804年他加冕为皇帝。1805年的奥斯特里茨之战是他权势的顶峰，但1812年征俄之役使其大军覆灭。他1814年退位，从流放地归来百日复辟后于1815年在滑铁卢战败，最终于1821年在流放地圣赫勒拿岛去世。

en: Nicolas Roger de Beaufort (1340–1415), comte de Beaufort and vicomte de La Mothe, was a son of Guillaume II Roger and Marie de Chambon and a brother of Pope Gregory XI. First destined for the church, he took up arms after his father was captured at Poitiers in 1356. In 1371 he served in the papal league against the Visconti of Milan, campaigning in Lombardy with John Hawkwood and sharing in the victory at Montichiari in May 1373. Around 1370 he married Marguerite de Galard, and after her death married Marthe de Montaut in 1396.
zh: 尼古拉·罗歇·德·博福尔（1340—1415），博福尔伯爵、拉莫特子爵，是纪尧姆二世·罗歇与玛丽·德·尚邦之子，教皇额我略十一世之弟。他本准备出任神职，1356年父亲在普瓦捷战役被俘后转而从军。1371年他加入反对米兰维斯孔蒂家族的教皇同盟，在伦巴第与约翰·霍克伍德并肩作战，1373年5月参与蒙蒂基亚里之捷。约1370年他娶玛格丽特·德·加拉尔，丧妻后于1396年续娶玛尔特·德·蒙托。

en: Odo (c. 857–898), called Odo of Paris, was the eldest son of Robert the Strong and Count of Paris from 882. When Vikings besieged Paris in 885 and 886, he defended the city with Bishop Joscelin and broke out to seek aid after the bishop died. After the emperor Charles the Fat was deposed in 887, the West Frankish nobles chose Odo as king and crowned him at Compiègne in February 888, the first ruler of the Robertian dynasty. He defeated a Viking army at Montfaucon and won recognition from the East Frankish king Arnulf. He sought the loyalty of the magnates, and died on 1 January 898, leaving the crown to the Carolingian Charles the Simple.
zh: 厄德（约857—898），人称巴黎的厄德，是强者罗贝尔的长子，882年起成为巴黎伯爵。885至886年维京人围攻巴黎时，他与主教若斯兰共同守城，主教死后他突围求援。887年皇帝胖子查理被废后，西法兰克贵族推举厄德为王，他于888年2月在贡比涅加冕，是罗贝尔王朝的第一位国王。他在蒙福孔击败一支维京军队，获得东法兰克国王阿努尔夫的承认。他在位期间着力争取大贵族效忠。898年1月1日厄德去世，王位传给加洛林王朝的糊涂查理。

en: Pepin the Short (c. 714–768), son of Charles Martel, was the first Carolingian king of the Franks. He ruled as mayor of the palace from 741 with his brother Carloman, and became sole ruler after Carloman entered a monastery in 747. With Pope Zachary's backing he deposed the Merovingian Childeric III and was crowned in 751. Pope Stephen II anointed him at Saint-Denis in 754, and his campaigns against the Lombards produced the Donation of Pepin, basis of the Papal States. He took Narbonne in 759 and subdued Aquitaine, dying in 768; his sons Charlemagne and Carloman succeeded him.
zh: 矮子丕平（约714—768）是查理·马特之子，也是第一位加洛林王朝的法兰克国王。他自741年起与兄长卡洛曼一同担任宫相，747年卡洛曼进入修道院后独掌大权。在教皇扎迦利支持下，他废黜墨洛温王朝的希尔德里克三世，于751年加冕为王。754年，教皇斯德望二世在圣但尼为他涂油；他出兵攻打伦巴第人，由此产生的“丕平献土”奠定了教皇国的基础。他于759年夺取纳博讷、征服阿基坦，768年去世，王国由儿子查理曼和卡洛曼继承。

en: Péronnelle de Thouars (c. 1330–1397), daughter of Louis I, Viscount of Thouars, and Joan II, Countess of Dreux, inherited Dreux in 1365 and the viscounty of Thouars in 1370 after her brothers died without heirs. In 1345 she married Amaury IV de Craon, who ruled Thouars jure uxoris until his death in 1373; her second husband, from 1376, was Tristan Rouault de Boisménard. In 1378 she ceded Dreux to Charles V in exchange for Benon. She died at Puybéliard on 30 October 1397, ending the five-century rule of the elder House of Thouars.
zh: 佩罗内勒·德·图阿尔（约1330—1397）是图阿尔子爵路易一世与德勒女伯爵让娜二世之女，兄弟二人无嗣而亡后，她于1365年继承德勒伯国，1370年继承图阿尔子爵领。1345年她嫁给阿马尔里克四世·德·克朗，后者凭妻权统治图阿尔直至1373年去世；1376年她再嫁特里斯坦·鲁奥·德·布瓦梅纳尔。1378年，她以德勒伯国与查理五世交换伯南领地。1397年10月30日她死于皮贝利雅尔，统治图阿尔五百余年的图阿尔家族长支就此断绝。

en: Philip of Valois (1 July 1336 – 1 September 1375), born in Paris, was the younger son of King Philip VI and Joan of Burgundy. In 1344 his father created him Duke of Orléans with the County of Valois as an apanage, and in 1345 he married Blanche, daughter of Charles IV; the marriage was childless. He fought beside his brother John II at Poitiers in 1356 and fled the field, then went as a hostage to England under the 1360 Treaty of Brétigny, being freed in 1365. He died suddenly in 1375, and his apanage reverted to the crown.
zh: 菲利普·德·瓦卢瓦（1336年7月1日—1375年9月1日）生于巴黎，是法王腓力六世与勃艮第的让娜较小的儿子。1344年，父亲把新设立的奥尔良公爵领连同瓦卢瓦伯国作为封禄赐给他；1345年他娶查理四世之女布朗什为妻，无子嗣。1356年他随兄长约翰二世在普瓦捷作战，临阵脱逃；后依1360年《布雷蒂尼条约》作为人质被送往英格兰，1365年获释。1375年他猝然去世，封禄收归王室。

en: Philip VI of France (1293–1350), called the Fortunate, was the first Valois king, chosen by the nobles and tested by that choice for the rest of his life. His father Charles of Valois had struggled for the throne and never won it; in 1328, when the last Capetian, Charles IV, died, the nobility preferred Charles's paternal cousin Philip to his nephew through his sister, Edward III of England. Philip opened with victory at Cassel in 1328, restoring the Count of Flanders. Relations with Edward soured over Aquitaine and Philip's backing of David II of Scotland, and in 1337 Philip declared Aquitaine forfeit. Edward answered by claiming the French crown: the Hundred Years' War had begun. His fleet was destroyed at Sluys in 1340; at Crécy in 1346 he ordered a general attack as evening fell, and barely escaped as his army was annihilated. Calais fell in 1347. The Black Death then killed Queen Joan and a third of the population. He bought the Dauphiné in 1349 and died on 22 August 1350, leaving a divided kingdom to his son John II.
zh: 腓力六世（1293—1350），绰号幸运者，是瓦卢瓦王朝的第一位国王，由贵族推举为王，此后一生都在为这一选择付出代价。他的父亲瓦卢瓦的查理争夺王位而未能如愿；1328年末代卡佩国王查理四世去世，法国贵族选择了查理的父系堂兄腓力，而不是查理的外甥英王爱德华三世。腓力即位之初在1328年的卡塞尔大胜，使佛兰德伯爵复位。他与爱德华因阿基坦问题，以及腓力支持苏格兰国王大卫二世而日渐交恶；1337年，腓力宣布没收阿基坦。爱德华以主张法兰西王位作为回应，百年战争由此爆发。他的舰队于1340年在斯勒伊斯覆灭；1346年在克雷西，他在傍晚下令全军进攻，军队被歼灭，他本人勉强脱身。加来于1347年陷落。随后黑死病夺走了王后让娜和三分之一的人口。他于1349年购得多菲内，1350年8月22日去世，把一个分裂的王国留给儿子约翰二世。

en: Philip I, called the Amorous (c. 1052–1108), was king of the Franks from 1060, son of Henry I and Anne of Kiev. Crowned in 1059, he first ruled under Baldwin V of Flanders's regency. His intervention in Flanders ended in defeat at Cassel in 1071. In 1076 he relieved Dol-de-Bretagne, forcing William the Conqueror to make peace. He enlarged the royal demesne with the Vexin in 1082 and Bourges in 1100. In 1092 he repudiated his queen Bertha of Holland and married Bertrada of Montfort, wife of Count Fulk IV of Anjou, for which he was repeatedly excommunicated. He received absolution after public penance in 1104 and died at Melun on 29 July 1108.
zh: 腓力一世，世称“多情者”（约1052—1108），自1060年起为法兰克人之王，是亨利一世与基辅的安娜之子。他1059年加冕，初由佛兰德尔伯爵博杜安五世摄政。他出兵佛兰德尔，1071年在卡塞勒战败。1076年，他解救布列塔尼的多勒，迫使“征服者”威廉议和。他于1082年兼并韦克桑、1100年取得布尔日，扩大了王室领地。1092年，他废黜王后荷兰的贝尔塔，娶安茹伯爵富尔克四世之妻蒙福尔的贝特拉达，因此多次被开除教籍。1104年他公开忏悔并获赦，于1108年7月29日在默伦去世。

en: Philip II (1165–1223), called Augustus, was the only son of Louis VII and Adela of Champagne. Crowned in 1179 while his father was still alive, he ruled France from 1180. That year he married Isabella of Hainault, who brought Artois as her dowry, and from 1190 he was the first monarch to style himself King of France rather than King of the Franks. He joined the Third Crusade before returning to France. After years of war with the Plantagenets, his victory at Bouvines in 1214 broke the Angevin Empire, left royal authority unchallenged, and helped force King John of England to accept Magna Carta. He walled Paris and stabilized the crown's finances, dying in 1223.
zh: 腓力二世（1165—1223），绰号奥古斯特，是路易七世与香槟的阿黛勒的独子。他于1179年在父亲在世时加冕，1180年起统治法兰西。同年他娶埃诺的伊莎贝拉，后者以阿图瓦为嫁妆；自1190年起，他率先自称“法兰西国王”，而非“法兰克人之王”。他参加第三次十字军东征，随后返回法国。经过与金雀花王朝多年交战，他于1214年在布汶战役中获胜，瓦解了安茹帝国，使王权再无挑战者，也迫使英格兰国王约翰接受《大宪章》。他修筑巴黎城墙、整顿王室财政，于1223年去世。

en: Philip III (1245–1285), called the Bold, was the second son of Louis IX and Margaret of Provence, becoming heir after his elder brother died in 1260. In 1262 he married Isabella of Aragon. He was beside Louis IX when he died at Tunis in 1270 and was crowned at Reims the next year. In 1271 his uncle Alphonse of Poitiers died childless, and Philip annexed the County of Toulouse to the royal domain. In 1274 he granted the Comtat Venaissin to the pope; the Treaty of Orléans extended French influence into Navarre. Urged by his uncle Charles of Naples, he led the Aragonese Crusade until disease shattered his army and forced a retreat; he died of dysentery at Perpignan in 1285, succeeded by his son Philip IV.
zh: 腓力三世（1245—1285），绰号“勇敢者”，是路易九世与普罗旺斯的玛格丽特的次子，1260年长兄死后才成为王储。1262年他娶阿拉贡的伊莎贝拉。1270年路易九世死于突尼斯时他随侍在侧，次年在兰斯加冕。1271年，叔父普瓦捷的阿方斯无嗣而终，他随即将图卢兹伯国并入王室领地。1274年他将韦奈桑伯国交给教皇；《奥尔良条约》又把法兰西的影响扩展到纳瓦拉。在叔父那不勒斯的查理敦促下，他发动阿拉贡十字军，但军中疫病流行、被迫撤退，1285年在佩皮尼昂死于痢疾，王位传给儿子腓力四世。

en: Philip IV (1268–1314), called the Fair and the Iron King, ruled France from 1285 and held Navarre from 1284 through his wife Joan I. Governing through lawyer-ministers like Guillaume de Nogaret, he curbed feudal privilege and centralised royal power. He clashed with Edward I of England over Aquitaine and fought rebellious Flanders. Despite defeat at the Golden Spurs in 1302, he eventually won Flemish towns and a large payment. His quarrel with Pope Boniface VIII over clerical taxation led to the 1303 attack at Anagni and the Avignon Papacy. He expelled the Jews in 1306 and destroyed the Knights Templar in 1307. In 1314 his daughters-in-law were accused of adultery in the Tour de Nesle affair. He died that year, leaving three sons who reigned as Louis X, Philip V and Charles IV.
zh: 腓力四世（1268—1314），绰号“美男子”，又称“铁国王”，1285年起统治法兰西，并因1284年迎娶胡安娜一世而领有纳瓦拉。他依靠纪尧姆·德·诺加雷等法律家大臣治国，削弱封建特权，将王权集中。他与英格兰国王爱德华一世争夺阿基坦，并与反叛的佛兰德交战。尽管1302年在金马刺战役中战败，他最终取得部分佛兰德城镇和巨额赔款。他因向教士征税与教皇卜尼法斯八世冲突，最终酿成1303年的阿纳尼之袭和阿维尼翁教廷之始。他于1306年驱逐犹太人，1307年剿灭圣殿骑士团。1314年他的儿媳们在奈斯勒塔事件中被控通奸；他同年去世，三子相继即位，即路易十世、腓力五世和查理四世。

en: Philip V (c. 1291–1322), called the Tall, was the second son of Philip IV and Joan I of Navarre. His father granted him the County of Poitiers. After Louis X died in 1316 he took the regency; the posthumous John I lived only days, and Philip had himself crowned at Reims. He set aside the claim of Louis's daughter Joan after the Estates General excluded women from the succession, fixing the precedent of the Salic law. His reforms created an independent Court of Finances, standard weights and measures, and a single currency. He also improved relations with Flanders, which had rebelled under his father. He died of dysentery in 1322 leaving only daughters, succeeded by his brother Charles IV.
zh: 腓力五世（约1291—1322），绰号“高大者”，是腓力四世与纳瓦拉的胡安娜一世的次子。父亲将普瓦捷伯国封给他。1316年兄长路易十世去世后，他出任摄政；遗腹子约翰一世出生仅数日便夭折，腓力随即在兰斯加冕。三级会议裁定女性不得继承王位，他据此排除路易之女胡安娜的继承权，确立了萨利克法的先例。他推行改革，设立独立的审计法院，统一度量衡与货币。他也改善了与佛兰德的关系，那里曾在他父亲统治时期叛乱。1322年他死于痢疾，身后只有女儿，弟弟查理四世继位。

en: Peter of Clermont (1298–1341) was the youngest son of Robert, Count of Clermont, and a brother of Louis I, Duke of Bourbon. He became archdeacon of Tonnerre in 1307 and later archdeacon of Notre-Dame de Paris.
zh: 皮埃尔·德·克莱蒙（1298—1341）是克莱蒙伯爵罗贝尔的幼子、第一代波旁公爵路易一世的弟弟。他1307年成为托内尔执事长，后任巴黎圣母院执事长。

en: Peter I of Courtenay (c. 1126–1183) was the sixth son of King Louis VI and Adelaide of Maurienne. His father gave him the office of lay abbot of the collegiate church of Mantes. He joined his brother Louis VII on the Second Crusade in 1147, fighting at Laodicea and the siege of Damascus, and was the only brother to stay loyal during the revolt of 1149–1150. Around 1150 he married Elizabeth de Courtenay, heiress to the lordships of Courtenay and Montargis, founding the Capetian House of Courtenay. He took the cross again in 1179 with Henry I of Champagne, died in the Holy Land, and left a son who became Latin Emperor of Constantinople.
zh: 皮埃尔一世·德·库尔特奈（约1126—1183）是国王路易六世与莫里耶讷的阿德莱德的第六子。父亲授予他芒特协同教堂俗人院长的职位。1147年他随兄长路易七世参加第二次十字军东征，在老底嘉和大马士革围城战中作战；1149—1150年诸弟叛乱时，他是唯一忠于国王的兄弟。约1150年，他娶库尔特奈和蒙塔日领地的女继承人伊丽莎白·德·库尔特奈，开创了卡佩家族的库尔特奈支系。1179年他与香槟的亨利一世再次领取十字前往圣地并在那里去世，其子日后成为君士坦丁堡的拉丁皇帝。

en: Raoul de Coucy (died c. 1389) was a younger son of Guillaume I de Coucy and Isabelle de Châtillon. His father died in 1335, and Raoul held the lordships of Montmirail, La Ferté-Gaucher, Encre and Bailleul. He married Jeanne d'Harcourt, daughter of Jean, Count of Harcourt and Aumale. Their daughter Blanche carried Montmirail to her husband Hugues II, Count of Roucy, and a younger son, also named Raoul, became bishop of Metz and then of Noyon.
zh: 拉乌尔·德·库西（约1389年卒）是纪尧姆一世·德·库西与伊莎贝尔·德·沙蒂永较年幼的儿子。父亲于1335年去世，拉乌尔持有蒙米拉伊、拉费泰戈谢、昂克尔和巴约勒的领地。他娶阿库尔与欧马勒伯爵让之女让娜·德·阿库尔为妻。女儿布朗什将蒙米拉伊带给丈夫鲁西伯爵于格二世；一个较年幼的儿子也叫拉乌尔，先后出任梅斯主教和努瓦永主教。

en: Renaud II de Trie (c. 1260–1316), count of Dammartin and lord of Trie, was the son of Count John I of Dammartin and Yolande of Dreux. Like his father he served Philip IV in the Flemish wars: at the Battle of the Golden Spurs near Courtrai on 11 July 1302 his father was killed while Renaud escaped. At the victorious Battle of Mons-en-Pévèle on 18 August 1304 he killed William of Jülich to avenge his father; he was said to have beheaded William as he fled. By Philippa of Beaumont-en-Gâtinais he left two sons, Renaud III and John III, successive counts of Dammartin.
zh: 雷诺二世·德·特里（约1260—1316）是达马尔坦伯爵、特里领主，达马尔坦伯爵让一世与约朗德·德·德勒之子。他和父亲一样随腓力四世参加佛兰德战争：1302年7月11日科特赖克附近的金马刺战役中，父亲战死，他得以脱身。1304年8月18日，在获胜的蒙斯昂佩韦勒战役中，他杀死于利希的威廉，为父报仇；据传他在威廉逃跑时斩下了他的首级。他与博蒙昂加蒂奈的菲利帕生有雷诺三世和让三世二子，两人先后成为达马尔坦伯爵。

en: Renaud I de Trie, a younger son of Jean I de Trie and Alix of Dammartin, held Fontenay-en-Vexin and Vaumain. He founded the Fontenay branch of his house; his grandsons included Mathieu III, marshal of France, and Guillaume de Trie, archbishop of Reims.
zh: 雷诺一世·德·特里是让一世·德·特里与达马尔坦的阿莉克斯较年幼的儿子，领有丰特奈昂韦克桑和沃曼。他开创了特里家族的丰特奈支系，孙子中出了法兰西元帅马蒂厄三世和兰斯大主教纪尧姆·德·特里。

en: Renaud II de Trie, lord of Vaumain and Fontenay in the Vexin, was the son of Renaud de Trie and Jeanne de Houdenc. He fought in Flanders and was killed at Courtrai on 11 July 1302. His son Mathieu III became marshal of France.
zh: 雷诺二世·德·特里是韦克桑的沃曼与丰特奈领主，雷诺·德·特里与让娜·德·乌当之子。他赴佛兰德作战，1302年7月11日战死于科特赖克，其子马蒂厄三世后来成为法兰西元帅。

en: René Descartes (1596–1650) was a French philosopher and mathematician born at La Haye in Touraine and educated at La Flèche and Poitiers. While serving in the Dutch army at Breda, he met Isaac Beeckman, who encouraged his mathematical studies. After army service in the Netherlands and Germany, he settled in the Dutch Republic in 1628. His Discourse on the Method (1637), including his essay on geometry, linked algebra and geometry as analytic geometry and set out cogito, ergo sum, I think therefore I am. The Meditations followed in 1641 and the Principles of Philosophy in 1644. In 1649 Queen Christina summoned him to Sweden, where he died at Stockholm on 11 February 1650.
zh: 勒内·笛卡儿（1596—1650）是法国哲学家和数学家，生于图赖讷的拉海，曾在拉弗莱什和普瓦捷求学。在布雷达的荷兰军队服役时，他结识了鼓励他研究数学的伊萨克·贝克曼。在荷兰和德意志从军之后，他于1628年定居荷兰共和国。1637年出版的《谈谈方法》附有几何学等论文，把代数与几何贯通为解析几何，并提出了“我思故我在”的命题。此后他又于1641年发表《第一哲学沉思集》、1644年发表《哲学原理》。1649年他应克里斯蒂娜女王之邀前往瑞典，1650年2月11日在斯德哥尔摩去世。

en: Robert I (c. 860–923), younger son of Robert the Strong, ruled the county of Paris and the March of Neustria under his brother King Odo. He helped defend Paris against the Vikings in 885 and fought them on the Seine and the Loire for decades. In 898 he recognised the Carolingian Charles the Simple as king, who confirmed his offices and possessions. Robert defeated a Viking force in the Loire valley in 921. When Charles granted Chelles Abbey to his favourite in 922, Robert and the magnates revolted and crowned him at Reims on 29 June. On 15 June 923 Robert's army defeated Charles at Soissons, though Robert himself fell in the fighting. The nobles then elected his son-in-law Rudolph of Burgundy king.
zh: 罗贝尔一世（约860—923）是强者罗贝尔的幼子，在兄长厄德国王治下领有巴黎伯国与纽斯特里亚边疆。他于885年参与防守巴黎，抵抗维京人，数十年间又在塞纳河与卢瓦尔河流域抗击维京人。898年，他承认加洛林王朝的糊涂查理为王，查理确认了他的官职与领地。921年，罗贝尔在卢瓦尔河谷击败一支维京军队。922年查理把谢勒修道院赐给宠臣，罗贝尔遂与大贵族起兵反叛，于6月29日在兰斯拥立他加冕为王。923年6月15日，罗贝尔的军队在苏瓦松击败查理，他本人却在混战中阵亡。贵族随后推举他的女婿勃艮第的拉乌尔为王。

en: Robert of Artois (1326–after 1347) was the fourth son of Robert III of Artois and Joan of Valois, King Philip VI's sister. When his father was condemned for forged documents and fled to England in 1334, the royal government seized the children. Robert was held at Nemours in 1342, then transferred with his mother and brother James to Château Gaillard. He died in captivity after 1347, probably during the Black Death, leaving no descendants.
zh: 阿图瓦的罗贝尔（1326—1347年后）是罗贝尔三世·德·阿图瓦与法王腓力六世之妹瓦卢瓦的让娜的第四子。父亲因伪造文书获罪并于1334年逃亡英格兰后，王室拘押了他的子女。罗贝尔于1342年被囚于讷穆尔，随后与母亲和兄长雅克一同转押加亚尔堡。1347年之后他瘐死狱中，可能死于黑死病，无后嗣。

en: Robert II, called the Pious (c. 972–1031), the only son of Hugh Capet, was crowned co-king in 987 and ruled alone from 996 as the second Capetian king of the Franks. Educated by Gerbert of Aurillac, later Pope Sylvester II, he assisted his father in the sieges of Laon in 988 and 991. He put aside his first wife Rozala; his second marriage, to his kinswoman Bertha, ended after church opposition. As sole king he maintained alliances with Normandy and Anjou against the ambitions of Odo II of Blois. After a long war against Otto-William he secured the Duchy of Burgundy in 1005, and in 1022 he had heretics burned at Orléans, the first such execution recorded in medieval France. His last years were shaken by the revolts of his sons Henry and Robert from 1025.
zh: “虔诚者”罗贝尔二世（约972—1031）是于格·卡佩的独子，987年被加冕为共治国王，996年起亲政，是卡佩王朝第二位法兰克人之王。他师从后来成为教皇西尔维斯特二世的欧里亚克的热尔贝，988年与991年协助父亲围攻拉昂。他抛弃了第一任妻子罗萨拉；与亲属贝尔特的第二次婚姻则在教会反对后结束。独自统治后，他维持与诺曼底和安茹的联盟，遏制布卢瓦的厄德二世的野心。经过与奥托-威廉的长期战争，他于1005年取得勃艮第公国；1022年又在奥尔良下令火刑处死异端，这是中世纪法国见于记载的首例此类处决。1025年起，他的儿子亨利与罗贝尔起兵叛乱，动摇了他的晚年统治。

en: Robert de Foix was a younger son of Gaston I, Count of Foix, and Joan of Artois, and a brother of Count Gaston II. Destined for the Church, he became bishop of Lavaur in 1338 and held the Languedoc diocese until his death. His mother had been imprisoned by Gaston II at Foix in 1331, then moved to Orthez and Lourdes. In 1347 Robert secured her release, and she withdrew to Carbonne. He died the following year, in 1348.
zh: 罗贝尔·德·富瓦是富瓦伯爵加斯东一世与阿图瓦的让娜较年幼的儿子、伯爵加斯东二世的弟弟。他投身教会，1338年出任拉沃尔主教，治理这座朗格多克教区，直至去世。1331年，他的母亲被加斯东二世囚禁于富瓦，后来又被转移至奥尔泰兹和卢尔德。1347年，罗贝尔促成母亲获释，她随即退居卡博讷。他于次年，即1348年去世。

en: Roberte de Beaumetz (or Beaumez, born c. 1311) was the daughter of Gilles VI de Beaumetz and Ide d'Escaincourt. In 1328 she married Guy VII de Mauvoisin, baron of Rosny in the Île-de-France, by whom she had two daughters, Laure and Marguerite.
zh: 罗贝尔特·德·博梅斯（约1311年生）是吉勒六世·德·博梅斯与伊德·德埃斯坎库尔之女。1328年，她嫁给法兰西岛的罗尼男爵居伊七世·德·莫瓦桑，生有洛尔和玛格丽特两个女儿。

en: Maximilien de Robespierre (1758–1794) was a French lawyer from Arras and the most influential leader of the radical Jacobins. Elected to the Estates-General in 1789 and to the National Convention in 1792, he campaigned for voting rights for all men and opposed the Atlantic slave trade. He helped justify the execution of Louis XVI in January 1793. That July he joined the Committee of Public Safety, as France faced foreign enemies and revolts in its provinces. His call for revolutionary government backed by terror drove the Reign of Terror, in which thousands went to the guillotine. On 9 Thermidor (27 July 1794) the Convention turned against him; he was arrested and guillotined without trial the next day.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔
zh: 马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔（1758—1794）是法国阿拉斯的律师，也是激进雅各宾派最有影响力的领袖。他1789年入选三级会议、1792年入选国民公会，争取所有男性的选举权，并反对大西洋奴隶贸易。他参与推动了1793年1月处死路易十六。同年7月，法国外有敌军、各省发生叛乱之际，他加入公共安全委员会。他主张以恐怖手段支撑革命政府，推动了把数千人送上断头台的恐怖统治。1794年7月27日（热月9日），国民公会转而反对他，他被捕并于次日未经审判便被送上断头台。

en: Roger d'Armagnac (c. 1277–1339) was a churchman of the comital house of Armagnac: son of Count Géraud VI and Marthe of Béarn, and nephew of Archbishop Amanieu II of Auch. As archdeacon of Agen he was named by Pope John XXII in 1317 the first bishop of the newly created diocese of Lavaur. In 1319, after his brother Bernard VI, Count of Armagnac, died, the pope allowed Roger to act as guardian of Bernard's minor children John and Marthe. At Lavaur he gave land in 1328 to enlarge the canons' cloister, consecrated the cathedral's high altar in 1331, and in 1334 joined Notre-Dame de Péchaudier to the provostship. He was translated to Laon in 1336 and died in 1339.
zh: 罗歇·德·阿马尼亚克（约1277—1339）是阿马尼亚克伯爵家中走上教会道路的一员，为伯爵热罗六世与贝阿恩的玛尔特之子，欧什大主教阿马尼厄二世的外甥。1317年，教皇约翰二十二世任命时任阿让总执事的他为新设拉沃尔教区的首任主教。1319年，亡兄阿马尼亚克伯爵贝尔纳六世留下年幼的儿女让和玛尔特，教皇准许他出任两人的监护人。在拉沃尔，他于1328年提供地皮扩建教士回廊，1331年祝圣大教堂主祭坛，1334年将佩绍迪耶圣母院并入教长区。1336年他调任拉昂主教，1339年去世。

en: Roger I of Blois (died 24 June 1024) was royal chancellor and bishop of Beauvais, the city's first count-bishop. Probably the son of Archbishop Hugh of Blois of Bourges, he recovered the abbey of Coulombs after 986 and began its reform. He became chancellor to Hugh Capet and Robert the Pious in 988 and succeeded Hervé as bishop of Beauvais around 999. After 1007 he represented the count of Blois and Chartres at Dreux. In 1015 an agreement with Count Odo II of Blois restored to him part of the comital rights over Beauvais, which he then donated to the bishop's church, paving the way for the later prince-bishopric.
zh: 罗歇一世·德·布卢瓦（1024年6月24日卒）曾任法兰西王室御前秘书，后任博韦主教，是博韦第一位伯爵主教。他可能是布尔日大主教于格·德·布卢瓦之子，986年后收回库隆修道院并开始改革。988年他成为于格·卡佩与“虔诚者”罗贝尔的御前秘书，约999年继埃尔韦之后出任博韦主教。1007年后，他在德勒代表布卢瓦与沙特尔伯爵。1015年，他与布卢瓦伯爵厄德二世达成协议，收回博韦的部分伯爵权利，随即将这些权利赠予主教区教会，为日后的主教伯国铺平道路。

en: Rudolph (c. 890–936) was elected king of West Francia in 923, succeeding his father-in-law Robert I, and spent his reign defending the realm. In 925 Henry the Fowler of East Francia permanently annexed Lotharingia unopposed. From 924 Viking and Norman raiders ravaged the Loire valley and Burgundy; near Fauquembergues the Normans ambushed him, wounding the king, before he defeated Vikings in the Limousin. In 933 he granted the Channel Islands to William Longsword, count of Rouen, and in 935 his army drove invading Magyars from Burgundy without a battle. He died in January 936, leaving no sons.
zh: 拉乌尔（约890—936）于923年被推举为西法兰克国王，继承岳父罗贝尔一世的王位，在位期间始终忙于抵御外敌。925年，东法兰克国王捕鸟者亨利永久吞并洛泰尔尼亚，拉乌尔无力阻止。自924年起，维京人和诺曼人不断劫掠卢瓦尔河谷与勃艮第；诺曼人在福康贝格附近伏击并击伤了他，后来他在利穆赞击败维京人。933年，他把海峡群岛授予鲁昂伯爵长剑威廉；935年他率军迫使入侵勃艮第的马扎尔人不战而退。他于936年1月去世，没有留下儿子。

en: Simon of Thouars (1331–1365) was the second son of Louis I, Viscount of Thouars, and Jeanne II of Dreux, through whom he held the county of Dreux. In 1365 he married Jeanne of Artois, but on his wedding day, 12 July 1365, he was killed in a tournament and was buried in the chapel at Eu. After his death, Dreux was divided between his sisters Péronnelle and Marguerite, with a third reserved for Jeanne's dower; Péronnelle inherited Thouars when their father died in 1370.
zh: 西蒙·德图阿尔（1331—1365）是图阿尔子爵路易一世与德勒的让娜二世的次子，因母亲的关系领有德勒伯爵领。1365年他娶阿图瓦的让娜为妻，却在婚礼当天，即1365年7月12日的比武大会上身亡，葬于厄镇的礼拜堂。他死后，德勒由姐妹佩罗内尔与玛格丽特分承，三分之一留作让娜的寡妇产；1370年父亲去世后，佩罗内尔继承了图阿尔。

en: Yolanda of Lusignan (1257–1314), Countess of La Marche, was the eldest daughter of Hugh XII of Lusignan and Jeanne de Fougères. Her father died at Carthage in 1270 on the Eighth Crusade of Louis IX, and she inherited the Breton lordships of Fougères and Porhoët from her mother. In 1308 she succeeded her brother Guy as countess of La Marche and lady of Lusignan, after the male line of the house had died out. After her death Philip the Fair annexed the county to the crown. Her first husband was Élie Rudel, lord of Pons.
zh: 吕西尼昂的约朗德（1257—1314），世袭拉马什女伯爵，是吕西尼昂的于格十二世与让娜·德·富热尔的长女。1270年，她的父亲随路易九世参加第八次十字军东征，在迦太基病故；她又从母亲处继承了布列塔尼的富热尔与波尔奥埃领地。1308年，家族男性血脉断绝后，她继弟弟居伊成为拉马什女伯爵和吕西尼昂女领主。她死后，美男子腓力将拉马什并入王室领地。她的第一任丈夫是蓬斯领主埃利·吕德尔。

en: Francis Xavier (1506–1552) was a Navarrese cleric and one of the founders of the Society of Jesus. After the invasion of Navarre, his family's lands were confiscated and their castle damaged. He went to study in Paris in 1525, met Ignatius of Loyola there, and with him was one of the seven men who took vows at Montmartre in 1534. Sent east by the Portuguese crown, he reached Goa in 1542 and preached in India, Malacca and the Maluku Islands. Guided by the Kagoshima samurai Yajirō, he landed at Kagoshima on 15 August 1549, opening the first Christian mission in Japan; he won leave to preach from Shimazu Takahisa and Ōuchi Yoshitaka before departing in 1551. He died on Shangchuan Island off China in 1552 and was canonized in 1622.
zh: 方济各·沙勿略（1506—1552）是纳瓦拉的神职人员，耶稣会的创始人之一。纳瓦拉遭入侵后，他家的土地被没收，城堡也遭到破坏。1525年他赴巴黎求学，在那里结识依纳爵·罗耀拉，并于1534年与后者等七人在蒙马特立誓。他受葡萄牙王室派遣东行，1542年抵达果阿，先后在印度、马六甲和摩鹿加群岛传教。经鹿儿岛武士弥次郎引导，他于1549年8月15日在鹿儿岛登陆，开启了日本最早的基督教传教活动，并先后获得岛津贵久与大内义隆的传教许可，1551年离开日本。1552年，他在中国近海的上川岛病逝，1622年被追封为圣徒。

en: Franciscus Gomarus (1563–1641) was a strict Calvinist theologian, born at Bruges to parents who fled the Habsburg Netherlands for the Palatinate in 1578 to practise their Protestant faith freely. He studied at Strasbourg, graduated from Cambridge in 1584 and continued at Heidelberg. From 1587 he pastored a Dutch Reformed congregation in Frankfurt until persecution dispersed it in 1593. In 1594 he took the theology chair at Leiden, where after 1603 he led the opposition to Jacobus Arminius, defending unconditional predestination against the Remonstrants. At the Synod of Dort of 1618–1619 he was the foremost champion of orthodox Calvinism, and remained an active theologian until his death in 1641.
zh: 弗朗西斯库斯·戈马鲁斯（1563—1641）是严守加尔文派的神学家，生于布鲁日；他的父母于1578年为自由信奉新教逃离哈布斯堡尼德兰，迁居普法尔茨。他在斯特拉斯堡求学，1584年毕业于剑桥，随后赴海德堡深造。1587年起他在法兰克福任荷兰归正会牧师，直至1593年教众因迫害而离散。1594年他出任莱顿大学神学教授，1603年后成为阿民念的主要反对者，以无条件预定论对抗抗辩派。在1618至1619年的多德会议上，他是正统加尔文教义最主要的捍卫者，直至1641年去世前仍活跃于神学界。

en: François de Moulins de Rochefort (c. 1470–1526), born into Poitevin nobility, was the son of Jean de Moulins de Rochefort and Louise Jamin. He became a canon in 1500 and later abbot of Saint-Mesmin de Micy. He served as tutor and almoner to the young Francis of Angoulême, schooling the future Francis I in Renaissance learning, and around 1510 composed for Louise of Savoy an illuminated Treatise on the Cardinal Virtues. After Francis took the crown in 1515 he remained a royal councillor, and in 1519 was appointed grand almoner of France, holding that office until his death in 1526. From 1524 he was also commendatory prior of Saint-Magloire de Léhon.
zh: 弗朗索瓦·德·穆兰·德·罗什福尔（约1470—1526）出身普瓦图贵族，是让·德·穆兰·德·罗什福尔与路易丝·雅曼之子。他于1500年成为议事司铎，后任圣梅曼·德·米西修道院院长。他担任少年昂古莱姆的弗朗索瓦的教师兼施赈神父，以文艺复兴学问塑造了后来的弗朗索瓦一世；约1510年，他为萨伏依的路易丝撰写了带彩绘插图的《枢德论》。1515年弗朗索瓦即位后他继续担任国王顾问，1519年出任法兰西大施赈官，在任直至1526年去世。自1524年起，他还担任莱翁圣马格洛瓦尔修道院领俸修院长。

en: François Martin de Vitré (1575–1631) was a French apothecary and surgeon from Vitré in Brittany. Before his voyage he trained as an apothecary and attended courses at Montpellier's medical university. In May 1601 he sailed as surgeon aboard the Croissant, one of two ships equipped by merchants of Saint-Malo, Vitré and Laval for the East Indies. After her consort the Corbin was wrecked in the Maldives, the Croissant traded at Aceh in Sumatra and called at Surat in Gujarat. On the return voyage in 1603 she was intercepted by the Dutch and Martin was put ashore in England. At Henry IV's bidding he published at Rennes in 1604 the first French account of the East Indies.
zh: 弗朗索瓦·马丁·德·维特雷（1575—1631）是布列塔尼维特雷的法国药剂师兼外科医生。远航之前，他接受药剂师训练，并在蒙彼利埃医学院听课。1601年5月，他作为外科医生登上‘新月号’，与另一艘由圣马洛、维特雷和拉瓦勒商人装备的船一同驶往东印度。姊妹船‘科尔班号’在马尔代夫失事后，‘新月号’在苏门答腊的亚齐贸易，并停靠古吉拉特的苏拉特。1603年返航途中该船被荷兰人拦截，马丁被送上英格兰海岸。应亨利四世要求，他于1604年在雷恩出版了法国人撰写的第一部东印度行记。

en: Friedrich Schiller (1759–1805) was a German playwright, poet and historian born at Marbach in Württemberg. He entered a military academy in Stuttgart in 1773, studied medicine and wrote his first play, The Robbers, there. After graduating he briefly served as a regimental doctor. The play's Mannheim premiere caused a sensation, and after attending it without leave he fled Stuttgart in 1782, eventually settling near Weimar. In 1789 he became professor of history at the University of Jena. From 1794 his friendship with Goethe shaped Weimar Classicism; together they wrote the satirical poems Xenien. The Duke of Saxe-Weimar ennobled him in 1802. He died at Weimar in 1805, leaving dramas such as Wallenstein and William Tell.
zh: 弗里德里希·席勒（1759—1805）是生于符腾堡马尔巴赫的德国剧作家、诗人与历史学家。1773年，他进入斯图加特的一所军校，学习医学，并在那里写出第一部戏剧《强盗》。毕业后他曾短暂担任军医。该剧在曼海姆首演后轰动一时；他因擅自前往观剧，于1782年逃离斯图加特，最终定居魏玛附近。1789年，他出任耶拿大学历史学教授。1794年起，他与歌德的友谊塑造了魏玛古典主义，两人合写了讽刺诗集《克塞尼恩》。1802年，萨克森-魏玛公爵封他为贵族。1805年他在魏玛去世，留下《华伦斯坦》《威廉·退尔》等剧作。

en: Fidesmido II da Monteverde was a Fermo nobleman in the March of Ancona. His son, possibly illegitimate, was Mercenario da Monteverde, who seized Fermo in 1331 and ruled it as a tyrant until his murder in 1340.
zh: 菲德斯米多二世·达·蒙泰韦尔德是安科纳边区费尔莫的贵族。他的儿子梅尔切纳里奥·达·蒙泰韦尔德可能是私生子，于1331年夺取费尔莫，以暴君身份统治，1340年遇刺身亡。

en: Mercenario da Monteverde (c. 1275–1340) was a Ghibelline commander who became tyrant of Fermo, in a March of Ancona where the Avignon popes leaned on Guelph families such as the Mulucci of Macerata to hold the province. He began fighting in 1318, raiding towns around Macerata, and in 1323 defeated the Guelphs under Berardo II da Varano of Camerino at the battle of Osimo. In September 1328 he and the Ghibelline communes were party at Fermo to the preliminary peace terms with the papal rector. In 1331 he seized Fermo by a coup and ruled there for ten years, ignoring the repeated demands of Pope Benedict XII that he submit to the Church. In February 1340 conspirators set on him as he rode with seven companions and killed him; chroniclers remembered him as a wicked tyrant and enemy of the Church.
zh: 梅尔切纳里奥·达·蒙泰韦尔德（约1275—1340）是吉伯林派将领，后来成为费尔莫的暴君。当时的安科纳边区里，阿维尼翁的教宗倚重马切拉塔穆卢奇家族这样的圭尔夫派家族来维持全省。他于1318年开始征战，劫掠马切拉塔一带的城镇；1323年在奥西莫战役中击败卡梅里诺领主贝拉尔多二世·达·瓦拉诺率领的圭尔夫派。1328年9月，他与吉伯林派市镇一道在费尔莫参与了与教廷边区总督的初步和约。1331年，他发动政变夺取费尔莫，统治该城十年，对教皇本笃十二世要求他归顺教会的一再呼吁置之不理。1340年2月，他与七名同伴骑马出行时遭谋反者袭击身亡；编年史家称他为邪恶的暴君、教会之敌。

en: Rinaldo da Monteverde, called Rinalduccio (died 1380), was a condottiere and possibly the illegitimate son of the tyrant Mercenario da Monteverde. After his father's murder in 1340 he took refuge in Milan with the Visconti. In 1373 he returned to Fermo with the backing of Giovanni Visconti da Oleggio, and in December 1376 had himself proclaimed captain of the people. In 1377 he repeatedly attacked Sant'Elpidio, home of one of his father's killers. His despotic rule was hated, and in 1379 Fermo rose against him with help from the Varano of Camerino. He fled, hired three thousand men and besieged the city, but was repulsed. Shut up with his family in Montefalcone castle, he was seized by conspirators who tricked their way in on 31 May 1380. On 2 June he and his sons were beheaded in Fermo's main square. A column carved with the severed heads stood there until Lodovico Migliorati, lord of Fermo, removed it in 1419.
zh: 里纳尔多·达·蒙泰韦尔德，人称小里纳尔多（？—1380），是雇佣兵首领，可能是暴君梅尔切纳里奥·达·蒙泰韦尔德的非婚生子。1340年父亲遇刺后，他逃往米兰投靠维斯孔蒂家族。1373年，他借乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂·达·奥莱焦之力返回费尔莫，1376年12月让人拥立自己为人民长官。费尔莫人痛恨他的专制统治；1377年，他多次进攻圣埃尔皮迪奥，那里是刺杀其父的一名谋反者的故乡。1379年市民起事反抗，卡梅里诺的瓦拉诺家族也协助了起事者。他逃走后雇佣三千人围攻费尔莫，却遭击退。他与家人退守蒙泰法尔科内城堡，1380年5月31日被诈开城门的谋反者俘获。6月2日，他和儿子们在费尔莫的公共广场上被斩首。广场上随后立起一根刻着斩首头颅的石柱，直到1419年才被费尔莫领主洛多维科·米廖拉蒂撤去。

en: Risabella was the wife of Mercenario da Monteverde, the Ghibelline who made himself lord of Fermo in 1331 and ruled it as tyrant until his murder in 1340. By him she left a daughter, Mittarella, his heiress, who married Lodovico da Mogliano.
zh: 里莎贝拉是蒙泰韦尔迪的梅尔切纳里奥之妻：其夫是吉伯林派首领，1331年成为费尔莫僭主，施行暴政，直至1340年遇刺身亡。她为丈夫生下女儿兼继承人米塔雷拉，米塔雷拉后来嫁给莫利亚诺的洛多维科。

en: Joanna of Burgundy, called Jeanne de Montbéliard (c. 1292–1349), was the eldest daughter of Reginald of Burgundy, Count of Montbéliard, and Guillemette of Neufchâtel. Around 1303 she married Ulrich III, Count of Ferrette, by whom she had two daughters, Joanna and Ursula. Widowed in 1324, she quickly betrothed Joanna to Albert II of Austria, carrying the County of Ferrette to the Habsburgs. She later married Rudolf Hesso of Baden-Baden and then William of Katzenelnbogen. Inheriting Belfort and Héricourt, she founded a collegiate church in 1342 and a hospice in 1349, and was remembered as the Good Lady of Belfort.
zh: 勃艮第的让娜（一称蒙贝利亚尔的让娜，约1292—1349）是蒙贝利亚尔伯爵勃艮第的雷诺与讷沙泰勒的吉耶梅特的长女。约1303年她嫁给费雷特伯爵乌尔里希三世，生有让娜和乌尔苏拉两女。1324年守寡后，她很快将女儿让娜许配给奥地利的阿尔布雷希特二世，费雷特伯国由此转入哈布斯堡家族。此后她又改嫁巴登-巴登藩侯鲁道夫·赫索，再嫁卡岑埃尔恩博根的威廉。她继承了贝尔福和埃里库尔，1342年创立参事会教堂，1349年创办济贫院，被称为“贝尔福的好夫人”。

en: Joanna of Pfirt (c. 1300–1351) was heiress of Count Ulrich III of Pfirt. When her father died in March 1324, she inherited his Sundgau lands. Leopold of Austria sent his brother Albert to ask her mother for Joanna's hand; by the treaty of Thann she ceded her lands to the Habsburgs, giving them a contiguous territory in southern Alsace, and on 26 March married Albert II. She became Duchess of Austria in 1330, the year polyarthritis began to cripple her husband. Travel pained him, so he sent her on diplomatic missions; in 1336 she mediated peace between the Habsburgs and the House of Luxembourg over the Carinthian inheritance. After years without a child and a pilgrimage her husband made in 1337, she bore Rudolf IV in 1339, aged thirty-nine. Six of her children survived, among them Leopold III, whose birth in 1351 cost her life. She was buried in the Gaming charterhouse that her husband had founded.
zh: 费雷特的约翰娜（约1300—1351）是费雷特伯爵乌尔里希三世的女继承人。1324年3月父亲去世后，她继承了桑德戈领地。奥地利的利奥波德派弟弟阿尔布雷希特向她的母亲求婚；依照《塔恩条约》，她把领地让与哈布斯堡家族，使其在南阿尔萨斯获得连片土地，并于3月26日嫁给阿尔布雷希特二世。1330年她成为奥地利公爵夫人，也正是这一年，多发性关节炎开始使她的丈夫行动不便。他出行痛苦，便派她出使，1336年她为哈布斯堡家族与卢森堡家族调解克恩滕遗产争端，促成和约。多年没有孩子，公爵又在1337年外出朝圣；1339年，三十九岁的她生下鲁道夫四世。她的子女中有六人存活，包括利奥波德三世，1351年生下他后不久，她便去世。她葬在丈夫创建的加明卡尔特会修道院教堂。

en: Theobald I of Ferrette (c. 1250 – 1310/11) ruled the County of Pfirt, or Ferrette, in Upper Alsace from 1275. A younger son of Count Ulrich II, he inherited because the sons of his elder brothers were still underage. He attended the imperial diet of Augsburg in 1275, allied with the bishops of Basel and backed King Adolf of Nassau, who named him imperial advocate in Alsace against Albert of Austria; after Adolf's defeat his position grew difficult. By Katharina von Klingen he left a son, Ulrich III, who succeeded him on his death between December 1310 and February 1311.
zh: 费雷特的蒂博（约1250—1310/1311）自1275年起统治上阿尔萨斯的普菲尔特（费雷特）伯国。他是乌尔里希二世伯爵的幼子，因两位兄长之子尚未成年而继承伯国。1275年，他出席奥格斯堡帝国议会，与巴塞尔主教结盟，并支持罗马人民的国王拿骚的阿道夫；阿道夫任命他为阿尔萨斯的帝国福格特，与奥地利的阿尔布雷希特对抗。阿道夫战败后，他的处境日益艰难。他与卡塔琳娜·冯·克林根生子乌尔里希三世；1310年12月至1311年2月间他去世，乌尔里希三世继位。

en: Ulrich III of Ferrette (c. 1280 – 11 March 1324) succeeded his father Theobald as Count of Pfirt in 1311. Married to Joan of Montbéliard, he broke with his family's earlier policy and backed the Habsburg Frederick the Fair against Louis of Bavaria in the imperial succession: Frederick made him provincial advocate of Alsace in 1315 and enfeoffed him with Delle in 1320. He also served King Philip V of France. Dying without a son in 1324, he left his county to his daughters; his widow wed the eldest, Joanna, to Albert II of Austria, and Pfirt passed to the Habsburgs.
zh: 费雷特的乌尔里希三世（约1280—1324年3月11日）于1311年继其父蒂博成为普菲尔特伯爵。他娶蒙贝利亚尔的让娜为妻，一改家族此前的立场，在帝位之争中支持哈布斯堡的美男子腓特烈、反对巴伐利亚的路易：1315年腓特烈任命他为阿尔萨斯的地方福格特，1320年又将德勒封给他。他还效力于法兰西国王腓力五世。1324年他去世，没有儿子，伯国由女儿们继承；其遗孀将长女约翰娜嫁给奥地利的阿尔布雷希特二世，普菲尔特伯国由此并入哈布斯堡家族。

en: Alix de La Tour du Pin (c. 1278–1309) was a daughter of Humbert I, Dauphin of Viennois. In 1296 she married John I, Count of Forez, bringing him the Viennois lands of Forez as her dowry. Her son Guigues VII succeeded as count.
zh: 阿莉克斯·德·拉图尔迪潘，又称阿莉克斯·德·维埃努瓦（约1278—1309），是维埃努瓦王太子安贝尔一世之女。1296年她嫁给福雷伯爵让一世，将福雷的维埃努瓦领地作为嫁妆带入夫家，其子居伊七世后来继位为伯爵。

en: Guigues I of Forez (died after 1137) was the first count of Forez and Lyon from the House of Albon, the son of Guigues-Raymond d'Albon and Ide of Forez, through whom he inherited the county in 1107. Around 1134 he married Sibylle, lady of Beaujeu, daughter of Lord Guichard III of Beaujeu. In 1137 he donated to Cluny Abbey for his parents' souls; he died after 1137, and his son Guigues II succeeded him.
zh: 吉格一世·德·福雷（1137年之后去世）是阿尔邦家族出掌福雷与里昂的第一位伯爵，吉格-雷蒙·德·阿尔邦与福雷的伊德之子，1107年经母系继承福雷伯国。约1134年，他娶博若莱女领主西比勒，即博若莱领主吉沙尔三世之女。1137年，他为父母的灵魂向克吕尼修道院捐赠；他在1137年之后去世，子吉格二世继位。

en: Guigues II of Forez (1130–1206) was the son of Count Guigues I and Sibylle de Beaujeu. His father entrusted him to King Louis VII, who raised him at court, and he succeeded as count of Lyon and Forez in 1138. During his rule disputes arose between Forez and the lords of Beaujeu over their lands. Frederick Barbarossa's Golden Bull stripped him of his rights over Lyon, and he quarrelled with Archbishop Héracle de Montboissier; restored in 1167 with the backing of Louis VII and Pope Alexander III and the election of Guichard of Pontigny, he ceded his Lyonnais lands in 1173. He married Guillelmine, abdicated in favour of their son Guigues III in 1198, and died on 6 December 1206.
zh: 吉格二世·德·福雷（1130—1206）是伯爵吉格一世与西比勒·德·博若莱之子。父亲把他托付给法王路易七世，他在宫廷中长大，1138年继位为里昂与福雷伯爵。他统治期间，福雷与博若莱领主就双方土地发生争端。腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的金玺诏书剥夺了他对里昂的权利，他因此与里昂大主教埃拉克尔·德·蒙布瓦西耶发生争执；1167年在路易七世和教皇亚历山大三世支持以及蓬蒂尼的吉沙尔当选后，他恢复权利，最终于1173年让出里昂内的领地。他娶吉耶尔米娜为妻，1198年退位传子吉格三世，1206年12月6日去世。

en: Guigues III of Forez (1160–1203), nicknamed Branda, was count of Forez from 1199, when his father Guigues II retired to the abbey of La Bénisson-Dieu. His short reign was spent fighting the lords of Beaujeu, who had designs on Forez. In 1202 he took the cross for the Fourth Crusade, but instead of following the main army to Constantinople he sailed from Marseille with Walter, bishop of Autun, and three hundred knights and sergeants straight for the Holy Land. He reached Acre early in 1203 and died shortly afterwards, and was buried in the Hospitallers' church of Saint John.
zh: 吉格三世·德·福雷（1160—1203），绰号布兰达，1199年因父亲吉格二世退隐贝尼松迪厄修道院而成为福雷伯爵。他在位时间不长，一直同觊觎福雷的博若莱领主作战。1202年，他宣誓参加第四次十字军东征，但没有随主力前往君士坦丁堡，而是与欧坦主教戈蒂埃率领三百名骑士和军士从马赛登船，直航圣地。1203年初他抵达阿卡，不久便在阿卡去世，葬于医院骑士团的圣约翰教堂。

en: Guigues IV of Forez (c. 1199–1241) inherited the county as a child in 1203, when his father Guigues III died on the Fourth Crusade; his uncle Renaud, archbishop of Lyon, acted as regent until 1218. He granted Montbrison a communal charter in 1223 and founded the collegiate church of Notre-Dame-d'Espérance there in 1224. His marriage in 1226 to Matilda of Courtenay, countess of Nevers, made him count of Nevers. He joined the Barons' Crusade in 1239, helped build a fortress at Ascalon, and died at Castellaneta in Italy on his way home, on 29 October 1241.
zh: 吉格四世·德·福雷（约1199—1241）在1203年父亲吉格三世死于第四次十字军东征时幼年继位，由叔父里昂大主教勒诺摄政至1218年。1223年他授予蒙布里松城市特许状，1224年在当地创立希望圣母协同教堂。1226年他与讷韦尔女伯爵库特奈的玛蒂尔达成婚，由此成为讷韦尔伯爵。1239年他参加男爵十字军，曾参与在阿斯卡隆修筑要塞，归国途中于1241年10月29日在意大利的卡斯特拉内塔去世。

en: Guigues-Raymond d'Albon was a younger son of Count Guigues II of Albon and Agnes of Barcelona. He married Ide of Forez, heiress to the county of Forez; their son Guigues I inherited Forez and founded the Albon line of its counts.
zh: 吉格-雷蒙·德·阿尔邦是阿尔邦伯爵吉格二世与巴塞罗那的阿格尼丝较年幼的儿子。他娶福雷伯国的女继承人福雷的伊德为妻；其子吉格一世继承福雷，开创了阿尔邦家族的福雷伯爵世系。

en: Guigues V (died 12 September 1259) was count of Forez from 1241, the elder son of Count Guigues IV and Matilda of Courtenay. Succeeding while still a boy, he faced the claims of his uncle William, lord of Baffie, until a treaty of 1244 confirmed him in possession of the county. He married Alix de Chacenay, daughter of Erard II of Chacenay, but the marriage produced no children. On his death the county passed to his younger brother, Renaud I.
zh: 维戈五世（1259年9月12日卒）自1241年起担任福雷伯爵，是伯爵维戈四世与库特奈的玛蒂尔达的长子。他幼年继位，叔父巴菲领主纪尧姆与他争夺伯国，直到1244年双方签订条约，才确认他对福雷的统治。他娶沙瑟奈的埃拉尔二世之女阿莉克斯为妻，二人没有子嗣。他去世后，伯国由弟弟勒诺一世继承。

en: Guigues VI of Forez (died 1278) was the eldest son of Count Renaud I and Isabelle of Beaujeu. His father became lord of Beaujeu in 1265, but faced rival claims to the inheritance. In 1268 Guigues married Joan of Montfort, daughter of Philip of Montfort, count of Castres. The following year King Louis IX recognized the rights of Isabelle and her children to Beaujeu. Guigues succeeded his father as count of Forez in 1270 and claimed Beaujeu through his mother, but ceded it to his younger brother Louis. He died in 1278 leaving a minor heir, John I, who ruled under the regency of Joan of Montfort.
zh: 吉格六世·德·福雷（1278年卒）是福雷伯爵勒诺一世与博若莱的伊莎贝尔的长子。他的父亲于1265年成为博若莱领主，但继承权受到他人争议。1268年，吉格娶卡斯特尔伯爵菲利普·德·蒙福尔之女蒙福尔的让娜。次年，国王路易九世承认伊莎贝尔及其子女对博若莱的权利。1270年吉格继父为福雷伯爵，并凭母系主张博若莱领地，后来将其让给弟弟路易。他于1278年去世，继承人让一世年幼，由蒙福尔的让娜摄政。

en: Guigues VII (c. 1299–1358), from a cadet branch of the house of Albon and a grandson of Humbert I of Viennois through his mother, became count of Forez in 1333 and kept up his father John I's administrative reforms as the Hundred Years' War began. He stayed loyal to Philip VI of Valois against Edward III in the Flemish campaigns of 1338–1340, and the king's trust brought command of royal armies in the Midi from 1345 to 1349 and the post of lieutenant-general for Touraine, Anjou, Maine, Aunis and Saintonge. In 1349, after France bought the province, he did homage to the Dauphin for his mother's Viennois fiefs; in 1351 the pope gave him the Golden Rose. In 1357, after the Black Prince's raids, he led 400 lances against Robert Knolles's English to help the hard-pressed Béraud II of Auvergne. He died in 1358, and the pillaging reached the heart of Forez; his eldest son Louis I succeeded.
zh: 维戈七世（约1299—1358）出自阿尔邦家族的一支旁系，外祖父是维埃努瓦的安贝尔一世。1333年他继父亲让一世任福雷伯爵，延续其行政改革，而百年战争的最初动荡也在此时到来。1338至1340年的佛兰德战役中，他始终效忠瓦卢瓦的腓力六世，对抗英格兰的爱德华三世；凭着国王的信任，他于1345至1349年统率王家军队在法兰西南部作战，并出任国王在都兰、安茹、曼恩、奥尼斯和圣通日一带的代理官。1349年法国购得维埃努瓦后，他就母亲一方继承的采邑向法兰西王太子宣誓效忠；1351年获教皇颁赐金玫瑰。1357年，在黑太子劫掠之后，他亲率400枪骑兵对抗罗伯特·诺尔斯统领的英军，援助陷入困境的奥弗涅的贝罗二世。他于1358年去世，劫掠随即蔓延到福雷腹地，长子路易一世继位。

en: John I (c. 1275 – 3 July 1333) was count of Forez from 1278, succeeding his father Guigues VI under the regency of his mother, Joan of Montfort. In 1296 he married Alix de la Tour-du-Pin. He also served Philip IV at the siege of Lille. He helped bring Lyon under the French crown through the treaty of Vienne in 1312, backed Philip of Poitiers's regency in 1316, and organised the Lyon conclave that elected Pope John XXII. From 1317 he sat on the royal council and established a chambre des comptes at Montbrison. The Diana heraldic hall there may have been built under his authority. His son Guigues VII succeeded him.
zh: 让一世（约1275—1333年7月3日）自1278年起任福雷伯爵，父亲维戈六世去世后由母亲蒙福尔的让娜摄政。1296年，他迎娶阿莉克斯·德·拉图尔迪潘。他还在里尔围城战中为腓力四世效力。1312年，他推动签订《维埃纳条约》，使里昂并入法兰西王室；1316年他支持普瓦捷的腓力出任摄政，并在里昂组织了选出教皇约翰二十二世的秘密会议。自1317年起他位列国王会议，还在蒙布里松设立审计院。当地的迪亚娜纹章厅可能是在他的主持下兴建的。死后由儿子维戈七世继位。

en: Jeanne de Bourbon (1312–1402), daughter of Louis I, Duke of Bourbon, and Mary of Avesnes, married Guigues VII, Count of Forez. She was the mother of Counts Louis I and John II of Forez.
zh: 让娜·德·波旁（1312—1402）是波旁公爵路易一世与阿韦讷的玛丽之女，嫁给福雷伯爵吉格七世，是福雷伯爵路易一世、让二世的母亲。

en: Margaret of Savoy-Achaea (1303 – after 1371) was the only daughter of Philip I of Piedmont, Prince of Achaea, and Isabella of Villehardouin. Betrothed at five to a son of Philip I of Taranto, she married Renaud d'Albon of Forez in 1324.
zh: 萨伏依-亚该亚的玛格丽特（1303年2月—1371年后）是皮埃蒙特领主、亚该亚亲王菲利波一世与维尔阿杜安的伊莎贝拉唯一的女儿。她5岁时许配给塔兰托的菲利波一世之子，1324年嫁给福雷伯爵之子雷诺·达尔邦。

en: Renaud d'Albon, who died in 1370, was a younger son of John I, Count of Forez, and brother of Count Guigues VII. In 1324 he married Margaret of Savoy-Achaea, daughter of Philip I of Piedmont.
zh: 雷诺·达尔邦（1370年卒）是福雷伯爵让一世的幼子、伯爵吉格七世的弟弟。1324年，他娶皮埃蒙特领主菲利波一世之女、萨伏依-亚该亚的玛格丽特为妻。

en: Renaud I (1226–1270) was count of Forez from about 1260, succeeding his childless elder brother Guigues V. He was the younger son of Count Guigues IV and Matilda of Courtenay. In 1247 he married Isabelle of Beaujeu, daughter of Humbert V of Beaujeu and widow of Simon II of Semur, whose dower brought him the lands of Saint-Bonnet, Pouilly and Luzy. After Guichard V of Beaujeu died in 1265 he claimed Beaujeu in his wife's name. Foulques of Montgascon and Aymard of Poitiers contested the succession, which was settled only in 1269, when King Louis IX recognised Isabelle's rights. His eldest son, Guigues VI, succeeded him in Forez; another son, Louis, inherited Beaujeu.
zh: 勒诺一世（1226—1270）约在1260年继无嗣的兄长维戈五世之后成为福雷伯爵，是维戈四世与库特奈的玛蒂尔达的小儿子。1247年，他迎娶博若莱的安贝尔五世之女、瑟米尔的西蒙二世的遗孀伊莎贝尔，随嫁妆获得圣博内、普伊和吕济三处领地。1265年吉沙尔五世去世后，他以妻子的名义主张博若莱领主之位。蒙加斯孔的富尔克与普瓦捷的艾马尔提出异议，直到1269年法王路易九世才承认伊莎贝尔的权利。他死后由长子维戈六世继承福雷，另一子路易继承博若莱。

en: John Visconti (c. 1229 – May 1275) was judge of Gallura from 1238. The son of Ubaldo I Visconti of Cagliari, he inherited Gallura under his cousin Ubaldo II's will of 1237 and recovered it from Ubaldo's widow Adelasia and her second husband Enzo of Hohenstaufen. In 1254 he joined Pisa against the judge of Cagliari, and when that giudicato was partitioned in 1258 he annexed a third, including Ogliastra and Sarrabus. He later fought in the Guelph-Ghibelline wars and returned to Sardinia in 1274. The next year Pisa expelled him for joining the Guelphs, and he joined forces with Lucca and Florence to take Montopoli castle. He died at San Miniato in 1275, and his son Nino succeeded him.
zh: 乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂（约1229—1275年5月）自1238年起任加卢拉审判官。他是卡利亚里的乌巴尔多一世·维斯孔蒂之子，依堂兄乌巴尔多二世1237年的遗嘱继承加卢拉，并从乌巴尔多的遗孀阿德拉西娅及其第二任丈夫霍亨斯陶芬的恩佐手中夺回领地。1254年，他随比萨进攻卡利亚里审判官；1258年比萨瓜分该审判官国后，他吞并了其中三分之一的土地，包括奥利亚斯特拉和萨拉布斯。后来他投身圭尔夫派与吉伯林派的战争，1274年返回撒丁岛。次年，他因加入圭尔夫派而被比萨驱逐，随后联合卢卡和佛罗伦萨攻占蒙托波利城堡。1275年他在圣米尼亚托去世，儿子尼诺继位。

en: Lamberto Visconti (died 1225) was a Pisan nobleman of the Visconti family and the first of his dynasty to rule in Sardinia. Elena, heiress of the giudicato of Gallura and last of the Lacon-Gunale, chose him as her husband despite Pope Innocent III, her overlord, having planned another match. In 1209 he and his Pisan allies drove out Comita III of Torres, who had invaded Gallura and occupied Civita. In 1215 he landed an army at Cagliari, fortified the hill overlooking the city and left his brother Ubaldo to conquer the rest. After Elena died in 1218 he ruled Gallura alone. In 1220 he married Benedetta of Cagliari; he died in 1225 and his son Ubaldo II succeeded him.
zh: 兰贝托·维斯孔蒂（1225年卒）出身比萨贵族维斯孔蒂家族，是该家族第一个在撒丁岛取得统治的人物，领有加卢拉审判官国。加卢拉女继承人、拉孔-古纳莱家族最后的成员埃莱娜不顾宗主教皇英诺森三世安排的婚事，自行选他为夫。1209年，托雷斯的科米塔三世入侵加卢拉、占领奇维塔，他联合比萨盟友将其逐出。1215年，他率军在卡利亚里登陆，加固俯瞰城池的山丘，并让兄弟乌巴尔多征服其余领土。1218年埃莱娜去世后，他独自统治加卢拉。1220年，他迎娶卡利亚里的贝内黛塔；1225年他去世，儿子乌巴尔多二世继位。

en: Ugolino Visconti, known as Nino (c. 1265 – August 1296), was judge of Gallura from 1275, succeeding his father John. Exiled with his father in 1274, he returned to Pisa after the peace of Rinonico. A leader of Pisa's Guelph party, he served the city as capitano del popolo and podestà, but in 1288 his grandfather Count Ugolino della Gherardesca and Archbishop Ruggieri degli Ubaldini turned against him; Ruggieri drove him into exile and seized his giudicato. Nino fought back with Genoa, Lucca and Florence. He married Beatrice d'Este, and his daughter Joanna inherited Gallura. His friend Dante places him in Purgatorio.
zh: 乌戈利诺·维斯孔蒂，人称尼诺（约1265—1296年8月），1275年继父亲乔瓦尼之后成为加卢拉审判官。1274年，他随父亲流亡，里诺尼科和约后返回比萨。他是比萨圭尔夫派的领袖，曾任比萨的人民领袖和行政长官；1288年，他的外祖父、多诺拉蒂科伯爵乌戈利诺·德拉盖拉尔代斯卡与大主教鲁杰里·德利乌巴尔迪尼联手对付他，鲁杰里将他流放并夺取了他的审判官国。尼诺联合热那亚、卢卡和佛罗伦萨反击。他娶埃斯特的贝阿特丽切为妻，女儿乔万娜后来继承了加卢拉。他的友人但丁在《神曲·炼狱篇》中写到了他。

en: Ubaldo I Visconti (died 1230) was a Pisan nobleman, son of the patrician Eldizio Visconti and brother of Lamberto. About 1200 he supported Judge William I Salusio IV of Cagliari against Comita III of Logudoro on Pisa's orders. In 1213 he helped defeat an anti-Visconti coalition near the river Frigido. In 1214 he and Lamberto attacked Cagliari and Arborea, and in 1215 their forces seized the hill overlooking Cagliari, the future Castel di Castro; by 1217 Ubaldo had forced the judge Benedetta to cede her giudicato and hold it as Pisa's vassal. In 1220 he arranged Lamberto's marriage to the widowed Benedetta and governed Cagliari on his brother's behalf. He died in 1230; his son John later inherited Gallura.
zh: 乌巴尔多一世·维斯孔蒂（1230年卒）是比萨贵族，城市长老埃尔迪齐奥·维斯孔蒂之子、兰贝托的兄弟。约1200年，他奉比萨共和国之命支援卡利亚里审判官古列尔莫一世·萨卢西奥四世，对抗洛古多罗的科米塔三世。1213年，他在弗里吉多河附近协助击败反维斯孔蒂联盟。1214年，他与兰贝托进攻卡利亚里和阿尔博雷亚；1215年，比萨军队攻占俯瞰卡利亚里的山丘，即后来的卡斯特罗堡，到1217年他已迫使女审判官贝内黛塔割让审判官国，再以比萨封臣的身份领回。1220年，他促成兰贝托与守寡的贝内黛塔成婚，并代表兄弟治理卡利亚里。他于1230年去世，儿子乔瓦尼后来继承了加卢拉。

en: Ubaldo II (1207–1238) was judge of Gallura from 1225, the son of Lamberto Visconti and Elena of Gallura, last heiress of the Lacon-Gunale. In 1219, when both were twelve, he married Adelasia of Torres at the basilica of Saccargia under a Pisan alliance that Pope Honorius III tried in vain to annul. On his uncle Ubaldo I's death in 1230 he seized Cagliari to keep it under Pisan influence. In 1236 his influence helped secure Adelasia's election as judge of Torres, which he ruled as her consort. In 1237 he declined to acknowledge papal overlordship of Gallura. He died of fever at Siligo in 1238, leaving Gallura by will to his cousin John Visconti.
zh: 乌巴尔多二世（1207—1238）自1225年起任加卢拉审判官，是兰贝托·维斯孔蒂与加卢拉女审判官、拉孔-古纳莱家族最后的埃莱娜之子。1219年，年仅十二岁的他与托雷斯的阿德拉西娅在萨卡尔贾大殿成婚，这桩服务于比萨结盟的婚事遭到教皇洪诺留三世阻挠，却未能被废除。1230年叔父乌巴尔多一世去世后，他进占卡利亚里，以维持比萨在当地的影响。1236年，他的影响力促成阿德拉西娅当选托雷斯审判官，他也以其夫君的身份统治当地。1237年，他拒绝承认教廷对加卢拉的宗主权。1238年，他在锡利戈因热病去世，遗嘱将加卢拉传给堂弟乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂。

en: Galileo Galilei (1564–1642) was an Italian astronomer, physicist and mathematician, born in Pisa. He taught mathematics at Pisa from 1589 and at the University of Padua from 1592. In 1609 he built a telescope, demonstrated it to the Venetian senate and turned it to the sky. In Sidereus Nuncius in 1610 he published his observations of lunar mountains and four moons of Jupiter; he later observed the phases of Venus. He also studied motion and falling bodies. His defence of Copernicus in the Dialogue Concerning the Two Chief World Systems in 1632 led to an Inquisition trial in 1633; he was forced to recant and lived under house arrest, writing Two New Sciences in 1638. He died at Arcetri in 1642.
zh: 伽利略·伽利莱（1564—1642）是意大利天文学家、物理学家和数学家，生于比萨。他1589年起在比萨教授数学，1592年转往帕多瓦大学任教。1609年，他自制望远镜，向威尼斯元老院演示后将其指向天空。1610年他在《星际信使》中发表了对月球山脉和木星四颗卫星的观测，后来又观察到金星的盈亏。他还研究了运动和落体。1632年他在《两大世界体系的对话》中为哥白尼学说辩护，1633年遭宗教裁判所审判，被迫放弃主张，余生遭到软禁，其间于1638年写成《关于两门新科学的对话》。1642年他在阿切特里去世。

en: Gammala (1263–1302), eldest son of Crown Prince Zhenjin and grandson of Kublai Khan, was raised at court by Empress Chabi. As a young prince he guarded the northern border, where rebel princes submitted on his approach and envoys of Duwa and Chapar sued for peace. In 1290 Kublai made him Prince of Liang and sent him to govern Yunnan; in 1292 he became Prince of Jin in Mongolia, commanding Genghis Khan's four ordos and the Mongol homeland. His son Yesün Temür later took the throne and in 1324 honoured him posthumously as Emperor Xianzong.
zh: 甘麻剌（1263—1302）是太子真金的长子、元世祖忽必烈之孙，自幼由祖母察必皇后养在宫中。他出镇帝国北境，叛王岳木忽儿等闻其到来便望风请降，笃哇、察八儿等诸王也遣使求和，边境得以安宁。1290年，忽必烈封他为梁王，派他出镇云南；1292年改封晋王，移镇漠北，统领成吉思汗四大斡耳朵与蒙古本土。其子也孙铁木儿后来登基为泰定帝，1324年追尊他为显宗皇帝。

en: Alī Mubārak, who ruled as Alauddin Ali Shah (c. 1290–1342), was an independent sultan of Lakhnauti in Bengal. After serving Malik Firuz in Delhi, he fell out of favour and moved east, becoming army minister to Qadar Khan, the Tughluq governor of Lakhnauti. When Qadar Khan died in 1339, Ali killed his deputy and seized the province, taking the title Alauddin Ali Shah. He fought a triangular war with Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah of Sonargaon and Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah of Satgaon, and moved his capital to Pandua. In 1342 Ilyas Shah defeated and killed him and took Lakhnauti.
zh: 阿拉丁·阿里·沙（约1290—1342），原名阿里·穆巴拉克，是孟加拉拉克瑙蒂的独立苏丹。他早年在德里效力于马利克·菲鲁兹，失势后东赴孟加拉，担任拉克瑙蒂总督卡达尔汗的军政长官。1339年卡达尔汗死后，他杀死副督夺取拉克瑙蒂，自立为阿拉丁·阿里·沙。此后他与索纳尔冈的法赫尔丁·穆巴拉克·沙、萨特冈的沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯沙三足鼎立、连年交战，并将都城迁往潘杜阿。1342年，伊利亚斯沙击败并杀死他，夺取了拉克瑙蒂。

en: Qadar Khan, originally Malik Pindar Khilji, was appointed governor of Lakhnauti by Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq around 1328. In 1338 he marched against the rebel Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah and seized Sonargaon, but was killed when his army fell out over the spoils.
zh: 卡达尔汗原名马利克·平达尔·卡尔吉，约1328年被苏丹穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克任命为拉克瑙蒂总督。1338年，他出兵讨伐反叛的法赫尔丁·穆巴拉克·沙并攻占索纳尔冈，却在所部因分赃内讧时被杀。

en: Gaykhatu (c. 1259 – 21 March 1295) was the fifth Ilkhan of Persia and a son of Abaqa, governing Anatolia under his brother Arghun before his election as Ilkhan at Ahlat in July 1291. A Buddhist with the Tibetan name Rinchendorje, he was generous to Christians. In 1294 his vizier Sad al-Din Zanjani persuaded him to issue Chinese-style paper money, or chao; merchants refused the notes, bazaars shut and trade collapsed, forcing him to withdraw the experiment. In March 1295 his cousin Baydu rose in revolt and Gaykhatu was captured and strangled with a bowstring on 21 March.
zh: 海合都（约1259—1295年3月21日）是伊儿汗国第五代君主、阿八哈之子，在兄长阿鲁浑在位时总督安纳托利亚，1291年7月于阿赫拉特被推举为伊儿汗。他信奉佛教，取藏名仁钦多吉，对基督教徒也十分慷慨。1294年，在宰相撒都丁·赞贾尼建议下，他仿效元朝发行纸钞交钞，却因商民拒用、市集停闭、贸易瘫痪而被迫废止。1295年3月，堂兄弟拜都起兵反叛，海合都被俘，于3月21日被弓弦勒死。

en: Adelaide of Everstein, who died after 1373, was the daughter of Count Herman II of Everstein and Adelaide of Lippe. In 1335 or 1336 she married Ernest I of Brunswick-Grubenhagen; her nine children included the princes Albert I and Frederick.
zh: 埃弗施泰因的阿德莱德（1373年后卒）是埃弗施泰因伯爵赫尔曼二世与利珀的阿德莱德之女，1335或1336年嫁给不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根亲王恩斯特一世，生下阿尔布雷希特一世、弗里德里希等九个子女。

en: Agnes of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (c. 1318–1371 or earlier) was a daughter of Duke Henry II of Brunswick-Grubenhagen and Jutta of Brandenburg. She married Duke Barnim III of Pomerania-Stettin and was the mother of dukes Casimir III, Swantibor III and Bogislaw VII.
zh: 阿格内丝（约1318—1371年或以前）是不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根公爵海因里希二世与勃兰登堡的尤塔之女，嫁给波美拉尼亚-斯德丁公爵巴尔尼姆三世，是卡齐米日三世、斯万提波三世和博吉斯瓦夫七世三位公爵之母。

en: Agnes of Meissen (c. 1264–after 1332) was the daughter of Albert II, Margrave of Meissen, by Margaret of Sicily, herself a daughter of Emperor Frederick II. In 1282 she married Henry I the Marvelous, Duke of Brunswick-Grubenhagen, and bore him sixteen children. Her daughter Adelaide married Henry of Bohemia, while another daughter, Adelheid, took the name Irene and married the Byzantine emperor Andronikos III Palaiologos. Her sons Henry II, Ernest, William and John each ruled in Grubenhagen. She died after September 1332.
zh: 迈森的阿格妮丝（约1264—1332年后）是迈森藩侯阿尔布雷希特二世与西西里的玛格丽特之女，其母是皇帝腓特烈二世的女儿。1282年，她嫁给不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根公爵、号称“奇才”的亨利一世，为他生育了十六个子女。女儿阿德莱德嫁给波希米亚国王亨利，另一女儿阿德尔海德改名伊琳娜，嫁给拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡三世·巴列奥略。她的儿子亨利二世、恩斯特、威廉和约翰先后在格鲁本哈根执政。她于1332年9月之后去世。

en: Albert I, called the Tall (1236–15 August 1279), was the eldest son of Otto the Child, first Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg, and Matilda of Brandenburg, succeeding his father in 1252. In 1260–1261 his troops fought the Danes in Schleswig for Queen Margaret Sambiria of Denmark, and in 1263 he intervened in the Thuringian Succession War in support of his mother-in-law Sophie of Brabant. In 1269 he divided the Welf lands with his brother John, keeping the south around Brunswick and Wolfenbüttel. When John died in 1277, Albert became guardian of his young nephew Otto. During the Great Interregnum he backed Ottokar II of Bohemia, defeated at the Marchfeld in 1278. Albert died in 1279 and was buried in Brunswick Cathedral.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特一世，绰号“高个子”（1236—1279年8月15日），是首任不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵“孩童”奥托与勃兰登堡的玛蒂尔德之长子，1252年继父位。1260—1261年，他应丹麦的玛格丽特·桑比里亚女王之请出兵，在石勒苏益格与丹麦人交战；1263年又介入图林根继承战争，支持岳母布拉班特的索菲的诉求。1269年，他与弟弟约翰瓜分韦尔夫家族领地，领有不伦瑞克和沃尔芬比特尔一带的南部土地。约翰于1277年去世后，阿尔布雷希特成为年幼侄子奥托的监护人。大空位时代，他支持波希米亚国王奥托卡二世，后者于1278年在马希费尔德战败。阿尔布雷希特于1279年去世，葬于不伦瑞克大教堂。

en: Adelaide, called Alessia (c. 1242–1285), was a daughter of Boniface II, Marquess of Montferrat, and Margaret of Savoy. About 1263 she became the second wife of Albert I, Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg. Her sons Henry, Albert and William succeeded their father, and Luther became Grand Master of the Teutonic Knights in 1331. Widowed in 1279, she married Count Gerhard I of Holstein-Itzehoe and died in February 1285.
zh: 阿德莱德，又称阿莱西娅（约1242—1285），是蒙费拉托侯爵波尼法乔二世与萨伏依的玛格丽特之女。约1263年，她成为不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵阿尔布雷希特一世的第二任妻子。她的儿子亨利、阿尔布雷希特和威廉继承了父亲的地位，卢特则于1331年出任条顿骑士团大团长。1279年守寡后，她改嫁荷尔斯泰因-伊策霍伯爵格哈德一世，于1285年2月去世。

en: Balthazar of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (c. 1336 – 1384 or 1385) was a son of Duke Henry II and his second wife Helvis of Ibelin, daughter of the Seneschal of Cyprus. Following his brothers into the Latin East, he went to the Morea and briefly bore the title Despot of Romania, bound up with the Angevin claims in Albania and southern Greece. He married Giacobella Caetani of the baronial Caetani family of Fondi in the Kingdom of Naples. He died after 14 January 1384.
zh: 不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的巴尔塔扎尔（约1336—1384/1385年）是格鲁本哈根公爵海因里希二世与第二任妻子、塞浦路斯总管之女伊贝林的海尔维丝之子。他追随诸兄弟前往拉丁东方，在摩里亚短期保有“罗马尼亚专制君主”头衔，该头衔与安茹家族在阿尔巴尼亚和希腊南部的领地主张相连。他娶了那不勒斯王国丰迪卡埃塔尼男爵家族的雅各贝拉。他于1384年1月14日之后去世。

en: Ernest I of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (c. 1297 – 9 March 1361) was a younger son of Duke Henry I the Admirable, who founded the small principality of Grubenhagen in 1291 and left eight sons and eight daughters to provide for. Ernest was destined for the Church, but after his father died in 1322 he ruled jointly with his brothers Henry II and William. A pact of 1324 soon gave way to partition: Ernest received the area around Einbeck, Grubenhagen Castle and Osterode, while Einbeck, Osterode and Duderstadt stayed under joint rule. Henry II withdrew from power in 1342 and died in 1351; his sons stayed abroad and died without heirs. When William died childless in 1360, Ernest ruled the whole principality. He had made his son Albert I co-regent in 1359, and when he died on 9 March 1361 Albert succeeded him.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/恩斯特一世_(布倫瑞克-格魯本哈根)
zh: 不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的恩斯特一世（约1297—1361年3月9日）是公爵海因里希一世（“令人敬仰者”）的幼子之一。海因里希一世在1291年建立了格鲁本哈根这个小侯国，却留下八个儿子和八个女儿要安置。恩斯特原本准备走教会道路，1322年父亲去世后，他与兄弟海因里希二世、威廉共同统治。1324年的协议很快变为分家：恩斯特分得艾恩贝克、格鲁本哈根城堡和奥斯特罗德周边地区，艾恩贝克、奥斯特罗德和杜德施塔特仍由兄弟共同统治。海因里希二世于1342年退出权力，1351年去世，他的儿子留在国外，没有留下后代。弟弟威廉1360年无嗣去世后，恩斯特统治了整个侯国。他在1359年立儿子阿尔布雷希特一世为共治者，1361年3月9日去世后，阿尔布雷希特继位。

en: Henry I, called the Admirable (August 1267 – 7 September 1322), was a Welf duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg and the first ruler of the principality of Grubenhagen. The eldest son of Duke Albert the Tall and Adelaide of Montferrat, he first governed Wolfenbüttel with his brothers until they divided the inheritance in 1291, when Henry received Grubenhagen, with Einbeck, Osterode and Duderstadt, and made Einbeck his residence. He quarrelled with his brother Albert over lands around Brunswick and Wolfenbüttel, but Albert prevailed and Henry withdrew to Grubenhagen. In 1320 the emperor named him Count Palatine of Saxony. He married Agnes of Meissen in 1282, and on his death his sons divided Grubenhagen among themselves.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/海因里希一世_(布倫瑞克-格魯本哈根)
zh: 海因里希一世，绰号“可敬者”（1267年8月—1322年9月7日），是韦尔夫家族的不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵，也是格鲁本哈根侯国的第一位统治者。他是高个子公爵阿尔布雷希特与蒙费拉托的阿德莱德的长子，起初与兄弟共同治理沃尔芬比特尔；1291年瓜分遗产时，他分得格鲁本哈根，领有艾恩贝克、奥斯特罗德和杜德施塔特等地，并以艾恩贝克为驻地。他与弟弟阿尔布雷希特争夺不伦瑞克和沃尔芬比特尔附近的领地，失利后退居格鲁本哈根。1320年，皇帝封他为萨克森行宫伯爵。他于1282年娶迈森的阿格尼丝为妻，死后几个儿子瓜分了格鲁本哈根。

en: Henry II of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (before 1296 – after 1351), called de Graecia, “of Greece”, was the eldest son of Duke Henry I and Agnes of Meissen. Grubenhagen, a small principality founded in 1291, could not support Henry I's eight sons and eight daughters. After their father died in 1322 the brothers agreed to rule jointly but divided the government, and Henry was left with little, chiefly administering their common property. In 1327 he joined Emperor Louis IV on his coronation journey to Rome, travelled on to Constantinople, where his brother-in-law Andronikos III received him, and made a pilgrimage to Jerusalem. On Cyprus he met his second wife, Heloise of Ibelin, and he came home in 1331 laden with relics. He withdrew from rule in 1342 for an annuity, handing his share of Hameln, Einbeck and Osterode to the Archbishop of Mainz. He died at Grubenhagen Castle; his son Otto became the last husband of Joanna I of Naples.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/海因里希二世_(布倫瑞克-格魯本哈根)
zh: 不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的海因里希二世（1296年前—1351年后），人称“希腊人”，是公爵海因里希一世与迈森的阿格尼丝的长子。格鲁本哈根是1291年建立的小侯国，养不起海因里希一世的八个儿子和八个女儿。1322年父亲去世后，兄弟几人约定共同统治，但随后分割了治权，海因里希所得无几，主要是管理兄弟的共有财产。1327年，他随皇帝路易四世前往罗马参加加冕，继续前往君士坦丁堡，姻兄弟安德洛尼卡三世接待了他，他又去耶路撒冷朝圣。他在塞浦路斯结识第二任妻子伊贝林的埃洛伊丝，1331年携圣物归国。1342年他放弃统治，换取一笔年金，把自己在哈梅林、艾恩贝克和奥斯特罗德的份额交给美因茨大主教。他死于格鲁本哈根城堡；儿子奥托后来成为那不勒斯女王乔万娜一世的最后一任丈夫。

en: Helvis of Ibelin (died 1347), daughter of Philip of Ibelin, Seneschal of Cyprus, married Henry II, Duke of Brunswick-Grubenhagen, in 1330. Her sons included Philip, Constable of Jerusalem, and Balthazar, Despot of Romania.
zh: 伊贝林的海尔维丝（1347年卒）是塞浦路斯总管菲利普·德·伊贝林之女，1330年嫁给不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根公爵海因里希二世。她的儿子包括耶路撒冷统帅菲利普和罗马尼亚专制君主巴尔塔扎尔。

en: John of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (c. 1321 – after 4 December 1346) was a son of Duke Henry II of Brunswick-Grubenhagen and Jutta of Brandenburg. He became a canon of Halberstadt Cathedral.
zh: 不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的约翰（约1321—1346年12月4日后）是不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根公爵海因里希二世与勃兰登堡的尤塔之子，曾任哈尔伯施塔特主教座堂法政牧师。

en: John I of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (c. 1304 – 23 May 1367) was a younger son of Duke Henry I the Miraculous and Agnes of Meissen. Destined for the church, he was to be admitted to the Mainz cathedral chapter on the pope's instructions to the bishop of Osnabrück in 1320, and on 17 June 1325 surrendered his inheritance to his brothers Henry II, Ernest I and William for a pension of thirty marks a year. He held church dignities at Hildesheim, Osnabrück and Münster, was cathedral provost of Halberstadt from 1341, and served as provost of St. Alexandri in Einbeck, where he died and was buried in 1367.
zh: 不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的约翰一世（约1304—1367年5月23日）是公爵海因里希一世（绰号“怪人”）与迈森的阿格妮丝的幼子。他投身教会，1320年教宗命奥斯纳布吕克主教将他接纳入美因茨主教座堂参事会；1325年6月17日，他以每年30马克的年金为条件，把应继家产让给兄长海因里希二世、恩斯特一世和威廉。他先后在希尔德斯海姆、奥斯纳布吕克和明斯特担任神职，1341年起任哈尔伯施塔特主教座堂教长，并担任艾恩贝克圣亚历山德里修院教长，1367年在艾恩贝克去世安葬。

en: Jutta of Brandenburg (born before 1302, died before 1330) was an Ascanian princess, daughter of Margrave Henry I of Brandenburg-Stendal and the first wife of Henry II, Duke of Brunswick-Grubenhagen. Her children included Otto, husband of Queen Joanna I of Naples.
zh: 尤塔·冯·勃兰登堡（1302年前生，1330年前卒）是勃兰登堡-施滕达尔藩侯亨利一世之女，不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根公爵亨利二世的第一任妻子，生子奥托，后娶那不勒斯女王乔万娜一世。

en: Louis of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (born c. 1323) was a son of Duke Henry II of Brunswick-Grubenhagen and his first wife Jutta of Brandenburg. He entered the church and served as a canon of Cammin in Pomerania. He died around 1373.
zh: 不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的路德维希（约1323年生）是格鲁本哈根公爵海因里希二世与首任妻子勃兰登堡的尤塔之子。他进入教会，在波美拉尼亚的卡缅担任法政牧师，约于1373年去世。

en: Otto of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (born 1337) was the eldest son of Prince Ernest I of Grubenhagen and Adelaide of Everstein. He died young, and the principality later passed to his younger brother Albert I.
zh: 不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的奥托（1337年生）是格鲁本哈根亲王恩斯特一世与埃弗施泰因的阿德莱德的长子，幼年夭折，侯国后来由其弟阿尔布雷希特一世继承。

en: Otto of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (c. 1320–1399), called the Tarantine, was the eldest son of Duke Henry II and Jutta of Brandenburg. With little to inherit, he became a bold condottiere, fighting in 1339 for John of Montferrat at Asti. His marriage to Violante of Vilaragut, widow of James III of Majorca, made him the richest member of his poor house. In 1376 he married Queen Joanna I of Naples, her fourth husband, and became Prince of Taranto and Count of Acerra, though not king. The couple backed the Avignon pope Clement VII in the Western Schism, and when Charles of Durazzo took Naples in 1381, Otto was captured trying to free the queen; she was strangled in prison in 1382. Freed in 1384, he won Naples back for Louis II of Anjou in 1387, but, passed over for captain-general, joined the Durazzo side. He died at Foggia in 1399, having rarely seen Grubenhagen again.
zh: 不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的奥托（约1320—1399），人称“塔兰托人”，是公爵海因里希二世与勃兰登堡的尤塔的长子。家里能继承的东西太少，他成了一名大胆的雇佣兵队长，1339年为蒙费拉托的乔瓦尼在阿斯蒂作战。他娶马略卡国王海梅三世的遗孀维拉古特的维奥兰特，由此成为这个贫穷家族中最富有的人。1376年，他与那不勒斯女王乔万娜一世结婚，这是女王的第四任丈夫；他没有得到王位，却成为塔兰托亲王和阿切拉伯爵。西方教会大分裂中，夫妇二人支持阿维尼翁教皇克雷芒七世。1381年杜拉佐的查理攻占那不勒斯，奥托试图营救女王时被俘，乔万娜于1382年在狱中被勒死。奥托1384年获释，1387年为安茹的路易二世夺回那不勒斯，却因没被任命为王国总司令，转投杜拉佐一方。他于1399年卒于福贾，此后几乎再没见过格鲁本哈根。

en: Philip of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (c. 1332 – 1369/70) was a younger son of Duke Henry II, called de Graecia, and his Cypriot wife Helvis of Ibelin. He made his career in the Latin East like his brothers and became Constable of Jerusalem. By his first wife Helisia de Dampierre he had a daughter Helvis, who married King James I of Cyprus, and a son John, later Admiral of Cyprus. His second marriage to Alix of Ibelin, widow of King Hugh IV of Cyprus, required a papal dispensation. He died on 4 August 1369 or 1370.
zh: 不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的菲利普（约1332—1369/1370年）是绰号“希腊人”的格鲁本哈根公爵海因里希二世与塞浦路斯妻子伊贝林的海尔维丝所生之子。他和诸兄弟一样在拉丁东方谋生，官至耶路撒冷统帅。他与首任妻子埃利萨·德·当皮埃尔生女海尔维丝，后嫁塞浦路斯国王雅克一世；生子约翰，后任塞浦路斯舰队司令。他续娶塞浦路斯国王于格四世的遗孀伊贝林的爱丽丝，这场婚姻需教皇特准。他于1369或1370年8月4日去世。

en: Riddag of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (c. 1334 – c. 1366) was a son of Duke Henry II of Brunswick-Grubenhagen and Helvis of Ibelin.
zh: 不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的里达格（约1334—约1366年）是格鲁本哈根公爵海因里希二世与伊贝林的海尔维丝之子。

en: William of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (c. 1298–1360) was the third son of Henry I the Miraculous and Agnes of Meissen. When his father died in 1322, he took rule of the small Principality of Grubenhagen jointly with his brothers Henry II and Ernest I. A 1324 pact kept the towns of Einbeck, Osterode and Duderstadt under common rule, but the brothers soon divided the rest of the territory. William reigned until his death in 1360, and because he left no children his brother Ernest I united the whole principality under his hand.
zh: 不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的威廉（约1298—1360）是海因里希一世（绰号“怪人”）与迈森的阿格妮丝的第三子。1322年父亲去世后，他与兄长海因里希二世、恩斯特一世共同统治狭小的格鲁本哈根亲王国。1324年兄弟三人达成共治协议，艾恩贝克、奥斯特罗德、杜德施塔特三城维持共管，其余领土却很快被瓜分。威廉统治到1360年去世为止；他没有子嗣，整个亲王国遂归恩斯特一世一人统治。

en: Adam Smith (1723–1790) was a Scottish economist and philosopher of the Scottish Enlightenment, born at Kirkcaldy. After studying at Glasgow and Oxford, he lectured in Edinburgh and worked with David Hume; from 1752 he held the chair of moral philosophy at Glasgow. The Theory of Moral Sentiments appeared in 1759. As tutor to the Duke of Buccleuch he travelled in France and met Voltaire and the physiocrat Quesnay. In 1776 he published The Wealth of Nations, expounding the division of labour, free markets and competition, and founding modern economics. Against policies protecting national merchants by restricting imports, he argued that self-interest and competition could contribute to prosperity. He died in Edinburgh in 1790.
zh: 亚当·斯密（1723—1790）是苏格兰启蒙运动时期的经济学家、哲学家，生于柯科迪。他先后在格拉斯哥大学和牛津大学求学，后在爱丁堡讲学，与大卫·休谟合作，1752年起任格拉斯哥大学道德哲学教授，1759年出版《道德情操论》。后来他担任巴克卢公爵的导师，游历法国，结识伏尔泰和重农学派学者魁奈。1776年，他出版《国富论》，阐述分工、自由市场与竞争，奠定了现代经济学的基础。他反对通过限制进口保护本国商人的政策，认为个人利益与竞争能够促进繁荣。1790年他在爱丁堡去世。

en: Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Makki (c. 1300 – 1364 or 1365) was the Amazigh ruler of Gabès, head of the Banu Makki dynasty under Hafsid overlordship. When Genoese raiders seized Tripoli in 1354 and demanded fifty thousand gold mithqals for its release, Ahmad negotiated its liberation and paid the ransom himself, aided by the people of Gabès and the Djerid, after Sultan Abu Inan sent no help.
