zh: 吉奥尔基二世（约1050—1112）是巴格拉季奥尼王朝的格鲁吉亚国王，1072年继承父亲巴格拉特四世的王位。1070年他已崭露头角，率领格鲁吉亚—阿兰联军在占贾附近击败沙达德王朝埃米尔法德尔二世。他在位时饱受塞尔柱人的进攻和国内问题困扰。1088年大地震后，他于1089年在贵族逼迫下退位，让位于十六岁的儿子大卫四世（建造者），此后仅为名义上的共治者，直至去世。

en: George III (died 1184), younger son of Demetrius I, ruled Georgia from 1156. He campaigned aggressively against Armenia's Muslim rulers: he seized Ani in 1161, defeated a Shah-Armen coalition and captured the king of Erzerum, and sacked Dvin in 1162. Defeated by an Eldiguzid coalition in 1163, he gave Ani back to the Shaddadids before reoccupying it in 1174. In 1177 he crushed a noble revolt led by Ivane Orbeli in favour of his nephew Demna, who was blinded and died in prison. In 1178 he crowned his daughter Tamar co-ruler; she succeeded him in 1184.
zh: 吉奥尔基三世（？—1184）是德米特里一世的幼子，1156年起统治格鲁吉亚。他对亚美尼亚的穆斯林统治者大举用兵：1161年夺取阿尼，击败沙赫—阿尔门联盟并俘获埃尔祖鲁姆的统治者，1162年洗劫德温。1163年他被埃尔德古兹联盟击败，将阿尼归还沙达德王朝，又于1174年重新占领。1177年，他镇压了伊万涅·奥尔贝利为首、企图拥立其侄德姆纳的贵族叛乱，德姆纳被弄瞎后死于狱中。1178年他立女儿塔玛尔为共治君主，塔玛尔于1184年继位。

en: George IV, called Lasha Giorgi (1191–1223), son of Tamar the Great and David Soslan, was made co-ruler in 1207 and ruled Georgia from 1213. He reasserted suzerainty over Ganja after its atabeg withheld tribute, and in 1219 forced Erzurum, Nakhchivan and Ahlat to pay. His plans to join the Fifth Crusade ended when the first Mongol incursion into the Caucasus routed the Georgians twice in 1221–1222 and wounded him. He died of the wound at Bagavan in Armenia in January 1223, aged thirty-one, while arranging his sister Rusudan's marriage to the Shah of Shirvan. Rusudan succeeded him; his son by a commoner ruled as David VII.
zh: 吉奥尔基四世，人称“拉沙·吉奥尔基”（1191—1223），是塔玛尔大王与大卫·索斯兰之子，1207年被立为共治君主，1213年起统治格鲁吉亚。占贾的阿塔贝格停纳贡赋后，他出兵重新确立了格鲁吉亚的宗主权；1219年又迫使埃尔祖鲁姆、纳希切万和阿赫拉特纳贡。他本计划参加第五次十字军东征，但1221—1222年，首次侵入高加索的蒙古军队两度击溃格军，他本人也身负重伤。1223年1月，他在亚美尼亚的巴加万为妹妹鲁苏丹安排与希尔万沙的婚事时因伤重去世，年三十一岁。鲁苏丹随后继位；他与平民女子所生的儿子后来成为大卫七世。

en: George V the Brilliant (c. 1286–1346) of the Bagrationi dynasty was the king who set about putting Georgia back together as the Ilkhanate declined. The Ilkhan Ghazan installed him in 1299 against his rebel brother David VIII, but his authority reached little beyond Tbilisi, earning him the name Shadow King of Tbilisi; in 1302 his brother Vakhtang III replaced him. He returned as regent for his nephew George VI, was crowned in 1318, and ruled as ally of the Ilkhan Abu Sa'id and his minister Chupan. Chupan's execution in 1327 gave him his opening: he stopped paying tribute, expelled the Mongol troops, brought Imereti and the western nobles under his crown, and in 1334 peacefully drew Samtskhe back. He issued two law codes between 1325 and 1338 and won back Georgian monasteries in Palestine from the Mamluks. To Philip VI of France he offered thirty thousand soldiers for a crusade. He died in 1346; his son David IX succeeded him.
zh: 辉煌者吉尔奥尔基五世（约1286—1346）出身巴格拉季昂尼王朝，是在伊儿汗国走向衰落之际着手重新整合格鲁吉亚的国王。1299年，伊儿汗合赞扶他上台，对抗反叛的兄长大卫八世，但他的权力几乎出不了第比利斯，人称“第比利斯的影子国王”；1302年，他被兄长瓦赫唐三世取代。后来他为侄儿吉尔奥尔基六世摄政，1318年加冕，作为伊儿汗不赛因及其重臣出班的盟友统治国家。1327年出班被处死，给了他机会：他停止纳贡、驱逐蒙古军队，使伊梅列季和西部贵族臣服于王冠，1334年又和平地收回萨姆茨赫。1325至1338年间他颁布两部法典，并从马穆鲁克人手中要回了格鲁吉亚人在巴勒斯坦的修道院。他还向法王腓力六世表示，愿为十字军出兵三万。他于1346年去世，其子大卫九世继位。

en: George VI, called the Little (1303/1304–1318), was a son of David VIII. After the death of Vakhtang III in 1308, the Ilkhan Öljaitü made the boy king of eastern Georgia and appointed his uncle, the future George V, as regent. When David VIII died in 1311, two kings coexisted until Öljaitü confirmed George VI; the Mongols enthroned him again in 1314 to shore up his authority. His reign remained nominal, overshadowed by Mongol-backed rival and provincial kings. He died while still a child in 1318.
zh: 乔治六世，绰号“年幼者”（1303/1304—1318），是大卫八世之子。1308年瓦赫坦三世去世后，伊利汗完者都将这个孩童立为东格鲁吉亚国王，任命其叔父、后来的乔治五世摄政。1311年大卫八世去世后两王并立，最终由完者都确认乔治六世的地位；1314年蒙古人再次为他加冕以巩固王权。在蒙古扶持的并立国王与地方王公环伺之下，他的统治始终有名无实，1318年幼年去世。

en: Giovanni da Firenze was an Italian Dominican friar appointed bishop of Tiflis, in Georgia, on 7 February 1330. Pope John XXII had erected the Latin diocese in the Georgian capital in August 1329, and the missionary see was suppressed in 1356.
zh: 乔瓦尼·达·菲伦泽是意大利多明我会修士，1330年2月7日被任命为格鲁吉亚梯弗里斯主教。教皇约翰二十二世于1329年8月在格鲁吉亚都城设立这一拉丁教区，这个传教教区于1356年被撤销。

en: Mirian III (c. 258/277–361) founded the Chosroid dynasty and ruled Iberia, or Kartli, in Georgia. As a Sasanian Persian vassal he fought in Shah Narseh's war against Rome in 297–298, but after Persia's defeat he drew his kingdom toward Rome. Through the preaching of Nino, a Cappadocian woman, Mirian became the first Christian king of Iberia and around 337 made Christianity the kingdom's state religion. In 360 the Roman emperor Constantius sent him costly gifts to secure his allegiance against Iran. The Georgian Orthodox Church venerates him as Saint Equal to the Apostles.
zh: 米利安三世（约258/277—361）是格鲁吉亚伊比利亚（卡尔特利）科斯罗埃斯王朝的开国君主。作为萨珊波斯附庸，他曾参加297—298年沙纳尔塞斯对罗马的战争；波斯战败后，他使王国转而亲近罗马。在卡帕多细亚女子尼诺的传道下，米利安成为伊比利亚第一位信奉基督教的国王，并于约337年将基督教立为国教。360年，罗马皇帝君士坦提乌斯向他赠送厚礼，争取他在对抗伊朗时效忠罗马。格鲁吉亚正教会尊他为“使徒同等者”圣徒。

en: She was the queen of King George V the Brilliant of Georgia and mother of his successor David IX. Her name is unknown; the Georgian Chronicles call her a daughter of a Greek Komnenian emperor, but her parentage remains uncertain.
zh: 她是格鲁吉亚国王“辉煌者”吉奥尔基五世的王后、继位者大卫九世的母亲。她的姓名不详；《格鲁吉亚编年史》称她是希腊科穆宁皇族一位皇帝的女儿，但其出身仍无法确定。

en: Rusudan (1194–1245), daughter of Queen Tamar and David Soslan, succeeded her brother George IV as queen of Georgia in 1223. In 1225 the Khwarazmshah Jalal al-Din Mangburni, fleeing the Mongols, defeated the Georgians at Garni and sacked Tbilisi in 1226, killing more than a hundred thousand inhabitants. Her alliance with the Seljuks of Rum ended in rout at Bolnisi in 1228. As the Mongols overran Georgia from 1235, Rusudan submitted in 1239, accepting an annual tribute of fifty thousand gold pieces and military obligations. She died in 1245, waiting for her son David to return from the Mongol court.
zh: 鲁速丹（1194—1245）是塔马尔女王与达维特·索斯兰之女，1223年继其兄乔治四世之后成为格鲁吉亚女王。1225年，被蒙古人追击而西逃的花剌子模沙札兰丁·明布尔努在加尔尼击败格鲁吉亚军队，又于1226年洗劫第比利斯，逾十万居民遇难。她与罗姆塞尔柱人结盟，却在1228年的博尔尼西之战中溃败。1235年起蒙古人席卷格鲁吉亚，鲁速丹于1239年臣服，承诺每年缴纳五万金币贡金并承担军役。1245年，她在等待儿子大卫从蒙古宫廷返回时去世。

en: Saint Nino (c. 280–c. 332) was a Cappadocian woman who brought Christianity to Iberia, also known as Kartli. Fleeing Diocletian's persecution, she alone of her company escaped death in Armenia and reached Kartli. Tradition holds that the Virgin Mary appeared to her and gave her a grapevine cross, sending her to preach. Nino healed and converted Queen Nana, then King Mirian III, after which Christianity became Iberia's state religion. She died at Bodbe in Kakheti, and the grapevine cross became the symbol of Georgian Christianity.
zh: 圣尼诺（约280—约332）是把基督教传入伊比利亚，也就是卡尔特利的卡帕多细亚女子。为逃避戴克里先的迫害，她同行的人在亚美尼亚悉数殉道，只有她一人逃到卡尔特利。相传圣母向她显现，赠予葡萄藤十字架，命她前去传教。尼诺行神迹治愈并归化了娜娜王后，又使国王米利安三世皈依，基督教由此成为伊比利亚国教。她在卡赫季的博德贝去世，葡萄藤十字架也成为格鲁吉亚基督教的标志。

en: Sindukhtar Jaqeli was the queen of David IX of Georgia and the mother of Bagrat V the Great and of Gulkhan-Eudokia, wife of the Trapezuntine emperor Manuel III. She was a princess of the Jaqeli dynasty of Samtskhe.
zh: 辛杜克塔尔·贾克利是格鲁吉亚国王大卫九世的王后，“大帝”巴格拉特五世与古尔历汉-尤多琪亚之母，后者嫁给了特拉比松皇帝曼努埃尔三世。她出身萨姆茨赫的贾克利王朝。

en: Tamar the Great (c. 1160–1213), daughter of George III, was Georgia's first ruling queen, styled mepe, or king, from 1184. She overcame aristocratic opposition, divorced Yury Bogolyubsky of Vladimir, and in 1191 married the Alan prince David Soslan, her leading general. Their armies defeated the Eldiguzids at Shamkor in 1195 and the Seljuk sultan of Rum at Basian around 1202, and helped found the Empire of Trebizond in 1204. Her reign was the peak of the Georgian Golden Age, her empire spanning the Black Sea to the Caspian, when Shota Rustaveli composed The Knight in the Panther's Skin.
zh: 塔玛尔大王（约1160—1213）是吉奥尔基三世之女，格鲁吉亚第一位以本人名义执政的女性，1184年起以“梅佩”（意为国王）的尊号统治。她压服贵族反对势力，与弗拉基米尔的尤里·博戈柳布斯基离婚，又于1191年嫁给自己的主要将领、阿兰王公大卫·索斯兰。格军1195年在沙姆科尔击败埃尔德古兹王朝，约1202年在巴西安击溃鲁姆的塞尔柱苏丹；1204年格鲁吉亚军队还助建特拉比松帝国。她在位时是格鲁吉亚黄金时代的顶峰，帝国横跨黑海至里海，绍塔·鲁斯塔韦利也在这一时期创作了《虎皮武士》。

en: Vakhtang II (died 1292), son of David VI Narin of western Georgia, was placed on the throne of eastern Georgia by the Ilkhan Arghun in 1289, after the execution of Demetrius II, to unite both Georgian realms under Mongol rule. Arghun gave him his sister Oljath in marriage. Crowned at Tbilisi, Vakhtang ruled firmly and twice defeated the intrigues of his atabeg Khutlubuga, who backed Demetrius's son David; the new Ilkhan Gaykhatu supported him too. He died in 1292 after a reign of barely three years and was buried at Gelati, whereupon David succeeded him and married his widow.
zh: 瓦赫坦二世（？—1292）是西格鲁吉亚国王大卫六世·纳林之子。1289年德米特里二世被处死后，伊利汗阿鲁浑为使两个格鲁吉亚王国同受蒙古统治，将他立为东格鲁吉亚国王，并把其妹奥勒贾特嫁给他。瓦赫坦在第比利斯加冕，治国强硬，两次挫败阿塔贝格胡特卢布加扶持德米特里之子大卫的图谋，新伊利汗海合都也对他加以庇护。他在位仅三年，于1292年早逝，葬于格拉特修道院。大卫随后继位，并娶了他的遗孀。

en: Vakhtang III (1275–1308), son of Demetrius II by his Trapezuntine wife, was named king of Georgia by the Ilkhan Ghazan in 1302 as a counterweight to his rebel brother David VIII. His power scarcely ran beyond Tbilisi and the southern and eastern provinces, and after an unsuccessful campaign against David's mountain guerrillas the brothers agreed to rule jointly. Most of Vakhtang's reign was spent leading Georgian and Armenian auxiliaries in Mongol wars, notably the march on Damascus in 1303 and the Gilan campaign of 1304. He died in 1308, survived by his wife Ripsime and sons Demetrius and George.
zh: 瓦赫坦三世（1275—1308）是德米特里二世与特拉比松公主之子，1302年被伊利汗合赞立为格鲁吉亚国王，用以牵制起兵反抗的兄长大卫八世。他的势力几乎不出第比利斯及南部、东部诸省；征讨大卫的山地游击军失利后，兄弟二人约定共同治国。瓦赫坦在位期间大多率领格鲁吉亚和亚美尼亚辅助军为蒙古征战，尤以1303年进军大马士革和1304年的吉兰战役为著。他于1308年去世，遗下妻子里普西梅和儿子德米特里、乔治。

en: Georg von Peuerbach (1423–1461), born at Peuerbach in Upper Austria, studied at the University of Vienna from 1446 and became its leading astronomer. After observing the Moon occult Jupiter in 1451, he lectured in Italy, where Bologna and Padua offered him chairs and he met the astronomer Giovanni Bianchini and Cardinal Nicholas of Cusa. He returned to Vienna in 1453 and lectured on Latin poetry. In 1454 he became court astrologer to King Ladislas V and later imperial astronomer to Frederick III. His lectures on Ptolemaic planetary theory were attended by the young Regiomontanus, who became his pupil and collaborator, and were later printed as the Theoricae Novae Planetarum. He died in 1461.
zh: 格奥尔格·冯·波伊尔巴赫（1423—1461）生于上奥地利的波伊尔巴赫，1446年起在维也纳大学求学，后成为该校最重要的天文学家。1451年观测月掩木星后，他前往意大利讲学，博洛尼亚和帕多瓦大学都曾聘他任教，他还结识了天文学家乔瓦尼·比安基尼和库萨的尼古拉枢机。他1453年返回维也纳，讲授拉丁诗歌。1454年他任国王拉斯洛五世的宫廷占星师，后来成为腓特烈三世的皇家天文学家。他讲授托勒密行星理论时，年轻的雷格蒙塔努斯曾在座听讲，后来成为他的学生与合作者；其讲稿后来以《新行星理论》为名刊印。他于1461年去世。

en: Arjanji Sartanji Gohil was a ruler of Palitana in Gujarat; a genealogy places him between Sartanji Shahji and Nonghanji I Arjanji, with a reign from 1250 to 1300.
zh: 阿禅吉·萨尔坦吉·戈希尔是古吉拉特的巴利塔纳统治者；一份家谱将他列于萨尔坦吉·沙赫吉与农甘吉一世·阿禅吉之间，记其在位于1250—1300年。

en: Rajput bardic accounts make Mokhadaji Gohil a Gohil chief of Saurashtra, ruling from 1309 until his death in 1347. Son of Ranoji, founder of Ranpur, he seized Bhimdad from the Vala Rajputs and Umrala from the Kolis. He took Khokhra and the port of Ghogha, then conquered Piram Island in the Gulf of Cambay from the Baria Kolis and made it a base for piracy. His sea raids drew Delhi Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq, who was in Gujarat to quell a rebellion; in 1347, after hard fighting, Tughluq captured Ghogha and Piram and killed him.
zh: 据拉杰普特吟游传统记载，莫克达吉·戈希尔是索拉什特拉的戈希拉拉杰普特首领，1309年起在位，直至1347年战死。他是兰普尔建立者拉诺吉之子，从瓦拉拉杰普特人手中夺取比姆达德，又从科利人手中夺取乌姆拉拉。他攻占霍克拉与港口戈加，接着从巴里亚科利人手中征服坎贝湾中的皮拉姆岛，将其作为海盗据点。他的海上劫掠引来正在古吉拉特平叛的德里苏丹穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克；1347年经过激战，图格鲁克攻占戈加与皮拉姆，将其斩杀。

en: Ranoji Gohil (r. c. 1254–1309) was a Gohil Rajput chief in Saurashtra, reckoned in tradition as a son or grandson of the migrant leader Sejakji. He founded Ranpur, named after himself, and moved his capital there. With Koli levies from Dhanmer he captured Vala, the ancient Vallabhipur, and extended Gohil power on the Saurashtra coast. His son Mokhadaji succeeded him and held Piram Island until 1347.
zh: 拉诺吉·戈希尔（约1254—1309年在位）是索拉什特拉的戈希尔拉杰普特首领，相传为迁居者塞贾克吉之子或孙。他建立了以自己命名的兰普尔，并将都城迁此；又借助丹梅尔的科利人军队攻占瓦拉（古城伐腊毗补罗），把戈希尔势力扩展到索拉什特拉沿海。其子莫克达吉继位，据有皮拉姆岛直至1347年。

en: Gian Giacomo Trivulzio (1440 or 1441–1518) was a Milanese nobleman and condottiero from the ancient House of Trivulzio. After fighting for the Sforza dukes, he entered French service under Charles VIII in 1483 and moved to the service of Naples in 1488. As commander of the Neapolitan army he negotiated peace with Charles, who then employed him; he fought for France at Fornovo in 1495. Commanding Louis XII's army, he forced Ludovico Sforza from Milan in 1499 and was made a marshal of France and governor of the city. He later fought at Agnadello in 1509 and Marignano in 1515 and defended Milan against Emperor Maximilian I in 1516. Falling into disgrace, he died at Arpajon in 1518.
zh: 吉安·贾科莫·特里武尔齐奥（1440或1441—1518）是米兰古老贵族特里武尔齐奥家族出身的雇佣军首领。他早年为斯福尔扎公爵作战，1483年转投法王查理八世，1488年又进入那不勒斯服役。作为那不勒斯军队的统帅，他与查理议定和约，随后受查理雇用，于1495年为法国参加福尔诺沃战役。此后他统领路易十二的军队，1499年将卢多维科·斯福尔扎逐出米兰，受封法兰西元帅并出任米兰总督。他还参加了1509年阿尼亚德洛战役和1515年马里尼亚诺战役，1516年击退神圣罗马帝国皇帝马克西米利安一世对米兰的进攻。他后来失宠遭贬，1518年死于法国的阿尔帕容。

en: Giuseppe Briati (1686–1772) was the leading Venetian artistic glassmaker of the eighteenth century, born on Murano. To meet competition from the new Bohemian crystal, he developed a glass type called uso cristallo and invented fresh decorative techniques. In 1739 he opened his own furnace in Venice, producing mirrors, tableware, wall lamps and elaborate chandeliers, including pagoda or Chinese-style pieces whose arms were adorned with multicoloured glass flowers. His lumiere wall lamps became the speciality of the Venetian glass industry. He died in Venice on 18 January 1772.
zh: 朱塞佩·布里亚蒂（1686—1772）是18世纪威尼斯首屈一指的艺术玻璃匠，生于穆拉诺岛。为应对新兴波希米亚水晶的竞争，他研制出名为“仿水晶”的新玻璃品种，并发明了新的装饰技法。1739年他在威尼斯自开窑厂，产品包括镜子、餐具、壁灯和精美的枝形吊灯，其中有以彩色玻璃花装饰灯臂的“宝塔式”或“中国式”吊灯。他的壁灯成为当时威尼斯玻璃业的招牌产品。1772年1月18日他在威尼斯去世。

en: Frederick VI of Schönburg (died 1328) was a younger son of Frederick III of Schönburg, the royal Bohemian land judge in the Pleissenland who divided the family estates around 1300. Frederick and his brothers each received one of the house's three lordships of Pürstein, Glauchau and Hassenstein. He is attested in charters between 1310 and 1327 and served the Bohemian crown as sub-chamberlain in 1317 and 1318.
zh: 弗里德里希六世·冯·舍恩堡（?—1328）是弗里德里希三世之子；其父曾任波希米亚王国的普莱森兰地方法官，并于1300年前后分封家族领地。弗里德里希与兄弟各得珀尔施泰因、格劳豪和哈森施泰因三处领地之一。1310至1327年间的特许状中留有他的记载，1317—1318年任波希米亚王室的副内库官。

en: Friedrich VII von Schönburg was the son of Friedrich VI, imperial governor for King John of Bohemia, who was killed in a Prague uprising in 1328. Around 1330 Friedrich gained the Bohemian crown castle of Pürstein in the Ore Mountains.
zh: 弗里德里希七世·冯·舍恩堡是弗里德里希六世·冯·舍恩堡之子；其父曾任波希米亚国王约翰的帝国摄政，1328年在布拉格旧城的一场暴动中被杀。约1330年，弗里德里希取得了位于厄尔士山脉的波希米亚王室城堡皮尔施泰因。

en: García II (1041/1043–1090), youngest son of Ferdinand I of León-Castile and Sancha, received Galicia in the 1065 partition, with Portugal south to the Mondego and the parias of Badajoz and Seville. In early 1071 he killed the rebel Portuguese count Nuno Mendes at Pedroso, but his brothers' invasions drove him into exile in Seville. After Sancho II's murder at Zamora in October 1072, Alfonso VI lured him to a parley in February 1073 and chained him in Luna Castle. He died there on 22 March 1090, asking to be buried in fetters at San Isidoro de León.
zh: 加西亚二世（1041或1043—1090）是莱昂与卡斯蒂利亚国王斐迪南一世与桑查最小的儿子。1065年父王分封诸子，他得到加利西亚，疆土包括向南直到蒙德古河的葡萄牙地区，以及巴达霍斯和塞维利亚泰法的贡金。1071年初，他在佩德罗索击杀叛乱的葡萄牙伯爵努诺·门德斯，但两个兄弟相继入侵，迫使他流亡塞维利亚。1072年10月桑乔二世在萨莫拉遇刺后，阿方索六世于1073年2月诱他赴会将其擒获，锁入卢纳城堡。1090年3月22日他死于囚所，遗嘱要求戴着镣铐葬入莱昂的圣伊西德罗教堂。

en: Raymond of Burgundy (c. 1070–1107) was the fourth son of Count William I of Burgundy. He came to Iberia around 1087 with a Burgundian army aiding Alfonso VI of León. After the army abandoned the siege of Tudela in April 1087, its leader Odo went west to Alfonso's court. Raymond married the king's heiress, Urraca, receiving the government of the Kingdom of Galicia, then including the counties of Portugal and Coimbra. In 1095 Alfonso detached those two counties and granted them to Raymond's kinsman Henry of Burgundy. Raymond ruled Galicia with near-royal authority, using titles including count and prince, until his death on 24 May 1107. His son by Urraca, Alfonso VII, later ruled León and Castile, and his brother became Pope Callixtus II.
zh: 勃艮第的雷蒙多（约1070—1107）是勃艮第伯爵威廉一世的第四子。约1087年，他随勃艮第军队来到伊比利亚，援助莱昂的阿方索六世。1087年4月，军队放弃围攻图德拉后，统帅厄德向西前往阿方索的宫廷。雷蒙多娶国王的女继承人乌拉卡为妻，受命统治加利西亚王国，当时该地还包括葡萄牙和科英布拉两个伯国。1095年，阿方索把这两个伯国划出，封给雷蒙多的亲属勃艮第的亨利。雷蒙多以近乎君王的权威统治加利西亚，使用伯爵、亲王等头衔，直到1107年5月24日去世。他与乌拉卡所生的儿子阿方索七世后来统治莱昂与卡斯蒂利亚，他的兄弟则成为教皇加里斯都二世。

en: Sancho Ordóñez (c. 895–929) was the eldest son of King Ordoño II of León and Elvira Menéndez. After his uncle Froila II died in 925, he briefly seized León before his brother Alfonso IV drove him out. Alfonso had the support of the Leonese nobility and his father-in-law, the king of Pamplona. In 926 Sancho was crowned king of Galicia at Santiago de Compostela, ruling with the backing of the Galician nobility and styling himself Prince of Galicia in charters. In 927 and 928 he granted estates to Galician nobles. At Christmas 927 he and Alfonso jointly held an assembly, confirming the restoration of the monastery of Santa María de Loio. He married Goto Muñiz and died in 929, whereupon Alfonso inherited Galicia.
zh: 桑乔·奥多尼斯一世（约895—929）是莱昂国王奥多尼奥二世与埃尔维拉·梅嫩德斯的长子。925年叔父弗鲁埃拉二世去世后，他一度占据莱昂，随后被弟弟阿方索四世逐出。阿方索得到莱昂贵族和其岳父潘普洛纳国王的支持。926年，桑乔在圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉加冕为加利西亚国王，依靠加利西亚贵族进行统治，并在特许状中自称“加利西亚亲王”。927年和928年，他向加利西亚贵族赠予庄园。927年圣诞节，他与阿方索共同主持一次大会议，确认修复洛伊奥的圣马利亚修道院。他娶戈托·穆尼斯为妻，929年去世，阿方索随即继承了加利西亚。

en: Henry III of Głogów (1251/1260–1309), son of Konrad I, fought at Stolec in 1277 and on the Marchfeld in 1278, where Ottokar II of Bohemia fell. In 1290 Henry IV Probus made him heir of Wrocław, but its burghers drove him out for Henry V the Fat, starting years of war. From 1301 styling himself heir of Poland, he conquered most of Greater Poland, including Kalisz, in 1306–1307. His reign brought monetary reforms and a dozen towns. He married Matilda of Brunswick-Lüneburg in 1291 and died in December 1309, leaving five sons including Przemko II.
zh: 格沃古夫的亨里克三世（1251/1260—1309）是康拉德一世之子。1277年他战于斯托莱茨，1278年参加马希费尔德之战，波希米亚国王奥托卡二世在此役阵亡。1290年弗罗茨瓦夫的亨里克四世（公正者）立他为继承人，但弗罗茨瓦夫市民很快将他赶走、迎立胖子亨里克五世，由此引发连年战争。1301年起他自称波兰王国王位继承人，1306—1307年征服包括卡利什在内的大波兰大部。他治下推行货币改革、新建十余座城镇。1291年娶不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的玛蒂尔达，1309年12月去世，留下五个儿子，普热姆科二世即其中之一。

en: Konrad I of Głogów (c. 1228–1274) was a Silesian Piast, son of Henry II the Pious. Destined for the Church and sent to study in Paris, he returned in 1248 to claim his inheritance. Backed by Greater Poland and the people of Głogów, he forced his brother Bolesław II in 1251 to cede him Głogów and Żagań. He promoted German settlement, granted Głogów Magdeburg town law in 1253, supported the Bishop of Wrocław, and after about 1260 attached himself to King Ottokar II of Bohemia. He died in August 1273 or 1274, leaving Głogów to his son Henry III.
zh: 格沃古夫的康拉德一世（约1228—1274）是西里西亚皮亚斯特家族王公，虔敬者亨里克二世之子。他原本被安排走教会道路、送往巴黎求学，却在1248年回国要求分得遗产。在大波兰诸公爵与格沃古夫市民的支持下，他于1251年迫使兄长波列斯瓦夫二世割让格沃古夫和萨根。他鼓励德意志移民，1253年授予格沃古夫马格德堡城市法，支持弗罗茨瓦夫主教，约1260年后依附波希米亚国王奥托卡二世。1273年或1274年8月去世，格沃古夫传给儿子亨里克三世。

en: Mechthild of Brunswick-Lüneburg (1276–1318), called Matilda in Polish sources, was the only daughter of Duke Albert I of Brunswick-Lüneburg and Alessia of Montferrat. In March 1291 she married Duke Henry III of Głogów, allying the Welf and Piast dynasties in his feud with Henry V the Fat of Legnica. She bore Henry nine children. When Henry died in 1309, she ruled his Silesian duchies as regent until 1312, although their eldest son Henry IV was already of age. Głogów itself was hers as a dower under her husband's will. She died on 26 April 1318, and Głogów passed to her sons Henry IV and Przemko II, who ruled it jointly.
zh: 不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的玛蒂尔达（德语作梅希蒂尔德，1276—1318）是不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵阿尔布雷希特一世与蒙费拉托的阿莱西娜唯一的女儿。1291年3月，她嫁给格沃古夫公爵亨里克三世，这场婚姻使韦尔夫家族与皮雅斯特家族结盟，共同对付莱格尼察的胖子亨里克五世。她为亨里克生下九个子女。1309年丈夫去世后，尽管长子亨里克四世已成年，她仍出任摄政，统治丈夫的西里西亚诸公国直至1312年。依丈夫的遗嘱，格沃古夫本身作为寡妇产由她持有。她于1318年4月26日去世，格沃古夫由儿子亨里克四世和普热姆科二世共同继承。

en: Przemko II of Głogów (c. 1305–1331), youngest son of Henry III and Matilda of Brunswick-Lüneburg, ruled jointly with his brothers after 1309, receiving Głogów in 1318 and ruling alone from 1321. He married Constance of Świdnica in 1326. After 1329 he was the only one of Henry III's sons to refuse homage to King John of Bohemia, saying he would rather lose his inheritance than serve a foreign ruler; his brothers deposed him. He died suddenly on 11 January 1331, reportedly poisoned by his own vassals, and that autumn John of Bohemia seized Głogów.
zh: 格沃古夫的普热姆科二世（约1305—1331）是亨里克三世与不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的玛蒂尔达最小的儿子。1309年后与诸兄共治，1318年获得格沃古夫，1321年起独自统治。1326年娶希维德尼察的康斯坦策。1329年后，他是亨里克三世诸子中唯一拒绝向波希米亚国王约翰行臣服礼者，声称宁可失去遗产也不愿臣服外族君主，结果被诸兄废黜。1331年1月11日他突然死去，据传是被自己的封臣毒杀；同年秋天，波希米亚的约翰夺取格沃古夫。

en: Berdi Beg (c. 1310–1359) was khan of the Golden Horde from 1357. When his father Jani Beg conquered Azerbaijan in 1357, Berdi was left viceroy in Tabriz; recalled in his father's final illness, he succeeded that July amid rumors of patricide. He secured his throne by executing at least twelve kinsmen, even killing an infant brother himself. He signed a trade treaty with Venice in 1358 and restored the Russian Church's privileges. He died in 1359 in unclear circumstances, with some accounts saying he was murdered, opening two decades of civil war in the Golden Horde. Later accounts held that the line of Batu became extinct on his death.
zh: 别儿迪别（约1310—1359年）自1357年起为金帐汗国可汗。1357年其父札尼别征服阿塞拜疆后，他以副王身份留守大不里士；父亲病危时被召回，于当年7月继位，时人怀疑是他策划了父亲之死。他为巩固汗位处死至少十二名亲族，甚至亲手杀死襁褓中的幼弟。1358年他与威尼斯签订通商条约，并恢复罗斯教会的特权。1359年他死因不明，一些记载称他被杀，金帐汗国随之陷入长达二十年的内乱。后世记载认为拔都一脉随他的去世而绝嗣。

en: Öz Beg (1282–1341), whose Muslim name was Ghiyath al-Din Muhammad, ruled the Golden Horde from 1313, longer than any other khan, and under him it reached its zenith. His father Toghrilcha was executed by Toqta, who sent the boy into exile. When Toqta died in January 1313, Öz Beg took the throne, converted to Sunni Islam, and crushed the Mongol nobles who plotted against him. He confirmed the tax exemption of the Russian clergy and built New Sarai, a trading city whose bazaars and broad streets Ibn Battuta later praised. He allied with the Mamluk sultans and attacked Ilkhanid Azerbaijan in 1319, 1325 and 1335. In Russia he interfered in the princes' quarrels and favoured Moscow: his sister married Yury, and the Tver princes Mikhail, Dmitry and Aleksandr were each put to death at Sarai. After Tver's 1327 uprising he sent Ivan I Kalita with a Tatar army, and in 1331 made him grand prince, the true start of Moscow's rise. He died in 1341, succeeded by his son Tini Beg.
zh: 月即别（1282—1341），教名吉亚斯丁·穆罕默德，1313年起统治金帐汗国，在位之久超过任何一位大汗，国势也在他手里达到鼎盛。他的父亲脱古列儿被脱脱处死，他本人被流放。1313年1月脱脱去世，他夺得汗位，改宗逊尼派伊斯兰教，并镇压了密谋反对他的蒙古贵族。他确认了罗斯教士免税的旧诏，又修建了新萨莱城，这座商贸城市的集市与宽阔街道后来受到伊本·白图泰称赞。他与马穆鲁克苏丹结盟，于1319年、1325年和1335年进攻伊儿汗国治下的阿塞拜疆。在罗斯，他干预诸王公间的纷争，偏袒莫斯科：他的妹妹嫁给了尤里，特维尔的米哈伊尔、德米特里和亚历山大三位王公先后在萨莱被处死。1327年特维尔起义后，他派伊凡一世·卡利塔率鞑靼军队前去镇压，1331年又册立伊凡为大公，莫斯科的崛起由此真正开始。他于1341年去世，其子迪尼别继位。

en: Jani Beg (died 1357) was khan of the Golden Horde from 1342. A son of Öz Beg Khan, he eliminated his elder brother Tini Beg and was elected with his mother Taydula Khatun's support. He intervened in the Russian principalities, backing Moscow's Simeon and Ivan II, and Russian chroniclers called him 'the good tsar'. His quarrel with the Italian colonies led to the long siege of Kaffa in Crimea, traditionally linked to the Black Death's arrival in Europe. In 1357 he took Tabriz in Azerbaijan and died after falling ill on the way home; contemporaries suspected that his son Berdi Beg ordered his murder, but the cause of death is uncertain.
zh: 札尼别（？—1357年）自1342年起为金帐汗国可汗。他是月即别汗之子，除掉长兄迪尼别后，在母亲泰都拉王后支持下经库里勒台当选。他介入罗斯诸公国事务，扶植莫斯科的谢苗与伊凡二世，罗斯编年史称他为“善良的沙皇”。他与意大利殖民地的冲突导致克里米亚的卡法遭长期围攻，此事在传统说法中与黑死病传入欧洲有关。1357年他攻取阿塞拜疆的大不里士，回师途中患病去世；时人怀疑其子别儿迪别下令弑父，但死因不明。

en: Tini Beg (died 1342) was briefly khan of the Golden Horde in 1341–1342. A son of Öz Beg Khan and Taydula Khatun, he was his father's designated heir and governed the White Horde from about 1328. When Öz Beg died in 1341, Tini Beg was on the eastern border fighting Chagatai raiders, while his brother Jani Beg held the court at Sarai. On his way back in 1342 he was killed at Saray-Jük by emirs incited by his mother, who favored Jani Beg. Pope Benedict XII had once written urging him to convert to Christianity.
zh: 迪尼别（？—1342年）于1341—1342年短暂在位，为金帐汗国可汗。他是月即别汗与泰都拉王后之子，约1328年起受命管辖白帐，被父亲立为继承人。1341年月即别汗去世时，他正在东部边境与察合台袭扰者作战，其弟札尼别留守萨莱。1342年他在返回途中于萨莱楚克被母亲煽动的异密杀害，泰都拉意在扶立札尼别。教宗本笃十二世曾写信劝他皈依基督教。

en: Local chronicles record Sau Malik II as raja of Gilgit from 1276 to 1345. The son of Torra Khan, who gave the Trakhan dynasty its name, he took power after the Badakhshan-backed interlude of Shah Ra'is Khan and was succeeded in 1345 by Chilis Khan.
zh: 据当地编年史记载，萨乌·马利克二世于1276—1345年任吉尔吉特拉贾。他是为特剌汗王朝定名的托拉汗之子，在巴达赫尚支持的沙赫·赖斯汗短暂当政之后即位，1345年由奇利斯汗继位。

en: Davyd Konstantinovich (died 1280) was the second prince of the Galich-Dmitrov principality, succeeding his father Konstantin Yaroslavich at Galich and Dmitrov in 1255. In 1276 he married the eldest daughter of Prince Fyodor Rostislavich the Black of Yaroslavl. The chronicles record his death as Prince Davyd, grandson of Yaroslav, prince of Galich and Dmitrov. He was the last ruler known to hold both towns together, and after his death in 1280 his brother Vasily Konstantinovich became prince of Galich.
zh: 达维德·康斯坦丁诺维奇（？—1280）是加利奇-德米特罗夫公国的第二代王公，1255年继承父亲康斯坦丁·雅罗斯拉维奇，领有加利奇和德米特罗夫。1276年，他娶雅罗斯拉夫尔王公费奥多尔·罗斯季斯拉维奇‘黑者’的长女为妻。编年史记其卒为‘雅罗斯拉夫之孙、加利奇与德米特罗夫王公达维德’。他是已知最后一位同时领有两座城镇的统治者，1280年死后，弟弟瓦西里·康斯坦丁诺维奇成为加利奇王公。

en: Fyodor Davydovich was prince of Galich-Mersky, a son of Davyd Konstantinovich of Galich-Dmitrov by his marriage to a daughter of Prince Fyodor Rostislavich the Black of Yaroslavl. After his uncle Vasily's death, the family lands may have passed to his nephews and been divided: Fyodor received Galich-Mersky and Boris, whom some consider his brother, took Dmitrov. Nothing is recorded of his rule. Genealogies claim he sold half of Galich to Ivan Kalita of Moscow, a sale historians dispute. A prince Fyodor whose death the Nikon Chronicle records in 1335 has been identified by a historian as this prince. He left a single son, Ivan.
zh: 费奥多尔·达维多维奇是加利奇-梅尔斯基王公，加利奇-德米特罗夫王公达维德·康斯坦丁诺维奇与雅罗斯拉夫尔王公费奥多尔·罗斯季斯拉维奇‘黑者’之女所生之子。叔父瓦西里死后，家族领地可能由侄辈继承并瓜分：费奥多尔得到加利奇-梅尔斯基，鲍里斯分得德米特罗夫，有学者认为鲍里斯是他的兄弟。他的统治事迹无考。一些家谱称他把半个加利奇卖给了莫斯科的伊凡·卡利塔，此事是否发生在史学界有争议。《尼康编年史》记一位费奥多尔王公于1335年去世，有学者认为此人即费奥多尔·达维多维奇。他只留下儿子伊凡。

en: Ivan Fyodorovich, the only son of Fyodor Davydovich, was prince of Galich-Mersky from before 1335 to about 1360.
zh: 伊凡·费奥多罗维奇是费奥多尔·达维多维奇的独子，约于1335年前至1360年前后任加利奇-梅尔斯基王公。

en: Konstantin Yaroslavich (died 1255) was the first appanage prince of Galich-Mersky and Dmitrov, a son of Grand Prince Yaroslav Vsevolodovich of Vladimir and brother of Alexander Nevsky. The chronicles first name him in 1238 among the princes who survived Batu's invasion. In 1243 he went to Karakorum while his father visited Batu, and he remained with the Mongols until 1245. After Yaroslav's death he received Galich and Dmitrov as his appanage. He died in the spring of 1255 and was buried in the Dormition Cathedral in Vladimir, leaving two sons, Davyd and Vasily.
zh: 康斯坦丁·雅罗斯拉维奇（？—1255）是第一代加利奇-梅尔斯基与德米特罗夫封邑王公，弗拉基米尔大公雅罗斯拉夫·弗谢沃洛多维奇之子、亚历山大·涅夫斯基之弟。编年史于1238年首次提到他，将他列入拔都入侵后幸存的王公。1243年，父亲前往拔都处时，他前往哈拉和林，在蒙古方面留居至1245年；雅罗斯拉夫死后，他分得加利奇和德米特罗夫为封邑。1255年春他去世，葬于弗拉基米尔圣母升天大教堂，留下达维德与瓦西里两个儿子。

en: Vasily Konstantinovich (died 1310) was a prince of the Galich-Dmitrov principality, a son of its first ruler Konstantin Yaroslavich and grandson of Grand Prince Yaroslav Vsevolodovich of Vladimir. When his father died in 1255, Galich and Dmitrov passed to his brother Davyd Konstantinovich. After Davyd's death in 1280 Vasily became prince of Galich and ruled there until his own death in 1310. The principality then passed to his nephew Fyodor Davydovich, who held Galich-Mersky.
zh: 瓦西里·康斯坦丁诺维奇（？—1310）是加利奇-德米特罗夫公国的王公，初代王公康斯坦丁·雅罗斯拉维奇之子、弗拉基米尔大公雅罗斯拉夫·弗谢沃洛多维奇之孙。1255年父亲死后，加利奇和德米特罗夫由其兄弟达维德·康斯坦丁诺维奇继承。1280年达维德死后，瓦西里成为加利奇王公，统治至1310年去世。公国随后传给侄子费奥多尔·达维多维奇，领有加利奇-梅尔斯基。

en: Albrecht II von Gleichenstein (c.1220–24 March 1290) belonged to the Gleichenstein line of counts in the Eichsfeld. During his lifetime the comital house faced debt and conflict with the city of Erfurt: in 1283 the counts were forced to pledge their Vogtei rights to Erfurt's town council, which bought the rights outright in 1290.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特二世·冯·格莱兴施泰因（约1220—1290年3月24日）属于艾希斯费尔德的格莱兴施泰因伯爵支系。在他有生之年，伯爵家族面临债务和与爱尔福特城的冲突：1283年，伯爵们被迫将福格特权利抵押给爱尔福特市议会，该市又于1290年把这些权利彻底买下。

en: Albrecht III von Gleichenstein (died 1283) belonged to the Gleichenstein branch of the comital house of Gleichen in the Eichsfeld.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特三世·冯·格莱兴施泰因（卒于1283年）属于格莱兴伯爵家族在艾希斯费尔德的格莱兴施泰因支系。

en: Ernst I (c. 1096 – 29 December 1151) was the elder son of Count Erwin I of Gleichen and Helinburg of Lohra. He appears as count of Tonna in 1110 and count in Thuringia in 1114, and from 1120 he held the advocacy of Erfurt. Charters show him as Vogt of St Peter and Paul Abbey in Erfurt in 1134 and of Gerode Abbey in 1143, and as burgrave-count of Harburg in the Eichsfeld in 1139 and 1148. Documented from 1108 to 1150, he died on 29 December 1151. By an unnamed wife he left sons Erwin II and Ernst II.
zh: 恩斯特一世（约1096—1151年12月29日）是格莱兴伯爵埃尔温一世与洛拉的海伦堡的长子。1110年他以托纳伯爵、1114年以图林根伯爵身份出现，1120年起担任埃尔福特的护法官。文书记载他1134年任埃尔福特圣彼得与圣保罗修道院护法官，1143年任格罗德修道院护法官，1139年和1148年两度出任艾希斯费尔德的哈尔堡城堡伯爵。他于1108年至1150年间屡见于文书，1151年12月29日去世，与名字无考的妻子生下埃尔温二世、恩斯特二世二子。

en: Ernst II of Gleichen-Harburg (c. 1152 – 1170) was a son of Count Ernst I of Tonna. From 1152 he ruled with his brother Erwin II as count of Gleichenstein; he held Harburg Castle in the Eichsfeld from 1154 and the advocacy of Gerode Abbey from 1157. In 1162 he founded the Cistercian Reifenstein Abbey at Kleinbartloff with monks from Volkenroda. His castles of Harburg and Rusteberg were destroyed in 1165 during wars between the archbishops of Mainz and the Thuringian landgraves, who captured him and had him beheaded in 1170. He married Guda.
zh: 恩斯特二世·冯·格莱兴-哈尔堡（约1152—1170）是托纳伯爵恩斯特一世之子。1152年起，他与兄弟埃尔温二世同任格莱兴施泰因伯爵，1154年起领有艾希斯费尔德的哈尔堡城堡，1157年起任格罗德修道院护法官。1162年，他在克莱因巴特洛布创建西多会的赖芬施泰因修道院，从福尔克罗达修道院迁来修士。1165年，在美因茨大主教与图林根藩侯的交战中，哈尔堡和鲁斯特贝格两座城堡被毁；1170年他被图林根藩侯俘获并斩首。他娶古达为妻。

en: Ernst III von Gleichen, called zu Velseck (died 1230), was a son of Count Erwin II of Gleichen-Tonna and a brother of Lambert II. The family's castle of Velsecke in the Eichsfeld was first documented in 1180 and later rebuilt as Gleichenstein. He married Berta of Lohra. Lambert's sons divided the comital house into the Gleichen and Gleichenstein branches. Ernst died in 1230.
zh: 恩斯特三世·冯·格莱兴，又称费尔泽克的恩斯特（卒于1230年），是格莱兴-通纳伯爵埃尔温二世之子、兰伯特二世的兄弟。家族在艾希斯费尔德的费尔泽克城堡于1180年首见记载，后来重建为格莱兴施泰因。他娶罗拉的贝尔塔为妻。兰伯特的儿子们把伯爵家族分为格莱兴与格莱兴施泰因两支。恩斯特于1230年去世。

en: Ernst IV von Gleichen (1198–16 May 1277) was a son of Count Lambert II and Sophie of Weimar-Orlamünde, and after the family partition he headed the Gleichen line of the comital house, with its seats at Tonna and the Burg Gleichen near Gotha. A knight as well as a count, he married two Danish noblewomen in succession, Ingeborg Pedersdatter and Margrete Olufsdatter. His sons included Erwin III and Heinrich IV, who served as a knight and royal councillor in Sweden; under Heinrich's grandsons this line later split into the Blankenhain and Tonna branches.
zh: 恩斯特四世·冯·格莱兴（1198—1277年5月16日）是伯爵兰伯特二世与魏玛-奥尔拉明德的索菲之子；家族分产之后，他统领伯爵家族的格莱兴支系，据点在通纳和哥达附近的格莱兴堡。他兼具骑士与伯爵身份，先后迎娶两位丹麦贵族女子英厄堡·佩德斯达特和玛格丽特·奥卢夫斯达特。儿子包括埃尔温三世和海因里希四世，后者曾在瑞典任骑士和国王顾问；到海因里希的孙子一辈，这一支系又分为布兰肯海因和通纳两支。

en: Ernst V von Gleichenstein (died c.1270) belonged to the Eichsfeld branch of the Thuringian comital house of Gleichen.
zh: 恩斯特五世·冯·格莱兴施泰因（约1270年卒）属于图林根格莱兴伯爵家族的艾希斯费尔德支系。

en: Erwin I (c. 1040 – c. 1116), in Latin Erwinus comes, is the earliest known member of the comital house of Gleichen in Thuringia. He first appears in charters in 1099 as count at Tonna and is named count in Thuringia in 1114. Late in life he became a monk at Reinhardsbrunn Abbey. By his wife Helinburg, daughter of Count Beringer I of Lohra and heiress of Lohra, who founded Volkenroda Abbey in 1130, he left two sons who carried the line forward, Ernst I of Tonna and Lambert I.
zh: 埃尔温一世（约1040—约1116），拉丁语作埃尔维努斯伯爵，是图林根格莱兴伯爵家族已知最早的成员。1099年他首次以托纳伯爵身份见于文书，1114年被称作图林根伯爵，晚年在莱因哈茨布伦修道院出家为僧。妻子海伦堡是洛拉伯爵贝林格一世之女、洛拉的女继承人，于1130年创建福尔克罗达修道院；两子恩斯特一世与兰伯特一世延续了家族血脉。

en: Erwin II (c. 1124 – 7 September 1192), born at Gräfentonna, was the son of Count Ernst I of Tonna. He appears in 1154 as count of Tonna and Vogt of Gerode Abbey, and in 1162 he is the first of his line to style himself count of Gleichen, the name his dynasty afterwards bore. In 1167 he appears as count in Thuringia and Vogt of Ohrdruf Abbey. He died on 7 September 1192 and was buried with his wife in the Peterskloster in Erfurt. His sons, among them Lambert II and Ernst III, divided the inheritance.
zh: 埃尔温二世（约1124—1192年9月7日）生于格雷芬托纳，是托纳伯爵恩斯特一世之子。1154年他以托纳伯爵兼格罗德修道院护法官的身份出现；1162年，他成为家族中第一个自称格莱兴伯爵的人，这个名号此后成为家族姓氏。1167年，他又以图林根伯爵和奥尔德鲁夫修道院护法官的身份出现。1192年9月7日他去世，与妻子合葬于埃尔福特的圣彼得修道院。其子兰伯特二世、恩斯特三世等人瓜分了遗产。

en: Heinrich I von Gleichenstein (c.1202–1257) was a son of Count Lambert II of Gleichen and Sophie of Weimar-Orlamünde. When his father's inheritance was divided, he took the Eichsfeld lands. After the Velsecke castle had been destroyed in 1234 in the war between the Archbishop of Mainz and Landgrave Heinrich Raspe of Thuringia, he rebuilt it in 1241–1246 as Gleichenstein, calling himself and his line after the castle. He ruled as count of Gleichenstein until his death on 20 January 1257. His wife was Mechtild of Schwerin.
zh: 海因里希一世·冯·格莱兴施泰因（约1202—1257）是格莱兴伯爵兰伯特二世与魏玛-奥尔拉明德的索菲之子。分割父产时，他分得艾希斯费尔德的领地。费尔泽克城堡于1234年在美因茨大主教与图林根领地伯爵海因里希·拉斯佩的战争中被毁，他于1241—1246年将其重建为格莱兴施泰因堡，并以城堡作为自己和支系的名号。他以格莱兴施泰因伯爵的身份统治，直至1257年1月20日去世。他的妻子是什未林的梅希蒂尔德。

en: Heinrich III von Gleichenstein (died 1299) was the last count of the Gleichenstein branch in the Eichsfeld. The comital house's debts led to the sale of its Eichsfeld estates and castles to the Archbishopric of Mainz in 1294; the family's Vogtei rights there were also sold to Mainz that year. With Heinrich's death in 1299 the Gleichenstein line died out.
zh: 海因里希三世·冯·格莱兴施泰因（卒于1299年）是格莱兴施泰因支系在艾希斯费尔德的末代伯爵。伯爵家族因负债于1294年把艾希斯费尔德的地产和城堡卖给美因茨大主教区，家族在当地的福格特权利也于同年售予美因茨。随着海因里希于1299年去世，格莱兴施泰因支系绝嗣。

en: Heinrich IV, also numbered III, von Gleichen (c.1250–1314) was a son of Count Ernst IV von Gleichen and Ingeborg Pedersdatter. He built on the family's Nordic ties by marrying Lucia Svantepolksdotter, from a leading Swedish magnate house, and Swedish sources record him as a knight and a member of the royal council, the riksråd. In Thuringia he held the Gleichen inheritance and fathered Hermann IV and Heinrich V. He died in 1314.
zh: 海因里希四世（亦被排为三世）·冯·格莱兴（约1250—1314）是格莱兴伯爵恩斯特四世与英厄堡·佩德斯达特之子。他延续家族与北欧的联系，娶瑞典显贵家族之女露西亚·斯万特波克斯达特为妻，瑞典史料中记载他是骑士和国王政务会成员。在图林根，他保有格莱兴祖产，生子赫尔曼四世与海因里希五世。他于1314年去世。

en: Hermann, called the Younger, was count of Gleichen-Tonna and from 1332 Schultheiss, or bailiff, of Ohrdruf in Thuringia. The son of Count Heinrich III and Lucia Svantepolksdotter, he first appears in charters in 1301. Before 1325 he married Sophie, daughter of Count Dietrich of Honstein-Klettenberg. He is documented acting as count through 1343 and died at Nuremberg on 18 May 1345, being buried in the church of St. Peter and Paul in Erfurt. His son Heinrich VI succeeded him.
zh: 赫尔曼人称“年幼者”，是格莱兴-托纳伯爵，1332年起任图林根奥尔德鲁夫的地方行政长官。他是伯爵海因里希三世与露琪亚·斯万特波克斯多塔之子，1301年首次见于文书。1325年之前，他娶霍恩施泰因-克莱滕贝格伯爵迪特里希之女索菲为妻。1343年仍有他行使伯爵职权的记载，1345年5月18日卒于纽伦堡，葬于埃尔福特的圣彼得与圣保罗教堂，其子海因里希六世继位。

en: Lambert I (c. 1100 – 13 October 1149) was a younger son of Count Erwin I of Gleichen and Helinburg of Lohra. He is documented from 1125 and appears as count of Tonna in 1134; in 1147 he is called count of Berg, in Latin de Monte. He married Mechtild, daughter of Count Theodoric of Are. Lambert died at Erfurt on 13 October 1149 and was buried in Volkenroda Abbey, the house his mother had founded. A son, Lambert called the Younger, appears in charters in 1150 and 1151.
zh: 兰伯特一世（约1100—1149年10月13日）是格莱兴伯爵埃尔温一世与洛拉的海伦堡的幼子。1125年起他见于文书，1134年以托纳伯爵身份出现，1147年被称为贝格伯爵，其名号意为‘山’。他娶阿尔伯爵狄奥多里克之女梅希蒂尔德为妻，1149年10月13日卒于埃尔福特，葬在母亲创建的福尔克罗达修道院。其子小兰伯特在1150年和1151年的文书中出现。

en: Lambert II, also numbered Lambert III (c. 1160 – 14 September 1227), was the son of Count Erwin II of Gleichen. He appears in charters as count of Erfurt in 1191, as Vogt of the Peterskloster and of Erfurt in 1193, and from 1195 as count of Gleichen. He married Sophie of Weimar-Orlamünde, daughter of Count Siegfried III and Sophie of Denmark, documented from 1223, who survived him until 1244. Lambert died on 14 September 1227. His son Ernst IV succeeded in Gleichen and Tonna, while another son, Heinrich of Gleichenstein, founded a younger line.
zh: 兰伯特二世（部分谱系作兰伯特三世，约1160—1227年9月14日）是格莱兴伯爵埃尔温二世之子。他在文书中1191年任埃尔福特伯爵，1193年任圣彼得修道院和埃尔福特护法官，1195年起称格莱兴伯爵。他娶魏玛-奥拉明德的索菲为妻，索菲是伯爵西格弗里德三世与丹麦的索菲之女，1223年起见于记载，1244年才去世。兰伯特于1227年9月14日去世，其子恩斯特四世继承格莱兴与托纳，另一子海因里希成为格莱兴施泰因支系的始祖。

en: Lambert II, also numbered III, von Gleichen-Tonna (died 14 September 1227) was a Saxon count and, from 1193, archiepiscopal Vogt of Erfurt and its Peterskloster, the key Mainz office in central Thuringia. He married Sophie of Weimar-Orlamünde. His sons Ernst IV and Heinrich I founded the two comital lines of Gleichen and Gleichenstein, while another son, Hermann, became bishop of Cammin. Lambert's grave slab, which later became linked to the legend of the count with two wives, survives in Erfurt Cathedral.
zh: 兰伯特·冯·格莱兴-通纳（排行为兰伯特二世或三世，卒于1227年9月14日）是萨克森伯爵，1193年起担任爱尔福特及当地圣彼得修道院的美因茨福格特，这是美因茨大主教区在图林根中部最关键的职位。他娶魏玛-奥尔拉明德的索菲为妻。儿子恩斯特四世和海因里希一世分别开创格莱兴和格莱兴施泰因两支伯爵世系，另一个儿子赫尔曼后来出任卡缅主教。兰伯特的墓板现存于爱尔福特大教堂，后世还把它与伯爵有两位妻子的传说联系在一起。

en: Alan of Galloway (before 1199–1234) was hereditary Lord of Galloway and Constable of Scotland. Succeeding his father Roland in 1200, he led the Scottish crown's forces, held English lands and advised King John over Magna Carta. He took part in the English colonisation of Ulster, while his intervention in the Norse kingdom of the Isles drew a retaliatory fleet from King Hákon Hákonarson of Norway; Norse sagas ranked him among the great warriors of his age. He died in February 1234 leaving daughters as heirs, whereupon Alexander II partitioned Galloway among them, ending the native line founded by Fergus.
zh: 加洛韦的艾伦（1199年前—1234）是世袭加洛韦领主兼苏格兰统帅。他于1200年继承父亲罗兰之位，统领苏格兰王室军队，在英格兰拥有领地，曾在《大宪章》时期为英王约翰献策。他参与英格兰在阿尔斯特的殖民，又因介入挪威治下的群岛王国，招致挪威国王哈康四世的舰队报复；北欧萨迦将他列为当时最伟大的战士之一。1234年2月他去世，由女儿们继承，亚历山大二世随即将加洛韦分封给其诸女，终结了由弗格斯开创的本土统治者世系。

en: Dervorguilla of Galloway (c. 1210–1290) was a Scottish heiress, daughter of Alan, Lord of Galloway and Margaret of Huntingdon, descended through her mother from King David I. She married John de Balliol in 1223 and became one of her father's heirs on his death in 1234; her royal descent underpinned her son John Balliol's claim to Scotland's throne. After her husband's death in 1269 she kept his embalmed heart in an ivory casket, and in 1273 founded Dulce Cor, the Cistercian Sweetheart Abbey, near Dumfries. In 1282 she endowed and gave statutes to Balliol College, Oxford. She died on 28 January 1290 and was buried there.
zh: 加洛韦的德沃尔吉拉（约1210—1290）是苏格兰女继承人，加洛韦领主艾伦与亨廷顿的玛格丽特之女，随母系为大卫一世后裔。1223年她嫁给约翰·德·巴利奥尔，1234年父亲去世后成为继承人之一；其王室血统成为儿子约翰·巴利奥尔日后争夺苏格兰王位的依据。1269年丈夫死后，她将丈夫的心脏防腐保存在象牙匣中；1273年在邓弗里斯附近创建西多会的斯威特哈特修道院，拉丁语名为杜尔切科尔。1282年，她为牛津大学贝利奥尔学院设立永久基金并颁行章程。1290年1月28日去世，葬于该修道院。

en: Helen of Galloway (b. c. 1215, fl. thirteenth century) was a daughter and co-heiress of Alan, Lord of Galloway, by his first wife, a daughter of Roger de Lacy, Constable of Chester. She became the first wife of Roger de Quincy, Earl of Winchester, who died in 1264, and was the mother of his only children, three daughters. Through them her Galloway inheritance reached leading Anglo-Scottish houses: Margaret married William de Ferrers, Earl of Derby, Elizabeth married Alexander Comyn, Earl of Buchan, and Helen married Alan de la Zouche.
zh: 加洛韦的海伦（约1215年生）是加洛韦领主艾伦与原配（切斯特统帅罗杰·德·拉西之女）的女儿及共同继承人之一。她嫁给1264年去世的温切斯特伯爵罗杰·德·昆西，是他的第一任妻子，他的三个女儿均为她所出，后代仅此一系。凭借她带来的加洛韦继承权，三个女儿分别嫁入显贵：玛格丽特嫁德比伯爵威廉·德·费勒斯，伊丽莎白嫁巴肯伯爵亚历山大·科明，海伦嫁艾伦·德·拉·祖什。

en: Adolf II (c. 1300–1347) ruled the County of the Mark from the death of his father Engelbert II in 1328. His first marriage, to Irmgard of Cleves, was dissolved in 1324, and a papal dispensation allowed him to wed Margaret of Cleves, daughter of Count Dietrich VIII, through whom his sons later inherited Cleves. As Vogt of Essen Abbey he secured the election of his sister Katharina as its abbess in 1337. He died at Fröndenberg in October 1347 and was succeeded by his eldest son Engelbert III; his younger son Adolf became Count of Cleves in 1368.
zh: 阿道夫二世（约1300—1347）在父亲恩格尔贝特二世于1328年去世后成为马克伯爵。他先娶克莱沃的伊尔姆加德，婚姻于1324年解除；后在教皇特许下娶克莱沃伯爵迪特里希八世之女玛格丽特，他的儿子们正是凭借这段婚姻后来继承克莱沃伯国。作为埃森修道院的世俗保护人，他于1337年促成其姊妹卡塔琳娜当选该院院长。1347年10月，他在弗伦登贝格去世，长子恩格尔贝特三世继位；幼子阿道夫后来于1368年成为克莱沃伯爵。

en: Adolf III of the Mark (c. 1334–1394), second son of Adolf II and Margaret of Cleves, was made Bishop of Münster by Pope Innocent VI in 1357 and briefly served as Archbishop-Elector of Cologne in 1363, resigning to pursue the Cleves inheritance. Under a 1362 agreement with his uncle Engelbert of Liège, he succeeded the childless Count John of Cleves in 1368, ruling with Liège's support. In 1369 he married Margaret of Jülich. After his brother Engelbert III died without heirs in 1391, he inherited the Mark also and gave it to his son Dietrich in 1393.
zh: 阿道夫三世（约1334—1394）是阿道夫二世与克莱沃的玛格丽特的次子。1357年，教皇英诺森六世任命他为明斯特主教；1363年他短暂担任科隆大主教兼选帝侯，随后辞职以争取克莱沃继承权。根据1362年与任列日主教的叔父恩格尔贝特达成的协议，他于1368年继承无嗣的克莱沃伯爵约翰，并在列日支持下稳固统治。1369年，他娶于利希的玛格丽特为妻。1391年兄长恩格尔贝特三世无嗣而终，他又继承马克伯国，并于1393年将马克交给儿子迪特里希。

en: Dietrich I of the Mark (1336–1406) was the third son of Count Adolf II of the Mark and Margaret of Cleves. He held canonries in several churches and became provost of Cologne Cathedral. He twice administered the Prince-Bishopric of Osnabrück, but after being elected Bishop of Liège he declined the see and returned to secular life. When his brother Adolf secured Cleves in 1368, Dietrich received most of the Cleves lands on the right bank of the Rhine, including Dinslaken and Duisburg, ruling there as lord until his death.
zh: 迪特里希一世·冯·德马克（1336—1406）是马克伯爵阿道夫二世与克莱沃的玛格丽特的第三子。他在多座教堂担任法政牧师，后任科隆大教堂座堂教长，曾两度代管奥斯纳布吕克采邑主教区；在被选为列日主教后，他辞而不就，还俗过世俗生活。1368年兄长阿道夫取得克莱沃后，迪特里希获得莱茵河右岸的大部分克莱沃领地，包括丁斯拉肯和杜伊斯堡，以领主身份统治至去世。

en: Eberhard I of the Marck-Arenberg (c. 1305–1387), a younger son of Count Engelbert II of the Mark, was first trained as a cleric. He took a master's degree at Liège in 1326, studied canon law at Orléans until 1330, and in 1339 became provost of Münster Cathedral, later a canon and cantor at Cologne. In 1351 he left the Church to marry Maria of Looz, through whom he gained Peer and Neufchâteau in the Ardennes, and inherited Arenberg from his mother, founding the Mark-Arenberg line. His daughter Margareta became abbess of Essen.
zh: 埃伯哈德一世·冯·德马克-阿伦贝格（约1305—1387）是马克伯爵恩格尔贝特二世之子、阿道夫二世的弟弟，早年走上教士之路。他于1326年在列日取得硕士学位，其后在奥尔良学习教会法至1330年，1339年出任明斯特大教堂座堂教长，后来在科隆任法政牧师与唱诗班长。1351年，他离开教会，娶洛恩的玛丽亚为妻，借此获得阿登地区的佩尔和讷沙托，又从母亲手中继承阿伦贝格领地，开创了马克-阿伦贝格支系。他的女儿玛格丽塔后来成为埃森修道院女院长。

en: Eberhard I von der Mark (c.1255–4 July 1308) became count in 1277, after his father Engelbert I, abducted by Count Herman of Lohn, died imprisoned at Bredevoort; in 1278 Eberhard stormed the castle in revenge. From 1281 he allied with Berg, Cleves and Jülich against the Archbishops of Cologne and fought at Worringen in 1288: the victory freed the County of Mark from Cologne's overlordship and won him Brakel, Westhofen and Waltrop. By his wife Irmgard of Berg he fathered his successor Engelbert II, Adolf, later bishop of Liège, and Kunigunde. In 1301 he founded Bergneustadt.
zh: 埃伯哈德一世·冯·德马克（约1255—1308年7月4日）于1277年继位为马克伯爵：此前他的父亲恩格尔贝特一世被洛恩伯爵赫尔曼掳走，囚禁于布雷德福特并死在那里；1278年，埃伯哈德攻克该堡报仇。1281年起，他与贝格、克莱沃和于利希结盟对抗科隆大主教，1288年战于沃林根并获胜；此役使马克伯国摆脱科隆的宗主权，他还获得布拉克尔、韦斯特霍芬和瓦尔特罗普。妻子贝格的伊尔姆加德为他生下继承人恩格尔贝特二世、日后出任列日主教的阿道夫以及库妮贡德。1301年，他建立贝格诺伊施塔特城。

en: Engelbert II (1275–1328) ruled the County of Mark from 1308, succeeding his father Eberhard I, and through his 1299 marriage to Mechtilde of Arenberg also held Arenberg. He fought Bishop Ludwig II of Münster and Archbishop Henry II of Virneburg of Cologne; when Ludwig marched into Hamm in 1323, Engelbert captured him and freed him only after payment of five thousand silver marks. In the throne dispute between Frederick the Fair and Ludwig IV, he backed Ludwig. In 1321 he granted Bochum its town charter at Blankenstein Castle. His sons Adolf II and Eberhard inherited Mark and Arenberg.
zh: 恩格尔贝特二世（1275—1328）于1308年继父亲埃伯哈德一世之后成为马克伯爵；1299年他与阿伦贝格的梅希蒂尔德成婚，由此兼领阿伦贝格。他与明斯特主教路德维希二世、科隆大主教维尔讷堡的亨利二世对抗：1323年路德维希进军哈姆时被他俘获，支付五千马克白银的赎金后才获释。在美男子腓特烈与路易四世争夺德意志王位期间，他转而支持路易四世。1321年，他在布兰肯施泰因城堡授予波鸿城市特许状，其子阿道夫二世与埃伯哈德后来分别继承马克和阿伦贝格。

en: Engelbert III of the Mark (1333–1391), eldest son of Adolf II and Margaret of Cleves, succeeded as Count of the Mark in 1347, ruling from Blankenstein Castle. He allied with Cologne against Count Gottfried IV of Arnsberg, but Arnsberg was sold to the archbishopric, and he fought Cologne again in 1376–1377. When his brother Adolf inherited Cleves in 1368, Engelbert received the Cleves lands east of the Rhine. He married Richardis of Jülich in 1354 and Elisabeth of Sponheim in 1381, but left no son; dying of plague at Wetter in December 1391, he was succeeded by Adolf.
zh: 恩格尔贝特三世（1333—1391）是阿道夫二世与克莱沃的玛格丽特的长子，1347年继位为马克伯爵，常驻布兰肯施泰因城堡。他起初与科隆结盟，对抗阿恩斯贝格伯爵戈特弗里德四世，但阿恩斯贝格最终被卖给科隆大主教区，他又于1376—1377年与科隆交战。1368年弟弟阿道夫继承克莱沃后，把莱茵河以东的克莱沃领地让给他。他于1354年娶于利希的理查迪斯，1381年娶施蓬海姆的伊丽莎白，但没有儿子；1391年12月他在韦特城堡死于鼠疫，由弟弟阿道夫继位。

en: Engelbert III of the Mark (1304–1368), second son of Count Engelbert II, became provost of Liège in 1332 and was named its Prince-Bishop by Pope Clement VI in 1345. He at once faced a city revolt, was defeated at Vottem in 1346 but beat the rebels at Tourinne in 1347, ending the unrest with concessions. He lost the Cologne see to his nephew Adolf in 1362, but Pope Urban V made him Archbishop and Elector of Cologne in 1364 after Adolf resigned. Ailing, he took Kuno II of Falkenstein as coadjutor in 1366 and died in August 1368.
zh: 恩格尔贝特三世·冯·德马克（1304—1368）是马克伯爵恩格尔贝特二世的次子，1332年成为列日座堂教长，1345年被教皇克雷芒六世任命为列日采邑主教。他上任伊始便遭遇列日城市叛乱，1346年在沃泰姆之战中战败，1347年在图兰讷之战中击败叛军，随后以让步平息动乱。1362年他竞争科隆大主教之位，败给侄子阿道夫；1364年阿道夫辞职后，教皇乌尔班五世任命他为科隆大主教兼选帝侯。他体弱多病，1366年接受库诺二世·冯·法尔肯施泰因担任助理主教，1368年8月去世。

en: Margaret of the Mark (died 29 September 1409) was a daughter of Count Adolf II of the Mark and Margaret of Cleves. Her parents betrothed her as a child to the future John I of Nassau-Siegen by a contract of 14 August 1343, and the wedding took place on 30 November 1357. The marriage brought John revenues from Gummersbach and Hamm in the County of the Mark and claims to Cleves. She was the mother of Nassau-Siegen counts Adolf I, John II, Engelbert I and John III, who jointly succeeded their father in 1416.
zh: 马克的玛格丽特（1409年9月29日卒）是马克伯爵阿道夫二世与克莱沃的玛格丽特之女。1343年8月14日，双方父母签订婚约，将她许配给后来的拿骚-锡根伯爵约翰一世，婚礼于1357年11月30日举行。这段婚姻为约翰带来马克伯国境内古默斯巴赫和哈姆的收入，以及对克莱沃的继承主张。她生有阿道夫一世、约翰二世、恩格尔贝特一世和约翰三世，四子于1416年共同继承父亲之位。

en: Margaret of Cleves (c. 1310 – after 1348) was a daughter of Count Dietrich VIII of Cleves and Margaret of Guelders. In 1332 she married Count Adolf II of the Marck, bearing him seven children, among them Engelbert III and Adolf III. In 1333 her father issued an inheritance law settling Cleves on Margaret and her sisters, but his brother John objected and had it repealed in 1338. After Adolf died and Dietrich died in 1347, Margaret and her sons pressed her claim to Cleves against John, who prevailed; her son Adolf finally secured the county in 1368.
zh: 克莱沃的玛格丽特（约1310—1348年后）是克莱沃伯爵迪特里希八世与海尔德的玛格丽特之女。1332年，她嫁给马克伯爵阿道夫二世，生下恩格尔贝特三世、阿道夫三世等七个子女。1333年，她的父亲颁布继承法，规定克莱沃伯国由玛格丽特与她的姐妹继承，但叔父约翰提出反对，并于1338年促成该法废除。阿道夫二世去世、迪特里希八世于1347年去世后，玛格丽特与儿子们向约翰主张克莱沃的继承权，未能成功；她的儿子阿道夫最终于1368年取得克莱沃伯国。

en: Mechtild of the Mark was a daughter of Count Adolf II of the Mark and Margaret of Cleves. In 1371 she married Count Eberhard II of Isenburg-Grenzau, by whom she was the mother of Philipp II of Isenburg-Grenzau.
zh: 梅希蒂尔德·冯·德马克是马克伯爵阿道夫二世与克莱沃的玛格丽特之女，1371年嫁给伊森堡-格伦曹伯爵埃伯哈德二世，是伊森堡-格伦曹的菲利普二世的母亲。

en: Agnes of Chalon (died after October 1350) was the daughter of John I, Count of Chalon, by his third wife Laure de Commercy. In 1285 she married Count Amadeus II of Geneva, tying him to her brother John I of Chalon-Arlay and his Habsburg connections. She bore five children, among them William III, who succeeded his father. Amadeus's will of 1306 named her regent for their children, but on his death in 1308 the adult William claimed power; her brother mediated a settlement in 1311. She made her will in October 1350 and chose Geneva's Franciscan church as her burial place.
zh: 沙隆的艾格尼丝（1350年10月后卒）是沙隆伯爵约翰一世与第三任妻子洛尔·德·科梅尔西之女。1285年，她嫁给日内瓦伯爵阿梅迪奥二世，这桩婚事使伯爵与她的兄长沙隆-阿尔莱领主约翰一世及其身边的哈布斯堡阵营结盟。她生有五个子女，其中包括继位为伯爵的威廉三世。阿梅迪奥1306年的遗嘱指定她摄政监护子女，但1308年伯爵去世后，已成年的威廉要求亲政，她的兄长出面调停，于1311年达成和解。她于1350年10月立下遗嘱，选择日内瓦的方济各会教堂作为葬地。

en: Agnes of Savoy (1286–1322) was a daughter of Count Amadeus V of Savoy and Sibylle of Bâgé and sister of the future counts Edward and Aymon. On 31 August 1297, amid the wars between Geneva and Savoy, she was contracted to marry William, heir to the County of Geneva; he became Count William III in 1308. Their son Amadeus, the future Amadeus III of Geneva, was born on 29 March 1311, and they had two daughters. William died in 1320, leaving Agnes her dowry and Genevois lands. She died on 4 October 1322 and was buried at Hautecombe Abbey.
zh: 阿格妮丝·德·萨伏依（1286—1322）是萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥五世与博热的西比耶之女，与后来的萨伏依伯爵爱德华、艾蒙为姊妹。1297年8月31日，正值日内瓦与萨伏依交战之际，她与日内瓦伯国继承人纪尧姆订立婚约，后者于1308年继位为纪尧姆三世。两人的儿子阿梅迪奥生于1311年3月29日，即后来的日内瓦伯爵阿梅迪奥三世，另有两个女儿。纪尧姆于1320年去世，为她留下嫁妆和热讷瓦的地产。她于1322年10月4日去世，葬于欧特孔布修道院。

en: Amadeus II (died 22 May 1308) was Count of Geneva from 1280, succeeding his brother Aymon II. A son of Count Rudolf of Geneva and Marie de Coligny, he inherited a county burdened by debt and surrounded by the expanding lands of Savoy. He fought Amadeus V of Savoy in coalitions from 1282, with allies including the Dauphin of Viennois and Rudolf of Habsburg, but by 1287 had to do homage at Annemasse. Renewing the war in 1304, he built the fortress of Gaillard near Geneva and accepted papal arbitration in 1306. He married Agnes of Chalon in 1285 and died near Vuache castle in 1308, leaving Geneva to his son William III.
zh: 阿梅迪奥二世（1308年5月22日卒）自1280年起任日内瓦伯爵，继承了兄长艾蒙二世。他是日内瓦伯爵鲁道夫与玛丽·德·科利尼之子，继承的伯国债务沉重，四周为不断扩张的萨伏依领地包围。1282年起，他联合维埃纳王太子与哈布斯堡的鲁道夫参加反萨伏依同盟，但到1287年被迫在阿讷马斯向阿梅迪奥五世宣誓效忠。1304年战事再起，他在日内瓦附近修建加亚尔堡垒，并于1306年接受教皇仲裁。1285年他娶沙隆的艾格尼丝为妻，1308年死于维阿什城堡附近，日内瓦由其子威廉三世继承。

en: Amadeus III of Geneva (1311–1367) succeeded his father William III as count of Geneva in 1320, under the regency of his grandmother Agnes of Chalon and mother Agnes of Savoy until 1325. He ruled the Genevois, but not the city of Geneva. Caught in the old struggle between Savoy and the Dauphin of Viennois, he fought at Varey in 1325 on the Dauphin's side against his uncle, Count Edward of Savoy; in 1329 he did homage to Count Aymon of Savoy, ending nearly a century of conflict. From 1343 he shared the regency of Savoy with Louis II of Vaud for the boy count Amadeus VI. But in 1355 he had to admit defeat as Savoy swept its neighbours, and his county was left enclosed by Savoyard lands. In 1358 Charles IV took him under imperial protection, a way out of Savoyard jurisdiction. Five sons succeeded him in turn, the last becoming the Avignon antipope Clement VII.
zh: 阿梅迪奥三世（1311—1367）1320年继承父亲纪尧姆三世为日内瓦伯爵，1325年前由祖母沙隆的阿涅丝与母亲萨伏依的阿涅丝摄政。他统治日内瓦伯领，但不包括日内瓦城。在萨伏依与维埃诺王太子的旧怨中，他于1325年站在王太子一边，在瓦雷战役中对阵身为舅父的萨伏依伯爵爱德华；1329年，他向萨伏依伯爵艾蒙行臣服礼，结束了近百年的冲突。1343年起，他与沃男爵路易二世共同为年幼的萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥六世摄政。然而1355年萨伏依大举进攻邻国，他被迫认输，伯国从此被萨伏依的领地团团围住。1358年，皇帝查理四世将他置于帝国保护之下，使他得以脱离萨伏依的管辖。他的五个儿子相继继位，幼子罗贝尔后来成为阿维尼翁对立教宗克雷芒七世。

en: Amadeus IV of Geneva (died 4 December 1369) was the second son of Amadeus III and Mathilde d'Auvergne, and one of five brothers who held the county in turn. In 1367 he succeeded his childless elder brother Aymon III, and that year confirmed the franchises of Annecy. His father and brother had kept close to Savoy; he reversed that policy and backed the bishops of Lausanne and Geneva against his cousin Count Amadeus VI of Savoy. Yet on 13 May 1368 he did homage to Amadeus for the county. He then joined Amadeus's Italian campaign against Philip II of Piedmont and attended Philip's trial at Rivoli, possibly in the hope of speaking with the Emperor, who was in the region. In February 1369 Charles IV again revoked the Savoyard count's vicariate and declared Geneva an immediate imperial fief. Amadeus died that December.
zh: 阿梅迪奥四世（？—1369年12月4日）是阿梅迪奥三世与玛蒂尔达·德·奥弗涅的次子，也是先后执掌伯国的五兄弟之一。1367年，无嗣的兄长艾蒙三世去世，他继任日内瓦伯爵，同年确认阿讷西的城市特许状。父亲和兄长一向亲近萨伏依，他却反其道而行，支持洛桑和日内瓦主教对抗表兄萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥六世。然而1368年5月13日，他还是为日内瓦伯国向阿梅迪奥六世行臣服礼。随后他参加阿梅迪奥六世征讨皮埃蒙特的腓力二世的意大利战事，并在里沃利出席对腓力的审判，或许是想借机面见当时也在当地的皇帝。1369年2月，皇帝查理四世再次撤销萨伏依伯爵的帝国代理权，宣布日内瓦为帝国直领封地。同年12月，阿梅迪奥去世。

en: Eleanor of Joinville was the daughter of William of Joinville, seigneur of Gex, and Joan of Savoy, herself daughter of Louis I of Vaud. On the death of her brother Hugh, the last seigneur of the Joinville-Gex line, she inherited the barony of Gex. In 1351 she married Hugh of Geneva, who held Gex through her and refused homage to Count Amadeus VI of Savoy. Savoyard troops seized Gex after the battle of Les Abrets in April 1354, and the treaty of Paris of January 1355 assigned the Pays de Gex to Savoy. Her marriage was childless.
zh: 埃莉诺·德·茹安维尔是热克斯领主纪尧姆·德·茹安维尔与沃的路易一世之女让娜·德·萨伏依的女儿。其兄于格去世后，她作为茹安维尔-热克斯家族的继承人继承了热克斯男爵领。1351年，她嫁给于格·德·日内瓦，后者凭她的身份领有热克斯，并拒绝向萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥六世效忠。1354年4月阿布雷战役后，萨伏依军队攻占热克斯，1355年1月的《巴黎条约》将热克斯地区划归萨伏依。这段婚姻没有留下子嗣。

en: William III of Geneva (1280–1320) was count of Geneva from 1308, when he succeeded his father Amadeus II. A peace treaty between his father and Savoy in 1291 led to his betrothal to Beatrice of Savoy. After that agreement was annulled, he married her sister Agnes, daughter of Count Amadeus V, in 1297. His succession brought a dispute with his mother Agnes of Chalon, settled by an agreement in 1308. He made perpetual peace with Savoy in October 1308 at Saint-Georges-d'Espéranche, acknowledging several castles as fiefs of the count, and in 1316 did homage to the dauphin of Viennois. His children with Agnes included Amadeus III, born in 1311, who succeeded him. William made his will at Annecy in April 1319 and died the following year.
zh: 纪尧姆三世（1280—1320）1308年继承父亲阿梅迪奥二世，成为日内瓦伯爵。1291年，父亲与萨伏依的和约促成了他与萨伏依的贝阿特丽丝的婚约；婚约废除后，他于1297年娶了她的妹妹、伯爵阿梅迪奥五世之女阿涅丝。继位时，他与母亲沙隆的阿涅丝发生争执，双方于1308年达成协议。1308年10月，他在圣乔治德斯佩朗什与萨伏依订立永久和约，承认多座城堡为萨伏依伯爵的封地；1316年又向维埃纳的王太子行臣服礼。他与阿涅丝的子女包括1311年出生的阿梅迪奥三世，后来继承其位。纪尧姆于1319年4月在阿讷西立下遗嘱，次年去世。

en: Mathilde d'Auvergne, also called Mahaut de Boulogne (c. 1318 – 24 October 1399), was a daughter of Count Robert VII of Auvergne and Boulogne. In 1334 she married Count Amadeus III of Geneva and bore him ten children, five sons and five daughters. The five sons succeeded to Geneva in turn, and the youngest, Robert, became the Avignon antipope Clement VII. As pope he left the government of the county to his mother and named his nephew Humbert of Villars as heir. When Robert died in 1394, the widowed countess and her daughters contested Humbert's succession; in a suit opened in 1395 she claimed usufruct of the county and the castles of Gruffy and Thônes. She made her will at Rumilly in 1396 and died in 1399. Her surviving daughters Blanche and Catherine were named heirs to her goods and rights, and Blanche took the title of countess of Geneva.
zh: 玛蒂尔达·德·奥弗涅，又称马霍·德·布洛涅（约1318—1399年10月24日），是奥弗涅与布洛涅伯爵罗贝尔七世之女。1334年，她嫁给日内瓦伯爵阿梅迪奥三世，生有五子五女。五个儿子相继继承日内瓦，幼子罗贝尔成为阿维尼翁对立教宗克雷芒七世。他以教宗之身把伯国政务交给母亲，并指定外甥安贝尔·德·维拉尔为继承人。1394年罗贝尔去世后，守寡的伯爵夫人与女儿们对安贝尔的继承提出异议；她在1395年开始的诉讼中要求取得伯国的用益权以及格吕菲和托讷两座城堡。她于1396年在吕米伊立下遗嘱，1399年去世。幸存的女儿布朗什与卡特琳被指定为她财产和权利的继承人，日内瓦女伯爵的头衔由布朗什承袭。

en: Gonçalo da Silveira (1526–1561) was a Portuguese Jesuit born at Almeirim, the tenth child of the first count of Sortelha. He joined the Society of Jesus at Coimbra and from 1555 served as provincial superior of the Jesuits in India. In 1560 he sailed for south-east Africa, landing at Sofala, and in 1561 he reached the court of the Mwenemutapa Negomo. He refused the king's gifts and gave him a painting of the Virgin Mary; at Negomo's request he instructed and baptised the king and his mother, as well as hundreds of Shona nobles. A traditional account relates that rivals accused him of witchcraft and spying. He was strangled on 15–16 March 1561 and thrown into the Musengezi River.
zh: 贡萨洛·达·西尔韦拉（1526—1561）是葡萄牙耶稣会传教士，生于阿尔梅林，为第一代索尔特利亚伯爵的第十个孩子。他在科英布拉加入耶稣会，1555年起任耶稣会印度省会长。1560年他前往非洲东南部，在索法拉登陆，1561年抵达姆韦尼穆塔帕内戈莫的宫廷。他拒收国王的馈赠，赠予国王一幅圣母像；应内戈莫请求，他教导国王与王母并为他们施洗，又为数百名绍纳贵族施洗。按传统说法，政敌指控他行巫术、充当间谍。1561年3月15至16日他被勒死，尸体抛入穆森盖济河。

en: Albert I of Gorizia (c. 1240 – 1 April 1304) was the younger son of Count Meinhard III and Adelaide of Tyrol. After their father was defeated by Carinthian and Salzburg forces, Albert and his brother Meinhard IV were held hostage at Hohenwerfen Castle from 1253 until their release in 1262. The brothers ruled jointly until dividing their inheritance in 1271, when Albert kept the County of Gorizia and lands in Friuli, Istria, Carniola and the Puster Valley. He fought the Venetians alongside the patriarchs of Aquileia and backed Rudolf I against Ottokar II of Bohemia, campaigning in Carniola and Styria. His sons Henry III and Albert II succeeded him in turn.
zh: 阿尔贝一世（约1240—1304年4月1日）是戈里齐亚—蒂罗尔伯爵迈因哈德三世与蒂罗尔的阿德尔海德的幼子。父亲被克恩滕与萨尔茨堡军队击败后，他和兄长迈因哈德四世从1253年起被扣在霍恩韦尔芬城堡为人质，1262年才获释。兄弟二人共同统治，1271年瓜分领地，阿尔贝获得戈里齐亚伯国及弗留利、伊斯特拉、卡尼奥拉和普斯特山谷的领地。他联合阿奎莱亚牧首与威尼斯作战，并支持鲁道夫一世对抗波希米亚国王奥托卡二世，出兵卡尼奥拉和施蒂里亚。他的儿子亨利三世和阿尔贝二世相继继位。

en: Albert II of Gorizia (died 1327 at Lienz) was a son of Count Albert I by his second wife Euphemia and the younger half-brother of Count Henry II. After Albert I partitioned the county in 1303, the Lienz treaties of 1307 assigned him the Anterior County, ruled from Bruck Castle near Lienz. In 1305 he accompanied his cousin Duke Henry of Carinthia to a Bohemian wedding. A reserved ruler, he built the Lienz town wall in 1311 and in April 1327 licensed a Jewish bank there. His wife Euphemia of Matsch bore the future counts Albert III, Henry III and Meinhard VI.
zh: 阿尔伯特二世（1327年卒于利恩茨）是阿尔伯特一世伯爵与第二任妻子奥伊菲米娅所生的儿子，海因里希二世伯爵的同父异母弟弟。阿尔伯特一世1303年瓜分伯国后，1307年的《利恩茨分割条约》把后来所称的“前伯国”分给他，他在利恩茨附近的布吕克城堡统治。1305年，他陪同堂兄卡林西亚公爵海因里希前往波希米亚参加婚礼。他为政低调，1311年修筑利恩茨城墙，1327年4月批准在当地开设一家犹太银行。妻子马奇的奥伊菲米娅生下后来的伯爵阿尔伯特三世、海因里希三世和迈因哈德六世。

en: Albert III of Gorizia (died 1374) was the eldest son of Count Albert II by Elizabeth of Hesse. From 1329 to 1338 he governed Gorizia, Friuli and Istria for his minor cousin John Henry IV. In 1338 the brothers inherited the county, ruling jointly; in 1339 Albert became sole count palatine of Carinthia, and in 1342 he waived his share of Gorizia and took instead Istria, the Windic March and Metlika. He married Helen and, in 1353, Catherine of Celje, both marriages childless.
zh: 阿尔贝三世（1374年卒）是戈里齐亚伯爵阿尔贝二世与黑森的伊丽莎白的长子。1329至1338年，他代年幼的堂弟约翰·亨利四世管理戈里齐亚、弗留利和伊斯特拉。1338年，兄弟几人共同继承伯国；1339年阿尔贝成为唯一的克恩滕行宫伯爵，1342年放弃对戈里齐亚的份额，改领伊斯特拉、温代奇边区和梅特利卡。他先后娶海伦以及1353年迎娶的采列的卡塔琳娜，两次婚姻都无子女。

en: Anne of Austria (1318 – 14 December 1343) was the youngest daughter of Frederick the Fair, King of the Romans, and Isabella of Aragon. After her father's reconciliation with Emperor Louis IV, she married Duke Henry XV of Lower Bavaria at Landshut on 21 September 1328; the union was childless and Henry died in 1333. On 29 September 1336 she married Count John Henry IV of Gorizia in Gorizia, and was widowed a second time in March 1338. She returned to Vienna, joined the Poor Clares and from 1341 served as abbess of their convent, where she died aged twenty-five.
zh: 奥地利的安妮（1318—1343年12月14日）是罗马人民的国王“美男子”腓特烈与阿拉贡的伊莎贝拉的幼女。父亲与皇帝路易四世和解后，她于1328年9月21日在兰茨胡特嫁给下巴伐利亚公爵亨利十五世；婚姻无子女，亨利于1333年去世。1336年9月29日，她在戈里齐亚嫁给伯爵约翰·亨利四世，1338年3月再度守寡。此后她返回维也纳加入贫穷修女会，1341年起出任修女院院长，1343年在该院去世，终年25岁。

en: Beatrix da Camino (c. 1279–1321) was a daughter of Gherardo III da Camino, lord of Treviso, by his Milanese wife Chiara della Torre. She married Henry III of Gorizia in 1297, a match her father arranged to seal an alliance, and bore Meinhard V.
zh: 贝阿特丽丝·达·卡米诺（约1279—1321）是特雷维索领主盖拉尔多三世·达·卡米诺与米兰妻子基娅拉·德拉·托雷之女。1297年，她作为父亲结盟安排的一部分嫁给戈里齐亚伯爵亨利三世，生下迈因哈德五世。

en: Beatrix of Lower Bavaria (1302–1360) was a Wittelsbach princess, the daughter of Duke Stephen I of Lower Bavaria and Jutta of Schweidnitz. In 1322 she married Count Henry III of Gorizia and bore him John Henry IV. When Henry died in 1323, the infant succeeded to the county and Beatrix served as co-regent and administrator of the Gorizia lands. After Patriarch Pagano of Aquileia died in 1332, she took over its secular government, and in 1333 the Friulian parliament named her captain general of Friuli.
zh: 贝娅特丽克丝（1302—1360）出身维特尔斯巴赫家族，是下巴伐利亚公爵施特凡一世与希维德尼察的尤塔之女。1322年她嫁给戈里齐亚伯爵亨利三世，育有约翰·亨利四世。1323年亨利三世去世，幼子继承伯国，贝娅特丽克丝出任共同摄政，掌管戈里齐亚领地。1332年阿奎莱亚牧首帕加诺去世后，她接掌阿奎莱亚的世俗行政，并于1333年获弗留利议会任命为弗留利总指挥官。

en: Elisabeth of Hesse (c. 1276 – after 30 October 1308), a daughter of Landgrave Henry I of Hesse, married Count Albert II of Gorizia in March 1299. A great-granddaughter of Saint Elisabeth of Thuringia, she likely helped spread that saint's cult at Albert's residence of Lienz.
zh: 黑森的伊丽莎白（约1276—1308年10月30日后）是黑森方伯亨利一世之女。1299年3月她嫁给戈里齐亚伯爵阿尔贝二世。她是图林根的圣伊丽莎白的曾孙女，可能曾在丈夫的驻地利恩茨推动这位圣徒的崇拜。

en: Engelbert I (died 14 December 1122) was an early count of the Meinhardiner dynasty and the elder brother of Count Meinhard I of Gorizia. After the Aribonid count Rapoto V died in 1099, Engelbert received the Bavarian count palatinate as a kinsman of Count Palatine Aribo II, and in 1102–1104 he inherited further Aribonid lands, including the advocacy of Millstatt Abbey. He ruled the Gorizia lands in the upper Puster Valley jointly with his brother Meinhard I, and in 1122 he ceded the Millstatt advocacy to the Holy See. The Millstatt necrology records his death on 14 December 1122.
zh: 恩格尔贝特一世（1122年12月14日去世）是迈因哈德家族早期伯爵，戈里齐亚伯爵迈因哈德一世的兄长。1099年阿里博家族的拉波托五世死后，他以行宫伯爵阿里博二世亲戚的身份领有巴伐利亚行宫伯国，1102—1104年又继承阿里博家族的其他领地，包括米尔施塔特修道院的护院权。他与弟弟迈因哈德一世共同统治上普斯特山谷的戈里齐亚领地，1122年把米尔施塔特护院权让给教廷，米尔施塔特修道院的亡者名录记载他死于1122年12月14日。

en: Engelbert II (died 1 April 1191) was a younger son of Count Meinhard I of Gorizia and Elisabeth of Schwarzenburg. First mentioned in 1137 as advocate of Millstatt Abbey, he was made Count Palatine of Carinthia about 1145. In 1150 he inherited Gorizia from his elder brother Henry II and ruled it until his death; he also held the advocacies of Aquileia and Saint Peter's Abbey in Istria and the margraviate of Istria. A loyal Hohenstaufen supporter, he rivalled the Andechs dukes of Merania in Istria. By his wife Adelaide of Scheyern-Dachau-Valley he fathered Engelbert III and Meinhard II.
zh: 恩格尔贝特二世（1191年4月1日去世）是戈里齐亚伯爵迈因哈德一世与施瓦岑堡的伊丽莎白较年幼的儿子之一。他在1137年首次以米尔施塔特修道院护院官的身份被记载，约1145年受任卡林西亚行宫伯爵，1150年继兄长海因里希二世之后成为戈里齐亚伯爵，直至去世。他还掌握阿奎莱亚和伊斯特拉圣彼得修道院的护院权，并一度据有伊斯特拉藩侯之位。作为霍亨斯陶芬家族的坚定支持者，他在伊斯特拉与安德希斯家族的梅拉尼亚公爵争衡。妻子沙伊恩-达豪-瓦利的阿德莱德为他生下恩格尔贝特三世和迈因哈德二世。

en: Engelbert III (died 1220) of the Meinhardiner dynasty ruled the County of Gorizia from 1191 until his death. He was the son of Count Engelbert II and Adelaide, daughter of Count Otto I of Scheyern. On his father's death in 1191 he inherited the county jointly with his brother Meinhard II. During his reign he held the advocacies of the Patriarchate of Aquileia and Millstatt Abbey. In 1183 he married Matilda, Countess of Pisino, and in 1190 he remarried Matilda of Andechs, daughter of Margrave Berthold I of Istria; the second Matilda bore his successor, Meinhard III.
zh: 恩格尔贝特三世（1220年卒）是迈因哈德家族成员，1191年起统治戈里齐亚伯国，直到去世。他是恩格尔贝特二世与沙伊恩伯爵奥托一世之女阿德莱德的儿子，1191年父亲去世后与兄弟迈因哈德二世共同继承伯国。他在位时身兼阿奎莱亚宗主教区和米尔施塔特修道院的护院官。1183年他先娶皮西诺女伯爵玛蒂尔德，1190年续娶伊斯特拉藩侯贝特霍尔德一世之女安德希斯的玛蒂尔德，第二位玛蒂尔德生下了他的继承人迈因哈德三世。

en: Euphemia of Matsch (died around 1353) was the daughter of Ulrich II, bailiff of Matsch, and Margareta von Vaz. She became the second wife of Albert II of Gorizia, who ruled the county as regent for his nephew John Henry IV from 1323 until his death in 1327. Her sons Henry V and Meinhard VI and their half-brother Albert III succeeded as counts of Gorizia after John Henry IV died in 1338. In 1349 she and her sons founded the Carmelite monastery at Lienz, built for twelve friars. She is last documented around 1353.
zh: 曼德沙伊德的奥伊菲米娅（约1353年卒）是曼德沙伊德行政官乌尔里希二世与玛加蕾特·冯·瓦茨之女，后成为戈里齐亚伯爵阿尔贝二世的第二任妻子；阿尔贝自1323年起替侄子约翰·亨利四世摄政，1327年去世。约翰·亨利四世于1338年早逝后，她的儿子亨利五世、迈因哈德六世与继子阿尔贝三世成为戈里齐亚伯爵。1349年，她与儿子们在利恩茨创立加尔默罗会修道院，规模可容纳十二名修士。她最后一次见于记载约在1353年。

en: Henry II (died 1148 or 1149) was a son of Count Meinhard I of Gorizia and Elisabeth of Schwarzenburg. He first appears in 1139 with his father in a charter of Patriarch Pilgrim of Aquileia. After Meinhard I died about 1142, Henry ruled jointly with his brother Engelbert II, and he is last documented in 1147 as advocate of Aquileia. He apparently died unmarried without recorded wife or children, and the Aquileia mortuary rolls place his death on 10 or 11 October. The 21 April 1150 Treaty of Ramuscello already names him dead, after which Engelbert II ruled alone.
zh: 海因里希二世（1148或1149年卒）是戈里齐亚伯爵迈因哈德一世与施瓦岑堡的伊丽莎白之子。1139年，他首次随父亲出现在阿奎莱亚宗主教皮尔格里姆的文书中。约1142年迈因哈德一世去世后，他与兄弟恩格尔贝特二世共同统治，1147年最后一次以阿奎莱亚护院官的身份见于记载。他显然没有结婚，史料中找不到妻子或子女的记录；阿奎莱亚的亡者名录把他的卒日定于10月10或11日。1150年4月21日的《拉穆谢洛条约》已称他已故，此后恩格尔贝特二世独自统治。

en: Helen was the first wife of Count Albert III of Gorizia, who ruled from 1338; their marriage was childless, and in 1353 Albert married Catherine of Celje.
zh: 海伦是1338年起统治戈里齐亚的伯爵阿尔贝三世的第一任妻子，婚姻没有子女；1353年阿尔贝另娶采列的卡塔琳娜。

en: Henry III of Gorizia (c. 1263 – April 1323) was the elder son of Count Albert I and Euphemia of Głogów. In 1295–1299 he joined his father's invasion of Istria against Aquileia, taking Plomin, Labin, Buzet and Tolmin before a patriarchal army forced them to withdraw. He succeeded as count in 1304, inheriting fiefs in Friuli, Istria, Carniola and Carinthia, while his brother Albert received the Puster Valley. He first fought the patriarch alongside Rizzardo IV da Camino, then changed sides in 1310 to become the patriarchate's captain general and drive Treviso's troops from Friuli. He was podestà of Trieste in 1311. By Beatrix da Camino he had Meinhard V, and by Beatrix of Lower Bavaria John Henry IV.
zh: 戈里齐亚伯爵亨利三世（约1263—1323年4月）是阿尔贝一世与格沃古夫的奥伊菲米娅的长子。1295至1299年，他随父亲入侵伊斯特拉、进攻阿奎莱亚牧首区，攻占普洛明、拉宾、布泽特和托尔明，后因牧首军队到来而撤退。1304年他继位为伯爵，继承了家族在弗留利、伊斯特拉、卡尼奥拉和克恩滕的封地，弟弟阿尔贝则获得普斯特山谷。他起初联合里扎尔多四世·达·卡米诺与牧首作战，1310年倒戈成为牧首区的统帅，将特雷维索军队逐出弗留利，并于1311年出任的里雅斯特长官。第一任妻子贝阿特丽丝·达·卡米诺生下迈因哈德五世；第二任妻子下巴伐利亚的贝阿特丽丝生下约翰·亨利四世。

en: Henry V of Gorizia (died 1362) was a son of Count Albert II and his second wife Euphemia of Matsch. In 1338 he and his brothers Albert III and Meinhard VI inherited the County of Gorizia from their cousin John Henry IV and ruled it jointly. In 1349 Henry was appointed captain general of Friuli. He married Cigliola, daughter of Jacopo of Carrara, and died in 1362.
zh: 亨利五世（1362年卒）是戈里齐亚伯爵阿尔贝二世与第二任妻子曼德沙伊德的奥伊菲米娅之子。1338年，他与兄弟阿尔贝三世、迈因哈德六世一同继承堂兄约翰·亨利四世的戈里齐亚伯国，共同统治。1349年，亨利被任命为弗留利统帅。他娶卡拉拉的雅各布之女奇廖拉为妻，于1362年去世。

en: John Henry IV of Gorizia (1322–1338), the only surviving son of Count Henry III and Beatrix of Lower Bavaria, succeeded his father in 1323 as an infant. His mother, his uncle Albert II and, after 1329, his cousin Albert III acted as regents. In 1332, aged nine, Trieste elected him its podestà against Venetian expansion. His betrothal to Beatrice of Sicily was cancelled in 1335; by the treaty of Ljubljana he married Anna of Habsburg, daughter of anti-king Frederick the Fair, in a childless marriage. He died in 1338 and was buried at Rosazzo Abbey, succeeded by Albert II's sons.
zh: 约翰·亨利四世（1322—1338）是戈里齐亚伯爵亨利三世与下巴伐利亚的贝阿特丽丝唯一存活的儿子，1323年在襁中继位。政务先后由母亲、叔父阿尔贝二世以及1329年之后的堂兄阿尔贝三世摄政。1332年，九岁的他被的里雅斯特选为长官，以缔结对抗威尼斯扩张的同盟。1335年，他与西西里的贝阿特丽丝的婚约被取消；依《卢布尔雅那条约》，他娶对立国王“美男子”腓特烈之女奥地利的安妮为妻，婚姻无子女。他于1338年去世，葬于罗萨佐修道院，由叔父阿尔贝二世的儿子们继位。

en: Margaret of Gorizia was a daughter of Count Albert II of Gorizia and his second wife Euphemia of Matsch, and the sister of Counts Albert III, Henry V and Meinhard VI, who jointly inherited the county in 1338.
zh: 戈里齐亚的玛格丽特是伯爵阿尔贝二世与第二任妻子曼德沙伊德的奥伊菲米娅之女，也是1338年共同继承伯国的阿尔贝三世、亨利五世和迈因哈德六世三位伯爵的姊妹。

en: Meginhard, also counted as Meinhard III, was a Bavarian count in the upper Lurngau around Lienz who died around 1090; he was probably the ancestor of the Meinhardiner dynasty of the Counts of Gorizia.
zh: 迈因哈德（亦被排作迈因哈德三世）是利恩茨一带上卢恩高的巴伐利亚籍伯爵，约1090年去世，可能是戈里齐亚伯爵所在的迈因哈德家族始祖。

en: Meinhard VI of Gorizia (died 1385) was the son of Count Albert II and Euphemia of Matsch. In 1338 he inherited Gorizia with his brothers Albert III and Henry V, and ruled alone from 1365. His claim to Tyrol failed when Countess Margaret ceded the county to Rudolf IV of Austria in 1363. He weakened the patriarchate of Aquileia, but Venice gained most; his debts forced him to mortgage Gorizia estates and withdraw to Schloss Bruck in Lienz. He married Catherine of Pfannberg and then Utehild of Matsch; his son Henry VI succeeded him after his death in May 1385 or later.
zh: 迈因哈德六世（1385年卒）是戈里齐亚伯爵阿尔贝二世与曼德沙伊德的奥伊菲米娅之子。1338年，他与兄弟阿尔贝三世、亨利五世共同继承戈里齐亚，1365年起独自统治。他对蒂罗尔伯国的继承权落空：1363年女伯爵玛格丽特将蒂罗尔让给奥地利公爵鲁道夫四世。他削弱了阿奎莱亚牧首区，最大受益者却是威尼斯；债务迫使他不断抵押戈里齐亚地产，退居利恩茨的布鲁克城堡。他先后娶普凡贝格的卡塔琳娜和曼德沙伊德的乌特希尔德；他于1385年5月或之后去世，由儿子亨利六世继位。

en: Meinhard I (died 1142) of the Meinhardiner dynasty was advocate of the Patriarchate of Aquileia and the first of his house documented as Count of Gorizia. He first appears in an Aquileia charter in 1120–1121; around 1120 he and his brother Engelbert I were involved in a patriarchal donation to a church of Saint John. In 1139 the patriarchate's villages complained about his ruthless tax collectors. In January 1142 he witnessed for King Conrad III at Regensburg; dying, he granted three vineyards to Saint Peter's Abbey, Salzburg. The Aquileia and Millstatt necrologies date his death to 14 September 1142. His wife Elissa of Schwarzenburg bore him the future counts Engelbert II and Henry II.
zh: 迈因哈德一世（1142年卒）是迈因哈德家族成员，任阿奎莱亚宗主教区护院官，也是家族中第一个有文献记载的戈里齐亚伯爵。1120—1121年，他首次出现在阿奎莱亚的文书中；约1120年，他与兄弟恩格尔贝特一世参与了宗主教向一座圣约翰教堂的捐赠。1139年，宗主教区的村庄控诉他的税吏横征暴敛。1142年1月，他在雷根斯堡为国王康拉德三世作证，临终前把三处葡萄园赠给萨尔茨堡的圣彼得修道院。阿奎莱亚和米尔施塔特的亡者名录把他的卒日定于1142年9月14日。妻子施瓦岑堡的伊丽莎白为他生下后来的伯爵恩格尔贝特二世和海因里希二世。

en: Meinhard II, called the Elder (c. 1163 – 1231), was a younger son of Count Engelbert II of Gorizia and Vogt, or reeve, of the Patriarchate of Aquileia. In 1192 he tried to seize Richard the Lionheart, shipwrecked near Aquileia returning from crusade, but the king escaped into Austria. He joined Emperor Henry VI's crusade of 1197 and witnessed Duke Frederick I of Austria die at Acre in 1198. Quarrels with the patriarchal church earned him temporary excommunication around 1216. In 1220 he succeeded his brother Engelbert III as count of Gorizia. Meinhard married three times, but none of his children survived childhood; his nephew Meinhard III succeeded him.
zh: 迈因哈德二世，绰号“长者”（约1163—1231），是戈里齐亚伯爵恩格尔贝特二世的幼子，曾任阿奎莱亚牧首区的福格特，即行政代管人。1192年，英王狮心王理查十字军东征归途在阿奎莱亚附近遇险，迈因哈德企图将他擒获，但理查逃入奥地利。他参加了皇帝亨利六世1197年发动的十字军，1198年在阿卡见证奥地利公爵腓特烈一世去世。他与牧首区教会的争执使他在约1216年被短暂处以绝罚。1220年，他继兄长恩格尔贝特三世任戈里齐亚伯爵。他结过三次婚，但子女都夭折了；死后由侄子迈因哈德三世继位。

en: Meinhard III (c. 1200–1258) was Count of Gorizia from 1231 and, jure uxoris, Count of Tyrol as Meinhard I from 1253. He was the son of Engelbert III and Matilda of Andechs. An ally of Emperor Frederick II against Pope Innocent IV, he governed Styria, Carniola and Austria as imperial governor after 1246, until Ottokar II expelled him in 1251. Defeated at Greifenburg in September 1252, he surrendered his sons as hostages under the Peace of Lieserhofen. In 1253 he secured southern Tyrol. He died on 22 July 1258 at Tirol Castle, leaving sons Meinhard II and Albert I.
zh: 迈因哈德三世（约1200—1258）1231年起任戈里齐亚伯爵，1253年又凭借妻权成为蒂罗尔伯爵（称迈因哈德一世）。他是恩格尔贝特三世与安德希斯的玛蒂尔德之子。作为皇帝腓特烈二世反对教皇英诺森四世的坚定盟友，1246年后他以帝国总督身份治理施蒂利亚、卡尼奥拉和奥地利，1251年被奥托卡二世驱逐。1252年9月他在格赖芬堡战败，被迫按《利瑟霍芬和约》交出儿子作为人质，1253年取得南蒂罗尔。1258年7月22日他在蒂罗尔城堡去世，留下儿子迈因哈德二世和阿尔伯特一世。

en: Meinhard V of Gorizia (born after 1297, died after 1318) was a son of Count Henry III and his first wife Beatrix da Camino, of the Albertine line of the House of Gorizia. Little is recorded of his life, but he probably ruled jointly with his father. Around 1314 Henry III negotiated his marriage to a daughter of King James II of Aragon. He died before his father, and in 1323 the county passed to his younger half-brother John Henry IV.
zh: 迈因哈德五世（1297年后生，1318年后卒）是戈里齐亚伯爵亨利三世与第一任妻子贝阿特丽丝·达·卡米诺之子，属戈里齐亚家族的阿尔贝支系。其生平记载很少，可能与父亲共同执政。约1314年，亨利三世曾安排他与阿拉贡国王海梅二世的一个女儿成婚。他先于父亲去世，1323年伯国由其同父异母弟约翰·亨利四世继承。

en: Abu Said Faraj ibn Ismail (1248–1320) was a Nasrid prince, nephew of Muhammad I and trusted adviser to Sultans Muhammad II and Muhammad III. After his father's death Muhammad I brought him to court, where he befriended the future Muhammad II. He married Muhammad II's daughter Fatima and in 1279 became governor of Málaga, the emirate's chief port, recovered that year from the Marinids. He restored the city's economy, built up the Granadan navy and in 1306 led the conquest of Ceuta. In 1311 he rebelled against Sultan Nasr to place his son Ismail on the throne; his forces captured castles but failed to besiege the capital. After he attempted to surrender Málaga to the Marinids, he was deposed and imprisoned by Ismail, dying in 1320.
zh: 阿布·赛义德·法拉杰·本·伊斯玛仪（1248—1320）是奈斯尔王朝宗室，穆罕默德一世之侄，也是穆罕默德二世和穆罕默德三世两任素丹信赖的顾问。父亲去世后，穆罕默德一世将他带入宫廷，他在那里与日后的穆罕默德二世结为朋友。他娶穆罕默德二世之女法蒂玛为妻，1279年被任命为马拉加总督——这座埃米尔国最重要的港口当年刚从马林王朝手中收复。他恢复当地经济、造船充实格拉纳达海军，并于1306年率军攻占休达。1311年他起兵反对素丹纳斯尔，企图拥立儿子伊斯玛仪登基；他的军队攻占数座堡垒，却未能围攻首都。此后他试图把马拉加献给马林王朝，遭废黜并被伊斯玛仪囚禁，1320年死于狱中。

en: 'Alwa was a Christian concubine and favourite of Sultan Ismail I of Granada, and mother of Muhammad IV, Prince Faraj, and princesses Fatima and Maryam. Ismail separated from her before his death in 1325; she was alive in 1333.
zh: 阿勒瓦是格拉纳达苏丹伊斯梅尔一世宠爱的基督徒妃子，是穆罕默德四世、王子法拉杰及法蒂玛、麦尔彦两位公主的生母。伊斯梅尔一世在1325年去世前与她分居，1333年时她仍在世。

en: Bahar was a woman of Christian origin who became an umm walad, a freed concubine, of Sultan Ismail I of Granada. Her only child was Ismail's third son Yusuf, born in the Alhambra on 29 June 1318, and he lived in her house until 1333, when at fifteen he took the throne as Yusuf I after his brother Muhammad IV was assassinated. His reign and that of his son came to be seen as Granada's golden age. The vizier Ibn al-Khatib praised her good deeds, chastity and equanimity. In 1350 Yusuf lay sick when the traveller Ibn Battuta reached Granada and sought an audience, and it was Bahar who gave him money for his stay.
zh: 巴赫是基督教地区出身的女子，成为格拉纳达素丹伊斯玛仪一世的“乌姆·瓦莱德”，即生子后获释的妾。她唯一的孩子是伊斯玛仪的第三子优素福，1318年6月29日生于阿兰布拉宫。优素福一直住在她的住所，1333年其兄穆罕默德四世遇刺，十五岁的他继位，称优素福一世。他和儿子的统治后来被视为格拉纳达的黄金时代。维齐尔伊本·哈提卜称赞她乐善好施、持身贞静、性情平和。1350年旅行家伊本·白图泰来到格拉纳达请求觐见，优素福正在病中，是巴赫赠给他足够停留期间使用的钱财。

en: Faraj was a Nasrid prince of Granada, a son of Sultan Ismail I by his Christian concubine 'Alwa. He was the younger brother of Sultan Muhammad IV and the elder brother of Sultan Yusuf I.
zh: 法拉杰是格拉纳达的奈斯尔王子，苏丹伊斯梅尔一世与基督徒妃子阿勒瓦之子，为穆罕默德四世之弟、优素福一世之兄。

en: Fatima bint al-Ahmar (c. 1260–1349) was the Nasrid princess who held her dynasty together through a run of coups and boy sultans. A daughter of Sultan Muhammad II of Granada, she was trained in the barnamaj, the biobibliographies of Islamic scholars, and married her father's cousin and adviser Abu Said Faraj, governor of Málaga, where she raised their children. When her half-brother Nasr grew unpopular, she allied with the factions seeking to overthrow him: her husband rebelled in 1311, and in 1314 their son Ismail deposed Nasr and reigned as Ismail I, the first Nasrid to inherit the throne through the female line. She helped him govern. When his son Muhammad IV came to the throne at ten, and later Yusuf I at fifteen, Fatima served as their guardian, and Ibn al-Khatib called her ‘the Sultan's Grandmother’. She died in 1349; his elegy for her is the only one ever written for a Nasrid princess.
zh: 法蒂玛·宾特·艾哈迈尔（约1260—1349）是在接连不断的政变和幼主继位中撑住奈斯尔王朝的公主。她是格拉纳达素丹穆罕默德二世之女，精通“巴尔纳马吉”之学，即伊斯兰学者传记目录学；她嫁给父亲的堂亲兼顾问、马拉加总督阿布·赛义德·法拉杰，在马拉加抚养子女。异母弟纳斯尔渐失人心时，她与谋求推翻他的派系结盟：丈夫于1311年起兵，1314年其子伊斯玛仪推翻纳斯尔，登基为伊斯玛仪一世，成为首位经由母系继承王位的奈斯尔君主。她协助儿子治国。伊斯玛仪之子穆罕默德四世十岁继位，后来优素福一世十五岁继位，法蒂玛都是他们的监护人，伊本·哈提卜称她为“素丹的祖母”。她于1349年去世，伊本·哈提卜为她写的挽歌，是奈斯尔王朝唯一一首献给公主的挽歌。

en: Fatima was a Nasrid princess of Granada, a daughter of Sultan Ismail I by his Christian concubine 'Alwa, and a sister of Sultans Muhammad IV and Yusuf I.
zh: 法蒂玛是格拉纳达的奈斯尔公主，苏丹伊斯梅尔一世与基督徒妃子阿勒瓦之女，是穆罕默德四世与优素福一世的姐妹。

en: Abu Abdallah ibn al-Hakim al-Rundi (1261 – 14 March 1309) was a Ronda-born scholar and poet of the Banu al-Hakim, a branch of the Abbadid dynasty. After studying in the east from 1284, including at Mecca and Medina, he entered Sultan Muhammad II's chancery in 1287 as a secretary. He also mediated between the sultan and his own brothers when they rebelled. Under Muhammad III he became sole vizier in 1303 with the title dhu al-wizaratayn. He made peace with Castile and seized Ceuta from the Marinids, provoking a triple alliance of Castile, Aragon and the Marinids. His policies and extravagant life angered the people of Granada. On 14 March 1309 a mob sacked his palace; Muhammad III was deposed and Abu Abdallah killed by rival Atiq ibn al-Mawl.
zh: 阿布·阿卜杜拉·伊本·哈基姆·伦迪（1261—1309年3月14日）出生于龙达，是学者兼诗人，出身阿拔德王朝支系巴努·哈基姆家族。1284年他赴东方求学，曾到麦加和麦地那，1287年进入苏丹穆罕默德二世的中书省任秘书。他的兄弟反叛苏丹时，他也曾从中调解。穆罕默德三世在位时，他于1303年成为唯一的维齐尔，获得“两府维齐尔”的尊号。他与卡斯蒂利亚议和，又从马林王朝手中夺取休达，招致卡斯蒂利亚、阿拉贡与马林王朝三方结盟。他的政策和奢侈生活激怒了格拉纳达民众。1309年3月14日，暴民洗劫他的府邸，穆罕默德三世被废，阿布·阿卜杜拉被政敌阿提格·伊本·毛勒杀死。

en: Lisan al-Din Ibn al-Khatib (16 November 1313 – 1374) was the great polymath of Nasrid Granada: poet, historian, physician, philosopher and, for much of his life, vizier. Born at Loja, he lost his father and brother at the Battle of Río Salado in 1340, then worked as secretary to his teacher Ibn al-Jayyab, Yusuf I's vizier, and succeeded him as vizier when Ibn al-Jayyab died of plague. The coup of 1359 put him in prison; the Marinid sultan secured his release, and he spent three years in Moroccan exile before returning in 1362 when Muhammad regained the throne. His verses decorate the Alhambra, and his history of Granada, al-Ihata, was written in 1369. In 1371, with Muhammad V grown wary of him and the Grand Qadi al-Nubahi branding his Sufi writings heretical, he left Granada again. Tried for heresy at Fes, he was strangled in 1374, and his enemies had his body dug up and burned.
zh: 利桑丁·伊本·哈提卜（1313年11月16日—1374）是奈斯尔王朝格拉纳达的全才学者，身兼诗人、史家、医生、哲学家，一生大半时间任维齐尔。他生于洛哈，1340年父亲和兄长在萨拉多河战役中战死，此后他在老师、优素福一世的维齐尔伊本·贾亚布手下任秘书，伊本·贾亚布死于鼠疫后，他接任维齐尔。1359年政变后他被捕入狱，马林王朝苏丹出面将他救出，他流亡摩洛哥三年，1362年穆罕默德复位后返回。他的诗句装饰着阿兰布拉宫，所著《格拉纳达全史》于1369年成书。1371年，穆罕默德五世对他心生戒备，大法官努巴希又斥他论苏非的著作为异端，他再次离开格拉纳达。1374年，他在非斯以异端罪名受审，被缢死，仇敌还掘出他的遗体焚烧。

en: Abu'l-Walid Ismail I ibn Faraj (1279–1325), fifth Nasrid sultan of Granada from 1314, was a grandson of Muhammad II through his mother Fatima. After his father Abu Said Faraj's rebellion against Sultan Nasr failed and he was imprisoned, Ismail resumed the revolt and forced Nasr to abdicate in 1314. At the Battle of the Vega on 25 June 1319 his forces routed Castile, which had backed Nasr under a papal crusade, killing both royal regents. A truce followed, and Castile ended its support for Nasr. In 1324–1325 he took Baza, Orce, Huéscar, Galera and Martos, using cannons in a siege for the first time in Iberia. He enlarged the Alhambra and Generalife before a kinsman assassinated him in July 1325.
zh: 阿布·瓦利德·伊斯玛仪一世·本·法拉杰（1279—1325）是格拉纳达奈斯尔王朝第五任素丹，1314年起在位。他是穆罕默德二世的外孙，母亲为法蒂玛；其父阿布·赛义德·法拉杰反对素丹纳斯尔的叛乱失败并被囚后，他继续起兵，于1314年迫使纳斯尔退位。卡斯蒂利亚支持纳斯尔并取得教皇的十字军授权，但在1319年6月25日的维加战役中，伊斯玛仪的军队大败卡斯蒂利亚军，击毙两位摄政亲王。双方随后停战，卡斯蒂利亚停止支持纳斯尔。1324年至1325年，他连克巴萨、奥尔塞、韦斯卡尔、加莱拉和马托斯，并在围城战中使用火炮，这在伊比利亚半岛尚属首次。他为阿尔罕布拉宫和赫内拉利费宫增建了多处建筑，1325年7月被一名宗室亲属刺杀。
