en: Ismail was the youngest son of Abu'l-Walid Ismail I, Sultan of Granada, born to his concubine Qamar. He was thus a half-brother of Sultans Muhammad IV and Yusuf I, who successively ruled the Nasrid emirate after their father's assassination in 1325.
zh: 伊斯玛仪是格拉纳达苏丹阿布·瓦利德·伊斯玛仪一世与妾室盖麦尔所生的幼子，也是1325年其父遇刺后相继在位的苏丹穆罕默德四世与优素福一世的异母弟。

en: Ismail ibn Nasr was the younger brother of Muhammad I, founder of the Nasrid dynasty of Granada, who appointed him governor of Málaga. He held that post until his death in 1257. His son Abu Said Faraj, born 1248, later also governed Málaga.
zh: 伊斯玛仪·本·奈斯尔是格拉纳达奈斯尔王朝缔造者穆罕默德一世的幼弟，被兄长任命为马拉加总督，一直任职到1257年去世。其子阿布·赛义德·法拉杰生于1248年，后来也出任马拉加总督。

en: Maryam was a Nasrid princess of Granada, the younger daughter of Sultan Ismail I by his Christian concubine 'Alwa, and a sister of Sultans Muhammad IV and Yusuf I.
zh: 麦尔彦是格拉纳达的奈斯尔公主，苏丹伊斯梅尔一世与基督徒妃子阿勒瓦的幼女，是穆罕默德四世与优素福一世的姐妹。

en: Abu Abdullah Muhammad ibn Yusuf ibn Nasr (c. 1195–1273), called Ibn al-Ahmar, was the founder of the Nasrid dynasty and the first emir of Granada, the last independent Muslim state on the Iberian Peninsula. He seized his native Arjona in 1232 in revolt against Ibn Hud, entered Granada in 1237 and went on to secure Almería and Málaga. In 1246 he surrendered Jaén to Ferdinand III of Castile and became the king's vassal, even aiding the Christian capture of Seville in 1248. In 1264 he turned against Castile and supported an unsuccessful Muslim rebellion; two years later his former allies, the Banu Ashqilula, rebelled against him. He began building the Alhambra and died in 1273 after a fall from his horse.
zh: 阿布·阿卜杜拉·穆罕默德·本·优素福·本·奈斯尔（约1195—1273），别号伊本·艾哈迈尔，是奈斯尔王朝的缔造者、格拉纳达埃米尔国的第一任埃米尔——该国是伊比利亚半岛最后一个独立穆斯林政权。1232年，他在故乡阿尔霍纳起兵反抗伊本·胡德；1237年入主格拉纳达，随后又取得阿尔梅里亚和马拉加。1246年，他将哈恩交给卡斯蒂利亚国王斐迪南三世并向其称臣，甚至在1248年协助基督徒攻占塞维利亚。1264年，他转而反对卡斯蒂利亚，支持一场未能成功的穆斯林起义；两年后，他的旧盟友巴努·阿什基卢拉家族也起兵反对他。他动工修建阿尔罕布拉宫，1273年坠马后不久去世。

en: Muhammad ibn Faraj was a Nasrid prince, the younger son of Abu Said Faraj, governor of Málaga, and Fatima bint al-Ahmar, and brother of Sultan Ismail I. During the minority of his nephew Muhammad IV, the commander Uthman ibn Abi al-Ula rose against the vizier Ibn al-Mahruq and in 1327 proclaimed Muhammad rival sultan at Andarax in the Alpujarras, with backing from Castile. Muhammad IV called in Marinid troops, but the civil war reached a stalemate. In 1328 the young sultan reconciled with Uthman and ordered the vizier killed; the pretender was captured and sent into exile in North Africa.
zh: 穆罕默德·本·法拉杰是奈斯尔王朝宗室，马拉加总督阿布·赛义德·法拉杰与法蒂玛·宾特·艾哈迈尔的幼子，素丹伊斯玛仪一世之弟。他的侄子穆罕默德四世年幼在位时，大将奥斯曼·本·阿比·乌拉起兵反对宰相伊本·马赫鲁克，并于1327年在阿尔普哈拉斯的安达拉斯拥立穆罕默德为对立素丹，还得到卡斯蒂利亚支持。穆罕默德四世召来马林王朝军队，但内战陷入僵局。1328年，年轻的素丹与奥斯曼和解并下令杀死宰相；这位僭位者被俘并被流放北非。

en: Muhammad II (c. 1235–1302), called al-Faqih, the canon lawyer, succeeded his father Muhammad I as the second Nasrid emir of Granada in 1273. He maneuvered between Castile and the Marinids of Morocco, suppressing the Banu Ashqilula revolt and recovering Málaga in 1279. In 1280 Granada faced simultaneous attacks by Castile, the Marinids and the Banu Ashqilula; the latter left for North Africa in 1288. In 1292 he helped Castile seize Tarifa, then switched sides when Sancho IV kept the town; after Sancho's death in 1295 his forces took Quesada and Alcaudete. A patron of scholars and poets, he organized the Volunteers of the Faith, expanded the Alhambra and promoted trade with Genoa and Pisa.
zh: 穆罕默德二世（约1235—1302），别号“法基赫”（教法学家），1273年继承父亲穆罕默德一世，成为格拉纳达奈斯尔王朝的第二任埃米尔。他在卡斯蒂利亚与摩洛哥马林王朝之间纵横捭阖，镇压巴努·阿什基卢拉家族的叛乱，于1279年收复马拉加。1280年格拉纳达同时遭到卡斯蒂利亚、马林王朝和巴努·阿什基卢拉的进攻；1288年，后者迁往北非。1292年他协助卡斯蒂利亚夺取塔里法，桑乔四世拒绝交出该城后便转与马林王朝结盟。1295年桑乔死后，格拉纳达军队攻占克萨达和阿尔考德特。他优待学者和诗人，组建“信仰志愿军”，扩建阿尔罕布拉宫，并发展与热那亚和比萨的贸易。

en: Muhammad III (1257–1314), called al-Makhlu, the Deposed, ruled the Nasrid Emirate of Granada from 1302. He captured Bedmar from Castile in 1303 and became Ferdinand IV's tribute-paying vassal in 1304. He seized Ceuta from the Marinids in 1306, holding both sides of the Strait and driving Castile, the Marinids and Aragon into coalition. Nearly blind and dominated by vizier Ibn al-Hakim, he was deposed in March 1309 in favour of his half-brother Nasr. After two restoration plots, he was drowned in an Alhambra pool in January 1314. A poet, he built the Partal Palace and the Alhambra's Great Mosque.
zh: 穆罕默德三世（1257—1314），别号“迈赫卢”（被废黜者），1302年起统治格拉纳达埃米尔国。1303年他从卡斯蒂利亚手中夺取贝德马尔，1304年向斐迪南四世称臣纳贡。1306年他从马林王朝手中夺取休达，扼守直布罗陀海峡两岸，促使卡斯蒂利亚、马林王朝和阿拉贡结盟反对格拉纳达。他晚年几乎失明，大权旁落于维齐尔伊本·哈基姆，1309年3月在宫廷政变中被异母弟纳斯尔取代。两度有人拥立他复位失败后，他于1314年1月被溺死在阿尔罕布拉宫的水池中。他善于作诗，修建了帕尔塔尔宫和阿尔罕布拉大寺。

en: Muhammad IV (1315–1333), son of Ismail I and Christian Alwa, became sixth Nasrid sultan of Granada in 1325 at age ten, after his father's assassination. Civil war followed between vizier Ibn al-Mahruq and Uthman ibn Abi al-Ula, the Volunteers' commander, who with Castilian backing proclaimed Muhammad's uncle rival sultan. He ceded Ronda, Marbella and Algeciras to the Marinids, probably in exchange for their aid, then in 1328 took power, reconciling Uthman and killing the vizier. In 1333 he helped the Marinids capture Gibraltar and made peace with Castile; the day after the truce he was assassinated on the orders of Uthman's sons, aged eighteen, and his brother Yusuf I succeeded.
zh: 穆罕默德四世（1315—1333）是伊斯玛仪一世与基督徒阿勒瓦之子，1325年父亲遇刺后，年仅十岁的他成为格拉纳达奈斯尔王朝第六任素丹。即位不久爆发内战：维齐尔伊本·马赫鲁克与“信仰志愿军”统帅乌斯曼·伊本·阿比·乌拉相争，后者得到卡斯蒂利亚支持，拥立穆罕默德的叔父为对立素丹。穆罕默德向马林王朝割让龙达、马贝拉和阿尔赫西拉斯，可能是为了换取援兵；他又于1328年亲政，与乌斯曼和解并诛杀维齐尔。1333年他协助马林王朝攻取直布罗陀，与卡斯蒂利亚议和；休战次日，他在乌斯曼之子的命令下遇刺，年仅十八岁，弟优素福一世继位。

en: Muhammad VI (1333–1362), nicknamed el Bermejo, the Red One, was the tenth Nasrid sultan of Granada. In August 1359 he led a coup that deposed Muhammad V and installed Ismail II, whom he executed in June or July 1360 to seize the throne. In the War of the Two Peters he allied with Aragon against Castile, but after Aragon made a separate peace in 1361, Peter I of Castile and the returning Muhammad V overwhelmed him. He fled on 13 April 1362 and surrendered at Seville, where Peter killed him with a lance on 27 April and sent his head to Granada.
zh: 穆罕默德六世（1333—1362）绰号“红人”贝尔梅霍，是格拉纳达奈斯尔王朝第十任苏丹。1359年8月，他发动宫廷政变推翻穆罕默德五世、拥立伊斯玛仪二世，又于1360年6月或7月将伊斯玛仪二世处死，自立为苏丹。在“两个佩德罗战争”中，他与阿拉贡结盟对抗卡斯蒂利亚；1361年阿拉贡单独媾和后，卡斯蒂利亚国王佩德罗一世与回国的穆罕默德五世联手将他击败。1362年4月13日他逃出格拉纳达，在塞维利亚投降，4月27日被佩德罗用长矛刺死，首级被送往格拉纳达。

en: Nasr (1287–1322), fourth Nasrid sultan of Granada, was enthroned on 14 March 1309 when a palace revolution deposed his brother Muhammad III. He inherited a three-front war against Castile, Aragon and the Marinids, buying peace with the cession of Ceuta, Algeciras and Ronda and tribute to Castile; his troops repulsed the Aragonese siege of Almería in December 1309. Suspected of pro-Christian sympathies and mocked for his astronomy, he repulsed Abu Said Faraj's initial revolt in 1311, but abdicated to his nephew Ismail I on 8 February 1314 after a renewed rebellion. He ruled Guadix as a vassal and sought Castilian help to regain the throne, until dying without heirs in 1322.
zh: 纳斯尔（1287—1322）是格拉纳达奈斯尔王朝第四任素丹。1309年3月14日，一场宫廷政变废黜了他的兄长穆罕默德三世，将他推上王位。他接手的是一场与卡斯蒂利亚、阿拉贡和马林王朝三面作战的战争：他把休达、阿尔赫西拉斯和龙达割给马林王朝，向卡斯蒂利亚纳贡，以此媾和；1309年12月，格拉纳达军队又击退了阿拉贡对阿尔梅里亚的围攻。他被怀疑亲基督教，又因沉迷天文学而遭讥议。1311年他击退了阿布·赛义德·法拉杰的首次叛乱，但叛乱再起后，他于1314年2月8日被迫向外甥伊斯玛仪一世退位。此后他以附庸身份统治瓜迪克斯，寻求卡斯蒂利亚帮助复位，1322年无嗣而终。

en: Qamar was a concubine of Sultan Ismail I of Granada and the mother of his youngest son, also named Ismail.
zh: 盖迈尔是格拉纳达苏丹伊斯梅尔一世的妃子，为他生下幼子伊斯梅尔。

en: Yusuf I (1318–1354), seventh Nasrid sultan of Granada, came to the throne at fifteen in 1333, after his brother Muhammad IV was murdered, at first ruling in name only under his grandmother Fatima. In 1334 his envoys secured a four-year peace with Castile and the Marinids of Morocco. When it lapsed he allied with the Marinids against Alfonso XI of Castile, and the allies were crushed at the Río Salado on 30 October 1340; Algeciras fell in 1344 after a two-year siege. When Alfonso died of the Black Death outside Gibraltar in 1350, Yusuf ordered his commanders not to attack the Castilians carrying their king's body home, then made peace with Peter I. Granada lost ground yet flourished under him: he founded the Madrasa Yusufiyya and enlarged the Comares Palace, and Ibn al-Khatib served as his vizier. He was stabbed while praying in the Great Mosque on Eid al-Fitr, 19 October 1354, and his son Muhammad V succeeded him.
zh: 优素福一世（1318—1354）是格拉纳达奈斯尔王朝第七任素丹。1333年其兄穆罕默德四世遇刺，十五岁的他继位，起初在祖母法蒂玛监护下徒有其名。1334年，他的使者与卡斯蒂利亚及摩洛哥的马林王朝议定四年和约。和约期满后，他与马林王朝联手对抗卡斯蒂利亚的阿方索十一世，却在1340年10月30日的萨拉多河战役中惨败；阿尔赫西拉斯被围两年，于1344年落入阿方索之手。1350年阿方索在直布罗陀城下死于黑死病，优素福下令部下不得攻击护送国王遗体撤退的卡斯蒂利亚人，随后与佩德罗一世议和。战场上屡有失地，他治下的格拉纳达却文教兴盛：他创办优素福经学院，扩建科马雷斯宫，伊本·哈提卜曾任他的维齐尔。1354年10月19日开斋节，他在大清真寺礼拜时遇刺，其子穆罕默德五世继位。

en: Yusuf ibn Nasr was a member of the Banu Nasr clan settled at Arjona. The son of Nasr, he fathered Muhammad ibn Yusuf, called Ibn al-Ahmar, who seized Arjona in 1232 and founded the Nasrid emirate of Granada, and a younger son Ismail.
zh: 优素福·本·奈斯尔是定居阿尔霍纳的巴努·奈斯尔氏族成员，奈斯尔之子。其子穆罕默德·本·优素福（别号伊本·艾哈迈尔）于1232年夺取阿尔霍纳，建立格拉纳达奈斯尔王朝；另有幼子伊斯玛仪。

en: Johann I von Hals (died 7 November 1347) was count of the imperial county of Hals, whose seat was Castle Hals on the Ilz near Passau in Lower Bavaria. The only son of Count Albert VII, he belonged to the von Kamm lineage that had styled itself von Hals since 1160. In 1337 he married Margareta, daughter of Landgrave Ulrich I of Leuchtenberg. In 1338 he released a farm at Haindling from its feudal obligation so that it could be given to the local chapel. He donated a holding at Stiegelheim to Aldersbach monastery in 1341. Their son Leopold became the last count of Hals.
zh: 约翰一世·冯·哈尔斯（1347年11月7日卒）是直辖于神圣罗马帝国的哈尔斯伯国伯爵，治所是下巴伐利亚帕绍附近伊尔茨河畔的哈尔斯城堡。他是阿尔布雷希特七世伯爵的独子，属于自1160年起以冯·哈尔斯为姓的卡姆家族。1337年，他娶洛伊希滕贝格领地伯爵乌尔里希一世之女玛格丽特为妻。1338年，他免除了海因德林一处农庄的封建义务，使其能够捐给当地礼拜堂。1341年，他将施蒂格尔海姆的一处田产捐给阿尔德斯巴赫修道院。其子利奥波德成为末代哈尔斯伯爵。

en: Leopold von Hals (died 3 March 1370) was the last count of the imperial county of Hals, seated at Castle Hals on the Ilz near Passau in Lower Bavaria. The son of Count Johann I and Margareta of Leuchtenberg, he married Anna of Magdeburg, daughter of Burchard V, Burgrave of Magdeburg and Count of Hardegg, in 1360, but the marriage remained childless. With his death the male line of the von Kamm counts of Hals ended, and his lands became the object of a long inheritance dispute between Leuchtenberg and Ortenburg.
zh: 利奥波德·冯·哈尔斯（1370年3月3日卒）是直辖于神圣罗马帝国的哈尔斯伯国末代伯爵，驻地为下巴伐利亚帕绍附近伊尔茨河畔的哈尔斯城堡。他是约翰一世伯爵与洛伊希滕贝格的玛格丽特之子，1360年娶马格德堡城堡伯爵、哈尔德格伯爵布尔夏德五世之女安娜为妻，但婚姻无嗣。他死后，卡姆家族一系的哈尔斯伯爵男嗣断绝，其领地成为洛伊希滕贝格与奥尔滕堡长期继承权之争的目标。

en: Togha Temür (died 13 December 1353) was the last strong claimant to the Ilkhanate from the house of Genghis Khan, and the only one from eastern Iran. A descendant of Genghis's brother Qasar, he led the nomadic Chete, whom his grandfather had settled near Astarabad, and his power rested on Gorgan and western Khorasan. When the Ilkhan Abu Sa'id died without an heir in 1335 and the realm fell apart, eastern amirs backed him for the throne. His march west in 1337 took the old capital Soltaniyeh, but the Jalayirid Hasan Buzurg defeated him and sent him home. In 1338 Hasan made him Ilkhan in return for help, but the alliance soured and Togha Temür never reunited the Ilkhanate. He spent his last years fighting the Sarbadars of western Khorasan and could not subdue them. In December 1353 their leader Yahya Karawi came to his camp and killed him and his household; most of his lands passed to the Sarbadars.
zh: 脱合帖木儿（？—1353年12月13日）是成吉思汗家族最后一位有实力问鼎伊儿汗位的宗王，也是其中唯一出自伊朗东部的一位。他是成吉思汗之弟合撒儿的后裔，统领祖父安置在阿斯塔拉巴德附近的游牧切特部，势力根基在戈尔甘和呼罗珊西部。1335年伊儿汗不赛因无嗣而终，伊儿汗国土崩瓦解，东部异密们拥立他为伊儿汗。1337年他西征，占领旧都苏丹尼耶，却被札剌亦儿王朝的大哈桑击败，退回东方。1338年，大哈桑以立他为伊儿汗为条件求援，但双方很快反目，脱合帖木儿始终未能重统伊儿汗国。晚年他长期与呼罗珊西部的萨尔巴达尔人作战，无法将其征服。1353年12月，萨尔巴达尔首领亚赫瑶·卡劳比来到他的军营，将他和家族杀害；他的大部分领地落入萨尔巴达尔人之手。

en: Mehmed Chakhshadan was Bey of Germiyan from 1340 to 1361, succeeding his father Yakub I at Kütahya. His nickname Chakhshadan meant the fighter or warrior. His forces retook Kula and Angir, modern Simav, from the Catalan Company. Yet Germiyan lost its former dominance, for the Aydınid beylik became independent in his reign. He died in 1361 and was succeeded by his elder son Suleiman Shah.
zh: 穆罕默德·恰赫沙丹于1340年至1361年任盖尔米扬贝伊，在屈塔希亚继承父亲雅库布一世之位；绰号“恰赫沙丹”意为好斗者、战士。他的军队从加泰罗尼亚佣兵团手中收复了库拉和安吉尔（今锡马夫）。但盖尔米扬丧失了往日的优势，艾登贝伊国在他治下独立。他于1361年去世，长子苏莱曼沙阿继位。

en: Musa was a son of Yakub I, founder of the Germiyan beylik around Kütahya in western Anatolia, as recorded in a deed of 1363; his brother Mehmed Chakhshadan succeeded their father as bey in about 1340.
zh: 1363年的一份契据记载，穆萨是安纳托利亚西部、以屈塔希亚为中心的盖尔米扬贝伊国创建者雅库布一世之子；他的兄弟穆罕默德·恰赫沙丹约于1340年继承父位成为贝伊。

en: Suleiman Shah, known as Shah Chelebi (died 1387), was Bey of Germiyan from 1361, succeeding his father Mehmed Chakhshadan at Kütahya. After backing the Hamidids against the Karamanids, he sought Ottoman protection and in 1381 married his daughter Devletşah Hatun to Murad I's son Bayezid. The dowry surrendered Kütahya, Simav, Eğrigöz and Tavşanlı to the Ottomans, so Suleiman withdrew to Kula, where he died in 1387. A generous patron of letters, he had Persian works such as the Kabus-name translated into Turkish.
zh: 苏莱曼沙阿世称“沙阿·切莱比”（1387年卒），1361年起任盖尔米扬贝伊，在屈塔希亚继承父亲穆罕默德·恰赫沙丹之位。他支持哈米德贝伊国对抗卡拉曼王朝后，转而寻求奥斯曼庇护，于1381年将女儿德夫莱特沙赫·哈顿嫁给穆拉德一世之子巴耶济德。嫁妆把屈塔希亚、锡马夫、埃里格兹和塔夫尚勒交给奥斯曼，苏莱曼只得退居库拉，并于1387年卒于该地。他慷慨奖掖文学，在位时《卡布斯教诲录》等波斯作品被译成土耳其语。

en: Yakub I (died c. 1340) founded the Germiyan beylik in western Anatolia, centered on Kütahya. After submitting to Kayqubad III of the Sultanate of Rum, he became independent as the Seljuk state collapsed, and his domains stretched east to Ankara. The contemporary al-Umari called him the most powerful Turkish emir, suzerain of his neighbours, with Byzantium paying him one hundred thousand gold pieces a year. The Catalan Company destroyed his army at Aulax in April 1304, and he twice besieged Philadelphia, which finally agreed to tribute around 1311. In 1313 he encouraged the Chavdar Tatars to attack the neighbouring Ottoman beylik. He died around 1340, leaving a prosperous realm to his son Mehmed.
zh: 雅各布一世（约1340年卒）在安纳托利亚西部建立了以屈塔希亚为中心的盖尔米扬贝伊国。他起初臣服于鲁姆苏丹国的凯库巴德三世，塞尔柱国家瓦解后获得独立，疆土向东远达安卡拉。同时代的欧麦里称他是最强大的土耳其异密、诸邻邦的宗主，拜占庭每年向他缴纳十万枚金币。1304年4月，加泰罗尼亚佣兵团在奥拉克斯歼灭其军队；他又两度围攻非拉铁非，该城最终约于1311年同意纳贡。1313年，他唆使恰夫达尔鞑靼人进攻邻近的奥斯曼贝伊国。约1340年他去世，将一个富庶的国家传给儿子穆罕默德。

en: Catherine de la Tour-Châtillon (died 1367), daughter of the knight John I, lord of Châtillon, was the second wife of Count Peter IV of Gruyère. Her son Rodolphe IV succeeded as count of Gruyère.
zh: 卡特琳·德拉图尔-沙蒂永（1367年卒）是骑士、沙蒂永领主让一世之女，格吕耶尔伯爵皮埃尔四世的第二任妻子，生子鲁道夫四世，后继承格吕耶尔伯爵之位。

en: William II of Gruyères (fl. first half of the twelfth century) was the first count to bear the title count of Gruyères, appearing as Willelmus comes de Grueria in 1144. The eldest son of Count William I, he and his brother Radbod were co-lords of Marsens, and the brothers were among the donors who founded Humilimont Abbey near Marsens. His filiation is recorded in the Rougemont charter of 1115. His wife's name is unknown, and he was succeeded by his son Rudolf I.
zh: 格吕耶尔的纪尧姆二世（12世纪上半叶在世）是第一位使用“格吕耶尔伯爵”头衔的人，1144年的文献以“格吕埃里亚伯爵威廉”称呼他。他是纪尧姆一世伯爵的长子，与弟弟拉博德同任马尔桑领主，兄弟二人还作为捐助人促成了马尔桑附近于米利蒙修道院的创立。其家世记载于1115年的鲁日蒙契据。他的妻子名字无考，继位者是儿子鲁道夫一世。

en: Peter I of Gruyères (c. 1162 – after 1200) was a younger son of Count Rudolf I and Agnes of Glâne. He first appears as count, Petrus comes de Grueria, in an 1197 charter beside his brother Rudolf II, renouncing rights in favour of Hauterive Abbey with the consent of their mother Agnes and of Peter's wife Clemence of Estavayer. A charter of 1200 again names both brothers as counts, when they were forced to surrender Riaz and Albeuve to the bishopric of Lausanne. Peter died without issue, and the county passed to Rudolf II.
zh: 格吕耶尔的彼得一世（约1162—1200年后）是鲁道夫一世伯爵与格拉讷的阿涅斯的次子。1197年的一份契约首次以伯爵身份提到他，与弟弟鲁道夫二世并列；在母亲阿涅斯和妻子埃斯塔瓦耶的克莱芒斯同意下，他们宣布放弃对上里夫修道院的若干权利。1200年的一份捐赠契约再次把兄弟二人并列为伯爵，他们同时被迫把里亚和阿尔伯弗交给洛桑主教区。彼得无嗣而终，伯国归于鲁道夫二世。

en: Peter II, called the Elder (1224–c. 1304), was count of Gruyère, the eldest son of Rodolphe III and Colombe of Belmont. A knight, he also served as avoué of Vevey, the lay protector of the town's church institutions, and had shared in ruling the county with his father since 1264. His heir, his eldest son Peter the Younger, lord of Montsalvens, died before him in 1283. The young man's widow, Guillemette of Grandson, then ran much of the county and used the title countess from 1291. Peter died around 1304 and his grandson Peter III followed him as count.
zh: 彼得二世，绰号‘年长者’（1224—约1304），格吕耶尔伯爵，鲁道夫三世与贝尔蒙的科隆布之长子。他身为骑士，还出任沃韦的护尉，即当地教会机构的世俗保护人；自1264年起便与父亲共同治理伯国。他的继承人、长子蒙萨尔旺领主‘小彼得’于1283年先他而死。此后，小彼得的遗孀格朗松的吉耶梅特实际主持伯国政务，并从1291年起使用伯爵夫人头衔。彼得约于1304年去世，其孙彼得三世继位。

en: Peter III of Gruyères (1279–1342), grandson of Count Peter II, was the younger son of Peter the Younger and Guillemette of Grandson. He first assisted his grandfather as lord of Gruyères before succeeding as count, when he left the lordships of Montsalvens and Le Vanel to his nephews. In 1307 he and his wife founded the Part-Dieu Charterhouse. He added Les Ormonts and the castles of Laubeck and Mannenberg to his domains, became avoyer of Fribourg in 1330, and promoted cattle trading, cloth making and cheese production. He died late in 1342 and was buried at Part-Dieu.
zh: 格吕耶尔的彼得三世（1279—1342）是彼得二世伯爵之孙、“小彼得”与格朗松的吉耶梅特较年幼的儿子。他先以格吕耶尔领主身份辅佐祖父，继承伯爵爵位后把蒙萨尔旺和勒瓦内两处领地留给侄子。1307年，他与妻子创立帕尔迪厄加尔都西会修道院。他取得奥尔蒙以及劳贝克、曼嫩贝格城堡以扩张领地，1330年出任弗里堡市政长官，并推动牲畜贸易、呢绒织造和奶酪生产。他于1342年末去世，葬在帕尔迪厄修道院。

en: Peter IV of Gruyères, also called Perrod (c. 1280–19 April 1365), was the son of Rodolphe of Gruyères and Contesson, and nephew of Count Peter III, who became guardian to him and his brother John after they were orphaned young. Knighted around 1327, Louis II of Savoy made him bailiff of the Pays de Vaud in 1329, and in 1342 he succeeded his uncle as count, ruling jointly with his brother John of Montsalvens. In 1352 he joined the confederacy of Bern and Fribourg, and in 1359 he granted Gruyères its charter of liberties. His second wife Catherine de la Tour-Châtillon bore his successor Rodolphe IV.
zh: 格吕耶尔的彼得四世，又称佩罗（约1280—1365年4月19日），是罗多尔夫·德·格吕耶尔与孔泰松之子、彼得三世伯爵之侄；他与弟弟让早孤，由叔父抚养成人。约1327年他受封骑士，1329年被萨伏依的路易二世任命为沃州行政长官，1342年继叔父之后成为伯爵，与弟弟、蒙萨尔旺领主让共同执政。1352年，他加入伯尔尼与弗里堡的同盟；1359年，他授予格吕耶尔城自由特许状。第二任妻子拉图尔-沙蒂永的卡特琳生下了继承人罗多尔夫四世。

en: Peter of Gruyère, called the Younger, was the eldest son of Count Peter II and held Montsalvens. Before March 1267 he married Guillemette of Grandson, later countess of Gruyère; they had two sons, Rodolphe and Peter. He died before his father in 1283.
zh: 格吕耶尔的彼得，人称‘小彼得’，是伯爵彼得二世的长子，领有蒙萨尔旺。1267年3月之前，他与格朗松的吉耶梅特成婚，吉耶梅特后为格吕耶尔伯爵夫人；两人生有鲁道夫、彼得两子。1283年，他先于父亲去世。

en: Rodolphe of Gruyère, lord of Montsalvens, was the son of Peter the Younger and Guillemette of Grandson. He married Contesson; their son Peter, born in 1307, later became Count Peter IV. Rodolphe died before Peter III became count, and Montsalvens passed to his sons.
zh: 格吕耶尔的鲁道夫是‘小彼得’与格朗松的吉耶梅特之子，承袭蒙萨尔旺领主之位。他娶孔泰松为妻，生子彼得（生于1307年），后成为伯爵彼得四世。鲁道夫在彼得三世成为伯爵之前去世，蒙萨尔旺后来传给了他的儿子们。

en: Rudolf I of Gruyères (c. 1120 – c. 1196), the only son of William II, succeeded his father as count around 1145–1154 and was also styled count of Ogo in charters, including one of 1173. By his wife Agnes of Glâne, who brought him a large inheritance, he had five children. He patronised the abbeys of Haut-Crêt and Hauterive, endowing Haut-Crêt with lands at Châtillens around 1157 and Montheron Abbey with estates at Chevressy in 1177. In 1195 pressure from the bishop of Lausanne forced him to surrender Bulle and its market. His son Peter I succeeded him.
zh: 格吕耶尔的鲁道夫一世（约1120—约1196）是纪尧姆二世的独子，约1145至1154年间继位为伯爵，在1173年等契约中还被称为奥戈伯爵。妻子格拉讷的阿涅斯带来丰厚遗产，二人育有五个子女。他资助上克雷和上里夫修道院：约1157年把沙蒂扬的产业赠予上克雷修道院，1177年又把舍夫雷西的地产赠予蒙特龙修道院。1195年，在洛桑主教施压下，他被迫交出布勒城及其集市。其子彼得一世继位。

en: Rodolphe II of Gruyère (c. 1170–1224) was a count of Gruyère in the Sarine valley of modern Switzerland, a younger son of Count Rodolphe I and Agnès of Glâne. Destined for the church, he was called the cleric in an 1173 charter, but in 1197 he married Gertrude, probably of Montagny. He tried to revive the market of Gruyères, which his father had surrendered in 1195 to please the bishop of Lausanne, until Bishop Berthold of Neuchâtel forced him to desist. He gave land to Haut-Crêt Abbey, and his son Rodolphe III succeeded him.
zh: 鲁道夫二世（约1170—1224）是今瑞士萨讷河谷格吕耶尔的伯爵，为伯爵鲁道夫一世与格拉讷的阿涅丝之幼子。他本被安排投身教会，1173年的一份特许状称他为‘教士’；1197年，他迎娶很可能出身蒙塔尼家族的格特鲁德。他试图恢复格吕耶尔集市——其父已于1195年为迁就洛桑主教将其废止——但主教纳沙泰尔的贝特霍尔德迫使他作罢。他曾向上克雷修道院捐赠田产，死后由儿子鲁道夫三世继位。

en: Rodolphe III, called the Younger (c. 1200–1269/1270), was count of Gruyère and the eldest son of Rodolphe II and Gertrude of Montagny. He had to surrender the estate of Ogens, his wife Colombe of Belmont's dower land, to William of Ecublens, bishop of Lausanne. On 19 April 1244, under pressure from Count Peter II of Savoy, he yielded Gruyères Castle as freehold; the fief was regranted to his son William, a canon of Lausanne. In May 1254 he founded the church of Saint Theodule in Gruyères with the bishop's consent. His son Peter II succeeded him.
zh: 鲁道夫三世，绰号‘年轻人’（约1200—1269/1270），格吕耶尔伯爵，是鲁道夫二世与蒙塔尼的格特鲁德的长子。他被迫把妻子贝尔蒙的科隆布作为嫁资带来的奥让领地交给洛桑主教埃屈布朗的纪尧姆。1244年4月19日，迫于萨伏依伯爵彼得二世的压力，他将格吕耶尔城堡作为自由地交出，该采邑随即转封给他担任洛桑咏礼司铎的儿子纪尧姆。1254年5月，他经主教同意在格吕耶尔兴建圣狄奥多尔教堂。其子彼得二世继位。

en: Anna of Werle (born c. 1331) was a daughter of John II, Lord of Werle-Güstrow, and Mechtild of Brunswick-Grubenhagen. She became a nun at Dobbertin Abbey in Mecklenburg.
zh: 安娜·冯·韦尔勒（约1331年生）是韦尔勒-居斯特罗领主约翰二世与不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的梅希蒂尔德之女，后在梅克伦堡的多贝廷修道院出家为修女。

en: Bernard I (c. 1245–c. 1286), a son of Nicholas I of Werle and Jutta of Anhalt, first appears in a charter in 1273. From 1277 he ruled Werle jointly with his brothers Henry I and John I, and when the lands were divided in 1281 he received the lordship of Prisannewitz. His name last appears in a document on 9 March 1282, and by 3 March 1288 his nephew Nicholas II referred to him as dead; 1286 is considered the likely year of his death. He was buried at Doberan Minster, leaving no documented wife or children.
zh: 伯恩哈德一世（约1245—约1286）是韦尔莱领主尼古拉一世与安哈尔特的尤塔之子，1273年首见于一份特许状。1277年起，他与兄长海因里希一世、约翰一世共治韦尔莱；1281年分家时，他分得普里桑讷维茨领地。1282年3月9日是他最后一次在文书中署名，到1288年3月3日，其侄尼古拉二世已称他已故，学界推定他卒于1286年。他葬于多贝兰大教堂，没有留下可考的妻子和子女。

en: Henry I (c. 1245–8 October 1291) ruled Werle from 1277, first jointly with his brothers John I and Bernard I after the death of their father Nicholas I, and from the partition of 1281 as lord of Werle-Güstrow. In 1291 his sons Henry and Nicholas, fearing for their inheritance after his second marriage to Matilda of Brunswick-Lüneburg, struck him down during a hunt near Saal. They were soon ousted by Henry's nephew Nicholas II, who reunited Werle. His first wife, married in 1262, was Rikissa Birgersdotter.
zh: 海因里希一世（约1245—1291年10月8日）自1277年起统治韦尔莱：父亲尼古拉一世死后，他先与弟弟约翰一世、伯恩哈德一世共治；1281年分家后领有韦尔莱-居斯特罗。1291年，他的两个儿子海因里希与尼古拉因父亲续娶不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的玛蒂尔德而担心继承权不保，在萨尔附近行猎时将他杀害。兄弟二人不久即被海因里希的侄子尼古拉二世推翻，韦尔莱重归统一。他1262年娶的第一任妻子是里基莎·比耶尔斯多塔。

en: Henry II of Werle (born after 1262, died after 1308) was a son of Henry I, Lord of Werle-Güstrow, and Rikissa Birgersdotter, and first appears in a charter of 1 August 1282. With his brother Nicholas he murdered their father during a hunt near Saal, fearing his second marriage to Matilda of Brunswick-Lüneburg would threaten their inheritance. Henry then held the lordship of Penzlin into the Margrave's War, while his cousin Nicholas II seized the succession; he disappears from charters after the patricide. His wife was a daughter of Duke Barnim I of Pomerania, identified as either Mechthild or Beatrix. Their son Barnim became a canon at Cammin and their daughter Mechthild a prioress at Pyritz.
zh: 维尔勒的海因里希二世（1262年后生，1308年后卒）是维尔勒-居斯特罗领主海因里希一世与里基莎·比耶格斯多塔之子，最早见于1282年8月1日的一份特许状。他担心父亲与不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的玛蒂尔德再婚会危及继承权，便与兄弟尼古拉在萨尔附近的狩猎中杀死父亲。此后他占据彭茨林领地，一直撑到藩侯战争时期，但继承权落入堂兄尼古拉二世之手；弑父之后，特许状中便不再出现他的名字。他的妻子是波美拉尼亚公爵巴尔尼姆一世之女，可能是梅希蒂尔德或贝娅特丽克丝。两人的儿子巴尔尼姆成为卡明的座堂参事，女儿梅希蒂尔德则成为皮里茨的女修院院长。

en: John I (c. 1245–15 October 1283) was the eldest son of Nicholas I, lord of Werle, and Jutta of Anhalt. After his father's death in 1277 he ruled Werle jointly with his brothers Henry I and Bernard I until the family divided its lands in 1281, when John took Werle-Parchim and ruled there until his death. He married Sophia, a daughter of Count Gunther of Lindow-Ruppin, and was buried in Doberan Minster. His son Nicholas II later reunited the Werle lands.
zh: 约翰一世（约1245—1283年10月15日）是韦尔莱领主尼古拉一世与安哈尔特的尤塔之长子。1277年父亲死后，他与弟弟海因里希一世、伯恩哈德一世共治韦尔莱，直至1281年诸子分家；他分得韦尔莱-帕尔希姆，在当地统治到去世。他娶林多-鲁平伯爵金特之女索菲娅为妻，死后葬于多贝兰大教堂。其子尼古拉二世后来重新统一了韦尔莱诸领地。

en: John II, called the Bald (born after 1250, died 27 August 1337), was the second son of John I of Werle and Sophia of Lindow-Ruppin. From 1309 he shared Werle with his brother Nicholas II, who withdrew from government after travelling to Montpellier in 1311 in hope of a cure for leprosy; that year John married Matilda of Brunswick. When Nicholas died in 1316, Werle was divided again: John took Werle-Güstrow and his nephew John III took Werle-Goldberg. In 1326 Christopher II of Denmark promised John and Henry II of Mecklenburg the Rügen estates, but their claims could not be enforced in the War of the Rügen Succession. Burdened with debt, John cleared it through host-desecration trials against Jews in Güstrow and Krakow am See. He died in 1337 and was buried in Doberan Minster.
zh: 约翰二世，绰号“秃头”（1250年后生，1337年8月27日卒），是维尔勒的约翰一世与林道-鲁平的索菲娅的次子。自1309年起，他与兄长尼古拉二世共同统治维尔勒；1311年尼古拉前往蒙彼利埃，希望治好麻风病，此后退出政务，同年约翰娶不伦瑞克的玛蒂尔德为妻。1316年尼古拉去世，维尔勒再度分家：约翰得到维尔勒-居斯特罗，侄子约翰三世得到维尔勒-戈尔德贝格。1326年，丹麦国王克里斯托弗二世许诺把吕根的地产封给约翰和梅克伦堡公爵海因里希二世，但这些要求在吕根继承战争中无法兑现。约翰负债累累，靠在居斯特罗和湖畔克拉科夫对犹太人提起的亵渎圣体审判还清了债务。他于1337年去世，葬于多贝兰大教堂。

en: John III, called John van Ruoden (before 1300–1352), took Werle-Goldberg in the 1316 partition after his father Nicholas II died, while his uncle John II kept Werle-Güstrow. His mother was Rixa of Denmark; in 1317 he married Mechtild, daughter of Duke Otto I of Pomerania, and he built a castle at Goldberg. The Rügen War of Succession broke his finances. In 1326 Christopher II of Denmark promised Rügen to John and Henry II of Mecklenburg, though he had already pledged it to Pomerania. Under the Peace of Brudersdorf Pomerania kept Rügen and owed Mecklenburg thirty-one thousand silver marks, but John won only a pledge on Tribsees, which Pomerania conquered. To pay his war contractors from the Moltke, Hahn, Maltzan and Flotow families he pledged Laage, Malchin, Stavenhagen and Malchow, most of his land. From 1350 he left rule to his son Nicholas IV. He was gravely ill in 1352 and was probably buried at Malchow Abbey.
zh: 约翰三世，绰号“约翰·范·鲁登”（1300年前—1352），1316年父亲尼古拉二世去世、维尔勒分家后得到维尔勒-戈尔德贝格，叔父约翰二世则保有维尔勒-居斯特罗。他的母亲是丹麦的里克莎；1317年他娶波美拉尼亚公爵奥托一世之女梅希蒂尔德，并在戈尔德贝格修建了城堡。吕根继承战争拖垮了他的财政。1326年，丹麦国王克里斯托弗二世许诺把吕根封给约翰和梅克伦堡公爵海因里希二世，却早已把它许给波美拉尼亚。《布吕德斯多夫和约》让波美拉尼亚保住吕根，并向梅克伦堡赔偿三万一千银马克，约翰却只得到特里布泽斯的抵押权，最终也被波美拉尼亚攻占。为偿付毛奇、哈恩、马尔灿和弗洛托等家族的战争承包商，他把拉格、马尔欣、施塔文哈根和马尔肖等地抵押出去，等于押掉了大半领地。1350年起，他把统治权交给儿子尼古拉四世；1352年他病重，死后可能葬于马尔肖修道院。

en: John of Werle-Goldberg (c. 1329–1341) was a son of John III, Lord of Werle-Goldberg, and his first wife Mechtild of Pomerania, and a brother of Nicholas IV. He died before his father in 1341.
zh: 维尔勒-戈尔德贝格的约翰（约1329—1341）是维尔勒-戈尔德贝格领主约翰三世与第一任妻子波美拉尼亚的玛蒂尔德之子，也是尼古拉四世的兄弟。他于1341年先于父亲去世。

en: Matilda of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (born c. 1295, died 1344) was a daughter of Duke Henry I of Brunswick-Grubenhagen and Agnes of Meissen. In 1311 she married John II, Lord of Werle-Güstrow, and bore Nicholas III, Bernard II and Sophia, wife of Duke Barnim IV of Pomerania-Wolgast.
zh: 不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的玛蒂尔德（约1295—1344）是公爵海因里希一世与迈森的阿格内丝之女。1311年嫁维尔勒-居斯特罗领主约翰二世，生子尼古拉三世、贝尔纳德二世和女索菲娅；索菲娅后嫁波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特公爵巴尔宁四世。

en: Mechtild of Werle-Goldberg (c. 1329–1361) was a daughter of John III, Lord of Werle-Goldberg, and his first wife Mechtild of Pomerania. She married Count Otto I of Schwerin and died in 1361.
zh: 维尔勒-戈尔德贝格的梅希蒂尔德（约1329—1361）是维尔勒-戈尔德贝格领主约翰三世与第一任妻子波美拉尼亚的梅希蒂尔德之女，嫁给什未林伯爵奥托一世，于1361年去世。

en: Nicholas I (c. 1210–1277) was a younger son of the Mecklenburg prince Henry Borwin II and ruled as Lord of Rostock from 1229 to 1234, administering Rostock as regent for his younger brother Henry Borwin III. Around 1231 he married Jutta of Anhalt. In the Mecklenburg partition of 1234 he received the lordship of Werle. Fighting alongside Duke Barnim I of Pomerania against Brandenburg, he lost Perleberg, Wesenberg and Penzlin but secured Parchim, Plau and Goldberg after the death of his brother Pribislaw. He founded the towns of Penzlin in 1235 and Röbel in 1261, and in 1275 mediated a quarrel between his sons, who divided Werle after his death.
zh: 尼古拉一世（约1210—1277）是梅克伦堡诸侯海因里希·博尔温二世年纪较小的儿子，1229年至1234年任罗斯托克领主，并代弟弟海因里希·博尔温三世执掌罗斯托克。约1231年，他与安哈尔特的尤塔成婚。1234年梅克伦堡第一次分封时，他获得维尔勒领地。他与波美拉尼亚公爵巴尔尼姆一世联兵对抗勃兰登堡，丧失佩尔莱贝格、韦森贝格和彭茨林，但在兄弟普里比斯拉夫去世后取得帕尔希姆、普劳和戈尔德贝格。他于1235年建立彭茨林、1261年建立勒伯尔两座城镇，1275年调解诸子之争；他去世后，儿子们瓜分了维尔勒。

en: Nicholas II (before 1275 – 18 February 1316) ruled Werle-Parchim from 1283 and, after 1292, the reunited lordship of Werle. When his cousins murdered his uncle Henry I in 1291, Nicholas waged a long war against them and their allies, Lord Henry II of Mecklenburg and Elector Albert III of Brandenburg, finally reuniting Werle-Parchim with Werle-Güstrow. In 1292 he married Richeza, a daughter of King Eric V of Denmark. In 1311 he journeyed to Montpellier's famous school of medicine seeking a cure for leprosy; treatment only slowed the disease, so he withdrew from government and retired to Pustow near Güstrow. After his death Werle was divided between his son John III and his brother John II.
zh: 尼古拉二世（1275年前—1316年2月18日）自1283年起统治维尔勒-帕尔希姆，1292年后统治重新统一的维尔勒领地。1291年堂兄弟们杀死叔父海因里希一世后，他与堂兄及其盟友梅克伦堡领主海因里希二世、勃兰登堡选侯阿尔布雷希特三世长期作战，最终将维尔勒-帕尔希姆与维尔勒-居斯特罗重新合为一体。1292年，他与丹麦国王埃里克五世之女里克莎成婚。1311年，他前往名医云集的蒙彼利埃求医，希望治愈麻风病；治疗只延缓了病情，他于是退出政务，退居居斯特罗附近的普斯托。他死后，维尔勒被儿子约翰三世与弟弟约翰二世瓜分。

en: Nicholas III, called Staveleke (born after 1311, died 1360–1361), was the eldest son of John II, Lord of Werle-Güstrow, and Matilda of Brunswick-Grubenhagen. When his father died in 1337 he ruled alone, and from 1339 he governed jointly with his younger brother Bernard. In the partition of 14 July 1347 Bernard received Werle-Waren while Nicholas kept Werle-Güstrow. On 6 January 1338 he married Agnes of Mecklenburg, who bore him Lorenz and John V; his second wife was Mechtild of Holstein-Kiel, mother of his daughter Catherine. He is last attested on 10 August 1360.
zh: 尼古拉三世，绰号“斯塔弗勒克”（1311年后生，1360—1361年间卒），是维尔勒-居斯特罗领主约翰二世与不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的玛蒂尔德的长子。1337年父亲去世后他独自统治，1339年起与弟弟贝尔纳德共同执政。1347年7月14日领地瓜分，贝尔纳德获得维尔勒-瓦伦，尼古拉保留维尔勒-居斯特罗。1338年1月6日他娶梅克伦堡的阿格内丝为妻，生子洛伦茨和约翰五世；第二任妻子是荷尔斯泰因-基尔的梅希蒂尔德，生女卡塔琳娜。1360年8月10日是他最后一次见于记载。

en: Nicholas IV, nicknamed Poogenoge or Pig's Eyes (before 1331–1354), ruled Werle-Goldberg from 1350 until his death, the son of John III and Mechtild of Pomerania. He took over a lordship ruined by his father's Rügen war: Laage, Malchin, Stavenhagen and Malchow were pledged to John's war contractors with little hope of redemption. Nicholas governed jointly with his father at first and alone once John withdrew in 1350. The nickname was said to come from the shape and expression of his eyes. On 14 March 1354 he still concluded a regional peace pact, and he died before 13 November that year. His son John IV succeeded him; his wife Agnes, probably a daughter of Ulrich II of Lindow-Ruppin, afterwards married John I of Mecklenburg-Stargard.
zh: 尼古拉四世，绰号“猪眼”（1331年前—1354），是约翰三世与波美拉尼亚的梅希蒂尔德之子，1350年至去世任维尔勒-戈尔德贝格领主。他接手的领地已被父亲的吕根之战拖垮：拉格、马尔欣、施塔文哈根和马尔肖早已抵押给为约翰作战的承包商，几乎无望赎回。他起初与父亲共同执政，1350年父亲引退后独自统治。这个绰号据称来自他眼睛的形状与神情。1354年3月14日他还缔结了一份地区和约，同年11月13日前去世。他的儿子约翰四世继位；妻子阿格妮丝可能是林道-鲁平的乌尔里希二世之女，后来改嫁梅克伦堡-施塔加德的约翰一世。

en: Nicholas of Werle-Güstrow (c. 1263–1298) was a son of Henry I, Lord of Werle-Güstrow, and his first wife Rikissa Birgersdotter. Fearing that their father's second marriage would cost them their inheritance, Nicholas and his brother Henry II murdered Henry I during a hunt near Saal on 8 October 1291 and succeeded him in Güstrow. Their rule was short: their cousin Nicholas II of Werle-Parchim overthrew and persecuted the brothers and reunited Werle. Nicholas died in 1298.
zh: 维尔勒-居斯特罗的尼古拉（约1263—1298）是维尔勒-居斯特罗领主海因里希一世与第一任妻子里基莎·比耶格斯多塔之子。由于担心父亲再婚会危及自己的继承权，1291年10月8日，他与兄弟海因里希二世在萨尔附近的一次狩猎中杀死海因里希一世，随后在居斯特罗继位。但兄弟二人掌权不久，堂兄维尔勒-帕尔希姆的尼古拉二世便推翻并迫害他们，重新统一了维尔勒。尼古拉于1298年去世。

en: Richardis (born c. 1316) was the second wife of John III, Lord of Werle-Goldberg, marrying him after his first wife died around 1332. Her birth family is unrecorded. Her daughters Sophia and Rixa married Albert II of Lindow-Ruppin and became prioress of Dobbertin Abbey.
zh: 里夏迪斯（约1316年生）是维尔勒-戈尔德贝格领主约翰三世的第二任妻子，在他的前妻约1332年去世后与他成婚，出身不详。她的女儿索菲娅嫁给林道-鲁平的阿尔布雷希特二世，里克莎则成为多贝尔廷修道院的女修院院长。

en: Sophia of Werle (c. 1320–1364) was a daughter of John II, Lord of Werle-Güstrow, and Matilda of Brunswick-Grubenhagen. She married Duke Barnim IV of Pomerania-Wolgast-Rügen, to whom she bore Wartislaw VI, Bogislaw VI and Elisabeth, who married Duke Magnus I of Mecklenburg.
zh: 维尔勒的索菲娅（约1320—1364）是居斯特罗领主约翰二世与不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的玛蒂尔德之女，嫁波美拉尼亚公爵巴尔宁四世，生瓦季斯瓦夫六世、波吉斯瓦夫六世和伊丽莎白；后者嫁梅克伦堡公爵马格努斯一世。

en: Sophia of Werle-Goldberg (died 1384) was a daughter of John III, Lord of Werle-Goldberg, by his second wife Richardis. She married Count Albert II of Lindow-Ruppin. Her half-brother Nicholas IV governed Werle-Goldberg alone from 1350.
zh: 维尔勒-戈尔德贝格的索菲娅（1384年卒）是领主约翰三世与续弦理卡迪丝之女，嫁林道-鲁平伯爵阿尔布雷希特二世。她同父异母的兄弟尼古拉四世从1350年起独掌维尔勒-戈尔德贝格的政务。

en: Guarino da Verona (1374–1460) was an Italian Renaissance humanist and a pioneer of Greek studies in Italy. Born in Verona, he spent five years in Constantinople learning Greek under Manuel Chrysoloras, returning in 1408 with Greek manuscripts. It was said that the loss of one case of manuscripts in a shipwreck turned his hair grey overnight. He taught Greek in Verona, Venice and Florence before becoming professor at Ferrara in 1436 under the patronage of Marquis Leonello d'Este, where pupils such as Vittorino da Feltre flocked to his lectures. He interpreted for Byzantine envoys at the councils of Ferrara and Florence, translated Strabo and some of Plutarch's Lives, and compiled a Greek grammar.
zh: 维罗纳的瓜里诺（1374—1460）是意大利文艺复兴人文主义者、意大利希腊学研究的先驱。他生于维罗纳，曾在君士坦丁堡师从赫里索洛拉斯攻读希腊文五年，1408年携希腊文手稿回国。相传一箱手稿在海难中丢失，使他一夜白头。他先后在维罗纳、威尼斯、佛罗伦萨讲授希腊文。1436年，他在莱昂内洛·德埃斯特侯爵资助下出任费拉拉的希腊文教授，费尔特雷的维多里诺等学生慕名前来。他曾在费拉拉和佛罗伦萨的公会议上为拜占庭使节担任口译，译有斯特拉波的作品和普鲁塔克的部分传记，还编写了一部希腊语法纲要。

en: Bino Gabrielli, in full Bino di Pietro dei Gabrielli, was a Guelph nobleman of Gubbio and a son of Pietro di Gabriello, brother of Cante Gabrielli, the Florentine podestà who condemned Dante to exile. Bino served as podestà of Lucca in 1300 and Orvieto in 1303. In the first half of 1306 he held the same office in Florence and commanded its troops against Pistoia, taking possession of the city after its surrender on 10 April. On his return to Florence, knights honored him with a golden canopy. His descendants were the first lords of Carbonana Castle, on the road between Gubbio and Umbertide.
zh: 比诺·加布里埃利，全名比诺·迪·彼得罗·德·加布里埃利，是古比奥的圭尔夫派贵族，彼得罗·迪·加布里埃洛之子，也是判处但丁流放的佛罗伦萨长官坎特·加布里埃利的兄弟。他于1300年任卢卡长官，1303年任奥尔维耶托长官。1306年上半年，他出任佛罗伦萨长官，并率军征讨皮斯托亚，在该城于4月10日投降后接管了它。返回佛罗伦萨时，骑士们以金色华盖向他致敬。他的后裔是古比奥通往翁贝蒂德要道上卡尔博纳纳城堡的最早领主。

en: Cante dei Gabrielli di Gubbio (c. 1260–c. 1335) was an Italian condottiero from a leading Guelph family of Gubbio. In 1298 he mediated a peace between Bologna and Azzo VIII d'Este. Driven out of Gubbio by the Ghibellines in 1300, he returned among men disguised as pilgrims during the feast of St John and took control of the city, becoming its de facto lord. He was repeatedly podestà of cities such as Florence, Siena and Orvieto. Entering Florence with Charles of Valois in November 1301, he became podestà and in January and March 1302 issued the sentences condemning Dante Alighieri to lifelong exile. In 1317 Pope John XXII made him captain general of the Guelph League; he took Assisi in 1321 and later Urbino. He died in Gubbio around 1335.
zh: 坎特·德·加百列（约1260—约1335）是出身古比奥圭尔夫派名门的意大利雇佣军首领。1298年，他调解博洛尼亚与阿佐八世·德斯特之间的和平。1300年他被吉伯林派逐出古比奥，随后在圣约翰节与一群假扮朝圣者的人返回，夺取城市控制权，成为事实上的统治者。他多次出任佛罗伦萨、锡耶纳、奥尔维耶托等城市的长官。1301年11月，他随瓦卢瓦的查理进入佛罗伦萨并就任长官，于1302年1月和3月两次宣判，将但丁·阿利吉耶里终身流放。1317年，教皇约翰二十二世任命他为圭尔夫联盟统帅；他于1321年攻克阿西西，随后攻取乌尔比诺，约1335年在古比奥去世。

en: Cante II Gabrielli was the son of Jacopo de' Gabrielli da Gubbio and a grandson of the Cante Gabrielli who condemned Dante to exile. Driven from Gubbio when Giovanni di Cantuccio seized power in 1350, he took part in operations against the city in 1352 and recovered Monte Santa Maria. In 1355 Cardinal Albornoz imprisoned him and his father at Montefalco. Cante was podestà of Bologna in 1378, then served Florence as captain of the guard in 1379, when he arrested and executed suspected conspirators after the Ciompi revolt. In 1380 he returned to Gubbio and joined an uprising against Bishop Gabriello Gabrielli.
zh: 坎特二世·加布里埃利是雅各波·德·加布里埃利·达·古比奥之子，也是判处但丁流放的坎特·加布里埃利之孙。1350年乔瓦尼·迪·坎图乔夺取古比奥后，他被迫离城；1352年他参与对古比奥的军事行动，夺回了蒙特圣玛丽亚。1355年枢机主教阿尔沃诺斯将他与父亲囚禁在蒙特法尔科。1378年坎特担任博洛尼亚长官，1379年任佛罗伦萨卫戍队长，在梳毛工起义后逮捕并处决了涉嫌密谋者。1380年他返回古比奥，参加反对主教加布里埃洛·加布里埃利的起事。

en: Cantuccio Gabrielli was a nobleman of the Guelph Gabrielli family of Gubbio and a son of Bino Gabrielli. In 1315 he served as podestà of Orvieto. Florence appointed him captain of war in 1331 during its conflict with Lucca, but his youth and inexperience hindered his command. His son Giovanni di Cantuccio Gabrielli made himself signore of Gubbio in 1350 and ruled the city until 1354.
zh: 坎图乔·加布里埃利是古比奥圭尔夫贵族加布里埃利家族的成员，比诺·加布里埃利之子。1315年，他担任奥尔维耶托长官。1331年佛罗伦萨与卢卡交战时，他被任命为佛罗伦萨战争队长，但年轻缺乏经验，指挥表现不佳。其子乔瓦尼·迪·坎图乔·加布里埃利于1350年自立为古比奥领主，统治该城至1354年。

en: Gabriello di Necciolo Gabrielli was a nobleman of Gubbio and an early figure of the Gabrielli family. He served as podestà of Gubbio in 1224 and again in 1229. His son Pietro also held that office, and his grandson Cante later became podestà of Florence, where he condemned Dante to exile in 1302.
zh: 加布里埃洛·迪·内乔洛·加布里埃利是古比奥贵族，也是加布里埃利家族的早期人物。他于1224年和1229年两度出任古比奥执政官。其子彼得罗也担任过这一职务，孙子坎特后来成为佛罗伦萨执政官，于1302年判处但丁流放。

en: Gabriello Gabrielli was a prelate of the Gabrielli of Gubbio who became bishop and ruler of his native city. In 1376 he and his brother Francesco took control of the consular offices during a revolt against papal rule. Appointed bishop in 1377, he later brought Gubbio back under papal authority. In 1380 he returned with cavalry to suppress a revolt against him. By 1381 he governed the city and received the papal vicariate. Pope Urban VI revoked it in 1383, and Gabriello relinquished his authority over Gubbio. He retired to Cantiano, where he died of plague that autumn.
zh: 加布里埃洛·加布里埃利出身古比奥加布里埃利家族，成为故乡的主教和统治者。1376年，他与兄弟弗朗切斯科趁反抗教皇统治的起义掌握了执政官职位。1377年他获任主教，随后使古比奥重归教皇权威。1380年，他率骑兵返回古比奥，镇压了反对他的起事。至1381年，他已统治该城，并获教皇任命为代理。1383年教皇乌尔班六世撤销其代理职务，加布里埃洛放弃了对古比奥的权力。他退往坎蒂亚诺，当年秋天死于瘟疫。

en: Giovanni di Cantuccio Gabrielli, count of Borgovalle, was a Gubbio nobleman who on 7 August 1350 made himself signore of Gubbio, ending Guelph communal rule. In 1350 he razed the castle of Camporeggiano, and in 1351 his troops devastated Fratta during the wars between Perugia and the Visconti. Besieged in 1354 by Cardinal Albornoz, he surrendered Gubbio to the Church, and in 1355 he was imprisoned at Montefalco with his cousin Jacopo Gabrielli.
zh: 乔瓦尼·迪·坎图乔·加布里埃利是博尔戈瓦莱伯爵、古比奥贵族。1350年8月7日，他自立为古比奥领主，结束了圭尔夫派的公社统治。1350年他夷平坎波雷贾诺城堡；1351年佩鲁贾与维斯孔蒂家族交战期间，他的军队劫掠了弗拉塔。1354年枢机主教阿尔沃诺斯围攻古比奥，他将城市交给教会；1355年他与表亲雅各波·加布里埃利一同被囚于蒙特法尔科。

en: Jacopo de' Gabrielli da Gubbio (1295–1363) was born at Gubbio, son of Cante Gabrielli, who as podestà of Florence sentenced Dante to exile. Knighted in 1326, he became podestà of Bologna in 1327 but left rather than swear obedience to Cardinal Bertrand du Pouget, who was making himself master of the city. As Siena's war captain he subdued Grosseto in 1334 and Massa Marittima in 1335. Florence made him Conservatore of its state in 1335, and in 1337 he took possession of Arezzo. His harsh and arbitrary rule won him the name of tyrant of Florence, and he was later said to have prepared the way for the Duke of Athens, who seized the city in 1342. As Senator of Rome in 1338–1339 he restored the Milvian Bridge and other works wrecked by factional fighting. Cardinal Albornoz imprisoned him in 1355 for refusing to surrender Cantiano; reconciled, Jacopo became his governor of Faenza and Todi, and died in 1363.
zh: 雅各布·德·加布里埃利·达·古比奥（1295—1363）生于古比奥，是坎特·加布里埃利之子——其父任佛罗伦萨最高行政长官时判处但丁流放。他于1326年受封骑士，1327年出任博洛尼亚最高行政长官，却不愿向正在把该城攥进手里的贝特朗·迪·普热枢机宣誓服从，宁可离职。他为锡耶纳统兵，于1334年征服格罗塞托、1335年征服马萨马里蒂马。1335年佛罗伦萨任命他为国家执政官，1337年他接收了阿雷佐。他的行事严酷专断，得了“佛罗伦萨暴君”之名，后人还说他为1342年夺取该城的雅典公爵铺了路。他于1338—1339年任罗马元老，重修了米尔维奥桥和其他毁于派系争斗的工程。1355年，他因拒绝交出坎蒂亚诺，遭阿尔沃诺斯枢机囚禁；双方和解后，他出任枢机治下的法恩扎和托迪总督，1363年去世。

en: Necciolo Gabrielli was a Gubbio nobleman and father of Gabriello Gabrielli, who became bishop of Gubbio in 1377, governed the city in 1381 and relinquished power before dying in 1383, and Francesco Gabrielli, lord of Cantiano.
zh: 内乔洛·加布里埃利是古比奥贵族，其子加布里埃洛·加布里埃利于1377年成为古比奥主教，1381年统治该城，1383年放弃权力并去世；另一个儿子弗朗切斯科·加布里埃利是坎蒂亚诺领主。

en: Nello Gabrielli (born c. 1304) was a Gubbio nobleman of the Gabrielli family, a son of Cante Gabrielli, the Guelph captain who condemned Dante to exile and made himself signore of Gubbio.
zh: 内洛·加布里埃利（约1304年生）是古比奥加布里埃利家族贵族，圭尔夫派领袖坎特·加布里埃利之子；其父曾判处但丁流放并成为古比奥领主。

en: Pietro di Gabriello Gabrielli was a nobleman of the Gabrielli family of Gubbio. His father Gabriello had served as the city's podestà, and Pietro held the same office in 1261 before becoming captain of the people in 1263. Pietro was the father of Cante Gabrielli, the Florentine podestà who condemned Dante Alighieri to exile in 1302.
zh: 彼得罗·迪·加布里埃洛·加布里埃利是古比奥加布里埃利家族的贵族。他的父亲加布里埃洛曾任古比奥执政官，彼得罗于1261年担任同一职务，1263年又出任人民队长。彼得罗是坎特·加布里埃利之父；坎特出任佛罗伦萨执政官时，于1302年判处但丁流放。

en: Rosso Gabrielli was a Gubbio nobleman of the Guelph Gabrielli family and a son of Pietro di Gabriello. He served as podestà of Fossombrone in 1287 and later of Florence, where, after the battle of Campaldino, he led operations against the castles of Anghiari and Poppi and the lands of Count Guido Novello. He held office at Roccacontrada in 1291–1292 and 1294, and at Siena in 1293.
zh: 罗索·加布里埃利是古比奥圭尔夫派加布里埃利家族的贵族，彼得罗·迪·加布里埃洛之子。1287年他出任福松布罗内执政官，后来担任佛罗伦萨执政官；坎帕尔迪诺战役后，他率军攻毁安吉亚里和波皮的城堡，并蹂躏圭多·诺韦洛伯爵的领地。他于1291—1292年和1294年担任罗卡孔特拉达执政官，1293年又出任锡耶纳执政官。

en: Guillaume Budé (1467–1540) was France's leading humanist. After studying law at Orléans, he devoted himself to Latin and Greek at about the age of twenty-four. He won fame with the Annotationes in Pandectas (1508), which applied philology to Roman law, and De Asse (1514), a treatise on ancient coins and measures. Sent as ambassador to Rome under Louis XII and made master of requests under Francis I, he persuaded Francis to found the Collège des Trois Langues, later the Collège de France, and the royal library at Fontainebleau, whose books began the Bibliothèque nationale. In 1529 he published a collection of notes on the Greek language. In 1533 he helped dissuade the king from banning printing. He died in Paris on 20 August 1540.
zh: 纪尧姆·比代（1467—1540）是法国首屈一指的人文主义者。他曾在奥尔良学习法律，约二十四岁时潜心研习拉丁语和希腊语。1508年，他出版《〈学说汇纂〉评注》，以文献学方法研究罗马法，1514年又写成论述古代钱币与度量衡的《论阿司》，由此享誉欧洲。他在路易十二朝出使罗马，在弗朗索瓦一世朝任请愿官，并推动弗朗索瓦一世创立三语学院（即后来的法兰西公学院）和枫丹白露王室图书馆，后者构成法国国家图书馆的雏形。1529年，他出版希腊语注释集。1533年，他促成国王放弃查禁印刷术。1540年8月20日，他在巴黎去世。

en: Guru Amar Das (1479–1574) was the third Sikh guru. Born at Basarke, he followed the Vaishnava tradition and made repeated pilgrimages to Haridwar on the Ganges. He was about sixty when in 1539 he heard his nephew's wife Bibi Amro, daughter of Guru Angad, sing a Nanak hymn, and became Angad's disciple, succeeding him on 26 March 1552. From Goindwal he organised the community through the Manji system, appointing representatives to spread the faith, and a Peerah system for women. He gathered its hymns into a pothi that fed into the Adi Granth, and pushed reforms, banning sati and permitting widow remarriage. He died on 1 September 1574, naming his son-in-law Jetha as Guru Ram Das.
zh: 古鲁·阿摩罗·达斯（1479—1574）是锡克教第三任古鲁。他出生于巴萨尔凯，早年信奉毗湿奴派，多次前往恒河畔的赫尔德瓦尔朝圣。1539年，年约六十的他听到侄媳比比·阿姆罗吟唱那纳克的赞美诗；阿姆罗是古鲁·安加德之女，他遂成为安加德的弟子，并于1552年3月26日继其位。他以戈因德瓦尔为中心，通过“曼吉”制度组织教团，委派代表到各地传教，还设立面向女性的“皮拉”制度。他把教团的赞美诗汇编成一部波提，后来成为《阿迪·格兰特》的基础；他还推动改革，禁止萨蒂、允许寡妇再嫁。他于1574年9月1日去世，临终前立女婿杰塔为继任者，即古鲁·拉姆·达斯。

en: Guru Angad (1504–1552), born Lehna at Matte-di-Sarai, was the second of the Sikh gurus. His family left their ancestral village for Khadur in fear of an invasion by Babur's armies. A priest of the goddess Durga in Khadur, he met Guru Nanak at Kartarpur in his late twenties and served him devotedly for six or seven years; on 7 September 1539 Nanak renamed him Angad and installed him as successor. He led the community from Khadur Sahib on the Beas, adopted and formalised the Gurmukhi alphabet for the Sikh scriptures, and began collecting Nanak's hymns, adding sixty-two or sixty-three saloks of his own. He died on 29 March 1552, having chosen his disciple Amar Das as the third guru.
zh: 古鲁·安加德（1504—1552），原名勒希那，出生于马泰迪萨赖，是锡克教第二位古鲁。他的家人因担心巴布尔的军队入侵，离开祖居的村庄迁往卡杜尔。他原是卡杜尔供奉难近母女神的祭司，年近三十时在卡尔塔普尔遇见古鲁·那纳克，随后忠心侍奉六七年；1539年9月7日，那纳克为他改名“安加德”，立他为继任者。他在贝阿斯河畔的卡杜尔萨希卜领导教团，采用并规范了书写锡克教经典的古木基字母，开始收集那纳克的赞美诗，并加入自己所作的六十二或六十三首短诗。他于1552年3月29日去世，临终前选定弟子阿摩罗·达斯为第三任古鲁。

en: Guru Arjan (1563–1606), the fifth Sikh Guru, succeeded his father Guru Ram Das in 1581. His succession caused disputes and divisions among the Sikhs. He founded settlements including Tarn Taran and completed the Harmandir Sahib at Amritsar, where his father had founded the town and built a sacred pool. He compiled the Adi Granth, collecting the hymns of earlier Gurus and other saints into one scripture, which he installed in the temple. He also reorganized the Masand system, urging Sikhs to give one-tenth of their income to fund gurdwaras and communal kitchens. Arrested on the orders of the Mughal emperor Jahangir for backing the rebel prince Khusrau Mirza, he refused to convert and was put to death in 1606, becoming the first Sikh martyr.
zh: 古鲁·阿尔琼（1563—1606）是第五位锡克古鲁，1581年继其父古鲁·拉姆·达斯之位。他的继位在锡克人中引发争议与分裂。他创建了塔恩塔兰等聚落，并建成阿姆利则的哈曼迪尔·萨希卜庙；他的父亲此前已在那里创建城镇并修建圣池。他编纂《阿迪·格兰特》，将此前历代古鲁和其他圣徒的颂诗汇成一部圣典，安奉于庙中。他还整顿马桑德制度，号召锡克人捐出十分之一收入，用于兴建谒师所和公共食堂。他因支持叛乱王子胡斯劳·米尔扎，被莫卧儿皇帝贾汉吉尔下令逮捕，因拒绝改宗于1606年遇害，成为第一位锡克教殉道者。

en: Guru Gobind Singh (1666–1708), born Gobind Das in Patna, became the tenth Sikh Guru in 1675 after his father Guru Tegh Bahadur was beheaded on Aurangzeb's orders. His education included riding and archery, and in 1685 he moved to Paonta by the Yamuna. A warrior, poet and philosopher, he fought twenty-one battles against Mughal armies and the hill rajas of the Sivaliks. On Vaisakhi 1699 at Anandpur he founded the Khalsa, a Sikh warrior community, and introduced the Five Ks. Two of his sons died in battle and two were executed by the Mughal administrator Wazir Khan. He completed the Guru Granth Sahib and named it the eternal Guru, ending the line of human Gurus before his death in October 1708.
zh: 古鲁·戈宾德·辛格（1666—1708）原名戈宾德·达斯，生于巴特那，1675年其父古鲁·得格·巴哈杜尔被奥朗则布下令处斩后继任为第十代锡克古鲁。他所受的教育包括骑马与射箭，1685年迁至亚穆纳河畔的旁塔。他集武士、诗人与哲人于一身，与莫卧儿军队及西瓦利克山的土邦主交战二十一次。1699年维萨基节，他在阿南德普尔创立锡克武士团体卡尔萨，并提出“五K”戒律。他的两个儿子战死，另两个被莫卧儿官员瓦齐尔汗处决。他最终编定《古鲁·格兰特·萨希卜》，宣布这部经典为永恒的古鲁，结束了人代代任古鲁的传承，于1708年10月去世。

en: Guru Har Krishan (1656–1664) was the eighth Sikh Guru and its youngest, placed on the gaddi at the age of five in 1661 after his father Guru Har Rai disowned the elder son Ram Rai for altering scripture to please Aurangzeb. Aurangzeb meanwhile rewarded Ram Rai with land grants in the Dehra Dun region. In 1664 the emperor summoned the child through Raja Jai Singh to Delhi, apparently intending to replace him with Ram Rai. Har Krishan contracted smallpox there and the meeting was cancelled; he died on 30 March, before his eighth birthday. His last words, Baba Bakala, guided the Sikhs to his grand-uncle Guru Tegh Bahadur as the ninth Guru.
zh: 古鲁·哈尔·克利香（1656—1664）是第八位锡克古鲁，也是最年幼的一位：1661年其父古鲁·哈尔·拉伊因长子拉姆·拉伊为讨好奥朗则布篡改经文而与他断绝关系，年仅五岁的克利香遂登古鲁之位。奥朗则布则赏赐拉姆·拉伊德拉敦地区的土地。1664年皇帝通过拉贾斋·辛格把这位幼童召往德里，似有意以拉姆·拉伊取而代之。克利香在德里染上天花，会面因此取消；他于3月30日夭折，未满八岁。他临终留下“巴巴在巴卡拉”的遗言，指引锡克人找到他的叔祖古鲁·得格·巴哈杜尔，是为第九代古鲁。

en: Guru Har Rai (1630–1661) became the seventh Sikh Guru in 1644, aged fourteen, succeeding his grandfather Guru Hargobind. His elder brother Dhir Mal, backed by the Mughals, had sought to form a rival Sikh tradition. Though Har Rai kept the army Hargobind had built, he avoided war, devoting himself to preaching, care for all living things, and the singing of scripture. In the Mughal succession war he backed the tolerant prince Dara Shikoh against Aurangzeb and provided Dara with medical care. Summoned to court in 1660 to explain his support, he sent his elder son Ram Rai, who altered a line of the Adi Granth to please Aurangzeb. Har Rai disowned him and named his younger son Har Krishan his successor; he died in 1661, aged thirty-one.
zh: 古鲁·哈尔·拉伊（1630—1661）于1644年成为第七位锡克古鲁，年十四岁，继其祖父古鲁·哈尔戈宾德之位。他的兄长迪尔·马尔曾在莫卧儿支持下试图另立锡克派系。他保留了祖父建立的军队，却避免战争，致力于传教、爱护众生和唱诵经文。莫卧儿皇位继承战争中，他支持宽厚的王子达拉·舒科，反对奥朗则布，还为达拉提供医疗照护。1660年，他被召入宫廷解释自己对达拉的支持，遂派长子拉姆·拉伊前往；后者为讨好奥朗则布而篡改《阿迪·格兰特》中的一句经文。哈尔·拉伊遂与他断绝关系，指定幼子哈尔·克利香继位；他于1661年去世，年仅三十一岁。

en: Guru Hargobind (1595–1644) became the sixth Sikh Guru in 1606, aged eleven, after his father Guru Arjan was executed on Jahangir's orders. As a boy he studied religious texts with Bhai Gurdas and learned swordsmanship and archery from Baba Buddha. He armed the Sikh community, wore two swords symbolising miri and piri, temporal and spiritual authority, founded its first army, the Akal Sena, and built the Akal Takht before the Harmandir Sahib at Amritsar. In 1609 Jahangir jailed him in Gwalior Fort; released around 1612, he is said to have freed fifty-two imprisoned Rajput rajas, remembered as Bandi Chhor Divas. He later fought four campaigns against Shah Jahan's armies and died at Kiratpur in 1644.
zh: 古鲁·哈尔戈宾德（1595—1644）于1606年成为第六位锡克古鲁，年十一岁，此前其父古鲁·阿尔琼被贾汉吉尔下令处死。他少年时随巴伊·古尔达斯研习宗教经典，向巴巴·布达学习剑术与射箭。他武装锡克社群，身佩双剑，象征世俗与精神双重权威，即米里与皮里；他建立锡克人的第一支军队阿卡尔·塞纳，并在阿姆利则的哈曼迪尔·萨希卜庙前修建阿卡尔塔赫特。1609年贾汉吉尔将他囚禁于瓜廖尔堡，约1612年获释时，相传他使被关押的五十二名拉杰普特土邦主一同获释，此事被纪念为班迪·乔尔·迪瓦斯。他后来与沙贾汗的军队四次交战，1644年在基拉特布尔去世。

en: Guru Nanak (1469–1539) was the Indian mystic and poet honoured as the founder of Sikhism and its first guru. Born at Talwandi, now Nankana Sahib in the Punjab, he worked as a storekeeper in Sultanpur before a spiritual awakening around 1496. He then travelled widely preaching Ik Onkar, the one God in all creation, and teaching equality and honest work. About 1524 he settled at Kartarpur on the Ravi, where he established communal worship and the common kitchen; his 974 hymns enter the Guru Granth Sahib. Among the prayers included in the scripture are his Japji Sahib and Asa di Var, the Ballad of Hope. He died there on 22 September 1539, having named Lehna as Guru Angad.
zh: 古鲁·那纳克（1469—1539）是印度神秘主义者与诗人，被尊为锡克教创始人、首任古鲁。他出生于塔尔万迪，即今旁遮普的南卡纳萨希卜，早年在苏丹布尔做仓库管事，约1496年获得灵性觉悟。此后他四处游历，传讲“伊克·昂卡尔”，即寓于一切造物之中的独一真神，并倡导平等与诚实劳动。约1524年，他在拉维河畔的卡尔塔普尔定居，建立集体礼拜和公共食堂制度；他的974首赞美诗收入《古鲁·格兰特·萨希卜》，其中的祈祷文包括《贾普吉·萨希卜》和《希望之歌》。他于1539年9月22日在当地去世，临终前指定勒希那继任，即古鲁·安加德。

en: Guru Ram Das (1534–1581), born Jetha in Lahore, was the fourth Sikh guru. Orphaned at seven, he grew up with his maternal grandmother and moved with her to Goindwal at twelve. He served Guru Amar Das there and in 1553 married his daughter Bibi Bhani; in 1574 Amar Das chose him over his sons as successor. Facing hostility from those sons, he moved the community to Guru-ka-Chak and founded Ramdaspur, later Amritsar, Sikhism's holiest city, where he dug the Amrit Sarovar and invited merchants and artisans to settle. He expanded the manji system and composed 638 hymns, about a tenth of the Guru Granth Sahib. He died at Goindwal on 1 September 1581, succeeded by his son Arjan.
zh: 古鲁·拉姆·达斯（1534—1581），原名杰塔，出生于拉合尔，是锡克教第四任古鲁。他七岁成孤，由外祖母抚养，十二岁随她迁至戈因德瓦尔。他在那里侍奉古鲁·阿摩罗·达斯，1553年娶其女比比·芭妮为妻；1574年，阿摩罗·达斯越过诸子选他为继任者。面对前任诸子的敌意，他把教团中心迁往古鲁卡恰克，建立了后来改名阿姆利则的拉姆达斯布尔，即锡克教最神圣的城市；他在当地挖掘了“阿姆利特萨罗瓦尔”圣池，并招徕商人与工匠定居。他扩充了曼吉制度，创作638首赞美诗，约占《古鲁·格兰特·萨希卜》的十分之一。他于1581年9月1日在戈因德瓦尔去世，由儿子阿尔琼继任。

en: Guru Tegh Bahadur (1621–1675), born Tyag Mal in Amritsar, was the youngest son of Guru Hargobind, who renamed him for bravery in the Battle of Kartarpur. He lived in retreat at Bakala until 1664, when the dying words of the child Guru Har Krishan led the Sikhs to acclaim him their ninth Guru. Several claimants had appeared at Bakala; Sikh tradition tells how the merchant Makhan Shah recognised Tegh Bahadur when he knew of the merchant's secret vow. He founded Anandpur Sahib and travelled as far as Assam preaching; 115 of his hymns entered the Guru Granth Sahib. Sikh accounts say he defended Kashmiri Brahmins facing forced conversion under Aurangzeb; he was taken to Delhi and beheaded on the emperor's orders in November 1675.
zh: 古鲁·得格·巴哈杜尔（1621—1675）原名提亚格·马尔，生于阿姆利则，是古鲁·哈尔戈宾德的幼子，因在卡尔塔布尔之战中表现英勇而得今名。他长年隐居巴卡拉，直到1664年，年幼的古鲁·哈尔·克利香临终遗言指引锡克人奉他为第九代古鲁。巴卡拉当时出现了多名继承者；锡克传说记载，商人马克汉·沙阿发现得格·巴哈杜尔知晓他暗许的誓愿，认出他才是真正的古鲁。他建立阿南德普尔·萨希卜城，远行至阿萨姆传教，有115首颂诗被收入《古鲁·格兰特·萨希卜》。锡克记载称他为遭奥朗则布逼迫改宗的克什米尔婆罗门仗义执言；他被押往德里，于1675年11月奉皇帝之命斩首。

en: A later manuscript of Khadag Rai's Gopachala chronicle names Kunwar Pal as the grandfather of Virasimha Dev, who seized Gwalior Fort in 1394 and founded the Tomara line of Gwalior rajas.
zh: 哈达格·赖所著戈帕查拉编年史的一份晚出写本将昆瓦尔·帕尔记作维尔辛格·德夫的祖父；维尔辛格·德夫于1394年夺取瓜廖尔堡垒，开创了瓜廖尔都摩罗诸王的世系。

en: Virsingh Dev (Virasimha-deva) was the first Tomara raja of Gwalior. A feudatory of the Tughluq sultans of Delhi, he rebelled in 1391 and was defeated by the imperial general Islam Khan. Later chronicles relate that while serving as a palace watchman in Delhi his vigilance during a rainstorm moved Sultan Ala ud-din Sikandar Shah to grant him Gwalior Fort in 1394; when its governor resisted, Virsingh took the fort by surprising him at a banquet. Muslim chroniclers date the seizure to the confusion of Timur's 1398 invasion. He ruled Gwalior until about 1400 and was succeeded by Uddharana Dev.
zh: 维尔辛格·德夫是瓜廖尔的初代都摩罗罗阇。他本是德里图格鲁克苏丹的封臣，1391年起兵反叛，被朝廷将领伊斯兰汗击败。后世编年史记载，他在德里王宫充当守门人时，因在暴雨中坚守岗位感动了阿拉丁·西坎达尔沙苏丹，遂于1394年获赐瓜廖尔堡垒；当地总督拒不让出，维尔辛格便在一次宴会上发动突袭夺取堡垒。穆斯林编年史家则把夺城归于1398年帖木儿入侵造成的乱局。他统治瓜廖尔至约1400年，由乌达拉纳·德夫继位。

en: The Garhwal royal chronicle lists Anant Pal II as the thirty-sixth Panwar raja of Garhwal, reigning from 1330 to 1358 after Jit Pal and before Ajay Pal, who united the fifty-two hill forts into the Garhwal kingdom in 1358.
zh: 据加瓦尔王室编年史记载，阿南特·帕尔二世是加瓦尔的第36代潘瓦尔罗阇，1330—1358年在位，在吉特·帕尔之后、阿贾伊·帕尔之前；阿贾伊·帕尔于1358年将当地52座山寨统一为加瓦尔王国。

en: Agnes of Nuremberg (before 1326 – after 1363), a Hohenzollern, was a daughter of Burgrave Frederick IV of Nuremberg. She married Count Berthold V of Neuffen, lord of Marstetten and Graisbach, and after his death in 1342 Count Albert of Werdenberg-Heiligenberg.
zh: 阿格内丝·冯·纽伦堡（1326年前—1363年后）出身霍亨索伦家族，是纽伦堡城伯腓特烈四世之女，先嫁马施泰滕与格赖斯巴赫领主诺伊芬伯爵贝托尔德五世，1342年其死后改嫁韦登贝格-海利根贝格伯爵阿尔布雷希特。

en: Albert I of Habsburg (July 1255 – 1 May 1308), eldest son of Rudolf I, received Austria and Styria from his father in 1282. The Treaty of Rheinfelden in 1283 entrusted him with their sole government. Passed over by the electors in 1291, he defeated King Adolf of Nassau at the Battle of Göllheim in 1298, where Adolf was killed, and was elected King of the Romans and crowned at Aachen. Pope Boniface VIII recognized him only in 1303. In 1306 he placed his son Rudolf on the Bohemian throne, but defeat at Lucka in 1307 checked him in Thuringia. On 1 May 1308 his nephew John Parricida murdered him at Windisch on the Reuss.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特一世（1255年7月—1308年5月1日）是鲁道夫一世的长子，1282年从父亲手中获得奥地利与施蒂利亚。1283年的《莱茵费尔登条约》将两地的统治权单独交给他。1291年选帝侯们没有选他，他便于1298年在格尔海姆战役击败拿骚的阿道夫，后者在战斗中身亡；他随后当选罗马人的国王，在亚琛加冕。教皇卜尼法斯八世迟至1303年才承认他。1306年他把儿子鲁道夫扶上波希米亚王位，但1307年在图林根的卢卡战败受挫。1308年5月1日，他在罗伊斯河畔的温迪施被侄子“弑亲者”约翰杀害。

en: Albert II the Wise or the Lame (1298–1358), a younger son of Albert I, was elected Bishop of Passau in 1313 while still a minor but gave up the see in 1317. In 1330 he succeeded Frederick the Fair as duke of Austria and Styria. His 1324 marriage to Joanna of Pfirt brought the county of Pfirt. When Henry of Carinthia died without a male heir, Albert pressed his claim against John of Bohemia, and on 2 May 1335 Emperor Louis IV enfeoffed him and Otto with Carinthia and Carniola. That year Pope Benedict XII asked him to reconcile Louis with the Church. Probably polyarthritis crippled him, yet he kept governing. He gave Styria its constitution, the Bergbüchel, resumed the Gothic choir of St Stephen's Cathedral in Vienna, and issued the Albertinian House Rule on succession. After his death in 1358 his sons ruled jointly, until the Treaty of Neuberg in 1379 split the house into two lines.
zh: “智者”阿尔布雷希特二世（1298—1358），又称“跛者”，是阿尔布雷希特一世较年幼的儿子之一，1313年尚未成年时就被选为帕绍主教，1317年放弃该职。1330年他继兄长美男子腓特烈之后，成为奥地利和施蒂利亚公爵。1324年他与费雷特的约翰娜成婚，获得费雷特伯国。克恩滕的亨利去世后无子，阿尔布雷希特向波希米亚的约翰争夺继承权，1335年5月2日皇帝路易四世把克恩滕和卡尼奥拉封赐给他和奥托。同年，教皇本笃十二世请他调解路易与教会的冲突。他大概因多发性关节炎而行动不便，却仍然亲政。他为施蒂利亚制定了宪章《贝格比歇尔》，主持续建维也纳圣斯蒂芬大教堂的哥特式唱诗班席，并颁布《阿尔布雷希特家法》规定继承。1358年他去世后，诸子共同执政，直到1379年《新堡条约》把家族分成两支。

en: Gabriel Bethlen (1580–1629) was a Calvinist Hungarian nobleman who ruled Transylvania as prince from 1613, installed with Ottoman backing and recognised by Emperor Matthias in 1615. His father had lost his ancestral estate during the Ottoman occupation, and both his parents died in 1591. Bethlen was wounded at the Battle of Sellenberk in 1599. In the Thirty Years' War he invaded Royal Hungary in 1619, took Kassa and Pressburg and menaced Vienna, and on 20 August 1620 the diet at Besztercebánya elected him king of Hungary. At the Peace of Nikolsburg of 31 December 1621 he surrendered the crown in return for seven counties, fortresses and guaranteed religious freedom for Hungarian Protestants. After two more campaigns he made peace in 1624 and 1626, and died in 1629.
zh: 拜特伦·加博尔（1580—1629）是匈牙利加尔文宗贵族，1613年在奥斯曼支持下成为特兰西瓦尼亚亲王，1615年获皇帝马蒂亚斯承认。他的父亲在奥斯曼占领期间失去祖产，他的父母都于1591年去世。1599年，拜特伦在塞伦贝克战役中受伤。三十年战争中，他于1619年攻入匈牙利王室领地，连克科希策与普雷斯堡，兵临维也纳；1620年8月20日，班斯卡-比斯特里察议会推举他为匈牙利国王。1621年12月31日签订《尼科尔斯堡和约》，他放弃王位，换取七个州、数座要冲要塞以及匈牙利新教徒宗教自由的保障。此后他又两度用兵，分别于1624年和1626年议和，1629年去世。

en: Stephen Bocskai (1557–1606) was a Hungarian Calvinist nobleman born at Kolozsvár in Transylvania. He spent his youth at Emperor Maximilian's court and became captain of Várad in 1592. As councillor and captain to Prince Sigismund Báthory, he signed Transylvania's alliance with the Holy League at Prague in 1595 and led its troops to victory over the Ottomans at Giurgiu later that year. Hounded by Emperor Rudolf II's anti-Protestant officials, he rose in revolt in 1604 with Hajdú soldiers and was elected Prince of Transylvania in February 1605 and Prince of Hungary in April. The Treaty of Vienna of June 1606 secured Transylvania's autonomy and religious freedom for Protestant nobles and burghers; he died that December.
zh: 伯茨凯·伊什特万（1557—1606）是生于特兰西瓦尼亚科洛日瓦尔的匈牙利加尔文宗贵族。他少年时在皇帝马克西米利安的宫廷度过，1592年出任瓦拉德统领。他作为亲王巴托里·齐格蒙德的顾问与将领，于1595年在布拉格签署特兰西瓦尼亚加入神圣同盟的条约，同年又率军在久尔久之役击败奥斯曼人。因遭皇帝鲁道夫二世反新教官员的逼迫，他于1604年率豪伊杜士兵起事，1605年2月当选特兰西瓦尼亚亲王，4月又当选匈牙利亲王。1606年6月的《维也纳条约》确立了特兰西瓦尼亚的自治和新教贵族与市民的信仰自由；他于同年12月去世。

en: Catherine of Savoy (c. 1298–1336) was a daughter of Count Amadeus V of Savoy and Maria of Brabant. On 26 May 1315 she married Leopold I, Duke of Austria and Styria, at Basel, a match tied to Habsburg rapprochement with the House of Luxembourg. She took an active part in the Habsburgs' efforts to recover the imperial crown after 1308 and corresponded directly with Pope John XXII. Her two daughters married the French lord Enguerrand VI de Coucy and Duke Bolko II of Świdnica. Widowed in 1326, Catherine died at Rheinfelden in 1336 and was buried at Königsfelden Monastery.
zh: 萨伏依的卡特琳（约1298—1336）是萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥五世与布拉班特的玛丽亚之女。1315年5月26日，她在巴塞尔嫁给奥地利与施蒂利亚公爵利奥波德一世，这桩婚事与哈布斯堡家族同卢森堡家族的和解有关。她积极参与1308年后哈布斯堡家族重夺帝位的活动，并直接与教皇约翰二十二世通信。她的两个女儿分别嫁给法国领主昂盖朗六世·德·库西和希维德尼察公爵博尔科二世。1326年守寡后，卡特琳于1336年在莱茵费尔登去世，葬于柯尼希斯费尔登修道院。

en: Isabella of Aragon (1302–1330) was a daughter of James II of Aragon and Blanche of Anjou. After a planned match with Oshin of Armenia collapsed, she married Frederick I of Austria at Ravensburg on 11 May 1315. Frederick had been elected German king in October 1314 in rivalry with Louis IV of Bavaria, so Isabella became queen of a divided Germany. The rivals made peace in 1325 and ruled jointly until Frederick retired to Austria and died in January 1330. Blind for her last six years, Isabella died that July and was buried at the Franciscan church in Vienna.
zh: 阿拉贡的伊丽莎白（1302—1330）是阿拉贡国王海梅二世与安茹的布朗什之女。她与亚美尼亚的奥欣的婚约告吹后，于1315年5月11日在拉芬斯堡嫁给奥地利的腓特烈一世。腓特烈于1314年10月在与巴伐利亚的路易四世的竞争中当选德意志国王，伊丽莎白因而成为分裂的德意志的王后。两名对立国王于1325年议和并共同执政，后来腓特烈退居奥地利，1330年1月去世。伊丽莎白晚年失明六年，同年7月去世，葬于维也纳的方济各会教堂。

en: Elizabeth of Bavaria (c. 1305–1330) was born at Landshut, a daughter of Stephen I, Duke of Lower Bavaria, and Jutta of Schweidnitz. On 15 May 1325 she married Otto of Habsburg, younger brother of Duke Frederick the Fair. She bore two sons, Frederick in 1327 and Leopold in 1328, both of whom later briefly ruled Austria as dukes. When Frederick the Fair died in January 1330 her husband succeeded as Duke Otto IV, but Elizabeth died only two months later, on 25 March 1330.
zh: 维特尔斯巴赫的伊丽莎白（约1305—1330）生于兰茨胡特，是下巴伐利亚公爵施特凡一世与希维德尼察的尤塔之女。1325年5月15日，她嫁给公爵“美男子”腓特烈的弟弟、哈布斯堡家族的奥托。她生有二子：1327年出生的腓特烈和1328年出生的利奥波德，二人后来都曾短暂出任奥地利公爵。1330年1月“美男子”腓特烈去世，她的丈夫继位为奥托四世公爵，但仅两个月后，伊丽莎白便在1330年3月25日去世。

en: Frederick the Fair (1289 – 13 January 1330), second son of Albert I, ruled Austria and Styria from 1308. After Henry VII died in 1313, the divided electors chose Frederick and his cousin Louis of Bavaria as rival kings in 1314. In 1315 he married Isabella, daughter of James II of Aragon, who brought an immense dowry. Defeated and captured at the Battle of Mühldorf in 1322, he was held prisoner for three years. The Treaty of Munich in 1325 made him Louis's co-king, though he never held real power. He died at Gutenstein on 13 January 1330, succeeded in Austria by his brothers Albert II and Otto.
zh: 美男子腓特烈（1289年—1330年1月13日）是阿尔布雷希特一世的次子，1308年起统治奥地利与施蒂利亚。1313年亨利七世去世后，意见分裂的选帝侯于1314年分别选出腓特烈和他的表兄巴伐利亚的路易为对立国王。1315年，他迎娶阿拉贡国王海梅二世之女伊莎贝拉，她带来了丰厚的嫁妆。1322年，他在米尔多夫战役战败被俘，囚禁三年。1325年的《慕尼黑条约》立他为路易的共治国王，但他始终未掌实权。他于1330年1月13日卒于古滕施泰因，奥地利由弟弟阿尔布雷希特二世和奥托继承。

en: Frederick II of Habsburg (1327–1344) was the elder son of Otto the Merry, Duke of Austria, and Elizabeth of Lower Bavaria. After Otto's death in 1339 he and his brother Leopold were titular dukes under the guardianship of their uncle Albert II. That year Frederick claimed Lower Bavaria as his mother's inheritance, but Emperor Louis IV rejected his suit. Raised at Königsfelden and Lenzburg Castle, he held the Further Austrian lands. A marriage to a daughter of Edward III of England was planned but never came about. He died suddenly at Neuberg in December 1344, amid suspicions of poisoning.
zh: 哈布斯堡的腓特烈二世（1327—1344）是奥地利公爵奥托“快活者”与下巴伐利亚的伊丽莎白的长子。1339年奥托死后，他与弟弟利奥波德在叔父阿尔布雷希特二世监护下成为名义上的公爵。同年，腓特烈以母亲的继承权提出下巴伐利亚的领土要求，被皇帝路易四世驳回。他在柯尼希斯费尔登和伦茨堡长大，领有前奥地利领地；曾计划与英格兰国王爱德华三世之女联姻，最终未能成婚。1344年12月他在诺伊贝格突然去世，时人怀疑他遭人毒杀。

en: Gabriel von Salamanca (1489–1539) came from a wealthy merchant family of Burgos in Castile and was already a chancellor under Emperor Maximilian I by 1514. When Archduke Ferdinand took over Austria in 1521, Salamanca became his general treasurer and archchancellor, opening the dynasty access to Fugger loans. He was made a baron in 1523 and enfeoffed with the County of Ortenburg in Carinthia in 1524. His economic measures and alleged self-serving conduct met fierce opposition from the Austrian and Tyrolean nobility, and he was forced out in 1526. He remained Ferdinand's close adviser and retained his fiefs. In 1533 he began building a Renaissance palace at Spittal an der Drau; he died at Ensisheim in Alsace in 1539 before its completion.
zh: 加布里埃尔·冯·萨拉曼卡（1489—1539）出身卡斯蒂利亚布尔戈斯的富商家族，1514年已在皇帝马克西米利安一世麾下任掌玺官。1521年斐迪南接管奥地利后，他出任总司库兼大掌玺官，为哈布斯堡家族打通了向富格尔家族借贷的门路。1523年他受封男爵，1524年获封克恩顿的奥尔滕堡伯国。他的经济措施和被指谋取私利的行为遭到奥地利及蒂罗尔贵族强烈反对，1526年被迫去职。此后他仍是斐迪南的亲信顾问，保有封地。1533年他开始在德拉瓦河畔施皮塔尔兴建文艺复兴式宫殿，1539年卒于阿尔萨斯的恩西赛姆，未能看到宫殿落成。

en: Michael Gaismair (1490–1532), born at Sterzing in the County of Tyrol, was secretary to the bishop of Brixen before he led the miners and peasants of the Eisack and Puster valleys in revolt during the German Peasants' War of 1525. The rebels occupied and looted Brixen and Neustift. Summoned to the Innsbruck diet by Archduke Ferdinand, he was arrested for treason but escaped after two months to Switzerland, where he sought Zwingli's backing. In May 1526 he drafted a constitution for an egalitarian, democratic Christian Tyrol; his plans included abolishing noble titles and nationalizing land and mines. He then joined the Salzburg rising. Defeated, he fled to Venice and was murdered at Padua on 15 April 1532 by soldiers collecting Ferdinand's bounty.
zh: 米夏埃尔·盖斯迈尔（1490—1532）生于蒂罗尔伯国的施泰青，本是布里克森主教的秘书，1525年德意志农民战争期间率领艾萨克河谷和普斯特河谷的矿工与农民起事。起义者占领并洗劫了布里克森和诺伊施蒂夫特。他应斐迪南之召赴因斯布鲁克邦议会，却以叛国罪被捕，两个月后越狱逃往瑞士，并向茨温利寻求支持。1526年5月，他起草了一部建立平等、民主的基督教蒂罗尔的宪政草案；他的设想包括废除贵族头衔，将土地和矿山收归国有。随后他又投身萨尔茨堡起义。失败后他逃往威尼斯，1532年4月15日在帕多瓦被为领取斐迪南悬赏的士兵杀害。

en: Gertrude of Hohenberg (c. 1225 – 16 February 1281) was the daughter of Count Burkhard V of Hohenberg and Matilda of Tübingen. Around 1253 she married Count Rudolf of Habsburg and lived with him at Rheinfelden; she bore eleven children, including the future King Albert I. When Rudolf was elected King of the Romans in 1273 and crowned at Aachen, she was crowned beside him and afterwards styled herself Queen Anne. She kept out of politics and died in Vienna on 16 February 1281. By her own wish she was buried at Basel Minster, giving Rudolf an opportunity to mend ties with the city's citizens after conflicts with its bishops; through her children she became ancestress of the Austrian Habsburgs.
zh: 霍恩贝格的格特鲁德（约1225年—1281年2月16日）是霍恩贝格伯爵伯克哈特五世与图宾根的玛蒂尔德之女。约1253年，她嫁给哈布斯堡伯爵鲁道夫，与他生活在莱茵费尔登；她生下十一个子女，其中包括后来的国王阿尔布雷希特一世。1273年鲁道夫当选罗马人的国王并在亚琛加冕，她在丈夫身旁一同加冕，此后自称“安妮王后”。她不干预政事，1281年2月16日卒于维也纳。按她本人遗愿，她被安葬在巴塞尔主教座堂，使鲁道夫在与当地主教冲突后有机会修复与市民的关系；凭借子女，她成为奥地利哈布斯堡家族的先祖。

en: Gregor Erhart (c. 1465–1540), born at Ulm the son of sculptor Michel Erhart, was a leading wood and stone sculptor spanning Late Gothic and Renaissance. He worked in his father's workshop before settling in Augsburg in 1494, where a shortage of woodcarvers offered prospects of commissions. In the imperial city patronised by the Fugger, he gained master's rights in 1496 and married Anna Mair, a kinswoman of Hans Holbein the Elder. He created the Marian altar at Kaisheim Abbey with Daucher and Holbein in 1502, a life-size painted Magdalen now in the Louvre, and the seated Schutzmantelmadonna of about 1510 in the Frauenstein pilgrimage church. He handed his Augsburg workshop to his son Paul in 1531 and died in 1540.
zh: 格雷戈里·埃哈特（约1465—1540）生于乌尔姆，父亲是雕刻家米夏埃尔·埃哈特，是晚期哥特风格向文艺复兴过渡时期重要的木石雕刻家。他早年在父亲的作坊工作，1494年定居奥格斯堡，当地缺少木雕师，有望获得委托。在这座受富格尔家族资助的帝国城市，他于1496年取得师傅资格，娶安娜·迈尔为妻，与老汉斯·荷尔拜因有姻亲关系。1502年他与道赫尔和荷尔拜因为凯斯海姆修道院创作圣母祭坛，还雕有今藏卢浮宫的等身彩绘《抹大拉的马利亚》，以及约1510年为弗劳恩施泰因朝圣教堂所作的坐式《护佑圣母》。1531年他把奥格斯堡的作坊交给儿子保罗，1540年去世。

en: Gundakar of Liechtenstein (1580–1658), born at Lednice, was the youngest son of Baron Hartmann II and brother of Princes Karl I and Maximilian. In 1606 the brothers agreed that the first-born of the eldest surviving line would head their house. Gundakar married Elizabeth Lucretia, Duchess of Cieszyn, in 1618. He served the Habsburgs as a soldier, diplomat and imperial Obersthofmeister through the Thirty Years' War. In the confiscations after the White Mountain he acquired the Moravian lordships of Moravský Krumlov and Uherský Ostroh, and in 1623 he and Maximilian were raised to imperial princes; in 1633 his Moravian estates were styled the Principality of Liechtenstein. He founded the Gundakar line, the younger branch of the house.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/列支敦斯登的岡達克爾
zh: 列支敦士登的贡达克尔（1580—1658）生于莱德尼采，是哈特曼二世男爵的幼子、卡尔一世和马克西米利安两位亲王的弟弟。1606年，兄弟三人约定由现存最年长支系的长子担任家族首领。1618年，贡达克尔迎娶切申女公爵伊丽莎白·卢克蕾齐娅。三十年战争期间，他以军人、外交官和帝国宫廷总管的身份效力哈布斯堡王朝。白山战役后的抄没中，他获得摩拉夫斯基克鲁姆洛夫和乌赫尔斯基奥斯特罗赫两处摩拉维亚领地，1623年他与兄长马克西米利安受封帝国亲王；1633年，他的摩拉维亚领地被定名为列支敦士登亲王国。他开创了家族的幼支——贡达克尔支系。

en: Lorenz Leopold Haschka (1749–1827) was an Austrian poet born in Vienna, where he died. He joined the Jesuits young, but after the order's 1773 suppression turned to secular poetry and, under Josephinism, became a freemason. He wrote odes against the papacy and religious orders, and received help from his pupil Johann Baptist von Alxinger and the poet Karoline Pichler. After Joseph II's death he returned to Catholicism, and in 1797 was chosen to write the words of the patriotic anthem Gott erhalte Franz den Kaiser, set to music by Joseph Haydn and first sung on 12 February for Francis II's birthday. He later taught aesthetics at Vienna's Theresianum and worked at its university library, retiring in 1824.
zh: 洛伦兹·利奥波德·哈什卡（1749—1827）是奥地利诗人，生于维也纳，也卒于此。他年轻时加入耶稣会，1773年耶稣会被解散后还俗写诗，并在约瑟夫主义影响下成为共济会员。他写颂诗抨击教廷和修会，得到学生约翰·巴普蒂斯特·冯·阿尔克辛格与诗人卡罗琳·皮希勒的帮助。皇帝约瑟夫二世去世后他重归天主教，1797年受命为爱国颂歌《天佑吾皇弗朗茨》作词：歌曲由约瑟夫·海顿谱曲，于当年2月12日弗朗茨二世诞辰庆典上首次演唱。他后来在维也纳的特雷西亚学院教授美学，并任职于维也纳大学图书馆，1824年退休。

en: Joseph Haydn (1732–1809) was the Austrian composer who defined the Classical symphony and string quartet, earning the name father of both forms. Born at Rohrau, he was a choirboy at Vienna's St. Stephen's Cathedral, then struggled to make a living as a freelance musician. He served Count Morzin and became vice-Kapellmeister to the Esterházy princes in 1761, rising to Kapellmeister in 1766. For nearly thirty years he served the family, working for much of that time at their remote Eszterháza palace, where he had his own orchestra and wrote symphonies, quartets and operas. After Prince Nikolaus died in 1790 he twice visited London, where his twelve London symphonies made him Europe's most famous composer; his late masterpieces include the oratorios The Creation (1798) and The Seasons (1801).
zh: 约瑟夫·海顿（1732—1809）是奥地利作曲家，对古典主义交响曲与弦乐四重奏的定型贡献最大，被誉为这两种体裁之父。他生于罗劳，少年时在维也纳圣斯蒂芬大教堂当唱诗班歌童，此后作为自由音乐家艰难谋生。他曾受雇于莫尔津伯爵，1761年成为埃施特哈齐亲王的副乐长，1766年升任乐长。他为该家族服务近三十年，长期在偏远的埃施特哈扎宫工作，拥有自己的乐队，写下大量交响曲、四重奏与歌剧。1790年尼古劳斯亲王去世后，他两度访问伦敦，十二部《伦敦交响曲》使他成为欧洲最负盛名的作曲家；晚年杰作包括清唱剧《创世纪》（1798）和《四季》（1801）。

en: Johann Lukas von Hildebrandt (1668–1745) was a defining architect of the Austrian High Baroque. Born in Genoa to a German father and an Italian mother, he studied in Rome under Carlo Fontana, then built fortresses for Prince Eugene of Savoy in the campaigns of 1695–1696 before settling in Vienna. He became court engineer in 1700, head of the court building department in 1711 and court architect in 1723. Competing with the Fischer von Erlach architects, he built his reputation through commissions for prominent Viennese families, combining Italian and French elements. For Prince Eugene he designed the Lower and Upper Belvedere (1714–1722); his other works include St. Peter's Church, the Palais Kinsky, Schloss Hof and the Schönborn Palace at Göllersdorf.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/约翰·卢卡斯·冯·希尔德布兰特
zh: 约翰·卢卡斯·冯·希尔德布兰特（1668—1745）是奥地利巴洛克鼎盛时期最具代表性的建筑师。他生于热那亚，父亲为德意志人、母亲为意大利人，早年在罗马师从卡洛·丰塔纳，1695至1696年在意大利战事中为萨伏依的欧根亲王修筑要塞，随后定居维也纳。他于1700年任宫廷工程师，1711年任宫廷营造部门主管，1723年成为宫廷建筑师。他与费舍尔·冯·埃尔拉赫父子竞争，凭借为维也纳显贵家族承接工程建立声誉，其设计融合了意大利与法国元素。他为欧根亲王设计了下美景宫与上美景宫（1714—1722），其他作品还有维也纳圣彼得教堂、金斯基宫、霍夫宫和格勒尔斯多夫的申博恩宫。

en: Johann Sigismund Hubert (1736–1792) was an Austrian hydraulic and cameral engineer who made the first attempts to shield Vienna from the Danube. In 1771 he tried to regulate the river below the city, raising a protection dam almost six metres high that floods breached again and again. In 1785–1786, by order of Emperor Joseph II, he built a left-bank embankment at Floridsdorf to protect the Marchfeld, the core of the dam later named the Hubertusdamm after him. Decades after his death, the first large-scale regulation of the river at Vienna took place in the 1870s.
zh: 约翰·西格蒙德·胡贝特（1736—1792）是奥地利水利与官房工程师，最早尝试保护维也纳免受多瑙河水患。1771年，他试图整治城郊河段，筑起一道近六米高的防护坝，却屡次被洪水冲决。1785至1786年，他奉约瑟夫二世之命在弗洛里茨多夫修建左岸大堤，以保护马希费尔德，这段堤坝日后以他命名为胡贝特大堤。在他去世几十年后，维也纳河段于1870年代进行了首次大规模整治。

en: Karl I of Liechtenstein (1569–1627) was the elder son of Baron Hartmann II and the first prince of his house. He converted to Catholicism in 1599 and in 1605 established a Hospitaller branch at Feldsberg. He served Rudolf II as Obersthofmeister until 1607, but in the Habsburg succession quarrel he backed Archduke Matthias against the emperor and helped him seize power; a grateful Matthias made him a hereditary prince in 1608. He acquired the Silesian duchies of Troppau in 1613 and Jägerndorf in 1622. For his support of Ferdinand II at the White Mountain he became vice-regent of Bohemia in 1622 and was rewarded with confiscated rebel estates. He died in Prague in 1627.
zh: 列支敦士登的卡尔一世（1569—1627）是哈特曼二世男爵的长子，也是家族中第一位受封亲王的人。他于1599年改宗天主教，1605年在费尔德斯贝格建立仁爱修会分院。他曾任鲁道夫二世的宫廷总管至1607年，在哈布斯堡继承权之争中支持大公爵马蒂亚斯对抗皇帝，助其夺权；1608年马蒂亚斯投桃报李，封他为世袭亲王。他于1613年取得西里西亚的特罗保公国，1622年取得耶格恩多夫公国。因在白山战役中支持斐迪南二世，他于1622年出任波希米亚副摄政，并得到被没收的叛党地产。1627年他卒于布拉格。

en: Leopold I the Glorious (c. 1290 – 28 February 1326), third son of Albert I, was co-duke of Austria and Styria with his brother Frederick the Fair from 1308. He administered Further Austria and pursued his father's murderers. He accompanied Emperor Henry VII on his Italian campaign of 1311 and backed Frederick's claim to the German crown in the 1314 double election. In 1315 his knights were routed by the Swiss Confederates at the Battle of Morgarten. After Frederick was captured at Mühldorf in 1322, Leopold fought on and surrendered the imperial regalia in a failed bid for his release. He died at Strasbourg on 28 February 1326.
zh: “荣耀者”利奥波德一世（约1290年—1326年2月28日）是阿尔布雷希特一世第三子，1308年起与兄长美男子腓特烈共治奥地利和施蒂利亚。他管理前奥地利，并追讨杀害父亲的凶手。他随皇帝亨利七世参加1311年的意大利远征，并在1314年的双重选举中支持腓特烈争夺德意志王位。1315年，他的骑兵在莫尔加滕战役被瑞士同盟军队击溃。1322年腓特烈在米尔多夫被俘后，利奥波德继续作战，甚至交出帝国御用器以换取兄长获释，但谈判失败。1326年2月28日他卒于斯特拉斯堡。

en: Leopold II of Habsburg (1328–1344) was the younger son of Duke Otto the Merry of Austria and Elizabeth of Lower Bavaria. He lost his mother at age two and his father at eleven; after Otto's death in 1339, he and his elder brother Frederick II were titular dukes of Austria under their uncle Albert II's guardianship. Leopold died suddenly on 10 August 1344, aged sixteen, and Frederick died just as suddenly four months later. Contemporaries suspected both had been poisoned, and Albert II continued to rule Austria.
zh: 哈布斯堡的利奥波德二世（1328—1344）是奥地利公爵奥托“快活者”与下巴伐利亚的伊丽莎白的幼子。他两岁丧母、十一岁丧父；1339年奥托死后，他与兄长腓特烈二世在叔父阿尔布雷希特二世的监护下成为名义上的奥地利公爵。1344年8月10日，十六岁的利奥波德突然死去，四个月后腓特烈也同样猝逝，时人怀疑二人均遭毒杀。阿尔布雷希特二世由此继续执掌奥地利。

en: Ludwig van Beethoven (1770–1827) was a German composer and pianist born in Bonn. Taught first by his father and by Christian Gottlob Neefe, he was a child prodigy before settling in Vienna in 1792, where he studied with Haydn and won noble patrons including Lichnowsky and Lobkowitz. He became known as a virtuoso pianist and published his first set of piano trios in 1795. From around 1798 his hearing steadily failed, yet he wrote his Eroica and Fifth Symphonies, Fidelio and the Emperor Concerto while growing deaf. His Ninth Symphony and Missa solemnis appeared in 1824 and his late quartets in 1825–1826, composed in almost total silence. He died in Vienna in 1827.
zh: 路德维希·范·贝多芬（1770—1827）是德国作曲家、钢琴家，生于波恩。他早年先随父亲、后随克里斯蒂安·戈特洛布·内费学习音乐，幼年即为神童，1792年定居维也纳，师从海顿，并得到利希诺夫斯基、洛布科维茨等贵族赞助。他以钢琴演奏技艺闻名，1795年出版了首套钢琴三重奏。约1798年起他的听力不断衰退，却仍在日渐失聪中写下《英雄交响曲》《第五交响曲》、歌剧《费德里奥》和《皇帝钢琴协奏曲》。1824年《第九交响曲》与《庄严弥撒》问世，1825至1826年又在近乎全聋中完成晚期弦乐四重奏。1827年他在维也纳去世。

en: Martin Siebenbürger (c. 1475–1522), born Mert Kapp in Hermannstadt in Transylvania, followed his uncle to Vienna, where he taught law at the university and became the city's judge in 1512. His relentless prosecution of corruption among municipal officials in the Lauffner affair earned him powerful enemies, who denounced him to Emperor Maximilian I. After Maximilian's death, Vienna sent him as its representative to Emperor Charles V in 1519. In 1520 the city council made him mayor of Vienna. He sought to preserve the city's autonomy, but after Archduke Ferdinand took over Austria, he was tried with five former councillors at the Wiener Neustadt blood court, condemned, and beheaded on 11 August 1522.
zh: 马丁·西本比格（约1475—1522）原名梅尔特·卡普，生于特兰西瓦尼亚的赫尔曼施塔特，随叔父前往维也纳，在维也纳大学教授法律，1512年出任维也纳城市法官。他在劳夫纳案中穷追市政官员的贪腐，因而树敌甚众，被人告到皇帝马克西米利安一世面前。马克西米利安去世后，维也纳于1519年派他作为代表觐见皇帝查理五世。1520年，市议会选他为维也纳市长。他力图维护城市自治，但斐迪南接管奥地利后，他与另外五名前市政委员在维也纳新城血法庭受审并被判处死，1522年8月11日在维也纳新城被斩首。

en: Maximilian of Liechtenstein (1578–1643) was a Moravian nobleman and younger brother of Prince Karl I. A career soldier in Habsburg service, he fought at the White Mountain in 1620 and rose to field marshal in the imperial army. Through his marriage to Catherine Šemberová, heiress of the Boskovice lords, he inherited large Moravian estates and more in the Bohemian confiscations, and was raised to imperial prince in 1623. From 1627 to 1632 he guarded his nephew Karl Eusebius and enforced the Counter-Reformation in the family lands. In 1633 he and his wife founded a monastery at Vranov with a family crypt. In 1638 he took command of the fortress of Győr, strengthened its defences and died there.
zh: 列支敦士登的马克西米利安（1578—1643）是摩拉维亚贵族、卡尔一世亲王之弟。他年轻时便在哈布斯堡军中服役，1620年参加白山战役，最终官至帝国陆军元帅。他通过迎娶博斯科维采领主的女继承人卡特日娜·谢姆贝罗娃，继承了摩拉维亚的大片地产，又在波希米亚抄没风潮中扩充产业，1623年受封帝国亲王。1627至1632年，他为侄儿卡尔·优西比乌监护领地，并在家族领地推行反宗教改革。1633年，他与妻子在弗拉诺夫建立修院及家族墓室。1638年他出任杰尔要塞司令，强化要塞防御，并在那里去世。

en: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791) was a composer born in Salzburg in the Holy Roman Empire. Trained by his father Leopold, he was a keyboard and violin prodigy by five and toured Europe's courts as a child, followed by three journeys to Italy. After restless years at the Salzburg court, he travelled to Munich, Mannheim and Paris in 1777–1779 in search of employment. He settled in Vienna in 1781 after his dismissal by the archbishop. There he found fame but little security, producing Die Entführung aus dem Serail, The Marriage of Figaro, Don Giovanni, Così fan tutte and The Magic Flute, along with over eight hundred works. He also composed more than a dozen piano concertos in Vienna. He died there at 35, leaving his Requiem unfinished.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/沃尔夫冈·阿玛多伊斯·莫扎特
zh: 沃尔夫冈·阿马多伊斯·莫扎特（1756—1791）是作曲家，生于神圣罗马帝国的萨尔茨堡。他由父亲利奥波德培养，五岁便擅长键盘与小提琴，童年随父巡演欧洲各国宫廷，此后三次前往意大利。在萨尔茨堡宫廷度过不如意的数年后，他于1777至1779年前往慕尼黑、曼海姆和巴黎寻找职位。1781年被大主教解职后，他定居维也纳。他在那里赢得盛名却生计不稳，写下了《后宫诱逃》《费加罗的婚礼》《唐·乔万尼》《女人心》《魔笛》等作品，一生完成逾八百部乐曲。他还在维也纳创作了十余首钢琴协奏曲。35岁时他在当地去世，《安魂曲》未能完成。

en: Otto the Merry (1301–1339), youngest son of Albert I, married Elizabeth of Bavaria, a Wittelsbach, in the reconciliation after the Habsburgs lost the German throne at Mühldorf in 1322. In 1327 he founded Neuberg Abbey in Styria on the birth of his first son. From 1330 he ruled the Habsburg duchies with his brother Albert II. In 1335 he married Anna of Bohemia, daughter of John the Blind. After their maternal uncle Henry of Carinthia died without male heirs, Emperor Louis IV enfeoffed the brothers with Carinthia and Carniola on 2 May 1335; Otto was enthroned as duke on the Zollfeld in the ancient Carantanian rite and thereafter governed Carinthia. In 1337 he founded the order Societas Templois for a crusade against pagan Prussians and Lithuanians. His nickname recalls the festive air of his court. He died at Neuberg in 1339, aged 37; his two sons died in 1344, presumably poisoned, and his line ended.
zh: “欢乐者”奥托（1301—1339）是阿尔布雷希特一世的幼子。1322年哈布斯堡在米尔多夫败北，输掉了德意志王位之争；随后两家和解，他娶了维特尔斯巴赫家族的巴伐利亚的伊丽莎白。1327年为庆祝长子出生，他在施蒂利亚创建新堡修道院。1330年起他与兄长阿尔布雷希特二世共治哈布斯堡诸公国。1335年他娶约翰“盲人”之女波希米亚的安娜。舅父克恩滕公爵亨利去世时没有男性继承人，皇帝路易四世于1335年5月2日将克恩滕和卡尼奥拉封赐兄弟二人；奥托在措尔费尔德按古老的卡兰塔尼亚仪式即位为公爵，此后主要治理克恩滕。1337年他创立用于征伐普鲁士和立陶宛异教徒的骑士团体“圣殿社”。“欢乐者”的绰号来自他宫廷里的欢庆气氛。1339年他卒于新堡修道院，终年37岁；两个儿子于1344年先后去世，据推测死于毒杀，他这一支就此绝嗣。

en: Francis II Rákóczi (1676–1735), born at Borsi in Zemplén County, was the wealthiest magnate in Hungary. In 1694, after completing his university studies, he married Charlotte Amalie of Hesse-Wanfried without Emperor Leopold I's prior approval. After a secret appeal to France against Habsburg rule was exposed, he was condemned to death but escaped to Poland.
