Returning in 1703, he led the Kuruc rising known as his War of Independence: elected Prince of Transylvania in 1704, he was named Ruling Prince of Hungary at Szécsény in 1705, yet refused the royal crown. Defeats at Zsibó (1705) and Trencsén (1708) and the Peace of Szatmár (1711) ended the revolt. He died in Ottoman exile at Rodosto in 1735.
zh: 拉科齐·费伦茨二世（1676—1735）生于泽姆普林州的波尔希，是匈牙利最富有的大贵族。1694年，他完成大学学业后，未经皇帝利奥波德一世事先同意便与黑森-万弗里德的夏洛特·阿玛莉埃成婚。他因秘密向法国求助、反抗哈布斯堡统治事泄而被判死刑，却越狱逃往波兰。1703年他回国领导库伦茨军起事，即拉科齐独立战争：1704年他当选特兰西瓦尼亚大公，1705年在塞切尼议会上被推举为匈牙利邦联大公，但他拒绝了王冠。1705年日博乌之役和1708年特伦钦之役接连战败，1711年《萨图马雷和约》结束了起事。1735年他在奥斯曼帝国流亡地罗多斯托去世。

en: Rudolf I of Habsburg (1 May 1218 – 15 July 1291) was a Swabian count who, in 1273, became the first member of his house elected King of the Romans, ending the Great Interregnum. He took over the main Habsburg line after his father's death in 1240, married Gertrude of Hohenberg and joined the Prussian Crusade in 1254. He defeated and killed his rival Ottokar II of Bohemia at the Battle on the Marchfeld in 1278, securing Austria, Styria and Carinthia for his dynasty and laying the foundations of Habsburg power on the Danube. His efforts to make the crown hereditary failed, and he died at Speyer in 1291, never having been crowned emperor.
zh: 鲁道夫一世（1218年5月1日—1291年7月15日）原是施瓦本伯爵，1273年成为哈布斯堡家族首位当选的罗马人的国王，结束了大空位时代。1240年父亲去世后，他接掌哈布斯堡家族主支，迎娶霍恩贝格的格特鲁德，并于1254年参加普鲁士十字军。1278年，他在马希菲尔德战役击败并击杀对手波希米亚国王奥托卡二世，为家族夺得奥地利、施蒂利亚和克恩滕，奠定哈布斯堡在多瑙河流域的权势基础。他使王位世袭的努力失败，1291年卒于施派尔，终生未加冕为皇帝。

en: Samson Wertheimer (1658–1724) was the leading court Jew and financier to the Habsburg emperor Leopold I. Born in Worms and educated at the yeshivas of Worms and Frankfurt, he settled in Vienna, where he supplied the imperial armies and, together with Samuel Oppenheimer, helped finance the Habsburg war effort in the War of the Spanish Succession. He also served as chief rabbi of Hungary and Moravia and rabbi of Eisenstadt. A scholar and patron of scholars, he paid for the Frankfurt printing of the Babylonian Talmud (1712–1722), undertaken by his son-in-law Moses Kann. His wealth and influence earned him the nickname Judenkaiser, the ‘Jewish emperor’; ten imperial soldiers guarded his house.
zh: 萨姆松·韦特海默（1658—1724）是哈布斯堡皇帝利奥波德一世麾下最重要的宫廷犹太人与银行家。他生于沃尔姆斯，曾在沃尔姆斯和美因河畔法兰克福的耶什瓦求学，后定居维也纳，为帝国军队提供军需，并与塞缪尔·奥本海默一同资助哈布斯堡王朝在西班牙王位继承战争中的战事。他还担任匈牙利与摩拉维亚的大拉比及艾森施塔特拉比。他本人是学者，也资助学者，于1712至1722年出资让女婿摩西·卡恩在法兰克福印制《巴比伦塔木德》。他的财富与权势为他赢得“犹太皇帝”的绰号，十名帝国士兵守卫着他的宅邸。

en: Samuel Oppenheimer (1630–1703) was the court Jew and military financier of Emperor Leopold I in Vienna. Born at Heidelberg, he funded the Habsburg armies in the Great Turkish War and became the emperor's Oberfaktor. He advanced a hundred thousand gulden for war expenses to Margrave Ludwig of Baden, who recommended him for the post. Though Vienna's Jews had been expelled in 1670, Leopold let him settle there; he founded synagogues and schools and ransomed Jewish captives of the Turkish wars. Around 1700 rioters looted his house. Contemporaries called him the Judenkaiser, and he undertook delicate diplomatic missions for the emperor. When he died in 1703, the state repudiated its debts to his heir Emanuel, bankrupting the firm and triggering a credit crisis.
zh: 塞缪尔·奥本海默（1630—1703）是皇帝利奥波德一世在维也纳的宫廷犹太人与军费筹措人。他出生于海德堡，为哈布斯堡军队进行大土耳其战争提供资金，成为皇帝的首席宫廷代理人。他曾向巴登藩侯路德维希垫付十万盾军费，后者推荐他担任这一职务。1670年维也纳犹太人遭驱逐后，利奥波德仍准许他在当地定居；他修建犹太会堂和学校，还为土耳其战争中被俘的犹太人赎身。约1700年，他的住宅遭暴乱者洗劫。同时代人称他为“犹太人皇帝”，他还为皇帝承担过微妙的外交使命。1703年他去世后，国家拒绝向继承人埃马努埃尔清偿债务，致使其商号破产，并引发信贷危机。

en: Georg Tannstetter (1482–1535), also called Collimitius, was born at Rain am Lech in Bavaria and studied at Ingolstadt before Conrad Celtis called him to the University of Vienna in 1503 to teach mathematics. One of the leading Viennese humanists, he became personal physician to Emperor Maximilian I in 1510 and was ennobled as von Thanau in 1516, later serving Ferdinand I at Innsbruck. In 1518 he travelled to Buda with his student Joachim Vadian. He edited the map of Hungary known as Tabula Hungariae from a manuscript by Lazarus Secretarius; printed in 1528, it included a scale and details of some 1300 settlements. His lives of Vienna's mathematicians, Viri Mathematici, pioneered the history of science.
zh: 格奥尔格·坦施泰特（1482—1535）人称科利米提乌斯，生于巴伐利亚的莱希河畔赖因，曾在因戈尔施塔特求学，1503年应康拉德·策尔蒂斯之邀到维也纳大学教授数学，是维也纳最重要的人文主义者之一。1510年他成为皇帝马克西米利安一世的御医，1516年受封贵族，获“冯·塔瑙”名号，后来在因斯布鲁克侍奉斐迪南一世。1518年，他与学生约阿希姆·瓦迪安前往布达。他依据拉扎鲁斯·塞克雷塔里乌斯的手稿编订《匈牙利地图》，于1528年印行，图上附有比例尺和约1300处聚落的细节。所著《数学家列传》记述维也纳数学家的生平，被视为科学史的先驱之作。

en: Bernhard von Cles, in Italian Bernardo Clesio (1485–1539), was born at Cles Castle in the Prince-Bishopric of Trent and studied law at Bologna. He became Prince-Bishop of Trent in 1514 and led the diocese through the peasant rising of 1525 under Michael Gaismair, in which his brother was killed. A fierce opponent of Luther, as president of Archduke Ferdinand's Privy Council from 1527 he pressed the Protestant estates at the Diet of Speyer in 1529. Made a cardinal in 1530, he helped prepare the Council of Trent and rebuilt Trento as a Renaissance city. He commissioned the rebuilding of Santa Maria Maggiore, enlarged Buonconsiglio Castle and called on artists including Dosso Dossi to decorate the additions. He died at Brixen in 1539.
zh: 伯恩哈德·冯·克勒斯，意大利名贝尔纳多·克莱肖（1485—1539），生于特伦托采邑主教区的克莱斯城堡，曾在博洛尼亚攻读法律。1514年他出任特伦托采邑主教，在1525年米夏埃尔·盖斯迈尔领导的农民起义中守住教区，他的兄弟在动乱中丧命。作为路德的死敌，他自1527年任斐迪南枢密院主席，1529年在施派尔帝国会议上对新教诸侯施压。1530年他升任枢机，为特伦托会议铺路，并把特伦托改建为文艺复兴式城市。他下令重建圣母大殿，扩建博恩孔西利奥城堡，并请多索·多西等艺术家装饰新建筑。1539年他卒于布里克森。

en: Joseph Wenzel I of Liechtenstein (1696–1772), born in Prague, was twice Prince of Liechtenstein (1712–1718 and 1748–1772) and regent from 1732 to 1745; in 1718 he traded Vaduz and Schellenberg for Rumburk. A professional soldier from his first campaign under Prince Eugene in 1717, he also served as imperial envoy to Berlin in 1735–1736 and ambassador to Paris in 1738–1741. He became a field marshal in 1745 and, as generalissimo in Italy, defeated the French and Spanish at Piacenza in 1746. Appointed director general of artillery in 1744, he spent his own money rebuilding the service; his 1753 Liechtenstein artillery system made Austrian gunners the best in Europe during the Seven Years' War.
zh: 约瑟夫·文策尔一世（1696—1772）生于布拉格，两度担任列支敦士登亲王（1712—1718、1748—1772），1732至1745年任摄政；1718年他以瓦杜兹和谢伦贝格换取伦布尔克。他自1717年随欧根亲王出征起成为职业军人，也于1735至1736年出使柏林，1738至1741年任驻巴黎大使。1745年他晋升陆军元帅，任意大利方向大元帅时于1746年在皮亚琴察击败法国与西班牙联军。1744年他出任炮兵总监，自掏腰包重整炮兵；他于1753年推行的“列支敦士登炮兵体系”使奥地利炮兵在七年战争中成为欧洲之冠。

en: Hachiun (born c. 1166), also called Hachiun Alchi, was the third son of Yesugei and Hö'elün and a full brother of Genghis Khan, four years younger than Temüjin. The Secret History of the Mongols mentions him far less often than his brothers Qasar and Temüge, leading to the view that he may have died young. He was still alive in 1207, when Genghis Khan apportioned lands and subjects and ranked him seventh in the hierarchy. His son Eljigidey inherited his house and was later enfeoffed as prince of Jinan.
zh: 合赤温（1166年生），又称合赤温额勒赤，是也速该与诃额仑的第三子、成吉思汗的同母三弟，比铁木真年幼四岁。《蒙古秘史》中关于他的记载远少于兄长合撒儿和幼弟铁木哥，因此有人认为他可能早逝。1207年他仍在世，成吉思汗分封土地与属民时，他在亲贵序列中位列第七。其子按赤台承袭家业，后来受封济南王。

en: Baldwin of Avesnes (1219–1295), younger son of Bouchard IV of Avesnes and Margaret II of Flanders, was declared legitimate by the pope at Louis IX of France's request and received Beaumont as his apanage in 1246. His parents' marriage had been declared illegal because his father had received minor orders. He spent decades fighting beside his brother John I against their Dampierre half-brothers and was blamed for the tournament accident at Trazegnies that killed William III of Dampierre. Reconciled with his mother after John's death, he was sent by her on an expedition against Namur. He sold Dunkirk and Warneton to Guy of Flanders in 1287. He also compiled a universal chronicle and married Felicitas of Coucy, who bore him a daughter, Beatrice.
zh: 阿韦讷的博杜安（1219—1295）是阿韦讷的布沙尔四世与佛兰德的玛格丽特二世的幼子，经法兰西国王路易九世请求，被教皇承认为合法子嗣，1246年受封博蒙作为封禄。他的父亲曾领低级圣职，父母的婚姻因此被判非法。他数十年间随兄长约翰一世与同母异父的丹皮尔家族兄弟作战，并被认为要对特拉泽尼比武会上导致丹皮尔的威廉三世身亡的意外负责。约翰死后他与母亲和解，奉母命出征那慕尔。1287年他将敦刻尔克和瓦尔讷通卖给佛兰德伯爵居伊。他还编纂过一部世界编年史，妻子库西的费利西泰为他生下女儿贝阿特丽斯。

en: Bouchard IV of Avesnes (1182–1244), son of James of Avesnes and Adela of Guise, began his career as a cantor and subdeacon at Laon. He became bailiff of Hainaut in 1212 and married his ward Margaret, the ten-year-old daughter of Baldwin VI of Hainaut, without her family's consent. He fought for Flanders at Bouvines in 1214, and Pope Innocent III declared the marriage unlawful and excommunicated him in 1216. Bouchard and Margaret took refuge in Luxembourg. Captured in 1219 and held at Ghent for two years, he was freed after Margaret accepted the dissolution; his sons John I and Baldwin later fought the Flemish succession war. He was finally beheaded at Rupelmonde on Countess Joanna's orders.
zh: 阿韦讷的布沙尔四世（1182—1244）是阿韦讷的雅克与吉斯的阿德琳之子，早年在拉昂教会担任歌咏长和副执事。1212年他出任埃诺邑督，未经家属同意便娶了受他监护的埃诺的鲍德温六世之女、年仅十岁的玛格丽特。1214年他在布汶为佛兰德一方作战，1216年教皇英诺森三世宣布这桩婚姻非法并将他绝罚。布沙尔与玛格丽特避往卢森堡。1219年他被俘，在根特关押两年，直到玛格丽特同意解除婚姻才获释；他的儿子约翰一世与博杜安后来卷入佛兰德继承战争。最终他被女伯爵让娜下令在吕佩尔蒙德斩首。

en: Walter II of Avesnes (c. 1170–1244), eldest son of the crusader James of Avesnes and Adeline of Guise, was lord of Avesnes, Guise, Condé and Leuze and, through his marriage to Margaret, Countess of Blois, count of Blois and Chartres. He fought at the Battle of Bouvines in 1214, then went to the Holy Land; captured and ransomed by the Templars, he donated 1,000 bezants towards the building of Château Pèlerin in 1218. Using income from Guise, he began modernizing his castles and built one at Englancourt to control the road through Hainaut. In 1226 he attended the coronation of Louis IX and later helped free Count Ferdinand of Flanders.
zh: 戈蒂埃二世·德·阿韦讷（约1170—1244）是十字军将领阿韦讷的雅克与吉斯的阿德琳的长子，身为阿韦讷、吉斯、孔代和勒兹领主，并因迎娶布卢瓦女伯爵玛格丽特而成为布卢瓦与沙特尔伯爵。他参加了1214年的布汶战役，随后前往圣地；被俘后由圣殿骑士团赎回，1218年捐出一千拜占特金币协助修建朝圣者城堡。他用吉斯的收入着手改建自己的城堡，并在昂格朗库尔修筑城堡，控制穿过埃诺的道路。1226年他出席路易九世的加冕礼，后来又帮助佛兰德伯爵费朗恢复自由。

en: William I, called the Good (c. 1286–1337), was never meant to rule: his brother John fell at Courtrai in 1302, another brother died in 1303, and in 1304 he became count of Hainaut, Holland and Zeeland. That year Guy of Namur beat him at Duiveland and, with Brabant, overran most of Zeeland and Holland, but William recovered the lands and fought Flanders until the Peace of Paris in 1323, when Flanders renounced Zeeland and he gave up his claim to Imperial Flanders. He occupied much of the Utrecht bishopric and annexed Amsterdam to Holland. In 1305 he married Joan of Valois, sister of the future Philip VI. In 1326 he backed Queen Isabella's expedition against Edward II, and his daughter Philippa was betrothed to the heir, the future Edward III; another daughter, Margaret, married Emperor Louis IV. In 1337 he joined Edward, Brabant and others in a coalition against Philip VI, but died on 7 June, succeeded by William II.
zh: 威廉一世（绰号好人，约1286—1337）本来轮不到继承：兄长约翰1302年战死于科特赖克，另一位兄长1303年去世，1304年他成为埃诺、荷兰与泽兰伯爵。当年他在德伊夫兰岛被那慕尔的居伊击败，居伊与布拉班特联手夺取了泽兰和荷兰的大部分；威廉收复失地，与佛兰德作战直到1323年的巴黎和约，佛兰德放弃对泽兰的要求，他则放弃对帝国佛兰德的要求。他还占据乌得勒支主教区大部，把阿姆斯特丹并入荷兰。1305年，他迎娶未来的腓力六世之姐瓦卢瓦的让娜。1326年，他支持王后伊莎贝拉远征英格兰对付爱德华二世，女儿菲莉帕与王储（即后来的爱德华三世）订婚；另一个女儿玛格丽特嫁给皇帝路易四世。1337年，他与爱德华、布拉班特等结成反对腓力六世的同盟，却在6月7日去世，由威廉二世继位。

en: William II of Hainaut (1307–1345), later called the Bold, found himself between France and the Empire. As a young man he made a pilgrimage to the Holy Land and fought the Moors in Spain. In 1337 he succeeded his father William the Good as count of Hainaut, Holland and Zeeland, holding part of his lands from the French king and part from Emperor Louis IV, who backed Edward III. Trying to please both, he angered both, and out of resentment at Philip VI he joined the English. As Edward III's brother-in-law he fought at the 1339 siege of Cambrai and the 1340 siege of Tournai. In 1344 he crusaded with the Teutonic Order in Prussia. In 1345 he took Utrecht, checking its bishop's bid for independence, then turned on a Frisian revolt and was killed at the Battle of Warns near Stavoren on 26 September, leaving no heir. His sister Margaret, Emperor Louis IV's wife, inherited his counties.
zh: 埃诺的威廉二世（1307—1345），后来得绰号“勇敢者”，夹在法兰西与帝国之间。他年轻时曾前往圣地朝圣，并在西班牙与摩尔人作战。1337年，他继承其父好人威廉，成为埃诺、荷兰和泽兰伯爵，却要为一部分领地向法王称臣，为另一部分向皇帝路易四世称臣，而路易四世支持爱德华三世。他想两头讨好，结果两头得罪，终因不满腓力六世而加入英格兰一方。作为爱德华三世的王后菲莉帕的兄弟，他参加了1339年的康布雷围城战和1340年的图尔奈围城战。1344年，他随条顿骑士团前往普鲁士参加十字军。1345年，他夺取乌得勒支，阻止当地主教谋求独立，随后回师镇压弗里斯兰人的起义，9月26日在斯塔福伦附近的瓦恩斯战役中战死，没有留下继承人。他的姐姐、皇帝路易四世之妻玛格丽特继承了这些伯国。

en: Isabella of Hainaut (c. 1323–1361) was a daughter of William I the Good, Count of Hainaut, and Joan of Valois, and sister of Queen Philippa of England. In 1354 she married Robert of Namur, later a Knight of the Garter; the marriage was childless.
zh: 埃诺的伊莎贝尔（约1323—1361）是埃诺伯爵威廉一世“好人”与瓦卢瓦的让娜之女、英格兰王后菲莉帕的妹妹。1354年她嫁给后来成为嘉德骑士的罗伯特·德·那慕尔，婚姻没有子女。

en: James of Avesnes (1152–1191), son of Nicholas d'Oisy, Lord of Avesnes, and Matilda de la Roche, was lord of Avesnes, Condé and Leuze from 1171. He took the cross in 1187 and led French, Flemish and Frisian crusaders by ship to the Holy Land, reaching the siege of Acre in September 1189. Guy of Lusignan and Henry of Champagne were also leading forces at the siege, though neither dominated its command. At the Battle of Arsuf on 7 September 1191 James was unhorsed and cut down after slaying fifteen enemy warriors. Hospitallers and Templars found his body the next day; it was buried at Arsuf in the presence of Richard the Lionheart and Guy of Lusignan.
zh: 阿韦讷的雅克（1152—1191）是阿韦讷领主尼古拉·德瓦西与玛蒂尔德·德拉罗什之子，1171年起成为阿韦讷、孔代和勒兹的领主。1187年他加入第三次十字军东征，率领法兰西、佛兰德和弗里斯兰十字军乘船前往圣地，1189年9月抵达阿卡围城战场。吕西尼昂的居伊和香槟的亨利也在围城中领军，但都未能取得主导权。1191年9月7日，雅克在阿尔苏夫战役中落马，斩杀十五名敌军战士后战死。次日医院骑士和圣殿骑士寻获他的遗体，葬于阿尔苏夫，狮心王理查与吕西尼昂的居伊出席了葬礼。

en: John I of Avesnes (1218–1257) was the eldest son of Bouchard IV of Avesnes and Margaret II of Flanders, whose papally dissolved marriage left him considered illegitimate until Frederick II recognised his legitimacy. When Margaret inherited Flanders and Hainaut in 1244 and favoured her Dampierre sons, fighting followed; Louis IX's 1246 arbitration awarded John Hainaut, but Margaret refused to surrender it. He defeated Guy of Dampierre at Walcheren in July 1253, taking him prisoner, and secured the county with the backing of his brother-in-law William II of Holland. Guy relinquished his claim to Hainaut in 1257. John married Adelaide of Holland in 1246 and died at Valenciennes on Christmas Eve 1257, leaving the future John II.
zh: 阿韦讷的约翰一世（1218—1257）是阿韦讷的布沙尔四世与佛兰德的玛格丽特二世的长子；父母的婚姻被教皇解除，他一度被视为私生子，直到腓特烈二世承认其合法身份。1244年玛格丽特继承佛兰德与埃诺后偏爱丹皮尔家族诸子，继承战争由此爆发；1246年路易九世仲裁，将埃诺判给约翰，但玛格丽特拒绝交出领地。1253年7月他在瓦尔赫伦战役击败并俘虏丹皮尔的居伊，在妻舅荷兰伯爵威廉二世支持下坐稳埃诺。1257年居伊放弃对埃诺的要求。约翰于1246年迎娶荷兰的阿德莱德，1257年平安夜在瓦朗谢讷去世，其子即后来的约翰二世。

en: John II of Avesnes (1247–1304), son of Count John I of Hainaut and Adelaide of Holland, became count of Hainaut in 1280 on his grandmother Margaret's death and inherited Holland and Zeeland in 1299, uniting the three counties. Backed by France, he fought Count Guy of Flanders for Imperial Flanders. His eldest son was killed fighting for France at the Golden Spurs in 1302. John's enemies overran much of Holland and Zeeland, and Guy of Namur defeated his son William on Duiveland, until the Franco-Holland fleet defeated Guy off Zierikzee in 1304. He married Philippa of Luxembourg in 1270 and died on 22 August 1304, succeeded by his son William I.
zh: 阿韦讷的约翰二世（1247—1304）是埃诺伯爵约翰一世与荷兰的阿德莱德之子，1280年祖母玛格丽特去世后继任埃诺伯爵，1299年又继承荷兰与泽兰，将三地合为一体。他在法兰西支持下为帝国佛兰德与佛兰德伯爵居伊交战。1302年他的长子在金马刺战役中为法兰西作战时阵亡。约翰的敌人攻占荷兰与泽兰大部，那慕尔的居伊在德伊夫兰岛击败他的儿子威廉，直到1304年法兰西—荷兰联合舰队在济里克泽海战击败居伊。他于1270年迎娶卢森堡的菲莉帕，1304年8月22日去世，由儿子威廉一世继位。

en: Joan of Valois (c. 1294–1352) stood where the French and English crowns met. Daughter of Charles of Valois and sister of Philip VI of France, she married William I of Avesnes, Count of Hainaut, Holland and Zeeland, and governed Hainaut as regent whenever he was away. Her daughter Philippa married Edward III of England, which made Joan mother-in-law to one king and sister to the other. After William died in 1337 she took the veil at Fontenelle Abbey, but kept her own chancellery and staff. In 1340, after Edward beat Philip at Sluys and then besieged Tournai without the money to carry on, Pope Benedict XII asked her to mediate. She begged her brother for peace, then went to Edward in his tent and begged him too; on 23 September the two kings agreed a truce without loss of face. In 1345 she mediated a quarrel inside Tournai. She died at Fontenelle on 7 March 1352.
zh: 让娜·德·瓦卢瓦（约1294—1352）所处的位置，正是法兰西与英格兰两顶王冠的交汇处。她是瓦卢瓦的查理之女、法王腓力六世之妹，嫁与威廉一世·德·阿韦讷，成为埃诺、荷兰与泽兰伯爵夫人，丈夫外出时由她以摄政身份治理埃诺。她的女儿菲莉帕嫁给英王爱德华三世，让娜因此既是一位国王的岳母，又是另一位国王的妹妹。1337年威廉去世后，她入丰特奈勒修道院为修女，却保留自己的文书机构和侍从。1340年，爱德华在斯勒伊斯击败腓力后围攻图尔奈，却无力继续作战，教皇本笃十二世请让娜调停。她先向兄长求和，再到爱德华的帐中向他求和；9月23日，两位国王休战，双方都保住了颜面。1345年，她又调解了图尔奈城内的一场争端。1352年3月7日，她在丰特奈勒修道院去世。

en: Philippa of Luxembourg (1252–1311) was a daughter of Count Henry V of Luxembourg and Margaret of Bar. She married John II, Count of Holland and Hainaut, of the House of Avesnes, and her many children linked the chief courts of western Europe. Her son William succeeded as Count of Hainaut and Holland and fathered Queen Philippa of England; another son, John of Beaumont, married the Countess of Soissons. Her daughters married Louis I, Duke of Bourbon, Robert II of Artois, and Roger Bigod, Earl of Norfolk. She died on 6 April 1311.
zh: 卢森堡的菲莉帕（1252—1311）是卢森堡伯爵亨利五世与巴尔的玛格丽特之女。她嫁给阿韦讷家族的荷兰与埃诺伯爵约翰二世，众多子女把西欧各主要宫廷联结起来。儿子威廉继承父位成为埃诺与荷兰伯爵，是英格兰王后菲莉帕的父亲；另一个儿子博蒙领主约翰娶了苏瓦松女伯爵。她的几个女儿分别嫁给波旁公爵路易一世、阿图瓦的罗贝尔二世和诺福克伯爵罗杰·比戈德。她于1311年4月6日去世。

en: Yolande of Flanders (c. 1274–1313) was a daughter of Count Robert III of Flanders. On 24 July 1287 she married the Brabantine knight Walter II of Enghien; widowed in 1309, she guarded the inheritance of their son Walter III.
zh: 佛兰德斯的约朗德（约1274—1313）是佛兰德斯伯爵罗贝尔三世之女，1287年7月24日嫁给布拉班特骑士昂吉安的戈蒂埃二世；1309年守寡后，为儿子戈蒂埃三世守护领地。

en: Boris Vyacheslavich (c. 1056–1078) was the son of Vyacheslav Yaroslavich, prince of Smolensk, and a grandson of Yaroslav the Wise. Left an izgoi prince excluded from his inheritance after 1057, he vanishes from the chronicles until 4 May 1077, when he seized Chernigov while its prince Vsevolod was away; he held it only eight days before fleeing to Tmutarakan. In summer 1078, with Oleg Svyatoslavich's backing, he defeated Vsevolod and retook Chernigov. On 3 October 1078 he fell fighting Vsevolod and Grand Prince Izyaslav near Chernigov.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/鲍里斯·维亚切斯拉维奇
zh: 鲍里斯·维亚切斯拉维奇（约1056—1078）是斯摩棱斯克王公维亚切斯拉夫·雅罗斯拉维奇之子、智者雅罗斯拉夫之孙。1057年父亲死后，他成为被剥夺继承权的“伊兹戈伊”王公，直到1077年才在编年史中出现。是年5月4日，他趁切尔尼戈夫王公弗谢沃洛德外出之机夺取公位，但仅统治约八天便逃往特穆塔拉干。1078年夏，他在奥列格·斯维亚托斯拉维奇支持下击败弗谢沃洛德，再据切尔尼戈夫。1078年10月3日，他在切尔尼戈夫附近与弗谢沃洛德及基辅大公伊贾斯拉夫的激战中阵亡。

en: Ivan Vasilkovich (died 1141), also called Igor, was a Rurikid prince, son of Vasilko Rostislavich of Terebovlia. When Vasilko died in 1124, Ivan received Halych while his brother Rostislav took Terebovlia. In 1125 he and his brother joined Mstislav of Kiev in the feud between their cousins Vladimir Volodarevich of Zvenigorod and Rostislav Volodarevich of Peremyshl, supporting the latter. In 1140 he campaigned beside Vladimir in the strife between his father-in-law Vsevolod Olgovich of Kiev and the claimant Izyaslav Mstislavich. He died childless at Halych in 1141, and Vladimir then united the southwestern Rus lands under Halych.
zh: 伊凡·瓦西里科维奇（？—1141），一称伊戈尔，是留里克王朝王公、捷列博夫利王公瓦西里科·罗斯季斯拉维奇之子。1124年父亲去世后，他领有加利奇，其兄弟罗斯季斯拉夫继承捷列博夫利。1125年，他与兄弟随同基辅大公姆斯季斯拉夫介入堂兄弟兹韦尼哥罗德王公弗拉基米尔·沃洛达列维奇与普热梅希尔王公罗斯季斯拉夫·沃洛达列维奇之争，支持后者。1140年，他与弗拉基米尔一同参加其岳父基辅大公弗谢沃洛德·奥利戈维奇同王位竞争者伊贾斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇的冲突。1141年他在加利奇无嗣而终，弗拉基米尔随即将西南罗斯诸地统一于加利奇。

en: Oleg Yaroslavich, called Nastasich (died 1188), was the illegitimate son of the Halych prince Yaroslav Osmomysl by his mistress Anastasia Charg. In 1170 Yaroslav put aside his wife Olga, daughter of Yuri Dolgorukiy, who fled with her son Vladimir, while Yaroslav favored Oleg. On his deathbed in 1187 he left Halych to Oleg, giving Vladimir only Peremyshl, but the boyars drove Oleg out. He fled to Rurik Rostislavich at Ovruch, then joined the Polish king Casimir II, who restored him in Halych. Oleg was soon poisoned, and the boyars invited Roman Mstislavich.
zh: 奥列格·雅罗斯拉维奇，绰号“纳斯塔西奇”（？—1188），是加利奇王公雅罗斯拉夫·奥斯莫梅斯尔与情妇阿纳斯塔西娅·恰尔格的私生子。1170年，雅罗斯拉夫遗弃妻子、尤里·多尔戈鲁基之女奥尔加，奥尔加带着儿子弗拉基米尔出逃，雅罗斯拉夫却偏爱奥列格。1187年雅罗斯拉夫临终时遗命将加利奇传给奥列格，只把普热梅希尔分给弗拉基米尔，但波雅尔贵族随即将奥列格驱逐。他先投奔奥夫鲁奇的留里克·罗斯季斯拉维奇，又投靠波兰国王卡齐米日二世，后者助他重返加利奇。奥列格不久即被毒杀，波雅尔贵族遂迎立罗曼·姆斯季斯拉维奇。

en: Rostislav Vasilkovich, baptized Gregory (died before 1141), was a Rurikid prince, son of Vasilko Rostislavich of Terebovlia. On his father's death in 1124 he became prince of Terebovlia while his brother Ivan took Halych. In 1125 and 1126 he and Ivan joined Mstislav of Kiev in backing their cousin Rostislav Volodarevich of Peremyshl against Vladimir Volodarevich of Zvenigorod, who was supported by the king of Hungary. He died before 1141, and Terebovlia then passed to Ivan.
zh: 罗斯季斯拉夫·瓦西里科维奇（教名格里戈里，1141年前卒）是留里克王朝王公、捷列博夫利王公瓦西里科·罗斯季斯拉维奇之子。1124年父亲去世后，他成为捷列博夫利王公，兄弟伊凡领有加利奇。1125至1126年，他与伊凡随同基辅大公姆斯季斯拉夫，支持堂兄弟普热梅希尔王公罗斯季斯拉夫·沃洛达列维奇，对抗得到匈牙利国王支持的兹韦尼哥罗德王公弗拉基米尔·沃洛达列维奇。他于1141年前去世，捷列博夫利随后并入伊凡的领地。

en: Rostislav Volodarevich (died 1128) was the eldest son of Volodar Rostislavich of Peremyshl and ruled as prince of Zvenigorod from 1092 and of Peremyshl from 1124. In 1122 he was held hostage in Kraków in place of his father against a ransom of eight thousand grivnas. After Volodar died in 1124 he defended Peremyshl against a Polish army, and in 1125–1126 against his younger brother Vladimir Volodarevich of Zvenigorod, who was aided by the king of Hungary; the Vasilkovichi and Mstislav the Great backed him. On his death Vladimir took Peremyshl, while Zvenigorod went to his son Ivan Berladnik.
zh: 罗斯季斯拉夫·沃洛达列维奇（？—1128）是普热梅希尔王公沃洛达尔·罗斯季斯拉维奇的长子，自1092年任兹韦尼哥罗德王公，1124年起任普热梅希尔王公。1122年，为抵偿八千格里夫纳赎金，他代替父亲在克拉科夫为人质。1124年父亲去世后，他抵御波兰军队攻打普热梅希尔；1125至1126年，他又对抗据有兹韦尼哥罗德的幼弟弗拉基米尔·沃洛达列维奇，匈牙利国王出兵助其弟，而瓦西里科维奇兄弟与姆斯季斯拉夫大帝支持罗斯季斯拉夫。他死后，弗拉基米尔取得普热梅希尔，兹韦尼哥罗德则归其子伊凡·别尔拉德尼克。

en: Rurik Rostislavich (d. 1092) was the eldest son of Rostislav Vladimirovich of Tmutarakan and a great-grandson of Yaroslav the Wise. After his father's death he and his brothers Volodar and Vasilko grew up dispossessed at Vladimir-Volynsky. In 1084 the brothers fled to the Cherven cities, raised an army and occupied Vladimir in Volhynia. Rurik established himself as prince of Peremyshl, securing the southwestern Rus lands for his dynasty, and died childless in 1092; his brothers Volodar and Vasilko kept his lands.
zh: 留里克·罗斯季斯拉维奇（?—1092）是特穆塔拉干王公罗斯季斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇的长子、智者雅罗斯拉夫的曾孙。父亲死后，他与弟弟沃洛达尔、瓦西里科作为被夺位的王公在弗拉基米尔-沃伦斯基长大。1084年，三兄弟逃往切尔文诸城，募兵占领了沃伦的弗拉基米尔。留里克随后成为普热梅希尔王公，为家族保住了罗斯西南的土地。他于1092年去世，无子嗣，领地由弟弟沃洛达尔和瓦西里科继承。

en: Vasilko Rostislavich (c. 1066–1124) was the third son of Rostislav Vladimirovich of Tmutarakan and Lanka, daughter of King Béla I of Hungary. With his elder brothers Rurik and Volodar he secured the Rostislavichi hold on the Cherven cities and became the first prince of Terebovlia in 1092. In November 1097, after the council at Liubech, Grand Prince Sviatopolk II lured him to Kiev, where David Igorevich of Volhynia seized and blinded him. This blinding, almost unheard of among the Rurikids, shattered the Liubech settlement and reopened civil war. He held Terebovlia until his death in 1124.
zh: 瓦西里科·罗斯季斯拉维奇（约1066—1124）是特穆塔拉干王公罗斯季斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇与匈牙利国王贝拉一世之女兰卡的第三子。他与兄长留里克、沃洛达尔一起在切尔文诸城站稳脚跟，1092年成为第一位捷列博夫利王公。1097年11月，王公们在柳别奇会议达成和解后，基辅大公斯维亚托波尔克二世把他诱骗到基辅，沃伦王公达维德·伊戈列维奇将他逮捕并刺瞎双眼。这种酷刑在留里克王朝极为罕见，柳别奇协议由此破裂，内战再度爆发。他此后仍领有捷列博夫利，直至1124年去世。

en: Vladimir Yaroslavich (1151–1199), the only legitimate son of Yaroslav Osmomysl and Olga of Suzdal, was the last Rostislavichi prince of Halych. In 1187 his father left the throne to his illegitimate son Oleg; Vladimir seized Halych with boyar support, only to be driven out. The succession struggle drew Hungary, Poland and neighbouring Rus' principalities into civil war. He fled to King Béla III of Hungary, who jailed him and gave Halych to his son Andrew. He escaped to Germany and returned in 1189 with backing from Emperor Frederick Barbarossa; the protection of his uncle Vsevolod the Big Nest brought stability. Vladimir ruled until his death in 1199, after which Roman the Great of Volhynia seized Halych.
zh: 弗拉基米尔·雅罗斯拉维奇（1151—1199）是雅罗斯拉夫·奥斯莫梅斯尔与苏兹达尔的奥尔加唯一的嫡子，也是哈利奇末代罗斯季斯拉夫系王公。1187年父亲遗命传位给庶子奥列格，弗拉基米尔在贵族支持下夺取哈利奇，却很快被逐。继承之争将匈牙利、波兰和邻近罗斯诸公国卷入内战。他逃奔匈牙利国王贝拉三世，贝拉却将他囚禁，把哈利奇交给自己的儿子安德烈。弗拉基米尔逃往德意志，1189年在皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨支持下返国复位，舅父弗谢沃洛德·大窝的庇护为他带来稳定。他统治至1199年去世，此后沃伦的罗曼大帝夺取哈利奇。

en: Volodymyrko Volodarovych (1104–1153) was the younger son of Volodar Rostislavich and the first prince of a united Halych. He received Zvenyhorod in 1124, failed to take Peremyshl from his brother Rostyslav in 1125–1126, but inherited it in 1128. After expelling his nephews and adding Terebovlia and Halych, he made Halych his capital in 1141 and defended the new principality against Kiev. Allied with Yuri Dolgorukiy, whose daughter Olga married his son Yaroslav in 1149, he defeated the Kievan prince Izyaslav Mstislavich. In alliance with Emperor Manuel Komnenos against Hungary, he made peace with King Géza in 1152. He died in February 1153 and was succeeded by Yaroslav Osmomysl.
zh: 弗拉基米尔科·沃洛达列维奇（1104—1153）是沃洛达尔·罗斯季斯拉维奇的幼子，也是统一的哈利奇公国第一位王公。1124年父亲去世后他领有兹韦尼哥罗德，1125至1126年未能从兄长罗斯季斯拉夫手中夺取普热梅希尔，但于1128年继领该城。他逐出侄辈，兼并捷列博夫利亚与哈利奇，1141年定哈利奇为都城，并抵御基辅方面的进攻。他与尤里·多尔戈鲁基结盟，击败基辅王公伊贾斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇，其子雅罗斯拉夫于1149年娶多尔戈鲁基之女奥尔加。他又与拜占庭皇帝曼努埃尔·科穆宁联手对抗匈牙利，于1152年同匈牙利国王盖萨议和。1153年2月他去世，子雅罗斯拉夫·奥斯莫梅斯尔继位。

en: Volodar Rostislavich (died 1124) was a Rurikid prince, son of Rostislav of Tmutarakan and, chronicles say, a daughter of King Béla I of Hungary. Expelled from Tmutarakan with his brothers Rurik and Vasilko after 1067, they seized lands in the Carpathian foothills. The Council of Liubech (1097) confirmed Peremyshl to him; in 1099 the brothers defeated Kiev at Rozhne Pole and repelled a Hungarian invasion. In 1117 Volodar and Vasilko joined allies in besieging Vladimir-Volynsky and forced its prince to surrender. Captured in Poland in 1122, he was ransomed by the blinded Vasilko for two thousand grivnas of silver. He died on 19 March 1124, counted with his brothers among the founders of independent Halych.
zh: 沃洛达尔·罗斯季斯拉维奇（？—1124）是留里克王朝王公，特穆塔拉干王公罗斯季斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇之子；据后世史书记载，其母为匈牙利国王贝拉一世之女。1067年父亲死后，他与兄弟留里克、瓦西里科被逐出特穆塔拉干，随后在喀尔巴阡山麓夺取领地。1097年柳别奇会议确认普热梅希尔归他所有；1099年兄弟二人在罗日涅原野击败基辅军队，并击退匈牙利人的入侵。1117年沃洛达尔与瓦西里科联合盟友围攻弗拉基米尔-沃伦斯基，迫使该城王公投降。1122年他在波兰被俘，失明的瓦西里科筹措两千格里夫纳白银将他赎回。1124年3月19日他去世，与诸兄弟同被视为独立的哈利奇公国奠基人之一。

en: Yaroslav Osmomysl (c. 1135–1187) ruled Halych from 1153, son of Volodymyrko and a daughter of King Coloman of Hungary. He leant on Hungary and Poland against Kiev, which backed his rival cousin Ivan Berladnic; after years of war, Yaroslav secured Ivan's expulsion to Byzantium. He drew close to Byzantium after sheltering Andronikos Komnenos in 1164–1165. In 1172 he put aside his wife Olga of Suzdal for the concubine Anastasia, whom the Halych boyars burned at the stake. Forced to swear to live peacefully with Olga, he expelled her the next year. He died on 1 October 1187, bequeathing the throne to his natural son Oleg. His epithet Osmomysl, meaning 'Eight-Minded', was made famous by The Tale of Igor's Campaign.
zh: 雅罗斯拉夫·奥斯莫梅斯尔（约1135—1187）自1153年起为哈利奇王公，是弗拉基米尔科与匈牙利国王卡尔曼之女所生之子。外交上他依靠匈牙利和波兰对抗基辅，基辅支持与他争位的堂兄伊凡·贝尔拉德尼克；多年战争后，雅罗斯拉夫迫使伊凡流亡拜占庭。1164至1165年他收留安德洛尼卡·科穆宁，此后与拜占庭修好。1172年，他为宠姬阿纳斯塔西娅休弃妻子、苏兹达尔的奥尔加，哈利奇贵族愤而将阿纳斯塔西娅处以火刑。他被迫起誓与奥尔加和睦相处，却在次年将她逐走。他于1187年10月1日去世，遗命传位给私生子奥列格。其绰号“奥斯莫梅斯尔”意为“八智”，因史诗《伊戈尔远征记》而闻名。

en: Dündar Beg, called Felek al-Din (died 1324 or 1326), ruled the Hamidid beylik of southwestern Anatolia from about 1300. He moved his capital from Uluborlu to Eğirdir, rebuilt the city as Felekabad, and founded the Grand Mosque of Burdur and the Taşmedrese madrasa. Expanding during Ilkhanid internal strife, he seized Antalya and granted it to his brother Yunus, founder of the Teke branch. In 1321 he dropped Ilkhanid overlordship from his coins and took the title sultan. The Ilkhanid governor Timurtash later took Felekabad; Dündar fled to Antalya, was handed over by his nephew Mahmud, and was executed.
zh: 丁达尔贝伊，称号法莱克丁（卒于1324或1326年），约1300年起统治安纳托利亚西南部的哈米德侯国。他将都城从乌卢博尔卢迁至埃伊尔迪尔，重建该城并改名法莱克阿巴德，还修建了布尔杜尔大清真寺和塔什梅德雷塞经学院。他趁伊儿汗内乱扩张，夺取安塔利亚，封给弟弟尤努斯，即泰克支系的始祖。1321年，他在钱币上取消伊儿汗的宗主署名，自称苏丹。后来伊儿汗异密铁木尔塔什攻占法莱克阿巴德，丁达尔逃往安塔利亚，被侄子马哈茂德交出，最终被处死。

en: Hamid Beg was the eponymous ancestor of the Hamidid dynasty of southwestern Anatolia. His Turkmen tribe, originally settled in northern Syria, migrated into Anatolia, where he served the Sultanate of Rum and trained the children and army of Sultan Kayqubad I. In 1240 Sultan Kaykhusraw II granted him frontier lands around Isparta and Burdur. Hamid is said to have declared independence after the deposition of the Rum sultan Mesud II, ruling Isparta, Burdur and Eğirdir from the fortified town of Uluborlu, his capital. Whether he was still alive at that time is uncertain; sources place his death in the late thirteenth century.
zh: 哈米德贝伊是安纳托利亚西南部哈米德侯国的同名始祖。他所属的土库曼部落原居叙利亚北部，后迁入安纳托利亚；他效力于罗姆苏丹国，曾为苏丹凯库巴德一世训练子女与军队。1240年，苏丹凯霍斯鲁二世将伊斯帕塔与布尔杜尔一带的边境封地赐给他。相传罗姆苏丹梅苏德二世被废后，哈米德宣布独立，以设防城镇乌卢博尔卢为都，统治伊斯帕塔、布尔杜尔与埃伊尔迪尔等地。他当时可能已经去世；各史料将他的卒年定于13世纪末。

en: Muizeddin Ibrahim Bey was a son of Hızır Bey of the Hamidids and died around 1370 while lord of Şuhut.
zh: 穆伊兹丁·伊卜拉欣贝伊是哈米德侯国赫泽尔贝伊之子，约1370年去世时为舒胡特领主。

en: İlyas Beg was a Hamidid frontier ruler, son of Hamid Beg and father of Dündar Bey. He succeeded his father and governed the Uluborlu region, as shown by his donations to the sheikh Shikem, and probably died early in the fourteenth century.
zh: 伊利亚斯贝伊是哈米德家族的边境统治者，哈米德贝伊之子、丁达尔贝伊之父。他继父亲之后统治乌卢博尔卢一带，他向谢赫·希凯姆捐赠的文书可资证明；据推测他于14世纪初去世。

en: Hızır Bey was a son of Dündar Bey, founder of the Hamidid beylik around Uluborlu in southwestern Anatolia. The Ilkhanid governor Timurtash seized Eğirdir and had Dündar killed at Antalya; Hızır later held the beylik together after its disruption. He ruled around 1327–1328 and restored the damaged great mosque at Eğirdir, which took his name. Another account credits him with a mosque, bathhouse and madrasa at Isparta. In 1328 his brother İshak Bey returned from Mamluk Egypt and took over the beylik. Hızır's son Muizeddin İbrahim later held Şuhut.
zh: 赫泽尔贝伊是安纳托利亚西南部乌卢博尔卢一带哈米德侯国建立者丁达尔贝伊之子。伊儿汗国总督铁木尔塔什攻占埃伊尔迪尔，在安塔利亚杀死丁达尔；赫泽尔后来维系住了遭受打击的侯国。他约于1327至1328年统治，修复了埃伊尔迪尔受损的大清真寺，清真寺因而得名赫泽尔贝伊清真寺。另有记载称，他在伊斯帕尔塔修建了清真寺、浴室和经学院。1328年，兄弟伊沙克贝伊从马穆鲁克埃及返回，接掌侯国。赫泽尔之子穆伊兹丁·伊卜拉欣后来统治舒胡特。

en: Kahaʻimaoeleʻa, also called Kahai IV, was a Hawaiian high chief who ruled as aliʻi nui of the island of Hawaiʻi from 1285 to 1315. He was the son of Chief Kalapana and the chiefess Malamaʻihanaʻae, and succeeded his father after Kalapana died around 1285. He was the first ruler to keep his royal residence in Waipiʻo Valley. By his half-sister Kapo-a-Kauluhailea he fathered Kalaunuiohua, who followed him on the island's throne.
zh: 卡哈伊莫埃莱亚，又称卡哈伊四世，是夏威夷的高级酋长，于1285至1315年担任夏威夷岛最高酋长。他是酋长卡拉帕纳与女酋长玛拉玛伊哈娜埃之子，约1285年父亲死后继位。他是首位将怀皮奥谷作为王室驻地的统治者。他与异父姐妹卡波阿考卢海莱阿生下卡劳努伊奥胡阿，后者后来继任该岛的最高酋长。

en: Kalapana, also called Kalapanakuʻioʻiomoa, was a Hawaiian high chief of the island of Hawaiʻi. Tradition makes him possibly the son of Prince Kanaloa and his sister Makoʻani, children of Chief Kanipahu and Hualani of Molokai. Kalapana succeeded the chief Kamaiole after Kamaiole was murdered and ruled the island until about 1285. By his wife, the chiefess Malamaʻihanaʻae, he fathered Kahaʻimaoeleʻa, who followed him as high chief and first made Waipiʻo Valley a royal residence.
zh: 卡拉帕纳，又称卡拉帕纳库伊奥伊奥莫阿，是夏威夷岛的高级酋长。按口传谱系，他可能是卡纳洛阿王子与其姐妹马科阿尼之子，二人为酋长卡尼帕胡与莫洛凯岛的胡阿拉尼的子女。酋长卡马伊奥莱被弑后，卡拉帕纳继位，统治该岛直至约1285年。他娶高级女酋长玛拉玛伊哈娜埃，生子卡哈伊莫埃莱亚；其子继位后，最先将怀皮奥谷作为王室驻地。

en: Kalaunuiohua (fl. c. 1300) was a high chief of the island of Hawaiʻi in the Pili line, who succeeded his father Kahaimoelea. Chants remember him as a great warrior chief. He invaded Maui and captured its chief Kamaluohua, then conquered Molokaʻi's chief Kahokuohua and defeated Huapouleilei of Oʻahu, carrying all three rulers off captive. He next sailed against Kauaʻi, but was routed and taken prisoner by its sovereign Kukona at Koloa, in the war called Kawelewele. Freed after several years, he never made war again.
zh: 卡劳努伊奥华（约1300年前后在世）是夏威夷岛的高级酋长，属皮利世系，继其父卡海莫埃莱阿之位。古代吟诵传说把他记为勇武善战的酋长：他入侵茂宜岛，俘获酋长卡马卢奥华，继而征服莫洛凯岛的卡霍库奥华，又击败瓦胡岛的华波乌雷伊雷伊，将三位酋长全部掳走。随后他进军考爱岛，却在科洛亚附近的卡韦勒韦勒之战中被考爱君主库科纳击溃并俘虏。被囚数年后获释，从此再未兴兵。

en: Kapo-a-Kauluhailea, called Kapo, was a Hawaiian high chiefess, daughter of Malamaʻihanaʻae and the priest Haunaʻakamahala. She married her half-brother Kahaʻimaoeleʻa, the high chief of Hawaiʻi, and bore him Kalaunuiohua.
zh: 卡波，全名卡波阿考卢海莱阿，是夏威夷的高级女酋长，玛拉玛伊哈娜埃与祭司豪纳阿卡马哈拉之女。她嫁给异父兄弟、夏威夷岛高级酋长卡哈伊莫埃莱亚，生下卡劳努伊奥胡阿。

en: Malamaʻihanaʻae was a Hawaiian high chiefess of the island of Hawaiʻi, born to Piʻikalani and his consort Kalamea, a kinswoman of the high chief Kanipahu. She married her close relative Kalapana, who came to rule the island after the usurper Kamaiole was murdered. Their son Kahaʻimaoeleʻa succeeded as chief after Kalapana died around 1285, holding his court in Waipiʻo Valley. She later married the priest Haunaʻakamahala, who had a heiau temple built. Their daughter Kapo-a-Kauluhailea married Kahaʻimaoeleʻa and became the mother of Kalaunuiohua.
zh: 玛拉玛伊哈娜埃是夏威夷岛的高级女酋长，父母为皮伊卡拉尼与其配偶卡拉梅阿，卡拉梅阿是高级酋长卡尼帕胡的亲族。她嫁给近亲卡拉帕纳；僭主卡马伊奥莱被弑后，卡拉帕纳成为岛上的统治者。两人之子卡哈伊莫埃莱亚于约1285年卡拉帕纳死后继位，在怀皮奥谷设立朝廷。她后来改嫁祭司豪纳阿卡马哈拉，后者命人修建了一座海奥神庙。两人的女儿卡波阿考卢海莱阿嫁给卡哈伊莫埃莱亚，生下卡劳努伊奥胡阿。

en: Albert II of Brunswick-Lüneburg (c. 1294–1358), son of Duke Albert the Fat of Brunswick-Göttingen and Rixa of Werle, was bishop of Halberstadt from 1325 to 1358 and spent most of it in feuds. A cathedral canon by 1319, he won only five votes in the chapter election of 1324, but Archbishop Matthias of Mainz chose him, although Pope John XXII had granted the see to Giseko of Holstein. In 1325 he took Guntekenburg from the counts of Regenstein, and in 1326 Quedlinburg's guardianship passed to his church. His own chapter then allied with the city's three collegiate chapters against him. When he closed the cathedral and the Liebfrauenkirche, Halberstadt rose, several of his envoys were killed and he had to flee; peace came in 1338. After 1340 he kept Aschersleben against Anhalt. In the 1350s Pope Innocent VI excommunicated him and forced his resignation. He died in 1358 and was buried at St Blasius in Brunswick.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特二世·冯·不伦瑞克-吕讷堡（约1294—1358）是不伦瑞克-哥廷根公爵“胖子”阿尔布雷希特与维尔勒的里克莎之子，1325至1358年任哈尔伯施塔特主教，任内大半时间都在争斗。1319年他已是主教座堂的议事司铎；1324年的参事会选举中他只得五票，美因茨大主教马蒂亚斯却选定了他，尽管教皇约翰二十二世已把该主教区封给荷尔斯泰因的吉塞科。1325年他从雷根施泰因伯爵手中攻取贡特肯堡，1326年奎德林堡的庇护权转归他的教会。随后，他自己的参事会与城中三个教士会联合起来反对他。他关闭了主教座堂和圣母教堂，哈尔伯施塔特市民随即暴动，他的几名使者被杀，他本人被迫出逃；直到1338年才恢复和平。1340年后他顶住安哈尔特，保住阿舍斯莱本。1350年代，教皇英诺森六世将他逐出教会，迫使他辞去主教职位。他于1358年去世，葬于不伦瑞克的圣布拉修斯教堂。

en: Bayram was the first bey of the Hacıemiroğulları, a Çepni Turkmen lordship on the Black Sea coast of northeastern Anatolia that Greek sources called Chalybia. Early in the 14th century the region was subject to the Mongols and then to Eretna, but during the Mongol civil war of 1335–1336 Bayram made himself independent. He fought the Empire of Trebizond, and in 1348 joined a league of beys that besieged Trebizond itself, only to be defeated. His death date is unknown; by 1357 his son Hacı Emir had succeeded him.
zh: 巴伊拉姆是哈吉埃米尔贝伊国的第一代贝伊，这是安纳托利亚东北黑海沿岸的切普尼土库曼人领地，希腊史料称之为哈利比亚。14世纪初该地区先后臣服于蒙古人与埃尔特纳，但在1335—1336年蒙古内战期间，巴伊拉姆自立为政。他与特拉布宗帝国交战，1348年联合众贝伊围攻特拉布宗城，却遭败绩。其卒年不详，到1357年其子哈吉埃米尔已经继位。

en: Hacı Emir İbrahim Beg, called Chatzymyris in Greek sources, was the son of Bayram and ruler of the Black Sea beylik of Chalybia, later named Hacıemiroğulları after him. By 1357 he was raiding Trebizond's lands around Maçka, and in 1358 he sealed peace with the empire by marrying Theodora, daughter of Emperor Basil. A campaign to take Giresun failed in 1361, but with the backing of his ally Kadı Burhaneddin he captured Cotyora (Ordu) in 1380 and moved his capital to nearby Eskipazar.
zh: 哈吉·埃米尔·易卜拉欣贝伊在希腊史料中称哈齐米里斯，是巴伊拉姆之子、黑海沿岸哈利比亚贝伊国的统治者，后来的国名哈吉埃米尔贝伊国即得自于他。1357年他已攻略特拉布宗境内的马奇卡一带，1358年迎娶皇帝巴西尔之女狄奥多拉，与特拉布宗帝国联姻修好。1361年攻取吉雷松的战事失败，但在盟友卡迪·布尔汉丁支持下，他于1380年夺取科提奥拉（奥尔杜），并把都城迁至附近的埃斯基帕扎尔。

en: Chahula was a Borjigin Mongol prince, son of Eljigidei (Alchidai) and head of the princely house founded by Hachiun. As head of the Hachiun family he and his son Yezhili took part in Kublai's campaign against the Dali Kingdom in 1253.
zh: 察忽剌是孛儿只斤氏蒙古宗王，按赤台之子、合赤温家族的宗主。1253年，他携儿子也只里，以合赤温家族宗主的身份随忽必烈出征大理国。

en: Eljigidei, also called Alchidai, was a Borjigin prince, the son of Hachiun, a full brother of Genghis Khan. Hachiun died young, so Eljigidei headed the family. In 1203 he warned Temüjin that Toghrul, the Kereit khan, was about to attack and fought when the Kereit were destroyed. In the 1206 appanage grants he received his father's share as a left-wing prince. Campaigning under Ögedei, he helped destroy the Jin field army at Sanfeng Mountain in 1232 and captured Puxian Wannu of Eastern Xia in 1233. In 1251 he helped enthrone Möngke as khan.
zh: 按赤台（又译阿勒赤台、额勒只吉歹）是孛儿只斤氏宗王，成吉思汗同母弟合赤温之子。合赤温早卒，由按赤台掌理家族。1203年，他侦知克烈部王罕将要来袭，先行告知铁木真，随后在攻灭克烈部的战事中从军作战。1206年蒙古帝国分封时，他作为左翼宗王领受父亲一系的份额。他随窝阔台征战，1232年在三峰山之战参与歼灭金朝野战主力，1233年擒获东夏的蒲鲜万奴。1251年，他参与拥戴蒙哥即汗位。

en: Qulaqur, also called Quleihuer, was head of the Qachiun house, a Borjigin lineage descended from Genghis Khan's brother Qachiun. In 1260 he attended the Kaiping kurultai that enthroned Kublai. He had succeeded his father Chaqula; by about 1283 he had been succeeded by Shingnar.
zh: 忽剌忽儿（又译忽列虎儿）是合赤温家族宗主，该家族为成吉思汗之弟合赤温的后裔。1260年他出席拥戴忽必烈的开平忽里台大会。他继父亲察忽剌之位，约1283年前已由胜纳哈儿接任。

en: Munanzi was a Borjigin prince of the Hachiun line, son of Hulachu (Khulahur). He first held the title Prince of Jiyang, and in 1330 the Yuan court enfeoffed him as Prince of Wu. His son Čosgen inherited the title after him.
zh: 木南子是合赤温系的孛儿只斤氏宗王，忽剌忽儿（忽列虎儿）之子，初封济阳王，1330年改封吴王。其子搠思坚后来袭爵。

en: Čosgen (Shuosijian, 搠思坚) was a Borjigin prince of the Hachiun line and the son of Munanzi, from whom he inherited the Yuan dynasty title Prince of Wu. His own son, Dorji, appears in the History of Ming under the name Duo'erzhi.
zh: 搠思坚是合赤温系的孛儿只斤氏宗王，木南子之子，承袭其父的元朝吴王爵位。其子朵尔赤即《明史》中所记的朵耳只。

en: Henry III of Brunswick-Lüneburg (c. 1296–1363) was a Welf prince who held the bishopric of Hildesheim from 1331 against the will of the pope. Son of Duke Albert II of Brunswick-Göttingen and brother of Bishop Albert II of Halberstadt, he was elected by the cathedral chapter in August 1331. But his predecessor Otto II of Woldenberg had put the bishopric into papal hands before dying, and the pope had named a different archbishop of Mainz, so confirmation was doubtful. John XXII appointed Count Erich of Holstein-Schaumburg instead and placed Henry, who refused to yield, under ban and interdict. With the chapter, the Brunswick dukes and the local nobility behind him, Henry controlled most of the bishopric, while Erich held little beyond the city and its monasteries. The schism lasted until about 1350. In 1346–1349 he built the water castle of Marienburg near Hildesheim. He died in Hildesheim on 6 February 1363.
zh: 海因里希三世·冯·不伦瑞克-吕讷堡（约1296—1363）是韦尔夫家族的亲王，1331年起违抗教皇的意愿，据有希尔德斯海姆主教区。他是不伦瑞克-哥廷根公爵阿尔布雷希特二世之子，哈尔贝尔施塔特主教阿尔布雷希特二世之弟。1331年8月，主教座堂参事会选举他继位。但前任主教奥托二世·冯·沃尔登贝格临终前已把主教区交到教皇手中，教皇又在美因茨另任了大主教，因此他的确认悬而未决。教皇约翰二十二世改任荷尔斯泰因-绍恩堡伯爵埃里希为主教，海因里希不肯让步，被处以绝罚和禁罚。在参事会、不伦瑞克公爵和当地贵族的支持下，海因里希控制了主教区大部分地方，埃里希则基本只有城市和修道院。分裂局面持续到约1350年。1346至1349年，他在希尔德斯海姆附近修建水堡马林堡。1363年2月6日，他在希尔德斯海姆去世。

en: Otto I of Brunswick (c. 1247–1279), a Welf and son of Duke Otto the Child of Brunswick-Lüneburg, was bishop of Hildesheim from 1260 until his death. Elected by the cathedral chapter while still under age, he was confirmed by the pope in 1264 and consecrated in 1274. He enlarged his church's lands, buying the county of Wohldenberg in 1275 and acquiring Poppenburg and Peine. A feud with his brother Duke Albert followed an arbitration awarding Albert five Salzgau villages. Their brother John supported Otto, but after John's death the war went badly: Albert took Campen in 1279, seized Sarstedt and Gronau, and marched on Hildesheim. Otto died with the town under threat on 4 July 1279, aged thirty-two.
zh: 奥托一世·冯·不伦瑞克-吕讷堡（约1247—1279）是韦尔夫家族成员，不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵“孩童”奥托之子，1260年至去世任希尔德斯海姆主教。他尚在幼年便被主教座堂参事会选出，1264年获教皇确认，1274年才正式祝圣。他扩张教会领地，1275年购得沃尔登贝格伯国，又取得波彭堡与派讷。一项裁决将萨尔茨高的五个村庄判给兄长阿尔布雷希特公爵后，他与兄长交战。另一位兄长约翰支持奥托，但约翰死后战事不利：1279年阿尔布雷希特攻占坎彭，又夺取萨尔施泰特和格罗瑙，进军希尔德斯海姆。1279年7月4日，在城池告急之际奥托去世，年仅32岁。

en: Amano was the Garad, or king, of the Muslim Hadiya state south of Shewa in the early fourteenth century. Hadiya lay on the slave and inland trade routes that Emperor Amda Seyon I of Ethiopia meant to take from the Muslim sultanates of the east. Amano refused to visit the emperor and pay tribute, urged on by a Muslim called Bel'am, whom the royal chronicle denounces as a prophet of darkness and who promised that the emperor would be delivered into his hands. Amda Seyon invaded Hadiya, put many of its people to the sword, enslaved the rest and took Amano prisoner, while Bel'am escaped to Ifat. Hadiya was soon absorbed and by 1332 was supplying troops for the emperor's campaign against Ifat.
zh: 阿玛诺是14世纪初绍阿以南穆斯林政权哈迪亚的国王，称号加拉德。哈迪亚地处奴隶贸易和内陆商路上，埃塞俄比亚皇帝安达·塞永一世正想从东方的穆斯林苏丹国手中夺取这些商路。阿玛诺拒绝觐见皇帝并缴纳贡赋，怂恿他的是一个名叫贝拉阿姆的穆斯林，皇帝的编年史斥其为‘黑暗的先知’，称他曾预言皇帝将落入阿玛诺手中。安达·塞永于是入侵哈迪亚，以利剑屠戮许多居民，将其余人掳为奴隶，并俘虏了阿玛诺，贝拉阿姆则逃往伊法特。哈迪亚随后被并入帝国，到1332年已为皇帝征讨伊法特的战事提供兵员。

en: Heinrich Kramer (c. 1430–1505), Latinized as Henricus Institoris, was a German Dominican friar and inquisitor born at Schlettstadt in Alsace. Before 1474 he was made inquisitor for the Tyrol and Salzburg. Pope Innocent VIII's bull Summis desiderantes affectibus of 1484 affirmed his authority to prosecute witches, but his witch trial at Innsbruck in 1485 was halted by the bishop of Brixen, who expelled him. Returning to Cologne, he wrote the Malleus Maleficarum, first printed in 1487; the witch-hunting handbook was condemned by the Cologne theological faculty yet became the most influential text of the European witch trials. In 1491 Nuremberg's council sought his advice on witch trials, and in 1500 Pope Alexander VI assigned him to Bohemia and Moravia.
zh: 海因里希·克雷默（约1430—1505），拉丁名为亨利克斯·因斯蒂托里斯，是德意志多明我会修士、宗教裁判官，生于阿尔萨斯的施莱茨塔特。1474年前，他受命在蒂罗尔和萨尔茨堡主持异端审判。1484年教宗英诺森八世发布诏书，确认他有权追猎女巫；但1485年他在因斯布鲁克主持的女巫审判被布里克森主教叫停，本人也遭驱逐。返回科隆后，他写成《女巫之槌》，1487年首次刊印。这部猎巫手册虽遭科隆神学家谴责，却成为欧洲女巫审判中影响最大的文本。1491年纽伦堡市议会就女巫审判向他征询意见，1500年教宗亚历山大六世将他派往波希米亚和摩拉维亚。

en: Enrico Zuccalli (c. 1642–1724) was a Swiss architect from Roveredo in the Three Leagues, who shaped Bavarian High Baroque. He served the Wittelsbach rulers of Bavaria and Cologne and helped introduce Italian Baroque architecture to Germany. Trained in the circle of Bernini in Rome and Paris, he settled in Munich in 1669 and succeeded Agostino Barelli as court architect. He completed the Theatinerkirche and Nymphenburg Palace, built Lustheim Palace (1684–1688) and the Palais Porcia (1693), began the Electoral Palace at Bonn in 1697 and the New Palace at Schleißheim in 1701. The Austrian occupation of 1706 cost him his offices; he then rebuilt Ettal Abbey church and died in Munich in 1724.
zh: 恩里科·祖卡利（约1642—1724）是瑞士建筑师，生于三同盟的罗韦雷多，塑造了巴伐利亚的鼎盛巴洛克风貌。他为巴伐利亚和科隆的维特尔斯巴赫统治者服务，推动意大利巴洛克建筑传入德意志。他曾在罗马和巴黎的贝尔尼尼圈子中受训，1669年定居慕尼黑，继阿戈斯蒂诺·巴雷利出任选帝侯宫廷建筑师。他完成了剧院教堂与宁芬堡宫，修建了卢斯特海姆宫（1684—1688）和波尔恰宫（1693），1697年在波恩动工兴建选帝侯宫，1701年开建施莱斯海姆新宫。1706年奥地利占领巴伐利亚后他被免去一切职务，随后主持改建埃塔尔修道院教堂，1724年在慕尼黑去世。

en: Adelaide of Hesse (after 1323–after 1371) was the eldest daughter of Landgrave Henry II of Hesse and Elisabeth of Thuringia. On 29 September 1341 she married King Casimir III of Poland in Poznań and was crowned queen consort. The marriage was unhappy; Casimir soon lived apart from her at his court while Adelaide resided chiefly at Żarnowiec castle, where she founded the parish church. He separated from her in 1356 to marry Krystyna Rokiczana, and the church annulled Adelaide's marriage only in 1368. She returned to Hesse and, after Casimir's death, secured Pope Gregory XI's support in seeking the return of her property.
zh: 黑森的阿德海德（1323年后—1371年后）是黑森方伯海因里希二世与图林根的伊丽莎白的长女。1341年9月29日，她在波兹南嫁给波兰国王卡齐米日三世，并加冕为王后。这段婚姻并不幸福，卡齐米日很快便与她分居，阿德海德主要居住在扎尔诺维茨城堡，并在当地修建了教区教堂。1356年国王离弃她，另娶克里斯蒂娜·洛基查娜，教会迟至1368年才宣布废除她的婚姻。她返回黑森，并在卡齐米日死后争取到教皇格列高利十一世的支持，要求归还自己的财产。

en: Adelheid of Ravensberg (c. 1270–1338) was the daughter of Count Otto III of Ravensberg and Hedwig of Lippe. In 1297 she married Otto I, Landgrave of Hesse, becoming landgravine when he inherited Hesse in 1308. Her children included Henry II, called the Iron, who ruled Hesse from 1328, Louis the Junker, and Otto, who became Archbishop of Magdeburg in 1331. She survived her husband by ten years and died at Marburg, where she was buried in the Church of St. Elizabeth.
zh: 阿德海德·冯·拉芬斯贝格（约1270—1338）是拉芬斯贝格伯爵奥托三世与黑德维希·楚尔·利珀之女。1297年她嫁给黑森领地伯爵奥托一世，1308年丈夫袭封后成为黑森领地伯爵夫人。她的子女包括1328年起统治黑森的“铁人”亨利二世、“贵族”路德维希，以及1331年成为马格德堡大主教的奥托。她比丈夫多活十年，卒于马尔堡，葬于圣伊丽莎白教堂。

en: Eberhard I of Eppstein (c. 1337–1391) was a nobleman of the younger line of the House of Eppstein, son of Gottfried V and Liutgard of Breuberg. He married three times: Agnes of Nassau in 1347, Isengard of Ziegenhain in 1356, and, after 1376, Luitgard of Falkenstein. His last marriage gave his sons Gottfried VII and Eberhard II a claim to the Falkenstein inheritance, from which in 1419 they received the Butzbach third, including Königstein and Kransberg. Eberhard died between May and October 1391.
zh: 埃伯哈德一世·冯·埃普施泰因（约1337—1391）出身埃普施泰因家族幼支，是戈特弗里德五世与布罗伊贝格的柳特加德之子。他三次成婚：1347年娶拿骚的阿格妮丝，1356年娶齐根海恩的伊森加德，1376年后娶法尔肯施泰因的柳特加德。最后一次婚姻使他的儿子戈特弗里德七世与埃伯哈德二世取得法尔肯施泰因遗产的继承权，两人于1419年分得其中的“布茨巴赫三分之一”，包括柯尼希施泰因和克兰斯贝格。埃伯哈德卒于1391年5月至10月之间。

en: Elisabeth of Hesse (c. 1320–1390) was a daughter of Landgrave Henry II the Iron of Hesse and Elisabeth of Thuringia. On 4 October 1341 she married Duke Ernest I of Brunswick-Göttingen. She bore at least six children, including Otto I, who succeeded his father in Göttingen in 1367. Widowed that year, Elisabeth died at Göttingen on 7 March 1390; she was buried in Hannover.
zh: 黑森的伊丽莎白（约1320—1390）是黑森方伯“铁人”海因里希二世与图林根的伊丽莎白之女。1341年10月4日，她嫁给不伦瑞克-格丁根公爵恩斯特一世。她至少生有六个子女，其中奥托一世于1367年在格丁根继承父位。同年丧夫后，伊丽莎白于1390年3月7日卒于格丁根，葬于汉诺威。

en: Elisabeth of Meissen (c. 1306–1367) was the daughter of Margrave Frederick I of Meissen and Elisabeth of Lobdeburg-Arnshaugk. In 1321 she married Henry II, Landgrave of Hesse, later called the Iron, and bore him five children, including Otto the Younger, his co-ruler from 1339, and Adelaide, who married King Casimir III of Poland in 1341. After Henry accused her of adultery in 1339, Elisabeth withdrew to Eisenach under her brother's protection, and she died there in 1367.
zh: 伊丽莎白·冯·迈森（约1306—1367）是迈森藩侯腓特烈一世与伊丽莎白·冯·洛德堡-阿恩斯豪克之女。1321年她嫁给后来被称为“铁人”的黑森领地伯爵亨利二世，生下五名子女，包括1339年起与父亲共同执政的奥托，以及1341年嫁给波兰国王卡齐米日三世的阿德海德。1339年亨利指控她通奸后，伊丽莎白退居爱森纳赫，受其兄弟庇护，最终于1367年在当地去世。

en: Gottfried V of Eppstein (c. 1318–1341) was a nobleman of the younger line of the House of Eppstein, a family that built one of the most powerful lordships in medieval Hesse. The son of Gottfried IV and Loretta of Daun, he married Liutgard of Breuberg in 1328, widow of Konrad V of Weinsberg. As an heiress she brought into the marriage an eighth of the lordship of Breuberg in the Odenwald. Their sons were Gottfried VI and Eberhard I, who continued the Eppstein line. Gottfried died between August 1336 and October 1341.
zh: 戈特弗里德五世·冯·埃普施泰因（约1318—1341）出身埃普施泰因家族幼支，该家族在中世纪黑森建立起最有权势的贵族领地之一。他是戈特弗里德四世与道恩的洛蕾塔之子，1328年迎娶魏因斯贝格的康拉德五世的遗孀布罗伊贝格的柳特加德。作为女继承人，她把奥登林山的布罗伊贝格领地八分之一的份额带入婚姻。两人的儿子戈特弗里德六世与埃伯哈德一世延续了家族世系。戈特弗里德卒于1336年8月至1341年10月之间。

en: Gottfried VI of Eppstein was a son of Gottfried V of Eppstein and Liutgard of Breuberg, and a brother of Eberhard I. He died between April 1355 and March 1357.
zh: 戈特弗里德六世·冯·埃普施泰因是戈特弗里德五世·冯·埃普施泰因与布罗伊贝格的柳特加德之子、埃伯哈德一世的兄弟，卒于1355年4月至1357年3月之间。

en: Henry I, called the Child (1244–1308), was the first landgrave of Hesse and founder of the ruling dynasty, son of Henry II of Brabant and Sophie of Thuringia. When the Ludowingian line died out in 1247, his mother fought the Thuringian succession war and secured Hesse for him; the 1265 Treaty of Langsdorf confirmed him as landgrave under Mainz. Outlawed in 1274, he regained King Rudolf I's favour against Ottokar II of Bohemia, defeated Mainz at Fritzlar in 1290, and in 1292 became a prince of the realm. He died at Marburg amid a succession war among his sons.
zh: 海因里希一世，绰号“小孩”（1244年6月24日—1308年12月21日），是第一代黑森伯爵、黑森王朝的始祖，布拉班特公爵亨利二世与图林根的索菲之子。1247年路德温格家族绝嗣，他的母亲在图林根继承战争中为他保住黑森，1265年的《兰格斯多夫条约》确认他为隶属于美因茨的黑森伯爵。1274年他被剥夺法律保护，后因协助国王鲁道夫一世对抗波希米亚的奥托卡二世重获信任，1290年在弗里茨拉尔击败美因茨，1292年成为帝国诸侯。他最终在诸子争位的内战中死于马尔堡。

en: Henry II of Hesse, called the Iron (before 1302–1376), was Landgrave of Hesse from 1328, having ruled as co-regent with his father Otto I since 1320. In 1321 he married Elisabeth of Thuringia, daughter of Margrave Frederick I of Meissen. He won two feuds against Abbot Henry VII of Fulda in 1356 and 1361. When his only son Otto the Younger died in 1366, Henry made his nephew Hermann co-regent, provoking war with Duke Otto of Brunswick; to fund it he taxed all imported goods. He died on 3 June 1376 and Hermann succeeded him.
zh: 海因里希二世（1302年前—1376），绰号“铁人”，1328年起任黑森方伯，此前自1320年起便与父亲奥托一世共同摄政。1321年，他迎娶迈森藩侯腓特烈一世之女图林根的伊丽莎白。1356年和1361年，他两度在与富尔达修道院长亨利七世的家族仇争中获胜。独子“射手”奥托于1366年死后，他立侄子赫尔曼为共同摄政，由此与不伦瑞克公爵奥托开战；为筹措军费，他对所有进口货物征税。他于1376年6月3日去世，赫尔曼继位。

en: Hermann I the Elder of Hesse (after 1305–1368/1370) was the youngest son of Landgrave Otto I of Hesse and Adelheid of Ravensberg. In 1326 Pope John XXII offered him a church prebend at Avignon, but he renounced an ecclesiastical career. When his eldest brother Henry II succeeded in 1328, Hermann received Nordeck Castle near Giessen as his apanage, and in 1349 also Grebenstein Castle. After his nephew Otto the Younger died in 1366, he made no claim to the landgraviate. He last appears alive in July 1368 and was dead by July 1370, leaving no known issue.
zh: 赫尔曼一世（1305年后—1368至1370年间），绰号“长者”，是黑森方伯奥托一世与拉文斯贝格的阿德海德最小的儿子。1326年在阿维尼翁，教皇约翰二十二世曾许诺他一份教会俸禄，但他放弃了教士生涯。长兄海因里希二世1328年继位后，他得到吉森附近的诺德克城堡作为封禄，1349年又获得格雷本施泰因城堡。1366年侄子“射手”奥托去世后，他没有提出对黑森方伯领的继承权。1368年7月的文书还提到他在世，1370年7月的文书已称他“已故”，无子嗣记载。

en: Louis the Junker of Hesse (1305–1345) was the third son of Landgrave Otto I of Hesse and Adelheid of Ravensberg. During a visit to Pope John XXII in Avignon in 1326, he was offered a church prebend on condition of celibacy, but he refused and abandoned an ecclesiastical career. When his brother Henry II inherited the landgraviate in 1328, Louis received the castle and district of Grebenstein as his apanage. On 15 October 1340 he married Elisabeth of Sponheim, widow of Count Rudolph I of Hohenberg. Their son Hermann II later succeeded as Landgrave of Hesse.
zh: 路德维希（1305—1345），绰号“容克”，是黑森方伯奥托一世与拉文斯贝格的阿德海德的第三子。1326年随家人在阿维尼翁觐见教皇约翰二十二世时，教皇许诺只要他保持独身便授予教会俸禄，但他拒绝并放弃了教士前程。1328年兄长海因里希二世继承方伯领后，他得到格雷本施泰因城堡及辖区作为封禄。1340年10月15日，他娶霍恩贝格伯爵鲁道夫一世的遗孀、施蓬海姆的伊丽莎白为妻。其子赫尔曼二世后来继任黑森方伯。

en: Margaretha of Hesse was a daughter of Landgrave Henry II the Iron of Hesse and Elisabeth of Thuringia. From 1339 she was a nun at Haydau Cistercian monastery, and she died in 1353.
zh: 黑森的玛格丽特是黑森方伯“铁人”海因里希二世与图林根的伊丽莎白之女，1339年起在海道的西多会修道院当修女，1353年去世。

en: Otto I (c. 1272–1328) was landgrave of Upper Hesse from 1308 and reunited the landgraviate by inheriting Lower Hesse in 1311 after his half-brother John's death. A son of Henry I the Child, he held Marburg and Giessen and thereafter ruled from Kassel as well. He waged a long feud with Archbishop Matthias of Mainz, losing Giessen briefly in 1327 before its citizens restored it to him, and won a victory at Wetzlar, after which King John of Luxembourg mediated a settlement in 1328. He died at Kassel and was buried in Ahnaberg monastery.
zh: 奥托一世（约1272—1328）是海因里希一世之子，1308年起为上黑森伯爵，1311年异母弟约翰死后又继承下黑森，重新统一黑森伯国，领有马尔堡、吉森，并以卡瑟尔为驻地。他与美因茨大主教马特希亚斯长期争斗，1327年吉森一度失守，赖市民反正而复城；他在韦茨拉尔获胜后，经卢森堡的约翰国王调停，于1328年达成和解。他死于卡瑟尔，葬于阿纳贝格修道院。

en: Otto the Younger of Hesse, called Otto the Marksman (before 1322–1366), was the only son of Landgrave Henry II of Hesse and Elisabeth of Thuringia. In 1338 he married Elisabeth of Cleves, but the marriage remained childless. From 1339 he was co-regent with his father and imperial governor in Mühlhausen. He fought in his father's victorious feuds against Abbot Henry VII of Fulda, ravaging Hausen in 1356 and plundering Hünfeld with Margrave Frederick III of Meissen in 1361. Residing at Spangenberg Castle, he died suddenly there in December 1366, rumoured poisoned by the Fulda abbot.
zh: 奥托（1322年前—1366），绰号“射手”，是黑森方伯海因里希二世与图林根的伊丽莎白的独子。1338年他娶克莱沃的伊丽莎白为妻，婚姻无子嗣。1339年起，他与父亲共同摄政，并担任帝国在米尔豪森的总督。他参加了父亲对富尔达修道院长亨利七世的两次获胜的家族仇争：1356年洗劫豪森，1361年与迈森藩侯腓特烈三世一起劫掠欣费尔德。他居住在施潘根贝格城堡，1366年12月猝死于该地，传言称他是被富尔达修道院长毒杀。

en: Sophie of Thuringia (20 March 1224–29 May 1275), duchess of Brabant, was the daughter of Landgrave Louis IV of Thuringia and Saint Elisabeth of Hungary, born at Wartburg Castle. In 1241 she married Duke Henry II of Brabant, and their son Henry the Child founded the Hessian dynasty. When her uncle Henry Raspe died heirless in 1247, she fought the War of the Thuringian Succession against the Meissen margraves and Mainz, retaining Hesse for her son; the 1264 settlement gave him Hesse while Meissen took Thuringia. She died at Marburg and was buried at Villers Abbey.
zh: 图林根的索菲（1224年3月20日—1275年5月29日），布拉班特公爵夫人，是图林根伯爵路易四世与匈牙利的圣伊丽莎白之女，生于瓦尔特堡城堡。1241年她嫁给布拉班特公爵亨利二世，所生之子“小孩”海因里希后来成为黑森王朝的开创者。1247年叔父海因里希·拉斯佩无嗣而终，她遂投身图林根继承战争，对抗迈森藩侯和美因茨，为儿子保住黑森；1264年的分割协定使他获得黑森，图林根则归迈森。她死于马尔堡，葬于维莱尔修道院。

en: Agnes of Hohenberg (died 5 June 1366) was a Swabian noblewoman of the counts of Hohenberg, kinsmen of the Habsburgs, and daughter of Count Rudolf II and Margareta of Nassau-Hadamar. In 1349 she married Duke Konrad IV of Teck. In June 1352 the couple and his cousin Friedrich III bound themselves to keep open several Tyrolean castles of the margrave of Brandenburg, including Ehrenberg and Rodenegg. On 4 September 1352 Konrad was murdered in Munich, leaving Agnes a childless widow. Friedrich still owed her 5000 guilders in 1356, the year she acknowledged receiving two annual payments of 3000 each. With her mother she founded the St Ursula benefice at Ehingen. She died on 5 June 1366 and was buried in the collegiate church of St Moriz in Rottenburg, where a yearly memorial for her and Konrad was kept on that date.
zh: 阿格尼丝·冯·霍恩贝格（？—1366年6月5日）是施瓦本贵族女子，出身与哈布斯堡有亲的霍恩贝格伯爵家，是伯爵鲁道夫二世与拿骚-哈达玛的玛格丽特之女。1349年，她嫁给泰克公爵康拉德四世。1352年6月，夫妇二人与公爵的堂弟腓特烈三世一同承诺，为勃兰登堡藩侯开放其在蒂罗尔的数座城堡，包括埃伦贝格和罗德内格。同年9月4日，康拉德在慕尼黑遇刺，阿格尼丝成为没有子嗣的寡妇。腓特烈在1356年仍欠她5000弗罗林，她同年确认已收到两期年付款，各3000弗罗林。她与母亲一同在埃英根创立了圣乌尔苏拉俸职。她于1366年6月5日去世，葬于罗滕堡的圣莫里茨修道院教堂，教堂每年在这一天为她和康拉德举行追思。

en: Agnes of Schaunberg (died after 1348) was a daughter of Count Henry of Schaunberg in Upper Austria and the wife of Count Henry of Hohenberg-Rotenburg; she was still alive on 24 June 1348.
zh: 阿格内丝·冯·绍恩贝格（1348年后去世）是上奥地利绍恩贝格伯爵海因里希之女，嫁给霍恩贝格-罗滕堡伯爵海因里希，1348年6月24日仍有在世的记录。

en: Albert II of Hohenberg-Rotenburg (c. 1235–1298) inherited the lands around Hohenberg, Haigerloch and Rotenburg from his father Burchard V in 1253 and refounded Rotenburg as his seat around 1280. A follower of his brother-in-law King Rudolf I of Habsburg, he served as imperial governor of Lower Swabia, charged with recovering lost imperial and former Staufen lands. In 1280 he defeated Count Hartmann of Grüningen and imprisoned him at Asperg. After Rudolf's death he backed Albert of Austria against King Adolf of Nassau, who deprived him of his offices. On 17 April 1298 he was killed near his castle of Leinstetten. Two song stanzas attributed to him as 'Albert of Haigerloch' survive in the Codex Manesse.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特二世·冯·霍恩贝格-罗滕堡（约1235—1298）于1253年从父亲布尔夏德五世手中继承霍恩贝格、海格洛赫和罗滕堡一带的领地，约1280年重建罗滕堡作为统治中心。他追随姐夫哈布斯堡的鲁道夫一世，任下施瓦本帝国地方长官，奉命收回失去的帝国领地和施陶芬旧领。1280年他击败格吕宁根伯爵哈特曼，将其囚禁于阿斯佩格。鲁道夫死后他支持奥地利的阿尔布雷希特对抗国王拿骚的阿道夫，后者剥夺了他的官职。1298年4月17日，他在自己的莱恩施泰滕城堡附近战死。《马内塞手抄本》保存了两节署名“海格洛赫的阿尔布雷希特”、被认为是他的歌词。

en: Burchard II of Zollern-Hohenberg (c. 1096–1150/1155) was a Swabian count and the ancestor of the Hohenberg line of the Hohenzollern family. The second son of Count Frederick I of Zollern and Udilhild of Urach, he saw his elder brother Frederick II inherit Zollern after their father died in 1125, while he founded the Zollern-Hohenberg branch, named for Hohenberg Castle near Schorzingen. He married Helmburgis of Schala-Burghausen, and his sons Burchard III and Frederick held the county of Hohenberg. His great-great-granddaughter Gertrude married Rudolf of Habsburg, the future king of the Romans.
zh: 索伦-霍恩贝格的布尔夏德二世（约1096—1150/1155）是施瓦本伯爵，霍亨索伦家族霍恩贝格支系的始祖。他是索伦伯爵弗里德里希一世与乌拉赫的乌迪尔希德的次子，1125年父亲死后，长兄弗里德里希二世继承索伦，他则另立索伦-霍恩贝格支系，以许尔青根附近的霍恩贝格城堡得名。他娶沙拉-布格豪森的黑尔姆布吉斯，儿子布尔夏德三世和弗里德里希都受封霍恩贝格伯爵。他的玄孙女格特鲁德嫁给了后来的罗马人的国王哈布斯堡的鲁道夫。

en: Burchard III of Zollern-Hohenberg (died after 4 July 1193) was a Swabian count of the line that split from the House of Hohenzollern in the twelfth century, the son of Count Burchard II and Helmburgis of Schala-Burghausen. He is attested as count of Zollern in 1163 and as count of Hohenberg from 1179. With his brother Frederick he witnessed charters of Emperor Frederick I in 1179 and of Duke Frederick of Swabia in 1185. He married Kunigunde of Grünberg and was the father of Burchard IV, who succeeded him.
zh: 索伦-霍恩贝格的布尔夏德三世（？—1193年7月4日后）是12世纪从霍亨索伦家族分出的索伦-霍恩贝格支系的施瓦本伯爵，伯爵布尔夏德二世与黑尔姆布吉斯·冯·沙拉-布格豪森之子。他在1163年的文书中已称索伦伯爵，1179年起称霍恩贝格伯爵，并与弟弟腓特烈一同在皇帝腓特烈一世1179年、施瓦本公爵腓特烈1185年的特许状上联署。他娶库妮贡德·冯·格林贝格，继承者布尔夏德四世是他的儿子。

en: Burchard IV of Zollern-Hohenberg (died before 1225) was a Swabian count, the son of Count Burchard III and Kunigunde of Grünberg. On 6 February 1207 he and his brother Albert, as counts of Zollern, witnessed a charter of King Philip of Swabia at Strasbourg. He is attested as count of Hohenberg from 1213, when he appeared at Constance and Überlingen. In 1216 and 1217 he was present at proceedings of King Frederick II in Constance and Rottweil. He married Wilipirg of Aichelberg, who bore him his successor Burchard V and a daughter Kunigunde. His granddaughter Gertrud Anna married Rudolf of Habsburg, the later German king.
zh: 索伦-霍恩贝格的布尔夏德四世（？—1225年前）是施瓦本伯爵，布尔夏德三世与库妮贡德·冯·格林贝格之子。1207年2月6日，他与弟弟阿尔贝特以索伦伯爵身份在斯特拉斯堡为德意志国王施瓦本的菲利普的特许状联署。1213年起他以霍恩贝格伯爵见于文书，当年曾到康斯坦茨和于伯林根。1216年和1217年，他在康斯坦茨与罗特韦尔出席国王腓特烈二世主持的事务。他娶维利普格·冯·艾歇尔贝格，生子继承者布尔夏德五世，另有一女库妮贡德。他的孙女格特鲁德·安娜嫁给了后来的德意志国王哈布斯堡的鲁道夫。

en: Burchard V of Hohenberg (died 14 July 1253) was Count of Hohenberg and Haigerloch, the only son of Burchard IV and Wilipirg of Aichelberg. In 1233 he married Mechthild, an heiress of the Counts Palatine of Tübingen, bringing the dynasty lands around Nagold and Wildberg. His daughter Gertrud Anna married Rudolf of Habsburg in 1245 and became German queen after his election as king in 1273. His other children included the minstrel Albert II and Burchard VI. On his death the main county passed to Albert, while Nagold and Wildberg went to Burchard VI, founder of a junior line.
zh: 霍恩贝格的布尔夏德五世（？—1253年7月14日）是霍恩贝格与海格洛赫伯爵，布尔夏德四世与维利普格·冯·艾歇尔贝格的独子。1233年，他娶图宾根行宫伯爵家族的女继承人梅希蒂尔德，纳戈尔德和维尔德贝格一带的领地由此归入霍恩贝格家族。女儿格特鲁德·安娜于1245年嫁给哈布斯堡的鲁道夫，1273年鲁道夫当选德意志国王后成为王后。其他子女有诗人伯爵阿尔贝特二世和布尔夏德六世。1253年他去世后，伯爵领地主体归阿尔贝特，纳戈尔德和维尔德贝格则归布尔夏德六世，形成旁支。

en: Heinrich of Hohenberg-Rotenburg was the youngest son of Count Rudolf I of Hohenberg and Agnes of Werdenberg, and a Swabian count of the Hohenberg-Rotenburg line. He was killed in battle on 12 May 1352.
zh: 海因里希·冯·霍恩贝格-罗滕堡是霍恩贝格伯爵鲁道夫一世与阿格尼丝·冯·韦尔登贝格的幼子，霍恩贝格-罗滕堡支系的施瓦本伯爵。他于1352年5月12日在战斗中被杀。

en: Hugo I of Hohenberg-Rotenburg was a Swabian count, a son of Count Rudolf I of Hohenberg and Agnes of Werdenberg. He married Ursula of Pfirt and died on 26 May 1354.
zh: 胡戈一世·冯·霍恩贝格-罗滕堡是施瓦本伯爵，霍恩贝格伯爵鲁道夫一世与阿格尼丝·冯·韦尔登贝格之子。他娶乌尔苏拉·冯·普菲尔特为妻，于1354年5月26日去世。

en: Margareta of Hohenberg (died 24 August 1366) was a countess of the Swabian Hohenberg-Rotenburg line, daughter of Count Rudolf II of Hohenberg and Margareta of Nassau-Hadamar. She married Count Ludwig VIII of Oettingen, becoming countess of Oettingen in Swabia and Bavaria and landgravine in Alsace.
zh: 霍恩贝格的玛格丽特（？—1366年）是施瓦本贵族女子，霍恩贝格伯爵鲁道夫二世与拿骚-哈达马尔的玛格丽特之女，嫁给厄廷根伯爵路德维希八世，成为厄廷根伯爵夫人、阿尔萨斯领地伯爵夫人。

en: Margaret of Nassau-Hadamar was a daughter of Count Emicho I of Nassau-Hadamar and Anna of Hohenzollern. She married Count Rudolf II of Hohenberg, who died in 1335, and her children included his successor Rudolf III. She died on 30 January 1370.
zh: 玛格丽特·冯·拿骚-哈达马尔是拿骚-哈达马尔伯爵埃米希一世与安娜·冯·霍亨索伦之女。她嫁给霍恩贝格伯爵鲁道夫二世，丈夫于1335年去世，她所生的子女包括继承人鲁道夫三世。此后她以遗孀身份生活，于1370年1月30日去世。

en: Rudolf I of Hohenberg (died 11 January 1336) was Count of Hohenberg and lord of Triberg, the son of the minstrel-count Albert II and Margaret of Fürstenberg. In 1335 Emperor Louis the Bavarian named him imperial governor in Alsace and Lower Swabia. By his first wife Agnes of Werdenberg he had four sons, Albert, Rudolf II, Hugo and Henry, along with a daughter; his later marriages to Irmengard of Württemberg in 1318 and Elisabeth of Sponheim in 1331 were childless. He died in Austria in January 1336 and was buried in the family vault at Ehingen.
zh: 霍恩贝格的鲁道夫一世（？—1336年1月11日）是霍恩贝格伯爵、特里贝格领主，诗人伯爵阿尔贝特二世与玛格丽特·冯·菲尔斯滕贝格之子。1335年，皇帝路易四世（巴伐利亚人）任命他为阿尔萨斯与下施瓦本的帝国总督。他先娶阿格妮丝·冯·韦尔登贝格，生有阿尔贝特、鲁道夫二世、胡戈、亨利希四子及一女；1318年续娶伊尔门加德·冯·符腾堡、1331年再娶伊丽莎白·冯·施蓬海姆，两次婚姻均无子嗣。1336年1月他卒于奥地利，葬于埃欣根的霍恩贝格家族墓地。

en: Rudolf of Hohenberg (died 26 February 1335), son of Count Rudolf I and Agnes of Werdenberg, died a year before his father and was buried in the family tomb at Ehingen.
zh: 霍恩贝格的鲁道夫（？—1335年2月26日）是伯爵鲁道夫一世与阿格妮丝·冯·韦尔登贝格之子，比父亲早一年去世，葬在埃欣根的霍恩贝格家族墓地。

en: Rudolf III of Hohenberg (died 1389) was a Swabian count of Hohenberg and lord of Rotenburg, succeeding his father Rudolf II around 1336. His house had a royal link: Gertrud of Hohenberg was the wife of King Rudolf of Habsburg. Rudolf III married Ida of Toggenburg, who bore him a daughter, Margarethe, but no son, and he was deep in debt. On 26 October 1381 he sold the entire county of Hohenberg for 66000 gold gulden to Duke Leopold III of Austria, a great-grandson of that royal pair, and comital rule in his line ended. He died before 30 November 1389, the last male of the Hohenberg-Rotenburg branch.
zh: 鲁道夫三世（？—1389）是施瓦本的霍恩贝格伯爵、罗滕堡领主，约1336年继承父亲鲁道夫二世。他的家族与王室有渊源：霍恩贝格的格特鲁德是哈布斯堡的鲁道夫国王之妻。鲁道夫三世娶托根堡的伊达，只得一女玛格丽特，没有儿子，又债台高筑。1381年10月26日，他以66000金古尔登把整个霍恩贝格伯国卖给奥地利公爵利奥波德三世，而利奥波德正是那对王室夫妇的曾孙，这一支的伯爵统治就此终结。他于1389年11月30日前去世，是霍恩贝格-罗滕堡支系最后一位男性成员。

en: Ursula of Pfirt was the daughter of Count Ulrich III of Pfirt and Joanna of Burgundy, and a younger sister of Joanna of Pfirt, wife of Duke Albert II of Austria. Ursula married Count Hugo I of Hohenberg-Rotenburg and later Count William of Montfort-Bregenz.
zh: 普菲尔特的乌尔苏拉是普菲尔特伯爵乌尔里希三世与勃艮第的约翰娜之女，奥地利公爵阿尔布雷希特二世之妻、普菲尔特的约翰娜的妹妹。她先嫁霍恩贝格-罗滕堡伯爵胡戈一世，后改嫁蒙福尔特-布雷根茨伯爵威廉。

en: Haniji (died 1395) was the founder and first king of Hokuzan, the northernmost of the three Ryukyu kingdoms, which he broke away from a Chūzan weakened under King Tamagusuku. One account makes him a grandson of the lord of Wakugawa, himself a son of King Eiso. Songs preserved in the Omoro Sōshi relate that Haniji destroyed the lord of Nakijin, a cousin's son, and took Nakijin Castle for himself; then in 1322 he threw off Tamagusuku's rule and called himself king of Hokuzan. He held northern Okinawa, its neighbouring islands and the southern Amami Islands. In 1383 he sent tribute to the Ming court of China. The Chūzan Seifu gives his son Min as his successor. A reign of nearly seventy years leads some scholars to think Haniji was several rulers of the same name in succession, since repeating a name across generations was common in Ryukyu.
zh: 怕尼芝（？—1395）是琉球三山时代北山王国的建立者和初代国王，他趁中山在玉城治下国力衰弱，另立北山。一种说法称他是涌川按司之孙，而涌川按司是英祖王之子。据《思草纸》中的琉歌记载，他攻灭了今归仁按司（其堂兄弟之子），夺取今归仁城；1322年他宣布脱离玉城的统治，自称北山王，领有冲绳本岛北部、附近岛屿及奄美群岛南部。1383年，他向中国明朝朝贡。据《中山世谱》记载，他死后由儿子珉继位。因在位近七十年，部分学者认为“怕尼芝”可能指数代同名的君主，当时琉球父子数代同名十分常见。

en: Ali was a Borjigid prince of the Ilkhanate, one of the sons of Ilkhan Baydu, and father of Musa, whom the Baghdad ruler Ali Padshah enthroned as a puppet Ilkhan in 1336.
zh: 阿里是伊儿汗国的孛儿只斤氏宗王，伊儿汗拜都之子，木撒之父；1336年巴格达城主阿里把木撒拥立为傀儡伊儿汗。

en: Baydu (died 4 October 1295) was the sixth Ilkhan of Persia, a grandson of Hulagu and son of Taraqai. After serving as viceroy in the Jazira, he overthrew his cousin Gaykhatu, who was strangled on 21 March 1295, and was enthroned at Tabriz. An easygoing ruler sympathetic to Christianity, he wore a cross and allowed churches in his ordo while the victorious amirs partitioned the realm. Arghun's son Ghazan, backed by Amir Nawruz, then revolted from Khorasan; Baydu's army melted away, he was caught near Nakhchivan and executed on 4 October 1295, after a seven-month reign.
zh: 拜都（？—1295年10月4日）是伊儿汗国第六任君主，旭烈兀之孙、塔剌海之子，早年曾任贾吉拉总督。1295年3月21日，他推翻堂兄弟海合都（海合都被弓弦勒死），在大不里士即位。拜都性情温和、易于摆布，本人同情基督教，佩戴十字架，允许在自己的斡耳朵内设置礼拜堂，而国土尽被参与政变的异密瓜分。阿鲁浑之子合赞在异密捏兀鲁思支持下从呼罗珊举兵，拜都的军队纷纷倒戈；他逃往格鲁吉亚途中在纳希切万附近被俘，1295年10月4日被处死，在位仅约七个月。

en: Musa Khan was a Borjigid prince and a grandson of Ilkhan Baydu. In April 1336 his patron Ali Padshah, ruler of Baghdad, defeated Ilkhan Arpa Ke'un at the Battle of Jaghatu near Maraghe; Arpa was soon captured and killed at Soltaniyeh, and Musa was enthroned as a figurehead Ilkhan. Within months the Jalayirid leader Hasan Buzurg defeated Ali Padshah and Musa at Qara Darra near Van; Ali was executed and Musa fled. In June 1337 he joined the rival claimant Togha Temür and reoccupied Soltaniyeh, but Emir Qara Hasan captured and killed him on 10 July 1337.
zh: 木撒是孛儿只斤氏宗王，伊儿汗拜都之孙。1336年4月，拥立他的巴格达城主阿里在马拉盖附近的察哈图之战中击败伊儿汗阿儿巴；阿儿巴不久在苏丹尼耶被擒杀，木撒随后被扶立为伊儿汗，实为阿里的傀儡。数月后，札剌亦儿部首领大哈散在凡城附近的喀拉·达拉击败阿里与木撒，阿里被处死，木撒出逃。1337年6月，他投奔争位者脱合帖木儿，合兵再占苏丹尼耶，却被异密哈喇·哈散擒获，于1337年7月10日被杀。

en: Taraqai was a Borjigid prince, the fifth son of Ilkhan Hulagu and father of the future Ilkhan Baydu. He was killed by lightning travelling from Mongolia to Iran; his widow and the young Baydu reached the Ilkhanate only in 1269, with Qutui Khatun's camp.
zh: 塔剌海是蒙古孛儿只斤氏宗王，伊儿汗旭烈兀的第五子，后来的伊儿汗拜都之父。他在从蒙古前往伊朗的途中遭雷击身亡，他的遗孀与年幼的拜都直到1269年才随忽推哈敦的斡耳朵抵达伊儿汗国。

en: Ahmad was a son of Rumaythah ibn Abi Numayy, the Sharif and Emir of Mecca, and a brother of Thaqabah and Ajlan, who each later ruled Mecca as emir.
zh: 艾哈迈德是麦加谢里夫兼埃米尔鲁迈塞·伊本·艾比·努迈伊之子，也是后来相继担任麦加埃米尔的塞盖拜与阿吉兰的兄弟。

en: Adelaide of Nassau (c. 1311 – 8 August 1344), born in Wiesbaden, was a countess of the Walram line of the House of Nassau, the daughter of Count Gerlach I of Nassau and Agnes of Hesse. In or after 1327 she married Ulrich III, who became Lord of Hanau in 1346. She bore him at least five children, including his heir Ulrich IV and Elisabeth, who married Count William II of Katzenelnbogen. Adelaide died on 8 August 1344 and was buried in Arnsburg Abbey, where her gravestone survives.
zh: 拿骚的阿德莱德（约1311—1344年8月8日）生于威斯巴登，属拿骚家族瓦尔拉姆支系，是拿骚伯爵格拉赫一世与黑森的阿格尼丝之女。1327年或稍后，她嫁给乌尔里希三世，后者于1346年成为哈瑙领主。她至少育有五名子女，包括继承人乌尔里希四世和嫁给卡岑埃尔恩博根伯爵威廉二世的伊丽莎白。阿德莱德于1344年8月8日去世，葬于阿恩斯堡修道院，墓碑留存。

en: Agnes of Hanau was a daughter of Lord Ulrich III of Hanau and Adelaide of Nassau. She is documented in 1346 as a nun at Klarenthal Abbey, the Poor Clares' monastery in Wiesbaden.
zh: 哈瑙的阿格尼丝是哈瑙领主乌尔里希三世与拿骚的阿德尔海德之女，1346年的文献记载她是威斯巴登克拉伦塔尔修道院的贫穷修女会修女。

en: Agnes of Hohenlohe (before 1295 – 29 November 1346) was the daughter of Kraft I of Hohenlohe-Weikersheim. In 1310 she married Ulrich II, Lord of Hanau, and bore him ten children. Her eldest son Ulrich III succeeded as Lord of Hanau, while another son, Conrad, became prince-abbot of Fulda before he was killed in 1383. Her daughters married into the comital families of Falkenstein and Isenburg or entered convents at Patershausen and Gerlachsheim. Agnes died on 29 November 1346.
zh: 霍恩洛厄的阿格内丝（1295年前—1346年11月29日）是霍恩洛厄-魏克斯海姆的克拉夫特一世之女。1310年，她嫁给哈瑙领主乌尔里希二世，为他生下十名子女。长子乌尔里希三世继位为哈瑙领主；另一子康拉德曾任富尔达亲王修道院长，1383年被杀。她的女儿们或嫁入法尔肯施泰因和伊森堡伯爵家族，或进入帕特斯豪森与格拉克斯海姆修院。阿格内丝于1346年11月29日去世。

en: Anna of Hanau was a daughter of Ulrich III, Lord of Hanau, and Adelaide of Nassau. She is recorded in 1396 as abbess of the Cistercian nunnery of Patershausen, near Heusenstamm in the Wetterau.
zh: 哈瑙的安娜是哈瑙领主乌尔里希三世与拿骚的阿德莱德之女。1396年的记载中，她任韦特劳地区霍伊森施塔姆附近帕特斯豪森西多会女修院院长。

en: Elisabeth of Hanau (born 1335–1340, died after 1396) was a daughter of Lord Ulrich III and Adelaide of Nassau. On 22 June 1355 she was betrothed to Count William II of Katzenelnbogen, marrying him soon after. He secured her morning gift of 4000 Frankfurt guilders on the town and castle of Zwingenberg, while her father gave as dowry his one-sixth share of Tannenberg Castle and revenues from Schaafheim. The marriage was childless; William died before 23 October 1385, and Elisabeth is last recorded alive on 2 October 1396.
zh: 哈瑙的伊丽莎白（1335—1340年间生，1396年后卒）是哈瑙领主乌尔里希三世与拿骚的阿德尔海德之女。1355年6月22日，她与卡岑埃尔恩博根伯爵威廉二世订婚，随后不久成婚。丈夫把山麓茨温根贝格的城镇与城堡抵押给她，作为4000法兰克福盾的晨礼；她的父亲则以坦嫩贝格城堡六分之一的份额和沙夫海姆村的收入作为嫁妆。二人没有子女；威廉于1385年10月23日前去世，伊丽莎白最后一次见于记载是1396年10月2日。

en: Elisabeth von Rieneck (c. 1260 – c. 1300) was the daughter of Count Louis III of Rieneck. The peace of 1271, which ended the long conflict between the Archbishops of Mainz and the Counts of Rieneck over the western Spessart, stipulated her marriage to Ulrich I of Hanau. Betrothed on 2 October 1272 while both were still children, they were to marry six years later. Her rich dowry, including the town of Steinau an der Straße, greatly strengthened the young Lordship of Hanau. Her son Ulrich II later succeeded as lord, and she was buried at Arnsburg Abbey.
zh: 伊丽莎白·冯·林埃克（约1260—约1300）是林埃克伯爵路易三世之女。美因茨大主教与林埃克伯爵为争夺西斯佩萨特长期交战，1271年的和约规定她嫁给哈瑙领主赖因哈德一世的长子乌尔里希。1272年10月2日她与乌尔里希订婚，当时两人都还是孩子，婚礼原定六年后举行。她的嫁妆丰厚，包括施泰瑙安德施特拉瑟城，大大增强了新兴哈瑙领地的实力。她的儿子乌尔里希二世后来继位，她本人葬于阿恩斯堡修道院。

en: Reinhard of Hanau (born between 1330 and 1340, died after 1400) was a younger son of Lord Ulrich III of Hanau and Adelaide of Nassau. Because Hanau followed primogeniture, his elder brother Ulrich IV inherited the lordship and Reinhard was steered into the Church. He became rector of the church at Wertheim in 1386, studied at Bologna in 1387, and served as archdeacon and canon of Würzburg Cathedral from 1387 and as a canon of Mainz from 1389. In 1400 he exchanged his Würzburg canonry and archdiaconate with members of the Schwarzburg family, the last year he is documented alive.
zh: 赖因哈德·冯·哈瑙（1330至1340年间生，1400年后卒）是哈瑙领主乌尔里希三世与拿骚的阿德尔海德较年幼的儿子之一。由于哈瑙实行长子继承制，领主权归兄长乌尔里希四世，赖因哈德被安排走教会之路。他1386年任韦尔特海姆教堂教区长，1387年赴博洛尼亚求学，同年成为维尔茨堡大教堂的执事长和教士会成员，1389年又任美因茨大教堂教士会成员。1400年，他把维尔茨堡的教士职位与执事长职和施瓦茨堡家族的成员交换，这也是文献中最后一次记载他在世。

en: Ulrich I (c. 1255/1260 – late 1305 or early 1306) was Lord of Hanau from 1281, when he succeeded his father Reinhard I. Through his mother Adelheid of Münzenberg he inherited a sixth share of the wealthy Münzenberg inheritance, the disputes over which were largely settled in 1288. In 1292 his feud with the Archbishop of Mainz over the Bachgau ended in defeat and imprisonment at Bingen. A loyal follower of the kings of Germany, he campaigned in their armies and was appointed Landvogt of the Wetterau in 1300. King Albert granted Hanau its city charter in 1303.
zh: 乌尔里希一世（约1255/1260—1305年末或1306年初）自1281年父亲赖因哈德一世去世后担任哈瑙领主。他凭借母亲阿德尔海德·冯·明岑贝格的身份，继承了富饶的明岑贝格遗产的六分之一，相关继承纠纷于1288年基本了结。1292年，他因巴赫高地区与美因茨大主教结仇交战，兵败被俘于宾根。他是德意志国王的忠实追随者，多次随军出征，1300年被任命为韦特劳的地方长官。1303年，国王阿尔布雷希特向哈瑙颁发城市特许状。

en: Ulrich II (c. 1288–1346) was Lord of Hanau from 1305/1306. In 1310 he campaigned with King John of Bohemia, and in 1314 he attended Emperor Louis IV's election in Frankfurt, afterwards helping to pacify the Wetterau by settling noble feuds in courts. He enlarged his lordship by buying judicial rights over Brandenstein and half those over Schlüchtern in 1316, holding Bornheimerberg as an imperial mortgage from 1320, and gaining extensive Rieneck lands after an inheritance dispute following the death of his uncle Count Louis V in 1333. In 1339 he decreed primogeniture in Hanau, among the earliest such laws in Germany. He died on 23 September 1346.
zh: 乌尔里希二世（约1288—1346）自1305/1306年起担任哈瑙领主。1310年他随波希米亚国王约翰出征，1314年在法兰克福出席皇帝路易四世的选举，此后推动以法庭而非私战解决韦特劳贵族的纠纷。他不断扩张领地：1316年购得布兰登施泰因的司法权及施吕希滕一半司法权，1320年起以帝国抵押的形式领有博恩海默贝格，1333年舅父路易五世伯爵死后又在继承争议中取得大片林埃克领地。1339年，他在哈瑙颁布长子继承法，是德国最早的同类法令之一。他于1346年9月23日去世。

en: Ulrich III (c. 1310–1369/1370) was Lord of Hanau from 1346 and imperial governor in the Wetterau. He lent to Emperor Charles IV and in 1349 received the Frankfurt Schultheiß office as security, adding the Frankfurt City Forest office in 1360; with Bornheimerberg these posts encircled the city, whose guild disputes he mediated from 1358. He took Schelmenburg Castle in 1354, sat at the Metz and Nuremberg diets of 1356 that issued the Golden Bull, and in 1368 gained minting rights for Babenhausen. His wife was Adelaide of Nassau, mother of his successor Ulrich IV.
zh: 乌尔里希三世（约1310—1369/1370）自1346年起任哈瑙领主，并兼任韦特劳的帝国长官。他曾向皇帝查理四世放贷，1349年取得法兰克福的地方长官职位作为抵押，1360年又获得法兰克福城市林的同一职务；加上博恩海默贝格领地，这些职位形成对法兰克福的包围，1358年起他还出面调解城中的行会纷争。1354年他夺取谢尔门堡城堡，1356年出席颁布金玺诏书的梅斯与纽伦堡帝国会议，1368年获得巴本豪森的铸币权。他的妻子是拿骚的阿德尔海德，即继承人乌尔里希四世的母亲。

en: Ulrich IV (c. 1330/1340–1380), son of Ulrich III, was Lord of Hanau from 1369/1370 and briefly governor of the Wetterau in 1371. He joined the Star League against Hesse and killed the Hessian ally Frowin of Hutten at Steinau an der Straße; Frowin's relatives captured him, and his uncle Bishop Adolph of Speyer won his release for a 7500-guilder ransom. In 1372 he sold Babenhausen to the Bohemian crown and received it back as a fief, and in 1375 he gave the Hanau primogeniture decree its final form. He died in 1380 and was buried in Arnsburg Abbey.
zh: 乌尔里希四世（约1330/1340—1380）是乌尔里希三世之子，1369/1370年起任哈瑙领主，1371年还短暂担任韦特劳长官。他加入对抗黑森的“星辰同盟”，在道路旁施泰瑙杀死黑森的盟友胡滕的弗罗温；弗罗温的亲属将他俘获，其叔父施派尔主教阿道夫出面调解，他以7500盾赎金获释。1372年他把巴本豪森卖给波希米亚王室，再以封邑形式领回；1375年他将哈瑙的长子继承法定为最终形态。他于1380年去世，葬于阿恩斯堡修道院。

en: Berthold VII of Henneberg-Schleusingen, called the Wise (1272–1340), ruled as count for fifty-six years from 1284, succeeding his father Berthold V, and rose from local count to imperial prince. In 1309 King Henry VII pledged him the imperial city of Schweinfurt and granted him rights to its imperial castle; on 25 July 1310 he raised Berthold to imperial prince at the Frankfurt Diet. In 1312 the marriage of Berthold's son Henry VIII to Jutta of Brandenburg brought the Coburg domain back to Henneberg, practically doubling his territory. He was governor of the Kingdom of Bohemia in 1313 and became one of Emperor Louis IV's most influential advisers, and from 1323 to 1330 he was guardian of Louis's eldest son, Margrave Louis of Brandenburg, and governor of the Mark. He died at Schleusingen on 13 April 1340, and Henry VIII succeeded him.
zh: 亨讷贝格-施莱辛根伯爵贝特霍尔德七世（1272—1340），人称“智者”，1284年继承父亲贝特霍尔德五世，在位五十六年，由地方伯爵升为帝国王侯。1309年，国王亨利七世把帝国城市施韦因富特抵押给他，并授予他当地帝国城堡的权利；1310年7月25日，又在法兰克福帝国会议上将他升为帝国王侯。1312年，他借儿子亨利八世与勃兰登堡的尤塔联姻，使科堡领地重归亨讷贝格家族，领地实际上扩大了近一倍。他于1313年出任波希米亚王国摄政，后来成为皇帝路易四世最有影响的顾问之一，并在1323—1330年担任皇帝长子、勃兰登堡藩侯路易的监护人和勃兰登堡摄政。1340年4月13日他卒于施莱辛根，亨利八世继位。

en: Henry VIII of Henneberg (c. 1288 – 10 September 1347) succeeded his father Berthold VII the Wise as Count of Henneberg-Schleusingen in 1340, and was the count in whose time the house ran short of sons. In 1312 his marriage to Jutta of Brandenburg, arranged by his father's marriage policy, restored the Coburg domain to Henneberg, practically doubling its territory. But the marriage produced only surviving daughters. In 1339 his younger brother John explicitly reserved his right to inherit the county, and in 1340 Emperor Louis IV confirmed it. Shortly before his death in 1347 Henry settled the succession. The southern New Lordship, much of which Jutta had brought as her dowry, went to his widow and his three unprovided daughters, while the old northern Henneberg lands passed to John I, so the county that Berthold had enlarged was split again.
zh: 亨讷贝格的亨利八世（约1288—1347年9月10日）于1340年继承父亲“智者”贝特霍尔德七世，任亨讷贝格-施莱辛根伯爵，在他任内，这个家族的男嗣不足。1312年，他与勃兰登堡的尤塔结婚，这桩联姻出自父亲的联姻策略，使科堡领地重归亨讷贝格，领地实际上扩大了近一倍。但夫妻二人只有存活下来的女儿。1339年，弟弟约翰明确保留了对伯国的继承权，皇帝路易四世于1340年确认了这一权利。1347年临终前，亨利安排继承事宜：南部的“新领地”大部分是尤塔的嫁妆，分给遗孀和三个尚未安顿的女儿，北部古老的亨讷贝格土地则传给约翰一世，贝特霍尔德扩大起来的伯国就此再度分裂。

en: John I of Henneberg-Schleusingen (1289 – 2 May 1359) was a younger son of Berthold VII the Wise. Years in his father's retinue gave him contacts at the Brandenburg and Danish courts, and in 1334 he negotiated the release of Prince Otto, captured after the battle of Viborg, though on terms so heavy that the Danes resented him. When his brother Henry VIII died in 1347 leaving only daughters, John inherited the reduced northern part of the county, which left him weak against the bishopric of Würzburg, the old Henneberg rival. In 1348 he took the Würzburg burgraviate, held by the Hennebergs since 1157, from Bishop Albert II as a fief, together with the hereditary marshal's office. In 1349 he married Elisabeth of Leuchtenberg, and in 1356 Charles IV named him imperial councillor at the Nuremberg Diet. Debts and his own extravagance forced him to pawn castles and towns throughout his reign, among them three castles to Fulda in 1350.
zh: 约翰一世（1289—1359年5月2日）是“智者”贝特霍尔德七世较年幼的儿子。他早年多随侍父亲，因此在勃兰登堡和丹麦宫廷都有门路；1334年，他通过谈判促成奥托王子获释，王子在维堡之战后被俘，但条件十分苛刻，丹麦人因此怨恨他。1347年兄长亨利八世去世且只留下女儿后，约翰继承了缩小的北部领地，面对老对手维尔茨堡主教区时处境虚弱。1348年，他从主教阿尔布雷希特二世手中以封臣身份领回亨讷贝格家族自1157年起掌有的维尔茨堡城堡伯爵职，并获得世袭元帅职。1349年他娶洛伊希滕贝格的伊丽莎白为妻；1356年，查理四世在纽伦堡帝国会议上任命他为皇帝顾问。债务加上他自己的挥霍，使他在位期间不断抵押城堡和城镇，1350年就把三座城堡抵押给了富尔达修道院。

en: Jamal al-Din Muhammad was the Nawayath Muslim sultan of Hunnur, modern Honnavar on the Kanara coast, and son of the merchant-founder Hasan Nakhuda. His fleet made him a coastal power to whom the king of Malabar paid annual tribute, and he threatened the Alupa ruler so directly that in 1338 the Hoysala king Vira Ballala III stationed an army at Barkur against him. About 1340 he accepted the suzerainty of Harihara of Gersoppa. When Ibn Battuta visited in 1343, he sailed with Jamal al-Din's fleet of 52 ships that captured Sindapur, before a counter-attack in 1344 clouded the sultanate's fate.
zh: 贾迈勒·丁·穆罕默德是霍努尔（今卡纳拉海岸的霍纳沃尔）的纳瓦亚特穆斯林苏丹，商人建国者哈桑·纳胡达之子。他以海军实力著称，马拉巴尔国王每年向他纳贡；他对阿卢帕统治者的威胁如此直接，以至1338年曷萨拉国王维拉·巴拉拉三世在巴尔库尔驻军防备。约1340年，他臣服于格尔索帕的哈里哈拉。1343年伊本·白图泰到访时，随他那支由52艘船组成的舰队攻占了辛达普尔；1344年对方发动反攻，此后苏丹国的命运便不得而知。

en: Tradition calls him Shah Khan, or Ayasho I, the founder of the Ayasho dynasty of Hunza. He was a grandson of the earlier ruler Shah Thum, and the vizier Chosay Boto brought him back from Afghanistan to Hunza. There he married Nur Bibi, daughter of the Girkis ruler Sahib Khan, whom the Hunza people had raised to the throne after her father was killed while hunting in Nagar. Through this marriage Ayasho took power and founded the line that, by Hunza tradition, ruled the valley from 874 until 1974, its rulers bearing the Burushaski title of Thum.
zh: 相传他名叫沙阿·汗，又称阿亚绍一世，是罕萨阿亚朔王朝的建立者。他是前代统治者沙阿·图姆之孙，由维齐尔乔赛·博托从阿富汗接回罕萨。他娶了吉尔基斯家族萨希卜·汗之女努尔·比毗；萨希卜·汗在讷格尔狩猎时遇害，罕萨人便拥立努尔·比毗继位。阿亚绍借这桩婚姻取得政权，开创了阿亚朔王统；按罕萨传说，该王统自874年起统治河谷，直至1974年，君主使用布鲁夏斯基语称号“图姆”。

en: Nur Bibi was, in Burusho tradition, the daughter of Sahib Khan, called Girkis, the last ruler of Hunza's Girkis line. When her father was lured to a hunt in neighbouring Nagar and killed, the Hunza people placed her on the throne with the title Thum. She then married Shah Khan, a prince of the old ruling house whom the vizier Chosay Boto had fetched from Afghanistan. Their marriage founded the Ayasho dynasty, which by tradition ruled Hunza from 874 until the end of the state in 1974.
zh: 按布鲁绍人的传说，努尔·比毗是罕萨吉尔基斯王统末代统治者萨希卜·汗（人称吉尔基斯）之女。她父亲被诱到邻近的讷格尔狩猎并遇害后，罕萨人拥立她登上以“图姆”为号的王位。后来她嫁给沙阿·汗，即维齐尔乔赛·博托从阿富汗接回的旧王族后裔。两人的结合开创了阿亚朔王朝；按传说，该王朝自874年起统治罕萨，直至1974年王国终结。

en: Burkhard I (died 1061), lord of Zollern in Swabia, is the first reliably documented member of the Hohenzollern dynasty. The annals of the Reichenau monk Berthold record that in 1061 a Burchardus and a Wezil de Zolorin were killed, apparently in a feud. His father may have been Frederick, a count in the Sülichgau around Tübingen, and his mother Irmentrud, daughter of Count Burkhard of Nellenburg. The next documented Zollern was Count Frederick I, probably his son or grandson and ancestor of the later Prussian kings.
zh: 布尔夏德一世（？—1061）是士瓦本的措伦领主，也是霍亨索伦家族第一位有可靠文献记载的成员。赖谢瑙修道院修士贝尔托德的编年史记载，1061年有“措伦的布尔夏德”和“措伦的韦齐尔”二人被杀，大约死于一场世仇。其父可能是图宾根一带叙利希高的伯爵腓特烈，母亲疑为内伦堡伯爵布尔夏德之女伊尔门特鲁德。下一位有文献可考的措伦伯爵腓特烈一世大概是他的儿子或孙子。
