en: Frederick I, Count of Zollern, nicknamed Maute, was a powerful Swabian count and a loyal supporter of Emperor Henry V. A son or grandson of Count Burkhard I, he married Udilhild of Urach and fathered at least eight children; his eldest son succeeded him as Frederick II, while a younger son, Burkhard, founded the Zollern-Hohenberg line that lasted until 1486. Frederick was the first advocate of Alpirsbach Abbey, founded by Adalbert of Zollern and other lords. The abbey's documents did not give Frederick his family name. Henry V sent him on a diplomatic mission to France, and he accompanied the emperor's Italian expedition of 1110–1111 to claim the imperial crown in Rome. He died before 1125.
zh: 索伦伯爵腓特烈一世绰号“毛特”，是势力强大的施瓦本伯爵，也是皇帝亨利五世的忠实追随者。他是布尔夏德一世之子或孙，娶乌拉赫的乌迪尔希尔德为妻，至少有八个子女；长子继位为腓特烈二世，较年幼的儿子布尔夏德则开创了延续至1486年的索伦-霍恩贝格支系。腓特烈是阿尔皮尔斯巴赫修道院的首任护院官，该院由索伦的阿达尔贝特等领主创立。修道院文书记载腓特烈时没有使用他的家族名。亨利五世曾派他出使法国，他还随皇帝参加1110—1111年为在罗马加冕而进行的意大利远征。他于1125年前去世。

en: Frederick II, Count of Zollern (died 1142 or after 1145), was the eldest son of Frederick I and Udilhild of Urach, succeeding his father around 1125. He backed Emperor Lothar III against the Hohenstaufen from 1125 until Lothar's death in 1137, then after 1138 supported the Hohenstaufen king Conrad III against the Welfs. During his rule the Zollern counts enlarged their allodial lands and castles in southwestern Germany, reaching the Rhine and upper Danube and adding holdings in Alsace and along the Neckar. He fell in battle, and his son became Burgrave Frederick I of Nuremberg.
zh: 索伦伯爵腓特烈二世（卒于1142年或1145年后）是腓特烈一世与乌拉赫的乌迪尔希尔德的长子，约1125年继承父位。1125年至皇帝洛塔尔三世1137年去世，他支持洛塔尔三世对抗霍亨斯陶芬家族；1138年后转而支持霍亨斯陶芬家族的国王康拉德三世对抗韦尔夫家族。他统治期间，索伦伯爵扩充了在德意志西南部的自主地产和城堡，势力远达莱茵河与多瑙河上游，并在阿尔萨斯和内卡河畔取得领地。他后来战死，其子成为纽伦堡城堡伯爵腓特烈一世。

en: Frederick IV of Zollern (c. 1188–c. 1255), also numbered Frederick II as Burgrave of Nuremberg, was a son of Frederick I of Nuremberg-Zollern and Sophia of Raabs, and the younger brother of Conrad I. After his father's death around 1204 he succeeded as Burgrave of Nuremberg. In 1218 the brothers divided their inheritance: Conrad took the Franconian lands and the Nuremberg burgraviate, while Frederick received the ancestral County of Zollern in Swabia, becoming the founder of the Swabian line of the House of Hohenzollern. He was succeeded by his son Frederick V.
zh: 索伦伯爵腓特烈四世（约1188—约1255），在纽伦堡城伯序列中又称腓特烈二世，是纽伦堡-索伦的腓特烈一世与拉布斯的索菲亚之子、康拉德一世之弟。约1204年父亲去世后，他继任纽伦堡城伯。1218年兄弟俩瓜分遗产：康拉德取得法兰克尼亚领地和纽伦堡城伯之位，腓特烈获得位于施瓦本的祖产索伦伯国，由此成为霍亨索伦家族施瓦本支系的始祖。他去世后由其子腓特烈五世继位。

en: Frederick IX of Hohenzollern, called the Old or the Black Count, was the second son of Count Frederick VIII. In 1339 he succeeded his elder brother Fritzli II as Count of Hohenzollern and ruled until his death between 1377 and 1379. In 1341 he married Adelheid of Hohenberg-Wildenberg. In 1342 he made a treaty of agnatic seniority with the Zollern-Schalksburg line, under which the senior of the two counts decided who would inherit the original Zollern fief. Commanding the larger force, he became a captain of the Lion League, an important association of Swabian nobles. In 1344 he divided the lands with his younger brother Frederick of Strasbourg and founded the Black Count line. It died out in 1412 with his son Frederick X, and the Strasbourg line inherited the county, later producing the princes of Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen and Hohenzollern-Hechingen.
zh: 霍亨索伦伯爵腓特烈九世，人称“老者”或“黑伯爵”，是伯爵腓特烈八世的次子。1339年他继兄长弗里茨利二世成为霍亨索伦伯爵，直至1377年至1379年间去世。1341年，他迎娶霍恩贝格-维尔登贝格的阿德尔海德。1342年，他与索伦-沙尔克堡支系签订宗亲长幼继承协定，由两支伯爵中年长者决定索伦原封地的继承人。他统率的兵力更强，因而出任施瓦本贵族的重要联盟“狮子同盟”的统领之一。1344年，他与弟弟斯特拉斯堡的腓特烈分割领地，开创“黑伯爵”支系。该支系于1412年随其子腓特烈十世去世而断绝，伯爵领由斯特拉斯堡支系继承，这一支后来分出霍亨索伦-西格马林根与霍亨索伦-黑兴根两家侯爵。

en: Frederick V of Zollern succeeded his father Frederick IV as Count of Zollern around 1255 and died at Hohenzollern Castle on 24 May 1289. As reeve of Beuron Archabbey he founded Stetten Abbey in Gnadental in 1259, and with his wife Udilhild of Dillingen, whom he had married in 1258, expanded it in 1267 with a crypt for the Zollern family. His long feud with the Counts of Hohenberg ended through the mediation of King Rudolf I in 1286. The County of Zollern reached its greatest influence under him, and after his death was partitioned among his sons and lost importance. His son Frederick of Merkenberg founded the Schalksburg line, while Udilhild outlived her husband and died as a nun at Stetten.
zh: 索伦伯爵腓特烈五世约1255年继承父亲腓特烈四世之位，1289年5月24日卒于霍亨索伦城堡。他担任博伊隆修道院的行政官，于1259年在格纳登塔尔创立施泰滕修道院；1258年他迎娶迪林根的乌迪尔希德，夫妇二人于1267年扩建修道院，增建索伦家族墓室。他与霍恩贝格伯爵家族长期争斗，1286年经德意志国王鲁道夫一世调解和解。在他治下索伦伯国势力达到顶峰，他死后伯国被诸子瓜分，影响力随之下降。他的儿子梅尔肯贝格的腓特烈开创了沙尔克堡支系，而乌迪尔希德在丈夫去世后于施泰滕修道院出家，终老于此。

en: Frederick VI of Zollern, called the Knight, succeeded his father Frederick V as Count of Zollern around 1289 and died on 4 May 1298. In the year of his succession he divided the family lands with his younger brother Frederick the Younger, who received the lordships of Schalksburg and Mühlheim and founded a cadet line, while Frederick kept the ancestral county around Hohenzollern Castle. In 1281 he married Kunigunde, daughter of Margrave Rudolf I of Baden, and in 1296 he sold estates to Bebenhausen Abbey. His son Frederick VII succeeded him.
zh: 索伦伯爵腓特烈六世，人称“骑士”，约1289年继承父亲腓特烈五世之位，1298年5月4日去世。继位同年，他与弟弟“小腓特烈”瓜分家族领地：弟弟得到沙尔克堡和米尔海姆领地，另立支系；腓特烈六世保留霍亨索伦城堡周围的祖传伯国。1281年，他迎娶巴登藩侯鲁道夫一世之女库妮贡德；1296年，他把部分地产出售给贝本豪森修道院。他死后由儿子腓特烈七世继位。

en: Frederick VII of Zollern was the elder son of Count Frederick VI and Kunigunde, daughter of Margrave Rudolf I of Baden, and ruled the County of Zollern from 1298 until his death. Also in 1298 he married Euphemia, daughter of Count Albert II of Hohenberg; the match, promoted by King Rudolf I, ended the long rivalry between the Swabian comital houses of Zollern and Hohenberg. He and Euphemia had two sons, Fritzli and Albert. Frederick died after 6 October 1309, and the county passed to his younger brother Frederick VIII.
zh: 索伦伯爵腓特烈七世是伯爵腓特烈六世与巴登藩侯鲁道夫一世之女库妮贡德的长子，1298年起统治索伦伯国直至去世。同样在1298年，他迎娶霍恩贝格伯爵阿尔布雷希特二世之女尤菲米娅；这门亲事由国王鲁道夫一世亲自促成，结束了索伦与霍恩贝格两个施瓦本伯爵家族多年的敌对。他与尤菲米娅生有弗里茨利和阿尔布雷希特两个儿子。腓特烈于1309年10月6日之后去世，伯国传给弟弟腓特烈八世。

en: Frederick VIII of Zollern, called Easter Sunday (died 1333), was a count of Hohenzollern, the younger son of Count Frederick VI and Kunigunde, daughter of Margrave Rudolf I of Baden. When his elder brother Frederick VII died in 1309 he came to rule, jointly with his nephew Fritz I until the latter's death around 1313, and then alone. In the division of the lands with his brother he founded the Hohenzollern line. In the factional wars he first backed Austria and later stood with Emperor Louis IV. Letters call him cheerful and kindly, yet a resolute man of war.
zh: 腓特烈八世（？—1333），绰号“复活节”，是霍亨索伦伯爵，伯爵腓特烈六世与巴登藩侯鲁道夫一世之女库妮贡德所生的小儿子。1309年兄长腓特烈七世死后，他开始执政，先与侄子弗里茨利一世共治，约1313年侄子去世后独自统治。在与兄长分割领地时，他开创了霍亨索伦支系。在当时的党派战争中，他先支持奥地利，后来转而站在皇帝路易四世一边。旧书信说他开朗和善，却也是果决善战之人。

en: Frederick of Hohenzollern, called the Strasbourg One, was the younger son of Count Frederick VIII of Zollern. In 1333 he became a canon at Strasbourg, but in 1342 he returned to secular life and in 1343 married Margaret, daughter of Count Burchard V of Hohenberg-Wildberg. In 1344 he and his elder brother Frederick IX, the Black Count, divided their inheritance, and Frederick founded the Strasbourg line, from which the later counts and princes of Hohenzollern-Hechingen and Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen sprang. He died after 9 March 1365, before his brother, leaving a son, Frederick XI.
zh: 霍亨索伦的腓特烈绰号“斯特拉斯堡人”，是索伦伯爵腓特烈八世的幼子。1333年他成为斯特拉斯堡的法政牧师，1342年还俗，1343年娶霍恩贝格-维尔德贝格伯爵布克哈德五世之女玛格丽特。1344年，他与兄长“黑伯爵”腓特烈九世瓜分父产，开创斯特拉斯堡支系，后来的霍亨索伦-黑兴根与霍亨索伦-锡格马林根伯爵和诸侯都出自该支。他于1365年3月9日后去世，死在兄长之前，留下儿子腓特烈十一世。

en: Fritzli II, Count of Zollern, was the eldest son of Count Frederick VIII of Zollern. He succeeded his father as ruling count in 1333 but died before 16 March 1339, when his younger brother Frederick IX, the Black Count, followed him.
zh: 索伦伯爵弗里茨利二世是索伦伯爵腓特烈八世的长子。他于1333年继任为执政伯爵，1339年3月16日前去世，其弟“黑伯爵”腓特烈九世继位。

en: Gottfried, count of Zollern-Zimmern (died 1156–1160), was a son of Count Frederick I of Zollern and Udilhild of Urach.
zh: 戈特弗里德是措伦-齐门伯爵，于1156至1160年间去世，为措伦伯爵腓特烈一世与乌拉赫的乌迪尔希尔德之子。

en: Dietrich von Dalwigk (Latin Theodericus, died 1359) was a Corvey monk from a Waldeck ministerial family, admitted through the influence of King John of Bohemia. Elected prince-abbot of Corvey in 1336, he enfeoffed Count Bernard V of Lippe with part of the County of Schwalenberg in 1345 and in 1349 settled the feud over Lichtenfels Castle with Count Otto II of Waldeck. Emperor Charles IV confirmed Corvey's right to hold a vehmic court in 1349, and in 1356 he allowed Höxter to raise a triple town wall. He died in 1359 after 23 years' rule.
zh: 狄奥多里克·冯·达尔维格（拉丁语作特奥德里库斯，1359年去世）出身瓦尔德克的一个侍臣贵族家族，因波希米亚国王约翰的举荐成为科维修道院修士。1336年他当选为科维采邑修道院院长。1345年他将施瓦伦贝格伯国的一部分封给利珀伯爵伯恩哈德五世，1349年与瓦尔德克伯爵奥托二世就利希滕费尔斯城堡的争端达成和解。1349年皇帝查理四世确认科维拥有设立菲姆法庭的权利，1356年他准许赫克斯特修筑三重城墙。他统治23年后于1359年去世。

en: Ermengard of Holstein (died c. 1326), daughter of Count Henry I of Holstein-Rendsburg, married Count Otto II of Hoya. She was the mother of Gerhard III and John II, who inherited Hoya in 1324 and divided it in 1345, after her death.
zh: 荷尔斯泰因的埃尔门加德（约1326年去世）是荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡伯爵亨利一世之女，嫁给霍亚伯爵奥托二世。她是格哈德三世与约翰二世的母亲，两个儿子于1324年继承霍亚，并在她去世后的1345年将伯国瓜分。

en: Gerhard II (c. 1260 – 18 October 1312 or 1313) was count of Hoya, son of Count Henry II. Destined for the church, he was a canon at Verden from 1275 and Bremen from 1278, leaving the clergy when his elder brother died in 1279. From 1281 he ruled with his father, and after 1290 with his brother Otto II. Peaceable and on good terms with his neighbors, he encouraged trade and work in timber, clay and stone. In 1302 the brothers received Drakenburg and the Bücken vogtei from their kinsman Duke Otto of Brunswick-Lüneburg. Married twice, he died childless.
zh: 格哈德二世（约1260—1312年10月18日或1313年）是霍亚伯爵，海因里希二世之子。他自幼准备投身教会，1275年起任费尔登的法政牧师，1278年成为不来梅教区参事会成员，1279年长兄死后还俗。1281年起随父亲理政，1290年后与弟弟奥托二世共治。他性情温和，与邻邦和睦相处，在领地内鼓励贸易以及木材、黏土和石料方面的营生。1302年，兄弟二人从亲属不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵奥托手中受封德拉肯堡镇及比肯的保护权。他两次结婚，均无子女。

en: Gerhard III of Hoya (died 1383) ruled the County of Hoya from 1324, first jointly with his brother John after their father Otto II died. In 1345 the brothers divided the county, Gerhard taking the Lower County around Hoya and John the Upper County around Nienburg. His long reign was spent in feuds: he fought the Hoya Feud of 1351–1359 against Bremen, and in 1370 joined Welf duke Magnus II Torquatus in the Lüneburg War of Succession. In 1353 he arbitrated between King Valdemar IV of Denmark and the counts of Holstein at Nyborg. He died in 1383.
zh: 霍亚的格哈德三世（1383年去世）自1324年起统治霍亚伯国：父亲奥托二世死后，他先与兄弟约翰共同执政。1345年兄弟二人瓜分伯国，格哈德取得霍亚一带的下伯国，约翰取得尼恩堡一带的上伯国。他漫长的统治充斥着封建私战：1351—1359年与不来梅等势力展开霍亚战争，1370年又投奔韦尔夫家族的公爵马格努斯二世（绰号“戴项圈者”）一方，参加吕讷堡继承战争。1353年他在尼堡调解丹麦国王瓦尔德马四世与荷尔斯泰因诸伯爵的纠纷，1383年去世。

en: Henry I (died 1235) was the first documented count of Hoya, ruling from 1202. His father, a Frisian from Rüstringen, had settled at Hoya with the Bremen archbishops' support and built a castle in the Weser. Henry bought the county of Stumpenhusen in 1202 and adopted its name and seal, expelled the lords of Hodenberg after 1206, and acquired the county of Nienburg in 1215. A Staufer partisan in the German throne conflict, he aided Archbishop Gerhard of Bremen against the Stedinger, defeating them at Hilgermissen in 1213. He was buried at Bücken and succeeded by his son Henry II.
zh: 海因里希一世（？—1235）是第一位有文献记载的霍亚伯爵，1202年起在位。他的父亲是来自吕斯特林根的弗里斯兰人，在不来梅大主教支持下定居霍亚、在威悉河中岛上筑堡。海因里希于1202年买下施图彭豪森伯国并改用其姓氏与印章，1206年起驱逐霍登贝格领主，1215年取得自由伯国尼恩堡。在德意志王位之争中他支持霍亨斯陶芬家族，并协助不来梅大主教格哈德进攻施特丁根人，1213年在希尔格米森将其击败。他葬于比肯修道院教堂，由儿子海因里希二世继位。

en: Henry II, called Henry with the Axe, was count of Hoya from 1235, when he succeeded his father Henry I, until his death on 25 January 1290. Chronicles gave him his nickname for the exceptional violence and brutality with which he waged war. He chiefly pressed south against the bishops of Minden and secured the new frontier with castles at Liebenau and Steyerberg. With Jutta of Ravensberg he is said to have fathered twenty-five legitimate children, at least eight of whom reached adulthood, including his successors Gerhard II and Otto II. He was buried at Loccum Abbey.
zh: 海因里希二世（？—1290年1月25日），绰号“持斧者”，1235年继承父亲海因里希一世成为霍亚伯爵，统治至去世。据当时编年史记载，他因作战格外凶狠残暴而得此绰号。他主要向南对付明登主教，扩张领地，并在利伯瑙和施泰尔贝格修建城堡，拱卫新边界。相传他与拉文斯贝格的尤塔育有25个婚生子女，其中至少8人长大成人，继任者格哈德二世与奥托二世都是他的儿子。他葬于洛库姆修道院。

en: Otto II (1271–1324) was count of Hoya from 1313, when he succeeded his childless elder brother Gerhard II, until his death. A younger son of Count Henry II and Jutta of Ravensberg, he married Ermengard of Holstein, daughter of Adolf VI, and had four children. During his short reign he allied with the dukes of Brunswick-Lüneburg, the archbishopric of Bremen, and the counts of Oldenburg and Diepholz. It was already agreed in his lifetime that his sons Gerhard and John should divide the county, which they did in 1345.
zh: 奥托二世（1271—1324）是霍亚伯爵，1313年无子女的兄长格哈德二世死后继位，统治至1324年。他是海因里希二世与拉文斯贝格的尤塔年纪较小的儿子，娶荷尔斯泰因伯爵阿道夫六世之女埃尔门加德，育有四个子女。他在位时间不长，与不伦瑞克-吕讷堡诸公爵、不来梅大主教区以及奥尔登堡和迪普霍尔茨的伯爵们结盟。他生前已商定由儿子格哈德和约翰瓜分伯国，两人最终于1345年分家。

en: Agnes of Horne, the youngest daughter of Willem IV of Horne, became abbess of Keyserbosch, the Norbertine nunnery near Neer in Limburg that served as the family church of the lords of Horne.
zh: 霍恩的阿格内丝是霍恩的威廉四世最小的女儿，后来出任凯瑟博斯修女院院长；这座诺伯特修会修女院位于林堡的内尔附近，是霍恩诸领主的家族修道院。

en: Elizabeth of Cleves-Hülchrath (1315–1347), daughter of Dietrich Luf III, was the second wife of Willem IV of Horne. She was the mother of Willem V of Horne and of Arnold II of Horne, bishop of Utrecht and later of Liège.
zh: 克莱沃-许尔赫拉特的伊丽莎白（1315—1347）是迪特里希·卢夫三世之女、霍恩领主威廉四世的第二任妻子。她是威廉五世与阿诺德二世的母亲，阿诺德二世曾任乌得勒支主教，后任列日主教。

en: Elisabeth of Horne (1326–1360), daughter of Willem IV and Oda of Putten, married Johan II van Arkel, lord of Heukelum, on 20 November 1353. Her son Otto III succeeded as lord of Heukelum; her daughter Elisabeth married Jan V van Renesse in 1372.
zh: 霍恩的伊丽莎白（1326—1360）是霍恩的威廉四世与皮滕的奥达之女，1353年11月20日嫁给赫克勒姆领主约翰二世·范·阿尔克尔。她的儿子奥托三世后来继任赫克勒姆领主，女儿伊丽莎白则于1372年嫁给约翰五世·范·勒内瑟。

en: Gerard I van Horne (1270-1331) was a nobleman of the House of Horne and a son of William II of Horne. He held the lordships of Horne, Altena, Perwijs, Heeze and Oost-Barendrecht, buying Herlaar in 1315. In 1302 he married Johanna of Leuven-Gaasbeek, who bore his heir William IV in 1305; after her death he married Irmgard of Cleves in 1316, by whom he had Dirk of Horne. In 1318 he hosted the nobles mediating between the count of Holland and the duke of Brabant over the Land of Heusden. He was buried in the Carmelite church in Brussels.
zh: 赫拉尔德一世·范霍恩（1270—1331）是霍恩家族贵族，威廉二世·范霍恩之子。他领有霍恩、阿尔特纳、佩韦斯、海泽和东巴伦德雷赫特，1315年购入海尔拉尔。1302年他娶勒芬-哈斯贝克的约翰娜，1305年生下继承人威廉四世；丧妻后于1316年续娶克莱沃的伊尔姆加德，生子迪尔克。1318年，他接待了一批为荷兰伯爵与布拉班特公爵调停赫斯登领地争端的贵族。他死后葬于布鲁塞尔的加尔默罗会教堂。

en: Gerard II of Horne (1324–1345), son of Willem IV of Horne and Oda of Putten, was made lord of Heeze and Leende in 1342 and in 1343 succeeded his father as lord of Horne and Altena. In 1345 he joined Count William IV of Holland's invasion of Friesland as one of the seven knight bannerets of the Holland host. On 26 September 1345 he was killed, with the count, at the Battle of Warns near Stavoren, where nearly the entire invasion army was destroyed. He died unmarried, and his lordships were divided between his sister Johanna and his half-brothers.
zh: 霍恩的赫拉德二世（1324—1345）是霍恩的威廉四世与皮滕的奥达之子。1342年他受封海斯与伦德领主，1343年父亲去世后继任霍恩与阿尔特纳领主。1345年他随荷兰伯爵威廉四世远征弗里斯兰，是荷兰军中七名方旗骑士之一；9月26日，他在斯塔福伦附近的瓦恩斯战役中与伯爵一同阵亡，侵攻大军几乎全军覆没。他未婚而终，广土众领被分给姐姐乔安娜与异母诸弟。

en: Johanna of Horne (1320–1356), daughter of Willem IV of Horne and Oda of Putten, inherited the lordships of Horne, Altena, Gaasbeek, Herstal and Strijen in 1345 after her brother Gerard II fell at the Battle of Stavoren. She married Gijsbrecht III of Abcoude, lord of Abcoude and Duurstede, who governed her lands iure uxoris. Their children included Zweder and Willem of Abcoude. In 1353 she granted Herstal to her eldest son Zweder, and on her death in 1356 the rest of her domains followed, though her half-siblings challenged the succession until arbitration in 1357.
zh: 霍恩的乔安娜（1320—1356）是霍恩的威廉四世与皮滕的奥达之女。1345年其兄赫拉德二世在斯塔福伦战役中阵亡，她由此继承霍恩、阿尔特纳、加斯贝克、埃斯塔勒和斯特里恩等领地。她嫁给阿布考德与迪尔斯泰德领主海斯布雷赫特三世·范·阿布考德，后者以妻权代管她的领地，子女包括兹韦德与威廉。1353年她把埃斯塔勒封给长子兹韦德，1356年去世后其余领地也归其继承，但她的异母弟妹起而争夺，直至1357年仲裁方才了结。

en: Oda of Horne (1318–1353) was a daughter of Willem IV of Horne and Oda of Putten. In 1340 she married John II, Lord of Polanen, Lek and Breda, a leading Holland nobleman, and bore him three children, including his heir John III and Beatrice.
zh: 霍恩的奥达（1318—1353）是霍恩的威廉四世与皮滕的奥达之女，1340年嫁给荷兰显贵、波拉嫩、莱克与布雷达领主约翰二世，育有三个子女，包括继承人约翰三世和贝阿特丽斯。

en: Oda of Putten (1295-1332), lady of Putten and Strijen, was the daughter of Nicholas III, lord of Putten, and Aleida of Strijen. In 1315 she married William IV of Horne and bore him his heir Gerard II and daughters including Joanna of Horne.
zh: 奥达·范皮滕（1295—约1332）是皮滕与斯特赖恩的女领主，皮滕领主尼古拉三世与斯特赖恩的阿莱达之女。1315年她嫁给威廉四世·范霍恩，生下继承人赫拉尔德二世以及约翰娜等女儿。

en: Willem IV of Horne (c. 1302–1343), son of Gerard I, was lord of Horne, Altena, Weert and Heeze. He took charge of Altena in 1321, but the count of Kleve refused to invest him, favouring his half-brother Dirk; Count William III of Holland guaranteed his position in 1327. He married Oda of Putten by 1316 and Elisabeth of Kleve-Hülchrath in 1336, with eleven children. He joined Holland, Brabant and Flanders on the commission that cleared Rainald II of Guelders of plotting to poison the French royal family, granted Heeze to Gerard II in 1342 and died in 1343.
zh: 霍恩的威廉四世（约1302—1343）是赫拉德一世之子，领有霍恩、阿尔特纳、韦尔特、海斯等地。1321年他接掌阿尔特纳，但克莱沃伯爵拒绝向他正式授封，改属意其异母弟德里克；1327年荷兰伯爵威廉三世出面保证他对该地的占有。他于1316年前娶皮滕的奥达，1336年续娶克莱沃-许尔克拉特的伊丽莎白，共育有十一名子女。他与荷兰、布拉班特、佛兰德共同参加调查委员会，为海尔德的雷诺二世洗清图谋毒杀法国王室的罪名；1342年他把海斯封给赫拉德二世，1343年去世。

en: Willem V of Horne (c. 1337–1357) was the eldest son of Willem IV of Horne by Elisabeth of Kleve-Hülchrath. After his half-brother Gerard II fell at Warns in 1345, his uncle Dirk of Perwez secured him the lordships of Horne, Kortessem and Weert as fifth lord of Horne, while his half-sister Johanna and her husband Gijsbrecht of Abcoude took the Brabant lands. The fief of Altena was granted to him by Holland in 1347. In 1349 he married Machteld, daughter of John IV of Arkel, and was dead by April 1357, when Altena passed to his brother Dirk Loef.
zh: 霍恩的威廉五世（约1337—1357）是霍恩的威廉四世与克莱沃-许尔克拉特的伊丽莎白的长子。1345年异母兄赫拉德二世在瓦恩斯战死后，叔父佩尔韦的德里克为他争得霍恩、科特瑟姆和韦尔特等领地，使他成为第五代霍恩领主；异母姐姐乔安娜与丈夫阿布考德的海斯布雷赫特则取得布拉班特诸地。阿尔特纳封邑于1347年由荷兰封赐给他。1349年他娶阿尔克尔的约翰四世之女玛赫特尔德，至1357年4月已经去世，阿尔特纳转归其弟德里克·勒夫。

en: Ludwig II of Mansbach (c. 1280–1343), born at Mansbach in Hesse, was the forty-ninth abbot of the Imperial Abbey of Hersfeld from 1324 to his death. His rule saw the abbey's continuing decline: in 1328 he began the Schloss zu den Eichen outside the town, and that November was forced by the hostile town and convent to accept four ministeriales as guardians and to grant the city self-rule over its crafts. In 1332 he sold the abbey's valuable rights at Arnstadt to the counts of Schwarzburg, and from 1336 also headed the Johannesberg provostry. He died in Hersfeld in 1343.
zh: 曼斯巴赫的路德维希二世（约1280—1343）生于黑森的曼斯巴赫，1324年起出任黑斯费尔德帝国修道院第四十九任院长，直至去世。任内修道院持续衰落：1328年他动工在城外修建橡树堡；同年11月，在敌视他的城市与修院逼迫下，他被迫接受四名家臣担任监护，并准许城市自行管理行会事务。1332年，他把修道院在阿恩施塔特的宝贵权益卖给施瓦茨堡伯爵，1336年起又兼领约翰尼斯贝格修道院，1343年卒于黑斯费尔德。

en: Ereyanga (r. 1098–1102), son of the Hoysala king Vinayaditya, was made crown prince, or yuvaraja, in 1062 and waited more than thirty years to reign. A Jain who took the title Vira Ganga, he served the Western Chalukyas as a senior commander, helping Someshvara II crush rebellions; in their wars he is said to have burned Dhara in Malwa, ravaged Chakragotta, cowed the Cholas and defeated the king of Kalinga. His own rule lasted only four years. By Echala Devi he left three sons, Ballala, Bitti Deva and Udayaditya; Bitti Deva became King Vishnuvardhana.
zh: 埃雷扬加（1098—1102年在位）是曷萨拉国王毗那耶阿迭多之子，1062年被立为王储，等候三十余年才登基。他信奉耆那教，号称维拉·甘伽，作为高级将领为西遮娄其王朝效力，帮助索梅什瓦拉二世平定叛乱；相传他在遮娄其的战争中焚毁马尔瓦的陀罗城、蹂躏查克拉戈塔、震慑朱罗人、击败羯陵伽国王。他正式统治曷萨拉仅四年。王后埃查拉·黛薇为他生下巴拉拉、比蒂·提婆和乌达亚阿迭多三子，其中比蒂·提婆即后来的毗湿奴伐弹那。

en: Narasimha I (r. 1152–1173) succeeded his father Vishnuvardhana as Hoysala king. His great achievement was victory over his own overlord, the Western Chalukya king Tailapa III, a blow that opened the road to Hoysala independence in the next reign. He fared less well against Bijjala II, the Kalachuri feudatory who had seized the Chalukya capital Kalyani, and could not check his rise. His generals kept up the dynasty's Jain patronage, building the Bhandara Basadi at Shravanabelgola in 1159. His reign ended when his own son Veera Ballala II displaced him.
zh: 那罗辛哈一世（1152—1173年在位）继父亲毗湿奴伐弹那之后成为曷萨拉国王。他最大的武功是击败了自己的宗主西遮娄其国王泰拉帕三世，这一胜利为下一任统治者宣告曷萨拉独立铺平了道路。但他抵挡不住夺取遮娄其都城迦罗尼的迦罗珠利封臣比贾拉二世，无力遏制其崛起。他的将领延续了王朝对耆那教的护持，于1159年在什拉瓦纳贝拉戈拉建成班达拉寺。他最终被自己的儿子毗罗·巴拉拉二世推翻。

en: Narasimha III (1240–1292) ruled the Hoysala Empire from 1263, when he succeeded his father Vira Someshwara, until his death. His reign was spent at war within the family: his brother Ramanatha held the southern lands from Kannanur and disputed the crown, while around 1266 Mahadeva, the Yadava king of Devagiri, invaded deep into Hoysala territory before Narasimha defeated him and forced him to flee by night. A devotee of the Jain tirthankara Parshvanatha, he was succeeded in 1292 by his son Veera Ballala III.
zh: 那罗辛哈三世（1240—1292）于1263年继承父亲毗罗·苏梅湿婆罗之位，统治曷萨拉帝国，直至去世。他在位时连年征战：其弟罗摩纳特以卡纳努尔为据点占据南部，与他争夺王位；约1266年，德瓦吉里的雅达瓦国王摩诃提婆又大举入侵，深入曷萨拉疆土，却被那罗辛哈击败，被迫连夜逃走。他崇信耆那教祖师巴湿伐那陀，1292年去世后由其子维拉·巴拉拉三世继位。

en: Nripa Kama II ruled the early Hoysala realm from about 1026 until his death in 1047. A chief of the dynasty's Malnad hill country in Karnataka, he was possibly a vassal of the Western Ganga kings and fought repeated wars against the expanding Cholas. He kept hold over several districts in the Malnad. His son Vinayaditya succeeded him.
zh: 尼利波·迦摩二世是曷萨拉王朝早期首领，约1026年起统治，1047年去世。他起家于卡纳塔克的马尔纳德山区，可能臣属于西恒伽王朝，曾与不断扩张的朱罗王朝屡次交战。他控制着马尔纳德的若干地区。他死后由儿子毗那耶阿迭多继位。

en: Veera Ballala I (r. 1102–1108), eldest son of Ereyanga, succeeded as Hoysala king with his capital at Belur. A Jain, he subdued the restive Chengalva and Santhara chiefs of the Malnad, but his short reign was otherwise uneventful. He tried more than once to throw off the overlordship of the Western Chalukyas, only to be brought to heel by the powerful Chalukya Vikramaditya VI. On his death his younger brother Bitti Deva succeeded as Vishnuvardhana.
zh: 毗罗·巴拉拉一世（1102—1108年在位）是埃雷扬加的长子，继位为曷萨拉国王，定都贝鲁尔。他信奉耆那教，在位期间平定了马尔纳德不驯服的琴加尔瓦人和桑塔拉人，此外统治短暂而平静。他曾数次试图摆脱西遮娄其王朝的宗主权，却被强势的遮娄其国王维克拉马迪亚六世压制。他死后由幼弟比蒂·提婆继位，即毗湿奴伐弹那。

en: Veera Ballala II (r. 1173–1220), who displaced his father Narasimha I, carried the Hoysalas to the height of their power. He defeated the Yadavas of Devagiri, the Southern Kalachuris and the Pandyas of Madurai, humbled the fading Western Chalukyas and made the shrinking Cholas of Tanjore his clients; by 1200 his conquests had made the Hoysalas the strongest power in the Deccan. He married the Chola princess Cholamahadevi and gave his daughter Somaladevi to Kulothunga Chola III. His son Vira Narasimha II and queen Umadevi led his armies, while poets Janna and Rudrabhatta adorned his court.
zh: 毗罗·巴拉拉二世（1173—1220年在位）推翻父亲那罗辛哈一世自立，把曷萨拉王朝带到国力的顶峰。他先后击败德瓦吉里的雅达瓦王朝、南迦罗珠利王朝和马杜赖的潘地亚王朝，压服日趋衰微的西遮娄其，使不断收缩的坦焦尔朱罗王朝承认其宗主权；到1200年前后，曷萨拉已凭他的征服成为德干最强的势力。他娶朱罗公主朱罗玛哈黛薇为后，又把女儿索玛拉黛薇嫁给朱罗国王库洛通加三世。他的儿子毗罗·那罗辛哈二世与王后乌玛黛薇替他统军理政，詹纳、鲁德拉巴塔等卡纳达语诗人则点缀其宫廷。

en: Veera Ballala III (c. 1262–1342), son of Narasimha III, was the last great king of the Hoysala dynasty, ruling from Dwarasamudra, modern Halebidu. He warred with the Yadavas of Devagiri and the Pandyas of Madurai and intervened in the Pandya succession around 1310. In 1311 Malik Kafur, general of Alauddin Khalji of Delhi, sacked Dwarasamudra, forcing Ballala to pay tribute; a second Delhi invasion plundered the capital around 1327. He later built a new capital on the Tungabhadra. In 1342 he was defeated, captured and killed at Kannanur by the sultan of Madurai.
zh: 维拉·巴拉拉三世（约1262—1342）是那罗辛哈三世之子，曷萨拉王朝最后一位伟大国王，以德瓦拉萨穆德拉（今哈勒比德）为都。他与德瓦吉里的雅达瓦王朝、马杜赖的潘地亚王朝交战，并在约1310年插手潘地亚王位之争。1311年，德里苏丹阿拉乌德丁·卡尔吉的将领马利克·卡富尔洗劫德瓦拉萨穆德拉，迫使他纳贡称臣；约1327年德里军队再度劫掠都城。此后他在栋格珀德拉河畔另建新都。1342年，他在甘纳努尔被马杜赖苏丹击败俘杀。

en: Vinayaditya (r. 1047–1098) was a Jain king of the Hoysala dynasty and an able feudatory of the Western Chalukyas of Kalyani. From his Malnad base he brought the Kongalvas, Chengalvas, Santharas of Humcha and Kadambas of Bayalnadu under Hoysala control, and after the Western Gangas disappeared under Chola occupation he seized parts of Gangavadi. He ruled South Kanara and Mysore and was a noted builder of towns, linked by marriage to Chalukya Someshvara I. His son was Ereyanga.
zh: 毗那耶阿迭多（1047—1098年在位）是曷萨拉王朝的耆那教国王，也是迦罗尼西遮娄其王朝得力的封臣。他以马尔纳德为根基，降服孔加尔瓦人、琴加尔瓦人、胡姆查的桑塔拉人和巴亚尔纳德的迦丹巴人等地方小酋长；西恒伽王朝在朱罗占领根加瓦迪后覆亡，他乘机夺取根加瓦迪的部分土地。他统治南卡纳拉与迈索尔，以兴建城镇闻名，并与遮娄其国王索梅什瓦拉一世结为姻亲。他的儿子是埃雷扬加。

en: Vira Narasimha II (r. 1220–1234) succeeded his father Veera Ballala II as Hoysala king. He pushed Hoysala power deep into the Tamil country: he defeated the Kadavas and the Pandyas of Madurai and levied tribute on them, and he backed his ally, possibly his son-in-law, Rajaraja Chola III against Pandya raids. To watch over these southern affairs he set up a second capital at Kannanur Kuppam near Srirangam, and in a later campaign he fought for the Cholas again and marched as far south as Rameswaram. The Kannada poet Sumanobana graced his court.
zh: 毗罗·那罗辛哈二世（1220—1234年在位）继父亲毗罗·巴拉拉二世之后成为曷萨拉国王，把曷萨拉的势力深入泰米尔地区。他击败迦达瓦人和马杜赖的潘地亚人，向其征收贡赋，并支持盟友、可能是其女婿的罗阇罗阇·朱罗三世抵御潘地亚入侵。为就近掌控南方事务，他在斯里兰格姆附近的甘纳努尔·库帕姆建立第二都城；后来他再次为朱罗出战，一路南下远征至拉梅斯沃勒姆。卡纳达语诗人苏摩诺巴纳是他的宫廷诗人。

en: Vira Someshwara (c. 1190–1263) ruled the Hoysala Empire from 1234, succeeding his father Vira Narasimha II. In the Tamil country the provincial court at Kannanur Kuppam near Srirangam upheld Hoysala influence over the Chola and Pandya kings, who gave him the honorific Mamadi, meaning uncle. After his death his sons Narasimha III and Ramanatha fought one another for the kingdom.
zh: 毗罗·苏梅湿婆罗（约1190—1263）于1234年继承父亲毗罗·那罗辛哈二世的王位，统治曷萨拉帝国，都城在德瓦拉萨穆德拉。在泰米尔地区，曷萨拉以斯里兰格姆附近的卡纳努尔库帕姆为行都，保持对朱罗和潘地亚两国国王的影响，两国国王以意为“舅父”的尊称“马马迪”称呼他。他死后，诸子那罗辛哈三世与罗摩纳特为争夺王国互相攻伐。

en: Vishnuvardhana (r. 1108–1152), born Bitti Deva, took the Hoysala throne on the death of his elder brother Veera Ballala I. Originally a Jain, he won his fame against the Cholas: near Talakadu he routed the Chola general Adiyamma, recovered lost territory and took the title Talakadugonda, endowing Jain temples at Shravanabelgola and Kambadahalli. Later, influenced by Ramanuja, he turned to Vaishnavism and adopted the name Vishnuvardhana, though his queen Shantala Devi remained Jain. His victories made the Hoysalas a true kingdom, and he crowned his reign with the Chennakesava Temple at Belur and the Hoysaleswara Temple at Halebidu.
zh: 毗湿奴伐弹那（1108—1152年在位）原名比蒂·提婆，兄长毗罗·巴拉拉一世死后于1108年登上曷萨拉王位。他本为耆那教徒，靠对朱罗的战争成名：在塔拉卡杜附近击溃朱罗将领阿迪亚马，收复失地，获得“塔拉卡杜贡达”的称号，并向什拉瓦纳贝拉戈拉和坎巴达哈利的耆那教寺院广施土地。后来他受罗摩奴阇影响改奉毗湿奴派，改名毗湿奴伐弹那，而王后珊塔拉·黛薇仍信奉耆那教。他的战功使曷萨拉真正成为王国；他又大兴土木，贝鲁尔的钦纳克萨瓦神庙和哈勒比德的霍伊萨莱什瓦拉神庙都建于其在位时。

en: Al-Adil Shihab al-Din was the Ayyubid emir of Hasankeyf, ruling from 1328 to 1349 between Mujir al-Din Muhammad and as-Salih Abu Bakr Khalil.
zh: 阿迪勒·希哈卜丁是哈桑凯伊夫的阿尤布埃米尔，1328至1349年在位，前承穆吉尔丁·穆罕默德，后继者为萨利赫·阿布·贝克尔·哈利勒。

en: As-Salih Abu Bakr Khalil I was the Ayyubid emir of Hasankeyf from 1349 to 1378, after al-Adil Shihab al-Din and before Fakhr al-Din Sulayman.
zh: 萨利赫·阿布·贝克尔·哈利勒是哈桑凯伊夫的阿尤布埃米尔，1349至1378年在位，前承阿迪勒·希哈卜丁，后继者为法赫尔丁·苏莱曼。

en: Hügechi (died 1271) was the fifth son of Kublai Khan and the first Mongol prince enfeoffed in Yunnan. On 12 September 1267 he was made Prince of Yunnan with a silver seal and sent southwest to take charge of Dali, Kunming and the Gold Teeth lands, registering households, levying taxes and appointing darughachi governors. His rule angered Baoheding, the local commander of the thirty-seven tribes, who in 1271 poisoned him at a banquet. Hügechi died that night, and officials in his household accepted bribes to conceal the affair. After a secret report by his tutor Zhang Lidao reached Kublai, the emperor sent investigators and Baoheding was executed. His son Esen-Temür later became Prince of Yunnan.
zh: 忽哥赤（？—1271年）是元世祖忽必烈第五子，也是首位受封出镇云南的蒙古宗王。1267年9月12日，他被封为云南王，获赐银印，奉命出镇大理、鄯阐（今昆明）和金齿等地，编订户籍、征发赋役、设置达鲁花赤。他的到来引起大理等处三十七部宣慰都元帅宝合丁的忌恨，宝合丁于1271年在宴会上将他毒杀，他当夜身亡，王府官员又收受贿赂隐瞒其事。王府文学张立道秘密派人赴大都告发，忽必烈派断事官博罗欢等人前往审理，宝合丁最终伏诛。其子也先帖木儿后来袭封云南王。

en: Hulegu (c. 1217–8 February 1265) was a son of Tolui and Sorghaghtani Beki and a grandson of Genghis Khan. In 1253 his brother the great khan Möngke sent him west to subdue the Muslim lands. He destroyed the Nizari Assassins in 1256, was named il-khan the same year, and sacked Baghdad on 10 February 1258, killing the Abbasid caliph al-Musta'sim and ending the caliphate. He then overthrew Syria's Ayyubids and took Damascus, until Egypt's Mamluks halted the Mongol advance. His realm became the Ilkhanate of Persia, and he died in February 1265, succeeded by his son Abaqa.
zh: 旭烈兀（约1217—1265年2月8日）是拖雷与唆鲁禾帖尼之子、成吉思汗之孙，蒙哥、忽必烈之弟。1253年，其兄大汗蒙哥命他率军西征西亚诸伊斯兰国家。他于1256年攻灭阿萨辛派，同年受封伊儿汗；1258年2月10日攻陷巴格达，处死阿拔斯王朝哈里发穆斯台绥木，阿拔斯哈里发国就此灭亡。随后他攻灭叙利亚的阿尤布王朝、进占大马士革，兵锋最终被埃及的马木留克王朝遏止。他建立的国家即波斯伊儿汗国；1265年2月他病逝，其子阿八哈继位。

en: Agnes of Austria (1281–1364) was a daughter of King Albert I of Germany and Elisabeth of Tirol. On 13 February 1296 she married Andrew III of Hungary in Vienna, and with her father's backing the king put down the revolts of the Kőszegi and Csák families. Small of stature, she wore dresses her sisters had outgrown, and was praised for her modesty. Andrew's death in 1301 ended the male line of the Árpád dynasty; a contemporary, Stephen Ákos, called him its last golden twig. Agnes, a childless widow of nineteen, never remarried. She became patron of Königsfelden Monastery, founded by her mother, and lived nearby with her stepdaughter Elizabeth. Her good name made her a sought-after mediator: in 1333 she arranged a treaty between Austria and Swiss towns during the Gümmenenkrieg, and in 1351 she settled a dispute between Duke Albert II and the Swiss Confederacy. Her brothers sought her counsel at Königsfelden, where she died in 1364.
zh: 奥地利的阿格尼丝（1281—1364）是德意志国王阿尔布雷希特一世与蒂罗尔的伊丽莎白之女。1296年2月13日，她在维也纳嫁给匈牙利国王安德鲁三世，国王在岳父的支持下镇压了克塞吉家族和恰克家族的叛乱。她身材矮小，常穿姐妹们不要的旧衣裙，因朴素而受称赞。1301年安德鲁去世，阿尔帕德王朝的男性世系断绝；同时代的斯蒂芬·阿卡什称他是这个家族“最后一根金枝”。年仅十九岁、没有子女的寡后阿格尼丝再未改嫁。她资助母亲创立的柯尼希斯费尔登修道院，并与继女伊丽莎白住在附近。良好的名声使她常被请去调解：1333年居梅嫩战争期间，她促成奥地利与瑞士城镇的和约；1351年，她又解决了公爵阿尔布雷希特二世与瑞士邦联的争端。兄弟们常到柯尼希斯费尔登向她求教，她于1364年在那里去世。

en: Andrew of Hungary (1327–1345), Duke of Calabria, was a son of Charles I of Hungary. His family felt cheated of Naples, whose crown Charles II had left in 1295 to Robert rather than to Andrew's father. To end the quarrel, Andrew was betrothed in 1333 at the age of six to Joanna, granddaughter and heir of Robert the Wise, who made him Duke of Calabria. Raised in Naples, the soldierly boy never fitted the refined court, and the marriage was unhappy. When Robert died in 1343 and left the crown to Joanna alone, Andrew was kept from power. His mother Elizabeth came to Naples and sought papal authorization for his coronation. In 1345 Pope Clement VI agreed to crown both spouses, but Andrew only as an honorary consort. Before the news was out, conspirators strangled him at Aversa after a hunt on 18 September 1345. His brother Louis I of Hungary twice invaded the kingdom to avenge him.
zh: 匈牙利的安德拉什（1327—1345），卡拉布里亚公爵，是匈牙利国王卡罗伊一世之子。他的家族觉得那不勒斯被人夺走了：1295年，查理二世把王位传给罗贝托，而不是安德拉什的父亲。为平息争端，1333年六岁的安德拉什与智者罗贝托的孙女兼继承人乔万娜订婚，罗贝托封他为卡拉布里亚公爵。他在那不勒斯长大，这个尚武的孩子始终融不进精致的宫廷，婚姻并不幸福。1343年罗贝托去世，把王位只留给乔万娜，安德拉什被排斥在权力之外。其母伊丽莎白来到那不勒斯，为他争取教皇批准加冕。1345年，教皇克雷芒六世同意为夫妻二人加冕，但安德拉什只是名义上的王夫。消息公布之前，1345年9月18日，密谋者趁他狩猎之后在阿韦尔萨将他勒死。其兄匈牙利的拉约什一世两度入侵那不勒斯为他复仇。

en: Andrew II (c. 1177–1235), a younger son of Béla III, held Croatia and Dalmatia under his brother Emeric before becoming king of Hungary and Croatia in 1205. His lavish grants of royal estates to his supporters, the new institutions, weakened crown revenues. He repeatedly fought to seize Halych and Lodomeria, but local boyars and neighbouring princes repelled him. His queen Gertrude of Merania was murdered by discontented lords in 1213. He joined the Fifth Crusade in 1217–1218 but achieved little in the Holy Land. In 1222 he was forced to issue the Golden Bull confirming the liberties of royal servants, and in 1224 the Diploma Andreanum granted privileges to the Transylvanian Saxons. He died on 21 September 1235; his daughter by Gertrude was Saint Elizabeth of Hungary.
zh: 安德拉什二世（约1177—1235）是贝拉三世的幼子，先在兄长伊姆雷治下领有克罗地亚和达尔马提亚，1205年登上匈牙利与克罗地亚王位。他把大量王室地产慷慨封赐给支持者，即所谓“新制”，削弱了王室收入。他屡次出兵争夺加利西亚和洛多梅里亚，却被当地波雅尔与邻近诸侯击退。1213年，他的王后梅拉尼亚的格特鲁德遭不满的贵族杀害。1217至1218年他参加第五次十字军东征，在圣地收获甚微。1222年他被迫颁布《金玺诏书》，确认王室臣属的自由权；1224年又以《安德烈诏书》授予特兰西瓦尼亚撒克逊人特权。他于1235年9月21日去世，与格特鲁德所生之女即匈牙利的圣伊丽莎白。

en: Andrew III (c. 1265–1301), called the Venetian, was a grandson of Andrew II, born in Venice to Stephen the Posthumous and Tomasina Morosini. In 1278 the rebellious lord Ivan Kőszegi invited him to Hungary against Ladislaus IV, but the conspiracy failed. As the last male Árpád he was elected king of Hungary and Croatia after Ladislaus IV's murder in 1290. He issued the first Hungarian coronation diploma confirming noble and clerical privileges, but the Kőszegi, Csák and other baronial houses ruled their lands independently, rebelling repeatedly. Albert of Austria and Mary of Hungary also claimed his throne; Andrew forced Albert to make peace within a year. He died on 14 January 1301, leaving his queen Agnes of Austria, and the Árpád dynasty died with him.
zh: 安德拉什三世（约1265—1301）人称“威尼斯人”，是安德拉什二世之孙，为遗腹子伊什特万与托马西娜·莫罗西尼在威尼斯所生。1278年叛乱贵族伊万·克瑟吉邀请他到匈牙利对抗拉斯洛四世，但密谋失败。作为阿帕德家族最后的男性，他在1290年拉斯洛四世遇刺后被推举为匈牙利与克罗地亚国王。他颁布了匈牙利第一份确认贵族与教士特权的加冕诏书，但克瑟吉、恰克等贵族家族割据自专、屡起叛乱。奥地利的阿尔布雷希特和匈牙利的玛丽亚等人都对他的王位提出主张；安德拉什在一年内迫使阿尔布雷希特议和。他于1301年1月14日去世，身后留下王后奥地利的阿格尼丝，阿帕德王朝也随他绝嗣。

en: Béla IV (1206–1270), eldest son of Andrew II, governed Slavonia and Transylvania before succeeding as king of Hungary and Croatia in 1235. On 11 April 1241 the Mongols destroyed his army at Mohi and chased him to the Adriatic coast; Hungary was devastated before their withdrawal in 1242. Béla allowed barons and prelates to build stone fortresses, promoted fortified towns and settled thousands of colonists on depopulated lands, earning the name second founder of Hungary. He occupied Styria in 1254 but lost it in 1260, fought a civil war against his son Stephen, and died on 3 May 1270 as a Franciscan tertiary.
zh: 贝拉四世（1206—1270）是安德拉什二世的长子，早年治理斯拉沃尼亚和特兰西瓦尼亚，1235年继位为匈牙利与克罗地亚国王。1241年4月11日，蒙古军在穆希之战歼灭其军队，一路追击他至亚得里亚海岸；1242年蒙古军撤离前，匈牙利已遭受严重破坏。贝拉允许贵族与主教修建石造堡垒，推动设防城镇发展，向人烟断绝之地迁入数千殖民者，因此被称为匈牙利的“第二位建国者”。他于1254年占领施蒂利亚，1260年失去该地，曾与儿子伊什特万爆发内战，1270年5月3日作为方济各会第三会会士去世。

en: Elizabeth the Cuman (1240–1290/1295) was queen consort of Stephen V of Hungary and regent for her son Ladislaus IV. A Cuman chieftain's daughter, traditionally held to be Khan Köten, she was betrothed while a child to Stephen, eldest son of Béla IV, sealing the agreement that gave the Cumans asylum in return for conversion to Catholicism and loyalty to the king. When Stephen V died in 1272, she ruled Hungary as regent during Ladislaus IV's minority until 1277. Her daughters Anna and Maria married Andronikos II Palaiologos and Charles II of Naples.
zh: 库曼人伊丽莎白（1240—1290/1295）是匈牙利国王伊什特万五世的王后，并在儿子拉斯洛四世未成年时摄政。她是库曼酋长之女，传统说法认为其父是忽滩汗。她幼年即与贝拉四世的长子伊什特万订婚，这桩婚约是双方协议的保证：库曼人皈依天主教、效忠国王，以换取庇护。1272年伊什特万五世去世后，她在拉斯洛四世成年前以摄政身份统治匈牙利，直至1277年。女儿安娜和玛丽亚分别嫁给拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡二世与那不勒斯国王卡洛二世。

en: Elizabeth of Hungary (died c. 1367) was a daughter of King Charles I of Hungary and a sister of Catherine, Duchess of Świdnica. She was married to Bolesław of Opole, a Silesian Piast duke.
zh: 匈牙利的伊丽莎白（约1367年卒）是匈牙利国王查理一世之女、希维德尼察公爵夫人卡特琳的姐妹，嫁给西里西亚皮雅斯特家族的奥波列公爵博莱斯瓦夫。

en: Stephen of Anjou (1332–1354), Hungarian István, was the youngest son of Charles I of Hungary and Elizabeth of Poland to survive childhood. Styled Duke of Slavonia from 1339 to 1346, he had no part in governing it. In 1349 he received his own household and the counties of Szepes and Sáros from his brother Louis, who made him Duke of Transylvania that year. As heir to his childless brother, he and his mother governed the kingdom during Louis's Neapolitan campaign in 1350. Late that year he married Margaret of Bavaria, daughter of Emperor Louis IV, despite Pope Clement VI's sharp opposition. The match made him unpopular in Poland, and the Polish nobles accepted Louis as Casimir III's heir in 1351 only after he promised to keep Stephen out of their government. Stephen was later entrusted with Croatia, Dalmatia and Slavonia. He died in 1354 returning from a campaign against Serbia, and his infant son John inherited his duchy.
zh: 安茹的斯蒂芬，匈牙利语名伊什特万（1332—1354），是卡罗伊一世与波兰的伊丽莎白活过童年的儿子中最小的一个。1339至1346年他挂名斯拉沃尼亚公爵，却不参与治理。1349年，他从兄长拉约什手中得到自己的家政班底和塞派什、沙罗什两郡，同年被封为特兰西瓦尼亚公爵。作为无子嗣兄长的继承人，他在1350年拉约什远征那不勒斯期间与母亲共同执掌国政。同年年末，他迎娶皇帝路易四世之女巴伐利亚的玛格丽特，教皇克雷芒六世强烈反对。这桩婚事使他在波兰不得人心，1351年波兰贵族承认拉约什为卡齐米日三世的继承人，条件是不让他参与波兰政务。他后来受命管辖克罗地亚、达尔马提亚和斯拉沃尼亚。1354年，他在征伐塞尔维亚的归途中去世，幼子约翰继领其地。

en: John Hunyadi (c. 1406–1456) was Hungary's foremost commander against the Ottomans. He learned warfare on Hungary's southern frontier, employed professional soldiers and mobilized local peasants against invaders. Made Ban of Szörény in 1439 and Voivode of Transylvania in 1441, he routed Ottoman raiders in Transylvania in 1442 and led the Long Campaign across the Balkans in 1443–1444, before defeat at Varna in 1444 and Kosovo in 1448. He ruled as regent of Hungary for the young Ladislaus V from 1446 to 1453. In 1456 he repelled Sultan Mehmed II's assault on Belgrade, then died of plague in the crusader camp weeks later. His son became King Matthias Corvinus.
zh: 匈雅提·亚诺什（约1406—1456）是匈牙利抗击奥斯曼人的头号统帅。他在匈牙利南部边境磨练军技，雇佣职业士兵，也动员当地农民抵御入侵。他于1439年任塞韦林巴昂，1441年任特兰西瓦尼亚总督，1442年在特兰西瓦尼亚击溃奥斯曼劫掠军，1443至1444年率军远征巴尔干，但1444年在瓦尔纳、1448年在科索沃两度兵败。1446至1453年，他在幼王拉斯洛五世治下担任匈牙利摄政。1456年，他击退苏丹穆罕默德二世对贝尔格莱德的围攻，几周后却因十字军营地暴发的瘟疫病逝。他的儿子后来成为国王马加什·科尔温。

en: John Angelos, called Kaloiōannēs or Good John (c. 1193 – before 1250), was a Byzantine prince, the son of Emperor Isaac II Angelos and Margaret of Hungary. After the Latin sack of Constantinople in 1204 he fled with his mother to Thessalonica and around 1220 to the Hungarian court of his uncle King Andrew II, who made him governor of Syrmia and the regions beyond the Sava. In 1225 he took 200 silver marks from the Archbishop of Kalocsa for the Bosnian Crusade but never campaigned. He was dead by July 1250, when his wife Matilda is recorded as his widow.
zh: 约翰·安杰洛斯，人称“卡洛伊奥安尼斯”，意为“好人约翰”（约1193—1250年前卒），是拜占庭皇子，皇帝伊萨克二世·安杰洛斯与匈牙利的玛格丽特之子。1204年君士坦丁堡遭拉丁人洗劫后，他随母亲逃往塞萨洛尼基，约1220年又投奔舅父匈牙利国王安德烈二世的宫廷，受任管辖西尔米乌姆及萨瓦河以南地区。1225年，他收下考洛乔总主教为波斯尼亚十字军提供的200银马克，却始终没有出兵。至1250年7月他已去世，妻子玛蒂尔达在文书中被记作他的遗孀。

en: Coloman (c. 1317–1375) was the illegitimate son of King Charles I of Hungary, born to a concubine kept on Csepel Island. Destined for the Church, he became a canon at Várad in 1332, grand provost of Esztergom in 1335, and bishop of Győr by papal bull in 1337, aged about twenty. He accompanied his half-brother Louis I on the Neapolitan campaign of 1350, but was imprisoned in 1353, accused of conspiring against the king. Freed by 1359 and restored to his see, he remained bishop of Győr until his death.
zh: 科洛曼（约1317—1375）是匈牙利国王查理一世的私生子，生母是养在切派尔岛行宫的侍妾。他被安排走教会道路，1332年任瓦拉德法政牧师，1335年任埃斯泰尔戈姆大修士长，1337年由教宗诏书任命为杰尔主教，时年仅约二十岁。他随异母兄拉约什一世参加1350年的那不勒斯战役，却在1353年被控谋反国王而下狱；1359年前获释并恢复主教之职，此后一直担任杰尔主教直至去世。

en: Charles I of Hungary, called Charles Robert (1288–1342), was the Angevin prince who put a shattered kingdom back together. Grandson of Charles II of Naples and Mary of Hungary, whose claim he inherited, he landed at Split as a boy of twelve in 1300 and was crowned in 1301 with a provisional crown. But Hungary had split into about a dozen provinces under oligarchs, and most refused him. Proclaimed king in 1308, he was crowned with the Holy Crown in 1310. His victory at Rozgony in 1312 and the death of Matthew Csák in 1321 made him master of nearly the whole kingdom. He granted office fiefs instead of perpetual estates and opened gold mines that made Hungary Europe's largest gold producer. The defeat at Posada in 1330 did not stop Wallachia from becoming independent. In 1335 he mediated at Visegrád between John of Bohemia and Casimir III of Poland. His son Louis the Great inherited the rebuilt kingdom.
zh: 卡罗伊一世，一称查理·罗伯特（1288—1342），是把四分五裂的王国重新拼合起来的安茹王子。他是那不勒斯的查理二世与匈牙利的玛丽亚之孙，继承了祖母对匈牙利的王位主张；1300年，十二岁的他在斯普利特登陆，1301年以临时王冠加冕。但匈牙利已分裂为十余个由寡头把持的省份，多数人拒绝承认他。1308年他被拥立为王，1310年以圣冠再次加冕。1312年罗兹戈尼之战获胜，1321年寡头马特·恰克去世，他成为几乎整个王国的主人。他不再世袭永久地封赐土地，改用任职期间才有效的“官职采邑”，并开采金矿，使匈牙利成为欧洲最大的黄金产地。1330年他在波萨达战败，没能阻止瓦拉几亚走向独立。1335年，他在维谢格拉德调解波希米亚的约翰与波兰的卡齐米日三世的争端。儿子拉约什大王继承了这个重整后的王国。

en: Catherine of Hungary (c. 1315–1355) was a daughter of King Charles I of Hungary, probably by his first wife Maria of Bytom. In 1338 she married Henry II, Duke of Świdnica, a Silesian Piast. After Henry died between 1343 and 1345, she raised their only daughter Anna at Visegrád. In 1353 Anna married Charles IV, Holy Roman Emperor, while Catherine's brother Louis I of Hungary renounced his claims to Świdnica in favour of the House of Luxembourg. Catherine died in 1355.
zh: 匈牙利的卡特琳（约1315—1355）是匈牙利国王查理一世之女，母亲可能是国王的第一任妻子比托姆的玛丽亚。1338年，她嫁给西里西亚皮雅斯特家族的希维德尼察公爵亨里克二世。亨里克于1343至1345年间去世后，她带着独女安娜在维舍格勒生活。1353年，安娜嫁给神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理四世，卡特琳之兄匈牙利国王拉约什一世则将对希维德尼察的权利让予卢森堡家族。卡特琳于1355年去世。

en: Catherine of Hungary (c. 1256 – after 1316) was a Hungarian princess of the Árpád dynasty, the second daughter of King Stephen V and Elizabeth the Cuman, and sister of King Ladislaus IV. In 1268 she married the Serbian heir Stefan Dragutin as part of the peace ending the Serb-Hungarian war, and she was queen of Serbia during his reign from 1276 to 1282. Her children included Stefan Vladislav II, later lord of Syrmia, and the monk Urošica. Her sister Elizabeth married Dragutin's brother Milutin. She outlived Dragutin, who died in 1316.
zh: 匈牙利的凯瑟琳（约1256—1316年后）是阿帕德王朝的匈牙利公主，国王伊什特万五世与库曼人伊丽莎白的次女，国王拉斯洛四世的妹妹。1268年，作为塞尔维亚与匈牙利战争结束后的和议一环，她嫁给塞尔维亚王储斯特凡·德拉古廷，1276至1282年丈夫在位期间为塞尔维亚王后。她的子女包括后来的斯雷姆领主斯特凡·弗拉迪斯拉夫二世和出家为僧的乌罗什察；她的妹妹伊丽莎白则嫁给了德拉古廷的弟弟米卢廷。她比1316年去世的德拉古廷长寿。

en: Clemence of Austria (1262–February 1293 or 1295), daughter of King Rudolf I of Germany and Gertrude of Hohenberg, married Charles Martel of Anjou, titular King of Hungary, on 8 January 1281. Their three children were Charles I, who won the Hungarian crown in 1308 after her death; Beatrice, wife of John II of Viennois; and Clemence, second wife of King Louis X of France and mother of John I. Clemence died in Naples, probably in 1293 after the birth of her youngest daughter, though 1295 is also argued, and was buried there.
zh: 哈布斯堡的克莱门斯（1262—1293年2月，一说1295年）是德意志国王鲁道夫一世与霍恩贝格的格特鲁德之女。1281年1月8日，她嫁给名义上的匈牙利国王安茹的查理·马特。两人育有三名子女：在她死后于1308年夺得匈牙利王位的查理一世；嫁给维埃纳的让二世的贝亚特丽切；以及法兰西国王路易十世的第二任王后、约翰一世之母克莱门西娅。克莱门斯在那不勒斯去世，可能是在1293年幼女出生后，亦有1295年之说，葬于那不勒斯。

en: Ladislaus IV (1262–1290), called the Cuman for his mother's Cuman origin, inherited Hungary and Croatia at nine in 1272, when his father Stephen V died while the rebel lord Joachim Gutkeled held him captive. Baronial factions fought for power during his minority until he came of age in 1277. Allied with Rudolf I of Germany, his troops helped defeat Ottokar II of Bohemia at the Marchfeld on 26 August 1278. His defence of pagan Cumans against a papal legate earned him excommunication; he routed a Cuman invasion in 1282 and survived a Mongol raid in 1285. In his last years he could no longer control the most powerful lords and bishops. He was murdered by three Cuman assassins on 10 July 1290.
zh: 拉斯洛四世（1262—1290）因母亲的库曼血统而被称为“库曼人”。1272年其父伊什特万五世去世时他年仅9岁，且正被叛乱贵族约阿希姆·古特凯莱德拘押，随后继承匈牙利与克罗地亚王位。他未成年期间贵族派系争夺权力，1277年亲政。他与德意志国王鲁道夫一世结盟，其军队在1278年8月26日的马希费尔德之战中协助击败波希米亚的奥托卡二世。他庇护信奉异教的库曼人、对抗教皇使节，因此被开除教籍；1282年击退库曼人入侵，1285年又扛过蒙古人的袭击。晚年他已无法控制最有权势的贵族与主教。1290年7月10日，他被三名库曼人刺杀。

en: Louis I, called the Great (1326–1382), succeeded his father Charles I as King of Hungary and Croatia in 1342, inheriting a centralised kingdom; his mother Elizabeth of Poland acted as a kind of co-regent for decades. When his brother Andrew was murdered at Naples in 1345, he accused Queen Joanna, and punishing her became the aim of his foreign policy: he invaded twice between 1347 and 1350, but the papacy never recognised his claim and he withdrew in 1351. That year he confirmed the liberties of the Hungarian nobility and set a uniform rent for peasants. In 1358 he forced Venice to give up the Dalmatian towns, and in 1367 he founded a university at Pécs. Under a treaty of 1338 he inherited Poland from his maternal uncle Casimir III in 1370. With no son, he issued the Privilege of Koszyce in 1374 to win acceptance for his daughters as heirs. Hungarian historians long counted him their most powerful king.
zh: 拉约什一世，即拉约什大王（1326—1382），1342年继承父亲卡罗伊一世的匈牙利和克罗地亚王位，接手的是一个中央集权的王国；其母波兰的伊丽莎白数十年里如同共同摄政者。1345年弟弟安德拉什在那不勒斯遇害，他指控乔万娜女王，惩罚她成了他对外政策的主轴：1347至1350年间他两度出兵，但教廷始终不承认他的主张，1351年他撤军。同年，他确认匈牙利贵族的自由权利，并规定农民向地主缴纳统一的地租。1358年他迫使威尼斯放弃达尔马提亚诸城镇，1367年在佩奇创办大学。根据1338年的条约，他于1370年从舅父卡齐米日三世手中继承波兰。因无子嗣，他在1374年颁布科希策特权，为女儿们的继承权争取承认。匈牙利史家长期视他为本国最强大的国王。

en: Maria of Bytom (before 1295–1317) was queen of Hungary as the wife of Charles I Robert and the only daughter of Casimir, Piast duke of Bytom, by Helena, commonly identified as a daughter of Lev I of Galicia. In 1306 she married Charles, probably in Bytom, and was crowned at Székesfehérvár. The marriage, probably promoted by Władysław I the Elbow-high, drew Hungary and the Silesian Piasts together against Bohemia. The marriage is now considered childless, though older historians gave her two daughters. She died on 15 December 1317; her brothers Bolesław and Mieszko later became Hungarian prelates.
zh: 比托姆的玛丽亚（1295年前—1317）是匈牙利国王查理一世·罗贝尔的王后，皮亚斯特家族比托姆公爵卡齐米日与海莱娜的独女；海莱娜通常被认为是加利奇公爵列夫一世之女。1306年，她嫁给查理，婚礼可能在比托姆举行；她在塞克什白堡加冕。这桩联姻可能由“矮子”瓦迪斯瓦夫一世促成，使匈牙利与西里西亚皮亚斯特系联手对抗波希米亚。现代研究认为二人没有子女，旧说则称她生有两女。1317年12月15日她去世；她的兄弟博莱斯瓦夫和梅什科后来成为匈牙利的高级教士。

en: Maria Laskarina (c. 1206–1270) was queen consort of Hungary as the wife of Béla IV, and a daughter of Theodore I Laskaris, founder of the Nicaean Empire, by Anna Komnene Angelina. In 1218, aged about twelve, she married Prince Béla, eldest son of Andrew II, converting from Orthodoxy to Catholicism to seal the Nicaean-Hungarian alliance. She became queen when Béla succeeded in 1235. During the Mongol invasion she and her children took refuge at Klis and Split, and in the 1260s she supported Béla against their son Stephen. She died on 24 June 1270, weeks after her husband.
zh: 玛丽亚·拉斯卡里娜（约1206—1270）是匈牙利国王贝拉四世的王后，尼西亚帝国建立者狄奥多尔一世·拉斯卡里斯与安娜·科穆宁·安杰利娜之女。1218年，年约十二岁的她嫁给安德烈二世的长子贝拉王子，并由东正教改宗天主教，以此缔结尼西亚与匈牙利的盟约。1235年贝拉继位，她成为王后。蒙古入侵匈牙利期间，她与子女避居克利斯和斯普利特；1260年代的内战中，她支持贝拉对抗儿子伊什特万。1270年6月24日，她在丈夫去世数周后离世。

en: Elizabeth of Hungary (1207–1231) was the daughter of King Andrew II and Gertrude of Merania, sent as a child to the Thuringian court and married in 1221 to Louis IV, Landgrave of Thuringia. Franciscan friars arrived in 1223 and influenced her religious life. In 1226, while Louis attended an imperial diet, she managed affairs at home and distributed alms during a famine. Louis died on crusade in 1227, leaving her widowed at twenty; with her dowry she founded a hospital at Marburg and served the sick herself. She died on 17 November 1231, aged twenty-four. Reports of healings at her grave were investigated before Gregory IX canonised her in 1235. She is patroness of the Third Order of Saint Francis.
zh: 匈牙利的圣伊丽莎白（1207—1231）是匈牙利国王安德拉什二世与梅拉尼亚的格特鲁德之女，自幼被送往图林根宫廷，1221年嫁给图林根领地伯爵路易四世。1223年方济各会修士抵达，影响了她的宗教生活。1226年路易出席帝国议会时，她主持家中事务，在饥荒中广施赈济。1227年路易在十字军途中去世，她20岁便守寡，随后用嫁妆在马尔堡创办医院，亲自照料病人。她于1231年11月17日去世，年仅24岁。墓前治愈奇迹的传闻经调查后，教皇格列高利九世于1235年将她封圣。她是方济各会第三会的主保圣人。

en: Stephen V (1239–1272) was the eldest son of Béla IV and Maria Laskarina, crowned in childhood and married to Elizabeth, daughter of a Cuman chieftain. He governed Transylvania from 1257 and Styria from 1258. Styrian nobles rebelled with the support of Ottokar II of Bohemia, who routed Stephen and his father at Kressenbrunn in July 1260. He forced Béla to cede the lands east of the Danube as junior king in 1262 and fought him until peace in 1266. Stephen succeeded to the throne in 1270 and repelled Ottokar's invasion of Hungary in 1271, winning a decisive battle on the Rábca. After his son Ladislaus was seized by the rebel lord Joachim Gutkeled, he died suddenly on 6 August 1272.
zh: 伊什特万五世（1239—1272）是贝拉四世与玛丽亚·拉斯卡里娜的长子，幼年即被加冕，娶库曼人酋长之女伊丽莎白为妻。他1257年起治理特兰西瓦尼亚，1258年起治理施蒂利亚。施蒂利亚贵族在波希米亚国王奥托卡二世支持下反叛，1260年7月奥托卡在克雷森布伦击败伊什特万父子的军队。1262年他迫使贝拉割让多瑙河以东土地，受封小国王，并与父亲交战至1266年议和。1270年他继位为王，1271年击退奥托卡二世对匈牙利的入侵，在拉布察河赢得决定性战役。儿子拉斯洛被叛乱贵族约阿希姆·古特凯莱德劫持后不久，他于1272年8月6日暴病而亡。

en: Tomasina Morosini (c. 1250–c. 1297) was a Venetian noblewoman of the powerful Morosini family. Around 1264, in Venice, she married Stephen the Posthumous, an exiled Árpád prince claiming the Hungarian throne, bringing him Venetian wealth and backing. The Great Council of Venice approved the marriage, although Stephen was a foreigner without Venetian citizenship. Their only son, the future Andrew III, was born around 1265 and raised in her family's palace. Stephen died in 1271, having named Tomasina's brother Albertino and brother-in-law Marino Gradenigo as Andrew's guardians. She remained in Venice, but when Andrew became King of Hungary she followed him in 1292 and ruled as Duchess of Slavonia. She died in 1296 or early 1297, amid rumours of poison; her son was the last Árpád king.
zh: 托玛希娜·摩洛西尼（约1250—约1297）出身威尼斯豪门摩洛西尼家族。约1264年，她在威尼斯嫁给流亡的阿尔帕德家族亲王、匈牙利王位声索者“遗腹子”斯蒂芬，为他带来威尼斯的财富与支持。尽管斯蒂芬是没有威尼斯公民权的外国人，威尼斯大议会仍批准了这桩婚事。两人的独子、后来的安德烈三世约1265年出生，在摩洛西尼家族的府邸长大。斯蒂芬于1271年去世，生前指定托玛希娜的兄弟阿尔贝蒂诺和姻兄弟马里诺·格拉德尼戈为安德烈的监护人。她留居威尼斯；儿子登上匈牙利王位后，她于1292年前往匈牙利，受封斯拉沃尼亚女公爵。她于1296年或1297年初去世，坊间传言她系中毒而亡。她的儿子是阿尔帕德王朝最后一位国王。

en: Yolanda of Courtenay (c. 1197–1233) was Queen of Hungary as the second wife of Andrew II. Daughter of Peter II of Courtenay, Latin Emperor of Constantinople, and Yolanda of Flanders, she was a niece of Emperor Henry I, who arranged the marriage. In February 1215 she was crowned at Székesfehérvár, prompting the Bishop of Veszprém to claim coronation of queens as his privilege, confirmed by Pope Innocent III. After Henry I died in 1216 her father, not Andrew II, was chosen Latin emperor. As queen, Yolanda received letters from Pope Honorius III and granted land to citizens. Around 1230 she helped arrange the marriage of her niece Matilda to John Angelos. She kept good relations with her stepchildren, and her daughter Yolanda married James I of Aragon.
zh: 库尔特奈的约兰德（约1197—1233）是匈牙利国王安德烈二世的第二任王后。她是君士坦丁堡拉丁皇帝皮埃尔二世·德·库尔特奈与佛兰德的约兰德之女、拉丁皇帝亨利一世的外甥女，这桩婚事正是由亨利一世安排。1215年2月，她在塞克什白堡加冕为后，促使维斯普雷姆主教主张加冕王后是本教区的特权，并得到教皇英诺森三世确认。1216年亨利一世去世后，被选为拉丁皇帝的是她的父亲而非安德烈二世。身为王后，约兰德曾收到教皇洪诺留三世的来信，也曾向民众授地。约1230年，她帮助安排外甥女玛蒂尔达与约翰·安杰洛斯的婚事。她与丈夫前妻所生的子女关系融洽，女儿约兰德嫁给了阿拉贡国王海梅一世。

en: Dietrich (died after 1341) was a Premonstratensian canon who became bishop of Havelberg in 1324 or 1325, after serving as the cathedral's provost. In 1327 he issued an edict against men who plundered or burned church property, while Pope John XXII kept Brandenburg under an interdict. He consecrated the high altar of Havelberg Cathedral in 1330 and enlarged its library. In 1336 and 1338 the pope entrusted him with lifting the interdict laid on Halle after the murder of Archbishop Burchard III of Magdeburg. He is last attested on 27 August 1341.
zh: 狄奥多里克（1341年后卒）是普雷蒙特雷修会教士，担任座堂教长后于1324或1325年出任哈弗尔贝格主教。1327年，教宗约翰二十二世对勃兰登堡边区施加禁罚，他颁布法令惩处劫掠、焚毁教会财物者。1330年，他为哈弗尔贝格主教座堂的大祭坛祝圣，并扩充座堂藏书。1336至1338年间，教宗委托他解除马格德堡大主教布尔夏德三世遇刺后施加给萨勒河畔哈雷的禁罚。1341年8月27日是他最后一次见于记载。

en: Muzaffar al-Din Afrasiab II became ruler of the Hazaraspid dynasty of Great Lorestan about 1340, succeeding his father Yusuf Shah II at Idhaj in the Zagros. During his reign the Ilkhanate collapsed, so that the atabegs of Lorestan no longer answered to a Mongol overlord, while the Muzaffarids of Fars under Mubariz al-Din Muhammad rose as a new danger. Afrasiab was succeeded by his son Nawr-al-Ward.
zh: 穆扎法尔丁·阿夫拉西亚布二世约1340年继其父优素福·沙阿二世之后，在扎格罗斯山区的伊宰统治大卢尔斯坦的哈扎拉斯普王朝。他在位期间伊尔汗国瓦解，卢尔斯坦的阿塔贝格不再听命于蒙古宗主；与此同时，法尔斯的穆扎法尔王朝在穆巴利兹丁·穆罕默德率领下崛起为新的威胁。其子努尔瓦德继位。

en: Rukn al-Din Yusuf Shah II was the Hazaraspid atabeg of Great Lorestan, ruling from his capital Idhaj, now Izeh, in the Zagros from about 1330 to 1339 or 1340. He succeeded his father Nusrat al-Din Ahmad and was likewise remembered as a benevolent ruler. He died at Shushtar aged about forty-three and was followed by his son Muzaffar al-Din Afrasiab II as the Ilkhanate began to break apart.
zh: 鲁肯丁·优素福·沙阿二世是大卢尔斯坦的哈扎拉斯普阿塔贝格，约1330年起在扎格罗斯山区的都城伊宰（今伊泽）统治，直至1339或1340年。他继承父亲努斯拉特丁·艾哈迈德，和父亲一样以仁厚著称。他在舒什塔尔去世，终年约43岁，其子穆扎法尔丁·阿夫拉西亚布二世继位，时值伊尔汗国开始瓦解。

en: Muhammad ibn Iyas (1448–c.1523) was an Egyptian historian of the late Mamluk age, born and educated in Cairo and trained in the Hanafi school of law. He belonged to a Mamluk military family and studied under the jurist and historian Abd al-Basit. His major work, Bada'i al-zuhur fi waqa'i al-duhur, is a universal history of Egypt in five parts that he carried down to 1522. As an eyewitness to the Ottoman invasion of 1517 and the fall of the Mamluk sultanate, he recorded the conquest in detailed, dated entries, making his chronicle a principal source for Egypt's transition from Mamluk to Ottoman rule.
zh: 穆罕默德·伊本·伊亚斯（1448—约1523）是马穆鲁克晚期的埃及史家，生于开罗并在当地求学，遵循哈乃斐法学派。他出身马穆鲁克军人家族，曾师从法学家兼史家阿卜杜勒巴西特。他的主要著作《百花奇观：历代大事记》是分为五部的埃及通史，记事一直延续到1522年。他亲身经历了1517年奥斯曼入侵和马穆鲁克苏丹国覆灭，在书中以系日的详细笔法记录这场征服，使这部编年史成为了解埃及从马穆鲁克转入奥斯曼统治的首要史料。

en: Ibn Khaldun (1332–1406) was an Arab historian and thinker born in Tunis to a family of Sevillian refugees. His family had left Seville in 1232 and settled first in Ceuta before moving to Tunis. He served Maghrebi rulers, even as chief minister at Béjaïa, before retiring in 1375 to the Berber-guarded retreat of Qalat Ibn Salama, where he drafted the Muqaddimah, the introduction to his universal history Kitab al-Ibar. Its theories were later used by Ottoman historians to analyse the growth and decline of their empire. Settling in Cairo from 1382, Sultan Barquq named him Maliki grand qadi in 1384 and he taught at al-Azhar. In 1400 he went out to negotiate with Tamerlane during the siege of Damascus. He died in Cairo in 1406, shortly after his sixth appointment as qadi.
zh: 伊本·赫勒敦（1332—1406）是生于突尼斯的阿拉伯史家与思想家，家族为塞维利亚难民后裔。他的家族于1232年离开塞维利亚，先在休达定居，后迁往突尼斯。他长年在马格里布诸王朝任职，曾出任贝贾亚首相，1375年退隐于柏柏尔人护卫的伊本·萨拉迈堡，在那里起草《历史绪论》——即其通史巨著《殷鉴书》的导言。后来的奥斯曼史家用书中理论分析帝国的兴衰。1382年起他定居开罗，1384年被苏丹巴尔库克任命为马立克派大法官，并在爱资哈尔讲学。1400年大马士革被围期间，他出城与帖木儿谈判。1406年，他在第六次出任法官后不久于开罗去世。

en: Ichil was a 13th-century Mongol amir of the Barlas tribe in the Chagatai Khanate and an ancestor of Timur, succeeding his father Qarachar. Timurid works expanded on his career: the Shajarat al-atrak makes him generalissimo serving the Chagatai khans Alghu and Mubarak Shah, while Yazdi's Zafarnama says he joined Prince Teguder after attending the enthronement of Khan Baraq, whereupon his son Aylangir took over his duties. A 1317 Baghdad manuscript of Rashid al-Din's Jami' al-tawarikh calls him a great amir in the service of the Ilkhan Abaqa, though modern scholars suspect that passage may be a later insertion.
zh: 亦连吉儿是13世纪察合台汗国巴鲁剌思部的蒙古埃米尔，帖木儿的先祖，继其父哈剌察儿任职。帖木儿朝著作对他的事迹多有铺陈：《突厥世系》称他担任全军统帅，臣事察合台汗阿鲁忽和木八剌沙；耶兹德《帖木儿武功记》则说他在参加八剌汗的即位典礼后投奔宗王特古迭儿，其子艾兰吉尔随即接掌他的职司。1317年巴格达抄本的拉施特丁《史集》称他是在伊儿汗阿八哈帐下效力的大埃米尔，但现代学者怀疑这段文字是后人添入的。

en: Rao Dhavalmalji was a Rathore Rajput ruler of Idar and a younger son of its founder Rao Sonag. After his elder brother Rao Emalji died early following a reign of about two years, Dhavalmalji succeeded him on the Idar throne.
zh: 拉奥·达瓦尔马尔吉是伊德尔的罗怙罗族拉杰普特统治者，伊德尔建立者拉奥·索纳格的幼子。其兄拉奥·埃马尔吉在位约两年早逝后，他继位成为伊德尔拉奥。

en: Rao Emalji was a Rathore Rajput ruler of Idar and a son of its founder Rao Sonag. He succeeded his father as Rao but ruled for only about two years and died early. His descendants, the Emaliya Raos, held the jagirs of Ahmednagar and Vijapur.
zh: 拉奥·埃马尔吉是伊德尔的罗怙罗族拉杰普特统治者，伊德尔建立者拉奥·索纳格之子。他继承父亲之位，但仅在位约两年便早逝。其后代称“埃马利亚拉奥”，领有艾哈迈德讷格尔和维贾布尔的札吉尔。

en: Kehar, also called Harbal, was a Rathore Rao of Idar in northern Gujarat. He succeeded his father Rao Lunkaran in 1324 and ruled the hill state until 1345, when Rao Ranmal followed him.
zh: 克哈尔又名赫尔巴尔，是古吉拉特北部伊德尔的罗怙罗族罗阇。他于1324年继承父亲罗阇·伦卡兰，统治这个山地城邦直至1345年，之后由罗阇·伦马尔继位。

en: Rao Sonag, also called Sonangji, was a Rathore Rajput chief and the founder of Idar State. A younger son of Rao Sheoji, who led the Rathores into Marwar, he first held the fief of Sametra from the Chaulukya ruler of Anhilwad Patan. In 1257 he and his brother Rao Asthan seized Idar, overthrowing the Koli chieftain Samalio Sora through a ruse devised by Samalio's Nagar Brahmin minister: Rathore warriors hidden in carriages struck down the chief at a feast. As Idar's first Rao he founded the Idariya Rathore line and died in 1275.
zh: 拉奥·索纳格，又称索南吉，是罗怙罗族拉杰普特首领，伊德尔土邦的建立者。他是率领罗怙罗人进入马尔瓦尔的拉奥·谢奥吉较年幼的儿子之一，最初从安希尔瓦德·帕坦的遮娄其统治者那里受封萨梅特拉采邑。1257年，他与兄弟拉奥·阿斯坦合力攻取伊德尔：萨马利奥的纳加尔婆罗门宰相设下计策，把罗怙罗武士藏在马车里，在宴会上击杀科利酋长萨马利奥·索拉。索纳格成为第一代伊德尔拉奥，开创“伊达里亚·罗怙罗”世系，于1275年去世。

en: Jamal ad-Din I was Muslim governor of Ifat in the mid-fourteenth century, son of Nahwi ibn Mansur Walashma and brother of Sultans Haqq ad-Din I and Sabr ad-Din I. He owed his post to the Ethiopian emperor: in 1332, after Sabr ad-Din's revolt failed, Amda Seyon I released him from prison and made him governor, perhaps having held him as a hostage for Ifat's loyalty. It did not last. The royal chronicle claims he joined Salih's Muslim alliance, defeated at the Battle of Das, and later refused to hand over Christian converts to Islam, though he did produce his brother's son. Amda Seyon ravaged Ifat and replaced him with his brother Nasr ad-Din. Historian Taddesse Tamrat doubts that Jamal ever went so far as rebellion, holding that he was recalled to court and imprisoned again on the pretext of the converts.
zh: 贾迈勒丁一世是14世纪中叶伊法特的穆斯林统治者，纳赫维·伊本·曼苏尔·瓦拉什马之子，哈格丁一世、萨布尔丁一世的兄弟。他的位置得自埃塞俄比亚皇帝：1332年萨布尔丁叛乱失败后，安达·塞永一世将他从狱中释放，任命为伊法特统治者，此前或许一直把他扣作保证伊法特效忠的人质。这个安排没有维持多久。皇家编年史称，他随后加入萨利赫的穆斯林联盟，在达斯之战中被击败，后来又拒绝交出皈依伊斯兰教的基督徒，只交出了兄弟的儿子。安达·塞永蹂躏伊法特，由其兄弟纳斯尔丁接替他。历史学家塔德塞·塔姆拉特则认为，贾迈勒丁并未走到叛乱那一步，而是被召回宫廷，以未能交出改宗者为借口再次囚禁。

en: Nahwi ibn Mansur was a prince of the Walashma dynasty of the Muslim Sultanate of Ifat, and a grandson of its founder Umar ibn Dunya-hawz. Four of his sons ruled Ifat: Haqq ad-Din I, Sabr ad-Din I, Jamal ad-Din I and Nasr ad-Din.
zh: 纳赫维·伊本·曼苏尔是穆斯林伊法特苏丹国瓦拉什马王朝的王公，开国君主乌马尔·伊本·敦亚豪兹之孙。他的四个儿子曾统治伊法特：哈格丁一世、萨布尔丁一世、贾迈勒丁一世与纳斯尔丁。

en: Sabr ad-Din I was sultan of the Muslim Sultanate of Ifat in the early fourteenth century, a son of Nahwi ibn Mansur Walashma and younger brother of Sultan Haqq ad-Din I. By then Amda Seyon I of Ethiopia had been absorbing the Muslim borderlands and the inland trade that ran through them. Early in 1332 Sabr ad-Din answered by rallying the Muslims of the Horn against the Christian emperor, attacking garrisons, burning churches, enslaving people and forcing the clergy to convert. Amda Seyon defeated him in battle and then overran Dawaro and Bale. Sabr ad-Din was captured together with his ally Haydara of Dawaro and imprisoned, and the emperor made his brother Jamal ad-Din I ruler of Ifat. The campaign ended the independence of Hadiya, Fatagar, Dawaro and Ifat.
zh: 萨布尔丁一世是14世纪初穆斯林伊法特苏丹国的苏丹，纳赫维·伊本·曼苏尔·瓦拉什马之子、苏丹哈格丁一世之弟。其时埃塞俄比亚的安达·塞永一世正不断吞并穆斯林边地，以及经由这些地方的内陆贸易。1332年初，萨布尔丁起兵回应，召集非洲之角的穆斯林对抗信奉基督教的皇帝，进攻驻军、焚毁教堂、奴役民众、强迫教士改宗。安达·塞永将其击败，继而攻陷达瓦罗和巴莱。萨布尔丁与盟友达瓦罗国王海达拉一同被俘下狱，皇帝随后改立其弟贾迈勒丁一世为伊法特之主。这场战事终结了哈迪亚、法塔加尔、达瓦罗和伊法特的独立。

en: Bernard I was Lord of L'Isle-Jourdain in Gascony from 1132 to 1161, succeeding his father Jordan I. His son Jordan II succeeded him as lord.
zh: 贝尔纳一世是加斯科涅的利勒茹尔丹领主，1132至1161年在位，继承父亲茹尔丹一世之位。死后由儿子茹尔丹二世继位。

en: Bernard II Jordan (c. 1181–1228) was lord of L'Isle-Jourdain in Gascony from 1205 until his death. He was the eldest son of Jourdain III and Esclarmonde of Foix, called the Great Esclarmonde, who received the Cathar consolamentum in 1204 and became a central figure of Catharism in Languedoc. He married Indie, an illegitimate daughter of Count Raymond V of Toulouse, and his rule spanned most of the Albigensian Crusade. On his death in 1228 he was succeeded by his sons Bernard III and Jourdain IV in turn; another son, Bertrand, became bishop of Toulouse.
zh: 贝尔纳二世·茹尔丹（约1181—1228）自1205年起任加斯科涅的利勒茹尔丹领主，直至去世。他是茹尔丹三世与富瓦的埃斯克拉蒙德——人称“大埃斯克拉蒙德”——的长子，其母于1204年接受卡特里派的慰藉礼，成为朗格多克卡特里派的核心人物。贝尔纳娶图卢兹伯爵雷蒙五世的私生女安迪为妻，统治岁月大半处于阿尔比十字军时期。他于1228年去世后，儿子贝尔纳三世、茹尔丹四世相继继位，另一子贝尔特朗后来成为图卢兹主教。

en: Bernard III (c. 1210–1240) was the son of Bernard II Jordan and Indie, an illegitimate daughter of Count Raymond V of Toulouse. He ruled the Gascon lordship of L'Isle-Jourdain from 1228 until his death in 1240, when his younger brother Jourdain IV succeeded him.
zh: 贝尔纳三世（约1210—1240）是贝尔纳二世·茹尔丹与图卢兹伯爵雷蒙五世私生女安迪之子。他自1228年起统治加斯科涅的利勒茹尔丹领地，1240年去世后由弟弟茹尔丹四世继位。

en: Bernard IV Jordan (died 1340) was Lord of L'Isle-Jourdain in Gascony, a lord allied to the Counts of Foix. In 1291 he married Marguerite de Foix, daughter of Count Roger-Bernard III, and kept up that alliance afterwards. He succeeded his father Jordan V in 1303 or 1304 and served Philip IV of France as seneschal of Languedoc until 1309. The papacy also took notice of him: in 1319 Pope John XXII, calling him ‘son’, wrote to complain of the Ghibelline advance in Lombardy. Between 1328 and 1331 he planned to join Philip VI on a crusade against Granada, though the expedition never set out. His eldest son Bertrand succeeded him.
zh: 贝尔纳四世·茹尔丹（1340年卒）是加斯科涅的利勒茹尔丹领主，与富瓦伯爵家结盟。1291年，他娶富瓦伯爵罗歇-贝尔纳三世之女玛格丽特·德·富瓦，此后一直维系着这一联盟。1303或1304年，他继承父亲茹尔丹五世之位，并在1309年之前为法王腓力四世出任朗格多克司法总管。教廷也注意到了他：1319年，教皇约翰二十二世称他为‘儿子’，写信抱怨吉伯林派在伦巴第的得势。1328至1331年间，他计划随腓力六世远征格拉纳达，却终未成行。他死后由长子贝尔特朗继位。

en: Bertrand I (died c. 1349) was the first Count of L'Isle-Jourdain in Gascony and the eldest son of Bernard IV Jordan and Marguerite de Foix. In 1340 Philip VI of France raised his lordship to a county, and in 1344 named him the king's lieutenant and commander-in-chief in Guyenne. During the English Gascon campaign he was captured at the Battle of Auberoche on 21 October 1345 by the Earl of Derby's Anglo-Gascon force. He married Isabelle de Lévis in 1328, and was last attested on 26 June 1348; his son Jean Jourdain I succeeded him.
zh: 贝尔特朗一世（约1349年卒）是加斯科涅利勒茹尔丹的第一代伯爵，贝尔纳四世·茹尔丹与玛格丽特·德·富瓦的长子。1340年，法王腓力六世将其领地升格为伯国；1344年，又任命他为国王在吉耶讷的副将兼最高指挥官。1345年英军征伐加斯科涅期间，他于10月21日的欧贝罗什之战中被德比伯爵麾下的英加联军俘虏。他于1328年娶伊莎贝尔·德·勒维，1348年6月26日最后一次见于记载，死后由子让·茹尔丹一世继位。

en: Isabelle de Lévis, Dame de Saissac, was the daughter of Eustache de Lévis, lord of Florensac and Saissac, and Béatrix de Thurey. In 1328 she married Bertrand I, the first Count of L'Isle-Jourdain in Gascony, and her son Jean Jourdain I succeeded him.
zh: 赛萨克女领主伊莎贝尔·德·勒维是弗洛朗萨克与赛萨克领主厄斯塔什·德·勒维和贝阿特丽丝·德·蒂雷之女。1328年，她嫁给加斯科涅利勒茹尔丹第一代伯爵贝尔特朗一世，其子让·茹尔丹一世后来继位。

en: Jean Jourdain I (died 1365), second Count of L'Isle-Jourdain in Gascony, was the son of Bertrand I and Isabelle de Lévis, succeeding around 1349. On 8 July 1350 he contracted to marry Jeanne d'Albret, daughter of Lord Bernard Aiz V of Albret.
zh: 让·茹尔丹一世（1365年卒）是加斯科涅利勒茹尔丹的第二代伯爵，贝尔特朗一世与伊莎贝尔·德·勒维之子，约1349年继位。1350年7月8日，他与阿尔布雷领主贝尔纳·埃齐五世之女让娜·德·阿尔布雷订立婚约。

en: John of L'Isle-Jourdain was a younger son of Bernard IV Jordan, Lord of L'Isle-Jourdain in Gascony, and a brother of the first count Bertrand I.
zh: 让·德·利勒茹尔丹是加斯科涅利勒茹尔丹领主贝尔纳四世·茹尔丹之子，第一代伯爵贝尔特朗一世的弟弟。

en: Jordan I was Lord of L'Isle-Jourdain in Gascony from 1089 to 1132, succeeding his father Raymond. A Latin document of 1071 already calls the place Isla Jordanis. His son Bernard I succeeded him.
zh: 茹尔丹一世是加斯科涅的利勒茹尔丹领主，1089至1132年在位，继承父亲雷蒙之位。早在1071年的拉丁文文书中，其领地已以“茹尔丹之岛”的拉丁名出现。死后由儿子贝尔纳一世继位。

en: Jordan II was Lord of L'Isle-Jourdain in Gascony from 1161 to 1194, the son of Bernard I and Jordane. He married Escarone of Terride and was the father of Jordan III, who succeeded him.
zh: 茹尔丹二世是加斯科涅的利勒茹尔丹领主，1161至1194年在位，贝尔纳一世与若尔达娜之子。他娶泰里德的埃斯卡罗纳为妻，继承人茹尔丹三世是他的儿子。

en: Jordan III (c. 1150–1200) was Lord of L'Isle-Jourdain in Gascony, succeeding his father Jordan II in 1196. In 1175 he married Esclarmonde of Foix, daughter of Count Roger-Bernard I of Foix and sister of Count Raymond-Roger; the marriage produced six children, among them his heir Bernard Jordan. He warred with Bernard of Comminges until the count of Toulouse summoned both men to Verdun-sur-Garonne and made them lay down arms. He was dead by October 1200, when his widow turned to Catharism and became a leading Perfect.
zh: 茹尔丹三世（约1150—1200）是加斯科涅的利勒茹尔丹领主，1196年继承父亲茹尔丹二世之位。1175年，他娶富瓦伯爵罗歇-贝尔纳一世之女、富瓦伯爵雷蒙-罗歇之妹埃斯克拉蒙德·德·富瓦，两人生有六名子女，继承人贝尔纳·茹尔丹即其中之一。他与科曼日的贝尔纳交战，最后图卢兹伯爵亲自把两人召到加龙河畔韦尔丹，勒令放下武器。1200年10月他已离世，遗孀此后转向清洁派，成为重要的清洁派完人。

en: Jordan IV (c. 1220–1288) was Lord of L'Isle-Jourdain in Gascony, son of Bernard II and Indie of Toulouse, and a vassal of Alfonso of Poitou. Around 1260 he joined a troubadour poetic debate, a torneyamen, with Guiraut Riquier and others. A crusader in the Guelph wars of Italy, he took a contingent of knights and crossbowmen to Charles of Anjou in 1266 and was enfeoffed in Calabria. He soon returned to Gascony, but Charles threatened to confiscate his fiefs unless he returned. Jordan lingered until 1282, when he brought a new band of soldiers to Italy. In 1285 he took part in Philip III's Aragonese Crusade.
zh: 茹尔丹四世（约1220—1288）是加斯科涅的利勒茹尔丹领主，贝尔纳二世与图卢兹的安迪之子，普瓦捷的阿尔方斯的封臣。约1260年，他与吉罗·里基耶等人参加游吟诗人的诗歌论战‘托内亚曼’。他是投身意大利圭尔夫派战争的十字军战士，1266年率一队骑士与弩兵投奔安茹的查理，受封卡拉布里亚的封地。他不久便返回加斯科涅，查理威胁若他不回意大利就没收其封地。他拖延至1282年，才带着一队新兵返回意大利。1285年，他加入腓力三世的阿拉贡十字军。

en: Jordan V (c. 1250–1305) ruled the Gascon lordship of L'Isle-Jourdain from 1271 until his death. A son of Jordan IV, he married Guillaumine de Durfort and was succeeded by his son Bernard IV Jordan. His other son Jourdain was hanged at Montfaucon in 1323.
zh: 茹尔丹五世（约1250—1305）自1271年起统治加斯科涅的利勒茹尔丹领地，直至去世。他是茹尔丹四世之子，娶迪尔福的纪尧米娜，死后由儿子贝尔纳四世·茹尔丹继位；另一子小茹尔丹于1323年被绞死于蒙福孔。

en: Marguerite de Foix (c. 1275–1304) was a daughter of Count Roger-Bernard III of Foix and Margaret of Béarn. In 1291 she married Bernard IV Jordan, Lord of L'Isle-Jourdain; their children included Bertrand I, later lord, and Mathe, wife of Bernard VIII of Comminges.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·富瓦（约1275—1304）是富瓦伯爵罗歇-贝尔纳三世与贝阿恩的玛格丽特之女。1291年，她嫁给利勒茹尔丹领主贝尔纳四世·茹尔丹；子女包括后来继位的贝尔特朗一世和嫁给科曼日伯爵贝尔纳八世的玛特。

en: Odon Raymond (died 1038) is the first lord named in the recorded succession of L'Isle-Jourdain, ruling that Gascon lordship around 1000–1038 as a vassal of the counts of Toulouse. On his death his son Raymond succeeded him and ruled until 1089.
zh: 奥东·雷蒙（卒于1038年）是利勒茹尔丹传世世系中第一位具名的领主，约1000—1038年统治这块加斯科涅领地，为图卢兹伯爵的封臣。他死后儿子雷蒙继位，统治至1089年。

en: Raymond was Lord of L'Isle-Jourdain in Gascony from 1038 to 1089, succeeding his father Odo Raymond. Around 1040 he married Gervaise, daughter of Count William III Taillefer of Toulouse. His son Jordan I succeeded him.
zh: 雷蒙是加斯科涅的利勒茹尔丹领主，1038至1089年在位，继承父亲奥东·雷蒙之位。约1040年，他娶图卢兹伯爵纪尧姆三世·塔耶费尔之女热尔韦斯为妻。死后由儿子茹尔丹一世继位。

en: Bagrat I, called the Minor (Georgian mts'ire; died 1372) of the Bagrationi dynasty, succeeded his father Michael as king of Imereti in 1329 while still a child. With rival noble factions carving up the provinces, he could do little from his capital Kutaisi. In 1330 his relative George V the Brilliant of Georgia crossed the Likhi Range, annexed Imereti and reunited the Georgian kingdom; Bagrat was left as eristavi (duke) of Imereti, seated at Shorapani. In 1358, with David IX's leave, he married Natela, daughter of Qvarqvare I Jaqeli of Samtskhe, and fathered three kings, Alexander, George and Constantine.
zh: 巴格拉特一世绰号“年幼者”（格鲁吉亚语称姆齐列，？—1372），是巴格拉季昂王朝成员，1329年父亲米哈伊尔去世后继任伊梅雷蒂国王，当时尚是孩童。贵族派系瓜分各省，他困守首都库塔伊西而无所作为。1330年，他的亲戚、格鲁吉亚国王“辉煌者”吉奥尔基五世越过苏拉姆山脉征服伊梅雷蒂，重新统一格鲁吉亚王国；巴格拉特被降为伊梅雷蒂公爵（埃里斯塔维），驻节沙拉帕尼。1358年经大卫九世允许，他娶萨姆茨赫王公克瓦尔克瓦雷一世·贾克利之女纳特拉为妻，生下后来相继称王的亚历山大、吉奥尔基和君士坦丁。

en: Constantine I (died 1327) of the Bagrationi dynasty ruled Imereti, or Western Georgia, as king from 1293, when he succeeded his father David VI Narin. His younger brother Michael disputed the crown and seized the northern provinces of Racha, Lechkhumi and Argveti, and the brothers' civil war lasted until Constantine's death. The Dadiani, Sharvashidze and Gurieli princes exploited the chaos to turn Odishi, Abkhazia and Guria into virtually independent principalities. He died in 1327 without an heir, and Michael took the throne.
zh: 君士坦丁一世（？—1327年）出身巴格拉季昂王朝，1293年继承父亲大卫六世·纳林的王位，成为伊梅雷蒂（西格鲁吉亚）国王。他的弟弟米哈埃里争夺王位，占据拉恰、列奇胡米和阿尔格维蒂等北方省份，兄弟内战一直持续到他去世。达迪亚尼、沙尔瓦希泽和古里耶利等王公趁机使奥迪希、阿布哈兹和古里亚成为近乎独立的公国。他于1327年去世，无子嗣，王位由米哈埃里继承。

en: Michael I (died 1329) of the Bagrationi dynasty was a younger son of David VI Narin of Imereti. When his brother Constantine I took the throne in 1293, Michael rebelled and held the northern provinces of Racha, Lechkhumi and Argveti through nearly thirty-five years of civil war, while the western nobles carved out de facto independence. He reached the throne only in 1327, after the childless Constantine died. As king he failed to bring the Dadiani, Gurieli and other princes to heel, and at his death in 1329 he left his young son Bagrat I as heir.
zh: 米哈埃里一世（？—1329年）出身巴格拉季昂王朝，是伊梅雷蒂国王大卫六世·纳林的幼子之一。1293年兄长君士坦丁一世即位时他起兵争夺，据有拉恰、列奇胡米和阿尔格维蒂等北方省份，内战持续近三十五年，西方诸贵族趁机取得事实独立。直到1327年无嗣的君士坦丁去世，他才登上王位。在位期间他未能使达迪亚尼、古里耶利等王公臣服，1329年去世，留下年幼的儿子巴格拉特一世继位。

en: Alidosia Alidosi was a daughter of Lippo II Alidosi, papal vicar and first lord of Imola, and of his second wife Cianghella della Tosa, the Florentine woman Dante recalls in the fifteenth canto of Paradise. She married Lippo Severoli.
zh: 阿利多西亚·阿利多西是伊莫拉首任教廷代牧兼领主利波二世·阿利多西与第二任妻子、佛罗伦萨人钱盖拉·德拉·托萨之女——但丁在《神曲·天堂篇》第十五章曾追忆其母。她嫁给了利波·塞韦罗利。

en: Alidosio Alidosi was an Italian nobleman of the Alidosi family of Imola. From 1278 to 1288 he governed the city as prefect and captain of the people, with the Latin title Defensor Pupuli Civitatis Imole. With his brother Mainardo he again became captain of the people at Imola on 29 November 1290. In 1291 he commanded nearby Forlì, but a popular rising in March 1292 drove the Alidosi out of Imola. He held the captaincy for the last time in 1302 and is last recorded alive on 31 August 1311.
zh: 阿利多西奥·阿利多西是伊莫拉阿利多西家族的意大利贵族。1278至1288年，他以长官和人民领袖的身份治理该城，拥有拉丁文头衔‘伊莫拉人民保卫者’。1290年11月29日，他与兄弟马伊纳尔多再度在伊莫拉自立为人民领袖。1291年他统领邻近的弗利，但1292年3月民众起事，将阿利多西家族逐出伊莫拉。1302年他最后一次出任人民领袖；史料中关于他的最后记载是1311年8月31日仍在世。

en: Alidosio Alidosi was an early member of the Alidosi family near Imola. In 1209 he and his brother Lito, called Malgarito, received the fief of Massa di Sant'Ambrogio from Emperor Otto IV, with full jurisdiction over it.
zh: 阿利多西奥·阿利多西是伊莫拉一带阿利多西家族的早期成员。1209年，他与绰号“马尔加里托”的兄弟利托一同获皇帝奥托四世册封圣安布罗焦马萨，对该封地享有完整管辖权。

en: Azzo Alidosi (died 1372), a son of Roberto Alidosi, was an Italian condottiero who succeeded his father as papal vicar and lord of Imola in 1362. Serving the Church under Cardinal Gil de Albornoz, he entered Bologna for the pope in 1360; as a friend of both sides, he was sent to take possession of Fermo, which Albornoz had ceded in exchange for Bologna. His rule was troubled: in 1363 a revolt led by his brother Bertrando ended with both brothers carried to Bologna by papal forces, and he was jailed there again in 1366. He married Rengarda Manfredi of Faenza and later Margherita di Castelbarco, and died in 1372.
zh: 阿佐·阿利多西（？—1372）是罗伯托·阿利多西之子，意大利佣兵首领，1362年父亲死后成为伊莫拉的教廷代牧兼领主。他曾在枢机主教吉尔·德·阿尔沃诺斯麾下为教会效力，1360年代表教皇进入博洛尼亚；作为双方的友人，他受命前往接管费尔莫，阿尔沃诺斯曾以该城换回博洛尼亚。他在伊莫拉的统治并不安稳：1363年其弟贝特朗多起兵反叛，兄弟二人均被教廷军队带往博洛尼亚；1366年他又一次被囚禁于该城。他先娶法恩扎统治家族的伦加尔达·曼弗雷迪，后娶玛格丽塔·迪·卡斯泰尔巴科，1372年去世。

en: Bartolomea Alidosi was a daughter of Lippo II Alidosi, papal vicar and lord of Imola, and his wife Cianghella della Tosa. She married Pandolfo da Polenta, who ruled Ravenna and Cervia and was starved to death in prison there by his brother Bernardino in 1347.
zh: 巴托洛梅娅·阿利多西是伊莫拉教廷代牧兼领主利波二世·阿利多西之妻钱盖拉·德拉·托萨之女，嫁给潘多尔福·达·波伦塔。潘多尔福曾短暂统治拉文纳与切尔维亚，1347年被其兄贝尔纳迪诺囚禁于切尔维亚，最终活活饿死。

en: Bertrando Alidosi (died 12 November 1391), son of Roberto Alidosi, was an Italian condottiero who ruled Imola as papal vicar from 1372 until his death, succeeding his brother Azzo, with whom Pope Urban V had associated him. In 1365 he received the lordships of Castel del Rio, Monte La Fine and Castiglione. Like Azzo he was twice imprisoned at Bologna by papal forces in 1366, and in 1371 a revolt drove him to Avignon, where Pope Gregory XI sheltered him. He died at Imola in 1391, succeeded by his son Luigi, called Ludovico, the last Alidosi lord of the city.
zh: 贝特朗多·阿利多西（？—1391）是罗伯托·阿利多西之子，意大利佣兵首领。教皇乌尔班五世命他协助兄长阿佐共同执政，1372年阿佐死后，他继任伊莫拉的教廷代牧兼领主，直至去世。1365年，他受封卡斯泰尔德里奥、蒙特拉菲内和卡斯蒂廖内的领主权。1366年他与阿佐两度被教廷军队囚禁于博洛尼亚；1371年又因叛乱被迫逃往阿维尼翁，受到教皇格里高利十一世庇护。1391年他死于伊莫拉，其子路易（卢多维科）继位，是阿利多西家族在伊莫拉的最后一位领主。

en: Carlo Alidosi (died 1354) was a son of Lippo II Alidosi, lord of Imola, and became bishop of his native city while still a cathedral canon, appointed by Pope Clement VI. In 1346 he held Imola's first diocesan synod, and in 1350 he brought the Humiliati order to Dozza. He had the church of Sant'Agostino built in Imola and worked to recover Church estates seized in the wars. Shortly before his death in 1354, Cardinal Gil de Albornoz asked him to publish the excommunication of Francesco I Ordelaffi of Forlì and Guglielmo Manfredi of Faenza.
zh: 卡洛·阿利多西（？—1354）生于伊莫拉，是伊莫拉僭主利波二世·阿利多西之子。他担任伊莫拉主教座堂咏礼司铎时，被教皇克雷芒六世任命为家乡的主教。1346年他主持了伊莫拉首次教区会议，1350年把谦卑修会引入多扎。他在伊莫拉修建了圣奥斯定教堂，并致力于收复战乱中被侵占的教会地产。1354年去世前不久，枢机主教埃吉迪奥·阿尔沃诺斯要求他宣布开除弗利僭主弗朗切斯科一世·奥尔德拉菲和法恩扎僭主古列尔莫·曼弗雷迪的教籍。

en: Cianghella della Tosa (c. 1290–1339) was a Florentine noblewoman, daughter of Arrigo della Tosa and cousin of Rosso della Tosa, a Black Guelph leader of Florence. She became the second wife of Lippo II Alidosi, who seized Imola in 1334 and became its papal vicar in 1336. Reputedly proud and quarrelsome, she separated from him and returned to Florence, where she was said to live scandalously. Dante's ancestor Cacciaguida names her in canto fifteen of Paradiso as a byword for the city's later corruption. She died in Florence on 19 March 1339.
zh: 钱盖拉·德拉·托萨（约1290—1339）是佛罗伦萨贵族女子，阿里戈·德拉·托萨之女，佛罗伦萨黑圭尔夫派首领罗索·德拉·托萨的堂妹。她嫁给伊莫拉领主利波二世·阿利多西为续弦；利波于1334年夺取伊莫拉，1336年成为当地的教皇代官。相传钱盖拉生性骄横好斗，后来与丈夫分离回到佛罗伦萨，生活放荡。但丁的先祖卡恰圭达在《神曲·天堂篇》第十五歌中点到她的名字，把她当作后世佛罗伦萨道德败坏的典型。她于1339年3月19日在佛罗伦萨去世。

en: Lippo Alidosi was a son of Lippo II Alidosi, lord of Imola from 1334 to 1350, and a brother of Roberto Alidosi, who succeeded their father as papal vicar of Imola in 1350.
zh: 利波·阿利多西是1334至1350年统治伊莫拉的利波二世·阿利多西之子，也是1350年继任伊莫拉教皇代官的罗伯托·阿利多西的兄弟。

en: Lippo I Alidosi was de facto lord of Imola from 1278 to 1288, ruling as captain of the people with the title Defensor Pupuli Imole et Capitaneus Civitatis Imole. The papal inquisitor of Romagna imprisoned him together with his nephew Lippo II Alidosi. In 1317 he plotted to reconquer Imola and make himself master of the city again, but he died shortly afterwards.
zh: 利波一世·阿利多西是1278至1288年间伊莫拉事实上的领主，以人民领袖身份执政，头衔为‘伊莫拉人民保卫者兼伊莫拉城队长’。罗马涅的教皇宗教裁判官将他与侄子利波二世·阿利多西一同下狱。1317年，他图谋重新夺取伊莫拉、再度自立为该城之主，但不久后便死去。

en: Lippo II Alidosi (died 1350), also called Litto, was the first Alidosi lord of Imola. A son of Alidosio Alidosi, he fought the Este in 1333 while they warred with the Church, was captured, and later released. In March 1334, when Bologna expelled the papal legate Bertrand du Poujet, established governments were overthrown in several other towns. Lippo seized power in Imola and served the new free commune of Bologna as podestà in 1334–1335. Pope Benedict XII named him papal vicar of Imola in 1336, and Clement VI confirmed the vicariate in 1346. He joined the 1340 league formed to check the Visconti and ruled Imola until his death.
zh: 利波二世·阿利多西（？—1350），又称利托，是阿利多西家族统治伊莫拉的第一人。他是阿利多西奥·阿利多西之子，1333年埃斯特家族与教会交战时他与其作战，被俘后获释。1334年3月博洛尼亚驱逐教皇使节贝尔特朗·迪·普热，其他多座城镇的原有政权也被推翻。利波在伊莫拉掌权，并于1334至1335年出任新生的博洛尼亚自由公社最高长官。1336年教皇本笃十二世封他为伊莫拉教皇代牧，1346年克雷芒六世予以确认。他还加入了1340年遏制维斯孔蒂家族的同盟，统治伊莫拉直至去世。

en: Luigi Alidosi was a son of Roberto Alidosi, papal vicar and lord of Imola. His brothers Azzo and Bertrando in turn ruled the city as papal vicars after their father's death.
zh: 路易·阿利多西是伊莫拉教廷代牧兼领主罗伯托·阿利多西之子。他的兄弟阿佐与贝特朗多在父亲死后先后以教廷代牧身份统治伊莫拉。

en: Madonna Alidosi was a daughter of Roberto Alidosi, papal vicar and lord of Imola. Her brothers Azzo and Bertrando succeeded one another as papal vicars of the city.
zh: 马多娜·阿利多西是伊莫拉教廷代牧兼领主罗伯托·阿利多西之女，她的兄弟阿佐与贝特朗多相继出任该城的教廷代牧。

en: Riccardo Alidosi was a soldier and son of Lippo II Alidosi, lord of Imola from 1334 to 1350. His brother Roberto succeeded their father at Imola in 1350.
zh: 里卡尔多·阿利多西是一名军人，是1334至1350年统治伊莫拉的利波二世·阿利多西之子。他的兄弟罗伯托·阿利多西于1350年继任伊莫拉领主。

en: Roberto Alidosi (died 29 November 1362) was an Italian nobleman who ruled Imola as papal vicar from 1350, succeeding his father Lippo II Alidosi, the city's first signore. In 1356 he served as captain of the papal army. He married first Michelina Malatesta, daughter of Malatesta III Malatesta, lord of Pesaro, and after her death Giacoma Pepoli of the ruling Bolognese family. On his death at Imola in 1362 he was succeeded by his son Azzo; a second son, Bertrando, later held the signoria as well.
zh: 罗伯托·阿利多西（1362年11月29日去世）是意大利贵族，1350年起以教皇代官身份统治伊莫拉，继其父、伊莫拉首任领主利波二世·阿利多西之后掌权。1356年他出任教皇军队统领。他先娶佩萨罗领主马拉泰斯塔三世·马拉泰斯塔之女米凯利娜·马拉泰斯塔，丧妻后又娶博洛尼亚统治家族的贾科马·佩波利。1362年他在伊莫拉去世，由儿子阿佐继任；另一个儿子贝尔特拉多后来也领有伊莫拉。

en: İshak Bey was the last bey of the İnançid principality of Lâdik around Denizli, succeeding his father Murad Arslan Bey, who died before 1362. Continuing his father's patronage of learning, he had a madrasa built in Denizli that still bore his name in the sixteenth century. Around 1368 his small beylik, hard pressed by the Germiyan dynasty, accepted Germiyan overlordship. He was still alive in 1391, when he sold part of his estates to the Ottoman sultan Bayezid I during the latter's campaign at Denizli.
zh: 伊沙克贝伊是以代尼兹利为中心的伊南奇（拉迪克）侯国末代贝伊，在1362年前继父亲穆拉德·阿尔斯兰贝伊而立。他延续父亲对学术的扶持，在代尼兹利修建了一座以自己名字命名的经学院，该建筑到16世纪仍然存在。约1368年，迫于格尔米扬王朝的压力，他的小侯国承认了格尔米扬的宗主权。1391年他仍在世，奥斯曼苏丹巴耶济德一世兵临代尼兹利时，他把部分地产卖给了后者。

en: Murad Arslan Bey was ruler of the İnançid beylik of Lâdik, the small Turkmen principality centered on Denizli in southwestern Anatolia. Succeeding his father İnanç Mehmed Bey in 1336, he maintained the close ties his house had built with neighbouring rulers such as the Germiyan and Aydın beys. A patron of learning, he promoted scholarly work and encouraged the writing of books in Turkish. He died before 1362 and was succeeded by his son İshak Bey, under whom the beylik accepted Germiyan rule around 1368.
zh: 穆拉德·阿尔斯兰贝伊是伊南奇（拉迪克）贝伊国的统治者，这是以安纳托利亚西南部代尼兹利为中心的土库曼小侯国。他于1336年继承父亲伊南奇·穆罕默德贝伊之位，维系着家族与格尔米扬、艾登等邻邦贝伊的密切关系。他提倡学术，鼓励用土耳其语著书立说。他于1362年前去世，其子伊沙克贝伊继位；约1368年，伊南奇侯国在伊沙克治下承认了格尔米扬的统治。

en: Ghiyath al-Din Kai-Khusrau was a son of Sharaf al-Din Mahmud Shah, the Injuid governor of Fars for the Ilkhans. As his father's deputy in Shiraz, he joined the Muzaffarid ruler Mubariz al-Din Muhammad in 1327 to drive the atabeg Haji Shah from Yazd. After Abu Sa'id's death in 1335 he expelled the Ilkhanid replacement governor and ruled Fars as an independent amir. When his elder brother Mas'ud Shah entered Shiraz in 1338, Kai-Khusrau refused him submission, was defeated in the ensuing war, and died in his brother's prison.
zh: 吉亚斯丁·凯霍斯鲁是伊儿汗国法尔斯总督、因珠人谢拉夫丁·马哈茂德沙之子。他代父镇守设拉子，1327年与穆扎法尔王朝的穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德联手，把阿塔贝格·哈吉沙赶出亚兹德。1335年伊儿汗不赛因死后，他驱逐伊儿汗国派来接替的总督，以独立埃米尔身份统治法尔斯。1338年，长兄马斯乌德沙进入设拉子，凯霍斯鲁拒绝臣服，战败后死在兄长的狱中。

en: Jalal al-Din Mas'ud Shah was a son of Sharaf al-Din Mahmud Shah, founder of Injuid rule in Fars. After his father was executed by the Ilkhan Arpa Ke'un in 1335, he fled to the Jalayirid Hasan Buzurg; when Arpa was later captured by rebels, he was handed to Mas'ud Shah and killed. Mas'ud Shah served as vizier to the Jalayirid puppet Ilkhan Muhammad Khan, then contested Shiraz with his brother Kai-Khusrau until the latter died in 1338/39. Driven out by the Chobanids, he allied with Yagi Basti, who murdered him in 1342.
