zh: 让·采克拉斯，即蒂利伯爵（1559—1632），是三十年战争中天主教阵营的主要统帅。他生于西属尼德兰的蒂利城堡，在科隆接受耶稣会教育，早年随亚历山大·法尔内塞与荷兰人作战，参加过1585年的安特卫普围城战，后又在匈牙利攻打土耳其人。1610年，巴伐利亚公爵马克西米连任命他为天主教联盟军队司令。他1620年取得白山战役大捷，参与征服普法尔茨，1626年在卢特击溃丹麦军队。1631年他洗劫马格德堡，造成约两万名居民死亡。此后他在布莱登菲尔德被古斯塔夫·阿道夫击败，1632年又在班贝格击败瑞典军队。同年他在雷恩之战中受致命伤，4月30日死于因戈尔施塔特。

en: John Barbour (c. 1320–1395) was a Scottish churchman and the first major poet to write in Scots. Educated at Oxford and Paris, he became archdeacon of Aberdeen in 1356 and later served in the household of his patron, Robert II. He was an exchequer auditor in 1372 and a clerk of audit in 1373. For the king he composed The Brus, a verse chronicle of Robert the Bruce and the Scottish wars of independence, including the victory at Bannockburn; he was paid ten pounds for it in 1377 and granted a life pension in 1378. He died at Aberdeen in March 1395, leaving The Brus as the founding epic of Scottish poetry.
zh: 约翰·巴伯（约1320—1395）是苏格兰教士，也是第一位有确切姓名的苏格兰语重要诗人。他曾在牛津和巴黎求学，1356年成为阿伯丁会吏长，后来在庇护人罗伯特二世的宫廷中任职。1372年他担任财政审计官，1373年任审计书记。他为国王创作长诗《布鲁斯》，以韵文记述罗伯特·布鲁斯和苏格兰独立战争，其中包括班诺克本大捷；1377年他因此获赏十镑，1378年又获终身年金。1395年3月他在阿伯丁去世，《布鲁斯》成为苏格兰诗歌的奠基史诗。

en: John Calvin (1509–1564), born Jean Cauvin at Noyon in Picardy, trained as a humanist lawyer before breaking with the Roman Catholic Church around 1530. After anti-Protestant violence in France he fled to Basel, where the first edition of his Institutes of the Christian Religion appeared in 1536. Persuaded by William Farel, he joined the Reformation in Geneva; resistance from the city council led to their expulsion in 1538. Calvin ministered to French refugees in Strasbourg before returning in 1541 to reshape Geneva's church and liturgy. His denunciation of Michael Servetus led to Servetus being burned at the stake in 1553. Calvin promoted the Reformation across Europe and died at Geneva in 1564.
zh: 约翰·加尔文（1509—1564）原名让·科万，生于皮卡第的努瓦永，早年受教成为人文主义法学家，约1530年与罗马教会决裂。法国发生迫害新教徒的暴力后，他逃往巴塞尔，1536年在那里出版初版《基督教要义》。他受威廉·法雷尔之邀到日内瓦推动宗教改革，因市议会反对，两人于1538年被逐。加尔文在斯特拉斯堡为法国难民牧会，1541年重返日内瓦，改革当地教会与礼仪。他谴责米格尔·塞尔韦特，导致后者于1553年被处以火刑。加尔文在欧洲各地推动宗教改革，1564年在日内瓦去世。

en: John of Fordun (died c. 1384) was a Scottish priest and chronicler, probably a chaplain at St Machar's Cathedral in Aberdeen. Outraged that Edward III's armies had carried off or destroyed Scotland's old records, he travelled through England and Ireland gathering material for the first continuous history of his country. Written in Latin and divided into five books, his Chronica Gentis Scotorum traced the Scottish kings back to the legendary Fergus I and ended with David I's death in 1153. Its first three books cover an early history that cannot be verified, but later historians Hector Boece and George Buchanan drew on them. Walter Bower later continued it as the Scotichronicon, and Fordun remained the foundation of Scottish historiography for centuries.
zh: 约翰·福顿（约1384年卒）是苏格兰教士、编年史家，可能在阿伯丁的圣马查尔大教堂任神父。爱德华三世的军队夺走或销毁了苏格兰的古老档案，他愤而周游英格兰和爱尔兰搜集材料，撰写苏格兰第一部通史。这部拉丁文著作分为五卷，称《苏格兰人编年史》，把苏格兰王世系上溯到传说中的弗格斯一世，止于1153年大卫一世去世。前三卷记述的早期历史无法证实，但后来的史家赫克托·博伊斯和乔治·布坎南仍取材于此。沃尔特·鲍尔后来将其续写为《苏格兰编年史》，福顿的著作在数百年间一直是苏格兰史学的基础。

en: John Law (1671–1729) was a Scottish financier whose theories reshaped French finances under the Regency. Born in Edinburgh, he killed a man in a duel in 1694, escaped a death sentence, and made his way as a gambler across Europe. In 1716 the regent Philippe d'Orléans let him found a note-issuing bank, nationalized as the Banque royale in 1718. The bank took gold deposits in exchange for notes and lent out the gold. His Mississippi Company (1717), created to develop Louisiana and other French colonies, drove the speculation of the Mississippi Bubble. Made controller-general of finances in 1720, he fled France when it collapsed and died impoverished in Venice in 1729.
zh: 约翰·罗（1671—1729）是苏格兰金融家，他的理论在摄政时期重塑了法国财政。他生于爱丁堡，1694年在决斗中杀死一人，逃脱死刑后以赌徒身份辗转欧洲各地。1716年，摄政王奥尔良公爵腓力批准他创办发行纸币的银行，该行于1718年被国家收编为王家银行。银行以纸币换取黄金存款，再将黄金贷出。他1717年创立、旨在开发路易斯安那及其他法国殖民地的密西西比公司，掀起了“密西西比泡沫”的投机狂潮。1720年他出任财政总监，泡沫破裂后被迫逃离法国，1729年穷困潦倒地死于威尼斯。

en: Ndiadiane Ndiaye (also Njaajan Njaay) is the legendary founder of the Jolof Empire, remembered in the oral histories of the Wolof and Serer; the dates of his reign are unknown. Tradition makes him the son of Fatoumata Sall and says he grew up in the upper Senegal valley. When his mother remarried after his father's death, he left home and travelled down the Senegal River to Waalo, where his good judgments led the people to choose him as ruler. After sixteen years there he founded the Jolof state by peaceful means. Wolof tradition adds that the Wolof language took shape at his court from the Fula, Serer and Mandinka speech of his subjects, and the royal bath at coronations in Waalo and Jolof recalled the place where he first emerged from the river. His son Sare Ndiadiane succeeded him, beginning the Ndiaye dynasty, which ruled Jolof until the 19th century.
zh: 恩迪亚迪亚内·恩迪亚耶（又作恩贾詹·恩贾伊）是乔洛夫帝国传说中的建立者，沃洛夫人和塞雷尔人的口述历史都记着他，其在位年代不详。相传他是法图玛塔·萨尔之子，在上塞内加尔河谷长大。父亲去世、母亲改嫁后，他离家出走，沿塞内加尔河来到瓦洛，因断事公允被当地人推举为首领。统治瓦洛十六年后，他以和平方式建立了乔洛夫国家。沃洛夫人的传说还说，沃洛夫语就是在他的宫廷里，由臣民所说的富拉语、塞雷尔语和曼丁卡语混合而成；瓦洛与乔洛夫加冕礼上的王室沐浴，则是为了纪念他最初从河中走出的地方。他死后，其子萨尔·恩迪亚迪亚内继位，开创恩迪亚耶王朝，该王朝统治乔洛夫直至19世纪。

en: Joseph-Ignace Guillotin (1738–1814) was a French physician and politician born at Saintes. In 1784 he served on a royal commission investigating Franz Mesmer's theory of animal magnetism. His 1788 petition on the composition of the Estates-General brought him public support despite an attempt to suppress it. A Paris deputy to the Estates-General of 1789, he helped the locked-out National Assembly find the tennis court where members swore the Tennis Court Oath. On 10 October 1789 he proposed that executions be carried out by a simple beheading machine, hoping a swifter, painless death would be a step toward abolishing capital punishment. He neither designed nor built the device, but a mocking song attached his name to it. He died in Paris in 1814.
zh: 约瑟夫-伊尼亚斯·吉约丹（1738—1814）是法国医生和政治家，生于桑特。1784年，他加入皇家委员会，调查弗朗茨·梅斯默的动物磁力理论。1788年，他就三级会议的组成撰写请愿书，尽管当局试图压制，仍为他赢得公众支持。他是1789年三级会议的巴黎代表，曾在国民议会被拒之门外时指引议员们前往网球场，由此立下网球场宣誓。1789年10月10日，他提议以简单的机械斩首装置执行死刑，希望这种迅速而少痛苦的处死方式成为废除死刑的第一步。他并未参与该装置的设计或制造，但一首嘲讽歌曲让他的名字与它永远连在一起。1814年他在巴黎去世。

en: Josetsu was a Zen painter-monk active in Kyoto in the early fifteenth century and one of the founders of suiboku ink painting in Japan. Resident at Shōkoku-ji, he is regarded as the teacher of Tenshō Shūbun, who carried his Chinese-derived landscape style into the Ashikaga painting academy. His best-known work, Catching a Catfish with a Gourd, painted around 1413, depicts a comical fisherman against a winding river and a bamboo grove. It is thought to have been inspired by a riddle posed by the Ashikaga shōgun: how to catch a catfish with a gourd. The image can be read as Zen humour or as a visual kōan inviting the viewer to see in new ways.
zh: 如拙是15世纪初活跃于京都的禅僧画师，也是日本水墨画的奠基人之一。他驻锡相国寺，被视为天章周文的老师；周文后来把他取法中国的山水画风带入足利幕府画院。他最著名的作品《瓢鲇图》约作于1413年，画中一位滑稽的渔人身后是蜿蜒的河流和竹林。此画被认为取材于足利幕府将军所出的谜题：怎样用葫芦捉住鲶鱼。这幅画可被视为禅宗幽默，或一则引导观者换个角度看问题的图像公案。

en: Jarwan ibn Nasser al-Maliki, called Jarwan I, founded the Jarwanid dynasty of Shiite Arabs in fourteenth-century Eastern Arabia. From the port of Qatif he seized power over the Bahrain region, driving out the forces of Sa'id ibn Mughamis, chief of the Muntafiq tribe based at Basra. Contemporary authors including Ibn Battuta and Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani describe the Jarwanids as rawafid, Shia who rejected the first three caliphs, and mosques under their rule followed the Shia form of prayer. The dynasty he founded fell to the Jabrids in the fifteenth century.
zh: 贾尔万·伊本·纳赛尔·马利基即贾尔万一世，是14世纪东阿拉伯什叶派阿拉伯政权贾尔万王朝的建立者。他以港口卡提夫为据点，夺取巴林地区的统治权，驱逐了以巴士拉为基地的蒙塔菲格部落酋长赛义德·伊本·穆加米斯的军队。伊本·白图泰、伊本·哈杰尔·阿斯卡拉尼等当时学者称贾尔万人为“拉斐德”，即拒绝承认前三任哈里发的什叶派；在其治下，清真寺按什叶派方式礼拜。他建立的王朝于15世纪被贾布尔王朝取代。

en: Rawal Gharsi Singh was a Bhati Rajput ruler of the Kingdom of Jaisalmer who reigned from 1306 to 1335, succeeding Rawal Durjan Sal, also called Duda, and followed by Rawal Kehar Singh II.
zh: 拉瓦尔·加尔西·辛格是斋沙默尔王国的婆提拉杰普特统治者，1306至1335年在位，继又称杜达的拉瓦尔·杜尔詹·萨尔之后即位，死后由拉瓦尔·凯哈尔·辛格二世继位。

en: Elisabeth of Brabant-Aarschot (c. 1280–1350/1355) was a daughter of Godfrey of Brabant, Lord of Aarschot, and Jeanne, Lady of Vierzon. Before 1299 she married Gerhard V, Count of Jülich; her sons included the first Duke of Jülich, William I.
zh: 布拉班特的伊丽莎白（约1280—1350/1355）是阿尔斯霍特领主布拉班特的戈弗雷与维耶尔宗女领主让娜之女。1299年之前她嫁给于利希伯爵格哈德五世，儿子中包括于利希首任公爵威廉一世。

en: Gerhard V of Jülich (before 1250–1328), youngest son of Count William IV, succeeded his brother Walram as count in 1297. He fought for King Adolf at Göllheim in 1298 and, after Adolf's fall, submitted to Albert I, who confirmed his imperial fief. In 1300 he aided Albert against the Rhenish electors and secured Rhine tolls at Kaiserswerth against the Archbishop of Cologne. In 1313 he backed Louis the Bavarian for the crown and allowed his Aachen coronation despite Cologne's protests. He married Elisabeth of Brabant and died on 29 July 1328, succeeded by his son William.
zh: 于利希的格哈德五世（1250年前—1328）是于利希伯爵威廉四世最小的儿子，1297年继兄长瓦尔拉姆之后袭爵。1298年他在格尔海姆之战中为国王阿道夫作战；阿道夫败死后，他向阿尔布雷希特一世臣服，后者确认了他的帝国采邑。1300年他协助阿尔布雷希特对抗莱茵选侯，并从科隆大主教手中取得凯泽斯韦特等地的莱茵河关税。1313年他支持巴伐利亚人路易争夺王位，不顾科隆大主教反对，允许其在亚琛加冕。他娶布拉班特的伊丽莎白，1328年7月29日去世，儿子威廉继位。

en: Gerhard VI of Jülich (c. 1325–1360) was Count of Berg and Ravensberg, the eldest son of William I of Jülich and Joanna of Hainaut. About 1344 he married Margaret of Ravensberg, heiress of Ravensberg and, through her mother, of the County of Berg; as her paternal and maternal uncles died without issue between 1346 and 1348, both counties passed to the House of Jülich. Gerhard opposed the Archbishop of Cologne and won places including Hardenberg, Neviges and Kaiserswerth. He died at a tournament in Düsseldorf on 18 May 1360 and was buried at Altenberg Abbey; his son William succeeded in Berg.
zh: 于利希的格哈德六世（约1325—1360）是贝格与拉文斯贝格伯爵，为于利希的威廉一世与埃诺的让娜的长子。约1344年，他娶拉文斯贝格的玛格丽特——她是拉文斯贝格的女继承人，并凭母系拥有贝格伯国的继承权；1346至1348年间她的叔父与舅父先后绝嗣而终，两个伯国遂并入于利希家族。格哈德与科隆大主教对抗，夺取哈登贝格、内维格斯、凯泽斯韦特等地。1360年5月18日，他在杜塞尔多夫的一场骑士比武中身亡，葬于阿尔滕贝格修道院，其子威廉继领贝格。

en: Joanna of Hainaut (c. 1312–1374) became countess of Jülich through her marriage to William V of Jülich, celebrated in Cologne on 26 February 1324. She was the third daughter of William I the Good, Count of Hainaut, Holland and Zeeland, and Joan of Valois, and a younger sister of Philippa of Hainault, queen of Edward III of England. In 1329 she and her mother travelled to England to visit Queen Philippa. Her children included William II, Duke of Jülich, and Gerhard VI, Count of Berg and Ravensberg, maternal grandfather of Adolph I, Duke of Cleves.
zh: 埃诺的让娜（约1312—1374）于1324年2月26日在科隆与于利希的威廉五世成婚，成为于利希伯爵夫人。她是埃诺、荷兰与泽兰伯爵“好人”威廉一世与瓦卢瓦的让娜的第三个女儿，也是英格兰国王爱德华三世之后埃诺的菲莉琶的妹妹。1329年，她随母亲前往英格兰探望王后菲莉琶。她的子女包括于利希公爵威廉二世，以及贝格与拉文斯贝格伯爵格哈德六世——后者是克莱沃公爵阿道夫一世的外祖父。

en: William I (c. 1299–1361) ruled Jülich as count from 1328, margrave from 1336 and, from 1356, as its first duke. Eldest son of Count Gerhard V, he married Joanna of Hainaut in 1324, making him brother-in-law to Edward III of England and Emperor Lewis IV. In 1337 he helped form the German-English alliance that opened the Hundred Years' War, later backing Charles IV, who raised him to duke. His sons imprisoned him during a revolt of Jülich knights in 1349, but he was freed in 1351. He died in 1361 and was followed by his second son, William II.
zh: 威廉一世（约1299—1361）自1328年起任于利希伯爵，1336年成为藩侯，1356年成为于利希首任公爵。他是格哈德五世伯爵的长子，1324年娶埃诺的让娜，由此成为英格兰国王爱德华三世与皇帝路易四世的连襟。1337年，他参与促成开启百年战争的德英同盟，后来转而支持查理四世，由后者将他晋封为公爵。1349年于利希骑士叛乱时，他被儿子们囚禁，1351年获释。他于1361年去世，由次子威廉二世继位。

en: Jayaba Mukne, also called Jayadev Rao Naik, was the founder and first raja of Jawhar in the northern Konkan. A chief of the Mahadev Koli people, he established the Mukne dynasty and the state of Jawhar in 1306. He married Mohanadevi of the Sisodia Rajput house and was succeeded by his son Dhulba Rao, later the raja Nemshah Mukne, who in June 1343 received the title of shah from Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq.
zh: 阇耶跋·穆克内又称阇耶提婆·拉奥·纳伊克，是孔坎北部乔哈尔的开国之君、第一代罗阇。他是摩诃提婆·科利人的首领，于1306年建立穆克内王朝和乔哈尔邦。他娶斯苏提阿家族拉杰普特人摩诃那拜为妻，死后由其子图尔巴·拉奥继位，即后来的罗阇内姆沙阿·穆克内，后者于1343年6月获苏丹穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克授予“沙阿”称号。

en: Mohanabai, called Rani Mohanabai of Dharmagad, was a Sisodia Rajput princess who married Jayaba Mukne, founder of the Jawhar state. Her two sons, Nem Shah and Holkar Rao Mukne, were born of the marriage.
zh: 摩诃那拜又称达尔马加德的拉尼·摩诃那拜，是斯苏提阿家族的拉杰普特公主，嫁给乔哈尔开国之君阇耶跋·穆克内，育有内姆沙阿和霍尔卡尔·拉奥·穆克内两子。

en: Vasily Mikhailovich (1304–1368), known as Vasily of Kashin, was the youngest son of Mikhail of Tver and Anna of Kashin. In 1319 he received Kashin as an appanage, and after the anti-Tatar uprising of 1327 he fled Tver for Ladoga. In 1346 the khan Jani Beg granted the Tver patent to his nephew Vsevolod, who intercepted and robbed him at Bezdezh, but in 1349 Vsevolod surrendered the throne and Vasily became prince of Tver. He spent his reign feuding with his nephews and warring with Lithuania, and died at Kashin in July 1368.
zh: 瓦西里·米哈伊洛维奇（1304—1368），人称卡申的瓦西里，是特维尔王公米哈伊尔·雅罗斯拉维奇与卡申的安娜最小的儿子。1319年，他获得卡申作为采邑；1327年特维尔爆发反抗鞑靼人的起义，他逃往拉多加。1346年，金帐汗札尼别把特维尔的册封诏书颁给其侄弗谢沃洛德，后者还在别兹杰拦截并洗劫了他；1349年弗谢沃洛德让出王位，瓦西里成为特维尔大公。他在位期间与诸侄争斗、同立陶宛交战，1368年7月死于卡申。

en: Basir Onin succeeded his father Imaga, who in 1309 founded the Papuan kingdom of Sran later called Kaimana, becoming its second Rat Sran and ruling with the title Rat Sran Adi. He moved the royal capital from Weri to Borombouw on Adi Island, judging the island a strategic seat on the shipping and trade route leading to the Koiwai mainland. In later life he declared himself too old to rule and installed his son Woran as king in his place.
zh: 巴西尔·奥宁继承父亲伊马加，成为巴布亚斯兰王国（后称凯马纳王国，伊马加于1309年建王国）的第二代拉特·斯兰，王号为“拉特·斯兰·阿迪”。他把王都从韦里迁往阿迪岛上的博龙布，认为该岛扼守通往科伊瓦伊大陆的航运贸易要冲。晚年他自称年迈退位，立之子沃兰继任国王。

en: Imaga, who bore the title Rat Sran Nati Patimunin, was the founder of the Kingdom of Sran, later called Kaimana, on the Bomberai Peninsula of West Papua. Papuan oral tradition relates that he came from the Mbaham highlands of the Patimunin region and bound the scattered villages to himself by visits and marriage alliances, until in 1309 they raised him as their king. He set his capital at Weri on Tunasgain Bay in Fakfak and traded with merchants from Seram. His brother Imuli founded the neighboring kingdom of Baham.
zh: 伊马加的王号为“拉特·斯兰·纳蒂·帕蒂穆尼”，相传是西巴布亚邦巴赖半岛斯兰王国（后称凯马纳王国）的建立者。巴布亚口传史称，他来自帕蒂穆宁地区的姆巴哈姆山地，靠逐村走访和联姻结盟把分散的村落聚拢到自己麾下，众人于1309年推举他为王。他定都于法克法克图纳斯盖恩湾畔的韦里，与马鲁古斯兰岛的商人通商。他的兄弟伊穆利则建立了邻邦巴哈姆王国。

en: Kanō Masanobu (1434–1530) was a Japanese painter who served the Ashikaga shogunate in Kyoto as its official painter and is counted the founder of the Kanō school. His father Kagenobu was a samurai and amateur painter. Records show Masanobu was working as a painter in the capital by 1463; he succeeded Sōtan as official painter to the shogunate. His provincial origins and lack of court rank drew criticism from an aristocrat who denied he was a born court painter. He painted in the Chinese-derived suiboku ink-wash tradition of Tenshō Shūbun, adding firmer, more clearly defined forms, and produced Zen subjects alongside Buddhist deities. Few works survive, among them Zhou Maoshu Appreciating Lotuses. His son Kanō Motonobu built the family workshop into Japan's dominant painting school for four centuries.
zh: 狩野正信（1434—1530）是日本室町时代的绘师，在京都担任室町幕府的御用绘师，被奉为狩野派之祖。其父景信是武士，也是一名业余画家。据古记录记载，正信在1463年已在京都以画师身份活动；他后来接替宗湛担任幕府御用绘师。他的地方出身和缺少朝廷品级招来一位贵族批评，称他并非天生的宫廷画师。他承袭天章周文一脉源自中国的水墨画风，却以更坚实明确的造型自成面貌，兼绘禅宗题材与佛像、菩萨。其存世作品极少，《周茂叔爱莲图》是其中代表。其子狩野元信后来把家族画派发展成统领日本画坛四百年的狩野派。

en: Alâeddin Halil Mirza was a son of the Karamanid ruler Mahmut Bey. He became bey of Karaman after his elder brothers Musa and İbrahim, when İbrahim I stepped down in his favour between 1332 and 1340. Unlike them he undertook no military campaigns; his reign was devoted to pious building, and he commissioned mosques and other charitable foundations in Ermenek. He died in 1340, after which İbrahim took power again.
zh: 阿拉丁·哈利勒·米尔扎是卡拉曼统治者马哈茂德贝伊之子。1332至1340年间，其兄易卜拉欣一世让位，他登基为卡拉曼贝伊，在诸兄穆萨、易卜拉欣之后相继执政。与诸兄不同，他不曾进行军事征战；在位期间致力于宗教建筑，在埃尔梅内克下令修建清真寺及其他慈善设施。他于1340年去世，其后易卜拉欣再度执政。

en: Fahreddin Ahmed, a son of the Karamanid bey İbrahim I, succeeded his father as the ninth ruler of Karaman. His reign was brief, lasting from about 1349 until his death on 18 January 1350. Throughout those months he was at war with the Mongols and with the neighboring beylik of Eretna. He is said to have fallen in battle against the Mongols in 1350.
zh: 法赫尔丁·艾哈迈德是卡拉曼贝伊易卜拉欣一世之子，继父位成为卡拉曼第九代统治者。他在位时间很短，约1349年即位，1350年1月18日去世。在位的几个月间，他一直与蒙古人及邻邦埃雷特纳侯国交战；一说他于1350年在抗击蒙古人的战斗中阵亡。

en: Bedreddin İbrahim was a son of the Karamanid ruler Mahmut Bey. After his elder brother Musa succeeded in 1312, İbrahim claimed the throne and rose in revolt in 1318, winning it with the backing of the Egyptian Mamluks; Ibn Battuta once served as his envoy to Cairo. Between 1332 and 1340 he abdicated in favour of his brother Halil, but after Halil died in 1340 he resumed rule. He campaigned against the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia and was certainly still alive in 1343.
zh: 巴德尔丁·易卜拉欣是卡拉曼统治者马哈茂德贝伊之子。其兄穆萨1312年继位后，他声称拥有王位，于1318年举兵反叛，在埃及马穆鲁克王朝支持下夺取王位，伊本·白图泰曾作为他的使节出使开罗。1332至1340年间，他让位给弟弟哈利勒，1340年哈利勒死后又重新执政。他曾出征奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国，可以确定1343年时仍在世。

en: Karaman Bey was a younger son of İbrahim I, ruler of the Karamanid state in Anatolia, and brother of the rulers Ahmet and Şemseddin.
zh: 卡拉曼贝伊是安纳托利亚卡拉曼侯国统治者易卜拉欣一世年纪较小的儿子，艾哈迈德与舍姆斯丁两位统治者的兄弟。

en: Karim al-Din Karaman Bey (died c. 1262), son of the Turkoman leader Nure Sofi, succeeded his father before 1256 as a Seljuk vassal in the Taurus above Laranda. He built a semi-independent beylik, taking Ermenek, Mut, Ereğli, Gülnar and Silifke in wars with the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia; Laranda was renamed Karaman after him. In 1261, claiming to restore the exiled Sultan Kaykaus II, he marched on Konya but was routed by a Seljuk-Mongol army at Gevele and died soon after. His son Mehmet I succeeded him and revived the Karamanid state in 1276.
zh: 卡里曼丁·卡拉曼贝伊（约1262年卒）是土库曼首领努雷·苏菲之子，1256年前接替父亲，成为拉拉达以北托罗斯山中的塞尔柱封臣。他建立起半独立的侯国，在与奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国的战争中夺取埃尔梅内克、穆特、埃雷利、居尔纳尔和锡利夫凯；拉拉达城后来以他改名为卡拉曼。1261年，他以拥立流亡苏丹凯考斯二世为名进军科尼亚，却在盖韦莱被塞尔柱—蒙古联军击败，不久死去。其子穆罕默德一世继位，于1276年重振卡拉曼国家。

en: Badr al-Din Mahmud Bey (c. 1250–1308), fourth ruler of the Karamanid Turkoman state, was a son of its founder Karaman Bey. In 1293 he drove a Cypriot crusader force from Alanya and ruled there under his brother Güneri, whom he succeeded at Laranda in 1300; he was the first Karamanid to style himself sultan. He defeated the Ilkhanid army of Kazancuk in the Taurus passes and, after Hethum II of Armenia died in 1307, raided Armenian Cilicia. In 1308 he won near Anamur but died of his wounds and was buried at Balkusan. His son Musa succeeded him.
zh: 巴德尔丁·马哈茂德贝伊（约1250—1308）是土库曼卡拉曼国家的第四位统治者，开国君主卡拉曼贝伊之子。1293年他把塞浦路斯十字军逐出阿拉尼亚，在兄长古纳里贝伊治下统治该地，1300年在拉拉达继位，是第一个使用“苏丹”称号的卡拉曼君主。他在托罗斯山口击败卡赞丘克率领的伊儿汗国军队，并在亚美尼亚国王海屯二世1307年死后攻入亚美尼亚奇里乞亚。1308年他在阿纳穆尔附近获胜，却因伤重而死，葬于巴尔库桑，其子穆萨继位。

en: Burhanettin Musa, a son of Mahmut Bey, became bey of Karaman in 1312. After the Mongol emir Çoban seized Konya, his brother İbrahim, backed by the Egyptian Mamluks, rebelled and took the capital Larende, so that when Ibn Battuta visited in 1332 Musa ruled only Ermenek. In 1352, amid disorder in the beylik, he was invited back to Karaman and reigned until 1356. He campaigned against the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia, seizing much of its territory, and died at Konya in 1356.
zh: 布尔汉丁·穆萨是马哈茂德贝伊之子，1312年继位为卡拉曼贝伊。蒙古将领埃米尔·楚邦攻占科尼亚后，其弟易卜拉欣在埃及马穆鲁克王朝支持下发动叛乱，夺取都城卡拉曼（旧称拉伦德），以致1332年伊本·白图泰到访时，穆萨仅保有埃尔梅内克一地。1352年侯国内乱，他被请回卡拉曼，统治至1356年。他出征奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国，夺取大片领土，1356年卒于科尼亚。

en: Şemseddin Bey (died 1352) was a ruler of the Karamanid beylik in Anatolia and a son of İbrahim Bey. In 1350 he succeeded his brother Ahmet Bey as the tenth bey of Karaman, but his reign lasted only about two years. In 1352, during the dynasty's succession struggles, he was believed to have been poisoned by one of his brothers. His son Savcı Bey later ruled Alaiye as its bey.
zh: 舍姆斯丁贝伊（？—1352）是安纳托利亚卡拉曼侯国的统治者，易卜拉欣贝伊之子。1350年，他继兄长艾哈迈德贝伊之后成为卡拉曼第十代贝伊，在位仅约两年。1352年王朝爆发继承权之争，据信他被一名兄弟毒杀。他的儿子萨夫哲贝伊后来成为阿拉尼亚的统治者。

en: Seyfeddin Süleyman was the elder son of the Karamanid bey Alâeddin Halil and governed Ermenek for his uncle Musa when Musa died in 1356 and he succeeded as bey. He appointed his brother Alâattin Ali governor of Ermenek; after Ali defeated a hostile coalition, its losers allied with Mehmet of the neighboring Eretna beylik against Süleyman. In 1361, on his way to an old soldier’s funeral, Süleyman was assassinated. Turkish chroniclers remember him as a pious, kindly ruler, and his tomb stands in Konya.
zh: 赛法丁·苏莱曼是卡拉曼贝伊阿拉丁·哈利勒的长子，在其叔穆萨在位时受任治理埃尔梅内克，1356年穆萨去世后继位为贝伊。他任命弟弟阿拉丁·阿里为埃尔梅内克总督；阿里击败一个敌对联盟后，失败的一方勾结邻邦埃雷特纳侯国的统治者穆罕默德与苏莱曼为敌。1361年，苏莱曼在赴一位老兵葬礼的途中遇刺身亡。土耳其史籍称他仁厚虔诚，其陵墓位于科尼亚。

en: Luanuʻu was an aliʻi nui, or supreme chief, of the Hawaiian island of Kauaʻi, named in the traditional line of island rulers between Kamahano and Kukona, who reigned shortly before 1350.
zh: 卢亚努乌是夏威夷考爱岛的阿利伊努伊，即最高酋长，在传统的岛君世系中名列卡马哈诺与库科纳之间，约于1350年之前统治考爱。

en: Kazimierz Siemienowicz (c. 1600–c. 1651) was a Polish–Lithuanian general of artillery, military engineer and a pioneer of rocketry, born in the Raseiniai region of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. He fought in the Smolensk War of 1632–1634, served Frederick Henry of Orange in Dutch armies and took part in the Siege of Hulst in 1645. He returned in 1646 as King Władysław IV gathered specialists for a new artillery corps, and became second-in-command of the Royal Artillery in 1648. Around 1649 he settled in Amsterdam, where in 1650 he published his Latin treatise Artis Magnae Artilleriae on artillery, rockets and pyrotechnics, a standard handbook for two centuries.
zh: 卡齐米日·谢米耶诺维奇（约1600—约1651）是波兰—立陶宛的炮兵将领、军事工程师和火箭学先驱，生于立陶宛大公国的拉塞尼艾地区。他参加过1632—1634年的斯摩棱斯克战争，曾在荷兰为奥兰治亲王弗雷德里克·亨德里克效力，参与1645年的许尔斯特围城战。1646年国王瓦迪斯瓦夫四世招募专家筹建炮兵部队时，他返回国内，1648年出任王家炮兵副司令。约1649年他定居阿姆斯特丹，1650年在当地出版拉丁文论著《伟大的炮兵艺术》，内容涵盖火炮、火箭与烟火制造，在此后两个世纪里一直是该领域的标准手册。

en: Keykubad Bey was the second ruler of the Kubadids, a Turkmen principality on Anatolia's Black Sea coast, succeeding his father Tâceddin Altunbaş around 1357. He kept Ladik as his capital in the lands around Ladik and Kavak, while his tutor Emir Taşan broke away to found the neighboring Taşanoğulları beylik. Under Keykubad the Kubadids became vassals of the Amasya rulers Hacı Şadgeldi and Emir Ahmed. His son Ali Bey campaigned against the neighboring Taceddinoğulları and won Samsun, then succeeded him.
zh: 凯库巴德贝伊是安纳托利亚黑海沿岸土库曼小邦库巴德贝伊国的第二代统治者，约1357年继其父塔杰丁·阿尔通巴什之位。他以拉迪克为都，领有拉迪克和卡瓦克一带，而他的导师埃米尔塔尚另立门户，建立了邻近的塔尚奥卢贝伊国。凯库巴德在位时，库巴德臣服于阿马西亚统治者哈吉·沙德格尔迪与埃米尔艾哈迈德。其子阿里贝伊征讨邻近的塔杰丁奥卢贝伊国，夺取萨姆松，随后继承了他的位子。

en: Tâceddin Altunbaş was a Seljuk prince, a son of Gıyaseddin Mesud II, the last Sultan of Rûm. After his father's death in 1308, the Mongol Ilkhan granted him Amasya and the lands around Samsun and Ladik, which he governed as a Mongol vassal. In 1318, after his atabeg Emir Yeşbek was killed in Amasya during clashes with the Mongols, he withdrew north to Ladik and ruled independently, founding the Turkmen beylik of the Kubadids. He died around 1357 and was succeeded by his son Keykubad.
zh: 塔杰丁·阿尔通巴什是塞尔柱王公，罗姆末代苏丹吉亚斯丁·梅苏德二世之子。1308年父亲死后，蒙古伊尔汗把阿马西亚及萨姆松、拉迪克一带封给他，他作为蒙古藩属治理其地。1318年，他的阿塔贝格埃米尔耶什贝克在阿马西亚与蒙古人的冲突中被杀，他北撤拉迪克独立统治，建立了土库曼人的库巴德贝伊国。约1357年去世，其子凯库巴德继位。

en: Abdullah II, called Kademi (ʿAbdallāh bin Kade, died 1335), became mai of Kanem about 1311, succeeding his murdered cousin Ibrahim I Nikale. He began by avenging Ibrahim: inviting the killers to court on the pretext of ennobling them, he had them executed, then defeated the rebel Bagharimi Gayu in civil war and, as the chronicle puts it, established his power with a strong hand. Remembered as a just ruler, he died a natural death at Njimi. His four sons succeeded him in turn and all fell fighting the Sao.
zh: 阿卜杜拉二世，一称卡杰米（阿卜杜拉·本·卡代，1335年卒）约于1311年成为加奈姆麦伊，继遇刺的堂兄弟易卜拉欣一世·尼卡莱之位。他即位之初便为易卜拉欣报仇：以封赏为名把凶手召入宫中，随即全部处死，随后又在内战中击败反叛者巴加里米·加尤，用编年史的话说，以铁腕确立了自己的权力。他被后世视为公正的君主，最终在恩吉米善终。他的四个儿子先后继位，又全部在对萨奥人的战争中战死。

en: Biri Ibrahim (Biri bin Dunama), enumerated as Biri II and also recorded as Kashim Biri or Uthman (died 1296), was a son of mai Dunama II Dibalemi and ruled Kanem during the long succession war between Dunama's sons. The precise sequence and dates of the mais who ruled in this period are uncertain. The conflict lasted from Dunama's death until the rise of Ibrahim I Nikale, Biri's son, who later made the pilgrimage to Mecca.
zh: 比里·易卜拉欣（比里·本·杜纳马），世称比里二世，又记作卡欣·比里或乌斯曼（1296年卒），是麦伊杜纳马二世·迪巴拉米之子，在杜纳马诸子争夺王位的长期混战中统治加奈姆。这一时期历代麦伊的确切世次和年代并不清楚。纷争从杜纳马去世一直持续到比里之子易卜拉欣一世·尼卡莱崛起，后者后来曾赴麦加朝觐。

en: Dawud, called Nikalemi, was a son of mai Ibrahim I Nikale and succeeded his half-brother Idris I as mai of Kanem in about 1353. Taking the throne over Idris's many sons provoked civil war, and the Sayfawa split into the Dawudid and Idrisid branches. Dawud was the first mai to face the Bilala invading from the east; they defeated him, seized the capital Njimi and killed him at Melfala near Lake Fitri about 1363. His death began a centuries-long conflict between the Sayfawa and the Bilala. He was succeeded by his son Uthman I.
zh: 达乌德（绰号尼卡莱米）是麦伊易卜拉欣一世·尼卡莱之子，约1353年继异母兄伊德里斯一世之位成为加奈姆麦伊。他越过伊德里斯的众多儿子即位，引发内战，赛法瓦王朝分裂为达乌德系和伊德里斯系。达乌德是首位抵御自东方入侵的比拉拉人的麦伊；比拉拉人击败他，攻占都城恩吉米，并于约1363年在菲特里湖附近的梅尔法拉将他杀死。他的死开启了赛法瓦王朝与比拉拉人长达数世纪的冲突。其子奥斯曼一世继位。

en: Dunama II Dibalemi (Dunama bin ʿAbd al-Jalīl, died 1248) was mai of Kanem and one of its greatest warrior-rulers, succeeding his father Selema II around 1221. He built a large cavalry force, sometimes credited with bringing cavalry warfare to central Africa, and waged jihad against his pagan neighbours: he seized the Fezzan, fought a seven-year war against the Toubou, raided from a fleet on Lake Chad, and drove the Sao south towards Mafoni. His power reached from Kano to the Ouaddaï highlands. He kept a pilgrim hostel in Cairo, and under him Kanem stood at the height of its strength.
zh: 杜纳马·迪巴拉米（杜纳马·本·阿卜杜勒·贾利勒，1248年卒）是加奈姆的麦伊，约1221年继承父亲塞莱马二世之位，是加奈姆最强有力的征战君主之一。他建立庞大骑兵，被认为把骑兵作战引入中非，还以吉哈德之名进攻异教邻邦：夺取费赞，与图布人进行了长达七年的战争，率舰队在乍得湖上攻掠，并把萨奥人向南逐至马福尼一带，势力西起卡诺、东至瓦达伊高原。他在开罗为朝觐者设立旅舍。在他治下，加奈姆国力臻于鼎盛。

en: al-Hajj Ibrahim I, called Nikale (Ibrahim bin Biri, died around 1315), was mai of Kanem and a grandson of Dunama II Dibalemi. Succeeding his uncle Dirke Kelem, he emerged from the long succession war between Dunama's sons, though strife continued: he once put one of his own sons to death, probably for revolt. He made the pilgrimage to Mecca, earning the title al-Hajj. After about twenty years he was murdered at Dískama by the yerima Muhammad bin Ghadi, his body thrown into the Wau River; his cousin Abdullah II Kademi succeeded him.
zh: “哈吉”易卜拉欣一世，绰号尼卡莱（易卜拉欣·本·比里，约1315年卒）是加奈姆麦伊，杜纳马二世·迪巴拉米之孙。他继承叔父迪尔克·凯莱姆之位，从杜纳马诸子的长期继承权混战中崛起，但纷争并未止息：他在位期间曾处死一个亲生儿子，大概是因其谋反。他曾前往麦加朝觐，因而得到“哈吉”称号。在位约二十年后，他在迪斯卡马被高官耶里马穆罕默德·本·加迪杀害，尸体被抛入瓦乌河，堂兄弟阿卜杜拉二世·卡杰米继位。

en: al-Hajj Idris I, called Nikalemi, was a son of mai Ibrahim I Nikale and succeeded Muhammad I Kure as mai of Kanem in about 1329. His accession ended the line of Abdullah II, whose four sons had perished in wars against the Sao. Idris ruled for twenty-four or twenty-five years, far longer than his predecessors, and at some point made the pilgrimage to Mecca. He died about 1353, probably at Damasak, perhaps while campaigning against the Sao. His half-brother Dawud succeeded over Idris's own sons, splitting the Sayfawa into rival Idrisid and Dawudid branches.
zh: “哈吉”伊德里斯一世（绰号尼卡莱米）是麦伊易卜拉欣一世·尼卡莱之子，约1329年继穆罕默德一世·库里之位成为加奈姆麦伊。阿卜杜拉二世的四个儿子先后在对萨奥人的战争中丧命，伊德里斯的即位终结了该支系的统治。他在位二十四或二十五年，远比此前的麦伊长久，并曾前往麦加朝觐。约1353年他去世，可能卒于达马萨克，或许是在征讨萨奥人期间。其异母弟达乌德越过他的儿子们继位，赛法瓦王朝由此分裂为伊德里斯系与达乌德系两个对立支派。

en: Kade I, called Aujami (Kade bin Dunama, also recorded as Abd al-Kadim, died 1277), succeeded his father Dunama II Dibalemi as mai of Kanem after his death. His reign belonged to the decades-long conflict in which Dunama's sons, established as governors of the outer provinces, fought over the throne; the exact order and dates of the mais in these years are uncertain. Kade was the father of Abdullah II Kademi, who later restored order after the murder of Ibrahim I Nikale.
zh: 卡代一世，一称奥贾米（卡代·本·杜纳马，又记作阿卜杜勒·卡迪姆，1277年卒）在父亲杜纳马二世·迪巴拉米死后继位，成为加奈姆麦伊。他在位时，杜纳马的众子身为外省总督，为争夺王位混战数十年，这一时期麦伊的世次和年代都不清楚。卡代是阿卜杜拉二世·卡杰米之父，阿卜杜拉后来在易卜拉欣一世·尼卡莱遇刺后重整了秩序。

en: Kure I, called Gana (the Younger), was a son of mai Abdullah II Kademi of the Sayfawa dynasty. He succeeded his brother Selema III as mai of Kanem in about 1326, after Selema was killed fighting the Sao south of Lake Chad. Though younger than his brother Kure Kura, Kure Gana took the throne first. His reign lasted little more than a year: he too was defeated and killed by the Sao at a place called Ghaliwa. A conflicting tradition places his death in Hausaland. He was succeeded by Kure Kura, who ruled as Kure II.
zh: 库里一世（绰号“小库里”）是赛法瓦王朝麦伊阿卜杜拉二世·卡德米之子。约1326年，其兄塞莱马三世在乍得湖以南与萨奥人作战时被杀，库里遂继兄位成为加奈姆麦伊。尽管比兄长库里·库拉年幼，他却先登王位。他在位仅一年多，便同样在名为加利瓦的地方被萨奥人击败身亡，另有相互矛盾的传说称他死于豪萨兰。继位者是库里·库拉，即库里二世。

en: Kure II, called Kura (the Elder), was a son of mai Abdullah II Kademi and the elder brother of Kure I Gana. In about 1327 he succeeded Kure I, who had been killed fighting the Sao of Bornu south of Lake Chad. Two of his brothers, Selema III and Kure I, had already died in the same rising. After a short reign Kure II was also defeated and slain by the Sao at Ghaliwa, the very site where Kure I had fallen. He was succeeded by another brother, Muhammad I Kure.
zh: 库里二世（绰号“大库里”）是麦伊阿卜杜拉二世·卡德米之子、库里一世·加纳的兄长。约1327年，库里一世在乍得湖以南与博尔努的萨奥人作战时被杀，他继承王位。此前他的两个兄弟塞莱马三世和库里一世已死于萨奥人的同一场起事。在位不久，库里二世同样在库里一世殒命的加利瓦被萨奥人击败杀死，由另一兄弟穆罕默德一世·库里继位。

en: Muhammad I, also called Kure Muhammad, was a son of mai Abdullah II Kademi and his wife Kagala. In about 1328 he succeeded his brother Kure II Kura as mai of Kanem. Three of his brothers, Selema III, Kure I Gana and Kure II, had already been killed in quick succession in wars against the Sao of Bornu south of Lake Chad. After a brief reign Muhammad suffered the same fate, slain by the Sao at Nanigham. With him the sons of Abdullah II were extinguished, and the throne passed to Idris I, son of Ibrahim I Nikale.
zh: 穆罕默德一世（又称库里·穆罕默德）是麦伊阿卜杜拉二世·卡德米与妻子卡加拉之子。约1328年，他继兄库里二世·库拉之位成为加奈姆麦伊。此前他的三个兄弟塞莱马三世、库里一世·加纳和库里二世已在乍得湖以南对博尔努萨奥人的战争中接连战死。在位短暂，穆罕默德也遭同样命运，在纳尼加姆被萨奥人所杀。他死后阿卜杜拉二世的儿子尽皆身亡，王位传给易卜拉欣一世·尼卡莱之子伊德里斯一世。

en: Selema III, also called Salmama II (Sǝlǝma bin ʿAbdallāh, died around 1326), was mai of the Kanem Empire in the early fourteenth century, succeeding his father Abdullah II Kademi. His short reign, beginning around 1322, was dominated by the rising of the Sao peoples south of Lake Chad, whom earlier mais had weakened but never fully subdued. Selema campaigned against them but was killed in battle at a site recorded as Yúsub or N'difu, and was succeeded by his brother Kure I Gana.
zh: 塞莱马三世，一称萨尔马马二世（萨莱马·本·阿卜杜拉，约1326年卒）是14世纪初加奈姆帝国的马伊，继其父阿卜杜拉二世·卡杰米之位。他约于1322年登位，统治短暂，其间乍得湖以南的萨奥人起兵——历代马伊虽曾削弱萨奥人，却始终未能将其彻底征服。萨尔马马出兵征讨，战死于记作尤苏卜或恩迪富之地，其弟库里一世·加纳继位。

en: Andrei Mstislavich was a Rurikid prince, the fourth son of Mstislav Mikhailovich of Karachev and a brother of Panteleimon Mstislavich. He is described as prince of Kozelsk or of Zvenigorod, the latter title appearing in a sixteenth-century genealogy. He appears just once in the sources: under 1339 the Voskresensk Chronicle reports that he was killed by his own nephew, Vasily Panteleimonovich, for reasons unrecorded. A later genealogy names his wife as Elena, possibly a daughter of Grand Prince Gediminas of Lithuania, and gives him two sons, Fyodor and Ivan.
zh: 安德烈·姆斯季斯拉维奇是留里克王公，卡拉切夫王公姆斯季斯拉夫·米哈伊洛维奇的第四子、潘捷列伊蒙·姆斯季斯拉维奇之弟。他的头衔有科泽利斯克王公和兹韦尼哥罗德王公两种说法，后者见于一部16世纪家谱。他在史料中仅出现一次：《沃斯克列先斯克编年史》在1339年条下记载，他被亲侄瓦西里·潘捷列伊莫诺维奇杀死，原因失载。一部晚出的家谱称他的妻子叶连娜可能是立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯之女，并有费奥多尔、伊凡两个儿子。

en: Mstislav Mikhailovich (1220–c. 1280) was a Rurikid prince, traditionally one of the younger sons of Mikhail Vsevolodovich of Chernigov and the founder of the Karachev branch of the Olgovichi. Sixteenth-century genealogies assign him Karachev, Kozelsk and Zvenigorod, and he is counted as the first prince of Karachev, although the title is not attested before 1383 and many scholars regard Kozelsk as his actual seat. Genealogies name Svyatoslav, Tit and Andrei as his sons; Tit and Andrei also appear in chronicles.
zh: 姆斯季斯拉夫·米哈伊洛维奇（1220—约1280）是留里克王公，传统上被认为是切尔尼戈夫王公米哈伊尔·弗谢沃洛多维奇较年幼的儿子之一，也是奥列格维奇家族卡拉切夫支系的始祖。按16世纪编成的家谱，他领有卡拉切夫、科泽利斯克和兹韦尼哥罗德，被视为第一代卡拉切夫王公；但这一称号1383年才首次见于记载，不少学者认为科泽利斯克才是他的实际中心。家谱将斯维亚托斯拉夫、季特和安德烈列为他的儿子；季特和安德烈也见于编年史。

en: Panteleimon Mstislavich was a Rurikid prince of the Karachev line, traditionally a grandson of Mikhail Vsevolodovich of Chernigov and the third son of Prince Mstislav Mikhailovich of Karachev. He is known almost entirely from later genealogies, and historians differ over whether he held Karachev or Zvenigorod. His only mention in the chronicles is indirect: the Voskresensk Chronicle records that in 1339 his son Vasily Panteleimonovich killed Panteleimon's brother Andrei Mstislavich, prince of Kozelsk.
zh: 潘捷列伊蒙·姆斯季斯拉维奇是卡拉切夫支系的留里克王公，传统上被认为是切尔尼戈夫王公米哈伊尔·弗谢沃洛多维奇之孙、卡拉切夫王公姆斯季斯拉夫·米哈伊洛维奇的第三子。后人对他的了解几乎全部来自晚出家谱，他究竟领有卡拉切夫还是兹韦尼哥罗德，史家说法不一。编年史中他唯一一次被间接提及：《沃斯克列先斯克编年史》记载，1339年他的儿子瓦西里·潘捷列伊莫诺维奇杀死了他的弟弟、科泽利斯克王公安德烈·姆斯季斯拉维奇。

en: Svyatoslav Mstislavich (died 1310) was a Rurikid prince of Karachev, the second son of Mstislav Mikhailovich, from whom he inherited Karachev. He appears in the sources only once: the Nikon Chronicle records that in 1310 Prince Vasily Alexandrovich of Bryansk, with troops of the Golden Horde, invaded his lands and seized Karachev, and Svyatoslav was killed. He may have laid claim to Bryansk, which had passed to the Smolensk branch of the Rurikids. He left no heirs; later genealogies make Andrei Mstislavich of Zvenigorod his brother.
zh: 斯维亚托斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇（1310年卒）是卡拉切夫的留里克王公，姆斯季斯拉夫·米哈伊洛维奇的次子，在父亲死后继承卡拉切夫。他在史料中只出现过一次：《尼康编年史》记载，1310年布良斯克王公瓦西里·亚历山德罗维奇联合金帐汗国军队入侵他的领地、夺取卡拉切夫，斯维亚托斯拉夫兵败身死。他可能曾对已落入留里克王朝斯摩棱斯克支系之手的布良斯克提出主张。他没有留下继承人，晚出家谱称兹韦尼哥罗德王公安德烈·姆斯季斯拉维奇是他的兄弟。

en: Vasily Panteleimonovich was the son of Panteleimon Mstislavich, prince of Karachev, and grandson of Mstislav Mikhailovich. He is named only once in the chronicles: the Voskresensk Chronicle states that in 1339 he killed his uncle Andrei Mstislavich, prince of Kozelsk or Zvenigorod. The motive is not recorded, though modern historians have suggested a quarrel over his father's appanage after Panteleimon's death. One scholar also proposed that Vasily was later killed by the Mongols of the Golden Horde.
zh: 瓦西里·潘捷列伊莫诺维奇是卡拉切夫王公潘捷列伊蒙·姆斯季斯拉维奇之子、姆斯季斯拉夫·米哈伊洛维奇之孙。他在编年史中仅被提到一次：《沃斯克列先斯克编年史》记载他于1339年杀死了叔父——科泽利斯克（一说兹韦尼哥罗德）王公安德烈·姆斯季斯拉维奇。杀人原因史无记载，现代学者推测可能与潘捷列伊蒙死后的封地之争有关；也有学者认为瓦西里后来被金帐汗国的蒙古人所杀。

en: Ivane II, called Atabek-Ivane and the Great, was an Armenian prince of the Hasan-Jalalyan house who ruled Khachen in the second half of the fourteenth century. He was the son of Prince Jalal II and grandson of Ivane-Atabek I. His own domains covered Lower Khachen, while he exercised suzerain rights over the entire Khachen principality. Sources name him as its prince from 1361. He was succeeded by his son Jalal III.
zh: 伊凡二世（又称阿塔贝克-伊凡，绰号“大帝”）是哈桑-贾拉良家族的亚美尼亚王公，于14世纪后半叶统治哈琴。他是贾拉勒二世之子、伊凡-阿塔贝克一世之孙。他的直领之地为下哈琴，同时对整个哈琴公国保有宗主权。史料自1361年起称他为哈琴王公，其子贾拉勒三世继立。

en: Sultan Ibrahim Shah, son of Sultan Mahmud Shah I and Tunku Aishah, was the sixth Sultan of Kedah and held the throne for fifty-two years. He succeeded his father in 1321 and was proclaimed on 14 May of that year, first residing at Kota Sungai Mas. In May 1323 he moved his court to Kota Seputih, built by his uncle Raja Muda Ahmad, and made it his capital. Malay chronicles credit him with fixing the ranks of his ministers, and record that Kedah's population and trade grew during his reign, his name reaching Sumatra, China and India. He died in 1373 and was buried at Kota Seputih, succeeded by his son Sulaiman Shah I.
zh: 苏丹伊布拉欣·沙是马哈茂德·沙一世与东古·艾莎之子，吉打第六任苏丹，在位52年。他1321年继承父位，同年5月14日正式即位，先居双溪马士。1323年5月，他将宫廷迁往由叔父王储艾哈迈德兴建的哥打士布爹，并以此为都。马来史籍记载，他厘定了大臣的等级次序；在他治下吉打人口增长、贸易兴盛，声名远播苏门答腊、中国和印度。他于1373年去世，葬于哥打士布爹，其子苏莱曼·沙一世继位。

en: Tunku Mala was the permaisuri, or queen consort, of Sultan Ibrahim Shah of Kedah, who reigned from 1321 to 1373, and the mother of his successor Sultan Sulaiman Shah I.
zh: 东古·摩罗是吉打苏丹伊布拉欣·沙（1321—1373年在位）的王后，也是继位苏丹苏莱曼·沙一世的母亲。

en: Prithvi Chand II was a Katoch Rajput raja of Kangra, the Punjab Hills state also called Nagarkot. In 1333 the army of the Delhi sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq invaded his state but, unable to fight in the hills, was defeated and withdrew.
zh: 普里特维·钱德二世是旁遮普山区小国冈格拉（又称讷格尔果德）的卡托奇拉杰普特拉杰。1333年，德里苏丹穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克的军队入侵其国，但因无法在山地作战而被击退。

en: Khabul Khan (died 1148) was the founder and first khan of the Khamag Mongol confederation, uniting the Khiyad, Taichuud, Jalair and Jurkhin clans under Borjigin leadership. A son of Tumbinai Khan, he fought off invasions by the Jurchen Jin dynasty; summoned to the Jin court in 1135, he offended the emperor by pulling his beard and then led Mongol raids into Jin territory. In 1147 the Jin recognized him as king of the Mongols. He campaigned against the Tatars with his son Khadan. Although he had seven sons, he was succeeded by his cousin Ambaghai.
zh: 合不勒汗（1148年卒）是蒙兀国联盟的创建者和第一位可汗，把乞颜、泰赤乌、札剌亦儿和主儿勤等部团结在孛儿只斤氏之下。他是敦必乃之子，多次击退女真人金朝的进攻；1135年应召入朝时，他捋金太宗的胡须，触怒了皇帝，后来又率蒙古部袭扰金境。1147年，金熙宗册封他为蒙兀国王。他还与儿子合丹一同征讨塔塔儿部。他虽有七子，临终却传位给从弟俺巴孩。

en: Khaduli Barlas was a Borjigin Mongol prince, the son of Tumbinai Khan and twin brother of Khabul Khan, founder of the Khamag Mongol. He served Khabul as a military commander, minister and adviser between about 1130 and 1148, and fought at his side in the campaigns against the Jurchen Jin dynasty of China. His son Erumduli and grandson Suqu Sechen both held commands under the confederation's khans.
zh: 哈笃里·巴鲁剌思是蒙古孛儿只斤氏王公，敦必乃之子，也是蒙兀国创建者合不勒汗的孪生兄弟。约1130至1148年间，他以军事首领、大臣兼谋主的身份辅佐合不勒，并随其参加对女真人金朝的征战。其子额鲁木笃里、其孙速忽赤臣都在联盟诸汗麾下担任军职。

en: Candravati is known only from the Cambodian Royal Chronicles as a daughter of King Jayavarman IX. She married the gardener Trasak Paem after he seized her father's throne, and chronicles make her mother of Nippean Bat and Sithean Reachea.
zh: 钱德拉瓦蒂仅见于柬埔寨王家编年史：她是国王阇耶跋摩九世之女。王家园丁特罗萨克·帕埃姆弑君篡位后娶她为妻，编年史把尼皮安·巴特和悉提因·列谢记为她所生。

en: Srindrabhupesvarachuda (born c. 1250) was the eldest daughter of Khmer king Jayavarman VIII. She married Indravarman, and an inscription records the pair being crowned as heir and consort while her father still reigned. She persuaded her father to set aside her brother, the intended crown prince, and stole the golden sword of office for her husband. Her brother had his toes cut off and was thrown into a dark dungeon, after which Indravarman III took the throne in 1295.
zh: 室利因陀罗布佩什瓦拉朱达（约1250年生）是高棉国王阇耶跋摩八世的长女。她嫁给因陀罗跋摩；碑铭记载，其父在位时二人已一同受封为王储与配偶。她说服父亲废黜原定继位的兄弟，盗走象征王权的金剑交给丈夫。她的兄弟被砍去脚趾、投入暗牢，因陀罗跋摩三世随后于1295年登上王位。

en: Indrajayavarman (died 1327), also called Indravarman IV, ruled the Khmer Empire from 1308 to 1327; his tie to his predecessor Indravarman III is unknown. A devotee of Shiva under strong brahmin influence, he renewed the persecution of Buddhists and encouraged the destruction of Buddha images, reviving religious strife in the empire. His reign also brought fresh Siamese incursions, launched under the pretext of defending the Buddhist faith. His inscriptions are the last Sanskrit records at Angkor. He was succeeded by his son Jayavarman IX.
zh: 因陀罗阇耶跋摩（？—1327），又称因陀罗跋摩四世，1308至1327年统治高棉帝国，与前任因陀罗跋摩三世的亲属关系不详。他是湿婆的虔诚信徒，深受婆罗门影响，在位时恢复迫害佛教徒，鼓励毁坏佛像，重新引发帝国的宗教纷争。他统治期间，暹罗人又以保卫佛教为名大举入侵柬埔寨。他留下的碑铭是吴哥最后一批梵文记录，死后由其子阇耶跋摩九世继位。

en: Indravarman II (died 1243), son of Jayavarman VII and Queen Jayarajadevi, ruled the Khmer Empire from about 1215. His reign is poorly documented, since his successor Jayavarman VIII may have destroyed the records; a single inscription gives his death year. A Buddhist like his father, he enlarged or completed several of Jayavarman VII's temples. Under him the empire shrank: the Khmers lost control of Champa, and the newborn Sukhothai kingdom under Indraditya seized western territories. The historian David P. Chandler saw in him a possible model for the Leper King of Khmer legend.
zh: 因陀罗跋摩二世（？—1243）是阇耶跋摩七世与王后阇耶罗阇黛维之子，约自1215年起统治高棉帝国。他在位的记载十分稀少，继任者阇耶跋摩八世可能销毁了相关记录，只有一方碑铭载明他卒于1243年。他和父亲一样信奉佛教，扩建或完成了阇耶跋摩七世时期的几座寺庙。他在位时帝国版图收缩：高棉丧失了对占城的控制，新兴的素可泰王国在室利膺陀罗铁治下夺取了西部领土。学者戴维·钱德勒推测，他可能是高棉传说中“麻风国王”的原型。

en: Indravarman III (died 1308), also titled Srindravarman, ruled the Khmer Empire from 1295. As commander of the army he took the throne when his father-in-law Jayavarman VIII abdicated. The king's daughter stole the royal Sacred Sword for him, while the crown prince was seized, had his toes cut off and was imprisoned. After suppressing resistance, Indravarman was crowned by the royal priest Vidyesavid and married the princess to legitimize his rule. A Theravada Buddhist, Indravarman made that school the state religion. In 1296 the Chinese envoy Zhou Daguan visited his Angkor court and later wrote his detailed Customs of Cambodia. Zhou recorded that a recent war with the Siamese had devastated the country.
zh: 因陀罗跋摩三世（？—1308），又号室利因陀罗跋摩，自1295年起统治高棉帝国。他原任军队统帅，在岳父阇耶跋摩八世逊位后取得王位。国王之女盗出王室圣剑交给他，王储则被逮捕、割去脚趾并囚禁。平定抵抗后，因陀罗跋摩由王室祭司毗底耶室毗加冕，并娶公主为妻，以确立统治的合法性。他信奉上座部佛教，即位后将其立为国教。1296年，元朝使节周达观访问吴哥宫廷，后来据所见所闻写成《真腊风土记》。周达观记载，近期与暹罗人的战争使国家遭到严重破坏。

en: Jayavarman IX (died 1336), also called Jayavarmadiparamesvara, ruled the Khmer Empire from 1327 to 1336, succeeding his father Indrajayavarman. Like his father he was a convinced Shaivite. He is the last Angkorean king named in temple inscriptions, and the last Sanskrit inscription in Cambodia belongs to his reign. The Cambodian Royal Chronicle, which names him Sihanouk, relates that in 1336 he was murdered by the royal gardener Trasak Paem, who married his daughter and seized the throne; that tale is probably legendary.
zh: 阇耶跋摩九世（？—1336），又称阇耶跋摩底·波罗摩湿婆罗，1327至1336年统治高棉帝国，继父因陀罗阇耶跋摩之位。他和父亲一样是虔诚的湿婆信徒。他是最后一位见于庙宇碑铭的吴哥国王，柬埔寨最后一方梵文碑铭也出自他在位期间。柬埔寨王家编年史称他为“西哈努”，并记载1336年他被王家园林总管特罗萨克·帕埃姆谋害，凶手娶了他的女儿、篡夺王位；这一说法很可能属于传说。

en: Jayavarman VII (c. 1122–1218) was the most powerful king of the Khmer Empire. A son of Dharanindravarman II, he was already past fifty when the Chams sacked Angkor in 1177; he drove out the invaders and was crowned in 1181. His armies took the Cham capital Vijaya in 1190 and annexed Champa in 1203. The first Khmer king devoted to Buddhism, he followed the Mahayana tradition. His queen Jayarajadevi and her sister Indradevi, whom he married after the queen's death, are thought to have inspired his faith. He built Angkor Thom and the Bayon, with Ta Prohm and Preah Khan, and founded 102 hospitals and 121 rest houses along the highways. His son Indravarman II succeeded him.
zh: 阇耶跋摩七世（约1122—1218）是高棉帝国国力最盛时的国王。他是陀罗尼因陀罗跋摩二世之子，1177年占城军队洗劫吴哥时，年过半百的他起兵驱逐入侵者，于1181年登基。他的军队1190年攻占占城首都毗阇耶，1203年吞并占城。他是第一位虔信佛教的高棉国王，信奉大乘佛教。他的王后阇耶罗阇黛维与其妹因陀罗黛维被认为对他的信仰影响很大；王后去世后，他娶了因陀罗黛维。他修建了吴哥城、巴戎寺以及塔布隆寺、圣剑寺，还创办102所医院，沿大道设立121处驿馆。他死后由其子因陀罗跋摩二世继位。

en: Jayavarman VIII (born c. 1210) ruled the Khmer Empire from 1243 to 1295. A Shaivite Hindu, he reversed the Buddhism of his father Jayavarman VII, destroying Buddha images at Preah Khan, turning the Bayon into a temple of Shiva and casting its great Buddha statue into a well. In 1281 he imprisoned Mongol envoys in Champa, and when Kublai Khan's armies invaded in 1283 he bought peace with tribute. In 1290 Lavo threw off Khmer overlordship; the following year his court sent tribute to China. He also suffered a devastating war against the Siamese. He endowed the Mangalartha shrine in 1295, shortly before his son-in-law Indravarman III forced him to abdicate and the kingdom returned to Buddhism.
zh: 阇耶跋摩八世（约1210年生）于1243至1295年统治高棉帝国。他信奉湿婆派印度教，一改其父阇耶跋摩七世的佛教政策：捣毁圣剑寺等地的佛像，将巴戎寺改为湿婆神庙，并把寺中的大佛像投入井底。1281年他在占城囚禁蒙古使节，1283年忽必烈的军队来攻，他以纳贡换取和平。1290年罗斛摆脱高棉宗主权；次年他的朝廷向中国进贡。他还在与暹人的战争中遭受重创。1295年他捐资修建曼加拉萨寺，不久便被女婿因陀罗跋摩三世逼迫退位，王国重新归向佛教。

en: Nippean Bat (Khmer Nibbanapada), personal name Ponhea Kreak, is named by the Cambodian Royal Chronicles as ruler of the Khmer Empire from 1340 to 1346. The eldest son of the gardener-king Trasak Paem and Candravati, he succeeded his father. The chronicles remember his six-year reign for a loss: the Thais rose in revolt, set up their own independent kingdoms and freed themselves from Khmer vassalage, and the empire lost all its Siamese dependencies. His younger brother Sithean Reachea followed him on the throne, and the crown passed on to Nippean Bat's own son Lompong Reachea. He left three sons: Lompong Reachea, Soriyotei I and Prince Sukha Dhara Pada.
zh: 尼皮安·巴特（高棉语称尼般那巴达），本名奔哈·克雷克，据柬埔寨王家编年史记载，于1340至1346年统治高棉帝国。他是“园丁国王”特罗萨克·帕埃姆与钱德拉瓦蒂的长子，继承父位。编年史记住他的六年在位，是因为一次丧失：泰人起兵反叛，建立各自的独立王国，摆脱高棉的宗主权，帝国失去了全部暹罗属地。他死后由弟弟悉提因·列谢继位，王位随后又传给他自己的儿子隆庞·列谢。他留下三个儿子：隆庞·列谢、索里约泰一世和苏卡·达拉·巴达王子。

en: The Cambodian Royal Chronicles name Sithean Reachea (Khmer Siddhanaraja) as ruler of the Khmer Empire from 1346 to 1347. The younger son of Trasak Paem and Candravati, he succeeded his elder brother Nippean Bat but reigned only three or six months before abdicating in favor of his nephew Lompong Reachea. After stepping down he bore the ceremonial title Maha Upayuvaraja, meaning retired great king, and died on an unknown date.
zh: 柬埔寨王家编年史把悉提因·列谢（高棉语作悉达那罗阇）列为1346至1347年的高棉帝国统治者。他是特罗萨克·帕埃姆与钱德拉瓦蒂的幼子，继兄长尼皮安·巴特为王，却只在位三到六个月，便让位给侄子隆庞·列谢。退位之后，他保有“摩诃乌巴瑜婆罗阇”，意即退位大王的荣誉头衔，卒年不详。

en: Trasak Paem, also called Chay, is the first Khmer ruler known only from the Cambodian Royal Chronicles, and is said to have died around 1340. The chronicles make him a royal gardener to a king identified with Jayavarman IX, so skilled at growing sweet cucumbers that his title means master of the tasty cucumber. The king gave him his own spear to guard the crop. One night the king came to test his zeal, and Chay mortally wounded him; the dying man cleared him of blame. With no heir, the court turned to a white elephant at the royal election, and it passed over the nobles to choose the gardener from the crowd. Facing the dignitaries' hostility, he withdrew to a residence at Banteay Samré and began his quiet reign only after eliminating his predecessor's loyalists. He married the old king's daughter Candravati; the chronicles name his sons Nippean Bat and Sithean Reachea. Historians judge him probably legendary.
zh: 特罗萨克·帕埃姆，又名杰，是仅见于柬埔寨王家编年史的最早一位高棉统治者，相传约卒于1340年。编年史说他本是被比定为阇耶跋摩九世的那位国王的王家园丁，擅长种甜黄瓜，名号意为“美味黄瓜之主”。国王把自己的长矛交给他看守瓜田。一天夜里，国王前来试探他是否尽心，被他刺成致命伤，临终前却说他无罪。国王没有子嗣，朝中无人能定继承人，于是在选王仪式上请白象裁决，白象越过群臣，从人群中选中了这位园丁。面对权贵的敌意，他退居班迭萨姆雷的住所，直到清除了前朝旧臣，才开始平静的统治。他娶了先王的女儿钱德拉瓦蒂，编年史载其二子为尼皮安·巴特和悉提因·列谢。史家多认为他是传说人物。

en: Jaitpal was a 14th-century Rajput raja of Kherla in Gondwana. Tradition calls him the greatest of Kherla's Rajput rulers and credits him with building the fortress of Kherla. He was succeeded by Narsingh Rai, the first Gond king of Kherla.
zh: 杰特帕尔是14世纪冈德瓦纳凯尔拉的拉杰普特拉杰，相传是冈德人入主前最伟大的一位，凯尔拉城堡被认为为他所建。他死后由第一位冈德国王纳尔辛格·拉伊继位。

en: Abdullah was a son of the Ilkhanid Mongol emir Mulay. He inherited his father's fiefs in Quhistan and ruled them as an autonomous lord during the reign of the Chupanid puppet Ilkhan Sulaiman (1339–1343).
zh: 阿卜杜拉是伊利汗国蒙古异密穆莱之子。他继承了父亲在库希斯坦的封地，在楚邦系拥立的傀儡伊利汗速来曼在位期间（1339—1343）割据自守。

en: Ajkan was an early ahpop, or king, of the Kʼicheʼ Maya, ruling from Pismachi in the Guatemalan highlands around 1300–1325, between the reigns of Tzʼikin and Kʼokaibʼ.
zh: 阿赫坎是基切玛雅人的早期“阿赫波普”（即国王），约1300至1325年在危地马拉高地的皮斯马奇统治，在位时间介于齐金与科凯布之间。

en: Kʼokaibʼ was an early ahpop, “man of the mat”, as the Kʼicheʼ called their king, in the Guatemalan highlands. The Kʼicheʼ traced their rulers to invaders who entered the highlands around 1200 and founded three lineages: the Nima Kʼicheʼ, who ruled, the Tamub, probably traders, and the Ilokʼab, warriors. Native king lists place Kʼokaibʼ at Pismachi, a new town with a large ritual center, around 1325–1350, after Ajkan and before Kʼonache. Under these two kings the lineages began to quarrel, and the Ilokʼab left Pismachi for the nearby town of Mukwitz Chilokʼab. The kingdom they left behind later moved its capital to Qʼumarkaj and grew into the power of highland Guatemala until the Spanish conquest of 1524.
zh: 科凯布是危地马拉高地基切人早期的“阿赫波普”，意为“席上之人”，即基切人对国王的称呼。基切人把统治者的来历追溯到约1200年进入高地的外来者，他们建立了三大支系：尼马基切是统治阶层，塔穆布可能从事贸易，伊洛克阿布是武士。据基切本土王名表，科凯布约于1325至1350年在皮斯马奇统治，介于阿赫坎与科纳切之间；皮斯马奇是新建的城镇，有一座大型礼仪中心。在这两位国王治下，各支系开始争执，伊洛克阿布离开皮斯马奇，迁居附近的穆克维茨·奇洛克阿布。留下来的王国后来迁都库马尔卡赫，成为危地马拉高地的强权，直到1524年被西班牙征服。

en: Gerald FitzMaurice (c. 1150–1204), first Lord of Offaly, was a Cambro-Norman nobleman and second son of Maurice FitzGerald, Lord of Llanstephan. He came to Ireland in the Norman invasion of 1169–71 and distinguished himself fighting Ruaidrí Ua Conchobair outside Dublin in 1171. He held Maynooth and Naas in Kildare, built Maynooth Castle, and campaigned in the conquest of Limerick in 1197, gaining Croom. Through his marriage to Eve de Bermingham around 1193 he acquired the barony of Offaly. He died 15 January 1204, leaving a son Maurice, Justiciar of Ireland and ancestor of the Kildare earls.
zh: 杰拉尔德·菲茨莫里斯（约1150—1204年1月15日）是第一代奥法利领主、坎布罗诺曼贵族，兰斯特凡领主莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德的次子。1169至1171年诺曼人入侵爱尔兰时他随父出征，1171年在都柏林城外迎战爱尔兰高王鲁艾德里·奥康诺，表现英勇。他领有基尔代尔的梅努斯与纳斯，修建梅努斯城堡，并在1197年参加征服利默里克，取得克鲁姆。约1193年他迎娶伊芙·德·伯明翰，由此获得奥法利男爵领地。1204年1月15日去世，独子莫里斯曾任爱尔兰政法官，是历代基尔代尔伯爵的祖先。

en: John FitzThomas FitzGerald (c. 1250–1316), fourth Lord of Offaly and first Earl of Kildare, was an Anglo-Norman magnate. In 1291 he accused the justiciar William de Vesci of oppression before Edward I; when de Vesci fled rather than face trial by combat, the king granted him Kildare and Rathangan. In 1294–1295 he imprisoned Richard de Burgh, Earl of Ulster, at Lea Castle, later marrying his heir Thomas to de Burgh's daughter Joan. He fought in Edward I's Scottish wars and resisted Edward Bruce's invasion of 1315–16. Created earl on 14 May 1316, he died that September.
zh: 约翰·菲茨托马斯·菲茨杰拉德（约1250—1316年9月）是第四代奥法利领主、第一代基尔代尔伯爵，盎格鲁诺曼大贵族。1291年，他在爱德华一世面前控告爱尔兰政法官威廉·德·维西苛政扰民；德·维西拒绝比武审判、逃往法国，国王遂把基尔代尔、拉森甘等领地判赐给他。1294至1295年，他在利城堡囚禁阿尔斯特伯爵理查德·德·伯格，随后和解，让继承人托马斯迎娶德·伯格之女琼。他参加爱德华一世的苏格兰战争，并抵抗1315至1316年爱德华·布鲁斯的入侵。1316年5月14日受封基尔代尔伯爵，同年9月去世。

en: Maurice FitzThomas FitzGerald, 4th Earl of Kildare (1318–1390), was an Irish nobleman, the second son of Thomas FitzGerald, 2nd Earl of Kildare, and Joan de Burgh, daughter of the Earl of Ulster. He succeeded his brother Richard as earl in 1329. In 1347 he served Edward III at the siege of Calais, where he was knighted, and in 1360 he was appointed Lord Justice of Ireland, taking office again in 1371 and 1375. In 1364 he led Irish nobles to England to protest the misgovernment of Ireland. He died in 1390 and was buried at Christ Church Cathedral, Dublin.
zh: 莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德，第四代基尔代尔伯爵（1318—1390），是爱尔兰贵族，第二代基尔代尔伯爵托马斯·菲茨杰拉德与阿尔斯特伯爵之女琼·德·伯格的次子。1329年幼兄第三代伯爵理查夭折，他遂袭爵。1347年他随爱德华三世参加加来围城战，由国王亲自册封为骑士；1360年受命出任爱尔兰代总督，又于1371年和1375年两度出任该职。1364年他率领爱尔兰贵族赴英，向爱德华三世申诉爱尔兰的治理失当。他于1390年去世，葬于都柏林基督教会座堂。

en: Maurice FitzGerald (c. 1105–1176), Lord of Llanstephan in Wales and Maynooth and Naas in Ireland, was a Cambro-Norman baron and a leader of the Norman invasion of Ireland. He fought at the Battle of Crug Mawr in 1136, and in 1146 lost Llansteffan Castle to a Welsh attack. In 1169 he sailed to Ireland to back the exiled Leinster king Diarmait Mac Murchada, helping his half-brother Robert FitzStephen take Wexford and fighting in the storming of Dublin in 1171. He died around September 1176; his sons Thomas and Gerald founded the Desmond and Kildare lines of the FitzGeralds.
zh: 莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德（约1105—约1176年9月），领有威尔士的兰斯特凡以及爱尔兰的梅努斯、纳斯，是坎布罗诺曼男爵，也是诺曼人入侵爱尔兰的领袖之一。1136年他参加克鲁格莫尔之战，1146年兰斯特凡城堡在威尔士人的进攻中失守。1169年他渡海前往爱尔兰，支持流亡的伦斯特国王迪尔梅德复位，协助同母异父弟弟罗伯特·菲茨斯蒂芬攻取韦克斯福德，并参加1171年强攻都柏林之役。他于约1176年9月去世；其子托马斯与杰拉尔德分别开创了菲茨杰拉德家族的德斯蒙德与基尔代尔支系。

en: Maurice FitzGerald (c. 1194–1257), second Lord of Offaly, was an Anglo-Norman soldier who served as Justiciar of Ireland from 1232 to 1245 under Henry III. He founded the Franciscan friary at Youghal in 1224. At the Curragh in 1234 he defeated Richard Marshal, who died of his wounds amid rumours of betrayal. As justiciar he joined the subjugation of Connacht in 1235. He founded Sligo Castle in 1245, and invaded Tír Chonaill in 1247, winning the Battle of Ballyshannon. In 1257 he fought Gofraidh Ó Domhnaill in single combat at Credan; both were gravely wounded, and Maurice died of his injuries at Youghal on 20 May.
zh: 莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德（约1194—1257年5月20日）是第二代奥法利领主、盎格鲁诺曼军事贵族，1232至1245年在亨利三世手下担任爱尔兰政法官。1224年他在约尔创建方济各会修道院。1234年他在库拉格击败理查德·马歇尔，后者伤重而死，时人传言莫里斯出卖了他。1235年他以政法官身份参与征服康诺特。1245年他主持修建斯莱戈城堡，1247年入侵蒂尔康奈，赢得巴利香农之战。1257年他在克雷丹与蒂尔康奈首领戈弗雷·奥唐奈单挑决斗，二人均负重伤，莫里斯于5月20日在约尔伤重而亡。

en: Thomas FitzJohn FitzGerald (died 1328), second Earl of Kildare, was the son and heir of the first earl, John FitzThomas. In 1312 he married Joan de Burgh, daughter of the Earl of Ulster. During Edward Bruce's invasion he commanded a large army against the Scots in Ulster, though the decisive victory came when Bruce was defeated and killed in 1318. He served twice as Lord Justice of Ireland, from 1318 to 1321 and again from February 1326 until his death. He died at Maynooth on 9 April 1328, leaving sons Richard and Maurice, who succeeded in turn as earl.
zh: 托马斯·菲茨约翰·菲茨杰拉德（？—1328年4月9日）是第二代基尔代尔伯爵，第一代伯爵约翰·菲茨托马斯之子与继承人。1312年他迎娶阿尔斯特伯爵之女琼·德·伯格。爱德华·布鲁斯入侵期间，他受命统率大军在阿尔斯特抗击苏格兰军；1318年布鲁斯战败被杀。他两度出任爱尔兰政法官：1318至1321年，以及1326年2月直至去世。1328年4月9日卒于梅努斯，遗有理查德与莫里斯二子，相继袭伯爵位。

en: Thomas FitzMaurice (died 1213), Lord of OConnello and Shanid in Munster, was the eldest son of Maurice FitzGerald, Lord of Llanstephan, and founder of the Desmond branch of the Geraldines. In 1210 he led an Anglo-Norman army gathered in Munster, together with Geoffrey de Marisco and the followers of Donnchadh Cairbreach Ó Briain, king of Thomond, into Connacht. The campaign forced Cathal Crobhdearg Ua Conchobair, king of Connacht, into negotiations with the Justiciar John de Gray. He married Ellinor, daughter of Jordan de Marisco; their son John became first Baron Desmond.
zh: 托马斯·菲茨莫里斯（？—1213）是芒斯特的奥康内洛与沙尼德领主、兰斯特凡领主莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德的长子，杰拉尔德家族德斯蒙德支系的始祖。1210年，他与杰弗里·德·马里斯科一起，率领集结于芒斯特的盎格鲁诺曼军队及托蒙德国王唐查德·卡尔布里奇·奥布莱恩的部众入侵康诺特，迫使康诺特国王卡哈尔·克罗布代尔格·奥康诺与爱尔兰政法官约翰·德·格雷谈判。他娶乔丹·德·马里斯科之女埃莉诺为妻，其子约翰成为第一代德斯蒙德男爵。

en: Alexander Yaroslavich Nevsky (1221–1263), son of Yaroslav II of Vladimir, was prince of Novgorod when he routed a Swedish army on the Neva in 1240, winning his nickname Nevsky. Recalled from exile, he defeated the Livonian Order on frozen Lake Peipus in the Battle on the Ice on 5 April 1242, halting the crusaders' eastward push. He submitted to the Golden Horde rather than fight the Mongols and became grand prince of Vladimir in 1252. He died at Gorodets on 14 November 1263 while returning from the khan at Sarai, and was canonized by the Orthodox Church in 1547.
zh: 亚历山大·雅罗斯拉维奇·涅夫斯基（1221—1263）是雅罗斯拉夫二世·弗谢沃洛多维奇之子，担任诺夫哥罗德王公期间于1240年在涅瓦河击溃瑞典军队，由此得到“涅夫斯基”的绰号。遭放逐后又被召回的他，于1242年4月5日在楚德湖冰面的冰上之战中击败利沃尼亚骑士团，挡住了十字军东进。他没有与蒙古人开战，而是臣服于金帐汗国，1252年成为弗拉基米尔大公。1263年11月14日，他在从萨莱谒见汗王返程途中病逝于戈罗杰茨，1547年被东正教会封圣。

en: Algimantas, also called Olgimund, was a prince of the Lithuanian Holshany family. Late chronicles make him Gediminas's viceroy in Kyiv after the city fell in 1321 or 1324, and say he received baptism as Fyodor; they call him either a son of Mindaugas Holshansky or of the legendary Holsha. His name otherwise survives only in the patronymic of his son Ivan, whom documents of 1385–1388 name Ivan Algimantaitis and who fought for Vytautas in the Lithuanian civil war of 1381–1384.
zh: 阿尔吉曼塔斯（又译奥利格蒙德）是立陶宛阿尔谢尼什凯家族的王公。后世编年史称他在1321年或1324年基辅陷落后出任格迪米纳斯的基辅总督，受洗后改名费奥多尔；关于他的父亲，诸书或作明道加斯，或作传说始祖戈尔沙。除此之外，他的名字仅见于其子伊万的父称：1385至1388年的文书称后者为伊万·阿尔吉曼塔伊季斯，即阿尔吉曼塔斯之子；伊万曾在1381至1384年立陶宛内战中为维陶塔斯作战。

en: Anton Losenko (1737–1773) was a Russian neoclassical painter, born at Hlukhiv. Orphaned, he sang in the court choir at Saint Petersburg until his voice broke, then trained under Ivan Argunov and entered the Imperial Academy of Arts in 1759. Sent to Paris in 1760, he studied under Jean Restout the Younger and painted the miraculous catch of fish. In 1766–1769 he worked in Rome, studying Raphael and painting Cain and Abel. Back in Russia, his canvas Vladimir and Rogneda won him the title of academician; in 1772 he became professor and director of the Academy, where his textbook on human proportions served generations of Russian painters. He died in 1773.
zh: 安东·洛先科（1737—1773）是俄罗斯新古典主义画家，生于赫卢希夫。他幼年成孤，在圣彼得堡宫廷唱诗班唱歌，变声后师从伊万·阿尔古诺夫，1759年进入皇家美术学院。1760年他被派往巴黎，师从让·雷斯图（小），并绘制奇迹捕鱼的故事。1766—1769年他在罗马研习拉斐尔，绘制该隐与亚伯。返回俄国后，他的画布油画《弗拉基米尔与罗格涅达》为他赢得院士头衔；1772年他升任教授并出任学院院长，所著人体比例教科书供数代俄国画家使用。他于1773年去世。

en: Davyd Sviatoslavich (c. 1050–1123), a son of Grand Prince Sviatoslav II of Kiev, held Pereyaslavl, Murom, Smolensk and Novgorod in turn before the 1097 Council of Lyubech assigned him Chernigov, which he ruled until his death. With his brother Oleg he fought Monomakh's sons over Murom and Smolensk, but later joined Monomakh's campaigns against the Cumans between 1103 and 1111, fighting at the Suteni and Salnitsa rivers and sacking the Cuman towns of Sharukan and Sugrov. His son Iziaslav III became grand prince of Kiev.
zh: 达维德·斯维亚托斯拉维奇（约1050—1123）是基辅大公斯维亚托斯拉夫二世之子，先后受封佩列亚斯拉夫尔、穆罗姆、斯摩棱斯克和诺夫哥罗德，1097年柳别奇大会将切尔尼戈夫划归于他，他在此统治直至去世。他曾与兄长奥列格联兵，为争夺穆罗姆和斯摩棱斯克同莫诺马赫诸子交战，后来又随莫诺马赫在1103至1111年间征讨波洛韦茨人，参加苏捷尼河、萨尔尼察河之战，并攻下沙鲁坎、苏格罗夫两座波洛韦茨城镇。其子伊贾斯拉夫三世后来成为基辅大公。

en: Gleb Yurievich (c. 1130–1171), a son of Yuri Dolgorukiy by a daughter of the Cuman khan Aepa and brother of Andrei Bogolyubsky, first appears in the chronicles in 1146/47 and fought alongside his father in 1147. He held Kanev from 1149 and in 1155 received Pereyaslavl, which he kept after his father's death. After Bogolyubsky's army sacked Kiev in 1169, Gleb took the Kievan throne; when Mstislav II briefly seized the city, Gleb returned with Cuman allies and retook it in 1170. He died on 20 January 1171, widely believed to have been poisoned by Kievans as his father had been.
zh: 格列布·尤里耶维奇（约1130—1171）是尤里·多尔戈鲁基与波洛韦茨汗阿埃帕之女所生之子、安德烈·博戈柳布斯基之弟，1146/47年首次见于编年史，1147年随父亲征战。他自1149年起镇守卡涅夫，1155年受封佩列亚斯拉夫尔，并在父亲死后保住该城。1169年博戈柳布斯基的军队洗劫基辅后，格列布登上基辅大公之位；姆斯季斯拉夫二世一度夺城，他率波洛韦茨盟军于1170年反攻夺回。1171年1月20日他去世，时人普遍认为他和父亲一样是被基辅人毒死的。

en: Igor II Olgovich (c. 1096–1147), son of Oleg of Chernigov, held the Kievan throne for less than a fortnight in 1146. His brother Vsevolod II had named him heir, but the Kievans called in his kinsman Iziaslav II, whose army defeated Igor; lamed and trapped in marshland, he was captured and thrown into a pit. Released, deathly ill, in autumn 1146, he became a monk in Kiev. In 1147 a mob that suspected him of plotting to regain the throne tore down the balcony sheltering him and killed him. He was venerated as a martyr and buried in Chernigov.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/伊戈尔二世·奥利戈维奇
zh: 伊戈尔二世·奥利戈维奇（约1096—1147）是切尔尼戈夫王公奥列格之子，1146年占据基辅大公之位不足两周。其兄弗谢沃洛德二世虽已立他为继承人，基辅人却迎立其宗亲伊贾斯拉夫二世；伊戈尔兵败后因腿疾困在沼泽中被俘，投入深坑。1146年秋他病重获释，在基辅出家为修士。1147年，一群暴民怀疑他图谋复位，拆毁他避身的阳台将他杀死。他被尊为殉道圣人，遗体安葬于切尔尼戈夫。

en: Ingvar Yaroslavich (died 1220), son of Yaroslav Izyaslavich of Volhynia, ruled Dorogobuzh and then Lutsk from 1180. In 1202 Roman Mstislavich of Galicia and Vsevolod the Big Nest installed him as grand prince of Kiev in place of Rurik Rostislavich, but Rurik recovered the city within the year with Cuman help. Ingvar briefly held Vladimir-Volynsk in 1204, and in 1212 he and Mstislav Romanovich captured Kiev, after which he yielded the throne to Mstislav and withdrew to Lutsk. The Tale of Igor's Campaign praises him as six-winged.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/因戈瓦爾·雅羅斯拉維奇
zh: 因戈瓦尔·雅罗斯拉维奇（？—1220）是沃伦的雅罗斯拉夫·伊贾斯拉维奇之子，先为多罗戈布日王公，1180年起成为卢茨克王公。1202年，加利奇的罗曼·姆斯季斯拉维奇与大窝弗谢沃洛德安排他取代留里克·罗斯季斯拉维奇出任基辅大公，但留里克当年便借助库曼人夺回基辅。1204年他一度受封弗拉基米尔-沃伦斯基；1212年他与姆斯季斯拉夫·罗曼诺维奇合力攻占基辅，随后主动让位，退回卢茨克。《伊戈尔远征记》称他“生有六翼”。

en: Igor (c. 877–945) was Prince of Kiev from 912 to 945 and, by tradition, the son of Rurik. Left an infant at his father's death in 879, he grew up under the regency of his kinsman Oleg. The Primary Chronicle tells how Oleg brought the young Igor to Kiev, lured its rulers Askold and Dir from the city and had them killed. In 941 and 944 Igor led Rus' fleets against Constantinople; Greek fire broke the first attack, and in 945 he made a treaty with Emperor Constantine VII. That year the Drevlians murdered him while he tried to collect tribute a second time, after which his widow Olga took vengeance and the regency.
zh: 伊戈尔（约877—945）于912至945年任基辅王公，相传是留里克之子。879年父亲去世时他尚在襁褓，由亲属奥列格摄政。《往年纪事》记载，奥列格带年幼的伊戈尔来到基辅，将该城统治者阿斯科尔德与季尔诱出并杀害。941和944年，伊戈尔两次率领罗斯水师进攻君士坦丁堡，第一次攻势被希腊火粉碎，945年他与拜占庭皇帝君士坦丁七世缔约。同年，他因试图二次征收贡赋被德列夫利安人杀死，其妻奥莉加随后为他复仇并代行摄政。

en: Igor Svyatoslavich the Brave (3 April 1151 – c. 1201), son of Sviatoslav Olgovich of Chernigov, was prince of Putivl, Novgorod-Seversk (1180–1198) and finally Chernigov (1198–1201/1202). In 1169 he fought for Andrey Bogolyubsky of Vladimir against the prince of Kiev. In 1185, without Kiev's leave, he led a campaign against the Cumans raiding southern Rus': after an opening success his army was destroyed on the Kaiala River and he was captured, later escaping. His ill-fated expedition became the subject of the epic Tale of Igor's Campaign. He married Yaroslavna, daughter of Yaroslav Osmomysl of Halych.
zh: 勇者伊戈尔（1151年4月3日—约1201年）是切尔尼戈夫王公斯维亚托斯拉夫·奥利戈维奇之子，历任普季夫尔、诺夫哥罗德-谢韦尔斯基（1180—1198）和切尔尼戈夫（1198—1201/1202）王公。1169年，他随弗拉基米尔的安德烈·博戈柳布斯基同基辅王公作战。1185年，他未报基辅大公便率军征讨袭扰罗斯南部的库曼人，初战告捷后却在卡亚拉河畔全军覆没，本人被俘，后来伺机逃脱。这场失败的远征正是史诗《伊戈尔远征记》的题材。他娶加利奇王公雅罗斯拉夫·奥斯莫梅斯尔之女雅罗斯拉夫娜为妻。

en: Ivan Ivanovich was a Rurikid prince of Putivl, the son of Ivan Romanovich and a great-grandson of Igor Sviatoslavich, hero of the Tale of Igor's Campaign. The Vvedensky Synodikon records him as a passion-bearer killed by the Tatars for the Christian faith. Historian Leontiy Voytovych placed his death during the Mongol invasion of 1239, earlier than the dating of his life to the late thirteenth and early fourteenth centuries. Historians regard him as the father of Vladimir-Ivan, prince of Kyiv, Andrei of Ovruch, and possibly Stanislav of Kyiv.
zh: 伊万·伊万诺维奇是留里克王朝的普季夫利王公，伊万·罗曼诺维奇之子、《伊戈尔远征记》主人公伊戈尔·斯维亚托斯拉维奇的曾孙。《韦坚斯基追思名录》记载，他是因基督教信仰被鞑靼人杀害的受难圣徒。历史学家列昂季·沃伊托维奇认为他死于1239年蒙古入侵期间，这早于将他生平置于13世纪末至14世纪初的年代判断。历史学家认为，基辅王公弗拉基米尔-伊万、奥夫鲁奇王公安德烈，以及可能还有基辅王公斯坦尼斯拉夫，都是他的儿子。

en: Iziaslav II Mstislavich (c. 1096–1154), a son of Mstislav I of Kiev and grandson of Vladimir II Monomakh, ruled Kursk, Polotsk, Turov, Volhynia and Pereyaslavl before taking the Kievan throne in 1146. His reign was dominated by war with his uncle Yuri Dolgorukiy of Suzdalia, who drove him from Kiev in 1149; Iziaslav recovered the capital in 1151 and held it until his death in November 1154. Baptized Panteleimon, he was among the first Rus princes called tsar in the chronicles, patronized the scholar Clement Smolyatich, and founded the Volhynian Iziaslavichi line.
zh: 伊贾斯拉夫二世·姆斯季斯拉维奇（约1096—1154）是基辅大公姆斯季斯拉夫一世之子、弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫之孙，登上基辅大公之位前先后统治库尔斯克、波洛茨克、图罗夫、沃伦和佩列亚斯拉夫尔。1146年他入主基辅，在位期间主要与叔父、苏兹达尔的尤里·多尔戈鲁基交战，1149年被逐走，1151年收复基辅并统治到1154年11月去世。他教名潘捷列伊蒙，是编年史最早称以“沙皇”的罗斯王公之一，曾庇护学者克利缅特·斯莫利亚季奇，也是沃伦伊贾斯拉维奇一系的始祖。

en: Iziaslav Davidovich (died 1161), the youngest son of Davyd of Chernigov, was prince of Starodub and Chernigov before he thrice seized the Kievan throne. After Iziaslav Mstislavich died in 1154 he took Kiev with Cuman help, but had to yield it to Yuri Dolgorukiy; he returned as grand prince after Yuri's death in 1157. Driven out in 1158 for sheltering Ivan Berladnik, he crossed the frozen Dnieper with Cumans and retook Kiev by surprise in February 1161, only to be mortally wounded while besieging Rostislav at Belgorod. He died on 6 March 1161 and was buried in Chernigov.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/伊贾斯拉夫·达维多维奇
zh: 伊贾斯拉夫·达多维奇（？—1161）是切尔尼戈夫王公达维德的幼子，先为斯塔罗杜布和切尔尼戈夫王公，其后三度占据基辅大公之位。1154年伊贾斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇死后，他借波洛韦茨人之助夺取基辅，却被迫让给尤里·多尔戈鲁基；1157年尤里死后他重登大公公位。1158年他因庇护流亡者伊万·贝尔拉德尼克被逐。1161年2月，他率波洛韦茨人越过封冻的第聂伯河突袭基辅得手，围攻退守别尔哥罗德的罗斯季斯拉夫时受致命伤，于3月6日去世，葬于切尔尼戈夫。

en: Iziaslav IV Vladimirovich (born 1186, last attested 1235–1236), son of Vladimir Igorevich of Galicia, was prince of Terebovlia in 1210 and of Novgorod-Seversk before claiming Kiev. In 1233 he joined Daniel Romanovich's campaign against the Hungarians in Galicia, then defected and ravaged Daniel's lands. In 1234 Iziaslav brought Cuman allies from the steppe, routed the forces of Grand Prince Vladimir Rurikovich and Daniel near Torchesk and captured Vladimir. In 1235 he joined Michael of Chernigov in capturing Kiev and became grand prince. The chronicles lose sight of him after 1235, and the date of his death is unknown.
zh: 伊贾斯拉夫四世·弗拉基米罗维奇（1186年生，1235至1236年间尚有记载）是加利奇王公弗拉基米尔·伊戈列维奇之子，1210年任捷列博夫利亚王公，后据有诺夫哥罗德-谢韦尔斯基，进而争夺基辅。1233年，他先随丹尼尔·罗曼诺维奇进攻占据加利奇的匈牙利人，随即倒戈并蹂躏丹尼尔的领地。1234年，伊贾斯拉夫从草原引来库曼援军，在托尔切斯克附近击溃基辅大公弗拉基米尔·留里科维奇与丹尼尔的军队，俘获弗拉基米尔。1235年，他与切尔尼戈夫的米哈伊尔一同攻占基辅，成为大公。1235年后编年史不再提到他，卒年不详。

en: Iziaslav I Yaroslavich (1024–1078) was the eldest son of Yaroslav the Wise and his second wife Ingigerd. His marriage to Gertrude, sister of the Polish king Casimir I, sealed a 1043 agreement between Yaroslav and Casimir. Prince of Turov from 1045, he became Grand Prince of Kiev in 1054, ruling with his brothers Sviatoslav and Vsevolod. He helped compose the law code of Yaroslav's descendants. In 1067 the brothers defeated Vseslav of Polotsk and seized him under a truce. After the Cumans defeated them at the Alta River in 1068, a Kiev uprising drove Iziaslav into Polish exile. Restored in 1069, he was expelled again in 1073 and sought Western aid before regaining Kiev in 1077. On 3 October 1078 he fell fighting Oleg Sviatoslavich, the only ruling Grand Prince killed in battle.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/伊贾斯拉夫一世·雅罗斯拉维奇
zh: 伊贾斯拉夫一世·雅罗斯拉维奇（1024—1078）是智者雅罗斯拉夫与第二任妻子因吉戈尔德的长子。他与波兰国王卡齐米日一世的妹妹格特鲁德联姻，巩固了雅罗斯拉夫与卡齐米日于1043年达成的协议。他自1045年起任图罗夫王公，1054年成为基辅大公，与兄弟斯维亚托斯拉夫、弗谢沃洛德共同执政。他参与编纂《雅罗斯拉夫诸子法典》。1067年，三兄弟击败波洛茨克王公弗谢斯拉夫，并借停战之机将其诱捕。1068年，他们在阿尔塔河被波洛伏齐人击败，基辅市民起义，伊贾斯拉夫被迫流亡波兰。他于1069年复位，1073年再度被逐，曾向西方求援，1077年才重登基辅公位。1078年10月3日，他在与奥列格·斯维亚托斯拉维奇作战时阵亡，是唯一战死沙场的在任大公。

en: Michael Vsevolodovich of Chernigov (c. 1185 – 20 September 1246), son of Vsevolod the Red, ruled Pereyaslavl, Novgorod-Seversk, Novgorod, Galicia and Chernigov, and became grand prince of Kiev in 1236. He fought the Mongols at the Kalka River in 1223 and long contested Galicia-Volhynia with Daniel of Galicia, while promoting trade and allying with Poland and Hungary. During the Mongol invasion in 1239 he fled to Hungary, then returned to seek a patent from Batu Khan. In 1246 Batu executed him and his boyar Theodore for refusing Mongol purification rites; the Orthodox Church venerates both as martyrs.
zh: 切尔尼戈夫的米哈伊尔·弗谢沃洛多维奇（约1185年—1246年9月20日）是“红发”弗谢沃洛德之子，历任佩列亚斯拉夫尔、诺夫哥罗德-谢韦尔斯基、诺夫哥罗德、加利奇和切尔尼戈夫王公，1236年成为基辅大公。他1223年在卡尔卡河与蒙古人作战，又长年同加利奇的丹尼尔争夺加利奇-沃伦，同时推动贸易，与波兰和匈牙利结盟缔约。1239年蒙古入侵期间他逃往匈牙利，后来返回向拔都请求册封。1246年，拔都因他拒绝行蒙古净化仪式，将他和他的波雅尔费奥多尔处死，东正教会将二人尊为殉道圣徒。

en: Mikhail Yuryevich, called Mikhalko (c. 1145–1176), was the eldest son of Yuri Dolgorukiy's second marriage and half-brother of Andrei Bogolyubsky, who expelled him from Suzdalia. He lived at Ostyor from 1162 and then Torchesk. Named to the Kievan throne after Gleb's death in 1171, he declined it and sent his brother Vsevolod instead; besieged at Torchesk by the Rostislavichi, he won Pereiaslavl in the peace. After Bogolyubsky's murder he took Vladimir, was driven to Chernigov by the Rostov and Suzdal boyars, returned to defeat Yaropolk Rostislavich in 1175, and ruled Vladimir until his death on 20 June 1176.
zh: 米哈伊尔·尤里耶维奇，又名米哈尔科（约1145—1176），是尤里·多尔戈鲁基第二次婚姻的长子、安德烈·博戈柳布斯基的异母弟，曾被博戈柳布斯基逐出苏兹达尔。1162年起他先后居于奥斯乔尔和托尔切斯克。1171年格列布死后，他被任命为基辅大公，却辞不受位，改派弟弟弗谢沃洛德前往；他在托尔切斯克遭罗斯季斯拉维奇一派围攻，议和后获得佩列亚斯拉夫尔。博戈柳布斯基遇刺后他入主弗拉基米尔，又被罗斯托夫和苏兹达尔的波雅尔逼到切尔尼戈夫；1175年他返回并击败亚罗波尔克·罗斯季斯拉维奇，统治弗拉基米尔直到1176年6月20日去世。

en: Mindaugas Holshansky was a Lithuanian prince of the Holshany family whom the late chronicles make a kinsman of the legendary founder Holsha. The Bykhovets Chronicle and the Lithuanian and Samogitian Chronicle relate that after Gediminas defeated the forces of Kyiv on the Irpin River and took the city in 1321 or 1324, he appointed Mindaugas his viceroy there. The chronicles disagree over his tie to the next prince, Algimantas, calling him either his son or his brother. These later chronicles are the sole record of his life.
zh: 相传明道加斯是立陶宛阿尔谢尼什凯家族的王公，与传说中的家族始祖戈尔沙同族。据贝霍韦茨编年史及《立陶宛与萨莫吉希亚编年史》记载，格迪米纳斯在伊尔平河击败基辅军队、于1321年或1324年攻取基辅后，任命明道加斯为当地总督。至于他与下一位王公阿尔吉曼塔斯的关系，两部编年史说法不一，或称其子，或称其弟。他的事迹仅见于这些后世编年史。

en: Mstislav II Iziaslavich (c. 1125–1170), son of Grand Prince Iziaslav II, fought beside his father against Yuri Dolgorukiy and the princes of Chernigov. He defeated the Cumans in 1153 but was beaten by them on the Psel, and in 1155 Dolgorukiy drove him to Poland; returning in 1156, he beat his rival at Vladimir-Volynsky. He held the Kievan throne in 1158–1159 and again from 1167, until Andrei Bogolyubsky's army sacked Kiev in 1169 and forced him back to Volhynia. He retook Kiev in 1170 but died on 19 August, leaving a son, Roman the Great of Galicia-Volhynia.
zh: 姆斯季斯拉夫二世·伊贾斯拉维奇（约1125—1170）是基辅大公伊贾斯拉夫二世之子，曾随父亲同尤里·多尔戈鲁基及切尔尼戈夫诸王公作战。1153年他先击败波洛韦茨人，随后却在普肖尔河畔战败；1155年多尔戈鲁基将他赶到波兰，1156年他率军返回，在弗拉基米尔—沃伦斯基击败对手。他于1158—1159年、1167—1169年两度就任基辅大公。1169年安德烈·博戈柳布斯基的军队洗劫基辅，他被迫退回沃伦。1170年他收复基辅，却于同年8月19日去世，其子即后来的加利奇—沃伦王公罗曼大帝。

en: Mstislav Romanovich the Old (died 1223), son of Roman Rostislavich of Smolensk and baptized Boris, ruled Pskov, Smolensk from 1197 and Belgorod in 1206 before becoming grand prince of Kiev in 1214. He joined the 1185 campaign against the Cumans and in 1221 drove off an invading Hungarian army. In April 1223 he led the southern Rus' princes against the Mongols of Jebe and Subutai; after the catastrophe on the Kalka River he was trapped at a nearby palisade, captured, and executed, reportedly smothered under planking in vengeance for the slain envoys.
zh: “老”姆斯季斯拉夫·罗曼诺维奇（？—1223）是斯摩棱斯克王公罗曼·罗斯季斯拉维奇之子，教名鲍里斯，先后领有普斯科夫、斯摩棱斯克（1197年起）和别尔哥罗德（1206年），1214年成为基辅大公。他参加了1185年征讨库曼人的远征，1221年击退入侵的匈牙利军队。1223年4月，他率领罗斯南部诸王公迎击哲别和速不台的蒙古军；卡尔卡河惨败后，他在附近一处木栅营垒中被俘遇害，据传因蒙古使者被杀而被压在木板之下窒息而死。

en: Mstislav Vladimirovich (1076–1132), called the Great, was the eldest son of Vladimir Monomakh, born at Turov. He ruled Novgorod from 1095 to 1117, served as his father's co-ruler, and succeeded him as grand prince of Kiev in 1125. In 1096 he defeated his father's cousin Oleg of Chernigov on the Koloksha river, and as grand prince campaigned against Polotsk, the Cumans, Estonians and Lithuanians. By his Swedish wife Christina his daughters married the kings of Norway and Denmark. When he died on 14 April 1132, the chronicler wrote, the land of Rus was torn apart.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/姆斯季斯拉夫一世·弗拉基米羅維奇
zh: 姆斯季斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇（1076—1132），史称大帝，是弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫的长子，生于图罗夫。他1095至1117年任诺夫哥罗德王公，后为父亲的共治者，1125年继位为基辅大公。1096年，他在科洛克沙河击败父亲的堂兄弟、切尔尼戈夫的奥列格；为大公后又征讨波洛茨克、波洛韦茨人、爱沙尼亚人与立陶宛人。他与瑞典公主克里斯蒂娜所生的女儿分别嫁给挪威和丹麦国王。1132年4月14日他去世后，编年史家写道，罗斯国土随之四分五裂。

en: Oleg Svyatoslavich (c. 1052–1115), a son of Grand Prince Sviatoslav II of Kiev, ruled Vladimir-Volynsk, Tmutarakan, Chernigov and Novgorod-Seversk. In 1078 he allied with the Cumans to seize Chernigov from his uncle Vsevolod, but defeat at Nezhata meadow drove him back to Tmutarakan; the Khazars handed him to Byzantium, which exiled him to Rhodes. Returning with Cuman aid, he retook Chernigov from Vladimir Monomakh in 1094, lost it in 1096, and from 1097 held Novgorod-Seversk. He founded the Olgovichi clan and never ruled Kiev.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/奥列格·斯维亚托斯拉维奇_(切尔尼戈夫)
zh: 奥列格·斯维亚托斯拉维奇（约1052—1115）是基辅大公斯维亚托斯拉夫二世之子，先后统治弗拉基米尔-沃伦斯基、特穆塔拉干、切尔尼戈夫和诺夫哥罗德-谢韦尔斯基。1078年，他联合波洛韦茨人从叔父弗谢沃洛德手中夺取切尔尼戈夫，却在内扎塔草地之战中战败，逃回特穆塔拉干，后被可萨人解送拜占庭，流放罗得岛。他借波洛韦茨人之助返回，于1094年从弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫手中夺回切尔尼戈夫，1096年再度失守，1097年改领诺夫哥罗德-谢韦尔斯基。他是奥利戈维奇家族的始祖，从未登上基辅大公之位。

en: Roman Rostislavich (c. 1132–1180), eldest son of Rostislav Mstislavich, helped Iziaslav II defend Kiev in 1151 and fought in the defeat of Yuri Dolgorukiy on the Ruta. In 1169 he joined Andrei Bogolyubsky's sack of Kiev, and in 1171 Andrei made him grand prince, only to force him back to Smolensk two years later for shielding boyars suspected of murdering Gleb. After Andrei's death in 1174 Roman returned to Kiev as an independent ruler. He lost it to Sviatoslav of Chernigov in 1176, held Novgorod in 1179, and died in Smolensk in 1180, leaving a son, Mstislav III.
zh: 罗曼·罗斯季斯拉维奇（约1132—1180）是斯摩棱斯克王公罗斯季斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇的长子。1151年他协助伊贾斯拉夫二世守卫基辅，参与了在鲁塔河击败尤里·多尔戈鲁基的战役。1169年他参加安德烈·博戈柳布斯基攻占基辅之役；1171年博戈柳布斯基立他为基辅大公，两年后又因他庇护涉嫌谋害格列布的基辅波雅尔而把他逐回斯摩棱斯克。1174年博戈柳布斯基死后，罗曼以独立王公身份再据基辅。1176年他被迫把基辅让给切尔尼戈夫的斯维亚托斯拉夫，1179年统治诺夫哥罗德一年，1180年死于斯摩棱斯克，其子即后来的基辅大公姆斯季斯拉夫三世。

en: Rostislav Rurikovich (1173 – before 1214), baptized Mikhail, was a son of Rurik Rostislavich of Kiev and Anna of Turov. In 1189 he was married, at sixteen, to the eight-year-old Verkhuslava, daughter of Vsevolod the Big Nest of Vladimir. He ruled Torchesk from 1195 and won victories against the Cumans. When Roman Mstislavich of Galicia tonsured Rurik as a monk in 1204 and jailed his sons, Vsevolod forced their release, and Roman installed Rostislav as grand prince of Kiev (1204–1206). He later held Vyshgorod and briefly seized Halych in 1210, only to be expelled that autumn.
zh: 罗斯季斯拉夫·留里科维奇（1173年—1214年前），教名米哈伊尔，是基辅大公留里克·罗斯季斯拉维奇与图罗夫的安娜之子。1189年，十六岁的他娶弗拉基米尔大窝弗谢沃洛德八岁的女儿韦尔胡斯拉娃为妻。他自1195年起统治托尔切斯克，并数次击败库曼人。1204年，加利奇的罗曼·姆斯季斯拉维奇将其父削发为僧、囚禁诸子，大窝弗谢沃洛德迫使罗曼放人，罗斯季斯拉夫随即被扶立为基辅大公（1204—1206年）。此后他领有维什哥罗德，1210年一度攻占哈利奇，但当年秋天就被逐走。

en: Rostislav I Mstislavich (c. 1110–1167), a son of Mstislav I of Kiev and Christina of Sweden, founded the Smolensk branch of the Rurikids. He held Smolensk from 1125 and briefly ruled Novgorod in 1154 before moving on Kiev. He was Grand Prince of Kiev three times: for a single week in 1154, when Iziaslav III drove him to Chernigov, then from 1159 to 1161 and again from 1161 until his death in March 1167. His sons Roman I, Rurik Rostislavich and Davyd later ruled in Kiev or Smolensk, continuing the Rostislavichi line.
zh: 罗斯季斯拉夫一世·姆斯季斯拉维奇（约1110—1167）是基辅大公姆斯季斯拉夫一世与瑞典的克里斯蒂娜之子，留里克王朝斯摩棱斯克支系的始祖。他自1125年起统治斯摩棱斯克，1154年又短暂入主诺夫哥罗德，随后南下基辅。他三度出任基辅大公：1154年仅在位一周便被伊贾斯拉夫三世赶到切尔尼戈夫，此后又于1159—1161年、1161年至1167年3月去世两度执政。他的儿子罗曼一世、留里克·罗斯季斯拉维奇和达维德后来都曾在基辅或斯摩棱斯克称公，罗斯季斯拉维奇一系由此延续。

en: Rurik (died 879) was the Varangian chieftain whom Rus' tradition credits with founding the dynasty that ruled Kievan Rus'. The Primary Chronicle records that East Slavic and Finnic tribes drove the Varangians across the sea and stopped paying tribute, but then fell into conflict. In 862 they invited Rurik and his brothers Sineus and Truvor to restore order. One chronicle manuscript places his first settlement at Novgorod, another at Ladoga. After his brothers died he absorbed their lands at Beloozero and Izborsk. On his deathbed he entrusted his young son Igor and his realm to his kinsman Oleg, who later seized Kiev and established Kievan Rus'.
zh: 留里克（？—879）是瓦良格人的首领，罗斯传统认为他是统治基辅罗斯的留里克王朝开创者。据《往年纪事》记载，东斯拉夫人与芬兰人诸部落曾将瓦良格人逐至海外并停止纳贡，随后却陷入内斗。862年，他们请来留里克及其兄弟西涅乌斯、特鲁沃尔恢复秩序。一种编年史抄本称他最初在诺夫哥罗德立足，另一种称他先到拉多加。两兄弟死后，他兼并了他们在别洛奥泽罗和伊兹博尔斯克的领地。临终时，他把年幼的儿子伊戈尔和国土托付给亲属奥列格；奥列格后来夺取基辅，建立了基辅罗斯。

en: Rurik Rostislavich (c. 1140–1212), a son of Grand Prince Rostislav Mstislavich of Kiev, led the Smolensk branch of the Rurikids for nearly forty years. He ruled Novgorod in 1170–1171 and Belgorod from 1173, and between 1173 and 1210 seized the Kievan throne at least six times. From 1181 to 1194 he ruled Kiev jointly with Sviatoslav Vsevolodovich of Chernigov. In 1203 he and his Cuman allies sacked Kiev; forced into a monastery in 1204 by Roman Mstislavich, he broke his vows and returned. Vsevolod the Red finally displaced him in 1210, and he died in Chernigov.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/留里克·罗斯季斯拉维奇
zh: 留里克·罗斯季斯拉维奇（约1140—1212）是基辅大公罗斯季斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇之子，近四十年来始终是留里克王朝斯摩棱斯克支系的首领。他于1170至1171年统治诺夫哥罗德，1173年起领有别尔哥罗德，并在1173至1210年间至少六次登上基辅大公之位。1181至1194年，他与切尔尼戈夫的斯维亚托斯拉夫·弗谢沃洛多维奇共同统治基辅。1203年，他联合库曼人洗劫基辅；1204年被罗曼·姆斯季斯拉维奇送入修道院后，他背弃誓约还俗复位。1210年他终被“红发”弗谢沃洛德逐走，在切尔尼戈夫去世。

en: Olga (c. 900–969) became regent of Kievan Rus' in 945, after the Drevlians killed her husband Igor, ruling for her young son Sviatoslav as the first woman to head the state. The Primary Chronicle recounts her revenge: Drevlian envoys were buried alive or burned in a bathhouse, and in 946 she fired their capital Iskorosten by tying burning sulphur to birds. She regularised tribute collection through administrative posts called pogosti. Baptised around 955 and taking the name Elena, she was the first Christian Rurikid ruler, honoured as a saint Equal to the Apostles. She died on 11 July 969.
zh: 奥莉加（约900—969）于945年成为基辅罗斯摄政：当时德列夫利安人杀死了她的丈夫伊戈尔，她代幼子斯维亚托斯拉夫执政，是首位统治这个国家的女性。《往年纪事》记载了她的报复：德列夫利安使者被活埋或烧死在浴室中；946年，她命人把系着燃硫布条的鸟放出，焚毁其都城伊斯科罗斯坚。她还通过名为“波戈斯特”的行政据点规范贡赋征收。约955年她受洗，取名叶莲娜，是留里克家族第一位受洗的统治者，被尊为“与使徒同等”的圣徒，于969年7月11日去世。

en: The sixteenth-century Belarusian-Lithuanian chronicles make Stanislav the last Rurikid prince of Kyiv. They relate that the Lithuanian grand duke Gediminas invaded his lands and in 1320 defeated him and his allies Oleg of Pereyaslavl, Lev of Lutsk and Roman of Bryansk at the battle on the Irpin River, after which Stanislav fled to Bryansk and then to Ryazan, whose prince gave him his daughter Olga in marriage. These accounts were first written down two centuries after the events, and the same Stanislav has also been identified with the Kyivan prince Fyodor.
zh: 据16世纪的白俄罗斯-立陶宛编年史记载，斯坦尼斯拉夫是基辅的末代留里克王公。书中写道，立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯入侵他的领地，于1320年在伊尔平河之战中击败他与佩列亚斯拉夫尔王公奥列格、卢茨克王公列夫、布良斯克王公罗曼的联军；斯坦尼斯拉夫先逃到布良斯克，再投奔梁赞，梁赞公把女儿奥尔加嫁给他。这些说法仅见于两个世纪后编成的编年史，也有学者将他比定为基辅王公费奥多尔。

en: Sviatopolk II Iziaslavich (1050–1113), baptized Michael, was the son of Iziaslav I of Kiev by a concubine. He held Polotsk from 1069, ruled Novgorod in 1078–1088 and Turov from 1088, before succeeding to Kiev in 1093 after Vsevolod's death. His reign was dominated by rivalry and shifting alliances with his cousin Vladimir Monomakh. He attended the princely congresses organized by Monomakh, but also took part in conflicts among the Rurikid princes. The Cumans routed their armies at the Stugna River in 1093, but together they defeated the Cumans at the Salnytsia River in 1111. Sviatopolk encouraged the embellishment of St Michael's Abbey in Kiev. He died on 16 April 1113.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/斯维亚托波尔克二世·伊贾斯拉维奇
zh: 斯维亚托波尔克二世·伊贾斯拉维奇（1050—1113），教名米哈伊尔，是基辅大公伊贾斯拉夫一世的私生子。他1069年受封波洛茨克，1078至1088年统治诺夫哥罗德，1088年起领有图罗夫，1093年弗谢沃洛德死后继承基辅大公之位。他在位期间，与堂兄弟弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫时敌时友。他参加莫诺马赫召集的王公会议，也卷入留里克王公间的争斗。1093年，波洛伏齐人在斯图格纳河大败他们的军队；1111年，二人联兵在萨利尼察河击败波洛伏齐人。他支持装饰基辅的圣米迦勒修道院，于1113年4月16日去世。

en: Sviatopolk I Vladimirovich, called the Accursed (c. 979–1019), was made prince of Turov in 988 by Vladimir the Great, whose son or stepson he was, and married a daughter of Bolesław I the Brave of Poland. Encouraged by his wife and Bishop Reinbern of Kolberg, he prepared to fight Vladimir, who imprisoned all three; Reinbern died in captivity. After Vladimir died in 1015 he seized Kiev; chronicles accuse him of murdering his brothers Boris and Gleb, later venerated as saints. Yaroslav of Novgorod defeated him at Lyubech in 1016, but Sviatopolk returned in 1018 with Polish and Pecheneg help and retook Kiev, only to quarrel with Bolesław. In 1019 Yaroslav routed him on the Alta River; Sviatopolk died fleeing west.
zh: 斯维亚托波尔克·弗拉基米罗维奇（约979—1019），绰号恶棍，988年被弗拉基米尔一世封为图罗夫王公——他可能是弗拉基米尔之子，也可能是其继子——并娶波兰公爵波列斯瓦夫一世之女。在妻子和科沃布热格主教赖恩伯恩的鼓动下，他准备对抗弗拉基米尔，后者将三人囚禁，赖恩伯恩死于狱中。1015年弗拉基米尔死后他夺取基辅，编年史指控他杀害了后来被尊为圣徒的兄弟鲍里斯和格列布。1016年，诺夫哥罗德的雅罗斯拉夫在柳别奇击败他；1018年他借波兰和佩切涅格军队卷土重来，再占基辅，却与波列斯瓦夫反目。1019年雅罗斯拉夫在阿尔塔河将其击溃，斯维亚托波尔克西逃途中死去。

en: Sviatoslav II Yaroslavich (1027–1076), a younger son of Yaroslav the Wise, received Chernigov when his father divided Kievan Rus among his sons in 1054. With his brothers Iziaslav of Kiev and Vsevolod of Pereyaslav he formed a princely triumvirate: together they defeated Vseslav of Polotsk on the Nemiga in 1067, but the Cumans routed them on the Alta in 1068, after which Sviatoslav alone crushed a Cuman band at Snovsk. In 1073, backed by Vsevolod, he drove Iziaslav from Kiev and ruled as grand prince until his death on 27 December 1076. He sponsored collections of theological writings.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/斯维亚托斯拉夫二世·雅罗斯拉维奇
