In 1319 he married Margaret of Neuchâtel, but the marriage was childless. When his clerical younger brother Eberhard II demanded a share of the inheritance, Hartmann had him imprisoned. A reconciliation at Thun Castle on 31 October 1322 turned violent after drinking, and Hartmann fell from a window and died. Backed by Bern, Eberhard then seized the county.
zh: 哈特曼二世（约1299—1322）于1301年继其父哈特曼一世成为基堡伯爵，因年幼由人监护；1313年起，他作为奥地利公爵利奥波德一世的封臣领有勃艮第方伯领地。1319年他娶纳沙泰尔的玛格丽特为妻，没有子嗣。在教会任职的弟弟埃伯哈德二世索要一份遗产，哈特曼便将他囚禁。1322年10月31日，双方在图恩城堡安排和解，酒酣之际口角演成斗殴，哈特曼坠窗身亡。埃伯哈德随后在伯尔尼的支持下夺取了伯国。

en: Hartmann III von Habsburg-Kyburg (c. 1330–1377) succeeded his father Eberhard II as count of Kyburg and landgrave of Burgundy. Reversing Eberhard's pro-Bern course after the so-called brother-murder of Thun, he leaned toward Habsburg Austria and pledged the towns of Burgdorf, Thun and Oltigen to the Austrian dukes. In 1375 his son Rudolf II inherited the indebted county of Neuchâtel-Nidau. Hartmann died on 29 March 1377.
zh: 哈特曼三世·冯·哈布斯堡-基堡（约1330—1377）继承父亲埃伯哈德二世，任基堡伯爵兼勃艮第方伯。其父在“图恩弑兄”后倒向伯尔尼，哈特曼三世却转而亲哈布斯堡奥地利，把布格多夫、图恩和奥尔蒂根诸城抵押给奥地利公爵。1375年，他的儿子鲁道夫二世继承了债台高筑的纳沙泰尔-尼道伯国。哈特曼于1377年3月29日去世。

en: Hartmann I of Kyburg (c. 1275–1301) was a count of Kyburg of the Neu-Kyburg line, son of Eberhard I of Habsburg-Laufenburg and Anna, the Kyburg heiress. He succeeded his father in 1284 while still a child and remained under the guardianship of his uncle Rudolf, bishop of Constance, until 1292. Hartmann was the first of his line to style himself simply count of Kyburg. In 1298 he married Elisabeth of Freiburg, who bore him Hartmann II, Eberhard II and Katharina. He died on 29 March 1301, leaving an underage heir.
zh: 哈特曼一世（约1275—1301）是新基堡支系的基堡伯爵，埃伯哈德一世与基堡女继承人安娜之子。1284年父亲去世后他年幼继位，由叔父、康斯坦茨主教鲁道夫监护至1292年，也是支系中第一个只以冯·基堡为称的伯爵。1298年，他娶弗赖堡的伊丽莎白为妻，生下哈特曼二世、埃伯哈德二世和卡塔琳娜。他于1301年3月29日去世，继承人尚且年幼。

en: Margareta von Kyburg was a daughter of Count Eberhard II von Neu-Kyburg and Anastasia von Signau. She married Count Emicho VI of Leiningen, whose seat was Hardenburg in the Palatinate, and was the mother of his successor Emicho VII.
zh: 玛格丽特·冯·基堡是新基堡伯爵埃伯哈德二世与阿纳斯塔西娅·冯·西格纳乌之女，嫁给府邸在普法尔茨哈登堡的莱宁根伯爵埃米希六世，生子后继伯爵埃米希七世。

en: Titus Mstislavich (died after 1365) was a prince of Kozelsk from the Rurikid line of Karachev, a son of Prince Mstislav Mikhailovich. The chronicles name him only once, without a patronymic, under 1365, when he brought his retinue to help Oleg of Ryazan and Vladimir of Pronsk defeat an army of the Golden Horde at Shishevsky Forest. Later genealogies call him Titus Mstislavich. His sons Svyatoslav and Ivan held Karachev and Kozelsk and married daughters of Algirdas of Lithuania and Oleg of Ryazan.
zh: 季特·姆斯季斯拉维奇（1365年后去世）是留里克王朝卡拉切夫支系的科泽利斯克王公，卡拉切夫王公姆斯季斯拉夫·米哈伊洛维奇之子。编年史中他只被提到一次，而且没有记载父名：1365年，他率部驰援梁赞王公奥列格和普龙斯克王公弗拉基米尔，在希舍夫斯基森林击败金帐汗国的军队。后世的谱系书称他为季特·姆斯季斯拉维奇。他的儿子斯维亚托斯拉夫和伊凡分别领有卡拉切夫与科泽利斯克，并分别娶立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯和梁赞王公奥列格之女为妻。

en: Baldwin II of Courtenay (late 1217–October 1273), the last Latin emperor of Constantinople, was a younger son of Peter of Courtenay and Yolanda of Flanders. He succeeded his brother Robert in 1228 and ruled first with his father-in-law John of Brienne, marrying John's daughter Marie in 1234. His impoverished realm held little beyond Constantinople, and he repeatedly travelled west to seek money and troops. In 1238 his regency council pawned the Crown of Thorns to Venetian creditors; Baldwin later pledged his son Philip to merchants for loans. On 25 July 1261 Alexios Strategopoulos recaptured Constantinople and Baldwin fled, eventually reaching Italy. After signing the Treaty of Viterbo with Charles of Anjou in 1267, he died in Naples in 1273.
zh: 库尔特奈的鲍德温二世（1217年末—1273年10月）是拉丁帝国末代皇帝，为库尔特奈的彼得与佛兰德斯的约兰德较年幼的儿子之一。他1228年继兄罗伯特即位，先与岳父布列讷的约翰共治，1234年娶约翰之女玛丽。他贫困的帝国所余领土仅及君士坦丁堡附近，他多次前往西欧寻求钱财和军队。1238年他的摄政会议把荆棘冠抵押给威尼斯债权人；鲍德温后来又将儿子菲利普押给商人抵债。1261年7月25日，阿莱克修斯·斯特拉特戈普洛斯收复君士坦丁堡，鲍德温逃离，最终来到意大利。1267年他与安茹的查理签订《维泰博条约》，1273年死于那不勒斯。

en: Berengaria of León (1204–1237) was the daughter of Alfonso IX of León and Berengaria of Castile, and a younger sister of Ferdinand III, who became king of Castile in 1217. In 1223 Alfonso offered his daughter Sancha in marriage to the twice-widowed John of Brienne, former king of Jerusalem. Berengaria's mother offered John one of her own daughters instead; he chose Berengaria and married her at Toledo in 1224. When John was elected Latin emperor in 1229 and crowned at Constantinople in 1231, she became empress consort of the Latin Empire. Her daughter Marie married Baldwin II, while her sons Alphonso of Brienne and Louis of Beaumont served the kings of France. She died on 12 April 1237, within weeks of her husband.
zh: 莱昂的贝伦加丽娅（1204—1237）是莱昂国王阿方索九世与卡斯蒂利亚的贝伦加丽娅之女，也是1217年登上卡斯蒂利亚王位的费尔南多三世之妹。1223年，阿方索提议将女儿桑查嫁给两度丧妻的前耶路撒冷国王布列讷的约翰。贝伦加丽娅的母亲则提出让约翰迎娶自己的一个女儿；他选择了贝伦加丽娅，二人于1224年在托莱多成婚。1229年约翰当选拉丁皇帝、1231年于君士坦丁堡加冕，她遂成为拉丁帝国的皇后。其女玛丽嫁给鲍德温二世，诸子阿方索和路易则效力于法兰西国王。1237年4月12日，她在丈夫去世仅数周后离世。

en: John of Brienne (c. 1170–1237), a younger son of the count of Brienne in Champagne, married the heiress Maria and was crowned king of Jerusalem in 1210. After Maria's death he ruled as regent for their daughter Isabella and led the Fifth Crusade, which seized Damietta in 1219 but collapsed in 1221. In 1225 he married Isabella to Emperor Frederick II, who took the kingdom from him. In 1229 John was elected Latin emperor at Constantinople and crowned in 1231. He led its defense against Nicaea and Bulgaria in 1235–1236 and died as a Franciscan friar in 1237.
zh: 布列讷的约翰（约1170—1237）是香槟地区布列讷伯爵较年幼的儿子，与耶路撒冷女王储玛丽亚成婚，1210年加冕为耶路撒冷国王。玛丽亚死后，他以女儿伊莎贝拉的名义摄政，并统领第五次十字军东征，于1219年攻占杜姆亚特，却在1221年溃败。1225年他将伊莎贝拉嫁给皇帝腓特烈二世，后者随即从他手中夺走王国。1229年约翰当选君士坦丁堡的拉丁皇帝，1231年加冕；1235至1236年他领导抵御尼西亚与保加利亚的围攻，1237年以方济各会修士身份去世。

en: Peter II of Courtenay (c. 1155–c. 1218), son of Peter I of Courtenay and cousin of King Philip II of France, took the cross on the Third Crusade in 1190, fought in the Albigensian Crusade at the siege of Lavaur in 1211, and fought at Bouvines in 1214. Chosen Latin emperor after his brother-in-law Henry of Flanders died in 1216, he was crowned by Pope Honorius III in Rome in April 1217. He borrowed Venetian ships in return for a promise to capture Durazzo, but failed and continued overland. Theodore Komnenos Doukas of Epirus captured him, and Peter died in captivity without ruling Constantinople, where his wife Yolanda governed for a time.
zh: 皮埃尔二世·德·库尔特奈（约1155—约1218）是皮埃尔一世·德·库尔特奈之子、法兰西国王腓力二世的堂亲。他1190年参加第三次十字军东征，1211年在阿尔比十字军东征中参与围攻拉沃尔，1214年又投身布汶战役。1216年内兄佛兰德斯的亨利死后无嗣，他被选为拉丁皇帝，1217年4月在罗马由教宗洪诺留三世加冕。他向威尼斯人借船，答应为他们攻取都拉斯，但攻城失败后转走陆路。伊庇鲁斯专制君主狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯将他俘获，他死于囚禁之中，从未在君士坦丁堡执政；妻子约兰德曾在那里代行统治。

en: Robert of Courtenay (1201–1228) was Latin emperor of Constantinople from 1221 until his death, a younger son of Peter II of Courtenay and Yolanda of Flanders. Succeeding after his brother Philip II of Namur renounced the claim, he was crowned on 25 March 1221 and allied with his brother-in-law Andrew II of Hungary. His reign brought defeat: Thessalonica fell to Theodore Komnenos Doukas of Epirus in 1224, and John III Vatatzes of Nicaea beat him at Poimanenos the same year. A Burgundian conspiracy drove him from Constantinople; he fled to Rome and died in the Morea early in 1228.
zh: 库尔特奈的罗贝尔（1201—1228）是1221年至去世期间在位的君士坦丁堡拉丁皇帝，皮埃尔二世·德·库尔特奈与佛兰德的约兰达的幼子之一。其兄那慕尔侯爵腓力二世放弃继承权后，他于1221年3月25日加冕，并与姻兄匈牙利国王安德烈二世结盟。他在位期间连遭挫败：1224年塞萨洛尼基被伊庇鲁斯的狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯攻占，同年又在波伊曼农之战中被尼西亚的约翰三世·瓦塔泽斯击败。一伙勃艮第贵族密谋将他逐出君士坦丁堡，他逃往罗马申诉，1228年初死于返程途中的摩里亚。

en: Albert IV of Saxe-Lauenburg (1315–1343) was the eldest son of Duke John II and Elisabeth of Holstein-Rendsburg. In 1321 he succeeded his father as duke of the Saxe-Bergedorf-Molln branch of Saxe-Lauenburg, ruling first under his mother's regency; she later married Eric Christoffersen, son of King Christopher II of Denmark. In 1334 Albert married Beata, daughter of Gunzelin VI, Count of Schwerin, and after her death married Sophia of Werle-Gustrow in 1341. His three sons by Beata, John III, Albert V and Eric III, later ruled the branch duchy in turn. Albert died in 1343.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿爾布雷希特四世_(薩克森-勞恩堡)
zh: 萨克森-劳恩堡的阿尔布雷希特四世（1315—1343）是公爵约翰二世与荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡的伊丽莎白的长子。1321年他继承父位，成为萨克森-劳恩堡分支萨克森-贝格多夫-默尔恩的公爵，起初由母亲摄政；其母后来嫁给丹麦国王克里斯托弗二世之子埃里克·克里斯托弗森。1334年，阿尔布雷希特娶什未林伯爵贡策林六世之女碧雅特，她去世后又于1341年娶维尔勒-居斯特罗的索菲。他与碧雅特所生的三个儿子约翰三世、阿尔布雷希特五世和埃里希三世后来相继统治该支系公国。阿尔布雷希特于1343年去世。

en: Albert V of Saxe-Lauenburg (c. 1335–1370) was the second son of Duke Albert IV and Beata of Schwerin. In 1356 he succeeded his childless brother John III as duke of the Saxe-Bergedorf-Molln branch. Short of money, he sold Molln to Lubeck for 9737.5 marks, a key stage on the salt route to Scandinavia. With his cousin Eric II he plundered merchants near Hamburg until 1363, when Hamburg and its allies stormed Bergedorf castle. By 1366 he had married Catherine of Werle-Gustrow, but died without heirs in 1370; his brother Eric III succeeded him.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿爾布雷希特五世_(薩克森-勞恩堡)
zh: 萨克森-劳恩堡的阿尔布雷希特五世（约1335—1370）是阿尔布雷希特四世公爵与什未林的碧雅特的次子。1356年无嗣而终的兄长约翰三世传位给他，他成为萨克森-贝格多夫-默尔恩支系公爵。因手头拮据，他以9737.5吕贝克马克将默尔恩卖给吕贝克；默尔恩是通往斯堪的纳维亚的食盐商路上的重要驿站。他与堂叔埃里希二世一道在汉堡附近劫掠商人，1363年汉堡及其盟军攻陷贝格多夫城堡。1366年前他娶维尔勒-居斯特罗的卡塔琳娜，1370年无嗣而终，弟弟埃里希三世继位。

en: Elisabeth of Pomerania (died after 1349) was a daughter of Duke Bogislaw IV of Pomerania and Margaret of Rugen. About 1318 she married Duke Eric I of Saxe-Lauenburg, and was the mother of Duke Eric II and of Helene, Countess of Hoya.
zh: 波美拉尼亚的伊丽莎白（1349年后去世）是波美拉尼亚公爵波吉斯瓦夫四世与吕根的玛格丽特之女。约1318年她嫁给萨克森-劳恩堡公爵埃里希一世，是公爵埃里希二世与霍亚伯爵夫人海伦娜的母亲。

en: Eric I of Saxe-Lauenburg (c. 1280–1360) was an Ascanian duke, the second son of Duke John I of Saxony and Ingeborg. When John I abdicated in 1282, Eric and his brothers succeeded under their uncle Albert II's guardianship, and Saxony was partitioned into Saxe-Lauenburg and Saxe-Wittenberg in 1296. Eric held Bergedorf and Lauenburg, inherited his brother Albert III's Ratzeburg share after 1308, and ceded Bergedorf to John II in 1321. About 1317 he married Elisabeth, daughter of Bogislaw IV of Pomerania. He abdicated in 1338 for his son Eric II and died in exile at Nienburg in 1360.
zh: 萨克森-劳恩堡的埃里希一世（约1280—1360）是阿斯坎尼家族的公爵，萨克森公爵约翰一世与英格堡的次子。1282年约翰一世退位后，埃里希与兄弟在叔父阿尔布雷希特二世监护下继位，1296年萨克森正式分裂为萨克森-劳恩堡与萨克森-维滕堡。埃里希领有贝格多夫和劳恩堡，1308年后继承兄弟阿尔布雷希特三世的拉策堡份额，1321年将贝格多夫让给约翰二世。约1317年，他娶波美拉尼亚公爵波吉斯瓦夫四世之女伊丽莎白。1338年他让位给儿子埃里希二世，1360年在尼恩堡的流亡中去世。

en: Eric II of Saxe-Lauenburg (c. 1318–1368) was the eldest son of Duke Eric I and Elisabeth, daughter of Bogislaw IV of Pomerania. When his father abdicated in 1338 he succeeded as duke of the Saxe-Ratzeburg-Lauenburg branch. With his cousin Albert V of Saxe-Bergedorf-Molln he plundered merchants travelling through their lands, until in 1363 Hamburg, Count Adolphus IX of Holstein-Kiel and Archbishop Albert II of Bremen moved against them and stormed Albert's castle at Bergedorf. About 1342 he married Agnes, daughter of Count John III of Holstein-Plon; their son Eric IV succeeded him in 1368.
zh: 萨克森-劳恩堡的埃里希二世（约1318—1368）是埃里希一世公爵与波美拉尼亚公爵波吉斯瓦夫四世之女伊丽莎白的长子。1338年父亲退位后，他继位为萨克森-拉策堡-劳恩堡支系公爵。他与堂侄萨克森-贝格多夫-默尔恩的阿尔布雷希特五世一道劫掠途经其领地的商人，1363年汉堡、荷尔斯泰因-基尔伯爵阿道弗斯九世与不来梅大主教阿尔布雷希特二世联手出兵，攻陷了阿尔布雷希特在贝格多夫的城堡。约1342年，他娶荷尔斯泰因-普伦伯爵约翰三世之女阿格尼丝；儿子埃里希四世于1368年继位。

en: Eric III of Saxe-Bergedorf (c. 1335–1401), youngest son of Duke Albert IV of Saxe-Lauenburg and Beata of Schwerin, was initially destined for the clergy. After his brothers John III and Albert V died without heirs he left the church and in 1370 succeeded Albert as duke of the heavily indebted Saxe-Bergedorf-Molln branch. He pawned Bergedorf, the Vierlande, his half of the Saxon Wood and Geesthacht to Lubeck for 16262.5 marks, keeping only a life tenancy. He died heirless in 1401, succeeded by his cousin Eric IV, under whom the two branch duchies reunited.
zh: 萨克森-贝格多夫的埃里希三世（约1335—1401）是萨克森-劳恩堡公爵阿尔布雷希特四世与什未林的碧雅特的幼子，本拟从事神职。两位兄长约翰三世和阿尔布雷希特五世先后无嗣而终后，他离开教会，于1370年继阿尔布雷希特之位，统治负债累累的萨克森-贝格多夫-默尔恩支系公国。他以16262.5吕贝克马克把贝格多夫、菲尔兰德、萨克森森林的一半份额和盖斯特哈赫特典给吕贝克，仅保留终身用益权。1401年他无嗣而终，族亲埃里希四世继位，两个支系公国在其治下重新统一。

en: Helene of Saxe-Lauenburg was a daughter of Duke Eric I of Saxe-Lauenburg and Elisabeth of Pomerania. She married John II, Count of Hoya-Bruchhausen, and was mother of Eric I, Count of Hoya. She was still living on 11 August 1354.
zh: 萨克森-劳恩堡的海伦娜是萨克森-劳恩堡公爵埃里希一世与波美拉尼亚的伊丽莎白之女，嫁给霍亚-布鲁希豪森伯爵约翰二世，是霍亚伯爵埃里希一世的母亲。1354年8月11日时她仍在世。

en: John I (1249–1285) was Duke of Saxony from the House of Ascania. After his father Albert I died in 1260, he ruled jointly with his younger brother Albert II, gradually partitioning the three disconnected Saxon lands between them in 1269, 1272 and 1282. In 1269 he also became burgrave of Magdeburg. In 1270 he married Ingeborg, possibly a daughter of Birger Jarl or King Eric of Sweden. In 1282 he resigned in favour of his three minor sons John II, Eric I and Albert III, and entered the Franciscan monastery at Wittenberg, where he died on 30 July 1285.
zh: 约翰一世（1249—1285）是阿斯坎尼家族的萨克森公爵。1260年父亲阿尔布雷希特一世去世后，他与弟弟阿尔布雷希特二世共同执政，并于1269、1272和1282年逐步瓜分三块互不相连的萨克森领地。1269年他还成为马格德堡城堡伯爵。1270年，他与英格堡结婚，她可能是比尔耶尔伯爵或瑞典国王埃里克之女。1282年，他让位于三个年幼的儿子约翰二世、埃里希一世和阿尔布雷希特三世，进入维滕贝格的方济各会修道院，1285年7月30日在那里去世。

en: John II of Saxe-Lauenburg (c. 1275–1322) was the eldest son of Duke John I and Ingeborg Birgersdotter. After his father resigned in 1282, he and his brothers were placed under their uncle Albert II's guardianship and joined him as rulers upon coming of age. In 1296 Saxony was divided into Saxe-Wittenberg and Saxe-Lauenburg. John held the Mölln portion and gained Bergedorf from his brother Eric I in 1321, his branch becoming Saxe-Bergedorf-Mölln. Though blind from his youth, he claimed the disputed Saxon electoral vote and joined the 1314 imperial election that raised Louis IV of Bavaria to the German kingship. He died on 22 April 1322.
zh: 萨克森-劳恩堡的约翰二世（约1275—1322）是约翰一世公爵与英格堡·比耶尔斯多塔的长子。1282年父亲退位后，他与弟弟们先由叔父阿尔布雷希特二世监护，成年后与叔父共同执政。1296年萨克森被分为萨克森-维滕贝格与萨克森-劳恩堡两部分。约翰分得默尔恩一份，1321年又从弟弟埃里希一世手中获得贝格多夫，他的支系因此称萨克森-贝格多夫-默尔恩。他虽自幼失明，仍主张存在争议的萨克森选侯票，并参加了1314年推举巴伐利亚人路易四世为德意志国王的选帝。1322年4月22日去世。

en: John III of Saxe-Lauenburg (c. 1335–1356) was the eldest son of Duke Albert IV and Beata of Schwerin, daughter of Count Gunzelin VI of Schwerin. On his father's death in 1343 he succeeded as duke of the Saxe-Bergedorf-Molln branch of Saxe-Lauenburg. In 1356 he died without an heir, and the branch duchy passed to his younger brother Albert V; a third brother, Eric III, in turn succeeded Albert later.
zh: 萨克森-劳恩堡的约翰三世（约1335—1356）是阿尔布雷希特四世公爵与什未林伯爵贡策林六世之女碧雅特的长子。1343年父亲去世后，他继位为萨克森-劳恩堡的萨克森-贝格多夫-默尔恩支系公爵。1356年他无嗣而终，支系公国传给弟弟阿尔布雷希特五世；三弟埃里希三世后来又在阿尔布雷希特之后继位。

en: Thai chronicle genealogy records the second king of the Tritrueng line as ruler of Phraek Si Racha and later king of Lavo, and names Son Sai among his children.
zh: 泰国编年史谱系记载，特里特棱世系的第二代王统治帕艾·西拉查，后来成为罗涡国王，其子女中有颂赛。

en: Thai chronicles make Kraisornrat a Tai ruler of the northern city-state of Chaliang in the upper Chao Phraya valley. Lavo's court had moved from Lavapura, modern Lopburi, to Ayodhya in the 1080s, and its former seat stood vacant from 1087 until Kraisornrat took it in 1106. Chaliang then became a northern stronghold of Lavapura, held by the crown prince. Kraisornrat married Suladevi, a princess of Si Satchanalai, and the chronicles name Sai Nam Phueng among his children.
zh: 泰国编年史记载，克赖颂叻是湄南河上游泰人城邦差良的统治者。罗涡王廷在1080年代从拉瓦普拉（今华富里）迁往阿约提亚，旧都的王位自1087年起空缺，直到克赖颂叻于1106年进占该城。此后差良成为拉瓦普拉的北方要塞，由王储驻守。克赖颂叻娶西沙差那莱公主苏拉黛维为妻，编年史记载他的子女中有赛南朋。

en: Chronicle genealogy recorded by Phra Borihan Thepthani identifies Kraisonrat as coming from Wiang Phang Kham in Singhanavati and places him among the ancestors of the rulers of Phraek Si Racha and the Lavo Ayodhya line.
zh: 帕·博里汉·贴塔尼整理的泰国编年史谱系记载，克赖颂叻来自辛哈纳瓦蒂的威昂潘坎，是帕艾·西拉查与罗涡阿约提亚一系统治者的先祖之一。

en: Chronicles present Sri Thammasokkarat as a Tai ruler of Si Satchanalai. In 1181, when the Khmer king Jayavarman VII moved to recover Lavapura, the former Lavo capital, and appointed his kinsman Narupatidnavarman to govern it, Sri Thammasokkarat withdrew under this pressure to Nakhon Si Thammarat on the Malay Peninsula. Later Thai tradition honours him as founder of that city and first king of the Sri Thammasokaraj, or Padummavamsa, dynasty, whose rulers governed the twelve peninsula cities and kept ties with Sukhothai.
zh: 编年史记载，室利达摩索卡拉是西沙差那莱的泰人统治者。1181年，高棉国王阇耶跋摩七世着手收复罗涡旧都拉瓦普拉，并任命亲属那鲁帕廷德拉跋摩治理该城；室利达摩索卡拉在这一压力下南撤至马来半岛的那空是贪玛叻（洛坤）。后世泰人传统尊他为该城的建立者、室利达摩索卡拉王朝（又称巴东旺萨王朝）的开国君主，该王朝统治半岛十二城，并与素可泰保持往来。

en: Heinrich II Bochholt (died 1 March 1341), son of a Lübeck councilman, was elected bishop of Lübeck in 1317, the first commoner to hold the Hanseatic city's see. His election ended the quarrel his predecessor Burkhard von Serkem had waged with the city council, and Pope John XXII lifted the interdict Serkem had imposed. After seven years at the papal court in Avignon, Heinrich in 1329 resumed the stalled Gothic high choir of Lübeck Cathedral, endowing five side altars at his own cost. He died in March 1341, a month before the choir was consecrated.
zh: 海因里希二世·博霍尔特（1341年3月1日卒）是吕贝克一名市政官之子，1317年当选吕贝克主教，是这座汉萨城市首位平民出身的主教。他的当选平息了前任布尔夏德·冯·塞尔肯与市议会的冲突，教宗若望二十二世也解除了塞尔肯颁布的禁罚令。在阿维尼翁教廷停留七年后，海因里希于1329年重启停工的吕贝克主教座堂哥特式高坛工程，并自费捐建五座附属祭坛。他于1341年3月去世，一个月后高坛才举行祝圣礼。

en: Henry XIII (1235–1290) was the younger son of Otto II of Bavaria and Agnes of Brunswick. In 1254 he succeeded his father with his brother Louis II, and in 1255 the brothers partitioned the duchy, Henry taking Lower Bavaria in its first division. The division broke the law and angered Bavarian bishops, who allied with Ottokar II of Bohemia. Henry made Landshut his residence, began Burghausen Castle, and in 1257 joined Louis to repel Ottokar's invasion. He later warred on Salzburg and Passau, shifted allegiance between King Rudolph I and Ottokar, and in 1274 helped found Fürstenzell Abbey. His peace ordinances imposed heavy penalties for carrying swords or daggers in Landshut. He died in 1290, leaving Lower Bavaria to his son Otto III.
zh: 亨利十三世（1235—1290）是巴伐利亚公爵奥托二世与不伦瑞克的阿格尼丝较年幼的儿子。1254年他与兄长路易二世共同继承父位，1255年兄弟瓜分公国，亨利分得下巴伐利亚，这是巴伐利亚的首次分裂。瓜分违反法律，激怒了巴伐利亚主教，他们转而与波希米亚国王奥托卡二世结盟。亨利以兰茨胡特为居所，动工修建布格豪森城堡，1257年又与路易联手击退奥托卡的入侵。此后他屡与萨尔茨堡和帕绍交战，在德意志国王鲁道夫一世与奥托卡之间反复倒戈，并于1274年协助创办菲斯滕采尔修道院。他颁行的治安条例对在兰茨胡特携带剑或匕首者处以重罚。他于1290年去世，下巴伐利亚传给儿子奥托三世。

en: Henry XIV (1305–1339), born at Landshut, was a son of Stephen I of Lower Bavaria and Jutta of Schweidnitz. When their father died in 1310, he and his brother Otto IV took the duchy under the guardianship of their cousin Emperor Louis IV. In 1328 he married Margaret, daughter of John of Bohemia. He backed Louis against Frederick the Fair and became a candidate for the German crown when Louis considered temporarily resigning in 1333. A feud with Otto IV and their cousin Henry XV over the partition of Lower Bavaria strained his ties with the emperor and pushed him toward his father-in-law John; in winter 1337 he rode with large retinues on John's crusade with the Teutonic Order in Prussia. After reconciling with Louis IV in February 1339, he died of leprosy that 1 September. Lower Bavaria passed to his son John I, who died in 1340, and by December Bavaria was reunited under Louis IV.
zh: 亨利十四世（1305—1339）生于兰茨胡特，是下巴伐利亚公爵斯特凡一世与希维德尼察的尤塔之子。1310年父亲去世后，他与弟弟奥托四世在堂兄皇帝路易四世监护下继承公国。1328年，他娶波希米亚国王约翰之女玛格丽特。他支持路易对抗美男子腓特烈，1333年路易考虑暂时退位时，他成为德意志王位候选人。后来他因瓜分下巴伐利亚之事与奥托四世及堂兄亨利十五世反目，与皇帝的关系恶化，转而靠向岳父约翰；1337年冬，他带着大批随从随约翰赴普鲁士，参加条顿骑士团的十字军。1339年2月与路易四世和解，同年9月1日死于麻风病。下巴伐利亚传给儿子约翰一世，约翰一世于1340年去世，当年12月巴伐利亚已重归路易四世统一。

en: Henry XV (1312–1333), called the Natternberger after his favourite Natternberg Castle, was a Wittelsbach Duke of Lower Bavaria, son of Duke Otto III and Agnes of Głogów, born shortly before his father's death. He grew up under the tutelage of his cousin Emperor Louis IV and ruled jointly with his cousins Henry XIV and Otto IV until the partition of 1331 gave him Deggendorf and the surrounding lands. In 1327 he stood unsuccessfully as a candidate for the Hungarian crown. He married Anna of Austria and died childless at Natternberg near Deggendorf on 18 June 1333.
zh: 亨利十五世（1312—1333）是维特尔斯巴赫家族的下巴伐利亚公爵，公爵奥托三世与格沃古夫的阿格妮丝之子，因喜爱纳滕贝格城堡而得到“纳滕贝格的”绰号。他出生后不久父亲即去世，在堂兄皇帝路易四世监护下长大，与堂亲亨利十四世和奥托四世共同执政，直到1331年瓜分下巴伐利亚，他分得德根多夫一带。1327年，他曾谋求匈牙利王位但未果。他娶奥地利的安娜为妻，1333年6月18日无嗣而卒于德根多夫附近的纳滕贝格。

en: John I of Bavaria (29 November 1329 – December 1340), called John the Child, was the only son of Duke Henry XIV of Lower Bavaria and Margaret of Bohemia, daughter of King John the Blind. After two childhood betrothals were set aside, on 18 April 1339 he married Anna, daughter of Emperor Louis IV, in Munich, sealing peace between the Wittelsbach branches. When Henry died that September, the emperor became his guardian. John ruled Lower Bavaria only a year, dying at Landshut aged eleven; with him the Lower Bavarian line ended and Louis IV reunited the duchy divided in 1255.
zh: 巴伐利亚的约翰一世（1329年11月29日—1340年12月），人称“孩童约翰”，是下巴伐利亚公爵亨利十四世与波希米亚的玛格丽特——波希米亚国王“盲人约翰”之女——的独子。两次童年订婚先后取消后，他于1339年4月18日在慕尼黑迎娶皇帝路易四世之女安娜，这桩婚姻促成维特尔斯巴赫两派和解。同年9月亨利去世，皇帝成为他的监护人。约翰只统治下巴伐利亚一年，便在兰茨胡特夭折，年仅十一岁；随着他去世，下巴伐利亚支系绝嗣，路易四世重新统一了1255年分裂的公国。

en: Kunigunde von Orlamünde (1303–1382) was a German noblewoman, the eldest daughter of Ulrich I, Landgrave of Leuchtenberg. In 1321 she married Otto VI, Count of Weimar-Orlamünde; the pair had no children of their own and adopted a daughter, Podika von Schaumnerg. Widowed with a large inheritance in 1340, she endowed the Cistercian Convent of the Celestial Throne in Nuremberg in 1342 and served there as abbess until her death. German folklore later made her the model for the White Lady (Weiße Frau) said to haunt the Hohenzollern castles.
zh: 库妮贡德·冯·奥拉明德（1303—1382）是德意志贵族女子，为洛伊希滕贝格领地伯爵乌尔里希一世的长女。1321年，她嫁给魏玛-奥拉明德伯爵奥托六世；二人没有亲生子女，收养了女儿波迪卡·冯·绍姆内格。1340年丈夫去世后，她承得大笔遗产，于1342年捐资纽伦堡的熙笃会天座修道院，并出任该院院长直至去世。德意志民间传说后来把她附会为出没于霍亨索伦家族城堡的“白衣夫人”的原型。

en: Louis III (1269–1296) was born in Landshut, a younger son of Henry XIII of Lower Bavaria and Elizabeth of Hungary. After his father's death in 1290, Lower Bavaria was held by the three brothers Otto III, Louis and Stephen, though Louis and Stephen only became co-regents in summer 1294. On 30 May 1293 the brothers agreed at Vilshofen on an ordinance to govern their life together and limit their courts, allowing each just twelve horses for his stable. Louis nevertheless raised taxes to fund a lavish household. He married Isabelle, daughter of Frederick III of Lorraine, and died childless on 13 May 1296, his share falling to his brothers.
zh: 路易三世（1269—1296）生于兰茨胡特，是下巴伐利亚公爵亨利十三世与匈牙利的伊丽莎白较年幼的儿子。1290年父亲死后，下巴伐利亚由奥托三世、路易、斯特凡三兄弟共同领有，但路易与斯特凡迟至1294年夏才成为共同摄政。1293年5月30日，三兄弟在多瑙河畔菲尔斯霍芬订立规章，安排共同生活并限制各自的宫廷，每人的马厩只准养十二匹马。路易却照旧加税以维持奢华的宫廷。他娶洛林公爵腓特烈三世之女伊莎贝尔为妻，1296年5月13日去世，无嗣，领地份额归于两位兄弟。

en: Margaret of Bohemia (8 July 1313 – 11 July 1341), also called Margaret of Luxembourg, was the eldest daughter of King John of Bohemia and the Přemyslid princess Elizabeth; her brother later became the Emperor Charles IV. On 12 August 1328 she married Henry XIV, Duke of Lower Bavaria, at Straubing, allying him with her father against the Emperor Louis IV. Her son John I was born in 1329; a second son died young. When John I's death ended the Lower Bavarian line in 1340, Louis IV took the duchy and Margaret withdrew to Bohemia, dying in Prague in July 1341.
zh: 波希米亚的玛格丽特（1313年7月8日—1341年7月11日），又称卢森堡的玛格丽特，是波希米亚国王约翰与普热米斯尔王朝公主伊丽莎白的长女，弟弟后来成为皇帝查理四世。1328年8月12日，她在施特劳宾嫁给下巴伐利亚公爵亨利十四世，这桩婚事使亨利与她的父亲结盟，共同对抗皇帝路易四世。她于1329年生下儿子约翰一世，另有一子早夭。1340年约翰一世去世，下巴伐利亚支系绝嗣，路易四世接管公国，玛格丽特返回波希米亚，于1341年7月在布拉格去世。

en: Otto III (1261–1312), eldest son of Henry XIII and Elizabeth of Hungary, succeeded his father in 1290 and ruled Lower Bavaria jointly with his brothers Louis III and Stephen I. A grandson of Béla IV of Hungary and an opponent of the Habsburgs, he fought for King Adolf at Göllheim in 1298. Offered the Hungarian crown in 1301, he accepted in 1305 after Wenceslaus III renounced his own claim in Otto's favor. Otto slipped into Buda disguised as a merchant and was crowned at Székesfehérvár in December. His rival Charles of Anjou captured fortresses and Buda, while Ladislaus Kán, voivode of Transylvania, imprisoned Otto in 1307. Otto abdicated in 1308 and died at Landshut in 1312.
zh: 奥托三世（1261—1312）是亨利十三世与匈牙利的伊丽莎白之长子，1290年继位，与弟弟路易三世、斯特凡一世共同统治下巴伐利亚。他是匈牙利国王贝拉四世的外孙，与哈布斯堡家族为敌，1298年在格尔海姆战役中为德意志国王阿道夫作战。1301年有人向他献上匈牙利王冠，1305年瓦茨拉夫三世放弃主张、转而支持他后，他才接受。奥托乔装商人潜入布达，12月在塞克什白堡加冕。对手安茹的查理攻占多座要塞和布达，特兰西瓦尼亚总督拉迪斯劳斯·坎则于1307年囚禁了奥托。奥托于1308年退位，1312年卒于兰茨胡特。

en: Otto IV (1307–1334) was a Wittelsbach Duke of Lower Bavaria, son of Duke Stephen I and Jutta of Schweidnitz. From his father's death in 1310 he ruled jointly with his brother Henry XIV and cousin Henry XV. The co-regents warred among themselves in 1322, and in 1331 Lower Bavaria was partitioned, Otto taking Burghausen and Traunstein. Estranged from his brother, he named his cousin Emperor Louis IV his contracted heir. He married Richardis of Jülich and died in Munich on 14 December 1334, his young son Albert predeceasing him.
zh: 奥托四世（1307—1334）是维特尔斯巴赫家族的下巴伐利亚公爵，公爵斯特凡一世与希维德尼察的尤塔之子。1310年父亲去世后，他与兄长亨利十四世、堂兄亨利十五世共同执政。共同统治者于1322年相互开战，1331年下巴伐利亚被瓜分，奥托分得布格豪森和特劳恩施泰因。他与兄长交恶，立堂兄皇帝路易四世为约定继承人。他娶于利希的理查迪斯为妻，1334年12月14日卒于慕尼黑，幼子阿尔布雷希特先他而死。

en: Stephen I (1271–1310), born in Landshut, was the youngest son of Henry XIII of Lower Bavaria and Elizabeth of Hungary, who may have named him for her brother Stephen V of Hungary. Destined for the church in Salzburg, he was blocked by Pope Nicholas IV, eager to limit Wittelsbach influence, and from 1290 ruled Lower Bavaria jointly with his brothers Otto III and Louis III. While Otto pursued the Hungarian crown from 1305 to 1308, Stephen governed the duchy alone. He died in 1310 fighting the Habsburgs under Frederick I of Austria, leaving sons Henry XIV and Otto IV.
zh: 斯特凡一世（1271—1310）生于兰茨胡特，是下巴伐利亚公爵亨利十三世与匈牙利的伊丽莎白最小的儿子，母亲可能以其舅匈牙利国王斯特凡五世之名为他取名。他本被安排在萨尔茨堡走教士之路，教宗尼古拉四世为限制维特尔斯巴赫家族的势力而加以阻止；1290年起他与兄长奥托三世、路易三世共同统治下巴伐利亚。1305至1308年奥托争夺匈牙利王位期间，由斯特凡独自治理公国。他与哈布斯堡家族为敌，1310年在对奥地利的腓特烈一世作战时死去，遗下亨利十四世、奥托四世二子。

en: Alberto Rusca was a son of Franchino I Rusca, lord of Como, and Zaccarina Visconti, daughter of Matteo I Visconti of Milan, and a brother of Lotario and Ottone.
zh: 阿尔贝托·鲁斯科尼是科莫领主弗兰基诺一世·鲁斯科尼与米兰领主马泰奥一世·维斯孔蒂之女扎卡丽娜·维斯孔蒂之子，洛泰里奥和奥托内的兄弟。

en: Franchino I Rusca (died 1339), of the Rusconi family, was the Ghibelline lord of Como and a son of Pietro, lord of the city. In October 1301 Matteo I Visconti of Milan gave him his daughter Zaccarina, though he had promised her to Riccardo Langosco the year before; the match allied Como with the Visconti. In 1313 Franchino crushed the rival Guelph Vitani family and became captain and lord general of the commune and people of Como, and from 1327 he ruled the city and its countryside as imperial vicar. The Milanese house he had married into then took the city from him. In 1335 the Rusca, besieged by Bishop Benedetto da Asinago and barely able to defend themselves, turned again to Azzone Visconti, and Franchino offered him the lordship of Como in return for Bellinzona. Azzone entered Como on 25 July. Franchino kept Bellinzona until he died in 1339; the Visconti took it a year later.
zh: 弗兰基诺一世·鲁斯科尼（?—1339）出身科莫的鲁斯科尼家族，属吉伯林派，是科莫领主彼得罗之子，自己也成了科莫的领主。1301年10月，米兰统治者马泰奥一世·维斯孔蒂把女儿扎卡丽娜嫁给了他，尽管前一年马泰奥已将她许配给里卡尔多·兰戈斯科；这桩婚事使科莫与维斯孔蒂家族结盟。1313年，弗兰基诺击败对头圭尔夫派的维塔尼家族，成为科莫公社与人民的统领兼总领主；1327年起又以帝国代牧身份统治科莫城及其乡郊。后来，他联姻的这个米兰家族夺走了科莫。1335年，鲁斯科尼家族被主教贝内代托·达西纳戈围攻，勉强支撑，再度向阿佐内·维斯孔蒂求援；弗兰基诺提出把科莫的统治权让给他，换取贝林佐纳。7月25日，阿佐内进入科莫。弗兰基诺保住贝林佐纳直到1339年去世，一年后维斯孔蒂家族也夺取了该城。

en: Giovanna Nogarola was a daughter of Bailardino Nogarola, the Veronese condottiero and diplomat who served the Scaliger lords of Verona, and a sister of Enida and Cagnolo Nogarola.
zh: 乔万娜·诺加罗拉是维罗纳将领、外交官拜拉迪诺·诺加罗拉之女，后者效力于维罗纳的斯卡拉家族；埃妮达和卡尼奥洛·诺加罗拉是她的兄弟姐妹。

en: Loterio Rusca (c. 1225–1291) was a Ghibelline nobleman of the Rusconi family of Como and the city's first de facto lord. Already signore del popolo, in 1276 he moved to set up a signoria and forced the hostile bishop Giovanni degli Avvocati into exile with Archbishop Ottone Visconti of Milan. In 1284 he and William VII of Montferrat freed the Guelph leader Guido della Torre from Castel Baradello. War between Como and Milan continued until the Peace of Lomazzo in 1286 recognized his supremacy over the city.
zh: 洛泰里奥·鲁斯科尼（约1225—1291）出身科莫的鲁斯科尼家族，属吉伯林派，是科莫第一位实际意义上的统治者。他本已担任“人民首领”，于1276年着手建立个人统治，并迫使反对他的科莫主教乔瓦尼·德利·阿沃卡蒂流亡，投奔米兰大主教奥托内·维斯孔蒂。1284年，他与蒙费拉托的古列尔莫七世将圭尔夫派首领圭多·德拉·托雷从巴拉德罗城堡放出。科莫与米兰的战争持续到1286年，《洛马佐和约》承认他对科莫的最高地位。

en: Lotario Rusca was a nobleman of the Rusca family of Como. He married Enrica Visconti, an illegitimate daughter of Bernabò Visconti, lord of Milan; their son, born around 1360, was Franchino II Rusca, who became signore of Como.
zh: 洛泰里奥·鲁斯科尼是科莫鲁斯科尼家族的贵族。他娶米兰领主贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂的私生女恩里卡为妻；二人之子约1360年出生，即后来成为科莫统治者的弗兰基诺二世·鲁斯科尼。

en: Napoleone, called Napo, della Torre (c. 1201–16 August 1278) was the leading noble of the Guelph della Torre house and de facto lord of Milan from 1265. Podestà of Piacenza in 1260, he succeeded his cousin Filippo as Anziano del Popolo of Milan and as podestà of Como. In 1267 he commanded the Guelph league against Conradin. He later refused to support Charles of Anjou's expansion in Italy and in 1273 joined the imperial party to counter him, becoming imperial vicar in Lombardy in 1274. On 21 January 1277 Archbishop Ottone Visconti defeated and captured him at Desio, ending della Torre rule in Milan. He died after nineteen months in a cage at Castel Baradello in Como.
zh: 拿波列奥内·德拉·托雷（约1201—1278年8月16日），绰号纳波，是圭尔夫派德拉·托雷家族的首要贵族，1265年起成为米兰的实际统治者。他于1260年任皮亚琴察长官，后接替堂兄菲利波出任米兰“人民长老”，并兼任科莫长官。1267年，他统领圭尔夫联盟对抗康拉丁。此后他拒绝支持安茹的查理在意大利扩张，1273年转向皇帝阵营以抗衡查理，1274年出任伦巴第帝国代牧。1277年1月21日，米兰大主教奥托内·维斯孔蒂在代西奥战役中将他击败俘获，德拉·托雷家族在米兰的统治就此终结。他被囚于科莫巴拉德罗城堡的牢笼中十九个月后，于1278年死去。

en: Pietro Rusconi was a nobleman of the Ghibelline Rusconi family of Como and a younger son of the city's first lord, Loterio Rusca. In March 1286 he was one of four Como envoys who settled terms with Milan in the negotiations that produced the Peace of Lomazzo, proclaimed on 2 April 1286. In 1291 he is recorded as podestà of Carasso near Bellinzona, a district then held by the Rusconi. He had died before 1302.
zh: 彼得罗·鲁斯科尼出身科莫的吉伯林派贵族鲁斯科尼家族，是科莫首任统治者洛泰里奥·鲁斯科尼的幼子之一。1286年3月，他作为科莫的四名谈判代表之一与米兰方面商定条款，最终促成1286年4月2日公布的《洛马佐和约》。1291年，史料记载他担任贝林佐纳附近卡拉索的长官，当时该地区属鲁斯科尼家族。他在1302年之前已经去世。

en: Zaccarina Visconti (died c. 1322) was a daughter of Matteo I Visconti, lord of Milan, and Bonacossa Borri. In 1300 her father promised her in marriage to Riccardo Langosco, on condition that his father Filippone expel the Beccaria family from Pavia, which was done the same year. Matteo nevertheless broke the engagement and in October 1301 married her instead to Franchino I Rusca, the Ghibelline lord of Como. She gave Franchino three sons, Lotario, Alberto and Ottone.
zh: 扎卡丽娜·维斯孔蒂（?—约1322）是米兰统治者马泰奥一世·维斯孔蒂与博纳科萨·博里之女。1300年，父亲将她许配给里卡尔多·兰戈斯科，条件是其父菲利波内把贝卡里亚家族逐出帕维亚，此事当年即告完成。但马泰奥最终毁约，于1301年10月将她改嫁科莫的吉伯林派统治者弗兰基诺一世·鲁斯科尼。她为弗兰基诺生下洛泰里奥、阿尔贝托、奥托三个儿子。

en: Malik Izz al-Din Husayn III was the sixteenth atabeg of the Khorshidi dynasty of Little Luristan, succeeding his murdered father Shuja al-Din Mahmud in 1349 or 1350 when he was about twelve. He allied with the Muzaffarids and the Jalayirids: in 1383 Shah Shuja married his daughter at Khorramabad and another daughter married Ahmad Jalayir. Timur's armies ravaged Luristan in 1386 and razed the fortress of Khorramabad. Captured and exiled to Turkestan in 1388, he returned three years later, but around 1404 his severed head was displayed stuffed with straw.
zh: 马利克·伊兹丁·侯赛因三世是小洛雷斯坦霍什迪王朝第十六代阿塔伯克，1349或1350年父亲舒贾丁·马哈茂德被杀时，他年仅约十二岁便继位。他与穆扎法尔王朝和札剌亦儿王朝结盟：1383年，沙阿·舒贾在霍拉马巴德迎娶他的一个女儿，另一个女儿嫁给艾哈迈德·札剌亦儿。1386年，帖木儿的军队蹂躏洛雷斯坦，夷平霍拉马巴德要塞。1388年他被俘并流放突厥斯坦，三年后获释归来；约1404年，他被砍下的头颅被塞满稻草示众。

en: Shuja al-Din Mahmud Khorshidi was the fifteenth atabeg of the Khorshidi dynasty, which ruled Little Luristan from its capital Khorramabad. The son of Izz al-Din Husayn II, he succeeded his father in the 1330s and kept close to the camp of the Ilkhanids as Mongol power in Iran broke apart. His reign ended in 1349 or 1350, when his own subjects killed him. He was succeeded by his twelve-year-old son Izz al-Din Husayn, the future Malik Izz al-Din Husayn III.
zh: 舒贾丁·马哈茂德·霍什迪是霍什迪王朝第十五代阿塔伯克，该王朝以霍拉马巴德为都城统治小洛雷斯坦。他是伊兹丁·侯赛因二世之子，于1330年代继位；在伊利汗国势力瓦解之际，他与伊利汗军营保持密切关系。1349或1350年，他被自己的臣民杀死，由年仅十二岁的儿子伊兹丁·侯赛因继位，即后来的马利克·伊兹丁·侯赛因三世。

en: Siemowit of Dobrzyń (c. 1262–1312) was a Piast prince, son of Casimir I of Kuyavia, who received the Dobrzyń district in the family division of around 1288. Captured by Lithuanian raiders in 1293, he spent two years in captivity while his brother Władysław I the Elbow-high ruled the duchy. Around 1296 he married Anastasia, daughter of Leo I of Halych. He did homage to Wenceslaus II of Bohemia in 1300, was deposed in 1303 and restored in 1305, after which he backed Władysław. He died in 1312, leaving minor sons under the regency of his widow and brother.
zh: 多布任的谢莫维特（约1262—1312）是皮亚斯特王朝王公，库亚维公爵卡齐米日一世之子，约1288年在家族分封中获得多布任地区。1293年立陶宛人入侵时他被俘，被囚禁两年，其间公国由其兄瓦迪斯瓦夫一世（沃凯泰克）代管。约1296年，他娶加利奇王公列夫一世之女安娜斯塔西娅为妻。1300年他向波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫二世臣服，1303年因叛乱被废，1305年复位，此后转而支持瓦迪斯瓦夫一世。他于1312年去世，诸子年幼，由其兄瓦迪斯瓦夫一世与遗孀共同摄政。

en: Władysław the Hunchback (c. 1303–1352) was a Piast prince, the son of Siemowit of Dobrzyń and Anastasia Lvovna of Halych–Volhynia. He ruled Dobrzyń from 1312, and in 1327 exchanged it with his uncle Władysław I the Elbow-high for the Duchy of Łęczyca amid Teutonic Order pressure. With his brother Bolesław he founded a Holy Sepulchre hospital at Rypin in 1323 and granted the village of Łódź to the bishops of Kujawy in 1332. The 1343 Treaty of Kalisz returned Dobrzyń to him. Childless, he died in 1351 or 1352, and his lands reverted to the Polish crown.
zh: 驼背者瓦迪斯瓦夫（约1303—1352）是皮雅斯特王朝王公，多布任的谢莫维特与安娜斯塔西娅·列维芙娜之子。他自1312年起统治多布任；1327年，迫于条顿骑士团的威胁，他与叔父“矮子”瓦迪斯瓦夫一世达成协议，以祖传的多布任换得文奇察公国。他与兄弟博莱斯瓦夫于1323年在里平创立圣墓骑士团医院，1332年将罗兹村封赠给库亚维的主教们。1343年《卡利什条约》签订后，多布任重归其手。他没有子嗣，于1351或1352年去世，领地并入波兰王国。

en: Matilda of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel was a daughter of Duke Magnus I of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel and Sophia of Brandenburg-Stendal. Around 1343 she became the third wife of Bernhard III, Prince of Anhalt-Bernburg, joining the Welfs to the Ascanian princes of Anhalt. She was the mother of Otto III, who later ruled Anhalt-Bernburg. Bernhard died in August 1348, and Matilda was still living on 28 June 1354.
zh: 不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔的玛蒂尔达是不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔公爵马格努斯一世与勃兰登堡-施滕达尔的索菲娅之女。约1343年，她成为安哈尔特-贝恩堡亲王伯恩哈德三世的第三任妻子，使韦尔夫家族与安哈尔特的阿斯坎尼王公联姻。她的儿子奥托三世后来统治安哈尔特-贝恩堡。伯恩哈德于1348年8月去世，玛蒂尔达在1354年6月28日仍在世。

en: Sophia of Brandenburg-Stendal (1300–1356) was the daughter of Margrave Henry I of Brandenburg-Stendal and Agnes of Bavaria, born into the Ascanian dynasty. In 1327 she married Magnus the Pious, Duke of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel, linking the Askaniers to the Welfs. She bore him several children who reached adulthood, including Magnus II with the Necklace, Albert, Prince-Archbishop of Bremen, and Matilda, wife of Bernhard III of Anhalt-Bernburg. Her daughters Agnes and Sophie married into the counts of Hohnstein.
zh: 勃兰登堡-施滕达尔的索菲娅（1300—1356）是勃兰登堡-施滕达尔藩侯亨利一世与巴伐利亚的阿格尼丝之女，出身阿斯坎尼家族。1327年，她嫁给不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔公爵“虔诚者”马格努斯，使阿斯坎尼家族与韦尔夫家族联姻。她所生并长大成人的子女包括“戴项链者”马格努斯二世、不来梅大主教阿尔贝特，以及嫁给安哈尔特-贝恩堡的伯恩哈德三世的玛蒂尔达；女儿阿格尼丝和索菲娅则嫁入霍恩施泰因伯爵家族。

en: Yi Se-jwa (1445–1504), styled Paegŏn and enfeoffed as Prince Kwangyang, was a civil official of early Joseon from the Gwangju Yi clan. He was the eldest son of Yi Kŭk-kam and the grandfather of Yi Chun-gyŏng. In 1482, under King Seongjong, he carried the royal order that forced the deposed Queen Yun, mother of the future King Yeonsangun, to take poison. During the literati purge of 1498 he urged the execution of Kim Chong-jik and his followers. After he accidentally spilled wine on Yeonsangun's robe at a banquet in 1503, the king exiled him on a charge of lèse-majesté. His role in Queen Yun's death later caught up with him, and in the purge of 1504 the king had him put to death.
zh: 李世佐（1445—1504），字伯彦，封广阳君，本贯广州李氏，是朝鲜王朝前期的文臣。他是李克堪的长子，也是李浚庆的祖父。1482年成宗在位时，他奉命携毒药前往，将被废的尹氏赐死，而尹氏正是后来燕山君的生母。1498年戊午士祸时，他奏请处死金宗直及其门人。1503年的一次宴会上，他不慎把酒洒在燕山君的衣服上，被以凌上的罪名流放。他曾参与赐死尹氏一事后来牵连到他，1504年甲子士祸中燕山君将他处死。

en: Diarmait mac Máel na mBó (died 7 February 1072) was King of Leinster and, with opposition, High King of Ireland. In 1042 he made himself king of Leinster and installed his son Murchad as king of Dublin. Allied with Niall mac Eochada of Ulaid, he pressed the kingdoms of Mide and Brega. After 1066 he sheltered the sons of King Harold Godwinson of England and lent them the Dublin fleet for invasions of England in 1068 and 1069. He was killed fighting Conchobar Ua Máel Sechlainn of Mide at the battle of Odhbha near Navan on 7 February 1072.
zh: 迪尔梅特·马克·梅尔·纳·姆博（?—1072年2月7日）是伦斯特国王，并在反对声中成为爱尔兰至高王。1042年，他自立为伦斯特国王，并立其子穆尔哈德为都柏林国王。他与乌拉德国王尼尔·麦克·埃奥卡达结盟，向米斯和布雷加两个王国施压。1066年后，他收留英格兰国王哈罗德·戈德温森的儿子们，并于1068和1069年借出都柏林舰队支持他们反攻英格兰。1072年2月7日，他在纳文附近的奥瓦战役中与米斯国王康乔巴尔·奥·梅尔·塞克兰交战时被杀。

en: Domhnall mac Art mac Murchada Caomhánach was a king of Leinster from the Kavanagh dynasty, the Gaelic lineage that held out in the Wicklow highlands after the Norman invasion of Ireland. He succeeded his father Art mac Murchada, who had ruled from 1314, and reigned from 1323 to 1338. He allied with Murchad O'Byrne against English settlers and may have been elected king at an assembly in 1328. Captured soon afterwards, he escaped from Dublin in January 1331. In 1335 he campaigned in Scotland for Edward III. In 1338 he was succeeded by his son Domhnall mac Domhnall, who ruled Leinster until 1347.
zh: 多姆纳尔·麦克·阿特·麦克·穆尔哈达·卡瓦纳是卡瓦纳王朝的伦斯特国王；诺曼人入侵爱尔兰后，这一盖尔支系在威克洛高地坚持抵抗。他于1323年继承父亲阿特·麦克·穆尔哈达之位（其父自1314年起在位），统治至1338年。他与穆尔哈德·奥伯恩结盟对抗英格兰殖民者，可能于1328年在一次集会上被推举为国王。不久他被俘，1331年1月从都柏林逃脱。1335年，他为爱德华三世在苏格兰作战。1338年，其子多姆纳尔·麦克·多姆纳尔继位，统治伦斯特至1347年。

en: Anna of Nuremberg (died 1340), daughter of Burgrave Frederick IV of Nuremberg, married Ulrich I, Landgrave of Leuchtenberg, as his second wife on 23 April 1328. Her sons Ulrich II and John I later inherited the landgraviate.
zh: 纽伦堡的安娜（?—1340）是纽伦堡城伯腓特烈四世之女，于1328年4月23日作为第二任妻子嫁给莱希滕贝格领地伯爵乌尔里希一世。她的儿子乌尔里希二世和约翰一世后来都成为莱希滕贝格领地伯爵。

en: John I of Leuchtenberg (c. 1330–1407) was the second son of Landgrave Ulrich I of Leuchtenberg and Anna of Nuremberg, daughter of Burgrave Frederick IV. After his father died in 1334, he and his elder brother Ulrich II ruled jointly until 1366, when they divided the landgraviate: John received the eastern part and kept his seat at Pleystein, while the two brothers governed the south together. In 1376 Emperor Charles IV raised him to landgrave of Leuchtenberg and count of Hals near Passau. He married Metze of Rožmberk and died on 2 December 1407.
zh: 洛伊希滕贝格的约翰一世（约1330—1407）是洛伊希滕贝格方伯乌尔里希一世与纽伦堡城堡伯爵腓特烈四世之女安娜的次子。1334年父亲去世后，他与兄长乌尔里希二世共同统治；1366年二人瓜分方伯国，约翰获得东部、驻于普莱施泰因，南部则由兄弟俩共管。1376年，皇帝查理四世升封他为洛伊希滕贝格方伯兼帕绍附近的哈尔斯伯爵。他娶罗日姆贝克的梅策为妻，于1407年12月2日去世。

en: Ulrich II of Leuchtenberg (c. 1326–1378) was landgrave of Leuchtenberg from 1334, succeeding his father Ulrich I; his mother was Anna of Nuremberg, daughter of Burgrave Frederick IV. In 1366 he and his brother Johann divided the landgraviate, Ulrich taking the west and Johann the east, and they minted coin at Rothenburg ob der Tauber in 1361. He moved his residence from Leuchtenberg Castle to Pfreimd, which he raised to a town in 1372 with a six-year tax exemption to attract settlers. In 1376 Emperor Charles IV named him count of Hals. He married Margarete of Niemodlin.
zh: 洛伊希滕贝格的乌尔里希二世（约1326—1378）于1334年继父乌尔里希一世之位成为洛伊希滕贝格方伯，母亲是纽伦堡城堡伯爵腓特烈四世之女安娜。1366年，他与弟弟约翰瓜分方伯国，乌尔里希取西部、约翰取东部；兄弟二人还于1361年在陶伯河上游罗滕堡铸造钱币。他把居所从洛伊希滕贝格城堡迁至普弗赖姆德，1372年将该地升格为城镇，并以免税六年吸引移民。1376年，皇帝查理四世封他为哈尔斯伯爵。他娶涅莫德林的玛格丽特为妻。

en: Ulrich I of Leuchtenberg (1293–23 November 1334) was landgrave of Leuchtenberg, succeeding his father Gebhard VI in 1293. In 1313 he fought at the Battle of Gammelsdorf on the side of Louis the Bavarian. In 1332 he purchased the town of Pfreimd, which later became the landgraves' residence. He died in the Cistercian monastery of Walderbach on 23 November 1334. By his second wife Anna of Nuremberg he fathered his successors Ulrich II and John I.
zh: 洛伊希滕贝格的乌尔里希一世（1293—1334年11月23日）是洛伊希滕贝格方伯，1293年继父格布哈德六世之位。1313年，他在加梅尔斯多夫战役中站在巴伐利亚人路易一方作战。1332年，他购得普弗赖姆德镇，此地后来成为历代方伯的居所。1334年11月23日，他在瓦尔德巴赫的西多会修道院去世。第二任妻子纽伦堡的安娜为他生下继承人乌尔里希二世和约翰一世。

en: Bolesław III the Generous (1291–1352), eldest son of Henry V the Fat, was Duke of Legnica, Brzeg and Wrocław from 1296. He married Margareta, daughter of Wenceslaus II of Bohemia, and after the Přemyslids died out in 1306 claimed the Bohemian crown: he took Opava in 1308 but renounced his claim at Olomouc in 1311. The 1311 division left him Brzeg, and he could not retake Wrocław from his brothers. He became a Bohemian vassal in 1329, and in 1342 abdicated Legnica to his sons Wenceslaus I and Louis I, retiring to Brzeg.
zh: “慷慨者”博莱斯瓦夫三世（1291—1352）是“胖子”亨里克五世的长子，自1296年起任莱格尼察、布热格和弗罗茨瓦夫公爵。他娶波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫二世之女玛格丽特为妻；1306年普热米斯尔王朝绝嗣后，他宣称波希米亚王位，1308年夺取奥帕瓦，却于1311年在奥洛穆茨放弃了主张。1311年的诸子分地使他只得到布热格，他也未能从兄弟手中夺回弗罗茨瓦夫。1329年他成为波希米亚附庸，1342年把莱格尼察让给儿子瓦茨瓦夫一世和路德维克一世，自己退居布热格。

en: Henry V the Fat (c. 1248–22 February 1296), eldest son of Bolesław II of Legnica, was duke of Jawor from 1273, Legnica from 1278 and Wrocław from 1290. In 1277 his charge at the battle of Stolec turned his father's defeat into victory and captured two dukes. Seized at Sądowel by Henry IV Probus in 1281, he was forced to recognize Henry IV as duke of Wrocław, though its citizens invited him to rule in 1290. In 1293 Henry III of Głogów imprisoned him for six months in an iron cage; his health broken, he died on 22 February 1296 leaving minor sons under his brother Bolko.
zh: 胖子亨里克五世（约1248—1296年2月22日）是莱格尼察公爵波列斯瓦夫二世的长子，1273年起任雅沃尔公爵，1278年起任莱格尼察公爵，1290年起任弗罗茨瓦夫公爵。1277年，他在斯托莱茨战役中的冲锋扭转了父亲的败局，还俘获两名敌对公爵。1281年，他在桑多韦尔被亨里克四世·普罗布斯扣押，被迫承认亨里克四世为弗罗茨瓦夫公爵，但1290年弗罗茨瓦夫市民邀请他前来统治。1293年，格沃古夫公爵亨里克三世把他囚禁在铁笼中达六个月；他身体由此垮掉，于1296年2月22日去世，诸子年幼，由弟弟布尔科监护。

en: Katarina Šubić (died 1358), daughter of Mladen II Šubić, Ban of Croatia, married Bolesław III the Generous, Duke of Legnica-Brzeg, in 1326, four years after his first wife's death; the marriage was childless. When Bolesław abdicated in 1342 she retired with him to Brzeg, and on his death in 1352 his will left her the Duchies of Brzeg and Oława as her dower, to rule in her own right for life. She reigned over Brzeg for six years, and after her death in 1358 the lands passed to her stepsons Wenceslaus I and Louis I.
zh: 卡塔琳娜·舒比奇（？—1358）是克罗地亚班姆拉登二世·舒比奇之女，1326年嫁给莱格尼察—布热格公爵“慷慨者”波列斯瓦夫三世，时距其原配去世已四年，婚姻无子嗣。1342年丈夫退位后，她随他退居布热格。1352年波列斯瓦夫去世，遗嘱将布热格和奥瓦瓦作为遗孀产留给她，由她终身自主统治。她统治布热格六年，1358年去世后，领地归于继子瓦茨瓦夫一世和路德维克一世。

en: Louis I the Fair (c. 1321–1398), second son of Bolesław III the Generous of Legnica, received Brzeg, Chojnów and half of Oława after a six-year war against his brother Wenceslaus I, settled in 1359. After Wenceslaus died in 1364 he ruled Legnica as regent for his underage nephews until 1373, repaired its finances, bought back Brzeg-Oława in 1368 and acquired Kluczbork, Byczyna and Wołczyn in 1373. A trusted mediator for Emperors Charles IV and Wenceslaus IV, he promoted the cult of St Hedwig and was buried in the collegiate church at Brzeg in 1398.
zh: “公正者”路德维克一世（约1321—1398）是莱格尼察公爵“慷慨者”波列斯瓦夫三世的次子，与兄长瓦茨瓦夫一世打了六年内战，凭1359年的和约赢得布热格、霍伊努夫和半个奥瓦瓦。1364年瓦茨瓦夫死后，他为年幼的侄子们摄政莱格尼察至1373年，整顿财政，1368年赎回布热格—奥瓦瓦，1373年取得克卢奇堡、贝奇纳和武夫琴。他多次受皇帝查理四世和瓦茨瓦夫四世委派调解争端，推崇圣雅德维加崇拜，1398年葬于布热格的协同教堂。

en: Margaret of Bohemia (21 February 1296–8 April 1322), Czech Markéta Přemyslovna, was a daughter of King Wenceslaus II of Bohemia and Judith of Habsburg. Betrothed by her father to Bolesław III the Generous, Duke of Legnica and Brzeg, she married him in 1308. The match gave Bolesław a claim to the Bohemian crown after the Přemyslid dynasty died out in 1306, although the crown passed to John of Luxembourg. She died on 8 April 1322, one day after giving birth to her youngest son Nikolaus; her surviving sons were Wenceslaus I and Louis I the Fair.
zh: 玛克塔·普热米斯洛娃（1296年2月21日—1322年4月8日）是波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫二世与哈布斯堡的茱蒂丝之女。她由父亲许配给莱格尼察兼布热格公爵博莱斯瓦夫三世（慷慨者），1308年成婚。1306年普热米斯尔王朝绝嗣，这桩婚姻使博莱斯瓦夫获得了宣称波希米亚王位的资格，但王位最终落入卢森堡的约翰之手。1322年4月8日，她在生下幼子尼古拉斯的次日去世，留下瓦茨拉夫一世和路德维克一世两个儿子。

en: Wenceslaus I (c. 1318–1364), eldest son of Bolesław III the Generous of Legnica, received the Duchy of Namysłów from his father in 1338. When Bolesław abdicated in 1342, Wenceslaus and his brother Louis I ruled Legnica-Brzeg jointly, dividing their rule in 1345. A quarrel over the inheritance after their father's death in 1352 sparked a six-year civil war; defeated in 1359, Wenceslaus ceded Brzeg-Oława and Chojnów to Louis as an independent duchy. A loyal supporter of Emperor Charles IV in Silesia, he died excommunicated for unpaid debts and was buried in the Legnica church he had founded.
zh: 瓦茨瓦夫一世（约1318—1364）是莱格尼察公爵“慷慨者”波列斯瓦夫三世的长子，1338年从父亲手中得到纳梅斯武夫公国。1342年父亲退位后，他与弟弟路易一世共同统治莱格尼察—布热格，1345年才分治。1352年父亲去世引发的继承争端演变为持续六年的内战；1359年战败后，瓦茨瓦夫将布热格—奥瓦瓦和霍伊努夫割给路易，成为独立公国。他在西里西亚坚定支持皇帝查理四世，最终因未偿债务被开除教籍，葬于他本人在莱格尼察修建的教堂。

en: Elisabeth of Baden (born c. 1220), daughter of Margrave Hermann V of Baden, was widowed from Count Eberhard V of Eberstein and then married Ludwig II, Lord of Lichtenberg in Alsace. Her sons included Johann I and Sigibodo, Bishop of Speyer.
zh: 巴登的伊丽莎白（约1220年生）是巴登藩侯赫尔曼五世之女，先为埃伯施泰因伯爵埃伯哈德五世的遗孀，后改嫁阿尔萨斯的利希滕贝格领主路德维希二世，生子约翰一世及施派尔主教西吉博多。

en: Heinrich II von Lichtenberg (died before 9 February 1269) ruled as lord of Lichtenberg in Lower Alsace jointly with his brother Ludwig II, and like their father Ludwig I he held the advocacy (Vogt) of Strasbourg. Both brothers are first recorded in 1249, and under them the family steadily built up its Alsatian estates. After Heinrich and Ludwig died the dynasty split in 1271 into an elder and a younger line: Heinrich's descendants formed the elder branch, headed by his son Conrad I, while Ludwig II's heirs formed the younger.
zh: 海因里希二世·冯·利希滕贝格（？—1269）与兄弟路德维希二世共治下阿尔萨斯的利希滕贝格领地，并和父亲路德维希一世一样担任斯特拉斯堡的福格特（护尉官）。兄弟二人都始见于1249年的记载，在他们治下家族在阿尔萨斯不断扩张地产。海因里希与路德维希死后，家族于1271年分为长、幼两支：海因里希的后裔为长支，由其子康拉德一世统领，路德维希二世的继承人则为幼支。

en: Johann I von Lichtenberg, called the Elder (first recorded 1281, died 22 August 1315), was lord of Lichtenberg and Vogt in Alsace, leading the younger branch created by the family partition of 1271. The second son of Ludwig II and Elisabeth of Baden, he inherited that line's estates and married Adelaide of Werdenberg. When the elder branch's Conrad I died in 1294, Johann became guardian of Conrad's young son Johann II. His uncle Konrad III was bishop of Strasbourg, and his brother Sigibodo became bishop of Speyer in 1302.
zh: 约翰一世·冯·利希滕贝格，人称“长者”（1281年首见记载，1315年8月22日卒），是利希滕贝格领主、阿尔萨斯福格特，统领1271年分家后形成的幼支。他是路德维希二世与巴登的伊丽莎白的次子，继承幼支领地，娶韦尔登贝格的阿德尔海德为妻。1294年长支的康拉德一世去世后，他成为其年幼之子约翰二世的监护人。他的叔父康拉德三世曾任斯特拉斯堡主教，弟弟西吉博多于1302年成为施派尔主教。

en: Johann II von Lichtenberg, called Hannemann (born before 1295, died 1366), was head of the elder line of the Lords of Lichtenberg in Alsace. His father Konrad I died when Johann was still a minor, and Johann I of the family's younger line acted as his guardian. In 1318 he married Countess Johanna von Leiningen, who bore him Heinrich III and Agnes. From 1330 onwards treaties split the Lichtenberg lands between the two lines. In 1340 he disputed the village of Gottesheim with Count Palatine Rudolf II without success, and in 1341 he had to acknowledge Electoral Palatinate's suzerainty.
zh: 约翰二世·冯·利希滕贝格，绰号“哈尼曼”（1295年前—1366），是阿尔萨斯利希滕贝格领主家族长支的族长。父亲康拉德一世早逝时他尚未成年，由家族幼支的约翰一世担任监护人。1318年他迎娶约翰娜·冯·莱宁根伯爵小姐，生子海因里希三世和女阿格妮丝。1330年起，一系列条约在两支之间划分了利希滕贝格领地。1340年他与行宫伯爵鲁道夫二世争夺戈特斯海姆村未果，1341年被迫承认普法尔茨选侯的宗主权。

en: Johanna von Leiningen, called Jenata, was a daughter of Count Friedrich IV von Leiningen. In 1318 she married Johann II von Lichtenberg, an Alsatian lord; her children were Heinrich III and Agnes, wife of Count Simon of Zweibrücken-Bitsch.
zh: 约翰娜·冯·莱宁根（昵称“耶娜塔”）是弗里德里希四世·冯·莱宁根伯爵之女，1318年嫁给阿尔萨斯领主约翰二世·冯·利希滕贝格，生有海因里希三世与阿格妮丝；阿格妮丝嫁给茨韦布吕肯—比奇伯爵西蒙。

en: Ludwig I von Lichtenberg (first attested 1206, died 1252) was an Alsatian nobleman, lord of Lichtenberg and Vogt of Neuweiler. He was the father of Ludwig II and Heinrich II, who carried on the secular lordship, and of Conrad III and Friedrich I, who both became bishops of Strasbourg; his other sons also entered the church. The later Lichtenberg lords of the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries all descended from his line.
zh: 路德维希一世·冯·利希滕贝格（1206年首见记载，1252年卒）是阿尔萨斯贵族，任利希滕贝格领主和诺伊韦勒的地方代牧。他的儿子路德维希二世和海因里希二世承续世俗领地；另两子康拉德三世和弗里德里希一世都官至斯特拉斯堡主教，其余诸子也都成为教士。13至14世纪的历代利希滕贝格领主都出自他这一支。

en: Ludwig II von Lichtenberg (first recorded 1249, died 1271) ruled as lord of Lichtenberg jointly with his brother Heinrich II and served as Landvogt, the territorial advocate, in Alsace. A son of Ludwig I, he married Margravine Elisabeth of Baden, daughter of Margrave Hermann V and widow of Count Eberhard of Eberstein. Their sons included Johann I, later head of the younger Lichtenberg line, and Sigibodo, who became bishop of Speyer in 1302. After the two brothers' deaths the family estates were divided in 1271 into an elder and a younger branch.
zh: 路德维希二世·冯·利希滕贝格（1249年首见记载，1271年卒）与兄弟海因里希二世同为利希滕贝格领主，并担任阿尔萨斯的兰德福格特（地方护尉）。他是路德维希一世之子，娶巴登藩侯赫尔曼五世之女、埃伯施泰因伯爵埃伯哈德的遗孀巴登的伊丽莎白为妻。诸子中包括后来统领利希滕贝格幼支的约翰一世，以及1302年成为施派尔主教的西吉博多。两兄弟死后，家族领地于1271年分为长、幼两支。

en: Adolf II von der Mark (1288–1344), third son of Count Eberhard I of the Mark, became Prince-Bishop of Liège in 1313 through King Philip IV of France. In 1316 resistance to his authoritarian rule forced him to sign the Peace of Fexhe, which curbed his powers; after trying to revoke it he fled to Huy in 1324 and put Liège under interdict. He sold Mechelen to Flanders in 1333, joined the siege of Maastricht in 1334, and failed to annex Loon in 1336. The Tribunal of the XXII curbed his authority in 1343, a year before he died.
zh: 阿道夫·德·拉马克（1288—1344）是马克伯爵埃伯哈德一世的第三子，1313年经法王腓力四世举荐出任列日采邑主教。他统治专横，1316年被迫签署限制其权力的《费克斯和约》；1324年他试图废约，逃往于伊并对列日处以禁行圣事令。1333年他把梅赫伦卖给佛兰德，1334年参与围攻马斯特里赫特，1336年吞并洛恩未果。1343年二十二人法庭削弱其权力，一年后他去世。

en: Ibn al-Khatib (1313–1374), born at Loja, was an Arab-Andalusi poet, historian, physician and vizier of the Nasrid Emirate of Granada. After his father and brother died at the Battle of Río Salado in 1340, he entered the court chancery and became vizier to Emir Yusuf I, later serving Muhammad V. Arrested after a coup in 1359, he went into exile in Marinid Morocco, returning to his office when Muhammad regained the throne in 1362. His poems, including the muwashshah Jadaka al-Ghaithu, adorn the Alhambra, and his history of Granada, al-Ihata, was completed in 1369. Exiled a second time to Morocco, he was arrested there on a heresy charge in 1374 and strangled in prison at Fes, where his body was burned.
zh: 伊本·哈提卜（1313—1374）生于洛哈，是阿拉伯安达卢西亚的诗人、史家、医生，也是奈斯尔王朝格拉纳达埃米尔国的维齐尔。1340年父亲与兄长在萨拉多河战役中战死后，他进入宫廷文书处，成为优素福一世的维齐尔，后来又效力于穆罕默德五世。1359年政变后他被捕，继而流亡马林王朝治下的摩洛哥；1362年穆罕默德复位，他也回国复职。他的诗作装饰着阿尔罕布拉宫的墙壁，其中包括穆瓦沙赫体诗篇《吉达卡·盖斯》；记述格拉纳达历史的《群书荟萃》于1369年成书。第二次流亡摩洛哥后，他于1374年以异端罪名被捕，在非斯狱中被缢杀，尸体遭焚。

en: Butigeidis (died 1290 or 1291) was Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1285 and the first undisputed Gediminid ruler, taking power after Daumantas' death. He fought the Teutonic Order, which had recently overrun Suvalkija. In 1289, Peter of Dusburg records, he led about eight thousand men against a Teutonic stronghold in Sambia; the Knights built a castle at Ragainė, forcing the Lithuanians to abandon Kolainiai across the Nemunas. Butigeidis was the first grand duke to fortify the Nemunas with a chain of castles. With his brother Butvydas he ceded Vawkavysk to Volhynia under a peace treaty, and Butvydas succeeded.
zh: 布蒂盖迪斯（1290或1291年卒）自1285年起任立陶宛大公，是格迪米纳斯王朝第一位无可争议的统治者，在道曼塔斯死后掌权。他在位期间与刚征服苏瓦尔基亚的条顿骑士团作战。据杜伊斯堡的彼得记载，1289年他率约八千人进攻骑士团在桑比亚的据点；骑士团则在拉盖内修筑城堡，迫使立陶宛人放弃涅曼河对岸的科莱奈。布蒂盖迪斯是首位沿涅曼河修建一连串堡垒的大公。他还与弟弟布特维达斯依照和约把瓦夫卡维斯克割让给沃里尼亚，死后由布特维达斯继位。

en: Butvydas, also known as Pukuveras (died c. 1295), was Grand Duke of Lithuania from about 1290. First mentioned in 1289, when he and his brother Grand Duke Butigeidis made peace with Volhynia, he may have shared power before ruling alone after Butigeidis died. Peter of Dusburg’s chronicle calls him king of the Lithuanians in 1291. His short reign was spent resisting annual Teutonic Order raids into Samogitia and fighting the Order’s Polish allies in Masovia. He was the father of Grand Dukes Vytenis and Gediminas, who built Lithuania into a major power.
zh: 布特维达斯，又名普库韦拉斯（?—约1295），约1290年起任立陶宛大公。史料首次提到他是在1289年，当时他与兄弟、大公布蒂盖迪斯同沃伦议和；据推测两人曾共同执政，布蒂盖迪斯死后他才独自统治。杜伊斯堡的彼得所著编年史在1291年条下称他为“立陶宛人的国王”。他在位时间不长，持续抵御条顿骑士团每年对萨莫吉希亚的侵袭，并在马佐夫舍同与骑士团结盟的波兰人作战。他是大公约维特尼斯和格迪米纳斯之父，后两人将立陶宛建成欧洲强国。

en: Euphemia of Volhynia, daughter of Prince Andrew of Galicia and heiress of Lutsk, married Liubartas of Lithuania around 1321–1323 and died before 1349.
zh: 沃里尼亚的欧费米娅是加利西亚王公安德烈之女、卢茨克女继承人，约1321—1323年嫁给立陶宛的柳巴尔塔斯，1349年前去世。

en: Gediminas (c. 1275–1341) became grand duke of Lithuania around 1316 and made it a power between the Teutonic Knights and the weakened Ruthenian principalities. Pressed by the Teutonic and Livonian orders, he allied with the Tatars in 1319 and wrote to Pope John XXII in 1322 offering baptism. In 1323 he invited Hanseatic merchants and artisans to settle in his lands and made peace with the Livonian Order; but he backed out of baptism, turned the papal legates away and stayed pagan. In 1325 his daughter Aldona married Casimir, the future king of Poland. In the east he took Belarusian and Ukrainian lands, seized Kiev after the battle on the Irpin, and brought Lithuania close to the Black Sea. Legend says an iron wolf in a dream led him to found Vilnius. He died in 1341, presumably killed in a coup, leaving the Gediminid dynasty and sons such as Algirdas and Kęstutis; Jaunutis succeeded him but was deposed by Algirdas in 1345.
zh: 格迪米纳斯（约1275—1341）约1316年起任立陶宛大公，在条顿骑士团与日渐衰弱的罗斯诸公国之间，把立陶宛经营成一方强权。面对条顿骑士团和利沃尼亚骑士团的压力，他于1319年与鞑靼人结盟，1322年致信教皇约翰二十二世，表示愿意受洗。1323年，他邀请汉萨商人与工匠入境定居，并与利沃尼亚骑士团议和；但他在受洗一事上反悔，拒见教皇使节，终身仍信奉异教。1325年，他的女儿阿尔东娜嫁给后来的波兰国王卡齐米日。在东方，他吞并白俄罗斯和乌克兰的土地，在伊尔平河战役后夺取基辅，使立陶宛逼近黑海。相传他梦见铁狼，因而建立维尔纽斯。他于1341年去世，据推测死于政变，留下格迪米纳斯王朝，以及阿尔吉尔达斯、科斯图提斯等儿子；扬努蒂斯继位，1345年被阿尔吉尔达斯推翻。

en: Jaunė (died c. 1344) was said to have been the third wife of Gediminas, Grand Duke of Lithuania. Historian Józef Wolff identified her as a daughter of Prince Ivan of Polatsk; she appears only in the late Bychowiec Chronicle, and some historians doubt she ever lived. Historian Jan Tęgowski suggested that she married Gediminas before he took power, possibly around 1308–1309; she is said to have borne him Algirdas, Kęstutis, Liubartas and other children. After her death in 1344, her elder sons Algirdas and Kęstutis drove their brother Jaunutis, Gediminas's chosen heir, from Vilnius in the winter of 1345. Tradition also credits her with founding an Orthodox monastery.
zh: 雅乌拿（约1344年卒）相传是立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯的第三任妻子。历史学家约瑟夫·沃尔夫认为她是波洛茨克王公伊凡之女；她只见于成书较晚的《贝霍维茨编年史》，部分史学家怀疑她确有其人。历史学家扬·滕戈夫斯基推测她在格迪米纳斯掌权之前便已嫁给他，婚期可能在1308—1309年；相传她为他生下阿尔吉尔达斯、科斯图提斯、柳巴尔塔斯等子女。1344年她死后，年长的儿子阿尔吉尔达斯与科斯图提斯于1345年冬把格迪米纳斯指定的继承人雅努蒂斯逐出维尔纽斯。相传她还创立了一座东正教修道院。

en: Jaunutis (Christian name Ioann; c. 1300–after 1366) succeeded his father Gediminas as Grand Duke of Lithuania in 1341. His rule was largely peaceful, but in 1345 his elder brothers Algirdas and Kęstutis, frustrated by his inactivity, agreed to depose him; Kęstutis seized Vilnius and installed Algirdas. Offered the Duchy of Zasłaŭje, Jaunutis resisted, was imprisoned, escaped to Moscow and was baptized there as Ioann, but won no support. He later reconciled with Algirdas and ruled Zasłaŭje until his last appearance in a Polish treaty of 1366.
zh: 尧努蒂斯（教名约安；约1300—1366年后）于1341年继父亲格迪米纳斯之后成为立陶宛大公。他统治年间大体平静，但1345年兄长阿尔吉尔达斯和科斯图提斯不满他按兵不动，合力将他废黜：科斯图提斯夺取维尔纽斯，拥立阿尔吉尔达斯。尧努蒂斯拒绝接受扎斯拉夫耶公国，反抗失败后被囚，逃脱后前往莫斯科并受洗改名约安，却未求得援助。他后来与阿尔吉尔达斯和解，领有扎斯拉夫耶，最后见于记载是1366年与波兰的条约。

en: Kęstutis (c. 1297–1382), son of Grand Duke Gediminas, was Duke of Trakai and, from 1345, co-ruler with his brother Algirdas, ruling western Lithuania. He spent decades defending Lithuania and Samogitia against the Teutonic Knights, negotiating conversion with Pope Clement VI in 1349 and accepting a promise of a crown from King Louis I of Hungary in 1351 only to escape. After Algirdas died in 1377 he seized Vilnius from his nephew Jogaila in 1381 and ruled alone, but Jogaila retook the city in 1382; Kęstutis was captured and died in Kreva Castle that August. His son by Birutė was Vytautas.
zh: 科斯图提斯（约1297—1382）是立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯之子，受封特拉凯公爵，1345年起与兄长阿尔吉尔达斯共同统治，主持立陶宛西部防务。他数十年间抵御条顿骑士团对立陶宛和萨莫吉希亚的进攻，1349年曾与教皇克雷芒六世谈判受洗封王，1351年接受匈牙利国王拉约什一世的王冠许诺后又中途逃脱。1377年阿尔吉尔达斯死后，他于1381年从侄子雅盖洛手中夺取维尔纽斯独自称大公；1382年雅盖洛夺回城市，科斯图提斯被俘，8月死于克雷瓦城堡。他与比鲁特所生之子即维陶塔斯。

en: Liubartas (died c. 1385), youngest son of Grand Duke Gediminas of Lithuania, was the last ruler of Galicia–Volhynia. About 1321 he married a daughter of Andrew of Galicia and received Lutsk and Liubar in Volhynia. After Yuri II Boleslav was poisoned in 1340, rebellious nobles invited him to rule Galicia and Volhynia, but in 1349 Casimir III of Poland took all but eastern Volhynia, and Liubartas was captured in 1351. The 1366 treaty left him eastern Volhynia; after Casimir died in 1370 he seized all of Volhynia. He backed his brother Kęstutis against Jogaila and built Lutsk Castle.
zh: 柳巴尔塔斯（约1385年卒）是立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯的幼子，也是加利西亚－沃里尼亚王国的末代统治者。约1321年，他娶加利西亚的安德烈之女，获得沃里尼亚的卢茨克和柳巴尔。1340年尤里二世·博莱斯瓦夫被毒杀后，反叛的贵族邀他统治加利西亚和沃里尼亚，但1349年波兰的卡齐米日三世夺取其几乎全部领地，他本人也在1351年被俘。1366年的条约只留给他东沃里尼亚；1370年卡齐米日死后，他攻占整个沃里尼亚。他支持兄长科斯图提斯对抗约盖拉，并修建了卢茨克城堡。

en: Manvydas (died 1348?), eldest son of Gediminas, Grand Duke of Lithuania, inherited Kernavė and Slonim on his father's death in 1341; he was probably the second son killed beside Narimantas at the Battle of Strėva in 1348.
zh: 曼维达斯（？—约1348）是立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯的长子，1341年父亲去世后分得克尔纳韦和斯隆尼姆；他可能就是1348年斯特雷瓦战役中与纳里曼塔斯一同阵亡的另一子。

en: Margiris or Margis (died 25 February 1336) was a Lithuanian prince remembered as the defender of Pilėnai. In early 1329, during the Teutonic crusade in which King John of Bohemia captured Medvėgalis, a Lithuanian challenged John to single combat and later paid a ransom. Jean d'Outremeuse named him Margalis and noted that his son married a countess of Clermont in France; whether Margalis was Margiris is disputed. In February 1336 a Teutonic army stormed Pilėnai, which held some four thousand people. When defense became hopeless Margiris killed his wife and guards and then himself, while the defenders burned the castle rather than surrender. He became a Lithuanian national hero.
zh: 玛格吉里斯，又名马尔吉斯（1336年2月25日卒），是立陶宛王公，以死守皮莱奈堡闻名。1329年初，在波希米亚国王约翰参加条顿十字军、攻占梅德韦加利斯的战役中，一名立陶宛人向约翰挑战决斗，后来缴纳赎金脱身。编年史家让·德乌特勒默斯称他为马尔加利斯，还提到他的儿子前往法国，与克莱蒙的一位女伯爵成婚；马尔加利斯是否就是玛格吉里斯仍有争议。1336年2月，条顿大军猛攻皮莱奈，堡中约有四千人。眼看大势已去，玛格吉里斯先杀死妻子和卫兵，随后自尽，守军也纵火焚堡、拒不投降。他后来成为立陶宛的民族英雄。

en: Skalmantas, also called Skolomend (born c. 1210, died after 1285), is the possible early ancestor of the Gediminid dynasty. He is known only from later sources: the late fourteenth-century Russian poem Zadonshchina has two sons of Algirdas call themselves great-grandsons of Skalmantas, while the Liubech Synodik records a duke Gomantas, sometimes identified with him, whose daughter Helena married a Rurikid prince of Kozelsk. Scholars debate whether he was Gediminas's grandfather or father, and some identify him with the Sudovian (Yotvingian) leader Komantas. Tradition makes Butigeidis and Butvydas his sons.
zh: 斯卡尔曼塔斯，又名斯科洛缅德（约1210年生，1285年后卒），可能是格迪米纳斯王朝的早期祖先。他仅见于后世文献：14世纪末的罗斯史诗《扎顿什奇纳》中，阿尔吉尔达斯的两个儿子自称是斯卡尔曼塔斯的曾孙；《柳别奇追思名录》记载了一位可能与他同为一人的公爵戈曼塔斯，其女海伦娜嫁给科泽利斯克的留里克系王公。学界对他究竟是格迪米纳斯的祖父还是父亲存有争议，也有人认为他就是苏多维亚人（约特文吉人）首领科曼塔斯。传统世系把布蒂盖迪斯和布特维达斯列为他的儿子。

en: The 16th-century Bychowiec Chronicle names Vida as a pagan wife of Gediminas, Grand Duke of Lithuania, who came from Courland.
zh: 据16世纪《贝霍维茨编年史》记载，维塔是立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯的异教妻子，来自库罗尼亚。

en: Vytenis was Grand Duke of Lithuania from about 1295 to about 1316, the first Gediminid to enjoy a long reign. He first appears in 1292 raiding Masovia; as grand duke he backed its duke Boleslaus II, recovered Ruthenian lands lost after Mindaugas' death and took Pinsk and Turov. In 1298, allied with Riga, he defeated the Livonian Order at Turaida, killing Land Master Bruno, and around 1307 he annexed Polatsk. He campaigned against the Teutonic Knights and was last recorded in September 1315 besieging Christmemel. He died soon after without an heir, and his brother Gediminas succeeded.
zh: 维特尼斯约1295年至1316年任立陶宛大公，是格迪米纳斯王朝第一位统治时间较长的君主。史载他1292年首次出现，袭掠马佐夫舍；成为大公后，他支持马佐夫舍公爵波列斯瓦夫二世，收复明道加斯遇刺后丧失的罗斯土地，夺取平斯克和图罗夫。1298年他与里加结盟，在图拉伊达击败利沃尼亚骑士团，斩杀其团长布鲁诺，约1307年吞并波洛茨克。他连年征讨条顿骑士团，1315年9月最后一次见于记载，当时正在围攻克里斯特梅梅尔。不久后他去世且没有继承人，由弟弟格迪米纳斯继位。

en: Žvelgutis, whose name is also recorded as Swalegote, is the only known son of Grand Duke Vytenis of Lithuania. He may have died before his father, leaving Vytenis without an heir so that his brother Gediminas succeeded to the grand-ducal throne.
zh: 日韦尔古蒂斯，名字在史料中亦写作斯瓦莱戈特，是立陶宛大公维特尼斯唯一知名的儿子。他可能先于父亲去世，维特尼斯因而无嗣，王位由其弟格迪米纳斯继承。

en: Eberhard von Monheim (c. 1275–before 1362) was Landmeister of the Teutonic Order's Livonian branch from May 1328 to June 1340, and the man who brought Riga to heel. A former commander of Ventspils and Kuldīga, he took office just as Livonia flared up: in June 1328 the Letts burned the order's fortress at Daugavgrīva, and the Lithuanians joined the rising, raiding as far as Paistu in 1329. After pushing them back he besieged Riga from September 1329. Severe famine struck the city, and it surrendered on 17 March 1330. He had part of its walls pulled down and began an order fortress outside the old city limits, the later Riga Castle. A winter campaign against Lithuania failed in 1340, and he resigned on 24 June. He then held a commandery in Cologne or Mechelen, and was last recorded on 24 November 1360 as an official at Mohrungen in Prussia.
zh: 埃伯哈德·冯·蒙海姆（约1275—1362年前）自1328年5月至1340年6月任条顿骑士团利沃尼亚分支的首领，正是他制服了里加。他此前曾指挥文茨皮尔斯和库尔迪加城堡，上任时利沃尼亚恰好陷入动荡：1328年6月，拉脱维亚人烧毁了骑士团在道加夫格里瓦的要塞，立陶宛人加入叛乱，1329年一路袭至派斯图。他击退立陶宛人后，于1329年9月起围攻里加。城内发生严重饥荒，里加于1330年3月17日投降。他下令拆毁部分城墙，并在旧城界外动工修建骑士团要塞，即后来的里加城堡。1340年讨伐立陶宛的冬季战事失败，他于6月24日辞职。此后他在科隆或梅赫伦担任骑士团指挥官，1360年11月24日最后一次见于记载，当时在普鲁士的莫龙根任职。

en: Phayu was king of the Lan Na kingdom in northern Thailand, succeeding his father Khamfu, who by legend died after being bitten by a mermaid or crocodile. The Sip-Ha Rajawong Chronicle records that his ministers and officials crowned him at Chiang Mai when he was twenty-eight. Khamfu had moved the court to Chiang Saen; Phayu moved the capital back to Chiang Mai. Tradition portrays him as a righteous Buddhist ruler, under whom the kingdom knew peace and prosperity and Buddhism flourished. He died in 1355, and the ministers unanimously invited his son Kue Na, who had been governing Chiang Saen, to take the throne.
zh: 帕育是泰国北部兰纳王国的国王，继承父亲坎富的王位；相传坎富是被美人鱼或鳄鱼咬伤后死去的。《锡哈罗旺编年史》记载，大臣与官员在清迈为二十八岁的他举行加冕。坎富原把朝廷设在清盛，帕育则把都城迁回清迈。传统说法称他是一位笃信佛教的贤明君主，治下国家和平安宁、繁荣昌盛，佛教兴盛。他于1355年去世，大臣们一致迎请曾治理清盛的其子古纳继位。

en: Frederick IV (c. 1250–1316) was Count of Leiningen, son of Count Frederick III and Adelaide of Kyburg. He ruled the family lands jointly with his uncle Emicho IV and cousin Emicho V, and after Emicho V died around 1289 he inherited part of their estates, including Madenburg Castle. In 1274 he received Lindelbrunn as a fief, and from 1275 to 1301 he served Emperor Rudolf of Habsburg as landvogt of Speyergau; in 1301 Emperor Albert I pledged him Falkenburg Castle. His sons Frederick V of Leiningen-Dagsburg and Godfrey of Leiningen-Hardenburg divided the inheritance in 1317.
zh: 腓特烈四世（约1250—1316）为莱宁根伯爵，是伯爵腓特烈三世与基堡的阿德莱德之子。他先与叔父埃米希四世、堂兄埃米希五世共同统治家族领地，约1289年埃米希五世死后继承其部分产业，包括马登堡城堡。1274年他受封林德尔布伦恩领地，1275年至1301年担任哈布斯堡的鲁道夫皇帝任命的施派尔高地方长官；1301年阿尔布雷希特一世皇帝把福尔肯堡城堡抵押给他。他的两个儿子莱宁根-达格斯堡的腓特烈五世与莱宁根-哈登堡的戈特弗里德于1317年瓜分了遗产。

en: Frederick V (born c. 1269, died after 1327) was Count of Leiningen and lord of Leiningen-Dagsburg and Ormes, the eldest son of Count Frederick IV and Johanna of Sponheim-Kreuznach. When his father died in 1316, he and his half-brother Godfrey I of Leiningen-Hardenburg divided the family lands in 1317, Frederick taking Dagsburg and so founding the Leiningen-Dagsburg line. His brother Emicho was bishop of Speyer from 1314 to 1328. Frederick married Sophie of Freiburg and, after her death, Marie of Châtillon, and was succeeded by his son Frederick VI; the Dagsburg line died out in 1467.
zh: 腓特烈五世（约1269年生，1327年后卒）为莱宁根伯爵、达格斯堡与奥尔姆领主，是伯爵腓特烈四世与施蓬海姆-克罗伊茨纳赫的约翰娜的长子。1316年父亲去世后，他与异母弟莱宁根-哈登堡的戈特弗里德一世于1317年瓜分家族领地，他获得达格斯堡，开创莱宁根-达格斯堡支系。其弟埃米希于1314年至1328年任施派尔主教。他先后娶弗赖堡的索菲与沙蒂永的玛丽，由儿子腓特烈六世继位；达格斯堡支系于1467年绝嗣。

en: Frederick VI of Leiningen-Dagsburg (c. 1294–1342), also numbered Frederick V, ruled as count of Leiningen-Dagsburg in the Vosges. He was the only son of Count Frederick V and his first wife Sophie of Freiburg, and married Jutta of Isenburg-Limburg, who died in 1335. Their sons included Frederick VII, who kept Dagsburg, Frederick VIII, ancestor of the Rixingen line, and Emich. Frederick died between 1 January and 21 July 1342, and his sons divided the inheritance in 1343.
zh: 腓特烈六世·冯·莱宁根－达格斯堡（约1294—1342，亦被排为腓特烈五世）是孚日山区的莱宁根－达格斯堡伯爵。他是伯爵腓特烈五世与第一任妻子弗赖堡的索菲的独子，娶1335年去世的伊森堡－林堡的尤塔为妻。诸子中有保有达格斯堡的腓特烈七世、里克辛根支系的始祖腓特烈八世，以及埃米希。腓特烈于1342年1月1日至7月21日之间去世，诸子于1343年瓜分了遗产。

en: Frederick VII of Leiningen-Dagsburg was the eldest son of Count Frederick VI and Jutta of Isenburg-Limburg. Before 9 August 1353 he married Yolanda of Blois-Châtillon (1323–1363), daughter of Count Guy I of Blois and Margaret of Valois and widow of Duke Rudolf of Lorraine, who had fallen in 1346. The marriage produced no heir. Frederick is last documented on 3 March 1377 and died before 19 January 1378.
zh: 腓特烈七世·冯·莱宁根－达格斯堡是伯爵腓特烈六世与伊森堡－林堡的尤塔的长子。1353年8月9日之前，他迎娶布卢瓦－沙蒂永的约兰达（1323—1363）——布卢瓦伯爵居伊一世与瓦卢瓦的玛格丽特之女、1346年战死的洛林公爵鲁道夫的遗孀。这段婚姻没有留下继承人。腓特烈在1377年3月3日仍见于记载，1378年1月19日前去世。

en: Godfrey, in German Joffrid I of Leiningen-Hardenburg (c. 1304–1344), was count of Leiningen-Hardenburg and lord of Rixingen, Guntersblum and Heidesheim. He was the son of Count Frederick IV of Leiningen and his second wife Jeanne d'Aspremont, and half-brother of Count Frederick V and of Emich, bishop of Speyer. By his first wife Agnes of Ochsenstein he fathered Fritzmann, who married the Rixingen heiress Johanna of Forbach and founded the Rixingen line; his second wife Matilda of Salm bore him Count Emich VI.
zh: 戈弗雷，德语作约弗里德一世·冯·莱宁根－哈登堡（约1304—1344），是莱宁根－哈登堡伯爵，并领有里克辛根、贡特斯布鲁姆和海德斯海姆。他是莱宁根伯爵腓特烈四世与第二任妻子让娜·达斯普勒蒙之子，也是腓特烈五世和施派尔主教埃米希的同父异母兄弟。他与第一任妻子阿格妮丝·冯·奥克森施泰因生子弗里茨曼，后者娶里克辛根女继承人约翰娜·冯·福尔巴赫，开创里克辛根支系；第二任妻子萨尔姆的玛蒂尔德为他生下埃米希六世。

en: Aonghus Óg Mac Domhnaill, or Angus Og MacDonald, was chief of Clann Domhnaill and Lord of Islay, a younger son of Aonghus Mór. He first backed Edward I of England against John Balliol and rival Clann Dubhghaill, but after Robert the Bruce killed John Comyn in 1306 and claimed the Scottish crown, Clann Domhnaill appears to have switched its support to Robert, and members of the clan sheltered him. The late fourteenth-century work The Bruce records Aonghus fighting at Bannockburn in 1314; he received former Clann Dubhghaill lands. He may have died between 1314 and 1318; Henry Lee recorded that he died in 1330 at Finlaggan and was buried on Iona. His son Eóin became the first Lord of the Isles.
zh: 安格斯·奥格·麦克唐纳是麦克唐纳家族首领、艾莱领主，安格斯·莫尔的幼子。他起初支持英格兰国王爱德华一世，对抗约翰·巴里奥和敌对的麦克杜格尔家族；1306年罗伯特·布鲁斯杀死约翰·科明并自立为苏格兰国王后，麦克唐纳家族似乎转而支持罗伯特，家族成员收留了他。14世纪末的《布鲁斯》记载安格斯参加了1314年的班诺克本战役；他获封原属麦克杜格尔家族的土地。他可能于1314年至1318年间去世；亨利·李记载他1330年卒于芬拉根，葬在爱奥那岛。其子约翰成为第一代群岛之王。

en: John of Islay (Eoin mac Aonghais; died 1386), son of Aonghus Óg Mac Domhnaill, became chief of Clan Donald and styled himself Lord of the Isles from 1336. Edward Balliol granted him Kintyre, Knapdale, Skye and Lewis, but David II confirmed his holdings in 1343. Through his first wife Amie mac Ruari he inherited Garmoran in 1346, gaining most of the Hebrides. Around 1350 he married Margaret Stewart, daughter of the future Robert II, and divorced Amie. He submitted to David II at Inverness in 1369 and died in 1386.
zh: 艾拉的约翰（盖尔语名作埃文·麦克·安格斯，1386年去世）是安格斯·奥格·麦克唐纳之子，后成为麦克唐纳氏族族长，1336年起自称“群岛领主”。爱德华·巴里奥曾将金泰尔、克纳普代尔、斯凯岛和刘易斯岛封赐给他，1343年大卫二世确认了他原有的领地。1346年，他凭第一任妻子埃米·麦克·鲁阿里继承加莫兰，势力遍及赫布里底群岛大部。约1350年，他与后来的罗伯特二世之女玛格丽特·斯图亚特结婚并与埃米离婚。1369年他在因弗内斯向大卫二世臣服，1386年去世。

en: Iain Ciar MacLeod (1330 – c. 1392), eldest son of Malcolm, is considered the fourth chief of Clan MacLeod, succeeding his father between 1360 and 1370. The Bannatyne manuscript describes him as the most tyrannical MacLeod chief, feared even by his own family; his wife, daughter of an Irish O'Neill chieftain, was said to be as cruel and to have buried two daughters alive in Dunvegan Castle's dungeon. Around 1392, after a hunt on Harris, he was ambushed and struck by an arrow; he died at Rodel and was buried on Iona. His only surviving son, William Cleireach, succeeded him.
zh: 伊恩·西亚尔·麦克劳德（1330—约1392）是马尔科姆的长子，被视为麦克劳德氏族第四代族长，于1360至1370年间继承父位。《班纳蒂恩手稿》称他是所有麦克劳德族长中最暴虐的一位，连自己的家人都惧怕他；他的妻子是爱尔兰奥尼尔酋长之女，相传同样残忍，曾将两个女儿活埋在邓韦根城堡的地牢里。约1392年，他在哈里斯岛狩猎后遭伏击，中箭受伤，死于罗德尔，葬于爱奥那岛。唯一存活的儿子威廉·克莱雷赫继任族长。

en: Mary (Máire) MacDonald, daughter of Aonghus Óg of Islay, chief of Clan Donald, was the first wife of William, 5th Earl of Ross. Her daughter Euphemia succeeded to the earldom of Ross with her husband Walter de Leslie.
zh: 玛丽（盖尔语名玛伊蕾）·麦克唐纳是麦克唐纳氏族族长安格斯·奥格之女，第五代罗斯伯爵威廉的第一任妻子；其女尤菲米娅后与丈夫沃尔特·德·莱斯利继承罗斯伯爵领。

en: Malcolm MacLeod (Gille Caluim MacLeòid; 1296–1370), son of Tormod and grandson of Leod, is considered the third chief of Clan MacLeod, succeeding about 1320. Around 1343, in the reign of David II, he appears in a royal charter, one of the first MacLeod chiefs in contemporary records. Clan tradition calls him the clan's greatest hero: he slew a bull at Glenelg with only a dirk and carried its horn to Dunvegan, where it became Sir Rory Mor's Horn. Known as Good Fat Malcolm in old age, he died at Stornoway and was buried on Iona, succeeded by Iain Ciar.
zh: 马尔科姆·麦克劳德（盖尔语名作吉勒·卡卢姆·麦克劳伊德，1296—1370）是托蒙德之子、氏族始祖利奥德之孙，被视为麦克劳德氏族第三代族长，约于1320年继任。1343年前后，在大卫二世在位期间，他的名字出现在一份王室特许状中，是最早见于同时代记载的麦克劳德族长之一。氏族传说称他为全族最伟大的英雄：相传他仅凭一把匕首在格伦埃尔格杀死一头野牛，将牛角带回邓韦根，后来成为“罗里·莫尔爵士之角”。晚年因肥胖得号“好心的胖卡勒姆”，最终在斯托诺韦去世，葬于爱奥那岛，族长之位由伊恩·西亚尔继承。

en: Thomas de Rossy (died 20 September 1348) was a Scottish churchman who became Bishop of the Isles, the medieval see covering the Hebrides and Mann. In 1331, while a canon of Dunkeld Cathedral, he was provided to the see by Pope John XXII in succession to Bernard, and was consecrated at the papal curia between 7 and 10 June. The Chronicles of Mann call him the first bishop to levy twenty shillings of visitation dues from the Manx churches and to exact from parish rectors the tithes they received from visiting herring fishermen. After an eighteen-year episcopate he was buried at Scone.
zh: 托马斯·德·罗西（1348年9月20日卒）是苏格兰教士，出任群岛主教，该主教区中世纪时辖赫布里底群岛与马恩岛。1331年，他身为邓凯尔德大教堂的法政牧师，被教宗若望二十二世任命接替伯纳德出掌该主教区，并于6月7日至10日间在教廷祝圣。《马恩编年史》称他是第一位向马恩岛各教堂征收20先令巡视费，并向堂区神甫征收他们从外来鲱鱼渔民处取得的什一税的主教。担任主教18年后，他安葬于斯昆。

en: Adosinda was queen consort of Asturias during the reign of her husband Silo, 774–783. A daughter of Alfonso I and Ermesinda and granddaughter of Pelagius, after her brother Fruela I was killed in 768 she had her young nephew Alfonso sheltered at San Julián de Samos monastery. She herself chose Silo, a wealthy landowner of Pravia, as her husband. When he died without heirs in 783 she secured the boy's election as Alfonso II, but her half-brother Mauregatus seized power, and she was forced to take the veil at San Juan de Pravia in 783 or 785.
zh: 阿多辛达是阿斯图里亚斯王后，其夫希罗于774年至783年在位。她是阿方索一世与埃尔梅辛达之女、佩拉约的外孙女。768年其兄弗鲁埃拉一世遇弑后，她把年幼的侄子阿方索送往萨莫斯的圣胡利安修道院庇护。她亲自挑选普拉维亚的富有地主希罗为夫。783年希罗无嗣而终，她促成侄子被拥立为阿方索二世，但她的异母兄毛雷加图斯篡夺王位，她被迫于783年或785年在普拉维亚的圣胡安修道院出家为修女。

en: Alfonso Fróilaz, called the Hunchback, briefly held the united throne of Asturias, Galicia and León in 925. The eldest son of Fruela II, he succeeded in July 925 but within the year was driven from León by his cousins Sancho, Alfonso IV and Ramiro II, sons of Ordoño II. After Alfonso IV seized power in 926, Alfonso Fróilaz was recognised as king in the northeast, where a charter of 927 still bears his name. In 932 Ramiro II had him and his cousins blinded in a single day and confined them in León's Ruiforco monastery.
zh: 阿方索·弗罗伊拉斯，人称“驼背”，曾在925年短暂领有阿斯图里亚斯、加利西亚和莱昂的统一王位。他是弗罗伊拉二世的长子，925年7月继位，但不出一年就被堂兄弟——奥多尼奥二世的几个儿子桑乔、阿方索四世和拉米罗二世——逐出莱昂。926年阿方索四世掌权后，阿方索·弗罗伊拉斯在东北部被承认为国王，927年的一份特许状仍用他的名义。932年，拉米罗二世下令在一天之内刺瞎他和其他堂兄弟，把他们囚禁在莱昂的鲁伊福尔科修道院。

en: Alfonso I, called the Catholic (c. 693–757), was the third king of Asturias, reigning from 739. Son of Duke Peter of Cantabria, he married Ermesinda, daughter of Pelagius, and succeeded her brother Favila. Exploiting the Berber Revolt of 740, he reconquered Galicia, took León in 754 and raided as far as La Rioja. Lugo and Tui, which had remained unoccupied by Muslim forces, joined his domain. The frontier populations withdrew north under him, creating the depopulated Desert of the Duero as a buffer against Muslim armies; more than a century passed before it was resettled. He founded the shrine of Covadonga in memory of his father-in-law's victory there and died at Cangas in 757. His sons Fruela and Mauregatus both later became kings.
zh: 阿方索一世，绰号“天主教徒”（约693—757），是阿斯图里亚斯第三位国王，739年即位。他是坎塔布里亚公爵佩德罗之子，娶佩拉约之女埃尔梅辛达为妻，并在她的兄弟法维拉死后继位。他趁740年柏柏尔人起义之机收复加利西亚，754年攻取莱昂，兵锋远达拉里奥哈。未被穆斯林军队占领的卢戈和图伊也归入他的领地。在他治下边境居民北撤，形成荒无人烟的“杜罗荒漠”，作为抵御穆斯林军队的缓冲地带；一个多世纪后，这里才重新有居民定居。他修建科瓦东加圣祠，纪念岳父在那里取得的胜利，757年死于坎加斯。他的儿子弗鲁埃拉和毛雷加图斯后来都成为国王。

en: Alfonso II (c. 760–842), called the Chaste, was the Oviedo-born son of Fruela I and Munia. After his father's murder in 768, he was elected king in 783, but magnates raised his uncle Mauregatus to the throne instead. Alfonso fled to his mother's relatives in Álava and became king in 791 after Bermudo I abdicated. He made Oviedo his capital and built churches including San Tirso and Santullano. After Cordoban raids in 794 he sent embassies to Charlemagne, who recognized him, and his troops sacked Lisbon in 798. In 814 the tomb of Saint James was found at Compostela and he became its first pilgrim. His victories of 825 opened the repopulation of Galicia and León. He died in 842 after a fifty-year reign.
zh: 阿方索二世（约760—842），绰号“纯洁者”，是弗鲁埃拉一世与姆妮亚之子，出生于奥维耶多。768年父亲遇刺后，他于783年被推举为王，但贵族转而拥立他的叔父毛雷加托。阿方索逃往阿拉瓦投奔母族，791年贝尔穆多一世退位后他继承王位。他定都奥维耶多，修建了圣蒂尔索教堂、圣图利亚诺教堂等建筑。794年科尔多瓦军队入侵后，他多次遣使觐见查理曼并获得承认，798年其军队洗劫里斯本。814年，圣雅各的陵墓在孔波斯特拉被发现，他成为前往该地的第一位朝圣者。825年的胜利开启了对加利西亚和莱昂的再移民。他在位约半个世纪，于842年去世。

en: Alfonso III, called the Great (c. 848–910), succeeded his father Ordoño I as king of Asturias in 866. He fled the usurper Count Fruela of Galicia, returning after Fruela's murder. He crushed a Basque revolt in 867 and around 869 allied with Pamplona, strengthening the bond by marrying Jimena. Continuing his father's resettlement of the frontier, his counts took Porto in 868 and Coimbra in 878, advancing the frontier to the Mondego. In 878 he defeated Salid ibn Ghanim's army at Polvoraria, then the Córdoban prince al-Mundir at Valdemora, forcing the first truce from Córdoba. His sons rebelled in 909; after his death at Zamora on 20 December 910 the kingdom was divided among them.
zh: 阿方索三世，绰号“伟大者”（约848—910），866年继承父亲奥多尼奥一世的阿斯图里亚斯王位。即位之初他被加利西亚的篡位伯爵弗鲁埃拉逼走，弗鲁埃拉被杀后才返回。867年他平定巴斯克人叛乱，约869年与潘普洛纳结盟，并娶希梅娜以巩固盟约。他继续父亲的边境移民政策，手下的伯爵们于868年攻取波尔图、878年攻取科英布拉，把边境推到蒙德古河。878年，他在波尔沃拉里亚击败萨利德·伊本·加尼姆的军队，随后在巴尔德莫拉击败科尔多瓦王子蒙迪尔，迫使科尔多瓦首次求和。909年他的儿子们起兵反叛；910年12月20日他在萨莫拉去世，王国被儿子们瓜分。

en: Alfonso IV (c. 890s–933), called the Monk, was a son of Ordoño II of León. After Fruela II died in 925, Alfonso and his brothers, backed by Jimeno Garcés of Pamplona, drove Alfonso Fróilaz to the eastern marches of Asturias: Alfonso took León, his brother Sancho took Galicia, and on Sancho's death in 929 he reunited both kingdoms. In 931 he abdicated in favour of his brother Ramiro II and entered a monastery. A year later, regretting his retirement, he rebelled with Fruela's sons, was captured and blinded, and died at Sahagún in August 933. His son by Onneca Sánchez, a niece of Jimeno, was Ordoño IV.
zh: 阿方索四世（约890年代—933），人称“修道士”，是莱昂国王奥多尼奥二世之子。925年弗鲁埃拉二世死后，他与兄弟们在潘普洛纳的希梅诺·加尔塞斯支持下将堂兄阿方索·弗鲁伊拉斯赶至阿斯图里亚斯东部边地：阿方索取得莱昂，兄长桑乔取得加利西亚；929年桑乔去世，他重新统一两国。931年他让位给弟弟拉米罗二世，进入修道院。次年他后悔退隐，联合弗鲁埃拉的儿子们起兵，战败后被刺瞎双眼，于933年8月死在萨哈贡的修道院。他与希梅诺的侄女、潘普洛纳的欧妮卡生有奥多尼奥四世。

en: Alfonso IX (1171–1230), born in Zamora, was the only son of Ferdinand II of León and Urraca of Portugal, and ruled León from 1188. Faced with protests over taxes, he summoned the Cortes of León that year, an assembly of nobles, clergy and town delegates regarded as an early Western European parliament with urban representation. His marriages to Theresa of Portugal (1191) and Berengaria of Castile (1197) were both annulled for consanguinity; the second brought an interdict. He also invaded Castile with Muslim troops and was excommunicated. He founded the University of Salamanca in 1218 and captured Mérida and Badajoz in 1230, the year of his death. His son Ferdinand III inherited León and united it with Castile.
zh: 阿方索九世（1171—1230）出生于萨莫拉，是莱昂国王斐迪南二世与葡萄牙的乌拉卡唯一的儿子，1188年起统治莱昂。面对民众对税收的抗议，他同年召开由贵族、教士和城市代表组成的莱昂议会，被视为西欧早期包含城市代表的议会之一。他1191年娶葡萄牙的特蕾莎、1197年娶卡斯蒂利亚的贝伦加利亚，两次婚姻均因血亲关系被废除，第二次婚姻还招致禁罚。他还联合穆斯林军队入侵卡斯蒂利亚，受到绝罚。1218年他创办萨拉曼卡大学，1230年即他去世的当年攻占梅里达和巴达霍斯。其子斐迪南三世继承莱昂，将其与卡斯蒂利亚合并。

en: Alfonso V (c. 994–1028), called the Noble, succeeded his father Bermudo II as king of León in 999, aged five. His mother Elvira García and Count Menendo González, his Galician tutor, served as regents until Menendo's death in 1008. Alfonso married Menendo's daughter Elvira Menéndez in 1013 and used the title emperor of all Spain to assert his standing among Christian rulers. He rebuilt the kingdom after years of civil war and Muslim ravaging, and in 1017 he and Elvira granted León its first charters of privileges, fostering the city's revival. After her death he married Urraca of Pamplona, despite a bishop's objection to their kinship. On 7 August 1028 he was killed by an arrow while besieging Viseu, and his son Bermudo III succeeded him.
zh: 阿方索五世（约994—1028），人称“高贵者”，999年父王贝尔穆多二世去世时年仅五岁，便继位为莱昂国王。母亲埃尔维拉·加西亚与在加利西亚抚养他的梅嫩多·冈萨雷斯伯爵共同摄政，至1008年梅嫩多去世后亲政。1013年阿方索迎娶梅嫩多之女埃尔维拉·曼德斯，并使用全西班牙皇帝的称号，彰显他在基督教统治者中的地位。经历多年内战与穆斯林蹂躏后，他着手重建王国；1017年，他与埃尔维拉向莱昂城颁布首批特权特许状，推动城市复兴。埃尔维拉死后，他娶潘普洛纳的乌拉卡为妻，尽管一位主教因两人近亲而反对。1028年8月7日，他在围攻维塞乌时中箭身亡，王位传给儿子贝尔穆多三世。

en: Alfonso VI (c. 1040–1109), called the Brave, was the second son of Ferdinand I of León and his queen Sancha. Inheriting León in 1065, he fought his brothers Sancho II and García; Sancho's murder at Zamora in 1072 and García's long imprisonment left him ruler of León, Castile and Galicia. His greatest triumph was the capture of Toledo in 1085, after which he styled himself emperor of Spain. The conquest helped provoke an Almoravid invasion, which he resisted for the rest of his reign. Leonese and Castilian armies suffered defeats at Sagrajas (1086), Consuegra (1097) and Uclés (1108), where his heir Sancho died. He died in 1109 and was succeeded by his daughter Urraca.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿方索六世_(雷昂與卡斯提亞)
zh: 阿方索六世（约1040—1109），绰号“勇敢者”，是莱昂国王斐迪南一世与王后桑查的次子。1065年他继承莱昂，与兄弟桑乔二世、加西亚交战；1072年桑乔在萨莫拉城外遇刺，加西亚遭到长期囚禁，他由此成为莱昂、卡斯蒂利亚和加利西亚的统治者。他最大的功业是1085年攻占托莱多，此后自称“全西班牙皇帝”。这一征服促使阿尔摩拉维王朝入侵，他在余下的统治岁月中不断抵御。莱昂与卡斯蒂利亚军队在萨拉卡（1086）、孔苏埃格拉（1097）和乌克莱斯（1108）受挫，继承人桑乔在乌克莱斯阵亡。1109年他去世，女儿乌拉卡继位。

en: Aurelius (c. 740–774) was King of Asturias from 768 until his death. The son of Fruela of Cantabria and nephew of Alfonso I, he was chosen king by the Asturian nobility after his cousin Fruela I was assassinated, and may have been crowned at Sama. His quiet six-year reign saw him put down a rebellion of serfs, the first anti-seignorial revolt recorded in the Iberian Peninsula; he may have negotiated peace with the Muslim south through exchanged brides. He died of natural causes in 774 and was succeeded by his cousin-in-law Silo; contemporary chronicles do not mention a wife or children. His brother Bermudo I later reigned.
zh: 奥勒留（约740—774）于768年被推举为阿斯图里亚斯国王，在位直至去世。他是坎塔布里亚的弗罗伊拉之子、阿方索一世的侄子；堂兄弗罗伊拉一世遇刺后，阿斯图里亚斯贵族将他选为国王，他可能在萨马加冕。他在位六年，政局平静，史载的主要事件是他镇压了一场农奴起义——这是伊比利亚半岛有记载的第一次反领主起义；他可能以交换新娘的习俗与南方的穆斯林议和。774年他自然死亡，由堂姐夫西罗继位；同时代编年史未提及他的妻子或子女。他的弟弟贝尔穆多一世后来也登上王位。

en: Bermudo I, called the Deacon (c. 750–797), was King of Asturias from 788 or 789 until 791.
