A son of Fruela of Cantabria and brother of King Aurelius, he was elected by the palace nobility after Mauregatus died, probably to bar Alfonso II's succession. In 791 an Arab-Berber army invaded Álava and Galicia and defeated him at the Burbia River. Bermudo then abdicated and Alfonso II took the crown. The Chronicle of Alfonso III attributed his abdication to his status as a deacon, but whether he acted voluntarily is unknown. Remembered as merciful and pious, he lived on, perhaps as a monk, leaving a son by an unnamed wife who later reigned as Ramiro I.
zh: 贝尔穆多一世，人称“助祭”（约750—797），于788或789年至791年任阿斯图里亚斯国王。他是坎塔布里亚的弗罗伊拉之子、国王奥勒留之弟，在马雷加托死后由宫廷贵族推举继位，此举很可能是为了阻止阿方索二世继位。791年，一支阿拉伯-柏柏尔军队入侵阿拉瓦和加利西亚，在布尔比亚河击败他。贝尔穆多随后退位，阿方索二世取得王位。《阿方索三世编年史》将他的退位归因于其助祭身份，但他是否自愿退位并不清楚。他被称为仁慈虔诚之人，退位后仍活了很久，可能做了修士；他与一位姓名不详的妻子生有一子，即后来的国王拉米罗一世。

en: Bermudo II (c. 950–999), called the Gouty, was a son of Ordoño III of León. In 982 Galician nobles proclaimed him king in revolt against Ramiro III, and he was crowned at Santiago de Compostela. After Ramiro's death in 985 he ruled all León. He sought the Caliphate of Córdoba's protection, yet Almanzor's armies came as conquerors; Bermudo expelled them in 987. Between 991 and 992 a noble revolt expelled him, but he was soon restored. Almanzor destroyed Coimbra and León, took Astorga in 996 and sacked Santiago de Compostela in 997. Gout-crippled, Bermudo travelled by litter in his last year. He died in El Bierzo in September 999, and his son Alfonso V succeeded him.
zh: 贝尔穆多二世（约950—999），人称“痛风者”，是莱昂国王奥多尼奥三世之子。982年加利西亚贵族拥立他为王，反抗拉米罗三世，他在圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉加冕；985年拉米罗死后，他统治整个莱昂。他投靠科尔多瓦哈里发国寻求庇护，曼苏尔的军队却以征服者的姿态前来；贝尔穆多于987年将其驱逐。991至992年间，一场贵族叛乱将他驱逐，但他很快复位。曼苏尔摧毁科英布拉和莱昂，996年攻取阿斯托加，997年洗劫圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉。贝尔穆多因痛风致残，最后一年乘轿出行，于999年9月在埃尔别尔索去世，其子阿方索五世继位。

en: Bermudo III (c. 1015–1037), son of Alfonso V of León and Elvira Menéndez, became king of León in 1028 while still a child and was the last ruler of the line of Peter of Cantabria. Like earlier Leonese kings he occasionally used an imperial title. In 1034 Sancho III of Pamplona drove him from his kingdom and he took refuge in Galicia. He recovered León, but on 4 September 1037 he was defeated and killed at the Battle of Tamarón fighting his brother-in-law Ferdinand of Castile, who then annexed the kingdom.
zh: 贝尔穆多三世（约1015—1037）是莱昂国王阿方索五世与埃尔维拉·梅嫩德斯之子，1028年幼年即位，是坎塔布里亚的佩德罗一系最后一位统治者。他和此前几位莱昂国王一样，偶尔使用皇帝头衔。1034年，潘普洛纳的桑乔三世将他逐出国境，他逃往加利西亚避难。他后来收复莱昂，却在1037年9月4日的塔马龙战役中，与姐夫卡斯蒂利亚的斐迪南交战时兵败身亡，莱昂随后被斐迪南兼并。

en: Ermesinda (born c. 720 or 730, date of death unknown) was queen consort of Asturias as the wife of Alfonso I. The Latin Chronicon Albeldense names her a daughter of King Pelagius and Queen Gaudiosa and sister of King Favila. When Favila was killed by a bear in 739, her husband Alfonso, son of Duke Peter of Cantabria, took the crown through her claim. Her children were Fruela I, Vimarano, whom Fruela had killed in 765, and Adosinda, who married King Silo.
zh: 埃尔梅辛达（约720或730年生，卒年不详）是阿斯图里亚斯王后，阿方索一世之妻。拉丁文《阿尔韦尔达编年史》记载她是国王佩拉约与王后高迪奥萨之女、国王法维拉的姐妹。739年法维拉被熊咬死，她的丈夫、坎塔布里亚公爵佩德罗之子阿方索凭借她的继承权取得王位。她的子女有弗鲁埃拉一世、765年被弗鲁埃拉杀害的维马拉诺，以及嫁给希罗王的阿多辛达。

en: Favila or Fafila (died 739) was the second king of Asturias, succeeding his father Pelagius in 737. The only known act of his short reign was the founding of the Church of Santa Cruz in his capital of Cangas de Onís, where he was later buried. In 739 he was mauled to death by a bear during a royal hunt, for which later Asturian chroniclers blamed his frivolity, although such hunts also served to bind the court together. He was buried beside his wife Froiluba and succeeded by his brother-in-law Alfonso I.
zh: 法维拉（亦作法菲拉，？—739）是阿斯图里亚斯第二位国王，737年继其父佩拉约而立。他短暂统治中唯一可考的事迹，是在都城坎加斯德奥尼斯修建圣十字教堂，他身后也葬于此处。739年，他在一次王室狩猎中被熊咬死，后世阿斯图里亚斯编年史家归咎于他轻浮误事，尽管这类狩猎也有凝聚宫廷的作用。他与妻子弗罗伊卢巴合葬，王位由妹夫阿方索一世继承。

en: Ferdinand I (c. 1015–1065), called the Great, was a younger son of Sancho III of Pamplona and Muniadona of Castile. Count of Castile from 1029, he married Sancha of León and in 1037 killed Bermudo III at Tamarón, taking the crown of León in 1038. He had acknowledged the supremacy of his elder brother García of Navarre under their father's will, but in 1054 defeated him at Atapuerca, where García was killed. Tradition holds that Ferdinand was crowned emperor of Spain in 1056. He extracted tribute from the Muslim taifas of Zaragoza, Toledo and Seville and took Coimbra in 1064. He died at León in December 1065, leaving Castile, León and Galicia to Sancho, Alfonso and García.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/斐迪南一世_(莱昂与卡斯蒂利亚)
zh: 斐迪南一世（约1015—1065），绰号“伟大者”，是潘普洛纳的桑乔三世与卡斯蒂利亚的穆尼亚多纳较年幼的儿子。他1029年成为卡斯蒂利亚伯爵，娶莱昂的桑查为妻，1037年在塔马龙击杀莱昂国王贝尔穆多三世，1038年取得莱昂王位。他曾遵父亲遗嘱承认兄长纳瓦拉国王加西亚的宗主地位，却于1054年在阿塔普埃尔卡击败兄长，加西亚在战役中阵亡。相传斐迪南于1056年加冕为“西班牙皇帝”。他向萨拉戈萨、托莱多、塞维利亚等穆斯林泰法国索取贡金，1064年攻占科英布拉。1065年12月他在莱昂去世，把卡斯蒂利亚、莱昂和加利西亚分别留给桑乔、阿方索和加西亚三个儿子。

en: Ferdinand II (c. 1137–1188), born in Toledo, was a younger son of Alfonso VII of León and Castile. When his father died in 1157 the realm was divided and Ferdinand received León and Galicia. In 1158 he and his brother Sancho III of Castile signed the Treaty of Sahagún, agreeing to campaign jointly against Muslim territories and divide their conquests. He warred with Castile under Sancho and his nephew Alfonso VIII, while campaigning south against the Almohads, taking Alcántara in 1164 and Cáceres after capturing Afonso I of Portugal at Badajoz in 1169. In 1170 he founded the Order of Santiago to protect pilgrims to Compostela, and in 1180 he made peace with Castile at Tordesillas. His son Alfonso IX succeeded him.
zh: 斐迪南二世（约1137—1188）出生于托莱多，是莱昂与卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索七世较年幼的儿子。1157年父亲去世后，王国被瓜分，他分得莱昂和加利西亚。1158年，他与卡斯蒂利亚国王桑乔三世签订《萨阿贡条约》，约定共同进攻穆斯林领地并瓜分战果。他先与兄长桑乔三世、后又与侄子阿方索八世治下的卡斯蒂利亚交战，同时南下进攻穆瓦希德王朝：1164年夺取阿尔坎塔拉，1169年在巴达霍斯俘虏葡萄牙国王阿方索一世后取得卡塞雷斯。1170年他创立圣地亚哥骑士团，以保护前往孔波斯特拉的朝圣者；1180年在托德西利亚斯与卡斯蒂利亚议和。其子阿方索九世继位。

en: Fruela of Cantabria, also called Fruela Pérez (c. 708–c. 756), was the second son of Duke Peter of Cantabria and a younger brother of King Alfonso I of Asturias. He fought alongside Alfonso in the king's campaigns against the Muslim rulers of the Iberian Peninsula, helping to take Lugo, Tui, Porto, Braga, Viseu and Chaves in the northwest. Although he never wore a crown himself, his sons Aurelius and Bermudo I both succeeded to the Asturian throne, and his daughter married Lope, a noble of Álava.
zh: 坎塔布里亚的弗罗伊拉，又称弗罗伊拉·佩雷斯（约708—约756），是坎塔布里亚公爵佩德罗的次子、阿斯图里亚斯国王阿方索一世之弟。据《阿方索三世编年史》记载，他随阿方索出征伊比利亚半岛的穆斯林统治者，参与攻占西北部的卢戈、图伊、波尔图、布拉加、维塞乌、查韦斯诸城。他本人从未称王，但两个儿子奥勒留和贝尔穆多一世先后登上阿斯图里亚斯王位；他还有一个女儿嫁给了阿拉瓦贵族洛佩。

en: Fruela I (c. 722–768), called the Cruel, was the eldest son of Alfonso I of Asturias and Ermesinda, Pelayo's daughter, and ruled from 757. He suppressed Basque and Galician revolts, married the Basque noblewoman Munia of Álava, and defeated a Cordoban army in which Omar, son of the emir Abd al-Rahman I, was killed. In 761 the church from which Oviedo grew was founded in his reign. He murdered his popular brother Vimarano, earning his nickname, and was assassinated at Cangas de Onís in 768. His cousin Aurelius succeeded him, while his son Alfonso later ruled as Alfonso II.
zh: 弗鲁埃拉一世（约722—768），绰号“残忍者”，是阿斯图里亚斯国王阿方索一世与佩拉约之女埃尔梅辛达的长子，757年起统治阿斯图里亚斯。他镇压了巴斯克和加利西亚的起义，娶巴斯克贵族女子姆妮亚·德·阿拉瓦为妻，还击败一支科尔多瓦军队，埃米尔阿卜杜勒-拉赫曼一世之子奥马尔战死。761年，后来发展为奥维耶多城的教堂在他在位时建立。他杀害深得人心的弟弟比梅拉诺，因而得到“残忍者”的绰号，768年本人在都城坎加斯德奥尼斯遇刺。堂弟奥雷利欧继位，他的儿子阿方索后来成为阿方索二世。

en: Fruela II (c. 874–925), youngest son of Alfonso III of Asturias, received Asturias when he and his brothers deposed their father and divided the kingdom in 910. García took León and Ordoño took Galicia; Fruela's diminished kingdom remained subordinate to León. He consolidated the region later called Castile and kept its counts in check, while acknowledging the hegemony of his brother Ordoño II of León. When Ordoño died in 924 the magnates ignored Ordoño's young sons and elected Fruela king of León. He alienated the nobles by killing Gebuldo and Aresindo, sons of Olmundo, and after only fourteen months died of leprosy in August 925. His death opened a succession war between his sons and Ordoño's.
zh: 弗鲁埃拉二世（约874—925）是阿斯图里亚斯国王阿方索三世的幼子。910年，他与兄弟废黜父王并瓜分王国，他得到阿斯图里亚斯，加西亚得到莱昂，奥多尼奥得到加利西亚；弗鲁埃拉缩小了的王国仍从属于莱昂。他巩固了后来称为卡斯蒂利亚的地区，压制当地伯爵，同时承认兄长莱昂国王奥多尼奥二世的宗主地位。924年奥多尼奥去世，权贵们撇开奥多尼奥年幼的儿子，推举弗鲁埃拉为莱昂国王。他杀害奥尔蒙多之子赫武尔多和阿雷辛多，招致贵族怨恨；在位仅十四个月，便于925年8月死于麻风病。他死后，他的儿子与奥多尼奥的儿子之间爆发继承战争。

en: García I (c. 871–914), eldest son of Alfonso III of Asturias and Queen Jimena, ruled León from 910 until his death. Implicated in a court conspiracy in 909, he saw Alfonso abdicate and divide the realm among his three sons: García received León, Ordoño Galicia and Fruela Asturias. He fortified the line of the Duero and resettled Roa, Osma, Clunia and San Esteban de Gormaz, while Count Gonzalo Fernández of Castile rose in power. García died at Zamora in 914 without an heir, and León passed to his brother Ordoño II.
zh: 加西亚一世（约871—914）是阿斯图里亚斯的阿方索三世与王后希梅娜的长子，910年起统治莱昂，直到去世。909年他卷入一场宫廷阴谋，阿方索随后退位，把王国分给三个儿子：加西亚得到莱昂，奥多尼奥得到加利西亚，弗罗伊拉得到阿斯图里亚斯。他在杜罗河一线修筑防御，向罗阿、奥斯马、克鲁尼亚和圣埃斯特万-德戈马斯重新移民，卡斯蒂利亚伯爵贡萨洛·费尔南德斯则乘机壮大。914年加西亚在萨莫拉去世，未留下继承人，莱昂传给弟弟奥多尼奥二世。

en: Mauregatus, known as the Usurper, was an illegitimate son of Alfonso I of Asturias, said to be born to a Moorish servant woman. When King Silo died in 783, the nobility elected the young Alfonso II at the urging of Silo's widow Adosinda. Mauregatus gathered an army of supporters, seized the throne and drove Alfonso II into exile in Álava. Folk tradition links him with the apocryphal Tribute of the Hundred Maidens paid to the Moors. He ruled until his natural death in 789 and was buried at Pravia, where Bermudo I succeeded him.
zh: 毛雷加图斯，绰号“篡位者”，是阿斯图里亚斯国王阿方索一世的私生子，相传生母是一名摩尔人侍女。783年国王希罗去世后，贵族们在希罗的遗孀阿多辛达推动下拥立年轻的阿方索二世。毛雷加图斯纠集支持者起兵，夺取王位，将阿方索二世赶到阿拉瓦流亡。民间传说把他与向摩尔人进贡百名少女的“百名贞女贡”附会在一起。他统治到789年自然死亡，葬于普拉维亚，贝尔穆多一世继位。

en: Ordoño I (c. 821–866), son of Ramiro I, was born in Oviedo and governed Galicia for his father before succeeding him in 850 as the first Asturian king to take the crown without election. He put down a Basque rebellion backed by the Banu Qasi of Zaragoza. On his return he defeated a Moorish army near the Ebro before it could attack Bardulia. Against the warlord Musa ibn Musa he divided his forces, sending one part to besiege Albelda and the other against Musa at Monte Laturce; Musa's army was routed and he himself barely escaped. Ordoño repopulated Tui, Astorga, León and Amaya. He died of gout at Oviedo on 27 May 866, leaving the throne to his son Alfonso III.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/奧多尼奧一世_(阿斯圖里亞斯)
zh: 奥多尼奥一世（约821—866）是拉米罗一世之子，生于奥维耶多，曾代父亲治理加利西亚，850年继位为阿斯图里亚斯国王，是第一位未经选举便登基的阿斯图里亚斯君主。他镇压了得到萨拉戈萨的巴努·卡西家族支持的巴斯克人叛乱。返程时，他在埃布罗河附近击败了一支准备进攻巴尔杜利亚的摩尔军队。对阵军阀穆萨·伊本·穆萨时，他分兵围攻阿尔韦尔达，并在拉图尔塞山迎战穆萨；穆萨的大军被击溃，他本人仅以身免。奥多尼奥重新向图伊、阿斯托尔加、莱昂和阿马亚移民。866年5月27日，他因痛风在奥维耶多去世，王位传给儿子阿方索三世。

en: Ordoño II (c. 873–924), second son of Alfonso III of Asturias, was educated at the Banu Qasi court in Zaragoza. He received Galicia when his father's kingdom was divided among three brothers in 910. In 914, after his brother García died childless at Zamora, he inherited León and made the city his royal seat. He sacked Mérida and Évora, forcing the Muslim governor to buy his retreat. Allied with Sancho I of Pamplona, he routed the Muslims at San Esteban de Gormaz in 917 and took Arnedo and Calahorra in 918. In 920 the emir Abd-ar-Rahman III defeated him at Valdejunquera and captured the bishops of Tui and Salamanca. Ordoño died at León in June 924.
zh: 奥多尼奥二世（约873—924）是阿斯图里亚斯国王阿方索三世的次子，曾在萨拉戈萨的巴努卡西家族宫廷受教育。910年父王的王国分给三兄弟，他得到加利西亚。914年兄长加西亚在萨莫拉无嗣而终，他继承莱昂，并以莱昂城为王都。他洗劫梅里达和埃武拉，迫使穆斯林总督出钱换取他撤军。他与潘普洛纳国王桑乔一世结盟，917年在圣埃斯特班-德戈麦斯击溃穆斯林，918年夺取阿尔内多和卡拉奥拉。920年，科尔多瓦埃米尔阿卜杜-拉赫曼三世在瓦德洪克拉击败他，俘虏图伊和萨拉曼卡的主教。奥多尼奥于924年6月在莱昂去世。

en: Ordoño III (c. 926–956), eldest son of Ramiro II, succeeded his father as king of León in 951. He sought to continue his father's work of fortifying the land and royal authority against the separatist Castilian count Fernán González. His throne was disputed by his half-brother Sancho the Fat, backed by Navarre and Fernán, and he also faced a Galician rebellion and attacks from Muslim al-Andalus. In 955 he raided as far as Lisbon and returned with rich plunder, forcing the caliph Abd al-Rahman III to conclude a peace treaty. He married Fernán's daughter Urraca and later repudiated her over her father's alliance with Sancho. Ordoño died at Zamora in 956, leaving a son, the future king Bermudo II.
zh: 奥多尼奥三世（约926—956）是拉米罗二世的长子，951年继位为莱昂国王。他试图延续父亲的政策，巩固国土和王权，对抗谋求分离的卡斯蒂利亚伯爵费尔南·冈萨雷斯。他的王位遭到异母弟“胖子”桑乔争夺，桑乔得到纳瓦拉和费尔南支持；他还要应对加利西亚叛乱和穆斯林安达卢斯的进攻。955年他远征至里斯本，带回大量战利品，迫使哈里发阿卜杜勒-拉赫曼三世签订和约。他娶费尔南之女乌拉卡为妻，后来因其父与桑乔结盟而将她休弃。奥多尼奥于956年在萨莫拉去世，留下儿子、后来的国王贝尔穆多二世。

en: Ordoño IV (c. 926–c. 963), called the Bad, was the son of Alfonso IV of León and Onneca Sánchez of Pamplona. In 958 Leonese, Galician and Castilian nobles, weary of the obese Sancho I, rebelled and placed Ordoño on the throne with the backing of his father-in-law, Count Fernán González of Castile, whose daughter Urraca he married. In 960 a Navarrese and Córdoban alliance restored Sancho, and Ordoño fled, abandoning his wife at Burgos and losing Fernán's support. He reached the caliph's court in Córdoba through Medinaceli and sought aid, but Sancho also offered to submit to the caliph. Ordoño died in exile around 963, still dethroned.
zh: 奥多尼奥四世（约926—约963），人称“坏人”，是莱昂国王阿方索四世与潘普洛纳的欧妮卡之子。958年，厌恶肥胖的桑乔一世的莱昂、加利西亚和卡斯蒂利亚贵族起兵，在他的岳父、卡斯蒂利亚伯爵费尔南·冈萨雷斯支持下将他扶上王位；他娶了伯爵之女乌拉卡。960年，纳瓦拉与科尔多瓦的联军助桑乔复位，奥多尼奥出逃，在布尔戈斯抛弃妻子，失去了费尔南的支持。他经梅迪纳塞利到科尔多瓦的哈里发宫廷求助，桑乔也向哈里发表示臣服。奥多尼奥约963年死在流亡地，至死未能复位。

en: Peter (died 730) was the Visigothic duke of Cantabria at the time of the Muslim conquest of Spain, said by the Chronicle of Alfonso III to descend from kings Liuvigild and Reccared I. When Musa ibn Nusair sacked Amaya in 714, he led his people into the northern mountains. He backed Pelayo of Asturias's revolt and may have sent his son Alfonso to Pelayo's court after Covadonga. Alfonso married Pelayo's daughter Ermesinda, uniting Cantabria with Asturias, and later reigned as King Alfonso I. Peter was also father of Fruela of Cantabria and grandfather of Kings Aurelius and Bermudo I.
zh: 佩德罗（卒于730年）是穆斯林征服西班牙时期的坎塔布里亚公爵，出身西哥特贵族；《阿方索三世编年史》称他是西哥特国王柳维吉尔德与雷卡雷德一世的后裔。714年穆萨·伊本·努赛尔洗劫阿马亚时，他率部众退入北部山区。他支持阿斯图里亚斯的佩拉约起事，可能在科瓦东加之战后把儿子阿方索送到佩拉约宫廷。阿方索娶佩拉约之女埃尔梅辛达，使坎塔布里亚与阿斯图里亚斯合为一体，后来成为国王阿方索一世。佩德罗还是坎塔布里亚的弗罗伊拉之父、国王奥勒留与贝尔穆多一世的祖父。

en: Pelagius (Pelayo, c. 685–737) was a nobleman in the Asturias, whom the chronicles call the son of the Galician duke Favila and an exile from Toledo under Wittiza. His origins remain disputed, and the chronicles recording them were written long after his death. After the Arab conquest of 711 he led a northern rebellion. Elected princeps by the Asturian magnates with his capital at Cangas de Onís, he founded the Kingdom of Asturias in 718. At Covadonga, c. 722, his small force defeated and killed the Muslim commander Alkama, later seen as opening the Reconquista. He died in 737 and was succeeded by his son Favila; his daughter Ermesinda married Alfonso I.
zh: 佩拉约（拉丁语作佩拉吉乌斯，约685—737）是阿斯图里亚斯的贵族。编年史称他是加利西亚公爵法维拉之子，曾被维提萨逐出托莱多。他的出身仍有争议，记载此事的编年史成书于他去世很久之后。711年阿拉伯人征服伊比利亚后，他在北方山区率众起义。他被阿斯图里亚斯贵族推举为首领，定都坎加斯德奥尼斯，于718年建立阿斯图里亚斯王国。约722年，他以少量兵力在科瓦东加击败穆斯林军队，阵斩其主将阿尔卡马，此战后来被视为收复失地运动的开端。737年他去世，其子法维拉继位；女儿埃尔梅辛达嫁给了阿方索一世。

en: Ramiro I (c. 790–850), son of Bermudo I, became king of Asturias in 842 after Alfonso II died without children. The Chronicle of Alfonso III records that the childless king had chosen Ramiro as his successor. While he was away marrying, the palace count Nepotian seized power with the support of Asturians and Basques loyal to Alfonso; Ramiro raised an army in Galicia, defeated him at the Bridge of Cornellana and had him blinded and confined in a monastery. In 844 he routed Vikings who landed at Corunna and burned much of their fleet. His resettlement of León failed when Córdoban forces burned the city in 846. Near Oviedo he built Santa María del Naranco, a gem of pre-Romanesque ramirense architecture. He died on 1 February 850.
zh: 拉米罗一世（约790—850）是贝尔穆多一世之子，842年无嗣的阿方索二世去世后成为阿斯图里亚斯国王。据《阿方索三世编年史》记载，阿方索二世曾选定拉米罗为继承人。他外出举行婚礼时，宫廷伯爵内波蒂安在效忠阿方索的阿斯图里亚斯人和巴斯克人支持下篡夺权力，拉米罗在加利西亚募兵，在科尔内亚纳桥之战中将其击败，随后弄瞎了他的双眼并把他关进修道院。844年，一批维京人在拉科鲁尼亚登陆，他将其击溃，并烧毁了他们的大部分船只。他试图重新移民莱昂，但846年科尔多瓦军队焚毁该城，行动告终。他在奥维耶多附近修建了纳兰科圣马利亚殿，这是前罗马式“拉米罗风格”的杰作。他于850年2月1日去世。

en: Ramiro II (c. 900–951), son of Ordoño II of León, took the crown in 931 after his brother Alfonso IV abdicated. His marriage to Urraca Sánchez secured an alliance with Pamplona. An energetic commander whom the Moors called the Devil for his ferocity, he led a León–Pamplona coalition to a decisive victory over the caliph Abd al-Rahman III at Simancas in 939, then pushed the frontier from the Duero to the Tormes and repopulated strongholds such as Osma and Clunia. In his final years he lost Pamplona's support, and Count Fernán González of Castile briefly gained de facto independence. In 950 he defeated the Cordovans again at Talavera. He died on 1 January 951, leaving sons by two wives, Ordoño III and Sancho I.
zh: 拉米罗二世（约900—951）是莱昂国王奥多尼奥二世之子。931年兄长阿方索四世退位后，他取得王位。他与乌拉卡·桑切斯联姻，取得潘普洛纳的支持。他作战勇猛，摩尔人称他为“魔鬼”。939年，他率领莱昂与纳瓦拉联军在西曼卡斯战役决定性击败哈里发阿卜杜勒-拉赫曼三世，随后将边境从杜罗河推进到托尔梅斯河，并移民充实奥斯马、克鲁尼亚等要塞。晚年他失去潘普洛纳的支持，卡斯蒂利亚伯爵费尔南·冈萨雷斯短暂取得事实独立。950年他又在塔拉维拉击败科尔多瓦军队。他于951年1月1日去世，两任妻子留下奥多尼奥三世和桑乔一世两个儿子。

en: Ramiro III (c. 961–985), son of Sancho the Fat, succeeded his father as king of León in 966, aged five. His aunt, the nun Elvira Ramírez, first held the regency and used the title of queen, followed by his mother Teresa Ansúrez, who had entered a convent after her husband's death. His reign was marked by support for the clergy. His regents confirmed peace with the Caliph al-Hakam II, while Ramiro also faced Vikings who had invaded Galicia. He married Sancha Gómez and tried to impose absolute rule, alienating the Galician and Castilian nobility. Repeated routs by Almanzor's armies, including at San Esteban de Gormaz, led the Galicians to proclaim Bermudo II king in 982. Ramiro lost León in 984 and died on 26 June 985.
zh: 拉米罗三世（约961—985）是“胖子”桑乔之子，966年五岁时继位为莱昂国王。他的姑母、修女埃尔维拉·拉米雷斯首先摄政，使用王后称号，之后由母亲特里萨·安苏雷斯接手；特里萨在丈夫死后进入修道院。拉米罗统治时期支持教士。摄政团与哈里发哈卡姆二世确认和约，拉米罗还面临入侵加利西亚的维京人。成年后拉米罗娶桑查·戈麦斯，试图实行专制统治，导致加利西亚和卡斯蒂利亚贵族离心。曼苏尔的军队接连将他击溃，包括圣埃斯特班-德戈麦斯之败；982年加利西亚人拥立贝尔穆多二世为王，拉米罗于984年失去莱昂，985年6月26日去世。

en: Sancha of León (c. 1018–1067), daughter of King Alfonso V and Elvira Menéndez, married Ferdinand I of Castile in 1032, after her betrothed García Sánchez was killed on his way to the wedding. When Ferdinand slew her brother Bermudo III at Tamarón in 1037, Sancha's claim brought him the crown of León. Mother of Sancho II, Alfonso VI and García II, she after Ferdinand's death in 1065 strove in vain to reconcile her warring sons. She died on 8 November 1067 and was buried at León's San Isidoro, to which she and Ferdinand gave the crucifix bearing their names.
zh: 莱昂的桑查（约1018—1067）是莱昂国王阿方索五世与埃尔维拉·梅嫩德斯之女。1032年，她嫁给卡斯蒂利亚的费尔南多一世；此前她的未婚夫加西亚·桑切斯在赴婚途中被杀。1037年，费尔南多在塔马隆战役杀死她的兄长贝尔穆多三世，凭借桑查的继承权戴上莱昂王冠。她是桑乔二世、阿方索六世和加西亚二世的母亲，1065年丈夫死后曾徒劳地调解互相攻战的儿子们。1067年11月8日她去世，葬于莱昂的圣伊西多罗教堂；她与费尔南多曾向该教堂供奉以二人名字命名的十字架。

en: Sancho I (c. 932–966), called the Fat, was the son of Ramiro II of León and Urraca Sánchez of Pamplona. He took the throne after Ordoño III died in 956, but in 958 Count Fernán González and the nobles deposed him for his gross obesity and raised up Ordoño IV. Fleeing to his grandmother Toda of Pamplona, Sancho promised the caliph Abd al-Rahman III lands along the Duero. In Córdoba he received treatment from the court physician Hasdai ibn Shaprut; a Muslim and Pamplonian army took Zamora in 959 and León in 960, restoring him. He soon abandoned his agreement with the caliph, and Castilian and Galician nobles grew more independent. In 966 he was poisoned, leaving his young son Ramiro III to succeed him.
zh: 桑乔一世（约932—966），人称“胖子”，是莱昂国王拉米罗二世与潘普洛纳的乌拉卡·桑切斯之子。956年奥多尼奥三世死后他登上王位，但958年费尔南·冈萨雷斯伯爵率领贵族以他过度肥胖为由将他废黜，另立奥多尼奥四世。桑乔投奔外祖母托达，并向哈里发阿卜杜勒-拉赫曼三世许诺杜罗河沿岸的土地。他在科尔多瓦接受宫廷医生哈斯代·伊本·沙普鲁特的治疗；穆斯林与潘普洛纳联军959年攻取萨莫拉、960年攻取莱昂，助他复位。他不久便抛弃与哈里发的协议，卡斯蒂利亚和加利西亚贵族也日益独立。他于966年被毒杀，幼子拉米罗三世继位。

en: Silo ruled the kingdom of Asturias from 774 until his death in 783, winning the crown through his marriage to Adosinda, daughter of Alfonso I. He moved his court from Cangas de Onís to Pravia, where he was a landed magnate. Pravia lay in the Nalón valley on the Roman road to Astorga, closer to the centre of his kingdom. His reign saw no major fighting with the Umayyads of Córdoba, but when Galicia rebelled he defeated the rebel army at the Battle of Montecubeiro. The Diploma of King Silo, dated 23 August 775, is the oldest surviving medieval document from the Iberian Peninsula; in it he granted land to monks to found a monastery. He died at Pravia in 783.
zh: 希罗于774年至783年统治阿斯图里亚斯王国，他因娶阿方索一世之女阿多辛达而获得王位。他把宫廷从坎加斯德奥尼斯迁到自己拥有土地和势力的普拉维亚。普拉维亚位于纳隆河谷通往阿斯托尔加的罗马道路上，离王国中心更近。他在位期间没有与科尔多瓦的倭马亚人发生大规模战事，但加利西亚叛乱时，他在蒙特库贝罗战役中击败了叛军。775年8月23日的《希罗王特许状》是伊比利亚半岛现存最古老的中世纪文书；他在文书中向修士赐地，供他们建立修道院。他于783年在普拉维亚去世。

en: Theresa (c. 1080–1130) was the illegitimate daughter of Alfonso VI of León. In 1093 she married the French nobleman Henry of Burgundy, receiving the County of Portugal from her father in 1096. Widowed in 1112, she defended Coimbra and in 1116 was recognized queen by Pope Paschal II. War with her half-sister Queen Urraca ended with her capture at Lanhoso in 1121 and accepting vassalage to León, though she retained her royal title. Her alliance with the Galician nobleman Fernando Pérez de Traba helped her pursue a greater share of the Leonese inheritance. Portuguese nobles and clergy supported her son Afonso Henriques, who defeated her at São Mamede in 1128 and exiled her; she died in 1130.
zh: 特蕾莎（约1080—1130）是莱昂国王阿方索六世的私生女。1093年她嫁给法国贵族勃艮第的亨利，1096年父亲把葡萄牙伯国交给他们夫妇。1112年守寡后她坚守科英布拉，1116年被教皇帕斯加尔二世承认为女王。她与同父异母的姐姐乌拉卡女王交战，1121年在拉尼奥索被俘，被迫承认莱昂的宗主权，但保留了女王称号。她与加利西亚贵族费尔南多·佩雷斯·德·特拉瓦结盟，以争取更多莱昂遗产。葡萄牙贵族和教士支持她的儿子阿方索·恩里克斯，他于1128年在圣马梅德击败她并将其放逐。她于1130年去世。

en: Urraca (c. 1081–1126), called the Reckless, was the daughter of Alfonso VI of León and Constance of Burgundy. Her half-brother Sancho's death in battle in 1108 left her the heir. In 1109 she inherited León, Castile and Galicia, western Europe's first queen regnant. Widowed by Raymond of Burgundy, she married Alfonso I of Aragon at Monzón late in 1109. His abuse drove her away by 1110; her lover Gómez González fell at Candespina in 1111 and the marriage was annulled in 1112. War with Aragon, rebel Galicia and her half-sister Theresa followed. She died at Saldaña on 8 March 1126, and her son by Raymond, Alfonso VII, succeeded her.
zh: 乌拉卡（约1081—1126），绰号“鲁莽者”，是莱昂国王阿方索六世与勃艮第的康斯坦丝之女。1108年同父异母弟弟桑乔战死后，她成为继承人。1109年她继承莱昂、卡斯蒂利亚和加利西亚，是西欧第一位以自身身份执政的女王。第一任丈夫勃艮第的雷蒙死后，她于1109年底在蒙松嫁给阿拉贡国王阿方索一世。丈夫的虐待迫使她在1110年前离开；她的情人戈麦斯·冈萨雷斯1111年战死于坎德斯皮纳，婚姻于1112年废除。此后她与阿拉贡、叛乱的加利西亚以及同父异母的妹妹特蕾莎连年交战。1126年3月8日她在萨尔达尼亚去世，她与雷蒙所生的儿子阿方索七世继位。

en: Diederik of Heinsberg (1300–1361), lord of Heinsberg on the Lower Rhine, was the son of Matilda, daughter of Count Arnold V of Loon. When his uncle Louis IV died childless in 1336, Diederik claimed the counties of Loon and Chiny. An 1190 pact promised Loon to Liège, but his brother-in-law Prince-Bishop Adolph of La Marck secured him the counties, and a later bishop, Engelbert III, lifted the threat of excommunication against him. He ruled until his death at Stokkem in January 1361, which opened the War of the Loon Succession.
zh: 海因斯贝格的迪德里克（1300—1361）是下莱茵海因斯贝格的领主，母亲为洛恩伯爵阿诺德五世之女玛蒂尔德。1336年其舅路易四世无嗣而终，迪德里克遂主张继承洛恩与希尼两伯国。1190年的协约本已规定洛恩应并入列日教会，但他的内兄、列日采邑主教阿道夫·冯·德马克力保他得到两伯国，继任主教恩格尔贝特三世还解除了对他施以绝罚的威胁。他统治至1361年1月在斯托克姆去世，其死引发了洛恩继承战争。

en: Kunigunde of the Mark (c. 1293–1343) was a daughter of Count Eberhard I of the Mark and a sister of Adolph of La Marck, Prince-Bishop of Liège. She married Diederik of Heinsberg, Count of Loon and Chiny.
zh: 德马克的库妮贡德（约1293—1343）是马克伯爵埃伯哈德一世之女、列日采邑主教阿道夫·冯·德马克之妹。她嫁给洛恩与希尼伯爵海因斯贝格的迪德里克。

en: Adalbert (c. 1000–1048) was the eldest son of Gerhard, Count of Metz, and Gisela. When Godfrey of Upper Lorraine rebelled against Emperor Henry III after being refused Lower Lorraine in 1044, Godfrey was defeated and in 1047 the emperor installed Adalbert as duke of Upper Lorraine in his place. Godfrey continued the war, however, and on 11 November 1048 Adalbert was killed fighting him at the Battle of Thuin. He left no son, and Henry III at once named his brother Gerhard duke in his stead.
zh: 阿达尔贝尔（约1000—1048）是梅斯伯爵格哈德与吉塞拉的长子。1044年，上洛林的戈德弗鲁瓦因皇帝亨利三世拒绝把下洛林封给自己而起兵反叛，兵败后，皇帝于1047年改封阿达尔贝尔为上洛林公爵。但戈德弗鲁瓦继续作战，1048年11月11日，阿达尔贝尔在蒂安战役中与他交战时阵亡。他没有儿子，亨利三世随即任命其弟格拉尔继任公爵。

en: Elisabeth of Austria (c. 1285–1352), known in Lorraine as Isabelle, was the tenth of twelve children of King Albert I of Germany and sister of Frederick the Fair. Her father meant to tie the Habsburgs to France by betrothing her to a son of Philip IV, but the match was cancelled after her brother Rudolph married a French princess in 1300. A marriage contract with Frederick IV of Lorraine followed in 1306, and they married in 1307, which put Lorraine behind her brother's claim to the empire. At Mühldorf in 1322 her husband was captured fighting for him, and the French king secured his release. Widowed in 1328, she became regent of Lorraine for her young son Rudolph, until his marriage to Eleanor of Bar gave the regency to Eleanor's father, Edward I of Bar. Of her six children only Rudolph and Margaret grew up. She died at Nancy on 19 May 1352 and was buried at Königsfelden.
zh: 奥地利的伊丽莎白（约1285—1352），在洛林称伊莎贝尔，是德意志国王阿尔布雷希特一世十二个子女中的第十个，“美男子”腓特烈之妹。父亲本想借她与法王腓力四世一位儿子的婚约把哈布斯堡与法国拴在一起，但1300年她的兄长鲁道夫迎娶法国公主后，婚约被取消。她于1306年与洛林公爵费里四世订立婚约，1307年成婚，洛林由此站到她兄弟的帝位宣称一边。1322年，丈夫在米尔多夫战役中为他作战被俘，后经法王斡旋获释。1328年守寡后，她为幼子拉乌尔摄政洛林，直到拉乌尔娶巴尔的埃莱奥诺尔，摄政之位转归埃莱奥诺尔之父爱德华一世。她的六个子女中只有拉乌尔和玛格丽特长大成人。她于1352年5月19日在南锡去世，葬于克尼格斯费尔登修道院。

en: Frederick I, called Ferry (c. 1143–1206), was the second son of Matthias I and Judith of Swabia. Favoured by his mother for the succession, he received Bitche from his elder brother Simon II in 1176, but revolted against him. After three years of war, the Treaty of Ribemont in 1179 gave him the German-speaking northern half of Lorraine, while Simon kept the south. When Simon abdicated to a monastery in 1205, he named Frederick's son as heir. Frederick nevertheless inherited the whole duchy, but ruled barely a year before dying on 7 April 1206. By Ludmilla, daughter of Mieszko III of Poland, he was succeeded by his son Frederick II.
zh: 费里一世（约1143—1206），德语称腓特烈，是马修一世公爵与士瓦本的朱迪思的次子。母亲有意让他继位，他于1176年从兄长西蒙二世处得到比奇，随后起兵反对兄长。三年战争后，依1179年的《里布蒙条约》，他取得洛林北部德语区，西蒙保有南部。1205年西蒙退位进入修道院，指定费里之子为继承人，费里却继承了整个公国，但在位仅约一年，便于1206年4月7日去世。他娶波兰梅什科三世之女卢德米拉，继承人是儿子费里二世。

en: Frederick II (c. 1165–1213), son of Frederick I and Ludmilla of Poland, reunited Lorraine in 1205–1206, when his uncle Simon II abdicated, naming him heir, and his father died, ending the division made at Ribemont in 1179. His 1188 marriage to Agnes of Bar brought Amance, Longwy and Stenay, but he joined the bishop of Metz against her father, Count Theobald I. The count seized Prény, and Frederick was captured in February 1208 and held seven months. In the German succession he backed Philip of Swabia, then Otto IV, then Frederick of Hohenstaufen. He defeated the Alsatian lord Hartung of Wangen and signed a treaty at Rosheim in August 1213 and died on 10 October.
zh: 费里二世（约1165—1213）是费里一世与波兰的卢德米拉之子。1205年伯父西蒙二世退位并指定他继位，1206年父亲去世，他由此重新合并1179年《里布蒙条约》造成的公国分裂。1188年他与巴尔的艾格尼丝成婚，获得阿芒斯、隆维、斯特奈三地，但他联合梅斯主教与岳父蒂博伯爵交战。伯爵夺取普雷尼，费里于1208年2月兵败被俘，囚禁七个月。在德意志王位之争中，他先后投靠士瓦本的腓力、奥托四世与霍亨斯陶芬的腓特烈。1213年8月，他击败阿尔萨斯领主旺根的哈通，随后在罗斯海姆签订条约，10月10日去世。

en: Frederick III, called Ferry (1240–1303), only son of Matthias II and Catherine of Limburg, inherited Lorraine in 1251 aged eleven; his mother held the regency until 1255. That year he married Margaret of Champagne, daughter of King Theobald I of Navarre, who was also count of Champagne, tightening the duchy's ties to France. The dukes' traditional loyalty to the emperor had weakened in the first half of the century. In the disputed royal election of 1257 he backed Alfonso X of Castile against Richard of Cornwall. His quarrels with the bishops of Metz brought excommunication from Pope Clement IV in 1267 and an interdict on the duchy. He died on 31 December 1303 and was succeeded by his son Theobald.
zh: 费里三世（1240—1303）是马蒂厄二世与林堡的卡特琳的独子，1251年十一岁时继承洛林，1255年前由母亲摄政。同年他娶香槟的玛格丽特，即纳瓦拉国王兼香槟伯爵蒂博一世之女，使公国与法兰西的联系更加紧密。洛林公爵对皇帝的传统忠诚在13世纪上半叶已逐渐减弱。在1257年有争议的国王选举中，他支持卡斯蒂利亚的阿方索十世，反对康沃尔的理查。他与梅斯诸主教争执不断，1267年被教宗克雷芒四世处以绝罚，公国也遭禁罚。他于1303年12月31日去世，儿子蒂博继位。

en: Frederick IV, called the Fighter (1282–1328), succeeded his father Theobald II as Duke of Lorraine in 1312. Married to Elisabeth, daughter of Emperor Albert I, he backed his brother-in-law, the Habsburg claimant Frederick the Handsome, in his contest with Louis of Bavaria for the German crown after the disputed election of 1314. He fought beside him at the Battle of Mühldorf in 1322, where both were captured; Charles IV of France secured his release in exchange for Lorraine's neutrality in imperial affairs, strengthening its ties to France. He campaigned in Aquitaine in 1324 and in the War of Metz in 1325–1326, and was killed fighting for Philip VI at the Battle of Cassel in 1328.
zh: 费里四世，绰号“斗士”（1282—1328），1312年继其父蒂博二世为洛林公爵。他娶皇帝阿尔布雷希特一世之女伊丽莎白，支持妻子的兄弟、哈布斯堡王位争夺者“美男子”腓特烈，在1314年有争议的选举后与巴伐利亚的路易争夺德意志王位。1322年，他与腓特烈一同在米尔多夫战役中被俘；法王查理四世促成他获释，条件是洛林不介入帝国事务，此举加强了洛林与法国的联系。1324年他出征阿基坦，1325至1326年参加梅斯战争，1328年在卡塞尔战役中为腓力六世作战身亡。

en: Gerard of Alsace (c. 1030–1070), the second son of the count of Metz, received Metz and Châtenois in 1047 when his elder brother Adalbert became Duke of Upper Lorraine under Emperor Henry III. After Adalbert fell fighting the deposed duke Godfrey III the next year, Henry invested Gerard with Lorraine. Rebels imprisoned him, but Bishop Bruno of Toul, later Pope Leo IX, freed him in 1049. The emperor sent troops to help him fight the rebels, and Gerard remained loyal to the imperial dynasty. In 1053 he fought at the disastrous Battle of Civitate against the Normans. He founded the castle of Prény, the seed of Nancy, and died in 1070 suppressing a revolt.
zh: 阿尔萨斯的格拉尔（约1030—1070）是梅斯伯爵的次子，1047年兄长阿达尔贝特从皇帝亨利三世手中受封上洛林公国时，他继承了梅斯与沙特努瓦伯国。次年阿达尔贝特在与被废公爵戈弗雷三世的战斗中阵亡，皇帝遂将洛林封给格拉尔。叛乱贵族一度将他囚禁，图尔主教布鲁诺——即后来的教宗利奥九世——于1049年设法将他救出。皇帝派兵助他平叛，格拉尔始终效忠皇室。1053年，他在惨败的奇维塔特战役中与诺曼人交战。他修建了普雷尼城堡，即南锡的雏形，最终于1070年在镇压叛乱时死去。

en: Margaret of Lorraine (died 1348) was a daughter of Theobald II, Duke of Lorraine, and Isabelle de Rumigny. About 1311 she married Guy of Namur, styled count of Zeeland, and after his death married in 1313 Louis IV, Count of Looz and Chiny.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·洛林（1348年卒）是洛林公爵蒂埃博二世与吕米尼的伊莎贝尔之女。约1311年，她嫁给自称泽兰伯爵的那慕尔的居伊；居伊死后，她于1313年改嫁洛兹与希尼伯爵路易四世。

en: Margaret of Lorraine was a daughter of Duke Frederick IV of Lorraine and Elisabeth of Austria, and a sister of Duke Rudolph. She married successively Jean de Chalon, lord of Auberive, Conrad, count of Freiburg, and Ulrich IX, lord of Rappoltstein.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·洛林是洛林公爵费里四世与奥地利的伊丽莎白之女、公爵拉乌尔之妹。她先后嫁给奥伯里夫领主让·德·沙隆、弗赖堡伯爵康拉德，以及拉波尔特施泰因领主乌尔里希九世。

en: Marie de Châtillon (1323–1363) was Duchess of Lorraine by her marriage to Duke Rudolph the Valiant. She was the daughter of Guy I of Châtillon, Count of Blois, and Margaret of Valois, sister of King Philip VI of France. When Rudolph was killed at the Battle of Crécy in 1346, their young son John I inherited the duchy, and Marie served as regent until 1354, ruling jointly with Eberhard III, Count of Württemberg. In that year John II of France dispensed John from his minority, ending the regency.
zh: 沙蒂永的玛丽（1323—1363）嫁给洛林公爵“勇者”拉乌尔，成为洛林公爵夫人。她是布洛瓦伯爵居伊一世·德·沙蒂永与法王腓力六世之妹瓦卢瓦的玛格丽特之女。1346年拉乌尔在克雷西战役战死后，幼子若望一世继承公国，玛丽出任摄政，与符腾堡伯爵埃伯哈德三世共同执政，直至1354年法王约翰二世颁布豁免令，准许尚未成年的若望亲政，摄政结束。

en: Matthias I (c. 1119–1176), eldest son of Simon I, ruled Upper Lorraine from 1138, when he married Judith, daughter of Duke Frederick II of Swabia sister of Frederick Barbarossa, and niece of King Conrad III, binding his house to the Hohenstaufen. Like his forefathers, he supported the German kings and emperors, accompanying Barbarossa to his coronation in Rome by Pope Adrian IV in 1155 and serving in his wars against the papacy and the kings of France and Sicily. He enlarged the ducal demesne at the expense of the bishop of Toul while founding churches and abbeys. He died on 13 May 1176 and was buried at Clairlieu Abbey.
zh: 马修一世（约1119—1176）是西蒙一世的长子，1138年起统治上洛林。约在同年，他娶士瓦本公爵腓特烈二世之女、红胡子腓特烈的妹妹、国王康拉德三世的侄女朱迪思，使自家与霍亨斯陶芬家族结盟。他沿袭祖辈的政策，坚定支持德意志国王和皇帝，1155年随红胡子腓特烈前往罗马，参加教宗阿德里安四世为其举行的加冕礼，并在皇帝对教宗以及法兰西、西西里两国王的战争中效力。他以损害图尔主教为代价扩张公爵直领，同时也修建教堂和修道院。1176年5月13日他去世，葬于克莱尔略修道院。

en: Matthias II (c. 1193–1251), son of Frederick II and Agnes of Bar, succeeded his brother Theobald I in 1220. He first yielded Nancy to his brother's widow Gertrude of Dagsburg, wife of Theobald IV of Champagne, but it reverted at her death in 1225. He restored the alliance with the emperors, joining Frederick II on the Sixth Crusade in 1228 and helping crush his son Henry's revolt in 1235. In 1230 the count of Bar and his allies ravaged the ducal lands and took castles. Matthias failed to recover them in 1240, and war with Bar ended in peace in 1245, and in 1247 he joined the papal party against Frederick. He died on 9 February 1251. His son by Catherine of Limburg became Frederick III.
zh: 马蒂厄二世（约1193—1251）是费里二世与巴尔的艾格尼丝之子，1220年继兄长蒂埃博一世即位。他起初被迫把南锡交给守寡的嫂子格特鲁德，后者已改嫁香槟伯爵蒂博四世，但1225年格特鲁德死后南锡复归公国。他恢复了与皇帝的旧盟，1228年随腓特烈二世参加第六次十字军东征，1235年协助平定皇子亨利的叛乱。1230年巴尔伯爵及其盟友劫掠公爵领地并夺取数座城堡。马蒂厄于1240年试图收复失地未果，与巴尔的战争于1245年议和，1247年他加入教宗一派反对腓特烈。1251年2月9日他去世，他与林堡的卡特琳所生之子继位，即费里三世。

en: Rudolph, called the Valiant (1320–1346), became Duke of Lorraine as a boy in 1328, under the regency of his Habsburg mother Elisabeth of Austria until 1334. He grew into a warrior prince who fought in four separate wars, in Lorraine, France, Brittany and Iberia. In 1337 Count Henry IV of Bar refused to do homage for several lordships; Rudolph sacked Pont-à-Mousson and ravaged the Barrois until Philip VI stepped in. Lorraine's ties to France were already strong and grew stronger under him: his second wife, Marie of Blois, was the king's niece. In 1340 he sent troops to help raise the Siege of Tournai, then joined Alfonso XI of Castile against the Moors of Granada and distinguished himself at the Battle of Gibraltar in November. He backed his brother-in-law Charles of Brittany in the War of the Breton Succession, and was killed beside Philip VI at Crécy in 1346, leaving the duchy to his infant son John I.
zh: 拉乌尔，绰号“勇者”（1320—1346），1328年幼年继位为洛林公爵，由出身哈布斯堡家族的母亲奥地利的伊丽莎白摄政至1334年。他长成了一位好战的亲王，先后卷入洛林、法国、布列塔尼和伊比利亚的四场战争。1337年，巴尔伯爵亨利四世拒绝为几处领地向他效忠，拉乌尔劫掠蓬塔穆松并蹂躏巴鲁瓦，直到腓力六世出面才平息。洛林与法国本已关系紧密，在他手里更进一步：他的第二任妻子布卢瓦的玛丽是国王的外甥女。1340年，他派兵协助解除英军对图尔奈的围攻，随后投奔卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十一世，攻打格拉纳达的摩尔人，11月在直布罗陀战役中表现出众。他在布列塔尼继承战争中援助妻子的兄弟布列塔尼的查理，1346年在克雷西与腓力六世并肩作战时阵亡，年幼的儿子约翰一世继承了公国。

en: Simon I (1076–1139) ruled Upper Lorraine from 1115, succeeding his father Theodoric II. Through his mother Hedwig of Formbach he was a half-brother of Emperor Lothair III, and he continued the dynasty's alliance with the emperors, accompanying Henry V to the Diet of Worms in 1122 that settled the Investiture Controversy. He clashed with the bishop of Metz and the archbishop of Trier, both allies of the count of Bar, whose family had contested his father's succession. The archbishop excommunicated him until Pope Innocent II lifted the sentence. A friend of Bernard of Clairvaux, he founded abbeys including Sturzelbronn in 1135, and was buried first at Saint-Dié and then at Sturzelbronn. He married Adelaide of Leuven and was succeeded by his son Matthias.
zh: 西蒙一世（1076—1139）于1115年继承父亲蒂埃里二世，统治上洛林。凭借生母福尔姆巴赫的海德薇格，他是皇帝洛泰尔三世的同母异父兄弟；他延续家族与皇帝的同盟，1122年随亨利五世出席沃尔姆斯议会，那次会议解决了主教叙任权之争。他与梅斯主教及特里尔大主教冲突；二人都是巴尔伯爵的盟友，巴尔家族曾争夺其父的继承权。他被处以绝罚，直至教宗英诺森二世解除。他是明谷的贝尔纳之友，修建了多座修道院，包括1135年的斯图策尔布龙修道院，身后先葬于圣迪耶，后迁葬于此。他娶勒芬的阿德莱德，儿子马蒂亚斯继位。

en: Simon II (1140–1207) succeeded his father Matthias I as Duke of Upper Lorraine in 1176. His mother favoured his younger brother Frederick, so Simon had an assembly of nobles confirm him and concede feudal privileges, creating the Estates of Lorraine. Frederick, granted Bitche as an appanage, still revolted; after three years the Treaty of Ribemont split the duchy, leaving Simon the French-speaking south and Frederick the German-speaking north. His marriage to Ida, daughter of the count of Mâcon and Vienne, was childless. He named his nephew Frederick as his heir, although his brother ultimately succeeded him. In 1202 he ceded rights over Vaudémont to the count of Bar, abdicated to a monastery in 1205, dying on 4 January 1207.
zh: 西蒙二世（1140—1207）于1176年继承父亲马修一世的上洛林公爵之位。母亲偏爱弟弟腓特烈，西蒙只得召集贵族会议确认其统治，并承认若干封建特权，由此设立洛林三级会议。他把比奇封给腓特烈作封地，后者仍起兵反叛；三年战争后，《里布蒙条约》将公国一分为二，西蒙保有南部法语区，腓特烈取得北部德语区。他与马孔及维埃纳伯爵之女伊达婚后无嗣。他指定侄子腓特烈为继承人，但最终由弟弟继位。1202年他把对沃代蒙的宗主权让给巴尔伯爵，1205年退位进入修道院，1207年1月4日去世。

en: Theobald I (c. 1191–1220), son of Frederick II and Agnes of Bar, ruled Lorraine from 1213. He stood by Emperor Otto IV and was captured at Bouvines on 27 July 1214, but soon released. From 1216 he backed Erard of Brienne's claim to Champagne on behalf of Philippa of Champagne; Emperor Frederick II and the armies of Champagne, Burgundy and Bar invaded, burned Nancy and besieged him at Amance, where he surrendered by treaty on 1 June 1218 and gave up his support for Erard. He died on 17 February 1220, amid rumours of poison. Childless by his wife Gertrude of Dagsburg, he was succeeded by his brother Matthias II.
zh: 蒂埃博一世（约1191—1220）是费里二世与巴尔的艾格尼丝之子，1213年成为洛林公爵。他支持皇帝奥托四世，1214年7月27日在布汶战役中被俘，但很快获释。1216年起，他支持布里耶讷的埃拉尔代表香槟的菲利帕提出的继承要求；皇帝腓特烈二世会同香槟、勃艮第和巴尔的军队入侵，焚毁南锡并把他围困在阿芒斯，他于1218年6月1日订约投降，放弃支持埃拉尔。1220年2月17日他去世，有被毒杀的传言。妻子达格斯堡的格特鲁德没有子嗣，弟弟马修二世继位。

en: Theobald II (1263–1312) succeeded his father Frederick III as Duke of Lorraine in 1303. In 1298 he fought for Albert of Habsburg at Göllheim against King Adolf of Germany. Allied with Philip IV of France, he and his son Frederick fought at the Battle of the Golden Spurs near Kortrijk in 1302, where the Flemings defeated the French knights. He served at Mons-en-Pévèle in 1304, then joined the Duke of Brabant and the Count of Savoy in negotiating peace with Flanders. In 1305 he attended the coronation of Pope Clement V at Lyon and collected the papal tenth despite resistance from the bishop of Metz. In 1278 he married Isabelle de Rumigny; their son Frederick IV succeeded him.
zh: 蒂博二世（1263—1312）于1303年继其父费里三世出任洛林公爵。1298年，他在格尔海姆支持哈布斯堡的阿尔布雷希特，同德意志国王阿道夫作战。他与法王腓力四世结盟，1302年与儿子费里参加科特赖克附近的金马刺战役，佛兰德人在此击败法国骑士。1304年他参加蒙桑佩韦勒战役，随后与布拉班特公爵和萨伏依伯爵共同参与同佛兰德的和谈。1305年，他出席教皇克雷芒五世在里昂的加冕礼，并顶着梅斯主教的抵制为教皇征收什一税。1278年他娶吕米尼的伊莎贝尔，其子费里四世继位。

en: Theodoric II the Valiant (died 1115) succeeded his father Gerard as Duke of Upper Lorraine in 1070. Louis, husband of Sophia of Bar, contested the succession, but Theodoric won election by the nobles, granted the County of Vaudémont to his brother to bind his family, and was confirmed by Emperor Henry IV. After Louis died, his son Theodoric of Bar continued the claim. The duke remained loyal to the emperors, campaigning against the Saxons between 1070 and 1078 and opposing Popes Gregory VII and Urban II. In 1095 he took the cross for the First Crusade but withdrew through ill health, sending his vassals east instead. Afterward he took little part in imperial affairs. He died on 30 December 1115.
zh: “勇者”蒂埃里二世（？—1115）于1070年继承父亲格拉尔的上洛林公爵之位。巴尔的索菲亚的丈夫路易争夺继承权，但蒂埃里赢得贵族推举，将沃代蒙伯国封给弟弟以维系家族，并得到皇帝亨利四世的确认。路易死后，其子巴尔的蒂埃里继续争夺继承权。公爵始终效忠皇帝，1070至1078年间参加对萨克森人的战争，并与教宗格列高利七世、乌尔班二世为敌。1095年他领取十字标志参加第一次十字军东征，却因健康恶化退出，改派封臣东行。此后他很少参与帝国事务，于1115年12月30日去世。

en: Adelaide of Waldeck (c. 1264 – c. 1339–1342) was a daughter of Henry III, Count of Waldeck, and Matilda of Arnsberg-Cuyk. On 24 November 1276 she married Simon I, Lord of Lippe, and bore him at least eleven children. Her sons included Bernard, bishop of Paderborn from 1321, and Otto and Bernard V, who divided Lippe between them on Simon's death in 1344 and ruled at Lemgo and Rheda.
zh: 瓦尔德克的阿德莱德（约1264—约1339/1342）是瓦尔德克伯爵海因里希三世与阿恩斯贝格-屈伊克的玛蒂尔德之女。1276年11月24日，她嫁给利珀领主西蒙一世，至少育有十一个子女。诸子中，伯恩哈德于1321年成为帕德博恩主教；1344年西蒙去世后，奥托与伯恩哈德五世瓜分利珀，分别在伦戈和雷达统治。

en: Bernard IV (c. 1230–June 1275) was ruling Lord of Lippe, eldest son of Bernard III and Sophie of Cuijck-Arnsberg. In 1254 he took charge of Rheda and in 1265 succeeded his father in Lippe, while his brother Herman III received Lippstadt. In 1267 he and his uncle Simon I, bishop of Paderborn, fought the Duchy of Jülich at Zülpich, where Simon was captured; Bernard ransomed him in 1269, saddling his house with debt. He acted as regent of Ravensberg and was buried at Marienfeld Abbey after his death in 1275, leaving a son, Simon I, by Agnes of Cleves.
zh: 伯恩哈德四世（约1230—1275年6月）是利珀领主，伯恩哈德三世与克伊克-阿恩斯贝格的索菲之长子。1254年他开始掌管雷达，1265年继承父亲的利珀领主之位，其弟赫尔曼三世分得利普施塔特。1267年，他与叔父帕德博恩主教西蒙一世在曲尔皮希同于利希公国作战，西蒙兵败被俘；1269年伯恩哈德借巨款将他赎回，使家族背上沉重债务。他还曾担任拉文斯贝格摄政，1275年去世后葬于马林费尔德修道院，与克莱沃的阿格尼丝生有继承人西蒙一世。

en: Otto, Lord of Lippe (c. 1300 – c. 1360), was a son of Simon I and Adelaide of Waldeck. On his father's death in 1344 the lordship was divided: Otto received Lemgo, Detmold and the Falkenburg, while his brother Bernard V took Rheda and Lippstadt. Otto ruled his share as Lord of Lippe-Lemgo until his death, residing in Lemgo, which then consisted of separate old and new towns amalgamated only in 1365. He married Irmgard of the Marck, daughter of Count Engelbert II of the Mark, and their son Simon III was born about 1340.
zh: 利珀领主奥托（约1300—约1360）是西蒙一世与瓦尔德克的阿德莱德之子。1344年父亲去世后，利珀领地被瓜分：奥托得到伦戈、代特莫尔德和法尔肯堡，其兄弟伯恩哈德五世分得雷达与利普施塔特。奥托以利珀-伦戈领主的身份统治自己的那份领地，直至去世；他驻跸的伦戈当时还分为彼此独立的老城和新城，直到1365年才合并。他娶马克伯爵恩格尔贝特二世之女伊尔姆加德·冯·德·马克为妻，儿子西蒙三世约生于1340年。

en: Simon I, Lord of Lippe (c. 1261–1344), ruled Lippe from 1275, succeeding his father Bernard IV. In 1302 a coalition of the bishops of Münster, Osnabrück and Paderborn, the Count of Ravensberg and Herford city took Enger Castle and held him captive for eighteen months in Osnabrück, releasing him only on condition he raze it. In 1323 he acquired Varenholz Castle and high justice over Langenholzhausen, and during his reign Lippe reached its greatest extent. Married to Adelaide of Waldeck, he died in 1344, whereupon his sons Otto and Bernard V divided the lordship between Lemgo and Rheda.
zh: 利珀领主西蒙一世（约1261—1344）于1275年继承父亲伯恩哈德四世的领地，统治利珀直至去世。1302年，明斯特、奥斯纳布吕克和帕德博恩三地主教联合拉文斯贝格伯爵与黑尔福德城攻下恩格城堡，将他囚禁在奥斯纳布吕克达十八个月，直到他答应拆毁城堡才获释。1323年，他取得法伦霍尔茨城堡及对朗根霍尔茨豪森的高级裁判权；在他治下，利珀的疆域达到最大。他娶瓦尔德克的阿德莱德为妻，1344年去世后，诸子奥托与伯恩哈德五世将领地瓜分，分别以伦戈和雷达为中心统治。

en: Jean de Rossillon, a noble cleric from the pays de Gex, served the Count of Savoy as judge of the Chablais-Genevois bailliage from 1297. After becoming canon of Lausanne and dean of Allinges, he was elected bishop of Lausanne in 1323, and Pope John XXII confirmed the election that October. As prince-bishop he fought the sons of Savoyard bailli Aymon III de Montagny, secured recognition of episcopal rights at Avenches in 1339, and in the Laupen war sided with Fribourg against Bern. He probably died on 15 April 1341 and was buried in Lausanne Cathedral.
zh: 让·德·罗西永出身热克斯地区的贵族教士家庭，1297年起任萨伏依伯爵的沙布莱-日内瓦执行官区法官。他后来成为洛桑大教堂参事、阿兰日总铎，1323年被选为洛桑主教，教皇约翰二十二世于当年10月确认选举。任采邑主教期间，他与萨伏依执行官艾蒙三世·德·蒙塔尼之子交战，1339年在阿旺什使主教权利获得承认，又在劳彭战争中支持弗里堡、对抗伯尔尼。他可能于1341年4月15日去世，葬于洛桑圣母大教堂。

en: Othon de Champvent (died 19 April 1312) was prince-bishop of Lausanne from 1309. He came from the Champvent lords, a cadet branch of Grandson southwest of Lake Neuchâtel, and was a son of Henri, seigneur de Champvent and brother of Bishop Guillaume. His cousin Othon I of Grandson helped his career, notably at Henry III's English court, where he appears to have been from 1259; he held prebends in England and France and is recorded as a Lausanne canon in 1282. Already an old man, he was raised to the see by Pope Clement V in 1309, and in 1311 renewed his church's truce with Louis II of Savoy, baron of Vaud.
zh: 奥东·德·尚旺（1312年4月19日卒）自1309年起任洛桑采邑主教。他出身尚旺领主家族，即格朗松家族在纳沙泰尔湖西南的支系，是尚旺领主亨利之子、洛桑主教纪尧姆之弟。他的堂兄格朗松的奥东一世帮助他发展事业，尤其是在英格兰亨利三世的宫廷，他似乎从1259年起就在那里；他在英格兰和法兰西都领有教士俸禄，1282年已有记载称他任洛桑大教堂参事。年事已高时，教皇克雷芒五世于1309年将他擢升为主教；1311年，他与沃男爵萨伏依的路易二世续订教会和约。

en: Pierre d'Oron (died 27 March 1323) was prince-bishop of Lausanne from 1313. Born to a Valais ministerial family serving the abbots of Saint-Maurice-d'Agaune, son of Vevey's co-lord, he first appears in 1298 as a canon of Toul and was treasurer of Lausanne when a revolt broke out during the episcopal vacancy of 1313. Pope Clement V appointed him bishop on 1 October 1313 after he helped restore order, and he created the office of episcopal bailli. In 1316 he fought Louis II of Vaud, who seized Gourze and Villarzel, before accepting Count Amadeus V of Savoy's mediation and protection.
zh: 皮埃尔·德·奥龙（1323年3月27日卒）自1313年起任洛桑采邑主教。他出身瓦莱、世代为圣莫里斯达戈讷修道院院长效劳的侍臣家族，是沃韦共领领主之子，1298年首次见于记载，时任图勒的咏礼司铎；1313年主教空缺、洛桑爆发叛乱时他正担任教会司库，协助恢复秩序，教皇克雷芒五世遂于当年10月1日任命他为主教。他创设了主教执行官一职。1316年他与沃的路易二世交战，古尔斯塔楼和维拉尔泽勒城堡相继失守，最后接受萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥五世的调停与保护。

en: Castracane di Ruggero di Castracane was a Lucchese merchant-banker of the Castracani degli Antelminelli and grandfather of Castruccio Castracani. With his brother Lutterio he inherited, shortly after mid-century, a fortune that included rural estates. His family lived in the Curtis Sancti Martini by the cathedral and participated in Lucca's iron and silver mining, documented from 1255. In his time the firm financed Lucchese spice merchants bound for North Africa in 1270 and grew into one of the great Lucchese banking houses, active in France and Flanders. His son was Gerio, father of Castruccio.
zh: 卡斯特拉卡内·迪·鲁杰罗·迪·卡斯特拉卡内是卢卡商人银行家，属卡斯特拉卡尼·德利·安泰尔米内利家族，为卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼的祖父。13世纪中叶过后不久，他与兄弟卢泰里奥共同继承一笔家产，其中包括乡间地产。他的家族住在大教堂旁的圣马丁坊，并参与卢卡的铁银矿开采，采矿活动1255年已有记载。他在世时，家族商号于1270年资助卢卡香料商人前往北非，并发展成卢卡的大银行商号之一，业务遍及法兰西与佛兰德。其子杰里奥即卡斯特鲁乔之父。

en: Castruccio Castracani degli Antelminelli (1281–1328) was a Ghibelline condottiero and lord of Lucca. Exiled by the Black Guelphs in 1300, he soldiered in Flanders for Philip IV of France and with the Visconti in Lombardy before serving Uguccione della Faggiuola of Pisa, helping to take Lucca in 1314 and win the Battle of Montecatini in 1315. Uguccione imprisoned him, but an uprising in Lucca expelled his master and freed him. Chosen lifelong lord of Lucca in 1316, he defeated the Florentines at Altopascio in 1325 and was made duke of Lucca, Pistoia, Volterra and Luni by Emperor Louis the Bavarian; he seized Pisa in 1327. He died on 3 September 1328.
zh: 卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼·德利·安泰尔米内利（1281—1328）是吉伯林派的雇佣兵首领、卢卡之主。1300年他被圭尔夫派黑党放逐，曾在佛兰德为法王腓力四世作战，又在伦巴第投奔维斯孔蒂家族，随后效力于比萨之主乌古乔内·德拉·法焦拉，参与1314年夺取卢卡，并在1315年的蒙特卡蒂尼战役中取胜。乌古乔内囚禁了他，但卢卡的起义驱逐了乌古乔内，使他重获自由。1316年他被选为卢卡终身统治者，1325年在阿尔托帕肖击败佛罗伦萨人，被皇帝巴伐利亚人路易封为卢卡、皮斯托亚、沃尔泰拉和卢尼公爵，1327年攻占比萨。他于1328年9月3日去世。

en: Gerio, also called Ruggero, di Castracane degli Antelminelli was a Lucchese merchant-banker and father of Castruccio Castracani. His firm traded across France, Flanders and England, and in 1296 it still carried a large debt to the Ricciardi company without difficulty; by 1 August that year his son Castruccio had been emancipated from him. After the murder of the Guelph Obizo degli Obizi in 1300, the Castracani were outlawed. Gerio took refuge in Ancona on business and died there in 1301.
zh: 杰里奥（又名鲁杰罗）·迪·卡斯特拉卡内·德利·安泰尔米内利是卢卡商人银行家，卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼之父。他的商号贸易遍及法兰西、佛兰德和英格兰；1296年家族虽欠下里恰尔迪公司一笔巨款，仍显得偿付无虞，到同年8月1日他的儿子卡斯特鲁乔已解除父亲的监护。1300年圭尔夫派贵族奥比佐·德利·奥比齐遇害后，卡斯特拉卡尼家被宣布为叛党并遭放逐。杰里奥因商务避居安科纳，1301年死于当地。

en: Gualtiero degli Antelminelli (c. 1271–1321), also spelled Gualterio, was a Lucchese nobleman of the Ghibelline Antelminelli. He was the son of Lutterio and father of Francesco Castracani, who bought the lordship of Lucca from Emperor Louis the Bavarian in 1329.
zh: 瓜尔蒂耶罗·德利·安泰尔米内利（约1271—1321）是卢卡吉伯林贵族安泰尔米内利家族成员，卢泰里奥之子、弗朗切斯科·卡斯特拉卡尼之父。其子弗朗切斯科于1329年从皇帝路易四世手中买下卢卡的统治权。

en: Lutterio degli Antelminelli (c. 1241–1291) was a Lucchese nobleman of the Ghibelline Antelminelli family and father of Gualtiero. His grandson Francesco Castracani degli Antelminelli briefly ruled Lucca in 1329.
zh: 卢泰里奥·德利·安泰尔米内利（约1241—1291）是卢卡吉伯林贵族安泰尔米内利家族成员，瓜尔蒂耶罗之父。他的孙子弗朗切斯科·卡斯特拉卡尼·德利·安泰尔米内利于1329年短暂统治卢卡。

en: Ruggero di Castracane was a member of the Lucchese Castracani family and the great-grandfather of Castruccio Castracani. His house appears in Lucca documents from the early thirteenth century as money changers living near San Martino cathedral, and from 1255 as participants in the city's iron and silver mining. Shortly after mid-century his sons Castracane and Lutterio inherited a fortune that included rural property.
zh: 鲁杰罗·迪·卡斯特拉卡内是卢卡卡斯特拉卡尼家族成员，卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼的曾祖父。他的家族自13世纪初便见于卢卡文献，在圣马蒂诺大教堂附近以兑换货币为业，并从1255年起参与卢卡的铁银矿开采。13世纪中叶过后不久，他的儿子卡斯特拉卡内与卢泰里奥继承了一笔家产，其中包括乡间地产。

en: Lucrezia Borgia (1480–1519) was the illegitimate daughter of Rodrigo Borgia, later Pope Alexander VI, born at Subiaco near Rome. Given a humanist education, she spoke Spanish, Valencian, Italian and French, and could read Latin and Greek. In 1493 her father married her to Giovanni Sforza of Pesaro, a marriage annulled in 1497. Her second husband, Alfonso of Aragon, Duke of Bisceglie, was murdered in 1500, reputedly on her brother Cesare's orders. In 1499 she had been appointed governor of Spoleto, the Papal States' first female governor. Her third marriage, to Alfonso I d'Este, took her to Ferrara, where she ran the duchy twice as regent, patronized the poet Ariosto, and died after childbirth in 1519.
zh: 卢克雷齐娅·波吉亚（1480—1519）是罗德里戈·波吉亚（后来的教宗亚历山大六世）的私生女，生于罗马附近的苏比亚科。她接受过人文主义教育，会说西班牙语、瓦伦西亚语、意大利语和法语，也能读拉丁语和希腊语。1493年，父亲将她嫁给佩萨罗的乔瓦尼·斯福尔扎，这桩婚姻于1497年被宣告无效。她的第二任丈夫比谢列公爵阿拉贡的阿方索于1500年遇害，据传是她的兄长切萨雷下令所为。1499年，她被任命为斯波莱托总督，是教皇国历史上第一位女性总督。第三任丈夫阿方索一世·德斯特将她带到费拉拉，她在那里两度担任摄政主政，赞助诗人阿里奥斯托，1519年因产后并发症去世。

en: Lukeni lua Nsanze was a princess of Mbata, the daughter of its ruler Nsaku Lau. Around 1375, when Mbata forged an alliance with Nimi a Nzima, ruler of Mpemba Kasi and Vungu, she was given to him in marriage. Kongo tradition presents this wedding as the founding act of the Kingdom of Kongo. Her son Lukeni lua Nimi, born around 1380, took his given name from her. He led the conquests that built the kingdom and became its first king; the rulers who followed took their name from his lineage, the Kilukeni, which held power until 1567.
zh: 卢凯尼·卢安桑泽是姆巴塔公主，姆巴塔统治者恩萨库·劳之女。约1375年，姆巴塔与姆彭巴·卡西和温古的统治者尼米·阿·恩齐马结盟，她被嫁给尼米·阿·恩齐马。刚果传统将这场婚礼视为刚果王国的奠基之举。她的儿子卢凯尼·卢阿·尼米约于1380年出生，名字取自母亲。他领导了奠定王国的征战，成为第一代刚果国王；此后的统治者皆自称出自他的基卢凯尼世系，该世系掌权直至1567年。

en: Elisabeth of Brunswick-Lüneburg (died 20 February 1386) was a daughter of Otto III, Prince of Lüneburg, and his wife Matilda of Mecklenburg; her only brother drowned in the Ilmenau as a child.
zh: 不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的伊丽莎白（1386年2月20日卒）是吕讷堡亲王奥托三世与梅克伦堡的玛蒂尔德之女；她唯一的兄弟幼年在伊尔默瑙河溺亡。

en: Elisabeth of Brunswick-Lüneburg (c. 1330 – 17 April 1384) was the daughter of William II, Prince of Lüneburg, by his first wife Hedwig of Ravensberg. She married Duke Otto of Saxe-Wittenberg, who died in 1350; their son Albert was William's chosen heir to Lüneburg, a claim that helped trigger the Lüneburg War of Succession after 1369. Around 1354 she married Count Nicholas of Holstein-Rendsburg, to whom she bore a daughter, also named Elisabeth.
zh: 不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的伊丽莎白（约1330—1384年4月17日）是吕讷堡亲王威廉二世与第一任妻子拉文斯贝格的海德维希之女。她先嫁萨克森-维滕堡公爵奥托，奥托于1350年去世；二人的儿子阿尔布雷希特被威廉选为吕讷堡继承人，这一继承权在1369年后引发了吕讷堡继承战争。约1354年，她改嫁荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡伯爵尼古拉，生下女儿伊丽莎白。

en: Hedwig of Ravensberg (c. 1318 – 5 December 1336) was the elder daughter of Count Otto IV of Ravensberg and Margaret of Berg-Windeck. Before April 1328 she married William II of Brunswick-Lüneburg, Prince of Lüneburg, and bore his daughter Elizabeth.
zh: 黑德维希·冯·拉芬斯贝格（约1318—1336年12月5日）是拉芬斯贝格伯爵奥托四世与贝格-温德克的玛格丽特的长女，1328年4月前嫁给不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵威廉二世，生女伊丽莎白。

en: Henry the Lion (1129/1131–1195), son of Henry the Proud, recovered Saxony in 1142. He helped his cousin Frederick Barbarossa win the German throne in 1152 and was restored to Bavaria in 1156. He founded Munich in 1157 and Lübeck in 1159, and in 1166 erected the bronze lion before Dankwarderode Castle in Brunswick, where he also built the collegiate church of St Blaise. In 1168 he married Matilda, daughter of Henry II of England. After he refused troops for Barbarossa's Italian war, he was stripped of both duchies in 1180 and spent years exiled in England. He died at Brunswick in 1195, leaving sons Henry, Count Palatine of the Rhine, and Emperor Otto IV.
zh: 狮子亨利（1129或1131—1195）是骄傲者亨利之子，1142年收复萨克森。他于1152年帮助表亲腓特烈·巴巴罗萨夺得德意志王位，1156年重新得到巴伐利亚。他于1157年建立慕尼黑、1159年建立吕贝克，1166年在不伦瑞克的丹克瓦德罗德城堡前竖起铜狮像，又在城内修建圣布莱修斯教堂。1168年他娶英格兰国王亨利二世之女玛蒂尔达。他拒绝为巴巴罗萨的意大利战争出兵后，于1180年被剥夺两个公国，长年流亡英格兰。他于1195年在不伦瑞克去世，留下莱茵行宫伯爵亨利和皇帝奥托四世等儿子。

en: John (c. 1242–1277) of the House of Welf ruled Brunswick-Lüneburg with his brother Albert the Tall after their father Otto the Child died in 1252. The brothers partitioned the duchy in 1267–1269: John took the northern estates around Lüneburg and Hanover, founding the Old Line of Lüneburg. The principalities remained one duchy under imperial law. In a feud with Count Gunzelin III of Schwerin he won Uelzen and granted it privileges in 1270. He tried unsuccessfully to control the Lüneburg saltworks, then gave the citizens a monopoly on the salt trade along the Old Salt Route to Lübeck. His son by Liutgard of Holstein-Itzehoe succeeded him as Otto II the Strict, under his uncles' guardianship until 1282.
zh: 约翰（约1242—1277）出身韦尔夫家族，1252年父亲“孩童”奥托去世后，与兄长“高大的”阿尔布雷希特共同统治不伦瑞克-吕讷堡。1267至1269年兄弟瓜分公国：约翰取得吕讷堡和汉诺威一带的北部领地，开创吕讷堡长系。依帝国法，两个亲王国仍属同一公国。在与什未林伯爵贡策林三世的争斗中，他夺得于尔岑，并于1270年授予其城市特权。他试图控制吕讷堡盐场却未能成功，随后把沿古盐道通往吕贝克的盐业贸易垄断权交给市民。他与荷尔斯泰因-伊策霍的柳特加德所生之子继位，即奥托二世（严厉者），由叔伯监护至1282年。

en: Marie (died by 1340) was the second wife of William II, Prince of Lüneburg. Her family is unrecorded. She bore him a daughter, Matilda, who married Louis of Brunswick-Lüneburg in 1355 and Otto I of Holstein-Schaumburg in 1368.
zh: 玛丽亚（1340年前卒）是吕讷堡亲王威廉二世的第二任妻子，家族出身无记载。她生有一女玛蒂尔德，1355年嫁给不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的路德维希，1368年改嫁荷尔斯泰因-绍姆堡的奥托一世。

en: Matilda of Brunswick-Lüneburg (died 1357) was a daughter of Otto III, Prince of Lüneburg, and Matilda of Mecklenburg. In 1339 or 1340 she married Count Otto II of Waldeck, who later claimed her father's Lüneburg inheritance. Her children included Henry VI of Waldeck.
zh: 玛蒂尔德（1357年卒）是吕讷堡亲王奥托三世与梅克伦堡的玛蒂尔德之女，1339或1340年嫁给瓦尔德克伯爵奥托二世；丈夫后来主张继承奥托三世的吕讷堡领地，二人育有继任伯爵亨利六世。

en: Matilda of Mecklenburg (1293–1358), daughter of Henry II, Lord of Mecklenburg, and Beatrix of Brandenburg, was the wife of Otto III, Prince of Lüneburg. Her daughter Matilda married Count Otto II of Waldeck; her only son Otto drowned in the Ilmenau as a child.
zh: 梅克伦堡的玛蒂尔达（1293—1358）是梅克伦堡领主海因里希二世与勃兰登堡的贝娅特丽克丝之女，嫁给吕讷堡侯爵奥托三世。女儿玛蒂尔达嫁给瓦尔德克伯爵奥托二世；独子奥托幼年在伊尔梅瑙河溺亡。

en: Matilda of Bavaria (1275 – 28 March 1319) was a Wittelsbach princess, daughter of Duke Louis II of Upper Bavaria and Matilda of Habsburg. Her brother Louis IV was elected King of the Romans in 1314 and later became Holy Roman Emperor. She married Duke Otto II of Brunswick-Lüneburg and bore him eight children, including Otto III and William II, who both ruled as princes of Lüneburg, and Louis, bishop of Minden. She died in 1319 and was buried beside her husband in St. Michael's Abbey at Lüneburg.
zh: 巴伐利亚的玛蒂尔达（1275—1319年3月28日）是维特尔斯巴赫家族的公主，上巴伐利亚公爵路易二世与哈布斯堡的玛蒂尔达之女。她的弟弟路易四世于1314年当选罗马人的国王，后来成为神圣罗马皇帝。她嫁给不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵奥托二世，生有八个子女，其中奥托三世和威廉二世先后成为吕讷堡君主，路易任明登主教。她于1319年去世，与丈夫合葬于吕讷堡的圣米迦勒修道院。

en: Otto II the Strict (c. 1266–1330) of the House of Welf was Prince of Lüneburg from 1277, ruling under the guardianship of his uncles until 1282. His reign was filled with feuds over border and property disputes, financed by pledging estates; he curbed the knights' rights and kept the public peace. He granted town rights to Dahlenburg in 1289 and Celle in 1292 and bought the County of Wölpe in 1302 for 6500 silver marks. After a disputed royal election, he allied with Louis of Bavaria, who granted him an imperial fief in 1315. That year Otto issued a law of succession for his sons Otto and William. He died in 1330 and was buried at St. Michael's monastery in Lüneburg.
zh: 奥托二世（严厉者，约1266—1330）出身韦尔夫家族，1277年起任吕讷堡亲王，因年幼由叔伯摄政至1282年。他的统治充斥着围绕边界与产业的仇争，靠抵押领地筹措费用；他限制骑士权利，维护公共和平。他于1289年和1292年先后授予达伦堡、策勒城市特权，并于1302年以6500银马克买下韦尔珀伯国。一场有争议的选王后，他与巴伐利亚的路易结盟，1315年从路易处获得帝国采邑。同年他为儿子奥托与威廉颁布继承法。1330年他去世，葬于吕讷堡的圣米迦勒修道院。

en: Otto III (c. 1296–1352) of the House of Welf, the second son of Otto the Strict and Matilda of Bavaria, was Prince of Lüneburg from 1330. His father introduced him to government as early as 1314, and in 1315 made provision for the succession of Otto and his brother William II; from 1330 the brothers ruled the undivided land together. They enlarged their estates around Gifhorn, buying the village of Fallersleben and the counties of Papenheim and Wettmarshagen. They also backed the growing towns, making the Ilmenau navigable between Lüneburg and Uelzen and concluding trade agreements with the dukes of Saxe-Lauenburg, and Lüneburg's trade flourished. The Ilmenau also took Otto's only son, who drowned in it as a child. When Otto died in 1352 he left no male heir, so William alone faced the question of who would inherit Lüneburg, a question that ended in war after William's death.
zh: 奥托三世（约1296—1352）出身韦尔夫家族，是奥托二世（严苛者）与巴伐利亚的玛蒂尔达的次子，1330年起任吕讷堡亲王。父亲早在1314年便让他参与政务，1315年又为他与弟弟威廉二世安排了继承；自1330年起兄弟二人共同统治未分割的领地。他们扩大了吉夫霍恩一带的地产，购入法勒斯莱本村及帕彭海姆、韦特马尔斯哈根两处伯国。他们还扶持成长中的城镇，疏浚伊尔梅瑙河使吕讷堡至于尔岑段通航，并与萨克森-劳恩堡公爵缔结贸易协定，吕讷堡的商业因而兴盛。伊尔梅瑙河也夺走了奥托的独子，孩子幼年溺亡于河中。1352年奥托去世，没有男性继承人，吕讷堡由谁继承的问题于是只落在威廉一人肩上，并在威廉去世后演变为战争。

en: William II (c. 1300–1369) of the House of Welf ruled the Principality of Lüneburg from 1330, jointly at first with his brother Otto III; together they expanded the estates around Gifhorn and made the Ilmenau navigable to Uelzen. After Otto died without a male heir in 1352, the succession became the problem of William's life. He promoted his grandson Albert of Saxe-Wittenberg as heir, then reconsidered, fearing the influence of Albert's uncles. In 1355 he married his younger daughter to her Brunswick cousin Ludwig, a match that would have reunited the divided Welf lands, and Welf succession agreements also favoured male heirs of the house. Emperor Charles IV, however, treated Lüneburg as an imperial fief that would fall vacant at William's death, and had already enfeoffed Albert and his uncles, laying the groundwork for the Lüneburg War of Succession. Shortly before dying at Lüneburg in November 1369, William handed rule to Magnus of Brunswick of the Wolfenbüttel line.
zh: 威廉二世（约1300—1369）出身韦尔夫家族，1330年起统治吕讷堡亲王国，起初与兄长奥托三世共同执政；二人一同扩大吉夫霍恩一带的地产，并疏浚伊尔梅瑙河使其可通航至于尔岑。1352年奥托去世且没有男性继承人，此后继承问题成了威廉一生的心病。他扶持外孙萨克森-维滕贝格的阿尔贝特为继承人，后来因担心阿尔贝特叔伯的影响而改变主意。1355年，他把小女儿嫁给不伦瑞克系的堂亲路德维希，此举本可让分裂的韦尔夫领地重归一统；韦尔夫家族的继承约定也优先考虑家族的男性继承人。然而皇帝查理四世视吕讷堡为威廉去世后将收归帝国的采邑，已将它一并封给阿尔贝特及其叔伯，为吕讷堡继承战争埋下祸根。1369年11月在吕讷堡去世前不久，威廉把政权交给沃尔芬比特尔系的不伦瑞克的马格努斯。

en: William of Winchester (1184–1213) was the youngest son of Duke Henry the Lion of Saxony and Matilda of England, born in Winchester during his father's exile. He probably grew up at his uncle King Richard I's court. In 1194 he and his brother Otto were surrendered as hostages to secure Richard's ransom. In 1199 William and his brother Henry unsuccessfully pursued their inheritance claims in England. At the 1202 partition of the Welf lands at Paderborn he received Lüneburg and made it his residence, fostering its salt trade. Earlier that year he married Helena, sister of King Canute VI of Denmark. Their only son, Otto the Child, became the first Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg in 1235.
zh: 温切斯特的威廉（1184—1213）是萨克森公爵狮子亨利与英格兰的玛蒂尔达最小的儿子，生于父亲流亡期间的温切斯特。他很可能在舅父理查一世的宫廷长大。1194年，他与兄长奥托被交为人质，以担保缴纳理查的赎金。1199年，威廉与兄长亨利赴英主张继承权，却未能成功。1202年韦尔夫家族在帕德博恩瓜分遗产，威廉分得吕讷堡一带的北部领地，以吕讷堡为驻地，并扶持当地盐业贸易。同年早些时候，他娶了丹麦国王克努特六世之妹海伦娜。独子“孩童”奥托后来于1235年成为首任不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵。

en: Beatrice of Avesnes (c. 1240–1321) was born at Valenciennes, a daughter of Baldwin of Avesnes and Felicitas of Coucy. In 1265 she married Count Henry VI of Luxembourg, linking the houses of Avesnes and Luxembourg. Her eldest son Henry, born in 1274, was elected King of the Romans in 1308 and crowned Holy Roman Emperor as Henry VII in 1312. Another son, Baldwin, held the archbishopric of Trier as prince-elector from 1307 to 1354. Beatrice founded Beaumont Abbey in 1310 and died on 25 February 1321.
zh: 阿韦讷的贝娅特丽克丝（约1240—1321）生于瓦朗谢讷，是博杜安·德·阿韦讷与库西的费利西泰之女。1265年，她嫁给卢森堡伯爵亨利六世，联结了阿韦讷家族与卢森堡家族。她的长子亨利生于1274年，1308年当选罗马人的国王，1312年加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利七世；另一个儿子博杜安于1307至1354年担任特里尔大主教，位列选帝侯。贝娅特丽克丝于1310年创立博蒙修道院，1321年2月25日去世。

en: Henry V the Blond (1216–1281) inherited Arlon from his father Waleran III of Limburg in 1226 and Luxembourg and Laroche from his mother Ermesinde in 1247. His 1240 marriage to Margaret of Bar brought him Ligny, though a feud over its suzerainty with Theobald II of Bar ended with his capture at Prény in 1266 and Louis IX's arbitration in 1268. He seized Namur in 1256 while its margrave Baldwin II was in Constantinople. Baldwin sold his rights to Guy of Dampierre, who retook Namur and married Henry's daughter Isabelle. Henry joined Edward of England on the Ninth Crusade and returned after a truce with the Mamluks. He died in 1281; his sons fell at Worringen in 1288.
zh: 亨利五世（金发者，1216—1281）于1226年从父亲林堡公爵瓦勒良三世手中继承阿尔隆，1247年又从母亲埃尔梅辛德手中继承卢森堡与拉罗什伯国。1240年他与巴尔的玛格丽特成婚，得到利尼作为嫁妆；后因利尼宗主权与巴尔伯爵蒂博二世结怨，1266年在普雷尼被俘，1268年经法王路易九世仲裁获释。1256年，他趁那慕尔侯爵鲍德温二世身在君士坦丁堡之际夺取那慕尔。鲍德温将权利卖给当皮埃尔的居伊，后者夺回那慕尔并娶了亨利的女儿伊莎贝尔。他随英格兰的爱德华参加第九次十字军东征，与马穆鲁克议和后返乡。1281年他去世；诸子均于1288年战死沃林根。

en: Henry VI (c. 1240–1288) was Count of Luxembourg and Arlon, titles he inherited from his father Henry V the Blond. He took charge of government while his father accompanied Louis IX of France on crusade, and succeeded as count in 1281. Drawn into his neighbours' quarrels, he joined the Limburg succession war and was killed at the Battle of Worringen on 5 June 1288 by a knight of John I of Brabant. His brothers Waleran and Baldwin and his half-brother Henry of Houffalize also fell. Around 1261 he married Beatrice d'Avesnes; their sons Henry VII, later Holy Roman Emperor, and Baldwin, Archbishop of Trier, secured the rise of the House of Luxembourg.
zh: 亨利六世（约1240—1288）是卢森堡与阿尔隆伯爵，头衔继承自父亲金发者亨利五世。父亲随法王路易九世参加十字军期间，由他执掌政务，并于1281年继位。他卷入邻邦纷争，加入林堡继承战争，1288年6月5日在沃林根战役中被布拉班特公爵约翰一世手下的骑士杀死。他的兄弟瓦勒良、鲍德温以及同父异母的兄弟于法利兹的亨利也在战役中阵亡。约1261年他娶阿韦讷的贝亚特丽克丝；儿子亨利七世后来成为神圣罗马帝国皇帝，另一个儿子鲍德温成为特里尔大主教，奠定了卢森堡家族的崛起。

en: Henry VII (1278/79–1313), son of Count Henry VI of Luxembourg and Beatrice d'Avesnes, grew up at the French court and ruled Luxembourg from 1288. After King Albert I was murdered in 1308, Henry's brother Baldwin, Archbishop of Trier, won over electors for him. Henry was elected King of the Romans at Frankfurt on 27 November 1308 and crowned at Aachen in 1309. He crossed the Alps in 1310 to revive imperial authority in Italy, then torn between Guelphs and Ghibellines. He married his son John to Elizabeth of Bohemia, winning the Bohemian crown for the Luxembourg dynasty, and was crowned emperor in Rome on 29 June 1312, the first since Frederick II. He died at Buonconvento on 24 August 1313 and was buried in Pisa.
zh: 亨利七世（1278/79—1313）是卢森堡伯爵亨利六世与阿韦讷的贝亚特丽克丝之子，在法国宫廷长大，1288年起统治卢森堡。1308年国王阿尔布雷希特一世遇刺后，亨利的弟弟、特里尔大主教鲍德温为他争取选侯的支持。亨利于1308年11月27日在法兰克福当选罗马人的国王，1309年在亚琛加冕。他于1310年翻越阿尔卑斯山，在归尔甫派与吉伯林派纷争的意大利重振皇权。他为儿子约翰迎娶波希米亚的伊丽莎白，为卢森堡家族赢得波希米亚王位，并于1312年6月29日在罗马加冕，成为腓特烈二世之后首位皇帝。1313年8月24日，他在布翁孔文托去世，葬于比萨。

en: Margaret of Brabant (4 October 1276 – 14 December 1311), daughter of Duke John I of Brabant and Margaret of Flanders, married Count Henry VII of Luxembourg on 9 July 1292, settling the quarrel over Limburg. When Henry was elected King of the Romans in 1308 she became queen. Her children were John the Blind, king of Bohemia and father of Emperor Charles IV; Maria, wife of Charles IV of France; and Beatrix, wife of Charles I of Hungary. She joined Henry's Italian campaign, fell ill at Brescia, and died at Genoa, where Henry commissioned Giovanni Pisano to carve her monument.
zh: 布拉班特的玛格丽特（1276年10月4日—1311年12月14日）是布拉班特公爵约翰一世与佛兰德斯的玛格丽特之女。1292年7月9日她嫁给卢森堡伯爵亨利七世，这场婚姻了结了林堡争端。1308年亨利当选罗马人的国王，她成为王后。她的子女是波希米亚国王、皇帝查理四世之父“盲人”约翰，嫁给法兰西国王查理四世的玛丽，以及嫁给匈牙利国王查理一世的贝阿特丽切。她随亨利远征意大利，在布雷西亚染病，1311年死于热那亚，亨利委托雕塑家乔瓦尼·皮萨诺为她制作了陵墓纪念碑。

en: Margaret of Courtenay (1194–1270) was the daughter of Peter II of Courtenay, Latin Emperor of Constantinople, and Yolanda of Flanders. In 1217 she married Henry I, Count of Vianden. When her brother Henry II died in 1229, she seized Namur and defended it against Ferrand, Count of Flanders, until the peace of Cambrai in 1232. She ruled the margraviate until 1237, when her brother Baldwin II reclaimed it and she withdrew to Vianden. Widowed in 1252, she became a nun at Marienthal, dying on 17 July 1270. Her children included Philip, Count of Vianden, and Henry, bishop of Utrecht.
zh: 那慕尔的玛格丽特（1194—1270）是拉丁帝国皇帝库尔特奈的彼得二世与佛兰德斯的约兰达之女。1217年她嫁给菲安登伯爵亨利一世。1229年兄长亨利二世去世后，她夺取那慕尔侯国，抵御佛兰德斯伯爵费尔南的进攻，直至1232年签订《康布雷和约》。她统治那慕尔至1237年，弟弟鲍德温二世收回侯国，她便退居菲安登。1252年丈夫去世后她在马里恩塔尔修道院出家，于1270年7月17日去世。子女中有菲安登伯爵菲利普和乌得勒支主教亨利。

en: Margaret of Bar (c. 1225 – 23 November 1275) was the eldest daughter of Count Henry II of Bar and Philippa of Dreux. In 1240 she married Count Henry V of Luxembourg, bringing Ligny-en-Barrois as her dowry. A dispute over that fief led her brother Count Theobald II of Bar to war on Henry, who was captured at Prény in 1266 and freed only through King Louis IX's arbitration in 1268. Her children included Henry VI of Luxembourg, Waleran of Ligny, Isabelle, wife of Guy of Dampierre, and Philippa, wife of Count John II of Holland.
zh: 巴尔的玛格丽特（约1225—1275年11月23日）是巴尔伯爵亨利二世与德勒的菲丽帕的长女。1240年她嫁给卢森堡伯爵亨利五世，以利尼昂巴鲁瓦作为嫁妆。围绕这块封地的争端使她的兄弟巴尔伯爵蒂博二世与亨利交战，1266年亨利于普雷尼战败被俘，直到1268年经法兰西国王路易九世仲裁才获释。她的子女包括卢森堡伯爵亨利六世、利尼领主瓦勒良、嫁给当皮埃尔的居伊的伊莎贝尔，以及嫁给荷兰伯爵约翰二世的菲莉帕。

en: Ibrahim was a son of Jalaluddin Ahsan Khan, founder of the Madurai Sultanate. He served as purse bearer at the court of the Delhi sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq. When his father declared Ma'bar independent of Delhi around 1335, Tughluq had Ibrahim killed in retaliation.
zh: 易卜拉欣是马杜赖苏丹国建立者贾拉勒丁·阿赫桑汗之子，在德里苏丹穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克宫中任掌袋侍从。约1335年其父宣布马巴尔脱离德里独立，图格鲁克便将易卜拉欣处死作为报复。

en: Jalaluddin Ahsan Khan (died 1339), originally named Hasan Kaithali, was the first sultan of the Madurai Sultanate. In 1335 he declared Ma'bar independent of Delhi. When Muhammad bin Tughluq sent an army against him, Ahsan Khan defeated it; the sultan of Delhi retaliated by executing Ahsan Khan's son Ibrahim, his imperial purse-bearer. The Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta was his son-in-law. After about four years' rule Ahsan Khan was murdered by one of his nobles in 1339.
zh: 贾拉鲁丁·阿赫桑汗（1339年卒）原名哈桑·凯萨利，是马杜赖苏丹国的首任苏丹。1335年，他宣布马巴尔脱离德里独立。穆罕默德·伊本·图格鲁克派军征讨被他击败；德里苏丹为报复，处死了阿赫桑汗在朝中担任掌袋官的儿子易卜拉欣。摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰是他的女婿。统治约四年后，他于1339年被一名贵族杀害。

en: Otto of Hesse (1301 – 30 April 1361) was Archbishop of Magdeburg from 1327 until his death. A son of Landgrave Otto I of Hesse and a grandson of Saint Elizabeth of Thuringia, he was designated for the see by Pope John XXII and received the pallium in August 1327. He reconciled Magdeburg, placed under the imperial ban after citizens murdered his predecessor Burchard III in 1325, and on 26 April 1333 received the city's homage. He settled border disputes with Brandenburg, acquired lands around Sandau, and withstood a revolt of the local nobility, dying at Wolmirstedt in 1361.
zh: 黑森的奥托（1301—1361年4月30日）1327年起任马格德堡大主教，直至去世。他是黑森伯爵奥托一世的儿子、图林根的圣伊丽莎白之孙，由教皇约翰二十二世选定出任该职，1327年8月接受白羊毛披肩。1325年马格德堡市民杀害前任大主教布尔夏德三世，城市被处帝国禁令，奥托促成解除禁令，于1333年4月26日接受城市宣誓效忠。他还解决了与勃兰登堡的边界争端，取得桑道一带土地，并顶住当地贵族的叛乱，1361年卒于沃尔米施泰特。

en: Mahmud Ghazan (5 November 1271 – 11 May 1304) was the seventh Ilkhan of Persia, ruling from 1295. As viceroy of Khorasan under his father Arghun, he long defended the frontier against the Chagatai. In June 1295, with the emir Nawruz's backing, he converted to Sunni Islam, overthrew the Ilkhan Baydu and took the throne. He defeated the Mamluks at Wadi al-Khazandar in December 1299 and occupied Damascus, but his army was decisively beaten at Marj al-Saffar in April 1303. At home he reformed the currency and tax system and crushed a series of princely revolts. He died near Qazvin in May 1304.
zh: 马哈茂德·合赞（1271年11月5日—1304年5月11日）是伊儿汗国第七代君主，1295年即位。他是阿鲁浑之子，早年任呼罗珊总督，长期抵御察合台汗国的侵扰。1295年6月，他在异密捏吾鲁兹支持下皈依逊尼派伊斯兰教，推翻伊儿汗拜都登位。1299年12月，他在瓦迪哈赞达尔之战击败马穆鲁克并占领大马士革，但他的军队于1303年4月在迈尔季萨法尔之战惨败。内政方面，他改革币制与赋税，镇压了接连不断的宗王叛乱。1304年5月，他在加兹温附近去世。

en: Henry III of Virneburg (c. 1295 – 21 December 1353) was Archbishop and Elector of Mainz. A son of Count Rupert II of Virneburg and nephew of the archbishop of Cologne, he secured the see through Pope John XXII in 1328, although the chapter had elected Baldwin of Luxembourg and Henry was only accepted in 1336. He backed Emperor Louis IV of Bavaria against the Curia, holding a provincial synod at Mainz in 1338. Deposed by Pope Clement VI on 7 April 1346 in favour of Gerlach of Nassau, he nevertheless kept his position in Mainz until his death in 1353.
zh: 维尔讷堡的亨利三世（约1295—1353年12月21日）是美因茨大主教兼选帝侯。他是维尔讷堡伯爵鲁普雷希特二世之子、科隆大主教的侄子，靠教皇约翰二十二世于1328年得到美因茨大主教之位；但座堂议会另选了卢森堡的巴尔杜因，亨利直到1336年才被普遍接受。他支持皇帝巴伐利亚的路易四世对抗教廷，1338年在美因茨召开行省主教会议。1346年4月7日教皇克雷芒六世将他废黜、改立拿骚的格拉赫，但他仍保住在美因茨的地位，直至1353年去世。

en: Conrad of Wittelsbach (c. 1120/1125–1200) was Archbishop of Mainz and a cardinal caught in the struggle between emperor and pope. A son of Count Otto IV of Wittelsbach, he was appointed archbishop by Frederick Barbarossa at the Council of Lodi in 1161. Refusing to back the antipope Paschal III, he broke with the emperor in 1165 and fled to Rome, where Pope Alexander III made him a cardinal. The 1177 Treaty of Venice gave him Salzburg, but in 1183 he returned to Mainz, rebuilt its walls and renovated its cathedral, and hosted the Pentecost feast of 1184. He joined the 1197 crusade as papal legate and attended Leo I's coronation in Armenia. In 1200 he secured an armistice between the Hohenstaufen and Welf factions in Germany, dying later that year.
zh: 康拉德·冯·维特尔斯巴赫（约1120/1125—1200）是美因茨大主教和枢机主教，身处皇帝与教宗的争斗之中。他是维特尔斯巴赫伯爵奥托四世之子，1161年由腓特烈·巴巴罗萨在洛迪会议上任命为大主教。他拒绝支持对立教宗帕斯加尔三世，于1165年与皇帝决裂、逃到罗马，教宗亚历山大三世将他立为枢机主教。1177年的《威尼斯条约》把萨尔茨堡划给他；1183年他回到美因茨，重建城墙、修缮主教座堂，并在1184年主持了五旬节庆典。1197年他以教宗使节身份参加十字军，出席了亚美尼亚国王莱翁一世的加冕礼。1200年，他促成德意志的霍亨斯陶芬派与韦尔夫派休战，同年去世。

en: Anusapati, also called Anushanatha, was the second king of Singhasari in East Java, ruling from 1227 to 1248. The Pararaton chronicle makes him the son of Ken Dedes and Tunggul Ametung of Tumapel, raised as Ken Arok's stepson after Arok murdered his father and married his mother. In 1227 Anusapati avenged Tunggul Ametung by killing Ken Arok with the same cursed kris that Mpu Gandring had forged for the murder. He ruled Singhasari for two decades, until 1248, when his half-brother Panji Tohjaya killed him with that same blade.
zh: 阿努沙帕蒂，又名阿努沙纳塔，是东爪哇信诃沙里的第二任国王，1227年至1248年在位。《国王之书》记载，他是肯·蒂德丝与杜马佩尔首领通古尔·阿梅通之子，肯·阿罗克杀死他的生父并娶他的母亲后，他成为肯·阿罗克的继子。1227年，他用姆普·甘德灵当年为那场谋杀铸造的同一把受诅咒的格里斯剑杀死肯·阿罗克，为父报仇。他统治信诃沙里约二十年，1248年被异母弟潘吉·托查亚用同一把剑杀死。

en: Cakradhara, later titled Kertawardhana, Bhre Tumapel, was a Javanese nobleman and prince consort of Majapahit. The Pararaton chronicle records that after King Jayanegara died in 1328 he won the contest held to marry the royal princesses and took Dyah Tya, who ruled as Queen Tribhuwana Wijayatunggadewi, as his wife. As prince of Tumapel he ruled the old Singhasari heartland. The Nagarakretagama praises the couple as devout Buddhists and likens him to the dhyani Buddha Ratnasambhava. Their son, born in 1334, became King Hayam Wuruk; their daughter Dyah Nertaja became princess of Pajang.
zh: 查克拉达拉后称克尔塔瓦尔达纳、封号图马佩尔亲王，是爪哇贵族、满者伯夷王夫。据爪哇编年史《帕拉拉通》记载，1328年国王贾亚纳加拉死后，他在迎娶王室公主的比试中获胜，娶了后来以特里布婆那·毗阇耶顿迦提毗之名执政的迪雅·特亚为妻。作为图马佩尔亲王，他统治旧信诃沙里的核心地区。《爪哇史颂》称赞二人为虔诚的佛教徒，并把他比作五方佛中的宝生佛。他们的儿子生于1334年，即后来的哈亚·乌鲁克国王；女儿迪雅·涅尔塔贾成为帕章公主。

en: Dara Petak, later called Indreswari, was a princess of Dharmasraya, a Buddhist Malay kingdom in Sumatra, and a daughter of King Tribhuwanaraja. In 1275 the Singhasari ruler Kertanegara sent the Pamalayu expedition to Sumatra, and when the army returned to Java after the Mongols were driven out in 1293, it brought Dara Petak and her elder sister Dara Jingga to the court. Intended for Kertanegara, who had died, she married his heir Raden Wijaya, founder of Majapahit, and became his only non-Javanese consort. Their son Jayanegara succeeded as the second Majapahit king in 1309. Her Malay name means white dove.
zh: 达拉·佩塔，后称因德雷斯瓦里，是苏门答腊的佛教马来王国达摩室利耶的公主，国王特里布瓦纳拉贾之女。1275年，信诃沙里君主格尔达纳卡拉派帕马拉尤远征军出征苏门答腊；1293年蒙古军队被逐出爪哇后，回师的军队将达拉·佩塔与其姐达拉京加带回宫中。她本要献给格尔达纳卡拉，但国王已死，于是嫁给其继承人、满者伯夷开国君主罗登·韦查耶，成为他唯一非爪哇籍的配偶。两人之子查雅纳迦拉于1309年继位，是为满者伯夷第二任国王。她的马来语名字意为白鸠。

en: Gajah Mada (c. 1290–c. 1364), also called Jirnnodhara, was the general and chief minister who made Majapahit the dominant power in the Javanese world. His career began in 1313 and rose after he helped King Jayanegara crush the Ra Kuti rebellion. In 1334 Queen Tribhuwana made him mahapatih, and the Pararaton records the Palapa Oath he swore: he would take no rest or pleasure until he had united the Nusantara archipelago. The oath startled the court; his rival Ra Kembar mocked it, and the quarrel ended in a duel, sanctioned by the queen, in which Ra Kembar died. Decades of campaigns then brought Majapahit to its peak under Hayam Wuruk. After the Bubat massacre of 1357, officials blamed him, since he had meant to demand Sunda's submission. He died in obscurity in 1364. Hayam Wuruk judged that he had gathered too much power for one man and split his duties among four new ministers.
zh: 加查·马达（约1290—约1364），又名吉尔诺达拉，是使满者伯夷成为爪哇世界霸主的名将与首相。他的仕途始于1313年，因协助查雅纳迦拉王平定拉·库提叛乱而平步青云。1334年，特里布婆那女王任命他为玛哈帕蒂，《国王之书》记载了他立下的帕拉帕誓言：在统一努山塔拉群岛之前绝不休憩享乐。这一誓言令朝廷震惊，对手拉·肯巴尔出言嘲笑，争执以一场经女王认可的决斗收场，拉·肯巴尔死于其中。此后数十年的征战，使满者伯夷在哈亚·乌鲁克时期臻于鼎盛。1357年布巴特惨案之后，朝臣归咎于他，因为他原打算迫使巽他称臣。他于1364年默默去世。哈亚·乌鲁克认为他积累的权力太大，不宜由一人掌握，便把他的职权分给四位新任大臣。

en: Gayatri Rajapatni (c. 1276–1350) was the youngest daughter of Kertanegara, last king of Singhasari, and chief queen of Kertarajasa (Raden Wijaya), founder of Majapahit. When Kediri forces overran Singhasari in 1292 she escaped disguised as a servant. After Wijaya founded Majapahit in 1293 she became his favourite consort, bearing two daughters, Tribhuwana and Rajadewi. She sponsored Adityawarman and, as queen dowager, may also have supported the rise of Gajah Mada, then retired as a Buddhist nun. After Jayanegara died in 1328 she had Tribhuwana enthroned in 1329, and died at her monastery in 1350, later portrayed as the bodhisattva Prajnaparamita.
zh: 加娅特丽·拉贾帕特妮（约1276—1350）是信诃沙里末代国王格尔达纳卡拉的幼女，也是满者伯夷开国君主格尔达拉查沙（即罗登·韦查耶）的王后。1292年谏义里军队攻灭信诃沙里时，她乔装成仆人逃出起火的王宫。1293年韦查耶建立满者伯夷后，她成为最受宠爱的配偶，生下特里布婆那与拉贾德维两个女儿。她栽培了阿迪亚瓦曼，王太后时期也可能支持过加查·玛达的晋升，随后出家成为比丘尼。1328年查雅纳迦拉死后，她于1329年命特里布婆那登位；1350年于寺院中去世，身后被奉为菩萨般若波罗蜜多的化身。

en: Hayam Wuruk (1334–1389), regnal name Rajasanagara, was the fourth ruler of Majapahit, under whom the Javanese empire reached its greatest power. The poet Prapanca recorded that he was born in the year Mount Kelud erupted, and read the eruption as a sign that Shiva had taken human form. Raised by his mother Queen Tribhuwana, he came to the throne in 1350 at sixteen, with Gajah Mada still Mahapatih, and together they extended Majapahit's sway across the Nusantara archipelago. In 1357 his planned marriage to Dyah Pitaloka, daughter of the Sundanese king Linggabuana, ended in the Bubat massacre, in which the princess and her party died; court officials blamed Gajah Mada, who had meant to demand Sunda's submission. In 1365 Prapanca composed the Nagarakretagama in his praise, describing his journeys through East Java. He sent embassies to China from 1370 to 1381 and died in 1389. A succession quarrel between Wikramawardhana and Wirabhumi then pulled the empire into decline.
zh: 哈亚·乌鲁克（1334—1389），王号罗阇沙纳加拉，是满者伯夷第四位君主，在他治下这个爪哇帝国臻于极盛。诗人帕拉潘查记载，他出生那年克卢德火山喷发，并把这看作湿婆降世为人的征兆。他由母亲特里布婆那女王一手栽培，1350年年方十六岁即位，加查·马达仍任玛哈帕蒂，君臣合力，将满者伯夷的势力扩展到努山塔拉群岛。1357年，他与巽他国王林加布阿纳之女迪亚·皮塔洛卡的婚事以布巴特惨案收场，公主及随行者尽数遇难；朝臣归咎于加查·马达，因为他原打算迫使巽他称臣。1365年，帕拉潘查撰成《爪哇史颂》称颂他，记述了他巡行东爪哇的旅程。1370年至1381年间他多次遣使中国，1389年去世。此后，瓦的克拉马瓦尔达纳与维拉布米争夺继承权，帝国由盛转衰。

en: Jayanegara (1294–1328) was the second emperor of Majapahit and the only son of its founder Raden Wijaya, succeeding in 1309. His troubled reign was shaken by barons' revolts: Gajah Biru rose in 1314, and in 1319 Kuti seized the palace, forcing the king to flee until Gajah Mada crushed the rebellion. The Javanese chronicle Pararaton brands him a dissolute ruler, Kala Gemet, who desired his officers' wives and his own half-sisters. He sent embassies to China from 1325 until 1328, when his physician Tanca murdered him during an operation. Childless, he was succeeded by his half-sister Tribhuwana.
zh: 查雅纳加拉（1294—1328）是满者伯夷第二任君主、开国者罗登·韦查耶的独子，1309年继位。他在位时政局动荡，旧将接连叛乱：加札·比鲁于1314年起事，1319年库蒂攻占王宫，他被迫出逃，靠加札·马达平定叛乱才得以复位。爪哇编年史《爪哇诸王志》给他“加拉·格梅特”的恶号，称他觊觎臣下的妻子乃至自己的异母妹妹。1325至1328年他多次遣使中国。1328年，他在一次小手术中被御医坦察杀害；因无子嗣，王位由异母妹妹特丽布瓦娜继承。

en: Ken Arok, or Ken Angrok, titled Rajasa (died c. 1227), founded the East Javanese kingdom of Singhasari and the Rajasa dynasty. The Pararaton chronicle gives him humble beginnings on the banks of the Brantas River: abandoned as an infant, he was raised by a thief and became a notorious thief in Kediri himself. The rishi Mpu Lohgawe reformed him and declared him an avatar of Vishnu. Serving Tunggul Ametung of Tumapel, he desired his master's wife Ken Dedes, whom Lohgawe said would bear a royal dynasty. He murdered Tunggul with the kris of Mpu Gandring, seized Ken Dedes, and built a kingdom centered on Singhasari. To legitimize his rise, he claimed descent from Shiva. Around 1227 his stepson Anusapati killed him with the same cursed blade.
zh: 肯·阿罗克（一译肯·昂罗克），王号罗阇沙（约1227年卒），是东爪哇信诃沙里王国和罗阇沙王朝的建立者。《国王之书》记载，他出身于布兰塔斯河畔的贫寒人家，幼时被遗弃，由盗贼抚养，长大后在谏义里为盗、声名狼藉。仙人姆普·洛加韦点化他改邪归正，并宣布他是毗湿奴的化身。他在杜马佩尔首领通古尔·阿梅通麾下效力时，爱上主人的妻子肯·蒂德丝；洛加韦预言她将孕育一个王朝。他用姆普·甘德灵铸造的格里斯剑刺杀通古尔，夺娶肯·蒂德丝，建立起以信诃沙里为中心的王国。为使登位名正言顺，他自称湿婆的后裔。约1227年，继子阿努沙帕蒂用同一把受诅咒的剑将他杀死。

en: The Javanese Pararaton chronicle portrays Ken Dedes as the daughter of the Buddhist monk Mpu Purwa, a woman famed across Java for her beauty. Tunggul Ametung, ruler of Tumapel, seized her as his wife while her father was away, and Mpu Purwa cursed him for the abduction. Ken Arok murdered Tunggul Ametung, took Ken Dedes as his queen and founded the kingdom of Singhasari in 1222. She was later revered as the ancestress of the Rajasa dynasty, which ruled Java from Singhasari into the Majapahit era.
zh: 据爪哇编年史《国王之书》记载，肯·蒂德丝是佛教僧侣姆普·普尔瓦之女，美貌传遍爪哇。杜马佩尔的统治者通古尔·阿梅通趁她父亲外出修行时将她强娶为妻，普尔瓦为此诅咒他必遭杀身之祸。后来肯·阿罗克刺杀通古尔·阿梅通，于1222年建立信诃沙里王国，立她为后。她被后世尊为罗阇沙王朝的女始祖，该王朝从信诃沙里时代起直至满者伯夷时代统治爪哇。

en: Kertanegara, also called Sivabuddha (died 1292), was the last king of Singhasari, ruling East Java from 1268; his father Wisnuwardhana had enthroned him in 1254 to secure the succession. He was the first Javanese ruler to expand beyond Java: Bali submitted in 1284, and Madura and parts of Borneo acknowledged him. When Kublai Khan's envoys demanded tribute in 1289, he had them branded, mutilated and expelled. In 1290 he sent the main army to Sumatra against Jambi, and in 1292, with it abroad, the rebel Jayakatwang stormed the palace and killed him, clearing the way for Raden Wijaya's Majapahit.
zh: 克塔纳伽拉，又名湿婆佛陀（1292年卒），是信诃沙里末代国王，1268年起统治东爪哇；为确保继承，其父毗湿奴伐弹那1254年便将他立为国王。他是第一位把势力扩张到爪哇岛以外的爪哇统治者：1284年巴厘臣服，马都拉和婆罗洲部分地区也向他归附。1289年忽必烈遣使要求朝贡，他下令将使者烙印、施以残刑后驱逐出境。1290年，他派主力军队远征苏门答腊的占碑；1292年大军在外，叛将贾亚卡旺攻占宫殿将他杀死，为拉登·韦查耶建立满者伯夷铺平了道路。

en: Kudamerta, later known as Wijayarajasa, Bhre Wengker, was a noble of the Majapahit court in Java. After King Jayanegara died in 1328, the Pararaton records that he and Cakradhara won a contest to marry the two royal princesses; Kudamerta married Dyah Wiyat, known as Rajadewi, younger sister of Queen Tribhuwana. A daughter of his by a concubine became the chief queen of Hayam Wuruk. After Rajadewi died in the 1370s he proclaimed himself king at Pamotan as Bhatara Parameswara, heading the breakaway Eastern Court, and died in 1388. The Surawana temple was built around 1390 as his funerary monument.
zh: 库达梅尔塔，后称威查亚拉贾萨、温克尔王公，是爪哇满者伯夷宫廷的贵族。据《爪哇诸王志》记载，1328年国王查亚纳加拉死后，他与查克拉达拉在择婿比试中胜出，得以迎娶两位王室公主；库达梅尔塔娶了女王特里布婆那的幼妹迪亚·维雅特，即拉贾德维。他与妾室所生的一个女儿后来成为哈奄·武禄的王后。1370年代拉贾德维去世后，他在帕莫坦自立为王，号称巴塔拉·巴拉梅斯瓦拉，统领分裂的东廷，最终于1388年去世。约1390年建成的苏拉瓦纳神庙便是他的陵庙。
