en: Dyah Lembu Tal, also called Sri Harsawijaya or Mahisa Tal, was a Javanese knight of the Singhasari kingdom, described in the Nagarakretagama as a ksatria yudha, or warrior noble. He was the son of Mahisa Campaka and a descendant of Ken Arok, founder of Singhasari, through Ken Dedes. He is chiefly remembered as the father of Raden Wijaya, who in 1293 drove out Kublai Khan's Mongol expedition and founded the Majapahit kingdom.
zh: 伦布·塔尔（又称斯里·哈尔萨维查亚或马希萨·塔尔）是信诃沙里王国的爪哇武士，《爪哇史颂》称他为征战的武士贵族。他是马希萨·坎帕卡之子，经肯·蒂德丝一系为信诃沙里开国君主肯·阿罗克的后裔。他最主要的身份是罗登·韦查耶之父：其子于1293年击退忽必烈派遣的蒙古远征军，建立满者伯夷王国。

en: Mahisa Campaka, also called Narajaya and titled Bhatara Narasinghamurti (c. 1230–1269), was a Singhasari prince of the Rajasa line, the son of Mahisa Wong Ateleng. The Pararaton makes him the companion of Rangga Wuni, the future Wisnuwardhana: backed by the army of Tumapel, the two overthrew the usurper Panji Tohjaya in 1250. The Nagarakretagama and a Balinese legal text describe Narasinghamurti as supreme commander, or Ratu Anggabhaya, of Singhasari and ruler of seven islands beyond Java. The Nagarakretagama names him the father of Lembu Tal and grandfather of Raden Wijaya, the founder of Majapahit. The Mantring Gianyar inscription names two wives and identifies Indijaketana as Lembu Tal's mother.
zh: 马希萨·占帕卡，又名纳拉查亚，称号巴塔拉·纳拉辛哈穆尔蒂（约1230—1269），是罗阇沙世系的信诃沙里王子，马希萨·翁·阿特伦之子。《国王之书》把他写成朗加·武尼——即后来的毗湿奴伐弹那——的伙伴：在杜马佩尔军队支持下，二人于1250年推翻篡位者潘吉·托查亚。《爪哇史颂》与一部巴厘法律文献称纳拉辛哈穆尔蒂是信诃沙里最高统帅“拉图·昂加巴亚”，并统治爪哇以外的七座岛屿。《爪哇史颂》记载，他是伦布·塔尔之父、满者伯夷建国者拉登·韦查耶的祖父。曼特林·吉安雅碑铭记有他的两位妻子，并称因迪查克塔娜是伦布·塔尔的母亲。

en: Mahisa Wong Ateleng, also styled Sri Bhatara Parameswara, was a Javanese prince of the Rajasa dynasty, born to Ken Arok and Ken Dedes, the founder and first queen of Singhasari. The Pararaton records him ruling Kediri under the overlordship of Tumapel after Singhasari's foundation in 1222, and gives his wife as Ken Rimbi, daughter of Ken Umang. The Nagarakretagama styles him Bhatara Parameswara, names a son Narasinghamurti and traces the later Majapahit kings to his line. His recorded son was Mahisa Campaka.
zh: 马希萨·翁·阿特伦，又号室利·巴塔拉·帕拉梅斯瓦拉，是罗阇沙王朝的爪哇王子，为信诃沙里开国君主肯·阿罗克与第一位王后肯·蒂德丝所生。《国王之书》记载，1222年信诃沙里建国之后，他在杜马佩尔的宗主权下统治谏义里，并娶肯·乌芒之女肯·伦比为妻。《爪哇史颂》称他为巴塔拉·帕拉梅斯瓦拉，说他有子纳拉辛哈穆尔蒂，并把后来的满者伯夷诸王追溯为他的后裔。他见于记载的儿子是马希萨·占帕卡。

en: Mpu Prapanca was a 14th-century Buddhist monk and poet, or mpu, at the Majapahit court in Java, writing under the name Dang Acarya Nadendra. In 1365 (1287 Saka) he composed the Nagarakretagama in Old Javanese as a eulogy to King Hayam Wuruk. The epic portrays Majapahit at the height of its power, describing its capital, temples and vassal lands across the archipelago, and remains the chief source for the empire's history. He reportedly described himself as a former head of the kingdom's Buddhist clergy, a dharmadhyaksa kasogatan, though scholars have disputed this claim.
zh: 普拉班扎是14世纪爪哇满者伯夷宫廷的佛教僧侣兼诗人，“姆普”是爪哇人对博学大师的尊称，他又号当·阿查里亚·纳伦德拉。1365年（塞迦历1287年），他以古爪哇语写成《纳加拉克尔塔加玛》，作为对国王哈奄·武禄的颂词。这部史诗描绘了鼎盛时期的满者伯夷，记述其都城、庙宇与横跨群岛的藩属，是研究该帝国历史的首要文献。相传他自称曾任王国佛教僧团首脑达玛迪亚克沙·卡索加坦，但学者对这一说法提出了质疑。

en: Raden Wijaya was the Javanese prince who founded the Majapahit kingdom and ruled it from 1293 until his death in 1309. When Kublai Khan's Mongol army landed at Tuban in 1292 to avenge an insult by the dead Singhasari king Kertanegara, Wijaya enlisted it against Jayakatwang of Kediri, the ruler who had overthrown Singhasari. After Jayakatwang fell in 1293, he turned on the Mongols and drove them from Java, then took the throne. To secure his claim, he married Kertanegara's daughters, including Gayatri Rajapatni. He rewarded his ally Aria Wiraraja with Madura and an autonomous region around Lumajang, and appointed Wiraraja's son Nambi prime minister. His son Jayanegara succeeded him.
zh: 罗登·韦查耶是爪哇王公，满者伯夷王国的创立者，1293年至1309年在位。1292年，忽必烈的元朝军队在图班登陆，要为信诃沙里国王克塔纳伽拉羞辱蒙古使臣一事复仇；此时克塔纳伽拉已死，韦查耶借元军之力攻打推翻信诃沙里的谏义里统治者贾亚卡特望。1293年贾亚卡特望败亡后，他转而攻击元军，将其逐出爪哇，随后登基。为巩固法统，他娶了克塔纳伽拉的女儿们，其中包括加亚特里·拉贾帕特尼。他将马都拉和卢马姜周边的自治地区赐给盟友阿里亚·维拉拉贾，又任命维拉拉贾之子南比为首相。死后由其子查雅纳迦拉继位。

en: Rajadewi, birth name Dyah Wiyat and titled Bhre Daha, princess of Daha, was the younger daughter of Majapahit founder Kertarajasa (Raden Wijaya) and his chief queen Gayatri Rajapatni, younger sister of Queen Tribhuwana. The Pararaton relates that her half-brother King Jayanegara wanted the two sisters as wives and confined them in the palace quarters for years. After Jayanegara's murder in 1328 a marriage contest was held, and Rajadewi wed the nobleman Kudamerta, later styled Wijayarajasa, Bhre Wengker. The Pararaton calls the marriage childless. She died in the 1370s, after which her husband set up the breakaway Eastern Court at Pamotan.
zh: 拉贾德维，原名迪亚·维雅特，封号达哈公主，是满者伯夷开国君主格尔达拉查沙（罗登·韦查耶）与王后加娅特丽·拉贾帕特妮的幼女，特里布婆那女王之妹。《爪哇诸王志》记载，她的异母兄长查雅纳迦拉国王欲纳她与姐姐为妃，将二人长年幽禁于深宫。1328年查雅纳迦拉遇刺后，宫中举行择婿比试，拉贾德维嫁给贵族库达梅尔塔，即后来的温克尔王公威查亚拉贾萨。《爪哇诸王志》称二人没有子嗣。她于1370年代去世，此后丈夫便在帕莫坦建立起割据的东廷。

en: Rangga Wuni, known by his reign name Wisnuwardhana (died 1270 or 1272), was the son of King Anusapati and, from 1248, king of Tumapel, the heart of Singhasari in East Java. Raised at Ken Arok's court, he and his companion Mahisa Campaka, also called Narasinghamurti, overthrew the usurper Panji Tohjaya, and the two governed together as king and chief minister. To secure the succession he had his young son Kertanegara enthroned in 1254. Wisnuwardhana ruled until 1268 and died at Singhasari in 1270 or 1272.
zh: 朗加·武尼以王号毗湿奴伐弹那闻名（1270或1272年卒），是阿努沙帕蒂王之子，1248年起统治东爪哇的杜马佩尔，即信诃沙里的核心之地。他在肯·阿罗克的宫廷中长大，与伙伴马希萨·占帕卡（又名纳拉辛哈穆尔蒂）合力推翻篡位者潘吉·托查亚，此后二人以国王与首相的身份共同治国。为确保继承无虞，他在1254年立幼子克塔纳伽拉为王。毗湿奴伐弹那在位至1268年，1270或1272年于信诃沙里去世。

en: Tribhuwana Wijayatunggadewi, born Dyah Tya, was the third monarch and first queen regnant of Majapahit, ruling from 1329 to 1350. Eldest daughter of the founder Raden Wijaya and Gayatri Rajapatni, she was shut away for years in the women's quarter of the palace by her half-brother Jayanegara, who wanted her as consort. After he was murdered in 1328, her mother, by then in a convent, placed her on the throne. In 1331 she led the army herself against the rebellions of Sadeng and Keta. In 1334 she appointed Gajah Mada as Mahapatih; he swore the Palapa oath to carry Majapahit's power across the archipelago, and killed the rival who mocked him in a duel she sanctioned. Majapahit conquered Bali in 1343 and sent Adityawarman to subdue Sumatra in 1347. She ruled under Gayatri's auspices, so when Gayatri died in 1350 she gave the throne to her son Hayam Wuruk, and went on sitting in the council of royal elders.
zh: 特里布婆那·毗阇耶顿迦提毗（本名迪亚·特亚）是满者伯夷第三位君主、第一位执政女王，1329年至1350年在位。她是开国君主罗登·韦查耶与加亚特里·拉贾帕特尼的长女；异母兄长查雅纳迦拉想纳她为妃，把她在王宫内宅关了多年。他于1328年遇刺后，已入庵修行的母亲让她登上王位。1331年，她亲自率军平定萨登与克塔叛乱。1334年她任命加查·马达为玛哈帕蒂，他立下帕拉帕誓言，要把满者伯夷的势力推向整个群岛，并在她认可的决斗中杀死了嘲笑他的对手。满者伯夷于1343年征服巴厘，1347年派阿蒂亚瓦曼平定苏门答腊。她是在加亚特里庇护下执政，因此1350年加亚特里去世时，她把王位让给儿子哈亚·乌鲁克，自己仍留在王室长老会议中。

en: Al-Amir Abi, also named Abi Abdallah Kanz ad-Daula, was a Muslim ruler of the Nubian kingdom of Makuria and a son of Kanz ad-Dawla Muhammad. The surviving king lists date his rule to 1333, the year his father died at Old Dongola.
zh: 阿米尔·阿比（又称阿比·阿卜杜拉·坎兹·道拉）是努比亚马库里亚王国的穆斯林统治者，坎兹·道拉·穆罕默德之子。流传下来的国王列表把他的统治时间系于1333年，即其父在旧栋古拉去世的那一年。

en: Saba Nol, called Weluda Ityopya in the Ge'ez Life of Ewostatewos, was a Christian king of Noba, the Nubian land south of the Fifth Nile Cataract, remembered only through Ethiopian hagiography. Around 1337 he received the exiled Ethiopian monk Ewostatewos while facing a great revolt, and begged the saint to intercede for him; the hagiography credits Ewostatewos's prayers with his victory over the rebels. The gloss explaining his Arabic name as Ge'ez for son of Ethiopia may be a copyist's invention, and modern scholars suggest he could be a memory of the Makurian king Siti.
zh: 萨巴·诺尔是诺巴的基督教国王（诺巴位于尼罗河第五瀑布以南的努比亚地区），吉兹语《埃沃斯塔特沃斯行传》称他为韦卢达·伊特约皮亚，关于他的记载仅见于这部埃塞俄比亚圣徒传记。约1337年，他在遭遇大规模叛乱时接待了流亡的埃塞俄比亚修士埃沃斯塔特沃斯，请求圣徒为他代祷；行传把他对叛军的胜利归功于埃沃斯塔特沃斯的祈祷。传记把他的阿拉伯语名字解释为吉兹语的“埃塞俄比亚之子”，这一说法可能是抄经士的附会；现代学者推测，他可能是对马库里亚国王西蒂的一种追忆。

en: Siti was a Christian king of the Nubian kingdom of Makuria, also called Dotawo, who ruled from about 1331 to at least December 1333. He is known only from Old Nubian sources: documents found at Edfu in Upper Egypt and Qasr Ibrim name him king, while inscriptions at Banganarti, a graffito in northern Kordofan and a painted inscription at Sonqi Tino also record him. He appears to have seized power from the Muslim ruler Kanz ad-Dawla Muhammad, who had taken Dongola in the 1310s and regained power after a temporary overthrow, and restored Makuria as a Christian kingdom.
zh: 西蒂是努比亚基督教王国马库里亚（又称多塔沃）的国王，约1331年至1333年12月以后在位。他只在古努比亚语文献中留下记载：上埃及伊德富和盖斯尔·伊卜里姆出土的文书称他为国王，班加纳尔蒂的铭文、北科尔多凡的一处涂鸦以及松基·蒂诺的彩画题记也出现他的名字。他似乎从穆斯林统治者坎兹·道拉·穆罕默德手中夺取了权力——后者于1310年代占据栋古拉，曾被暂时推翻，随后复位——并使马库里亚恢复为基督教王国。

en: Mande Bori, also called Mande Bakari or Abu Bakr in Arabic, was a hero of Mande oral tradition and the brother and right-hand man of Sundiata Keita. His own mother having died young, he was raised by Sogolon Condé, shared the family's exile, and fought in the wars against the Sosso, including the Battle of Kirina in 1235. After Sundiata founded the Mali Empire, he held the office of kankoro-sigui, or viceroy. He never reigned himself, but his grandsons Mansa Musa and Mansa Suleyman later ruled Mali at the height of its power.
zh: 曼德·博里，又称曼德·巴卡里，阿拉伯语名作阿布·贝克尔，是曼丁戈口述传统中的英雄，松迪亚塔·凯塔的兄弟与得力副手。生母早逝后他由索戈隆·孔德抚养，随家族一同流亡，并参加了对索索人的战争，包括1235年的基里纳战役。松迪亚塔建立马里帝国后，他出任康科罗-西吉，即副王。他本人从未称曼萨，但孙辈曼萨·穆萨与曼萨·苏莱曼后来在马里帝国鼎盛时期相继在位。

en: Abu Ishaq al-Sahili, also called al-Tuwayjin (c. 1290–1346), was an Andalusi poet and legal scholar from Granada who became the most celebrated foreign scholar at the court of Mansa Musa of Mali. He left al-Andalus around 1321 and met Musa during the pilgrimage to Mecca in 1324, then returned with him to Mali. He directed construction of an audience chamber in the capital, paid for in gold, and settled in Timbuktu; he traveled to the Maghreb and exchanged gifts with the Marinid sultan Abu al-Hasan. He died in Timbuktu on 15 October 1346; Ibn Battuta saw his tomb there in 1353.
zh: 阿布·伊沙克·萨希利，又称图韦金（约1290—1346），是格拉纳达出身的安达卢斯诗人兼教法学者，后成为马里曼萨·穆萨宫廷中最负盛名的外来学者。约1321年他离开安达卢斯，1324年在麦加朝觐时结识曼萨·穆萨，随后随他前往马里。他主持修建了都城的觐见厅，获赐重金，后定居廷巴克图；他曾前往马格里布，与马林王朝苏丹阿布·哈桑交换礼物。1346年10月15日他在廷巴克图去世，伊本·白图泰1353年造访该城时曾见到他的坟墓。

en: Abu Bakr, called Bata Mande Bori in Mande oral tradition, was the fifth mansa of the Mali Empire, reigning after the tyrant Khalifa was overthrown around 1275. He was the son of a daughter of Sundiata Keita and may have been adopted by him, making him the first mansa to succeed through the female line. After an uneventful reign he was succeeded by Sakura, an enslaved court official who seized power in a coup. He is often confused with his namesake Abu Bakr, Sundiata's brother and the ancestor of Mansa Musa.
zh: 阿布·贝克尔在曼丁戈口述传统中称巴塔·曼德·博里，是马里帝国第五位曼萨，在暴君哈利法约于1275年被推翻后在位。他是松迪亚塔·凯塔的外孙，也可能被松迪亚塔收为养子，因而成为第一位经由母系继承的曼萨。他的统治平淡无奇，之后由宫廷奴隶出身的萨库拉发动政变夺权继位。他常与同名的阿布·贝克尔——松迪亚塔之弟、曼萨·穆萨的祖先——相混淆。

en: Faga Leye was, by Mande oral tradition, the son of Abu Bakr (Mande Bori), brother of Sundiata Keita, and the father of Mansa Musa. He never reigned himself, but his son took the throne around 1312 and ruled the Mali Empire at its height.
zh: 据曼丁戈口述传统，法加·拉耶是松迪亚塔·凯塔之弟阿布·贝克尔（曼德·博里）之子、曼萨·穆萨之父。他本人从未称曼萨，但他的儿子约于1312年继承王位，将马里帝国推向鼎盛。

en: Khalifa was the fourth mansa of the Mali Empire, known only from Ibn Khaldun's fourteenth-century Kitāb al-ʻIbar. The Arab chronicler makes him a son of Sundiata Keita, ruling late in the thirteenth century after his brothers Mansa Wali and Wati. He describes Khalifa as insane and devoted to archery, shooting his own subjects for sport, until they rose against him and killed him. The throne then passed to Abu Bakr, a grandson of Sundiata born of a daughter. Maurice Delafosse placed Khalifa's brief reign around 1273–1275.
zh: 哈利法是马里帝国第四位曼萨，生平仅见于中世纪阿拉伯学者伊本·赫勒敦的《教训书》。据伊本·赫勒敦记载，他是松迪亚塔·凯塔之子，于13世纪末在兄长曼萨·瓦利和瓦蒂之后即位。书中说他精神失常、沉溺射箭，常以箭矢射杀臣民取乐，最终民众起事将他杀死。王位随后传给松迪亚塔的外孙阿布·贝克尔。莫里斯·德拉福斯把他短暂的在位时间定在1273—1275年前后。

en: Maghan I (1280s–1341), also called Magha, was the tenth mansa of Mali and the eldest son of Kankan Musa I, better known as Mansa Musa. When Musa left on his famous pilgrimage to Mecca in 1324, Maghan was left in nominal charge of the empire. He took the throne when Musa died in 1337, but reigned in his own right for only four years. He died in 1341, reportedly of a heart attack, and the crown went to his uncle Sulayman rather than to his own line. The historian Nehemia Levtzion suggests that Sulayman, as the eldest male of the dynasty, had been passed over for Maghan and may have deposed him. Maghan's son Jata was in the end the one to seize power, in the civil war that followed Sulayman's death.
zh: 马甘一世（1280年代—1341）又称马加，是马里第十位曼萨，即著名的曼萨·穆萨（坎坎·穆萨一世）的长子。1324年穆萨启程前往麦加朝觐时，他被留下名义上执掌国政。1337年穆萨去世后他继位，但实际统治仅四年。1341年他去世，据称死于心脏病，王位没有传给子嗣，而由其叔苏莱曼继承。史学家内赫米亚·列夫齐翁认为，苏莱曼作为王室中年纪最长的男性，当年被越过而让位于马甘，后来可能还废黜了他。苏莱曼死后马里陷入内战，最终夺得权力的是马甘之子贾塔。

en: Naré Maghann Konaté, also called Maghan Kon Fatta, was a twelfth-century faama of the Mandinka chiefdom of Kiri, in what is now Mali, and a figure of the Epic of Sundiata. The epic recounts that a hunter-diviner foretold his heir would be born of an ugly woman, so he married the hunchbacked Sogolon Condé, who bore him Sundiata Keita. He favoured Sundiata over his eldest son Dankaran Touman, but after his death around 1218 Dankaran Touman seized the throne and drove Sundiata into exile.
zh: 纳雷·马甘·科纳特，又称马甘·孔·法塔，是12世纪今马里一带曼丁戈人小邦基里的法王，也是《松迪亚塔史诗》中的人物。史诗讲述，一位猎占师预言他的继承人将由一个丑陋的女子所生，他于是娶了驼背的索戈隆·孔德，后者生下松迪亚塔·凯塔。他属意松迪亚塔而非长子丹卡兰·图曼继位，但约1218年他死后，丹卡兰·图曼夺取王位，迫使松迪亚塔流亡。

en: Muhammad ibn Qu was the eighth mansa of the Mali Empire, succeeding his father Mansa Qu around 1305 as the immediate predecessor of Mansa Musa. In Cairo in 1324, Musa recounted that his predecessor fitted out 200 ships, and then 2000, to explore the limits of the Atlantic Ocean and never returned, leaving Musa to rule. The Arab historian al-Umari recorded the story without naming the predecessor, whom several historians identify as Muhammad from the succession. The voyage is often wrongly credited to an Abu Bakr II, a ruler who never reigned, the error stemming from a mistranslation by Baron de Slane.
zh: 穆罕默德·伊本·库是马里帝国第八位曼萨，约1305年继承其父曼萨·库的王位，是曼萨·穆萨的直接前任。1324年，穆萨在开罗讲述，他的前任先后装备200艘和2000艘船只，前去探索大西洋的尽头，结果一去不返，穆萨于是继位。阿拉伯学者欧麦里记录了这段叙述，但没有写出前任的名字；一些历史学家根据继承关系推定此人为穆罕默德。这次远航常被误归于一位从未在位的“阿布·贝克尔二世”，该错误源于德·斯兰男爵的误译。

en: Mansa Musa (c. 1280–c. 1337) was the ninth Mansa of Mali and ruled the empire at its greatest extent. By his own account he came to the throne because his predecessor sailed into the Atlantic and never returned, though some historians suspect he simply deposed him. Mali's wealth rested on taxing the salt and gold trade, with gold from Bambuk and Bure. In 1324 Musa went on pilgrimage to Mecca with an enormous retinue, and his lavish gifts in Cairo pushed the price of gold down there for years; the news travelled as far as Europe, where maps such as the 1375 Catalan Atlas showed a rich West African ruler. He annexed Gao and Timbuktu, built ties with the Mamluk and Marinid courts, and brought scholars such as the Andalusian poet Abu Ishaq al-Sahili to Mali, making Timbuktu a centre of Islamic learning. His reign is linked to building at Timbuktu's Djinguereber Mosque. He died around 1337, and his son Maghan succeeded him.
zh: 曼萨·穆萨（约1280—约1337）是马里第九位曼萨，在他治下帝国疆域达到极盛。据他本人的说法，前任曼萨驶入大西洋后一去不回，他才得以登基；也有史家怀疑他其实是废黜了前任。马里的财富来自对食盐和黄金贸易的征税，金子主要产自邦布库和布雷。1324年，穆萨率庞大的随从队伍前往麦加朝觐，在开罗的豪阔馈赠使当地金价连续多年走低；消息传到欧洲，1375年的《加泰罗尼亚地图》等地图上就画出了一位富有的西非君主。他吞并加奥和廷巴克图，与马穆鲁克王朝、马林王朝通好，又把安达卢斯诗人阿布·伊沙克·萨希利等学者请到马里，使廷巴克图成为伊斯兰学术中心。廷巴克图的金加雷贝尔清真寺在他统治时期有所营建。他约于1337年去世，其子马甘继位。

en: Qu, also transliterated Gao and called Kon Mamadi in oral tradition, was mansa of the Mali Empire from about 1300 to 1305. A son of Mansa Uli, he came to the throne after Sakura, the former court slave who had seized power, was murdered while returning from the pilgrimage to Mecca; Mande tradition claims Kon Mamadi killed Sakura himself with the help of Sakura's daughter. His accession ended the succession disputes between the great council, the Gbara, and the hunter guilds that had troubled Mali since Sundiata's death. He died in 1305 and was succeeded by his son Muhammad.
zh: 库，又译高，口述传统中称孔·马马迪，约1300年至1305年任马里帝国曼萨。他是曼萨·乌利之子，在篡权的宫廷奴隶萨库拉朝觐归来途中被杀后继位；曼丁戈传说称孔·马马迪在萨库拉女儿的帮助下亲手杀死了萨库拉。他的即位结束了自松迪亚塔死后大议事会格巴拉与猎人行会之间的继承纷争。他于1305年去世，其子穆罕默德继位。

en: Sakura (died c. 1300) was a mansa of the Mali Empire, known chiefly from Ibn Khaldun. Born outside the ruling Keita dynasty, possibly as a royal slave or client, he seized the throne amid palace conflicts around 1285. He stabilized Mali and stretched its power from the Atlantic eastward beyond Gao, capturing Gao by his account, while trade with the Muslim world flourished under his rule. He made the pilgrimage to Mecca, the first mansa to do so since Uli. Returning from the hajj, he was killed at Tajura near Tripoli; with his death the Keita line returned to power.
zh: 萨库拉（约1300年卒）是马里帝国的曼萨，事迹主要见于伊本·赫勒敦的记述。他并非凯塔王族，可能曾是宫廷奴隶或门客，约1285年趁宫廷内乱篡夺王位。他稳定了马里政局，将势力从大西洋沿岸向东扩张到加奥以东，伊本·赫勒敦称加奥也被他攻占；在他治下，马里与穆斯林世界的贸易兴盛。他还赴麦加朝觐，是乌利之后第一位朝觐的曼萨。归途中他在的黎波里附近的塔朱拉被杀，他死后凯塔家族重新掌权。

en: Mansa Sulayman (d. c. 1360), brother of Mansa Musa, ruled Mali from about 1341 after Musa's son Maghan, though the historian Nehemia Levtzion suggests that he, as the eldest male of the dynasty, had been passed over and may have deposed him. He kept up Musa's diplomacy with the Marinid sultan Abu al-Hasan of Fez, and in 1348 or 1349 sent an embassy to congratulate him on conquering Ifriqiya. In 1352 the Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta reached his court and left the fullest eyewitness account of Mali at its height. He noted the security of the land but found Sulayman a miser beside Musa. During his stay, Sulayman imprisoned his principal wife and cousin Qasa and accused her of conspiring against him; his court condemned her, and she took sanctuary with the khatib. Sulayman died around 1360, the last great mansa. His son Qasa reigned nine months, and the civil war that followed ended Mali's golden age.
zh: 曼萨·苏莱曼（约1360年卒）是曼萨·穆萨的兄弟，约1341年继穆萨之子马甘之后统治马里；史学家内赫米亚·列夫齐翁认为，他作为王室中年纪最长的男性，当年被越过，后来可能废黜了马甘。他延续穆萨的外交，与非斯的马林王朝苏丹阿布·哈桑往来，1348年或1349年遣使祝贺其征服伊夫里基叶。1352年，摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰到访他的宫廷，留下了关于鼎盛时期马里最详尽的亲历记录；他称许当地治安良好，却认为苏莱曼远不如穆萨慷慨。伊本·白图泰逗留期间，苏莱曼囚禁了身为堂亲的正妃卡萨，指控她谋反；宫廷判她有罪，她向清真寺讲经人寻求庇护。苏莱曼约于1360年去世，是最后一位伟大的曼萨。其子卡萨在位九个月，随后爆发的内战终结了马里的黄金时代。

en: Sundiata Keita (c. 1217–c. 1255) was the son of the Mandinka ruler Naré Maghann Konaté and founder of the Mali Empire. The Mandinka epic transmitted by griots tells how persecution after his father's death drove him into exile at Mema, and how he returned to free his people from Soumaoro Kanté, king of Sosso. Around 1235 Sundiata and his warlords defeated Soumaoro at Kirina and became the first Mandinka ruler to take the title Mansa, ruling from Niani over a federation that controlled the goldfields and trade routes. Among his leading generals was Tiramakhan Traore. During his reign, Mali's social and political norms began to be codified in the Gbara and Kouroukan Fouga. He died around 1255, traditionally drowned in the Sankarani River.
zh: 松迪亚塔·凯塔（约1217—约1255）是曼丁戈首领纳雷·马甘·科纳特之子，马里帝国的创立者。格里奥口述的曼丁戈史诗讲述：父亲死后他遭迫害，流亡到梅马，后来返回家乡，将族人从苏苏国王苏曼古鲁·康德手中解放出来。约1235年，松迪亚塔与各部战将在基里纳击败苏曼古鲁，成为第一位采用“曼萨”称号的曼丁戈君主，定都尼亚尼，统治着一个掌控金矿与商路的联邦。他的杰出将领包括蒂拉马坎·特拉奥雷；在他统治时期，马里的社会与政治规范开始形成格巴拉和库鲁坎富加。他约于1255年去世，相传溺死于桑卡拉尼河。

en: A daughter of Sundiata Keita, founder of the Mali Empire, her name is unrecorded. Ibn Khaldun mentions her only as the mother of Abu Bakr, called Bata Mande Bori in oral tradition, the fifth mansa of Mali.
zh: 她是马里帝国建立者松迪亚塔·凯塔的女儿，名字未见史载。编年史家伊本·赫勒敦只提到她是阿布·贝克尔的母亲——后者在口述传统中称巴塔·曼德·博里，于13世纪末成为马里第五位曼萨。

en: Mansa Uli, also called Wali or Yérélinkon, was the second mansa of the Mali Empire and the son and successor of Sundiata Keita. Remembered as one of Mali's greatest rulers, he consolidated the new empire, and the historian Nehemia Levtzion suggests he may have been the first mansa to bring Walata, Timbuktu, and Gao under Mali's rule. At some point between 1260 and 1277 he made the pilgrimage to Mecca. He was apparently succeeded by his brother Wati, while his own son Qu later took the throne.
zh: 曼萨·乌利，又称瓦利或耶雷林孔，是马里帝国第二位曼萨，松迪亚塔·凯塔之子与继承人。他被视为马里最伟大的统治者之一，巩固了新生的帝国；历史学家内厄姆·莱夫齐翁认为，他可能是第一位将瓦拉塔、廷巴克图和加奥纳入马里统治的曼萨。1260年至1277年间的某个时候，他赴麦加朝觐。他似乎由弟弟瓦蒂继位，而他的儿子库后来登上王位。

en: Mansa Wati, also rendered Ouati, was the third mansa of the Mali Empire. Arab sources name him as a son, possibly adopted, of Sundiata Keita and place his short reign between that of his brother Mansa Uli, who made the pilgrimage to Mecca between 1260 and 1277, and that of Khalifa, who was overthrown around 1275. Mande oral tradition does not remember him, which the historian Djibril Tamsir Niane explained by its tendency to preserve only rulers who left descendants.
zh: 曼萨·瓦蒂，又译瓦提，是马里帝国第三位曼萨。阿拉伯史料称他是松迪亚塔·凯塔之子，也可能是养子，其短暂统治介于其兄曼萨·乌利（1260年至1277年间赴麦加朝觐）与约1275年被推翻的哈利法之间。曼丁戈口述传统中没有关于他的记忆，历史学家吉布里尔·塔姆西尔·尼亚奈解释说，口述史家往往只记得留有后裔的统治者。

en: Melik Temür (died 2 June 1307) was a Mongol prince, a son of Ariq Böke. In 1276 he joined Shiregi's revolt against Kublai and, during a dispute among the rebels, supported Sarban in replacing Shiregi; after the revolt failed he took refuge with Kaidu in Central Asia. In 1306 he abandoned Kaidu's successor Chapar and surrendered to the Yuan prince Qayishan; the following year he accompanied Ananda to Dadu. After Chengzong's death he backed Ananda's failed bid for the throne; Qayishan, reigning as Wuzong, had him put to death at Shangdu in 1307. His great-grandson Arpa later briefly held the Ilkhanid throne.
zh: 明里帖木儿（？—1307年6月2日）是蒙古宗王，阿里不哥之子。1276年，他随宗王昔里吉起兵反抗忽必烈，叛军内讧时又支持撒里蛮取代昔里吉；事败后他投奔中亚的海都。1306年，他脱离海都的继承者察八儿，向元朝宗王海山投降；次年随安西王阿难答入朝大都。元成宗死后，他依附阿难答争夺帝位，事败后被已即位的海山（元武宗）赐死于上都。他的曾孙阿儿巴后来曾短暂登上伊儿汗之位。

en: Kitbugha, royal name al-Malik al-Adil (died 1303), was a Mongol soldier in Hulagu's Ilkhanid army until captured at the First Battle of Homs in 1260. Bought by Qalawun, he was freed and raised to emir. After al-Ashraf Khalil's murder in 1293 he ruled Egypt as regent for the nine-year-old al-Nasir Muhammad, and in December 1294 deposed the boy and took the throne. His favor to Oirat refugees, together with famine and plague, turned the emirs against him, and in November 1296 they overthrew him in Damascus and raised up Lajin. Granted Salkhad, he governed Hama and died there in 1303.
zh: 怯的不花，王号阿迪勒（？—1303），原为旭烈兀伊儿汗军中的蒙古士兵，1260年第一次霍姆斯战役中被俘，由嘉拉温买下后获释并被提拔为埃米尔。1293年阿什拉夫·哈利勒遇刺后，他以摄政身份为九岁的纳西尔·穆罕默德执掌埃及，1294年12月废黜幼主自立。他厚待1296年涌入的卫拉特难民，加上饥荒与瘟疫，令埃米尔们离心；1296年11月他们在大马士革将他推翻，拥立拉金。他受封塞勒海德，后出镇哈马，1303年卒于当地。

en: Al-Ashraf Ala al-Din Kujuk (1334–1345), a son of al-Nasir Muhammad and his Tatar wife Ardu, was made Bahri Mamluk sultan of Egypt in August 1341, aged five or six, after the strongman Qawsun deposed and executed his half-brother al-Mansur Abu Bakr. Qawsun ruled as regent until a mamluk revolt overthrew him in late December 1341; Kujuk was deposed on 21 January 1342 and returned to his mother in the Cairo Citadel. In September 1345, after the death of Sultan as-Salih Isma'il, court rivals accused Ardu of sorcery and the eleven-year-old Kujuk was murdered.
zh: 阿什拉夫·阿拉丁·库朱克（1334—1345）是纳西尔·穆罕默德与鞑靼妃子阿尔杜之子。1341年8月，权臣盖松废并处死他的异母兄长曼苏尔·阿布·贝克尔后，把年仅五六岁的他立为埃及伯海里马穆鲁克苏丹，自己以摄政身份独揽大权。1341年12月底盖松在马穆鲁克哗变中倒台，库朱克于1342年1月21日被废，回到开罗城堡的母亲身边。1345年萨利赫·伊斯玛仪死后，宫中与阿尔杜为敌者指控她施行巫术，十一岁的库朱克于同年9月遇害。

en: Al-Mansur Sayf al-Din Abu Bakr (c. 1321–1341) was the Bahri Mamluk sultan who briefly ruled Egypt after the death of his father, al-Nasir Muhammad, in June 1341. Born to the concubine Narjis, he trained from boyhood at the desert fortress of al-Karak, was made an emir in 1335 and governor of al-Karak in 1339, and was named heir ahead of his brothers. His reign lasted about two months: in August 1341 the senior emir Qawsun deposed and arrested him, and two months later had him executed at Qus in Upper Egypt.
zh: 曼苏尔·赛义夫丁·阿布·贝克尔（约1321—1341）是伯海里马穆鲁克苏丹，1341年6月父亲纳西尔·穆罕默德去世后短暂统治埃及。他为妃子纳尔吉斯所生，自幼在沙漠要塞卡拉克受训，1335年受封埃米尔，1339年出任卡拉克总督，并被父亲越过诸兄弟立为继承人。他在位仅约两个月：1341年8月，重臣盖松将他废黜逮捕，两个月后又在上埃及的库斯将他处死。

en: Al-Nasir Badr al-Din Hasan (1334/1335–1361), a son of al-Nasir Muhammad by his Tatar concubine Kuda, was the Bahri Mamluk sultan of Egypt in two reigns, 1347–1351 and 1354–1361. Enthroned at twelve, he was at first a figurehead for senior emirs and was toppled in 1351 when he tried to rule in person. Restored in 1354, he purged the great emirs and staffed the state with the awlad al-nas, sons of mamluks. In 1361 he was killed by his own mamluk Yalbugha al-Umari. His reign left Cairo the great Sultan Hasan Mosque-Madrasa.
zh: 纳西尔·拜德尔丁·哈桑（1334/1335—1361）是纳西尔·穆罕默德与鞑靼妃子库达之子，曾两度出任埃及伯海里马穆鲁克苏丹（1347—1351、1354—1361）。他十二岁登基，起初只是诸埃米尔的傀儡，1351年试图亲政即被废黜；1354年复位后，他整肃重臣，改用马穆鲁克后裔执掌政务。1361年，他被自己的马穆鲁克叶勒卜加·欧迈里杀害。他在位期间为开罗留下了宏伟的苏丹哈桑清真寺暨经学院。

en: Alaa al-Din Ali bin al-Imam was an Egyptian emir of the el-Emam family and a descendant of the Egyptian judge Abu Uday al-Masri. He rose under Sultan al-Ashraf Qansuh al-Ghuri, whose trust he gained as he advanced to high office. In 1501 he became supervisor of the sultan's privy treasury, and in 1503 also of pious endowments. He later held the posts of commander of the pilgrimage, secretary of state and supervisor of the armies. He was known as Abu al-Asitul, Father of the Fleet.
zh: 阿拉丁·阿里·本·伊玛目是埃及伊玛目家族的埃米尔，也是埃及法官阿布·乌代·马斯里的后裔。他在苏丹阿什拉夫·坎苏·古里在位时崛起，逐渐获得苏丹信任，身居高位。1501年他出任苏丹私库总监，1503年又兼掌宗教捐赠；其后历任朝觐车队统帅、掌玺秘书官和军队总监。他绰号“舰队之父”。

en: Al-Nasir Shihab al-Din Ahmad (1316–1344), a son of Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad, was Bahri Mamluk sultan of Egypt from January to June 1342. As a boy he was sent to the desert fortress of al-Karak to learn horsemanship, and he never stopped preferring it, and its Bedouin allies, to Cairo. After his father died in 1341, the strongman Qawsun ruled through a five-year-old puppet, al-Ashraf Kujuk, until emirs sympathetic to Ahmad ousted them; Ahmad still delayed his departure for Egypt. Two months into his reign he went back to al-Karak with part of the treasury and governed through a deputy. When he executed his own backers, the emirs Tashtamur and Qutlubugha, his half-brother al-Salih Isma'il deposed him. The Mamluks besieged al-Karak at least seven times before Ahmad was captured in July 1344 and beheaded that month. Chroniclers judged him the worst of his father's sons.
zh: 纳西尔·希哈卜丁·艾哈迈德（1316—1344）是苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德之子，1342年1至6月任伯海里马穆鲁克埃及苏丹。他少年时被送往沙漠要塞卡拉克学习骑术，此后始终更愿意待在那里，与当地的贝都因部落为伴，而不愿住在开罗。1341年父亲去世后，权臣考松通过五岁的幼君阿什拉夫·库鲁克把持朝政，直到同情艾哈迈德的埃米尔将二人推翻；艾哈迈德仍一再拖延赴埃及。即位两个月后，他携部分国库返回卡拉克，通过一名代理人治理埃及。他处死自己的支持者、埃米尔塔什塔穆尔与库特卢卜加，异母弟萨利赫·伊斯玛仪便将他废黜。马穆鲁克军队至少七次围攻卡拉克，1344年7月艾哈迈德被俘，当月被斩首。史家称他是父亲诸子中最糟的一个。

en: Al-Nasir Muhammad ibn Qalawun (1285–1341) was the Bahri Mamluk sultan of Egypt and Syria, enthroned three times between 1293 and 1341 and the dynasty's longest-ruling sultan. Put on the throne at eight after his brother al-Ashraf Khalil's murder, he was ruler in name only: the emir Kitbugha deposed him in 1294, and in 1309 he withdrew to al-Karak rather than live under the emirs Baybars al-Jashnakir and Salar. Egyptians clamoured for his return, and in 1310 he came back determined to rule alone, executing Baybars and arresting Salar, who died in prison. He abolished the emirs' surcharges on commoners, ordered a land survey, made peace with the Ilkhanids in 1322, and in 1330 sent away French envoys who had asked him for Jerusalem. His canal to Alexandria opened in 1311, and he rebuilt much of the Cairo Citadel and renovated over thirty mosques. He died in 1341; eight of his sons reigned.
zh: 纳西尔·穆罕默德·本·嘉拉温（1285—1341）是埃及与叙利亚的伯海里马穆鲁克苏丹，1293至1341年间三度在位，是该王朝在位最久的苏丹。兄长阿什拉夫·哈利勒遇刺后，年仅八岁的他被拥立为苏丹，却只是名义上的君主：1294年埃米尔怯的不花将他废黜；1309年，他不愿再受埃米尔拜巴尔·贾山基尔与萨拉尔摆布，退居卡拉克。埃及民众呼吁他回来，1310年他复位，决心独掌大权，处决了拜巴尔，又逮捕萨拉尔，后者死于狱中。他废除埃米尔向平民加征的杂税，推行土地清丈，1322年与伊儿汗国议和，1330年又把向他索要耶路撒冷的法国使节赶出埃及。通往亚历山大的运河于1311年通航，开罗城堡也在他手里大加扩建，三十多座清真寺得到翻修。他于1341年去世，八个儿子后来相继登上王位。

en: Ardu was a Tatar concubine of the Bahri Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad and the mother of the future sultan al-Ashraf Kujuk, born in 1334. When another Tatar concubine, Kuda, died, Ardu raised Kuda's infant son, the future sultan al-Nasir Hasan. After al-Nasir Muhammad's death in 1341, the emir Aqsunqur al-Nasiri married her in 1343, and she later married Sultan al-Kamil Sha'ban. During the reign of as-Salih Isma'il, a rival wife accused Ardu of sorcery, and in September 1345 her eleven-year-old son Kujuk was murdered in the resulting court intrigues.
zh: 阿尔杜是伯海里马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德的鞑靼妃子，1334年生下后来的苏丹阿什拉夫·库朱克。另一位鞑靼妃子库达死后，阿尔杜收养了她襁褓中的儿子，即后来的苏丹纳西尔·哈桑。纳西尔·穆罕默德1341年去世后，埃米尔阿克松古尔·纳西里于1343年娶她为妻，此后她又改嫁苏丹卡米勒·沙班。萨利赫·伊斯玛仪在位期间，与她为敌的妃嫔指控她施行巫术；1345年9月，她十一岁的儿子库朱克在随之而来的宫廷倾轧中遇害。

en: Sitt Ashlun Khatun was a Mongol noblewoman, daughter of the Ilkhanate commander Shaktay ibn Qarajin, who had entered Mamluk service. In 1282 she married the Mamluk sultan Qalawun, and in 1285 she bore a son, Muhammad, the future sultan al-Nasir Muhammad; Qalawun heard the news at the siege of Margat. Ashlun raised the boy in Mongol fashion. He was made child sultan in 1293 after the murder of his half-brother al-Ashraf Khalil, and when Kitbugha deposed him in 1294 Ashlun went with her son into confinement at al-Karak, returning with him to Cairo when he was restored in 1299.
zh: 阿什伦·哈屯是蒙古贵族女子，父亲是投奔马穆鲁克的伊儿汗国将领沙克泰·伊本·卡拉金。1282年她嫁给马穆鲁克苏丹盖拉温，1285年产下一子穆罕默德，即后来的苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德；盖拉温是在围攻马尔盖特要塞时得到这个消息的。阿什伦按蒙古风俗将儿子抚养长大。1293年异母兄长阿什拉夫·哈利勒遇刺后，年幼的穆罕默德被拥立为苏丹；1294年怯的不花将他废黜，阿什伦随儿子一同被幽禁于卡拉克，1299年儿子复位时又随他回到开罗。

en: Barquq (c.1336–1399) was a Circassian brought to Egypt in 1364 as a mamluk of the amir Yalbugha al-Umari. Rising through the army, he brought his father to Egypt in 1381 and gave him the rank of amir. In 1382 he deposed the child sultan al-Salih Hajji and founded the Burji Mamluk dynasty. His Cairo mosque-madrasa was completed in 1386. Ousted in a revolt that restored Hajji in 1389, he retook the throne in 1390 and replaced almost all governors and senior officials with members of his household. After Timur took Baghdad in 1393 he allied with the Ottomans against him. He died in 1399, leaving the throne to his son Faraj.
zh: 赛夫丁·巴尔库克（约1336—1399）是切尔克斯人，约1364年被带到埃及，成为埃米尔耶勒卜加·乌马里的马穆鲁克。他在军中崛起，1381年将父亲接到埃及，授予埃米尔军衔。1382年他废黜幼苏丹萨利赫·哈吉，建立布尔吉马穆鲁克王朝。他在开罗敕建的清真寺—伊斯兰学校于1386年落成。1389年叛乱贵族复立哈吉，他一度失位，但1390年夺回王位，用自家私属替换了几乎所有总督和高级官员。1393年帖木儿攻占巴格达后，他与奥斯曼结盟对抗。1399年他去世，其子法拉吉继位。

en: Bayad (died 1331) was a singer and freed slave who became a wife of the Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad and the mother of the future sultan al-Nasir Ahmad. She later divorced the sultan and married the emir Maliktamur al-Sarjuwani, who raised Ahmad at al-Karak.
zh: 巴亚德（？—1331）本是歌女、获释女奴，后成为马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德的妻妾，是未来苏丹纳西尔·艾哈迈德的生母。她后来与苏丹离异，改嫁埃米尔马利克帖木儿·萨尔朱瓦尼，由后者在卡拉克抚养艾哈迈德。

en: Baybars al-Jashankir, royal name al-Malik al-Muzaffar Rukn al-Din (died 1310), was a Circassian mamluk of Sultan Qalawun who rose to be emir and jashankir, food taster. During al-Nasir Muhammad's second reign he served as vice-sultan and, with Sayf al-Din Salar, dominated the young ruler. In 1302 he helped crush a Bedouin rebellion in Upper Egypt, and in 1303 commanded against the Mongols at the Battle of Shaqhab. When al-Nasir withdrew to al-Karak in 1309, Salar and the Burji mamluks made him sultan. His short reign saw famine and unrest; in 1310 he abdicated, was captured, and executed on al-Nasir's orders.
zh: 拜巴尔·贾山基尔，王号穆扎法尔·鲁克丁（？—1310），是苏丹嘉拉温麾下的切尔克斯马穆鲁克，累迁至埃米尔和苏丹的尝食侍从“贾山基尔”。纳西尔·穆罕默德第二次在位期间，他出任副苏丹，与赛义夫丁·萨拉尔一同挟制年幼的君主。1302年他参与平定上埃及的贝都因人叛乱，1303年在舍盖卜战役中率军迎击蒙古人。1309年纳西尔退居卡拉克，萨拉尔与布尔吉马穆鲁克拥立他为苏丹。他在位短暂，饥荒与动荡不断；1310年退位后被捕，奉纳西尔之命处决。

en: Benjamin II was the 82nd Coptic Pope of Alexandria and Patriarch of the See of St Mark, serving from 1327 to 1339. Born in Demicrat in southern Egypt, he lived as a hermit and a monk at Deir al-Baqal in Mount Tura before his election, and was consecrated on 10 May 1327 succeeding John IX. During his episcopate the Copts suffered fierce persecution under the Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad, with churches and monasteries destroyed; he rebuilt the ruined Monastery of Abba Bishoy in the Nitrian Desert. He died on 6 January 1339 and was later reburied there.
zh: 本雅明二世是第82任亚历山大教宗兼圣马可牧首，1327年至1339年在任。他生于埃及南部的德米克拉特，早年在旷野隐居，后入图拉山的巴加勒修道院修道；约翰九世去世后他当选，于1327年5月10日祝圣继位。他在任期间，马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德治下的科普特人遭受严酷迫害，多处教堂与修道院被毁；他重建了尼特伦沙漠中残破的圣比绍伊修道院。他于1339年1月6日去世，后遗体迁葬该院。

en: Dinara was a daughter of the Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad and his favorite wife Khawand Toghay, and a sister of Prince Sayf al-Din Anuk. She was married on 22 June 1331 to the emir Baktamur al-Saqi.
zh: 迪娜拉是马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德与宠妻哈万德·托盖之女、王子赛义夫丁·阿努克的姐妹。1331年6月22日，她嫁给埃米尔巴克塔穆尔·萨基。

en: Jamal al-Din Yusuf (1320–1346) was a son of the Bahri Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad by his concubine Narjis, and the full brother of Sultan al-Mansur Abu Bakr and Ramadan.
zh: 贾迈勒丁·优素福（1320—1346）是伯海里马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德与妃子纳尔吉斯之子，与苏丹曼苏尔·阿布·贝克尔、拉马丹为同母兄弟。

en: Khawand Toghay was the favourite wife of the Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad ibn Qalawun, who reigned from 1293 to 1341. A Turkish slave girl bought from Tankiz al-Husami, the sultan's governor in Syria, she entered the Cairo Citadel as his concubine; he freed her and married her in 1321. After her manumission she was remembered for her kind heart and for personally attending to the needs of her own slaves, and contemporary sources describe her as an influential voice in royal court decisions. She bore the sultan a son, Prince Anuk, born in 1323, who died in 1340. She outlived her husband by some seven years and was buried in her own mausoleum in Cairo's Northern Cemetery.
zh: 哈万德·托盖是马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德·本·盖拉温（1293—1341年在位）最宠爱的妻子。她是突厥人，原为奴婢，由苏丹派驻叙利亚的总督坦基兹·侯赛尼买来，进入开罗城堡成为苏丹的侍妾；1321年，苏丹释放她并娶她为妻。获释之后，她以心地善良、亲自照料手下奴婢的需求而闻名，史料称她在宫廷决策中颇有影响力。她为苏丹生下王子阿努克，生于1323年，1340年去世。她比丈夫多活了约七年，葬在开罗北墓地为自己建的陵墓中。

en: Kuda was a Tatar concubine of the Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad and mother of the future sultan al-Nasir Hasan. She died when Hasan was an infant and was buried in Cairo's Sultaniyya Mausoleum; the concubine Ardu then raised the boy.
zh: 库达是马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德的鞑靼妃子，是后来的苏丹纳西尔·哈桑的生母。她在哈桑襁褓时去世，葬于开罗的苏丹尼耶陵墓，王子此后由妃子阿尔杜抚养。

en: Lajin, royal name al-Malik al-Mansur Husam al-Din (died 1299), was a Mamluk of possibly Circassian origin, bought by Sultan Qalawun, whose daughter he married. He served as governor of Damascus from 1280 and took part in the assassination of Sultan al-Ashraf Khalil in 1293. He persuaded Kitbugha to seize the throne, then in November 1296 forced him aside and became sultan. During his reign an army raided the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia. Favoritism toward his mamluk Mankutumur, made atabeg over senior emirs, led to his murder with Mankutumur in Cairo on 16 January 1299, after which al-Nasir Muhammad returned.
zh: 拉金，王号曼苏尔·侯萨姆丁（？—1299），可能出身切尔克斯，被苏丹嘉拉温买下并娶其女为妻。1280年起任大马士革总督，1293年参与刺杀苏丹阿什拉夫·哈利勒。他先怂恿怯的不花篡位，又于1296年11月逼退怯的不花，自立为苏丹。在位期间曾出兵劫掠奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国。他提拔自己的马穆鲁克曼库图穆尔为阿塔贝格，位居老资格埃米尔之上，最终于1299年1月16日在开罗与曼库图穆尔一同被杀，纳西尔·穆罕默德随后复位。

en: Narjis was a concubine of the Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad and mother of three of his sons, including al-Mansur Abu Bakr, who reigned briefly as sultan in 1341. Al-Nasir later married her to Tuquzdamur al-Hamawi, and after his death in 1345 to Arghun al-Isma'ili.
zh: 纳尔吉斯是马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德的嫔妃，生有三子，其中包括1341年短暂在位的曼苏尔·阿布·伯克尔。纳西尔后来将她嫁给图古兹达穆尔，其1345年死后又改嫁阿尔衮。

en: Qalawun (c. 1222–1290), title al-Mansur, was a Kipchak Turk sold as a mamluk for a thousand dinars, hence his nickname al-Alfi. Rising under Sultan Baybars, he became atabeg to the child sultan Solamish and in 1279 took the throne. In 1280 he defeated rebel governor Sunqur al-Ashqar, and in 1281 joined him to repel Ilkhan Abaqa at the Second Battle of Homs. Against the Crusaders he took Margat in 1285 and Tripoli in 1289, extinguishing the County of Tripoli. He died in Cairo on 10 November 1290 while besieging Acre, which his son al-Ashraf Khalil took in 1291.
zh: 嘉拉温（约1222—1290），王号曼苏尔，是钦察突厥人，被卖为马穆鲁克时以一千第纳尔买下，故得绰号“阿尔菲”（千金之人）。他在拜巴尔斯苏丹麾下崛起，成为幼主索拉米什的阿塔贝格，1279年篡位自立。1280年击败反叛的大马士革总督孙库尔·阿什卡尔，1281年又与其联手，在第二次霍姆斯战役击退伊儿汗阿八哈。对十字军方面，他1285年攻取麦尔盖卜，1289年攻陷的黎波里，灭亡的黎波里伯国。1290年11月10日他在围攻阿卡期间卒于开罗，阿卡于1291年由其子阿什拉夫·哈利勒攻克。

en: Qutlughmalik was a daughter of Tankiz al-Husami, Mamluk viceroy of Damascus, and widow of Ahmad ibn Baktamur al-Saqi. In 1334 she married Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad, and in 1338 bore him a son, as-Salih Salih, later Mamluk sultan in 1342–1345.
zh: 库特卢格马利克是马穆鲁克大马士革总督坦基兹·胡萨米之女，原嫁艾哈迈德·伊本·巴克塔穆尔。1334年她改嫁苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德，1338年产子萨利赫，即1342至1345年在位的马穆鲁克苏丹萨利赫。

en: Ramadan (1320 – 27 February 1343) was a son of the Bahri Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad by his concubine Narjis, and the full brother of Sultan al-Mansur Abu Bakr and Jamal al-Din Yusuf.
zh: 拉马丹（1320年—1343年2月27日）是伯海里马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德与妃子纳尔吉斯之子，与苏丹曼苏尔·阿布·贝克尔、贾迈勒丁·优素福为同母兄弟。

en: Sayf al-Din Anuk (8 April 1323 – 31 August 1340) was a son of the Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad and his favorite wife, Khawand Toghay. Long his father's preferred heir, he accompanied the sultan on the departure for the Mecca hajj in 1332, meeting his half-brothers at al-Aqaba. By July 1340 he had lost favor and been dropped from the succession. He died on 31 August 1340, months before his father, and was buried in his father's Cairo madrasa.
zh: 赛义夫丁·阿努克（1323年4月8日—1340年8月31日）是马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德与其宠妻哈万德·托盖之子。他长期是父亲属意的继承人；1332年曾随苏丹启程前往麦加朝觐，在亚喀巴与异母兄弟们会合。到1340年7月，他已经失宠并被排除出继承序列。他于1340年8月31日去世，比父亲早数月，葬于其父在开罗修建的经学院内。

en: Agnese Pico (1303–1340) was an Italian noblewoman of the Pico della Mirandola family, the daughter of Francesco I Pico, first imperial vicar of Mirandola and Modena. In November 1321 Rinaldo Bonacolsi of Mantua captured her father with her brothers Prendiparte and Tommasino and had them shut up without food or water in the castle of Castel d'Ario, where they starved. Agnese became the first wife of Guido Gonzaga, capitano del popolo of Mantua. Her daughters Beatrice and Tommasina married Nicolò I d'Este of Ferrara and Azzo da Correggio. She died at Mantua in 1340.
zh: 阿涅塞·皮科（1303—1340）是皮科·德拉·米兰多拉家族的意大利贵族女子，米兰多拉首任帝国代理人、摩德纳行政长官弗朗切斯科一世·皮科之女。1321年11月，曼托瓦统治者里纳尔多·博纳科尔西俘获她的父亲及兄弟普伦迪帕特、托马西诺，把他们关入卡斯泰尔达里奥城堡，断水断粮，任其饿死。阿涅塞后来成为曼托瓦“人民首领”圭多·贡扎加的第一任妻子，两个女儿贝亚特丽切和托马西娜分别嫁给费拉拉的尼科洛一世·埃斯特与阿佐·达·科雷焦。她于1340年在曼托瓦去世。

en: Anna Dovara (c. 1301–c. 1354) was an Italian noblewoman of the Dovara clan of Cremona and the wealthy lady of Isola Dovarese. In 1322 she married Filippino Gonzaga, son of Luigi I Gonzaga, Mantua's first capitano del popolo, in a lavish wedding, bringing rich Cremonese lands including Isola Dovarese and Pomponesco as her dowry. The marriage gave the Gonzaga their first foothold in the Cremonese countryside. Her daughter Gigliola married Matteo II Visconti in 1342. Anna died in Mantua around 1354.
zh: 安娜·多瓦拉（约1301—约1354）是出身克雷莫纳多瓦拉家族的意大利贵族女继承人，拥有伊索拉多瓦雷塞的富饶领地。1322年，她嫁给曼托瓦首位人民统领卢伊吉一世·贡扎加之子菲利皮诺·贡扎加，婚礼极尽奢华，并把伊索拉多瓦雷塞、蓬波内斯科等克雷莫纳领地作为嫁妆带入夫家，贡扎加家族由此首次控制克雷莫纳乡郊。其女吉廖拉于1342年嫁给马泰奥二世·维斯孔蒂。安娜约于1354年在曼托瓦去世。

en: Antonia da Correggio was an Italian noblewoman, the daughter of Guido IV da Correggio, signore of Correggio, and Guidaccia della Palù. In 1328 she married Feltrino Gonzaga, a son of Luigi I Gonzaga of Mantua; with him she founded the cadet Gonzaga line of Novellara and Bagnolo and became its lady consort. Of her four sons, Guido (1340–1399) inherited Novellara in 1374 and married Ginevra Malatesta, while Guglielmo, later count of Thiene, and Odoardo both joined the conspiracies of 1356 and 1376 against the Mantuan Gonzaga and fought as captains for Bologna.
zh: 安东尼娅·达·科雷焦是意大利贵族女子，科雷焦领主圭多四世·达·科雷焦与圭达恰·德拉·帕卢之女。1328年，她嫁给曼托瓦的路易吉一世·贡扎加之子费尔特里诺·贡扎加，与丈夫一同开创诺瓦拉拉与巴尼奥洛的贡扎加旁支，成为该支系的领主夫人。四个儿子中，圭多（1340—1399）于1374年继承诺瓦拉拉领地，娶吉内芙拉·马拉泰斯塔；古列尔莫后来成为蒂耶内伯爵，他与奥多阿尔多都参与了1356年和1376年反对曼托瓦本家的阴谋，并为博洛尼亚人充当雇佣兵首领。

en: Beatrice Gonzaga (c. 1301 – c. 1335) was a Mantuan noblewoman, the daughter of Guido Gonzaga and Agnese Pico. She married Nicolò I d'Este, who ruled Ferrara jointly with his brothers Rinaldo II and Obizzo III after the Este returned to power in 1317. Her son Rinaldo d'Este (1333–1369) became a knight, and her daughter Jacopa married Trincia Trinci, signore of Foligno. Beatrice died at Ferrara around 1335, nine years before her husband.
zh: 贝亚特丽切·贡扎加（约1301—约1335）是曼托瓦贵族女子，圭多·贡扎加与阿涅塞·皮科之女。她嫁给尼科洛一世·埃斯特；1317年埃斯特家族重掌费拉拉后，尼科洛与兄弟里纳尔多二世、奥比佐三世共同统治该城。儿子里纳尔多·埃斯特（1333—1369）成为骑士，女儿雅各帕嫁给福利尼奥领主特林恰·特林奇。贝亚特丽切约1335年在费拉拉去世，比丈夫早九年。

en: Caterina Malatesta (c. 1300 – c. 1340) was an Italian noblewoman, the daughter of the condottiero Pandolfo I Malatesta, lord of Rimini, and Taddea da Rimini. After 1319 she became the second wife of Luigi I Gonzaga, first capitano del popolo of Mantua, tying his new signoria to the Malatesta lords of the Romagna. Their four children were Corrado, husband of Verde Beccaria and founder of the cadet line later made marquises of Palazzolo, Alberto, Luigia, who married Azzo I da Correggio, and Federico, who died in 1376, long after Caterina's death at Mantua around 1340.
zh: 卡泰丽娜·马拉泰斯塔（约1300—约1340）是意大利贵族女子，里米尼领主、雇佣兵首领潘多尔夫一世·马拉泰斯塔与塔代亚·达·里米尼之女。1319年后，她成为曼托瓦首位“人民首领”路易吉一世·贡扎加的第二任妻子，使新生的贡扎加政权与罗马涅的马拉泰斯塔领主联姻。两人育有四个子女：科拉多娶韦尔德·贝卡里亚，是后来成为帕拉佐洛侯爵的旁支始祖；此外还有阿尔贝托、嫁给阿佐一世·达·科雷焦的路易贾，以及1376年去世的费德里科。卡泰丽娜约1340年在曼托瓦去世，远早于费德里科。

en: Corrado Gonzaga was an Italian condottiero born in Mantua, the son of Luigi I Gonzaga, the city's first capitano del popolo, and Caterina Malatesta. His father cut him out of the succession to Mantua, which passed through his brother's line. In 1340 he married Verde Beccaria, daughter of Lodrisio Beccaria, a noble of Pavia. Their son Filippino carried on his branch, and Corrado is counted the founder of the cadet Gonzaga line whose descendants became marquises of Palazzolo in 1595.
zh: 科拉多·贡扎加是生于曼托瓦的意大利雇佣兵统帅，为曼托瓦首任平民首领卢伊吉一世·贡扎加与卡泰丽娜·马拉泰斯塔之子。父亲将他排除在曼托瓦继承权之外，领地由其兄弟一系承袭。1340年，他迎娶帕维亚贵族洛德里西奥·贝卡里亚之女韦尔德·贝卡里亚，生子菲利皮诺延续支系。科拉多被视为贡扎加家族旁支始祖，其后代于1595年成为帕拉佐洛侯爵。

en: Federico Gonzaga (died c. 1376) was a Mantuan condottiero, a son of Luigi I Gonzaga, the city's first capitano del popolo, and Caterina Malatesta of Rimini. In 1354 he joined the conspiracy that Fregnano della Scala raised against Cangrande della Scala, lord of Verona. In 1376 he plotted again, this time against his own nephew Ludovico II Gonzaga of Mantua, together with Odoardo and Guglielmo Gonzaga, sons of Feltrino. The courtier Guido Cavriani uncovered the scheme; Federico was condemned to death but escaped, dying around the same year.
zh: 费德里科·贡扎加（？—约1376）是曼托瓦雇佣兵首领，曼托瓦首位“人民首领”路易吉一世·贡扎加与里米尼的卡泰丽娜·马拉泰斯塔之子。1354年，他参与弗雷尼亚诺·德拉·斯卡拉针对维罗纳领主坎格兰德·德拉·斯卡拉的阴谋。1376年，他又与费尔特里诺之子奥多阿尔多、古列尔莫·贡扎加合谋，反对自己的侄子、曼托瓦领主卢多维科二世。阴谋被廷臣圭多·卡夫里亚尼揭发，费德里科被判处死刑却成功逃走，约于同年去世。

en: Feltrino Gonzaga (c. 1305–1374), third son of Mantua's first capitano del popolo Luigi I Gonzaga, founded the Gonzaga line of Novellara. In 1328 he helped drive the Bonacolsi from Mantua and married Antonia da Correggio. From 1335 he held Reggio Emilia, where he demolished the San Nazario quarter to build a great citadel and in 1345 resisted Mastino della Scala. In 1363 he led an anti-Visconti league to victory at Solara, and in 1366 Charles IV made him imperial vicar. His harsh rule had turned the Reggiani against him, and when Bernabò Visconti besieged the city in 1370 and again in 1371, his allies failed him. Rather than yield to the Este, who had joined Bernabò, he surrendered to his old enemy and on 17 May 1371 sold Reggio for fifty thousand gold florins, keeping Novellara and Bagnolo. He spent his last years wandering the cities of northern Italy in poverty and died in Padua in 1374.
zh: 费尔特里诺·贡扎加（约1305—1374）是曼托瓦首位“人民首领”路易吉一世·贡扎加的第三子，诺瓦拉拉贡扎加家族旁支的始祖。1328年他参与将博纳科尔西家族逐出曼托瓦，并娶安东尼娅·达·科雷焦为妻。1335年起他领有雷焦艾米利亚，拆掉圣纳扎里奥街区，修起一座雄伟的城堡，1345年又抵挡住马斯蒂诺·德拉·斯卡拉的进攻。1363年他率领反维斯孔蒂联盟在索拉拉获胜，1366年被查理四世任命为帝国代理人。他的严苛统治使雷焦居民离心离德；1370年和1371年贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂两度围城，盟友纷纷背弃了他。他不愿向与贝尔纳博联手的埃斯特家族屈膝，转而向宿敌投降，于1371年5月17日以五万金弗罗林出售雷焦，仅保留诺瓦拉拉和巴尼奥洛。晚年他漂泊于意大利北部各城，穷困潦倒，1374年卒于帕多瓦。

en: Filippino Gonzaga (died 5 April 1356) was a Mantuan condottiero and a son of Luigi I Gonzaga, Mantua's first capitano del popolo. His marriage in 1322 to Anna Dovara brought the Gonzaga the lands of Isola Dovarese and their first foothold in the Cremonese region, including Sabbioneta and Viadana. In August 1328 he and his brothers helped their father drive out Rinaldo Bonacolsi. In 1342 he married his daughter Gigliola to Matteo II Visconti of Milan and then fought for the Visconti against the della Scala and, in 1350, Bologna. Widowed in 1354, he married Verena of Habsburg-Laufenburg, connecting the Gonzaga to imperial circles. He died in Mantua in 1356 and was buried in its cathedral.
zh: 菲利皮诺·贡扎加（1356年4月5日卒）是曼托瓦雇佣兵首领，曼托瓦首位“人民首领”路易吉一世之子。1322年他娶安娜·多瓦拉，婚姻带来了伊索拉多瓦雷塞的领地，使贡扎加家族首次在克雷莫纳地区立足，获得萨比奥内塔、维亚达纳等地。1328年8月，他与兄弟们协助父亲驱逐里纳尔多·博纳科尔西。1342年他把女儿吉廖拉嫁给米兰的马泰奥二世·维斯孔蒂，此后随维斯孔蒂家族对斯卡拉家族作战，1350年又参加攻打博洛尼亚。1354年丧偶后续娶哈布斯堡-劳芬堡的韦雷娜，使贡扎加家族与帝国圈层联姻。他于1356年在曼托瓦去世，葬于当地大教堂。

en: Gigliola Gonzaga, also called Egidiola (c. 1325 – c. 1377), was the eldest daughter of the Mantuan condottiero Filippino Gonzaga and Anna Dovara. In 1342 her father married her to Matteo II Visconti, and as his wife she was co-consort of Milan alongside the wives of Galeazzo II and Bernabò Visconti. Her daughters were Caterina, who later married Ugolino Gonzaga, and Andreola, who became a nun. Widowed in 1355 when Matteo died, probably poisoned by his brothers at Saronno, she returned to Mantua and disputed her mother's Cremonese border lands with her Gonzaga kinsmen until the family absorbed them.
zh: 吉廖拉·贡扎加（约1325—约1377），一作埃吉迪奥拉，是曼托瓦雇佣兵首领菲利皮诺·贡扎加与安娜·多瓦拉的长女。1342年，父亲将她嫁给马泰奥二世·维斯孔蒂；作为马泰奥之妻，她与加莱亚佐二世、贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂的妻子同为米兰的共同领主夫人。两个女儿中，卡泰丽娜后来嫁给乌戈利诺·贡扎加，安德莱奥拉成为修女。1355年马泰奥在萨罗诺城堡疑被众兄弟毒杀，吉廖拉寡居后返回曼托瓦，为继承母亲的克雷莫纳边境领地与贡扎加亲族长期争执，这些土地最终被家族吞并。

en: Guido Corradi da Gonzaga, also called Corrado (died Mantua, 1318), was an Italian landowner of the Corradi-Gonzaga family, from which came the Gonzaga lords of Mantua. Son of Antonio Corradi and Richilde Pedroni, and a friend of Mantua's Bonacolsi rulers, he raised his house's standing through friendship pacts with the cities neighboring Mantua. By his first wife Estrambina di San Martino he had several children, including Luigi (1268–1360), who after Guido's death became the first Gonzaga captain of the people of Mantua and founded the dynasty that ruled from 1328, and Petronio, a canon of Como.
zh: 圭多·科拉迪·达·贡扎加，又称科拉多（？—1318，卒于曼托瓦），是科拉迪-贡扎加家族的意大利地主，曼托瓦历代贡扎加领主即出自该家族。他是安东尼奥·科拉迪与里基尔达·佩德罗尼之子，与曼托瓦的博纳科尔西统治者交好，并通过与周边城市缔结友好盟约提升了家族声望。他与第一任妻子圣马蒂诺的埃斯特兰比娜育有数子，包括卢多维科（1268—1360）和曾任科莫主教座堂法政牧师的彼得罗尼奥。圭多死后，卢多维科成为贡扎加家族首任曼托瓦平民首领，并开创了1328年起统治该城的王朝。

en: Guido Gonzaga (1290–1369) was the eldest son of Ludovico I Gonzaga, who made the family masters of Mantua. Podestà of Mantua in 1328 and also of Reggio Emilia, he became lord of the latter in 1335. He reached the head of Mantua only in 1360, at seventy, as its second capitano del popolo, ruling beside his son Ugolino, who most likely held the real power until two of Guido's other sons, Francesco and Ludovico, murdered him in October 1362. In 1368 Barnabò Visconti occupied Mantua, and Emperor Charles IV had to intervene to free it; the Peace of Bologna then added Cavriana, Solferino, Medole and other lands to the city. Guido died in 1369 and was succeeded by his son Ludovico II, whose mother was Beatrice of Bar.
zh: 圭多·贡扎加（1290—1369）是卢多维科一世的长子，其父使贡扎加家族成为曼托瓦之主。他于1328年任曼托瓦行政长官，也曾任雷焦艾米利亚行政长官，1335年成为后者的领主。直到1360年，年已七旬的他才作为曼托瓦第二位“人民首领”执掌该城，与儿子乌戈利诺共同统治，实权很可能掌握在乌戈利诺手中，直到后者于1362年10月被圭多的另外两个儿子弗朗切斯科和卢多维科刺杀。1368年贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂占领曼托瓦，皇帝查理四世出面干预才使该城获释；随后签订的《博洛尼亚和约》将卡夫里亚纳、索尔费里诺、梅多莱等地划归曼托瓦。圭多于1369年去世，其子卢多维科二世继位，后者的母亲是巴尔的贝阿特丽切。

en: Ludovico II Gonzaga (1334–1382) was the third capitano del popolo of Mantua. A son of Guido Gonzaga and Beatrice of Bar, on 14 October 1362 he and his brother Francesco murdered their elder brother Ugolino at a dinner; Francesco died in mysterious circumstances in 1368, leaving Ludovico sole heir. Succeeding in 1369, he allied Mantua with Bernabò Visconti, married Alda d'Este of Ferrara, wedded his son Francesco to Visconti's daughter Agnese, opened trade with Venice and strengthened his fortresses. He survived noble plots in 1373 and 1376 and died on 4 October 1382.
zh: 卢多维科二世·贡扎加（1334—1382）是曼托瓦第三位“人民首领”，圭多·贡扎加与巴尔的贝阿特丽切之子。1362年10月14日，他与兄弟弗朗切斯科在晚宴上谋杀了兄长乌戈利诺；1368年弗朗切斯科也神秘死去，卢多维科遂成为唯一继承人。1369年继位后，他让曼托瓦与贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂结盟，娶费拉拉的阿尔达·埃斯特为妻，又让儿子弗朗切斯科迎娶维斯孔蒂之女阿涅塞，同时与威尼斯通商、加固境内城防。他躲过1373年和1376年的贵族阴谋，于1382年10月4日去世。

en: Ludovico I Gonzaga (1268–1360) founded Gonzaga rule in Mantua. A son of Guido Corradi, on 16 August 1328 he drove out Rinaldo Bonacolsi with Ghibelline troops lent by Cangrande I della Scala and the help of his father-in-law Guglielmo Azzone Panebarco. Twelve days later Mantua's citizens elected him capitano del popolo. In 1329 Emperor Louis IV named him imperial vicar, and in 1335 he became lord of Reggio Emilia. He backed the Visconti at Parabiago in 1339, aided Pisa against Florence in 1342, and hosted Petrarch in Mantua in 1349. In his later years he fought Bernabò Visconti. He died in 1360 and was succeeded in Mantua by his son Guido, while another son, Feltrino, held Reggio Emilia.
zh: 卢多维科一世·贡扎加（1268—1360）是在曼托瓦建立贡扎加家族统治的意大利贵族。他是圭多·科拉迪之子，1328年8月16日借助坎格兰德一世·德拉·斯卡拉的吉伯林军队与岳父古列尔莫·阿佐内·潘内巴尔科的帮助，驱逐里纳尔多·博纳科尔西。十二天后，他被曼托瓦市民选为“人民首领”。1329年皇帝路易四世任命他为帝国代理人，1335年他又成为雷焦艾米利亚领主。1339年他支持维斯孔蒂家族打赢帕拉比亚戈战役，1342年帮助比萨抵御佛罗伦萨，1349年在曼托瓦接待来访的诗人彼特拉克。晚年他与贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂交战。1360年他去世，其子圭多在曼托瓦继位，另一子费尔特里诺则掌管雷焦艾米利亚。

en: Margherita Gonzaga was a Mantuan noblewoman, the daughter of Guido Gonzaga, capitano del popolo of Mantua, and Beatrice of Bar. In 1353 she became the second wife of Jacopino da Carrara, signore of Padua, who ruled the city jointly with his nephew Francesco I da Carrara. In October 1354 Jacopino and Francesco led a Venetian league against the Visconti of Milan. Rivalry over the succession, sharpened by Margherita's quarrels with Francesco's wife Fina Buzzaccarini, ended in 1355 when Francesco uncovered a plot and jailed Jacopino. Margherita fled to Mantua with her son Jacopo, who died in Puglia in 1385.
zh: 玛格丽塔·贡扎加是曼托瓦贵族女子，曼托瓦“人民首领”圭多·贡扎加与巴尔的贝阿特丽切之女。1353年，她嫁给帕多瓦领主雅各皮诺·达·卡拉拉，成为其第二任妻子；雅各皮诺与侄子弗朗切斯科一世·达·卡拉拉共同统治帕多瓦。1354年10月，叔侄二人率领威尼斯组建的联军对抗米兰的维斯孔蒂家族。继承权之争因玛格丽塔与弗朗切斯科之妻菲娜·布扎卡里尼的冲突而激化，1355年弗朗切斯科破获雅各皮诺的阴谋并将其下狱，玛格丽塔带着儿子雅各波逃回曼托瓦。雅各波于1385年在普利亚去世。

en: Richilda Ramberti, known as the Brescianina (1269–1319), was an Italian noblewoman born in Brescia into the Ghibelline Ramberti family. Her father Ramberto Ramberti was a condottiero and podestà of Modena serving Mantua's Bonacolsi. In 1312 she married Ludovico I Gonzaga. Their children included Guido, the second captain of the people of Mantua, Filippino, Feltrino, ancestor of the Gonzaga of Novellara, and Tommasina. Richilda brought the Gonzaga important estates in Brescia and Ferrara. She died in Mantua in 1319, before her husband.
zh: 里基尔达·兰贝蒂，绰号“布雷夏尼娜”（1269—1319），是生于布雷西亚的意大利贵族女性，出身吉伯林派的兰贝蒂家族。父亲兰贝托·兰贝蒂是佣兵首领，曾代表曼托瓦的博纳科尔西家族任摩德纳执政官。1312年她嫁给卢多维科一世·贡扎加，子女包括曼托瓦第二任平民首领圭多、菲利皮诺、诺韦拉拉贡扎加支系的始祖费尔特里诺，以及托马西娜。她为贡扎加家族带来布雷西亚和费拉拉的大片地产，1319年先于丈夫在曼托瓦去世。

en: Tommasina Gonzaga was a Mantuan noblewoman, the daughter of Luigi I Gonzaga, Mantua's first capitano del popolo, and Richilda Ramberti. In 1319 she married Guglielmo Azzone Castelbarco, a condottiero serving the della Scala of Verona, who on 16 August 1328 led a band of Veronese troops that helped expel the Bonacolsi from Mantua and bring the Gonzaga to power. In 1333 the couple hosted Charles IV of Luxembourg, the future emperor, at their castle of Avio. She died in 1372, leaving six children.
zh: 托马西娜·贡扎加是曼托瓦贵族女子，曼托瓦首位“人民首领”路易吉一世·贡扎加与里基尔达·兰贝尔蒂之女。1319年，她嫁给为维罗纳斯卡拉家族效力的雇佣兵首领古列尔莫·阿佐内·卡斯泰尔巴科；1328年8月16日，古列尔莫率领一队维罗纳武装参与驱逐博纳科尔西家族、扶植贡扎加家族统治曼托瓦的行动。1333年，夫妇二人在阿维奥城堡接待后来成为皇帝的卢森堡的查理四世。她于1372年去世，留下六个子女。

en: Tommasina Gonzaga was a Mantuan noblewoman, the second daughter of Guido Gonzaga, capitano del popolo of Mantua, and Agnese Pico of the Pico della Mirandola. In February 1340 she married the condottiero Azzo da Correggio, who with della Scala support took Parma in 1341 and ruled it until he ceded the city to Obizzo III d'Este of Ferrara in 1344. They had seven children, among them Ludovico, a condottiero in Visconti service who died in 1375, and Giberto, podestà of Milan in 1372, who died in 1402.
zh: 托马西娜·贡扎加是曼托瓦贵族女子，曼托瓦“人民首领”圭多·贡扎加与皮科·德拉·米兰多拉家族的阿涅塞·皮科的次女。1340年2月，她嫁给雇佣兵首领阿佐·达·科雷焦；阿佐在斯卡拉家族支持下于1341年夺取帕尔马，统治至1344年将该城让给费拉拉的奥比佐三世·埃斯特。两人育有七个子女，其中卢多维科是为维斯孔蒂家族效力的雇佣兵首领，1375年去世；吉贝尔托于1372年出任米兰行政长官，1402年去世。

en: Ugolino Gonzaga (1320–1362), a Mantuan condottiero, was the son of Guido Gonzaga, Mantua's second capitano del popolo, and Beatrice of Bar. He was the Gonzaga who bound the family to Milan. In 1340 he married Verde della Scala, daughter of Mastino II, yet in 1342–1343 he fought beside the Milanese against the Scaligers in Tuscany. After Verde's death he married Emilia della Gherardesca, and when Emilia died in 1349 he wed Caterina Visconti, daughter of Matteo II Visconti and niece of Bernabò. That Visconti alliance lasted into the early sixteenth century. From 1360 he governed Mantua with his aged father, most likely as its real ruler. Venice disliked the alliance and backed a plot, and on 13 October 1362 his brothers Francesco and Ludovico, with the Castelbarco family's support, murdered him.
zh: 乌戈利诺·贡扎加（1320—1362）是曼托瓦雇佣兵首领，曼托瓦第二位“人民首领”圭多·贡扎加与巴尔的贝阿特丽切之子，也是把贡扎加家族与米兰绑在一起的人。1340年他娶马斯蒂诺二世·德拉·斯卡拉之女韦尔黛为妻，1342至1343年却随米兰军在托斯卡纳与斯卡拉家族作战。韦尔黛去世后，他娶埃米莉娅·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡；埃米莉娅于1349年去世，他又娶马泰奥二世·维斯孔蒂之女、贝尔纳博的侄女卡泰丽娜。这一与维斯孔蒂家族的同盟一直延续到16世纪初。1360年起，他与年迈的父亲共同治理曼托瓦，很可能才是实际的统治者。威尼斯不喜欢这一同盟，支持了一场阴谋：1362年10月13日，乌戈利诺被兄弟弗朗切斯科和卢多维科在卡斯泰尔巴科家族协助下刺杀。

en: Rinchen, also called Lhachen Rinchan Bhoti, was a Ladakhi Buddhist nobleman. After his father and kinsmen were murdered by the Kalamanya clan, he feigned peace to avenge them before seeking his fortune in Kashmir. In the chaos after a Mongol invasion he seized the Kashmir throne in 1320, founding the Kashmir Sultanate. He later converted to Islam under the influence of the Sufi Bulbul Shah, becoming the valley's first Muslim ruler and taking the name Sadr al-Din Shah. He built the Big Mosque and died on 25 November 1323, leaving his son Haidar Khan to Shah Mir's care.
zh: 仁钦，一称拉钦·仁钦·波提，是拉达克的佛教贵族。父亲与亲族被卡拉曼亚氏族害死后，他假意讲和、设计复仇，随后前往克什米尔谋求发展。趁蒙古入侵后的乱局，他于1320年夺取克什米尔王位，开创克什米尔苏丹国。此后他在苏菲派修士布尔布尔·沙阿影响下皈依伊斯兰教，改名萨德尔丁·沙阿，成为克什米尔谷地首位穆斯林统治者。他主持修建大清真寺，于1323年11月25日去世，幼子海达尔汗被托付给沙阿·米尔。

en: Marc-Pierre de Voyer de Paulmy, comte d'Argenson (1696–1764), was Louis XV's reforming secretary of state for war. After heading the Paris police and the royal book censorship, he enjoyed the goodwill of the philosophes. Made war minister in 1743, during the War of the Austrian Succession he reorganized the army after consulting Marshal Saxe, revived local militias to aid recruitment, was present at Fontenoy in 1745, and founded the École royale du génie at Mézières to train military engineers. After the war he standardized the artillery and established an officer training school. He also laid out the Place de la Concorde. Dismissed after the 1757 Damiens plot against the king, he died in 1764, days after returning from exile.
zh: 马克-皮埃尔·德·瓦耶·德·波尔米，阿尔让松伯爵（1696—1764），是路易十五手下锐意改革的陆军大臣。他曾掌管巴黎警务和王室书籍审查，受到启蒙哲士的好感。1743年，正值奥地利王位继承战争，他被任命为陆军大臣，在征询萨克森元帅后整顿军队，恢复地方民兵以协助征募，1745年亲临丰特努瓦战场，并在梅济耶尔创办王家工兵学校培养军事工程师。战后他统一炮兵制度，创办军官学校。他还主持规划了协和广场。1757年达米安刺杀国王未遂后他被解职，1764年在流放归来数日后去世。

en: Martin Luther (1483–1546), born at Eisleben, was an Augustinian friar ordained priest in 1507 and a theology professor at Wittenberg. In 1517 his Ninety-five Theses attacked the sale of indulgences and sparked the Protestant Reformation. He refused Pope Leo X's demand to recant his writings and was excommunicated in 1521; at the Diet of Worms he again refused to recant before Emperor Charles V and was declared an outlaw. Sheltered at the Wartburg, he translated the New Testament into German, completing the full Bible in 1534. His teaching of justification by faith alone and his marriage to Katharina von Bora shaped Lutheranism.
zh: 马丁·路德（1483—1546）生于艾斯莱本，原是奥古斯丁会修士，1507年受任神父，在维滕贝格教授神学。1517年，他的《九十五条论纲》抨击赎罪券买卖，引发新教改革。他拒绝教皇利奥十世撤回著作的要求，1521年被革除教籍；在沃尔姆斯帝国议会上，他再次拒绝在皇帝查理五世面前撤回著作，并被宣判为不受法律保护之人。隐居瓦尔特堡期间，他将《新约》译成德语，1534年完成全本《圣经》。他主张因信称义，并与卡塔琳娜·冯·博拉结婚，其学说奠定了路德宗的基础。

en: Matteo Ricci (1552–1610) was an Italian Jesuit and a founder of the Jesuit China mission. At the Roman College he studied mathematics and astronomy under Christopher Clavius; he sailed from Lisbon in 1578 and reached Goa that year. He reached Macau in 1582, mastered Chinese, and settled at Zhaoqing with Michele Ruggieri in 1583, where he made his first Chinese world map in 1584. Moving north via Nanchang and Nanjing, he entered Beijing in 1601 and served the Wanli Emperor as astronomer and cartographer, publishing the enlarged Kunyu Wanguo Quantu in 1602. He stressed parallels between Catholicism and Confucian teaching and worked with Xu Guangqi to translate Euclid's Elements into Chinese. He died in Beijing in 1610.
zh: 利玛窦（1552—1610）是意大利籍耶稣会士，耶稣会在华传教事业的奠基人之一。他在罗马学院师从克里斯托弗·克拉维乌斯学习数学和天文学，1578年从里斯本乘船出发，同年抵达果阿。1582年他抵达澳门，熟习汉语，1583年与罗明坚定居肇庆，并于1584年绘制了第一幅中文世界地图。此后他经南昌、南京北上，1601年进入北京，以天文、制图之学侍奉万历帝，1602年刊行了增订的《坤舆万国全图》。他着力阐明天主教与儒家义理的相通之处，并与徐光启合作将欧几里得《几何原本》译成中文。1610年，利玛窦在北京去世。

en: Maximilien de Béthune, first Duke of Sully (1560–1641), was a Huguenot nobleman born near Mantes who became Henry of Navarre's closest counselor from 1571. During the St Bartholomew's Day Massacre in 1572, he escaped by carrying a Catholic book of hours. He fought through the Wars of Religion and was wounded at Ivry in 1590, advising Henry's conversion to Catholicism while refusing his own. From 1596 he reformed royal finances, becoming superintendent in 1601 and balancing the budget while promoting agriculture, roads and the Canal de Briare. He curbed abuses in tax collection and built bridges as well as roads. Made a duke and peer in 1606, he resigned after Henry IV's assassination in 1610; named a marshal in 1634, he died at Villebon in 1641.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/叙利公爵马克西米利安·德·贝蒂纳
zh: 第一代叙利公爵马克西米连·德·贝蒂讷（1560—1641）是胡格诺派贵族，生于芒特附近，自1571年起追随纳瓦拉的亨利，成为他最亲信的谋臣。1572年圣巴托罗缪大屠杀期间，他携带天主教祈祷书躲过追杀。宗教战争期间他为亨利率军作战，1590年在伊夫里战役负伤；他劝说亨利改宗天主教，自己却始终拒绝改宗。1596年起他整顿王室财政，1601年出任财政总监，在实现收支平衡的同时推动农业、道路建设和布里亚尔运河工程。他整治税收弊端，并修建道路和桥梁。1606年他受封公爵和法兰西重臣。1610年亨利四世遇刺后他便辞职；1634年获授法国元帅衔，1641年在维尔邦去世。

en: Casimir I of Kuyavia (c. 1211–1267) was a Piast prince and second son of Konrad I of Masovia. He received Kuyavia from his father in 1233 and Ląd in 1239 with Constance, daughter of Henry II the Pious. After Konrad died in 1247 he took Sieradz-Łęczyca and Dobrzyń (1248) from his brothers. His 1250s bid to Christianize the Yotvingians failed amid Teutonic opposition, so he settled Templars at Łuków. A coalition led by Bolesław the Pious forced him to promise to cede Ląd in 1259; he refused to do so until another attack in 1261. His third wife, Euphrosyne of Opole, bore Władysław I the Elbow-high, the future king of reunited Poland.
zh: 库亚维的卡齐米日一世（约1211—1267）是皮亚斯特王公，马佐夫舍的康拉德一世次子。1233年父亲把库亚维封给他；1239年他娶虔诚者亨里克二世之女康斯坦丝，得到隆德城堡领作为嫁妆。1247年康拉德死后，他从兄弟手中夺取谢拉兹—文奇察，1248年又夺取多布任。1250年代，他试图使雅特维格人皈依基督教，因条顿骑士团反对而失败，于是在武库夫安置圣殿骑士团。1259年虔诚者博莱斯瓦夫率领的联军迫使他承诺割让隆德；他拒绝履约，直到1261年联军再次进攻才交出。第三任妻子奥波莱的叶芙洛茜妮为他生下后来重新统一波兰的国王瓦迪斯瓦夫一世“矮子”。

en: Konrad I (c. 1187–1247), youngest son of Casimir II the Just, was duke of Masovia from 1194 and Kuyavia from 1205. In 1205 he and his brother Leszek the White defeated Roman the Great of Galicia–Volhynia at Zawichost, where Roman was killed. His campaigns against pagan Prussia in 1209, 1219 and 1222 failed amid border raids; Prussian incursions even threatened his residence at Płock. In 1226 he invited the Teutonic Order to conquer Chełmno Land and subdue the Prussians. Its master sought confirmation of the order's rights from emperor and pope, and Frederick II issued the Golden Bull of Rimini. He seized the Kraków seniorate as high duke in 1229–1232 and again in 1241–1243, and died in 1247.
zh: 康拉德一世（约1187—1247）是“正义者”卡齐米日二世的幼子，自1194年任马佐夫舍公爵，1205年起兼领库亚维亚。1205年，他与兄长“白者”莱谢克在扎维霍斯特击败加利西亚-沃里尼亚的罗曼大帝，罗曼战死。他在1209、1219和1222年征伐异教普鲁士均告失败，普鲁士人的入侵甚至威胁到他在普沃茨克的住所。1226年，他邀请条顿骑士团征服海乌姆诺地区、制服普鲁士人。骑士团团长要求皇帝与教廷确认其权利，腓特烈二世颁布了《里米尼金玺诏书》。他于1229—1232年及1241—1243年两度据有克拉科夫大公之位，1247年去世。

en: Hugo V was Count of Montfort-Bregenz, the son of Count Ulrich I, who died in 1287. He began ruling Bregenz in 1294 and acquired the Bregenzerwald as a pledge in 1307. In 1311 he bought Staufen Castle in the Upper Allgäu from Marquard von Schellenberg and founded the collegiate chapter of Staufen. He secured a market privilege for Bregenz in 1330. When he died on 26 July 1338, the Montfort-Bregenz line became extinct, and the Bregenz lands were divided among the surviving branches of the Montfort counts.
zh: 雨果五世是蒙特福特-布雷根茨伯爵，1287年去世的乌尔里希一世之子。他于1294年开始统治布雷根茨，1307年取得布雷根茨森林的质押权。1311年，他从马尔夸德·冯·谢伦伯格手中购得上阿尔高的施陶芬城堡，并创立了施陶芬法政牧师团。1330年，他为布雷根茨取得集市特权。1338年7月26日他去世后，蒙特福特-布雷根茨支系绝嗣，布雷根茨领地被蒙特福特家族的其他支系瓜分。

en: Ulrich I, Count of Montfort-Bregenz (died 7 April 1287), was a Swabian nobleman of the Montfort house, a cadet line of the counts palatine of Tübingen, and ruled the Bregenz lands in Vorarlberg. He was the second son of Count Hugo II of Montfort-Bregenz and Elisabeth of Burgau; his brothers included Friedrich, bishop of Chur from 1282, and Wilhelm, prince-abbot of St. Gallen from 1281. Before 1272 he married Agnes of Helfenstein, who bore him his successor Hugo V (died 1338), and he also left an illegitimate daughter, Katharina.
zh: 乌尔里克一世，蒙特福特-布雷根茨伯爵（？—1287年4月7日），是士瓦本贵族蒙特福特家族的成员，该家族为图宾根行宫伯爵的旁支，他统有福拉尔贝格的布雷根茨领地。他是蒙特福特-布雷根茨伯爵雨果二世与布尔高的伊丽莎白的次子，兄弟包括1282年起任库尔主教的腓特烈，以及1281年起任圣加伦亲王修道院长的威廉。1272年之前他娶黑尔芬施泰因的阿格妮丝为妻，生下继承人雨果五世（卒于1338年），另有一私生女卡塔琳娜。

en: Brian Bóruma, known as Brian Boru (c. 941–23 April 1014), made himself king of his native Munster by 978, then subdued Dublin, Leinster and the northern Uí Néill. In 1002 Máel Sechnaill mac Domnaill acknowledged him high king of Ireland at Athlone, ending the Uí Néill hold on the high kingship. In 1014 his army met the Norsemen of Dublin and their Leinster allies at Clontarf, near Dublin: Brian's forces won, but the elderly king himself was killed in the battle. He founded the O'Brien dynasty.
zh: 布赖恩·博鲁（约941—1014年4月23日）在故土芒斯特起家，于978年成为芒斯特国王，随后压服都柏林、伦斯特和北方的尼尔诸王。1002年，麦尔·舍赫奈尔·马克·多姆奈尔在阿斯隆承认他为爱尔兰至高王，尼尔家族对至尊王位的把持就此终结。1014年，他的军队在都柏林附近的克隆塔夫迎战都柏林诺斯人及其伦斯特盟友：布赖恩一方获胜，但年迈的国王本人战死阵中。他是奥布莱恩王朝的开创者。

en: Cormac MacCarthy Mor (1271–1359) of the MacCarthy dynasty ruled as Prince of Desmond from 1325 until his death. In that same year Diarmaid Óg MacCarthy was murdered in the courtroom at Tralee by Maurice FitzMaurice, 4th Baron Kerry, who was attainted by the Dublin parliament and forfeited his lands. Cormac's sons included Donal Og MacCarthy Mor, who succeeded him and ruled Desmond until 1391, and Dermot MacCarthy, the first Lord of Muskerry (1340–1381).
zh: 科马克·麦卡锡·莫尔（1271—1359）是麦卡锡家族成员，1325年起任德斯蒙德亲王，直至去世。就在1325年，迪尔梅德·奥格·麦卡锡在特拉利的法庭内被第四代凯里男爵莫里斯·菲茨莫里斯杀害，后者被都柏林议会判处剥夺公权，领地遭没收。科马克的儿子包括多纳尔·奥格·麦卡锡·莫尔和德莫特·麦卡锡（1340—1381）：前者继承父位，统治德斯蒙德至1391年；后者成为第一代马斯克里领主。

en: Diarmait Ua Briain (c. 1060–1118) was a son of Toirdelbach Ua Briain, king of Munster. After their father died in 1086 his brother Muirchertach drove him into exile, and he is thought to have led the Irish fleet that helped Rhys ap Tewdwr win the Battle of Mynydd Carn in Wales. Reconciled in 1093, he ruled Waterford as dux, and in 1114 he took the kingship of Munster when Muirchertach fell ill. Four years of civil war followed. He died at Cork in 1118, after which Toirdelbach Ua Conchobair invaded and partitioned Munster.
zh: 迪尔梅德·奥布莱恩（约1060—1118）是芒斯特国王托德尔巴赫·奥布莱恩之子。1086年父亲死后，他被兄长穆尔切赫特放逐，相传曾率领爱尔兰舰队在威尔士的米尼德卡恩之战中助里斯·阿普·图杜尔获胜。1093年双方和解，他以首领身份统治沃特福德，1114年趁穆尔切赫特病重取得芒斯特王位，随后陷入四年内战。他于1118年在科克去世，死后泰尔德巴赫·奥康乔巴尔入侵并瓜分了芒斯特。

en: Donnchad mac Briain (died 1064) was a son of Brian Boru and Gormflaith, a Leinster king's daughter. He survived the Battle of Clontarf in 1014, where his father and half-brother Murchad were killed, and made himself king of Munster; his rival half-brother Tadc was assassinated in 1023, reportedly on his order. He later fought Diarmait mac Maíl na mBó of Leinster and his nephew Toirdelbach Ua Briain. In 1058 Diarmait and his allies drove him from Limerick, with Toirdelbach present. Deposed in 1063, he went on pilgrimage to Rome, died in 1064, and was buried at Santo Stefano al Monte Celio.
zh: 邓查德·麦克·布赖恩（？—1064）是布赖恩·博鲁与伦斯特国王之女戈姆弗莱斯之子。他在1014年的克隆塔夫之战中生还，父亲和异母兄弟穆尔哈德在此役阵亡，他随后成为芒斯特国王；与他争位的异母兄弟塔德于1023年遇刺，《蒂厄纳赫编年史》称出自他的命令。他后来与伦斯特的迪尔梅德·麦克·马尔纳姆博及侄子托德尔巴赫·奥布莱恩交战。1058年，迪尔梅德及其盟军将他逐出利默里克，托德尔巴赫也在场。1063年他被废黜，前往罗马朝圣，1064年死于当地，葬于蒙特切利奥的圣斯德望堂。

en: Muirchertach Ua Briain (c. 1050–1119), son of Toirdelbach, ruled Dublin for his father and succeeded him as king of Munster in 1086. In 1101 he declared himself high king of Ireland, gave Cashel to the Church, and presided over a reforming synod at Cashel. He fought Domnall Ua Lochlainn of the Northern Uí Néill to a stalemate, while his fleets intervened in Wales and faced Norway's Magnus Barefoot in the Irish Sea. In 1114 illness let his brother Diarmait seize power; though he recovered, his nephew Toirdelbach Ua Conchobair partitioned Munster in 1118. He died at Lismore in 1119.
zh: 穆尔切赫特·奥布莱恩（约1050—1119）是托尔德巴赫之子，曾代父镇守都柏林，1086年继位为芒斯特国王。1101年他自立为爱尔兰最高国王，将卡舍尔岩堡赠予教会，并在卡舍尔主持改革教务会议。他与北方奥尼尔家族的多姆纳尔·乌阿·洛赫莱因长期交战，终成僵持，同时派舰队介入威尔士，并在爱尔兰海与挪威的“赤脚王”马格努斯对峙。1114年他病重，兄弟迪尔梅德乘机夺权；他虽康复，外甥托尔德巴赫·奥康瑙尔仍于1118年瓜分芒斯特。1119年他卒于利斯莫尔。

en: Tadc mac Briain (died 1023) was a son of Brian Boru by his wife Echrad. After his father's death at Clontarf in 1014, he was a leading contender for the kingship of Munster, rivalling his half-brother Donnchad mac Briain. By his wife Mór he fathered Toirdelbach Ua Briain, who later became king of Munster and one of Ireland's most powerful kings. Tadc was assassinated in 1023 at Donnchad's instigation.
zh: 塔德·麦克·布赖恩（？—1023）是布赖恩·博鲁与妻子埃赫拉德之子。1014年父亲在克隆塔夫战死后，他是芒斯特王位的有力争夺者，与异母兄弟邓查德·麦克·布赖恩分庭抗礼。他与妻子莫尔生有一子托德尔巴赫·奥布莱恩，后者后来成为芒斯特国王，是爱尔兰最有权势的国王之一。塔德于1023年在邓查德的主使下遇刺身亡。

en: Toirdelbach Ua Briain (1009–14 July 1086), grandson of Brian Bóruma, was king of Munster and effectively high king of Ireland. His father Tadc was killed in 1023, probably on the orders of his half-brother Donnchad, who seized Munster. Allied from the 1050s with Diarmait mac Maíl na mBó of Leinster, Toirdelbach wore Donnchad down and in 1063 drove him into exile to Rome. After Diarmait's death he became Ireland's master, installing his sons Muirchertach in Dublin and Diarmait in Waterford, and made and unmade kings of Connacht. He died at Kincora on 14 July 1086 after a long illness, leaving Muirchertach his successor.
zh: 托尔德巴赫·奥布莱恩（1009—1086年7月14日）是布赖恩·博鲁之孙，芒斯特国王，事实上的爱尔兰最高国王。其父塔德于1023年遇害，可能是奉其同父异母兄弟唐查德之命被杀；唐查德随即夺取芒斯特。自1050年代起，他与伦斯特的迪尔梅德结盟，逐步逼垮唐查德，于1063年将其放逐到罗马。迪尔梅德死后，他成为爱尔兰的主宰：儿子穆尔切赫特镇都柏林、迪尔梅德镇沃特福德，康诺特国王也由他废立。1086年7月14日他久病后卒于金科拉，穆尔切赫特继掌大权。

en: Toirdhealbhach mac Diarmada Ua Briain (died 1167), a son of Diarmait Ua Briain, was king of Munster from 1142. His brother Tadhg deposed him in 1151, but he recovered the kingship after Tadhg's death in 1154. In 1157 the high king Muirchertach Mac Lochlainn drove him out and divided Munster, until Ruaidrí Ua Conchobair of Connacht restored him in North Munster later that year. His own son Muirchertach deposed him in 1165, and he died in 1167 and was buried at Killaloe. Domnall Mór Ua Briain was one of his sons.
zh: 泰尔德巴赫·麦克·迪尔马达·奥布莱恩（？—1167）是迪尔梅德·奥布莱恩之子，1142年起成为芒斯特国王。1151年他被兄弟塔德废黜，1154年塔德死后复位。1157年，至高王穆尔切赫特·麦克·洛克伦将他驱逐并瓜分芒斯特，同年康诺特国王鲁艾德里·奥康乔巴尔出兵，助他在北芒斯特复位。1165年他被儿子穆尔切赫特废黜，1167年去世，葬于基拉卢。多姆纳尔·莫尔·奥布莱恩是他的儿子之一。

en: Wudayy ibn Jammaz was one of the twelve sons of Jammaz ibn Shihah, the long-ruling emir of Medina from the Banu Muhanna, descendants of the Prophet through Husayn. The quarrel over Jammaz's inheritance shaped his life. Around 1301 he and his brother Muqbil opposed the succession of the chosen heir, Mansur. By then Cairo had claimed the right to appoint Medina's emir, so each rival either sought Mamluk backing or struck while the holder was away. Wudayy seized Medina by force in 1316/7 and again in 1326/7, was acknowledged as co-emir in 1335, and from 1336 ruled as sole emir until his death in 1342/3. His rule was one of the few breaks in the hold of Mansur's descendants, who took the emirate back after him. Like Mecca, Medina depended on Egypt for its food, and its emirs answered to the emir of Mecca.
zh: 伍代·伊本·贾马兹是长期统治麦地那的埃米尔贾马兹·伊本·希哈的十二个儿子之一，出自巴努·穆罕纳家族，该家族经阿里之子侯赛因，上溯到先知穆罕默德。争夺父亲留下的位子，贯穿了他的一生。约1301年，贾马兹指定的继承人曼苏尔即位，他与兄弟穆格比勒起而反对。此时开罗已自认有权任命麦地那的埃米尔，各路对手要么设法争取马穆鲁克的支持，要么趁在位者外出时夺城。伍代于1316/7年和1326/7年两度以武力夺取麦地那，1335年获承认为共同埃米尔，1336年起成为唯一埃米尔，统治至1342/3年去世。他的执政是曼苏尔一系执掌麦地那期间少数的中断之一，他死后，该系重新夺回埃米尔之位。和麦加一样，麦地那的粮食依赖埃及供应，其埃米尔也受麦加埃米尔节制。

en: Abu Bakr ibn Shaikh 'Umar was the Somali sultan ruling Mogadishu when the Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta reached the city in 1331, at the height of its medieval prosperity. Ibn Battuta called him a Barbara, the medieval term for native Somalis, which fits the modern view that Mogadishu was a Somali town and not an Arab or Persian enclave. Ibn Battuta described Mogadishu as an exceedingly large city of wealthy merchants, famed for high-quality fabrics exported as far as Mamluk Egypt. He recorded that Sultan Abu Bakr spoke Somali and fluent Arabic alike, and kept a retinue of viziers, legal scholars, commanders and royal eunuchs.
zh: 阿布·贝克尔·伊本·谢赫·欧麦尔是摩加迪沙的索马里苏丹。1331年摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰抵达摩加迪沙时，正值该城中世纪繁荣的顶峰，在位的就是他。伊本·白图泰称他为“巴巴拉”，这是中世纪对本地索马里人的称呼，与现代学者认为摩加迪沙是索马里人的城镇、而非阿拉伯人或波斯人飞地的看法相符。伊本·白图泰称摩加迪沙是一座极大的城市，富商云集，以优质织物闻名，产品远销马穆鲁克埃及。他还记载，苏丹阿布·贝克尔既说索马里语，也能说流利的阿拉伯语，宫廷中配有维齐尔、教法学者、将领和王室宦官。

en: Ludwig von Braunschweig-Lüneburg (c. 1300–1346) was a Welf prince, a son of Duke Otto II the Strict, and from 1324 Bishop of Minden, the first of several Welf bishops there. Elected over the city's own candidate, he kept the see only through an arbitration by his brother Duke Otto III. His election was meant to bring Minden into step with the duchy against the Counts of Hoya, Wunstorf and Schaumburg, but it did not work out: Hoya troops destroyed his Neuhaus castle in 1335, and he quarreled with Minden's citizens. To defend against Hoya he built Schlüsselburg, granting the cathedral chapter, the noble advocate von dem Berge and the city joint rights over it to pay for construction. In 1332 his uncle Emperor Louis the Bavarian granted him Vehmic free-court rights. His finances never recovered, and in 1339 he placed the bishopric under his ducal brothers' guardianship, which lasted until 1348. He died at Walsrode in 1346.
zh: 路德维希·冯·不伦瑞克-吕讷堡（约1300—1346）是韦尔夫家族王公，不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵奥托二世（严苛者）之子，1324年起任明登主教，是明登数位韦尔夫出身的主教中的第一位。他击败明登城自行推举的候选人当选，最终靠兄长奥托三世公爵仲裁才坐稳主教之位。推举他本是希望明登与公国携手，对抗霍亚、温斯托夫和绍姆堡诸伯爵的威胁，结果并未如愿：霍亚军队1335年摧毁了他的诺伊豪斯城堡，他还与明登市民纷争不断。为抵御霍亚，他修建施吕塞尔堡，并为筹措建费，给予主教座堂参议会、贵族保护人冯·德姆·贝格和明登城共同处置权。1332年，其舅皇帝路易（巴伐利亚人）授予他菲默法庭的自由审判权。他的财政始终没有好转，1339年他将主教区置于诸公爵兄弟的监护之下，监护持续到1348年。1346年，他在瓦尔斯罗德去世。

en: Adelheid von Fischbach was the wife of Wilhelm IV von Manderscheid, lord of Manderscheid in the Eifel, and the mother of his daughter Agnes.
zh: 阿德莱德·冯·菲施巴赫是艾费尔曼德沙伊德领主威廉四世·冯·曼德沙伊德之妻，育有女儿阿格内丝。

en: Agnes von Manderscheid was the daughter of Wilhelm IV von Manderscheid, lord of Manderscheid in the Eifel, and his wife Adelheid von Fischbach.
zh: 阿格内丝·冯·曼德沙伊德是艾费尔曼德沙伊德领主威廉四世·冯·曼德沙伊德与妻子阿德莱德·冯·菲施巴赫之女。

en: Gertrud von Virneburg was a daughter of Count Hermann III von Virneburg and Lucardis von Nassau. She married the knight Wilhelm II, called Willekin, von Manderscheid, and her children included Wilhelm III, lord of Manderscheid, and Mechtild von Manderscheid.
zh: 格特鲁德·冯·菲尔讷堡是菲尔讷堡伯爵赫尔曼三世与卢卡迪斯·冯·拿骚之女，嫁给骑士威廉二世·冯·曼德沙伊德（人称小威勒金），子女包括曼德沙伊德领主威廉三世和梅希蒂尔德·冯·曼德沙伊德。

en: Jutta von Reuland was a noblewoman whose first husband was the knight Wilhelm III von Manderscheid, who died in 1313, by whom she had a son Wilhelm. She later married Johann I von Fels in Luxembourg, by whom she had Johann III von Fels.
zh: 尤塔·冯·罗伊兰特是贵族妇女，先嫁骑士威廉三世·冯·曼德沙伊德（1313年卒），生子威廉；后改嫁卢森堡的约翰一世·冯·费尔斯，生子约翰三世。

en: Wilhelm II, called Willekin, von Manderscheid (born 1247 or before 1256, attested until after 1270) was a knight of the Kerpen-Manderscheid family. He married Gertrud von Virneburg, daughter of a count of Virneburg, and fathered Wilhelm III, lord of Manderscheid.
zh: 威廉二世·冯·曼德沙伊德，人称小威勒金，生于1247年或1256年前，1270年后仍在世，是克尔彭-曼德沙伊德家族的骑士，娶格特鲁德·冯·菲尔讷堡，子为曼德沙伊德领主威廉三世。

en: Wilhelm III von Manderscheid (born before 1271, died 1313) was a knight of the Kerpen-Manderscheid family, the son of Wilhelm II and Gertrud von Virneburg, and the husband of Jutta von Reuland.
zh: 威廉三世·冯·曼德沙伊德（1271年前生，1313年卒）是克尔彭-曼德沙伊德家族的骑士，威廉二世与格特鲁德·冯·菲尔讷堡之子，尤塔·冯·罗伊兰特的丈夫。

en: Wilhelm IV von Manderscheid was a lord of Manderscheid in the Eifel, the son of Wilhelm III von Manderscheid and Jutta von Reuland, who later married Johann I von der Fels in Luxembourg. In 1328 Archbishop Baldwin of Trier enfeoffed Wilhelm jointly with his mother and stepfather with half of Ramstein Castle near Kordel, and the holders repeatedly pledged their shares in the following years. He married Adelheid von Fischbach, and their daughter was Agnes.
zh: 威廉四世·冯·曼德沙伊德是艾费尔地区曼德沙伊德的领主，威廉三世·冯·曼德沙伊德与尤塔·冯·罗伊兰特之子，母亲后来改嫁卢森堡的约翰一世·冯·德·费尔斯。1328年，特里尔大主教巴尔杜因将科德尔附近的拉姆施泰因城堡的一半作为封地封给威廉，与其母亲、继父共同持有，此后他们又多次抵押各自的份额。他娶阿德莱德·冯·菲施巴赫为妻，女儿名叫阿格内丝。

en: Izz al-Din Ajlan ibn Rumaythah (c. 1307–1375) became Emir of Mecca in 1343 or 1344, when he and his brother Thaqabah bought the emirate from their aged father Rumaythah for sixty thousand dirhams without the Mamluk sultan's approval. Thaqabah went to Egypt to seek recognition, but the sultan had him arrested and ordered Rumaythah restored. Ajlan fled to Yemen, where he disrupted shipping to Mecca, raising prices during the hajj. He returned in 1345 with a sultan's decree and took office without bloodshed. Thaqabah deposed him several times, and he spent 1359–1361 in Cairene prison. Restored in 1361, he made his son Ahmad coregent and in 1362 conquered Haly Ibn Yaqub, a feat no emir of Mecca had managed since Abu al-Futuh, who ruled 994–1039. In 1372 he handed Mecca to Ahmad, remaining named in the sermon until his death in October 1375.
zh: 伊兹丁·阿杰兰·伊本·鲁迈萨（约1307—1375）于1343或1344年成为麦加埃米尔：他与兄弟塞格拜未经马穆鲁克苏丹许可，以6万迪拉姆的价钱，从年迈的父亲鲁迈萨手中买下埃米尔之位。塞格拜赴埃及请求承认，苏丹却将他拘捕并下令恢复鲁迈萨的职位。阿杰兰逃往也门，干扰驶往麦加的船只，导致朝觐期间物价上涨。他于1345年携苏丹敕令返回，兵不血刃地接任。在与塞格拜的长期争斗中，他数度被废，1359至1361年被囚禁于开罗。1361年复位后，他立儿子艾哈迈德为共同埃米尔，1362年攻取哈利·伊本·叶尔孤卜，这是自阿布·法图赫（994—1039年在位）以来没有一位麦加埃米尔做到过的事。1372年他将麦加交给艾哈迈德，但聚礼讲道中仍保留其名，直至1375年10月去世。

en: Muhammad Abu Numayy I (c. 1232–1301) was Emir of Mecca from 1250, ruling first with his father Abu Sa'd and then his uncle Idris ibn Qatadah. In 1269 he submitted to the Mamluk sultan Baybars, who invested him. In 1270 he defeated and beheaded Idris at Khulays and began to rule alone. In 1271 Jammaz ibn Shihah of Medina captured Mecca, but Abu Numayy defeated him and retook the city after forty days. He defeated Jammaz again in 1276, and retook Mecca after Jammaz's brief seizure of the city in 1288. On 6 October 1301 he abdicated in favour of his sons Humaydah and Rumaythah and died two days later.
zh: 穆罕默德·阿布·努米一世（约1232—1301）自1250年起任麦加埃米尔，起初先后与父亲阿布·萨德、叔父伊德里斯·伊本·卡塔达共同执政。1269年，他臣服于马穆鲁克苏丹拜巴尔并获其册封。1270年，他在胡莱斯击败并斩杀伊德里斯，开始单独统治。1271年，麦地那埃米尔贾马兹·伊本·希哈攻占麦加，阿布·努米在40天后击败他并夺回城市。1276年，他再次击败贾马兹，并在1288年贾马兹短暂占据麦加后复位。1301年10月6日，他传位给儿子胡迈达和鲁迈萨，两天后去世。

en: Asad al-Din Rumaythah, a son of Abu Numayy I, was Emir of Mecca seven times between 1301 and 1345, and each time the sultans in Cairo had the last word. Proclaimed joint emir with his brother Humaydah in October 1301, he was arrested by the Egyptian emir Baybars al-Jashnakir after the hajj of 1302 and taken to Cairo in chains; there Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad dressed the brothers in Mamluk robes. Restored in 1305, he spent decades in a feud with Humaydah and later their brother Utayfah, deposed, jailed and reinstated by Cairo in turn. From 1321 he openly backed Zaydi Shi'ism in Mecca. In 1343 or 1344 his sons Thaqabah and Ajlan forced him to abdicate for sixty thousand dirhams; the sultan reversed it, but in October 1345 he formally yielded Mecca to Ajlan at the dome over Zamzam. He died on 3 March 1346. At his funeral the Shafi'i chief qadi stopped the Zaydi imam from leading the prayer.
zh: 阿萨德丁·鲁迈萨是阿布·努米一世之子，1301至1345年间七度成为麦加埃米尔，每一次都由开罗的苏丹说了算。1301年10月，他与兄弟胡迈达并立为埃米尔；1302年朝觐结束后，埃及异密拜伯尔斯·贾什纳基尔将兄弟二人拘捕，戴着镣铐押往开罗，苏丹纳绥尔·穆罕默德在那里让他们换上马穆鲁克袍服。1305年复位后，他与胡迈达、后来又与另一兄弟乌泰法争斗数十年，被开罗轮番废黜、囚禁又复立。1321年起，他公开支持麦加的栽德派什叶教义。1343或1344年，诸子塞格拜和阿杰兰以6万迪拉姆逼他退位；苏丹推翻了这一安排，但1345年10月，他仍在渗渗泉圆顶屋前正式把麦加让给阿杰兰。1346年3月3日他去世，葬礼上，沙斐仪派的首席法官不许栽德派伊玛目带领祷告。

en: Albert II, called the Degenerate (c. 1240–1314), of the House of Wettin, ruled as Margrave of Meissen, Landgrave of Thuringia and Count Palatine of Saxony. In 1255 he married Margaret of Sicily, daughter of the Emperor Frederick II, but his affair with Kunigunde of Eisenberg drove Margaret from the Wartburg in 1270. When he favoured the sons of his second marriage, his elder sons Frederick and Diezmann made war on him; Frederick captured Albert, and the Treaty of Rochlitz in 1289 cost him most of his lands. In 1293 he sold Thuringia to King Adolf of Nassau.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特二世，绰号“堕落者”（约1240—1314），出身韦廷家族，身任迈森藩侯、图林根领地伯爵与萨克森行宫伯爵。1255年他迎娶皇帝腓特烈二世之女西西里的玛格丽特，却与艾森贝格的库妮贡德私通，迫使玛格丽特于1270年离开瓦特堡。由于他偏爱第二次婚姻所生之子，儿子腓特烈与迪茨曼起兵反叛；腓特烈俘获父亲，1289年的《罗赫利茨条约》使他丧失大部分领地。1293年，他把图林根卖给国王拿骚的阿道夫。

en: Johann Sebastian Bach (1685–1750), born at Eisenach, was the supreme late-Baroque German composer. Orphaned at ten, he lived with his eldest brother Johann Christoph for five years before continuing his musical education at Lüneburg. He served as organist and court musician at Arnstadt, Mühlhausen and Weimar, then as Kapellmeister at Köthen from 1717, where he wrote the Brandenburg Concertos. In 1723 he became Thomaskantor in Leipzig, directing music in four city churches and composing cycles of cantatas, the St. Matthew Passion and the Mass in B minor. Long known mainly as an organist, he secured the title of Saxon court composer in 1736 and died at Leipzig in 1750 after eye surgery.
zh: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫（1685—1750），生于爱森纳赫，是巴洛克晚期最伟大的德意志作曲家。他十岁成了孤儿，与长兄约翰·克里斯托夫生活了五年，随后在吕讷堡继续学习音乐。他先后在阿恩施塔特、米尔豪森和魏玛担任管风琴师与宫廷乐师，1717年起在克滕任乐长，期间写下《勃兰登堡协奏曲》。1723年他出任莱比锡圣托马斯学校乐监，负责四座城市教堂的音乐，创作了成套康塔塔、《马太受难曲》和《b小调弥撒》。他生前主要以管风琴家闻名，1736年获封萨克森宫廷作曲家称号，1750年在眼科手术后于莱比锡去世。

en: Balthasar (21 December 1336 – 18 May 1406) of the House of Wettin was Margrave of Meissen and Landgrave of Thuringia. The second son of Margrave Frederick II, he was born at Weißenfels; after his father's death in 1349, his elder brother Frederick III acted as regent and guardian until Balthasar and their brother William came of age and ruled jointly with him. In 1374 he married Margaret, daughter of Burgrave Albert of Nuremberg; their son Frederick IV succeeded him. In November 1382 the Division of Chemnitz ended a quarrel with Frederick III's sons by assigning Balthasar the Landgraviate of Thuringia. He died at the Wartburg in 1406.
zh: 巴尔塔扎尔（1336年12月21日—1406年5月18日）是韦廷家族的迈森藩侯兼图林根领地伯爵。他是藩侯腓特烈二世的次子，生于魏森费尔斯；1349年父亲去世后，兄长腓特烈三世摄政并担任监护人，直到巴尔塔扎尔与弟弟威廉成年后同他共同执政。1374年，他娶纽伦堡城堡伯爵阿尔布雷希特之女玛格丽特为妻，儿子腓特烈四世后来继承了他的爵位。1382年11月，《开姆尼茨分割协议》结束了他与腓特烈三世诸子的争端，将图林根领地伯国划归巴尔塔扎尔。1406年他在瓦特堡去世。

en: Elisabeth of Meissen (22 November 1329 – 21 April 1375), born at the Wartburg, was the daughter of Margrave Frederick II of Meissen and Mathilde of Bavaria. On 7 September 1356 she married at Jena Frederick V, Burgrave of Nuremberg, and became Burgravine of Nuremberg when he succeeded to the title in 1357. Of her nine children, her younger son Frederick, born in 1371, became the first Hohenzollern Elector of Brandenburg, while her daughter Elisabeth married Rupert of Germany. She died in 1375 aged forty-five.
zh: 迈森的伊丽莎白（1329年11月22日—1375年4月21日）生于瓦特堡，是迈森藩侯腓特烈二世与巴伐利亚的玛蒂尔德之女。1356年9月7日，她在耶拿与纽伦堡城堡伯爵腓特烈五世成婚，1357年丈夫袭爵后成为纽伦堡城堡伯爵夫人。她共育有九名子女，其中1371年出生的幼子腓特烈成为霍亨索伦家族第一位勃兰登堡选帝侯，女儿伊丽莎白则嫁给了德意志国王鲁普雷希特。1375年她去世，终年45岁。

en: Elisabeth of Lobdeburg-Arnshaugk (1286–1359) was the last heiress of the Arnshaugk branch of the lords of Lobdeburg in Thuringia. On 24 August 1300 she married Margrave Frederick I of Meissen at Gotha, bringing her family's Thuringian claims to the Wettins.
