After her husband suffered a stroke in 1321 she took over the government, and from his death in 1323 she ruled as regent for her underage son Frederick II until 1329. She remained an adviser to three generations of Wettin rulers and died at Gotha on 22 August 1359.
zh: 伊丽莎白·冯·洛德堡-阿恩斯豪格克（1286—1359）是图林根洛德堡家族阿恩斯豪格克支系的末代女继承人。1300年8月24日，她在哥达与迈森藩侯腓特烈一世成婚，为韦廷家族带来了娘家在图林根的领地权益。1321年丈夫中风后她接管政务，1323年丈夫去世后又为年幼的儿子腓特烈二世摄政，直至1329年。此后她继续为三代韦廷君主出谋划策，于1359年8月22日在哥达去世。

en: Frederick II the Earnest (30 November 1310 – 18 November 1349) was Margrave of Meissen and Landgrave of Thuringia from 1323, ruling first under the guardianship of his mother Elisabeth of Lobdeburg-Arnshaugk until he came of age in 1329. His declaration of a public peace in 1338 curtailed noble privileges and provoked the Thuringian Count's War of 1342–1346, when rebel lords gathered at Arnstadt. After Emperor Louis IV died in 1347 he declined the German crown and supported Charles IV, whom he met at Bautzen in 1348. He died at the Wartburg.
zh: 腓特烈二世（1310年11月30日—1349年11月18日），绰号“严肃者”，1323年起任迈森藩侯兼图林根领地伯爵，先由母亲伊丽莎白·冯·洛德堡-阿恩斯豪格克监护，1329年成年后亲政。他1338年颁布的国内和平令限制了贵族特权，引发1342—1346年的图林根伯爵战争，叛乱领主在阿恩施塔特结盟。1347年皇帝路易四世去世后，他拒绝接受德意志王位，转而支持查理四世，并于1348年在包岑与其会晤。他最终在瓦特堡去世。

en: Frederick III the Strict (14 December 1332 – 21 May 1381) of the House of Wettin was Margrave of Meissen and Landgrave of Thuringia. Born at Dresden, he took over the government after his father Frederick II died in 1349, initially ruling on behalf of his brothers William, Balthasar and Louis; from 1368 the brothers ruled jointly, exercising authority in two-year rotations, and in 1379 their lands were permanently divided. He married Catherine of Henneberg, heiress to Coburg and other estates, and his son by her became Elector Frederick I of Saxony. Frederick died at Altenburg in 1381.
zh: 腓特烈三世（1332年12月14日—1381年5月21日），绰号“严厉者”，韦廷家族成员，任迈森藩侯兼图林根领地伯爵。他生于德累斯顿，1349年父亲腓特烈二世去世后接管政务，最初代表弟弟威廉、巴尔塔扎尔和路易执政；1368年起兄弟们共同统治，每两年轮流执政，1379年领地最终被永久瓜分。他娶亨讷贝格的卡塔琳娜为妻，后者带来科堡等领地，其子后来成为萨克森选帝侯腓特烈一世。1381年，腓特烈在阿尔滕堡去世。

en: Frederick I, called the Brave or the Bitten (1257–1323), Margrave of Meissen and Landgrave of Thuringia, was the son of Albert the Degenerate and Margaret of Sicily, grandson of Emperor Frederick II. Legend says his mother bit his cheek when she fled the Wartburg in 1270, giving him his nickname. With his brother Diezmann he warred on their father, was captured in 1281 and reconciled in 1289. His victory over King Albert I at Lucka in 1307 secured Thuringia, and the emperor enfeoffed him in 1310. Paralyzed by a stroke in 1321, he died at Eisenach in 1323.
zh: 腓特烈一世，绰号“勇敢者”或“被咬者”（1257—1323），迈森藩侯、图林根领地伯爵，是“堕落者”阿尔布雷希特与西西里的玛格丽特之子、皇帝腓特烈二世的外孙。相传1270年母亲逃离瓦特堡时咬了他的面颊，他因此得名。他与弟弟迪茨曼一同对父亲开战，1281年被俘，至1289年双方达成和解。1307年，他在卢卡击败国王阿尔布雷希特一世，保住图林根；1310年皇帝将他的领地正式封赐给他。1321年他因中风瘫痪，1323年卒于爱森纳赫。

en: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe (1749–1832), born in Frankfurt, was the most influential writer in the German language. An early participant in the Sturm und Drang movement, he became famous across Europe with his 1774 novel The Sorrows of Young Werther. In 1775 he settled at Weimar in the service of Duke Karl August, who ennobled him in 1782. From 1776 he served on the duke's privy council and oversaw the reopening of silver mines at Ilmenau. After his Italian journey he published the Metamorphosis of Plants, directed the Weimar theatre from 1791, and began a friendship with Friedrich Schiller in 1794. He issued the first part of Faust in 1808 and died in Weimar in 1832.
zh: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德（1749—1832）生于法兰克福，是最具影响力的德语作家。他早年参加狂飙突进运动，1774年凭小说《少年维特之烦恼》名扬欧洲。1775年，他定居魏玛，效力于卡尔·奥古斯特公爵，并于1782年被封为贵族。1776年起，他在公爵的枢密院任职，主持伊尔梅瑙银矿的重开。意大利之行后，他发表《植物变形记》，1791年起执掌魏玛剧院，1794年与弗里德里希·席勒结为好友。1808年，他出版《浮士德》第一部，1832年在魏玛去世。

en: Margaret of Sicily (c. 1237–1270) was a Hohenstaufen princess born in Foggia, daughter of Emperor Frederick II and Isabella of England. Betrothed in 1242, she married Albert “the Degenerate”, heir to Meissen, in 1255, bringing the Pleissnerland as her dowry. The couple lived at Eckartsberga and the Wartburg, where she bore five children. In 1265 Albert became Landgrave of Thuringia and Count Palatine of Saxony. After her nephew Conradin was executed in 1268, she inherited the Hohenstaufen claim to Sicily and Swabia. In June 1270, discovering Albert’s adultery, she fled to Frankfurt am Main, where the citizens supported her. She died there on 8 August. Legend says she bit her son Frederick’s cheek, earning him “the Bitten”.
zh: 西西里的玛格丽塔（约1237—1270）是霍恩施陶芬家族的公主，生于福贾，为皇帝腓特烈二世与英格兰的伊莎贝拉之女。1242年她即与迈森藩侯国继承人“堕落者”阿尔布雷希特定下婚约，1255年成婚，以普莱斯纳兰为嫁妆。夫妇二人先后居于埃卡茨贝加和瓦尔特堡，她在此生下五名子女。1265年，阿尔布雷希特成为图林根领地伯爵和萨克森宫廷伯爵。1268年侄子康拉丁被处决后，她成为霍恩施陶芬家族对西西里与士瓦本继承权的合法继承人。1270年6月，她发现阿尔布雷希特通奸后逃离瓦尔特堡，前往美因河畔法兰克福，得到市民的支持，并于8月8日在那里去世。相传她曾咬了儿子腓特烈的面颊，后者因而得到“被咬者”的绰号。

en: Matilda of Bavaria (1313–1346) was the eldest daughter of the Wittelsbach emperor Louis IV and his first wife, Beatrice of Silesia. In May 1323 she married Frederick II, Margrave of Meissen, at Nuremberg, binding the Wettin margrave to her father's imperial court. Of her nine children, six survived infancy, among them the future margraves Frederick III, Balthasar and William I, and Elisabeth, wife of the Burgrave of Nuremberg. Matilda died at Meissen on 2 July 1346, three years before her husband.
zh: 巴伐利亚的玛蒂尔达（1313—1346）是维特尔斯巴赫家族的神圣罗马帝国皇帝路易四世与第一任妻子西里西亚的贝翠丝的长女。1323年5月，她在纽伦堡嫁给迈森藩侯腓特烈二世，使韦廷家族的藩侯与父皇的宫廷结盟。她生有九名子女，其中六人活过幼年，包括后来的藩侯腓特烈三世、巴尔塔萨和威廉一世，以及嫁给纽伦堡城堡伯爵的伊丽莎白。1346年7月2日，玛蒂尔达在迈森去世，比丈夫早三年。

en: Ahmet Bey, called Ahmed Gazi, was a son of the Menteşeid ruler İbrahim Bey and a grandson of Orhan Bey. After İbrahim's death in the mid-fourteenth century, Ahmet and his brothers Musa and Mehmet divided the Menteşe beylik between them. After Musa died before 1375, Ahmet succeeded him and also ruled Milas and Beçin. He commissioned a medrese at Beçin in 1375–1376 and died in 1391. His tombstone there gives his lineage as Ahmed Gazi, son of İbrahim, son of Orhan, son of Mesut — the chief written source for the Menteşeid dynasty's ancestry.
zh: 艾哈迈德贝伊人称艾哈迈德·加齐，是门泰谢统治者易卜拉欣贝伊之子、奥尔汗贝伊之孙。易卜拉欣于14世纪中叶去世后，艾哈迈德与兄弟穆萨、穆罕默德瓜分门泰谢贝伊国。穆萨于1375年前去世，艾哈迈德继承其位，也统治米拉斯和贝琴。他于1375—1376年在贝琴兴建经学院，1391年去世。他在经学院的墓碑写明其谱系为艾哈迈德·加齐——易卜拉欣之子——奥尔汗之孙——梅苏德曾孙，这也是记载门泰谢王朝世系的主要文字史料。

en: İbrahim Bey was the fourth ruler of the Menteşeid beylik of southwestern Anatolia, succeeding his father Orhan Bey, while his brother Hızır held Çine. After a crusader fleet took İzmir from Aydın in 1344, the Menteşeids joined Aydın in attacking Crete. As İbrahim prepared at Balat in 1350 to march on İzmir, Venice threatened the harbour and compelled him to make a treaty between 1352 and 1355 that disarmed the beylik. He died around 1355, and his lands passed to his sons Musa, Mehmet and Ahmet.
zh: 易卜拉欣贝伊是安纳托利亚西南部门泰谢贝伊国的第四任统治者，继承父亲奥尔汗贝伊之位，他的兄弟赫泽尔则领有奇内。1344年，十字军舰队从艾丁手中夺取伊兹密尔后，门泰谢与艾丁联合袭击克里特。1350年，易卜拉欣在巴拉特整军，准备进军伊兹密尔，威尼斯随即以舰队威胁港口，迫使他在1352至1355年间签订解除武装的和约。他约于1355年去世，领地交给儿子穆萨、穆罕默德和艾哈迈德。

en: Mehmet Bey was a son of the Menteşeid ruler İbrahim Bey of Milas. After İbrahim's death in the mid-fourteenth century, the beylik was divided between Mehmet and his brothers Musa and Ahmet; Mehmet ruled Muğla and Çine. He and his son İlyas joined an alliance against the Ottomans, who seized Menteşeid lands; both fled to Timur. In 1402, after Timur defeated the Ottomans at Ankara, Mehmet joined İsfendiyar Bey of Kastamonu in visiting Timur near Denizli to seek the return of Menteşeid lands. Mehmet died in early 1403. A Persian treatise on hunting, the Bazname, was translated for his son Mahmud Çelebi.
zh: 穆罕默德贝伊是驻跸米拉斯的门泰谢统治者易卜拉欣贝伊之子。易卜拉欣于14世纪中叶去世后，贝伊国由穆罕默德与兄弟穆萨、艾哈迈德瓜分；穆罕默德统治穆拉和奇内。他与儿子伊利亚斯加入反奥斯曼同盟，奥斯曼人夺取门泰谢领地后，父子二人逃往帖木儿处。1402年帖木儿在安卡拉击败奥斯曼人之后，穆罕默德与卡斯塔莫努的伊斯芬迪亚尔贝伊一同在代尼兹利附近朝觐帖木儿，请求归还门泰谢的领地。穆罕默德于1403年初去世。一部波斯语狩猎著作《巴兹纳梅》曾为他的儿子马哈茂德·切莱比翻译。

en: Menteşe Bey (died c. 1295) founded the Anatolian beylik that bore his name, with its capital at Milas in ancient Caria. Leading Oghuz Turks pushed west by Mongol pressure, he seized Byzantine lands around Muğla and first appears in the sources in 1276–1277, when he joined the Jimri rebellion and helped take Konya. Around 1282 he captured Tralles and Nyssa, and in 1291 coins struck at Milas acknowledged Seljuk suzerainty. After he seized Miletus, the Byzantine general Alexios Philanthropenos defeated and killed him near Priene in 1295. His son Mesut succeeded him.
zh: 门泰谢贝伊（卒于约1295年）是同名安纳托利亚侯国的开创者，都城设在古卡里亚境内的米拉斯。他率领因蒙古人压力西迁的乌古斯突厥人夺取穆拉一带的拜占庭土地；史料中首次提到他是在1276—1277年，他参加吉姆里起事并协助攻占科尼亚。约1282年他攻取特拉莱斯与尼萨，1291年米拉斯铸造的钱币承认塞尔柱宗主权。他夺取米利都后，拜占庭将领阿莱克修斯·菲兰斯罗佩诺斯于1295年在普里埃内附近将其击败击杀。其子梅苏特继位。

en: Mesut Bey (died c. 1319) was the second ruler of the Menteşe beylik in southwestern Anatolia, succeeding his father Menteşe Bey, the dynasty's founder. In 1300 his forces seized a large part of Rhodes, and trade with Crete began around the same time. The Hospitaller knights conquered Rhodes in 1308; in 1311 the Genoese allied with Mesut against them after the knights seized their merchants' goods. At Beçin Castle near Milas, Mesut received Ulu Arif Çelebi, a travelling Mevlevi teacher and grandson of Rumi. Mesut was succeeded on his death by his son Orhan.
zh: 梅苏特贝伊（卒于约1319年）是安纳托利亚西南部门泰谢侯国的第二代统治者，继其父、王朝开创者门泰谢贝伊之位。1300年，他的军队攻占罗得岛大部，门泰谢与克里特岛的贸易也在这一时期开始。1308年医院骑士团征服罗得岛；1311年，因骑士团扣押热那亚商人货物，热那亚人与梅苏特结盟对抗骑士团。在米拉斯附近的贝钦城堡，梅苏特接待了四处游历的梅夫拉维教团导师、鲁米之孙乌卢·阿里夫·切勒比。他死后由其子奥尔汗继位。

en: Musa Bey was a son of İbrahim Bey, the fourth Menteşeid ruler at Milas. After İbrahim's death in the mid-fourteenth century, the Menteşe beylik was divided between Musa and his brothers Mehmet and Ahmet, who each governed their own share.
zh: 穆萨贝伊是门泰谢贝伊国第四代统治者、驻跸米拉斯的易卜拉欣贝伊之子。易卜拉欣于14世纪中叶去世后，门泰谢贝伊国由穆萨与兄弟穆罕默德、艾哈迈德瓜分，三人各自治理自己的领地。

en: Orhan Bey, also called Şücaüddin Orhan, was the third ruler of the Menteşeid Turks in southwestern Anatolia, succeeding his father Mesut Bey at Milas shortly before 1320. That year he sent a fleet against Rhodes in a failed attempt to take the island back from the Hospitallers. When Ibn Battuta passed through the region in 1333, he visited Orhan at Beçin and called him the sultan of Milas, while the Mamluk writer al-Omari recorded the towns and troops under his command. Orhan was followed by his son İbrahim.
zh: 奥尔汗贝伊又称舒贾丁·奥尔汗，是安纳托利亚西南部门泰谢突厥贝伊国的第三任统治者，于1320年前不久在米拉斯继承父亲梅苏德贝伊之位。同年他派舰队进攻罗得岛，试图从医院骑士团手中夺回该岛，但未能成功。1333年伊本·白图泰途经此地时，曾在贝琴拜访奥尔汗，称他为米拉斯苏丹；马穆鲁克作家欧麦里也记载了他治下的城镇与军队。奥尔汗之子易卜拉欣继位。

en: Hammir Singh (1302–1364) was a Rajput chief of the Sisodia branch of the Guhila dynasty, which had lost Chittor to Alauddin Khalji's invasion of Mewar. As Rana of Sisoda he campaigned for years to recover his ancestral lands, finally taking Chittorgarh early in the reign of Muhammad bin Tughluq and expelling the Delhi Sultanate's Chauhan vassal. Rajput chronicles record that he defeated a Delhi army at Singoli and made Mewar independent; a 1438 temple inscription records his victory over a Muslim army. Crowned Maharana in 1326, he founded the ruling Sisodia line, built temples at Chittor and Sewantri, and died in 1364.
zh: 哈米尔·辛格（1302—1364）是古希拉王朝西索迪亚支系的拉杰普特首领，其家族在梅瓦尔遭阿拉乌德丁·卡尔吉入侵时失去了吉多尔。他身为西索达的拉纳，为收复祖业征战多年，终于在穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克在位初年攻下吉多尔加尔，驱逐了德里苏丹国的乔汉人附庸。拉杰普特编年史记载，他在辛戈利击败德里的军队，使梅瓦尔赢得独立；1438年的一篇神庙铭文则记载他击败了一支穆斯林军队。他于1326年加冕为大拉纳，开创西索迪亚统治世系，在吉多尔和塞万特里修建神庙，1364年去世。

en: Jaita Meena was, by local tradition, the last Meena chieftain of Bundi in Hadoti, ruling in the early fourteenth century. He built the Jait Sagar reservoir beneath the Aravalli hills at Bundi, named after him, before the Hada Chauhans took the country.
zh: 相传杰塔·米纳是14世纪初统治哈多蒂本迪的末代米纳首领。在哈达·乔汉人夺取该地之前，他在本迪的阿拉瓦利山下修建了杰特萨加尔水库，并以自己的名字为它命名。

en: Aleramo (died before 991) was the Frankish founder of the Aleramici dynasty and marquis of western Liguria. He appears in 933, when King Hugh enfeoffed him near Vercelli. In 955 he received lands in what is now the province of Alessandria; Berengar II, whose daughter Gerberga he married, named him marquis in 958. He then sided with Emperor Otto I, who confirmed his march in 967, from the Tanaro to the Ligurian Sea. His sons Anselm and Otto founded the Savona and Monferrato lines, and tradition places his tomb at Grazzano. Legend makes him elope with Otto’s daughter Adelasia on a white and a red horse, winning the land he could ride without rest and naming it Monferrato.
zh: 阿莱拉莫（991年前去世）是法兰克人，阿莱拉莫家族的始祖，也是西利古里亚边区的侯爵。他在933年见于记载，意大利国王于格在韦尔切利附近封给他一块采邑。955年他获封今亚历山德里亚省一带的土地；958年，贝伦加尔二世封他为侯爵，他娶了贝伦加尔的女儿格贝尔加。此后他倒向皇帝奥托一世，后者于967年确认了他从塔纳罗河到利古里亚海的边区。他的儿子安塞尔姆和奥托分别开创萨沃纳与蒙费拉托支系，传说他葬在格拉扎诺。相传他与奥托的女儿阿德拉西娅分别骑着红马和白马私奔，赢得自己策马不休所能跑遍的土地，并将其命名为蒙费拉托。

en: Anselm I (died 998) was the eldest surviving son of the Frankish marquis Aleramo, by his first wife Adelasia. Succeeding his father as marquis of the whole Aleramic march, he held Savona and Montferrat before the latter passed to his brother Otto. A placitum of 983 records him as marquis at Otto III’s court in Ravenna, under Empress Adelaide’s regency. He appears with his father and stepmother Gerberga in a donation to San Quintino di Spigno abbey, and married Gisla of Milan. He founded the Anselmian Aleramici line of Savona, Del Vasto, Del Bosco and Sezzadio; his son Anselm II inherited Savona.
zh: 安塞尔姆一世（998年卒）是法兰克侯爵阿莱拉莫与第一任妻子阿德拉西娅所生的在世长子。他承袭父亲成为整个阿莱拉莫边区的侯爵，领有萨沃纳和蒙费拉托，后来蒙费拉托转入其弟奥托之手。983年拉文纳宫廷裁判文书已称他为侯爵，当时奥托三世年幼，由皇太后阿德莱德摄政。他与父亲及继母格贝尔加见于一份向斯皮尼奥的圣昆蒂诺修道院捐赠的文书，并娶米兰的吉斯拉为妻。他是阿莱拉莫家族“安塞尔姆支系”——萨沃纳、德尔瓦斯托、德尔博斯科和塞扎迪奥诸侯爵的始祖，儿子安塞尔姆二世继承了萨沃纳。

en: Argentina Spinola (1294–1337) was the daughter of Opizzino Spinola, captain of the people of Genoa, and Violante of Saluzzo. In October 1307 she married in Constantinople Theodore Palaiologos, son of the Byzantine emperor Andronikos II and heir to the March of Montferrat; with her father's backing the couple seized power at Casale. While Theodore was absent in Constantinople from 1325, pressing a claim to the imperial succession, Argentina governed Montferrat as regent until his return in 1328. She died at Casale early in 1337, leaving a son, the future Marquess John II, and a daughter, Yolande of Savoy.
zh: 阿尔真蒂娜·斯皮诺拉（1294—1337）是热那亚人民领袖奥比齐诺·斯皮诺拉与萨卢佐的维奥兰特之女。1307年10月，她在君士坦丁堡嫁给拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡二世之子、蒙费拉托侯国继承人狄奥多尔·巴列奥略；夫妇凭借她父亲的支持在卡萨莱掌权。1325年狄奥多尔为谋求帝国皇位返回君士坦丁堡，阿尔真蒂娜在他离开期间以摄政身份治理蒙费拉托，直到1328年狄奥多尔返回。1337年初她在卡萨莱去世，留下后来继位为侯爵的儿子乔万尼二世和嫁给萨伏依的女儿薇尔兰特。

en: Beatrice of Castile (1254–1286) was a daughter of Alfonso X of Castile and Violant of Aragon, born at Valladolid. She was the second of eleven children, including the future King Sancho IV. Alfonso first betrothed her to John II, Margrave of Brandenburg, to win Brandenburg's support for his claim to the German crown, but the engagement was broken off. In August 1271 she married at Murcia William VII, Marquess of Montferrat, becoming his third wife. William's daughter Margaret married Beatrice's brother John. Her children included Yolande, who took the name Irene and married the Byzantine emperor Andronikos II Palaiologos, and John I, who succeeded William as marquess. She died in 1286, six years before her husband.
zh: 贝阿特丽斯（1254—1286）是卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十世与阿拉贡的维奥兰特之女，生于巴利亚多利德。她在十一个子女中排行第二，未来的国王桑乔四世是她的兄弟。阿方索起初将她许配给勃兰登堡藩侯约翰二世，以换取对方支持自己竞选德意志王位，但婚约最终取消。1271年8月，她在穆尔西亚嫁给蒙费拉托侯爵威廉七世，成为其第三任妻子。威廉之女玛格丽特嫁给了贝阿特丽斯的兄弟约翰。她的子女包括改名伊琳娜、嫁给拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡二世·巴列奥略的约兰德，以及后来继任侯爵的约翰一世。她于1286年去世，比丈夫早六年。

en: Boniface II “the Giant” (July 1202–1253) was Marquis of Montferrat from 1225, son of William VI and Berta di Clavesana. His father had left heavy debts to the German crown, which Boniface failed to repay. Taking power in 1226, he joined the Lombard League against Frederick II. Alessandria defeated him in 1230 and took Chivasso in 1231. His wife Margaret of Savoy, married in 1235, bore William VII and Alessia. Reconciled in 1239, he received Thessalonica and became its titular king. Guelph in 1243, he submitted to Frederick at Turin in 1245. In 1253 Conrad IV granted him Casale Monferrato; days later, on 12 May, he died at Moncalvo after dictating his will.
zh: “巨人”波尼法乔二世（1202年7月—1253年）自1225年起任蒙费拉托侯爵，是古列尔莫六世与克拉韦萨纳的贝尔塔之子。他未能偿还父亲欠德国王室的巨额债务。1226年亲政后，他加入伦巴第同盟，与腓特烈二世为敌。1230年他被亚历山德里亚击败，1231年基瓦索失守。1235年他娶萨伏依的玛格丽特，生下古列尔莫七世和阿莱西娅。1239年他与皇帝和解，受封萨洛尼卡，成为名义上的国王。1243年他倒向圭尔夫派，1245年又在都灵向腓特烈臣服。1253年，康拉德四世将卡萨莱蒙费拉托封给他；几天后的5月12日，他在蒙卡尔沃口授遗嘱后去世。

en: Cécile de Comminges (c. 1300–1354) was the youngest daughter of Bernard VII, Count of Comminges, and Laure de Montfort. She was married first to Amanieu, heir to the county of Astarac, who died in 1326 before his own father. When her son Centule IV succeeded as count in 1330 while still a minor, Cécile governed Astarac as regent. In 1337, around age 37, she married the 16-year-old John II Palaiologos, Marquess of Montferrat, becoming his marchioness. The marriage was childless and she died at Casale Monferrato in 1354.
zh: 塞茜尔·德·科曼日（约1300—1354）是科曼日伯爵贝尔纳七世与洛尔·德·蒙福尔的幼女。她先嫁给阿斯塔拉克伯国继承人阿马尼厄，后者于1326年先于其父去世。1330年，她的儿子桑蒂勒四世幼年继位，塞茜尔以摄政身份治理阿斯塔拉克。约1337年，年约37岁的她再嫁16岁的蒙费拉托侯爵乔瓦尼二世·帕里奥洛加斯，成为侯爵夫人。这段婚姻没有子女，她于1354年在卡萨莱蒙费拉托去世。

en: Henry (c. 1020–1045) was the younger son of Marquis William III of Montferrat and Waza. Around 1041 he married Adelaide, daughter of Margrave Ulric Manfred II of Turin and heiress of the March of Turin. When William III died in 1042, Henry ruled the March of Montferrat jointly with his elder brother Otto II; a charter of January 1042 records him granting lands to the church of Turin. His joint rule ended with his early death in 1045.
zh: 恩里科（约1020—1045）是蒙费拉托侯爵威廉三世与瓦扎的幼子。约1041年，他娶都灵边疆伯奥尔德里克·曼弗雷迪二世之女、都灵边疆区女继承人阿德莱德为妻。1042年威廉三世去世后，他与兄长奥托二世共同治理蒙费拉托边疆区；1042年1月的一份特许状记载他向都灵教会赠与土地。1045年他早逝，共同执政随之结束。

en: John I, called the Just (c. 1277–1305), was the last Aleramici marquis of Montferrat, the only son of William VII and Beatrice of Castile, daughter of Alfonso X. Guarded as a boy by Thomas of Saluzzo and Charles II of Naples, he later fought to recover his towns from Asti and Alessandria. In 1296 he married Margaret of Savoy, daughter of Amadeus V, but had no children. His league drove Matteo Visconti from Milan in 1302 and Asti submitted in 1303. Dying in January 1305, he made his nephew Theodore Palaiologos his heir, bringing the Palaiologoi to Montferrat.
zh: 乔瓦尼一世，人称“公正者”（约1277—1305），是末代阿莱拉莫家族蒙费拉托侯爵，为威廉七世与卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十世之女贝亚特丽斯的独子。少年时他受萨卢佐侯爵托马索和那不勒斯国王查理二世庇护，后来作战试图从阿斯蒂和亚历山德里亚手中收复城镇。1296年他娶萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥五世之女玛格丽塔为妻，但没有子嗣。他组织的联盟于1302年将马泰奥·维斯孔蒂逐出米兰，1303年阿斯蒂臣服。1305年1月他临终前立外甥狄奥多尔·帕里奥洛格斯为继承人，帕里奥洛格斯家族由此入主蒙费拉托。

en: John II Palaiologos (1321–1372) was Marquis of Montferrat from 1338 and spent his reign pushing the march's borders out against its neighbours. The son of Theodore I, he shared in government from 1336 and succeeded at seventeen. With help from his cousin Otto of Brunswick-Grubenhagen he turned on the Angevins of Naples, who held large possessions in Piedmont, and used King Robert's death in 1343 to take Alessandria, Asti and Tortona by 1344. In 1345 at Gamenario he defeated their vicar Reforza d'Angoult. With Luchino Visconti's tacit backing he added Alba, Bra and Valenza; in 1355 he escorted Charles IV through Italy and received Cherasco, Novara and Pavia. His 1358 marriage to Isabella, titular queen of Majorca, cost him imperial favour and brought war with the Visconti; he gave back the Pavia lands for Visconti ones near Asti. He died at Volpiano in 1372 and was buried at Chivasso; three of his sons succeeded him in turn.
zh: 乔瓦尼二世·巴列奥略（1321—1372）自1338年起任蒙费拉托侯爵，在位期间一直在向外推进侯国的边界。他是提奥多罗一世之子，1336年起参预政事，十七岁继位。他在堂兄弟不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的奥托帮助下，对在皮埃蒙特拥有大片领地的那不勒斯安茹家族开战，利用国王罗贝托于1343年去世的机会，到1344年攻占亚历山德里亚、阿斯蒂和托尔托纳。1345年他在加梅纳里奥击败其总督雷福尔扎·当古。在卢基诺·维斯孔蒂的默许下，他又夺得阿尔巴、布拉和瓦伦扎；1355年他护送查理四世巡行意大利，获授凯拉斯科、诺瓦拉和帕维亚。1358年他娶马略卡名义女王伊莎贝尔为妻，这桩婚事使他失去皇帝宠信，还招来与维斯孔蒂家族的战争。他以帕维亚一带的土地换回维斯孔蒂家族在阿斯蒂附近的领地。1372年他死于沃尔皮亚诺，葬于基瓦索，三个儿子先后继位。

en: William III (c. 970–1042) was the third Marquis of Montferrat from 991, succeeding his father Otto I. He founded Spigno monastery and in 1014 donated land to Fruttuaria abbey with his brother Riprando. He abandoned the imperial cause, allying with Ulric Manfred II of Turin and Bishop Leo of Vercelli. The allies soon quarrelled, and after Leo besieged him at Santhià, William burned Vercelli in revenge. Peace with Manfred was sealed by marrying his son Henry to Manfred’s daughter Adelaide. He resisted Conrad II until the emperor destroyed his Orba valley fortress. Dying in 1042, he left the marquisate to Otto II; the Miracula sancti Bononii names his wife Waza.
zh: 古列尔莫三世（约970—1042）是第三代蒙费拉托侯爵，991年继承父亲奥托一世的爵位。他修建了斯皮尼奥修道院，并于1014年与兄弟里普兰多向弗鲁图阿里亚修道院捐赠土地。他背弃了家族亲皇帝的立场，与都灵的乌尔里克·曼弗雷德二世和韦尔切利主教利奥结盟。盟友不久便发生争执，利奥把他围困在桑蒂亚之后，古列尔莫焚毁韦尔切利作为报复。他与曼弗雷德议和，让儿子恩里科娶曼弗雷德的女儿阿德尔海德为妻，以此巩固和约。他坚持抵抗康拉德二世，直到皇帝摧毁了他在奥尔巴河谷的堡垒。他于1042年去世，把侯爵领地传给奥托二世；《圣博诺尼奥神迹录》记载了他的妻子瓦扎。

en: William IV (c. 1030–1100) of the Aleramici dynasty was Marquis of Montferrat from 1084, the eldest son of Marquis Otto II and Constance of Savoy. He first appears in a 1059 document at Savona, where he limited his powers over the city, probably at the citizens’ request. In 1093 he attended Emperor Henry IV’s donation of the monastery of Breme to the church of Pavia. A charter of September 1096 records him conceding rights over Santo Stefano di Allein in the Aosta Valley. His successor Rainier was born of his second wife, Otta di Aglié. William died in 1100.
zh: 阿莱拉莫家族的古列尔莫四世（约1030—1100）于1084年成为蒙费拉托侯爵，是侯爵奥托二世与萨伏依的科斯坦扎的长子。1059年，他首次在萨沃纳的一份文献中出现，在其中限制了自己对该城的权力，此举可能出于市民的要求。1093年，他出席皇帝亨利四世将布雷梅修道院赠予帕维亚教会的仪式。1096年9月的一份特许状记载，他让出了对奥斯塔谷地阿兰的圣斯德望堂的权利。继任者兰尼埃里是他与第二任妻子阿列的奥塔所生。古列尔莫于1100年去世。

en: William V “the Old” (c. 1115–1191) ruled Montferrat from 1135, the son of Marquis Renier I and Gisela of Burgundy. By Judith of Babenberg he had five sons, including Conrad, later King of Jerusalem, and Boniface, founder of the Kingdom of Thessalonica. In 1167 he unsuccessfully sought marriages for his eldest sons with daughters of Henry II of England and then sisters of William I of Scotland. A Second Crusade veteran, he backed Frederick Barbarossa against the Lombard League, then allied with Byzantine Emperor Manuel I Komnenos and married his son Renier to Manuel’s daughter Maria. In 1183 he joined his grandson Baldwin V in the Holy Land. Saladin captured him at Hattin in 1187; freed in 1188, he died at Tyre in 1191.
zh: “老者”古列尔莫五世（约1115—1191）自1135年起统治蒙费拉托，是侯爵兰尼埃里一世与勃艮第的吉塞拉之子。他与巴本堡的茱蒂丝生有五个儿子，其中包括后来成为耶路撒冷国王的科拉多，以及萨洛尼卡王国的建立者波尼法乔。1167年，他先后为长子们求娶英格兰国王亨利二世的女儿和苏格兰国王威廉一世的姐妹，均未成功。他曾参加第二次十字军东征，先支持皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨对抗伦巴第同盟，后与拜占庭皇帝曼努埃尔一世·科穆宁结盟，让儿子兰尼埃里迎娶曼努埃尔的女儿玛丽亚。1183年，他前往圣地投奔孙子鲍德温五世。1187年他在哈丁被萨拉丁俘虏，1188年获释，1191年死于泰尔。

en: William VI (c. 1173–1226), son of Marquis Boniface I and Elena del Bosco, ruled Montferrat from 1207. Fighting Asti on his father’s behalf, he accepted defeat and made peace in 1206. On his father’s death in the Fourth Crusade, he kept Montferrat while his half-brother Demetrius inherited Thessalonica. He abandoned the Guelph emperor Otto IV for Frederick II, escorting Frederick from Genoa in 1212 and pleading for him at the Fourth Lateran Council in 1215. He took the cross to relieve Thessalonica, but enemies in Piedmont and financial difficulties delayed him; in 1224 he pledged his marquisate to Frederick. Reaching Greece, he died near Almyros on 17 September 1226, his army wasted by dysentery. Berta di Clavesana’s son succeeded as Boniface II.
zh: 古列尔莫六世（约1173—1226）是侯爵波尼法乔一世与埃莱娜·德尔博斯科之子，1207年起统治蒙费拉托。他代表父亲与阿斯蒂作战，1206年承认失败并议和。父亲在第四次十字军东征中死后，他保有蒙费拉托，而同父异母的弟弟德米特里继承了萨洛尼卡。他背弃支持圭尔夫派的皇帝奥托四世，转投腓特烈二世：1212年从热那亚护送腓特烈，并在1215年第四次拉特朗公会议上为他申辩。他立誓参加十字军救援萨洛尼卡，却因皮埃蒙特的敌人和财政困难一再推迟出发；1224年，他将侯国抵押给腓特烈。抵达希腊后，他于1226年9月17日在阿尔米罗斯附近去世，所部军队因痢疾溃散。他与克拉韦萨纳的贝尔塔所生之子继位，即波尼法乔二世。

en: William VII (c. 1240–1292), called the Great Marquis, ruled Montferrat from 1253 as son of Boniface II and Margaret of Savoy. His mother governed as regent until 1257. Once a Guelph ally of Charles I of Naples, he allied with Alfonso X of Castile and married Alfonso’s daughter Beatrice in 1271. With his allies he routed Charles’s forces at Roccavione in 1274. He led a Lombard league and briefly ruled Milan, until Ottone Visconti expelled him in 1281. His daughter Yolande, renamed Irene, married Byzantine Emperor Andronikos II Palaiologos. In 1290 he entered Alessandria to make peace, but the citizens seized and caged him. He died on 6 February 1292, caged eighteen months, probably starved. Dante numbers him among the negligent princes in Purgatory.
zh: “伟大侯爵”古列尔莫七世（约1240—1292）是波尼法乔二世与萨伏依的玛格丽特之子，1253年起统治蒙费拉托。他的母亲摄政至1257年。他本是安茹的查理（那不勒斯的查理一世）的圭尔夫派盟友，后来与卡斯蒂利亚的阿方索十世结盟，并于1271年迎娶阿方索之女贝亚特丽切。1274年，他与盟友在罗卡维奥内击败查理的军队。他曾统领伦巴第城市同盟，短暂统治米兰，1281年被奥托内·维斯孔蒂逐出。女儿约兰达改名伊琳娜，嫁给拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡二世·帕里奥洛格斯。1290年他进入亚历山德里亚议和，却被市民抓住关入笼中。1292年2月6日，他在被囚禁十八个月后死于该地，可能是被饿死。但丁在《炼狱篇》中把他列入疏于职守的君主之列。

en: Margaret of Savoy (1225–c. 1264) was a daughter of Count Amadeus IV of Savoy. In 1228 she was betrothed to Boniface II, Marquess of Montferrat, and her grandfather Thomas I promised a fief as her dowry. They married around 1235, and she became the mother of his heir William VII and of Alessia. When Boniface died in May 1253, his testament named Margaret guardian and regent for the underage William, and she ruled Montferrat for about two years until he came of age. Her aunt Beatrice mentioned her in a testament dated 14 January 1264.
zh: 萨伏依的玛格丽特（1225—约1264）是萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥四世之女。1228年，她与蒙费拉托侯爵博尼法乔二世订婚，祖父托马索一世承诺以一块封地作为她的嫁妆。两人约于1235年成婚，生下继承人威廉七世与阿莱西娅。1253年5月博尼法乔去世，遗嘱指定玛格丽特监护年幼的威廉并出任摄政，她统治蒙费拉托约两年，直至儿子成年。姨母贝阿特丽切在1264年1月14日的遗嘱中提到了她。

en: Otto I (died 991) was the third son of Aleram, founder of the Aleramici dynasty, and a younger brother of Anselm of Savona. He first appears in 961, in the charter founding Grazzano Abbey, where his eldest brother William is already named as dead. After Aleram died around 969 the family march passed to Anselm; Otto is recorded beside him as marquis only in 991 and died in that same year. His short co-rule began the Ottonian branch from which the marquises of Montferrat descended, and his son William III later held Montferrat under Anselm's overlordship.
zh: 奥托一世（？—991）是阿莱拉莫王朝开创者阿莱拉莫的第三子、萨沃纳的安塞尔莫之弟。他最早于961年在格拉扎诺修道院的创立特许状中出现，其中长兄威廉已被记作亡故。约969年阿莱拉莫去世后，家族边疆区由安塞尔莫接管；奥托仅在991年与兄长并列为侯爵，同年便死去。他短暂的共同执政开创了“奥托支系”，蒙费拉托历代侯爵都出自该支；其子威廉三世后来在安塞尔莫的宗主权下领有蒙费拉托。

en: Otto II (c. 1015–1084) was the son of Marquis William III of Montferrat and Waza. First named in a charter of 1040, he succeeded his father as marquis in 1042 and at first ruled the march jointly with his younger brother Henry, until Henry died in 1045. He married Constance of Savoy, daughter of Count Amadeus II, who bore him three sons. His long rule left little other record. Otto died on 20 November 1084 and was followed by his son William IV.
zh: 奥托二世（约1015—1084）是蒙费拉托侯爵威廉三世与瓦扎之子。1040年的一份特许状首次提到他，1042年父亲去世后继任侯爵，起初与弟弟恩里科共同治理边疆区，直到恩里科于1045年去世。他娶萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥二世之女科斯坦扎为妻，后者为他生下三个儿子。其漫长统治留下的记载很少。奥托于1084年11月20日去世，其子威廉四世继位。

en: Rainier (1075–1137), son of Marquis William IV of Montferrat and Otta di Agliè, ruled the marquisate from 1100. A charter drawn up at Sutri in March 1111 names him Raynerius de Monteferrato Marchio, the first surviving document to call a lord of Montferrat marquis. He founded the abbey of Santa Maria di Lucedio near Trino and steered his house firmly toward the imperial court, since Montferrat was then a German fief. In 1105 he married Gisela of Burgundy, widow of Count Humbert II of Savoy. Their only son succeeded him as William V in 1137.
zh: 拉涅里（1075—1137）是蒙费拉托侯爵威廉四世与奥塔·迪·阿列耶之子，1100年起统治侯国。1111年3月在苏特里订立的一份特许状称他为“蒙费拉托的拉涅里，侯爵”，这是现存文件中首次以侯爵头衔称呼蒙费拉托的统治者。他在特里诺附近兴建了卢切迪奥的圣马利亚修道院，并因蒙费拉托当时是德意志封邑而坚定推行亲帝国宫廷的政策。1105年他娶萨伏依伯爵翁贝托二世的遗孀、勃艮第的吉塞拉。1137年他去世，独子继位为威廉五世。

en: Theodore I Palaiologos (c. 1290–1338) was Marquis of Montferrat from 1306 and founder of its Palaiologan line. The second son of Emperor Andronikos II and Irene of Montferrat, he was born in Constantinople as a porphyrogennetos. When his uncle John I, last of the Aleramici marquises, died heirless in 1305, the march passed to Irene's children. The patriarch of Constantinople blocked the claim of Theodore's elder brother John, so Theodore sailed to Genoa in 1306 and in 1307 married Argentina Spinola, daughter of the Genoese captain Opicino Spinola. Manfred IV of Saluzzo had occupied much of the march, and the Acaja family and Charles II of Anjou also wanted a share. Backed by the Spinola and local supporters, Theodore won back the lost lands within a few years and in 1310 received investiture from Henry VII. He kept the parliaments of feudatories and towns that Manfred had introduced. He died at Trino in 1338, succeeded by his son John II.
zh: 提奥多罗一世·巴列奥略（约1290—1338）自1306年起任蒙费拉托侯爵，是该侯国巴列奥略支系的开创者。他是拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡二世与蒙费拉托的伊琳娜的次子，生于君士坦丁堡，拥有“紫衣贵族”身份。1305年，他的舅舅、阿莱拉米奇家族末代侯爵约翰一世无嗣而终，侯国由伊琳娜的子女继承。君士坦丁堡牧首阻止提奥多罗的长兄约翰继承，提奥多罗于1306年渡海前往热那亚，1307年与热那亚平民领袖奥比奇诺·斯皮诺拉之女阿根廷·斯皮诺拉成婚。萨卢佐的曼弗雷迪四世已占据侯国大部分土地，阿卡亚家族和那不勒斯的查理二世也想分一杯羹。借助斯皮诺拉家族和本地支持者，提奥多罗数年内收复失地，1310年获皇帝亨利七世册封。他沿用曼弗雷迪引入的封臣与城镇议会。1338年他死于特里诺，其子约翰二世继位。

en: Yolande Palaeologina (June 1318 – 24 December 1342), also called Violante, was the daughter of Theodore I Palaiologos, Marquess of Montferrat, and the Genoese noblewoman Argentina Spinola. On 1 May 1330 she married Aimone, Count of Savoy, sealing the new peace between Montferrat and Savoy; the settlement also promised Savoy the Montferrat succession if the Palaeologan male line died out. As countess she bore Amadeus VI, later called the Green Count, and Bianca, who married Galeazzo II Visconti of Milan. She died at Chambéry in 1342 giving birth to her last child.
zh: 薇尔兰特·巴列奥洛加（1318年6月—1342年12月24日）又称维奥兰特，是蒙费拉托侯爵狄奥多尔一世·巴列奥略与热那亚贵妇阿尔真蒂娜·斯皮诺拉之女。1330年5月1日，她嫁给萨伏依伯爵艾莫内，为蒙费拉托与萨伏依之间新达成的和平缔约；协议还约定巴列奥略家族男系一旦绝嗣，由萨伏依继承蒙费拉托。作为伯爵夫人，她生下后来号称“绿伯爵”的阿梅迪奥六世，以及嫁给米兰的加莱亚佐二世·维斯孔蒂的比安卡。1342年，她在尚贝里生下最后一个孩子时去世。

en: Albert of Mansfeld was a son of Count Burchard III of Mansfeld-Querfurt and Sophie of Luchow, and a brother of Count Burchard V. He is documented in 1352.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特·冯·曼斯费尔德是曼斯费尔德-奎尔富特伯爵布尔夏德三世与索菲·冯·吕肖之子，伯爵布尔夏德五世的兄弟，1352年见于文书。

en: Burchard III, also numbered Burchard IV, was Count of Mansfeld-Querfurt, the line founded when the lords of Querfurt inherited Mansfeld in 1229. He first appears as count in 1273, while still under age. Before 20 December 1286 he married Sophie of Lüchow. In 1287 he held Seeburg Castle, and in 1301 he is named as lord of Bornstedt. His children included Burchard V, Oda and Albert. He died between 2 October 1310 and 28 October 1311.
zh: 布尔夏德三世（一作四世）是曼斯费尔德-奎尔富特伯爵；1229年奎尔富特家族继承曼斯费尔德，开创这一支系。1273年他首次以伯爵身份出现，当时尚未成年。1286年12月20日前，他娶吕肖的索菲为妻。1287年他据有塞堡，1301年的文献称他为博恩施泰特领主。子女包括布尔夏德五世、奥达和阿尔布雷希特。他于1310年10月2日至1311年10月28日之间去世。

en: Burchard V was Count of Mansfeld from the Querfurt line, the son of Count Burchard IV and husband of Oda of Wernigerode. He is documented from 1291 and steadily built up his lordship at the foot of the Harz, holding Allstedt from 1316, Hedersleben from 1320, Schraplau from 1335 and Helfta from 1346. Of his many sons, Burchard VI succeeded him as count, Gebhard married Luitgard of Valkenstein in 1327, and Ruprecht served the Hospitallers as commander at Mirow and Goslar. Burchard died between 1354 and 1358 and was buried at Eisleben.
zh: 布尔夏德五世是曼斯费尔德伯国奎尔富特支系的伯爵，伯爵布尔夏德四世之子，娶韦尔尼格罗德的奥达为妻，1291年起见诸文献。他在哈茨山山前逐步扩充领地：1316年起领有阿尔施泰特，1320年得到黑德斯莱本，1335年得到施拉普劳，1346年得到黑尔夫塔。他众多的儿子中，布尔夏德六世继任伯爵，格布哈德于1327年娶法尔肯施泰因的卢伊特加德，鲁普雷希特则在米罗和戈斯拉尔担任医院骑士团指挥官。布尔夏德于1354至1358年间去世，葬在艾斯莱本。

en: Burchard VI of Mansfeld was the eldest son of Count Burchard V of Mansfeld-Querfurt and Oda of Wernigerode. Born before 1327, he bore the title of count and died between 1354 and 1358.
zh: 布尔夏德六世·冯·曼斯费尔德是曼斯费尔德-奎尔富特伯爵布尔夏德五世与奥达·冯·韦尔尼格罗德的长子，生于1327年以前，身有伯爵头衔，于1354年至1358年间去世。

en: Gebhard III of Mansfeld was a son of Count Burchard V of Mansfeld-Querfurt and Oda of Wernigerode, first documented in 1314. On 21 October 1327 he obtained a papal dispensation at Avignon to marry Luitgard of Valkenstein, who bore him two sons, Albert and Gebhard. He died young, between November 1332 and June 1335, while his sons were still children. His son Albert was a count in 1353, and Gebhard followed as count in 1362.
zh: 格布哈德三世·冯·曼斯费尔德是曼斯费尔德-奎尔富特伯爵布尔夏德五世与奥达·冯·韦尔尼格罗德之子，1314年首次见于文书。1327年10月21日，他在阿维尼翁获得教皇特许，娶法尔肯施泰因的卢特加德为妻，生有阿尔布雷希特与格布哈德两子。1332年11月至1335年6月间他早逝，二子尚幼。其子阿尔布雷希特于1353年已为伯爵，1362年格布哈德继任伯爵。

en: Oda of Mansfeld was a daughter of Count Burchard III of Mansfeld-Querfurt and Sophie of Luchow, and a sister of Count Burchard V. She appears in surviving charters between 1308 and 1314 and had died by 26 August 1353.
zh: 奥达·冯·曼斯费尔德是曼斯费尔德-奎尔富特伯爵布尔夏德三世与索菲·冯·吕肖之女，伯爵布尔夏德五世的姐妹。她在1308年至1314年间的文书中留有记载，1353年8月26日前去世。

en: Rupert of Mansfeld was a son of Count Burchard III of Mansfeld-Querfurt and Sophie of Luchow. He entered the Church and is documented as a canon of Magdeburg Cathedral in 1297.
zh: 鲁普雷希特·冯·曼斯费尔德是曼斯费尔德-奎尔富特伯爵布尔夏德三世与索菲·冯·吕肖之子，出任教职，1297年的文书已记载他为马格德堡主教座堂参事。

en: Rupert of Mansfeld was a son of Count Burchard V of Mansfeld-Querfurt and Oda of Wernigerode, documented from 1314 to 1359. He entered the Order of Saint John and served as a Hospitaller commander: from 1339 to 1341 he was Komtur of Mirow, and from 1349 to 1359 he headed the commandery of Goslar.
zh: 鲁普雷希特·冯·曼斯费尔德是曼斯费尔德-奎尔富特伯爵布尔夏德五世与奥达·冯·韦尔尼格罗德之子，1314年至1359年间均有文书记载。他加入圣约翰医院骑士团，历任辖区长官：1339年至1341年任米罗辖区长官，1349年至1359年执掌戈斯拉尔辖区。

en: Hugh II (c. 1195 – 11 August 1260) was Count of Montfort in Swabia, of the house founded by the Counts Palatine of Tübingen at Montfort Castle in the Vorarlberg. On his father Hugh I's death in 1228 he took up the inheritance with his brother Rudolf I, ancestor of the counts of Werdenberg, and ruled the county from 1234. He married Elizabeth of Burgau, daughter of Margrave Henry of Burgau. Their sons divided the inheritance, founding the Montfort lines of Bregenz under Ulrich I, Feldkirch under Rudolf II and Tettnang under Hugh.
zh: 雨果二世（约1195—1260年8月11日）是士瓦本的蒙特福特伯爵，其家族为图宾根行宫伯爵在福拉尔贝格的蒙特福特城堡所建支系。1228年父亲雨果一世去世后，他与兄弟、韦尔登贝格伯爵一脉的始祖鲁道夫一世共同继承遗产，1234年起统治伯国。他娶布郜藩侯亨利之女伊丽莎白为妻。诸子分割家产，分别建立乌尔里希一世的布雷根茨、鲁道夫二世的费尔德基希和雨果的泰特南等蒙特福特支系。

en: Hugh IV (died 11 August 1310) was Count of Montfort-Feldkirch in the Vorarlberg, the eldest son of Count Rudolph II and Agnes of Grüningen. He married Anna of Veringen, while his brothers Rudolph III, later bishop of Constance, and Ulrich II entered the church. On 11 August 1310 Hugh was killed at Schaffhausen, after which his brothers Rudolph and Ulrich took over the government. In 1375 his son Rudolph IV, as the last of the Feldkirch line, sold the town and lordship of Feldkirch to Duke Leopold III of Austria.
zh: 雨果四世（1310年8月11日卒）是福拉尔贝格的蒙特福特-费尔德基希伯爵，伯爵鲁道夫二世与格吕宁根的阿格妮斯的长子。他娶费林根的安娜为妻；兄弟鲁道夫三世和乌尔里希二世都进入教会，鲁道夫后来任康斯坦茨主教。1310年8月11日，雨果在沙夫豪森被杀，此后他的兄弟鲁道夫与乌尔里希接掌政务。1375年，其子鲁道夫四世作为费尔德基希支系末代伯爵，把费尔德基希城及领地卖给奥地利公爵利奥波德三世。

en: Rudolph II (died 19 October 1302) was Count of Montfort-Feldkirch and founder of its line of the Counts Palatine of Tübingen. A son of Count Hugh II of Montfort and Elizabeth of Burgau, he married before 1263 Agnes, daughter of the powerful Count Hartmann I of Grüningen, and in September 1265 swore his father-in-law an oath over lands in the Alpgau. In the family partition he secured the town and lordship of Feldkirch, the best share in the Vorarlberg. His daughter Elizabeth married the steward Eberhard of Waldburg before 1275, and his son Hugh IV succeeded him.
zh: 鲁道夫二世（1302年10月19日卒）是蒙特福特-费尔德基希伯爵，开创了图宾根行宫伯爵的费尔德基希支系。他是蒙特福特伯爵雨果二世与布郜的伊丽莎白之子，1263年前娶权势显赫的格吕宁根伯爵哈特曼一世之女阿格妮斯，1265年9月就阿尔普郜的土地向岳父宣誓立约。分家时他取得福拉尔贝格最富庶的一份——费尔德基希城及其领地。女儿伊丽莎白于1275年前嫁给宫廷总管瓦尔德堡的埃伯哈德，儿子雨果四世继位。

en: Rudolf IV of Montfort-Feldkirch was the fourth son of Count Hugo IV and Anna of Veringen. Left underage at his father's death in 1310, he grew up under the regency of his uncles Rudolf, bishop of Constance, and Ulrich II. As the last count of Montfort-Feldkirch he sold the city and lordship of Feldkirch to Duke Leopold III of Austria in 1375, ending Montfort rule over the town. He died on 13 March 1375 and was buried in the church of Saint Nicholas in Feldkirch. His daughter Agnes became countess of Werdenberg-Sargans.
zh: 鲁道夫四世·冯·蒙特福特-费尔德基希是伯爵胡戈四世与费林根的安娜的第四子。1310年父亲去世时他尚未成年，由叔父康斯坦茨主教鲁道夫与乌尔里希二世摄政。他是蒙特福特-费尔德基希的末代伯爵，1375年将费尔德基希城及领地售予奥地利公爵利奥波德三世，蒙特福特家族对该城的统治就此终结。他于1375年3月13日去世，葬在费尔德基希的圣尼古拉教堂；其女阿格尼丝后为韦尔登贝格-萨尔甘斯伯爵夫人。

en: Michel Le Tellier (1603–1685), marquis de Barbezieux, was the French statesman who built Louis XIV's army. Born in Paris, he became maître des requêtes in 1631 and intendant of justice for the French army in Piedmont in 1640. Through Cardinal Mazarin's favour he became Secretary of State for War in 1643, remaining loyal to Mazarin through the Fronde. Over three decades he and his son Louvois turned the royal armies into a disciplined professional force. As Chancellor from 1677 he strengthened royal authority over military appointments and discipline, and in 1679 restored the teaching of civil law at the University of Paris. A fierce enemy of the Huguenots, he helped persuade the king to revoke the Edict of Nantes and died at Versailles in 1685, days after signing it.
zh: 米歇尔·勒泰利耶（1603—1685），巴伯济约侯爵，是为路易十四打造新式军队的法国政治家。他生于巴黎，1631年出任审查官，1640年任驻皮埃蒙特法军司法总监。借马扎然枢机的赏识，他于1643年任战争大臣，在投石党之乱中始终效忠马扎然。此后三十余年间，他与儿子卢福瓦侯爵把王室军队改造成纪律严明的职业化军队。1677年出任法国首席大法官后，他强化了国王对军官任免与军纪的掌控，并于1679年恢复巴黎大学的民法教学。他敌视胡格诺派，力劝路易十四废除《南特敕令》，1685年在敕令签署十几天后于凡尔赛去世。

en: Michelangelo di Lodovico Buonarroti Simoni (1475–1564) was an Italian sculptor, painter and architect of the High Renaissance, born at Caprese near Arezzo and raised in Florence. He carved the Pietà in Rome and the David in Florence (1501–1504) before turning thirty. Pope Julius II commissioned him to design a tomb, a project that occupied him for decades. For the same pope he painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling in 1508–1512, and later The Last Judgment on its altar wall. In Florence he built the Medici Chapel and Laurentian Library, and from 1546 directed work on St Peter's, designing its dome. He died in Rome in 1564 and was buried in Florence's Santa Croce.
zh: 米开朗基罗·迪·洛多维科·博纳罗蒂·西莫尼（1475—1564）是意大利盛期文艺复兴雕塑家、画家和建筑师，出生于阿雷佐附近的卡普雷塞，在佛罗伦萨长大。不到三十岁，他就在罗马雕成《哀悼基督》，并于1501至1504年在佛罗伦萨雕成《大卫》。教皇尤利乌斯二世委托他设计陵墓，这项工程占据了他数十年时间。他又为这位教皇在1508至1512年间绘制西斯廷礼拜堂天顶画，后来在祭坛墙上绘制《最后的审判》。他在佛罗伦萨主持建造美第奇礼拜堂和劳伦佐图书馆，1546年起主持圣伯多禄大教堂工程并设计其穹顶。1564年他在罗马去世，葬于佛罗伦萨圣十字圣殿。

en: Berengaria of Navarre (c. 1165–1170 – 23 December 1230), queen of England, was the eldest daughter of King Sancho VI of Navarre and Sancha of Castile. Eleanor of Aquitaine arranged her marriage to Richard the Lionheart, who in 1190 ended his long betrothal to Alys of France. Berengaria joined Richard on the Third Crusade; when her ship was imperilled off Cyprus, he conquered the island from Isaac Komnenos and married her at Limassol on 12 May 1191. The marriage was childless, she saw Richard little and lived mostly in his French lands, never visiting England in his lifetime. As a widow she gave generously to the church, although she struggled to collect her pension from Richard's successor John.
zh: 纳瓦拉的贝伦加丽亚（约1165—1170年—1230年12月23日）是英格兰王后，纳瓦拉国王桑乔六世与卡斯蒂利亚的桑查的长女。阿基坦的埃莉诺促成了她与狮心王理查的婚事，理查于1190年解除了与法兰西的艾丽斯维持多年的婚约。贝伦加丽亚随理查参加第三次十字军东征；她的座船在塞浦路斯附近遇险，理查遂从伊萨克·科穆宁手中征服该岛，并于1191年5月12日在利马索尔与她成婚。两人没有子女，她与理查聚少离多，长住他在法兰西的领地，在他生前从未到过英格兰。守寡后她慷慨资助教会，尽管向理查的继承人约翰追索年金颇为困难。

en: John I of Beaumont (c. 1253–1306), also called John of Brienne-Beaumont, was viscount of Beaumont in Maine and lord of Sainte-Suzanne. The son of Louis of Acre and Agnes of Beaumont, he inherited the viscounty on his mother's death around 1301 and kept her name of Beaumont rather than Brienne. In 1305 he was one of Charles of Valois's sureties for his daughter Jeanne's marriage to the count of Hainaut. By his first wife Jeanne de la Guerche he fathered his heir Robert. He died in 1306 and was buried at Étival Abbey.
zh: 博蒙的约翰一世（约1253—1306），又称约翰·德·布列讷-博蒙，是曼恩的博蒙子爵，兼领圣苏珊。他是阿卡的路易与阿涅丝·德·博蒙之子，约1301年母亲去世后才继承子爵之位，并沿用母姓博蒙而不用父姓布列讷。1305年，瓦卢瓦的查理为女儿让娜与埃诺伯爵的婚约提供担保人，他是其中之一。他与元配拉盖尔什的让娜生下继承人罗贝尔，于1306年去世，葬在埃蒂瓦尔修道院。

en: John II of Brienne-Beaumont (c. 1305 – before 21 January 1355) was the eldest son of Robert of Beaumont, viscount of Beaumont, and Marie de Craon, and a descendant of John of Brienne, king of Jerusalem. In 1327 he succeeded his father to the viscounty and the lordships of Sainte-Suzanne, Le Lude and La Fleche. In 1338 he served at Amiens as a knight banneret with one knight and nine squires. By his second wife, Marguerite de Poitiers, he had his heir Louis II. He was buried at Melinais Abbey.
zh: 让二世·德·布列讷-博蒙（约1305—1355年1月21日前）是博蒙子爵罗贝尔·德·博蒙与玛丽·德·克朗的长子，为耶路撒冷国王布列讷的约翰的后裔。1327年他承袭父职，领有博蒙子爵领及圣苏珊娜、勒吕德、拉弗莱什等领地。1338年，他作为方旗骑士，携一名骑士、九名侍从在亚眠服役。他与第二任妻子玛格丽特·德·普瓦捷生有继承人路易二世，死后葬于梅利奈修道院。

en: Jeanne de Beaumont was a daughter of Jean II de Beaumont, vicomte of Beaumont in Maine, by Marguerite de Poitiers, and sister of Louis II. She married Guillaume de Villiers, seigneur du Hommet, and in 1373 brought him lands in the Champagne au Maine.
zh: 让娜·德·博蒙是曼恩博蒙子爵让二世·德·博蒙与玛格丽特·德·普瓦捷之女、路易二世的姐妹。她嫁给迪奥梅领主纪尧姆·德·维利耶，1373年将曼恩香槟地区的部分领地带给夫家。

en: Louis of Brienne, called Louis of Acre (c. 1230–after 1285), was a younger son of John of Brienne, king of Jerusalem and Latin emperor of Constantinople, and Berengaria of León. As a boy he left Constantinople with his brothers for the court of their cousin Louis IX of France, whose crusade he joined in Egypt. Around 1253 he married Agnes of Beaumont, heiress to the viscounty of Beaumont in Maine, holding Beaumont, Fresnay and Sainte-Suzanne in her right. His sons included his heir John, Henry de Beaumont, and Louis, bishop of Durham; his daughter Margaret married Bohemond VII of Tripoli.
zh: 阿卡的路易（约1230—1285年后），即路易·德·布列讷，是耶路撒冷国王兼君士坦丁堡拉丁皇帝约翰·德·布列讷与莱昂的贝伦加利亚较年幼的儿子之一。他幼年随兄弟离开君士坦丁堡，在表兄法王路易九世的宫廷长大，并随路易九世参加远征埃及的十字军。约1253年，他娶博蒙子爵领地的女继承人阿涅丝为妻，以妻权领有曼恩的博蒙、弗雷奈与圣苏珊，称博蒙子爵。诸子中有继承人约翰、亨利和达勒姆主教路易；女儿玛格丽特嫁给的黎波里伯爵博希蒙德七世。

en: Louis II de Beaumont (born after 1330, died 1364), also called Louis II de Brienne-Beaumont, was viscount of Beaumont and lord of Sainte-Suzanne, Le Lude and La Flèche in Maine. The son of Jean II de Beaumont and Marguerite de Poitiers, he descended from John of Brienne, king of Jerusalem and Latin emperor of Constantinople. He inherited his father's lands around 1355. In May 1364 Charles V sent him with Bertrand du Guesclin against the Navarrese, and he fell at Cocherel on 23 May 1364 as the French won a decisive victory. His lands passed to his half-sister Marie.
zh: 路易二世·德·博蒙（1330年后生，1364年卒），又称路易二世·德·布里耶纳-博蒙，是博蒙子爵，兼领曼恩的圣苏珊娜、勒吕德和拉弗莱什。他是让二世·德·博蒙与玛格丽特·德·普瓦捷之子，先祖为曾任耶路撒冷国王、君士坦丁堡拉丁皇帝的布列讷的约翰。约1355年，他继承父亲的领地。1364年5月，法王查理五世派他随贝特朗·杜·盖克兰征讨纳瓦拉派；5月23日，法军在科什雷勒取得决定性胜利，他却在此役阵亡。死后领地传给同父异母的姐姐玛丽。

en: Marguerite de Poitiers, or Marguerite de Valentinois, was the daughter of Aymar V de Poitiers, count of Valentinois, and Sibylle des Baux. On 31 December 1330 she became the second wife of Jean II de Beaumont, vicomte of Beaumont in Maine, and died in 1380.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·普瓦捷（一称玛格丽特·德·瓦朗蒂努瓦）是瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵艾马尔五世·德·普瓦捷与西比勒·德·博之女。1330年12月31日，她嫁给曼恩博蒙子爵让二世·德·博蒙为续弦，1380年去世。

en: Marguerite de Beaumont was a daughter of John II, viscount of Beaumont, by his second wife Marguerite de Poitiers. She married Bouchard VII of Vendome, lord of Feuillet, and was the mother of Marguerite of Vendome. She died in 1373.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·博蒙是博蒙子爵让二世与第二任妻子玛格丽特·德·普瓦捷之女，嫁予费耶领主、旺多姆的布沙尔七世，生女玛格丽特·德·旺多姆，于1373年去世。

en: Robert of Beaumont, also called Robert of Brienne-Beaumont (after 1285 – 20 September 1327), was viscount of Beaumont in Maine and lord of Sainte-Suzanne, Le Lude and La Flèche. The son of John I of Beaumont and Jeanne de la Guerche, and a great-grandson of Emperor John of Brienne, he succeeded his father to the viscounty in 1306. He died on 20 September 1327 and was probably buried at Étival Abbey beside his father. His eldest son John II succeeded him.
zh: 博蒙的罗贝尔，又称罗贝尔·德·布列讷-博蒙（1285年后—1327年9月20日），是曼恩的博蒙子爵，兼领圣苏珊、勒吕德和拉弗莱什。他是约翰一世与元配拉盖尔什的让娜之子，拉丁皇帝约翰·德·布列讷的曾孙，1306年承袭父爵为博蒙子爵。1327年9月20日去世，可能葬在其父长眠的埃蒂瓦尔修道院；长子约翰二世继任子爵。

en: Qutb al-Din Muhammad (died 1346) was the Mihrabanid malik of Sistan from December 1330, when the notables raised him to power after his uncle Nusrat al-Din Muhammad died. A deeply religious man, he patronized Sistan's religious figures, fed travelers and the poor, and distributed the province's fortresses among his family. The collapse of Ilkhanid rule spared Sistan most of the wars ravaging Persia, though the Kartid malik Mu'izz al-Din Husayn invaded in 1333 or 1334 at the bidding of his opponents before withdrawing. Qutb al-Din died of plague in 1346, and his son Taj al-Din succeeded him.
zh: 库特卜丁·穆罕默德（1346年卒）于1330年12月成为米赫拉班王朝的锡斯坦马利克：其叔父努斯拉特丁·穆罕默德死后，显贵们拥立他继位。他笃信宗教，优待锡斯坦的宗教人士，赈济旅人和贫民，并把省内的城堡分封给族人。伊利汗国中央政权崩溃，使锡斯坦大体避开了肆虐波斯的战乱；只有卡尔提德马利克穆仪兹丁·侯赛因应其政敌之请于1333或1334年来侵，随后退兵。1346年库特卜丁死于瘟疫，其子塔吉丁继位。

en: Taj al-Din ibn Qutb al-Din (died 1351) was Mihrabanid malik of Sistan from 1346 to 1350. As his father Qutb al-Din Muhammad's governor of the town of Uq, he succeeded in 1346 despite a rival claim by Muhammad ibn Nusrat al-Din Muhammad; he was well-intentioned but weak. In 1350 a conspiracy in Shahr-i Sistan drove him out and enthroned Jalal al-Din Mahmud. Fleeing by way of Kerman to Herat, he won Kartid malik Mu'izz al-Din Husayn's backing for his restoration. In 1351 a Chagatai coalition under Amir Qazaghan attacked Herat, and Taj al-Din fell defending the city.
zh: 塔吉丁·伊本·库特卜丁（1351年卒）于1346—1350年任米赫拉班王朝的锡斯坦马利克。他曾奉父库特卜丁·穆罕默德之命镇守乌克城，1346年继位时挫败了穆罕默德·伊本·努斯拉特丁·穆罕默德的争位；他用心良善却性格软弱。1350年，锡斯坦城的一场密谋将他驱逐，另立扎兰丁·马哈茂德。他经克尔曼逃到赫拉特，说动卡尔提德马利克穆仪兹丁·侯赛因助他复位。1351年，埃米尔加兹罕率察合台诸部联军攻打赫拉特，塔吉丁在守城战中阵亡。

en: Mikołaj Rej (1505–1569) was a Polish nobleman, politician and writer, the first major author to write entirely in Polish. After one year at the Kraków Academy he largely educated himself through Latin literature and served voivode Andrzej Tęczyński at Sandomierz from about 1524. In 1543 he made his name with the verse dialogue A Brief Discussion between a Lord, a Bailiff and a Priest. A convert to Calvinism in 1541 or 1548, he attended synods, founded Protestant schools and communities on his lands, sat in the sejms, and wrote moral and didactic prose. He founded Rejowiec in 1547 and died there in 1569, remembered as a father of Polish literature.
zh: 米科瓦伊·芮伊（1505—1569）是波兰贵族、政治家和作家，也是第一位完全以波兰语写作的重要作家。他在克拉科夫学院只读了一年，之后主要通过研读拉丁文学自学，约1524年起在桑多梅日为总督安杰伊·滕琴斯基效力。1543年，他以诗体对话《地主、村长与神父的短论》一举成名。他于1541年或1548年皈依加尔文宗，出席宗教会议，在自己的领地上创办新教学校和教会，参加各级瑟姆，并写有大量道德教诲散文。1547年他兴建雷伊奥维茨城，1569年在那里去世，被视为波兰文学之父。

en: Mingqan Ke'un was a Mongol prince, son of Malik Temür and grandson of Ariq Böke. In the summer of 1306 he came to Iran during the reign of Öljaitü. His son Sose was the father of Arpa Ke'un, the Ilkhan of 1335–1336.
zh: 明安是蒙古宗王，灭里·帖木儿之子、阿里不哥之孙。1306年夏，他在完者都汗在位时来到伊朗。其子苏萨生阿儿巴，阿儿巴于1335至1336年称伊儿汗。

en: Anne Robert Jacques Turgot (1727–1781) was a French economist and Controller-General of Finances to Louis XVI. After serving in the Parlement of Paris, he met the economists Quesnay and Vincent de Gournay, and in 1754 wrote in support of religious tolerance. He spent thirteen years as intendant of Limoges from 1761, reforming the land tax and writing his Reflections on the Formation and Distribution of Wealth. In 1774 he became navy minister and then controller-general. He freed the grain trade, and in 1776 issued the Six Edicts abolishing the royal corvée and the guilds. Aristocratic and parlementary opposition forced his dismissal on 12 May 1776; he died in Paris in 1781.
zh: 安·罗伯特·雅克·杜尔哥（1727—1781）是法国经济学家、法王路易十六的财政总监。他早年在巴黎高等法院任职，结识了经济学家魁奈和樊尚·德·古尔奈，1754年撰文支持宗教宽容。1761年他出任利摩日总督，在任十三年间改革土地税，并写下《关于财富的形成和分配的考察》。1774年他先任海军大臣，旋即改任财政总监，放开谷物贸易；1776年颁布六项敕令，废除王室徭役和行会制度。贵族与高等法院群起反对，他于1776年5月12日被迫去职，1781年在巴黎去世。

en: Gleb Vseslavich (died September 13, 1119), a son of Vseslav of Polotsk, received Minsk when the Polotsk lands were divided in 1101 and founded the Minsk line of the Rurikids. In 1104 his Minsk withstood a siege by Monomakh's allies, and in 1106 he raided the Baltic Semigallians. After he burned Slutsk in 1116, Vladimir Monomakh took Orsha and Drutsk and forced terms on him. Gleb resumed war in 1119, was captured by Mstislav, and died a prisoner in Kiev that September.
zh: 格列布·弗谢斯拉维奇（？—1119年9月13日）是波洛茨克王公弗谢斯拉夫之子，1101年波洛茨克领地分封时获得明斯克，开创留里克家族的明斯克支系。1104年，他的明斯克顶住了莫诺马赫盟友的围攻；1106年又出兵攻掠波罗的海部落塞米加利亚人。1116年他焚毁斯卢茨克后，弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫攻取奥尔沙和德鲁茨克，逼其议和。1119年格列布重启战端，被姆斯季斯拉夫俘虏，同年9月死于基辅囚所。

en: Rostislav Glebovich (died 1165) succeeded his father Gleb Vseslavich as prince of Minsk in 1146. In 1151 the Polotsk citizens expelled Rogvolod Borisovich and invited Rostislav, who left Minsk to his brother Volodar. In 1158 Rogvolod seized Drutsk and drove out Rostislav's son Gleb, then returned to Polotsk; he made peace with Rostislav after a ten-day siege of Minsk. The war over Drutsk and Iziaslavl dragged on until 1161, and Rostislav died holding Minsk in 1165.
zh: 罗斯季斯拉夫·格列波维奇（？—1165）是明斯克王公格列布·弗谢斯拉维奇之子，1146年袭任明斯克王公。1151年，波洛茨克人驱逐罗格沃洛德·鲍里索维奇，迎立罗斯季斯拉夫，他把明斯克交给弟弟沃洛达里。1158年罗格沃洛德夺取德鲁茨克，逐走罗斯季斯拉夫之子格列布，随后重返波洛茨克；他围攻明斯克十日不克，与罗斯季斯拉夫议和。此后围绕德鲁茨克与伊贾斯拉夫尔的战事一直持续到1161年。1165年，罗斯季斯拉夫卒于明斯克任上。

en: Vladimir, also called Valdemar or Woldemar of Polotsk (c. 1140s–1216), ruled Polotsk from about 1184; Henry of Livonia's chronicle styles him the great king of Polotsk. In 1203 he invaded Livonia, briefly retook Ikskile and forced the Livs to resume tribute before defeat at Holme. At Jersika in 1212 he recognized Bishop Albert's rule over the Livs in exchange for free trade on the Dvina. In 1216, after the Estonians called him to march on Riga, he died suddenly aboard ship as the host assembled.
zh: 弗拉基米尔，又名瓦尔德马（约1140年代—1216），约自1184年起统治波洛茨克，亨利的《利沃尼亚编年史》称他为波洛茨克的伟大国王。1203年，他入侵立窝尼亚，一度收复伊克什基莱、迫使立窝尼亚人重新纳贡，但在霍尔姆兵败。1212年，他在杰瑟卡承认里加主教阿尔伯特对立窝尼亚人的统治，换取道加瓦河自由贸易。1216年，爱沙尼亚人请他进军里加，大军集结之际，他登船后猝然去世。

en: Volodar Glebovich (c. 1090s–after 1167), son of Gleb Vseslavich, took Minsk when his brother Rostislav moved to Polotsk in 1151, later held Gorodets, and was prince of Minsk again from 1165. Around 1135, probably while in exile, he married Richeza of Poland, daughter of Boleslaw III and widow of Magnus the Strong; the marriage soon ended in divorce, and their daughter Sophia of Minsk married Valdemar I of Denmark. In 1167 he defeated Vseslav Vasilkovich near Polotsk and briefly held the Polotsk throne.
zh: 沃洛达里·格列波维奇（约1090年代—1167年后）是格列布·弗谢斯拉维奇之子。1151年兄长罗斯季斯拉夫转赴波洛茨克后，他领有明斯克，后改领戈罗杰茨，1165年再度成为明斯克王公。约1135年，他可能在流亡期间娶波兰公爵波列斯瓦夫三世之女、强者马格努斯的遗孀里基莎为妻，婚姻不久破裂；两人的女儿明斯克的索菲娅后来嫁给丹麦国王瓦尔德马一世。1167年，他在波洛茨克附近击败弗谢斯拉夫·瓦西里科维奇，短暂登上波洛茨克公位。

en: Agnes of Mecklenburg (1320–1340) was a daughter of Henry II the Lion of Mecklenburg and Anna of Saxe-Wittenberg. On 6 January 1338 she married Nicholas III, Lord of Werle-Güstrow, and was the mother of Lorenz and John V, who both later ruled Werle-Güstrow.
zh: 梅克伦堡的阿格内丝（1320—1340）是“狮子”亨利二世与萨克森-维滕贝格的安娜之女。1338年1月6日她嫁给韦尔勒-居斯特罗领主尼古拉斯三世，生有洛伦茨和约翰五世，二人后来都成为韦尔勒-居斯特罗领主。

en: Albert I (after 1230–15 or 17 May 1265) ruled Mecklenburg from 1264 to 1265 alongside brother Henry I. A son of John I and Liutgard of Henneberg, he was buried at Doberan; his marriage to a daughter of Nicholas I of Werle is undocumented.
zh: 阿尔伯特一世（1230年后—1265年5月15或17日）于1264至1265年与兄长海因里希一世共同统治梅克伦堡。他是约翰一世与亨内贝格的柳特加德之子，葬于多贝兰大教堂；相传他曾娶韦尔勒的尼古拉斯一世之女，但此事无文献可考。

en: Albert II of Mecklenburg (c. 1318 – 18 February 1379), born in Schwerin, was a son of Henry II the Lion and Anna of Saxe-Wittenberg, succeeding his father as Lord of Mecklenburg in 1329. In 1336 he married Euphemia, whose mother Ingeborg was the only legitimate daughter of King Haakon V of Norway; through her he gained estates in Sweden. In 1348 Emperor Charles IV raised Mecklenburg to a duchy, making Albert and his younger brother John its first dukes. When Swedish nobles turned on his brother-in-law, King Magnus IV, Albert put forward his own son Albert as their candidate, meaning to rule through him; the younger Albert deposed Magnus. He also married his eldest son Henry to Ingeborg, eldest daughter of Valdemar IV of Denmark, and offered their infant son as heir to Denmark, without success. The Swedes called him the Fox of Mecklenburg for his scheming and avarice; he died in 1379.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿爾布雷希特二世_(梅克倫堡)
zh: 阿尔布雷希特二世（约1318—1379年2月18日）生于什未林，是“狮子”亨利二世与萨克森-维滕贝格的安娜之子，1329年继父亲之位成为梅克伦堡领主。1336年他娶尤菲米娅，她的母亲英厄堡是挪威国王哈康五世唯一的婚生女，他借此在瑞典获得产业。1348年，神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理四世将梅克伦堡升格为公国，他与弟弟约翰成为首任公爵。瑞典贵族与他的妻兄国王马格努斯四世反目时，他推出同名的儿子阿尔布雷希特作为贵族一方的人选，打算自己在幕后掌权；小阿尔布雷希特后来废黜了马格努斯。他还安排长子亨利娶丹麦国王瓦尔德马四世的长女英厄堡，并把两人的幼子推举为丹麦继承人，未能成功。瑞典人因他的算计与贪婪，称他为“梅克伦堡的狐狸”；他于1379年去世。

en: Anna of Saxe-Wittenberg (c. 1290–1327) was a German noblewoman of the House of Ascania, the daughter of Duke Albert II of Saxony and Agnes of Austria, herself a daughter of King Rudolf I of Germany. On 6 July 1315 she married Henry II the Lion, Lord of Mecklenburg, as his second wife. Her children included Albert II the Great, the first Duke of Mecklenburg, John I of Mecklenburg-Stargard, Ludgarda, who married Duke Władysław of Bytom, Agnes, wife of Nicholas III of Werle, and Beatrix, abbess of Ribnitz. She died in November 1327.
zh: 萨克森-维滕贝格的安娜（约1290—1327）是阿斯坎尼家族的德意志贵族女性，萨克森公爵阿尔伯特二世与奥地利的阿格尼丝之女，其外祖父是德意志国王鲁道夫一世。1315年7月6日，她嫁给梅克伦堡领主“狮子”海因里希二世，成为其第二任妻子。她的子女包括首任梅克伦堡公爵“伟人”阿尔伯特二世、梅克伦堡-施塔加德的约翰一世、嫁给比托姆公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫的柳德加达、嫁给韦尔勒领主尼古拉斯三世的阿格尼丝，以及里布尼茨修道院女院长贝阿特丽克丝。她于1327年11月去世。

en: Beatrix of Mecklenburg, also called Beate (1324 – 5 August 1399), was the youngest daughter of Henry II the Lion and Anna of Saxe-Wittenberg. In March 1325 she was betrothed at Barth to Jaromar, only son of Prince Wizlaw III of Rügen, a match meant to tie Mecklenburg to Rügen. Jaromar died that May and Wizlaw in November, ending the princely house of Rügen. She was instead given to the Poor Clare convent her father had founded at Ribnitz in 1323–24, taking the habit there aged five in 1329. Two nuns from Weißenfels led the convent in turn until she was old enough, and on 20 May 1349, with a papal dispensation for her youth, she was elected abbess, the first princely abbess of Ribnitz. The convent church was built in her lifetime, and its chronicle praises her piety and charity. She resigned through illness in 1398 and is venerated as a Blessed.
zh: 梅克伦堡的贝娅特丽克丝，又名贝娅特（1324—1399年8月5日），是“狮子”亨利二世与萨克森-维滕贝格的安娜最小的女儿。1325年3月，她在巴特与吕根亲王维斯拉夫三世的独子雅罗马订亲，这门亲事本想把梅克伦堡与吕根连在一起；雅罗马当年5月去世，维斯拉夫也在11月去世，吕根亲王家族遂告绝嗣。她改而被送进父亲1323至1324年在里布尼茨创办的贫穷修女会修道院，1329年年仅五岁便在那里穿上会衣。在她够年龄之前，修院先后由两名来自魏森费尔斯的修女主持。1349年5月20日，教廷因她年轻特准，她当选为院长，成为里布尼茨第一位出身诸侯家的女院长。修院教堂建于她生前，院史称颂她虔诚、乐善好施。她于1398年因病辞职，被天主教会尊为真福者。

en: Elizabeth of Mecklenburg was a daughter of John II, Lord of Mecklenburg, and became abbess of Rehna Abbey; she was still living in 1352.
zh: 梅克伦堡的伊丽莎白是梅克伦堡领主约翰二世之女，曾任雷纳修道院女院长，1352年时仍在世。

en: Euphemia Eriksdotter (c. 1317–1363/1370) was a Swedish princess, daughter of Duke Eric Magnusson of Södermanland and Ingeborg of Norway, and younger sister of King Magnus Eriksson. Betrothed in 1321, she married Albert II of Mecklenburg at Rostock in 1336, becoming duchess consort while keeping real political weight in Sweden, where she witnessed seals and in 1340–1341 persuaded Magnus to renew Norwegian trading privileges for Rostock and Wismar. In 1357 she gave estates to Skänninge Abbey. Her son Albert became king of Sweden in 1364.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/歐菲米亞·埃里克斯多塔
zh: 欧菲米亚·埃里克斯多塔（约1317—1363/1370）是瑞典公主，南曼兰公爵埃里克·马格努松与挪威的英格博格之女，瑞典国王马格努斯·埃里克松之妹。她1321年订婚，1336年在罗斯托克与梅克伦堡的阿尔布雷希特二世成婚，成为公爵夫人，同时在瑞典仍保有实际政治影响：她曾为多份文书的封印作证，并于1340—1341年说动马格努斯恢复罗斯托克和维斯马在挪威的贸易特权。1357年，她把产业赠予雪平厄修道院。她的儿子阿尔布雷希特于1364年登上瑞典王位。

en: Henry Borwin I (c. 1150–1227) ruled as Lord of Mecklenburg from 1178, succeeding his father Pribislav after his tournament death at Lüneburg, and married Matilda, illegitimate daughter of Henry the Lion. From 1183 to 1185 he warred on his cousin Nicholas I, allowing King Canute VI of Denmark to capture him and force the cession of Rostock and acceptance of Canute as his liege; Rostock returned to him as a Danish fief in 1200. He fought for Denmark at the Battle of Stellau and received Gadebusch and Ratzeburg, then aided the Danish conquest of Estonia in 1218–1219. He refounded Rostock and Wismar and founded Dobbertin Abbey.
zh: 亨里克·鲍尔温一世（约1150—1227年1月28日）自1178年起任梅克伦堡领主。父亲普里比斯拉夫在吕讷堡的比武中伤死后他继任，并娶狮子亨利的私生女玛蒂尔德为妻。1183至1185年他与堂兄尼古劳斯一世交战，丹麦国王克努特六世乘机将他俘获，迫使他割让罗斯托克并承认克努特为宗主；1200年罗斯托克作为丹麦封邑归还给他。他站在丹麦一方参加施特劳战役，获得加德布施和拉策堡作封邑，1218至1219年又协助丹麦征服爱沙尼亚。他重建罗斯托克和维斯马，创立多贝尔廷修道院，1227年去世。

en: Henry Borwin II (c. 1170–5 June 1226) of the Nikloting dynasty ruled Mecklenburg from 1219 and added Rostock in 1225. A grandson of Prince Pribislav and son of Henry Borwin I, he backed Count Henry I of Schwerin against King Valdemar II of Denmark; victory at the Battle of Mölln in 1225 and the Treaty of Bardowick freed Mecklenburg from Danish overlordship. In 1200 he married Christina, said to be a daughter of King Sverker II of Sweden. He died at Güstrow in 1226, leaving four sons who in 1234 divided Mecklenburg into Werle, Parchim-Richenberg, Rostock and Mecklenburg.
zh: 海因里希·鲍尔温二世（约1170—1226年6月5日）是尼克洛特家族的王公，1219年起统治梅克伦堡，1225年又领有罗斯托克。他是王公普里比斯拉夫之孙、海因里希·鲍尔温一世之子，曾支持什未林伯爵海因里希一世对抗丹麦国王瓦尔德马二世；1225年默尔恩之战获胜后，借《巴多维克条约》使梅克伦堡摆脱了丹麦的宗主权。1200年，他娶相传为瑞典国王斯渥克尔二世之女的克里斯蒂娜。1226年他卒于居斯特罗，留下四个儿子；诸子于1234年将梅克伦堡瓜分为韦尔勒、帕尔希姆-里兴贝格、罗斯托克和梅克伦堡。

en: Henry I of Mecklenburg, called the Pilgrim (c. 1230 – 2 January 1302), was the eldest son of John I the Theologian and ruled Mecklenburg from 1264. From 1266 he required the Jews of Wismar to pay protection money and arranged for the town to supply communion bread and wine to churches in the Ilow area. In 1270 he crusaded against pagan Lithuania, and in 1271 he went on pilgrimage to the Holy Land, only to be captured and held by the Mamluks in Cairo for 27 years. His brothers John II and Nicholas III ruled as regents after a dispute with their cousins over the regency and guardianship of his children. He returned via Morea and Rome in 1298, resumed power in 1299 but left government to his son Henry II, and died in 1302, buried at Doberan Minster.
zh: 亨利一世（约1230—1302年1月2日），绰号“朝圣者”，是“神学家”约翰一世的长子，1264年起统治梅克伦堡。自1266年起，他要求维斯马的犹太人缴纳保护费，并安排该城向伊洛地区的教堂供应圣餐饼酒。1270年他参加十字军讨伐尚未基督教化的立陶宛，1271年启程前往圣地朝圣，途中被俘，被马穆鲁克人囚禁在开罗达27年。他的弟弟约翰二世和尼古拉斯三世与堂兄弟争夺摄政权及其子女的监护权后，担任摄政。1298年他经摩里亚和罗马返回，1299年正式恢复统治，但政务主要交给儿子亨利二世，1302年去世，葬于多伯兰大教堂。

en: Henry II of Mecklenburg, called the Lion (after 14 April 1266 – 21 January 1329), was the son of Henry I the Pilgrim and ruled Mecklenburg from 1302, after regency years during his father's long captivity. Around 1299 he acquired Stargard from his father-in-law Albert III of Brandenburg. In 1304 he fought for King Wenceslaus II of Bohemia against Emperor Albert I, earning his nickname. He fought Wismar and Rostock from 1310, taking Rostock in 1312 and subduing it again after a revolt in 1313. When Brandenburg reclaimed Stargard, Henry defeated Margrave Waldemar at Gransee in 1316 and secured it in the Treaty of Templin in 1317. He died at Sternberg in 1329.
zh: 亨利二世（1266年4月14日后—1329年1月21日），绰号“狮子”，是“朝圣者”亨利一世之子。父亲长期被囚期间，梅克伦堡经历了摄政时期；1302年他开始统治。约1299年，他从岳父勃兰登堡的阿尔布雷希特三世手中获得施塔加德领地。1304年他为波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫二世作战、对抗皇帝阿尔布雷希特一世，由此赢得“狮子”的绰号。1310年起他与维斯马和罗斯托克交战，1312年攻取罗斯托克，该城于1313年起义后又被他镇服。勃兰登堡索还施塔加德，他便于1316年在格兰塞击败藩侯瓦尔德马，1317年凭《滕普林条约》保住该地。1329年他卒于施滕贝格。

en: Henry III (c. 1337–1383) was the eldest son of Duke Albert II of Mecklenburg and Euphemia of Sweden, sister of King Magnus IV, and the heir to his father's Scandinavian ambitions. In 1362 he married Ingeborg, eldest daughter and potential heiress of King Valdemar IV of Denmark. Their infant son was soon offered, unsuccessfully, as heir to Denmark against Valdemar's youngest daughter Margaret, the future ruler of the Kalmar Union. Their daughter Maria became the mother of Eric of Pomerania. After Ingeborg's death Henry married Matilda of Werle in 1377, a childless match, and in 1379 he succeeded his father as duke of Mecklenburg. He died at Schwerin on 24 April 1383 from a tournament accident at Wismar and was buried in Doberan Minster; his brother Magnus I and his son Albert IV took up joint rule.
zh: 海因里希三世（约1337—1383）是梅克伦堡公爵阿尔布雷希特二世与瑞典国王马格努斯四世之妹尤菲米娅的长子，也是父亲北欧野心的继承者。1362年，他娶丹麦国王瓦尔德马四世的长女、可能的继承人英厄堡；两人的幼子很快被推举为丹麦继承人，与瓦尔德马的小女儿、后来统治卡尔马联盟的玛格丽特争夺，未能成功。女儿玛丽亚是波美拉尼亚的埃里克的生母。英厄堡死后，海因里希于1377年娶韦尔莱的玛蒂尔德，婚姻无子嗣；1379年他继父亲之位成为梅克伦堡公爵。1383年4月24日，他因在维斯马的比武大会上受伤，在什未林去世，葬于多贝兰修道院教堂；他的弟弟马格努斯一世与儿子阿尔布雷希特四世接手共同统治。

en: John I of Mecklenburg, called the Theologian (c. 1211 – 1 August 1264), was the eldest son of Henry Borwin II and ruled as Lord of Mecklenburg from 1234. He fought at Bornhöved in 1227, where the Danish defeat freed his land from Danish suzerainty, and later warred against Saxe-Lauenburg and Holstein when they claimed overlordship. He had ruled jointly with his brothers before the division of 1234, when he kept the ancestral lands. In 1255 his brother Pribislaw I was imprisoned by the Bishop of Schwerin and lost his lordship; John received Sternberg in the ensuing division. He promoted the Church and German settlement in Mecklenburg, where Slavs still predominated, and in 1262 allied with the Guelphs against Denmark. He was buried in Doberan Minster.
zh: 约翰一世（约1211—1264年8月1日），绰号“神学家”，是海因里希·鲍尔温二世的长子，1234年起任梅克伦堡领主。1227年他参加博恩赫费德战役，丹麦战败使梅克伦堡摆脱了丹麦的宗主权；此后萨克森-劳恩堡与荷尔斯泰因提出宗主权要求，他又以战争捍卫独立。他原与诸弟共同统治，1234年分家时保留祖业。1255年弟弟普里比斯拉夫一世被什未林主教囚禁并失去领地，约翰在随后的分割中得到施滕贝格。他扶持教会、鼓励德意志人移居，当时梅克伦堡仍以斯拉夫人为主；1262年他与韦尔夫家族结盟对抗丹麦，死后葬于多伯兰大教堂。

en: John I of Mecklenburg-Stargard (1326 – 1392/93) was the youngest son of Henry II the Lion and Anna of Saxe-Wittenberg. His father died in 1329, and John remained under guardianship until 1344. On 8 July 1348 Emperor Charles IV raised him and his brother Albert II to ducal rank at Prague. The brothers first backed the False Waldemar against Margrave Louis V of Bavaria, as Charles did, and made peace with Louis in 1350 once the emperor withdrew his support. In the division of Mecklenburg on 25 November 1352 John received Stargard, Sternberg, Lübz and Ture, founding the Mecklenburg-Stargard line. He backed his nephew Albert III's bid for the Swedish throne. His last dated document is of 9 August 1392; by 9 February 1393 his sons John II and Ulrich I were ruling in his place.
zh: 约翰一世（1326—1392/1393年）是“狮子”亨利二世与萨克森-维滕贝格的安娜最小的儿子。父亲1329年去世，他受监护直到1344年。1348年7月8日，皇帝查理四世在布拉格将他与哥哥阿尔布雷希特二世一同升为公爵。兄弟二人起初与查理四世一样支持“假瓦尔德马”，对抗巴伐利亚藩侯路易五世；1350年皇帝撤回支持后，他们也与路易和解。1352年11月25日梅克伦堡分家，他分得施塔加德、施滕贝格、吕布茨和图雷，开创梅克伦堡-施塔加德支系。他支持侄子阿尔布雷希特三世争取瑞典王位。最后一份注明日期的文书写于1392年8月9日，1393年2月9日前，他的儿子约翰二世和乌尔里希一世已接位统治。

en: John II (c. 1250–1299) was the youngest son of John I of Mecklenburg and Luitgard of Henneberg. After his father died he ruled Mecklenburg from 1264 jointly with his brothers. When his elder brother Henry I was taken captive while on pilgrimage in 1275, John and his brother Nicholas III took over the regency and the guardianship of Henry's sons. From 1283 he is recorded as lord of Gadebusch, probably held as his apanage. His daughter Elizabeth became abbess of Rehna. John died on 12 October 1299.
zh: 约翰二世（约1250—1299）是梅克伦堡领主约翰一世与亨内贝格的柳特加德的幼子。父亲去世后，他自1264年起与诸兄弟共同统治梅克伦堡。1275年兄长亨利一世在朝圣途中被俘，约翰遂与兄弟尼古拉三世共同摄政，监护亨利诸子。1283年起，史料称他为加德布施领主，该地可能是他分得的封邑。其女伊丽莎白后来出任雷纳修道院院长。约翰于1299年10月12日去世。

en: John III (after 1266–1289) was a son of Henry I of Mecklenburg and Anastasia of Pomerania. From 1287 he ruled Mecklenburg jointly with his elder brother Henry II, while their uncle Nicholas III acted as regent. On 3 November 1288 he married Helena, daughter of Wizlaw II, Prince of Rügen. His rule was short: on 27 May 1289 he drowned off the island of Poel and was buried in the Franciscan monastery at Wismar. His daughter Luitgard, born around 1289, married Count Gerhard II of Hoya in 1302.
zh: 约翰三世（1266年后—1289）是梅克伦堡领主亨利一世与波美拉尼亚的阿纳斯塔西娅之子。1287年起，他与兄长亨利二世共同统治梅克伦堡，由叔父尼古拉三世摄政。1288年11月3日，他娶吕根亲王维斯拉夫二世之女海伦娜为妻。他的统治十分短暂：1289年5月27日在珀尔岛附近溺水身亡，葬于维斯马的方济各会修道院。其女柳特加德约生于1289年，1302年嫁给霍亚伯爵格哈德二世。

en: Niklot (c. 1090 – August 1160) was a pagan prince of the Slavic Obotrites, ruling the Obotrite confederacy with the Kissini and Circipani from 1130/1131, and lord of Schwerin, Quetzin and Malchow. He resisted Saxon princes for nearly thirty years. After the Wendish Crusade of 1147 he became a tributary vassal of Henry the Lion, in whose service he crushed a Kissini and Circipani rising in 1151. In 1160 Henry and Valdemar the Great of Denmark attacked him, and Niklot was killed at Burg Werle. His death ended Slavic rule in Mecklenburg up to the Peene; he was ancestor of the House of Mecklenburg.
zh: 尼克洛特（约1090—1160年8月）是中世纪斯拉夫奥博特人的首领，1130至1131年间成为奥博特里特部落联盟（含基西尼部落和切尔奇帕尼部落）的首领，领有什未林、克钦和马尔肖。他在近三十年里抵抗撒克逊诸侯，1147年文德十字军东征后沦为狮子亨利的纳贡附庸，1151年为其镇压基西尼人与切尔奇帕尼人的起义。1160年，狮子亨利与丹麦国王瓦尔德马一世联手进攻，尼克洛特在维尔勒城堡被杀。他的死终结了梅克伦堡直至佩讷河一带的斯拉夫人统治；他是梅克伦堡家族的先祖。

en: Nicholas I, Lord of Mecklenburg (died 25 May 1200), was a son of Wertislaw, the Obotrite prince who ruled Rostock, and governed Mecklenburg from 1178. Between 1183 and 1185 he warred against his cousin Henry Borwin I with Danish backing; in 1185 both cousins had to acknowledge King Canute VI of Denmark as their liege lord, who enfeoffed Nicholas with Rostock. He also campaigned with the Danes and Emperor Frederick I against Henry the Lion. At Waschow in May 1200 the Mecklenburgers defeated Count Adolf III of Holstein, securing southwestern Mecklenburg, but Nicholas fell in the battle.
zh: 尼古拉斯一世（？—1200年5月25日）是奥博德里特王公、罗斯托克统治者韦尔蒂斯拉夫之子，自1178年起统治梅克伦堡。1183至1185年间，他在丹麦支持下与堂亲海因里希·鲍尔温一世交战；1185年，两人被迫承认丹麦国王克努特六世为宗主，克努特随即将罗斯托克封给尼古拉斯。他还曾随丹麦人与皇帝腓特烈一世讨伐狮子亨利。1200年5月，梅克伦堡军队在瓦绍击败荷尔斯泰因伯爵阿道夫三世，巩固了梅克伦堡西南部，但尼古拉斯一世战死阵中。

en: Nicholas II (before 1180–28 September 1225) was Lord of Gadebusch from 1217 and a son of Henry Borwin I of Mecklenburg. He feuded with his father and brother Henry Borwin II, lost all standing, and died at Gadebusch after a fall from his castle.
zh: 尼古拉斯二世（1180年前—1225年9月28日）自1217年起为加德布施领主，是梅克伦堡王公海因里希·鲍尔温一世之子。他与父亲和兄长海因里希·鲍尔温二世交战，由此失势沉沦，最终在加德布施从自己的城堡坠落，伤重而死。

en: Nicholas III of Mecklenburg (after 1230 – 8 June 1289 or 1290) was a younger son of John I the Theologian and an ecclesiastic: on 9 January 1266 he became canon of Lübeck Cathedral, and from 1269 was a priest at St Mary's in Wismar. When his brother Henry I the Pilgrim was captured on pilgrimage to the Holy Land, Nicholas and his brother John II acted as regents and guardians for Henry's underage sons. Last attested in April 1289, he was buried at Doberan Minster.
zh: 尼古拉斯三世（1230年后—1289或1290年6月8日）是“神学家”约翰一世的幼子之一，身为教士：1266年1月9日他成为吕贝克主教座堂的法政牧师，1269年起又在维斯马的圣马利亚教堂任神父。兄长“朝圣者”亨利一世在前往圣地朝圣途中被俘后，他与弟弟约翰二世一同摄政，并监护亨利年幼的儿子们。他最后见于记载是1289年4月，葬于多伯兰大教堂。

en: Pribislav (c. 1132 – 30 December 1178), son of the Obotrite prince Niklot, was the first Prince of Mecklenburg. After Niklot fell in 1160, he and his brother Wertislav led the revolt of 1163 against Henry the Lion; defeated at Verchen in 1164, with Wertislav hanged, Pribislav fled to Pomerania. The Cistercian Berno of Amelungsborn persuaded him to side with the Christians against pagan Slavs, and in 1167 Henry restored him as Prince of Mecklenburg, Kessin and Rostock, founding a dynasty that ruled until 1918. Pribislav founded Doberan Abbey in 1171 and died in 1178 of wounds from a tournament at Lüneburg, succeeded by his son Henry Borwin I.
zh: 梅克伦堡的普里比斯拉夫（约1132—1178年12月30日）是奥博特里特王公尼克洛特之子，也是第一任梅克伦堡亲王。1160年尼克洛特战死后，他与兄弟弗拉季斯拉夫于1163年起兵反抗狮子亨利；1164年在费尔兴战败，弗拉季斯拉夫被绞死，普里比斯拉夫逃奔波美拉尼亚。西多会修士阿默隆斯博恩的贝尔诺劝他与基督徒结盟对抗异教斯拉夫人，1167年狮子亨利恢复他的地位，封他为梅克伦堡、克辛和罗斯托克亲王，由此开创的王朝一直延续到1918年。1171年他创立多伯兰修道院，1178年在吕讷堡的一次比武中因伤而死，其子亨里克·鲍尔温一世继立。

en: Wertislaw (c. 1130 – May or June 1164) was a son of the Obotrite prince Niklot and brother of Prince Pribislav. After Niklot was killed fighting Henry the Lion of Saxony in 1160, Wertislaw and Pribislav waged a guerrilla war from Pomerania against the German vassals and Christian missionaries installed in the Obotrite lands. Defending Burg Werle in the winter of 1163, he was captured by Henry's troops. When Pribislav renewed the revolt in summer 1164, Henry had Wertislaw hanged at the Trostberg near Malchow. His son Nicholas I later became Lord of Mecklenburg.
zh: 弗拉季斯拉夫（约1130—1164年5月或6月）是奥博特里特王公尼克洛特之子、王公普里比斯拉夫的兄弟。1160年尼克洛特在与萨克森公爵狮子亨利作战时被杀后，他与普里比斯拉夫以波美拉尼亚为基地，对安插在奥博特里特土地上的德意志附庸和基督教传教士展开游击战。1163年冬，他在守卫维尔勒城堡时被亨利的军队俘虏。1164年夏普里比斯拉夫再起叛乱，亨利下令将他绞死于马尔肖附近的特罗斯特贝格。其子尼古劳斯一世后来成为梅克伦堡领主。

en: Telheiba was a Meitei king of the Ningthouja dynasty who ruled Kangleipak, the Kingdom of Manipur, from 1335 to 1355, between the reigns of Kongyamba and Tonaba, as recorded in the royal chronicle Cheitharol Kumbaba.
zh: 特尔海巴是梅泰人宁托贾王朝（又称梅泰王朝）的国王，据王室编年史《切塔罗尔·昆巴巴》记载，他于1335—1355年统治刚莱博，即曼尼普尔王国，前王为孔扬巴，后王为托纳巴。

en: Hinakeha was a chiefess of ancient Molokaʻi and the wife of its first named high chief, Kamauaua. Hawaiian chants name her as the mother of his sons, including Keʻoloʻewa, who succeeded Kamauaua. Her name likely recalls the moon goddess Hina.
zh: 希娜凯哈是古代莫洛凯的女酋长，嫁给该岛第一位有名可考的高阶酋长卡马瓦瓦。歌谣相传她是凯奥洛埃瓦等诸子之母，凯奥洛埃瓦后来继承了卡马瓦瓦之位；她的名字可能与月亮女神希娜有关。

en: Hualani, whose name means “heavenly fruit,” was in Hawaiian tradition a ruling high chiefess of Molokaʻi. She was the daughter of Chiefess Kamauliwahine and Laniaiku, and is presented in genealogies as great-granddaughter of Nuakea, herself a granddaughter of the voyager chief Maweke, giving her both Molokaʻi and Oʻahu descent. Tradition relates that Kanipahu, a chief of Hawaiʻi Island’s Pili line who ruled until c. 1245, was living concealed on Molokaʻi when Hualani learned his rank and took him as her husband. Their son was Kalahumoku I, ancestor of later Molokaʻi chiefs.
zh: 华拉妮的名字意为“天上的果实”，相传是莫洛凯的执政高阶女酋长。她是女酋长卡马乌利瓦希内与拉尼艾库之女，家谱中相传为努阿凯阿的曾孙女，而努阿凯阿是远航酋长马韦凯的孙女，因此她兼有莫洛凯与瓦胡两岛的血统。相传约13世纪、夏威夷岛比利家族的酋长卡尼帕胡（约1245年前后在位）隐匿身份流落莫洛凯时，华拉妮得知他的首领身份，便招他为夫。两人之子卡拉胡莫库一世，是后世莫洛凯酋长的祖先。

en: Kamauaua was, in Hawaiian chants and genealogies, the first named high chief of Molokaʻi, though tradition notes that he was probably not the island's first ruler. His wife was the chiefess Hinakeha, who bore him four sons: Kaupeʻepeʻe-nui-kauila, Keʻoloʻewa, Haili and Uli-hala-nui. The eldest son refused the rule, so Keʻoloʻewa succeeded him. His line later gave Molokaʻi three ruling chiefesses, Kapau-a-Nuʻakea, Kamauliwahine and Hualani, who married the Hawaiʻi Island chief Kanipahu, ruler until c. 1245.
zh: 在夏威夷歌谣与谱系中，卡马瓦瓦是莫洛凯岛第一位留下名字的高阶酋长，但传说也指出他未必是该岛最早的统治者。他的妻子是女酋长希娜凯哈，为他生下考佩埃佩埃-努伊-考伊拉、凯奥洛埃瓦、海利与乌利-哈拉-努伊四个儿子；长子不愿继位，凯奥洛埃瓦遂承嗣。他这一支后来出了卡帕乌阿努阿凯阿、卡马乌利瓦希内、华拉妮三位执政女酋长，其中华拉妮嫁给了统治至约1245年的夏威夷岛酋长卡尼帕胡。

en: Kamauliwahine, whose name means “woman,” was a ruling chiefess of Molokaʻi in Hawaiian tradition. She was the only recorded child of Lanileo and the chiefess Kapau-a-Nuʻakea, whom she succeeded as aliʻi nui, or supreme chief, of the island. Her partner was Laniaiku, and their daughter Hualani inherited the rule after her death. Hualani married Kanipahu, a Hawaiʻi Island chief of the Pili line whose reign ended c. 1245.
zh: 卡马乌利瓦希内的名字意为“女人”，相传是莫洛凯的执政女酋长。她是拉尼莱奥与女酋长卡帕乌阿努阿凯阿唯一见载的孩子，后来继承母亲之位，成为岛上的最高酋长。她的伴侣是拉尼艾库，两人的女儿华拉妮在她身后继位。华拉妮嫁给了夏威夷岛比利世系的酋长卡尼帕胡，后者的统治约于1245年结束。

en: Kapau-a-Nuʻakea, whose name means “Kapau child of Nuʻakea,” was in Hawaiian genealogies a ruling chiefess of Molokaʻi. She was the only recorded child of High Chief Keʻoloʻewa and his Oʻahu-born wife Nuʻakea, granddaughter of the voyager Māweke. Kapau succeeded her father as the island's aliʻi nui, at a time when a woman could rule Molokaʻi in her own right. Her husband was Lanileo, and their daughter Kamauliwahine succeeded her. Her granddaughter Hualani married the Hawaiʻi Island chief Kanipahu, who ruled until c. 1245.
zh: 卡帕乌阿努阿凯阿，名字意为“努阿凯阿的孩子卡帕乌”，据夏威夷谱系记载是莫洛凯的执政女酋长。她是高阶酋长凯奥洛埃瓦与出生于瓦胡的妻子努阿凯阿——远航酋长马韦凯的孙女——唯一见载的孩子。卡帕乌继承父亲之位成为岛上的最高酋长，当时女子本就可以凭自身身份统治莫洛凯。她的丈夫是拉尼莱奥，女儿卡马乌利瓦希内后来继位；她的孙女华拉妮嫁给了统治至约1245年的夏威夷岛酋长卡尼帕胡。

en: Keʻoloʻewa, also called Keʻoloʻewa-a-Kamauaua, was in Hawaiian tradition a high chief of Molokaʻi, the son of the island's first named ruler Kamauaua and the chiefess Hinakeha. His elder brother Kaupeʻepeʻe-nui-kauila was the firstborn but declined the rule, so Keʻoloʻewa succeeded their father. He married Nuʻakea, a high chiefess born on Oʻahu and a granddaughter of the voyager chief Māweke. Their only recorded child, Kapau-a-Nuʻakea, succeeded him, and their descendant Hualani married the Hawaiʻi Island chief Kanipahu, who ruled until c. 1245.
zh: 凯奥洛埃瓦，又称卡马瓦瓦之子凯奥洛埃瓦，相传是莫洛凯的高阶酋长，父亲是该岛第一位有名可考的统治者卡马瓦瓦，母亲是女酋长希娜凯哈。他的兄长考佩埃佩埃-努伊-考伊拉虽为长子，却不愿继位，凯奥洛埃瓦便继承父位。他娶了出生在瓦胡的高阶女酋长、远航酋长马韦凯的孙女努阿凯阿。两人唯一见载的孩子卡帕乌阿努阿凯阿继他而立，后裔华拉妮则嫁给了统治至约1245年的夏威夷岛酋长卡尼帕胡。

en: Laniaiku was, in Hawaiian genealogies, the partner of Kamauliwahine, ruling chiefess of Molokaʻi, and the father of her successor Hualani, who married the Hawaiʻi Island chief Kanipahu.
zh: 据夏威夷谱系记载，拉尼艾库是莫洛凯执政女酋长卡马乌利瓦希内的伴侣，也是继位者华拉妮的生父；华拉妮后来嫁给夏威夷岛酋长卡尼帕胡。

en: Lanileo was, in Hawaiian genealogies, the husband of Kapau-a-Nuʻakea, the ruling chiefess of Molokaʻi. He was the father of Kamauliwahine, who succeeded Kapau as ruling chiefess of the island.
zh: 据夏威夷谱系记载，拉尼莱奥是莫洛凯执政女酋长卡帕乌阿努阿凯阿的丈夫，两人之女卡马乌利瓦希内后来继任为莫洛凯的执政女酋长。

en: Nuʻakea was, in Hawaiian tradition, a high chiefess born on Oʻahu, the daughter of Keaunui of ʻEwa and Wehelani and granddaughter of the Tahitian-born wizard chief Māweke, whom chants place in the eleventh century. She was named after the goddess of milk and lactation. She went to Molokaʻi and married its high chief Keʻoloʻewa, bearing his successor Kapau-a-Nuʻakea. The scholar Martha Beckwith held that the historical chiefess was later deified as the goddess Nuʻakea. Her great-granddaughter Hualani married the Hawaiʻi Island chief Kanipahu, ruler until c. 1245.
zh: 据夏威夷传说，努阿凯阿是出生于瓦胡的高阶女酋长，父亲是埃瓦的凯奥努伊，母亲是韦赫拉尼，祖父是出生于塔希提、擅行法术的酋长马韦凯——歌谣称马韦凯生活在11世纪。她的名字取自司掌乳汁与哺乳的女神。后来她前往莫洛凯，嫁给当地高阶酋长凯奥洛埃瓦，生下继位者卡帕乌阿努阿凯阿。学者玛莎·贝克威思认为，这位真实存在过的女酋长后来被神化为女神努阿凯阿。她的曾孙女华拉妮嫁给了统治至约1245年的夏威夷岛酋长卡尼帕胡。

en: Abraham Cresques (1325–1387) was a Jewish cartographer born in Palma, the leading master of the Majorcan cartographic school. Besides maps he made clocks, compasses and other nautical instruments. Together with his son Jehuda Cresques he produced the Catalan Atlas in 1375, a set of chart-tablets commissioned by the Crown of Aragon and one of the most celebrated mappae mundi of the later Middle Ages, blending Mediterranean portolan knowledge with reports from Asia and Africa.
zh: 亚伯拉罕·克雷斯克斯（1325—1387）是生于帕尔马的犹太地图学家，马略卡制图学派的核心大师。除绘制地图外，他还制作时钟、罗盘等航海仪器。1375年，他与儿子耶胡达·克雷斯克斯合作完成《加泰罗尼亚地图集》。这套受阿拉贡王室委托绘制的挂图是中世纪晚期最负盛名的世界地图之一，将地中海波托兰海图的传统与来自亚洲、非洲的见闻融为一体。

en: Constance of Aragon (1318–1346) was the eldest daughter of King Alfonso IV of Aragon and Teresa d'Entença, and sister of Peter IV. To seal friendship with Aragon, King James III of Majorca married her at Perpignan on 24 September 1336. When James refused fealty to her brother in 1342, Peter IV invaded and in the war of 1343–1344 drove James from Majorca, annexing the Balearic Islands to the Crown of Aragon. Mother of the pretender James IV and Isabella of Majorca, she died in exile at Montpellier in 1346.
zh: 康斯坦丝（1318—1346）是阿拉贡国王阿方索四世与特雷莎·德·昂特恩卡的长女，佩德罗四世的姐姐。为与阿拉贡修好，马略卡国王海梅三世于1336年9月24日在佩皮尼昂与她成婚。1342年海梅拒绝向她的弟弟宣誓效忠，佩德罗四世遂发兵入侵，在1343—1344年的战争中将海梅逐出马略卡，把巴利阿里群岛并入阿拉贡王冠领地。她是王位觊觎者海梅四世和马略卡的伊莎贝拉的母亲，1346年在流亡中死于蒙彼利埃。

en: Esclaramunda of Foix (c. 1255–1315) was queen consort of Majorca, wife of James II. Daughter of Count Roger IV of Foix and Brunissende of Cardona, she married the infante James, younger son of James I of Aragon, at Perpignan in October 1275. When James inherited Majorca, Roussillon, Cerdagne and Montpellier in 1276, she became queen and bore six children, including Sancho, James II's successor, Ferdinand, father of James III, and Sancha, wife of Robert of Naples. She tutored her grandson James III and protected the Order of Mercy. She died at Perpignan in 1315, five years after her husband.
zh: 富瓦的埃斯克拉蒙德（约1255—1315）是马略卡国王海梅二世的王后。她是富瓦伯爵罗热四世与布吕尼桑德·德·卡尔多纳之女，1275年10月在佩皮尼昂嫁给阿拉贡国王海梅一世的幼子海梅。1276年海梅继承马略卡、鲁西永、塞尔达尼亚和蒙彼利埃，她遂成为王后，共育有六名子女，包括继位的桑乔、海梅三世之父斐迪南以及嫁给那不勒斯国王罗贝托的桑莎。她曾抚育孙子海梅三世，并庇护仁慈会。1315年她在佩皮尼昂去世，比丈夫多活了五年。

en: Ferdinand of Majorca (1278–1316), born at Perpignan, was the third son of King James II and Viscount of Aumelas from 1311. Frederick III of Sicily sent him to command the Catalan Company, but its leader Bernat de Rocafort rebuffed him, and Venetians captured him on his return. Released by 1310, he fought at Almería and became Lord of Catania in 1313. Through his wife Isabella of Sabran, heiress of Margaret of Villehardouin, he claimed Achaea, seizing Clarenza in June 1315. His rival Matilda of Hainaut returned with Venetian and Burgundian forces, while the aid he expected from Majorca and Sicily was delayed. Ferdinand was killed at the Battle of Manolada on 5 July 1316. His son by Isabella became King James III of Majorca.
zh: 费尔南多·德·马略卡（1278—1316）生于佩皮尼昂，是马略卡国王海梅二世的第三子，1311年起任欧梅拉斯子爵。西西里国王腓特烈三世派他统率加泰罗尼亚佣兵团，却遭该团首领贝尔纳特·德·罗卡福特拒绝；他在归途中被威尼斯人俘虏，至1310年已获释，参加阿尔梅里亚围城战，1313年成为卡塔尼亚领主。他娶维勒哈杜安的玛格丽特的女继承人伊莎贝拉·德·萨布朗为妻，借此主张亚该亚亲王国的继承权，于1315年6月攻占克拉伦扎。竞争对手玛奥·德·埃诺带着威尼斯和勃艮第援军返回，而他期盼的马略卡和西西里援军迟迟未到。1316年7月5日，费尔南多在马诺拉达战役中阵亡。他与伊莎贝拉的儿子后来成为马略卡国王海梅三世。

en: Ferdinand the Younger (1316–1342) was born in Nicosia, Cyprus, a posthumous son. His father, Infante Ferdinand of Majorca, had been killed at Manolada while trying to settle in Achaea, and his mother was Isabella of Ibelin. He grew up at the Angevin court of Naples under his aunt Sancha, so steeped in Franciscan ideals that he took some vows, with the support of Pope John XXII. King Sancho's will made him heir to the Majorcan crown after his half-brother James III, who in 1326 granted him an annual income of three thousand livres, later replaced by the viscounty of Aumelas, and gave him Miramar in 1337 and Vernet in 1339. About 1338 he married Esquiva of Lusignan, daughter of Hugh IV of Cyprus, and they had a daughter, Alicia. His relations with his father-in-law deteriorated, and in 1341 he was imprisoned; only papal intervention freed him. He returned alone to Majorca and died there in 1342.
zh: 小费尔南多（1316—1342）生于塞浦路斯尼科西亚，是遗腹子：父亲马略卡王子费尔南多为在亚该亚立足，战死于马诺拉达，母亲是伊莎贝拉·德·伊贝林。他在那不勒斯的安茹宫廷由姑母桑查抚养长大，深受方济各会理想影响，以至发过部分修道誓愿，并得到教皇约翰二十二世的支持。按国王桑乔的遗嘱，他是继异母兄海梅三世之后的马略卡王位继承人；海梅于1326年赐他每年三千里弗尔的年金，后来改封欧梅拉斯子爵领，1337年又把米拉马尔、1339年把韦尔内特封给他。约1338年，他娶塞浦路斯国王于格四世之女埃斯基瓦·德·吕西尼昂，两人有一女阿莉西亚。他与岳父的关系恶化，1341年被囚禁，经教皇斡旋才得以脱身。他独自返回马略卡，1342年在当地去世。

en: Isabella de Sabran (1297 – 7 May 1315) was the daughter of Isnard de Sabran, Lord of Ansouis, and Margaret of Villehardouin, heiress to the Frankish Principality of Achaea. In 1314 she married Ferdinand of Majorca, a younger son of King James II, at Messina; her mother made over to the couple the barony of Akova and her claim to Achaea. She gave birth to the future James III of Majorca on 5 April 1315 at Catania and died a month later. Ferdinand then took up the Achaean claim in the name of their infant son.
zh: 伊莎贝尔·德·萨布朗（1297—1315年5月7日）是昂苏伊领主伊斯纳尔·德·萨布朗与亚该亚法兰克亲王国女继承人玛格丽特·德·维勒哈杜因之女。1314年，她在墨西拿嫁给马略卡国王海梅二世的幼子之一费尔南多；母亲将阿科瓦男爵领以及自己对亚该亚的继承权都让与这对夫妇。1315年4月5日，她在卡塔尼亚生下未来的马略卡国王海梅三世，一个月后便去世。费尔南多随后以他们襁褓中的儿子的名义争夺亚该亚。

en: Isabella of Ibelin (1300–after 1342) was a Cypriot noblewoman, daughter of Philip of Ibelin, seneschal of Cyprus, and Maria Embriaco. In October 1315 she married by proxy Ferdinand of Majorca, claimant to the Principality of Achaea; the wedding in person followed at Glarentza in the Morea on 7 June 1316. Weeks later Ferdinand was defeated and beheaded after the Battle of Manolada. Returning to Cyprus widowed, she married the titular Count of Jaffa, Hugh of Ibelin, in 1320. She was the mother of Ferdinand, Viscount of Omélas, and was later accused of sorcery by King Hugh IV.
zh: 伊贝林的伊莎贝尔（1300—1342年后）是塞浦路斯贵族女子，父亲是塞浦路斯总管腓力·德·伊贝林，母亲是玛丽亚·恩布里亚科。1315年10月，她以代理婚礼嫁给亚该亚侯国的觊觎者、马略卡的费尔南多；1316年6月7日，两人在摩里亚的克拉伦扎亲自成婚。仅仅数周后，费尔南多就在马诺拉达战役兵败后被斩首。她守寡返回塞浦路斯，于1320年再嫁名义上的雅法伯爵于格·德·伊贝林。她生子奥梅拉斯子爵费尔南多，后来被于格四世指控施行巫术。

en: James II of Majorca (1243–1311), second son of James I of Aragon and Violant of Hungary, inherited Mallorca, Ibiza and Formentera with Roussillon, Cerdanya and Montpellier in 1276. That year he funded a language school for Franciscan missionaries at Miramar. By the 1279 Treaty of Perpignan he became a vassal of the Crown of Aragon. France and Aragon contested Sicily, and James, whose borderlands were exposed to invasion, made an agreement with France. After he sided with France against his nephew Alfonso III, the Balearics were annexed but restored under the 1295 Treaty of Anagni. He then reformed the currency and economy and built Bellver Castle and Palma Cathedral. Married to Esclaramunda of Foix, he was succeeded in 1311 by his son Sancho.
