zh: 马略卡国王海梅二世（1243—1311）是阿拉贡国王海梅一世与匈牙利的约兰的次子，1276年继承马略卡、伊维萨、福门特拉三座巴利阿里岛屿，以及鲁西永、塞尔达尼亚和蒙彼利埃。同年他资助米拉马尔的一所方济各会传教士语言学校。1279年他据《佩皮尼昂条约》承认自己是阿拉贡王室的封臣。法国与阿拉贡争夺西西里时，海梅的边境领地易遭入侵，他与法国达成协议。他曾联法对抗外甥阿方索三世，巴利阿里群岛一度被吞并，1295年凭《阿纳尼条约》收复。此后他改革币制与经济，修建贝尔韦尔城堡和帕尔马主教座堂。他娶富瓦的埃斯克拉尔蒙达，1311年由儿子桑乔继位。

en: James III of Majorca (1315–1349), called the Rash, was born at Catania. His father Ferdinand was killed at Manolada in 1316 trying to seize Achaea from the Angevins, and his mother Isabella of Sabran died soon after the birth; the orphan was declared Prince of Achaea. In 1324 he succeeded his uncle Sancho as King of Majorca. Majorcan kings swore fealty to Aragon, but James argued that no king could hold authority over another, and jurists of Montpellier backed him. In 1337 he issued the Leges palatinae, the first code of its kind for a royal court, and commissioned an illuminated copy that he kept even after losing his throne, finally selling it to Philip VI of France. In 1342 he refused fealty to his cousin Peter IV of Aragon. A troubadour wrote a poem in his defence, but Peter conquered Majorca in 1344. James died at the Battle of Llucmajor on 25 October 1349, trying to recover it.
zh: 海梅三世，绰号“鲁莽者”（1315—1349），生于卡塔尼亚。1316年，父亲费尔南多为从安茹家族手中夺取亚该亚，在马诺拉达战死；母亲伊莎贝拉·德·萨布朗在他出生后不久也已去世，孤儿被宣布为亚该亚亲王。1324年，他继叔父桑乔之后成为马略卡国王。马略卡国王历来要向阿拉贡国王宣誓效忠，海梅却主张国王不应受另一位国王管辖，蒙彼利埃的法学者为他辩护。1337年，他颁布《宫廷法》，这是同类宫廷法典中的首创；他还委托制作了一部精美的装饰手抄本，失去王位后仍带在身边，最终卖给了法王腓力六世。1342年，他拒绝向表兄阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世宣誓效忠，一位行吟诗人写诗为他辩护，但佩德罗仍于1344年征服了马略卡。1349年10月25日，海梅在试图收复王国的柳克马约尔战役中阵亡。

en: James IV of Majorca (c. 1336 – 20 January 1375), born at Perpignan, was the son of James III and Constance of Aragon. After his father fell at Llucmajor in 1349 trying to reconquer the island, James was captured by his uncle Peter IV of Aragon and caged in Barcelona until 1362. Escaping to Naples, he married Queen Joanna I at Castel Nuovo on 26 September 1363, as king consort without power. He fought for the Black Prince at Nájera in 1367 and twice attacked Roussillon, dying defeated at Soria in 1375; his claim passed to his sister Isabella.
zh: 海梅四世（约1336—1375年1月20日）生于佩皮尼昂，是海梅三世与阿拉贡的康斯坦丝之子。1349年父亲在试图收复马略卡的柳克马约尔战役中阵亡后，他被舅父阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世俘获，关在巴塞罗那的铁笼里直至1362年。他逃到那不勒斯，1363年9月26日在新堡与女王乔万娜一世成婚，成为不预政务的王夫。1367年他随黑太子出战纳赫拉战役，又两度进攻鲁西永，均告失败，1375年死于索里亚，其继承权传给妹妹伊莎贝拉。

en: Sancho I (Catalan Sanç; c. 1277 – 4 September 1324), called the Pacific, was King of Majorca, Count of Roussillon and Cerdanya and Lord of Montpellier from 1311 until his death. Succeeding his father James II, he kept the realm at peace and aided James II of Aragon's conquest of Sardinia. His marriage to Maria of Anjou was childless, and he made a will in 1322 settling the crown on his nephew James, son of his late brother Ferdinand, and set up a regency council, forestalling annexation by Aragon. He spent much time in the uplands because of his asthma and died at Formiguères in 1324.
zh: 桑乔一世（加泰罗尼亚语作桑斯，约1277—1324年9月4日），绰号“和平者”，自1311年起任马略卡国王、鲁西永与塞尔达尼亚伯爵、蒙彼利埃领主，直至去世。他继承父亲海梅二世之位，治下太平无事，还协助阿拉贡国王海梅二世征服撒丁岛。他与安茹的玛丽亚的婚姻没有子女，便于1322年立下遗嘱，把王位传予亡弟费尔南多之子、侄子海梅，并设立摄政会议，阻止了阿拉贡的兼并。他因哮喘常在高地休养，1324年在福尔米盖尔去世。

en: Albert Azzo II (1009–1097), Margrave of Milan and Liguria, was a powerful nobleman in the Holy Roman Empire. Inheriting his father's lands around 1029, he enlarged his estates in northern Italy. In 1069–1070 he sought to gain Maine for his son Hugh through the rights of his wife Garsende, a co-heiress of its counts. Around 1073 he made the castle of Este his residence, giving the House of Este its name; before his building project Este had been little more than a village. In the Investiture Controversy he first mediated between Henry IV and Pope Gregory VII, then sided with the pope. His son by Kunigunde of Altdorf, Welf I of Bavaria, founded the Guelph line; Fulco I, his son by Garsende of Maine, began the Italian branch. Azzo died in 1097 at Vangadizza monastery, aged 88.
zh: 阿尔贝托·阿佐二世（1009—1097）是米兰与利古里亚藩侯，也是神圣罗马帝国的一位有权势的贵族。他约于1029年继承父领，不断在北意大利扩张地产。1069—1070年，他凭妻子加尔桑德作为曼恩伯爵家族共同继承人的权利，试图为儿子于格争取曼恩。约1073年，他将埃斯泰城堡定为居所，埃斯特家族由此得名；在他的建造工程之前，埃斯泰不过是个小村庄。主教叙任权之争期间，他先试图在皇帝亨利四世与教皇格列高利七世之间调停，后转而支持教皇。他与首任妻子阿尔特多夫的库妮贡德生下巴伐利亚公爵韦尔夫一世，即韦尔夫（归尔夫）家族的祖先；与第二任妻子曼恩的加尔桑德所生之子富尔科一世则开创了家族的意大利支系。他于1097年在万加迪扎修道院去世，享年88岁。

en: Andreotto Visconti was the son of Uberto Visconti, lord of Massino, and Berta Pirovano, and brother of Archbishop Ottone Visconti, first lord of Milan. His son Teobaldo, beheaded by the Torriani in 1276, was the father of Matteo I Visconti, the Great.
zh: 安德雷奥托·维斯孔蒂是马西诺领主乌贝托·维斯孔蒂与贝尔塔·皮罗瓦诺之子，大主教奥托尼·维斯孔蒂的兄弟。其子特巴尔多1276年被托里亚尼家族斩首，特巴尔多之子为“伟人”马泰奥一世。

en: Antiochia Visconti was a Milanese noblewoman, a daughter of Pietro Visconti and a sister of the soldier Lodrisio Visconti. She married Simone della Torre, second son of Guido della Torre, Lord of Milan, a marriage that tied the rival Visconti and della Torre families together.
zh: 安蒂奥基娅·维斯孔蒂是米兰贵族女子，彼得罗·维斯孔蒂之女、武将洛德里西奥·维斯孔蒂的姐妹。她嫁给米兰领主圭多·德拉·托雷的次子西莫内·德拉·托雷，这桩婚事将彼此敌对的维斯孔蒂家族与德拉·托雷家族联结在一起。

en: Azzo V d'Este (1125–1193) was an Italian nobleman, the son of Margrave Obizzo I. In 1176 he married Marchesella Adelardi, heiress of the Adelardi, the leading Guelph family of Ferrara; the marriage brought the Este large estates in the city and leadership of its Guelph party, opening the road to the later Este lordship of Ferrara. Azzo lived in Ferrara while his father still ruled the marquisate of Este. He died prematurely in 1193, shortly before Obizzo I, so he never reigned; the succession passed to his son Azzo VI.
zh: 阿佐五世·德斯特（1125—1193）是意大利贵族，藩侯奥皮佐一世之子。1176年，他娶费拉拉首要圭尔夫家族阿德拉尔迪家的女继承人马尔凯塞拉·阿德拉尔迪为妻；这场婚姻为埃斯特家族带来费拉拉的大片地产和当地圭尔夫派的领导权，为日后统治费拉拉铺平了道路。父亲执掌埃斯特藩侯领地期间，阿佐住在费拉拉。他于1193年先于父亲早逝，终未继位，家族由其子阿佐六世继承。

en: Azzone Visconti (7 December 1302 – 16 August 1339) was born at Ferrara, where his parents Galeazzo I and Beatrice d'Este had taken refuge after the Torriani drove his grandfather Matteo out of Milan; he was their only legitimate son. In 1325 he commanded at Altopascio and Zappolino. After King Louis IV jailed the family in Monza castle in 1327, he sold Azzone the imperial vicariate of Milan in 1329 for sixty thousand florins. Azzone fortified the city against Louis' return; in September his uncle Marco, who coveted the lordship, was found dead, the Viscontis won the pope's absolution, and in March 1330 the council made him lord of Milan for life. He rebuilt Visconti power, taking Bergamo in 1332, Vercelli and Cremona in 1334, then Como, Lodi, Piacenza and Brescia. Crippled by gout, he gave Luchino the army that crushed Lodrisio at Parabiago early in 1339, and died that August, buried in San Gottardo, a church he had commissioned.
zh: 阿佐内·维斯孔蒂（1302年12月7日—1339年8月16日）生于费拉拉：托里亚尼家族把他的祖父马泰奥赶出米兰后，父母加莱亚佐一世与贝阿特丽切·德斯特避居此地。他是二人唯一的嫡子。1325年，他在阿尔托帕肖和扎波利诺两役中统兵取胜。1327年，国王路易四世把维斯孔蒂一家关进蒙扎城堡，1329年却以六万弗罗林把米兰皇帝代理人的头衔卖给阿佐内。阿佐内加固米兰以防路易卷土重来；同年9月，觊觎领主之位的叔父马尔科被发现死去，维斯孔蒂家族获得教皇赦免，1330年3月，议会推举他为米兰终身领主。他重建家族势力：1332年取得贝加莫，1334年取得韦尔切利和克雷莫纳，随后是科莫、洛迪、皮亚琴察和布雷西亚。他因痛风行动不便，1339年初把军队交给卢基诺，后者在帕拉比亚戈击溃洛德里西奥；同年8月阿佐内去世，葬于他下令兴建的圣哥达教堂。

en: Beatrice d'Este (1268–1334), daughter of Obizzo II d'Este, marquis of Ferrara, married first Nino Visconti, judge of Gallura in Sardinia, and bore him a daughter Joanna in 1291. Widowed in 1296, she returned to Ferrara, and on 24 June 1300 married Galeazzo I Visconti at Modena, becoming lady of Milan; their son was Azzone Visconti. After the second marriage Joanna lost her inheritance and found shelter at Volterra. Beatrice shared the Visconti exile of 1302–1311 and later fled Piacenza with Azzone to escape revolts. After Emperor Louis the Bavarian deposed Galeazzo in 1327 and he died in exile in 1328, Azzone became lord of Milan in 1329. Dante alludes to her in Purgatorio. She died in Milan in 1334.
zh: 贝阿特丽切·德斯特（1268—1334）是费拉拉侯爵奥比佐二世·德斯特之女。她嫁给撒丁岛加卢拉法官尼诺·维斯孔蒂，1291年生下女儿乔万娜；1296年丧夫后返回费拉拉。1300年6月24日，她在摩德纳改嫁加莱亚佐一世·维斯孔蒂，成为米兰领主夫人，生子阿佐内·维斯孔蒂。再婚后，乔万娜失去继承权，在沃尔泰拉寻得庇护。1302—1311年贝阿特丽切随维斯孔蒂家族流亡，后来又与阿佐内为躲避叛乱逃离皮亚琴察。皇帝路易四世于1327年废黜加莱亚佐，后者1328年死于流放，阿佐内遂于1329年成为米兰领主。但丁在《神曲·炼狱篇》中影射过她。1334年她卒于米兰。

en: Benedetto da Asinago (c. 1273–1339) was a Lombard friar from the Locarno region whom Pope John XXII appointed Bishop of Como in 1328. Como's clergy had instead elected Valeriano Rusca, the candidate of Emperor Louis the Bavarian, so the city had two rival bishops, one named by the pope and one by the emperor, and they fought over the see for years. In 1335 Benedetto gathered allies and attacked the city to drive Rusca out. The hard-pressed Rusca family finally offered Azzone Visconti of Milan the lordship of Como in return for Bellinzona. On 25 July Azzone entered with an army, installed Benedetto as the lawful bishop, fortified the city and made peace between its Guelphs and Ghibellines, keeping the lordship for himself. Benedetto held the see until his death in October 1339.
zh: 贝内代托·达西纳戈（约1273—1339）是出身洛迦诺一带的伦巴第修士，1328年被教皇约翰二十二世任命为科莫主教。但科莫教士另选了皇帝路易四世（巴伐利亚人）属意的瓦莱里亚诺·鲁斯卡，于是城里出现了两位对立的主教，一位由教皇任命，一位由皇帝任命，为教区争战多年。1335年，贝内代托纠集盟军攻打科莫，要赶走鲁斯卡。招架不住的鲁斯卡家族最终向米兰的阿佐内·维斯孔蒂开出条件：科莫的统治权换贝林佐纳。7月25日，阿佐内率军进城，扶立贝内代托为合法主教，加固城防，调停当地圭尔夫派与吉伯林派，统治权则归他自己。贝内代托一直担任主教，直到1339年10月去世。

en: Bernabò Visconti (1323 – 19 December 1385), son of Stefano Visconti and Valentina Doria, lived in exile after a plot against his uncle Luchino, until Archbishop Giovanni recalled him to Milan in 1349. In 1350 he married Beatrice Regina della Scala of Verona. In 1354 he inherited Milan with Matteo II and Galeazzo II and took the eastern lands facing the Scaligeri: Bergamo, Brescia and Cremona. Matteo died in 1355, rumoured poisoned by his brothers. In November 1356 the Visconti army caught an invading league at Casorate and captured the imperial vicar Marquard of Randeck. Bernabò fought almost constant wars against Pope Urban V, Florence, Venice and Savoy; in 1363 the pope declared him a heretic and proclaimed a crusade, and the 1364 peace cost him Bologna but brought half a million florins and lifted his excommunication. On 6 May 1385 his nephew Gian Galeazzo seized him, and he died in Trezzo castle that December, apparently poisoned.
zh: 贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂（1323—1385年12月19日）是斯特凡诺·维斯孔蒂与瓦伦蒂娜·多里亚之子。他因参与谋害叔父卢基诺的阴谋而流亡，直到1349年乔瓦尼大主教将他召回米兰。1350年，他娶维罗纳的贝阿特丽切·雷吉娜·德拉·斯卡拉。1354年，他与马泰奥二世、加莱亚佐二世共同继承米兰，分得与斯卡拉家族接壤的东部领地：贝加莫、布雷西亚和克雷莫纳。1355年马泰奥暴卒，传闻遭兄弟毒杀。1356年11月，维斯孔蒂军队在卡索拉泰截住入侵的反维斯孔蒂联盟，俘虏了皇帝代理人马夸德·冯·兰代克。贝尔纳博几乎连年与教皇乌尔班五世、佛罗伦萨、威尼斯和萨伏依交战；1363年教皇宣布他为异端并发起十字军讨伐，1364年的和约让他交出博洛尼亚，换得五十万弗罗林，并解除了绝罚。1385年5月6日，侄子吉安·加莱亚佐将他拘捕，同年12月他死于特雷佐城堡，疑为中毒。

en: Bernardino Corio (1459–c. 1519) was a Milanese humanist historian from a family that had served the Sforza for two and a half centuries. A chamberlain to Galeazzo Maria Sforza from 1474, he witnessed the duke's murder in 1476 and later entered Ludovico Sforza's circle, holding offices including Giudice delle Strade. Backed by Ludovico, who wanted to justify Sforza rule, he began around 1485 a history of Milan from its origins to 1499. In 1497 the duke ordered the archives of Como and Valtellina opened to him. Corio left Milan after Ludovico's fall. Printed in 1503, his Patria historia was the first scholarly history of an Italian city written in the vernacular rather than Latin.
zh: 贝尔纳迪诺·科里奥（1459—约1519）是米兰人文主义历史学家，其家族效忠斯福尔扎家族已逾两个半世纪。1474年起他任加莱亚佐·马利亚·斯福尔扎的侍从，亲历1476年公爵遇刺，后进入卢多维科·斯福尔扎的圈子，曾任道路法官等职。约1485年，他在希望为斯福尔扎统治辩护的卢多维科支持下，开始撰写一部从米兰起源写到1499年的史书。1497年公爵下令向他开放科莫与瓦尔泰利纳的档案。卢多维科倒台后，科里奥离开米兰。1503年刊行的《祖国史》是第一部用意大利俗语而非拉丁语写成的意大利城市学术史著作。

en: Catherine of Savoy-Vaud (1324 – 18 June 1388) was the daughter of Louis II of Savoy, Baron of Vaud, and Isabella of Châlon. In 1330 she married Azzone Visconti, lord of Milan, who left her a childless widow in 1339. After her brother Giovanni fell at the Battle of Laupen, a special privilege made her Louis's heir, ruling Vaud as baroness from 1349. Her second husband, Constable Raoul II de Brienne, was beheaded in 1350; in 1352 she married William I of Namur. In 1359 she sold Vaud to Amadeus VI of Savoy for a hundred and sixty thousand florins.
zh: 卡泰丽娜·迪·萨伏依-沃（1324—1388年6月18日）是沃男爵路易二世·德·萨伏依与伊莎贝尔·德·沙隆之女。1330年她嫁给米兰领主阿佐内·维斯孔蒂，1339年丈夫去世，未留子嗣。弟弟乔瓦尼在劳彭战役阵亡后，凭借一项特殊特权她被立为父亲的继承人，1349年起以女男爵身份统治沃。她的第二任丈夫、法国统帅拉乌尔二世·德·布里耶纳于1350年被斩首，1352年她改嫁那慕尔侯爵威廉一世。1359年，她以16万弗罗林的价格把沃卖给萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥六世。

en: Caverno della Torre, also recorded as Caverna, was a Lombard nobleman of the Guelph della Torre family of Milan and a son of Pagano della Torre, count of Valsassina and podestà of Brescia, who died in 1241.
zh: 卡韦尔诺·德拉·托雷（亦作卡韦尔纳）是米兰归尔甫派德拉·托雷家族的伦巴第贵族，为瓦尔萨西纳伯爵、布雷西亚执政官帕加诺·德拉·托雷（1241年卒）之子。

en: Ermanno della Torre was a son of Pagano della Torre, Count of Valsassina, and is recorded as podestà of Florence; he was still alive after 1258.
zh: 埃尔曼诺·德拉·托雷是瓦尔萨西纳伯爵帕加诺·德拉·托雷之子，据载曾任佛罗伦萨的波德斯塔，1258年后仍在世。

en: Filippo della Torre (early 13th century – 24 September 1265) was a Milanese Guelph noble, son of Iacopo, count of Valsassina, and brother of Martino, first signore of Milan. Made podestà of Genoa in 1256, he provoked a popular revolt by his disloyal administration. Back in Milan he became perpetual people's captain and succeeded Martino as lord on 18 December 1263. He brought Novara, Lodi, Vercelli and Bergamo under his sway, bloodily subdued Como, and in 1264 expelled the Ghibelline Oberto Pallavicino. In 1265 he supported the passage of Charles I of Anjou's troops, then died suddenly on 24 September and was buried at Chiaravalle.
zh: 菲利波·德拉·托雷（13世纪初—1265年9月24日）是米兰圭尔夫派贵族，瓦尔萨西纳伯爵贾科莫之子、米兰首任领主马蒂诺之弟。1256年他被任命为热那亚波德斯塔，因施政不忠于该城而引发民众暴动。回到米兰后，他成为终身人民领袖，并于1263年12月18日继马蒂诺之后成为米兰领主。他使诺瓦拉、洛迪、韦尔切利和贝加莫臣服，血腥镇压科莫，1264年驱逐皇帝派首领奥贝托·帕拉维奇诺。1265年他支持安茹的查理一世的军队借道，同年9月24日暴卒，葬于基亚拉瓦莱修道院。

en: Finiberto della Torre was the son of Simone della Torre and Antiochia Visconti, and grandson of Guido della Torre, Guelph lord of Milan. He had a son, Guido.
zh: 菲尼贝托·德拉·托雷是西莫内·德拉·托雷与安蒂奥基亚·维斯孔蒂之子，米兰圭尔夫派领主圭多·德拉·托雷之孙。他有一子圭多。

en: Fulco I d'Este (c. 1070–c. 1134) founded the Italian branch of the House of Este. A younger son of Margrave Albert Azzo II and Garsende of Maine, he inherited the family's Italian estates around Mantua, Padua, Treviso and Verona when his father died in 1097, while his elder half-brother Welf took the lands north of the Alps. Welf disputed the partition in vain, and after Fulco's death the Bavarian Guelphs only dropped their claim in 1154. Fulco was the first of his line to forge ties with the nobility of Ferrara, later ruled by his descendants; his son Obizzo I succeeded him.
zh: 富尔科一世·德斯特（约1070—约1134）是埃斯特家族意大利支的始祖。他是藩侯阿尔贝托·阿佐二世与曼恩的加森德所生的幼子之一，1097年父亲去世后继承了家族在意大利的领地——曼托瓦、帕多瓦、特雷维索和维罗纳一带，异母长兄韦尔夫则分得阿尔卑斯山以北的土地。韦尔夫不服分割，企图夺取意大利领地而未果；富尔科死后，巴伐利亚的韦尔夫派直到1154年才放弃主张。富尔科是家族中率先与费拉拉贵族结交的人，其后代后来统治了费拉拉，其子奥皮佐一世继位。

en: Francesco della Torre was a Milanese Guelph noble, son of Pagano I della Torre and brother of Napoleone, who ruled Milan from 1265. He held the lordship of Seprio while his brothers Paganino held Vercelli and Raimondo sat as bishop of Como. When Archbishop Ottone Visconti attacked the della Torre by night at Desio, Francesco was killed in the battle on 21 January 1277. His son Guido was captured with his uncle Napoleone and imprisoned at Castel Baradello in Como, and the Visconti became masters of Milan.
zh: 弗朗切斯科·德拉·托雷是米兰圭尔夫派贵族，帕加诺一世·德拉·托雷之子、1265年起统治米兰的纳波莱奥内的兄弟。他领有塞普里奥，兄弟帕加尼诺据有韦尔切利，拉伊蒙多则任科莫主教。大主教奥托内·维斯孔蒂在代西奥夜袭德拉·托雷家族时，弗朗切斯科于1277年1月21日战死。他的儿子圭多与叔父纳波莱奥内一同被俘，囚禁于科莫的巴拉德罗城堡；维斯孔蒂家族就此成为米兰之主。

en: Francesco Pecorari was an architect from Cremona active in the first half of the fourteenth century. An inscription on the octagonal bell tower of Milan's church of San Gottardo, raised between 1330 and 1336 to carry the city's first public clock, names him in Latin as Magister Franciscus de Pecoraris de Cremona. He is also credited with the octagonal tower of Chiaravalle Abbey near Milan, dated 1329–1340, and with work on the great Torrazzo bell tower of his native Cremona.
zh: 弗朗切斯科·佩科拉里是克雷莫纳建筑师，活跃于14世纪上半叶。米兰圣戈塔尔多教堂的八角形钟楼建于1330—1336年，用来安放全城第一座公共时钟，塔上铭文以拉丁文称他为“克雷莫纳的弗朗切斯科·德·佩科拉里斯大师”。米兰附近基亚拉瓦莱修道院的八角形塔楼（1329—1340年）也出自他之手，他还参与了故乡克雷莫纳托拉佐大钟楼的工程。

en: Galeazzo I Visconti (1277–1328), son of Matteo I Visconti, married Beatrice d'Este on 24 June 1300 and shared the long Visconti exile. He spent several years at the courts of the Este and Bonacolsi. Named capitano del popolo of Milan in 1322, he succeeded his father as lord and defeated a Papal–Angevin army at Bassignana, earning excommunication from Pope John XXII in March 1323. Unrest in Milan weakened his authority. With Emperor Louis IV he routed another papal army near Monza, but the emperor imprisoned him there in 1327 on his brother Marco's accusations. Freed in March 1328, he took shelter with Castruccio Castracani and died at Pescia on 6 August; his son Azzone succeeded him.
zh: 加莱亚佐一世·维斯孔蒂（1277—1328）是马泰奥一世·维斯孔蒂之子。1300年6月24日他娶贝阿特丽切·德斯特为妻，并随家族度过长期流亡，曾在德斯特与博纳科尔西家族的宫廷寄居多年。1322年他被任命为米兰人民统帅，继任其父为领主，在巴西尼亚纳击败教皇与安茹的联军，1323年3月被教皇约翰二十二世开除教籍。米兰的动荡削弱了他的权威。他借助皇帝路易四世在蒙扎附近再破教皇军，却于1327年因弟弟马可的指控被皇帝囚禁于蒙扎。1328年3月获释后，他投奔卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼，8月6日卒于佩夏；其子阿佐内继位。

en: Galeazzo II Visconti (c. 1320 – 4 August 1378), son of Stefano Visconti and Valentina Doria, was exiled in 1346 by his uncle Luchino, who suspected him of an affair with Luchino's wife, and returned after Luchino died. In 1354 he inherited Milan with his brothers Bernabò and Matteo II and took the western lands facing Savoy. When a league backed by Emperor Charles IV's vicar attacked in 1356, the Visconti army beat it at Casorate. Galeazzo took Pavia in 1359, founded its university in 1361 and invited Petrarch there. He rebuilt it in the manner of the old Lombard and Italian capital, and in 1365, once its castle was finished, moved his court there, leaving Milan to Bernabò. He married his son Gian Galeazzo to Isabelle of Valois, sister of the French king, for half a million florins. He joined the War of the Eight Saints in 1375 and died three years later; Gian Galeazzo succeeded him.
zh: 加莱亚佐二世·维斯孔蒂（约1320—1378年8月4日）是斯特凡诺·维斯孔蒂与瓦伦蒂娜·多里亚之子。1346年，叔父卢基诺怀疑他与自己的妻子有私情，将他放逐，直到卢基诺去世后他才回到米兰。1354年，他与兄弟贝尔纳博、马泰奥二世共同继承米兰，分得毗邻萨伏依的西部领地。1356年，皇帝查理四世的代理人支持的联盟来犯，维斯孔蒂军队在卡索拉泰将其击败。1359年他攻取帕维亚，1361年在当地创办大学并邀请彼特拉克前来。他仿照古代伦巴第与意大利诸王的国都重建这座城市，1365年城堡竣工后，把宫廷迁往帕维亚，将米兰留给了贝尔纳博。他花五十万弗罗林，让儿子吉安·加莱亚佐迎娶法国国王的妹妹瓦卢瓦的伊莎贝拉。1375年他加入八圣之战，三年后去世，吉安·加莱亚佐继位。

en: Galvano Fiamma (1283–1344) was a Milanese Dominican born into a family of notaries. He entered the monastery of Sant'Eustorgio, taught theology at Pavia from 1308 to 1313, and later lectured in Milan on ethics, rhetoric and economics. His many chronicles, among them the Chronica Galvagnana and the Chronicon maius, trace Milan's history from its origins, and he drew a map of the city around 1330. In 1339 Archbishop Giovanni Visconti made him his chaplain. He has also been identified as the first Mediterranean writer to describe lands across the Atlantic.
zh: 加尔瓦诺·菲亚马（1283—1344）是米兰多明我会修士，出身公证人家庭。他入圣欧斯托焦修道院，1308—1313年在帕维亚教授神学，后回米兰讲授伦理学、修辞学和经济学。他著有《加尔瓦尼奥编年史》《大编年史》等多部史书，从起源起记述米兰历史，并在约1330年绘制了一幅米兰地图。1339年，米兰大主教乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂任命他为专职神父。他还被认为是最早记述大西洋彼岸陆地的地中海地区作家。

en: Gaspare Visconti was the son of the feudatory Uberto Visconti and Berta Pirovano and a brother of Archbishop Ottone Visconti. He was podestà of Oleggio in 1248 and headed the Visconti branches holding Caronno, Jerago and Fagnano; his son Pietro was lord of Seprio.
zh: 加斯帕雷·维斯孔蒂是封建主乌贝托·维斯孔蒂与贝尔塔·皮罗瓦诺之子，大主教奥托尼·维斯孔蒂的兄弟。他于1248年任奥莱焦的波德斯塔，是据有卡龙诺、耶拉戈和法尼亚诺的维斯孔蒂支系首领，其子彼得罗为塞普里奥领主。

en: Gianfrancesco da Correggio (born c. 1320), also called Canfrancesco or Cagnolo, was the son of Simone da Correggio, who had made himself lord of Parma with his brothers in 1341 and died in 1344. That year Azzo gave the city up to Este, and his uncles quarrelled over the sale. Gianfrancesco first backed Azzo, then shifted between the great lords contending for the Po valley, and never regained the Parma his father had held. He served at the Visconti court and then at the Este court in Ferrara, where King Louis of Hungary made him a knight. After siding with the Ghibellines he fled Ferrara, but was caught and brought back to the Este court. Obizzo d'Este took San Quirico from him, and he gained his freedom only by ceding Gualtieri as well.
zh: 詹弗朗切斯科·达·科雷焦（约1320年生），又作坎弗朗切斯科，通称卡尼奥洛，是西莫内·达·科雷焦之子；西莫内1341年与兄弟们夺得帕尔马，1344年去世。同年阿佐把这座城让给了埃斯特家族，叔父们为这笔出售起了争执。詹弗朗切斯科先支持阿佐，随后在争夺波河流域的各大领主之间反复投靠，始终未能夺回父亲曾拥有的帕尔马。他先后在维斯孔蒂家族的宫廷和费拉拉的埃斯特宫廷任职，在费拉拉由匈牙利国王拉约什封为骑士。他站在皇帝派一边后逃离费拉拉，却被追回埃斯特宫廷。奥比佐·德斯特夺走他在帕尔马地区的圣奎里科，他又割让瓜尔蒂耶里才重获自由。

en: Giovanni di Balduccio (c. 1300 – c. 1365) was a Pisan sculptor, son of Balduccio di Alboneto. Trained in Pisa's cathedral workshop, he signed work at Sarzana in 1327 and at San Casciano in Val di Pesa in 1330–1331 before Azzone Visconti called him to Milan around 1334. There his signed marble shrine of Saint Peter Martyr in Sant'Eustorgio, dated 1339, is his masterpiece. He also sculpted for the Brera church, declined the mastership of Pisa Cathedral in 1349, and is credited by some scholars with the Arca di Sant'Agostino at Pavia, built 1362–1365.
zh: 乔瓦尼·迪·巴尔杜乔（约1300—约1365）是比萨雕塑家，巴尔杜乔·迪·阿尔博内托之子。他在比萨大教堂作坊学艺，1327年在萨尔扎纳、1330—1331年在佩萨河谷圣卡夏诺留下署名作品，约1334年应阿佐内·维斯孔蒂之邀前往米兰。他在米兰圣欧斯托焦教堂署名完成的圣彼得·殉道者大理石圣龛（1339年）是其代表作。他还为布列拉教堂雕刻，1349年婉拒比萨大教堂工坊总监之职；帕维亚的圣奥古斯丁圣龛（1362—1365年）也被一些学者归于他手。

en: Giovanni Visconti (1290–1354), son of Matteo I Visconti, was an archbishop who led armies and held cities by force. Elected archbishop of Milan in 1317, he was refused confirmation by Pope John XXII, who installed Aicardo da Camodeia and excommunicated him for heresy in 1323; the antipope Nicholas V made him a cardinal. He became bishop and lord of Novara in 1331 and entered Milan in triumph in 1339 after Aicardo's death, confirmed only in 1342. With his brother Luchino he bought the co-lordship of Milan from the pope for half a million florins, and after 1349 he ruled alone with his nephews Matteo II, Galeazzo II and Bernabò. He gained Bologna in 1350 and Genoa in 1353. When Florence organized an alliance against him, he had leading Bolognese arrested and tortured until they confessed to a plot with Florence, and used it to justify war. Petrarch was his guest in 1353; Giovanni died on 5 October 1354.
zh: 乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂（1290—1354）是马泰奥一世·维斯孔蒂之子，一位带兵打仗、以武力夺取并守住城市的大主教。1317年他当选米兰大主教，教皇约翰二十二世拒绝批准，改任艾卡尔多·达·卡莫代亚，并于1323年以异端罪名将他绝罚；对立教皇尼古拉五世则封他为枢机。1331年他成为诺瓦拉主教兼领主，1339年艾卡尔多去世后凯旋进入米兰，1342年才获正式批准。他与兄弟卢基诺以五十万弗罗林向教皇买下米兰共治权；1349年后独自统治，并让侄子马泰奥二世、加莱亚佐二世与贝尔纳博参与政权。他于1350年取得博洛尼亚，1353年取得热那亚。佛罗伦萨组织联盟对抗他时，他拘捕并拷问博洛尼亚的多名显要，逼出与佛罗伦萨合谋的供词，借此向佛罗伦萨开战。1353年彼特拉克来做他的客人；1354年10月5日他去世。

en: Guglielmo Pallavicino (1106–1162) was a feudal nobleman of the Pallavicino family of Parma and the father of Oberto, who died in 1196.
zh: 古列尔莫·帕拉维奇诺（1106—1162）是帕尔马帕拉维奇诺家族的封建贵族，其子奥贝托于1196年去世。

en: Iacopo della Torre was a Milanese nobleman of the della Torre house who died in 1216. He was the father of Pagano della Torre, count of Valsassina from 1216 and later podestà of Brescia and Bergamo, whose career made the family a power in Lombardy.
zh: 贾科莫·德拉·托雷是米兰德拉·托雷家族的贵族，1216年去世。他是帕加诺·德拉·托雷之父；帕加诺自1216年起任瓦尔萨西纳伯爵，后来出任布雷西亚和贝加莫的波德斯塔，使家族成为伦巴第强权。

en: Iacopo della Torre, count of Valsassina, was a Milanese nobleman of the Guelph della Torre house and nephew of Pagano I. He fathered Martino, first signore of Milan in 1259, and Filippo, who succeeded to the lordship in 1263, and was buried at Chiaravalle Abbey.
zh: 贾科莫·德拉·托雷是米兰圭尔夫派德拉·托雷家族贵族、瓦尔萨西纳伯爵，帕加诺一世之侄。他生下1259年成为米兰首任领主的马蒂诺，以及1263年继任领主的菲利波，身后葬于基亚拉瓦莱修道院。

en: Isabella Fieschi (fl. 1331–1356), daughter of the Genoese noble Carlo Fieschi, count of Savignone, was a great-niece of Pope Adrian V. In 1331 she married Luchino Visconti in Milan, a match arranged to seal an alliance between Genoa and Milan. He was much older and had been married twice before. She became lady of Milan in 1339, when Luchino took power after the death of his nephew Azzone. She was known for her beauty and her lovers. An official visit to Venice in 1347 turned scandalous, with Doge Andrea Dandolo and Luchino's nephew Galeazzo II reportedly among them, and Luchino swore to punish her cruelly; he died shortly after, in 1349, rumoured to have been poisoned by her. Her son was forced to give up his rights to power in Milan and she was placed under house arrest. In 1356 she escaped and reportedly returned to her family in Savignone.
zh: 伊莎贝拉·菲耶斯基（活跃于1331—1356年）是热那亚贵族、萨维尼奥内伯爵卡洛·菲耶斯基之女，教皇阿德里安五世的侄孙女。1331年她在米兰嫁给鲁吉诺·维斯孔蒂，这桩婚事是为了缔结热那亚与米兰的联盟。鲁吉诺年长许多，此前已结过两次婚。1339年，鲁吉诺在侄子阿佐内死后掌权，她成为米兰领主夫人。她以美貌和情人闻名。1347年她出访威尼斯，闹出丑闻，据称威尼斯总督安德烈亚·丹多洛和鲁吉诺的侄子加莱亚佐二世都在其列，鲁吉诺扬言要严惩她；他不久后于1349年去世，传闻是被她毒死。她的儿子被迫放弃在米兰掌权的权利，她本人遭软禁。1356年她逃出米兰，据称回到萨维尼奥内的家族中。

en: Leonardo di ser Piero da Vinci (1452–1519) was an Italian polymath of the High Renaissance, born near Vinci in Tuscany and trained in Florence under the sculptor-painter Andrea del Verrocchio. From 1482 to 1499 he served Ludovico Sforza of Milan, painting The Last Supper at Santa Maria delle Grazie and modelling the unfinished Gran Cavallo equestrian monument. Back in Florence he painted the Mona Lisa, while thousands of notebook pages explored anatomy, optics, flight and engineering. His designs included flying machines, though few of his inventions were built in his lifetime. He later worked in Milan again and briefly in Rome. In 1516 he accepted Francis I's invitation to France, where he died at Amboise in 1519.
zh: 列奥纳多·迪·塞尔·皮耶罗·达·芬奇（1452—1519）是意大利盛期文艺复兴博学者，出生于托斯卡纳的芬奇镇附近，在佛罗伦萨师从雕塑家兼画家安德烈亚·德尔·韦罗基奥。1482至1499年，他效力于米兰公爵卢多维科·斯福尔扎，在感恩圣母修道院绘制《最后的晚餐》，并为未完成的“大骏马”骑马像制作模型。回到佛罗伦萨后，他创作了《蒙娜丽莎》，数千页笔记则涉及解剖学、光学、飞行与机械工程。他设计过飞行器，但生前很少有发明得以造出。此后他重返米兰工作，又在罗马短暂居留。1516年，他应弗朗索瓦一世之邀前往法国，1519年在昂布瓦斯去世。

en: Leonardo Visconti (died c. 1376) was the natural son of Giovanni Visconti, archbishop and co-lord of Milan. In 1352 he served as podestà of Novara, but a quarrel with his father drove him from Visconti territory, and he took shelter at Viazalla castle in the Vercelli country with his wife. He then entered the service of John II, Marquess of Montferrat, and helped the marquess acquire Alba, Asti and Cuneo, setting himself against his Milanese Visconti kinsmen. He died around 1376.
zh: 莱奥纳多·维斯孔蒂（约1376年卒）是米兰大主教兼共治领主乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂的私生子。1352年他担任诺瓦拉的波德斯塔，后因与父亲失和而离开维斯孔蒂领地，携妻子避居韦尔切利一带的维亚扎拉城堡。此后他效力于蒙费拉托侯爵乔瓦尼二世，助其取得阿尔巴、阿斯蒂和库内奥，由此与米兰的维斯孔蒂族人为敌。他约于1376年去世。

en: Lodrisio Visconti (c. 1280–1364), son of Pietro Visconti and Antiochia Crivelli, was a Milanese condottiero who fought both for and against his own house. He first backed Matteo Visconti and his son Galeazzo in winning Milan back from the Torriani, then helped his cousin Marco arrest Galeazzo I and Azzone at Monza. He fled to his Seprio fief, but Azzone destroyed it, and Lodrisio took service with Mastino II della Scala of Verona. In 1339, backed by Mastino, he raised the Compagnia di San Giorgio, largely Swiss and remembered as the first organised mercenary company led by an Italian. He invaded the Milanese and was defeated and captured at Parabiago in February. With his son Ambrogio he spent ten years in an iron cage in San Colombano castle, until Archbishop Giovanni Visconti freed him. He later led troops for Galeazzo II in Piedmont, distinguished himself in the 1356 victory over the anti-Visconti league, and died in 1364.
zh: 洛德里西奥·维斯孔蒂（约1280—1364）是皮埃特罗·维斯孔蒂与安蒂奥基亚·克里韦利之子，米兰籍雇佣兵首领，在家族内斗中既帮过本家，也反过本家。起初他支持马泰奥·维斯孔蒂及其子加莱亚佐从托里亚尼家族手中夺回米兰，后来协助堂兄马可在蒙扎拘捕加莱亚佐一世和阿佐内。他逃到自己的塞普里奥封地，阿佐内却将其摧毁，他转而投靠维罗纳的马斯蒂诺二世·德拉·斯卡拉。1339年，他在马斯蒂诺支持下组建圣乔治佣兵团，成员以瑞士人为主，被视为意大利人统领的第一支建制佣兵团。他入侵米兰领地，2月在帕拉比亚戈战败被俘，与儿子安布罗焦一同被关在圣科隆巴诺城堡的铁笼里达十年，直到大主教乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂将他释放。他后来为加莱亚佐二世在皮埃蒙特统兵，在1356年击败反维斯孔蒂同盟的战役中立功，1364年去世。

en: Lombardo della Torre (c. 1231–1280) was a Milanese Torriani nobleman, son of Ermanno della Torre and Lucia da Correggio. He fought valiantly alongside his kinsmen in the wars against Archbishop Ottone Visconti and was among the sixty della Torre who charged at the battle of Desio on 21 January 1277. Captured in the defeat, he was thrown into the iron cage of Castel Baradello above Como, where he perished in 1280. By Caterina Pirovano he left sons Febo and Raimondo II, who carried on the family line in Friuli.
zh: 伦巴多·德拉·托雷（约1231—1280）是米兰托里亚尼家族贵族，埃尔曼诺·德拉·托雷与露琪亚·达·科雷焦之子。他在对抗米兰大主教奥托内·维斯孔蒂的战争中随族人英勇作战，1277年1月21日代西奥之战时与六十名族人一同冲锋，兵败被俘。他被关进科莫上方巴拉德罗城堡的铁笼，1280年死于狱中。他与妻子卡泰丽娜·皮罗瓦诺生有费博和雷蒙多二世，二子在弗留利延续了家族血脉。

en: Luchino Visconti (1287 or 1292 – 24 January 1349), son of Matteo I Visconti, was left out of the succession and chose a soldier's life. In 1339 he led Milan's army to victory at Parabiago over Lodrisio's mercenaries, and when Azzone died that August he and his brother Giovanni, the archbishop, were chosen lords of Milan, with Luchino holding real power. He took Bellinzona in 1340 and Locarno in 1341, the year he won the pope's absolution for the family, and in 1346 forced the Este to sell him Parma. His rule was harsh: Francesco Pusterla's plot against him ended with Pusterla and his sons beheaded, and he later exiled his nephews Bernabò, Galeazzo and Matteo. When plague reached Milan in 1348 he had the first infected houses walled up, and the city was spared the worst. In January 1349, after reportedly threatening his wife Isabella Fieschi with burning at the stake, he died of poison; Corio and Giovio blamed her.
zh: 卢基诺·维斯孔蒂（1287或1292—1349年1月24日）是马泰奥一世·维斯孔蒂之子，被排除在继承之外，转而投身军旅。1339年，他统率米兰军队，在帕拉比亚戈击败族人洛德里西奥的雇佣军；同年8月阿佐内去世，他与兄弟乔瓦尼大主教被推举为米兰领主，实权掌握在他手里。1340年，他攻取贝林佐纳；1341年攻取洛迦诺，并为家族求得教皇赦免；1346年迫使埃斯特家族把帕尔马卖给他。他的统治严厉：弗朗切斯科·普斯泰拉谋反败露，普斯泰拉父子被斩首；他后来又放逐了侄子贝尔纳博、加莱亚佐和马泰奥。1348年瘟疫传入米兰，他下令把最早出现病例的几户人家封死，米兰躲过了最惨重的灾难。1349年1月，相传他扬言要把妻子伊莎贝拉·菲耶斯基烧死，随后中毒身亡，编年史家科里奥和焦维奥都认为是她下的手。

en: Manfredo Beccaria was a son of the Pavian signore Manfredi Beccaria and brother of Castellino and Fiorello Beccaria, who shared rule over Pavia. From him descended the Beccaria branch of the Gropello, lords of Gropello Cairoli, and he was succeeded by his son Corrado.
zh: 曼弗雷多·贝卡里亚是帕维亚统治者曼弗雷迪·贝卡里亚之子，与曾共同执掌帕维亚的卡斯特利诺、菲奥雷洛为兄弟。贝卡里亚家族的格罗佩洛支——格罗佩洛-卡伊罗利的领主——自他而兴，其后由其子科拉多承袭。

en: Marco Visconti, nicknamed Balatrone (c. 1289–1329), was a Ghibelline condottiero, son of Matteo I Visconti and Bonacossa Borri. He fought for Henry VII from 1310, taking Alessandria and ousting Archbishop Cassone della Torre from Milan; he later took Asti and Vercelli, served Genoa's Doria and Spinola, and was excommunicated. He fought for Pisa at Montecatini in 1315. In 1327, with Lodrisio, he accused Galeazzo of treason and established a pro-imperial government. He accompanied Louis the Bavarian to his imperial coronation in Rome. In Tuscany in 1329 he seized Lucca with the Company of the Ceruglio and sold it for thirty thousand florins. On his return to Milan on 5 September 1329, he was strangled and his body thrown from a window; his nephew Azzone and Luchino were said to have taken part.
zh: 马可·维斯孔蒂，绰号巴拉特罗内（约1289—1329），是吉伯林派雇佣兵首领，马泰奥一世·维斯孔蒂与博纳科萨·博里之子。他自1310年为亨利七世作战，攻占亚历山德里亚，把大主教卡索内·德拉·托雷逐出米兰；后来又夺取阿斯蒂和韦尔切利，为热那亚的多里亚家族与斯皮诺拉家族效力，并被开除教籍。1315年他为比萨参加蒙泰卡蒂尼战役。1327年，他与洛德里西奥一同控告加莱亚佐叛国，建立亲帝国政府，并随巴伐利亚的路易赴罗马参加其皇帝加冕礼。1329年他在托斯卡纳率切鲁利奥佣兵团夺取卢卡，将该城以三万弗罗林售出。1329年9月5日他回到米兰后被勒死，尸体被掷出窗外；据称他的侄子阿佐内与鲁吉诺参与了杀害。

en: Martino della Torre (died 20 November 1263), son of Iacopo della Torre and nephew of Pagano I, led Milan's popular party. An elder of the Credenza di Sant'Ambrogio from 1247, he continued the land survey begun by Pagano and was podestà of Lodi in 1252. A peace with the noble faction in 1258 provided for the division of public offices between the parties. In April 1259 he became capitano del popolo and then the first signore of Milan. With Oberto Pallavicino he defeated the Ghibelline Ezzelino III da Romano at Cassano d'Adda in 1259, and later appointed Pallavicino commander-general. He fought Pope Urban IV's appointment of Ottone Visconti as archbishop and was excommunicated. Made podestà of Novara in June 1263, he died at Lodi that November and was buried at Chiaravalle.
zh: 马蒂诺·德拉·托雷（1263年11月20日卒）是贾科莫·德拉·托雷之子、帕加诺一世之侄，米兰平民派的领袖。1247年起任圣安布罗斯公社会长老，继续帕加诺开始的土地清丈，1252年任洛迪的波德斯塔。1258年他与贵族派达成和约，规定双方分配公职。1259年4月他成为人民统领，随后成为米兰第一任领主。他与奥贝托·帕拉维奇诺联手，于1259年在阿达河畔卡萨诺击败皇帝派领袖埃泽利诺三世·达·罗马诺，后来任命帕拉维奇诺为总指挥。他抵制教皇乌尔班四世任命奥托内·维斯孔蒂为大主教，因而被绝罚。1263年6月他出任诺瓦拉的波德斯塔，同年11月在洛迪病逝，葬于基亚拉瓦莱修道院。

en: Matteo I Visconti, called the Great (1250–1322), son of Teobaldo Visconti, married Bonacossa Borri in 1269 and was named capitano del popolo by his great-uncle Archbishop Ottone in 1287, succeeding as lord of Milan in 1295. Imperial vicar of Lombardy from 1294, he was driven into exile in 1302 by a league led by the Della Torre and other enemies. He spent several years as a guest of the Scala family at Nogarola. In 1311 Henry VII sold him the title of imperial vicar of Milan. His sons extended Ghibelline power and took Pavia in 1315. Excommunicated by Pope John XXII, condemned for necromancy and threatened with a crusade, he abdicated in 1322 and died on 24 June, leaving Milan to his son Galeazzo I.
zh: 马泰奥一世·维斯孔蒂，号称伟大者（1250—1322），是泰奥巴尔多·维斯孔蒂之子，1269年娶博纳科萨·博里。1287年，他的叔祖父、大主教奥托内任命他为米兰人民统帅，1295年继任米兰领主。他自1294年担任伦巴第帝国代理人，1302年被德拉·托雷家族及其他敌对势力组成的联盟逐出米兰，在诺加罗拉受斯卡拉家族庇护多年。1311年亨利七世将米兰帝国代理人头衔卖给他。他的诸子扩张吉伯林派势力，于1315年夺取帕维亚。他被教皇约翰二十二世开除教籍、以巫术定罪并面临十字军讨伐，1322年退位，6月24日去世，米兰传予其子加莱亚佐一世。

en: Matteo II Visconti (c. 1319–1355) was the eldest son of Stefano Visconti and Valentina Doria. In 1342 he married Egidiola Gonzaga, daughter of Mantua's captain Filippino Gonzaga. After a failed plot against his uncle Luchino Visconti he was exiled to Montferrat in 1346 and recalled in 1349. When his uncle Archbishop Giovanni died in 1354, Matteo and his brothers Galeazzo II and Bernabò divided the Visconti domains, his share including Lodi, Piacenza, Parma and Bologna. He died at Saronno in September 1355 after dinner, almost certainly poisoned on his brothers' orders, who then split his lands.
zh: 马泰奥二世·维斯孔蒂（约1319—1355）是斯泰法诺·维斯孔蒂与瓦伦蒂娜·多里亚的长子。1342年，他娶曼托瓦平民长官菲利皮诺·贡扎加之女埃吉迪奥拉·贡扎加为妻。因反对叔父卢基诺·维斯孔蒂的密谋败露，他于1346年被放逐到蒙费拉托，1349年才被召回米兰。1354年叔父乔瓦尼大主教去世后，马泰奥与弟弟加莱亚佐二世、贝尔纳博瓜分维斯孔蒂领地，分得洛迪、皮亚琴察、帕尔马和博洛尼亚。1355年9月他在萨罗诺晚餐后身亡，几乎可以确定是奉其弟之命被毒杀，他的领地随后被两人瓜分。

en: Corrado della Torre, known as Mosca (c. 1251–1307), was a son of Napoleone della Torre, Guelph lord of Milan, and Marguerite de Baux. Podestà of Mantua in 1268–1269, he fought at Desio in 1277, was captured with his father and held in the Baradello tower. He later governed Istria and served as podestà of Trieste in 1293 and Bergamo in 1304. In 1305 he arbitrated a dispute in the Tortona area and ordered Pietro di Montegioco to surrender his castle and release its prisoners. He also obtained permission to draw water from the Brembo, beginning an irrigation system for the fields around Treviglio. In 1307 a plot by Matteo Visconti and Ottorino da Soresina against him and his cousin Guido failed. Corrado died in Milan on 24 October 1307 and was buried at San Francesco Grande.
zh: 科拉多·德拉·托雷，绰号“莫斯卡”（约1251—1307），是米兰归尔甫派领主拿波列奥内·德拉·托雷与普罗旺斯贵族玛格丽特·德·博之子。他于1268至1269年任曼托瓦执政官，1277年参加代西奥之战，与父亲一同被俘，囚禁于巴拉德罗塔。此后他出掌伊斯特拉，并于1293年任的里雅斯特执政官、1304年任贝加莫执政官。1305年，他在托尔托纳地区仲裁纠纷，命令彼得罗·迪·蒙泰焦科交出城堡并释放囚犯。他还获准从布伦博河引水，为特雷维廖周边农田修建灌溉系统。1307年，马泰奥·维斯孔蒂与奥托里诺·达·索雷西纳密谋除掉他和堂兄圭多，事败。科拉多于1307年10月24日在米兰去世，葬于大圣方济各堂。

en: Oberto I Pallavicino, nicknamed Pelavicino (1080–1148), was a Lombard feudatory of Busseto, near Parma, son of Oberto IV of the Obertenghi; his nickname became the family name Pallavicino. In 1116 he courted Emperor Henry V when the latter entered Italy to claim Matilda of Canossa's inheritance. From 1124 he held Fontanellato castle and the former Este lands of Soragna and Borgo San Donnino. In 1136 he helped found the Cistercian abbey of Chiaravalle della Colomba. After feuding with his son Delfino, he submitted lands in the Parma region to Piacenza in 1145 and received them back as fiefs in return for homage. War broke out between Parma and Piacenza, and Delfino sided with Parma against him. Oberto died at Busseto in 1148, before hostilities ended in 1153.
zh: 奥贝托一世·帕拉维奇诺，绰号佩拉维奇诺（1080—1148），是帕尔马附近布塞托的伦巴第封臣，奥贝尔滕吉家族的奥贝托四世之子；他的绰号后来演变为家族姓氏帕拉维奇诺。1116年皇帝亨利五世进入意大利索取卡诺莎的玛蒂尔达的遗产时，奥贝托向他示好。1124年起，他领有丰塔内拉托城堡以及原属德斯特家族的索拉尼亚、博尔戈圣多尼诺等地。1136年，他参与创建熙笃会的基阿拉瓦莱-德拉科隆巴修道院。后来他与儿子德尔菲诺反目，于1145年将帕尔马地区的土地交给皮亚琴察，以效忠换取这些封地。帕尔马与皮亚琴察爆发战争，德尔菲诺联合帕尔马对抗父亲。奥贝托于1148年卒于布塞托，未能等到1153年战事结束。

en: Obizzo I d'Este (c. 1100–1193) succeeded his father Folco I as marquis of Este and reunited his grandfather Albert Azzo II's Italian lands. He maintained good relations with both emperor and pope. In 1163 he aided Frederick Barbarossa against Verona and Padua, yet in 1167 joined the Lombard League against the emperor; he attended the Peace of Venice in 1177 with a retinue of 180 men and was named podestà of Padua the same year. In 1184 Barbarossa made him marquis of Milan and Genoa. In Ferrara he led the Guelph Adelardi faction, preparing his family's rise in the city. His son Azzo V died in 1193, and when Obizzo died on Christmas Day that year, his grandson Azzo VI succeeded him.
zh: 奥比佐一世·埃斯特（约1100—1193）继承父亲富尔科一世成为埃斯特藩侯，把祖父阿尔贝托·阿佐二世曾拥有的意大利领地重新统一。他与皇帝和教皇都保持了良好关系。1163年，他协助腓特烈·巴巴罗萨攻打维罗纳和帕多瓦，却在1167年加入反对皇帝的伦巴第同盟；1177年他带着180名随从出席威尼斯和会，同年被任命为帕多瓦的波德斯塔。1184年，巴巴罗萨封他为米兰和热那亚藩侯。在费拉拉，他成为归尔夫派阿代拉尔迪家族的领袖，为家族日后在该城的崛起铺平道路。儿子阿佐五世于1193年去世，奥比佐同年圣诞节去世后，由孙子阿佐六世继位。

en: Ottone Visconti (1207–1295), churchman born near Novara, became the first Visconti lord of Milan. In 1262 Pope Urban IV named him archbishop over the candidate of the Guelph Della Torre, who opposed his appointment. Their occupation of Milan Cathedral began a war between the families; in 1263 Ottone surrendered after their troops besieged Arona. In the long war that followed, his nephew Teobaldo was beheaded in 1276, but Ottone defeated Napoleone della Torre at Desio and entered Milan as its ruler on 22 January 1277. Victor again at Vaprio d'Adda in 1281, he made his grand-nephew Matteo I capitano generale in 1287, retired to religious affairs, and died at Chiaravalle Abbey on 8 August 1295.
zh: 奥托内·维斯孔蒂（1207—1295）出身教士，生于诺瓦拉附近，是维斯孔蒂家族首任米兰领主。1262年，教皇乌尔班四世越过归尔甫派德拉·托雷家族推举的人选，任命他为米兰大主教，该家族反对这一任命。德拉·托雷家族占据米兰主教座堂，两家由此开战；1263年，奥托内在其军队围攻阿罗纳后投降。在随后的长期战争中，他的侄子泰奥巴尔多于1276年被斩首；但1277年1月奥托内在代西奥击败纳波莱奥内·德拉·托雷，于1月22日以统治者身份进入米兰。1281年他又在阿达河畔瓦普里奥获胜，1287年任命侄孙马泰奥一世·维斯孔蒂为统帅，此后退居教务，1295年8月8日卒于基阿拉瓦莱修道院。

en: Pagano della Torre, Count of Valsassina from 1216, was a Guelph noble and son of Iacopo della Torre. Named podestà of Brescia in 1227 as the second Lombard League formed, he also held Bergamo in 1229, but feuding noble families forced him to flee. Podestà of Brescia again in 1235, he represented Milan at a meeting of League envoys in Viterbo the following year. After the imperial victory at Cortenuova in 1237, he gathered the broken Milanese army at Pontida and sheltered its men in Valsassina, caring for the wounded. Milan made him an elder of the Credenza di Sant'Ambrogio in 1240, where he promoted a land survey that lowered taxes. He died on 6 January 1241 and was buried at Chiaravalle.
zh: 帕加诺·德拉·托雷是1216年起受封的瓦尔萨西纳伯爵，教皇派贵族，贾科莫·德拉·托雷之子。1227年第二次伦巴第同盟组建时，他被任命为布雷西亚的波德斯塔，1229年执掌贝加莫，却因贵族家族争斗被迫逃离。1235年他再度出掌布雷西亚，次年代表米兰参加同盟使者在维泰博的会议。1237年帝国军队在科尔泰诺瓦取胜后，他在蓬蒂达收拢溃散的米兰残军，将他们安置在瓦尔萨西纳并救治伤员。1240年米兰立他为圣安布罗斯公社会的长老，他在任上推行土地清丈，降低了赋税。1241年1月6日去世，葬于基亚拉瓦莱修道院。

en: Pietro Azario (1312 – after 1367) was a notary born in Novara, then under Milanese rule. By 1347 he was serving the Visconti at Borgomanero, and from about 1362 he acted as chancellor to the podestà of Tortona, Giovanni del Pirovano. There he compiled his Liber Gestorum in Lombardia, a chronicle of northern Italy and above all of Milan under the Visconti from 1250 to 1362, later extended with the events of 1363–1364. A trusted copy survives in Milan's Biblioteca Ambrosiana; his death is unrecorded, though he was alive in 1367.
zh: 彼得罗·阿扎里奥（1312—1367年后）是生于诺瓦拉的公证人，当时诺瓦拉处在米兰统治之下。1347年他已在博尔戈马内罗为维斯孔蒂家族效力，约1362年起担任托尔托纳行政长官乔瓦尼·德尔·皮罗瓦诺的文书。他在当地撰写《伦巴第事迹录》，记述1250—1362年间北意大利、尤其是维斯孔蒂治下米兰的历史，后来又补入1363—1364年的史事。米兰安布罗修图书馆藏有一份可靠抄本；其卒年不详，但1367年仍在世。

en: Pietro Visconti was a Milanese nobleman of the Visconti house, son of Gaspare Visconti and lord of Seprio. By his wife Antiochia Crivelli he fathered the condottiero Lodrisio Visconti and Antiochia, wife of Simone della Torre.
zh: 彼得罗·维斯孔蒂是米兰维斯孔蒂家族贵族，加斯帕雷·维斯孔蒂之子、塞普里奥领主。他与妻子安蒂奥基娅·克里韦利生下雇佣兵首领洛德里西奥·维斯孔蒂，以及嫁给西莫内·德拉·托雷的安蒂奥基娅。

en: Francesco Sforza (23 July 1401–8 March 1466) was the Italian condottiero who founded the Sforza dynasty in Milan. Born at Cigoli in Tuscany, illegitimate son of condottiero Muzio Sforza, he fought from his teens in his father's company and served in turn Naples, the papacy, Florence, Venice and the Visconti. In 1433–1435 he attacked the Papal States for Milan, then changed sides after taking Ancona and became its papal vicar. In 1441 he married Bianca Maria Visconti, daughter of Duke Filippo Maria. After 1447 he first served, then besieged the Ambrosian Republic, entering Milan as duke in 1450. He improved irrigation canals, reorganised the administration and helped broker the Treaty of Lodi in 1454. He ruled until his death, succeeded by his son Galeazzo Maria.
zh: 弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎（1401年7月23日—1466年3月8日）是在米兰建立斯福尔扎王朝的意大利雇佣兵首领。他生于托斯卡纳的奇戈利，是佣兵队长穆齐奥·斯福尔扎的私生子，少年起便随父征战，先后受雇于那不勒斯、教皇国、佛罗伦萨、威尼斯和维斯孔蒂家族。1433—1435年他为米兰攻打教皇国，攻占安科纳后转变阵营，获教皇任命为该城代牧。1441年他与米兰公爵菲利波·马利亚之女比安卡·马利亚·维斯孔蒂成婚。1447年维斯孔蒂家族绝嗣后，他先效力继而围攻安布罗斯共和国，1450年入主米兰成为公爵。他改善灌溉水道、重组行政，并于1454年促成《洛迪和约》。他统治直至1466年去世，其子加莱亚佐·马利亚继位。

en: Simone della Torre (c. 1278–1324) was the second son of Guido della Torre, the Guelph lord of Milan, by his wife Beatrice Guidi di Battifolle. To seal an alliance between the rival houses, he married Antiochia, daughter of Pietro Visconti. After his father was driven from Milan by the Emperor Henry VII in 1311, Simone fought in the exiled Della Torre and papal league against the Visconti and took part in the capture of Monza in 1323. On 28 February 1324 the league was routed by the Milanese at the battle of Vaprio d'Adda, where Simone was killed.
zh: 西莫内·德拉·托雷（约1278—1324）是米兰圭尔夫派领主圭多·德拉·托雷与妻子贝阿特丽切·圭迪·迪·巴蒂福莱的次子。为促成两个敌对家族结盟，他娶了彼得罗·维斯孔蒂之女安蒂奥基亚。1311年父亲被神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利七世逐出米兰后，西莫内加入流亡的德拉·托雷家族与教皇联军，同维斯孔蒂家族作战，并参加了1323年攻取蒙扎之役。1324年2月28日，联军在阿达河畔瓦普里奥战役中被米兰军队击溃，西莫内战死。

en: Stefano Visconti (1288–4 July 1327), lord of Arona, was son of Matteo I Visconti and Bonacossa Borri. In 1318 he married Valentina Doria, daughter of Bernabò Doria of Sassello, sealing a Ghibelline alliance against the Genoese Guelphs. Their sons Matteo II, Galeazzo II and Bernabò shared rule of Milan; their daughter Diana married Sicilian admiral Ramon de Vilaragut. Stefano died after serving as taster at Louis the Bavarian's coronation banquet in July 1327. Suspected of a poisoning plot, his brothers Galeazzo, Giovanni and Luchino and his nephew Azzone were imprisoned at Monza, triggering a crisis with the Empire.
zh: 斯泰法诺·维斯孔蒂（1288—1327年7月4日）是米兰的马泰奥一世·维斯孔蒂与博纳科萨·博里之子，受封阿罗纳领主。1318年，他迎娶萨塞洛的贝尔纳博·多里亚之女瓦伦蒂娜·多里亚，缔结吉伯林派同盟以对抗热那亚的圭尔夫派。其子马泰奥二世、加莱亚佐二世、贝尔纳博日后分治米兰，女儿迪亚娜嫁给西西里海军将领拉蒙·德·维拉加古特。1327年7月，他在巴伐利亚的路易加冕意大利国王的宴会上担任试食者，宴后死去。帝国方面怀疑有人毒杀国王，将他的兄弟加莱亚佐、乔瓦尼、卢基诺和侄子阿佐内囚禁在蒙扎，引发维斯孔蒂家族与帝国的危机。

en: Teobaldo Visconti (1230–1276) was a Milanese nobleman and soldier, born at Invorio near Novara, son of Andreotto Visconti and nephew of Archbishop Ottone Visconti. By his wife Anastasia Pirovano he fathered Matteo I, later called the Great, who became lord of Milan, and Uberto. The Della Torre opposed Ottone's appointment as archbishop, and the families fought for Milan. After Napoleone della Torre exiled opposing noble families, they formed a coalition in Novara and Pavia. With their support, Teobaldo led an army and occupied Castelseprio, but was defeated near Gallarate; captured with twenty-two companions, he was beheaded there in 1276 on Napoleone's orders.
zh: 泰奥巴尔多·维斯孔蒂（1230—1276）是米兰贵族与军人，生于诺瓦拉附近的因沃里奥，是安德雷奥托·维斯孔蒂之子、大主教奥托内·维斯孔蒂的侄子。他与妻子阿纳斯塔西娅·皮罗瓦诺生有马泰奥（后称伟大者，成为米兰领主）和乌贝托。德拉·托雷家族反对奥托内出任大主教，两家为争夺米兰而交战。纳波莱奥内·德拉·托雷流放反对他的贵族家族后，流亡者在诺瓦拉和帕维亚结盟。泰奥巴尔多得到他们的支持，率军攻占卡斯泰尔塞普里奥，却在加拉拉泰附近兵败；1276年，他与二十二名同伴一同被俘，被纳波莱奥内下令在加拉拉泰斩首。

en: Uberto Visconti (c. 1170–1248) was a Lombard nobleman, son of Ruggero Visconti, consul of Milan. He held the fiefs of Massino, Albizzate and Besnate, probably granted by Emperor Frederick II, and is regarded as progenitor of the Visconti lords and dukes of Milan. He married Berta Pirovano and had six sons, the most famous being Ottone, archbishop of Milan; the rival Torriani family later invoked Uberto's reputed lack of piety to challenge Ottone's election. Uberto died in 1248, before his son made the family masters of Milan.
zh: 乌贝托·维斯孔蒂（约1170—1248）是伦巴第贵族，米兰执政官鲁杰罗·维斯孔蒂之子。他领有马西诺、阿尔比扎泰和贝塞纳特等封地，很可能是皇帝腓特烈二世所封，被视为米兰维斯孔蒂领主与公爵王朝的始祖。他娶贝尔塔·皮罗瓦诺为妻，生有六子，最著名的是后来担任米兰大主教的奥托内；敌对的托里亚尼家族曾以乌贝托被指缺乏宗教虔诚为由，阻挠奥托内当选。乌贝托于1248年去世，没能看到儿子使家族成为米兰之主。

en: Valentina Doria (1290 – 27 August 1359) was a Genoese noblewoman, daughter of Bernabò Doria of Sassello and Eliana Fieschi. In 1318 she married Stefano Visconti, son of Milan's lord Matteo I, a match meant to bind the Ghibelline Visconti to her father against Genoa's Guelphs. She bore four children, among them Matteo II, Galeazzo II and Bernabò, who later shared rule of Milan. Widowed when Stefano died in 1327, she was laid beside him in Sant'Eustorgio; Bonino da Campione carved their joint tomb in 1359.
zh: 瓦伦蒂娜·多里亚（1290—1359年8月27日）是热那亚贵族女子，萨塞洛的贝尔纳博·多里亚与埃莉安娜·菲耶斯基之女。1318年，她嫁给米兰领主马泰奥一世之子斯特凡诺·维斯孔蒂，这桩婚事意在使吉伯林派的维斯孔蒂家族与其父结盟，共同对付热那亚的圭尔夫派。她生有四个子女，包括后来分治米兰的马泰奥二世、加莱亚佐二世和贝尔纳博。1327年斯特凡诺去世后她守寡，身后葬于圣欧斯托焦教堂，与丈夫合葬；博尼诺·达·坎皮奥内于1359年为二人雕刻了合葬墓。

en: Si Kefa, also called Hso Hkan Hpa (1294–1369), was the Tai ruler of Möng Mao who founded the Luchuan state, succeeding around 1335. Tai chronicles say he built a new capital at Selan, then won the submission of Hsenwi, Möng Mit and other neighbouring Tai states. The Yuan court sent four expeditions against him, in 1342, 1346, 1347 and 1348, and all failed. Fearing more, he sent his heir to nominally acknowledge Yuan authority; with the Red Turban rebellions under way, the Yuan could only name him Pingmian Pacification Commissioner in 1355. He then turned west. His brother conquered Assam without a fight, but Hkan Hpa suspected him of plotting and poisoned him on his return. In 1364 his forces sacked the Burmese kingdoms of Sagaing and Pinya and carried the king of Pinya back to Möng Mao; a Sagaing prince founded Ava the next year. He died in 1369, succeeded by his son Si Bingfa.
zh: 思可法，傣语名思翰法（1294—1369），是麓川（勐卯）君主、麓川思氏政权的缔造者，约1335年继位。傣族编年史记载，他修筑新都色兰，随后使木邦、孟密等周边傣族邦国臣服。元朝先后在1342年、1346年、1347年和1348年四次发兵讨伐，均告失败。他担心再遭进攻，派继承人赴元廷名义上表示归附；红巾起义爆发后，元朝只能在1355年封他为平缅宣慰使。随后他转向西方：其弟攻下阿萨姆，对方未作抵抗，但思可法疑心弟弟图谋不轨，在他返回时将其毒杀。1364年，他的军队攻陷并劫掠缅甸的实皆与彬牙两个王国，把彬牙国王带回勐卯；次年，一位实皆王子建立了阿瓦王国。1369年他去世，其子思并发继位。

en: Corrado del Carretto (c. 1250–1316/1319) was the eldest son of Giacomo del Carretto, marchese del Finale, and Caterina da Marano, an illegitimate daughter of Emperor Frederick II. After his father died the family lands were divided in 1268 into three shares, the terzieri, and Corrado received Millesimo in the Bormida valley, becoming the first marchese di Millesimo and founder of that line of the Aleramici. Invested in 1269, he placed his fief of Roccavignale under the lordship of Asti. His son Franceschino continued the Millesimo branch.
zh: 科拉多·德尔·卡雷托（约1250—1316/1319）是菲纳莱侯爵贾科莫·德尔·卡雷托与皇帝腓特烈二世私生女卡泰丽娜·达·马拉诺的长子。父亲死后，家族领地于1268年被分为三个“三分区”，科拉多分得博尔米达河谷的米莱西莫，成为第一代米莱西莫侯爵，也是阿勒拉米奇家族该支系的始祖。1269年他获得正式册封，并将罗卡维尼亚莱采邑置于阿斯蒂的宗主权之下。其子弗兰切斯基诺延续了米莱西莫支系。

en: Ma Xiuying (1332–1382), better known as Empress Ma, was the principal wife of the Ming founder Zhu Yuanzhang. Orphaned young, she was adopted by Red Turban leader Guo Zixing and married to his officer Zhu Yuanzhang in 1352. When Guo suspected Zhu of betrayal during a famine, Ma secretly brought her husband food. She accompanied her family on campaign and comforted soldiers' families left at Hezhou when Zhu crossed the Yangtze. At the Battle of Lake Poyang in 1363 she supplied troops and gave out treasure against Chen Youliang. When Zhu took the throne as the Hongwu Emperor in 1368 she became empress. Admired for her frugality and for refusing to advance her own relatives, she remained his close political adviser until her death in 1382.
zh: 马秀英（1332—1382），世称马皇后，是明朝开国皇帝朱元璋的结发妻子。她自幼丧亲，被红巾军首领郭子兴收为养女，1352年由郭子兴许配给部将朱元璋。饥荒时郭子兴怀疑朱元璋叛变，马氏偷偷给丈夫送食物。她随家人征战，朱元璋渡江时，她安抚留在和州的军属。1363年鄱阳湖水战期间，她供给军需、散发金帛，对抗陈友谅。1368年朱元璋称帝、年号洪武，她被立为皇后。她以节俭著称，又拒绝让亲族借她升迁，直到1382年去世前，始终是洪武帝亲近的政治顾问。

en: Zhu Yuanzhang (1328–1398), the Hongwu Emperor, founded the Ming dynasty after rising from destitution amid the Yuan collapse. Orphaned by plague in 1344, he lived as a wandering novice Buddhist monk before joining the Red Turban rebels in 1352. He married Guo Zixing's foster daughter, captured Nanjing in 1356, and built a powerful southern regime. He defeated Chen Youliang, took the title King of Wu in 1364, and later defeated Zhang Shicheng. In 1368 he proclaimed the Ming dynasty and drove the Yuan court back to Mongolia. His government banned private overseas trade and enforced a strict sea ban. After a thirty-year reign he was succeeded by his grandson, the Jianwen Emperor.
zh: 朱元璋（1328—1398），即洪武帝，是明朝的开国皇帝，于元末从赤贫中崛起。1344年瘟疫夺去他亲人的性命后，他做过云游的见习僧人，1352年加入红巾军。他娶首领郭子兴的养女为妻，1356年攻占南京，在南方建立起强大政权。他击败陈友谅，1364年称吴王，后来又击败张士诚。1368年他建立明朝，将元廷赶回蒙古。他的朝廷禁止私人海外贸易，推行严厉的海禁。他在位三十年，死后由孙儿建文帝继位。

en: Mikhail Davidovich was the first appanage prince of Mologa, a younger son of David Fyodorovich, prince of Yaroslavl. When David died in 1321, Mikhail and his elder brother Vasily divided the principality: Vasily kept Yaroslavl, while Mikhail took the Mologa river basin and a stretch of the Volga, where the town of Mologa arose. In 1362 he travelled to the Golden Horde with Grand Prince Dmitry Ivanovich to pay homage to the khan. Under him an international trade fair flourished at Kholopy Gorodok. He died around 1362, leaving three sons, Fyodor, Ivan and Lev.
zh: 米哈伊尔·达维多维奇是第一代莫洛加封邑王公，为雅罗斯拉夫尔王公德维德·费奥多罗维奇年纪较小的儿子。1321年父亲去世后，他与长兄瓦西里瓜分公国：瓦西里继承雅罗斯拉夫尔，米哈伊尔分得莫洛加河流域及伏尔加河的一段，莫洛加城即在其地兴起。1362年，他随大公德米特里·伊万诺维奇前往金帐汗国觐见可汗。在他治下，霍洛皮戈罗多克的国际集市贸易兴盛。他约于1362年去世，留有费奥多尔、伊万、列夫三个儿子。

en: Amaury I of Montfort (died 1053) was the second lord of Montfort-l'Amaury in the Île-de-France, succeeding his father Guillaume, who had raised the first wooden castle on the mound that gave the lordship its name. Amaury rebuilt the castle in stone, enclosed the growing town with fortifications and founded a castle chapel. Around 1028 he married Bertrade, a woman of uncertain origin traditionally assigned to the house of Gometz, who bore him his successor Simon I and Mainier d'Épernon. He died in 1053.
zh: 阿马尔里克一世·德·蒙福尔（1053年卒）是法兰西岛蒙福尔拉莫里的第二位领主，继承父亲纪尧姆；纪尧姆曾在一座土丘上建起最初的木堡，领地也由此得名。阿马尔里克将城堡改建为石造，为日渐形成的城镇修筑围墙，还兴建了一座城堡礼拜堂。约1028年，他娶出身不详、传统上被认为出自戈梅家族的贝尔特拉德为妻，生下继承人西蒙一世与迈尼耶·德佩尔农。他于1053年去世。

en: Amaury II of Montfort (1056–1089) was the fourth lord of Montfort-l'Amaury, the son of Simon I of Montfort and Isabel de Broyes. He succeeded his father around 1087 but died soon after, followed by his half brother Richard de Montfort.
zh: 阿马尔里克二世·德·蒙福尔（1056—1089）是第四代蒙福尔拉莫里领主，西蒙一世·德·蒙福尔与伊莎贝尔·德·布鲁瓦之子。他约在1087年继父位，但不久后去世，领主之位由异母弟里夏尔·德·蒙福尔继承。

en: Amaury III of Montfort (died 1137), a son of Simon I, succeeded his brother Simon II as lord of Montfort in 1101 and claimed the county of Évreux in 1118 when his uncle William died. Henry I annexed Évreux, but Amaury formed a coalition with the French king, the count of Anjou and Norman barons. He seized the town in October 1118 and his supporters held its citadel after Henry burned it in 1119; at the council of Reims Henry granted him the county in exchange for the keep. Disputes over royal taxation led Amaury into another revolt in 1123. Captured at Bourgtheroulde in 1124, he was freed when his captor defected and later recovered the county. By Agnès de Garlande he left sons Simon III and Amaury IV, and he died in April 1137.
zh: 阿马尔里克三世·德·蒙福尔（1137年卒）是西蒙一世之子，1101年继其兄西蒙二世成为蒙福尔领主；1118年舅父纪尧姆死后，他要求继承埃夫勒伯国。英王亨利一世将埃夫勒并入公国，阿马尔里克遂联合法王、安茹伯爵及诺曼贵族，于1118年10月夺取该城。1119年亨利焚城后，他的支持者仍坚守城堡；兰斯会议上亨利以伯国换回主堡。王室征税引发的争端使阿马尔里克于1123年再次起兵。1124年他在布特鲁德遇伏被俘，俘获者倒戈使他脱身，后来他又收回伯国。他与阿涅丝·德加朗德生有西蒙三世、阿马尔里克四世等子嗣，于1137年4月去世。

en: Amaury VI de Montfort (1192–1241) was the eldest son of Simon IV de Montfort. Knighted in 1213 at Castelnaudary, he fought under his father in the Albigensian Crusade and succeeded to the claim on Toulouse in 1218. In 1224 he ceded his Languedoc lands to Louis VIII, who raised Montfort-l'Amaury into a county. Appointed Constable of France in 1230, he yielded the earldom of Leicester to his brother Simon in 1239. Captured at Gaza on the Barons' Crusade with 600 others, he spent eighteen months in Cairo. Released in 1241 after an alliance between the crusaders and the Egyptian sultan, he died at Otranto on his way home. His body was buried in Rome and his heart returned to Haute-Bruyère Abbey.
zh: 阿马尔里克六世·德·蒙福尔（1192—1241）是西蒙四世·德·蒙福尔的长子。1213年他在卡斯泰尔诺达里受封骑士，随父亲参加阿尔比十字军，并于1218年继承了对图卢兹的权利主张。1224年，他把朗格多克的领地割让给路易八世，后者将蒙福尔拉莫里升格为伯国。1230年他出任法国王室统帅，1239年将莱斯特伯爵爵位让给弟弟西蒙。他在诸爵十字军期间于加沙与另外600人一同被俘，在开罗被囚禁十八个月。1241年十字军与埃及苏丹结盟后他获释，归国途中死于奥特朗托。他的遗体葬于罗马，心脏则被送回上布吕耶尔修道院。

en: Beatrice de Montfort (c. 1248–1311) inherited the county of Montfort-l'Amaury as an infant in 1249, when her father John I died in Cyprus on the Seventh Crusade. Her mother Jeanne remarried in 1251; after Jeanne's death, Beatrice and her half-sister Blanche were her co-heiresses. In 1260 Beatrice married Robert IV, Count of Dreux, who became count of Montfort by right of his wife and ruled alongside her. Her daughter Yolande married King Alexander III of Scotland in 1285 and Arthur II, Duke of Brittany, in 1292, and her son John II became Count of Dreux. Through Yolande she was the ancestress of the Montfort dukes of Brittany. Beatrice died on 9 March 1311 and was buried at Haute-Bruyère Abbey.
zh: 贝阿特丽丝·德·蒙福尔（约1248—1311）在1249年尚在襁褓中便继承了蒙福尔拉莫里伯国，当时她的父亲让一世参加第七次十字军东征，死于塞浦路斯。她的母亲让娜于1251年再婚；让娜死后，贝阿特丽丝与同母异父的妹妹布朗什共同继承了母亲的遗产。1260年，贝阿特丽丝嫁给德勒伯爵罗贝尔四世，后者凭妻子的权利成为蒙福尔伯爵，与她共治。女儿约朗德于1285年嫁给苏格兰国王亚历山大三世，1292年再嫁布列塔尼公爵阿蒂尔二世；儿子让二世成为德勒伯爵。通过约朗德，她是布列塔尼蒙福尔系公爵的先祖。贝阿特丽丝于1311年3月9日去世，葬于上布吕耶尔修道院。

en: Beatrice of Viennois (1205–1248?) was the daughter of André Dauphin de Bourgogne, dauphin of Vienne, and wife of Amaury VI de Montfort, constable of France. Her children included Jean I de Montfort.
zh: 维埃纳的贝娅特丽克丝（1205—1248？）是维埃纳王太子安德烈·多芬·德·勃艮第之女、法兰西王室统帅阿莫利六世·德·蒙福尔之妻，子为让一世·德·蒙福尔。

en: John I de Montfort (c. 1228–1249) inherited the county of Montfort-l'Amaury in 1241 from his father Amaury VI de Montfort; his mother was Béatrice of Burgundy. In March 1248 he married Jeanne de Châteaudun, lady of Château-du-Loir, whose only child by him was Beatrice, later countess of Montfort. That July he granted land to Port-Royal Abbey, where his sister Pernelle was a nun, then took the cross with Louis IX on the Seventh Crusade. His fleet reached Limassol only to be scattered by storms, and John died of sickness in Cyprus early in 1249.
zh: 让一世·德·蒙福尔（约1228—1249）于1241年从父亲阿马尔里克六世·德·蒙福尔手中继承蒙福尔拉莫里伯国，母亲为勃艮第的贝阿特丽丝。1248年3月，他娶卢瓦堡女领主让娜·德·沙托丹为妻，独女即后来的蒙福尔女伯爵贝阿特丽丝。同年7月，他向姐妹佩内尔出家的波尔罗亚尔修道院赠予土地，随后随路易九世参加第七次十字军东征。舰队抵达利马索尔后遭风暴打散，让于1249年初在塞浦路斯染病而死。

en: John of Montfort (1294–1345), son of Arthur II of Brittany and his second wife Yolande of Dreux, inherited the county of Montfort-l’Amaury from his mother in 1322. When Duke John III died in 1341, he claimed Brittany against his niece Joan of Penthièvre and her husband Charles of Blois, beginning the War of the Breton Succession. Said to have been urged on by his wife, he rode to Nantes, where the townsmen swore loyalty, then took the ducal treasury at Limoges and was recognised as duke in May, though the great vassals kept away. At Windsor Edward III promised military aid. In September the peers at Conflans awarded Brittany to Charles, and Philip VI confiscated Montfort-l’Amaury. Nantes fell on 21 November after a three-week siege, and John was taken to the Louvre. He died on 26 September 1345; his wife Joanna of Flanders kept up the fight, and his son John IV later won the duchy.
zh: 让·德·蒙福尔（1294—1345）是布列塔尼公爵阿蒂尔二世与第二任妻子德勒的约朗德之子，1322年从母亲手中继承蒙福尔拉莫里伯国。1341年让三世公爵去世，他向侄女庞蒂耶夫尔的让娜及其丈夫布卢瓦的夏尔争夺布列塔尼，布列塔尼继承战争由此爆发。相传受妻子怂恿，他赶往南特，市民宣誓效忠；他随后取得利摩日的公爵金库，5月被承认为公爵，大封臣则多有回避。在温莎，英王爱德华三世答应给予军事援助。9月，法国贵族会议在孔弗朗裁定公爵领归夏尔，腓力六世又没收了蒙福尔拉莫里。11月21日，南特经三周围攻陷落，让被俘，关入卢浮宫。他于1345年9月26日去世；妻子佛兰德的让娜继续抗争，其子让四世后来夺得公爵之位。

en: Joan of Flanders, called Jeanne la Flamme (c. 1295–1374), was the daughter of Louis I, Count of Nevers, and Joan of Rethel, and in 1329 married John of Montfort, claimant to Brittany. The childless death of Duke John III in 1341 sparked a succession dispute: England supported the Montfort claim, while France backed Charles of Blois and his wife Joan of Penthièvre. When Philip VI imprisoned her husband during the ensuing war, Joan took command of the Montfort cause herself. At the 1342 siege of Hennebont she fought in armour, led three hundred men out to burn Charles of Blois's camp, and held the town until English relief arrived. Froissart praised her courage and energy. She later took refuge in England, where Edward III confined her at Tickhill Castle, for reasons historians dispute. She died in September 1374; her son John IV later became Duke of Brittany.
zh: 佛兰德的让娜，绰号“火焰”（约1295—1374），是讷韦尔伯爵路易一世与勒泰勒的让娜之女，1329年嫁给布列塔尼公国的争夺者让·德·蒙福尔。1341年布列塔尼公爵让三世去世，没有留下子嗣，引发继承争端：英格兰支持蒙福尔的主张，法国则支持夏尔·德·布卢瓦及其妻潘蒂耶夫尔的让娜。战争中，法王腓力六世囚禁了她的丈夫，她便亲自执掌蒙福尔一派。1342年埃讷邦围城战中，她披甲作战，率三百人出城烧毁夏尔·德·布卢瓦的营寨，并坚守城池直到英军来援。傅华萨称赞她的勇气与魄力。后来她避居英格兰，被爱德华三世囚禁于蒂克希尔城堡，原因史家尚有争议。她于1374年9月去世；其子让四世后来成为布列塔尼公爵。

en: Richard of Montfort (died 1092) was the fifth lord of Montfort-l'Amaury, a son of Simon I and Agnès d'Évreux. He succeeded his half-brother Amaury II in 1089. His reign was consumed by a family feud: his uncle William, count of Évreux, and Raoul II of Tosny, husband of Richard's half-sister Isabelle, ravaged each other's lands after their wives fell out. Richard took the count's side and was killed by an arrow at the siege of Conches in 1092. His death brought grief to both sides and led them to negotiate a truce, though hostilities soon resumed. He died unmarried, and his brother Simon II succeeded him.
zh: 里夏尔·德·蒙福尔（1092年卒）是蒙福尔拉莫里的第五位领主，西蒙一世与阿涅丝·德埃夫勒之子，1089年继其异母兄阿马尔里克二世之位。他在位时卷入一场家族仇杀：舅父埃夫勒伯爵纪尧姆与他异母姐的丈夫拉乌尔二世因各自的妻子反目，互相劫掠对方的领地。里夏尔站在伯爵一方，1092年在围攻孔什时中箭身亡。他的死令双方悲痛，促成停战，但战事不久又起。他未婚而卒，其弟西蒙二世继位。

en: Simon I of Montfort (died 1087) was the third lord of Montfort-l'Amaury, succeeding his father Amaury I. He continued the family's building programme, founding the church of Saint-Pierre and the chapel of Saint-Laurent. By his first wife Isabelle, daughter of Hugh I of Broyes, he had Amaury II and Guillaume, later bishop of Paris. After Isabelle died, Simon sought the hand of Agnès d'Évreux, but her father refused. Her half-brother Raoul de Tosny carried her off to Montfort, where she became Simon's second wife; Raoul in turn married Simon's daughter Isabelle. Agnès bore Richard, Simon II, Amaury III and Bertrade, who married Fulk IV of Anjou and then King Philip I of France.
zh: 西蒙一世·德·蒙福尔（1087年卒）是蒙福尔拉莫里的第三位领主，继其父阿马尔里克一世之位。他延续家族的营建工程，修建了圣彼得教堂与圣老楞佐小堂。他先娶布罗瓦领主于格一世之女伊莎贝尔，生下阿马尔里克二世与后来出任巴黎主教的纪尧姆。伊莎贝尔去世后，西蒙向阿涅丝·德埃夫勒求婚，遭其父拒绝。阿涅丝同父异母的兄弟拉乌尔·德托尼将她劫至蒙福尔，成为西蒙的第二任妻子；拉乌尔则娶了西蒙之女伊莎贝尔。阿涅丝生下里夏尔、西蒙二世、阿马尔里克三世和贝尔特拉德，贝尔特拉德先后嫁给安茹伯爵富尔克四世与法王腓力一世。

en: Simon II of Montfort (died 1101) was the sixth lord of Montfort-l'Amaury, a son of Simon I and Agnès d'Évreux, who succeeded his brother Richard after Richard was killed at Conches in 1092. In 1098 William II Rufus of England, ruling Normandy while Duke Robert Curthose was on crusade, besieged Montfort, but Simon repulsed the attack. He died unmarried in 1101 and the lordship passed to his younger brother Amaury III.
zh: 西蒙二世·德·蒙福尔（1101年卒）是蒙福尔拉莫里的第六位领主，西蒙一世与阿涅丝·德埃夫勒之子，1092年其兄里夏尔在孔什战死后继位。1098年，诺曼底公爵罗贝尔·柯索斯参加十字军在外，英格兰国王威廉二世（红脸威廉）代管诺曼底并围攻蒙福尔，被他成功击退。他于1101年未婚而终，领地传给弟弟阿马尔里克三世。

en: Simon III of Montfort, called the Bald (1117–1181), was count of Évreux from 1140 and lord of Montfort-l'Amaury from 1137, younger son of Amaury III and Agnès de Garlande. Amaury III had divided his lands between his sons, but the death of Amaury IV reunited Évreux and Montfort under Simon. For Montfort the family owed allegiance to the French king, and for Évreux to the English king, placing it amid their rivalry. Simon sided with Henry II of England and surrendered the fortresses of Montfort, Rochefort and Épernon to him, blocking Louis VII's roads between Paris and Orléans. He later reconciled with Louis, who entrusted him with the castle of Saint-Léger-en-Yvelines. Simon died in 1181.
zh: 西蒙三世·德·蒙福尔，绰号“秃头”（1117—1181），1140年起为埃夫勒伯爵，1137年起为蒙福尔拉莫里领主，是阿马尔里克三世与阿涅丝·德加朗德的幼子。阿马尔里克三世曾把领地分给诸子，阿马尔里克四世死后，埃夫勒与蒙福尔统归西蒙。家族因蒙福尔向法王效忠，因埃夫勒向英王效忠，身处两王的争夺之间。西蒙倒向英格兰国王亨利二世，交出蒙福尔、罗什福尔和埃佩尔农的要塞，使路易七世无法在巴黎与奥尔良之间自由通行。后来他与路易七世和解，获托管伊夫林地区圣莱热城堡。西蒙于1181年去世。

en: Simon IV de Montfort (c. 1175–1218) was lord of Montfort-l'Amaury near Paris from 1188 and, through his mother Amicia de Beaumont, Earl of Leicester in England. He joined the Fourth Crusade in 1199 but refused to share in the sack of Zara and left the army rather than march on Constantinople. After the siege of Carcassonne in 1209, he was elected leader of the Albigensian Crusade in Languedoc. In 1210 he burned 140 Cathars at Minerve who refused to recant. He routed Peter II of Aragon at Muret in 1213 and received the county of Toulouse in 1215. He was killed on 25 June 1218 at the siege of Toulouse, struck in the head by a stone from a mangonel.
zh: 西蒙四世·德·蒙福尔（约1175—1218）自1188年起担任巴黎附近的蒙福尔拉莫里领主，并凭母亲阿米茜·德·博蒙的血统成为英格兰莱斯特伯爵。1199年他参加第四次十字军，却拒绝参与洗劫扎拉，并不愿进军君士坦丁堡而脱离军队。1209年卡尔卡松围城后，他被推选为朗格多克阿尔比十字军的首领。1210年，他在米内尔夫烧死了140名拒绝放弃信仰的卡特里派信徒。1213年，他在米雷击溃阿拉贡国王佩德罗二世，1215年受封图卢兹伯爵。1218年6月25日，他在围攻图卢兹时被投石机抛出的石块击中头部身亡。

en: Yolande of Dreux (c. 1269–1322) was the daughter of Robert IV, Count of Dreux, and Beatrice, Countess of Montfort. In October 1285 she married King Alexander III of Scotland, who died in March 1286; she declared herself pregnant at Stirling, but the pregnancy did not result in a living child and she returned to France. In 1294 she married Arthur of Brittany, Duke Arthur II from 1305. She inherited Montfort-l'Amaury from her mother in 1311 and ruled it as suo jure countess. After long dower disputes with her stepson John III, she died on 2 August 1322, leaving the county to her son John.
zh: 德勒的约朗德（约1269—1322）是德勒伯爵罗贝尔四世与蒙福尔女伯爵贝阿特丽丝之女。1285年10月，她嫁给苏格兰国王亚历山大三世；国王于1286年3月去世，她在斯特灵宣布自己有孕，但最终没有生下存活的孩子，她后来返回法兰西。1294年她嫁给布列塔尼的阿蒂尔，即1305年继位的阿蒂尔二世。1311年她继承母亲的蒙福尔拉莫里伯国，以自身权利受封女伯爵。她与继子让三世长期争夺亡夫遗产，于1322年8月2日去世，伯国传给儿子让。

en: Mengu-Timur (died 1280), a son of Toqoqan and grandson of Batu, was khan of the Golden Horde from 1266 to 1280. He struck silver coins in his own name without the great khan's and declined to visit Kublai, making the Horde effectively independent. In 1267 he granted the Russian Church a yarlyk of tax exemption, exchanged embassies with the Mamluk sultan Baybars, and around 1280 allowed the Genoese to lease Caffa in Crimea. He aided Kaidu against the Chagatai khan Baraq and died soon after an unsuccessful campaign against Poland in 1280. His son Toqta later ruled the Horde.
zh: 忙哥帖木儿（？—1280）是金帐汗，1266至1280年在位，为托托罕之子、拔都之孙。他铸造只署自己名字而不署大汗之名的银币，又拒绝入朝觐见忽必烈，使金帐汗国取得实际独立。1267年，他颁给俄罗斯教会免税的敕令，与马穆鲁克苏丹拜巴斯互通使节，并在1280年前后允许热那亚人在克里米亚租借卡法。他曾出兵援助海都对抗察合台汗八剌，1280年远征波兰失利后不久死去。他的儿子脱脱后来成为金帐汗。

en: Abd al-Haqq I (1147–1217), son of the Marinid chief Muhyu, was the first leader of the Marinid dynasty, a Zenata Berber noble of the Zab region. After Muhyu died of wounds fighting for the Almohads at Alarcos in 1195, he took command of the Banu Marin. After the Almohad disaster at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212, he led his tribe into north-eastern Morocco in 1213 or 1214, occupying the Rif and taxing its towns. In 1217 an Almohad army, aided by Banu Riyah Arabs and a dissident Marinid clan, defeated and killed him. His son Uthman I succeeded.
zh: 阿卜杜勒·哈克一世（1147—1217）是马林王朝的首位首领，出身扎卜地区的泽纳塔柏柏尔贵族，为马林酋长米赫尤之子。1195年米赫尤在为穆瓦希德王朝作战时伤死于阿拉科斯战役，阿卜杜勒·哈克遂接掌巴努·马林部落。1212年穆瓦希德王朝在拉斯纳瓦斯·德·托洛萨惨败后，他于1213或1214年率部进入摩洛哥东北部，占据里夫地区并向城镇征税。1217年，穆瓦希德军队在巴努·里亚赫阿拉伯部落和一支叛离的马林氏族协助下将他击败击杀，其子奥斯曼一世继立。

en: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Uthman (c. 1297–1351) became Marinid sultan of Morocco in 1331. His dark complexion, inherited from a sub-Saharan mother, earned him the name Black Sultan. He married the Hafsid ruler's daughter Fatima, sealing an alliance against Zayyanid Tlemcen. In 1333 he took Gibraltar from Castile, though his attack on Tarifa ended in disaster in 1339. In the Maghreb he took Tlemcen in 1337 and Hafsid Ifriqiya in 1347, briefly reuniting the region as the Almohads had. Then he overreached with the Arab tribes, who defeated him near Kairouan in April 1348, and his son Abu Inan Faris, governor of Tlemcen, proclaimed himself sultan at Fes. A tempest wrecked the fleet carrying the sultan home off Bougie, his supporters drifted away, and Abu Inan beat him on the Oum er-Rebia in May 1350. Broken, he abdicated in the High Atlas and died there in May 1351; Abu Inan had his body taken to the Marinid necropolis at Chellah.
zh: 阿布·哈桑·阿里·本·奥斯曼（约1297—1351）于1331年即位为摩洛哥马林王朝苏丹。他的深色肤色得自撒哈拉以南出身的母亲，因此被称为“黑苏丹”。他迎娶哈夫斯王朝统治者之女法蒂玛，结盟对抗宰扬王朝的特莱姆森。1333年他从卡斯蒂利亚手中夺取直布罗陀，但1339年进攻塔里法惨败。在马格里布，他于1337年攻占特莱姆森，1347年吞并哈夫斯王朝治下的伊夫里奇亚，一度像穆瓦希德王朝那样重新统一了这片地区。随后他对阿拉伯部落操之过急，1348年4月在凯鲁万附近被部落击败，担任特莱姆森总督的儿子阿布·伊南·法里斯在非斯自立为苏丹。苏丹乘舰东归，舰队在贝贾亚近海被风暴摧毁，追随者陆续离去，1350年5月又在乌姆赖比阿河畔败给阿布·伊南。他心力交瘁，在大阿特拉斯山区退位，并于1351年5月死在那里；阿布·伊南将遗体迁往舍拉的马林王朝陵园。

en: Abu al-Rabi Sulayman (March 1289–23 November 1310) succeeded his brother Abu Thabit Amir as Marinid sultan in July 1308, while Ceuta was held by the Nasrid-backed pretender Othman ibn Idris. When Nasr of Granada abandoned the pretender after a coup, Marinid and Granadan forces retook Ceuta in July 1309. Abu al-Rabi returned the favour, sending a fleet that raised the Castilian siege of Algeciras in January 1310 and troops to aid Granada near Almería. His Granadine bride brought Algeciras and Ronda as dowry, but he died of illness without sons in November 1310, and his uncle Abu Sa'id Uthman II succeeded him.
zh: 阿布·拉比·苏莱曼（1289年3月—1310年11月23日）于1308年7月继其兄阿布·萨比特·阿米尔之位，成为马林王朝苏丹，当时休达仍在格拉纳达支持的觊觎者奥斯曼·本·伊德里斯手中。1309年格拉纳达政变后，新君纳赛尔抛弃这位觊觎者，马林与格拉纳达联军于同年7月收复休达。阿布·拉比投桃报李，1310年1月派舰队逼退围攻阿尔赫西拉斯的卡斯蒂利亚军队，又派兵到阿尔梅里亚附近援助格拉纳达。他娶的格拉纳达公主以阿尔赫西拉斯与龙达为嫁妆，但他1310年11月病逝且无子，叔父阿布·赛义德·奥斯曼二世继位。

en: Abu Ali Omar was the Marinid prince who threatened to split Morocco in two. A son and designated heir of Sultan Abu Sa'id Uthman II, he rebelled in 1315 and entrenched himself in Fez. The sultan first negotiated to pass the state to him, then, hearing that Abu Ali had fallen ill, besieged Fez and forced his surrender. Abu Ali lost the succession to his brother Abu al-Hasan and received an appanage centred on the Saharan trading city of Sijilmasa. In 1320 he rose again and seized much of southern Morocco, Marrakesh included, until the sultan defeated him at the Oum er-Rebia in 1322 and again let him keep Sijilmasa. Abu Ali allied with the Zayyanid sultan Abu Tashufin of Tlemcen, the Marinids' enemy; in 1332 Abu al-Hasan, by then sultan, took Sijilmasa and had his brother put to death.
zh: 阿布·阿里·欧麦尔是险些把摩洛哥一分为二的马林王朝王子。他是苏丹阿布·赛义德·奥斯曼二世之子，也曾被立为储君，1315年起兵反叛，据守非斯。苏丹起初谈判要把国家交给他，得知他患病后却转而围攻非斯，迫使他投降。阿布·阿里失去继承权，让位于兄弟阿布·哈桑，获封以撒哈拉商城西吉勒马萨为中心的封邑。1320年他再度起事，夺取包括马拉喀什在内的摩洛哥南部大片土地，1322年在乌姆赖比阿河被苏丹击败，苏丹再次允许他保有西吉勒马萨。阿布·阿里与马林王朝的敌人、特莱姆森的扎扬王朝苏丹阿布·塔什芬结盟；1332年，已经继位的阿布·哈桑攻克西吉勒马萨，将兄长处死。

en: Abu Inan Faris (1329–1358), son of the Marinid sultan Abu al-Hasan Ali, was governing Tlemcen when Arab tribes routed his father at Kairouan in April 1348. He returned to Fes, declared himself sultan and took the title Commander of the Believers, while Tlemcen and the central Maghreb rose in revolt. After his father died in 1351 he retook Tlemcen in 1352 and Béjaïa in 1353. Granada, fearing an invasion, sponsored a short-lived revolt by his brother Abu al-Fadl. He took Tunis in 1357, becoming master of Ifriqiya, until intrigues forced him to retreat. He built madrasas at Meknes and Fes, from which the Bou Inania madrasas take their name, and commissioned Ibn Juzayy to record Ibn Battuta's travels, finished in December 1355. In November 1357 he fell ill, and when he began to recover, his vizier, who had put another heir forward, had him strangled on 10 January 1358.
zh: 阿布·伊南·法里斯（1329—1358）是马林王朝苏丹阿布·哈桑·阿里之子。1348年4月阿拉伯部落在凯鲁万击溃其父时，他正担任特莱姆森总督，随即返回非斯自立为苏丹，号称“信士的长官”，特莱姆森与马格里布中部则趁机叛乱。1351年父亲死后，他于1352年重克特莱姆森，1353年攻取贝贾亚。格拉纳达担心他入侵，资助他的兄弟阿布·法德勒发动了短暂的叛乱。1357年他占领突尼斯，成为伊夫里奇亚之主，随后因朝中阴谋被迫退兵。他在梅克内斯和非斯修建经学院，布·伊纳尼亚经学院即以他命名；又命伊本·朱扎伊记录伊本·白图泰的游历，该书于1355年12月完成。1357年11月他一病不起，待他渐渐康复时，曾另立继承人的维齐尔于1358年1月10日派人将他勒死。

en: Abu Malik Abd al-Wahid (died 1339), also called Abomelique, was a son of the Marinid sultan Abu al-Hasan Ali and his foremost general in Al-Andalus. Though he had lost an eye, he governed Algeciras and in June 1333 took Gibraltar from Castile, then fought for his father against the rebels at Tlemcen in 1334. When the truce expired in 1338, he returned to Ronda with a large force sent by his father. Castile, Aragon and Portugal joined against the threat and blockaded the Strait, and Alfonso XI raided deep into Marinid territory. In 1339 Abu Malik answered with an invasion, raiding Medina-Sidonia and besieging Jerez de la Frontera without taking it. On the way back, his loot-laden army was ambushed and destroyed, some 10,000 men killed or captured. Caught without armour or a horse, Abu Malik hid by a stream and feigned death, but a Castilian soldier saw him move and killed him with a spear.
zh: 阿布·马利克·阿卜杜勒-瓦希德（？—1339），又名阿博梅利克，是马林王朝苏丹阿布·哈桑·阿里之子，也是他在安达卢斯的主将。他虽眇一目，仍出任阿尔赫西拉斯总督，于1333年6月从卡斯蒂利亚手中夺取直布罗陀，1334年又随父亲征讨特莱姆森的叛军。1338年休战期满，他带着父亲派来的大军返回龙达，卡斯蒂利亚、阿拉贡和葡萄牙联手应对这一威胁，封锁海峡，阿方索十一世则深入马林人领土袭掠。1339年，阿布·马利克以入侵作答，袭掠梅迪纳-西多尼亚，围攻赫雷斯-德拉弗龙特拉而未能攻克。满载战利品回师途中，他的军队遭到伏击而覆没，约一万人被杀或被俘。阿布·马利克未披甲、无坐骑，藏在溪边装死，却被一名卡斯蒂利亚士兵发现他动弹，用长矛刺死。

en: Abu Sa'id Uthman II (December 1276–August 1331), a younger son of Abu Yusuf Yaqub, succeeded his nephew Abu al-Rabi Sulayman as Marinid sultan in November 1310. Pious and peace-loving, he returned Algeciras and Ronda to Granada in 1313 to end Iberian entanglements. His son Abu Ali rebelled in Fez in 1315; Uthman removed him from the succession and named Abu al-Hasan heir. Abu Ali rebelled again from Sijilmasa in 1320, seizing Marrakesh before defeat at the Oum er-Rebia in 1322; Uthman pardoned him and left him Sijilmasa. He adorned Fez with the Al-Attarine and other madrasas, and died near Taza in 1331.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿布·赛义德·奥斯曼·本·雅各布
zh: 阿布·赛义德·奥斯曼·本·雅各布（1276年12月—1331年8月），即奥斯曼二世，是阿布·优素福·雅各布诸子中年纪较轻的一位，1310年11月继侄儿阿布·拉比·苏莱曼之位，成为马林王朝第九任苏丹。他虔诚而喜好和平，1313年将阿尔赫西拉斯与龙达归还格拉纳达，以了结伊比利亚半岛的纠葛。1315年他的儿子阿布·阿里在非斯举叛，奥斯曼剥夺其继承权，另立阿布·哈桑为继承人。1320年阿布·阿里又以西吉勒马萨为基地再起，一度攻占马拉喀什，1322年在乌姆赖比阿河战败；奥斯曼赦免了他，让他保有西吉勒马萨。他在非斯修建了阿塔林经学院等建筑，1331年死于塔扎附近。

en: Abu Thabit Amir (1284–28 July 1308) became Marinid sultan in May 1307 after his father Abu Yaqub Yusuf was assassinated at the long siege of Tlemcen. With four pretenders challenging him and the Nasrid-backed Uthman ibn Abi al-Ula holding Ceuta and much of northern Morocco, he quickly defeated three rivals, negotiated an orderly lifting of the siege with Abu Zayyan I and hurried north. To direct operations against Uthman he founded a town south of Ceuta, Tetouan, but fell ill and died there in July 1308 after a year's reign, leaving the throne to his brother Abu al-Rabi Sulayman.
zh: 阿布·萨比特·阿米尔（1284—1308年7月28日）于1307年5月即位为马林王朝苏丹，此前他的父亲阿布·雅各布·优素福·纳赛尔在对特莱姆森的长期围城战中遇刺。当时有四名觊觎王位者与他争位，格拉纳达支持的奥斯曼·本·阿比·乌拉据有休达和摩洛哥北部大片土地。他迅速击败三个对手，又与阿布·扎扬一世达成协议、有序解围，随即挥师北返。为统筹对奥斯曼的战事，他在休达以南修筑城镇得土安，但仅在位一年便染病，于1308年7月死于得土安，王位由其弟阿布·拉比·苏莱曼继承。

en: Abu Yahya Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Haqq (died 1258) was a Marinid ruler, a son of Abd al-Haqq I who succeeded his brother Muhammad I in 1244. He seized Meknes, the first Marinid capital, but an Almohad counter-offensive under Abu al-Hasan as-Said drove him back into eastern Morocco. When the Almohad caliph was killed attacking Tlemcen in 1248, Abu Yahya destroyed the remnants of his army at Guercif, made himself master of eastern Morocco and captured Fez. By his death from illness in 1258, the once-dominant Almohads had been reduced to southern Morocco.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿布·叶海亚·本·阿卜杜勒-哈克
zh: 阿布·叶海亚·本·阿卜杜勒-哈克（？—1258）是马林王朝首领，阿卜杜勒-哈克一世之子，1244年继其兄穆罕默德一世之位。他攻占梅克内斯，以此为马林人的第一个都城，却因穆瓦希德哈里发阿布·哈桑·赛义德反攻而退回摩洛哥东部。1248年，这位哈里发在进攻特莱姆森时兵败被杀，阿布·叶海亚随即在盖尔西夫歼灭其残军，控制整个摩洛哥东部，并攻克非斯。到1258年他病逝时，曾称霸一方的穆瓦希德人已退守摩洛哥南部。

en: Abu Yaqub Yusuf an-Nasr (c. 1230–13 May 1307) succeeded his father Abu Yusuf Yaqub as Marinid sultan in 1286. His reign faced revolts from Abdalwadid-backed princes and, in 1288, from his own son Abu Amir. After Castile took Tarifa in 1292 he failed to recover it, and in 1295 ceded Algeciras and Ronda to Granada, abandoning Spain. He then turned on Tlemcen, taking Taourirt, Oujda, and besieging it from 1299 at the camp city of al-Mansura. On 13 May 1307, as the city neared surrender, a eunuch killed him in his camp, and Abu Thabit's accession ended the siege.
zh: 阿布·雅各布·优素福·纳赛尔（约1230—1307年5月13日）于1286年继其父阿布·优素福·雅各布之位，成为马林王朝苏丹。在位期间，得到扎扬王朝支持的王公和他自己的儿子阿布·阿米尔先后反叛，后者事在1288年。1292年卡斯蒂利亚夺取塔里法，他反攻不克，1295年将阿尔赫西拉斯与龙达割给格拉纳达，退出伊比利亚半岛。随后他转攻特莱姆森，连克陶里尔特、乌季达，自1299年起在营地新城曼苏拉围城。1307年5月13日，城池将下之际，他在营帐中被一名宦官刺死，阿布·萨比特继位后结束了围攻。

en: Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq (c. 1212–20 March 1286), fourth son of Marinid founder Abd al-Haqq I, was governor of Taza when his brother Abu Yahya died in 1258; he displaced his nephew and seized power. He retook Salé in 1260 from a Christian fleet probably from Castile and entered Marrakesh on 8 September 1269, extinguishing the Almohad Caliphate and unifying Morocco around Fez, founding New Fez in 1276. From 1275 he crossed to Spain four times to aid Granada against Castile, taking Tarifa and Algeciras and winning at Écija. He died at Algeciras in March 1286 and was buried at Chellah.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿布·优素福·雅各布·本·阿卜杜勒-哈克
zh: 阿布·优素福·雅各布·本·阿卜杜勒-哈克（约1212—1286年3月20日）是马林王朝开国者阿卜杜勒-哈克一世的第四子。1258年其兄阿布·叶海亚去世时，他正担任塔扎总督，遂取代侄儿夺得大位。1260年他从一支可能来自卡斯蒂利亚的基督徒舰队手中收复塞拉，1269年9月8日攻入马拉喀什，灭亡穆瓦希德哈里发国，以非斯为中心统一摩洛哥，并于1276年营建新都新非斯。自1275年起，他为援助格拉纳达对抗卡斯蒂利亚四次渡海远征，夺取塔里法与阿尔赫西拉斯，在埃西哈之战中获胜。1286年3月他死于阿尔赫西拉斯，葬于舍拉。

en: Fatima was a woman of Fes, probably an Abyssinian concubine of Marinid sultan Abu Sa'id Uthman II. Chronicler al-Baydhaq names her as mother of Abu al-Hasan Ali, whose dark complexion earned him the name Black Sultan.
zh: 法蒂玛是菲斯女子，可能是马林王朝苏丹阿布·赛义德·奥斯曼二世的阿比西尼亚妾侍。编年史家拜达格记载她是阿布·哈桑·阿里之母，阿布·哈桑因肤色深而被称为“黑苏丹”。

en: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Abi Zar al-Fasi (died between 1310 and 1320) was a Moroccan historian and scholar of Fes, the presumed author of the Rawd al-Qirtas. Written at the instigation of Marinid sultan Abu Sa'id Uthman II, the work chronicles the kings of the Maghreb and the history of Fes from the coming of Idris I in 788 down to the Marinids. Divided into four parts on the Idrisids, Almoravids, Almohads and Marinids, it became one of the most widely circulated medieval Maghrebi histories, though its authorship was long debated amid variant manuscripts.
zh: 阿布·哈桑·阿里·伊本·阿比·扎尔·法西（1310至1320年间去世）是摩洛哥史学家、非斯学者，被认为是《罗乌德·吉尔塔斯》（意为“纸园”）的作者。该书奉马林王朝苏丹阿布·赛义德·奥斯曼二世之命而作，记述自788年伊德里斯一世兴起至马林王朝的马格里布诸王史与非斯城史，分为伊德里斯王朝、穆拉比特王朝、穆瓦希德王朝、马林王朝四部分，是中世纪流传最广的马格里布史书之一，因抄本众多，作者归属长期存在争议。

en: Abu Abdallah Muhammad ibn Battuta (1304–1368/69) was a Berber Muslim scholar born in Tangier into a family of qadis, during the reign of the Marinid dynasty. In June 1325 he set out on pilgrimage to Mecca and spent nearly thirty years on the road, through Africa, the Middle East, Central Asia, India, China and the Iberian Peninsula, by one reckoning some 117,000 km, farther than Zheng He or Marco Polo. From 1333 he served the Delhi sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq as a judge for six years, later leading an embassy to Yuan China and visiting the Maldives and Sumatra. He returned to Morocco in 1354, and the Marinid sultan Abu Inan had his secretary Ibn Juzayy write down the account he dictated, the Rihla, completed in December 1355. Nearly everything known about his life comes from that book. He died in Fez in 1368 or 1369.
zh: 艾布·阿卜杜拉·穆罕默德·伊本·白图泰（1304—1368或1369）是柏柏尔穆斯林学者，出生于马林王朝统治下丹吉尔的一个教法法官世家。1325年6月，他启程前往麦加朝觐，此后近三十年间一路游历非洲、中东、中亚、印度、中国和伊比利亚半岛，据一种估算行程约11.7万公里，超过郑和和马可·波罗。1333年起，他在德里为苏丹穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克担任了六年法官，后来又奉命出使元朝中国，途中到过马尔代夫和苏门答腊。1354年他返回摩洛哥，马林王朝苏丹阿布·伊南命秘书伊本·朱扎伊记下他的口述，这就是《游记》，1355年12月完成。他的生平几乎全靠这部书流传。1368或1369年，他在非斯去世。

en: Ibrahim ibn Ali, known as Abu Salim and by the regnal title al-Musta'in billah, was a Marinid sultan and a son of Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Uthman. He was born around 1335 and seized or received the throne at Fes in 1359 after Abu Bakr ibn Faris, in the unsettled years following Abu Inan Faris's murder. As ruler he named the great scholar Ibn Khaldun as his judge of mazalim, hearing civil petitions. After two years and three months, civilian and military officials overthrew him in the autumn of 1361, and Tashfin ibn Ali succeeded him.
zh: 易卜拉欣·本·阿里，又称阿布·萨利姆，王号“穆斯塔因·比拉”，马林王朝苏丹，阿布·哈桑·阿里·本·奥斯曼之子，约生于1335年。1359年，他在阿布·伊南·法里斯遇刺后的动荡岁月中，于阿布·伯克尔·本·法里斯之后在非斯登上王位。在位期间，他任命大学者伊本·赫勒敦为马扎里姆法官，受理民间申诉。他统治两年三个月后，于1361年秋被文武官员推翻，塔什芬·本·阿里继位。

en: Muhammad ibn Abd al-Haqq (1202–1244) was a Marinid ruler, a son of Abd al-Haqq I and younger brother of Uthman I, whom he succeeded in 1240. He continued fighting the Almohad Caliphate, especially around Meknes. On 12 November 1244 he fell in battle against the Almohads, killed by Juan Gaitan, an officer of Christian mercenaries.
zh: 穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒-哈克（1202—1244）是马林王朝首领，阿卜杜勒-哈克一世之子、奥斯曼一世之弟，1240年继其兄之位。他继续与穆瓦希德哈里发国作战，尤其在梅克内斯一带。1244年11月12日，他在与穆瓦希德军队交战时阵亡，杀死他的是基督徒佣兵军官胡安·盖坦。

en: Tashfin ibn Ali, known by the kunya Abu Umar, was a Marinid sultan and a son of Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Uthman. In 1361 he succeeded Ibrahim ibn Ali on the throne at Fes, during the succession turmoil that followed the murder of Sultan Abu Inan Faris in 1358. Tashfin was a mere figurehead in the grip of his vizier Umar ibn Abd Allah. After a reign of three months and two days the vizier deposed him on 21 Safar 763 AH, around December 1361, and he died soon afterwards. Muhammad II ibn Faris then succeeded him.
zh: 塔什芬·本·阿里，库尼亚阿布·奥马尔，马林王朝苏丹，阿布·哈桑·阿里·本·奥斯曼之子。1361年，他在非斯继易卜拉欣·本·阿里即位，时值1358年苏丹阿布·伊南·法里斯遇刺后的王位动荡。塔什芬只是维齐尔奥马尔·伊本·阿卜杜拉手中的傀儡，在位仅三个月零两天，便于伊斯兰历763年萨法尔月21日（约1361年12月）被废，不久死去，穆罕默德二世·本·法里斯随后继位。

en: Uthman ibn Abd al-Haqq (1196–1240), also called Abu Sa'id Uthman I, was the second ruler of the Marinids. In 1217 he succeeded his father Abd al-Haqq I, who had fallen in battle against the Almohads, and spent his reign campaigning in the western Maghreb against the Almohad Caliphate. In 1240 he was assassinated by one of his Christian slaves, and his brother Muhammad ibn Abd al-Haqq succeeded him.
zh: 奥斯曼·本·阿卜杜勒-哈克（1196—1240），又称阿布·赛义德·奥斯曼一世，是马林人的第二任首领。1217年，其父阿卜杜勒-哈克一世在与穆瓦希德人作战时阵亡，他继位后在马格里布西部征战，对抗穆瓦希德哈里发国。1240年，他被自己的一名基督徒奴隶刺杀，其弟穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒-哈克继位。

en: Abram Petrovich Gannibal (c. 1696–1781) was a Russian military engineer and general of African origin. Captured as a child and taken to Constantinople, he was brought to Moscow in 1704 as a gift for Peter the Great, who became his godfather at his baptism. He accompanied Peter on military campaigns and studied mathematics and engineering abroad. After Peter's death, he was exiled to Siberia in 1727 and built fortifications there. Pardoned in 1730, he continued to serve in Siberia until 1733. Under Empress Elizabeth he was superintendent of Reval from 1742 to 1752, then rose to chief military engineer in 1756 and general-in-chief in 1759. One of his great-grandsons was the poet Alexander Pushkin.
zh: 阿布拉姆·彼得罗维奇·汉尼拔（约1696—1781）是非洲裔俄国军事工程师、上将。他幼年被俘带往君士坦丁堡，1704年作为礼物被送到莫斯科献给彼得大帝，受洗时彼得担任他的教父。他随彼得出征，并在国外学习数学与工程。彼得去世后，1727年他被流放西伯利亚，在当地修筑防御工事；1730年获赦后，他继续在西伯利亚服役至1733年。伊丽莎白女皇在位期间，他于1742至1752年担任雷瓦尔督办，1756年出任俄军总军事工程师，1759年晋升上将。诗人亚历山大·普希金是他的曾外孙。

en: Afanasy Lavrentievich Ordin-Nashchokin (1605–1680) was a Russian statesman and diplomat under Tsar Alexis. Born to a poor landowning family near Pskov and educated in Latin, German and mathematics, he helped determine the Russo-Swedish frontier in 1642. He distinguished himself during the Pskov uprising of 1650 and the Russo-Swedish War of 1656–1658. As head of the Posolsky Prikaz from 1667, he negotiated the Truce of Andrusovo with Poland-Lithuania, abolished export and import tolls, set up a postal service and promoted shipbuilding on the Dvina and Volga. He also brought merchants together to encourage direct trade with Sweden.
