The first junior noble to reach boyar rank through merit rather than family connections, he was dismissed in 1671, took monastic vows and died in 1680.
zh: 阿法纳西·拉夫连季耶维奇·奥尔金-纳晓金（1605—1680）是沙皇阿列克谢·米哈伊洛维奇麾下的政治家与外交家。他出身普斯科夫附近的贫寒地主家庭，通晓拉丁语、德语和数学，1642年参与划定俄瑞边界。此后他在1650年普斯科夫起义和1656—1658年俄瑞战争中崭露头角。1667年起执掌使节衙门，与波兰立陶宛联邦谈判达成《安德鲁索沃停战协定》，废除进出口关税，兴办邮政，并推动西德维纳河与伏尔加河上的造船业。他还召集商人，促进与瑞典的直接贸易。他是俄国第一位凭功绩而非家族关系晋封波雅尔的低级贵族，1671年被解职后出家修道，1680年去世。

en: Alexander Peresvet (died 8 September 1380) was a Russian monk-warrior famed for the Battle of Kulikovo. Probably from Bryansk, he was tonsured at the Boris and Gleb Monastery in Rostov, moved to a monastery in Pereslavl under Dmitry Donskoy, then followed Sergius of Radonezh at the Trinity Lavra. In 1380, as Dmitry marched against the Tatar warlord Mamai, Sergius blessed the campaign and sent Peresvet and Rodion Oslyabya with the army. At the opening of the battle Peresvet met the Golden Horde champion Chelubey in single combat, and the two killed each other at the first charge. Legend says he alone kept his saddle. The epic Zadonshchina instead describes him making a speech as the battle began.
zh: 亚历山大·佩列斯韦特（1380年9月8日卒）是俄罗斯东正教武僧，因库里科沃战役闻名。他可能出身布良斯克，在罗斯托夫的鲍里斯与格列布修道院出家，德米特里·顿斯科伊统治期间迁往佩列斯拉夫尔的一座修道院，后在圣三一修道院追随拉多涅茨的谢尔盖。1380年德米特里出兵征讨鞑靼军阀马迈，谢尔盖为战事祝福，派佩列斯韦特与罗季翁·奥斯利亚比亚随军。战役开始时，佩列斯韦特与金帐汗国勇士切卢别伊单挑，二人在第一次冲锋中同归于尽。相传唯有他没有落马；史诗《顿河彼岸》则记载他在战斗开始时发表了一番讲话。

en: Prince Alexey Mikhailovich Lvov (1580s–1653) was a Russian statesman from the princely Lvov family. He was voivode at Nizhny Novgorod in 1610, fought with Dmitry Pozharsky's militia in 1612, and in 1613 signed the charter electing Mikhail Romanov tsar and escorted him from the Ipatiev Monastery to Moscow. After holding Astrakhan (1618–1620) and embassies to Denmark and Poland, where he helped conclude the Peace of Polyanovka in 1634, he headed the Grand Palace Office from 1627 to 1647 and effectively led the government in Mikhail's final years. He retired in 1652 and died in 1653.
zh: 阿列克谢·米哈伊洛维奇·利沃夫公爵（1580年代—1653）是出身利沃夫公爵家族的俄国政治家。1610年他出任下诺夫哥罗德督军，1612年随德米特里·波扎尔斯基参加第二支民军，1613年在选举米哈伊尔·罗曼诺夫为沙皇的诏书上署名，并护送沙皇从伊帕季耶夫修道院前往莫斯科。他后来担任阿斯特拉罕督军（1618—1620），又出使丹麦和波兰，在波兰促成了1634年的《波利亚诺夫卡和约》。1627至1647年，他主持大宫廷衙门，在米哈伊尔晚年实际执掌政府。1652年他告老退休，次年去世。

en: Andrei Ivanovich (4 June 1327 – 6 June 1353) was the youngest son of Grand Prince Ivan I Kalita of Moscow. In 1341 he became the first appanage prince of Serpukhov. He journeyed several times to the Golden Horde, notably in 1341 when his brother Simeon the Proud received the khan's grand-princely patent. By his wife Maria, a princess of Rostov, he fathered Vladimir the Bold, born in 1353 and later a hero of Kulikovo. Andrei died of the Black Death in Moscow on 6 June 1353 and was buried in the Cathedral of the Archangel.
zh: 安德烈·伊万诺维奇（1327年6月4日—1353年6月6日）是莫斯科大公伊万一世·卡利塔的幼子，留里克王朝后裔。1341年，他成为第一代谢尔普霍夫封邑王公。他曾数次代表家族前往金帐汗国，其中包括1341年其兄骄傲者西缅取得汗的册封诏书、就大公之位的那一次。他的妻子玛丽亚是罗斯托夫王公之女，1353年生下勇者弗拉基米尔，即后来库里科沃之战的英雄。1353年6月6日，安德烈在莫斯科死于黑死病，葬于天使长大教堂。

en: Andrei Rublev (c. 1360–c. 1430) was the greatest master of medieval Russian icon and fresco painting. First recorded in 1405, he joined Theophanes the Greek and Prokhor of Gorodets in painting the Cathedral of the Annunciation in the Moscow Kremlin. In 1408 he and Daniel Chorny decorated the Dormition Cathedral in Vladimir, and from 1425 to 1427 the Trinity Cathedral at the Trinity Lavra. His only fully authenticated work is the icon of the Trinity of about 1410, based on the story of Abraham's hospitality. At Moscow's Andronikov Monastery he painted the Saviour Cathedral and died. In 1551 a church council made his style a model for church painting; he was canonized in 1988.
zh: 安德烈·鲁布廖夫（约1360—约1430）是中世纪俄罗斯最伟大的圣像画与壁画大师。史籍首次提到他是在1405年：他与希腊人狄奥凡和戈罗杰茨的普罗霍尔一起，为莫斯科克里姆林宫的圣母领报大教堂绘制圣像与壁画。1408年，他与丹尼尔·乔尔内装饰弗拉基米尔的圣母安息大教堂；1425至1427年又绘制圣三一修道院的圣三大教堂。他唯一被完全确认的真迹是约1410年创作的《三位一体》圣像，取材于亚伯拉罕待客的故事。他在莫斯科安德罗尼科夫修道院绘制救世主大教堂壁画，并在那里去世。1551年一次教会会议将他的画风定为教会绘画的典范；1988年他被封圣。

en: Antonio Possevino (1533–1611) was a Mantuan-born Jesuit and papal diplomat. He joined the Society of Jesus in 1559 and founded Jesuit schools in Savoy, including those at Chambéry, Mondovì and Turin. As envoy of Pope Gregory XIII from 1578, he led missions across northern and eastern Europe: he received King John III of Sweden into the Catholic Church and travelled to Moscow to negotiate with Ivan the Terrible. Mediating between Ivan and Stephen Báthory of Poland, he secured the Truce of Jam Zapolski in 1582, ending the war between Russia and Poland-Lithuania. His later works include an account of Russia and the encyclopedic Bibliotheca selecta; he died in Ferrara in 1611.
zh: 安东尼奥·波塞维诺（1533—1611）是出生于曼托瓦的耶稣会士与教皇外交官。他于1559年加入耶稣会，在萨伏依创办耶稣会学校，包括尚贝里、蒙多维和都灵的学校。1578年起，他作为教皇格列高利十三世的使节多次出使北欧和东欧：他为瑞典国王约翰三世举行皈依天主教的仪式，并前往莫斯科与伊凡雷帝谈判。他在伊凡与波兰的斯特凡·巴托里之间斡旋，促成1582年的《亚姆·扎波尔斯基停战协定》，结束了俄国与波兰立陶宛之间的战争。晚年著有俄国见闻录和百科全书式的《精选文库》，1611年在费拉拉去世。

en: Antonio Rinaldi (1709–1794) was an Italian architect from Palermo, trained by Luigi Vanvitelli, who worked most of his life in Russia. In 1751 Hetman Kirill Razumovsky summoned him to decorate his residences in what is now Ukraine. From 1754 he served as chief architect of the young court of Peter III and Catherine II at Oranienbaum, where he built Peter III's palace, the Chinese Palace and the Ice-Sliding Pavilion. In the 1770s, as Grigory Orlov's architect, he designed the Marble Palace in Saint Petersburg and the vast Gatchina Castle, along with the Chesma Column and Kagul Obelisk at Tsarskoe Selo. In 1784 poor health took him back to Italy, and he died in Rome.
zh: 安东尼奥·里纳尔迪（1709—1794）是巴勒莫出身的意大利建筑师，师从路易吉·万维泰利，大半生在俄国工作。1751年，盖特曼基里尔·拉祖莫夫斯基召他到今乌克兰境内装饰自己的府邸。1754年起，他担任彼得三世与叶卡捷琳娜二世年轻宫廷的首席建筑师，在奥拉宁鲍姆修建了彼得三世宫、中国宫与滑冰亭。1770年代，他作为格里戈里·奥尔洛夫的建筑师，设计了圣彼得堡的大理石宫和宏伟的加特契纳宫，以及皇村的切什梅柱和卡古尔方尖碑。1784年，他因健康恶化返回意大利，后在罗马去世。

en: Aigusta Anastasia (c. 1320–1345), most likely a daughter of Lithuania's Grand Duke Gediminas, was baptized Orthodox as Anastasia to marry Prince Simeon of Moscow in November or December 1333. The match held promise for relations between the rival powers, but war between them resumed in 1335. Her sons Vasily and Konstantin died in infancy, and her daughter Vasilisa married the Tverite prince Mikhail Vasilevich of Kashin in 1350. In 1345 Jaunutis, probably her brother, sought her help after Algirdas deposed him. She took the veil just before her death on 11 March 1345 and was buried in a Kremlin church she had founded.
zh: 阿纳斯塔西娅（约1320—1345）很可能是立陶宛大公格季米纳斯之女，为在1333年11或12月嫁给莫斯科王公西缅而受洗皈依东正教，取名阿纳斯塔西娅。这场婚姻曾有望缓和立陶宛与莫斯科的敌对关系，但两国1335年便战火重燃。她所生的瓦西里与康斯坦丁均夭折，女儿瓦西丽莎于1350年嫁给特维尔系的卡申王公米哈伊尔·瓦西里耶维奇。1345年，很可能是她兄长的尧努蒂斯被阿尔吉尔达斯废黜后曾向她求助。1345年3月11日她临终前出家为修女，葬于她出资修建的克里姆林宫教堂。

en: Bogdan Matveyevich Khitrovo (c. 1615–1680) was a Russian boyar and statesman under Tsars Alexis and Feodor III. As governor of Temnikov in the 1640s he founded a chain of forts on the Volga, including Simbirsk. From 1648 he ran a succession of prikazy, and from 1654 until his death he headed the Kremlin Armoury, putting the tsar's icon painters under his patronage. Despite the opposition of Avvakum, he encouraged Simon Ushakov and others to absorb Western naturalism. He fought Poland and joined the Truce of Andrusovo talks. In his last sixteen years he administered the Kremlin palaces and other state estates. He died in March 1680, leaving books and icons to monasteries and freeing his slaves in his will.
zh: 波格丹·马特维耶维奇·希特罗沃（约1615—1680）是沙皇阿列克谢和费奥多尔三世两朝的波雅尔与重臣。1640年代他任捷姆尼科夫总督，在伏尔加河沿线修建了一系列堡垒，辛比尔斯克即出自其手。1648年起他接连掌管多个衙门，1654年至去世长期主持克里姆林兵器库，沙皇家的圣像画家因而受其庇护。他不顾大司祭阿瓦库姆等人的反对，鼓励西蒙·乌沙科夫等人吸收西方的写实技法。他还参加了对波兰的战争与《安德鲁索沃停战协定》的谈判。生命的最后16年，他管理克里姆林宫殿及其他国有地产。他于1680年3月去世，遗嘱将书籍和圣像赠予修道院，并释放自己的奴仆。

en: Boris Feodorovich Godunov (1552–1605) rose at the court of Ivan the Terrible as an oprichnik and married the daughter of Malyuta Skuratov; his sister Irina wed the heir Feodor in 1580, making Boris the future tsar's brother-in-law. From Feodor I's accession in 1584 he was the de facto ruler of Russia. When Feodor died childless in 1598, Boris had himself elected tsar by the Zemsky Sobor and was crowned on 1 September. He imported foreign teachers, sent Russians to study abroad and made peace with Sweden in 1595. In 1600 he moved against the rival Romanov family, forcing Feodor Romanov into a monastery and exiling or imprisoning his brothers. Boris died in April 1605 during the Time of Troubles.
zh: 鲍里斯·费奥多罗维奇·戈东诺夫（1552—1605）以特辖军身份在伊凡雷帝宫廷发迹，娶了马柳塔·斯库拉托夫之女；1580年他的妹妹伊琳娜嫁给皇储费奥多尔，他由此成为未来沙皇的内兄。1584年费奥多尔一世上台后，他成为俄罗斯的实际统治者。1598年费奥多尔无嗣而终，鲍里斯由缙绅会议选举为沙皇，9月1日加冕。他引进外国教师、派遣俄国人出国留学，并于1595年与瑞典议和。1600年他打击对手罗曼诺夫家族，迫使费奥多尔·罗曼诺夫出家，并将其兄弟流放或监禁。1605年4月，鲍里斯在混乱时代中去世。

en: Daniil Aleksandrovich (1261–5 March 1303), known as Daniel of Moscow, was the youngest son of Alexander Nevsky and the first prince of Moscow, given Moscow on Nevsky's death in 1263 and ruling in person only from 1282. A peacemaker in the feuds of the Rus princes, he led a Moscow–Tver coalition against Grand Prince Andrey, took Kolomna from Ryazan in 1301 and received Pereslavl-Zalessky by bequest in 1302. He founded the Danilov Monastery in Moscow, died in monastic vows on 5 March 1303, without ever holding Vladimir's grand princely throne, and was the forefather of the Daniilovichi line.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/丹尼尔·亚历山德罗维奇
zh: 丹尼尔·亚历山德罗维奇（1261—1303年3月5日），史称莫斯科的丹尼尔，是亚历山大·涅夫斯基最小的儿子、莫斯科第一代王公。1263年父亲去世后他受封莫斯科，直至1282年才真正亲政。在罗斯诸王公的混战中，他以调停者著称，曾率领莫斯科与特维尔联军对抗安德烈大公；1301年他从梁赞手中夺取科洛姆纳，1302年又依遗嘱获得佩列斯拉夫尔-扎列斯基。他在莫斯科创立达尼洛夫修道院，1303年3月5日临终前落发为僧，于同日去世。他终生未能登上弗拉基米尔大公之位，却是莫斯科留里克王朝丹尼洛维奇支系的始祖。

en: Dmitry Gerasimov (c. 1465 – after 1535) was a Russian translator, diplomat and philologist, probably born in Novgorod. After learning Latin and German in Livonia, he served as interpreter on Vasily III's embassies to Prussia, Sweden, Denmark and Emperor Maximilian I. In 1525 Vasily III sent him as envoy to Pope Clement VII in Rome to discuss an anti-Ottoman league. There he described Russia's geography to Paolo Giovio, who compiled the information in a book. Battista Agnese then mapped it, providing a pattern for most sixteenth-century maps of Muscovy. Gerasimov also translated religious works and Donatus's grammar, comparing Latin with Church Slavonic and proposing terms for Slavic grammar. He collaborated with Maximus the Greek.
zh: 德米特里·格拉西莫夫（约1465—1535年后）是俄国翻译家、外交官与语言学者，可能出生于诺夫哥罗德。他在利沃尼亚学会拉丁语和德语，此后在瓦西里三世派往普鲁士、瑞典、丹麦和皇帝马克西米利安一世的使团中担任译员。1525年，瓦西里三世派他为使节前往罗马觐见教皇克雷芒七世，商谈结成反对奥斯曼的联盟。他在罗马向保罗·乔维奥讲述俄国地理，乔维奥将这些信息汇编成书，巴蒂斯塔·阿涅塞随后据此绘制地图，成为16世纪多数莫斯科维亚地图的范本。格拉西莫夫还翻译宗教著作和多纳图斯的语法书，比较拉丁语与教会斯拉夫语，并为斯拉夫语语法提出术语。他与马克西姆·格列克合作。

en: Domenico Trezzini (c. 1670–1734) was a Swiss-Italian architect from Ticino who became the first architect of St Petersburg. After training in Italy and working in Copenhagen, he was recruited by Peter I and reached Russia in 1703 and the new capital in February 1704. He contributed to major projects including the Peter and Paul Fortress and its cathedral (1712–1733), the Summer Palace, the Twelve Collegia, the Kronstadt fortifications and the Alexander Nevsky Monastery. He founded a school on the European model and helped define the Petrine Baroque. He trained Mikhail Zemtsov and other Russian architects, and died in St Petersburg in 1734.
zh: 多梅尼科·特列齐尼（约1670—1734）是瑞士提契诺出身的意大利裔建筑师，圣彼得堡的第一位建筑师。他在意大利学艺，后在哥本哈根工作，受到彼得一世招募，1703年抵达俄国，1704年2月来到新都。他参与了多项重要工程，包括彼得保罗要塞及其中1712—1733年修建的彼得保罗大教堂、夏宫、十二院、喀琅施塔得防御工事和亚历山大·涅夫斯基修道院。他创办了一所欧式学校，帮助形成彼得巴洛克风格，培养了米哈伊尔·泽姆佐夫等俄国建筑师，1734年在圣彼得堡去世。

en: Elena Vasilyevna Glinskaya (c. 1510–1538), daughter of the Lithuanian prince Vasili Glinsky, became the second wife of Grand Prince Vasili III of Moscow in January 1526, after he set aside his first consort. Boyars opposed the match, while the Church opposed the divorce. In 1530 she bore Ivan, the future Ivan the Terrible. On Vasili's death in 1533 she became Russia's first female regent, ruling for her three-year-old son. Her uncle Mikhail Glinsky was imprisoned in 1534 after a conflict at court. Her government fought Lithuania to an armistice in 1537, carried out the currency reform of 1535 that introduced the kopek and unified the coinage, and raised new walls around Moscow. She died suddenly in April 1538, amid rumours of poisoning.
zh: 叶连娜·瓦西里耶芙娜·格林斯卡娅（约1510—1538）是立陶宛王公瓦西里·格林斯基之女，1526年1月在瓦西里三世与原配离异后成为他的第二任妻子。贵族反对这桩婚事，教会则反对离婚。1530年她生下未来的伊凡雷帝。1533年瓦西里三世去世后，她为年仅三岁的儿子摄政，成为俄罗斯第一位女性摄政者。1534年，她的叔父米哈伊尔·格林斯基在宫廷斗争后被囚禁。她的政府与立陶宛交战并于1537年达成停战，1535年推行货币改革、发行戈比并统一铸币，还在莫斯科周围修筑新城墙。1538年4月她突然去世，时人盛传她是被毒杀。

en: Fyodor Apraksin (1661–1728) was one of Russia's first admirals and a lifelong friend of Peter the Great. A stolnik to the young tsar after his sister Marfa married Tsar Feodor III in 1681, he was appointed governor of Arkhangelsk in 1692 and from 1697 supervised the building of the first Russian fleet at Voronezh. He fought at the Azov siege of 1696, became the first governor of Azov in 1700 and general-admiral in 1708. He led Russian squadrons in the Great Northern War, including an expedition into the Gulf of Bothnia in 1719. He headed the Admiralty from 1717 and commanded the Baltic Fleet from 1723, dying in Moscow in 1728.
zh: 费奥多尔·阿普拉克辛（1661—1728）是俄国最早的海军将领之一，也是彼得大帝终生的朋友。1681年其姐玛尔法嫁给沙皇费奥多尔三世后，他成为年轻彼得的侍臣；1692年出任阿尔汉格尔斯克总督，1697年起在沃罗涅日督造俄国第一支舰队。他参加了1696年亚速围攻战，1700年成为亚速首任总督，1708年晋封海军元帅。大北方战争期间他多次率舰队出征，1719年远征波的尼亚湾。1717年起他主持海军部，1723年起指挥波罗的海舰队，1728年在莫斯科去世。

en: Feodor Nikitich Romanov (1553–1633), first of the Romanov surname, served Tsar Feodor I against Sweden and negotiated with Emperor Rudolf II's ambassadors in 1593–1594. A popular candidate for the throne in 1598, he was forced by Boris Godunov in 1600 to take monastic vows as Filaret. The False Dmitry made him metropolitan of Rostov in 1605, and he was imprisoned in Poland from 1610 to 1618 for rejecting Sigismund III as tsar. Freed after the Truce of Deulino, he was enthroned Patriarch of Moscow in June 1619 and co-ruled Russia with his son Tsar Michael until his death in 1633. He reformed tax assessment and collection, encouraged theological publishing and reorganized the army with foreign officers' help.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/費奧多爾·尼基季奇·羅曼諾夫
zh: 费奥多尔·尼基季奇·罗曼诺夫（1553—1633）是第一个使用罗曼诺夫姓氏的人，曾在费奥多尔一世时期对瑞典作战，并于1593—1594年与皇帝鲁道夫二世的使节谈判。1598年他是众望所归的王位人选，1600年被鲍里斯·戈东诺夫强迫出家，取修道名菲拉列特。1605年伪德米特里任命他为罗斯托夫都主教；1610年至1618年他因拒绝承认西吉斯蒙德三世为沙皇而被囚禁在波兰。《杰乌利诺停战协定》后获释，1619年6月就任莫斯科宗主教，此后与儿子米哈伊尔沙皇共同执政，直至1633年去世。他改革税额评定与征收，鼓励出版神学著作，并借助外国军官整顿军队。

en: Francesco Bartolomeo Rastrelli (1700–1771) was an Italian architect born in Paris, where his Florentine father Carlo Rastrelli worked as a sculptor. In 1716 he accompanied his father to Saint Petersburg at Peter I's invitation and trained in his workshop. His first palace, for former Moldavian prince Dimitrie Cantemir, followed in 1721. Appointed senior court architect in 1730, he served Empresses Anna and Elizabeth, creating the opulent Late Baroque of the Winter Palace, the Catherine Palace at Tsarskoye Selo and the Smolny Convent. Elizabeth's death in 1762 left his planned bell tower at Smolny unfinished. Under Catherine II he retired to Courland, where he supervised the completion and decoration of the ducal palaces. He died in 1771, shortly after joining the Imperial Academy of Arts.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/弗朗切斯科·巴尔托洛梅奥·拉斯特雷利
zh: 弗朗切斯科·巴尔托洛梅奥·拉斯特雷利（1700—1771）是意大利建筑师，生于巴黎，父亲卡洛·拉斯特雷利是在当地工作的佛罗伦萨雕塑家。1716年，他应彼得一世之邀随父亲迁居圣彼得堡，在父亲的作坊学艺。1721年，他接到第一项重要委托，为摩尔多瓦前大公迪米特里耶·坎泰米尔建造宫殿。1730年他出任宫廷首席建筑师，历仕安娜女皇与伊丽莎白女皇，以奢华的晚期巴洛克风格设计了冬宫、皇村的叶卡捷琳娜宫和斯莫尔尼修道院。1762年伊丽莎白去世，他为斯莫尔尼设计的钟楼未能建成。叶卡捷琳娜二世时期他退隐库尔兰，监督公爵宫殿的竣工和装饰。1771年他去世，此前不久刚入选帝国艺术学院。

en: François Le Fort (1656–1699) was a Genevan adventurer who became Peter the Great's favourite and Russia's first general-admiral. He began his military career in the Dutch army in 1674 and entered Russian service as a captain in 1678. He fought in the Crimean campaigns of 1687 and 1689. From 1690 he was the tsar's closest companion, organizing the toy-army manoeuvres and the All-Joking, All-Drunken Synod of Fools and Jesters, and rose to general by 1693. In 1695 he took naval command in the Azov campaigns, and in 1696 jointly led Peter's Grand Embassy to Western Europe. He died in Moscow in March 1699, mourned by Peter as his one trusty man.
zh: 法兰茨·列福尔特（1656—1699）是日内瓦出生的冒险家，后成为彼得大帝的宠臣、俄国第一位海军元帅。他1674年在荷兰军队开始军旅生涯，1678年以上尉军衔进入俄军，参加了1687和1689年两次克里木远征。1690年起他成为年轻沙皇最亲密的伙伴，一手筹办“玩具军队”演武和癫狂酗酒的“愚人小丑会议”，1693年晋升上将。1695—1696年亚速远征期间他指挥海军，1696年又与他人共同率领彼得的大使团出使西欧。1699年3月他在莫斯科病逝，彼得痛惜他是自己唯一可靠的人。

en: Elena Alexandrovna (died 1 March 1331), possibly a daughter of Prince Alexander Glebovich of Smolensk, was the first wife of Ivan I Kalita of Moscow. On her deathbed in the Spassky Monastery she took the veil under the name Solomonida. She left three young sons, Simeon, Ivan and Andrei, and was buried in the monastery cathedral in the Moscow Kremlin, the first tomb in the grand-princely mausoleum of Moscow.
zh: 叶莲娜·亚历山德罗夫娜（？—1331年3月1日）可能是斯摩棱斯克王公亚历山大·格列博维奇之女，是莫斯科王公伊凡一世·卡利塔的第一任妻子。她在救主修道院临终前出家为尼，法号所罗莫尼达。她留下谢苗、伊凡、安德烈三个年幼的儿子，葬于莫斯科克里姆林宫救主修道院大教堂，是莫斯科大公陵寝中的第一座墓葬。

en: Ivan Bolotnikov (1565–1608) led a great peasant uprising during the Time of Troubles. A slave of Prince Andrei Teliatevsky, he fled to the Cossacks, was captured by Crimean Tatars and sold as a helmsman on a Turkish galley, then freed by German ships and carried to Venice. Returning through Poland, he heard tales of Tsar Dmitri and met Mikhail Molchanov at Sambor. In 1606 Molchanov sent him to Putivl with a letter claiming he served Dmitri. There he raised rebels, defeated the tsar's troops at Kromy and besieged Moscow. Driven back to Kaluga and then Tula, he surrendered to Vasily Shuisky in October 1607 after a long siege. He was taken to Kargopol, blinded and drowned in 1608.
zh: 伊万·波洛特尼科夫（1565—1608）是混乱时期大规模农民起义的领袖。他本是安德烈·捷利亚杰夫斯基大公的奴仆，逃奔哥萨克后被克里米亚鞑靼人俘获，卖到土耳其桨帆船上担任舵手，后被德国船只解救并带到威尼斯。他取道波兰返回时听闻沙皇德米特里的传闻，并在桑博尔遇到米哈伊尔·莫尔恰诺夫。1606年，莫尔恰诺夫派他携信前往普季夫利，信中称他是德米特里的仆人。他在那里聚集起义军，在克罗梅击败沙皇军队并围攻莫斯科。他被击退至卡卢加，再退到图拉，在长期围困后于1607年10月向瓦西里·舒伊斯基投降。他被押往卡尔戈波尔，1608年被刺瞎后溺死。

en: Ivan Fyodorov (c. 1510–1583) was the first printer of Muscovy. Educated at the University of Kraków, he became a deacon in the Moscow Kremlin and in 1564 set up the Moscow Print Yard with Pyotr Mstislavets, issuing the Apostol, the first dated printed book in Russia. Persecuted by scribes and forced to flee after his workshop burned, he found refuge with Hetman Hrehory Chodkiewicz in Lithuania, printing the Didactic Gospel at Zabłudów in 1569. From 1572 he worked in Lviv, issuing an alphabet book in 1574. In the service of Prince Konstanty Wasyl Ostrogski, he established a press at Ostrog and printed the first complete Church Slavonic Bible in 1581. He died in Lviv in 1583.
zh: 伊万·费奥多罗夫（约1510—1583）是莫斯科第一位印刷商。他曾就读于克拉科夫大学，后任莫斯科克里姆林宫辅祭，1564年与彼得·姆斯季斯拉韦茨创办莫斯科印刷院，刊印俄国第一部有确切纪年的印刷书《使徒》。他受到抄书吏迫害，作坊遭火毁后被迫出逃，在立陶宛得到盖特曼赫雷霍里·霍德凯维奇庇护，1569年在扎布武杜夫印成《教导福音书》。1572年起他在利沃夫工作，1574年刊印识字课本。此后他为康斯坦丁·瓦西里·奥斯特罗格斯基亲王服务，在奥斯特罗赫开设印刷所，于1581年印出第一部完整的教会斯拉夫语圣经。他于1583年在利沃夫去世。

en: Ivan Gramotin (d. 1638) was a Russian diplomat and head of the Posolsky Prikaz through the Time of Troubles. First made its head in August 1605 under False Dmitry I, he negotiated with Polish envoys in 1606, then served False Dmitry II and King Sigismund III, who restored him to the post with the rank of Keeper of the Seal. He also held a place in the Boyar Duma. Sent to Poland in 1612 over Wladislaus's claim to the Russian throne, he befriended Filaret, later patriarch, and after returning to Moscow in 1618 handled Turkish and English negotiations. Exiled at Filaret's insistence in 1626 for his intrigues, he returned in 1634 and died a monk at the Trinity Lavra in 1638.
zh: 伊万·格拉莫京（？—1638）是俄国外交官，在混乱时期长期担任外交衙门长官。1605年8月，他在伪德米特里一世治下首次受命主持外交衙门；1606年与波兰使节谈判，此后又先后投靠伪德米特里二世和国王齐格蒙特三世，后者恢复了他的职位，并授予他掌玺官的等级。他还进入贵族杜马。1612年，他为瓦迪斯瓦夫争夺俄国王位一事出使波兰，与在押的、后来成为大牧首的菲拉列特结交；1618年回到莫斯科后主持对土耳其和英国的交涉。1626年，他因权谋活动在菲拉列特坚持下被流放，1634年返回，1638年在谢尔盖圣三一修道院出家去世。

en: Ivan I Danilovich, nicknamed Kalita (Moneybag) (c. 1288–1340), was the fourth son of Daniel of Moscow and a grandson of Alexander Nevsky. He became Prince of Moscow in 1325, after his brother Yury was murdered by Dmitry of Tver, and won the khan's favour over Moscow's old rival Tver. Metropolitan Peter made Moscow his residence, and on 4 August 1326 Ivan laid the foundation of its first stone church, the Dormition Cathedral. When Tver rose against the Mongols in 1327, Özbeg Khan sent him with Alexander of Suzdal and a Tatar army to crush it. The khan divided the grand principality between them in 1328; after Alexander's death in 1331, Ivan became sole Grand Prince of Vladimir. He collected the khan's tribute from the other princes and spent it on Moscow. In 1339 his rival Alexander of Tver was executed at the Horde, ending a struggle of about thirty-five years. Ivan died on 31 March 1340, and his son Simeon succeeded him.
zh: 伊凡一世·丹尼洛维奇，绰号“卡利塔”（钱袋）（约1288—1340），是莫斯科王公丹尼尔的第四子，亚历山大·涅夫斯基之孙。1325年，兄长尤里被特维尔的德米特里杀害，他继任莫斯科王公，并在争取汗廷青睐上胜过莫斯科的宿敌特维尔。都主教彼得选定莫斯科为驻地，1326年8月4日，伊凡为城中第一座石造教堂圣母安息大教堂奠基。1327年特维尔爆发反蒙古起义，月即别汗派他与苏兹达尔的亚历山大率鞑靼军队前去镇压。1328年，汗把大公国分给二人；1331年亚历山大死后，伊凡独任弗拉基米尔大公。他替汗向其他王公征收贡赋，并把所得用在莫斯科身上。1339年，他的对手特维尔的亚历山大在金帐汗国被处死，延续约三十五年的争斗就此结束。伊凡于1340年3月31日去世，其子谢苗继位。

en: Ivan II Ivanovich, called the Fair (30 March 1326 – 13 November 1359), was a son of Ivan I Kalita who held Ruza and Zvenigorod until his brother Simeon died of the Black Death in 1353, when he succeeded as prince of Moscow and grand prince of Vladimir. A passive ruler, he let Algirdas of Lithuania take his father-in-law's city of Bryansk and Oleg of Riazan raid his lands; yet aided by Metropolitan Alexius he annexed Borovsk and Vereya. His second wife bore him Dmitry Donskoy. He died in 1359 and was buried in the Cathedral of the Archangel.
zh: 伊凡二世·伊万诺维奇，绰号“美公”（1326年3月30日—1359年11月13日），是伊万一世·卡利塔之子。他原本领有鲁扎和兹韦尼哥罗德，1353年兄长西缅死于黑死病后，继位为莫斯科王公兼弗拉基米尔大公。他性情温和消极，听任立陶宛的阿尔吉尔达斯攻占其岳父的城市布良斯克，也纵容梁赞的奥列格袭掠境内；但在都主教阿列克谢的辅佐下，他兼并了博罗夫斯克和韦列亚。继室为他生下德米特里·顿斯科伊。他于1359年去世，葬于天使长大教堂。

en: Ivan IV Vasilyevich, known as the Terrible (1530–1584), was Grand Prince of Moscow from 1533 and in 1547 became the first ruler crowned Tsar of all Russia. After a chaotic boyar regency he ruled with a circle of reformers, established the Zemsky Sobor, revised the law code and created the streltsy, Russia's first standing army. He conquered Kazan in 1552 and Astrakhan in 1556, bringing the whole Volga under Russian control. During the failed Livonian War (1558–1583), his oprichniki carried out a violent purge, including the massacre of Novgorod. He later killed his eldest son in a rage. His younger son Feodor succeeded him in 1584; Feodor's childless death in 1598 ended the Rurik dynasty.
zh: 伊凡四世·瓦西里耶维奇，史称伊凡雷帝（1530—1584），1533年起为莫斯科大公，1547年成为首位加冕的全俄罗斯沙皇。经历波雅尔贵族混战的摄政时期后，他与一批改革派共同执政，设立缙绅会议，修订法典，建立俄国第一支常备军射击军。他于1552年征服喀山、1556年征服阿斯特拉罕，将整个伏尔加河流域纳入俄国统治。失利的利沃尼亚战争（1558—1583）期间，他的特辖军大肆清洗，包括屠杀诺夫哥罗德居民。他后来在盛怒之下杀死长子。1584年他的幼子费奥多尔继位；1598年费奥多尔无嗣去世，留里克王朝随之终结。

en: Ivan Viskovatyi (c. 1510s–1570) was the first head of the Posolsky Prikaz, the foreign office of Ivan the Terrible. Given charge of diplomacy in 1549, he and Alexei Adashev directed Russian foreign policy through the 1550s, when Kazan and Astrakhan were conquered. After Richard Chancellor reached Moscow in 1553, he negotiated the privileges granted to the English Muscovy Company in 1555. He also organised the diplomatic archive and introduced formal registers of embassies. In 1561 he became Keeper of the Seal and entered the Boyar Duma; in 1562–1563 he led an embassy to Denmark to negotiate Baltic treaties. During the oprichnina he was accused of treason after the sack of Novgorod and was publicly executed in Moscow on 25 July 1570.
zh: 伊万·维斯科瓦季（约1510年代—1570）是伊凡雷帝外交衙门的首任长官。1549年，他受命掌管外交事务，与阿列克谢·阿达舍夫在1550年代主持俄国外交，那正是喀山和阿斯特拉罕被征服的十年。1553年理查德·钱塞勒抵达莫斯科后，他于1555年谈成给予英国莫斯科公司的贸易特权。他还整理外交档案，开始正式编纂使节簿。1561年他出任掌玺官并进入贵族杜马；1562至1563年，他率使团赴丹麦谈判波罗的海条约。特辖制时期，他在诺夫哥罗德遭洗劫后被指控叛国，1570年7月25日在莫斯科被公开处死。

en: James Bruce (1669–1735) was a Russian field marshal and scientist of Scottish descent, and one of Peter the Great's ablest lieutenants. He served in the Crimean and Azov campaigns, rebuilt the artillery lost at Narva in 1700 and commanded the guns at Poltava in 1709, earning the Order of St Andrew. One of the most learned men in Russia, he opened its first observatory in the Sukharev Tower in 1701, and his library of over fifteen hundred volumes later passed to the Academy of Sciences. He headed the Mining and Manufacturing Collegium from 1717 and the Mining Collegium from 1722, becoming one of Russia's first counts in 1721. Muscovites rumoured him a magician.
zh: 雅各·布鲁斯（俄语名雅科夫·维利莫维奇·布留斯，1669—1735）是苏格兰裔俄国陆军元帅、科学家，彼得大帝最得力的助手之一。他参加了克里木远征和亚速远征，重建了1700年纳尔瓦之战中损失的炮兵，并在1709年波尔塔瓦战役中指挥炮兵，获授圣安德烈勋章。他是当时俄国最博学的人之一，1701年在苏哈列夫塔创办俄国第一座天文台，他收藏的一千五百余卷图书后来并入科学院图书馆。1717年起他主持矿业与制造业委员会，1722年起主持矿业委员会，1721年成为俄国首批伯爵之一。莫斯科民间传说他是魔法师。

en: Jean-Baptiste Le Blond (1679–1719) was a French architect and garden designer in the tradition of André Le Nôtre, known in Paris for his hôtels particuliers and for a seminal treatise on formal gardens in 1709. Invited by Peter the Great, he arrived at St Petersburg in 1716 with the unprecedented title of Architect-General. He laid out workshops and nurseries along the Neva and introduced lighting for the main streets with oil lanterns of his own design. He drew up an unexecuted grid plan centred on Vasilievsky Island, designed the Apraksin Palace and helped plan the first palace and cascades at Peterhof in 1717. He died of smallpox there in March 1719.
zh: 让-巴蒂斯特·勒布隆（1679—1719）是法国建筑师与园林设计师，承袭安德烈·勒诺特尔的造园传统，在巴黎以私家府邸设计和1709年一部经典法式园林论著闻名。他应彼得大帝邀请，1716年抵达圣彼得堡，获授前所未有的“总建筑师”头衔。他在涅瓦河畔兴办工场与苗圃，推行以自己设计的油灯照亮主要街道。他绘制了以瓦西里岛为中心、最终未获采纳的棋盘式城市规划，设计了阿普拉克辛宫，并在1717年参与规划彼得霍夫的首批宫殿与喷泉瀑布。1719年3月他在当地染天花去世。

en: Joseph Volotsky (1439–1515), born Ivan Sanin, was a Russian Orthodox monk and theologian. About 1459 he entered Paphnutius of Borovsk's monastery and in 1477 became its hegumen, but after disputes with the brethren he founded the Joseph-Volokolamsk Monastery in 1479 under a strict rule. In his book The Enlightener he attacked the Judaizer heresy, demanding death for unrepentant heretics, and at the councils of 1503 and 1504 led the Possessors, defending monastic landownership against Nilus of Sora and the Non-Possessors. He also taught that the tsar held autocratic power. He died in 1515 and was canonized in 1579.
zh: 约瑟夫·沃洛茨基（1439—1515）俗名伊万·萨宁，是俄罗斯正教会修士与神学家。约1459年，他进入博罗夫斯克的帕夫努季修道院，1477年成为院长；因与修士发生争执，1479年另立教规森严的约瑟夫—沃洛科拉姆斯克修道院。他在著作《启蒙者》中抨击“犹太派”异端，要求处死拒不悔改的异端分子，并在1503和1504年的会议上率领“占有派”维护修道院地产，对抗尼尔·索尔斯基的“非占有派”。他的学说还主张沙皇的专制权力。他于1515年去世，1579年被封圣。

en: Marco Ruffo, known in Russian chronicles as Mark Fryazin, was an Italian architect active in Moscow in the late fifteenth century. His Italian name remains uncertain; Ruffo was a nineteenth-century conjecture. In 1484 he built a treasury for Ivan III in the Kremlin, followed in 1487 by the Small Embankment Palace, whose facade bore Italian architectural details. His surviving work is the Beklemishevskaya tower of 1487. He worked on the Kremlin's Spasskaya and Nikolskaya towers, later completed by Pietro Antonio Solari. He began the Palace of Facets in 1487; Solari also worked on it, and it was completed in 1491 as the grand princes' reception hall. Chronicles last mention him in 1491; his later fate is unknown.
zh: 马尔科·鲁福在俄国编年史中被称为“马克·弗里亚津”，是15世纪后期活跃于莫斯科的意大利建筑师。他的意大利原名尚无定论，“鲁福”是19世纪的推测。1484年，他为伊凡三世在克里姆林宫修建国库；1487年又建成小滨河宫，其立面带有意大利建筑细部。他的存世作品为1487年建成的别克列米舍夫斯卡亚塔。他还参与修建克里姆林宫的斯巴斯克塔和尼古拉塔，后来由彼得罗·安东尼奥·索拉里竣工。1487年他开始建造多棱宫，索拉里也参与其事；多棱宫于1491年落成，是大公接见宾客的大厅。编年史对他的最后记载是1491年，此后下落不明。

en: Maria Yaroslavna of Borovsk (c. 1420–1485) was the daughter of Yaroslav Vladimirovich, prince of Borovsk and Maloyaroslavets, and became grand princess of Moscow on marrying Vasily II in 1433. During the Muscovite civil war she was exiled to Galich after Vasily Kosoy and Dmitry Shemyaka seized Moscow. She returned to Moscow with difficulty, but in February 1446 Shemyaka captured her and sent her to Uglich with her husband. Mother of Ivan III, she granted tax exemptions to the Trinity Lavra in 1450 and the Kirillo-Belozersky Monastery in 1471. After her husband's death she inherited Rostov and Poshekhonye, and in 1480 blessed her son's campaign against Ahmed Khan. She took the veil as Marfa in 1482 and died in 1485.
zh: 博罗夫斯克的玛丽亚·雅罗斯拉夫娜（约1420—1485）是博罗夫斯克与小雅罗斯拉韦茨王公雅罗斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇之女，1433年嫁给瓦西里二世，成为莫斯科大公夫人。莫斯科内战期间，瓦西里·科索伊和德米特里·舍米亚卡夺取莫斯科，她被放逐到加利奇。她历经艰难返回莫斯科，1446年2月却被舍米亚卡俘获，与丈夫一同流放乌格利奇。她是伊凡三世的母亲，1450年赐谢尔盖圣三一修道院免税，1471年又赐基里洛-别洛泽尔斯基修道院免税。丈夫死后她继承了罗斯托夫和波舍洪耶，1480年为儿子迎击艾哈迈德汗的大军祝福。1482年她出家，修道名玛尔法，1485年去世。

en: Alexius (before 1296–1378), born Eleutherius, was Metropolitan of Kiev and all Rus' from 1354 and a patron saint of Moscow. The son of a Chernigov boyar, he became a monk around 1313 and Bishop of Vladimir in 1352 before his election as metropolitan during a stay in Constantinople. As spiritual tutor of the young Dmitry Donskoy, he led the Muscovite government as regent and backed Dmitry against Tver and Nizhny Novgorod. He sent Sergius of Radonezh to suspend church services in Nizhny Novgorod until the dispute ended. In 1357 the Golden Horde khan Jani Beg summoned him to cure his blind mother Taydula. He founded the Andronikov and Chudov monasteries, tried unsuccessfully to persuade Sergius to succeed him, and was canonized in 1448.
zh: 阿列克塞（1296年前—1378年），俗名叶列夫费里，1354年起任基辅及全罗斯都主教，是莫斯科的主保圣人之一。他出身切尔尼戈夫的波雅尔家庭，约1313年出家，1352年成为弗拉基米尔主教，后在君士坦丁堡期间被选为都主教。他担任年幼的德米特里·顿斯科伊的精神导师并摄政，主持莫斯科政局，支持德米特里对抗特维尔和下诺夫哥罗德。他派拉多涅茨的谢尔盖前往下诺夫哥罗德，暂停教堂礼拜直至争端结束。1357年，金帐汗国可汗札尼别召他为失明的母亲泰都拉治病。他创立了安德罗尼科夫修道院和丘多夫修道院，曾试图说服谢尔盖继任但未成功，1448年被封圣。

en: Natalya Kirillovna Naryshkina (1651–1694) was raised in the Western-leaning household of the Moscow boyar Artamon Matveyev and became Tsar Alexis's second wife in February 1671 after a bride-show. In May 1672 she bore the future Peter the Great. As tsaritsa she broke with terem custom, riding in an open carriage and becoming the first Russian woman to attend a theatre. She was made regent for the ten-year-old Peter in May 1682 but was ousted within days by her stepdaughter Sophia amid the Streltsy revolt, in which two of her brothers and Matveyev were killed. Under Sophia's regency, Natalya lived with Peter mainly at Preobrazhenskoe. Restored after Peter seized power in August 1689, she ruled until her death in 1694.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/納塔利婭·基里洛芙娜·納雷什金娜
zh: 纳塔利娅·基里洛芙娜·纳雷什金娜（1651—1694）在亲西方的莫斯科大贵族阿尔塔蒙·马特维耶夫家长大，1671年2月在选后中成为沙皇阿列克谢的第二任妻子。1672年5月她生下未来的彼得大帝。身为皇后她打破深闺旧俗，乘坐敞篷马车，还是第一位观看戏剧的俄罗斯女性。1682年5月她被立为十岁的彼得的摄政，但几天后就在射击军叛乱中被继女索菲娅推翻；她的两名兄弟和马特维耶夫在叛乱中遇害。索菲娅摄政期间，纳塔利娅与彼得主要住在普列奥布拉任斯科耶。1689年8月彼得夺权后她重新摄政，直至1694年去世。

en: Patrick Gordon (1635–1699) was a Scottish soldier who became a Russian general. Born in Aberdeenshire, he enlisted in Swedish service in 1655, fought for Sweden and Poland and was wounded at Chudnov in 1660, before joining the Russian army in 1661. A major-general by 1678 and commander at Kiev, he took part in the Crimean expeditions of 1687 and 1689. In 1689 his troops turned the Moscow coup in Peter the Great's favour against Sophia. His movable rampart helped take Azov in 1696. Peter made him a trusted adviser and organizer of his Western-style army; Gordon also secured Muscovy's first permanent Catholic church. He died in Moscow, leaving a detailed diary.
zh: 帕特里克·戈登（1635—1699）是苏格兰裔军人，后成为俄国将军。他生于阿伯丁郡，1655年加入瑞典军队，先后为瑞典和波兰作战，1660年在楚德诺夫负伤，1661年转入俄军。1678年升少将，后出镇基辅，并参加了1687年和1689年的克里木远征。1689年他麾下军队在莫斯科政变中倒向彼得大帝、击败摄政索菲娅。1696年他设计的“活动壁垒”助力攻克亚速。彼得视他为心腹谋主，命他按西欧模式编练军队；戈登还促成在莫斯科公国建立第一座永久性天主教堂。他在莫斯科去世，留下一部详尽的日记。

en: Peter I, known as the Great (1672–1725), ruled Russia as tsar from 1682 and was proclaimed its first emperor in 1721. He reigned jointly with his half-brother Ivan V until 1696. After taking power from his half-sister Sophia in 1689, he toured Western Europe to study shipbuilding and administration, then imposed sweeping reforms: a modern navy, a new civil script, the Julian calendar, and the Table of Ranks. He established a Governing Senate in 1711 and the Russian Academy of Sciences in 1724. His Azov campaigns gained a Black Sea foothold, and victory in the Great Northern War (1700–1721) secured the eastern Baltic coast. In 1703 he founded Saint Petersburg, to which he moved the capital in 1712, making Russia a European power.
zh: 彼得一世，史称彼得大帝（1672—1725），1682年起任俄国沙皇，1721年成为俄国首位皇帝。他与异母兄伊凡五世共治至1696年。1689年从异母姐姐索菲娅手中夺权后，他游历西欧学习造船与治国，随后推行全面改革：建立近代海军、推行新的民用字体、采用儒略历、颁布官秩表。他于1711年设立元老院，1724年创办俄罗斯科学院。亚速远征取得黑海立足点，大北方战争（1700—1721）的胜利则取得了波罗的海东岸领土。1703年他营建圣彼得堡，1712年迁都于此，使俄国跻身欧洲强国之列。

en: Postnik Yakovlev was a Russian architect from Pskov, active in the mid-sixteenth century. He helped erect the Cathedral of Saint Basil the Blessed on Red Square between 1555 and 1560 to mark the conquest of Kazan. The name Barma is also associated with the building, but may have been Yakovlev's nickname or that of an assistant. In 1561 and 1562 he and Ivan Shirjay designed the walls of the Kazan Kremlin and its Annunciation Cathedral; in 1588 he added a chapel to Saint Basil's over the grave of Basil Fool for Christ. Legend claims Ivan the Terrible blinded him so he could never build anything more beautiful, but his later works suggest the story is a myth.
zh: 波斯尼克·雅科夫列夫是16世纪中期活跃的普斯科夫建筑师。1555至1560年，他参与在红场修建圣瓦西里主教座堂，以纪念征服喀山。“巴尔马”这一名字也与建堂有关，但可能是雅科夫列夫的绰号，也可能指他的助手。1561至1562年，他与伊万·希尔贾伊设计了喀山克里姆林宫的城墙和圣母领报大教堂；1588年又为圣瓦西里主教座堂加建小堂，覆盖在圣愚瓦西里的墓上。相传伊凡雷帝在教堂落成后刺瞎他的双眼，使他再也造不出更美的建筑，但他此后的作品表明这一说法可能是传说。

en: Prokhor of Gorodets was a Russian icon painter active around 1400, thought to have been the teacher of Andrei Rublev. The Trinity Chronicle records that in 1405 he worked with Theophanes the Greek and the young Rublev on the frescoes and icons of the Cathedral of the Annunciation in the Moscow Kremlin. The chronicler calls him an elder and lists his name before Rublev. Scholars attribute to him several feast-tier icons from the cathedral, among them the Crucifixion, Ascension and Assumption, distinguished by bold highlights and slender figures.
zh: 戈罗杰茨的普罗霍尔是约1400年前后活跃的俄罗斯圣像画家，被认为是安德烈·鲁布廖夫的老师。据《三一编年史》记载，1405年他与希腊人狄奥凡和年轻的鲁布廖夫一起，为莫斯科克里姆林宫的圣母领报大教堂绘制壁画与圣像。编年史家称他为“长老”，并把他的名字排在鲁布廖夫之前。学者们将该大教堂节庆系列的数幅圣像归在他名下，包括《钉十字架》《升天》和《圣母安息》，其特点是高光鲜明、人物纤细。

en: Ridolfo Fioravanti, nicknamed Aristotele, was born in Bologna about 1415 into a family of architects and engineers. He won fame for the devices he used to rebuild noble towers there. Between 1458 and 1467 he worked for Cosimo de' Medici in Florence and in Milan, before returning to Bologna to design the Palazzo Bentivoglio. In 1467 he worked for King Matthias Corvinus in Hungary. In 1475 Ivan III invited him to Moscow, where from 1475 to 1479 he built the Kremlin's Dormition Cathedral on the model of the older cathedral in Vladimir, introducing new influences. One account says he later served as a military engineer in the campaigns against Novgorod, Kazan and Tver; another says he died in captivity after asking to return to Italy. He died around 1486.
zh: 鲁道尔夫·菲奥拉万蒂绰号“亚里士多德”，约1415年生于博洛尼亚一个建筑师与工程师世家。他因重建当地贵族塔楼所使用的器械而成名。1458至1467年间，他在佛罗伦萨为科西莫·德·美第奇效力，又在米兰工作，随后回到博洛尼亚设计本蒂沃利奥宫。1467年，他为匈牙利国王马加什·科尔温效力。1475年，伊凡三世将他请到莫斯科；1475至1479年，他以弗拉基米尔的古老大教堂为蓝本，主持修建了克里姆林宫内的圣母安息大教堂，并引入新的建筑影响。一种记载称他后来以军事工程师身份参加对诺夫哥罗德、喀山和特维尔的征战；另一种说法称他请求返回意大利后被囚，死于狱中。他约于1486年去世。

en: Sergius of Radonezh (1314–1392), born Bartholomew, was a Russian Orthodox monk and monastic reformer. With his brother he built a forest hermitage and a church of the Trinity at Makovets Hill near Radonezh, which grew into the Trinity Lavra of St. Sergius, Russia's most revered monastery. After his brother left, Sergius lived alone until other monks gathered around him and persuaded him to become their abbot. He insisted that monks live by their own labor, and his disciples founded some forty monasteries across central and northern Russia. He declined to succeed Metropolitan Alexius, and in 1380 blessed Dmitry Donskoy before the Battle of Kulikovo. His relics were found in 1422, and he is venerated as one of Russia's greatest saints.
zh: 拉多涅茨的谢尔盖（1314—1392），俗名巴尔多罗买，是俄罗斯东正教修士与修道院改革者。他与兄长在拉多涅日附近马科维茨山的密林中建起隐修小室和圣三教堂，后来发展为俄罗斯最受尊崇的谢尔盖圣三一修道院。兄长离开后，谢尔盖独居林中，直到其他修士聚集于此，说服他担任院长。他坚持修士须靠自己的劳作生活，弟子们在俄罗斯中部和北部创办了约四十座修道院。他拒绝继阿列克塞之后出任都主教，1380年在库里科沃战役前为德米特里·顿斯科伊祝福。1422年发现了他的遗骸，他被尊为俄罗斯最伟大的圣徒之一。

en: Simeon Ivanovich, nicknamed the Proud (7 September 1317 – 27 April 1353), was the eldest son of Ivan I Kalita, succeeding him as prince of Moscow and grand prince of Vladimir in 1340. He traveled to the Golden Horde and secured his investiture from Uzbeg Khan, outbidding the rival princes of Tver and Suzdal. That year he also forced Novgorod to surrender the tax revenues of Torzhok. He had married the Lithuanian princess Aigusta Anastasia in 1333, and his rule saw repeated standoffs with Algirdas of Lithuania. Simeon and his sons died when the Black Death reached Moscow in 1353.
zh: 西缅·伊万诺维奇，绰号“骄傲者”（1317年9月7日—1353年4月27日），是伊万一世·卡利塔的长子，1340年继位为莫斯科王公兼弗拉基米尔大公。他亲赴金帐汗国，以重金从月即别汗手中取得册封诏书，压倒特维尔和苏兹达尔的竞争王公。同年，他迫使诺夫哥罗德共和国交出托尔若克的丰厚税收。他于1333年迎娶立陶宛公主阿纳斯塔西娅，在位期间又与立陶宛的阿尔吉尔达斯屡屡对峙。1353年黑死病传入莫斯科，西缅与诸子染病而死。

en: Symeon of Polotsk (1629–1680), born Samuel Piotrowski-Sitnianowicz in Polotsk, was a Belarusian-born churchman, poet and educator. Educated at the Kiev Mohyla College, he presented panegyric verses to Tsar Alexis when the tsar visited Polotsk in 1656, and moved to Moscow in 1664, where he taught Latin to clerks of the Privy Affairs Office. From 1667 he served as court poet and tutor to the tsar's children, including Fyodor, Sophia and the young Peter. His Baroque plays, among them a comedy of the Prodigal Son, were gathered into the collections Rifmologion and Vertograd mnogotsvetny. He died in Moscow in 1680.
zh: 谢苗·波洛茨基（1629—1680）俗名萨穆伊尔·彼得罗夫斯基-西特尼亚诺维奇，生于波洛茨克，是白俄罗斯出身的教会人士、诗人与教育家。他曾在基辅莫希拉学院求学，1656年沙皇阿列克谢巡幸波洛茨克时向其献颂诗，1664年迁居莫斯科，向枢密事务衙门的书吏教授拉丁文。1667年起他出任宫廷诗人，并教导沙皇的子女，包括费奥多尔、索菲娅和年幼的彼得。他的巴洛克戏剧（如《浪子的喜剧》）后来收入《韵律集》和《多彩的花园》两部集子。1680年，他在莫斯科去世。

en: Simon (Pimen) Fyodorovich Ushakov (c. 1626–1686) was the leading Russian icon painter of the seventeenth century. Around 1648 he joined the Silver Chamber as a paid artist, and his bright-coloured, proto-Baroque icons brought him to the notice of Patriarch Nikon and Tsar Alexis, who assigned him to the Kremlin Armoury in 1664 under Bogdan Khitrovo. That same year he published a treatise on icon painting. Drawing on Western naturalism, he also pioneered secular portraits, or parsuna, and book engravings; conservatives led by Archpriest Avvakum denounced his saints as fleshly and unorthodox. He trained many pupils, and some of his icons reached Western Europe, where they helped attract interest in Russian painting. He died in Moscow on 25 June 1686.
zh: 西蒙（皮缅）·费奥多罗维奇·乌沙科夫（约1626—1686）是17世纪俄国首屈一指的圣像画家。约1648年他进入银器坊成为领俸画师，其色彩明快、带原始巴洛克风格的圣像得到牧首尼康和沙皇阿列克谢的赏识，1664年被调入克里姆林兵器库，在波格丹·希特罗沃手下任职；同年他还刊行了一部圣像画论著。他借鉴西方写实技法，开创了世俗肖像画“帕尔苏纳”与书籍版画，以大司祭阿瓦库姆为首的保守派却斥其圣像肉欲、不合正教。他培养了许多学生，一些圣像传到西欧，帮助当地人关注俄国绘画。1686年6月25日他在莫斯科去世。

en: Zoe Palaiologina (c. 1449–1503), known in Russia as Sophia Fominichna, was a Byzantine princess, niece of the last emperor Constantine XI and daughter of Thomas Palaiologos, Despot of the Morea. After the Ottoman conquest of the Morea in 1460 she was raised in Rome under papal protection. In 1472 she married Grand Prince Ivan III of Moscow. In 1502 she saw her son Vasily III made co-ruler after the downfall of the rival heir Dmitry. She died in Moscow in 1503.
zh: 佐伊·巴列奥略（约1449—1503）在俄罗斯称索菲娅·福米尼什娜，是拜占庭公主、末代皇帝君士坦丁十一世的侄女，摩里亚专制君主托马斯·巴列奥略之女。1460年奥斯曼征服摩里亚后，她在罗马受教廷抚养长大。1472年，她嫁给莫斯科大公伊凡三世。1502年争位者德米特里失势后，她的儿子瓦西里三世被立为共治大公。1503年，她在莫斯科去世。

en: Sofya Yuryevna was the daughter of Yury Danilovich, prince of Moscow, and in 1320 married Konstantin Mikhailovich, the future prince of Tver, after his brother ransomed him from Moscow captivity.
zh: 索菲娅·尤里耶芙娜是莫斯科王公尤里·达尼洛维奇之女。1320年，在康斯坦丁·米哈伊洛维奇被其兄从莫斯科拘禁中赎回后，她嫁给了这位后来的特维尔王公。

en: Stephen of Perm (c. 1340–1396) was a Russian Orthodox missionary, bishop and painter who converted the Komi peoples. Born in Ustyug, son of a cathedral cleric, he became a monk in Rostov, learned Greek, and around 1370 devised a distinct alphabet for the Komi language, the Old Permic script. From 1376 he worked along the Vychegda and Vym rivers, destroying pagan shrines as he won converts. In 1383 he was consecrated the first bishop of Perm. His new see threatened Novgorod's control of the region's tribute and, aided by Ustyug, defeated a Novgorodian army in 1385. Stephen visited Novgorod in 1386, when it acknowledged the new situation. He died in Moscow in 1396 and was canonized in 1549.
zh: 彼尔姆的斯特凡（约1340—1396）是俄罗斯东正教传教士、主教，也是画家，曾使科米人皈依基督教。他生于乌斯秋格，是大教堂教士之子，在罗斯托夫出家，学习希腊语，约1370年为科米语创制了独特的字母，即古彼尔姆文字。1376年起，他在维切格达河与维姆河流域传教，捣毁异教神龛，争取信徒。1383年他被祝圣为彼尔姆首任主教。新教区威胁到诺夫哥罗德对当地贡赋的控制；1385年，其教区在乌斯秋格协助下击败诺夫哥罗德军队。1386年斯特凡访问诺夫哥罗德，该城承认了新局面。1396年他在莫斯科去世，1549年被封圣。

en: Spiridon is the earliest named ancestor of the Stroganov family, recorded in the 1390s during the reign of Grand Prince Dmitry Donskoy of Moscow; his grandson Luka Kuzmich rented lands along the Northern Dvina. A later family tradition, reported by seventeenth-century Dutch travellers, makes him a baptized Tatar put to death by a khan in 1395 for refusing to abandon Christianity, a tale the historian Nikolay Karamzin rejected as a fable.
zh: 斯皮里东是斯特罗加诺夫家族谱系中最早具名的始祖，家谱记载他生活在莫斯科大公德米特里·顿斯科伊在位时期，1390年代已有其名；他的孙子卢卡·库兹米奇在北德维纳河一带承租土地。17世纪荷兰旅行家转述过一则家族传说，称他原是改宗基督教的鞑靼人，1395年因不肯背弃信仰被汗处死；历史学家尼古拉·卡拉姆津认为这一说法不足凭信。

en: Tikhon Nikitich Streshnev (1644?–1719) was a Russian boyar and one of Peter the Great's most trusted statesmen. With his uncle Rodion, he mentored the young Peter. After Peter's coronation in 1682 he received the court rank of okolnichiy, becoming a boyar in 1688 and head of the Razryadny Prikaz, the military chancellery, in 1690. During the Grand Embassy of 1697 he governed Russia jointly with Prince Romodanovsky. In 1709 he became Moscow's first governor and in 1711 a founding senator, signing Tsarevich Alexei's death sentence in 1718. His exceptional height later fed rumours that he was Peter's real father.
zh: 吉洪·尼基季奇·斯特列什涅夫（1644?—1719）是俄国波雅尔，也是彼得大帝最信任的重臣之一。他与叔父罗季翁一同教导年幼的彼得。1682年彼得加冕后，他获得宫廷侍从官阶，1688年晋封波雅尔，1690年出任主管军务的任免衙门长官。1697年彼得率大使团出访西欧期间，他与罗莫达诺夫斯基王公共同主持国政。1709年他成为莫斯科第一任总督，1711年成为新设立的执政元老院首批元老之一，1718年在皇子阿列克谢的死刑判决书上签了名。他身材异常高大，后来因此流传他才是彼得生父的说法。

en: Ulyana (died c. 1365, or in 1374) was the second wife of Ivan I Kalita of Moscow, marrying him in 1332, a year after the death of his first wife Elena. In his 1340 will Ivan left her and her younger children fourteen volosts east and north of Moscow, over ten villages near the city and the revenue of its trade tax. She kept these lands for life, remained its senior princess, honoured by her stepsons, and outlived many of them. Her appanage was divided after her death between Kalita's grandsons Dmitry Donskoy and Vladimir of Serpukhov.
zh: 乌利扬娜（约1365年或1374年去世）是莫斯科王公伊凡一世·卡利塔的第二任妻子，1332年在第一任妻子叶莲娜去世一年后嫁与伊凡。伊凡在1340年的遗嘱中，把莫斯科以东、以北的十四个乡，以及城郊十余座村庄和莫斯科商业税收入留给她与年幼的子女。她终身保有这些领地，始终是家族中的长公主，受到继子们敬重，且比他们中许多人长寿。她死后，封邑被分给卡利塔的两个孙子——德米特里·顿斯科伊与谢尔普霍夫王公弗拉基米尔。

en: Yury Danilovich (1281–21 November 1325), eldest son of Daniel of Moscow, ruled Moscow from 1303 and contested Vladimir's grand princely throne with his uncle Mikhail of Tver, the Horde's appointee of 1304. After Tverite campaigns forced his submission, Yury went to the Horde, married Uzbeg Khan's sister Konchaka and secured the khan's favour. When she died in Tverite captivity he accused Mikhail of poisoning her, and the khan executed Mikhail in 1318, making Yury grand prince. In 1322 Mikhail's son Dmitry took the title and, at Sarai in 1325, slew him for withholding tribute.
zh: 尤里·丹尼洛维奇（1281—1325年11月21日）是莫斯科的丹尼尔的长子，1303年起任莫斯科王公，与叔父特维尔的米哈伊尔争夺弗拉基米尔大公之位，后者于1304年获金帐汗国汗王册封。特维尔两度用兵迫使他屈服后，尤里前往金帐汗国，娶月即别汗之妹康查卡为妻，赢得汗王欢心。康查卡在特维尔的囚禁中死去，尤里控告米哈伊尔毒杀其妻，汗王遂于1318年处死米哈伊尔，立尤里为弗拉基米尔大公。1322年，米哈伊尔之子德米特里夺得大公之位，并于1325年在萨莱以尤里截留贡赋为由将他杀死。

en: Bernard de Meslin was a Benedictine regular abbot of Notre-Dame de Mouzon in the Ardennes. He took charge of the Meuse-side abbey in 1348, in the plague year, and remained abbot until his death in 1354.
zh: 贝尔纳·德·梅兰是阿登省穆宗圣母院修道院的本笃会在院院长。他于瘟疫流行的1348年接掌这座默兹河畔修院，一直任职到1354年去世。

en: Frédéric III was a Benedictine regular abbot of Notre-Dame de Mouzon in the Ardennes. He succeeded Lambert d'Yvois at the Meuse-side abbey in 1345 and died in 1347.
zh: 弗雷德里克三世是阿登省穆宗圣母院修道院的本笃会在院院长。他于1345年继兰伯特·德伊瓦之后执掌这座默兹河畔的修院，1347年在任内去世。

en: Guy III was a Benedictine regular abbot of Notre-Dame de Mouzon in the Ardennes, and the third abbot of that name at the Meuse-side monastery. He succeeded Bernard de Meslin in 1354 and died after about a year, in 1355.
zh: 居伊三世是阿登省穆宗圣母院修道院的本笃会在院院长，也是这座默兹河畔修院第三位以此为名的院长。他于1354年继贝尔纳·德·梅兰就任，在任约一年后于1355年去世。

en: Jean III de Saint-Avit was a Benedictine regular abbot of Notre-Dame de Mouzon in the Ardennes. He took over the Meuse-side abbey in 1360 and held it for eighteen years until his death in 1378.
zh: 让三世·德·圣阿维是阿登省穆宗圣母院修道院的本笃会在院院长。他于1360年接掌这座默兹河畔修院，在任十八年，直至1378年去世。

en: Lambert d'Yvois was a Benedictine regular abbot of Notre-Dame de Mouzon, a monastery on the Meuse in the Ardennes, on the border between France and the Empire. He headed the abbey from 1332 until his death in 1345.
zh: 兰伯特·德伊瓦是穆宗圣母院修道院的本笃会在院院长；该修院位于阿登省默兹河畔，地处法兰西与神圣罗马帝国交界。他于1332年起执掌修院，1345年去世。

en: Pierre II Hazard was a Benedictine regular abbot of Notre-Dame de Mouzon in the Ardennes. He succeeded Frédéric III in 1347, the year before the Black Death reached northern France, and died in 1348.
zh: 皮埃尔二世·阿扎尔是阿登省穆宗圣母院修道院的本笃会在院院长。他于1347年继弗雷德里克三世就任，时值黑死病传入法国北部前夕，1348年去世。

en: Pierre III Hazard was a Benedictine regular abbot of Notre-Dame de Mouzon in the Ardennes, another abbot named Hazard after Pierre II. He succeeded Guy III in 1355 and ruled the Meuse-side abbey until his death in 1360.
zh: 皮埃尔三世·阿扎尔是阿登省穆宗圣母院修道院的本笃会在院院长，是继皮埃尔二世之后另一位名为阿扎尔的院长。他于1355年继居伊三世就任，执掌这座默兹河畔修院，直至1360年去世。

en: Pierre IV d'Essonne was a Benedictine regular abbot of Notre-Dame de Mouzon in the Ardennes. He succeeded Jean III de Saint-Avit in 1378 and headed the Meuse-side monastery for sixteen years, through the early reign of Charles VI, until his death in 1394.
zh: 皮埃尔四世·德埃松是阿登省穆宗圣母院修道院的本笃会在院院长。他于1378年继让三世·德·圣阿维就任，执掌这座默兹河畔修院十六年，历经查理六世统治初期，直至1394年去世。

en: John Randolph, 3rd Earl of Moray (1306 – 17 October 1346), was the second son of Thomas Randolph, Robert the Bruce's comrade, and inherited the earldom after his brother fell at Dupplin Moor in 1332. He commanded a division at Halidon Hill in 1333 and, after exile in France, served as joint Guardian of Scotland with Robert Stewart from 1334. In 1335 he defeated Edward III's Flemish mercenaries at Boroughmuir but was captured soon after and spent five years in English prisons. Exchanged in 1341, he fell while commanding the Scottish right wing at Neville's Cross on 17 October 1346.
zh: 约翰·兰道夫，第三代马里伯爵（1306—1346年10月17日），是罗伯特·布鲁斯的战友托马斯·兰道夫的次子，1332年兄长在杜普林沼泽战死后袭爵。1333年他在哈利登山战役中指挥一个师，战败后流亡法国；1334年回国，与罗伯特·斯图亚特共同出任苏格兰护国主。1335年，他在巴勒缪尔击败爱德华三世的佛兰德雇佣军，但旋即被俘，在英格兰的监狱中度过五年。1341年他通过交换获释，1346年10月17日在内维尔十字之战指挥苏格兰军右翼时阵亡。

en: Gebhard von Schrapelau (died 1340), a son of Burchard I of the Schraplau branch of the counts of Querfurt, was a canon from 1301, provost of Magdeburg Cathedral from 1314 and custodian of Hildesheim Cathedral before his election as bishop of Merseburg in 1320. He was bishop-elect from 1320 to 1323 and granted Vitzenburg Castle as a fief in 1323. He governed Merseburg until 1340. His constant feuds left the bishopric in disorder and debt for his successor, Heinrich V zu Stolberg, to repair.
zh: 格布哈德·冯·施拉普劳（？—1340）出身奎尔富特伯爵家族的施拉普劳支系，为布尔夏德·冯·施拉普劳之子。他1301年起任教士，1314年任马格德堡主教座堂教长，后任希尔德斯海姆主教座堂司库，1320年当选梅泽堡主教。1320至1323年他为当选主教，并于1323年将维岑堡城堡封作采邑。他统治梅泽堡至1340年，连年私战使主教区秩序混乱、负债累累，只能留给继任者亨利五世收拾。

en: Aldebert II of La Marche (died 1088), son of Bernard I and Amélie de Montignac, first appears as count on 16 June 1047. Early in his rule he burned Lesterps Abbey to flush out Jourdain de Chabanais sheltering there, then compensated the monks with his rights over the town's free men, confirmed by his daughter in 1098. Lay defender of Charroux Abbey, he long served Duke William VIII of Aquitaine and joined him at Philip I's coronation in Reims in 1059. By Ponce he fathered Boso III and Almodis I; the Chronicle of Saint-Maixent dates his death to 1088.
zh: 阿德尔贝尔二世·德·拉马什（？—1088）是贝尔纳一世与阿梅莉·德·蒙蒂尼亚克之子，1047年6月16日首次以伯爵身份出现。在位初年，他火烧莱斯特尔修道院，把躲在里面的仇敌茹尔丹·德·沙巴奈逼出，事后又把自己对当地自由民的权利赠予修道士作为补偿，其女于1098年确认了这一赠予。他身为沙鲁修道院的世俗保护者，长期追随阿基坦公爵威廉八世，1059年随公爵赴兰斯参加腓力一世的加冕礼。他与妻子庞斯生有博松三世和阿尔莫迪斯一世；据《圣迈克桑编年史》记载，他于1088年去世。

en: Almodis I of La Marche (c. 1062–by 1129), daughter of Aldebert II and Ponce, married Roger le Poitevin of Montgommery. After her brother Boso III died childless in 1091, her uncle Eudes I took the county, but on 12 December 1098 she issued her first charter as countess, confirming her father's gift to Lesterps Abbey. Roger, exiled from England in 1102 for supporting Robert Curthose, joined her. With the help of Count William V of Angoulême, she held Charroux against the threat of Hugh VII of Lusignan. With her sons Aldebert III and Boso IV she founded a Fontevrist priory at Châtain in 1115; she was dead by 1129.
zh: 阿尔莫迪斯一世·德·拉马什（约1062—1129年前）是阿德尔贝尔二世与庞斯之女，嫁给蒙哥马利家族的罗歇·勒普瓦特万。1091年兄弟博松三世无嗣而终，叔父厄德一世夺取伯国，但1098年12月12日，她以女伯爵身份发出第一份特许状，确认父亲对莱斯特尔修道院的赠予。罗歇因支持罗贝尔·柯索斯于1102年被逐出英格兰，此后到拉马什与她会合。她得到昂古莱姆伯爵威廉五世的帮助，守住了受到于格七世·德·吕西尼昂威胁的沙鲁。1115年，她与儿子阿德尔贝尔三世、博松四世在沙坦创建一座丰特夫罗派修道院；至迟1129年，文书已称她去世。

en: Bernard I of La Marche (c. 991–1047), son of Aldebert I, was passed over as a boy in favour of his uncle Boso II. Around 1008 Duke William V of Aquitaine detached La Marche from Périgord and invested Bernard, keeping control during his minority, when Abbot Peter of Le Dorat held the county and long refused to yield it. Bernard appears as count by 1023; by that year he had also feuded with Hugh IV of Lusignan over Civray, as told in the Latin narrative Conventum. He died before June 1047; by Amélie de Montignac he left the counts Aldebert II and Eudes I.
zh: 贝尔纳一世·德·拉马什（约991—1047）是伯爵阿德尔贝尔一世之子。父亲死后他未能继位，叔父博松二世取得伯国；约1008年，阿基坦公爵威廉五世把拉马什从佩里戈尔分出封给贝尔纳，并在他幼年时掌控实权，由勒多拉修道院院长皮埃尔执政，后者长期拒绝交出权力。1023年前，他已以伯爵身份签署文书；至迟在这一年，他也因锡夫雷与于格四世·德·吕西尼昂兵戎相见，此事见于一部拉丁文叙事《协约》。他于1047年6月前去世，与阿梅莉·德·蒙蒂尼亚克生有伯爵阿德尔贝尔二世和厄德一世。

en: Boso III of La Marche (died 1091), son of Aldebert II and Ponce, was count from 1088. In 1071, in his father's lifetime, he already bore the comital title in Duke William VIII of Aquitaine's following. He witnessed ducal charters and endowed Le Dorat Abbey. He was killed in 1091 while besieging Confolens, fighting either William V of Angoulême or Hugh of Lusignan, as historians differ. Married but childless, he was succeeded by his uncle Eudes I over his sister Almodis I's claims.
zh: 博松三世·德·拉马什（？—1091）是阿德尔贝尔二世与庞斯之子，1088年父亲死后成为拉马什伯爵。早在1071年父亲在世时，他便已带着伯爵头衔出现在阿基坦公爵威廉八世的随从中。在位期间，他在公爵文书上联署，并向勒多拉修道院施赠。1091年，他在围攻孔福朗时战死：现代史家对其敌手是谁说法不一，或认为是昂古莱姆伯爵威廉五世，或认为是吕西尼昂的于格。他虽已婚，却没有留下子嗣，叔父厄德一世力压其姐妹阿尔莫迪斯一世的继承权而继位。

en: Eudes I of La Marche (born c. 1028), younger son of Bernard I and Amélie de Montignac, gave property to Nouaillé Abbey with his brother Aldebert II by 1048, attended the Council of Bordeaux in 1080 and appears with his nephew Boso III in ducal acts. When Boso died childless at Confolens in 1091, Eudes took the county despite claims from his niece Almodis I, her husband Roger de Montgommery and Hugh VI of Lusignan; his undated charter confirms the succession against the Saint-Maixent chronicle. His last recorded acts appear to date no later than 1095, and by December 1098 Almodis had succeeded him.
zh: 厄德一世·德·拉马什（约1028年生）是贝尔纳一世与阿梅莉·德·蒙蒂尼亚克的幼子。继位之前许久，他至迟于1048年与兄长阿德尔贝尔二世共同向努瓦耶修道院赠产，1080年出席波尔多公会议，并在公爵文书中随侍侄子博松三世。1091年博松在孔福朗战死且无子嗣，厄德不顾侄女阿尔莫迪斯一世及其夫罗歇·德·蒙哥马利，以及于格六世·德·吕西尼昂的争夺而继任伯爵；他的一份未署年特许状证实了这次继位，推翻了《圣迈克桑编年史》的说法。记载他的最后几份文书似乎不晚于1095年，至1098年12月阿尔莫迪斯已继位。

en: Guy I of Lusignan (1269–1308), also called Guiard, was the younger son of Hugh XII of Lusignan and Jeanne de Fougères. His brother Hugh XIII disinherited him in 1297, but after Hugh died in 1303 Guy claimed La Marche and Angoulême against his nephew Renaud de Pons; King Philip IV backed him and the Parlement of Paris confirmed his counties in 1304. He fought for the king at Mons-en-Pévèle the same year, but in 1305 he made terms with the English at Saintes, ceding Cognac and Merpins in return for the office of seneschal of Saintonge. Accused before Philip in 1308 for paying homage to the English king, Guy died before trial. He died childless in November 1308, ending the senior male line of Lusignan.
zh: 居伊一世·德·吕西尼昂（1269—1308），又称吉亚尔，是于格十二世与让娜·德·富热尔的幼子。其兄于格十三世于1297年剥夺了他的继承权，但1303年于格去世后，居伊与外甥勒诺·德·蓬争夺拉马什和昂古莱姆；腓力四世国王支持他，巴黎高等法院于1304年确认了他的两个伯国。同年他在蒙桑佩韦勒为国王作战，但1305年在圣特与英格兰人达成协议，割让科尼亚克和梅尔潘，换取圣通日总管的职位。1308年，他因向英格兰国王宣誓效忠而被告至腓力面前，审判前便已去世。他于当年11月去世，无子嗣，吕西尼昂家族的长房男系就此断绝。

en: Hugh IX, called le Brun or the Brown (before 1151–1219), was a Poitevin lord of the house of Lusignan who followed Richard the Lionheart on the Third Crusade. He was with Richard in Sicily in 1190 and at the siege of Acre the following year, and visited the captive king at Speyer in 1194. In December 1199 he detained Eleanor of Aquitaine and in return secured the county of La Marche. When King John married Isabella of Angoulême, the bride promised to the Lusignans, Hugh's appeal to Philip Augustus helped bring the 1202 sentence against John's French fiefs. Reconciled in 1214, he fought beside John at La Roche-aux-Moines. He joined the Fifth Crusade and died at the siege of Damietta on 11 August 1219.
zh: 于格九世绰号“棕发”（1151年前—1219）是吕西尼昂家族的普瓦图贵族，曾随狮心王理查参加第三次十字军东征。1190年他随理查来到西西里，次年参加阿卡围城，1194年又到施派尔探望被囚禁的理查。1199年12月，他在阿基坦的埃莉诺途经时将其扣留，以此换得拉马什伯国。英王约翰娶走原本许配给吕西尼昂家族的昂古莱姆的伊莎贝拉后，于格向法王腓力二世·奥古斯都申诉，促成1202年宣判没收约翰在法兰西的领地。1214年双方和解，他随约翰参加罗什欧穆瓦讷之战。后来他加入第五次十字军东征，1219年8月11日死于杜姆亚特围城战。

en: Hugh X of Lusignan (c. 1182–1249) succeeded his father Hugh IX as count of La Marche in 1219. In 1220 he married Isabella of Angoulême, widow of John of England, becoming count of Angoulême and stepfather to Henry III. He used the conflict between Capetians and Plantagenets to strengthen his authority in Aquitaine, securing funds for castle building and religious patronage in exchange for his support. He wavered between the Capetian and Plantagenet courts until 1241, when he defied Louis IX and Alphonse of Poitiers and raised Poitou in revolt. The rising collapsed with the royal victory at Taillebourg in July 1242. In 1248 he joined Louis IX's Seventh Crusade and was killed outside Damietta on 5 June 1249, where his father had died in 1219.
zh: 吕西尼昂的于格十世（约1182—1249）于1219年继其父于格九世成为拉马什伯爵。1220年，他迎娶英格兰国王约翰的遗孀昂古莱姆的伊莎贝拉，借此成为昂古莱姆伯爵、英王亨利三世的继父。他利用卡佩与金雀花两朝的纷争加强自己在阿基坦的权势，以支持换取资金，兴建城堡并资助宗教事业。他在卡佩与金雀花两个朝廷之间摇摆，1241年公然对抗路易九世和普瓦捷的阿方斯，煽动普瓦图贵族反叛；1242年7月，叛乱随着王军在塔耶堡之战获胜而瓦解。1248年他随路易九世参加第七次十字军东征，1249年6月5日战死在杜姆亚特城外，他的父亲正是1219年在同一座城下丧生。

en: Hugh XI of Lusignan (c. 1221–1250), called the Brown, was the eldest son of Hugh X of Lusignan and Isabelle of Angoulême, former queen of England, making him a half-brother of Henry III. Betrothed to Joan of Toulouse in 1224 and Isabelle of France in 1227, he married neither; in 1236 he married Yolande, daughter of Peter I of Brittany. He inherited Angoulême from his mother in 1246 and La Marche from his father in 1249. That year he agreed to serve the count of Poitiers for a year on the Seventh Crusade. He joined Louis IX on the expedition and was killed on 6 April 1250 at the Battle of Fariskur in Egypt. His son Hugh XII succeeded him.
zh: 于格十一世·德·吕西尼昂（约1221—1250），绰号“棕发”，是于格十世与英格兰前王后昂古莱姆的伊莎贝尔的长子，也是英格兰国王亨利三世的同母异父兄弟。他于1224年与图卢兹的让娜、1227年与法兰西的伊莎贝尔订婚，但两桩婚约均告解除；1236年，他与布列塔尼公爵皮埃尔一世之女约兰德结婚。他于1246年继承母亲的昂古莱姆伯国，1249年又继承父亲的拉马什伯国。同年，他答应在第七次十字军东征中为普瓦捷伯爵效力一年。他随路易九世出征，1250年4月6日在埃及的法里斯库尔战役中阵亡，其子于格十二世继位。

en: Hugh XII of Lusignan (c. 1238–1270) succeeded his father Hugh XI, killed at Fariskur in 1250, as Count of La Marche and Angoulême, ruling at first under the regency of his mother Yolande of Brittany. On 29 January 1254 he married Jeanne, heiress of Fougères, who bore him six children including Hugh XIII and Guy I. He is the likeliest author behind the trouvère known only as the Conte de la Marche. In 1270 he joined Louis IX's Eighth Crusade and died in its early fighting at Tunis, whereupon Hugh XIII succeeded him.
zh: 于格十二世·德·吕西尼昂（约1238—1270）在父亲于格十一世于1250年法里斯库尔战死后，继承拉马什与昂古莱姆伯国，起初由母亲布列塔尼的约兰德摄政。1254年1月29日，他娶富热尔的女继承人让娜为妻，二人育有于格十三世、居伊一世等六名子女。他最可能是那位仅以“拉马什伯爵”之名传世的特罗维尔诗人。1270年，他随路易九世参加第八次十字军东征，在突尼斯的初期战事中死去，由于格十三世继位。

en: Hugh XIII of Lusignan (25 June 1259 – 1 November 1303) was the eldest son of Hugh XII and Jeanne de Fougères. A boy of eleven when his father died on crusade at Tunis in 1270, he inherited the counties of La Marche and Angoulême. At Pau on 1 July 1276 he married Beatrice of Burgundy, daughter of Duke Hugh IV of Burgundy, but the marriage was childless. When Hugh died at Cognac on 1 November 1303, his brother Guy I claimed the two counties, ending the direct line of his own branch.
zh: 于格十三世·德·吕西尼昂（1259年6月25日—1303年11月1日）是于格十二世与让娜·德·富热尔的长子。1270年父亲在突尼斯十字军军中死去时，他年仅十一岁，便继承了拉马什与昂古莱姆两个伯国。1276年7月1日，他在波城迎娶勃艮第公爵于格四世之女勃艮第的贝阿特丽丝，但婚姻没有子嗣。1303年11月1日他在科尼亚克去世后，其弟居伊一世取得两个伯国，他这一支的直系也就此断绝。

en: Yolande of Brittany (1218–1272), also called Yolande de Dreux, was the only daughter of Duchess Alix of Thouars and Peter I of Brittany. As a child she was thrice betrothed—to Henry III of England, John of France and Theobald IV of Champagne—but married none; in January 1236 she wed Hugh XI of Lusignan, bringing him the Breton counties of Penthièvre and Porhoët. When Hugh was killed at Fariskur in 1250, she ruled La Marche and Angoulême as regent for her son Hugh XII until 1256. She died on 10 October 1272 at Bouteville.
zh: 布列塔尼的约兰德（1218—1272），一称约兰德·德·德勒，是布列塔尼女公爵阿莉克斯·德·图阿尔与皮埃尔一世的独女。她幼年三度订婚，对象分别是英格兰国王亨利三世、法兰西王子让和香槟伯爵蒂博四世，却均未成婚；1236年1月，她嫁给于格十一世·德·吕西尼昂，并把布列塔尼的庞蒂耶夫尔和波尔奥埃两个伯国带给他。1250年于格在法里斯库尔阵亡后，她以摄政身份为儿子于格十二世掌管拉马什与昂古莱姆，直到1256年。1272年10月10日，她在布特维尔去世。

en: Davyd, or David, Yurievich (c. 1163–1228) became prince of Murom after his elder brother Vladimir died in 1205. A steady ally of Vsevolod the Big Nest of Vladimir, he joined the 1207 siege of Pronsk and briefly held that town in 1208 before being expelled. He supported Vsevolod's sons, marching on Rostov in 1213 and fighting at Lipitsa in 1216 for Grand Prince Yuri Vsevolodovich; in 1220 he sent his son Svyatoslav against the Volga Bulgars. He died on 2 April 1228. Some scholars identify him and his wife with the saints Peter and Fevronia of Murom.
zh: 达维德（又译大卫）·尤里耶维奇（约1163—1228）在兄长弗拉基米尔于1205年死后成为穆罗姆王公。他始终是弗拉基米尔大公弗谢沃洛德·大窝的忠实盟友：1207年参与对梁赞地区普龙斯克的围攻，1208年一度受领该城，但很快被当地王公驱逐。他支持弗谢沃洛德诸子争雄，1213年随军远征罗斯托夫，1216年在利皮察战役中为大公尤里·弗谢沃洛多维奇而战，1220年又派儿子斯维亚托斯拉夫出征伏尔加保加利亚。1228年4月2日他去世。部分学者认为他与妻子就是东正教圣徒穆罗姆的彼得与费夫罗尼娅。

en: Gleb Vladimirovich (baptized David, c. 987–1015), a son of Vladimir the Great, was prince of Murom from about 1013 and younger brother of Prince Boris of Rostov. After Vladimir's death in 1015 their half-brother Sviatopolk seized Kiev and had Boris murdered; he then summoned Gleb from Murom. Near Smolensk, Yaroslav the Wise sent warning of the plot, but Sviatopolk's men overtook Gleb and, on 9 September 1015, his own cook cut his throat on their leader's order. In 1019 Yaroslav buried him beside Boris in Vyshhorod. The Russian Church canonized the brothers as passion-bearers Saints Boris and Gleb.
zh: 格列布·弗拉基米罗维奇（教名大卫，约987—1015）是弗拉基米尔大帝之子，约1013年受封穆罗姆王公，罗斯托夫王公鲍里斯的弟弟。1015年父亲死后，异母兄斯维亚托波尔克占据基辅并杀害鲍里斯，随后召格列布从穆罗姆前来。行至斯摩棱斯克附近，智者雅罗斯拉夫派人报信示警，但斯维亚托波尔克的追兵还是赶上了他：1015年9月9日，他的厨师奉追兵首领之命割断了他的喉咙。1019年雅罗斯拉夫将他与鲍里斯合葬于维什哥罗德。俄罗斯教会将兄弟二人册封为受难圣徒，即圣鲍里斯与圣格列布。

en: Vasily Yaroslavich (died 1345) was a Rurikid prince of Murom. The chronicles mention him only once, at his death; he was buried at the Borisoglebsky Monastery near Murom and succeeded by Yuri Yaroslavich, possibly his younger brother.
zh: 瓦西里·雅罗斯拉维奇（？—1345年）是留里克王朝的穆罗姆王公。编年史只在记载他于1345年去世时提到过他一次，他葬于穆罗姆附近的鲍里斯格列布修道院，死后由尤里·雅罗斯拉维奇继立，后者可能是他的弟弟。

en: Vladimir Svyatoslavich (died 1161), son of Sviatoslav Yaroslavich, was prince of Murom in 1147–1149 and 1155–1161 and prince of Ryazan from 1153. He first appears in 1146 fighting for Sviatoslav Olgovich against Iziaslav Mstislavich, then fleeing his lands to Novgorod-Seversk. On 4 April 1147 he was among the princes whom Yuri Dolgorukiy received at Moscow, in the town's first chronicle mention, and that summer he marched on Mtsensk. In 1159 his Murom regiments joined Andrei Bogolyubsky's campaign for Chernigov and Kiev. At his death in 1161 his cousin Gleb Rostislavich took Ryazan.
zh: 弗拉基米尔·斯维亚托斯拉维奇（？—1161）是斯维亚托斯拉夫·雅罗斯拉维奇之子，1147—1149年及1155—1161年任穆罗姆王公，1153年起兼领梁赞。1146年他首次见于记载，助斯维亚托斯拉夫·奥利戈维奇对抗伊贾斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇，后弃地逃往诺夫哥罗德—谢韦尔斯克。1147年4月4日，他随诸王公在莫斯科受到尤里·多尔戈鲁基接待，此事正载于莫斯科首次见诸编年史的记录中；同年夏他出征姆岑斯克。1159年，他麾下的穆罗姆部队参加安德烈·博戈柳布斯基争夺切尔尼戈夫与基辅的远征。1161年他死后，堂兄格列布·罗斯季斯拉维奇占据梁赞。

en: Yaroslav (c. 1260–c. 1330) was the father of Vasily Yaroslavich (died 1345), prince of Murom; Vasily's successor Yuri Yaroslavich (died 1354) may have been his son too, or a son of Yaroslav of Pronsk.
zh: 雅罗斯拉夫（约1260—约1330）是穆罗姆王公瓦西里·雅罗斯拉维奇（1345年卒）的父亲；瓦西里的继任者尤里·雅罗斯拉维奇（1354年卒）也可能是他的儿子，或是普龙斯克的雅罗斯拉夫之子。

en: Yaroslav Svyatoslavich (baptized Pankraty, c. 1071–1129) was the youngest son of Grand Prince Sviatoslav II of Kiev and founder of the Murom-Ryazan line of the Rurikids. He first appears in 1096 fighting for his brother Oleg against Vladimir Monomakh; after defeat on the Koloksha he withdrew to Murom and made peace. At the 1097 Lyubech congress the Murom-Ryazan land was assigned to him. In 1103 the Mordvins routed him, and in 1123 he moved to rule Chernigov. His nephew Vsevolod Olgovich drove him out in 1127, and Kiev refused to restore him. He died in Murom in 1129.
zh: 雅罗斯拉夫·斯维亚托斯拉维奇（教名潘克拉季，约1071—1129）是基辅大公斯维亚托斯拉夫二世的幼子，留里克王朝穆罗姆—梁赞支系的始祖。1096年，他在罗斯东部的战争中协助兄长奥列格对抗弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫；在科洛克沙河战败后退守穆罗姆，与对方议和。1097年柳别奇王公大会将穆罗姆—梁赞之地分封给他。1103年他被莫尔多瓦人击败，1123年离开穆罗姆改镇切尔尼戈夫。1127年侄子弗谢沃洛德·奥利戈维奇将他驱逐，基辅方面也不肯为他复国。1129年他在穆罗姆去世。

en: Yaroslav Yurievich was prince of Murom from 1237, the only son of Yuri Davidovich, who may have fallen fighting Batu's Mongols on the Voronezh river. Almost nothing is recorded of his rule. In 1239 the Mongols overran the Mordvin lands and burned Murom, and his principality passes from the chronicles. In 1248 he is named once more, marrying his daughter Maria to Prince Boris Vasilkovich of Rostov; his wife, the Tver chronicle notes, was a sister of the wife of Yaroslav Vsevolodovich. After 1248 the Murom princes vanish from the sources for nearly a century, until 1345.
zh: 雅罗斯拉夫·尤里耶维奇自1237年起任穆罗姆王公，是尤里·达维多维奇的独子；其父可能在沃罗涅日河抗击拔都蒙古军时战死。关于他的统治，史籍几乎没有留下记载。1239年蒙古人攻灭莫尔多瓦诸部并焚毁穆罗姆，他的公国也随之从编年史中消失。1248年他的名字再次出现：将女儿玛丽亚嫁给罗斯托夫王公鲍里斯·瓦西里科维奇；《特维尔编年史》还记载，他的妻子是雅罗斯拉夫·弗谢沃洛多维奇之妻的姊妹。1248年之后，穆罗姆王公在史料中消失了近一个世纪，直到1345年才重新出现。

en: Yuri Davidovich (died c. 1237) became prince of Murom in 1228 after his elder brother Svyatoslav predeceased their father Davyd. He joined Grand Prince Yuri Vsevolodovich of Vladimir on campaigns against the Mordvins in 1229 and 1232. In autumn 1237, when Batu's Mongols reached the southern Ryazan borders, the Murom princes joined the Ryazan princes in battle on the Voronezh. Yuri most likely fell there, though sources never confirm it; the Tale of the Destruction of Ryazan misnames him Davyd Ingvarevich. His son Yaroslav succeeded to a Murom sacked the following winter.
zh: 尤里·达维多维奇（？—约1237）在兄长斯维亚托斯拉夫先于父亲达维德去世后，于1228年成为穆罗姆王公。1229年和1232年，他两度参加弗拉基米尔大公尤里·弗谢沃洛多维奇征讨莫尔多瓦人的远征。1237年秋，拔都的蒙古军逼近梁赞南境，穆罗姆王公与梁赞王公一同出兵，在沃罗涅日河迎战。尤里很可能战死于此役，但史料没有明言；《拔都毁灭梁赞记》还把他误称为达维德·因格瓦列维奇。他的儿子雅罗斯拉夫继位，而穆罗姆在次年冬天遭到劫掠。

en: Yuri Vladimirovich (c. 1140–1174) succeeded his father Vladimir Svyatoslavich as prince of Murom in 1161, while the senior Ryazan throne passed to Yuri's cousin once removed Gleb Rostislavich; Murom then stayed with Yuri's line. An ally of Andrei Bogolyubsky of Vladimir, he sent troops against the Volga Bulgars in 1164 and again in winter 1172, against Roman of Novgorod in late 1169, and against the Smolensk Rostislavichi in the Kievan land in 1173. He died on 19 January 1174 and was buried at the Saviour Church in Murom, which the chronicles say he had himself built.
zh: 尤里·弗拉基米罗维奇（约1140—1174）于1161年继父亲弗拉基米尔·斯维亚托斯拉维奇之后成为穆罗姆王公，他的堂叔格列布·罗斯季斯拉维奇则取得梁赞的长系王公之位，穆罗姆从此由尤里一脉单独承袭。他与弗拉基米尔王公关系密切：1164年和1172年冬两次派兵协助安德烈·博戈柳布斯基进攻伏尔加保加利亚，1169年底出兵攻打诺夫哥罗德的罗曼，1173年又在基辅地区作战，讨伐斯摩棱斯克的罗斯季斯拉维奇一系。1174年1月19日他去世，葬于穆罗姆的救主教堂；据编年史记载，这座教堂正是他本人主持修建的。

en: Yuri, or Georgy, Yaroslavich was prince of Murom from 1345 to 1354, succeeding Vasily. In 1351 he rebuilt long-deserted Murom: he set up his court there, boyars, merchants and townsfolk settled after him, and he restored the churches and furnished them with icons. In 1354 Fyodor Glebovich, backed by the Golden Horde, drove him out. The rivals pleaded their claims before the Horde's princes; Fyodor won, took Yuri into custody, and Yuri died in prison the same year. He is venerated as a local saint of Murom.
zh: 尤里（又名格奥尔基）·雅罗斯拉维奇是1345—1354年的穆罗姆王公，继瓦西里之后继位。1351年，他重建荒废已久的穆罗姆：在城中设立宫廷，贵族、商人和市民随之迁入定居，又整修教堂，为其配备圣像。1354年，得到金帐汗国支持的费奥多尔·格列波维奇将他驱逐。两位竞争者前往汗国，在汗国诸王公面前诉讼，费奥多尔胜诉，尤里被交给他关押，同年死于狱中。他被尊为穆罗姆的地方圣徒。

en: In the Salasilah, Guna Perana Tungga was the eighteenth Maharaja of the kingdom of Kutai Martapura. His daughter Perwati Dewi married Aji Batara Agung Paduka Nira, second king of Kutai Kartanegara, and his son Wijaya Warman succeeded as nineteenth Maharaja.
zh: 在古泰摩多补罗的传统王世系中，古纳·佩拉纳·通加是第十八代摩诃罗阇。他的女儿佩尔瓦蒂·德维嫁给古泰卡塔内加拉第二代国王阿吉·巴塔拉·阿贡·帕杜卡·尼拉，儿子维贾亚·瓦尔曼继他之后成为第十九代摩诃罗阇。

en: Wijaya Warman was, in the traditional king list of Kutai Martapura, the nineteenth Maharaja of the Hindu kingdom at Muara Kaman, succeeding his father Guna Perana Tungga. His sister married Aji Batara Agung Paduka Nira, second ruler of Kutai Kartanegara.
zh: 维贾亚·瓦尔曼是古泰摩多补罗传统王世系中的第十九代摩诃罗阇，在穆阿拉卡曼的印度教王国继父亲古纳·佩拉纳·通加之后在位。他的姊妹嫁给了古泰卡塔内加拉第二代统治者阿吉·巴塔拉·阿贡·帕杜卡·尼拉。

en: Dietrich III von Moers (born c. 1250) was count of Moers on the Lower Rhine, son of Count Dietrich II and Elisabeth von Altena-Isenberg. By his wife Margareta von Isenburg he fathered his successor Dietrich IV, and is last recorded alive in 1307.
zh: 迪特里希三世·冯·默尔斯（约1250年生）是莱茵河下游默尔斯伯国的伯爵，伯爵迪特里希二世与伊丽莎白·冯·阿尔特瑙-伊森堡之子。他与妻子玛格丽特·冯·伊森堡生有继承人迪特里希四世，1307年仍见于记载。

en: Dietrich IV von Moers (died 15 February 1346) was ruling count of the Lower Rhine county of Moers, succeeding his father Dietrich III in 1307. A 1306 charter names him as a knight settling a dispute among Moers' aldermen. Before 1314 he married Kunigunde von Volmestein, who bore his heir Friedrich II and, among other children, Dietrich V, later lord of Didam, and Hedwig, abbess of St. Klara in Neuss. He died in February 1346, and Friedrich II succeeded him.
zh: 迪特里希四世·冯·默尔斯（？—1346年2月15日）是莱茵河下游默尔斯伯国的在任伯爵，1307年继父亲迪特里希三世之后继位。1306年的一份特许状记载，他以骑士身份裁决了默尔斯陪审法官之间的纠纷。1314年之前，他与库妮贡德·冯·福尔默施泰因成婚，后者生下继承人弗里德里希二世，以及后来成为迪达姆领主的迪特里希五世和诺伊斯圣克拉拉修道院院长黑德维希等子女。他于1346年2月去世，由弗里德里希二世继位。

en: Friedrich von Moers was a younger son of Count Dietrich III of Moers and Margareta von Isenburg-Arenfels, and a brother of the ruling Count Dietrich IV. He died after 1341.
zh: 弗里德里希·冯·默尔斯是默尔斯伯爵迪特里希三世与玛加蕾特·冯·伊森堡-阿伦费尔斯之子，在任伯爵迪特里希四世的弟弟，卒于1341年以后。

en: Gaucher de Châtillon, called Gaucher de Nevers (c. 1221–1250), was the only son of Guy II, Count of Saint-Pol, and Agnès de Donzy, heiress of Nevers, Tonnerre and Auxerre. His mother died in 1225 and his father was killed at the siege of Avignon the following year; he and his sister Yolande were raised by their grandmother Mahaut de Courtenay. In 1236 he married Jeanne, daughter of Count Philip Hurepel of Clermont. He fought the English in La Marche in 1242 and joined Louis IX's Seventh Crusade in 1248. In Cyprus an epidemic claimed many crusaders, including his brother-in-law Archambaud IX of Bourbon. He was killed at Fariskur in Egypt after Mansurah, defending the approach to the village where the sick king had stopped. His sister inherited his counties.
zh: 戈谢·德·沙蒂永，人称“讷韦尔的戈谢”（约1221—1250），是圣波勒伯爵居伊二世与讷韦尔、托内尔、欧塞尔女继承人阿涅斯·德·栋济的独子。他的母亲于1225年去世，父亲次年死于阿维尼翁围城战；他与姐姐约兰德由外祖母玛奥·德·库特奈抚养。1236年，他娶克莱蒙伯爵菲利普·于雷佩尔之女让娜。1242年他在拉马什与英格兰人作战，1248年参加路易九世的第七次十字军东征。在塞浦路斯，瘟疫夺去了许多十字军战士的生命，包括他的姻兄弟波旁的阿尚博九世。曼苏拉之战后，他在埃及法里斯库尔保卫染病国王驻足的村庄入口时战死，他的姐姐继承了各伯国。

en: Jeanne de Clermont (1219–1252) was a French Capetian noblewoman, a granddaughter of King Philip II Augustus through his son Philip Hurepel, Count of Clermont, and Matilda of Dammartin, Countess of Boulogne. On her father's death in 1234 she inherited claims to Clermont and part of Mortain, and in 1236 she married Gaucher de Châtillon, heir to Nevers, Auxerre and Tonnerre. Gaucher died on the Seventh Crusade in Egypt in April 1250, and their marriage was childless. Jeanne died in January 1252, her estates reverting to the French royal domain.
zh: 让娜·德·克莱蒙（1219—1252）是法兰西卡佩王朝贵族，祖父为法王腓力二世·奥古斯都，父亲是克莱蒙伯爵菲利普·于尔佩尔，母亲是布洛涅女伯爵玛蒂尔德·德·达马尔坦。1234年父亲去世后，她成为克莱蒙伯国和莫尔坦伯国一部分的继承人；1236年嫁给讷韦尔、欧塞尔和托内尔的继承人戈谢·德·沙蒂永。戈谢参加第七次十字军东征，于1250年4月在埃及战死，两人没有子女。让娜于1252年1月去世，遗产收归法兰西王室领地。

en: Rao Asthan (died 15 April 1291) was the second Rathore Rao, ruling from his father Sheoji's death in 1273. He conquered Khed from the Guhila Rajputs, and his descendants took the name Khedecha Rathores. He killed Samaliya Koli of Idar and granted Idar to his younger brother Sonag, ancestor of the Idariya Rathores, while another brother, Aja, settled near Dwarka. When Jalaluddin Khalji's army attacked Pali in 1291, Asthan marched from Khed to meet it and died in the fighting. His son Doohad succeeded him.
zh: 拉奥·阿斯唐（1291年4月15日卒）是第二代拉托尔拉奥，1273年父亲谢奥吉死后继位。他从古希拉拉杰普特人手中夺取凯德，他的后裔由此被称为凯德查拉托尔人。他击杀伊达尔的萨马利亚·科利，把伊达尔封给弟弟索纳格，即伊达里雅拉托尔人的祖先；另一个弟弟阿贾则定居在德瓦尔卡附近。1291年贾拉勒丁·卡尔吉的军队进攻帕利，阿斯唐从凯德驰援，战死阵中，其子杜哈德继位。

en: Rao Chhada, also called Chhadaji, was a Rathore Rajput chief who ruled the Marwar lands from Khed from 1328 to 1344. The son of Rao Jalansi, he inherited the long frontier struggle of his line: he defeated the Sodha Rajputs and prevailed against the rulers of Jaisalmer, Nagaur and Jalore. Like nine of the fifteen early Rathore chiefs, he died in battle, falling in 1344 while fighting the Songara Chauhans. His son Rao Tida succeeded him and avenged his death by defeating the Songaras.
zh: 拉奥·恰达（又称恰达吉）是拉托尔族拉杰普特首领，1328—1344年以凯德为据点统治马尔瓦尔。他是拉奥·贾兰西之子，继承了家族长期的边境征战，击败索达拉杰普特人，并战胜贾沙梅尔、纳高尔和贾洛尔的统治者。他与早期十五位拉托尔首领中的九位一样战死沙场，于1344年在与松加拉·乔汉人作战时阵亡。其子拉奥·蒂达继位，后击败松加拉人，为父报仇。

en: Rao Doohad (died 1309) succeeded his father Asthan in 1291 as Rathore Rao, ruling from the towns of Pali and Khed. He is said to have added some 140 villages to his principality and to have built the Nagnechiya Mata temple at Nagana. Doohad once seized Mandore, the capital of the Parihar Rajputs, but the Parihars soon retook it; on his second attack he was killed in a skirmish between Thob and Tarsinghari in 1309. Of his seven sons, Raipal succeeded him.
zh: 拉奥·杜哈德（1309年卒）于1291年继父亲阿斯唐之位成为拉托尔拉奥，以帕利和凯德两镇为统治中心。相传他为领地攻取了约140个村庄，并在纳加纳修建了纳格内奇亚·玛塔神庙。他曾攻占帕里哈拉杰普特人的都城曼多尔，但很快被帕里哈拉人夺回；1309年他再度进攻，在索布与塔尔辛加里之间的一场遭遇战中被杀。他有七个儿子，罗伊波罗继位。

en: Rao Jalansi (died 1328), a younger son of Kanhapal, was Rathore Rao in Marwar. Later chronicles remember him for defeating the Sodha Rajputs and the ruler of Multan. He died fighting Turkic raiders in 1328 and was succeeded by his son Chhada.
zh: 拉奥·贾兰西（1328年卒）是卡纳帕尔较年幼的儿子之一，曾任马尔瓦尔的拉托尔拉奥。后世编年史记载，他击败了索达拉杰普特人和木尔坦的统治者。1328年他在与突厥袭掠者作战时身亡，其子查达继位。

en: Rao Kanhapal, also called Karanpal, was Rathore Rao after his father Raipal, ruling the clan's Pali and Khed lands from about 1313.
zh: 拉奥·卡纳帕尔（一称卡兰帕尔）在父亲罗伊波罗之后成为拉托尔拉奥，约1313年起统治家族在帕利和凯德的领地。

en: Rao Raipal ruled the Rathores of Pali and Khed from 1309 to 1313, succeeding his father Doohad. Later chronicles praise him for distributing grain to the poor during a famine, earning him the epithet Mahirelan, meaning like Indra. He was succeeded by his son Kanhapal.
zh: 拉奥·罗伊波罗1309年继父亲杜哈德之位，统治帕利和凯德的拉托尔人，直至1313年。后世编年史称他在饥荒中向贫民分发粮食，因此得到“摩诃伊兰”（意为如同因陀罗）的称号。其子卡纳帕尔继位。

en: Rao Sheoji, also called Siha, is named in Rathore chronicles as a grandson of Jayachandra, the last Gahadavala king of Kannauj, and is said to have led his kin west into Marwar after the dynasty fell to the Ghurids. Invited to Pali by Brahmins harassed by Mer and Meena raiders, he defeated the local chief Kanha Mer, founded the first Rathore polity at Pali around 1243 and took the title Rao. With his Chavda wife he fathered Asthan and Sonag, ancestors of the Khedecha and Idariya Rathores. The Bithoor inscription records his death in battle in 1273.
zh: 拉奥·谢奥吉（又称西哈），拉托尔家族编年史称他是卡瑙杰加哈达瓦拉王朝末代国王贾伊昌德之孙；相传加哈达瓦拉王朝为古尔人所灭后，他率族人西迁马尔瓦尔。帕利的婆罗门苦于梅尔德人与米那人的袭扰，将他请来；他击败当地首领坎哈·梅尔，约1243年在帕利建立拉托尔人的第一个政权，并采用“拉奥”称号。他与查夫达族妻子生有阿斯唐和索纳格，二人分别是凯德查与伊达里雅拉托尔人的祖先。比特尔铭文记载他于1273年战死。

en: Musunuri Prolaya Nayaka was a Telugu warrior chieftain and the founding ruler of the Musunuri Nayaka line. After the Delhi Sultanate overthrew the Kakatiya kingdom of Warangal in 1323 and led its king Prataparudra away captive, the ministers Annaya Mantri and Kolani Rudradeva rallied the scattered Telugu nayakas and chose Prolaya as their leader. His Vilasa grant of 1330, found in the Godavari delta, presents him as the ruler who restored order as in Prataparudra's days. On his death his cousin Kapaya Nayaka carried on the revolt and took Warangal in 1336.
zh: 穆苏努里·普罗拉亚·纳亚卡是泰卢固武将，穆苏努里·纳亚卡政权的开创者。1323年德里苏丹国攻灭瓦朗加尔的卡卡提亚王朝，国王普拉塔帕鲁德拉被掳走后，大臣安纳亚·曼特里与科拉尼·鲁德拉德瓦召集散落各地的泰卢固纳亚卡首领，推举普罗拉亚为领袖。1330年他在戈达瓦里河三角洲颁赐的维拉萨铭文，称他恢复了普拉塔帕鲁德拉时代的秩序。他死后，堂兄弟卡帕亚·纳亚卡继续抵抗，于1336年攻取瓦朗加尔。

en: Alagia Malaspina of Giovagallo was a daughter of Manfredo II Malaspina, Marquis of Giovagallo in Lunigiana. She married Moroello II Malaspina, Marquis of Mulazzo, and was the mother of his successor Antonio I, who died in 1407.
zh: 焦瓦加洛的阿拉贾·马拉斯皮纳是卢尼贾纳焦瓦加洛侯爵曼弗雷迪二世之女，嫁给穆拉佐侯爵莫罗埃洛二世，生子安东尼一世；安东尼后袭穆拉佐侯爵，1407年去世。

en: Angelica of Verona was the wife of Isnardo II Malaspina, Marquis of Verrucola in Lunigiana. She was the mother of Niccolò Malaspina, who succeeded his father as marquis and died in 1416.
zh: 维罗纳的安杰莉卡是卢尼贾纳韦鲁科拉侯爵伊斯纳尔多二世·马拉斯皮纳之妻，生下继承人尼科洛，尼科洛后袭侯爵，1416年去世。

en: Antonio I Malaspina was Marquis of Mulazzo in Lunigiana, the son of Moroello II Malaspina and Alagia Malaspina of Giovagallo. He died in 1407, and his son Azzone succeeded him as marquis of Mulazzo.
zh: 安东尼奥一世·马拉斯皮纳是卢尼贾纳的穆拉佐侯爵，莫罗埃洛二世·马拉斯皮纳与焦瓦加洛的阿拉贾·马拉斯皮纳之子。他于1407年去世，其子阿佐内继任穆拉佐侯爵。

en: Azzolino II Malaspina was the son of Gabriele Malaspina, marquis of Verrucola, and a younger brother of Spinetta Malaspina il Grande. He married Giovanna Cagnoli of Verona and fathered Gabriele, Galeotto and Guglielmo, who inherited Fosdinovo from their uncle Spinetta in 1352.
zh: 阿佐利诺二世·马拉斯皮纳是韦鲁科拉侯爵加布里埃尔之子，“伟大者”斯皮内塔的弟弟。他娶维罗纳的乔万娜·卡尼奥利，生子加布里埃尔、加莱奥托和古列尔莫；1352年，他们从伯父斯皮内塔手中继承了福斯迪诺沃领地。

en: Beatrice Visconti was a daughter of Matteo I Visconti, lord of Milan, and Bonacossa Borri. In 1310 she married the Lunigiana condottiero Spinetta Malaspina il Grande, lord of Fosdinovo and marquis of Verrucola. The marriage tied Spinetta to Milan's ruling house, and in 1314 Matteo made him podestà of the city. Her daughter Giovanna Novella married Ludovico I Gonzaga of Mantua in 1340; her other daughters were Ghidda and Elisabetta. Spinetta left no legitimate sons, so on his death in 1352 his nephews succeeded him.
zh: 贝亚特里切·维斯孔蒂是米兰领主马泰奥一世·维斯孔蒂与博纳科萨·博里之女。1310年，她嫁给卢尼贾纳的雇佣兵首领、福斯迪诺沃领主兼韦鲁科拉侯爵“伟大者”斯皮内塔·马拉斯皮纳。这场联姻使斯皮内塔攀上米兰统治家族，马泰奥于1314年任命他为米兰的波德斯塔，即首席长官。她的女儿乔凡娜·诺韦拉于1340年嫁给曼托瓦的卢多维科一世·贡扎加，另有女儿吉达和伊丽莎白。斯皮内塔没有嫡子，1352年去世后由侄子们继位。

en: Bernabò Malaspina was a nobleman of the Mulazzo branch of the Malaspina marquises of Lunigiana and a son of Moroello of Mulazzo. Moroello and Giovanni, founders of the Fabbrica and Ottone branches in the Trebbia valley, were sons of either Bernabò or Galeazzo of Mulazzo.
zh: 贝尔纳博·马拉斯皮纳是卢尼贾纳马拉斯皮纳家族穆拉佐支的贵族，穆拉佐的莫罗埃洛之子。特雷比亚河谷法布里卡与奥托尼两支的始祖莫罗埃洛和乔瓦尼，是贝尔纳博或穆拉佐的加莱亚佐之子。

en: Corrado Malaspina, called l'Antico (c. 1180–after 1254), was an Italian marquis, son of Obizzo II, and founder of the Malaspinas' Spino Secco branch. In 1198 he confirmed ceding the Grondola hills to Piacenza, then built a web of treaties with Genoa, Milan, Tortona and Modena. In 1220 Emperor Frederick II confirmed the rights and possessions of Corrado and his cousin Opizzo; the next year they made the first great division of the family lands. Corrado attended the imperial court and in 1226 escorted Frederick across the Apennines. In 1246 he briefly sided with Milan and Piacenza against the emperor before returning to his allegiance. A patron of Provençal troubadours, he is last documented in July 1254.
zh: 科拉多·马拉斯皮纳，绰号“老者”（约1180—1254年以后），是意大利侯爵、奥比佐二世之子，也是马拉斯皮纳家族“枯棘”支系的始祖。1198年，他确认将格龙多拉诸丘割让给皮亚琴察，随后与热那亚、米兰、托尔托纳和摩德纳缔结了一系列条约。1220年，皇帝腓特烈二世确认了他和堂兄弟奥比佐的领地与权利；次年，两人完成家族领地的第一次大分封。科拉多曾随侍皇帝宫廷，1226年护送腓特烈翻越亚平宁山脉。1246年，他短暂支持米兰和皮亚琴察反对皇帝，随后重新归附。他曾资助普罗旺斯行吟诗人，最后一次见于记载是1254年7月。

en: Cubitosa d'Este was a daughter of Azzo VII d'Este, lord of Ferrara, and his wife Giovanna di Puglia. She married Isnardo I Malaspina, marquis of Verrucola of the Spino Fiorito branch, and was the mother of Gabriele Malaspina, who succeeded to Verrucola.
zh: 库比托莎·德斯特是费拉拉领主阿佐七世·德斯特与其妻普利亚的乔万娜之女。她嫁给“花刺”支派的韦鲁科拉侯爵伊斯纳尔多一世·马拉斯皮纳，生子加布里埃莱·马拉斯皮纳，即后来的韦鲁科拉侯爵。

en: Federico I Malaspina was marquis of Villafranca in Lunigiana and of Virgoletta, a son of Corrado Malaspina il Vecchio, founder of the Malaspina family's Spino Secco branch. His sons were Corrado, known as il Giovane and praised by Dante in the Purgatorio, Tommaso and Opizzino. Federico died shortly before 1266, when the Malaspina estates were divided: his sons received the Lunigiana lands centered on Villafranca, estates in the Trebbia and Staffora valleys, and the family's Sardinian possessions. He founded the Villafranca line.
zh: 费代里科一世·马拉斯皮纳是卢尼贾纳的维拉弗兰卡和维尔戈莱塔侯爵，为马拉斯皮纳家族“干刺”支始祖科拉多·“老者”·马拉斯皮纳之子。他的儿子有被但丁在《炼狱篇》中称颂的“青年”科拉多，以及托马索和奥比齐诺。费代里科于1266年前不久去世，同年马拉斯皮纳家族分割产业：他的儿子们分得以维拉弗兰卡为首府的卢尼贾纳领地、特雷比亚河谷与斯塔福拉河谷的产业，以及家族在撒丁岛的领地。他是维拉弗兰卡支的始祖。

en: Franceschino Malaspina was marquis of Mulazzo in Lunigiana, the son of Moroello Malaspina and Berlanda Grimaldi. He took part in the wars of Guelfs and Ghibellines, campaigning against the archbishop of Luni in 1298, and several times hosted the exiled Dante Alighieri at Mulazzo. On 6 October 1306, at Sarzana, he gave Dante his general mandate to negotiate for the whole Ghibelline branch of the family; the poet concluded the Peace of Castelnuovo with the bishop of Luni that same morning. Franceschino died in 1319 and was succeeded by his son Moroello II.
zh: 弗兰切斯基诺·马拉斯皮纳是卢尼贾纳穆拉佐的侯爵，莫罗埃洛·马拉斯皮纳与贝尔兰达·格里马尔迪之子。他卷入圭尔夫派与吉伯林派的战争，1298年参加了讨伐卢尼大主教的战事，并在穆拉佐多次接待流亡中的但丁·阿利吉耶里。1306年10月6日，他在萨尔扎纳授予但丁全权委托，代表整个吉伯林派的马拉斯皮纳家族谈判；诗人当天上午便与卢尼主教订立了《卡斯特尔诺沃和约》。弗兰切斯基诺于1319年去世，其子莫罗埃洛二世继立。

en: Gabriele Malaspina was marquis of Verrucola near Fivizzano in Lunigiana, from the Malaspina family's Spino Fiorito branch. The son of Isnardo I Malaspina and Cubitosa d'Este, daughter of Azzo VII of Ferrara, he was invested in 1269 by the bishop of Luni, together with his uncle Alberto and his cousins, with Verrucola, Fivizzano, Olivola, Massa, Monzone and Fosdinovo. He died in 1289 and was succeeded by his son Spinetta, later called il Grande, the future lord of Fosdinovo.
zh: 加布里埃尔·马拉斯皮纳是卢尼贾纳菲维扎诺附近韦鲁科拉的侯爵，出身马拉斯皮纳家族“花刺”支，为伊萨尔诺一世·马拉斯皮纳与费拉拉阿佐七世之女库比托萨·德埃斯特之子。1269年，卢尼主教将韦鲁科拉、菲维扎诺、奥利沃拉、马萨、蒙佐内和福斯迪诺沃封赐给他、他的叔父阿尔贝托及众堂兄弟。他于1289年去世，其子斯皮内塔继立，即后来被称为“伟大者”的福斯迪诺沃领主。

en: Gabriele Malaspina (c. 1311–1359) was the eldest son of Azzolino II Malaspina and Giovanna Cagnoli of Verona, and a nephew of Spinetta the Great. When his uncle died without legitimate heirs in 1352, Gabriele and his brothers Galeotto and Guglielmo inherited Fosdinovo, Marciaso, Comano and the Terre dei Bianchi. In 1355 Emperor Charles IV raised Fosdinovo to a marquisate and invested the three brothers as marquises. A cleric, Gabriele became bishop of Luni. He died in 1359, and his share of the lands passed to his two brothers.
zh: 加布里埃莱·马拉斯皮纳（约1311—1359）是阿佐利诺二世·马拉斯皮纳与维罗纳的乔万娜·卡尼奥利的长子，也是“伟大者”斯皮内塔的侄子。1352年叔伯斯皮内塔无合法子嗣而终，加布里埃莱与弟弟加莱奥托、古列尔莫继承了福斯迪诺沃、马尔恰索、科马诺和比安基之地。1355年，皇帝查理四世将福斯迪诺沃升格为侯爵领地，册封三兄弟为侯爵。加布里埃莱是教士，曾任卢尼主教，1359年去世，他那份领地由两个弟弟瓜分。

en: Galeotto I Malaspina (died 15 March 1367) was a son of Azzolino II Malaspina and Giovanna Cagnoli of Verona, and nephew of Spinetta the Great.
