In 1352 he and his brothers Gabriele and Guglielmo inherited their uncle's lordship of Fosdinovo, and in 1355 Emperor Charles IV, on his way to Rome, raised Fosdinovo to a marquisate and invested the three as marquises. After Gabriele, the bishop of Luni, died in 1359, the two surviving brothers divided the lands. Galeotto received Fosdinovo itself, and from 1361 he ruled it unchallenged, which is why he counts as the first marquis of Fosdinovo. He had served as a judge in Verona and was a knight. He died at Fosdinovo in 1367 and was buried in the church of San Remigio, in a tomb monument built right after his death.
zh: 加莱奥托一世·马拉斯皮纳（1367年3月15日卒）是阿佐利诺二世·马拉斯皮纳与维罗纳的乔万娜·卡尼奥利之子，“伟大者”斯皮内塔的侄子。1352年，他与兄长加布里埃莱、弟弟古列尔莫继承了叔伯斯皮内塔的福斯迪诺沃领主权；1355年，皇帝查理四世前往罗马途中，将福斯迪诺沃升格为侯爵领地，册封三兄弟为侯爵。卢尼主教加布里埃莱于1359年去世后，两位在世的兄弟瓜分领地。福斯迪诺沃本土归加莱奥托，自1361年起由他独掌，因此被视为福斯迪诺沃的第一代侯爵。他曾在维罗纳担任法官，受封骑士。1367年他在福斯迪诺沃去世，葬于圣雷米焦教堂，墓碑纪念物在他身后随即建成。

en: Giovanna Cagnoli was the wife of Azzolino II Malaspina of Fosdinovo, younger brother of Spinetta the Great. Her sons Gabriele, Galeotto and Guglielmo inherited Fosdinovo from their uncle in 1352, and in 1355 Emperor Charles IV made them its first marquises.
zh: 乔万娜·卡尼奥利嫁给阿佐利诺二世·马拉斯皮纳，即‘伟大者’斯皮内塔之弟。其子加布里埃莱、加莱奥托、古列尔莫1352年继承叔父的福斯迪诺沃，1355年查理四世将他们册封为首批侯爵。

en: Guglielmo I Malaspina was a Lombard marquis, son of Moroello I Malaspina and a lady of the Roman Frangipane family. In 1200 he allied with Milan and Piacenza in their war against Parma and Pavia. Like his uncle Alberto, he kept his court open to troubadours, and Peire Raimon de Tolosa and Aimeric de Peguilhan sang his liberality; when he died in 1220 Aimeric composed a planh, or lament, in his memory. His son Opizzino succeeded him.
zh: 古列尔莫一世·马拉斯皮纳是伦巴第侯爵，莫雷洛一世·马拉斯皮纳与罗马弗兰吉帕尼家族一女子之子。1200年，他与米兰、皮亚琴察结盟，共同对帕尔马和帕维亚作战。和叔父阿尔贝托一样，他的宫廷向游吟诗人敞开，佩尔·雷蒙·德·图卢兹和艾梅里克·德·佩吉扬都曾歌咏他的慷慨；1220年他去世时，艾梅里克为他作了一首悼亡歌。其子奥皮齐诺继嗣。

en: Guglielmo Malaspina was a son of Azzolino II Malaspina and Giovanna Cagnoli of Verona, and a nephew of Spinetta Malaspina il Grande, lord of Fosdinovo. When Spinetta died in 1352 without legitimate heirs, Guglielmo and his brothers Gabriele and Galeotto succeeded as lords of Fosdinovo, Marciaso, Comano and the Terre dei Bianchi. In 1355 Emperor Charles IV raised their fief to a marquisate. After Gabriele, bishop of Luni, died in 1359, the surviving brothers divided the lands in 1361, Galeotto taking Fosdinovo. Guglielmo died in 1368, leaving a daughter named Taddea.
zh: 古列尔莫·马拉斯皮纳是阿佐利诺二世·马拉斯皮纳与维罗纳的乔凡娜·卡尼奥利之子，也是福斯迪诺沃领主“伟大者”斯皮内塔·马拉斯皮纳的侄子。斯皮内塔于1352年去世且无嫡嗣，古列尔莫与兄弟加布里埃莱、加莱奥托共同继领福斯迪诺沃、马尔恰索、科马诺和比安基诸地。1355年，皇帝查理四世将他们的领地升为侯国。1359年卢尼主教加布里埃莱去世后，余下两兄弟于1361年瓜分领地，加莱奥托取得福斯迪诺沃。古列尔莫于1368年去世，遗有一女塔代亚。

en: Isnardo I Malaspina was a marquis of Verrucola in Lunigiana, one of the sons of Opizzo Malaspina, who founded the Spino Fiorito branch of the family when the Malaspina lands were divided in 1221. Isnardo married Cubitosa d'Este, daughter of Azzo VII d'Este, lord of Ferrara, and with his brother Bernabò received the castle of Marciaso near Fosdinovo. In 1269 the bishop of Luni invested his son Gabriele with Verrucola, Fivizzano and Fosdinovo. Isnardo died in June 1275 and Gabriele succeeded him.
zh: 伊萨尔诺一世·马拉斯皮纳是卢尼贾纳韦鲁科拉的侯爵，为奥比佐·马拉斯皮纳之子；1221年马拉斯皮纳家族领地分割，奥比佐开创“花刺”支。伊萨尔诺娶费拉拉领主阿佐七世·德埃斯特之女库比托萨·德埃斯特，并与兄弟贝尔纳博一同受封福斯迪诺沃附近的马尔恰索城堡。1269年，卢尼主教将韦鲁科拉、菲维扎诺和福斯迪诺沃封给他的儿子加布里埃尔。伊萨尔诺于1275年6月去世，加布里埃尔继立。

en: Isnardo II Malaspina was Marquis of Verrucola in Lunigiana, a son of Gabriele Malaspina and brother of Spinetta the Great. He married Angelica of Verona and was succeeded as marquis by their son Niccolò, who died in 1416.
zh: 伊斯纳尔多二世·马拉斯皮纳是卢尼贾纳的韦鲁科拉侯爵，加布里埃莱·马拉斯皮纳之子，‘伟大者’斯皮内塔的兄弟。他娶维罗纳的安杰莉卡，继承人是其子尼科洛，尼科洛卒于1416年。

en: Margherita Malaspina was a daughter of Moroello II Malaspina, Marquis of Mulazzo, and his wife Alagia of Giovagallo. She married Obizzo Malaspina of the Lusuolo branch of the family, who died in 1368.
zh: 玛格丽塔·马拉斯皮纳是穆拉佐侯爵莫罗埃洛二世·马拉斯皮纳与妻子焦瓦加洛的阿拉贾之女，嫁给家族卢苏奥洛支系的奥比佐·马拉斯皮纳，后者于1368年去世。

en: Moroello II Malaspina was Marquis of Mulazzo in Lunigiana, succeeding his father Franceschino I. He married Alagia, daughter of Manfredo II Malaspina of Giovagallo, and on his death in 1365 was succeeded by their son Antonio I, who held the marquisate until 1407.
zh: 莫罗埃洛二世·马拉斯皮纳是卢尼贾纳的穆拉佐侯爵，继其父弗兰切斯基诺一世之位。他娶焦瓦加洛的曼弗雷迪二世之女阿拉贾，1365年去世，子安东尼一世继位，统治穆拉佐至1407年。

en: Moroello I Malaspina (died 1199) was a Lombard marquis, younger son of Obizzo I Malaspina and brother of Obizzo II, called Obizzone. His son Guglielmo and grandson Opizzino became the heads of the Spino Fiorito branch.
zh: 莫雷洛一世·马拉斯皮纳（1199年卒）是伦巴第侯爵，奥比佐一世·马拉斯皮纳的幼子、奥比佐二世（人称奥比佐内）之弟。他的儿子古列尔莫和孙子奥皮齐诺后来成为“花刺”支派的首领。

en: Moroello I Malaspina was marquis of Mulazzo in Lunigiana, a son of Corrado Malaspina il Vecchio, founder of the Malaspina family's Spino Secco branch. He married Berlanda Grimaldi and fathered Franceschino Malaspina, later marquis of Mulazzo. He died in 1284.
zh: 莫罗埃洛一世·马拉斯皮纳是卢尼贾纳穆拉佐的侯爵，系马拉斯皮纳家族“干刺”支始祖科拉多·“老者”·马拉斯皮纳之子。他娶贝尔兰达·格里马尔迪，生子后来的穆拉佐侯爵弗兰切斯基诺，于1284年去世。

en: Obizzo I Malaspina, called the Great, was a Lombard nobleman, the son of Adalberto Malaspina. In 1154 he fought at the siege of Tortona against Emperor Frederick Barbarossa, yet in 1164 he joined the emperor and rescued him from the men of Pontremoli. In later years he supported the Lombard League against imperial power, and in 1172, with Pisan backing, he raised a fierce revolt against Genoa. He married Maria Bianco di Vezzano, who gave him three sons; the Fosdinovo line of the Malaspina, including Spinetta the Great, descended from him.
zh: 奥比佐一世·马拉斯皮纳，绰号“伟大者”，是伦巴第贵族，阿达尔贝托·马拉斯皮纳之子。1154年，他参加围攻托尔托纳，与皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨为敌；但1164年他转与皇帝结盟，把皇帝从蓬特雷莫利人手中救出。晚年他支持伦巴第联盟对抗皇权，1172年又在比萨支持下起兵猛烈反抗热那亚。他娶韦扎诺的玛丽亚·比安科，生有三子，福斯迪诺沃的马拉斯皮纳支系——包括“伟大者”斯皮内塔——即为其后裔。

en: Obizzo II Malaspina, called Obizzone, was a Lombard marquis and the elder son of Obizzo I Malaspina and Maria Bianco di Vezzano. In 1184 he and his father promised the commune of Piacenza the castle of Oramala, and in 1185 he sat as imperial judge at Lucca. In 1187 the abbot of San Colombano at Bobbio enfeoffed him and his brothers with Carana, and in 1189 he joined in selling the Val d'Enza and Val di Taro to Piacenza. He died in 1193, and his son Corrado il Vecchio led the Spino Secco branch.
zh: 奥比佐二世·马拉斯皮纳，人称奥比佐内，是伦巴第侯爵，奥比佐一世·马拉斯皮纳与玛丽亚·比安科·迪·韦扎诺的长子。1184年，他与父亲向皮亚琴察城邦许诺交出奥拉马拉城堡；1185年，他在卢卡担任帝国法官。1187年，博比奥的圣科隆巴诺修道院院长将卡拉纳封授给他与诸弟；1189年，他参与把恩扎河谷和塔罗河谷卖给皮亚琴察。他于1193年去世，其子科拉多·伊尔韦基奥后来统领“枯刺”支派。

en: Opizzino Malaspina, also recorded as Obizzo I, was marquis of Villafranca in Lunigiana, a son of Federico I and brother of Corrado il Giovane and Tommaso. In the family partition of 1266 the three brothers received the Lunigiana estates centered on Villafranca, lands in the Trebbia and Staffora valleys and a share of the Malaspina possessions in Sardinia, and in 1281 their uncle Alberto ceded them another third of his Sardinian lands. In 1296 Opizzino and Tommaso agreed with their cousin Moroello of Giovagallo to be mutual heirs of their Sardinian estates. He died in 1301.
zh: 奥比齐诺·马拉斯皮纳（又记作奥比佐一世）是卢尼贾纳维拉弗兰卡的侯爵，费代里科一世之子，“青年”科拉多与托马索的兄弟。1266年家族分割产业时，三兄弟分得以维拉弗兰卡为首府的卢尼贾纳领地、特雷比亚河谷与斯塔福拉河谷的土地，以及马拉斯皮纳家族在撒丁岛产业的一份；1281年，叔父阿尔贝托又将自己撒丁岛领地的三分之一让给他们。1296年，奥比齐诺与托马索和堂兄乔瓦加洛的莫罗埃洛约定互为撒丁岛产业的继承人。他于1301年去世。

en: Opizzo Malaspina, called Opizzino, was a Lombard marquis and the son of Guglielmo I Malaspina. He first appears in 1212, swearing accords with Milan and Piacenza, and succeeded his father in 1220. In 1221 he and Corrado il Vecchio divided the great Malaspina inheritance: Opizzino took the Lunigiana lands east of the Magra, with Filattiera, and became the forefather of the Spino Fiorito branch. He served Emperor Frederick II, who stayed at Oramala in 1238, but from 1246 sided with Milan and Piacenza against him. He died in 1249 or 1254, leaving sons including Isnardo.
zh: 奥皮佐·马拉斯皮纳，人称奥皮齐诺，伦巴第侯爵，古列尔莫一世·马拉斯皮纳之子。1212年他首次见于记载，与米兰、皮亚琴察宣誓缔约，并于1220年继承父位。1221年，他与科拉多·伊尔韦基奥瓜分马拉斯皮纳家族的庞大家业：奥皮齐诺分得卢尼贾纳境内马格拉河以东、以菲拉蒂耶拉为中心的领地，成为“花刺”支派的始祖。他曾效力于皇帝腓特烈二世，皇帝1238年驻跸奥拉马拉；但1246年起他转而联合米兰和皮亚琴察对抗皇帝。他于1249或1254年去世，诸子中有伊斯纳尔多。

en: Spinetta Malaspina, called the Great (1282–1352), was the son of Gabriele Malaspina of Verrucola and founder of the Malaspina lords of Fosdinovo. A friend of Uguccione della Faggiola and Cangrande della Scala, in 1311 Emperor Henry VII made him imperial vicar of Reggio, and in 1314 his father-in-law Matteo Visconti named him podestà of Milan. In 1317 Castruccio Castracani seized Fosdinovo and other Lunigiana fiefs and drove him to Verona, where he served the Scaligeri for years; with Cangrande's troops he recovered his lands in 1320, and the struggle ran on until Castruccio died in 1328. In 1340 he bought out the local nobles and became undisputed lord of Fosdinovo, where he enlarged the castle. He died in 1352 without legitimate heirs, passing his state to his nephews Gabriele, Galeotto and Guglielmo. His heirs raised him a cenotaph in Verona, but his own tomb was never found.
zh: 斯皮内塔·马拉斯皮纳，绰号“伟大者”（1282—1352），是韦鲁科拉的加布里埃莱·马拉斯皮纳之子，也是福斯迪诺沃马拉斯皮纳统治者的开创者。他是乌古乔内·德拉·法焦拉和坎格兰德·德拉·斯卡拉的朋友，1311年，皇帝亨利七世任命他为雷焦的帝国代理官；1314年，岳父马泰奥·维斯孔蒂任命他为米兰的最高行政长官。1317年，卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼夺取福斯迪诺沃等卢尼贾纳领地，把他赶到维罗纳，他在那里为斯卡拉家族效力多年；1320年借坎格兰德的军队收复领地，双方的争斗持续到卡斯特拉卡尼于1328年去世。1340年，他买下当地贵族的权利，成为福斯迪诺沃无可争议的领主，并扩建了城堡。1352年他去世时没有合法继承人，领地传给侄子加布里埃莱、加莱奥托和古列尔莫。后人在维罗纳为他立了一座衣冠冢，但他自己的墓地始终没有找到。

en: Mikhail Rostislavich (died 1279) was a Rurikid prince of the Smolensk branch of the dynasty, a younger son of Rostislav Mstislavich, prince of Smolensk. From 1260 he ruled the appanage principality of Mstislavl, and in 1278, after the death of his elder brother Gleb, he succeeded as grand prince of Smolensk. He reigned there for only about a year and died in 1279. His sons were Andrei of Vyazma, Fyodor and Konstantin. After his death his brother Fyodor had the foremost claim to Smolensk, but during Fyodor's long absence their nephew Alexander Glebovich controlled it. In 1297 Alexander proclaimed himself prince and openly fought his uncle.
zh: 米哈伊尔·罗斯季斯拉维奇（?—1279）是留里克王朝斯摩棱斯克支的王公，斯摩棱斯克王公罗斯季斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇较年幼的儿子之一。他自1260年起领有封邑姆斯季斯拉夫尔公国，1278年其兄格列布死后继位为斯摩棱斯克大公，在位仅约一年，于1279年去世。他的儿子有维亚济马王公安德烈、费奥多尔和康斯坦丁。他死后，其兄弟费奥多尔拥有斯摩棱斯克的优先继承权，但由于费奥多尔长期缺席，他们的侄子亚历山大·格列波维奇实际控制了当地。1297年，亚历山大自称王公，公开与叔父争斗。

en: Roman Glebovich (died after 1301) was a Rurikid prince of the Smolensk line, the younger son of Gleb Rostislavich, prince of Smolensk. From 1281 he held the appanage principality of Mstislavl. Historian Leontiy Voytovych held that Roman was prince of Novgorod until 1293, although a chronicle names Dmitry Alexandrovich as prince from 1284. In 1293 Roman led Novgorodians against a fortress the Swedes had built in Karelian land, but a thaw and lack of fodder for the horses forced a retreat. In 1300 he and his elder brother Alexander of Smolensk besieged Dorogobuzh, where their cousin Andrei Mikhailovich of Vyazma defeated them. He is last mentioned alive after 1301. His son Dmitry later held Bryansk.
zh: 罗曼·格列博维奇（1301年后去世）是留里克王朝斯摩棱斯克支的王公，斯摩棱斯克王公格列布·罗斯季斯拉维奇的幼子。他自1281年起领有姆斯季斯拉夫尔公国。历史学家列昂季·沃伊托维奇认为他在1293年以前还担任诺夫哥罗德王公，但一部编年史记载德米特里·亚历山德罗维奇自1284年起担任该职。1293年，罗曼率诺夫哥罗德人攻打瑞典人在卡累利阿土地上修建的一座堡垒，因解冻和缺少马料被迫退兵。1300年，他与兄长斯摩棱斯克的亚历山大围攻多罗戈布日，被堂兄维亚济马的安德烈·米哈伊洛维奇击败。1301年后的记载中最后一次提到他。其子德米特里后来据有布良斯克。

en: Bonleone Mulucci was a member of the Guelph Mulucci family of Macerata, whose ruling branch in the early fourteenth century bore his name. His sons were Fredo, who shared rule of Macerata with Muluccio II, and Pietro, bishop there from 1323.
zh: 邦莱奥内·穆卢奇是马切拉塔归尔夫派穆卢奇家族成员，14世纪初该家族的统治支派以他命名。其子有与穆卢乔二世共同执掌马切拉塔的弗雷多，以及1323年起任当地主教的彼得。

en: Fredo Mulucci was the leading man of the Guelph Mulucci house that dominated Macerata from about 1325. The city had become a bishopric in 1320 and the seat of the papal rector of the March, and the popes backed the Mulucci to keep it obedient. Fredo ruled with his uncle Muluccio II, and his brother Pietro became bishop there in 1323. In 1328 he joined the papal army's siege of Senigallia. A popular rising drove the family out in February 1335; they returned the next year with papal support. In August 1340 the guilds overthrew the signoria, and Fredo had to cede his rights over Casale to the commune. In March 1353, allied with the Malatesta, he appeared among the witnesses of the Peace of Sarzana between Florence and the Visconti, which let Macerata's exiles return.
zh: 弗雷多·穆卢奇是约自1325年起主宰马切拉塔的圭尔夫派穆卢奇家族的头面人物。该城1320年升为教区，又是教廷边区总督的驻地，教宗扶持穆卢奇家族，以保证城市顺服。弗雷多与叔父穆卢乔二世共掌权柄，兄弟彼得罗于1323年出任该城主教。1328年，他参加教廷军队围攻塞尼加利亚。1335年2月民众起事将家族逐出，次年他们靠教廷支持返城。1340年8月行会推翻领主政权，弗雷多被迫把对卡萨莱的权利让给市镇。1353年3月，他已与马拉泰斯塔家族结盟，名列佛罗伦萨与维斯孔蒂家族《萨尔扎纳和约》的见证人，和约允许马切拉塔的流亡者返回。

en: Guarnaccia Mulucci was a son of Bonleone of the Guelph Mulucci family, which had risen to dominate Macerata in the later thirteenth century on the strength of its lands and its loyalty to the pope. Early in the fourteenth century the family split into two branches: Bonleone's, whose arms showed a rampant lion with five lilies, and that of Guarnaccia's uncle Muluccio II. In 1306 Guarnaccia and Muluccio attended a settlement between Camerino and the communes of Matelica, San Severino and Fabriano, concluded in Macerata's communal palace under papal authority. That same year he was among the guarantors for Macerata at the Church's provincial parliament at Montolmo. The family's offices usually lay within the Marches, but in 1309–1310 Guarnaccia served farther afield as captain of the people at Siena.
zh: 瓜尔纳恰·穆卢奇是圭尔夫派穆卢奇家族成员博恩莱奥内之子。该家族凭土地财富和对教宗的忠诚，在13世纪后半叶成为马切拉塔的主导者。14世纪初，家族分成两支：一支是博恩莱奥内这一系，纹章为一头持五朵百合花的直立狮子；另一支由瓜尔纳恰的叔父穆卢乔二世领头。1306年，瓜尔纳恰与穆卢乔在马切拉塔市政宫出席卡梅里诺与马泰利卡、圣塞韦里诺和法布里亚诺诸市镇在教廷主持下达成的和解。同年，他在蒙特尔莫举行的教会省级议会上担任马切拉塔市镇的担保人之一。家族所任公职通常位于马尔凯境内，但1309—1310年瓜尔纳恰远赴锡耶纳担任人民队长。

en: Leone Mulucci of Macerata was a son of Muluccio II; in 1345 he and his brother Vanni sold their houses near the church of San Giovanni.
zh: 马切拉塔的莱奥内·穆卢奇是穆卢乔二世之子；1345年，他与兄弟瓦尼出售了他们在圣乔瓦尼教堂附近的房屋。

en: Muluccio, son of Mulo, was a leading figure of the Guelph Mulucci family of Macerata. In the struggle between papal and imperial supporters in the March of Ancona, he sided with the pope. He served as podestà of Montegiorgio in 1251 and received compensation for losses under imperial occupation after Macerata returned to papal obedience in 1252. Exiled with his family during Manfred's reign, he led an attack on Montolmo and became podestà of Castelfidardo in 1269. The 1268 register recorded him as the city's largest landowner. From 1281 he sat on Macerata's special council, which made decisions of government.
zh: 穆卢乔是穆洛之子，出身马切拉塔的圭尔夫派穆卢奇家族。在安科纳边区亲教皇派与亲皇帝派的斗争中，他站在教皇一边。1251年他出任蒙特焦尔焦市政官；1252年马切拉塔重新归顺教廷后，他因帝国占领期间遭受的损失获得赔偿。曼弗雷迪在位时，他与家族一度流亡，期间率军攻打蒙特尔莫，并于1269年担任卡斯泰尔菲达尔多市政官。1268年地籍册记载他的土地面积为全城之冠；从1281年起，他是负责政府决策的马切拉塔特别议会议员。

en: Muluccio II Mulucci headed one of the two branches of the Guelph family that ruled Macerata under papal favour between 1320 and 1340. The city had just become a bishopric and the seat of the papal rector of the March, and the popes relied on the Mulucci to keep it loyal. A paternal grandson of Muluccio I, he attended a settlement between neighbouring communes at Macerata in 1306. He served as podestà of Tolentino in 1314, Montegiorgio in 1320, Siena in 1323, the crowning post of his career, and Fano in 1337. In 1328 he and his son Nucciarello took up arms at Montefano against Ghibellines from Osimo. A papal inquiry in 1341, after the guilds had overthrown the family, named him and his nephew Fredo as the rulers of the signoria, supported by Nucciarello. In 1345 his sons Vanni and Leone sold their houses in the city.
zh: 穆卢乔二世·穆卢奇是圭尔夫派穆卢奇家族两支之一的首领；1320至1340年，这一家族在教廷支持下统治马切拉塔。当时该城刚升为教区，又是教廷边区总督的驻地，教宗倚重穆卢奇家族来保证它的忠顺。他是穆卢乔一世的父系孙辈，1306年在马切拉塔出席邻近市镇之间的和解。他先后担任托伦蒂诺（1314年）、蒙特焦尔焦（1320年）、锡耶纳（1323年）和法诺（1337年）的市政官，其中锡耶纳一任是他仕途的顶点。1328年，他与儿子努恰雷洛在蒙特法诺对奥西莫的吉伯林派作战。行会推翻家族统治之后，1341年的教廷调查称，他与侄子弗雷多在努恰雷洛支持下执掌领主政权。1345年，他的儿子万尼与莱奥内卖掉了在城中的房屋。

en: Nucciarello Mulucci was a son of Muluccio II of the Guelph family that held Macerata with the backing of the papal rector of the March. Like his father he served the papal cause in arms: in 1328 the two took the field at Montefano against Ghibellines from Osimo. He was podestà of Cingoli twice, in 1333 and 1335. The family's rule was not free of friction with the citizens, and in January 1336 the rector summoned Nucciarello, his brother Vanni and their kinsman Fredo, together with the city's officials, to restore peace. A papal inquiry of 1341, after the guilds had overthrown the family in August 1340, described Nucciarello as a supporter of the signoria led by his father and Fredo.
zh: 努恰雷洛·穆卢奇是穆卢乔二世之子，出身于在教廷边区总督支持下掌控马切拉塔的圭尔夫派家族。他和父亲一样为教廷的事业出力作战：1328年，父子二人在蒙特法诺对奥西莫的吉伯林派作战。1333年和1335年，他两次担任钦戈利市政官。家族的统治与市民之间并非没有摩擦，1336年1月，边区总督召集努恰雷洛、他的兄弟万尼和族人弗雷多以及城市官员，调解纷争。1340年8月行会推翻家族统治之后，1341年的教廷调查称，努恰雷洛支持由其父和弗雷多执掌的领主政权。

en: Blessed Pietro Mulucci (c. 1257–1347) was a Franciscan friar of the Guelph Mulucci house of Macerata and brother of the city's lord Fredo. In 1320 Pope John XXII deprived rebellious Recanati of its see and made Macerata, a city loyal to the papacy, a diocese. That year Pietro appeared as a witness at an inquisitorial trial of Recanati rebels accused of heresy, and on 6 June 1323 the pope named him the second bishop of Macerata. In 1325 he attended the canonization inquiry for Nicholas of Tolentino, where witnesses named him as an eyewitness to a miracle. Learned tradition remembers him as a zealous bishop who promoted the cult of Our Lady of Loreto, then inside his new diocese, and had a church raised around the Holy House. He held the see through his family's signoria and its overthrow by the guilds in 1340, dying in office on 29 October 1347.
zh: 真福彼得罗·穆卢奇（约1257—1347）是马切拉塔圭尔夫派穆卢奇家族的方济各会修士，也是该城统治者弗雷多的兄弟。1320年，教宗约翰二十二世剥夺反叛的雷卡纳蒂的主教座，把忠于教廷的马切拉塔升为教区。同年，彼得罗曾作为证人出席对被控异端的雷卡纳蒂叛乱者的宗教审判；1323年6月6日，教宗任命他为马切拉塔第二任主教。1325年，他出席托伦蒂诺的圣尼古拉封圣调查，证人称他曾亲眼目睹一项奇迹。学者传统视他为热心信仰的主教，说他推动洛雷托圣母崇拜（洛雷托当时属新设的马切拉塔教区），并在圣家周围建起教堂。他在任期间历经家族掌权及1340年行会推翻其统治，1347年10月29日卒于任上。

en: Vanni Mulucci, Giovanni by baptismal name, belonged to the Guelph family that dominated Macerata from about 1325, when the city was newly a bishopric and the seat of the papal rector of the March. In January 1336 the rector summoned Vanni, his brother Nucciarello and Fredo Mulucci with the city's officials to restore peace. The papal Informatio inquiry of 1341 records that Vanni held some authority in the city but was not always in agreement with Fredo. After the guilds overthrew the family in August 1340, Vanni and his brother Leone sold their houses near San Giovanni in 1345. The Mulucci faded from city politics, but Vanni's heirs, with Fredo's, were later among Macerata's largest landowners, with estates chiefly in the fertile Chienti valley.
zh: 万尼·穆卢奇本名乔瓦尼，出身于约自1325年起主宰马切拉塔的圭尔夫派穆卢奇家族，当时该城刚升为教区，并成为教廷边区总督的驻地。1336年1月，边区总督召集万尼、他的兄弟努恰雷洛和弗雷多·穆卢奇以及城市官员，调解城内纷争。1341年教廷调查报告记载，万尼在城中有一定权威，但与弗雷多并非始终一心。1340年8月行会推翻家族统治后，万尼与兄弟莱奥内于1345年卖掉了圣乔瓦尼教堂附近的房屋。穆卢奇家族从此淡出城市政治，但万尼和弗雷多的继承人后来成为马切拉塔最大的土地所有者之一，地产主要位于肥沃的基恩蒂河谷。

en: Agnes of Montbéliard (died c. 1377), eldest daughter of Reginald of Burgundy, Count of Montbéliard, and Guillemette de Neufchâtel, was the heiress through whom the county passed to her husband, Henry of Montfaucon. They married on 24 April 1320, and a 1332 treaty partitioning her brother Othenin's inheritance made Henry count in her right. In 1350 and 1352 King John II summoned Agnes with other Burgundian barons to serve against the English. Her county suffered the Black Death in 1349, then a feud of over thirty years with Louis of Neufchâtel for the Val de Morteau, begun when Henry seized part of Louis's lands for lack of homage and built the castle of Réaumont as an affront. Her son Stephen succeeded as count, and Louis became Archbishop of Besançon.
zh: 蒙贝利亚尔的阿格内丝（约1377年卒）是蒙贝利亚尔伯爵雷金纳德·德·勃艮第与吉耶梅特·德·讷沙泰勒的长女，伯国正是经由她转到丈夫蒙福孔的亨利手中。两人于1320年4月24日成婚；1332年，一项瓜分其兄弟奥特南遗产的条约使亨利凭妻权成为蒙贝利亚尔伯爵。1350和1352年，国王约翰二世召她与勃艮第其他男爵一同对英格兰作战。伯国先在1349年遭黑死病蹂躏，又为莫尔托谷地同讷沙泰勒的路易缠斗三十多年；起因是亨利以对方未行臣服礼为由扣押其部分领地，并兴建雷奥蒙城堡，令对方大感受辱。她的儿子斯蒂芬继任伯爵，另一子路易成为贝桑松大主教。

en: Amadeus II of Montfaucon (c. 1130–1195) was Count of Montbéliard and lord of Montfaucon from 1163. The son of Richard II of Montfaucon and Sophie, daughter and heiress of Count Theodoric II of Montbéliard, he inherited the county through his mother. A loyal supporter of Emperor Frederick Barbarossa while other Burgundian barons held aloof, he was rewarded in 1170 with a share of the lordship of Orbe, becoming lord of Montagny near Yverdon. The grant also served Frederick’s aim of strengthening his rights east of the Jura and countering the house of Zähringen. In 1195 Count Palatine Otto I of Burgundy had him assassinated. His son Richard III succeeded him; another son, Walter, later served as regent of Cyprus.
zh: 蒙福孔的阿马德乌斯二世（约1130—1195）自1163年起任蒙贝利亚尔伯爵、蒙福孔领主。他是蒙福孔的理查二世与蒙贝利亚尔伯爵蒂埃里二世之女兼继承人索菲之子，通过母亲的血统继承伯国。当勃艮第其他男爵纷纷疏远皇帝时，他始终支持皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨，1170年获赐奥尔布领地的一部分，成为伊韦尔东附近的蒙塔尼领主。这次授地也有助于腓特烈巩固在汝拉山东侧的权利，制衡采林根家族。1195年，勃艮第行宫伯爵奥托一世派人将他暗杀。其子理查三世继位，另一子戈蒂埃后来出任塞浦路斯摄政。

en: Stephen of Montfaucon (1325–1397), son of Henry I and Agnes of Montbéliard, was Count of Montbéliard from 1367. In 1354 he married Margaret of Chalon-Arlay and governed the county during his father’s later campaigns. His daughter Jeanne died in childbirth in 1389, and Stephen withdrew to his ancestral castle at Montfaucon. His heir Henry II fell fighting the Ottomans at Nicopolis in 1396; Stephen sent men to search for him in vain. All his children died before him, and by his 1397 will he left Montbéliard to his ten-year-old granddaughter Henriette, betrothed to Eberhard IV of Württemberg, so carrying the county into the House of Württemberg.
zh: 蒙福孔的艾蒂安（1325—1397）是亨利一世与蒙贝利亚尔的阿格内丝之子，1367年起任蒙贝利亚尔伯爵。1354年，他娶沙隆-阿尔莱的玛格丽特为妻，在父亲晚年征战期间主持伯国政务。女儿让娜于1389年死于难产，艾蒂安退居蒙福孔的祖堡。继承人亨利二世于1396年在尼科波利斯同奥斯曼人作战时阵亡，艾蒂安派人寻找，却没有结果。他的子女全部先他而逝，于是他在1397年立下遗嘱，把蒙贝利亚尔传给年仅十岁的孙女亨丽埃特，并让她与符腾堡的埃伯哈德四世订婚，伯国由此转入符腾堡家族。

en: Henry I of Montfaucon (died 1367) was a baron of the County of Burgundy who became Count of Montbéliard through his wife. As the eldest he took over the barony of Montfaucon after John II died, and in 1320 he married Agnes, daughter of Reginald of Burgundy, who had governed Montbéliard. Her brother Othenin, mentally disabled, was kept under guardianship; after his death Henry ruled the county, and Emperor Louis IV invested him on 23 January 1339. In 1332 he made a treaty with the Margrave of Baden over the fief of Ferrette. In March 1340 the townspeople of Montbéliard rose against him, and he ended the revolt with promises of pardon rather than bloodshed. He fought for Philip VI against the Flemings at Cassel in 1328, later against the English, and in Prussia with the Teutonic Knights against the Lithuanians. In 1362 Charles IV named him imperial vicar in the County of Burgundy. His son Stephen succeeded him.
zh: 蒙贝利亚尔的亨利一世（1367年卒）是勃艮第伯国的一位男爵，因婚姻成为蒙贝利亚尔伯爵。兄长让二世去世后，他以长兄的身份接掌蒙福孔男爵领；1320年，他娶勃艮第的雷金纳德之女阿格内丝，雷金纳德曾执掌蒙贝利亚尔。阿格内丝的兄弟奥特南患有智力障碍，一直处在监护之下；他去世后，亨利统治该伯国，1339年1月23日皇帝路易四世正式册封他。1332年，他与巴登藩侯就费雷特采邑订立条约。1340年3月，蒙贝利亚尔市民起事，他以赦免的许诺而非流血平息了叛乱。他曾于1328年随腓力六世在卡塞尔同佛兰德人作战，后来对英格兰人作战，还随条顿骑士团前往普鲁士征讨立陶宛人。1362年，皇帝查理四世任命他为勃艮第伯国的帝国代理官。其子艾蒂安继位。

en: Joan of Montfaucon (died after 1370) was a daughter of Henry I of Montfaucon, count of Montbéliard, and Agnes of Montbéliard. She married first Hugh of Joinville, seigneur of Gex, and after his death William of Vergy. Her daughter Henriette married John of Longwy.
zh: 让娜·德·蒙福孔（1370年后去世）是蒙福孔领主、蒙贝利亚尔伯爵亨利一世与阿涅丝·德·蒙贝利亚尔之女。她先嫁热克斯领主于格·德·茹安维尔，丈夫死后改嫁纪尧姆·德·韦尔吉。她的女儿亨利埃特嫁给了让·德·隆格维。

en: Louis de Montfaucon was a younger son of Henry I of Montfaucon, who became Count of Montbéliard in 1321 through his marriage to its heiress, Agnes of Burgundy. Louis chose an ecclesiastical career, serving as dean before becoming Archbishop of Besançon. He died on 25 July 1362 during his father's lifetime, so he never held the county, which passed to his elder brother Stephen in 1367.
zh: 路易·德·蒙福孔是亨利一世·德·蒙福孔较年幼的儿子，亨利于1321年凭借与伯国女继承人勃艮第的阿涅丝成婚而成为蒙贝利亚尔伯爵。路易投身教会，先任大教堂教长，后升任贝桑松大主教。他于1362年7月25日先于父亲去世，未能继承伯国，伯国于1367年传给他的兄长艾蒂安。

en: Louis of Scarpone (c. 1015–1071/1076) was the son of Count Richwin of Scarpone and Matilda of Eguisheim, sister of Pope Leo IX. In 1038 Emperor Conrad II married him to Sophie of Bar, heiress of the dukes of Upper Lorraine, to strengthen imperial influence against the house of Ardenne. The marriage brought Louis the county of Bar and lordship of Mousson; in 1042 the emperor gave him Montbéliard, Altkirch and Ferrette. He repulsed Count Renaud I of Burgundy's siege in 1044. After Duke Gerard of Lorraine died in 1070, Louis claimed the duchy through Sophie, but Emperor Henry IV chose Gerard's son Theodoric II. Louis died soon afterwards; his own son Theodoric founded the comital house of Bar.
zh: 斯卡蓬的路易（约1015—1071/1076）是斯卡蓬伯爵里什温与教宗利奥九世之妹埃吉桑的玛蒂尔达之子。1038年，皇帝康拉德二世为加强对抗阿登家族的影响力，将上洛林公爵的女继承人巴尔的索菲许配给他。路易由此获得巴尔伯国和穆松领地，1042年皇帝又赐给他蒙贝利亚尔、阿尔特基什与费雷特。1044年，他击退勃艮第伯爵雷诺一世的围攻。1070年洛林公爵热拉尔去世后，路易凭索菲的血统要求公爵之位，但皇帝亨利四世选择了热拉尔之子蒂耶里二世。路易不久后去世；他的儿子蒂耶里开创了巴尔伯爵家族。

en: Louise de Montfaucon was a daughter of Henry I of Montfaucon, Count of Montbéliard, and Agnes of Burgundy. On 10 November 1343 she married John III, lord of Cossonay, L'Isle and Surpierre, and bore his heir Louis II.
zh: 路易丝·德·蒙福孔是蒙贝利亚尔伯爵亨利一世·德·蒙福孔与勃艮第的阿涅丝之女。1343年11月10日，她嫁给科索奈、利勒和叙尔皮埃尔的领主让三世，并为他生下继承人路易二世。

en: Othenin, called the Mad (died 1338), was Count of Montbéliard but never governed it. The only son of Reginald of Burgundy and Guillemette de Neufchâtel, he was too mentally disabled to take part in the county's affairs and was placed under the tutelage of his uncle Hugh of Chalon, lord of Fraisans. A peace treaty of 1305 betrothed him to Jeanne, sister of John of Chalon-Auxerre. He lived shut away at the Château de Montfaucon near Besançon until his death in 1338 and was buried at the Saint-Maimbœuf church in Montbéliard. Emperor Louis IV named as his successor Henry I of Montfaucon, husband of Othenin's sister Agnes.
zh: 疯子奥特南（1338年卒）名义上是蒙贝利亚尔伯爵，却从未真正执政。他是勃艮第的雷金纳德与吉耶梅特·德·讷沙泰勒的独子，因心智残疾无法过问伯国事务，被置于叔父、弗赖桑领主于格·德·沙隆的监护之下。1305年，一项和约为他订下婚约，对象是沙隆-欧塞尔的让之妹让娜。此后他一直幽居在贝桑松附近的蒙福孔城堡，1338年去世，葬于蒙贝利亚尔的圣曼伯夫教堂。皇帝路易四世指定他的继任者为蒙福孔的亨利一世，即他姊妹阿格内丝的丈夫。

en: Reinard of Montfaucon was a son of Count Henry I of Montbéliard and Agnes of Montbéliard, and brother of Count Stephen of Montbéliard. He was killed fighting the Austrians at the Battle of Sempach in 1386.
zh: 雷纳尔·德·蒙福孔是蒙贝利亚尔伯爵亨利一世与蒙贝利亚尔的阿格内丝之子，艾蒂安伯爵的兄弟。1386年，他在森帕赫战役中同奥地利人作战时阵亡。

en: Reginald of Burgundy (c. 1260–1321), a son of Hugh of Chalon and Countess Adelaide I, married Guillemette de Neufchâtel in 1282 and ruled Montbéliard and Belfort as count by right of his wife, heiress to both counties. The couple lived at the castles of Montbéliard, Héricourt and Étobon. In 1318, when Duke Eudes IV acquired the County of Burgundy by marriage, Reginald became its lieutenant-general. He died in 1321 and was buried at Baume-les-Messieurs Abbey. His son Othenin succeeded as Count of Montbéliard under his uncle's guardianship; after Othenin's death in 1339, the county passed to Reginald's daughter Agnes and her husband Henry of Montfaucon.
zh: 勃艮第的雷金纳德（约1260—1321）是沙隆的于格与女伯爵阿德莱德一世之子，1282年同吉耶梅特·德·讷沙泰勒结婚，凭妻子的继承权成为蒙贝利亚尔和贝尔福伯爵。夫妇俩住在蒙贝利亚尔、埃里库尔和埃托邦城堡。1318年，勃艮第公爵厄德四世通过婚姻取得勃艮第伯国，雷金纳德被任命为伯国的总代理官。他于1321年去世，葬在博姆莱梅谢厄修道院。其子奥特南继任蒙贝利亚尔伯爵，由叔父监护；奥特南1339年去世后，伯国传给雷金纳德的女儿阿格内丝及其丈夫亨利·德·蒙福孔。

en: Richard III of Montfaucon was Count of Montbéliard and lord of Montfaucon, the son of Amadeus II and Béatrice de Joinville. In the German succession dispute after 1198 he and Stephen II of Auxonne backed the Welf claimant Otto IV against Philip of Swabia. Richard and Walter captured the bishop of Besançon and were excommunicated; a settlement in 1199 lifted the sentence in return for abandoning claims in the Jorat. Richard later joined Stephen’s war against Otto of Merania, whose forces occupied Orbe castle. He also warred against Count Frederick II of Ferrette over a fort at Delle, and peace was sealed by the marriage of his son Theodoric III to Frederick’s daughter Alix. Richard died in 1227.
zh: 蒙福孔的理查三世是蒙贝利亚尔伯爵、蒙福孔领主，阿马德乌斯二世与贝阿特丽丝·德·茹安维尔之子。1198年后的德意志王位之争中，他与欧塞尔的艾蒂安二世支持韦尔夫家族的奥托四世，反对士瓦本的腓力。理查与戈蒂埃囚禁贝桑松主教，因而被处绝罚；1199年他们放弃对若拉的主张，换取解除绝罚。理查后来参加艾蒂安对梅拉尼亚的奥托的战争，奥托的军队占据了奥尔布城堡。他又因德勒的要塞同费雷特伯爵腓特烈二世交战，最终以其子蒂埃里三世迎娶腓特烈之女阿莉克斯缔和。理查于1227年去世。

en: Theodoric I (Thierry, c. 1045–1103) ruled as count of Montbéliard, Bar and Verdun and lord of Mousson. The son of Count Louis of Scarpone and Sophie of Bar, he claimed the Duchy of Lorraine after his father’s death, renewing a claim his father had made. Emperor Henry IV rejected him; when he ravaged the Diocese of Metz in reprisal, he was defeated by Bishop Adalbéron III and Duke Theodoric II. Reconciled with the Church, he founded a Benedictine abbey at Walbourg in 1074 and rebuilt the church of Montbéliard in 1080. He did not take the cross, sending his son Louis on crusade instead. After 1096 Bishop Richer granted him Verdun for life, amid turbulent relations between secular and ecclesiastical powers.
zh: 蒂埃里一世（约1045—1103）是蒙贝利亚尔、巴尔和凡尔登伯爵、穆松领主。他是斯卡尔波内的路易伯爵与巴尔的索菲之子。父亲死后，他延续父亲的主张，要求继承洛林公爵领地，却被皇帝亨利四世驳回；他报复性地洗劫梅斯主教区，却被梅斯主教阿达尔贝龙三世和洛林公爵蒂埃里二世击败。与教会和解后，他于1074年在瓦尔堡修建本笃会修道院，1080年重建蒙贝利亚尔教堂。他没有亲自参加十字军，而是派儿子路易前往。1096年后，凡尔登主教里谢将伯国终身授予他，世俗与教会权力之间的关系却并不平静。

en: Theodoric II (c. 1078 – January 1163), son of Count Theodoric I and Ermentrude of Burgundy, became count of Montbéliard in 1103. First given the family's Meuse lands, he was driven out by their people for his harsh temper before receiving Montbéliard at his father's death. He stood well with the emperors and took part in the Concordat of Worms in 1122, and founded several monasteries, including Belchamp Abbey. His son Theodoric III predeceased him, so the county passed to his grandson Amadeus II of Montfaucon, son of his daughter Sophie, who had married Richard II of Montfaucon in 1128.
zh: 蒂埃里二世（约1078—1163年1月）是蒙贝利亚尔伯爵，为蒂埃里一世伯爵与勃艮第的威廉一世之女埃芒特吕德之子。他最初分得家族在默兹河畔的领地，却因性情暴戾被当地人驱逐；1103年父亲去世后，他分得蒙贝利亚尔。他深得皇帝信任，参与了1122年的沃尔姆斯宗教协定，还创立了包括贝尔尚圣母修道院在内的多座修道院。其子蒂埃里三世先他而亡，爵位最终由外孙、即女儿索菲1128年嫁给蒙福孔的里夏尔二世后所生的阿梅德二世继承。

en: Theodoric III of Montfaucon (1205–1283), called the Great Baron, was Count of Montbéliard from 1227, succeeding his father Richard III. In 1248 he founded Montbéliard’s first hospital for the poor outside the city walls, placed under the protection of Pope Innocent IV, and he granted Lure Abbey the right to exploit the Saulnot saltworks. He married Alix, daughter of Count Frederick II of Ferrette. Their son Richard died before him in 1279, so in 1282 Theodoric settled the county on his great-granddaughter Guillemette de Neufchâtel; her marriage to Reginald of Burgundy carried Montbéliard into a new dynasty.
zh: 蒙福孔的蒂埃里三世（1205—1283），人称“大男爵”，1227年继承父亲理查三世之位，任蒙贝利亚尔伯爵。1248年，他在城墙外创办蒙贝利亚尔第一所贫民医院，由教皇英诺森四世庇护，又把索恩诺盐场的开采权授予吕尔修道院。他娶费雷特伯爵腓特烈二世之女阿莉克斯为妻。儿子理查先于他在1279年去世，因此他于1282年将伯国传给曾孙女吉耶梅特·德·讷沙泰勒；吉耶梅特嫁给勃艮第的雷金纳德，蒙贝利亚尔由此转入新的王朝。

en: Congalach Cnogba (died 956), also called Congalach mac Máel Mithig, was a king of Brega of the Síl nÁedo Sláine and high king of Ireland from about 944. He was a grandson of Flann Sinna and sister's son of his predecessor Donnchad Donn. The annals show him at war with most of his neighbours, contending with Ruaidrí ua Canannáin of the Cenél Conaill and now allying with, now fighting Amlaíb Cuarán, Norse king of Dublin. In 956 he was killed in an ambush at Dún Ailinne in County Kildare while fighting the Leinstermen and the Norse of Dublin.
zh: 康加拉赫·卡纳巴（？—956），又称康加拉赫·麦克·梅尔·米蒂格，是出身西尔·纳·艾多·斯莱内支系的布雷加国王，约944年成为爱尔兰至高王。他母系上是弗兰·锡纳的外孙、前任至高王唐查德·唐恩的外甥。据编年史记载，他与四邻征战不休：既与基内尔·科奈尔支系的鲁艾德里·瓦·卡纳南争雄，又与都柏林的诺斯国王奥拉夫·夸兰时敌时友。956年，他在基尔代尔郡的邓阿林遭遇伏击，与伦斯特人和都柏林的诺斯—盖尔人交战时被杀。

en: Donnchad Donn (died 944), son of Flann Sinna of Clann Cholmáin, twice rebelled against his father, at Kells in 904 and again in 915. When his brother Conchobar and brother-in-law Niall Glúndub fell against the Vikings at Dublin in September 919, Donnchad took Mide and the high kingship. He blinded one brother, Áed, and killed another, Domnall, to secure his rule. He campaigned against the Norse in Louth and long fought his forceful son-in-law Muirchertach of the Leather Cloaks, who raided Mide in 941 and fell in 943. Donnchad died in 944, and his nephew Congalach Cnogba succeeded him as king of Tara.
zh: 唐查德·唐恩（？—944）是弗兰·锡纳之子，出身乔尔缅家族。他曾于904年在凯尔斯、915年两度起兵反叛父亲。919年9月，兄弟康科巴尔与姐夫奈尔·格隆达在都柏林对战维京人时阵亡，唐查德遂成为米斯国王兼爱尔兰至高王。为巩固统治，他刺瞎了兄弟艾德，又杀死另一兄弟多姆纳尔。他曾出兵劳斯征讨诺斯人，并长期与强势的女婿“皮氅”穆尔切尔特赫·麦克·奈尔争权；后者941年劫掠米斯，943年战死。唐查德于944年去世，塔拉王位由外甥康加拉赫·卡纳巴继承。

en: Flann Sinna (847 – 25 May 916), son of Máel Sechnaill I of Clann Cholmáin, was king of Mide from 877 and high king from 879. He took hostages from Leinster, attacked Armagh with Irish and Norse allies in 882, and lost to the Vikings at the Battle of the Pilgrim in 887. In 908 he routed the Munstermen at Bellaghmoon and killed King Cormac mac Cuilennáin. High crosses at Clonmacnoise named him king of Ireland. After his heir Óengus was killed in 915 and his sons revolted, Flann died on 25 May 916 near Mullingar; Niall Glúndub succeeded him.
zh: 弗兰·锡纳（847—916年5月25日）是麦尔·舍赫奈尔一世之子，877年起任米斯国王，879年成为爱尔兰至高王。他即位之初先向伦斯特索取人质，882年联合爱尔兰人与诺斯人进攻阿马，887年在朝圣者之战中被维京人击败。908年，他在贝拉穆恩击溃芒斯特军队，击杀芒斯特国王科马克·麦克·奎莱南；克朗麦克诺伊斯的高十字架上刻有他作为爱尔兰国王的名号。915年继承人奥恩古斯被杀、诸子叛乱，他于916年5月25日在马林加附近去世，塔拉王位由奈尔·格隆达继承。

en: Máel Sechnaill mac Domnaill (949–1022), called Máel Sechnaill Mór, of the Clann Cholmáin branch of the Uí Néill, became king of Mide and High King of Ireland in 980. That year he defeated Olaf Cuaran of Dublin at the Battle of Tara, took Dublin after a three-day siege and freed its Gaelic slaves. With Brian Boru of Munster he won the Battle of Glenmama in 999, but surrendered the high kingship to Brian in 1002. After Brian fell at Clontarf in 1014, Máel Sechnaill regained the high kingship and ruled until his death.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/麥爾·舍赫奈爾·馬克·多姆奈爾
zh: 麦尔·舍赫奈尔·马克·多姆奈尔（949—1022），又称麦尔·舍赫奈尔·莫尔，出身尼尔王朝的克兰·霍尔迈因支系，于980年成为米斯国王和爱尔兰至尊王。同年他在塔拉之战击败都柏林国王奥拉夫·库兰，围城三天后攻克都柏林，释放了城中的盖尔奴隶。999年他与芒斯特国王布莱恩·博鲁联手在格伦马马之战取胜，却在1002年将至尊王位让给布莱恩。1014年布莱恩在克朗塔夫战死后，他重登至尊王位，统治至1022年去世。

en: Máel Sechnaill I (died 27 November 862) of Clann Cholmáin became king of Mide in 845 after killing his brother Flann, and king of Tara in 846. Late in 845 he captured the Viking leader Turgesius and drowned him in Lough Owel. Acknowledged as high king by the Ulstermen, he took Munster hostages in campaigns of 854, 856 and 858, and at Rahugh in 859 detached Osraige from Munster. In 860 he led Munster, Leinster and Connacht against his northern rival Áed Findliath, beating off a night attack near Armagh. His son Flann Sinna later held the high kingship.
zh: 麦尔·舍赫奈尔一世（？—862年11月27日）出身乔尔缅家族，845年杀死兄弟弗兰后成为米斯国王，846年成为塔拉国王。845年末，他擒获维京首领索吉尔斯，将其溺死在奥韦尔湖。他被阿尔斯特人承认为爱尔兰至高王，又于854、856、858年三次出征芒斯特索取人质，并于859年在拉胡集会上将奥斯里从芒斯特治下划出。860年，他率领芒斯特、伦斯特和康诺特的诸王北上征讨对手艾德·芬德里亚斯，在阿马附近击退夜袭。他于862年去世，其子弗兰·锡纳后来亦成为至高王。

en: Gjin Mataranga was a son of the Albanian lord Paul I Mataranga, who ruled Gora near Lake Ohrid. His marriage is unrecorded, and he was the father of Paul II Mataranga.
zh: 金·马特兰加是统治奥赫里德湖附近戈拉地区的阿尔巴尼亚领主保罗一世·马特兰加之子，婚姻情况无记载，有一子保罗二世·马特兰加。

en: The father of the Albanian lord Paul I Mataranga was an unnamed nobleman of the Mataranga family, which held the coastland between Durrës and Vlorë. The family is first documented in 1297, when its members attacked Ragusan merchants near the Karavasta Lagoon.
zh: 阿尔巴尼亚领主保罗一世·马特兰加的父亲是马特兰加家族一位不知名的贵族；该家族据有都拉斯与发罗拉之间的沿海地带，最早于1297年见载，时其成员在卡拉瓦斯塔湖附近袭击拉古萨商人。

en: Paul I Mataranga (Albanian: Pal Matrënga) was an Albanian feudal lord of the Mataranga family who held the Byzantine title of sevastocrator and governed the region of Gora near Lake Ohrid. In 1319 he joined a coalition of Albanian nobles that rose against King Milutin of Serbia, and a papal letter of 17 June 1319 shows Pope John XXII counting him among the favoured lords of Albania. Around 1328 his daughter Euphemia married Andrea II Muzaka, allying the Mataranga with the Muzaka family. He died around 1350.
zh: 保罗一世·马特兰加是马特兰加家族的阿尔巴尼亚封建领主，拥有拜占庭“至尊者”头衔，统治奥赫里德湖附近的戈拉地区。1319年，他加入阿尔巴尼亚贵族联军，起兵反抗塞尔维亚国王米卢廷；1319年6月17日的一封教宗信件显示，教宗若望二十二世将他视为阿尔巴尼亚受宠信的领主之一。约1328年，其女尤菲米娅嫁给安德烈亚二世·穆扎基，马特兰加家族由此与穆扎卡家族结盟。他约于1350年去世。

en: Blasius Mataranga (Albanian: Vlash Matrënga) was an Albanian nobleman of the Mataranga family who ruled the short-lived Principality of Mataranga from 1358 to 1367. Holding the Byzantine title of sevastokrator, recognised by the Serbian emperor Simeon Uroš, he controlled the coast between Durrës and Vlorë, including the port of Karavasta, and grew wealthy on grain trade with Ragusa. He fought the rival Thopia and Balsha families and died around 1367, possibly killed while held captive by the Balsha. His son Gjon survived him.
zh: 布莱修斯·马特兰加是马特兰加家族的阿尔巴尼亚贵族，于1358至1367年统治昙花一现的马特兰加侯国。他拥有拜占庭“至尊者”头衔，并得到塞尔维亚皇帝西梅翁·乌罗什承认，控制着都拉斯与发罗拉之间的海岸，包括卡拉瓦斯塔港，靠与拉古萨的粮食贸易致富。他与敌对的托皮亚、巴尔沙两家族交战，约于1367年死去，可能命丧巴尔沙家族的囚禁中。其子吉翁在他死后仍在世。

en: Aymar Adhémar de Monteil de La Garde (c. 1299–1361) was born into a noble family of the Dauphiné and became archdeacon of Reims and dean of Toul before succeeding his uncle Louis de Poitiers as bishop of Metz in 1327. As prince-bishop he warred against Duke Raoul of Lorraine until Philip VI of France mediated a peace, and in 1346 he fought at Crécy beside the French king. He later clashed with the regent Marie de Châtillon and Robert I of Bar, burning Château-Salins, invading the Barrois and taking Conflans-en-Jarnisy. He died at Metz on 12 May 1361.
zh: 艾马尔·阿代马尔·德蒙泰伊·德拉加尔格（约1299—1361）出身多菲内贵族家庭，历任兰斯助祭长、图勒主教座堂教长，1327年继其舅路易·德·普瓦捷之后出任梅斯主教。作为主教诸侯，他与洛林公爵拉乌尔交战，直到法王腓力六世调停议和；1346年，他随法王参加克雷西之战。此后他又与摄政玛丽·德·沙蒂永、巴尔公爵罗贝尔一世冲突，焚毁萨兰堡，入侵巴尔鲁瓦，攻取雅尔尼西地区孔夫朗。1361年5月12日，他卒于梅斯。

en: Gérard IV of Metz, also called Gerard de Bouzonville (c. 993–c. 1045), was a Lotharingian count, the son of Count Adalbert II of Metz and Judith of Öhningen. In 1033 he succeeded his father as count of Metz and Bouzonville, and a charter of Remiremont Abbey in 1038 also styles him count of Alsace. By his wife Gisela he left two sons, Adalbert and Gérard, who both became dukes of Upper Lorraine; the younger Gérard founded the ducal House of Lorraine, ancestor of the later Habsburg-Lorraine dynasty.
zh: 梅斯的热拉尔四世，又称布宗维尔的热拉尔（约993—约1045），是洛塔林吉亚的伯爵，梅斯伯爵阿达尔贝特二世与厄宁根的尤迪特之子。1033年他继父亲之后成为梅斯和布宗维尔伯爵，1038年勒米尔蒙修道院的一份特许状还称他为阿尔萨斯伯爵。他与妻子吉塞拉生有阿达尔贝特和热拉尔二子，二人都成为上洛林公爵；幼子热拉尔开创了洛林公爵家族，后世的哈布斯堡—洛林王朝即出自这一支。

en: Fa Ngum (1316–1393) founded the Lao kingdom of Lan Xang. Born in Muang Sua, he was the son of Prince Phi Fa, whom his grandfather Khamphong had exiled to Angkor in the 1320s. He grew up at the Khmer court and married a Khmer princess. The Muang Sua he left was a principality under Mongol influence and torn by family quarrels. Backed by Jayavarman IX, he returned with an army, subdued Lao principalities from Champasak to the upper Mekong, and in 1353 was crowned at Luang Prabang. He named his realm Lan Xang Hom Khao, land of a million elephants and a white parasol, and brought Theravada Buddhism and the Phra Bang from Angkor. At his Khmer queen's request he made Buddhism the state religion in 1359, with Vientiane as a religious centre. In 1372 his nobles deposed him in favour of his son Samsenethai, and Fa Ngum died in exile.
zh: 法昂（1316—1393）是老挝澜沧王国的开国国王。他生于勐苏瓦，是王子披法之子；披法在1320年代被祖父坎蓬放逐到吴哥。法昂在高棉宫廷长大，并娶了一位高棉公主。他离开时的勐苏瓦受蒙古势力影响，王室内部纷争不断。在阇耶跋摩九世支持下，他起兵返回，征服从占巴塞到湄公河上游的佬人诸邦，1353年在琅勃拉邦登基，国号“澜沧洪考”，意为百万大象与白伞之地。他又从吴哥引入上座部佛教，迎来帕邦佛像。1359年，应高棉王后请求，他立佛教为国教，以万象为宗教中心。1372年贵族废黜法昂，拥立其子桑森泰，法昂最终死于流亡之中。

en: Panya Khamphong, titled Phraya Khamphong, ruled the Lao principality of Muang Sua, on the site of later Luang Prabang, from 1316. His father Panya Lang had founded the panya dynasty in 1271, in a Mekong valley where the Mongols, who had taken Dali in 1253, held great sway. In 1286 Khamphong took part in a coup, probably Mongol-inspired, that exiled his father. Between 1286 and 1297 his lieutenants, acting for Sukhothai's Ramkhamhaeng and the Mongols, pacified wide territories, and in 1308 he seized the ruler of Muang Phuan, which was his vassal by 1312. Mongol overlordship was unpopular, and the dynasty was torn by family quarrels. After his son Phi Fa took one of Khamphong's wives as a lover, Khamphong drove Phi Fa and his young grandson Fa Ngum into exile at Angkor in the 1320s. Fa Ngum later returned and founded the kingdom of Lan Xang in 1353.
zh: 披耶坎蓬是佬人勐苏瓦（在今琅勃拉邦一带）政权的统治者，1316年起在位。他的父亲披耶朗1271年建立了披耶王朝，当时蒙古人在1253年攻下大理之后，对湄公河中游有着极大的影响力。1286年，坎蓬参与了一场多半由蒙古人策动的政变，把父亲赶下台。1286至1297年间，他的部将替素可泰的兰甘亨和蒙古人平定了大片地区；1308年他擒获勐普安的统治者，到1312年该地已成勐苏瓦的属国。蒙古的宗主权不得人心，王室内部争斗不断。后来其子披法与坎蓬的一名妻妾私通，坎蓬遂在1320年代把披法和年幼的孙子法昂放逐到吴哥。法昂后来重返故土，于1353年建立澜沧王国。

en: Lao chronicles name Khun Phi Fa (died 1343) as ruler of Muang Sua. The eldest son of King Suvanna Kamphong, he was banished after an affair with one of his father's wives, and his name was changed from Yak Fa to Phi Fa, meaning demon. He returned to take the throne after his father's death and died in 1343, when his brother Kham Hiao succeeded him. His son Fa Ngum became the founder-king of Lan Xang.
zh: 据老挝编年史记载，坤披法（？—1343）是勐苏瓦的统治者。他是国王披耶坎蓬的长子，因与父王妃嫔私通被驱逐，名字也由亚法改为披法，意为恶鬼。父亲死后他回国登位，1343年去世，由弟弟琴俸继位。其子法昂后来成为澜沧王国的开国国王。

en: Muhammad al-Jazuli (died 1465) was a Moroccan Sufi sheikh of the Berber Jazulin tribe in the Sous region, who claimed descent from the Prophet Muhammad. He studied at the Saffarin madrasa in Fez, then spent forty years travelling in Mecca, Medina and Jerusalem before returning to Fez, where he completed the prayer collection Dala'il al-Khayrat, among the most popular devotional works in Sunni Islam. The collection was usually divided into seven sections for recitation over the days of the week. Initiated into the Shadhili order, he spent fourteen years in seclusion before gathering many followers at Safi, until its governor expelled and poisoned him in 1465. In 1541 his remains were moved to Marrakesh, where he is honoured among its seven saints.
zh: 穆罕默德·贾祖利（卒于1465年）是摩洛哥苏斯地区柏柏尔贾祖利部落的苏菲谢赫，自称是先知穆罕默德的后裔。他曾在非斯的萨法林经学院学习，随后在麦加、麦地那和耶路撒冷游学四十年，回到非斯后编成祈祷文集《达拉伊勒·海拉特》，这部书后来成为逊尼派流传最广的虔修读物之一，通常分为七部分，按一周七日诵读。他加入沙兹里教团，独修十四年后在萨菲聚集了大批弟子，最终于1465年被当地总督驱逐并毒杀。1541年，他的遗骸迁葬马拉喀什，被尊为该城七圣之一。

en: Ludolf von Steinfurt was a noble lord of the Westphalian House of Steinfurt in the Prince-Bishopric of Münster. He held half of Bredevoort Castle, which he had strongly fortified before his kinsmen sold their share to the see of Münster in 1284. In the feud against Bishop Otto III of Rietberg he alone fought on after the truce of 1303; his clerical allies were excommunicated, but his coalition prevailed and secured the bishop's deposition in 1306. By his wife Pyronetta von Bilstein he fathered Rudolf, later cathedral scholaster of Münster.
zh: 卢多尔夫·冯·施泰因富特是威斯特法伦施泰因富特家族的贵族领主，身处明斯特采邑主教区。他持有布雷德福特城堡的一半份额，并在1284年族人把名下份额卖给明斯特教会之前大力加固了这座城堡。在与主教奥托三世·冯·里特贝格的争斗中，1303年停战后唯有他继续作战，他的教士盟友被开除教籍，但其同盟最终取胜，于1306年迫使主教去职。他与妻子皮罗内塔·冯·比尔施泰因生有鲁道夫，后者后来出任明斯特主教座堂学务长。

en: Ludwig of Hesse (1282 or 1283–1357), a son of Landgrave Henry I of Hesse, ruled as Bishop Ludwig II of Münster from 1310 until his death, the longest episcopate in the see's history. He curbed the estates and the nobility, bound castle lords to him through open houses, and granted town charters to Dülmen (1311), Billerbeck (1318), Ramsdorf (1319) and Rheine (1327). He founded collegiate churches at Dülmen and Horstmar and monasteries in Münster, and cared for the sick during plague and famine. He died on 18 August 1357 and was buried in Münster Cathedral.
zh: 黑森的路易（1282或1283—1357）是黑森伯爵亨利一世之子，1310年起以路德维希二世之号任明斯特主教，直至去世，是该主教区在位时间最长的主教。他压制贵族与等级会议，以“开放宅邸”体系将城堡领主笼络到自己麾下，并授予迪尔门（1311年）、比勒贝克（1318年）、拉姆斯多夫（1319年）和赖讷（1327年）城市特许状。他在迪尔门、霍斯特马尔设立牧师会教堂，在明斯特城修建修道院，并在瘟疫与饥荒期间照料病患。1357年8月18日他去世，葬于明斯特主教座堂。

en: Rudolf von Steinfurt was a son of Lord Ludolf VII of Steinfurt and Peronette of Bilstein, and a cleric in the diocese of Münster. While rector of the chapel at Hesseldorn near Nordwalde, he and his brother Baldewin asked Bishop Ludwig II to exchange their prebends, a swap that admitted Rudolf to the Münster cathedral chapter. On 28 March 1364 he is first recorded as Domscholaster, the cathedral school's master, and in 1369 he served the bishop as Amtmann, or bailiff, in the Emsland.
zh: 鲁道夫·冯·施泰因富特是施泰因富特领主卢多尔夫七世与比尔施泰因的佩罗内特之子，在明斯特教区任神职。他担任诺德瓦尔德附近黑瑟尔多恩小堂教区长时，与兄弟鲍德温请求路德维希二世主教互换圣俸，借此进入明斯特主教座堂圣职团。1364年3月28日，他首次以座堂学监的身份出现，负责管理主教座堂学校；1369年，他奉主教之命出任埃姆斯兰的地方官。

en: Mutukan (died 1221), also spelled Mö'etüken, was the eldest son of Chagatai Khan and a favourite grandson of Genghis Khan. He took part in the Mongol invasion of the Khwarazmian Empire and was killed by an arrow shot from the walls during the siege of Bamiyan in September 1221. In his fury Genghis Khan had the city destroyed and its whole population put to the sword after it fell. His descendants included the Chagatai khans Qara Hülëgü, his son, and Baraq, his grandson through Yesünto'a.
zh: 抹土干（？—1221年），又作木阿秃干、莫图根，是察合台的嫡长子，也是成吉思汗钟爱的孙子。他随蒙古大军西征花剌子模，1221年九月在围攻巴米扬时被城上射来的箭射死。成吉思汗大怒，城破后下令将城池夷平、屠尽城中生灵。他的后裔中有察合台汗哈剌旭烈与八剌，前者是他的儿子，后者是他的儿子也孙脱所生的孙子。

en: Edmond Albanach de Burgh (died 1375), called the Scot for the years he spent hostage there, was a son of William Liath de Burgh and founder of the Mayo Bourkes, the Mac William Íochtar. In 1332 his cousin the Earl of Ulster starved his elder brother Walter to death in prison; Edmond made himself lord of Mayo, and the earl was murdered the next year in revenge, leaving only an infant daughter. In April 1338 Edmond and his brother Raymond seized their rival cousin Edmond de Burgh at Ballinrobe, who was later thrown into Lough Mask in a sack of stones; the killing ended English overlordship of Connacht. The brothers hid on islands off the western coast until Edward III pardoned them in 1340. In 1366 he joined Aodh Ua Conchobhair and Liam Ó Kelly against the Clanricarde Burkes. He died in 1375 the strongest lord west of the Shannon.
zh: 埃德蒙·阿尔巴纳赫·德·伯格（?—1375），绰号“阿尔巴纳赫”（意为苏格兰人），得自他在苏格兰充当人质的岁月。他是“灰发”威廉·德·伯格之子，梅奥伯克家族（北麦克威廉）的奠基人。1332年，表亲阿尔斯特伯爵把他的兄长沃尔特囚禁饿死，埃德蒙自立为梅奥领主；次年伯爵遭人报复杀害，只留下一个年幼的女儿。1338年4月，他与兄弟雷蒙德在巴林罗布擒获身为政敌的堂亲埃德蒙·德·伯格，后者随后被装进石头袋子沉入马斯克湖；这桩命案终结了英格兰对康诺特的宗主权。兄弟二人逃到西海岸的岛屿避难，1340年获英王爱德华三世赦免。1366年他联合阿德·乌阿·康霍巴尔与利亚姆·奥凯利对抗克兰里卡德伯克家族。1375年他去世时已是香农河以西最强的领主。

en: Thomas mac Edmond Albanach de Búrca (died 1402) was the second Mac William Íochtar, lord of Lower Connacht and Mayo. He was the son of Edmond Albanach de Burgh, founder of the Mayo Bourkes, and Sadhbh Ní Mháille, a daughter of the O'Malley chief Diarmuid mac Owen Ó Máille, and he succeeded his father as chieftain in 1375. Three of his sons died in 1384. His death in 1402 is recorded in the Annals of the Four Masters, and his son Walter mac Thomas succeeded him as third Mac William Íochtar.
zh: 托马斯·麦克·埃德蒙·阿尔巴纳赫·德·伯格（?—1402）是第二代北麦克威廉，即下康诺特与梅奥的领主。他是梅奥伯克家族奠基人埃德蒙·阿尔巴纳赫·德·伯格与奥马利酋长迪尔梅德·麦克·欧文·奥马利之女西芙·奥马利之子，1375年继其父成为酋长。他有三个儿子于1384年死去。1402年他去世，此事见于《四大师年鉴》；其子沃尔特·麦克·托马斯继任为第三代北麦克威廉。

en: Mubariz al-Din Muhammad (1301–1363) founded Iran's Muzaffarid dynasty and filled the gap left when Ilkhanid rule in central Iran dissolved. He inherited his father Sharaf al-Din Muzaffar's Ilkhanid offices in 1314, took Yazd from its Atabeg in 1319, and subdued rebellious Sistan, reportedly in 21 battles. After Abu Sa'id's death he made himself independent, seizing Kirman in 1339 or 1340 and Bam soon after. That made him the rival of the Injuids of Shiraz and Isfahan, whose ruler Abu Ishaq failed to take Yazd in 1350–1351. In 1353 Mubariz captured Shiraz, chased Abu Ishaq to Isfahan and executed him; Shiraz became his capital. He declined to become a vassal of the Golden Horde khan Jani Beg, and in 1357 briefly occupied Tabriz before the Jalayirids marching from Baghdad forced him out. A harsh ruler, he was blinded and imprisoned by his son Shah Shuja in 1358 and died in prison in 1363.
zh: 穆巴里兹·丁·穆罕默德（1301—1363）是伊朗穆扎法尔王朝的开创者，伊儿汗国在伊朗中部的统治瓦解后，他填补了这片权力真空。1314年他承袭父亲谢拉夫·丁·穆扎法尔在伊儿汗国的官职，1319年从亚兹德阿塔贝格手中夺取亚兹德，又平定了锡斯坦的叛乱，先后与叛军交战21次。不赛因死后，他自立门户，1339或1340年攻取克尔曼，随后拿下巴姆。这使他成为设拉子与伊斯法罕的因朱王朝的对手，因朱统治者阿布·伊沙克于1350—1351年围攻亚兹德未果。1353年穆巴里兹攻占设拉子，追击阿布·伊沙克至伊斯法罕并将其处死，设拉子成为都城。他拒绝向金帐汗札尼别称臣，1357年短暂进占大不里士，随后在从巴格达开来的札剌亦儿军队逼迫下撤出。他以严苛著称，1358年被儿子沙·舒贾刺瞎并囚禁，1363年死于狱中。

en: Shah Shoja (1333–1384) took the Muzaffarid state of southern Iran to its widest reach, from Balochistan to Arran. He came to power over his father: after stopping Mubariz al-Din Muhammad from demolishing the tomb of the poet Saadi, he blinded and imprisoned him in 1358 and took the throne. His long reign was a running quarrel with his brothers. Shah Mahmud, backed by his father-in-law, the Jalayirid Shaikh Awais, seized Shiraz in 1364, and Shoja could not retake his capital until 1366; he occupied Isfahan after Mahmud's death. Contemporaries described a well-educated prince who wrote verse himself, and Hafez, who spent much of his career under Shoja, alluded to him 39 times. In 1383, drunk, he had his own son Sultan Shebli blinded and regretted it the next day. That year he wrote to the warlord Timur, then campaigning in Azerbaijan, and entrusted his sons to him. He died in 1384, naming Zain al-Abidin his successor.
zh: 沙·舒贾（1333—1384）把伊朗南部的穆扎法尔王朝带到势力的顶点，疆域从俾路支斯坦延伸至阿兰。他是踩着父亲上台的：穆巴里兹·丁·穆罕默德要毁掉诗人萨迪的陵墓，被他拦下；1358年他刺瞎并囚禁了父亲，夺取王位。在位期间，他与兄弟们争斗不休。其兄沙·马哈茂德得到岳父、札剌亦儿王朝的谢赫·阿瓦伊斯支持，1364年攻占设拉子，舒贾直到1366年才收回都城；马哈茂德死后，他进占伊斯法罕。同时代人记述他是一位学识渊博、自己也写诗的君主，哈菲兹的大半诗歌生涯都在他治下度过，诗中39次提到他。1383年，他酒醉后刺瞎了亲生儿子苏丹·谢卜利，次日便后悔不已。同年，他致信正在阿塞拜疆作战的统帅帖木儿，将儿子们托付给他。1384年他去世，遗命以扎因·阿比丁为继承人。

en: Andrea I Muzaka (died 1319), also called Andrew Musachi, was an Albanian lord who built the Muzaka family's power from its base at Berat; some sources name his father as Lal Muzaka. Holding the Byzantine title sebastokrator and the Angevin office of Marshal of Albania from 1280, he was a vassal of the Angevin kings of Naples. His lands included Myzeqe, Opar and Skrapar in central Albania. In 1319 Pope John XXII sent confidential letters to Andrea and other Albanian nobles seeking support against the Serbian king Milutin, as part of a crusade led by Philip of Taranto. His son Theodore I inherited his lands.
zh: 安德烈亚一世·穆扎卡（?—1319），又名安德鲁·穆萨基，是阿尔巴尼亚贵族，以培拉特为根基奠定了穆扎卡家族的势力；部分史料称其父为拉尔·穆扎卡。他拥有拜占庭的“至尊者”头衔，自1280年起担任安茹王朝授予的“阿尔巴尼亚元帅”，是那不勒斯安茹诸王的封臣。他的领地包括阿尔巴尼亚中部的穆泽切、奥帕尔与斯克拉帕尔。1319年，教皇若望二十二世秘密致信安德烈亚等阿尔巴尼亚贵族，争取他们支持塔兰托的腓力领导的十字军，反对塞尔维亚国王米卢丁。其子特奥多尔一世继承了他的领地。

en: Andrea II Muzaka (c. 1318–1372) inherited the Muzaka principality from his father Theodore I about 1331 and carried it to its greatest extent. He rose against Byzantine rule in southern Albania in 1335–1341 and in 1336 swore fealty to the Angevin king of Naples, whose court recognized him as Despot of the Kingdom of Albania. When Stefan Dušan's Serbia overran the country, he led the resistance and in 1350 retook Berat, driving Dušan's governor John Komnenos Asen back to Kanina. After Dušan's empire collapsed, Andrea and King Vukašin both claimed the Macedonian lands around Kastoria; Andrea won at Pelister in 1369, and Emperor John V Palaiologos named him Despot of Epirus. He took a double-headed eagle under a star as his arms, replacing the family's spring emblem, and in 1371 seized Kastoria from Prince Marko. He died in 1372, ruling from the Adriatic to Kastoria, and was buried at Durrës.
zh: 安德烈亚二世·穆扎卡（约1318—1372）约1331年从父亲特奥多尔一世手中继承穆扎卡公国，并把它扩张到最大。1335—1341年，他在阿尔巴尼亚南部起兵反抗拜占庭统治；1336年他向安茹家族的那不勒斯国王效忠，安茹方面承认他为“阿尔巴尼亚王国专制君主”。杜尚的塞尔维亚席卷阿尔巴尼亚时，他领导抵抗，1350年收复培拉特，把杜尚任命的统治者约翰·科穆宁·阿森赶回卡尼纳。杜尚帝国崩溃后，安德烈亚与塞尔维亚国王武卡欣同时索要卡斯托里亚一带的马其顿土地；1369年他在佩利斯特获胜，拜占庭皇帝约翰五世·帕里奥洛格斯因此封他为“伊庇鲁斯专制君主”。他改用星辰之下的双头鹰作纹章，取代家族原有的泉水徽记；1371年又从马尔科王子手中夺取卡斯托里亚。他于1372年去世，领地西起亚得里亚海、东至卡斯托里亚，葬于都拉斯。

en: Euphemia Mataranga (Albanian Efimia Matrënga) was an Albanian noblewoman of the Mataranga family, the daughter of Paul I Mataranga, a sevastocrator who ruled the province of Gora near Lake Ohrid. Around 1328 she married Andrea II Muzaka in the Church of Saint Anthony in Durrës, linking the Mataranga and Muzaka lordly houses. Her children included Gjin I and Teodor II Muzaka; her daughter Comita married Balsha II, and another daughter Chiranna married Andrea Gropa. She and Andrea were buried together in the Church of Saint Anthony in Durrës.
zh: 埃菲米娅·马特兰加是阿尔巴尼亚马特兰加家族的贵族女子，父亲保罗一世·马特兰加拥有“至尊者”头衔，统治奥赫里德湖附近的戈拉地区。约1328年，她在都拉斯的圣安东尼教堂嫁给安德烈亚二世·穆扎卡，使马特兰加家族与穆扎卡家族联姻结盟。她的子女包括金一世和特奥多尔二世·穆扎卡；女儿科米塔嫁给巴尔沙二世，另一个女儿基兰娜嫁给安德烈亚·格罗帕。她与丈夫最终合葬于都拉斯的圣安东尼教堂。

en: Gjin I Muzaka (1337–1389) was an Albanian prince of the Muzaka family, a son of Andrea II Muzaka and Euphemia Mataranga. In 1367 he appears as a kaballarios in Ioannina, where the Serbian governor Thomas Preljubović held him prisoner for a time. When Andrea II died in 1372, his lands were divided among his three sons: Gjin received Tomorniza beneath Mount Tomorr and the Devoll valleys, and after his brother Stoya died without heirs he also took Kastoria. He married Suina Arianiti and was probably buried in the Analepsis church he founded at Korçë.
zh: 金一世·穆扎卡（1337—1389）是阿尔巴尼亚穆扎卡家族的王公，安德烈亚二世·穆扎卡与埃菲米娅·马特兰加之子。1367年，他以“卡瓦拉里奥斯”的身份出现在约阿尼纳，被塞尔维亚总督托马斯·普雷柳博维奇短期囚禁。1372年安德烈亚二世去世时将领地分给三个儿子：金得到托莫尔山下的托莫尔尼察和德沃尔河谷；其兄弟斯托亚无嗣而死后，卡斯托里亚也归入他手。他娶苏伊娜·阿里亚尼蒂为妻，可能葬于科尔察由他捐建的复活教堂。

en: Mentulo Muzaka, also called Matarango, Count of Këlcyra, was a son of Teodor I Muzaka, lord of Berat, and brother of Andrea II Muzaka. In 1319 Pope John XXII named him among the Albanian barons urged to stay loyal to the Angevins against the Serbs.
zh: 门图洛·穆扎卡，又称马塔兰戈，克尔察伯爵，是培拉特领主特奥多尔一世·穆扎卡之子、安德烈亚二世·穆扎卡的兄弟。1319年，教皇约翰二十二世在敦促阿尔巴尼亚贵族继续效忠安茹王朝、抵御塞尔维亚人推进的文书中点名了他。

en: Teodor I Muzaka was an Albanian nobleman, son of Andrea I Muzaka, who ruled the Lordship of Berat from 1319 until his death around 1331. His lands ran from Myzeqe and Berat through Skrapar and Tomorricë south to Këlcyra, and he held the high Byzantine court title of protosebastos. His reign was overshadowed by the advance of the Serbian king Stefan Uroš II Milutin and by Angevin claims to Albania; Pope John XXII numbered him among the Albanian barons urged to remain loyal to the Angevins. He was succeeded by his son Andrea II Muzaka.
zh: 特奥多尔·穆扎卡是阿尔巴尼亚贵族，安德烈一世·穆扎卡之子，自1319年至约1331年去世时统治培拉特领地。他的疆土从米泽切亚、培拉特经斯克拉巴里、托莫里察向南延伸至克尔曲拉，并领有拜占庭高级宫廷头衔普罗托塞巴斯托斯。他在位时，塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·乌罗什二世·米卢丁步步进逼，安茹家族又对阿尔巴尼亚提出主权要求；教皇约翰二十二世把他列入被敦促效忠安茹家族的阿尔巴尼亚男爵之中。他死后由儿子安德烈二世·穆扎卡继位。

en: Teodor II Muzaka (1337–1389) was an Albanian prince of the House of Muzaka, second son of Despot Andrea II Muzaka and Euphemia Mataranga. When Andrea died in 1372, his lands were split among three sons: Gjin inherited the main holdings, Teodor received Berat and Myzeqe, and Stoya took Kastoria. In 1383–1384 Teodor and Stoya, together with the monk Dionysius, founded the Orthodox Church of Saint Athanasius of Mouzaki in Kastoria. Teodor fell on 15 June 1389 fighting the Ottomans at the Battle of Kosovo in the coalition led by Prince Lazar of Serbia.
zh: 特奥多尔二世·穆扎卡（1337—1389）是阿尔巴尼亚穆扎卡家族贵族，专制君主安德烈亚二世·穆扎卡与尤菲米娅·马塔兰加之次子。1372年父亲去世后，领地分给三个儿子：金继承主体领地，特奥多尔得到培拉特与穆泽切，斯托亚得到卡斯托里亚。1383—1384年，特奥多尔与斯托亚及修士狄奥尼修斯一道，在卡斯托里亚修建了东正教的穆扎基圣亚大纳修教堂。1389年6月15日，他在塞尔维亚公拉扎尔率领的反奥斯曼联军中战死于科索沃战役。

en: Hasan II (died 1349), also called Fakhr al-Dawla Hasan, was the last ruler of the Bavand dynasty in Tabaristan. A son of Shah-Kaykhusraw, he succeeded his brother Sharaf al-Muluk in 1334. In 1344 the Sarbadar leader Mas'ud invaded Mazandaran and occupied Amol, but Hasan retook Sari and, with the Paduspanid Eskandar II, annihilated the Sarbadars; Mas'ud was captured and executed. In 1349 Hasan's execution of his powerful vassal Jalal ibn Ahmad Jal provoked a noble revolt. He sought Chulabid support, but the sons of Kiya Afrasiyab murdered him in his bath on 17 April 1349, ending Bavand rule.
zh: 哈桑二世（？—1349），又称法赫尔·道莱·哈桑，是塔巴里斯坦巴文德王朝末代统治者，沙·凯胡斯劳之子，1334年继兄沙拉夫·穆鲁克之位。1344年，萨尔巴达尔首领马苏德入侵马赞德兰并占领阿莫勒，哈桑收复萨里，与帕杜斯潘的伊斯坎达尔二世合围，歼灭萨尔巴达尔军队，马苏德被俘后处死。1349年，他处死权势重臣贾拉勒·伊本·艾哈迈德·贾勒，引发贵族叛乱。他向丘拉比家族求援，基雅·阿夫拉西亚卜的两个儿子却于4月17日在浴室中将他谋杀，巴文德王朝至此灭亡。

en: Tradition names Shamshir as the third king of Nagar, a Burusho valley state in the Gilgit highlands, ruling after Azar and before Sultan. The same tradition traces the Maglot dynasty to Maghlot, who with his brother Girkis divided ancient Broshal into Nagar and Hunza.
zh: 相传沙姆希尔是吉尔吉特高地布鲁绍人山谷政权讷格尔的第三代王，在阿扎尔之后、苏丹之前在位。该谱系称莫格洛特王朝始于马格洛特，他与兄弟吉尔基斯把古布鲁沙尔分为讷格尔与罕萨。

en: Elisabeth of Namur (c. 1329–1382) was the youngest daughter of John I, Count of Namur, of the Dampierre house, and Marie of Artois; her elder sister Blanche became queen of Sweden by marriage to Magnus Eriksson. In 1350 she married the Wittelsbach count palatine Rupert I, who secured the electoral dignity for the Palatinate under the Golden Bull of 1356. The marriage remained childless. A patron of the Heidelberg Franciscans, she enlarged their friary around 1375 and asked in her will to be buried before the high altar of their church. She died at Heidelberg in 1382.
zh: 那慕尔的伊丽莎白（约1329—1382）是当皮埃尔家族那慕尔伯爵约翰一世与阿图瓦的玛丽的幼女，其姊布兰卡嫁给马格努斯·埃里克松，成为瑞典王后。1350年，她嫁给维特尔斯巴赫家族的行宫伯爵鲁普雷希特一世，后者依1356年金玺诏书为普法尔茨取得选帝侯地位。二人没有子女。她是海德堡方济各会的赞助人，约1375年出资扩建其修道院，并在遗嘱中要求葬于该会教堂的主祭坛前。1382年，她于海德堡去世。

en: Guy II of Namur (c. 1312–1336) was briefly margrave of Namur. Second son of John I and Marie of Artois, he fought in 1332 with Louis I of Flanders against John III of Brabant over Mechelen. He succeeded his brother John II on 2 April 1335 and, for a pension, did homage to Edward III of England and joined his Scottish campaign. At Boroughmuir the Scots surprised his rearguard and captured him. On his way home through Flanders he was killed jousting in a tournament at Saint-Venant on 12 March 1336, leaving Namur to his brother Philip III.
zh: 那慕尔的居伊二世（约1312—1336）只短暂担任那慕尔侯爵。他是若望一世与阿图瓦的玛丽的次子，1332年随佛兰德斯伯爵路易一世，为争夺梅赫伦领地与布拉班特公爵约翰三世作战。1335年4月2日他继承兄长若望二世，以领取年金为条件向英王爱德华三世称臣，并随其出征苏格兰。在巴勒穆尔，苏格兰人突袭他所在的后卫部队并将他俘获。获释后经佛兰德斯返乡途中，他于1336年3月12日在圣沃南的比武大会上参加骑枪对决时被杀，那慕尔由弟弟菲利普三世继承。

en: William I (1324–1391), called the Rich, ruled Namur from 1337. The fifth son of John I of Namur and Marie of Artois, he inherited after his four elder brothers died childless between 1333 and 1337, with his mother serving as regent during his minority. He joined the English side in the Hundred Years' War, while Namur itself stayed peaceful apart from a weavers' revolt in 1351. Money from his mother and then his wife let him buy lands that enlarged the county, and he promoted mining, metalworking and trade. In 1362 Emperor Charles IV made Namur directly subject to the Empire, ending its vassalage to Hainaut. William was defeated and captured at Baesweiler in 1371. His first wife, Jeanne of Hainault, died of the plague two years after their 1348 wedding; in 1352 he married Catherine of Savoy, and their sons were William II and John III, the last Marquis of Namur.
zh: 威廉一世（1324—1391），人称“富有者”，自1337年起统治那慕尔。他是那慕尔的约翰一世与阿图瓦的玛丽的第五子，四位兄长在1333至1337年间先后无嗣而终，他因而继位，未成年时由母亲摄政。他在百年战争中加入英格兰一方，而那慕尔本土除1351年的织工起义外一直保持和平。他先后靠母亲和妻子的财富购置土地，扩大了疆域，并发展采矿、冶铁与贸易。1362年，神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理四世下诏使那慕尔直属于帝国，不再向埃诺称臣。1371年，威廉在巴斯韦勒战役中战败被俘。他的第一任妻子埃诺的让娜于1348年成婚，两年后死于黑死病；1352年他改娶萨伏依的卡特琳，二人之子为威廉二世和约翰三世，后者是那慕尔的末代侯爵。

en: Henry II of Courtenay (1206–1229) was margrave of Namur from 1226 until his death. The third son of Peter II of Courtenay, Latin Emperor of Constantinople, and Yolanda of Flanders, he succeeded when his eldest brother Philip II fell heirless on the Albigensian Crusade in 1226; their second brother Robert already ruled the Latin Empire. Henry was in France under the guardianship of Enguerrand III of Coucy. After Robert died in 1228, he waived his claim to Constantinople in favour of his brother Baldwin. He died in 1229 aged about twenty-three, childless, and Namur passed to his sister Margaret.
zh: 库尔特奈的亨利二世（1206—1229）是1226年至去世为止的那慕尔侯爵。他是拉丁帝国皇帝库尔特奈的彼得二世与佛兰德斯的约兰达的第三子。1226年长兄菲利普二世在阿尔比十字军中战死、无嗣，而二哥罗贝尔已是拉丁帝国皇帝，亨利遂继承那慕尔侯国；当时他身在法国，由库西领主昂盖朗三世监护。1228年罗贝尔去世，他放弃对君士坦丁堡皇位的主张，让给弟弟鲍德温。1229年他去世，年仅约23岁，无子嗣，那慕尔由姐姐玛格丽特继承。

en: John I of Namur (1267–1330) of the House of Dampierre was son of Count Guy of Flanders and Isabelle of Luxembourg. He governed Namur for his father from 1297 and succeeded as marquis in 1305. He fought beside his brother Guy of Namur at the victory of the Golden Spurs in 1302, but was defeated at Mons-en-Pévèle in 1304 and made peace with France in 1307. In 1308 the French king ruled in John's favour against Charles of Valois's claim to Namur. The emperor's 1314 grant of Cambrai led to John's excommunication; from 1318 to 1322 he fought the bishop of Liège. With Marie of Artois he fathered later counts and Blanche, queen of Sweden, and died in 1330.
zh: 那慕尔的约翰一世（1267—1330）出身当皮埃尔家族，是佛兰德斯伯爵居伊与卢森堡的伊莎贝尔之子。他自1297年起代父治理那慕尔，1305年继任侯爵。他与弟弟那慕尔的居伊并肩作战，参加了1302年金马刺战役佛兰德斯一方的胜利，但1304年在蒙斯昂佩韦勒战败，1307年与法国议和。1308年瓦卢瓦的查理主张那慕尔继承权，法国国王裁决约翰胜诉。1314年皇帝把康布雷封赐给他，他因此被开除教籍；1318—1322年他与列日主教交战。他与阿图瓦的玛丽亚生下后来几代那慕尔伯爵以及瑞典王后布朗什，1330年去世。

en: John II of Namur (c. 1311–1335) was margrave of Namur from 1330 until his death. The eldest son of John I and Marie of Artois, he succeeded on 26 January 1330 and, as lord of Sluis, renewed that town's laws and customs on 1 July. In May 1332 he joined a league of Low Countries princes against John III, Duke of Brabant, until Philip VI of France mediated an end to the conflict. He never married and died on 2 April 1335, leaving an illegitimate son Philip killed defending Dendermonde in 1380; his brother Guy II succeeded him.
zh: 那慕尔的若望二世（约1311—1335）是1330年至去世为止的那慕尔侯爵。他是若望一世与阿图瓦的玛丽的长子，1330年1月26日继位；作为斯勒伊斯领主，他于7月1日更新了该城的法律与惯例。1332年5月，他加入尼德兰多位领主针对布拉班特公爵约翰三世的同盟，直至法王腓力六世出面调停、结束冲突。他终身未婚，1335年4月2日去世，留有一名私生子菲利普（1380年在登德尔蒙德防御战中被杀），由弟弟居伊二世继位。

en: Louis of Namur (1325–between 1378 and 1386) was a younger son of John I, Marquis of Namur, and Marie of Artois, and a brother of the marquises John II, Guy II, Philip III and William I. He held the lordships of Peteghem and Bailleul. In 1346 he accompanied William to the Battle of Crécy. He governed Namur during his brother's absence when unrest broke out in 1352, and fought against the Duke of Brabant in 1356 and 1357. In 1365 he married Isabelle de Pierrepont, who ruled the county of Roucy in her own right. The marriage produced no children, and Louis died between 1378 and 1386.
zh: 那慕尔的路易（1325—1378至1386年间）是那慕尔侯爵约翰一世与阿图瓦的玛丽亚较年幼的儿子之一，约翰二世、居伊二世、菲利普三世、威廉一世几代侯爵的兄弟。他拥有珀特海姆与巴约勒两处领地。1346年，他随威廉参加克雷西战役。1352年那慕尔发生动乱时，他正代外出的兄弟治理当地；1356年和1357年，他参加了对布拉班特公爵的战争。1365年，他娶了以己身统治鲁西伯国的伊莎贝尔·德·皮埃尔蓬为妻。两人没有子女，路易于1378至1386年间去世。

en: Margaret of Namur (c. 1323–1383) was a daughter of John I, Marquis of Namur, and Marie of Artois, and sister of William I and Blanche, queen of Sweden; she became a nun at Peteghem in Flanders and died in 1383.
zh: 那慕尔的玛格丽特（约1323—1383）是那慕尔侯爵约翰一世与阿图瓦的玛丽亚之女，那慕尔侯爵威廉一世和瑞典王后布朗什的姐妹；她在佛兰德斯的彼得赫姆出家为修女，1383年去世。

en: Marie of Artois (1291–1365), daughter of Philip of Artois and sister of Robert III, married John I of Namur in 1310. He gave her Wijnendale Castle and lands in Flanders yielding 8000 livres a year. When he left for Italy with Emperor Henry VII, a revolt broke out at Namur in 1313. She and her three children were shut in Namur Castle, fearing for their lives, until John persuaded Count Arnoul V of Looz to put it down. Widowed in 1330, she saw three sons succeed as margrave and die within seven years; her relations with the first, John II, had already soured after she intervened at Sluis, apparently at Philip VI's request. In 1337 her youngest son William inherited at fifteen, and she ruled Namur as regent until 1340. In 1342 she bought Poilvache from John the Blind of Luxembourg, and in 1353 she gave it to William.
zh: 阿图瓦的玛丽亚（1291—1365）是阿图瓦的腓力之女、罗贝尔三世的妹妹，1310年嫁给那慕尔侯爵约翰一世。约翰把韦嫩达尔城堡和佛兰德每年可得8000里弗尔的土地赐给她。约翰随皇帝亨利七世远征意大利时，1313年那慕尔爆发叛乱。她和三个孩子被困在那慕尔城堡，性命堪忧，直到约翰说服洛斯伯爵阿尔努尔五世平定叛乱。1330年她丧夫寡居，此后七年间，三个儿子相继袭爵又相继去世；其中长子约翰二世与她早已不睦，起因是她介入斯勒伊斯事务，似乎是应腓力六世之请。1337年，幼子威廉十五岁继位，她以摄政身份统治那慕尔至1340年。1342年她从卢森堡的“盲人”约翰手中购得普瓦瓦什堡，1353年把它交给威廉。

en: Philip II of Courtenay (1195–1226), called à la Lèvre, was Marquis of Namur, the eldest son of the Latin Emperor Peter II of Courtenay and Yolande of Hainaut. In 1212 his uncle Philip the Noble named him heir to Namur. He defended it against Waleran III of Limburg, whose wife Ermesinde was descended from Henry the Blind, an earlier ruler of Namur. Peace was concluded at Dinant in 1222. After his father's death in 1217 he refused the Latin imperial throne, which went to his brother Robert. In 1226 he joined Louis VIII's Albigensian Crusade at the siege of Avignon, dying of illness near Saint-Flour. Unmarried, he left Namur to his brother Henry.
zh: 库尔特奈的菲利普二世（1195—1226），绰号“厚唇”，是那慕尔侯爵，拉丁帝国皇帝皮埃尔二世·德·库尔特奈与埃诺的约兰达的长子。1212年，他的舅舅“贵族”菲利普指定他为那慕尔继承人。他抵抗林堡的瓦勒朗三世的进攻；瓦勒朗的妻子埃尔梅辛德是那慕尔前统治者“盲人”亨利的后代。双方于1222年在迪南议和。1217年父亲去世后，他拒绝了君士坦丁堡的拉丁皇位，皇位由其弟罗贝尔继承。1226年，他随路易八世参加阿尔比十字军，围攻阿维尼翁，后在圣弗卢尔附近病逝。他终身未娶，那慕尔由弟弟亨利继承。

en: Philip III of Namur (1319–1337), a son of John I and Marie of Artois, inherited the marquisate in March 1336 after his brother Guy II was killed in a tournament in Flanders. He was then in Sweden with his sister Blanche, queen of Sweden and Norway. Rather than return home, he travelled toward the Holy Land via Cyprus with his brother-in-law Henry II of Vianden. At Famagusta the townsmen, enraged by his party's conduct, killed him and his companions in September 1337. He was buried in the Franciscan church there and succeeded by his brother William I.
zh: 菲利普三世（那慕尔）（1319—1337）是那慕尔侯爵约翰一世与阿图瓦的玛丽亚之子。1336年3月，其兄居伊二世在佛兰德斯的一场比武大会上身亡，他继位为那慕尔侯爵。当时他正在瑞典，身处其姐、瑞典与挪威王后布朗什的宫廷。他没有直接返回那慕尔，而是偕姐夫菲安登伯爵亨利二世取道塞浦路斯前往圣地。在法马古斯塔停留期间，一行人因行为放纵触怒市民，1337年9月他与同伴悉数被杀，葬于当地方济各会教堂，其弟威廉一世继位。

en: Robert of Namur (1323–1391), a younger son of John I of Namur, was a Low Countries noble who tied his fortunes to England. After crusading in Prussia and the Holy Land as a young man, he was sent in 1346 by his uncle Robert III of Artois, who leaned toward the English, to Edward III's camp at the siege of Calais, and made a good impression on the king. In 1350 he and Henry of Grosmont commanded the flagship at the sea battle off Winchelsea; in 1354 he married Isabella of Hainault, sister of Queen Philippa, and became Edward's brother-in-law. He was made a Knight of the Garter in 1369. In 1371 he led 2,000 men for Wenceslaus of Luxembourg and Brabant at Baesweiler, lost, and was ransomed. He also brought Jean Froissart to England; at his request Froissart wrote a recent history, and its first book, completed in 1373, was dedicated to him. Neither of his marriages produced children.
zh: 那慕尔的罗伯特（1323—1391）是那慕尔的约翰一世的幼子之一，出身低地国家的贵族，一生与英格兰紧紧相连。年轻时，他曾参加普鲁士和圣地的十字军。1346年，亲英的叔父阿图瓦的罗贝尔三世派他前往加来城下，晋见正在围城的爱德华三世，给国王留下了好印象。1350年，他与格罗斯蒙特的亨利在温奇尔西海战中指挥英格兰旗舰；1354年，他娶王后菲莉帕之妹埃诺的伊莎贝拉为妻，成为国王的连襟。1369年，他获授嘉德骑士。1371年，他率两千人为卢森堡与布拉班特公爵文策尔一世作战，在巴斯韦勒败北，缴纳赎金后获释。他还将让·傅华萨引荐到英格兰，应他之请，傅华萨撰写近世史，1373年完成的《编年史》第一卷便题献给他。他两次婚姻均无子女。

en: Anastasia Orsini was a daughter of Roberto Orsini, count of Nola, and Sveva del Balzo. She married Giordano Orsini, lord of Monterotondo, by whom she had a son, Francesco, and was still living on 7 April 1351.
zh: 阿纳斯塔西娅·奥尔西尼是诺拉伯爵罗贝托·奥尔西尼与斯韦瓦·德尔·巴尔佐之女，嫁给蒙特罗通多领主焦尔达诺·奥尔西尼，生子弗朗切斯科，1351年4月7日仍在世。

en: Angelo Acciaiuoli (c. 1330–1380) was the son of Niccolò Acciaioli, grand seneschal of Naples, and inherited his father's titles in Italy and Greece. From 1358 he was count of Malta and Gozo, and he became the second count of Melfi and count of Gerace, as well as grand seneschal of the kingdom of Sicily and governor of the Neapolitan lands on the island in 1364. He ruled Corinth from 1365 until 1371, when his cousin Nerio I Acciaiuoli drove him out. He died at Messina around 1380.
zh: 安杰洛·阿恰约利（约1330—1380）是那不勒斯大总管尼科洛·阿恰约利之子，继承了父亲在意大利和希腊的头衔。1358年起他成为马耳他与戈佐伯爵，后任第二代梅尔菲伯爵、杰拉切伯爵，1364年出任西西里王国大总管兼那不勒斯在西西里领地的总督。1365年至1371年他统治科林斯，1371年被堂亲内里奥一世·阿恰约利逐出。约1380年，他在墨西拿去世。

en: Antonello de' Cabanni was a son of the Neapolitan royal chamberlain Carlo de' Cabanni and Margherita da Ceccano, and a grandson of the courtier Raimondo de' Cabanni.
zh: 安东内洛·德·卡巴尼是那不勒斯王室侍从官卡洛·德·卡巴尼与玛格丽塔·达·切卡诺之子，朝臣拉伊蒙多·德·卡巴尼之孙。

en: Beatrice of Sicily (c. 1252–1275), second daughter of Charles I of Anjou, king of Sicily, and Beatrice of Provence, was betrothed under the Treaty of Viterbo of May 1267 to Philip of Courtenay, heir to the Latin Empire. The wedding took place at Foggia on 15 October 1273, when she was twenty-one. Days later her father-in-law Baldwin II died, and Philip was proclaimed titular Latin emperor with Beatrice as his empress. Their only child, Catherine of Courtenay, was born on 25 November 1274. Beatrice died in late 1275 after a short illness.
zh: 西西里的贝亚特丽切（约1252—1275）是西西里国王安茹的查理与普罗旺斯的贝亚特丽切的次女。1267年5月的《维泰博条约》把她许配给拉丁帝国继承人库尔特奈的菲利普。1273年10月15日，两人在福贾成婚，时年二十一岁。婚后数日，她的公公鲍德温二世去世，菲利普被拥立为名义上的拉丁皇帝，贝亚特丽切成为名义上的皇后。两人唯一的孩子库尔特奈的凯瑟琳于1274年11月25日出生。贝亚特丽切在短暂患病后于1275年末去世。

en: Beatrice of Anjou (1295–1321), fourteenth child of Charles II of Naples and Mary of Hungary, was twice married for dynastic ends. In 1305 the aged Azzo VIII d'Este, lord of Ferrara, Modena and Reggio, wed the ten-year-old princess after paying her father fifty-one thousand florins; their son Fresco died in 1309, after Azzo himself. Later that same year she married Bertrand III des Baux, Count of Andria in the Kingdom of Naples, by whom she had a daughter, Marie des Baux, born around 1319. Beatrice died in 1321.
zh: 安茹的贝亚特丽切（1295—1321）是那不勒斯国王卡洛二世与匈牙利的玛丽亚的第十四个孩子，两度因王朝利益出嫁。1305年，年迈的费拉拉、摩德纳和雷焦领主埃斯特的阿佐八世向她的父亲支付五万一千弗罗林后，娶下年仅十岁的公主；两人的儿子弗雷斯科于1309年夭折，时在阿佐本人故去之后。同年，她改嫁那不勒斯王国的安德里亚伯爵贝特朗三世·德斯·博，约1319年生下女儿玛丽·德斯·博。贝亚特丽切于1321年去世。

en: Bertrand III des Baux (Bertrando del Balzo) was born at Andria in August 1295, the son of Bertrand II des Baux and Bérengère d'Andria, and became count of Andria. A leading Neapolitan baron, he was senator of Rome in 1323, captain-general of Tuscany from 1326 to 1330, and long served as grand justiciar of the realm. In 1309 he married Beatrice of Anjou, daughter of King Charles II, and later Marguerite d'Aulnay, mother of his heir Francis. Pope Clement VI charged him with punishing the killers of Andrew of Hungary, who was murdered in 1345. He died in Naples in 1347 or 1351.
zh: 贝特朗三世·德斯·博（意大利语名贝尔特兰多·德尔·巴尔佐）1295年8月生于安德里亚，是贝特朗二世·德斯·博与贝朗热尔·德·安德里亚之子，后成为安德里亚伯爵。他是那不勒斯王国的重要封臣：1323年任罗马元老，1326至1330年任托斯卡纳统帅，并长期担任王国大司法官。1309年他娶那不勒斯国王查理二世之女安茹的贝阿特丽切，后又娶玛格丽特·多奈，后者生下继承人弗朗切斯科。教宗克雷芒六世委派他惩办匈牙利的安德烈亚遇刺案的凶手；安德烈亚于1345年遇刺。他于1347年或1351年在那不勒斯去世。

en: Bertrand des Baux (c. 1238–1305), youngest son of Barral des Baux and Sibylle d'Anduze, was the first Angevin count of Avellino. In 1265, with his father, he joined Charles of Anjou's conquest of the Kingdom of Sicily, and in 1268 Charles granted him the county of Avellino with Calvi and Padula; he fought at Tagliacozzo the same year. In 1270–1271 he was Charles's vicar of Rome, directing the city's civil and military government. Avellino rebelled against his harsh rule in 1276. In 1287, commanding a forty-ship fleet against Sicily, he was captured by the Aragonese near Augusta; ransomed, he negotiated a two-year truce with Alfonso III, and died in Provence in 1305.
zh: 贝特朗·德·博（意大利语作贝尔特朗多·德尔·巴尔佐，约1238—1305）是巴拉尔·德·博与西比勒·当迪兹的幼子，也是安茹王朝首任阿韦利诺伯爵。1265年他随父亲加入安茹的查理对西西里王国的征服，1268年查理封给他阿韦利诺伯国及卡尔维、帕杜拉等地，同年他参加塔利亚科佐战役。1270—1271年他出任查理派驻罗马的代理人，掌管城市的民政与军事。1276年阿韦利诺反抗他的严苛统治。1287年他率领四十艘战船的舰队进攻西西里，在奥古斯塔附近被阿拉贡人俘虏，获释后参与谈成与阿方索三世的两年停战协定，1305年死于普罗旺斯。

en: Blanche of Baux (Bianca del Balzo) was a daughter of Bertrand III des Baux, count of Andria, and his second wife Marguerite d'Aulnay, and a sister of Francis I, first duke of Andria.
zh: 布朗什·德斯·博（意大利语名比安卡·德尔·巴尔佐）是安德里亚伯爵贝特朗三世·德斯·博与第二任妻子玛格丽特·多奈之女，第一代安德里亚公爵弗朗切斯科一世的姐妹。

en: Charles, Duke of Calabria (1298–1328), son of Robert the Wise of Naples and Yolanda of Aragon, became Duke of Calabria and vicar of the kingdom on his father's accession in 1309. After Castruccio Castracani won Altopascio in 1325, Florence elected Charles its signore for ten years in 1326. He was then attempting to take Sicily and sent Walter of Brienne as his deputy. Charles's arrival checked Castracani, but he taxed the city harshly and was recalled in 1327 when Emperor Louis IV entered Italy. He died at Naples on 9 November 1328, before his father. His daughter by Marie of Valois inherited Robert's crown as Queen Joanna I, and another daughter, Maria, was born posthumously in 1329.
zh: 卡拉布里亚公爵卡洛（1298—1328）是那不勒斯国王智者罗贝托与亚拉冈的薇尔兰特之子，1309年父亲即位后受封卡拉布里亚公爵并任王国副君。1325年卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼在阿尔托帕肖获胜后，佛罗伦萨于1326年推举卡洛为任期十年的城市领主。他当时正试图夺取西西里，便派布里安的瓦尔特代行职权。卡洛抵达后遏制了卡斯特拉卡尼，却在城中课以重税，1327年因皇帝路易四世进军意大利而被召回。1328年11月9日，他先于父亲在那不勒斯去世。他与瓦卢瓦的玛丽之女后来继承罗贝托的王位，即乔万娜一世；另一女玛丽亚为遗腹女，1329年出生。

en: Carlo de' Cabanni (died by 1340) was the eldest son of Raimondo de' Cabanni, the freed slave who rose to the top of the Neapolitan royal household, and Philippa of Catania, a fisherman's daughter who had been wet nurse to the royal children. He served as royal chamberlain and vice-seneschal of the royal hospice. He married Margherita da Ceccano, a member of the high nobility, and they had four children: Raimondello, Antonello, Sancia and Giovannella. Sancia was a companion of Princesses Joanna and Maria. Within five years of his death the family fell: in 1345 Sancia and Philippa were accused of taking part in the murder of Andrew, Duke of Calabria, husband of Queen Joanna I. Philippa died in prison, Carlo's brother Roberto was executed, and Raimondello was declared innocent in 1346.
zh: 卡洛·德·卡巴尼（至迟于1340年去世）是拉伊蒙多·德·卡巴尼与卡塔尼亚的菲利帕的长子。他的父亲是由奴隶升到那不勒斯王室内廷顶层的自由人，母亲是渔夫之女，曾做王室子女的奶妈。他曾任王室内侍及王宫副总管，娶出身高等贵族的切卡诺的玛格丽塔，两人育有拉伊蒙代洛、安托内洛、桑恰和乔万内拉四个子女。女儿桑恰是乔万娜、玛丽亚两位公主的女伴。他去世后不到五年，家族便告覆灭：1345年，桑恰与菲利帕被指控参与谋杀女王乔万娜一世的丈夫、卡拉布里亚公爵安德烈。菲利帕死于狱中，卡洛的兄弟罗伯托被处决，拉伊蒙代洛则在1346年被宣告无罪。

en: Charles II, called the Lame (1254–1309), King of Naples, was the son of Charles I of Anjou and Prince of Salerno from 1272. After the Sicilian Vespers, his father made him regent on the mainland in 1283; Charles held an assembly that abolished unpopular taxes. Admiral Roger of Lauria captured him in 1284; he was still an Aragonese prisoner when his father died in 1285. Crowned at Rieti by Pope Nicholas IV in 1289, he fought on for Sicily until the Peace of Caltabellotta in 1302, which recognized Frederick's rule for life and provided for the island's return to the Angevins on his death. Charles's daughter Eleanor married Frederick. His children by Maria of Hungary founded the Neapolitan and Hungarian lines, and he died at Naples in May 1309, succeeded by Robert the Wise.
zh: 卡洛二世，绰号跛子（1254—1309），那不勒斯国王，安茹的查理之子，1272年受封萨莱诺亲王。西西里晚祷之后，父亲于1283年任命他为半岛领地的摄政；卡洛召集会议，废除了不得人心的赋税。1284年，海军将领罗杰·德·劳里亚将他俘获；1285年父亲去世时他仍被阿拉贡人囚禁。1289年，教皇尼古拉四世在列蒂为他加冕。他继续争夺西西里，直至1302年签订《卡尔塔贝洛塔和约》，承认腓特烈终身统治该岛，并约定其死后归还安茹家族。卡洛的女儿埃莱奥诺拉嫁给了腓特烈。他与匈牙利的玛丽亚的子女开创了那不勒斯和匈牙利两支安茹世系。1309年5月，他在那不勒斯去世，智者罗贝托继位。

en: Caterina de' Cabanni was a daughter of Roberto de' Cabanni, count of Eboli and grand seneschal of Naples, and Sichelgaita Filomarino. Through her grandmother Philippa of Catania she entered the Angevin court as a lady-in-waiting to the young princesses Joanna and Maria. She was given in marriage to Niccolò d'Aquino, lord of Villamaina, becoming his first wife. She had died by 1370, when Niccolò married his second wife, Rosella Crispano.
zh: 卡泰丽娜·德·卡巴尼是那不勒斯埃博利伯爵、王国大司膳罗伯托·德·卡巴尼与西凯尔加伊塔·菲洛马里诺之女。经祖母菲利帕·卡塔涅塞安排，她进入安茹王廷，成为年幼公主乔安娜与玛丽亚的女伴。她后来嫁给维拉马伊纳领主尼科洛·达奎诺，是其第一任妻子，于1370年之前去世，尼科洛在该年续娶罗塞拉·克里斯帕诺。

en: Charles I of Anjou (1227–1285), youngest son of Louis VIII of France and Blanche of Castile, gained Anjou and Maine from his brother Louis IX and Provence by marrying Beatrice. He accompanied Louis on the Seventh Crusade to Egypt and in 1250 forced Marseille, Arles and Avignon to acknowledge his suzerainty. With papal support he sought Sicily from the Hohenstaufens. Crowned King of Sicily at Rome in 1266, he defeated Manfred at Benevento and the Hohenstaufen heir Conradin at Tagliacozzo in 1268. He became King of Albania in 1272, bought a claim to Jerusalem in 1277 and took Achaea in 1278. The Sicilian Vespers of 1282 cost him the island, but he kept mainland Naples, dying at Foggia in 1285 while preparing its reconquest.
zh: 安茹的查理（1227—1285）是法王路易八世与卡斯蒂利亚的布朗什的幼子，从兄王路易九世处获得安茹和曼恩，又因迎娶贝阿特丽切得到普罗旺斯。他随路易参加了远征埃及的第七次十字军，1250年迫使马赛、阿尔勒和阿维尼翁承认他的宗主权。他在教廷支持下向霍亨斯陶芬家族夺取西西里。1266年，他在罗马加冕为西西里国王，在贝内文托击败曼弗雷迪，1268年又在塔利亚科佐击败霍亨斯陶芬继承人康拉丁。他于1272年成为阿尔巴尼亚国王，1277年购得耶路撒冷王位的宣称权，1278年成为亚该亚亲王。1282年西西里晚祷使他失去西西里岛，但他守住了半岛上的那不勒斯，1285年在福贾筹备反攻时去世。

en: Dominic Thopia (c. 1300s–1382) was born into the Thopia family of Durrës, Albanian nobles who had turned from Orthodoxy to Catholicism, and made his career in the Church instead. Educated in Italy, he joined the Dominicans, and in 1336 King Robert of Naples made him court chaplain and adviser. From 1345 he was the order's vicar for Dalmatia and Durrës and founded its house at Shkodër. Louis I of Hungary backed his appointment as bishop of Ston and Korčula in 1350. His bid for the vacant archbishopric of Dubrovnik in 1360 collapsed: the council, fearing for the city's autonomy, expelled him. As archbishop of Zadar from 1368 to 1376 he received Louis and Queen Elizabeth in 1371, was remembered as Father of the Poor for giving away his possessions, and supported his nephew Karl Thopia's takeover of Durrës. In 1376 he was moved to the bishopric of Bosnia, and he died at Đakovo in 1382.
zh: 多米尼克·托皮亚（约1300年代—1382）出生在都拉斯的托皮亚家族，这个阿尔巴尼亚贵族家族已由东正教改宗天主教，而他选择在教会中谋出路。他在意大利受教，加入多明我会，1336年那不勒斯国王罗贝尔任命他为宫廷神父和顾问。1345年起，他任该会驻达尔马提亚与都拉斯的总代理，并创建了会在斯库台的修院。匈牙利的拉约什一世支持他于1350年出任斯通与科尔丘拉主教。1360年他争取空缺的杜布罗夫尼克大主教职位，却以失败告终：议会担心城市自治受损，将他驱逐。1368至1376年任扎达尔大主教，1371年接待了拉约什与王后伊丽莎白，他把财物散给穷人，被称为“穷人之父”；他还支持侄子卡尔·托皮亚夺取都拉斯。1376年他调任波斯尼亚主教，1382年在贾科沃去世。

en: Elizabeth of Hungary (c. 1255–c. 1322), daughter of Stephen V and his Cuman queen, was raised in the Dominican monastery on Rabbits' Island, founded by her grandfather Béla IV. Her aunt Margaret lived there and wished Elizabeth to succeed her as head of the community. Elizabeth was recorded as prioress in 1278. In 1288 she was carried off by Bohemian magnate Záviš of Falkenstein, in a marriage unrecognised by the Hungarian Church; Záviš was executed in 1290. Her alleged marriage to Stefan Uroš II Milutin of Serbia and its place in the sequence of her marriages remain disputed. By 1300 she retired to a Dominican convent in Naples, dying there honoured as Blessed Elizabeth the Widow.
zh: 匈牙利的伊丽莎白（约1255—约1322）是伊什特万五世与库曼王后之女，自幼在祖父贝拉四世创办的兔子岛多明我会修道院长大。她的姑母玛格丽特住在这里，曾希望伊丽莎白继任修道院院长。1278年的记载称她已任院长。1288年她被波希米亚大贵族法尔肯施泰因的扎维什劫走，匈牙利教会不承认这段婚姻；扎维什于1290年被处死。她是否曾嫁给塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·乌罗什二世·米卢廷，以及这段婚姻的先后次序，均有争议。1300年时她已退居那不勒斯的一座多明我会修道院，最终在那里去世，被尊为真福者“寡妇伊丽莎白”。

en: Eloisa of Anjou (January or February 1325 – 27 December 1325) was the eldest child of Charles, Duke of Calabria, and Marie of Valois, and an elder sister of the future Queen Joanna I; she died before reaching her first birthday.
zh: 安茹的埃洛伊丝（1325年1或2月—1325年12月27日）是卡拉布里亚公爵卡洛与瓦卢瓦的玛丽亚的长女，也是后来的女王乔万娜一世的姐姐，未满周岁便夭折。

en: Elzéar of Sabran (1285–1323), baron of Ansouis and count of Ariano, was a Provençal nobleman and Franciscan tertiary serving the Angevin kings of Naples. He was educated at the Abbey of St. Victor in Marseille under his uncle, its abbot. He and his wife Delphine of Glandèves took vows of chastity and joined the Franciscan Third Order together. He inherited Ariano on his father's death in 1309. In 1312 he led King Robert of Naples' army to Rome against Emperor Henry VII, and in 1317 became tutor and later castellan to Robert's son Duke Charles. In 1323 he went as ambassador to Paris to arrange Charles's marriage to Marie of Valois, dying there on 27 September after completing the mission. He was canonised as a saint around 1371.
zh: 普罗旺斯贵族埃尔泽阿·达·萨布拉诺（1285—1323）是昂苏伊男爵、阿里亚诺伯爵，也是方济各第三会会士，效力于那不勒斯的安茹王朝。他在马赛圣维克多修道院受教育，由身为院长的叔父教导。他与妻子格朗代沃的德尔菲娜立下守贞誓约，共同加入方济各第三会。1309年父亲去世后，他继承阿里亚诺。1312年，他率领那不勒斯国王罗贝托的军队进军罗马，对抗神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利七世；1317年，他成为罗贝托之子查理公爵的导师，后来又任其城堡总管。1323年，他出使巴黎，为查理迎娶瓦卢瓦的玛丽议婚，完成使命后于9月27日在巴黎去世。他约于1371年被册封为圣徒。

en: Philip of Majorca (1288–c. 1343) was the youngest of the four sons of James II of Majorca and Esclaramunda of Foix, in a family given to piety: his grandfather James I had given up his crowns to become a monk. At Avignon in 1308 Philip met the Spiritual Franciscan Angelo da Clareno, and from 1311 he sheltered him at Perpignan when he was persecuted. Philip joined the Franciscan Third Order and held that all clergy should live in poverty, even after John XXII denounced the Spirituals as heretics in 1316.
