When she died childless in 1255, her kinsman Leone dalle Carceri claimed the inheritance against the triarchs Narzotto dalle Carceri and Guglielmo da Verona, and appealed to William II of Villehardouin, Prince of Achaea. The quarrel drew in Venice and most of Frankish Greece as the War of the Euboeote Succession; Leone's son Grapella ultimately succeeded her.
zh: 卡林塔娜·达莱·卡尔切里（？—1255）约自1220年起以奥雷奥斯为治所统治内格罗蓬特的北区，直至去世。她继承了父亲里扎尔多·达莱·卡尔切里——1216年拉瓦诺死后设立的六名伦巴第六分领主之一。1255年她死后无嗣，亲属莱昂内·达莱·卡尔切里向另外两名三头统治者纳尔佐托·达莱·卡尔切里、古列尔莫·达·维罗纳主张继承权，并向亚该亚亲王威廉二世·德·维尔阿杜安申诉。争端把威尼斯和法兰克希腊的多数统治者卷入埃维亚继承战争；莱昂内之子格拉佩拉最终继承了她的领地。

en: Felisa da Verona was a Lombard noblewoman of Negroponte, daughter of Guglielmo I da Verona, triarch of the central third, and sister of Giberto II. Her first husband was Narzotto dalle Carceri, triarch of the southern third around Karystos, who died in 1264. Afterwards Licario, an ambitious knight whose father came from Vicenza and who served her brother, wooed and secretly married her, but her relatives had the match dissolved and drove him out. Licario took service with Emperor Michael VIII Palaiologus and conquered most of Euboea for Byzantium.
zh: 费利萨·达·维罗纳是内格罗蓬特的伦巴第贵族女性，中部三执政古列尔莫一世·达·维罗纳之女、吉贝尔托二世之妹。她先嫁据有卡里斯托一带南部三头领地的纳尔佐托·达莱·卡尔切里，纳尔佐托于1264年去世。此后，在她兄长麾下效力、父亲来自维琴察的野心骑士利卡里奥向她求爱并秘密成婚，但她的亲属废除了这桩婚事并将他赶走。利卡里奥遂投效拜占庭皇帝米哈伊尔八世·巴列奥略，为拜占庭征服埃维亚岛大部。

en: Francesco of Verona was a Lombard lord of Frankish Negroponte whose youngest son Boniface sold the castle he inherited from him in 1287.
zh: 弗朗切斯科·达维罗纳是法兰克人治下内格罗蓬特的伦巴第领主，其幼子博尼法乔·达维罗纳于1287年卖掉了从他那里继承的城堡。

en: Gaetano da Verona (died 1296) was a Lombard lord of Frankish Negroponte, a son of Francesco of Verona and kinsman of the triarch Giberto II da Verona. Before 1271 he obtained a sixth of the northern triarchy of Oreos. He died in 1296. His daughter Maria inherited his share and married Albert Pallavicini, marquess of Bodonitsa, and then Andrea Cornaro, baron of Scarpanto.
zh: 加埃塔诺·达·维罗纳（？—1296）是法兰克人治下内格罗蓬特的伦巴第贵族领主，弗朗切斯科·达维罗纳之子、三执政吉贝尔托二世·达·维罗纳的族人。1271年之前，他获得北部奥雷奥斯三头领地的六分之一。他于1296年去世，其女玛丽亚继承他的份额，先后嫁给博多尼察侯爵阿尔贝托·帕拉维奇尼和斯卡尔潘托男爵安德烈亚·科尔纳罗。

en: Giberto da Verona (died c. 1208) was a Veronese nobleman of the dalle Carceri kindred and one of the first triarchs of the Frankish island of Negroponte. In 1200 he and his kinsman Ravano joined the Venetian host of the Fourth Crusade and fought at the capture of Constantinople, then took service with Boniface of Montferrat, king of Thessalonica. In August 1205 Boniface enfeoffed him with the central third of Euboea around Chalkis. He died about 1208, leaving two sons, Guglielmo I and Alberto, who later held triarch shares on the island.
zh: 吉贝尔托一世·达·维罗纳（？—约1208）出身维罗纳的达莱·卡尔切里贵族家族，是法兰克人治下内格罗蓬特岛最早的三执政之一。1200年，他与亲属拉万加入第四次十字军的威尼斯军队，参加了攻占君士坦丁堡之役，随后效力于萨洛尼卡国王蒙费拉的博尼法乔。1205年8月，博尼法乔将埃维亚岛以哈尔基斯为中心的中部三分之一封给他。他约于1208年去世，留有古列尔莫一世与阿尔贝托二子，后来都在该岛分得三头领地。

en: Giberto II da Verona (died 1278) was triarch of the central third of Negroponte from 1275, the second son of Guglielmo I da Verona and Simone de Villehardouin. He succeeded after his elder brother Guglielmo II fell fighting the Byzantines, at the height of the reconquest of Euboea led by the Byzantine admiral Licario. Giberto joined Marino II dalle Carceri, triarch of the north, in resisting the invasion, but in 1278 the two triarchs lost a decisive battle and perished or fled the island. Central Euboea then passed under Byzantine control.
zh: 吉贝尔托二世·达·维罗纳（？—1278）自1275年起任内格罗蓬特中部三头领地的三执政，是古列尔莫一世·达·维罗纳与西蒙娜·德·维尔阿杜安的次子。兄长古列尔莫二世在与拜占庭人作战时战死后，他在拜占庭海军将领利卡里奥大举收复埃维亚之际继位。他联合北部三执政马里诺二世·达莱·卡尔切里抵抗入侵，但1278年两位三执政在决战中失败，非战死即逃离该岛，埃维亚中部随后落入拜占庭之手。

en: George I Ghisi (died 15 March 1311), son of the Venetian lord Bartholomew Ghisi, held the Achaean barony of Chalandritsa through his first wife, heiress of Guy of Dramelay. In 1292, as castellan of Kalamata, he attacked Roger of Lauria's raiding Aragonese fleet near Navarino, was captured, and freed only for a heavy ransom. In Venice's war with Byzantium he helped seize Keos and Serifos, and in 1303 inherited Tinos and Mykonos from his father. Through his second wife Alice dalle Carceri he became triarch of Negroponte, and fell against the Catalan Company at the Cephissos in 1311.
zh: 乔治一世·吉西（卒于1311年3月15日）是威尼斯领主巴尔托洛梅奥·吉西之子，凭借第一任妻子——德拉姆莱的居伊的女继承人——成为亚该亚亲王国的哈兰德里察男爵。1292年，他以卡拉马塔城防司令身份在纳瓦里诺附近进攻罗杰·德·劳里亚的阿拉贡劫掠舰队，战败被俘，付出巨额赎金后才获释。威尼斯与拜占庭交战期间，他与另两名威尼斯人合伙夺取凯阿岛和塞里福斯岛，1303年又继承父亲的蒂诺斯岛与米科诺斯岛。他凭第二任妻子阿莉切·达莱·卡尔切里成为内格罗蓬特三执政之一，1311年在凯菲索斯之战（即阿尔米罗斯之战）中被加泰罗尼亚佣兵团击杀。

en: George II Ghisi (c. 1318–1344/45), son of Bartholomew II Ghisi, was lord of Tinos and Mykonos and triarch of Negroponte. In 1326/27 his father married him to Simona of Aragon, daughter of the Catalan vicar-general Alfonso Fadrique, sealing peace with the Catalans; her dowry brought half the castellany of Saint Omer in Thebes. He succeeded in 1341. At Clement VI's call in 1343 he armed a galley for the first Smyrniote crusade alongside Duke John I Sanudo. The crusade's leaders Henry of Asti, Martino Zaccaria and the Venetian admiral Pietro Zeno all died in the fighting, and George vanishes from the record after 1344/45, so he may have gone in person and fallen with them. His minor son Bartholomew III succeeded under Simona's regency.
zh: 乔治二世·吉西（约1318—1344/45）是巴尔托洛梅奥二世·吉西之子，领有蒂诺斯岛、米科诺斯岛，并任内格罗蓬特三主之一。1326/27年，父亲为他与加泰罗尼亚副王阿方索·法德里克之女、阿拉贡的西莫娜成婚，以此同加泰罗尼亚人讲和；西莫娜的嫁妆是底比斯圣奥梅尔城堡领地的一半。1341年他继承父亲之位。1343年应教皇克雷芒六世号召，他与纳克索斯公爵乔瓦尼一世·萨努多合力装备一艘桨帆船，参加第一次士麦那十字军。这支十字军的统帅阿斯蒂的亨利、马尔蒂诺·扎卡里亚和威尼斯海军统帅彼得罗·泽诺先后战死，乔治在1344/45年之后也不再见于记载，可能亲赴战场，与他们一同阵亡。幼子巴尔托洛梅奥三世继位，由西莫娜摄政。

en: Giovanni dalle Carceri (c. 1330–1358) was central triarch of Negroponte from 1340 to 1358. The son of Peter dalle Carceri and Balzana Gozzadini, he inherited Chalkis in 1340 aged ten, under his mother's regency and the tutorship of his uncle Domenico Gozzadini, until he came of age in 1349. A mooted sale of his claims to Duke John I Sanudo of Naxos instead became a marriage with the duke's daughter Florence, with a rich dowry. From 1350 to 1352 he gave Venice substantial help against Genoa, and on his death in 1358 his son Nicholas III succeeded.
zh: 乔瓦尼·达莱·卡尔切里（约1330—1358）是1340至1358年的内格罗蓬特中部三执政。他是彼得·达莱·卡尔切里与巴尔扎娜·戈扎迪尼之子，1340年父亲去世时年仅十岁，继承哈尔基斯，由母亲摄政、舅父多梅尼科·戈扎迪尼监护，1349年成年亲政。他曾打算把自己的权利卖给纳克索斯公爵乔瓦尼一世·萨努多，最终改为迎娶公爵之女菲奥伦扎，并得到丰厚嫁妆。1350至1352年威尼斯对热那亚作战期间，他向威尼斯提供大量援助；1358年去世，其子尼科洛三世继位。

en: Grapella dalle Carceri (died 1264) was a Lombard triarch of Negroponte, the son of Leone dalle Carceri and son-in-law of Guglielmo I da Verona, whose daughter Margherita he married. After Carintana dalle Carceri died childless in 1255, his family's claim to the northern triarchy of Oreos helped provoke the War of the Euboeote Succession. In the peace of 1262, William II of Villehardouin recognized Grapella, Guglielmo and Narzotto dalle Carceri as the island's three triarchs. He ruled until his death in 1264.
zh: 格拉佩拉·达莱·卡尔切里（？—1264）是内格罗蓬特的伦巴第三头统治者，莱昂内·达莱·卡尔切里之子，娶古列尔莫一世·达·维罗纳之女玛格丽塔为妻。1255年卡林塔娜·达莱·卡尔切里死后无嗣，他的家族对北区奥雷奥斯的继承权主张促成了埃维亚继承战争。在1262年的和约中，威廉二世·德·维尔阿杜安承认格拉佩拉、古列尔莫与纳尔佐托·达莱·卡尔切里为岛上的三名三头统治者。他统治至1264年去世。

en: Grapozzo dalle Carceri was a Lombard triarch of Euboea (Negroponte) in Frankish Greece, ruling the northern third at Oreos from 1279 until about 1315. His son by Beatrice of Verona was Peter dalle Carceri, later Baron of Arcadia.
zh: 格拉波佐·达莱·卡尔切里是法兰克希腊埃维亚岛（内格罗蓬特）的伦巴第三头，1279至约1315年镇守北部的奥雷奥斯。他与贝亚特丽切·达·维罗纳所生的儿子彼得·达莱·卡尔切里后任阿卡迪亚男爵。

en: Guglielmo I da Verona (died 1263) ruled the central third of Frankish Euboea around Chalkis as triarch from 1216. Only an infant when his father Giberto, one of the original triarchs, died, he received the family share in 1217 with his brother Alberto. Through his first wife Elena of Montferrat, niece of King Demetrius, he bore the title king of Thessalonica in 1243–1246. In 1256 he and his son-in-law Narzotto dalle Carceri opposed William II of Villehardouin's seizure of a triarchy but were beaten at Karydi. He died in a Byzantine raid in 1263.
zh: 古列尔莫一世·达·维罗纳（？—1263）自1216年起担任三执政，统治法兰克人治下埃维亚岛以哈尔基斯为中心的中部三分之一。父亲吉贝尔托是初代三执政之一，去世时他尚在襁褓，1217年与兄弟阿尔贝托一同领受家族份额。他凭第一任妻子、德米特里国王的侄女蒙费拉的埃莱娜，于1243—1246年拥有萨洛尼卡国王的头衔。1256年，他与女婿纳尔佐托·达莱·卡尔切里反对威廉二世·德·维尔阿杜安夺取一头领地，却在卡里迪之战中被击败。1263年，他在拜占庭人的一次袭击中身亡。

en: Guglielmo II da Verona (died 1273/75) was a Lombard noble of Negroponte, the second son of Guglielmo I da Verona, triarch of the central third of Euboea and for a time titular king of Thessalonica. Guglielmo married Catherine, a niece of Prince William II of Villehardouin, and was killed fighting the Byzantine fleet at the sea battle of Demetrias, near modern Volos.
zh: 古列尔莫二世·达·维罗纳（？—1273/75）是内格罗蓬特的伦巴第贵族，古列尔莫一世·达·维罗纳的次子；其父领有埃维亚岛中部三主辖区，还曾一度为挂名的塞萨洛尼基国王。他娶亚该亚亲王威廉二世·德·维尔阿杜安的侄女卡特琳为妻，最终在今沃洛斯附近的德米特里阿斯海战中对抗拜占庭舰队时阵亡。

en: Isabella dalle Carceri (died 1220) was a Lombard noblewoman who ruled Chalkis on the Frankish island of Negroponte after her husband's death. Sometime before 25 May 1212 Pope Innocent III empowered the Archbishop of Athens to marry her to Ravano dalle Carceri, lord of the island, even though she was then another man's wife. When Ravano died in 1216 the Venetian bailiff divided Euboea into sixths, assigning Isabella half of the central third around Chalkis, which she held until her death. She has sometimes been identified with the trobairitz Ysabella.
zh: 伊莎贝拉·达莱·卡尔切里（？—1220）是伦巴第贵族女性，丈夫死后成为法兰克人治下内格罗蓬特岛哈尔基斯的执政女领主。1212年5月25日之前，教皇英诺森三世特许雅典大主教为她与该岛君主拉万·达莱·卡尔切里主持婚礼，尽管她当时仍是他人之妻。1216年拉万去世后，威尼斯政务官将埃维亚岛分为六份，把哈尔基斯所在中部三头领地的一半分给她，她统治至1220年去世。也有说法认为她就是女游吟诗人伊莎贝拉。

en: Leone dalle Carceri (last attested 1259) was a Lombard baron of Negroponte and a kinsman of Carintana dalle Carceri, triarch of the northern third of Oreos. When Carintana died childless in 1255 and the other two triarchs, Narzotto dalle Carceri and Guglielmo da Verona, shut his family out of her inheritance, Leone appealed to William II of Villehardouin, Prince of Achaea and overlord of the island. William imprisoned the two triarchs and occupied Oreos, opening the War of the Euboeote Succession. Leone's son Grapella was recognized as triarch in the peace of 1262.
zh: 莱昂内·达莱·卡尔切里（1259年最后见载）是内格罗蓬特的伦巴第贵族，北区奥雷奥斯三头统治者卡林塔娜·达莱·卡尔切里的亲属。1255年卡林塔娜死后无嗣，另外两名三头统治者纳尔佐托·达莱·卡尔切里与古列尔莫·达·维罗纳将他的家族排除在继承之外，莱昂内遂向埃维亚岛封君、亚该亚亲王威廉二世·德·维尔阿杜安申诉。威廉囚禁两名三头统治者并占领奥雷奥斯，埃维亚继承战争由此爆发。在1262年的和约中，莱昂内之子格拉佩拉被承认为三头统治者。

en: Margaret van Liedekerke, daughter of Engilbert of Liederkerque, Grand Constable of Achaea, married the Negroponte triarch Bartholomew II Ghisi and was the mother of George II Ghisi. In 1326–1327 she was for a time imprisoned.
zh: 玛格丽特·范·利德凯尔克是亚该亚大统帅恩吉尔伯特·范·利德凯尔克之女，嫁与内格罗蓬特三执政巴尔托洛梅奥二世·吉西，生子乔治二世；1326至1327年她一度被关押。

en: Maria dalle Carceri (died 1323) was sovereign marchioness of Bodonitsa from 1311 until her death. Born to a Lombard family of Verona that had reached Greece with the Fourth Crusade, she was the daughter of Gaetano and heiress to a sixth of Euboea. Her first husband, Albert Pallavicini, was killed at the Battle of the Cephissus in 1311, and Maria succeeded him, dividing the march with their daughter Guglielma under the Assizes of Romania. She kept the Catalan Company from taking Bodonitsa but paid them an annual tribute of four warhorses, then married Andrea Cornaro for protection.
zh: 玛丽亚·达莱·卡尔切里（？—1323）自1311年起担任博多尼察执政女侯爵，直至去世。她出身随第四次十字军抵达希腊的维罗纳伦巴第家族，是加埃塔诺之女，并继承了埃维亚岛六分之一的领地。她的第一任丈夫阿尔贝托·帕拉维奇尼于1311年在凯菲索斯河战役中阵亡，玛丽亚继位，并依《罗马尼亚法令》与女儿古列尔玛瓜分侯国。她使博多尼察免于被加泰罗尼亚佣兵团吞并，但须年年向其进贡四匹战马；随后她为求得庇护改嫁安德烈亚·科尔纳罗。

en: Marino dalle Carceri, also called Merino de Carcere, was a Lombard nobleman of Frankish Negroponte, a son of Niccolò dalle Carceri, of the Veronese family that held the triarchies of Euboea.
zh: 马里诺·达莱·卡尔切里（一作梅里诺·德·卡尔切雷）是法兰克人治下内格罗蓬特的伦巴第贵族，尼古拉·达莱·卡尔切里之子，出自据有埃维亚诸三头领地的维罗纳家族。

en: Marino Ghisi, a younger son of the Venetian lord George I Ghisi and brother of Bartholomew II, joined Bartholomew in selling their half of the island of Kea to Ruggiero Premarin in 1328.
zh: 马里诺·吉西是威尼斯领主乔治一世·吉西较年幼的儿子、巴尔托洛梅奥二世之弟；1328年，他与巴尔托洛梅奥把两人共有的半座凯阿岛卖给鲁杰罗·普雷马林。

en: Marino I dalle Carceri (died 1247) was a Lombard hexarch of Negroponte who ruled the northern triarchy from Oreos. A son of Redondello dalle Carceri and nephew of Ravano, who had held all Euboea until 1216, he married Margherita, daughter of Pecoraro da Mercanuovo, the first lord of Oreos. When Ravano died, the Venetian bailo split the island into six hexarchies, and Marino took one of the northern shares with his brother Rizzardo. He ruled until 1247, and his son Narzotto later became triarch of Chalkis.
zh: 马里诺一世·达莱·卡尔切里（？—1247）是内格罗蓬特的伦巴第六分领主，以奥雷奥斯为治所统治北区。他是雷东代洛·达莱·卡尔切里之子、拉瓦诺的侄子，娶奥雷奥斯首任领主佩科拉罗·达·梅尔卡诺沃的女儿玛格丽塔为妻。1216年拉瓦诺死后，威尼斯驻岛长官将全岛分为六份，马里诺与兄弟里扎尔多共同分得北区。他统治至1247年，其子纳尔佐托后来成为哈尔基斯的三头统治者。

en: Marino II dalle Carceri, also called Merineto (died 1278), was the son of Narzotto dalle Carceri, triarch of the southern third of Negroponte, and Felisa da Verona. On Narzotto's death in 1264 he inherited the southern triarchy based at Karystos while still a child, ruling under his mother's regency. In 1268 he joined the peace agreement between Venice and Byzantium; in 1270 he allied with Guglielmo II, triarch of central Negroponte, against Byzantium. In 1278, the year of his death, Byzantine troops under the Italian renegade Licario overran most of Euboea. His son Grapozzo dalle Carceri later held the northern triarchy of Oreos.
zh: 马里诺二世·达莱·卡尔切里（又名梅里内托，？—1278）是内格罗蓬特南部三分之一领地三执政纳尔佐托·达莱·卡尔切里与费利萨·达·维罗纳之子。1264年父亲去世后，他在幼年继领以卡里斯托斯为中心的南部三头领地，由母亲摄政。1268年，他加入威尼斯与拜占庭的和约；1270年，他与内格罗蓬特中部三执政古列尔莫二世结盟，反对拜占庭。1278年，意大利叛逃者利卡里奥率领拜占庭军队攻占埃维亚大部，马里诺二世也在同年去世。其子格拉波佐·达莱·卡尔切里后来据有北部的奥雷奥斯三头领地。

en: Narzotto dalle Carceri was a Lombard nobleman of the Veronese dalle Carceri family who ruled the southern third, or triarchy, of the Frankish island of Negroponte from 1247 until his death in 1264, holding the barony of Karystos. He married Felisa da Verona, daughter of William I of Verona, triarch of the central third around Chalkis and titular king of Thessalonica.
zh: 纳尔佐托·达莱·卡尔切里是维罗纳达莱·卡尔切里家族的伦巴第贵族，自1247年起统治法兰克人治下内格罗蓬特岛的南部三分之一，领有卡里斯托男爵领，直至1264年去世。他娶费利萨·达·维罗纳为妻，后者是据有哈尔基斯一带中部三头领地的古列尔莫一世·达·维罗纳之女，古列尔莫还曾是名义上的萨洛尼卡国王。

en: Nicolò dalle Carceri was a Veronese noble, a son of Redondello dalle Carceri and brother of the Negroponte triarchs Marino I and Rizzardo; genealogical sources name his son Marino.
zh: 尼科洛·达莱·卡尔切里是维罗纳贵族，雷东代洛·达莱·卡尔切里之子，内格罗蓬特三头统治者马里诺一世与里扎尔多的兄弟；家谱记载他的儿子名叫马里诺。

en: Peter dalle Carceri (Italian Pietro, died 1340) gathered most of Negroponte into one hand. Since the Fourth Crusade, Euboea had been split into three thirds, Chalkis, Karystos and Oreos, run by a few interrelated Lombard families under growing Venetian influence. Peter succeeded his father Grapozzo to a share of Oreos and inherited half of Chalkis from his mother Beatrice of Verona. In 1328 he added the other half of Chalkis, held by Maria Navigajoso, and succeeded Maria dalle Carceri to a share of Karystos, giving him two thirds of the island. By 1324 he also held half the Barony of Arcadia in Achaea, usually thought to have come through his second marriage to Balzana Gozzadini, widow of Erard II of Aulnay, who died soon afterwards. When Peter died in 1340, Chalkis passed to Giovanni, his only son by that marriage; the last triarchs would leave the island to Venice in 1383 and 1390.
zh: 彼得·达莱·卡尔切里（意大利语名彼得罗，？—1340）把内格罗蓬特的大半收归一手。第四次十字军东征以来，埃维亚岛被分成哈尔基斯、卡里斯托和奥雷奥斯三个“三分之一”，由几个彼此联姻的伦巴第家族掌管，受威尼斯的影响日增。彼得继承父亲格拉波佐在奥雷奥斯的份额，又从母亲贝亚特丽切·达·维罗纳处继承半个哈尔基斯。1328年，他取得原属玛丽亚·纳维加约佐的另外半个哈尔基斯，并继受玛丽亚·达莱·卡尔切里在卡里斯托的份额，据有全岛的三分之二。至1324年，他还持有亚该亚亲王国阿卡迪亚男爵领的一半，通常认为这是他与奥奈男爵埃拉尔二世的遗孀巴尔扎娜·戈扎迪尼的第二次婚姻所得，巴尔扎娜不久后去世。彼得于1340年去世，哈尔基斯传给这次婚姻所生的独子乔瓦尼；末代三头后来在1383年和1390年把全岛留给了威尼斯。

en: Ravano dalle Carceri (died 1216) was a Veronese nobleman who joined the Fourth Crusade and helped conquer Euboea from the Byzantines in 1205. King Boniface of Thessalonica divided the island into three triarchies and probably granted him the central third around Chalkis. In 1209, after the other triarchs died or left, Ravano seized the whole island, briefly defied the Latin Emperor Henry, then foiled a plot against the emperor's life and kept Negroponte until his death. In 1217 the Venetian bailiff split Euboea into sixths, his daughter Bertha sharing Chalkis with Ravano's widow Isabella.
zh: 拉万·达莱·卡尔切里（？—1216）是维罗纳贵族，参加第四次十字军，于1205年参与从拜占庭手中夺取埃维亚岛。萨洛尼卡国王博尼法乔将该岛分为三个三头领地，可能把以哈尔基斯为中心的中部三分之一封给了他。1209年，在另外两巨头或死或离去后，拉万夺取全岛，一度抗拒拉丁皇帝亨利，随后又挫败了一起谋害皇帝的阴谋，至死保有内格罗蓬特。1217年，威尼斯派驻的政务官将埃维亚岛分为六份，其女贝尔塔与他的遗孀伊莎贝拉平分哈尔基斯。

en: Rizzardo dalle Carceri (died 1220) was a Lombard hexarch of Negroponte. A son of Redondello dalle Carceri and nephew of Ravano, who had ruled all Euboea until his death in 1216, he received one of the two shares of the northern triarchy of Oreos in the partition arbitrated by the Venetian bailo, ruling it alongside his brother Marino I. He died in 1220, and his daughter Carintana inherited his sixth. When she died childless in 1255, the dispute over her inheritance grew into the War of the Euboeote Succession.
zh: 里扎尔多·达莱·卡尔切里（？—1220）是内格罗蓬特的伦巴第六分领主。他是雷东代洛·达莱·卡尔切里之子、拉瓦诺的侄子；拉瓦诺在1216年去世前统治整个埃维亚岛，随后在威尼斯驻岛长官仲裁的瓜分中，他与兄弟马里诺一世共同领有以奥雷奥斯为治所的北区。他于1220年去世，女儿卡林塔娜继承了他的份额；卡林塔娜于1255年死后无嗣，继承争端演变为埃维亚继承战争。

en: Simona of Aragon was a daughter of the Catalan vicar-general of Athens, Alfonso Fadrique, and Marulla da Verona. In 1326–1327 she was married to George II Ghisi, lord of Tinos and Mykonos, to seal peace between the Catalans and the Ghisi; her dowry was half the castellany of Saint Omer in Thebes. After George II's death she became regent for their minor son Bartholomew III, governing Tinos, Mykonos and the Negroponte triarchy until he came of age in 1358.
zh: 阿拉贡的西莫娜是雅典加泰罗尼亚副王阿方索·法德里克与马鲁拉·达·维罗纳之女。1326至1327年，她嫁给蒂诺斯与米科诺斯领主乔治二世·吉西，以巩固加泰罗尼亚人与吉西家族之间的和约；她的嫁妆是底比斯圣奥梅尔城堡领地的一半。乔治二世死后，她为年幼的儿子巴尔托洛梅奥三世摄政，统辖蒂诺斯岛、米科诺斯岛与内格罗蓬特三主辖区，直到1358年儿子成年。

en: Amadeus of Neuchâtel (died 3 February 1288), son of Rudolph III and Sibylle de Montfaucon, was co-lord of Neuchâtel with his brothers Ulrich IV and Henry from their father's death in 1263. On 8 August 1270 his grandfather Theodoric III of Montbéliard arbitrated the succession: Amadeus, the elder brother, received Henry's liege homage for his share, while their sisters were assigned revenues on Boudry and the Côte. Later that year he married Jordane of La Sarraz, lady of Belmont. He ruled alone from Henry's death in 1283, and his son Rudolph IV, born in 1274, succeeded him.
zh: 阿梅代（纳沙泰尔）（？—1288年2月3日）是鲁道夫三世与西比勒·德·蒙福孔之子，1263年父亲死后与兄弟乌尔里希四世、亨利共同担任纳沙泰尔领主。1270年8月8日，外祖父蒙贝利亚尔的蒂埃里三世仲裁分家：长兄阿梅代接受亨利为其分得的封地行效忠礼，两个姊妹则分得布德里和拉科特的收入。同年，他娶贝尔蒙女主、拉萨拉的若尔达娜为妻。1283年亨利死后他独领全境，1274年出生的儿子鲁道夫四世后来继位。

en: Berthold I of Neuchâtel (c. 1183–1259) was the son of Rodolphe II. In 1214, under the guardianship of his uncle Ulrich III of Nidau, a charter of franchises let burghers disputing with him seek the bishop of Lausanne's arbitration. After a partition with Ulrich in 1218, Berthold took the title of lord while his uncle kept that of count; from Ulrich's death in 1225 Berthold styled himself count again. After the bishop of Basel burned Neuchâtel in 1249, Berthold founded Nugerol in 1253 and set up a court of the Three Estates and a town council. His son by Richenza of Frobourg was Rodolphe III.
zh: 贝尔托德一世（纳沙泰尔）（约1183—1259）是鲁道夫二世之子。1214年，在叔父尼道的乌尔里希三世监护下，城镇居民获颁自由特许状，允许与伯爵发生争讼的市民请求洛桑主教仲裁。1218年，他与叔父分家，本人取领主头衔、叔父保留伯爵头衔；1225年乌尔里希死后，贝尔托德重新自称伯爵。1249年巴塞尔主教焚毁纳沙泰尔后，贝尔托德于1253年兴建讷日罗尔镇，又设立“三等级法庭”和市议会。他与弗罗堡的里琴莎所生之子是鲁道夫三世。

en: Eleanor of Savoy-Vaud was a daughter of Louis I of Vaud, baron of the Pays de Vaud, and Jeanne de Montfort. On 18 October 1294 she married Rudolph IV, lord of Neuchâtel, and was the mother of his heir Louis I, born in 1305.
zh: 埃莱奥诺尔·德·萨伏依-沃是沃地男爵路易一世·德·萨伏依-沃与让娜·德·蒙福尔之女。1294年10月18日，她嫁给纳沙泰尔领主鲁道夫四世，是继承人路易一世（1305年生）的母亲。

en: Louis I (1305–1373) ruled as count of Neuchâtel from 1325, the son of Count Rudolph IV and Eleanor of Savoy-Vaud. In 1343 he swore fealty to the Holy Roman Empire as a citizen of Besançon and granted liberties to the men of Boudry. Emperor Charles IV gave him in 1347 the right to mint coin and levy tolls, adding criminal justice in 1354. He campaigned with Albert II of Austria against Zurich in 1351 and became councillor to Duke Rudolf IV in 1359. His three sons predeceased him, so his daughters Isabella and Varenne inherited the county in 1373.
zh: 路易一世（1305—1373）自1325年起担任纳沙泰尔伯爵，是伯爵鲁道夫四世与萨伏依-沃的埃莱奥诺尔之子。1343年，他以贝桑松市民身份向神圣罗马帝国宣誓效忠，同年向布德里居民授予自由特许状。1347年，皇帝查理四世赐他铸币与征收通行税的权利，1354年又加授刑事司法权。1351年他随奥地利的阿尔布雷希特二世出征苏黎世，1359年成为公爵鲁道夫四世的顾问。他的三个儿子均先他而死，1373年他去世后，女儿伊莎贝拉与瓦雷娜继承了伯国。

en: Rudolph III of Neuchâtel (died 1263), son of Count Berthold I and Richenza of Frobourg, was created the first count of Thielle. After fire destroyed the old castle in 1249, he built the new castle of Neuchâtel in 1250. From his father's death in 1259 he ruled as lord of Neuchâtel until 1263, exceptionally styling himself count. In 1260 he granted franchises to the suburbs of Nugerol. He married Sibylle, daughter of Count Theodoric III of Montbéliard, and their son Amadeus succeeded as lord.
zh: 鲁道夫三世（纳沙泰尔）（？—1263）是贝尔托德一世伯爵与弗罗堡的里琴莎之子，受封为首任蒂埃尔伯爵。1249年旧城堡失火后，他于1250年主持修建纳沙泰尔新城堡。1259年父亲去世后，他以纳沙泰尔领主身份统治至1263年，并罕见地使用伯爵头衔。1260年，他向讷日罗尔城郊颁授自由特许状。他娶蒙贝利亚尔伯爵蒂埃里三世之女西比勒为妻，其子阿梅代后来继任领主。

en: Rudolph IV (1274–1343), called Rollin, succeeded his father Amadeus as lord of Neuchâtel in 1288; he lost imperial immediacy and received his lands as a fief from John I of Chalon-Arlay. In 1294 he married Eleanor, daughter of Louis I, Baron of Vaud, and became bailiff of Vaud. Rudolph defeated the lords of Valangin at Coffrane in 1296 and destroyed their Bonneville fort in 1301. He allied with Bern in 1308 and Solothurn in 1324, founded Le Landeron facing the Bishopric of Basel, and died in 1343, leaving the county to his son Louis I.
zh: 鲁道夫四世（1274—1343），人称“罗兰”，1288年父亲阿梅代去世后继任纳沙泰尔领主；他失去帝国直辖地位，从沙隆-阿尔莱的让一世手中领受自己的领地作为封地。1294年他迎娶沃男爵路易一世之女埃莱奥诺尔，后来担任沃地的执行官。鲁道夫1296年在科法讷击败瓦朗然诸领主，1301年摧毁他们的博纳维尔据点。他于1308年与伯尔尼结盟、1324年与索洛图恩结盟，又在面向巴塞尔主教区的边境创建勒朗德龙；1343年去世，伯国传给儿子路易一世。

en: Sibylle de Montfaucon, also called Sibylle de Montbéliard, was the daughter of Count Theodoric III of Montbéliard and Alix of Ferrette. She married Rodolphe III, lord of Neuchâtel, and as dame de Neuchâtel bore his successors Ulrich IV, Henry and Amadeus. She died in 1277.
zh: 西比勒·德·蒙福孔（一称西比勒·德·蒙贝利亚尔）是蒙贝利亚尔伯爵蒂埃里三世与费雷特的阿莉克斯之女。她嫁给纳沙泰尔领主鲁道夫三世，以纳沙泰尔女主身份生下继承人乌尔里希四世、亨利和阿梅代，于1277年去世。

en: Hervé IV of Donzy (1173–1222) was a powerful baron of the Nivernais. In 1199, in a feud over the castle of Gien, he defeated and captured his suzerain Peter II of Courtenay at Cosne-sur-Loire; a settlement followed, and in 1200 his marriage to Peter's daughter Mahaut de Courtenay made him Count of Nevers. In 1204–1205 he supported the French against the English in Normandy, Poitou and Touraine. He joined the Albigensian Crusade in 1209 and fought for King John of England at Bouvines in 1214, later winning Philip Augustus's pardon. In 1217 he joined the French invasion of England. After Peter of Courtenay died in 1219 he also held Auxerre and Tonnerre. He died at Saint-Aignan in January 1222, reputedly poisoned.
zh: 埃尔韦四世·德·栋济（1173—1222）是尼韦奈的强势男爵。1199年，为争夺日安城堡，他在卢瓦尔河畔科讷击败并俘虏了封君库尔特奈的彼得二世；双方随后和解，1200年他娶彼得之女玛奥·德·库尔特奈，成为讷韦尔伯爵。1204—1205年，他在诺曼底、普瓦图和都兰支持法国对抗英格兰。1209年他加入阿尔比十字军，1214年在布汶为英格兰国王约翰作战，事后又求得腓力·奥古斯都的赦免。1217年他参加法国对英格兰的入侵。1219年库尔特奈的彼得死后，他又兼领欧塞尔和托内尔。1222年1月他在圣艾尼昂去世，相传被人毒死。

en: Louis I of Nevers (1272–22 July 1322), son of Robert III of Flanders and Yolande of Burgundy, succeeded his mother as count of Nevers in 1280. In December 1290 he married Joan, countess of Rethel and daughter of Count Hugh IV of Rethel, and ruled Rethel jure uxoris until his death. Their children were Joan, who married John of Brittany, count of Montfort, in 1329 after Louis's death, and Louis de Crécy, born in 1304, later count of Flanders, Nevers and Rethel. Louis died in Paris two months before his father, so he never ruled Flanders.
zh: 路易一世（讷韦尔）（1272—1322年7月22日）是罗贝尔三世与勃艮第的约朗德之子，1280年继母亲之后成为讷韦尔伯爵。1290年12月，他娶勒泰勒女伯爵让娜（勒泰勒伯爵于格四世之女）为妻，此后以妻之名统治勒泰勒直至去世。两人生下让娜（在路易死后于1329年嫁给蒙福尔伯爵、布列塔尼的让）和1304年出生的路易·德·克雷西，后者后来身兼佛兰德、讷韦尔与勒泰勒伯爵。路易在巴黎去世，比父亲早死两个月，因此从未成为佛兰德伯爵。

en: Matilda I of Nevers (1188–29 July 1257) was ruling countess of Nevers, Auxerre and Tonnerre. Only daughter of Peter II of Courtenay and Agnes I of Nevers, she married Hervé IV of Donzy in October 1199, after he captured her father in war; the peace ceded him Nevers. Together they founded Bellary monastery in 1209 and Notre-Dame de l'Épeau abbey in 1211. After her father's death, Matilda inherited Auxerre and Tonnerre; Hervé returned from the Fifth Crusade to take control of the counties. Widowed in 1222, she married Guigues IV of Forez in 1226. In 1223 she granted Auxerre a charter of liberties from the Château de Druyes, and in 1235 founded the Cistercian nunnery of Le Réconfort de Saizy. She died at Coulanges-sur-Yonne, succeeded by her great-granddaughter Matilda II.
zh: 玛蒂尔达一世（1188—1257年7月29日）是讷韦尔、欧塞尔和托内尔三个伯国的实际统治者，为库尔特奈的皮埃尔二世与讷韦尔的阿格尼丝一世的独女。1199年10月，她嫁给栋济的埃尔夫四世：此前埃尔夫在交战中俘获了她的父亲，议和条件是把讷韦尔伯国割让给他并成婚。夫妇二人于1209年创办贝拉里修道院，1211年又创办莱波圣母修道院。父亲去世后，玛蒂尔达继承欧塞尔和托内尔；埃尔夫从第五次十字军东征返回，接管这两个伯国。1222年她守寡，1226年改嫁福雷的居伊四世。1223年，她在德吕城堡向欧塞尔颁发自由特许状，1235年又创办了赛济的西多会修女院“安慰圣母院”。她在约讷河畔库朗日去世，由曾孙女玛蒂尔达二世继位。

en: Yolande of Burgundy (December 1247–2 June 1280), daughter of Odo of Burgundy and Countess Matilda II of Nevers, inherited Nevers, Tonnerre and Auxerre on her mother's death in 1262; a 1273 Parlement of Paris ruling left her Nevers and Druyes. Her first husband, John Tristan, son of Louis IX, died of dysentery at Tunis in 1270 on the Eighth Crusade. In 1272 she married Robert III of Flanders, and that year they claimed the Duchy of Burgundy by primogeniture, but Philip III awarded it to her uncle Robert II. Her son Louis of Nevers was born the same year.
zh: 勃艮第的约朗德（1247年12月—1280年6月2日）是勃艮第的厄德与讷韦尔女伯爵玛蒂尔德二世之女，1262年母亲死后继承讷韦尔、托内尔和欧塞尔；1273年巴黎高等法院裁定她分得讷韦尔和德吕耶城堡。第一任丈夫是法王路易九世之子让·特里斯坦，1270年在第八次十字军东征期间于突尼斯死于痢疾。1272年她改嫁罗贝尔三世，同年夫妇二人以长嗣继承权主张勃艮第公国，但腓力三世将公国判给她的叔父罗贝尔二世。她的儿子路易（讷韦尔的路易一世）同年出生。

en: Nicolas Fouquet (1615–1680) was a French financier born in Paris into a noblesse de robe family. During Mazarin's exile in the Fronde, he protected the cardinal's property and kept him informed of affairs at court. Loyal to Mazarin through the Fronde, he was made Superintendent of Finances in 1653 and amassed a vast fortune, buying Belle-Île and building the chateau of Vaux-le-Vicomte. On 17 August 1661 he entertained Louis XIV there with a sumptuous fete, but the jealous king, urged on by Colbert, had him arrested by d'Artagnan at Nantes on 5 September 1661 on charges of embezzlement. After a three-year trial he was imprisoned for life and died in the fortress of Pignerol on 23 March 1680.
zh: 尼古拉·富凯（1615—1680）是法国财政官员，生于巴黎的一个穿袍贵族家庭。投石党运动期间，马萨林流亡在外，他保护了这位枢机的财产，并向他通报宫廷消息。他在投石党运动期间忠于马萨林，1653年被任命为财政总监，积聚了巨额财富，买下贝勒岛并修建了沃勒维孔特城堡。1661年8月17日，他在那里以奢华的盛宴款待路易十四，但心生猜忌的国王在柯尔贝尔怂恿下，于9月5日命达达尼昂在南特将他逮捕，罪名是侵吞公款。经过三年审讯，他被判处终身监禁，1680年3月23日死于皮内罗洛要塞。

en: Engelbert I (died 1329), of the Ziegenhain comital house, ruled the County of Nidda in the Wetterau from 1294, styling himself count of Ziegenhain and lord of Nidda. In March 1294 he sold the castle and town of Neustadt to Archbishop Gerhard II of Mainz for 2200 marks. His feud with the Hospitallers over villages ended only in 1315. He married Heilwig of Isenburg-Büdingen in 1286, and their only child was Lukardis. In 1300 King Albert I allowed his fiefs to pass to her should he have no sons, and Engelbert died without male heir on 6 September 1329.
zh: 恩格尔贝特一世（卒于1329年）出身齐根海因伯爵家族，自1294年起统治韦特劳地区的尼达伯国，自称“齐根海因伯爵、尼达领主”。1294年3月，他以2200马克将诺伊施塔特城堡与城镇卖给美因茨大主教格哈德二世。他与医院骑士团争夺村庄，纷争迟至1315年才平息。1286年，他迎娶伊森堡-比丁根的海尔维希，两人唯一的孩子是柳特加德。1300年，国王阿尔布雷希特一世允准他在无子之时由女儿继承封地；1329年9月6日他去世，未留下男性继承人。

en: Heilwig of Isenburg was the eldest daughter of Louis I of Isenburg-Büdingen. In 1286 she married Count Engelbert I of Nidda; their only child, Lukardis, inherited the county. As a widow she bequeathed her dower lands in 1336 to her grandson Gottfried VII of Ziegenhain.
zh: 伊森堡的海尔维希是伊森堡-比丁根伯爵路德维希一世的长女。1286年她嫁给尼达伯爵恩格尔贝特一世，独女卢卡迪斯后来继承了尼达伯国。守寡之后，她于1336年把自己的寡居地产遗赠给孙子齐根海因的戈特弗里德七世。

en: Louis II (died after 1289) was Count of Nidda, succeeding his father Gottfried IV. In 1258 a partition mediated by the archbishop of Mainz separated Nidda from the County of Ziegenhain, leaving Louis with Nidda and Neustadt. In 1259 he bought out his co-owners' share of Nidda Castle. Drawn into the Thuringian-Hessian war of succession, he backed Mainz against the landgraves of Hesse: around 1270 he built Neustadt Castle against Marburg, but Hessian troops took it in 1273. In 1279 he pledged the Fulda Vogtei. His son Engelbert I succeeded him.
zh: 路德维希二世（1289年后去世）是尼达伯爵，继承父亲戈特弗里德四世。1258年，在美因茨大主教调停下，尼达与齐根海因伯国正式分家，路德维希分得尼达与诺伊施塔特。1259年，他买下尼达城堡其他共有人的份额。图林根-黑森继承战争中，他站在美因茨一边对抗黑森领地伯爵：约1270年他修筑诺伊施塔特城堡以防范马尔堡，但1273年即被黑森军队攻占。1279年他把富尔达护佑权抵押出去，死后由儿子恩格尔贝特一世继位。

en: Lukardis (died 1333), also called Luitgard, was the only child and heiress of Count Engelbert I of Nidda and Heilwig of Isenburg-Büdingen. In 1311 she married Count John I of Ziegenhain, and on 4 February that year the couple confirmed the town of Nidda's existing rights and freedoms on their wedding day. In 1323 Emperor Louis IV enfeoffed John with Nidda castle and town as an imperial fief. After her father died in 1329, Lukardis nominally ruled the County of Nidda until her own death in 1333, after which John united Nidda with Ziegenhain.
zh: 柳特加德（卒于1333年），又称卢伊特加德，是尼达伯爵恩格尔贝特一世与伊森堡-比丁根的海尔维希唯一的女儿和继承人。1311年，她嫁给齐根海因伯爵约翰一世；同年2月4日婚礼当天，夫妇二人确认了尼达城既有的权利与自由。1323年，皇帝路德维希四世将尼达城堡与城镇作为帝国封地授予约翰。1329年父亲去世后，柳特加德名义上统治尼达伯国，直至1333年离世，此后约翰将尼达与齐根海因合为一体。

en: John II of Hoya (1319–1377) became ruling count in 1324 after his father Otto II's death, governing jointly with his brother Gerhard III. Once a canon of Hildesheim and Bremen, he married Helen of Saxony-Lauenburg in 1338. In 1345 the brothers divided their lands: John took the Upper County with his seat at Nienburg on the Weser, Gerhard the Lower County around Hoya. His rule saw the Great Plague and the Hoya Feud against the city of Bremen, and late in life he joined Magnus II of Brunswick-Lüneburg in the Lüneburg War of Succession.
zh: 约翰二世（霍亚，1319—1377）在1324年父亲奥托二世去世后继任伯爵，与兄弟格哈德三世共同统治。他本是希尔德斯海姆和不来梅的法政牧师，1338年娶萨克森-劳恩堡的海伦。1345年兄弟瓜分领地：约翰得到上伯国，以威悉河畔宁堡为居城，格哈德得到以霍亚为中心的下伯国。他在位期间经历了大瘟疫和与不来梅城为敌的霍亚之争，晚年又加入不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵马格努斯二世一方，卷入吕讷堡继承战争。

en: Nimi a Nzima is named in Kongo oral tradition as the last ruler of Mpemba Kasi, a Bantu kingdom in the Vungu lands that was vast but not strong, and that tradition remembers as the Mother of Kongo. He married Lukeni lua Nsanze, daughter of Nsaku Lau, chief of Mbata, the neighboring kingdom to the north, and the match bound the two states together. Around 1375 Mpemba Kasi and Mbata merged to form the Kingdom of Kongo. Their son Lukeni lua Nimi, who as a young man collected tolls on his father's behalf, is traditionally said to have conquered the country around Mbanza Kongo and become its first king, though some accounts credit the founding to Nimi himself. The traditions were written down by Giovanni Cavazzi da Montecuccolo in the seventeenth century.
zh: 尼米·阿·恩齐马在刚果口传传统中是姆彭巴·卡西的末代统治者。这个班图王国位于温古之地，疆域辽阔却不强盛，传统称之为“刚果之母”。他娶北邻姆巴塔之主恩萨库·劳的女儿卢凯尼·卢安桑泽为妻，这场联姻把两国连在一起。约1375年，姆彭巴·卡西与姆巴塔合并，形成刚果王国。他们的儿子卢凯尼·卢阿·尼米年轻时曾替父亲收取过路税，传统称他征服了姆班扎刚果一带，成为第一位国王，不过也有说法把建国之功算在尼米本人头上。这些传统由乔瓦尼·卡瓦齐·达·蒙泰库科利于17世纪记录成文。

en: Withego I von Ostrau (died 27 October 1348) was bishop of Naumburg from 1335. A son of Henning von Ostrau, he became a canon at Merseburg in 1315, dean at Zeitz in 1324 and provost at Sulza in 1326. The Naumburg chapter made him accept its first episcopal election capitulation. He repaired relations with Margrave Frederick II of Meissen and stayed neutral in the Thuringian Count War. In 1347 he and the city of Naumburg ended a feud against Poppo von Würzburg and his sons. He also sat on papal commissions for marriage dispensations, and probably died at Zeitz.
zh: 维特戈一世·冯·奥斯特劳（1348年10月27日卒）自1335年起任瑙姆堡主教。他是亨宁·冯·奥斯特劳之子，1315年任梅泽堡法政牧师，1324年任蔡茨执事长，1326年任苏尔察总务长。瑙姆堡主教座堂参事会要他接受首份主教选举誓约。他修复了与迈森藩侯腓特烈二世的关系，在图林根伯爵战争中保持中立。1347年，他与瑙姆堡城一同结束了对波波·冯·维尔茨堡父子的私战；他还参加教廷处理婚姻豁免的委员会，可能卒于蔡茨。

en: Bolesław the Elder (c. 1293 – c. 1365) was a Silesian Piast duke, eldest son of Bolko I of Opole. After his father's death in 1313 he ruled Wieluń and Niemodlin. His career was tied to the Luxembourg kings of Bohemia: war with Władysław I the Elbow-high cost him Wieluń in 1326, and on 18 February 1327 he did homage to King John at Opawa. He joined John's 1328 crusade against Lithuania, bought Prudnik in 1336 and in 1355 accompanied Charles IV to his imperial coronation in Rome. In 1325 he married Euphemia of Wrocław, by whom he had eight children.
zh: 波列斯瓦夫“长者”（约1293—约1365）是西里西亚皮亚斯特家族公爵，奥波莱公爵波尔科一世的长子。1313年父亲死后，他统治维隆与涅莫德林。他的政治生涯与波希米亚的卢森堡诸王紧密相连：与瓦迪斯瓦夫一世“矮子”的战争使他于1326年失去维隆；1327年2月18日，他在奥帕瓦向国王约翰行臣服礼。他参加了约翰1328年对立陶宛的十字军征讨，1336年购得普鲁德尼克，1355年随查理四世赴罗马参加皇帝加冕。1325年他娶弗罗茨瓦夫的欧菲米亚为妻，生有八个子女。

en: Euphemia of Wrocław (born c. 1312, died after 1384), also called Ofka, was the second daughter of Henry VI the Good, duke of Wrocław, and Anna of Austria, daughter of King Albert I of Germany. In 1324 or 1325 she married Bolesław the Elder, duke of Niemodlin; because the pair were distant cousins, Pope John XXII issued a dispensation for the marriage. The marriage, arranged by her father to build an alternative Piast succession line, gave her three sons and five daughters. Long outliving Bolesław, in October 1383 Władysław Opolczyk confirmed her dower rights; she died soon after.
zh: 弗罗茨瓦夫的欧菲米亚（约1312年生，1384年后卒），又称奥夫卡，是弗罗茨瓦夫公爵亨里克六世“善人”与德意志国王阿尔布雷希特一世之女奥地利的安娜的次女。1324年或1325年，她嫁给涅莫德林公爵波列斯瓦夫“长者”；因二人是远亲，教皇约翰二十二世为这桩婚姻颁下豁免。这桩由父亲安排、意在另辟皮亚斯特家族继承线的婚姻共生有三子五女。她远比波列斯瓦夫长寿，1383年10月瓦迪斯瓦夫·奥波尔奇克确认了她的终身赡养权，此后不久她便去世。

en: Nogai (died 1299 or 1300) was a Mongol prince and general of the Golden Horde, great-grandson of Jochi and nephew of Khan Berke. Though he never took the throne, from 1266 he ruled the lands west of the Dnieper as the Horde's uncrowned master and kingmaker. He raided Poland, Bulgaria and Byzantium, married Emperor Michael VIII Palaiologos's daughter, and in 1280 executed the Bulgarian rebel Ivaylo and installed vassal tsars in Bulgaria. In 1285 he invaded Hungary. He helped place Toqta on the throne in 1291, but the two later fought over their authority and trading rights in Crimea. Nogai defeated Toqta in 1297, only to be defeated and killed at Kahamlyk, near the Dnieper, in 1299 or 1300.
zh: 那海（？—1299/1300）是金帐汗国的蒙古宗王与将领，术赤的曾孙、别儿哥汗的侄子。他虽从未登上汗位，但自1266年起便以立汗者的身份实际掌控第聂伯河以西的土地。他率军劫掠波兰、保加利亚和拜占庭，娶拜占庭皇帝米哈伊尔八世·巴列奥略之女为妻，1280年处死保加利亚起义者伊瓦伊洛，在保加利亚扶立附庸沙皇，又于1285年入侵匈牙利。1291年他协助脱脱登上汗位，二人后来却因权势与克里米亚的贸易权争斗。那海于1297年击败脱脱，却在1299或1300年于第聂伯河附近的卡哈姆利克兵败被杀。

en: Agnes Haakonsdatter (1290–1319) was the elder daughter of King Haakon V of Norway, born to Gro Sigurdsdatter before her parents' marriage. As she was illegitimate, the succession was settled in favour of her younger sister Ingeborg, with Agnes's descendants retaining a contingent claim. In 1302 she married Baron Havtore Jonsson of the Sudreim clan, governor of Romerike, whose estates included Borregård near Sarpsborg. Her sons Jon and Sigurd Havtoresson, known as the Havtoresønnene, held leading roles in the Norwegian council under her nephew, King Magnus VII Eriksson.
zh: 阿涅丝·哈康斯多塔（1290—1319）是挪威国王哈康五世的长女，母亲为格萝·西居尔斯多塔；因出生时父母尚未正式成婚，她被视为非婚生女儿，王位继承因此改由妹妹英格堡优先，她的后裔仅保留英格堡一系绝嗣后的候补继承权。1302年，她嫁给苏德雷姆家族的男爵、鲁默里克总督哈夫托尔·荣松，后者在萨普斯堡附近拥有博勒高等多处地产。她的儿子荣·哈夫托雷松与西居尔·哈夫托雷松合称“哈夫托尔诸子”，在表亲马格努斯七世·埃里克松在位时出任挪威参政会要职。

en: Haakon V Magnusson (1270–1319) was the younger son of King Magnus the Lawmender and ruled Norway from the death of his brother Eric II in 1299 until his own death. As Duke of Norway, he had governed lands around Oslo and Stavanger under his brother from 1280. He curbed his nobles, renewed the war against Denmark and made peace in 1309, while Oslo displaced Bergen as the kingdom's main seat of government; he built the Akershus and Bohus fortresses. The last male king of the House of Sverre, he had no legitimate son. He married his daughter Ingeborg to the Swedish duke Erik Magnusson in 1312, and on 8 May 1319 was succeeded by their infant son Magnus Eriksson.
zh: 哈康五世·马格努松（1270—1319）是“修法王”马格努斯国王的幼子，1299年兄长埃里克二世去世后继任挪威国王，直至去世。自1280年起，他作为挪威公爵在兄长治下统领奥斯陆和斯塔万格周边的土地。他遏制贵族势力，重启对丹麦的战争并于1309年媾和；他在位时奥斯陆取代卑尔根成为王国主要的统治中心，阿克斯胡斯与布胡斯两座要塞也由他主持修建。他是斯韦勒家族最后一位男系国王，没有合法的儿子。1312年他将女儿英格堡嫁给瑞典公爵埃里克·马格努松，1319年5月8日去世后，由他们年幼的儿子马格努斯·埃里克松继位。

en: Havtore Jonsson (c. 1275–1320) was a Norwegian baron of the Sudrheim family on Romerike and the son of the knight Jon Raude Ivarsson. In 1302 he was betrothed to Agnes Håkonsdatter, the illegitimate daughter of King Håkon V, whom he later married. A great landowner with estates including Borregård, he also served as sysselmann of Romerike. In April 1319, he joined other nobles at the dying Håkon's bedside in swearing to uphold the king's provisions for succession and government. His sons Jon and Sigurd, the Havtoresønner, later served Magnus Eriksson.
zh: 哈夫托雷·容松（约1275—约1320）是出身鲁默里克苏德尔海姆家族的挪威男爵，骑士容·劳德·伊瓦尔松之子。1302年，他与国王哈康五世的私生女阿格妮丝·哈康斯多塔订婚，后来迎娶了她。他坐拥博雷加德等大批地产，并任鲁默里克的地方长官。1319年4月，他与其他贵族在病危的哈康床前宣誓，遵守国王关于王位继承和国家治理的规定。他的儿子容、西古尔德人称哈夫托雷兄弟，后来侍奉马格努斯·埃里克松。

en: Ingeborg of Norway (1301–1361) was the only legitimate daughter of King Håkon V. In 1312 she married the Swedish duke Erik Magnusson, mothering Magnus Eriksson and Eufemia. After Erik died in prison in 1318 and Håkon V in 1319, her young son Magnus inherited Norway and was elected king of Sweden, and Ingeborg participated in both regency governments, becoming Sweden's first female regent. Her tie to Canute Porse and her independent rule at Varberg led the nobility to remove her in 1326–1327. She later married Porse, duke of Halland, and died on 17 June 1361.
zh: 英格堡·哈康斯多塔（1301—1361）是挪威国王哈康五世唯一的嫡女。1312年，她嫁给瑞典公爵埃里克·马格努松，子女为马格努斯·埃里克松和尤菲米娅。1318年埃里克死于狱中，1319年哈康五世驾崩，她年幼的儿子马格努斯继承挪威王位并当选瑞典国王，英格堡参与两国的摄政政府，成为瑞典第一位女性摄政。她与克努特·波尔斯交好，并在瓦尔贝格独自行使权力，贵族遂于1326至1327年将她排挤出摄政班子。她后来嫁给哈兰公爵波尔斯，1361年6月17日去世。

en: Jon Havtoresson (c. 1312–1395) belonged, with his brother Sigurd, to one of the most powerful families in Norway. His mother Agnes was an illegitimate daughter of King Haakon V Magnusson; his father, the knight Havtore Jonsson, came from the Sudrheim family, a powerful Romerike house that may itself have descended from King Harald Gille. As probably the eldest son, Jon inherited the manor of Skea, with estates in Solør and Odalen, and held further lands in Østfold, among them Borregård and Huseby. He governed Borgarsysla and advised both Magnus Eriksson and Haakon VI. His marriage to Birgitta Knutsdatter produced sons Ulv, Håkon and Brynjolv, all three members of the Council of the Realm; his daughter Cecilia married the Swedish-born knight Ulv Holmgeirsson, and Brynjolv's male line became the Swedish noble family Roos af Hjelmsäter.
zh: 约翰·哈夫托雷松（约1312—1395）与弟弟西古尔德同属挪威最有权势的家族。母亲阿格妮丝是国王哈康五世·马格努松的私生女；父亲是骑士哈夫托雷·荣松，出自罗默里克的强势家族苏德尔海姆家，这个家族本身可能也是国王哈拉尔·吉勒的后裔。约翰很可能是长子，继承了斯凯亚庄园及苏洛尔、奥达伦的地产，另在东福尔拥有产业，包括博勒高和胡斯比。他出任博尔加叙斯拉的地方长官，并为马格努斯·埃里克松与哈康六世两位国王出谋划策。他与比吉塔·克努茨达特所生的乌尔夫、哈康和布吕恩约尔夫三子都进入王国参政会；女儿塞西莉娅嫁给出生于瑞典的骑士乌尔夫·霍尔姆盖尔松，布吕恩约尔夫的男系后裔成为瑞典贵族罗斯·阿夫·耶尔姆塞特家族。

en: Sigurd Havtoresson (c. 1315–c. 1390) was a grandson of King Haakon V Magnusson through his mother Agnes, the king's illegitimate daughter, and with his brother Jon belonged to the most powerful families in Norway. His father, the knight Havtore Jonsson, was of the Sudrheim family of Romerike, and Sigurd held the family seat at Sudreim. He served as lawman, district governor, castellan and member of the Council of the Realm, and became the largest private landowner in late medieval Norway. His daughter Agnes Sigurdsdatter was the mother of Sigurd Jonsson, who rose to be the foremost secular figure in the country and later its regent.
zh: 西古尔德·哈夫托雷松（约1315—约1390）是国王哈康五世·马格努松的外孙，母亲阿格妮丝是国王的私生女。他与兄长约翰同属挪威最有权势的家族。父亲是骑士哈夫托雷·荣松，出自罗默里克的苏德尔海姆家族，西古尔德驻守家族旧地苏德尔海姆。他历任法律官、地方长官、城堡司令和王国参政会成员，并成为中世纪晚期挪威最大的私人地主。其女阿格妮丝·西古尔斯达特是西古尔德·荣松之母，这位外孙后来成为挪威国内首屈一指的世俗权贵，并出任摄政。

en: Peter Wessel Tordenskiold (1690–1720) was a Norwegian naval officer in the Royal Dano-Norwegian fleet, born in Trondheim as the tenth child of alderman Jan Wessel. He ran away to Copenhagen in 1704 and, after voyages to the West and East Indies, became a naval second lieutenant in 1711. During the Great Northern War he won fame attacking Swedish ships whatever the odds. In 1712 he helped destroy Swedish transports near Rügen and was promoted. In 1716 Frederick IV ennobled him as Tordenskiold, meaning Thunder Shield, and at Dynekilen he seized and destroyed nearly the entire Swedish transport fleet, forcing Charles XII's army out of Norway. Promoted vice-admiral, he then took Marstrand and Carlsten fortress, until a duel near Hanover killed him in November 1720.
zh: 彼得·韦塞尔·托登肖尔（1690—1720）是丹挪皇家舰队的挪威籍海军军官，生于特隆赫姆，为市政官扬·韦塞尔的第十个孩子。1704年他只身前往哥本哈根，远航西印度群岛和东印度后于1711年成为海军少尉。大北方战争中，他以不顾兵力悬殊、逢敌必战而声名鹊起。1712年他参与摧毁吕根岛附近的瑞典运输船队，获得晋升。1716年腓特烈四世将他封为贵族，赐姓托登肖尔，意为“雷霆之盾”；同年他在迪内基伦缴获并摧毁几乎整支瑞典运输船队，迫使卡尔十二世的军队撤出挪威。他升任海军中将后又攻克马斯特兰德与卡尔斯滕要塞，1720年11月在汉诺威附近的一场决斗中身亡。

en: Konstantin Vsevolodovich (1185–1218), surnamed the Wise, was the eldest son of Vsevolod the Big Nest, grand prince of Vladimir. He ruled in Novgorod from 1205 and received Rostov and Yaroslavl from his father in 1208. When Vsevolod on his deathbed left Vladimir to his younger son Yuri, Konstantin resisted, and at the Battle of Lipitsa in 1216 he and Mstislav the Bold defeated Yuri, making Konstantin grand prince of Vladimir. He founded the Assumption Cathedral in Rostov and amassed a great library. He died in 1218, leaving Rostov to his son Vasilko, whereupon Yuri regained Vladimir.
zh: 康斯坦丁·弗谢沃洛多维奇（1185—1218），人称“智者”，是弗拉基米尔大公弗谢沃洛德三世（“大窝”）的长子。他自1205年起出镇诺夫哥罗德，1208年获封罗斯托夫与雅罗斯拉夫尔。父亲临终时将弗拉基米尔传给幼子尤里，康斯坦丁拒不从命；1216年，他与“大胆者”姆斯季斯拉夫在利皮察战役中击败尤里，成为弗拉基米尔大公。他在罗斯托夫始建圣母安息大教堂，并搜集了大量藏书。1218年他去世，把罗斯托夫留给儿子瓦西里科，尤里随后重登弗拉基米尔大公之位。

en: Mstislav Izyaslavich (died 1069) was the eldest son of Grand Prince Iziaslav I Yaroslavich of Kiev and Gertrude of Poland. The Novgorod First Chronicle records that Iziaslav installed him in Novgorod, where he ruled around 1067. In 1069 he returned to Rus from Poland with his exiled father and was sent to crush the Kiev uprising against Iziaslav, putting it down through mass executions and blindings. Later that year he defeated Prince Vseslav Briachislavich and took the throne of Polotsk, but died soon afterwards.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/姆斯季斯拉夫·伊贾斯拉维奇_(波洛茨克)
zh: 姆斯季斯拉夫·伊贾斯拉维奇（？—1069）是基辅大公伊贾斯拉夫一世·雅罗斯拉维奇与波兰的格特鲁德的长子。《诺夫哥罗德第一编年史》的王公列表记载，伊贾斯拉夫将他安置到诺夫哥罗德，他约于1067年统治该城。据《往年纪事》记载，1069年他随遭放逐的父亲从波兰返回罗斯，随即受命镇压基辅人反抗大公的起义，以处死、剜目的暴烈手段平息叛乱。同年他击败波洛茨克王公弗谢斯拉夫·布里亚奇斯拉维奇，取得波洛茨克公位，不久后便去世。

en: Sviatoslav III Vsevolodovich (1196–1252), a son of Vsevolod the Big Nest, was twice prince of Novgorod between 1200 and 1210. At the family partition he received Yuriev-Polsky, where he built the Cathedral of St George in 1230–1234, and in 1220 he sacked Aşlı in Volga Bulgaria. He fought the Mongols at the Battle of the Sit in 1238 and became grand prince of Vladimir with the Golden Horde's patent in 1246, only to be ousted by his nephew Mikhail Khorobrit in 1248. In 1250 he visited the Horde with his son Dmitry, and he died at Yuriev-Polsky in 1252.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/斯维亚托斯拉夫·弗谢沃洛多维奇_(弗拉基米尔)
zh: 斯维亚托斯拉夫三世·弗谢沃洛多维奇（1196—1252）是弗谢沃洛德三世（“大窝”）之子，曾在1200年至1210年间两度担任诺夫哥罗德王公。分封时他得到尤里耶夫-波利斯基，并于1230—1234年在当地修建圣格奥尔吉教堂；1220年他攻掠伏尔加保加利亚的阿什雷。1238年，他参加西蒂河战役，抗击拔都率领的蒙古大军。1246年，他凭金帐汗国的封诰成为弗拉基米尔大公，却于1248年被侄子米哈伊尔·霍罗布里特逐出弗拉基米尔。1250年他与儿子德米特里赴汗廷，最终于1252年在尤里耶夫-波利斯基去世。

en: Vladimir Yaroslavich (1020–1052) was prince of Novgorod from 1036 until his death. In governing he was assisted by the voivode Vyshata and Bishop Luka Zhidiata. The eldest son of Yaroslav the Wise of Kiev by Ingegerd of Sweden, he may have fought the Finns in 1042 and in 1043 led the last Rus' expedition against Byzantium, where a storm wrecked much of his fleet, yet he defeated its pursuers. He founded Novgorod's Cathedral of St Sophia in 1045 and was buried there when he died in 1052, two years before his father. Venerated as Saint Vladimir (feast 4 October), he left a son Rostislav, whose line ruled Halych until 1199.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/弗拉基米尔·雅罗斯拉维奇_(诺夫哥罗德)
zh: 弗拉基米尔·雅罗斯拉维奇（1020—1052）于1036年起任诺夫哥罗德王公，直至去世。总督维沙塔和主教卢卡·日季亚塔协助他治理政事。他是基辅大公智者雅罗斯拉夫与瑞典的因吉戈尔德的长子，1042年可能曾与芬兰人交战，1043年率领罗斯人最后一次远征拜占庭：船队在君士坦丁堡附近遭遇风暴，损失惨重，但他仍击败了前来追击的拜占庭战船。1045年他在诺夫哥罗德修建圣索菲亚主教座堂，1052年先于父亲两年去世，葬于该堂。东正教会尊他为圣人（瞻礼日10月4日）。其子罗斯季斯拉夫的后裔后来统治哈利奇，直至1199年。

en: Vysheslav Vladimirovich (born c. 977) was the eldest son of Vladimir the Great of Kyiv, born to his first wife, the Varangian Olava. From about 988 he ruled as prince of Novgorod, the seat his father assigned to his senior son. One account places his death in Novgorod after 1010; the throne passed to his younger brother Yaroslav the Wise, then prince of Rostov. A conflicting theory identifies him with the Rus prince Vissavald; Norse sagas recount that Vissavald sought Sigrid of Sweden's hand and was burned by her around 995.
zh: 维谢斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇（约977年生）是基辅的弗拉基米尔大帝与第一任妻子、瓦良格人奥拉娃所生的长子。约988年起他出镇诺夫哥罗德，那是父亲封给长子的席位。一种说法认为他于1010年后在诺夫哥罗德去世；公位改由当时担任罗斯托夫王公的弟弟智者雅罗斯拉夫继承。另一种相冲突的看法认为他就是罗斯王公维萨瓦尔德：北欧萨迦讲述，维萨瓦尔德向瑞典的西格丽德求婚，约995年被她烧死。

en: Aimery III (died 1239), a son of the Castilian noble Pedro Manrique de Lara of the House of Lara, held the viscounty of Narbonne from 1194, after his father seized it in 1192. His reign was dominated by the Albigensian Crusade: pressured by the duke of Burgundy, he reluctantly served Simon de Montfort at Béziers in 1209 and Minerve in 1210, but after Muret in 1213 he refused Montfort entry to Narbonne and repulsed his attack. In 1223 he did homage to Raymond VII of Toulouse, and at his death in 1239 the viscounty passed to his son Amalric I.
zh: 艾默里三世（？—1239）是卡斯蒂利亚贵族佩德罗·曼里克·德·拉腊之子，属拉腊家族。其父于1192年夺取纳博讷后，他自1194年起担任纳博讷子爵，任内前期正值阿尔比十字军肆虐：在勃艮第公爵施压下，他不情愿地追随西蒙·德·孟福尔，于1209年出现在贝济耶、1210年参加米内尔瓦围城战；但1213年米雷战役之后，他拒绝孟福尔进入纳博讷，并击退其进攻。1223年他向图卢兹伯爵雷蒙七世行臣服礼，1239年去世时子爵之位传给儿子阿马尔里克一世。

en: Aimery IV of Narbonne (c. 1245–1298) was viscount of Narbonne from 1270 and an Italian condottiero. Serving Charles I of Anjou, king of Sicily, he commanded the Guelph army against the Ghibellines of Arezzo, and in 1289 won the Battle of Campaldino, overran the Aretine countryside as far as Arezzo's gates, and was feted in Florence, where he represented Charles II of Naples. The last great Occitan troubadour, Guiraut Riquier, served at his court. He married Sibylle, daughter of Count Roger IV of Foix, and died in October 1298, leaving Narbonne to his son Amalric II.
zh: 艾默里四世（约1245—1298）自1270年起任纳博讷子爵，也是在意大利谋生的职业军人。他效力于西西里国王安茹的查理一世，逐步升任归尔甫军队统帅，1289年在坎帕尔迪诺战役中击败阿雷佐的吉伯林派，横扫阿雷佐郊野直至城门之下，并在佛罗伦萨受到凯旋式欢迎；他还曾代表那不勒斯的查理二世驻节该城。奥克语最后一位重要行吟诗人吉罗·里基耶曾在其宫廷效力。他娶富瓦伯爵罗热四世之女西比拉为妻，1298年10月去世，纳博讷由其子阿马尔里克二世继承。

en: Aimery V (c. 1285–1336) was the eldest son of Amalric II of Narbonne and Jeanne de l'Isle-Jourdain. He is mentioned in a document dated September 1298, during his father's tenure as viscount. He succeeded his father as viscount of Narbonne after Amalric's death on 19 June 1328. In 1334 he is recorded acquiring the viscounty of Castelnou in the kingdom of Majorca. He made his testament in 1336 and died the same year, leaving the viscounty to his eldest son Amalric III, born of his first wife Catherine de Poitiers.
zh: 艾默里五世（约1285—1336）是阿马尔里克二世与让娜·德·利勒-茹尔丹的长子。父亲担任子爵期间，一份1298年9月的文书提到了他。1328年6月19日父亲去世后，他继任纳博讷子爵。1334年的记载称他已取得马略卡王国境内的卡斯泰尔努子爵领地；1336年他立下遗嘱并于同年去世，纳博讷由其与发妻卡特琳·德·普瓦捷所生的长子阿马尔里克三世继承。

en: Aimery VI de Narbonne (c. 1328–1388) became viscount in 1341 under his mother Tiburge de Son's tutelage after his half-brother Amalric III died. The English captured him at Auberoche in 1345 and again, wounded, at Poitiers in 1356; in November 1355 he defended Narbonne against the Black Prince. He was governor of Languedoc in 1358 and admiral of France from 1369 to 1373. From 1381 he waged the brutal war of the viscount against Narbonne itself. He died in 1388 and was buried at Fontfroide Abbey, succeeded by his son William I.
zh: 艾默里克六世·德·纳博讷（约1328—1388）在异母兄阿马尔里克三世死后，于1341年继任子爵，由母亲蒂比尔格·德松监护。他两度被英军俘虏：1345年在欧贝罗什被俘，1356年在普瓦捷再度被俘并负伤；1355年11月他坚守纳博讷，抵御黑太子的进攻。1358年他任朗格多克总督，1369至1373年任法兰西海军统帅。1381年起，他对纳博讷本城发动残酷的“子爵战争”。他卒于1388年，葬于丰弗鲁瓦德修道院，由儿子纪尧姆一世继位。

en: Amalric I (c. 1215–1270), eldest son of Aimery III of the House of Lara and Marguerite de Marly, was viscount of Narbonne from his father's death in 1239 until his own. A charter of 1229 names him together with Aimery III, and from at least 1246 he struck his own coinage in the city. He married Philippa d'Anduze, dame de Sommières, daughter of the Languedoc baron Pierre Raymond of Anduze. When he died in December 1270, the viscounty passed to their son Aimery IV.
zh: 阿马尔里克一世（约1215—1270）是艾默里三世与玛格丽特·德·马利的长子，1239年父亲死后继任纳博讷子爵，直至去世。1229年的一份特许状中已有他与艾默里三世共同出现的署名；至迟从1246年起，他在纳博讷铸造自己的钱币。他迎娶朗格多克男爵皮埃尔·雷蒙·德·昂迪兹之女、索米耶尔女领主菲利帕·德·昂迪兹。1270年12月他去世，纳博讷子爵之位由其子艾默里四世继承。

en: Amalric II (c. 1260–1328), eldest son of Aimery IV of Narbonne and Sibylle de Foix, was a French soldier. Captured at Perpignan on Philip III's Aragonese Crusade in 1285, he then served Charles II of Naples in Tuscany. Italian sources make him commander of the Florentine Guelph army at the Battle of Campaldino in 1289; during the ensuing campaign he stormed Rondine outside Arezzo. He succeeded his father as viscount in 1298, joined Philip IV's Flemish campaign in 1300, and was later sent to Armenia on crusade after the Mongol invasion. He died in June 1328, succeeded by his son Aimery V.
zh: 阿马尔里克二世（约1260—1328）是艾默里四世与西比拉·德·富瓦的长子，法国武将。1285年他随腓力三世参加阿拉贡十字军，在佩皮尼昂被俘；其后效力于那不勒斯的查理二世，在托斯卡纳作战。意大利史料将1289年坎帕尔迪诺战役中的佛罗伦萨归尔甫军队统帅记作他；在随后的战事中，他攻克阿雷佐城外的龙迪内城堡。1298年他继任纳博讷子爵，1300年参加腓力四世的佛兰德远征，后又在蒙古入侵后被派往亚美尼亚组织十字军。1328年6月去世，其子艾默里五世继位。

en: Amalric III de Narbonne was viscount of Narbonne from 1336 until his death at Montpellier on 8 February 1341. The eldest son of Aymeri V de Narbonne by his first wife Catherine de Poitiers, he first appears in a charter of September 1298 and in 1331 is named with his wife Briande d'Aix in two Carthusian charters from Durbon. He succeeded his father in 1336, but almost nothing is recorded of his five-year rule. He died without issue, so the viscounty passed to his half-brother Aimery VI, son of Tiburge de Son.
zh: 阿马尔里克三世·德·纳博讷于1336年成为纳博讷子爵，1341年2月8日卒于蒙彼利埃。他是艾默里克五世·德·纳博讷与第一任妻子普瓦捷的卡特琳的长子，最早见于1298年9月的一份特许状，1331年又与妻子艾克斯的布里安德一同出现在迪尔邦的两份加尔都西会特许状中。他于1336年继承父位，但五年统治几乎没有记载。他死后无嗣，子爵之位传给异母弟艾默里克六世，即蒂比尔格·德松之子。

en: Catherine de Poitiers was a daughter of Count Aymar IV of Valentinois and Marguerite of Geneva. In 1309 she married Aymeri, the future Viscount Aymeri V of Narbonne, and was the mother of Viscount Amalric III.
zh: 卡特琳·德·普瓦捷是瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵艾马尔四世与日内瓦的玛格丽特之女，1309年嫁给后来的纳博讷子爵艾默里五世，是子爵阿马尔里克三世的母亲。

en: Guillaume de Narbonne was a younger son of Amalric II, Viscount of Narbonne, and Jeanne de l'Isle-Jourdain. Through his marriage to Gaillarde de Lévis, heiress of Montaigut, he held the lordships of Montaigut in the Albigeois and Montagnac near Béziers. A writ of 1337 names him alongside his brother Peter, abbot of Saint-Paul of Narbonne, in a suit over the barony of Sévérac. He later lost his reason and died insane, leaving a son, Jean de Narbonne, who married Catherine de Rocafolio.
zh: 纪尧姆·德·纳博讷是纳博讷子爵阿马尔里克二世与利勒茹尔丹的让娜较年幼的儿子之一。他凭借与蒙泰居女继承人加亚尔德·德·莱维斯的婚姻，领有阿尔比地区的蒙泰居和贝济耶附近的蒙塔尼亚克两处领地。1337年的一份令状提到，他与兄弟、纳博讷圣保罗修道院院长皮埃尔一同卷入塞韦拉克男爵领的诉讼。他后来精神失常，在疯狂中死去，留有一子让·德·纳博讷，娶罗卡福廖的卡特琳为妻。

en: Jeanne de l'Isle-Jourdain was a daughter of Jourdain IV, the troubadour lord of L'Isle-Jourdain in Gascony, by his second wife Vacquerie de Monteil. She married Amalric II, Viscount of Narbonne, and bore him seven children, including Viscount Aymeri V and Peter, Bishop of Urgell.
zh: 利勒茹尔丹的让娜是加斯科涅的利勒茹尔丹领主、行吟诗人茹尔丹四世与第二任妻子蒙泰伊的瓦克里之女，嫁给纳博讷子爵阿马尔里克二世，生下艾默里五世、于尔热勒主教皮埃尔等七个子女。

en: Sibylle of Narbonne (c. 1330–1368) was the daughter of Viscount Aymeri V of Narbonne and Tiburge de Son, and sister of Viscount Aimery VI. She married Andreu I de Fenollet, viscount of Ille and Canet, and her son Peter VIII succeeded him in 1387.
zh: 纳博讷的西比尔（约1330—1368）是纳博讷子爵艾默里克五世与蒂比尔格·德松之女、艾默里克六世的姐妹，嫁给伊尔与卡内子爵安德略一世·德·费诺列特，儿子佩雷八世于1387年继位。

en: Karijotas, also called Koriat and baptized Michael, was a son of Gediminas, grand duke of Lithuania, and ruled Navahrudak from 1341 and Vawkavysk. In 1349 Algirdas sent him to Jani Beg, khan of the Golden Horde, to seek an alliance against the Teutonic Knights and Moscow, but the khan handed him to Simeon of Moscow for ransom. He is last mentioned in 1358 and died between 1358 and 1363. His sons George and Fedir helped defeat the Tatars at Blue Waters in 1363 and received Podolia.
zh: 卡里约塔斯（又名科里亚特，受洗名米哈伊尔）是立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯之子，1341年起统治新格鲁多克和瓦夫卡维斯克。1349年，阿尔吉尔达斯派他出使金帐汗国可汗札尼别，谋求结盟对抗条顿骑士团与莫斯科，札尼别却把他交给莫斯科王公谢苗以索取赎金。他最后一次见于记载是在1358年，卒于1358至1363年间。他的儿子乔治和费奥多尔在1363年蓝水之战中协助击败鞑靼人，受封波多利亚。

en: George Koriatovich (died 1375 or 1377) was the eldest son of the Lithuanian prince Karijotas and a Gediminid who ruled Podolia. After the Battle of Blue Waters, he and his brothers received Podolia around 1363. He cooperated with Casimir III of Poland against his Lithuanian kinsmen in the Galicia–Volhynia struggles, and with his brother Alexander fled to the Polish court after the two were expelled around 1362. In 1374 he was elected voivode of Moldavia, where his Vlach subjects murdered him in 1375 or 1377.
zh: 乔治·科里奥托维奇（卒于1375或1377年）是立陶宛王公卡里约塔斯的长子，格迪米纳斯家族成员，领有波多利亚。蓝水之战后，他与兄弟于1363年前后受封波多利亚。他与波兰国王卡齐米日三世合作，在加里西亚—沃里尼亚的争斗中对抗立陶宛亲族；约1362年他与兄弟亚历山大被逐，逃入波兰宫廷。1374年他被推举为摩尔达维亚总督，1375或1377年在当地被瓦拉几亚臣民杀害。

en: Alberic III of Dammartin (c. 1135–1200) is first recorded as count of Dammartin in a charter of 1162, in which he confirmed the possessions of Chaalis Abbey in the county. In 1165 he married Mahaut, heiress of Clermont. Serving Philip Augustus, he led a mission to the English king in 1180 and fought Philip of Flanders, who captured him at Dammartin in 1182. After the French king made peace with Flanders in 1186, Alberic and his son appear in English exchequer accounts for Norfolk and Suffolk. Around 1187 he transferred to Henry II of England, receiving the Norman fief of Lillebonne. He later supported John Lackland against Philip Augustus, died at Lillebonne on 19 September 1200, and was buried at Jumièges Abbey. His sons Renaud and Simon both became counts.
zh: 阿尔贝里克三世·德·达马尔坦（约1135—1200）作为达马尔坦伯爵首次见于1162年的一份文书，他在其中确认了沙利修道院在伯国内的财产。1165年他娶克莱蒙女继承人玛奥为妻。他效力于腓力·奥古斯特，1180年率使团出使英王，又与佛兰德伯爵腓力作战，于1182年在达马尔坦被俘。1186年法王与佛兰德媾和后，阿尔贝里克父子出现在英格兰诺福克与萨福克的财政账册中。约1187年他转投英王亨利二世，获授诺曼底的利勒博讷封地。后来他支持无地王约翰对抗腓力·奥古斯特，1200年9月19日卒于利勒博讷，葬于瑞米耶日修道院。其子雷诺与西蒙后来都成为伯爵。

en: Jas Pal was a raja of the Nurpur kingdom in the Himalayan foothills and a chief of the Pathania clan of Rajputs, ruling in the first half of the fourteenth century. He was succeeded as raja by Kailas Pal, whose reign began in 1353.
zh: 阇娑·帕尔是喜马拉雅山麓努尔布尔王国的拉贾，也是拉杰普特人帕塔尼亚氏族的首领，14世纪上半叶在位。他的王位由凯拉斯·帕尔继承，后者于1353年开始统治。

en: Anna of Nuremberg (died 1355) was the daughter of Burgrave Frederick III of Nuremberg of the Hohenzollern family and Helena of Saxony. In 1295 or 1296 she married Count Emich I of Nassau-Hadamar, a cousin of King Adolf of Germany, and bore him eight children, including his successor John and Emich II, co-ruler of Nassau-Hadamar. Widowed in 1334, she secured the imperial castle of Kammerstein in Franconia as her dower in 1336, kept her widow's seat at Hadamar until 1349, and then retired to Kammerstein, where she died in 1355. She supported the Poor Clares and Franciscans in Nuremberg and helped found Bärbach Abbey. She was buried in the Franciscan Barfüsserkirche in Nuremberg.
zh: 纽伦堡的安娜（？—1355）是霍亨索伦家族的纽伦堡城堡伯爵腓特烈三世与萨克森的海伦娜之女。1295或1296年，她嫁给拿骚-哈达马尔伯爵埃米希一世（德意志国王阿道夫的堂弟），生有八名子女，包括继承人约翰和后来共治拿骚-哈达马尔的埃米希二世。1334年丧夫后，她于1336年取得法兰克尼亚的皇家城堡卡默施泰因作为寡妇产业，1349年以前在哈达马尔居孀，此后退居卡默施泰因，1355年卒于该地。她资助纽伦堡的圣嘉勒会与方济各会修院，并参与创建贝尔巴赫修院，葬于纽伦堡的方济各会赤脚教堂。

en: Emich II of Nassau-Hadamar (died 1 March 1359) was the second son of Count Emich I and Anna of Nuremberg. He entered the Church and is attested as a canon of Mainz in 1328 and 1336, but soon left the clergy and from 1337 shared rule with his brother John. He lived on the family's Franconian lands around Kammerstein Castle and fought beside John in the Nassau-Dillenburg feud of 1350 and 1351. He repeatedly seized revenues from monasteries and churches, including Eberbach Abbey, but in his will ordered full restitution. He died unmarried in 1359, and John then ruled alone.
zh: 拿骚-哈达马尔的埃米希二世（卒于1359年3月1日）是伯爵埃米希一世与纽伦堡的安娜的次子。他起初进入教会，1328和1336年的文献记载他是美因茨大教堂的法政牧师，但不久便还俗，自1337年起与兄长约翰共同治理。他多住在家族位于法兰克、卡默施泰因帝国城堡周围的领地上，1350至1351年与约翰一同参加拿骚-迪伦堡的封建私战。他屡次侵夺修道院和教堂的收入，埃伯巴赫修道院也未能幸免，但在遗嘱中要求全数归还。1359年他未婚而终，约翰此后独自统治。

en: Emich of Nassau-Hadamar (1331 – 8 June 1343) was the eldest son of Count John of Nassau-Hadamar and his wife Elisabeth of Waldeck. He died in childhood.
zh: 拿骚-哈达马尔的埃米希（1331年—1343年6月8日）是拿骚-哈达马尔伯爵约翰与妻子瓦尔代克的伊丽莎白的长子，幼年夭折。

en: Henry II the Rich (c. 1180–1250), Count of Nassau, was the eldest son of Count Walram I and ruled from 1198, at first jointly with his brother Rupert. He enlarged his domains around Wiesbaden through the imperial stewardship granted around 1214 and built the castles of Sonnenberg, Ginsburg and Dillenburg. He married Matilda of Guelders in 1215 and joined Emperor Frederick II on the Sixth Crusade in 1228. His sons Walram II and Otto I divided the Nassau lands in 1255 and founded the dynasty's two lines.
zh: 海因里希二世（绰号“富有者”，约1180—1250）是拿骚伯爵瓦尔拉姆一世的长子，1198年起统治拿骚，起初与兄弟鲁佩特共同执政。他于约1214年获帝国授予威斯巴登周边的管辖权，扩大拿骚版图，并主持修建索嫩贝格、金斯堡和迪伦堡三座城堡。1215年他娶海尔德的玛蒂尔达，1228年随皇帝腓特烈二世参加第六次十字军东征。他的儿子瓦尔拉姆二世与奥托一世于1255年瓜分拿骚领地，开创家族的两大支系。

en: Margaret of Nuremberg (died after 1382), a daughter of Burgrave Frederick IV of Nuremberg, married Count Adolph I of Nassau-Wiesbaden-Idstein in 1332. Her sons Gerlach II and Walram IV inherited his lands, and two other sons became archbishops of Mainz.
zh: 纽伦堡的玛格丽特（?—1382年后）是纽伦堡城伯腓特烈四世之女，于1332年嫁给拿骚-威斯巴登-伊德施泰因伯爵阿道夫一世。她的儿子格拉赫二世和瓦拉姆四世继承了领地，另有两个儿子成为美因茨大主教。

en: Otto I (1224–1290), Count of Nassau, was a younger son of Henry II the Rich. He succeeded his father before 1251 together with his brother Walram II, and on 16 December 1255 the brothers signed the Prima Divisio, partitioning Nassau along the river Lahn; Otto took the northern lands of Siegen, Dillenburg, Herborn and Ems. His feuds with Rhenish lords and a quarrel over Teutonic Order estates brought him excommunication in 1285, settled the following year. By Agnes of Leiningen he left sons Henry, Emicho and John.
zh: 奥托一世（1224—1290）是拿骚伯爵海因里希二世“富有者”较年幼的儿子之一，1251年前与兄弟瓦尔拉姆二世一同继位。1255年12月16日，二人签订《初分条约》，以兰河为界瓜分拿骚：奥托分得兰河以北的锡根、迪伦堡、黑博恩和埃姆斯。他与莱茵地区诸领主多次结仇交战，又因条顿骑士团地产之争于1285年被开除教籍，次年才和解。他娶莱宁根的阿格妮丝，死后由儿子亨利、埃米希和约翰继位。

en: Nsaku Lau was the ruler of the Bantu kingdom of Mbata, north of Mpemba Kasi, in the later fourteenth century. Kongo founding tradition holds that around 1375 he allied himself with Nimi a Nzima, ruler of Mpemba Kasi and Vungu, and sealed the pact by marrying his daughter Lukeni lua Nsanze to him. Their son Lukeni lua Nimi, born around 1380, led the expansion from which the Kingdom of Kongo took shape, and the Kilukeni rulers who followed descended from him. As Kongo centralized, Mbata lost influence; by 1620 it kept only the symbolic title Nkaka andi a Mwene Kongo, grandfather of the king of Kongo.
zh: 恩萨库·劳是14世纪后期位于姆彭巴·卡西以北的班图人姆巴塔王国的统治者。刚果建国传说称，约1375年他与姆彭巴·卡西和温古的统治者尼米·阿·恩齐马结盟，并将女儿卢凯尼·卢安桑泽嫁给对方以巩固盟约。两人的儿子卢凯尼·卢阿·尼米约于1380年出生，领导了扩张，刚果王国由此成形，此后的基卢凯尼诸王都出自他的世系。随着刚果集权加强，姆巴塔的影响力逐渐衰退；到1620年，它只保留了“刚果国王的外祖父”（恩卡卡·安迪·阿·姆韦内·刚果）这一象征性称号。

en: John (c. 1275–1328), third son of Count Otto I of Nassau, was destined for the Church and became a canon at Worms. After his mother's death in 1303 he left the clergy, receiving Nassau-Dillenburg with Herborn, Haiger and Beilstein in the brothers' partition. In 1308 the Bishop of Worms enfeoffed him with the Hundred of Kalenberg, and he fought the long Dernbach feud against local lords and Hesse. In 1327 he captained the Mainz-Nassau army, winning at Seibertshausen, but fell against the Hessians near Wetzlar on 10 August 1328. Unmarried, his lands reverted to his brothers.
zh: 约翰（约1275—1328）是拿骚伯爵奥托一世的第三子，原本准备从事神职，曾任沃尔姆斯大教堂教士。1303年母亲去世后他还俗，在兄弟分封中得到拿骚-迪伦堡，领有黑博恩、海格尔和拜尔施泰因。1308年，沃尔姆斯主教将卡伦贝格百户区封给他；他还为确立主权，与当地领主和黑森领地伯爵长期进行“德恩巴赫仇争”。1327年他出任美因茨-拿骚联军统领，在赛伯茨豪森取胜，却于1328年8月10日在韦茨拉尔附近与黑森军队作战时阵亡。他未婚而死，领地归于兄弟。

en: Elisabeth of Waldeck (died before 22 June 1385), a daughter of Count Henry IV of Waldeck and Adelaide of Cleves, married John of Nassau-Hadamar by 1331. She bore John ten children, including his successors Henry and Emich III, and survived her husband.
zh: 瓦尔德克的伊丽莎白（1385年6月22日前卒）是瓦尔德克伯爵亨利四世与克莱沃的阿德尔海德之女，1331年前嫁给拿骚-哈达马尔的约翰。她为约翰生下十个子女，包括继承人亨利和埃米希三世，并比丈夫长寿。

en: Emicho I (d. 7 June 1334), second son of Count Otto I of Nassau, founded the elder Nassau-Hadamar line. Before 1297 he married Anna of Hohenzollern, daughter of Burgrave Frederick III of Nuremberg, who bore him at least eight children, including his successor John. With his brother Henry he fought for his cousin King Adolf of Nassau at the Battle of Göllheim on 2 July 1298. In the family partition of 1303 he received Hadamar, Driedorf and the Esterau, ruling as Count of Nassau-Hadamar.
zh: 埃米希一世（？—1334年6月7日）是拿骚伯爵奥托一世的次子，老拿骚-哈达马尔支系的开创者。1297年前他娶纽伦堡城堡伯爵腓特烈三世之女霍亨索伦的安娜，育有至少八个子女，继承人约翰即其中之一。1298年7月2日，他与兄弟亨利在格尔海姆之战中为表兄、德意志国王拿骚的阿道夫作战。1303年家族分封时，他分得哈达马尔、德里多夫和埃斯特劳，成为拿骚-哈达马尔伯爵。

en: John (died 1364 or 1365) was ruling count of Nassau-Hadamar from his father Emich I's death in 1334. He enlarged his lands by buying a share of Driedorf in 1334 and taking the Amt Ellar in pledge in 1337. His later feuds drove him into debt: he backed Emperor Charles IV against Louis the Bavarian, and in 1351 was captured near Löhnberg fighting for Limburg and had to ransom himself. Between 1360 and 1364 he sold his Frankish estates around Kammerstein to Burgrave Albert of Nuremberg. By Elisabeth of Waldeck he left sons, among them his successor Henry.
zh: 约翰（卒于1364或1365年）自父亲埃米希一世1334年去世后统治拿骚-哈达马尔伯国。他扩张领地，1334年购入德里德多尔夫的一份份额，1337年又以抵押方式取得埃拉尔辖区。后来他卷入多场封建私战，债台高筑：他支持皇帝查理四世对抗巴伐利亚人路易，1351年在为林堡作战时于伦贝格附近被俘，不得不支付赎金脱身。1360至1364年间，他把卡默施泰因一带的法兰克领地卖给纽伦堡城堡伯爵阿尔布雷希特。妻子瓦尔代克的伊丽莎白为他生下多个儿子，继承人亨利便是其中之一。

en: Adolph I (c. 1307–1370) was the eldest son of Count Gerlach I of Nassau and Agnes of Hesse. Associated in the government from about 1338, he and his brothers took full power when their father abdicated in 1344 and ruled jointly until they partitioned the inheritance in 1355. Adolph thereby founded the Nassau-Wiesbaden-Idstein line and resided chiefly at Idstein, where he enlarged the town church and built the Hexenturm, promoted weaving at Wiesbaden, and built Adolfseck Castle. In imperial politics he supported Emperor Charles IV. In 1322 he married Margaret of Nuremberg, daughter of Burgrave Frederick IV.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿道夫一世_(拿騷-威斯巴登-伊德施泰因)
zh: 阿道夫一世（约1307—1370）是拿骚伯爵格拉赫一世与黑森的阿格尼丝的长子。约1338年起他参与治理，1344年父亲退位后与弟弟们共同掌权，1355年正式瓜分遗产。他由此开创拿骚-威斯巴登-伊德施泰因支系，主要驻跸伊德施泰因，在当地扩建城市教堂、修建女巫塔，又在威斯巴登扶持织业、修筑阿道夫塞克城堡。在帝国政治中他支持皇帝查理四世。1322年，他与纽伦堡城堡伯爵腓特烈四世之女玛格丽特成婚。

en: Gerlach I (c. 1285–1361), Count of Nassau and a younger son of King Adolf of Nassau, succeeded his elder brother Rupert in 1305 and ruled from Sonnenberg Castle near Wiesbaden. In 1309 he translated his father's body to Speyer Cathedral and erected the King's Cross at Göllheim. He escorted Henry VII to his imperial coronation in Rome in 1312, backed Frederick the Fair for the German crown, and submitted to Louis the Bavarian only after Mühldorf in 1322. Imperial Vogt of the Wetterau from 1326, he added Weilnau and Merenberg and divided Nassau among his sons in 1344.
zh: 格拉赫一世（约1285—1361）是拿骚瓦尔拉姆系伯爵，德意志国王阿道夫较年幼的儿子。1305年兄长鲁普雷希特早逝后他继承领地，驻跸威斯巴登附近的索嫩贝格城堡。1309年他将父亲的遗体迁往施派尔大教堂安葬，并在盖尔海姆建立国王十字。1312年他随亨利七世赴罗马参加皇帝加冕，支持英俊者腓特烈争夺德意志王位，直到1322年米尔多夫战役后才承认巴伐利亚人路德维希。1326年他出任韦特劳帝国地方长官，陆续取得魏尔瑙与梅伦贝格，1344年将拿骚分封给诸子。

en: Walram II (c. 1220–24 January 1276), Count of Nassau, was the second son of Henry II the Rich. He succeeded before 1251 with his brother Otto I, and the Prima Divisio of 16 December 1255 gave Walram the lands south of the river Lahn: Wiesbaden, Idstein and Weilburg. He served King Rudolf I as Hofmarschall and councillor, lost Niederlahnstein and Vallendar to the Archbishop of Trier, and carried on the Dernbach feud against Hesse. In a fit of madness he burned his copy of the division treaty and allegedly died mentally deranged. His son Adolf became King of Germany.
zh: 瓦尔拉姆二世（约1220—1276年1月24日）是海因里希二世“富有者”的次子，1251年前与兄弟奥托一世一同继位。1255年12月16日的《初分条约》将兰河以南的威斯巴登、伊德施泰因和魏尔堡划归瓦尔拉姆。他曾任德意志国王鲁道夫一世的宫廷元帅兼枢密顾问，在争斗中被特里尔大主教夺去下拉恩施泰因和法伦达尔，并继续同黑森进行“德恩巴赫仇争”。他曾在狂乱中烧毁自己那份分地条约，据称死时精神失常。其子阿道夫后来成为德意志国王。

en: Alexander Semyonovich, Prince of Novosil and presumably a son of Semyon Mikhailovich of Glukhov, was put to death in the Golden Horde on 15 September 1326. Scholars have linked his execution to ties with Gediminas of Lithuania.
zh: 亚历山大·谢苗诺维奇是诺沃西利王公，一般认为是格卢霍夫王公谢苗·米哈伊洛维奇之子。1326年9月15日他在金帐汗国被处死，有学者推测此事与他同立陶宛大公格季米纳斯的联系有关。

en: Simeon (Semyon Alexandrovich) was prince of Novosil in the middle of the fourteenth century, reckoned by genealogies a son of Prince Alexander Semyonovich, who was killed in the Golden Horde in 1326. He ruled the small upper-Oka principality while its princes steered between Moscow, Lithuania and the Horde. The testament of Grand Prince Simeon Ivanovich of Moscow, drawn up in 1353, records buying the village of Zabereg from him. His sons Ivan and Roman succeeded him as princes of Novosil.
zh: 西缅（谢苗·亚历山德罗维奇）是14世纪中叶的诺沃西利王公，谱系通常将他记作亚历山大·谢苗诺维奇之子，而其父于1326年在金帐汗国被杀。他统治这个奥卡河上游小邦时，诺沃西利诸王公正周旋于莫斯科、立陶宛与金帐汗国之间。莫斯科大公谢苗·伊万诺维奇1353年所立遗嘱记载，曾从他手中购得扎别列格村。他的儿子伊万与罗曼后来相继成为诺沃西利王公。

en: Later genealogies name Semyon Mikhailovich as Prince of Glukhov from 1246 and progenitor of the Glukhov and Novosil princely lines; his son Alexander ruled as Prince of Novosil.
zh: 后世谱系记载，谢苗·米哈伊洛维奇自1246年起任格卢霍夫王公，是格卢霍夫与诺沃西利两支王公世系的始祖，其子亚历山大为诺沃西利王公。

en: Raden Neno was the second ruler of the Dayak kingdom of Nan Sarunai in southern Borneo, reigning from 1329 to 1349 between Raden Japutra Layar and Raden Anyan. Tradition makes him a predecessor of the rulers under whom Majapahit conquered Nan Sarunai in the 1350s.
zh: 相传拉登·内诺是婆罗洲南部达雅克人古国楠沙鲁奈的第二任统治者，1329年至1349年在位，介于拉登·贾普特拉·拉亚尔与拉登·安扬之间；在他之后的统治者治下，楠沙鲁奈于1350年代被满者伯夷攻灭。

en: Henry I (c. 1270–1343), Count of Nassau-Siegen and eldest son of Count Otto I, succeeded his father with his brothers in 1290. He backed his cousin Adolf of Nassau's election as German king in 1292, fighting for him in Thuringia and at Göllheim in 1298, where Adolf was killed. Adolf had pledged him the Ratzenscheid silver mines, the basis of the Nassau mining rights. The 1303 partition of Nassau gave him Siegen, the Ginsburg, Haiger and the Westerwald, and in 1306 he gained Dillenburg from his brother John. He died in 1343, succeeded by his son Otto II.
zh: 海因里希一世（约1270—1343），拿骚-锡根伯爵，是拿骚伯爵奥托一世的长子。1290年他与弟弟们共同继承父位，1292年支持堂亲拿骚的阿道夫竞选德意志国王，并为其转战图林根，1298年随阿道夫战于盖尔海姆，阿道夫于此役阵亡。阿道夫曾将拉岑沙伊德银矿抵押给他，这成为拿骚家族矿业权的基础。1303年瓜分拿骚时，他分得锡根、金斯堡、海格尔与韦斯特瓦尔德，1306年又从弟弟约翰手中取得迪伦堡。他于1343年去世，其子奥托二世继位。

en: Otto II (c. 1305–1350/51) succeeded his father Henry I as Count of Nassau-Siegen in 1343. The 1341 partition gave him the Siegerland, Herborn with Dillenburg, Haiger and Löhnberg. His reign was spent in feuds and debt: in 1344 he sold Löhnberg and won Dillenburg its city rights from Emperor Louis the Bavarian, then sold the Nassau half of Siegen to Cologne, and in 1349 pledged Haiger and half the Ginsburg. He was killed in his feud with the Walderdorff brothers between late 1350 and early 1351. His son John I succeeded under the regency of his widow, Adelaide of Vianden.
zh: 奥托二世（约1305—1350/51）于1343年继其父海因里希一世成为拿骚-锡根伯爵。1341年的分家条约将锡格兰、附带迪伦堡的黑尔博恩边区、海格尔和伦贝格分给他。他的统治充斥着纷争与债务：1344年他卖掉伦贝格，并从皇帝巴伐利亚人路德维希手中为迪伦堡争取到城市权，随后又把锡根的拿骚半数份额卖给科隆，1349年将海格尔教区和半个金斯堡抵押出去。1350年底至1351年初，他在与瓦尔德多夫兄弟的仇杀中战死。其子约翰一世继位，由他的遗孀菲安登的阿黛拉伊德摄政。

en: John I (1309–1371) was the second son of Count Gerlach I of Nassau. He took power with his elder brother Adolph in 1344, and in the 1355 partition received Weilburg on the Lahn, founding the Nassau-Weilburg line. In 1356 he fought for France as a mercenary at Poitiers, where his half-brother Kraft was killed and John was captured but quickly released. Emperor Charles IV raised him to an Imperial Prince-Count in 1366. His marriages to Gertrude of Merenberg and Johanna of Saarbrücken brought him Merenberg, Gleiberg and the Saarbrücken inheritance. His son Philip I succeeded him in 1371.
zh: 约翰一世（1309—1371）是拿骚伯爵格拉赫一世的次子。1344年他与兄长阿道夫共同掌权，1355年分家时得到兰河畔的魏尔堡，开创拿骚-魏尔堡支系。1356年他作为雇佣兵为法国一方参加普瓦捷战役，异母弟克拉夫特战死，他本人被俘但很快获释。1366年皇帝查理四世将他升为帝国诸侯级伯爵。他先后娶梅伦贝格的格特鲁德与萨尔布吕肯的约翰娜为妻，由此取得梅伦贝格、格莱贝格和萨尔布吕肯的继承权。1371年他在魏尔堡去世，子菲利普一世继位。

en: Rappold von Külsheim is recorded as Reichsschultheiß of Nuremberg in 1338, the emperor's appointed deputy who exercised jurisdiction over the citizens of the imperial city.
zh: 拉波尔德·冯·屈尔斯海姆于1338年任纽伦堡帝国法官，即皇帝任命的代表，在这座帝国城市对市民行使裁判权。

en: Euphrosyne Yaroslavna was a Galician princess, the daughter of Prince Yaroslav Osmomysl of Halych and his wife Olga Yurievna, herself a daughter of Yuri Dolgorukiy of Suzdal. Her personal name is absent from the chronicles; the later attribution of Euphrosyne to Igor's wife remains uncertain. Around 1169 she married Prince Igor Svyatoslavich of Novgorod-Seversk and bore his six children, the eldest, Vladimir, born in 1171. She is famous as the Yaroslavna of The Lay of Igor's Campaign, which dramatises Igor's failed 1185 raid against the Polovtsians; her Yaroslavna's Lament, in which she pleads with the Dnieper for her husband's return, is one of the poem's most celebrated passages and made her the emblem of the faithful wife.
zh: 叶夫罗西尼娅·雅罗斯拉夫娜是哈利奇王公雅罗斯拉夫·奥斯莫梅斯尔与苏兹达尔公主奥尔加·尤里耶夫娜（尤里·多尔戈鲁基之女）的女儿。编年史没有记下她的名字，后世将叶夫罗西尼娅这一名字归于伊戈尔之妻仍有争议。约1169年，她嫁给诺夫哥罗德-谢韦尔斯基王公伊戈尔·斯维亚托斯拉维奇，为他生下六名子女，长子弗拉基米尔生于1171年。她便是《伊戈尔远征记》中的雅罗斯拉夫娜：史诗讲述伊戈尔1185年远征波洛伏齐人失败，《雅罗斯拉夫娜的哭泣》中，她向第聂伯河哀诉、祈求丈夫归来，是全诗最著名的段落之一，她也由此成为忠贞妻子的象征。

en: Nanker, born Jan Kołda around 1270 near Bytom, was a Polish cleric and supporter of King Władysław the Short. He was archdeacon of Sandomierz before studying canon law in Bologna, and later became dean of Kraków. Consecrated bishop of Kraków in 1320, he issued diocesan statutes and began the Gothic Wawel Cathedral. Translated to Wrocław in 1326, he ruled the episcopal principality of Nysa and in 1337 excommunicated King John of Bohemia. He died at Nysa in 1341 and was buried in Wrocław Cathedral.
zh: 南克尔约1270年生于比托姆附近，本名扬·考达，是波兰教士，也是国王瓦迪斯瓦夫一世（矮子）的支持者。他先任桑多梅日总执事，后赴博洛尼亚研习教会法，再任克拉科夫座堂主任司铎。1320年他就任克拉科夫主教，颁布教区法规，并主持动工兴建哥特式的瓦维尔大教堂。1326年他调任弗罗茨瓦夫主教，领有尼萨教会公国，1337年将波希米亚国王约翰开除教籍。他于1341年在尼萨去世，葬于弗罗茨瓦夫主教座堂。

en: Shōsatto, also read Ufusatu, founded Sannan (Nanzan), the southernmost of Okinawa's Three Kingdoms, in 1337. Later genealogies traced him to King Eiso; he had been aji of Ōzato, and he set his capital at Shimasoe-Ōzato Castle. The Ming Veritable Records record his tribute mission to China in 1383, and in 1385 the Hongwu Emperor invested him as King of Sannan with a gilded silver seal. His kingdom soon came apart: in 1392 Shō Hashi of Sashiki seized his capital and he withdrew to Shimajiri-Ōzato. One account says his uncle Ō Eishi, allied with Ō Ōso and Hashi, defeated him around 1396 and he fled. Korean records tell of a Sannan prince Shōsatto whom the Chūzan king asked Korea to hand over in 1394, and of a Sannan king who fled to Korea in 1398; some take the latter for Shōsatto, though others think him another lord.
zh: 承察度（琉球语读作乌夫萨图）于1337年建立南山国，是琉球三山时代南山王国的初代国王，南山是冲绳三国中最靠南的一个。后世谱系称他是英祖王的后裔；他原任大里按司，定都岛添大里城。据《明实录》记载，他于1383年遣使向明朝朝贡，1385年受明太祖册封为南山王，获赐镀金银印。他的国家随后迅速瓦解：1392年佐敷按司尚巴志攻占其都城，他退往岛尻大里城。一种说法称约1396年其叔父汪英紫与汪应祖、尚巴志联手将他击败，承察度出奔。据《朝鲜王朝实录》记载，1394年中山王曾请朝鲜交出一位“山南王子承察度”，1398年又有一位山南王逃往朝鲜；有人认为后者就是承察度，也有人认为是另一位按司。

en: Elepuʻukahonua was a high chief of ancient Oʻahu, remembered in Hawaiian chants as a son of Kumuhonua, a supreme chief of the island. On Kumuhonua's death he succeeded to the rule of Oʻahu; he may have been the eldest of four brothers, the others being Molohaia, Kahakuokane and Kukawaieakane. He married Chiefess Hikilena. Their son Kahokupohakano and grandson Nāwele, who ruled around 1290, both carried on the dynasty of Māweke on Oʻahu.
zh: 埃莱普乌卡霍努瓦是古代瓦胡岛的大酋长，据夏威夷歌谣记载，他是瓦胡最高酋长库穆霍努瓦之子。库穆霍努瓦死后，他继位统治瓦胡；他可能是四兄弟中的长子，其余三人为莫洛海亚、卡哈库奥卡内和库卡韦埃阿卡内。他娶女酋长希基莱纳为妻，其子卡霍库波哈卡诺、孙纳韦莱相继延续马韦凯一系在瓦胡的统治；纳韦莱约在1290年在位。

en: Hawaiian chants name Hainakolo as a chiefess of Oʻahu and the mother of Chief Elepuʻukahonua, who succeeded Kumuhonua as ruler of the island. Another genealogy names her as a daughter of Mulielealiʻi and the wife of Keanini.
zh: 夏威夷歌谣记载，哈伊娜科洛是瓦胡岛女酋长、酋长埃莱普乌卡霍努阿之母，埃莱普乌卡霍努阿继库穆霍努阿之后统治该岛。另一种家谱记载则把她列为穆列莱亚利伊之女、基亚尼尼之妻。

en: Hawaiian chants name Hikilena as the wife of the Oʻahu high chief Elepuʻukahonua; her own parents are not recorded. She was the mother of Kahokupohakano and grandmother of Nāwele, later ruler of Oʻahu.
zh: 夏威夷歌谣记载，希基莱娜是瓦胡高级酋长埃莱普乌卡霍努阿之妻，其父母已不可考。她是卡霍库波哈卡诺之母、后来统治瓦胡的纳韦莱的祖母。

en: Hoʻokamaliʻi was a high chief of ancient Oʻahu, descended from the Kauaʻi chief Moʻikeha. He seized the island's kingship from his cousin Hoʻokupohokano and ruled as aliʻi nui, succeeded by his son Kahaʻi.
zh: 霍奥卡马利伊是古代瓦胡岛大酋长，考艾岛酋长莫伊凯哈的后裔。他从堂亲霍奥库波哈卡诺手中夺取瓦胡王位，出任阿利伊努伊，其后由其子卡哈伊继位。

en: Kahaʻi was an early aliʻi nui, or supreme chief, of Oʻahu. He succeeded his father Hoʻokamaliʻi, who had taken the island from the line of Elepuʻukahonua, and ruled until his cousin Nāwele reconquered Oʻahu around 1290.
zh: 卡哈伊是瓦胡岛早期的阿利伊努伊，即最高酋长。他继其父霍奥卡马利伊之后在位；其父曾从埃莱普乌卡霍努瓦一系手中夺走瓦胡。约1290年，堂亲纳韦莱重新征服瓦胡，卡哈伊的统治告终。

en: Kahokupohakano, also called Hoʻokupohokano, was a high chief of ancient Oʻahu, the son of Chief Elepuʻukahonua and Chiefess Hikilena. After his father died he briefly held the title of aliʻi nui of Oʻahu, until his cousin Hoʻokamaliʻi, a descendant of the Kauaʻi chief Moʻikeha, usurped the throne. By his wife Kaumana II he fathered Nāwele, who around 1290 reconquered Oʻahu and restored the line of Māweke.
zh: 卡霍库波哈卡诺（又名霍奥库波哈卡诺）是古代瓦胡岛大酋长，为埃莱普乌卡霍努瓦与希基莱纳之子。父亲死后，他短暂领有瓦胡阿利伊努伊之位，不久便被堂亲、考艾酋长莫伊凯哈的后裔霍奥卡马利伊篡位。他与妻子考马纳二世生下纳韦莱；约1290年，纳韦莱重新征服瓦胡，恢复了马韦凯一系的统治。

en: Hawaiian genealogies name Kalanimoeikawaikai as a high chiefess of Oʻahu, the wife of the aliʻi nui Nāwele and mother of his son and successor, Lakona of Oʻahu.
zh: 夏威夷谱系记载，卡拉尼莫埃卡瓦伊卡伊是瓦胡岛的女酋长，嫁给最高酋长纳韦莱，生下其子、后来的继位者拉科纳。

en: Hawaiian chants name Kaumana, called Kaumana II, as a chiefess of Oʻahu, the wife of Kahokupohakano and mother of Nāwele, who became aliʻi nui of the island around 1290.
zh: 夏威夷歌谣记载，考马娜（一称考马娜二世）是瓦胡岛女酋长，卡霍库波哈卡诺之妻、纳韦莱之母；纳韦莱约在1290年成为该岛最高酋长。

en: Hawaiian chants name Keaunui, also called Keaunui-a-Maweke, as a high chief of the Nanaulu line who ruled Oʻahu's ʻEwa, Waiʻanae and Waialua districts. A son of the Tahitian-born ‘wizard’ chief Māweke and the high chiefess Naiolaukea, he was a brother of Mulielealiʻi and Kalehenui. He married Chiefess Wehelani, who bore him Laakona of ʻEwa, the chief and ‘wizard’ Moʻi, and Nuʻakea, chiefess of Molokaʻi. Tradition credits Keaunui with opening a navigable channel at Pearl Harbor.
zh: 夏威夷歌谣记载，凯亚乌努伊（又称凯亚乌努伊—阿—马韦凯）是纳纳乌鲁一系的高级酋长，统治瓦胡岛的埃瓦、怀阿奈和怀阿卢阿地区。他是出生于塔希提的‘巫师’酋长马韦凯与女酋长纳约劳凯娅之子，穆列莱亚利伊与卡莱赫努伊的兄弟。他娶女酋长韦赫拉妮为妻，生下埃瓦的拉阿科纳、酋长兼‘巫师’莫伊，以及莫洛凯女酋长努阿凯亚。相传凯亚乌努伊主持开凿了珍珠港的通航水道。

en: Hawaiian chants name Kekupahaikala as the father of the Tahitian-born priest-chief Māweke, a descendant of Nanaulu and an ancestor of Oʻahu's ruling chiefs.
zh: 夏威夷歌谣记载，凯库帕哈伊卡拉是出生于塔希提的祭司酋长马韦凯之父；马韦凯是纳纳乌鲁的后裔，也是瓦胡岛历代统治酋长的先祖。

en: Hawaiian chants name Kumuhonua as an aliʻi nui, or supreme chief, of Oʻahu. He was the son of the high chief Mulielealiʻi and Chiefess Wehelani, and a grandson of Māweke, the Tahitian-born priest and wizard who came to Oʻahu and raised a temple to Kanaloa. His siblings were Moʻikeha, chief of Kauaʻi, ʻOlopana, who sailed away to Tahiti, and Chiefess Hainakolo. Kumuhonua founded a dynasty on Oʻahu, was succeeded by his son Elepuʻukahonua, and his line still ruled the island in the time of his great-grandson Nāwele around 1290.
zh: 夏威夷歌谣称库穆霍努瓦为瓦胡岛的阿利伊努伊，即最高酋长。他是大酋长穆利埃拉利伊与女酋长韦赫拉尼之子，也是出生于塔希提的祭司、术士马韦凯之孙；马韦凯来到瓦胡后曾为神祇卡纳洛阿修建神庙。他的兄弟姐妹中有考艾岛酋长莫伊凯哈、远航塔希提的奥洛帕纳和女酋长海纳科洛。库穆霍努瓦在瓦胡开创王朝，死后由其子埃莱普乌卡霍努瓦继位；直到约1290年，他的曾孙纳韦莱仍在统治该岛。

en: Hawaiian chants name Maihikea as the wife of Kekupahaikala and the mother, by him, of the Tahitian-born chief Māweke, ancestor of the ruling chiefs of Oʻahu.
zh: 夏威夷歌谣记载，玛伊希凯娅是凯库帕哈伊卡拉之妻，并与其生下出生于塔希提的酋长马韦凯；马韦凯是瓦胡岛历代统治酋长的先祖。

en: Hawaiian chants name Māweke as a chief of the highest known rank and a kahuna, or priest, famed for his knowledge of black magic, who came to Hawaiʻi from Tahiti. They also name his famous ancestor Nanaulu and his parents as Kekupahaikala and Maihikea. On reaching Oʻahu he erected a temple to the god Kanaloa. He married the high chiefess Naiolaukea, who bore him the chiefs Mulielealiʻi, Keaunui and Kalehenui among other children, making him the ancestor of Oʻahu's ruling chiefs.
zh: 夏威夷歌谣相传，马韦凯从塔希提来到夏威夷，是品级最高的酋长，兼任祭司，以精通黑巫术闻名，并非夏威夷本地人。歌谣记载他的先祖是纳纳乌鲁，父亲为凯库帕哈伊卡拉，母亲为玛伊希凯娅。抵达瓦胡岛后，他为神祇卡纳洛阿修建了一座神庙。他娶女酋长纳约劳凯娅为妻，生下穆列莱亚利伊、凯亚乌努伊、卡莱赫努伊等子女，由此成为瓦胡岛历代统治酋长的先祖。

en: Moʻikeha was a high chief of ancient Kauaʻi, celebrated in Hawaiian chants for the migration by sea from Kahiki, the Tahitian homeland, to the Hawaiian Islands; the wind god Laʻamaomao sailed with him and settled on Molokaʻi. He was a son of the Oʻahu chief Mulielealiʻi and Wehelani, brother of Kumuhonua, a supreme chief of Oʻahu, and of ʻOlopana, who returned to Tahiti. His Kauaʻi line lasted two generations, and a descendant, Hoʻokamaliʻi, seized Oʻahu.
zh: 莫伊凯哈是古代考艾岛的大酋长，夏威夷歌谣传诵他率领族人从塔希提故土卡希基渡海迁居夏威夷，风神拉阿毛茅随行，后定居于莫洛凯岛。他是瓦胡酋长穆利埃拉利伊与韦赫拉尼之子，与瓦胡最高酋长库穆霍努瓦、返回塔希提的奥洛帕纳是兄弟。他开创的考艾王统延续两代；其后裔霍奥卡马利伊夺取了瓦胡。

en: Hawaiian chants and the writings of Abraham Fornander name Mulielealiʻi, also called Miʻi-i-ele-aliʻi, as an ancient high chief of Oʻahu with the title aliʻi nui. A son of the Tahitian-born priest-chief Māweke and his wife Naiolaukea, he was a brother of Chief Keaunui of ʻEwa. He married Chiefess Wehelani, who also married Keaunui and bore Mulielealiʻi Kumuhonua, later ruler of Oʻahu, the Kauaʻi chief Moʻikeha, ʻOlopana, who sailed to Tahiti, and Chiefess Hainakolo.
zh: 夏威夷歌谣与亚伯拉罕·福南德的记载称，穆列莱亚利伊（又名米伊埃莱阿利伊）是生活于瓦胡岛、拥有最高酋长头衔的古代高级酋长。他是出生于塔希提的祭司酋长马韦凯与妻子纳约劳凯娅之子，也是埃瓦酋长凯亚乌努伊的兄弟。他娶女酋长韦赫拉妮为妻，她也嫁给凯亚乌努伊，并为穆列莱亚利伊生下后来统治瓦胡的库穆霍努阿、考艾岛酋长莫伊凯哈、远航塔希提的奥洛帕纳，以及女酋长哈伊娜科洛。

en: Hawaiian chants name Naiolaukea, also called Naiolakea, as a high chiefess who married the Tahitian-born ‘wizard’ chief Māweke. She was the mother of the chiefs Mulielealiʻi, Keaunui of ʻEwa and Kalehenui.
zh: 夏威夷歌谣记载，纳约劳凯娅（又名纳约拉凯娅）是一名女酋长，嫁给出生于塔希提的‘巫师’酋长马韦凯。她生下穆列莱亚利伊、埃瓦酋长凯亚乌努伊和卡莱赫努伊等酋长。

en: Hawaiian genealogies name Nāwele as an aliʻi nui, or supreme chief, of Oʻahu around 1290. A descendant of the voyager chief Māweke, he was the son of Kahokupohakano and Kaumana and the grandson of Elepuʻukahonua. Chants relate that after his cousin Kahaʻi, son of the usurper Hoʻokamaliʻi, held Oʻahu, Nāwele reconquered the island and ruled it; the details of his reign are not recorded. His wife was the chiefess Kalanimoeikawaikai, and his son Lakona succeeded him as aliʻi nui.
zh: 据夏威夷谱系记载，纳韦莱约在1290年前后担任瓦胡岛的最高酋长。他是航海酋长马韦凯的后裔，父亲为卡霍库波哈卡诺、母亲为考马纳，祖父是埃莱普乌卡霍努阿。歌谣相传，篡位者霍奥卡马利伊之子、纳韦莱的堂亲卡海占据瓦胡后，纳韦莱重新征服该岛并成为统治者，其在位事迹没有流传下来。他的妻子是女酋长卡拉尼莫埃卡瓦伊卡伊，其子拉科纳后来继任最高酋长。

en: Hawaiian chants name Wehelani as a high chiefess of Oʻahu who married Keaunui of ʻEwa and bore the Molokaʻi chiefess Nuʻakea, and also married his brother Mulielealiʻi, to whom she bore Kumuhonua, ruler of Oʻahu.
zh: 夏威夷歌谣记载，韦赫拉妮是瓦胡岛女酋长，嫁给埃瓦酋长凯亚乌努伊，生下莫洛凯女酋长努阿凯亚；她也嫁给他的兄弟穆列莱亚利伊，生下瓦胡统治者库穆霍努阿。

en: Euphemia of Bytom (c. 1313–1378) was the daughter of Władysław, Duke of Bytom, and by 1333 the wife of Konrad I, Duke of Oleśnica. Her son was Konrad II the Gray, later Duke of Oleśnica.
zh: 比托姆的欧菲米娅（约1313—1378）是比托姆公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫之女，至迟于1333年嫁给奥莱希尼察公爵康拉德一世，生子康拉德二世“灰公爵”。

en: Konrad I (c. 1294–1366) was a Silesian Piast duke, the second son of Henry III of Głogów.
