en: Giacomino da Carrara was a Paduan nobleman and politician, a son of Jacopino da Carrara, podestà of Treviso, by his first wife Speronella Dalesmanni. He was the younger of the two Carraresi brothers from whom the lords of Padua descended, and he died before 1262.
zh: 贾科米诺·达·卡拉拉是帕多瓦贵族、政治家，特雷维索波德斯塔雅各皮诺·达·卡拉拉与第一任妻子斯佩罗内拉·达莱斯曼尼之子。他是卡拉拉两兄弟中的弟弟，帕多瓦领主均出自这两支，1262年前去世。

en: Giacomino da Carrara was a member of the Paduan Papafava branch of the Carrara family and the father of Cubitosa, whose son Alvise Forzatè was a nobleman and politician in Padua.
zh: 贾科米诺·达·卡拉拉是帕多瓦卡拉拉家族帕帕法瓦支系的成员，是库比托萨之父；其外孙阿尔维塞·福尔扎泰是帕多瓦贵族与政治人物。

en: Giacomo I da Carrara, called the Great (1264–1324), founded Carraresi rule over Padua. A Guelph, he led Padua's war against Verona over Vicenza in 1311. Shortly after 25 July 1318, under Ghibelline pressure and civic feuding, the Paduan aristocracy elected him defensor, protector and governor in perpetuity, making him the city's first signore. An alliance of Guelph and Ghibelline factions supported his election, and Ghibelline exiles returned, while he exiled the poet Albertino Mussato. When Cangrande I della Scala besieged Padua in 1319, Giacomo temporarily yielded office to Frederick the Fair to save the city and kept it from the Scaligeri. He died in 1324 and was buried at the Church of the Eremitani, leaving one daughter, Taddea.
zh: 雅各布一世·达·卡拉拉，人称“伟大者”（1264—1324），是卡拉拉家族统治帕多瓦的开创者。作为圭尔夫派，他于1311年领导帕多瓦为维琴察的归属问题对维罗纳作战。1318年7月25日后不久，面对吉伯林派的压力与城内党争，帕多瓦贵族推举他为终身保卫者、保护者兼总督，他由此成为该城第一位僭主。圭尔夫派与吉伯林派的联盟支持他当选，吉伯林派流亡者随后返城，他则放逐了诗人阿尔贝蒂诺·穆萨托。1319年坎格兰德一世·德拉·斯卡拉围攻帕多瓦，雅各布为保全城池暂时将职位让给美男子腓特烈，使城市免于落入斯卡拉家族之手。他于1324年去世，葬于埃雷米塔尼教堂，身后只留下一个女儿塔代娅。

en: Giacomo da Carrara was a Paduan nobleman of the Carraresi who held the castle of Agna. He opposed Ezzelino III da Romano, the Ghibelline master of the Veneto, and died after the castle fell to his enemies.
zh: 贾科莫·达·卡拉拉是卡拉拉家族的帕多瓦贵族，据守阿尼亚城堡。他与掌控威尼托的吉伯林派首领埃泽利诺三世·达·罗马诺为敌，城堡失陷后身亡。

en: Giacomo II da Carrara (c. 1305–1350), son of Niccolò da Carrara, took Padua by murder. His father's pro-Scaliger coup failed in 1327 and he was captured and sent to Germany. Freed after two years but barred from Padua, he lived at Chioggia, Venice and the Gonzaga court at Mantua until his cousin Ubertino let him return in 1340. Ubertino, dying in 1345, named Marsilietto Papafava as lord and passed Giacomo over; on the night of 6 May Giacomo killed Marsilietto and was proclaimed signore next morning. He declared an amnesty and let exiles return, and tied Padua to Venice, joining its campaigns at Zara in 1346 and Capodistria in 1348. He gathered artists at his court and in 1349 brought Petrarch to Padua as a cathedral canon. On 19 December 1350 Guglielmo, an illegitimate son of Giacomo I, stabbed him to death; he was buried in Sant'Agostino under a tomb with an epitaph by Petrarch.
zh: 雅各布二世·达·卡拉拉（约1305—1350）是尼科洛·达·卡拉拉之子，靠一场谋杀夺得了帕多瓦。1327年，他父亲支持斯卡拉家族的政变失败，他被俘送往德意志。两年后获释，却不得返回帕多瓦，先后住在基奥贾、威尼斯和曼托瓦的贡扎加宫廷，直到1340年堂兄乌贝蒂诺准许他回城。1345年乌贝蒂诺临终时指定马尔西列托·帕帕法瓦为领主，绕过了雅各布；5月6日夜里，雅各布杀死马尔西列托，次日清晨被宣布为领主。他宣布大赦，允许流亡者返乡，并让帕多瓦与威尼斯结盟，参加了威尼斯1346年收复扎拉和1348年收复科佩尔的战事。他在宫廷里聚集艺术家，1349年把彼特拉克请到帕多瓦担任大教堂法政牧师。1350年12月19日，他被雅各布一世的私生子古列尔莫刺死，葬于圣阿戈斯蒂诺教堂，墓上刻着彼特拉克所作的铭文。

en: Giberto IV da Correggio (c. 1320–1373) was an Italian condottiero and signore of Correggio, a small lordship squeezed between Este Ferrara and Visconti Milan. In 1344 Obizzo III d'Este knighted him after he saved Obizzo's life against Feltrino Gonzaga, but in 1346 Luchino Visconti took Guastalla from him. He came to terms with the Visconti in 1354, broke with them in 1361, and joined Charles IV's anti-Visconti league in 1368; Bernabò Visconti struck at Correggio in 1361 and again in 1371. In 1372, while Giberto was at Ferrara, his nephew Guido, a Visconti ally, entered Correggio and imprisoned his sons. Stripped of his lordship, Giberto became a general of Venice against the Carraresi of Padua. Beaten at Lova, he made up for it at Piove di Sacco by capturing the Paduan commander Rizzardo di Sambonifacio. He died in Venice in 1373.
zh: 吉贝尔托四世·达·科雷焦（约1320—1373）是意大利佣兵首领、科雷焦领主，领地夹在埃斯特的费拉拉与维斯孔蒂的米兰之间。1344年，他从费尔特里诺·贡扎加手下救了奥比佐三世·埃斯特一命，被后者册封为骑士；但1346年卢基诺·维斯孔蒂从他手中夺走瓜斯塔拉。1354年他与维斯孔蒂达成和解，1361年又与之决裂，1368年加入查理四世的反维斯孔蒂联盟；贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂1361年和1371年两度直接进攻科雷焦。1372年，吉贝尔托在费拉拉时，他的侄子、维斯孔蒂的盟友圭多进入科雷焦并囚禁了他的儿子们。失去领地后，吉贝尔托出任威尼斯的将领，对抗帕多瓦的卡拉拉家族。他在洛瓦战败，却在皮奥韦迪萨科俘获帕多瓦军首领里扎尔多·迪·圣博尼法乔，挽回了颜面，1373年卒于威尼斯。

en: Gigliola da Carrara was a daughter of Jacopo II da Carrara, lord of Padua, by his first wife Lieta Forzatè, and sister of Francesco I. She married Henry V, Count of Gorizia, who ruled jointly with his brothers from 1338 and died in 1362.
zh: 吉廖拉·达·卡拉拉是帕多瓦领主雅各布二世·达·卡拉拉与原配列塔·福尔扎泰之女、弗朗切斯科一世的姐妹，嫁给戈里齐亚伯爵亨利五世；后者自1338年起与兄弟共同执政，1362年去世。

en: Guglielmo de' Rossi (c. 1252–1339) was the Guelph soldier of Parma who spent half his life fighting to get back into the city. Son of Giacomo de' Rossi, he married Donella da Carrara of Padua in 1282, served as podestà of Modena (1281), Milan (1284) and Lucca (1291, 1293), and in 1293 drove the Sanvitale out of Parma when they tried to bring in the Este. After Giberto III da Correggio seized Parma in 1303, Guglielmo was repeatedly exiled. In 1308 he routed Giberto's Ghibellines before losing at Torrechiara. When Giberto switched to the Guelphs without readmitting the exiles, Guglielmo united discontented Ghibellines and banished Guelphs to take Borgo San Donnino; after Emperor Henry VII died, he sought peace. Reconciled, he married his daughter Maddalena to Giberto. In 1336 Mastino II della Scala's takeover of Parma drove him into exile again, and he died at the Carrara court in Padua in 1339, two years after his sons Pietro and Marsilio.
zh: 古列尔莫·德·罗西（约1252—1339）是帕尔马的圭尔夫派军人，半生都在为重返这座城市而战。他是贾科莫·德·罗西之子，1282年娶帕多瓦的多内拉·达·卡拉拉，历任摩德纳（1281）、米兰（1284）和卢卡（1291、1293）的波德斯塔，1293年挫败圣维塔莱家族引埃斯特家族入主帕尔马的图谋，将其逐出该城。1303年吉贝尔托三世·达·科雷焦夺取帕尔马后，古列尔莫屡遭流放。1308年他击败吉贝尔托的吉伯林派军队，随后在托雷基亚拉落败。吉贝尔托转投圭尔夫派却不让流亡者回城，古列尔莫便联合不满的吉伯林派和被逐的圭尔夫派夺取博尔戈圣多尼诺；皇帝亨利七世去世后，他转而求和。两人和解后，他把女儿马达莱娜嫁给吉贝尔托。1336年马斯蒂诺二世·德拉·斯卡拉接管帕尔马，他再度流亡，1339年在帕多瓦的卡拉拉宫廷去世，此前两年，儿子彼得罗和马西利奥相继离世。

en: Guido IV da Correggio (died 1345) was an Italian condottiero and signore of Correggio, the son of Giberto III. His career was made in the service of the Scaligeri of Verona. In 1328 he fought for Cangrande I della Scala in the conquest of Padua, and in 1331 he was elected podestà of Verona. Serving Cangrande's successor Mastino II, he took Parma in 1335 and became its vicar, and later defended Brescia for the Scaligeri until he was driven out. In 1341 he and his brother Azzo plotted to take Parma from the Scaligeri and hand it to the Visconti, but the scheme collapsed in a quarrel between the brothers; Guido then occupied Brescello. He died in 1345, and the next year Luchino Visconti took Guastalla from his son Giberto.
zh: 圭多四世·达·科雷焦（？—1345）是意大利佣兵首领、科雷焦领主，吉贝尔托三世之子。他的仕途是在维罗纳斯卡拉家族麾下起步的。1328年，他随坎格兰德一世·德拉·斯卡拉参与征服帕多瓦，1331年当选维罗纳的波德斯塔。他为坎格兰德的继任者马斯蒂诺二世效力，1335年攻取帕尔马并成为该城代理人，随后为斯卡拉家族镇守布雷西亚，直到被逐走。1341年，他与兄弟阿佐密谋从斯卡拉家族手中夺取帕尔马、交给维斯孔蒂家族，却因兄弟反目而失败，圭多随后占领布雷谢洛。他于1345年去世，次年，卢基诺·维斯孔蒂从他的儿子吉贝尔托手中夺走瓜斯塔拉。

en: Guido da Lozzo was the son of Nicolò da Lozzo, whose family held the castle of Lozzo in the Euganean hills. In 1313 the magistrates of Padua condemned Guido for treason and ordered his image painted in the communal palace as a mark of infamy. The sentence may have followed his father's delivery of the family castle the previous year.
zh: 圭多·达·洛佐是尼科洛·达·洛佐之子，其家族据有尤加尼山区的洛佐城堡。1313年，帕多瓦官员以叛国罪判处圭多，并下令在市政宫绘制他的污名画像。这一判决可能与其父上一年交出家族城堡有关。

en: Guidoriccio da Fogliano (c. 1290–1352), a condottiero from Reggio di Lombardia and son of Niccolò da Fogliano, is the rider portrayed in Simone Martini's celebrated fresco in Siena's Palazzo Pubblico. Siena hired him in 1327 to attack its rival Pisa and the Aldobrandeschi in the Maremma. In July 1328, with 900 horse and 6,000 foot, he besieged Montemassi, defended by Castruccio Castracani, and took it after seven months. In 1331 he captured Scansano, Arcidosso and Massa Marittima, and the next year defeated the Pisans at Giuncarico. The Sienese expelled him in 1333, so he went to Reggio and, with his brother Giberto, ousted Azzo Manfredi; two years later the Gonzaga conquered the city and the brothers moved to the Veneto. He was podestà of Padua in 1337 and of Verona in 1348, and in 1351 returned to Siena, where he died the next year and was buried in San Domenico.
zh: 圭多里乔·达·福利亚诺（约1290—1352）是生于伦巴第雷焦的意大利佣兵首领，尼科洛·达·福利亚诺之子；锡耶纳市政厅里西蒙内·马尔蒂尼著名壁画所绘的骑马武将就是他。1327年锡耶纳雇用他，在马雷马进攻其对手比萨和阿尔多布兰德斯基家族。1328年7月，他率900骑兵、6000步兵围攻由卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼防守的蒙特马西，七个月后攻克。1331年他攻占斯坎萨诺、阿尔奇多索和马萨马里蒂马，次年在朱恩卡里科击败比萨人。1333年他被锡耶纳人驱逐，转往雷焦，与兄弟吉贝尔托赶走阿佐·曼弗雷迪；两年后贡扎加家族攻占该城，兄弟二人迁往威尼托。他1337年任帕多瓦波德斯塔，1348年任维罗纳波德斯塔，1351年得以返回锡耶纳，次年卒于当地，葬于圣多梅尼科教堂。

en: Anna Gradenigo, also called Isabetta, was a daughter of the Venetian doge Pietro Gradenigo. She married Giacomo I da Carrara, the first signore of Padua, and mothered Taddea da Carrara, wife of Mastino II della Scala of Verona.
zh: 安娜·格拉代尼戈（又名伊莎贝塔）是威尼斯总督彼得罗·格拉代尼戈之女，嫁给帕多瓦首任僭主贾科莫一世·达·卡拉拉，其女塔代亚后嫁维罗纳的马斯蒂诺二世·德拉·斯卡拉。

en: Jacopina da Correggio, also called Giacomina, was the daughter of Simone da Correggio, signore of Correggio and Guastalla, and Cancelliera Maggi of Brescia. She married Ubertino Novello da Carrara, signore of Padua from 1338; the marriage was annulled in 1340 and left no children.
zh: 雅各皮娜·达·科雷焦（亦作贾科米娜）是科雷焦和瓜斯塔拉领主西莫内·达·科雷焦与布雷西亚的坎切列拉·马吉之女。她嫁给1338年起任帕多瓦领主的乌贝尔蒂诺·诺韦洛·达·卡拉拉；婚姻于1340年取消，无子女。

en: Jacopino da Carrara was a Paduan nobleman, the younger son of Niccolò da Carrara and Elena della Torre. In 1327 he was imprisoned for backing Cangrande della Scala of Verona against the Paduan lord Marsilio I. After his release he helped his brother Jacopo II govern between 1345 and 1350. When Jacopo II was assassinated in December 1350, Jacopino and his nephew Francesco were acclaimed joint lords of Padua. Rivalry over the succession led Francesco to imprison him in 1355, and he died in the fortress of Monselice in 1372.
zh: 雅各皮诺·达·卡拉拉是帕多瓦贵族，尼科洛·达·卡拉拉与埃莱娜·德拉·托雷的幼子。1327年，他因支持维罗纳领主坎格兰德·德拉·斯卡拉反对帕多瓦领主马尔西利奥一世而入狱。获释后，他在1345至1350年间协助兄长雅各布二世理政。1350年12月雅各布二世遇刺后，他与侄子弗朗切斯科一同被拥立为帕多瓦领主。继承之争使弗朗切斯科于1355年将他囚禁，他于1372年死于蒙塞利切城堡。

en: Jacopino Papafava was a Paduan nobleman of the Papafava branch of the da Carrara family. In 1326 he married Aica da Camino, daughter of Guecellone VII da Camino, lord of Treviso, and widow of Franceschino della Scala.
zh: 雅各皮诺·帕帕法瓦是帕多瓦贵族，出身达·卡拉拉家族的帕帕法瓦支系。1326年，他娶特雷维索领主圭切洛内七世·达·卡米诺之女、弗兰切斯基诺·德拉·斯卡拉的遗孀艾卡·达·卡米诺为妻。

en: Jacopo da Carrara was a member of the Paduan Carraresi family, the son of Giacomino da Carrara and the father of Marsilio da Carrara.
zh: 雅各波·达·卡拉拉是帕多瓦卡拉拉家族的一员，贾科米诺·达·卡拉拉之子，马尔西利奥·达·卡拉拉之父。

en: Lieta Forzatè was the daughter of Marzio Forzatè, count of Montemerlo, and the first wife of Giacomo II da Carrara, signore of Padua, whom she married in 1318. Her son Francesco I il Vecchio, born in 1325, became signore of Padua.
zh: 列塔·福尔扎泰是蒙泰梅洛伯爵马尔齐奥·福尔扎泰之女，1318年嫁给帕多瓦领主雅各布二世·达·卡拉拉，为其第一任妻子。其子弗朗切斯科一世（老者）生于1325年，后来成为帕多瓦领主。

en: Lieta was the daughter of Marsilietto Papafava da Carrara, lord of Padua for forty-one days in 1345, probably by Agnese Visconti. She married Nicolò Maltraversi, count of Lozzo, who was banished after the failed plot against Jacopo II in December 1345.
zh: 列塔是1345年短暂统治帕多瓦四十一天的马尔西列托·帕帕法瓦·达·卡拉拉之女，母亲可能是阿涅塞·维斯康蒂。她嫁给洛佐伯爵尼科洛·马尔特拉韦尔西；1345年12月反对雅各布二世·达·卡拉拉的密谋失败后，其夫被逐出帕多瓦。

en: Luigia Gonzaga was a Mantuan noblewoman, daughter of Luigi I Gonzaga, first capitano del popolo of Mantua, and Caterina Malatesta. She married Azzo I da Correggio, count of Casalpò from 1341 and lord of Correggio and Guastalla, and was the mother of Guido da Correggio.
zh: 路易贾·贡扎加是曼托瓦贵族女性，曼托瓦首任人民队长路易吉一世·贡扎加与卡泰丽娜·马拉泰斯塔之女。她嫁给1341年成为卡萨尔波伯爵、领有科雷焦和瓜斯塔拉的阿佐一世·达·科雷焦，生子圭多·达·科雷焦。

en: Margherita da Carrara (born c. 1331) was the daughter of Giacomo II da Carrara, signore of Padua, and his first wife Lieta Forzatè, and a sister of Francesco I il Vecchio. She married the German nobleman Ottone di Stumbergh.
zh: 玛格丽塔·达·卡拉拉（约1331年生）是帕多瓦僭主雅各布二世·达·卡拉拉与第一任妻子列塔·福尔扎泰之女，弗朗切斯科一世（老者）的姐妹，嫁给了德意志贵族奥托内·迪·斯图姆贝格。

en: Marsilio da Carrara (1294–1338) was the Carrara lord who lost Padua to the Scaligeri and took it back. He succeeded his uncle Giacomo I and put down a plot in the city, but when Niccolò da Carrara went over to the Scaliger of Verona, he had to surrender Padua to Cangrande della Scala in 1328. He kept the title of vicar and married Giacomo's daughter Taddea to Mastino II della Scala. In the war against the Papal States he fought beside Mastino at Brescia in 1330–1331, took the city by treachery and governed it as vicar. In 1332 he had his wife Bartolomea Scrovegni poisoned on suspicion of adultery. After Cangrande's death, Florence and Venice, increasingly worried by Scaliger power, backed him, and he retook Padua in 1337. He died in March 1338, succeeded by his cousin Ubertino.
zh: 马尔西利奥·达·卡拉拉（1294—1338）是先把帕多瓦丢给斯卡拉家族、后又夺回的卡拉拉领主。他继叔父雅各布一世成为帕多瓦僭主，挫败过城中的一次阴谋，但尼科洛·达·卡拉拉叛投维罗纳的斯卡拉家族后，他于1328年被迫把帕多瓦交给坎格兰德·德拉·斯卡拉。他保留了代理人头衔，并将雅各布的女儿塔代娅嫁给马斯蒂诺二世·德拉·斯卡拉。在对教皇国的战争中，他于1330至1331年与马斯蒂诺攻打布雷西亚，凭借内应夺取该城，并出任当地代理人。1332年，他因怀疑妻子巴尔托洛梅亚·斯克罗韦尼不忠而将其毒杀。坎格兰德死后，佛罗伦萨与日益担忧斯卡拉家族势力的威尼斯支持他，他于1337年收复帕多瓦。1338年3月他去世，堂弟乌贝蒂诺继位。

en: Marsilietto Papafava da Carrara (died 1345) came from a minor branch of the Carrara family, nicknamed Papafava, and ruled Padua for only forty-one days. Son of Albertino and Adelaide Scrovegni, he was wounded in the anti-Carrarese revolt of 22 September 1325, as his distant kinsman Marsilio was rising to the signoria, and helped Niccolò da Carrara retake the Curame tower from Venice. Exiled in August 1328 on a charge of insulting the imperial vicar, he was recalled when Padua submitted to Cangrande della Scala that September, and Cangrande knighted him at Verona. He fought at the siege of Monselice in 1337. On 27 March 1345 the dying signore Ubertino named him his heir, passing over Niccolò's sons Giacomo and Giacomino; Ubertino's vicar Pietro da Campagnola, Niccolò's bitter enemy, feared their revenge. Marsilietto renewed the alliance with Venice on 20 April. On 6 May Giacomo II killed him and took the signoria, claiming it by right of succession.
zh: 马尔西列托·帕帕法瓦·达·卡拉拉（卒于1345年）出身卡拉拉家族的一个旁支，该支绰号“帕帕法瓦”，他只统治了帕多瓦四十一天。他是阿尔贝蒂诺与阿德拉伊德·斯克罗韦尼之子。1325年9月22日反对卡拉拉家族的暴动中他受了伤，当时他的远亲马尔西利奥正走向领主之位；他后来协助尼科洛·达·卡拉拉从威尼斯手中夺回库拉梅塔楼。1328年8月，他因被指辱骂帝国代理人而遭放逐；同年9月帕多瓦归附坎格兰德·德拉·斯卡拉，他随即被召回，并在维罗纳被坎格兰德封为骑士。1337年，他参加了蒙塞利切围城战。1345年3月27日，临终的僭主乌贝蒂诺绕过尼科洛的儿子雅各布和贾科米诺，指定他为继承人；乌贝蒂诺的代理人彼得罗·达·坎帕尼奥拉是尼科洛的死敌，担心他们报复。马尔西列托于4月20日续订了与威尼斯的同盟。5月6日，雅各布二世杀死了他，以继承权为由夺取僭主之位。

en: Marsilio da Carrara was the elder son of Jacopino da Carrara, podestà of Treviso, by his second wife Maria da Baone. With his brother Jacopino he was the ancestor of two Carraresi branches from which the lords of Padua descended. He died before 1210.
zh: 马尔西利奥·达·卡拉拉是特雷维索波德斯塔雅各皮诺·达·卡拉拉与第二任妻子玛丽亚·达·巴奥内的长子。他与弟弟雅各皮诺是卡拉拉家族两支的先祖，帕多瓦领主即出自这两支。他于1210年前去世。

en: Marsilio da Carrara, also Marsiglio III, was a thirteenth-century Paduan nobleman, son of Jacopo da Carrara. His son Giacomo I became the first Carraresi lord of Padua in 1318; another son, Pietro Perenzano, fathered the second lord, Marsilio.
zh: 马尔西利奥·达·卡拉拉（一作马尔西利奥三世）是13世纪帕多瓦贵族，雅各布·达·卡拉拉之子。其子贾科莫一世1318年成为卡拉拉家族首任帕多瓦领主，另一子彼得罗·佩伦扎诺是第二任领主马尔西利奥之父。

en: Marzio Forzatè, count of Montemerlo, belonged to the Forzatè, a Transalgardi branch that held Montemerlo castle for the bishop of Padua. In 1306 Bishop Altigrado Cattaneo of Vicenza granted him several fiefs. His daughter Lieta married Jacopo II da Carrara in 1318.
zh: 蒙泰梅洛伯爵马尔齐奥·福尔扎泰出身特兰萨尔加尔迪家族的福尔扎泰支系，后者替帕多瓦主教镇守蒙泰梅洛城堡。1306年，维琴察主教阿尔蒂格拉多·卡塔内奥封赐他多处封地。其女列塔于1318年嫁给雅各布二世·达·卡拉拉。

en: Niccolò da Carrara (1282–1344), son of Ubertino il Vecchio and Iselgarda, was a Paduan noble who bet on the Scaligeri of Verona against his own kinsmen who ruled Padua. He began on the other side: in 1320 he helped Marsilio de' Rossi hold Padua against a Scaliger attack and was ambassador at the Congress of Bolzano, and in 1322 he was podestà and captain of war at Bologna. He then followed a pro-Scaliger policy and opposed his kinsman Marsilio, lord of Padua, plotting against him in 1327. Marsilio thwarted the plot and jailed Niccolò's friends but left Niccolò himself free; in 1328 Marsilio gave Padua up to Cangrande della Scala. In 1335 Niccolò became rector of the Guelph party at Parma. He died at Chioggia in 1344 and was buried in Padua's Sant'Agostino church; his son Giacomo II took power in Padua a year later.
zh: 尼科洛·达·卡拉拉（1282—1344）是老者乌贝蒂诺与伊塞尔加尔达之子，帕多瓦贵族，他把赌注押在维罗纳的斯卡拉家族身上，对抗自己家族中执掌帕多瓦的亲族。他起初站在另一边：1320年，他与马尔西利奥·德罗西一同抵御斯卡拉家族对帕多瓦的进攻，并作为使节出席博尔扎诺会议；1322年出任博洛尼亚的波德斯塔兼战争统领。此后他奉行亲斯卡拉的政策，反对同族的帕多瓦僭主马尔西利奥，并于1327年策划阴谋。马尔西利奥挫败了阴谋，监禁了他的友人，却让他本人保持自由；1328年，马尔西利奥把帕多瓦交给坎格兰德·德拉·斯卡拉。1335年，尼科洛成为帕尔马圭尔夫派的首领。1344年他卒于基奥贾，葬于帕多瓦的圣阿戈斯蒂诺教堂；一年后，他的儿子雅各布二世夺取了帕多瓦的政权。

en: Pietro da Carrara, called Perenzano, was a Paduan nobleman, son of Marsilio da Carrara and brother of the first lord, Giacomo I. By Emilia Fieschi he fathered Marsilio, lord of Padua from 1337, and Cunizza, put to death for adultery in 1330.
zh: 彼得罗·达·卡拉拉（别称佩伦扎诺）是帕多瓦贵族，马尔西利奥·达·卡拉拉之子、首任领主贾科莫一世之弟。他娶埃米莉娅·菲耶斯基，生子马尔西利奥（1337年成为帕多瓦领主）、女库尼扎（1330年因通奸被处死）。

en: Rinaldo Papafava da Carrara was a member of the Papafava branch of the Carrara family and the husband of Furiana degli Scrovegni.
zh: 里纳尔多·帕帕法瓦·达·卡拉拉属于卡拉拉家族的帕帕法瓦支，是富里亚娜·德格利·斯克罗韦尼之夫。

en: Sara da Camposampiero was a Paduan noblewoman, the daughter of Guglielmo III da Camposampiero. She married the Parmesan nobleman Bertrando de' Rossi, and was the mother of Caterina, wife of Leonardo Malaspina, and of Bertrando de' Rossi the younger, later count of San Secondo.
zh: 萨拉·达·坎波桑皮耶罗是帕多瓦贵族、古列尔莫三世·达·坎波桑皮耶罗之女，嫁给帕尔马贵族贝尔特拉多·德·罗西；女儿卡特琳娜嫁给莱奥纳尔多·马拉斯皮纳，儿子小贝尔特拉多后来成为圣塞孔多伯爵。

en: Ubertino da Carrara, called il Vecchio, was a Paduan nobleman, son of Bonifacio da Carrara. His son Niccolò led Padua's pro-Scaliger faction and died exiled at Chioggia in 1344; his nephew Ubertino I was lord of Padua from 1338.
zh: 乌贝蒂诺·达·卡拉拉（别称“老者”）是帕多瓦贵族，博尼法乔·达·卡拉拉之子。其子尼科洛执掌帕多瓦亲斯卡拉派，1344年死于基奥贾流放地；其侄乌贝蒂诺一世1338年成为帕多瓦领主。

en: Ubertino da Carrara, called Novello or Ubertinello (c. 1301–1345), was Lord of Padua from 1338 until his death. In 1325 he murdered Guglielmo Dente, his family's rival, and after exile in Chioggia returned by force to drive the Dente faction out of Padua. Succeeding his cousin Marsilio in 1338, he took Monselice, traded Treviso to Venice, and was named papal vicar by Benedict XII in 1339. He fought the Scaligeri through shifting alliances, reformed Padua's finances, raised walls and a clock tower, and patronized its university. He died on 29 March 1345, naming Marsilietto Papafava his successor.
zh: 乌贝蒂诺·达·卡拉拉，人称“诺韦洛”或“乌贝尔蒂内洛”（约1301—1345），1338年起任帕多瓦领主，直至去世。1325年他刺杀卡拉拉家族的政敌古列尔莫·登特，被流放基奥贾后又武力返回，将登特派逐出帕多瓦。1338年他继承堂兄马尔西利奥的权位，攻占蒙塞利切，取得特雷维索后将其让给威尼斯，1339年被教皇本笃十二世任命为教廷代理人。他在不断变换的同盟中与斯卡拉家族作战，整顿帕多瓦财政，修筑城墙和钟楼，并扶持帕多瓦大学。他于1345年3月29日去世，指定马尔西列托·帕帕法瓦为继承人。

en: Adolf (27 September 1300 – 29 January 1327), called the Upright, was the second son of Rudolf I, Duke of Bavaria, and Mechtild of Nassau, born at Wolfratshausen. After his father died in 1319 he was formally Count Palatine of the Rhine, but his uncle Emperor Louis IV occupied the Palatinate, so Adolf never exercised real rule. In 1320 he married Irmengard of Oettingen, who bore his son Rupert II in 1325. Adolf died at Neustadt and was buried in Schönau Abbey near Heidelberg; the 1329 Treaty of Pavia restored the Palatinate to his brothers and son.
zh: 阿道夫（1300年9月27日—1327年1月29日），人称正直者，生于沃尔夫拉茨豪森，是巴伐利亚公爵鲁道夫一世与拿骚的梅希蒂尔德的次子。1319年父亲去世后，他名义上成为莱茵普法尔茨伯爵，但普法尔茨被其叔父皇帝路易四世占据，他始终未能亲政。1320年，他娶厄廷根的伊尔门加德，1325年生子鲁普雷希特。1327年阿道夫卒于诺伊施塔特，葬于海德堡附近的舍瑙修道院；1329年的《帕维亚条约》将普法尔茨归还其弟与子。

en: Agnes of Hohenstaufen (1176–7 or 9 May 1204) was the daughter and heiress of Conrad, Count Palatine of the Rhine. To reconcile Staufen and Welf, she was betrothed as a child to Henry, eldest son of Henry the Lion. When Emperor Henry VI instead planned to wed her to King Philip II of France, her mother Irmengard married the pair at Stahleck Castle in early 1194; the match helped reconcile the two dynasties. From 1195 she ruled the Palatinate with Henry, and bore the future Count Palatine Henry VI and two daughters.
zh: 霍亨斯陶芬的阿格尼丝（1176—1204年5月）是莱茵行宫伯爵康拉德的女儿和继承人。为弥合施陶芬与韦尔夫两大家族，她幼年即许配给狮子亨利的长子海因里希。皇帝亨利六世一度想把她改嫁给法国国王腓力二世，其母伊尔门加德趁康拉德外出，于1194年初在施塔莱克城堡为两人完婚，促成两大家族和解。1195年起她与海因里希共同统治行宫领地，生下后来的行宫伯爵海因里希六世和两个女儿。

en: Anna of Carinthia-Tyrol (c. 1300–1331) was a Meinhardiner princess, one of four daughters of Otto III, Duke of Carinthia and Count of Tyrol, and Euphemia of Silesia-Liegnitz of the Piast dynasty. In 1328 she married Rudolf II, the Wittelsbach Count Palatine of the Rhine and imperial elector. In September 1329 she gave birth to a daughter, also named Anna, who in 1349 married the future Emperor Charles IV and became queen of Bohemia. Anna died on 31 October 1331 and was buried at Schönau Cistercian Abbey; Rudolf remarried and died blind without a male heir in 1353.
zh: 克恩滕-蒂罗尔的安娜（约1300—1331）是迈因哈德家族的贵族女子，克恩滕公爵兼蒂罗尔伯爵奥托三世与皮雅斯特王朝西里西亚-莱格尼察的尤菲米娅四个女儿之一。1328年，她嫁给维特尔斯巴赫家族的莱茵行宫伯爵、帝国选帝侯鲁道夫二世。1329年9月她生下女儿安娜；小安娜于1349年嫁给后来的神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理四世，成为波希米亚王后。安娜于1331年10月31日去世，葬在舍瑙西多会修道院；鲁道夫后来再婚，1353年失明而死，无男性继承人。

en: Anne of the Palatinate (1329–1353) was the daughter of Count Palatine Rudolf II and Anna of Carinthia, born at Merano on 26 September 1329. On 11 March 1349 she married Charles IV at Bacharach on the Rhine, becoming his second wife after Blanche of Valois's death. She was crowned Queen of the Romans at Aachen on 26 July 1349 and later crowned Queen of Bohemia. Her only son Wenceslaus, born in 1350, died in 1351, and Anne herself died on 2 February 1353, aged twenty-three.
zh: 普法尔茨的安娜（1329—1353）是莱茵行宫伯爵鲁道夫二世与卡林西亚的安娜之女，1329年9月26日生于梅拉诺。1349年3月11日，她在莱茵河畔的巴哈拉赫嫁给查理四世，成为继瓦卢瓦的布朗什之后的第二任妻子。1349年7月26日，她在亚琛加冕为罗马人的王后，其后又加冕为波希米亚王后。她唯一的儿子文策尔生于1350年，1351年夭折；安娜本人于1353年2月2日去世，年仅23岁。

en: Henry the Elder (c. 1173–1227), eldest son of Henry the Lion and Matilda of England, was raised in English exile. Returning to Germany in 1189, he defended Brunswick against the forces of King Henry VI. In 1193 he married Agnes of Hohenstaufen, Conrad's daughter, and was enfeoffed with the Rhine Palatinate in 1195, founding the Welf Palatine line. He served Emperor Henry VI in the Sicilian campaign of 1194 and the Crusade of 1197. He later supported his brother Otto IV, joined Philip of Swabia in 1203, and returned to Otto's side in 1208. He ceded the Palatinate to his son Henry in 1213; after his son's early death, he left his Welf hereditary lands to his nephew Otto the Child. He died 28 April 1227.
zh: 长者亨利（约1173—1227）是狮子亨利与英格兰的玛蒂尔达之长子，在英格兰的流亡中长大成人。1189年返回德意志后，他保卫不伦瑞克，抵抗国王亨利六世的军队。1193年他娶霍亨斯陶芬家族康拉德之女阿格尼丝，1195年受封莱茵行宫伯国，成为韦尔夫家族普法尔茨支系的始祖。他随皇帝亨利六世参加1194年的西西里战事和1197年十字军，后来支持弟弟奥托四世，1203年转投士瓦本的腓力，1208年又回到奥托一方。1213年他把行宫伯国让给儿子亨利；儿子早逝后，他将韦尔夫世袭领地留给侄子“孩童”奥托。他于1227年4月28日去世。

en: Henry VI the Younger of Brunswick (c. 1196–26 April 1214), of the House of Welf, was Count Palatine of the Rhine from 1212. The only son of Count Palatine Henry V and Agnes of Hohenstaufen, he was raised at the English court of his great-uncle King John and returned to Germany in 1211. In 1212 his father abdicated in his favour and he married Mathilde of Brabant; he backed his uncle Emperor Otto IV, then defected to Frederick II. He died childless in 1214 and was buried at Schönau Abbey, the Palatinate passing to Duke Louis I of Bavaria.
zh: 韦尔夫家族的“小”海因里希六世（约1196—1214年4月26日）1212年起任莱茵行宫伯爵。他是行宫伯爵海因里希五世与霍亨斯陶芬的阿格尼丝的独子，在外叔祖父英格兰国王约翰的宫廷长大，1211年返回德意志。1212年父亲让位给他，他娶布拉班特的玛蒂尔德为妻；他先支持叔父皇帝奥托四世，随后转投腓特烈二世。1214年他无嗣而终，葬于海德堡附近的舍瑙修道院，行宫领地由巴伐利亚公爵路易一世继承。

en: Irmengard of Oettingen (c. 1304–1389) was a daughter of Count Louis VI of Oettingen and Agnes of Württemberg. In 1320 she married Adolf the Upright, nominal Count Palatine of the Rhine; his uncle Emperor Louis IV exercised the actual power of government, and Adolf died in 1327. After his death she retired with her children to the Dominican Liebenau monastery at Worms; the Treaty of Pavia in 1329 secured her young son Rupert II's succession to the Palatinate. She took the veil around 1347 and died at Liebenau in 1389.
zh: 厄廷根的伊尔门加德（约1304—1389）是厄廷根伯爵路易六世与符腾堡的阿格尼丝之女。1320年，她嫁给名义上的莱茵行宫伯爵“正直者”阿道夫；实际政权由阿道夫的叔父皇帝路易四世掌握，阿道夫于1327年去世。丈夫死后，她携子女退入沃尔姆斯的多明我会利本奥修道院；1329年的《帕维亚条约》确保了幼子鲁普雷希特二世对普法尔茨的继承权。她约于1347年发愿成为修女，1389年在利本奥修道院去世。

en: Conrad of Hohenstaufen (c. 1135–8 November 1195), younger half-brother of Emperor Frederick Barbarossa, was the first hereditary Count Palatine of the Rhine. At the Reichstag of Worms in 1156 Barbarossa granted him the count palatine's dignity together with the Staufen estates around Speyer and Worms. From about 1160 he was married to Irmengard of Henneberg. He clashed with the archbishops of Trier and Cologne while extending his lordship. As his sons predeceased him, his lands passed through his daughter Agnes to her Welf husband Henry.
zh: 霍亨斯陶芬的康拉德（约1135—1195年11月8日）是神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈一世（巴巴罗萨）的幼弟，也是首任世袭莱茵行宫伯爵。1156年沃尔姆斯帝国会议上，巴巴罗萨将行宫伯爵头衔连同施陶芬家族在施派尔和沃尔姆斯一带的地产封赐给他。约1160年他娶伊尔门加德为妻，扩张势力时与特里尔和科隆大主教发生冲突。他的儿子都先他而死，领地最终经女儿阿格尼丝归于其韦尔夫家族的夫婿海因里希。

en: Mechtild of Nassau (before 1280–19 June 1323) was the youngest daughter of Adolf, King of the Romans, and Imagina of Isenburg-Limburg. On 1 September 1294 at Nuremberg she married Rudolf I of Bavaria, the Wittelsbach duke who became Count Palatine of the Rhine, becoming duchess and countess palatine. After Rudolf's death in 1319 and the long feud with his brother, Emperor Louis IV, her sons Rudolf II the Blind and Rupert I the Red and her grandson Rupert II received the Palatinate under the Treaty of Pavia in 1329. She died at Heidelberg in 1323 and was buried at Klarenthal Abbey.
zh: 拿骚的梅希蒂尔德（1280年前—1323年6月19日）是罗马人的国王阿道夫与伊森堡-林堡的伊玛吉娜的幼女。1294年9月1日，她在纽伦堡嫁给维特尔斯巴赫家族的巴伐利亚公爵、后来成为莱茵行宫伯爵的鲁道夫一世，成为公爵夫人和行宫伯爵夫人。1319年鲁道夫去世后，经过与其兄弟皇帝路易四世的长期争斗，她的儿子“盲人”鲁道夫二世和“红毛”鲁普雷希特一世及孙子鲁普雷希特二世依1329年的《帕维亚条约》获得行宫领地。1323年她卒于海德堡，葬于克拉伦塔尔修道院。

en: Mechthild of Bavaria (1312–1375), a daughter of Rudolf I of the Palatinate and Mechtild of Nassau, married Count John III of Sponheim-Starkenburg in 1331; her brothers included the Elector Palatine Rupert I, and her son John IV inherited Starkenburg.
zh: 巴伐利亚的梅希蒂尔德（1312—1375）是莱茵行宫伯爵鲁道夫一世与拿骚的梅希蒂尔德之女，1331年嫁给施蓬海姆-施塔尔肯堡伯爵约翰三世；她的兄弟包括普法尔茨选帝侯鲁普雷希特一世，儿子约翰四世后来继承施塔尔肯堡。

en: Rudolf II, called the Blind (1306–1353), was Count Palatine of the Rhine. Born at Wolfratshausen to Rudolf I of Wittelsbach and Mechthild of Nassau, daughter of King Adolf, he grew up in a family war: after his father's death in 1319, his uncle Emperor Louis IV seized the Palatinate under a treaty of 1317, and the fighting ended only in 1322. Rudolf and his brother Ruprecht I, wards of Count Johann of Nassau, reconciled with Louis after their mother's death in 1323. By the Treaty of Pavia in 1329 they took over the Palatinate, while Louis and his sons kept Upper Bavaria; Rudolf received Neustadt in the 1338 partition. In 1349 the brothers backed Günther von Schwarzburg as anti-king, yet Rudolf married his daughter Anna to Charles IV at Stahleck Castle; the Wittelsbachs recognized Charles in 1350. Illness led Rudolf to leave most government to his brother, and he died at Neustadt in 1353, blind in his last year.
zh: 鲁道夫二世，绰号“盲人”（1306—1353），是莱茵行宫伯爵。他生于沃尔夫拉茨豪森，是鲁道夫一世·维特尔斯巴赫与拿骚的梅希蒂尔德（国王阿道夫之女）之子，童年笼罩在家族内战之中：1319年父亲去世后，叔父皇帝路易四世依1317年的协议夺取普法尔茨，战事直到1322年才结束。鲁道夫与弟弟鲁普雷希特一世受拿骚伯爵约翰监护，1323年母亲去世后，兄弟俩与路易和解。1329年，依《帕维亚条约》，他们接管普法尔茨，路易及其诸子则保有上巴伐利亚；1338年家族析产时，鲁道夫分得诺伊施塔特。1349年，兄弟俩支持金特·冯·施瓦茨堡为对立国王，但鲁道夫却在施塔莱克城堡把女儿安娜嫁给查理四世；维特尔斯巴赫家族于1350年承认查理为国王。鲁道夫因病将大部分政务交给弟弟，1353年卒于诺伊施塔特，最后一年已经失明。

en: Rupert II, called the Hard (1325–1398), was Elector Palatine of the Rhine. Born at Amberg on 12 May 1325, the elder son of Count Palatine Adolf and Irmengard of Oettingen, he was named heir to his childless uncles Rudolf II and Rupert I by the Treaty of Pavia in 1329 and succeeded Rupert I in 1390. In 1391 he expelled the Jews from the Palatinate and seized their property, and in 1395 he issued the Rupertine Constitution keeping the Palatinate undivided and annexing Neckargemünd. Married in 1345 to Beatrice of Sicily, he died at Amberg in 1398.
zh: 鲁普雷希特二世，绰号“严厉者”（1325—1398），莱茵普法尔茨选帝侯。他于1325年5月12日生于安贝格，是莱茵行宫伯爵阿道夫与厄廷根的伊尔门加德的长子；1329年的《帕维亚条约》指定他为无嗣的两位叔父鲁道夫二世与鲁普雷希特一世的继承人，1390年他继承鲁普雷希特一世成为选帝侯。1391年，他将犹太人逐出普法尔茨并没收其财产；1395年颁布《鲁普雷希特宪章》，维持普法尔茨不被分割，又兼并内卡格明德。他于1345年迎娶西西里的贝阿特丽切，1398年在安贝格去世。

en: Rupert I, called the Red (1309–1390), was Count Palatine of the Rhine and then the first Elector Palatine. Born at Wolfratshausen, a son of Rudolf I of Wittelsbach and Mechthild of Nassau, he lost his father at ten. In 1329 he and his brother Rudolf II won the Treaty of Pavia from their uncle Emperor Louis IV, which made the Palatinate a principality of its own; the brothers shared the electoral vote until Rupert became sole count in 1353. He inherited Rudolf's debt to Charles IV, who split part of the Upper Palatinate off as New Bohemia. Charles's Golden Bull of 1356 guaranteed the Palatinate's vote in imperial elections, and in 1376 Rupert received Oppenheim, Nierstein and Ingelheim for voting Wenceslaus king. He founded Heidelberg University in 1386, the third in the Holy Roman Empire. Neither marriage, to Elisabeth of Namur and Beatrix of Jülich-Berg, produced an heir. He died at Neustadt in 1390, and his nephew Rupert II succeeded him.
zh: 鲁普雷希特一世，绰号“红发”（1309—1390），历任莱茵行宫伯爵、首任普法尔茨选帝侯。他生于沃尔夫拉茨豪森，是鲁道夫一世·维特尔斯巴赫与拿骚的梅希蒂尔德之子，十岁丧父。1329年，他与兄长鲁道夫二世从叔父皇帝路易四世手中争得《帕维亚条约》，使普法尔茨成为独立的公国；兄弟二人共享选帝侯票，1353年鲁普雷希特继位成为唯一的行宫伯爵。他同时继承了鲁道夫欠查理四世的债务，查理随后把上普法尔茨的一部分划出，称“新波希米亚”。查理1356年颁布的《金玺诏书》保障了普法尔茨的帝国选帝权；1376年，他因投票选举文策尔为国王，获得奥彭海姆、尼尔施泰因和英格尔海姆。他于1386年创办海德堡大学，即神圣罗马帝国的第三所大学。他先后迎娶纳慕尔的伊丽莎白和于利希-贝格的贝阿特丽克丝，两次婚姻均无继承人。1390年他卒于诺伊施塔特，由侄子鲁普雷希特二世继位。

en: Ottobuono de' Fieschi (c. 1205–1276), son of Tedisio Fieschi of Lavagna, became a papal chaplain in 1243 and was made Cardinal Deacon of San Adriano in December 1251 by his uncle Pope Innocent IV. Clement IV sent him to England in 1265 to reconcile Henry III with his barons and preach the Crusades; he stayed until 1268, named as a witness in the 1267 Statute of Marlborough. In 1268 he issued canons that became a foundation of English church law. He was elected pope as Adrian V on 11 July 1276 through Charles I of Anjou, but died at Viterbo on 18 August, unordained, after thirty-eight days, having suspended Gregory X's conclave rules. Dante places him among the avaricious in Purgatory.
zh: 奥托博诺·德·菲耶斯基（约1205—1276）是拉瓦尼亚的泰迪西奥·菲耶斯基之子，1243年成为教宗随侍神父，1251年12月被叔父依诺增爵四世任命为圣亚德堂枢机执事。克勉四世于1265年派他出使英格兰，调解亨利三世与贵族之间的纠纷并宣讲十字军；他一直留任到1268年，1267年的《马尔伯勒法令》中仍列有他作为见证人的名字。1268年他颁布教规，成为英格兰教会法的基础。1276年7月11日，经安茹的查理推动，他当选教宗，称哈德良五世，但仅在位三十八天，尚未领受司铎圣职便在8月18日卒于维泰博；他生前已暂停格列高利十世有关秘密会议的规章。但丁在《神曲·炼狱篇》中将他置于贪财者之中。

en: Jacques Fournier (c. 1285–1342), born at Saverdun in the County of Foix, joined the Cistercians, studied at Paris and became Abbot of Fontfroide in 1311. As Bishop of Pamiers from 1317 he hunted the last Cathars of Languedoc; his inquiry led to the burning of Guillaume Bélibaste in 1321, and his Montaillou inquiries filled the Fournier Register. Bishop of Mirepoix in 1326 and a cardinal from 1327, he kept wearing his Cistercian cowl and was nicknamed the white cardinal. Elected pope at Avignon on 30 December 1334 as Benedict XII, third of the Avignon popes, he could not move the court to Rome or Bologna and began the great papal palace at Avignon instead. He reformed the monastic orders, opposed nepotism and settled John XXII's dispute over the beatific vision with the bull Benedictus Deus, but could not bring Emperor Louis IV to terms. He died on 25 April 1342 and was buried at Avignon.
zh: 本笃十二世（约1285—1342）俗名雅克·富尼耶，生于富瓦伯国的萨韦尔丹，加入西多会，在巴黎求学，1311年任丰特弗鲁瓦德修道院院长。1317年起任帕米耶主教，大力清剿朗格多克残余的清洁派；经他调查，纪尧姆·贝利巴斯特于1321年被火刑处死，他在蒙塔尤的调查则记满了《富尼耶登记册》。他1326年任米尔普瓦主教，1327年升任枢机，仍穿着西多会的会袍，得了“白衣枢机”的绰号。1334年12月30日，他在阿维尼翁当选教宗，是第三任阿维尼翁教宗；他无法把教廷迁往罗马或博洛尼亚，便动工兴建阿维尼翁教皇宫。他改革各修会、反对裙带关系，并颁布《赞美天主》诏书了结若望二十二世留下的荣福直观之争，却没能与皇帝路易四世达成和解。1342年4月25日，他去世，葬于阿维尼翁。

en: Pope Benedict XI (1240–1304), born Niccolò Boccasini in Treviso, was a Dominican who studied in Venice and Milan and taught in houses of his order. He twice served as provincial prior of Lombardy, was elected master general of the order in 1296 and made a cardinal in 1298. He served as papal legate to Hungary and then France. He was at Pope Boniface VIII's side when French troops seized the pope at Anagni in 1303. Elected pontiff in October 1303, he lifted Boniface's excommunication of Philip IV of France but in June 1304 excommunicated Philip's minister Guillaume de Nogaret over the Anagni outrage, and brokered a French-English armistice. He died at Perugia on 7 July 1304 after eight months as pope.
zh: 教宗本笃十一世（1240—1304）生于特雷维索，原名尼科洛·博卡西尼，是多明我会会士，曾在威尼斯和米兰求学，并在修会各院任教。他两度出任伦巴第省会长，1296年当选修会总会长，1298年获封枢机，先后作为教宗使节出使匈牙利和法国。1303年法国军队在阿纳尼劫持教宗博义八世时，他随侍在侧。1303年10月他当选教宗，随即解除博义八世对法王腓力四世的绝罚，却于1304年6月因阿纳尼之变绝罚腓力的大臣纪尧姆·德·诺加雷，并促成法英停战。他在位仅八个月，于1304年7月7日在佩鲁贾去世。

en: Pedro Martínez de Luna (1328–1423), known as Papa Luna, was an Aragonese noble and canon lawyer who became the last great claimant of the Avignon papacy in the Western Schism. He studied law at Montpellier, took a doctorate and taught canon law there; Gregory XI, who valued his learning, birth and austere life, made him a cardinal in 1375. After Clement VII's death the Avignon cardinals elected him pope in September 1394 as Benedict XIII, and the Schism went on. France withdrew its obedience in 1398 and besieged his palace at Avignon for five years, until he escaped in 1403. In 1406 the Roman pope Gregory XII proposed that both resign together; Benedict refused, and the Council of Pisa in 1409 only added a third claimant. The Council of Constance deposed him in 1417, leaving only Aragon on his side. He held out in Peníscola castle and died there on 23 May 1423, still claiming the papacy.
zh: 佩德罗·马丁内斯·德·卢纳（1328—1423），人称“卢纳教皇”，是阿拉贡贵族、教会法学者，也是西方教会大分裂中阿维尼翁一系最后的重要教宗人选。他曾在蒙彼利埃大学学习法律，获得博士学位，并在那里教授教会法；格列高利十一世看重他的学识、出身和清苦的生活，1375年任命他为枢机。克勉七世去世后，阿维尼翁的枢机们于1394年9月选举他为教皇，称本笃十三世，大分裂由此延续。1398年法国撤回对他的承认，阿维尼翁教皇宫遭围困五年，他于1403年逃脱。1406年，罗马教宗格列高利十二世提议双方同时退位，本笃十三世拒绝；1409年比萨公会议反而选出了第三位教宗。1417年康斯坦茨公会议废黜他，此时只有阿拉贡还支持他。他退守佩尼伊斯科拉城堡，1423年5月23日在那里去世，至死仍自称教皇。

en: Gian Lorenzo Bernini (7 December 1598–1680) was born in Naples to the Mannerist sculptor Pietro Bernini and moved to Rome with his family in 1606, when his father received a papal commission. Pietro trained his son, and the two collaborated on several sculptures. A child prodigy patronized by Cardinal Scipione Borghese, Gian Lorenzo also attracted the attention of Pope Paul V. He carved Apollo and Daphne (1622–1625) and the groups that founded Baroque sculpture. As favourite artist of Pope Urban VIII he decorated St Peter's, later adding the Four Rivers Fountain (1648–1651) and the Ecstasy of Saint Teresa, and under Alexander VII the sweeping colonnades of St Peter's Square. In 1665 he served Louis XIV in Paris. He died in Rome on 28 November 1680.
zh: 吉安·洛伦佐·贝尼尼（1598年12月7日—1680年）生于那不勒斯，父亲是风格主义雕塑家彼得罗·贝尼尼，1606年父亲接受教宗委托后，他随家迁居罗马。彼得罗训练儿子，两人合作创作了多件雕塑。吉安·洛伦佐幼年有神童之名，受希皮奥内·博尔盖塞红衣主教庇护，也引起教宗保罗五世的注意。他创作了《阿波罗与达芙妮》（1622—1625）等群雕，开创巴洛克雕塑风格。作为教宗乌尔班八世最倚重的艺术家，他主持装饰圣彼得大教堂，后来又完成《四河喷泉》（1648—1651）与《圣特雷莎的狂喜》，并在亚历山大七世时期设计了环抱圣彼得广场的柱廊。1665年他赴巴黎为路易十四效力，1680年11月28日在罗马去世。

en: Bertoldo Orsini was a Roman nobleman, brother of Matteo Rosso Orsini, who served as podestà of Viterbo in 1259, Lucca in 1262, Messina in 1269 and Orvieto in 1278. In 1278 Pope Nicholas III named him count of Romagna and governor of Bologna, and he worked there alongside the legate Cardinal Latino Malabranca. Hostile to the Annibaldeschi faction, he spent a period of exile at Palestrina. He was again podestà of Orvieto in 1287 and governed Spoleto from 1298. He died in 1319.
zh: 贝尔托尔多·奥尔西尼是罗马贵族，马特奥·罗梭·奥尔西尼之弟，曾先后任维泰博（1259年）、卢卡（1262年）、墨西拿（1269年）和奥尔维耶托（1278年）的长官。1278年，教皇尼各老三世任命他为罗马涅伯爵兼博洛尼亚总督，与教皇使节拉蒂诺·马拉布兰卡枢机一同治理该地。因与安尼巴尔代斯基家族为敌，他曾一度被逐，避居帕莱斯特里纳。1287年他再次出任奥尔维耶托长官，1298年起任斯波莱托总督，1319年去世。

en: Bertoldo Orsini was a Roman noble, a son of Romano Orsini, count of Sovana, and Anastasia de Montfort, and a brother of Guido, the first count of Pitigliano.
zh: 贝尔托尔多·奥尔西尼是罗马贵族，索瓦纳伯爵罗马诺·奥尔西尼与阿纳斯塔西娅·德·蒙福尔之子，首任皮蒂利亚诺伯爵圭多的兄弟。

en: Bobone di Pietro was a 12th-century Roman nobleman of the Bobone family, a son of Pietro Bobone and brother of Pope Celestine III. The Orsini genealogy makes him father of Orso di Bobone (d. 1207), regarded as founder of the Orsini.
zh: 博博内·迪·彼得罗是12世纪罗马博博内家族的贵族，彼得罗·博博内之子、教皇雷定三世的兄弟。奥尔西尼谱系记载他是奥尔索·迪·博博内之父；奥尔索卒于1207年，被视为奥尔西尼家族的始祖。

en: Benedetto Caetani was born around 1230 at Anagni, a younger son of the baronial Caetani family. He studied law at Todi and in 1264 served Cardinal Simon de Brion on a mission to France. Made a cardinal in 1281, he was elected pope on 24 December 1294 after Celestine V abdicated. Boniface VIII asserted sweeping claims to papal supremacy: he issued the decretal collection Liber Sextus in 1298, proclaimed Rome's first jubilee year in 1300, and in 1302 published Unam sanctam amid his quarrel with Philip IV of France over taxing the clergy. On 7 September 1303 French troops seized him at Anagni; released after three days, he died in Rome on 11 October 1303.
zh: 本尼狄克·卡埃塔尼约1230年生于阿纳尼，是卡埃塔尼男爵家族的儿子之一，并非长子。他曾在托迪学习法律，1264年随枢机西蒙·德布里翁出使法国。他1281年受任枢机，1294年12月24日在雷定五世退位后当选教皇。博义八世极力主张教皇的至高权威：1298年颁布教令集《第六卷》，1300年在罗马首创圣年，1302年又在与法王腓力四世围绕向教士征税的争执中发布《唯一至圣》通谕。1303年9月7日，法国军队在阿纳尼将他拘捕；被囚三天后他获释，10月11日在罗马去世。

en: Guy of Burgundy, son of Count William I of Burgundy, became archbishop of Vienne in 1088 and led the French clergy's resistance to Emperor Henry V over lay investiture. In 1112 he convened bishops at Vienne who condemned lay investiture and excommunicated Henry. Elected pope at Cluny in 1119 as Callixtus II, he issued the bull Sicut Judaeis in 1120, protecting Jews from forced conversion and violence. His chief achievement was ending the Investiture Controversy with Henry V through the Concordat of Worms in 1122, which he confirmed at the First Lateran Council in 1123. The council also condemned simony and clerical concubinage. He died in Rome on 13 December 1124.
zh: 勃艮第的居伊是勃艮第伯爵威廉一世之子，1088年出任维埃纳大主教，曾率领法国教士反抗神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利五世的俗人授职主张。1112年，他在维埃纳召集主教会议，谴责俗人授职并将亨利逐出教会。1119年他在克吕尼当选教皇，称嘉礼二世，1120年颁布《犹太人保护通谕》，禁止强迫犹太人改宗并保障其人身安全。他最大的成就是1122年与亨利五世签订《沃尔姆斯宗教协定》，结束叙任权之争，并于1123年召开第一次拉特朗大公会议予以确认。会议还谴责买卖圣职和教士蓄妾。1124年12月13日，他在罗马去世。

en: Giacinto Bobone was born around 1106 into Rome's noble Orsini branch of the Bobone family. He studied under Peter Abelard in Paris and defended him at the 1140 Council of Sens, became cardinal deacon of Santa Maria in Cosmedin in 1144, and twice served as papal legate in Spain, in 1154–1155 and 1172–1175. The Roman Curia regarded him as an expert on Spain. Elected pope in March 1191 at about eighty-five, he took the name Celestine III and crowned Henry VI Holy Roman Emperor that April. In 1192 he confirmed the Teutonic Order, and in 1195 he quashed Philip II of France's repudiation of his wife Ingeborg. He died on 8 January 1198.
zh: 琴乔·博博内约1106年生于罗马博博内家族的奥尔西尼支。他曾在巴黎师从彼得·阿伯拉尔，1140年在桑斯会议上为其辩护，1144年受任为科斯梅丁圣母堂枢机执事，还曾于1154—1155年和1172—1175年两度作为教皇使节出使西班牙。罗马教廷视他为西班牙事务的专家。1191年3月，年约八十五岁的他当选教皇，取号雷定三世，并于同年4月为亨利六世加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇帝。1192年他批准条顿骑士团，1195年宣布法王腓力二世休弃妻子英厄堡无效。他于1198年1月8日去世。

en: Bertrand de Got (c. 1264–1314), born to a Gascon family at Villandraut, studied law at Orléans and Bologna and served as Bishop of Saint-Bertrand-de-Comminges before becoming Archbishop of Bordeaux in 1297. As archbishop he was a subject of the English king, but also a friend of Philip IV of France. Elected pope in 1305 as Clement V, he transferred the papal court from Rome to Avignon in 1309, opening the Avignon Papacy. Yielding to Philip IV, he moved against the Knights Templar, allowed the execution of many of its members and suppressed the order. He violently repressed the Dulcinians in Lombardy as heretics and issued the Clementine Constitutions in 1313. He died on 20 April 1314.
zh: 克勉五世（约1264—1314）俗名贝特朗·德·戈特，生于维朗德罗的一个加斯科涅家族，曾在奥尔良和博洛尼亚攻读法律，任圣贝尔特朗德科曼日主教，1297年成为波尔多大主教。他作为大主教是英王的臣属，也是法王腓力四世的朋友。1305年他当选教宗，1309年将教廷从罗马迁至阿维尼翁，开启阿维尼翁教宗时代。在腓力四世的压力下，他出手打击圣殿骑士团，默许处决其许多成员并最终取缔该修会。他以异端罪名残酷镇压伦巴第的多尔奇诺派，1313年颁布《克雷芒教令集》，1314年4月20日去世。

en: Pierre Roger (1291–1352), born at Maumont in the Limousin, entered the Benedictine abbey of La Chaise-Dieu as a boy and became a theology master in Paris in 1323. He rose from Abbot of Fécamp in 1326 to Archbishop of Sens in 1329 and Archbishop of Rouen in 1330, and was made a cardinal in 1338, serving Philip VI as councillor and diplomat. In 1328 he had unsuccessfully summoned Edward III to pay homage to Philip for Aquitaine. Elected pope at Avignon in May 1342, he took the name Clement VI, deepened French dominance of the Church. He added a chapel to the Papal Palace and kept composers such as Philippe de Vitry about him. In 1348, as the Black Death struck, he condemned the pogroms against the Jews and granted remission of sins to plague victims. He died on 6 December 1352, remembered as a munificent prince, but no saint, and was buried at La Chaise-Dieu.
zh: 皮埃尔·罗歇（1291—1352）生于利穆赞的莫蒙，少年时进入本笃会的拉谢斯迪约修道院，1323年在巴黎成为神学硕士。他1326年任费康修道院院长，此后历任桑斯大主教（1329年）和鲁昂大主教（1330年），1338年受任枢机，同时以顾问和外交官身份效力于腓力六世。1328年他曾奉命要求爱德华三世就阿基坦向腓力行臣服礼，却未获答复。1342年5月，他在阿维尼翁当选教宗，称克雷芒六世，加深了法国对教会的支配。他在教宗宫增建了一座礼拜堂，身边常有菲利普·德·维特里等作曲家。黑死病袭来的1348年，他下诏谴责迫害犹太人的暴行，并为染疫而死者颁赐罪罚大赦。1352年12月6日他去世，人们记得他是一位慷慨的君侯，却算不上圣人，遗体安葬在拉谢斯迪约。

en: Domenico Fontana (1543–1607) was born at Melide on Lake Lugano and settled in Rome in 1563 to join his elder brother. He began as a plasterer, then worked as a mason and master builder. In 1584 Cardinal Montalto entrusted him with building the Chapel of the Manger in Santa Maria Maggiore. As the trusted architect of Montalto, who became Pope Sixtus V in 1585, he was named architect of St Peter's, added the lantern to Michelangelo's dome, and rebuilt the Lateran Palace from 1586. In 1586 he famously moved the ancient Vatican obelisk into St Peter's Square and re-erected three other Roman obelisks. After Sixtus died he fell from favour and in 1592 moved to Naples, where he served the Spanish viceroy until his death on 28 June 1607.
zh: 多梅尼科·丰塔纳（1543—1607）生于卢加诺湖畔的梅利德，1563年前往罗马投奔兄长。他最初做灰泥工，后来成为石匠和营造师。1584年，蒙塔尔托红衣主教委托他在圣母大殿修建圣诞小堂。他是蒙塔尔托的亲信建筑师，这位主教于1585年成为教宗西斯都五世后，任命他为圣彼得大教堂建筑师；他为米开朗基罗设计的穹顶加装灯笼顶，并自1586年主持重建拉特朗宫。1586年，他将古老的梵蒂冈方尖碑迁至圣彼得广场，又在罗马城重新竖立另外三座方尖碑，轰动一时。西斯都五世去世后他失宠，1592年前往那不勒斯为西班牙总督效力，1607年6月28日在当地去世。

en: Francesco Petrarca (1304–1374), born at Arezzo, grew up in the shadow of the Avignon papacy: his family followed the papal court to France, and he spent much of his youth at Avignon. His notary father made him study law at Montpellier and Bologna, years he thought wasted. He returned to Avignon in 1326 to hold clerical offices. On 6 April 1327 he saw a woman named Laura in Avignon's church of Sainte-Claire, inspiring the lifelong sequence of Italian love poems called the Canzoniere. In 1336 he climbed Mont Ventoux for the view alone, and wrote a famous letter about it. His Latin epic Africa, on Scipio Africanus, made him a European celebrity, and on 8 April 1341 he was crowned poet laureate on Rome's Capitoline Hill. In 1345 he discovered Cicero's letters to Atticus at Verona, a find credited with founding Renaissance humanism. He retired to Arquà near Padua and died there on 19 July 1374.
zh: 弗朗切斯科·彼特拉克（1304—1374）生于阿雷佐，成长在阿维尼翁教廷的阴影下：家人随教廷迁往法国，他的青少年时代大半在阿维尼翁度过。公证人出身的父亲让他在蒙彼利埃和博洛尼亚攻读法律，他却认为这几年白白浪费。1326年他返回阿维尼翁担任教职。1327年4月6日，他在阿维尼翁的圣克莱尔教堂见到一位名叫劳拉的女子，由此写下贯穿一生的意大利语情诗组诗，即后来的《歌集》。1336年，他只为眺望风景而攀登旺图山，并写下一封著名的书信。他以大西庇阿为题材的拉丁语史诗《阿非利加》使他名闻欧洲，1341年4月8日在罗马的卡皮托利尼山被加冕为桂冠诗人。1345年，他在维罗纳发现西塞罗致阿提库斯的书信，这一发现被视为文艺复兴人文主义的开端。晚年他隐居帕多瓦附近的阿尔夸，1374年7月19日在那里去世。

en: Gentile I Orsini, son of Matteo Rosso Orsini the Great and Perna Gaetani, was the first Orsini lord of Pitigliano. He married Costanza de Cardinale and died before 1246, predeceasing his father. His sons included Bertoldo, second lord of Pitigliano, and Cardinal Matteo Rubeo.
zh: 真蒂莱一世·奥尔西尼是“伟大者”马泰奥·罗索与发妻佩尔娜·卡埃塔尼之子，首任皮蒂利亚诺领主，娶科斯坦扎·德·卡尔迪纳莱，1246年前先父而亡。其子有第二任领主贝尔托尔多和枢机马泰奥·鲁贝奥。

en: Gerald Odonis (1285–1349), born at Camboulit, joined the Franciscans at Figeac and taught theology at Toulouse and Paris. His order was split over poverty: John XXII had deposed Michael of Cesena in 1328, and on 10 June 1329 the Paris general chapter, siding with the pope, elected Gerald Minister General. In 1331 and 1332 he represented John at Naples, where King Robert and Queen Sancia protected the strict adherents of poverty. On 18 December 1333 he defended John's teaching on the beatific vision before the University of Paris. In 1337 he pushed his Benedictine constitutions through the Cahors chapter despite strong opposition, and he kept sending missionaries to Persia, Malabar and China. In 1342 Clement VI made him Patriarch of Antioch and Bishop of Catania. When the Black Death reached Messina in 1347, Catania would not let St Agatha's relics go, so he dipped them in water and carried the water there himself. He died of the plague in 1349.
zh: 杰拉尔德·奥多尼斯（1285—1349）生于康布利，在菲雅克加入方济各会，曾在图卢兹和巴黎教授神学。他的修会因贫穷之争而分裂：若望二十二世1328年罢免了切塞纳的米凯莱，1329年6月10日巴黎全体大会站在教宗一边，选举他为修会总会长。1331年和1332年，他代表教宗前往那不勒斯，当地的国王罗贝托与王后桑查庇护坚持严格守贫的一派。1333年12月18日，他在巴黎大学为若望二十二世的荣福直观主张辩护。1337年，他不顾强烈反对，在卡奥尔大会上通过“本笃会宪”，并不断向波斯、马拉巴尔和中国派遣传教士。1342年，克雷芒六世任命他为安条克牧首兼卡塔尼亚主教。1347年黑死病传到墨西拿时，卡塔尼亚人不肯交出圣阿加莎的圣髑，他便把圣髑浸入水中，亲自将这水带往墨西拿。1349年他死于瘟疫。

en: Giacoma Orsini was a Roman noblewoman who married Nicola Caetani, count of Fondi. Her son Onorato I Caetani, born around 1336, succeeded his father as count of Fondi in 1348 and became one of the leading barons of the Papal States.
zh: 贾科马·奥尔西尼是罗马贵族女子，嫁给丰迪伯爵尼科洛·卡埃塔尼。她的儿子奥诺拉托一世·卡埃塔尼约生于1336年，1348年继其父为丰迪伯爵，后成为教皇国首屈一指的大男爵之一。

en: Giovanni Orsini, called Giangaetano, was a Roman baron and lord of Vicovaro, son of Orso di Bobone. By Stefania Rubea he fathered Matteo Rosso Orsini the Great (1178–1246), senator of Rome, whose son became Pope Nicholas III. His will is dated 12 April 1232.
zh: 乔瓦尼·奥尔西尼，人称詹加埃塔诺，罗马贵族、维科瓦罗领主，奥尔索·迪·博博内之子。他与斯特凡尼娅·鲁贝娅生子“伟大者”马泰奥·罗索·奥尔西尼（1178—1246），后者曾任罗马元老，其子成为教皇尼各老三世。其遗嘱立于1232年4月12日。

en: Gil de Albornoz (1302/1303–1367), born at Carrascosa del Campo, was a Castilian churchman and soldier. He studied law at Toulouse and became Archbishop of Toledo in 1338, holding two reform synods. He fought the Marinid invasion at Río Salado in 1340 and led his see's levy at the capture of Algeciras in 1344. After Alfonso XI died in March 1350 he left Castile and never returned; Pope Clement VI made him a cardinal that December. Innocent VI named him grand penitentiary with the epithet “Angel of Peace”, a title his campaigns soon made ironic. Sent to Italy in 1353 to restore papal authority, he led mercenary armies in two campaigns and extended the Papal States. His Constitutiones Sanctae Matris Ecclesiae regulated their administration and division into provinces until 1816. He founded Bologna's Collegio di Spagna in 1364 and was made legate at Bologna in 1367, the year he died.
zh: 希尔·德·阿尔沃诺斯（1302/1303—1367）生于卡拉斯科萨德尔坎波，是卡斯蒂利亚的教士兼军人。他曾在图卢兹攻读法律，1338年出任托莱多大主教，主持两次改革会议。1340年，他在萨拉萨多河战役中抵御马林王朝自摩洛哥发动的入侵，1344年率教区武装参加攻取阿尔赫西拉斯。1350年3月阿方索十一世去世后，他离开卡斯蒂利亚，再没有回来；同年12月，教宗克雷芒六世立他为枢机主教。英诺森六世任命他为大赦官，赐号“和平天使”，而他随后的战事很快让这个称号成了反讽。1353年他被派往意大利，要恢复教宗的权威，率雇佣军两度出征，扩大了教皇国的疆域。他颁布的《埃吉迪奥宪章》规定教皇国的行政和省区划分，直到1816年才失效。1364年他在博洛尼亚创办西班牙学院，1367年被任命为博洛尼亚教廷特使，同年去世。

en: Pierre Roger de Beaufort (c. 1329–1378), born at Maumont in the Limousin, was the nephew of Pope Clement VI, who made him a cardinal in 1348 at about eighteen. He studied at Perugia and became a skilled canonist. Elected pope at Avignon on 30 December 1370, he took the name Gregory XI and was the seventh and last Avignon pope. He waged the War of the Eight Saints against Florence, placing the city under interdict in March 1376. Catherine of Siena came to Avignon to urge his return, and on 17 January 1377 he entered Rome, ending nearly seventy years of papal residence at Avignon. He died on 27 March 1378. Urban VI was elected to succeed him and a rival pope emerged at Avignon. Most of Europe followed the Avignon claimant, and the Western Schism, not fully healed until the Council of Constance, had begun.
zh: 皮埃尔·罗歇·德·博福尔（约1329—1378）生于利穆赞的莫蒙，是教宗克雷芒六世的侄子，1348年约十八岁时被叔父册封为枢机。他在佩鲁贾求学，成为精通教会法的学者。1370年12月30日，他在阿维尼翁当选教宗，称额我略十一世，是第七位也是最后一位阿维尼翁教宗。他对佛罗伦萨发动“八圣之战”，1376年3月对该城处以禁罚。锡耶纳的凯瑟琳亲赴阿维尼翁促其返回罗马，1377年1月17日他进入罗马，结束了教廷居留阿维尼翁近七十年的历史。1378年3月27日他去世。乌尔巴诺六世当选继任后，阿维尼翁出现了与其对立的教宗，欧洲大部分地区追随阿维尼翁一方，西方教会大分裂就此开始，直到康斯坦茨公会议才完全解决。

en: Gregory XII (c. 1327–1417), born Angelo Correr into a Venetian noble family, became bishop of Castello in 1380, Latin Patriarch of Constantinople in 1390 and a cardinal in 1405. Elected pope on 30 November 1406, at about eighty, he took office on the condition that he would resign if the Avignon claimant Benedict XIII did the same, ending a schism that had split the Church since 1378. Talks with Benedict went nowhere. In 1409 the Council of Pisa chose a third claimant, Alexander V, followed by John XXIII, and Gregory, holding Rome, recognised none of them. On 4 July 1415 he freely resigned at the Council of Constance, the last pope to do so until Benedict XVI in 2013. The council made him cardinal bishop of Porto and papal legate for life in the March of Ancona. He died at Recanati on 18 October 1417, the year Martin V was elected and the schism ended.
zh: 额我略十二世（约1327—1417）原名安杰洛·科雷尔，生于威尼斯贵族家庭，1380年任卡斯泰洛主教，1390年任君士坦丁堡拉丁宗主教，1405年成为枢机。1406年11月30日，年近八十的他当选教皇，条件是阿维尼翁一方的对立教皇本笃十三世若辞职，他也辞职，以此结束自1378年起分裂教会的大分裂。与本笃的谈判毫无结果。1409年比萨公会议另选了第三位教皇亚历山大五世，继任者是约翰二十三世，据守罗马的额我略一个都不承认。1415年7月4日，他在康斯坦茨公会议上主动退位，此后直到2013年本笃十六世退位前，再没有教皇辞职。公会议任命他为波尔图枢机主教和安科纳边区终身教廷特使。1417年10月18日，他在雷卡纳蒂去世，同年马丁五世当选，大分裂结束。

en: Guillaume Court (c. 1290–1361), born at Belpech in Languedoc, was a Cistercian theologian and abbot of Boulbonne who received a doctorate in theology from John XXII in 1319. He aided his uncle, the inquisitor Jacques Fournier, in the heresy trials at Montaillou. When Fournier became Benedict XII, he made Court Bishop of Nîmes in 1337, moved him the same year to Albi, and raised him to cardinal on 18 December 1338. Called the white cardinal, probably for the Cistercian robe he wore like his uncle, he sat in the conclaves of 1342, which chose Clement VI, and 1352, which chose Innocent VI, and served as legate in Lombardy. He investigated Franciscan spirituals and ordered Joannes de Rupescissa to write the Book of Secret Events. In 1354 he headed the Avignon tribunal that cleared Joannes, while two others, John of Castillon and Francis of Arquata, were condemned and burned. He died at Avignon on 12 June 1361.
zh: 纪尧姆·库尔（约1290—1361）生于朗格多克的贝尔佩什，是西多会神学家、布尔博纳修道院院长，1319年获若望二十二世颁授神学博士学位。他协助舅父、宗教裁判官雅克·富尼耶审理蒙塔尤的异端案件。富尼耶成为本笃十二世后，于1337年任命他为尼姆主教，同年改任阿尔比主教，1338年12月18日又将他擢升为枢机。他人称“白衣枢机”，大概因为他和舅父一样穿着西多会的会袍。他参加了选出克雷芒六世的1342年秘密会议和选出依诺增爵六世的1352年秘密会议，曾任伦巴第特使。他审查方济各会属灵派的案件，并命让·德·罗克塔亚德写下《隐秘事件之书》。1354年，他主持阿维尼翁的宗教法庭，为罗克塔亚德平反，另两人约翰·德·卡斯蒂永和弗朗西斯·德·阿尔誇塔则被判有罪并烧死。1361年6月12日，他卒于阿维尼翁。

en: Hélie de Talleyrand-Périgord was born at Périgueux in 1301, the third son of Count Elias VII of Périgord and Brunissende of Foix, and was destined for the Church. He became a leading cardinal of the Avignon papacy: at the conclave of December 1334 he headed the French cardinals resolved to keep the Curia in Avignon, against Napoleone Orsini’s party demanding a return to Rome, and the election went to Benedict XII. Cardinal-bishop of Albano from 1348 and a papal diplomat in the Hundred Years’ War, he became dean of the College of Cardinals in 1361. After Innocent VI died in 1362, the cardinals split between Hélie and Guy of Boulogne, neither able to win two-thirds, and settled on an outsider, who became Urban V. In 1363 Urban named Hélie legate for the crusade against the Turks planned by John II of France and Peter I of Cyprus; he died on 17 January 1364, before it set out.
zh: 埃利·德·塔列朗-佩里戈尔1301年生于佩里格，是佩里戈尔伯爵埃利七世与富瓦的布吕尼桑德的第三子，自幼被安排走上教会道路。他成为阿维尼翁教廷的核心枢机：1334年12月的教皇选举中，他率领法国枢机一派坚持把教廷留在阿维尼翁，对手是要求回归罗马的拿破仑·奥尔西尼一派，结果本笃十二世当选。1348年起任阿尔巴诺枢机主教，百年战争期间又充当教皇的使节斡旋，1361年出任枢机团团长。1362年英诺森六世去世后，枢机们分成支持他和支持布洛涅的居伊的两派，谁也拿不到三分之二的票数，最后选出一位局外人，即乌尔班五世。1363年，乌尔班任命他为十字军使节，这场对突厥人的远征由法王约翰二世与塞浦路斯的彼得一世筹划；1364年1月17日，他在远征启程前去世。

en: Sinibaldo Fieschi (c. 1195–1254), son of Count Ugo Fieschi of Lavagna, was a canonist trained at Parma and Bologna who wrote a commentary on papal decrees. Gregory IX made him a cardinal in 1227 and governor of the March of Ancona in 1235. Elected pope on 25 June 1243 as Innocent IV, he inherited a dispute over lands seized by Emperor Frederick II. He fled Frederick's agents to Lyon in 1244, where the Council of Lyon in 1245 deposed and excommunicated the emperor. He sent embassies to the Mongols and in 1252 issued Ad extirpanda, permitting torture of heretics. After Frederick's death he returned to Italy, claimed Sicily for Edmund Crouchback in 1254, dying at Naples on 7 December 1254.
zh: 依诺增爵四世（约1195—1254）俗名西尼巴尔多·菲耶斯基，是拉瓦尼亚伯爵乌戈·菲耶斯基之子，曾在帕尔马和博洛尼亚学习教会法，并撰写教宗教令注释。格列高利九世于1227年任命他为枢机，1235年任命他为安科纳边区总督。1243年6月25日他当选教宗，接手了教廷与皇帝腓特烈二世关于皇帝所占土地的争端。1244年他为躲避腓特烈的密探逃往里昂；1245年，里昂会议在那里宣布废黜皇帝并将其开除教籍。他向蒙古派遣使团，1252年颁布《根除异端》诏书，准许对异端用刑。腓特烈死后他返回意大利，1254年将西西里封给埃德蒙·克罗奇贝克，同年12月7日卒于那不勒斯。

en: Étienne Aubert, who became Pope Innocent VI (1282–1362), was the son of a Limousin lord and taught civil law at Toulouse before serving as Bishop of Noyon (1338) and Clermont (1340) and, from 1342, as a cardinal under Clement VI. In 1347 he went with Cardinal Annibaldo on the peace mission that produced the Truce of Calais. Elected at Avignon in December 1352, he was the fifth Avignon pope. He revoked a capitulation that placed the pope beneath the college of cardinals, reformed papal administration, and sent Cardinal Albornoz to restore order in Rome and the Papal States. His legates helped to bring about the 1360 Treaty of Brétigny between France and England. Plague and the Italian wars left the papacy short of money, so he cut the chapel staff and sold works of art. He died at Avignon on 12 September 1362, and Urban V succeeded him.
zh: 后来成为教皇依诺增爵六世（1282—1362）的艾蒂安·奥贝尔是利穆赞一位领主之子，曾在图卢兹教授民法，历任努瓦永主教（1338）和克莱蒙主教（1340），1342年起在克雷芒六世麾下任枢机。1347年，他随安尼巴尔多枢机出使调停，促成了加来休战。1352年12月他在阿维尼翁当选，是第五位阿维尼翁教皇。他废除了一项使教皇屈居枢机团之下的协议，改革教廷行政，并派遣阿尔沃诺斯枢机去整顿罗马和教皇国。他的使节促成了1360年英法之间的《布雷蒂尼条约》。瘟疫和意大利战事使教廷财政吃紧，他便裁减礼拜堂人员，出售艺术品。他于1362年9月12日卒于阿维尼翁，由乌尔班五世继任。

en: Innocent VII (c. 1336–1406), born Cosimo de' Migliorati at Sulmona in the Abruzzo, taught canon and civil law at Perugia and Padua before entering the papal Curia under Urban VI. He served ten years as papal collector in England, became archbishop of Ravenna in 1387 and a cardinal under Boniface IX in 1389. Elected pope on 17 October 1404 during the Western Schism, he faced Benedict XIII's court at Avignon. In August 1405 his nephew Ludovico Migliorati murdered eleven Romans, forcing him to flee to Viterbo; he returned in January 1406 and died in Rome on 6 November 1406.
zh: 依诺增爵七世（约1336—1406）原名科西莫·德·米廖拉蒂，生于阿布鲁佐的苏尔莫纳，曾在佩鲁贾和帕多瓦教授民法与教会法，后在乌尔巴诺六世任内进入教廷。他在英国担任了十年教廷收税官，1387年任拉韦纳大主教，1389年被博义九世任命为枢机。1404年10月17日，西方教会大分裂期间他被选为教皇，与阿维尼翁的敌对教皇本笃十三世分庭抗礼。1405年8月，其侄卢多维科·米廖拉蒂杀害十一名罗马人，他被迫逃往维泰博；1406年1月返回罗马，同年11月6日去世。

en: Jean-Raymond de Comminges (c. 1285–1348), a younger son of Count Bernard VII of Comminges and Laure de Montfort, entered the Cistercians and became a canon at Narbonne. Elected Bishop of Maguelone in 1309, he attended the Council of Vienne in 1311–1312 and in 1317 became the first Archbishop of Toulouse, where he founded the convent of Saint-Pantaléon. In 1320, as the Shepherds' Crusade threatened the region and massacred Jews and Cagots, he wrote to the pope seeking help and advice. John XXII made him a cardinal on 18 December 1327. In the 1334 conclave he refused election to the papacy, which then went to Benedict XII, and he sat in the conclave of 1342 that chose Clement VI. He died at Avignon in 1348.
zh: 让-雷蒙·德·科曼日（约1285—1348）是科曼日伯爵贝尔纳七世与洛尔·德·蒙福尔年纪较小的儿子，加入西多会，成为纳博讷的议事司铎。1309年他当选马格洛讷主教，1311—1312年出席维埃纳会议，1317年成为图卢兹首任大主教，并在当地创立圣庞塔莱翁修女院。1320年牧童十字军威胁当地，屠杀犹太人和卡戈人，他致信教宗请求援助和指示。若望二十二世于1327年12月18日将他擢升为枢机。1334年秘密会议上，他拒绝被推举为教宗，教宗之位随后归于本笃十二世；他又参加了1342年选出克雷芒六世的秘密会议。1348年，他卒于阿维尼翁。

en: Jacques Duèze (1244–1334), born at Cahors, taught law before becoming Bishop of Fréjus in 1300, Bishop of Avignon in 1310 and a cardinal in 1312. After a two-year interregnum caused by divisions among the cardinals, the Lyon conclave made him pope on 7 August 1316 as John XXII, second of the Avignon popes. He centralized power and income in the papacy while residing at Avignon. He excommunicated Emperor Louis IV the Bavarian, who answered by marching on Rome and enthroning the antipope Nicholas V, and he condemned the Franciscan doctrine of absolute poverty. In 1323 he canonized Thomas Aquinas. His beatific-vision teaching caused a scandal he retracted only on his deathbed at Avignon in December 1334.
zh: 若望二十二世（1244—1334）本名雅各伯·迪埃塞，生于卡奥尔，早年教授法律，1300年任弗雷瑞斯主教，1310年任阿维尼翁主教，1312年升任枢机。枢机间的分歧导致宗座空缺两年，1316年8月7日里昂秘密会议选举他为教宗，是第二任阿维尼翁教宗。他居于阿维尼翁，将权力和收入集中于教廷。他将神圣罗马帝国皇帝路易四世（巴伐利亚人）开除教籍，后者随即进兵罗马，拥立对立教宗尼古拉五世；他还下诏谴责方济各会的绝对贫穷主张。1323年，他将托马斯·阿奎那封圣。他关于荣福直观的主张引起轩然大波，直到1334年12月在阿维尼翁临终前才予以撤回。

en: Manuele Fieschi was a Genoese priest of the powerful Fieschi family who served as a papal notary at Avignon. Around 1337 he wrote to Edward III of England with a startling claim: that Edward's father, Edward II, had not been murdered at Berkeley in 1327 but had escaped and lived out his life in exile on the continent. A copy found at Montpellier in 1878 set off a debate that has run ever since. Some historians count the letter among the evidence that Edward II survived, while others suspect it was an attempt to blackmail the king. Fieschi later became bishop of Vercelli and died in 1349.
zh: 马努埃莱·菲耶斯基是热那亚教士，出身权门菲耶斯基家族，在阿维尼翁担任教廷公证人。约1337年，他写信给英格兰国王爱德华三世，声称其父爱德华二世1327年并未在伯克利遇害，而是逃脱，余生在欧洲大陆流亡。1878年，这封信的抄本在蒙彼利埃被发现，争论延续至今：有些史家把它算作爱德华二世幸存的证据之一，也有人怀疑这是对国王的一次勒索。菲耶斯基后来出任韦尔切利主教，于1349年去世。

en: Matteo Orsini was a Roman nobleman of the Orsini line of Monterotondo, a son of Rinaldo Orsini and Ocilenda. He held the lordship of Marino and served as a senator of Rome, active around 1310. His son Orso became the second lord of Monterotondo.
zh: 马泰奥·奥尔西尼是奥尔西尼家族蒙特罗通多支系的罗马贵族，里纳尔多·奥尔西尼与奥奇伦达之子。他领有马里诺，曾任罗马元老，1310年前后在世。其子奥尔索成为第二任蒙特罗通多领主。

en: Matteo Rosso Orsini, called the Great, was a Roman noble of the Orsini family, a personal friend of Saint Francis of Assisi and protector of the Franciscan order. In 1241 Pope Gregory IX named him senator of Rome, and during that year's sede vacante he was the city's effective lord, confining the cardinals in the Septizodium to force the papal election. He took a firm stand against the Italian campaigns of Emperor Frederick II and defeated him in 1243. He greatly enlarged the Orsini estates and died in 1246; his son became Pope Nicholas III.
zh: 马特奥·罗梭·奥尔西尼绰号“伟大者”，是罗马奥尔西尼家族的贵族，与亚西西的方济各私交甚笃，并担任方济各会的保护者。1241年，教皇格列高利九世任命他为罗马元老；同年教皇出缺期间，他是罗马城实际的主宰，曾把枢机们关在塞普蒂佐迪乌姆宫内以促成教皇选举。他坚决抵抗神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈二世在意大利的扩张，并于1243年将其击败。他大幅扩张奥尔西尼家族的领地，于1246年去世；其子后来成为教皇尼古拉三世。

en: Matteo Orsini, called 'di Monte', was a Roman man-at-arms, a son of Matteo Rosso Orsini the Great by his second wife Giovanna dell'Aquila. He died around 1281.
zh: 马泰奥·奥尔西尼，人称“迪蒙泰”，罗马武人，是“伟大者”马泰奥·罗索·奥尔西尼与第二任妻子焦万娜·德拉奎拉之子，约1281年去世。

en: Napoleone Orsini (1263–1342) was a Roman cardinal of the family that had given the Church Nicholas III, his uncle. Son of Rinaldo Orsini, Lord of Monterotondo, he took holy orders in 1285, and in 1288 Nicholas IV named him cardinal deacon of Sant'Adriano. As legate to Spoleto and Ancona under Boniface VIII he retook rebellious Gubbio in 1301 and backed the pope's crusades against the Colonna. In the Avignon years he reconciled with them and testified at Boniface's posthumous trial. In 1305 Clement V made him archpriest of St Peter's. He took a prominent part in the conclave of 1314–1316, which dragged on through quarrels among the cardinals' retinues, a fire-setting attempt and French royal meddling before it elected John XXII. As senior cardinal deacon he crowned Benedict XII in January 1335. Over his 54 years as a cardinal he sat in six conclaves, and he died at Avignon in 1342, a month before Benedict.
zh: 拿破仑·奥尔西尼（1263—1342）是罗马枢机，出身奥尔西尼家族，叔父即教皇尼古拉三世。他是蒙泰罗通多领主里纳尔多·奥尔西尼之子，1285年领受神职，1288年被尼古拉四世任命为枢机执事，领圣阿德里亚诺执事区。卜尼法斯八世在位时，他以驻斯波莱托与安科纳特使的身份于1301年收复反叛的古比奥，并支持教皇讨伐科隆纳家族的十字军。阿维尼翁教廷时期，他与科隆纳家族和解，在卜尼法斯死后的审判中出庭作证。1305年，克雷芒五世任命他为圣彼得大殿的总铎。他在1314—1316年漫长的秘密会议中发挥重要作用；会议一度混乱，先有枢机随从间的纷争，又有纵火未遂和法国王室的插手，最终选出若望二十二世。1335年1月，他以资深枢机执事的身份为本笃十二世加冕。担任枢机的54年间，他共参与六次秘密会议，1342年卒于阿维尼翁，比本笃十二世早一个月。

en: Nicola Caetani (c. 1310–1348) was count of Fondi from 1336, the son and successor of Roffredo III Caetani and Giovanna dell'Aquila, through whose marriage the county had returned to the Caetani. A man of arms, in 1348 he took into his pay the German mercenary Werner von Urslingen and his Great Company, who gathered 3000 cavalry at Terracina and, on his orders, ravaged the Roman Campagna and sacked Anagni after twelve of his envoys had been killed there. He married Giacoma Orsini and was succeeded by his son Onorato I.
zh: 尼科洛·卡埃塔尼（约1310—1348）自1336年起任丰迪伯爵，作为罗弗雷多三世·卡埃塔尼与乔万娜·德拉奎拉之子和继承人继位——丰迪伯国正是凭借父母的婚姻重归卡埃塔尼家族。他是一介武人：1348年，他雇佣德意志雇佣兵维尔纳·冯·乌尔斯林根及其大佣兵团，后者在泰拉奇纳集结3000名骑兵，奉他之命蹂躏罗马平原，并因他的十二名使节在阿纳尼遇害而洗劫该城。他娶贾科马·奥尔西尼为妻，死后由儿子奥诺拉托一世继位。

en: Giovanni Gaetano Orsini, eldest son of the Roman noble Matteo Rosso Orsini, was made cardinal deacon by Innocent IV in 1244. He served under eight popes, becoming protector of the Franciscans and inquisitor-general. In November 1277 he was elected pope at Viterbo after a six-month vacancy, taking the name Nicholas III; his family's influence helped secure his election. In 1278 Rudolf of Habsburg recognized papal sovereignty over Romagna, the March of Ancona and Spoleto, and a new constitution ended Charles of Anjou's hold on the Roman senatorship. In 1279 he issued Exiit qui seminat to settle the Franciscan poverty dispute. He was the first pope to reside permanently at the Vatican, and died of apoplexy on 22 August 1280.
zh: 乔瓦尼·加埃塔诺·奥尔西尼是罗马贵族马特奥·罗梭·奥尔西尼的长子，1244年被教皇英诺森四世任命为枢机执事。他历事八位教皇，曾任方济各会保护者和宗教裁判总监。1277年11月，在教皇之位空缺半年后，他在维泰博当选教皇，取号尼各老三世；家族的影响力帮助他取得当选。1278年，鲁道夫·冯·哈布斯堡承认教皇对罗马涅、安科纳边区和斯波莱托公国的主权；同年他颁布新宪章，结束了安茹的查理对罗马元老职位的把持。1279年，他发布《出去播种》通谕，裁定方济各会的贫穷之争。他是首位常驻梵蒂冈的教皇，1280年8月22日中风而死。

en: Onorato I Caetani (c. 1336–1400) was count of Fondi and a powerful baron of the Papal States and the Kingdom of Naples. Succeeding his father Nicola around 1348, he was confirmed by Queen Joanna I in 1352 and served as rector of Campagna and Marittima. On 20 September 1378 he sheltered the French cardinals at Fondi, who elected Robert of Geneva as the antipope Clement VII, opening the Western Schism. He backed the dukes of Anjou against Ladislaus of Durazzo; excommunicated by Boniface IX and defeated by papal and Neapolitan armies, he died at Fondi in April 1400.
zh: 奥诺拉托一世·卡埃塔尼（约1336—1400）是丰迪伯爵，也是教皇国与那不勒斯王国最有权势的男爵之一。约1348年他继承父亲尼科洛，1352年其伯爵地位得到乔万娜一世女王确认，后出任坎帕尼亚与马里蒂马统领。1378年9月20日，他在丰迪庇护法兰西枢机们，后者在当地推选日内瓦的罗贝尔为对立教宗克雷芒七世，西方教会大分裂由此开始。他支持安茹公爵们对抗杜拉佐的拉迪斯劳；在被博义九世绝罚、又被教皇与那不勒斯联军击败后，于1400年4月在丰迪去世。

en: Orso Orsini, called Orsello, was the second Orsini lord of Monterotondo. A son of Matteo Orsini, signore of Marino, he is attested around 1312 and married a cousin. His son Giordano Orsini succeeded to the Monterotondo line and died in 1367.
zh: 奥尔索·奥尔西尼，人称奥尔塞洛，是奥尔西尼家族第二任蒙特罗通多领主。他是马里诺领主马泰奥·奥尔西尼之子，1312年前后有载，娶堂亲为妻。其子焦尔达诺·奥尔西尼承袭蒙特罗通多支系，卒于1367年。

en: Orso di Bobone (c. 1136–1207) was a Roman politician regarded as the founder of the great Orsini house. The son of Bobone di Pietro, he was a nephew of Pope Celestine III and was counted among the senators of Rome before 1207. He married Gaetana Caetani of Sermoneta, and through his son Giovanni, called Giangaetano, he was the great-grandfather of Pope Nicholas III. The main Orsini lines, including the lords of Pitigliano, descend from him.
zh: 奥尔索·迪·博博内（约1136—1207）是罗马政治家，被视为显赫的奥尔西尼家族始祖。他是博博内·迪·彼得罗之子、教皇雷定三世的侄子，1207年前已位列罗马元老。他娶塞尔莫内塔的加埃塔纳·卡埃塔尼，其子乔瓦尼人称詹加埃塔诺，教皇尼各老三世便是他的曾孙。皮蒂利亚诺领主等奥尔西尼家族的主要支系都出自他这一脉。

en: Rinaldo della Torre, called Passerino, was a Milanese nobleman and soldier of the Guelph Della Torre family, the son of Napo della Torre and Margherita del Balzo. After Emperor Henry VII's vicar was driven from Cremona in January 1312, the city made him its podestà. With Giacomo Cavalcabò he led the Guelph army against the Visconti at the battle of Soncino on 16 March 1312, and in later campaigns against Galeazzo Visconti he stormed the castle of Tegnoso near Monza. He died around 1330.
zh: 里纳尔多·德拉·托雷绰号“帕塞里诺”，是米兰归尔甫派德拉·托雷家族的军人，纳波·德拉·托雷与玛格丽塔·德尔巴尔佐之子。1312年1月，皇帝亨利七世的代理官被逐出克雷莫纳后，该城选他为长官。1312年3月16日，他与贾科莫·卡瓦尔卡博一同率领归尔甫军队，在松奇诺战役中对抗维斯孔蒂派；后来在与加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂的战争中，他又攻占了蒙扎附近的泰尼奥索城堡。他约于1330年去世。

en: Pietro Bobone was a Roman nobleman of the Bobone family, named in the Orsini genealogy as the father of Giacinto Bobone, elected Pope Celestine III in 1191, and of Bobone di Pietro, grandfather of the Orsini line. He is recorded alive after 1159.
zh: 彼得罗·博博内是罗马博博内家族的贵族，奥尔西尼谱系记载他是雅钦多·博博内与博博内·迪·彼得罗之父：前者于1191年当选教皇，即雷定三世；后者之子奥尔索·迪·博博内开创了奥尔西尼家族。谱系记载他1159年后仍在世。

en: Pietro II Caetani (1250–1308) was a Roman nobleman of the Caetani family and a nephew of Pope Boniface VIII. With his uncle's backing he became count of Caserta in the Kingdom of Naples, and in 1297 he bought the Annibaldi strongholds of Sermoneta, Bassiano and Ninfa for a hundred and forty thousand gold florins, becoming the first Caetani lord of Sermoneta in 1299. He married Giovanna da Ceccano and died in 1308, leaving his lands to his son Roffredo III.
zh: 彼得罗二世·卡耶塔尼（1250—1308）是卡耶塔尼家族的罗马贵族，教宗博义八世的侄子。在叔父扶持下，他成为那不勒斯王国的卡塞塔伯爵；1297年，他以14万金弗罗林从阿尼巴尔迪家族手中购得塞尔莫内塔、巴西亚诺和宁芙等城堡，并于1299年成为卡耶塔尼家首任塞尔莫内塔领主。他娶焦万娜·达·切卡诺为妻，1308年去世，领地由其子罗弗雷多三世继承。

en: Raphael, born Raffaello Sanzio at Urbino in 1483, was an Italian Renaissance painter and architect, and the son of the court painter Giovanni Santi. Orphaned at eleven, he probably trained in Pietro Perugino's workshop and was already a master by 1500. He spent about four years in Florence absorbing its artistic traditions before Pope Julius II summoned him to Rome in 1508 to decorate the Vatican apartments. There he painted the Raphael Rooms, above all the School of Athens in the Stanza della Segnatura, and later worked as an architect. He died of fever on 6 April 1520, aged thirty-seven, and was buried in the Pantheon at his own request.
zh: 拉斐尔1483年生于乌尔比诺，原名拉法埃洛·圣齐奥，是意大利文艺复兴时期的画家和建筑师，父亲是宫廷画家乔瓦尼·桑蒂。他十一岁成为孤儿，后来很可能在彼得罗·佩鲁吉诺的作坊学艺，1500年时已是独立画师。他在佛罗伦萨约四年，吸收当地的艺术传统，1508年应教宗儒略二世之召前往罗马，装饰梵蒂冈的教皇寓所。他在那里绘制了“拉斐尔房间”湿壁画组画，其中最著名的是签字厅的《雅典学院》，晚年还担任建筑师。1520年4月6日，他因热病去世，年仅三十七岁，遵照本人遗愿安葬于万神殿。

en: Rinaldo Orsini (1217–1286) was an Italian nobleman and the founder of the Orsini line of Monterotondo. The third son of Matteo Rosso Orsini, he was a brother of Pope Nicholas III. In 1262 he served as podestà of Foligno. Later that year, when Henry of Castile entered Rome and joined the Ghibellines, Rinaldo fled and fortified himself in the castle of Marino, returning only after Conradin's defeat and death in 1268. He died on 29 May 1286, leaving sons including the future cardinal Napoleone Orsini.
zh: 里纳尔多·奥尔西尼（1217—1286）是意大利贵族，奥尔西尼家族蒙特罗通多支系的始祖。他是马泰奥·罗索·奥尔西尼的第三子，教宗尼古拉三世的兄弟。1262年他任福利尼奥的市政官；同年卡斯蒂利亚的亨利进入罗马并倒向吉伯林派，里纳尔多出逃，在马里诺城堡据守设防，直到1268年康拉丁兵败身亡后才返回罗马。他于1286年5月29日去世，子嗣中包括日后成为枢机主教的纳波莱奥内·奥尔西尼。

en: Roffredo I Caetani (c. 1200–1275), baron of the Caetani house of Anagni, served as podestà of Todi in 1274–1275. By Emilia Patrasso di Guarcino, niece of Pope Alexander IV, he fathered Benedetto Caetani, the future Pope Boniface VIII, and Roffredo II.
zh: 罗弗雷多一世·卡埃塔尼（约1200—1275）是阿纳尼卡埃塔尼家族男爵，1274—1275年任托迪行政长官。妻艾米利亚·帕特腊索·迪·圭尔奇诺是教皇亚历山大四世的侄女，子有后来的教皇博义八世本笃·卡埃塔尼和罗弗雷多二世。

en: Roffredo II Caetani (c. 1225–1296) was a nobleman of Anagni and brother of Pope Boniface VIII. In 1278 he bought land near Anagni on behalf of his brother Benedetto, the future pope. He became podestà of Todi in 1282 and later served as senator of Rome. In 1295 Charles II of Anjou made him count of Caserta, while Roffredo continued to acquire land around Anagni for the family. He married Elisabetta Orsini; their son Francesco became cardinal in 1295, and Pietro II succeeded him as count after his death in 1296.
zh: 罗弗雷多二世·卡埃塔尼（约1225—1296）是阿纳尼贵族、教皇博义八世的兄弟。1278年，他代兄弟贝内代托，即未来的教皇，在阿纳尼附近购地。1282年，他出任托迪行政长官，后来又担任罗马元老。1295年，安茹的查理二世封他为卡塞塔伯爵；罗弗雷多继续在阿纳尼周边为家族购置土地。他娶伊丽莎白·奥尔西尼，子弗朗切斯科于1295年成为枢机；1296年罗弗雷多去世后，彼得罗二世继承了伯爵爵位。

en: Roffredo, or Loffredo, III Caetani (c. 1270–1335) was a nobleman of the Kingdom of Naples, the son of Pietro II Caetani, marquess of Caserta, and a great-nephew of Pope Boniface VIII. He held the counties of Traetto and dell'Aquila. In 1297 he married Margherita dell'Aquila, countess palatine, but later divorced her and wed Giovanna dell'Aquila, heiress of the county of Fondi; through this marriage Fondi passed to the Caetani in 1299 and Roffredo became its count. He died in 1335 and was succeeded by his son Nicola.
zh: 罗弗雷多（又拼作洛夫雷多）三世·卡耶塔尼（约1270—1335）是那不勒斯王国贵族，卡塞塔侯爵彼得罗二世之子，教宗博义八世的侄孙。他领有特拉埃托和拉奎拉伯国。1297年他娶行宫伯爵夫人玛格丽塔·德拉奎拉为妻，后与其离异，改娶丰迪伯国女继承人焦万娜·德拉奎拉；凭借这桩婚姻，丰迪伯国于1299年转入卡耶塔尼家族，罗弗雷多成为丰迪伯爵。他于1335年去世，其子尼古拉继位。

en: Simone Martini (c. 1284–1344) was the Sienese painter who gave Italian art its courtly Gothic grace. Probably a pupil of Duccio di Buoninsegna, he worked in a Sienese tradition of soft, flowing line, set against the sober monumentality of Florence, and drew on French illuminated manuscripts and ivories that reached Siena along the Via Francigena. His first documented work is the Maestà of 1315 in Siena's Palazzo Pubblico. In 1317 King Robert of Anjou called him to Naples, where he painted Saint Louis of Toulouse crowning his brother Robert. He painted a polyptych in Pisa in 1319 and, with Lippo Memmi, the Annunciation of 1333 now in the Uffizi, and frescoed the San Martino Chapel at Assisi. By 1335 he was at the Avignon papal court, where he befriended Petrarch; two of Petrarch's sonnets refer to a portrait of Laura he is said to have painted. He died at Avignon in July 1344.
zh: 西莫内·马蒂尼（约1284—1344）是锡耶纳画家，为意大利艺术带来了宫廷式的哥特优雅。相传他师从杜乔·迪·博尼塞尼亚，所承的锡耶纳传统以柔和流畅的线条见长，与佛罗伦萨的庄重厚重相对，又吸收了沿法兰西杰纳大道传入锡耶纳的法国手抄本插图和象牙雕刻。他有纪年可考的最早作品，是1315年锡耶纳市政厅的《威严》湿壁画。1317年，安茹的罗贝尔国王召他前往那不勒斯，他在那里画下图卢兹的圣路易为兄弟罗贝尔加冕的画面。1319年他在比萨绘制多联画，1333年又与利波·梅米合作完成今藏乌菲齐美术馆的《天使报喜》，并在阿西西的圣马蒂诺礼拜堂绘制湿壁画。约1335年他已身在阿维尼翁教廷，与彼特拉克结交；彼特拉克的两首十四行诗提到一幅相传由他所绘的劳拉肖像。1344年7月，他卒于阿维尼翁。

en: Hugues Roger (1293–1363), the cardinal of Tulle, was a son of Guillaume Roger and Guillemette de Mestre, a brother of Pope Clement VI and an uncle of the future Gregory XI. A Benedictine monk of Tulle, he became abbot of Saint-Jean-d'Angély in 1341. With his brother on the papal throne at Avignon, he rose fast: bishop of Tulle in July 1342, cardinal-priest of San Lorenzo in Damaso that September. In 1345 he bought the barony of Portes-Bertrand from the dauphin Humbert II for 62,000 gold florins, and he later passed such estates to his nephew Guillaume Roger de Beaufort. He was abbot of Cluny from 1347 to 1350 and camerlengo of the cardinals from 1361. Elected pope in the 1362 conclave with fifteen votes, he refused, and Urban V was chosen instead. He died in 1363 at the abbey of Mallast, where he had retired, and was buried in Limousin, leaving 1.5 million livres in gold.
zh: 于格·罗歇（1293—1363），人称“蒂勒的枢机”，是纪尧姆·罗歇与纪耶梅特·德梅斯特尔之子，教皇克雷芒六世的兄弟，未来的格列高利十一世的叔父。他是蒂勒的本笃会修士，1341年出任圣让当热利修道院院长。兄弟在阿维尼翁登上教皇宝座后，他的升迁很快：1342年7月任蒂勒主教，同年9月受任为达马苏斯圣老楞佐堂枢机司铎。1345年，他以62000金弗罗林向多芬安贝尔二世买下波尔特-贝尔特朗男爵领，后来又把这类产业转给侄子纪尧姆·罗歇·德博福尔。1347至1350年他兼任克吕尼修道院院长，1361年出任枢机团财务总长。1362年教皇选举中，他得到十五票，却拒绝接受，乌尔班五世因而当选。1363年，他在隐居的马拉斯特修道院去世，葬于利穆赞，留下150万利弗尔的黄金。

en: Guillaume de Grimoard (1310–1370), a Benedictine canonist from Grizac near Mende, was neither bishop nor cardinal, and had few ties to the curia, when he was elected pope at Avignon on 28 September 1362 as Urban V. He kept the Benedictine Rule and lived simply, which often set him against cardinals used to wealth. He pressed monastic reform and sought reunion with the Greek Church. His 1363 crusade call led Peter I of Cyprus to seize Alexandria in 1365. That November, when the free companies led by Bertrand du Guesclin threatened Avignon, he had to pay them a ransom to leave the Rhône valley. In 1367 he moved the curia back to Rome, the first Avignon pope to do so, but Italian unrest drove him back to Avignon in 1370, where he died on 19 December. Beatified in 1870, he is the only beatified Avignon pope.
zh: 纪尧姆·德·格里莫阿尔德（1310—1370）是芒德附近格里扎克出身的本笃会教会法学家，1362年9月28日在阿维尼翁当选教皇、称乌尔班五世时，既非主教也非枢机，与教廷也少有往来。他仍遵守本笃会戒规，生活简朴，常与习惯了奢华的枢机们不合。他推行修道院改革，并谋求与希腊教会复合。1363年他号召十字军，塞浦路斯国王彼得一世的军队于1365年攻占亚历山大。同年11月，贝特朗·迪·盖克兰率领的自由佣兵团逼近阿维尼翁，他只得付赎金让他们离开罗讷河谷。1367年，他将教廷迁回罗马，是第一位这样做的阿维尼翁教皇；但意大利的乱局迫使他于1370年返回阿维尼翁，12月19日在那里去世。他于1870年被宣福，是唯一获此待遇的阿维尼翁教皇。

en: Bartolomeo Prignano (c. 1318–1389), a Neapolitan canon lawyer, worked in the papal chancery at Avignon, where he was known for simplicity and frugality, and became archbishop of Bari in 1377. He was elected pope as Urban VI on 8 April 1378, the last candidate chosen from outside the College of Cardinals. French cardinals rejected his reforms and at Fondi on 20 September 1378 elected Robert of Geneva as Clement VII. The Western Schism that followed split Christendom until 1417: France, Castile, Aragon and Scotland sided with Clement at Avignon. The historian Ludwig von Pastor judged Urban arbitrary and violent. He excommunicated Queen Joanna I of Naples and crowned her rival Charles III in 1381; besieged at Nocera in 1384, he executed his cardinal opponents. He died in Rome on 15 October 1389, likely from injuries sustained in a fall from his mule.
zh: 巴尔托洛梅奥·普里尼亚诺（约1318—1389）是那不勒斯籍教会法学者，曾在阿维尼翁教廷秘书处任职，以朴素节俭著称，1377年成为巴里大主教。他于1378年4月8日当选教宗，称乌尔巴诺六世，是最后一位从枢机团之外选出的教宗。法兰西枢机反对他的改革，于1378年9月20日在丰迪推选日内瓦的罗贝尔为克雷芒七世。随之而来的西方教会大分裂使基督教世界分裂到1417年：法兰西、卡斯蒂利亚、阿拉贡和苏格兰站在阿维尼翁的克雷芒一边。历史学家路德维希·冯·帕斯托尔评价乌尔巴诺专断而暴烈。他绝罚那不勒斯女王乔万娜一世，1381年为其政敌卡洛三世加冕；1384年被围困于诺切拉，事后处死了反对他的枢机。1389年10月15日，他在罗马去世，可能死于此前坠骡造成的伤势。

en: Azzo da Correggio (1303–c. 1362) was an Italian condottiero born in Parma, son of Giberto III da Correggio, the Defender, and a da Camino of Verona. Meant for the church, he turned to politics instead and set out to break the Rossi family's hold on Parma. In 1335, backed by the Della Scala of Verona, he succeeded and left them the lordship. The next year they sent him to Avignon to plead their cause against the Rossi, and there he befriended Petrarch. In 1337 he built the fortress of Colorno. In 1341 he took Parma from Mastino della Scala himself, with Petrarch at his side, and ruled it until 1344, when he ceded it to Obizzo III d'Este. Petrarch stayed with him several times and dedicated to him a canzone and works including De remediis utriusque fortunae. Azzo allied with the Visconti in 1347, hoping to regain Parma, and died at Milan in 1362 as Bernabò Visconti's guest.
zh: 阿佐·达·科雷焦（1303—约1362）是生于帕尔马的意大利雇佣军首领，为有“保卫者”之称的吉贝尔托三世·达·科雷焦与维罗纳达·卡米诺家族女子之子。他本来走教会的路，后来转向政治，着手打破罗西家族对帕尔马的控制。1335年，他在维罗纳德拉·斯卡拉家族支持下得手，把领主之位让给了他们。次年，斯卡拉家族派他去阿维尼翁，为对付罗西家族向教皇陈情，他在那里与彼特拉克结为好友。1337年他修筑科洛尔诺城堡。1341年，他在彼特拉克陪同下亲自从马斯蒂诺·德拉·斯卡拉手中夺取帕尔马，统治至1344年，随后将其让给费拉拉领主奥比佐三世·埃斯特。彼特拉克数次在他那里作客，并把一首歌谣和《论幸运与厄运的补救》等作品题献给他。1347年，阿佐为重夺帕尔马与维斯孔蒂家族结盟，1362年在米兰作为贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂的客人去世。

en: Teresa de' Rossi (born 1330) was the only recorded child of the Parmesan condottiero Marsilio de' Rossi and his wife Margherita. She married the Ghibelline marquis Uberto Pallavicino, son of Manfredino Pallavicino.
zh: 特蕾莎·德·罗西（1330年生）是帕尔马佣兵首领马西利奥·德·罗西与妻子玛格丽塔唯一见于记载的孩子，后嫁给“虔诚者”曼弗雷迪诺之子、吉伯林派侯爵乌贝尔托·帕拉维奇诺。

en: Guglielmo Pallavicini (twelfth century – 1217), called Guglielmo di Oberto, was a Lombard nobleman and the ancestor from whom all the known lines of the Pallavicino Lombard branch descend. The son of Oberto Pallavicini and Mabilia, he held the castle of Scipione. In 1198 he attacked Cardinal Pietro Capuano while the legate crossed his lands seeking peace between Parma and Piacenza, and was excommunicated by Pope Innocent III. The ban was lifted only in 1205, when Guglielmo surrendered the fortress of Landasio in Valmozzola to the Church. He died around 1217.
zh: 古列尔莫·帕拉维奇尼（12世纪—1217），又称古列尔莫·迪·奥贝托，是伦巴第贵族，帕拉维奇诺家族伦巴第支系所有已知分支的始祖。他是奥贝托·帕拉维奇尼与玛比利亚之子，领有希皮奥内堡。1198年，枢机主教皮埃特罗·卡普阿诺途经他的领地、试图调解帕尔马与皮亚琴察的争端时，古列尔莫竟发兵袭击这位使节，被教宗依诺增爵三世处以绝罚。直到1205年，他把瓦尔莫措拉的兰达肖要塞交给教会，绝罚才获解除。他约于1217年去世。

en: Manfredino Pallavicini, known as the Pious (1254–1328), was a Lombard nobleman of the Pallavicino family and a marchese in the Parma region, the only son and heir of the Ghibelline leader Oberto II. In the early fourteenth century he rebuilt the family castle of Ravarano, destroyed by the Guelphs of Parma, and with Visconti help recovered Tabiano. Driven from Ravarano by rival kinsmen, he won back the fortress along with Casola and Solignano after Parma made peace with Borgo San Donnino. In 1327 Emperor Louis the Bavarian confirmed his lands and privileges. He died in 1328.
zh: 曼弗雷迪诺·帕拉维奇尼，人称‘虔诚者’（1254—1328），是伦巴第帕拉维奇诺家族贵族、帕尔马一带的侯爵，吉伯林派领袖奥贝托二世的独子与继承人。14世纪初，他重建了被帕尔马圭尔夫派拆毁的家族城堡拉瓦拉诺，又在米兰维斯孔蒂家族帮助下收复塔比亚诺。他曾被对立的族人逐出拉瓦拉诺，待帕尔马与圣多尼诺堡议和后，才连同卡索拉和索利亚诺一并收复。1327年，皇帝路易四世（巴伐利亚人）确认了他的领地与特权。他于1328年去世。

en: Oberto II Pallavicino, also called Pelavicino (1197–1269), was an Italian condottiere of the Lombard Pallavicino family, son of Guglielmo Pallavicino. An imperial vicar and Ghibelline leader, he backed Emperor Frederick II against Pope Gregory IX and the communes from 1234, as their expansion threatened his family's lands. From 1250, with Buoso da Dovara, he mastered Parma, Cremona, Piacenza, Pavia and Brescia. He then turned on his former friend Ezzelino III da Romano and joined the Guelfs, helping the Lombard League win Cassano in 1259, and gained Milan and five other cities. He later fought Charles of Anjou in Lombardy without success and died at Gusaliggio on 8 May 1269.
zh: 欧贝尔托二世·帕拉维奇诺，又称佩拉维奇诺（1197—1269），是帕拉维奇诺家族伦巴第支系的意大利雇佣军首领，古列尔莫·帕拉维奇诺之子。他身为帝国代理人和吉伯林派领袖，自1234年起支持皇帝腓特烈二世对抗教皇格列高利九世及诸城市公社，后者的扩张威胁着他的家族领地。1250年起，他与博索·达·多瓦拉一道征服帕尔马、克雷莫纳、皮亚琴察、帕维亚和布雷西亚。随后他与旧友埃泽利诺三世·达·罗马诺反目，加入圭尔夫派，帮助伦巴第联盟在1259年的卡萨诺战役中获胜，由此获得米兰等六座城市。后来他在伦巴第与入侵的安茹的查理作战，屡遭败绩，1269年5月8日卒于古萨利乔。

en: Oberto Pallavicino (died 1196) was an Italian nobleman of the Pallavicino family and the son of Guglielmo Pallavicino. He was the father of Guglielmo Pallavicino di Oberto (died 1217), ancestor of the Lombard Pallavicino branches.
zh: 欧贝尔托·帕拉维奇诺（1196年卒）是帕拉维奇诺家族的意大利贵族，古列尔莫·帕拉维奇诺之子。他是古列尔莫·帕拉维奇诺·迪·欧贝尔托（1217年卒）之父，伦巴第帕拉维奇诺各支派的先祖。

en: Oberto, also called Uberto, Pallavicino was a Ghibelline marquis in the Parma region and a son of Manfredino 'il Pio' Pallavicino. When his father died in 1328 the family fiefs passed to Oberto and his brothers Federico and Donnino; in 1348, after Federico's death, he inherited Busseto and Solignano. He later made himself lord of Ravarano. He founded the Ravarano branch of the dynasty and married Teresa de' Rossi, daughter of the Parmesan condottiero Marsilio de' Rossi.
zh: 欧贝尔托（又译乌贝尔托）·帕拉维奇诺是帕尔马地区的吉伯林派侯爵，曼弗雷迪诺“虔诚者”·帕拉维奇诺之子。1328年父亲去世后，家族封地由他与兄弟费代里科、多尼诺分得；1348年费代里科去世，他又继承布塞托和索利尼亚诺。此后他成为拉瓦拉诺之主。他开创了帕拉维奇诺家族的拉瓦拉诺支系，并娶帕尔马佣兵首领马西利奥·德·罗西之女特蕾莎·德·罗西为妻。

en: Salvino della Torre (c. 1240–1287) was a Milanese nobleman of the Guelph della Torre family and a son of Filippo della Torre, lord of Milan. He became lord of Parma. His daughter Elena married Niccolò da Carrara in 1300.
zh: 萨尔维诺·德拉·托雷（约1240—1287）是米兰贵族，属圭尔夫派德拉·托雷家族，米兰领主菲利波·德拉·托雷之子。他后来成为帕尔马领主。其女埃莱娜于1300年嫁给尼科洛·达·卡拉拉。

en: Pasquale Paoli (1725–1807) was the son of the Corsican patriot Giacinto Paoli and grew up in exile in Naples after 1739. Returning in 1755, he was elected general of the Corsicans and built the Corsican Republic, ruling from Corte with an elected diet, a written constitution and a university. His government controlled much of the island while Genoa held the coastal cities. After Genoa transferred its rights over Corsica to France, his forces were beaten at Ponte Novu in 1769 and he fled to Britain. He returned with the French Revolution, then broke with France and helped found the Anglo-Corsican Kingdom of 1794–1796. He died in London in 1807.
