zh: 帕斯夸莱·保利（1725—1807）是科西嘉爱国者贾钦托·保利之子，1739年后随父流亡那不勒斯并在那里长大。1755年他回到科西嘉，被推举为科西嘉人的将军，建立科西嘉共和国，以科尔特为首都，设立民选议会、成文宪法和大学。他的政府控制了岛上大部分地区，热那亚则保有沿海城市。热那亚将对科西嘉的权利转让给法国后，他的军队于1769年在蓬泰诺沃战败，他逃往英国。法国大革命爆发后他返回家乡，后来与法国决裂，参与建立1794至1796年的英属科西嘉王国。1807年他在伦敦去世。

en: William Frangipani (Guglielmo; died 1337) was a Roman Franciscan of the Frangipani family who held the see of Patras as Latin Archbishop from 1317 and ruled its barony as a virtually autonomous lord. His ties ran to Venice: in 1321, with Byzantine forces under Andronikos Asen pressing the Principality of Achaea, he led an unsuccessful movement to hand what remained of it to the Republic, and in 1336 he became a Venetian citizen. In 1329, when Prince John of Gravina left the Morea for Italy, he was named bailli, the first cleric to hold the post; until 1331 he settled disputes between the feudal lords and shipped in Italian grain for the fortresses. After 1330 he repeatedly excommunicated the Catalans of Athens. When Bertrand des Baux became bailli in early 1336, relations soured and William refused homage to the prince. He died in 1337, and Bertrand's siege of Patras failed to bring the archbishopric back under control.
zh: 威廉·弗兰吉帕尼（意大利语名古列尔莫，1337年卒）是罗马弗兰吉帕尼家族的方济各会士，1317年起任帕特雷拉丁大主教，以近乎独立的领主身份统治帕特雷男爵国。他与威尼斯关系密切：1321年，拜占庭军队在安德罗尼卡·阿森率领下进逼亚该亚亲王国，他带头发起运动，要把亲王国剩余的土地交给威尼斯共和国，但未成功；1336年，他成为威尼斯公民。1329年，亲王格拉维纳的约翰离开摩里亚前往意大利，他被任命为巴伊略，是首位担任此职的教士；到1331年为止，他调解领主之间的纠纷，并从意大利运粮供应要塞。1330年以后，他多次将雅典公国的加泰罗尼亚人开除教籍。1336年初贝特朗·德博出任巴伊略，两人关系恶化，威廉拒绝再向亲王效忠。1337年他去世，贝特朗围攻帕特雷，未能使大主教区重新就范。

en: Castellino Beccaria (born c. 1300, died 1358) was a Ghibelline nobleman of Pavia who succeeded his father Musso as signore of the city in 1343 and ruled until his death. In 1346 he stood godfather to Luchino Novello, son of the Milanese lord Luchino Visconti. Luchino had exiled his nephews Galeazzo, Matteo and Bernabò after their plot against him failed in 1340, but after his death they came to power in Milan. Castellino then joined a coalition against Galeazzo II Visconti, alongside Ludovico I Gonzaga and John II of Montferrat. He died at Pavia in 1358, leaving no children by his wife Giulia Riccardi; the signoria passed to his brother Leodrisino. Guelfs then tried to found a republic, but the Visconti captured the city and added it to their domain.
zh: 卡斯泰利诺·贝卡里亚（约1300年生，1358年卒）是帕维亚的吉伯林派贵族，1343年继承父亲穆索成为该城领主，统治直至去世。1346年，他为米兰领主卢基诺·维斯孔蒂之子卢基诺·诺韦洛充当教父。卢基诺曾在1340年因侄子加莱亚佐、马泰奥和贝尔纳博密谋失败而将他们放逐，但他死后，这几个侄子在米兰掌权。卡斯泰利诺随后加入了反对加莱亚佐二世·维斯孔蒂的联盟，盟友包括卢多维科一世·贡扎加和蒙费拉托侯爵乔瓦尼二世。1358年他卒于帕维亚，与妻子茱莉亚·里卡尔迪没有子女；领主之位由其弟莱奥德里西诺继承。随后圭尔夫派试图建立共和国，但维斯孔蒂家族攻占该城，并入自己的领地。

en: Corradino Beccaria was a 14th-century nobleman of Pavia, a son of the Ghibelline leader Manfredo Beccaria and brother of the signore Musso. He was the ancestor of the Beccaria di San Gaudenzio line, which held the fiefs of Cervesina and San Gaudenzio.
zh: 科拉迪诺·贝卡里亚是14世纪帕维亚贵族，吉伯林派领袖曼弗雷多·贝卡里亚之子、城主穆索的兄弟。他是贝卡里亚家族圣高登齐奥支系的祖先，该支领有切尔韦西纳与圣高登齐奥两处封地。

en: Corrado Beccaria was a 14th-century nobleman of the Pavia Beccaria, son of Manfredo and lord of Gropello Cairoli. His granddaughter Oretta married Gaspare Visconti, through whom the family's Gropello estates passed to the Visconti in 1437.
zh: 科拉多·贝卡里亚是14世纪帕维亚贝卡里亚家族贵族，曼弗雷多之子，曾任格罗佩洛·卡伊罗利领主。他的孙女奥蕾塔·贝卡里亚嫁给加斯帕雷·维斯孔蒂，家族的格罗佩洛产业于1437年转入维斯孔蒂家族。

en: Fiorello Beccaria was a 14th-century nobleman of Pavia, the younger son of the signore Musso Beccaria and brother of Castellino, with whom he shared rule over the city. He married Filippina Sannazzaro of the lords of Pietra and rebuilt the fortress of Rocca de' Giorgi, later called Roccafirella after him. He founded the Beccaria di Messer Fiorello line; his son Galvagno received the fief of Pietra in 1405, and his descendants ruled Pietra and part of Broni and held the castle of Castana until 1531.
zh: 菲奥雷洛·贝卡里亚是14世纪帕维亚贵族，城主穆索·贝卡里亚较年幼的儿子、卡斯泰利诺的兄弟，曾与卡斯泰利诺共同统治帕维亚。他娶彼得拉领主家族的菲利皮娜·桑纳扎罗为妻，重建了罗卡德乔治要塞，该要塞后来以他得名“菲奥雷洛岩”。他开创了“菲奥雷洛先生的贝卡里亚”支系；其子加尔瓦尼奥于1405年受封彼得拉，后裔领有彼得拉和布罗尼的一部分，并保有卡斯塔纳城堡直至1531年。

en: Leodrisino Beccaria was the youngest son of Musso Beccaria, signore of Pavia, and brother of Castellino. In 1340 his daughter Verde married the Mantuan condottiero Corrado Gonzaga. His sons Musso and Manfredo founded the Robecco and Santa Giuletta branches of the family.
zh: 莱奥德里西诺·贝卡里亚是帕维亚城主穆索·贝卡里亚的幼子、末代城主卡斯泰利诺的兄弟。1340年，其女韦尔代嫁给曼图亚佣兵首领科拉多·贡扎加；其子穆索、曼弗雷多分别开创家族的罗贝科与圣朱莱塔支系。

en: Manfredo Beccaria (c. 1262–1322) led the Ghibelline popular party of Pavia. He had served as podestà of Vercelli in 1275 and Novara in 1278 before becoming potestas of the People and the Merchants in Pavia in 1282. He oversaw the city's grain supply and drew support from merchants and guilds, building a popular regime against the Guelph nobles. In 1289 William VII of Montferrat took Pavia and drove him into exile. Recalled in October 1290, he was confirmed ten-year podestà and ruled Pavia as its effective lord. In 1299 he led an anti-Visconti league, taking Vercelli and Novara, but in 1300 the rival Langosco expelled him again. Imprisoned around 1311, he was freed when the Visconti entered Pavia in 1315, dying there on 22 March 1322.
zh: 曼弗雷多·贝卡里亚（约1262—1322）是帕维亚的吉伯林派领袖。他曾于1275年担任韦尔切利、1278年担任诺瓦拉的波德斯塔，1282年起任帕维亚的“人民与商人长官”。他掌管城市粮食供应，依靠商人与行会，对抗归尔夫贵族并建立平民政权。1289年蒙费拉侯爵威廉七世攻占帕维亚，将他逐出。1290年10月他被召回，受任为期十年的波德斯塔，成为帕维亚事实上的领主。1299年他领导反维斯孔蒂同盟，一度攻占韦尔切利和诺瓦拉，但1300年敌对的兰戈斯科家族再度将他赶走。约1311年他被囚禁，1315年维斯孔蒂军队进入帕维亚后获释，1322年3月22日在该城去世。

en: Manfredo Beccaria was a son of the Pavese signore Musso Beccaria and brother of Castellino. Inheriting Gropello Cairoli, he founded the Beccaria di Gropello line. His son Corrado and grandson Manfredo succeeded him; his great-granddaughter Oretta married Gaspare Visconti, to whom the fief passed.
zh: 曼弗雷多·贝卡里亚是帕维亚城主穆索之子、卡斯泰利诺的兄弟，继承格罗佩洛卡伊罗利，开创家族格罗佩洛支系；子科拉多、孙曼弗雷多相继袭位，曾孙女奥雷塔嫁给加斯帕雷·维斯孔蒂，封地随之转入该家族。

en: Milano Beccaria was a 14th-century Pavia nobleman, son of Zanone Beccaria and ancestor of the Beccaria di Arena Po branch. After his descendants joined Castellino and Lancelotto's revolt against Filippo Maria Visconti, Arena Po was confiscated, leaving them only Bosnasco.
zh: 米拉诺·贝卡里亚是14世纪帕维亚贵族，扎诺内·贝卡里亚之子，为贝卡里亚家族阿雷纳波支系的始祖。其后人卷入卡斯泰利诺与兰切洛托反对菲利波·马里亚·维斯孔蒂的叛乱，阿雷纳封地被没收，仅余博斯纳斯科。

en: Musso Beccaria (died 1343), son of Manfredo Beccaria, was a Ghibelline signore of Pavia from 1322 and a loyal servant of Milan's Visconti. The Guelfs expelled his family in 1300, and it returned in 1315 only after Matteo Visconti drove its rivals from the city. In 1323 he was excommunicated after failing to answer an inquisitorial summons over his help to the Visconti. In 1328 he seized a papal convoy carrying sixty thousand gold gulden to Cardinal Bertrand du Pouget, the papal commander against the Visconti. The cardinal besieged Pavia and entered it on 8 June 1331, restoring Guelf rule. After a November 1332 uprising toppled the papal governor, Musso returned with Visconti help and in 1333 allied with Robert of Naples against John of Bohemia. In 1342 he turned to Louis IV of Bavaria, but Luchino Visconti forced him to submit. He died in 1343, succeeded by his son Castellino.
zh: 穆索·贝卡里亚（1343年卒）是曼弗雷多·贝卡里亚之子，自1322年起任帕维亚的吉伯林派领主，也是米兰维斯孔蒂家族的忠实追随者。1300年圭尔夫派驱逐了他的家族，直到1315年马泰奥·维斯孔蒂把对手逐出帕维亚，家族才得以返回。1323年，他因援助维斯孔蒂家族被宗教裁判所传召，未到庭后遭绝罚。1328年，他劫取教皇约翰二十二世送给贝特朗·迪普热枢机的六万金古尔登车队，迪普热正是教皇军对维斯孔蒂作战的统帅。枢机围困帕维亚，于1331年6月8日入城，恢复了圭尔夫派的统治。1332年11月起义推翻教皇代理人后，穆索借维斯孔蒂之助复位，1333年又与那不勒斯国王罗贝托结盟对抗波希米亚国王约翰。1342年他转而投向巴伐利亚的路易四世，却被卢基诺·维斯孔蒂逼得投降。他于1343年去世，其子卡斯泰利诺继位。

en: Rainaldo Beccaria was a 14th-century Pavia nobleman, son of Zanone Beccaria and ancestor of the Beccaria della Pieve branch, which held Montù Beccaria and Pieve del Cairo and died out in 1590.
zh: 拉伊纳尔多·贝卡里亚是14世纪帕维亚贵族，扎诺内·贝卡里亚之子，为贝卡里亚家族皮耶韦支系的始祖；该支领有蒙图贝卡里亚和卡伊罗的皮耶韦，1590年绝嗣。

en: Taddea Malaspina was a daughter of Gabriele Malaspina, marquis of Verrucola, and a sister of Spinetta Malaspina the Great, Isnardo II and Azzolino II.
zh: 塔代娅·马拉斯皮纳是韦鲁科拉侯爵加布里埃尔·马拉斯皮纳之女，“伟大者”斯皮内塔、伊斯纳尔多二世与阿佐利诺二世的姐妹。

en: Zanone Beccaria was a 14th-century nobleman of Pavia, son of the Ghibelline leader Manfredo Beccaria and brother of the signore Musso. Through his sons Rainaldo and Milano he founded the family's Pieve and Arena Po lines, which held Montù Beccaria, Pieve del Cairo and Mondondone.
zh: 扎诺内·贝卡里亚是14世纪帕维亚贵族，吉伯林派领袖曼弗雷多·贝卡里亚之子、城主穆索的兄弟。其子拉伊纳尔多、米拉诺分别开创家族的皮埃韦与波河阿里纳支系，领有蒙图贝卡里亚、皮埃韦-德尔凯罗、蒙东多内等地。

en: Bernard V of Lippe (1277–1341) was Prince-Bishop of Paderborn from 1321 until his death. A son of Simon I, Lord of Lippe, and Adelaide of Waldeck, he was appointed provost of Paderborn in 1305 and governed the bishopric de facto under bishops Günther I and Dietrich II before taking office. In 1309 he established a standing council of canons, ministeriales and citizens, and in 1326 issued the Privilegium Bernhardi, binding himself to consult the Estates before taxation. He bought much of Brakel, founded Dringenberg and Peckelsheim, and is regarded as the founder of Paderborn's medieval prince-bishopric.
zh: 利珀的贝尔纳德五世（1277—1341）自1321年起任帕德博恩采邑主教，直至去世。他是利珀领主西蒙一世与瓦尔德克的阿德莱德之子，1305年被任命为帕德博恩教长，在君特一世和迪特里希二世两任主教任内实际执掌主教区。1309年，他设立由法政牧师、家臣与市民组成的常设会议；1326年颁布《贝尔纳德特权令》，规定征税前须征询等级会议意见。他购入布拉凯尔大部分城区，兴建德林根贝格与佩克尔斯海姆，被视为帕德博恩中世纪采邑主教区的奠基人。

en: Francesco della Faggiola was a 14th-century Italian man-at-arms. He was the son of Ranieri della Faggiola, known as Neri, a Ghibelline condottiero and imperial vicar, and the grandson of Uguccione della Faggiola, who ruled Pisa and Lucca and won the battle of Montecatini in 1315.
zh: 弗朗切斯科·德拉·法焦拉是14世纪的意大利武士。他是吉伯林派雇佣军首领、帝国代理人拉涅里·德拉·法焦拉（绰号内里）之子，祖父乌古乔内·德拉·法焦拉曾统治比萨与卢卡，并于1315年赢得蒙特卡蒂尼战役。

en: Ranieri della Faggiola, called Neri (1290–1355), was a Ghibelline condottiero and imperial vicar, the son of Uguccione della Faggiola. He inherited the lordship of Badia Tedalda and allied with the Visconti against Florence; his son Francesco was also a man-at-arms.
zh: 拉涅里·德拉·法焦拉，绰号“内里”（1290—1355），是吉伯林派将领、帝国代理人，乌古乔内之子。他继承巴迪亚泰达尔达，与维斯孔蒂家族结盟对抗佛罗伦萨，子弗朗切斯科也是军人。

en: Philip I of Courtenay (1243–1283) was titular Latin Emperor of Constantinople from 1273, ruling in exile after the Greeks recovered the city in 1261. Born in Constantinople, he was the son of Emperor Baldwin II and Marie of Brienne; as a boy his father mortgaged him to Venetian merchants. By the Treaty of Viterbo in 1267 he was betrothed to Beatrice, daughter of Charles I of Sicily, and they married at Foggia in 1273, shortly before Baldwin's death. Philip held only the Latin lands in Greece and died at Viterbo in 1283. His daughter Catherine inherited his claim.
zh: 库特奈的菲利普一世（1243—1283）于1273年成为君士坦丁堡拉丁帝国的挂名皇帝；1261年希腊人收复君士坦丁堡后，他只能在流亡中统治。他生于君士坦丁堡，是皇帝鲍德温二世与布列讷的玛丽之子，幼年曾被父亲抵押给威尼斯商人。根据1267年的《维泰博条约》，他与西西里国王查理一世之女贝阿特丽切订婚，1273年在福贾成婚，不久鲍德温便去世。菲利普实际只掌握希腊的拉丁人领地，1283年死于维泰博，其女卡特琳继承了他的权利主张。

en: Pedro de Peralta y Ezpeleta, called the Younger (1421–c. 1492), was constable of Navarre and leader of the Agramont faction against the Beaumont party in the Navarrese Civil War of 1451–1455, fighting alongside his brother Martín. His father was Pedro de Peralta the Elder, and his mother Juana came from the Ezpeleta family. John II made him first Count of Santisteban de Lerín and Baron of Marcilla, lord of Peralta, Falces and other towns. He married Anne of Brabant, an illegitimate daughter of Anthony of Burgundy, in 1440, and Isabel de Foix in 1462. He later backed the Catholic Monarchs, receiving titles in return for supporting the marriage of Isabella of Castile and Ferdinand of Aragon in 1469.
zh: 佩德罗·德·佩拉尔塔-埃斯佩莱塔，人称“小佩德”（1421—约1492），是纳瓦拉宫廷长，在1451—1455年的纳瓦拉内战中领导阿格拉蒙特派，与兄弟马丁并肩同博蒙特派作战。他的父亲是老佩德罗·德·佩拉尔塔，母亲胡安娜出身埃斯佩莱塔家族。胡安二世封他为首任桑蒂斯特万-德·莱林伯爵、马尔西利亚男爵，领有佩拉尔塔、法尔塞斯等城镇。1440年他娶勃艮第的安东尼的私生女布拉班特的安妮，1462年续娶伊莎贝尔·德·富瓦。后来他支持天主教双王，因支持1469年卡斯蒂利亚的伊莎贝尔与阿拉贡的费尔南多联姻而获得封号。

en: Binnya E Laung was the only known son of King Binnya E Law of Martaban and heir presumptive from his father's accession in 1330. When summoned to the throne by his half-sister Sanda Min Hla, E Law brought his son with him to Martaban by ship. His rival was his younger half-cousin Binnya U, son of the powerful chief queen Sanda Min Hla. E Law did not formally name an heir apparent. In the 1340s, as the king's health failed, the two princes even fought an elephant-back duel, which Binnya U won; the enraged king had U arrested until the queen secured his release. E Laung died of smallpox soon afterward without taking the throne, and Binnya U succeeded in 1348.
zh: 频耶埃朗是马达班国王频耶埃劳唯一见于记载的儿子，1330年父亲即位后成为推定继承人。频耶埃劳受异母姐僧陀明罗召唤继位时，带着儿子乘船前往马达班。他的竞争者是比他年幼的表弟频耶宇——强势的僧陀明罗王后之子。频耶埃劳没有正式指定继承人。1340年代国王健康恶化，两位王子甚至在象背上决斗，频耶宇获胜；盛怒的国王将频耶宇下狱，王后出面才使他获释。不久后频耶埃朗死于天花，未能继位，频耶宇于1348年登基。

en: Binnya E Law (1308–1348/1349), son of King Hkun Law and nephew of founder Wareru, ruled Martaban from 1330. He was three when his father was assassinated in a coup in 1311, but E Law and the other children were spared. He won the trust of his cousin King Saw Zein, who made him governor of Sittaung and later Pegu. In 1330 Saw Zein was assassinated, and the young king Saw E, set up by Queen Sanda Min Hla, was poisoned within 49 days. Sanda Min Hla, E Law’s half-sister, then summoned him to Martaban. His armies defeated a Sukhothai invasion in 1330–1331, ending Martaban’s tributary status to the Siamese kingdom, though the fighting devastated farms and brought famine. In his later years his son Binnya E Laung and Sanda Min Hla’s son Binnya U rivalled for the succession, once fighting an elephant-back duel that U won. E Law died in 1348/1349, and U succeeded him.
zh: 频耶埃劳（1308—1348/1349）是恭劳王之子、王朝创立者伐丽流之侄，1330年起为马达班国王。1311年他年仅三岁，父亲在政变中遇刺，但他与其他子女获免于难。他深得表兄修齐因王信任，先后出任锡当总督和勃固总督。1330年，修齐因遇刺，由僧陀明罗王后扶立的年幼国王修埃也在四十九天内被毒死。僧陀明罗是埃劳的异母姐，随后召他前往马达班。1330—1331年，他的军队大败素可泰王国的入侵，结束了马达班对暹罗的藩属地位，但战火摧毁农田，引发饥荒。他统治后期，其子频耶埃朗与僧陀明罗之子频耶宇争夺继承权，两人甚至骑象决斗，结果频耶宇获胜。埃劳于1348/1349年去世，频耶宇继位。

en: Binnya U (1323–1384) took the throne of Martaban–Hanthawaddy in 1348 as Hsinbyushin, Lord of the White Elephant, succeeding his maternal uncle Binnya E Law. Son of Saw Zein and Sanda Min Hla, he held power only tenuously and bought the court's loyalty with marriages, taking three daughters of Minister Than-Bon himself. In 1351–1352 he drove back a Lan Na invasion, leading the counterattack on his white elephant; in 1352–1353 he retook Pegu from his half-brother Min Linka. In 1362 he raised the Shwedagon Pagoda at Dagon to about 20 metres. Then a coup by the brothers Byattaba and Laukpya in 1363–1364 began the loss of Martaban, and by 1369 he held only Pegu province, which became his capital. Ailing, he made his sister Maha Dewi regent in 1383 and died in January 1384 amid the revolt of his eldest son Binnya Nwe, who became King Razadarit.
zh: 频耶宇（1323—1384）1348年继舅父频耶埃劳为马达班—汉达瓦底国王，号“辛骠信”，意为“白象之主”。他是修齐因王与僧陀明罗王后之子，起初权力并不稳固，靠联姻笼络宫廷，亲自娶了大臣丹邦的三个女儿。1351—1352年，他骑白象率军反击，击退兰纳的入侵；1352—1353年，他攻克勃固，夺回被异母弟明林加占据的城池。1362年他在大光把大金塔加高到约20米。1363—1364年，劳骠兄弟发动政变，马达班自此逐步失守，到1369年他只剩勃固一省，便以勃固为都。他长年多病，1383年命姐姐摩诃提毗摄政，1384年1月在长子频耶努的叛乱中去世；频耶努即位，即亚扎底律。

en: Hkun Law (27 March 1254 – March 1311), born Ma Gada at Donwun, was Wareru's younger brother and heir. When Wareru was assassinated in January 1307 without a male heir, Gada succeeded as king of Martaban, receiving recognition from his overlord Sukhothai and the regnal name Hkun Law. He proved a weak ruler: Lan Na raiders struck as far south as Donwun and killed its governor, while the delta governor Min Bala, his brother-in-law, ruled like a sovereign. In March 1311 Min Bala seized Martaban while Law hunted near Moulmein. Returning to find the gates shut, Law fled into the woods, where Bala's troops killed him; most later Wareru-dynasty kings descended from Law.
zh: 恭劳（1254年3月27日—1311年3月）本名马加答，出生于棠温，是伐丽流之弟与继承人。1307年1月伐丽流遇刺且无子，马加答继位为马达班国王，得到宗主素可泰承认并获王号恭劳。他统治软弱：兰纳袭扰者长驱南下直抵棠温，杀死当地总督，而他的妹夫、三角洲总督敏巴拉形同独立之君。1311年3月，敏巴拉趁恭劳在毛淡棉附近狩猎时夺取马达班。恭劳返回时发现城门紧闭，逃入树林，却被敏巴拉的士兵追杀。后来伐丽流王朝的多数国王都是他的后裔。

en: Hnin U Yaing (c. 1260s – 1310s) was a princess of Martaban, younger sister of the kingdom's founder Wareru. In 1285 her brother used her to lure Governor Aleimma: the governor fell in love with her and was killed at their wedding feast, letting Wareru seize Martaban. She married Min Bala, whom Wareru made governor of Myaungmya, and joined her husband in the March 1311 coup against her brother Hkun Law. Bala's troops killed Law after he returned from a hunting trip and found the capital's gates shut. She then stopped Bala from taking the crown himself, insisting that their eldest son Saw O be made king; her sons Saw O and Saw Zein both later reigned.
zh: 宁乌亚英（约1260年代—1310年代）是马达班公主，王朝开创者伐丽流的幼妹。1285年，兄长借她引诱总督阿梨摩：阿梨摩爱上她，却在婚宴上被杀，伐丽流由此夺取马达班。她嫁给敏巴拉，丈夫被伐丽流任命为渺弥亚总督；1311年3月，她与丈夫发动政变推翻兄长恭劳。恭劳狩猎归来，发现首都城门紧闭，随后被敏巴拉的士兵杀害。她阻止敏巴拉自立为王，坚持立长子修乌继位。她的两个儿子修乌和修齐因后来都做了国王。

en: Maha Dewi (c. 1322–c. 1392), born Mwei Na, was a daughter of King Saw Zein and Queen Sanda Min Hla and elder sister of King Binnya U of Martaban. Her father gave her the name Maha Dewi after he took the throne. From 1364 she governed Dagon, and after 1369 she was her ailing brother's closest adviser, ruling the kingdom in all but name by the early 1380s. A court faction led by the chief minister tried to undermine her with talk of an affair with her nephew-in-law Smin Maru. In October 1383 Binnya U handed her his powers as regent, but she could not defeat the rebellion of her nephew and adopted son Binnya Nwe, whom the chief minister secretly backed. When U died in January 1384 the court chose Nwe, who took the throne as Razadarit and sent her back to Dagon in a purely ceremonial role.
zh: 摩诃提毗（约1322—约1392），乳名妙娜，是修齐因王与僧陀明罗王后之女、马达班国王频耶宇的姐姐。父亲即位后，赐她“摩诃提毗”之名。1364年起她治理大光，1369年后成为病弱弟弟最亲信的谋臣，到1380年代初已是王国的实际执政者。以首相为首的宫廷派系用她与侄女婿斯明马鲁的绯闻削弱她的影响。1383年10月，频耶宇把权力交给她摄政，但她无法镇压侄子兼养子频耶努的叛乱，首相暗中支持频耶努。1384年1月频耶宇去世，朝臣拥立频耶努，即亚扎底律；他把摩诃提毗送回大光，只保留名誉职务。

en: May Hnin Htapi was a daughter of King Loe Thai of Sukhothai, who in 1311 sent her to Martaban to marry the newly crowned King Saw O; Martaban was then Sukhothai's nominal vassal. As Saw O's chief queen she bore a son, Saw E, and a daughter. Saw O later broke with Sukhothai, and after his death in 1323 his successor Saw Zein made her his second-ranking queen. She gave birth to Min Linka while Zein fought to restore his authority over the kingdom. When Zein was assassinated in 1330, Saw E took the throne but was killed after 49 days by the chief queen Sanda Min Hla, after which Htapi vanishes from the chronicles.
zh: 梅宁塔琵是素可泰国王乐泰之女。1311年，父亲将她送往马达班，嫁给新即位的国王修乌，当时马达班是素可泰名义上的属邦。她作为修乌的正宫王后，生下儿子修埃和一个女儿。修乌后来脱离素可泰，1323年他去世后，继任国王修齐因立她为第二王后。修齐因征战以恢复对王国的统治时，她生下敏林加。1330年修齐因遇刺，修埃继位仅49天便被正宫僧陀明罗杀害，此后这位素可泰出身的王后便不见于史书。

en: Min Bala, also called Smim Myaungmya, was governor of the delta port of Myaungmya from the 1290s and the husband of Hnin U Yaing, sister of King Wareru, founder of Hanthawaddy. In March 1311 he seized the Martaban throne and killed Wareru's successor Hkun Law, his brother-in-law, but reluctantly yielded the crown to their eldest son Saw O on 10 April 1311 at his wife's insistence. Until his death in the later 1310s Bala was the power behind the throne, ruling from his own palace outside Martaban much as a sovereign. He and Hnin U Yaing had at least three sons; another, Saw Zein, later reigned as king.
zh: 敏巴拉又号斯敏·渺弥亚，自1290年代起任伊洛瓦底三角洲港口渺弥亚的总督，娶勃固王朝开创者伐丽流之妹宁乌亚英为妻。1311年3月，他夺取马达班王位，捕杀伐丽流的继任者、妻舅恭劳，却在妻子坚持下于1311年4月10日不情愿地把王位让给长子修乌。直到1310年代后期去世，敏巴拉始终是幕后掌权者，在马达班城外自己的宫殿中行使君主般的权力。他与宁乌亚英至少有三个儿子，其中修齐因此后也登位为王。

en: Min Linka (c. 1327–1352/53) was a younger son of King Saw Zein of Martaban and half-brother of King Binnya U, who appointed him governor of Pegu in 1348. Seeking to secure court allegiance through marriage alliances, U arranged Linka's marriage to Mwei Daw, the youngest daughter of Minister Than-Bon. When Lan Na invaded in 1351–1352, its army reached the outskirts of Martaban, but Linka sent no help to his hard-pressed brother. After the invaders were repelled, Binnya U marched on Pegu in 1352–1353 and retook it. Linka was carried back to Martaban and executed, and Mwei Daw became one of U's queens.
zh: 明林加（约1327—1352/1353）是马达班国王修齐因之子、频耶宇王的异母弟。1348年，频耶宇任命他为勃固总督。频耶宇为通过联姻争取宫廷效忠，安排他迎娶大臣丹邦的幼女妙杜。1351—1352年兰纳入侵，军队抵达马达班城郊，明林加却对苦战中的兄长按兵不救。敌军被击退后，频耶宇于1352—1353年进军攻克勃固；明林加被押回马达班处死，妙杜后来成为频耶宇的王后。

en: Sanda Min Hla (c. early 14th century – 1363/1364), personal name Hnin An Po, was chief queen of three kings of Martaban and the real power behind its throne. A daughter of King Hkun Law and niece of the founder Wareru, she lost her father to a coup in 1311; the usurping couple spared his children and married her to their own son, her cousin Saw Zein. By 1323 she was his chief queen and had borne Binnya U. After Zein's assassination in 1330 she put down the usurper Zein Pun within a week, then enthroned and married Saw E, grandson of the king of Sukhothai. She poisoned him after 49 days and placed her half-brother Binnya E Law on the throne. The killing brought a Sukhothai invasion in 1330–1331; E Law defeated it, ending Martaban's vassalage. She held power behind the throne until Binnya U succeeded in 1348.
zh: 僧陀明罗（约14世纪初—1363/1364年）本名宁安波，曾是马达班三位国王的正宫王后，也是王位背后的实际掌权者。她是国王恭劳之女、王朝开创者伐丽流的侄女，1311年父亲死于政变；夺位的夫妇留下了恭劳的子女，并把她嫁给自己的儿子、她的表兄修齐因。1323年她成为正宫王后，生下后来的国王频耶宇。1330年修齐因遇刺后，她在一周内平定篡位者泽因榜，随即拥立素可泰国王的外孙修埃为王并嫁给他，49天后又将他毒杀，改立异母兄弟频耶埃劳。素可泰因此于1330—1331年入侵，被频耶埃劳击败，马达班从此不再臣属素可泰。直到1348年儿子频耶宇继位，她始终是幕后掌权者。

en: Saw Zein (19 May 1303 – c. April 1330), also titled Binnya Ran De, was king of Martaban and a son of Min Bala and Hnin U Yaing. In September 1323 he succeeded his brother Saw O. His vassals revolted: he retook Pegu, Dagon and Dala, established a temporary capital north of Pegu and gathered war elephants before forcing the delta lords of Myaungmya and Bassein to submit. He could not recover the Tenasserim coast from Sukhothai and made a truce as its nominal vassal. A later attack on Prome failed, and in April 1330 his officer Zein Pun murdered him at a housewarming feast; the usurper was killed a week later.
zh: 修齐因（1303年5月19日—约1330年4月）又号频耶兰岱，是马达班国王、敏巴拉与宁乌亚英之子。1323年9月，他继兄长修乌之后登位。各地属僚随即反叛：他收复勃固、大光和德拉，在勃固以北设立临时首都并征集战象，随后迫使渺弥亚、勃生的三角洲领主臣服。他未能从素可泰手中夺回丹那沙林海岸，只得作为名义藩臣议和。他后来北攻卑谬失败，约1330年4月被部将泽因榜趁乔迁宴杀害，篡位者一周后也被诛杀。

en: Tala Shin Saw Bok was a queen of King Binnya E Law of Martaban, a daughter of King Hkun Law and the younger full sister of the powerful queen Sanda Min Hla. She and her siblings were spared when their father was overthrown in 1311. In about June 1330 her half-brother Binnya E Law, whom Sanda Min Hla had just placed on the throne, raised her as a principal queen. In the 1340s she joined her sister in persuading the king to release the young prince Binnya U, whom he had arrested after an elephant-back duel with the king's own son, Binnya E Laung. The two princes had competed for the throne; E Laung died of smallpox soon afterwards, and Binnya U succeeded as king in 1348.
zh: 陀罗信梭博克是马达班国王频耶埃劳的王后、国王恭劳之女，也是强势王后僧陀明罗的胞妹。1311年父亲被推翻时，她与兄弟姊妹得到赦免。约1330年6月，僧陀明罗把异母兄弟频耶埃劳扶上王位，他随即立她为王后。1340年代，王子频耶宇与国王之子频耶埃朗骑象决斗，事后被国王下令逮捕，她和姐姐一同劝说国王释放了他。两位王子曾争夺王位；频耶埃朗不久死于天花，频耶宇于1348年继位为王。

en: Wareru (20 March 1253 – c. 14 January 1307), founder of the Martaban Kingdom, was born Ma Gadu at Tagaw Wun near Thaton and served in the elephant stables of King Ram Khamhaeng of Sukhothai before returning home. He seized the governorship of Martaban in 1285, rebuilt its fortifications and in 1287 declared independence from the collapsing Pagan Empire with Sukhothai's backing. In 1295–1296 he and Tarabya of Pegu crushed a Pagan invasion, after which he eliminated Tarabya and united the three Mon provinces. Yuan China recognized him in 1298, and he commissioned the Wareru Dhammathat law code, which influenced Burmese and Siamese law for centuries. In January 1307 he was assassinated by Tarabya's sons.
zh: 马达班王国的开创者伐丽流（1253年3月20日—约1307年1月14日）本名马加杜，出生于直通附近的棠温，曾在素可泰国王兰甘亨的象厩供职，后返回故乡。1285年，他夺取马达班都督之位，重修城防，1287年在素可泰支持下宣布脱离蒲甘王朝独立。1295—1296年，他与勃固的多罗跋联手击退蒲甘大军，随后除掉多罗跋，统一三个孟族地区。1298年他获得元朝承认，并下令编纂《伐丽流法典》，影响缅甸和暹罗法律数百年。1307年1月，他被多罗跋的儿子们刺杀。

en: His name unrecorded, he was a poor peasant of Tagaw Wun near Martaban, and the father of Wareru, founder of Hanthawaddy, King Hkun Law, and Hnin U Yaing, wife of Min Bala.
zh: 其名不见史载，他是马达班附近棠温村的贫苦农民，子女包括勃固王朝开创者伐丽流、国王恭劳，以及嫁给敏巴拉的宁乌亚英。

en: Adalbert I (c. 955–997), second son of Boso the Old of La Marche, was captured with his brother Hélie I by Guy I, viscount of Limoges, in 974. Released after a reconciliation around 977, he married Guy's sister Almodis and was recognised in La Marche, first styling himself count there in 988; he added Périgord after Hélie's death. In 995 he and his brother Boso II, aided by Fulk Nerra of Anjou, warred against William V of Aquitaine. He was killed by an arrow at the siege of Gençay in the summer of 997 and buried at Charroux.
zh: 阿达尔贝尔一世（约955—997）是马尔什的博松老者的次子。974年，他与兄长埃利一世被利摩日子爵居伊一世俘虏，被囚禁数年；约977年双方和解，他娶居伊的妹妹阿尔莫迪斯为妻，并被承认领有马尔什。988年，他首次自称马尔什伯爵，埃利死后又取得佩里戈尔。995年，他联合弟弟博松二世，并得到安茹的富尔克·内拉支援，向阿基坦公爵威廉五世开战。997年夏，他在让塞围城战中中箭身亡，葬于沙鲁。

en: Ali Qushji (1403–1474), born Ala al-Din Ali in Samarkand, was a Timurid astronomer and mathematician whose epithet means falconer, after his father who kept Ulugh Beg's birds. He studied under Qazızade Rumi and Jamshid al-Kashi, wrote a treatise on the moon in Kerman, and joined Ulugh Beg's observatory in Samarkand, contributing to the Zij-i-Sultani star tables. After Ulugh Beg's assassination he traveled via Herat and Tabriz, and around 1470 reached Constantinople as the envoy of Uzun Hasan. Welcomed by Mehmed II, he stayed, helped found the Sahn-ı Seman madrasa, and taught there until his death in 1474. He argued for an astronomy independent of natural philosophy and discussed the rotation of the Earth.
zh: 阿里·库什吉（1403—1474），原名阿拉丁·阿里，生于撒马尔罕，是帖木儿王朝的天文学家、数学家；“库什吉”意为驯鹰人，得自他为乌鲁伯格养鹰的父亲。他曾师从卡扎扎德·鲁米和贾姆希德·卡西，在克尔曼撰写论述月亮运行的著作，后进入撒马尔罕的乌鲁伯格天文台，参与编撰《苏丹历表》。乌鲁伯格遇刺后，他经赫拉特、大不里士辗转西行，约1470年作为乌尊·哈桑的使节抵达君士坦丁堡。穆罕默德二世对他礼遇有加，他便留下，参与创建萨恩-塞米安经学院，并在此任教，直至1474年去世。他主张天文学独立于自然哲学，并探讨地球自转。

en: Archambaud II Talleyrand (c. 1185–1239), son of Hélie VII and Marguerite of Limoges, was count of Périgord from about 1209. In 1212, at Nemours, he did homage to King Philip Augustus, confirming the direct vassalage to the French crown begun by his father; John Lackland recognized it only after his defeats at Roche-aux-Moines and Bouvines in 1214. In 1239 Archambaud joined the Barons’ Crusade led by Theobald IV of Champagne and died the same year on the road to the Holy Land, perhaps at Acre. His son Hélie VIII succeeded him.
zh: 阿尔尚博二世·塔列朗（约1185—1239）是埃利七世与利摩日的玛格丽特之子，约1209年起任佩里戈尔伯爵。1212年，他在讷穆尔向法王腓力·奥古斯都行臣服礼，确认了其父开启的对法国王权的直接封臣关系；无地王约翰在1214年罗什欧穆瓦讷和布汶两度战败之后才予以承认。1239年，阿尔尚博加入香槟伯爵蒂博四世率领的男爵十字军，同年死于前往圣地的途中，可能殁于阿卡。其子埃利八世继位。

en: Archambaud III (c. 1237–c. 1295) was count of Périgord from 1251, succeeding his father Hélie VIII while still a child; until he came of age the county was governed by his mother Gaillarde. In 1277 he confirmed all the lands held by his cousin Hélie II de Talleyrand, sire de Grignols, and released him from vassalage, a settlement from which the Talleyrand-Périgord line later grew. He married twice, his second wife being Marie d'Anduze, and was succeeded by his son Hélie IX.
zh: 阿尔尚博三世（约1237—约1295）自1251年起为佩里戈尔伯爵，继承父亲埃利八世之位时尚在幼年，成年前由母亲加亚尔达治理伯国。1277年，他确认堂亲格里尼奥尔领主埃利二世·德·塔列朗对全部领地的权利，并解除其封臣依附关系，塔列朗-佩里戈尔一支后来由此发展起来。他曾两次结婚，第二任妻子为玛丽·德·昂迪兹，死后由儿子埃利九世继位。

en: Archambaud IV (c. 1300–1334) became count of Périgord in 1311 on the death of his father Hélie IX, ruling first under the regency of his mother Brunissende de Foix. On 26 November 1313 he married Jeanne, daughter of Renaud, sire de Pons and de Bergerac. When Jeanne's childless brother Hélie Rudel died in 1334, Archambaud seized Bergerac in his wife's name; the dead lord's widow Mathe d'Albret contested the inheritance and called in the English king. Archambaud died amid the quarrel without children, and his brother Roger-Bernard succeeded him.
zh: 阿尔尚博四世（约1300—1334）于1311年父亲埃利九世死后成为佩里戈尔伯爵，起初由母亲布吕尼桑德·德·富瓦摄政。1313年11月26日，他娶蓬与贝尔热拉克领主勒诺之女让娜为妻。1334年让娜无嗣的兄弟埃利·吕代尔去世，阿尔尚博以妻子的名义占领贝尔热拉克；死者遗孀玛特·德·阿尔布雷就遗产提起诉讼，并请来英格兰国王相助。阿尔尚博在这场争执中死去，没有子女，弟弟罗歇-贝尔纳继位。

en: Adalbert II, called Cadoirac (c. 1020–1072), was count of Périgord from 1044, succeeding his father Boson III. He feuded with Girard de Gordon, bishop of Périgueux, who until his death in 1059 refused to authenticate coins struck by Adalbert’s predecessor Count Hélie II. By his wife Asceline, heiress of the lord of Grignols, he left two sons, Hélie III and Adalbert III; the county later passed first through Hélie’s line and then, in 1149, to Adalbert’s grandson Boson IV.
zh: 阿达尔贝尔二世，绰号卡杜瓦拉克（约1020—1072），自1044年继父博松三世之位，成为佩里戈尔伯爵。他与佩里格主教吉拉尔·德·戈尔东长期敌对：主教直到1059年去世，都拒绝承认阿达尔贝尔的前任埃利二世所铸钱币的效力。他的妻子阿斯莉娜是格里尼奥勒领主的女继承人，两人生有埃利三世和阿达尔贝尔三世两个儿子；伯爵之位先由埃利一支传承，1149年转入阿达尔贝尔之孙博松四世手中。

en: Adalbert III (c. 1065–1116) was a son of Count Adalbert II Cadoirac of Périgord. After the death of his brother Hélie III, in 1101 or 1104, he held the county jointly with Hélie’s sons rather than alone: with his nephew Guillaume III Talleyrand until 1115, and then briefly with Hélie Rudel in 1116. Of his own sons, Boson IV later became count; Audebert held the lordship of Puyguilhem; and Raymond served as bishop of Périgueux from 1146 and then as archbishop of Bordeaux in 1158–1159.
zh: 阿达尔贝尔三世（约1065—1116）是佩里戈尔伯爵阿达尔贝尔二世·卡杜瓦拉克之子。兄长埃利三世于1101或1104年去世后，他与埃利的诸子共同执掌伯国，而非独自统治：先与侄子纪尧姆三世·塔列朗共治至1115年，1116年又与埃利·吕德尔短暂共治。他的儿子中，博松四世后来成为伯爵；奥德贝尔领有皮伊吉扬领地；雷蒙自1146年起任佩里格主教，并于1158—1159年升任波尔多大主教。

en: The Chronicle of Saint-Maixent records Boso, called the Old, as the son of Sulpice and grandson of Geoffroy, first count of Charroux. Around 950 he held the Limousin frontier march facing the county of Bourges, building the castle of Bellac as its seat, and is regarded as the first count of La Marche. Through his marriage to Emma of Périgord he also succeeded to the county of Périgord. From about 968 he warred with Géraud, viscount of Limoges, and died soon after. He divided his lands among his three eldest sons, Hélie, Adalbert and Boso.
zh: 博松，绰号“老者”，据圣迈克桑修道院编年史记载，是苏尔皮斯之子、沙鲁首任伯爵若弗鲁瓦之孙。约950年，他掌控利穆赞朝向布尔日伯国的边境马尔什边区，并修建贝拉克城堡作为治所，被视为第一代马尔什伯爵。他凭借与佩里戈尔的埃玛的婚姻又继承了佩里戈尔伯国。约968年起，他与利摩日子爵热罗交战，不久后去世。他把领地分给三个年长的儿子埃利、阿达尔贝尔和博松。

en: Boso II, third son of Boso the Old, was count of La Marche and Périgord from 997, succeeding his brother Adalbert I despite the claims of Adalbert's young son Bernard. In 997 he founded the abbey of Moutier-d'Ahun, and in 1000 he fought for his suzerain William V of Aquitaine against Adémar, viscount of Limoges. The chronicler Adémar de Chabannes accused Boso's unnamed wife of poisoning him after his return from Rome. His last charter is dated December 1003. By William V's award of 1008, Périgord passed to Boso's son Hélie and La Marche to his nephew Bernard I.
zh: 博松二世是博松老者的第三子，997年起为马尔什与佩里戈尔伯爵：这一年他继承兄长阿达尔贝尔一世之位，不顾其年幼之子贝尔纳的继承权。997年他建立米亚泰达安修道院；1000年，他追随封君阿基坦公爵威廉五世讨伐利摩日子爵阿代马尔。编年史家阿德马尔·德·沙巴纳指责博松无名号的妻子在他从罗马归来后毒杀了他，他存世的最后一份宪章日期为1003年12月。依威廉五世1008年的裁决，佩里戈尔归博松之子埃利，马尔什归其侄贝尔纳一世。

en: Boso III (c. 990–1031/1044), count of Périgord, was probably a younger son of Boso II. He succeeded his brother Hélie II around 1033, possibly after ruling at his side as co-count. His marriage to Aina, daughter of Géraud de Montignac and Nonie de Grignols, brought him the seigneuries of Montignac and Grignols. Their son Adalbert II, who died in 1072 or 1073, succeeded as count of Périgord, and their daughter Aina married Eudes de Bordeaux and then Guy-Geoffroy of Aquitaine.
zh: 博松三世（约990—1031/1044）为佩里戈尔伯爵，大概是博松二世的幼子。约1033年，他继承兄长埃利二世之位，此前可能已作为共治伯爵辅政。他娶热罗·德·蒙蒂尼亚克与诺妮·德·格里尼奥尔之女艾娜为妻，借此获得蒙蒂尼亚克和格里尼奥尔两块领地。他们的儿子阿达尔贝尔二世（1072或1073年卒）继位为佩里戈尔伯爵，女儿艾娜先后嫁给厄德·德·波尔多和居伊-若弗鲁瓦·德·阿基坦。

en: Boson IV (c. 1106–1166), a son of Adalbert III, first appears in 1135 as lord of Grignols. From the early 1140s he ruled Périgord as co-ruler of his uncle Hélie Rudel, whose sons had died in the Limoges war, and he governed alone from Hélie’s death in 1149 until his own. By his wife Contor he had his successor Hélie VI Talleyrand, two sons who became monks and another who became an abbot; his daughter Jourdaine married Archambaud V, viscount of Comborn.
zh: 博松四世（约1106—1166）是阿达尔贝尔三世之子，1135年首次以格里尼奥勒领主的身份出现。自1140年代初起，他作为叔父埃利·吕德尔的共治者统治佩里戈尔伯国，吕德尔的儿子们已在利摩日战争中丧命；1149年吕德尔死后他独掌政权，直至本人去世。他与妻子孔托尔生有继承人埃利六世·塔列朗，另有两个儿子出家为修士、一个儿子成为修道院院长；女儿茹尔丹嫁给了孔博恩子爵阿尔尚博五世。

en: Brunissende of Foix (died September 1324), daughter of Roger-Bernard III, Count of Foix, and Margaret, Viscountess of Béarn, married Count Hélie IX of Périgord in 1298 with a dowry of six thousand livres. Widowed in 1311, she ruled the county as regent during the minority of her son Archambaud. She was widely believed to hold great sway at the new Avignon curia; chroniclers even rumored she was the mistress of Pope Clement V, and she secured rich church benefices for her son Hélie, later an influential cardinal. In 1314 Hélie became a canon at Cahors with a prebend reserved for him. Her sons Archambaud and Roger-Bernard each became Count of Périgord.
zh: 布鲁妮桑德·德·富瓦（1324年9月卒）是富瓦伯爵罗歇·贝尔纳三世与贝阿恩子爵玛格丽特之女，1298年携六千利弗尔嫁妆嫁给佩里戈尔伯爵埃利九世。1311年丈夫去世，她在儿子阿尚博未成年期间以摄政身份统治伯国。时人普遍认为她在新生的阿维尼翁教廷极有权势，编年史家甚至传言她是教皇克雷芒五世的情妇；她为儿子埃利谋得丰厚的教会圣俸，埃利后来成为权势显赫的枢机主教。1314年，埃利成为卡奥尔的座堂参议，并获预留圣俸。她的儿子阿尚博与罗歇·贝尔纳先后成为佩里戈尔伯爵。

en: Eleanor of Vendôme (died c. 1350) was a daughter of Count Bouchard VI of Vendôme and Alix of Brittany. On 3 February 1339 she married Roger-Bernard, count of Périgord. She was the mother of Archambaud V, who succeeded as count of Périgord, Talleyrand, lord of Bergerac, and Joan, who married John II, count of Armagnac. Eleanor died around 1350, predeceasing her husband, who died in 1361 and whose county had just passed under English rule by the Treaty of Brétigny in 1360.
zh: 旺多姆的埃莱奥诺尔（约1350年卒）是旺多姆伯爵布沙尔六世与布列塔尼的阿莉克丝之女。1339年2月3日，她嫁给佩里戈尔伯爵罗歇-贝尔纳。她的儿子阿尔尚博五世后来承袭佩里戈尔伯爵之位，另一子塔列朗成为贝尔热拉克领主，女儿让娜则嫁给阿尔马尼亚克伯爵让二世。埃莱奥诺尔约于1350年早逝；丈夫1361年去世时，佩里戈尔已依1360年的《布雷蒂尼条约》转归英格兰统治。

en: Guillaume III Talleyrand (c. 1080–1115) was count of Périgord from 1104, the elder son of Hélie III. From 1104 or 1107 his charters name him jointly with his uncle Adalbert III and his brother Hélie Rudel, who carried on the government after him. He was only the second member of the dynasty to bear Talleyrand, originally a nickname that later became the family name. His son Hélie IV Talleyrand, styled count in some documents, was still living in 1131, but the succession passed to Guillaume’s brother Hélie Rudel.
zh: 纪尧姆三世·塔列朗（约1080—1115）自1104年起任佩里戈尔伯爵，是埃利三世的长子。1104或1107年起，特许状中他的名字常与叔父阿达尔贝尔三世和弟弟埃利·吕德尔并列，后者在他死后继续执政。他是家族中第二位使用“塔列朗”之名的人，该名最初只是绰号，后来演变为家族姓氏。他的儿子埃利四世·塔列朗在部分文书中被称作伯爵，1131年仍在世，但爵位最终由纪尧姆之弟埃利·吕德尔继承。

en: Hélie I (died 976 or 977) was count of La Marche and Périgord, the eldest son of Boso the Old and Emma of Périgord. In 974 he fought beside his father against Géraud, viscount of Limoges, and succeeded to La Marche when Boso died soon after. In July 975 his uncle Ranulf Bompar, count of Périgord, was killed and Hélie inherited that county too. After he blinded Benedict, a chorepiscopus intended for election as bishop of Limoges, Viscount Guy I captured Hélie and his brother Adalbert and imprisoned them at Montignac. Hélie escaped and set out for Rome to seek the pope's pardon, but died on the way; Adalbert inherited Périgord.
zh: 埃利一世（976或977年卒）是马尔什与佩里戈尔伯爵，博松老者与佩里戈尔的埃玛的长子。974年，他随父亲攻打利摩日子爵热罗的领地，父亲不久去世后他继位为马尔什伯爵。975年7月，他的舅父、佩里戈尔伯爵拉努尔夫·邦帕尔被杀，埃利继承佩里戈尔伯国。他弄瞎了拟被推举为利摩日主教的乡区主教本笃，子爵居伊一世随即将他和弟弟阿达尔贝尔俘获，关押在蒙蒂尼亚克。埃利逃脱后前往罗马请求教皇赦免，却死在途中，佩里戈尔由阿达尔贝尔继承。

en: Hélie II, count of Périgord, was a son of Boso II. When Boso died, La Marche and Périgord were meant to pass to his nephew Bernard, but their suzerain William V of Aquitaine kept La Marche for Bernard and gave Périgord to Hélie, who ruled at first under William's guardianship as a minor; this opened the line that held Périgord for four centuries. He married Adèle, held to be a daughter of Bertrand, sire de Pons, and left sons including Aldebert II. He last appears in a papal letter of 1031 and probably died soon afterwards.
zh: 埃利二世是佩里戈尔伯爵，博松二世之子。博松死后，马尔什与佩里戈尔两伯国本应传给其侄贝尔纳，但封君阿基坦公爵威廉五世把马尔什留给贝尔纳，将佩里戈尔交给埃利。埃利起初年幼，由威廉监护理政；这一安排开启了统治佩里戈尔四百年的家族支系。他娶阿代勒为妻，家谱称她是蓬领主贝特朗之女，儿子包括阿尔德贝尔二世。他在史料中最后出现于1031年的一封教皇信函中，可能不久后去世。

en: Hélie III (c. 1055–1104) succeeded his father Adalbert II Cadoirac as count of Périgord no later than 1073. His rule is documented by charters from the 1070s down to 1101. By his wife Garsende he had two sons who held the county in turn: Guillaume III Talleyrand, count from 1104, and Hélie Rudel, who followed his brother in 1115.
zh: 埃利三世（约1055—1104）最迟于1073年继其父阿达尔贝尔二世·卡杜瓦拉克之位，成为佩里戈尔伯爵。1070年代至1101年间的多份文书记载了他的统治。他与妻子加尔桑德生有两个先后承袭伯爵之位的儿子：1104年继位的纪尧姆三世·塔列朗，以及1115年继兄而立的埃利·吕德尔。

en: Hélie IX (c. 1261–1311) was Count of Périgord from 1294, son of Archambaud III. In 1276 he married Philippa, heiress of her brother Vézian III, Viscount of Lomagne and Auvillars; after Vézian's death in 1280 Mathe de Bordeaux disputed the claim before the English duke of Aquitaine, though he kept Lomagne until Philippa's death in 1286. Succeeding his father in 1294, he married Brunissende of Foix in 1298. In 1301 he ceded both lands to Philip IV of France to keep them from English sway. He died in 1311, leaving Archambaud IV a minor under Brunissende's regency.
zh: 埃利九世（约1261—1311）1294年起为佩里戈尔伯爵，伯爵阿尚博三世之子。1276年，他娶洛马涅和欧维拉尔子爵韦济安三世的妹妹兼继承人菲利帕为妻；1280年韦济安死后，他的继承权遭到马特·德·波尔多争夺，后者向身兼阿基坦公爵的英王申诉，他仍保有洛马涅，直到1286年菲利帕去世。1294年他承袭父位，1298年迎娶布鲁妮桑德·德·富瓦。1301年，为使洛马涅和欧维拉尔不落入英国势力之手，他把两地让给法王腓力四世。1311年他去世，幼子阿尚博四世继位，由布鲁妮桑德摄政。

en: Hélie V, called Rudel (c. 1083–1149), the younger son of Hélie III, ruled Périgord from 1115, after appearing for years beside his brother Guillaume III and their uncle Adalbert III. He fought a bitter war against Adémar le Barbu, viscount of Limoges, in which his own sons were killed. Left without an heir, he made his nephew Boson IV co-ruler, and by 1149 Boson governed alone. Hélie last appears in a charter of 1146; his nickname Rudel meant the hard or cruel one, and one tradition makes him ancestor of the lords of Bergerac.
zh: 埃利五世，绰号吕德尔（约1083—1149），是埃利三世的幼子。他在特许状中与兄长纪尧姆三世及叔父阿达尔贝尔三世并列多年，于1115年起统治佩里戈尔伯国。他同利摩日子爵“大胡子”阿代马尔恶战连年，几个亲生儿子都在战争中丧命。由于没有继承人，他立侄子博松四世为共治者，到1149年博松已独掌政权。他最后见于1146年的一份特许状；“吕德尔”意为坚毅或冷酷之人，另有一说认为他是贝尔热拉克领主家族的始祖。

en: Hélie VI Talleyrand (c. 1136–1203) was count of Périgord from 1166, succeeding his father Boson IV. In 1181 he answered the troubadour Bertran de Born’s call and joined the Aquitanian lords’ revolt against Richard the Lionheart; the rising was crushed and Hélie submitted in 1182. When Richard was imprisoned in Austria in 1192, he rebelled again, allied with King Philip Augustus and Count Raymond V of Toulouse, but ducal forces under the seneschal Elias de la Celle defeated him once more. His last charter, for Chancelade Abbey, dates to 1203–1204; his son Hélie VII succeeded.
zh: 埃利六世·塔列朗（约1136—1203）自1166年继父博松四世之位，成为佩里戈尔伯爵。1181年，他响应行吟诗人贝尔特朗·德·博恩的号召，加入阿基坦诸侯反对狮心王理查的叛乱；起事很快被平定，埃利于1182年被迫臣服。1192年理查被奥地利囚禁期间，他联合法王腓力·奥古斯都和图卢兹伯爵雷蒙五世再次起兵，又被公爵麾下总管埃利·德·拉塞尔率军击败。他最后一份给尚斯拉德修道院的特许状作于1203—1204年，其子埃利七世继位。

en: Hélie VII Talleyrand (c. 1150–c. 1209) succeeded his father Hélie VI as count of Périgord around 1203–1204. In May 1204 he travelled to Rouen and swore liege homage to King Philip Augustus of France, ending the county’s long vassalage to the dukes of Aquitaine; John Lackland accepted the change only in 1214. He married Marguerite, daughter of Viscount Adémar V of Limoges, and their son Archambaud II, who first appears in documents in 1212, did homage for the county to the French king that same year.
zh: 埃利七世·塔列朗（约1150—约1209）约在1203—1204年继父埃利六世之位，成为佩里戈尔伯爵。1204年5月，他前往鲁昂向法王腓力·奥古斯都行绝对臣服礼，就此结束伯国对阿基坦公爵长期的封臣依附，无地王约翰直到1214年才承认这一变更。他娶利摩日子爵阿代马尔五世之女玛格丽特为妻，两人的儿子阿尔尚博二世最早于1212年见于文书，也正是在这一年他为伯国向法王行臣服礼。

en: Hélie VIII (c. 1210/1215–1247/1251) succeeded his father Archambaud II as count of Périgord in 1239. In 1245 he confirmed his father’s grant of the castellany of Grignols to their kinsman Boson Talleyrand, founder of the Talleyrand-Périgord line. The long quarrel over the town of Périgueux ended in 1246, when the king enfranchised the townsmen and freed them from all payments to the counts. By his wife Gaillarde, a kinswoman of King James I of Aragon, he left a son, Archambaud III, who succeeded him.
zh: 埃利八世（约1210/1215—1247/1251）于1239年继父阿尔尚博二世之位，成为佩里戈尔伯爵。1245年，他确认父亲把格里尼奥勒城堡领赐给亲族博松·塔列朗的决定，后者开创了塔列朗-佩里戈尔支系。围绕佩里格城的长期争执于1246年了结：国王颁布敕令授予市民自由，免除他们向伯爵缴纳的一切贡纳。他的妻子加亚尔德是阿拉贡国王海梅一世的亲族，两人生有继位的儿子阿尔尚博三世。

en: Roger-Bernard (c. 1299–1361), a younger son of Count Hélie IX and Brunissende of Foix, became Count of Périgord in 1334 when his childless brother Archambaud IV died; another brother, Hélie, had been made a cardinal in 1331. Until 1340 he contested the lordship of Bergerac with Mathe d’Albret, the wife of his late brother. In 1339 he married Éléonore, daughter of Bouchard VI of Vendôme. With the Hundred Years’ War, Périgord came under repeated attack: the Earl of Derby raided it in 1345, and in 1356 the Black Prince entered Périgueux unopposed, on the ride that ended at Poitiers with King John II’s capture. The Treaty of Brétigny in 1360 put the county under English sovereignty. Roger-Bernard died the next year, and his son Archambaud V succeeded him.
zh: 罗歇·贝尔纳·德·佩里戈尔（约1299—1361）是埃利九世伯爵与布鲁妮桑德·德·富瓦较年幼的儿子。1334年，无嗣而终的兄长阿尚博四世去世，他继任佩里戈尔伯爵；另一位兄弟埃利早在1331年已被擢为枢机。直到1340年，他都在同已故兄长的妻子马特·德·阿尔布雷争夺贝尔热拉克领地。1339年，他娶旺多姆的布沙尔六世之女埃莱奥诺尔为妻。百年战争爆发后，佩里戈尔屡遭进攻：1345年德比伯爵纵兵劫掠；1356年黑太子未遇抵抗便进入佩里格，这次骑行最终在普瓦捷以法王约翰二世被俘告终。1360年《布雷蒂尼条约》使佩里戈尔转归英国主权之下。次年，罗歇·贝尔纳去世，其子阿尚博五世继位。

en: Giovanni Malatesta, called Gianciotto or lo Sciancato, the Lame, (c. 1245–1304) was the second son of Malatesta da Verucchio of Rimini. From 1265 he fought in Romagna in his father's wars against Guido da Montefeltro's Ghibellines and helped rule Rimini for the Papal State. In 1285 he found his wife Francesca da Polenta in the arms of his brother Paolo and killed them both, the murder Dante placed in the fifth canto of Inferno. After the Malatesta were expelled from Rimini in 1288, he served five times as podestà of Pesaro, where he died in 1304.
zh: 乔凡尼·马拉泰斯塔，人称“詹乔托”，又号“跛子”（约1245—1304），是里米尼的马拉泰斯塔·达·韦鲁基奥的次子。1265年起，他随父在罗马涅征战，对抗圭多·达·蒙泰费尔特罗率领的吉伯林派，并协助父亲代表教皇国治理里米尼。1285年，他撞见妻子弗朗切丝卡·达·波伦塔与弟弟保罗相拥，亲手将二人杀死，但丁把这桩谋杀写入《神曲·地狱篇》第五章。1288年马拉泰斯塔家族被逐出里米尼后，他五度出任佩萨罗行政长官，1304年卒于该城。

en: Philibert Orry, comte de Vignory (1689–1747), was a French administrator and the longest-serving finance minister of his century. Born in Troyes, the son of the economist Jean Orry, he was a cavalry captain in the War of the Spanish Succession before serving as an intendant. Appointed controller-general in 1730, he restored the dixième tax, fostered textiles and the Vincennes porcelain works, and balanced the budget in 1739–1740. He reformed the statutes of the Company of the Indies to support trade. From 1736 he also ran the king's buildings, founded the Paris Salon, and built France's road network through the corvée. In 1738 he instructed intendants to require inhabitants to work two weeks a year on roads. Madame de Pompadour's hostility forced his resignation in 1745.
zh: 菲利贝尔·奥里，维尼奥里伯爵（1689—1747），是法国大臣，也是那个世纪在任最久的财政总监。他生于特鲁瓦，父亲是经济学家让·奥里，曾在西班牙王位继承战争中任骑兵上尉，之后担任地方督办。1730年，他被任命为财政总监，恢复十分之一税，扶持纺织业和万塞讷瓷器工场，并于1739—1740年实现预算平衡。他改革印度公司章程以支持贸易。1736年起他又兼管王室建筑，创立巴黎沙龙展，并以王家劳役修筑法国公路网。1738年，他指示地方督办要求居民每年服役两周修路。在蓬帕杜夫人的敌视下，他于1745年去职。

en: Philipp Apian (1531–1589), born Philipp Bienewitz in Ingolstadt, was a mathematician, physician and cartographer, the son of Peter Apian. He began studying mathematics at Ingolstadt aged eleven and later studied in Burgundy and France. He succeeded his father as professor of mathematics at Ingolstadt in 1552. In 1554 Duke Albert V of Bavaria commissioned him to survey the duchy; after seven summers in the field he completed a huge map in 1563, followed in 1568 by the 24-sheet Bairische Landtafeln, the first detailed atlas of a European country. A Protestant, he left Ingolstadt in 1569 amid the Counter-Reformation and lost his Tübingen chair in 1583 for refusing to condemn Calvinism.
zh: 菲利普·阿皮安（1531—1589），本名菲利普·比内维茨，生于英戈尔施塔特，是数学家、医生与制图家，彼得·阿皮安之子。他十一岁起在英戈尔施塔特学习数学，后来又赴勃艮第和法国求学。1552年他继父之位任英戈尔施塔特大学数学教授。1554年，巴伐利亚公爵阿尔布雷希特五世委托他测绘公国；他用七个夏天实地勘测，于1563年绘成一幅巨型地图，又在1568年推出24幅分图组成的《巴伐利亚地图集》——欧洲第一部精确描绘单个国家的专用地图集。作为新教徒，他于1569年在反宗教改革中离开英戈尔施塔特，1583年因拒绝谴责加尔文宗而被解除蒂宾根大学的教职。

en: Phraya Kham Lue was an early-fourteenth-century prince of Phayao, a Tai Yuan kingdom. The local legend of Phrathat Chom Khiri names him as the son of Phraya Kham Daeng, to whom King Ngammueang handed the rule of Phayao, and grandson of Ngammueang, placing the prince around 1305. Tradition relates that while hunting in the Phayao hills he pursued a golden stag far across the border into Chiang Rai.
zh: 披耶坎鲁是14世纪初傣阮人王国帕尧的王子。帕塔宗给的地方传说称他是披耶坎登之子、帕尧王披耶昂孟之孙——昂孟晚年将帕尧政务交给坎登；传说将坎鲁的年代定于约1305年。相传他在帕尧山林狩猎时，追逐一头金色雄鹿远入清莱境内。

en: Catherine de la Tour du Pin (c. 1290–1337) was a daughter of Humbert I, Dauphin of Viennois. In 1312 she married Philip I of Savoy-Achaia, lord of Piedmont and prince of Achaea, and bore him eleven children. Her eldest son James succeeded Philip as lord of Piedmont in 1334. Several sons entered the Church, among them Edward, later Archbishop of Tarentaise, and Thomas, who became bishop of Turin and Aosta. Her daughter Beatrice married Humbert VI of Thoire and Villars in 1334, while other daughters married into the houses of Saluzzo and Poitiers. Catherine died in 1337.
zh: 凯瑟琳·德·拉图尔迪潘（约1290—1337）是维埃纳多菲内领主安贝尔一世之女。1312年，她嫁给皮埃蒙特领主兼亚该亚亲王菲利波一世，共育有十一名子女。长子贾科莫于1334年承袭父位成为皮埃蒙特领主；数名儿子进入教会，其中爱德华后来担任塔朗泰斯大主教，托马斯成为都灵和奥斯塔主教。女儿贝阿特丽斯于1334年嫁给图瓦和维拉尔领主安贝尔六世，其他女儿则嫁入萨卢佐和普瓦捷家族。凯瑟琳于1337年去世。

en: Pierre Boaistuau (c. 1517–1566) was a French humanist writer, translator and compiler born in Nantes and trained in civil and canon law at Poitiers, Valence and Avignon. Around 1550 he served the French ambassador Jean-Jacques of Cambrai and travelled through Italy and Germany, later visiting England and Scotland and meeting Elizabeth I. His Théâtre du monde appeared in 1558, and he was the first editor of Marguerite of Navarre's nouvelles, later the Heptaméron. His Histoires tragiques of 1559 translated six tales by Bandello, including Romeo and Juliet, which reached Shakespeare through English adaptations including Arthur Brooke's poem. Boaistuau introduced the tragic and prodigious tale as literary genres in France. He died in Paris in 1566.
zh: 皮埃尔·博瓦斯蒂奥（约1517—1566）是法国人文主义作家、翻译家和编纂者，生于南特，曾在普瓦捷、瓦朗斯和阿维尼翁学习民法与教会法。约1550年，他为法国驻东方使节让-雅克·德·康布雷效力，游历意大利和德意志，后来还访问英格兰与苏格兰、觐见过伊丽莎白一世。他的《世界剧场》于1558年问世，并首次编订了纳瓦拉的玛格丽特的短篇故事集，即后世所称的《七日谈》。1559年出版的《悲剧故事》翻译了班戴洛的六篇小说，其中包括《罗密欧与朱丽叶》；这一故事经阿瑟·布鲁克的长诗等英文改写传到了莎士比亚那里。博瓦斯蒂奥把悲剧故事和奇异故事两种文学体裁引入法国。1566年他在巴黎去世。

en: Pietro Perugino (c. 1446–1523), born Pietro Vannucci at Città della Pieve, was the leading painter of the Umbrian Renaissance. Trained in Florence in Andrea del Verrocchio's workshop alongside Leonardo da Vinci, he was enrolled as a master by 1472. Summoned to Rome in 1479, he led the team of painters, including Botticelli and Ghirlandaio, that decorated the new Sistine Chapel from 1481, contributing the Delivery of the Keys. In Perugia he frescoed the Collegio del Cambio between 1496 and 1500, depicting the planets, classical figures and his own portrait. The humanist Francesco Maturanzio advised him on the scheme. He trained Raphael, his most famous pupil, and died of plague at Fontignano in 1523.
zh: 彼得罗·佩鲁吉诺（约1446—1523）原名彼得罗·万努奇，生于翁布里亚的皮耶韦城，是翁布里亚文艺复兴画派的代表画家。他在佛罗伦萨安德烈亚·德尔·韦罗基奥的作坊学艺，与列奥纳多·达·芬奇同窗，1472年已登记为画师。1479年他应召前往罗马，1481年起率领包括波提切利和吉兰达约在内的画师团队装饰新建的西斯廷礼拜堂，《交付钥匙》即出自其手。1496至1500年，他在佩鲁贾为汇兑行会大厅绘制湿壁画，画中有行星、古代人物及他的自画像；人文主义者弗朗切斯科·马图兰齐奥为这一方案提供建议。他最著名的学生是拉斐尔，1523年他在丰蒂尼亚诺死于鼠疫。

en: Atula Maha Dhamma Dewi (born c. 1295), whose personal name was Saw Min Ya, was the chief queen consort of King Uzana I of Pinya. A daughter of King Kyawswa of Pagan, Pagan's last reigning king, and Queen Saw Soe, she was Uzana's half-sister by the same father. When Uzana took the Pinya throne in 1325, as the kingdom divided between Pinya and Sagaing, she became his chief queen and held that position until 1340. Her sons Sithu Min Oo and Thihapate were princes of Pinya, and she was a paternal aunt of King Swa Saw Ke of Ava.
zh: 阿杜拉·马哈·达马·代维（约1295年生），本名绍敏雅，是彬牙国王乌者那一世的正宫王后。她是蒲甘末代国王觉苏瓦与王后绍索之女，与乌者那为同父异母的兄妹。1325年王国分裂为彬牙与实皆，乌者那登上彬牙王位，她成为正宫王后，直至1340年。所生之子悉都敏乌与蒂哈巴泰都是彬牙王子，她也是阿瓦国王斯伐修寄的姑母。

en: Atula Sanda Dewi, whose personal name was Nan Lon Me, was born a Pagan princess around 1312. Her grandfather Kyawswa, a king of Pagan, was forced to abdicate by the three Myinsaing brothers in December 1297, and her father Saw Hnit then governed Pagan for them as viceroy until 1325. She became the chief queen consort of Kyawswa I, who ruled Pinya from 1344 to 1350. Her three sons Uzana II, Kyawswa II and Narathu each succeeded to the Pinya throne and were the kingdom's last three kings before Pinya fell in 1364. She died around 1357, before the dynasty's end.
zh: 阿杜拉·山达·代维本名南隆梅，约1312年生，是蒲甘公主。她的祖父蒲甘国王觉苏瓦于1297年12月被敏象三兄弟逼迫退位，父亲苏涅随后在他们的宗主权下出任蒲甘总督，直到1325年。她成为彬牙国王觉苏瓦一世的首席王后，觉苏瓦一世于1344至1350年在位。她的三个儿子乌兹那二世、觉苏瓦二世与那腊都相继登上彬牙王位，是该王国在1364年灭亡前的末代三王。她约于1357年去世，没有看到王朝的终结。

en: Kyaswa (1198–1251) ruled the Pagan kingdom of Burma from 1235, succeeding his father Htilominlo. A devout Buddhist scholar, he left most administration to his son Uzana and devoted himself to religious writing and patronage of orthodox Theravada monks. His peaceful reign saw the royal treasury drained by vast tax-free monastic estates; his attempt to reclaim land from forest-dwelling monks was reversed under public pressure. The treasury struggled to complete a temple, and Kyaswa refused to use forced labour in building temples. His Pyathada Temple at Pagan was smaller than many built by his predecessors. In 1249 he had stone edicts erected in the empire's villages ordering humane punishments and banning the impaling of thieves. He died in 1251.
zh: 加苏瓦（1198—1251）于1235年继承父亲梯罗明罗，成为缅甸蒲甘王朝国王。他是虔诚的佛教学者，把大部分政务交给王子乌兹那，自己潜心著述佛法、护持正统上座部僧团。他在位时天下大体太平，但免税的寺院领地日广，王室府库空虚；他试图收回森林僧团的土地，却迫于舆论作罢。王室财力已难以建成一座寺庙，加苏瓦又不愿征发劳役建寺。他在蒲甘修建的比亚达寺比许多前代寺庙规模都小。1249年，他下令在帝国各村勒石立敕，规定宽和用刑，禁止将盗贼刺穿处死。加苏瓦于1251年去世。

en: Kyawswa I (1299–1350), called Nga-zi Shin or Lord of the Five White Elephants, was king of Pinya from 1344 to 1350. The elder son of Thihathu and the Pagan princess Mi Saw U, he ranked second in line behind his half-brother Uzana, whose Pagan blood came from both parents. Governor of Pinle, the family's base, from 1313, he was beaten back by Saw Yun at Sagaing in 1316; after Uzana took the throne in 1325 he built up his own power at Pinle while the southern vassals drifted toward independence. In 1340 he refused Uzana's repeated demands for his five rare white elephants, and Uzana abdicated to become a monk. Kyawswa called himself king by 1342 and took over formally in 1344. He raised cavalry and shield infantry and tended the Kyaukse granary, and his reign was largely peaceful, though Toungoo obeyed in name only. He died suddenly in 1350 and became the nat Nga-zi Shin.
zh: 觉苏瓦一世（1299—1350），号称迦悉信，意为五白象王，1344至1350年为彬牙国王。他是梯诃都与蒲甘公主弥修乌的长子，在继承顺位上排在同母异父的兄长乌兹那之后，因为乌兹那父母两系都出自蒲甘王室。他自1313年起出任家族根据地宾里的总督，1316年被实皆的苏云击退；1325年乌兹那即位后，他在宾里拥兵自重，南方诸侯渐成独立之势。1340年，他拒绝交出稀有的五头白象，乌兹那多次索要无果，出家为僧。觉苏瓦1342年已自称国王，1344年正式接掌王国。他组建骑兵与持盾步兵，经营皎施粮仓，在位期间大体太平，只是东吁仅在名义上臣服。1350年他猝然去世，死后被奉为缅甸神灵迦悉信。

en: Kyawswa (1260–1299) became king of Pagan in 1289 with the support of the dowager queen Pwa Saw, after the collapse that followed his father Narathihapate's murder. He had governed Dala since 1285. His rule barely reached beyond Pagan city, while real power in the Kyaukse granary belonged to the three Myinsaing brothers, whom he recognised as viceroys in 1293. To counter them he sent his son Theingapati to the Yuan and received Mongol recognition as a vassal king in March 1297. That December the brothers invited him to a monastery dedication at Myinsaing, then seized him and forced him into monkhood. They executed him on 10 May 1299.
zh: 觉苏瓦（1260—1299）的父亲那腊底哈勃德遇害、蒲甘帝国崩溃后，他获太后婆娑支持，于1289年即位，此前他自1285年起任达拉总督。他的号令不出蒲甘城一带，皎施粮仓的实权握于敏象三兄弟之手，他在1293年承认三人为总督。为与之抗衡，他派儿子信合八的出使元朝，于1297年3月获元朝承认为藩属缅王。同年12月，三兄弟邀请他到敏象参加寺院落成典礼，随后将他拘捕，逼他剃度出家，并于1299年5月10日将他处死。

en: Kyawswa II (1328–1359), Lord of the Four White Elephants after the animals he inherited from his father, was king of Pinya from December 1350. A younger son, he had been made heir over his elder brother Uzana, whose legs were paralysed. His authority scarcely reached beyond the Kyaukse granary; Prome and Toungoo were nearly independent. Pressure from the north shaped his reign. Mong Mao, whose ruler Tho Kho Bwa had driven back three Mongol expeditions between 1342 and 1348, was turning on Sagaing, and in 1351 Kyawswa readily accepted a truce proposed by envoys from Sagaing, Pinya's rival since 1315. In 1358–59 Toungoo raided Kyaukse while Maw Shans broke through Sagaing's territory into Pinya. Kyawswa died in March 1359 during the raids, childless; his brother Narathu succeeded him. A week earlier, on 12 March, he had issued a decree ordering checks on tax-free religious lands, Burma's earliest recorded land survey.
zh: 觉苏瓦艾（1328—1359）即觉苏瓦二世，因继承父亲的四头白象而被称为“四白象王”莱悉信，1350年12月继位为彬牙国王。他是次子，因兄长乌兹那腿部瘫痪，被父亲立为王储。他的号令仅及皎施粮仓，卑谬、东吁近乎独立。北方的压力左右了他的一朝：麓川首领思可法在1342至1348年间三度击退蒙古人的远征，转而进逼实皆；1351年，实皆使者提出休战，觉苏瓦艾欣然接受，彬牙与这个自1315年以来的宿敌首次携手。1358至1359年，东吁劫掠皎施，木掸军又突破实皆领土攻入彬牙。他于1359年3月在战乱中去世，没有子嗣，王位由弟弟那腊都继承。一周前的3月12日，他颁布敕令，命人核查免税宗教地产，这是缅甸已知最早的土地调查记录。

en: Mi Saw U was a princess of Pagan, daughter of Narathihapate, the last sovereign king of that dynasty, and her life turned on its collapse. She was first married to her half-brother Kyawswa of Pagan. In December 1297 Thihathu of Myinsaing overthrew Kyawswa and seized her, pregnant with Kyawswa's son Uzana, making her his chief queen. Eager to pass as Pagan's rightful heir, Thihathu raised Uzana as his own child and named him heir apparent, while her son by Thihathu, Kyawswa, became governor of Pinle in 1313. Both sons went on to rule Pinya as kings. Her youngest son Nawrahta quarrelled with Kyawswa and defected to Sagaing around 1349.
zh: 弥修乌是蒲甘公主，末代国王那腊底哈勃德之女，她的一生随蒲甘王朝的覆亡而转折。她最初嫁给异母兄蒲甘国王觉苏瓦。1297年12月，敏象的梯诃都推翻觉苏瓦，夺走了怀着觉苏瓦之子乌兹那的她，立为王后。梯诃都急于以蒲甘正统继承人自居，把乌兹那收为己子并立为王储；她与梯诃都所生的儿子觉苏瓦，则在1313年受任宾里总督。两个儿子后来相继成为彬牙国王。她的幼子那罗多与觉苏瓦不和，约于1349年投奔实皆王国。

en: Mway Medaw (born c. 1297) was a queen consort of King Kyawswa I of Pinya, styled the Queen of the Northern Palace and ranked as one of his two principal queens. A princess of Pagan royal blood, she was the youngest child of King Kyawswa of Pagan and Queen Saw Soe, and a paternal aunt of King Swa Saw Ke of Ava. Her children included Min Letwe of Pinle and Saw Min Hla of Nyaungyan. Her husband Kyawswa I ruled Pinya from 1344 until his sudden death in 1350.
zh: 梅梅杜（约1297年生）是彬牙国王憍苴的王后，封号北宫王后，位列他的两位正宫王后之一。她出身蒲甘王室，是蒲甘国王觉苏瓦与王后绍索最幼的孩子，也是阿瓦国王斯伐修寄的姑母。她的子女有宾莱的敏莱特韦和娘彦的绍敏拉。其夫憍苴于1344年起统治彬牙，1350年暴卒。

en: Narathihapate (1238–1287), last king of the Pagan Empire, reigned from 1256, when Minister Yazathingyan placed him over his half-brother Thihathu. He exiled Yazathingyan soon after his accession, but recalled him to crush revolts in Martaban and Arakan. Growing tax-free religious estates had long drained the treasury, yet Narathihapate built the Mingalazedi Pagoda with forced labour. In the Mongol invasions of 1277–1287 he fled Pagan for Lower Burma in 1285, earning the byname 'Taruk-Pyay Min', king who fled the Chinese. He submitted to Kublai Khan in January 1287, and that July his son Thihathu, Viceroy of Prome, forced him to take poison, after which the empire broke apart.
zh: 那腊底哈勃德（1238—1287）是蒲甘王朝末代国王，1256年大臣耶娑梯犍撇开他的异母兄梯伽都，把他扶上王位。他即位不久便流放耶娑梯犍，后来又召回他平定马都八与阿腊干的叛乱。不断扩大的免税宗教地产长期消耗着王室府库，那腊底哈勃德仍征发民力修建弥伽罗佛塔。1277至1287年元军入侵期间，他于1285年弃蒲甘南逃下缅甸，得号“德由披敏”，意为畏中国人而逃的国王。1287年1月他向忽必烈乞降，同年7月在卑谬被镇守当地的儿子底哈都逼迫服毒而死，蒲甘帝国随之瓦解。

en: Narathu (c. 1333–1364?) ruled Pinya from 1359, succeeding his brother Kyawswa II, and was crowned in June 1360. Toungoo had rebelled and raided Kyaukse, and Narathu lacked the strength to control his vassals. He abandoned Pinya's alliance with Sagaing and, after Mong Mao Shans raided deep into his lands in 1362–1363, took the junior role under their ruler Tho Kho Bwa in a joint attack on Sagaing. His blockade of the Irrawaddy failed, allowing Sagaing's royalty to escape when the Shans sacked the city in April 1364. Dissatisfied with Pinya's performance, Tho Kho Bwa then sacked Pinya that May, carrying Narathu and his white elephants off to the Shan country. Narathu is remembered as Maw-Pa Min, the king taken to the Maw land.
zh: 那腊都（约1333—1364?）于1359年继兄长觉苏瓦艾之后成为彬牙国王，1360年6月加冕。东吁已经叛乱并劫掠皎施，那腊都无力控制属臣。他放弃了与实皆的同盟；1362至1363年麓川掸军深入劫掠彬牙后，他甘居次位，与麓川首领思可法结盟合攻实皆。彬牙军对伊洛瓦底江水道的封锁形同虚设，1364年4月实皆陷落时，王室得以逃脱。思可法嫌彬牙作战不力，随即回师，于5月洗劫彬牙，把那腊都连同他的白象带回麓川。他因此被称为“毛巴敏”，即被掳往木掸之地的国王。

en: Nawrahta of Kanni (b. 1300) was the youngest son of King Thihathu of Pinya and his chief queen Mi Saw U. On 7 February 1313 his father enfeoffed him with the town of Shisha. When the Myinsaing kingdom split into Pinya and Sagaing in 1315, he stayed with his father's Pinya side through the reigns of Uzana I and the regent Sithu. In March 1344 his brother Kyawswa took the throne and made him governor of Pinle, the family's ancestral base, but the two soon became rivals. In 1349 Nawrahta fled west to Sagaing, where his nephew Nawrahta Minye had just become king and made him governor of Kanni. Later chronicles trace King Bayinnaung of the Toungoo dynasty back to him as a maternal great-great-great-grandfather.
zh: 甘尼的那罗多（1300年生）是彬牙王梯诃都与王后弥修乌最小的儿子。1313年2月7日，父亲将希沙城封给他。1315年敏象王国分裂为彬牙与实皆两支，他仍站在父亲的彬牙一边，历经乌兹那一世与摄政悉都两朝。1344年3月，兄长觉苏瓦继位，任命他为家族故地宾里的总督，两人很快成了对手。1349年，那罗多西逃实皆，当时他的侄子那罗多弥夷刚刚称王，任命他为甘尼总督。后世编年史把东吁王朝国王勃印曩的世系追溯到他，称他是勃印曩的外高高祖。

en: Saw Hnit (1283–1325) was viceroy of Pagan from 1297 to 1325 under the suzerainty of the Myinsaing kingdom. A son of King Kyawswa of Pagan, he was placed on the throne by the three Myinsaing brothers Athinkhaya, Yazathingyan and Thihathu after they forced his father to abdicate in December 1297. Though styled king of Pagan, his authority reached only the lands around the city. He gave his first audience on 8 May 1299, two days before the brothers executed the deposed Kyawswa. On his death in 1325 his son Uzana succeeded him.
zh: 苏涅（1283—1325）于1297年至1325年担任蒲甘总督，臣服于敏象王国。他是蒲甘国王觉苏瓦之子。1297年12月，敏象三兄弟阿丁克亚、亚扎丁坚和底哈都逼迫觉苏瓦退位，立苏涅为名义上的蒲甘国王，其实际权力仅及蒲甘城周边地区。1299年5月8日他首次接见臣属，两天后三兄弟处死了被废的觉苏瓦。1325年苏涅去世，其子吾者那继任蒲甘总督。

en: Saw Pa Oh was a queen consort of King Kyaswa of Sagaing and a daughter of King Uzana I of Pinya. Before taking the Sagaing throne in 1339, Kyaswa had spent three years in exile at Mindon in Pinya territory. His marriage to Saw Pa Oh sealed peace between the long-rival sister kingdoms, and the peace held even after Uzana I was driven from power by Kyawswa I of Pinya in 1340–1344. Her daughter by Kyaswa, Saw Sala, became a queen of King Uzana II of Pinya.
zh: 绍巴奥是实皆国王加苏瓦的王后、彬牙国王乌者那一世之女。加苏瓦于1339年登上实皆王位之前，曾在彬牙境内的敏东流亡三年。他与绍巴奥成婚，使长期对峙的姊妹之邦议和；即便乌者那一世在1340—1344年间被憍苴逼迫下台，两国之间的和平仍得以维持。她与加苏瓦的女儿绍莎拉后来成为彬牙国王乌者那二世的王后。

en: Saw Pale was duchess of Taungdwin and the only daughter of King Thihathu of Pinya and Queen Yadanabon, a commoner-born concubine raised to queen after Pale's birth. Her elder brother Saw Yun became king of Sagaing. In 1317 Thihathu married her to Thihapate I, governor of Taungdwin, a match that ended the governor's planned rebellion. Her son Saw Hnaung later rose to be a leading general under King Swa Saw Ke of Ava.
zh: 梭巴列是东敦因总督夫人，彬牙国王梯诃都与王后婭達娜邦唯一的女儿；其母本是平民出身的妃子，在她出生后被父亲立为王后。她的兄长修雲后来成为实皆国王。1317年，梯诃都将她嫁给东敦因总督蒂哈巴泰一世，借此平息了这位总督图谋的叛乱。她的儿子梭瑙后来在阿瓦国王斯伐修寄麾下升任主将。

en: Saw Soe (1250–1334) was a principal queen consort of King Kyawswa of the Pagan dynasty of Burma. She was the daughter of Yazathingyan, chief minister and commander-in-chief of the Pagan army, and his wife Saw Khin Htut. The royal chronicles name her Kyawswa's chief queen, although modern historians give that position to Saw Thitmahti. Her children included Saw Hnit, viceroy of Pagan, Min Shin Saw, governor of Thayet, and queens of Pinya and Sagaing, and she was grandmother of King Swa Saw Ke of Ava.
zh: 绍索（1250—1334）是缅甸蒲甘王朝国王觉苏瓦的主要王后之一。她是蒲甘首席大臣兼军队统帅耶娑梯犍与妻子苏钦突之女。王室编年史将她记为觉苏瓦的正宫王后，现代史家则认为正宫应是苏迪马蒂。她的子女包括蒲甘总督苏涅、德耶总督敏欣绍，以及彬牙和实皆的王后；她也是阿瓦国王明吉斯伐修寄的祖母。

en: Sithu Min Oo (born c. late 1310s) was the elder son of King Uzana I of Pinya and a longtime claimant to its throne. When Uzana took the throne in 1325 Sithu was technically heir presumptive, but he may never have been proclaimed heir apparent, and the chronicles record no governorship for him, while his younger brother Thihapate ruled Yamethin. He nonetheless survived the rise of Kyawswa I, the fall of Pinya in 1364 and the founding of Ava in 1365. King Swa Saw Ke of Ava, seeking his prestige, gave Sithu his daughter Minkhaung Medaw in marriage, and through that line Sithu became an ancestor of the Toungoo kings Mingyi Nyo, Tabinshwehti and Nanda.
zh: 悉都·敏乌（约1310年代后期生）是彬牙国王乌兹那一世的长子，长期宣称拥有彬牙王位。1325年父亲即位时，他按理是推定继承人，却可能从未被正式立为王储，编年史也没有记载他出任总督，弟弟梯诃波帝反倒受命出镇央米丁。尽管如此，他熬过了觉苏瓦一世掌权、1364年彬牙陷落与1365年阿瓦建国。阿瓦国王斯伐修寄为借重他的声望，把女儿明康美道嫁给了他；凭借这一血脉，悉都·敏乌成为东吁王朝国王明吉瑜、德彬瑞蒂和南达勃因的祖先。

en: Tarabya I (1297–1339) was king of Sagaing in central Burma from 1327 to 1336. He was the son of Queen Yadanabon by her first husband and was adopted by her consort King Thihathu of Pinya. When his maternal half-brother Saw Yun founded Sagaing in 1315, Tarabya joined him and became his deputy. He succeeded Saw Yun as king in 1327 and married the late king's widow Saw Hnaung. In 1336 his son Shwetaungtet deposed and imprisoned him. Tarabya escaped, had Shwetaungtet killed in 1339, but was himself executed by the chief minister Nanda Pakyan.
zh: 德勒帕耶基（1297—1339）是缅甸实皆王国国王，1327至1336年在位。他是王后娅达娜邦与前夫之子，被娅达娜邦的丈夫、彬牙王梯诃都收为养子。1315年同母异父的弟弟苏云兴建实皆城时，他前往投奔，成为苏云的副手。1327年苏云去世，他继位为王，并收继苏云的寡妻绍南。1336年，其子瑞当代将他废黜囚禁；1339年他发动政变杀死瑞当代，随后被首相南达巴坚处死。

en: The Burmese chronicles describe Theinkha Bo as a son of the sawbwa (chief) of Binnaka. After quarrelling with his elder brother, who had inherited the chieftainship, he left Binnaka and settled at Myinsaing, where in 1260 he married a woman from a wealthy family. His three sons Athinkhaya, Yazathingyan and Thihathu became commanders relied on by King Narathihapate of Pagan, and in 1297 founded the Myinsaing dynasty that replaced Pagan rule; his daughter married a son of the king. His descendants later ruled Pinya, Sagaing and Ava.
zh: 据缅甸编年史记载，帝因迦波是宾那卡绍巴（酋长）之子。兄长继任酋长后，他与兄长发生争执，被迫离开宾那卡，最终定居敏象，并于1260年娶当地富家女子为妻。他的三个儿子阿丁克亚、亚扎丁坚和底哈都成为蒲甘国王那腊底哈勃德倚重的军队统帅，并于1297年建立取代蒲甘统治的敏象王朝；女儿则嫁给国王之子。他的后裔后来统治彬牙、实皆和阿瓦。

en: Thihapate (c. 1318–c. 1351), also called Chauk-Hse Shin, the Lord of Sixty Elephants, was the second son of King Uzana I of Pinya. Uzana had held the throne since 1325 but never shook off his rival Kyawswa, and he came to rely on Thihapate rather than on his elder son Sithu Min Oo. In the late 1330s he made him governor of Yamethin, where Thihapate kept a standing force of sixty war elephants, eight hundred cavalry and a thousand infantry. When Kyawswa I drove Uzana from power between 1340 and 1344, Thihapate seriously weighed rebellion, but the governor of Nyaungyan would not join him. He submitted after Kyawswa sent a rare black stallion from Onbaung. The chronicles do not mention him again, and by 1351 Swa Saw Ke governed Yamethin, so Thihapate may have died or been removed from office.
zh: 梯诃波帝（约1318—约1351）是彬牙国王乌兹那一世的次子，别号乔塞信，意为“六十象主”。乌兹那1325年即位，却始终摆脱不了对手觉苏瓦，比起长子锡都敏乌，更倚重这个次子。1330年代末，他任命梯诃波帝为央米丁总督，梯诃波帝在当地常备六十头战象、八百骑兵和一千步兵。1340至1344年间，觉苏瓦一世把乌兹那逐下王位，梯诃波帝认真考虑过起兵，良渊总督却不肯同行；觉苏瓦送来一匹出自翁榜的罕见黑色骏马示好，他便归顺。此后编年史不再提及他。1351年央米丁已由斯伐修寄执掌，梯诃波帝可能已去世，或已被免职。

en: Thihathu (1265–1325) was the founder of Burma's Pinya Kingdom. The youngest of three brothers from Myinsaing, he helped drive back Mongol invasions in 1287 and 1300–1301, and the brothers overthrew King Kyawswa of Pagan in 1298, reducing Pagan to a puppet state. After proclaiming himself king in 1309, he pushed aside his brother Yazathingyan following their eldest brother's death in 1310 and became sole ruler of central Burma. In 1313 he moved his capital to Pinya, styling himself Pagan's successor. His adoption of Kyawswa's son Uzana as heir drove his own son Saw Yun to found rival Sagaing in 1315. Thihathu died in 1325, and Pinya and Sagaing became separate kingdoms.
zh: 梯诃都（1265—1325）是缅甸彬牙王国的建立者。他是敏象三兄弟中最年幼的一个，曾在1287年和1300—1301年协助击退元军进犯；1298年，三兄弟废黜蒲甘国王觉苏瓦，使蒲甘名存实亡。1309年他自立为王，长兄于1310年去世后，他排挤次兄亚扎丁坚，独掌缅甸中部。1313年他迁都彬牙，以蒲甘的继承者自居。他收养觉苏瓦之子乌兹那为王储，逼得亲子苏云于1315年另据实皆与之抗衡。梯诃都于1325年去世，彬牙与实皆随后分裂为两个王国。

en: Uzana I (1298–c. 1357) was king of Pinya in central Burma from 1325 to 1340. He was born to King Kyawswa of Pagan and Mi Saw U six months after his father's overthrow, and was adopted at birth by the usurper Thihathu, who had taken Mi Saw U. At his coronation at Pinya in 1313, Thihathu presented himself as heir to Pagan and named Uzana heir-apparent. When Thihathu died in 1325 the kingdom split in two. Uzana kept Pinya but could not retake Sagaing in the north, and his southernmost vassals were practically independent; Pinya did nothing when neighboring kingdoms attacked them. His real rival was his half-brother Kyawswa of Pinle, who held court a few miles away with his own army. When Kyawswa twice refused to hand over five rare white elephants, Uzana abdicated in 1340 and spent his remaining years as a monk at Mekkhaya.
zh: 乌兹那一世（1298—约1357）是缅甸彬牙王国国王，1325至1340年在位。他是蒲甘王觉苏瓦与弥修乌之子，生于父亲被废黜半年之后，出生即被夺走弥修乌的篡位者梯诃都收养。1313年梯诃都在彬牙加冕，以蒲甘正统继承人自居，并立乌兹那为王储。1325年梯诃都去世，王国一分为二。乌兹那据有彬牙，却无力收复北方的实皆，最南端的诸侯近乎独立，邻国进攻其领地时，彬牙也未出兵干预。他真正的对手是同母异父弟觉苏瓦，后者据守仅隔数英里的宾里，拥有自己的军队。觉苏瓦两次拒绝献上五头稀有的白象，乌兹那于1340年退位，晚年在梅卡亚出家为僧。

en: Uzana (1213–1256) ruled the Pagan kingdom of Burma from 1251 to 1256, though he had already held full royal authority during the devout reign of his father Kyaswa. He left the business of government to his chief minister Yazathingyan, preferring to drink and hunt elephants. In May 1256 he was accidentally trampled to death by an elephant while hunting near Dala. His death opened a brief succession struggle: his eldest son Thihathu claimed the throne, but Yazathingyan's court secured the crown by November for Narathihapate, Uzana's son by a concubine.
zh: 乌兹那（1213—1256）于1251年至1256年统治缅甸蒲甘王朝，而早在其父加苏瓦虔心礼佛之时，他便已总揽王权。他把治国实务交给首相耶娑梯犍，自己贪杯好猎象。1256年5月，他在达拉附近猎象时意外被象踩踏身亡。他死后旋即爆发短暂的王位之争：长子梯诃都争位，耶娑梯犍为首的朝臣却于11月把乌兹那庶妃所生之子那腊底哈勃德扶上王位。

en: Uzana II (c. 1324–1364), called Pyaung, was the eldest son of King Kyawswa I of Pinya and spent his life in the shadow of his younger brothers. He grew up in Pinle and moved to Pinya with his family in 1344. Because his legs were weak or crippled, his father chose his brother Kyawswa as heir; after Kyawswa became king, their brother Narathu ranked ahead of Uzana as well. In May 1364 the Mong Mao Shans sacked Pinya and carried Narathu off, and in June the court elected the long-overlooked Uzana king. He ruled in name only for three months, with little authority even around the capital. Sagaing, Pinya's rival since 1315, lay in ruins from the same raids, but its new king, his kinsman Thado Minbya, proved the abler leader. Seeing a chance to reunite central Burma, Thado Minbya crossed the Irrawaddy in September 1364, took Pinya without a fight and had Uzana put to death.
zh: 乌兹那比昂（约1324—1364）即乌兹那二世，是彬牙国王觉苏瓦一世的长子，一生都活在弟弟们的阴影里。他在宾里长大，1344年随家人迁往彬牙。由于他腿部无力或有残疾，父亲选了弟弟觉苏瓦为王储；觉苏瓦即位后，另一个弟弟那腊都又排在他之前。1364年5月，麓川掸军攻破彬牙，掳走那腊都，6月朝廷推举久被忽视的乌兹那为王。他只做了三个月的名义国王，连都城周边也没有多少权威。自1315年起与彬牙对立的实皆同样毁于这场劫掠，但它的新王、乌兹那的亲族德多明帕耶更有才干。德多明帕耶想趁机重新统一缅甸中部，1364年9月渡过伊洛瓦底江，兵不血刃攻取彬牙，随即将乌兹那处死。

en: Yadanabon (c. 1280–?) was a queen of Thihathu, who in 1298 had just founded the Myinsaing kingdom with his two elder brothers and would later rule Pinya in central Burma. The chronicles describe her as a commoner from the northern village of Linyin, a widow travelling south with her one-year-old child, whom Thihathu met on a hunting trip and took as a concubine. She bore his first son Saw Yun, who founded the rival kingdom of Sagaing in 1315, and a daughter Saw Pale, and was then raised to Queen of the Northern Palace. Her line outlasted Pinya's: she was the mother of Saw Yun and Tarabya I of Sagaing, and her descendants included Sagaing's later kings, Thado Minbya, founder of the Ava Kingdom, and Ava's chief queens Shin Bo-Me and Shin Myat Hla.
zh: 娅达娜邦（约1280年生）是梯诃都的王后之一。1298年，梯诃都刚与两位兄长建立敏象王国，后来成为缅甸中部彬牙王国的君主。编年史记载，她本是北方林因村的平民，身为寡妇的她带着一岁的孩子南行，遇上外出狩猎的梯诃都，被纳为妾。她生下梯诃都的长子苏云——1315年他建立了与彬牙对峙的实皆王国——又生下女儿苏佩莱，随后被立为北宫王后。她的血脉比彬牙存续得更久：她是实皆王苏云与德勒帕耶基一世之母，后裔中有实皆后来的几位国王、阿瓦王国的建立者他拖弥婆耶，以及阿瓦王后辛波梅和辛敏拉。

en: Adelasia was the wife of the Pisan leader Gherardo della Gherardesca, called Gaddo, who dominated Pisa from 1316 until his death in 1320. Her son Fazio Novello led the city in the 1320s–1330s, and her daughter Agostina married Guido Orsini, first count of Pitigliano.
zh: 阿德拉西娅是比萨贵妇，嫁与1316年起主政比萨、1320年暴卒的领袖盖拉尔多·“加多”·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡。其子法齐奥·诺韦洛在1320—1330年代继领比萨，女儿阿戈斯蒂娜嫁给第一代皮蒂利亚诺伯爵圭多·奥尔西尼。

en: Andrea Gambacorta (c. 1290–1351), head of a leading Pisan family of popolani, traded woollen cloth in Pisa. In 1325 he proposed measures to protect Pisan merchants competing with Genoa for Florentine freight, and in 1341 he brought the painter Taddeo Gaddi to decorate San Francesco church, where he was later buried. When Pisa's signore Ranieri Novello della Gherardesca died in 1347, the city's leading families split into two parties: the Bergolini, who took their name from the young count's nickname Bergo, and their rivals, whom they mocked as Raspanti for their greed. They fought in council and then in the streets, and Andrea, leader of the Bergolini, led the rising that drove the Raspanti chiefs out in December. He then dominated Pisa and subject Lucca until his death in 1351, ruling through the Anziani with his nephew Francesco. His son Pietro ruled Pisa from 1369.
zh: 安德烈亚·甘巴科尔塔（约1290—1351）是比萨平民望族的族长，在比萨经营毛织品贸易。1325年他提出措施，保护与热那亚人竞争佛罗伦萨货运的比萨商人；1341年他迎请画家塔代奥·加迪装饰圣方济各教堂，身后也葬在那里。1347年比萨统治者拉涅里·诺韦洛·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡去世后，城中望族分成两派：一派自称贝尔戈利尼，名字取自年轻伯爵的绰号“贝尔戈”；对手则被他们讥为拉斯潘蒂，意指其贪得无厌。双方先在议会中交锋，继而在街巷厮杀，贝尔戈利尼派首领安德烈亚于12月领导起义，将拉斯潘蒂派首领逐出城外。此后他左右比萨及臣服的卢卡，直至1351年去世；他依靠长老会议与侄子弗朗切斯科执政。其子彼得罗于1369年起统治比萨。

en: Bartolomeo Gambacorta was a son of Buonaccorso di Gherardo Gambacorta and a brother of the Bergolini leader Francesco. He was put to death in Pisa on 26 May 1355, together with Francesco and their brother Lotto, after Emperor Charles IV's arrival overturned the family's regime.
zh: 巴尔托洛梅奥·甘巴科尔塔是博纳科尔索·迪·盖拉尔多·甘巴科尔塔之子、贝尔戈利尼派领袖弗朗切斯科的兄弟。1355年皇帝查理四世驾临比萨、颠覆其家族政权后，他于5月26日与弗朗切斯科及兄弟洛托一同在比萨被处死。

en: Bernabò della Gherardesca was a Pisan nobleman, son of Count Ranieri della Gherardesca, il Vecchio, and Ginevra Doria. As count of Donoratico he held the family feuds in Sardinia's Sulcis; on his death his younger brother Gherardo inherited his title and estates.
zh: 贝尔纳博·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡是比萨贵族，伯爵拉涅里·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡（人称“长者”）与吉内芙拉·多里亚之子。他作为多诺拉蒂科伯爵，领有家族在撒丁岛苏尔奇斯地区的采邑；他去世后，头衔与封地由弟弟盖拉多继承。

en: Bertecca Castracani was a daughter of Castruccio Castracani, lord of Lucca, and Pina degli Streghi. In 1327 she married Bonifazio Novello, known as Fazio Novello della Gherardesca, the leading lord of Pisa, and was the mother of Emilia della Gherardesca, born at Pisa in 1328.
zh: 贝尔泰卡·卡斯特拉卡尼是卢卡领主卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼与皮娜·德利·斯特雷吉之女。1327年，她嫁给比萨的实际统治者博尼法乔·诺韦洛（人称法齐奥·诺韦洛）·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡；女儿艾米莉亚1328年生于比萨。

en: Buonaccorso Gambacorta, known as Coscio, was a Pisan merchant and politician, son of Vernaccio and brother of Gherardo, or Gaddo. In 1295 he joined a trading partnership in Sardinia whose ships carried cheese, wool, pepper and other goods. He first served among Pisa's elders in 1297 and held the office repeatedly until 1312. In 1309 he joined an embassy to Barcelona that proposed placing Pisa under King James II of Aragon, amid fears for the city's autonomy and Sardinian interests. He died in Pisa before 1330.
zh: 博纳科尔索·甘巴科尔塔，绰号“科肖”，是比萨商人兼政治家，韦尔纳乔之子、盖拉尔多（又名加多）的兄弟。1295年，他在撒丁岛加入贸易合伙，其船只运载奶酪、羊毛、胡椒等货物。他于1297年首次出任比萨长老，此后多次担任该职，直至1312年。1309年，比萨担忧城市自治与撒丁岛利益受到威胁，他随使团前往巴塞罗那，提议让比萨归属阿拉贡国王海梅二世。他于1330年前在比萨去世。

en: Coscio Gambacorta, son of Francesco of the Pisan Gambacorta family, was credited by a later account with leaving the estates of Alica and Montecchio to the Charterhouse of Pisa alongside his nephew Lotto in the late fourteenth century.
zh: 科肖·甘巴科尔塔是比萨甘巴科尔塔家族的弗兰切斯科之子；后世记载称，他与侄子洛托在14世纪末将阿利卡和蒙泰基奥的地产遗赠给比萨卡尔都西会修道院。

en: Eldizio Visconti was a 12th-century Pisan patrician of the Visconti family and consul of Pisa in 1184–1185. By a daughter of Torchitorio III, judge of Cagliari, he fathered Lamberto, first Visconti judge of Gallura, and Ubaldo, podestà of Pisa.
zh: 埃尔迪齐奥·维斯孔蒂是12世纪比萨维斯孔蒂家族贵族，1184—1185年任比萨执政官。他娶卡利亚里法官托尔基托里奥三世之女，生子兰贝托（加卢拉首任维斯孔蒂家族法官）与乌巴尔多（比萨市政长官）。

en: Emilia della Gherardesca was born in Pisa in the spring of 1328, the daughter of Bonifazio Novello della Gherardesca, called Fazio Novello, signore of Pisa, and his wife Bertecca Castracani. She became the second wife of Ugolino Gonzaga, co-lord of Mantua, whose first wife Verde della Scala had died in 1340. Emilia herself died at Mantua in 1349 and was buried in the city's Cathedral of San Pietro.
zh: 埃米莉亚·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡于1328年春生于比萨，是比萨领主博尼法齐奥·诺韦洛（即法齐奥·诺韦洛）与妻子贝尔泰卡·卡斯特拉卡尼之女。她嫁给曼托瓦共同统治者乌戈利诺·贡扎加为继室；其原配维尔德·德拉·斯卡拉已于1340年去世。埃米莉亚1349年卒于曼托瓦，葬于当地的圣彼得大教堂。

en: Bonifazio della Gherardesca, known as Fazio (c. 1250–1312), was a Pisan nobleman, a son of Gherardo della Gherardesca “il Vecchio” and Teodora of Montferrat. After Pisa overthrew the giudicato of Cagliari in 1258, his father gained Sardinian territory including the curatorie of Sulcis, Nora and Decimo, which passed to Bonifazio and his brother Ranieri after 1272–1282; their cousin Guelfo later seized them, but Pisan troops under Ranieri retook the region by storming Villa di Chiesa in 1295. Bonifazio served as a Pisan admiral and fought at the battle of Meloria in 1284. His son Gherardo was the father of Fazio Novello, later lord of Pisa.
zh: 博尼法乔·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡，人称法齐奥（约1250—1312），是比萨贵族，盖拉尔多·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡“长者”与蒙费拉托的特奥多拉之子。1258年比萨攻灭卡利亚里王国后，他的父亲获得撒丁岛上的领地，其中苏尔奇斯、诺拉和德奇莫辖区在1272—1282年之后传给博尼法乔与兄弟拉涅里；堂亲圭尔福后来强占这些地方，1295年拉涅里率比萨军队攻破基耶萨镇，收复该地区。博尼法乔曾任比萨海军将领，参加1284年的梅洛里亚海战。他的儿子盖拉尔多是后来的比萨领主法齐奥·诺韦洛之父。

en: Bonifazio Novello della Gherardesca, known as Fazio Novello (c. 1305–1340), was the only son of Gherardo Gaddo, count of Donoratico. In 1327 he was among those who accepted Emperor Louis the Bavarian as lord of Pisa; when imperial rule bred discontent, he led the revolt of 17 June 1329 that expelled the imperial vicar, Tarlato of Arezzo, and became captain of the mercenaries and captain general. That August he made peace with Florence and returned Pisa to obedience to Pope John XXII. In January 1332 he beat back a coup by exiles under the former bishop Gherardo Orlandi, and on 10 November 1335 he put down a rising of noble and popular houses, after which he was made captain of war and of the guard; a victory tower at the Ponte di Spina recalled the day. The Studium Pisano was founded in 1338 under his rule. He died on 22 December 1340, and his son Ranieri Novello took over Pisa.
zh: 博尼法齐奥·诺韦洛·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡，人称“法齐奥·诺韦洛”（约1305—1340），是多诺拉蒂科伯爵盖拉尔多·加多的独子。1327年，他是同意奉皇帝巴伐利亚的路易为比萨之主的人之一；皇帝治下民怨渐深，1329年6月17日，他领导公开起义，赶走皇帝的代理人阿雷佐的塔尔拉托，出任比萨雇佣队长官和总司令。同年8月，他与佛罗伦萨缔和，让比萨重新服从教皇约翰二十二世。1332年1月，他击退以前主教盖拉尔多·奥兰迪为首的流亡者发动的政变；1335年11月10日，又镇压贵族与平民望族的联合叛乱，随后获任战争与卫戍长官，斯皮纳桥头的胜利塔便是为纪念那一天而建。比萨学园于1338年在他治下正式设立。他于1340年12月22日去世，儿子拉涅里·诺韦洛接掌比萨。

en: Francesco Gambacorta (c. 1300–1355), son of Buonaccorso di Gherardo and nephew of Andrea, was a wealthy Pisan merchant who served five terms as an elder. In March 1348 he helped design the Massa delle Prestanze, which consolidated the commune's debts at a single ten percent rate, secured by iron revenues from Pisan-held Elba. After 1349 he oversaw the commune's mounted mercenaries, and when Andrea died in 1351 he inherited leadership of the Bergolini faction and shared power with his brothers. In March 1353 he and his brother Lotto helped secure the Peace of Sarzana between Florence and the Visconti. In 1355 their opponents blamed them for a revolt against Emperor Charles IV. Francesco was arrested, tortured and condemned; he was executed with his brothers on 26 May.
zh: 弗朗切斯科·甘巴科尔塔（约1300—1355）是博纳科尔索·迪·盖拉尔多之子、安德烈亚之侄，也是一位富有的比萨商人，曾五次担任长老。1348年3月，他参与设立“公债库”，把公社的各项债务统一为一成利息，并以比萨治下厄尔巴岛的铁矿收入作担保。1349年起，他主管公社的骑兵雇佣队；1351年安德烈亚去世，他接任贝尔戈利尼派首领，与兄弟共同掌权。1353年3月，他与兄弟洛托促成佛罗伦萨与维斯孔蒂之间的《萨尔扎纳和约》。1355年，他们的对手指责他们策划反对皇帝查理四世的叛乱。弗朗切斯科遭逮捕、拷问并被判死刑，5月26日与兄弟一同被处决。

en: Gherardo Gambacorta, also known as Gaddo, was a Pisan merchant and brother of Buonaccorso, called Coscio. In 1294 he lent 262 ounces of gold to Charles II of Anjou for expenses connected with a journey to Rome. He served among the elders of Pisa in 1297, following his brother's election earlier that year. The brothers held property around Pisa and in Sardinia and made loans together. Under Ranieri della Gherardesca's rule in 1321–1325, Gherardo and Buonaccorso were among the merchants charged with the largest forced loans.
zh: 杰拉尔多·甘巴科尔塔又称加多，是比萨商人、人称科肖的布翁纳科尔索之兄弟。1294年，他借给安茹的查理二世262盎司黄金，用于前往罗马的旅费。1297年，他继兄弟于当年早些时候当选之后出任比萨长老。兄弟二人在比萨周边及撒丁岛拥有产业，并共同放贷。1321—1325年拉涅里·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡统治比萨期间，杰拉尔多和布翁纳科尔索是被征收最多强制借款的商人之一。

en: Gherardo della Gherardesca, called Gaddo or il Giovane (c. 1284–1320), son of Bonifazio di Gherardo, was the Pisan popular leader who helped overthrow Uguccione della Faggiola. In April 1316 Pisa's mercantile families, with his backing, revolted against Uguccione's harsh signoria and drove him out, and Gherardo held the post of capitano del popolo from April to June. He then shaped city policy through the commissions of sapientes, held command of the commune's mounted mercenaries and later became general defender of the people. On 12 May 1317 his government made peace with the Tuscan Guelf cities at Naples under Robert of Anjou. He died suddenly in 1320; his uncle Ranieri Nieri took power and became guardian to Gherardo's underage son Bonifazio.
zh: 盖拉尔多·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡，绰号“加多”，又称“年轻者”（约1284—1320），博尼法齐奥·迪·盖拉尔多之子，是协助推翻乌古乔内·德拉·法焦拉的比萨平民派领袖。1316年4月，比萨商人世家在他支持下起义，赶走统治严酷的乌古乔内，盖拉尔多于4月至6月出任人民长官。此后他通过“贤者委员会”主导城邦决策，担任公社骑兵雇佣队长官，后来又任人民总保卫者。1317年5月12日，其政府在那不勒斯经安茹的罗伯特调停，与托斯卡纳的圭尔夫诸城议和。他于1320年暴卒，叔父拉涅里·涅里接掌权力，成为其未成年儿子博尼法齐奥的监护人。

en: Gherardo Gambacorta was a son of the Pisan merchant and political leader Andrea Gambacorta and a brother of Pietro, who later became lord of Pisa.
zh: 盖拉多·甘巴科尔塔是比萨商人和政治领袖安德烈亚·甘巴科尔塔之子，也是后来成为比萨领主的彼得罗的兄弟。

en: Gherardo della Gherardesca, called il Vecchio (1198–1268), was the tenth of his name in the great Ghibelline house of Pisa. He fought in Pisa's Sardinian war against the pro-Genoese giudicato of Cagliari and shared the partition after its capital Santa Igia fell in 1258, receiving the curatorie of Cixerri, Sulcis, Nora and Decimo with his kinsman Ugolino. From 1261 he campaigned in the wars between Pisa and Lucca. He then followed Conradin of Hohenstaufen against Charles I of Anjou, was captured at Tagliacozzo in 1268, and beheaded in Naples on 29 October.
zh: 盖拉尔多·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡，人称“老者”（1198—1268），是比萨显赫吉伯林家族中第十位同名者。他参加比萨在撒丁岛讨伐倒向热那亚的卡利亚里王国的战争，1258年其都城圣伊贾陷落后，与族人乌戈利诺瓜分其地，分得奇谢里、苏尔奇斯、诺拉与代奇莫四区。1261年起他投身比萨与卢卡的战争，后来追随霍亨斯陶芬家族的康拉丁对抗安茹的查理一世，1268年在塔利亚科佐战役中被俘，10月29日于那不勒斯被斩首。

en: Gherardo della Gherardesca was the youngest son of Count Ranieri della Gherardesca, il Vecchio, by his third wife Ginevra Doria. On his brother Bernabò's death he inherited the title count of Donoratico and the family feuds in Sardinia's Sulcis. In September 1353, early in the Sardo-Catalan war, Arborean commanders captured him and took him to Oristano, where Judge Mariano IV persuaded him to back Arborea. He died in Sardinia in January 1355, after which King Peter IV of Aragon sentenced him posthumously for treason and confiscated all his lands.
zh: 盖拉多·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡是伯爵拉涅里·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡（人称“长者”）与第三任妻子吉内芙拉·多里亚的幼子。兄长贝尔纳博死后，他袭得多诺拉蒂科伯爵头衔以及家族在撒丁岛苏尔奇斯的采邑。1353年9月撒丁—加泰罗尼亚战争初期，他被阿尔博雷亚的将领俘获、押往奥里斯塔诺，当地行政官马里亚诺四世说服他转投阿尔博雷亚。1355年1月他卒于撒丁岛，此后阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世以叛逆罪将他追判，并没收其全部领地。

en: Ginevra Doria was a Genoese noblewoman, daughter of Bernabò Doria, and the third wife of the Pisan leader Ranieri Nieri della Gherardesca. Her sons Bernabò and Gherardo in turn held the county of Donoratico and the family's Sulcis fiefs in Sardinia.
zh: 吉内芙拉·多里亚是热那亚贵妇，贝尔纳博·多里亚之女，比萨领袖拉涅里·“涅里”的第三任妻子。她所生的贝尔纳博与盖拉尔多兄弟先后领有多诺拉蒂科伯国及撒丁岛苏尔奇斯领地。
