en: Idana Guidi di Romeo was an Italian noblewoman of the Guidi family. She married Bernabò della Gherardesca, count of Donoratico and lord of the Sulcis in Sardinia, the elder son of the Pisan leader Ranieri Nieri della Gherardesca and Ginevra Doria.
zh: 伊达娜·圭迪·迪·罗梅奥出身圭迪家族，嫁给多诺拉蒂科伯爵、撒丁岛苏尔奇斯领地之主贝尔纳博·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡；他是比萨领袖拉涅里·“涅里”·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡与吉内芙拉·多里亚的长子。

en: Lotto Gambacorta was a Pisan merchant-noble of the pro-Florentine Gambacorti family. In 1355 he was massacred with the city's ruler Francesco Gambacorta and their kinsman Bartolomeo, when the anti-Florentine faction seized power during Emperor Charles IV's visit to Pisa.
zh: 洛托·甘巴科尔塔是比萨甘巴科尔塔家族成员，该家族主张与佛罗伦萨结盟。1355年，反佛罗伦萨派趁皇帝查理四世到访比萨时夺权，他与统治者弗兰切斯科·甘巴科尔塔及族人巴尔托洛梅奥一同遇害。

en: Ranieri della Gherardesca, called Nieri (c. 1252–1325), was a son of Gherardo il Vecchio, beheaded at Naples with Conradin in 1268. Forced to leave Pisa for Sardinia in 1285, he returned to the island in 1294 to lead a Pisan expedition, defeating the sons of his rival Ugolino in 1295. He hosted Emperor Henry VII at Pisa in 1313 and fought at Montecatini in 1315, where he had himself knighted over the body of Charles of Anjou, nephew of King Robert of Naples. After his nephew Gherardo il Giovane died suddenly in 1320, Ranieri took charge of Pisa as captain of the commune's mounted mercenaries and general defender of the people, ruling until his death on 13 December 1325.
zh: 拉涅里·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡，绰号“涅里”（约1252—1325），是1268年与康拉丁一同在那不勒斯被斩首的盖拉尔多“老者”之子。1285年他被迫离开比萨前往撒丁岛，1294年再赴该岛率领比萨远征军，于1295年击败对手乌戈利诺的儿子们。1313年他在比萨款待皇帝亨利七世，1315年参加蒙泰卡蒂尼战役，战后踏着那不勒斯国王罗伯特之侄安茹的查理的遗体受封骑士。1320年其侄盖拉尔多“年轻者”暴毙后，拉涅里以公社骑兵雇佣队长官和人民总保卫者的身份接掌比萨，统治直至1325年12月13日去世。

en: Pietro Gambacorti (1319–1392) was a Pisan nobleman, son of Andrea Gambacorta. In 1355 an uprising supported by Emperor Charles IV overthrew the regime of his kinsman Francesco, which was thought to lean too close to Florence, and the family was driven into exile. Pietro returned to Pisa with his family in 1369 and, first as capitano delle masnade and then as doge, governed the republic until 1392. On 21 October 1392 he was assassinated by Jacopo d'Appiano, hungry for power and acting in agreement with Gian Galeazzo Visconti of Milan; his sons Lorenzo and Benedetto were killed in the same conspiracy. Pietro had six sons in all. His daughter Chiara became a Dominican nun and was later beatified.
zh: 彼得罗·甘巴科尔塔（1319—1392）是比萨贵族，安德烈亚·甘巴科尔塔之子。1355年，一场得到皇帝查理四世支持的起义推翻了他的族人弗朗切斯科的政权，该政权被认为过于亲近佛罗伦萨，甘巴科尔塔家族被逐流亡。彼得罗于1369年携家人返回比萨，先任佣兵队长，后任执政，统治比萨共和国直至1392年。1392年10月21日，他遭觊觎权位的雅各布·达皮亚诺暗杀，后者与米兰的詹·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂暗中串通；其子洛伦佐与贝内代托也在同一阴谋中被杀。彼得罗共有六子。他的女儿基娅拉成为多明我会修女，后来受宣福。

en: Ranieri Novello della Gherardesca, also called Ranieri II, was the young son of Fazio Novello della Gherardesca, signore of Pisa. On his father's death he succeeded as count of Donoratico and ruled Pisa from 1341 to 1347 under the tutorship of Tinuccio della Rocca. He was the last of the Donoratico lords. He died suddenly in 1347, after which Andrea Gambacorta took power in the city.
zh: 拉涅里·诺韦洛·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡（即拉涅里二世）是比萨领主法齐奥·诺韦洛·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡的幼子。父亲死后他袭为多诺拉蒂科伯爵，1341—1347年在蒂努乔·德拉·罗卡的监护下统治比萨，是多诺拉蒂科一系的最后一位领主。1347年，他突然去世；此后安德烈亚·甘巴科尔塔在比萨掌权。

en: Tinuccio della Rocca was a Pisan nobleman and a trusted agent of the counts of Donoratico. In 1320 he acted for the young Bonifazio Novello della Gherardesca, and in 1326 secured the Aragonese king's confirmation of the count's Sardinian fiefs. After Bonifazio's death in 1340, Tinuccio became guardian to his son Ranieri Novello and governed Pisa in his name. He helped capture Lucca in 1342, but a later war with the Visconti brought devastation and heavier taxes. Following Ranieri's sudden death in 1347, Tinuccio's opponents rose against him; his house was burned and he fled to Volterra.
zh: 蒂努乔·德拉·罗卡是比萨贵族，也是多诺拉蒂科伯爵的亲信代理人。1320年，他为年幼的博尼法齐奥·诺韦洛·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡办理事务；1326年，他取得阿拉贡国王对伯爵在撒丁岛封地的确认。博尼法齐奥于1340年去世后，蒂努乔成为其子拉涅里·诺韦洛的监护人，代他治理比萨。1342年，他协助攻取卢卡；但此后与维斯孔蒂家族的战争带来破坏和更沉重的赋税。1347年拉涅里突然去世后，蒂努乔的对手起兵反对他；他的宅邸被焚，他逃往沃尔泰拉。

en: Elizabeth Darcy (1332–1390) was born at Platten in County Meath, the daughter of John Darcy, 1st Baron Darcy de Knayth, justiciar of Ireland, and his wife Joan de Burgh of the Ulster earls. On 15 May 1346, aged fourteen, she married James Butler, 2nd Earl of Ormond, after obtaining a papal dispensation for their kinship, and became countess of Ormond. She bore six children, including James Butler, 3rd Earl of Ormond, and Eleanor, wife of the Earl of Desmond. Widowed in 1382, she married Sir Robert de Hereford, seneschal of Tipperary, and died on 24 March 1390.
zh: 伊丽莎白·达西（1332—1390）生于米斯郡普拉滕，是爱尔兰总督、第一代克奈斯的达西男爵约翰·达西与妻子、阿尔斯特伯爵家族的琼·德·伯格之女。1346年5月15日，年方十四的她因与第二代奥蒙德伯爵詹姆斯·巴特勒有亲属关系，在取得教皇特许后成婚，成为奥蒙德伯爵夫人。她生有六名子女，包括第三代奥蒙德伯爵詹姆斯·巴特勒和嫁给德斯蒙德伯爵的埃莉诺。1382年丧夫后，她改嫁蒂珀雷里总管罗伯特·德·赫里福德爵士，1390年3月24日去世。

en: John Darcy, 2nd Baron Darcy de Knayth (c. 1317–1356), was the eldest son of the first baron and a northern English landowner. In the opening phase of the Hundred Years' War he commanded a company alongside Walter Manny, fighting at Crécy in 1346 and the siege of Calais. In 1347 he inherited his father's estates and the constableship of the Tower of London, and sat regularly in Parliament from 1348. He married Alianore de Holland and, in 1344, the heiress Elizabeth Meynell. He died at Notton on 5 March 1356 and was buried at Gisborough Priory.
zh: 约翰·达西，第二代克奈斯的达西男爵（约1317—1356），是第一代男爵的长子，也是英格兰北部的大地主。百年战争初期，他与沃尔特·曼尼一同率队作战，1346年征战克雷西，随后参加加来围城战。1347年父亲去世后，他继承了父亲的地产并接任伦敦塔总管，1348年起屡获召出席议会。他先娶埃莉诺·霍兰，1344年又娶女继承人伊丽莎白·梅内尔。1356年3月5日他卒于诺顿，葬于吉斯伯勒修道院。

en: John Darcy, 1st Baron Darcy de Knayth (c. 1290–1347), was a Lincolnshire-born English peer and one of Edward III's most trusted councillors. Summoned to the barony in 1332, he served three terms as chief governor of Ireland from 1323 onward, and in 1324 presided at Kilkenny over the witchcraft trial of Alice Kyteler. He was the king's steward (1337–1340) and chamberlain (1342–1346), constable of the Tower of London, and fought at Crécy in 1346, carrying news of the victory back to Parliament. He died in 1347 and was buried at Gisborough Priory.
zh: 约翰·达西，第一代克奈斯的达西男爵（约1290—1347），出生于林肯郡，是英格兰贵族，也是爱德华三世最信任的谋臣之一。1332年他受封男爵，自1323年起三次出任爱尔兰总督；1324年他在基尔肯尼主持了爱丽丝·基特勒巫术案的审判。他历任国王内侍长（1337—1340）和宫务大臣（1342—1346）、伦敦塔总管，1346年征战克雷西，并奉命把捷报送回议会。他于1347年去世，葬于吉斯伯勒修道院。

en: John de Burgh (1286–1313) was the eldest son and heir of Richard Óg de Burgh, the Red Earl of Ulster. On 30 September 1308, at Waltham Abbey in Essex, he married Elizabeth de Clare, sister of Gilbert de Clare, Earl of Gloucester; his own sister Maud married Gilbert the same year, sealing a double alliance. Elizabeth joined him in Ireland in 1309 and on 17 September 1312 gave birth to William Donn, the future Earl of Ulster. John was killed in a minor skirmish at Galway on 18 June 1313, leaving the infant William as heir.
zh: 约翰·德·伯格（1286—1313）是阿尔斯特“红发伯爵”理查·奥格的长子与继承人。1308年9月30日，他在埃塞克斯的沃尔瑟姆修道院娶格洛斯特伯爵吉尔伯特·德·克莱尔之妹伊丽莎白·德·克莱尔为妻，两大家族结成双重联姻，他的妹妹莫德也在同年嫁给吉尔伯特。1309年伊丽莎白前往爱尔兰与他团聚，1312年9月17日生下后来的阿尔斯特伯爵威廉·多恩。1313年6月18日，约翰在戈尔韦的一场小规模冲突中身亡，襁褓中的威廉成为伯爵领地的继承人。

en: Sir John Morice (died 1362) was a Bedfordshire gentleman who spent most of his career in English Ireland, remembered for his keen, if not very successful, efforts to reform its government. He began in the service of Aymer de Valence, Earl of Pembroke, was pardoned in 1313 for backing the murderers of Piers Gaveston, and sat for Bedfordshire in the Parliament of 1322. In Ireland he was escheator from 1329 to 1336 and several times deputy justiciar, campaigning against the Irish of Mide in 1342. Charged with carrying out Edward III's reform ordinances of 1341, he governed as justiciar and was briefly lord chancellor in 1345–1346, but his rule was judged inept and unpopular. He was recalled in 1349 and died in England in 1362. His portrait in the Waterford Charter Roll is called the earliest of an Irish judge.
zh: 约翰·莫里斯爵士（?—1362）是贝德福德郡乡绅，大半生在英格兰治下的爱尔兰任职，因热心改革爱尔兰政务而留名，成效却有限。他早年效力于彭布罗克伯爵艾默·德·瓦朗斯，1313年因支持杀害皮尔斯·加韦斯顿的人而获赦，1322年代表贝德福德郡出席议会。在爱尔兰，他1329至1336年任籍没官，数次出任副总督，1342年征讨米德的爱尔兰人。他奉命推行爱德华三世1341年的改革诏令，出任爱尔兰总督，并在1345—1346年短暂担任爱尔兰大法官，但施政被认为无能而不得人心。1349年他被召回，1362年死于英格兰。《沃特福德特许状卷轴》中留有他的肖像，被视为爱尔兰法官最早的画像。

en: Richard Mór de Burgh (1194–1243), eldest son of William de Burgh, was a ward of the English crown after his father died in 1206 and came of age in 1214. Appointed seneschal of Munster in 1223, he claimed Connacht, his father's grant, and was confirmed in it in 1227. He served as justiciar of Ireland from 1228 to 1232, and in 1235 drove Felim Ua Conchobair from Connacht with a feudal host, taking the title Lord of Connacht. In 1236 he built a castle at Loughrea, where a town was founded; he also founded Galway. He fell ill on a voyage to France and died early in 1243.
zh: 理查德·莫尔·德·伯格（1194—1243）是威廉·德·伯格的长子，1206年父亲死后成为英格兰王室的被监护人，1214年成年。1223年他被任命为芒斯特总管，提出对康诺特的领有权——那是曾封给他父亲的土地，并于1227年获得确认。1228至1232年他担任爱尔兰政法官；1235年率封建联军将盖尔王费利姆·奥康纳逐出康诺特，取康诺特领主之号。1236年他在洛赫雷修建城堡，当地也建起城镇；他还创建了戈尔韦。1243年初，他在前往法国途中病逝。

en: Robert le Poer (died c. 1346) was an Irish judge and Crown official, said by some sources to have been a younger son of Arnold le Poer, seneschal of Kilkenny. As a young man he served John Hastings, 1st Baron Hastings, and went with him to Gascony in 1307; by 1322 he was the Hastings family's bailiff in Ireland. He held church livings at Lutterworth from 1318 and in County Carlow, became Chamberlain of North Wales in 1323, and was appointed Lord High Treasurer of Ireland in 1327, later serving as Chief Baron of the Irish Exchequer.
zh: 罗伯特·勒普尔（约1346年卒）是爱尔兰法官兼王室官员，部分史料称他是基尔肯尼总管阿诺德·勒普尔的幼子。他年轻时侍奉第一代黑斯廷斯男爵约翰·黑斯廷斯，1307年随其前往加斯科涅，到1322年已担任黑斯廷斯家族在爱尔兰的管家。他自1318年起领有路特沃思的圣俸，并在卡洛郡拥有教职；1323年出任北威尔士内务大臣，1327年被任命为爱尔兰财政大臣，后来又任爱尔兰财政法院首席男爵。

en: Slaine O'Brien was an Irish noblewoman, a daughter of Turlough O'Brien. She married the knight Sir Edmond de Burgh, by whom she had Richard and David Burke, and was also the wife of Toirdelbach Ó Conchobair, king of Connacht.
zh: 斯莱尼·奥布莱恩是爱尔兰贵族女子，特洛·奥布莱恩之女。她嫁给骑士埃德蒙·德·伯格爵士，生子理查德与大卫·伯克，也是康诺特国王托德尔巴赫·奥康乔巴尔之妻。

en: Sir Walter Liath de Burgh was an Anglo-Irish noble, the eldest son of Sir William Liath de Burgh and Finola Ní Bhriain of Thomond. He is first recorded in 1326, when he and Sir Edmond de Burgh were named guardians of the peace in Connacht, Tipperary and Limerick and keepers of the late Earl of Ulster's lands there. He later quarrelled with the young Earl William Donn, who imprisoned him; Walter starved to death in the earl's castle in February 1332, a killing that led to the earl's own murder the following year.
zh: 沃尔特·利亚斯·德·伯格爵士是盎格鲁—爱尔兰贵族，威廉·利亚斯·德·伯格爵士与托蒙德的芬奥拉·妮·布里安的长子。史籍中他最早见于1326年，当时他与埃德蒙·德·伯格爵士一同被任命为康诺特、蒂珀雷里和利默里克的治安官，并受托监护已故阿尔斯特伯爵在当地的领地。后来他与年轻的伯爵威廉·唐反目，被伯爵囚禁；1332年2月，沃尔特在伯爵的城堡中被饿死，此事直接导致伯爵本人在次年遇刺。

en: William de Burgh (c. 1160–1205/1206) was an Anglo-Norman from Burgh-next-Aylsham in Norfolk who went to Ireland with John, lord of Ireland, in 1185. Henry II made him governor of Limerick and granted him wide lands in Leinster and Munster, where he served as seneschal of Munster from 1201 to 1203. About 1193 he married a daughter of Domnall Mór Ó Briain, king of Thomond. He campaigned in Desmond and Connacht and took the title Lord of Connacht in 1203. He died in winter 1205/1206 and was buried at Athassel Priory, which he had founded around 1200.
zh: 威廉·德·伯格（约1160—1205/1206）是出身诺福克郡艾尔舍姆附近伯格的盎格鲁—诺曼人，1185年随爱尔兰之主约翰前往爱尔兰。亨利二世任命他为利默里克长官，赐给他伦斯特和芒斯特的大片土地，1201至1203年他出任芒斯特总管。约1193年，他娶托蒙德国王多姆纳尔·莫尔·奥布赖恩之女为妻，此后在德斯蒙德与康诺特征战，于1203年取康诺特领主之号。他于1205至1206年冬去世，葬在自己约1200年创立的阿塔塞尔修道院。

en: Sir William Liath de Burgh was an Anglo-Irish noble, son of William Óg de Burgh, who spent much of his career fighting for his cousin, the Earl of Ulster; he first appears in the records in 1290, defeated in a skirmish with the Mac Coughlans. He married Finnguala Ní Bhriain, daughter of Brian Ruad, King of Thomond, and served as Justiciar of Ireland from October 1308 to May 1309. His sons Edmond Albanach and Ulick founded the Mayo and Clanricarde branches of the Burkes. He died in 1324.
zh: 威廉·利亚斯·德·伯格爵士是盎格鲁—爱尔兰贵族，威廉·奥格·德·伯格之子，大半生为表亲阿尔斯特伯爵征战；史籍中他最早见于1290年，时在一场与麦科赫伦家族的小规模冲突中战败。他娶了托蒙德国王布赖恩·鲁阿德之女芬古拉·妮·布里安，并于1308年10月至1309年5月出任爱尔兰首席政法官。他的儿子埃德蒙·阿尔巴纳克与尤利克分别开创了伯克家族的梅奥与克兰里卡德支系。他于1324年去世。

en: Sir William Óg de Burgh was an Anglo-Irish noble and soldier, the third son of Richard Mor de Burgh, Lord of Connacht. He served with distinction in France under Henry III in 1245 and later fought in Scotland, before being drawn into the feudal wars of Ireland, where he killed the Lord of Desmond. In 1270 he was killed fighting the Ua Conchobair kings of Connacht at the Battle of Áth an Chip. His son William Liath was an ancestor of the Mayo Burkes, the Mac William Iochtar line.
zh: 威廉·奥格·德·伯格爵士是盎格鲁—爱尔兰贵族与军人，康诺特领主理查德·莫尔·德·伯格的第三子。1245年他随亨利三世在法国作战，表现出色，后来又征战苏格兰，随后卷入爱尔兰的封建混战，并在争斗中杀死了戴斯蒙德领主。1270年，他在阿汉基普战役中与康诺特的奥康诺诸王作战时被杀。他的儿子威廉·利亚斯是梅奥伯克家族支系，即下麦克威廉一脉的祖先。

en: Bolesław III of Płock (1322/1330–1351), son of Duke Wenceslaus and Elizabeth of Lithuania, inherited the duchy in 1336 under his uncles' regency, ruled from 1340, gaining Wizna and Sochaczew in 1345. A Bohemian vassal who did homage to King John, he later drew close to Casimir III of Poland. In 1351 he joined Casimir and Louis I of Hungary against his Lithuanian uncle Kęstutis, who accepted baptism and was placed in his custody; when Kęstutis escaped, Bolesław was killed pursuing him by an arrow at Mělník on 20 August 1351. He died unmarried and lies in Płock Cathedral.
zh: 普沃茨克的波列斯瓦夫三世（1322/1330—1351）是普沃茨克公爵瓦茨拉夫与立陶宛的伊丽莎白之子，1336年袭爵，由两位叔父摄政，1340年亲政，1345年又得到维兹纳和索哈切夫。他身为波希米亚封臣，曾向约翰国王行臣服礼，后来却与波兰国王卡齐米日三世接近。1351年，他随卡齐米日和匈牙利国王拉约什一世讨伐舅父、立陶宛大公科斯图提斯；科斯图提斯同意受洗并被交由他看管，随后逃脱。波列斯瓦夫追击时于1351年8月20日在梅尔尼克中箭身亡。他终身未婚，葬于普沃茨克主教座堂。

en: Elizabeth Giedyminówna (c. 1301–1364) was a Lithuanian princess, the daughter of Grand Duke Gediminas and probably Jewna of Polotsk. Around 1316 she married Wenceslaus, the Piast duke of Płock, and bore him Anna, later wife of Henry V of Żagań, and Bolesław III. After Wenceslaus died in 1336, she probably served as regent for her minor son until he came of age between 1340 and 1343. In 1349 Bolesław granted her Wyszogród for life, a holding confirmed by King Casimir III in 1355. She died on 2 June 1364 and was buried in Płock Cathedral.
zh: 伊丽莎白·格迪米尼奥芙娜（约1301—1364）是立陶宛公主，立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯之女，母亲很可能是波洛茨克的雅乌拿。约1316年，她嫁给皮亚斯特家族的普沃茨克公爵瓦茨拉夫，生下后来嫁给扎甘的亨里克五世的安娜和博莱斯瓦夫三世。1336年瓦茨拉夫去世后，她很可能为幼子摄政，直到儿子于1340年至1343年间成年。1349年博莱斯瓦夫把维绍格鲁德作为终身领地赐给她，1355年获卡齐米日三世国王确认。她于1364年6月2日去世，葬于普沃茨克主教座堂。

en: Wenceslaus of Płock (1293/1297–1336) was a Piast prince, son of Bolesław II of Płock and Kunigunde, and a grandson of Ottokar II of Bohemia. Inheriting Płock in 1313, he stayed neutral between Poland and the Teutonic Order, agreeing terms at Golub in 1321. After Władysław I attacked Płock in 1325, he backed the Order in the war of 1326. Switching to Poland in 1329, he was invaded by King John of Bohemia and the Knights and forced to do homage to Bohemia on 29 March. He died at Wyszogród in 1336, leaving a son, Bolesław III.
zh: 普沃茨克的瓦茨拉夫（1293/1297—1336）是皮亚斯特王朝王公，普沃茨克公爵波列斯瓦夫二世与波希米亚国王奥托卡二世之女库妮贡德之子。他于1313年承袭普沃茨克公国，长期在波兰与条顿骑士团之间保持中立，1321年在戈卢布与骑士团达成协议。1325年瓦迪斯瓦夫一世攻打普沃茨克，瓦茨拉夫遂在1326年爆发的波兰—条顿战争中支持骑士团。1329年他转投波兰，但波希米亚国王约翰联合骑士团入侵，迫使他于3月29日向波希米亚臣服。1336年他在维绍格鲁德去世，留下一子波列斯瓦夫三世。

en: Heinrich II, called the Bohemian (died 1302), was the eldest son of Heinrich I, Vogt of Plauen. First recorded in 1275 and knighted in 1289, he fought beside his father for King Adolf of Nassau against the Wettins, appearing in the royal camp at Borna in December 1294. In 1296 he became joint administrator of the fortress of Freyburg an der Unstrut, and in 1301 King Albert of Habsburg named him captain of Eger. He is last documented on 23 April 1302 and died soon afterwards, before his father; his son Heinrich III later held the Plauen lands.
zh: 海因里希二世，绰号“波希米亚人”（卒于1302年），是普劳恩福格特海因里希一世的长子。他最早见于1275年的记载，1289年受封骑士，后随父亲在拿骚的阿道夫国王麾下与韦廷家族作战，1294年12月曾驻于博尔纳的王营。1296年，他被任命为翁斯特鲁特河畔弗赖堡要塞的共管官；1301年，哈布斯堡的阿尔布雷希特国王任命他为埃格尔长官。1302年4月23日是他最后一次出现在文书中，此后不久便先于父亲去世。其子海因里希三世后来继承普劳恩领地。

en: Heinrich III of Plauen, called the Tall (c. 1284–1347/48), was Vogt of Plauen in the Vogtland. He is first documented on 24 August 1302 alongside his grandfather Heinrich I, and through his marriage to Margarethe of Seeberg was initially styled Heinrich of Seeberg, bearing the nickname the Tall from 1312. In March 1304 he and the Vogts of Plauen and Gera placed themselves under King Albert I at Nuremberg, and later that year he was appointed Landrichter of Eger. He died between February 1347 and May 1348.
zh: 普劳恩的海因里希三世，绰号“高个子”（约1284—1347/1348），是福格特兰普劳恩的福格特。1302年8月24日的文书首次记载了他，与祖父海因里希一世同列；因娶玛格丽特·冯·泽贝格为妻，他起初被称作“泽贝格的海因里希”，1312年起又有“高个子”的绰号。1304年3月，他与普劳恩和格拉的福格特们在纽伦堡接受阿尔布雷希特一世国王的庇护，同年获任埃格尔的地区法官。他在1347年2月至1348年5月间去世。

en: Bertold von Riesenburg was bishop of Pomesania in Prussia from 1331 until his death in November 1346, with his episcopal seat at Marienwerder.
zh: 贝特霍尔德·冯·里森堡于1331年出任普鲁士波美萨尼亚主教，驻地马林韦德，1346年11月在任上去世。

en: Demid Vladimirovich was a Pinsk prince of the Turov Izyaslavichi line, the middle of the three sons of Prince Vladimir Sviatopolkovich of Pinsk. In 1262 he and his brothers Fyodor and Yuri went to Nebl to congratulate the Galician-Volhynian prince Vasilko Romanovich on his victory over the Lithuanians near the town. Demid outlived his brother Yuri, whom he mourned at his death around 1288–1292, and he then took over the Pinsk principality. He died after 1292.
zh: 杰米德·弗拉基米罗维奇是图罗夫伊贾斯拉维奇一系的平斯克王公，平斯克王公弗拉基米尔·斯维亚托波尔科维奇三个儿子中的次子。1262年，他与兄弟费奥多尔、尤里前往涅布利，向加利西亚—沃伦王公瓦西里科·罗曼诺维奇祝贺在该城附近击败立陶宛人。杰米德比兄弟尤里长寿，约1288—1292年尤里去世时他曾为其哀悼，随后继领平斯克公国。他在1292年之后去世。

en: Fyodor Vladimirovich was a Pinsk prince of the Turov Izyaslavichi line, the eldest of the three sons of Prince Vladimir of Pinsk. After the death of Mikhail of Pinsk he made himself ruler there. In 1262 the chronicle finds him, with his brothers Demid and Yuri, congratulating the Galician-Volhynian prince Vasilko Romanovich on his victory over the Lithuanians near the town of Nebl. He is thought to have been the senior Pinsk prince at that time and to have tolerated Lithuanian raids on Volhynia. He was still living after 1292.
zh: 费奥多尔·弗拉基米罗维奇是图罗夫伊贾斯拉维奇一系的平斯克王公，平斯克王公弗拉基米尔三个儿子中的长子。平斯克的米哈伊尔死后，他据有了平斯克。据编年史记载，1262年，他与兄弟杰米德、尤里一同向加利西亚—沃伦王公瓦西里科·罗曼诺维奇道贺，祝贺其在涅布利城附近击败立陶宛人。一般认为他此时是平斯克诸王公中的最年长者，并曾纵容立陶宛人袭扰沃伦。1292年之后他仍在世。

en: Mikhail Vladimirovich, called Mikhail of Pinsk, was a Rurikid prince of the Turov Izyaslavichi line, generally held to be a son of Vladimir Sviatopolkovich. He received the Pinsk principality from his uncle Rostislav Sviatopolkovich, who ruled it until 1232. The Hypatian Chronicle places him at Pinsk in 1246–1247, when Daniel and Vasilko Romanovich fought the Lithuanian prince Lekovniy near the town; Mikhail tried to warn both the Lithuanians and the Romanovichi. He died after 1247, and Pinsk passed to Fyodor Vladimirovich.
zh: 米哈伊尔·弗拉基米罗维奇，即平斯克的米哈伊尔，是留里克王朝图罗夫伊贾斯拉维奇一系的王公，一般认为是弗拉基米尔·斯维亚托波尔科维奇之子。他从叔父罗斯季斯拉夫·斯维亚托波尔科维奇手中接掌平斯克公国，后者统治当地至1232年。《伊帕季耶夫编年史》在1246—1247年项下提到他：当时丹尼尔和瓦西里科·罗曼诺维奇兄弟在平斯克附近与立陶宛王公列科夫尼交战，米哈伊尔试图同时向立陶宛人和罗曼诺维奇兄弟示警。他在1247年后去世，平斯克随后转入费奥多尔·弗拉基米罗维奇之手。

en: Rostislav Sviatopolkovich (died 1232), younger son of Sviatopolk Yurievich of Turov, was a prince of the Turov Izyaslavichi line. In 1228 he claimed Turov as senior of the dynasty, but it went to his cousin's son Yuri Andreevich; after his brother Vladimir died that year, their cousin Vladimir Glebovich took Pinsk, and Rostislav secured it only in 1229. His sons seized Chartoryisk, but Daniel Romanovich of Galicia retook the town and captured them; in reply Rostislav sent troops to aid Vladimir of Kiev, Mikhail of Chernigov and Kotian's Polovtsians against Kamenets, without success. He ruled Pinsk until 1232.
zh: 罗斯季斯拉夫·斯维亚托波尔科维奇（卒于1232年）是图罗夫王公斯维亚托波尔克·尤里耶维奇的幼子，属图罗夫伊贾斯拉维奇一系。1228年，他以家族最年长者身份要求取得图罗夫，公位却落入堂侄尤里·安德烈耶维奇之手；同年其兄弟弗拉基米尔去世，堂兄弟弗拉基米尔·格列博维奇又占据平斯克，他迟至1229年才得到该公国。他的儿子们夺取恰尔托雷斯克后，加利西亚的丹尼尔·罗曼诺维奇收复该城并俘虏了他们；罗斯季斯拉夫遂发兵支援基辅的弗拉基米尔、切尔尼戈夫的米哈伊尔和科提安的波洛伏齐人，但围攻卡缅涅茨无功而返。他统治平斯克直至1232年去世。

en: Yaropolk Yuryevich, a Rurikid prince of Pinsk from the Turov line, is recorded only once, in 1190, when his wedding took place during Rurik Rostislavich's stay in Pinsk on a Lithuanian campaign. His son Yury of Nesvizh was killed at the Kalka River in 1223.
zh: 雅罗波尔克·尤里耶维奇是图罗夫系的留里克王族、平斯克王公，仅在1190年被记载一次：留里克·罗斯季斯拉维奇征伐立陶宛驻留平斯克期间，他举行了婚礼。其子涅斯维日王公尤里于1223年在迦勒迦河之战中被杀。

en: Yaroslav Yurievich was a Rurikid prince of the Turov-Pinsk line, a son of Yuri Vladimirovich of Pinsk. Genealogies list him as a prince of Pinsk, with some doubt, and name his brother Dmitry as a prince of Turov.
zh: 雅罗斯拉夫·尤里耶维奇是留里克王朝图罗夫—平斯克支系王公，平斯克王公尤里·弗拉基米罗维奇之子。家谱把他列为平斯克王公，但存疑，并称他的兄弟德米特里为图罗夫王公。

en: Yaroslav Yurievich (1144–c. 1184) was a Rurikid prince of Pinsk, the son of Yuri Yaroslavich of Turov and Anna Vsevolodovna, and may have held Kletsk after his father's death. The genealogist Nikolai Baumgarten proposed that he married Yefrosinya, a granddaughter of Yuri Dolgorukiy. He is found as prince of Pinsk in 1183, when he joined the campaign led by Grand Prince Sviatoslav Vsevolodovich of Kiev, alongside Mstislav of Goroden and Gleb of Dubrovitsa, which defeated the Polovtsian khan Konchak on the Orel river. Some historians infer that he died before 1190, when his brother Yaropolk is recorded holding Pinsk.
zh: 雅罗斯拉夫·尤里耶维奇（1144—约1184年）是留里克王朝的平斯克王公，图罗夫王公尤里·雅罗斯拉维奇与安娜·弗谢沃洛多芙娜之子，父亲死后可能领有克列茨克。谱系学家尼古拉·鲍姆加滕认为他娶了尤里·多尔戈鲁基的孙女叶夫罗西尼娅。1183年，他以平斯克王公身份参加基辅大公斯维亚托斯拉夫·弗谢沃洛多维奇统率的远征，与戈罗杰茨王公姆斯季斯拉夫、杜布罗维察王公格列布等人在奥列尔河击败波洛伏齐汗康恰克。部分历史学家认为他在1190年前去世：1190年的记载中，平斯克已由其兄弟雅罗波尔克统治。

en: Yuri, also called Georgy, Vladimirovich was prince of Pinsk, a member of the Turov Izyaslavichi line and a son of Prince Vladimir Sviatopolkovich. In 1262 he and his brothers Fyodor and Demid came to Nebl to congratulate Vasilko Romanovich of Volhynia on defeating the Lithuanians who had been raiding Pinsk lands. The chronicle praises him as a meek, humble and truthful prince; when he died, around 1288–1292, his widow, sons and brother Demid, and all the people mourned him with great lamentation. Demid then succeeded to Pinsk.
zh: 尤里（又名格奥尔基）·弗拉基米罗维奇是平斯克王公，属于图罗夫伊贾斯拉维奇一系，是弗拉基米尔·斯维亚托波尔科维奇之子。1262年，他与兄弟费奥多尔、杰米德前往涅布利，向沃伦王公瓦西里科·罗曼诺维奇祝贺战胜屡屡袭掠平斯克的立陶宛人。编年史称他“温顺、谦恭、诚实”；约1288—1292年间他去世时，遗孀、儿子们、兄弟杰米德和全体百姓都痛哭哀悼。杰米德随后继领平斯克。

en: Aimery IX (c. 1225–1256), viscount of Thouars in Poitou, was a son of Guy I of Thouars and Alix de Mauléon. In 1242 he submitted to King Louis IX rather than join the revolt of Hugh X of Lusignan. Succeeding his uncle Aimery VIII as viscount in 1246, he did homage to Alphonse of Poitiers, the king's brother. He spent much of his time at Thouars, made an agreement with the chapter of Saint-Hilaire in 1250, and confirmed his ancestors' gifts to Chambon Abbey in 1254. In 1255 he paid homage to Louis IX for the castles of Bugon and La Roche-sur-Yon, recovered through his Mauléon kin. He died on 11 December 1256; by Poitevin custom the viscounty passed to his brother Renaud, not his son Guy.
zh: 艾默里克九世（约1225—1256）是普瓦图的图阿尔子爵，居伊一世·德·图阿尔与阿莉克丝·德·莫莱翁之子。1242年，他没有参加吕西尼昂的于格十世叛乱，而是归顺国王路易九世。1246年他继叔父艾默里克八世之后成为子爵，向国王之弟、普瓦捷的阿尔方斯行臣服礼。他多居图阿尔，1250年与圣伊莱尔教士会达成协议，1254年确认祖辈对尚邦修道院的捐赠。1255年，他凭莫莱翁亲族关系收回比贡和永河畔拉罗什城堡，为此向路易九世行臣服礼。1256年12月11日他去世；按普瓦图习惯，子爵领传给弟弟雷诺，而非其子居伊。

en: Alphonse of Poitiers (1220–1271) was a younger son of King Louis VIII of France and Blanche of Castile, and a brother of Louis IX. Granted Poitou and Auvergne as his appanage, he fought beside Louis IX at Taillebourg in 1242 against Henry III of England. By the 1229 Treaty of Paris he married Joan, only child of Count Raymond VII of Toulouse, and inherited Toulouse in 1249. He and Charles of Anjou served as regents after Blanche's death in 1252. He took part in negotiations leading to the 1259 Treaty of Paris and governed his estates through officials and inspectors. He joined the Eighth Crusade and died at Savona in 1271 without heirs, his lands reverting to the crown.
zh: 阿尔方斯·德·普瓦捷（1220—1271）是法兰西国王路易八世与卡斯蒂利亚的布朗什之子、路易九世之弟。依照父亲遗嘱，他获得普瓦图和奥弗涅作为封禄，1242年在塔耶堡与路易九世并肩对抗英格兰国王亨利三世。根据1229年《巴黎条约》，他娶图卢兹伯爵雷蒙七世的独女让娜为妻，1249年继承图卢兹。1252年布朗什去世后，他与安茹的查理共同摄政。他参与了促成1259年《巴黎条约》的谈判，并通过官员和巡视人员管理领地。他参加第八次十字军东征，1271年死于萨沃纳，身后无嗣，领地收归法兰西王室。

en: Geoffrey IV of Thouars (c. 1125–1173), third son of Viscount Aimery V and Agnes of Poitiers, succeeded his brother William I as viscount in 1150. In 1156 he backed Geoffrey Plantagenet's claim to Anjou against Henry II of England and raided the lands of Henry's partisans. In November 1158 Henry besieged Thouars and stormed the supposedly impregnable castle in three days; Geoffrey fled, and the walls were dismantled at Eleanor of Aquitaine's request. He later recovered his lands, rebuilt the fortress and pilgrimaged to Santiago de Compostela. He died in 1173, and his son Aimery VII succeeded him.
zh: 若弗鲁瓦四世·德·图阿尔（约1125—1173）是图阿尔子爵艾默里五世与普瓦捷的艾格尼丝的第三子。1150年，他继兄弟纪尧姆一世之后成为图阿尔子爵。1156年，他支持安茹的若弗鲁瓦向英格兰国王亨利二世争夺安茹，袭掠亨利党羽的领地。1158年11月，亨利二世围攻图阿尔，三天便攻下这座号称坚不可摧的城堡，若弗鲁瓦出逃，城防应阿基坦的埃莉诺要求被拆毁。他后来收回领地、重建城堡，并前往圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉朝圣。1173年去世，其子艾默里七世继位。

en: Margaret of Lusignan (c. 1226–1288) was the daughter of Hugh X, count of La Marche, and Isabella of Angoulême, widow of King John of England, making her a half-sister of Henry III. In 1243 she married Raymond VII of Toulouse, but the Council of Lyons granted them a divorce in 1245. She then wed Aimery IX, viscount of Thouars, and bore him Guy II, who later held the viscounty. In 1253 her half-brother Henry III granted her an English pension. After Aimery died in 1256 she married Geoffrey VI of Châteaubriant. She died on 22 October 1288.
zh: 吕西尼昂的玛格丽特（约1226—1288）是拉马什伯爵于格十世与昂古莱姆女伯爵伊莎贝拉之女；其母曾为英格兰国王约翰的王后，故她是亨利三世同母异父的妹妹。1243年她嫁给图卢兹伯爵雷蒙七世，1245年里昂会议批准两人离婚。其后她改嫁图阿尔子爵艾默里九世，生下后来继任子爵的居伊二世。1253年，同母兄长亨利三世赐给她一份英格兰年金。艾默里于1256年去世后，她再嫁沙托布里扬领主若弗鲁瓦六世。她于1288年10月22日去世。

en: Boris Davidovich was prince of Polotsk from after 1180 until around 1186, likely a son of the Vitebsk prince Davyd Sviatoslavich. His reign is known only from the Polotsk chronicle retold by Vasily Tatishchev: his second wife Sviatokhna, daughter of a Pomeranian prince Casimir, intrigued against his sons Vasilko and Vyachko, who held appanages along the Dvina, and forged a letter that brought about the killing of leading Polotsk boyars. When Vasilko exposed the fraud, the townsfolk rose at the veche bell, seized Sviatokhna and killed or expelled her Pomeranian followers. Boris died shortly after 1184.
zh: 鲍里斯·达维多维奇是1180年后至约1186年间的波洛茨克王公，可能是维捷布斯克王公达维德·斯维亚托斯拉维奇之子。他的统治仅见于瓦西里·塔季谢夫转述的波洛茨克编年史《斯维亚托赫娜纪事》：他的续弦斯维亚托赫娜是波莫瑞王公卡齐米日之女，与领有德维纳河封地的继子瓦西里科、维亚奇科为敌，还伪造书信，致使波洛茨克的一批大贵族被杀。瓦西里科揭穿骗局后，市民听到维切钟声起事，逮捕斯维亚托赫娜，驱逐或杀死她带来的波莫瑞人。鲍里斯于1184年后不久去世。

en: Bryachislav Iziaslavich (c. 997–1044) was prince of Polotsk from 1001, succeeding his father Iziaslav as a child. In 1015 he inherited Lutsk on the death of his grandfather Vladimir I. His line was excluded from the Kievan succession as izgoi, and he fought to keep Polotsk independent. In 1020 he sacked Novgorod, but his uncle Yaroslav the Wise defeated him on the Sudoma River; he fled, leaving his prisoners and loot behind. In the peace of 1021 Yaroslav granted him only the cities of Vitebsk and Usvyat, yet their hostility continued for years. Bryachislav expanded his principality, founded Braslaw, and died in Polotsk in 1044. His son was Vseslav the Seer.
zh: 布里亚奇斯拉夫·伊贾斯拉维奇（约997—1044）自1001年起为波洛茨克王公，幼年继承父亲伊贾斯拉夫之位。1015年祖父弗拉基米尔一世去世，他获得卢茨克。其支系以“弃子”身份被排除在基辅继承之外，他力图维持波洛茨克独立。1020年他洗劫诺夫哥罗德，但叔父智者雅罗斯拉夫在苏多马河将他击败；他丢下俘虏和战利品逃走。1021年的和约中雅罗斯拉夫只向他让出维捷布斯克和乌斯维亚特两城，此后双方仍敌对多年。布里亚奇斯拉夫扩大了公国疆域，建立布拉斯拉夫城，1044年死于波洛茨克。其子即“先知者”弗谢斯拉夫。

en: Briachislav Vasilkovich was a prince of the Vitebsk line of the Polotsk Rurikids, held to be a son of Vitebsk prince Vasilko Briachislavich. He succeeded his father in Vitebsk around 1221 and moved to the Polotsk throne around 1232, ruling there until after 1241. Russian chronicles name him without patronymic in 1239, when his daughter married Alexander Yaroslavich, the future Alexander Nevsky and grand prince of Vladimir. His death year is unknown, and a later prince of Polotsk, Konstantin the Armless, is regarded as his probable son.
zh: 布里亚奇斯拉夫·瓦西里科维奇是波洛茨克留里克王公维捷布斯克支系的成员，一般认为是维捷布斯克王公瓦西里科·布里亚奇斯拉维奇之子。约1221年，他继父亲之后统治维捷布斯克；约1232年登上波洛茨克公位，一直统治到1241年以后。罗斯编年史在1239年不称父名地提到他：这一年，他的女儿嫁给亚历山大·雅罗斯拉维奇，即后来的亚历山大·涅夫斯基及弗拉基米尔大公。他的卒年不详，后来的波洛茨克王公“无臂者”康斯坦丁被认为很可能是他的儿子。

en: Iziaslav Iziaslavich was the son of Iziaslav Bryachislavich, prince of Vitebsk in the Polotsk land. Rurikid genealogies record his death in 1265.
zh: 伊贾斯拉夫·伊贾斯拉维奇是波洛茨克地区的维捷布斯克王公伊贾斯拉夫·布里亚齐斯拉维奇之子。留里克王公谱系记载，他于1265年去世。

en: Iziaslav Vladimirovich (978–1001) was the son of Vladimir I of Kiev by Rogneda of Polotsk, and founder of the Polotsk branch of the Rurik dynasty, the Iziaslavichi. After Vladimir's conversion in 988, Rogneda was divorced and sent back with Iziaslav to her homeland, first to Iziaslavl and then to Polotsk, where they ruled. Iziaslavl was named for him. He was the first prince to make Polotsk autonomous from Kiev, passing the principality to his descendants. He died in 1001 before his father, barring his line from the Kievan succession under the rota system. His son Vseslav died in childhood in 1003; another son, Bryachislav, continued the dynasty, which ruled Polotsk until 1222.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/伊贾斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇_(波洛茨克)
zh: 伊贾斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇（978—1001）是基辅大公弗拉基米尔一世与波洛茨克的罗格涅达之子，留里克王朝波洛茨克支系“伊贾斯拉维奇”的始祖。988年弗拉基米尔受洗后与罗格涅达离异，她带着伊贾斯拉夫返回故乡，先到伊贾斯拉夫尔，后到波洛茨克主政。伊贾斯拉夫尔以他命名。他是第一位让波洛茨克脱离基辅自治的王公，并把公位传给子孙。他先于父亲在1001年去世，其支系因此按顺位制度被排除在基辅继承之外。其子弗谢斯拉夫于1003年夭折，另一子布里亚奇斯拉夫延续王统，该支系统治波洛茨克直至1222年。

en: Jurgis Narimantaitis (c. 1326 – c. 1398), Polish Jerzy Narymuntowicz, was a Lithuanian prince of the Gediminid dynasty, probably the third son of Narimantas. From 1352 he held Belz, defending it against Louis I of Hungary, and from 1359 also Chełm; in 1366 he became a vassal of Casimir III of Poland. After Casimir's death he raided Lesser Poland with Kęstutis in 1376, only to lose his lands to Louis' counter-invasion in 1377. In 1388 he went over to the Teutonic Knights, but after 1392 served Vytautas, probably ending as prince of Pinsk.
zh: 尤尔吉斯·纳里曼塔伊蒂斯（波兰语作耶日·纳雷蒙托维奇，约1326—约1398）是格迪米纳斯王朝的立陶宛王公，可能是纳里曼塔斯的第三子。1352年起他领有贝尔兹，曾抵御匈牙利国王拉约什一世的进攻，1359年起又兼领海乌姆，1366年成为波兰国王卡齐米日三世的封臣。卡齐米日三世死后，他于1376年随科斯图提斯劫掠小波兰，1377年其领地反被拉约什一世的反攻夺取。1388年他投奔条顿骑士团，1392年后转而为维陶塔斯效力，最后可能以平斯克王公身份终老。

en: Konstantin, nicknamed the Armless, was prince of Polotsk in the 1250s and later prince of Vitebsk; one scholarly tradition makes him a son of Briachislav Vasilkovich. His nickname is recorded in the Instruction addressed to him by Simeon, bishop of Polotsk. While ruling Polotsk he ceded lands in Latgale to the Livonian Order, and late in the 1250s he lost the city to Tovtivil. A prince Konstantin, possibly another man, joined Russian princes on the campaigns against Yuryev in 1262 and Rakovor in 1268 and appears last in 1292, treating with the crusaders as an envoy of Grand Prince Dmitry of Vladimir.
zh: 绰号“无臂者”的康斯坦丁是1250年代的波洛茨克王公，后来任维捷布斯克王公，一种学术观点认为他是布里亚奇斯拉夫·瓦西里科维奇之子。他的绰号见于波洛茨克主教西缅写给他的《训诫书》。统治波洛茨克期间，他把拉特加利亚的部分领地割让给利沃尼亚骑士团；1250年代末他失去波洛茨克，公位落入陶特维拉斯之手。一位可能是另一人的康斯坦丁王公与罗斯诸王公一起参加了1262年攻打尤里耶夫和1268年攻打拉科沃尔的战事；史料最后一次提到这位王公是在1292年，当时他作为弗拉基米尔大公德米特里的使者之一与十字军谈判。

en: Liubko, also called Liubartas, was the only known son of Vainius, Lithuanian prince of Polotsk and brother of Gediminas. He ruled after Narimantas and was killed in 1342 fighting the Livonian Order, leaving no descendants.
zh: 柳布科（又名柳巴尔塔斯）是波洛茨克王公、格迪米纳斯之弟瓦伊纽斯唯一见于记载的儿子。他在纳里曼塔斯之后统治，1342年在与立窝尼亚骑士团交战时阵亡，无嗣。

en: Narimantas (died 2 February 1348), baptized Gleb, was a Lithuanian duke and the second son of Grand Duke Gediminas. He ruled Pinsk and Polotsk, and in 1333 Novgorod accepted him as prince of its northern towns Ladoga, Oreshek and Korela, making him the first Lithuanian service prince in Novgorod. Baptism in the Orthodox faith barred him from succeeding his father. He backed his brother Jaunutis against Algirdas and fled to the Golden Horde, but after reconciling with Algirdas he was killed leading troops against the Teutonic Knights at the Battle of Strėva on 2 February 1348.
zh: 纳里曼塔斯（洗礼名格列布，？—1348年2月2日）是立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯的次子，领有平斯克与波洛茨克。1333年，诺夫哥罗德接纳他为拉多加、奥列舍克、科列拉等北方城镇的王公，他由此成为诺夫哥罗德第一位立陶宛籍附庸王公；皈依东正教也使他失去继承父亲大公爵位的资格。他支持弟弟尧努蒂斯对抗阿尔吉尔达斯，一度逃奔金帐汗国，与阿尔吉尔达斯和解后，于1348年2月2日在斯特雷瓦河战役中率军对阵条顿骑士团时战死。

en: Rogvolod Vseslavich, baptized Boris (before 1054–1128), was the eldest son of Vseslav Briachislavich of Polotsk and ruled Polotsk after his father's death in 1101. Vasily Tatishchev relates that he founded the town of Borisov in 1102 while returning from a campaign against the Yotvingians, and in 1106 he probably joined the Polotsk princes' unsuccessful expedition against the Semigallians. Around 1120 he built a princely residence with the Boris and Gleb Monastery at Belchitsy near Polotsk, and the inscribed Boris Stones are linked with his reign. He died in early 1128 and was succeeded by his brother Davyd.
zh: 罗格沃洛德·弗谢斯拉维奇（教名鲍里斯，1054年前—1128年初）是波洛茨克王公弗谢斯拉夫·布里亚奇斯拉维奇的长子，1101年父亲死后登上波洛茨克公位。据瓦西里·塔季谢夫记载，1102年他在征讨雅特维格人返程时建立了鲍里索夫城；1106年，他可能参与了波洛茨克诸王公对泽姆加尔人的征战，此役以失败告终。约1120年，他在波洛茨克附近的别利奇齐修建王公府邸与鲍里斯-格列布修道院，刻有铭文的“鲍里斯石”也与他的统治有关。他于1128年初去世，公位由弟弟达维德继承。

en: Vainius, also called Voin, was the Lithuanian prince of Polotsk and a brother of Grand Duke Gediminas, held to be a son of Butvydas. He first appears in sources in 1324, already ruling Polotsk, and in 1326 joined Gediminas' embassy to Novgorod to make peace with the Novgorodians and the Livonian Order. He is thought to have died during the Order's campaigns against Polotsk in 1333–1334, and by 1338 Narimantas held the city. His only known son Liubartas was killed fighting the Order in 1342.
zh: 瓦伊纽斯（俄文称沃因）是立陶宛的波洛茨克王公、格迪米纳斯大公之弟，被认为是布特维达斯之子。1324年史籍首次提到他时，他已在统治波洛茨克；1326年，他随格迪米纳斯的使团前往诺夫哥罗德，与诺夫哥罗德人和利沃尼亚骑士团议和。一般认为他在1333至1334年骑士团进攻波洛茨克期间死去，1338年时该城已归纳里曼塔斯。他唯一知名的儿子柳巴特于1342年与骑士团作战时阵亡。

en: Vasilko Sviatoslavich (died 1144), son of Sviatoslav Vseslavich of Vitebsk and grandson of Vseslav the Seer, was prince of Polotsk from 1132. In 1129 he was among the Polotsk princes exiled to Byzantium by Grand Prince Mstislav the Great, possibly serving Emperor John II Komnenos as a commander. He returned around 1131, and in 1132 the citizens of Polotsk expelled Prince Sviatopolk Mstislavich and invited him to rule. In 1138 he escorted Vsevolod Mstislavich, expelled from Novgorod, with honour and swore to him by kissing the cross. Holding Polotsk until his death in 1144, he kept peace with the sons of Mstislav and in 1143 married his daughter to Sviatoslav Vsevolodovich.
zh: 瓦西里科·斯维亚托斯拉维奇（?—1144）是维捷布斯克王公斯维亚托斯拉夫·弗谢斯拉维奇之子、“先知者”弗谢斯拉夫之孙，1132年起为波洛茨克王公。1129年，基辅大公姆斯季斯拉夫大帝远征波洛茨克，把一众波洛茨克王公掳往拜占庭，瓦西里科也在其中，他可能曾在皇帝约翰二世·科穆宁麾下任将领。他约于1131年返回，1132年波洛茨克市民驱逐斯维亚托波尔克·姆斯季斯拉维奇，迎立他为主。1138年，被逐出诺夫哥罗德的弗谢沃洛德·姆斯季斯拉维奇途经波洛茨克，瓦西里科隆重护送他，并吻十字架向他立誓。他统治波洛茨克直至1144年去世，与姆斯季斯拉维奇兄弟保持和睦，1143年将女儿嫁给斯维亚托斯拉夫·弗谢沃洛多维奇。

en: Vasilko Volodarevich was a Rurikid prince of the Polotsk land, a son of Volodar Glebovich, prince of Minsk and briefly prince of Polotsk in 1167, likely born of Volodar's short-lived marriage to Ryksa, daughter of Boleslaw III of Poland. The Laurentian Chronicle names him as prince of Logoisk in 1186, when he campaigned against Polotsk together with the Novgorodians, a Smolensk force and the princes of Drutsk.
zh: 瓦西里科·沃洛达列维奇是波洛茨克地方的留里克王公，系明斯克王公、1167年还曾短暂据有波洛茨克的沃洛达里·格列波维奇之子，一般认为出自沃洛达里与波兰公爵波列斯瓦夫三世之女里克萨的短暂婚姻。《拉夫连季编年史》记载，1186年他身为洛戈伊斯克王公，与诺夫哥罗德人、一支斯摩棱斯克军队及德鲁茨克王公联兵出征波洛茨克。

en: Vseslav Bryachislavich, called the Seer (c. 1029–1101), was prince of Polotsk from 1044 and briefly grand prince of Kiev. Excluded from the Kievan succession as the only major Rurik prince not descended from Yaroslav the Wise, he raided northern Rus. After an unsuccessful siege of Pskov in 1065, he sacked Novgorod in the winter of 1066–1067, taking a bell and religious objects from its cathedral to Polotsk. The three Yaroslavichi defeated him on the Nemiga River in March 1067 and seized him during peace talks. Freed by the Kiev Uprising of 1068, he reigned in Kiev for seven months before securing Polotsk again in 1071. He built Polotsk's Cathedral of Holy Wisdom and died on 24 April 1101.
zh: 弗谢斯拉夫·布里亚奇斯拉维奇，人称“先知者”（约1029—1101），自1044年起为波洛茨克王公，并曾短暂登上基辅大公之位。他是唯一不出于智者雅罗斯拉夫一脉的重要留里克王公，被排除在基辅继承之外，于是袭掠罗斯北方。1065年他围攻普斯科夫受挫，1066—1067年冬洗劫诺夫哥罗德，将大教堂的一口钟和宗教器物带回波洛茨克。雅罗斯拉夫三王公于1067年3月在涅米加河将他击败，又在和谈时将他诱捕。1068年基辅起义把他从狱中救出，他在基辅执政七个月，1071年重新稳固波洛茨克。他修建了波洛茨克圣索菲亚大教堂，于1101年4月24日去世。

en: Vseslav Iziaslavich (990s–1003) was prince of Polotsk from 1001, the probably elder son of Iziaslav Vladimirovich and a grandson of Vladimir the Great of Kyiv. He appears to have been the first Polotsk prince to inherit his throne rather than receive it by grant, marking the principality's emergence as a hereditary Rurikid domain. The chronicles record only the year of his death. He likely died in childhood, and Polotsk passed to his brother Bryachislav.
zh: 弗谢斯拉夫·伊贾斯拉维奇（990年代—1003）自1001年起任波洛茨克王公，是伊贾斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇可能的长子，也是基辅大公弗拉基米尔大帝之孙。他似乎是首位以继承而非受封方式获得公位的波洛茨克王公，标志着波洛茨克成为留里克家族的世袭领地。编年史只留下他的卒年，他很可能幼年夭折，波洛茨克随后由其弟布里亚奇斯拉夫继承。

en: Aldona (baptized Anna; c. 1309 – 26 May 1339) was a Lithuanian princess, daughter of Grand Duke Gediminas, and from 1333 queen consort of Poland as the first wife of Casimir III. Their wedding on 30 April 1325 sealed the first Polish–Lithuanian alliance against the Teutonic Knights: Gediminas released some twenty-five thousand Polish captives, and in 1326 the two powers raided Brandenburg together. Remembered for her piety and the court musicians who always accompanied her, she died suddenly in May 1339 and was buried in Kraków, leaving two daughters.
zh: 阿尔东娜（洗礼名安娜，约1309—1339年5月26日）是立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯之女，1333年成为波兰王后，即国王卡齐米日三世的第一任妻子。1325年4月30日的婚礼促成了波兰与立陶宛首次结盟，共同对付条顿骑士团：格迪米纳斯释放了约2.5万名波兰俘虏，两国又于1326年联手攻袭勃兰登堡。她以虔诚和宫廷乐师终日随行闻名，1339年5月突然去世，葬于克拉科夫，身后留下两个女儿。

en: Bernardo Morando (c. 1540–1600) was an Italian architect, born in Padua or Venice in the Republic of Venice, who moved to Poland in 1569. In 1578 he signed an agreement with Great Crown Chancellor Jan Zamoyski to design the new foundation of Zamość, conceived as a Renaissance ideal city. He planned its layout, star-shaped fortifications, Lublin Gate, arsenal, Zamoyski Palace, Town Hall and collegiate church, largely complete by 1598. He also supervised the construction of burghers' houses and received two large houses in the city from Zamoyski. He also laid out the fortified towns of Tomaszów Lubelski and Szarogród. Morando served as mayor of Zamość in 1591–1593, was ennobled, and died there in 1600.
zh: 贝尔纳多·莫兰多（约1540—1600）是生于威尼斯共和国帕多瓦或威尼斯的意大利建筑师，1569年移居波兰。1578年，他与王国大总理扬·扎莫厄斯基签约，主持设计按文艺复兴“理想城市”理念兴建的新城扎莫希奇。他规划了城市布局、星形防御工事、卢布林门、军械库、扎莫伊斯基宫、市政厅和协同教堂，主体工程于1598年前基本完成。他还监督市民住宅的修建，并从扎莫厄斯基处获赠城中两座大宅。他还规划了设防城镇托马舒夫·卢贝尔斯基和沙罗格罗德。1591—1593年，莫兰多担任扎莫希奇市长，后受封贵族，1600年卒于当地。

en: Bolesław III Wrymouth (1086–1138) was duke of Poland from 1107. The son of Władysław I Herman, he and his half-brother Zbigniew expelled the palatine Sieciech in 1101 and divided the realm on their father's death in 1102. He later blinded Zbigniew, then did public penance and pilgrimaged to Hungary. Alliances with Hungary and Kievan Rus helped him repel an imperial invasion in 1109. From 1113 he conquered Pomerania in stages, with campaigns lasting into the 1120s; he incorporated Gdańsk Pomerania and supported Otto of Bamberg's missions. At the 1135 Congress of Merseburg he settled Pomerania's status with the Empire. His testament divided Poland among his sons, causing two centuries of fragmentation.
zh: 波列斯瓦夫三世，人称“歪嘴”（1086—1138），自1107年起为波兰公爵。他是瓦迪斯瓦夫一世·赫尔曼之子，1101年与异母兄兹比格涅夫联手逐走权臣谢切赫，1102年父亲死后两人瓜分国土。后来他弄瞎兹比格涅夫，随后公开忏悔并前往匈牙利朝圣。他与匈牙利和基辅罗斯结盟，帮助他在1109年击退神圣罗马帝国的入侵。1113年起他分阶段征服波美拉尼亚，战役持续至1120年代；他兼并格但斯克波美拉尼亚，并支持班贝格的奥托传教。1135年他在梅泽堡会议上与帝国敲定波美拉尼亚的地位。他的遗嘱把波兰分给诸子，导致近两百年的分裂。

en: Bolesław the Pious (1224/27–1279) was a Piast duke of Greater Poland, the second son of Duke Władysław Odonic. From 1257 he ruled the whole duchy, succeeding his elder brother Przemysł I and guarding his infant nephew Przemysł II. In 1258 he married Jolenta, daughter of King Béla IV of Hungary, and in 1262–1264 he served as regent of Masovia for the captive Duke Konrad II. In 1264 he issued the Statute of Kalisz, the first written charter of privileges for the Jews of Greater Poland. When he died in 1279 his lands passed to Przemysł II.
zh: 虔诚者波列斯瓦夫（1224/27—1279）是皮雅斯特王朝的大波兰公爵，瓦迪斯瓦夫·欧登尼采之次子。1257年其兄普热梅斯瓦夫一世去世后，他统治整个大波兰，并监护年幼的侄子普热梅斯瓦夫二世。1258年他娶匈牙利国王贝拉四世之女约伦塔（海伦娜）为妻，1262—1264年为被俘的康拉德二世摄政马佐夫舍。1264年，他颁布《卡利什特许状》，这是授予大波兰犹太人的首部成文特权法令。1279年他去世后，领地归于普热梅斯瓦夫二世。

en: Casimir III the Great (1310–1370), last Piast king of Poland, took the throne in 1333 over a small, ravaged realm. John of Bohemia still called himself king of Poland and was overlord of the Silesian dukes around it, and the Teutonic Order held Kuyavia. Casimir, who had married Aldona of Lithuania in 1325, chose treaties over war: at Visegrád in 1335 the arbitrators ordered Kuyavia and Dobrzyń returned, while he gave up Pomerania and the Chełmno Land to the Order; he also accepted the loss of Silesia. Turning east, he annexed Red Ruthenia in 1340. His Statutes of Wiślica and Piotrków codified Polish law, earning him the name the Polish Justinian. Nearly thirty towns were walled and some fifty castles built in his reign, and in 1364 he founded the University of Kraków. He confirmed Jewish privileges in 1334 and encouraged Jewish settlement. In 1355 he named his nephew Louis I of Hungary heir should he have no son. He died on 5 November 1370 without a legitimate son; Louis took the crown, and Piast rule ended.
zh: 卡齐米日三世，人称“大王”（1310—1370），是皮亚斯特王朝末代波兰国王。1333年即位时，他接手的是一个残破的小国：波希米亚的约翰仍自称波兰国王，并且是周围西里西亚诸公的宗主，条顿骑士团则占据着库亚维亚。1325年他娶立陶宛的阿尔东娜，对外宁可靠条约而不靠战争：1335年维谢格拉德仲裁，库亚维亚与多布任地归还波兰，他则把波美拉尼亚和海乌姆诺地让给骑士团；他还接受了失去西里西亚。随后他转向东方，1340年兼并红鲁塞尼亚。他颁布的维希利察与彼得库夫法规统一了波兰法律，赢得“波兰的查士丁尼”之称。在他治下，近三十座城镇筑起城墙，约五十座城堡落成，1364年他又创立克拉科夫大学。1334年他确认了犹太人的特权，并鼓励犹太人迁入。1355年他指定外甥匈牙利国王拉约什一世在自己无子时继位。1370年11月5日他去世，没有嫡子，拉约什继承王位，皮亚斯特王朝的统治至此终结。

en: Clemente Molli (c. 1599–1664) was an Italian sculptor born near Bologna into a family from Russi in Romagna; contemporaries also knew him as an architect and man of letters. He studied humanities and philosophy before turning to sculpture. After years working across northern Italy — a colossal marble group at Verona in 1634, depicting Venice and the River Adige, statues for Rovigo in 1635 and Forlì in 1636 — he settled in Venice, joined the Accademia degli Incogniti and often worked with Baldassare Longhena. Between 1644 and 1646 he carved in Warsaw the giant bronze statue of Sigismund III Vasa for Costante Tencalla's column. He died in Venice on 14 March 1664.
zh: 克莱门特·莫利（约1599—1664）是意大利雕塑家，生于博洛尼亚附近，家族原籍罗马涅的鲁西；时人还称他为建筑师与文人。他学习人文与哲学，后来转向雕塑。他早年在意大利北部辗转工作——1634年在维罗纳创作象征威尼斯与阿迪杰河的巨型大理石群雕，1635年和1636年分别为罗维戈、弗利制作雕像——后定居威尼斯，加入“匿名学院”，常与巴尔达萨雷·隆格纳合作。1644—1646年，他在华沙为科斯坦特·滕卡拉设计的圆柱雕刻齐格蒙特三世·瓦萨的巨型青铜像。1664年3月14日卒于威尼斯。

en: Costante Tencalla (1593–1646) was a Swiss-Italian architect born at Bissone on Lake Lugano. Trained in Rome, where he was a pupil, relative and associate of the Baroque architect Carlo Maderno, he followed his uncle Matteo Castelli to the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth and helped introduce early Roman Baroque architecture. Castelli became Poland's first royal architect. After Castelli's death in 1632 he worked at Bissone and Lugano before returning to Warsaw as royal architect to King Władysław IV Vasa. For the king he designed Sigismund's Column, erected in Warsaw in 1643–1644 with the sculptor Clemente Molli, and undertook buildings in Kraków, Lwów, Gniezno and Vilnius. He died in Warsaw in 1646.
zh: 科斯坦特·滕卡拉（1593—1646）是生于卢加诺湖畔比索内的瑞士籍意大利建筑师。他在罗马学艺，是巴洛克建筑师卡洛·马代尔诺的亲属、学生与合作者，后随叔父马泰奥·卡斯泰利前往波兰立陶宛联邦，将罗马早期巴洛克建筑引入当地。卡斯泰利成为波兰首位王室建筑师。1632年卡斯泰利去世后，他先在比索内和卢加诺工作，随后返回华沙，担任国王瓦迪斯瓦夫四世·瓦萨的王室建筑师。他为国王设计了1643—1644年在华沙竖立的西吉斯蒙德圆柱，由雕塑家克莱门特·莫利合作完成，并在克拉科夫、利沃夫、格涅兹诺和维尔纽斯主持工程。1646年卒于华沙。

en: Elizabeth of Poland (1326–1361) was the eldest daughter of Casimir III the Great of Poland and Aldona of Lithuania. Once betrothed to Louis VI the Roman, who instead married her younger sister Cunigunde, she was married on 28 February 1343 to Bogislaw V, Duke of Pomerania, sealing the anti-Teutonic agreement her father had signed in Poznań four days earlier. She lived mainly at Darłowo Castle and bore two children: Elizabeth of Pomerania, later the wife of Emperor Charles IV, and Casimir (Kaźko). She died in 1361 at an Augustinian monastery in Świątki and was buried there.
zh: 波兰的伊丽莎白（1326—1361）是波兰国王卡齐米日三世与立陶宛的阿尔东娜的长女。她原已许配给“罗马人”路易六世，对方后来却娶了她的妹妹库妮贡德。1343年2月24日，卡齐米日三世在波兹南与波美拉尼亚公爵博吉斯瓦夫五世达成针对条顿骑士团的盟约，四天后伊丽莎白便嫁给博吉斯瓦夫。她婚后主要住在达尔沃沃城堡，育有两个子女：后来成为神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理四世皇后的波美拉尼亚的伊丽莎白，以及卡齐米日（卡日科）。1361年她在希维翁特基的奥古斯丁会修道院去世并安葬于此。

en: Elizabeth of Poland (1305–1380), daughter of Władysław I the Elbow-high of the Piast dynasty and sister of Casimir III, became queen of Hungary by marriage to Charles I Robert. She founded a Poor Clares convent at Buda in 1334, endowed churches and shrines, and survived an assassination attempt that left her disabled. After her son Louis I took the throne in 1342 she became queen mother. In 1343 she travelled to Naples with almost the whole royal treasure to win the crown for her son Andrew, husband of Queen Joanna, and came away with only a promise from Joanna and the pope that he would be crowned as consort. When Casimir died in 1370 and Louis inherited Poland, she governed there as regent until 1376, a regency that ended in violence. She spent her last years in a monastery outside Buda, and died on 29 December 1380.
zh: 波兰的伊丽莎白（1305—1380）是皮雅斯特王朝的瓦迪斯瓦夫一世之女、卡齐米日三世的姊妹，嫁给匈牙利国王卡罗伊一世（查理·罗伯特），成为匈牙利王后。1334年她在布达创办贫穷修女会修道院，资助教堂与圣龛，并在一次刺杀中受伤致残。1342年儿子拉约什一世继位后，她成为王太后。1343年，她带着几乎整个王室财库前往那不勒斯，为儿子安德拉什，也就是乔万娜女王的丈夫争取王冠，结果只从乔万娜和教皇那里得到一个允诺：安德拉什将以王夫身份加冕。1370年卡齐米日三世去世、拉约什继承波兰王位，她出任波兰摄政至1376年，这段摄政以暴力收场。晚年她在布达城外的修道院度过，1380年12月29日去世。

en: Euphrosyne of Opole (1228/30–1292) was a Piast duchess, the youngest daughter of Duke Casimir I of Opole and his wife Viola. In 1257 she married her kinsman Casimir I of Kuyavia, bearing him four children, including Władysław I the Elbow-high, the future king who reunited Poland. After Casimir's death in December 1267 she ruled the Duchy of Kuyavia as regent for her sons until 1275, amid disputes with the Teutonic Order. That year she married Mestwin II, Duke of Pomerania; the childless marriage ended in divorce, and she died at Brześć Kujawski on 4 November 1292.
zh: 奥波莱的尤弗罗西娜（1228/30—1292）是皮雅斯特王朝的公爵夫人，奥波莱公爵卡齐米日一世与妻子维奥拉的幼女。1257年她嫁给同族的库亚维公爵卡齐米日一世，育有四个子女，其中包括后来重新统一波兰的瓦迪斯瓦夫一世。1267年12月丈夫去世后，她为诸子摄政库亚维公国直至1275年，任内与条顿骑士团屡起争端。同年她改嫁波美拉尼亚公爵梅斯特温二世，这段无嗣婚姻最终以离婚收场，她于1292年11月4日在库亚维地区布热希奇去世。

en: Hieronim Pinocci (1612–1676) was an Italian-born merchant, royal secretary, diplomat and writer, born at Lucca on 31 December 1612 and active in the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. He served King John II Casimir as envoy extraordinary to the Dutch Republic in 1658 and to England in 1659. In 1661 he edited the Merkuriusz Polski Ordynaryjny, the first Polish periodical newspaper, sponsored by the king and Queen Marie Louise Gonzaga and printed first in Kraków and then in Warsaw. The weekly covered European dynastic affairs and military campaigns and promoted political reform and stronger royal authority. He died in Warsaw on 28 October 1676.
zh: 希罗尼穆斯·皮诺奇（1612—1676）是意大利出身的商人、王室秘书、外交官与作家，1612年12月31日生于卢卡，后活跃于波兰立陶宛联邦。他受国王扬二世·卡齐米日委派，于1658年出任驻荷兰共和国特命使节，1659年出任驻英格兰特命使节。1661年，他主编《波兰信使报》，这是波兰第一份定期报纸，由国王与王后玛丽亚·路易莎·贡扎加赞助，先在克拉科夫、后在华沙印行。这份周报报道欧洲王朝事务与军事行动，提倡政治改革和加强王权。1676年10月28日卒于华沙。

en: Jadwiga of Kalisz (1266 – 10 December 1339) was the daughter of Bolesław the Pious, duke of Greater Poland, and Yolanda of Hungary. In 1293 she married Władysław Łokietek, then fighting Wenceslaus II of Bohemia for control of Poland, and in 1300 she had to flee into hiding with her children. She was crowned queen beside Władysław in Kraków on 30 January 1320 and took an active part in politics; her daughter Elizabeth married Charles I of Hungary that year. Mother of Casimir III, she governed Stary Sącz as regent from 1334 and died in 1339.
zh: 卡利什的雅德维加（1266—1339年12月10日）是大波兰公爵“虔诚者”博莱斯瓦夫与匈牙利的约兰达之女。1293年她嫁给正同波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫二世争夺波兰的瓦迪斯瓦夫一世“矮子”，1300年被迫带着子女逃亡躲藏。1320年1月30日，她在克拉科夫与丈夫一同加冕为波兰王后，此后积极参与政事；同年女儿伊丽莎白嫁给匈牙利国王查理一世。她是卡齐米日三世的母亲，1334年起在斯塔里松奇摄政，1339年去世。

en: Jan Zamoyski (1542–1605) was a Polish nobleman, statesman and magnate, educated at Paris, Strasbourg and Padua, where he took a law doctorate in 1564 and was elected rector of the law faculty in 1563. Returning to Poland in 1565, he became royal secretary, then Deputy Chancellor in 1576, Grand Chancellor of the Crown in 1578 and Great Hetman in 1581. After the Jagiellon dynasty died out in 1572, he helped secure the right of all nobles to vote in the royal election. A key adviser to Stephen Báthory, he led Polish forces in the Livonian campaigns, founded the city of Zamość and its academy, and in 1588 defeated the Habsburg claimant Maximilian III at Byczyna. He died on 3 June 1605.
zh: 扬·扎莫厄斯基（1542—1605）是波兰政治家与大贵族，曾在巴黎、斯特拉斯堡和帕多瓦求学，1564年获法学博士学位，1563年当选法学院院长。1565年回国后，他历任王室秘书，1576年任副总理、1578年任王国大总理、1581年任王国大盖特曼。1572年雅盖隆王朝绝嗣后，他推动确立全体贵族参与选王的权利。作为斯特凡·巴托里的核心谋臣，他率军参与利沃尼亚战争，兴建扎莫希奇城及扎莫希奇学院，并于1588年在贝奇纳战役击败哈布斯堡家族的王位竞争者马克西米连三世。1605年6月3日去世。

en: Casimir II the Just (1138–1194), a posthumous son of Bolesław III Wrymouth, received no land in his father's testament. In 1157 he was sent to Germany as a hostage to secure his brother's loyalty to Emperor Frederick Barbarossa. He ruled Wiślica from 1166 and Sandomierz from 1173, and in 1177, backed by nobles against his brother Mieszko III the Old, seized Kraków and became high duke of Poland. At the 1180 Assembly of Łęczyca he granted privileges to the Church. In 1184 he did homage to Emperor Frederick Barbarossa, and in 1186 inherited Masovia from his nephew Leszek, founding the Masovian Piast line. He ruled Kraków until his death in 1194, though Mieszko briefly displaced him; the Just is a 16th-century title.
zh: 卡齐米日二世，人称“正义者”（1138—1194），是波列斯瓦夫三世的遗腹子，父亲的遗嘱中没有分给他土地。1157年，他被送往德国作人质，以保证兄长效忠皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨。他自1166年统治维希利察，1173年起统治桑多梅日；1177年在贵族支持下对抗兄长“老者”梅什科三世，夺取克拉科夫，成为波兰大公。1180年文奇察会议上，他向教会授予特权。1184年他向皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨行臣服礼，1186年从侄子莱谢克手中继承马佐夫舍，开创马佐夫舍皮亚斯特支系。他统治克拉科夫至1194年去世，期间曾被梅什科短暂夺位；“正义者”之称直到16世纪才出现。

en: Kunigunde of Poland (c. 1328 – 26 April 1357) was the younger daughter of Casimir III the Great of Poland and Aldona of Lithuania. To block her match with the Wittelsbachs, John of Bohemia besieged Kraków in 1345 but failed to take the city, and that year she married Louis the Roman, son of Emperor Louis IV, duke of Bavaria and margrave of Brandenburg. Her husband soon returned to Bavaria, leaving her in Kraków; she only joined him in Berlin in 1356 and died there on 26 April 1357. The marriage was childless.
zh: 波兰的库妮贡德（约1328—1357年4月26日）是波兰国王卡齐米日三世与立陶宛的阿尔东娜的幼女。为阻止她与维特尔斯巴赫家族联姻，波希米亚国王约翰于1345年围攻克拉科夫却未能破城；同年她嫁给神圣罗马帝国皇帝路易四世之子、巴伐利亚公爵兼勃兰登堡藩侯“罗马人”路易。婚后不久丈夫便返回巴伐利亚，把她留在克拉科夫，她直到1356年才前往柏林与其团聚，1357年4月26日去世，两人没有子女。

en: Maciej, called Maćko, Borkowic (1298–1360), of the Napiwon arms, was voivode of Poznań from 1343 and a leader of Greater Poland's nobility. He campaigned in Red Ruthenia in 1340 and served as starosta of Poznań in 1348–1352, after Casimir III replaced the general governor with two local officials. When Casimir restored the general governorship in 1352 under Wierzbięta z Paniewic, Borkowic led the knightly confederation formed at Poznań that September. Greater Poland descended into civil war. After killing the voivode of Kalisz he was exiled to Silesia, returned in 1356 and swore fealty at Sieradz in 1358. Arrested in 1360 and tried by the king himself, he was starved to death in Olsztyn castle tower.
zh: 马切伊（人称马奇科）·博尔科维奇（1298—1360），纳皮温纹章，1343年起任波兹南总督，是大波兰贵族的领袖之一。1340年他随大波兰骑士出征红罗斯，1348年卡齐米日三世废除总长官一职，改设两名地方长官，博尔科维奇于1348—1352年担任其中的波兹南长官。1352年卡齐米日恢复总长官一职并授予维尔兹本塔·兹·帕涅维茨，博尔科维奇遂于当年9月在波兹南领导骑士联盟，起兵对抗国王，大波兰陷入内战。他杀死卡利什总督后被逐往西里西亚，1356年回国，1358年在谢拉兹宣誓效忠。1360年他被捕，由国王亲自审判，最终在奥尔什丁城堡塔楼中饿死。

en: Michael Sendivogius (1566–1636) was a Polish alchemist, philosopher and physician, born into a noble family of the Ostoja clan and educated at Kraków, Vienna, Leipzig and Cambridge. In the 1590s he worked at Emperor Rudolf II's court in Prague, and around 1600 he entered the service of King Sigismund III Vasa, an alchemy enthusiast who conducted experiments with him at Wawel Castle. A pioneer of chemistry, he devised ways of purifying acids and metals, designed mines and foundries, and wrote the influential treatise The New Chemical Light. He held that air contained a substance essential to life, which he identified with a gas released by heating saltpetre. He also served as a diplomat and died in obscurity in 1636.
zh: 迈克尔·森达兹沃（1566—1636）是波兰炼金术士、哲学家与医生，出身奥斯特亚氏族的贵族家庭，曾在克拉科夫、维也纳、莱比锡和剑桥求学。1590年代他在布拉格为鲁道夫二世宫廷效力，约1600年进入国王齐格蒙特三世·瓦萨的宫廷；痴迷炼金术的国王曾与他一同在瓦维尔城堡做实验。作为化学先驱，他改进了酸与金属的提纯方法，设计矿山和铸造厂，并著有影响深远的炼金术著作《新化学之光》。他认为空气含有维持生命的物质，并认定它就是加热硝石时释放的气体。他还曾出任外交官，1636年在相对落寞中去世。

en: Mieszko III the Old (c. 1122–1202) was a Piast duke, the fourth son of Bolesław III Wrymouth. His father's 1138 testament gave him Greater Poland, ruled from Poznań. In 1173 he succeeded his brother Bolesław IV as high duke at Kraków, but his drive to raise revenues and curb the nobility and clergy provoked a revolt that ousted him in 1177. He briefly retook Kraków in 1191 and after years of civil war recovered the high ducal title in 1198, holding it until his death at Kalisz in 1202, while keeping Greater Poland as his hereditary base.
zh: 梅什科三世“年老的”（约1122—1202）是皮亚斯特王朝王公，博莱斯瓦夫三世“歪嘴”的第四子。按父亲1138年的遗嘱，他分得大波兰，以波兹南为中心进行统治。1173年，他继兄长博莱斯瓦夫四世之后在克拉科夫就任大公，但他增收赋税、压制贵族与教会的举措激起叛乱，于1177年被赶下台。他一度于1191年夺回克拉科夫，又经多年内战后在1198年重获大公称号，直至1202年在卡利什去世；大波兰则始终是他的世袭根基。

en: Nicolaus Copernicus (1473–1543) was an astronomer born at Toruń in Royal Prussia, a region incorporated into the Polish Crown after the Thirteen Years' War. He studied in Kraków and in Italy, taking a doctorate in canon law at Ferrara in 1503. From 1503 he served his uncle Lucas Watzenrode, bishop of Warmia, as secretary and physician, then spent decades as a canon and administrator at Frombork. Before 1514 he circulated his Commentariolus outlining a heliocentric universe. He also worked on monetary questions, formulating a quantity theory of money in 1517. In 1543 his De revolutionibus orbium coelestium was printed at Nuremberg through Georg Rheticus, launching the Copernican Revolution. He died at Frombork on 24 May 1543, shortly after the book appeared.
zh: 天文学家尼古拉·哥白尼（1473—1543）生于王家普鲁士的托伦，这一地区在十三年战争后并入波兰王国。他曾在克拉科夫和意大利求学，1503年在费拉拉获得教会法博士学位。1503年起，他担任舅父瓦尔米亚主教乌卡什·瓦岑罗德的秘书兼医生，此后数十年在弗龙堡任大教堂教士并处理行政事务。1514年之前，他已散发阐述日心宇宙体系的《短论》。他也研究货币问题，1517年提出货币数量理论。1543年，《天体运行论》经由格奥尔格·雷蒂库斯在纽伦堡印行，开启了哥白尼革命。1543年5月24日，他在弗龙堡去世，此时书刚刚问世。

en: Odon of Poznań (c. 1145–1194), or Odon Mieszkowic, was the eldest son of Mieszko III the Old and Elisabeth of Hungary. In 1177 he joined the Lesser Polish revolt against his father, who had tried to force him into the priesthood and favored his younger half-brothers; backed by his uncle Casimir II he ruled Greater Poland in 1179–1181. After Mieszko III's return he received Poznań in the 1191 partition and Kalisz in 1193, where his mint struck coins reading Odon Dux. He died on 20 April 1194 and was buried at Poznań, leaving a young son, Władysław Odonic.
zh: 波兹南的奥东（约1145—1194），又称奥东·梅什科维奇，是梅什科三世“年老的”与匈牙利的伊丽莎白的长子。1177年，他参加小波兰贵族反对父亲的叛乱：梅什科三世曾试图逼他出家为僧，又偏爱第二次婚姻所生的弟弟们；在叔父“正义的”卡齐米日二世支持下，他于1179至1181年统治大波兰。梅什科三世返国后，他在1191年的分封中得到波兹南，1193年又得到卡利什，并在当地开设造币厂，铸有“奥东公爵”字样的钱币。1194年4月20日他去世，葬于波兹南，留下年幼的儿子瓦迪斯瓦夫·奥多尼奇。

en: Stanislaus of Szczepanów (1030–1079) was bishop of Kraków and one of the earliest native Polish bishops. Educated at Gniezno and probably Paris, he became a Kraków canon known for his preaching and was elected bishop in 1072, accepting only at the command of Pope Alexander II. As advisor to Bolesław II he helped bring papal legates to Poland and restore the archiepiscopal see of Gniezno, a precondition of the king's 1076 coronation. After a conflict with Bolesław, he was executed in 1079. Canonized in 1253, he is a patron saint of Poland.
zh: 斯坦尼斯瓦夫（1030—1079）是克拉科夫主教，也是最早的波兰籍主教之一。他在格涅兹诺求学，据传还曾就读巴黎，后成为克拉科夫大教堂教士，以讲道闻名，1072年被选为主教，直到教皇亚历山大二世下令才接受。作为博莱斯瓦夫二世的顾问，他促成教皇使节赴波兰并恢复格涅兹诺大主教区，为国王1076年加冕创造了条件。他与博莱斯瓦夫发生冲突，于1079年被处死。他于1253年被追封为圣徒，是波兰的主保圣人之一。

en: Adalbert of Prague, born Vojtěch (c. 956–997), was bishop of Prague and a missionary martyr. Of the powerful Slavnik family of Bohemia, he studied at Magdeburg and became bishop in 982, while still under canonical age. Conflicts with Bohemian nobles drove him into retreat at Rome; after returning to his diocese, he founded Břevnov Abbey in 993. Released from his see as a missionary bishop, he preached in Hungary and in March 997 joined Bolesław Chrobry at Gniezno before entering pagan Prussia, where tribesmen killed him on 23 April 997. Canonized in 999, he is a patron saint of Poland and Bohemia.
zh: 布拉格的亚德伯（约956—997），原名沃伊切赫，是布拉格主教和传教殉道者。他出身波希米亚权势显赫的斯拉夫尼克家族，在马格德堡求学，982年未满教会法定年龄便被推举为布拉格主教。他与波希米亚贵族屡次冲突，一度退隐罗马；返回教区后，他于993年创建布热夫诺夫修道院。后来他获准以传教主教身份离开教区，赴匈牙利传教，997年3月在格涅兹诺投奔博莱斯瓦夫·赫罗布里，随后进入异教的普鲁士，997年4月23日在那里被普鲁士人杀害。他于999年被追封圣徒，是波兰和波希米亚的主保圣人。

en: Wincenty Kadłubek (c. 1150–1223) was bishop of Kraków and the leading Polish scholar of his age. Educated at the Kraków cathedral school and then at Paris and Bologna, he was ordained before 1189 and served as provost of Sandomierz Cathedral. Consecrated bishop in 1208, he worked to reform the Kraków clergy. He wrote the Chronica Polonorum, the first chronicle of Polish history composed by a Pole and a cardinal source for early medieval Poland. In 1218 he resigned his see and retired to the Cistercian monastery at Jędrzejów, where he died in 1223. He was beatified in 1764.
zh: 文岑蒂·卡德乌贝克（约1150—1223）是克拉科夫主教，也是当时波兰首屈一指的学者。他先后在克拉科夫大教堂学校及巴黎、博洛尼亚求学，1189年前获授神职，曾任桑多梅日大教堂教长。1208年他就任克拉科夫主教，致力于改革教区神职人员。他撰写的《波兰编年史》是第一部由波兰人写成的波兰编年史，也是研究波兰早期中世纪史的核心史料。1218年他辞去主教职务，退隐延杰尤夫的熙笃会修道院，1223年在那里去世。他于1764年受宣福礼。

en: Wincenty of Kielcza (c. 1200–after 1262) was a Polish Dominican canon, poet, and the first Polish composer known by name. From about 1222 he served as chaplain to Bishop Iwo Odrowąż of Kraków, becoming a Kraków canon in 1257 and prior of the Dominican house at Racibórz in 1258–1260. For the 1254 translation of Saint Stanislaus's relics he composed the liturgical office Historia gloriosissimi Stanislai, containing the hymn Gaude Mater Polonia, long sung by Polish knights after victory. He also wrote a shorter and a longer life of Saint Stanislaus.
zh: 凯尔恰的文岑蒂（约1200—1262年后）是波兰多明我会教士、诗人，也是第一位留下姓名的波兰作曲家。约1222年起，他担任克拉科夫主教伊沃·奥德龙日的随行神职人员，1257年成为克拉科夫大教堂教士，1258至1260年任拉齐布日多明我会修道院院长。为1254年迎奉圣斯坦尼斯瓦夫圣髑，他创作了礼仪组曲《至荣斯坦尼斯瓦夫事记》，其中包括赞美诗《欢乐吧，波兰母亲》，长期由波兰骑士在获胜后传唱。他还撰写了长短两部圣斯坦尼斯瓦夫生平。

en: Władysław I the Elbow-high (c. 1260–1333) was the Piast duke who reunited Poland, the son of Casimir I of Kuyavia and Euphrosyne of Opole. In 1293 he married Hedwig, daughter of Bolesław the Pious. Driven into exile by Wenceslaus II of Bohemia, he recovered Kraków in 1306 after Wenceslaus III was murdered. With papal approval he was crowned king in January 1320, the first Polish royal coronation at Wawel Cathedral in Kraków. His later reign was dominated by war with the Teutonic Order. He died on 2 March 1333 and was succeeded by his son Casimir III the Great.
zh: 瓦迪斯瓦夫一世（矮子，约1260—1333）是重新统一波兰的皮雅斯特公爵，卡齐米日一世与奥波莱的尤弗罗西娜之子。1293年他娶虔诚者波列斯瓦夫之女雅德维加为妻。他曾被波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫二世驱逐流亡，1306年瓦茨拉夫三世遇刺后收复克拉科夫。在教廷批准下，他于1320年1月加冕为波兰国王，这是首次在克拉科夫瓦维尔主教座堂举行的波兰国王加冕礼。他在位后期主要与条顿骑士团作战。1333年3月2日他去世，其子卡齐米日三世（大帝）继位。

en: Władysław Odonic, called the Spitter (c. 1190–1239), was a Piast duke of Greater Poland, son of Odon of Poznań. From 1206 he fought his uncle Władysław III Spindleshanks for his inheritance, in years of exile. With Pomeranian help he routed the high duke's army at Ujście in 1227 and seized most of Greater Poland. At Gąsawa that November he was blamed for the ambush that killed Leszek the White. In 1229 he expelled his uncle and ruled all Greater Poland until 1234, when Henry I the Bearded took its southern and western lands. He died on 5 June 1239.
zh: 瓦迪斯瓦夫·奥多尼奇，绰号“吐痰者”（约1190—1239），是大波兰的皮亚斯特王公，波兹南的奥东之子。自1206年起，他为继承权同叔父瓦迪斯瓦夫三世“细腿”交战，流亡多年。在波美拉尼亚人支持下，他于1227年在乌伊希切击溃大公的军队，攻占大波兰大部。同年11月的贡萨瓦王公会议上，他被指应为设伏杀害大公莱谢克一世“白公”一事负责。1229年他驱逐叔父，统治整个大波兰；1234年亨里克一世“大胡子”夺去大波兰南部和西部土地。1239年6月5日他去世。

en: Iaroslav Sviatopolkovich (c. 1072–1123) was a Rurikid prince, the second son of Sviatopolk II, Grand Prince of Kiev. In 1100, after the Vitichev congress stripped Davyd Igorevich of Volhynia, his father made him prince of Vladimir-in-Volhynia. In 1102 the people of Novgorod refused to accept him as their prince. He strengthened ties with Hungary through marriage to a daughter of King Ladislaus I, and later wed Rogneda, daughter of Mstislav the Great. After he clashed with Vladimir Monomakh, who took Kiev in 1113, he sent Rogneda away and was driven from Volhynia in 1118. He fled to Poland and Hungary, returning with their troops to besiege Vladimir-in-Volhynia in 1123, where he was killed.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/雅罗斯拉夫·斯维亚托波尔科维奇
zh: 雅罗斯拉夫·斯维亚托波尔科维奇（约1072—1123）是留里克王朝王公、基辅大公斯维亚托波尔克二世的次子。1100年维季切夫会议剥夺了达维德·伊戈列维奇的沃伦领地，他随即被父亲封为弗拉基米尔-沃伦斯基王公。1102年，诺夫哥罗德人拒绝接纳他为王公。他先与匈牙利国王拉斯洛一世之女联姻，后又娶姆斯季斯拉夫大帝之女罗格涅达。1113年弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫取得基辅，雅罗斯拉夫与其发生冲突，送走了罗格涅达，并于1118年被逐出沃伦。他先后逃亡波兰和匈牙利，1123年率两国军队回攻弗拉基米尔-沃伦斯基，在围城时战死。

en: Barnim I the Good (c. 1217–1278), of the Griffin dynasty, ruled as duke of Pomerania from his father Bogislaw II's death in 1220, sharing power with his cousin Wartislaw III at Demmin. After the North German princes defeated Denmark at Bornhöved in 1227, Emperor Frederick II placed Pomerania under Brandenburg's suzerainty, and by the 1250 Treaty of Landin Barnim surrendered the Uckermark and accepted Ascanian overlordship. In 1264 he inherited Wartislaw's lands and united the duchy. He promoted German settlement and granted rights to Stettin in 1243 and many other towns. He died on 13 November 1278.
zh: 巴尔宁一世（约1217—1278），绰号‘善人’，出身格里芬家族，1220年父亲波吉斯瓦夫二世去世后成为波美拉尼亚公爵，与驻节代明的堂兄瓦季斯瓦夫三世分权而治。1227年北德诸侯在博恩赫沃德击败丹麦后，皇帝腓特烈二世将波美拉尼亚置于勃兰登堡的宗主权之下；1250年巴尔宁依据《兰丁条约》割让乌克马克，接受阿斯坎尼家族的宗主权。1264年他继承瓦季斯瓦夫的领地，统一波美拉尼亚公国。他推动德意志移民东进，1243年赐什切青城市权，其他许多城市也在其治下获得特权。他于1278年11月13日去世。

en: Bogislaw IV (c. 1255–1309), of the Griffin dynasty, was the eldest son of Barnim I of Pomerania and served as co-ruler from 1276 before succeeding as duke in 1278. While his half-brothers were underage he ruled the duchy alone, and in the early 1280s he intervened in the war over Brandenburg. After Barnim II died in 1295, Pomerania was partitioned and Bogislaw took Wolgast while Otto I received Szczecin. He later allied with Władysław the Short of Poland and fought in the Brandenburg War. He was buried in Stettin's Marienkirche and succeeded by his son Wartislaw IV.
zh: 波吉斯瓦夫四世（约1255—1309）出身格里芬家族，是波美拉尼亚公爵巴尔宁一世的长子，1276年起任共治者，1278年继位为公爵。他在异母弟年幼期间独掌公国，1280年代初卷入邻近勃兰登堡侯国的战争。1295年巴尔宁二世死后，波美拉尼亚被一分为二：波吉斯瓦夫获得沃尔加斯特，奥托一世获得什切青。他后来与波兰的瓦迪斯瓦夫一世（矮子）结盟，并参加勃兰登堡战争。他葬于什切青的圣母教堂，由其子瓦尔齐斯瓦夫四世继位。

en: Afonso I Henriques (1109–1185), called the Conqueror, was the son of Henry of Burgundy and Theresa of León, counts of Portugal. After Henry died in 1112, Theresa governed with the Galician Fernando Pérez de Traba; Portuguese nobles rallied around Afonso, who defeated her at the Battle of São Mamede in 1128 and ruled as count. He crushed the Moors at Ourique in 1139 and proclaimed himself king of independent Portugal. He secured independence after defeating León at Valdevez. Second Crusaders helped him take Santarém and Lisbon in 1147, and the papal bull Manifestis Probatum recognized the kingdom. When he died in 1185 he had doubled Portugal's size; his son Sancho I succeeded him.
zh: 阿方索·恩里克斯（1109—1185），人称“征服者”，是勃艮第的恩里克与莱昂的特蕾莎之子，父母都是葡萄牙伯国的统治者。1112年恩里克去世后，特蕾莎与加利西亚的费尔南多·佩雷斯·德·特拉瓦共同执政；葡萄牙贵族转而支持阿方索，他于1128年在圣马梅斯战役中击败母亲，即位为葡萄牙伯爵。1139年他在奥里基战役大败摩尔人，随后自立为独立的葡萄牙国王。他在瓦尔德韦什击败莱昂，巩固了独立。1147年，第二次十字军协助他攻占圣塔伦和里斯本，教皇随后颁布《明显的证明》诏书承认葡萄牙王国。1185年他去世时已使葡萄牙疆域扩大一倍，儿子桑乔一世继位。

en: Afonso II (1185–1223), called the Fat, was third king of Portugal and eldest surviving son of Sancho I and Dulce of Aragon, succeeding in 1211. He opened his reign by exiling rebellious siblings. He kept peace with Castile, while his nobles conquered Alcácer do Sal from the Moors. He built up royal administration and issued Portugal's first written laws, covering private property, civil justice and coinage. He opened trade with northern Europe and in 1220 began the inquirições to recover crown lands. His curbs on Church wealth led Pope Honorius III to excommunicate him. He died at Coimbra in 1223; his sons Sancho II and Afonso III both later became kings.
zh: 阿方索二世（1185—1223），人称“胖子”，是葡萄牙第三位国王、桑乔一世与阿拉贡的杜尔塞存活的长子，1211年继位。他即位之初便放逐了叛乱的兄弟姐妹。他与卡斯蒂利亚保持和平，阿尔卡塞尔-杜萨尔则由贵族们从摩尔人手中攻取。他加强王室行政，颁布葡萄牙最早的成文法，涉及私产、民事司法和铸币。他与北欧建立通商，并于1220年发起土地清查，以收回王室土地。由于限制教会财产，他被教皇霍诺里乌斯三世开除教籍。1223年他在科英布拉去世，他的儿子桑乔二世和阿方索三世后来先后为王。

en: Afonso III (1210–1279), called the Boulonnais, was the second son of Afonso II. In France he married Matilda II, Countess of Boulogne, in 1238 and ruled her county jure uxoris. In 1245 Pope Innocent IV declared his brother Sancho II deposed, and Afonso took Portugal. He styled himself overseer, curator and defender of the kingdom until Sancho died in 1248. After Faro fell in 1249 he became the first king styled King of Portugal and the Algarve, completing the Reconquista. In 1253 he divorced Matilda and married Beatrice of Castile. In 1254 he summoned the Cortes of Leiria, the first assembly with representatives of the towns, and made Lisbon his capital. The 1267 Treaty of Badajoz fixed the Castilian frontier on the Guadiana.
zh: 阿方索三世（1210—1279），绰号“布洛涅人”，是葡萄牙国王阿方索二世的次子。他在法国于1238年娶布洛涅女伯爵玛蒂尔达二世，以妻权统治布洛涅伯国。1245年教皇英诺森四世宣布废黜其兄桑乔二世，阿方索接掌葡萄牙。直到桑乔于1248年去世，他一直使用王国监督者、管理者与捍卫者的称号。1249年法鲁陷落后，他成为第一个使用“葡萄牙与阿尔加维国王”称号的君主，收复失地运动就此完成。1253年，他与玛蒂尔达离婚，娶卡斯蒂利亚的比阿特丽斯为妻。1254年他在莱里亚召开首次有城镇代表参加的议会，并定都里斯本。1267年的《巴达霍斯条约》将卡斯蒂利亚边界定为瓜迪亚纳河。

en: Afonso IV (1291–1357), called the Brave, was the only legitimate son of King Denis and Elizabeth of Aragon, but not his father's favourite: the old king preferred his bastard Afonso Sanches, and the half-brothers' rivalry several times ended in civil war. In 1309 Afonso married Beatrice of Castile. On succeeding in 1325 he exiled Sanches to Castile; after Sanches' failed invasions from there, their mother Elizabeth arranged a peace. In 1340 Afonso joined Alfonso XI of Castile in defeating the Marinids at Salado. His long reign was mostly peaceful, and he funded a commercial fleet and ordered Portugal's first maritime explorations. It ended in family tragedy. Alarmed by Castilian influence, as the brothers of his son Peter's mistress Inês de Castro became Peter's closest advisers, he had her murdered at Coimbra in 1355. Peter ravaged the country between the Douro and the Minho before father and son made peace in early 1357, and Afonso died that May.
zh: 阿方索四世（1291—1357），绰号“勇敢者”，是国王迪尼什与阿拉贡的伊莎贝拉唯一的嫡子，却不是父亲偏爱的儿子：老国王宠信私生子阿方索·桑切斯，两兄弟的积怨数次演变成内战。1309年，他与卡斯蒂利亚的比阿特丽斯成婚。1325年继位后，他把桑切斯放逐到卡斯蒂利亚；桑切斯从那里数次发兵入侵未果，最终在母亲伊莎贝拉的调解下议和。1340年，他与卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十一世联手，在萨拉多战役击败马里尼德人。他在位期间大体太平，出资组建商船队，下令进行葡萄牙最早的海上探险。晚年却以家庭悲剧收场：儿子佩德罗的情妇伊内斯·德·卡斯特罗的兄弟成了佩德罗最亲近的谋臣，他担心卡斯蒂利亚势力渗入，于1355年下令在科英布拉杀害伊内斯。佩德罗发兵蹂躏杜罗河与米尼奥河之间的土地，直到1357年初父子和解，阿方索当年5月去世。

en: Beatrice of Castile (1242/1244–1303) was an illegitimate daughter of Alfonso X of Castile and Mayor Guillén de Guzmán. In 1253 she married Afonso III of Portugal, in a settlement of Castile's claims over the Algarve. Afonso was still married to Matilda II of Boulogne, who accused him of bigamy in 1255; in 1258 the Pope condemned him for adultery. As queen Beatrice promoted Portuguese-Castilian rapprochement. She inherited her mother's estates in La Alcarria and protected the monastery of Santa Clara at Alcocer. After Afonso's death she quarrelled with her son King Denis, returned to Castile in 1282, supported Alfonso X against her half-brother Sancho, and was at her father's deathbed in 1284. She died in 1303 and was buried at Alcobaça.
zh: 卡斯蒂利亚的比阿特丽斯（1242/1244—1303）是卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十世与情妇玛约尔·纪廉·德·古斯曼的私生女。1253年她嫁给葡萄牙国王阿方索三世，这桩婚事意在了结卡斯蒂利亚对阿尔加维的主权要求。阿方索当时仍与布洛涅的玛蒂尔达二世保持婚姻，玛蒂尔达于1255年控告他重婚；1258年教皇因通奸谴责他。作为王后，比阿特丽斯推动葡萄牙与卡斯蒂利亚修好。她继承了母亲在拉阿尔卡里亚的产业，并庇护阿尔科塞尔的圣克拉拉修道院。阿方索三世去世后，她与儿子迪尼什国王不和，1282年返回卡斯蒂利亚，支持父亲阿方索十世对抗异母弟桑乔，并在1284年为父亲送终。她于1303年去世，葬于阿尔科巴萨修道院。

en: Beatrice of Castile (1293–1359), daughter of Sancho IV and María de Molina, was born at Toro. The 1297 Treaty of Alcañices ended the war between Castile and Portugal and arranged marriages for two pairs of siblings, so at four she was betrothed to the Portuguese infante Afonso and sent to grow up at King Denis's court, a home of troubadours. After a papal dispensation they married in Lisbon in 1309. Queen from 1325, she worked, like her mother-in-law Elizabeth of Aragon, as a mediator. When Afonso IV and her son-in-law Alfonso XI of Castile went to war in 1336, she crossed the border to Badajoz to ask for peace, in vain. In 1355 she and the archbishop of Braga helped reconcile her son Peter with his father after the murder of Inês de Castro. After her daughter-in-law Constance died in 1345, she raised the future Ferdinand I. She died in 1359 and lies beside her husband in Lisbon Cathedral.
zh: 卡斯蒂利亚的比阿特丽斯（1293—1359）是桑乔四世与玛丽亚·德·莫利纳之女，生于托罗。1297年的《阿尔卡尼伊塞斯条约》结束了卡斯蒂利亚与葡萄牙之间的战事，并安排了两对兄妹的联姻，四岁的她因此许配给葡萄牙王子阿方索，被送到迪尼什国王宫中长大，那里是游吟诗人云集之地。获教皇特许后，两人于1309年在里斯本成婚。1325年起她身为王后，像婆婆阿拉贡的伊莎贝尔一样充当宫廷纷争的调停人。1336年，丈夫阿方索四世与她的女婿卡斯蒂利亚的阿方索十一世开战，她越境前往巴达霍斯求和，未能成功。1355年，儿子佩德罗因伊内斯·德·卡斯特罗被害与父亲决裂，她与布拉加大主教出面斡旋，促成和解。1345年儿媳康斯坦丝去世后，她又抚养了后来的费尔南多一世。1359年她在里斯本去世，葬于里斯本大教堂，与丈夫相邻。

en: Denis (1261–1325), called the Farmer King and the Poet King, was the eldest son of Afonso III and ruled Portugal from 1279. In 1290 he decreed Portuguese the language of the law courts and founded the kingdom's first university in Lisbon. He promoted agriculture and ordered pine forests planted near Leiria to prevent soil degradation and supply timber for royal ships. In 1293 he approved a merchants' maritime insurance fund, and in 1308 signed Portugal's first commercial treaty with England. In 1319 he founded the Order of Christ to inherit the estates of the suppressed Templars. His poetry helped make Portuguese a literary language. His last years saw civil war between his heir Afonso and bastard son Afonso Sanches.
zh: 迪尼什（1261—1325），绰号“农夫国王”与“诗人国王”，是阿方索三世的长子，1279年起统治葡萄牙。1290年，他下令以葡萄牙语为法庭用语，并在里斯本创办国内第一所大学。他推动农业，下令在莱里亚附近营造松林，以防止土壤退化并为王室船只提供木材。1293年，他批准设立商人海上保险基金；1308年，他与英格兰签订葡萄牙第一个通商条约。1319年，他创立基督骑士团，接管被取缔的圣殿骑士团财产。他的诗作推动葡萄牙语成为文学语言。晚年，继承人阿方索与私生子阿方索·桑切斯之间爆发内战。

en: Eleanor of Portugal (1328 – 30 October 1348) was a Portuguese infanta, the youngest daughter of King Afonso IV and Beatrice of Castile, and sister of Peter I. In 1347 two rulers competed for Portuguese support, and on 14 November 1347 she married Peter IV of Aragon in Barcelona as his second wife, becoming the only Portuguese-born queen of Aragon. Travelling to Jérica the next year, she caught the Black Death at Teruel and died on 30 October 1348. Her remains were moved to Poblet Monastery in June 1350.
zh: 葡萄牙的埃莉诺（1328—1348年10月30日）是葡萄牙国王阿方索四世与卡斯蒂利亚的比阿特丽斯的幼女、国王佩德罗一世的妹妹。1347年两位君主为争取葡萄牙的支持竞相求娶，11月14日她在巴塞罗那嫁给阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世为第二任王后，也是唯一一位出生于葡萄牙的阿拉贡王后。次年她在前往赫里卡途中于特鲁埃尔染上黑死病，1348年10月30日病逝，1350年6月迁葬波夫莱特修道院。

en: Estêvão Gonçalves Leitão (born c. 1290) was a Portuguese noble who served as master of the Order of Christ and fought the Castilians near Braga in the 1336–1339 war under King Afonso IV.
zh: 埃斯特旺·贡萨尔维斯·莱唐（约1290年生）是葡萄牙贵族，曾任基督骑士团团长，在阿方索四世治下的1336—1339年葡萄牙-卡斯蒂利亚战争中，于布拉加附近与卡斯蒂利亚军队作战。

en: Fernão Dias Pais Leme (c. 1608–1681) was a São Paulo bandeirante nicknamed the Emerald Hunter. In 1638 he joined António Raposo Tavares' bandeira into southern Brazil, and from 1644 he led his own slave-raiding expeditions into the sertão. He was elected a local judge in 1651 and promoted reconciliation between the settlers and Jesuits in 1653. In 1661 he again led an expedition against Jesuit missions to capture Indigenous people for enslavement. In 1671 Governor Afonso Furtado commissioned him to find the emeralds of the legendary Serra da Sabarabuçu. Setting out in 1674, his bandeira spent years in the wilderness, founding camps and opening trails. He died of fever in 1681, believing the green stones he had sent south were emeralds; they were tourmalines.
zh: 费尔南·迪亚斯·派斯·莱梅（约1608—1681）是圣保罗的班德拉旗手，绰号“祖母绿猎手”。1638年，他加入安东尼奥·拉波佐·塔瓦雷斯远征巴西南部的旗队，1644年起又多次率领自己的旗队深入内陆掳掠印第安人为奴。1651年，他当选地方司法官，1653年促成定居者与耶稣会士和解。1661年，他再次率队袭击耶稣会传教区，掳掠原住民为奴。1671年，阿丰索·富尔塔多总督委托他寻找传说中的萨巴拉布苏山脉的祖母绿。1674年出发后，他的旗队在荒野中跋涉多年，建立营地、开辟道路。1681年他死于热病，至死以为送出的绿色石头是祖母绿，其实是电气石。

en: Francisco Álvares (c. 1465–1536/1541) was a Portuguese priest and explorer who spent much of his life in Coimbra. In 1515 he joined the Portuguese embassy to Emperor Lebna Dengel of Ethiopia, sailing with the returning Ethiopian ambassador Mateus. The mission reached the Ethiopian highlands only in 1520, where Álvares met the long-settled Pêro da Covilhã; he stayed six years and returned to Lisbon in 1526–1527. His report, A True Relation of the Lands of Prester John of the Indies, described his years in the Christian kingdom for European readers.
zh: 弗朗西斯科·阿尔瓦雷斯（约1465—1536/1541）是葡萄牙神父与探险家，大半生在科英布拉度过。1515年，他加入前往埃塞俄比亚皇帝勒布纳·丹格尔宫廷的葡萄牙使团，与归国的埃塞俄比亚使节马特乌斯同行。使团迟至1520年才进入埃塞俄比亚高原，他在那里见到了久居当地的佩罗·达·科维良。他在埃塞俄比亚停留六年，于1526—1527年返回里斯本。他的报告《印度祭司王约翰国土实录》向欧洲读者记述了他在这个基督教王国的见闻。

en: Francisco de Arruda (died 1547) was a Portuguese architect and sculptor, younger brother of Diogo de Arruda. With his brother he helped forge the Manueline style, Portugal's exuberant late Gothic; his most famous work is the Belém Tower in Lisbon, commissioned by Manuel I to guard the mouth of the Tagus. He repaired the castles of Moura, Mourão and Portel with semicircular artillery towers, worked on the strongholds of Safi and Azemmour in Morocco, and in 1520 designed Elvas Cathedral. That year he and Diogo also worked in Évora and at the Monastery of São Francisco. After Diogo's death in 1531 his later buildings moved toward Renaissance forms. He died on 30 November 1547.
zh: 弗朗西斯科·德·阿鲁达（卒于1547年）是葡萄牙建筑师与雕塑家，迪奥戈·德·阿鲁达的弟弟。他与兄长一同塑造了曼努埃尔式——葡萄牙华丽的晚期哥特风格；其最著名的作品是里斯本的贝伦塔，由曼努埃尔一世下令修建，扼守塔霍河口。他以半圆形炮台塔楼修缮、改造莫拉、莫朗和波特尔的城堡，参与摩洛哥萨非和阿泽穆尔要塞的工程，1520年设计了埃尔瓦什大教堂。同年，他与迪奥戈还在埃武拉和圣弗朗西斯科修道院工作。1531年迪奥戈去世后，他晚年建筑转向文艺复兴风格。1547年11月30日去世。

en: Elizabeth of Aragon (1271–1336), daughter of Peter III of Aragon and Constance II of Sicily, became queen of Portugal by marrying King Denis in 1288. She helped shape the Treaty of Alcañices between Denis and Castile in 1297 and arbitrated between Castile and Aragon in 1304. Her son Afonso accused Denis of favouring an illegitimate son, and civil war followed. In 1323 Elizabeth rode a mule between the opposing armies at Alvalade to prevent battle; peace returned in 1324 when Afonso swore loyalty to his father. She gave alms to the poor and was linked with the miracle of the roses, died at Estremoz in 1336, and was canonized by Pope Urban VIII in 1625.
zh: 阿拉贡的伊莎贝尔（1271—1336）是阿拉贡国王佩德罗三世与西西里的科斯坦察二世之女，1288年嫁给葡萄牙国王迪尼什，成为葡萄牙王后。1297年她促成迪尼什与卡斯蒂利亚之间的《阿尔卡尼伊塞斯条约》，1304年又为卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡调停。她的儿子阿方索指责迪尼什偏爱一名私生子，父子随后爆发内战。1323年伊莎贝尔骑着骡子挡在阿尔瓦拉迪对峙的两军之间，阻止交战；1324年阿方索向父亲宣誓效忠，战事平息。她以赈济贫民和“玫瑰奇迹”闻名，1336年卒于埃什特雷莫什，1625年被教皇乌尔班八世封圣。

en: John IV (1604–1656), eighth Duke of Braganza, succeeded his father Teodósio II in 1630. On 1 December 1640 the Forty Conspirators seized Lisbon, killed Miguel de Vasconcelos and ended sixty years of Spanish rule; John was acclaimed king, opening the Portuguese Restoration War and founding the Braganza dynasty. His troops beat Spain at Montijo in 1644, his fleets recovered Luanda in 1648 and northern Brazil from the Dutch by 1654, and in 1641 he allied with France and Sweden. He was also a composer and writer on music.
zh: 若昂四世（1604—1656）是第八代布拉干萨公爵，1630年继承父亲特奥多西奥二世之位。1640年12月1日，“四十密谋者”集团夺取里斯本，杀死米格尔·德·瓦斯孔塞洛斯，结束了西班牙六十年的统治；若昂被拥立为王，葡萄牙王政复古战争由此开始，布拉干萨王朝就此建立。他的军队1644年在蒙蒂若击败西班牙人，舰队1648年收复罗安达，到1654年从荷兰人手中收复巴西北部，并于1641年与法国、瑞典结盟。他还从事作曲，撰写音乐论著。

en: Portuguese poet Luís Vaz de Camões (c. 1524–1580) was born into an impoverished noble family and entered the court of John III. Around 1547 he lost his right eye fighting in Ceuta, and in 1553 he sailed for India, serving the crown in Goa and later in Macau, where tradition says he wrote much of his epic. Shipwrecked on the voyage home, he reached Lisbon in 1570. King Sebastian approved publication of Os Lusíadas in 1572; celebrating Vasco da Gama's voyage, it became Portugal's national epic. Camões also wrote lyric poetry and plays. He died in Lisbon on 10 June 1580.
zh: 葡萄牙诗人路易·瓦斯·德·贾梅士（约1524—1580）出身破落贵族家庭，年轻时出入里斯本的若昂三世宫廷。约1547年他在休达作战时失去右眼视力，1553年远航印度，在果阿为王室效力，后来又到澳门，相传史诗的大部分即在当地写成。归国途中遭遇海难，他于1570年回到里斯本。塞巴斯蒂安国王批准《卢济塔尼亚人之歌》于1572年出版，该诗以瓦斯科·达·伽马的航行为主线，成为葡萄牙的民族史诗。贾梅士还写过抒情诗和戏剧，于1580年6月10日在里斯本去世。

en: Luís de Meneses, 3rd Count of Ericeira (1632–1690), was a Portuguese nobleman, artillery general and historian who fought through the Restoration War, serving at the battles of Elvas (1659), Ameixial (1663) and Montes Claros (1665). He later wrote works on the war and became governor-at-arms of Trás-os-Montes in 1673. He backed the party that deposed Afonso VI in 1667 and became Vedor da Fazenda, or finance minister, under Pedro II. A Colbert-style mercantilist, he fostered Portuguese cloth and silk manufacture, settled foreign weavers at Covilhã and Fundão, and secured the protectionist sumptuary laws of 1677 and 1686. Troubled by melancholy, he killed himself at his Lisbon palace in May 1690.
zh: 第三代埃里塞拉伯爵路易斯·德·梅内塞斯（1632—1690）是葡萄牙贵族、炮兵将领和历史学家，曾参加葡萄牙复国战争，历经埃尔瓦什（1659）、阿梅西亚尔（1663）和蒙特斯克拉罗斯（1665）等战役。他后来撰写了有关这场战争的著作，并于1673年出任特拉斯奥斯蒙特斯军务总督。他支持1667年废黜阿丰索六世的一派，在佩德罗二世治下担任财政总监。他是科尔贝式的重商主义者，扶持葡萄牙本国的毛纺和丝织业，把外国织工安置在科维良和丰当，并推动1677年和1686年的保护主义禁奢法令。他长期受忧郁症困扰，1690年5月在里斯本的宅邸中自尽。

en: Ferdinand Magellan (c. 1480–1521) was a Portuguese mariner born into minor nobility. From 1505 he served in the Indian Ocean, fighting at Cannanore (1506) and Diu (1509) and joining Afonso de Albuquerque's conquest of Malacca in 1511. After Manuel I rejected his westward route to the Spice Islands, he won the backing of Charles I of Spain and sailed in 1519 with five ships. Despite storms and mutinies, he passed the strait named for him and crossed the Pacific, reaching Guam and then the Philippines. He was killed at the Battle of Mactan on 27 April 1521; under Juan Sebastián Elcano his crew completed the first circumnavigation in 1522.
zh: 斐迪南·麦哲伦（约1480—1521）是出身小贵族家庭的葡萄牙航海家。1505年起他在印度洋服役，参加1506年坎纳诺尔之战和1509年第乌之战，并在1511年随阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克征服马六甲。他提出向西航行前往香料群岛的计划遭曼努埃尔一世拒绝后，转获西班牙国王卡洛斯一世支持，于1519年率五艘船出航。尽管途中遭遇风暴和叛乱，他仍穿过后来以他命名的海峡，横渡太平洋，先后抵达关岛和菲律宾。他于1521年4月27日死于麦克坦岛战役；其船员在胡安·塞巴斯蒂安·埃尔卡诺率领下于1522年完成人类首次环球航行。

en: Pedro Afonso, Count of Barcelos (1287–1354), was the illegitimate son of King Denis of Portugal by Grácia Froes, and in 1314 his father gave him the town of Barcelos with the title of count. When Denis fell out with the heir Afonso, Pedro tried to hold a difficult middle line, and in 1317 he was exiled to Castile, where he met the court culture handed down from his great-grandfather Alfonso X the Wise. Recalled in 1322, he sided with the heir in the civil war and regained his confiscated lands in 1324, after backing Queen Elizabeth's peacemaking. He fought beside Afonso IV at Salado in 1340. A poet and troubadour like his father, he made his seat at Lalim near Lamego a cultural centre, and is credited with a good share of the major texts of medieval Portuguese literature. He died there in 1354 and was buried at Tarouca, under a tomb carved with boar-hunting scenes.
zh: 佩德罗·阿方索，巴塞卢什伯爵（1287—1354），是葡萄牙国王迪尼什与格拉西亚·弗罗埃斯的私生子，1314年父亲把巴塞卢什镇连同伯爵头衔赐给他。迪尼什与继承人阿方索失和时，他试图在两边维持艰难的平衡，1317年被逐往卡斯蒂利亚，在那里接触到曾祖父智者阿方索十世留下的宫廷文化。1322年召回后，他在内战中站到继承人一边，1324年在支持伊莎贝拉王后调停之后，夺回被没收的产业。1340年，他随阿方索四世参加萨拉多战役。他和父亲一样是诗人与游吟诗人，把拉梅古附近拉林的府邸经营成文化中心，中世纪葡萄牙文学的许多重要文本都归功于他。1354年他死于拉林，葬于塔鲁卡，墓上雕有猎野猪的场景。

en: Peter I (1320–1367), called the Just, was the son of Afonso IV and Beatrice of Castile. In 1340 his wife Constanza Manuel arrived in Portugal with her lady-in-waiting Inês de Castro, and Peter fell in love with Inês, making her exiled brothers his closest advisers.
