zh: 潘多尔福二世·马拉泰斯塔（1325—1373年1月）是马拉泰斯塔三世（古斯塔法米利亚）的长子，1347年任佩萨罗最高行政官，终身执掌该城，开创了马拉泰斯塔家族的佩萨罗支系。他身为雇佣兵首领，曾任加莱亚佐二世·维斯孔蒂的骑兵统领，1356年率维斯孔蒂军队首次围攻帕维亚，未能成功。加莱亚佐信任他，与其共治的弟弟贝尔纳博却恨他入骨，把他捆起来并下令斩首，幸得加莱亚佐出手相救，将他送回佩萨罗。此后他追随枢机主教阿尔沃诺斯，协助迫使切塞纳的奥尔德拉菲家族投降。1358年佛罗伦萨任命他为战争统帅，他不流血地把雇佣兵团伙赶出了佛罗伦萨领地。1363至1364年他率佛罗伦萨军队对抗比萨，同时图谋夺取该城的统治权；佛罗伦萨拒绝了他，他任由敌军蹂躏基安蒂和卡森蒂诺，最终被解职。晚年他在佩萨罗治理领地，与彼特拉克交好，诗人曾赠他《歌集》的手抄本。

en: Polentesia da Polenta was the daughter of Guido Novello da Polenta, lord of Ravenna, and Caterina Malabocca of Bagnacavallo. She married the condottiero Malatestino Novello Malatesta, son of Ferrantino Malatesta of Rimini. On 9 July 1326 her husband was seized through treachery by their cousin Ramberto I Malatesta and locked in the castle of Sant'Arcangelo. Polentesia placed herself at the head of a column of women who marched through Rimini demanding his release, and only laid down her arms when false news of his murder arrived. Her daughter Anna married Ubertino da Carrara, lord of Padua, in 1340.
zh: 波伦泰夏·达·波伦塔是拉韦纳领主圭多·诺韦洛·达·波伦塔与巴尼亚卡瓦洛的卡泰丽娜·马拉博卡之女，嫁给里米尼的费兰蒂诺·马拉泰斯塔之子、雇佣军首领马拉泰斯蒂诺·诺韦洛·马拉泰斯塔。1326年7月9日，丈夫被堂亲兰贝托一世·马拉泰斯塔设计擒获，关押进圣阿尔坎杰洛城堡；波伦泰夏亲自率领一队妇女在里米尼城中游行，要求放人，直到丈夫遇害的假消息传来才放下武器。其女安娜于1340年嫁给帕多瓦领主乌贝蒂诺·达·卡拉拉。

en: Ramberto Malatesta was the son of Giovanni, head of the Malatesta branch at Verucchio and a member of Rimini's General Council. When Giovanni died about 1221, Ramberto was his legitimate heir, but leadership of the house passed to his cousin Malatesta della Penna.
zh: 兰贝托·马拉泰斯塔是乔瓦尼之子，其父是马拉泰斯塔家族韦鲁基奥支系首领、里米尼总议事会成员。约1221年乔瓦尼去世，兰贝托虽为合法继承人，家族领导权却落入堂兄马拉泰斯塔·德拉佩纳之手。

en: Ramberto Malatesta (died 28 January 1330) was the youngest son of Gianciotto Malatesta and his second wife Zambrasina dei Zambrasi. In 1323, when his cousin Uberto, count of Giaggiolo, drew him into a plot to murder their uncle Pandolfo I, Ramberto pretended to join and killed Uberto at a banquet. At the family partition of 1326 he received no lands, while his cousins Malatesta III took Pesaro and Ferrantino Rimini. He tried to seize his relatives at a banquet, but Polentesia, wife of Malatestino Novello, organised Rimini's defence. Driven from Rimini, he reconciled with Malatesta in January 1327, yet in 1328 persuaded his brother Guido to attack the city. On 28 January 1330 Malatestino Novello slew him at Poggio Berni castle.
zh: 兰贝托·马拉泰斯塔（1330年1月28日卒）是詹乔托·马拉泰斯塔与第二任妻子赞布拉西娜·代·赞布拉西的幼子。1323年，堂兄贾焦洛伯爵乌贝托拉拢他密谋杀害叔父、家族首领潘多尔福一世，兰贝托假意应承，在宴席上亲手杀死乌贝托。1326年家族分封时他一无所获，堂亲马拉泰斯塔三世得到佩萨罗、费兰蒂诺得到里米尼。他设宴企图拘捕同族，马拉泰斯蒂诺·诺韦洛的妻子波伦泰西亚则组织里米尼的防御。他被逐出里米尼，1327年1月与马拉泰斯塔和解，却在1328年说服兄弟圭多进攻该城。1330年1月28日，马拉泰斯蒂诺·诺韦洛在波焦贝尔尼城堡将他杀死。

en: Samaritana Malatesta (died 1347) was the daughter of Ferrantino Malatesta, lord of Rimini, and Belluccia Baligani of Jesi. In 1314 she married Count Tolberto III da Camino of Ceneda. Widowed in 1317, she guarded her two young children, Beatrice and Biaquino VII, and ruled the castles of Portobuffolé, Camino, Motta and Cessalto. In 1326 she held them against Guecellone VIII da Camino with Venetian support. After her son Biaquino VII was killed in 1337, she lost her lands and retired to Rimini, where she died in 1347.
zh: 萨马里塔纳·马拉泰斯塔（？—1347）是里米尼领主费兰蒂诺·马拉泰斯塔与耶西的贝尔卢恰·巴利加尼之女。1314年，她嫁给切内达伯爵托尔贝托三世·达·卡米诺。1317年丈夫去世后，她监护两名年幼的子女贝阿特丽切和比亚奎诺七世，统辖波尔托布福莱、卡米诺、莫塔和切萨尔托等城堡。1326年，她在威尼斯的保护下击退了圭切洛内八世·达·卡米诺的夺地企图。1337年儿子比亚奎诺七世被杀，她被迫放弃领地返回里米尼，1347年在那里去世。

en: Taddea Malatesta was a daughter of Malatesta III Malatesta, known as Guastafamiglia, lord of Rimini and Pesaro, and his wife Costanza Ondedei. She married Giovanni Ordelaffi of the signorial family of Forlì, and died on 30 June 1363.
zh: 塔代亚·马拉泰斯塔是里米尼与佩萨罗领主马拉泰斯塔三世（绰号“瓜斯塔法米利亚”）与妻子科斯坦扎·翁代代伊之女，嫁给弗利统治家族的乔瓦尼·奥尔代拉菲，于1363年6月30日去世。

en: Taddea da Rimini (c. 1267–1362) was an Italian noblewoman and, by her marriage to Pandolfo I Malatesta, lady consort of Rimini and Pesaro until his death in 1326. She was the mother of Malatesta Guastafamiglia (1299–1364), lord of Pesaro and Rimini; Galeotto I (1300–1385), the condottiero; and Caterina, who married Luigi I Gonzaga of Mantua and died around 1340. Taddea died in Rimini in 1362.
zh: 塔代亚·达·里米尼（约1267—1362）是意大利贵族女子，嫁给里米尼与佩萨罗领主潘多尔福一世·马拉泰斯塔，1326年丈夫去世前为两地的领主夫人。她生有三个子女：佩萨罗与里米尼领主马拉泰斯塔·瓜斯塔法米利亚（1299—1364）、佣兵首领加莱奥托一世（1300—1385），以及嫁给曼托瓦的路易吉一世·贡扎加的卡泰丽娜（约1340年卒）。塔代亚于1362年在里米尼去世。

en: Malatesta Ungaro (June 1327 – 17 July 1372) was born Galeotto Malatesta, a younger son of Malatesta Guastafamiglia, lord of Pesaro and Rimini, and Costanza Ondedei. He took the name Ungaro after King Louis I of Hungary knighted him in December 1347. He married Costanza d'Este, daughter of Obizzo III of Ferrara, in 1363. As a papal commander under Cardinal Gil de Albornoz he fought the Ordelaffi and Manfredi, and on 16 April 1363 he heavily defeated Bernabò Visconti. He helped Pope Urban V return to Rome in 1367 and died at Rimini in 1372.
zh: 马拉泰斯塔·翁加罗（1327年6月—1372年7月17日）原名加莱奥托·马拉泰斯塔，是佩萨罗与里米尼领主马拉泰斯塔·瓜斯塔法米利亚与科斯坦扎·翁代代伊较年幼的儿子。1347年12月匈牙利国王拉约什一世封他为骑士后，他改名“翁加罗”。1363年，他娶费拉拉侯爵奥比佐三世之女科斯坦扎·德埃斯特为妻。作为枢机主教希尔·德·阿尔沃诺斯麾下的教廷将领，他征战奥尔代拉菲家族和曼弗雷迪家族，并于1363年4月16日重创贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂。1367年他协助教宗乌尔班五世返回罗马，1372年在里米尼去世。

en: Bardic tradition calls Chokrana a prince of the Parmar dynasty of Ujjain who ruled Junaraj, the old capital of Rajpipla. Having no son of his own, he summoned to his court his sister's younger son Samarsinhji, a Gohil boy whose father Mokhadaji had held Ghogha and the island of Piram until Muhammad bin Tughluq's troops killed him in 1347. Samarsinhji took the name Arjunsinhji, succeeded Chokrana and became the founder of the Gohil ruling line of Rajpipla State.
zh: 按拉杰普特口传谱系，乔克拉纳是出身乌贾因帕拉马尔王朝的王公，统治着拉杰皮普拉的旧都朱纳拉杰。他没有儿子，便把妹妹的幼子萨马尔辛吉接到身边；这个戈希尔男孩的父亲莫卡达吉曾占有戈加和皮拉姆岛，1347年被穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克的军队攻杀。萨马尔辛吉改名阿周那辛吉，继承了乔克拉纳的权位，成为拉杰皮普拉邦戈希尔统治世系的开创者。

en: Rodrigo Borgia (1431–1503), born Roderic de Borja at Xàtiva near Valencia, was a Spanish cardinal who became Pope Alexander VI. After studying law at Bologna, he was made a cardinal in 1456 by his uncle Pope Callixtus III and vice-chancellor of the Church a year later, serving four successive popes. In the Roman Curia he accumulated influence and wealth before his election as pope in August 1492 amid charges of simony. His 1493 bulls allocated New World lands to Spain after Columbus's voyage, while his policy in the Italian wars centred on advancing his children, above all Cesare. He died in August 1503, his name a byword for nepotism.
zh: 罗德里戈·波吉亚（1431—1503）出生于瓦伦西亚附近的哈蒂瓦，原名罗德里克·德·博尔哈，后成为教宗亚历山大六世。他在博洛尼亚攻读法律，1456年由舅父教宗加里斯都三世擢升为枢机，次年任教会副秘书长，历侍四位教宗。他在罗马教廷积累了影响力和财富，1492年8月在买卖圣职的指责中当选教宗。1493年他发布诏书，在哥伦布远航后将新大陆的土地划给西班牙；他在意大利战争中的政策则以提携子女、尤其是切萨雷为核心。1503年8月他去世，其名字成为任人唯亲的代名词。

en: Euphemia de Ross (c. 1329–c. 1389) was a daughter of Hugh, Earl of Ross, and sister of Earl William. She first married John Randolph, 3rd Earl of Moray, who was killed at Neville's Cross in 1346, leaving her large widow's estates including Badenoch. Before May 1355 she married Robert Stewart, nephew and heir of David II. When he became Robert II in 1371 she was queen, but her coronation at Scone was delayed to 1372–1373, possibly in part because of disputes over her sons' succession rights. Her son David gained Strathearn and Caithness. She died around 1389 and was buried at Dunfermline Abbey.
zh: 尤菲米娅·德·罗斯（约1329—约1389）是罗斯伯爵休之女、威廉伯爵的妹妹。她先嫁第三代马里伯爵约翰·伦道夫，后者1346年战死于内维尔十字，留给她包括巴德诺赫在内的大片寡妇领地。1355年5月前，她改嫁大卫二世的外甥兼继承人罗伯特·斯图尔特。1371年丈夫即位为罗伯特二世，她成为王后，在斯昆的加冕礼却推迟到1372至1373年间，诸子的继承顺位之争可能是原因之一。她的儿子大卫获封斯特拉森和凯斯内斯伯爵。她约于1389年去世，葬于邓弗姆林修道院。

en: Hugh, probably Gaelic Aodh, was Mormaer of Ross from 1323 until his death. The eldest son of Earl William II and Euphemia de Berkeley, he became a favourite of King Robert I, who granted him many lands, and married the king's sister Maud Bruce in Orkney. After Maud's death he married Margaret de Graham under a papal dispensation in 1329. His daughter Euphemia took as her second husband the future King Robert II. Hugh was killed beside many Scottish nobles at the Battle of Halidon Hill on 19 July 1333, and was succeeded by his son William.
zh: 休（盖尔语名作艾）于1323年继父位成为罗斯莫勒马，即罗斯伯爵。他是伯爵威廉二世与尤菲米娅·德·伯克利的长子，深得国王罗伯特一世宠信，受封大量土地，并在奥克尼群岛迎娶国王之妹莫德·布鲁斯。莫德死后，他于1329年凭教皇特许续娶玛格丽特·德·格雷厄姆。女儿尤菲米娅的第二任丈夫即后来的国王罗伯特二世。1333年7月19日，他与众多苏格兰贵族一同战死于哈利顿山战役，子威廉继位。

en: Maud Bruce, also called Matilda, was a Scottish noblewoman, a daughter of Robert de Brus, Lord of Annandale, and Marjorie, Countess of Carrick, and a sister of King Robert I. In 1306 she was seized by the Earl of Ross's men and handed to the English as a prisoner; after her release her brother married her to Hugh, the earl's son, to seal the reconciliation of the two houses. Her children included William, later Earl of Ross, and Marjory, wife of the Earl of Strathearn. She died before November 1329 and was buried at Dunfermline Abbey.
zh: 莫德·布鲁斯（一称玛蒂尔达）是苏格兰贵族女性，为安嫩代尔领主罗伯特·德·布鲁斯与卡里克女伯爵玛乔里之女、国王罗伯特一世的妹妹。1306年她被罗斯伯爵的部下俘获，交给英格兰方面囚禁；获释后，兄长将她嫁给伯爵之子休，以此促成两家和解。她的子女包括后来的罗斯伯爵威廉和斯特拉森伯爵夫人玛乔里。她于1329年11月前去世，葬于邓弗姆林修道院。

en: William, 5th Earl of Ross (died 1372), was the son of Earl Hugh and Matilda Bruce, Robert the Bruce's sister, and first cousin of David II. His father fell at Halidon Hill in 1333; William returned from Norway in 1336 to take up the earldom. In 1339 he forced the English garrison out of Perth by draining its moat. In 1346 he killed his vassal Ronald MacRuari at Elcho Priory and withdrew before Neville's Cross. He joined the Highland lords' revolt of 1366 and died in 1372, leaving the earldom to his daughter Euphemia.
zh: 第五代罗斯伯爵威廉（?—1372）是罗斯伯爵休与罗伯特·布鲁斯之妹玛蒂尔达·布鲁斯之子，即大卫二世的姑表兄弟。1333年父亲在哈利登山阵亡，他当时身在挪威，1336年返回接管伯国。1339年围攻珀斯时，他排干护城河，迫使英格兰守军投降。1346年，他在埃尔乔修道院杀死封臣罗纳德·麦克鲁阿里，并在内维尔十字之战前撤兵。1366年他参加高地贵族的反抗，1372年去世，罗斯伯国由女儿尤菲米娅继承。

en: Hugues de Pierrepont (died 1349) was the son of Count John V of Roucy and Marguerite de Bommiers. After his father fell at Crécy in 1346 he became seigneur de Pierrepont, and in 1347 he was made vidame of Laon. He married Marie de Clacy.
zh: 于格·德·皮埃尔蓬（?—1349）是鲁西伯爵约翰五世与玛格丽特·德·博米耶之子。1346年父亲在克雷西战死后，他成为皮埃尔蓬领主，1347年出任拉昂的主教代理。他娶玛丽·德·克拉西为妻。

en: John II (died 1251), of the House of Pierrepont, was count of Roucy and lord of Pierrepont, son of Robert of Pierrepont and Eustachie, heiress of Roucy. Recognized as heir in 1211, he did homage to Countess Blanche of Champagne in 1213 and probably fought at Bouvines in 1214. He stayed loyal to the crown during the barons' revolt against Blanche of Castile, gaining Sissonne from the rebel Enguerrand III of Coucy in 1227. He was killed in 1251 fighting for Charles of Anjou in the Flemish succession dispute, leaving a son, John III, by his second wife Marie of Dammartin.
zh: 让二世（？—1251）出身皮埃尔蓬家族，是鲁西伯爵兼皮埃尔蓬领主，皮埃尔蓬的罗贝尔与鲁西女继承人厄斯塔希之子。1211年他被确认为鲁西继承人，1213年向香槟女伯爵布朗什行臣服礼，可能还参加了1214年的布汶战役。贵族起兵反对摄政卡斯蒂利亚的布朗什时，他效忠王室，于1227年从叛乱者昂盖朗三世·德·库西处获得锡索讷。1251年，他在佛兰德继承纠纷中为安茹的查理作战时阵亡；第二任妻子达马尔坦的玛丽为他生下继承人让三世。

en: John III, of the House of Pierrepont, was count of Roucy, the son of Count John II and Marie of Dammartin. He married Isabelle of Mercoeur (c. 1240-1285), and their son John IV succeeded him in 1282 or 1285.
zh: 让三世出身皮埃尔蓬家族，是鲁西伯爵让二世与达马尔坦的玛丽之子，袭任鲁西伯爵。他娶梅克尔的伊莎贝尔（约1240—1285）为妻；其子让四世于1282或1285年继位为鲁西伯爵。

en: John IV (born between 1260 and 1269, died 1302), of the House of Pierrepont, was count of Roucy and lord of Pierrepont, succeeding his father John III in 1282 or 1285. By his wife Jeanne of Dreux, countess of Braine, whom he married by 1292, he also held Braine and Rochefort, with the viscounty of Mareuil. He served on the royal campaign of 1297 and in 1302 joined the war against Flanders, falling in battle near Mons-en-Pévèle. He left three children, John V, Marie and Béatrix.
zh: 让四世（1260至1269年间生—1302）出身皮埃尔蓬家族，于1282或1285年继承父亲让三世之位，任鲁西伯爵、皮埃尔蓬领主，并凭借妻子德勒的让娜（布赖讷女伯爵，至迟于1292年成婚）领有布赖讷与罗什福尔，还担任马勒伊子爵。1297年他在王室军中服役，1302年参加对佛兰德的战争，战死于蒙桑佩韦勒附近。子女有让五世、玛丽和贝阿特丽丝。

en: John V de Pierrepont (c. 1300–1346) was Count of Roucy, Braine and Rochefort, succeeding his father John IV and inheriting Braine through his mother Jeanne de Dreux. In 1320 he went as a French royal envoy to Flanders to mediate between Count Robert III and his son Louis of Nevers. In October 1339 he served in Philip VI's army facing Edward III at Buironfosse near Saint-Quentin, the first standoff of the Hundred Years' War. He was killed at Crécy on 26 August 1346. With his wife Marguerite de Bommiers he left sons Robert II, Simon and Hugues.
zh: 约翰五世·德·皮埃尔蓬（约1300—1346）是鲁西、布赖讷和罗什福尔伯爵，出身皮埃尔蓬家族，继承父亲约翰四世，布赖讷则来自母亲让娜·德·德勒的遗产。1320年，他作为法国国王的使节前往佛兰德，调解佛兰德伯爵罗贝尔三世与儿子讷韦尔的路易之争。1339年10月，他随腓力六世的军队出征，在圣康坦附近的比龙福斯与爱德华三世的英军对峙，这是百年战争中两军的首次对阵。1346年8月26日，他战死于克雷西之战。妻子玛格丽特·德·博米耶为他生下罗贝尔二世、西蒙和于格等儿子。

en: Jeanne de Dreux, Countess of Braine, was the daughter of Robert IV of Dreux and Béatrice de Montfort. She married John IV, Count of Roucy, and after his death Jean de Bar in 1304. Her son John V became Count of Roucy and Braine.
zh: 让娜·德·德勒是布拉讷女伯爵，德勒伯爵罗贝尔四世与贝阿特丽斯·德·蒙福尔之女。她先嫁鲁西伯爵让四世，丈夫死后于1304年改嫁让·德·巴尔。她的儿子让五世后来成为鲁西兼布拉讷伯爵。

en: Jeanne de Pierrepont, lady of Blazon and Chemillé, was a daughter of Count John V of Roucy, who was killed at Crécy in 1346, and Marguerite de Beaumez. On 26 January 1341 she married in Paris Charles I de Montmorency, a royal councillor who became Marshal of France in 1343 and fought at Crécy. Their children were Jean, who died young in 1352, and three daughters, Marguerite, Jeanne and Marie. She died on 10 January 1361.
zh: 让娜·德·皮埃尔蓬是布拉宗与舍米耶女领主，父亲是1346年在克雷西阵亡的鲁西伯爵让五世，母亲是玛格丽特·德·博梅。1341年1月26日，她在巴黎嫁给夏尔一世·德·蒙莫朗西；后者是国王顾问，1343年成为法兰西元帅，并曾在克雷西作战。两人生有儿子让（1352年早逝）和三个女儿玛格丽特、让娜、玛丽。让娜卒于1361年1月10日。

en: Marguerite de Bommiers was the daughter and heiress of Thibaut “le Grand” de Beaumetz, and brought the lordships of Bommiers and Blaison to her husband John V de Pierrepont, Count of Roucy. Her sons Robert II and Simon both succeeded as counts of Roucy.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·博米耶是蒂博·“勒格朗”·德·博梅之女及继承人，将博米耶和布莱宗领地带给丈夫鲁西伯爵约翰五世·德·皮埃尔蓬。她的儿子罗贝尔二世与西蒙先后成为鲁西伯爵。

en: Marie de Dammartin, daughter of Simon de Dammartin, Count of Aumale, and Marie de Ponthieu, was the third wife of John II of Pierrepont, Count of Roucy, whom she married around 1240. Her son John III succeeded to the county; she died in 1279.
zh: 玛丽·德·达马尔坦是欧马勒伯爵西蒙·德·达马尔坦与玛丽·德·蓬蒂厄之女，约1240年嫁给鲁西伯爵让二世·德·皮埃尔蓬，为其第三任妻子。她的儿子让三世后来继承伯爵之位，她本人于1279年去世。

en: Robert I of Pierrepont was a nobleman who married Eustachie, heiress to Roucy. Enguerrand III of Coucy seized Roucy in 1200 but had to restore it around 1204, when Robert became count. He died in June 1204.
zh: 罗贝尔一世·德·皮埃尔蓬是法兰西贵族，娶了鲁西的女继承人厄斯塔谢。库西的昂盖朗三世于1200年夺取鲁西，约1204年被迫归还，罗贝尔随即成为鲁西伯爵。他于1204年6月去世。

en: Robert II de Pierrepont (died 1364) succeeded his father John V as Count of Roucy and Braine after Crécy in 1346. He was royal lieutenant in Vermandois in 1347, grand master of waters and forests under John II, and governor of Burgundy in 1351. In 1356 he ceded Braine to his younger brother Simon and was captured at Poitiers, later paying a heavy ransom. In December 1358 the English took the castle of Roucy with him, his wife and daughter inside; they were ransomed and the castle was retaken in July 1359. He died in 1364, leaving one daughter, Isabelle.
zh: 罗贝尔二世·德·皮埃尔蓬（?—1364）在1346年克雷西之战后继承父亲约翰五世，成为鲁西和布赖讷伯爵。1347年他任王室驻韦芒杜瓦代理官，约翰二世在位时担任水泽森林总管，1351年任勃艮第总督。1356年他在普瓦捷之战被俘，付出巨额赎金获释，同年把布赖讷让给弟弟西蒙。1358年12月，英军攻占鲁西城堡，将他与妻女一同俘虏；一家人支付赎金后，城堡于1359年7月被收复。1364年他去世，只留下女儿伊莎贝尔。

en: Simon de Pierrepont (c. 1325–18 February 1392), count of Braine, was the youngest of the five sons of Count John V of Roucy and Marguerite de Beaumetz. When his father was killed at Crécy in 1346, Simon inherited Braine with the lordships of Tournanfuye and Villebéon. In 1381 his childless niece Isabelle sold the county of Roucy to Louis of Anjou, the French king's brother, for forty thousand gold francs. Louis died in September 1384, and Simon, by then the eldest of the house, contested the sale by claiming the right of lineage redemption. The Parlement ruled for him. By the treaty of 5 June 1385 he compensated Louis's heirs and took Roucy back, uniting it with Braine. By Marie de Châtillon he left a son, Hugh II, who succeeded him. He died at Bois-lez-Roucy and was buried at Saint-Yved of Braine.
zh: 西蒙·德·皮埃尔蓬（约1325—1392年2月18日）是布赖讷伯爵，鲁西伯爵让五世与玛格丽特·德·博梅五个儿子中最小的一个。1346年父亲在克雷西战役中阵亡，他继承了布赖讷以及图尔南菲、维尔贝翁两处领地。1381年，他没有子嗣的侄女伊莎贝尔以四万金法郎把鲁西伯国卖给法王之弟安茹的路易。1384年9月路易去世，此时西蒙已是家族中最年长者，他援引亲属回赎权，对这笔交易提出异议，高等法院判他胜诉。1385年6月5日的条约规定，他补偿路易的继承人，收回鲁西，与布赖讷合为一体。他与玛丽·德·沙蒂永生子于格二世，由其继位。他卒于布瓦莱鲁西，葬于布赖讷的圣伊韦修道院。

en: Bugis lontara chronicles name Petta Cakkeawo as the second ruler of the small kingdom of Berru (Barru) in South Sulawesi, reigning from 1336 to 1361. He succeeded the first ruler La Sarewo and was followed by Matinroe ri Daung Lesang.
zh: 据南苏拉威西巴鲁王室传统所引布吉隆塔拉编年史记载，佩塔·查凯奥于1336至1361年统治布吉人的贝鲁（巴鲁）小国，在首任统治者拉萨雷沃之后、马廷罗·里·道恩·莱桑之前在位。

en: Alexander Konstantinovich (1286 - died before 1307), prince of Uglich, was the elder son of Konstantin Borisovich of Rostov. After his uncle Dmitry died in 1294 and his father took Rostov, he received Uglich. His son Yuri succeeded him and later ruled Rostov.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/尤里·亚历山德罗维奇_(罗斯托夫)
zh: 亚历山大·康斯坦丁诺维奇（1286—1307年前）是乌格里奇王公、罗斯托夫王公康斯坦丁·鲍里索维奇的长子。1294年叔父德米特里去世、父亲改领罗斯托夫后，他领有乌格里奇。儿子尤里·亚历山德罗维奇继位，后来成为罗斯托夫王公。

en: Andrei Fedorovich (1328/1331–1409), only son of Prince Fyodor Vasilievich, inherited the Usretinsky half of Rostov in 1331 and ruled as a loyal ally of Moscow. In 1360 his uncle Konstantin Vasilievich obtained a Tatar yarlyk for all Rostov and drove him out, but in 1364 a Moscow host sent by Dmitry Donskoy restored him. He accompanied Dmitry to the Horde in 1371, marched against Tver in 1375 and fought on the right wing at Kulikovo in 1380. In 1408 he fled Edigu's raid, which burned Rostov, and died in 1409 after taking the monastic name Afanasy.
zh: 安德烈·费奥多罗维奇（1328/1331—1409）是费奥多尔·瓦西里耶维奇王公的独子，1331年承袭罗斯托夫的乌斯列滕斯基一侧，作为莫斯科的忠实战友统治。1360年，他的叔父康斯坦丁·瓦西里耶维奇取得金帐汗统辖整个罗斯托夫的诰封，将他驱逐；1364年，德米特里·顿斯科伊派来的莫斯科大军助他恢复领地。1371年他随德米特里前往金帐汗国，1375年参与征讨特维尔，1380年在库里科沃战役右翼作战。1408年也迪该的鞑靼军队焚掠罗斯托夫，他随百姓出逃。他于1409年去世，临终落发，取教名阿法纳西。

en: Boris Vasilkovich (1231-1277) was prince of Rostov from his father Vasilko's death fighting the Mongols in 1238; he kept Rostov while his younger brother Gleb received Beloozero, with their mother Maria of Chernigov ruling during their minority. In 1244 he travelled to Batu Khan and received his patent (yarlyk), the first of eight visits to the Golden Horde recorded by the chronicles. A loyal ally of Alexander Nevsky, he accompanied Mongol census-takers to Novgorod in 1258. In 1277 he joined Mengu-Timur's campaign against the Alans, fell ill and died on 16 September, leaving sons Dmitry and Konstantin.
zh: 鲍里斯·瓦西里科维奇（1231—1277）于1238年父亲瓦西里科抗击蒙古人阵亡后成为罗斯托夫王公：他领有罗斯托夫，弟弟格列布分得别洛焦尔斯克，幼年由母亲切尔尼戈夫的玛丽亚摄政。1244年他前往拔都汗处领取册封诏书，据编年史记载，这是他八次金帐汗国之行的第一次。他是亚历山大·涅夫斯基的亲信盟友，1258年曾随蒙古人口普查官前往诺夫哥罗德。1277年他参加忙哥帖木儿征讨阿兰人的战争，染病死于9月16日，留下儿子德米特里和康斯坦丁。

en: Boris Vladimirovich (died 24 July 1015), baptized Roman, was a son of Vladimir the Great of Kyiv and prince of Rostov from about 1010. In 1015, while campaigning against the Pechenegs, he learned at the Alta river of his father's death and his half-brother Sviatopolk's seizure of Kyiv. Refusing to march on the throne, he kept only his own retinue. The chronicle records that Sviatopolk's men wounded him in his tent on 24 July and he was killed as they carried him away. With his brother Gleb he became one of the first saints canonized in Kievan Rus, and was buried at Vyshgorod.
zh: 鲍里斯·弗拉基米罗维奇（？—1015年7月24日），教名罗曼，基辅大公弗拉基米尔大帝之子，约1010年起受封罗斯托夫王公。1015年他率军抵御佩切涅格人，在阿尔塔河畔得知父亲去世、异母兄斯维亚托波尔克占据基辅。他拒绝进军争位，只留下自己的亲兵。编年史记载，斯维亚托波尔克派来的人于7月24日冲入营帐刺伤了他，随后他在被带走途中遇害。他与弟弟格列布一同成为基辅罗斯最早封圣的圣徒之一，葬于维什哥罗德。

en: Dmitry Borisovich (1253-1294), eldest son of Boris Vasilkovich of Rostov, brought his father's body home from the Golden Horde in 1277 and in 1278 took Rostov jointly with his brother Konstantin. In 1279 he seized Beloozero from his cousin Mikhail Glebovich and in 1281 drove Konstantin out; a khan-ordered partition in 1286 gave him Uglich, and in 1288 he swapped back to Rostov. He marched against Tver with Grand Prince Dmitry Aleksandrovich and in 1293 joined the destructive Dyuden campaign. On his death in 1294 he left a son, Alexander, and a daughter Anna, later the saint Anna of Kashin.
zh: 德米特里·鲍里索维奇（1253—1294）是罗斯托夫王公鲍里斯·瓦西里科维奇的长子，1277年从金帐汗国迎回父亲遗体，1278年与弟弟康斯坦丁共即罗斯托夫公位。1279年他从堂兄弟米哈伊尔·格列布维奇手中夺取别洛焦尔斯克，1281年又把康斯坦丁逐出罗斯托夫；1286年汗廷下令分地，他改领乌格里奇，1288年才换回罗斯托夫。他曾随弗拉基米尔大公德米特里·亚历山德罗维奇出征特维尔，1293年参加了破坏惨重的杜坚征掠。1294年去世，留下儿子亚历山大和女儿安娜，即后来的圣徒卡申的安娜。

en: Fyodor Vasilievich (1311–1331) was a Rurikid prince, a son of Vasily Konstantinovich of Rostov. In 1320, after the death of their cousin Yuri Alexandrovich, he and his brother Konstantin divided the Rostov principality, Fyodor taking the Sretensk side and ruling as prince of Rostov-Sretensk. In 1326 he married Maria Fyodorovna. He died on 28 March 1331, leaving a single son, Andrei, who succeeded him.
zh: 费奥多尔·瓦西里耶维奇（1311—1331）是留里克王朝王公，罗斯托夫王公瓦西里·康斯坦丁诺维奇之子。1320年堂兄尤里·亚历山德罗维奇去世后，他与兄弟康斯坦丁瓜分罗斯托夫公国，费奥多尔分得斯列坚斯基一方，成为罗斯托夫-斯列坚斯基王公。1326年，他娶玛丽亚·费奥多罗芙娜为妻。1331年3月28日他去世，留有独子安德烈，后者继承了他的公位。

en: Gleb Vasilkovich (1237-1278), younger son of Vasilko Konstantinovich, became the first prince of Beloozero after his father was captured and killed following the defeat at the Sit River in 1238, while his brother Boris held Rostov. A close ally of Alexander Nevsky, he pursued the same accommodation with the Golden Horde and in 1257 married a daughter or kinswoman of Sartak Khan, baptized Feodora. In 1277-78 he joined Mengu-Timur's campaign against the Alans and took part in the storming of Dedyakov; when Boris died on campaign he succeeded to Rostov, but died on 13 December 1278 after a week's illness. His son Mikhail inherited Beloozero.
zh: 格列布·瓦西里科维奇（1237—1278）是瓦西里科·康斯坦丁诺维奇的幼子，1238年父亲在锡塔河战败后被俘遇害，他成为别洛焦尔斯克的首任王公，兄长鲍里斯领有罗斯托夫。他是亚历山大·涅夫斯基的亲信，同样对金帐汗国采取妥协政策，1257年娶撒里答汗之女或亲属，受洗后取名费奥多拉。1277—1278年他随忙哥帖木儿征讨阿兰人，参加了攻克杰佳科夫之战；鲍里斯在军中病死后他继位罗斯托夫，却在患病一周后于1278年12月13日去世。儿子米哈伊尔继承别洛焦尔斯克。

en: Konstantin Borisovich (1255-1307), younger son of Boris Vasilkovich of Rostov, went to the Golden Horde with his father in 1277 and, when Boris died there, served on Mengu-Timur's Alan campaign with his uncle Gleb, returning in 1278 to share Rostov with his brother Dmitry. Driven out by Dmitry in 1281 and reconciled soon after, he received Rostov in the khan's partition of 1286, then exchanged it for Uglich about 1289. He regained Rostov on Dmitry's death in 1294, gave Uglich to his son Alexander and died at the Horde in 1307. In 1302 he married a Tatar khan's daughter as his second wife.
zh: 康斯坦丁·鲍里索维奇（1255—1307）是罗斯托夫王公鲍里斯·瓦西里科维奇之子、德米特里的弟弟。1277年他随父亲前往金帐汗国，父亲在当地病死后，他随叔父格列布参加忙哥帖木儿的阿兰战役，1278年返回，与兄长德米特里分治罗斯托夫。1281年他被德米特里驱逐，不久和解；1286年汗廷分地时他分得罗斯托夫，约1289年又以罗斯托夫换取乌格里奇。1294年德米特里去世后他重得罗斯托夫，把乌格里奇交给儿子亚历山大，1307年卒于金帐汗国。1302年他在汗廷娶一位鞑靼汗之女为续弦。

en: Konstantin Vasilievich (1312–1365), second son of Prince Vasily Konstantinovich of Rostov, became in 1320 the first prince of the Borisoglebsk half of divided Rostov. In 1328 he married Maria, daughter of Ivan Kalita of Moscow, and thereafter served Moscow as a subordinate prince, campaigning against Smolensk in 1340 and marching against the Swedes in 1348. In 1360 he obtained a Tatar yarlyk for all of Rostov, dispossessing his nephew Andrei Fedorovich, but Moscow-backed resistance drove him to Ustyug in 1364. He returned to Rostov and died of the plague in 1365.
zh: 康斯坦丁·瓦西里耶维奇（1312—1365）是罗斯托夫王公瓦西里·康斯坦丁诺维奇的次子，1320年罗斯托夫公国分裂后，成为领有鲍里索格列布斯基一侧的首位支系王公。1328年他娶莫斯科王公伊凡·卡利塔之女玛丽亚，此后作为臣属王公为莫斯科效力，1340年参与征讨斯摩棱斯克，1348年领兵抵御瑞典。1360年他取得金帐汗统辖整个罗斯托夫的诰封，夺走侄子安德烈·费奥多罗维奇的乌斯列滕斯基一侧；但侄子得到莫斯科军队支持，1364年迫使他避居乌斯秋格。他后来返回罗斯托夫，1365年染瘟疫去世。

en: Maria Yaroslavna (1232-1297) was a daughter of Yaroslav Yuryevich, prince of Murom. In 1248 she married Boris Vasilkovich, prince of Rostov, and bore him sons Dmitry, Konstantin and Vasily; the two elder sons later ruled Rostov.
zh: 玛丽亚·雅罗斯拉夫娜（1232—1297）是穆罗姆王公雅罗斯拉夫·尤里耶维奇之女，1248年嫁给罗斯托夫王公鲍里斯·瓦西里科维奇，生子德米特里、康斯坦丁和瓦西里，其中两个长子后来相继统治罗斯托夫。

en: Vasilko Konstantinovich (1208-1238), eldest son of Konstantin Vsevolodovich of Vladimir, ruled Rostov from his father's death in 1218, his lands guaranteed by his uncle Grand Prince Yuri. He campaigned against the Volga Bulgars in 1220 and reached the Kalka battle in 1223 too late to fight. In 1238 he faced Batu's Mongol invasion, was captured after the rout on the Sit River and killed in the Sherensky forest. His sons Boris and Gleb divided Rostov and Beloozero; the Orthodox Church venerates him as a martyr.
zh: 瓦西里科·康斯坦丁诺维奇（1208—1238）是弗拉基米尔大公康斯坦丁·弗谢沃洛多维奇的长子，1218年父亲去世后成为罗斯托夫王公，封地由叔父尤里大公保证。1220年他出兵征讨伏尔加保加利亚，1223年赶到迦勒河战场时已来不及参战。1238年他率军抵抗拔都的蒙古入侵，在锡塔河战败后被俘，遇害于舍连斯基森林。他的儿子鲍里斯与格列布分领罗斯托夫和别洛焦尔斯克；东正教会将他尊为殉道者。

en: Vasily Konstantinovich (1291–1316) was prince of Rostov from 1307, when he succeeded his father Konstantin Borisovich, until his death. A chronicle records his return in 1316 with the Tatar envoys Kazanchy and Sabanchy, who, the chronicler writes, did much evil in Rostov. The situation in Rostov at the time appears to have been connected with the struggle between Mikhail of Tver and Yury of Moscow for the grand princely throne of Vladimir. He left two sons, Fyodor and Konstantin, under whom Rostov split into two appanages.
zh: 瓦西里·康斯坦丁诺维奇（1291—1316）于1307年继承父亲康斯坦丁·鲍里索维奇之位，成为罗斯托夫王公，直至去世。编年史记载，1316年他与鞑靼使臣卡赞奇和萨班奇一同返回，编年史家称二人“在罗斯托夫多行恶事”。当时罗斯托夫的局势似乎与特维尔的米哈伊尔和莫斯科的尤里争夺弗拉基米尔大公之位有关。他留有费奥多尔、康斯坦丁两子，罗斯托夫公国在其二子治下分裂为两个封邑。

en: Yuri Alexandrovich (died 30 May 1320), also called Georgy, was a Rurikid prince, son of Alexander Konstantinovich of Uglich. He succeeded his father in Uglich in 1307 while still a child, and in 1316 he also took Rostov after the death of his uncle Vasily Konstantinovich, becoming the last prince to rule a united Rostov. In 1318 a fierce Tatar envoy named Kochka came from the Golden Horde and brought much suffering on the city. Yuri died in 1320 aged about seventeen, leaving no certain heir, and Rostov was divided between his cousins into two halves.
zh: 尤里·亚历山德罗维奇（？—1320年5月30日），又名格奥尔基，留里克王朝王公，乌戈利茨王公亚历山大·康斯坦丁诺维奇之子。1307年父亲去世后，年幼的他继位为乌戈利茨王公；1316年叔父瓦西里·康斯坦丁诺维奇去世，他又领有罗斯托夫，成为最后一位统治统一罗斯托夫的王公。1318年，金帐汗国派来“凶狠的使臣”科奇卡，给罗斯托夫带来许多苦难。1320年尤里去世，年仅约十七岁，没有确定的子嗣，罗斯托夫随即被堂兄弟们分为两半。

en: Hasdai Crescas (c. 1340–1410/11) was a Jewish philosopher and legal scholar born in Barcelona who later served as crown rabbi of Aragon. His major work, Or Adonai (Light of the Lord), challenged the Aristotelian logic that dominated Jewish theology, arguing that faith and God's will could not be reduced to it. His only son was killed in the massacre of 1391, and his most famous writings date from after that year. In 1401–1402 Charles III of Navarre paid for his journey through Navarrese towns, where he was known as rabbi of Zaragoza. His critique of Aristotle later shaped the thought of Baruch Spinoza.
zh: 哈斯代·克雷斯卡斯（约1340—1410/11）生于巴塞罗那，是犹太哲学家和律法学者，后任阿拉贡王室拉比。他的代表作《主之光》批判亚里士多德逻辑在犹太神学中的主导地位，主张信仰与神的意志不能完全套用这种逻辑。1391年大屠杀中，他的独子遇害，他最著名的著作正写于此后。1401—1402年，纳瓦拉国王查理三世出资，让他巡访纳瓦拉各城，当地人称他为萨拉戈萨的拉比。他对亚里士多德的批判，后来影响了斯宾诺莎。

en: Sabbatai Zevi (1626–c. 1676) was a mystic and rabbi from Smyrna of a Romaniote Jewish family. In 1665 he declared himself the Jewish Messiah in Smyrna, and his movement spread through Jewish communities in Italy, Germany, the Netherlands and the Ottoman lands. He taught that sins would become righteous acts in the Messianic Age, and some followers deliberately broke Jewish law. Arrested in Constantinople in 1666, he was given the choice of death or conversion to Islam. He converted, and about 300 families who followed him converted too. He was later banished to Ulcinj, where he died in isolation.
zh: 沙巴泰·泽维（1626—约1676）是士麦那的神秘主义者与拉比，出身罗马尼奥特犹太家族。1665年，他在士麦那宣布自己是犹太人期盼已久的弥赛亚，其运动随即在意大利、德意志、尼德兰和奥斯曼境内的犹太社群中扩散。他宣称在弥赛亚时代，原本的罪行会变为善行，因此一些追随者故意违反犹太律法。1666年他抵达君士坦丁堡后被捕，奥斯曼当局让他在死亡与改信伊斯兰之间选择。他改信伊斯兰教，约300个追随他的家庭也随之改宗。此后他被流放到乌尔齐尼，在那里孤独地死去。

en: Ferrand Martínez (fl. late 14th century) was a cleric of Seville cathedral and archdeacon of Écija, earlier confessor to the queen mother of Aragon. For years he preached against the Jews of Castile, and historians regard him as the prime mover of the 1391 massacres, which began in Seville and spread across the Iberian kingdoms. The royal government imprisoned him in 1395. He was soon released, died shortly afterwards, and left his fortune to a hospital he had founded in Seville.
zh: 费兰·马丁内斯（14世纪后期在世）是塞维利亚大教堂的神职人员，曾任埃西哈副主教，此前担任阿拉贡王太后的告解神父。他多年在卡斯蒂利亚煽动反犹布道，史家认为1391年的大屠杀主要由他推动。这场屠杀始于塞维利亚，随后蔓延到伊比利亚各王国。1395年，王室下令将他囚禁。他很快获释，不久后去世，把遗产留给了他在塞维利亚创办的一所医院。

en: Gracia Mendes Nasi (1510–1569) was a Portuguese Jewish merchant and philanthropist born in Lisbon to a converso family. She inherited part of her husband Francisco Mendes Benveniste's fortune on his death in 1535. In 1542 she took control of the Mendes banking and trading house. From 1549 she openly practised Judaism in Ferrara, and in 1553 she settled in Constantinople, where she ran escape networks for converso families fleeing the Inquisition. In 1558 Suleiman the Magnificent granted her a long-term lease of Tiberias in Galilee, and she financed its rebuilding as a refuge for Jewish exiles.
zh: 格拉西亚·门德斯·纳西（1510—1569）是葡萄牙犹太商人和慈善家，生于里斯本的一个改宗者家族。1535年，丈夫弗朗西斯科·门德斯·贝内维斯特去世，她继承了他的一部分财富。1542年，她接管了门德斯银行与贸易商号。1549年起，她在费拉拉公开信奉犹太教；1553年她定居君士坦丁堡，并组织秘密路线，帮助逃离宗教裁判所的改宗者家庭。1558年，苏莱曼一世授予她加利利提比里亚的长期租约，她出资重建该城，使其成为犹太流亡者的避难所。

en: Joseph Nasi (1524–1579), known in Portuguese as João Miques, was a financier born to a Marrano family in Portugal who fled the Inquisition with his aunt Gracia Mendes Nasi. They reached the Ottoman capital in 1554, and he backed Selim II against his rival Bayezid, which made him a leading diplomat. He was appointed lord of Tiberias to resettle Jews there, but the project largely failed. Selim later made him Duke of Naxos. After Selim's death he lost influence, but he kept his titles.
zh: 约瑟夫·纳西（1524—1579）葡萄牙语名若昂·米克斯，出生于葡萄牙一个秘密信奉犹太教的家庭，与姑母格拉西亚·门德斯·纳西一同逃离宗教裁判所。1554年，他们抵达奥斯曼首都，他支持塞利姆二世对抗对手巴耶济德，由此成为重要的外交官。他被任命为提比里亚领主，计划在当地安置犹太人，但大体未能成功。塞利姆授予他纳克索斯公爵的头衔。塞利姆去世后他失去影响力，但仍保有头衔。

en: Joseph Maimaran was a Jewish financial adviser at Meknes and a leader of Moroccan Jewry under Sultan Moulay Ismail, who came to the throne in 1672. In 1682 he played a major part in drafting and negotiating commercial treaties between Morocco and the Netherlands. He died in 1683, and his son Abraham succeeded him as the sultan's favorite.
zh: 约瑟夫·迈马兰是穆莱·伊斯梅尔苏丹（1672年即位）时期梅克内斯的犹太财政顾问和摩洛哥犹太人首领。1682年，他在摩洛哥与荷兰商约的起草和谈判中发挥了重要作用。1683年他去世，儿子亚伯拉罕接替他成为苏丹的宠臣。

en: Samuel Pallache (c. 1550–1616) was a Moroccan Jewish merchant who served the Saadi sultan Zidan Abu Maali as an envoy to the Dutch Republic. In 1608 he negotiated with Prince Maurice of Nassau and the States-General at The Hague, and the 1610 Treaty of Friendship and Free Commerce was an early formal treaty between a European and a non-Christian state. Maurice also granted him permission to privateer, and he raided Portuguese and Spanish shipping. In 1614 he was arrested in England after capturing a Portuguese ship, and Maurice helped secure his release. He died at The Hague in 1616.
zh: 塞缪尔·帕拉切（约1550—1616）是摩洛哥犹太商人，受萨阿德王朝苏丹宰丹·阿布·马阿里派遣，出使尼德兰共和国。1608年，他在海牙与拿骚的莫里斯亲王及联省议会谈判，1610年签订《友好与自由贸易条约》，这是欧洲国家与非基督教国家早期的正式条约之一。莫里斯还授予他私掠许可，他因此袭击葡萄牙和西班牙的船只。1614年，他俘获一艘葡萄牙船后在英格兰被捕，莫里斯出面协助，使他获释。1616年，他在海牙去世。

en: Thomas Fairfax, 3rd Lord Fairfax of Cameron (1612–1671), known to his men as Black Tom, was an English Parliamentarian general. After soldiering in the Netherlands, he fought for Parliament from 1642 as second-in-command to his father in the north and distinguished himself at the Battle of Marston Moor in 1644. In January 1645 he was appointed commander-in-chief of the newly formed New Model Army, which forced Charles I's surrender in 1646. In 1648 he subdued royalist insurgents in Kent before besieging Colchester. Refusing to take part in the king's trial, he tried to prevent his execution. He resigned in 1650 and later backed George Monck's restoration of Charles II in 1660.
zh: 第三代卡梅伦的费尔法克斯勋爵托马斯·费尔法克斯（1612—1671）被部下称为“黑汤姆”，是英格兰议会军将领。他曾在荷兰从军，1642年起在北方担任父亲的副手，为议会作战，1644年在马斯顿荒原之战中立下战功。1645年1月，他被任命为新组建的新模范军总司令，于1646年迫使查理一世投降。1648年，他先平定肯特的王党叛乱，随后围攻科尔切斯特。他拒绝参与审判国王，并试图阻止处决。1650年他辞去军职，后来支持乔治·蒙克在1660年迎立查理二世复辟。

en: Dilawar Khan, who reigned as Amid Shah Daud Dilawar Shah, was an Afghan governor who founded the Malwa Sultanate. At Delhi he supported the rebel prince Muhammad ibn Firuz and was imprisoned by court officials. He was appointed governor of Malwa at Dhar in 1392 by the Tughlaq court. Following Timur's sack of Delhi in 1398, the fugitive Sultan Muhammad Shah sought shelter with him, and Dilawar offered him his kingdom and treasure. As Tughlaq authority collapsed, he had the Friday sermon read in his own name in 1401 and ruled Dhar as an independent sultan. He warred unsuccessfully against Malik Sarwar of Jaunpur. He died in 1406 and was succeeded by his son Hoshang Shah.
zh: 迪拉瓦尔汗，王号阿米德沙·达乌德·迪拉瓦尔沙，是阿富汗裔长官，马尔瓦苏丹国的开创者。他在德里支持叛乱的王子穆罕默德·伊本·菲鲁兹，因此被朝臣囚禁。1392年他被图格鲁克朝廷任命为驻达尔的马尔瓦长官。1398年帖木儿洗劫德里后，出逃的苏丹穆罕默德沙前来避难，迪拉瓦尔将自己的国土与财宝供其使用。随着图格鲁克权威崩溃，他于1401年命人以自己的名义宣读周五布道，在达尔建立独立的苏丹国。他与江布尔的马利克·萨尔瓦尔交战，却兵败撤退。他于1406年去世，其子胡尚格沙继位。

en: Ismail Mukh, an Afghan noble also styled Nasir-ud-din Ismail Shah, led the Deccani amirs who rebelled against Muhammad bin Tughluq of Delhi. The Deccan had been part of the Delhi Sultanate since the Khilji dynasty. In 1346 the rebels at Daulatabad raised Ismail to the throne, and their revolt broke Delhi's hold on the region. After the amirs' victory over the imperial army, Ismail stood down on 3 August 1347 in favour of Zafar Khan, who founded the Bahmani Sultanate as Ala-ud-din Bahman Shah. He received a jagir near Jamkhandi and the title Amir-ul-Umara, but was later poisoned by a local chieftain named Narayana.
zh: 伊斯梅尔·穆赫是阿富汗贵族，称号纳西尔丁·伊斯梅尔沙，领导德干的埃米尔们反叛德里苏丹穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克。德干自卡尔吉王朝以来便是德里苏丹国的一部分。1346年，叛军在道拉塔巴德拥立伊斯梅尔为王，这场叛乱使德里失去对德干的控制。联军击败朝廷大军后，1347年8月3日，伊斯梅尔让位给扎法尔汗；后者以阿拉乌德丁·巴赫曼沙之名建立巴赫曼尼苏丹国。他受封贾姆坎迪附近的封地，得到“众埃米尔之长”头衔，后来却被当地首领纳拉亚纳毒杀。

en: Malik Sarwar (died 1399), a eunuch of humble, possibly African origin, rose in the Delhi Sultanate from keeper of the royal jewels under Firuz Shah Tughlaq to governor of Delhi and then wazir, bearing the title Khwaja-i-Jahan. He helped Muhammad Shah IV gain the throne and was later made governor of the eastern provinces with the title Sultan-ush-Sharq. In 1394 Sultan Mahmud Shah sent him east with an army and twenty elephants to crush a rebellion at Jaunpur. With Delhi collapsing, he ruled the eastern provinces in practical independence, struck coins and had the Friday sermon read in his name, taking the title Atabak-i-Azam. He founded the Sharqi dynasty of Jaunpur and was succeeded by his adopted heir Mubarak Shah.
zh: 马利克·萨尔瓦尔（？—1399）出身卑微，是一名宦官，可能有非洲血统。他在德里苏丹国由菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克朝的王室珠宝保管官，累升至德里城长官和维齐尔，称号“世界之主”。他助穆罕默德沙四世登上王位，后来获任东部诸省长官，并受封“东方之苏丹”。1394年，苏丹马哈茂德沙派他率军携二十头战象东进，镇压江布尔的叛乱。此时德里国势崩溃，他实际上独立统治东部诸省，自铸钱币、以自己的名义宣读周五布道，并自称阿塔巴克·阿扎姆。他开创江布尔沙尔基王朝，死后由养子穆巴拉克沙继位。

en: Muzaffar Shah I (1342–1411), born Zafar Khan, was a Tughlaq-appointed governor who founded the Gujarat Sultanate. His paternal aunt had married into the Tughlaq family. In 1391 Delhi made him governor of Gujarat; the next year he defeated and killed the rebel Farhat-ul-Mulk at the battle of Kamboi and took charge at Patan. Farhat-ul-Mulk, the previous governor, had already defeated and killed an earlier appointee sent to replace him. When Timur sacked Delhi in 1398 and the sultanate disintegrated, Zafar Khan ruled Gujarat on his own. His son Tatar Khan deposed him in 1403 but died in 1404, when he regained power. He proclaimed himself Sultan Muzaffar Shah in 1407 and died in 1411, succeeded by his grandson Ahmad Shah I.
zh: 穆扎法尔沙一世（1342—1411）原名扎法尔汗，本是德里图格鲁克王朝任命的古吉拉特长官，后成为古吉拉特苏丹国的开创者。他的姑母嫁入了图格鲁克家族。1391年，德里朝廷任命他为古吉拉特长官；次年他在坎博伊之战击败并杀死叛乱的法尔哈特·穆勒克，入主帕坦。前任长官法尔哈特·穆勒克此前已击败并杀死朝廷派来接替他的一名官员。1398年帖木儿攻陷德里、苏丹国瓦解，扎法尔汗便独自统治古吉拉特。1403年其子塔塔尔汗将他废黜，塔塔尔汗于1404年死去，他重掌权力。1407年他自立为穆扎法尔沙，1411年去世，其孙艾哈迈德沙一世继位。

en: Ferdinand I (1380–1416), called Ferdinand of Antequera and the Just, was the younger son of John I of Castile and Eleanor of Aragon, born at Medina del Campo. From 1406 he was regent of Castile for his nephew John II alongside the boy's mother, Catherine of Lancaster, and in 1410 he took Antequera from Granada. When his maternal uncle Martin I of Aragon died without surviving legitimate offspring, the Compromise of Caspe chose Ferdinand king in 1412, making him the first Castilian ruler of the Crown of Aragon. He crushed the revolt of James II of Urgell in 1413. In 1416 he helped end the Western Schism by abandoning Antipope Benedict XIII, and died at Igualada on 2 April 1416.
zh: 斐迪南一世（1380—1416），又称安特克拉的斐迪南、“正义者”，是卡斯蒂利亚国王胡安一世与阿拉贡的埃莉诺所生的次子，生于梅迪纳德尔坎波。1406年起他与侄子胡安二世的母亲兰开斯特的凯瑟琳共同摄政卡斯蒂利亚，1410年从格拉纳达手中夺取安特克拉。他的舅父阿拉贡国王马丁一世去世时没有在世的合法子嗣，1412年卡斯佩妥协会议推举斐迪南为王，使他成为阿拉贡联合王国首位卡斯蒂利亚出身的统治者。1413年他镇压了乌尔赫尔的海梅二世的叛乱。1416年他抛弃对立教宗本笃十三世，帮助结束西方教会大分裂，同年4月2日卒于伊瓜拉达。

en: Joanot Martorell (c. 1410–1465) was a Valencian knight and writer, born in Valencia into a minor noble family from Gandia. Knighted by 1433, he spent long years in England, Portugal and Naples over his many chivalric disputes. From 1437 to 1445 he quarrelled with his cousin Joan de Monpalau, who had reportedly broken a promise to marry his sister. In England in 1438 he translated Guy of Warwick, and in 1454 he joined Alfonso the Magnanimous at Naples. On 2 January 1460 he began his romance Tirant lo Blanch, written in Valencian. He died in Valencia in 1465, leaving the manuscript with his creditor Martí Joan de Galba, who had it printed there in 1490. Cervantes later praised the book in Don Quixote.
zh: 祖亚诺·马杜尼（约1410—1465）是巴伦西亚骑士与作家，生于巴伦西亚一个祖籍甘迪亚的小贵族家庭。1433年他已有骑士身份，因多次骑士纷争长期旅居英格兰、葡萄牙和那不勒斯。1437至1445年，他与表亲祖安·德·蒙帕劳争执，后者似乎违背了迎娶他妹妹的诺言。1438年他在英格兰翻译《华威的盖伊》，1454年赴那不勒斯投奔宽宏的阿方索。1460年1月2日，他开始用巴伦西亚语创作骑士小说《骑士蒂朗》。1465年他卒于巴伦西亚，手稿留给债主马蒂·祖安·德·加尔巴，后者于1490年将其付梓。塞万提斯后来在《堂吉诃德》中盛赞此书。

en: Abraham Cresques (1325–1387), whose Hebrew name was Elisha ben Abraham, was a Jewish cartographer of Palma on Majorca and a leading figure of the Majorcan cartographic school. He made his living as a master map-maker and as a builder of clocks, compasses and nautical instruments, and was praised by a contemporary as a master of mappae mundi and of illuminated manuscripts. Together with his son Jehuda Cresques he drew the Catalan Atlas, conventionally dated 1375, a six-leaf world map on vellum that was in the French royal library by 1380 and is counted among the finest medieval maps.
zh: 亚伯拉罕·克雷斯克斯（1325—1387），希伯来名为以利沙·本·亚伯拉罕，是马略卡岛帕尔马的犹太地图学家，也是马略卡地图学派的代表人物。他以绘制地图为业，兼造钟表、罗盘和其他航海仪器；同时代人称他精通世界地图与泥金手抄本。他与儿子耶胡达·克雷斯克斯合作绘制了通常系年于1375年的《加泰罗尼亚地图集》，这是一部绘在六张羊皮纸上的世界地图，1380年已入藏法国王室图书馆，被视为中世纪最杰出的地图作品之一。

en: Francisco Herrera the Younger (1622–1685), el Mozo, was a Spanish painter and architect, born in Seville, the son of painter Francisco Herrera the Elder. He fled his father's violent temper for Rome, where he studied architecture and fresco and became known for his still lifes of fish. He returned to Seville in 1656, helped found the Seville Academy and in 1660 served under Murillo as sub-director. In Madrid from about 1661, he painted the Triumph of St. Hermengild; Philip IV made him court painter and superintendent of royal buildings, and Charles II named him master of the royal works. He designed the rebuilding of the Basilica of Our Lady of the Pillar in Zaragoza, begun in 1681, and died in Madrid in 1685.
zh: 小弗朗西斯科·埃雷拉（埃尔·莫索，1622—1685）是西班牙画家、建筑师，生于塞维利亚，是画家老弗朗西斯科·埃雷拉之子。他因父亲脾气暴烈而逃往罗马，在那里研习建筑与湿壁画，并以鱼类静物画闻名。1656年他回到塞维利亚，参与创立塞维利亚美术学院，1660年在牟利罗之下任副院长。约1661年起他在马德里供职，绘制《圣埃尔梅内希尔多的凯旋》；腓力四世任他为宫廷画家兼皇家建筑总监，查理二世又任命他主持皇家工程。他设计了萨拉戈萨皮拉尔圣母大教堂的重建工程，工程于1681年动工，他本人于1685年卒于马德里。

en: Jerónimo Zurita (1512–1580) was a Spanish historian, born in Zaragoza, who founded the modern tradition of historical scholarship in Spain. He studied at Alcalá de Henares under the scholar Hernán Núñez. Through his father Miguel, a physician to Charles V, he entered public service. He served as magistrate at Barbastro and in 1537 became assistant-secretary of the Inquisition. In 1548 he was appointed the first official chronicler of the Kingdom of Aragon, and in 1566 Philip II made him secretary to the council of the Inquisition. He resigned in 1571 to finish his Anales de la Corona de Aragón, printed between 1562 and 1580 after research in the archives of Aragon and libraries in Rome, Naples and Sicily. He died at Zaragoza in November 1580.
zh: 赫罗尼莫·苏里塔（1512—1580）是西班牙历史学家，生于萨拉戈萨，被视为西班牙近代史学的奠基人。他在阿尔卡拉德埃纳雷斯师从学者埃尔南·努涅斯，凭借查理五世御医、父亲米格尔的影响进入公职。他曾任巴尔瓦斯特罗行政官，1537年出任宗教裁判所助理秘书；1548年被任命为阿拉贡王国第一位官方编年史家，1566年被腓力二世任为宗教裁判所委员会秘书。1571年他辞职专心撰写《阿拉贡王冠编年史》，依据阿拉贡档案馆及罗马、那不勒斯和西西里图书馆的史料，全书于1562至1580年间印行。1580年11月卒于萨拉戈萨。

en: Gualberto Fabricio de Vagad was an Aragonese Cistercian monk and the first chronicler of the Kingdom of Aragon, born in Zaragoza in the first third of the fifteenth century. He lived chiefly at the monastery of Santa María de Santa Fe and also at San Juan de la Peña. Commissioned by the deputies of Ferdinand II, who named him senior chronicler, he wrote the Crónica de Aragón in the vernacular, from the legendary kingdom of Sobrarbe to the death of Alfonso V in 1458. He consulted archives across the Crown of Aragon, including those of San Juan de la Peña and Poblet. In its prologues he argued for the preeminence of Aragon and the importance of Zaragoza. It was printed in Zaragoza in 1499.
zh: 瓜尔韦托·法布里西奥·德·巴加德（约15世纪初生）是阿拉贡的西多会修士，也是阿拉贡王国第一位编年史家，生于萨拉戈萨。他主要住在圣菲的圣玛利亚修道院，也曾在圣胡安德拉佩尼亚修道院修行。他受费尔南多二世的代表委托撰写俗语史书，并被国王封为大编年史家；所著《阿拉贡编年史》从传说中的索夫拉尔韦王国一直写到1458年阿方索五世去世。他查阅了阿拉贡联合王国各地的档案，包括圣胡安德拉佩尼亚和波夫莱特的档案，并在序言中为阿拉贡的首要地位和萨拉戈萨的重要性辩护。该书于1499年在萨拉戈萨印行。

en: Juan de Lanuza y Urrea (1564–1591), called the Younger, was the last hereditary Justice of Aragon, succeeding his father in September 1591. He was at once caught up in the Alterations of Aragon, the revolt sparked when Philip II tried to seize the fugitive secretary Antonio Pérez through the Inquisition. Two days after Lanuza took office, Pérez was to be transferred to the Inquisition, but a riot in Zaragoza freed him. When royal troops marched on Zaragoza, Lanuza declared the invasion a violation of Aragon's fueros and led a makeshift force against them; his men scattered and he was captured. On 20 December 1591 Philip II had him beheaded without trial.
zh: 胡安·德·拉努萨-乌雷亚（小拉努萨，1564—1591）是阿拉贡末代世袭大法官，1591年9月承袭父职。他上任即卷入阿拉贡动乱：腓力二世企图借宗教裁判所逮捕逃亡大臣安东尼奥·佩雷斯。拉努萨上任两天后，佩雷斯将被移交宗教裁判所，萨拉戈萨爆发暴动，民众将他救出。王室军队进军萨拉戈萨时，拉努萨宣布入境违反阿拉贡的古老法律特权，并率一支仓促集结的队伍抵抗，队伍随即溃散，他本人被俘。1591年12月20日，腓力二世下令不经审判将他斩首。

en: Juan Fernández de Heredia (c. 1310–1396) was an Aragonese knight, born at Munébrega. He joined the Knights Hospitaller in 1328, held several commanderies and in 1346 received the castellany of Amposta. Fighting for Peter IV of Aragon against the Union of Aragon, he took part in the victory at Epila in 1348. Elected Grand Master of the Hospitallers in 1377, he led the order's fruitless attempts to acquire the Principality of Achaea in Greece, and from Avignon commissioned translations and historiographical works in Aragonese, among them the Chronicle of Morea. He died in 1396 and was buried at Caspe.
zh: 胡安·费尔南德斯·德·埃雷迪亚（约1310—1396）是阿拉贡骑士，生于穆内夫雷加。他1328年加入医院骑士团，历任多个辖区，1346年获得安波斯塔城堡长官之职。他在1348年的埃皮拉战役中支持佩德罗四世对抗阿拉贡联盟并取胜。1377年他当选医院骑士团大团长，主导了骑士团夺取希腊亚该亚侯国却终归徒劳的行动；他在阿维尼翁赞助把多种典籍翻译、编纂为阿拉贡语的工作，《摩里亚编年史》的阿拉贡语译本即出自其安排。他于1396年去世，葬于卡斯佩。

en: Giovanni Pontano (1426–1503) was an Italian humanist and poet, born at Cerreto in the Duchy of Spoleto. After his father was killed in a street brawl he grew up in Perugia and around 1448 settled in Naples, where Antonio Beccadelli brought him into the chancery of Alfonso the Magnanimous. He tutored the king's sons and served the Aragonese dynasty as political adviser, military secretary and chancellor. Pope Innocent VIII crowned him with laurels in 1486, and in 1495 he welcomed Charles VIII of France into Naples. From 1471 he led the Accademia Pontaniana, which took his name, and wrote Latin treatises such as De liberalitate and De magnificentia. He died in Naples in 1503.
zh: 乔瓦尼·蓬塔诺（1426—1503）是意大利人文主义者、诗人，生于斯波莱托公国的切雷托。父亲在街头斗殴中被杀后，他随母亲逃到佩鲁贾长大，约1448年定居那不勒斯，经安东尼奥·贝卡代利引荐进入宽宏的阿方索的中书省。他担任国王诸子的教师，历任阿拉贡王朝的政治顾问、军务秘书和首相。1486年教宗依诺增爵八世为他授予桂冠，1495年他迎接法国国王查理八世进入那不勒斯。1471年起主持蓬塔诺学园，学园后来以他的名字命名，还著有《论慷慨》《论宏伟》等拉丁文论著。1503年卒于那不勒斯。

en: Constantine Phaulkon (1647–1688), born Konstantinos Gerakis on Cephalonia, was a Greek adventurer who became chief minister to King Narai of Siam. He left Cephalonia at thirteen for London, where his name became Falcon and then Phaulkon. In 1669 he sailed to Bantam and joined the English East India Company as a clerk. In Siam from 1675 as a Company merchant, he mastered Siamese and four other languages. In 1679 he entered the service of Kosa Lek, who introduced him to Narai's court as an interpreter in 1681. He ran the royal treasury and steered Siam toward alliance with France. His power provoked the 1688 revolution: as Narai lay dying, Phetracha seized the court and had Phaulkon beheaded that June.
zh: 康斯坦丁·华尔康（1647—1688）生于凯法利尼亚岛，原名康斯坦丁诺斯·耶拉基斯，是后来成为暹罗国王那莱首席大臣的希腊冒险家。他13岁离开凯法利尼亚前往伦敦，原名被英文化为福尔肯，后又改成希腊式的华尔康。1669年他航行至万丹，加入英国东印度公司担任文书。1675年他作为公司商人来到暹罗，掌握了泰语及另外四门语言。1679年他进入科沙勒克麾下，后者于1681年将他引荐至那莱王宫廷任译员。他掌管王室财政，并推动暹罗与法国结盟。他的权势引发1688年革命：那莱王病危之际，佩拉差控制宫廷，于当年6月将华尔康斩首。

en: Johannes Aventinus (1477–1534), born Johann Georg Turmair at Abensberg in Bavaria, was a Renaissance humanist historian and philologist. He studied at Ingolstadt, Vienna, Kraków and Paris, taking his master's degree in 1504. In 1509 he became tutor to Duke William IV's younger brothers Louis and Ernest, and in 1517 Bavaria's first court historiographer. Research at around ninety Bavarian places and monasteries fed his Latin Annals of the Dukes of Bavaria (1521); he then wrote the German Bavarian Chronicle. Suspected of Protestant sympathies, he was briefly imprisoned in 1528 and died at Regensburg in 1534, honoured as the father of Bavarian historiography.
zh: 约翰内斯·阿文蒂努斯（1477—1534）是文艺复兴时期的人文主义历史学家与语文学家，生于巴伐利亚阿本斯贝格，原名约翰·格奥尔格·图尔迈尔。他曾在英戈尔施塔特、维也纳、克拉科夫和巴黎求学，1504年获硕士学位。1509年他成为巴伐利亚公爵威廉四世之弟路德维希和恩斯特的教师，1517年出任巴伐利亚首任宫廷史官。他考察了约九十处巴伐利亚地点和修道院，在此基础上于1521年完成拉丁文的《巴伐利亚公爵编年史》，随后又撰写德文的《巴伐利亚编年史》。他因被疑同情新教于1528年短暂入狱，1534年在雷根斯堡去世，被誉为“巴伐利亚史学之父”。

en: Jörg von Halsbach, also called Ganghofer (died 6 October 1488), was a late Gothic bricklayer and architect trained probably at Braunau or Wasserburg am Inn. First recorded in 1441 during reconstruction of the choir at Ettal Abbey, he later worked on the parish church at Polling, completed in 1450. In 1479–1484 he was consulted on the church tower at Hall in Tirol. He is most famous for Munich's Frauenkirche, begun in red brick in 1468 and raised within twenty years. From 1470 he remodelled Munich's Old Town Hall in late Gothic style and in 1478 began the Kreuzkirche, while also serving the bishops of Freising. He died in Munich in 1488 and was buried in the Frauenkirche.
zh: 约格·冯·哈尔斯巴赫，又名甘霍费尔（卒于1488年10月6日），是晚期哥特式时期的泥瓦匠与建筑师，可能在因河畔布劳瑙或因河畔瓦瑟堡学艺。他1441年首次见于埃塔尔修道院教堂唱诗班席的重建工程，此后又参与波灵教区教堂的建设，后者于1450年完工。1479至1484年，他就蒂罗尔州哈尔的教堂钟楼建设提供咨询。他最著名的作品是慕尼黑圣母教堂：1468年以红砖动工，仅用约二十年便建成。1470年起他以晚期哥特式风格改建慕尼黑旧市政厅，1478年又动工建造十字教堂，同时还为弗赖辛主教效力。1488年他在慕尼黑去世，葬于圣母教堂。

en: Nur Qutb Alam was a Bengali Muslim scholar and Chishti Sufi of Hazrat Pandua, son and successor of the court scholar Alaul Haq. He personally served his father and visitors to the khanqah, declined his brother's offer of government employment and made several pilgrimages to Mecca. After the Hindu raja Ganesha seized power and persecuted Bengal's Muslims, Alam wrote to Sultan Ibrahim Sharqi of Jaunpur begging him to invade. Ganesha and his wife offered their son Jadu to Alam for guidance; the boy became a Muslim and ruled as Sultan Jalaluddin Muhammad Shah. Alam also pioneered the Dobhashi idiom of Bengali literature. He died in 1415 or 1416 and was buried at Pandua's Shash Hazari Dargah beside his father.
zh: 努尔·库特卜·阿拉姆是孟加拉潘杜阿的穆斯林学者与契斯提教团苏非，宫廷学者阿劳勒·哈克之子与传人。他亲自服侍父亲和道堂访客，拒绝兄长安排的官职，并多次前往麦加朝觐。印度教徒拉贾·加内沙夺权并迫害孟加拉穆斯林后，阿拉姆致书江布尔苏丹易卜拉欣·沙尔吉请求出兵。加内沙夫妇提出将儿子贾杜交给阿拉姆教导；贾杜皈依伊斯兰教，后来成为苏丹贾拉鲁丁·穆罕默德沙阿。阿拉姆还开创了孟加拉语文学的多巴希传统。他于1415或1416年去世，葬在潘杜阿的六千道堂，与父亲相伴。

en: Syed Sultan (c. 1550–1648) was a medieval Bengali Muslim poet, born at Habiganj in the Taraf region of greater Sylhet, into a family claiming descent from the local ruler Syed Habibullah of the kingdom of Taraf. He lived in the Sultanshi household at Habiganj and devoted his verse to Islamic themes. He championed the Bengali language against maulvis who despised the vernacular. His masterpiece, the Nabibangsha of 1584, retells the lives of the prophets in Bengali epic verse and is one of the earliest Bengali adaptations of the Qisas al-Anbiya. In it he expressed his love for his mother tongue and helped establish a Bengali Muslim literary tradition.
zh: 赛义德·苏丹（约1550—1648）是中世纪孟加拉穆斯林诗人，生于大锡尔赫特地区塔拉夫的霍比甘杰，家族自称是塔拉夫王国统治者赛义德·哈比布拉的后裔。他居住在霍比甘杰的苏丹希家族宅邸，以诗歌书写伊斯兰教题材，并捍卫孟加拉语，驳斥鄙视本地语言的毛拉。他的代表作、完成于1584年的《先知世系》以孟加拉语史诗诗体重述众先知的生平，是《众先知故事》最早的孟加拉语改编本之一。他在作品中表达了对母语的热爱，并帮助建立孟加拉穆斯林文学传统。

en: Khan Jahan Ali, also called Ulugh Khan, was a Muslim commander and saint who governed the Sundarbans region of Khalifatabad for the Bengal sultans. His name suggests a possible Turkic origin. A noble under the Tughlaq sultans of Delhi, he appears to have migrated to Bengal after Timur's sack of Delhi in 1398, and Sultan Mahmud Shah made him governor. Clearing the mangrove forests of the Ganges Delta, he laid out roads, bridges, tanks and hundreds of baked-brick mosques around his capital, the future Bagerhat; the great Sixty Dome Mosque was completed in 1459 and gave its name to the Khan Jahan style. He died on 25 October 1459 and was buried beside one of his reservoirs.
zh: 汗·贾汉·阿里，又称乌鲁格汗，是穆斯林将领与圣徒，在孟加拉苏丹治下出掌孙德尔本斯的哈里发塔巴德地区。他的名字暗示他可能有突厥血统。他曾是德里图格鲁克苏丹国的贵族，似乎在1398年帖木儿洗劫德里后迁居孟加拉，获马哈茂德沙阿任命为总督。他开垦恒河三角洲的红树林沼泽，在都城（即后来的巴凯尔哈特）周围修筑道路、桥梁、蓄水池和数百座烧砖清真寺；宏伟的六十穹顶清真寺于1459年在他任内建成，这一建筑风格也以他的名字命名。他于1459年10月25日去世，安葬在一座蓄水池旁的圣陵中。

en: John Amos Comenius (Jan Amos Komenský, 1592–1670) was a Czech theologian and pedagogue born in Moravia, last bishop of the Unity of the Brethren. Ordained in 1616, he became pastor and school rector at Fulnek four years later. Religious war cost him his property and writings in 1621. Persecuted by the Habsburgs, he led the Brethren into exile at Leszno in Poland in 1628. His Janua linguarum reserata of 1631 made him famous across Europe, and Didactica Magna laid out universal education for children of both sexes. Summoned to England and Sweden to reform schools, he later settled in Amsterdam and in 1658 published Orbis Pictus, the first widely used illustrated textbook. He died in Amsterdam in November 1670, remembered as the Teacher of Nations.
zh: 约翰·阿摩司·夸美纽斯（捷克语名扬·阿莫斯·科门斯基，1592—1670），生于摩拉维亚，是捷克神学家和教育家、捷克兄弟会的最后一位主教。他于1616年受按立，四年后成为富尔内克的牧师和学校校长。1621年的宗教战争使他失去了财产和著作。在哈布斯堡王朝的迫害下，他于1628年带领兄弟会信徒流亡波兰莱什诺。1631年出版的《语言入门》使他名扬欧洲，《大教学论》则系统阐述了面向男女儿童的普及教育。他曾应英国和瑞典之邀前往改革学校，晚年定居阿姆斯特丹，1658年在那里出版第一部广泛使用的插图教科书《世界图解》。1670年11月他在阿姆斯特丹去世，被誉为“人类的导师”。

en: Jan Rokycana (c. 1396–1471) was a Hussite theologian born in Rokycany and the elected, though never papally confirmed, archbishop of the Utraquist church. He opposed the Taborites at Konopiště in 1423, became vicar of Prague's Týn Church in 1427 and rector of Charles University in 1435. At the 1441 Kutná Hora diet he helped establish the fundamentals of Hussite belief as the law of the land. After seeking recognition from Pope Nicholas V and the Greek Church in Constantinople, he backed George of Poděbrady's election as king in 1458. He later spoke against George in his sermons, and suffered a stroke in 1466. He died in Prague in February 1471 and was buried in the Týn Church.
zh: 扬·罗基察纳（约1396—1471），生于罗基察尼，是胡斯派神学家、圣杯派教会选出的大主教，但始终未获教皇批准。他于1423年在科诺皮什捷反对塔博尔派，1427年任布拉格泰恩教堂代理神父，1435年任查理大学校长。1441年，他在库特纳霍拉的邦国会议上协助把胡斯派基本信条定为国家法律。他先后向教皇尼古拉五世和君士坦丁堡的希腊教会寻求承认，后于1458年支持波杰布拉德的伊日当选国王。他后来在布道中反对伊日，1466年中风。1471年2月他在布拉格去世，葬于泰恩教堂。

en: Jiří Melantrich z Aventina (c. 1511–1580), born Jiří Černý Rožďalovický, was the leading Czech Renaissance printer and publisher. He opened his Prague workshop in the mid-1540s. After Ferdinand I banned Czech Protestant literature in 1547, he joined the Catholic printer Bartoloměj Netolický, whose workshop he later took over. His Melantrich's Bible appeared from 1549 in five editions by 1577. He also printed Erasmus's humanist works and a Czech edition of Mattioli's herbarium in 1562. A Lutheran tolerant of Catholicism, he sat on the Old Town council and was ennobled with the title z Aventina in 1557. From 1576 he worked with Daniel Adam z Veleslavína, who took over the press after his death in 1580.
zh: 伊日·梅兰特里赫·兹·阿文蒂纳（约1511—1580），原名伊日·切尔尼·罗日达洛维茨基，是文艺复兴时期捷克最重要的印刷商和出版家。他于1540年代中期在布拉格开办印刷坊。1547年斐迪南一世禁止捷克语新教书籍后，他加入天主教印刷商巴尔托洛梅伊·内托利茨基的商号，后来接手其印刷坊。《梅兰特里赫圣经》1549年首次刊行，到1577年共出五版。他还印制了伊拉斯谟的人文主义著作，1562年出版了捷克语版马蒂奥利本草志。他身为路德宗信徒而包容天主教，曾任布拉格老城议会议员，1557年获封“兹·阿文蒂纳”贵族称号。1576年起他与丹尼尔·亚当·兹·韦莱斯拉温合作；1580年他去世后，印刷坊由后者接手。

en: Kilian Ignaz Dientzenhofer (1689–1751) was a German-Bohemian Baroque architect, born in Prague, the most gifted of the Dientzenhofer family of architects. His father Christoph was also an architect. After attending the Jesuit gymnasium in Prague, he left Bohemia in 1709 or 1710. He toured Germany, France and Italy and trained under Johann Lukas von Hildebrandt in Vienna, returning to Bohemia in 1716. In Prague he built the Church of Saint John of Nepomuk at Hradčany (1720–1728), redesigned the Loreta in 1723, added the convent of Břevnov Monastery, and completed the Church of Saint Nicholas in Malá Strana. He also rebuilt Broumov monastery and planned its surrounding group of village Baroque churches. He died in Prague in December 1751.
zh: 基利安·伊格纳茨·丁岑霍费尔（1689—1751），生于布拉格，是德意志裔波希米亚巴洛克建筑师，也是丁岑霍费尔建筑世家中最有才华的一员。他的父亲克里斯托夫也是建筑师。他在布拉格的耶稣会学校受教育，1709或1710年离开波希米亚，游历德意志、法兰西和意大利，在维也纳拜约翰·卢卡斯·冯·希尔德布兰特为师，1716年返回波希米亚。他在布拉格的作品包括城堡区的内波穆克圣约翰教堂（1720—1728）、1723年改建的洛雷托、布热夫诺夫修道院的楼宇，以及由他完工的小城圣尼古拉教堂。他还重建了布劳莫夫修道院，并规划了周边一组乡村巴洛克教堂。1751年12月他在布拉格去世。

en: Josef Dobrovský (1753–1829) was a Czech philologist and historian, born at Balassagyarmat in Hungary while his father was stationed there as a soldier, and a founder of the Czech National Revival. Once a Jesuit novice, he returned to Prague to study theology after the order was dissolved in 1773. He later tutored the Nostitz family and served as seminary rector at Olomouc until 1790. In 1792 he travelled to Scandinavia and Russia in search of manuscripts scattered during the Thirty Years' War. In Prague he helped found the Royal Czech Society of Sciences (1784) and the National Museum (1818). His History of the Czech Language and Literature (1792) and Czech grammar (1809) put the language on a scholarly footing, and his 1822 Old Church Slavonic grammar made him a founder of Slavic studies. He died at Brno in January 1829.
zh: 约瑟夫·多布罗夫斯基（1753—1829），生于匈牙利包洛绍焦尔毛特（其父随军驻扎于此），是捷克语言学家、历史学家，捷克民族复兴的奠基人之一。他早年入耶稣会为初学修士，1773年该会解散后回到布拉格学习神学，后任诺斯蒂茨伯爵家的家庭教师，并在奥洛穆茨担任神学院院长，1790年去职。1792年，他前往斯堪的纳维亚和俄国，寻找三十年战争中散失的手稿。他在布拉格参与创立了捷克皇家科学学会（1784年）和国家博物馆（1818年）。其《捷克语言与文学史》（1792年）和捷克语语法（1809年）为捷克语奠定了学术基础，1822年的古教会斯拉夫语语法更使他成为斯拉夫学的奠基人之一。1829年1月他在布尔诺去世。

en: Benedikt Rejt (c. 1454–1536) was a Bohemian architect of German origin, summoned to Prague by King Vladislav II as a master builder and military engineer. From 1485 he modernized Prague Castle's fortifications, adding the Daliborka and Mihulka artillery towers. By 1489 his standing was such that he was asked to review the work of architect Matěj Rejsek. His masterpiece, the Vladislav Hall of 1493–1502 in the Old Royal Palace, was the largest vaulted hall without interior supports in Central Europe, and its broad Knights' Staircase let horsemen ride in for tournaments. He also built St. Barbara's Church in Kutná Hora and St. Nicholas's Church in Louny. In 1518 he chaired a congress of architects and stonemasons at Annaberg in Saxony.
zh: 贝内迪克特·赖特（约1454—1536）是德意志血统的波希米亚建筑师，被国王弗拉迪斯拉夫二世召到布拉格，任工匠师傅兼军事工程师。他自1485年起改建布拉格城堡的防御工事，增建了达利博尔卡和米胡尔卡火炮塔楼。到1489年，他已颇有声望，受邀评议建筑师马捷伊·赖塞克的工程。他的代表作是老王宫内1493—1502年建成的弗拉迪斯拉夫大厅，为当时中欧最大的无内部支撑拱顶大厅；宽阔的骑士阶梯可让骑士骑马入场比武。他还主持修建了库特纳霍拉的圣巴巴拉教堂和洛乌尼的圣尼古拉教堂。1518年，他在萨克森的安纳贝格主持建筑师与石匠大会。

en: Johannes Kepler (1571–1630), born at Weil der Stadt, was a German astronomer and mathematician. He taught mathematics in Graz before moving to Prague in 1600 as assistant to Tycho Brahe, whose planetary observations he inherited after Brahe's death in 1601, when Rudolf II appointed him imperial mathematician. In Astronomia nova (1609) he showed that Mars moves in an ellipse and formulated his first two laws of planetary motion; the third followed in Harmonice Mundi (1619). His work in optics included an improved refracting telescope. Later based in Linz and then Sagan, he died at Regensburg in November 1630. His laws of planetary motion helped underpin Newton's theory of universal gravitation.
zh: 约翰内斯·开普勒（1571—1630），生于帝国自由城市魏尔代斯塔特，是德意志天文学家和数学家。他先在格拉茨教授数学，1600年到布拉格担任第谷·布拉赫的助手；1601年布拉赫去世后，他继承了其行星观测资料，并被鲁道夫二世任命为皇家数学家。他在1609年的《新天文学》中证明火星沿椭圆轨道运行，提出行星运动前两条定律；第三定律载于1619年的《世界的和谐》。他的光学工作包括改进折射望远镜。他后来辗转林茨和萨甘，1630年11月在雷根斯堡去世。他的行星运动定律为牛顿的万有引力理论奠定了基础。

en: Tycho Brahe (1546–1601), born Tyge Ottesen Brahe at Knutstorp in Danish Scania, was the greatest astronomer of the pre-telescopic age. His 1572 observations of a new star, described in De nova stella (1573), shattered the Aristotelian idea of an unchanging sky. King Frederick II gave him the island of Hven, where from 1576 he built Uraniborg and gathered unprecedentedly precise planetary data. He later worked at the underground observatory Stjerneborg, finding his instruments at Uraniborg insufficiently steady, and devised the geo-heliocentric Tychonic system. Forced out by Christian IV in 1597, he became imperial astronomer in Prague under Rudolf II, where Johannes Kepler assisted him until he died in 1601. Kepler later used his data to develop the laws of planetary motion.
zh: 第谷·布拉赫（1546—1601），原名蒂格·奥特森·布拉赫，生于丹麦斯科讷的克努兹托普庄园，是望远镜发明前最伟大的天文学家。他在1572年观测到一颗新星，1573年在《论新星》中加以记述，打破了亚里士多德天界不变的学说。丹麦国王腓特烈二世将汶岛赐给他，他自1576年起在岛上修建天堡，积累了空前精确的行星观测数据。他发现天堡的仪器不够稳定，后来在地下的星堡观测所工作，并提出地心与日心混合的第谷体系。1597年他被克里斯蒂安四世逐离丹麦，到布拉格出任鲁道夫二世的皇家天文学家，约翰内斯·开普勒担任他的助手，直到他1601年去世。开普勒后来利用他的数据提出行星运动定律。

en: Erasmus Reinhold (1511–1553) was a German astronomer and mathematician, born and died at Saalfeld in Saxony. Educated at Wittenberg under Jacob Milich, he became professor of higher mathematics there in 1536 through Philipp Melanchthon, and later served as dean and rector. He catalogued stars and published a commentary on Peurbach's planetary theory in 1542, praising Copernicus while rejecting heliocentric cosmology on physical and theological grounds. Backed by Duke Albert of Prussia, he issued the Prutenic Tables in 1551, which recast Copernicus's calculations in a geocentric frame and replaced the old Alfonsine Tables. After Reinhold's death, his tables helped underpin the Gregorian calendar reform of 1582.
zh: 伊拉斯谟·赖因霍尔德（1511—1553）是德意志天文学家与数学家，生于萨克森的萨尔费尔德，并卒于故乡。他在维滕贝格师从雅各布·米利希，1536年经菲利普·梅兰希通举荐任高等数学教授，后又担任院长与校长。他编纂了星表，1542年为普尔巴赫的行星理论著作出版注疏，称赞哥白尼，却因物理学和神学理由拒绝日心宇宙观。在普鲁士公爵阿尔布雷希特资助下，他于1551年刊行《普鲁士星表》，把哥白尼的计算方法重新纳入地心体系，并取代了旧的《阿方索星表》。他去世后，该表成为1582年格列高利历改革的基础之一。

en: Johann Crüger (1598–1662) was a German composer and hymn editor, born a Sorb innkeeper's son at Groß Breesen near Guben. After schooling in Guben, Sorau, Breslau and Regensburg and theological study at Wittenberg, he settled in Berlin in 1622. For forty years he taught at the Gymnasium zum Grauen Kloster and served as cantor of the Nikolaikirche. During the Thirty Years' War he survived plague, which claimed his wife and five children in 1636. From 1643 he set hymns by Paul Gerhardt, and in 1647 he published the Praxis pietatis melica, the most influential Lutheran hymnal of the century, which appeared in many editions. His tunes include Nun danket alle Gott and Jesu, meine Freude. He died in Berlin.
zh: 约翰·克吕格尔（1598—1662）是德意志作曲家与圣诗集编者，索布人，生于古本附近的大布雷森一个客栈主家庭。他先后在古本、索劳、布雷斯劳和雷根斯堡求学，又在维滕贝格攻读神学，1622年定居柏林。此后四十年间，他在灰色修道院文理中学任教，并担任圣尼古拉教堂唱诗班指挥。三十年战争期间他感染瘟疫，幸存下来，但妻子和五个孩子于1636年死于瘟疫。1643年起他为保罗·格哈特的圣诗谱曲，1647年出版《虔诚歌咏实践》，这是17世纪影响最大的路德宗圣诗集，后来多次再版。他谱写的曲调包括《众人当感谢上帝》和《耶稣，我的喜乐》，最终在柏林去世。

en: Moses Mendelssohn (1729–1786) was a German-Jewish philosopher and a father of the Jewish Enlightenment, born in Dessau. Destined for the rabbinate, he followed his teacher to Berlin in 1743 and educated himself in languages and philosophy, becoming a silk merchant's partner and a Berlin writer. In 1755 his friend Lessing published his Philosophical Conversations anonymously without consulting him. In 1763 he won the Berlin Academy's essay prize, ahead of Kant; his Platonic dialogue Phaedo (1767) on the immortality of the soul made him famous as the German Socrates. He defended religious liberty in Jerusalem (1783) and translated the Pentateuch into German. A lifelong friend of Lessing, he died in Berlin in 1786.
zh: 摩西·门德尔松（1729—1786）是德裔犹太哲学家、犹太启蒙运动的奠基人之一，生于德绍。他原本要走拉比之路，1743年随老师前往柏林，自学语言与哲学，后来成为丝绸商人的合伙人和柏林名重一时的作家。1755年，他的友人莱辛未经他同意，匿名发表了他的《哲学对话》。1763年他赢得柏林科学院征文奖，名次在康德之前；1767年模仿柏拉图写成的《斐多》论述灵魂不死，使他被誉为“德国的苏格拉底”。1783年他在《耶路撒冷》中捍卫信仰自由，并把摩西五经译成德语。他是莱辛一生的挚友，1786年在柏林去世。

en: Johannes Agricola (1494–1566), born Johann Schneider at Eisleben, was a Protestant reformer and once a close friend of Martin Luther, whom he served as secretary at the Leipzig disputation of 1519. He taught and preached at Wittenberg, Frankfurt and Eisleben before his recall in 1536. He defended the doctrine Luther branded antinomian: that Christians justified by the gospel were no longer bound by the Mosaic law. The quarrel drove him from Wittenberg to Berlin in 1540. Elector Joachim II Hector made him court preacher, and he helped draft the Augsburg Interim of 1548. Its proposed acceptance of Catholic authority made him an outcast among Protestant theologians. He died of plague in Berlin.
zh: 约翰·阿格里科拉（1494—1566），原名约翰·施奈德，生于艾斯莱本，是新教改革家，曾是马丁·路德的密友，1519年在莱比锡辩论中担任路德的记录秘书。他先后在维滕贝格、法兰克福和艾斯莱本任教、布道，1536年被召回维滕贝格。在那里他主张：因福音而称义的基督徒不再受摩西律法约束——这一学说被路德斥为“反律论”。争执迫使他于1540年离开维滕贝格前往柏林。勃兰登堡选帝侯约阿希姆二世任命他为宫廷牧师，他还参与起草了1548年的《奥格斯堡临时敕令》。敕令提出接受天主教权威，使他受到新教神学家排斥。他最终在柏林死于瘟疫。

en: Johann Gottlieb Fichte (1762–1814) was a German philosopher and founder of German idealism, born at Rammenau in Upper Lusatia. The son of a ribbon weaver, he received financial support for his education. After theology studies at Jena and Leipzig, he worked as a private tutor and studied Kant's writings. He visited Kant at Königsberg in 1791 and won fame with Attempt at a Critique of All Revelation (1792), first mistaken for Kant's work. He took a philosophy chair at Jena in 1794, but was dismissed over atheism in 1799 and moved to Berlin. In occupied Berlin he delivered the Addresses to the German Nation (1807–1808), and in 1810 became the first rector of Berlin's new university. He died in 1814.
zh: 约翰·戈特利布·费希特（1762—1814）是德国哲学家、德国唯心主义的奠基人之一，生于上卢萨蒂亚的拉梅瑙。他是织带工之子，受人资助求学。曾在耶拿和莱比锡攻读神学，后来以家庭教师为生，并研读康德的著作。1791年他到柯尼斯堡拜访康德，随后以《试评一切天启》（1792）一举成名——该书最初还被读者当成康德的著作。1794年他出任耶拿大学哲学教授，1799年因无神论之争被解职，迁居柏林。在法军占领的柏林，他发表了《对德意志民族的演讲》（1807—1808），1810年成为柏林新建大学的首任校长。1814年他在当地去世。

en: Christoph Friedrich Nicolai (1733–1811) was a Berlin bookseller, critic and satirical novelist, the son of the founder of the Nicolaische Buchhandlung. In 1749 he went to Frankfurt an der Oder to learn the bookselling trade, returning to Berlin in 1752. With Lessing and Mendelssohn he edited the review journal Briefe, die neueste Literatur betreffend from 1759 to 1765, followed by his own Allgemeine deutsche Bibliothek (1765–1792), the organ of the popular Enlightenment philosophers. His novels included Sebaldus Nothanker (1773–1776) and The Joys of Young Werther (1775), a parody of Goethe's Sorrows of Young Werther giving its hero a happy ending. He published anecdotes of Frederick the Great and died in Berlin in 1811.
zh: 克里斯托夫·弗里德里希·尼古拉（1733—1811）是柏林的书商、评论家和讽刺小说家，父亲是尼古拉书店的创办人。1749年他赴奥得河畔法兰克福学习书业，1752年返回柏林。他与莱辛、门德尔松合编书评刊物《最新文学通讯》（1759—1765），其后又独自主持《全德文库》（1765—1792），后者是通俗启蒙哲人的阵地。他的小说包括《塞巴尔杜斯·诺坦克尔》（1773—1776）和《少年维特之欢乐》（1775），后者戏仿歌德的《少年维特之烦恼》，给主人公安排了圆满结局。他还刊行过腓特烈大帝轶事集，1811年在柏林去世。

en: Wilhelm von Humboldt (1767–1835) was a Prussian philosopher, linguist and diplomat, born at Potsdam. In 1791 he married Caroline von Dacheröden; five of their eight children survived to adulthood. After serving as a Prussian diplomat in Rome, he was placed in charge of church and school affairs in 1809 and overhauled Prussian education from primary schools through gymnasia to teacher training and examinations. He saw education as a means of realizing individual potential, rather than preparing pupils for fixed social roles. In 1810 he founded the University of Berlin on the principle that teaching and research are inseparable, a model copied across Europe, the United States and Japan. He later represented Prussia at Frankfurt and in London, while his philosophy of language helped found ethnolinguistics. He died at Tegel in 1835.
zh: 威廉·冯·洪堡（1767—1835），普鲁士哲学家、语言学家、外交官，生于波茨坦。1791年他与卡罗琳·冯·达赫勒登结婚，八个孩子中有五人长大成人。他曾任普鲁士驻罗马外交官，1809年受命主管宗教与教育事务，对从小学、中学到师资培训与考试制度的普鲁士教育体系进行全面改革。他认为教育应当帮助个人实现潜能，而非让学生适应固定的社会角色。1810年，他创立柏林大学，以教学与研究相统一为原则，这一模式后为欧洲、美国和日本的大学所效仿。此后他先后在法兰克福和伦敦担任外交使节，其语言哲学研究为民族语言学奠定了基础。1835年，他在泰格尔去世。

en: Gotthold Ephraim Lessing (1729–1781) was a German dramatist and critic of the Enlightenment, born in Kamenz, Saxony. After study in Leipzig and journalism in Berlin, he served in Breslau from 1760, where he wrote Laocoön. From 1767 he was the Hamburg National Theatre's critic, pioneering dramaturgy, and in 1770 became librarian at Wolfenbüttel. His friendship with the philosopher Mendelssohn had drawn him into the religious debates of his day. His pamphlet feud with Pastor Goeze in 1778 brought a ban, to which he replied with Nathan the Wise (1779), whose ring parable pleads for tolerance among Judaism, Christianity and Islam; its hero was modelled on his friend Moses Mendelssohn. He died in Brunswick in 1781.
zh: 戈特霍尔德·埃弗拉伊姆·莱辛（1729—1781）是德国启蒙运动时期的剧作家与评论家，生于萨克森的卡门茨。他曾在莱比锡求学、在柏林撰稿，1760年起在布雷斯劳任职，写下《拉奥孔》。1767年起他担任汉堡民族剧院评论人，首创戏剧顾问行当，1770年出任沃尔芬比特尔的图书馆管理员。与门德尔松的友谊使他关注当时的宗教论争。1778年他因与牧师格策的小册子论战遭到查禁，遂以诗体剧《智者纳坦》（1779）回应，借“指环寓言”呼吁犹太教、基督教与伊斯兰教互相宽容，主人公的原型是他的友人摩西·门德尔松。1781年他在不伦瑞克去世。

en: Carl Gotthard Langhans (1732–1808) was a Prussian architect and a pioneer of Neoclassicism in Germany. Born in Landeshut, Silesia, he studied law at Halle before teaching himself architecture from Vitruvius and Winckelmann. His design for a church at Glogau won him recognition in 1764. He rebuilt Hatzfeld Palace between 1766 and 1774; the count also introduced him to the Berlin court. Langhans then headed Silesia's Prussian building authority from 1775. In 1788 Frederick William II named him first director of the royal building commission in Berlin and charged him with the Brandenburg Gate, modelled on Athens's Propylaea, erected from 1788 to 1791 and crowned by Schadow's quadriga. He died near Breslau in 1808.
zh: 卡尔·戈特哈德·朗汉斯（1732—1808）是普鲁士建筑师、德国新古典主义的先驱，生于西里西亚的兰德斯胡特。他曾在哈雷攻读法律，后来靠维特鲁威与温克尔曼的著作自学建筑。1764年他以格洛高一座教堂的设计初获认可，1766至1774年重建哈特费尔德宫；哈特费尔德伯爵还将他引荐到柏林宫廷。1775年起他主管普鲁士在西里西亚的营造机构。1788年，腓特烈·威廉二世任命他为柏林皇家营造委员会首任总监，委托他修建勃兰登堡门：这座门仿照雅典卫城的山门，建于1788至1791年，顶上是沙多制作的驷马战车雕塑。1808年他在布雷斯劳附近去世。

en: Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel (1770–1831), born in Stuttgart, was the culminating philosopher of German idealism. At the Tübingen seminary he roomed with the poet Hölderlin and the philosopher Schelling, and his thought was shaped by the French Revolution and the Napoleonic wars. He sought to overcome what he saw as untenable dualisms in modern philosophy and to understand reality as a unified whole. His Phenomenology of Spirit (1807) and Science of Logic (1812–1816) unfold a dialectic in which consciousness advances through contradiction toward self-knowing spirit, or Geist. For Hegel, spirit was humanity coming to know itself through a historical process of rational development. Appointed to the philosophy chair at Berlin, he taught there until his death in 1831; his followers then split into Right and Left camps, the latter shaping the young Karl Marx.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/格奥尔格·威廉·弗里德里希·黑格尔
zh: 格奥尔格·威廉·弗里德里希·黑格尔（1770—1831），生于斯图加特，是德国唯心主义哲学的集大成者。在图宾根神学院求学时，他与诗人荷尔德林、哲学家谢林同窗，法国大革命和拿破仑战争深刻塑造了他的思想。他试图克服近代哲学中他认为站不住脚的二元对立，把现实理解为一个统一的整体。1807年问世的《精神现象学》与1812至1816年出版的《逻辑学》以辩证法展开其体系：意识经由矛盾不断前进，最终达到自我认识的“精神”。在黑格尔看来，精神是人类通过理性发展的历史进程认识自身。他受聘担任柏林大学哲学讲席教授，在那里任教直至1831年去世。他死后弟子分裂为老年黑格尔派与青年黑格尔派，后者深刻影响了青年卡尔·马克思。

en: Anna Dorothea Therbusch (1721–1782) was a leading Rococo portrait painter born Anna Dorothea Lisiewski in Berlin, the daughter of portraitist Georg Lisiewski. Her father taught her and her siblings to paint, and she copied the works of Antoine Pesne in her youth. She and her sister were celebrated as child prodigies, but after marrying an innkeeper in 1742 she abandoned painting for nearly twenty years, returning to her easel around 1760. She worked for the Duke of Württemberg in Stuttgart, was elected to the Paris Académie Royale in 1767 with Denis Diderot's patronage, and came home to Berlin in 1768 as Frederick the Great's court portraitist, decorating Sanssouci and painting the Prussian royal family. She died there in 1782.
zh: 安娜·多萝西娅·特布施（1721—1782）是洛可可时期著名肖像画家，生于柏林，本名安娜·多萝西娅·利索夫斯卡，父亲是肖像画家格奥尔格·利索夫斯基。父亲教她和兄弟姐妹绘画，她年轻时临摹安托万·佩内的作品。她与姐姐早年被誉为绘画神童，但1742年嫁给一名客栈老板后搁笔近二十年，约1760年才重拾画笔。她在斯图加特为符腾堡公爵作画，1767年在德尼·狄德罗的支持下当选巴黎皇家艺术院院士，1768年返回柏林，成为腓特烈大帝的宫廷肖像画家，装饰无忧宫并为普鲁士王室画像。1782年她在当地去世。

en: Christian Wolff (1679–1754) was a German rationalist philosopher, born in Breslau. Appointed professor of mathematics and natural philosophy at the University of Halle in 1706, he built a comprehensive system modelled on Leibniz, presenting every science in a demonstrative, mathematical order. He wrote chiefly in German, making it a language of scholarly instruction. His praise of Confucian ethics in a 1721 oration on leaving the pro-rectorship enraged the Pietist faculty, and in 1723 King Frederick William I expelled him from Prussia on pain of death. He taught at Marburg until 1740, when Frederick the Great recalled him to Halle. He became university chancellor in 1743 and was ennobled as a baron in 1745.
zh: 克里斯蒂安·沃尔夫（1679—1754）是德国理性主义哲学家，生于西里西亚的布雷斯劳（今弗罗茨瓦夫）。1706年他受聘为哈雷大学数学与自然哲学教授，以莱布尼茨哲学为基础，用论证演绎的数学方法梳理各门学问。他主要用德语写作，使德语成为学术教学的语言。1721年他在卸任副校长的演说中赞扬孔子的伦理学说，激怒了虔敬派同僚；1723年，腓特烈·威廉一世将他逐出普鲁士，违令者处死。他在马尔堡任教至1740年，随后被腓特烈大帝隆重召回哈雷，1743年出任校长，1745年受封男爵。

en: Kurt Christoph von Schwerin (1684–1757) was a Prussian field marshal under Frederick the Great. After soldiering in Dutch and Mecklenburg ranks at Blenheim and Malplaquet, he entered Prussian service in 1720. In 1730 he sat on the court martial that tried Crown Prince Frederick for desertion. Promoted field marshal and count on Frederick's accession, he saved the campaign at Mollwitz in April 1741: he persuaded Frederick to leave the wavering field and converted it into the victory that secured Silesia. After the war he governed the fortresses of Brieg and Neisse. In 1744 he marched from Glatz to join the king and took part in the siege and capture of Prague. On 6 May 1757, leading a regiment with its colours at Prague, he was killed by a cannonball.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/库尔特·克里斯托夫·冯·施维林
zh: 库尔特·克里斯托夫·冯·施维林（1684—1757），腓特烈大帝麾下的普鲁士陆军元帅。他早年先后在荷兰和梅克伦堡的军队中服役，曾在布伦海姆和马尔普拉凯作战，1720年转入普鲁士效力。1730年，他作为军事法庭成员，审判以逃亡罪名受审的王储腓特烈。腓特烈即位后，他晋升元帅并受封伯爵；1741年4月的莫尔维茨会战中，他先劝腓特烈撤离胜负未卜的战场，随后把战局扭转为确保西里西亚到手的胜利。战后他出任布里格和奈塞要塞总督。1744年，他从格拉茨率军与国王会师，参与围攻和占领布拉格。1757年5月6日，他在布拉格战役中高举团旗带队冲锋，被炮弹击中阵亡。

en: Andreas Schlüter (1659–1714) was a German Baroque sculptor and architect. After decorating the Royal Chapel at Danzig in 1681 and making sculpture for John III Sobieski's Wilanów Palace, he was invited to Berlin in 1694 as court sculptor to Elector Frederick III. In 1696 he travelled through Italy, studying the works of the Italian masters Michelangelo and Gian Lorenzo Bernini. Thereafter he decorated the Zeughaus armory with his dying warriors and, as court architect, reshaped the Berlin City Palace. He designed the Amber Room (1701–1709) and cast the equestrian statue of the Great Elector in 1708. In 1713 he joined Tsar Peter the Great in Saint Petersburg, where he died the next year.
zh: 安德烈亚斯·施吕特（1659—1714）是德国巴洛克雕塑家与建筑师。1681年他为但泽皇家礼拜堂装饰立面，后又为约翰三世·索别斯基的维拉努夫宫创作雕塑，并于1694年应邀前往柏林，出任选帝侯腓特烈三世的宫廷雕塑家。1696年他游历意大利，研习意大利大师米开朗琪罗与吉安·洛伦佐·贝尼尼的作品。此后他在柏林兵器馆以“垂死战士”群雕装饰建筑，又以宫廷建筑师身份主持改造柏林城市宫。他设计了琥珀宫（1701—1709），1708年铸造“大选帝侯”骑马像。1713年他投奔圣彼得堡的沙皇彼得大帝，次年在当地去世。

en: Simeon was a Bulgarian monk who in 1355–1356 copied and illuminated the Gospels of Tsar Ivan Alexander for the tsar of the Second Bulgarian Empire. The parchment Gospel book contains 366 miniatures, one of medieval Bulgaria's most important surviving manuscripts.
zh: 西缅是一名保加利亚修士，于1355—1356年为第二保加利亚帝国沙皇伊凡·亚历山大抄写并绘制了《伊凡·亚历山大沙皇福音书》。这部羊皮纸福音书配有366幅细密画，是中世纪保加利亚文化留存至今最重要的手抄本之一。

en: Constantine Harmenopoulos (1320–c. 1385) was a Byzantine jurist of Armenian descent who served in Thessalonica as nomophylax and katholikos krites, one of the highest judgeships of the late empire. His fame rests on the Hexabiblos, compiled in 1344–1345, a six-volume handbook gathering a wide range of Byzantine legal sources. After his death, it was widely adopted in the Ottoman Balkans.
zh: 君士坦丁·阿尔梅诺普洛斯（1320—约1385）是亚美尼亚裔拜占庭法学家，在塞萨洛尼基担任法律守护者与“普世法官”，属帝国晚期最高司法职务之一。他最重要的著作是1344—1345年编成的《六卷书》，这部六卷本法律手册汇集了广泛的拜占庭法律文献。他去世后，该书在奥斯曼治下的巴尔干广泛通行。

en: Giovanni Giustiniani Longo (1418–1453) was a Genoese nobleman and mercenary captain of Chios's powerful Giustiniani family. In January 1453 he sailed to Constantinople with seven hundred men to defend the city against Sultan Mehmed II, and Emperor Constantine XI named him protostrator, commander of the land defense. He trained the garrison, reinforced the Theodosian Walls and cushioned the Ottoman cannonade by packing breaches with rubble. He held the St. Romanus sector through the 55-day siege until he was gravely wounded in the final assault of 29 May. Evacuated to Chios, he died of his wounds on 1 June 1453.
zh: 乔瓦尼·朱斯蒂尼亚尼·隆戈（1418—1453）是热那亚贵族与雇佣兵将领，出身希俄斯岛势力显赫的朱斯蒂尼亚尼家族。1453年1月，他率约七百人航抵君士坦丁堡，协助抵御苏丹穆罕默德二世的进攻，皇帝君士坦丁十一世任命他为首席马夫，统管陆防。他训练守军、加固狄奥多西城墙，并用瓦砾填塞城墙缺口以缓冲炮击，在长达55天的围攻中坚守圣罗曼努斯门一带，直至5月29日最后总攻时身负重伤。他被撤往希俄斯岛，于1453年6月1日伤重而死。

en: George Sphrantzes (1401–c. 1478) was a Byzantine courtier and historian born in Constantinople. From 1418 he attended Emperor Manuel II and became a lifelong confidant of Constantine XI: he governed Glarentza in the Morea, served as protovestiarites under John VIII, negotiated Constantine's marriage to Caterina Gattilusio in 1440 and was made prefect of Mystras in 1446. Captured near Patras in 1429, he was released to negotiate the citadel's surrender. He witnessed the fall of Constantinople in 1453, was enslaved by the Ottomans and ransomed that September; in 1454 he went to Adrianople to ransom his wife. After taking monastic vows in 1472 he wrote his Chronicle, a key eyewitness record of the empire's final decades that ends in 1477.
zh: 乔治·斯弗兰齐斯（1401—约1478）是生于君士坦丁堡的拜占庭朝臣兼历史学家。他自1418年侍奉曼努埃尔二世皇帝，此后成为君士坦丁十一世一生的心腹：曾在摩里亚担任格伦扎总督，在约翰八世朝任皇家衣橱总管，1440年为君士坦丁议定与卡泰丽娜·加蒂卢西奥的婚事，1446年出任米斯特拉长官。1429年他在帕特雷附近被俘，随后获释去商议城堡投降。1453年他亲历君士坦丁堡陷落，被奥斯曼人掳为奴隶，当年9月获赎；1454年他前往阿德里安堡赎回妻子。1472年出家为僧后，他撰写《编年史》，记述帝国最后数十年的历史，是重要的亲历者史料，叙事止于1477年。

en: Alexander Mavrocordatos the Exaporite (1641–1709) was a Greek physician and statesman of the Mavrocordatos family. Educated at Rome, Padua and Bologna, he earned a medical doctorate in 1664 with a treatise on blood circulation, then taught at Constantinople's Patriarchal Academy before entering Ottoman service. In 1673 he became Grand Dragoman of the Porte under Sultan Mehmed IV. As chief Ottoman negotiator of the Treaty of Karlowitz in 1699 he received the title Keeper of Secrets and an imperial countship. His sons Nicholas and John began the family's rule as hospodars of Moldavia and Wallachia. He died in 1709.
zh: 亚历山大·马夫罗科扎托斯（1641—1709），绰号“密臣”，是马夫罗科扎托斯家族的希腊医生与政治家。他先后在罗马、帕多瓦和博洛尼亚求学，1664年以论述血液循环的论文获博士学位，回国后任教于君士坦丁堡牧首学院，随后进入奥斯曼政府。1673年，他成为苏丹穆罕默德四世的大译长。1699年，他作为奥斯曼首席谈判代表签订《卡尔洛夫奇条约》，获“掌秘”头衔与帝国伯爵爵位。他的儿子尼古拉斯和约翰由此开启了家族对摩尔达维亚和瓦拉几亚的统治。他于1709年去世。

en: Philotheos Skoufos (c. 1615/1625–1685) was a Greek painter, educator and clergyman, born at Chania on Crete. On Corfu he collaborated with the painter Emmanuel Tzanes. Skoufos belonged to both the Cretan and Heptanese schools, blending their Byzantine icon tradition with Venetian painting, and was briefly attached to the Greek church of San Giorgio dei Greci in Venice. As a priest he officiated at the wedding of the painter Ioannis Moskos. He died on Zakynthos in 1685; his best-known works are the Stoning of Saint Stephen and the Virgin in the Temple.
zh: 菲洛塞奥斯·斯库福斯（约1615/1625—1685）是希腊画家、教师与教士，生于克里特岛的哈尼亚。他在科孚岛与画家埃马努伊尔·扎内斯合作。斯库福斯兼属克里特画派与爱奥尼亚画派，将拜占庭圣像传统与威尼斯画派技法融为一体，还曾短暂供职于威尼斯的希腊人圣乔治堂。他以神父身份主持了画家约安尼斯·莫斯霍斯的婚礼。1685年卒于扎金索斯，代表作有《圣司提反被石刑》和《圣殿中的圣母》。

en: Demetrios Kydones (1324–1398) was a Byzantine theologian, translator and statesman born in Thessalonica who served an unprecedented three terms as mesazon, the empire's chief minister, under John VI Kantakouzenos from 1347, John V Palaiologos from 1369 to 1383, and Manuel II. Learning Latin at John VI's request, he translated Thomas Aquinas' Summa contra Gentiles and Summa Theologica into Greek, introducing Latin scholasticism to Byzantine readers. He retired from office in 1354 to concentrate on Latin studies. A Catholic by 1365, he sought reconciliation between the Eastern and Western churches to secure a military alliance. In 1369 he accompanied John V to Rome to seek papal support against the Ottoman Turks.
zh: 德米特里奥斯·基多尼斯（1324—1398）是塞萨洛尼基出身的拜占庭神学家、翻译家与政治家，曾史无前例三度出任帝国首席大臣“梅萨宗”，先后侍奉约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯（1347年起）、约翰五世·巴列奥略（1369—1383年）与曼努埃尔二世。他应约翰六世之请学习拉丁语，把托马斯·阿奎那的《反异教大全》和《神学大全》译为希腊语，将拉丁经院哲学引入拜占庭读书界。1354年他卸任，专心研究拉丁文。他在1365年前已皈依天主教，并争取东西教会和解，以建立军事同盟。1369年他随约翰五世前往罗马，谋求教宗支持以对抗奥斯曼土耳其人。

en: Tomás de Torquemada (1420–1498) was a Castilian Dominican friar, born at Valladolid, who became confessor and closest advisor to Queen Isabella I and supported her marriage to Ferdinand of Aragon in 1469. He served as prior of the monastery of Santa Cruz at Segovia and was present at Isabella's coronation in 1474. After the Catholic Monarchs set up the Spanish Inquisition in 1478, Pope Sixtus IV made him an inquisitor in 1482 and first Grand Inquisitor in 1483. He issued 28 articles guiding its tribunals and built a court network across Castile and Aragon. A driving force behind the Alhambra Decree of 1492 expelling Spain's Jews, he died at Ávila in 1498, his name a byword for persecution.
zh: 托马斯·德·托尔克马达（1420—1498）是卡斯蒂利亚多明我会修士，生于巴利亚多利德，曾任伊莎贝拉一世女王的告解神父与最亲信的顾问，并支持她在1469年与阿拉贡王子斐迪南联姻。他曾任塞哥维亚圣克鲁斯修道院院长，并出席了伊莎贝拉1474年的加冕礼。1478年天主教双王设立西班牙宗教裁判所后，教皇西克斯图斯四世于1482年任命他为裁判官，1483年又任命他为第一任大裁判官。他颁布28条规章指导裁判法庭，在卡斯蒂利亚和阿拉贡建立起法庭网络。他是1492年驱逐西班牙犹太人的《阿尔罕布拉诏书》的主要推手之一，1498年卒于阿维拉，其名字此后成为宗教迫害的代名词。

en: Francisco de Zurbarán (baptized 7 November 1598 – 27 August 1664) was a Spanish Baroque painter born at Fuente de Cantos in Extremadura. Sent to Seville to train in 1614, a commission of twenty-one paintings for the Dominican monastery of San Pablo el Real made his name in 1626, and he settled in the city in 1629. Around 1630 he became painter to Philip IV. In 1631 he painted the great altarpiece of the Apotheosis of Saint Thomas Aquinas for the saint's college in Seville. Called the Spanish Caravaggio for his stark chiaroscuro, he painted austere monks, nuns and martyrs and still lifes widely exported to Spanish America. He moved to Madrid in 1658 and died there in 1664.
zh: 弗朗西斯科·德·苏巴朗（1598年11月7日受洗—1664年8月27日）是西班牙巴洛克画家，生于埃斯特雷马杜拉的丰特德坎托斯。他1614年被送往塞维利亚学艺，1626年为圣巴勃罗皇家多明我修道院绘制21幅画的订单使他成名，1629年定居该城。约1630年，他成为腓力四世的宫廷画家。1631年，他为塞维利亚的圣托马斯·阿奎那学院绘制大型祭坛画《圣托马斯·阿奎那的神化》。他以强烈的明暗对照被称为“西班牙的卡拉瓦乔”，绘制肃穆的修士、修女、殉道者与静物，作品大量销往西属美洲。1658年他迁居马德里，1664年在当地去世。

en: Jerónimo de Ayanz y Beaumont (1553–1613) was a Navarrese soldier and inventor. A page to Philip II from 1567, he learned military skills and mathematics at court. He fought in Tunisia in 1573, at Gembloux in 1578 and in the Azores in 1582, winning the Order of Calatrava.
