Appointed administrator of the crown mines in 1587, he oversaw mines in Spain and America and turned to technology: he tested an immersion suit before the court of Philip III in the Pisuerga in 1602, designed windmills, furnaces and mine ventilation systems, and in 1606 registered the first patent for a steam-powered machine, built to drain flooded mines. He died in Madrid in 1613.
zh: 埃罗尼莫·德·阿扬斯–博蒙特（1553—1613）是纳瓦拉军人与发明家。他1567年起担任腓力二世的侍童，在宫廷学习军事技能和数学。1573年他征战突尼斯，1578年参加让布卢战役，1582年转战亚速尔，获卡拉特拉瓦骑士团身份。1587年他受命总管王家矿山，管理西班牙和美洲的矿场，此后转向技术：1602年在皮苏埃尔加河向腓力三世的宫廷演示潜水服，又设计风车、熔炉和矿井通风系统；1606年他注册了最早的蒸汽机专利，所造蒸汽设备用于为淹水的矿井排水。1613年他在马德里去世。

en: Diego de Huallpa was a Quechua Indian of sixteenth-century Upper Peru, credited with the accidental discovery of silver on the Cerro Rico at Potosí in 1545. Tradition says he lit a fire against the cold while looking for a lost llama and found silver melted from the rock among the ashes. He sold the silver at Cantumarca and told his companion Huanca, seeking his help in working it. After a quarrel between them, the story reached the Spaniards of nearby Porco, and the mountain became a great silver mine. Huallpa himself won no reward; the legendary native leader Chaqui Catari cursed him for revealing the mountain. Some twenty-seven years after the discovery, Huallpa told Viceroy Toledo of a shrine on its slopes.
zh: 迭戈·德·瓦尔帕是16世纪上秘鲁的克丘亚印第安人，被认为于1545年偶然发现了波托西里科山的银矿。相传他在寻找一只走失的羊驼时，夜里生火御寒，次日在余烬中发现岩石熔化后渗出的银脉。他在坎图马尔卡出售白银，告诉同伴万卡此事，请他帮忙开采。两人争执后，消息辗转传到附近波尔科的西班牙人耳中，这座山随后成为一处大银矿。瓦尔帕本人没有得到赏赐，传说中的印第安首领查基·卡塔里则咒骂他泄露了山的秘密。发现银矿约27年后，瓦尔帕向托莱多总督讲述了山坡上的一处祭所。

en: Tomás Luis de Victoria (c. 1548–1611) was Spain's greatest Renaissance composer of sacred music. After his father died in 1557, his uncle Juan Luis became his guardian and supported his musical education. A choirboy at Ávila Cathedral, he went to Rome in 1565 with a grant from Philip II, sang at the German College, absorbed Palestrina's polyphony and was ordained a priest in 1574. His motets, masses and Offices for Holy Week and the Dead set Latin texts in intensely expressive polyphony. In 1587 Philip II made him chaplain to his sister, the Dowager Empress María, at Madrid's Descalzas Reales convent; after the empress died in 1603 he stayed on as organist. He died there in 1611.
zh: 托马斯·路易斯·德·维多利亚（约1548—1611）是西班牙文艺复兴最杰出的宗教音乐作曲家。1557年父亲去世后，他的叔父胡安·路易斯成为其监护人，支持他学习音乐。他幼年在阿维拉大教堂当唱诗童，1565年凭腓力二世的资助前往罗马，在日耳曼学院任歌手，汲取帕莱斯特里纳的复调技法，1574年晋铎为神父。他的经文歌、弥撒曲以及圣周和亡者日课以富有感染力的复调为拉丁经文谱曲。1587年腓力二世任命他为其姐、皇太后玛丽亚在马德里皇家赤足女修院的随行神父；1603年皇太后去世后，他留任修院管风琴师，1611年在修院去世。

en: Pedro Cieza de León (c. 1518–1554) was a Spanish conquistador and chronicler of Peru. Born in Llerena, he sailed for the Indies around 1536 and for years campaigned and travelled through Peru, Popayán and Charcas, recording Inca history and the geography of the Andes. He returned to Seville in 1551 and married Isabel López de Abreu. There he published the first part of his Crónica del Perú in 1553, describing the geography and customs of the Andes and the founding of Spanish towns. Its second part dealt with Inca rule. He died in 1554, leaving three parts unpublished; they appeared only in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries.
zh: 佩德罗·谢萨·德·莱昂（约1518—1554）是西班牙征服者、秘鲁编年史家。他生于列雷纳，约1536年前往西印度，长年在秘鲁、波帕扬和查尔卡斯征战游历，记录印加历史与安第斯的山川风物。1551年他返回塞维利亚，与伊莎贝尔·洛佩斯·德·阿夫雷乌结婚。1553年，他在那里出版《秘鲁纪事》第一部分，记述安第斯地理、风俗及西班牙人建立的城镇；第二部分则讲述印加统治。他于1554年去世，留下未出版的三个部分，直到19、20世纪才陆续问世。

en: Juan de Castellanos (1522–1607) was a Spanish soldier, chronicler and priest of the New Kingdom of Granada. Born in Alanís near Seville, he sailed to the Indies in the 1530s, served at the pearl fisheries of Cubagua, and fought in expeditions across the Caribbean and the Colombian coast. In 1555 he decided to pursue an ecclesiastical career at Cartagena; ordained a priest, he served there and later at Riohacha. From 1562 he was parish priest of Tunja, where he amassed a library and spent over four decades in his ministry and writing. His epic Elegías de varones ilustres de Indias is one of the longest poems in Spanish, a verse history of the conquest and the Muisca. He died at Tunja in 1607.
zh: 胡安·德·卡斯特利亚诺斯（1522—1607）是新格拉纳达王国的西班牙军人、编年史家与神父。他生于塞维利亚附近的阿拉尼斯，1530年代渡海前往西印度，曾在库瓦瓜的采珠场服役，随军转战加勒比海与哥伦比亚海岸。1555年他在卡塔赫纳决定投身教职，受铎后先后在那里和里奥阿查任职。1562年起他任通哈教区神父，在那里积聚藏书，度过四十余年的牧职与写作生涯。他的史诗《西印度名人哀歌》是西班牙语最长的诗篇之一，以诗体记述征服历程与穆伊斯卡人。1607年他在通哈去世。

en: Josefa Amar y Borbón (1749–1833) was a Spanish writer of the Enlightenment. Born at Saragossa, she moved to Madrid when her father became physician to the royal household and was educated by royal preceptors, mastering Greek, Latin, French, English and Italian. Access to the king's libraries also allowed her to educate herself. Married in 1764, she returned to Saragossa in 1772 and became the first woman admitted to the Aragonese Economic Society in 1782. She joined the Madrid Economic Society's Ladies' Group in 1787 and the Medical Society of Barcelona in 1790. Through essays and translations she defended women's equal capacity for learning and public office, and her Discourse on the Physical and Moral Education of Women appeared in 1790.
zh: 何塞法·阿马尔-波旁（1749—1833）是西班牙启蒙时代的作家。她生于萨拉戈萨，父亲成为王室御医后举家迁居马德里，由宫廷教师教导，掌握希腊语、拉丁语、法语、英语和意大利语。她也利用国王的藏书自学。她1764年结婚，1772年回到萨拉戈萨，1782年成为阿拉贡经济学会接纳的第一位女性。她于1787年加入马德里经济学会的妇女团体，1790年加入巴塞罗那医学会。她通过论文和译作论证女性在学习和担任公职上具有同等能力，所著《论女性的身体与道德教育》于1790年出版。

en: María de Zayas y Sotomayor (baptized 12 September 1590; died around 1661) was a Spanish Golden Age writer born in Madrid, the daughter of infantry captain Fernando de Zayas y Sotomayor and María Catalina de Barrasa. In 1637 she published in Zaragoza her first novella collection, Novelas amorosas y ejemplares, followed in 1647 by the starker Desengaños amorosos, whose heroines expose the wrongs women endured in their day; both collections are now read as early feminist fiction. She also wrote the play Friendship Betrayed and poetry. Admired by Lope de Vega, who dedicated poems to her, she was called the Sibyl of Madrid by Alonso de Castillo Solórzano. She vanishes from the records after 1647.
zh: 玛丽亚·德·萨亚斯-索托马约尔（1590年9月12日受洗，约1661年去世）是西班牙黄金时代作家，生于马德里，父亲费尔南多·德·萨亚斯-索托马约尔是一名步兵上尉，母亲是玛丽亚·卡塔利娜·德·巴拉萨。1637年，她在萨拉戈萨出版第一部短篇小说集《爱情与劝诫故事集》，1647年又出版基调更为冷峻的《爱情的幻灭》，借女主人公之口揭示当时女性所受的欺凌，两部集子今被视为早期女性主义文学。她还写有戏剧《友谊中的背叛》和诗歌。洛佩·德·维加对她推崇备至，曾为她献诗；阿隆索·德·卡斯蒂略·索洛萨诺称她为“马德里的西比尔”。1647年后，她从记载中消失。

en: Francisca de Pedraza was an orphan from Alcalá de Henares, raised in the girls' college of the convent of San Juan de la Penitencia. In 1612 she married Jerónimo de Jaras, who beat her from their wedding night. She appealed to civil and ecclesiastical courts; early rulings ordered her husband to change his conduct, but she continued to seek a separation. In 1624 the papal nuncio Innocenzo Massimo referred her case to the University of Alcalá's scholastic tribunal. Its rector Álvaro de Ayala granted her a legal separation, the return of her dowry and a restraining order, one of the first such rulings for an abused wife in Spain.
zh: 弗兰西斯卡·德·佩德拉萨是埃纳雷斯堡人，自幼父母双亡，在圣胡安·德·拉·佩尼滕西亚修道院的孤女学院长大。1612年，她嫁给赫罗尼莫·德·哈拉斯，此人从新婚之夜起便对她拳脚相加。她向民事和教会法庭求助，早期判决虽命令丈夫改变态度，她仍须继续争取分居。1624年，教皇驻西班牙使节因诺琴佐·马西莫将案件转交阿尔卡拉大学的教会法庭，校长阿尔瓦罗·德·阿亚拉判决夫妻分居，向她发还嫁妆并签发保护令。这是西班牙最早判给受虐妻子的分居裁决之一。

en: Bartolomé de las Casas (1484–1566), born in Seville, was a Dominican friar who defended the indigenous peoples of Spanish America. He reached Hispaniola in 1502 and held an encomienda, but after the conquest of Cuba he renounced it in 1514. He initially advocated replacing indigenous labour with enslaved Africans, but later repudiated that position. As Protector of the Indians from 1516 he lobbied the Crown for decades, helped win the New Laws of 1542, and served as Bishop of Chiapas. His Short Account of the Destruction of the Indies denounced colonial atrocities, and at the Valladolid debate of 1550 he refuted Sepúlveda's claim that Indians were natural slaves. He died in 1566.
zh: 巴托洛梅·德·拉斯·卡萨斯（1484—1566）是多明我会修士，生于塞维利亚，毕生为西属美洲的原住民奔走辩护。他1502年抵达伊斯帕尼奥拉岛，曾领有委托监护制下的原住民劳役；参加征服古巴之后，他于1514年放弃了自己的监护权。他最初主张以非洲奴隶取代原住民劳役，后来撤回了这一主张。1516年他被任命为印第安人保护者，数十年间不断向王室进言，推动1542年《新法》颁布，并一度出任恰帕斯主教。他的《西印度毁灭述略》控诉殖民暴行；在1550年巴利亚多利德辩论中，他驳斥了塞普尔韦达所谓印第安人是天生奴隶的主张。他于1566年去世。

en: Juan Ginés de Sepúlveda (1490–1573) was a Spanish humanist and theologian born in the province of Córdoba. After studying at Alcalá and Bologna, he translated works of Aristotle from Greek into Latin and served at the papal curia in Rome, writing against Luther and Henry VIII. In 1515 he entered the Spanish College at Bologna, where Pietro Pomponazzi taught him and Alberto Pío, Prince of Carpi, became his patron. In 1529 he urged Charles V to unite Europe against the Turks. In Democrates (1535) he argued that a just war founded on natural law was compatible with Christianity. He is chiefly remembered as the opponent of Bartolomé de las Casas at the Valladolid debate of 1550–1551, where he defended the Spanish conquest of the Indies and the subjugation of Native Americans.
zh: 胡安·希内斯·德·塞普尔韦达（1490—1573）是西班牙人文主义者、神学家，生于科尔多瓦省。他在阿尔卡拉和博洛尼亚求学后，将亚里士多德的著作由希腊文译为拉丁文，并在罗马教廷供职，撰文反对路德和亨利八世。1515年，他进入博洛尼亚西班牙学院，师从彼得罗·蓬波纳齐，并得到卡尔皮亲王阿尔贝托·皮奥的庇护。1529年，他呼吁查理五世联合欧洲对抗土耳其人。他在1535年的《民主派》中主张，基于自然法的正义战争与基督教并不矛盾。他最知名的是在1550—1551年的巴利亚多利德辩论中与巴托洛梅·德·拉斯卡萨斯对阵，为西班牙征服西印度和压服美洲原住民辩护。

en: Luisa de Medrano (1484–1527), born into a noble Navarrese-Castilian family at Atienza, was one of the puellae doctae, the learned girls of Renaissance Spain. At the court of Queen Isabella I, she studied history and humanist philosophy alongside the royal children. She taught Latin at the University of Salamanca, taking the chair once held by Antonio de Nebrija; on 16 November 1508 the rector Pedro de Torres recorded her reading in the chair of Canons. Her brother Luis was also rector of the university during her time there. The humanist Lucio Marineo Siculo praised her public lectures on Latin letters. Her poems and philosophical writings have not survived, and she died in 1527.
zh: 路易莎·德·梅德拉诺（1484—1527）生于阿蒂恩萨的纳瓦拉-卡斯蒂利亚贵族家庭，是文艺复兴时期西班牙的“博学少女”之一。她在伊莎贝拉一世女王的宫廷中与王室子女一同学习历史和人文主义哲学，后在萨拉曼卡大学讲授拉丁文，接替了安东尼奥·德·内布里哈的教席；1508年11月16日，校长佩德罗·德·托雷斯记录下她在教会法教席宣读。她在该校期间，其兄路易斯也曾任校长。人文主义者卢乔·马里内奥·西库洛曾赞誉她公开讲授拉丁典籍。她的诗作与哲学著作均已散佚，1527年去世。

en: Zenón de Somodevilla, Marquess of Ensenada (1702–1781), born near Logroño, entered the navy administration in 1720 and rose under Philip V's minister Patiño. In 1736 Charles of Naples made him Marquess of Ensenada, and in 1743 Philip V named him minister of finance, war, the navy and the Indies. He led Spain through the War of the Austrian Succession and from 1749 ordered the great census called the Catastro of Ensenada, meant to make taxation fairer. He strengthened royal control over the Church, promoted public works and sent young Spaniards abroad to study. Ousted by court intrigue in 1754, he was briefly recalled under Charles III, exiled again in 1766, and died at Medina del Campo.
zh: 恩塞纳达侯爵塞农·德·索莫德维利亚（1702—1781）生于洛格罗尼奥附近，1720年进入海军行政部门供职，在费利佩五世的大臣帕蒂尼奥手下得到提拔。1736年，那不勒斯的卡洛斯封他为恩塞纳达侯爵；1743年，费利佩五世任命他兼管财政、战争、海军与西印度事务。他主持西班牙参与奥地利王位继承战争，并自1749年起推行大规模土地普查，即“恩塞纳达普查”，意在公平税负。他加强王权对教会的控制，兴办公共工程，并派遣西班牙青年出国学习。1754年他在宫廷倾轧中失势，卡洛斯三世时一度被召回，1766年再度遭放逐，后死于梅迪纳德尔坎波。

en: Juan de Mena (1411–1456) was a Castilian poet born at Córdoba and educated at Salamanca, who travelled in Italy before entering the court of King Juan II. His father died shortly after his birth and his mother a few years later. On visits to Rome and Florence he apparently sought ecclesiastical benefices without success. The king named him secretary of Latin letters and royal chronicler, though he chiefly wrote Dantean poetry full of classical myth. His masterpiece, the Laberinto de Fortuna of 1444, also called Las Trezientas, uses three Wheels of Fortune to survey Castilian history, urging national unity and the Reconquista under Juan II. He held the post under Enrique IV and died at Torrelaguna in 1456, one of the century's three great Castilian poets.
zh: 胡安·德·梅纳（1411—1456）是卡斯蒂利亚诗人，生于科尔多瓦，曾在萨拉曼卡求学，游历意大利后进入国王胡安二世的宫廷。他出生不久父亲便去世，几年后又失去了母亲。他在罗马和佛罗伦萨似乎曾寻求教会俸禄，但未获成功。国王任命他为拉丁文书秘书兼王室史官，他却主要创作深受但丁影响、充满古典神话的诗歌。1444年的代表作《命运的迷宫》（又名《三百首》）借三座命运之轮纵览卡斯蒂利亚历史，呼吁在胡安二世治下实现国家统一、推进收复失地运动。恩里克四世即位后他继续担任史官，1456年卒于托雷拉古纳，是当时卡斯蒂利亚三大诗人之一。

en: Jorge Manrique (c. 1440–1479) was a Castilian nobleman and poet of the Manrique de Lara family, nephew of the poet Gómez Manrique. His literary kin also included his great-uncle the Marquis of Santillana and his ancestor Pero López de Ayala, chancellor of Castile. He fought for Isabella and Ferdinand against Juana la Beltraneja in the Castilian War of Succession. After his father Rodrigo, Grand Master of the Order of Santiago, died in 1476, Jorge composed the Coplas por la muerte de su padre, an elegy on death as the equaliser of worldly glory and one of the classics of Spanish poetry. In April 1479 he was mortally wounded storming Garcimuñoz Castle, held by the Marquis of Villena.
zh: 霍赫·曼里奎（约1440—1479）是卡斯蒂利亚贵族、诗人，出身曼里克·德·拉腊家族，为诗人戈麦斯·曼里克之侄。他的文学世家中还有叔祖桑蒂利亚纳侯爵和先祖卡斯蒂利亚掌玺大臣佩罗·洛佩斯·德·阿亚拉。他在卡斯蒂利亚继承战争中为伊莎贝拉与斐迪南作战，对抗胡安娜·拉·贝尔特兰内哈。1476年，他的父亲、圣地亚哥骑士团团长罗德里戈·曼里奎去世，霍赫写下《祭父词》，以死亡抹平世间一切荣华为题，成为西班牙语诗歌的千古名篇。1479年4月，他在攻打比列纳侯爵据守的加尔西穆尼奥斯城堡时伤重而死。

en: Juan Bautista Muñoz (1745–1799) was a Spanish historian born at Museros near Valencia. A Dominican philosopher, he taught at Valencia University until Charles III made him cosmographer-major of the Indies in 1770. At the university he opposed Scholasticism and sought to introduce modern subjects into the curriculum. In 1779 the king charged him with writing an archive-based history of the Spanish Americas. In Seville from 1784 he persuaded minister José de Gálvez to gather all overseas documents into one repository; the result was the Archive of the Indies in a former merchants' exchange. The first volume of his History of the New World appeared in 1793, and he died in Madrid six years later.
zh: 胡安·包蒂斯塔·穆尼奥斯（1745—1799）是西班牙历史学家，生于巴伦西亚附近的穆塞罗斯。他是多明我会修士、哲学家，曾在巴伦西亚大学任教，1770年被卡洛斯三世任命为西印度首席宇宙志学家。在大学里，他反对经院哲学，努力将现代学科引入课程。1779年，国王命他依据档案撰写一部新的西属美洲史。1784年起他驻在塞维利亚，说服大臣何塞·德·加尔维斯把所有海外文献集中到一处保存，最终在旧日的商人交易所里建成西印度群岛综合档案馆。他的《新世界史》第一卷于1793年问世，六年后在马德里去世。

en: Ambrogio Spinola (1569–1630) was a Genoese nobleman who became the foremost general of Habsburg Spain. Entering Spanish service in 1602, he raised nine thousand troops at his own expense and took Ostend in 1604, then commanded the Army of Flanders and seized a string of Rhine towns from Maurice of Nassau. Early in the Thirty Years' War he led a campaign in the Palatinate. After the Twelve Years' Truce ended, he won his famous victory at Breda in 1625, later immortalized by Velázquez in The Surrender of Breda. Hampered by his rivalry with Olivares, he left Flanders in 1628 and died at the siege of Casale in September 1630 during the Mantuan succession war.
zh: 安布罗焦·斯皮诺拉（1569—1630）是热那亚贵族，后成为哈布斯堡西班牙最杰出的统帅。1602年他投效西班牙，自费募集九千人，1604年攻克奥斯坦德，随后出任佛兰德军团司令，从拿骚的莫里斯手中夺取莱茵河畔一连串城镇。三十年战争初期，他率军征战普法尔茨。十二年停战协定结束后，他于1625年赢得生平最著名的布雷达大捷，后来委拉斯开兹据此绘成《布雷达的投降》。因与奥利瓦雷斯相争而处处受制，他于1628年离开佛兰德，1630年9月在曼图亚继承战争期间死于卡萨莱围城战。

en: Fernán Sánchez de Valladolid was the first royal chronicler of Castile, active at the court of Alfonso XI from about 1325 to 1348. On the king's commission he compiled an ordered history of the realm from materials assembled under Alfonso X and Sancho IV, and is credited with the chronicles of Alfonso X, Sancho IV and Fernando IV, and above all the Crónica de Alfonso Onceno. That work follows Alfonso XI from his troubled minority through his wars against Granada and the siege of Algeciras. It depicts the misdeeds of the nobles during the king's minority and presents Alfonso as a ruler who sought justice and fought steadfastly against the Moors. His chronicles became a principal source for the period.
zh: 费尔南·桑切斯·德·巴利亚多利德是卡斯蒂利亚第一位王室史官，约1325至1348年效力于阿方索十一世的宫廷。他奉国王之命，依据阿方索十世和桑乔四世时期整理的史料，编写了体系完整的王国史，被认为是《阿方索十世编年史》《桑乔四世编年史》《费尔南多四世编年史》，尤其是《阿方索十一世编年史》的作者。后者从阿方索十一世多舛的幼龄时期写起，一直记述到他对格拉纳达的战争和阿尔赫西拉斯围城战。书中描绘了国王年幼时贵族的恶行，并将阿方索写成一位伸张正义、顽强对抗摩尔人的君主。他的编年史成为研究这一时期的主要史料。

en: Juan Ruiz (c. 1283–c. 1350), known as the Archpriest of Hita, was a Castilian cleric and poet, born in Alcalá de Henares and probably educated in Toledo. As archpriest at Hita he wrote El Libro de buen amor, the Book of Good Love, a mixture of fables, parodies, love adventures and comic autobiography, which he completed around 1343. In his verse he says he was imprisoned on the order of Gil Álvarez de Albornoz, Archbishop of Toledo. He died around 1350, regarded as the greatest Castilian poet of his century.
zh: 胡安·鲁伊斯（约1283—约1350），人称伊塔大司铎，是卡斯蒂利亚教士与诗人，生于埃纳雷斯堡，可能曾在托莱多求学。他担任伊塔大司铎期间创作了《真爱之书》，长诗糅合寓言、戏仿、情场奇遇与诙谐自述，约于1343年完成。他在诗中称自己曾奉托莱多大主教希尔·阿尔瓦雷斯·德·阿尔沃诺斯之命入狱。他约于1350年去世，被视为14世纪最伟大的卡斯蒂利亚诗人。

en: Antonio de Nebrija (1444–1522) was the leading Spanish humanist of his age. Born at Lebrija in Andalusia and educated at Salamanca and Bologna, he held the first chair of grammar at Salamanca from 1476 and published the Latin textbook Introductiones latinae in 1481. In Italy he had encountered the ideas of humanists such as Lorenzo Valla. In 1492 he brought out the Gramática de la lengua castellana, the first printed grammar of any modern European language, telling Queen Isabella that language was the instrument of empire. His Spanish-Latin dictionary followed in 1495. Later, under Cardinal Cisneros, he worked on the Complutensian Polyglot Bible, and he died at Alcalá de Henares in 1522.
zh: 安东尼奥·德·内夫里哈（1444—1522）是他那个时代最重要的西班牙人文主义者。他生于安达卢西亚的莱夫里哈，在萨拉曼卡和博洛尼亚求学，1476年起任萨拉曼卡大学首任语法讲席教授，1481年出版广受欢迎的拉丁语教材《拉丁语入门》。他在意大利接触过洛伦佐·瓦拉等人文主义者的思想。1492年，他发表《卡斯蒂利亚语语法》，这是首部印刷出版的近代欧洲语言语法书；他在献给伊莎贝拉女王的献词中提出，语言是帝国的工具。1495年他又编成《西班牙语—拉丁语词典》。晚年他在西斯内罗斯枢机主持下参与《康普鲁顿合参本圣经》，1522年卒于阿尔卡拉·德·埃纳雷斯。

en: Francisco de Enzinas (1518–1552) was a Spanish humanist and Protestant reformer, the first to translate the New Testament from Greek into Spanish. The son of a Burgos wool merchant, he studied at Louvain and at Wittenberg under Melanchthon, in whose house he lived while working on the translation. He had his Spanish New Testament printed at Antwerp in 1543 and presented a copy to Emperor Charles V in Brussels. Weeks later the Inquisition arrested him and ordered almost the entire edition burned; he escaped in 1545 and fled back to Wittenberg. At Melanchthon's request he wrote an account of his experiences in the Netherlands. He later taught Greek in England and died at Strasbourg in 1552.
zh: 弗朗西斯科·德·恩西纳斯（1518—1552）是西班牙人文主义者、新教改革家，也是第一位将《新约》从希腊文译成西班牙文的人。他是布尔戈斯羊毛商人之子，先后在鲁汶和维滕贝格求学，师从梅兰希通；翻译期间，他住在梅兰希通家中。1543年其西班牙文《新约》在安特卫普印行，他还在布鲁塞尔把一册进呈皇帝查理五世。几周后宗教裁判所将他逮捕，下令几乎焚毁全部印本；他于1545年越狱逃回维滕贝格，应梅兰希通之请写下自己在尼德兰的经历。后来他到英格兰教授希腊文，1552年逝于斯特拉斯堡。

en: Baltasar de Zúñiga y Velasco (1561–1622) was a Spanish nobleman and diplomat from a powerful court family. After surviving the 1588 Armada, he served Philip III as ambassador in Brussels (1599–1603), Paris (1603–1608) and Vienna (1608–1617). Back in Madrid, he joined the Duke of Uceda in bringing down the Duke of Lerma in 1618 and took charge of foreign policy. In 1619 he persuaded the king to aid the Habsburg emperor in Bohemia, taking Spain into the Thirty Years War. The following year he helped send the Army of Flanders to the emperor's aid. In 1621 he secured the rise of his nephew Olivares as Philip IV's chief minister. He died in office in 1622.
zh: 巴尔塔萨尔·德·苏尼加-贝拉斯科（1561—1622）是出身显贵的西班牙贵族与外交家。他在1588年无敌舰队远征中生还，随后历任腓力三世派驻布鲁塞尔（1599—1603）、巴黎（1603—1608）和维也纳（1608—1617）的大使。返回马德里后，他于1618年与乌塞达公爵联手扳倒莱尔马公爵，执掌外交大权。1619年，他说服国王出兵波希米亚援助哈布斯堡皇帝，使西班牙卷入三十年战争。次年，他参与派遣佛兰德斯军队援助皇帝。1621年，他扶植外甥奥利瓦雷斯成为腓力四世的首席大臣。1622年，他在任内去世。

en: José Antonio de Gaztañeta e Iturribalzaga (c. 1656 – 5 February 1728) was a Basque naval officer and ship designer born at Mutriku, Gipuzkoa. He sailed with his father from the age of twelve and joined the navy in 1684 after eleven voyages to America. In 1691 he saved a fleet returning from Naples by avoiding a French ambush near Mahon. In the War of the Spanish Succession he founded the El Astillero shipyard and later directed the building of ships in the Basque Country. Commanding the fleet, he was defeated and captured by the British at Cape Passaro on 11 August 1718, but soon returned to service. Promoted lieutenant-general in 1720, he led the treasure fleet through the blockade of Porto Bello in 1727, and died in Madrid in 1728.
zh: 何塞·安东尼奥·德·加斯塔涅塔-伊图里瓦尔萨加（约1656—1728年2月5日）是巴斯克海军军官与舰船设计师，生于吉普斯夸的穆特里库。他12岁起随父亲出海，往返美洲11次之后，于1684年加入海军。1691年，他避开法国舰队在马翁附近设下的伏击，救下一支从那不勒斯返航的舰队。西班牙王位继承战争期间，他创立埃尔阿斯蒂列罗船厂，后来在巴斯克地区主持建造船只。1718年8月11日，他率舰队在帕萨罗角海战中被英军击败俘虏，但很快复职。1720年他晋升海军中将，1727年率珍宝舰队突破英军对贝洛港的封锁，1728年在马德里去世。

en: Jorge Juan y Santacilia (1713–1773) was a Spanish naval officer, mathematician and astronomer, nicknamed the Spanish savant. As a lieutenant he joined the French Geodesic Mission to the Equator of 1735–1744, travelling the Viceroyalty of Peru with Antonio de Ulloa; their measurements confirmed that the Earth flattens at the poles. They also helped organize the Peruvian coast's defence against a British squadron during the War of Jenkins' Ear. Back in Spain from 1746 he served the Marquess of Ensenada, studied English shipbuilding in London, and reformed Spanish naval construction and education. He ended his career as ambassador to Morocco in 1766–1767 and director of the Seminary of Nobles in Madrid, where he died in 1773.
zh: 豪尔赫·胡安-圣塔西利亚（1713—1773）是西班牙海军军官、数学家与天文学家，时人称他为“西班牙智者”。他年轻时以海军中尉身份参加1735至1744年的法国赤道大地测量使团，与安东尼奥·德·乌略亚走遍秘鲁总督辖区，测量结果证实地球两极略扁。詹金斯的耳朵战争期间，两人还协助组织秘鲁海岸防御英国舰队。1746年回国后他效力于恩塞纳达侯爵，曾赴伦敦刺探英国造船技术，随后主持改革西班牙的舰船建造与海军教育。他晚年于1766至1767年出任驻摩洛哥大使，又任马德里贵族神学院院长，1773年卒于马德里。

en: Claudio Coello (2 March 1642 – 20 April 1693) was a Spanish Baroque painter born in Madrid to Portuguese parents. Trained under Francisco Rizi, he studied Titian, Rubens and van Dyck in the royal collection and later worked in Rome. With José Jiménez Donoso he painted frescoes in Madrid and Toledo and a triumphal arch for Queen Maria Louisa of Orleans's entry. In 1683 the Archbishop of Saragossa employed him. Named court painter to Charles II, he spent seven years on his masterpiece, the altarpiece of the Adoration of the Miraculous Host in the sacristy of San Lorenzo de El Escorial, with over fifty court portraits. Regarded as the last great Spanish painter of the century, he died in Madrid in 1693.
zh: 克劳迪奥·科埃略（1642年3月2日—1693年4月20日）是西班牙巴洛克画家，生于马德里，父母为葡萄牙人。他师从弗朗西斯科·里西，曾在王室藏品中研习提香、鲁本斯和凡·戴克的作品，后在罗马学艺。他与何塞·希门尼斯·多诺索在马德里和托莱多合绘湿壁画，又为奥尔良的玛丽亚·路易莎王后入城绘制凯旋门。1683年，萨拉戈萨大主教雇用了他。他成为卡洛斯二世的宫廷画家，耗费七年完成代表作——埃斯科里亚尔修道院圣洛伦索圣器室的祭坛画《朝拜圣体》，画中有五十余幅宫廷人物肖像。他被视为17世纪最后一位西班牙大画家，1693年在马德里去世。

en: Gaspar de Guzmán, Count-Duke of Olivares (1587–1645), was born in Rome while his father served as Spain's ambassador there. From 1621 he was the chief minister and favourite of Philip IV, guiding Spain through the renewed Eighty Years' War and the Thirty Years' War. He made the Netherlands his first priority, combining military action with attacks on Dutch fleets and trade. Spanish troops took Breda in 1625 and won at Nördlingen in 1634, but his drive to centralize power and raise wartime taxes provoked the revolts of Catalonia and Portugal in 1640. He was dismissed in January 1643 and died in retirement two years later.
zh: 奥利瓦雷斯伯公爵加斯帕尔·德·古兹曼（1587—1645）生于罗马，当时其父正担任西班牙驻罗马大使。自1621年起，他成为费利佩四世的宠臣与首席大臣，主持西班牙重启八十年战争并参与三十年战争。他将尼德兰置于首位，把军事行动与打击荷兰舰队及贸易结合起来。西军1625年攻克布雷达，1634年赢得讷德林根战役；但他推行中央集权、增加战时赋税，激起1640年加泰罗尼亚与葡萄牙的反叛。1643年1月他被罢黜，两年后在退隐中去世。

en: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo (baptized 1 January 1618 – 3 April 1682) was a Spanish Baroque painter born in Seville, where he trained with his uncle Juan del Castillo. In 1645 he married Beatriz Cabrera y Villalobos and received his first major commission: eleven canvases for Seville's San Francisco convent, painted by 1648. These depicted stories of Franciscan saints, ranging from stark contrasts of light and dark to the softly luminous style of his mature work. He also painted genre works like The Young Beggar. In 1660 he co-founded Seville's Academy of Fine Arts with Francisco Herrera the Younger. He became famous for luminous religious paintings, above all the Immaculate Conception, and warm scenes of street children. He died in 1682 after a fall from a scaffold while working at Cádiz.
zh: 巴托洛梅·埃斯特万·牟利罗（1618年1月1日受洗—1682年4月3日）是西班牙巴洛克画家，生于塞维利亚，师从舅父胡安·德尔·卡斯蒂略。1645年，他与贝亚特丽斯·卡夫雷拉-比利亚洛沃斯成婚，并接到第一份重要订单：为塞维利亚的圣方济各修道院绘制11幅油画，至1648年完成。这些画描绘方济各会圣徒的故事，风格从强烈的明暗对比到他成熟时期柔和明亮的笔法不等。他还绘有《小乞丐》等风俗画。1660年，他与小弗朗西斯科·埃雷拉共同创立塞维利亚美术学院。他以明亮柔和的宗教画闻名，尤以圣母无染原罪题材著称，也长于描绘街头儿童的温情场景。他在加的斯作画时从脚手架坠落，于1682年去世。

en: Tomás de Mercado (c. 1525–1575) was a Spanish Dominican theologian and economist of the School of Salamanca. Born either in Seville or Mexico, he joined the Dominicans in New Spain as a young man and taught arts at their Mexico City priory. He returned to Spain to study at Salamanca University, where he then lectured in philosophy, moral theology and law. He later worked at the Exchange House of Seville, a centre of Spain's international money flows. His Summa de tratos y contratos of 1571, a manual of deals and contracts, made him with Martín de Azpilcueta a founder of Iberian monetarism. He died at sea returning to Mexico.
zh: 托马斯·德·梅尔卡多（约1525—1575）是西班牙多明我会神学家、经济学家，属萨拉曼卡学派。他生于塞维利亚或墨西哥，年轻时在新西班牙加入多明我会，曾在墨西哥城的修院讲授艺学。他回西班牙后在萨拉曼卡大学求学，继而在那里讲授哲学、伦理神学与法学。此后他在塞维利亚的西印度贸易署任职，那里是西班牙国际资金流动的中心。1571年他写成《交易与契约大全》，这部交易与契约手册使他与马丁·德·阿斯皮利奎塔并列为伊比利亚货币主义的奠基人。他在返回墨西哥的海上去世。

en: Leonardus Lessius (1554–1623), born Lenaert Leys in Brabant, was a Jesuit theologian, jurist and economist of the School of Salamanca. He ranked first among Leuven's philosophy students in 1572, entered the Jesuits that year and taught philosophy at Douai. He studied at the Roman College under Bellarmine and Suárez. From 1585 he taught theology at Leuven, defending Luis de Molina's doctrine of grace against the Baianists in 1587–1588 despite censorship. Illness ended his teaching in 1600. He then wrote De iustitia et iure, applying moral theology to banking and allowing interest when a lender bore risk or lost gain. Known as the oracle of the Low Countries, he died at Leuven in 1623.
zh: 莱昂纳德·莱修斯（1554—1623），原名莱纳特·莱斯，生于布拉班特，是耶稣会神学家、法学家与经济学家，萨拉曼卡学派的代表人物。他于1572年在鲁汶的哲学学生中名列第一，同年加入耶稣会，后在杜埃教授哲学。他入罗马学院，师从贝拉明与苏亚雷斯。1585年起他在鲁汶教授神学，1587至1588年不顾审查，为路易斯·德·莫林纳的恩宠学说辩护，对抗巴伊乌斯派。1600年他因病停止教学，此后撰写《论法律与正义》，把道德神学应用于银行业，主张放债人承担风险或丧失收益时可以收取利息。他号称“尼德兰的神谕”，1623年卒于鲁汶。

en: Alejandro Malaspina (1754–1810), born at Mulazzo in Tuscany, was a Spanish naval officer and explorer. Joining the Spanish fleet in 1774, he fought Barbary corsairs and sailed to the Philippines. He circumnavigated the world on a royal commission in 1786–1788. From 1789 to 1794 he led the Malaspina Expedition, surveying the American Pacific coast from Cape Horn to the Gulf of Alaska and crossing to Guam, the Philippines, New Zealand and Australia. In Spain his criticism of colonial rule and his plot against Manuel Godoy led to his arrest in 1795 and imprisonment at La Coruña. Freed and exiled to Italy in 1802, he died at Pontremoli in 1810.
zh: 亚历杭德罗·马拉斯皮纳（1754—1810）生于托斯卡纳的穆拉佐，是效力于西班牙的海军军官与探险家。1774年他加入西班牙舰队，曾与柏柏尔海盗作战，并航行至菲律宾。1786至1788年，他受王室委派完成环球航行。1789至1794年，他率领“马拉斯皮纳远征队”，测绘了从合恩角到阿拉斯加湾的美洲太平洋海岸，又横渡大洋抵达关岛、菲律宾、新西兰与澳大利亚。回到西班牙后，他因批评殖民统治并参与密谋推翻曼努埃尔·戈多伊，于1795年被捕，囚禁于拉科鲁尼亚。1802年他获释并被逐回意大利，1810年卒于蓬特雷莫利。

en: Bernardo de Gálvez (1746–1786) was a Spanish general and colonial administrator born in Málaga province. He fought the Apaches on the northern frontier of New Spain before returning to Europe. As governor of Spanish Louisiana he backed the American revolutionaries, and after Spain entered the war in 1779 he led the campaigns of 1779–1781 that drove the British from West Florida, crowned by his victory at Pensacola; Charles III added the motto Yo Solo, 'I alone', to his coat of arms. Florida returned to Spain at the 1783 Treaty of Paris. He governed Cuba and succeeded his father as viceroy of New Spain, where he faced famine after poor harvests. He died of typhus in 1786.
zh: 贝尔纳多·德·加尔韦斯（1746—1786），西班牙将领与殖民官员，生于马拉加省。他曾在新西班牙北部边疆与阿帕奇人作战，之后返回欧洲。担任西属路易斯安那总督期间，他支持北美独立一方；1779年西班牙参战后，他指挥1779至1781年的一系列战役，将英军逐出西佛罗里达，最著名的一役是攻克彭萨科拉，卡洛斯三世为此把“唯我一人”的铭文加在他的纹章上。1783年《巴黎条约》使佛罗里达重归西班牙。他治理过古巴，又继其父出任新西班牙总督，在任内应对歉收引发的饥荒。1786年他死于斑疹伤寒。

en: Cosme Damián de Churruca y Elorza (1761–1805) was a Basque Spanish Navy officer and hydrographer born at Mutriku in Gipuzkoa. He entered the naval academy at Cádiz in 1776 and graduated at Ferrol in 1778. He earned distinction at the 1781 siege of Gibraltar, and surveyed the Strait of Magellan in 1788–1789 before charting the Antilles on a royal cartographic expedition of 1792–1795. In 1805 he married María Dolores Ruiz de Apodaca, a few months before he commanded the ship San Juan Nepomuceno as a brigadier at Trafalgar on 21 October. Mortally wounded, he forbade his officers to surrender and died on deck still giving orders. He was posthumously promoted to admiral, and his cousin was made Count of Churruca.
zh: 科斯马斯·达米安·德·丘鲁卡–埃洛萨（1761—1805），生于吉普斯夸的穆特里库，是巴斯克出身的西班牙海军军官与水文地理学家。他1776年进入加的斯海军学院，1778年在费罗尔毕业。1781年他在直布罗陀围攻战中表现出色，1788至1789年参与测量麦哲伦海峡，又在1792至1795年的王家制图远航中绘制安的列斯群岛海图。1805年他与玛丽亚·多洛雷斯·鲁伊斯·德·阿波达卡结婚；数月后的10月21日，已升任海军准将的他在特拉法尔加海战中指挥“圣胡安·内波穆塞诺”号战舰。他身负致命伤后仍禁止部下投降，在甲板上继续发号施令，直至阵亡。他被追晋海军上将，其表亲受封丘鲁卡伯爵。

en: Fausto Elhuyar (1755–1833) was a Spanish chemist born at Logroño. After studying in Paris with his brother Juan José, he taught mineralogy at Vergara in the Royal Basque Society, and in 1783 the two brothers first isolated tungsten there. In 1786 he was appointed director of mines in New Spain. Before departing, he toured Europe to study a method of refining silver and married Joan Raab in Vienna in 1787. He settled in Mexico City, became the first director of the School of Mines founded in 1792, built the Palace of Mining (1813), and advised Alexander von Humboldt. After Mexico's independence he returned to Spain, became minister of mines in 1822 and died in Madrid in 1833.
zh: 福斯托·德卢亚尔（1755—1833）是西班牙化学家，生于洛格罗尼奥。他与兄长胡安·何塞同在巴黎求学，后在皇家巴斯克学会所在地贝尔加拉教授矿物学；1783年兄弟二人在那里首次分离出钨。1786年他被任命为新西班牙矿业总监。赴任前，他游历欧洲研究炼银方法，1787年在维也纳与约安·拉布结婚。他定居墨西哥城，担任1792年创办的矿业学院首任院长，主持建成矿业宫（1813年），还曾为亚历山大·冯·洪堡提供咨询。墨西哥独立后他返回西班牙，1822年任矿业大臣，1833年在马德里去世。

en: Juan José Elhuyar (1754–1796) was a Spanish chemist and mineralogist born at Logroño. He studied medicine, surgery and chemistry, as well as mathematics, physics and natural history, in Paris from 1773 to 1777 with his brother Fausto. In 1781 he was sent to Sweden, where he worked with Torbern Bergman at Uppsala and Carl Wilhelm Scheele at Köping. Back in Spain, the brothers first isolated tungsten at the Royal Basque Society's laboratory in Vergara in 1783. Posted to New Granada in 1784, he improved the silver mines of Mariquita and worked with José Celestino Mutis. He died at Bogotá in 1796.
zh: 胡安·何塞·德卢亚尔（1754—1796）是西班牙化学家、矿物学家，生于洛格罗尼奥。1773至1777年他与弟弟福斯托同在巴黎学习医学、外科、化学、数学、物理学和自然史。1781年他被派往瑞典，先后在乌普萨拉与托尔贝恩·贝里曼、在雪平与卡尔·威廉·舍勒共事。回到西班牙后，兄弟二人于1783年在贝尔加拉的皇家巴斯克学会实验室中首次分离出钨。1784年他被派往新格拉纳达，改进马里基塔银矿，并与何塞·塞莱斯蒂诺·穆蒂斯合作，1796年在波哥大去世。

en: Francisco Javier de Balmis (1753–1819) was a Spanish physician born at Alicante. He trained at the military hospital there, became a military surgeon and served in New Spain, where he was appointed surgeon-major of the Mexico City military hospital in 1786. He studied Mexican plants and published a treatise on agave and begonia in 1794. As physician to Charles IV he persuaded the crown to back a vaccination mission. In 1803 the Royal Philanthropic Expedition sailed carrying the smallpox vaccine to Spanish America, using orphan boys as live carriers; Balmis carried it through Venezuela, Cuba and New Spain and on to the Philippines and China, in history's first international vaccination campaign. He died in Madrid.
zh: 弗朗西斯科·哈维尔·德·巴尔米斯（1753—1819）是西班牙医生，生于阿利坎特。他在当地军医院受训，成为军医并前往新西班牙服役，1786年获任墨西哥城军医院首席外科医生。他研究墨西哥植物，1794年出版有关龙舌兰和秋海棠的著作。作为卡洛斯四世的御医，他说服王室支持疫苗接种远征。1803年，皇家慈善疫苗远征启航，把牛痘疫苗运往西属美洲，途中以孤儿作为活体携带者；巴尔米斯带着疫苗经委内瑞拉、古巴和新西班牙，又抵达菲律宾和中国，这是历史上第一次国际疫苗接种行动。他在马德里去世。

en: Pedro Rodríguez de Campomanes (1723–1802) was a Spanish statesman and economist born at Tineo in Asturias. After studying law at Oviedo and Seville, he won notice in Madrid with a 1747 work on the Knights Templar and became Minister of the Treasury in 1760. A chief reformist adviser to Charles III, he drove the expulsion of the Jesuits in 1767. His essays of 1774–1775 urged the revival of Spanish crafts; he denounced guild privileges and favoured attracting foreign artisans and employing women. In another work he examined royal limits on church landholding. He presided over the Council of Castile from 1788 until Charles IV dismissed him in 1793, and died in 1802.
zh: 佩德罗·罗德里格斯·德·坎波马内斯（1723—1802），生于阿斯图里亚斯的蒂内奥，是西班牙政治家与经济学家。他曾在奥维耶多和塞维利亚攻读法律，后到马德里执业，1747年因一部论述圣殿骑士团的著作受到瞩目，1760年出任财政大臣。作为卡洛斯三世身边首要的改革派谋臣，他主导了1767年将耶稣会士逐出西班牙帝国的行动。他在1774至1775年的论著中主张复兴西班牙手工业，抨击行会特权，支持吸引外国工匠和让女性工作；另一部著作则探讨王权对教会持有土地的限制。他自1788年主持卡斯蒂利亚议会，1793年被卡洛斯四世解职，1802年去世。

en: Giulio Alberoni (1664–1752) was an Italian-born cardinal and chief minister of Philip V of Spain. A gardener's son from near Piacenza, he served Marshal Vendôme in the War of the Spanish Succession and reached Spain in 1711. He arranged Philip's marriage to Elisabetta Farnese in 1714, headed the government by 1715 and became a cardinal in 1717. He abolished internal customs, promoted colonial trade and reorganized state finances. His occupation of Sardinia (1717) and invasion of Sicily (1718) drew the Quadruple Alliance into war; after the British destroyed his fleet off Cape Passaro, he was dismissed in 1719. Returning to Italy, he took part in the papal conclave of 1721. As papal legate at Ravenna, he tried to bring San Marino under papal rule in 1739, but was replaced the following year.
zh: 朱利奥·阿尔贝罗尼（1664—1752）是出生于意大利的枢机主教，也是西班牙国王腓力五世的首席大臣。他是皮亚琴察附近一名园丁之子，在西班牙王位继承战争中效力于法国元帅旺多姆公爵，1711年抵达西班牙。1714年他撮合腓力与埃丽莎贝塔·法尔内塞成婚，1715年主持政府，1717年成为枢机主教。他废除内地关税、鼓励殖民地贸易、整顿国家财政。1717年他出兵占领撒丁岛，1718年入侵西西里岛，招致四国同盟参战；英军在帕萨罗角歼灭其舰队后，他于1719年被解职。他回到意大利，参加了1721年的教皇选举。后来他担任拉文纳的教廷使节，1739年试图将圣马力诺纳入教廷统治，次年被撤换。

en: Gaspar Melchor de Jovellanos (1744–1811) was an Asturian statesman and writer, a leading figure of the Spanish Enlightenment. Born at Gijón, he became a criminal judge at Seville in 1767 and later served in Madrid. From 1790 to 1797 he lived in virtual exile at Gijón, where he founded an institution to promote reform in Asturias. His Report on the Agrarian Law (1795) attacked entailed and church estates and urged agricultural reform as the key to Spain's prosperity. He was minister of justice from 1797 to 1798 and was imprisoned in Bellver Castle in Mallorca in 1801. Freed after the French invasion of 1808, he refused to serve Joseph Bonaparte, joined the Supreme Central Junta and died of pneumonia in Asturias in 1811.
zh: 加斯帕尔·梅尔乔·德·霍韦利亚诺斯（1744—1811）是阿斯图里亚斯出身的政治家与作家，西班牙启蒙运动的代表人物。他生于希洪，1767年在塞维利亚任刑事法官，后赴马德里任职。1790至1797年，他在希洪过着近乎流放的生活，创办机构推动阿斯图里亚斯的改革。他的《农业法报告》（1795年）抨击限嗣继承地产和教会地产，主张农业改革是西班牙富强的关键。他于1797—1798年担任司法大臣，1801年被囚于马略卡岛的贝利韦尔城堡。1808年法国入侵后获释，他拒绝为约瑟夫·波拿巴效力，加入最高中央洪达，1811年在阿斯图里亚斯死于肺炎。

en: Alonso de Santa Cruz (1505–1567) was a Seville-born cartographer, cosmographer and historian. He served at the Casa de Contratación and the Council of the Indies, where he maintained the Padrón Real, the crown's secret master chart of New World discoveries. In 1530 he produced the first map of magnetic variation from true north and designed new nautical instruments. He believed magnetic variation could help determine longitude and wrote about a method using the sun's declination. At Philip II's request he compiled in 1542 the Islario general, a survey of the world's islands, and he taught cosmography at the court of Charles V, whose five-volume biography he also wrote.
zh: 阿隆索·德·圣克鲁斯（约1505—1567）是生于塞维利亚的制图师、宇宙志学者和历史学家。他在通商署与西印度事务院供职，负责修订《皇家总图》——王室记载新大陆发现的机密母图。1530年，他绘制了第一幅相对真北的磁偏角变化图，并设计了新式航海仪器。他认为磁偏角有助于确定经度，也写过利用太阳赤纬测定经度的方法。应腓力二世之请，他于1542年编纂综述世界岛屿的《岛屿总志》；他还在查理五世的宫廷讲授宇宙志，并撰写了五卷本的查理五世传记。

en: Álvaro de Bazán, first Marquis of Santa Cruz (1526–1588), was Spain's foremost sixteenth-century admiral. Born at Granada, he fought the Ottomans in the Mediterranean, helped relieve Malta in 1565 and took command of the Naples galleys in 1568. At Lepanto in 1571 he led the Christian reserve and restored the line against Uluç Ali, and he helped conquer Tunis in 1573. Made a marquis in 1569, he crushed the French-backed fleet at Ponta Delgada in 1582, securing the Azores for Philip II, and in 1583 first proposed the invasion of England by sea. Appointed to command the Spanish Armada, he died at Lisbon in February 1588 before it sailed, unbeaten in battle.
zh: 阿尔瓦罗·德·巴桑，第一代圣克鲁斯侯爵（1526—1588），是16世纪西班牙最杰出的海军将领。他生于格拉纳达，长年在地中海与奥斯曼人作战，1565年参与解救被围困的马耳他，1568年统领那不勒斯桨帆船队。1571年勒班陀海战中他统率基督徒联军预备队，在乌卢奇·阿里突破战线时稳住阵脚，1573年又参与征服突尼斯。1569年他受封侯爵，1582年在蓬塔德尔加达海战中击溃有法国支持的舰队，为腓力二世保住亚速尔，1583年他最早提出渡海入侵英格兰。他被任命为西班牙无敌舰队司令，但1588年2月舰队启航前便在里斯本去世，平生未尝一败。

en: Andrés de Urdaneta (1508–1568) was a Basque explorer who became an Augustinian friar. Aged seventeen he joined the Loaísa expedition to the Spice Islands and spent over eight years in Asia before settling in New Spain around 1540 and taking the Augustinian habit in 1552. At Philip II's request he sailed with Legazpi to the Philippines in 1564, and in 1565 he mapped the eastward return route across the Pacific from the Philippines to Acapulco. The tornaviaje became the path of the Manila galleons for more than two centuries. In 1566 he reported on the voyage to the Casa de Contratación in Seville and to Philip II in Madrid. He died in Mexico City in 1568.
zh: 安德烈斯·德·乌达内塔（1508—1568）是巴斯克航海探险家，后来成为奥古斯丁会修士。十七岁时他加入前往香料群岛的洛艾萨探险队，在亚洲逗留八年有余，约1540年定居新西班牙，1552年加入奥古斯丁会。应腓力二世之请，他于1564年随黎牙实比远征菲律宾，1565年测定了从菲律宾横渡太平洋东至阿卡普尔科的返航航线。这条“回程航路”在此后两个多世纪里一直是马尼拉大帆船的贸易航线。1566年，他在塞维利亚向通商署、在马德里向腓力二世报告航程。他于1568年在墨西哥城去世。

en: José Moñino, Count of Floridablanca (1728–1808), was the reforming chief minister of Charles III of Spain. A Murcian lawyer, he became a criminal prosecutor in Castile in 1766 and investigated the Esquilache Riots that year. He backed the expulsion of the Jesuits in 1767; as envoy to Pope Clement XIV he secured the Jesuits' suppression and gained his countship in 1773. Chief minister from 1777, he freed colonial trade and founded the Bank of San Carlos in 1782. Spain recovered Menorca and Florida from Britain in 1782. His centralist policies brought him into conflict with the Aragonese faction at court. Ousted in 1792 and imprisoned until 1795, he died in 1808 heading the Supreme Central Junta against Napoleon.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/第一代弗洛里达夫兰卡伯爵何塞·莫尼诺
zh: 何塞·莫尼诺，弗洛里达夫兰卡伯爵（1728—1808），是西班牙国王卡洛斯三世的改革派首席大臣。这位穆尔西亚出身的法学家1766年出任卡斯蒂利亚刑事检察官，同年调查了埃斯基拉切骚乱。他支持1767年驱逐耶稣会；他出使教皇克雷芒十四世，促成教廷批准取缔耶稣会，1773年受封伯爵。1777年起担任首席大臣，他放开殖民地贸易，1782年创办圣卡洛斯银行。在他任内，西班牙于1782年从英国手中收回梅诺卡岛和佛罗里达。他的中央集权政策使他与宫廷中的阿拉贡派发生冲突。他1792年下台，被囚禁至1795年，1808年在主持抗击拿破仑的最高中央洪达期间去世。

en: Pedro Calderón de la Barca (1600–1681) was the last great dramatist of Spain's Golden Age. Born in Madrid, his first play was staged at the Royal Alcázar in 1623 during the Prince of Wales's visit to negotiate a dynastic marriage. He served in the royal army in Italy and Flanders from 1625 to 1635. After Lope de Vega died in 1635 he became Spain's foremost playwright, favoured by Philip IV with commissions for the Buen Retiro palace; his masterpiece La vida es sueño (Life Is a Dream) explores free will against foretold destiny. Ordained in 1651, he wrote chiefly Corpus Christi autos sacramentales and palace plays, dying in 1681.
zh: 佩德罗·卡尔德隆·德·拉·巴尔卡（1600—1681）是西班牙黄金时代最后一位伟大剧作家。他生于马德里，1623年首部剧作在马德里王家城堡上演，当时威尔士亲王正访西商议王室联姻。1625至1635年他在王家军队服役，转战意大利与佛兰德。1635年洛佩·德·维加去世后，他成为西班牙首屈一指的剧作家，深受腓力四世器重，受命为布恩雷蒂罗宫创作戏剧；代表作《人生如梦》探讨人在被注定的命运面前是否仍有自由意志。1651年他受任神父，此后主要为基督圣体节撰写圣事剧和宫廷剧，1681年在马德里去世。

en: Félix Lope de Vega (1562–1635), born in Madrid, was the most prolific playwright of Spain's Golden Age. In 1583 he fought at Ponta Delgada in the Azores under Álvaro de Bazán, Marquis of Santa Cruz. Exiled from Castile for libel, he married Isabel de Urbina in May 1588 and sailed with the Armada weeks later, surviving the failed expedition. In Valencia and later Madrid he forged the comedia nueva that made theatre mass entertainment; with Tirso de Molina and Calderón he defined Spanish Baroque drama. His output includes hundreds of plays, some three thousand sonnets and several novels. Ordained a priest in 1614, he served the Duke of Sessa from 1607 until his death in Madrid.
zh: 费利克斯·洛佩·德·维加（1562—1635）生于马德里，是西班牙黄金时代最高产的剧作家。1583年，他在圣克鲁斯侯爵阿尔瓦罗·德·巴桑麾下参加亚速尔群岛的蓬塔德尔加达海战。他因诽谤罪被判逐出卡斯蒂利亚，1588年5月与伊莎贝尔·德·乌尔维纳成婚，几周后便随无敌舰队出征，在这场失败的远征中生还。他在巴伦西亚和后来的马德里创立“新喜剧”范式，使戏剧成为大众娱乐，并与蒂尔索·德·莫利纳、卡尔德隆一同奠定了西班牙巴洛克戏剧。他的作品包括数百部剧本、约三千首十四行诗和多部长篇小说。他于1614年晋铎为神父，1607年起为塞萨公爵效力，直至在马德里去世。

en: Luis de Góngora y Argote (1561–1627) was a Spanish Baroque poet born in Córdoba, where he served as a canon of the cathedral. He took deacon's orders in 1586 and travelled on cathedral business through Navarre, Andalusia and Castile. Ordained priest around 1605, he later lived in Valladolid and Madrid, and in 1617 became honorary chaplain to Philip III through the Duke of Lerma. His elaborate, Latinate style, known as culteranismo or Gongorismo, reached its peak in the Fable of Polyphemus and Galatea (1612) and the Soledades. He feuded for decades with Francisco de Quevedo, champion of the rival conceptismo; both wrote bitter satires against each other. Illness forced him back to Córdoba in 1626, and he died there in 1627.
zh: 路易斯·德·贡戈拉-阿尔戈特（1561—1627）是西班牙巴洛克诗人，生于科尔多瓦，曾任当地大教堂法政牧师。他于1586年受执事圣职，奉大教堂之命前往纳瓦拉、安达卢西亚和卡斯蒂利亚各地。他约1605年晋铎，之后在巴利亚多利德和马德里生活，1617年经莱尔马公爵安排成为腓力三世的荣誉圣堂牧师。他繁复典雅、多用拉丁化句法的文风被称为“夸饰主义”，又称贡戈拉主义，代表作是《波吕斐摩斯与加拉特亚的寓言》（1612）和《孤独》。他与对立风格“概念主义”的代表弗朗西斯科·德·克维多终生论战，双方都写下尖刻的讽刺诗攻击对方。1626年他因病返回科尔多瓦，次年在当地去世。

en: Juan de Mariana (1536–1624) was a Spanish Jesuit theologian and historian of the School of Salamanca. Born at Talavera de la Reina, he studied at Alcalá de Henares and joined the Society of Jesus at seventeen. From 1561 he taught theology in Rome, where Robert Bellarmine was among his pupils. He travelled to Sicily and lectured on Thomas Aquinas in Paris from 1569. In poor health, he retired to Toledo in 1574 and spent the next fifty years in vigorous literary work. His treatise De rege et regis institutione (1599) argued that a people may depose, and even kill, a tyrant, numbering him among the Catholic Monarchomachs.
zh: 胡安·德·马里亚纳（1536—1624）是萨拉曼卡学派的西班牙耶稣会神学家与历史学家。他生于塔拉韦拉·德拉雷纳，曾在埃纳雷斯堡的阿尔卡拉求学，十七岁加入耶稣会。1561年起他在罗马教授神学，罗伯·贝拉明曾是他的学生。他去过西西里，1569年起在巴黎讲授托马斯·阿奎那。后因健康不佳，他于1574年退居托莱多，在此潜心著述达半个世纪。他在1599年的论著《论国王与国王的教育》中主张人民可以废黜乃至诛杀暴君，因而被视为天主教“反君主派”的一员。

en: Qiu Ying (c. 1494–1552), courtesy name Shifu, was a Ming gongbi painter and one of the Four Masters of Ming. Born to a peasant family in Taicang, he moved to Suzhou and worked as a lacquer painter until Zhou Chen trained him. Employed by wealthy Jiangnan collectors such as Xiang Yuanbian, he also worked in the homes of Chen Guan in Suzhou and Zhou Fenglai in Kunshan. Their collections gave him access to Song and Yuan paintings, broadening his art. He copied old masters so faithfully that his versions could pass for originals, while forging his own style of fine-line figures and blue-and-green landscapes. Though a professional outsider to Suzhou's amateur Wu school, he was ranked alongside Shen Zhou, Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.
zh: 仇英（约1494—1552），字实父，号十洲，原籍江苏太仓，后移居苏州，明代工笔画家，明四家之一。他出身农家，早年做过漆工和彩画工匠，后得画家周臣赏识，传授画艺。他长期受聘于项元汴等江南富藏家，也曾在苏州陈官、昆山周凤来家中作画，得以接触他们收藏的宋元画作，拓展画艺。他临摹古画几可乱真，同时形成了自己精细人物与青绿山水的画风。他虽是以卖画为生的职业画家，游离于苏州文人吴门画派之外，却仍与沈周、文徵明、唐寅并称。

en: Yun Shouping (1633–1690), hao Nantian, was an early-Qing painter, calligrapher and poet born at Wujin, Changzhou, son of loyalist Yun Richu. In the Ming-Qing war he served with his father in the anti-Qing resistance, was separated and adopted into a Qing official's household, and met his father again at Hangzhou's Lingyin Temple. His family could not afford to send him to the civil service examinations, and he devoted himself to art. He first painted landscape but, outshone by Wang Hui, turned to bird-and-flower painting, reviving the boneless mogu manner and founding the Changzhou school. His calligraphy followed Chu Suiliang. He ranks with the Four Wangs and Wu Li among the Six Masters of the early Qing, and died poor in 1690.
zh: 恽寿平（1633—1690），号南田，清初画家、书法家、诗人，常州府武进县人，明遗民恽日初之子。明清易代之际，他随父参加抗清，兵败失散，被清朝官员家中收养，后在杭州灵隐寺与父亲重逢。家中无力供他参加科举，他便投身艺术。他早年画山水，因自以为不及好友王翚而改画花鸟，重振“没骨”画法，成为常州画派的创始人。他的书法取法褚遂良。他与四王、吴历并称“清初六家”，晚年贫困，1690年去世。

en: Wu Li (c. 1632–1718), courtesy name Yushan, was a Chinese landscape painter, poet and Jesuit priest. Born at Changshu in Jiangsu, he studied painting under Wang Shimin and Wang Jian from 1646, after Huang Gongwang and Wang Meng, and is counted among the Six Masters of the early Qing. Through the Jesuit Couplet he converted, joined the Society of Jesus at Macau in 1682, and in 1688 was ordained at Nanjing by Bishop Luo Wenzao among the first Chinese Jesuit priests, named Simon-Xavier a Cunha. For thirty years he itinerated as a missionary near Shanghai and Jiading, dying in 1718.
zh: 吴历（约1632—1718），字渔山，江苏常熟人，清代山水画家、诗人，后为天主教耶稣会神父。1646年起随王时敏、王鉴学画，取法黄公望、王蒙，为“清初六家”之一。他经耶稣会士柏应理引领入教，1682年在澳门加入耶稣会，1688年在南京由罗文炤主教祝圣为司铎，是最早的中国籍耶稣会神父之一，圣名西满·沙勿略·雅古讷。此后约三十年间，他在上海、嘉定一带乡间奔走传教，1718年去世。

en: Wang Shimin (1592–1680) was a landscape painter of the late Ming and early Qing, born at Taicang, grandson of grand secretary Wang Xijue. His father was an editor at the Hanlin Academy, and Wang learned painting and calligraphy as a child. As a youth he studied under Dong Qichang and copied the Song and Yuan masters in his family's collection, above all Huang Gongwang. He served by hereditary privilege as vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, but retired through illness in 1632 and refused Qing office after 1644. He headed the Four Wangs, founded the influential Loudong landscape school, taught Wang Hui and Wu Li, and was the grandfather and teacher of Wang Yuanqi.
zh: 王时敏（1592—1680），明末清初山水画家，太仓州人，万历朝首辅王锡爵之孙。他的父亲任翰林院编修，他自幼学习书画。少年时他师从董其昌，临摹家藏宋元名迹，尤其宗法黄公望。他以荫官出仕，官至太常寺少卿，1632年称病辞官归隐；1644年明亡后不仕清朝，潜心绘事。他位居“四王”之首，开创了影响深远的山水画娄东派，王翚、吴历皆出其门下，王原祁是他的孙子，也亲受其指授。

en: Wang Jian (c. 1598 or 1609–1677), courtesy name Xuanzhao, was a landscape painter of the late Ming and early Qing, born at Taicang and a great-grandson of the writer Wang Shizhen. In 1638 he took a secretarial post by hereditary privilege, and in 1641 became prefect of Lianzhou in Guangdong, earning the nickname Wang Lianzhou. Dismissed in 1643, he retired to his Yanyuan garden at Taicang and painted landscapes in a meticulous, coloured manner inspired by the Five Dynasties master Dong Yuan. He is counted among the Four Wangs of early Qing painting.
zh: 王鉴（约1598/1609—1677），字玄照，明末清初山水画家，苏州府太仓州人，文学家王世贞的曾孙。1638年他以曾祖余荫任左府都事，1641年出为广东廉州知府，人称“王廉州”。1643年罢官归里，隐居太仓弇园，潜心作画。他的山水画笔法工细、设色浓润，取法五代画家董源，与王时敏、王翚、王原祁并称“四王”。

en: Wang Yuanqi (1642–1715), hao Lutai, was a Qing-dynasty court painter and official, born at Taicang and taught by his grandfather Wang Shimin. After the jinshi degree in 1670 he rose from magistrate to vice minister of revenue. He became curator of the Kangxi Emperor's collection. In 1704 he joined the South Study, painting for the emperor, and in 1705 compiled the hundred-chapter Peiwenzhai Catalogue of Painting and Calligraphy, and directed the 1711 Wanshou Ceremonial scrolls. His dense abstract landscapes, modelled on Yuan master Huang Gongwang, made him the Orthodox school's later leader and one of the Four Wangs. His works included a 1711 landscape in Huang's style. He died in office in 1715.
zh: 王原祁（1642—1715），号麓台，江苏太仓州人，清代宫廷画家与官员，祖父王时敏亲自教他作画。1670年中进士后，他由知县官至户部左侍郎，后掌管康熙帝的御藏。1704年入值南书房，为皇帝作画，1705年主持编纂百卷本《佩文斋书画谱》，又主持1711年的《万寿盛典图》。他构图繁密、画风抽象的山水取法元代大家黄公望，是正统派后期领袖，与王时敏、王鉴、王翚并称“四王”。他的作品包括1711年所作的仿黄公望山水。1715年卒于任上。

en: Wang Hui (1632–1717), courtesy name Shigu, was a leading early-Qing landscape painter born at Changshu into a family of painters. After studying with Zhang Ke and copying Yuan master Huang Gongwang, Wang Jian discovered him at twenty-one and took him as pupil; he later studied under Wang Shimin, copying his old-master collection. Blending the northern and southern manners, he was hailed by Wu Weiye as a sage of painting. In 1691 he was summoned to Beijing to direct the Southern Tour scrolls for the Kangxi Emperor. He founded the Yushan school, was one of the Four Wangs, and died in 1717.
zh: 王翚（1632—1717），字石谷，苏州府常熟人，清初山水画大家，出身绘画世家。他先师从张珂，专摹元代黄公望；21岁时王鉴见到他的扇面小景，将他收为弟子，后他又师从王时敏，临摹其家藏古代名迹。他融合南北二宗的画法，被吴伟业誉为“画圣”。1691年他奉召进京，主持绘制《康熙南巡图》。他是虞山派的创始人，与王时敏、王鉴、王原祁并称“四王”，1717年去世。

en: Fan Meng (died 1339), also recorded as Fan Mengduan, was a native of Bianliang, now Kaifeng in Henan, and a low-ranking clerk in the Bureau of Military Affairs in Henan during the Yuan dynasty. In the eleventh month of 1339 he conspired with Huo Bashi and others to forge an edict bearing the imperial seal. Claiming appointment as a secretary of the Henan provincial administration, he arrested the province's chief officials and put the pingzhang Yuelu Tiemuer, left administrator Jielie and surveillance commissioner Wanzhe Buhua to death, briefly controlling the Henan administration. The Yuan court sent officials to deal with the affair. Fan was soon seized, sent to Dadu, and executed by dismemberment for treason.
zh: 范孟（？—1339），一作范孟端，元朝河南江北行省汴梁路（今河南开封）人，原是河南行枢密院的低级掾史。至元五年（1339年）十一月，他与霍八失等同伙伪造盖有御宝的圣旨，自称奉帝命出任河南行省都事，借机拘捕行省主要官员，将平章政事月鲁帖木儿、左丞劫烈、廉访使完者不花等一并处死，一度控制河南行省衙署。元廷派官处置，事变很快失败，范孟被捕后押往大都，以谋逆罪名凌迟处死。

en: Tang Xianzu (1550–1616), courtesy name Yireng, was a Ming playwright born in Linchuan, Jiangxi. After passing the provincial exam in 1570, he twice failed the metropolitan test for refusing to help grand secretary Zhang Juzheng's sons, and became a jinshi only in 1583. His memorials exposed corruption, including the misuse of relief funds; a 1591 attack on court officials had him demoted to Guangdong, where he oversaw prisoners in Xuwen. He later governed Suichang County in Zhejiang, but frustrated by official constraints, retired to Linchuan in 1598. His plays, known as the Four Dreams, include The Peony Pavilion, in which the love of Du Liniang and Liu Mengmei conquers death. He founded the Linchuan school.
zh: 汤显祖（1550—1616），字义仍，号若士，江西临川人，明代戏曲家。他1570年中举后，因不肯替首辅张居正的儿子们科举攀附，两次会试落第，直到1583年才中进士。他上疏揭露包括侵吞赈济款在内的弊政；1591年因抨击朝臣被贬广东，在徐闻负责狱务。此后他出任浙江遂昌知县，却因施政受掣肘而失望，于1598年辞官回到临川。他的传奇合称“临川四梦”，尤以《牡丹亭》最为著名，剧中杜丽娘与柳梦梅的爱情足以跨越生死；他还开创了戏曲史上的临川派。

en: George Macartney, 1st Earl Macartney (1737–1806), was a British diplomat born in Ireland to a Scottish family of Kirkcudbrightshire origins. He graduated from Trinity College Dublin in 1759 and went on to study law in London. As envoy to Russia in 1764 he negotiated an alliance with Catherine II, and in 1768 he became Chief Secretary for Ireland. He later governed Grenada and Madras, where he concluded the Treaty of Mangalore in 1784. Created an earl in 1792, he led Britain's first embassy to Qing China, reaching the Qianlong Emperor's court in 1793, but returned in 1794 without trade concessions. He later governed the Cape Colony and died in 1806.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/第一代馬戛爾尼伯爵喬治·馬戛爾尼
zh: 第一代马戛尔尼伯爵乔治·马戛尔尼（1737—1806）是英国外交官，出生于爱尔兰，家族先世出自苏格兰的柯库布里郡。他于1759年毕业于都柏林三一学院，随后在伦敦学习法律。1764年他出使俄国，与叶卡捷琳娜二世谈结盟约，1768年出任爱尔兰首席大臣。后任格林纳达和马德拉斯总督，1784年签订《门格洛尔条约》。1792年受封伯爵后，他率领英国第一个使团出使清朝，1793年觐见乾隆帝，却未取得通商让步，1794年返英。其后他出任开普殖民地总督，1806年去世。

en: Yang Shen (1488–1559), courtesy name Yongxiu and art name Sheng'an, was a Ming-dynasty poet and scholar from Xindu in Sichuan, born in the capital to grand secretary Yang Tinghe. In 1511 he took first place in the palace examination, becoming zhuangyuan, and joined the Hanlin Academy. He also helped compile the Veritable Records of Emperor Wuzong. In the Great Rites Controversy of 1524 he led officials weeping and protesting at the palace gate, seeking to change the emperor's choice of imperial father. He was twice flogged and exiled to the Yongchang garrison in Yunnan. There he spent more than thirty years and produced many works on Yunnan's nature and history, including the lyric The Immortals by the River.
zh: 杨慎（1488—1559），字用修，号升庵，四川新都人，明代诗人、学者，生于京师，是内阁首辅杨廷和之子。1511年，他殿试第一，高中状元，入翰林院任修撰，并参与修撰《武宗实录》。1524年大礼议中，他率众官在宫门伏阙哭谏，要求皇帝更改皇考，两遭廷杖，被贬往云南永昌卫戍边。他在云南度过三十余年，写下大量以当地山川风物与历史文化为题的作品，其中包括词《临江仙》。

en: Qin Liangyu (1574–1648) was a female general of the late Ming. Born in Zhongzhou, Sichuan, she studied the classics, archery and riding with her brothers. In 1595 she married Ma Qiancheng, chieftain of Shizhu, and brought 500 men to support him against the 1599 Bozhou rebellion. Her husband's death in prison in 1613 made her pacification commissioner; with her famed White Staff troops she fought the Later Jin and Zhang Xianzhong. Defeated by Zhang, she withdrew but kept her soldiers from surrendering. Her policy of agricultural self-sufficiency drew refugees to Shizhu, where she helped them settle. The Longwu Emperor of Southern Ming made her a marquis; she died at Shizhu in 1648, the only woman listed among Ming generals in official history.
zh: 秦良玉（1574—1648）是明末女将，出生于四川忠州，自幼与兄弟一同学习经史、骑射。1595年她嫁与石砫土司马千乘，1599年率五百人支援丈夫征讨播州叛乱。1613年丈夫瘐死狱中后，她继任石砫宣抚使，率麾下著名的“白杆兵”抗击后金和张献忠的军队。她被张献忠击败后退守，但阻止了士兵投降。她推行农业自给，吸引流民来到石砫，并帮助他们安家。南明隆武帝封她为侯爵。1648年她在石砫去世，是正史将领列传中唯一的女性。

en: Wang Zhenyi (1768–1797) was a Qing-dynasty astronomer, mathematician and poet from Jiangning, the modern Nanjing. Her grandfather taught her astronomy, while her father taught her mathematics, medicine and geography. After her grandfather died in 1782, she spent years in Jilin reading his library and learning riding and archery from a Mongol general's wife. She later travelled with her family and made friends with female scholars in Jiangning through her poetry. Largely self-taught in astronomy and mathematics, she also taught male students after marrying Zhan Mei at twenty-five. Her poetry argued that women were men's equals. Most of her writings were burned at her death; the survivors were compiled by Qian Yiji, who called her the greatest female scholar since Ban Zhao. She died aged twenty-nine.
zh: 王贞仪（1768—1797）是清朝江宁（今南京）的天文学家、数学家与诗人。祖父教她天文，父亲则教她数学、医学和地理。1782年祖父去世后，她在吉林数年，遍读祖父的藏书，并随一位蒙古将军夫人学习骑射。此后她随家人游历，又在江宁以诗结识女学者。她的天文、数学多靠自学，25岁嫁给詹枚后甚至教授男学生。她在诗中主张女子可与男子比肩。她临终前焚毁大部分著作，残存文稿由钱仪吉辑录，钱仪吉称她为班昭之后第一女学者。她于1797年去世，年仅29岁。

en: Song Lian (1310–1381) was a historian and official of the early Ming dynasty, born in Pujiang, Zhejiang. A leading Neo-Confucian scholar of the Jinhua school under the Yuan, he refused Yuan office before joining Zhu Yuanzhang, the future Hongwu Emperor, and tutoring the crown prince. In 1369 he headed the Bureau of History and directed the compilation of the History of Yuan, completed in 1370. Commissioned by the Ming court as the official history of the preceding dynasty, his work became a major source for the histories of Han, Tungusic, Mongol and Turkic peoples. He rose to chief minister of the Hanlin Academy, but after retiring in 1377 was implicated in the Hu Weiyong case through his grandson and died in exile at Kui Prefecture in 1381.
zh: 宋濂（1310—1381），字景濂，号潜溪，浙江金华浦江人，明初的政治家、文学家与史学家。他是元代金华学派的重要理学家，元末辞谢翰林院编修之召，后投奔朱元璋，为太子讲授经学。1369年他出任总裁官，主持修纂《元史》，于1370年成书。明廷命他编修的这部前朝正史，成为研究汉族、通古斯、蒙古和突厥诸族历史的重要资料。他后官至翰林学士承旨。1377年辞官归乡，却因长孙宋慎卷入胡惟庸案而受牵连，1381年死于流放途中的夔州。

en: Liu Jin (1451–1510), a native of Xingping in Shaanxi, was the most powerful eunuch of the Zhengde Emperor's Ming court. Originally surnamed Tan, he castrated himself and entered palace service as a boy, becoming the crown prince's favorite attendant. When Zhu Houzhao ascended the throne in 1505, Liu led the eight eunuchs known as the Eight Tigers, headed the Directorate of Ceremonial, purged opposing officials and ran his own secret-police bureau from 1508. His reforms to increase state revenue strengthened eunuchs at the expense of scholar-officials and provoked unrest and opposition across the empire. In 1510, after the Prince of Anhua rebelled against him, fellow Tiger Zhang Yong denounced him for treason, and he was seized and executed by slicing.
zh: 刘瑾（1451—1510），陕西兴平人，明武宗正德朝权势最盛的宦官。他本姓谈，少年时自宫入宫并改姓刘，成为东宫太子最宠信的近侍。1505年朱厚照即位后，他统领号称“八虎”的八名宦官，掌管司礼监，斥逐反对他的朝臣，并于1508年自设内行厂特务机构。他为增加国库收入而推行改革，扩大宦官权势，削弱士大夫，引发各地的动荡与反对。1510年安化王以讨伐他为名起兵，八虎之一的张永告发他谋反，刘瑾随即被捕下狱，定罪后凌迟处死。

en: Michał Boym (c. 1612–1659) was a Polish Jesuit born in Lwów. He reached Macau about 1645 and opened a mission on Hainan, until the Manchu conquest drove him to Tonkin in 1647. In 1650 the Southern Ming Yongli court sent him as envoy to Pope Innocent X. Placed under house arrest in Goa, he escaped and travelled through Persia, reaching Venice in 1652. Pope Alexander VII received him in 1655 but gave no aid. His Flora Sinensis (Vienna, 1656), the first European survey of Chinese plants and animals, together with his writings on Chinese medicine, carried China's natural history to Europe. He died exhausted on the Tonkin-Guangxi border in 1659.
zh: 卜弥格（约1612—1659）是生于利沃夫的波兰籍耶稣会士。约1645年他抵达澳门，在海南岛建立传教点，1647年满清攻取海南后避居东京（今越南北部）。1650年，南明永历朝廷派他出使罗马，向教宗英诺森十世求援。他在果阿遭软禁后逃脱，经波斯于1652年抵达威尼斯。教宗亚历山大七世于1655年接见他，却未给予实际援助。他的《中国植物志》（1656年刊于维也纳）是欧洲第一部系统介绍中国动植物的著作，连同他论述中医的文字，把中国的博物学传入欧洲。1659年，他在交趾与广西边境劳顿而死。

en: Cao Xueqin (c. 1715–1763/64) was a Qing novelist, born at Shangyuan near Nanjing into a bondservant family of the Plain White Banner, grandson of Jiangning textile commissioner Cao Yin. His grandfather had been a childhood companion of the Kangxi Emperor, and the family hosted the emperor on four of his southern tours. In 1727 the Yongzheng Emperor seized its estates and jailed Cao Fu, forcing the family to Beijing. Cao spent his later years poor in the western suburbs, selling paintings while labouring for a decade on Dream of the Red Chamber, a novel of a great family's rise and fall. He died in 1763 or 1764, leaving some eighty chapters, core of one of China's Four Great Classical Novels.
zh: 曹雪芹（约1715—1763/1764），清代小说家，生于南京附近的上元，出身正白旗包衣世家，祖父曹寅曾任江宁织造。曹寅幼时与康熙帝相伴，曹家曾四次接驾南巡的皇帝。1727年，雍正帝查抄曹家、将曹頫下狱，败落的全家被迫迁往北京。曹雪芹晚年穷居北京西郊，卖画度日，以十年心血创作《红楼梦》，写一个大族的由盛转衰。他于1763或1764年去世，留下约八十回书稿，成为中国四大古典名著之一的雏形。

en: Huang Gongwang (1269–1354), born Lu Jian at Changshu, was the oldest of the Four Masters of Yuan literati painting. Ten years old when the Song fell to the Mongols, he found his path to office severely restricted, as did many Chinese scholars. He served as a low-ranking Censorate clerk and was jailed after becoming involved in a case concerning the minister Zhang Lu. After his release he became a Quanzhen Taoist hermit in the Fuchun Mountains near Hangzhou. There, from 1347 to 1350, he painted his great handscroll Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains and wrote the painter's manual Secrets of Landscape Painting. Rejecting the landscape conventions of the academy of his day, he built up scenes with dry brushstrokes and light ink washes, creating influential models for later painters.
zh: 黄公望（1269—1354），本姓陆名坚，平江路常熟州（今江苏常熟）人，是元代画坛“元四家”中年辈最长者。宋亡时他年仅十岁，后来如许多汉人士人一样仕途受限。他在御史台任低级掾吏时，因受大臣张闾一案牵连入狱。获释后他出家为全真道士，晚年隐居杭州附近的富春山。1347至1350年，他在此绘成长卷《富春山居图》，并著有画论《写山水诀》。他反对当时院体山水的惯例，以干笔和淡墨层层构筑景致，为后世画家提供了影响深远的范本。

en: Wu Zhen (1280–1354), courtesy name Zhonggui and art name the Taoist of the Plum Blossom, was a Yuan-dynasty painter born at Weitang near Jiaxing in Zhejiang, one of the Four Masters of the Yuan. Educated in philosophy and swordsmanship, he chose the quiet life of an artist. His paintings initially sold poorly, and he supported himself at times by fortune-telling while painter friends taught him their craft. Among those friends were Wu Guan, Zhang Guan and Tao Zhongyi. He took the tenth-century monk Juran as his model and became a master of moist-ink landscape, painting in long hemp-fibre strokes, as well as ink bamboo and pines; his bold, saturated ink style influenced later Ming and Qing painters.
zh: 吴镇（1280—1354），字仲圭，号梅花道人，浙江嘉兴魏塘桥（今嘉善）人，元代画家，“元四家”之一。他虽治学兼习剑术，却选择清静的画家生活。早年他的画作销路不佳，一度靠替人算命为生，并在画友指点下学画，画友中有吴瓘、张观和陶宗仪。他师法五代画僧巨然，以长披麻皴作水墨山水，兼擅墨竹与松石；其笔力雄劲、墨气沉厚的画风，深刻影响了后来明清两代的画家。

en: Ni Zan (1301–1374), art name Yunlin, was a Yuan painter and poet born to a wealthy Wuxi family, one of the Four Yuan Masters. In the 1340s his region suffered droughts, floods and famine, while the Yuan government taxed wealthy landowners heavily. When late-Yuan rebellions spread, he gave away his estates and collection and for twenty years lived on a houseboat, wandering the lakes of the southeast and studying under Huang Gongwang. After 1345 he developed his sparse ink landscapes of bare trees, empty water and distant banks with no human figures, painting ink bamboo to express his spirit rather than seek likeness. He returned to Wuxi in 1371 and the next year painted the Rongxi Studio.
zh: 倪瓒（1301—1374），号云林，江浙行省无锡州（今江苏无锡）人，元代画家、诗人，“元四家”之一。他出身富庶之家，1340年代当地水旱灾害引发饥荒，元廷又向富有的地主征收重税。元末乱局蔓延时，他把田产与收藏分送友人，此后二十年间乘舟漂泊于东南湖泖之间，并曾向黄公望学画。1345年以后，他形成疏淡的水墨山水：枯树、空水、远岸，画面从不画人物；他画墨竹只为抒写胸中逸气，不求形似。1371年他回到无锡，次年绘成《容膝斋图》。

en: Wang Meng (c. 1308–1385) was a landscape painter of the late Yuan and early Ming and the youngest of the Four Masters of Yuan painting. Born in Wuxing, modern Huzhou in Zhejiang, he was a maternal grandson of the painter-calligrapher Zhao Mengfu. He once hoped his painting would win him advancement, but the painter Ni Zan urged him to value the pursuit of learning over office and wealth. Late in the Yuan he briefly held office before withdrawing for thirty years to Yellow Crane Mountain in Yuhang, styling himself its woodcutter. Amid the wars at the end of the Yuan, he joined Zhang Shicheng and, after Zhang's defeat, went over to Zhu Yuanzhang. Under the Ming he became prefect of Tai'an in Shandong, but in 1385 he was implicated in Chancellor Hu Weiyong's treason case after viewing paintings at Hu's house, and died in prison.
zh: 王蒙（约1308—1385），字叔明，号黄鹤山樵，浙江湖州人，是元末明初的山水画家，也是元四家四人中最年轻的一位。他是书画家赵孟頫的外孙，曾希望凭画艺获得举荐，画家倪瓒却劝他重视乐道而非仕禄财富。元末他曾短暂出仕，后弃官隐居余杭黄鹤山约三十年。元末战乱中，他先投奔张士诚，张败后归附朱元璋。明朝建立后出任山东泰安知州，1385年因曾在丞相胡惟庸府中观画，受胡惟庸谋反案牵连，死于狱中。

en: Shen Zhou (1427–1509), courtesy name Qinan, was a Ming painter born into a scholarly landowning family at Xiangcheng near Suzhou. His family's wealth grew under the Ming lijia tax system, leaving its men free to live as scholar-artists. After his father's death, he chose not to sit for the civil service examinations, devoting himself instead to his widowed mother and to a reclusive life of poetry, calligraphy and painting; commoners who came to his door requesting works were never turned away. His wealth let him paint without relying on a patron. He modeled his landscapes and boneless flower paintings on the Four Masters of Yuan and founded the Suzhou-based Wu school of literati painting, which set personal expression against the academic Zhe school. He is ranked first among the Four Masters of Ming.
zh: 沈周（1427—1509），字启南，号石田，长洲相城（今江苏苏州）人，明代画家。他出身书香富户，家族在明代里甲征税制度下积累财富，男子得以过文人艺术家的生活。父亲去世后，他选择不应科举，在家奉养寡母，过着吟诗作画的隐居生活；凡登门求画者，哪怕是贩夫牧童，他也从不拒绝。富足的家境使他作画不必依赖赞助人。他的山水画与没骨花卉取法元四家，在苏州创立了文人画的吴门画派，以抒写心性对抗浙派的院体画风，名列明四家之首。

en: Wen Zhengming (1470–1559), born Wen Bi, was a Suzhou painter, calligrapher and poet and one of the Four Masters of Ming painting. Distant kin of the Song loyalist Wen Tianxiang, he took the art name Hengshan and in 1489 became the pupil of Shen Zhou, founder of the Wu school. He failed the provincial examinations nine times before winning a Hanlin Academy post in 1523; he resigned in 1526 and spent the next thirty years leading the Wu school in Suzhou. The Humble Administrator's Garden inspired his poems and paintings, including albums of its views in 1535 and 1551. Famed for his regular and running script, he died in 1559 while writing an epitaph.
zh: 文徵明（1470—1559），原名文璧，后以字行，号衡山居士，南直隶苏州府长洲县（今江苏苏州）人，明代画家、书法家、诗人，明四家之一。他是南宋忠臣文天祥的远裔，1489年拜吴门画派创始人沈周为师。他九次参加乡试都未中举，直到1523年经举荐才入翰林院任待诏；因不惯朝中倾轧，1526年辞官归乡，此后三十年主持吴门画派。他以拙政园为题作诗作画，1535年和1551年分别绘成园景画册。他的楷书与行书名扬天下，1559年在为人书写墓志时掷笔端坐而逝。

en: Tang Yin (1470–1524), courtesy name Bohu, was a Suzhou painter and poet, one of the Four Masters of Ming painting. Born into a tavern-keeper's family in Wuxian, he entered Suzhou's scholarly circles, befriending Wen Zhengming and gaining the patronage of Wen's father, Wen Lin. He took first place in the 1498 Nanjing provincial examinations, but in 1499 an examination-leak scandal in Beijing with Xu Jing ended his official career; he refused a clerical post in Zhejiang and returned to Suzhou. There he built his Peach Blossom Hermitage and earned a living painting landscapes and figures. In 1514 he briefly served the Prince of Ning at Nanchang, feigning madness to escape after discovering the prince's treason.
zh: 唐寅（1470—1524），字伯虎，又字子畏，号六如居士，南直隶苏州府吴县人，明代画家、诗人，明四家之一。他出身开酒馆的商贩之家，进入苏州文人圈，与文徵明结为好友，并得到文徵明父亲文林的提携。1498年他在应天（南京）乡试高中第一名解元，1499年却因与徐经卷入北京会试泄题案而下狱，仕途尽毁；他拒绝被派任的浙江小吏之职，回到苏州筑桃花庵，以卖山水人物画为生。1514年他曾短暂入南昌宁王朱宸濠幕府，察觉宁王谋反后，靠装疯才脱身归乡。

en: Lê Lợi (1385–1433) was the Vietnamese leader who drove out the Ming occupation and founded the Later Lê dynasty. Born into a landed family at Lam Sơn in Thanh Hóa, he was imprisoned under the Ming after their 1407 conquest. Held from 1413 to 1415, he worked for a Ming local administrator after his release. In 1418 he raised revolt as Prince of Pacification, wearing down Ming armies by guerrilla ambush. His early supporters included powerful families from his native Thanh Hóa. In 1427 his forces destroyed Liu Sheng's army at Chi Lăng and took Xương Giang, forcing the Ming to withdraw. Enthroned in 1428 and recognized by the Ming in 1431, he died in 1433 as Lê Thái Tổ.
zh: 黎利（1385—1433）是驱逐明朝在越统治、建立后黎朝的越南民族领袖。他出身清化蓝山的豪强之家，1407年明朝征服安南后曾被明军囚禁。他于1413至1415年被囚，获释后为明朝地方官效力。1418年，他起兵自称平定王，以游击伏击消耗明军。他早期的支持者包括家乡清化的几个大族。1427年，他的军队在支棱击败柳升所部，攻取昌江，迫使明朝撤军。1428年他登基称帝，1431年获明朝承认，1433年去世，庙号太祖。

en: Giovanni de' Marignolli (fl. 1338–1353) was a Florentine Franciscan and papal legate to the Mongol Yuan court of China. In 1338 Pope Benedict XII sent him after Christian Alan envoys of the Yuan emperor Toghon Temür reached Avignon, asking for a successor to Archbishop John of Montecorvino. Via Sarai and Almaliq he reached Khanbaliq in 1342 and was received by Toghon Temür. At Almaliq the mission had built a church and baptized converts, despite the killing of a bishop and six friars there the previous year. After three or four years he sailed home from Quanzhou by India and Persia, reaching Avignon in 1353 with the khan's letter. He later became bishop of Bisignano and chronicler to Emperor Charles IV in Prague.
zh: 马黎诺里（活跃于1338—1353年）是佛罗伦萨方济各会修士、出使中国元朝的教皇使节。1338年，元朝皇帝妥懽帖睦尔麾下信奉基督教的阿速人使臣抵达阿维尼翁，请求为已故大主教孟高维诺派任继任者，教皇本笃十二世遂派他东行。他经萨莱、阿力麻里，于1342年抵达汗八里，受到妥懽帖睦尔接见。使团曾在阿力麻里建造教堂、为信众施洗，尽管前一年一位主教和六名修士在那里遇害。居留三四年后，他由泉州启航，经印度、波斯，于1353年带着大汗的国书回到阿维尼翁。后来他出任比西尼亚诺主教，并在布拉格为皇帝查理四世编写编年史。

en: Ivan Nelipić (died 1344) was a Croatian nobleman and Duke of Knin from the Nelipić family. A voivode of Mladen II Šubić, he turned against his lord and helped overthrow him at the Battle of Bliska in 1322. Expelling the garrison from Knin, he made the city his seat and between 1322 and 1344 was the most powerful magnate in Croatia. He held Drniš and lands around the rivers Cetina, Čikola, Krka and Zrmanja. He repelled King Charles I Robert's expeditions and captured Juraj II Šubić near Knin in 1324. He defied Hungarian attempts to subdue him until his death in 1344; royal authority was re-established in Croatia the following year.
zh: 伊万·内利皮奇（？—1344）是克罗地亚贵族、克宁公爵，出身内利皮奇家族。他本是姆拉登二世·舒比奇麾下的督军，后来倒戈，在1322年的布利兹卡战役中促成姆拉登垮台。他把驻军逐出克宁，据该城为据点，1322至1344年间成为克罗地亚最有权势的大贵族。他控制德尔尼什以及采蒂纳河、奇科拉河、克尔卡河和兹尔马尼亚河流域的土地。他击退匈牙利国王查理·罗伯特派出的远征军，并于1324年在克宁附近俘获尤拉伊二世·舒比奇。他抵挡住匈牙利的征讨，直到1344年去世；次年克罗地亚重新归于王权之下。

en: Francisco de Pina (1585–1625) was a Portuguese Jesuit missionary and interpreter, born at Guarda, who pioneered the romanization of Vietnamese. He entered the Jesuits in 1605 and studied at St Paul's College in Macau from 1611 to 1617. There he encountered the works of João Rodrigues, who had used Portuguese phonetics to transcribe Japanese. In 1617 Pina arrived in Đàng Trong, or European Cochinchina, to work the missions at Hội An and Qui Nhơn alongside Francesco Buzomi. Drawing on Portuguese phonetic methods, he devised the first Latin transcription of Vietnamese, the basis of the modern chữ Quốc ngữ alphabet. He drowned on 15 December 1625 at Cửa Đại, rescuing guests from a wrecked boat.
zh: 弗朗西斯科·德·皮纳（1585—1625）是葡萄牙耶稣会传教士、翻译家，生于瓜达，越南语拉丁化拼音的开创者。他于1605年加入耶稣会，1611至1617年在澳门圣保禄学院学习，在那里接触了若昂·罗德里格斯的著作；罗德里格斯曾用葡萄牙语的表音方法转写日语。1617年他抵达欧洲人所称的交趾支那（塘中），在会安与归仁两地传教，与布佐米共事。他借鉴葡萄牙语的表音方法，首次用拉丁字母拼写越南语，成为现代国语字的基础。1625年12月15日，他在大门海域营救失事船只上的乘客时溺亡。

en: Christiern Pedersen (c. 1480–1554) was a Danish humanist, printer and translator, often called the father of Danish literature. Born at Helsingør and educated at Greifswald and Paris, he was a canon at Lund before publishing a Latin-Danish dictionary in 1510 and the first printed edition of Saxo Grammaticus's Gesta Danorum in 1514. Loyal to Christian II, he followed the exiled king to the Netherlands in 1526 and spent five years at Lier. He turned Lutheran in 1529 and issued his Danish translation of the New Testament. After running a press in Malmø he completed the first full Danish Bible in Copenhagen in 1543, printed in 1550. He died in 1554.
zh: 克里斯蒂安·佩德森（约1480—1554）是丹麦人文主义者、印刷商与翻译家，常被称为“丹麦文学之父”。他生于赫尔辛格，曾在格赖夫斯瓦尔德和巴黎求学，任隆德教区教士，1510年出版拉丁语—丹麦语词典，1514年首次印行萨克索·格拉玛提库斯的《丹麦人的事迹》。他忠于克里斯蒂安二世，1526年追随流亡的国王到尼德兰，在利尔住了五年。1529年他皈依路德宗，并于同年出版丹麦语《新约》译本。他曾在马尔默开办印刷所，后在哥本哈根完成第一部丹麦语全本《圣经》，译稿1543年完成、1550年印行。他于1554年去世。

en: Hans Mikkelsen (died 1532) was a wealthy merchant who became a councillor in Malmö in 1503 and its burgomaster from 1508, and a trusted adviser of King Christian II, helping to draft the king's reforming land laws. In 1520 he went to Stockholm to negotiate a Nordic trading alliance against the Hanseatic League. When Christian was driven from Denmark in 1523 he followed him into exile and embraced Luther's teaching at Wittenberg. He supervised the first Danish translation of the New Testament, printed in 1524, and himself translated the epistles of Paul. He followed the king to Norway in 1531 and died at Harderwijk in Guelders on 20 December 1532.
zh: 汉斯·米克尔森（卒于1532年）是富有的商人，1503年成为马尔默市政官，1508年起任市长，也是国王克里斯蒂安二世信赖的顾问，曾参与起草国王的改革性地方法律。1520年他前往斯德哥尔摩，商议建立北欧贸易联盟以抗衡汉萨同盟。1523年克里斯蒂安被逐出丹麦后，他随国王流亡，在维滕贝格皈依路德宗。他主持了1524年付印的第一部丹麦语《新约》翻译，并亲自翻译了保罗书信。1531年他随国王前往挪威，1532年12月20日在海尔德兰的哈尔德韦克去世。

en: Lorenz van Steenwinckel (1585–1619) was a Flemish-Danish architect and sculptor, son of Hans van Steenwinckel the Elder and brother of Hans the Younger. From 1613 he oversaw a series of building projects for Christian IV, among them the king's chapel in Roskilde Cathedral, the Trinity Church in the newly founded Kristianstad, and the Copenhagen Stock Exchange. His contracts specified that he should work from drawings supplied by the king. Art historians have differed over his contribution, some crediting him as a designer and others seeing him chiefly as a mason and stonecutter. He died suddenly in 1619 at only 34, and his unfinished works, including the Børsen, were completed by his brother Hans.
zh: 洛伦茨·范·斯滕温克尔（1585—1619）是佛兰德裔丹麦建筑师和雕塑家，为老汉斯·范·斯滕温克尔之子、小汉斯之兄。1613年起，他主持克里斯蒂安四世的一系列建筑工程，包括罗斯基勒大教堂中的国王礼拜堂、新建城市克里斯蒂安斯塔德的圣三一堂，以及哥本哈根证券交易所。他的合同规定他应依照国王提供的图样施工。艺术史家对他的贡献有不同看法：有人认为他是设计者，也有人认为他主要是泥瓦匠和石匠。1619年他猝然去世，年仅34岁，证券交易所等未竟工程由其弟汉斯完成。

en: Sir Andrew Sinclair of Ravenscraig (1555–1625), known in Denmark as Anders Sincklar, was a Scottish nobleman, third son of Henry, 6th Lord Sinclair. In 1589 he sailed with James VI to Norway for Anne of Denmark, staying on as hofjunker to Christian IV from 1591. In 1597 he became a chamber attendant to Queen Anne Catherine of Brandenburg. Married in 1600 to Kirsten Kaas, he held Scanian fiefs including Gladsaxehus, Gislöv and Landskrona, and began building Sinclairsholm. In the Kalmar War he captained a company at the capture of Öland and governed Kalmar. He ended as a Danish privy counsellor, colonel and envoy to England, dying on 17 January 1625.
zh: 雷文斯克雷格的安德鲁·辛克莱爵士（1555—1625）在丹麦称安诺斯·辛克勒，出身苏格兰贵族，是第六代辛克莱勋爵亨利的第三子。1589年他随詹姆士六世前往挪威迎接丹麦的安妮，随后留在丹麦宫廷，1591年起任克里斯蒂安四世的侍从，1597年成为勃兰登堡的安妮·凯瑟琳王后的内侍。1600年他与基尔斯滕·考斯成婚，领有格拉德萨克斯胡斯、伊斯勒夫和兰斯克鲁纳等斯科讷封地，并开始修建辛克莱尔斯霍尔姆庄园。卡尔马战争中他率连参加攻取厄兰，后任卡尔马长官。他最终官至丹麦国务顾问、上校兼驻英格兰使节，1625年1月17日去世。

en: Falk Lykke (1583–1650) of Skovgaard and Bollerup was a Danish nobleman, lensmand and officer from Skåne. He served in the Kalmar War and in 1612 became lensmand of Christianopel. In October 1625 he was commissioned colonel of the Scanian Regiment, and the same year exchanged Christianopel for Gulland with Visborg, governing all of Gotland until 1627, when he received Lund St. Peter's monastery. He repeatedly represented the Scanian nobility, and during the Torstenson War his regiment was long quartered at Helsingør, where he came into severe conflict with the townspeople. He helped Hans Strelow compile the Gotland chronicle, was knighted in 1648 and died on 7 July 1650.
zh: 福克·吕克（1583—1650）领有斯科夫高和博勒鲁普，是出身斯科讷的丹麦贵族、封地长官和军官。他参加卡尔马战争，1612年任克里斯蒂安奥佩尔的封地长官。1625年10月他受命任斯科讷团上校，同年以克里斯蒂安奥佩尔换取含维斯堡在内的哥得兰封地，统辖整个哥得兰岛，1627年改领隆德圣彼得修道院。他多次代表斯科讷贵族，托尔斯滕松战争期间其团队长期驻扎赫尔辛格，他在那里与市民发生激烈冲突。他曾协助汉斯·斯特雷洛夫编写《哥得兰编年史》，1648年受封骑士，1650年7月7日去世。

en: Lambert van Haven (1630–1695) was a Danish-Norwegian architect, master builder and painter, born in Bergen, the son of the painter Salomon van Haven. Already a royal master builder in 1653, he spent the next fifteen years studying Baroque art and architecture in Italy, France and the Netherlands. He also purchased works of art for the king during his travels. In 1671 Christian V named him Denmark-Norway's first General Building Master, overseeing all royal works; he redesigned Copenhagen's Nørreport gate and from 1682 built the Church of Our Saviour in Christianshavn, consecrated in 1696 after his death. He also supervised the king's paintings and sculptures and worked as a court painter. He introduced the classical European Baroque to Danish architecture.
zh: 兰伯特·范·哈文（1630—1695）是丹麦-挪威建筑师、营造师与画家，生于卑尔根，父亲是画家萨洛蒙·范·哈文。1653年他已成为王家营造师，随后十五年在意大利、法国和尼德兰学习巴洛克艺术与建筑，期间还为国王采购艺术品。1671年，克里斯蒂安五世任命他为丹麦-挪威首任总营造师，统管全部王室工程；他重新设计了哥本哈根的北城门，并于1682年起在克里斯蒂安港修建救主堂，教堂在他去世后的1696年才落成祝圣。他还负责监察国王的绘画和雕塑，并担任宫廷画家。他把欧洲古典巴洛克风格引入了丹麦建筑。

en: Pieter Jansz. Liorne (1561–1620) was a merchant and ship-owner of Hoorn in Holland, the son of a Mennonite preacher. He traded across the Baltic and with Italy and served his native town as alderman, councillor and several times burgomaster, as well as a director of the Hoorn chamber of the Dutch East India Company. The Hoorn chronicler Velius credits him as the chief initiator of the lengthened fluyt, a cheap bulk-carrying cargo ship that became decisive for Dutch seaborne trade. In 1618 Stadholder Maurice dismissed him, probably for sympathising with the Remonstrants.
zh: 彼得·扬斯·利奥内（1561—1620）是荷兰霍伦的商人与船东，父亲是门诺派牧师。他经营波罗的海与意大利贸易，并多次担任家乡的市政官、市议员和市长，还出任荷兰东印度公司霍伦分会的主管。据霍伦编年史家费利乌斯记载，他是加长型福禄特帆船的主要推动者；这种造价低廉的散装货船日后成为荷兰海上贸易的关键。1618年，执政毛里茨亲王将他解职，原因可能是他同情抗辩派。

en: Bahlul Khan Lodi (died 1489) was the chief of the Afghan Lodi tribe. He began trading horses and, after selling fine horses to the Sayyid sultan Muhammad Shah, rose from a land grant to govern Sirhind and then Lahore, winning the title Khan-i-Khanan against Malwa. He twice failed to take Delhi, in 1443 and 1447, but when the last Sayyid sultan Alam Shah withdrew to Badaun in 1448, his minister Hamid Khan invited Bahlul to take the throne. After Alam Shah abdicated, Bahlul ascended Delhi's throne on 19 April 1451 and founded the Lodi dynasty. In 1479 he conquered the Jaunpur Sultanate. He died in July 1489 and was followed by his son Sikandar Lodi.
zh: 巴赫卢勒汗·洛迪（1489年卒）是阿富汗洛迪部落的酋长。他早年以贩马为业，把良马卖给赛义德王朝的穆罕默德沙后，凭一块封邑起家，出镇锡尔欣德，又领有拉合尔，并在对马尔瓦的战事中赢得汗中之汗的称号。他曾于1443年和1447年两度攻打德里未果；末代赛义德苏丹阿拉姆沙于1448年退居巴道恩后，其大臣哈米德汗邀请巴赫卢勒入主德里。阿拉姆沙退位后，巴赫卢勒于1451年4月19日登上德里王位，建立洛迪王朝。1479年，他攻灭江布尔苏丹国。他于1489年7月去世，其子西坎达尔汗·洛迪继位。

en: Ismail Mukh, also known as Nasir-ud-din Ismail Shah, was an Afghan noble serving the Delhi Sultanate in the Deccan. In 1346 the Deccani amirs rebelled against Muhammad bin Tughluq and proclaimed him their leader at Daulatabad. The rebellion ended Delhi's control over the Deccan, which it had held since the Khilji dynasty. After Zafar Khan defeated the sultan's armies, Ismail stepped aside in his favour on 3 August 1347, an act from which the Bahmani Sultanate was born. Zafar Khan, enthroned as Ala-ud-Din Bahman Shah, gave him lands near Jamkhandi and the title Amir-ul-Umara. Ismail was later poisoned after a local chieftain briefly turned him against the new sultan.
zh: 伊斯梅尔·穆赫（又名纳西尔丁·伊斯梅尔沙）是在德干为德里苏丹国效力的阿富汗贵族。1346年，德干埃米尔起兵反抗穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克，在道拉塔巴德推举他为首领。这场叛乱使德里失去了自希尔吉王朝以来对德干的控制。扎法尔汗击败苏丹大军后，伊斯梅尔于1347年8月3日让位给他，巴赫曼尼苏丹国由此诞生。登基称阿拉丁·巴曼沙的扎法尔汗封给他贾姆坎迪附近的封地，并赐予诸埃米尔之长的头衔。后来一名地方首领一度挑唆他与新苏丹反目，他随即被毒杀。

en: Malik Maqbul, also titled Khan-i-Jahan Maqbul Tilangani, was a Telugu commander of the Kakatiya Empire named Gannama Nayaka, guarding Warangal Fort until Muhammad bin Tughluq conquered it in 1323. Captured and converted to Islam, he entered Delhi service and, after Warangal fell to rebels, governed Multan and Cambay, where Ibn Battuta met him. He rose to finance minister and then wazir under Firuz Shah Tughlaq, who called him brother and left all fiscal administration in his hands. While the sultan campaigned in Sindh for six months, Maqbul held Delhi. He died in 1369, and his son Jauna Khan succeeded him.
zh: 马利克·马克布勒（称号汗·伊·贾汉·马克布勒·蒂朗加尼）原是卡卡蒂亚王朝的泰卢固将领，名甘纳马·纳亚卡，镇守瓦朗加尔堡，直至1323年穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克将其攻占。他被俘后改宗伊斯兰教，转仕德里；瓦朗加尔被叛军夺取后，他先后出镇木尔坦与坎贝，伊本·白图泰曾在坎贝与他相见。他历任财政大臣，最终成为菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克麾下的维齐尔，苏丹称他为兄弟，将财政全部托付给他。苏丹出征信德的六个月间，他留守德里。他于1369年去世，其子朱纳汗继任。

en: Khizr Khan (c. 1361–1421) was governor of Multan under Firuz Shah Tughlaq and claimed descent from the Prophet Muhammad through his daughter Fatima, a claim that gave his line the name Sayyid dynasty. After Timur's invasion shattered Tughlaq power, he captured Delhi on 28 May 1414, imprisoned its ruler Daulat Khan Lodi, and reigned until 1421. Fearing Timur's heir Shah Rukh, he took no royal title, struck coins in former Tughlaq sultans' names, and only in 1417 secured leave to add his name beside Shah Rukh's. In 1414 his wazir Taj-ul-Mulk forced the ruler of Katehar to submit and pay tribute; in 1416 his army plundered and annexed Bayana and Gwalior. His son Mubarak Shah succeeded him.
zh: 希兹尔汗（约1361—1421）本是菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克麾下木尔坦的总督，自称经穆罕默德之女法蒂玛一脉为先知后裔，其家族也因此得名赛义德王朝。帖木儿入侵摧毁图格鲁克朝的权势后，他于1414年5月28日攻克德里，囚禁当时的统治者道拉特汗·洛迪，统治至1421年。由于忌惮帖木儿之子沙哈鲁，他不称王号，仍铸以图格鲁克前朝苏丹为名的钱币，迟至1417年才获准把自己的名字附在沙哈鲁名后。1414年，他的维齐尔泰杰·穆勒克迫使卡泰哈尔首领归顺纳贡；1416年，泰杰·穆勒克率军劫掠并吞并了巴亚纳和瓜廖尔。其子穆巴拉克沙继位。

en: John Locke (1632–1704) was an English philosopher and physician, a founder of British empiricism, born in Somerset and educated at Oxford. From 1666 he served Anthony Ashley Cooper, later Earl of Shaftesbury, and was elected a Fellow of the Royal Society in 1668. After Shaftesbury's fall he took refuge in the Netherlands from 1683, returning in 1689 with Queen Mary II after the Glorious Revolution. His Letter Concerning Toleration appeared in 1689. In 1689 and 1690 he published Two Treatises of Government and An Essay Concerning Human Understanding, arguing for natural rights, government by consent and the mind as a blank slate. He defended the right to resist tyranny when government lost the people's consent. He died in Essex in 1704.
zh: 约翰·洛克（1632—1704）是英格兰哲学家与医生，英国经验主义的奠基人之一，生于萨默塞特，就读于牛津大学。1666年起他侍奉后来受封沙夫茨伯里伯爵的安东尼·阿什利·库珀，1668年当选英国皇家学会会员。沙夫茨伯里失势后，他自1683年流亡荷兰，光荣革命后的1689年随玛丽二世返回英格兰。同年他的《论宽容书》问世。1689至1690年间，他出版《政府论》和《人类理解论》，主张自然权利与基于同意的政府，并提出心灵是一块白板。他维护人民反抗失去其同意的暴政的权利。1704年他在埃塞克斯去世。

en: Edmund of Langley, 1st Duke of York (1341–1402), was the fifth son of Edward III, born at Kings Langley, Hertfordshire. Made a Knight of the Garter in 1361, he was created Earl of Cambridge in 1362 and campaigned in France, Portugal and Castile. In 1370 he accompanied the Black Prince on the campaign that led to the siege and sack of Limoges. In 1381 he led an unsuccessful expedition to press his brother John of Gaunt's claim to Castile. Richard II made him Duke of York in 1385 and Keeper of the Realm during the king's Irish expeditions.
