Left to guard England in 1399, he first resisted and then joined the returning Henry Bolingbroke, and was rewarded when Bolingbroke became Henry IV. Founder of the House of York, Edmund died in 1402.
zh: 兰利的埃德蒙，第一代约克公爵（1341—1402），是爱德华三世第五子，生于赫特福德郡的国王兰利宫。1361年他成为嘉德骑士，1362年受封剑桥伯爵，曾在法兰西征战，还曾出兵葡萄牙和卡斯蒂利亚。1370年他随黑太子出征，围攻并洗劫利摩日。1381年他率军远征，为兄长冈特的约翰争夺卡斯蒂利亚王位，但无功而返。1385年理查二世封他为约克公爵，国王出征爱尔兰期间由他摄政守国。1399年他奉命留守英格兰，起初起兵抵抗回国的亨利·博林布鲁克，随后转而投靠，在博林布鲁克加冕为亨利四世后受到封赏。他是约克家族的始祖，1402年去世。

en: John of Gaunt, Duke of Lancaster (1340–1399), was the fourth son of Edward III, born at Ghent in Flanders. He married Blanche of Lancaster in 1359 and became one of the richest landowners in England, fighting in France and Spain. When his elder brother the Black Prince fell ill, John assumed many functions of government. Through his second wife Constance he claimed the crown of Castile, and in 1386 he arranged the Anglo-Portuguese alliance sealed by his daughter Philippa's marriage to John I of Portugal. He wielded great influence under Richard II and mediated between the king and rebellious nobles. After his death in 1399 the crown confiscated his estates; his son Henry Bolingbroke seized the throne as Henry IV, founding the House of Lancaster.
zh: 冈特的约翰，兰开斯特公爵（1340—1399），是爱德华三世第四子，生于佛兰德的根特。1359年他迎娶兰开斯特的布兰奇，成为英格兰最富有的大地主之一，在法兰西和西班牙征战。兄长黑太子病重时，约翰承担了许多政务。他凭借第二任妻子卡斯蒂利亚的康斯坦斯主张卡斯蒂利亚王位，1386年促成英葡同盟，并以女儿菲莉琶嫁给葡萄牙国王若昂一世来巩固同盟。他在理查二世朝影响甚大，曾在国王与反叛贵族之间调停。1399年他去世后，王室没收了他的领地；其子亨利·博林布鲁克夺取王位，是为亨利四世，开创兰开斯特王朝。

en: Henry Percy, 1st Earl of Northumberland (1341–1408), was one of the most powerful noblemen in northern England. Appointed Warden of the Scottish Marches in 1362, he was created earl at the coronation of Richard II in 1377. Richard made Percy's rival Ralph Neville Earl of Westmorland in 1397. With his son Harry 'Hotspur' Percy he backed Henry Bolingbroke's seizure of the throne in 1399 and became Constable of England. Father and son were tasked with subduing Owain Glyndŵr's Welsh rebellion. The Percys rebelled in 1403 and Hotspur fell at Shrewsbury; after the Tripartite Indenture of 1405 Henry fled to Scotland. Invading again in 1408, he was killed at Bramham Moor, his head displayed on London Bridge.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/第一代諾森伯蘭伯爵亨利·珀西
zh: 第一代诺森伯兰伯爵亨利·珀西（1341—1408）是英格兰北部最有权势的贵族之一。他于1362年出任苏格兰边境军务长官，1377年在理查二世加冕礼上受封伯爵。1397年，理查封珀西的对手拉尔夫·内维尔为威斯特摩兰伯爵。他与儿子、人称“热刺”的亨利支持亨利·博林布鲁克于1399年夺取王位，随后受任英格兰王室统帅。父子二人奉命镇压欧文·格林杜尔在威尔士发动的叛乱。1403年珀西家族起兵反叛，“热刺”战死于什鲁斯伯里；1405年签订三方分地契约后，亨利逃往苏格兰。1408年他再度入侵英格兰，在布拉默姆沼泽之战中被杀，头颅被悬挂在伦敦桥上示众。

en: Abba Giyorgis of Segla (c. 1365–1425) was one of the most influential Ethiopian Orthodox theologians and Ge'ez writers of his age. He served as court chaplain to Emperor Dawit I, as his father had done, and tutored royal princes, including the future Emperor Zara Yaqob. His teaching on the Sabbath drew the hostility of Dawit I, who imprisoned him; disputes over the Sabbath also divided Ethiopian monasteries. He was released on the accession of his former pupil Tewodros I and later flourished under Yeshaq I. His best-known works are the Book of Hours (Sa'atat) and the theological treatise Book of the Mystery of Heaven and Earth, which shaped Ethiopian liturgy and calendars.
zh: 塞格拉的阿巴·吉约吉斯（约1365—1425）是当时最有影响的埃塞俄比亚正教神学家与吉兹语作家之一。他像父亲一样担任皇帝达维特一世的宫廷司铎，教导诸王子，未来的皇帝札拉·雅各布即出自其门下。他关于安息日的主张触怒达维特一世而被监禁，安息日之争也使埃塞俄比亚的修道院产生分歧。直到旧徒特沃德罗斯一世即位，他才获释，其后在伊沙克一世朝继续著述。他最著名的作品是《时辰书》（《萨阿塔特》）与神学著作《天地奥秘之书》，对埃塞俄比亚的礼仪和历书影响深远。

en: Basalota Mika'el was a fourteenth-century Ethiopian monk who led a deputation against Emperor Amda Seyon I, accusing him of incest for taking his predecessor's concubine Jan Mogassa and threatening excommunication. The emperor exiled the monks; his Ge'ez saint's life survives.
zh: 巴萨洛塔·米卡埃尔是14世纪埃塞俄比亚修士，曾率修士团面谏皇帝阿姆达·塞翁一世，指责他纳先帝遗妃扬·莫加萨形同乱伦，并以绝罚相威胁。皇帝随后将众修士流放，他的吉兹语圣徒行传留存于世。

en: Masaccio (1401–1428), born Tommaso di Ser Giovanni di Simone in San Giovanni Valdarno near Arezzo, was the first great painter of the Florentine Quattrocento. His younger brother Giovanni, known as Scheggia, also became a painter. Registered as a master in Florence's painters' guild in 1422, he worked with Masolino on the Brancacci Chapel frescoes, where his solid, lifelike figures and dramatic light set a new standard for realism. His Trinity in Santa Maria Novella, painted around 1425–1427, applied Brunelleschi's linear perspective with rigorous precision. He died in Rome in the summer of 1428, aged twenty-six; later masters from Leonardo to Michelangelo studied his Brancacci figures.
zh: 马萨乔（1401—1428）出生于阿雷佐附近的圣乔瓦尼-瓦尔达诺，原名托马索·迪·塞尔·乔瓦尼·迪·西蒙，是佛罗伦萨15世纪第一位伟大画家。他的弟弟乔瓦尼，人称斯凯贾，也成为画家。1422年他以独立画师身份加入佛罗伦萨画家行会，后与马索利诺合作绘制布兰卡契礼拜堂壁画，画中人物厚重逼真、光影强烈，为写实树立了新标准。约1425—1427年，他为新圣母大殿创作《三位一体》，严谨运用布鲁内莱斯基的线性透视法。1428年夏他在罗马去世，年仅26岁；从达·芬奇到米开朗琪罗，后世大师都曾研究他在布兰卡契礼拜堂的人物。

en: Sir John Hawkwood (c. 1320–1394), born in Essex, became the most famous English condottiero in Italy. A longbowman in the Hundred Years' War, probably at Crécy and Poitiers, he joined the White Company after the Treaty of Brétigny in 1360, when free companies were forming in France. His company seized Pont-Saint-Esprit near Avignon before he entered Italy in 1361 and became its captain in 1363. He served the pope, the Visconti of Milan and finally Florence, which made him a citizen. In 1377 he married Donnina, an illegitimate daughter of Bernabò Visconti, and in 1387 won his finest victory at Castagnaro for Padua. He died in Florence in 1394 and was buried with honours in the Duomo.
zh: 约翰·霍克伍德爵士（约1320—1394）生于英格兰埃塞克斯，后来成为意大利最有名的英格兰佣兵队长。他曾在百年战争中当长弓手，可能参加过克雷西和普瓦捷战役。1360年《布雷蒂尼条约》签订后，法国各地出现自由佣兵团，他加入了“白军团”。军团攻占阿维尼翁附近的圣埃斯普里桥镇后，他于1361年进入意大利，1363年成为队长。他先后效力于教皇、米兰的维斯孔蒂家族和最终的佛罗伦萨，后者授予他公民身份。1377年，他娶贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂的私生女唐妮娜为妻；1387年他为帕多瓦出战，在卡斯塔尼亚罗取得生平最精彩的胜利。1394年他在佛罗伦萨去世，被隆重安葬于佛罗伦萨大教堂。

en: Charles-Louis de Secondat, baron de Montesquieu (1689–1755), was a French political philosopher. Born at the Château de la Brède near Bordeaux, he inherited in 1716 both his family title and the office of président à mortier of the Bordeaux Parlement. He won fame with the Persian Letters (1721), a satirical portrait of French society seen through two Persian visitors to Paris, sold his judicial office in 1726, and entered the Académie Française in 1728. That year he began a tour of Europe, spending more than a year in England before returning to La Brède. After years of travel and study he published The Spirit of the Laws (1748), which divided government into legislative, executive and judicial powers; the Church placed it on the Index in 1751.
zh: 夏尔·德·塞孔达，拉布雷德与孟德斯鸠男爵（1689—1755），通称孟德斯鸠，是法国政治哲学家。他生于波尔多附近的拉布雷德城堡，1716年继承家族爵位和波尔多高等法院庭长之职。1721年，他以借两名波斯访客的眼睛讽刺巴黎社会的《波斯人信札》一举成名；1726年卖掉司法官职，1728年入选法兰西学术院。同年他开始游历欧洲，在英国逗留一年多后返回拉布雷德。经过多年游历与著述，他于1748年出版《论法的精神》，主张把政府权力划分为立法、行政、司法三权；1751年，教会将此书列入禁书目录。

en: Arrigo della Rocca (c. 1340–1401) was a Corsican noble of the Cinarchesi clan Banda dei Fuori. As a boy his father Guglielmo gave him to the Genoese as a hostage, at Bonifacio and then Genoa. After fighting in Sambucuccio d'Alando's revolt he broke with Genoa and took refuge at the court of Aragon. He returned in 1373 with Aragonese backing, defeated the Genoese governor in 1375, and in 1376 had an assembly at Biguglia proclaim him count of Corsica under the Aragonese flag. In 1391 he took men and ships to relieve Alghero in Sardinia; in 1393 the king of Aragon appointed him lieutenant in Corsica. He mastered the island for years, but died in June 1401, possibly poisoned by the Genoese.
zh: 阿里戈·德拉·罗卡（约1340—1401）是科西嘉贵族，出身奇纳尔凯西五大族之一的“外帮”。幼年时父亲古列尔莫把他交给热那亚人作人质，先囚于博尼法乔，后解往热那亚。他参加过桑布库乔·达兰多的平民起义，后来与热那亚决裂，逃到阿拉贡王庭避难。1373年他在阿拉贡支持下返回科西嘉，1375年击败热那亚总督，1376年经比古利亚贵族集会拥立为科西嘉伯爵，升起阿拉贡旗帜。1391年他率兵船前往撒丁岛救援阿尔盖罗；1393年，阿拉贡国王任命他为科西嘉副官。他多年掌控全岛，1401年6月死去，可能是被热那亚人毒杀。

en: Sambucuccio d'Alando was a Corsican popular leader during the anti-feudal rising that broke out in 1357. An assembly of popular chiefs named him military commander, and the rebels razed the nobles' castles. Allied with Doge Simone Boccanegra, he helped bring the island under Genoese rule when a Corsican delegation made act of submission at Genoa in October 1358. When the nobles counter-attacked, he sought Genoese aid and a governor, Tridano della Torre. The popular camp later split, and Tridano was murdered in 1372. Sambucuccio again took up arms against the nobles and requested another governor, Giovanni da Magnera, who arrived in 1373. After that year all trace of him disappears.
zh: 桑布库乔·达兰多是1357年科西嘉反封建起义中的平民领袖。起义首领的集会推举他为军事指挥官，起义者夷平了贵族的城堡。他与热那亚总督西蒙内·波卡内格拉结盟，1358年10月科西嘉代表团赴热那亚正式归顺，帮助热那亚确立了对全岛的统治。贵族反扑时，他向热那亚请求援军和总督，特里达诺·德拉·托雷随后到任。平民阵营后来分裂，特里达诺于1372年遇刺。桑布库乔再次拿起武器对抗贵族，并请求派遣另一位总督乔瓦尼·达·马涅拉，后者于1373年到任。此后史料中再无他的记载。

en: Luiggi Giafferi (1668–1748) was born at Talasani in Corsica and captained in the Venetian army in the Morean War of 1694. Back home he entered the Noble Twelve and in 1706 went to Genoa as orator of Corsica to plead for reforms. In the 1729–1730 anti-tax rising he helped turn the revolt into an armed political insurrection and became one of the first generals of the Nation. After imprisonment in the Savona fortress in 1732 he returned in 1734 to lead the second insurrection beside Giacinto Paoli. Under King Theodore he was prime minister in 1736 and then regent, until French intervention forced him into exile in 1739. He became an infantry colonel in Naples.
zh: 路易吉·贾费里（1668—1748）生于科西嘉的塔拉萨尼，1694年在摩里亚战争中任威尼斯军队上尉。回到家乡后他入选“十二贵族”，1706年作为科西嘉演说者赴热那亚呼吁改革。1729至1730年的抗税起义中，他帮助将反抗转变为武装政治起义，并成为最早的几位“民族将军”之一。1732年他被囚于萨沃纳要塞，1734年返回科西嘉，与贾钦托·保利共同领导第二次起义。特奥多尔国王时期，他于1736年出任首相，随后担任摄政，直到1739年法国出兵迫使他流亡。他后来在那不勒斯担任步兵上校。

en: Galeazzo Alessi (1512–1572) was an Italian architect born in Perugia, where he trained under Giovan Battista Caporali and studied Roman ruins before moving to Genoa in 1548. He modernized the harbour fortifications with the Porta del Molo and built palaces along the new Strada Nuova, designs later copied by the young Rubens. From 1549 he spent decades on the Basilica of Santa Maria in Carignano, modelled on Bramante's scheme for St Peter's. He also built the Villa Pallavicino delle Peschiere in 1560. In Milan he designed Palazzo Marino and Santa Maria presso San Celso's facade, and he sent plans for the Escorial in Spain. Around 1561 he returned to Perugia, where he died in 1572.
zh: 加莱亚佐·阿莱西（1512—1572）是生于佩鲁贾的意大利建筑师，早年师从焦万·巴蒂斯塔·卡波拉利研习古罗马建筑，1548年移居热那亚。他主持整修港口防御，修建码头门，并在新辟的“新街”两侧设计多座宫殿，年轻的鲁本斯后来曾临摹这些建筑。1549年起他历时数十年营造卡里尼亚诺的圣母升天圣殿，设计参照布拉曼特改建圣彼得大教堂的方案。1560年他还建造了帕拉维奇诺·德莱佩斯基耶雷别墅。在米兰他设计了马里诺宫和圣切尔索附近圣母堂的立面，还为西班牙的埃斯科里亚尔修道院寄送图样。约1561年他返回佩鲁贾，1572年在当地去世。

en: Bartolomeo Bianco (1590–1657) was the leading architect of the Genoese Baroque. Born at Coldrerio near Como, he moved to Genoa with his father Cipriano, also an architect, and became the favourite builder of the Balbi family. From 1618 he laid out the new Via Balbi, improving the route between the port and the western gate, and lined it with palaces, including the Palazzo Balbi-Senarega, soon published by Rubens in his Palazzi di Genova. In 1626 he took charge of the city's New Walls, and from 1634 built the Jesuit college, his masterpiece, now the seat of the University of Genoa. Its steep site inspired a dramatic arrangement of loggias and stairways. He died in Genoa during the plague of 1657.
zh: 巴尔托洛梅奥·比安科（1590—1657）是热那亚巴洛克建筑的代表建筑师。他生于科莫附近的科尔代里奥，幼年随同为建筑师的父亲奇普里亚诺迁居热那亚，后来成为巴尔比家族最倚重的营造师。1618年起他主持开辟巴尔比街，改善港口与西城门之间的交通，沿街修建包括巴尔比-塞纳雷加宫在内的多座宫殿，鲁本斯后来在《热那亚的宫殿》中刊印了这些建筑。1626年他主持修建热那亚新城墙，1634年起建造耶稣会学院——这是他的杰作，后来成为热那亚大学的主楼。学院地势陡峭，他借此布置了富有戏剧效果的凉廊和阶梯。1657年他在鼠疫中病逝于热那亚。

en: Bernardo Strozzi (c. 1581–1644), called il Cappuccino and il Prete Genovese, was a Genoese Baroque painter and engraver of altarpieces, portraits, genre scenes and still lifes. He trained with Pietro Sorri and joined a Capuchin monastery in 1598, but left around 1608 to support his family through painting, winning patrons such as the Doria. For them he painted frescoes in the choir of San Domenico. In 1630 his refusal to return to the monastery led to his imprisonment. He settled in Venice around 1632, where Doge Francesco Erizzo and the Grimani family commissioned him. He painted altarpieces for the Incurabili and San Nicolò da Tolentino. His glowing colour and broad brushwork helped found the Venetian Baroque style. He died in Venice in 1644.
zh: 贝尔纳多·斯特罗齐（约1581—1644），人称“嘉布遣修士”和“热那亚神父”，是热那亚巴洛克画家兼版画家，擅画祭坛画、肖像、风俗画与静物。他师从彼得罗·索里，1598年加入嘉布遣修会，约1608年离开修院，靠绘画养家，赢得多里亚家族等赞助。他为多里亚家族在圣多明我堂的唱经席绘制壁画。1630年，他拒绝重返修院，因而被囚禁。约1632年他定居威尼斯，总督弗朗切斯科·埃里佐和格里马尼家族都向他订画。他为不治之症医院教堂和圣尼科洛·达·托伦蒂诺教堂绘制祭坛画，以明丽的色彩与奔放的笔触成为威尼斯巴洛克画风的奠基者之一，1644年在威尼斯去世。

en: Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione (1609–1664), called Il Grechetto, was a Genoese Baroque painter and printmaker. He trained in the studio of Giovanni Battista Paggi and studied the work of Rubens and Anthony van Dyck. He lived in Rome from 1634 to about 1645 and traveled to Florence and Naples before returning to Genoa. Back in Rome in 1647, he moved in 1651 to become court artist to Duke Carlo II Gonzaga in Mantua, where he died in 1664. He painted rural scenes crowded with animals, notably Noah's Ark and other Old Testament subjects featuring patriarchs and their flocks. He won lasting fame for his etchings and as the inventor of the monotype.
zh: 乔瓦尼·贝内代托·卡斯蒂廖内（1609—1664），人称“小希腊人”，是热那亚画派的巴洛克画家与版画家。他在乔瓦尼·巴蒂斯塔·帕吉的画室学艺，研习鲁本斯和安东尼·凡·戴克的作品。1634至约1645年他旅居罗马，游历佛罗伦萨与那不勒斯后回到热那亚。1647年他重返罗马，1651年前往曼托瓦，担任卡洛二世·贡扎加公爵的宫廷画家，1664年在当地去世。他擅长画动物成群的乡野场景，尤其喜爱挪亚方舟和其他描绘旧约先祖与牲畜的题材。其蚀刻画享有盛名，他也被视为独幅版画技法的发明者。

en: Valerio Castello (1624–1659) was a leading painter of the Genoese Baroque. The youngest son of the painter Bernardo Castello, he was apprenticed to Domenico Fiasella and Giovanni Andrea de' Ferrari, then studied in Milan and Parma, absorbing Procaccini, Rubens and van Dyck. He painted cycles in Genoese churches such as San Martino d'Albaro, and excelled in turbulent battle pieces and histories such as the Rape of the Sabines. Rubens inspired his compositions full of movement. Between 1655 and 1659 he frescoed the vaults of the Palazzo Balbi-Senarega, his masterpiece, including an allegorical Chariot of Time celebrating the Balbi family. He died suddenly in Genoa in 1659, aged about thirty-five, leaving pupils such as Domenico Piola.
zh: 瓦莱里奥·卡斯特罗（1624—1659）是热那亚巴洛克画派的代表画家。他是画家贝尔纳多·卡斯特罗的幼子，先后师从多梅尼科·菲亚塞拉和乔瓦尼·安德烈亚·德·费拉里，又到米兰、帕尔马研习普罗卡奇尼、鲁本斯和凡·戴克的作品。他为圣马蒂诺·达尔巴罗等热那亚教堂绘制壁画组画，尤以动势激烈的战争画和《抢劫萨宾妇女》等历史画见长。鲁本斯的作品启发了他充满动感的构图。1655至1659年他为巴尔比-塞纳雷加宫绘制拱顶壁画，这是他的杰作，其中寓意性的《时间之车》颂扬巴尔比家族。1659年他猝逝于热那亚，年仅约三十五岁，多梅尼科·皮奥拉等都是他的门生。

en: Alessandro Magnasco (1667–1749), called il Lissandrino, was a late-Baroque painter born in Genoa, the son of minor artist Stefano Magnasco. He trained under Valerio Castello and then Filippo Abbiati in Milan, where he worked until 1735 apart from a Florentine stay around 1703–1711 serving Grand Duke Cosimo III. He became famous for eerie, phantasmagoric genre scenes, monks' gatherings and stormy landscapes, built from flickering brushwork and small, fragmented figures. In Milan he also painted figures in Tavella's landscapes and Clemente Spera's ruins. His unusual subjects included inquisitorial torture and Jewish and Quaker religious ceremonies. He returned to Genoa in 1735 and died there in 1749.
zh: 亚历山德罗·马尼亚斯科（1667—1749），人称“小亚历山大”，是生于热那亚的巴洛克晚期画家，父亲是无名画家斯特凡诺·马尼亚斯科。他先后师从瓦莱里奥·卡斯泰洛和米兰的菲利波·阿比亚蒂，除约1703至1711年在佛罗伦萨效力于大公科西莫三世外，一直在米兰创作，直到1735年。他以诡谲奇幻的风俗画、修士聚会与风暴风景闻名，画面由飞动的笔触和细小破碎的人物构成。在米兰，他也为塔韦拉的风景画和克莱门特·斯佩拉的废墟画绘制人物。他的不寻常题材包括宗教裁判所的酷刑，以及犹太教和贵格会的宗教仪式。1735年他回到热那亚，1749年在当地去世。

en: Giorgi Saakadze (c. 1570–1629) was a Georgian military commander from the petty nobility of Kartli. Appointed mouravi of Tbilisi under King Luarsab II in 1608, he destroyed an Ottoman invasion at Tashiskari in 1609. Forced into exile by intrigue in 1612, he served Shah Abbas I of Iran, aided his invasion of Georgia in 1614 and became de facto ruler of Kartli in 1619. In 1625, learning Abbas planned to massacre armed Kartlians, including himself, he ambushed the Iranian army at Martqopi. After the subsequent Iranian victory at Marabda, he withdrew to the mountains and led a guerrilla campaign. Defeated at Bazaleti in 1626, he took Ottoman service under Murad IV and was executed in Constantinople in 1629.
zh: 吉奥尔基·萨阿卡泽（约1570—1629）是卡特利的格鲁吉亚军事统帅，出身低级贵族。1608年，他被国王卢阿尔萨布二世任命为第比利斯的穆拉维，1609年在塔什斯卡里歼灭一支奥斯曼入侵军。1612年遭宫廷倾轧被迫出逃后，他效力于伊朗沙阿阿拔斯一世，1614年协助其入侵格鲁吉亚，1619年成为卡特利的实际统治者。1625年，得知阿拔斯计划屠杀包括他在内的卡特利持武器者，他在马尔特科皮伏击伊朗军队。此后伊朗军在马拉布达获胜，他退入山区领导游击抵抗。1626年在巴扎莱蒂战败后，他转投穆拉德四世为奥斯曼效力，1629年在君士坦丁堡被处死。

en: Prince Sulkhan-Saba Orbeliani (1658–1725) of the House of Orbeliani was a Georgian writer, lexicographer and diplomat. Raised at the court of King George XI of Kartli, he studied in the palace library, wrote the fable collection A Book of Wisdom and Lies in his youth and took monastic vows at David Gareji in 1698. His Georgian Dictionary, combining a lexicon with an encyclopedia, helped standardize the literary Georgian language. As tutor and envoy of King Vakhtang VI he travelled to Paris and Rome, seeking aid from Louis XIV and Pope Clement XI against the Ottomans. France promised assistance, but Louis died and the mission came to nothing. He died in Moscow in 1725.
zh: 苏尔汉-萨巴·奥尔别利阿尼亲王（1658—1725）出身奥尔别利阿尼家族，是格鲁吉亚作家、辞典编纂家和外交官。他在卡特利国王吉奥尔基十一世的宫廷中长大，在王宫图书馆求学，年轻时写成寓言故事集《智慧与谎言》，1698年在大卫·加列贾修道院出家。他的《格鲁吉亚语辞典》兼具词典与百科全书性质，推动了书面格鲁吉亚语的规范化。作为瓦赫坦六世的老师和使节，他前往巴黎和罗马，向路易十四和教皇克雷芒十一世求援以对抗奥斯曼人。法国曾许诺援助，但路易去世，使命最终无功而返。1725年他在莫斯科去世。

en: Yahya ibn Umar ibn Rahhu was a Zenata Berber commander of the Banu Rahhu clan in Nasrid Granada and son-in-law of Uthman ibn Abi al-Ula, chief of the Volunteers of the Faith. In December 1326 the vizier named him rival commander of the Volunteers, drawing their troops from Uthman amid civil war. Around 1340 Sultan Yusuf I made him overall chief. After 1354 he governed for Muhammad V with the chamberlain Ridwan and the vizier Ibn al-Khatib; together they maintained peace with Castile and paid it tribute. When Ismail II seized power in 1359, Yahya stayed loyal and fled to Castile with two hundred horsemen, finding asylum in Cordoba before rejoining the exiled sultan in 1361.
zh: 叶海亚·伊本·奥马尔·伊本·拉胡是纳斯里德王朝格拉纳达的泽纳塔柏柏尔将领，出身巴努·拉胡家族，是“信仰志愿军”首领乌斯曼·伊本·阿比·乌拉的女婿。内战期间的1326年12月，大维齐尔任命他为与乌斯曼分庭抗礼的志愿军统领，志愿军随之背离乌斯曼。约1340年，优素福一世苏丹任命他为志愿军最高首领。1354年后，他与宫相里德万及维齐尔伊本·哈提卜共同辅佐穆罕默德五世治国，对卡斯蒂利亚维持和平并纳贡。1359年伊斯玛仪二世篡位，叶海亚仍忠于穆罕默德五世，率两百骑兵逃往卡斯蒂利亚，在科尔多瓦得到庇护，1361年重新与流亡苏丹会合。

en: Thomas von Villach (1435/1440–1523/1529), born Thomas Artula at Thörl near Arnoldstein, was the leading late-Gothic painter in Carinthia. Probably trained by Friedrich von Villach, he worked in Villach from about 1455, painting frescoes and altarpieces that blended Italian and later Netherlandish influences. Among the works attributed to him are the Landplagenbild of 1485 on Graz Cathedral, commemorating the plague, locusts and Ottoman siege the city suffered in 1480, and the frescoes at St. Paul's Abbey of 1493. He also painted frescoes in the choir of the church at his birthplace, Thörl. From 1520 he served as a city judge in Villach and died there between 1523 and 1529.
zh: 托马斯·冯·菲拉赫（1435/1440—1523/1529）本名托马斯·阿尔图拉，生于阿诺尔德施泰因附近的特尔尔，是克恩滕晚期哥特画派最重要的画家。他大概师从弗里德里希·冯·菲拉赫，约1455年起在菲拉赫创作湿壁画和祭坛画，融合意大利画风，后来又吸收尼德兰艺术。归于他的作品包括1485年绘于格拉茨大教堂的《天灾图》，纪念该城1480年遭受的瘟疫、蝗灾和奥斯曼人围攻，还有1493年圣保罗修道院的湿壁画。他也在家乡特尔尔教堂的唱诗班席绘制湿壁画。1520年起，年迈的他出任菲拉赫城市法官，1523至1529年间在当地去世。

en: Leonhard Egkelzain was the mining judge, or Bergrichter, of Schladming in Styria, whose silver, lead and copper mines in the Schladminger Tauern gave work to as many as fifteen hundred miners. In 1408 he drew up the Schladminger Bergbrief, the Schladming Mining Letter, which set down in writing the procedural rules and customary rights of the town's miners.
zh: 莱昂哈德·埃克尔蔡因是施蒂利亚施拉德明的矿业法官；当地施拉德明陶恩山区的银、铅、铜矿最多时雇用了一千五百名矿工。1408年，他制定了《施拉德明矿业书》，把该镇矿工的诉讼规则和习惯权利以书面形式确定下来。

en: Kaspar Schlick (c. 1396–1449), born at Eger to a merchant councilor, studied at Leipzig and entered Sigismund's service, attending the Council of Constance and travelling with him to Spain, France and England. He rose from scribe in 1416 to royal secretary, vice-chancellor and, in 1433, imperial chancellor, its first lay commoner. Knighted in Rome at Sigismund's coronation, he fought the Ottomans and Hussites, negotiated for the king in Prussia, Poland and Lithuania, and was made a count in 1437–1438. He served Albert II and Frederick III, married a Silesian duke's daughter in 1444, patronised Enea Silvio Piccolomini, and died in Vienna in 1449. His family's claimed noble ancestry was later disputed.
zh: 卡斯帕尔·施利克（约1396—1449）生于海布，父亲是商人兼市议员。他就读莱比锡大学，后进入西吉斯蒙德麾下，曾参加康斯坦茨宗教会议，并随他游历西班牙、法兰西和英格兰。他1416年任文书，历任国王秘书、副首相，1433年成为帝国首相，是首位出任此职的在俗平民。西吉斯蒙德加冕时他在罗马受封骑士，参加过对奥斯曼人和胡斯派的战争，代表国王在普鲁士、波兰和立陶宛谈判，1437至1438年受封伯爵。他先后效力阿尔布雷希特二世和腓特烈三世，1444年娶一位西里西亚公爵之女，资助过埃内亚·西尔维奥·皮科洛米尼，1449年卒于维也纳。其家族自称的贵族血统后来受到质疑。

en: Conrad Celtes (1459–1508), born Konrad Pickel near Schweinfurt in Franconia, was the foremost German humanist of his age. Educated at Cologne and Heidelberg, he published his Art of Writing Verses in 1486 and was crowned poet laureate by Emperor Frederick III at Nuremberg in 1487. He lectured across Germany and Italy, studied mathematics and astronomy at Kraków in 1489–1491, and founded a chain of humanist literary societies, including the Vistula literary society. In 1492 he urged German students at Ingolstadt to rival the Italians in learning. In 1494 he rediscovered the plays of Hrotsvitha at Regensburg. Summoned to Vienna by Maximilian I in 1497, he founded the Collegium Poetarum there in 1502 and died in Vienna in 1508.
zh: 康拉德·策尔蒂斯（1459—1508）生于法兰克尼亚施韦因富特附近，本名康拉德·皮克尔，是当时首屈一指的德意志人文主义者。他在科隆和海德堡求学后，于1486年出版《作诗术》，1487年在纽伦堡被皇帝腓特烈三世加冕为桂冠诗人。他遍历神圣罗马帝国乃至意大利讲学，1489至1491年在克拉科夫学习数学和天文学，并创办了一系列人文主义文学会，包括维斯瓦河文学会。1492年，他在英戈尔施塔特号召德意志学生在学问上与意大利人比肩。1494年，他在雷根斯堡重新发现了赫罗斯维塔的剧作。1497年他应马克西米利安一世之召前往维也纳，1502年在当地创立诗人学院，1508年于维也纳去世。

en: Johannes Cuspinian (1473–1529), born Johan Spießhaymer near Schweinfurt in Franconia, studied at Leipzig and Vienna, where he became professor of medicine and rector of the university in 1500. In 1493 Maximilian I crowned him poet laureate for a panegyric on St Leopold. A leading humanist of the Danubian literary circle around Conrad Celtes, he edited classical and medieval historical texts and wrote Austria, a historical survey of Lower Austria. As Maximilian's councillor and diplomat he undertook missions to Hungary, Bohemia and Poland. He negotiated the Habsburg–Jagiellonian double marriage alliance of 1515, which ultimately brought Bohemia and Hungary to the Habsburgs in 1526.
zh: 约翰内斯·库斯皮尼安（1473—1529）生于法兰克尼亚施韦因富特附近，原名约翰·施皮斯海默，曾在莱比锡和维也纳求学，后任维也纳大学医学教授，并于1500年出任校长。1493年，他因一篇赞颂圣利奥波德的文章而被马克西米利安一世加冕为桂冠诗人。他是康拉德·策尔蒂斯周围多瑙文学圈的核心人文主义者之一，校勘古典与中世纪史籍，还撰写了记述下奥地利的史地著作《奥地利》。作为马克西米利安的顾问与外交官，他曾出使匈牙利、波希米亚和波兰，并促成1515年哈布斯堡家族与雅盖隆家族的双重联姻，使波希米亚和匈牙利最终于1526年归入哈布斯堡家族。

en: Wilhelm von Schröder (1640–1688) was a German mercantilist and cameralist at the court of Emperor Leopold I in Vienna. After beginning law studies at Jena in 1659, he travelled in Holland and England, pursuing interests in economics and the natural sciences. He joined the Royal Society in 1662, but his attempt to finish his studies at Jena failed when his dissertation was rejected in 1663. He converted to Catholicism and entered Habsburg service in 1673, reporting from London on English economic innovations. In 1677 he took over Vienna's Kunst- und Werkhaus, a state model factory for wool, silk and glass promoted by Johann Joachim Becher; it closed in 1681 and burned in the 1683 Turkish siege. He died at Eperies while serving as a treasury councillor in Hungary.
zh: 威廉·冯·施罗德（1640—1688）是皇帝利奥波德一世维也纳宫廷中的德意志重商主义者与官房学派经济学家。他于1659年在耶拿开始攻读法律，后游历荷兰与英国，研究经济和自然科学。1662年他成为皇家学会会员，但1663年试图在耶拿完成学业时，论文未获通过。皈依天主教后，他于1673年进入哈布斯堡王朝任职，从伦敦发回有关英国经济新举措的报告。1677年，他接掌维也纳的艺术与工场院——约翰·约阿希姆·贝歇尔倡议设立的毛织、丝织与玻璃国家示范工场；工场于1681年关闭，1683年在土耳其人围攻维也纳时焚毁。他在匈牙利担任财政顾问期间卒于埃佩尔耶什。

en: Philipp Wilhelm von Hörnigk (1640–1714) was an Austrian cameralist and mercantilist writer. Born at Frankfurt am Main, he earned a doctorate in law at Ingolstadt in 1661 and from 1673 compiled trade statistics in Vienna with Johann Joachim Becher, his brother-in-law. After Vienna's 1683 Ottoman siege, his 1684 manifesto Austria over All argued that wealth rested on raw materials rather than trade, calling for protected mines and manufactures and an army of a hundred thousand men. Treating Habsburg lands as one economic space, it dominated economic policy discussion for over a generation. In 1690 he entered the service of the Bishop of Passau, where he died in 1714. His book reached fifteen editions by 1784, long after his death.
zh: 菲利普·威廉·冯·霍尼克（1640—1714）是奥地利官房学派学者、重商主义作家。他出生于美因河畔法兰克福，1661年在因戈尔施塔特获得法学博士学位，1673年起在维也纳与姻兄约翰·约阿希姆·贝歇尔一同编纂贸易统计。1683年维也纳遭奥斯曼围攻之后，他在1684年发表纲领性著作《奥地利高于一切，只要它愿意》，主张国家财富建立在原料而非贸易之上，呼吁保护矿山和工场，并组建一支十万人的军队。该书把哈布斯堡各领地视为统一的经济区，主导了超过一代人的经济政策讨论。1690年他转入帕绍主教麾下任职，1714年卒于当地。他去世许久之后，该书到1784年共印行十五版。

en: Ulrich von Eyczing (c. 1395–1460) was an Austrian baron who acquired Schrattenthal in 1434 and later bought further estates, extending his holdings from the Danube to Moravia. He served Dukes Albert IV and Albert V against the Hussites, and in 1439 was raised to baronial rank with his brothers. After Albert II's death he backed Queen Elizabeth and later served Frederick III, but on 14 October 1451 he formed the Mailberger Bund, uniting 250 nobles against the emperor's guardianship of Ladislaus Postumus. He sat on the regency council of 1453–1455 and became governor of Austria in 1457–1458. Later imprisoned by Albert VI, he was freed through the emperor's intervention and tried unsuccessfully to organise another league before his death in 1460.
zh: 乌尔里克·冯·艾青（约1395—1460）是奥地利男爵，1434年取得施拉滕塔尔，后来继续购置地产，使其领地从多瑙河延伸到摩拉维亚。他先后效力公爵阿尔布雷希特四世和阿尔布雷希特五世，参加过抗击胡斯派的战争，1439年与兄弟一同受封男爵。阿尔布雷希特二世死后，他支持王后伊丽莎白，后来效力腓特烈三世，但于1451年10月14日牵头结成有250名贵族参加的迈尔贝格联盟，反对皇帝监护拉斯洛。1453至1455年他任摄政会议成员，1457至1458年出任奥地利执政。后来他被阿尔布雷希特六世囚禁，经皇帝干预获释；1460年去世前，他试图另组联盟，却未能成功。

en: Johannes Müller von Königsberg (1436–1476), known as Regiomontanus, was a German mathematician and astronomer born at Königsberg in Lower Franconia. He became Georg von Peuerbach's pupil at Vienna in 1451. On Peuerbach's deathbed in 1461 he promised to complete his abridgement of Ptolemy's Almagest, and spent four years in Italy with Cardinal Bessarion, seeking and copying mathematical and astronomical manuscripts, before finishing the Epitome. He served Archbishop Vitéz in Hungary and Matthias Corvinus at Buda, building instruments and compiling trigonometrical tables. Settling in Nuremberg in 1471, he ran the first scientific printing press and in 1472 printed Peuerbach's planetary textbook. Summoned to Rome by Sixtus IV, he died there in 1476.
zh: 约翰内斯·米勒·冯·柯尼希斯贝格（1436—1476），人称雷格蒙塔努斯，是德意志数学家和天文学家，生于下法兰克尼亚的柯尼希斯贝格。他1451年在维也纳成为格奥尔格·冯·波伊尔巴赫的学生。1461年老师临终前，他许诺完成其托勒密《天文学大成》的节本；随后随贝萨里翁枢机在意大利游历四年，搜集和抄写数学、天文学手稿，最终完成《概要》一书。他曾在匈牙利为维泰兹大主教、在布达为马加什·科尔温效力，制造天文仪器、编制三角数表。1471年他定居纽伦堡，经营第一家科学印刷所，1472年刊印波伊尔巴赫的行星理论教材。后应教皇西克斯图斯四世之召前往罗马，1476年在当地去世。

en: Johann Faber (1478–1541), born Johannes Heigerlin in Leutkirch in Swabia, studied theology and canon law at Tübingen and Freiburg and became vicar-general of Constance in 1517. Once sympathetic to the reform efforts of Zwingli and others, he became their steadfast opponent, debating Zwingli at the First Zürich Disputation of 1523 and publishing his Malleus Haereticorum, or hammer of heretics. As Archduke Ferdinand's confessor from 1524 and Bishop of Vienna from 1530, he helped draft the Catholic refutation of the Augsburg Confession and led the campaign against Protestant teaching in Austria. Ferdinand sent him to Spain and England to seek aid against the Turks; as bishop he also founded twelve scholarships for boys without the means to become priests. He died at Baden near Vienna.
zh: 约翰内斯·法布里（1478—1541）生于施瓦本的洛伊特基希，原名约翰内斯·海格林，曾在蒂宾根和弗赖堡攻读神学与教会法，1517年任康斯坦茨副主教。他起初同情茨温利等人的改革努力，后来却成为他们坚定的论敌，1523年在第一次苏黎世辩论中与茨温利公开交锋，又写成《异端之锤》。1524年起他任斐迪南的告解神父，1530年任维也纳主教，参与起草驳《奥格斯堡信纲》的天主教文件，主持在奥地利抵制新教教义。斐迪南派他前往西班牙和英格兰，寻求援助以抵抗土耳其人；他担任主教时还为无力支付费用、希望成为神父的男孩设立了十二份奖学金。他最终于维也纳附近的巴登去世。

en: Melchior Khlesl (1552–1630) was an Austrian cardinal-statesman of the early Counter-Reformation. Born to Lutheran parents in Vienna, he studied philosophy at the university there and converted under Jesuit influence. Ordained in 1579, he became Lower Austrian vicar general in 1581 and led its Protestant towns back to Catholicism. He became Bishop of Vienna in 1602 and from 1609 served Matthias as chief minister, working for compromise between the confessional camps; he was made cardinal in 1616. His moderation angered hardliners; in 1618 Ferdinand II arrested him and held him in the Tyrol and Rome. Released in 1623, he resumed his Vienna diocese in 1628 and died in 1630.
zh: 梅尔希奥·克莱斯尔（1552—1630）是反宗教改革早期的奥地利枢机与政治家。他出生于维也纳一个路德宗家庭，在当地大学学习哲学，并在耶稣会影响下改宗天主教。1579年他受铎，1581年起任下奥地利副主教，推动当地新教城镇重归天主教。1602年他出任维也纳主教，1609年起担任马蒂亚斯的首席大臣，致力于天主教与新教两大阵营之间的妥协，1616年受封枢机。他的温和路线激怒了强硬派，1618年被斐迪南二世逮捕，先后关押于蒂罗尔和罗马。1623年获释后，他于1628年重返维也纳主教区，1630年去世。

en: Prince Eugene of Savoy (1663–1736) was born in Paris at the Hôtel de Soissons, youngest son of the Count of Soissons and Olympia Mancini, a niece of Cardinal Mazarin, and was raised at Louis XIV's court. Refused a French commission in 1683, he entered Emperor Leopold I's service and won fame at the relief of Vienna. A field marshal by 25, he crushed the Ottomans at Zenta in 1697, then with Marlborough shared the victories of Blenheim (1704), Oudenaarde (1708) and Malplaquet (1709). He also won at Turin in 1706 and Petrovaradin in 1716 before taking Belgrade in 1717. He served three emperors and collected art and books; his palaces in Vienna include the Belvedere.
zh: 萨伏依的欧根亲王（1663—1736）生于巴黎的苏瓦松公馆，是苏瓦松伯爵与马萨林枢机外甥女奥林匹娅·曼奇尼的幼子，在路易十四的宫廷中长大。1683年他未能获得法国军职，便转投皇帝利奥波德一世，在维也纳解围之战中成名。他25岁即升任陆军元帅，1697年在森塔击溃奥斯曼军，后来又与马尔博罗公爵联手取得布伦海姆（1704）、奥德纳尔德（1708）和马尔普拉凯（1709）诸役的胜利。他还于1706年在都灵、1716年在彼得罗瓦拉丁获胜，1717年攻克贝尔格莱德。他历事三位皇帝，收藏艺术品与书籍；维也纳的美景宫就是他留下的宫殿。

en: Johann Ribi von Lenzburg (1310s–1374), born at Seengen in Aargau, was the son of the Schultheiss of Lenzburg and rose through Habsburg service. He held church benefices in Alsace and at Zofingen, became a notary in 1352 and chancellor of Duke Albert II in 1353. From 1358 he headed Archduke Rudolf IV's chancellery, possibly helping to draft the Privilegium Maius, and mediated between Rudolf, Emperor Charles IV and King Louis I of Hungary. After an unsuccessful bid for the bishopric of Freising, he was appointed bishop of Gurk by the pope in 1359. He served as governor of Carinthia in 1363–1365. Rudolf secured his election as bishop of Brixen after failing to place him at Passau; the pope confirmed it in 1364. Johann died at Brixen in 1374.
zh: 约翰·里比·冯·伦茨堡（1310年代—1374）生于阿尔高的森根，父亲是伦茨堡的地方长官，靠效力哈布斯堡家族发迹。他在阿尔萨斯和措芬根领有教会圣俸，1352年任公证人，1353年成为公爵阿尔布雷希特二世的掌玺官。1358年起他主持大公爵鲁道夫四世的中书省，可能参与起草《大特权》，并多次在鲁道夫、皇帝查理四世与匈牙利国王拉约什一世之间调停。他竞逐弗赖辛主教未果，1359年由教皇任命为古尔克主教，1363至1365年任克恩滕长官。鲁道夫未能使他当选帕绍主教，转而促成他当选布里克森主教，教皇于1364年确认了这一任命。约翰1374年卒于布里克森。

en: Wenzel Anton von Kaunitz (1711–1794) was a Habsburg statesman born in Vienna, one of nineteen children of Count Maximilian Ulrich of Kaunitz. Originally destined for the Church, he studied law and diplomacy after his elder brother died. After serving in the Aulic Council from 1735, he secured Sardinian support for Maria Theresa at Turin in 1742. He later served as minister in the Austrian Netherlands and represented her at the Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle in 1748. Sent as ambassador to Versailles in 1750, he prepared the reversal of alliances that, once he became State Chancellor in 1753, became the Treaty of Versailles of 1756, joining Austria to France against Prussia. He directed Habsburg foreign policy until 1792 and was made a prince of the Empire in 1764.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/文策尔·安东·冯·考尼茨-里特贝格
zh: 文策尔·安东·冯·考尼茨-里特贝格（1711—1794）是生于维也纳的哈布斯堡政治家，为考尼茨伯爵马克西米利安·乌尔里希十九名子女之一。他原本预定从事教职，兄长去世后转而学习法律与外交。他1735年进入帝国枢密院，1742年在都灵为玛丽亚·特蕾西亚争取到撒丁王国的支持。此后他出任奥属尼德兰的政府大臣，并代表她签订1748年的《亚琛条约》。1750年他出使凡尔赛，为结盟逆转铺路；1753年出任国务首相后，这一安排化为1756年的《凡尔赛条约》，使奥地利与法国结盟、共同对抗普鲁士。他主持哈布斯堡外交至1792年，1764年受封帝国亲王。

en: Franz Anton von Raab (1722–1783) was an Austrian court official and agrarian reformer under Maria Theresa. Born in Carinthia and trained in law, he designed the land reform named after him, Raabization: from the 1770s, church and noble estates in the Bohemian and Austrian lands were split into small holdings sold to peasants on hereditary leases against cash payments that replaced their compulsory robota labour. Continued under Joseph II, the reform freed tenant farmers, founded new villages and raised state revenues. Knighted in 1755, Raab died in Vienna in 1783. His daughter Eleonore assembled a mineral collection later catalogued by Ignaz von Born.
zh: 弗朗茨·安东·冯·拉布（1722—1783）是玛丽亚·特蕾西亚朝的奥地利宫廷官员与土地改革家。他生于克恩滕州，曾攻读法律，设计了以他名字命名的土地改革“拉布化”：自1770年代起，波希米亚与奥地利领地内的教会和贵族大地产被分成小块，以世袭租约和现金偿付的方式卖给农民，以此抵偿他们承担的强制劳役。这场改革在约瑟夫二世时期继续推行，使佃农获得自由，催生出一批新村，并增加了国家收入。拉布于1755年受封骑士，1783年卒于维也纳。他的女儿埃莱奥诺尔收藏矿物，后来由伊格纳茨·冯·博恩编目。

en: Adam František Kollár (1718–1783) was a Slovak scholar and a central intellectual of Maria Theresa's enlightened reforms. Educated by the Jesuits at Trnava and Vienna, he left the order after completing his studies. In 1748 he joined the Imperial Court Library as a scribe and began teaching classical Greek at the University of Vienna. He became chief librarian in 1774 and served on the court education commission. A linguist at home in more than twenty languages, he wrote works of history and law that underpinned the empress's centralizing policy; his arguments in 1772 for her apostolic rights over Hungary helped justify the Habsburg acquisition of Galicia. In 1783 he gave the first definition of the discipline he named ethnology.
zh: 亚当·弗朗齐歇克·科拉尔（1718—1783）是斯洛伐克学者，也是玛丽亚·特蕾西亚开明改革的核心智囊。他在特尔纳瓦和维也纳接受耶稣会教育，完成学业后离开修会。1748年，他以抄写员身份进入帝国宫廷图书馆，并开始在维也纳大学教授古希腊语。1774年他升任馆长，并在宫廷教育委员会任职。他通晓二十余种语言，所著史学与法学著作为女皇的中央集权政策提供理论支撑；1772年他论证女皇对匈牙利的使徒王权，为哈布斯堡取得加利西亚提供依据。1783年，他为自己命名的“民族学”给出了第一个定义。

en: Klemens von Metternich (1773–1859) was an Austrian statesman and diplomat, foreign minister and chancellor. Born in Koblenz, the son of a Rhenish diplomat, he studied at Strasbourg and Mainz. After serving Austria as envoy to Saxony, Prussia and Napoleonic France, he became foreign minister in 1809, arranged Napoleon's marriage to Archduchess Marie Louise, then brought Austria into the War of the Sixth Coalition. He led the Austrian delegation at the Congress of Vienna in 1814–1815 and, as chancellor from 1821, shaped the conservative Concert of Europe. Opposed to liberalism, he used censorship and a network of spies to suppress unrest at home. The 1848 revolutions forced him from office; he returned from exile in 1851 and died in Vienna in 1859.
zh: 克莱门斯·冯·梅特涅（1773—1859）是奥地利政治家和外交家，曾任外交大臣与首相。他生于科布伦茨，父亲是莱茵地区的外交官，曾在斯特拉斯堡和美因茨求学。他历任奥地利驻萨克森、普鲁士和拿破仑法国的使节，1809年出任外交大臣，一手安排了拿破仑与奥地利女大公玛丽·路易丝的婚事，随后又使奥地利加入第六次反法同盟。1814至1815年，他率领奥地利代表团出席维也纳会议；1821年起任首相，主导保守的欧洲协调体系。他反对自由主义，在国内利用审查制度和间谍网络压制动荡。1848年革命迫使他下台；他于1851年结束流亡回国，1859年在维也纳去世。

en: Joseph Radetzky von Radetz (1766–1858) was a Bohemian-born Austrian field marshal. Orphaned young and schooled at Vienna's Theresa Academy, he entered the army as a cadet in 1784 and fought against the Ottomans and in the Napoleonic Wars. He was present at the siege of Belgrade during the Ottoman war and served in the Austrian Netherlands from 1792 to 1795. As chief of the general staff he helped plan the allied victory at Leipzig in 1813, and later drove reforms of the Austrian army. In the 1848–1849 Italian war he defeated Sardinia-Piedmont at Custoza and Novara, and his soldiers called him Father Radetzky; Johann Strauss I wrote the Radetzky March to celebrate Custoza. He died in Milan in 1858.
zh: 约瑟夫·拉德茨基·冯·拉德茨（1766—1858）是生于波希米亚的奥地利陆军元帅。他自幼父母双亡，在维也纳特雷西亚军校学习，1784年以学员身份入伍，先后参加奥土战争与拿破仑战争。奥土战争期间他参加了贝尔格莱德围城，1792至1795年在奥属尼德兰服役。任总参谋长期间，他参与筹划1813年莱比锡会战的联军胜利，战后推动奥地利陆军改革。1848至1849年的意大利战争中，他在库斯托扎和诺瓦拉击败撒丁-皮埃蒙特军队，被士兵称为‘拉德茨基老爹’；老约翰·施特劳斯为庆祝库斯托扎大捷创作了《拉德茨基进行曲》。1858年他在米兰去世。

en: Nicolò Pacassi (1716–1790) was an Italian-Austrian architect of the late Baroque and early classicism. Born in Wiener Neustadt to a merchant family from Gorizia, he succeeded Jean Nicolas Jadot as head of the court building office in 1753 and became Maria Theresa's chief court architect. From 1756 he was also a professor at Rome's Accademia di San Luca. He led the remodelling of Schönbrunn Palace, designed the ballroom wing of the Vienna Hofburg and rebuilt parts of Prague Castle, with further commissions in Innsbruck, Buda and Gorizia. Knighted in 1764 and raised to baron in 1769, he left the building office at his own request in 1772 and remained an adviser until his death in Vienna.
zh: 尼科洛·帕卡西（1716—1790）是巴洛克晚期至早期古典主义时期的意大利裔奥地利建筑师。他生于维也纳新城，家族是来自戈里齐亚的商人家庭。1753年，他接替让·尼古拉·雅多出任宫廷营造署主管，成为玛丽亚·特蕾西亚的首席宫廷建筑师。自1756年起，他还担任罗马圣卢卡学院教授。他主持改建美泉宫，设计维也纳霍夫堡的歌舞厅翼楼，并重建布拉格城堡的部分区域，还在因斯布鲁克、布达和戈里齐亚等地承接工程。他于1764年受封骑士，1769年晋封男爵，1772年应自己的请求离开营造署，此后担任顾问直至在维也纳去世。

en: John of Viktring (c. 1270–1345/1347) was elected abbot of the Cistercian monastery of Viktring near Klagenfurt in 1312. He served as chaplain and confidential secretary to Duke Henry of Carinthia, and in 1330 accompanied King John of Bohemia from Innsbruck across the Brenner Pass to Trent. After Henry's death in 1335 he pleaded the claims of Margaret of Tyrol at Linz before Emperor Louis IV, only for the Habsburg dukes to seize Carinthia. He then advised Dukes Albert II and Otto in Vienna until 1341, when he retired to his abbey and wrote the six-book chronicle Liber certarum historiarum, covering 1217–1343. He also served as chaplain to Patriarch Bertram of Aquileia.
zh: 约翰·冯·维克特林（约1270—1345/1347）于1312年当选为克拉根福附近维克特林西多会修道院院长。他任克恩滕公爵海因里希的宫廷神父与机要秘书，1330年随波希米亚国王约翰的军队从因斯布鲁克翻越布伦纳山口，前往特伦托。1335年海因里希去世后，他在林茨向皇帝路易四世陈情，为蒂罗尔的玛格丽特争取继承权，但克恩滕最终被哈布斯堡公爵夺取。此后他在维也纳为阿尔布雷希特二世与奥托两位公爵顾问，直到1341年退回修道院，撰写六卷本编年史《确凿史事》，记述1217至1343年的史事。他也曾担任阿奎莱亚宗主教贝特兰的神父。

en: Theophrastus von Hohenheim, called Paracelsus (1493–1541), was born at Einsiedeln in the Swiss canton of Schwyz, the son of a physician who taught him medicine and mineralogy. He took his doctorate at Ferrara around 1516 and travelled across Europe as an army surgeon. In 1526 he was called to Basel to treat the printer Johann Froben; there he also exchanged letters on medicine and theology with Erasmus. Appointed town physician in 1527, he lectured in German and publicly burned the standard medical texts of Avicenna. Rejecting classical authority in favour of observation and experiment, he pioneered chemical remedies and the study of poisons, later writing the Great Surgery. He died at Salzburg in 1541, leaving a movement, Paracelsianism, that transformed Renaissance medicine.
zh: 特奥夫拉斯图斯·冯·霍恩海姆，人称帕拉塞尔苏斯（1493—1541），生于瑞士施维茨州的艾恩西德尔恩，父亲是医生，曾教他医学与矿物学。他约1516年在费拉拉取得医学博士学位，后在欧洲游历、充任军医。1526年，他应召到巴塞尔为印刷商约翰·弗罗本治病；他还在当地与伊拉斯谟通信，讨论医学与神学。1527年他受聘为巴塞尔城市医生，用德语讲学，并当众焚毁阿维森纳的医学典籍。他摒弃古典权威，主张观察与实验，首倡用化学药物治病、系统研究毒物，后著有《大外科》。1541年他卒于萨尔茨堡，其学说形成帕拉塞尔苏斯主义，深刻改变了文艺复兴时期的医学。

en: Oswald von Wolkenstein (1376/1377–1445), born at Pfalzen near Brixen in Tyrol, was one of the finest German poets and composers of the later Middle Ages. As a youth he served as a squire for fourteen years, travelling as far as Crete, Lithuania, Crimea, Turkey and the Holy Land, journeys he recalled in autobiographical songs. After quarrelling with his brother over their inheritance, he received a share of Hauenstein Castle in 1407 but occupied the whole castle. From 1414 he served Emperor Sigismund as a diplomat, visiting England, Scotland and Portugal and joining the capture of Ceuta. He married Margarete von Schwangau in 1417 and fought in Tyrol's noble wars against Duke Frederick IV, who held him captive in 1421–1422. He died at Meran in 1445.
zh: 奥斯瓦尔德·冯·沃尔肯施泰因（1376/1377—1445）生于蒂罗尔布里克森附近的普法尔岑，是中世纪晚期最杰出的德语诗人和作曲家之一。他少年时给一名游侠骑士当侍从，十四年间远游至克里特、立陶宛、克里米亚、土耳其和圣地，后来把这些经历写入自传体歌曲。他与兄长争夺遗产，1407年分得豪恩施泰因城堡的一部分，却占据了整座城堡。1414年起他作为外交官效力皇帝西吉斯蒙德，曾出使英格兰、苏格兰和葡萄牙，并参加攻取休达。他1417年娶玛格丽特·冯·施万高，在蒂罗尔卷入贵族对抗公爵腓特烈四世的战争，1421至1422年被公爵囚禁。1445年他卒于梅拉诺。

en: Petrus Zwicker was a Celestine monk and inquisitor born at Wormditt in East Prussia. He served as school rector at Zittau in Upper Lusatia until 1381, when he entered the Celestine monastery on the Oybin; by 1395 he was its prior and provincial of the Celestines in Germany. From 1390 he was entrusted with pursuing heretics, and between 1391 and his death in Vienna in 1403 he directed one of the largest inquisitorial campaigns of the later Middle Ages, ranging through Austria, Pomerania, Brandenburg and Hungary and aimed almost entirely at the Waldensians.
zh: 彼得·茨维克是西莱斯庭会修士和宗教裁判官，生于东普鲁士的沃尔姆迪特。1381年以前他在上卢萨蒂亚的齐陶担任校长，同年进入奥伊宾山上的西莱斯庭会修道院；至迟到1395年，他已任该院院长兼德国西莱斯庭会省会长。1390年起他受命追捕异端，1391年至1403年在维也纳去世为止，他主持了中世纪晚期规模最大的异端裁判行动之一，足迹遍及奥地利、波美拉尼亚、勃兰登堡和匈牙利，矛头几乎全部指向韦尔多派。

en: Niklas Türing the Elder was a late-Gothic stonemason, sculptor and master builder whose family came from Memmingen in Swabia. Around 1480 Duke Sigmund of Tyrol brought him from the Allgäu to Innsbruck, and Emperor Maximilian I later named him court master builder. For Maximilian, who took over the Tyrolean regency in 1490, he and his son Gregor built the famous Golden Roof oriel in 1497–1500 and carved its figural and heraldic reliefs. He also made the castle giant Haidl for the Burgriesenhaus in Innsbruck, and shields of arms at Tratzberg Castle and the Münzertor in Hall. He died at Innsbruck in 1517.
zh: 老尼克拉斯·图林是哥特晚期的石匠、雕刻家兼建筑师，家族出自施瓦本的梅明根。约1480年，蒂罗尔公爵西吉斯蒙德把他从阿尔高召到因斯布鲁克，后来皇帝马克西米利安一世任命他为宫廷建筑总管。马克西米利安于1490年接掌蒂罗尔的统治，图林与儿子格雷戈尔于1497至1500年为他建造了著名的“金屋顶”凸窗，并雕刻了上面的人物与纹章浮雕。他还为因斯布鲁克的城堡巨人屋制作了城堡巨人海德尔，并为特拉茨贝格城堡和哈尔铸币门制作纹章盾。1517年他在因斯布鲁克去世。

en: Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina (c. 1525–1594) was an Italian composer, leading figure of the Roman School of Renaissance polyphony. Born near Rome in Palestrina, he served as organist at its cathedral from 1544 to 1551. Pope Julius III then made him maestro di cappella of the Cappella Giulia at St Peter's. His first book of Masses, published in 1554, was dedicated to Julius. Dismissed in 1555 because, as a married layman, he could not serve in Paul IV's all-clerical choir, he directed music at St John Lateran and Santa Maria Maggiore before rejoining St Peter's in 1571. His more than 105 masses and 250 motets helped establish a model for later sacred counterpoint.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/乔瓦尼·皮耶路易吉·达·帕莱斯特里纳
zh: 乔瓦尼·皮耶路易吉·达·帕莱斯特里纳（约1525—1594）是意大利作曲家，文艺复兴复调音乐罗马乐派的代表人物。他出生于罗马附近的帕莱斯特里纳，1544至1551年担任当地大教堂的管风琴师。此后教宗尤利乌斯三世任命他为圣彼得大教堂朱利亚礼拜堂乐长。他于1554年出版的第一部弥撒曲集献给了尤利乌斯。1555年，因身为已婚俗人，无法在教宗保禄四世只收神职人员的唱诗班任职，他被迫去职，此后先后主持拉特朗圣若望大殿和圣母大殿的音乐事务，1571年回到圣彼得大教堂。他作有超过105首弥撒曲和250首经文歌，其对位法成为后世宗教音乐的典范。

en: Pieter Bruegel the Elder (c. 1525–1569) was a leading Flemish painter and printmaker of the Northern Renaissance, celebrated for landscapes and peasant scenes. Born near Breda, he became an Antwerp guild master in 1551 and travelled to Italy. By 1552 he had reached Reggio Calabria, and in Rome he met the miniaturist Giulio Clovio. Settling in Antwerp in 1555, he designed prints for publisher Hieronymus Cock before turning to painting. In 1563 he married Mayken Coecke and moved to Brussels, where he died in 1569, leaving two painter sons, Pieter and Jan. His Landscape with the Fall of Icarus (c. 1560) and The Hunters in the Snow (1565) remain among his celebrated works.
zh: 老彼得·勃鲁盖尔（约1525—1569）是北方文艺复兴时期杰出的佛兰德斯画家与版画家，以风景画和农民题材闻名。他出生于布雷达一带，1551年成为安特卫普画师行会的师傅，随后前往意大利游学。1552年时他已抵达雷焦卡拉布里亚，并在罗马结识了细密画家朱利奥·克洛维奥。1555年他定居安特卫普，为出版商希罗尼穆斯·科克设计版画，后来转向绘画。1563年他与迈克·科克结婚，迁居布鲁塞尔，1569年在当地去世，两个儿子小彼得和扬后来都成为画家。《伊卡洛斯坠落的风景》（约1560）和《雪中猎人》（1565）是他的著名作品。

en: Martin Brenner (1548–1616) was prince-bishop of Seckau from 1585, who led the recatholicization of Styria during the Counter-Reformation. Born at Dietenheim in Württemberg and a doctor of theology from Pavia, he was appointed bishop by the Archbishop of Salzburg in 1585 and vicar general of Styria in 1591. From 1600 he headed military-backed commissions that expelled Lutheran preachers, burned Protestant books and forced the people to swear Catholic oaths or emigrate. He reconverted all of Styria within half a year and was called the Apostle of Styria. From 1602 he promoted catechism instruction in reconverted districts; in 1604 he led a campaign in Klagenfurt, preaching and pressing citizens to convert. He resigned his see in 1615 and died at Leibnitz in 1616.
zh: 马丁·布伦纳（1548—1616）1585年起任塞考采邑主教，是反宗教改革时期施蒂利亚重新天主教化的主导者。他出生于符腾堡的迪滕海姆，在帕维亚获得神学博士学位，1585年被萨尔茨堡大主教任命为主教，1591年出任施蒂利亚副主教。1600年起，他率领有军队支持的宗教委员会，驱逐路德宗传教士、焚烧新教书籍，并强迫民众宣誓信奉天主教，否则必须移居。他在半年内完成了整个施蒂利亚的改宗，被称为“施蒂利亚使徒”。1602年起他在重新天主教化的地区推行要理教育；1604年他主持克拉根福的改宗行动，讲道并督促市民改信。1615年他辞去主教之职，1616年卒于莱布尼茨。

en: Maximilian von und zu Trauttmansdorff (1584–1650) was an Austrian statesman born in Graz. After studying law at Padua, Siena and Perugia, he joined the Aulic Council in 1609 and became a key diplomat for Ferdinand II from 1618. He arranged the emperor's alliance with Bavaria in 1619, concluded the Peace of Nikolsburg with Gabriel Bethlen in 1621 and was raised count in 1623. From 1633 he was Obersthofmeister and closest adviser to Ferdinand III, negotiating the Peace of Prague in 1635. As head of the imperial delegation at Westphalia, he was a chief architect of the Peace of Westphalia. In 1648 he persuaded Ferdinand to accept peace without Spain's involvement or military support.
zh: 马克西米利安·冯·特劳特曼斯多夫（1584—1650）是生于格拉茨的奥地利政治家。他曾在帕多瓦、锡耶纳和佩鲁贾学习法律，1609年进入帝国枢密院，1618年后成为斐迪南二世倚重的外交官。1619年他促成皇帝与巴伐利亚的同盟，1621年与拜特伦·加博尔签订《尼科尔斯堡和约》，1623年受封伯爵。1633年起他担任后来的斐迪南三世的宫廷总管兼首席顾问，1635年谈成《布拉格和约》。作为威斯特伐利亚和会上的帝国代表团团长，他是《威斯特伐利亚和约》的主要缔造者之一。1648年，他说服斐迪南在西班牙不参与、也不提供军事支持的情况下接受和约。

en: Franz Seraph von Dietrichstein (1570–1636) was a Habsburg cardinal, Bishop of Olomouc and the first Prince of Dietrichstein. Born in Madrid to an imperial diplomat, he was made cardinal in 1599 and, as Bishop of Olomouc from 1600, led the Counter-Reformation in Moravia. President of the Privy Council from 1607, he crowned Matthias and Ferdinand II kings of Bohemia in 1611 and 1617. Exiled by the rebel estates in 1619, he returned after White Mountain as governor of Moravia and promoted its reconversion. In 1622 he served as a judge against the rebels. Raised to hereditary imperial prince in 1624, he named his nephew Maximilian as his heir and died at Brno in 1636.
zh: 方济各·塞拉夫·冯·迪特里希施泰因（1570—1636）是哈布斯堡的枢机主教、奥洛穆茨主教，也是迪特里希施泰因家族的第一位亲王。他出生于马德里，父亲是帝国外交官，1599年受封枢机，1600年起任奥洛穆茨主教，领导摩拉维亚的反宗教改革。1607年起任枢密院主席，先后于1611年和1617年为马蒂亚斯和斐迪南二世加冕为波希米亚国王。1619年他被叛乱的等级驱逐，白山战役后以摩拉维亚总督身份返回，推行当地的重新天主教化。1622年他参与审判叛乱者。1624年他被升为世袭帝国亲王，指定侄子马克西米利安为继承人，1636年卒于布尔诺。

en: Gerhard von Questenberg (c. 1586–1646) was an imperial diplomat and statesman of the Thirty Years' War, born in Cologne. A privy councillor to Ferdinand II and vice-president of the Court War Council, he bought confiscated lordships at Jarmeritz in Moravia in 1623 and Petschau in Bohemia in 1624, and was made a baron in 1627. One of the few councillors trusted by Wallenstein, he was chosen with Verda at the 1630 Regensburg Diet to deliver the general's dismissal at Memmingen. They negotiated his reinstatement in 1632; Questenberg mediated between him and the court until his murder in 1634. In 1636 he became imperial regent over the two Austrias and Hungary, dying in Vienna in 1646.
zh: 格哈德·冯·奎斯滕贝格（约1586—1646）是三十年战争时期的帝国外交家与政治家，出生于科隆。他任斐迪南二世的枢密顾问兼宫廷战争委员会副主席，1623年购入摩拉维亚的雅罗米日采领地，1624年购入波希米亚的佩绍夫领地，二者均是被没收的产业；1627年他受封男爵。他是少数得到华伦斯坦信任的顾问之一，1630年在雷根斯堡会议上与韦尔达一同受命，赴梅明根向这位统帅传达解职令。1632年二人又谈判其复职，奎斯滕贝格在华伦斯坦与宫廷之间斡旋，直到他于1634年遇刺。1636年奎斯滕贝格出任上、下奥地利及匈牙利的帝国摄政，1646年卒于维也纳。

en: Johann Baptist Verda, Baron von Verdenberg from 1623 (c. 1582–1648), was an imperial diplomat, the first court chancellor for Upper, Inner and Lower Austria, and confidant of Ferdinand II. Educated by the Jesuits in Graz with a law doctorate from Pavia, he entered Ferdinand's service in 1607 and became court chancellor in 1619, helping draft Bohemia's absolutist constitution after White Mountain. During the Thirty Years' War he negotiated with Wallenstein in 1630 and delivered his dismissal, later negotiating his reinstatement. He also helped negotiate with Saxony towards the Peace of Prague of 1635 and undertook an unsuccessful mission to England in 1636. Resigning at Ferdinand's death in 1637, he died in Vienna in 1648.
zh: 约翰·巴蒂斯特·韦尔达（约1582—1648）1623年受封韦尔登贝格男爵，是帝国外交官、首任统管上奥地利、内奥地利和下奥地利的宫廷首相，也是斐迪南二世的亲信。他在格拉茨的耶稣会学校受教育，在帕维亚取得法学博士学位，1607年进入斐迪南麾下任职，1619年出任宫廷首相，参与起草白山战役后波希米亚新的专制宪法。三十年战争期间，他于1630年与华伦斯坦谈判并传达解职令，后来又谈判其复职。他还参与对萨克森的谈判，促成1635年的《布拉格和约》，1636年出使英格兰但未获成功。1637年斐迪南二世去世后他辞去首相之职，1648年卒于维也纳。

en: Nikolaus Esterházy de Galántha (1583–1645) was a Hungarian nobleman born at Galanta and the founder of the wealthy House of Esterházy. Raised a Protestant, he converted to Catholicism and became, with Cardinal Pázmány, a pillar of Habsburg rule in Hungary, fighting the Ottoman occupation and opposing the Protestant princes Gabriel Bethlen and George I Rákóczi. His first marriage brought him wealth and the lordship of Munkács, which he surrendered to Bethlen under the Peace of Nikolsburg in 1622 in exchange for imperial compensation. Matthias II made him baron in 1613 and count of Bereg in 1617; he defeated the Turks on the Nyitra in 1623, and in 1625 Ferdinand II named him Palatine of Hungary, the kingdom's highest office. He received the Golden Fleece in 1626.
zh: 加兰塔的米克洛什·埃施特哈齐（1583—1645）是匈牙利贵族，生于加兰塔，是豪富的埃施特哈齐家族的奠基人。他本在新教家庭长大，后改宗天主教，与彼得·帕兹曼尼枢机并立，成为哈布斯堡统治匈牙利的支柱：他抗击奥斯曼占领，并同新教诸侯拜特伦·加博尔、拉科齐·捷尔吉一世对抗。第一段婚姻给他带来财富与蒙卡奇领地；依照《尼科尔斯堡和约》，他于1622年将蒙卡奇交给拜特伦，并从皇帝处得到补偿。马蒂亚斯于1613年封他为男爵，1617年封他为拜赖格伯爵；1623年他在尼特拉河击败土耳其人，1625年斐迪南二世任命他为匈牙利帕拉蒂尼，即王国的最高官职。1626年他获颁金羊毛勋章。

en: Vilém Slavata of Chlum (1572–1652) was a Bohemian nobleman born near Kutná Hora. Raised in the Unity of the Brethren, he converted to Catholicism in 1597 and served Rudolf II as burgrave of Karlštejn and Matthias as chamberlain of the Bohemian Crown. A firm backer of Ferdinand II, he was the king's viceregent in Prague when Protestant nobles led by Thurn threw him and Jaroslav of Martinice from the castle windows on 23 May 1618. He survived with severe injuries but was arrested. The next year he escaped to Saxony and then Passau. He returned after the White Mountain victory of 1620, became a leading figure in restoring Catholicism, and in 1628 became High Chancellor of Bohemia.
zh: 赫卢姆的维莱姆·斯拉瓦塔（1572—1652）是生于库特纳霍拉附近的波希米亚贵族。他在弟兄合一会的氛围中长大，1597年改宗天主教，曾任鲁道夫二世的卡尔施泰因城堡长官和马蒂亚斯的波希米亚王室内廷侍从长。作为斐迪南二世的坚定支持者，他担任国王在布拉格的摄政；1618年5月23日，图尔恩率领的新教贵族把他和马丁尼茨的雅罗斯拉夫从城堡窗口掷出。他身负重伤却生还，随后被捕；次年他逃往萨克森，再前往帕绍。1620年白山战役获胜后他返回波希米亚，积极推动恢复天主教，1628年出任波希米亚最高大臣。

en: Antonio Cesti (1623–1669), baptised Pietro, was an Italian Baroque composer, tenor and organist, among the most celebrated musicians of his generation. Born at Arezzo, he joined the Franciscans in 1637 but turned to secular music at Volterra, perhaps under Medici influence. His career as a singer and opera composer conflicted with his religious calling, and by 1650 he had been reprimanded. His first operas appeared in Venice in 1651. From 1652 he served Archduke Ferdinand Charles at Innsbruck, where he gave L'Argia for Queen Christina of Sweden and premiered Orontea in 1656. He entered the papal chapel in Rome in 1660 and became vice-Kapellmeister at Vienna in 1666, staging Il pomo d'oro for the court. He died in Florence in 1669.
zh: 安东尼奥·彻斯提（1623—1669），洗礼名彼得罗，是意大利巴洛克作曲家、男高音和管风琴师，也是他那一代最负盛名的音乐家之一。他出生于阿雷佐，1637年加入方济各会，后来在沃尔泰拉转向世俗音乐，或许受到美第奇家族的影响。他的歌唱与歌剧创作生涯和修士身份发生冲突，至1650年已受到训诫。1651年他的首批歌剧在威尼斯上演。1652年起他在因斯布鲁克侍奉奥地利大公斐迪南·卡尔，在那里为瑞典女王克里斯蒂娜的到访演出《阿尔吉亚》，并于1656年首演《奥龙泰阿》。1660年他进入罗马的教宗合唱团，1666年出任维也纳副乐长，为宫廷上演《金苹果》。1669年他在佛罗伦萨去世。

en: Franz Grillparzer (1791–1872) was an Austrian writer, born in Vienna and regarded as Austria's leading nineteenth-century dramatist. He studied law at the University of Vienna; after his father's death left the family in difficulty, he worked as a private tutor. From 1813 he earned his living as a civil servant, directing the Hofkammer archives from 1832 until his retirement in 1856. His verse plays, shaped by classical drama and often staged at the Burgtheater, include Sappho, the Medea trilogy and his 1825 tragedy of the Bohemian king, König Ottokars Glück und Ende. He wrote Beethoven's funeral oration in 1827 and Schubert's epitaph. After his only comedy was rejected by the public in 1840, he nearly passed from his contemporaries' memory.
zh: 弗朗茨·格里帕泽（1791—1872）是奥地利作家，生于维也纳，被视为19世纪奥地利首屈一指的剧作家。他曾在维也纳大学攻读法律；父亲去世后家境艰难，他做过家庭教师。1813年起他以公务员为业，1832年任宫廷财务署档案主管，直至1856年退休。他的诗剧受古典戏剧影响颇深，常在城堡剧院上演，代表作包括《萨福》、美狄亚三部曲以及1825年以波希米亚国王普热米斯尔·奥托卡二世为主角的悲剧《奥托卡王的兴衰》。1827年他为贝多芬的葬礼撰写悼词，还为舒伯特撰写了墓志铭。1840年他唯一的喜剧遭观众冷遇后，他几乎被同时代人遗忘。

en: Johann Anton von Pergen (1725–1814) was a Habsburg diplomat and statesman whose career spanned four monarchs. A Jesuit-educated lawyer, he served as imperial envoy at Mainz and administered the occupied western territories during the Seven Years' War. In 1766 he became a State Council vice-chancellor and Kaunitz's deputy, though he opposed Kaunitz's expansive imperial policy. In 1770 he drafted an education reform proposing state control of schools and the replacement of Jesuit teachers by laymen. As a minister under Joseph II he centralized the police and built up a secret police to enforce the emperor's radical reforms; after 1792 he returned under Francis II to suppress opposition.
zh: 约翰·安东·冯·佩尔根（1725—1814）是历仕四位君主的哈布斯堡外交家与政治家。他早年受耶稣会教育、学习法律，曾任帝国驻美因茨使节，七年战争期间治理西部被占领的地区。1766年，他出任国务院副首相兼考尼茨的副手，但反对考尼茨扩张性的帝国政策。1770年他起草教育改革方案，主张将学校置于国家管理之下，以世俗教师取代耶稣会士。作为约瑟夫二世手下的大臣，他把警察系统中央集权化，并建立秘密警察以推行皇帝的激进改革；1792年后他在弗朗茨二世治下复出，负责镇压反对势力。

en: Primož Trubar (1508–1586) was born at Rašica in the Duchy of Carniola and, after schooling in Salzburg and Trieste under Bishop Pietro Bonomo, served as a preacher in Ljubljana from 1530, where he gradually embraced Lutheran teaching until his expulsion in 1547. In exile at Rothenburg he wrote the first books ever printed in Slovene, the Catechismus and Abecedarium of 1550, published at Schwäbisch Hall. The speech of Ljubljana became the foundation of his written language. As the first superintendent of the Carniolan Protestant Church he published his Slovene translation of the whole New Testament in three parts by 1577. He wrote twenty-two books in Slovene, helping to establish its literary language, and died at Derendingen in 1586.
zh: 普里莫日·特鲁巴尔（1508—1586）生于卡尼奥拉公国的拉希察，曾在萨尔茨堡和的里雅斯特求学，在后者受主教彼得罗·博诺莫指导。1530年起他在卢布尔雅那任布道神父，逐渐接受路德宗主张，1547年被逐出城。流亡罗滕堡期间，他写成最早的斯洛文尼亚文印刷书籍，即1550年在施韦比施哈尔印行的《教理问答》和《识字课本》。他以卢布尔雅那的口语为书面语言的基础。作为卡尼奥拉新教教会的首任总监，他到1577年分三部分出版了完整的斯洛文尼亚语《新约》译本。他一生著有二十二部斯洛文尼亚文著作，帮助奠定了斯洛文尼亚书面语的基础，1586年卒于德伦丁根。

en: Johann Friedrich Böhmer (1795–1863) was a German historian and archivist born in Frankfurt am Main, the son of a Palatine official. After law studies at Heidelberg and Göttingen and time in Italy with the Nazarene painters, he returned to Frankfurt in 1822 and through Baron vom Stein became secretary to the Monumenta Germaniae Historica in 1824. Appointed city archivist in 1825 and city librarian in 1830, he launched the Regesta Imperii, a calendar of charters issued by the German kings and emperors. The work made him a pioneer of diplomatics, the critical study of charters. He disliked Prussia and Protestantism and favoured Austria and Catholicism, though he was not a Catholic.
zh: 约翰·弗里德里希·伯默尔（1795—1863）是德国历史学家、档案学家，生于美因河畔法兰克福，父亲是普法尔茨官员。他曾在海德堡、哥廷根攻读法律，后旅居意大利，与拿撒勒画派的画家交游，1822年回到法兰克福；经施泰因男爵引介，他于1824年出任《日耳曼历史文献》中央指导机构秘书。他1825年任法兰克福城市档案管理员，1830年任城市图书馆长，并启动《帝国文献汇编》，按年代整理历代德意志国王与皇帝颁布的宪章，由此成为以考订文献为务的古文书学先驱。他厌恶普鲁士和新教，倾向奥地利和天主教，但自己并非天主教徒。

en: Johann Strauss I (1804–1849) was an Austrian composer born in Leopoldstadt. Orphaned young and apprenticed to a bookbinder, he learned the violin, played in Joseph Lanner's orchestra and founded his own band in 1825. His Little Doves Waltz established his reputation at the Vienna carnival in 1826. His waltzes, polkas and galops made Vienna dance, and his tours took him across Germany, France, Belgium, the Netherlands and Britain. After hearing the quadrille in France in 1837, he composed his own and helped introduce the dance to Austria. With Lanner he transformed the waltz into a Viennese institution, earning the nickname Father of the Waltz and paving the way for his sons Johann, Josef and Eduard. His best-known work was the Radetzky March of 1848.
zh: 老约翰·施特劳斯（1804—1849）是奥地利作曲家，生于利奥波德城。他自幼父母双亡，曾给装订商当学徒，靠学习小提琴进入约瑟夫·兰纳的乐队，1825年自组乐队。1826年，他的《小鸽子圆舞曲》在维也纳狂欢节上为他赢得声誉。他的圆舞曲、波尔卡和加洛普让整个维也纳翩然起舞，还率乐队巡演德国、法国、比利时、荷兰和英国。1837年在法国听到四对舞曲后，他开始创作这类舞曲，帮助将四对舞引入奥地利。他与兰纳一道把圆舞曲发展成维也纳的标志，赢得‘圆舞曲之父’的称号，也为儿子小约翰、约瑟夫和爱德华开辟了道路。1848年创作的《拉德茨基进行曲》是他最著名的作品。

en: Marianna Martines (1744–1812) was an Austrian composer, pianist and singer in Classical Vienna. She grew up in her family's Vienna home, where the poet Metastasio lived and oversaw her education. He arranged a general education more extensive than was customary for women of her social class. She studied keyboard with the young Joseph Haydn, singing with Nicola Porpora and composition with Hasse and Bonno; Haydn and Porpora lived in the same building as her family. She performed often before Empress Maria Theresa, and her Italian-style masses, motets, cantatas and oratorios to Metastasio's texts won wide esteem; her third mass was sung at St. Michael's Church in 1761. In 1773 she became the first woman admitted to Bologna's Accademia Filarmonica, and her later home concerts were attended by Haydn and Mozart.
zh: 玛丽安娜·马丁内斯（1744—1812）是维也纳古典主义时期的奥地利作曲家、钢琴家与歌唱家。她在维也纳的家中长大，诗人梅塔斯塔西奥与她的家人同住，并督导她的教育。他为她安排的普通教育超过了当时同阶层女性通常接受的程度。她随年轻的约瑟夫·海顿学习键盘、随尼古拉·波尔波拉学习声乐，并随哈塞与博诺学习作曲；海顿和波尔波拉都与她家住在同一座楼里。她常为玛丽亚·特蕾西亚女皇演奏演唱，所作意大利风格的弥撒、经文歌、康塔塔及采用梅塔斯塔西奥脚本的清唱剧广受赞誉；她的第三部弥撒于1761年在圣米迦勒教堂演出。1773年，她成为首位入选博洛尼亚爱乐学院的女性，晚年家中的音乐聚会常有海顿和莫扎特出席。

en: Antonio Salieri (1750–1825) was an Italian composer born in Legnago, south of Verona in the Republic of Venice, who spent his career in Habsburg Vienna. Taken there as an orphaned pupil of Florian Leopold Gassmann and later patronised by Gluck, he directed the court Italian opera from 1774 to 1792 and served as imperial Kapellmeister from 1788 to 1824, responsible for music at the court chapel and its school. He also wrote for opera houses in Paris, Rome and Venice. His operas, written in Italian, French and German, were performed across Europe, and he taught Beethoven, Schubert, Liszt and Hummel. He wrote no operas after 1804; he vehemently denied rumours that he had poisoned Mozart.
zh: 安东尼奥·萨列里（1750—1825）是意大利作曲家，生于威尼斯共和国维罗纳以南的莱尼亚戈，一生事业都在哈布斯堡王朝的维也纳度过。他幼年父母双亡，被作曲家弗洛里安·利奥波德·加斯曼带到维也纳培养，后又受到格鲁克提携；1774至1792年主持宫廷意大利歌剧院，1788至1824年任宫廷乐长，负责宫廷礼拜堂及其学校的音乐。他也为巴黎、罗马和威尼斯的歌剧院创作。他用意、法、德三种语言创作的歌剧曾在欧洲各地上演，学生包括贝多芬、舒伯特、李斯特和胡梅尔。1804年后他不再创作歌剧；关于他毒杀莫扎特的传闻，他本人坚决否认。

en: Hugo Grotius (1583–1645), born at Delft, was a Dutch humanist jurist and a child prodigy who entered Leiden University at eleven. In 1598 he accompanied Johan van Oldenbarnevelt on a diplomatic mission to Paris, and the following year became an advocate at The Hague. His Mare Liberum of 1609 argued that the sea was open to all nations, challenging Portuguese claims to exclusive trade in Asian waters. Drawn into the Republic's religious conflicts on the Arminian side, he was imprisoned in Loevestein Castle after 1618 and escaped in 1621 hidden in a chest of books. In Paris he published De jure belli ac pacis in 1625, a foundation of modern international law. From 1634 he served Sweden as ambassador to France, and after being shipwrecked died at Rostock in 1645.
zh: 胡果·格劳秀斯（1583—1645）生于代尔夫特，是荷兰人文主义法学家，自幼有神童之名，十一岁便进入莱顿大学。1598年他随约翰·范·奥尔登巴讷费尔特出使巴黎，次年成为海牙律师。他在1609年发表的《海洋自由论》主张海洋向各国开放，挑战葡萄牙在亚洲海域的贸易独占权主张。因卷入共和国的宗教冲突、站在阿民念派一边，他于1618年后被囚禁在勒文斯泰因城堡，1621年藏在书箱中逃脱。他在巴黎于1625年出版《战争与和平法》，为现代国际法奠定了基础。1634年起他出任瑞典驻法国大使，后遇海难，1645年于罗斯托克去世。

en: Christiaan Huygens (1629–1695) was a Dutch mathematician, astronomer and physicist, born in The Hague, the second son of Constantijn Huygens, diplomat and adviser to the House of Orange. He studied law and mathematics at Leiden from 1645. Grinding lenses with his brother, he built powerful telescopes, discovered Saturn's largest moon, Titan, in 1655 and explained Saturn's appearance as the effect of a thin flat ring. In 1657 he patented the pendulum clock, and in 1659 he derived a formula for centrifugal force. His Horologium Oscillatorium of 1673 laid the foundations of dynamics. His Traité de la Lumière of 1690 set out the wave theory of light and the principle later named after him.
zh: 克里斯蒂安·惠更斯（1629—1695）是荷兰数学家、天文学家和物理学家，生于海牙，是奥兰治家族顾问、外交官康斯坦丁·惠更斯的次子。他自1645年起在莱顿学习法律与数学。他与兄长一同磨制镜片、制造高倍望远镜，于1655年发现土星最大的卫星土卫六，并解释土星的奇特外观来自一层薄而平的光环。1657年他取得摆钟专利，1659年推导出离心力公式。1673年的《摆钟论》奠定了动力学的基础。1690年的《光论》提出光的波动说，书中的原理后来以他命名。

en: Gerardus Mercator (1512–1594), born Gerard de Kremer in Rupelmonde, Flanders, was a Flemish cartographer, globe-maker and cosmographer. Trained in Leuven by Gemma Frisius, he won fame with a map of the Holy Land in 1537, his first world map in 1538 and a map of Flanders in 1539–1540. Arrested for Protestant heresy in 1543, he was jailed seven months and in 1552 moved to tolerant Duisburg, where he became ducal cosmographer. His world map of 1569 introduced the projection that still bears his name, drawing constant compass bearings as straight lines for navigation. Besides maps, he produced globes and scientific instruments; his Atlas was published posthumously in 1595.
zh: 格拉杜斯·墨卡托（1512—1594），本名赫拉德·德·克雷默，出生于佛兰德斯的吕佩尔蒙德，是佛兰德斯地图学家、地球仪制作家和宇宙志学者。他在鲁汶随赫马·弗里修斯学艺，1537年以圣地地图成名，1538年出版第一幅世界地图，1539至1540年绘制佛兰德斯地图。1543年他因被控倾向新教异端入狱七个月，1552年迁居宗教宽容的杜伊斯堡，担任公爵的宫廷宇宙志学者。他1569年的世界地图采用了至今以他命名的投影法，将恒定罗盘方位画为直线，便于航海。除地图外，他还制作地球仪和科学仪器；其《地图集》于1595年在他死后出版。

en: Johan de Witt (1625–1672) was a Dutch statesman born at Dordrecht. Trained in law and mathematics at Leiden, he became Grand Pensionary of Holland in 1653 and, with Cornelis de Graeff, dominated the Republic through its Stadtholderless Golden Age. A leading republican, he opposed the House of Orange and favoured shifting power to the regents of the provinces. In 1667 the Dutch raid on the Medway humiliated England, and he carried an act barring the House of Orange from the stadtholderate. In the Rampjaar of 1672 the Republic suffered defeats against an alliance including France and England; French armies invaded and advanced rapidly. De Witt was stabbed in June, resigned in August, and on the 20th was lynched with his brother Cornelis by an Orangist mob in The Hague.
zh: 约翰·德·维特（1625—1672）是荷兰政治家，生于多德雷赫特。他在莱顿学习法律与数学，1653年出任荷兰省大议长，与科内利斯·德·赫拉夫共同在无执政的黄金时代主导共和国政务。作为共和派领袖，他反对奥兰治家族，主张将权力转交各省的摄政阶层。1667年，荷兰舰队突袭梅德韦河，羞辱了英国，他又推动通过法案，禁止奥兰治家族担任执政。1672年的“灾难年”中，共和国在对抗法国、英国等国的联盟时连遭败绩，法军入侵并迅速推进。德·维特在6月遇刺受伤，8月辞职，20日与兄长科内利斯一同在海牙被奥兰治派暴民私刑处死。

en: Anthonie Heinsius (1641–1720) was a Dutch statesman born at Delft. After a law doctorate at Orléans in 1662, he became pensionary of Delft in 1679. Sent to Paris in 1682 to protest Louis XIV's seizures in the Principality of Orange, he was threatened with the Bastille and returned a convinced opponent of France. In 1689 he became Grand Pensionary of Holland and was a driving force behind the anti-French coalition in the Nine Years' War. After William III died in 1702, Heinsius became the Republic's main foreign policymaker. During the War of the Spanish Succession he helped direct Grand Alliance strategy with Marlborough and Prince Eugene. He died in office in 1720.
zh: 安东尼·海因修斯（1641—1720）是荷兰政治家，生于代尔夫特。1662年他在奥尔良大学取得法学博士学位，1679年出任代尔夫特市议长。1682年他被派往巴黎，就路易十四侵夺奥兰治亲王国提出抗议，险些被投入巴士底狱，回国后成为法国坚定的反对者。1689年他出任荷兰省大议长，成为九年战争中反法联盟的推动者之一。1702年威廉三世去世后，海因修斯成为共和国外交政策的主要制定者。在西班牙王位继承战争中，他与马尔伯勒、欧根亲王共同制定大联盟战略。1720年他卒于任上。

en: Baruch Spinoza (1632–1677) was a Dutch philosopher born in Amsterdam to a family of Portuguese-Jewish merchants. Raised in the city's Portuguese Jewish congregation, he challenged rabbinic authority and Jewish doctrine and was permanently expelled from it in 1656. He then lived quietly, first at Rijnsburg and later at Voorburg and The Hague, earning a living by grinding lenses. He published sparingly during his lifetime to avoid persecution. His Tractatus Theologico-Politicus questioned the divine origin of the Hebrew Bible and defended freedom of thought in a secular state, while his Ethics, identifying God with nature, was published only after his death. He declined a chair at Heidelberg to guard his independence, and died at The Hague in 1677.
zh: 巴鲁赫·斯宾诺莎（1632—1677）是荷兰哲学家，生于阿姆斯特丹一个葡萄牙犹太商人家庭。他在当地的葡萄牙犹太会社群中长大，因质疑拉比权威与犹太教义，于1656年被永久革出教门。此后他先后在莱茵斯堡、福尔堡和海牙过着平静生活，以磨镜片为生。为避免迫害，他生前很少发表著作。他的《神学政治论》质疑《希伯来圣经》的神圣来源，主张世俗国家中的思想自由；《伦理学》将上帝等同于自然，在他去世后才得以出版。为保持思想独立，他拒绝了海德堡大学的教席，1677年在海牙去世。

en: Johannes Bogerman (1576–1637) was a Frisian Calvinist theologian, born at Upleward in East Frisia, the son of a preacher. From 1591 he studied at Franeker, Heidelberg, Geneva, Oxford and Cambridge, then held Reformed pastorates at Sneek from 1599, Enkhuizen from 1603 and Leeuwarden from 1604. He preached against the Arminians and other religious groups. He was appointed president of the Synod of Dort of 1618–1619, which issued the Canons of Dort and authorized a new Dutch Bible translated from the original languages. Though he held a different view of predestination, he argued that the Canons should accommodate the infralapsarian position. He later helped translate that Statenbijbel, took a theology chair at Franeker in 1636, and died there the following year.
zh: 约翰内斯·博格曼（1576—1637）是弗里斯兰的加尔文派神学家，生于东弗里斯兰的乌普勒瓦尔德，父亲是牧师。1591年起，他先后在弗拉讷克、海德堡、日内瓦、牛津和剑桥求学，随后历任归正会牧师：1599年在斯内克，1603年在恩克赫伊曾，1604年在吕伐登。他在讲道中反对阿民念派及其他宗教群体。他被推举为1618至1619年多德会议的主席，会议通过《多德教规》，并授权从原典语言翻译新的荷兰语圣经。尽管他本人对预定论持不同观点，仍主张教规容纳堕落后预定论。他后来参与了这部《国家圣经》的翻译，1636年出任弗拉讷克神学教授，次年在当地去世。

en: Lodewijk Elzevir (c. 1540–1617) was a printer and publisher born in Leuven in the Habsburg Netherlands. He began as a bookbinder in Christoffel Plantijn's Antwerp workshop and married Maijke de Verdeijen Verbois in 1563. He moved to Wesel before 1570, to Douai before 1575, and settled in Leiden before 1580. In 1583 he produced his first book there, founding the House of Elzevir. Its books favoured sturdy construction and legible type, often in small formats with narrow margins. After his death his sons and grandsons expanded the business, which published Galileo's Two New Sciences when its author could not publish in Italy. The family business continued until 1791.
zh: 洛德韦克·埃尔泽维尔（约1540—1617）是生于哈布斯堡尼德兰鲁汶的印刷商与出版商。他在安特卫普的克里斯托费尔·普朗坦工场以装订匠起家，1563年与迈克·德·韦尔代延·韦尔布瓦结婚。他于1570年前迁往韦瑟尔，1575年前迁往杜埃，1580年前定居莱顿。1583年，他在莱顿印出第一部书，创立了埃尔泽维尔家族印坊。印坊的书注重坚固耐用与字体清晰，常采用小开本和窄页边。他去世后，儿子与孙子扩展了生意，并在伽利略无法于意大利出书时印行了他的《两门新科学》。家族生意延续至1791年。

en: Georg Giese (1497–1562) was a Hanseatic merchant of Danzig, one of the younger sons of the city's mayor Albrecht Giese and brother of Tiedemann Giese, later bishop of Culm. His family traded over long distances and maintained an office at the Steelyard, the Hansa's London trading enclave. From the 1520s he spent at least twelve years in London managing that office, and became the Alderman's Deputy there in 1533. In 1532 Hans Holbein the Younger painted his portrait amid the letters and seals of his counting house. He returned to Danzig in 1535, married Christine Krüger, daughter of a leading merchant, and died there in 1562.
zh: 格奥尔格·吉泽（1497—1562）是但泽的汉萨商人，是该市市长阿尔布雷希特·吉泽年纪较小的儿子之一，日后成为库尔姆主教的蒂德曼·吉泽是他的兄长。他的家族经营远距离贸易，在伦敦的汉萨商站钢院设有商号。自1520年代起，他在伦敦为家族经营这家商号至少十二年，1533年出任钢院市政官副使。1532年，小汉斯·荷尔拜因在他账房里的信件与印鉴之间为他绘制了肖像。1535年他回到但泽，迎娶富商之女克里斯蒂娜·克吕格，1562年在但泽去世。

en: Heinrich Sudermann (1520–1591) was a lawyer from Cologne and the first Syndic of the Hanseatic League. The son of Cologne's mayor Hermann Sudermann, he was elected in 1556 to the newly created post as a permanent official with legal training. He worked to protect and extend the diplomatic agreements of the League's member towns. Revised agreements in 1557 and 1579 set out the towns' obligations and made some progress towards that goal. Sudermann died in Lübeck in 1591.
zh: 海因里希·祖德曼（1520—1591）是来自科隆的法学家，汉萨同盟首任法务官。他的父亲是科隆市长赫尔曼·祖德曼；1556年，他当选为新设法务官职位，成为受过法律训练的常任官员。他致力于维护和扩展同盟各城镇的外交协议。1557年和1579年修订的协议明确了各城镇的义务，使这一工作取得了一定进展。1591年他在吕贝克去世。

en: András Hess (c. 1450–c. 1473) was a printer of German origin who founded the first printing press in the Kingdom of Hungary. In 1471 or 1472 he was summoned from Georg Lauer's workshop in Rome to Buda by Provost László Karai, acting for Archbishop János Vitéz of Esztergom, and with a grant of two thousand silver florins he set up his press in 1472. On 5 June 1473, the eve of Pentecost, he completed the Latin Chronica Hungarorum, or Buda Chronicle, the first book printed in Hungary. No trace of him or his press survives after 1473.
zh: 安德拉什·赫斯（约1450—约1473）是德意志裔印刷师，创办了匈牙利王国第一家印刷所。1471或1472年，他受布达教务长拉斯洛·考劳伊之请、为埃斯泰尔戈姆大主教亚诺什·维泰兹效力，从罗马格奥尔格·劳尔的作坊应召来到布达，并凭两千银弗罗林的资助于1472年开办印刷所。1473年6月5日，即五旬节前夜，他印成拉丁文的《匈牙利编年史》（又称《布达编年史》），这是匈牙利第一部印刷书籍。1473年之后，他本人和印刷所都再无踪迹。

en: Baron Tamás Nádasdy (1498–1562), called the Great Palatine, was a Hungarian statesman and soldier educated at Graz, Bologna and Rome. In 1525 Louis II sent him to the Diet of Speyer to seek help against the Turks, and he returned to learn of the disaster at Mohács. Appointed Ferdinand's commandant of Buda in 1527, he went over to John Zápolya after the city's capture and defended it against imperial troops in 1530. He returned to Ferdinand in 1533 and later defended the southern frontier as Ban of Croatia-Slavonia. In 1540 he became Judge royal, and in 1559 the diet of Pozsony elected him palatine. He founded a school and press at Újsziget and died in 1562.
zh: 男爵陶马什·纳道什迪（1498—1562）人称“伟大的总督”，是匈牙利政治家与军事家，曾在格拉茨、博洛尼亚和罗马求学。1525年，国王拉约什二世派他出席施派尔议会，向各方求援抵御奥斯曼人，他回国时得知摩哈赤惨败的消息。1527年，斐迪南任命他为布达城防司令；布达陷落后，他转投亚诺什·扎波尧伊，1530年守城抵御帝国军队。1533年他重返斐迪南阵营，后任克罗地亚-斯拉沃尼亚总督，守卫南部边境。1540年他出任王国大法官，1559年在波若尼议会上被推举为匈牙利总督。他在乌伊西格特创办学校与印刷所，1562年去世。

en: Count Tamás Erdődy (1558–1624) was a Hungarian-Croatian magnate who succeeded his father-in-law Krsto Ungnad as Ban of Croatia in 1583. He won his first victory over the Ottomans at Slunj in 1584, freed the Moslavina region in 1591, suffered defeat at Brest in 1592, and in 1593 helped crush the Ottoman army at Sisak, a battle that triggered the Long Turkish War; Pope Clement VIII sent him his congratulations. After leaving the banate in 1595, he served as master of the stewards and then master of the treasury. From 1607 he was perpetual count of Varaždin, an office made hereditary in his family. He held the banate again from 1608 to 1615 and died in 1624.
zh: 陶马什·艾尔德迪伯爵（1558—1624）是匈牙利—克罗地亚大贵族，1583年接替岳父克斯托·翁格纳德出任克罗地亚巴昂。他于1584年在斯拉尼首破奥斯曼军队，1591年解放莫斯拉维纳地区，1592年在布雷斯特战败，1593年又在锡萨克之战中协助击溃奥斯曼大军，此役直接引发漫长土耳其战争，教皇克雷芒八世为此向他致贺。1595年卸任巴昂后，他先后担任膳务总管和财政总管。1607年起他成为瓦拉日丁县世袭伯爵，该职位自此由艾尔德迪家族世代承袭。1608至1615年他再度出任巴昂，1624年去世。

en: Janus Pannonius (1434–1472), born in Slavonia, was the leading Hungarian humanist poet of his age and Bishop of Pécs. Sent to Italy in 1447 by his uncle John Vitéz, he studied under Guarino da Verona at Ferrara and canon law at Padua, writing his first classical epigrams before he was fifteen. He returned to Hungary in 1458, the year Matthias Corvinus took the throne, and became royal vice-chancellor and, in 1469, Ban of Slavonia. He maintained ties with leading philosophers and assembled a major humanist library, probably dispersed in 1526. He died at Medvedgrad near Zagreb in 1472.
zh: 亚努斯·潘诺尼乌斯（1434—1472）出生于斯拉沃尼亚，是当时匈牙利最杰出的人文主义诗人，曾任佩奇主教。1447年，他由舅父维特兹·亚诺什送往意大利，在费拉拉师从瓜里诺·达·维罗纳，后在帕多瓦攻读教会法，不满十五岁便写下首批古典体格律警句。1458年，即马加什·科尔温即位之年，他返回匈牙利，官至王室副首相，1469年出任斯拉沃尼亚巴昂。他与著名哲学家保持联系，并搜集了大量人文主义藏书，这批藏书可能于1526年散佚。1472年，他在萨格勒布附近的梅德韦德格勒德城堡去世。

en: Miklós Toldi (c. 1320–1390) was a Hungarian nobleman of Bihar County famed in folklore for superhuman strength. Long thought legendary, royal charters show he served Charles I and Louis I: in 1354 as viscount and castellan of Pozsony County, and in 1383 and 1385 as count of Szabolcs County. As a mercenary captain in Louis the Great's Italian campaigns he brought two lion cubs back from Florence in 1359 at the king's request. He died in 1390.
zh: 米克洛什·托尔迪（约1320—1390）是比豪尔州的匈牙利贵族，在民间传说中以神力闻名。他长期被认为是虚构人物，但王室特许状证明他曾效力查理一世和拉约什一世：1354年任波若尼州副州长兼城堡总管，1383和1385年任索博尔奇州州长。他作为雇佣军队长参加拉约什大帝的意大利战事，1359年应国王之请从佛罗伦萨带回两只幼狮。1390年去世。

en: Mark of Kalt (Hungarian: Márk Kálti; fl. 1336–1368) was a Hungarian Franciscan friar and chronicler born into the lesser nobility of Veszprém County. Chaplain to Queen Elizabeth of Poland in 1336–1337, he was parish priest of St Peter's in Buda in 1342–1352 and provost of Kő in 1353–1354. He has been identified with the guardian of the chapter of Székesfehérvár from 1358, though that identification has been questioned; the guardian last appears in that office in 1368. For Louis I he wrote the Latin Chronicon Pictum in 1358, an illustrated history of Hungary whose 147 miniatures were finished between 1370 and 1373. He likely died before the manuscript was completed.
zh: 马克·卡尔蒂（活动于1336—1368年）是匈牙利方济各会修士、编年史家，出身维斯普雷姆州的小贵族。1336至1337年他任波兰的伊丽莎白王后的宫廷神父，1342至1352年任布达圣彼得堂本堂神父，1353至1354年任克教堂教长。他被认为是1358年起担任塞克什白堡教士团监护的同名者，但这一认定受到质疑；该监护最后一次以此身份见于记载是在1368年。他为拉约什一世于1358年用拉丁文撰写《插图编年史》，这部配图匈牙利史书含147幅细密画，最后一批插图于1370至1373年间完成。他可能在书稿完工前便已去世。

en: Balázs Magyar (c. 1410–c. 1490) was a Hungarian general, a follower of John Hunyadi who became a leading captain of Matthias Corvinus's Black Army. In 1462 he was captain of the Highlands, and from 1470 he guarded the southern marches, serving as Ban of Croatia, Slavonia and Bosnia and as Voivode of Transylvania in 1472–1475, supporting Moldavia against the Ottomans. He fought the Hussites in Bohemia and helped take Veglia in 1479, though the island could not be held against the Venetian fleet. In 1480 he led a force to Italy that recaptured Otranto from the Turks. He retired to western Hungarian estates and died at Kassa in 1490. His daughter Benigna and her husband Pál Kinizsi inherited his property.
zh: 鲍拉日·马扎尔（约1410—约1490）是匈牙利将领，早年追随匈雅提·亚诺什，后来成为马加什·科尔温黑军的主要统帅之一。1462年他任高地地区统领，1470年起守卫南部边疆，历任克罗地亚、斯拉沃尼亚和波斯尼亚总督，并于1472至1475年任特兰西瓦尼亚总督，支持摩尔达维亚抵御奥斯曼人。他曾在波希米亚与胡斯派作战，1479年参加攻取克尔克岛，但该岛未能抵挡威尼斯舰队。1480年他率军前往意大利，从奥斯曼人手中收复奥特朗托。晚年退隐西匈牙利的庄园，1490年在考绍去世。他的女儿贝尼格纳与女婿保尔·基尼日继承了他的财产。

en: Pál Kinizsi (1432–1494) was the most celebrated general of Matthias Corvinus's Black Army, of obscure origins, holder of Nagyvázsony castle from 1472. In October 1479 he and István Báthory won a decisive victory over an Ottoman invasion at the Battle of Breadfield in Transylvania. In the 1480s he founded a Pauline monastery at Nagyvázsony, where he chose to be buried. From 1484 he was Count of Temes and Captain-General of the southern marches, and he never lost a battle in his career. After Matthias died in 1490 he backed Vladislas II, defeated John Corvinus at Bonefield and crushed the Black Army's mutinous remnants. He married Benigna, daughter of Blaise Magyar, suffered a stroke and died in 1494.
zh: 保尔·基尼日（1432—1494）是马加什·科尔温黑军最负盛名的将领，出身不详，1472年起领有大瓦若尼城堡。1479年10月，他与巴托里·伊什特万率军在特兰西瓦尼亚的面包原之战中大破来犯的奥斯曼军队。1480年代，他在大瓦若尼创办了一座保禄会修道院，并选择在那里安葬。1484年起他任泰迈什州伯爵兼南部边疆总兵，平生未尝一败。1490年马加什去世后，他支持乌拉斯洛二世，在骨田之战中击败亚诺什·科尔温，并剿灭了哗变的黑军残部。他娶鲍拉日·马扎尔之女贝尼格纳为妻，后来中风，1494年去世。

en: Johannes Honterus (1498–1549) was a Transylvanian Saxon humanist and Protestant reformer born in Brassó. He took his master of arts degree at Vienna in 1525, and after the Ottoman advance of 1529 worked in Kraków and Basel. In Kraków he published his first books, a Latin grammar and a cosmography manual. At Basel he practiced wood engraving, designed two star maps and printed the first published map of Transylvania, based on information gathered during visits home. Back home from 1533, he ran a printing house and school in Brassó and led the Transylvanian Saxons into the Lutheran Reformation, organizing their Evangelical church. He also published Latin grammars and cosmography textbooks.
zh: 约翰内斯·洪特鲁斯（1498—1549）是特兰西瓦尼亚的撒克逊人文主义者与新教改革家，出生于布拉索。他于1525年在维也纳取得文学硕士学位；1529年奥斯曼军队逼近后，他先后在克拉科夫与巴塞尔工作。在克拉科夫，他出版了最早的两本书，一本拉丁语语法和一本宇宙志。在巴塞尔，他从事木刻版画，绘制了两幅星图，并凭借回乡时收集的资料印行了第一幅出版的特兰西瓦尼亚地图。1533年回乡后，他在布拉索经营印刷厂和学校，带领特兰西瓦尼亚撒克逊人皈依路德宗，组建当地的福音派教会。他还出版了拉丁语语法和宇宙志教科书。

en: Adam František Kollár (1718–1783) was a Slovak jurist, historian and linguist. He joined the Jesuits and studied Hebrew and Middle Eastern languages in Vienna before leaving the order. He entered the Imperial-Royal Library in Vienna as a scribe in 1748 and rose to be its chief librarian from 1774 and an imperial court councillor. A trusted adviser to Empress Maria Theresa, he supplied the historical arguments for her centralist reforms and, in 1772, for enhanced Habsburg claims to Galicia and Dalmatia. His writings on the peoples of the monarchy gave ethnology its first formal definition in 1783, and he is counted among the earliest pan-Slavic writers. He died in Vienna that July.
zh: 亚当·弗朗齐歇克·科拉尔（1718—1783）是斯洛伐克法学家、历史学家与语言学家。他曾加入耶稣会，在维也纳学习希伯来语与中东语言，后来离开修会。1748年他以抄写员身份进入维也纳帝国王家图书馆，1774年升任馆长，并担任帝国宫廷顾问。作为玛丽亚·特蕾西亚女皇信任的谋臣，他以学术研究为女皇的中央集权改革提供历史依据，1772年又为哈布斯堡加强对加利西亚和达尔马提亚的主权主张立论。他研究君主国境内各民族的著作在1783年首次为民族学给出正式定义，他也被视为最早的泛斯拉夫主义作家之一，同年7月在维也纳去世。

en: Muhammad ibn Falah (1400–1461) was a Shi‘a theologian born in Wasit, Iraq, who founded the millenarian Musha‘sha‘iya sect. Educated at the Shia center of al-Hillah, he proclaimed himself the earthly representative of Imam Ali and the Mahdi, and was denounced as an unbeliever. His revelations, written in the style of the Qur'an, were collected as the Kalam al-Mahdi. In 1442 he established himself at Hoveizeh in Khuzestan, later the seat of the Musha‘sha‘ emirate. Claiming descent from Imam Musa al-Kazim, he died at Hoveizeh in 1461 and was succeeded by his son.
zh: 穆罕默德·伊本·法拉赫（1400—1461）是生于伊拉克瓦西特的什叶派神学家，千年末世教派穆沙阿沙伊耶的创始人。他在什叶派学术中心希拉求学，自称是伊玛目阿里与马赫迪在世间的代理人，因而被斥为不信者。他以《古兰经》文风写下的启示被汇编为《马赫迪言辞》。1442年，他在胡齐斯坦的霍韦伊泽立足，此地后来成为穆沙阿沙伊耶酋长国的中心。他自称是伊玛目穆萨·卡齐姆的后裔，1461年卒于霍韦伊泽，由其子继立。

en: Mirza Shah Hossein, in full Mirza Kamal al-Din Shah Hossein Isfahani (died 1523), was a Persian statesman of the early Safavid Empire and a native of Isfahan. Trained as an architect, in 1503 he became vizier to the Qizilbash governor Durmish Khan Shamlu. After the Battle of Chaldiran in 1514, he found Shah Ismail I's favorite wife, who had been lost in Azerbaijan, and the shah named him vakil (vicegerent) and vizier. In 1515 he protested the Portuguese conquest of Hormuz to their envoy, while seeking an alliance and requesting gunners and cannon founders. In 1516 he also took command of the musketeer corps. A close favorite of the withdrawn shah, he amassed power and in 1521 forced his old master Durmish Khan out to Herat. In April 1523 angry Qizilbash chiefs murdered him.
zh: 米尔扎·沙·侯赛因，全名米尔扎·卡迈勒丁·沙·侯赛因·伊斯法哈尼（卒于1523年），是萨法维帝国初期的波斯政治家，伊斯法罕本地人。他本是建筑师，1503年成为奇兹尔巴什总督杜尔米什汗·沙姆鲁的维齐尔。1514年查尔迪兰战役后，他找到了沙阿伊斯玛仪一世在阿塞拜疆失散的宠妻，沙阿任命他为瓦基勒（副王）兼维齐尔。1515年，他向葡萄牙使节抗议葡萄牙占领霍尔木兹，同时寻求结盟并请求派来炮手和铸炮匠。1516年他又接掌火枪兵部队。他深为消沉退隐的沙阿宠信，借机揽权，1521年把旧主杜尔米什汗排挤到赫拉特。1523年4月，愤怒的奇兹尔巴什首领将他杀害。

en: Abdi Beg Shirazi (1513–1580), whose full name was Khvaja Zayn al-Abedin Ali and who wrote under the pen name Novidi, was a poet, historian and administrator of Safavid Iran. Although known as Shirazi, he was probably born and raised in Tabriz, his mother's hometown. He served as a secretary and accountant (mostawfi) in the chancery of Shah Tahmasp I. He first wrote ghazals and rubaiyat, then turned to rhyming couplets under royal guidance and the encouragement of the poet Qasemi Gonabadi. In 1570 he completed the Takmelat al-akhbar, a Persian universal history chronicling the Safavids to 1570, dedicated to Princess Pari Khan Khanum. He died at Ardabil in 1580.
zh: 阿卜迪·贝格·设拉子（1513—1580），全名赫瓦贾·扎因·阿比丁·阿里，以笔名诺维迪创作，是萨法维伊朗的诗人、史学家和官员。他虽以“设拉子”为号，却可能生于并长于母亲的故乡大不里士。他在沙阿塔赫玛斯普一世的御前秘书处担任秘书兼财政审计官。早年他创作加泽尔诗和鲁拜，后来在王室指导和诗人卡塞米·戈纳巴迪的鼓励下转向双行诗。1570年，他完成波斯语通史《历史补编》，记述萨法维王朝至1570年的史事，题献给帕里汗·哈努姆公主，1580年卒于阿尔达比勒。

en: Sir Anthony Shirley (1565–c. 1635) was an English adventurer and diplomat, second son of Sir Thomas Shirley of Wiston. He fought in the Netherlands and France, and in 1593 Henry IV made him a knight of the Order of St Michael, prompting Elizabeth I to investigate his oath to a foreign monarch.
