In 1598 he sailed from Venice with his younger brother Robert, reached Shah Abbas I's court via Baghdad and Astarabad, and received the title Mirza Antonio. In 1599 Abbas sent him to Europe with Huseyn Ali Bey for an anti-Ottoman alliance; the embassy visited Moscow and Prague with little result, and Elizabeth I barred his return to England. He later served the Habsburgs and Spain as the self-styled Count of the East, and died in poverty in Madrid.
zh: 安东尼·谢利爵士（1565—约1635）是英格兰探险家、外交官，威斯顿的托马斯·谢利爵士次子。他曾在尼德兰和法国作战，1593年法王亨利四世授予他圣米歇尔骑士称号，伊丽莎白一世遂调查他向外国君主所立的誓言。1598年，他带着弟弟罗伯特从威尼斯起航，经巴格达和阿斯塔拉巴德抵达沙阿阿拔斯一世的宫廷，获赐“米尔扎·安东尼奥”称号。1599年，阿拔斯派他与侯赛因·阿里贝格一同出使欧洲，谋求反奥斯曼同盟；使团先后访问莫斯科和布拉格，收效甚微，伊丽莎白一世还禁止他返回英格兰。他后来以自封的“东方伯爵”身份效力于哈布斯堡家族和西班牙，最终在马德里潦倒而终。

en: Robert Shirley (c. 1581–1628) was an English traveller and adventurer, third son of Thomas Shirley of Wiston in Sussex. In 1598 he went with his brother Anthony to Safavid Persia, where he trained Shah Abbas I's army and reorganized its artillery on the English model, helping Persia match the Ottomans in the war of 1603–1612. In 1607 he married the Circassian Sampsonia, later Teresa Shirley. In 1608 Abbas sent him to seek a European alliance against the Ottomans. He visited Poland-Lithuania and Rome, and the emperor and pope made him a count. He returned to Persia in 1613 and died at Qazvin in 1628 soon after returning again with the English embassy.
zh: 罗伯特·雪莉（约1581—1628）是英格兰旅行家与冒险家，萨塞克斯郡威斯顿的托马斯·雪莉第三子。1598年，他随兄长安东尼前往萨法维波斯并留在当地，按英格兰模式为阿拔斯一世训练军队、重整炮兵，帮助波斯在1603—1612年对奥斯曼的战争中与对手势均力敌。1607年，他娶切尔克斯女子桑普索尼娅（后改名特蕾莎·雪莉）为妻。1608年，阿拔斯派他赴欧洲寻求结盟对抗奥斯曼。他访问波兰立陶宛和罗马，神圣罗马皇帝与教皇先后封他为伯爵。他于1613年返回波斯，1628年再次随英格兰使节返回后不久在加兹温去世。

en: Khvajeh Ali Safavi, also called Khvajeh Ali Siyahpush (c. 1370–1427), was the third head of the Safavid Sufi order at Ardabil, succeeding his father Sadr al-Din Musa around 1391. A grandson of the order's founder Safi al-Din Ardabili, he led it through the age of Timur. Later tradition credits him with saving several Tatar tribes of Sham from Timur's vengeance; these tribes became devoted followers, later known as the Qizilbash. Under his leadership the order, hitherto Sunni in sympathy, moved decisively toward popular Shi'ism. He died in 1427 and was succeeded by his son Ibrahim Shah.
zh: 赫瓦贾·阿里·萨法维，又称“黑衣者”西亚赫普什（约1370—1427），是阿尔达比勒萨法维修道教团的第三任教主，约1391年继其父萨德尔丁·穆萨接掌。他是教团创始人萨菲·丁·阿尔达比勒之孙，活跃于帖木儿时代。相传他从帖木儿手中救下沙姆地区的几个鞑靼部落，这些部落由此成为教团的忠实追随者，后来被称为奇兹尔巴什。在他领导下，原本倾向逊尼派的教团明显转向大众什叶派信仰。1427年他去世，其子易卜拉欣沙继位。

en: Iskandar Beg Munshi (1561/1562–1633/1634), whose name means Alexander Beg the Scribe, was an Iranian court chronicler of Safavid Iran. Born into a Turkoman clan of the Qizilbash, the militant Shia tribal elite that brought the Safavids to power, he and his elder brother nevertheless chose careers in the royal bureaucracy rather than the army. He trained as a scribe under Mirza Ata-Allah Isfahani in the later reign of Shah Tahmasp I. He is chiefly remembered for his history, the Tarikh-e Alam-ara-ye Abbasi, which narrates early Safavid rule, above all the reign of Shah Abbas I.
zh: 伊斯坎达·贝格·芒什（1561/1562—1633/1634），其名意为“书吏亚历山大贝格”，是萨法维伊朗的宫廷史官。他出身于奇兹尔巴什的一个突厥蛮部落家族，奇兹尔巴什是助萨法维家族夺权的善战什叶派部落精英，但他与兄长没有从军，而是选择进入王室官僚机构。塔赫玛斯普一世统治后期，他师从米尔扎·阿塔乌拉·伊斯法哈尼学习文书之术。他最负盛名的著作是一部史书，记述萨法维王朝早期的统治，尤其是沙阿阿拔斯一世一朝的史事。

en: William Adams (1564–1620) was an English navigator who reached Japan in April 1600 aboard the Liefde, the only surviving ship of a five-vessel Dutch expedition, and became the first Englishman in the country. As an apprentice at Limehouse he had spent twelve years learning shipbuilding, astronomy and navigation. Summoned before Tokugawa Ieyasu, he and Jan Joosten became the shōgun's foreign-affairs advisers; at Itō he built Japan's first Western-style sailing ship, an 80-ton vessel completed in 1604. Granted samurai rank and an estate at Hemi on the Miura Peninsula, he took the name Miura Anjin, led red-seal voyages to Siam and Cochinchina, and helped open the English factory at Hirado. For over a decade the Tokugawa authorities refused to let him leave Japan; when eventually allowed to return to England, he chose to stay. He died at Hirado in 1620.
zh: 威廉·亚当斯（1564—1620）是英格兰航海家，1600年4月乘荷兰五船探险队中唯一幸存的“慈爱号”漂流到日本，成为最早抵达日本的英格兰人。他曾在莱姆豪斯做了十二年学徒，学习造船、天文学和航海术。他被德川家康召见后，与耶扬子一同担任幕府的外交顾问，并在伊东主持建造日本第一艘西式帆船，这艘80吨的船于1604年完工。他获赐武士身份与三浦半岛逸见的领地，得名三浦按针，此后率领朱印船远航暹罗与交趾支那，并协助在平户开设英国商馆。德川当局十余年间不许他离开日本；后来获准返回英格兰时，他选择留下。1620年，他卒于平户。

en: Gedeon Chetvertinsky (1634–1690), secular name Hryhoriy Sviatopolk-Chetvertynsky, was a Ruthenian prince and Orthodox hierarch born in Volhynia. In 1659 he became bishop of Lutsk and Ostroh. After clashing with the Uniate Church, he fled to Baturyn in 1684 under Hetman Ivan Samoilovych's protection. In July 1685 a Kyiv synod proclaimed him metropolitan despite the refusal of senior clergy to attend. That October Patriarch Joachim of Moscow installed him as Metropolitan of Kyiv, Galicia and all Ruthenia; a tsarist charter guaranteed the metropolis its customary rights. In 1686 the Patriarch of Constantinople permitted Moscow control over Kyiv's metropolitans. After Samoilovych's fall he lost the style of all Ruthenia in 1688, and died at Kyiv in 1690.
zh: 格杰翁·斯维亚托波尔克-切特维尔廷斯基（1634—1690），俗名格里戈里·斯维亚托波尔克-切特维尔廷斯基，是鲁塞尼亚王公、东正教高级教士，生于沃伦。1659年，他出任卢茨克与奥斯特罗赫主教。与合并派教会冲突后，他于1684年逃往巴图林，受到盖特曼伊万·萨莫伊洛维奇庇护。1685年7月，尽管高级教士拒绝出席，基辅宗教会议仍推举他为都主教。同年10月，莫斯科牧首约阿基姆立他为基辅、加利西亚及全罗斯都主教；沙皇的宪章保障了基辅都主教区的惯有权利。1686年，君士坦丁堡牧首准许莫斯科控制基辅都主教的任命。萨莫伊洛维奇倒台后，他在1688年被剥夺“全罗斯”头衔，1690年于基辅去世。

en: Ivan Rutkovych (c. 1650–c. 1708) was a Ruthenian Baroque icon painter, born near Zolochiv in the Lviv region. He worked chiefly at Zhovkva and Univ and is regarded as founder of the Zhovkva school of icon painting and wood carving. He made iconostases with other masters, including those for wooden churches at Volytsia Derevlianska (1680–1682) and Volia Vysotska (1688–1689). His seven-row iconostasis for the Church of the Nativity in Zhovkva (1697–1699), now in the Lviv National Museum, is counted a masterpiece of Ukrainian art. It was restored and exhibited in 2009. Blending Byzantine tradition with secular, realistic European influences, he died between 1703 and 1708.
zh: 伊万·鲁特科维奇（约1650—约1708）是鲁塞尼亚巴洛克圣像画家，生于利沃夫地区佐洛奇夫附近。他主要在若夫克瓦和乌尼夫作画，被视为若夫克瓦圣像画与木雕画派的奠基人。他与其他大师合作制作圣幛，包括沃利齐亚-杰列夫良斯卡（1680—1682）和沃利亚-维索茨卡（1688—1689）木构教堂的圣幛。他为若夫克瓦圣诞教堂所作的七排圣幛（1697—1699）现藏利沃夫国家博物馆，被视为乌克兰艺术杰作，2009年修复后展出。他的风格融合拜占庭传统与世俗写实的欧洲影响，于1703—1708年间去世。

en: Phillippe de Longvilliers de Poincy (1584–1660) was a French nobleman and Bailiff Grand Cross of the Knights of Malta. In 1638 he sailed to the Caribbean as lieutenant governor of the French Isles of America, ruling Saint Christopher from 1639, first for the Compagnie des Îles de l'Amérique and after 1651 for the Knights of Malta. He ruled almost independently: he seized Saint-Barthélemy in 1648, occupied French Saint-Martin and Saint Croix, and refused entry to his appointed successor in 1644, eventually sending him back to France in chains. In 1651 he persuaded the Knights to buy the four islands. He built up Basseterre and the Château de la Montagne, and died on Saint Kitts in 1660.
zh: 菲利普·德·隆维利耶·德·普安西（1584—1660）是法国贵族、医院骑士团大十字巴伊。1638年，他作为法兰西美洲诸岛副总督扬帆加勒比，1639年起统治圣克里斯托弗岛（圣基茨岛），先效命于美洲群岛公司，1651年后转归医院骑士团。他的统治近乎自立：1648年夺取圣巴泰勒米岛，进占法属圣马丁岛和圣克罗伊岛，1644年还拒绝国王派来接替他的总督登陆，最终将其锁拿送回法国。1651年，他说服骑士团买下这四座岛屿。他营建了巴斯特尔和山间堡，1660年在圣基茨岛去世。

en: Giovanni Paolo Lascaris (1560–1657) was an Italian nobleman of the family of the Counts of Ventimiglia, related to the Lascaris emperors of Nicaea, and the 57th Grand Master of the Knights of Malta. He entered the Order of St John in 1584, oversaw its grain supplies and island ovens, and in 1632 went as ambassador to the Spanish court. In June 1636 he succeeded Antoine de Paule as Grand Master. He fortified Malta with the Lascaris coastal watchtowers (1637–1652), and in 1651 the Order bought four Caribbean islands, including Saint Kitts. He guarded the Order's independence against Spain and France, and died on Malta in 1657 aged 97.
zh: 乔瓦尼·保罗·拉斯卡里斯（1560—1657）是意大利贵族，出身与尼西亚皇族拉斯卡里斯有亲缘关系的文蒂米利亚伯爵家族，是医院骑士团第57任大团长。他1584年加入圣约翰医院骑士团，曾掌管骑士团粮食供应和岛上的烤炉，1632年出任驻西班牙宫廷使节。1636年6月，他接替安托万·德·保罗当选大团长。他修筑拉斯卡里斯海岸瞭望塔群（1637—1652）加固马耳他防务；1651年，骑士团在他任内购得包括圣基茨岛在内的四座加勒比岛屿。他抵制西班牙和法国、维护骑士团独立，1657年在马耳他去世，享年97岁。

en: Giacomo Bosio (1544–1627) was an Italian knight of the Order of St John and its first historian. Born at Chivasso near Turin to a Milanese noble family long serving the Order, he went to Rome in 1587 as the Order's representative at the Holy See. He wrote his forty-book history of the Hospitallers, from their origins to the siege era of Jean de la Valette in 1571, edited by two Franciscans and printed in three folio volumes in 1621. It was translated into French and later continued to 1688 by Bartolomeo dal Pozzo. He also published Corona del Cavaliere Gierosolimitano (1588) and Triomphante e gloriose Croce (1610). He died at Rome in 1627.
zh: 贾科莫·博西奥（1544—1627）是意大利的医院骑士团骑士，也是该修会最早的史家。他生于都灵附近的基瓦索，出身一个长期为骑士团效力的米兰贵族家庭。1587年，他作为骑士团驻教廷代表前往罗马。他撰写了四十卷本的医院骑士团史，叙事起自修会起源，止于1571年让·德·拉瓦莱特的时代；书稿经两名方济各会修士整理，于1621年以三卷对开本印行。该书被译成法语，后来由巴尔托洛梅奥·达尔波佐续写至1688年。他还著有《耶路撒冷骑士之冠》（1588）和《凯旋荣耀的十字架》（1610）。1627年他在罗马去世。

en: Ch'oe Musŏn (1325–1395) was a Goryeo general and inventor who gave Korea its first domestic gunpowder. He sought the formula as wokou pirates raided the coasts and penetrated inland, while the weakening Goryeo government struggled to maintain security. He traced the three ingredients of powder and, after years of failed experiments, bribed the Chinese merchant Li Yuan for the manufacturing secret, producing gunpowder between 1374 and 1376. In 1377 the court set up an official firearms bureau, where he devised shipboard cannons, hand cannons and rocket arrows; in 1380, as deputy commander, his guns helped sink over five hundred pirate ships at Jinpo. After the founding of Joseon, he retired from military and political affairs and died in 1395. King Taejo granted him an honorary office posthumously.
zh: 崔茂宣（1325—1395）是高丽末年的将领与火器发明家，使朝鲜半岛第一次实现火药自产。当时倭寇劫掠沿海，深入内陆，衰弱的高丽政府难以维持安全，他因此寻求火药配方。他探明火药的三种原料，又在多年试验失败后贿赂中国商人李元，求得配制秘方，于1374至1376年间试制出火药。1377年朝廷设立官方火器机构，他在其中研制出舰载火炮、手铳与火箭；1380年他以副元帅身份在镇浦以火炮协助击沉倭寇战船五百余艘。朝鲜王朝建立后，他退出军政，于1395年去世。太祖在他身后追赠官职。

en: Mun Ik-chŏm (1329–1398) was a Goryeo civil official and Neo-Confucian scholar from Gangseong-hyeon near Jinju in Gyeongsang Province. His career included service as an academic official and diplomat, and he lived principally in the Goryeo capital of Gaegyeong. After passing the civil service examination in 1360, he accompanied a diplomatic mission to Yuan China in 1363. Although the Yuan banned the export of cotton seeds, he brought home cotton seed and, helped by a Chinese monk, began growing cotton, introducing cotton cultivation to Korea. He died in 1398; in 1440 King Sejong posthumously enfeoffed him as Marquis Fumin.
zh: 文益渐（1329—1398）是高丽后期的文官、性理学者，庆尚道晋州江城县人。他曾任学官与外交官，主要居住在高丽都城开京。他1360年科举及第，1363年作为使节随员出使元朝。当时元朝禁止棉种出境，他仍将棉花种子带回国内，并在一名汉僧帮助下开始植棉，棉花种植由此传入朝鲜半岛。他于1398年去世，1440年朝鲜世宗追封他为富民侯。

en: Heo Nanseolheon (1563–1589), personal name Cho-hui, was a Joseon poet and painter of the Yangcheon Heo clan in Gangneung. A child prodigy, her Chinese verse written at age eight was hailed as the work of an immortal maiden. Her elder brother Heo Bong and younger brother Heo Gyun, author of The Tale of Hong Gildong, guided her education. After Heo Bong's exile, Heo Gyun helped her stay in touch with literary circles; his teacher Yi Dal shared Tang poetry with her. She composed some two hundred poems in Chinese. Married to Kim Seongnip, she suffered an unhappy marriage and the death of both children, and died of illness on March 19, 1589, aged twenty-seven.
zh: 许兰雪轩（1563—1589），本名楚姬，是朝鲜王朝中期的女诗人、女画家，出身江陵的阳川许氏。她自幼有神童之名，八岁时写的汉文诗即被誉为仙女手笔。兄长许篈与弟弟许筠——《洪吉童传》的作者——先后指导她治学。许篈流放后，许筠帮助她保持与文坛的联系；许筠的老师李达也向她传授唐诗。她留有约两百首汉文诗。她嫁给金成立后婚姻不幸，一子一女先后夭折，她本人于1589年3月19日病逝，终年二十七岁。

en: Radvila Astikas (died 1477), baptized Nicholas, was a Lithuanian magnate and founder of the Radziwiłł family. He served the Grand Duchy as the grand duke's marshal and twice as Grand Marshal of Lithuania. A leading member of the Council of Lords, he led embassies to the Teutonic Knights and the Golden Horde, and in 1447 received Kėdainiai from Casimir Jagiellon, developing it into a trading town that traded with the Hanseatic League. In 1473 he took part in negotiations defining the border between Lithuania and Livonia. He ended his career as voivode of Trakai from 1466 and castellan of Vilnius from 1475, dying in 1477.
zh: 拉德维拉·阿斯季卡斯（?—1477），洗礼名尼古拉斯，是立陶宛大贵族、拉齐维乌家族的始祖。他曾任大公的典礼官，并两度出任立陶宛大司马，是贵族会议的核心成员。他多次受命出使条顿骑士团和金帐汗国，1447年获卡齐米日·雅盖隆契克赐予凯代尼艾，并将其经营成与汉萨同盟通商的市镇。1473年他参与划定立陶宛与利沃尼亚边界的谈判。1466年起任特拉凯总督，1475年起任维尔纽斯城主，1477年去世。

en: Jonas Goštautas (c. 1393–1458) was a magnate of the Goštautai family in the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. First recorded at the 1413 Union of Horodło, he was a marshal under Vytautas the Great, was captured at Lutsk in 1431, and became voivode of Trakai in 1433. In 1440 he helped the Council of Lords proclaim Casimir Jagiellon Grand Duke of Lithuania against the wishes of Polish magnates, dissolving the personal union with Poland. Serving as voivode of Vilnius and Chancellor from 1443, he held power beside the young Grand Duke. He expanded the powers of the Council of Lords and campaigned against rebellious Kiev, but after a failed 1456 plot to replace Casimir with Simeon Olelkowicz he died in Vilnius in 1458.
zh: 约纳斯·戈什陶塔斯（约1393—1458）是立陶宛大公国戈什陶塔伊家族的大贵族。他在1413年赫罗德沃联合时首次见诸记载，曾任维陶塔斯大帝的典礼官，1431年在卢茨克被俘，1433年成为特拉凯总督。1440年，他协助贵族会议拥立卡齐米日·雅盖隆契克为立陶宛大公，违背波兰贵族的意愿，瓦解了两国的共主关系。1443年起，他任维尔纽斯总督兼大公国宰相，在年幼的大公身边掌握实权。他扩大了贵族会议的权力，出兵征讨叛乱的基辅；1456年图谋以谢苗·奥列尔科维奇取代卡齐米日失败，1458年于维尔纽斯去世。

en: Martynas Mažvydas (1510–1563) was a Protestant writer who produced the first printed book in Lithuanian. A Samogitian-born Lithuanian raised in Vilnius, he was persecuted for his Lutheran beliefs and, at Duke Albrecht of Prussia's invitation, entered the university in Königsberg in 1546. In 1547, still a student, he and his collaborators published The Simple Words of Catechism, based on Martin Luther's Small Catechism, at the Hans Weinreich press in an edition of no more than 300 copies. From 1549 he served as priest and from 1554 as archdeacon of Ragainė, overseeing parish education and issuing further Lithuanian hymns and prayer books until his death in Königsberg in 1563.
zh: 马蒂纳斯·马日维达斯（1510—1563）是新教作家，主持编写了第一本立陶宛语印刷书籍。他是出身萨莫吉希亚的立陶宛人，在维尔纽斯长大，因信奉路德宗受迫害，于1546年应普鲁士公爵阿尔布雷希特之邀进入柯尼斯堡大学。1547年，仍在求学的他与合作者在汉斯·魏因赖希印刷所出版了《教义问答简明之言》，该书以马丁·路德的《小教理问答》为蓝本，印数不超过300册。1549年起他任拉盖涅牧师，1554年升任总执事，督导教区教育，继续编写立陶宛语赞美诗和祈祷书，直到1563年在柯尼斯堡去世。

en: Franciszek Smuglewicz (1745–1807) was a Polish-Lithuanian painter and founder of the Vilnius school of art. Born in Warsaw to painters, he trained in Rome from 1763 under Anton von Maron, joined the Saint Luke Academy and adopted Neo-Classicism during twenty-one years in Italy. In 1765 he received a scholarship from King Stanisław August Poniatowski; he also helped catalogue artifacts from Nero's Golden House. Returning to Warsaw in 1784, he opened a school and won fame with historical canvases such as The Meeting of the Four Years' Sejm (1793) and Kościuszko's Oath at Kraków (1797). In 1797 he moved to Vilnius to lead the Institute of Sketch and Painting at the Vilnius Academy, teaching until his death in 1807.
zh: 弗朗齐谢克·斯穆格莱维奇（1745—1807）是活跃于波兰与立陶宛的画家，维尔纽斯画派的奠基人。他生于华沙的绘画世家，1763年赴罗马，师从安东·冯·马伦，加入圣路加学院，在意大利的二十一年间接受了新古典主义风格。1765年他获得国王斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基的奖学金；他还参与整理尼禄金宫的文物。1784年回到华沙后，他开办学校，以《四年议会开会》（1793年）和《柯斯丘什科在克拉科夫宣誓》（1797年）等历史题材油画成名。1797年他迁居维尔纽斯，主持维尔纽斯学院的素描与绘画学院，直到1807年去世。

en: Balthasar Russow (1536–1600) was a Livonian chronicler and Lutheran pastor, born in Reval, now Tallinn. Educated at the academy in Stettin in Pomerania, he served from 1566 until his death as pastor of the Estonian congregation at the Holy Spirit Church in Reval. He is famous for his Low German Chronica der Provinz Lyfflandt, which relates the decline of the Livonian Order and the Livonian War of 1558–1583. First printed at Rostock in 1578, it quickly sold out and appeared in a revised edition in 1584. Russow denounced the immorality of the Livonian nobility, the venality of mercenaries and the superstitions of Estonian peasants, while praising Swedish rule.
zh: 巴尔塔扎尔·鲁索（1536—1600）是利沃尼亚编年史家、路德宗牧师，生于雷瓦尔（今塔林）。他在波美拉尼亚的斯德丁学院求学，1566年起任雷瓦尔圣灵教堂爱沙尼亚语信众的牧师，直至去世。他以低地德语写成的《利夫兰省编年史》闻名，书记述利沃尼亚骑士团的衰落与1558—1583年的利沃尼亚战争。该书1578年首印于罗斯托克，很快售罄，1584年出修订版。鲁索在书中抨击利沃尼亚贵族的奢靡无行、雇佣军的贪财枉法和爱沙尼亚农民的迷信，对瑞典的统治则加以称许。

en: Maulana Malik Ibrahim, later known as Sunan Gresik, was the first of the Wali Songo, the nine missionaries credited with bringing Islam to Java. The inscription at his tomb identifies him as a native of Kashan in Persia. He first preached for thirteen years in Champa, where he married a king's daughter and fathered Sunan Ampel. In the late fourteenth century he settled near Gresik in Majapahit Java. His equal treatment of different castes in trade won support among lower castes and led to conversions. He treated the sick and taught better farming, and founded an Islamic boarding school after meeting the Majapahit ruler at Trowulan. He died at Gresik on 7 April 1419.
zh: 毛拉纳·马利克·易卜拉欣，后称苏南·锦石，是瓦利松戈九贤之首，相传正是这九位传教士将伊斯兰教传入爪哇。据其墓碑铭文考证，他生于波斯卡尚，先在占婆传教十三年，娶当地国王之女，生子苏南·安佩尔。14世纪末，他定居满者伯夷治下爪哇的锦石附近。他经商时平等对待不同种姓，赢得低种姓民众的支持，促使不少人皈依。他行医、教人改进耕作，并在特洛乌兰觐见满者伯夷君主后创办伊斯兰经学堂。1419年4月7日，他在锦石去世。

en: Gershom ben Eliezer Soncino was a member of the Jewish Soncino printing family and grandson of Gershom ben Moses; around 1550 he moved to Cairo, where he established a printing press.
zh: 格尔肖姆·本·埃利泽·松奇诺出身犹太松奇诺印刷世家，是格尔肖姆·本·摩西的孙子；约1550年他迁至开罗，在当地设立印刷所。

en: James II (c. 1438–1473), called the Bastard, was the illegitimate son of King John II of Cyprus and Marietta de Patras. He became Archbishop of Nicosia in 1456 but lost the see after killing the royal chamberlain. When John II died in 1458, the crown passed to James's half-sister Charlotte. In 1460, backed by the Egyptian Mamluk sultan Inal, James invaded, blockaded Charlotte and her husband Louis of Savoy in Kyrenia for three years, and was crowned king by 1464. Seeking Venetian support, he married Catherine Cornaro by proxy in 1468; they wed in person at Famagusta in 1472. James died there in 1473 amid rumours of Venetian poisoning, leaving his pregnant wife as regent.
zh: 雅克二世（约1438—1473），绰号“私生子”，是塞浦路斯国王约翰二世与玛丽埃塔·德·帕特拉斯的私生子。1456年，他被任命为尼科西亚大主教，但在杀死王室侍从长后被剥夺大主教之职。1458年约翰二世去世，王位传给雅克的异母姐姐夏洛特。1460年，雅克在埃及马穆鲁克苏丹伊纳勒支持下发兵，把夏洛特及其丈夫萨伏依的路易围困在凯里尼亚城堡达三年之久，并于1464年加冕为王。为寻求威尼斯支持，他于1468年与卡特琳娜·科尔纳罗举行代理婚礼，1472年两人在法马古斯塔正式成婚。1473年雅克在当地去世，坊间传言他是被威尼斯人毒杀的；他留下怀孕的妻子摄政。

en: Amir Husain al-Kurdi, known to the Portuguese as Mirocem, was the leading Mamluk naval commander under Sultan al-Ashraf Qansuh al-Ghuri and governor of Jeddah, whose walls and towers he raised to secure the Red Sea pilgrimage route. The sultan sent him into the Indian Ocean to defend his interests and protect Muslim pilgrims sailing to Mecca from the Portuguese. In 1508 he joined the Gujarati admiral Malik Ayyaz to defeat and kill Lourenco de Almeida at Chaul. The next year Francisco de Almeida avenged his son by crushing Husain's fleet at Diu, also seeking to free the Portuguese taken prisoner at Chaul. In 1517, with Selman Reis's Ottoman squadron, he helped repel the Portuguese from Jeddah, and died that same year.
zh: 埃米尔·侯赛因·库尔迪被葡萄牙人称为“米罗塞姆”，是马穆鲁克苏丹阿什拉夫·坎苏·古里麾下的首席海军将领，也是吉达总督；为拱卫红海朝觐航道，他为吉达修筑了城墙与塔楼。苏丹派他进入印度洋，维护自身利益，保护乘船前往麦加的穆斯林朝觐者免受葡萄牙人侵扰。1508年，他与古吉拉特舰队统帅马利克·阿亚兹联手，在焦尔海战击败并击毙洛伦索·德·阿尔梅达。次年，弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达为替儿子报仇、解救在焦尔被俘的葡萄牙人，在第乌海战击溃他的舰队。1517年，他会同塞尔曼·雷斯的奥斯曼分舰队在吉达击退葡萄牙人，同年去世。

en: Shams al-Din al-Sakhawi (1428–1497) was a Cairene Shafi'i scholar of hadith and history, and the leading student of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani, whose biography he later wrote. His hadith scholarship was deeply influenced by his teacher. A prolific author on hadith, Qur'anic exegesis and literature, he compiled al-Daw' al-Lami, a vast biographical dictionary of the notable figures of his century, and added a supplement to al-Maqrizi's chronicle of the Mamluk sultans. He recorded the marital histories of five hundred women in Egypt and observed that at least a third of women in Egypt and Syria married more than once. He also reported that three in ten marriages in fifteenth-century Cairo ended in divorce. He died in Medina.
zh: 沙姆斯丁·萨哈维（1428—1497）是开罗的沙斐仪派圣训学者和史家，也是伊本·哈贾尔·阿斯卡拉尼的得意门生，后来还为其师撰写了传记。他的圣训学深受老师影响。他著述宏富，遍及圣训、经注与文学，编纂了收录同时代名人的大型传记辞典《灿烂之光》，并为塔基丁·马克里齐的马穆鲁克苏丹编年史撰写续编。他在埃及记录了五百名女性的婚姻史，并观察到埃及和叙利亚至少三分之一的女性结过不止一次婚。他还记载，十五世纪开罗的婚姻中有十分之三以离异告终。他最终在麦地那去世。

en: Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani (1372–1449), born Ahmad ibn Ali in Cairo to a family from Ascalon, was the foremost Shafi'i scholar and hadith master of his age. Orphaned in infancy, he was sent by his guardian to study the Qur'an at five and had memorised it by nine. In 1397 he married the hadith scholar Uns Khatun, who lectured publicly to other scholars. He produced roughly 150 works on hadith, law, history and poetry, above all Fath al-Bari, his classic commentary on Sahih al-Bukhari, which earned him the epithet Hafiz of the Time. When he died in Cairo in 1449, the Abbasid caliph led his funeral prayer and about fifty thousand mourners, including Sultan Jaqmaq, attended.
zh: 伊本·哈贾尔·阿斯卡拉尼（1372—1449）本名艾哈迈德·本·阿里，生于开罗，家族来自阿斯凯隆，是当时最杰出的沙斐仪派学者和圣训大师。他幼年成孤，五岁时监护人送他学习《古兰经》，九岁已能背诵全本。1397年他娶圣训学者温斯·哈敦为妻，她曾向其他学者公开授课。他著有约150部作品，涉及圣训、教法、历史与诗歌，其中最负盛名的是为《布哈里圣训实录》所作的经典注释《法特赫·巴里》，为他赢得“时代的哈菲兹”之誉。1449年他在开罗去世，阿拔斯哈里发主持殡礼，包括苏丹哲格玛格在内约五万人为他送葬。

en: Jamal al-Din Yusuf, known as Ibn Taghribirdi (1411–1470), was an Egyptian historian born in Cairo into the Mamluk military elite; his father Sayf al-Din Taghribirdi was a leading amir under Sultans Barquq and Faraj. He studied law and history under Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani, Badr al-Din al-Ayni and al-Maqrizi, while mastering horsemanship, poetry and Turkish. His wealth freed him from earning a living, and his connections with amirs and the court of ten sultans gave him access to information. He wrote twelve historical works, above all the multi-volume annalistic chronicle al-Nujum al-zahira, which records Egypt's rulers from the Islamic conquest to 1467 with precise dates, as well as the Nile's fluctuations and building activity.
zh: 贾迈勒丁·优素福，世称伊本·塔格里比尔迪（1411—1470），是生于开罗的埃及史家，出身马穆鲁克军事权贵之家，父亲赛夫丁·塔格里比尔迪是苏丹巴尔库克与法拉吉在位时的高级埃米尔。他先后师从伊本·哈贾尔·阿斯卡拉尼、巴德尔丁·艾尼和塔基丁·马克里齐学习教法与历史，同时精通骑术、诗歌与突厥语。他家境富有，无需为生计工作，与埃米尔和十位苏丹宫廷的交往让他得以获取史料。他撰有十二部史书，代表作是多卷本编年史《灿烂星辰：埃及与开罗诸王志》，以精确日期记述自伊斯兰征服至1467年的历代埃及统治者，也记载尼罗河水情与建筑活动。

en: Heshen (1750–1799), born Shanbao, was a Manchu official of the Niohuru clan in the Qing dynasty. As a boy he studied at the Xian'an Palace school, learning Manchu, Chinese, Mongolian and Tibetan. He entered palace service as an imperial guard in 1772 and caught the eye of the Qianlong Emperor, who promoted him into the Grand Council in 1776. Over more than twenty years he accumulated dozens of offices and a vast fortune through bribes, marrying his son to the emperor's favourite daughter. After Qianlong abdicated in 1796, Heshen continued to dominate the government. Within days of Qianlong's death in 1799, the Jiaqing Emperor charged him with corruption, seized his wealth, and ordered him to strangle himself.
zh: 和珅（1750—1799），原名善保，满洲钮祜禄氏，清朝官员。他少年时入咸安宫官学读书，学会满、汉、蒙、藏文字。1772年他被授三等侍卫、入宫当差，因善于体察乾隆帝心意而获宠信，1776年进入军机处。此后二十余年间，他历任数十个要职，靠收受贿赂聚敛巨额家财，并让儿子娶了皇帝最宠爱的女儿。1796年乾隆帝退位后，和珅仍把持朝政。1799年乾隆帝去世后没几天，嘉庆帝即以贪腐罪名革职抄家，赐令他自尽。

en: Heinrich von Brühl (1700–1763) was chief minister of Saxony and Poland under Augustus III. A page at the Dresden court from 1719, he won the elector's trust when Augustus II died in 1733 and raised the money that secured Frederick Augustus II's election as Polish king. Made an Imperial count in 1737 and sole minister after 1738, he took the title of Prime Minister in 1746. Brühl accumulated offices and their salaries, and controlled access to the king, whose servants could not be appointed without his consent. His diplomacy shaped the Diplomatic Revolution of 1756, but his ruinous finances left Saxony helpless before Prussia in the Seven Years' War. He died at Dresden weeks after Augustus III in 1763.
zh: 海因里希·冯·布吕尔（1700—1763）是奥古斯特三世治下左右萨克森与波兰朝政的首席大臣。他1719年入德累斯顿宫廷当侍童，1733年奥古斯特二世去世时赢得新选侯信任，并筹得资金助弗里德里希·奥古斯特二世当选波兰国王。1737年他成为帝国伯爵，1738年后独掌相权，1746年获封新设的首相头衔。布吕尔兼任多个职位，领取各职俸禄，又控制着觐见国王的途径；国王的侍从须经他同意才能任用。他的外交促成了1756年的外交革命，但他败坏的财政使萨克森在七年战争中无力抵御普鲁士。1763年，他在奥古斯特三世去世数周后病故于德累斯顿。

en: Gottfried Silbermann (1683–1753), born at Kleinbobritzsch in Saxony, was the outstanding German organ builder of the Baroque. He learned the craft in Strasbourg from his brother Andreas after 1702, absorbing the French-Alsatian style, and managed his brother's workshop during Andreas's stay in Paris from 1704 to 1706. He returned to Saxony in 1710 and opened his workshop at Freiberg, completing the grand organ of Freiberg Cathedral in 1714. Appointed court organ builder to the Saxon elector in 1723, he built some fifty organs, including those of Freiberg Cathedral and Dresden's Hofkirche. He also made fortepianos after Cristofori's design from 1732, selling several to Frederick the Great, and died at Dresden in 1753.
zh: 戈特弗里德·西尔伯曼（1683—1753），生于萨克森的小博布里奇，是巴洛克时期最杰出的德国管风琴制造家。1702年后，他在斯特拉斯堡随兄长安德烈亚斯学艺，吸收法属阿尔萨斯流派的风格；1704—1706年兄长在巴黎期间，他负责管理兄长的作坊。1710年他回到萨克森，在弗赖贝格开设作坊，1714年建成弗赖贝格大教堂的大管风琴。1723年他被任命为萨克森选帝侯的宫廷管风琴制造师，一生造了约50架管风琴，代表作包括弗赖贝格大教堂和德累斯顿宫廷教堂的乐器。他还从1732年起按克里斯托福里的设计制造古钢琴，把数架卖给腓特烈大帝，1753年在德累斯顿去世。

en: Andreas Karlstadt (1486–1541), born Andreas Bodenstein at Karlstadt am Main, was a radical theologian of the early Reformation. A professor and chancellor at the University of Wittenberg, he defended Luther against Johann Eck at the Leipzig Debate of 1519. While Luther was hidden at the Wartburg in 1521–1522, Karlstadt led reform in Wittenberg, celebrating Mass in German and removing images. In 1522 he married Anna von Mochau, breaking with clerical celibacy. Later in conflict with Luther and expelled from Saxony, he served as a minister in Switzerland. In 1534 he became a minister and professor of Hebrew at Basel, where he died of the plague in 1541.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/安德烈亚斯·卡尔施塔特
zh: 安德烈亚斯·卡尔施塔特（1486—1541），原名安德烈亚斯·博登施泰因，生于美因河畔卡尔施塔特，是宗教改革初期的激进神学家。他任维滕贝格大学教授兼校长，在1519年的莱比锡辩论中与约翰·艾克交锋、为路德辩护。1521—1522年路德藏匿于瓦尔特堡期间，他在维滕贝格主导改革，用德语主持弥撒、拆除圣像。1522年，他与安娜·冯·莫肖结婚，打破神职人员独身的规定。他后来与路德反目并被逐出萨克森，在瑞士担任牧师。1534年，他在巴塞尔出任牧师和希伯来语教授，1541年死于鼠疫。

en: Johann Eck (1486–1543), born Johann Maier at Egg near Memmingen, was the foremost Catholic theologian to oppose Martin Luther. Ordained in Strasbourg in 1508, he became a professor at Ingolstadt in 1510 and its vice-chancellor in 1512. He attacked Luther's ninety-five theses in print and then debated Karlstadt and Luther at the Leipzig Disputation of 1519, where he pressed Luther to deny the authority of pope and councils. He then went to Rome and brought back the bull Exsurge Domine (1520) condemning Luther's writings. At Augsburg in 1530 he helped draft the Catholic Confutatio to the Augsburg Confession; he died at Ingolstadt in 1543.
zh: 约翰·埃克（1486—1543），原名约翰·迈尔，生于梅明根附近的埃克，是与马丁·路德对抗的最重要的天主教神学家。他于1508年在斯特拉斯堡受封为神父，1510年起在因戈尔施塔特大学任教，1512年出任副校长。他曾撰文抨击路德的九十五条论纲，并在1519年的莱比锡辩论中先后与卡尔施塔特、路德交锋，逼路德否认教宗与公会议的权威。此后他前往罗马，携1520年谴责路德著作的《主啊，求你兴起》诏书返回德意志。1530年，他在奥格斯堡协助起草针对《奥格斯堡信纲》的天主教《驳议》，1543年在因戈尔施塔特去世。

en: Lucas Cranach the Elder (1472–1553), born in Kronach, Franconia, was the leading German painter and printmaker of the early Reformation. He learned drawing from his father Hans Maler and took his surname from his birthplace. In 1504 Elector Frederick the Wise of Saxony made him court painter at Wittenberg, where he served the Saxon electors for the rest of his life. A close friend of Martin Luther, he ran a large workshop that produced portraits of Protestant princes and reformers, altarpieces, woodcuts and engravings, while also accepting Catholic patrons. A wealthy Wittenberg burgher who served twice as burgomaster, he joined John Frederick I in captivity after Mühlberg (1547) and died at Weimar in 1553.
zh: 老卢卡斯·克拉纳赫（1472—1553）生于法兰克尼亚的克罗纳赫，是宗教改革初期德国最重要的画家和版画家。他跟随父亲汉斯·马勒学习绘画，以出生地为姓。1504年，萨克森选帝侯“智者”腓特烈任命他为维滕贝格的宫廷画师，此后他终生效力于萨克森历代选帝侯。他是马丁·路德的密友，经营着庞大的作坊，绘制新教诸侯与改革家肖像、祭坛画、木刻和铜版画，同时也接受天主教主顾的订件。他是维滕贝格富有的市民，曾两度出任市长；1547年米尔贝格战役后，他追随被俘的约翰·腓特烈一世，1553年在魏玛去世。

en: Johann Melchior Dinglinger (1664–1731), born at Biberach in Swabia, was the most celebrated goldsmith of the Baroque age. Apprenticed in Ulm and trained as a journeyman in Augsburg, Nuremberg and Vienna, he settled in Dresden in 1692 and became court jeweller to Augustus the Strong of Saxony in 1698. With his brothers and the sculptor Permoser he ran a great workshop, creating the Golden Coffee Service of 1701 and the Court of Delhi on the Birthday of the Grand Mughal Aurangzeb (1701–1708), a tableau of 132 enamelled gold figures. Augustus continued to commission his work even in wartime, and Tsar Peter the Great also placed orders with him. Dinglinger died in Dresden in 1731.
zh: 约翰·梅尔希奥·丁林格（1664—1731），生于施瓦本的比伯拉赫，是巴洛克时代最负盛名的金匠。他先在乌尔姆当学徒，又到奥格斯堡、纽伦堡和维也纳做帮工精进技艺，1692年定居德累斯顿，1698年成为萨克森选帝侯“强者”奥古斯特的宫廷珠宝匠。他与两个兄弟和雕刻家佩莫瑟经营大作坊，创作了1701年的《黄金咖啡具》和1701—1708年的《大莫卧儿奥朗则布诞辰日的德里宫廷》，后者是由132个鎏金珐琅人物组成的盛饰。奥古斯特在战时也继续向他订制作品，俄国沙皇彼得大帝同样向他订货。丁林格于1731年在德累斯顿去世。

en: Abraham Gottlob Werner (1749–1817) was a German geologist born in Silesia. He studied law and mining at Freiberg and Leipzig, where he became interested in classifying minerals. In 1774 he published On the External Characters of Minerals, the first modern textbook of descriptive mineralogy, and in 1775 became teacher of mining and mineralogy at the Freiberg Mining Academy. There he taught that all rocks had crystallized from a primordial ocean, a doctrine called Neptunism, which drew students from across Europe including Alexander von Humboldt. His ideas provoked debate with the Plutonists, particularly over the origin of basalt. His demonstration of chronological succession in rock strata earned him the title father of German geology. He died in Dresden in 1817.
zh: 亚伯拉罕·戈特洛布·维尔纳（1749—1817）是生于西里西亚的德国地质学家。他在弗赖贝格和莱比锡学习法律与采矿，并在莱比锡对矿物分类产生了兴趣。1774年，他出版《论矿物的外部特征》，这是第一部现代描述矿物学教科书；1775年，他出任弗赖贝格矿业学院采矿与矿物学教师。他在该校提出所有岩石都由原始海洋结晶沉积而成的水成论，吸引了包括亚历山大·冯·洪堡在内的欧洲各国学生。他的理论引发了与火成论者的争论，焦点之一是玄武岩的成因。他论证了岩层形成的年代先后顺序，被誉为德国地质学之父，1817年在德累斯顿去世。

en: Johann Adolph Hasse (baptised 1699–1783) was a German composer born near Hamburg, the leading master of opera seria in his age. He began his career as a tenor at Hamburg in 1718. His first opera, Antioco, appeared at Brunswick in 1721, and he spent the 1720s in Naples studying under Alessandro Scarlatti. In 1730 he married the soprano Faustina Bordoni and was appointed Kapellmeister at Dresden, where his Cleofide premiered in 1731 and he was made Oberkapellmeister in 1747. He frequently set libretti by his friend Pietro Metastasio. The Seven Years' War scattered the court, and after his patron Augustus III died in 1763 he worked in Vienna, favoured by Maria Theresa, before ending his life in Venice.
zh: 约翰·阿道夫·哈塞（1699年受洗—1783）是生于汉堡附近的德国作曲家，也是当时正歌剧的领军人物。1718年，他在汉堡以男高音身份开始演艺生涯。1721年，他的第一部歌剧《安条克》在不伦瑞克上演；1720年代他长住那不勒斯，师从亚历山德罗·斯卡拉蒂。1730年，他与女高音福斯蒂娜·博尔多尼结婚，并被任命为德累斯顿宫廷乐长，1731年他的《克莱奥菲德》在当地首演，1747年升任首席乐长。他经常为好友彼得罗·梅塔斯塔西奥的剧本谱曲。七年战争使宫廷流散，1763年恩主奥古斯特三世去世后他转赴维也纳，深受玛丽亚·特蕾西亚器重，最后在威尼斯度过晚年。

en: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz (1646–1716), born in Leipzig, was a German polymath: mathematician, philosopher, librarian and diplomat. From the age of seven he had access to his late father's library, where he read widely in philosophy and theology. Sent to Paris in 1672, he devoted himself to mathematics, and in 1676 entered the service of the dukes of Brunswick at Hanover as councillor, historian and librarian, serving three successive rulers. Independently of Newton he developed the calculus, and also devised binary arithmetic and a mechanical calculating machine. In his Théodicée and Monadology he argued that this is the best of all possible worlds. Out of favour with George I, he died neglected in Hanover in 1716.
zh: 戈特弗里德·威廉·莱布尼茨（1646—1716），生于莱比锡，是德意志百科全书式的全才，身兼数学家、哲学家、图书馆馆长和外交官。七岁起，他便可使用亡父的藏书，在那里广泛阅读哲学和神学著作。1672年他被派往巴黎，在那里潜心钻研数学；1676年进入汉诺威的不伦瑞克公爵幕府，历任三任君主的顾问、史官和图书馆馆长。他独立于牛顿发展出微积分，还提出二进制算术、造出机械计算机。在《神正论》和《单子论》中，他论证我们这个世界是“一切可能世界中最好的世界”。他后来失宠于英王乔治一世，1716年在汉诺威冷清离世。

en: Georg Bartisch (1535–1607), born at Gräfenhain near Königsbrück in Saxony, was a barber-surgeon and pioneering eye specialist. Apprenticed at thirteen, he spent years as an itinerant surgeon through Saxony, Silesia and Bohemia before settling in Dresden as court oculist to the Saxon electors. Though he had no academic medical training, he became a skilled practitioner of eye surgery and also operated to remove urinary stones. In 1583 he published Ophthalmodouleia, the first comprehensive German textbook of ophthalmology, with ninety-two woodcuts of eye diseases and instruments, and gave the first printed account of removing a diseased eyeball. Skilled but superstitious, he held that astrology, witchcraft and magic had a place in medicine.
zh: 格奥尔格·巴蒂施（1535—1607），生于萨克森柯尼希斯布吕克附近的格拉芬海因，是理发师外科医生出身的眼科先驱。他十三岁拜师学艺，此后多年作为游医走遍萨克森、西里西亚和波希米亚，最后在德累斯顿定居，担任萨克森选帝侯的宫廷眼科医师。他虽未受过学院医学训练，却擅长眼科手术，也施行过取出尿路结石的手术。1583年，他出版《眼科医术》，这是第一部用德语写成的系统眼科学教科书，配有92幅描绘眼病和手术器械的木刻，并首次刊文记述摘除病眼的手术。他医术精湛却迷信，认为占星、巫术和魔法在医学中自有其位置。

en: Facino Cane da Casale (1360–16 May 1412), born Bonifacio Cane, was an Italian condottiero from Casale Monferrato. After early service under Charles of Durazzo, king of Naples, he hired his company to Verona, Padua and the Marquess of Montferrat. Captured by Padua in 1387, he entered its service after his release. His cruelty later led the marquess to dismiss him in 1397. He entered Visconti service in 1401 and gained Alessandria, Novara and Tortona. After Duke Gian Galeazzo's death in 1402 and his widow Caterina's in 1404, Facino largely controlled Milan for their young sons. Made count of Biandrate in 1406, he died at Pavia in 1412. His widow Beatrice married Filippo Maria Visconti, who inherited Facino's cities, treasure and soldiers.
zh: 法奇诺·卡内·达·卡萨莱（1360—1412年5月16日），出生时名博尼法乔·卡内，是出身卡萨莱蒙费拉托的意大利雇佣兵首领。他早年效力那不勒斯国王杜拉佐的查理，此后先后率雇佣军受雇于维罗纳、帕多瓦和蒙费拉托侯爵。1387年他被帕多瓦俘获，获释后转投帕多瓦；后来他的暴虐使侯爵于1397年将他解雇。1401年他转投米兰维斯孔蒂家族，获得亚历山德里亚、诺瓦拉和托尔托纳。吉安·加莱亚佐公爵于1402年去世、遗孀卡泰里娜于1404年去世后，法奇诺为他们年幼的儿子们大体掌控米兰。1406年他受封比安德拉泰伯爵，1412年死于帕维亚。遗孀贝亚特丽切改嫁菲利波·马利亚·维斯孔蒂，后者继承了法奇诺的城邑、财宝和军队。

en: Simone da Orsenigo was a fourteenth-century Lombard architect and builder, probably a native of Orsenigo near Como. He is remembered for his work on Milan Cathedral, where a document of 1387 names him its first general engineer and master. On the 1387 list of masters his name appears just after Marco da Campione, who headed the works, and he initially raised the structure in brick in the Lombard style. Replaced as engineer by Nicolas de Bonaventure in 1389, he kept working at the cathedral until 1395.
zh: 西蒙内·达·奥尔塞尼戈是14世纪伦巴第建筑师与营造师，可能是科莫附近奥尔塞尼戈人。他因参与修建米兰大教堂而为人铭记：1387年的一份文件称他为大教堂首任总工程师兼师傅；在1387年的工匠名单上，他的名字紧随主持工程的马尔科·达·坎皮奥内之后。他最初以砖石按伦巴第风格起建大教堂，1389年工程师之职由尼古拉·德·博纳文图尔接任，他本人则继续在大教堂任职至1395年。

en: Jacopo Dal Verme (1350–12 February 1409) was an Italian condottiero born at Verona, the son of condottiero Luchino Dal Verme. He began his career under Alberico da Barbiano and the Scaliger lords, then served the Visconti of Milan almost continuously from 1379, becoming Gian Galeazzo Visconti's captain general. He helped capture Bernabò Visconti in 1385, obtained Padua's surrender in 1387 and routed Jean III of Armagnac's French invasion army at Alessandria in 1391. In 1397 he took Borgoforte but was defeated by Carlo Malatesta, later helping Milan and Mantua make peace. He helped win the battle of Casalecchio in 1402. After Gian Galeazzo's death he defeated Facino Cane at Binasco, switched to Venice in 1407, and died there in 1409.
zh: 雅各布·达尔·韦尔梅（1350—1409年2月12日）是出生于维罗纳的意大利雇佣兵首领，父亲也是雇佣兵首领卢基诺·达尔·韦尔梅。他早年在阿尔贝里科·达·巴尔比亚诺和维罗纳斯卡拉家族麾下效力，1379年起长期追随米兰维斯孔蒂家族，成为吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂的统帅。1385年他参与擒获贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂，1387年迫使帕多瓦投降，1391年在亚历山德里亚之战击溃阿马尼亚克伯爵让三世的法国入侵军。1397年他攻占博尔戈福尔泰，却败于卡洛·马拉泰斯塔，后来促成米兰与曼托瓦讲和。1402年他参与赢得卡萨莱基奥之战。吉安·加莱亚佐死后，他在比纳斯科击败法奇诺·卡内，1407年转投威尼斯，1409年在那里去世。

en: Dragoș, called Vodă or the Founder, is traditionally regarded as the first voivode of Moldavia. Moldavian chronicles relate that he came from Maramureș in the mid-fourteenth century chasing an aurochs across the Carpathians and dismounted on the banks of the Moldova River; this dismounting became the legendary symbol of the principality's foundation. Most chronicles date his arrival to 1359, though historians have proposed earlier dates. He headed a Hungarian border march that emerged after Hungary's 1345 victory over the Golden Horde. Early sources credit him with founding Baia and Siret and inviting Saxon settlers, who introduced viticulture. Local tradition holds that he made his residence at Siret. He was succeeded by his son Sas; his grandson Balc was later expelled by Bogdan of Cuhea.
zh: 德拉戈什，人称沃德或奠基者，被传统视为摩尔多瓦首任沃伊沃德。摩尔多瓦编年史记载，他在14世纪中叶从马拉穆列什出发，翻越喀尔巴阡山追逐一头原牛，在摩尔多瓦河畔下马；这次下马成为公国奠基的传奇象征。多数编年史将他的到来定在1359年，但历史学家提出了更早的日期。1345年匈牙利击败金帐汗国后，一处匈牙利边疆领地随之出现，他成为其首领。早期史料称巴亚与锡雷特两城由他建立，他还邀来撒克逊移民，引入葡萄种植。当地传说他以锡雷特为驻地。他死后儿子萨斯继位，孙子巴尔克后来被库赫亚的博格丹驱逐。

en: Mohammed al-Shaykh (c. 1490–1557), son of the Saadi leader Abu Abdallah al-Qaim, became the first sultan of the Saadian dynasty. After his father died in 1517 he and his brother Ahmad al-Araj led the war against the Portuguese, taking Marrakesh in 1524 while Mohammed ruled Taroudannt. The Saadians and Wattasids divided their territories by the Treaty of Tadla in 1527, but the brothers later fell into conflict. He captured Agadir in 1541, forcing the Portuguese from Azamor and Safi, then seized Fez in 1549 and overthrew the Wattasids. He lost the city in 1554 but defeated the restored Wattasids at Tadla and retook it. While preparing an alliance with Spain against the Ottomans, he was assassinated by their agents in 1557 and buried in the Saadian Tombs at Marrakesh.
zh: 穆罕默德·谢赫（约1490—1557）是萨阿德家族首领阿布·阿卜杜拉·加伊姆之子，后来成为萨阿德王朝的第一位苏丹。1517年父亲去世后，他与兄弟艾哈迈德·阿拉杰共同领导对葡萄牙人的战争，1524年攻占马拉喀什，他本人则以塔鲁丹特为根据地。1527年萨阿德人与瓦塔斯人订立塔德莱条约，划分各自的势力范围，但兄弟二人后来发生冲突。1541年他攻克阿加迪尔，迫使葡萄牙人撤出艾宰穆尔和萨菲；1549年又攻取非斯，攻灭瓦塔斯王朝。1554年他失去非斯，却在塔德莱击败复辟的瓦塔斯势力，收复该城。1557年，他正筹划联合西班牙对抗奥斯曼人，被奥斯曼刺客杀害，葬于马拉喀什的萨阿德王陵。

en: Abu Zakariya Yahya ibn Ziyan al-Wattasi (died 1448) was a Wattasid strongman and vizier of Marinid Morocco. As long-time governor of Salé, he seized the Fez palace after Sultan Abu Sa'id Uthman III was assassinated in 1420, installed the infant Abd al-Haqq II as sultan, and ruled as regent. Granada and Tlemcen backed rival claimants, while regional governors asserted their independence. He kept power after the sultan came of age in 1436. When Prince Henry the Navigator's Portuguese army besieged Tangier in 1437, Abu Zakariya rallied Moroccan forces and starved it into surrender, securing a treaty promising the return of Ceuta. The victory won him widespread support. He ruled until his death, founding the Wattasid line of viziers and later sultans.
zh: 阿布·扎卡里亚·叶海亚·伊本·齐扬·瓦塔西（？—1448年）是瓦塔斯家族权臣，曾任马林王朝摩洛哥的维齐尔。他长期担任塞拉总督，1420年马林苏丹阿布·赛义德·奥斯曼三世遇刺后赶赴非斯控制王宫，拥立幼童阿卜杜勒·哈克二世继位，自任摄政。格拉纳达与特莱姆森支持其他王位觊觎者，各地总督也纷纷割据。1436年苏丹成年后他拒绝交权。1437年葡萄牙恩里克王子率军围攻丹吉尔，阿布·扎卡里亚召集摩洛哥军队围困敌营，断粮迫其投降并立约归还休达。这场胜利使他获得广泛支持。他执政直至去世，开创了瓦塔斯家族维齐尔和后来的苏丹世系。

en: Dmitry Yuryevich Krasny (died 22 September 1440) was the youngest son of Yury of Zvenigorod and grandson of Dmitry Donskoy, prince of Galich-Mersky. In the Great Feudal War he backed his father's moderate line, making peace with Vasily II in 1433 and receiving Bezhetsky Verkh. He and Yury pledged not to help his brothers Kosoy and Shemyaka, though he joined their father's march on Moscow in 1434. In 1437 he and his brother Dmitry Shemyaka led the army Khan Ulugh Muhammad routed at Belyov, and he governed Moscow in Vasily's absence in 1439. He died at Bezhetsky Verkh in 1440 after a strange, wasting illness; the chronicler's details suggest arsenic poisoning.
zh: 德米特里·尤里耶维奇·克拉斯内（？—1440年9月22日）是兹韦尼哥罗德王公尤里的幼子、德米特里·顿斯科伊之孙，加利奇-梅尔斯基王公。大封建战争期间，他追随父亲的温和路线，1433年与瓦西里二世和解并得到别热茨基韦尔赫。他与尤里承诺不援助兄长科索伊和舍米亚卡，1434年却又随父亲进军莫斯科。1437年，他与兄长德米特里·舍米亚卡共同率军，在别廖夫被兀鲁·穆罕默德汗击败；1439年瓦西里不在时代管莫斯科。1440年他在别热茨基韦尔赫患怪病衰竭而死，编年史对症状的记载使人怀疑他死于砒霜中毒。

en: Vasily Yuryevich Kosoy (c. 1403–1448), nicknamed the Squint, was the eldest son of Yury of Zvenigorod and a grandson of Dmitry Donskoy, and prince of Zvenigorod from 1421. Donskoy had placed Yury after his elder son Vasily I in the succession, but Vasily I passed the claim to his own sons, setting the two branches against each other. When Kosoy's father seized Moscow from Vasily II and then died in 1434, Kosoy proclaimed himself grand prince. His own brother Dmitry Shemyaka rejected him, joined Vasily II and drove him from the city in 1435. On 14 May 1436 Kosoy was defeated near Skoryatin in Rostov province, captured and blinded, and he died in captivity in 1448.
zh: 瓦西里·尤里耶维奇·科索伊（约1403—1448），绰号“斜眼”，是兹韦尼哥罗德王公尤里的长子、德米特里·顿斯科伊之孙，1421年起为兹韦尼哥罗德王公。顿斯科伊将尤里列在长子瓦西里一世之后继承大公之位，但瓦西里一世将继承权传给自己的儿子，两支家族因此发生争斗。1434年科索伊的父亲从瓦西里二世手中夺取莫斯科后不久死去，科索伊自立为大公。他的亲弟德米特里·舍米亚卡拒不承认，转而联合瓦西里二世，于1435年将他逐出莫斯科。1436年5月14日，科索伊在罗斯托夫的斯科里亚京附近战败被俘，随即被刺瞎双目，1448年死于囚禁之中。

en: Raja Todar Mal (1523/1524–1589) was Akbar's finance minister and one of the nine Navaratnas. Born at Laharpur in Awadh into a Hindu family, he began as a clerk and was entrusted by Sher Shah Suri with building the fort of Rohtas in Punjab. He entered Mughal service after the fall of the Sur dynasty, later governing Gujarat, running the Bengal mint and rising to four thousand cavalry rank. As Akbar's dewan he overhauled the empire's land revenue, introducing standard measurements, the zabt assessment and a ten-year settlement. His 1582–1584 decrees made Persian the language of Mughal administration. He rebuilt the Kashi Vishwanath temple in 1585, translated the Bhagavata Purana into Persian and died at Lahore in 1589.
zh: 拉贾·托达尔·马尔（1523/1524—1589）是阿克巴的财政大臣，也是宫廷九宝之一。他生于阿瓦德的拉哈尔普尔一个印度教家庭，早年任文书，后受舍尔沙·苏利之命修筑旁遮普的罗赫塔斯堡。苏尔王朝覆亡后他转入莫卧儿效力，曾任古吉拉特总督、掌管孟加拉铸币厂，获四千秩军衔。任财政大臣期间，他全面改革帝国田赋，推行统一丈量、扎卜特估税与十年定税制度，1582至1584年的政令又确立波斯语为莫卧儿行政语言。1585年他重建卡西·毗湿瓦纳特神庙，又将《薄伽梵往世书》译成波斯语，1589年在拉合尔去世。

en: Ustad Ahmad Lahori, also called Ahmad Mi'mar, Ahmad the Architect (c. 1570–1649), was a Persian-speaking architect and engineer serving the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan. The emperor's official chronicle names him with Ustad Hamid among the planners of the Red Fort at Delhi, built from 1639 to 1648 as the centre of the new capital Shahjahanabad. The emperor approved their plan and made his first state entry into the completed fort in 1648. Ahmad is widely credited with designing the Taj Mahal at Agra, the marble mausoleum for Shah Jahan's wife, though the only explicit evidence is a poem by his son Lutfullah Muhandis. His three sons were also architects; Lutfullah was an engineer, mathematician and poet. Ahmad died in 1649.
zh: 乌斯塔德·艾哈迈德·拉合里，又称建筑师艾哈迈德·艾马尔（约1570—1649），是效力莫卧儿皇帝沙贾汉的波斯语建筑师与工程师。皇帝的官方编年史将他与乌斯塔德·哈米德并列为德里红堡的设计者：红堡建于1639至1648年，是新都沙贾汉纳巴德的核心。皇帝批准了他们的设计，并于1648年首次以君主身份进入落成的红堡。艾哈迈德被普遍认为主持设计了阿格拉的泰姬陵，即沙贾汉为妻子修建的大理石陵墓，尽管唯一明确的证据出自其子卢特富拉·穆汉迪斯的一首诗。他的三个儿子也都是建筑师；卢特富拉还是工程师、数学家和诗人。艾哈迈德于1649年去世。

en: Luigi Vanvitelli (1700–1773), born in Naples to the Dutch painter Caspar van Wittel, was Italy's leading architect of the mid-eighteenth century, bridging Late Baroque and Neoclassicism. He began as a history painter and worked at St Peter's in Rome from 1724. After early work in Rome he built the pentagonal lazaretto at Ancona from 1733 and remodeled the basilica of Santa Maria degli Angeli. In 1750 Charles VII of Naples summoned him; his 1751 design for the Royal Palace of Caserta, with four courtyards, a grand staircase and a park axis, became the largest palace of its age and occupied him until his death at Caserta in 1773. His son Carlo completed the work.
zh: 路易吉·万维泰利（1700—1773）生于那不勒斯，父亲是荷兰风景画家卡斯帕·范·维特尔，是18世纪中叶意大利最重要的建筑师，风格介于晚期巴洛克与新古典主义之间。他最初是历史画家，1724年起在罗马圣彼得大教堂工作。他早年在罗马工作，1733年起在安科纳修建五边形的传染病隔离院，又改建了天使与殉教者圣母大殿。1750年，那不勒斯国王查理七世将他召去；他1751年设计的卡塞塔王宫设有四个庭院、宏伟大阶梯和纵贯园林的中轴，是当时规模最大的宫殿，工程占据了他的余生，直到1773年在卡塞塔去世。其子卡洛完成了余下工程。

en: Antonio Corradini (1688–1752) was a Venetian Rococo sculptor celebrated for marble figures draped in veils so thin that the body beneath stays visible. He trained under Antonio Tarsia in Venice and later became his son-in-law. In 1716–1717 he carved eighteen busts and two statues for Peter the Great's summer garden at Saint Petersburg, and from 1733 served as court sculptor to Emperor Charles VI in Vienna. In 1744 he settled in Naples summoned by Raimondo di Sangro, Prince of Sansevero, to decorate the Sansevero Chapel, where in 1750 he finished La Pudicizia, the veiled tomb of the prince's mother. He died in Naples in 1752; his bozzetti later guided Giuseppe Sanmartino's Veiled Christ.
zh: 安东尼奥·科拉迪尼（1688—1752）是威尼斯洛可可雕塑家，以披纱大理石像闻名：轻纱之下的身体轮廓依然清晰可辨。他在威尼斯师从安东尼奥·塔尔西亚，后来成为他的女婿。1716至1717年，他为彼得大帝在圣彼得堡的夏园雕刻了十八座胸像和两座雕像，1733年起在维也纳担任皇帝查理六世的宫廷雕塑家。1744年，他应圣塞韦罗亲王雷蒙多·迪·桑格罗之召定居那不勒斯，负责圣塞韦罗礼拜堂的雕塑装饰，并于1750年完成亲王母亲的披纱陵墓《羞怯》。1752年他卒于那不勒斯；他留下的草稿后来指引朱塞佩·圣马尔蒂诺完成了《蒙面基督》。

en: Charles d'Artois (c. 1300–1346) was the illegitimate son of Robert the Wise of Naples by Cantelma Cantelmo, raised at the royal court. He became his father's chamberlain in 1317 and received the barony of Roccaromana in 1322. On his deathbed in 1343 Robert named him and Queen Sancia guardians of his granddaughters Joanna and Maria. Joanna I made him Chancellor of the Realm and Count of Sant'Agata de' Goti in 1345. A leading plotter in the murder that September of her husband Andrew, he was condemned to death and fled with his eldest son to his county. Captured by Catherine, Latin Empress, and her son Louis of Taranto, he died at Melfi in 1346, of stress or poison.
zh: 夏尔·德·阿图瓦（约1300—1346）是那不勒斯国王罗贝托一世与坎泰尔玛·坎泰尔莫的私生子，自幼在王宫长大。1317年他成为父亲的侍从长，1322年获封罗卡罗马纳男爵。1343年罗贝托临终时指定他与王后桑恰共同监护孙女乔万娜和玛丽亚。1345年乔万娜一世任命他为王国御前大臣，封圣阿加塔-德戈蒂伯爵。同年9月，他是谋杀乔万娜丈夫安德烈的主谋之一，被判死刑后与长子逃往自己的封地。他被拉丁帝国女皇卡泰琳娜及其子塔兰托的路易俘获，1346年死于梅尔菲，一说忧惧而死、一说遭毒杀。

en: Jan Adriaenszoon Leeghwater (1575–1650), born Jan Adriaenszoon at De Rijp in North Holland, was a Dutch millwright and hydraulic engineer. In 1605 he obtained a patent for a diving bell that allowed work underwater. As a supervisor and millwright he helped drain the Beemster, completed in 1612, and worked on the draining of the Purmer (1622), Wormer (1626) and Schermer (1635). In 1629 he drained the marshes around besieged 's-Hertogenbosch for the Dutch army, and his 1641 book urged draining the Haarlemmermeer. He also improved the rotating-cap wooden windmill and died in Amsterdam.
zh: 扬·阿德里安松·莱赫瓦特（1575—1650），原名扬·阿德里安松，生于北荷兰省的德赖普，是荷兰风车工匠与水利工程师。1605年，他取得潜水钟专利，使人在水下工作成为可能。他以监工和风车工匠身份参与排干贝姆斯特湖的工程，工程于1612年完工；他也参与了皮尔默湖（1622）、沃尔默湖（1626）和斯赫尔默湖（1635）的排水工程。1629年，他为围攻斯海尔托亨博斯的荷兰军队排干城周沼泽；1641年他著书倡议排干哈勒默梅尔湖。他还改进了可转动风帽的木制风车，后卒于阿姆斯特丹。

en: Antonie van Leeuwenhoek (1632–1723) was a Dutch scientist born at Delft. At sixteen he became an apprentice at a linen-draper's shop in Amsterdam, before opening his own shop in Delft in 1654. He served as a municipal chamberlain from 1660 and was appointed a land surveyor in 1669. Largely self-taught, he took up lens grinding and in the 1670s built single-lens microscopes of his own making, achieving magnifications far beyond earlier lenses. He was the first to describe bacteria, protozoa, sperm cells and blood corpuscles, reporting his findings in some 560 letters to the Royal Society. He died at Delft on 26 August 1723, remembered as a founder of microbiology.
zh: 安东尼·范·列文虎克（1632—1723）是荷兰科学家，生于代尔夫特。16岁时他在阿姆斯特丹一家亚麻布店当学徒，1654年回到代尔夫特开店。他1660年起担任市政厅管理员，1669年获任土地测量员。他基本靠自学掌握磨镜技术，1670年代用自制的单透镜显微镜取得远超以往的放大效果，最早描述了细菌、原生动物、精子和红细胞。他把发现写成约560封信件寄给皇家学会。1723年8月26日他在代尔夫特去世，被视为微生物学的奠基人之一。

en: Pierre Bayle (1647–1706) was a French Huguenot philosopher, born at Carla-le-Comte near Pamiers, the son of a Calvinist minister. After studying at Puylaurens, he converted to Catholicism at Toulouse in 1669, returned to Calvinism and fled to Geneva. He held the chair of philosophy at the Protestant Academy of Sedan from 1675. In 1681 he fled persecution for the Dutch Republic shortly before the academy was suppressed, and became professor of philosophy and history at Rotterdam, losing the chair in 1693. His Historical and Critical Dictionary, published from 1697, deployed skepticism and footnotes in defence of toleration and shaped the Enlightenment. He died in Rotterdam in 1706.
zh: 皮埃尔·培尔（1647—1706）是法国胡格诺派哲学家，生于帕米耶附近的卡拉勒孔特，父亲是加尔文宗牧师。他在皮洛朗求学后，于1669年在图卢兹改宗天主教，后来重返加尔文宗并逃往日内瓦。1675年起，他在色当新教学院执掌哲学教席。1681年他为逃避迫害流亡荷兰共和国，不久学院遭查封；他在鹿特丹出任哲学与历史教授，1693年被解除教席。他自1697年起出版《历史批判辞典》，以怀疑论和大量注释为宗教宽容辩护，深刻影响了启蒙运动。1706年他在鹿特丹去世。

en: Hugo Grotius (1583–1645), born at Delft, was a Dutch humanist and jurist, a Leiden-trained prodigy. In 1598 he accompanied Johan van Oldenbarnevelt on a diplomatic mission to France. In 1609 he published Mare Liberum (The Free Sea), arguing the sea belonged to no state and was open to all trade, backing Dutch commerce against Portuguese monopoly. Amid disputes over religious policy in the Dutch Republic, he was seized with Oldenbarnevelt in 1618 and jailed for life in Loevestein Castle, but escaped in 1621 hidden in a book chest and fled to Paris. There in 1625 he issued De Jure Belli ac Pacis, a foundation of modern international law. Later Swedish ambassador in France, he died at Rostock in 1645.
zh: 胡果·格劳秀斯（1583—1645）生于代尔夫特，是荷兰人文主义者与法学家，年少即入莱顿大学求学的神童。1598年，他随约翰·范·奥尔登巴内费尔特出使法国。1609年，他出版《海洋自由论》，主张海洋不属于任何国家、应对一切贸易开放，为荷兰人打破葡萄牙贸易垄断的商业活动提供依据。荷兰共和国发生宗教政策争论，1618年他与奥尔登巴内费尔特一同被捕，被判终身囚禁于勒芬斯坦城堡；1621年他藏在书箱中越狱，逃往巴黎。1625年他在巴黎发表《战争与和平法》，为现代国际法奠定了基础。他后来出任瑞典驻法国大使，1645年卒于罗斯托克。

en: Rembrandt Harmenszoon van Rijn (1606–1669) was a Dutch painter and printmaker. Born in Leiden to a miller, he trained under Pieter Lastman in Amsterdam and opened a Leiden studio in 1625. Discovered by Constantijn Huygens in 1629, he moved to Amsterdam in 1631 and became its leading portraitist, marrying Saskia van Uylenburgh in 1634. His subjects included self-portraits and scenes from the Bible. Between 1640 and 1642 he painted The Night Watch. Saskia died in 1642, and his passion for collecting art forced him to declare insolvency in 1656; his collection was sold. Undiminished, he painted late masterpieces including The Jewish Bride before dying in Amsterdam in 1669. About three hundred paintings and three hundred etchings survive.
zh: 伦勃朗·哈尔门松·范·赖恩（1606—1669）是荷兰画家与版画家。他生于莱顿的磨坊主家庭，曾在阿姆斯特丹师从彼得·拉斯特曼，1625年在莱顿开设画室。1629年他得到康斯坦丁·惠更斯赏识，1631年迁居阿姆斯特丹，成为当地首屈一指的肖像画家，并于1634年娶萨斯基娅·范·厄伊伦堡为妻。他的题材包括自画像与圣经场景。1640至1642年间他绘成《夜巡》。萨斯基娅于1642年去世；他因热衷于收藏艺术品而在1656年被迫宣告破产，藏品被变卖。困境中他仍画出《犹太新娘》等晚期杰作，1669年卒于阿姆斯特丹。存世的油画与蚀刻画各约三百幅。

en: Menno van Coehoorn (1641–1704) was a Dutch officer and military engineer, born near Leeuwarden. Commissioned in 1657, he was wounded defending Maastricht in 1673 and fought at Seneffe in 1674 during the Franco-Dutch War. The rapid fall of Dutch fortresses in 1672 had exposed the weakness of their defences. He redesigned Dutch fortifications for the low, waterlogged terrain, relying on multiple lines and water defences, and was ranked with the French engineer Vauban as the age's leading siege expert. As inspector general of fortifications, he strengthened the Barrier towns after the 1697 Treaty of Ryswick, prioritising Nijmegen and Bergen op Zoom with limited funds. He took Venlo, Bonn and Huy in 1702–1703. He died at The Hague on 17 March 1704.
zh: 门诺·范·库霍恩（1641—1704）是荷兰军官与军事工程师，生于吕伐登附近。他1657年入伍，1673年在法荷战争中守卫马斯特里赫特负伤，1674年参加瑟内夫战役。1672年荷兰要塞迅速陷落，暴露了防御体系的弱点。他针对低湿地形重新设计荷兰防御工事，依托多道防线与水上设防，与法国工程师沃邦并称当时首屈一指的攻城筑城专家。作为防御工事总监，他在1697年《赖斯韦克条约》签订后主持加固屏障城镇，资金有限时优先加强奈梅亨和卑尔根奥普佐姆。他于1702至1703年攻取芬洛、波恩和于伊。1704年3月17日，他在海牙去世。

en: Willem Barentsz (c. 1550–1597) was a Dutch cartographer and navigator who led three expeditions seeking a Northeast Passage to China. He had sailed to Spain and the Mediterranean to prepare an atlas, which he published with Petrus Plancius. He believed the summer sun would melt the ice north of Siberia and leave a route open to trade. In 1594 he mapped Novaya Zemlya's west coast before ice drove him back, and a six-ship follow-up in 1595 also failed. In May 1596 he sailed again with Jacob van Heemskerk, discovering Bear Island and Spitsbergen, but his ship was trapped off Novaya Zemlya, where the sixteen men wintered in a driftwood lodge, Het Behouden Huys. In June 1597 survivors set out in open boats; Barentsz died at sea on 20 June. The Barents Sea bears his name.
zh: 威廉·巴伦支（约1550—1597）是荷兰制图师与航海家，曾三次率领探险队寻找通往中国的东北航道。他曾航行至西班牙和地中海，为编制地图集做准备，后来与彼得鲁斯·普兰修斯合刊了这部地图集。他相信夏日的阳光会融化西伯利亚以北的海冰，开辟一条贸易航道。1594年，他测绘了新地岛西海岸，终因海冰被迫返航；1595年六艘船组成的后续探险同样失败。1596年5月，他与雅各布·范·海姆斯凯克再度出航，发现了熊岛和斯匹次卑尔根，但船只在新地岛外海被困，十六人在一座浮木小屋“得救之屋”中过冬。1597年6月，幸存者乘敞篷小船启程，巴伦支于6月20日在海上去世。巴伦支海即以他命名。

en: Frederick Coyett (c. 1615–1687) was a Swedish nobleman who served the Dutch East India Company. Born in Stockholm to a family that had migrated from Brabant, he was the son of a goldsmith and brother of diplomat Peter Julius Coyet. He joined the company in 1643 and twice headed its Dejima trading post in Japan, in 1647–1648 and 1652–1653, helping free the Dutch sailors of the Nambu affair. Ennobled by Queen Christina in 1649, he became governor of Formosa in 1656. In 1661–1662 Zheng Chenggong's nine-month siege of Fort Zeelandia forced his surrender and ended Dutch rule. Exiled to the Banda Islands in 1665, he was ransomed and pardoned in 1674, and died in 1687.
zh: 弗雷德里克·揆一（约1615—1687）是效力于荷兰东印度公司的瑞典贵族，生于斯德哥尔摩，家族由布拉班特迁来。他的父亲是金匠，兄弟彼得·尤利乌斯·科耶特是外交官。他1643年加入公司，1647至1648年、1652至1653年两度出掌公司驻日本出岛商馆，并参与解决南部事件，促成被俘的荷兰船员获释。1649年他受瑞典克里斯蒂娜女王册封为贵族，1656年出任台湾长官。1661至1662年，郑成功围攻热兰遮城九个月，揆一被迫投降，荷兰在台统治就此终结。他于1665年流放班达群岛，1674年经赎身获赦，1687年去世。

en: Pieter Post (1608–1669) was a Dutch Golden Age architect, painter and printmaker, baptised at Haarlem, where he entered the Guild of Saint Luke in 1623. His father was a stained-glass painter, and his younger brother Frans also became a painter. With his collaborator Jacob van Campen he created the Dutch Baroque style of architecture, and together they designed the Mauritshuis in The Hague. As painter and architect to Stadtholder Frederik Hendrik, he oversaw additions to the Noordeinde Palace from 1640 and built Huis ten Bosch from 1645. His son Maurits also became an architect. He died at The Hague, where he was buried on 8 May 1669.
zh: 彼得·波斯特（1608—1669）是荷兰黄金时代的建筑师、画家与版画家，在哈勒姆受洗，并于1623年加入当地的圣路加行会。他的父亲是彩绘玻璃画家，弟弟弗兰斯也成为画家。他与合作者雅各布·范·坎彭共同开创了荷兰巴洛克建筑风格，两人联手设计了海牙的莫瑞泰斯皇家美术馆。作为执政弗雷德里克·亨德里克的御用画家和建筑师，他自1640年起主持诺尔代恩德宫的扩建，又于1645年起督造豪斯登堡宫。他的儿子毛里茨也成为建筑师。1669年5月8日，他在海牙下葬。

en: Sigurd Jonsson (1390s–1452) was a Norwegian nobleman and knight, descended through the Sudreim family from King Haakon V. He is first recorded on the Norwegian Council of the Realm in 1434. In 1440, after the council deposed King Erik, Sigurd ruled Norway as drottsete during the interregnum, until Christopher of Bavaria was crowned in Oslo in 1442. He commanded Akershus Fortress from 1440 to 1445 and led Norway's anti-Hanseatic policies. When Christopher died in 1448, he again guarded the realm, declined the crown himself, and backed Christian I. Part of the Norwegian council crowned the Swedish king Karl Knutsson instead, but Sigurd resisted him in southern Norway. Karl abandoned his claim and Christian was crowned in 1450.
zh: 西古尔德·荣松（1390年代—1452）是挪威贵族与骑士，出身苏德尔海姆家族，为国王哈康五世的后裔。1434年他首次见于挪威王国政务会议的记载。1440年政务会议废黜国王埃里克后，他在王位空悬期以摄政身份统治挪威，直到1442年巴伐利亚的克里斯托弗在奥斯陆加冕。1440至1445年他担任阿克斯胡斯城堡指挥官，并主导挪威的反汉萨政策。1448年克里斯托弗去世后他再度守护王国，本人拒绝王位，转而支持克里斯蒂安一世。部分挪威议员却拥立瑞典国王卡尔·克努特松，西古尔德在挪威南部抵抗他。卡尔放弃王位主张，克里斯蒂安于1450年加冕。

en: Cort Sivertsen Adeler (1622–1675) was a Norwegian-born seaman, the son of a shipper at Brevik, who entered the Dutch navy at fifteen and fought at the Battle of the Downs in 1639. From 1642 he served aboard a Dutch ship hired by Venice, becoming its captain in 1645 and flag captain in 1650. On 13 May 1654 his ship broke the Turkish galley line near the Dardanelles and sank fifteen galleys; Tenedos surrendered to him the following day. He was knighted in the Order of Saint Mark and became vice-admiral in 1660. Ennobled by Denmark in 1666, he led the Dano-Norwegian fleet until his death at Copenhagen in 1675.
zh: 科特·西韦尔森·阿德勒尔（1622—1675）生于挪威布雷维克，父亲是船主。他十五岁加入荷兰海军，1639年参加唐斯海战。1642年起他在一艘受雇于威尼斯的荷兰船上服役，1645年成为船长，1650年成为旗舰舰长。1654年5月13日，他的战舰在达达尼尔海峡附近冲破土耳其桨帆船的战线，击沉敌船十五艘；次日忒涅多斯岛向他投降。他受封圣马可骑士，1660年升任海军中将。1666年他被丹麦封为贵族，此后统领丹挪联合舰队，直至1675年在哥本哈根病逝。

en: Ingerd Ottesdotter Rømer (c. 1475–1555), lady of Austrått, was the wealthiest landowner in sixteenth-century Norway. Heiress of the noble Rømer family, she married Nils Henriksson, who became Chancellor and High Steward of Norway; her Austrått estate in the Trondheimsfjord made her daughters the most sought-after brides in the realm. Widowed in 1523, she worked through her powerful sons-in-law and opposed Archbishop Olav Engelbrektsson. In 1526 she received the exiled Swedish chancellor Peder Sunnanväder. Two years later she sheltered a claimant calling himself Nils Sture and planned to marry her daughter Eline to him and place him on Sweden's throne. She and her family embraced and promoted the Lutheran Reformation. She died in a shipwreck in 1555.
zh: 英厄·奥特斯多塔·罗默（约1475—1555）是奥斯特罗特庄园的女主人，也是16世纪挪威最富有的地主。作为罗默贵族家族的继承人，她嫁给后来官居挪威首相兼宫廷大总管的尼尔斯·亨里克松；她在特隆赫姆峡湾的奥斯特罗特遗产，使女儿们成为国内最受追捧的联姻对象。1523年守寡后，她借几位权势显赫的女婿行事，并与总主教奥拉夫·恩格尔布雷克特松对抗。1526年她接纳了流亡的瑞典前大臣佩德尔·松南韦德尔。两年后，她庇护了一位自称尼尔斯·斯图雷的王位觊觎者，计划将女儿埃琳嫁给他并助他登上瑞典王位。她全家皈依并大力推动路德宗宗教改革。1555年她在一场海难中丧生。

en: Niels Henrikssøn Gyldenløve (c. 1455–1523) was a Norwegian knight and landowner, the son of national counselor Henrik Jensson. By marrying Ingerd Ottesdotter Rømer, heiress of Austrått in the Trondheimsfjord, he settled an inheritance feud over the great manor and became one of Norway's largest landowners, with estates from Bergen and Vardøhus to Sunnmøre and Herjedalen. He and Ingerd had five daughters. He joined the Council of the Realm around 1483 and remained central to the government until his death. He took the honorific title of High Steward in 1514 or 1515, when he also joined the delegation fetching Christian II's bride Isabella of Burgundy.
zh: 尼尔斯·亨里克松·吉伦勒夫（约1455—1523）是挪威骑士与大地主，王国政务会议成员亨里克·延松之子。他娶了特隆赫姆峡湾奥斯特罗特庄园的女继承人英厄·奥特斯多塔·罗默，借此平息了围绕这座大庄园的继承之争，成为挪威最大的地主之一，领地从卑尔根、瓦德胡斯一直延伸到孙默勒与海里耶达伦。他与英厄育有五个女儿。约1483年他进入王国政务会议，直到去世都在政府中居于核心地位。1514或1515年他获授荣誉性的宫廷大总管头衔，并在同一时期参加迎接克里斯蒂安二世新娘勃艮第的伊莎贝拉的使团。

en: Karp was a fourteenth-century deacon in Pskov whom the chronicles name as the founder of the Strigolniki sect. He rejected the church hierarchy, monasticism and the fees charged for the sacraments, and taught that laymen might preach and perform the rites. His following first grew in Pskov and then spread to Novgorod. The chronicles record that in 1375 or 1376 the Novgorodians drowned Karp, the deacon Nikita and a third follower in the Volkhov River.
zh: 卡尔普是14世纪普斯科夫的一名执事，被编年史称为剪裁派的创始人。他反对教会等级制度、修道制度和圣事收费，主张俗人也有讲道和施行圣事的权利。他的信众先在普斯科夫壮大，随后传入诺夫哥罗德。编年史记载，1375或1376年，诺夫哥罗德人把卡尔普、执事尼基塔和另一名信徒投入沃尔霍夫河溺死。

en: Marfa Boretskaya, known as Marfa the Mayoress (d. after 1478), was one of the wealthiest landowners of late fifteenth-century Novgorod and widow of the posadnik Isaak Boretsky. After his death she expanded her estates along the Onega River. In the 1470s she led the boyar faction resisting Moscow's centralizing pressure. In 1471 she and her sons Dmitry and Fyodor negotiated the city's submission to Casimir IV of Lithuania and invited Mikhailo Olelkovich to rule, provoking Ivan III's campaign; after the Battle of Shelon, Dmitry was executed. Fyodor was arrested and exiled in 1475. Marfa continued to intrigue with Lithuania until Ivan III annexed Novgorod in 1478, when she was taken to Moscow and her estates were seized.
zh: 玛尔法·博列茨卡娅，人称“女行政长官玛尔法”（1478年后去世），是15世纪末诺夫哥罗德最富有的地主之一，行政长官伊萨克·博列茨基的遗孀。丈夫去世后，她在奥涅加河沿岸扩大了地产。1470年代，她领导波雅尔贵族派抵抗莫斯科的集权压力。1471年，她与儿子德米特里、费奥多尔同立陶宛的卡齐米日四世谈判，谋图让诺夫哥罗德归附立陶宛，并迎立米哈伊洛·奥列尔科维奇为统治者，由此招致伊凡三世出兵；舍隆河战役战败后，德米特里被处死。1475年费奥多尔被捕流放。玛尔法继续借立陶宛周旋，直至1478年伊凡三世吞并诺夫哥罗德，她被押往莫斯科，地产被没收。

en: Sarala Dasa was an Odia poet of the fifteenth century, the age of Gajapati Kapilendra Deva (d. 1466), honoured as the Adi Kabi, or First Poet, of Odia literature. Born Siddheswara Parida at Kanakapura, he came from a farming family with little formal schooling. Tradition tells that the goddess Sarala heard him singing while ploughing his father's field and granted him the gift of poetry. His own Mahabharata contains indications that he served in the Gajapati king's army. He was the first major writer to compose in Odia rather than Sanskrit, giving ordinary readers the Sarala Mahabharata, the Vilanka Ramayana and the Chandi Purana.
zh: 萨拉拉·达萨是15世纪的奥里亚语诗人，生活在加贾帕蒂国王卡皮伦德拉·代沃（卒于1466年）的时代，被尊为奥里亚文学的“最初诗人”（阿迪·卡比）。他原名西德什瓦拉·帕里达，生于加纳格布尔，出身农家，几乎没有受过正规教育。相传他耕种父亲的田地时唱歌，萨拉拉女神听见后赐予他作诗的才能。他自己的《摩诃婆罗多》中有迹象表明，他曾在加贾帕蒂国王的军队中服役。他是最早以奥里亚语而非梵文进行创作的重要诗人，为普通读者写下《萨拉拉摩诃婆罗多》《维兰卡罗摩衍那》和《昌迪往世书》。

en: Achyutananda Dasa was a sixteenth-century Odia poet, seer and Vaishnava saint, later called the Mahapurusa, or Great Person. Born into a Karana family at Tripura village in Cuttack district, he was the son of Dinabandhu Mohanty, an official of the Gajapati king Prataparudra Deva (r. 1497–1538). With Balarama, Jagannatha, Ananta and Jasobanta Dasa he formed the Panchasakha, five comrades who rendered Sanskrit scriptures into Odia for common readers. The most prolific of the five, he composed the Harivamsa, Kaibarta Gita and Gurubhakti Gita, along with prophetic writings, and was believed to see past, present and future. His writings described contemporary society, while often speaking of himself through cryptic analogies.
zh: 阿丘塔南达·达萨是16世纪的奥里亚语诗人、先知与毗湿奴派圣人，后世尊为“大士”（摩诃普鲁沙）。他生于克塔克地区特里普拉村的卡拉纳家庭，父亲迪纳班杜·莫汉蒂是加贾帕蒂国王普拉塔帕鲁德拉·代沃（1497—1538年在位）的属官。他与巴拉拉姆、贾格纳特、阿南塔和亚索班塔四位达萨并称“五友”（潘查萨卡），将梵文经典译为奥里亚语，供平民诵读。五人中他著作最丰，著有《诃利世系》《凯巴尔塔歌》《古鲁虔诚歌》及大量预言诗，世人相信他能洞见过去、现在与未来。他的作品描写了当时的社会，却常以隐晦的比喻谈论自己。

en: Kapilendra Deva (died 25 November 1466) founded the Suryavamsa Gajapati Empire of Odisha. A commander under the last Eastern Ganga king, Bhanudeva IV, he took power as the dynasty collapsed and became Gajapati. He drove off invasions by the Jaunpur and Bengal sultanates, annexing Gauda lands beyond the Ganga in 1447–1450, and sent his son Hamvira south to take Rajahmundry, win Devarakonda in 1458 and advance to Tiruchirappalli by 1464. Under him Odisha stretched from the Ganga to the Kaveri. He reduced taxes and warned nobles against oppressing the people. A patron of Jagannath worship and Odia letters, he was succeeded by his youngest son Purushottama Deva, whose succession led to civil war with Hamvira.
zh: 卡皮伦德拉·代沃（卒于1466年11月25日）是奥里萨太阳族加贾帕蒂帝国的建立者。他本是东恒伽王朝末代国王巴努提婆四世麾下的将领，在王朝崩溃之际掌权，称“加贾帕蒂”。他击退江布尔与孟加拉苏丹国的入侵，于1447至1450年吞并恒河对岸的高达地区；又派儿子哈姆维拉南下，攻取拉贾蒙德里，1458年在德瓦拉孔达获胜，至1464年推进到蒂鲁吉拉帕利。在他治下，奥里萨疆域北起恒河、南至高韦里河。他减轻赋税，告诫贵族不要压迫百姓。他崇奉贾格纳特、扶持奥里亚文学，去世后由幼子普鲁肖塔玛·代沃继位，继承问题引发了他与哈姆维拉之间的内战。

en: Purushottama Dasa (c. 1550–1600) was a sixteenth-century Odia poet and devotee of Jagannath, born into a Karana family in Puri district, the son of Bhagirathi Das. A resident of Puri, he kept the accounts of the Jagannath temple and could describe its festivals from direct observation. His poem Kanchi Kaveri, weaving King Purushottama Deva's Kanchi campaign and marriage together with legends of Jagannath, Krishna and Balarama, became a classic of Odia verse and was later translated into Bengali. In the poem Jagannath is an unseen power leading the Gajapati king's army. He also wrote the puranic poem Ganga Mahatmya, printed in Bengali script for Bengali readers, and several shorter devotional works.
zh: 普鲁肖塔玛·达萨（约1550—1600）是16世纪的奥里亚语诗人、贾格纳特神的虔诚信徒，生于普里地区的卡拉纳家庭，父亲是巴吉拉蒂·达斯。他住在普里，负责贾格纳特神庙的账目，因而能据亲身见闻描写庙中的节庆。他的长诗《甘吉—高韦里》把加贾帕蒂国王普鲁肖塔玛·代沃出征甘吉并迎娶公主的史事，与贾格纳特、黑天和大力罗摩的传说交织成篇，成为奥里亚语诗歌的经典，后来被译成孟加拉语。诗中贾格纳特以无形的力量率领加贾帕蒂国王的军队。他还著有往世书题材的《恒河颂》及若干短篇虔诚诗作；《恒河颂》曾以孟加拉文字印行，供孟加拉读者阅读。

en: Johannes Reuchlin (1455–1522) was a German humanist and a distinguished Christian scholar of Greek and Hebrew. Born at Pforzheim, he learned Greek in Paris and lectured at Basel from 1477. In 1482 he accompanied Count Eberhard of Württemberg to Italy as an interpreter, later serving him as a diplomat and meeting Pico della Mirandola in 1490. Ennobled by Emperor Frederick III in 1492, he learned Hebrew from imperial physician Jakob Loans and published De Verbo Mirifico in 1494 and the kabbalistic dialogue De Arte Cabalistica. When the Dominicans moved to destroy Jewish books, he defended Hebrew literature before the Inquisition. He later taught Hebrew at Ingolstadt and Tübingen and died at Stuttgart.
zh: 约翰内斯·罗伊希林（1455—1522）是德意志人文主义者，也是精通希腊语与希伯来语的杰出基督教学者。他生于普福尔茨海姆，在巴黎学习希腊语，1477年起在巴塞尔讲学。1482年他作为译员随符腾堡伯爵埃伯哈德前往意大利，后来担任伯爵的外交官，1490年结识皮科·德拉·米兰多拉。1492年他被皇帝腓特烈三世封为贵族，向御医雅各布·洛恩斯学习希伯来语，1494年出版《论神迹之道》，后又写成卡巴拉对话录《论卡巴拉之艺》。当多明我会主张焚毁犹太书籍时，他在宗教裁判所面前为希伯来文献辩护。晚年他在因戈尔施塔特和蒂宾根教授希伯来语，最终在斯图加特去世。

en: Gian Pietro Carafa (1476–1559), of the Neapolitan Carafa family, was a rigid reforming churchman who became Pope Paul IV. As papal envoy in Spain he developed an hostility to Spanish rule that shaped his later policy. Bishop of Chieti, he resigned in 1524 and founded the Theatine order with Saint Cajetan. A cardinal from 1536 and later archbishop of Naples, he persuaded Pope Paul III in 1542 to establish the Roman Inquisition on the Spanish model, as one of its inquisitors-general. Elected pope in 1555 over Charles V's opposition, he issued the first Index of Prohibited Books and, by the bull Cum nimis absurdum, ghettoized Rome's Jews. He died in 1559, hated by the Roman populace.
zh: 吉安·彼得罗·卡拉法（1476—1559）出身那不勒斯的卡拉法家族，是作风强硬的改革派教士，后来成为教宗保罗四世。他担任教廷驻西班牙使节时形成了反对西班牙统治的立场，影响了日后的政策。他曾任基耶蒂主教，1524年辞职，与圣嘉耶当共同创立戴蒂尼会。1536年他成为枢机，后来出任那不勒斯大主教；1542年他劝说教宗保罗三世仿照西班牙宗教裁判所设立罗马宗教裁判所，并出任总裁判官之一。1555年他不顾查理五世反对当选教宗，任内发布第一部《禁书目录》，又颁行诏书将罗马的犹太人限制在隔都之中。1559年他去世时，罗马民众对他恨之入骨。

en: Ignazio Danti (April 1536–1586), born Pellegrino Rainaldi Danti in Perugia, came from a family of artists and scientists. His father, an architect and engineer, and his aunt Teodora taught him painting and architecture. He entered the Dominican Order in 1555 and devoted himself to mathematics, astronomy and geography. He taught mathematics at Bologna and mapped the Perugian republic before Pope Gregory XIII called him to Rome as pontifical mathematician. Danti sat on the commission whose work produced the Gregorian calendar reform and supervised the forty frescoed regional maps of the Vatican's Gallery of Maps (1580–1581). He also supplied plans for the repair of the Claudian harbour at Portus. In 1583 Gregory made him Bishop of Alatri, where he convoked a diocesan synod before his death on 10 October 1586.
zh: 伊尼亚齐奥·丹蒂（1536年4月—1586年）生于佩鲁贾，原名佩莱格里诺·雷纳尔迪·丹蒂，出身艺术与科学世家。他的父亲是建筑师兼工程师，曾与姑母泰奥多拉一道教他绘画和建筑。1555年他加入多明我会，此后致力于数学、天文学与地理学。他曾在博洛尼亚教授数学，并绘制佩鲁贾共和国地图，后被教宗格列高利十三世召至罗马，任教宗数学家。他是历法改革委员会成员，推动了格列高利历的诞生，并主持梵蒂冈地图廊四十幅区域壁画地图的绘制（1580—1581年）。他还为波尔图斯的克劳狄乌斯港修复工程提供方案。1583年，格列高利十三世任命他为阿拉特里主教，他在当地召开教区会议，1586年10月10日去世。

en: Giordano Bruno (February 1548–1600), born Filippo Bruno in Nola near Naples, entered the Dominican Order at seventeen and was ordained a priest in 1572. Known for his skill in the art of memory, he demonstrated his mnemonic system before Pope Pius V. Charged with heterodoxy, he fled Naples in 1576 and wandered Europe, teaching in Paris and London, where in 1584 he published Italian dialogues defending an infinite universe of suns circled by planets. Denounced to the Venetian Inquisition in 1592, he was extradited to Rome in January 1593 and tried for seven years. The charges included his denial of the Trinity and other Catholic doctrines. Refusing to recant, he was burned at the stake in the Campo de' Fiori on 17 February 1600.
zh: 焦尔达诺·布鲁诺（1548年2月—1600年）原名菲利波·布鲁诺，生于那不勒斯附近的诺拉，十七岁入多明我会，1572年受任神父。他以精通记忆术闻名，曾在教宗庇护五世面前展示自己的记忆体系。1576年他因被控异端离开那不勒斯，辗转欧洲各地，曾在巴黎与伦敦讲学；1584年在伦敦出版意大利语对话集，主张宇宙无限、星辰皆是太阳并有行星环绕。1592年他遭人告发，被威尼斯宗教裁判所逮捕，1593年1月引渡至罗马，受审七年；指控包括他否认三位一体等天主教教义。他拒绝放弃主张，1600年2月17日在罗马鲜花广场被处以火刑。

en: Gil Álvarez de Albornoz (1302/1303–1367) was a Castilian churchman and soldier, archbishop of Toledo from 1338. He held reform synods at Toledo in 1339 and Alcalá in 1347. He fought against a Marinid invasion at the Battle of Río Salado in 1340 and led his levies at the capture of Algeciras in 1344. Made a cardinal in 1350, he was sent to Italy as legate by Pope Innocent VI in 1353, leading mercenary armies that reconquered most of the Papal States. In 1357 he promulgated the Constitutiones Sanctæ Matris Ecclesiæ, which governed the Papal States until 1816. He founded Bologna's College of Saint Clement in 1364 and died in 1367.
zh: 希尔·阿尔瓦雷斯·德·阿尔沃诺斯（1302/1303—1367）是卡斯蒂利亚的教士与军人，1338年起任托莱多大主教。他于1339年在托莱多、1347年在阿尔卡拉主持教会改革会议。1340年，他在萨拉多河战役中抗击马林王朝的入侵，1344年又率教区武装参加攻取阿尔赫西拉斯。1350年他升任枢机，1353年被教宗英诺森六世派往意大利担任特使，率领雇佣军收复了教皇国的大部分领土。1357年，他颁布《圣母教会宪法》（即“埃吉迪亚宪法”），这套法规一直治理教皇国至1816年。1364年他在博洛尼亚创办圣克莱门特学院，1367年去世。

en: Scipione Caffarelli-Borghese (1 September 1577–1633) was born in Artena to Francesco Caffarelli and Ortensia Borghese. When his maternal uncle became Pope Paul V in 1605, Scipione was made a cardinal, granted the Borghese name, and as Cardinal Nephew ran the Vatican government and the family finances. He held numerous ecclesiastical offices with stipends and amassed vast estates around Rome, his income reaching a hundred and forty thousand scudi by 1612, while restoring churches, roads and aqueducts. His use of papal funds for family investments caused resentment, and he often used his authority to compel owners to sell property at steep discounts. A discerning patron, he championed Caravaggio and the young Bernini and built the Villa Borghese to hold his collection. He died in Rome on 2 October 1633.
zh: 希皮奥内·卡法雷利-博尔盖塞（1577年9月1日—1633年）生于阿尔泰纳，父为弗朗切斯科·卡法雷利，母为奥尔滕西娅·博尔盖塞。1605年舅父当选教宗保罗五世后，他旋即被任命为红衣主教，获许使用博尔盖塞姓氏，并以枢机侄子的身份主持梵蒂冈政务与家族财政。他兼任众多有俸禄的教会职位，在罗马周边广置田产，到1612年年收入达十四万斯库多，同时出资修缮教堂、道路与输水道。他用教廷资金为家族投资招致怨恨，还常利用权势迫使业主低价出售产业。他独具眼光，资助卡拉瓦乔与年轻的贝尼尼，并修建博尔盖塞别墅以陈列收藏。1633年10月2日他在罗马去世。

en: Iacopo Bussolari (1312–1380) was an Augustinian hermit friar born in Pavia. In 1356 he placed himself at the head of a popular rising that drove the Beccaria family from the city, then led the Pavesi through the siege laid by Galeazzo II Visconti. He set up a republican regime in Pavia modelled on Cola di Rienzo's Rome, but when the Visconti took the city in 1359 he was imprisoned. Freed in 1373, he went first to Avignon and then to Ischia, where his brother Bartolomeo was bishop, and died there in 1380.
zh: 亚科波·布索拉里（1312—1380）生于帕维亚，是奥斯定会隐修士。1356年，他领导一场平民起义，将贝卡里亚家族逐出帕维亚，并在加莱亚佐二世·维斯孔蒂围攻该城时率领市民坚守。随后他仿效科拉·迪·里恩佐在罗马的建树，在帕维亚建立共和政权。1359年维斯孔蒂家族攻占帕维亚，他遭囚禁，1373年获释后先前往阿维尼翁，再赴其兄巴尔托洛梅奥任主教的伊斯基亚岛，1380年在当地去世。

en: Piotr Skarga (2 February 1536–1612) was born near Grójec in Mazovia and educated at the Kraków Academy. Ordained around 1564, he joined the Jesuits in Rome in 1569 and became a leading preacher of the Counter-Reformation in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. After returning to Poland in 1571 he preached in several cities, including Warsaw, where he addressed the Sejm. In 1579 he became first rector of the Vilnius Academy, and his Lives of the Saints became one of the most-read Polish books. From 1588 he was first court preacher to King Sigismund III Vasa. His Sejm Sermons (1597) urged stronger royal power and reform; he also criticized religious tolerance and the power of the nobility. He died in Kraków on 27 September 1612.
zh: 彼得·斯卡尔加（1536年2月2日—1612年）生于马佐夫舍格鲁耶茨附近，就读于克拉科夫学院。他约1564年受任神职，1569年在罗马加入耶稣会，后成为波兰—立陶宛联邦反宗教改革运动的重要布道者。1571年回到波兰后，他在多座城市布道，在华沙曾向议会发表布道。1579年他受命出任维尔纽斯学院首任院长，同年出版的《圣徒列传》成为波兰语流传最广的书籍之一。1588年起他担任国王齐格蒙特三世·瓦萨的首任宫廷布道师。《议会布道集》（1597年）呼吁强化王权、改革国政；他也批评宗教宽容与贵族的权力。1612年9月27日他在克拉科夫去世。

en: John III Sobieski (1629–1696) was born at Olesko to a Ruthenian voivode's family, studied in Kraków and toured western Europe before volunteering in 1648 to fight the Khmelnytsky Uprising. During his travels he learned French, German and Italian as well as Latin. He served through the Swedish Deluge and the wars with Muscovy and the Ottomans, rising to Grand Hetman of the Crown in 1668; his victory at Khotyn in 1673 made his name. Elected king in 1674 after Michael Korybut's death, he led the Christian coalition that broke the siege of Vienna in 1683, earning the name Lion of Lechistan. His reign brought the Commonwealth a measure of stability after years of conflict. He died in 1696 and was buried at Wawel Cathedral.
zh: 扬三世·索别斯基（1629—1696）生于奥列斯科，父亲是罗斯行省总督，他在克拉科夫求学并游历西欧，1648年志愿参军，参与镇压赫梅利尼茨基起义。游历期间，他除拉丁语外还学会了法语、德语和意大利语。他历经瑞典入侵的大洪水时代以及对莫斯科和奥斯曼的战争，1668年升任王冠大盖特曼，1673年在霍京大捷而声名大振。1674年米哈乌·科雷布特去世后他被选为国王，1683年率领基督教联军解维也纳之围，因而得名“利赫斯坦之狮”。连年战乱后，他的统治给联邦带来了一定程度的稳定。1696年去世，葬于瓦维尔大教堂。

en: Bohdan Khmelnytsky (c. 1595–1657) was a Ruthenian noble probably born at Subotiv near Chyhyryn and educated at a Jesuit college in Lviv or Jarosław. After his father fell at the Battle of Cecora in 1620, he spent two years in Turkish captivity. In 1648, with Crimean Tatar allies, he led the Zaporozhian Cossacks in a great uprising against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and created an independent Cossack hetmanate in Dnieper Ukraine. In 1648–1649 Cossacks under his leadership massacred tens of thousands of Poles and Jews, while others were handed over as slaves to his Tatar allies. In 1654 he concluded the Treaty of Pereiaslav with the Russian tsar, placing Ukraine under Russian protection. He died at Chyhyryn on 6 August 1657.
zh: 博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基（约1595—1657）是鲁塞尼亚贵族，可能生于奇吉林附近的苏博季夫，曾在利沃夫或雅罗斯瓦夫的耶稣会学院求学。1620年其父在楚措拉战役中阵亡，他本人被土耳其人俘虏两年。1648年，他联合克里米亚鞑靼人，率领扎波罗热哥萨克发动反抗波兰—立陶宛联邦的大起义，在第聂伯河乌克兰建立起独立的哥萨克酋长国。1648—1649年，他率领的哥萨克屠杀数万波兰人与犹太人，另有一些人被交给鞑靼盟友为奴。1654年他与俄国沙皇签订《佩列亚斯拉夫条约》，使乌克兰置于俄国保护之下。1657年8月6日他在奇吉林去世。

en: Arend Dickmann (1572–1627) was a Dutch-born sailor, a native of Delft who from 1608 lived in Gdańsk as captain and owner of a merchant ship carrying grain and oak timber. In 1626 he joined the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth navy in its war with Sweden, and on 24 November 1627 he was made admiral and commander-in-chief. Four days later he led the fleet to victory at the Battle of Oliwa in Gdańsk Bay, aboard the flagship Ritter Sankt Georg. His men boarded and captured the Swedish galleon Tigern and forced the Solen to be scuttled, while his flagship also fired on the Pelikanen. He was killed on the Tigern's deck by a stray cannon shot, possibly from either side.
zh: 阿伦德·迪克曼（1572—1627）是荷兰裔水手，生于代尔夫特，1608年起定居格但斯克，自任船主兼船长，经营谷物与橡木运输。1626年波瑞战争期间，他加入波兰—立陶宛联邦海军，1627年11月24日获授海军上将军衔，出任舰队总司令。四天后，他乘旗舰“圣乔治骑士号”在格但斯克湾的奥利瓦海战中率舰队取胜。他的部下跳帮俘获瑞典战船“虎号”，并迫使“太阳号”自沉，旗舰还炮击了“鹈鹕号”。他本人在“虎号”甲板上被一发流弹击中身亡，炮弹可能来自交战的任何一方。

en: Aleksander Józef Lisowski (c. 1580–1616) was a Polish noble whose family had settled in the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. He first soldiered in the Moldavian wars of 1601 and later joined the rokosz against King Sigismund III. During Muscovy's Time of Troubles he took service with False Dmitry II. In 1608 he defeated a Russian force near Zaraysk, but was later beaten by the voivode Kurakin and lost much of his loot. His bands raided as far as Kostroma before taking Pskov in 1610; in 1612 his men helped defend Smolensk, and in 1615 he outmarched Prince Pozharsky and burned Torzhok. After his sudden death at Starodub in October 1616, his freebooters called themselves the Lisowczycy, or Lisowski's men.
zh: 亚历山大·约瑟夫·利索夫斯基（约1580—1616）是波兰贵族，家族已定居立陶宛大公国。他1601年起在摩尔达维亚战争中从军，后来参加反对国王齐格蒙特三世的叛乱。莫斯科“动乱时代”期间，他投奔伪德米特里二世。1608年，他在扎赖斯克附近击败一支俄军，后来却被总督库拉金击败，损失大部分战利品。他率部四处劫掠，兵锋远达科斯特罗马，1610年攻取普斯科夫；1612年所部协助防守斯摩棱斯克，1615年他甩开波扎尔斯基亲王的大军，焚毁托尔若克。1616年10月他在斯塔罗杜布暴病而亡，部下此后自称“利索夫奇克”，意为利索夫斯基的人。

en: Georg Hewel, in Polish Jerzy Hewel, was a wealthy Gdańsk merchant and shipowner who helped King Władysław IV build a royal fleet in the 1630s. He placed two of his own merchant ships at the king's disposal for conversion into warships and undertook to buy others in his own name, helping to conceal the king's plans. Appointed the king's agent, he purchased ten more ships at royal expense. Together with his two vessels they formed the basis of the fleet, which soon found shelter at a hastily fortified harbour on the Hel Peninsula.
zh: 格奥尔格·赫韦尔（波兰语作耶日·赫韦尔）是格但斯克富商兼船东，1630年代协助国王瓦迪斯瓦夫四世组建王家舰队。他交出自己的两艘商船供国王改装为战舰，并答应以自己的名义购买其他船只，帮助掩盖国王的计划。获任国王代理人后，他以王室经费又购入十艘船，与自己的两艘船共同构成舰队的基础。舰队很快在赫尔半岛一处仓促加固的港口找到驻地。

en: Esterka Małach, traditionally called Esterka, was a fourteenth-century Jewish woman whom the chronicler Jan Długosz, writing under the year 1356, named as the beloved mistress of King Casimir III the Great. Said to be the granddaughter of a respected merchant and physician of Opoczno, she was credited by Długosz with prompting the king's favourable privileges for the Jews of Poland, and with bearing him two sons, Niemira and Pełka. In his chronicle Marcin Bielski wrote that Casimir had kept a Bohemian mistress at Łobzów before setting her aside and taking Esterka in her place.
zh: 埃斯特卡·马瓦赫（通称埃斯特卡）是14世纪的犹太女子。编年史家扬·德乌戈什在1356年条下记载，她是国王卡齐米日大王钟爱的情妇，相传是奥波奇诺一位受尊敬的商人和医生的孙女。德乌戈什把国王赐予波兰犹太人的优待特权归功于她的进言，并称她为国王生下涅米拉和佩乌卡两个儿子。马尔钦·别尔斯基在编年史中记载，卡齐米日曾在沃布祖夫安置一位波希米亚情妇，后来抛弃她，另纳埃斯特卡。

en: Zawisza the Black of Garbów (c. 1379–1428), of the Sulima arms, was a celebrated Polish knight who served Władysław II Jagiełło and Sigismund of Luxembourg as commander and diplomat. He fought at Grunwald in 1410, helped arrange the Treaty of Lubowla, and won tournaments at Buda in 1412 and Perpignan in 1416. At the Council of Constance he spoke in defence of Jan Hus. Captured at Kutná Hora in 1421 during the Hussite Wars, he was ransomed. In 1428 he led a banner of 500 light horsemen in Sigismund's campaign against the Ottomans. At Golubac on the Danube his troops guarded the defeated army's retreat; he was killed in battle or executed in Ottoman captivity.
zh: 加尔博夫的黑扎维沙（约1379—1428），苏利马纹章，是当时享有盛誉的波兰骑士，以统帅和外交官身份效力于瓦迪斯瓦夫二世·雅盖沃和卢森堡的西吉斯蒙德。他1410年参加格伦瓦德之战，促成《卢博夫拉条约》，并在1412年布达和1416年佩皮尼昂的骑士比武中夺魁。在康斯坦茨公会议上，他曾为扬·胡斯辩护。胡斯战争期间，他于1421年在库特纳霍拉被俘，随后被赎出。1428年他率领一支500人的轻骑兵队伍参加西吉斯蒙德对奥斯曼的战役，在多瑙河畔戈卢巴茨掩护败军撤退；他或战死沙场，或在奥斯曼囚禁中被处死。

en: Zbigniew Oleśnicki (1389–1455) was Bishop of Kraków from 1423 and the most powerful churchman-statesman of fifteenth-century Poland. A royal secretary at twenty, he fought beside Władysław II Jagiełło at Grunwald in 1410 and shaped the crown's policy under two Jagiellonian kings, governing effectively as regent during Władysław III's minority and leading the legation to the Council of Basel in 1433. He opposed the Hussites and, in the 1430s, clashed with Spytko of Melsztyn in a conflict that led to a brief civil war. In 1439 Pope Eugenius IV made him the first native Polish cardinal. He promoted Kraków University, employed Jan Długosz as his secretary, and pressed Władysław III's Hungarian crusade, which ended at Varna in 1444. He died in 1455.
zh: 兹比格涅夫·奥莱希尼茨基（1389—1455）1423年起任克拉科夫主教，是15世纪波兰权势最大的教会政治家。他二十岁时任国王秘书，1410年随瓦迪斯瓦夫二世·雅盖沃征战格伦瓦德，在雅盖洛王朝两任国王治下主导王国政策，瓦迪斯瓦夫三世幼年时实际执掌摄政，1433年率使团出席巴塞尔公会议。他反对胡斯派，1430年代与梅尔什廷的斯皮特科发生冲突，引发了一场短暂的内战。1439年，教皇尤金四世封他为第一位波兰籍枢机主教。他扶持克拉科夫大学，延揽扬·德乌戈什担任秘书，并推动瓦迪斯瓦夫三世的匈牙利十字军事业，这场事业于1444年在瓦尔纳覆灭。他于1455年去世。

en: Veit Stoss (before 1450–1533), in Polish Wit Stwosz, was a German sculptor probably born at Horb am Neckar, whose dramatic wood carvings stand between late Gothic and the Northern Renaissance. He settled in Nuremberg in 1473, marrying Barbara Hertz there, and in 1477 moved to Kraków, where his workshop completed the huge painted five-panel altarpiece for St Mary's Basilica in 1489; he also made Casimir IV's tomb in Wawel Cathedral. His son Stanisław, born in Kraków, also became a sculptor. Back in Nuremberg from 1496, Stoss was branded for forgery in 1503 and pardoned by Emperor Maximilian in 1506. Vasari called his Florentine St Roch a miracle in wood.
zh: 法伊特·施托斯（1450年前—1533），波兰语作维特·斯特沃什，是德国雕刻家，可能生于内卡河畔霍尔布，其富于戏剧张力的木雕风格介于晚期哥特式与北方文艺复兴之间。他1473年定居纽伦堡，在那里与芭芭拉·赫茨成婚，1477年迁居克拉科夫，其作坊于1489年为圣母圣殿完成巨型彩绘五联祭坛；他还制作了瓦维尔大教堂内的卡齐米日四世纪念墓。他生于克拉科夫的儿子斯坦尼斯瓦夫也成为雕刻家。1496年施托斯回到纽伦堡，1503年因伪造文书被判处双颊烙印，1506年获马克西米连皇帝赦免。瓦萨里把他为佛罗伦萨所作的《圣罗赫》称为“木头的奇迹”。

en: Martim Afonso de Sousa (c. 1500–1564) was a Portuguese nobleman born at Vila Viçosa and raised alongside the future John III.
