At the royal court he studied mathematics, cosmography and geography under Pedro Nunes. He later served Charles V against the French in Castile. In 1530 the king gave him command of an armada to drive the French from the Brazilian coast and begin permanent settlement. From 1531 he patrolled against pirates and interlopers, and on 22 January 1532 founded São Vicente, Brazil's first chartered town, becoming its first donatary captain. Back in Portugal he led the home fleet, and from 1542 to 1545 he served as governor of Portuguese India. He died in Lisbon on 21 July 1564.
zh: 马蒂姆·阿丰索·德·索萨（约1500—1564）是葡萄牙贵族，生于维拉维索萨，与后来的若昂三世一同长大。他在王宫师从佩德罗·努内斯学习数学、宇宙志和地理，后来在卡斯蒂利亚为查理五世效力，对抗法国人。1530年，国王命他统率舰队，把法国人逐出巴西海岸并开始永久殖民。1531年抵达巴西后，他清剿海盗和外来走私者，于1532年1月22日建立圣维森特——殖民地第一座正式设立的城镇，并成为该地的第一任受赠船长。回到葡萄牙后，他统率本土舰队，1542—1545年又出任葡属印度总督。1564年7月21日他在里斯本去世。

en: John Methuen (1650–1706) was an English lawyer, member of Parliament and diplomat, born the son of a wealthy Wiltshire cloth merchant. Called to the Bar in 1674, he became Master in Chancery in 1685 and sat in the Commons for Devizes from 1690. He held office simultaneously as Lord Chancellor of Ireland and English ambassador to Portugal. During the War of the Spanish Succession, he and his son Paul negotiated the Methuen Treaty of 1703: English textiles were admitted into Portugal while Portuguese wines paid no more duty in England than French wine. The agreement bound the two economies for decades and made port an English staple.
zh: 约翰·梅休因（1650—1706）是英格兰律师、下院议员和外交家，父亲是威尔特郡富有的呢绒商人。他1674年获律师资格，1685年成为衡平法院官员，1690年起代表迪韦齐斯选区进入下议院。他同时担任爱尔兰大法官和英格兰驻葡萄牙大使。西班牙王位继承战争期间，他与儿子保罗参与谈判，促成1703年的《梅休因条约》：英格兰毛织品获准进入葡萄牙，葡萄牙葡萄酒在英格兰缴纳的关税不高于法国葡萄酒。该协定把两国经济捆绑了数十年，也使波特酒成为英格兰市场上的常见商品。

en: Gaspar da Gama (c. 1444–c. 1510), also called Gaspar da Índia, was a Jewish merchant and linguist probably born in Poznań. In 1498, while serving the rulers of Goa, he boarded Vasco da Gama's returning fleet at Angediva Island. Suspected of being a spy, he was whipped and interrogated before being carried to Portugal, where he was baptized with the admiral as his godfather. Speaking Hebrew, Italian, Spanish and Indian tongues, he became an interpreter and guide to Portuguese fleets, sailing to India with Pedro Álvares Cabral in 1500 and again with Vasco da Gama in 1502.
zh: 加斯帕尔·达·伽马（约1444—约1510），又称“印度的加斯帕尔”，是犹太商人和语言天才，可能出生于波兹南。1498年，他在果阿统治者麾下任职时，于安热迪瓦岛登上瓦斯科·达·伽马返航的船队。他被怀疑是间谍，遭到鞭打和审讯，随后被带往葡萄牙受洗，由达·伽马担任教父。他通晓希伯来语、意大利语、西班牙语及印度诸语，成为葡萄牙舰队的翻译和向导，1500年随佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·卡布拉尔、1502年再随瓦斯科·达·伽马远航印度。

en: Fernão Lopes (c. 1385–after 1459) was Portugal's first royal chronicler and a founder of documentary historiography. Probably of humble Alentejo origins and self-educated, he was appointed head of the royal archives at the Torre do Tombo by John I in 1418, and in 1434 King Edward named him the realm's first cronista-mor, commissioning histories of the Portuguese kings. His surviving chronicles cover the reigns of Peter I, Ferdinand I and John I, drawing on official documents rather than rhetoric. He completed the first two parts of John I's reign, leaving the third to his successor Gomes Eanes de Zurara. He held office until about 1454, when Zurara succeeded him, and died sometime after 1459.
zh: 费尔南·洛佩斯（约1385—1459年后）是葡萄牙第一位王室编年史家，也是以文献为据的史学奠基人之一。他可能出身阿连特茹的平民家庭，靠自学成才；1418年被若昂一世任命为托雷·杜·通博王室档案馆的首席馆长，1434年被国王杜阿尔特任命为王国第一位首席编年史家，奉命撰写历代葡萄牙国王的历史。他存世的编年史涵盖佩德罗一世、斐迪南一世和若昂一世三朝，取材官方文书而非华丽辞藻。他完成了若昂一世编年史的前两部分，第三部分由继任者戈梅斯·埃亚内斯·德·祖拉拉写成。他约1454年去职，由祖拉拉继任，1459年之后去世。

en: Bartolomeu Dias (c. 1450–1500) was a Portuguese mariner who in 1481 helped build the fort of São Jorge da Mina in the Gulf of Guinea. Sent by John II to probe the southern African coast, he rounded the Cape of Good Hope in February 1488, becoming the first European known to sail from the Atlantic into the Indian Ocean. He demonstrated the value of a southwest course in the open ocean, far from the African coast. He later helped design the ships used by Vasco da Gama in 1497 and accompanied him as far as Cape Verde. In 1500 he captained a vessel in Cabral's fleet, which reached Brazil, and drowned in a storm off the Cape on 29 May 1500.
zh: 巴尔托洛梅乌·迪亚士（约1450—1500）是葡萄牙航海家，1481年参与在几内亚湾修建圣若热·达米纳要塞。受若昂二世派遣探查非洲南岸，他于1488年2月绕过好望角，成为已知第一个从大西洋驶入印度洋的欧洲人。他证明了远离非洲海岸、在大洋上向西南航行的路线的价值。后来他参与设计了瓦斯科·达·伽马1497年使用的船只，并随他航行至佛得角。1500年，他在卡布拉尔舰队中担任船长，随队抵达巴西，同年5月29日在好望角附近的风暴中溺亡。

en: António Raposo Tavares (1598–1658) was born in Alentejo and went to Brazil with his father in 1618, settling near São Paulo. In 1628 he led a bandeira of settlers and Tupi warriors against Jesuit-protected Guarani villages on the upper Paraná, taking thousands of captives and extending Portuguese rule east of the Uruguay River. He fought the Dutch in the northeast in 1639–1642. His final bandeira, begun in 1648, covered more than ten thousand kilometres through the interior, travelling along rivers including the Paraguay and eventually reaching Belém at the mouth of the Amazon. He returned to São Paulo and died in 1658.
zh: 安东尼奥·拉波佐·塔瓦雷斯（1598—1658）生于葡萄牙阿连特茹，1618年随父亲前往巴西，在圣保罗附近定居。1628年，他率领由定居者和图皮武士组成的旗队，袭击巴拉那河上游受耶稣会保护的瓜拉尼村落，掳走数千人，把葡萄牙的统治扩展到乌拉圭河以东地区。1639—1642年，他在东北部与荷兰人作战。他最后一次旗队远征始于1648年，在内陆行经一万多公里，沿巴拉圭河等河流前进，最终抵达亚马孙河口的贝伦。他返回圣保罗，于1658年去世。

en: Nuno Álvares Pereira (1360–1431) was a Portuguese general, legitimized son of the prior of Crato. In the 1383 crisis he backed John, Master of Aviz, and after victory at Atoleiros in 1384 was made constable of Portugal and count of Ourém. That year he harassed the Castilian army besieging Lisbon, until plague forced it to withdraw. On 14 August 1385 he led an outnumbered army to decisive victory over Castile at Aljubarrota, securing the new Aviz dynasty, and won again at Valverde. He also held Arraiolos and Barcelos, and gave much of his wealth to veterans when hostilities ended. After his wife died he entered a Carmelite convent in Lisbon as Frei Nuno de Santa Maria.
zh: 努诺·阿尔瓦雷斯·佩雷拉（1360—1431）是葡萄牙军事将领，为克拉托修道院长的私生子，后获承认为嫡出。1383年危机期间，他支持阿维什骑士团团长若昂；1384年阿托莱罗斯之战获胜后，他被任命为葡萄牙统帅，受封奥伦伯爵。同年他袭扰围攻里斯本的卡斯蒂利亚军队，直到瘟疫迫使敌军撤退。1385年8月14日，他率领兵力处于劣势的葡军在阿尔茹巴罗塔决战中决定性地击败卡斯蒂利亚军队，保住了新生的阿维什王朝，此后又在巴尔韦德再胜。他还领有阿赖奥卢什和巴塞卢什伯国，战争结束后将大部分财产赠予老兵。妻子去世后，他以“圣玛利亚的努诺”为名进入里斯本的加尔默罗会修道院修道。

en: Nuno Gonçalves (c. 1425–c. 1491) was appointed court painter to King Afonso V of Portugal in July 1450 and held the post until at least 1471; he was knighted by the king in 1470 and named official painter for Lisbon in 1471. His style shows the influence of Flemish masters such as Van Eyck and Van der Weyden. His surviving masterpiece is the polyptych of the Saint Vincent Panels, a panorama of Portuguese society, and he is also credited with the Pastrana Tapestries. He is regarded as the founder of painting in the Portuguese Renaissance.
zh: 努诺·贡萨尔维斯（约1425—约1491）于1450年7月被葡萄牙国王阿丰索五世任命为宫廷画师，任职至1471年以后；1470年被国王封为骑士，1471年成为里斯本官方画师。他的画风受凡·艾克、凡·德·韦登等佛兰德斯大师影响。其传世杰作是多联画《圣文森特祭坛画》，展现了葡萄牙社会的众生相，帕斯特拉纳挂毯也被认为出自他手。他被誉为葡萄牙文艺复兴绘画的奠基人。

en: Robert Burns (1759–1796), Scotland's national poet, was born at Alloway in Ayrshire, the son of a poor tenant farmer, and began writing songs while labouring on his family's farms. At fifteen he was the principal labourer at Mount Oliphant, where Nelly Kilpatrick inspired his first attempt at poetry during the 1774 harvest. In July 1786, hoping to pay for passage to Jamaica, he published Poems, Chiefly in the Scottish Dialect at Kilmarnock; its success carried him to Edinburgh instead, where a second edition appeared in 1787. He later farmed at Ellisland and worked as an exciseman in Dumfries, while composing and collecting songs such as Auld Lang Syne and Scots Wha Hae. He died at Dumfries in July 1796, aged 37.
zh: 罗伯特·伯恩斯（1759—1796）是苏格兰的民族诗人，生于艾尔郡的阿洛韦，父亲是穷苦佃农，他自幼在自家农场干活，同时开始创作歌谣。十五岁时他已是芒特奥利芬特农场的主要劳力；1774年收获时节，内莉·基尔帕特里克启发他首次尝试写诗。1786年7月，为筹钱前往牙买加，他在基尔马诺克出版《苏格兰方言诗集》，诗集一举成名，他没有出海，反而前往爱丁堡，第二版于1787年问世。后来他在埃利斯兰务农，又到邓弗里斯任税务官，同时创作和整理《友谊地久天长》《苏格兰人》等歌谣。1796年7月他在邓弗里斯去世，年仅37岁。

en: David Beaton (c. 1494–1546) was the last Scottish cardinal before the Reformation and, from 1539, Archbishop of St Andrews. A trusted diplomat of James V, he led negotiations for the king's French marriages to Madeleine of Valois and Mary of Guise, and championed the Auld Alliance against Henry VIII's pressure to break with Rome. After James V's death in 1542 he claimed the regency for the infant Mary, Queen of Scots, on the basis of a will widely regarded as forged, but was imprisoned. In 1544 he became papal legate in Scotland. He had the Protestant preacher George Wishart burned for heresy in March 1546 and was himself murdered in St Andrews Castle two months later.
zh: 达味·比顿（约1494—1546）是苏格兰宗教改革前最后一位枢机，1539年起任圣安德鲁斯大主教。他深得詹姆斯五世信任，多次出任驻法使节，主持国王与玛德琳·德·瓦卢瓦和玛丽·德·吉斯的婚姻谈判，并在亨利八世威逼苏格兰与罗马决裂时维护与法国的老同盟。1542年詹姆斯五世去世后，他凭一份普遍被认为伪造的遗诏要求成为襁褓中的苏格兰女王玛丽的摄政，却下狱失势。1544年他出任教宗驻苏格兰代表。1546年3月他下令以火刑处死新教传教士乔治·威沙特，两个月后即在圣安德鲁斯城堡遇刺身亡。

en: Sir George Bruce of Carnock (c. 1550–1625) was a Scottish merchant and mining engineer at Culross in Fife. He built Culross Palace, while his elder brother Edward built the nearby Culross House. He pioneered undersea coal mining at the Moat Pit, tunnelling under the Firth of Forth to the unheard-of depth of 40 fathoms, with drainage by a horse-driven chain of buckets. James VI visited in 1617 and emerged through a stone tower a quarter-mile offshore. Bruce also ran salt pans exporting to England and Germany, and in 1608–1609 was treasurer of the royal silver mine at Hilderston. The Moat Pit was flooded in March 1625, weeks before his death that May.
zh: 卡诺克的乔治·布鲁斯爵士（约1550—1625）是苏格兰商人、采矿工程师，在法夫的卡勒罗斯经营。他建造了卡勒罗斯宫，兄长爱德华则在附近建造了卡勒罗斯府。他首创海底采煤，坑井从陆地伸入福斯湾海底，深达此前闻所未闻的40英寻，并用马拉斗链排水。1617年詹姆斯六世亲临矿井，从离岸四分之一英里的一座石塔走出。布鲁斯还经营多处盐田，产品远销英格兰和德意志，并于1608至1609年担任希尔德斯顿王家银矿司库。1625年3月海底矿井被淹，几周后他便在同年5月去世。

en: Dositej Obradović (1739–1811), born in Čakovo in the Banat, was a Serbian monk, writer and reformer. Taking the name Dositej at the Hopovo monastery in 1757, he left in 1760 and taught in Dalmatia before studying at Halle and Leipzig, where his first book appeared in 1783. His travels exposed him to the German Enlightenment and took him across Europe and Asia Minor. Writing in the spoken vernacular instead of Church Slavonic, he became, with Vuk Karadžić, a father of modern Serbian literature. During the First Serbian Uprising he published Rise O Serbia in 1804, moved to Belgrade in 1807 as Serbia's first minister of education, founded the Velika škola in 1809, and died in Belgrade in 1811.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/多西泰伊·奧布拉多維奇
zh: 多西泰伊·奥布拉多维奇（1739—1811）出生在巴纳特的恰科沃，是塞尔维亚修士、作家与改革家。1757年他在霍波沃修道院出家，取法名多西泰伊，1760年离开修道院，曾在达尔马提亚任教，后在哈雷和莱比锡求学，1783年在莱比锡出版第一部著作。他游历欧洲和小亚细亚，接触到德国启蒙思想。他用民间口语而非教会斯拉夫语写作，与武克·卡拉季奇并称为现代塞尔维亚文学之父。第一次塞尔维亚起义期间，他于1804年发表《起来吧，塞尔维亚》，1807年前往贝尔格莱德出任塞尔维亚首任教育大臣，1809年创办大学校，1811年在贝尔格莱德去世。

en: Palman (called Palman Bracht; c. 1290–after 1363) was a German knight born in Styria. He served Henry III of Gorizia as a squire and later served the Habsburgs. Setting out for the Holy Land, he entered Zeta and joined Stefan Dušan with his German followers, becoming captain of Dušan's Alemannic Guard of 300 men. In 1331 he marched with Dušan from Skadar against Stefan Uroš III, and he later put down revolts in Zeta and northern Albania. He held Veria until John Cantacuzene retook it, and in 1355 his guard was sent to hold Klis. He is last attested in 1363, named in a will at Dubrovnik, and lives on in Serbian epic poetry.
zh: 帕尔曼（常称帕尔曼·布拉赫特，约1290—1363年后）是生于施蒂利亚的德意志骑士。他曾任戈里齐亚伯爵亨利三世的侍从，后来效力哈布斯堡家族。他动身前往圣地，途中进入泽塔，与德意志随从一同投效斯特凡·杜尚，成为杜尚麾下300人的阿勒曼尼卫队队长。1331年，他随杜尚从斯库台出兵讨伐斯特凡·乌罗什三世，后来又平定泽塔和阿尔巴尼亚北部的叛乱。他据守韦里亚，直至约翰·坎塔库泽努斯夺回该城；1355年，他的卫队被派往驻守克利斯。史料最后于1363年提到他，名字出现在杜布罗夫尼克的一份遗嘱中，他的形象也留存于塞尔维亚史诗中。

en: Makarije Sokolović (16th century–1574) was the first patriarch of the restored Serbian Patriarchate of Peć. A kinsman of the Ottoman grand vizier Mehmed-paša Sokolović, born to the Sokolović clan of Piva, Old Herzegovina, he owed the patriarchate's 1557 restoration to the vizier's influence, after the see lapsed in 1463. Before its restoration, Serbian Orthodox Christians had been under the Archbishopric of Ohrid. The sultan granted his patriarchate the rights of Constantinople; its jurisdiction extended beyond medieval Serbia into Bosnia and Dalmatia, and its more than forty eparchies included newly founded sees. His church renewed the Peć, Gračanica and Studenica monasteries. He resigned through illness in 1571 to his nephew Antonije and died in 1574; the Serbian Orthodox Church venerates him as a saint.
zh: 马卡里耶·索科洛维奇（16世纪—1574）是佩奇牧首区恢复后的首任塞尔维亚牧首。他出身老黑塞哥维那皮瓦的索科洛维奇家族，是奥斯曼大维齐尔穆罕默德帕夏·索科洛维奇的亲属；1463年牧首区在奥斯曼征服后中断，1557年凭这位大维齐尔的影响得以恢复。恢复之前，塞尔维亚正教徒隶属奥赫里德总主教区。苏丹授予他的牧首区与君士坦丁堡同等的权利；辖区除中世纪塞尔维亚领土外，还包括波斯尼亚和达尔马提亚，四十多个教区中有新设的教区。他的教会重修了佩奇、格拉查尼察和斯图代尼察修道院。他因病于1571年让位给侄子安东尼耶，1574年去世，被塞尔维亚正教会尊为圣人。

en: Francesco di Giorgio Martini (1439–1501) was a Sienese painter, architect and military engineer, trained in Vecchietta's workshop. In 1473 he and another engineer completed improvements to Siena's aqueduct and fountains, including the fountain in the Piazza del Campo. From the mid-1470s he served Federico da Montefeltro, Duke of Urbino, building nearly seventy fortifications, among the earliest star-shaped bastions, and designing Santa Maria delle Grazie church at Cortona. His Trattato di architettura, completed after 1482, set out ideal-city plans and machines; Leonardo da Vinci owned and annotated a copy. He returned to Siena as city engineer in 1486, advised on Milan Cathedral's dome in 1490, and in 1499 became capomaestro of Siena Cathedral.
zh: 弗朗切斯科·迪·乔治·马蒂尼（1439—1501）是锡耶纳画家、建筑师和军事工程师，学艺于韦基耶塔的作坊。1473年他与另一位工程师完成锡耶纳水道和喷泉的改善工程，其中包括坎波广场的喷泉。从1470年代中期起，他为乌尔比诺公爵费德里科·达·蒙特费尔特罗效力，修筑近七十座防御工事，其中包括最早一批星形棱堡，并设计了科尔托纳的圣马利亚感恩教堂。他的《建筑、工程与军事艺术论》在1482年后完成，绘有理想城市方案和机械图样，列奥纳多·达·芬奇曾收藏并批注过一个抄本。1486年他返回锡耶纳任城市工程师，1490年为米兰大教堂穹顶提供咨询，1499年出任锡耶纳大教堂工程总监。

en: Catherine of Siena (1347–1380), born Caterina di Jacopo di Benincasa, was the daughter of a Sienese cloth dyer who rejected marriage to join the Dominican mantellate as a mystic and ascetic. Her letters and reputation gave her rare political weight for a woman of her day: she helped persuade Pope Gregory XI to leave Avignon for Rome in 1376 and negotiated for peace between the papacy and Florence. She dictated her major work, The Dialogue, in 1377–1378, then backed Urban VI in Rome during the Great Schism, writing to princes and cardinals to urge obedience to him. She died in Rome in 1380 and was canonized in 1461.
zh: 锡耶纳的加大利纳（1347—1380），本名卡泰丽娜·迪·雅各波·迪·贝宁卡萨，是锡耶纳一名染工的女儿。她拒绝婚嫁，加入道明会的曼特拉特善会，过着神秘主义者的苦行生活。她的书信和声望使她在当时拥有罕见的政治影响力：1376年她帮助说服教宗额我略十一世把教廷从法国亚维农迁回罗马，并受托为教廷与佛罗伦萨议和奔走。1377至1378年她口授完成主要著作《对话录》，西方教会大分裂后又在罗马支持教宗乌尔巴诺六世，写信劝诸侯和枢机服从他。她于1380年在罗马去世，1461年被封圣。

en: Pandolfo Petrucci (1452–1512) was the effective lord of Renaissance Siena. His merchant family was exiled in 1456 after his uncle's failed plot against the republic and returned only in 1480. As captain of the city guard from 1495 he built his power, and after his brother's death in 1497 he eliminated his rivals, having his father-in-law killed in 1500, and ruled Siena as its undisputed master. He improved the city's economy and encouraged the arts. After secretly plotting against Cesare Borgia with other lords, he fled in 1503 and returned two months later under French protection. In 1512 he ceded Montepulciano to Florence before dying, leaving Siena to his son Borghese.
zh: 潘多尔福·佩特鲁奇（1452—1512）是文艺复兴时期锡耶纳事实上的统治者。他出身商人贵族家族，1456年因叔父反对共和国的密谋败露而全家被放逐，1480年才随流亡者返回。他自1495年起担任城防统领，借此积蓄权力；1497年继承兄长的官职后铲除异己，于1500年派人杀死岳父，成为锡耶纳无可争议的主人。他改善城市经济，鼓励艺术发展。他与其他领主秘密谋划反对切萨雷·博尔贾，1503年出逃，两个月后在法国保护下回国。1512年他将蒙特普尔恰诺割让给佛罗伦萨，同年去世，把锡耶纳留给儿子博格斯。

en: Abd al-Rahman al-Sa'di (Abderrahmane ben Abdallah ben Imrane ben Amir Es Saâdi; 1596 – c. 1656) was a West African jurist, imam and historian born in Timbuktu. He studied for about ten years under the scholar Muhammad Bagayogo. He served as a notary in Djenné and from 1627 as imam of the Sankoré mosque, then returned to Timbuktu around 1637, where as kātib, or government secretary, he mediated between local Songhai rulers and the Moroccan Arma administration. Around 1655 he began writing the Tarikh al-Sudan, an Arabic chronicle of the Songhai Empire down to the Moroccan invasion of 1591 and of Timbuktu under Moroccan rule, which remains a major source for Songhai history.
zh: 阿卜杜勒-拉赫曼·萨迪（全名阿卜杜勒-拉赫曼·本·阿卜杜拉·本·伊姆兰·本·阿米尔·萨迪，1596—约1656）是生于廷巴克图的西非法学家、伊玛目和史学家。他曾随学者穆罕默德·巴加约戈学习约十年，后在杰内做公证人，1627年起任桑科雷清真寺伊玛目，约1637年回到家乡廷巴克图，后担任书记官卡提卜，在桑海地方势力与摩洛哥阿尔马政权之间斡旋调停。约1655年，他开始撰写阿拉伯文编年史《苏丹史》，记述桑海帝国直至1591年摩洛哥入侵以及入侵后廷巴克图的历史，是研究桑海历史的重要原始文献。

en: Askia Muhammad I, called Askia the Great (1443–1538), was born Muhammad Ture and rose as a general under the Songhai ruler Sunni Ali. In 1493 he overthrew Sunni Ali's successor, Sunni Baru, for failing to uphold Islam, and founded the Askia dynasty. He made the hajj to Mecca in 1496 with 500 horsemen and 1000 infantry; on his return to Gao, the prestige of his pilgrimage strengthened his position. He extended Songhai from Taghaza to the Hausa cities of Katsina, Zaria and Gobir. He created a provincial bureaucracy, standardized taxes and trade, and made Islam the religion of the ruling class. His son Askia Musa deposed him in 1528, and he died in 1538.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿斯基亞·穆罕默德一世
zh: 阿斯基亚·穆罕默德一世，即阿斯基亚大帝（1443—1538），原名穆罕默德·图雷，原是桑海统治者索尼·阿里麾下崛起的将领。1493年，他以未能捍卫伊斯兰教为由推翻索尼·阿里的继承者索尼·巴鲁，建立阿斯基亚王朝。1496年他率500名骑兵和1000名步兵赴麦加朝觐；返回加奥后，朝觐带来的声望巩固了他的地位。他把桑海版图从北部的塔加扎扩展到卡齐纳、扎里亚和戈比尔等豪萨城邦。他建立行省官僚体系，统一税收和贸易规制，并把伊斯兰教立为统治阶层的宗教。1528年他被儿子阿斯基亚·穆萨废黜，1538年去世。

en: Per Brahe the Younger (1602–1680) was a Swedish soldier, statesman and twice a regent. Grandson of Per Brahe the Elder, he became chamberlain to Gustavus Adolphus in 1626, fought in Prussia during the Polish War and in Germany in 1630. After the king's death in 1632 he was one of the regents during Queen Christina's minority. He negotiated the 1635 Truce of Stuhmsdorf with Poland and became Lord High Steward in 1640. As Governor-General of Finland in 1637–1640 and 1648–1654 he reformed administration, introduced a postal system, promoted commerce, agriculture and education, founded ten towns and opened the Royal Academy of Turku in 1640. He was regent again after Charles X died in 1660, dying at Bogesund in 1680.
zh: 小佩尔·布拉赫（1602—1680）是瑞典军人、政治家，曾两度出任摄政。他是老佩尔·布拉赫之孙，1626年成为古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫的侍从，在波兰战争期间赴普鲁士作战，1630年又在德意志作战。国王于1632年阵亡后，他成为克里斯蒂娜女王幼年时的摄政之一。1635年他与波兰谈判达成《斯图姆斯多夫停战协定》，1640年受任最高法官。1637—1640年和1648—1654年他两任芬兰总督，改革行政、兴办邮政、促进商业、农业和教育，建立十座城镇，并于1640年创办图尔库皇家学院。1660年卡尔十世去世后他再次担任摄政，1680年在博格森德去世。

en: Olaus Rudbeck (1630–1702) was a Swedish polymath and professor of medicine at Uppsala University. Born in Västerås, the son of Bishop Johannes Rudbeckius, he won fame at twenty-three by describing the lymphatic vessels, Sweden's first major medical discovery. In 1655 he founded Sweden's first botanical garden at Uppsala, and also worked as an architect, astronomer and musician. His later years were devoted to Atland eller Manheim, a vast history arguing that Sweden was the lost Atlantis and the cradle of all civilization. He also planned a twelve-volume encyclopedia of plants, Campi elysii. During Uppsala's great fire of 1702 he directed firefighting from a roof while his house burned; many of his writings and botanical woodblocks were lost. He died in Uppsala shortly afterward.
zh: 奥洛夫·鲁德贝克（1630—1702）是瑞典的博学通才、乌普萨拉大学医学教授。他生于韦斯特罗斯，父亲是约翰内斯·鲁德贝克乌斯主教；二十三岁时因描述淋巴管而赢得声誉，这是瑞典第一项重大医学发现。1655年他在乌普萨拉创办瑞典第一座植物园，同时还兼具建筑师、天文学家和音乐家的身份。晚年他倾注心血于巨著《阿特兰，或曼海姆》，提出瑞典就是失落的亚特兰蒂斯、是一切文明的摇篮。他还计划编纂十二卷植物百科《极乐田园》。1702年乌普萨拉大火中，他站在屋顶指挥救火，自己的房屋却被烧毁；许多著作和植物图谱木版也付之一炬。不久后他在乌普萨拉去世。

en: Carl Michael Bellman (1740–1795) was Sweden's national poet-songwriter. A Stockholm civil servant's son, he tried banking at the Riksbank and study at Uppsala before debt drove him to Norway in 1763. From 1768, back in Stockholm, he composed a new kind of song, accompanying himself on the cittern in taverns and at court. King Gustav III called him a master improviser and became his patron, giving him a post at the lottery office in 1776. His reputation rests on two collections, Fredman's Epistles and Fredman's Songs, published in 1790 and 1791, whose drinking-house characters and rococo allusions blend comedy, satire and melancholy. Bellman died in Stockholm in 1795.
zh: 卡尔·米凯尔·贝尔曼（1740—1795）是瑞典的民族诗人与歌曲作家。他是斯德哥尔摩一名公务员之子，曾在瑞典央行供职、在乌普萨拉大学求学，后因债务所迫于1763年逃往挪威。回到斯德哥尔摩后，他从1768年起创作了一种全新的歌曲，在酒馆和宫廷中弹着西特恩琴自唱。国王古斯塔夫三世称他为即兴大师，成为他的庇护人，并于1776年授予他彩票局的职位。他的声誉建立在1790年和1791年出版的《弗雷德曼的书信》与《弗雷德曼之歌》两部集子上，酒肆人物与洛可可式典故交织，融合了滑稽、讽刺与忧伤。贝尔曼于1795年在斯德哥尔摩去世。

en: Jacob Johan Anckarström (1762–1792) was the Swedish captain who murdered King Gustav III. A former page and captain in the king's regiment, he was embittered after an acquittal at a Gotland slander trial and by the Union and Security Act of 1789 stripping the nobles of privilege. With Counts Horn and Ribbing he conspired, and on 16 March 1792 shot the king at a masked ball in Stockholm's Royal Opera. The king had received an anonymous warning but attended anyway. Anckarström dropped his pistol, and the guests were required to give their names before leaving. Gustav III died on 29 March. Anckarström confessed, was condemned to flogging, loss of his right hand and beheading, and was executed on 27 April 1792.
zh: 雅各布·约翰·安卡斯特伦（1762—1792）是弑杀瑞典国王古斯塔夫三世的瑞典军官。他曾在国王的团队里当侍从、任上尉，在哥得兰的诽谤国王案中被判无罪后仍心怀怨恨，1789年剥夺贵族特权的《联合与安全法》更使他愤恨。他与霍恩伯爵、里宾伯爵合谋，于1792年3月16日在斯德哥尔摩皇家歌剧院的一场假面舞会上枪击国王。国王事先收到匿名警告，仍然出席了舞会。安卡斯特伦丢下手枪，宾客离场前都被要求登记姓名。古斯塔夫三世于3月29日伤重而亡。安卡斯特伦认罪，被判处鞭笞、砍去右手再斩首，于1792年4月27日受刑。

en: Per Brahe the Elder (1520–1590) was a Swedish statesman and Count of Visingsborg. His father Joakim Brahe died in the Stockholm Bloodbath of 1520, and his mother Margareta Eriksdotter Vasa was Gustav Vasa's sister, so Brahe was cousin to kings Eric XIV, John III and Charles IX. Governor of Stockholm Castle from 1540, he joined the Privy Council in 1544. He married Beata Stenbock, elder sister of Gustav Vasa's third wife Katarina. In 1561 he was among Sweden's first counts at Eric XIV's coronation, receiving Visingsborg the following year, and under John III he became Lord High Justiciar (riksdrots) and Governor of Norrland. He died in 1590 at Stora Sundby; his grandson Per Brahe the Younger also became a statesman.
zh: 老佩尔·布拉赫（1520—1590）是瑞典政治家、维辛斯堡伯爵。父亲约阿基姆·布拉赫死于1520年斯德哥尔摩惨案，母亲玛格丽塔·埃里克斯多特·瓦萨是古斯塔夫·瓦萨之妹，因此他是埃里克十四世、约翰三世和卡尔九世三位国王的表兄。他自1540年起任斯德哥尔摩城堡总管，1544年进入枢密院。他迎娶贝娅塔·斯滕博克，她是古斯塔夫·瓦萨第三任妻子卡塔丽娜的姐姐。1561年埃里克十四世加冕时，他成为瑞典最早受封的伯爵之一，次年领有维辛斯堡；约翰三世在位时，他出任全国最高法官兼诺尔兰总督。1590年他在斯图拉松德比去世；他的孙子小佩尔·布拉赫也成为政治家。

en: Klaus Störtebeker (c. 1360 – 1401) was a leader of the Likedeeler, or Victual Brothers, pirates hired as privateers for Albert of Sweden against Margaret of Denmark, then raiders of Hanseatic shipping in the Baltic and North Sea. The name Likedeeler referred to their practice of sharing their spoils equally. Expelled from Visby on Gotland in 1398, they used Marienhafe in East Frisia as a base, where tradition makes him son-in-law of Frisian chieftain Keno ten Broke. Captured near Heligoland by a Hamburg fleet on 22 April 1401, he and 72 companions were beheaded on Hamburg's Grasbrook that October. Legend says his headless body passed eleven men before the headsman stopped him.
zh: 克劳斯·施特尔特贝克尔（约1360—1401）是“均分者”利克德勒（又称粮食兄弟会）海盗的首领：他们最初受瑞典的阿尔布雷希特雇佣，对丹麦的玛格丽特作战，随后在波罗的海和北海劫掠汉萨商船。“均分者”之名来自他们平分战利品的做法。1398年他们被逐出哥特兰岛的维斯比据点，改以东弗里斯兰的马林哈费为基地；相传他在那里娶了弗里斯兰酋长克诺·滕·布罗克的女儿。1401年4月22日，他在黑尔戈兰岛附近被汉堡舰队俘获，同年10月与72名同伙在汉堡格拉斯布鲁克被斩首。传说他被砍头后，无头的身躯仍走过11名同伴身边，最后被刽子手阻止。

en: Wizli Wisso (died 1350) was a knight of a Zurich ministerial family; his grandfather of the same name had died fighting for Habsburg at the Battle of Morgarten in 1315. After Rudolf Brun's guild revolution of 1336, Wizli joined the patrician exiles who sheltered in the Habsburg town of Rapperswil. On the night of 23–24 February 1350 he took part in their attempt to seize Zurich and overthrow Brun, later called the Murder Night of Zurich. The coup failed and Wizli was killed in the fighting; Brun confiscated his estates and sold his Haus zum Loch in 1354.
zh: 维茨利·维索（？—1350）是苏黎世家臣家族出身的骑士，他同名的祖父曾为哈布斯堡一方作战，1315年死于莫尔加滕战役。1336年鲁道夫·布伦发动行会革命后，维茨利加入流亡贵族，寄居哈布斯堡治下的拉珀斯维尔。1350年2月23日至24日夜，他参与流亡者攻占苏黎世、推翻布伦的行动，即后世所称的“苏黎世谋杀之夜”。政变失败，维茨利在混战中被杀，家产遭布伦没收，其宅邸“洞屋”于1354年被变卖。

en: Matthäus Schiner (c. 1465–1522), born at Mühlebach in the Valais, became bishop of Sion in 1499. A diplomat and commander, he forged the papal–Swiss alliance that gave rise to the Swiss Guard, and secured Bellinzona for the Confederacy in the Peace of Arona in 1503. Pope Julius II made him a cardinal in 1511. As legate he led Swiss troops that drove the French from Milan and installed Maximilian Sforza as duke in 1512. He won Novara in 1513, then fought at Marignano in 1515. In 1516 he went to London seeking an alliance against France, but the plan failed. Driven from Sion in 1517, he supported Charles V's election in 1519, advised him, helped draft the Edict of Worms, and died of plague in 1522.
zh: 马特乌斯·席纳（约1465—1522）生于瓦莱的米伦巴赫，1499年成为锡永主教。他长于外交与统兵，一手促成教宗与瑞士的同盟，瑞士近卫队即由此诞生；又在1503年的《阿罗纳和约》中为联邦争得贝林佐纳。1511年教宗尤利乌斯二世封他为枢机；他以特使身份率瑞士军队将法国人逐出米兰，1512年扶立马克西米利安·斯福尔扎为公爵。1513年他取得诺瓦拉之战的胜利，1515年又领兵参加马里尼亚诺战役。1516年他赴伦敦寻求反法同盟，计划却告失败。1517年他被逐离锡永，1519年支持查理五世当选，此后担任其顾问，参与起草《沃尔姆斯敕令》，1522年死于鼠疫。

en: Johannes Hadlaub (fl. c. 1300, died before 1340) was a Zurich Minnesinger and one of the last poets of Middle High German courtly song. A citizen of Zurich, he is documented buying a house there in 1302. Fifty-one of his songs survive in the Codex Manesse, the great Heidelberg song manuscript. His work included love songs, dawn songs, harvest songs, rural songs and longer lyrical compositions; some name historical figures around Zurich and Constance. Because his verse seems to have shaped the collection, scholars commonly assume he helped compile it. Gottfried Keller later made him the hero of the novella Hadlaub, which strongly influenced later perceptions of the poet.
zh: 约翰内斯·哈德劳布（约1300年前后在世，1340年前去世）是苏黎世的恋诗诗人，属中古高地德语宫廷抒情诗晚期的作者。他身为苏黎世市民，1302年在城中购房一事有案可查。《马内塞古抄本》即海德堡大型歌曲抄本，收录了他的51首作品。他的作品包括情歌、破晓歌、收获歌、乡村歌谣和较长的抒情诗，其中一些点名提到苏黎世与康斯坦茨一带的真实历史人物。由于他的诗作在抄本中地位特殊，学界普遍认为他参与了抄本编纂。戈特弗里德·凯勒后来以他为主人公写成中篇小说《哈德劳布》，深刻影响了后人对这位诗人的认识。

en: Dorothea of Montau (1347–1394), born at Groß Montau near Marienburg, was a Prussian visionary. She practised ascetic disciplines from childhood. Married to a Danzig swordsmith, she bore nine children and soon had visions; only one daughter survived plague and other diseases. In 1384 the couple sold their possessions and visited pilgrimage sites in the Empire. After her husband died in 1390 during her pilgrimage to Rome, she settled at Marienwerder. In 1391 she escaped burning as a witch at Danzig through her confessor Johannes of Marienwerder, who wrote down her revelations. On 2 May 1393 she was enclosed in a cell built against the cathedral, receiving communion until her death the next year. Beatified in 1976, she is venerated as patroness of Prussia and the Teutonic Order.
zh: 蒙陶的多萝特（1347—1394）生于马尔堡附近的大蒙陶，是普鲁士的神秘主义者。她自幼便行苦修。她嫁给但泽的一名兵器匠，生有九个孩子，婚后不久便开始得见异象；孩子中只有一名女儿在瘟疫和其他疾病中存活。1384年夫妇二人变卖财产，前往帝国内的朝圣地。1390年她赴罗马朝圣期间丈夫去世，此后她迁居马林韦尔德。1391年她在但泽被控行巫，险遭火刑，全靠告解神父马林韦尔德的约翰相救，后者后来笔录了她的启示。1393年5月2日，她被封入马林韦尔德大教堂墙边的隐修小室，领受圣体直至次年去世。她于1976年受宣福，被尊为普鲁士与条顿骑士团的主保圣人。

en: Johann von Posilge (c. 1340–1405) was a Prussian cleric traditionally regarded as a chronicler of the Teutonic Order, probably an Old Prussian from Posilge near Marienburg. First documented in 1376, he was official of the bishop of Pomesania at Riesenburg and parish priest at Deutsch Eylau and later Ladekopp. He also arbitrated a dispute between the Order and the bishopric of Warmia. The chronicle traditionally attributed to him, whose authorship remains disputed, begins its account in 1360 and was continued by another hand until 1419. Written in Latin but surviving only in German, it records political and cultural details, above all the Great War with Poland and Lithuania, and ranks among the most valuable German chronicles of the Order's state.
zh: 约翰·冯·普茨格（约1340—1405）是普鲁士教士，传统上被认为是条顿骑士团的编年史家，可能是出身于马尔堡附近普茨格村的古普鲁士人。他于1376年首次见于文献，在里森堡担任波梅萨尼亚主教的司法代理，并先后出任德意志艾劳与拉德科普的本堂神父。他还曾仲裁骑士团与瓦尔米亚主教区的争端。传统上归于他的编年史作者身份尚有争议，记事始于1360年，后来由他人续修至1419年；原以拉丁文写就，今仅存德文本。书记载了丰富的政治与文化细节，尤其是骑士团与波兰、立陶宛之间的“大战”，是骑士团国家最有价值的德语编年史之一。

en: Piotr of Grudziądz, or Petrus Wilhelmi de Grudencz (1392–c. 1480), was a composer and poet born at Graudenz (Grudziądz) in Prussia. He studied at the University of Kraków from 1418 and later worked in Vienna and near Basel. In the 1440s he was chaplain to Emperor Frederick III in Vienna, moving mainly in university circles rather than singing in the chapel. In 1448 he served at the bishop's court in Wrocław and in 1452 travelled to Rome, spending his last years in Silesia. Fewer than twenty of his works survive, identified by acrostics of his name. They include a five-voice motet, and his songs and motets reflect the musical culture of medieval Central Europe.
zh: 格鲁琼兹的彼得（1392—约1480），拉丁名作彼得鲁斯·威廉米·德·格鲁登茨，是生于普鲁士格劳登茨（格鲁琼兹）的作曲家与诗人。他自1418年在克拉科夫大学学习，后来在维也纳和巴塞尔一带活动。1440年代他在维也纳担任皇帝腓特烈三世的小堂神父，主要往来于大学圈子，并未在小堂唱诗。1448年他供职于弗罗茨瓦夫的主教宫廷，1452年前往罗马，晚年在西里西亚度过。他的作品存世不足二十首，学者凭借其中暗藏其名字的离合诗确认作者身份。存世作品包括一首五声部经文歌；他的歌曲和经文歌体现了中世纪中欧的音乐文化。

en: Fazlallah Astarabadi (1339/40–1394), pen name Naimi, was a Persian mystic born at Astarabad near the Caspian. As a child he inherited his father's position as judge, while assistants did the work. At eighteen, hearing a dervish recite a verse by Rumi brought him a religious experience. He later abandoned his family and possessions to become a wandering dervish, teaching that God reveals himself through the letters of scripture, the doctrine at the heart of the Hurufi movement. His Javidan-namah, or Eternal Book, set out his teaching, and followers gathered across Khorasan, Azerbaijan and Shirvan, above all at Baku, with the poet Nasimi among them. Condemned as a heretic, he was imprisoned at Alinja near Nakhchivan and executed in 1394 by order of Miran Shah, son of Timur.
zh: 法兹拉拉·阿斯塔拉巴迪（1339/40—1394），笔名纳伊米，是生于里海沿岸阿斯塔拉巴德的波斯神秘主义者。他幼年继承父亲的法官职位，实际事务由助手处理。十八岁时，他听一名德尔维希吟诵鲁米的诗句，获得了一次宗教体验。此后他舍弃家庭与财产，成为游方德尔维希，宣扬神借文字的字母显现自身，这一教义构成胡鲁非运动的核心。他的《贾维丹书》意为“永恒之书”，系统阐述其学说；信徒在呼罗珊、阿塞拜疆和希尔万各地聚集，以巴库为中心，诗人纳西米亦在其列。他被定为异端，囚禁在纳希切万附近的阿林贾，1394年奉帖木儿之子米兰沙之命被处死。

en: Gawhar Shad (died 1457) was the chief consort of the Timurid emperor Shah Rukh and daughter of the noble Ghiyath ud-Din Tarkhan. Married around 1388, she bore Shah Rukh Ulugh Beg in 1394 and helped move the capital from Samarkand to Herat in 1405. Her brothers served as administrators at the Timurid court in Herat. With her husband she patronized the arts, attracting poets, architects and philosophers to their court. Her patronage made Persian language and culture central to Timurid rule, funding Herat's Musalla complex and the Goharshad Mosque in Mashhad, begun in 1418. After Shah Rukh died in 1447 she was de facto ruler for a favored grandson until Abu Sa'id seized power and had her, aged over eighty, executed on 19 July 1457.
zh: 高哈尔绍德（？—1457）是帖木儿帝国皇帝沙哈鲁的正宫皇后，贵族吉亚斯丁·答剌罕之女。约1388年出嫁，1394年为沙哈鲁生下兀鲁伯，1405年促成帝国都城从撒马尔罕迁至赫拉特。她的兄弟在赫拉特的帖木儿宫廷担任官员。她与丈夫共同资助艺术，吸引诗人、建筑师和哲学家来到宫廷。她的扶持使波斯语言文化成为帖木儿朝统治的核心，先后资助修建赫拉特的穆萨拉建筑群和1418年动工的马什哈德高哈尔绍德清真寺。1447年沙哈鲁死后，她扶持宠孙继位，以摄政身份实际掌权；阿布·赛义德夺权后，年逾八旬的她于1457年7月19日被处死。

en: Ghiyath al-Din Jamshid al-Kashi (c. 1380–1429) was a Persian astronomer and mathematician born at Kashan. His Sullam al-sama of 1407 dealt with celestial distances, and his Khaqani Zij gave sine tables of unprecedented precision; in 1416 he wrote a treatise improving observational instruments. Shah Rukh and his wife Goharshad encouraged scientific study, while their son Ulugh Beg gathered scholars at Samarkand. Invited there by Ulugh Beg, al-Kashi led work at the observatory, calculated pi to sixteen decimal places in 1424 and wrote the Key to Arithmetic using decimal fractions. He died at Samarkand in 1429, leaving his Treatise on the Chord and Sine unfinished; Ulugh Beg called him a scientist who could solve the hardest problems.
zh: 吉亚斯丁·贾姆希德·卡希（约1380—1429）是生于卡尚的波斯天文学家与数学家。他1407年所著《天梯》探讨天体的距离，所编《哈卡尼历表》给出了精度空前的正弦函数表，1416年又撰文改进天文观测仪器。沙哈鲁与妻子高哈尔沙德鼓励科学研究，其子兀鲁伯则在撒马尔罕汇聚学者。卡希受兀鲁伯之邀前往该城，主持新天文台的研究，1424年将圆周率算到小数点后十六位，并在《算术之钥》中运用十进小数。1429年他在撒马尔罕去世，《弦与正弦论》未能完成；兀鲁伯曾称赞他是一位能解开最艰深难题的杰出学者。

en: Ali-Shir Nava'i (1441–1501), also called Nizam al-Din Ali-Shir Herawi, was a Timurid poet, statesman, linguist, mystic and painter, born in Herat on 9 February 1441. His family fled Herat after Shah Rukh's death in 1447 and returned to Khorasan in the 1450s. A schoolmate of Sultan Husayn Bayqara, he studied in Mashhad and Samarkand and, after Bayqara seized Herat in 1469, entered his service; in 1472 he was made emir of the supreme council. The greatest writer of Chagatai Turkic literature, he argued its superiority over Persian in Muhakamat al-Lughatayn and composed a Khamsa and four divans. He died unmarried in Herat on 3 January 1501.
zh: 阿里希尔·纳沃伊（1441—1501），又名尼扎姆丁·阿里希尔·赫拉维，1441年2月9日生于赫拉特，是帖木儿王朝的诗人、政治家、语言学家、神秘主义者和画家。1447年沙哈鲁死后，他的家人逃离赫拉特，1450年代返回呼罗珊。他与苏丹侯赛因·拜哈拉是同窗，曾在马什哈德和撒马尔罕求学；1469年拜哈拉夺取赫拉特后他入朝效力，1472年出任最高会议埃米尔。他是察合台突厥语文学最伟大的代表，在《两种语言之辩》中主张察合台语优于波斯语，并著有《五卷诗》和四部诗集。他终身未娶，1501年1月3日在赫拉特去世。

en: Qavam al-Din ibn Zayn al-Din Shirazi (died 1438) was a Persian architect of the Timurid period. A native of Shiraz, he served Shah Rukh at Herat as a master of engineering, design and building, and worked in Samarkand and Turan. His activity was first recorded in 1410; in an inscription of 1418 he called himself a worker in mud or clay. His monumental designs combined Iranian art with features of contemporary Central Asian buildings. For Queen Gawhar Shad he designed the Goharshad Mosque in Mashhad, begun in 1418, her Herat madrasa and mausoleum, and the Musalla complex of 1417–1438. He also built the shrine of Khwaja Abd Allah Ansari at Gazur Gah and the Ghiyasiyya madrasa at Khargird, and pioneered a dome on intersecting arches. He died in February 1438.
zh: 盖瓦姆丁·设拉齐（？—1438）是帖木儿王朝时期的波斯建筑师，生于设拉子，在赫拉特侍奉沙哈鲁，精通工程、设计与营造，也在撒马尔罕和图兰主持工程。他的活动最早见于1410年的记载；在一则1418年的铭文中，他自称泥工。他设计的大型建筑融合了伊朗艺术与当时中亚建筑的特色。他为皇后高哈尔绍德设计了马什哈德的高哈尔绍德清真寺（1418年动工）、皇后在赫拉特的经学院与陵墓，以及1417—1438年建成的穆萨拉建筑群，还修建了加祖尔加的赫瓦贾·阿卜杜拉·安萨里圣陵和哈尔季尔德的吉亚西耶经学院，并首创以交叉拱券承托穹顶的做法，1438年2月去世。

en: Hafiz-i Abru (died 1430), born Abd Allah al-Khwafi in Khorasan, was the leading Persian historian and geographer of the early Timurid court. He studied at Hamadan, joined Timur in the 1380s and accompanied the conqueror's campaigns from Transoxiana and Iran to Syria, gathering eyewitness geographical notes. He associated with scholars at the courts of Timur and his son Shah Rukh, and was known as a good chess player. After Timur's death he served Shah Rukh at Herat, who in 1414 commissioned his universal history, the Majma al-tawarikh, or Collection of Histories; he also continued Shami's Zafarnama and wrote on the geography of Fars, Kirman and Khurasan. He died in 1430 after joining Shah Rukh's 1429 campaign against the Qara Qoyunlu.
zh: 哈菲兹·阿布鲁（？—1430）原名阿卜杜拉·哈瓦菲，生于呼罗珊，是帖木儿朝早期最重要的波斯语史学家与地理学家。他在哈马丹求学，1380年代进入帖木儿宫廷，随帖木儿大军从河中和伊朗一直征战到叙利亚，沿途记录亲身见闻。他与帖木儿及其子沙哈鲁宫廷中的学者交往，也以善于下棋闻名。帖木儿去世后，他在赫拉特侍奉沙哈鲁；1414年奉沙哈鲁之命编纂通史《历史总汇》，又续成沙米的《武功记》，并撰有法尔斯、克尔曼与呼罗珊的地理志。1429年他随沙哈鲁征讨黑羊王朝，1430年去世。

en: Ali Pasha of Ioannina (c. 1743–1822) was an Albanian ruler in the Ottoman Empire. Starting as leader of a band of Albanian brigands, he entered Ottoman service and in 1788 was appointed pasha of the Sanjak of Ioannina. He married his sons to daughters of Ibrahim Pasha of Berat to secure an alliance and his borders. Through war and diplomacy he extended his control over much of Albania and mainland Greece, ruling his pashalik in all but complete independence from the Porte. His suppression of banditry and harsh methods of extracting wealth drew both admiration and criticism. Declared a rebel in 1820, he was hunted down and killed by Ottoman troops in 1822; his revolt helped set the stage for the Greek Revolution of 1821.
zh: 约阿尼纳的阿里帕夏（约1743—1822）是奥斯曼帝国的阿尔巴尼亚族统治者。他早年为阿尔巴尼亚匪徒首领，后入仕奥斯曼，1788年被任命为约阿尼纳桑贾克的帕夏。他让儿子们迎娶培拉特的易卜拉欣帕夏之女，以巩固同盟和辖区边界。他凭借征战与外交，将势力扩展到阿尔巴尼亚和希腊大陆大部，其帕夏辖区实际上独立于伊斯坦布尔朝廷。他镇压匪患，却也以严酷手段搜刮财富，既受人称许，也遭到批评。1820年他被宣布为叛臣，1822年被奥斯曼军队擒杀；他的起事客观上为1821年希腊革命铺平了道路。

en: Bekir Efendi, later known as Hacı Bekir, was an Ottoman confectioner from Araç in Kastamonu. He moved to Constantinople and in 1777 opened a small sweet shop at Bahçekapı. His shop became known for lokum, or Turkish delight, and akide candies flavoured with rose, cinnamon, mastic, orange and lemon. After making the pilgrimage to Mecca between 1817 and 1820 he was known as Hacı Bekir. His shop supplied the Ottoman palace, earning him the title of chief confectioner, şekercibaşı. Both the business and the title passed to his son Mehmet Muhiddin Efendi and then to his grandson Ali Muhiddin Hacı Bekir, who continued the family enterprise.
zh: 贝基尔·埃芬迪后称哈吉·贝基尔，是奥斯曼糖果师，来自卡斯塔莫努的阿拉奇。他移居君士坦丁堡，于1777年在巴赫切卡珀开设一间小糖果铺。店铺以洛库姆（土耳其软糖）和玫瑰、肉桂、乳香、橙子、柠檬口味的阿克德硬糖成名。1817至1820年间他前往麦加朝觐，此后被称为哈吉·贝基尔。他的店铺供应奥斯曼宫廷，他本人获封首席糖果师。店铺和首席糖果师的头衔均由其子穆罕默德·穆希丁·埃芬迪继承，随后又传给孙子阿里·穆希丁·哈吉·贝基尔，家族事业得以延续。

en: Ioannis Vlachos (1722 or 1730–1771), better known as Daskalogiannis, or John the Teacher, was a wealthy Cretan shipbuilder and shipowner. Born at Anopolis in Sfakia, he was sent abroad for his education by his father, also a wealthy shipowner. He was a town clerk in 1750, owned four three-masted merchant ships sailing out of southern Crete and served as chairman of Sfakia from 1765. In contact with the Russian envoy Count Orlov during the Russo-Turkish war, he led the Sfakian revolt of 1770 against Ottoman rule. The rising failed; Daskalogiannis surrendered at Frangokastello and was put to death on 17 June 1771, becoming a hero of Cretan folk song.
zh: 约安尼斯·弗拉霍斯（1722或1730年—1771），人称达斯卡洛扬尼斯，意为“教师约翰”，是克里特富有的造船主与船东。他生于斯法基亚的阿诺波利斯，父亲也是富有的船东，曾送他到海外求学。他于1750年担任镇书记，拥有四艘从克里特南部出海的三桅商船，并于1765年出任斯法基亚地区的议长。俄土战争期间，他与俄国使节奥尔洛夫伯爵联络，于1770年领导斯法基亚起义，反抗奥斯曼统治。起义失败后，达斯卡洛扬尼斯在弗兰戈卡斯特罗投降，于1771年6月17日被处死，成为克里特民歌中传颂的英雄。

en: Khayr al-Din Barbarossa (c. 1478–1546), born Hızır on Lesbos, was an Ottoman corsair and admiral. Sailing with his elder brother Oruç Reis, he helped seize Algiers from Spain in 1516. After Oruç's death in 1518 he inherited his command and the nickname Barbarossa, received the honorary name Khayr al-Din and pledged Algiers to the Ottomans. In 1529 he took the Peñón of Algiers from the Spaniards. In 1533 Suleiman the Magnificent made him Kapudan Pasha, or grand admiral, and he led an embassy to France. He conquered Tunis in 1534 and crushed the Holy League at Preveza in 1538, securing Ottoman mastery of the Mediterranean. After campaigning with France in the 1540s he retired to Constantinople and died in 1546.
zh: 海雷丁·巴巴罗萨（约1478—1546），本名赫兹尔，生于莱斯沃斯岛，是奥斯曼帝国的私掠船长和海军将领。他随兄长奥鲁奇·雷斯出海，1516年兄弟二人从西班牙手中夺取阿尔及尔。1518年奥鲁奇战死后，他接掌其部众，继承了“巴巴罗萨”的绰号，获赐“海雷丁”的尊号，并把阿尔及尔归附奥斯曼。1529年，他从西班牙人手中夺取阿尔及尔外的佩尼翁要塞。1533年，苏莱曼大帝任命他为卡普丹帕夏，即海军总司令，他还率使团前往法国。1534年他征服突尼斯，1538年在普雷韦扎大败神圣同盟，奠定奥斯曼在地中海的霸权。1540年代他与法国联合作战，此后退隐君士坦丁堡，1546年在当地去世。

en: Sedefkar Mehmed Agha (c. 1540–1617) built Istanbul's Sultan Ahmed Mosque, the Blue Mosque. Possibly born around Elbasan or in Tetovo, he was brought to Istanbul through the devshirme in 1563 and worked for twenty years in mother-of-pearl inlay, earning the surname Sedefkâr. He became Mimar Sinan's pupil and first assistant, completing the master's Muradiye Mosque at Manisa in 1586. In 1606 he became chief imperial architect. Between 1609 and 1616 he built the Sultan Ahmed Mosque beside the Hippodrome, its central dome buttressed by four semi-domes in a blend of Hagia Sophia and Sinan's style. He died in 1617.
zh: 赛德夫卡尔·穆罕默德阿迦（约1540—1617）建成了伊斯坦布尔的苏丹艾哈迈德清真寺，即蓝色清真寺。他可能生于爱尔巴桑一带或泰托沃，1563年通过德夫希尔梅制度被带到伊斯坦布尔，做了二十年螺钿镶嵌活计，由此得到“赛德夫卡尔”（螺钿匠）之名。他后来成为米马尔·希南的弟子和首席助手，1586年在马尼萨续成恩师动工的穆拉迪耶清真寺。1606年，他出任皇家首席建筑师。1609至1616年，他在赛马场旁建成苏丹艾哈迈德清真寺：中央大穹顶由四个半穹顶承托，融合了圣索菲亚与希南的风格。他于1617年去世。

en: Çandarlı Halil Pasha the Younger (d. 1453) was the fourth grand vizier from the Turkish Çandarlı family, which supplied five chief ministers to the early Ottoman state. He became grand vizier in 1439 under Murad II and twice, in 1444 and 1446, recalled the abdicated Murad to the throne, setting aside the young Mehmed II. After the first recall, Murad defeated the Crusaders at Varna. When Murad died in 1451, Halil ensured the immediate transfer of power to Mehmed. He opposed the siege of Constantinople and was suspected of taking Byzantine bribes. After Mehmed II conquered the city in 1453, Halil was dismissed and executed on 10 July.
zh: 钱达尔勒·哈利勒帕夏（？—1453，世称小哈利勒）出身土耳其钱达尔勒家族，是该家族出任大维齐尔的第四人，这个家族共为早期奥斯曼帝国贡献了五任大维齐尔。他1439年在穆拉德二世治下拜相，1444和1446年两度迎请退位的穆拉德复位、架空年少的穆罕默德二世。首次复位后，穆拉德在瓦尔纳击败十字军。1451年穆拉德去世，哈利勒确保穆罕默德立即继位。他反对围攻君士坦丁堡，并被怀疑收受拜占庭贿赂。1453年穆罕默德二世攻陷该城后，哈利勒被罢官，于7月10日处死。

en: Haji Bayram Veli (1352–1430), born Numan in Ankara, was an Ottoman Sufi poet and saint who founded the Bayramiyya dervish order. He made the pilgrimage to Mecca with his master Somunju Baba, who continued to teach him on the journey. Inheriting his master's authority in 1412, he returned to Ankara, where his preaching and hymns drew crowds to the lodge he built. When the order's rapid growth alarmed the authorities, they sent him to Murad II in Edirne. He went with his disciple Akshamsaddin, and the sultan let them lecture at court. A later legend credits Bayram with foretelling Mehmed II's conquest of Constantinople. He died in Ankara in 1430, leaving the order to Akshamsaddin.
zh: 哈吉·巴伊拉姆·韦利（1352—1430），本名努曼，生于安卡拉，是奥斯曼苏菲派诗人与圣徒，拜拉姆苦行僧教团的创立者。他与师尊索蒙朱巴巴一同赴麦加朝觐，旅途中师尊继续教导他。1412年继承师尊的权威后，他回到安卡拉，修建道堂，以讲道和赞诗吸引了大批信众。教团迅速壮大引起地方官不安，他们把他送往埃迪尔内觐见穆拉德二世。他与弟子阿克谢姆塞丁同行，苏丹允许他们在宫廷讲道。后世传说称巴伊拉姆曾预言穆罕默德二世将征服君士坦丁堡。1430年他在安卡拉去世，将教团传给阿克谢姆塞丁。

en: Meriwether Lewis (1774–1809) was an American explorer and soldier, born in Virginia on 18 August 1774. After militia service in the 1794 Whiskey Rebellion he joined the army, rose to captain, and in 1801 became Thomas Jefferson's secretary. Chosen by Jefferson to lead an expedition across the Louisiana Purchase, he shared command with William Clark; from 1804 to 1806 the Corps of Discovery traveled up the Missouri, crossed the Rockies and reached the Pacific in November 1805. Jefferson hoped to find a water route for trade with Asia; Lewis and his companions also collected scientific data and information about Indigenous nations. Appointed governor of Upper Louisiana in 1806, he died of gunshot wounds in Tennessee on 11 October 1809, in circumstances still disputed.
zh: 梅里韦瑟·刘易斯（1774—1809）是美国探险家、军人，1774年8月18日生于弗吉尼亚。1794年他参加民兵平定威士忌叛乱，后加入陆军升至上尉，1801年成为托马斯·杰斐逊总统的秘书。他受杰斐逊挑选率领穿越路易斯安那购地的远征，与威廉·克拉克共同指挥；1804至1806年，“发现军团”溯密苏里河而上，翻越落基山脉，于1805年11月抵达太平洋。杰斐逊希望找到一条通往亚洲的贸易水路；刘易斯和同伴还收集了科学资料与沿途原住民的信息。1806年他被任命为上路易斯安那总督，1809年10月11日在田纳西因枪伤身亡，究竟是他杀还是自杀至今没有定论。

en: William Clark (1770–1838) was an American explorer, soldier and territorial governor, born in Caroline County, Virginia, on 1 August 1770. His family moved to Kentucky in 1785, where his brother George Rogers Clark taught him wilderness survival skills. He served in the U.S. Army under Anthony Wayne at the Battle of Fallen Timbers in 1794. In 1803 his friend Meriwether Lewis invited him to share command of an expedition across the Louisiana Purchase; from 1804 to 1806 the Corps of Discovery followed the Missouri to the Pacific and back, mapping the American West. Clark later governed the Missouri Territory and from 1822 was Superintendent of Indian Affairs in St. Louis, where he died on 1 September 1838.
zh: 威廉·克拉克（1770—1838）是美国探险家、军人和领地总督，1770年8月1日生于弗吉尼亚州卡罗琳县。1785年他的家人迁往肯塔基，兄长乔治·罗杰斯·克拉克在那里教他野外生存技能。他在美军中服役，隶属安东尼·韦恩麾下，参加了1794年的鹿寨战役。1803年，友人梅里韦瑟·刘易斯邀他共同率领一支穿越路易斯安那购地的远征队；1804至1806年，“发现军团”沿密苏里河抵达太平洋再返回，绘制了美国西部的地图。他后来出任密苏里领地总督，1822年起在圣路易斯任印第安事务总监，1838年9月1日在当地去世。

en: Daniel Shays (1747–1825) was an American farmer and Continental Army captain, born in Hopkinton, Massachusetts, in 1747. In 1772 he married Abigail Gilbert and settled on a farm in Shutesbury. He fought at Bunker Hill, Saratoga and Stony Point, but left the army unpaid and returned home to debts and tax foreclosures. In 1786 he joined rural protesters shutting down county courts, and in January 1787 led hundreds of Regulators against the federal armory at Springfield, where militia grapeshot broke the assault; Benjamin Lincoln then scattered his men at Petersham. Condemned for treason, Shays was pardoned in 1788. He later lived on a federal pension and a small plot of land, and died in Sparta, New York, on 29 September 1825.
zh: 丹尼尔·谢司（1747—1825）是美国马萨诸塞的农民、大陆军上尉，1747年生于霍普金顿。1772年他与阿比盖尔·吉尔伯特成婚，在舒茨伯里的一座农场定居。他曾参加邦克山、萨拉托加和斯托尼角战役，退伍时军饷未结清，回家后负债累累、面临因欠税被没收田产。1786年他参加农民抗议，迫使县级法院停摆；1787年1月率数百名“规则派”攻打斯普林菲尔德的联邦军火库，被民兵的葡萄弹击退，本杰明·林肯随后在彼得舍姆击溃其部众。他以叛国罪被判刑，1788年获赦。此后他靠联邦抚恤金和一小块土地为生，1825年9月29日在纽约州斯巴达去世。

en: Benjamin Franklin (17 January 1706 – 17 April 1790) was a Founding Father of the United States. He made his name in Philadelphia as a printer and publisher of Poor Richard's Almanack, and in 1753 became deputy postmaster-general for the British colonies. His studies of electricity made him a leading scientist, and his inventions included the lightning rod. He also helped found Philadelphia's first fire department. As a colonial agent in London he helped secure repeal of the Stamp Act in 1766. He helped draft the Declaration of Independence in 1776, then as minister to France won the French alliance that sustained the revolution and the 1783 Treaty of Paris. President of Pennsylvania from 1785, he signed the Constitution in 1787.
zh: 本杰明·富兰克林（1706年1月17日—1790年4月17日）是美国开国元勋之一。他在费城以印刷商和《穷理查年鉴》出版者成名，1753年出任英属北美殖民地副邮政总长。他对电的研究使他成为杰出的科学家，发明中包括避雷针；他还参与创立了费城首支消防队。后来，他作为殖民地驻伦敦代理人，在1766年促成废除《印花税法》。1776年他参与起草《独立宣言》，随后出任驻法公使，争取到支撑独立战争的法国同盟以及1783年的《巴黎条约》。他1785年起任宾夕法尼亚州州长，1787年签署联邦宪法。

en: Tito Livio Burattini (1617–1681) was a Venetian inventor, instrument-maker and scientist born in Agordo, near Belluno, who spent his career in Poland and Lithuania. After studying in Padua and exploring the Great Pyramid with John Greaves in 1639, he was summoned to Warsaw by King Ladislaus IV in 1641. In 1647 he built a model aircraft called the flying dragon, which was said to have lifted a cat in 1648 but never a man. His 1675 treatise Universal Measure, printed at Vilnius, proposed the metro cattolico and first applied the name metre to a unit of length. He died in Kraków.
zh: 提托·李维欧·布拉提尼（1617—1681）是威尼斯共和国的发明家、仪器制造师与科学家，生于贝卢诺附近的阿戈尔多，大半生在波兰和立陶宛工作。他在帕多瓦求学，1639年与约翰·格里夫斯一同考察大金字塔，1641年被国王瓦迪斯瓦夫四世召往华沙。1647年他造出飞行器模型“飞龙”，相传1648年曾载起一只猫，却始终没能载人。1675年在维尔纽斯出版的《通用度量》提出“通用米”，是最早把标准长度单位命名为“米”的著作。他最终在克拉科夫去世。

en: Claudio Monteverdi (baptized 1567–1643) was an Italian composer born in Cremona whose work marks the transition from Renaissance to Baroque music. He published his first book of madrigals in 1587 and entered the Gonzaga court in Mantua around 1590. He defended his innovative techniques as a seconda pratica and employed basso continuo in his music. His opera L'Orfeo was performed at Mantua during Carnival in 1607 and printed in 1609. He also published the Vespers in 1610. In 1613 he became maestro di cappella at St Mark's Basilica in Venice, holding the post until his death. In old age, he wrote The Return of Ulysses and The Coronation of Poppea for Venetian theatres.
zh: 克劳迪奥·蒙特威尔第（1567年受洗—1643）是生于克雷莫纳的意大利作曲家，作品标志着文艺复兴音乐向巴洛克音乐的过渡。他于1587年出版第一卷牧歌，约1590年进入曼托瓦的贡扎加宫廷。他以“第二实践”之名为自己的创新技法辩护，并在音乐中运用通奏低音。他的歌剧《奥菲欧》1607年狂欢节期间在曼托瓦上演，1609年付印；他又于1610年出版《圣母晚祷》。1613年他出任威尼斯圣马可大教堂乐长，在任直至去世。晚年他为威尼斯剧院写下《尤利西斯还乡》与《波佩亚的加冕》。

en: Tiziano Vecellio, known as Titian (c. 1488/1490–1576), was the leading painter of the Venetian Renaissance, born at Pieve di Cadore near Belluno. Trained in Venice under Gentile and Giovanni Bellini alongside Giorgione, he painted frescoes at Padua in 1511 and won fame with the Assumption of the Virgin for the Frari, completed in 1518. Its agitated apostles broke with the meditative stillness of earlier Venetian painting. His patrons came to include the Gonzaga, Emperor Charles V, the papacy and Philip II of Spain. Equally master of portraits, mythologies and altarpieces, he defined Venetian colour and loose brushwork across nearly seventy years. His mature works were marked by subtle tones as well as loose brushwork; he died in Venice in the plague of 1576.
zh: 提齐亚诺·韦切利奥，即提香（约1488/1490—1576），是威尼斯文艺复兴时期最杰出的画家，生于贝卢诺附近的皮耶韦-迪卡多雷。他在威尼斯先后随真蒂莱·贝利尼、乔瓦尼·贝利尼学艺，与乔尔乔内同窗，1511年在帕多瓦绘制湿壁画，1518年为弗拉里教堂完成《圣母升天》，一举成名。画中激动的使徒打破了早期威尼斯绘画的沉静氛围。他的赞助人包括贡扎加家族、皇帝查理五世、教廷和西班牙国王腓力二世。他兼擅肖像、神话题材与祭坛画，在近七十年的创作中确立了威尼斯画派的色彩风格与奔放笔法。成熟时期的作品兼具细腻色调与奔放笔触；他最终于1576年在威尼斯鼠疫中去世。

en: Lorenzo Marcello (1603–1656) was a Venetian admiral born into the patrician Marcello family. He entered the navy in 1618, campaigned against Barbary pirates in the 1630s and fought the Papal fleet in 1642–1644 before joining the war against the Ottomans over Crete. At Valona in 1638, he remained in command after being wounded in the arm, earning the Senate's praise. In September 1655 he succeeded Francesco Morosini as Captain General of the Sea. On 26 June 1656 he led the combined Venetian and Maltese fleet against the Ottoman navy at the Dardanelles, winning Venice's greatest victory since Lepanto; he was killed by a cannon shot leading the centre into battle. His lieutenant concealed his body to preserve the crews' morale.
zh: 洛伦佐·马切洛（1603—1656）是威尼斯海军将领，出身贵族马切洛家族。他1618年加入海军，1630年代征讨巴巴里海盗，1642—1644年与教皇国舰队作战，随后投入争夺克里特的对奥斯曼战争。1638年他在瓦罗纳手臂受伤后继续指挥，受到元老院嘉奖。1655年9月，他接替弗朗切斯科·莫罗西尼出任海上总司令。1656年6月26日，他率领威尼斯与马耳他联合舰队在达达尼尔海峡迎战奥斯曼海军，取得勒班陀海战以来威尼斯最辉煌的胜利；他在率中军冲锋时被炮弹击中阵亡。副手为保持船员士气，遮住了他的遗体。

en: Adrian Willaert (c. 1490–1562) was a Flemish composer of the High Renaissance and the founder of the Venetian School. Born near Roeselare in Flanders, he went to Paris to study law but turned to music under Jean Mouton. In 1515 he entered the service of the Este family of Ferrara, probably accompanying Cardinal Ippolito I d'Este as far as Hungary. In 1527 the doge Andrea Gritti helped secure his appointment as maestro di cappella of St Mark's Basilica in Venice, a post he held until his death. Alongside sacred music he wrote numerous secular madrigals. He transplanted Franco-Flemish polyphony to Italy and trained musicians from across Europe, including Gioseffo Zarlino.
zh: 阿德里安·维拉尔特（约1490—1562）是文艺复兴盛期的佛兰德斯作曲家、威尼斯乐派的奠基人。他生于佛兰德斯的鲁瑟拉勒附近，早年赴巴黎学习法律，后来转而师从让·穆东学习音乐。1515年，他进入费拉拉的埃斯特家族效力，很可能曾随伊波利托一世·德斯特枢机远赴匈牙利。1527年，在总督安德烈·格里蒂的推动下，他出任威尼斯圣马可大教堂乐长，担任此职直至去世。除宗教音乐外，他还创作了大量世俗牧歌。他把法兰克—佛兰德复调音乐带到意大利，并培养了扎利诺等来自欧洲各地的音乐家。

en: Gioseffo Zarlino (1517–1590) was an Italian Franciscan composer and the most influential music theorist of the Renaissance, born at Chioggia near Venice. Educated by the Franciscans, he entered their order in 1532. He became a singer at Chioggia Cathedral in 1536 and its organist and a deacon by 1539. Ordained priest in 1540, he moved to Venice in 1541 to study with Adrian Willaert. In 1565 he succeeded Cipriano de Rore as maestro di cappella of St Mark's, holding the post until his death. His writings founded the theory of tonal harmony in the major and minor modes and contributed to counterpoint, and his pupils included Claudio Merulo and Vincenzo Galilei.
zh: 焦塞福·扎利诺（1517—1590）是意大利方济各会修士、作曲家，也是文艺复兴时期最有影响的音乐理论家，生于威尼斯附近的基奥贾。他受方济各会教育，1532年加入修会，1536年成为基奥贾大教堂歌手，至1539年又担任管风琴师并成为执事。1540年他晋铎，1541年到威尼斯师从阿德里安·维拉尔特。1565年，他继奇普里亚诺·德·罗雷之后出任圣马可大教堂乐长，直至去世。他的著述奠定了大小调调性和声理论的基础，也对对位法有所贡献，学生包括克劳迪奥·梅鲁洛和温琴佐·伽利莱。

en: Baldassare Donato (c. 1525/1530–1603) was an Italian composer and singer of the late Venetian school and a leading developer of the light secular villanella. First recorded as a singer at St Mark's Basilica in 1550, he was charged with training its choirboys in 1562. When Gioseffo Zarlino became maestro di cappella in 1565 Donato was demoted to singer, and their feud ended in a brawl on the Feast of St Mark in 1569. In 1577 he took a post at the Scuola Grande di San Rocco, but resigned by 1580 after falling out with his employers. He became Zarlino's deputy in 1588 and succeeded him at St Mark's in 1590, serving until his death.
zh: 巴尔达萨雷·多纳托（约1525/1530—1603）是威尼斯乐派晚期的意大利作曲家、歌手，也是维拉内拉等轻快世俗音乐的重要推动者。史料中他最早于1550年在威尼斯圣马可大教堂任歌手，1562年受命训练唱诗班男童。1565年扎利诺出任乐长后他被降为歌手，两人失和，1569年圣马可节当天甚至斗殴。1577年他转往圣洛克大会堂任职，却因与雇主不和，于1580年前辞职。1588年他成为扎利诺的副手，1590年接替他执掌圣马可大教堂，直至1603年去世。

en: Claudio Merulo (1533–1604), born Claudio Merlotti at Correggio, was an Italian organist, composer and publisher of the late Venetian Renaissance, celebrated for pioneering keyboard music. After a year at Brescia Cathedral, he was appointed organist of St Mark's in 1557 over Andrea Gabrieli, and became its first organist in 1566. He wrote festive music for Henry III of France's 1574 visit to Venice and represented the republic at the Medici wedding in 1579. In 1584 he left St Mark's for Parma's Farnese court; from 1587 he served Parma Cathedral and published his influential Toccate per organo. He died at Parma in 1604 and was buried beside Cipriano de Rore.
zh: 克劳迪奥·梅鲁洛（1533—1604），原名克劳迪奥·梅洛蒂，生于科雷焦，是威尼斯文艺复兴晚期的意大利管风琴家、作曲家兼出版商，以开拓性的键盘音乐闻名。他在布雷西亚大教堂任职一年后，于1557年击败安德烈亚·加布里埃利等人，被任命为圣马可大教堂管风琴师，1566年升任首席管风琴师。1574年法王亨利三世访问威尼斯时，他创作了庆典音乐，1579年又代表共和国出席美第奇家族的婚礼。1584年他离开圣马可，转投帕尔马的法尔内塞宫廷，1587年起任职帕尔马大教堂，并出版影响深远的《管风琴托卡塔》。他于1604年在帕尔马去世，葬在奇普里亚诺·德·罗雷的墓旁。

en: Giovanni Gabrieli (c. 1554/1557–1612) was an Italian composer and organist who brought the Venetian School to its peak at the turn to the Baroque. He probably studied in Venice with his uncle Andrea Gabrieli and studied in Munich with Orlando de Lassus before returning home by 1584. In 1585 he succeeded Claudio Merulo as principal organist of St Mark's and later became its principal composer, and organist for life at the Scuola Grande di San Rocco. After his uncle's death he compiled and edited Andrea's music for publication. His Sacrae symphoniae of 1597 spread the Venetian polychoral style across Europe, drawing pupils such as Heinrich Schütz. He died in Venice in 1612.
zh: 乔万尼·加布里埃利（约1554/1557—1612）是意大利作曲家、管风琴家，在文艺复兴向巴罗克过渡之际把威尼斯乐派推向顶峰。他很可能在威尼斯师从叔父安德烈亚·加布里埃利，又赴慕尼黑师从奥兰多·德·拉絮斯，至1584年已回国。1585年他继克劳迪奥·梅鲁洛之后出任圣马可大教堂首席管风琴师，后来又兼任首席作曲家，同时终身担任圣洛克大会堂管风琴师。叔父去世后，他整理编辑了安德烈亚的音乐作品并予以出版。1597年出版的《圣乐交响曲》把威尼斯复合唱风格传遍欧洲，吸引海因里希·许茨等学生前来求学。他于1612年在威尼斯去世。

en: Pietro Loredan (1372–1438) was a Venetian nobleman and admiral of the Loredan family. His father and grandfather had also commanded Venetian fleets. In 1403 he escorted the Byzantine emperor Manuel II to Constantinople and fought the Genoese at Modon on his return. In 1412, as captain-general, he took Šibenik and helped defeat the troops of Sigismund of Hungary at the Battle of Motta, securing Dalmatia for Venice. Sent against the Ottomans in 1416, he destroyed their fleet at the Battle of Gallipoli. He later campaigned against Genoa and Milan and was made Procurator of St Mark's in 1425. In 1423 he lost the doge's election to his rival Francesco Foscari; when Loredan died in 1438, Foscari was suspected of poisoning him.
zh: 彼得罗·洛雷丹（1372—1438）出身洛雷丹家族，是威尼斯贵族与海军统帅。他的父亲和祖父也曾统领威尼斯舰队。1403年他护送拜占庭皇帝曼努埃尔二世前往君士坦丁堡，返航时在莫东与热那亚人交战。1412年他出任舰队统帅，攻取希贝尼克，并在莫塔战役中协助击败匈牙利国王西吉斯蒙德的军队，为威尼斯保住达尔马提亚。1416年他奉命出征奥斯曼，在加里波利战役中摧毁奥斯曼舰队。此后他又对热那亚和米兰作战，1425年获任圣马可行政长官。1423年他在总督选举中败给政敌弗朗切斯科·福斯卡里；1438年他去世时，外界怀疑是福斯卡里将他毒杀。

en: Bartolomeo Bon (c. 1405–c. 1466) was a Venetian sculptor and architect whose career bridged Venetian Gothic and the early Renaissance. Trained by his father Giovanni Bon, he worked with him on the sculptural decoration of the Ca' d'Oro between 1424 and 1430. Father and son also made the marble door of the Frari and were entrusted with the Porta della Carta (1438–1442), the rich marble gateway joining the Doge's Palace to St Mark's Basilica. Bartolomeo also worked independently on the Porta della Carta, the portal of San Giovanni e Paolo and a portal of the Scuola Grande della Misericordia, including a sculpted lunette.
zh: 巴托洛梅奥·博诺（约1405—约1466）是威尼斯雕塑家兼建筑师，其生涯跨越威尼斯哥特式与文艺复兴早期。他从父亲乔瓦尼·博诺学艺，1424至1430年间随父参与黄金宫的雕刻装饰。父子还共同制作弗拉里荣耀圣母堂的大理石门，并受托修建纸门（1438—1442），这座华美的大理石门连接总督宫与圣马可大教堂。巴托洛梅奥也独立参与纸门的工作，并制作了圣乔凡尼保罗大教堂的门廊和仁慈大会堂的一座门廊，包括其雕刻半圆楣饰。

en: Antonio Vivaldi (1678–1741), nicknamed the Red Priest, was a Venetian Baroque composer and violinist. Ordained in 1703, he was excused from saying Mass through ill health and instead made his career at Venice's Ospedale della Pietà, where he taught violin and composed concertos for its orchestra of orphaned girls. He consolidated the solo concerto form in hundreds of works, above all The Four Seasons, and wrote more than fifty operas, some of which were staged in Venice, Mantua and Vienna. In 1740 he followed his patron Emperor Charles VI to Vienna, but the emperor died and Vivaldi died in poverty on 28 July 1741.
zh: 安东尼奥·维瓦尔第（1678—1741）是威尼斯巴洛克作曲家与小提琴家，绰号“红发神父”。他1703年受任神职，因体弱获准不主持弥撒，转而长年任职于威尼斯仁爱济贫院，在院里教授小提琴，并为孤女组成的乐团创作协奏曲。他以数百部作品确立了独奏协奏曲的形式，最著名的是《四季》，还写了50多部歌剧，其中一些在威尼斯、曼托瓦和维也纳上演。1740年他追随庇护人皇帝查理六世前往维也纳，皇帝不久去世，他本人也于1741年7月28日在贫困中离世。

en: Benedetto Marcello (1686–1739) was a Venetian nobleman, magistrate and Baroque composer, a pupil of Francesco Gasparini and Antonio Lotti. His father wanted him to pursue law, and he combined public service with music. While holding public office from the Council of Forty in 1711 to provincial governor at Pola, he wrote more than three hundred cantatas and four oratorios. His satire of the opera world, Il teatro alla moda, appeared anonymously in 1720. His masterpiece Estro poetico-armonico (1724–1727) set fifty psalms for voices and continuo and was admired across Europe by Goethe, Rossini and Verdi. In 1728 he secretly married his singing pupil Rosanna Scalfi, a commoner. He died of tuberculosis at Brescia in 1739 while serving as chamberlain.
zh: 贝内代托·马切洛（1686—1739）是威尼斯贵族、法官与巴洛克作曲家，师从弗朗切斯科·加斯帕里尼和安东尼奥·洛蒂。他的父亲希望他从事法律，他便在公职之余兼顾音乐。他1711年进入四十人团，后又出任波拉长官等公职，公务之余创作了三百余首康塔塔和四部清唱剧。1720年他匿名发表讽刺歌剧界的小册子《时髦的剧院》。其代表作《诗与和声的灵感》（1724—1727）将50首诗篇谱为人声与通奏低音的乐曲，在欧洲广受赞誉，歌德、罗西尼和威尔第都对其推崇备至。1728年他与平民出身的声乐学生罗桑娜·斯卡尔菲秘密成婚。1739年他在布雷西亚任总管大臣期间因结核病去世。

en: Alessandro Leopardi (c. 1465–1522/1523) was a Venetian sculptor, bronze founder and architect, nicknamed del Cavallo after his most famous work. A master at the Venetian mint, he was exiled for fraud in 1487 but recalled in 1490 to cast the bronze equestrian statue of Bartolomeo Colleoni left unfinished at Verrocchio's death. Verrocchio had made the clay model and wished his pupil Lorenzo di Credi to oversee its casting, but the Venetians chose Leopardi. The casting was completed in 1492 and his pedestal in 1495; his name was inscribed on the horse's girth. He also designed and cast the three richly sculpted bronze flagpole bases in St Mark's Square between 1505 and 1506, and later oversaw fortifications at Padua and Treviso.
zh: 亚历山德罗·莱奥帕尔迪（约1465—1522/1523）是威尼斯雕塑家、青铜铸造师兼建筑师，因最著名的作品得到“德尔卡瓦洛”（铸马者）的绰号。他本是威尼斯造币厂的师傅，1487年因欺诈被流放，1490年被召回，负责铸造韦罗基奥去世时未完成的巴尔托洛梅奥·科莱奥尼青铜骑马像。韦罗基奥已制成泥模，希望由弟子洛伦佐·迪·克雷迪主持铸造，威尼斯当局却选中了莱奥帕尔迪。铜像于1492年浇铸完成，他设计的基座在1495年落成，马的肚带上刻有他的名字。1505至1506年，他又设计并铸造了圣马可广场三座雕饰华美的青铜旗杆基座，后来还主持过帕多瓦和特雷维索的防御工事。

en: Paolo Sarpi (1552–1623) was a Venetian Servite friar, historian and canon lawyer who defended the Republic against the papacy. He entered the Servite Order in 1566, served as court theologian at Mantua and was elected provincial in 1579. He later became the senate's canonist consultor. When Pope Paul V laid Venice under interdict in 1606, Sarpi supplied the legal case for defiance; excommunicated in January 1607, he survived a dagger attack by five assassins the following October. In 1619 his History of the Council of Trent was published in London and at once banned in Rome. A friend of Galileo and advocate of church-state separation, he died in Venice in 1623.
zh: 保罗·萨尔皮（1552—1623）是威尼斯圣母忠仆会修士、历史学家和教会法学家，曾为威尼斯共和国对抗教廷。1566年他加入圣母忠仆会，后来在曼图亚担任宫廷神学家，1579年当选修会省会长，此后成为元老院的教会法顾问。1606年教宗保罗五世对威尼斯颁布禁令，萨尔皮为共和国的反抗提供法理依据；1607年1月他被革除教籍，同年10月遭五名刺客持刀袭击，侥幸生还。1619年，他的《特伦托会议史》在伦敦出版，随即被罗马列为禁书。他是伽利略的朋友，主张政教分离，1623年在威尼斯去世。

en: Antonio Pigafetta (c. 1492–c. 1534) was a Venetian nobleman and explorer from Vicenza. In 1518 he accompanied the papal ambassador Francesco Chiericati to Spain. The following year he joined Ferdinand Magellan's Spanish expedition to the Spice Islands, serving as Magellan's assistant and keeping a precise journal of the voyage. After Magellan's death in the Philippines in 1521, he was one of eighteen men, out of about 240 who had set out, who completed the entire voyage. Led by Juan Sebastián Elcano, they reached Spain in 1522 aboard the Victoria, completing the first circumnavigation of the globe. His journal also records the first Cebuano word list.
zh: 安东尼奥·皮加费塔（约1492—约1534）是维琴察出身的威尼斯贵族与探险家。1518年，他随教皇使节弗朗切斯科·基耶里卡蒂前往西班牙。次年，他加入费迪南德·麦哲伦率领的西班牙香料群岛探险队，担任麦哲伦的助手，并逐日详记航行见闻。1521年麦哲伦在菲律宾死后，他成为完成全程的十八人之一，出发时船队约有240人。1522年，他们在胡安·塞巴斯蒂安·埃尔卡诺率领下乘“维多利亚号”返回西班牙，完成了人类首次环球航行。他的日记还记下了最早的宿务语词汇表。

en: Francesco Foscari (1373–1457) was the 65th doge of Venice, elected in 1423 over Pietro Loredan after serving as ambassador and Procurator of St Mark's. His thirty-four-year reign was the longest in the republic's history. He led Venice through the Wars in Lombardy against the Visconti of Milan, driving its expansion on the Italian mainland until Francesco Sforza forced a peace. The prolonged war was costly for a republic whose wealth came from the sea. A patron of Renaissance art, he built the Gothic Ca' Foscari on the Grand Canal. His son Jacopo was tried and exiled, dying in Crete. In 1457 the Council of Ten made Foscari abdicate; he died days later and received a state funeral.
zh: 弗朗切斯科·福斯卡里（1373—1457）是威尼斯第65任总督，曾出任大使、圣马可行政长官等职，1423年击败彼得罗·洛雷丹当选。他在位34年，是威尼斯共和国历史上统治时间最长的总督。任内他领导威尼斯进行对抗米兰维斯孔蒂家族的伦巴第战争，推动共和国向意大利大陆扩张，最终被弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎迫使议和。漫长的战争让这个财富来自海洋的共和国付出了沉重代价。他也是文艺复兴艺术的赞助人，在大运河畔修建了哥特式的福斯卡里宫。其子雅各布受审流放，客死克里特。1457年十人团逼迫福斯卡里退位；他数日之后去世，获授国葬。

en: Fra Mauro (c. 1400–1459) was a Camaldolese monk and cartographer at the monastery of San Michele on Murano in the Venetian Lagoon. In his youth he travelled as a merchant and soldier and became familiar with the Middle East. Monastery records list collecting rents as his main duty; he also ran a mapmaking workshop, questioning merchants returning from overseas voyages. Around 1450 he finished his great circular world map on parchment, made for the rulers of Venice and Portugal. More than two metres across and covered with thousands of notes, it was the most detailed world map of its age and put accuracy above biblical geography, without Jerusalem at its centre.
zh: 弗拉·毛罗（约1400—1459）是威尼斯潟湖穆拉诺岛上圣米凯莱修道院的卡马尔多利会修士兼地图学家。他年轻时曾以商人、士兵身份远游，熟悉中东。修道院记录称他的主要职责是收取租金；他还主持制图作坊，常向远航归来的商人打听见闻。约1450年，他应威尼斯与葡萄牙统治者之托，在羊皮纸上绘成巨幅圆形世界地图。该图宽逾两米，附数千条注文，是当时最详尽的世界地图；它不把耶路撒冷置于中心，将准确性置于圣经地理传统之上。

en: Marino Sanuto the Younger (1466–1536) was a Venetian patrician, historian and diarist, the son of the senator Leonardo Sanuto. In 1483 he accompanied his cousin Mario on a tour of Istria and Venice's mainland provinces, recording his experiences. Elected to the Great Council at twenty and a senator from 1498, he kept a daily record of the republic's politics, diplomacy and news, granted access to the state's secret archives. His Diarii filled fifty-eight volumes covering 1496 to 1533. Twice passed over for the post of official historian, he received a senate pension in 1531 and died in 1536.
zh: 马里诺·萨努杜（1466—1536），威尼斯贵族、历史学家与日记作家，为参议员莱昂纳多·萨努杜之子。1483年，他陪同堂兄弟马里奥巡视伊斯特里亚与威尼斯的大陆领地，记录了沿途见闻。他二十岁即入选大议事会，1498年成为参议员，并获准查阅国家机密档案，逐日记录共和国的政治、外交与见闻。他的《日记》共五十八卷，记事自1496年至1533年。他两次与官方史官之职失之交臂，1531年得到元老院发放的年金，1536年去世。

en: Elena Cornaro Piscopia (1646–1684) was a Venetian noblewoman and philosopher, the daughter of Gianbattista Cornaro-Piscopia, Procurator of St Mark. A Benedictine oblate from 1665, she published a translation of Lanspergius in 1669 and in 1670 became president of Venice's Accademia dei Pacifici. Cardinal Barbarigo refused her a theology degree at Padua but allowed her to study philosophy, and on 25 June 1678, in Padua Cathedral, she was proclaimed a doctor of philosophy after disputing passages of Aristotle in Latin, the first woman to earn a doctorate in philosophy. She died of tuberculosis in Padua on 26 July 1684.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/埃琳娜·科尔纳罗·皮斯科皮亚
zh: 埃琳娜·科尔纳罗·皮斯科皮亚（1646—1684）是威尼斯贵族女性、哲学家，父亲是圣马可行政长官詹巴蒂斯塔·科尔纳罗-皮斯科皮亚。她1665年成为本笃会献修女，但并未正式出家；1669年出版了所译兰斯佩吉乌斯的著作，1670年出任威尼斯“和平学院”院长。巴尔巴里戈枢机不准她攻读神学学位，只许她学习哲学。1678年6月25日，她在帕多瓦主教座堂用拉丁语就亚里士多德的著作进行答辩，被授予哲学博士，成为第一位获得哲学博士学位的女性。1684年7月26日她因肺结核在帕多瓦去世。

en: Angelo Notari (1566–1663) was an Italian composer born in Padua and trained in Venice, who spent most of his career in England. From 1610 he served Henry, Prince of Wales, and from 1618 he served Prince Charles, later King Charles I, as a singer and lutenist. His 1613 collection Prime musiche nuove, containing monodies, canzonettas and variations on a madrigal by Rore, brought the latest Italian monodic style to the English court. He died in London in December 1663, aged about ninety-seven.
zh: 安杰洛·诺塔里（1566—1663）是生于帕多瓦、在威尼斯学成的意大利作曲家，大半生在英国度过。1610年起他侍奉威尔士亲王亨利，1618年起转入查理王子，即后来的国王查理一世宫中，担任歌手与琉特琴师。1613年出版的曲集《新乐初集》收录单声部歌曲、小坎佐纳以及基于罗尔一首牧歌的变奏曲，把意大利最新的单声部风格引入英国宫廷。1663年12月他在伦敦去世，享年约97岁。

en: Benedetto Castelli (1578–1643), born Antonio Castelli in Brescia, was an Italian Benedictine monk, mathematician and physicist, and the closest pupil of Galileo Galilei. He assisted Galileo's study of sunspots and took part in discussions of Copernican theory. In December 1610 he wrote to Galileo asking whether the phases of Venus could be seen through his telescope. In 1613 he took Galileo's old mathematics chair at the University of Pisa, and in 1625 Pope Urban VIII called him to teach at the Sapienza in Rome. His studies of running water, including advice on the Reno River dispute and the drainage of the Pontine Marshes, issued in the treatise On the Measurement of Running Waters, a foundation of modern hydraulics. His pupils included Torricelli, Borelli and Cavalieri. He died in Rome.
zh: 贝内代托·卡斯泰利（1578—1643）出生于布雷西亚，俗名安东尼奥，是意大利本笃会修士、数学家与物理学家，也是伽利略最亲近的弟子。他协助伽利略研究太阳黑子，参与讨论哥白尼学说。1610年12月，他写信询问伽利略能否用望远镜看到金星的盈亏。1613年他在比萨大学接任伽利略的数学教席，1625年被教宗乌尔班八世召往罗马智慧大学任教。他研究流水的运动与测量，曾为雷诺河之争和蓬蒂内沼泽排水提供意见，并著有《论流水的测量》，奠定了现代水力学的基础。他的学生包括托里拆利、博雷利与卡瓦列里，最终在罗马去世。

en: Nicolò Minato (c. 1627–1698) was a Venetian poet, librettist and impresario born in Bergamo. He began writing for the Venetian stage in 1650 with Orimonte for Francesco Cavalli while still working as a lawyer, and from 1665 helped run the Teatro San Salvador, revising Legrenzi's Zenobia e Radamisto there in 1667. In 1669 he moved to Vienna as court poet to Emperor Leopold I, composing more than 170 librettos and many oratorios. Over his career he wrote over 200 librettos, later revived by Handel and Telemann. He died in Vienna on 28 February 1698.
zh: 尼科洛·米纳托（约1627—1698）是威尼斯诗人、歌剧脚本作家与剧团经理人，生于贝加莫。1650年他以《奥里蒙特》一剧步入威尼斯戏剧界，脚本由弗朗切斯科·卡瓦利谱曲，当时他仍以律师为业；1665年起他参与经营圣萨尔瓦托雷剧院，1667年在那里与作曲家乔瓦尼·莱格伦齐合作修订《芝诺比娅与拉达米斯托》。1669年他前往维也纳，出任皇帝利奥波德一世的宫廷诗人，写下170多部脚本和大量清唱剧。他一生创作脚本200余部，身后作品仍被亨德尔、泰勒曼等作曲家重新采用。1698年2月28日他在维也纳去世。

en: Alberto Fortis (1741–1803) was an Augustinian abbot, naturalist and travel writer born in Padua. From 1765 he explored Veneto, Istria and Venetian Dalmatia, studying geology, antiquities and local folklore. In 1770 he travelled to Cres and Lošinj on the first of several journeys funded by English patrons and the Venetian Senate. His Journey to Dalmatia (1774), translated into English, French and German, described the customs, costumes and epic songs of the Morlach highlanders and first printed the ballad Hasanaginica, drawing European attention to the Balkan hinterland and inspiring a literary fashion later called Morlachism. In 1785 he became mineralogist to the Bourbon court of Naples, where he was tasked with reforming the saltpeter industry. He was elected to the Royal Society in 1795 and died in Bologna.
zh: 阿尔贝托·福尔蒂斯（1741—1803）是出生于帕多瓦的奥斯定会修士、博物学家与旅行作家。1765年起他在威尼托、伊斯特拉和威尼斯治下的达尔马提亚考察，研究地质、古物与当地民俗。1770年他前往克雷斯岛与洛希尼岛，这是英国赞助人与威尼斯元老院资助的数次旅行中的第一次。1774年出版的《达尔马提亚纪行》记述了莫拉克山民的风俗、服饰与史诗吟唱，并首次刊印民歌《哈桑阿吉尼察》；该书被译成英、法、德多种文字，使巴尔干腹地引起欧洲关注，催生了后来所称的“莫拉克主义”文学风尚。1785年他出任那不勒斯波旁王室的矿物学家，受命改革当地硝石业。1795年他当选英国皇家学会会员，最终在博洛尼亚去世。

en: Rosalba Carriera (1673–1757) was a Venetian Rococo painter who began with portrait miniatures and then made her name with pastel portraits, a medium she popularized across eighteenth-century Europe. She painted miniatures for snuff-box lids and was among the first to use ivory rather than vellum for them. Grand Tour travellers such as Frederick IV of Denmark and Augustus the Strong of Saxony sought her work, and in 1704 Rome's Accademia di San Luca made her a member. From 1720 to 1721 she worked in Paris, painting Watteau and the Regent's court and winning election to the Académie royale; in 1730 she went to Vienna, where Charles VI collected over 150 of her pastels. She died blind in Venice.
zh: 罗萨尔巴·卡列拉（1673—1757）是威尼斯洛可可画家，早年绘制肖像细密画，后以色粉肖像闻名，把色粉笔画推广到整个18世纪的欧洲。她曾为鼻烟盒盖绘制细密画，也是最早以象牙代替羊皮纸作画的画家之一。丹麦国王腓特烈四世、萨克森选帝侯“强者”奥古斯特等壮游者争相求画，1704年罗马圣路加学院接纳她为院士。1720至1721年她在巴黎创作，为华托和摄政宫廷画像，并入选皇家绘画雕塑学院；1730年她前往维也纳，皇帝查理六世收藏了她150多幅色粉画。她晚年双目失明，在威尼斯去世。

en: Giovanni Dondi dall'Orologio (c. 1330–1388) was a physician, astronomer and clockmaker born in Chioggia, the second son of Jacopo Dondi, who had built the great astronomical clock in Padua in 1344. From 1348 to 1364 Giovanni designed and constructed his Astrarium, a complex astronomical clock and planetarium modelling the movements of the planets with mathematical precision. It was built some sixty years after the first fully mechanical clocks in Europe. He taught in Padua, served as ambassador to Venice in 1371, and after the Paduan war moved to the University of Pavia, where he worked as a diplomat and scholar until his death at Abbiategrasso in 1388.
zh: 乔瓦尼·唐迪（约1330—1388）是生于基奥贾的医生、天文学家与钟表匠，为1344年在帕多瓦建造大型天文钟的雅各布·唐迪之次子。1348至1364年间，他设计并制成了“星盘仪”，这是一座精密的天文钟兼行星仪，以数学精度模拟行星运行。它的建造距欧洲首批全机械钟问世约六十年。他曾在帕多瓦任教，1371年出任驻威尼斯使节，帕多瓦与威尼斯交战后转往帕维亚大学，兼任外交与学术工作，1388年卒于阿比亚泰格拉索。

en: Vyasatirtha (1447–1539), born Yatiraja, was a Hindu philosopher and saint of Madhva's Dvaita school of Vedanta. Ordained in his youth, he succeeded Bramhanya Tirtha as pontiff at Abbur in 1478, then studied at Kanchi and under Sripadaraja at Mulbagal. As rajaguru of the Vijayanagara Empire he advised Kings Saluva Narasimha and Krishna Deva Raya, and was honoured as one of the three great saints of Dvaita. His Nyayamruta, Tatparya Chandrika and Tarka Tandava dissected rival philosophies; the Nyayamruta prompted an Advaita rebuttal by Madhusudhana Saraswati. He developed irrigation at Bettakonda and established temples in newly conquered regions. His Kannada and Sanskrit devotional songs such as Krishna Nee Begane shaped the Haridasa movement.
zh: 维亚萨提尔塔（1447—1539），本名亚蒂拉贾，是印度教摩陀婆二元论吠檀多学派的哲学家与圣徒。他少年出家，1478年继布拉曼亚·提尔塔出任阿布尔修道院住持，随后赴甘吉布勒姆求学，又在穆尔巴加尔师从斯里帕达拉贾。作为毗奢耶那伽罗帝国的帝师，他侍奉萨卢瓦·纳拉辛哈与克里希纳·德瓦·拉亚两位国王，被尊为二元论三大圣徒之一。所著《逻辑甘露》《月光注疏》《逻辑之舞》辩驳各派学说；《逻辑甘露》引来不二论者摩度苏陀那·萨拉斯瓦蒂的反驳。他在贝塔孔达兴修灌溉，并在新征服地区建立神庙。他以卡纳达语和梵语谱写的《克里希纳，快来吧》等虔诚歌影响了哈里达萨运动。

en: Nachana Somanatha was a Telugu poet of the Vijayanagara Empire in the fourteenth century. An inscription dated to 1344 records that King Bukka Raya I granted him the village of Penchukaladinne, also called Bukka-raya-puram; other readings give different dates. He translated the Sanskrit Harivamsa into Telugu as the Uttara-Harivamsamu and composed the Vasanta Vilasamu, an early prabandha work now lost. In the colophons of his works, he styled himself an innovative poet and a master of structure and storytelling. He helped shift Telugu verse from the Puranic manner toward the polished kavya style later perfected by Srinatha.
zh: 纳查纳·索马纳塔是14世纪毗奢耶那伽罗帝国的泰卢固语诗人。一则铭文记载，国王布卡一世将彭丘卡拉丁内村（又称布卡罗亚普兰）封赐给他；铭文年代一说为1344年，也有其他释读。他把梵语《诃利世系》译为泰卢固语的《乌塔拉诃利世系》，还创作了早期“普拉班达”诗体作品《瓦桑塔·维拉萨姆》，今已散佚。在作品跋文中，他自称革新诗人和精于结构与叙事的大师。他推动泰卢固诗歌从往世书体转向精致的宫廷诗风，为后来斯里纳塔等人的创作开辟了道路。

en: Kanaka Dasa (c. 1508–1606), born Thimmappa Nayaka near Haveri, was a Haridasa saint, poet and musician of the Dvaita Vedanta school. Tradition relates that he served as an army commander until defeat in battle turned him to religious life, when he became a disciple of Vyasatirtha. He composed keertanas and ugabhogas in simple Kannada for Carnatic music, using native metrical forms. With Purandara Dasa he contributed to the foundations of Carnatic music and became known as one of the twin poets of Haridasa devotional literature.
zh: 卡纳卡·达萨（约1508—1606），原名蒂马帕·纳亚卡，生于哈韦里一带，是信奉二元论吠檀多的哈里达萨圣徒、诗人与音乐家。相传他本是统兵将领，战败后弃武皈依，成为维亚萨提尔塔的弟子。他用浅白的卡纳达语和本土韵律谱写克尔坦和乌加博加，供卡纳提克音乐演唱。他与普兰达拉·达萨共同奠定卡纳提克音乐的基础，并称哈里达萨虔诚文学的双星。

en: Kempe Gowda I (1510–1569) was chieftain of Yelahanka and a vassal of the Vijayanagara Empire. In 1526 he conquered Sivagange and then annexed Domlur. In 1537, with imperial permission, he built a fortified town, Bengaluru Pete, and moved his capital there from Yelahanka. Within its eight gates, two main roads crossed and other streets ran parallel or perpendicular to them; markets were set aside for different goods and trades. He built the Gavi Gangadhareshwara temple and the great Bull Temple with its granite monolith of Nandi. Once imprisoned for years after a rival's complaint, he was restored to his lands and granted surrounding villages, dying in 1569.
zh: 肯佩·高达一世（1510—1569）是叶拉汉卡的首领、毗奢耶那伽罗帝国的封臣。1526年，他征服锡瓦甘盖，随后兼并多姆卢尔。1537年，他经皇帝准许修筑设防城镇班加罗尔佩特，将都城从叶拉汉卡迁此。城中有八座城门，两条主道交叉，其余街道与之平行或垂直，不同货物与行当各有市场。他修建加维·甘加达雷什瓦拉神庙以及供奉整块花岗岩南迪石像的大公牛神庙。他曾因邻邦首领告状被囚禁数年，获释后恢复领地并获赐周边村庄，1569年去世。

en: Atukuri Molla (1440–1530), known as Kummari Molla after her potter caste, was one of the earliest women to write poetry in Telugu. The daughter of potter Kesanna Setti of Gopavaram near Nellore, she was named Molla, meaning jasmine, after a flower favored by the god her father worshipped. She claimed Shiva as her guru and took the poet Pothana as her model. She rendered the Sanskrit Ramayana into plain Telugu as the Molla Ramayanam and recited it at the court of Krishnadevaraya. Refusing to dedicate the work to any king, she entrusted it to temple authorities in her home village. She then went to Srisailam, where she practiced austerities and taught spiritual seekers before her death around 1530.
zh: 阿图库里·摩拉（1440—1530）因陶工种姓而被称为“陶工摩拉”，是最早的泰卢固语女诗人之一。她是内洛尔附近戈帕瓦拉姆村陶工凯萨纳·塞蒂之女，名字摩拉意为茉莉，是她父亲所敬神祇喜爱的花。她奉湿婆为上师，以诗人波塔纳为楷模。她把梵语《罗摩衍那》译为浅白的泰卢固语，成《摩拉罗摩衍那》，并在克里希纳·德瓦·拉亚的宫廷中诵读。她拒绝按当时惯例将诗作题献给任何国王，而把它托付给故乡的寺庙管理者。此后她前往斯里赛勒姆修行，向求道者讲学，约1530年在那里辞世。

en: Tallapaka Tirumalamma, popularly called Timmakka, was a Telugu poet of the fifteenth century and is regarded as the first woman to write poetry in Telugu. Born into a Niyogi Brahmin family, she became the first wife of the singer-poet Annamacharya. Her surviving work, the Subhadra Kalyanam, is a dvipada kavya of some 1170 poems based on Nannaya's Telugu Mahabharata. It retells the marriage of Arjuna and Subhadra, filling the Sanskrit story with Telugu domestic life and humor.
zh: 塔拉帕卡·蒂鲁马拉马，通称蒂姆卡，是15世纪的泰卢固语女诗人，被视为第一位以泰卢固语创作诗歌的女性。她出身尼约吉婆罗门家庭，后成为吟唱诗人安纳马查里亚的元配。她传世的作品《妙贤婚礼》是一部约1170首的双行体长诗，取材于南纳亚的泰卢固语《摩诃婆罗多》，重述阿周那与妙贤的姻缘，并在这一梵语故事中融入了泰卢固人的家庭生活与诙谐情趣。

en: Zacharias Kopystensky (died 21 March 1627), born in Przemyśl, was an Orthodox cleric and writer in the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. Educated at the Ostroh Academy, he entered the Kyiv Pechersk Lavra and in 1624 succeeded Yelisey Pletenetsky as its archimandrite. He belonged to a circle of Orthodox clerics who promoted national liberation and cultural self-preservation. His chief work, Palinodiia (1621–1623), defended Eastern Orthodoxy against the Ruthenian Uniate Church, and he translated the Horologion and works of John Chrysostom. The Hustyn Chronicle, a history of the old Rus' lands to 1598, has also been attributed to him, though its authorship remains disputed.
zh: 撒迦利亚·科佩斯坚斯基（？—1627），生于普热梅希尔，是波兰—立陶宛联邦的东正教神职人员与作家。他曾在奥斯特罗赫学院求学，后入基辅洞窟修道院，1624年继叶利谢·普列捷涅茨基出任院长。他属于一个提倡民族解放与维护文化的东正教神职人员圈子。其主要著作《翻案篇》（1621—1623）为东正教辩护，驳斥鲁塞尼亚合并派教会；他还翻译了《时祷书》和金口约翰的著作。记述古罗斯直至1598年历史的《古斯滕编年史》也被归于他的名下，但作者归属仍有争议。

en: Shona tradition presents Nyatsimba Mutota (c. 1400–c. 1450), a royal prince of declining Great Zimbabwe, as the founder of the Mutapa Empire. Tradition relates that a salt shortage led him to lead his people north to Dande, where he set up a new dynasty. Taking the title Mwene Mutapa, Lord of the Conquered Lands, he also became high priest of Mwari. Around 1440 he opened campaigns along the Zambezi and conquered Great Zimbabwe itself. He appointed sons as vassals over conquered lands and built the gold and ivory trade with Sofala. He was killed in war with a Tonga tribe about 1450 and succeeded by his son Matope.
zh: 尼亚钦巴·穆托塔（约1400—约1450），据绍纳人传说，是日渐衰落的大津巴布韦的王族成员、穆塔帕帝国的创建者。相传因盐源匮乏，他率族人北迁至丹德，在那里建立新王朝。他采用“姆韦尼穆塔帕”（意为“被征服土地之主”）的称号，又成为姆瓦里大祭司。约1440年起，他沿赞比西河四处征战，一度征服大津巴布韦。他委派儿子作为封臣治理征服的土地，并发展与索法拉的黄金和象牙贸易。约1450年，他在与通加部落的战争中身亡，其子马托佩继位。

en: Changamire Dombo (died c. 1696) was the Shona ruler who founded the Rozvi Empire on the Zimbabwean Plateau. Mutapa had become a Portuguese vassal earlier in the century, and Portuguese settlers raided its Shona subjects as disease and famine devastated the region. Likely once a Mutapa governor, Dombo used royal cattle herds to build a following, defeated Portuguese and Mutapa forces in the 1670s and 1680s, and conquered the gold-rich kingdom of Butua about 1683. In the 1690s, answering a Mutapa ruler's call for aid, he massacred Portuguese traders and drove every Portuguese off the plateau, later conquering Manyika before his death about 1696.
zh: 昌加米尔·东博（？—约1696）是绍纳人的首领，在津巴布韦高原创建了罗兹维帝国。此前穆塔帕已沦为葡萄牙的附庸，葡萄牙定居者不断袭扰其绍纳臣民，疾病与饥荒也肆虐当地。东博可能曾任穆塔帕总督，凭借王室牛群招揽部众，于1670至1680年代击败葡萄牙人与穆塔帕的军队，约1683年征服盛产黄金的布图阿王国。1690年代，他应一位穆塔帕君主之请出兵相助，大肆屠戮葡萄牙商人，将葡萄牙势力全部逐出高原，此后又征服马尼卡，约1696年去世。

en: Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba (1453–1515), known as El Gran Capitán, was a Spanish general born at Montilla. He fought for Isabella of Castile in the civil war after 1474, and in 1479 led 120 lancers in the final battle against Portugal. He then campaigned in the conquest of Granada and in the Italian Wars, where he was the first European to use firearms decisively on the battlefield and reorganized infantry with pikes and guns. He was made Duke of Santángelo in 1497 and Duke of Terranova in 1502, and he served as viceroy of Naples. He died on 2 December 1515.
zh: 贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦（1453—1515）出生于蒙蒂利亚，是西班牙将领，人称“大统帅”。1474年后，他在卡斯蒂利亚的内战中追随伊莎贝拉一世，1479年率120名长矛骑兵参加了对葡萄牙的最后一战。此后他参与征服格拉纳达和意大利战争，他是欧洲最早在战场上决定性运用火器的将领，并把长矛与火枪重新编组进步兵。1497年他获封圣安赫洛公爵，1502年获封泰拉诺瓦公爵，并任那不勒斯总督。他于1515年12月2日去世。

en: Benjamin Hornigold (c. 1680–1719) was an English pirate of the Bahamas. From 1713 he raided shipping off New Providence and helped make Nassau a self-styled Republic of Pirates. By 1717 he commanded the thirty-gun sloop Ranger and had made Edward Teach, later Blackbeard, his second-in-command; the two took several prizes together that spring, including a Spanish ship carrying flour for Havana and a Portuguese ship carrying wine from Madeira. After he refused to rob British ships, his crew voted him from command. In December 1718 he took the King's Pardon from Governor Woodes Rogers and hunted former comrades, capturing John Auger, until a hurricane wrecked his ship on a reef in 1719.
zh: 本杰明·霍尼戈尔德（约1680—1719）是在巴哈马活动的英国海盗。1713年起，他在新普罗维登斯岛外海劫掠商船，参与把拿骚打造成自封的“海盗共和国”。到1717年，他已统率装备30门炮的单桅帆船“游侠号”，并任命后来人称“黑胡子”的爱德华·蒂奇为副手；当年春天两人联手夺取了多艘船，包括一艘载面粉前往哈瓦那的西班牙船和一艘从马德拉运酒的葡萄牙船。因他拒绝劫掠英国船只，船员投票将他罢免。1718年12月，他接受伍兹·罗杰斯总督颁发的国王特赦，转而追捕旧日同伙，抓获约翰·奥格；1719年，他的船在飓风中触礁，他也随之丧命。

en: Henry Every (born 20 August 1659, vanished 1696) was an English pirate called the Arch Pirate. As first mate of the warship Charles II, he took command in a mutiny at Corunna in 1694, after the crew had gone unpaid and Spain failed to issue a privateering commission. He renamed her Fancy and was elected captain. On 7 September 1695 he led a pirate squadron that captured the Grand Mughal's treasure ships Fateh Muhammed and Ganj-i-Sawai off India, seizing plunder worth up to six hundred thousand pounds, the richest prize of the pirate age. The raid outraged the Mughal court; the Privy Council and East India Company offered a reward for Every, sparking a worldwide manhunt, but he eluded it and disappeared in 1696.
