zh: 亨利·埃弗里（1659年8月20日生，1696年后下落不明）是被称为“海盗大王”的英国大海盗。他本是战船“查理二世号”的大副，因船员被拖欠薪饷且西班牙未发私掠许可证，1694年他在拉科鲁尼亚趁哗变夺取船权，将船改名“幻想号”，并被推举为船长。1695年9月7日，他率领海盗船队在印度外海截获莫卧儿大帝的宝船“法塔赫穆罕默德号”和“根杰伊萨瓦伊号”，掠走价值高达60万英镑的财物，是海盗时代最丰厚的一票。此事激怒莫卧儿朝廷，枢密院和东印度公司悬赏捉拿埃弗里，引发全球搜捕，但他躲过追捕，1696年便销声匿迹。

en: Thomas Tew (died September 1695), the Rhode Island Pirate, was an English privateer turned pirate. From Bermuda he sailed the sloop Amity in 1692 and, with his crew's consent, turned pirate in the Red Sea, seizing a Mughal treasure ship late in 1693 and returning rich to Newport in April 1694; he pioneered the route called the Pirate Round. On a second cruise beginning in November 1694 he joined Henry Every at the Mandab Strait and was killed in September 1695 attacking a Mughal ship believed to be the Fateh Muhammed. He was later said to be a founder of the legendary pirate colony Libertalia.
zh: 托马斯·图（?—1695）人称“罗得岛海盗”，本是英国私掠船长，后沦为海盗。他从百慕大于1692年驾驶单桅帆船“友谊号”出海，在征得船员同意后转入红海为盗，1693年末劫掠了一艘莫卧儿宝船，1694年4月带着巨额财富返回纽波特；他开辟的这条航线后来被称为“海盗环线”。1694年11月他再度出航，在曼德海峡与亨利·埃弗里联手，1695年9月攻打一艘被认为是“法塔赫·穆罕默德号”的莫卧儿船只时战死。后世传说他是传奇海盗殖民地莱伯塔利的建立者之一。

en: Jan Janszoon of Haarlem, known after his conversion as Murat Reis the Younger (c. 1570–c. 1641), was a Dutch seaman turned Barbary corsair. Captured by Algerian corsairs off Lanzarote in 1618, he converted to Islam and took the name Murad, thereafter raiding European shipping from Algiers and the Moroccan coast. He helped found the independent Republic of Salé and served as its first president and commander, and he also governed Oualidia. In 1622 he docked at Veere under the Moroccan flag; Dutch authorities brought his wife and children to persuade him to abandon piracy, but he refused. On 20 June 1631 he led the sack of Baltimore in Ireland, carrying much of its population away into slavery.
zh: 出身哈勒姆的扬·扬松在皈依伊斯兰教后称小穆拉特·雷斯（约1570—约1641），本是荷兰水手，后成为柏柏尔海盗。1618年他在兰萨罗特岛附近被阿尔及尔海盗俘获，随即改信伊斯兰教并改名穆拉特，从此以阿尔及尔和摩洛哥海岸为基地劫掠欧洲船只。他参与建立独立的塞拉共和国，出任首任总统兼统帅，并曾担任瓦利迪亚总督。1622年，他悬挂摩洛哥旗帜停靠费勒，荷兰当局带来他的妻儿劝他放弃海盗生涯，却遭到拒绝。1631年6月20日，他率众洗劫爱尔兰的巴尔的摩村，将大批村民掳为奴隶。

en: Guillaume Cale, also called Jacques Bonhomme, was a prosperous peasant of Mello near Beauvais who led the Jacquerie, the peasant rising that swept northern France after King John II's capture at Poitiers in 1356. In May 1358 he gathered thousands of peasants and townsmen, overran local castles and burned the royal residence at Montmorency, sending a detachment to besiege the Dauphin's family at Meaux. On 10 June 1358 Charles the Bad of Navarre seized him under a pledge of safe-conduct before the Battle of Mello; Cale was tortured and beheaded at Clermont and the rising collapsed.
zh: 吉约姆·卡尔，人称“好人雅克”，是博韦附近梅洛村的富裕农民。1356年法王约翰二世在普瓦捷战役被俘后，他领导了席卷法国北部的农民起义“扎克雷”。1358年5月，他聚集数千农民与市民，连克地方城堡，焚毁蒙莫朗西的王室宅邸，并分兵在莫城围困王太子的家眷。1358年6月10日，纳瓦拉国王恶人查理以安全通行的许诺将他诱捕；梅洛战役后，他被押往克莱蒙受刑并斩首，起义随即失败。

en: Jan Želivský (1380–9 March 1422) was a radical Hussite priest whose preaching helped spark the Hussite Wars. Born in Humpolec, Bohemia, he preached in Prague at the Church of Saint Mary Major, drawing crowds with fiery apocalyptic sermons. On 30 July 1419 he led a Hussite procession past the New Town Hall; after councillors stoned the procession, his followers stormed the hall and hurled the councillors from the windows, the First Defenestration of Prague. After defeat at Brüx in 1421 he lost command, and on 9 March 1422 the Prague town council arrested and beheaded him in factional strife.
zh: 扬·热利夫斯基（1380—1422年3月9日）是激进的胡斯派神父，他的布道推动点燃了胡斯战争。他生于波希米亚的洪波莱茨，在布拉格圣母大堂讲道，以充满末世色彩的激烈言辞吸引大批信众。1419年7月30日，他率胡斯派游行队伍经过新市政厅；议员向人群投掷石头后，愤怒的追随者冲入楼内，把议员们从窗户掷出，是为布拉格第一次掷出窗外事件。1421年布吕克斯战败后他被解除指挥权，1422年3月9日，布拉格市议会在胡斯派内讧中将他逮捕斩首。

en: Liu Ji (1311–1375), courtesy name Bowen and commonly called Liu Bowen, was a strategist, scholar and official of the late Yuan and early Ming, born in Qingtian, Zhejiang. After passing the Yuan jinshi examination he served the Mongol regime for 25 years before retiring from office. In 1348 he refused a rebel leader's bribe, but the man won favour at the Yuan court instead. In 1360 he joined the rebel leader Zhu Yuanzhang and advised him through the campaigns that overthrew the Yuan and founded the Ming in 1368. Zhu also put Liu in charge of conquering Zhejiang. With Jiao Yu he compiled the military treatise Huolongjing, or Fire Dragon Manual. He later fell out with the chancellor Hu Weiyong and died in 1375, possibly poisoned.
zh: 刘基（1311—1375），字伯温，通常称刘伯温，浙江青田人，是元末明初的军事家、学者与官员。他考中元朝进士后为蒙古政权效力二十五年，最终辞官归隐。1348年，他拒绝起事首领的贿赂，此人却转而在元朝廷获得宠信。1360年，他投奔起事首领朱元璋，为其出谋划策，辅佐推翻元朝，于1368年建立明朝。朱元璋还命他负责攻取浙江。他与焦玉共同编纂兵书《火龙经》。后来他与丞相胡惟庸交恶，于1375年去世，相传可能是被毒杀。

en: Xu Pu (1429–1499) was a Ming dynasty grand secretary born in Yixing, in modern Jiangsu. He passed the palace examination in 1454 as second-ranked jinshi, or bangyan, and entered the Hanlin Academy. He joined the Grand Secretariat in 1487 and became senior grand secretary in 1492, serving in the cabinet for twelve years with a quiet, consensus-seeking style. He unsuccessfully urged the Hongzhi Emperor to curb the influence of Li Guang and the Daoists, and was received in audience only once during his ministry. In 1497 he was put in charge of compiling the Collected Statutes of the Ming Dynasty, which were published only in 1509. He retired because of failing eyesight and died in 1499, canonised as Wenjing.
zh: 徐溥（1429—1499）是明代大臣，直隶宜兴县（今江苏宜兴）人。他于1454年考中进士，列一甲第二名，即榜眼，随后入翰林院。他于1487年入阁，1492年出任内阁首辅，在阁十二年，为政安静，注重调和。他曾劝明孝宗限制李广及道士的势力，但未获成功，在阁期间只获皇帝召见一次。1497年，他奉命主持编纂《大明会典》，此书直到1509年才颁行。后来他因眼疾辞官，1499年去世，谥号文靖。

en: Wang Shouren (1472–1529), known as Wang Yangming, was a Ming statesman, general and Neo-Confucian philosopher born in Yuyao, Zhejiang. He earned the jinshi degree in 1499. Banished in 1506 for offending the eunuch Liu Jin, he later became governor of Jiangxi. In 1517–1518 he suppressed peasant revolts in Jiangxi, Fujian and Guangdong, petitioning the court to grant amnesty, and in 1519 crushed Zhu Chenhao, Prince of Ning, capturing him before the rebel could take Nanjing. As a thinker he rejected Zhu Xi's dualism and taught innate knowing and the unity of knowledge and action; he and Lu Xiangshan were regarded as founders of the Lu–Wang School of the Mind. In 1584, after his death, he was enshrined in the Confucian Temple.
zh: 王守仁（1472—1529），号阳明，世称王阳明，浙江余姚人，是明代的政治家、军事家与理学家。他于1499年考中进士，1506年因得罪宦官刘瑾被贬谪，后来出任江西巡抚。1517至1518年，他平定江西、福建、广东的民众起事，并请求朝廷赦免起事者；1519年又迅速平定宁王朱宸濠叛乱，在叛军攻取南京前将朱宸濠俘获。思想上，他反对朱熹的二元论，提出“致良知”与“知行合一”之说，与陆象山同被视为陆王心学的开创者。1584年，他在身后被从祀孔子庙廷。

en: Muhammad Salih Thattvi was a seventeenth-century Mughal metallurgist, astronomer and craftsman from Thatta in Sindh, active at the Mughal court in the mid-seventeenth century. He cast seamless celestial globes by the lost-wax process, following a technique pioneered in Kashmir in 1589–1590. His globe of AH 1070 (1659–1660), twenty-one centimetres across with silver dots marking about 1018 stars, is in Delhi's Red Fort Museum; another of 1663–1664 in the Khalili Collection carries Arabic and Sanskrit inscriptions, the latter added by another craftsman about a century later. A smaller gilded globe dated 1662 is also in the collection. He made at least four astrolabes dated between 1661 and 1667, held in the United States, India, London and Oxford.
zh: 穆罕默德·萨利赫·塔特维是17世纪莫卧儿的冶金家、天文学家兼工匠，来自信德的特达，活跃于17世纪中叶的莫卧儿宫廷。他以失蜡法铸造无缝天球仪，这一工艺于1589—1590年在克什米尔首创。他在伊斯兰历1070年（1659—1660年）所铸的天球仪直径21厘米，以银点标示约1018颗星，现存德里红堡博物馆；1663—1664年的一件藏于哈利利收藏，带有阿拉伯语和梵语铭文，后者由另一名工匠约一个世纪后添加。哈利利收藏还有一件较小的镀金天球仪，署年1662年。他还制作了至少四件署年在1661—1667年间的星盘，分藏于美国、印度、伦敦和牛津。

en: Mian Mir (c. 1550–1635), born Mian Mir Muhammad Qadiri, was a Qadiri Sufi saint who lived in Lahore. Claiming descent from the Caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab, he founded the Mian Khel branch of the Qadiri order and became the spiritual instructor of the Mughal prince Dara Shikoh, eldest son of Shah Jahan. His younger sister Bibi Jamal Khatun also became a noted Sufi. He died in August 1635, and Dara Shikoh, his devoted disciple, read his funeral oration. His shrine southeast of Lahore near Alamganj draws Muslim and Sikh devotees, and Mullah Shah Badakhshi succeeded him.
zh: 米安·米尔（约1550—1635），本名米安·米尔·穆罕默德·卡迪里，是居于拉合尔的卡迪里教团苏菲圣徒。他自称是哈里发欧麦尔·本·赫塔卜的后裔，开创了卡迪里教团的米安海勒支派，并成为莫卧儿皇子、沙贾汗长子达拉·舒科的灵性导师。他的妹妹比比·贾玛尔·哈通也是著名苏菲。他于1635年8月去世，笃信他的弟子达拉·舒科为他诵读殡礼祷文。其陵墓在拉合尔东南的阿拉姆甘吉附近，穆斯林与锡克教徒都前往朝拜，穆拉·沙·巴达赫希继承了他的道统。

en: Reza Abbasi (c. 1565–1635), earlier called Aqa Reza, was the leading Persian miniaturist of the Isfahan school and the last great master of the Persian miniature. Probably trained by his father Ali Asghar, he joined Shah Abbas I's royal workshop young, and the shah granted him the honorific Abbasi in 1603. As book illustration gave way to albums, he made his name with single muraqqa leaves showing one or two elegant figures on a spare garden ground; his earliest dated drawing is from 1601. His works ranged from pure pen drawings to fully coloured paintings, and he often signed and dated them. His style shaped later painters such as Mo'en Mosavver and his son Muhammad Shafi.
zh: 礼萨·阿巴西（约1565—1635），早年称阿迦·礼萨，是伊斯法罕画派最重要的波斯细密画家，也被视为最后一位波斯细密画大师。他可能随父亲、细密画家阿里·阿斯加尔学艺，年轻时便加入沙阿阿拔斯一世的皇家画室，1603年获沙阿赐号“阿巴西”。在书籍插图让位于画册的时代，他以穆拉卡单页画著称，常以素淡园林为背景，只画一两个姿态优雅的人物，现存最早的署年画作作于1601年。他的作品既有纯线描，也有通幅设色的画作，并常常署名、注明日期。他的画风影响了穆因·穆萨维尔等后世画家以及他的儿子穆罕默德·沙菲。

en: Bahāʾ al-Dīn al-ʿĀmilī (1547–1621), known as Sheikh Bahāʾī, was a Twelver Shia polymath in Safavid Iran. Born near Baalbek in Ottoman Syria to a family from Jabal ʿĀmil, he was brought to Iran after his father's mentor was executed in 1558; his father later became shaykh al-Islām of Herat. He completed his studies in Isfahan and travelled through Iraq, Syria and Egypt before returning to Iran. Trusted by Shah Abbas I, he planned the new capital Isfahan, including Naqsh-e Jahan Square and the Shah Mosque, and wrote over a hundred Arabic and Persian treatises on law, mathematics and astronomy. His Persian Tashrīḥ al-Aflāk argued for the possibility of the Earth's motion. He died in Isfahan and was buried at Mashhad.
zh: 巴哈丁·阿米利（1547—1621），通称谢赫·巴哈伊，是萨法维伊朗的十二伊玛目派什叶派通才学者。他出生于奥斯曼叙利亚的巴勒贝克附近，家族来自阿米勒山；1558年其父的老师被处决后，他随家人迁居伊朗，其父后来出任赫拉特的伊斯兰长老。他在伊斯法罕完成学业，又游历伊拉克、叙利亚和埃及，随后返回伊朗。他深受沙阿阿拔斯一世倚重，主持了新都伊斯法罕的城市规划，包括纳克什·贾汗广场和沙阿清真寺，并以阿拉伯语和波斯语写下百余部涉及教法、数学与天文的著作。他的波斯语作品《天体解剖》提出了地球运动的可能性。他卒于伊斯法罕，葬于马什哈德。

en: Şerafeddin Sabuncuoğlu (1385–1468) was an Ottoman surgeon and physician who spent his career at the Darüşşifa hospital in Amasya, founded in 1308, and directed it for fourteen years. He began studying medicine at seventeen, in a city that was a centre of commerce and culture in the early Ottoman Empire. In 1465, aged about eighty, he completed the Cerrahiyyetü'l-Haniyye (Imperial Surgery), the first illustrated surgical atlas written in Turkish. Its three chapters treat 191 topics in 412 pages and carry his own miniatures, including the first depictions of female surgeons. Three original manuscript copies survive, two in his own hand. Drawing on al-Zahrawi's al-Taṣrīf, he added his own techniques, among them ligating the temporal artery for migraine.
zh: 谢拉夫丁·萨本久奥卢（1385—1468）是奥斯曼外科医生兼内科医师，长期在阿马西亚1308年建立的达尔什法医院行医，并担任院长十四年。他十七岁开始学医，当时阿马西亚是奥斯曼帝国早期的商业与文化中心。1465年，年约八旬的他完成《帝王外科学》，这是第一部用土耳其语写成的插图外科图谱。全书三章、412页，论述191个主题，配有他亲手绘制的插图，其中最早出现了女性外科医生的画像。该书现存三份原始手稿，其中两份出自他本人之手。该书虽借鉴宰赫拉威的《医学宝鉴》，也记载了他自创的技法，例如结扎颞动脉治疗偏头痛。

en: ʿAbd al-ʿAlī al-Bīrjandī (died 1528) was a Persian astronomer, mathematician and physicist who worked in Birjand, in Khurasan; his birth date is unrecorded. Trained under scholars such as Mansur ibn Muʿin al-Din al-Kashi, he produced a string of technical commentaries, chief among them the Sharḥ al-Tadhkirah on Nasir al-Din al-Tusi's astronomical treatise. Completed in 1507–1508, this commentary examined objections to Tusi and discussed mathematical devices used in planetary theory. Birjandi also wrote on astronomical instruments and prepared a work on constructing almanacs in 1478–1479. In the commentary he tested the claim that a falling stone disproves the Earth's rotation, arguing that a stone dropping perpendicular to the horizon could remain compatible with a moving Earth. He died in 934 AH and was buried at Bojd near Birjand.
zh: 阿卜杜勒·阿里·比里詹迪（?—1528）是波斯天文学家、数学家与物理学家，在呼罗珊的比尔詹德治学，生年不详。他曾受教于曼苏尔·本·穆因丁·卡什等学者，留下多部专业注释，其中最重要的是为纳西尔丁·图西的天文学著作所作的《〈提要〉注》。这部注释于1507—1508年完成，审视了前人对图西的反驳，并讨论行星理论中的数学装置。比里詹迪还写过天文仪器方面的著作，并于1478—1479年完成一部关于编制历书的作品。他在《〈提要〉注》中检验了“落石可证地球静止”的说法，认为石块沿垂直于地平线的方向落下仍可与地球运动相容。他卒于伊斯兰历934年，葬于比尔詹德附近的布季德村。

en: Lin Daoqian was a 16th-century Chinese pirate of Teochew origin and a native of Huilai in Guangdong. From the 1560s he raided the coasts of Guangdong and Fujian; in 1566 he attacked Zhao'an with 50 ships and was driven off by the Ming navy under Yu Dayou, fleeing via Penghu to Taiwan. The Ming authorities offered a bounty for him in 1568, but used his fleet against other pirates in 1569. Repeatedly pardoned and restive, he fled overseas in 1573 and in 1578 established a base with two thousand followers in Patani on the Malay Peninsula. He continued raiding, but after 1581 may have settled in Patani, where he served as customs chief and cast cannon for its queen. Patani tradition says he died testing one of them.
zh: 林道乾是16世纪的中国海盗，潮州人，广东惠来人。1560年代起，他袭扰广东、福建沿海；1566年率战船五十艘攻打诏安，被俞大猷率领的明军水师击退，经澎湖逃往台湾。明廷于1568年悬赏捉拿他，1569年却又借用他的船队攻打其他海盗。他屡受招安又再度反叛，1573年逃亡海外，1578年率部众两千人在马来半岛的北大年建立据点。他继续劫掠，1581年后可能在北大年定居，管理海关并为当地女王铸造大炮。北大年当地相传，他在试射其中一门炮时身亡。

en: Zhu Biao (1355–1392) was the eldest son of the Hongwu Emperor and the founding crown prince of the Ming dynasty. Born in Taiping to Zhu Yuanzhang and Lady Ma, he became heir in 1364 under the Kingdom of Wu and crown prince at the Ming proclamation in 1368. Educated in Confucian statecraft by Song Lian, he took part in daily government from 1377 and was known for his humanity. His father placed trusted associates, including the generals Xu Da and Chang Yuchun, in charge of his household. Sent to Shaanxi in 1391 to assess a capital move to Xi'an, he presented a map and a memorial on his return. He fell ill and died in May 1392. His son Zhu Yunwen later reigned as the Jianwen Emperor.
zh: 朱标（1355—1392）是洪武帝的长子，明朝的开国皇太子。他生于太平，为朱元璋与马氏之子，1364年朱元璋称吴王时被立为世子，1368年明朝建立时成为皇太子。他在宋濂教导下学习儒家治国之术，1377年起参与日常政务，以仁厚著称。朱元璋安排徐达、常遇春等亲信将领管理他的东宫事务。1391年他奉命巡视陕西，考察迁都西安之事，归来后呈上地图和奏疏。他随后患病，于1392年5月去世。其子朱允炆后来继位，即建文帝。

en: Khlopko Kosolap (died 1603) was an ataman of a robber band in Russia during the Time of Troubles. Amid the great famine of 1601–1603 he commanded the largest such detachment, with up to six hundred men, near Moscow. Many of the rebels were kholopy who fled estates when their masters refused to feed them, and the bands received support from the peasantry. In August 1603 the government sent a hundred streltsy under Ivan Basmanov against Khlopko. The rebels ambushed the troops and killed Basmanov on 12 September, but were routed; the wounded Khlopko was captured and soon executed. Tsar Boris Godunov ordered an investigation, as the rebels included servants of disgraced boyars.
zh: 赫洛普科·科索拉普（1603年卒）是俄罗斯混乱时期的一名匪帮首领。1601—1603年大饥荒期间，他率领其中最大的一支队伍在莫斯科近郊活动，人数多达六百人。许多叛乱者是因主人拒绝供养而逃离庄园的奴仆，这些队伍也得到农民支持。1603年8月，政府派伊万·巴斯马诺夫率一百名射击军围剿赫洛普科。叛军设伏，于9月12日击杀巴斯马诺夫，但仍被击溃，负伤的赫洛普科被俘，不久被处决。由于叛乱者中有失宠波雅尔的仆人，沙皇鲍里斯·戈杜诺夫下令调查。

en: Lennart Torstensson (1603–1651) was a Swedish field marshal of the Thirty Years' War. A page to Gustavus Adolphus, he led the Swedish artillery from 1629 and helped win Breitenfeld (1631) and the Lech. Captured at Alte Veste, he was imprisoned for nearly a year at Ingolstadt. In 1641 he succeeded Banér as generalissimo, crushed the Imperials at the second Breitenfeld (1642), invaded Denmark in the war named after him (1643–1645), and won at Jüterbog (1644) and Jankau (1645). Crippled by gout, he resigned in 1645, was made a count, and governed Sweden's western provinces until his death.
zh: 伦纳特·托尔斯滕松（1603—1651）是三十年战争中的瑞典陆军元帅。他早年是古斯塔夫·阿道夫的侍童，1629年执掌瑞典炮兵，在第一次布莱登菲尔德战役（1631）和赖恩战役中立下战功。他在阿尔特韦斯特被俘，囚于因戈尔施塔特近一年。1641年他接替巴纳出任全军总司令，在第二次布莱登菲尔德战役（1642）击溃帝国军，随后入侵丹麦——这场1643—1645年的战争以他的名字命名，又在于特博格（1644）和扬考（1645）连克敌军。他因痛风致残，1645年辞职，后受封伯爵，统辖瑞典西部诸省直至去世。

en: Count Gustav Horn (1592–1657) was a Swedish field marshal of the Thirty Years' War. The youngest son of Field Marshal Karl Henriksson Horn, he was born at Örbyhus in Uppsala County and studied warfare under Maurice of Orange. He was seriously wounded at the siege of Riga in 1621 and became a field marshal in 1628. As Gustavus Adolphus's second-in-command, he stopped Tilly's flank attack at Breitenfeld in 1631 after the Saxon allies fled. After the king's death in 1632, Horn and John Banér took command of Swedish forces in Germany. Captured at Nördlingen in 1634, he was held at Burghausen until exchanged in 1642. He conquered most of Scania in 1644, became Count of Björneborg in 1651, and later governed Livonia and served as Lord High Constable.
zh: 古斯塔夫·霍恩伯爵（1592—1657）是三十年战争中的瑞典陆军元帅。他是陆军元帅卡尔·亨里克松·霍恩的幼子，生于乌普萨拉郡的厄尔比胡斯，曾随奥兰治的莫里斯学习军事。1621年围攻里加时他身负重伤，1628年晋升陆军元帅。作为古斯塔夫·阿道夫的副帅，1631年萨克森盟军溃逃后，他在布莱登菲尔德挡住了蒂利的侧翼进攻。国王于1632年阵亡后，霍恩与约翰·巴纳共同统领驻德意志瑞典军。1634年他在讷德林根被俘，囚于布格豪森，直到1642年才获交换释放。1644年他攻占斯科讷大部，1651年成为比约讷堡伯爵，其后出任利沃尼亚总督和王国大元帅。

en: Henri de La Tour d'Auvergne, Viscount of Turenne (1611–1675), known as Turenne, was one of France's greatest generals. A younger son of the Duke of Bouillon, he trained under his uncle Maurice of Nassau. In the Thirty Years' War he took Breisach in 1638, became Marshal of France in 1643, and beat the Imperials at Zusmarshausen in 1648. He initially supported the Fronde but returned to royal service in 1651. He defeated Condé's rebels at Paris and the Spanish at Arras (1654) and the Dunes (1658), and became Marshal General in 1660. He converted to Catholicism in 1668. In 1675 he won at Turckheim and maneuvered around the Vosges in winter, driving the Imperials from Alsace. He was killed by a cannonball at Salzbach.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/蒂雷納子爵亨利·德·拉圖爾多韋涅
zh: 蒂雷纳子爵亨利·德·拉图尔多韦涅（1611—1675），通称蒂雷纳，是法国最伟大的将领之一。他是布永公爵年纪较小的儿子，早年在舅父拿骚的毛里茨麾下受训。三十年战争中，他于1638年攻克布赖萨赫，1643年成为法国元帅，1648年在楚斯马斯豪森击败帝国军。他最初支持投石党运动，1651年重返王室阵营。他在巴黎城下击败孔代亲王的叛军，又在阿拉斯（1654）和沙丘（1658）战胜西班牙军，1660年成为法国大元帅。他于1668年改宗天主教。1675年他在蒂尔凯姆取胜，并在冬季绕过孚日山脉，将帝国军逐出阿尔萨斯。他最终在萨斯巴赫被炮弹炸死。

en: Johann von Aldringen (1588–1634) was an imperial field marshal born in the Duchy of Luxembourg who served Spain from 1606 before entering imperial service in 1618. He fought beside Wallenstein at the Dessau Bridge in 1626 and negotiated the transfer of Mecklenburg to him in 1628. He helped negotiate the Peace of Lübeck in 1629 and grew rich at the sack of Mantua in 1630. He and his comrade Matthias Gallas married daughters of Count d'Arco. As Tilly's artillery commander he was wounded at the Lech in April 1632, then succeeded Tilly and became a field marshal. He joined the plot against Wallenstein and was shot while retreating across the Isar at Landshut on 22 July 1634.
zh: 约翰·冯·阿尔德林根（1588—1634）是帝国陆军元帅，生于卢森堡公国，1606年起在西班牙军中服役，1618年转入帝国军队。1626年他与华伦斯坦并肩作战于德绍桥，1628年通过谈判使梅克伦堡公国转交华伦斯坦。1629年他参与议定《吕贝克和约》，1630年在洗劫曼图亚时大发横财。他与战友马蒂亚斯·加拉斯分别迎娶了阿尔科伯爵的女儿。作为蒂利的炮兵指挥官，他在1632年4月的莱希河战役中负伤，随后接替蒂利指挥并晋升陆军元帅。他参与了反对华伦斯坦的密谋，1634年7月22日在兰茨胡特撤退、渡过伊萨尔河时中弹身亡。

en: Otto Heinrich Fugger, Count of Kirchberg and Weissenhorn (1592–1644), was born in Augsburg into his famous banking family and became a professional soldier. He fought at the White Mountain in 1620, at Breda under Spinola, and in the War of the Mantuan Succession, then entered Bavarian service in 1631 and captured Fulda. Promoted Feldzeugmeister in 1632, he supported Wallenstein with six thousand men at the Alte Veste. In 1634 he succeeded the fallen Aldringen as commander and distinguished himself at Nördlingen, gaining the Golden Fleece from Spain and an imperial countship. Appointed governor of Augsburg in 1635, he was later dismissed after protests against his policies favouring Catholics, but retained command of the garrison. He died there on 12 October 1644.
zh: 基希贝格与魏森霍恩伯爵奥托·海因里希·富格尔（1592—1644）生于奥格斯堡的富格尔银行望族，后成为职业军人。他参加了1620年的白山战役、斯皮诺拉指挥的布雷达围城战以及曼图亚继承战争，1631年转入巴伐利亚军中服役并攻占富尔达。1632年他晋升炮兵总监，率六千人在阿尔特韦斯特支援华伦斯坦。1634年他接替阵亡的阿尔德林根指挥军队，在讷德林根战功卓著，由此获得西班牙授予的金羊毛骑士头衔并受封帝国伯爵。1635年他出任奥格斯堡总督，后因偏袒天主教的政策引发抗议而被免职，但仍指挥驻军。他于1644年10月12日卒于该城。

en: Gottfried Heinrich Graf zu Pappenheim (1594–1632), a Bavarian nobleman who converted to Catholicism in 1614, became an imperial cavalry general in the Thirty Years' War. He gained experience of cavalry warfare in Polish service and was left for dead at the White Mountain in 1620. He took command of a cuirassier regiment in 1622 and ruthlessly crushed the Upper Austrian peasant revolt in 1626. Made an imperial count in 1628, he helped storm Magdeburg in 1631 and, after Breitenfeld, covered the imperial retreat and led raids against the Swedes on the lower Rhine and Weser. Recalled to Wallenstein's army, he fell mortally wounded leading his cavalry at Lützen on 16 November 1632 and died soon afterwards.
zh: 戈特弗里德·冯·帕本海姆伯爵（1594—1632）是巴伐利亚贵族，1614年改宗天主教，后成为三十年战争中帝国军勇猛的骑兵将领。他在波兰军中积累了骑兵作战经验，1620年白山战役中重伤被弃于战场。他于1622年接掌一个胸甲骑兵团，1626年残酷镇压了上奥地利农民起义。1628年他受封帝国伯爵，1631年参与强攻马格德堡，布莱登菲尔德战役后掩护帝国军撤退，又在莱茵河下游与威悉河一带袭扰瑞典军队。被召回华伦斯坦军中后，他在1632年11月16日的吕岑战役中率骑兵冲锋时受致命伤，不久去世。

en: Charles Bonaventure de Longueval, Count of Bucquoy (1571–1621), was a general born at Arras in the Spanish Netherlands. He entered the Army of Flanders young, fought at Nieuwpoort in 1600 and the Siege of Ostend, and served as General of the Artillery under Ambrogio Spinola. In 1610 he went to France as ambassador to convey condolences after Henry IV's murder. In 1613 he became governor of Hainaut. At the outbreak of the Bohemian Revolt in 1618, Emperor Matthias gave him command of the Imperial army. He was beaten by Thurn at Lomnice in 1618, defeated Mansfeld at Sablat in 1619, and with Tilly won the Battle of White Mountain in November 1620. He was killed at the siege of Neuhäusel on 10 July 1621.
zh: 夏尔·博纳旺蒂尔·德·隆格瓦勒，即比夸伯爵（1571—1621），是生于西属尼德兰阿拉斯的将领。他年轻时加入佛兰德军队，参加过1600年的纽波特战役和奥斯坦德围城战，并在安布罗西奥·斯皮诺拉麾下担任炮兵总监。1610年，他作为特使赴法国，就亨利四世遇刺致哀；1613年出任埃诺总督。1618年波希米亚起义爆发时，皇帝马蒂亚斯任命他为帝国军队司令。同年他在洛姆尼采被图尔恩击败，1619年在萨布拉特击败曼斯菲尔德，1620年11月又与蒂利联手赢得白山战役。1621年7月10日，他在新海瑟尔围城战中阵亡。

en: Franz von Mercy (c. 1597–1645), born at Longwy in Lorraine, became a field marshal and commander-in-chief of the Bavarian army in 1643. Wounded at Breitenfeld in 1631, he defended Konstanz two years later. Captured and exchanged in 1634, he defended Rheinfelden against a Swedish siege until its food ran out. In 1641 he protected the Imperial Diet at Regensburg from Banér's Swedes. He destroyed a French army at Tuttlingen in November 1643, held Freiburg against Condé and Turenne in 1644, and routed Turenne at Herbsthausen in May 1645. He was killed by a musket shot at the Second Battle of Nördlingen on 3 August 1645 and buried at Ingolstadt.
zh: 弗朗茨·冯·梅西（约1597—1645）生于洛林的隆维，1643年成为巴伐利亚陆军元帅兼巴伐利亚军总司令。他1631年在布莱登菲尔德负伤，两年后坚守康斯坦茨。1634年他被俘并经交换获释，此后防守莱茵费尔登，抵抗瑞典军围攻直至粮尽。1641年他在雷根斯堡保护帝国议会免遭巴纳的瑞典军进攻。1643年11月他在图特林根歼灭一支法军，1644年在弗赖堡力抗孔代与蒂雷纳，1645年5月在黑尔布斯豪森击溃蒂雷纳。1645年8月3日，他在第二次讷德林根战役中中弹身亡，葬于因戈尔施塔特。

en: Ambrogio Spinola (1569–1630), Marquess of Los Balbases, was a Genoese nobleman and one of the ablest generals in Spanish pay. He entered Spanish service in 1602, raising nine thousand men at his own expense, and forced the long-besieged garrison of Ostend to surrender. As commander-in-chief in Flanders he seized a string of Rhine towns from Maurice of Nassau, a campaign that also ruined him financially. He overran the Palatinate early in the Thirty Years' War and crowned his career by taking Breda in 1625 after a long siege. Undermined by Olivares, he left Flanders in 1628 and died at the Siege of Casale during the War of the Mantuan Succession on 25 September 1630.
zh: 安布罗西奥·斯皮诺拉，即洛斯巴尔瓦塞斯侯爵（1569—1630），是热那亚贵族，也是西班牙军中最杰出的将领之一。1602年他投身西班牙效力，自费募集九千人，并迫使长期被围的奥斯坦德守军投降。作为佛兰德军队总司令，他从拿骚的莫里斯手中夺取莱茵河沿岸一连串城镇，这场战役也使他破产。三十年战争初期他横扫普法尔茨，又在长期围攻后于1625年攻取布雷达，此役成为他一生战绩的顶点。由于奥利瓦雷斯的排挤，他1628年离开佛兰德，1630年9月25日死于曼图亚继承战争中的卡萨莱围城战期间。

en: Tommaso Caracciolo, Duke of Roccarainola (1572–1631), was a Neapolitan aristocrat who served Spain as a professional soldier. He began as a common infantryman and became a captain in 1600. After fighting at the Siege of Ostend in 1601, he led a tercio in the War of the Montferrat Succession (1614–1617) and helped take Vercelli in 1617. In the Bohemian-Palatine War he played a decisive part at the Battle of the White Mountain in 1620, holding off Hungarian and Cossack cavalry. Philip IV made him Duke of Roccarainola in 1625, the same year the French captured him in Liguria and held him five months for ransom. He died in 1631 travelling to Genoa as its new governor-general.
zh: 罗卡赖诺拉公爵托马索·卡拉乔洛（1572—1631）是效力于西班牙的那不勒斯贵族军人。他从普通步兵做起，1600年升任上尉。1601年他参加佛兰德的奥斯坦德围城战，此后在蒙费拉托继承战争（1614—1617）中率领一支西班牙方阵部队，1617年参与攻占韦尔切利。在波希米亚—普法尔茨战争中，他在1620年的白山战役里挡住匈牙利和哥萨克骑兵，发挥了决定性作用。1625年腓力四世封他为罗卡赖诺拉公爵；同年他在利古里亚被法军俘获，五个月后靠赎金获释。1631年，他在赴热那亚就任总督途中去世。

en: Peter Ernst von Mansfeld (c. 1580–1626), commonly called Ernst, was an illegitimate son of the Spanish stadtholder Count Peter Ernst von Mansfeld and was raised a Catholic in Luxembourg. From about 1610 he served the Protestant princes and became a leading mercenary general of the early Thirty Years' War. Sent to aid the Bohemian rebels in 1618, he took Pilsen but was defeated at Sablat in 1619. He held the Upper Palatinate against Tilly in 1621 and beat him at Wiesloch in April 1622. Later that year he entered Dutch service, fought through Spanish forces at Fleurus and helped relieve Bergen op Zoom. Wallenstein routed him at the Dessau Bridge in April 1626; retreating through Bosnia, he died at Rakovica near Sarajevo that November.
zh: 彼得·恩斯特·冯·曼斯菲尔德（约1580—1626），通称恩斯特·冯·曼斯菲尔德，是西班牙总督彼得·恩斯特·冯·曼斯菲尔德伯爵的私生子，在卢森堡长大，信奉天主教。约1610年起他转而为新教诸侯效力，成为三十年战争初期最重要的雇佣军将领之一。1618年他奉命支援波希米亚起义军并攻占比尔森，1619年却在萨布拉特战败。他于1621年在上普法尔茨顶住蒂利的进攻，1622年4月在维斯洛赫击败蒂利。同年晚些时候他转投荷兰，在弗勒吕斯突破西班牙军队，并参与解救贝亨奥普佐姆。1626年4月，华伦斯坦在德绍桥将其击溃；他撤退途经波斯尼亚时，于同年11月在萨拉热窝附近的拉科维察病死。

en: Heinrich Matthias von Thurn (1567–1640) was a Bohemian Protestant noble and leader of the Bohemian Revolt. After imperial service against the Turks, he became marshal of the Protestant nobility. In 1617 he joined nobles demanding that Ferdinand uphold their religious freedom; on 23 May 1618 he helped lead the Defenestration of Prague, opening the Thirty Years' War. A Defender of the Protestant Faith, he commanded the Bohemian army, backed Frederick V's election as king, and fought at White Mountain in 1620. Exiled after the defeat, he lost his Bohemian estates and served Sweden as lieutenant general under Gustavus Adolphus. Captured by Wallenstein in 1633 and ransomed, he retired to Swedish Estonia and died at Pärnu in 1640.
zh: 英德日赫·马加什·图尔恩（德语名海因里希·马蒂亚斯·冯·图尔恩，1567—1640）是波希米亚新教贵族，波希米亚起义的领袖之一。他曾在帝国军中对土耳其人作战，后任新教贵族元帅。1617年，他与其他贵族要求斐迪南维护他们的宗教自由；1618年5月23日，他参与领导布拉格掷出窗外事件，三十年战争由此爆发。作为新教信仰保卫者之一，他统率波希米亚军队，支持推选腓特烈五世为国王，并参加1620年的白山战役。战败后他流亡国外，失去波希米亚领地，在古斯塔夫·阿道夫麾下担任瑞典军中将。1633年他被华伦斯坦俘虏，获赎后退居瑞典属爱沙尼亚，1640年死于派尔努。

en: Johan Banér (1596–1641) was a Swedish field marshal born at Djursholm in Uppland; he was four when his father was executed in the Linköping Bloodbath of 1600. Joining up in 1615, he distinguished himself at the siege of Pskov and became one of Gustavus Adolphus's foremost generals, leading the Swedish cavalry's right wing at Breitenfeld in 1631 and fighting at the Lech and Alte Veste. After Nördlingen he took command in Germany and restored Sweden's cause with victories at Wittstock in 1636 and Chemnitz in 1639. His last exploit was a midwinter surprise march on Regensburg in 1641, but the thawing ice prevented its capture. He died at Halberstadt on 10 May 1641.
zh: 约翰·巴纳（1596—1641）是瑞典陆军元帅，生于乌普兰的于什霍尔姆城堡；他四岁时父亲在1600年的林雪平血案中被处死。他1615年从军，在普斯科夫围城战中崭露头角，后成为古斯塔夫二世麾下最重要的将领之一，1631年在布莱登菲尔德战役中指挥瑞典骑兵右翼，又转战莱希河与阿尔特韦斯特。讷德林根战败后他接掌驻德意志的瑞典军队，1636年在维特施托克、1639年在开姆尼茨取得大捷，重振瑞典声威。他最后的壮举是1641年隆冬出兵奇袭雷根斯堡，但冰面解冻使他未能攻下该城。同年5月10日他卒于哈尔伯施塔特。

en: Wolderich Lappe was a knight of the Lappe family, landed lords in Hadeln on the Lower Elbe and followers of the dukes of Saxe-Lauenburg. In 1324 Duke Eric I pledged him jurisdictional rights in the parishes of Wolde and Groden for 200 marks, securing him steady revenues around Ritzebüttel. On 19 July 1325 he appears in the first surviving charter to name Ritzebüttel, promising in a treaty not to move against Jan von Stotel and Luder von Wersebe. Charters of 1329 and 1332 attest his leading position in Hadeln.
zh: 沃尔德里希·拉佩是拉佩家族的骑士；该家族是易北河下游哈德尔恩地区的地产领主，臣属于萨克森-劳恩堡公爵。1324年，公爵埃里克一世以200马克为价，将沃尔德和格罗登两个教区的司法权抵押给他，使他在里策比特尔一带有稳定收入。1325年7月19日，他出现在首份提及里策比特尔的现存契约中，立约不再与扬·冯·施托特尔、卢德·冯·韦尔泽贝为敌。1329和1332年的文书表明他在哈德尔恩身居要职。

en: Albrecht VI (born 1330) was count of Lindow-Ruppin, succeeding his father Ulrich II. In 1370 he pledged the lordship of Lindau to Prince John II of Anhalt-Köthen for 1300 marks of Brandenburg silver and was forced to sell further villages to meet his debts. Under the treaty of 1377 with Emperor Charles IV he had to give up the Havelland estates of Glien and Rhinow. In 1381 he tried to buy the castle of Möckern with its villages but could not raise the purchase price.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特六世（1330年生）是林多-鲁平伯爵，承袭父亲乌尔里希二世。1370年，他以1300马克勃兰登堡白银为价，把林多领地抵押给安哈尔特-克滕亲王约翰二世，后来又被迫变卖更多村庄偿债。根据1377年与皇帝查理四世订立的条约，他须交出哈弗尔兰的格林和里诺地产。1381年他试图购买默肯城堡及附属村庄，却凑不齐款项。

en: Günther II, count of Lindow-Ruppin, was a son of Count Ulrich I and ruled jointly with his brother Ulrich II. He married Liutgard of Mecklenburg, widow of Count Gerhard II of Hoya, and died around 1338.
zh: 金特二世是林多-鲁平伯爵、乌尔里希一世伯爵之子，与兄弟乌尔里希二世共同统治家族领地。他娶霍亚伯爵格哈德二世的遗孀梅克伦堡的柳特加德为妻，约1338年去世。

en: Liutgard of Mecklenburg (c. 1289–1352) was the only child of John III, lord of Mecklenburg, and Helena of Rügen. In 1302 she married Count Gerhard II of Hoya; the marriage was childless. Gerhard died in 1312 or 1313, and Liutgard in 1352.
zh: 梅克伦堡的柳特加德（约1289—1352）是梅克伦堡君主约翰三世与妻子吕根的海伦娜的独生女。1302年她嫁给霍亚伯爵格哈德二世，婚姻没有子女；格哈德于1312或1313年去世。柳特加德本人卒于1352年。

en: Ulrich I was count of Lindow-Ruppin in Brandenburg after his father Günther I died in 1284. By his wife Adelheid von Schladen he left the counts Ulrich II and Günther III, and died in 1316.
zh: 乌尔里希一世是勃兰登堡的林多-鲁平伯爵，1284年父亲金特一世去世后继位，娶阿德尔海德·冯·施拉登，子乌尔里希二世、金特三世，1316年去世。

en: Ulrich II (c. 1300–3 February 1356) was count of Lindow-Ruppin, succeeding his father Ulrich I in the Brandenburg march. He married Agnes of Anhalt-Zerbst, and their children included Albrecht, later Count Albrecht VI, and Agnes, wife of John I of Mecklenburg-Stargard. In 1334 he had to surrender lands around Rathenow and Friesack, but the margrave confirmed his rights to Gransee and Wusterhausen in 1347, and these became Brandenburg fiefs in 1349. The same year he sold Fürstenberg and bought Havelland estates around Glien, Rhinow and Bötzow.
zh: 乌尔里希二世（约1300—1356年2月3日）是林多-鲁平伯爵，在勃兰登堡马克承袭父亲乌尔里希一世。他娶安哈尔特-采尔布斯特的阿格尼丝，子女包括后来成为伯爵的阿尔布雷希特六世，以及嫁给梅克伦堡-施塔加德公爵约翰一世的阿格尼丝。1334年他被迫交出拉特诺和弗里扎克一带的土地；1347年藩侯确认他对格兰塞和武斯特豪森的权利，两地于1349年成为勃兰登堡采邑。同年他出售菲尔斯滕贝格，购得哈弗尔兰的格林、里诺和伯措周围的地产。

en: Alexander Pushkin (1799–1837), born in Moscow to an old noble family and descended through his mother from Abram Gannibal, the African godson of Peter the Great, is regarded as Russia's greatest poet and founder of modern Russian literature. His first poem appeared in 1814 at the Tsarskoye Selo Lyceum. In 1820 he published his first long poem, Ruslan and Ludmila, but his Ode to Liberty and other verses brought exile under Alexander I that year. Under surveillance by the emperor's political police, he wrote the drama Boris Godunov; his novel in verse Eugene Onegin appeared between 1825 and 1832. He died in February 1837 after a duel with the French officer Georges d'Anthès.
zh: 亚历山大·普希金（1799—1837）生于莫斯科的古老贵族家庭，母系先祖是彼得大帝的黑人教子阿布拉姆·汉尼拔，被视为俄国最伟大的诗人和现代俄国文学的奠基人。1814年，他在皇村学校发表第一首诗。1820年，他发表首部长诗《鲁斯兰与柳德米拉》，但《自由颂》等诗篇使他在同年被亚历山大一世流放。在沙皇政治警察的监视下，他创作了戏剧《鲍里斯·戈都诺夫》，诗体小说《叶甫盖尼·奥涅金》则在1825至1832年间陆续发表。1837年2月，他在与法国军官乔治·丹特斯决斗后伤重死去。

en: Alexander Radishchev (1749–1802) was a Russian writer and social critic. He served as a page at Catherine the Great's court in 1765. Sent to the University of Leipzig in the 1760s, he returned steeped in Enlightenment ideas of natural law and entered Catherine the Great's civil service. In 1790 he privately printed A Journey from St Petersburg to Moscow, a fierce attack on serfdom and autocracy that Catherine condemned as Jacobin sedition. She ordered copies confiscated and destroyed. Arrested and sentenced to death, he was exiled instead to Ilimsk in Siberia until 1797. Pardoned under Alexander I, he briefly helped draft legal reforms but, broken by persecution, took his own life in 1802.
zh: 亚历山大·拉季舍夫（1749—1802）是俄国作家与社会批评家。1765年，他在叶卡捷琳娜二世的宫廷担任侍从。1760年代他被派往莱比锡大学学习，回国时深受自然法等启蒙思想熏陶，进入叶卡捷琳娜二世的政府任职。1790年，他自费印行《从彼得堡到莫斯科旅行记》，尖锐抨击农奴制与专制制度，被叶卡捷琳娜斥为雅各宾式煽动。女皇下令没收并销毁该书。他被捕并判处死刑，后改判流放西伯利亚伊利姆斯克，直到1797年才获释。亚历山大一世即位后，他一度参与起草法律改革，但终因迫害摧折，于1802年自杀。

en: Aleksey Fyodorovich Adashev (1510–1561) was a low-born Russian statesman who became the closest lay adviser of Tsar Ivan IV. After the Moscow fires of 1547 he and the priest Sylvester headed the reforming government of Ivan's early years: the new Sudebnik law code was confirmed by the first Zemsky Sobor in 1550, the Stoglav church council met in 1551, and Kazan and Astrakhan fell in 1552 and 1556. As head of the Petition Office he also led diplomacy with Livonia, Poland and Denmark. In 1560 he was exiled to Livonia, and he died imprisoned in Dorpat in 1561.
zh: 阿列克谢·费奥多罗维奇·阿达舍夫（1510—1561）出身不高，却成为沙皇伊凡四世最亲近的世俗谋臣。1547年莫斯科大火之后，他与神父西尔韦斯特共同主持伊凡早年的改革政府：1550年首次缙绅会议批准新的《法典》，1551年召开百条宗教会议，1552年和1556年相继攻灭喀山汗国与阿斯特拉罕汗国。他身为请愿衙门主管，还主持了与利沃尼亚、波兰和丹麦的外交。1560年他被流放利沃尼亚，1561年死于多尔帕特的囚禁中。

en: Boris Ivanovich Morozov (1590–1661) was a boyar who headed the Russian government in the early reign of Tsar Alexis, whose tutor he became in 1634. In January 1648 he arranged Alexis's marriage to Maria Miloslavskaya and ten days later married her sister Anna, becoming the tsar's brother-in-law. He supervised several departments, including the Grand Treasury and the Streltsy. He cut state salaries and imposed a heavy salt tax to fill the treasury, provoking the Salt Riot of 1648; the tsar saved him from the mob by a feigned exile to the Kirillo-Belozersky Monastery. Back in Moscow, he helped draft the 1649 legal code, the Sobornoye Ulozheniye, and continued to direct the government discreetly in the early 1650s.
zh: 鲍里斯·伊万诺维奇·莫罗佐夫（1590—1661）是沙皇阿列克谢统治早期主持俄国政府的大贵族，1634年起担任年幼的阿列克谢的太傅。1648年1月，他促成沙皇迎娶玛丽亚·米洛斯拉夫斯卡娅，十天后自己娶了皇后的妹妹安娜，成为沙皇的连襟。他管理包括国库和射击军在内的多个部门。为充实国库，他削减官吏俸禄、开征高额盐税，引发了1648年的盐税暴动；沙皇将他假流放至基里尔-别洛泽尔斯基修道院，使他免于暴民之手。回到莫斯科后，他参与制定了1649年的《会议法典》，并在1650年代初继续低调主持政府。

en: Ernst Johann von Biron (1690–1772), a Courland nobleman, entered Anna Ivanovna's court in Courland through his sister's intercession and supplanted Peter Bestuzhev in Anna's favour. He became the all-powerful favourite of the empress after she took the Russian throne in 1730; his dominance was dubbed the Bironovshchina. In 1737 he was elected Duke of Courland and Semigallia, ruling the duchy from Saint Petersburg. Anna's will made him regent for the infant Ivan VI in October 1740, but within weeks Münnich's coup overthrew him and he spent 1740 to 1761 in exile. Peter III recalled him, and Catherine II restored him to Courland in 1763, which he passed to his son Peter in 1769.
zh: 恩斯特·约翰·冯·比隆（1690—1772）是库尔兰贵族，经姐姐引荐进入安娜·伊凡诺芙娜在库尔兰的宫廷，并取代彼得·别斯图热夫成为安娜的宠臣。1730年安娜登上俄国皇位后，他权倾朝野，当权时期被称为“比隆之乱”。1737年，他当选库尔兰和瑟米加利亚公爵，却在圣彼得堡遥控公国。安娜遗命他于1740年10月为幼帝伊凡六世摄政，但仅仅几周后便在米尼希发动的政变中倒台，1740至1761年被流放。彼得三世将他召回，叶卡捷琳娜二世于1763年恢复了他的库尔兰公爵之位；1769年他把公国传给儿子彼得。

en: Fyodor Isakovich Baykov (c. 1612–c. 1663) was the first Russian ambassador sent to China. In 1654 Tsar Alexis dispatched him to the Shunzhi Emperor to establish regular trade between Moscow and Beijing. Before leaving Tobolsk, he sent Setkul Ablin ahead as a messenger. Baykov travelled up the Irtysh, across Dzungaria and the Gobi, but was stopped at Kalgan because Chinese officials mistook Ablin for the ambassador. He reached the Forbidden City in March 1656. His refusal to kowtow except to the emperor himself and his insistence on presenting his credentials directly to the emperor left negotiations deadlocked; after months of isolation the Qing court expelled him. He returned to Moscow, leaving a detailed account of his journey.
zh: 费奥多尔·伊萨科维奇·拜科夫（约1612—约1663）是俄国派往中国的第一位正式使节。1654年，沙皇阿列克谢派他出使顺治皇帝，意图建立莫斯科与北京之间的常规贸易。离开托博尔斯克前，他派塞特库尔·阿布林作为信使先行。他沿额尔齐斯河而上，穿越准噶尔与戈壁，却在张家口受阻，因为中国官员误以为阿布林才是使节。他于1656年3月抵达紫禁城，因坚持只向皇帝本人行叩拜礼并亲自递交国书，谈判陷入僵局；被清廷冷落数月后遭驱逐。他返回莫斯科，并留下了详尽的出使行记。

en: Grigory Orlov (1734–1783) was a Russian guards officer and favourite of Empress Catherine the Great. Wounded at Zorndorf in 1758 during the Seven Years' War, he became Catherine's lover and, with his brothers, led the coup of 1762 that deposed her husband Peter III and placed her on the throne. Made a count and then, in 1772, a prince of the Holy Roman Empire, he headed the Free Economic Society, patronized scholars and painters, and organized Moscow's response to the plague of 1771. He supported the scholar Mikhail Lomonosov, collected paintings by Rembrandt and other masters, and commissioned the Great Gatchina Palace. After failed peace talks at Focșani he lost favour and died in Moscow in 1783.
zh: 格里戈里·奥尔洛夫（1734—1783）是俄国近卫军官、女皇叶卡捷琳娜二世的宠臣。七年战争期间，他在1758年的措恩多夫战役中负伤，后来成为叶卡捷琳娜的情人，并与众兄弟一起领导1762年政变，推翻女皇的丈夫彼得三世，将叶卡捷琳娜扶上皇位。他受封伯爵，1772年晋封神圣罗马帝国公爵，主持自由经济学会，资助学者与画家，并在1771年主持莫斯科的鼠疫防疫。他资助学者米哈伊尔·罗蒙诺索夫，收藏伦勃朗等大师的画作，并委托兴建加特契纳大宫殿。福克沙尼和谈失败后他失宠，1783年在莫斯科去世。

en: Ivan Ivanovich Betskoy (1704–1795), born in Stockholm to Field Marshal Prince Ivan Trubetskoy and his Swedish mistress, was Catherine II's chief adviser on education. A fall from his horse ended his service in the Danish cavalry, and his father summoned him to Russia in 1729. He later spent years in Paris among Enlightenment thinkers, including Rousseau. He helped Catherine seize power from Peter III in 1762 and in 1763 presented his Statute for the Education of the Youth of Both Sexes, inspired by Locke and Rousseau. He oversaw the Smolny Institute for noble girls, founded foundling homes in Moscow in 1764 and Saint Petersburg in 1770, and served as president of the Imperial Academy of Arts from 1764 to 1794, building Russia's first unified public education system.
zh: 伊万·伊万诺维奇·别茨科伊（1704—1795）生于斯德哥尔摩，是陆军元帅伊万·特鲁别茨科伊王公与瑞典情妇之子，后来成为叶卡捷琳娜二世的教育首席顾问。他在丹麦骑兵服役时坠马退役，1729年应父亲召唤赴俄。此后他在巴黎生活多年，结识了卢梭等启蒙思想家。他在1762年协助叶卡捷琳娜推翻彼得三世夺权，1763年呈上深受洛克与卢梭影响的《男女青少年教育章程》。他主持创办斯莫尔尼贵族女子学院，于1764年在莫斯科、1770年在圣彼得堡建立育婴堂，并在1764至1794年担任帝国艺术学院院长，建立起俄国第一套统一的公共教育体系。

en: Ivan Ivanovich Shuvalov (1727–1797) was a Russian patron of education and the arts during the Enlightenment. A Moscow-born court page, he became Empress Elizabeth's favourite in 1749 and was made a general in 1760, though he refused the title of count. With Mikhail Lomonosov he secured Elizabeth's approval in January 1755 for the Imperial Moscow University, becoming its first curator, and in 1757 he founded the Academy of the Three Noble Arts in his own Saint Petersburg palace, serving as its first president. From 1763 to 1777 he travelled Europe, corresponding with Voltaire and Diderot and buying art for the Academy and the Hermitage. Catherine II made him High Chamberlain in 1777.
zh: 伊万·伊万诺维奇·舒瓦洛夫（1727—1797）是启蒙时代俄国教育与艺术的赞助人。他生于莫斯科，本是宫廷侍从，1749年成为伊丽莎白女皇的宠臣，1760年获授将军衔，却拒绝接受伯爵封号。他与罗蒙诺索夫合作，于1755年1月促成女皇批准创办帝国莫斯科大学，并出任首任学监；1757年，他在自己位于圣彼得堡的宅邸中创办三大高贵艺术学院，并担任首任院长。1763至1777年他游历欧洲，与伏尔泰、狄德罗等人通信，为艺术学院和艾尔米塔什博物馆搜罗艺术品。1777年，叶卡捷琳娜二世任命他为高级侍从长。

en: Joseph Bové (1784–1834) was a neoclassical architect who rebuilt Moscow after the great fire of 1812. Born in St Petersburg to a Neapolitan painter, he trained in Moscow and worked under Matvei Kazakov and Carlo Rossi. In 1813 the Moscow Building Commission placed him in charge of façade design for the reconstructed city. His department approved new façades and enforced the street lines of the rebuilding plan, though the sheer number of private builders proved difficult to control. He laid out Red Square and Theatre Square, rebuilt the Manege, erected the Triumphal Arch at Tverskaya Zastava, and designed his most famous building, the Bolshoi Theatre, opened in 1825. He died in Moscow in 1834.
zh: 约瑟夫·博韦（1784—1834）是新古典主义建筑师，主持了1812年大火之后莫斯科的重建。他生于圣彼得堡，父亲是那不勒斯画家，本人在莫斯科学艺，曾在马特维·卡扎科夫与卡洛·罗西手下工作。1813年，莫斯科建设委员会任命他主管重建城区的立面设计。他的部门负责审批新立面，并按重建规划确定街道边线，但私人建造者人数众多，难以管控。他规划了红场与剧院广场，改建莫斯科练马场，修建特维尔关卡的凯旋门，并设计了他最著名的建筑——1825年落成的莫斯科大剧院。1834年他在莫斯科去世。

en: Grigory Lukyanovich Skuratov-Belsky, known as Malyuta Skuratov, was a leader of Ivan the Terrible's Oprichnina. He rose to prominence in 1569 through the trial and execution of Prince Vladimir of Staritsa, Ivan's cousin and a possible claimant to the throne, and in December 1569 he strangled the former Metropolitan Philip II for denouncing the Oprichnina. His daughter Maria married Boris Godunov in 1570. In January 1571 he led a punitive expedition against Novgorod, killing thousands suspected of treason. That year he was put in charge of investigating the Russian army's defeat by the Crimean khan Devlet Giray. Skuratov was killed in 1573 storming Weissenstein in the Livonian War and buried at the Joseph-Volokolamsk Monastery.
zh: 格里戈里·卢基扬诺维奇·斯库拉托夫-别利斯基，人称马柳塔·斯库拉托夫，是伊凡雷帝特辖区时期的首领之一。1569年，他因审判并处决沙皇堂弟、潜在的王位觊觎者斯塔里察王公弗拉基米尔而得势；同年12月，他又奉命勒死了公开抨击特辖区制度的前莫斯科都主教腓力二世。其女玛丽亚于1570年嫁给鲍里斯·戈东诺夫。1571年1月，他率军惩讨诺夫哥罗德，以叛国嫌疑杀害了数千人。同年，他负责调查俄军败于克里米亚汗德夫莱特·格莱的原因。1573年，他在利沃尼亚战争中强攻魏森施泰因时阵亡，葬于约瑟夫-沃洛科拉姆斯克修道院。

en: Michael Maddox (1747–1822) was an English showman and theatre manager who settled in Russia. After bringing a museum of mechanical curiosities to Russia in 1766, touring Madrid and staging profitable shows at London's Haymarket Theatre, he returned to Moscow and in 1776 joined Prince Pyotr Urusov's theatre company. When their wooden Znamensky Theatre burned down in 1780, Maddox bought Urusov's share and employed Christian Rosberg to build the brick Petrovsky Theatre on Petrovka Street, Moscow's first permanent opera house and the direct predecessor of the Bolshoi Theatre. In 1792 financial troubles forced its transfer to the state, and he received a life pension from Empress Maria Feodorovna.
zh: 迈克尔·马多克斯（1747—1822）是定居俄国的英国演出商人与剧院经理。1766年，他带着机械珍奇博物馆到圣彼得堡和莫斯科办展，后来前往马德里巡演，在伦敦干草市场剧院的演出获利丰厚。他重返莫斯科后，于1776年加入彼得·乌鲁索夫公爵的剧团。1780年，木结构的兹纳缅斯基剧场焚毁，马多克斯买下乌鲁索夫的股份，雇用克里斯蒂安·罗斯伯格在彼得罗夫卡街建起砖石结构的彼得罗夫斯基剧院——莫斯科第一座常设歌剧院，也是莫斯科大剧院的直接前身。1792年因财务困难，剧院收归国有，他从皇后玛丽亚·费奥多罗夫娜处领取终身年金。

en: Prince Mikhail Shcherbatov (1733–1790) was a Russian statesman, historian and political thinker of an ancient boyar family. He defended serfdom and the nobility's old privileges, while holding up the British constitutional monarchy and separation of powers as a political ideal. He represented the Yaroslavl nobility at Catherine II's Legislative Commission of 1767 and became imperial historiographer in 1768, later serving as president of the Chamber Council from 1778 and as a senator from 1779. His seven-volume History of Russia from the Earliest Times appeared from 1771, followed by the utopian Journey to the Land of Ophir (1784). A founder of Russian conservatism, he attacked court morals in On the Corruption of Morals in Russia, published posthumously in 1797.
zh: 米哈伊洛·谢尔巴托夫王公（1733—1790）是俄罗斯帝国的政治家、历史学家和政治思想家，出身古老的波雅尔家族。他维护农奴制和贵族的古老特权，同时推崇英国的君主立宪与权力分立制度。他在1767年代表雅罗斯拉夫尔贵族出席叶卡捷琳娜二世召集的立法委员会，1768年出任帝国史官，1778年起任税务院院长，1779年起任参政院参政。他的七卷本《俄罗斯远古史》自1771年起陆续刊行，此后又写成乌托邦作品《奥菲尔之地游记》（1784）。他是俄罗斯保守主义的奠基人之一，在身后于1797年出版的《论俄罗斯道德之败坏》中抨击宫廷风气。

en: Mikhail Vasilyevich Lomonosov (1711–1765) was a Russian scientist and writer whose work ranged from chemistry and astronomy to poetry. The son of a fisherman from the far north of Russia, he walked to Moscow in 1730 and entered the Slavic Greek Latin Academy by pretending to be a nobleman's son. From 1736 he studied at Marburg under the philosopher Christian Wolff, then mining at Freiberg. In 1745 he became the St Petersburg Academy's first Russian professor of chemistry, and in 1755 he helped Ivan Shuvalov found Moscow University. Observing the 1761 transit of Venus, he detected the planet's atmosphere; he also shaped the modern Russian literary language.
zh: 米哈伊尔·瓦西里耶维奇·罗蒙诺索夫（1711—1765）是俄国科学家与作家，研究和创作涉及化学、天文学与诗歌。他是俄国北方渔民之子，1730年徒步走到莫斯科，冒充贵族子弟进入斯拉夫-希腊-拉丁学院。1736年起，他在马尔堡师从哲学家克里斯蒂安·沃尔夫，后又到弗赖堡学习采矿。1745年，他成为圣彼得堡科学院第一位俄国籍化学教授；1755年，他与伊万·舒瓦洛夫共同创办莫斯科大学。在观测1761年金星凌日时，他发现了金星大气层；此外他还深刻影响了现代俄罗斯文学语言的形成。

en: Mikhail Speransky (1772–1839) was the chief reforming statesman of Alexander I's Russia. The son of a village priest in Vladimir Province, he rose to become the tsar's closest adviser after 1807. His plans produced the ministry system and, in 1810, the State Council, of which he became the first state secretary. Aristocratic opposition brought him dismissal and exile to Perm in 1812. He later served as governor of Penza and governor-general of Siberia, returning to the State Council in 1821. Under Nicholas I, he directed the compilation of the Complete Collection of Laws, which formed the basis of the Code of Laws of the Russian Empire, published in 1833. He received the title of count weeks before his death in 1839.
zh: 米哈伊尔·斯佩兰斯基（1772—1839）是亚历山大一世时期俄国最主要的改革派政治家。他是弗拉基米尔省乡村神父之子，1807年后成为沙皇最亲近的顾问。他主持的改革奠定了部制，并于1810年促成设立国务会议，本人出任首任国务秘书。1812年，因贵族反对，他被解职并流放彼尔姆。此后他出任奔萨总督和西伯利亚总督，1821年重返国务会议。尼古拉一世时期，他主持编纂《俄罗斯帝国法律全集》，并以此为基础编成1833年刊行的《俄罗斯帝国法典》。1839年初他受封伯爵，几周后便去世。

en: Nikon (1605–1681), born Nikita Minin to Mordvin peasants near Nizhny Novgorod, became the seventh Patriarch of Moscow and all Rus' in 1652. He entered a monastery as a boy, later married and served as a parish priest. After his three children died, he became a monk and took the name Nikon. A confidant of Tsar Alexis, he largely ruled Russia during the Polish campaigns and founded the New Jerusalem Monastery. From 1654 he convened councils that corrected the Russian service books after Greek models and reformed ritual, splitting conservatives into the Old Believers' Raskol. His assertion of church supremacy over the tsar alienated Alexis, and in December 1667 the Great Moscow Synod deposed and exiled him north, while confirming his reforms. He died returning from exile in 1681.
zh: 尼孔（1605—1681）俗名尼基塔·米宁，出生在下诺夫哥罗德附近的莫尔多瓦农民家庭，1652年成为第七任莫斯科和全罗斯牧首。他少年时进入修道院，后来成婚并担任教区神父。三个孩子去世后，他出家为僧，取名尼孔。作为沙皇阿列克谢的密友，他在对波兰战争期间实际主持俄罗斯国政，并修建了新耶路撒冷修道院。1654年起，他接连召开宗教会议，仿照希腊经书修订俄罗斯礼仪书、改革仪式，反对派由此分裂出去，形成旧礼仪派的“大分裂”。他主张教权高于沙皇，招致阿列克谢疏远；1667年12月，莫斯科大公会议将他罢黜并流放北方，同时认可了他的改革。1681年他在流放归来途中去世。

en: Nikolay Novikov (1744–1818) was a Russian writer and publisher, often called the first Russian journalist and a leading voice of the Russian Enlightenment. After the Legislative Assembly of 1767, he edited the Moscow Gazette and brought out satirical journals modelled on The Spectator, attacking serfdom and social abuses and even drawing printed replies from Catherine the Great. With Johann Georg Schwarz and others, he helped spread Rosicrucian ideas in Russia. Backed by his masonic network, his press issued roughly a third of all books published in Russia, and he promoted Shakespeare among Russian readers. In 1792 Catherine imprisoned him without trial in the Shlisselburg Fortress; Paul I freed him in 1796, but he never returned to public life.
zh: 尼古拉·诺维科夫（1744—1818）是俄国作家与出版家，常被称为第一位俄国记者，也是俄国启蒙运动的代表人物。参加1767年立法委员会会议之后，他主编《莫斯科公报》，创办仿效《旁观者》的讽刺刊物，抨击农奴制与社会弊病，连叶卡捷琳娜二世都曾亲自撰文回应。他与约翰·格奥尔格·施瓦茨等人在俄国传播玫瑰十字思想。他依靠共济会网络支持的出版社，发行了当时俄国约三分之一的书籍，并向俄国读者推广莎士比亚。1792年，叶卡捷琳娜未经审判便将他囚禁于什利谢利堡要塞；1796年保罗一世将他释放，此后他再未公开活动。

en: Prince Sergei Trubetskoy (1790–1860) was a Russian guards colonel and a leader of the Decembrist revolt. He fought at Borodino and was wounded at Leipzig in the campaigns of 1812–1814, then rose to colonel in 1821 and headed the reform-minded Northern Society. Chosen the rebels' dictator for the Senate Square rising of December 1825, he lost his nerve and never appeared, taking refuge in the Austrian embassy instead. Arrested and sentenced to death, he was instead sent to lifelong hard labour in the Nerchinsk mines and later settled near Irkutsk. His wife Ekaterina was the first Decembrist wife to follow him into exile. Amnestied in 1856, he died in Moscow in 1860.
zh: 谢尔盖·特鲁别茨科伊公爵（1790—1860）是俄国近卫军上校、十二月党人起义的主要组织者之一。他参加过1812—1814年的战争，在博罗季诺作战，在莱比锡负伤，1821年升为上校，后来主持主张改革的北方协会。1825年12月参议院广场起义前夕，他被推举为起义者的独裁官，却临阵退缩，始终没有露面，而是躲入奥地利使馆。他被捕并判处死刑，后改判终身苦役，流放涅尔琴斯克矿区，后来在伊尔库茨克附近定居。他的妻子叶卡捷琳娜是第一位随夫流放的十二月党人妻子。1856年他获大赦，1860年在莫斯科去世。

en: Sophie Auguste Friederike of Anhalt-Zerbst (1729–1796), born in Stettin to a minor German princely family, became Catherine the Great, empress of Russia. In 1744 she converted to Orthodoxy and took the name Catherine; in 1745 she married the future Peter III. In July 1762, with the guards and the Orlov brothers, she overthrew Peter III and seized the crown. Her thirty-four-year reign made Russia a recognized European great power: victories over the Ottomans brought Crimea and the Black Sea coast, Poland was partitioned, and the Russian Enlightenment flourished under her patronage. She founded the Smolny Institute for noble girls and promoted provincial administration and public education. Serf labour remained central to the economy, and discontent helped fuel Pugachev's rebellion. She died in 1796 and was succeeded by her son Paul.
zh: 安哈尔特-采尔布斯特的索菲·奥古斯特·弗雷德里克（1729—1796）生于斯德丁一个德意志小诸侯家庭，后来成为俄国女皇叶卡捷琳娜二世，即叶卡捷琳娜大帝。1744年，她皈依东正教，改名叶卡捷琳娜；1745年嫁给后来的彼得三世。1762年7月，她借助近卫军与奥尔洛夫兄弟发动政变，推翻彼得三世，夺取皇位。她在位34年，使俄国成为公认的欧洲强国：对奥斯曼帝国的战争带来了克里米亚与黑海沿岸，波兰遭到瓜分，俄国启蒙运动在她的庇护下走向繁荣。她创立斯莫尔尼贵族女子学院，推动地方行政与公共教育的发展。农奴劳动仍是经济的支柱，不满情绪助长了普加乔夫起义。1796年她去世，其子保罗继位。

en: Sylvester was a priest of Moscow's Cathedral of the Annunciation and, with Aleksey Adashev, the most powerful adviser to Tsar Ivan IV. A former manuscript copyist and icon painter from Novgorod, he is first recorded at the Annunciation Cathedral in 1545. After the great Moscow fire of 1547 he became the leading voice of the Chosen Council, shaping the government's church and administrative reforms until 1560. Having lost Ivan's favour, he withdrew to the Kirillov monastery at Beloozero and then to Solovki, where under the monastic name Spiridon he copied books. He is thought to have died around 1566.
zh: 西尔韦斯特是莫斯科圣母领报大教堂的司祭，与阿列克谢·阿达舍夫并为沙皇伊凡四世最有权势的谋臣。他原是诺夫哥罗德的抄书人与圣像画师，最早于1545年见于圣母领报大教堂的记载。1547年莫斯科大火之后，他成为“重臣会议”的核心人物，主导了1560年以前的教会与行政改革。失宠于伊凡之后，他先退隐白湖的基里洛夫修道院，后转往索洛维茨基修道院，取教名斯皮里东，在那里抄录经书。一般认为他约于1566年去世。

en: Vasily Nikitich Tatishchev (1686–1750) was a Russian statesman, historian and ethnographer. Trained at Moscow's Artillery and Engineering school, he served in the Great Northern War against Sweden and held senior posts under Peter the Great. In 1730 he backed Anna Ivanovna's accession against the Supreme Privy Council. Sent to run the Urals factories, he founded Yekaterinburg and Perm. During the Bashkir War he took overall command of operations in 1737, but was removed in 1739. He later governed Astrakhan from 1741 to 1744. His History of Russia, one of the first full works on the subject, was published posthumously in 1767.
zh: 瓦西里·尼基季奇·塔季谢夫（1686—1750）是俄国政治家、历史学家与民族志学者。他毕业于莫斯科炮兵工程学校，曾参加对瑞典的大北方战争，在彼得大帝麾下担任要职。1730年，他支持安娜·伊凡诺芙娜登基，对抗最高枢密院。后来他奉命管理乌拉尔工厂，创建了叶卡捷琳堡与彼尔姆。巴什基尔战争期间，他于1737年接掌全局指挥，却在1739年被撤职。1741至1744年，他出任阿斯特拉罕总督。他所著的《俄罗斯史》是俄国最早的通史著作之一，在他身后于1767年出版。

en: Yemelyan Pugachev (c. 1742–1775) was a Don Cossack who led the greatest peasant uprising of Catherine the Great's reign. A veteran of the Seven Years' War and the Russo-Turkish War of 1768–1774, he deserted in 1770 and drifted among discontented Cossacks and Old Believers. In 1772 he joined a protest among the Terek Cossacks, was chosen their representative, and escaped after being arrested on his way to present their complaint. In 1773 he proclaimed himself the murdered tsar Peter III and promised an end to serfdom, drawing a huge rebel army that overran the Volga and Urals lands and burned Kazan in 1774. Defeated near Tsaritsyn, he was handed over by his own men and beheaded in Moscow in January 1775.
zh: 叶梅利扬·普加乔夫（约1742—1775）是顿河哥萨克，领导了叶卡捷琳娜二世时期规模最大的农民起义。他曾参加七年战争和1768—1774年的俄土战争，1770年逃离军队，在不满的哥萨克与旧礼仪派信徒中流亡。1772年，他参加捷列克哥萨克的抗议，被选为代表，在前去呈递诉状途中被捕后逃脱。1773年，他自称是已遇害的沙皇彼得三世，许诺废除农奴制，聚集起庞大的起义军，席卷伏尔加河与乌拉尔之间的土地，并于1774年焚毁喀山。他在察里津附近战败，被部下出卖，1775年1月在莫斯科被斩首。

en: Yury Matveyevich Felten, born Georg Friedrich Veldten (1730–1801) to a German family in Russian service, was an architect favoured by Catherine the Great. He studied at Tübingen from 1744 to 1749, then returned to Saint Petersburg and completed his architectural studies with Empress Elizabeth's support. From 1752 to 1762 he assisted Bartolomeo Rastrelli on the Winter Palace, then designed the Old Hermitage, the Zubov wing of the Catherine Palace at Tsarskoye Selo and the Chesme Palace. He built the lifting machine that moved the giant granite pedestal of the Bronze Horseman, and in 1783 completed the celebrated iron railing of the Summer Garden. He taught at the Imperial Academy of Arts from 1764 and directed it from 1789 until his death.
zh: 尤里·马特维耶维奇·费尔滕（1730—1801）原名格奥尔格·弗里德里希·费尔滕，出身于一个供职俄国的德意志家庭，是深受叶卡捷琳娜大帝信任的建筑师。1744至1749年，他在蒂宾根求学，随后返回圣彼得堡，在伊丽莎白女皇资助下完成建筑学业。1752至1762年，他作为巴尔托洛梅奥·拉斯特雷利的助手参与冬宫建造，此后设计了旧艾尔米塔什、皇村叶卡捷琳娜宫的祖博夫配楼和切什梅宫。他还造出起重装置，搬运了青铜骑士雕像的巨型花岗岩基座；1783年完成了著名的夏花园铁栅栏。他自1764年起在帝国艺术学院任教，1789年出任院长，直至去世。

en: Bernard of Ravensberg (died 1346) was a younger son of Count Otto III of Ravensberg and Hedwig of Lippe. He served as provost of Schildesche and as a canon at Osnabrück and Münster, and studied at Bologna in 1303. After his elder brother Otto IV died in 1328, Bernard succeeded to the County of Ravensberg as the last male of the Ravensberg-Calvelage line. He kept the county out of the great feuds of his day, and having no children arranged for his niece Margaret and her husband Gerhard of Jülich to inherit. He died in September 1346.
zh: 伯恩哈德·冯·拉芬斯贝格（？—1346）是拉芬斯贝格伯爵奥托三世与利珀的海德维希的幼子。他本走教会道路，曾任希尔德舍修道院院长、奥斯纳布吕克与明斯特的法政牧师，并于1303年在博洛尼亚求学。1328年兄长奥托四世去世后，伯恩哈德继位为拉芬斯贝格伯爵，是拉芬斯贝格-卡尔费拉格家族的最后一位男嗣。他使伯国避开当时的各大纷争，因无子嗣，安排侄女玛格丽特及其丈夫于利希的格哈德继承领地。他于1346年9月去世。

en: Margaret of Ravensberg (c. 1320–1389) was the daughter of Count Otto IV of Ravensberg and Margaret of Berg-Windeck. When her uncle Bernard, the last male count, died without issue in 1346, she inherited Ravensberg; two years later the death of her maternal uncle Adolf IX of Berg brought her the County of Berg as well. Through her marriage to Gerhard VI of Jülich, both counties passed to the House of Jülich. She was the mother of William, the first Duke of Berg, and died in February 1389.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/拉文斯貝格的瑪格麗特
zh: 玛格丽特·冯·拉芬斯贝格（约1320—1389）是拉芬斯贝格伯爵奥托四世与贝格-温德克的玛格丽特之女。1346年，她的叔叔、家族末代男嗣伯恩哈德无嗣而终，她由此继承拉芬斯贝格；两年后舅父贝格伯爵阿道夫九世去世，她又继承了贝格伯国。通过与于利希的格哈德六世联姻，两个伯国都归于利希家族。她是首任贝格公爵威廉的母亲，于1389年2月去世。

en: Margaret of Berg-Windeck (c. 1285–1340) was the daughter of Henry of Berg, lord of Windeck, and Agnes of the Mark. In 1313 she married Count Otto IV of Ravensberg. Their daughters were Hedwig, wife of Duke William of Brunswick-Lüneburg, who died in 1334, and Margaret, who in 1338 married Gerhard of Jülich. When Otto died in 1328 Ravensberg passed to his brother Bernard, and the countess last appears in charters in 1339. Her daughter Margaret inherited Ravensberg in 1346 and the County of Berg in 1348.
zh: 贝格-温德克的玛格丽特（约1285—约1340）是温德克领主贝格的亨利与马克的阿格尼丝之女。1313年她嫁给拉文斯贝格伯爵奥托四世。两个女儿分别是嫁给不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵威廉、1334年去世的黑德维希，以及1338年嫁给于利希的格哈德的小玛格丽特。1328年奥托去世后，拉文斯贝格伯国传给其弟伯恩哈德，玛格丽特本人最后一次见于文书是1339年。她的女儿玛格丽特于1346年继承拉文斯贝格，1348年又继承贝格伯国。

en: Otto III (c. 1246–1306) was count of Ravensberg from 1249. As his father Louis died while he was a minor, Bernard III of Lippe held the regency and occupied Ravensberg Castle before Otto was installed. In 1267 he fought for Archbishop Engelbert II of Cologne at the Battle of Zülpich, and in 1277 he joined the bishops of Osnabrück and Münster in an alliance against the lords of Lippe. On 5 March 1271 he married Hedwig of Lippe, and in 1293 founded a canonry at Bielefeld, where he and his wife were buried. His son Otto IV succeeded him.
zh: 奥托三世（约1246—1306）自1249年起为拉芬斯贝格伯爵。父亲路德维希去世时他尚年幼，由利珀领主伯恩哈德三世摄政，后者甚至强占拉芬斯贝格城堡，奥托最终才得以继位。1267年，他在曲尔皮希战役中为科隆大主教恩格尔贝特二世作战；1277年与奥斯纳布吕克、明斯特两位主教结盟对抗利珀领主。1271年3月5日他娶利珀的黑德维希，1293年在比勒费尔德创立参事会修道院，死后与妻子合葬于此。其子奥托四世继位。

en: Otto IV (c. 1276–1328) was count of Ravensberg from 1306 until his death, the fifth child of Otto III and Hedwig of Lippe. Destined for the church, he became a canon at Osnabrück in 1293 and at Münster in 1301, but returned to secular life to succeed his father. In 1313 he married Margaret of Berg-Windeck, who bore him two daughters, Hedwig and Margaret, and no son. Through Margaret's marriage to Gerhard of Jülich, Ravensberg later passed to the counts of Jülich. Otto was buried at Bielefeld.
zh: 奥托四世（约1276—1328）是1306年至去世的拉芬斯贝格伯爵，奥托三世与利珀的黑德维希的第五个孩子。他原本准备进入教会，1293年成为奥斯纳布吕克大教堂教士，1301年成为明斯特大教堂教士，父亲死后才还俗继位。1313年他娶贝格-温德克的玛格丽特，只生下黑德维希和玛格丽特两个女儿，没有儿子。后来拉芬斯贝格经女儿玛格丽特与于利希的格哈德的婚姻，转入于利希伯爵家族。奥托葬于比勒费尔德。

en: Gleb Rostislavich (died 30 June 1177) was prince of Ryazan and ancestor of its Rurikid branch, a son of Rostislav Yaroslavich. In 1145 his father sent him to rule Ryazan, but a Suzdalian siege drove him to the Polovtsians in 1146. He founded the town of Glebov in 1159 and secured Ryazan after the death of his cousin Vladimir. In 1176 he burned Moscow and sacked Bogolyubovo, but Vsevolod the Big Nest defeated him on the Koloksha in 1177, capturing him and his sons. Gleb died in prison at Vladimir after refusing freedom in exchange for Ryazan.
zh: 格列布·罗斯季斯拉维奇（？—1177年6月30日）是梁赞王公、留里克王朝梁赞支系的始祖，罗斯季斯拉夫·雅罗斯拉维奇之子。1145年父亲派他出镇梁赞，但1146年苏兹达尔军队围攻梁赞，迫使他投奔波洛伏齐人。1159年他建立格列博夫城，堂兄弗拉基米尔死后，他坐稳了梁赞公位。1176年他焚毁莫斯科、洗劫博戈柳博沃，1177年却在科洛克沙河被弗谢沃洛德·大窝击败，与诸子一同被俘。格列布被押往弗拉基米尔入狱，因拒绝以放弃梁赞换取自由，于6月30日死于狱中。

en: Igor Glebovich (died 1194) was an appanage prince of Ryazan, the second son of Gleb Rostislavich. He fought beside his father at the Battle of the Koloksha in 1177, where Vsevolod the Big Nest captured him, and after Gleb died in prison Ryazan was held jointly by Igor and his brothers Roman and Vladimir. In 1180 he backed Roman in their feud against their brothers Vladimir and Vsevolod, and in 1186 Vsevolod the Big Nest's intervention forced the Ryazan princes to swear submission. His son Ingvar later ruled as prince of Ryazan.
zh: 伊戈尔·格列波维奇（？—1194）是梁赞的封邑王公，格列布·罗斯季斯拉维奇的次子。1177年他随父亲参加科洛克沙河战役，被弗谢沃洛德·大窝俘虏；父亲死于狱中后，梁赞由他与兄弟罗曼、弗拉基米尔共同领有。1180年他支持罗曼对抗兄弟弗拉基米尔和弗谢沃洛德；1186年弗谢沃洛德·大窝再次出兵，迫使梁赞诸王公吻十字架宣誓服从。他的儿子因戈瓦尔后来成为梁赞王公。

en: Ingvar Igorevich, in baptism Kosma (died 1235), was prince of Ryazan from 1217. In 1207 he was among the Ryazan princes accused of treason and carried off to prison by Vsevolod the Big Nest of Vladimir, and he was released only in 1212. He escaped the princely congress at Isady in 1217, where his cousin Gleb Vladimirovich massacred his rivals and Ingvar's brothers died. In 1219 he defeated Gleb and his Polovtsian allies, then sought help from Grand Prince Yuri Vsevolodovich of Vladimir and defeated them again. In 1220 he founded the Olgov Monastery near Ryazan.
zh: 因戈瓦尔·伊戈列维奇（教名科斯马，？—1235）于1217年起任梁赞王公。1207年，他被诬告谋反而遭弗拉基米尔大公弗谢沃洛德（大窝）掳走囚禁，直到1212年才获释。1217年，堂兄弟格列布·弗拉基米罗维奇在伊萨德的王公大会上设伏屠杀对手，他因没有赴会而幸免于难，他的兄弟却遇害。1219年，他击败格列布及其波洛韦茨盟军，随后向弗拉基米尔大公尤里·弗谢沃洛多维奇求援，再次击败对方。1220年，他在梁赞附近建立奥尔戈夫修道院。

en: Ivan II Ivanovich, called Korotopol (died 1343), was prince of Ryazan, son of Ivan Yaroslavich. He is thought to have succeeded in 1327 after his father was executed by Öz Beg Khan of the Golden Horde. In 1333 he joined Ivan Kalita of Moscow against Novgorod, and in 1340 marched with a Horde army against Smolensk. On the way he robbed his cousin Alexander of Pronsk, took him to Pereyaslavl and killed him there. In 1342 Alexander's son brought Tatar troops against him and besieged Pereyaslavl; Ivan resisted for a day, fled by night and died the following year.
zh: 伊凡·伊万诺维奇，绰号科罗托波尔（？—1343），是梁赞王公，伊凡·雅罗斯拉维奇之子。一般认为他于1327年继位，此前其父在金帐汗国被月即别汗处死。1333年，他随莫斯科的伊凡·卡利塔出征诺夫哥罗德；1340年又随汗国军马进讨斯摩棱斯克，途中抢劫了堂兄弟、普龙斯克王公亚历山大，将他带到佩列亚斯拉夫尔杀害。1342年，亚历山大之子带鞑靼军队围攻佩列亚斯拉夫尔，伊凡据守一整日，趁夜弃城逃走，于次年去世。

en: Ivan Yaroslavich (c. 1280–1327), son of Yaroslav Romanovich, held Pronsk from 1299 and took the grand princely table of Ryazan around 1308 after his cousin Vasily was killed in the Horde. In 1320 Prince Yury Danilovich of Moscow and Vladimir marched against him, but the two made peace without a battle. The chronicles differ over his end: some say he was killed in 1327 on the Tatar expedition against Tver that avenged Shchelkan's murder, in company with Ivan Kalita; others, that the Tatars killed him in the Horde. His son Ivan Korotopol succeeded him.
zh: 伊凡·雅罗斯拉维奇（约1280—1327）是雅罗斯拉夫·罗曼诺维奇之子，1299年起领有普龙斯克，约1308年堂兄弟瓦西里在汗廷被杀后登上梁赞大公之位。1320年，莫斯科兼弗拉基米尔王公尤里·丹尼洛维奇出兵来攻，双方未交战便议和。关于他的结局，编年史说法不一：一说他1327年随伊凡·卡利塔参加鞑靼人征讨特维尔、为谢尔坎被杀复仇之役时遇害；另一说他是在汗廷被鞑靼人所杀。其子伊凡·科罗托波尔继位。

en: Konstantin Romanovich (died 1306) was the youngest son of Grand Prince Roman Olgovich of Ryazan and ruled Ryazan from 1299, possibly holding Pronsk before that. In autumn 1301 Prince Daniil Alexandrovich of Moscow invaded, defeated a Tatar force Konstantin had hired near Pereyaslavl-Ryazansky, and captured him through a ruse, reportedly the treachery of his own boyars. He was kept in honour in Moscow while Daniil planned to free him after peace, but Daniil died in 1303, and his successor Yury Danilovich ordered Konstantin killed in 1306. His son Vasily succeeded in Ryazan.
zh: 康斯坦丁·罗曼诺维奇（？—1306）是梁赞大公罗曼三世·奥利戈维奇的幼子，1299年起统治梁赞，此前可能领有普龙斯克。1301年秋，莫斯科王公丹尼尔·亚历山德罗维奇入侵，在梁赞佩列亚斯拉夫尔附近击溃康斯坦丁雇来的鞑靼军队，并靠诈术将他俘获，据《尼康编年史》称这是他手下波雅尔贵族叛变所致。他在莫斯科受到礼遇，丹尼尔本打算议和后放他回去，但丹尼尔于1303年去世，继位的尤里·丹尼洛维奇在1306年下令将他杀死。其子瓦西里随后统治梁赞。

en: Oleg II Ivanovich (died 1402) was grand prince of Ryazan from about 1350 and a persistent rival of Moscow. In 1365 he defeated a raiding Horde army under Tagai, but in 1371 Dmitri of Moscow's troops routed him at Skornishchevo and briefly drove him from the throne. In the 1380 Kulikovo campaign he negotiated with Mamai and Jogaila without joining the battle. After seizing Kolomna in 1385, he made peace through the mediation of Sergius of Radonezh and in 1387 married his son Fyodor to Dmitri's daughter Sofia. He died in July 1402, later venerated as a Ryazan saint.
zh: 奥列格二世·伊万诺维奇（？—1402）约1350年起为梁赞大公，长期与莫斯科争雄。1365年，他击败塔盖率领的汗国劫掠军；1371年，莫斯科的德米特里的军队在斯科尔尼谢沃将他击溃，一度把他赶下大公之位。1380年库里科沃战役期间，他与马迈和雅盖沃谈判周旋，却没有参战。1385年他夺取科洛姆纳，后经谢尔盖·拉多涅日斯基调解议和，于1387年为儿子费奥多尔迎娶德米特里之女索菲娅。他于1402年7月去世，后来被尊为梁赞圣徒。

en: Oleg Ingvarevich, called the Red or the Handsome (c. 1215–1258), was the only senior Ryazan prince to survive Batu's invasion of 1237 to 1238. Said to have been captured at Kolomna, he refused the khan's demand to convert and was spared for his rare beauty. He took charge of the ruined principality and returned to Ryazan in 1243, the first Russian prince to visit Karakorum and return alive, possibly receiving his patent from the regent Töregene. Summoned and detained by the Horde in 1250, he was freed in 1252, took monastic vows, and died on 20 March 1258.
zh: 奥列格·因戈瓦列维奇，绰号“红者”，一称“美男子”（约1215—1258），是1237—1238年拔都入侵后唯一幸存的梁赞长系王公。相传他在科洛姆纳被俘，拔都逼他改宗，他坚决不从，却因罕见的美貌而获赦。他出掌残破的梁赞，1243年返回城中，是第一位前往哈拉和林并活着归来的罗斯王公，可能从摄政的脱列哥那手中取得册封诏书。1250年他被召往汗廷扣押，1252年获释，临终前出家苦修，1258年3月20日去世。

en: Roman Olgovich (1237–19 July 1270) was grand prince of Ryazan from 1258, the only son of Oleg the Red. Given the princely name Yaroslav and baptized Roman, he inherited a principality slowly recovering from the Mongol sack and kept it from fresh ruin for twelve years while complying with the Horde. A tax collector slandered him to Khan Mengu-Timur, who summoned him in 1270 and offered death or the khan's faith. Roman refused, was tortured and mutilated before execution, and is venerated as an Orthodox martyr saint. Before leaving he divided his appanages among his sons, including Konstantin.
zh: 罗曼三世·奥利戈维奇（1237—1270年7月19日）1258年起任梁赞大公，是奥列格（红者）的独子。他的王公名为雅罗斯拉夫，洗礼得名罗曼。他接手的公国正从蒙古人的洗劫中缓慢恢复，十二年间勉力屈从汗廷，使梁赞免遭新的战祸。一名征税官向忙哥帖木儿汗进谗，大汗便于1270年召他前往，逼他在死亡和皈依鞑靼人的信仰之间作选择。罗曼宁死不从，受酷刑、被肢解后处死，被东正教尊为殉道圣徒。临行前他把封邑分给诸子，其中包括康斯坦丁。

en: Svyatoslav Yaroslavich (died 1145) was a Rurikid prince of Ryazan and Murom, a son of Yaroslav Svyatoslavich of Murom. When his father died in 1129 the family lands were divided: his elder brother Yury took Murom, while Svyatoslav and his younger brother Rostislav jointly received the Ryazan region, ruling in Ryazan and Pronsk respectively. In 1143, after Yury's death, Svyatoslav moved to the senior throne of Murom and ceded Ryazan to Rostislav. He died in Murom two years later. His sons included Vladimir, later grand prince of Ryazan.
zh: 斯维亚托斯拉夫·雅罗斯拉维奇（？—1145）是留里克王朝的梁赞、穆罗姆王公，穆罗姆王公雅罗斯拉夫·斯维亚托斯拉维奇之子。1129年父亲去世后，家族领地被瓜分：长兄尤里领有穆罗姆，斯维亚托斯拉夫与弟弟罗斯季斯拉夫共同领有梁赞地区，分别在梁赞和普龙斯克执政。1143年长兄尤里死后，斯维亚托斯拉夫入主穆罗姆公位，把梁赞让给罗斯季斯拉夫，两年后在穆罗姆去世。其子弗拉基米尔后来成为梁赞大公。

en: Yaroslav Romanovich (died 1299) was a Rurikid prince, a son of the martyred grand prince Roman Olgovich of Ryazan. After his father's execution in the Horde in 1270, he received the Principality of Pronsk while his brother Fyodor took Ryazan; he is held to have ruled Pronsk from 1270 to 1294. When Fyodor died in 1294, some historians hold that Yaroslav succeeded to the Ryazan table, although no chronicle expressly titles him prince of Ryazan. The annals record nothing of his life save his death in 1299, after which Konstantin ruled Ryazan.
zh: 雅罗斯拉夫·罗曼诺维奇（？—1299）是留里克系王公，梁赞殉道大公罗曼三世·奥利戈维奇之子。1270年父亲在汗廷遇害后，他分得普龙斯克公国，兄弟费奥多尔则得到梁赞；他被认为于1270—1294年统治普龙斯克。1294年费奥多尔去世后，一些史家认为梁赞大位由他继承，但没有任何编年史明确称他为梁赞王公。史书对其生平毫无记载，只提到他于1299年去世，此后梁赞由康斯坦丁统治。

en: Volrad von dem Dorne was bishop of the prince-bishopric of Ratzeburg from 1335 to 1355. In the mid-fourteenth century he had the old episcopal castle at Farchau near Schmilau demolished.
zh: 福尔拉德·冯·德姆·多尔内于1335至1355年担任拉策堡主教区主教。14世纪中叶，他下令拆毁了施米劳附近法尔肖的旧主教城堡。

en: Fyodor Yuryevich (died 1348) was prince of Rzhev and Fomin, from the Smolensk branch of the Rurik dynasty, who served the princes of Moscow. In 1314 Yuri Danilovich of Moscow sent him with Prince Afanasy Danilovich to Novgorod to expel the governors of Grand Prince Mikhail Yaroslavich of Tver; they seized the city, but after Mikhail defeated the Novgorodians near Torzhok in 1315, Fyodor was handed over and lost his Rzhev appanage. He kept part of Fomin, later served as the grand prince's namestnik in Novgorod, and died there on 1 December 1348.
zh: 费奥多尔·尤里耶维奇（？—1348）是勒热夫与福明王公，出身留里克王朝斯摩棱斯克支系，效力于莫斯科诸王公。1314年，莫斯科王公尤里·丹尼洛维奇派他随阿凡纳西·丹尼洛维奇前往诺夫哥罗德，驱逐特维尔大公米哈伊尔·雅罗斯拉维奇的总督；他们夺占该城，但1315年米哈伊尔在托尔若克击败诺夫哥罗德人后，费奥多尔被交出，并失去了勒热夫采邑。他保留了福明的一部分领地，后来担任大公驻诺夫哥罗德的长官，于1348年12月1日在当地去世。

en: Yuri Yurievich was a Rurikid prince of the Fominsky branch of the Smolensk Rurikids, named in genealogies as prince of Fominsk and possibly holder of Rzhev. He was the father of Fyodor Yuryevich, prince of Rzhev and Fominsk, who died in 1348.
zh: 尤里·尤里耶维奇是留里克王朝福明斯克支系王公，出自斯摩棱斯克王公一系，谱系称他领有福明斯克，可能还领有勒热夫。其子费奥多尔·尤里耶维奇任勒热夫兼福明斯克王公，1348年去世。

en: John I of Saarbrücken (c. 1260–1342) was count of Saarbrücken from 1308, the son of Count Simon IV and Margaret of Broyes. In 1285 he inherited part of the lordship of Commercy from his mother. From 1297 he served the dukes of Lorraine and campaigned in Flanders for France. He joined King Henry VII's embassy to the papal court at Avignon in 1309 and fought with the emperor's auxiliaries in Italy in 1313, where he was captured. He granted town rights to Saarbrücken in 1322 and Commercy in 1324, and died on 23 January 1342.
zh: 约翰一世·冯·萨尔布吕肯（约1260—1342）自1308年起任萨尔布吕肯伯爵，是伯爵西蒙四世与布鲁瓦的玛格丽特之子。1285年，他从母亲处继承了科梅尔西领地的一部分。1297年起他效力于洛林公爵，为法国在佛兰德征战。1309年，他作为国王亨利七世使团的成员前往阿维尼翁教廷；1313年又加入皇帝的援军赴意大利作战，其间被俘。他于1322年和1324年先后授予萨尔布吕肯与科梅尔西城市权，1342年1月23日去世。

en: John II of Saarbrücken (1310/1313–1381) was count of Saarbrücken from 1342. The son of Simon of Saarbrücken-Commercy and Margaret of Savoy, he received the County of Saarbrücken on his grandfather John I's death in 1342, while most of Commercy went to his cousin. He fought for France and was captured with King John II at the Battle of Poitiers in 1356 and imprisoned in England until 1360. He served France on embassies to Emperor Charles IV and England and was made Grand Bouteiller in 1364. He died on 11 March 1381, leaving Saarbrücken to his daughter Johanna.
zh: 约翰二世·冯·萨尔布吕肯（1310/1313—1381）自1342年起任萨尔布吕肯伯爵。他是西蒙·冯·萨尔布吕肯-科梅尔西与萨伏依的玛格丽特之子，1342年祖父约翰一世去世后获得萨尔布吕肯伯国，科梅尔西的大部分则归堂兄弟所有。他为法国作战，1356年在普瓦捷战役中与法王约翰二世一同被俘，囚禁在英格兰直至1360年。此后他代表法国出使皇帝查理四世的宫廷和英格兰，1364年被任命为法兰西宫廷大斟酒官。他于1381年3月11日去世，萨尔布吕肯由女儿约翰娜继承。

en: Jean II de Sarrebruck-Commercy (died 1344) was a younger son of Jean I, count of Saarbrücken and lord of Commercy, and Mahaut d'Apremont. He inherited the castle of Commercy as sire of Commercy-Château-Haut, while his nephew Jean IV kept the county of Saarbrücken and the Château-Bas portion of the town. In 1324 he and his father granted Commercy its charter of franchises. Before 16 April 1331 he married Alix de Joinville, heiress of Briquenay and Vénizy, who brought him those Champagne lordships; their sons Simon II and Jean III later ruled Commercy.
zh: 萨尔布吕肯-科梅尔西的约翰二世（？—1344）是萨尔布吕肯伯爵兼科梅尔西领主约翰一世与玛奥·达普勒蒙的幼子。他继承科梅尔西城堡，成为科梅尔西“上堡”领主，侄子约翰四世则保有萨尔布吕肯伯国和城里的“下堡”部分。1324年，他与父亲联署颁给科梅尔西城市特许状。1331年4月16日前，他娶布里克奈与沃尼济的女继承人阿历克丝·德·茹安维尔，获得这两处香槟领地；儿子西蒙二世与约翰三世后来相继统治科梅尔西。

en: Johanna of Saarbrücken (died 1374–1376) was a daughter of Simon of Saarbrücken-Commercy and Margaret of Savoy. She married Gerhard VII of Blankenheim, lord of Kasselburg, and was the mother of Frederick of Blankenheim, bishop of Strasbourg and Utrecht.
zh: 约翰娜·冯·萨尔布吕肯（1374至1376年间去世）是西蒙·冯·萨尔布吕肯-科梅尔西与萨伏依的玛格丽特之女，嫁给卡瑟尔堡领主格哈德七世·冯·布兰肯海姆；儿子弗里德里希·冯·布兰肯海姆先后担任斯特拉斯堡与乌得勒支主教。

en: Margaret of Savoy-Vaud (died 7 April 1313), daughter of Louis I, lord of Vaud, and Jeanne de Montfort, married first Jean de Salins, lord of Vignory, and then in 1309 Simon of Saarbrücken-Commercy. She was the mother of Count Johann II of Saarbrücken.
zh: 萨伏依-沃的玛格丽特（？—1313年4月7日）是沃领主路易一世与让娜·德蒙福尔之女，先嫁维尼奥里领主让·德萨兰，1309年改嫁科梅尔西的西蒙，生子约翰二世。

en: Simon IV of Saarbrücken-Commercy (c. 1244–1308) was count of Saarbrücken and lord of Commercy. Son of Simon of Broyes-Commercy and Countess Mathilde of Saarbrücken, he shared in governing the county from 1266 and succeeded his mother in 1274. He bought off his Montfaucon half-brothers' claims and faced the bishop of Metz, who treated Saarbrücken as a lapsed fief; allied with Duke Frederick III of Lorraine, he received St. Wendel as war compensation and in 1277 settled with the bishop, receiving the county as a fief. By his first wife Margaret of Broyes-Commercy he fathered his heir Johann I.
zh: 西蒙四世·冯·萨尔布吕肯-科梅尔西（约1244—1308）是萨尔布吕肯伯爵兼科梅尔西领主。他是布罗耶-科梅尔西的西蒙与萨尔布吕肯女伯爵玛蒂尔德之子，1266年起参与县政，1274年母亲去世后继任伯爵。他用年金打发了蒙福孔异父兄弟的继承要求，又对抗宣称伯国已因绝嗣而收回的梅斯主教：他与洛林公爵腓特烈三世结盟，得到圣文德尔作为战事补偿，并于1277年与主教和解，以受封形式领有伯国。他与第一任妻子布罗耶-科梅尔西的玛格丽特生子继承人约翰一世。

en: Simon of Saarbrücken-Commercy (c. 1284–1325) was the eldest son of Count Johann I of Saarbrücken and Mathilde d'Aspremont, and was marked out as sole heir to both the County of Saarbrücken and the lordship of Commercy. In 1309 he married Margaret of Savoy, daughter of Louis I, lord of Vaud, who bore him a son, Johann II, and several daughters. Simon died before his father in 1325, overturning the planned succession: his younger brother Johann was designated heir to Commercy, while his young son Johann was designated heir to the County of Saarbrücken.
zh: 西蒙·冯·萨尔布吕肯-科梅尔西（约1284—1325）是萨尔布吕肯伯爵约翰一世与玛蒂尔德·达普雷蒙的长子，被定为萨尔布吕肯伯国和科梅尔西领地的唯一继承人。1309年，他迎娶沃领主萨伏依的路易一世之女萨伏依的玛格丽特，生有一子约翰二世及数女。西蒙于1325年先于父亲而死，预定的继承安排随之改变：其弟约翰被定为科梅尔西的继承人，年幼的儿子约翰则被定为萨尔布吕肯伯国的继承人。

en: Shwetaungtet, also called Anawrahta I of Sagaing (1313–1339), ruled Sagaing as a usurper from 1335/36 to 1339. His father Tarabya, a commoner stepson of King Thihathu of Pinya, had followed Saw Yun's revolt of 1315 and took over Sagaing after Saw Yun died in 1327, as king or regent for Saw Yun's infant sons. Shwetaungtet, nearly ten years older than the eldest of them, had the weaker claim but moved before they grew up: in 1335/36 he staged a palace coup and imprisoned his father. He could not get hold of the boys. Queen Saw Hnaung and the minister Nanda Pakyan hid them at Mindon in Pinya, paying the minister to keep silent. In 1339 Shwetaungtet found them and led an expedition to bring them back, but soon afterwards his father's loyalists killed him at the palace. Nanda Pakyan won the fighting that followed, executed Tarabya and placed Kyaswa on the throne.
zh: 瑞当代，又称阿奴律陀一世（1313—1339），1335/36至1339年以篡位者的身份统治实皆。他的父亲答里必牙（德勒帕耶基）是彬牙国王梯诃都的平民继子，曾追随苏云在1315年起事；1327年苏云去世后，答里必牙执掌实皆，以国王（一说摄政）的身份代管苏云的幼子们。瑞当代比苏云的长子年长近十岁，继承权却更弱，于是趁他们尚未成年下手：1335/36年发动宫廷政变，囚禁父王。可是他抓不到那几个孩子——绍南王后与首相南达巴坚把他们藏在彬牙境内的敏东，并不断贿赂这位首相，要他守口如瓶。1339年，瑞当代查出下落，率军前往带回诸王子，不久便在宫中被父王的党羽杀死。南达巴坚在随后的战斗中获胜，处死德勒帕耶基，扶立加苏瓦为王。

en: Kyaswa (1323–1349), the eldest son of Sagaing's founder Saw Yun, was king from 1339 to 1349. He was not yet four when his father died in 1327 and his uncle Tarabya I took the throne. After Tarabya's son Shwetaungtet seized power in 1335/36, Kyaswa was hidden for three years at Mindon in Pinya. In 1339 Chief Minister Nanda Pakyan crushed the coups, executed Tarabya and crowned the sixteen-year-old, then went on running the government himself. The reign was largely peaceful. Kyaswa kept the peace with Pinya, Sagaing's rival across the river, by marrying Saw Pa Oh, daughter of King Uzana I, and it held even after Uzana lost his throne. An inscription of 1343 or 1344 at the Thamanda Pagoda records the land and monastery he gave with his two queens and tells of his exile. He died around March 1349 without a male heir, and his brother succeeded him.
zh: 加苏瓦（1323—1349）是实皆开国君主苏云的长子，1339年至1349年在位。1327年父亲去世时他还不满四岁，叔父德勒帕耶基继位。1335/36年德勒帕耶基之子瑞当代篡位，加苏瓦被送到彬牙境内的敏东躲藏了三年。1339年，首相南达巴坚平定政变、处死德勒帕耶基，拥立十六岁的加苏瓦为王，朝政仍由他自己主持。这一朝大体太平：加苏瓦迎娶彬牙国王乌兹那一世之女绍巴奥，稳住了与江对岸宿敌彬牙的关系，即便乌兹那后来失位，和平仍然维持。1343或1344年，他与两位王后在塔曼达佛塔立碑，记下所捐的土地和寺院，也讲述了他的流亡经历。1349年3月前后，加苏瓦去世，没有留下男嗣，王位传给了他的弟弟。

en: Nawrahta Minye (1326–1349), also called Anawrahta II, was king of Sagaing for just over seven months in 1349. The third child of King Saw Yun and Queen Saw Hnaung, he was an infant when his father died. In 1336 his cousin Shwetaungtet seized the throne, and he spent three years exiled at Mindon in Pinya before the family returned in 1339. Chief Minister Nanda Pakyan then crowned his brother Kyaswa and ran the government, leaving Minye at most a nominal role. He came to the throne in 1349, when Kyaswa died without a male heir, taking the reign name Anawrahta. He found a white elephant and styled himself Hsinbyushin, Lord of the White Elephant. He strained Kyaswa's peace with Pinya by sheltering Nawrahta, governor of Pinle, who was fleeing his brother King Kyawswa I of Pinya, though no war followed. He died shortly after 8 November 1349, childless, and his younger brother Tarabya II succeeded him.
zh: 瑙亚塔明耶（1326—1349），又称阿奴律陀二世，1349年为实皆国王，在位仅七个多月。他是国王苏云与王后绍南的第三个孩子，幼年丧父。1336年堂兄瑞当代篡位，他在彬牙的敏东流亡三年，1339年随家人返回实皆。首相南达巴坚随即拥立他的兄长加苏瓦为王并掌理国政，明耶至多只有名义上的角色。1349年加苏瓦去世，没有男嗣，他继位为王，取王号阿奴律陀。他得到一头白象，遂自称辛标信，意为白象王。宾里总督瑙亚塔出逃兄长彬牙国王觉苏瓦一世，他予以庇护，使加苏瓦留下的对彬牙和平关系趋于紧张，不过并未开战。1349年11月8日后不久，他去世，没有子嗣，由弟弟德勒帕耶艾继位。

en: Saw Hnaung (1296–?), also called Kodawgyi, was the chief queen consort of the Sagaing kingdom in Upper Burma. A daughter of King Kyawswa of Pagan and Queen Saw Soe, she was chief queen to two kings of Sagaing, Saw Yun and Tarabya I. Her sons Kyaswa, Nawrahta Minye and Tarabya II each reigned as king of Sagaing, while her daughter Soe Min Kodawgyi became the mother of Thado Minbya, founder of the Ava kingdom. Saw Hnaung was also a paternal aunt of King Swa Saw Ke of Ava.
zh: 绍南（1296—？），又称科道基，是上缅甸实皆王国的首席王后。她是蒲甘国王觉苏瓦与王后绍索之女，先后为实皆两位国王苏云与答里必牙一世的首席王后。她的三个儿子迦苴、那罗多弥夷与答里必牙二世都做过实皆国王，女儿索敏则是阿瓦王国建立者他拖弥婆耶的生母。绍南也是阿瓦国王斯伐修寄的姑母。

en: Saw Yun (c. 1299–5 February 1327) was the founder of the Sagaing kingdom in Upper Burma. The eldest son of King Thihathu of Myinsaing–Pinya and Queen Yadanabon, he was raised at Pinle and moved to Pinya in 1313. In 1315, angry that his father named his adopted stepbrother Uzana I heir, he crossed the Irrawaddy to build Sagaing, where he repelled two Pinya expeditions by 1317. He remained nominally loyal to his father while ruling Sagaing in practice. In 1318 he formed the thousand-strong Sagaing Htaungthin cavalry regiment. After Thihathu's death in 1325 the two kingdoms split, and Saw Yun died in February 1327; his three sons all ruled Sagaing.
zh: 苏云（约1299—1327年2月5日）是缅甸上缅甸实皆王国的开创者。他是敏象—彬牙国王底哈都与王后雅达娜邦的长子，在彬莱长大，1313年迁居彬牙。父亲立养子、他的继兄乌兹那为王储，苏云心怀不满，于1315年渡过伊洛瓦底江前往实皆筑城，至1317年两次击退彬牙的讨伐。他名义上仍效忠父亲，实际上统治着实皆。1318年他组建号称千人的“实皆腾廷”骑兵团。1325年底哈都死后，实皆与彬牙正式分裂，他于1327年2月去世；他的三个儿子后来都登上了实皆王位。

en: Soe Min Kodawgyi (born 1322 or earlier) was the eldest daughter of Saw Yun, founder of Sagaing, and the mother of Thado Minbya, the future founder of Ava. In 1335–1336 she fled Sagaing with her husband Thado Hsinhtein, governor of Tagaung, when her half-cousin Shwetaungtet seized the throne. They spent three years at Mindon inside Pinya and returned in 1339, when her brother Kyaswa became king. In 1351 the couple negotiated a truce with Kyawswa II of Pinya. In February 1352 her brother Tarabya II died heirless and her husband was also dead, so she became kingmaker: she married the court official Minbyauk Thihapate, who took the throne, and she became chief queen. As Maw Shan raiders struck Sagaing in the 1350s she twice led missions to Pinya seeking an alliance, but Pinya withdrew after a devastating Shan raid in 1358–1359. In 1364 Thado Minbya overthrew her husband.
zh: 索敏（1322年或更早出生）是实皆开国君主苏云的长女，也是日后阿瓦王国的建立者德多明帕耶之母。1335至1336年间，堂兄瑞当代篡位，她与丈夫太公城总督德多信滕逃离实皆，在彬牙境内的敏东住了三年，1339年弟弟加苏瓦即位后返回。1351年，夫妇二人与彬牙的觉苏瓦艾议订停战协定。1352年2月，弟弟德勒帕耶艾死后无嗣，她的丈夫也已去世，她成了拥立新王的人：下嫁朝臣明波梯诃波帝，使其登基，自己成为王后。1350年代，猛卯的掸人不断袭扰实皆，她两次率使团赴彬牙寻求结盟；1358至1359年掸人一次重创之后，彬牙退出了这一同盟。1364年，德多明帕耶推翻了她的丈夫。

en: Tarabya II (1327–1352), the youngest son of Sagaing's founder Saw Yun, was born eight months after his father's death. After his cousin Shwetaungtet's coup in 1336 he spent three years in exile at Mindon in Pinya. When the family returned in 1339, Chief Minister Nanda Pakyan crowned his brother Kyaswa and ran the state, and Tarabya had only a nominal role. Kyaswa and Nawrahta Minye both died within eight months in 1349, and Tarabya took the throne late that year. He inherited Nawrahta's white elephant and styled himself Hsinbyushin, Lord of the White Elephant. Relations with Pinya were tense: in 1351 he sheltered Saw Ke, the governor of Yamethin who had fled Kyawswa II. But he tried to cool matters by sending his sister Soe Min and her husband Thado Hsinhtein to negotiate a truce with Kyawswa II, and the peace held. He died in February 1352, and Soe Min's second husband Thihapate succeeded him.
zh: 德勒帕耶艾（1327—1352）是实皆开国君主苏云的幼子，生于父亲去世八个月后。1336年堂兄瑞当代篡位，他在彬牙的敏东流亡三年。1339年一家返回后，首相南达巴坚拥立他的兄长加苏瓦为王并主持国政，德勒帕耶艾只有名义上的角色。1349年，加苏瓦与瑙亚塔明耶在八个月内相继去世，他在当年晚些时候登基，继承了瑙亚塔明耶的白象，自称辛标信，意为白象王。当时与彬牙的关系紧张：1351年，央米丁总督斯伐修寄逃离彬牙的觉苏瓦艾，他予以庇护。但他设法缓和局势，派王姐索敏与姐夫德多信滕赴彬牙同觉苏瓦艾和谈，和平得以维持。1352年2月他去世，继位者是索敏的第二任丈夫梯诃波帝。

en: Azalaïs of Montferrat (1150–1232) was Marchioness of Saluzzo and later its regent. Daughter of William V of Montferrat and Judith of Babenberg, she married Marquis Manfred II of Saluzzo before 1182; her brothers included Boniface of Montferrat and Conrad, king of Jerusalem. Like Boniface she patronised troubadours, including Peire Vidal, and around 1192 founded the church of San Lorenzo. After her son Boniface died in 1212 and her husband in 1215, she ruled Saluzzo as regent for her grandson Manfred III until 1218, making treaties with Savoy and Asti. In 1216 she arranged a marriage between her granddaughter Agnes and a son of Thomas I of Savoy, though it never took place. In 1224 she endowed the convent of Rifreddo. She died in 1232 and was buried at Staffarda Abbey.
zh: 蒙费拉托的阿拉西亚（1150—1232）是萨卢佐侯爵夫人，后为萨卢佐摄政。她是蒙费拉托侯爵威廉五世与尤蒂特·冯·巴本贝格之女，1182年前嫁给萨卢佐侯爵曼弗雷德二世，兄弟中有蒙费拉托的博尼法乔和耶路撒冷国王科拉多。她和博尼法乔一样庇护游吟诗人，佩尔·维达尔曾在诗中称颂她；约1192年她修建圣洛伦佐教堂。儿子博尼法乔于1212年、丈夫于1215年先后去世，她为孙子曼弗雷德三世摄政，统治萨卢佐至1218年，与萨伏依和阿斯蒂订约。1216年，她为孙女阿涅丝与萨伏依的托马斯一世之子安排婚事，但婚姻最终未能缔结。1224年，她资助里弗雷多女修院。1232年她去世，葬于斯塔法尔达修道院。

en: Azonne of Saluzzo (c. 1336–1426) was third son of Marquess Thomas II of Saluzzo and Ricciarda Visconti, daughter of Milanese lord Galeazzo I. While his brother Frederick II inherited the marquisate, Azonne held the lordships of Monasterolo, Oncino, Paesana, Crissolo, Sanfront and Castellar.
