Dogged by debts, he repeatedly sold or pledged parts of his duchy; in 1337 his brothers Henry IV and Conrad I bought Ścinawa from him, while he retained sovereignty for life. He married Margaret of Pomerania, widow of the lord of Rostock, and died childless by May 1365.
zh: 希齐纳瓦的扬（约1298—1365年5月19日以前）是西里西亚皮亚斯特家族成员，格沃古夫公爵亨里克三世的第四子。父亲死后他与诸兄共同统治，1317年分得希齐纳瓦、古拉和卢宾，成为独立公爵。1329年，他在弗罗茨瓦夫向波希米亚国王约翰行臣服礼。由于债务缠身，他不断变卖、抵押公国领地；1337年，兄长亨里克四世和康拉德一世买下希齐纳瓦，他终身保留统治权。他娶波美拉尼亚的玛格丽特，即罗斯托克领主的遗孀，1365年5月前去世，没有子嗣。

en: Margaret of Pomerania (Polish Małgorzata, born by 1287, died 1334) was Lady of Rostock and later Duchess of Ścinawa, and the daughter of Bogislaw IV, Duke of Pomerania-Wolgast, and Margaret of Rügen. In 1299 she married Nicholas I the Child, Lord of Rostock, of the House of Mecklenburg; their daughter Elisabeth married Count Christian of Oldenburg-Delmenhorst in 1317. Widowed when Nicholas died in 1314, she later married John, the Silesian Piast Duke of Ścinawa and a son of Henry III of Głogów, a childless union that tied her to the Głogów Piasts. She died shortly before 25 July 1334.
zh: 波美拉尼亚的玛格丽特（波兰语名玛乌戈热塔，1287年或之前生，1334年卒）是罗斯托克领主夫人，后来成为希齐纳瓦公爵夫人，也是波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特公爵波吉斯瓦夫四世与吕根的玛格丽特之女。1299年，她嫁给梅克伦堡家族的罗斯托克领主尼古拉一世，绰号“孩子”；两人之女伊丽莎白于1317年嫁给奥尔登堡-德尔门霍斯特伯爵克里斯蒂安。1314年尼古拉去世，她后来改嫁西里西亚皮亚斯特王公、格沃古夫的亨里克三世之子希齐纳瓦公爵扬，这段婚姻没有子嗣，也使她与格沃古夫皮亚斯特家族联姻。她于1334年7月25日前不久去世。

en: Jean II de Roussillon was a Benedictine monk from the noble de Roussillon family of the Dauphiné, who ruled as abbot of Saint-Claude in the Jura from 1328 to 1348, when he was succeeded by Guillaume de Beauregard.
zh: 让二世·德·鲁西永是本笃会修士，出身多菲内的鲁西永贵族家族，1328至1348年任汝拉山区圣克洛德修道院院长，其后由纪尧姆·德·博勒加尔继任。

en: Áed mac Cináeda (Anglicized Hugh, c. 840–878), son of Kenneth MacAlpin, became king of the Picts in 877 after the death of his brother Causantín. A later Gaelic poem, the Duan Albanach, gave him the epithet Fhionnscothach, ‘of the White Flowers’. He ruled barely a year: the Chronicle of the Kings of Alba says he was killed at a place named Nrurim, while the Annals of Ulster record the king of the Picts slain by kinsmen in 878. Later chroniclers blamed his successor Giric and placed his grave at Inverurie. His son Causantín reigned as Constantine II from 900.
zh: 艾德·麦克·肯尼思（约840—878）是肯尼思·麦卡尔平之子，877年其兄康斯坦丁一世死后即位为皮克特人国王。后世的盖尔语诗篇给他“白花”的绰号。他在位仅一年：《阿尔巴国王编年史》说他在名为努鲁林的地方被杀，《阿尔斯特编年史》则记载这位皮克特人国王于878年被亲属所害。后世编年史家称凶手是他的继任者吉里克，并说他葬于因弗鲁里。其子康斯坦丁于900年即位，即康斯坦丁二世。

en: Agnes de Beaumont was a daughter of Henry de Beaumont, Earl of Buchan, and Alice Comyn. Genealogies record her marriage to Thomas de Lucy, second Baron Lucy, a northern English baron who fought at the Battle of Neville's Cross in 1346 and died in 1365.
zh: 阿格尼丝·德·博蒙是巴肯伯爵亨利·德·博蒙与艾丽斯·科明之女。谱系记载她嫁给第二代露西男爵托马斯·德·露西；后者是英格兰北方贵族，曾参加1346年的内维尔十字战役，卒于1365年。

en: Alan fitz Walter (c. 1140–1204) succeeded his father Walter fitz Alan in 1178 as hereditary High Steward of Scotland, serving William the Lion as steward until his death. Under him the family acquired the Isle of Bute, and Rothesay Castle on the island was possibly built on his initiative. Later accounts say he accompanied Richard the Lionheart on the Third Crusade and returned to Scotland in 1191. A patron of the Knights Templar, he expanded the order's Scottish holdings. He died in 1204 and was buried at Paisley Abbey.
zh: 艾伦·菲茨沃尔特（约1140—1204）于1178年继承父亲沃尔特·菲茨阿兰，成为世袭苏格兰王室总务官，侍奉“狮王”威廉，直至去世。他任内家族取得比特岛，岛上的罗思西城堡可能由他主持修建。后世记载称他曾随“狮心王”理查参加第三次十字军东征，1191年返回苏格兰。他庇护圣殿骑士团，扩展了骑士团在苏格兰的产业，于1204年去世，葬在佩斯利修道院。

en: Alexander Comyn, second Earl of Buchan (c. 1217–1289), was a leading Scoto-Norman magnate and chief counsellor of King Alexander III. The son of William Comyn and Marjory, heiress of the mormaers of Buchan, he served as Justiciar of Scotia from 1258 and Constable of Scotland from 1275. In 1284 he joined the nobles who recognised Margaret of Norway as heir to the throne, and after Alexander III's death he was one of the Guardians of Scotland from 1286 until his death in 1289. By his wife Elizabeth de Quincy he left many children, including his heir John.
zh: 第二代巴肯伯爵亚历山大·科明（约1217—1289）是重要的苏格兰—诺曼大贵族，国王亚历山大三世的首席顾问。他是威廉·科明与巴肯莫尔麦尔的女继承人玛乔丽之子，1258年起任苏格兰司法官，1275年起任苏格兰统帅。1284年，他与众贵族共同承认挪威的玛格丽特为王位继承人；亚历山大三世去世后，他于1286年成为苏格兰守护者之一，直至1289年去世。他与妻子伊丽莎白·德·昆西生有众多子女，继承人是其子约翰。

en: Alexander Comyn (c. 1258–1308) was a younger son of Alexander Comyn, second Earl of Buchan. While the earldom passed to his elder brother John, he served as sheriff of Aberdeen from 1297 to 1304, during the First War of Scottish Independence, and campaigned with the Hebridean leader Lachlann Mac Ruaidhrí. By his wife Joanna Latimer he left two daughters, Alice and Margaret. He died in 1308, shortly before his childless brother John, and the title to the earldom of Buchan passed to his daughters; Alice was the wife of Henry de Beaumont.
zh: 亚历山大·科明（约1258—1308）是第二代巴肯伯爵亚历山大·科明年纪较小的儿子。伯爵之位由其兄约翰继承，他本人则在1297—1304年担任阿伯丁郡长。第一次苏格兰独立战争期间，他曾与赫布里底首领拉克伦·麦克·鲁艾德里联合作战。他与妻子乔安娜·拉蒂默生有爱丽丝、玛格丽特两个女儿。他于1308年去世，不久后无嗣的兄长约翰也死去；巴肯伯爵的爵位权利传给他的两个女儿，其中爱丽丝嫁给了亨利·德·博蒙特。

en: Alexander Bruce, Earl of Carrick (d. 19 July 1333), was an illegitimate son of Edward Bruce, Earl of Carrick, younger brother of King Robert I. During Edward Balliol's invasion of Scotland he fought for the Bruce loyalists at Dupplin Moor in 1332, then briefly defected to Balliol and was captured and nearly killed at Annan before rejoining the crown. Married to Eleanor Douglas, daughter of the guardian Sir Archibald Douglas, he fell fighting for the young King David II at the Battle of Halidon Hill in 1333.
zh: 亚历山大·布鲁斯，卡里克伯爵（1333年7月19日卒），是国王罗伯特一世之弟、卡里克伯爵爱德华·布鲁斯的私生子。爱德华·巴里奥入侵苏格兰期间，他先于1332年在杜普林沼地为布鲁斯一方作战，随后倒向巴里奥，在安南被俘、险些被杀，之后又重归王党。他娶苏格兰摄政阿奇博尔德·道格拉斯爵士之女埃莉诺·道格拉斯为妻，1333年在哈利登山之战中为年幼的国王大卫二世战死。

en: Alexander I, Alaxandair mac Maíl Coluim, called the Fierce (c. 1078–1124), was a son of Malcolm III and Saint Margaret and king of Scotland from 1107, when he succeeded his brother Edgar. He married Sybilla of Normandy, an illegitimate daughter of Henry I of England, but the marriage was childless. After Moray rebels attacked his court at Invergowrie, he chased and defeated them at Stockford in Ross, earning his nickname. He founded the Augustinian priory at Scone around 1115 and Inchcolm Abbey. He died at Stirling on 23 April 1124 and was succeeded by his brother David I.
zh: 亚历山大一世，盖尔语名作亚历山大·麦克马尔科姆，身后绰号“猛烈的”（约1078—1124），是马尔科姆三世与圣玛格丽特之子，1107年继承兄长埃德加的王位。他娶英格兰国王亨利一世的私生女西比拉为妻，两人没有子女。马里的叛乱者袭击他在因弗高里的驻跸后，他挥军北上追击，在罗斯的斯托克福德将其击败，“猛烈的”绰号由此而来。他约1115年在斯昆建立奥古斯丁会修道院，并兴建英奇科姆修道院。1124年4月23日他在斯特灵去世，由弟弟大卫一世继位。

en: Alexander II (1198–1249), son of William the Lion and Ermengarde de Beaumont, succeeded his father in 1214 aged sixteen. In the First Barons’ War he supported John’s rebel barons and campaigned in northern England, then made peace with Henry III and married Henry’s sister Joan in 1221. He crushed the MacWilliam risings in the north and subdued Galloway, while the Treaty of York in 1237 fixed the Anglo-Scottish border much as it remains. After Joan’s death he married Marie de Coucy in 1239, mother of Alexander III. In 1249 he sailed to subdue the Hebrides but died on Kerrera.
zh: 亚历山大二世（1198—1249）是狮子王威廉与博蒙的埃芒加德之子，1214年十六岁时继承父位。第一次诸侯战争期间，他支持反叛约翰王的英格兰诸侯，在英格兰北部作战，随后与亨利三世议和，并于1221年娶亨利之妹琼为妻。他镇压了北方的麦克威廉叛乱，平定加洛韦；1237年的《约克条约》划定了与英格兰的边界，其走向大体沿用至今。琼死后，他于1239年续娶库西的玛丽，即亚历山大三世之母。1249年他出征赫布里底群岛，却在克雷拉岛上去世。

en: Alexander III (1241–1286), son of Alexander II and Marie de Coucy, succeeded in 1249 aged seven, crowned at Scone. In 1251 he married Margaret, daughter of Henry III, but refused homage for Scotland. He claimed the Western Isles from Norway; Haakon IV invaded in 1263, but a storm damaged his ships and the Battle of Largs was indecisive. By the Treaty of Perth in 1266 Scotland gained the Hebrides and Man. When his children died, his granddaughter Margaret, Maid of Norway, was named heir in 1284. He married Yolande of Dreux in 1285 and died in a riding fall at Kinghorn in 1286.
zh: 亚历山大三世（1241—1286）是亚历山大二世与库西的玛丽之子，1249年七岁继位，在斯昆加冕。1251年他娶英格兰国王亨利三世之女玛格丽特为妻，但拒绝为苏格兰行臣服礼。他向挪威索要西部群岛；1263年哈康四世入侵，但风暴损坏了他的舰船，拉格斯之战也未分胜负。1266年的《珀斯条约》使苏格兰取得赫布里底群岛和马恩岛。子女相继去世后，1284年他的外孙女“挪威少女”玛格丽特被承认为继承人。1285年他续娶德勒的约朗德，1286年在金霍恩坠马身亡。

en: Alexander Stewart of Dundonald (c. 1214–1283) succeeded his father as hereditary High Steward of Scotland in 1241. He joined Louis IX of France on the Seventh Crusade, where his brother John was killed at Damietta in 1249. He appears to have made a pilgrimage to Santiago de Compostela and named his heir James after the saint. In 1255 he served as a regent during the minority of Alexander III. In October 1263 he commanded the Scottish army at Largs, repelling the invasion of Haakon IV of Norway. Under him the Stewarts gained the Cowal peninsula and Dunoon Castle. He died in 1283.
zh: 邓唐纳德的亚历山大·斯图亚特（约1214—1283）于1241年继承父职，成为世袭苏格兰王室总务官。他随法兰西国王路易九世参加第七次十字军东征，弟弟约翰于1249年在埃及达米埃塔阵亡。他似乎曾前往圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉朝圣，并以这位圣徒之名为继承人取名詹姆斯。1255年亚历山大三世年幼，他出任摄政之一。1263年10月，他在拉格斯战役中指挥苏格兰军队，击退挪威国王哈康四世的入侵。他任内斯图亚特家族取得考沃尔半岛和达农城堡，于1283年去世。

en: Alice de Beaumont was a daughter of Henry de Beaumont, Earl of Buchan, who campaigned in Scotland for Edward Balliol, and his wife Alice Comyn, heiress of the earldom of Buchan.
zh: 艾丽斯·德·博蒙是巴肯伯爵亨利·德·博蒙与妻子艾丽斯·科明之女；其父曾在苏格兰为爱德华·巴利奥尔作战，其母是巴肯伯爵领的女继承人。

en: Alice Comyn (1289–1349) was the eldest daughter of Alexander Comyn, Sheriff of Aberdeen, and niece and heiress of John Comyn, Earl of Buchan. Shortly before 14 July 1310 she married the English baron Henry de Beaumont, who claimed the earldom in her right; his long struggle to secure Buchan helped cause the Second War of Scottish Independence. She attended Queen Isabella of France's court. Through her daughter Isabel, wife of Henry of Grosmont, Duke of Lancaster, she was great-grandmother of Henry IV. She died on 3 July 1349, when the Comyn line of Buchan came to an end.
zh: 艾丽斯·科明（1289—1349）是阿伯丁郡长亚历山大·科明的长女，也是巴肯伯爵约翰·科明的侄女和女继承人。1310年7月14日前不久，她嫁给英格兰贵族亨利·德·博蒙，后者以她的权利宣称巴肯伯爵之位；他为夺取巴肯进行的长期争斗，促成了第二次苏格兰独立战争。她曾在法兰西的伊莎贝拉王后宫中侍奉。她的女儿伊莎贝尔嫁给兰开斯特公爵亨利·格罗斯蒙特，因此她是亨利四世的曾外祖母。她于1349年7月3日去世，科明家族在巴肯的世系就此终结。

en: Alpín mac Echdach (died 834) is the king of Dál Riata remembered as father of Kenneth MacAlpin, founder of the ruling line of Alba. He appears only in a tenth-century royal pedigree and later chronicles, which make him the son of Eochaid. John of Fordun's chronicle gives him a three-year reign from 831, spent warring against the Picts who had overrun his kingdom. Later accounts tell of an initial victory near Angus, in which the Pictish king fell, followed by Alpín's defeat in Galloway. They differ on whether he fell in battle or was captured and beheaded afterwards, and on whether he died on 20 July or in August 834. His son Kenneth succeeded him.
zh: 阿尔平·麦克·埃赫达（?—834）是后世谱系中的达尔里阿达国王，被记为阿尔巴王族开创者肯尼思·麦克阿尔平之父。他只见于10世纪的王室谱系和后世编年史，其中称他是埃赫德之子。编年史家福特敦的约翰记载他于831年继位，在位三年，不断与侵占其国土的皮克特人交战。后世记载称他先在安格斯附近取胜，阵斩皮克特国王，继而在加洛韦兵败；他是战死还是战后被俘斩首，以及死于834年7月20日还是8月，记载并不一致。其子肯尼思随后继立。

en: Alyse de Crawford was the first wife of Sir Neil Campbell, one of Robert the Bruce's closest companions, and mother of Sir Colin Og Campbell of Lochawe, to whom Bruce granted the barony of Loch Awe in 1315.
zh: 阿丽丝·德·克劳福德是罗伯特·布鲁斯最亲密的战友之一尼尔·坎贝尔爵士的原配妻子，生子洛豪的科林·奥格·坎贝尔爵士；1315年，布鲁斯将奥湖男爵领地封给她的儿子科林。

en: Sir Andrew Murray (1298–1338) was the posthumous son of Andrew Moray, commander at Stirling Bridge, and held the lordships of Avoch, Petty and Bothwell. When Robert I's regent Thomas Randolph died in 1332 and his successor, the Earl of Mar, was killed at Dupplin Moor nine days after being chosen, Edward Balliol was crowned and David II's supporters named Murray Guardian; they chose him again in 1335. Taken prisoner in 1333 while trying to rescue Ralph Golding, he refused to yield to anyone but the English king and was carried to Durham. Freed in 1334, he forced Henry de Beaumont out of Dundarg Castle by cutting its water pipes. In 1335 he marched north with eleven hundred men to relieve Kildrummy, held by his wife Christina Bruce, sister of Robert I, and killed David of Strathbogie at Culblean. He fell ill besieging Edinburgh Castle, went home to Avoch and died in 1338; he lies at Dunfermline Abbey.
zh: 安德鲁·默里爵士（1298—1338）是斯特灵桥之战指挥官安德鲁·默里的遗腹子，据有阿沃赫、佩蒂和博斯韦尔三处领地。1332年，罗伯特一世指定的摄政托马斯·伦道夫去世，继任的马尔伯爵当选九天后便在达普林荒原战死，爱德华·巴利奥尔随即加冕，大卫二世的支持者推举默里为护国官，1335年再度推举他。1333年他为营救拉尔夫·戈尔丁而被俘，坚称只向英格兰国王投降，被押往达勒姆。1334年获释后，他切断敦达格城堡的水管，迫使亨利·德博蒙特出降。1335年，他率一千一百人北上解救基尔德拉米城堡，守城的是他的妻子、罗伯特一世之妹克里斯蒂娜·布鲁斯；他在库尔布伦杀死了大卫·斯特拉斯博吉。他在围攻爱丁堡城堡时染病，回到阿沃赫，1338年去世，葬于邓弗姆林修道院。

en: Sir Archibald Douglas (before 1298–1333) was the younger son of William le Hardi by Eleanor de Lovaine and half-brother of the Good Sir James, under whom he raided the Bishopric of Durham during the 1327 Weardale campaign. When Edward Balliol invaded with English backing in 1332, Douglas surprised him in the Camisade of Annan night attack on 16 December and drove him back to England. He was appointed Guardian of Scotland in March 1333. In July 1333 he marched to relieve besieged Berwick and was killed leading the uphill assault at the Battle of Halidon Hill on 19 July.
zh: 阿奇博尔德·道格拉斯爵士（1298年前—1333）是“大胆者”威廉与埃莉诺·德·洛万较年幼的儿子、“好爵士”詹姆斯的异母弟，1327年威尔戴尔之役中曾随兄长征掠达勒姆主教区。1332年爱德华·巴里奥在英格兰支持下入侵苏格兰，道格拉斯在12月16日的安嫩夜袭中突袭巴里奥，将其逐回英格兰。1333年3月，他出任苏格兰护国主。1333年7月，他进军救援被围的贝里克，7月19日在哈利顿山之战中率部仰攻时阵亡。

en: Archibald Douglas, called the Grim (c. 1330–1400), illegitimate son of Sir James the Black Douglas, Robert the Bruce's lieutenant who fell on crusade at Teba, was named an heir to the Douglas lands in 1342 and served France. In 1362 he married Joanna de Moravia, heiress of Bothwell, whose estates he took, rebuilding Bothwell Castle. As Lord of Galloway he was the Black Douglases' chief magnate, and after his kinsman James, 2nd Earl, fell at Otterburn without legitimate issue, Archibald inherited as 3rd Earl of Douglas. He died at Threave Castle at Christmas 1400 and was buried at Bothwell.
zh: 阿奇博尔德·道格拉斯，绰号“冷酷者”（约1330—1400），是罗伯特·布鲁斯的爱将“黑爵士”詹姆斯·道格拉斯的私生子，其父在特瓦的十字军征战中战死。1342年他被列为道格拉斯领地的继承人之一，曾效力于法兰西。1362年，他娶博思韦尔女继承人乔安娜·德·莫里为妻，接管其大片地产并重建博思韦尔城堡。作为加洛韦领主，他是黑道格拉斯家族的头号权贵；族人第二代伯爵詹姆斯在奥特本阵亡且没有合法子嗣后，他袭爵成为第三代道格拉斯伯爵。1400年圣诞节，他在思里夫城堡去世，葬于博思韦尔。

en: Beatrice de Beaumont was a daughter of Henry de Beaumont, Earl of Buchan, and Alice Comyn. She married Charles I de Trie, Count of Dammartin, the French lord whose family held Dammartin-en-Goele, northeast of Paris.
zh: 贝娅特丽丝·德·博蒙是巴肯伯爵亨利·德·博蒙与艾丽斯·科明之女，嫁给当马尔坦伯爵夏尔一世·德·特里；特里家族统治着巴黎东北的当马尔坦昂戈埃勒。

en: Agnes Randolph, called Black Agnes for her dark complexion, was the daughter of Thomas Randolph, Earl of Moray, and in 1324 married Patrick, Earl of Dunbar and March. While her husband was away in 1338, she took command of Dunbar Castle and held it against an English army under William Montagu, Earl of Salisbury, from 13 January to 10 June, forcing the besiegers to abandon the blockade during the Second War of Scottish Independence. She died in 1369 and was buried near Mordington.
zh: 阿格内丝·伦道夫因肤色黝黑被称为“黑阿格内丝”，是马里伯爵托马斯·伦道夫之女，1324年嫁给邓巴与马奇伯爵帕特里克。1338年丈夫外出期间，她亲自指挥守卫邓巴城堡，从1月13日到6月10日抵御威廉·蒙塔古（索尔兹伯里伯爵）率领的英军，最终迫使围攻者在第二次苏格兰独立战争期间撤围。她于1369年去世，葬在莫丁顿附近。

en: Christina Bruce (c. 1278–1356/57), sister of King Robert I of Scots, married Sir Christopher Seton in 1301; he was executed by the English in 1306. Captured at Tain after Kildrummy Castle fell, she spent eight years confined in the Gilbertine nunnery at Sixhills in Lincolnshire, and was freed in October 1314 in the exchange for the Earl of Hereford after Bannockburn. In 1326 she married Sir Andrew Murray, Guardian of Scotland. In 1335 she held Kildrummy Castle against David of Strathbogie until Murray's victory at Culblean. She died in 1356 or 1357.
zh: 克里斯蒂娜·布鲁斯（约1278—1356/1357）是苏格兰国王罗伯特一世的妹妹。1301年她嫁给克里斯托弗·西顿爵士，后者于1306年被英格兰人处决。基尔德鲁米城堡陷落后，她在泰恩被俘，关押于林肯郡希克斯希尔的吉尔伯丁修会修女院达八年，1314年10月在班诺克本战役后作为交换赫里福德伯爵的人质获释。1326年，她与苏格兰护国公安德鲁·默里爵士结婚。1335年，她坚守基尔德鲁米城堡抵抗大卫·斯特拉斯博吉，直至默里在库尔布林取胜。她于1356或1357年去世。

en: Sir Colin Og Campbell of Lochawe (died 1340), Cailean Óg in Gaelic, was the eldest son of Sir Neil Campbell and probably Alyse Crawford, and stepson of Mary Bruce, sister of Robert the Bruce. In 1316 the king granted him Lochawe and Ardscotnish as a free barony, in return for troops and a forty-oared galley when required. He campaigned with Bruce in Ireland in 1315–1318 and later supported David II against Edward Balliol; Dunoon Castle may have been taken by his Campbells. By his wife Helena he left a son Archibald, ancestor of the Earls of Argyll.
zh: 洛赫奥的科林·奥格·坎贝尔爵士（盖尔语名卡莱安·奥格，？—1340）是尼尔·坎贝尔爵士的长子，母亲可能是爱丽丝·克劳福德，罗伯特·布鲁斯之妹玛丽·布鲁斯是他的继母。1316年，国王将洛赫奥与阿德斯科特尼什作为自由男爵领地封赐给他，条件是应需要提供军队和一艘四十桨战船。1315至1318年他随布鲁斯远征爱尔兰，后来支持大卫二世对抗爱德华·巴里奥；达农城堡可能就是被他手下的坎贝尔族人夺取。他与妻子海伦娜的儿子阿奇博尔德是历代阿盖尔伯爵的祖先。

en: Causantín mac Cináeda, counted as Constantine I (c. 836–877), was a son of Kenneth MacAlpin who succeeded his uncle Domnall as king of the Picts after Domnall's death on 13 April 862. His reign was dominated by Viking attacks. In 870 Norse leaders Amlaíb and Ímar sacked Dumbarton Rock, stronghold of Alt Clut, and two years later Causantín had its fugitive king Artgal killed. The Chronicle of the Kings of Alba claims he killed Amlaíb in 871 or 872. After a defeat near Dollar in 875, he fell fighting Vikings in Fife in 877, reportedly beheaded, and was buried on Iona.
zh: 康斯坦丁一世（盖尔语名考桑廷·麦克·基纳达，约836—877）是肯尼思·麦卡尔平之子，叔叔唐纳德于862年4月13日去世后，他继任皮克特人国王。他在位时维京人连年进犯：870年，诺斯首领奥拉夫与伊瓦尔攻陷不列颠人王国阿尔特克鲁德的要塞邓巴顿岩，两年后康斯坦丁又主使杀死了逃亡的阿尔特克鲁德国王阿特加尔。《阿尔巴国王编年史》称他在871或872年杀死奥拉夫。875年军队在多勒附近战败后，他于877年在法夫抗击维京人时被杀，传为斩首，葬于艾奥纳岛。

en: Causantín mac Áeda, anglicised Constantine II (died 952), son of Áed and grandson of Kenneth MacAlpin, ruled Alba from 900 to 943, the longest reign of any early Scottish king. He spent it containing the Uí Ímair Vikings and the ambitions of Wessex. After Æthelstan invaded Alba in 934, he allied with Olaf Guthfrithson of Dublin and Owain of Strathclyde, but was defeated at Brunanburh in 937, where his son Cellach fell. In 943 he abdicated to the Culdee monastery at St Andrews and died there in 952. His reign saw Pictland remade as the Gaelic kingdom of Alba.
zh: 康斯坦丁二世（盖尔语名考桑廷·麦克·艾德，952年卒）是艾德之子、肯尼思·麦卡尔平之孙，900—943年为阿尔巴国王，在位四十三年，为早期苏格兰诸王中最长。他一生主要应对伊瓦尔后裔维京人与威塞克斯的扩张。934年埃塞尔斯坦入侵阿尔巴后，他与都柏林国王奥拉夫·古斯弗里森、斯特拉斯克莱德国王欧文结盟，却在937年的布鲁南博尔之战中战败，其子凯莱赫战死。943年他退位隐居圣安德鲁斯的库迪斯派修道院，952年卒于该地。在他治下，皮克特兰转变为盖尔人的阿尔巴王国。

en: Causantín mac Cuiléin, anglicised as Constantine III and called Constantine the Bald, was a son of King Cuilén and ruled the kingdom of Alba from 995 to 997. Fourteenth-century chronicler John of Fordun portrays him as conspiring against Kenneth II, who was killed at Fettercairn in 995, after which Constantine seized the crown. Fordun describes his reign as a struggle with Kenneth II's son Malcolm and Malcolm's uncle Kenneth. In 997 he was killed in battle at Rathinveramon, the fortress at the mouth of the River Almond near Perth, and Kenneth III succeeded him.
zh: 康斯坦丁三世，盖尔语原名考桑坦·麦克库伦，绰号“秃头王”，是国王库伦之子，于995年至997年统治阿尔巴王国。14世纪编年史家福特安的约翰记载，他参与了反对肯尼思二世的阴谋——肯尼思二世于995年在费特凯恩遇害，康斯坦丁随即夺取王位。福特安记载，他在位期间与肯尼思二世之子马尔科姆及其叔父肯尼思争斗。997年，他在拉辛维拉蒙战死，此地是珀斯附近阿尔蒙河河口的要塞，肯尼思三世随后继位。

en: Cuilén mac Ilduilb, anglicised Colin (died 971), son of Indulf and nicknamed An Fionn, ‘the White’, ruled Alba from 967. After challenging Dub he was defeated in 965, but Dub was expelled and killed in 967. In 971 he and his brother Eochaid were slain by Britons of Strathclyde; the killer was Rhydderch ap Dyfnwal, whose daughter the king had abducted and raped, probably a son of King Dyfnwal of Strathclyde. Cuilén was buried at St Andrews or Iona. Kenneth II succeeded him and raided Strathclyde in revenge, and Cuilén's son later reigned as Constantine III.
zh: 科林（盖尔语名奎伦·麦克·伊尔杜尔布，？—971）是英多尔夫之子，绰号“白人”，967年起为阿尔巴国王。他曾挑战杜夫，965年战败，但杜夫于967年被逐杀。971年，他与弟弟奥凯德被斯特拉斯克莱德的不列颠人杀害；凶手是里德赫，科林此前掳走并奸污了他的女儿，里德赫可能是斯特拉斯克莱德国王多姆纳尔之子。科林葬于圣安德鲁斯，一说艾奥纳岛。肯尼思二世继位后袭掠斯特拉斯克莱德以为报复，科林之子后来即位，即康斯坦丁三世。

en: David I (c. 1084–1153), youngest son of Malcolm III and Saint Margaret, entered the court of Henry I as a young man and held Cumbrian lands before succeeding his brother Alexander I as king of Scots in 1124. He spent a decade subduing rivals such as Óengus of Moray. Backing his niece Matilda against Stephen, he invaded England, was defeated at the Battle of the Standard in 1138, yet secured Northumberland and Cumbria. His reign brought the Davidian Revolution of burghs, monasteries, feudal tenure and Anglo-Norman settlers. He died at Carlisle in 1153, venerated as a saint.
zh: 戴维一世（约1084—1153）是马尔科姆三世与圣玛格丽特的幼子，青年时进入英格兰国王亨利一世的宫廷，领有坎伯兰一带的土地，1124年继兄长亚历山大一世之后成为苏格兰国王。他用了约十年时间平定莫里的安格斯等对手。他支持外甥女玛蒂尔达皇后对抗斯蒂芬，进军英格兰，1138年在军旗之战中战败，却仍控制了诺森伯兰和坎布里亚。他统治下的“戴维革命”为苏格兰带来了自治市镇、修道院、封建制度和盎格鲁—诺曼移民。1153年他卒于卡莱尔，被尊为天主教圣人。

en: David II (5 March 1324 – 22 February 1371), son of Robert the Bruce, became king of Scots in 1329 and was crowned at Scone in November 1331, the first anointed Scottish king. Married in 1328 to Joan of the Tower, daughter of Edward II, he fled to France after Halidon Hill in 1333 and returned only in 1341. Captured invading England at Neville's Cross in 1346, he was held eleven years until the 1357 Treaty of Berwick fixed his ransom at one hundred thousand merks. The last male Bruce, he died childless; his nephew Robert II succeeded.
zh: 大卫二世（1324年3月5日—1371年2月22日）是罗伯特·布鲁斯之子，1329年继位为苏格兰国王，1331年11月在斯昆加冕，是第一位受涂油礼的苏格兰国王。1328年，他娶英格兰国王爱德华二世之女塔的琼为妻。1333年哈利顿山战役后，他流亡法国，1341年才回国。1346年他入侵英格兰，在内维尔十字战役中被俘，囚禁十一年，直至1357年《贝里克条约》定下10万马克赎金。他是布鲁斯家族最后一位男性，无嗣而终，外甥罗伯特二世继位。

en: Sir David II Strathbogie (died 28 December 1326) was Earl of Atholl, the son of Earl John Strathbogie and Marjory, daughter of the Earl of Mar. A prisoner in England in 1300, he succeeded his father in 1306 and recovered the Atholl estates in 1307. That year he rebelled against Robert the Bruce and was banished, forfeiting his Scottish lands. He received three Norfolk manors in compensation and was granted the barony of Chilham in Kent in 1321. Serving the English crown, he became warden of Northumberland in 1322, sat in the English parliament as Lord Strathbogie, and commanded English troops in Gascony in 1325.
zh: 大卫·斯特拉斯博吉爵士（1326年12月28日卒）是阿索尔伯爵，为阿索尔伯爵约翰·斯特拉斯博吉与马尔伯爵之女马乔里之子。他于1300年被囚于英格兰，1306年承袭父位，1307年收回阿索尔地产。同年他起兵反叛罗伯特·布鲁斯，遭放逐并被没收苏格兰领地。他获得诺福克的三座庄园作为补偿，1321年又获封肯特的奇勒姆男爵领。他效力英格兰王室，1322年出任诺森伯兰长官，以斯特拉斯博吉勋爵身份出席英格兰议会，并于1325年统率英军驻守加斯科涅。

en: David III Strathbogie (1309–1335) was the son of David II Strathbogie, Earl of Atholl, whose title was forfeited after he defected to England. In 1327 David served with Edward III on the Weardale campaign in Scotland. He married Katherine, daughter of Henry de Beaumont, and in 1332 joined the disinherited lords who backed Edward Balliol. He fought at Dupplin Moor, where Balliol restored him as Earl of Atholl, and at Halidon Hill in 1333. He changed sides twice during the wars that followed, returning to Balliol in 1335. He besieged Kildrummy Castle and on 30 November 1335 was killed at Culblean fighting the guardian Andrew Murray's army. His son David IV never reclaimed Atholl.
zh: 大卫三世·斯特拉斯博吉（1309—1335）是阿索尔伯爵大卫二世·斯特拉斯博吉之子；其父叛投英格兰后，伯爵头衔被没收。1327年，大卫随爱德华三世参加在苏格兰的威尔代尔战役。他娶亨利·德博蒙特之女凯瑟琳，1332年加入支持爱德华·巴里奥的“被剥夺者”贵族，在杜普林沼泽作战，巴里奥恢复了他的阿索尔伯爵头衔；1333年又参加哈利顿山战役。此后的战争中他两度改换阵营，1335年重新投归巴里奥。他围攻基尔德拉米城堡，1335年11月30日在库尔布伦与苏格兰护国官安德鲁·默里的军队交战阵亡，其子大卫四世再未收回阿索尔。

en: David IV Strathbogie (c. 1332–1369) was an Anglo-Scottish noble who inherited the barony of Strabolgi and the forfeited, titular earldom of Atholl as a small child, after his father David III was killed fighting for Edward Balliol at the Battle of Culblean in November 1335. Before 1361 he married Elizabeth Ferrers, daughter of Henry Ferrers, 2nd Baron Ferrers of Groby, and he was summoned among the English barons. He died on 10 October 1369 leaving only two daughters, Philippa and Elizabeth, so his barony fell into abeyance and his estates were divided between them.
zh: 大卫四世·斯特拉斯博吉（约1332—1369）是盎格鲁-苏格兰贵族。1335年11月，他的父亲大卫三世为爱德华·巴利奥尔作战，在库尔布林战役中阵亡，他幼年便继承斯特拉斯博吉男爵爵位以及被没收的名义阿索尔伯爵头衔。1361年前，他娶第二代格罗比的费勒斯男爵亨利·费勒斯之女伊丽莎白·费勒斯，并曾作为男爵被召入英格兰议会。1369年10月10日去世，只留下菲莉帕和伊丽莎白两个女儿，男爵爵位因而中止，地产由两女平分。

en: Donald I, Domnall mac Ailpín (812–862), followed his brother Kenneth MacAlpin as king of the Picts in 858 and ruled for four years. The Chronicle of the Kings of Alba records that in his reign the Gaels and their king established the rights and laws of the kingdom, the laws of Áed, at Forteviot. One later chronicle claims he was assassinated at Scone, while medieval verse says he died of disease. He died on 13 April 862, was buried on Iona, and the kingship passed to his nephew Constantine, son of Kenneth.
zh: 唐纳德一世（812—862），本名多姆纳尔·麦克·亚尔宾，858年继兄长肯尼思·麦克阿尔平之后成为皮克特人的国王，在位四年。《阿尔巴国王编年史》记载，他在位时盖尔人与其国王在福泰维奥订立王国的权利与法律，即“艾德之法”。后世一部编年史称他在斯昆遇刺，中世纪的预言诗则说他病逝。他于862年4月13日去世，葬在爱奥那岛，王位传给侄子、肯尼思之子君士坦丁。

en: Domnall mac Causantín, anglicized Donald II (c. 862–900), son of Constantine I, took power in 889 after the fall of Giric, who had killed his uncle Áed; the Prophecy of Berchán nicknamed him Dásachtach, ‘the Madman’. He spent his reign fighting Vikings. The Chronicle of the Kings of Alba records a victory over the Danes at Innisibsolian, then his death at Norse hands when Dunnottar was sacked in 900. Irish annals style him king of Alba, not king of the Picts. He was buried on Iona, succeeded by his cousin Constantine II; his son later reigned as Malcolm I.
zh: 唐纳德二世（盖尔语名多姆纳尔·麦克·考桑廷，约862—900）是康斯坦丁一世之子，889年吉里克倒台后取得王位——吉里克此前杀害了他的叔叔艾德。《贝尔尚预言》给他“狂人”的绰号。他在位期间持续与维京人作战，《阿尔巴国王编年史》记载他在伊尼西布索利安击败丹麦人，900年邓诺塔遭洗劫时死于诺斯人之手。爱尔兰编年史已称他为阿尔巴国王，而非皮克特人国王。他葬于艾奥纳岛，王位由堂弟康斯坦丁二世继承，其子后来成为马尔科姆一世。

en: Donald III, Domnall Bán or Donald the Fair (c. 1032–1099), second son of Duncan I, spent his youth in Irish exile after Macbeth killed his father in 1040. When his brother Malcolm III and Malcolm's heir Edward fell at Alnwick in November 1093, the aged Donald seized the crown, expelled the English courtiers and banished Margaret's sons. His nephew Duncan II displaced him with English backing in 1094, but Duncan's murder on 12 November restored Donald. In 1097 his nephew Edgar overthrew him with William Rufus's aid; Donald was blinded, imprisoned at Rescobie and died in 1099.
zh: 唐纳德三世，绰号“白脸”唐纳德·班（约1032—1099），是邓肯一世的次子。1040年麦克白杀害他的父亲后，他长年流亡爱尔兰，兄长马尔科姆三世则统治苏格兰。1093年11月马尔科姆和继承人爱德华在阿尼克战死后，年迈的唐纳德夺取王位，驱逐朝中的英格兰客卿，并赶走玛格丽特所生的诸子。1094年5月，侄子邓肯二世借英格兰军队入侵，但邓肯于同年11月12日被杀，唐纳德复位。1097年，另一个侄子埃德加借助威廉·鲁弗斯的力量将他推翻；唐纳德被刺瞎双眼，囚禁于雷斯科比，1099年死去。

en: Donald Mackay was the eldest son of Iye Mackay, 4th of Strathnaver, and heir to the chiefship of Clan Mackay in Strathnaver. In 1370, during the feud with Clan Sutherland, he and his father were murdered together at Dingwall Castle in Ross-shire by Nicholas Sutherland of Duffus, brother of William, 5th Earl of Sutherland. Donald left several sons, of whom the eldest, Angus Mackay, succeeded his grandfather as 6th of Strathnaver; another son, Huistean Du, later tutored Angus's heir during his minority.
zh: 唐纳德·麦凯是第四代斯特拉思纳弗首领伊耶·麦凯的长子，也是斯特拉思纳弗麦凯氏族首领之位的继承人。1370年，在与萨瑟兰氏族的仇杀中，他和父亲在罗斯郡的丁沃尔城堡一同被第五代萨瑟兰伯爵威廉之弟、杜弗斯的尼古拉斯·萨瑟兰杀害。唐纳德留下数个儿子，长子安格斯·麦凯后来继承祖父之位，成为第六代斯特拉思纳弗首领；另一子休斯廷·杜曾在安格斯的继承人年幼时担任其监护。

en: Dub mac Maíl Coluim, anglicised Duff (c. 928–967), son of Malcolm I, became king of Alba in 962 after Indulf's death; his Gaelic name meant ‘the Black’. He spent his reign fighting Cuilén, Indulf's son. Dub defeated him ‘upon the ridge of Crup’, where the abbot of Dunkeld and the mormaer of Atholl fell, yet was later driven from the kingdom. The Annals of Ulster record him killed by the Scots themselves in 967; later legend said he was murdered at Forres and his body hidden under Kinloss bridge. His son Kenneth III later reigned.
zh: 杜夫（盖尔语名杜布·麦克·马尔·科卢姆，约928—967）是马尔科姆一世之子，962年英多尔夫战死后成为阿尔巴国王；他的盖尔语名字意为“黑色的”。他在位时一直与英多尔夫之子科林交战，在“克鲁普山脊”一役中击败对手——邓凯尔德修道院长与阿索尔总督均于此战阵亡——但他后来仍被逐出国境。《阿尔斯特编年史》记载他于967年被苏格兰人自己所杀；后世传说称他在福里斯遇害，尸体被藏在金洛斯桥下。其子肯尼思三世后来称王。

en: Donnchad mac Crinain, Duncan I (c. 1001–1040), nicknamed An t-Ilgarach, the Sick, was king of Alba from 1034. A grandson of King Malcolm II through Malcolm's daughter Bethóc and Crínán, lay abbot of Dunkeld, he succeeded his grandfather unopposed on 25 November 1034. In 1039 he led a large army to besiege Durham and was routed. The next year he marched into Moray, the domain of his war leader Macbeth, and was killed at Bothnagowan, near Elgin, on 14 August 1040, opening the way for Macbeth's kingship. He was the historical King Duncan of Shakespeare's Macbeth.
zh: 邓肯·麦克克里南，即邓肯一世（约1001—1040），绰号“病人”，1034年起为阿尔巴（苏格兰）国王。他是国王马尔科姆二世的外孙，母亲贝索克是马尔科姆之女，父亲是邓凯尔德世俗修道院院长克里南。1034年11月25日外祖父去世，他顺利继位。其统治后期战事失利：1039年率大军围攻达勒姆，大败而回；次年又进军自己的“战争领袖”麦克白的领地莫瑞，于1040年8月14日在埃尔金附近的博特纳戈万战死，麦克白随即登上王位。他就是莎士比亚《麦克白》中“邓肯王”的原型。

en: Duncan II, Donnchad mac Máel Coluim (c. 1060–1094), was the eldest son of Malcolm III by Ingibiorg Finnsdóttir. Handed to William the Conqueror as a hostage in 1072, he grew up a knight at the Norman court. After his uncle Donald III seized the throne in 1093, Duncan invaded with troops lent by William II, won in June 1094 and was crowned at Scone. Once he dismissed his foreign soldiers he was ambushed and killed on 12 November 1094 by Máel Petair of Mearns, acting for Donald, after less than seven months as king.
zh: 邓肯二世，盖尔语名作邓肯·麦克马尔科姆（约1060—1094），是马尔科姆三世与因加·芬斯多特尔的长子。1072年他被交给征服者威廉作人质，在诺曼人的宫廷长大成为骑士。1093年叔父唐纳德三世篡位后，邓肯借助威廉二世提供的军队入侵苏格兰，1094年6月获胜并在斯昆加冕。他遣散外国军队后遭到伏击，于1094年11月12日被受唐纳德指使的默恩斯领主马尔彼得杀害，在位不足七个月。

en: Edgar, Étgar mac Maíl Choluim, called Probus (c. 1074–1107), was the fourth son of Malcolm III and Saint Margaret and ruled Scotland from 1097. After his half-brother Duncan II was murdered in 1094, Edgar claimed the crown with English backing; in 1097 his uncle Edgar Ætheling defeated Donald III and Edmund and set him on the throne. His peaceful reign saw Coldingham Priory founded in 1098 and his recognition of Magnus Barefoot's hold on the Hebrides and Kintyre. He died unmarried at Edinburgh on 8 January 1107, was buried at Dunfermline Abbey and was succeeded by his brother Alexander.
zh: 埃德加，盖尔语名作埃德加·麦克马尔科姆，绰号普罗伯斯，意为勇士（约1074—1107），是马尔科姆三世与圣玛格丽特的第四子，1097年起为苏格兰国王。1094年异母兄邓肯二世被杀后，他在英格兰国王威廉二世支持下争位；1097年，舅父高贵者埃德加率军击败唐纳德三世和埃德蒙，将他扶上王位。他在位期间政局平稳，1098年建立科尔丁厄姆小修道院，并承认挪威国王赤脚王马格努斯对赫布里底和金泰尔的控制。1107年1月8日他在爱丁堡去世，未曾娶妻，葬于邓弗姆林修道院，王位传给弟弟亚历山大。

en: Edward Balliol (c. 1283–1364) was the eldest son of John Balliol, the Scottish king who abdicated in 1296, and Isabella de Warenne, and was held in the Tower of London until 1299. When Robert I died in 1329, leaving an infant heir, Balliol joined the Disinherited, English magnates who had lost Scottish lands in the peace. In 1332, with covert English backing, they invaded, won at Dupplin Moor and had him crowned at Scone, but he was soon driven out and turned to Edward III. Edward's army won at Halidon Hill in 1333 and set him on the throne again, in return for much of southern Scotland; by the Treaty of Newcastle in 1334 Balliol ceded Lothian and did homage. Forces loyal to David II regained the country, and defeats such as Culblean in 1335 unravelled his cause. The Scots never accepted him. In 1356 he surrendered his claim to Edward III for a pension and died childless in 1364.
zh: 爱德华·巴里奥（约1283—1364）是苏格兰国王约翰·巴里奥与伊莎贝拉·德·瓦伦之长子，其父于1296年退位，他本人被囚于伦敦塔，直到1299年获释。1329年罗伯特一世去世、留下年幼的继承人，巴里奥加入‘被剥夺继承权者’的行列，这是一批在和约中失去苏格兰领地的英格兰贵族。1332年，他们在英格兰暗中支持下入侵苏格兰，在杜普林沼泽取胜，并让他在斯昆加冕；但他很快被逐出，转而求助爱德华三世。1333年英军在哈利顿山获胜，把他重新扶上王位，代价是苏格兰南部大片土地；按1334年的《纽卡斯尔条约》，他割让洛锡安并向英王行臣服礼。支持大卫二世的势力逐步收复全国，1335年库尔布伦之役等挫败使他的事业瓦解。苏格兰人始终没有接受他。1356年，他以年金为条件把王位要求让给爱德华三世，1364年无嗣而终。

en: Edward Bruce (c. 1280–1318), Earl of Carrick, was Robert the Bruce's younger brother and a chief captain in the Scottish wars of independence. He captured Rutherglen Castle in 1313 and commanded a schiltrom at Bannockburn in 1314. In 1315 he landed at Larne in Ulster to open a second front against England, and with the backing of Irish allies was proclaimed High King of Ireland in 1315 and crowned the next year. His three-year campaign ended in defeat and death at the Battle of Faughart on 14 October 1318. His illegitimate son Alexander later inherited Carrick.
zh: 爱德华·布鲁斯（约1280—1318）是罗伯特·布鲁斯的弟弟、卡里克伯爵，也是苏格兰独立战争中其兄麾下的主要将领之一。1313年他攻克拉瑟格伦城堡，1314年在班诺克本指挥一个长矛圆阵。1315年，他在阿尔斯特的拉恩登陆，开辟对英格兰作战的第二战场；在爱尔兰盟友支持下，他于1315年被拥戴为爱尔兰至尊王，次年加冕。这场历时三年的征战以1318年10月14日福哈特战役的失败和他本人的阵亡告终，他的私生子亚历山大后来继承了卡里克。

en: Eleanor de Brus (c. 1334–1368) was the daughter of Alexander Bruce, Earl of Carrick, killed at Halidon Hill in 1333. She married Sir William de Cunynghame of Kilmaurs, later Earl of Carrick, and left children.
zh: 埃莉诺·德·布鲁斯（约1334—1368）是1333年战死于哈利顿山的卡里克伯爵亚历山大·布鲁斯之女，嫁给后来受封卡里克伯爵的基尔茅斯的威廉·德·坎宁安爵士，留有后代。

en: Eleanor Douglas, daughter of Sir Archibald Douglas, Guardian of Scotland, married five times. Her first husband was Alexander Bruce, Earl of Carrick, killed at Halidon Hill in 1333; her later husbands included Sir James Sandilands and Sir Patrick Hepburn of Hailes.
zh: 埃莉诺·道格拉斯是苏格兰护国主阿奇博尔德·道格拉斯爵士之女，一生五次嫁人。第一任丈夫是1333年战死哈利顿山的卡里克伯爵亚历山大·布鲁斯，其后的丈夫包括詹姆斯·桑迪兰兹爵士和海尔斯的帕特里克·赫本爵士。

en: Elizabeth de Beaumont (died 27 October 1400) was a daughter of Henry de Beaumont, Earl of Buchan, and Alice Comyn. She married Nicholas Audley, third Baron Audley (1328–1391), and the marriage produced no children.
zh: 伊丽莎白·德·博蒙（？—1400年10月27日）是巴肯伯爵亨利·德·博蒙与艾丽斯·科明之女，嫁给第三代奥德利男爵尼古拉斯·奥德利（1328—1391），婚后没有子女。

en: Elizabeth Bruce was the youngest daughter of King Robert I of Scots, probably by his queen Elizabeth de Burgh, after whom she was named. She married Sir Walter Oliphant, also called Olifaunt, lord of Aberdalgie and Dupplin in Perthshire, and bore him at least three sons, John, Walter and Malcolm. In 1364 her brother King David II reconfirmed the estates held by Elizabeth and her husband, and she was still living in that year.
zh: 伊丽莎白·布鲁斯是苏格兰国王罗伯特一世最小的女儿，一般认为是王后伊丽莎白·德·布治所生，并以母亲的名字命名。她嫁给珀斯郡阿伯达尔吉与杜普林的领主沃尔特·奥利芬特（又作奥利方特）爵士，至少生有约翰、沃尔特、马尔科姆三个儿子。1364年，她的兄弟大卫二世国王再次确认了她与丈夫持有的地产，她当时仍在世。

en: Elizabeth de Burgh (c. 1289–1327) was the second wife and queen of King Robert I of Scots. Daughter of Richard Óg de Burgh, 2nd Earl of Ulster, she married Robert in Essex in 1302 and was crowned beside him at Scone in March 1306. Captured with the Bruce women by the Earl of Ross after Methven and handed to the English, she remained a prisoner in England until her exchange in 1314 after Bannockburn. She bore the future David II and died in 1327 after falling from her horse at Cullen, and was buried at Dunfermline Abbey.
zh: 伊丽莎白·德·伯格（约1289—1327）是苏格兰国王罗伯特一世的第二任妻子与王后。她是第二代阿尔斯特伯爵理查德·奥格·德·伯格之女，1302年在埃塞克斯与罗伯特成婚，1306年3月在斯昆与丈夫一同加冕。梅思文战败后，她与布鲁斯家的女眷被罗斯伯爵俘获并交给英格兰人，在英格兰被囚，直到1314年班诺克本战役后才通过交换获释。她生下了后来的大卫二世，1327年在卡伦坠马身亡，葬于邓弗姆林修道院。

en: Elizabeth de Comyn (1299–1372) was the daughter of John Comyn of Badenoch, murdered by Robert Bruce at Dumfries in 1306, and Joan de Valence. After her uncle Aymer de Valence, Earl of Pembroke, died in 1324, she inherited Goodrich and Painswick, but the Despensers, Edward II's favourites, imprisoned her and forced her to surrender her estates. Released in October 1325, she secretly married Richard Talbot, who retook Goodrich after Queen Isabella's invasion in 1326. Their son Gilbert, later third Baron Talbot, was born around 1332. Widowed in 1356, she married John Bromwich and died on 20 November 1372.
zh: 伊丽莎白·德·科明（1299—1372）是巴德诺赫领主约翰·科明与琼·德·瓦朗斯之女；1306年，父亲在邓弗里斯被罗伯特·布鲁斯杀害。1324年舅父彭布罗克伯爵艾马尔·德·瓦朗斯去世后，她继承了古德里奇和佩恩斯威克，却被爱德华二世的宠臣德斯潘塞父子囚禁，被迫交出产业。1325年10月获释后，她秘密嫁给理查·塔尔博特；1326年伊莎贝拉王后起兵，塔尔博特随即夺回古德里奇。两人的儿子吉尔伯特约于1332年出生，后成为第三代塔尔博特男爵。1356年丧夫后，她改嫁约翰·布罗姆威奇，于1372年11月20日去世。

en: Elizabeth Mure, said to have been born at Rowallan Castle in Ayrshire, was the daughter of Sir Adam Mure of Rowallan. Around 1336 she entered a secular marriage with Robert Stewart, High Steward of Scotland, which contemporaries criticized as uncanonical; after a papal dispensation of November 1347 the couple remarried in 1349. She bore Robert at least ten children, including the future Robert III, the Duke of Albany and the Earl of Buchan, but died before May 1355, long before her husband took the throne as Robert II in 1371.
zh: 伊丽莎白·缪尔相传出生于艾尔郡的罗阿兰城堡，是罗阿兰的亚当·缪尔爵士之女。约1336年，她与苏格兰王室总管罗伯特·斯图亚特按世俗婚姻结合，时人批评这桩婚姻不合教规；1347年11月教皇特许颁布后，两人于1349年重新成婚。她为罗伯特产下至少十个子女，包括后来的罗伯特三世、奥尔巴尼公爵和巴肯伯爵，但她在1355年5月前便已去世，远早于丈夫1371年登基为罗伯特二世。

en: Eochaid ab Rhun (fl. 853–889) was the son of Rhun ab Arthgal, British king of Strathclyde, by a daughter of Cináed mac Ailpín, king of the Picts. After Áed mac Cináeda was killed by Giric in 878, sources link Eochaid with rule over the Picts, perhaps reigning alongside Giric while he retained Strathclyde; under Viking pressure on Northumbria the British kingdom then expanded southward. In 889 Eochaid and Giric were driven out; their successor, the Alpínid Domnall mac Custantín, may have been responsible. Nothing more is recorded of Eochaid.
zh: 奥凯德·阿普·伦（853—889年间有载）是不列颠人的斯特拉斯克莱德国王伦·阿普·阿斯加尔之子，母亲是皮克特王辛纳德·麦克埃尔平（即肯尼思一世）之女。878年艾德·麦克辛纳德被吉里克所杀后，据史籍记载，奥凯德与皮克特人的王位联系在一起，可能与吉里克共治，同时仍领有斯特拉斯克莱德；乘维京人压迫诺森伯里亚之机，这个不列颠王国向南扩张。889年，奥凯德与吉里克被驱逐，继位的阿尔平家族成员多姆纳尔·麦克君士坦丁可能是驱逐他们的人。此后奥凯德再无记载。

en: Farquhar Mackay was a younger son of Iye Mackay, 4th of Strathnaver, chief of Clan Mackay, and served as physician to King Robert II of Scotland. His sister Mariota married Alexander Stewart, Earl of Buchan, known as the Wolf of Badenoch.
zh: 法夸尔·麦凯是麦凯氏族首领、第四代斯特拉思纳弗首领伊耶·麦凯之子，曾任苏格兰国王罗伯特二世的御医。他的姐妹玛丽奥塔嫁给了号称“巴德诺赫之狼”的巴肯伯爵亚历山大·斯图亚特。

en: Gilbert Talbot, 3rd Baron Talbot (c. 1332–1387) was an English nobleman and soldier, succeeding his father Richard as baron in 1356. He fought in France under the Black Prince. In 1381 he campaigned in Portugal and Spain under the Earl of Cambridge and took part in the capture of Higuera la Real, and in 1385 he was summoned to Newcastle against the Scots. He returned to Spain in 1386 with John of Gaunt, who was pressing his claim to Castile, and died there of the plague on 24 April 1387, leaving heavy debts. His son Richard succeeded him.
zh: 第三代塔尔博特男爵吉尔伯特·塔尔博特（约1332—1387）是英格兰贵族、军人，1356年继承父亲理查德的男爵爵位。他随黑太子在法兰西作战；1381年随剑桥伯爵征战葡萄牙与西班牙，参与攻占伊格拉拉雷亚尔；1385年被召至纽卡斯尔抵御苏格兰人。1386年，他随正主张卡斯蒂利亚王位的冈特的约翰再赴西班牙，1387年4月24日死于当地鼠疫，身后留下沉重债务，儿子理查德继位。

en: Henry de Beaumont (1280–1340) was an English baron, son of Louis of Brienne and Agnès de Beaumont, and a leader of the Disinherited, the nobles whose Scottish lands Robert I had forfeited. A household knight of Edward I from 1297, he fought at Falkirk, where Wallace's spearmen killed his horse under him, and later at Bannockburn and Boroughbridge. By 1310 he had married Alice Comyn, heiress of the earldom of Buchan, and claimed it in her right. In 1331 he persuaded Edward Balliol to come to England and helped plan the invasion of 1332, which won Dupplin Moor and Balliol's crown at Scone. After Halidon Hill he returned to Buchan and rebuilt Dundarg Castle. Andrew Murray besieged him there and forced his surrender on 23 December 1334. He followed Edward III to the Low Countries in 1338 and died there in 1340. His son John never claimed Buchan; when Alice died in 1349, the Comyn line of Buchan ended.
zh: 亨利·德博蒙特（1280—1340）是英格兰男爵，布里耶纳的路易与阿涅丝·德博蒙之子，也是“被剥夺者”的首领之一，这批贵族的苏格兰领地被罗伯特一世没收。他自1297年起是爱德华一世的宫廷骑士，在福尔柯克被华莱士的长枪方阵刺死了坐骑，后来又参加了班诺克本和巴勒布里奇之战。1310年前后，他娶了巴肯伯爵领地的继承人爱丽丝·科明，以妻权主张该伯爵领地。1331年，他说服爱德华·巴里奥来到英格兰，并参与筹划1332年的入侵，杜普林沼泽一战获胜，巴里奥在斯昆加冕。哈利顿山之战后，他回到巴肯重建敦达格城堡。安德鲁·默里围攻此地，迫使他在1334年12月23日投降。1338年他随爱德华三世前往低地国家，1340年在那里去世。儿子约翰从未主张巴肯伯爵之位；1349年爱丽丝去世，巴肯的科明家族一脉就此断绝。

en: Ildulb mac Causantín, anglicised Indulf (c. 927–962), son of Constantine II, ruled Alba from 954 to 962 and was nicknamed An Ionsaighthigh, ‘the Aggressor’. The Chronicle of the Kings of Alba records that in his day oppidum Eden, usually identified as Edinburgh, was abandoned to the Scots, marking their advance into Lothian. In 962 he fell fighting Vikings near Cullen at the Battle of Bauds, though the Prophecy of Berchán says he died at St Andrews. He was buried on Iona and succeeded by Dub; his own sons Cuilén and Amlaíb both later reigned.
zh: 英多尔夫（盖尔语名伊尔杜尔布·麦克·考桑廷，约927—962）是康斯坦丁二世之子，954—962年为阿尔巴国王，绰号“侵略者”。《阿尔巴国王编年史》记载，他在位时通常被认为即今爱丁堡的“伊甸城”被弃守给苏格兰人，标志着盖尔势力进入洛锡安。962年，他在卡伦附近的鲍兹战役中与维京人作战阵亡，但《贝尔尚预言》说他死于圣安德鲁斯。他葬于艾奥纳岛，由杜夫继位；他的亲子科林与安拿比后来都登上了王位。

en: Isabel Strathbogie (born c. 1334) is recorded as the probable daughter of David III Strathbogie, titular Earl of Atholl, and his wife Katherine Beaumont. She married Sir Edmund de Cornwall, who died on 22 March 1354.
zh: 伊莎贝尔·斯特拉斯博吉（约1334年生），据记载可能是名义阿索尔伯爵大卫三世·斯特拉斯博吉与妻子凯瑟琳·博蒙特之女，嫁给1354年3月22日去世的埃德蒙·德·康沃尔爵士。

en: Isabella de Warenne (c. 1253–before 1292) was the daughter of John de Warenne, sixth Earl of Surrey, and Alice de Lusignan, maternal half-sister of King Henry III of England. About 9 February 1281 she married John Balliol, head of the powerful Balliol house and a future claimant to the Scottish throne. The marriage linked the Balliols to the English court and produced Edward Balliol, later himself a pretender to the Scottish crown. Isabella is thought to have died before 1292, when her husband was chosen king, so she was probably never queen.
zh: 伊莎贝拉·德·瓦伦（约1253—1292年前）是第六代萨里伯爵约翰·德·瓦伦与爱丽丝·德·吕西尼昂之女，其母是英格兰国王亨利三世同母异父的妹妹。约1281年2月9日，她嫁给巴利奥尔家族首领约翰·巴利奥尔——一个有权问鼎苏格兰王位的人，这桩婚姻把巴利奥尔家族与英格兰宫廷联结起来。她生下爱德华·巴利奥尔，后者后来也成为苏格兰王位的觊觎者。一般认为她在1292年丈夫被推举为国王之前便已去世，很可能从未成为王后。

en: Iye Mackay, 4th of Strathnaver, was chief of Clan Mackay in the Highlands, succeeding his father Donald Mackay, 3rd of Strathnaver. His long feud with the Earl of Sutherland ended in 1370, when he and his eldest son and heir Donald were murdered at Dingwall Castle by the earl's party. His other children included Farquhar Mackay, physician to Robert II, and Mariota, wife of Alexander Stewart, Earl of Buchan, the Wolf of Badenoch. Since Donald died with him, the chiefship passed to his grandson Angus Mackay.
zh: 第四代斯特拉思纳弗首领伊耶·麦凯是高地麦凯氏族的首领，继承了父亲第三代首领唐纳德·麦凯之位。他与萨瑟兰伯爵长期结仇，1370年，他与长子兼继承人唐纳德在丁沃尔城堡被伯爵一方杀害。他的其他子女包括罗伯特二世的御医法夸尔·麦凯，以及嫁给巴肯伯爵亚历山大·斯图亚特（“巴德诺赫之狼”）的玛丽奥塔。由于唐纳德与他同时遇害，首领之位传给了孙子安格斯·麦凯。

en: Sir James Douglas, called the Black Douglas (c. 1286–1330), was Robert the Bruce's most feared lieutenant in the Scottish Wars of Independence. Son of William le Hardi, who died an English prisoner, he retook Douglas Castle in the 1307 massacre remembered as the Douglas Larder, seized Roxburgh Castle in 1314 and fought at Bannockburn. His raids into England, notably Myton in 1319 and Weardale in 1327, helped force the 1328 Treaty of Northampton. After Bruce died he carried the king's heart to Spain and was killed fighting the Moors at Teba on 25 August 1330.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/詹姆斯·道格拉斯_(道格拉斯勳爵)
zh: 詹姆斯·道格拉斯爵士，绰号“黑道格拉斯”（约1286—1330），是苏格兰独立战争中罗伯特·布鲁斯麾下最令敌人胆寒的将领。其父“大胆者”威廉作为英格兰人的囚徒死于伦敦塔。1307年，他以被称作“道格拉斯储藏室”的屠杀夺回家族的道格拉斯城堡，1314年攻取罗克斯堡城堡，并参加班诺克本战役。他深入英格兰的奔袭——尤以1319年米顿和1327年威尔戴尔为著——促成了1328年的《诺咸顿条约》。布鲁斯死后，他携国王的心脏前往西班牙，1330年8月25日在特瓦战役与摩尔人作战时阵亡。

en: James Stewart (c. 1260–1309) was the fifth hereditary High Steward of Scotland. In 1286 he was chosen one of the six Guardians governing the kingdom during the interregnum. In the Wars of Independence he first supported William Wallace and, after the defeat at Falkirk in 1298, transferred his backing to Robert Bruce. Sent to France in 1302 seeking help against Edward I, he nevertheless swore fealty to Edward at Lanercost in 1306, before returning to the Scottish cause. He died in Bruce's service on 16 July 1309. By Egidia de Burgh he fathered Walter, the sixth High Steward.
zh: 詹姆斯·斯图亚特（约1260—1309）是第五代世袭苏格兰王室总务官。1286年，他被推选为王位空悬期间治理国家的六位护国官之一。苏格兰独立战争中，他起初支持威廉·华莱士，1298年福尔柯克战败后转而支持罗伯特·布鲁斯。1302年他奉命出使法国，寻求对抗爱德华一世的援助；1306年却在拉纳科斯特向爱德华宣誓效忠，随后又回归苏格兰阵营。1309年7月16日，他在效力布鲁斯期间去世。他与艾吉迪娅·德·伯格生子沃尔特，即第六代总务官。

en: Joan de Beaumont was a daughter of Henry de Beaumont, Earl of Buchan, and Alice Comyn. Genealogies relate that she married Fulk VII FitzWarin, third Baron FitzWarin, who held Whittington Castle in Shropshire and died in 1349.
zh: 琼·德·博蒙是巴肯伯爵亨利·德·博蒙与艾丽斯·科明之女。谱系记载她嫁给第三代菲茨沃林男爵富尔克七世；后者领有什罗普郡的惠廷顿城堡，卒于1349年。

en: John de Balliol (before 1208 – 1268) was an Anglo-Scottish baron of Barnard Castle. In 1223 he married Dervorguilla of Galloway, whose wealthy inheritance funded his career. On Henry III's instruction he served as a joint protector of the young Alexander III of Scotland and was a leading counsellor of Henry from 1258 to 1265. He was sheriff of Nottinghamshire and Derbyshire in 1261–1262. Captured at the Battle of Lewes in 1264, he escaped and rejoined Henry. After a dispute with the bishop of Durham, he supported scholars at Oxford from around 1263; Dervorguilla's later endowments helped establish Balliol College. He died in 1268; his son John was chosen king of Scots in 1292.
zh: 约翰·德·巴利奥尔（1208年以前—1268）是领有巴纳德城堡的英苏贵族。1223年，他娶加洛韦的德沃尔吉拉为妻，妻子丰厚的遗产资助了他的仕途。他奉亨利三世之命担任年幼的苏格兰国王亚历山大三世的共同保护人，并在1258至1265年间任亨利的主要顾问之一。1261至1262年，他担任诺丁汉郡及德比郡郡长。1264年他在刘易斯战役中被俘，随后逃脱并重新投奔亨利。与达勒姆主教发生争执后，他从约1263年起资助牛津的学者；德沃尔吉拉后来的捐赠促成了巴利奥尔学院的建立。他于1268年去世，其子约翰于1292年被推举为苏格兰国王。

en: John Balliol (c. 1249–1314), derisively called Toom Tabard, meaning Empty Coat, was King of Scots from 1292 to 1296. After the death of Margaret, Maid of Norway, Edward I of England chose Balliol over rival claimants, but treated Scotland as an English vassal. In 1295 Balliol renounced his fealty and concluded the Auld Alliance with France. Edward invaded, and after the defeat of 1296 Balliol abdicated and was imprisoned in the Tower of London. He later retired to his French estates, where he died in 1314; his son Edward Balliol revived the claim.
zh: 约翰·巴里奥（约1249—1314）被讥称为“空外套”（图姆·塔巴德），1292至1296年任苏格兰国王。挪威少女玛格丽特去世后，英格兰国王爱德华一世在诸位王位竞争者中选中巴里奥，却把苏格兰当作英格兰的附庸。1295年，巴里奥宣布不再效忠爱德华，并与法国缔结“老同盟”。爱德华随即发兵入侵，1296年苏格兰战败后，巴里奥退位并被囚禁于伦敦塔。他后来退隐到法兰西的领地，1314年在那里去世；其子爱德华·巴里奥后来重新提出王位主张。

en: John de Beaumont (1318–1342), second Baron Beaumont, was the son of Henry de Beaumont and Alice Comyn, heiress of Buchan. His family was the English branch of the French house of Brienne. Where his father had claimed the Scottish earldom of Buchan through his wife, John never used the title. His marriage tied him to the house of Lancaster: on 6 November 1330 he married Eleanor of Lancaster, sister of Henry of Grosmont, who had married John's sister Isabel. In 1338 John and Eleanor, a lady-in-waiting to Queen Philippa, accompanied the queen to Ghent in her Low Countries homeland, where his son Henry was born in 1340. After his father's death in 1340 he returned to England and took his seat in parliament. He died on 14 April 1342 of wounds from a tournament, leaving the infant Henry as baron; his widow Eleanor married Richard FitzAlan, Earl of Arundel, in 1344.
zh: 约翰·德博蒙特（1318—1342），第二代博蒙特男爵，是亨利·德博蒙特与巴肯女继承人爱丽丝·科明之子。他的家族是法国布里耶纳家族的英格兰支系。父亲曾凭妻子的权利主张苏格兰的巴肯伯爵头衔，约翰却从未使用这一头衔。婚姻把他与兰开斯特家族联在一起：1330年11月6日，他娶格罗斯蒙特的亨利之妹兰开斯特的埃莉诺为妻，而格罗斯蒙特的亨利娶了约翰的姐妹伊莎贝尔。1338年，约翰与担任菲利帕王后侍女的埃莉诺随王后前往她的故乡低地国家的根特，儿子亨利于1340年在那里出生。1340年父亲去世后，他返回英格兰，进入议会就任男爵。1342年4月14日，他因比武大会受伤而死，留下年幼的亨利继承爵位；遗孀埃莉诺于1344年改嫁阿伦德尔伯爵理查德·菲茨艾伦。

en: John Comyn I (c. 1215–c. 1275) succeeded his uncle Walter as Lord of Badenoch in 1258 and served as Justiciar of Galloway. During Alexander III's minority the Comyns dominated Scotland from 1249 until ousted by Alan Durward, returning in 1257–58. He fought for Henry III of England at the Battle of Lewes in 1264 and was captured. Henry III licensed him to crenellate Tarset Castle in 1267, and he raised a tower at Blair Castle in 1269. In 1275 he helped lead the expedition that crushed the Manx revolt. His son was the Black Comyn.
zh: 约翰·科明一世（约1215—约1275）于1258年继叔父沃尔特之位成为巴德诺赫领主，并任加洛韦司法官。亚历山大三世年幼期间，科明家族在1249年起把持苏格兰朝政，后被艾伦·德沃德排挤，1257—1258年重新掌权。1264年他在刘易斯战役中为英格兰国王亨利三世作战，兵败被俘。1267年亨利三世特许他为塔西特城堡修建雉堞，1269年他在布莱尔城堡建起一座塔楼。1275年，他参与率军镇压了马恩岛叛乱。他的儿子即“黑科明”。

en: John Comyn II, the Black Comyn (c. 1250–1302), was Lord of Badenoch and head of the most powerful baronial house in Scotland. After the death of Alexander III he became one of the six guardians regenting for the infant queen Margaret, Maid of Norway, and later put forward a claim to the crown in the Great Cause. He married Eleanor de Balliol, sister of King John Balliol, binding the Comyns to the Balliol cause. He died at Lochindorb Castle in 1302 and was succeeded by his son John, the Red Comyn.
zh: 约翰·科明二世，绰号“黑科明”（约1250—1302），是巴德诺赫领主，也是苏格兰最有权势的男爵家族之首。亚历山大三世去世后，他成为六名护国主之一，为幼主“挪威少女”玛格丽特摄政，后来又在“大业”王位继承裁断中提出王位主张。他娶国王约翰·巴里奥的妹妹埃莉诺·德·巴里奥为妻，使科明家族与巴里奥阵营结盟。1302年他在洛欣多布城堡去世，其子约翰，即“红科明”，继领家业。

en: John Comyn III, the Red Comyn (c. 1274–1306), was the leading noble of the Balliol party in the First War of Scottish Independence. Son of the Black Comyn and nephew of King John Balliol, he married Joan de Valence, cousin of Edward I, and after Balliol's 1296 abdication served as Guardian, commanding resistance to the English. On 10 February 1306 he met Robert the Bruce at the Greyfriars church in Dumfries, where Bruce stabbed him to death before the high altar. The murder cleared Bruce's path to the crown and began a Comyn blood feud.
zh: 约翰·科明三世，绰号“红科明”（约1274—1306），是苏格兰第一次独立战争中巴里奥阵营的首席贵族。他是“黑科明”之子、国王约翰·巴里奥的外甥，娶爱德华一世的表妹琼·德·瓦朗斯为妻；1296年巴里奥退位后，他出任苏格兰护国主，指挥对英格兰的抵抗。1306年2月10日，他在邓弗里斯的方济各会教堂与罗伯特·布鲁斯会面，布鲁斯在高坛前将他刺杀。这桩谋杀为布鲁斯称王扫清了障碍，也结下了科明家族的血仇。

en: John Comyn IV (c. 1294–1314) was the only son of the Red Comyn, who was killed at Dumfries in 1306. Sent to England by his mother Joan de Valence, he saw his Badenoch lordship forfeited, probably at Robert Bruce's St Andrews parliament of 1309. He married Margaret Wake, by whom he had a son Aymer, who died in infancy in 1316. Comyn returned to Scotland in the English army and was killed leading a cavalry charge against the Scottish schiltrons on the main day of the Battle of Bannockburn, 24 June 1314.
zh: 约翰·科明四世（约1294—1314）是“红科明”的独子，其父于1306年在邓弗里斯被杀。母亲琼·德·瓦朗斯把他送往英格兰，其巴德诺赫领地很可能在1309年罗伯特·布鲁斯召开的圣安德鲁斯议会上被没收。他娶玛格丽特·韦克为妻，生子埃默，埃默于1316年夭折。科明随英格兰军队回到苏格兰，1314年6月24日班诺克本战役的主战之日，他率骑兵向苏格兰长矛方阵冲锋时战死。

en: John Douglas was a son of Sir Archibald Douglas, Guardian of Scotland, and Beatrice de Lindsay, and brother of William Douglas, 1st Earl of Douglas. He accompanied King David II to France and died in the king's retinue there before 1342.
zh: 约翰·道格拉斯是苏格兰护国主阿奇博尔德·道格拉斯爵士与比阿特丽斯·德·林赛之子，第一代道格拉斯伯爵威廉·道格拉斯的兄弟。他随大卫二世前往法国，1342年之前在国王的随从中客死他乡。

en: Katherine de Beaumont (died 1368) was the daughter of Henry de Beaumont, Earl of Buchan, and his wife Alice Comyn. Between 1327 and 1330 she married David III Strathbogie, titular Earl of Atholl and a leading supporter of Edward Balliol, bringing Northumberland manors as her dowry. David was killed at the Battle of Culblean on 30 November 1335, after which the Scottish Guardian Andrew Moray besieged her in Lochindorb Castle; Edward III relieved her there in the summer of 1336. Her son David later claimed the earldom of Atholl. She died on 11 November 1368.
zh: 凯瑟琳·德·博蒙（？—1368）是巴肯伯爵亨利·德·博蒙与妻子艾丽斯·科明之女。1327至1330年间，她嫁给名义上的阿索尔伯爵、爱德华·巴利奥尔的主要支持者大卫·德·斯特拉斯博吉三世，以诺森伯兰的几处庄园作为嫁妆。1335年11月30日，大卫在卡尔布兰战役中阵亡，苏格兰护国官安德鲁·默里随即把她围困在洛欣多布城堡；1336年夏，爱德华三世发兵将她救出。她的儿子大卫后来继续宣称阿索尔伯爵之位。她于1368年11月11日去世。

en: Kenneth de Moravia (died 19 July 1333) was the fourth Earl of Sutherland and chief of Clan Sutherland in the Scottish Highlands. The second son of William de Moravia, second Earl of Sutherland, he inherited the earldom after the death of his brother William, the third earl. He married Mary, daughter of Domhnall I, Earl of Mar, and their son William succeeded as the fifth earl. Kenneth was killed fighting the English at the Battle of Halidon Hill on 19 July 1333.
zh: 肯尼思·德·莫拉维亚（?—1333）是第四代萨瑟兰伯爵、苏格兰高地上萨瑟兰氏族的首领。他是第二代萨瑟兰伯爵威廉·德·莫拉维亚的次子，在兄长第三代伯爵威廉死后继承伯爵之位。他娶马尔伯爵多姆纳尔一世之女玛丽，生子威廉，后来继承为第五代伯爵。1333年7月19日，肯尼思在哈里登山战役中与英格兰军队作战时阵亡。

en: Kenneth I, called Kenneth MacAlpin (c. 810–858), was king of the Picts. Tradition holds that he succeeded his father Alpín as king of Dál Riada around 841 and conquered the Picts between 843 and 850. It hails him as founder of Scotland, or Alba, and surnames him the Conqueror, although the kingdom of Alba emerged gradually after his reign. He warred against the Britons of Strathclyde and Viking raiders, made Forteviot his royal centre, and moved the Stone of Scone and other relics from Iona into his kingdom. He died on 13 February 858 and was succeeded by his brother Donald.
zh: 肯尼思一世（约810—858），即肯尼思·麦克·亚尔宾，是皮克特人之王。传统记载称他约841年继承父亲阿尔平的达尔里阿达王位，又于843—850年征服皮克特人。传统上奉他为苏格兰（盖尔语称阿尔巴）的开国君主，绰号“征服者”，但阿尔巴王国是在他统治后逐渐形成的。他一生与斯特拉斯克莱德的不列颠人及维京入侵者作战，以福泰维奥为统治中心，并把斯昆石等圣物从爱奥那岛迁回自己的王国。他于858年2月13日去世，弟弟唐纳德继立。

en: Cináed mac Maíl Coluim, anglicised Kenneth II (932–995), son of Malcolm I, became king of Alba in 971 after Cuilén's murder. Cuilén's brother Amlaíb contested the north until Kenneth killed him in 977. He raided northern England, and later tradition says King Edgar recognised his rule over Lothian after he submitted in 973. In 995 he was ‘deceitfully killed’ at Fettercairn, and legend blamed Finnguala of Angus, who lured him into a booby-trapped cottage to avenge her son. Buried on Iona, he was succeeded by Constantine III; his son Malcolm II became king later.
zh: 肯尼思二世（盖尔语名基纳达·麦克·马尔·科卢姆，932—995）是马尔科姆一世之子，971年科林被杀后成为阿尔巴国王。科林之弟安拿比在北方与之争位，直到977年被肯尼思杀死。他不断侵袭英格兰北部；后世传说称，他于973年向英王埃德加臣服，后者承认他对洛锡安的统治。995年，他在费特凯恩被“背信弃义地杀害”，传说指使者是安格斯的芬瓜拉，她为给儿子报仇，把他诱入设有弩机陷阱的小屋。他葬于艾奥纳岛，康斯坦丁三世继位；其子马尔科姆二世后来也成为国王。

en: Cináed mac Duib, anglicised as Kenneth III and nicknamed An Donn, the Chief, ruled the Gaelic kingdom of Alba as king from 997 until 1005. A son of King Dub, he came to the throne after the death of Constantine III. His reign is poorly recorded; Irish annals record that Gille Coemgáin mac Cináeda killed Dúngal mac Cináeda in 999. Around 25 March 1005 he was defeated and killed at the battle of Monzievaird in Strathearn by his rival Máel Coluim, who then ruled as Malcolm II.
zh: 肯尼思三世，盖尔语原名奇纳德·麦克杜夫，绰号“酋长王”，于997年至1005年统治盖尔人的阿尔巴王国。他是国王杜夫之子，在康斯坦丁三世死后登上王位。关于其统治的记载很少，爱尔兰编年史记载吉勒·科姆甘·麦克奇纳德于999年杀死邓加尔·麦克奇纳德。约1005年3月25日，他在斯特拉森的蒙齐瓦德战役中被对手马尔科姆击败身亡，后者随后称王，即马尔科姆二世。

en: Lulach mac Gille Coemgáin (c. 1032–1058) was the son of Gille Coemgáin, Mormaer of Moray, and Gruoch, and thus the stepson of Macbeth. After Macbeth fell at the Battle of Lumphanan on 15 August 1057, his supporters placed Lulach on the throne; he was inaugurated at Scone around 8 September, the first Scottish king whose coronation details are recorded. He ruled barely seven months, earning the nicknames the Unfortunate and the Simple, before Malcolm III killed him on 17 March 1058 and seized the crown. He was buried on Iona, and his son Máel Snechtai became Mormaer of Moray.
zh: 卢拉赫·麦克吉莱科姆甘（约1032—1058）是莫里总督吉莱·科姆甘与格鲁赫之子，即麦克白的继子。1057年8月15日麦克白在伦法南之战阵亡后，其部众拥立卢拉赫为王，约9月8日在斯昆加冕，他是留有加冕记载的第一位苏格兰国王。他在位仅七个月，绰号“不幸者”和“愚钝者”，1058年3月17日被马尔科姆三世杀害，王位被夺。他葬于艾奥纳岛，其子马尔·斯内赫塔后来成为莫里总督。

en: Mac Bethad mac Findláich, known as Macbeth (c. 1005–1057), was the son of Findláech of Moray and became Mormaer of Moray in 1032, marrying Gruoch, widow of his predecessor Gille Coemgáin. After Duncan I invaded Moray in 1040 and fell to his men, Macbeth took the throne of Alba. His seventeen-year reign was largely peaceful: he made a pilgrimage to Rome in 1050, scattering alms to the poor. In 1054 Siward of Northumbria invaded and fought a bloody battle at Dunsinane, and in 1057 Macbeth was killed at Lumphanan by forces loyal to the future Malcolm III and was buried on Iona.
zh: 麦克贝斯·麦克芬莱克，通称麦克白（约1005—1057），是莫里统治者芬莱克之子，1032年成为莫里总督，并娶前任统治者吉莱·科姆甘的遗孀格鲁赫为妻。1040年邓肯一世入侵莫里、死于其部众之手后，麦克白登上阿尔巴王位。他在位十七年，国内大体安定；1050年他前往罗马朝圣，向贫民慷慨施舍。1054年诺森伯里亚伯爵西沃德入侵苏格兰，在邓斯纳恩激战；1057年麦克白在伦法南被效忠于后来马尔科姆三世的军队所杀，葬于艾奥纳岛。

en: Máel Coluim mac Domnaill, anglicised Malcolm I (c. 897–954), son of Donald II, became king of Alba in 943 when his cousin Constantine II abdicated into a monastery. In 945 Edmund I of England, after ravaging Cumbria and blinding the sons of its king Domnall mac Eógain, commended Strathclyde to Malcolm in return for an alliance. Malcolm later raided Northumbria as far south as the River Tees and campaigned in Moray, where he killed a ruler named Cellach. He was killed in 954, probably in the Mearns, and buried on Iona. His sons Dub and Kenneth II later reigned.
zh: 马尔科姆一世（盖尔语名梅尔·科卢姆·麦克·多姆纳尔，约897—954）是唐纳德二世之子，943年堂兄康斯坦丁二世退位为僧后成为阿尔巴国王。945年，英格兰国王埃德蒙一世劫掠坎布里亚、刺瞎斯特拉斯克莱德国王多姆纳尔·麦克·埃奥盖因诸子的双眼后，将斯特拉斯克莱德“托付”给马尔科姆，以换取结盟。他后来南征诺森布里亚，兵锋远抵蒂斯河；又出师马里，杀死了名叫凯莱赫的首领。954年他被杀，约在梅恩斯地区，葬于艾奥纳岛。他的儿子杜夫与肯尼思二世后来相继为王。

en: Máel Coluim mac Cináeda, anglicised Malcolm II (c. 954–1034), son of Kenneth II, won the kingship of Alba in 1005 by killing Kenneth III at Monzievaird in Strathearn. In 1018, with his ally Owain Foel of Strathclyde, he crushed the Northumbrians at Carham on the Tweed and secured Lothian for the Scots. He married his daughters into the neighbouring dynasties: Bethóc wed Crínán of Dunkeld and bore the future Duncan I, and another daughter was reputedly the mother of Macbeth. Malcolm died at Glamis on 25 November 1034 after reigning twenty-nine years, and his grandson Duncan succeeded him.
zh: 马尔科姆二世（盖尔语名梅尔·科卢姆·麦克·基纳达，954—1034）是肯尼思二世之子，1005年在斯特拉森的蒙齐维尔杀死肯尼思三世，夺得阿尔巴王位。1018年，他联合盟友斯特拉斯克莱德国王欧文·福尔，在特威德河畔的卡拉姆大败诺森布里亚人，为苏格兰人确立了对洛锡安的统治。他把女儿们嫁给周边王朝：贝索克嫁给邓凯尔德的克里南，生下后来的邓肯一世；另一个女儿据传是麦克白的母亲。1034年11月25日，马尔科姆在格拉姆斯去世，在位二十九年，王位传给他的外孙邓肯。

en: Malcolm III, Máel Coluim mac Donnchada, called Canmore or Great Chief (1031–1093), was the eldest son of Duncan I and ruled Scotland for thirty-five years. He was exiled as a child after Macbeth killed his father in 1040. In 1057 he slew Macbeth at Lumphanan, and on 23 March 1058 killed Macbeth's successor Lulach near Huntly to seize the crown. In 1070 he married Margaret of Wessex, later Saint Margaret, mother of the future kings Edgar, Alexander and David. After repeated raids into northern England, he was killed at the First Battle of Alnwick on 13 November 1093.
zh: 马尔科姆三世，盖尔语名作马尔科姆·麦克邓肯，绰号“大头”，意为伟大的首领（1031—1093），是邓肯一世的长子，统治苏格兰三十五年。1040年麦克白杀死其父后，他幼年流亡。1057年，他在隆发南击杀麦克白；1058年3月23日又在亨特利附近杀死麦克白的继承者卢拉赫，夺得王位。1070年，他娶威塞克斯的玛格丽特——后来的圣玛格丽特，后来的国王埃德加、亚历山大和大卫都是她所生。他屡次入侵英格兰北部，最终于1093年11月13日在第一次阿尼克之战中被杀。

en: Malcolm IV (1141–1165), the Maiden, eldest son of Earl Henry of Huntingdon and Ada de Warenne, succeeded his grandfather David I and was inaugurated at Scone in May 1153 aged twelve. In 1157 he did homage to Henry II of England and surrendered Cumbria and Northumbria in return for the earldom of Huntingdon; in 1159 he was knighted at the siege of Toulouse. He faced revolts by his earls, campaigned in Galloway and Moray, and in 1164 saw Somerled of Argyll killed at Renfrew. He founded Coupar Angus Abbey and died unmarried at Jedburgh in 1165 aged twenty-four.
zh: 马尔科姆四世（1141—1165），绰号“少女王”，是亨廷顿伯爵亨利与瓦伦的阿达的长子，继承祖父戴维一世的王位，1153年5月十二岁时在斯昆即位。1157年他向英格兰国王亨利二世行臣服礼，以坎布里亚和诺森布里亚换取亨廷顿伯爵领；1159年在图卢兹围城战中受封骑士。他在位时平定诸伯爵的叛乱，出征加洛韦和莫里，1164年阿盖尔的萨默莱德在伦弗鲁战死。他创立了库珀安格斯修道院，1165年未婚而卒于杰德堡，年仅二十四岁。

en: Margaret Bruce (born between 1315 and 1322, died c. 1346) was probably the eldest daughter of King Robert I of Scots by his second wife Elizabeth de Burgh. In 1324, during peace talks to end the First War of Scottish Independence, Scottish envoys proposed her marriage to the English heir Edward, but the negotiations came to nothing. In 1345 she married William de Moravia, 5th Earl of Sutherland. She died giving birth to her only child, John, Master of Sutherland, and was buried among her family at Dunfermline Abbey.
zh: 玛格丽特·布鲁斯（1315至1322年间生，约1346年卒）可能是苏格兰国王罗伯特一世与第二任妻子伊丽莎白·德·布治的长女。1324年，在旨在结束第一次苏格兰独立战争的和谈中，苏格兰使节提议将她嫁给英格兰王位继承人爱德华，但谈判无果而终。1345年，她嫁给第五代萨瑟兰伯爵威廉·摩拉维亚。她在生下独子、萨瑟兰继承人约翰时去世，葬于邓弗姆林修道院的家族墓地。

en: Marjorie Bruce (c. 1296–1316 or 1317) was the eldest daughter of King Robert I of Scots, born of his first wife Isabella of Mar. Captured by the English with the queen and other Bruce women after her father's coronation in 1306, she spent years in captivity in England before her release after Bannockburn. In 1315 she married Walter Stewart, 6th High Steward of Scotland. Tradition says her son Robert was born after she fell from her horse near Paisley, though the fall may have occurred after his birth. He succeeded to the throne as Robert II in 1371, making Marjorie the ancestress of the House of Stewart.
zh: 玛乔里·布鲁斯（约1296—1316或1317）是苏格兰国王罗伯特一世的长女，为第一任妻子马尔的伊莎贝拉所生。1306年父亲加冕后，她与王后及布鲁斯家的其他女眷一同被英格兰人俘获，在英格兰被囚禁多年，直到班诺克本战役后才获释。1315年，她嫁给苏格兰第六代王室总管沃尔特·斯图尔特。相传她在佩斯利附近坠马后生下儿子罗伯特，但坠马也可能发生在他出生之后。罗伯特于1371年继位为罗伯特二世，玛乔里因此成为斯图亚特王朝的先祖。

en: Mary Bruce (c. 1282–1323) was a younger sister of King Robert I of Scots and a daughter of Robert de Brus, 6th Lord of Annandale. After her brother claimed the crown in 1306, she was handed to the English by the Earl of Ross. Edward I ordered her displayed in a cage at Roxburgh Castle, where she was held for about four years. Moved to better confinement in 1310, she was freed in 1314 in exchange for English nobles captured at Bannockburn. She married first Sir Neil Campbell and later Alexander Fraser.
zh: 玛丽·布鲁斯（约1282—1323）是苏格兰国王罗伯特一世的妹妹，第六代安嫩代尔领主罗伯特·德·布鲁斯之女。1306年其兄称王之后，她被罗斯伯爵交给英格兰人。英王爱德华一世下令将她关在罗克斯堡城堡悬挂示众的牢笼里，前后约四年。1310年她被转移到条件较好的囚所，1314年以班诺克本战役中俘获的英格兰贵族为交换获释。她先嫁尼尔·坎贝尔爵士，后嫁亚历山大·弗雷泽。

en: Sir Niall mac Cailein, also called Neil or Nigel Campbell (d. 1316), was a son of Cailean Mór and a lifelong warrior in the service of Robert the Bruce. First recorded in 1282, he was probably the Niall who carried goods to Norway in 1293 for Robert's sister Queen Isabella Bruce. One of Bruce's earliest adherents in 1306, he stood by him after the defeats at Methven and Dalrigh, fought the English and the MacDougalls, and negotiated with the English crown in 1309 and 1314. He married the king's sister Mary Bruce, and his service to the king elevated the Campbells in the Scottish nobility.
zh: 尼尔·麦克·卡莱恩爵士，又称尼尔·坎贝尔或奈杰尔·坎贝尔（1316年卒），是卡莱恩·莫尔之子，一生追随罗伯特·布鲁斯征战。史料最早于1282年提到他，1293年为罗伯特的姐姐、挪威王后伊莎贝拉·布鲁斯运送物品前往挪威的尼尔很可能就是他。1306年他是罗伯特最早的拥护者之一，在梅思文和达尔里战败后仍忠心不贰，与英格兰人及麦克杜格尔家族作战，并于1309年和1314年两度受命与英格兰王室谈判。他娶国王的妹妹玛丽·布鲁斯为妻，他对国王的效力使坎贝尔家族跻身苏格兰上层贵族。

en: She was a daughter of Kenneth MacAlpin, king of the Picts, and the wife of Rhun, king of the Britons of Strathclyde. Her son Eochaid ab Rhun inherited the kingship of Strathclyde and may also have ruled the Picts from 878 to 889.
zh: 她是皮克特人国王肯尼思·麦克阿尔平的女儿，嫁给斯特拉斯克莱德的不列颠人国王鲁恩。其子奥凯德继承了斯特拉斯克莱德王位，并可能于878—889年统治皮克特人。

en: Patrick Dunbar, Earl of March (c. 1285–1369), was a leading Scottish magnate under Robert the Bruce and David II, succeeding his father in 1309. He changed sides several times in the wars of independence before finally supporting the Scottish cause; in 1338 his wife Agnes Randolph, the famed Black Agnes, defended Dunbar Castle against an English siege. When his brother-in-law John Randolph fell at Neville's Cross in 1346, Dunbar took the Earl of Moray title and lands. He joined the brief recapture of Berwick in 1355 and backed a revolt against David II in 1363, dying in 1369.
zh: 马奇伯爵帕特里克·邓巴（约1285—1369）是罗伯特·布鲁斯与大卫二世两朝的重要苏格兰权贵，1309年承袭父位。独立战争中他曾数度倒戈，最终支持苏格兰一方；1338年，他的妻子、著名的“黑艾格尼丝”艾格尼丝·伦道夫坚守邓巴城堡，抵御英格兰人的围攻。1346年内兄约翰·伦道夫战死于内维尔十字后，他接管了马里伯爵的头衔与领地。1355年他参与短暂夺回贝里克的行动，1363年又支持反对大卫二世的叛乱。他于1369年去世。

en: Richard de Beaumont was a son of Henry de Beaumont, Earl of Buchan, and Alice Comyn, and a brother of John, second Lord Beaumont, who was killed in a tournament in 1342.
zh: 理查德·德·博蒙是巴肯伯爵亨利·德·博蒙与艾丽斯·科明之子，第二代博蒙男爵约翰的兄弟；约翰于1342年在比武大会上身亡。

en: Richard Comyn (b. c. 1190–1194, d. c. 1244–1249) was a son of William Comyn, Lord of Badenoch and Earl of Buchan, by his first wife Sarah Fitzhugh. His son John Comyn succeeded as Lord of Badenoch.
zh: 理查德·科明（约1190—1194年生，约1244—1249年卒）是巴德诺赫领主、后兼布肯伯爵的威廉·科明与第一任妻子萨拉·菲茨休之子。他的儿子约翰·科明后来继任巴德诺赫领主。

en: Sir Richard de Brus (died 1287), Lord of Writtle, was a younger son of Robert de Brus, fifth Lord of Annandale, and Isabella de Clare. An English household knight of Edward I, he may have accompanied the king on crusade, fought in Edward's conquest of Wales, and was given command of Denbigh in 1280. On 20 September 1286 he was a signatory of the Turnberry Band, the bond of Scottish and Anglo-Irish nobles sealed at Turnberry Castle. He held lands at Writtle, Tottenham and Kempston, died unmarried in 1287, and his estates reverted to his father.
zh: 里特尔领主理查·德·布鲁斯爵士（？—1287）是第五代安南达尔领主罗伯特·德·布鲁斯与伊莎贝拉·德·克雷尔较年幼的儿子。他是英王爱德华一世的内府骑士，可能曾随国王参加十字军，后参与爱德华征服威尔士的战争，1280年受命镇守登比。1286年9月20日，他在特恩贝里城堡签署了苏格兰与英吉利—爱尔兰贵族结盟的《特恩贝里盟约》。他领有里特尔、托特纳姆和肯普斯顿的土地，1287年未婚而终，地产重归其父。

en: Richard Talbot, 2nd Baron Talbot (c. 1306–1356) was an English nobleman and soldier who in 1326 married Elizabeth de Comyn, heiress to the forfeited Comyn estates in England and Scotland. As one of the Disinherited he fought for Edward Balliol at Dupplin Moor in 1332 and was made Lord of Mar, but was captured in 1334 and held in Dumbarton Castle until ransomed in 1335. Edward III made him captain of Berwick in 1337, and he fought at Morlaix (1342) and Crécy (1346). He inherited his barony in 1346 and died in October 1356, succeeded by his son Gilbert.
zh: 第二代塔尔博特男爵理查德·塔尔博特（约1306—1356）是英格兰贵族、军人，1326年娶被没收的科明家族在英格兰与苏格兰地产的女继承人伊丽莎白·德·科明。作为“被剥夺继承权者”之一，他于1332年在杜普林沼地之战中为爱德华·巴利奥尔效力，受封马尔勋爵；1334年被俘，囚禁于敦巴顿城堡，1335年缴纳赎金获释。1337年爱德华三世任命他为贝里克守将，他又参加莫尔莱战役（1342）和克雷西战役（1346）。1346年他继承男爵爵位，1356年10月去世，儿子吉尔伯特继位。

en: Robert de Brus (c. 1078–1141), first Lord of Annandale, was a Norman knight from Brix in the Cotentin who came to England with King Henry I and was granted some eighty manors in Yorkshire, centred on Skelton. In 1119 he founded Gisborough Priory. His friendship with David I of Scotland brought him the lordship of Annandale in 1124, but when David invaded England in support of Empress Matilda, Robert renounced his homage and fought for Stephen at the Battle of the Standard in 1138. He died in 1141, founder of the Bruce dynasty in Scotland.
zh: 第一代安南达尔领主罗伯特·德·布鲁斯（约1078—1141）是出身诺曼底科唐坦半岛布里克斯的诺曼骑士，随英王亨利一世来到英格兰，领有约克郡约八十座庄园，以斯凯尔顿为中心。1119年他创立吉斯伯勒修道院。他与苏格兰国王大卫一世的交情使他在1124年受封安南达尔；但当大卫为支持玛蒂尔达皇后入侵英格兰时，罗伯特宣布解除封臣效忠，1138年在标准战中为斯蒂芬王作战。他于1141年去世，是布鲁斯家族在苏格兰的基业开创者。

en: Robert de Brus, called le Meschin, was the second Lord of Annandale (died c. 1194), a younger son of the first Bruce lord. While his father renounced David I before the Battle of the Standard in 1138, Robert fought for the Scots; family tradition says his own father captured him in the battle and gave him to King Stephen. He retained the family's Scottish lands while the Yorkshire estates went to his elder brother Adam, and made Lochmaben the centre of the lordship. He married Euphemia, was buried at Gisborough Priory, and was succeeded by his son William.
zh: 第二代安南达尔领主罗伯特·德·布鲁斯（卒于约1194年）绰号“勒梅尚”，是第一代领主较年幼的儿子。1138年标准战前他的父亲宣布解除对大卫一世的效忠，罗伯特却继续为苏格兰作战；家族传说称他在战阵中被生父俘获，交给了斯蒂芬王。他保有家族在苏格兰的领地，约克郡的产业则归长兄亚当，并把洛克马本建成领地的统治中心。他娶尤菲米娅为妻，葬于吉斯伯勒修道院，由其子威廉继位。

en: Robert de Brus, called the Noble, was the fourth Lord of Annandale (c. 1195–1245), son of William de Brus and Christina mac Uhtred. About 1219 he married Isobel of Huntingdon, daughter of David, Earl of Huntingdon and a descendant of King David I; the match brought him the Essex manors of Writtle and Hatfield Broadoak, and it later supplied his great-grandson Robert the Bruce with his claim to the Scottish crown. They had two sons and a daughter. He died in 1245 and was buried with his ancestors at Gisborough Priory, succeeded by his son Robert.
zh: 第四代安南达尔领主罗伯特·德·布鲁斯（约1195—1245）绰号“高贵者”，是威廉·德·布鲁斯与克里斯蒂娜·麦克·乌特雷德之子。约1219年，他娶亨廷登伯爵大卫之女、大卫一世后裔亨廷登的伊泽贝尔为妻；这桩婚事使他得到埃塞克斯的里特尔和哈特菲尔德布罗德奥克庄园，后来也成为其曾孙罗伯特·布鲁斯主张苏格兰王位的血统依据。两人育有两子一女。他于1245年去世，葬入祖茔吉斯伯勒修道院，由其子罗伯特继位。

en: Robert de Brus, fifth Lord of Annandale, called the Competitor (c. 1215–1295), was a Scottish magnate and regent during Alexander III's minority, when he was once named heir presumptive. A great-great-grandson of David I, he claimed the crown after the Maid of Norway died in 1290, but Edward I of England awarded the throne to his rival John Balliol in the Great Cause of 1292. Robert then resigned Annandale and his claim to his eldest son. He died at Lochmaben Castle in 1295 and was buried at Gisborough Priory, his grandson becoming King Robert I.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/第五代安南達爾領主羅伯特·布魯斯
zh: 第五代安南达尔领主罗伯特·德·布鲁斯（约1215—1295）人称“竞争者”，是苏格兰大贵族，曾在亚历山大三世未成年期间出任摄政，并一度被立为推定继承人。他是大卫一世的玄孙。1290年挪威少女玛格丽特死后，他出面争夺王位；但在史称“大业”的继承权之争中，英王爱德华一世于1292年把王位判给了他的对手约翰·巴里奥。罗伯特随即将安南达尔和王位主张让给长子。1295年他在洛克马本城堡去世，葬于吉斯伯勒修道院；其孙后来成为国王罗伯特一世。

en: Robert de Brus (1243–1304), sixth Lord of Annandale, became Earl of Carrick by his marriage in 1271 to Marjorie, the Carrick heiress, whom legend says kept him captive at Turnberry until he consented. A cross-border baron, he fought for Henry III in the Barons' War, is presumed to have taken the cross with the future Edward I in 1268, and later wavered between Edward and the Scots in the Wars of Independence. His father passed his throne claim to him after the judgment of 1292, and when he died in 1304 it passed to his eldest son, the future Robert the Bruce.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/羅伯特·布魯斯_(第六代安南達爾領主)
zh: 第六代安南达尔领主罗伯特·德·布鲁斯（1243—1304）于1271年与卡里克女继承人玛乔里成婚，由此成为卡里克伯爵；相传玛乔里曾把他软禁在特恩贝里城堡，直到他答应婚事。作为跨越英苏两边的贵族，他曾在诸侯战争中为亨利三世作战，据信1268年随后来的爱德华一世领取十字军十字，后来又在苏格兰独立战争期间在爱德华与苏格兰阵营之间摇摆。1292年王位裁决后，他的父亲将王位主张传给他；他于1304年去世后又传给长子，即后来的罗伯特一世。

en: Robert II (1316–1390), born Robert Stewart, was the son of Walter Stewart, High Steward of Scotland, and Marjorie Bruce, daughter of Robert the Bruce. As High Steward he guarded Scotland during David II's exile in France and again after David's capture at Neville's Cross in 1346. When David died childless in 1371, Robert became the first Stewart king, crowned at Scone on 26 March. From 1384 power passed to his sons, first John, later Robert III, then Robert, Earl of Fife. Robert II died at Dundonald Castle in 1390 and was buried at Scone.
zh: 罗伯特二世（1316—1390）本名罗伯特·斯图亚特，是苏格兰王室总管沃尔特·斯图亚特与罗伯特·布鲁斯之女玛乔丽·布鲁斯之子。担任王室总管期间，他在大卫二世流亡法国以及1346年内维尔十字之战被俘后两度守护王国。1371年大卫二世无嗣而终，罗伯特成为斯图亚特王朝第一位苏格兰国王，3月26日在斯昆加冕。1384年起大权转入诸子手中，先由长子约翰（即后来的罗伯特三世）掌权，后来由法夫伯爵罗伯特接手。罗伯特二世1390年于邓唐纳德城堡去世，葬在斯昆修道院。

en: Robert I, known as Robert the Bruce (1274–1329), was King of Scots from 1306 and leader of Scotland's war of independence against England. After killing his rival John Comyn in 1306 he was crowned at Scone, but defeat at Methven drove him into hiding until his victory at Loudoun Hill in 1307 began his comeback. His triumph over Edward II at Bannockburn in 1314 re-established Scottish independence; in 1320 Scottish nobles asserted it in the Declaration of Arbroath, and in 1328 England renounced its claim to sovereignty in the Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton. He died in 1329 and was buried at Dunfermline Abbey, succeeded by his son David II.
zh: 罗伯特一世（1274—1329）世称罗伯特·布鲁斯，1306年即位为苏格兰国王，领导了苏格兰反抗英格兰的独立战争。1306年他杀死政敌约翰·科明后在斯昆加冕，却在梅思文战败后被迫藏匿，直到1307年在劳登山取胜才东山再起。1314年他在班诺克本击败爱德华二世，重建苏格兰的独立地位；1320年苏格兰贵族在《阿布罗斯宣言》中主张独立，1328年英格兰则在《爱丁堡—北安普敦条约》中放弃对苏格兰的宗主权。他于1329年去世，葬于邓弗姆林修道院，由其子大卫二世继位。

en: Thomas de Beaumont, born around 30 November 1324, was a younger son of Henry de Beaumont, Earl of Buchan, and his wife Alice Comyn, and a brother of John, second Lord Beaumont.
zh: 托马斯·德·博蒙约生于1324年11月30日，是巴肯伯爵亨利·德·博蒙与妻子艾丽斯·科明之子，第二代博蒙男爵约翰的弟弟。

en: Thomas Randolph (c. 1285–1332), nephew of Robert the Bruce, was made Earl of Moray in 1312 and became a chief lieutenant of the king. On 14 March 1314 he retook Edinburgh Castle by a secret path and commanded a schiltron at Bannockburn that June. He helped take Berwick in 1318, won the Battle of Myton in 1319, sealed the Declaration of Arbroath in 1320 and secured papal recognition of Bruce at Avignon in 1324. He served as regent for the child David II from 1329 and died at Musselburgh in July 1332 while marching against Edward Balliol.
zh: 托马斯·伦道夫（约1285—1332）是罗伯特·布鲁斯的外甥，1312年受封莫里伯爵，成为国王最倚重的将领之一。1314年3月14日，他率部沿一条秘密小径攀崖，从英格兰人手中夺回爱丁堡城堡；同年6月在班诺克本之战中指挥一个长枪方阵。他1318年参与攻克贝里克，1319年在迈顿之战获胜，1320年签署《阿布罗斯宣言》，1324年在阿维尼翁促成教皇承认布鲁斯的王位。1329年起他为幼王大卫二世担任摄政，1332年7月进军抵御爱德华·巴里奥途中卒于马瑟尔堡。

en: Walter fitz Alan (c. 1106/1110–1177), younger son of the Anglo-Norman baron Alan fitz Flaad, entered David I of Scotland’s service around 1136 and became royal steward, or dapifer, around 1150, serving David, Malcolm IV and William the Lion. He received the western lordships of Renfrew, Strathgryfe, Mearns and North Kyle, and in 1163 founded Paisley Priory. He may have commanded when Somerled was slain near Renfrew in 1164. He died at Melrose in 1177 and was buried at Paisley; his son Alan inherited his office, from which the royal House of Stewart took its name.
zh: 沃尔特·菲茨艾伦（约1106/1110—1177）是盎格鲁—诺曼贵族艾伦·菲茨弗拉德较年幼的儿子之一，约1136年投效苏格兰国王戴维一世，约1150年成为王室总管，先后侍奉戴维一世、马尔科姆四世和狮子王威廉。他受封伦弗鲁、斯特拉斯格里夫、梅恩斯和北凯尔等西部领地，1163年创立佩斯利修道院。1164年诺斯—盖尔人国王萨默莱德在伦弗鲁附近战死，沃尔特可能即当地苏格兰军的指挥者。1177年他卒于梅尔罗斯，葬于佩斯利；其子艾伦承袭总管之职，后来的斯图亚特王室即由此职得名。

en: Walter Stewart of Dundonald (c. 1180–1246) was the third hereditary High Steward of Scotland and Justiciar of Scotia, the senior royal judge in the Scottish heartlands. The eldest son of Alan fitz Walter, he was the first of his line to use Stewart as a family name. As seneschal and justiciar he witnessed charters of Alexander II, and around 1213 gave timber from the forest of Sanquhar for Paisley Priory. By his wife Beatrix, daughter of the Earl of Angus, he fathered Alexander Stewart, the fourth High Steward. He died in 1246.
zh: 邓唐纳德的沃尔特·斯图亚特（约1180—1246）是第三代世袭苏格兰王室总务官，兼任苏格兰司法长，即苏格兰核心地区的最高王室法官。他是艾伦·菲茨沃尔特的长子，也是家族中第一个以斯图亚特为姓氏的人。他以总务官兼司法长的身份见证亚历山大二世颁发的特许状，约1213年又从桑克尔森林拨付木材，用于修建佩斯利修道院。他娶安格斯伯爵之女贝娅特丽克丝，生子第四代总务官亚历山大·斯图亚特，于1246年去世。

en: Walter Stewart (c. 1296–1327), sixth hereditary High Steward of Scotland, fought at Bannockburn in 1314. As Warden of the Western Marches he received the forfeited lands of Largs, granting them to Paisley Abbey in 1316. In 1315 he married Marjorie Bruce, daughter of Robert I, who died giving birth in 1316 to their son Robert, the future Robert II and first Stewart king. During Bruce's Irish campaign he helped govern and defend the borders, and held Berwick against Edward II's siege in 1319. He died at Bathgate Castle on 9 April 1327.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/第六代蘇格蘭王室總務官華特·斯圖爾特
zh: 沃尔特·斯图亚特（约1296—1327）是第六代世袭苏格兰王室总务官。1314年他参加了班诺克本战役。担任西部边境长官期间，他获赐被没收的拉格斯土地，1316年将其赠予佩斯利修道院。1315年，他娶罗伯特一世之女玛乔丽·布鲁斯为妻；1316年玛乔丽生下儿子罗伯特时去世，这个孩子即后来的罗伯特二世、斯图亚特王朝第一位国王。布鲁斯出征爱尔兰期间，他协助治国戍边，并于1319年坚守贝里克，抵御爱德华二世的围攻。1327年4月9日，他在巴斯盖特城堡去世。

en: William Comyn (1163–1233) was a Scottish noble who became Lord of Badenoch and, by marrying Marjory, Countess of Buchan, the first Comyn earl of Buchan. The son of Richard Comyn, Justiciar of Lothian, he served King William the Lion as sheriff of Forfar, warden of Moray and, from 1205, Justiciar of Scotia. He campaigned against the rebel Meic Uilleim kindred, beheading Gofraid mac Domnaill at Kincardine in 1213 and crushing their power by 1229, when he was granted Badenoch. His rise opened the century of Comyn dominance in Scotland. He died in 1233 and was buried at Deer Abbey.
zh: 威廉·科明（1163—1233）是苏格兰贵族，受封巴德诺赫领主，并因娶巴肯女伯爵玛乔丽而成为科明家族第一代巴肯伯爵。他是洛锡安司法官理查德·科明之子，效力于苏格兰国王威廉一世，历任福法尔郡长、马里守将，1205年升任苏格兰司法官，为王国最高世俗官职。他率军征讨反叛的麦克威廉家族，1213年在金卡丁斩首戈弗雷·麦克唐纳，至1229年将其势力铲除，因功受封巴德诺赫。他的崛起开启了科明家族在苏格兰的百年权势。他于1233年去世，葬于迪尔修道院。

en: William de Brus, third Lord of Annandale (died 1212), succeeded his father Robert in 1194 after his elder brother predeceased him. He held large estates across northern England, where King John granted him a weekly market at Hartlepool, and he gave lands to the canons of Gisburn. He appears in English government records and witnessed a charter of William the Lion of Scotland. By his wife Christina mac Uhtred he left three sons and was succeeded by the eldest, Robert, whose marriage to Isobel of Huntingdon later gave the Bruces their claim to the Scottish throne.
zh: 第三代安南达尔领主威廉·德·布鲁斯（？—1212）在长兄先于父亲亡故后，于1194年继位。他在英格兰北部拥有大片地产，约翰王准许他在哈特尔浦设立每周集市，他还向吉斯本的法政牧师团赠予土地。他的名字见于英格兰政府文书，并曾为苏格兰的狮子王威廉的特许状作证。他与妻子克里斯蒂娜·麦克·乌特雷德生有三子，由长子罗伯特继位；罗伯特后来迎娶亨廷登的伊泽贝尔，为布鲁斯家族带来了苏格兰王位的继承权。

en: William de Moravia, 5th Earl of Sutherland and chief of Clan Sutherland, succeeded his father Kenneth in 1333 and was a loyal supporter of David II in the wars against England. In 1345, under a papal dispensation of late 1342, he married Margaret Bruce, daughter of Robert the Bruce; their son John of Sutherland was once regarded as an heir to the crown but died of plague in London. After Margaret's death he married Joanna Menteith in 1346, by whom he had Robert, later 6th Earl. William last appears on record in February 1370; he may have died soon after, but was certainly dead before 1389.
zh: 第五代萨瑟兰伯爵、萨瑟兰氏族首领威廉·德·莫拉维亚于1333年继承父亲肯尼思的爵位，在对英战争中始终是大卫二世的忠实支持者。1345年，凭1342年底的教皇特许，他娶罗伯特·布鲁斯之女玛格丽特·布鲁斯为妻；二人的儿子萨瑟兰的约翰曾被视为王位继承人，却在伦敦死于瘟疫。玛格丽特死后，他于1346年续娶乔安娜·门蒂思，生下后来的第六代伯爵罗伯特。威廉最后一次见于记载是1370年2月；他可能不久后去世，但可以确定的是他在1389年前已死。

en: William Douglas le Hardi (1243–1298), Lord of Douglas, was a Scottish border baron and the father of the Black Douglas. He may have accompanied the Earl of Atholl on the Eighth Crusade in 1270. By his first wife Elizabeth Stewart, daughter of the High Steward of Scotland, he had his heir James; in 1288 he abducted the wealthy widow Eleanor de Lovaine and made her his second wife. He joined William Wallace's rising after the English conquest, was captured in 1297 and imprisoned in the Tower of London, where he died from ill treatment in January 1298.
zh: 威廉·道格拉斯（1243—1298），绰号“大胆者”，道格拉斯领地的苏格兰边境领主，也是“黑暗的詹姆斯·道格拉斯”之父。他可能在1270年随阿索尔伯爵参加了第八次十字军东征。他先娶苏格兰最高总务官之女伊丽莎白·斯图尔特，生下继承人詹姆斯；1288年他劫走富有的寡妇埃莉诺·德·洛万并娶为继室。英格兰征服苏格兰后他加入威廉·华莱士的起义，1297年被俘并关入伦敦塔，1298年1月因遭受虐待而死。

en: William Douglas, 1st Earl of Douglas (c. 1323–1384), son of Sir Archibald Douglas, killed at Halidon Hill, and nephew of Bruce's lieutenant Sir James the Good, was raised in France as ward of the Knight of Liddesdale. He returned in 1348, drove the English from Douglasdale and harried them in Ettrick Forest, then killed Liddesdale in a 1353 feud and in 1354 gained a charter of all the Douglas lands. He married Margaret of Mar in 1357 and was created first Earl of Douglas in 1358; his sons included James, 2nd Earl, and the bastard George, Earl of Angus. He died in 1384.
zh: 第一代道格拉斯伯爵威廉·道格拉斯（约1323—1384）是战死于哈利顿山的阿奇博尔德·道格拉斯爵士之子、布鲁斯麾下名将“好人”詹姆斯爵士的侄子。他在法国由利兹代尔骑士监护长大，1348年回国，将英格兰人逐出道格拉斯谷地，并在埃特里克森林袭扰敌军。1353年，他在宿怨中杀死利兹代尔骑士，1354年获颁涵盖全部道格拉斯领地的特许状。他于1357年娶马尔的玛格丽特，1358年受封第一代道格拉斯伯爵，儿子包括第二代伯爵詹姆斯和私生子、安格斯伯爵乔治。他于1384年去世。

en: William, Lord of Douglas, was a son of the Black Douglas, James, and inherited the Douglas lands as a child after his father was killed in Spain in 1330. His uncle, Sir Archibald Douglas, guarded his inheritance. Exchequer records of 1331 name him Willelmus dominus de Duglas, and Coldingham Priory complained to David II that he and his uncle held Swinton lands unjustly. In 1333 he followed the Guardian to the relief of Berwick and was slain beside him at the Battle of Halidon Hill on 19 July, unmarried and still under age.
zh: 道格拉斯领主威廉是“黑道格拉斯”詹姆斯之子，1330年父亲在西班牙战死后，他以幼龄继承道格拉斯家族领地，由叔父阿奇博尔德·道格拉斯爵士监护家业。1331年的财政卷宗里已有“道格拉斯领主威廉”之名，科尔丁厄姆修道院的修士还曾向大卫二世申诉，称他与叔父非法占有斯温顿的田产。1333年，他随护国主出兵救援贝里克，7月19日在哈利顿山之战中与叔父一同阵亡，死时尚未成年，也未娶妻。

en: William the Lion (c. 1142–1214), younger brother of Malcolm IV, inherited Northumbria but lost it to Henry II in 1157 and became king in 1165. He made Scotland’s first treaty with France in 1168, and while backing the 1173–1174 revolt against Henry II was captured at Alnwick in 1174; the Treaty of Falaise made him Henry’s vassal until Richard I sold the release of those terms in 1189. In 1186 he married Ermengarde de Beaumont, mother of Alexander II. He extended royal power into Caithness, founded Arbroath Abbey and died in 1214 after nearly forty-nine years as king.
zh: 狮子王威廉（约1142—1214）是马尔科姆四世之弟，原领有诺森布里亚，1157年被亨利二世夺走，1165年即位为苏格兰国王。1168年他缔结苏格兰与法国之间的第一个同盟；1173—1174年他支持反对亨利二世的叛乱，1174年在阿尼克被俘，被迫签订《法莱斯条约》向亨利二世称臣，直到1189年理查一世收取款项后才解除这些条款。1186年他娶博蒙的埃芒加德为妻，后来的亚历山大二世即其所生。他把王权推进到凯斯内斯，创立阿布罗斯修道院，在位近四十九年后于1214年去世。

en: Hans Jakob Christoffel von Grimmelshausen (1621/22–1676) was a German novelist of the Thirty Years' War. Born at Gelnhausen, he was about ten when Hessian soldiers seized him; he grew up amid its armies, enlisted in the Imperial forces in 1639 and later worked as a regimental clerk. At the war's close he entered the service of the bishop of Strasbourg; he also converted to Catholicism. In 1665 he became magistrate at Renchen in Baden, where he turned to writing. His picaresque novel Simplicius Simplicissimus, published in 1669, drew on his wartime experiences and became the age's most famous German novel. It belonged to his Simplician cycle, which also included The Life of Courage. He died at Renchen in 1676.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/漢斯·雅各布·馮·克里斯托·格里梅爾斯豪森
