zh: 汉斯·雅各布·冯·克里斯托·格里梅尔斯豪森（1621/22—1676）是三十年战争时代的德国小说家。他生于盖尔恩豪森，约十岁时被黑森士兵掳走，在各路军队中长大，1639年加入帝国军队，后来在团部担任文书。战争结束时他开始效力于斯特拉斯堡主教，他也改宗了天主教。1665年他出任巴登伦欣的地方长官，此后潜心写作。1669年出版的流浪汉小说《痴儿西木传》取材于他的战争经历，成为那个时代最著名的德语小说。这部作品属于他的西木系列，系列还包括《库拉什传》。1676年，他在伦欣去世。

en: Hans Tausen (1494–1561), called the Danish Luther, was the leading theologian of the Danish Reformation. A Hospitaller monk who studied with Luther at Wittenberg from 1523, he preached the new doctrine at Viborg in Jutland under the townspeople's protection, and in 1526 King Frederick I made him a chaplain. He was the first Danish priest to marry and the first reformer to conduct services in Danish instead of Latin. He went to preach in Copenhagen in 1529. In 1533 he was sentenced to expulsion from the diocese, but protected the bishop from an angry crowd. In 1535 he printed the first Danish Pentateuch. He later became Bishop of Ribe in 1542, holding the see until his death in 1561.
zh: 汉斯·陶森（1494—1561）人称‘丹麦的路德’，是丹麦宗教改革中最重要的神学家。他本是医院骑士团修士，1523年起到维滕贝格随路德学习，回国后在日德兰的维堡宣讲新教教义，受到持武器的市民保护；1526年弗雷德里克一世任命他为宫廷牧师。他是第一位结婚的丹麦神父，也是改革派中第一个用丹麦语而非拉丁语主持礼拜的人。1529年他前往哥本哈根讲道。1533年他被判逐出教区，却保护主教免遭愤怒的人群伤害。1535年他印行第一部丹麦语摩西五经。1542年他出任里伯主教，任职至1561年去世。

en: John Knox (c. 1514–1572) was the leading Reformer of Scotland. Born at Haddington and ordained a priest, he embraced Protestant teaching through George Wishart. After Cardinal Beaton's murder in 1546, French forces captured Knox and sent him to the galleys; released in 1549, he served Edward VI in England and influenced the Book of Common Prayer. He then fled under Mary I to Geneva, where he studied with John Calvin and wrote an order of service later adopted by the Scottish church. Returning to Scotland in 1559, he led the Reformation that overthrew the regent Mary of Guise, helped frame the Kirk's 1560 confession and Presbyterian order, and challenged Mary, Queen of Scots. He died at Edinburgh in 1572.
zh: 约翰·诺克斯（约1514—1572）是苏格兰宗教改革的领袖。他生于哈丁顿，早年受任神父，因乔治·威沙特而接受新教教义。1546年红衣主教比顿遇刺后，诺克斯被法军俘获、罚做桨手；1549年获释后在英格兰侍奉爱德华六世，影响了《公祷书》的内容。玛丽一世复辟天主教后，他逃往日内瓦，师从约翰·加尔文，并编写了后来为苏格兰教会采用的礼拜仪式。1559年他返回苏格兰，领导了推翻摄政玛丽·德·吉斯的宗教改革，参与制定苏格兰教会1560年的信仰告白与长老制教规，并多次当面诤谏苏格兰女王玛丽。1572年他在爱丁堡去世。

en: Przemysł of Inowrocław (c. 1278–1338/39), a Piast, the second son of Ziemomysł of Kuyavia, inherited his father's duchy in 1287 under regency. He submitted to Wenceslaus II of Bohemia in 1300, but from 1306 served his uncle Władysław I Łokietek as governor of Gdańsk Pomerania until the Teutonic Order seized it in 1309. He ruled Bydgoszcz and Wyszogród from 1314 and recovered Inowrocław after his brother Leszek abdicated between 1320 and 1324. In 1327 or 1328 he exchanged Inowrocław for Sieradz, whose lands the Teutonic Knights ravaged soon after. He died unmarried in late 1338 or early 1339.
zh: 伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫的普热梅斯乌（约1278—1338/1339）是皮亚斯特王朝王公、库亚维的齐莫梅斯乌的次子，1287年在摄政下继承父亲的公国。他于1300年臣服波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫二世，但1306年起为叔父瓦迪斯瓦夫一世（“矮子”）担任格但斯克波美拉尼亚总督，直到1309年条顿骑士团夺取该地。1314年起他统治比得哥什和维绍格罗德，约1320至1324年兄长莱谢克退位后重新取得伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫。1327至1328年，他以伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫交换谢拉兹，此后的战争中谢拉兹遭条顿骑士蹂躏。他于1338年底或1339年初去世，终身未娶。

en: Ziemomysł of Inowrocław (c. 1245–1287) was the second son of Casimir I of Kuyavia and a Piast prince. On his father's death in 1267 he inherited the Inowrocław district, where he leaned on German knights supplied by his father-in-law Sambor II of Pomerania. That policy provoked a revolt of the local knighthood and an invasion by Bolesław the Pious, who drove him out in 1271. He recovered his duchy in 1278 through his brother Leszek II the Black, and in 1284 joined Leszek's war against the Teutonic Order. He died late in 1287.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/伊諾弗羅茨瓦夫的謝莫米斯烏
zh: 伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫的谢莫米斯乌（约1245—1287）是库亚维公爵卡齐米日一世的次子，皮亚斯特家族王公。1267年父亲死后，他分得伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫领地，倚仗岳父波美拉尼亚公爵桑博尔二世提供的德意志骑士。这一政策激起当地骑士叛乱，虔诚者博莱斯瓦夫乘机入侵，于1271年将他逐走。1278年，他借兄长“黑色的”莱谢克二世之力恢复公国，1284年又随莱谢克参加对条顿骑士团的战争。他于1287年末去世。

en: Alexander Komnenos Asen was a Bulgarian noble in the Serbian Empire, the son of Despot John Komnenos Asen and nephew of Tsar Ivan Alexander of Bulgaria and Empress Helena of Serbia. On his father's death, probably in 1363, he succeeded as sebastos and lord of Kanina and Valona on the Adriatic coast, trading widely with Venice and Ragusa. He soon lost both cities to the Albanian lord Andrea II Muzaka. He is thought to have fallen at the Battle of the Maritsa on 26 September 1371, and by 1372 his lands belonged to Balša II.
zh: 亚历山大·科穆宁·阿森是塞尔维亚帝国治下的保加利亚贵族，专制公约翰·科穆宁·阿森之子，保加利亚沙皇伊万·亚历山大与塞尔维亚皇后海伦娜的侄子。约1363年父亲死后，他继任塞巴斯托斯，领有亚得里亚海沿岸的卡尼纳和发罗拉，与威尼斯、拉古萨广泛通商。不久，两城都被阿尔巴尼亚领主安德烈二世·穆扎卡夺取。一般认为他于1371年9月26日的马里查河战役中阵亡；到1372年，其领地已落入巴尔沙二世之手。

en: Ana-Neda (fl. 1323–1357) was a Serbian princess, daughter of King Stefan Uroš II Milutin. Her husband Michael Shishman, despot of Vidin, became emperor of Bulgaria in 1323 but divorced her in 1324 to marry a Byzantine princess, imprisoning her and their sons. After Michael died at Velbazhd in 1330, her brother King Stefan Uroš III placed her son Ivan Stephen on the Bulgarian throne, and she may have ruled as regent. Deposed with her son in 1331, she took refuge in Dubrovnik. She may later have become a nun and was buried at Dečani; she was venerated as Saint Jelena.
zh: 安娜-内达（活跃于1323—1357年）是塞尔维亚内马尼奇王朝的公主，国王斯特凡·乌罗什二世·米卢廷之女。她的丈夫、维丁专制公米哈伊尔·希什曼于1323年成为保加利亚皇帝，却在1324年为迎娶拜占庭公主而与她离婚，并囚禁了她和几个儿子。1330年米哈伊尔死于韦尔巴日德战役后，她的兄长塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·乌罗什三世把她的儿子伊凡·斯蒂芬扶上保加利亚王位，安娜-内达可能曾摄政。1331年她随儿子被废，逃往杜布罗夫尼克避难。她后来可能出家，葬于代查尼修道院，被尊为圣叶连娜。

en: Andronikos Angelos Palaiologos (c. 1282–1328) was a Byzantine aristocrat, grandson of Michael II of Epirus through his father Demetrios Koutroules and of Emperor Michael VIII through his mother Anna. By 1326 he was protovestiarios and protosebastos, and in 1327–28 he governed Velegrada. In the civil war between Andronikos II and Andronikos III he first backed the grandson, then changed sides. When Andronikos III won in 1328, his family was seized and his Macedonian estates confiscated; he fled to Serbia and died in exile at Prilep the same year. His daughter Anna became queen consort of Epirus.
zh: 安德罗尼科斯·安格洛斯·巴列奥略（约1282—1328）是拜占庭贵族：通过父亲德米特里·库特鲁莱斯为伊庇鲁斯统治者米海尔二世之孙，通过母亲安娜为皇帝米海尔八世的外孙。到1326年，他已身兼御衣总管和首席至尊者之职，1327—1328年出守韦莱格拉达（今培拉特）。在安德罗尼科斯二世与安德罗尼科斯三世的内战中，他先支持皇孙，后又倒戈。1328年安德罗尼科斯三世获胜后，他的家人被捕、马其顿地产被没收，他逃往塞尔维亚，同年死于流亡地普里莱普。其女安娜后来成为伊庇鲁斯王后。

en: Anna was the wife of the Bulgarian noble Ivan Dragushin of the Terter dynasty, who held lands in Macedonia under the Serbian king Stefan Dušan. Their son appears with Ivan's mother Marina in the frescoes of the Pološko Monastery, where Ivan was buried before 1340.
zh: 安娜是保加利亚特尔特王朝贵族伊万·德拉古申之妻，伊万在塞尔维亚国王斯特芬·杜尚治下领有马其顿的土地。他们的儿子与伊万之母玛丽娜一同出现在波洛什修道院的壁画中，伊万于1340年前葬在该院。

en: Anna Dandolo (died c. 1258) was a Venetian noblewoman of the powerful Dandolo family, daughter of Vice-Doge Rainero Dandolo and granddaughter of Doge Enrico Dandolo. Her father was killed fighting the Genoese in Crete in 1209. Around 1217 she married Stefan, Grand Prince of Serbia, at Venice, and the couple sailed to Dalmatia. She was crowned beside him in 1217 when he became the first crowned king of Serbia. The marriage linked Orthodox Serbia to Venice, drawing Venetian artisans and Latin influence into the kingdom. Their son Stefan Uroš I succeeded to the throne in 1243. Long outliving her husband, Anna died around 1258 and was buried at Sopoćani Monastery.
zh: 安娜·丹多洛（约1258年卒）出身威尼斯权贵丹多洛家族，是威尼斯副总督拉伊纳罗·丹多洛之女、总督恩里科·丹多洛的孙女。她的父亲于1209年在克里特与热那亚人的战斗中阵亡。约1217年，她在威尼斯嫁给塞尔维亚大亲王斯特凡，随后夫妇二人乘船前往达尔马提亚。1217年斯特凡加冕为塞尔维亚第一位国王时，她与他一同受封王后。这桩联姻把信奉东正教的塞尔维亚与威尼斯联系起来，引来威尼斯工匠，也带来拉丁文化的影响。她的儿子斯特凡·乌罗斯一世于1243年继承王位。安娜在丈夫死后长年在世，约1258年去世，葬于索波查尼修道院。

en: Đorđe Nemanjić was the eldest son of Vukan Nemanjić and ruled Zeta as the heir of his branch of the Nemanjići. After his father's death he styled himself king of Duklja, and about 1208 accepted the suzerainty of Venice to shield his ports and his independence from his uncle Stefan the First-Crowned. In a treaty of 3 July 1208 he promised Venice military support if Dimitri of Arbanon at Kroja attacked Venetian territory. By 1216 Stefan had conquered Zeta and ended its independence, but Đorđe kept a regional lordship as prince of Duklja. He appears in sources for the last time in 1242.
zh: 乔尔杰·内马尼奇是武坎·内马尼奇的长子，以内马尼奇家族这支继承人的身份统治泽塔。父亲死后，他自称杜克里亚国王，并于约1208年接受威尼斯的宗主权，以保护港口、抵御叔父“首任国王”斯特凡的吞并。1208年7月3日的条约中，他许诺若盘踞克鲁亚的阿尔巴农首领迪米特里进攻威尼斯领地，便向威尼斯提供军事援助。到1216年，斯特凡已征服泽塔，结束了其独立，但乔尔杰仍以杜克里亚王公身份保有一块领地。1242年是他最后一次见于史料。

en: Dmitar Nemanjić, also called Dimitrije, was a son of Grand Prince Vukan Nemanjić and nephew of Stefan the First-Crowned. As župan of Polimlje he asked Emperor Michael VIII Palaiologos in April 1271 to grant the Hilandar Monastery an estate on the Struma River. Using masons from Dubrovnik he built the Davidovica Monastery near Brodarevo, completed by August 1281. Late in life he took monastic vows as the monk David, and in 1286 he went on pilgrimage to Jerusalem. His son Vratislav was grandfather of Princess Milica of Serbia, and the Orthodox Church venerates him as Saint David.
zh: 德米塔尔·内马尼奇，又名迪米特里耶，是大茹潘武坎·内马尼奇之子、“首任国王”斯特凡的侄子。他受封波利姆列地区的茹潘，1271年4月曾请求皇帝米哈伊尔八世·帕里奥洛格斯把斯特鲁马河畔的一处产业赐给希勒德修道院。他雇用杜布罗夫尼克石匠，在利姆河畔布罗达雷沃附近修建达维多维察修道院，于1281年8月前竣工。晚年他出家为修士，取名大卫，1286年启程前往耶路撒冷朝圣。他的儿子弗拉蒂斯拉夫是塞尔维亚公主米莉察的祖父，东正教会奉他为圣大卫。

en: Dragana, also called Draginja, was a sister of Prince Lazar and the wife of čelnik Musa, governor of Brvenik under Emperor Stefan Uroš V. Her sons Stefan and Lazar Musić fell fighting at the Battle of Kosovo in 1389.
zh: 德拉加娜（一称德拉吉尼亚）是拉扎尔大公的姊妹，嫁给乌罗什五世朝出守布尔韦尼克的首领穆萨；其子斯特凡和拉扎尔·穆西奇于1389年在科索沃战役中战死。

en: George (Đurađ I) Balšić (died 1378) was lord of Zeta from 1362, eldest son of Balša I, whose family dominated the coastal Serbian lands after Stefan Dušan's death. He warred on Karl Thopia of Albania, who held him captive from 1364 to his Ragusan-mediated release in 1366; he besieged Kotor and converted to Catholicism in 1369. The Serbian court regarded his attack on Kotor as rebellion, while Venice complained about his ships in the Adriatic. After the Battle of Maritsa in 1371 he made Zeta independent, taking Prizren and Peć from King Marko. In 1375 he and Lazar Hrebeljanović convened the assembly that elected Patriarch Jefrem. He died at Skadar in January 1378, leaving Zeta to Balša II.
zh: 乔治（杜拉一世）·巴尔希奇（？—1378）1362年起任泽塔领主，是巴尔沙一世的长子；斯特凡·杜尚死后，巴尔希奇家族在他这一代称雄塞尔维亚沿海地区。他与阿尔巴尼亚的卡尔·托皮亚交战，1364年被俘，经杜布罗夫尼克调停于1366年获释；他曾围攻科托尔，1369年改宗天主教。塞尔维亚宫廷将他进攻科托尔视为叛乱，威尼斯则抱怨他的船只出现在亚得里亚海。1371年马里查战役后，他使泽塔取得独立，并从马尔科国王手中夺取普里兹伦和佩奇。1375年，他与拉扎尔·赫雷别利亚诺维奇共同召开会议，选出牧首耶夫雷姆。他于1378年1月在斯库台去世，泽塔传给其弟巴尔沙二世。

en: Helena of Bulgaria (c. 1315 – 7 November 1374), born Elena Sratsimir, was a Bulgarian princess, queen and empress consort of Stefan Dušan of Serbia. Daughter of despot Sratsimir of Kran and Keratsa Petritsa and sister of Tsar Ivan Alexander, she married Dušan in April 1332 to seal the Bulgarian-Serbian peace, bearing him Stefan Uroš V and a daughter Theodora. After Dušan's death in 1355 she was regent for her son and ruled a principality around Serres and the Chalcidice. She took the veil as Elizabeth in 1359, governed Serres until 1365, and was canonized as Saint Elizabeth.
zh: 海伦娜（约1315—1374年11月7日），本名埃莱娜·斯拉齐米尔，是保加利亚公主，塞尔维亚国王、后称帝的斯特凡·杜尚的王后与皇后。她是克兰专制公斯拉齐米尔与克拉察·佩特里察之女、沙皇伊万·亚历山大的姐妹，1332年4月依据保加利亚—塞尔维亚和约嫁给杜尚，生下斯特凡·乌罗什五世及女儿狄奥多拉。1355年杜尚死后，她代子摄政，并以塞雷和哈尔基季基为中心统治自己的领地。1359年她出家为修女，法名伊丽莎白，统治塞雷至1365年，身后被东正教会尊为圣伊丽莎白。

en: Helena Doukaina Angelina was a Greek noblewoman of Thessaly, daughter of its sebastokrator John I Doukas and Hypomone. Around 1273 to 1276 she married Stefan Uroš II Milutin of Serbia, who became king in 1282. Milutin abandoned her around 1283. She may have been the mother of Stefan Konstantin, later a claimant to the Serbian throne, and seems to have returned to Greece.
zh: 海伦娜·杜卡伊娜·安格利娜是色萨利的希腊贵族女子，父亲是色萨利至尊者约翰一世·杜卡斯，母亲为希波莫尼。约1273至1276年间，她嫁给塞尔维亚的斯特凡·乌罗什二世·米卢廷；米卢廷于1282年成为国王，却在约1283年将她遗弃。她可能是后来争夺塞尔维亚王位的斯特凡·康斯坦丁之母，此后似乎返回了希腊。

en: Hrelja, also called Stefan Dragovol or Hrelja Ohmućević (died 27 December 1342), was a Serbian lord whose domain around Štip, and later Strumica, lay where Serbia, Bulgaria and Byzantium met. He served Kings Milutin, Dečanski and Dušan, and in the 1320s led a Serbian detachment to help Andronikos II in a Byzantine civil war. In 1334–1335 he rebuilt the church of Rila Monastery and raised Hrelja's Tower, with a chapel of the Transfiguration on top; its inscription names Dušan as his lord. By the late 1330s he had broken away and ruled from Strumica, nominally under Byzantium. In the next civil war he backed John VI Kantakouzenos, who gave him Melnik and the title protosebastos. In summer 1342 Kantakouzenos, seeking Serbian help, gave him up: Hrelja acknowledged Dušan again and ceded Melnik. He became the monk Hariton and died at Rila that December, said by Bulgarian sources to have been killed on Dušan's orders.
zh: 赫雷利亚，又名斯特凡·德拉戈沃尔、赫雷利亚·奥赫穆切维奇（？—1342年12月27日），是塞尔维亚领主，领地以什蒂普为中心，后来又纳入斯特鲁米察，正处在塞尔维亚、保加利亚与拜占庭的交界处。他先后效力于米卢丁、德钱斯基和杜尚三位国王，1320年代曾率塞尔维亚分队在拜占庭内战中援助安德洛尼卡二世。1334—1335年，他重建里拉修道院的教堂，并修起赫雷利亚塔，塔顶设变容礼拜堂，塔上的铭文称杜尚为他的君主。1330年代末他脱离塞尔维亚，以斯特鲁米察为都，名义上臣属拜占庭。下一次拜占庭内战中他支持约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯，获封梅尔尼克和首席至尊者头衔。1342年夏，坎塔库泽努斯为换取塞尔维亚的支持而舍弃了他：赫雷利亚重新承认杜尚的宗主权，交出梅尔尼克。他在里拉修道院出家，法名哈里顿，同年12月去世，据保加利亚方面的记载，他是奉杜尚之命被害。

en: John Palaiologos (1288/89–1326) was a Byzantine aristocrat of the Palaiologos dynasty, the son of the general Constantine Palaiologos and grandson of Emperor Michael VIII. In 1305 he received the rank of panhypersebastos and soon married Eirene, daughter of Theodore Metochites. By 1325 he was governor of Thessalonica. In 1326 he rebelled against his uncle, Emperor Andronikos II, and joined the Serbian king Stefan Dečanski in raiding Byzantine Macedonia as far as Serres. Offered the title of Caesar, he submitted, but fell ill and died at Skopje the same year. His daughter Maria became Dečanski's queen.
zh: 约翰·巴列奥略（1288/89—1326）是拜占庭巴列奥略王朝贵族，将军君士坦丁·巴列奥略之子、皇帝米哈伊尔八世之孙。1305年他获授“至尊者”宫廷荣衔，不久娶狄奥多罗斯·梅托希特斯之女伊琳娜为妻。1325年前后任塞萨洛尼基总督。1326年他反叛伯父安德洛尼卡二世皇帝，投奔塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·德钱斯基，随其洗劫拜占庭属马其顿，兵锋远至塞雷。皇帝以凯撒头衔相诱，他于是归顺，却在同年病卒于斯科普里。其女玛丽亚后来成为德钱斯基的王后。

en: Ivan Dragushin (fl. 1299–1340), also called Jovan Dragušin, was a Bulgarian nobleman, the son of Despot Aldimir of Kran from the Cuman Terter dynasty and Marina Smilets, daughter of Tsar Smilets. After Aldimir was possibly killed around 1305, he and his mother took refuge in Constantinople and then in Serbia, where his aunt Teodora was queen to Stefan Dečanski. His cousin Stefan Dušan enfeoffed him with lands around the Crna River in Macedonia. With his mother he founded the Pološko Monastery near Kavadarci, where he was buried before 1340. He and his wife Anna had a son.
zh: 伊万·德拉古申（活跃于1299—1340年），又译约万·德拉古申，是保加利亚贵族，克兰专制公阿尔迪米尔与沙皇斯米莱茨之女玛丽娜·斯米莱茨之子，父系出自库曼人的捷尔捷尔家族。约1305年阿尔迪米尔可能遇害后，他随母亲先逃往君士坦丁堡，再转赴塞尔维亚，投奔姨母、斯特凡·德钱斯基的王后狄奥多拉。表兄斯特凡·杜尚将马其顿境内茨尔纳河一带封给他。他与母亲共同修建了卡瓦达尔齐附近的波洛什科修道院，1340年之前葬于该院。他与妻子安娜生有一子。

en: Jefimija (1349–1405), secular name Jelena, was the daughter of Caesar Vojihna of Drama and the wife of Despot Jovan Uglješa Mrnjavčević. She is honoured as the first female poet of medieval Serbia. Her Lament for a Dead Son was engraved on the back of a diptych after her infant son Uglješa died and was buried beside Vojihna at Hilandar, and her Encomium of Prince Lazar is another landmark of old Serbian literature. She was also a skilled needlewoman and engraver, lived her later years as a nun, and died in 1405.
zh: 耶菲米娅（1349—1405），俗名耶莱娜，是德拉马凯撒沃伊赫纳之女、专制公约万·乌格列沙·姆尔尼亚夫切维奇之妻，被尊为中世纪塞尔维亚第一位女诗人。幼子乌格列沙夭折后葬于希兰达尔修道院的沃伊赫纳墓旁，她把《悼亡子》刻在一座双联圣像的背面；另一篇《拉扎尔颂》也是古塞尔维亚文学的名篇。她还是技艺精湛的刺绣与雕刻匠人，晚年出家为尼，1405年去世。

en: Jelena was a Serbian noblewoman and the first wife of King Stefan Uroš II Milutin of Serbia. She was the mother of Stefan Uroš III, called Dečanski, who was born around 1276 and later ruled as king of Serbia.
zh: 叶莱娜是塞尔维亚贵族女子，塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·乌罗什二世·米卢丁的第一任妻子。她是斯特凡·乌罗什三世（德查斯基）的生母，后者约1276年出生，后来成为塞尔维亚国王。

en: Jelena Nemanjić Šubić was a daughter of King Stefan Uroš III Dečanski by Maria Palaiologina and a half-sister of Stefan Dušan. She married the Croatian magnate Mladen III Šubić and ruled with him from Klis fortress in Dalmatia. Widowed in 1348, she held Klis and Skradin for her young son Mladen IV, pressed by Venice and King Louis I of Hungary. In 1355 she refused Venice's offer to buy the towns and called on Dušan for aid, but after his death that December Skradin passed to Venice and Klis to Hungary; Palman led her away, leaving Mladen IV a hostage.
zh: 耶莱娜·内马尼奇·舒比奇是塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·乌罗什三世·德钱斯基与玛丽亚·巴列奥略之女、斯特凡·杜尚的异母妹妹。她嫁给克罗地亚大贵族姆拉登三世·舒比奇，与丈夫同以达尔马提亚的克利斯要塞为治所。1348年姆拉登死后，她代幼子姆拉登四世坚守克利斯和斯克拉丁，承受威尼斯与匈牙利国王拉约什一世的压力。1355年她拒绝威尼斯购城之议，向杜尚求援；杜尚于12月死后，斯克拉丁归于威尼斯，克利斯落入匈牙利之手，帕尔曼带她离开，姆拉登四世被留作人质。

en: Elizabeth of Serbia (Jelisaveta Nemanjić, fl. 1270–1331) was the daughter of King Stefan Dragutin of Syrmia and Catherine of Hungary. After 1283 she married Stephen I Kotromanić, ban of Bosnia, a match arranged by Ban Prijezda II to win her father's alliance; Dragutin already held the Bosnian lands of Usora and Soli, and Stephen ruled under his influence. Her children included Stephen II, Vladislav, Ninoslav and Catherine. After he died in 1314 she was briefly regent for the young Stephen II, then took refuge in Ragusa, where she died about 1331. Through her, her grandson Tvrtko I later claimed the Serbian throne.
zh: 塞尔维亚的伊丽莎白（耶丽萨维塔·内马尼奇，活跃于1270—1331年）是斯雷姆国王斯特凡·德拉古廷与匈牙利的卡塔琳娜之女。1283年后，她嫁给波斯尼亚班斯捷潘一世·科特罗马尼奇；这场婚姻由班普里耶兹达二世安排，用以换取德拉古廷的同盟。德拉古廷此时已据有乌索拉和索利两处波斯尼亚领地，斯捷潘也在他的影响下统治。她的子女包括斯捷潘二世、弗拉迪斯拉夫、尼诺斯拉夫和卡塔琳娜。1314年丈夫死后，她一度为年幼的斯捷潘二世摄政，随后避居拉古萨，约1331年在那里去世。她的孙子特夫尔特科一世后来正是凭借她的血统主张塞尔维亚王位。

en: Lazar Hrebeljanović (c. 1329–15 June 1389) began as a stavilac, a court cupbearer, to Tsar Stefan Dušan, and married Princess Milica around 1353. After Dušan died in 1355 the Serbian Empire broke into the domains of magnates. By 1371 Lazar held Rudnik as knez, or prince. That September the Ottomans destroyed the Mrnjavčević brothers at the Maritsa, and in December the Nemanjić dynasty ended with Tsar Uroš; Lazar took Priština and Novo Brdo, and in 1373, with Tvrtko of Bosnia, defeated Nikola Altomanović. His Moravian Serbia became the largest Serbian state. He sought to restore the empire with the Church's backing, though the nobility never accepted him as supreme ruler, and he built Ravanica Monastery. On 15 June 1389 he led the Christian army against Sultan Murad I on Kosovo Polje. Both rulers died in a battle that was tactically a draw but ruinous for the Serbs, and the Church later venerated Lazar as a martyr and saint.
zh: 拉扎尔·赫雷别利亚诺维奇（约1329—1389年6月15日）起初只是沙皇斯特凡·杜尚宫廷里的侍饮官，约1353年娶米莉察公主为妻。1355年杜尚去世后，塞尔维亚帝国分裂成各地大贵族的领地。到1371年，拉扎尔已占有鲁德尼克，以王公（克涅兹）自居。当年9月，奥斯曼人在马里查河击溃姆尔尼亚夫切维奇兄弟；12月，乌罗什皇帝去世，内马尼奇王朝绝嗣。拉扎尔夺取普里什蒂纳和新布尔多，1373年又与波斯尼亚的特夫尔特科联手击败尼古拉·阿尔托马诺维奇。他的摩拉瓦塞尔维亚成为最大的塞尔维亚国家。他试图在教会支持下重建帝国，但贵族始终不承认他是最高统治者；他还修建了拉瓦尼察修道院。1389年6月15日，他率领基督教联军在科索沃平原迎战苏丹穆拉德一世。双方统帅都阵亡，这一仗在战术上是平局，却使塞尔维亚元气大伤；教会后来尊拉扎尔为殉道者和圣徒。

en: Maria Palaiologina (died 1355) was queen consort of Serbia as the second wife of King Stefan Uroš III Dečanski, whom she married in 1324. The daughter of John Palaiologos, Byzantine governor of Thessaloniki, and Eirene Metochitissa, she was a great-niece of Emperor Andronikos II. She bore Dečanski a son, Simeon Uroš, and daughters Jelena and Teodora. After Stefan Dušan deposed Dečanski, who was then killed at Zvečan in 1331–1332, Maria sought Byzantine backing to place Simeon on the throne, in vain. She took the veil as Marta and died at Skopje on 7 April 1355.
zh: 玛丽亚·巴列奥略（逝于1355年）是塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·乌罗什三世·德钱斯基的第二任王后，两人于1324年成婚。她是拜占庭塞萨洛尼基总督约翰·巴列奥略与伊琳娜·梅托希蒂萨之女、皇帝安德洛尼卡二世的侄孙女，与德钱斯基育有一子西梅翁·乌罗什以及耶莱娜、特奥多拉两女。1331—1332年斯特凡·杜尚废黜德钱斯基、后者在兹韦钱被杀后，玛丽亚寻求拜占庭支持以拥立西梅翁继位，未能成功。她出家为修女，法名玛尔塔，于1355年4月7日在斯科普里去世。

en: Marina Smilets (before 1292 – 7 April 1355) was a Bulgarian princess, the eldest daughter of Tsar Smilets and his Byzantine wife Smiltsena Palaiologina. Her father took the Bulgarian throne in 1292, and her younger brother became Tsar Ivan II. She married Aldimir, the Terterid despot of Kran, and bore him a son, Ivan Dragushin. After Aldimir was possibly killed around 1305, she fled with the boy to Serbia, where her sister Teodora was the first wife of King Stefan Dečanski. As the maternal aunt of Stefan Dušan she remained close to the Serbian court, and her donor portrait survives at the Pološko Monastery near Kavadarci.
zh: 玛丽娜·斯米莱茨（1292年前—1355年4月7日）是保加利亚公主，沙皇斯米莱茨与拜占庭妻子斯米尔采娜·巴列奥略的长女。她的父亲于1292年登上保加利亚王位，弟弟后来成为沙皇伊万二世。她嫁给克兰的专制公、捷尔捷尔家族的阿尔迪米尔，生子伊万·德拉古申。约1305年阿尔迪米尔可能遇害后，她携幼子逃往塞尔维亚，因为她的妹妹狄奥多拉正是国王斯特凡·德钱斯基的第一任王后。作为斯特凡·杜尚的姨母，她长期居于塞尔维亚宫廷；她的捐献者画像现存于卡瓦达尔齐附近的波洛什科修道院。

en: Milica (c. 1335–1405), daughter of Prince Vratko of a collateral branch of the Nemanjić dynasty, married Prince Lazar Hrebeljanović. When Lazar fell at Kosovo Polje in 1389, she ruled Serbia as regent for their son Stefan Lazarević until he came of age in 1393. The first months were the worst: Sigismund's Hungarians took northern fortresses and reached Kragujevac, Vuk Branković tried to unseat her, and when the Ottomans reached her border in the summer of 1390 she accepted their suzerainty and let them pass freely through her lands. She founded Ljubostinja monastery about 1390 and took the veil there around 1393 as the nun Eugenia. In 1397 she issued ‘A Mother's Prayer’ with her sons at Dečani, and she wrote a lament for her husband. In 1403 she went to the sultan at Serres to argue for Stefan in a dispute between her sons and Branković. She died on 11 November 1405, was buried at Ljubostinja and was canonised.
zh: 米莉察（约1335—1405）是内马尼奇王朝旁系的弗拉特科亲王之女，嫁给拉扎尔·赫雷别利亚诺维奇大公。1389年拉扎尔在科索沃平原战死，她代儿子斯特凡·拉扎列维奇摄政塞尔维亚，直到1393年他成年。最难的是头几个月：西吉斯蒙德的匈牙利军攻占北部要塞，打到克拉古耶瓦茨；武克·布兰科维奇谋求推翻她；1390年夏天奥斯曼人兵临边境，她接受奥斯曼宗主权，允许他们自由通过领地。约1390年她修建柳博斯蒂尼亚修道院，约1393年在那里出家，法名叶夫根尼娅。1397年她与儿子们在代昌尼修道院发布《母亲的祈祷》，并写下哀悼丈夫的挽歌。1403年她前往塞雷斯面见苏丹，在儿子们与布兰科维奇的纷争中为斯特凡辩护。她于1405年11月11日去世，葬于柳博斯蒂尼亚，后被封圣。

en: Nikola Nemanjić was a Serbian župan, a son of Vratko Nemanjić and brother of Princess Milica. A burial inscription of 1379 records his name, title and parentage, and the Nemanjić genealogy lists him among Vratko's children.
zh: 尼古拉·内马尼奇是塞尔维亚茹潘，弗拉特科·内马尼奇之子、米莉察公主的兄弟。1379年的一方墓葬铭文记载了他的名字、头衔与身世，内马尼奇谱系也把他列为弗拉特科之子。

en: Pribac Hrebeljanović (c. 1300–1362) was a Serbian nobleman who backed Stefan Dušan's rise and whose son Lazar would become prince of Serbia as the empire fell apart. His father Hrebljan, a merchant who rose in the army of Stefan Milutin, became governor of Stalać. Pribac commanded a thousand men under the Dečani edict of 1330 and fought at Velbazhd and in the capture of Prilep and Ohrid. When Dušan revolted against his father Stefan of Dečani, Pribac gave him full support and was rewarded with Kosovo estates and the title of logothete, attested in a charter of 1343. He held Prilepac and Prizrenac, organized royal feasts, weddings and meetings, and may have become royal chancellor. When the Serbian Empire took shape and many nobles gained higher titles and more land, none was offered to him. He died at Ferizaj in 1362; Lazar fell fighting the Ottomans at Kosovo in 1389.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/皮里巴茨·赫雷别利亚诺维奇
zh: 皮里巴茨·赫雷别利亚诺维奇（约1300—1362）是塞尔维亚贵族，支持斯特凡·杜尚崛起，他的儿子拉扎尔后来在塞尔维亚帝国瓦解之际成为塞尔维亚王公。其父赫雷布良是在斯特凡·米卢廷军中发迹的商人，后任斯塔拉奇长官。皮里巴茨曾按1330年的德查尼敕令统领千人，参加韦尔巴日德战役以及攻取普里莱普和奥赫里德的战事。杜尚反叛其父斯特凡·德查尼时，他全力支持，因而得到科索沃的封地与书记官头衔，1343年杜尚的特许状中即以此头衔提到他。他拥有普里莱帕茨和普里兹雷纳茨，负责组织王室宴会、婚礼和会议，也可能出任过王室大臣。塞尔维亚帝国形成时，许多贵族获得更高的头衔和更多土地，他却没有得到。1362年他在费里扎伊去世；拉扎尔于1389年在科索沃与奥斯曼人作战时阵亡。

en: The wife of the Serbian logothete Pribac Hrebeljanović is unnamed in the sources. She was the mother of Prince Lazar Hrebeljanović, who fell fighting the Ottomans at Kosovo in 1389, and of a daughter named Dragana.
zh: 塞尔维亚财计官普里巴茨·赫雷别利亚诺维奇之妻，姓名不见于史料。她是1389年在科索沃之战中战死的拉扎尔大公之母，还生有一女德拉加娜。

en: Ratoslava was the wife of the Serbian grand župan Altoman Vojinović and the mother of the magnate Nikola Altomanović, born in 1348.
zh: 拉托斯拉娃是塞尔维亚大茹潘阿尔托曼·沃伊诺维奇之妻，1348年生下后来成为割据大贵族的尼古拉·阿尔托马诺维奇。

en: Simeon Uroš, nicknamed Siniša (c. 1326–1370), was a son of King Stefan Dečanski of Serbia by the Byzantine princess Maria Palaiologina, and half-brother of Emperor Dušan. Dušan named him despot in 1346 and governor of Epirus and Acarnania in 1347; he won over the local aristocracy by marrying Thomais Orsini, daughter of the region's former ruler John II Orsini. When Dušan died in 1355 and his son Stefan Uroš V took the throne, Simeon tried to make himself co-ruler and master of the empire's southern provinces. In 1356 he came into conflict with his nephew while trying to take Thessaly and Macedonia. He then proclaimed himself emperor of the Serbs and Greeks and ruled a separate state centred on Thessaly and Epirus, splitting the south away from the empire, until his death in 1370. His son Jovan Uroš succeeded him.
zh: 西缅·乌罗斯，绰号西尼沙（约1326—1370），是塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·德钱斯基与拜占庭公主玛丽亚·帕里奥洛吉娜之子，皇帝杜尚的异母弟。1346年，杜尚封他为专制公，1347年任命他为伊庇鲁斯和阿卡纳尼亚总督；他迎娶该地区旧统治者乔瓦尼二世·奥尔西尼之女托马伊丝·奥尔西尼，争取到当地贵族。1355年杜尚去世，其子斯特凡·乌罗什五世继位，西缅谋求成为共治者，并掌控帝国的南方诸省。1356年，他试图夺取色萨利和马其顿，与侄子发生冲突。此后他自称塞尔维亚人与希腊人的皇帝，在色萨利和伊庇鲁斯另立一国，使帝国南部脱离出去，直至1370年去世。其子约万·乌罗斯继位。

en: Simonida (c. 1294 – after 1336), born Simonis Palaiologina, was a Byzantine princess and queen consort of Serbia as the wife of King Stefan Milutin. A daughter of Emperor Andronikos II Palaiologos and Irene of Montferrat, she was promised to Milutin in 1298 to seal peace after a Byzantine defeat, and married him at Thessalonica in spring 1299, aged five. Her Greek entourage brought Byzantine court ceremony, titles and law to Serbia. A patron of arts and letters, she appears in a celebrated fresco at Gračanica monastery. After Milutin's death in 1321 she returned to Constantinople and became a nun.
zh: 西莫妮达（约1294—1336年后），原名西莫妮斯·巴列奥略，是拜占庭公主，后成为塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·米卢廷的王后。她是拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡二世与蒙费拉托的伊琳娜之女；1298年拜占庭战败后被许配给米卢廷以巩固和约，1299年春两人在塞萨洛尼基成婚，时年五岁。她带来的希腊随从将拜占庭宫廷礼仪、头衔与法律引入塞尔维亚。她赞助文艺，格拉查尼察修道院中她的壁画像极为著名。1321年米卢廷死后，她回到君士坦丁堡，成为修女。

en: The unnamed son of the Bulgarian noble Ivan Dragushin and his wife Anna, he appears beside his grandmother Marina Smilets in a donor portrait in the Pološko Monastery church near Kavadarci.
zh: 他是保加利亚贵族伊万·德拉古申与妻子安娜之子，姓名不见于记载，在卡瓦达尔齐附近波洛什科修道院教堂的捐献者画像中与祖母玛丽娜·斯米莱茨一同出现。

en: Stefan Uroš I, Uroš the Great (c. 1223–1 May 1277), was the youngest son of Stefan the First-Crowned and Anna Dandolo, granddaughter of the Venetian doge Enrico Dandolo. Chosen by the nobility, he replaced his half-brother Stefan Vladislav in 1243 after a brief succession war and ruled until 1276. He gave Vladislav the administration of Zeta and married Helen, with whom he had sons Dragutin and Milutin. His long reign brought a mining boom that laid the groundwork for later Serbian expansion; he was also the first Serbian ruler to wear the full ceremonial vestments of Byzantine emperors. In 1276 conflict with his son Stefan Dragutin forced him to abdicate, and he died on 1 May 1277.
zh: 斯特凡·乌罗斯一世，世称乌罗斯大帝（约1223—1277年5月1日），是‘首任加冕者’斯特凡与威尼斯总督恩里科·丹多洛的孙女安娜·丹多洛的幼子。他受贵族拥立，在一场短暂的王位战争后于1243年取代异母兄斯特凡·弗拉迪斯拉夫，统治塞尔维亚至1276年。他把泽塔交给弗拉迪斯拉夫治理，并娶海伦为妻，育有德拉古廷和米卢廷两个儿子。他在位长久，矿业与经济兴盛，为日后塞尔维亚的扩张奠定基础；他也是第一位采用拜占庭皇帝全套礼服的塞尔维亚统治者。1276年，与儿子斯特凡·德拉古廷的冲突迫使他退位，他于1277年5月1日去世。

en: Stefan Uroš III, called Dečanski (c. 1276–1331), was king of Serbia from 1322. The son of Stefan Milutin, he spent his youth as a hostage at the court of Nogai Khan and governed Zeta. After Milutin died in 1321, Stefan was crowned in January 1322 and then defeated the rival claimants Konstantin and Stefan Vladislav II, the latter in 1324. In 1330 Bulgaria and Byzantium planned an invasion of Serbia, but Stefan defeated the Bulgarians at Velbazhd, where Tsar Michael Asen III was killed. He founded Visoki Dečani monastery, which gave him his name. In 1331 his son Stefan Dušan deposed him; he died at Zvečan on 11 November and was canonised.
zh: 斯特凡·乌罗什三世，世称德钱斯基（约1276—1331），自1322年起任塞尔维亚国王。他是斯特凡·米卢丁之子，年轻时曾作为人质留在那海汗的宫廷，后来出统泽塔。1321年米卢丁去世后，他于1322年1月加冕，随后击败争位者康斯坦丁和堂兄斯特凡·弗拉迪斯拉夫二世，后者于1324年败北。1330年保加利亚和拜占庭计划入侵塞尔维亚，但斯特凡在维尔巴日德击败保加利亚军，沙皇米哈伊尔·阿森三世战死。他修建了维索基德查尼修道院，并由此得名。1331年，其子斯特凡·杜尚将他废黜，他于11月11日死于兹韦查恩堡，后来被封圣。

en: Stefan Dragutin (c. 1244–12 March 1316) was the eldest son of King Stefan Uroš I and Helen of Anjou. Married to Catherine of Hungary and already titled young king, he rebelled with Hungarian help and forced his father to abdicate in 1276, ruling Serbia until 1282. After a riding accident he handed the crown to his brother Milutin but kept the northern lands; in 1284 he received the Hungarian banates of Mačva, Usora and Soli, becoming the first Serbian ruler of Belgrade, unofficially styled king of Syrmia. Their conflicts became open war in 1301; after Milutin's mercenaries defeated him in 1311 or 1312, Dragutin made peace. He died as a monk in 1316.
zh: 斯特凡·德拉古廷（约1244—1316年3月12日）是国王斯特凡·乌罗斯一世与安茹的海伦的长子。他娶匈牙利的卡塔琳为妻并受封‘年轻国王’，后于1276年借匈牙利援军起兵，逼迫父亲退位，自立为塞尔维亚国王，统治至1282年。一次坠马受伤后，他把王位让给弟弟米卢廷，但保留了北部领地；1284年他获得匈牙利封出的马奇瓦、乌索拉和索利三个边区，成为第一位统治贝尔格莱德的塞尔维亚君主，被非正式地称为斯雷姆国王。兄弟间的冲突于1301年演变为公开战争，德拉古廷在1311或1312年被米卢廷的雇佣兵击败后议和。他出家为僧，于1316年去世。

en: Stefan Uroš IV Dušan (c. 1308–1355), called the Mighty, made medieval Serbia the leading power of the Balkans. After his father Dečanski was exiled in 1314, he lived in Constantinople until 1320, and he made his name at Velbazhd against Bulgaria in 1330. Nobles who wanted to expand south resented Dečanski for not pressing the victory on Byzantium; in 1331 Dušan besieged his father at Nerodimlje, had him imprisoned, and was crowned king in September. From 1342 he exploited the Byzantine civil war to take Byzantine lands as far as Kavala. On Easter, 16 April 1346, he was crowned emperor of the Serbs and Greeks at Skopje by the newly raised Serbian patriarch, for which Constantinople excommunicated him in 1350. He took Epirus in 1347 and Thessaly in 1348, ruling from the Danube to the Gulf of Corinth, and proclaimed his Code at Skopje on 21 May 1349. He died at Prizren on 20 December 1355 while preparing a campaign against the Turks, and his empire fell apart under his son Stefan Uroš V.
zh: 斯特凡·乌罗什四世·杜尚（约1308—1355），世称“强者”杜尚，使中世纪塞尔维亚成为巴尔干首强。1314年父亲德钱斯基被流放后，他在君士坦丁堡生活到1320年。1330年，他在对保加利亚的维尔巴日德之战中崭露头角。许多想向南扩张的贵族不满德钱斯基不乘胜进攻拜占庭；1331年杜尚在内罗迪姆列围困父亲，将其囚禁，9月加冕为国王。1342年起，他趁拜占庭内战夺取直到卡瓦拉的拜占庭领土。1346年4月16日复活节，新擢升的塞尔维亚牧首在斯科普里为他加冕，称塞尔维亚人与希腊人的皇帝；1350年，君士坦丁堡为此将他逐出教会。1347年他攻取伊庇鲁斯，1348年攻取色萨利，疆域北起多瑙河、南抵科林斯湾；1349年5月21日，他在斯科普里颁布《杜尚法典》。1355年12月20日，他在筹划讨伐土耳其人时卒于普里兹伦，其子斯特凡·乌罗什五世继位后，帝国随即瓦解。

en: Stefan Konstantin (c. 1283–1322) ruled as king of Serbia from the death of his father Stefan Milutin on 29 October 1321 until the spring of 1322. The younger son of Milutin, probably born to the king's Greek wife Helena, he held the appanage of Zeta, with Zahumlje and Travunia, and became heir after his elder brother Stefan was exiled. When Milutin died, Konstantin faced Stefan, returned from exile, and their cousin Vladislav II. Rejecting a power-sharing offer, he was defeated and killed in battle below Zvečan fortress, leaving Stefan to rule as Dečanski.
zh: 斯特凡·康斯坦丁（约1283—1322）于1321年10月29日父亲斯特凡·米卢廷死后成为塞尔维亚国王，在位至1322年春。他是米卢廷的幼子，生母可能是国王的希腊妻子海伦，早年受封泽塔封地（含扎胡姆列和特拉武尼亚），兄长斯特凡被流放后成为王储。米卢廷死后，他要面对结束流亡归来的兄长和堂兄弗拉迪斯拉夫二世。他拒绝分权提议，在兹韦查恩要塞下的战役中兵败被杀，斯特凡随后以德钱斯基之名登上王位。

en: Stefan Uroš II Milutin (c. 1253–29 October 1321), youngest son of Stefan Uroš I and Helen of Anjou, became king when his brother Dragutin abdicated in 1282. He immediately invaded Byzantium, seizing northern Macedonia including Skoplje, his capital. In 1283 he and Dragutin advanced deep into Byzantine territory as far as Kavala, and by 1284 he held northern Albania and Durrës. The peace of 1299 let him keep the conquests as the dowry of Simonis, daughter of Emperor Andronikos II. His reign brought a mining boom, including the silver works at Novo Brdo, and churches such as Our Lady of Ljeviš in Prizren. He also founded a hospital in Constantinople. He died in 1321 and was venerated as a saint.
zh: 斯特凡·乌罗斯二世·米卢廷（约1253—1321年10月29日）是斯特凡·乌罗斯一世与安茹的海伦的幼子，1282年其兄德拉古廷退位后成为塞尔维亚国王。他即位后随即入侵拜占庭，夺取包括斯科普里在内的马其顿北部并以此为都。1283年，他与德拉古廷深入拜占庭领土，远达卡瓦拉；到1284年他又控制了阿尔巴尼亚北部与都拉斯。1299年双方议和，他以皇帝安德洛尼卡二世之女西蒙尼斯的嫁妆为名保留了征服所得。他在位时矿业兴盛，新布尔多发展为重要银矿产区，还兴建了普里兹伦的列维什圣母教堂等教堂。他也在君士坦丁堡创办了一所医院。他于1321年去世，后被尊为圣徒。

en: Stefan Nemanja (c. 1113–1199), youngest son of the Zachlumian prince Zavida, was Grand Prince of Raška from 1166 to 1196. Born at Ribnica in Zeta, near modern Podgorica, he united neighbouring Serb lands, including Zeta, and broke free of Byzantine overlordship around 1180. He founded Studenica Monastery. In 1196 he abdicated in favour of his middle son Stefan, withdrew to Mount Athos as the monk Simeon, and with his son Saint Sava restored the Hilandar Monastery in 1198–1199. He died there on 13 February 1199 and was canonised as Saint Simeon the Myroblyte.
zh: 斯特凡·尼曼雅（约1113—1199）是扎胡姆列王公扎维达的幼子，1166年至1196年任拉什卡大茹潘。他生于泽塔的里布尼察（今波德戈里察附近），将包括泽塔在内的周边塞尔维亚人地区统一于自己治下，约1180年摆脱了拜占庭的宗主权。他修建了斯图代尼察修道院。1196年，他让位给次子斯特凡，自己以修士西缅的身份退隐阿索斯山，并于1198年至1199年与幼子圣萨瓦一同重建希勒德修道院。1199年2月13日他在当地去世，后被封圣，称圣西缅·米尔托奇维。

en: Stefan Nemanjić, known as the First-Crowned (c. 1165–24 September 1228), was the second son of Grand Prince Stefan Nemanja and succeeded as Grand Prince of Serbia in 1196. After civil war and exile in his struggle with his elder brother Vukan, he regained power and brought Zeta and Hum under his control. He supported his kinsman Andrija in the struggle for Hum, and by 1216 controlled Zeta, whose ruler had accepted Venetian suzerainty. Around 1217 he married the Venetian noblewoman Anna Dandolo. In 1217 he obtained a crown from Pope Honorius III and became Serbia's first crowned king, and in 1219 his brother Saint Sava secured autocephaly for the Serbian Church. He took monastic vows shortly before he died and was buried at Sopoćani.
zh: 斯特凡·尼曼伊奇，人称‘首任加冕者’（约1165—1228年9月24日），是大亲王斯特凡·内马尼亚的次子，1196年继任塞尔维亚大亲王。在与兄长武坎的多年内战中他一度流亡，后重新掌权，并将泽塔和胡姆纳入统治。他支持亲属安德里亚争夺胡姆，又在1216年之前控制了泽塔，其统治者曾接受威尼斯的宗主权。约1217年，他娶威尼斯贵族安娜·丹多洛为妻。1217年，他从教宗洪诺留三世处取得王冠，成为第一位受加冕的塞尔维亚国王；1219年，其弟圣萨瓦又为塞尔维亚教会争取到自治地位。他在去世前不久出家修道，安葬于索波查尼修道院。

en: Stefan Radoslav (c. 1192–after 1235) was the eldest son of Stefan the First-Crowned and Eudokia Angelina, daughter of Emperor Alexios III. He succeeded as king of Serbia in 1228 and was crowned at Žiča by his uncle Archbishop Sava. His marriage to Anna, daughter of Theodore Komnenos Doukas of Epirus, gave his court a strong Greek flavour and alienated the Serbian nobility. After Theodore's capture by Ivan Asen II of Bulgaria in 1230, the nobles rose in autumn 1233 and replaced Radoslav with his brother Vladislav. He fled to Dubrovnik, later returning to Serbia as the monk Jovan.
zh: 斯特凡·拉多斯拉夫（约1192—1235年后）是“首任国王”斯特凡与拜占庭皇帝阿历克塞三世之女尤多基娅·安格琳娜的长子。1228年他继承父位成为塞尔维亚国王，由叔父大主教萨瓦在日查为他加冕。他娶伊庇鲁斯君主狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯之女安娜为妻，宫廷因此希腊色彩浓厚，引起塞尔维亚贵族不满。1230年狄奥多尔被保加利亚皇帝伊凡·阿森二世击败俘虏后，贵族于1233年秋起事，以其弟弗拉季斯拉夫取代了他。他逃到杜布罗夫尼克，后来以修士约万的身份返回塞尔维亚。

en: Stefan Uroš V (1336–1371), called the Weak, was the only son of Stefan Dušan and Helena of Bulgaria. Crowned co-ruler in 1346, he succeeded as Serbian emperor in December 1355. Under him the empire broke apart: his uncle Simeon Uroš proclaimed himself tsar in the south, his mother Helena held Serres with Jovan Uglješa, and magnates such as Nikola Altomanović ruled on their own. In 1365 Vukašin Mrnjavčević became co-ruler and in 1369 made his son Marko heir. After the Maritsa disaster of 1371, Uroš died childless that December, ending Nemanjić rule; he was canonised.
zh: 斯特凡·乌罗什五世（1336—1371），世称‘弱者’乌罗什，是斯特凡·杜尚与保加利亚的海伦娜的独子。他1346年被立为共治国王，1355年12月继位为塞尔维亚皇帝。他在位时帝国走向瓦解：叔父西缅·乌罗什在南方自立为帝，母亲海伦娜与约万·乌格列沙盘踞塞雷，尼古拉·阿尔托马诺维奇等大贵族各自为政。1365年武卡辛·姆尔尼亚夫切维奇成为共治国王，1369年又立其子马尔科为继承人。1371年马里查战役惨败后，乌罗什于12月无子而终，内马尼奇王朝的统治告终，他后来被正教会封圣。

en: Stefan Vladislav (c. 1198–after 1264) was a son of Stefan the First-Crowned. In 1234 the Serbian nobility, hostile to the Greek tilt of his brother King Radoslav, raised Vladislav to the throne. He married Beloslava, daughter of Ivan Asen II of Bulgaria, and held the maritime province of Hum against Hungarian crusaders. When his uncle Archbishop Sava died in Bulgaria in 1235, Vladislav buried his relics in the Mileševa Monastery he had founded. After the Mongol devastation of the Balkans under Kadan, the nobles deposed him in 1243 for his brother Uroš I, and he kept Zeta as governor.
zh: 斯特凡·弗拉季斯拉夫（约1198—1264年后）是“首任国王”斯特凡之子。1234年，塞尔维亚贵族不满其兄国王拉多斯拉夫的亲希腊倾向，拥立弗拉季斯拉夫登位。他娶保加利亚皇帝伊凡·阿森二世之女贝洛斯拉娃为妻，并抵挡住匈牙利十字军，保住滨海的胡姆地区。1235年叔父大主教萨瓦在保加利亚去世，弗拉季斯拉夫迎回其遗骨，安葬在他修建的米莱舍瓦修道院。合丹率领的蒙古人蹂躏巴尔干后，贵族于1243年废黜他，改立其弟乌罗什一世。他仍以泽塔长官的身份留在当地。

en: Stefan Vladislav II (c. 1270–after 1326) was the eldest son of King Stefan Dragutin of Serbia and Catherine of Hungary. When Dragutin abdicated to his brother Stefan Milutin in 1282, the succession right of one of his sons, Vladislav or Urošica, was acknowledged. In 1293 he married Constanza Morosini, a kinswoman of King Andrew III of Hungary. He inherited his father's northern realm of Syrmia in 1316 but was defeated and imprisoned by Milutin. Freed after Milutin's death in 1321, he claimed the Serbian crown with Hungarian and Bulgarian backing, was beaten by Stefan Dečanski, and retired to Hungary in 1324.
zh: 斯特凡·弗拉迪斯拉夫二世（约1270—1326年后）是塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·德拉古廷与匈牙利的凯瑟琳的长子。1282年德拉古廷让位给弟弟斯特凡·米卢廷时，其子弗拉迪斯拉夫或乌罗什察其中一人的继承权得到确认。1293年，他娶匈牙利国王安德拉什三世的亲属康斯坦察·莫罗西尼为妻。1316年他继承父亲在北方的斯雷姆领地，却被米卢廷击败囚禁。1321年米卢廷死后获释，他在匈牙利和保加利亚支持下争夺塞尔维亚王位，被斯特凡·德钱斯基击败，于1324年退入匈牙利。

en: Theodora Nemanjić (1330 – after 1381) was the youngest daughter of King Stefan Uroš III Dečanski and Maria Palaiologina, and a half-sister of Stefan Dušan. In 1347 she married Despot Dejan, whom Dušan made sebastokrator, and bore him Jovan Dragaš and Constantine Dragaš, who ruled the eastern marches after Maritsa, and a daughter, Teodora. Long widowed, she became a nun as Evdokija; a charter of 1379 records her and her son Constantine donating to Hilandar. Through Constantine's daughter Helena Dragaš she was the great-grandmother of the last Byzantine emperors John VIII and Constantine XI.
zh: 狄奥多拉·内马尼奇（1330—1381年以后）是国王斯特凡·乌罗什三世·德钱斯基与玛丽亚·巴列奥略最小的女儿、斯特凡·杜尚的异母妹妹。1347年她嫁给专制公德扬，杜尚封他为至尊者；她生下约万·德拉加什和康斯坦丁·德拉加什——兄弟二人在马里查战役后割据东部边疆——另有一女狄奥多拉。寡居多年后她出家为尼，法名叶夫多基娅，1379年的一份特许状记载她与儿子康斯坦丁向希兰达尔修道院捐赠。通过康斯坦丁之女海伦娜·德拉加什，她是拜占庭末代皇帝约翰八世和君士坦丁十一世的曾祖母。

en: Theodora, second daughter of Tsar Smilets of Bulgaria and Smiltsena Palaiologina, married the Serbian crown prince Stefan Uroš III, later Stefan Dečanski, on 24 August 1296. She was the mother of Stefan Dušan, the future emperor. When Milutin drove her husband into exile at Constantinople in 1314, she followed him and remained there until their return in 1320. She attended the state assembly of 6 January 1322 where Dušan was crowned young king. Around this time she and Dečanski divorced; he later married Maria Palaiologina. A patron of literature and the arts, she died around 1322–1323 and was probably buried at Banjska.
zh: 狄奥多拉是保加利亚沙皇斯米莱茨与斯米尔采娜·巴列奥略娜的次女，于1296年8月24日嫁给塞尔维亚王储斯特凡·乌罗什三世，即后来的斯特凡·德钱斯基。她是未来皇帝斯特凡·杜尚的母亲。1314年米卢廷将她的丈夫流放君士坦丁堡，她随行前往，一直留到1320年一家获准归国。1322年1月6日她出席杜尚加冕为“年轻国王”的国事大会。这一时期她与德钱斯基离婚，后者随后娶了玛丽亚·巴列奥略。她扶持文学与艺术，约1322—1323年去世，可能葬于巴尼斯卡修道院。

en: Urošica (fl. 1285 – before 1316) was a Serbian prince of the Nemanjić dynasty, the younger son of King Stefan Dragutin and Catherine of Hungary. Renouncing political life, he took monastic vows as Stefan and died young before 1316, before his brother Vladislav inherited Syrmia. He was buried in the church of Saint Achillius at Arilje, his father's endowment. Tradition makes him and Vladislav founders of the Tavna Monastery in Bosnia, and the Serbian Orthodox Church venerates him as a saint on 11 November.
zh: 乌罗什察（活跃于1285年—1316年前）是尼曼雅王朝的塞尔维亚王公，国王斯特凡·德拉古廷与匈牙利的凯瑟琳的幼子。他弃俗出家，取法名斯特凡，于1316年之前早逝，未能见到兄长弗拉迪斯拉夫继承斯雷姆。他葬于父亲捐资修建的阿里列圣阿基里乌斯教堂。相传他与弗拉迪斯拉夫是波斯尼亚塔夫纳修道院的建立者；塞尔维亚正教会将他奉为圣人，于11月11日纪念。

en: Vojihna (c. 1298–1360) was a Serbian nobleman of a collateral Nemanjić line who became one of Stefan Dušan's leading commanders. Appointed governor of Drama before November 1345, he was raised to the rank of caesar before 1348 and accompanied Dušan to Mount Athos late in 1347. In the autumn of 1356 he defeated and captured the Byzantine pretender Matthew Kantakouzenos near Serres, later handing him to Emperor John V Palaiologos for ransom. He died around 1360 and was buried at Hilandar; his daughter Jefimija married Despot Jovan Uglješa, who inherited his Drama lands.
zh: 沃伊赫纳（约1298—1360）出身内马尼奇王朝旁支，是斯特凡·杜尚麾下最主要的将领之一。1345年11月前他被任命为德拉马总督，1348年前获封凯撒，1347年末随杜尚前往阿索斯圣山。1356年秋，他在塞雷附近击败并俘获拜占庭帝位觊觎者马修·坎塔库泽努斯，随后将其交给皇帝约翰五世·巴列奥略以换取赎金。他约于1360年去世，葬于希兰达尔修道院；其女耶菲米娅嫁给专制公约万·乌格列沙，后者继承了他在德拉马的领地。

en: Vratislav Nemanjić was a Serbian župan of the Nemanjić dynasty and the only son of Prince Dmitar Nemanjić known by name. His father mentioned his heirs in a charter of 1286, while a grave slab excavated at the Davidovica Monastery calls Vratislav grand župan. Serbian genealogies make him the father of the nobleman Vratko, sung in epic poetry as Jug Bogdan, and the grandfather of Princess Milica, wife of Prince Lazar. A Ragusan document of 1319 mentions another son, Radoslav.
zh: 弗拉季斯拉夫·内马尼奇是尼曼雅王朝的塞尔维亚茹潘，也是迪米塔尔·内马尼奇唯一有名可考的儿子。父亲1286年颁赐的一份特许状提到其继承人，大卫多维察修道院出土的墓板则称弗拉季斯拉夫为大茹潘。塞尔维亚谱系记载，他是贵族弗拉特科之父——弗拉特科在史诗中被传唱为尤格·博格丹——也是拉扎尔大公之妻米莉察公主的祖父。1319年的一份拉古萨文件还提到他的另一个儿子拉多斯拉夫。

en: Vratko Nemanjić (fl. 1325–1355) was a Serbian nobleman of the Nemanjić dynasty's Vukan branch, the son of grand župan Vratislav and great-grandson of Vukan Nemanjić. A companion of Stefan Dušan, in 1342 he and vojvoda Oliver led a Serbian army against Serres in support of John VI Kantakouzenos, but the siege collapsed when dysentery killed some 1500 of their men. His daughter Milica married Prince Lazar around 1353, and a burial inscription of 1379 attests his son župan Nikola. Serbian epic poetry remembers him as Jug Bogdan, the aged hero of the Kosovo cycle.
zh: 弗拉特科·内马尼奇（活跃于1325—1355年）是内马尼奇王朝武坎一支的贵族，大茹潘弗拉迪斯拉夫之子、武坎·内马尼奇的曾孙。他是斯特凡·杜尚的同侪，1342年与将领奥利弗一道，为支援约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯而率军攻打塞雷，却因痢疾流行、约1500人病死而惨败。他的女儿米莉察约于1353年嫁给拉扎尔大公，1379年的一方墓葬铭文还记载了他的儿子茹潘尼古拉。塞尔维亚史诗把他传唱为科索沃歌谣中的老英雄尤格·博格丹。

en: Vukan Nemanjić was the eldest son of Grand Prince Stefan Nemanja. Around 1190 his father gave him the maritime lands centred on Zeta, and an inscription of 1195 in Kotor calls him king of Duklja. When Nemanja abdicated in 1196 the Serbian throne went to Vukan's younger brother Stefan. In 1202 Vukan overthrew Stefan with troops from King Emeric of Hungary, whose vassal he became, promising to convert his people to Catholicism if the pope granted him a royal title. After a Bulgarian invasion in 1203 Stefan returned and deposed him in 1204. Reconciled through their brother Saint Sava, Vukan kept Zeta until his death soon after 1207.
zh: 武坎·内马尼奇是大茹潘斯特凡·尼曼雅的长子。约1190年，父亲把以泽塔为中心的滨海领地封给他，1195年科托尔的一段铭文已称他为杜克里亚国王。1196年尼曼雅退位时，塞尔维亚王位传给了他的弟弟斯特凡。1202年，武坎在匈牙利国王伊姆雷的军队帮助下推翻斯特凡，成为匈牙利封臣，并许诺若教宗授予他王号，就让臣民改宗天主教。1203年保加利亚入侵后，斯特凡于1204年回国将他废黜。经弟弟圣萨瓦调解，兄弟和解，武坎保留泽塔直到1207年后不久去世。

en: John Komnenos Asen (c. 1305–1363) was a Bulgarian nobleman, son of the despot Stracimir of Kran and brother of Tsar Ivan Alexander of Bulgaria and of Helena, wife of Serbian Tsar Stefan Dušan. He joined his sister at the Serbian court, where Dušan made him despot and put him in charge of his lands in southern Albania. From about 1345 he ruled the Principality of Valona, at first as a Serbian vassal. He held Berat until Andrea II Muzaka took it in 1350 and drove him back to Kanina. Around 1350–1355 he married Anna Palaiologina, widow of the Epirote despot John II Orsini, which legitimised his standing. After Dušan died in 1355 he sided with the failed Simeon Uroš, yet with Venetian help kept Valona effectively independent; he had become a Venetian citizen in 1353 and traded with Venice and Ragusa. He probably died of the plague in 1363 and was succeeded by Alexander, likely his son.
zh: 约翰·科穆宁·阿森（约1305—1363）是保加利亚贵族，为克兰专制公斯特拉齐米尔之子，保加利亚沙皇伊凡·亚历山大与塞尔维亚沙皇斯特凡·杜尚之妻海伦娜都是他的兄弟姐妹。他前往海伦娜所在的塞尔维亚宫廷，杜尚封他为专制公，让他掌管阿尔巴尼亚南部的领地。约1345年起，他统治发罗拉公国，起初是塞尔维亚的封臣。他一度占据培拉特，1350年被安德烈亚二世·穆扎卡夺走，退回卡尼纳。约1350—1355年，他娶了安娜·帕里奥洛吉娜，她是伊庇鲁斯专制君主乔瓦尼二世·奥尔西尼的遗孀，这桩婚姻巩固了他的地位。1355年杜尚死后，他站在失败的西缅·乌罗斯一边，却靠威尼斯的帮助保住了发罗拉事实上的独立；他1353年成为威尼斯公民，并与威尼斯和拉古萨通商。他很可能于1363年死于瘟疫，由很可能是其子的亚历山大继位。

en: Sesshū Tōyō (c. 1420–1506) was the greatest Japanese ink painter of his age. Born into a samurai family in Bitchū Province, he became a Zen monk at Kyoto's Shōkoku-ji and studied for twenty years under Tenshō Shūbun. After leaving Kyoto he devoted himself to painting at a provincial Zen temple in western Japan. In 1467 he sailed to Ming China with a Japanese envoy, funded by a warrior clan trading with China. He travelled from Ningbo to Beijing and studied Chinese landscape masters at first hand. He fused their realism with Japanese Zen sensibility in works such as his Winter Landscape and the Four Landscape Scrolls of the Seasons. He died at Masuda in 1506, and later Japanese painting schools claimed him as founder.
zh: 雪舟（约1420—1506）是当时日本最伟大的水墨画家。他出身备中国的武士家庭，少年时入京都相国寺为禅僧，随天章周文学画二十年。离开京都后，他在日本西部的一座地方禅寺专心作画。1467年，他随日本遣明使船前往明朝中国，旅费由从事对华贸易的武士家族资助；他从宁波一路游历到北京，亲炙中国山水画名家。他把中国画的写实笔法与日本禅宗意趣融为一体，代表作有《冬景山水图》与《四季山水图卷》等。1506年他在益田去世，后世日本众多画派都奉他为开山之祖。

en: Shaikh Ali ibn Ali Qushji was an Ilkhanid administrator in Khurasan. Under Abu Sa'id Bahadur Khan he was posted as governor of the province. After Abu Sa'id's death in 1335, Qushji put forward the Genghisid prince Togha Temür as Ilkhan, persuading the amirs of Khurasan and Mazandaran to have the Friday prayer read and coins struck in his name. On Togha Temür's westward campaign of 1337 the army was routed near Sultaniya by the Jalayirid Hasan Buzurg. Qushji fled, was seized at Bistam by Arghun Shah's men, and was executed, his head sent to Hasan Buzurg.
zh: 谢赫·阿里·伊本·阿里·库什吉是伊利汗国在呼罗珊的官员，在不赛因汗在位时出任呼罗珊行省长官。1335年不赛因死后，他拥立成吉思汗系宗王脱合帖木儿为伊利汗，说服呼罗珊和马赞达兰的异密们以脱合帖木儿之名诵读呼图白、铸造钱币。1337年脱合帖木儿西征时，其军队在苏丹尼耶附近被札剌亦儿人谢赫·大哈散击溃。库什吉出逃，在巴斯塔姆被阿尔衮沙的部下俘获处死，首级被送往谢赫·大哈散处。

en: Bahram Khan, also called Tatar Khan (died 1337), was a general of the Delhi Sultanate and governor of Sonargaon in East Bengal. Chronicle accounts make him the infant son of a defeated ruler of Khorasan, adopted and raised by Sultan Ghiyath al-Din Tughlaq after a night attack near Multan. Appointed governor of Satgaon in 1324, he was transferred to Sonargaon in 1328 and ruled there until his death. When he died in 1337 his armour keeper Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah seized power and founded the independent sultanate of Sonargaon.
zh: 巴赫拉姆汗，又称塔塔尔汗（？—1337），是德里苏丹国的将领，曾任东孟加拉索纳尔冈总督。据编年史记载，他是一位战败的呼罗珊统治者之子，尚在襁褓中便被吉亚斯丁·图格鲁克在木尔坦附近一次夜袭后收养。1324年他被任命为萨特冈总督，1328年调任索纳尔冈，一直统治到去世。1337年他死后，掌管甲胄的侍从法赫尔丁·穆巴拉克沙夺取政权，建立起独立的索纳尔冈苏丹国。

en: Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah (r. 1338–1349) was the founder of the independent sultanate of Sonargaon and its Mubarak Shahi dynasty. A Bengali Muslim who rose as armour-bearer (silahdar) to the Delhi governor Bahram Khan, he seized power after Bahram died in 1337 and made Sonargaon his capital. After Qadar Khan, governor of Lakhnauti, occupied the city, Fakhruddin lured his troops amid a dispute over the spoils, killed Qadar Khan and recovered Sonargaon. He then conquered Comilla, Noakhali and Sylhet, and in 1340 became the first Muslim ruler to take Chittagong. Ibn Battuta visited his court in 1346. He died in 1349 and was succeeded by Ikhtiyaruddin Ghazi Shah.
zh: 法赫尔丁·穆巴拉克沙（1338—1349年在位）是独立的索纳尔冈苏丹国和穆巴拉克·沙希王朝的建立者。他出身孟加拉穆斯林，在德里任命的索纳尔冈总督巴赫拉姆汗麾下担任掌甲侍从（西拉达尔）。1337年巴赫拉姆汗死后，他夺取政权，以索纳尔冈为都城。拉克瑙提总督卡达尔汗一度攻占索纳尔冈，法赫尔丁趁敌军因分赃内讧之际诱使对方，杀死卡达尔汗并收复城池。此后他征服库米拉、诺阿卡利和锡尔赫特，又于1340年成为首位拿下大港吉大港的穆斯林统治者。1346年伊本·白图泰曾访问他的宫廷。他于1349年去世，由伊赫提亚鲁丁·加齐沙继位。

en: Ardashir was the last atabeg of the Shabankara dynasty of Fars, ruling from Īj. In 1355 he defied the Muzaffarid ruler Mubariz al-Din, who sent his son Mahmud against him; defeated, Ardashir lost his lands and the dynasty ended.
zh: 阿尔达希尔是法尔斯沙班卡拉王朝的末代阿塔贝格，以伊杰为统治中心。1355年他抗拒穆扎法尔王朝君主穆巴列兹丁的命令，后者派儿子马赫穆德前来征讨；阿尔达希尔战败，领地被吞并，王朝就此灭亡。

en: Shidibala (1302–1323), titled Gegeen Khan and Emperor Yingzong of Yuan, was the eldest son of Ayurbarwada, succeeding him in April 1320. His early reign was overshadowed by his grandmother Dagi and her councillor Temuder, but in 1320 he raised the young Jalayir noble Baiju against them, and after Dagi and Temuder died in 1322 he took full power. With Baiju he carried out Confucian reforms, recalled Chinese scholar-officials and in 1323 promulgated the Da Yuan Tong Zhi code. That September, Temuder's surviving faction and the Alan guard murdered him at Nanpo, the first violent overthrow of a Yuan emperor.
zh: 硕德八剌（1302—1323），号格坚汗，庙号英宗，爱育黎拔力八达长子，1320年4月继位。即位之初，朝政受制于祖母答己及其宠臣铁木迭儿；1320年，他提拔年轻的札剌亦儿贵族拜住以相制衡，1322年答己与铁木迭儿相继死去，他遂全面亲政。他与拜住推行儒治改革，起用汉族士大夫，并于1323年颁行《大元通制》。同年九月，铁木迭儿余党联合阿速卫兵在南坡发动政变，将他弑杀，这是元朝首次以暴力更迭皇帝。

en: Shikellamy (died 1748), also called Swatana, was an Oneida chief and overseer for the Haudenosaunee Confederacy, supervising the Shawnee and Lenape along Pennsylvania's Susquehanna River and protecting the confederacy's southern border. He first appears in the records at Philadelphia in 1728, when he lived in a Shawnee village, and in 1742 settled at Shamokin at the river's forks. For two decades he was the chief go-between linking the Pennsylvania government with the confederacy council at Onondaga, guiding the colonial envoy Conrad Weiser through Iroquois country and helping keep the frontier at peace. He died at Shamokin in December 1748.
zh: 希凯拉米（卒于1748年），又名斯瓦塔纳，是奥奈达酋长兼豪德诺索尼联盟的督办，负责监管宾夕法尼亚萨斯奎哈纳河沿岸的肖尼人与莱纳佩人，并保卫联盟南部边界。史料中他最早于1728年在费城露面，当时住在一处肖尼村落；1742年他迁居萨斯奎哈纳河两河交汇处的沙莫金。约二十年间，他是宾夕法尼亚殖民政府与奥农达加联盟议事会之间最主要的中间人，曾为殖民地使节康拉德·魏瑟穿越易洛魁地区引路，帮助维持边疆和平。1748年12月，他在沙莫金去世。

en: Adolphus of Holstein (born by 1330) was a son of Gerhard III, Count of Holstein-Rendsburg, and Sophia of Werle.
zh: 荷尔斯泰因的阿道夫（1330年以前出生）是荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡伯爵格哈德三世与韦尔勒的索菲之子。

en: Adolph IX (c. 1327–1390), numbered Adolf VII in the Kiel tradition, was the only son of Count John III the Mild of Holstein-Kiel, whom he succeeded in 1359 as count of Holstein-Kiel and Holstein-Plön. In December 1362 he married Anna of Mecklenburg-Schwerin, daughter of Duke Albert II of Mecklenburg. His long reign was mostly peaceful: in 1375 Prince-Archbishop Albert II of Bremen mortgaged him the Haseldorf Marsh, which was never redeemed and so stayed with Holstein. He died heirless on 26 January 1390, after which the Rendsburg counts occupied his lands.
zh: 阿道夫九世（约1327—1390，按基尔谱系又称阿道夫七世）是荷尔斯泰因-基尔伯爵“温和者”约翰三世的独子，1359年继位，领有荷尔斯泰因-基尔与荷尔斯泰因-普伦。1362年12月他娶梅克伦堡公爵阿尔布雷希特二世之女、梅克伦堡-什未林的安娜为妻。他统治长久且大体太平：1375年不来梅采邑大主教阿尔布雷希特二世把哈瑟尔多夫沼泽抵押给他，该地产始终未被赎回，从此并入荷尔斯泰因。1390年1月26日他无嗣而终，伦茨堡诸伯爵随即占领了他的领地。

en: Gerhard I (1232–1290) was Count of Holstein-Itzehoe, the second son of Count Adolf IV of Holstein. From 1238 he ruled Holstein jointly with his elder brother John I under the guardianship of their brother-in-law Duke Abel of Schleswig. The brothers made a trade treaty with Lübeck in 1255 and divided the county in 1261, Gerhard receiving Itzehoe with Stormarn and Plön. He won the Battle of Loh Moor in 1262 and, after John's death in 1263, governed Kiel as regent for his nephews. He died on 21 December 1290; his sons partitioned Itzehoe into Plön, Pinneberg and Rendsburg.
zh: 格哈德一世（1232—1290）是荷尔斯泰因－伊策霍伯爵，荷尔斯泰因伯爵阿道夫四世的次子。1238年父亲退隐修道院后，他与兄长约翰一世在姐夫石勒苏益格公爵阿贝尔的监护下共同统治荷尔斯泰因。兄弟二人于1255年与吕贝克订立通商条约，1261年瓜分伯国，格哈德分得伊策霍以及施托尔马恩、普伦等地。1262年他在洛沼泽之战中获胜，1263年约翰去世后又以摄政身份替侄子治理基尔。他于1290年12月21日去世，诸子将伊策霍瓜分为普伦、平讷贝格和伦茨堡。

en: Gerhard II, called the Blind (1254 – 28 October 1312), was count of Holstein-Plön from 1290. The second son of Gerhard I of Holstein-Itzehoe and Elisabeth of Mecklenburg, he received Plön when his father's county was divided among the brothers in 1290, while Adolph VI took Schauenburg and Henry took Rendsburg. On 12 December 1275 he married Ingeborg, daughter of King Valdemar of Sweden; their son Gerhard IV succeeded at Plön. In 1293 he married Agnes of Brandenburg, widow of King Eric V of Denmark, by whom he had John III, who ruled Holstein-Kiel from 1312.
zh: 格哈德二世，绰号“盲人”（1254—1312年10月28日），1290年起任荷尔斯泰因-普伦伯爵。他是荷尔斯泰因-伊策霍伯爵格哈德一世与梅克伦堡的伊丽莎白的次子。1290年父亲死后，伯国由诸子瓜分：格哈德分得普伦，弟弟阿道夫六世得到绍恩堡，亨利得到伦茨堡。1275年12月12日，他娶瑞典国王瓦尔德马尔之女英格堡，儿子格哈德四世后来继任普伦伯爵。1293年，他又娶丹麦国王埃里克五世的遗孀、勃兰登堡的阿格尼丝，生子约翰三世，于1312年起统治荷尔斯泰因-基尔。

en: Gerhard III (c. 1292–1340), called the Great or the Bald Count, inherited Holstein-Rendsburg as a boy and built it into a strong north German principality. In 1326 he helped depose King Christopher II of Denmark and set his nephew Valdemar on the throne, ruling Denmark as regent and detaching Schleswig through the Constitutio Valdemariana. From 1332 he was the effective ruler of Jutland and Funen, his regime weighed down by debt and peasant revolts. On 1 April 1340, while campaigning at Randers, he was slain in his bedroom by the Danish squire Niels Ebbesen, ending Holstein rule in Denmark.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/格哈德三世_(霍爾斯坦-倫茨堡)
zh: 格哈德三世（约1292—1340），绰号“大帝”或“秃头伯爵”，幼年继承荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡，将其经营成北德意志的强大邦国。1326年他参与废黜丹麦国王克里斯托弗二世，把外甥瓦尔德马扶上丹麦王位，自己以摄政身份统治丹麦，并通过《瓦尔德马宪章》使石勒苏益格脱离丹麦。1332年起，他成为日德兰和菲英的实际统治者，政权却深陷债务与农民起义。1340年4月1日，他在兰讷斯征讨叛军时，被丹麦乡绅尼尔斯·艾布森闯入睡房杀死，荷尔斯泰因人对丹麦的统治就此终结。

en: Gerhard IV (c. 1277–1323) was Count of Holstein-Plön from 1312, the eldest son of Count Gerhard II and Ingeborg of Sweden. On 30 July 1313 he married Anastasia, daughter of Nicholas I of Schwerin. Soon after succeeding, on 7 June 1314, he sold almost all of his inheritance to his younger brother John III, keeping little beyond the comital title. He died around 1323, leaving a son Gerhard V, a canon at Lübeck Cathedral, and a daughter Ingeborg, who married Count Conrad I of Oldenburg and mothered Christian V of Oldenburg.
zh: 格哈德四世（约1277—约1323）自1312年起任荷尔斯泰因-普伦伯爵，是伯爵格哈德二世与瑞典的英格堡的长子。1313年7月30日，他娶什未林伯爵尼古拉一世之女阿纳斯塔西娅为妻。继位后不久，他于1314年6月7日将几乎全部世袭领地卖给弟弟约翰三世，自己仅保留伯爵头衔。他约于1323年去世，遗下儿子格哈德五世（吕贝克大教堂法政牧师）与女儿英格堡；英格堡嫁给奥尔登堡伯爵康拉德一世，是奥尔登堡伯爵克里斯蒂安五世之母。

en: Gerhard V of Holstein-Plön (c. 1315–1350) was the only son of Count Gerhard IV and Anastasia of Schwerin. About 1323, aged eight, he inherited Holstein-Plön on his father's death, but he never formally ruled the county and lived as a landowner and a canon and provost of Lübeck Cathedral. He died on 22 September 1350, unmarried and without children, leaving Holstein-Plön to his uncle John III of Kiel, who thus reunited Plön with Kiel.
zh: 荷尔斯泰因-普伦的格哈德五世（约1315—1350）是格哈德四世伯爵与什未林的阿纳斯塔西娅的独子。约1323年父亲去世，年仅八岁的他继承荷尔斯泰因-普伦，但从未正式统治该伯国，只是一名地主，并出任吕贝克大教堂的咏礼司铎兼教长。他于1350年9月22日去世，未婚且无子嗣，荷尔斯泰因-普伦传给领有基尔的叔父约翰三世，普伦与基尔由此重新合为一体。

en: Henry I (1258–1304) was the first Count of Holstein-Rendsburg and a son of Gerhard I of Holstein-Itzehoe. In 1285 he persuaded King Eric V of Denmark to release Duke Valdemar IV of Schleswig from captivity. After Gerhard died in 1290, the surviving sons partitioned Holstein-Itzehoe and Henry received the Rendsburg portion, which he ruled until his death. He waged repeated wars against the Ditmarschen and, shortly before he died on 5 August 1304, introduced a toll on imported goods; Hamburg received half the proceeds, and Holstein-Schaumburg and Holstein-Rendsburg divided the other half.
zh: 亨利一世（1258—1304）是第一代荷尔斯泰因－伦茨堡伯爵，格哈德一世之子。1285年，他说服丹麦国王埃里克五世释放遭囚禁的石勒苏益格公爵瓦尔德马四世。1290年父亲去世后，在世的诸子瓜分荷尔斯泰因－伊策霍，亨利分得伦茨堡。他在位期间不断与迪特马尔申交战，并在1304年8月5日去世前不久开征进口货物税；汉堡获得一半收入，其余由荷尔斯泰因－绍姆堡和荷尔斯泰因－伦茨堡分配。

en: Henry II (c. 1317–c. 1384), called Iron Henry, was the elder son of Count Gerhard III of Holstein-Rendsburg and Sophia of Werle. After his father's murder in 1340 he ruled Holstein-Rendsburg jointly with his younger brother Nicholas, pressing their claims in Schleswig against Denmark and campaigning against the Frisians. A famed mercenary captain, he fought in Italy, France, Russia and Estonia and served both English and Swedish armies. In 1367 he commanded a Hanseatic League fleet, and in 1368 his forces captured Copenhagen. By his second wife Ingeborg of Mecklenburg he fathered Gerhard VI, later Duke of Schleswig.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/海因里希二世_(霍爾斯坦-倫茨堡)
zh: 海因里希二世（约1317—约1384），绰号“铁人海因里希”，是荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡伯爵格哈德三世与韦尔勒的索菲的长子。1340年父亲遇刺后，他与弟弟尼库劳斯共同统治荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡，在石勒苏益格与丹麦相争，并对弗里斯兰人用兵。作为著名的雇佣军首领，他曾在意大利、法兰西、罗斯和爱沙尼亚作战，先后效力英格兰和瑞典军队。1367年他统率汉萨同盟舰队，1368年率军攻占哥本哈根。他与第二任妻子梅克伦堡的英格堡生有格哈德六世，后者后来成为石勒苏益格公爵。

en: Ingeborg of Holstein (c. 1316–after 1349) was the daughter of Count Gerhard IV of Holstein-Plön and sister of Gerhard V. She married Count Conrad I of Oldenburg and was the mother of Counts Conrad II and Christian V, who succeeded their father in Oldenburg.
zh: 荷尔斯泰因的英厄堡（约1316年生，1349年后在世）是荷尔斯泰因-普伦伯爵格哈德四世之女、格哈德五世的姐妹。她嫁给奥尔登堡伯爵康拉德一世，是康拉德二世与克里斯蒂安五世的母亲，两个儿子后来相继继承了奥尔登堡伯国。

en: John III, called the Mild (c. 1297–1359), was a count of Holstein-Plön and Holstein-Kiel, son of Gerhard II the Blind and the Danish queen dowager Agnes of Brandenburg, and thus half-brother of Kings Eric VI and Christopher II. In 1312 he succeeded in Plön and inherited Kiel in 1316. A chief creditor of the Danish crown, he with Count Gerhard III of Rendsburg guarded Schleswig in 1332–1340, ruling Denmark east of the Great Belt. In 1350 his nephew Gerhard V bequeathed Plön to him. He died in 1359, succeeded in his German possessions by his son Adolphus.
zh: 绰号“温和者”的约翰三世（约1297—1359）是荷尔斯泰因-普伦与荷尔斯泰因-基尔伯爵，为“瞎子”格哈德二世与丹麦太后勃兰登堡的阿格尼丝之子，是埃里克六世与克里斯托弗二世的同母异父兄弟。1312年他继承普伦，1316年又继承基尔。作为丹麦王室的主要债权人，1332—1340年他与伦茨堡伯爵格哈德三世一同监护石勒苏益格，并统治大贝尔特海峡以东的丹麦地区。1350年侄子格哈德五世把普伦遗赠给他。他于1359年去世，子嗣阿道夫继承了他的德意志领地。

en: Nicholas, also called Claus of Holstein (1321–1397), was the second son of Count Gerhard III and Sophia of Werle. From 1340 he co-ruled Holstein-Rendsburg, first with his brother Henry II and later with his nephews. In 1375 he became co-ruler of Schleswig, ruling it alone after Henry's death. In 1386 he yielded the Duchy of Schleswig to Henry's son Gerhard VI. In 1390 he and his nephews inherited Holstein-Kiel, uniting nearly all of Holstein. He married Elisabeth of Brunswick-Lüneburg in 1354, died at Itzehoe on 8 May 1397, and was buried there.
zh: 尼库劳斯（1321—1397），又称荷尔斯泰因的克劳斯，是格哈德三世与韦尔勒的索菲的次子。1340年起，他先与兄长海因里希二世、后与侄子们共同统治荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡。1375年他成为石勒苏益格的共治者，海因里希死后独自执政。1386年，他把石勒苏益格公爵之位让给海因里希之子格哈德六世。1390年他与侄子们继承荷尔斯泰因-基尔，几乎统一整个荷尔斯泰因。他于1354年迎娶不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的伊丽莎白，1397年5月8日在伊策霍去世并葬于当地。

en: Sophia of Werle (d. after 1339) was a daughter of Lord Nicholas II of Werle and Richeza, daughter of King Eric V of Denmark. In 1310 her uncle King Eric VI betrothed her to Duke Erik Magnusson of Södermanland and sent her to Sweden, but Erik married Ingebjørg of Norway in 1312 and Sophia returned home. Around 1315 she married Count Gerhard III of Holstein-Rendsburg, later the ruler of Denmark. Her sons Henry II and Nicholas succeeded as counts, and she also bore Adolf and Elisabeth; through Henry she was an ancestress of the House of Oldenburg.
zh: 韦尔勒的索菲（1339年后在世）是韦尔勒领主尼库劳斯二世与丹麦国王埃里克五世之女里基莎的女儿。1310年，她的舅舅丹麦国王埃里克六世将她许配给南曼兰公爵埃里克·马格努松，并把她送往瑞典；但埃里克于1312年另娶挪威的英格堡，索菲只好返回韦尔勒。约1315年，她嫁给后来统治丹麦的荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡伯爵格哈德三世。儿子海因里希二世和尼库劳斯后来继任伯爵，她还生有阿道夫和伊丽莎白；通过海因里希，她成为奥尔登堡家族的先祖之一。

en: Princess Shouning was a Yuan imperial princess, the daughter of Gammala, Prince of Jin, and elder sister of Yesün Temür, the future Taiding Emperor; her grandfather was Crown Prince Zhenjin and her great-grandfather Kublai Khan. She married into the Naiman clan. When her cousin's son Emperor Yingzong took the throne, he granted her seventy-five thousand guan in paper currency, and after her brother seized power in 1323 she received a hundred qing of land and further gifts of notes. Her daughter Babusha married Khutughtu Khan and bore the future Emperor Ningzong; another daughter, Sadabala, entered the Taiding Emperor's harem in 1326.
zh: 寿宁公主是元朝公主，晋王甘麻剌之女，后来的泰定帝也孙铁木儿之姊，祖父为皇太子真金，曾祖父为忽必烈。她下嫁乃马真氏。堂侄元英宗即位后，赐她钞七万五千贯；1323年其弟泰定帝登基，又赐她田地百顷、钞三万锭，另赐钞五千锭。她的女儿八不沙嫁给元明宗，生下后来的元宁宗；另一女撒答八剌于1326年被舅舅泰定帝纳入宫中。

en: Nusrat al-Din Hasan (died 1277) was a son of the Seljuk vizier Sahib Ata Fakhr al-Din Ali. In 1275 his father secured Karahisar-i Sahib (Afyonkarahisar) and its region as a family holding for Hasan and his brother Taj al-Din Husayn, founding the Sahib Ataid beylik under their joint rule. When the Karamanid Mehmed Bey and the Seljuk pretender Cimri seized Konya in 1277, the brothers marched against them and both fell at the Battle of Değirmençayı. Hasan's son Shams al-Din Mehmed succeeded as bey.
zh: 努斯拉丁·哈桑（？—1277年）是鲁姆塞尔柱维齐尔萨希布·阿塔·法赫尔丁·阿里之子。1275年，他的父亲为哈桑及其兄弟塔杰丁·侯赛因求得以萨希布-卡拉希萨尔（阿菲永卡拉希萨尔）为中心的地区作家族封地，萨希布-阿塔贝伊里克由此在二人共同统治下建立。1277年，卡拉曼的穆罕默德贝伊与塞尔柱僭位者吉姆里攻占科尼亚，兄弟二人出兵征讨，双双战死于代伊尔门恰伊战役。哈桑之子舍姆塞丁·穆罕默德继位。

en: Taj al-Din Husayn (died 1277) was a son of the powerful Seljuk vizier Sahib Ata Fakhr al-Din Ali. In 1275, after his father regained the vizierate, the Ilkhan Abaqa granted Karahisar-i Sahib (Afyonkarahisar) and its district to Husayn and his brother Nusrat al-Din Hasan as a holding, establishing the Sahib Ataid beylik under their joint rule. In 1277 the brothers took the field against the Karamanid Mehmed Bey, who with the pretender Cimri had seized Konya, and both were killed at the Battle of Değirmençayı.
zh: 塔杰丁·侯赛因（？—1277年）是权势显赫的鲁姆塞尔柱维齐尔萨希布·阿塔·法赫尔丁·阿里之子。1275年他的父亲重掌维齐尔之位后，伊利汗阿八哈将萨希布-卡拉希萨尔（阿菲永卡拉希萨尔）及周边地区封给侯赛因与兄弟努斯拉丁·哈桑，萨希布-阿塔贝伊里克由此在二人共同统治下建立。1277年，兄弟二人出兵征讨偕同僭位者吉姆里攻占科尼亚的卡拉曼穆罕默德贝伊，双双战死于代伊尔门恰伊战役。

en: Mughith al-Din Isa, son of Muzaffar al-Din and cousin of the Sahib Ataid ruler Nusreddin Ahmed, was the emir who restored the great mosque of Karahisar in 1341.
zh: 穆吉斯丁·伊萨是穆扎法尔丁之子、萨希布-阿塔统治者努斯雷丁·艾哈迈德的堂兄弟；这位埃米尔于1341年修复了卡拉希萨尔大清真寺。

en: Shams al-Din Mehmed (died 1287) was the second bey of the Sahib Ataids. His father Nusrat al-Din Hasan and his uncle Taj al-Din Husayn, joint founders of the beylik, both fell fighting the Karamanids at the Battle of Değirmençayı in 1277, and Mehmed succeeded to the rule of Karahisar-i Sahib (Afyonkarahisar). In 1287 he led his forces to repel an attack by the neighbouring Germiyanids and was killed in the fighting. His son Nusrat al-Din Ahmed succeeded him.
zh: 舍姆塞丁·穆罕默德（？—1287年）是萨希布-阿塔的第二代贝伊。1277年，贝伊里克的共同创建者——他的父亲努斯拉丁·哈桑与叔父塔杰丁·侯赛因在代伊尔门恰伊战役中同卡拉曼人作战时双双阵亡，穆罕默德遂继领萨希布-卡拉希萨尔（阿菲永卡拉希萨尔）。1287年，他率军抵御邻邦格尔米扬的进攻，战死沙场。其子努斯拉丁·艾哈迈德继位。

en: Muzaffar al-Din (died 1333) was a son of Shams al-Din Mehmed, the second Sahib Ataid bey of Karahisar-i Sahib (Afyonkarahisar), and a brother of Nusrat al-Din Ahmed, who ruled the beylik after their father fell fighting the Germiyanids in 1287.
zh: 穆扎法尔丁（？—1333年）是萨希布-卡拉希萨尔（阿菲永卡拉希萨尔）第二代萨希布-阿塔贝伊舍姆塞丁·穆罕默德之子，也是努斯拉丁·艾哈迈德的兄弟；艾哈迈德在其父1287年与格尔米扬人作战阵亡后统治该贝伊里克。

en: Nusreddin Ahmed was the third bey of the Sahib Ataid Turkish principality centered on Karahisar-i Sahib. In 1287 he succeeded his father Shams al-Din Mehmed, who had fallen in battle against a Germiyanid attack. When the Ilkhanid governor Temürtaş marched against the Anatolian march lords and besieged Karahisar, Ahmed took refuge with the Germiyanids. Temürtaş abandoned the siege in 1327 after his own father, Emir Choban, was killed by the Ilkhan Abu Sa'id, and Ahmed returned to rule as a Germiyanid vassal. He died in 1343, after which his lands were absorbed into the Germiyanid beylik.
zh: 努斯雷丁·艾哈迈德是以萨希卜卡拉希萨尔为中心的萨希布-阿塔突厥贝伊国第三代贝伊。1287年，其父沙姆斯丁·穆罕默德在抵御格尔米扬进攻的战斗中身亡，艾哈迈德继位。伊利汗国安纳托利亚长官帖木儿塔什征讨边境诸贝伊并围攻卡拉希萨尔时，他逃往格尔米扬避难。1327年，帖木儿塔什之父出班被伊利汗不赛因处死，他遂撤围逃往埃及，艾哈迈德得以归国，作为格尔米扬的附庸继续统治。他于1343年去世，领土随后被并入格尔米扬贝伊国。

en: Fakhr al-Din Ali, known as Sâhib Ata, was grand vizier of the Seljuk Sultanate of Rum. First recorded in 1249 as amir-i dad, the chief justiciar, he held the regency in 1258 when Sultan Kaykawus II joined the Ilkhanid campaign against Baghdad, received the title sahib in 1260, and became grand vizier in 1261. After the Mongols executed Mu'in al-Din Parwana in 1277, he was the dominant ruler of the sultanate. His sons Husayn and Hasan founded the Sahip Ataid principality. A great architectural patron, he died in 1288 after returning ill from the Ilkhanid court at Tabriz.
zh: 法赫尔丁·阿里，通称萨希布·阿塔，是罗姆塞尔柱苏丹国的大维齐尔。史籍中他最早于1249年以司法长官“埃米尔·达德”身份出现；1258年苏丹伊兹丁·凯考斯二世随伊儿汗大军出征巴格达期间，他以摄政留守，1260年获赐“萨希布”称号，1261年出任大维齐尔。1277年穆因丁·佩瓦内被蒙古人处死后，他成为罗姆苏丹国最有权势的执政者。其子侯赛因与哈桑开创萨希布·阿塔侯国。他大兴土木、广建慈善机构，1288年在大不里士觐见伊儿汗后抱病返回，不久便去世。

en: Dietrich I (documented 1209–1249) was Count of Hohnstein, a Harz comital dynasty, and Vogt, or lay protector, of Homburg monastery on the Unstrut. Before 1231 he married Hedwig, daughter of Count Frederick II of Brehna. In the spring of 1231 he appeared among the princes gathered at the imperial court assembly at Worms. He is last recorded in 1249 and died on 23 July that year. His son Henry I succeeded him in the county and added the Klettenberg lordship in 1253.
zh: 迪特里希一世（见于1209—1249年文献）是哈茨山区伯爵世家霍恩施泰因家族的伯爵，并担任温斯特鲁特河畔洪堡修道院的护佑官（福格特）。1231年之前，他迎娶布雷纳伯爵腓特烈二世之女海德维希。1231年春，他作为诸侯之一出席沃尔姆斯帝国宫廷会议。他于1249年7月23日去世，其子海因里希一世继位，并于1253年取得克莱滕贝格领地。

en: Dietrich II (c. 1245–1309) was Count of Hohnstein-Klettenberg, the son of Count Henry I. Made a knight in 1275, he became junior head of the dynasty in 1279 and steadily widened its Thuringian holdings: Arnsberg in 1293, Sondershausen by 1295, Voigtstedt and Artern in 1298, and the Vogtei of Dietenborn in 1299. In 1303 he held Roßla and Uftrungen jointly with the counts of Stolberg, and in 1307 he became senior of the house. He married Sophie of Anhalt-Bernburg and died between 28 May and 11 August 1309.
zh: 迪特里希二世（约1245—1309）是霍恩施泰因-克莱滕贝格伯爵，海因里希一世之子。1275年受封骑士，1279年成为家族的年少领主，并不断扩大在图林根的领地：1293年取得阿恩斯贝格，1295年前取得松德斯豪森，1298年取得福格特施泰特与阿特恩，1299年成为迪滕博恩的护佑官，1303年与施托尔贝格诸伯爵共同领有罗斯拉和乌夫特龙根，1307年成为全族族长。他娶安哈尔特-贝恩堡的索菲为妻，于1309年5月28日至8月11日之间去世。

en: Henry I (c. 1225–1284/93) was Count of Hohnstein, succeeding his father Dietrich I in 1249. In 1253 he took over Klettenberg, and over the following decades he built up a Thuringian lordship piecemeal: half of Kirchberg Castle and Ehrich in 1259, Greußen in 1260, and in 1263 Landgrave Albert of Thuringia enfeoffed him with Spatenberg Castle and its rights; Sömmerda followed in 1268. He married Mechthild of Regenstein before 1253, became senior of the house in 1280, and died on 24 January, between 1284 and 1293.
zh: 海因里希一世（约1225—1284/1293）是霍恩施泰因伯爵，1249年继承父亲迪特里希一世。1253年他接管克莱滕贝格，此后数十年间逐步在图林根扩展领地：1259年取得基希贝格城堡的一半份额与埃里希，1260年取得格罗伊森，1263年图林根领地伯爵阿尔布雷希特将施帕滕贝格城堡及其权益封赐给他，1268年又取得瑟默达。1253年前他娶雷根施泰因的玛蒂尔德为妻，1280年成为家族族长，于1284至1293年间的1月24日去世。

en: Heinrich II (IV), Count of Honstein, was born around 1275, the son of Count Dietrich II and Sophie of Anhalt-Bernburg. Through his marriage before 1302 to Irmgard, heiress of Arnstadt, he inherited Arnstadt in 1302. He became head of the house in 1305 and ruled its Klettenberg lands from 1309. He acquired Lohra in 1324, built Heringen Castle with his brother Dietrich III in 1327 and held Heringen until 1332; he held Blankenburg in pledge from 1339. He founded the Klettberg line, is last documented in 1342 and died before 1344.
zh: 海因里希二世（又排序四世）是霍恩施泰因伯爵，约1275年生，为伯爵迪特里希二世与安哈尔特-贝恩堡的索菲之子。他在1302年前娶阿恩施塔特女继承人伊尔姆加德，于1302年继承阿恩施塔特。1305年他成为家族之长，1309年起统治克莱滕贝格领地。他于1324年取得罗拉，1327年与弟弟迪特里希三世合筑黑林根城堡，领有黑林根至1332年；1339年起受质领有布兰肯堡。他开创了克莱滕贝格支系，最后见于1342年的文书，1344年前去世。

en: Henry III of Honstein (c. 1256–1305) was a count of the Honstein dynasty who ruled its southern Harz lands around Honstein, Arnstadt and Sondershausen. He was the son of Count Henry I of Honstein and Mechtild of Regenstein. Before 28 November 1282 he married Jutta, daughter of Count Otto II of Ravensberg. His son Henry V kept Sondershausen after him, and another son, Dietrich IV, also ruled there as count. Henry III died between 10 August and 13 December 1305, and Jutta died shortly before him.
zh: 亨利希三世·冯·霍恩施泰因（约1256—1305年）是霍恩施泰因家族的伯爵，领有南哈茨山区霍恩施泰因、阿恩施塔特和松德斯豪森一带的领地。他是霍恩施泰因伯爵亨利希一世与雷根施泰因的梅希蒂尔德之子。1282年11月28日之前，他娶拉文斯贝格伯爵奥托二世之女尤塔为妻。其子亨利希五世在他之后领有松德斯豪森，另一子迪特里希四世也在当地任伯爵。亨利希三世于1305年8月10日至12月13日之间去世，尤塔稍早于他亡故。

en: Henry V (III) of Honstein (c. 1290–1356) was count of Honstein-Sondershausen in the Thuringian Harz, son of Count Henry III and Jutta of Ravensberg. First recorded in 1300, he ruled Sondershausen from 1312 and held the pledged lordships of Wolmirstedt from 1327, Dornburg from 1343 and Rotenburg from 1347. Around 1319 he married Matilda of Brunswick-Göttingen, daughter of Duke Albert II. Their daughters Agnes and Elizabeth married Schwarzburg counts, while Richza wed the count of Beichlingen in 1339. Leaving no son, Henry died after 24 April 1356, and Sondershausen passed to the Schwarzburgs.
zh: 亨利希五世（又编号为三世）·冯·霍恩施泰因（约1290—1356）是图林根哈茨山区霍恩施泰因-松德斯豪森伯爵，伯爵亨利希三世与拉文斯贝格的尤塔之子。他1300年首见文献记载，1312年起统治松德斯豪森，又于1327年、1343年、1347年先后受领抵押领地沃尔米施泰特、多恩堡和罗滕堡。约1319年，他娶不伦瑞克-哥廷根公爵阿尔布雷希特二世之女玛蒂尔达；女儿阿格妮丝与伊丽莎白分别嫁入施瓦茨堡家族，里查则于1339年嫁给拜希林根伯爵。他没有儿子，1356年4月24日之后去世，松德斯豪森转入施瓦茨堡家族之手。

en: Matilda of Brunswick-Göttingen (1293–1356), daughter of Duke Albert II of Brunswick-Göttingen and Rixa of Werle, married Count Henry V of Honstein-Sondershausen around 1319. Her brothers included Duke Otto the Mild and the bishops of Halberstadt and Hildesheim.
zh: 玛蒂尔达·冯·不伦瑞克-哥廷根（1293—1356）是不伦瑞克-哥廷根公爵阿尔布雷希特二世与维尔勒的里克萨之女，约1319年嫁给霍恩施泰因-松德斯豪森伯爵亨利希五世；她的兄弟中有“温和者”奥托及哈尔伯施塔特、希尔德斯海姆的主教。

en: Richza of Honstein (died after 1386) was a daughter of Count Henry V of Honstein-Sondershausen and Matilda of Brunswick-Göttingen. On 1 May 1339 she married Count Frederick XI of Beichlingen-Rotenburg.
zh: 里查·冯·霍恩施泰因（1386年后卒）是霍恩施泰因-松德斯豪森伯爵亨利希五世与不伦瑞克-哥廷根的玛蒂尔达之女，1339年5月1日嫁给拜希林根-罗滕堡伯爵弗里德里希十一世。

en: Antoni de Vilaragut i Visconti (1336–1400) was a Catalan nobleman, son of Ramon de Vilaragut and Diana Visconti of Milan. He went from Valencia to Sicily at sixteen and, captaining ships defending the island against the kings of Naples, received the barony of Tripi from John, duke of Athens. In 1375 Peter IV made him castellan of Xàtiva, and in 1388 John I named him majordomo and granted him the barony of Dosaigües and Alaquàs. He died there in 1400 leaving one of its greatest estates; the Seneca translations once credited to him may have been made by his grandson of the same name.
zh: 安东尼·德·维拉拉古特-维斯孔蒂（1336—1400）是加泰罗尼亚贵族，拉蒙·德·维拉拉古特与米兰的戴安娜·维斯孔蒂之子。他16岁时从瓦伦西亚前往西西里，率船队保卫岛屿、抵御那不勒斯诸王，因而从雅典公爵胡安手中受封特里皮男爵领。1375年，佩德罗四世任命他为哈蒂瓦城守；1388年，胡安一世任他为总管，赐他多赛圭斯男爵领和阿拉夸斯。1400年他在瓦伦西亚去世，留下当地最庞大的地产之一；旧题他翻译的塞内加作品，可能出自其同名孙子之手。

en: Beatrice of Sicily (5 September 1326 – 12 October 1365) was a princess of the House of Barcelona, daughter of King Peter II of Sicily and Elisabeth of Carinthia, born in Palermo. In 1335 she was betrothed to her cousin John Henry IV of Gorizia, but the match was broken off when his mother allied the county with the Habsburgs. In 1345 she married Rupert, Count Palatine of the Rhine, after obtaining a papal dispensation. Her son Rupert became King of Germany. She died in 1365 and was buried at Schönau Abbey near Heidelberg.
zh: 西西里的贝亚特丽切（1326年9月5日—1365年10月12日）是巴塞罗那家族的公主，西西里国王彼得二世与卡林西亚的伊丽莎白之女，生于巴勒莫。1335年，她与表亲戈里齐亚伯爵约翰·亨利四世订婚，但男方母亲转而与哈布斯堡家族结盟，婚约告吹。1345年，她在获教皇特许后嫁给莱茵行宫伯爵鲁普雷希特。她的儿子鲁普雷希特后来成为德意志国王。1365年她去世，葬于海德堡附近的舍瑙修道院。

en: Beatrice of Savoy (born before 4 March 1223) was the elder daughter of Count Amadeus IV of Savoy. In March 1233 she married Manfred III, marquess of Saluzzo, and on his death in 1244 she held the regency for their young son Thomas, until Boniface II of Montferrat forced her aside. In March 1247 she married by proxy Manfred, son of Emperor Frederick II, sealing the Savoy-Hohenstaufen alliance; the contract was signed on 21 April. Their daughter Constance (1249–1302) married Peter III of Aragon. Beatrice died in 1258 or 1259, just as her husband seized the crown of Sicily.
zh: 萨伏依的贝娅特丽克丝（1223年3月4日前生）是萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥四世的长女。1233年3月，她嫁给萨卢佐侯爵曼弗雷德三世；1244年丈夫去世后，她代年幼的儿子托马索摄政，后被蒙费拉托侯爵博尼法斯二世逼迫交出摄政权。1247年3月，她以代理婚礼嫁给皇帝腓特烈二世之子曼弗雷德，这桩婚约意在巩固萨伏依与霍亨斯陶芬的同盟，婚契于4月21日签署。两人的女儿康斯坦丝（1249—1302）后来嫁给阿拉贡国王佩德罗三世。1258或1259年，就在丈夫夺取西西里王冠之际，贝娅特丽克丝去世。

en: Bianca Lancia (c. 1210–c. 1248) was an Italian noblewoman of the Lancia family of Piedmont, who spent much of her life at the family seat of Brolo. She became the mistress of Emperor Frederick II, probably meeting him in Sicily between 1226 and 1230, and bore him three children: Constance, who married the Nicaean emperor John III Vatatzes in 1244; Manfred, later king of Sicily; and Violante, wed to Richard Sanseverino, count of Caserta. Chroniclers record a deathbed marriage to Frederick around 1247, which legitimized Manfred but was never recognized as canonical by the Church.
zh: 比安卡·兰恰（约1210—约1248）是皮埃蒙特兰恰家族的意大利贵妇，大半生居于家族领地布罗洛城堡。她成为皇帝腓特烈二世的情妇，两人大约于1226至1230年间在西西里相识，共生有三个子女：1244年嫁给尼西亚皇帝约翰三世·瓦塔齐斯的康斯坦丝、后来成为西西里国王的曼弗雷德，以及嫁给卡塞塔伯爵里卡尔多·桑塞韦里诺的维奥兰特。据编年史家记载，约1247年她在临终之际与腓特烈成婚，曼弗雷德由此获得嫡子身份，但教会始终不承认这场婚姻具有教会法效力。

en: Blasco Lancia (born c. 1318) was the eldest son of Ugo Lancia, second baron of Ficarra. He succeeded his father as third baron of Ficarra, and the later Marquesses of Ficarra and Dukes of Brolo descended from his line.
zh: 布拉斯科·兰恰（约1318年生）是菲卡拉第二代男爵乌戈·兰恰的长子，袭任第三代菲卡拉男爵；后世的菲卡拉侯爵与布罗洛公爵两支都出自他这一系。

en: Cesarea Lancia, also called Cesarina (born c. 1320–1326), was a Sicilian noblewoman, daughter of Pietro Lancia, Count of Caltanissetta and lord of Delia, and Isabella di Alagona. In 1340 she married the Aragonese infante John of Randazzo, Duke of Athens and Neopatras, who became regent for his nephew King Louis in 1342. As Pietro left no sons, the County of Caltanissetta passed to John through this marriage. Her son Frederick succeeded his father as Duke of Athens and Neopatras when John died of plague at Milo in April 1348. Cesarea was lady of Caltanissetta.
zh: 切萨雷娅·兰恰又称切萨里娜（约1320—1326年生）是西西里贵族女子，父亲是卡尔塔尼塞塔伯爵、代利亚领主彼得罗·兰恰，母亲是伊莎贝拉·迪·阿拉戈纳。1340年，她嫁给阿拉贡王族、雅典与新帕特拉斯公爵乔万尼·迪·兰达佐；他于1342年开始为侄子路易国王摄政。因彼得罗没有儿子，卡尔塔尼塞塔伯国经这场婚姻转入乔万尼手中。1348年4月乔万尼在米洛染瘟疫去世，她的儿子腓特烈承袭雅典与新帕特拉斯公爵之位。切萨雷娅本人为卡尔塔尼塞塔女主。

en: Catherine of Sicily (1320–1342) was a daughter of King Frederick III of Sicily and his wife Eleanor of Anjou. She became abbess of the convent of Santa Chiara in Messina, where she died in 1342.
zh: 西西里的凯瑟琳（1320—1342）是西西里国王费德里科三世与王后安茹的埃莉诺之女，曾任墨西拿圣嘉勒修道院院长，1342年在当地去世。

en: Conradin (25 March 1252 – 29 October 1268), the last heir of the Hohenstaufen dynasty, was the son of King Conrad IV of Germany and Elisabeth of Bavaria, inheriting the Duchy of Swabia and claims to Sicily and Jerusalem in 1254. Raised in Bavaria, he saw Manfred crowned king of Sicily in 1258 after a false rumour of his death. He crossed the Alps in 1267 to answer the Ghibelline call after Charles of Anjou seized southern Italy. Excommunicated by the pope that year, he entered Rome in July 1268. On 23 August 1268 Charles crushed his army at Tagliacozzo. Betrayed at Astura while trying to sail to Sicily, Conradin was beheaded in Naples on 29 October 1268, aged sixteen, ending the Hohenstaufen male line.
zh: 康拉丁（1252年3月25日—1268年10月29日）是霍恩施陶芬王朝末代继承人，德意志国王康拉德四世与巴伐利亚的伊丽莎白之子，1254年继承士瓦本公国以及对西西里和耶路撒冷的王位主张。他在巴伐利亚长大；1258年，他的死讯谣言传出后，曼弗雷迪加冕为西西里国王。安茹的查理占领南意大利后，他于1267年应吉伯林派之请翻越阿尔卑斯山，同年被教皇开除教籍，1268年7月进入罗马。1268年8月23日，查理在塔利亚科佐歼灭其军队。康拉丁试图从阿斯图拉登船前往西西里时被出卖，1268年10月29日在那不勒斯被斩首，年仅十六岁，霍恩施陶芬家族男系就此断绝。

en: Constance of Sicily (1304/1306 – after 1344), born at Palermo, was a daughter of Frederick III of Sicily and Eleanor of Anjou. She was betrothed to a son of Philip IV of France until the boy died in 1308, then married King Henry II of Cyprus in 1317 and was widowed in 1324. On 29 December 1331 she married Leo IV of Cilician Armenia; the marriage further aroused anti-Western and anti-Catholic sentiment in Armenia, and all her pregnancies ended in miscarriage. After Leo was murdered in December 1341, she married John of Lusignan in 1343 and died after 19 June 1344.
zh: 西西里的康斯坦丝（1304/1306—1344年后）生于巴勒莫，是西西里国王腓特烈三世与安茹的埃莉诺之女。她先许配给法国国王腓力四世之子，未婚夫1308年夭折；1317年她嫁给塞浦路斯国王亨利二世，1324年守寡。1331年12月29日，她改嫁奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王莱昂四世；这桩婚姻进一步激起亚美尼亚的反西方和反天主教情绪，她的每次怀孕都以流产告终。1341年12月莱昂被谋杀后，她于1343年再嫁吕西尼昂的约翰，1344年6月19日之后去世。

en: Constance of Sicily (1324 – 22 October 1355) was a daughter of King Peter II and Elisabeth of Carinthia. Unmarried, she was abbess of Santa Chiara in Messina and educated her younger brothers Louis and Frederick. After her mother the queen regent died in 1352, Constance took over the regency for the young King Louis, ruling a kingdom torn by baronial feuds and the Black Death. Louis died of the plague on 16 October 1355; Constance followed him days later on 22 October. Their sister Euphemia then served as regent for her brother Frederick.
zh: 西西里的科斯坦察（1324—1355年10月22日）是国王皮埃特罗二世与克恩滕的伊丽莎白之女。她终身未嫁，任墨西拿圣嘉勒修道院院长，并教导弟弟路德维科与费德里科。1352年身为摄政的母亲去世后，科斯坦察接任摄政，辅佐幼王路德维科，统治着被贵族内讧与黑死病撕裂的王国。1355年10月16日路德维科死于瘟疫，数日之后的10月22日科斯坦察也病逝。妹妹欧菲米亚随后出任弟弟费德里科的摄政。

en: Conrad of Antioch (born 1240/1241, died after 1312) was the eldest son of Frederick of Antioch, grandson of Emperor Frederick II and nephew of King Manfred. In 1258 he was confirmed in the counties of Albe, Celano and Loreto and made captain of Abruzzo. He fought to restore Hohenstaufen control in central Italy for Manfred, but the Angevin conquest forced him into exile. There his cousin Conradin made him prince of Abruzzo. He joined Conradin's invasion of 1267–1268, fought at Tagliacozzo, and was a prisoner until 1272. In the War of the Sicilian Vespers he raided Angevin Abruzzo in 1282–1286 without success, then retired to Anticoli; in May 1312 he led fifty knights to Rome to greet Henry VII.
zh: 安条克的康拉德（1240/1241年生，1312年后去世）是安条克的弗雷德里克的长子、皇帝腓特烈二世之孙、曼弗雷迪国王的侄子。1258年他的阿尔贝、切拉诺和洛雷托三处伯国获得确认，并被任命为阿布鲁佐长官。他为曼弗雷迪征战，试图恢复霍恩施陶芬家族在意大利中部的统治，却在安茹家族征服王国后被迫流亡。流亡期间堂弟康拉丁授予他阿布鲁佐亲王头衔。1267—1268年，他加入康拉丁收复王国的进军，在塔利亚科佐参战，被俘后关押至1272年。西西里晚祷战争期间，他于1282—1286年多次袭扰安茹家族治下的阿布鲁佐，均未得手，此后退居安蒂科利；1312年5月，他还率五十名骑士赴罗马迎接亨利七世。

en: Corrado Lancia, known as Corrado di Castromainardo, was a Sicilian nobleman, founder of the Lancia branch of Sicily. His father Galeotto was executed by the Angevins after Tagliacozzo in 1268, and the family took refuge in Aragon, returning under Aragonese rule. In 1302 the crown granted him the baronies of Longi, Ficarra and Castania and Brolo castle; he later served as justiciar of Palermo and head of the royal patrimony. In 1312 he led 2200 men to Djerba and defeated its rebel Moors, and in 1314 he negotiated the truce of Trapani with Robert of Anjou. He died around 1328.
zh: 科拉多·兰恰，人称卡斯特罗马伊纳尔多的科拉多，是西西里贵族与将领，兰恰家族西西里支系的始祖。其父加莱奥托于1268年塔利亚科佐战役后被安茹家族处死，全家避难阿拉贡，在阿拉贡统治西西里后才返回。1302年，王室将隆吉、菲卡拉、卡斯塔尼亚等男爵领地及布罗洛城堡封赐给他，他此后历任巴勒莫司法官和王室财产总管。1312年，他率2200人远征杰尔巴岛，击败岛上叛乱的摩尔人；1314年又在特拉帕尼与安茹的罗贝尔谈判停战。他于约1328年去世。

en: Corrado Lancia (born c. 1319) was a son of Ugo Lancia, second baron of Ficarra. He held the lordship of Mongialino in the territory of Mineo and served the Sicilian crown as castellan and captain of the castle and town of Sambuca.
zh: 科拉多·兰恰（约1319年生）是菲卡拉第二代男爵乌戈·兰恰之子，领有米内奥境内的蒙贾利诺庄园，并为西西里王室担任萨姆布卡城堡与城镇的城堡总管兼军政长官。

en: Constance II of Sicily (c. 1249–1302) was the only daughter of Manfred, King of Sicily, and Beatrice of Savoy. Raised largely by Bella d'Amichi, she kept her as a confidante after becoming queen. On 13 June 1262 she married Peter, eldest son of James I of Aragon. After Manfred fell to Charles of Anjou at Benevento in 1266, she inherited the Hohenstaufen claim to Sicily. Queen consort of Aragon from 1276, she ruled Sicily alongside Peter after the Sicilian Vespers of 1282 until his death in 1285. Peter and then their sons claimed Sicily in her right during the ensuing war, which divided the kingdom between their heirs and those of Charles. Her sons included James II of Aragon and Frederick III of Sicily. She died as a nun in Barcelona on 9 April 1302.
zh: 科斯坦察二世（约1249—1302）是西西里国王曼弗雷迪与萨伏依的贝阿特丽切的独女。她主要由贝拉·达米基抚养长大，成为王后后仍以她为心腹。1262年6月13日，她嫁给阿拉贡国王海梅一世的长子彼得。1266年，曼弗雷迪在贝内文托战役中与安茹的查理作战时身亡，她继承了霍恩施陶芬家族对西西里的王位主张。1276年起她成为阿拉贡王后，1282年西西里晚祷起义后与彼得共同统治西西里，直至1285年彼得去世。在随后的战争中，彼得及其子凭她的权利主张西西里王位，战争最终使王国在他们与查理的继承人之间分裂。她的儿子包括阿拉贡国王海梅二世和西西里国王费德里科二世。1302年4月9日，她在巴塞罗那以修女身份去世。

en: Demetrius of Montferrat (1205–1230) was king of Thessalonica from 1207. Born in the city and named after its patron Saint Demetrius, he was the son of Marquis Boniface I of Montferrat and Margaret of Hungary. After his father was killed fighting the Bulgarians, the Latin Emperor Henry of Flanders overawed the rebellious Lombard barons and crowned the boy king on 6 January 1209. When Theodore Komnenos Doukas of Epirus took Thessalonica in December 1224, Demetrius fled to Frederick II in Italy, joined his crusade, ceded him his claims to the kingdom and died at Amalfi in 1230.
zh: 蒙费拉托的德米特里（1205—1230年）自1207年起为塞萨洛尼基国王。他生于该城，以城中主保圣人圣德米特里得名，是蒙费拉托侯爵博尼法乔一世与匈牙利的玛格丽特之子。父亲在对保加利亚人的战事中被杀后，拉丁帝国皇帝佛兰德的亨利压服叛乱的伦巴第诸侯，于1209年1月6日为幼主加冕。1224年12月伊庇鲁斯的狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯攻陷塞萨洛尼基，德米特里逃往意大利投奔腓特烈二世，参加了后者的十字军并把对王国的权利让予他，1230年卒于阿马尔菲。

en: Eleanor of Anjou (August 1289–1341), third daughter of Charles II of Naples and Mary of Hungary, was a bride whose wedding helped end a war.
