Her childhood marriage to Philippe II de Toucy in 1299 was dissolved by Pope Boniface VIII in January 1300, because the two were related and had not sought papal permission. On 17 May 1302 she married Frederick III, King of Sicily, whom her father had long fought over Sicily. The wedding was part of the diplomacy behind the Peace of Caltabellotta of 19 August 1302, which gave Frederick the island and her father the mainland kingdom. She bore Frederick nine children, including Peter II, his successor, Constance, and Manfred, William and Giovanni, who each held the duchy of Athens. Widowed in 1337, she died on 9 August 1341 at the monastery of San Nicolò di Arena in Catania and was buried at a Franciscan monastery there.
zh: 安茹的埃莉诺（1289年8月—1341）是那不勒斯国王卡洛二世与匈牙利的玛丽亚的第三个女儿，她的婚礼促成了一场战争的结束。1299年，她幼年嫁给菲利普二世·德·图西，1300年1月教皇卜尼法斯八世因两人有亲属关系且未获教皇许可而解除了这段婚姻。1302年5月17日，她嫁给西西里国王费德里科二世，而她的父亲一直为西西里与他交战。这场婚礼属于《卡尔塔贝洛塔和约》（1302年8月19日）背后的外交努力：和约把西西里岛划给费德里科，大陆王国归她的父亲。她为费德里科生下九个子女，包括继位的彼得二世、科斯坦察，以及都曾任雅典公爵的曼弗雷迪、威廉和乔瓦尼。1337年守寡，1341年8月9日卒于卡塔尼亚的圣尼科洛·迪·阿雷纳修道院，葬于当地一座方济各会修道院。

en: Eleanor (1325–1375) was a Sicilian princess, daughter of King Peter II of Sicily and Elisabeth of Carinthia. On 27 August 1349 she married King Peter IV of Aragon at Valencia as his third wife, becoming queen consort of the Crown of Aragon. She held strong influence at court, and in 1357 backed an unsuccessful plan to send Aragonese aid to her brother Frederick IV of Sicily in exchange for the Duchy of Neopatras. Her sons John I and Martin I both became kings of Aragon. She died at Lleida on 20 April 1375 and was buried at Poblet.
zh: 艾蕾诺拉（1325—1375）是西西里公主，为西西里国王彼得二世与卡林西亚的伊丽莎白之女。1349年8月27日，她在巴伦西亚嫁给阿拉贡国王彼得四世，成为其第三任妻子、阿拉贡联合王国王后。她在宫廷中颇有影响力；1357年，她支持出兵援助弟弟、西西里国王腓特烈四世，以换取新帕特拉斯公国，但计划未果。她的儿子约翰一世与马丁一世都成为阿拉贡国王。1375年4月20日她在莱里达去世，葬于波夫莱特修道院。

en: Elizabeth of Carinthia (1298?–1352) was the daughter of Otto III of Carinthia of the House of Gorizia and Euphemia of Silesia-Liegnitz. In 1323 she married King Peter II of Sicily and became queen, bearing the future kings Louis and Frederick IV as well as four daughters. When Peter died in 1342, her brother-in-law John of Randazzo ruled as regent for the child Louis; after John's death from plague in April 1348 Elizabeth took the regency herself. For four years she steered the crown through feuding Catalan and Latin noble factions until her own death, probably of plague, in 1352.
zh: 卡林西亚的伊丽莎白（约1298—1352）是戈里齐亚家族卡林西亚公爵奥托三世与西里西亚-莱格尼察的欧费米娅之女。1323年，她嫁给西西里国王彼得二世成为王后，生下后来的国王路易与腓特烈四世以及四个女儿。1342年彼得去世后，先由小叔兰达佐的约翰为幼王路易摄政；1348年4月约翰染瘟疫而死，伊丽莎白亲自出任摄政。她主持朝政四年，在加泰罗尼亚派与拉丁派贵族的争斗中维系王权，最终于1352年去世，可能同样死于瘟疫。

en: Elisabetta of Sicily (c. 1297–1341) was an illegitimate daughter of King Frederick III of Sicily by Sibilla Sormella. She married first Count Ponç VI of Empúries in 1313 and then, in 1322, Raimondo Peralta, grand admiral of Aragon and first count of Caltabellotta.
zh: 西西里的伊丽莎白（约1297—1341）是西西里国王腓特烈三世与情妇西比拉·索尔梅拉的私生女，1313年先嫁安普里亚斯伯爵庞斯六世，1322年改嫁阿拉贡海军大将、首任卡尔塔贝洛塔伯爵拉伊蒙多·佩拉尔塔。

en: Euphemia of Sicily (1330 – 28 February 1359) was a princess of the House of Barcelona, daughter of King Peter II of Sicily and Elisabeth of Carinthia. When her brother King Louis and her regent sister Constance both died of plague in October 1355, the crown passed to her underage brother Frederick IV, and Euphemia was named vicar of the kingdom. She ruled through feuds between the pro-Catalan Artale Alagona and Francesco Ventimiglia, whom she favoured; Frederick removed her from the vicariate, though she directed the regency until 1357. She never married and died in 1359, holding the lordship of Gagliano.
zh: 西西里的欧费米娅（1330—1359年2月28日）是巴塞罗那家族的公主，西西里国王彼得二世与卡林西亚的伊丽莎白之女。1355年10月，她的兄长国王路易与担任摄政的姐姐康斯坦斯先后染瘟疫去世，王位传给幼弟腓特烈四世，欧费米娅被任命为王国摄政。她执政期间，亲加泰罗尼亚的阿塔莱·阿拉戈纳与弗朗切斯科·文蒂米利亚争斗不休，她偏袒文蒂米利亚，最终被腓特烈免去摄政头衔，但仍主持政务至1357年。她终身未嫁，1359年去世，领有加利亚诺封地。

en: Frederick of Antioch (c. 1223–1255/56) was an illegitimate son of Emperor Frederick II by Matilda of Antioch. From 1246 to 1250 he served his father as imperial vicar of Tuscany, levying troops and taxes from its cities. He ruled Florence as podestà and drove out the Guelph leaders in 1248. After a Florentine rebellion defeated his men near Figline in 1250 and the emperor died that December, his Tuscan regime collapsed. He then joined his half-brother Conrad IV, who confirmed his county of Albe and granted him Celano and Loreto. Frederick backed Manfred against the papacy before dying of plague during the siege of Foggia in 1255 or 1256.
zh: 安条克的弗雷德里克（约1223—1255/1256）是神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈二世与安条克的玛蒂尔达的私生子。1246至1250年，他受父亲任命担任托斯卡纳帝国代理人，向各城征兵征税。他在佛罗伦萨任波德斯塔，1248年驱逐城中的圭尔夫派首领。1250年佛罗伦萨起事者在菲格利内附近击败其军队，同年12月腓特烈二世去世，他在托斯卡纳的政权随之瓦解。随后他投奔异母兄康拉德四世，后者确认了他的阿尔贝伯国，并赐予他切拉诺和洛雷托。他支持曼弗雷德对抗教廷，最终于1255或1256年在围攻福贾期间死于瘟疫。

en: Frederick III of Sicily (1272–1337) was the third son of Peter III of Aragon and Constance II. In 1291 he became regent of Sicily for his brother James II. When James handed the island to the Church and the Angevins by the Treaty of Anagni in 1295, the Sicilians would not go back to the French they had driven out in 1282, and the nobles crowned Frederick king at Palermo in 1296. He held out against Angevin and papal armies, defeating an invasion in 1299 and taking Charles II's son Philip prisoner. The Peace of Caltabellotta in 1302 recognised him as king for life and married him to Eleanor of Anjou, though the crown was nominally to return to the Angevins. He strengthened the Sicilian parliament, renewed the war with Naples in 1313 with Emperor Henry VII's backing, and saw the island under papal interdict from 1321 to 1335. He died at Paternò in 1337; his son Peter II succeeded him regardless.
zh: 西西里国王费德里科二世（1272—1337）是阿拉贡国王彼得三世与科斯坦察二世的第三子。1291年起，他代兄长海梅二世摄政西西里。1295年，海梅在《阿纳尼条约》中把西西里交给教会，由安茹家族接收；西西里人不愿重回他们1282年赶走的法国人，贵族们于1296年在巴勒莫拥立费德里科为王。他率军抵御安茹家族和教皇的进攻，1299年击败入侵军，俘虏卡洛二世之子菲利普。1302年的《卡尔塔贝洛塔和约》承认他终身为王，并安排他与安茹的埃莉诺成婚，条文上王位日后须归还安茹家族。他强化了西西里议会，1313年在皇帝亨利七世支持下再度对那不勒斯开战；1321至1335年间，西西里被教皇处以禁令。他于1337年卒于帕泰尔诺，儿子彼得二世仍继承了王位。

en: Galeotto Lancia was the son of Galvano Lancia, grand marshal of the Kingdom of Sicily. Captured with his father at the Battle of Tagliacozzo on 23 August 1268, he was executed soon afterwards, either near Genazzano in September or at Naples on 29 October 1268.
zh: 加莱奥托·兰齐亚是西西里大元帅加尔瓦诺·兰齐亚之子。1268年8月23日，他与父亲在塔利亚科佐战役中一同被俘，父子二人随后被处决，一说于9月在杰纳扎诺附近就义，一说于10月29日在那不勒斯伏诛。

en: Galvano Lancia (before 1220–1268) was an Italian noble and commander of the Lancia family. Emperor Frederick II made him justiciar of Sicily in 1240 and podestà of Padua in 1242–1244. Expelled by Conrad IV in 1252, he became Manfred's chief lieutenant and organized an army in Apulia in 1254. In 1256 he was named imperial vicar of Tuscany, prince of Salerno and grand marshal of Sicily, and held Fondi from 1261. Excommunicated in 1268 for attacking the Papal States, he joined Conradin against Charles of Anjou and was captured at Tagliacozzo on 23 August. He was executed either near Genazzano in September or at Naples on 29 October.
zh: 加尔瓦诺·兰齐亚（1220年前—1268）是兰齐亚家族的意大利贵族与将领。1240年皇帝腓特烈二世任命他为西西里司法官，1242—1244年任帕多瓦波德斯塔。1252年他被康拉德四世驱逐，后成为曼弗雷迪的首要副手，1254年在普利亚组织军队。1256年他受任托斯卡纳帝国代理人、萨莱诺亲王兼西西里大元帅，1261年起领有丰迪伯国。1268年他因进攻教皇国被开除教籍，遂投奔康拉丁对抗安茹的查理，8月23日在塔利亚科佐被俘。他被处决，一说在9月的杰纳扎诺附近，另一说在10月29日的那不勒斯。

en: Walter III of Brienne (French: Gautier, c. 1166–June 1205), eldest son of Count Erard II, succeeded as count of Brienne in Champagne in 1191. In 1200 he married Elvira, daughter of the deposed Sicilian king Tancred, and prepared an army to press her claim to Sicily. Having taken the cross for the Fourth Crusade, he recruited crusaders for his Italian campaign and sold or mortgaged his lands to finance it. Pope Innocent III refused Elvira's claim to the throne but recognized the couple's rights to Taranto and Lecce, in return for her family's recognition of King Frederick. Walter won battles at Capua and Cannae in 1201, but in June 1205 he was stabbed in his camp at Terracina and died of his wounds. His posthumous son was Walter IV.
zh: 布列讷的沃尔特三世（法语名戈蒂埃，约1166—1205）是埃拉尔二世伯爵的长子，1191年袭任香槟地区的布列讷伯爵。1200年，他娶被废黜的西西里国王坦克雷迪之女埃尔薇拉为妻，筹备军队为她争夺西西里王位。他参加第四次十字军，招募十字军战士加入他的意大利远征，又出售或抵押领地筹款。教皇英诺森三世拒绝承认埃尔薇拉的王位主张，却承认夫妻二人对塔兰托和莱切的权利，条件是她的家族承认腓特烈为国王。1201年沃尔特在卡普阿和坎尼连获胜仗，1205年6月却在泰拉奇纳的营寨中遇刺，伤重身亡，其遗腹子即沃尔特四世。

en: Giovanna Peralta (c. 1323–1356) was a daughter of Raimondo Peralta, count of Caltabellotta, and Isabella of Aragon. In 1343 she married Matteo I Moncada, count of Agosta, by whom she was the mother of Guglielmo Raimondo Moncada, marquis of Malta and Gozo.
zh: 乔万娜·佩拉尔塔（约1323—1356）是卡尔塔贝洛塔伯爵拉伊蒙多·佩拉尔塔与阿拉贡的伊莎贝拉之女。1343年，她嫁给奥古斯塔伯爵马泰奥一世·蒙卡达，所生之子古列尔莫·拉伊蒙多·蒙卡达后来成为马耳他与戈佐侯爵。

en: John of Randazzo (1317–1348) was the fourth son of Frederick III of Sicily and Eleanor of Anjou, and the most powerful nobleman in Sicily under his brother Peter II and his nephew Louis. In 1338 he received the duchy of Randazzo, and he also held the duchies of Athens and Neopatria and the county of Malta. When Peter II died in 1342, John became regent for the young Louis. He favoured the Catalan party over the local Italian nobility, yet kept the kingdom at peace, and named the Catalan Blasco II de Alagona to succeed him. He married Cesarea, daughter of the count of Castalnasetta, and their son Frederick became Duke of Athens after him. John died of the Black Death in 1348 and was buried beside his father and nephew in Catania cathedral. War broke out upon his death.
zh: 兰达佐的乔瓦尼（1317—1348）是西西里国王费德里科二世与安茹的埃莉诺的第四子，在兄长彼得二世和侄子路易两朝都是岛上最有权势的贵族。1338年，他受封兰达佐公爵，并领有雅典与新帕特雷两个公爵领地及马耳他伯国。1342年彼得二世去世后，他为年幼的路易摄政西西里。他相较本地意大利贵族更倚重加泰罗尼亚派，却维持了王国的和平，并指定加泰罗尼亚人布拉斯科二世·德·阿拉戈纳接任。他娶卡斯塔尔纳塞塔伯爵之女切萨雷亚，儿子费德里科后来继任雅典公爵。1348年他死于黑死病，与父亲和侄子一同葬在卡塔尼亚大教堂。他一死，战争就爆发了。

en: Grandiana, called Diana Visconti (born c. 1318), was a daughter of Stefano Visconti of Milan and Valentina Doria. Between 1332 and 1335 she married the Catalan baron Ramon de Vilaragut, admiral of Sicily, and was the mother of Antoni de Vilaragut i Visconti.
zh: 格兰迪亚娜·维斯孔蒂绰号戴安娜（约1318年生），是米兰的斯特凡诺·维斯孔蒂与瓦伦蒂娜·多里亚的女儿。1332至1335年间，她嫁给西西里王国舰队海军上将、加泰罗尼亚贵族拉蒙·德·维拉拉古特，是安东尼·德·维拉拉古特-维斯孔蒂的母亲。

en: Guglielmo Raimondo Peralta, known as Guglielmone, was the son of Raimondo Peralta, first count of Caltabellotta, whom he succeeded in 1349. By Luisa di Sclafani he fathered Guglielmo Peralta, later count of Caltabellotta and lord of Sciacca.
zh: 古列尔莫·拉伊蒙多·佩拉尔塔绰号“古列尔莫内”，是第一代卡尔塔贝洛塔伯爵拉伊蒙多·佩拉尔塔之子，1349年承袭家族封地。他与妻子路易莎·迪·斯克拉法尼生有古列尔莫·佩拉尔塔，后者后来受封卡尔塔贝洛塔伯爵、夏卡领主。

en: Henry (VII) (1211–1242) was the eldest son of the Emperor Frederick II and Constance of Aragon. Crowned king of Sicily in 1212, he was elected king of the Romans at Frankfurt in 1220 and crowned at Aachen in 1222. He took personal rule of Germany in 1228, but his pro-city policy angered the princes, forcing the Statutum in favorem principum at Worms in 1231. Rebelling against his father, he surrendered in 1235 and was deposed and imprisoned. He died on 12 February 1242 near Martirano after a fall from his horse and was buried at Cosenza.
zh: 亨利（七世）（1211—1242年）是皇帝腓特烈二世与阿拉贡的康斯坦丝的长子。他1212年尚在襁褓中便加冕为西西里国王，1220年在法兰克福被选为罗马人的国王，1222年在亚琛加冕。1228年他开始亲政德意志，但其扶植城市的政策触怒诸侯，被迫于1231年在沃尔姆斯颁布《有利于诸侯的法令》。他举兵反叛父亲，1235年投降后遭废黜囚禁。1242年2月12日，他在卡拉布里亚的马蒂拉诺附近坠马身亡，葬于科森扎。

en: Helena Angelina Doukaina (c. 1242–1271) was a Byzantine princess, daughter of Michael II Komnenos Doukas, despot of Epirus, and Theodora Petraliphaina. On 2 June 1259 she married King Manfred of Sicily at Trani, sealing an Epirote-Sicilian alliance; her dowry brought him rights to Durazzo, Corfu and other Albanian towns. After Manfred was killed at the Battle of Benevento in 1266, she tried to flee from Trani to Epirus with her children but was seized by the Angevins. Charles I of Anjou imprisoned her in the castle of Nocera Inferiore, where she died in 1271.
zh: 海伦娜·安杰利娜·杜卡伊娜（约1242—1271年）是拜占庭公主，伊庇鲁斯专制君主米哈伊尔二世·科穆宁·杜卡斯与狄奥多拉·佩特拉利法伊娜之女。1259年6月2日，她在特拉尼嫁给西西里国王曼弗雷德，缔结伊庇鲁斯与西西里的同盟；她的嫁妆为丈夫带来了都拉佐、科孚及其他阿尔巴尼亚城镇的权利。1266年曼弗雷德在贝内文托战役战死后，她携子女试图从特拉尼逃往伊庇鲁斯，却被安茹人擒获。安茹的查理一世将她囚禁在诺切拉-因费廖雷的城堡中，她于1271年死于狱中。

en: Hugh of Ibelin (c. 1295–1349) was a younger son of Guy, titular count of Jaffa. He inherited the titular county from his brother Philip in 1316, served as seneschal of Jerusalem, and married Isabella of Ibelin, widow of Infante Ferdinand of Majorca.
zh: 于格·德·伊贝林（约1295—1349）是名义雅法伯爵居伊较年幼的儿子之一。1316年其兄腓力去世后，他承袭名义雅法伯爵之位，后来出任耶路撒冷王国总管，并娶马略卡王子费尔南多的遗孀伊莎贝拉·德·伊贝林为妻。

en: Elisabeth of Sicily (c. 1310–1349) was a princess of the Sicilian House of Barcelona, daughter of King Frederick III and Eleanor of Anjou. On 27 June 1328 she was married to the underage Wittelsbach prince Stephen II of Bavaria, sealing the alliance between her father and Emperor Louis IV. Her four children included the future dukes Stephen III of Bavaria-Ingolstadt, Frederick of Bavaria-Landshut and John II of Bavaria-Munich, and Agnes, who married King James I of Cyprus. When Stephen began ruling in 1347 she became duchess of Bavaria, but she died at Landshut on 21 March 1349.
zh: 西西里的伊丽莎白（约1310—1349）是西西里巴塞罗那王朝的公主，国王腓特烈三世与安茹的埃莉诺之女。1328年6月27日，她嫁给尚未成年的维特尔斯巴赫家族王子、巴伐利亚的斯特凡二世，以巩固父亲与皇帝路易四世的同盟。她的四个子女包括后来的因戈尔施塔特公爵斯特凡三世、兰茨胡特公爵腓特烈、慕尼黑公爵约翰二世，以及嫁给塞浦路斯国王雅克一世的阿格尼丝。1347年斯特凡执政后她成为巴伐利亚公爵夫人，1349年3月21日卒于兰茨胡特。

en: Isabella II (1212–1228) was queen of Jerusalem from birth. Her mother, Queen Maria of Montferrat, died after she was born, and her father John of Brienne ruled during her minority. In August 1225 she was crowned queen and married by proxy to the Emperor Frederick II, king of Sicily, then wed him in person in Italy, becoming empress and queen of Sicily. Frederick at once claimed Jerusalem and excluded her from power. She died aged fifteen, days after bearing her only son, the future king Conrad, and was buried at Andria.
zh: 伊莎贝拉二世（1212—1228年）出生即继位为耶路撒冷女王。母亲蒙费拉托的玛丽亚在生下她后去世，父亲布里耶纳的约翰在她幼年时执掌国政。1225年8月，她加冕为女王并通过代理婚礼嫁给身兼西西里国王的皇帝腓特烈二世，随后二人在意大利亲自成婚，她由此成为皇后兼西西里王后。腓特烈旋即自行宣称耶路撒冷王位，将她排除在权力之外。她年仅十五岁，在独子、后来的国王康拉德出生数日之后去世，葬于安德里亚。

en: Conrad of Bavaria (Italian: Corrado di Baviera; c. 1105–17 March 1126) was a younger son of Duke Henry the Black of Bavaria and Wulfhilde of Saxony, born at the Welf castle of Ravensburg. He spent time at his family's monastery of Weingarten and studied theology at Cologne, where his family intended him to become archbishop. The preaching of Arnold the German drew him to the Cistercian Order at Morimond. Arnold planned to found a monastery in the Holy Land, but Bernard of Clairvaux opposed the journey and Arnold died in 1125. Conrad continued alone, hoping to live as a hermit there, but settled in a cave at Modugno near Bari. His holiness drew local followers before his death in 1126. His cult was confirmed by beatification in 1832, and he is patron of Molfetta.
zh: 巴伐利亚的康拉德（意大利语作科拉多·迪·巴维埃拉，约1105—1126年3月17日）是巴伐利亚公爵“黑者”亨利与萨克森的武尔夫希尔德的幼子之一，生于韦尔夫家族的拉芬斯堡。他曾在家族的魏因加滕修道院生活，后在科隆学习神学，家族本打算让他日后出任大主教。日耳曼人阿诺德的布道感召他加入莫里蒙的西多会。阿诺德计划在圣地建立修道院，但明谷的伯尔纳反对这次旅程，阿诺德也于1125年去世。康拉德独自继续前行，希望在圣地隐修，却在巴里附近莫杜尼奥的一处洞穴定居，以圣洁赢得当地人追随，于1126年去世。1832年他获宣福，是莫尔费塔的主保圣人。

en: Manfred (1232–26 February 1266) was the last Hohenstaufen king of Sicily, the natural son of Emperor Frederick II and Bianca Lancia. Educated in Paris and Bologna and made prince of Taranto, he took the regency for his nephew Conradin in 1254. After negotiating with Pope Innocent IV, he fled to Lucera and, with Muslim allies, defeated a papal army at Foggia that December. Excommunicated by successive popes, he had himself crowned king at Palermo in 1258 and championed the Ghibellines, aiding Siena to victory at Montaperti in 1260. Called in by Pope Urban IV, Charles of Anjou defeated and killed Manfred at the Battle of Benevento on 26 February 1266, seizing Sicily.
zh: 曼弗雷迪（1232—1266年2月26日）是霍恩施陶芬王朝末代西西里国王，皇帝腓特烈二世与比安卡·兰齐亚之子。他曾在巴黎和博洛尼亚求学，受封塔兰托亲王；1254年为侄子康拉丁摄政。与教皇英诺森四世谈判后，他逃往卢切拉，同年12月在穆斯林盟友协助下于福贾击败教皇军队。他接连被数任教皇开除教籍，1258年在巴勒莫自行加冕为王，又力挺吉伯林派，1260年助锡耶纳打赢蒙塔佩尔蒂之战。教皇乌尔班四世召来安茹的查理，后者于1266年2月26日在贝内文托战役中击败并杀死曼弗雷迪，夺取了西西里。

en: Margaret of Sicily (1331–1377) was the youngest daughter of King Frederick III of Sicily and Eleanor of Anjou, born in Palermo. In 1348 she married the widowed Count Palatine Rudolf II of the Rhine of the House of Wittelsbach, known as the Blind for the eye disease that left him sightless in his final year. The marriage was childless. Plagued by illness, Rudolf withdrew from government in favour of his brother Rupert I, who gained the Palatinate's electoral dignity in 1356. Margaret survived her husband by more than two decades and died at Neustadt an der Weinstraße in 1377.
zh: 西西里的玛格丽特（1331—1377）是西西里国王腓特烈三世与安茹的埃莉诺最小的女儿，生于巴勒莫。1348年，她嫁给维特尔斯巴赫家族丧偶的莱茵行宫伯爵鲁道夫二世；伯爵因眼疾在人生最后一年双目失明，被称为“失明者”。两人没有子女。鲁道夫体弱多病，后来退隐，把政务交给弟弟鲁普雷希特一世，后者于1356年为普法尔茨争得选帝侯地位。玛格丽特在丈夫身后又活了二十余年，1377年卒于魏恩施特拉瑟河畔诺伊施塔特。

en: Marie of Brienne (c. 1224–1275), also called Marie d'Acre, was the daughter of John of Brienne, king of Jerusalem and Latin emperor of Constantinople, and Berengaria of León. Betrothed in 1229 to Baldwin II of Courtenay, her father's junior co-emperor, she was to cement an alliance between the two rulers. She was about ten when they married in 1234, becoming Latin empress alongside her mother. She governed Constantinople as regent during Baldwin's long fundraising journeys in the West in 1237–1239 and again from 1243, and later defended the Courtenay lands at Namur. Her son Philip was born in 1243; she died in exile in 1275 after Constantinople fell to the Nicaeans in 1261.
zh: 布列讷的玛丽（约1224—1275），又称阿卡的玛丽，是耶路撒冷国王、君士坦丁堡拉丁皇帝布列讷的约翰与莱昂的贝伦加利亚之女。1229年她与父亲的共治皇帝库尔特奈的鲍德温二世订婚，以巩固两位统治者的联盟。1234年两人成婚，约十岁的玛丽与母亲同为拉丁帝国皇后。鲍德温长期前往西欧筹募军费时，她于1237—1239年及1243年起以摄政身份主持君士坦丁堡政务，后来又守护库尔特奈家族在那慕尔的领地。她的儿子菲利普生于1243年；1261年君士坦丁堡被尼西亚人攻陷后她流亡异乡，1275年去世。

en: Niccolò Lancia was a Sicilian nobleman of the Lancia dynasty, barons of Longi in the Messina region. In late 1330 William II, duke of Athens and Neopatras, named him vicar general of the two Catalan-ruled Greek duchies, replacing Alfonso Fadrique. In 1331 he led the duchies in their war against Walter VI of Brienne, who sought to reconquer Athens, and he held the vicariate until about 1335.
zh: 尼科洛·兰恰是西西里贵族，出自在墨西拿一带领有隆吉的兰恰家族。1330年底，雅典和新帕特拉公爵纪尧姆二世任命他为这两个由加泰罗尼亚人统治的希腊公国的总代理，接替阿方索·法德里克。1331年，他率领两公国抗击企图夺回雅典的布里耶纳的沃尔特六世，并一直任职到约1335年。

en: Peter II of Sicily (24 July 1305 – 15 August 1342), eldest son of Frederick III and Eleanor of Anjou, was recognized as heir by the Sicilian parliament in 1314 and associated with his father's throne in April 1321. He married Elisabeth of Carinthia in 1322 and ruled alone after Frederick died on 25 June 1337. His reign was marked by feuds with the Ventimiglia, Palizzi and Chiaramonte families and by naval defeat at Lipari against the Neapolitans in 1339. He died at Calascibetta in August 1342, leaving the crown to his young son Louis.
zh: 皮埃特罗二世（1305年7月24日—1342年8月15日）是腓特烈三世与安茹的埃莉诺的长子。1314年，西西里议会承认他为王位继承人；1321年4月，父亲将他扶上王位共同执政。1322年他娶克恩滕的伊丽莎白为妻，1337年6月25日腓特烈三世去世后开始独掌王权。他在位期间，王室与文蒂米利亚、帕利齐、基亚拉蒙特等大家族争斗不已，1339年又在利帕里海战中败于那不勒斯人。1342年8月他在卡拉希贝塔去世，王位传给年幼的儿子路德维科。

en: Pietro Lancia was the second count of Caltanissetta and lord of Delia, Naro and Sambuca in Aragonese Sicily. In 1299 he succeeded to the fiefs of his uncle Corrado Lancia, and grew into one of the island's richest feudatories, drawing more than a thousand ounces of gold a year from his lands around Caltanissetta and Naro. By his wife, of the Alagona family, he had two daughters: Cesarea, who married John, duke of Randazzo, in 1324, and Eleonora, wife of Artale II Alagona. When he died in 1335 without a male heir, his county passed to the duke of Randazzo.
zh: 彼得罗·兰恰是阿拉贡治下西西里的第二代卡尔塔尼塞塔伯爵，也是代利亚、纳罗和桑布卡的领主。1299年，他继伯父科拉多·兰恰之后领有其封邑，成为西西里最富有的封臣之一，仅卡尔塔尼塞塔和纳罗一带的土地每年就带来超过一千盎司黄金的收入。他娶阿拉戈纳家族之女为妻，生有两女：1324年嫁给兰扎佐公爵乔瓦尼的切萨雷亚，以及嫁给阿塔莱二世·阿拉戈纳的埃莱奥诺拉。1335年他去世时没有男性继承人，伯爵领地遂归兰扎佐公爵所有。

en: Raimondo Peralta (in Catalan Ramon de Peralta; c. 1292–1349) was a Sicilian nobleman and admiral in Aragonese service, when Aragon was holding Sardinia against Genoa and the Angevins were fighting for Sicily. He fought at the siege of Castel di Castro in the conquest of Sardinia in 1323; in 1325 he replaced Francesco Carroz as land commander, but the two hated each other and the king removed both. From 1326 he served his cousin King Frederick of Sicily against the Angevins. Made grand admiral of Aragon in 1335, he defended Sardinia against Genoa and kept the Angevins from landing at Palermo, but could not stop the Hafsids from retaking Djerba. In 1338 he was invested with Caltabellotta and other fiefs as first count, and in 1340 became grand chancellor of Sicily. In 1347 he invaded Naples and made peace with Queen Joanna I. He died at Palermo in 1349, while Latins and Catalans fought for control of Sicily.
zh: 拉伊蒙多·佩拉尔塔（加泰罗尼亚语作拉蒙·德·佩拉尔塔，约1292—1349）是为阿拉贡效力的西西里贵族与海军将领，当时阿拉贡正设法守住撒丁岛、抵挡热那亚，安茹家族则在争夺西西里。1323年他参加阿拉贡征服撒丁岛之役，亲历卡斯特尔迪卡斯特罗围城战；1325年接替弗朗切斯科·卡罗兹统率陆军，但两人互相敌视，国王遂免去二人的职务。1326年起他追随表亲西西里国王费德里科，对抗安茹家族。1335年他出任阿拉贡海军元帅，率舰队保卫撒丁岛、抵御热那亚，并阻止安茹军队在巴勒莫登陆，却未能阻止哈夫斯王朝收复杰尔巴。1338年他受封卡尔塔贝洛塔等采邑，成为首任伯爵，1340年升任西西里大法官。1347年他攻入那不勒斯王国，与女王乔万娜一世议和。1349年他卒于巴勒莫，当时拉丁人与加泰罗尼亚人正为控制西西里而争斗。

en: Ramón de Vilaragut y Sarriá (c. 1295–c. 1359) was a Catalan noble of the Crown of Aragon, son of Berenguer de Vilaragut and a Valencian squire who rose to command Sicily's army and navy. About 1333 he married Grandiana, called Diana, daughter of Stefano Visconti of Milan; their son Antonio was born in 1336. In 1342 his brother Berenguer granted him the Valencian lordships of Alcaissia, Sollana and Trullars. In 1344 John, Duke of Randazzo, regent for the young King Louis I of Sicily, gave him the castle and barony of Tripi and sent him as envoy to negotiate the duke's marriage to his cousin Constance of Aragon. In 1345 he became captain general and admiral of Sicily. He died around 1359, by which time Sollana belonged to his son Antonio.
zh: 拉蒙·德·维拉古特-萨里亚（约1295—约1359）是阿拉贡联合王国的加泰罗尼亚贵族，出身巴伦西亚的侍从骑士，后来升任西西里的军队统帅。他是贝伦格尔·德·维拉古特之子。约1333年，他娶米兰贵族斯特凡诺·维斯孔蒂之女格兰迪亚娜（又名迪亚娜）为妻，1336年生子安东尼奥。1342年，其兄贝伦格尔将阿尔凯西亚、索利亚纳和特鲁利亚尔斯三处巴伦西亚领地封赐给他。1344年，年幼的西西里国王路易一世的摄政、兰达佐公爵乔万尼把特里皮城堡与男爵领赐给他，并派他担任使节，商议公爵与堂妹阿拉贡的科斯坦察的婚事。1345年，他出任西西里军队统帅兼海军司令。约1359年去世，此时索利亚纳已归其子安东尼奥所有。

en: Rinaldo d'Este (1230–1251) was the only son of Azzo VII d'Este, Guelph lord of Ferrara, and his wife Giovanna of Apulia. In 1239 his father gave him to the Emperor Frederick II as a hostage in pledge of loyalty. When Azzo openly joined the papal side, Rinaldo was imprisoned, first at Cremona and then in Apulia, where he died, probably poisoned, in 1251 at the urging of Ezzelino III da Romano. His illegitimate son Obizzo, born around 1247 to a Neapolitan laundress, was legitimised by Pope Innocent IV in 1252 and inherited Ferrara in 1264.
zh: 里纳尔多·德斯特（1230—1251年）是费拉拉的圭尔夫派领主埃斯特的阿佐七世与普利亚的焦万娜的独子。1239年，父亲将他交予皇帝腓特烈二世作为效忠的人质。阿佐公开倒向教廷后，里纳尔多遭到囚禁，先关押于克雷莫纳，后转移至普利亚，1251年在埃泽利诺三世·达·罗马诺的怂恿下遇害，很可能死于毒杀。他与一名那不勒斯洗衣女工所生的私生子奥比佐约生于1247年，1252年获教宗英诺森四世承认为合法子嗣，1264年继承费拉拉。

en: Ugo Lancia, also called Ugone (born c. 1299), was a Sicilian baron in the Messina area, son of Corrado Lancia di Castromainardo, founder of the Sicilian Lancia branch. Succeeding his father around 1328, he held the baronies of Ficarra and Longi, the castle of Brolo and the lordships of Galati and Mongialino. In 1322 he sold the fief of Castania to Eustachio di Gregorio; in 1335 he owned half of the Limbaccari fief near Piazza; in 1340 he served as strategot, or royal governor, of Messina. His sons Blasco, Corrado and Nicola carried on the family's branches.
zh: 乌戈·兰恰又称乌戈内（约1299年生），是墨西拿地区的西西里男爵，为兰恰家族西西里支系始祖科拉多·兰恰·迪·卡斯特罗马伊纳尔多之子。约1328年袭爵后，他领有菲卡拉与隆吉男爵领地、布罗洛城堡以及加拉蒂、蒙贾利诺两处庄园。1322年他把卡斯塔尼亚封地卖给埃乌斯塔基奥·迪·格雷戈里奥；1335年时占有皮亚扎附近林巴卡里封地的一半；1340年出任墨西拿的斯泰拉蒂戈托，即王室总督。他的儿子布拉斯科、科拉多与尼科洛分别延续了家族的各支系。

en: Sidi Ahmed Ou Moussa (c. 1460–1563) was a Moroccan Sufi sheikh of the Jazula confederation in the Anti-Atlas mountains of the Sous. Born in the Ida Ou Semlal, he was the son of Sidi Musa u-Driss and Lalla Tawnut. He studied Islam in Marrakesh and travelled long in the east before returning to the Sous in 1521 and settling at Tazerwalt, where he founded a zawiya that drew hundreds of disciples and gave rise to the Tazerwalt dynasty. Keeping good relations with the ruling Saadian dynasty, he turned his religious authority into an enclave of power. He died in 1563, and his tomb in the zawiya became a pilgrimage site; his descendants inherited much of his wealth and standing.
zh: 西迪·艾哈迈德·乌·穆萨（约1460—1563）是摩洛哥苏斯地区反阿特拉斯山区贾祖拉部落联盟的苏菲谢赫。他生于伊达乌塞姆拉勒地区，父亲是西迪·穆萨·乌·德里斯，母亲是拉拉·陶努特。他早年在马拉喀什学习伊斯兰教，又长期游学东方，1521年返回苏斯并定居塔泽尔瓦勒特，在那里建立扎维叶道堂，吸引了数百名弟子，塔泽尔瓦勒特王朝由此兴起。他与当朝萨阿德王朝保持良好关系，凭宗教威望在萨阿德国家内开辟出一片势力之地。他于1563年去世，道堂中的陵墓成为朝谒之地，子孙继承了他的大部分财富与地位。

en: Agnese Montefeltro was a daughter of Galasso Montefeltro, imperial vicar of Urbino, and a sister of Nolfo, Paolo, Guittone and Bonconte Montefeltro.
zh: 阿涅塞·蒙特费尔特罗是乌尔比诺帝国代官加拉索·蒙特费尔特罗之女，是诺尔弗、保罗、圭托内和邦孔特的姊妹。

en: Jacopo Casali was the eldest-listed son of Ranieri II Casali, the first signore of Cortona, and a brother of Bartolomeo, the second signore. He is recorded as a condottiere.
zh: 雅各布·卡萨利是科尔托纳首任领主拉涅里二世·卡萨利名列首位的儿子，是第二代领主巴尔托洛梅奥的兄弟，史载为佣兵队长。

en: Bolesław I the Tall (1127–1201), eldest son of Władysław II the Exile, fled to Germany when his father was driven from Poland in 1146. In 1163, through Frederick Barbarossa's intervention, he and his brother Mieszko Tanglefoot received Silesia, and Bolesław established himself at Wrocław. A 1172 revolt by Mieszko and his son Jarosław forced him to divide the duchy and cede Opole. He founded the Cistercian Lubiąż Abbey and obtained a protective bull from Pope Innocent III in 1198. He died in December 1201 at Leśnica and was buried at Lubiąż; his son Henry I the Bearded inherited Wrocław.
zh: 波列斯瓦夫一世（“高个子”，1127—1201）是瓦迪斯瓦夫二世（被放逐者）的长子。1146年父亲被逐出波兰后，他逃往德意志。1163年，经腓特烈·巴巴罗萨调停，他与弟弟梅什科“绊脚”共同获得西里西亚，波列斯瓦夫以弗罗茨瓦夫为治所。1172年，梅什科与他的儿子雅罗斯瓦夫起兵，迫使他分割公国、割让奥波莱。他创立了熙笃会的卢邦日修道院，并于1198年取得教宗英诺森三世的保护诏书。1201年12月他在莱希尼察去世，葬于卢邦日，弗罗茨瓦夫由其子亨里克一世（“大胡子”）继承。

en: Henry II the Pious (1196–1241), son of Henry I the Bearded and Saint Hedwig, married Anne, daughter of King Ottokar I of Bohemia, in 1218. After ruling as interim duke during his father's 1229 captivity, he was made co-ruler in 1234 and succeeded in March 1238 to Silesia, Kraków, southern Greater Poland and the high-ducal title, and acted as regent of Opole-Racibórz and Sandomierz. On 9 April 1241, at the Battle of Legnica, he led a Silesian and Greater Polish coalition against the Mongol invaders and was defeated and killed. His death undid his father's project of Piast reunification.
zh: 亨里克二世（“虔诚者”，1196—1241）是亨里克一世“大胡子”与圣海德维希之子，1218年娶波希米亚国王奥托卡一世之女安娜为妻。1229年父亲被囚期间他曾代理公爵政务，1234年被立为共治者，1238年3月继位，领有西里西亚、克拉科夫与南大波兰，并拥有波兰大公头衔，还曾为奥波莱-拉齐布日和桑多梅日摄政。他短暂的统治随着蒙古入侵告终：1241年4月9日，他率领西里西亚与大波兰联军在莱格尼察迎战蒙古大军，兵败战死。他的死使父亲统一皮亚斯特诸领地的事业付诸东流。

en: Henry I the Bearded (c. 1165–1238), son of Bolesław I the Tall, ruled Silesia from Wrocław after 1201. In 1202 his uncle Mieszko Tanglefoot seized Opole, but Henry consolidated Lower Silesia, promoting mining and Magdeburg-law German settlement; in 1211 Złotoryja became the first chartered town in Poland. Married to Hedwig of Andechs, later Saint Hedwig, he exploited the Piast succession wars to take Kraków in 1232 and rule as high duke of Poland, also acquiring large parts of Greater Poland. He died at Krosno Odrzańskie on 19 March 1238, leaving his realms to his son Henry II the Pious.
zh: 亨里克一世（“大胡子”，约1165—1238）是波列斯瓦夫一世（高个子）之子，1201年起以弗罗茨瓦夫为都统治西里西亚。1202年，叔父梅什科“绊脚”夺取奥波莱，但亨里克巩固了下西里西亚，发展矿业并按马格德堡法招徕德意志移民；1211年，兹沃托雷亚成为波兰第一座获得特许状的城市。他娶安德希斯的海德维希为妻（后者后来被封圣），乘皮亚斯特诸公爵争夺继承权的战乱，于1232年攻取克拉科夫，成为波兰大公，还取得大波兰的大片土地。1238年3月19日他卒于奥得河畔克罗斯诺，领地由其子亨里克二世（“虔诚者”）继承。

en: Casimir I of Opole (c. 1178–1230), only son of Mieszko IV Tanglefoot, ruled Opole and Racibórz from his father's death in 1211. He first joined the junior Piast dukes' coalition, and at the Congress of Wolbórz in 1215 granted wide privileges and immunities to the Church. He later drew close to his cousin Henry I the Bearded, supporting Henry's 1225 expedition against Kraków. Casimir moved his residence to Opole and promoted German settlement under town law, chartering Leśnica in 1217, Biała in 1225 and Olesno in 1226. He died on 13 May 1230.
zh: 卡西米尔一世（奥波莱的，约1178—1230）是梅什科四世“绊脚”的独子，1211年父亲去世后统治奥波莱与拉齐布日。他起初加入皮亚斯特家族少壮派公爵的同盟，1215年在沃尔布日会议上向教会授予广泛特权与豁免权。后来他与堂兄亨里克一世“大胡子”接近，支持后者1225年征讨克拉科夫。卡西米尔将居所迁至奥波莱，推行按城市法招徕德意志移民的政策，先后于1217年特许建立莱希尼察、1225年建立比亚瓦、1226年建立奥莱斯诺。他于1230年5月13日去世。

en: Mieszko IV Tanglefoot (c. 1130–1211) was the second son of Władysław II the Exile and, like his brother Bolesław the Tall, grew up in exile at Altenburg after 1146, studying in Bamberg. The brothers recovered Silesia through Frederick Barbarossa's intervention in 1163 and ruled it jointly until 1173, when Mieszko took Racibórz as his own duchy. He added Opole in 1202, founding the Opole line of the Silesian Piasts. In June 1210 he captured Kraków and assumed the high-ducal title of Poland. He died there on 16 May 1211, leaving Opole-Racibórz to his son Casimir I.
zh: 梅什科四世（“绊脚”，约1130—1211）是瓦迪斯瓦夫二世（被放逐者）的次子。1146年后，他与兄长波列斯瓦夫“高个子”一样在阿尔滕堡的流放中长大，曾在班贝格求学。1163年经腓特烈·巴巴罗萨调停，兄弟二人收复西里西亚并共同统治；至1173年，梅什科领有拉齐布日，自成一公国。1202年他又取得奥波莱，开创西里西亚皮亚斯特家族的奥波莱支系。1210年6月，他攻占克拉科夫，取得波兰大公之位，1211年5月16日卒于该地，奥波莱-拉齐布日由其子卡西米尔一世继承。

en: Władysław II the Exile (1105–1159), eldest son of Bolesław III Wrymouth, was high duke of Poland and duke of Silesia from 1138 under his father's succession settlement. His bid to centralize power brought war with his three younger half-brothers; after he blinded their ally, the palatine Piotr Włostowic, the brothers expelled him from Poland in 1146. He took refuge with his wife's imperial kindred at Altenburg. Frederick Barbarossa's Polish campaign of 1157 did not restore him, and he died in exile in 1159. His sons recovered Silesia in 1163, becoming the founders of the Silesian Piasts.
zh: 瓦迪斯瓦夫二世（“被放逐者”，1105—1159）是波列斯瓦夫三世（“歪嘴”）的长子，1138年起依据父亲的分封安排出任波兰大公兼西里西亚公爵。他试图集权，与三个同父异母的弟弟交战；在他弄瞎诸弟的盟友、重臣彼得·沃斯托维奇之后，诸弟于1146年起兵将他逐出波兰。他投奔妻子在阿尔滕堡的皇室亲族。腓特烈·巴巴罗萨1157年的波兰远征未能使他复位，他最终于1159年客死流放地。他的儿子们于1163年取回西里西亚，成为西里西亚皮亚斯特支系之祖。

en: Simon Le Moyne (1604–1665), a Jesuit born at Beauvais, taught at Rouen from 1627 to 1632 before reaching New France in 1638. He worked among the Wendat until their dispersal drove him back to Quebec in 1650. Fluent in the Wendat and Haudenosaunee languages, he became New France's chief peace envoy to the Iroquois. In 1653 he travelled up the Oswego River to Onondaga Lake, founded the Sainte Marie de Gannentaha mission and discovered the Onondaga salt springs. He later negotiated with the Mohawks, returning in 1662 with nineteen freed French captives, and died of fever near Trois-Rivières in 1665.
zh: 西蒙·勒穆瓦纳（1604—1665）是出生于博韦的耶稣会士，1627至1632年在鲁昂任教，1638年抵达新法兰西，多年在休伦人地区传教；1650年休伦联盟覆灭后，他退回魁北克。他精通休伦语与易洛魁语，成为新法兰西派往易洛魁联盟的首席和平使节。1653年，他沿奥斯威戈河抵达奥农达加湖，在那里建立甘嫩塔哈圣玛丽传教站，并发现了奥农达加盐泉。此后他多次与莫霍克人谈判，1662年带回十九名获释的法国俘虏，1665年在三河镇附近死于热病。

en: Simon Stevin (1548–1620) was a Flemish mathematician and engineer, born probably in Bruges. After years as a merchant's clerk and then city clerk of Bruges from 1577, he moved north in 1581 and enrolled at Leiden University in 1583. Bruges had seen intense religious conflict, with Catholics and Calvinists alternately controlling its government. At Leiden he befriended Maurice of Nassau and became his tutor and principal adviser, director of the Dutch water works from 1592 and quartermaster-general of the States-General's army. He coined a native Dutch word for mathematics, translated other scientific terms into Dutch, proved the law of equilibrium on the inclined plane, and built a wind-driven land carriage that outran horses on the coastal sands.
zh: 西蒙·斯泰芬（1548—1620）是弗拉芒数学家与工程师，可能生于布鲁日。他曾做过商人书记员，1577年起任布鲁日市政文书，1581年北上，1583年入读莱顿大学。当时布鲁日宗教冲突激烈，天主教徒与加尔文派轮流掌控市政。他在莱顿结识拿骚的莫里斯，后来成为他的教师和首席顾问，1592年起主管荷兰的水利事务，并任联省军队的军需总监。他用荷兰语本族词为数学命名，也将其他科学术语译成荷兰语；他还证明了斜面上的平衡定律，造出一辆风力陆地车，在海滩上跑得比马还快。

en: Aymon de Châtillon (c. 1260–1323) was a Valdostan cleric of a cadet branch of the Challant lords. Canon and archdeacon of Aosta from 1280 and canon of Sion from 1299, he was elected bishop of Sion in 1308 after his cousin Boniface de Challant, becoming a prince of the Empire and count of the Valais. In December 1308 he exchanged homages with the count of Savoy, held a diocesan synod in 1310, and defeated Bernese Oberland lords who had invaded the Upper Valais; in 1319 he ordered Valais notaries to register acts at Sion. He died there on 19 July 1323.
zh: 艾蒙·德·沙蒂永（约1260—1323）是瓦莱达奥斯塔教士，出身沙朗家族的沙蒂永幼支。他自1280年任奥斯塔主教座堂的法政司和会吏长，1299年改任锡永法政司，1308年堂兄博尼法斯·德·沙朗去世后当选为锡永主教。作为主教，他同时是神圣罗马帝国诸侯、瓦莱州伯爵与行政长官：1308年12月他与萨伏依伯爵互换臣服誓约，1310年召开教区会议，还击败了入侵上瓦莱的伯尔尼高地贵族。1319年，他命令瓦莱的公证人必须在锡永官署登记文书。1323年7月19日，他在锡永去世。

en: Aymon de La Tour, called Aymon IV of Châtillon (d. 1338), was a Valais cleric of a baronial family, son of Pierre IV de La Tour. Pope John XXII named him bishop of Sion on 24 November 1323. He sold Laupen to Bern in 1324. He defended his see's autonomy against the counts of Savoy, allying with the Dauphin Guigues VIII in 1327 before rendering only limited homage on the Morge. He added lands at Grengiols and Simplon and settled Carthusians at Géronde in 1331. He died at Sion in April 1338, after making his will at Tourbillon.
zh: 艾蒙·德·拉图尔（又称艾蒙四世·德·沙蒂永，1338年卒）出身瓦莱的男爵家族，是皮埃尔四世·德·拉图尔之子。1323年11月24日，教宗若望二十二世任命他为锡永主教。1324年，他把劳彭卖给伯尔尼。他抵御萨伏依伯爵、维护教区自主，1327年与多菲内王太子吉格八世结盟，最后只在莫尔日河畔行有限的臣服礼。他取得格伦焦尔和辛普朗一带的地产，1331年在热龙德安置加尔都西会士。1338年4月，他在图尔比永堡立下遗嘱后不久于锡永去世。

en: Boniface de Challant (c. 1240–1308) was a Valdostan cleric of the Challant family, appointed bishop of Sion by the pope in December 1289 and consecrated in 1290. He ruled the see like a fief, building Tourbillon above Sion, and in 1293 demanded liege homage from Count Amadeus V of Savoy for Chillon. From 1294 he warred on his neighbors, defeating Peter IV de la Tour and razing Riddes, before making peace with Savoy in December 1301. He founded the hospice of Brigue in 1304, made a treaty of combourgeoisie with Bern and regulated Simplon traffic, and died at Sion on 18 June 1308.
zh: 博尼法斯·德·沙朗（约1240—1308）是势力显赫的沙朗家族出身的瓦莱达奥斯塔教士，1289年12月15日被教皇任命为锡永主教，1290年3月在罗马祝圣。他把主教区当作封邑统治：在锡永附近修建图尔比永城堡，1293年就西庸城堡要求萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥五世行臣服礼。1294年起他接连与邻邦交战，1294年在卢埃什击败皮埃尔四世·德·拉图尔，又荡平里德斯要塞，最终于1301年12月与萨伏依议和。他还在1304年创办布里格救济院，与伯尔尼订立共市民盟约，并整顿辛普朗山口的货运。1308年6月18日，他在锡永去世。

en: Skanderbeg, born Gjergj Kastrioti (c. 1405–1468), was an Albanian nobleman and military commander. Sent as a hostage to the Ottoman court, he trained in the Enderun school, served Sultan Murad II for twenty years, and became sanjakbey of Dibra in 1440. At the Battle of Nish in 1443 he deserted, returned to Albania and seized Krujë, and in 1444 united the Albanian princes in the League of Lezhë. In 1451 the Treaty of Gaeta secured an alliance with Naples, whose sovereignty he formally acknowledged while remaining independent in practice. For twenty-five years his guerrilla campaigns defeated repeated Ottoman invasions, even after the fall of Constantinople. He died of fever in 1468, and Krujë fell ten years later.
zh: 斯坎德培（约1405—1468），本名杰尔吉·卡斯特里奥蒂，是阿尔巴尼亚贵族与军事统帅。他少年时作为人质进入奥斯曼宫廷，在恩德伦学校受训，为苏丹穆拉德二世效力二十年，1440年出任迪勃拉桑贾克贝伊。1443年尼什战役期间他叛逃归国、夺取克鲁亚，并于1444年联合阿尔巴尼亚诸王公组成莱什联盟。1451年《加埃塔条约》确立了他与那不勒斯的同盟；他在名义上承认那不勒斯的宗主权，实际上仍保持独立。归国后的二十五年间，他以游击战屡次击退奥斯曼大军，即便君士坦丁堡陷落后也不曾屈服。他1468年死于热病，克鲁亚于十年后陷落。

en: Zayd al-Aṣghar, called the Younger, was a son of Abu Numayy I, Emir of Mecca. He ruled as Sultan of Suakin on the Red Sea African coast and later served as Naqib of the Talibids in Iraq.
zh: 小扎伊德是麦加埃米尔阿布·努米一世之子。他在红海非洲沿岸的萨瓦金称苏丹，后来前往伊拉克，出任塔利卜家族的纳基卜。

en: Ban Sen (born 1301) was the twelfth raja of Suket in the Punjab Hills. Born posthumously after his father Kranchan Sen died fighting Kullu, he was adopted by his maternal grandfather and ruled 1301–1346. Tradition credits him with the Parashara temple at Prashar Lake.
zh: 班·森（1301年生）是旁遮普山区苏盖德的第十二代拉杰。父亲克兰钱·森与库鲁交战身亡后，他作为遗腹子出生，被外祖父收养，1301至1346年在位。相传帕拉夏尔湖畔的帕拉夏尔神庙由他修建。

en: Dmitry Fyodorovich (d. 1354) was the fifth appanage prince of Starodub-on-the-Klyazma and a Rurikid, the eldest son of Prince Fyodor Ivanovich. He succeeded in 1330 after his father was killed in the Golden Horde and ruled until 1354 or the following year. He was buried at Starodub, and left sons Semyon Krapiva and Fyodor, ancestor of the Mikitinichi-Ryapolovsky princes.
zh: 德米特里·费奥多罗维奇（1354年卒）是克利亚济马河畔斯塔罗杜布的第五代封邑王公，出身留里克家族，是王公费奥多尔·伊万诺维奇的长子。1330年父亲在金帐汗国被杀后，他继位并统治到1354年或次年。他葬于斯塔罗杜布，留下儿子谢苗·克拉皮瓦和费奥多尔，后者是米基季尼奇-里亚波洛夫斯基王公家族的始祖。

en: Fyodor Ivanovich, called the Pious, was the fourth appanage prince of Starodub-on-the-Klyazma, succeeding his father Ivan Mikhailovich in 1315. The chronicles record only a single event of his life: in 1330 he was killed at the court of the Golden Horde, with no explanation of the circumstances. Venerated as a martyr for the Orthodox faith, he was canonized as a holy prince; his body was buried in the Nativity of the Theotokos church at Aleksino, where his relics were said to heal the sick.
zh: 费奥多尔·伊万诺维奇绰号“虔诚者”，是克利亚济马河畔斯塔罗杜布的第四代封邑王公，1315年继承父亲伊凡·米哈伊洛维奇。编年史只记载了他生平的一件事：1330年他在金帐汗国宫廷被杀，经过与原因均未留下记录。他被视为为东正教信仰殉道的殉道者并获封圣；遗体安葬在阿列克西诺的圣母圣诞教堂，相传其圣骸能治愈病人。

en: Ivan Mikhailovich, known as Kalistrat, was the third appanage prince of Starodub-on-the-Klyazma, a Rurikid principality in northeastern Rus. The only son of Prince Mikhail Ivanovich, he inherited the appanage from his father in 1281 and ruled until about 1315. The chronicles record almost nothing of his reign and disagree on the date of his death. His only son Fyodor Ivanovich, later canonized as a holy prince, succeeded him.
zh: 伊凡·米哈伊洛维奇绰号“卡利斯特拉特”，是克利亚济马河畔斯塔罗杜布的第三代封邑王公，这座罗斯东北部的小邦属于留里克王朝。他是米哈伊尔·伊万诺维奇王公的独子，1281年继承封邑，统治到约1315年。编年史对他的统治几乎毫无记载，对其卒年也说法不一。他的独子费奥多尔·伊万诺维奇继位，后者后来被封圣为圣徒王公。

en: Ivan Vsevolodovich, nicknamed Kasha, was the youngest son of Vsevolod the Big Nest, grand prince of Vladimir. In 1212–1213 he backed his brother Yuri II against Konstantin, and in 1226 he and Svyatoslav led the Vladimir host on a successful campaign against the Mordvins. After Batu's invasion, Grand Prince Yaroslav in 1238 granted him the devastated Starodub as his appanage, making him its first prince. In 1246 he accompanied Yaroslav to the Golden Horde, and he died in 1247, leaving Starodub to his son Mikhail; he was buried in the Dormition Cathedral at Vladimir.
zh: 伊万·弗谢沃洛多维奇，绰号卡沙，是弗拉基米尔大公弗谢沃洛德（大窝）最小的儿子。1212至1213年的兄弟争位中，他支持兄长尤里二世对抗康斯坦丁；1226年，他与兄长斯维亚托斯拉夫率领弗拉基米尔军队成功征伐莫尔多瓦人。拔都入侵之后，大公雅罗斯拉夫·弗谢沃洛多维奇于1238年把刚遭战火蹂躏的斯塔罗杜布封给他作采邑，他由此成为第一代斯塔罗杜布王公。1246年，他随雅罗斯拉夫前往金帐汗国。1247年他去世，葬于弗拉基米尔圣母安息大教堂，斯塔罗杜布由其子米哈伊尔继承。

en: Mikhail Ivanovich was the second appanage prince of Starodub, succeeding his father Ivan Vsevolodovich Kasha. Chronicles first name him in January 1277, among the princes attending the funeral at Kostroma of Grand Prince Vasily Yaroslavich. In 1281 he answered the summons of Andrey Alexandrovich, who with Tatar support advanced on Murom to seize Vladimir from his elder brother Dmitry; Mikhail joined Andrey's brutal campaign against Pereyaslavl-Zalessky and probably died during it, the Nikon chronicle giving 1281 as his death year. His son Ivan Kalistrat carried on the Starodub line.
zh: 米哈伊尔·伊万诺维奇是第二代斯塔罗杜布藩王，继父亲伊万·弗谢沃洛多维奇·卡沙之后统治。编年史首次提到他，是1277年1月他在科斯特罗马参加大公瓦西里·雅罗斯拉维奇的葬礼。1281年，安德烈·亚历山德罗维奇在鞑靼人支持下进兵穆罗姆，要从兄长德米特里手中夺取弗拉基米尔，米哈伊尔响应其征召，加入了安德烈攻打佩列亚斯拉夫尔-扎列斯基的残酷征战，并很可能就死在这场兵乱之中；《尼康编年史》系其卒年于1281年。其子伊万·卡利斯特拉特延续了斯塔罗杜布世系。

en: Vladimir Vsevolodovich (1192–1227), baptized Dmitry, was a son of Vsevolod the Big Nest of Vladimir and prince first of Pereyaslavl and then of Starodub. In the brothers' war after 1212 he held Moscow for Konstantin against Yuri, then yielded it and withdrew south to Pereyaslavl, where he married a daughter of Prince Gleb Svyatoslavich of Chernigov. Captured by the Cumans in 1215, he was freed in 1218 and received Starodub as his appanage. He died on 6 January 1227 after taking the schema; Starodub then reverted to the grand princes of Vladimir.
zh: 弗拉基米尔·弗谢沃洛多维奇（1192—1227），教名德米特里，是弗拉基米尔大公弗谢沃洛德（大窝）之子，先后受封佩列亚斯拉夫和斯塔罗杜布。1212年后诸兄弟内战，他据守莫斯科替康斯坦丁对抗尤里，最终交出莫斯科，退往南方的佩列亚斯拉夫，并在那里娶切尔尼戈夫王公格列布·斯维亚托斯拉维奇之女为妻。1215年他被波洛韦茨人（库曼人）俘获，1218年获释后领有斯塔罗杜布。他于1227年1月6日出家苦衣后不久去世；此后斯塔罗杜布重新并归弗拉基米尔大公。

en: Simon I ruled as Count of Upper Salm from 1332. He was the son of Count John I of Salm and Jeanne de Joinville, heiress of Neuviller. In 1334, at Commercy, he married Mathilde of Saarbrücken, daughter of Count Simon V of Saarbrücken-Commercy; their son John, born around 1335, later ruled as Count John II of Salm. Simon was killed at the Battle of Crécy in France in 1346.
zh: 西蒙一世自1332年起担任上萨尔姆伯爵，是萨尔姆伯爵约翰一世与讷维莱尔女继承人让娜·德·茹安维尔之子。1334年，他在科梅尔西迎娶萨尔布吕肯-科梅尔西伯爵西蒙五世之女玛蒂尔达；两人的儿子约翰约生于1335年，后来继位为萨尔姆伯爵约翰二世。1346年，西蒙一世在法国的克雷西战役中阵亡。

en: John II (German: Johann II; c. 1335–c. 1400) was Count of Upper Salm in the Vosges and of Chiny, succeeding his father Simon I, who fell fighting for the French at Crécy in 1346. On 22 May 1355 at Sittard he married Philippa of Heinsberg-Valkenburg, heiress of Herpen and Ravenstein. Their daughter Odile married John III of Wassenaar-Polanen in 1390. John died between 1386 and 1400.
zh: 约翰二世（德语作约翰·冯·萨尔姆，约1335—约1400）是孚日山区的上萨尔姆伯爵，兼领希尼。其父西蒙一世1346年在克雷西战役中为法兰西作战阵亡，他随后继承家业。1355年5月22日，他在锡塔德与海因斯贝格-法尔肯堡的菲莉帕成婚，妻子是海尔彭和拉芬斯泰因领地的女继承人。女儿奥迪尔于1390年嫁给瓦瑟纳尔-波拉嫩的约翰三世。他于1386年至1400年间去世。

en: Mathilde of Saarbrücken was the daughter of Count Simon V of Saarbrücken-Commercy and Margaret of Savoy-Vaud. In 1334 she married at Commercy Simon I, Count of Upper Salm, who was killed at the Battle of Crécy in 1346. Their only son, John, born around 1335, succeeded as Count John II of Salm. After Simon's death Mathilde married a knight named John, and she was still alive after 1367.
zh: 萨尔布吕肯的玛蒂尔达是萨尔布吕肯-科梅尔西伯爵西蒙五世与萨伏依-沃的玛格丽特之女。1334年，她在科梅尔西嫁给上萨尔姆伯爵西蒙一世；西蒙于1346年在克雷西战役中阵亡。两人的独子约翰约生于1335年，后来袭位为萨尔姆伯爵约翰二世。丈夫死后，玛蒂尔达改嫁一位名叫约翰的骑士，1367年之后她仍在人世。

en: Maghnus Mac Cathail Ó Conchobhair was chief of the Ó Conchobhair Sligigh, Gaelic lords of Cairbre Drom Cliabh in what is now County Sligo, from 1329 until his death in 1342.
zh: 马格努斯·麦克卡海尔·奥康诺是盖尔爱尔兰家族奥康诺·斯莱戈的首领，据有今斯莱戈郡的凯尔布雷·德罗姆克利阿夫，1329年继任，1342年去世。

en: Hugo von Dürrach, a kinsman of Konrad von Dürrach, was Schultheiss (chief magistrate) of Solothurn in 1335/36 and again in 1346/47. He belonged to the Dürrach family that supplied the imperial city's leading magistrates through the fourteenth century.
zh: 雨果·冯·迪拉赫是康拉德·冯·迪拉赫的族人，于1335/36年和1346/47年两度出任索洛图恩的首席地方官。迪拉赫家族在14世纪接连出任这座帝国城市的最高长官。

en: Konrad von Dürrach was Schultheiss (chief magistrate) of Solothurn in 1328/29–1333/34 and again in 1336/37–1339/40. His family led the city's pro-Bern party; during his second tenure Solothurners fought beside Bern at the Battle of Laupen in 1339.
zh: 康拉德·冯·迪拉赫于1328/29—1333/34年、1336/37—1339/40年两度出任索洛图恩首席地方官。他的家族主导城中的亲伯尔尼派；在他第二任内，索洛图恩人于1339年与伯尔尼并肩参加劳彭战役。

en: Friedrich von Leibnitz (died 30 March 1338), from a Salzburg ministerial family seated at Leibnitz Castle, was cathedral provost when unanimously elected Prince-Archbishop of Salzburg in 1315; he received consecration at Avignon in November 1316. He allied Salzburg with Austria against Bavaria; at the Battle of Mühldorf in 1322, Duke Frederick of Austria and most of the Salzburg knights were captured. Salzburg faced heavy reparations, and the Bavarians occupied Tittmoning in 1324. In 1328 he issued Salzburg's first provincial ordinance, later regarded as the birth of the independent principality, and ruled until 1338.
zh: 莱布尼茨的弗里德里希（？—1338年3月30日）出身于以莱布尼茨城堡为族堡的萨尔茨堡家臣家族，担任座堂主任司铎时于1315年获一致推选为萨尔茨堡采邑大主教，1316年11月在阿维尼翁受祝圣。他让萨尔茨堡与奥地利结盟对抗巴伐利亚；1322年米尔多夫战役中，奥地利公爵弗里德里希和大多数萨尔茨堡骑士被俘。萨尔茨堡为此承担巨额赔款，1324年蒂特莫宁又被巴伐利亚人占据。1328年他颁布萨尔茨堡第一部邦法，被视为独立邦国诞生之始，统治直至1338年去世。

en: Jam Unar (died 1352), titled Malik Ferozuddin Shah, was the founder of the Samma dynasty and the first sultan of Sindh. In 1333 he rebelled against Malik Rattan, the Delhi-appointed governor of Sehwan, killed him in single combat and seized the city, though a Delhi army soon retook it. In 1351 he fought alongside the Soomra rulers against Muhammad bin Tughluq's invasion, then expelled the last Soomra, Hamir, and was elected ruler of Sindh by the Samma and Soomra chiefs. He died in 1352.
zh: 贾姆·乌纳尔（？—1352），称号马利克·菲罗兹丁·沙，是萨姆玛王朝的建立者、信德第一任苏丹。1333年，他起兵反抗德里苏丹国任命的塞赫万总督马利克·拉坦，在单骑决斗中将其斩杀并攻占该城，但塞赫万很快被德里大军夺回。1351年，他与苏姆拉诸首领联手抗击穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克的入侵，随后驱逐末代苏姆拉统治者哈米尔，被萨姆玛与苏姆拉首领共同推举为信德之主，次年去世。

en: Hrelja, known in Balkan epic as Relja Krilatica, the Winged One (died 1342), was a Serbian magnate who served kings Milutin, Dečanski and Dušan from Štip and Strumica. First recorded in the 1320s leading a detachment in the Byzantine civil war, he in 1334–1335 rebuilt the church of Rila Monastery, adding the defensive tower named after him; its inscription names Dušan as his lord. In the late 1330s, from a border domain between Serbia, Bulgaria and Byzantium, he broke away and ruled from Strumica, formally recognising Byzantine authority. In the next Byzantine civil war he backed John VI Kantakouzenos, who gave him Melnik and the title protosebastos. When Kantakouzenos fled to Dušan's court in 1342 and gave up his ally for Serbian help, Hrelja submitted to Dušan again and ceded Melnik. He died at Rila on 27 December 1342, tonsured as the monk Hariton and buried in the church he had rebuilt; Bulgarian tradition blames Serb mercenaries hired by Dušan.
zh: 赫雷利亚（？—1342）在巴尔干史诗中被称为“翼人”雷利亚·克里拉蒂察，是塞尔维亚大贵族，以什蒂普和斯特鲁米察一带为领地，先后效力于米卢丁、德钱斯基和杜尚三位国王。史籍中他首次见于1320年代，率塞尔维亚分队卷入拜占庭内战；他于1334—1335年重修里拉修道院的教堂，增建了以他名字命名的防御塔楼，塔上铭文称杜尚为他的君主。1330年代末，他凭借夹在塞尔维亚、保加利亚与拜占庭之间的边境领地脱离塞尔维亚，以斯特鲁米察为中心统治，名义上承认拜占庭权威。下一场拜占庭内战中，他支持约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯，获封梅尔尼克和“首席塞巴斯托斯”头衔。1342年坎塔库泽努斯逃到杜尚的宫廷，为换取塞尔维亚的援助舍弃了盟友，赫雷利亚只得重新臣服杜尚并交出梅尔尼克。同年12月27日，他在里拉修道院去世，不久前刚出家，法名哈里顿，葬在他重修的教堂里；保加利亚的说法是，他死于杜尚雇来的塞尔维亚雇佣兵之手。

en: Beka I Jaqeli (c. 1242–1308) succeeded his father Sargis I in 1285 as prince of Samtskhe, the Jaqeli domain in southern Georgia stretching from Tashiskari to Erzurum and the Black Sea. A vassal of the Mongol Il-Khans, he paid them tribute while ruling independently of the Georgian crown with the court title of Mandaturukhutsesi, and fended off Turkish raids from the Sultanate of Rum. He married his daughter Jiajak to the Trapezuntine emperor Alexios II, and another daughter, Natela, to King Demetrius II of Georgia; her son George V was raised at Beka's court after the Mongols executed Demetrius.
zh: 贝卡一世·贾克利（约1242—1308）于1285年继承父亲萨尔吉斯一世，成为萨姆茨赫王公。他的贾克利领地位于格鲁吉亚南部，从塔希斯卡里一直延伸到埃尔祖鲁姆和黑海。他向蒙古伊尔汗国称臣纳贡，同时脱离格鲁吉亚王权独立统治，拥有宫廷头衔“曼达图尔胡采西”，还击退了罗姆苏丹国方向的土耳其人袭扰。他把女儿贾贾克嫁给特拉比松皇帝阿莱克修斯二世，另一个女儿娜特拉嫁给格鲁吉亚国王德米特里二世；蒙古人处死德米特里后，娜特拉之子格奥尔基五世在贝卡的宫廷中长大。

en: Beka II Jaqeli (1332–1391) became atabeg of Samtskhe in 1361, succeeding his father Qvarqvare I, and was confirmed in office by his kinsman King Bagrat V of Georgia. From 1372 he ruled Meskheti jointly with his brother Shalva; when Shalva died in 1389 his place passed to his son Aghbugha I. During Timur's invasions of Georgia Beka's authority collapsed, and after the conqueror's devastating campaigns he abandoned Bagrat and surrendered to Timur. He died in 1391, leaving the throne to his son Ivane II.
zh: 贝卡二世·贾克利（1332—1391）于1361年继父亲克瓦克瓦雷一世之后担任萨姆茨赫阿塔贝格，并由同族的格鲁吉亚国王巴格拉特五世确认。自1372年起，他与兄弟沙尔瓦共治梅斯赫季；沙尔瓦于1389年去世后，其子阿格布加一世接替其位。帖木儿入侵格鲁吉亚期间，贝卡的权威崩溃，在征服者的毁灭性征伐之后，他背弃巴格拉特，向帖木儿投降。他于1391年去世，其子伊瓦涅二世继位。

en: Jiajak Jaqeli was a Georgian princess, daughter of Beka I Jaqeli, the atabeg of Samtskhe, and empress consort of Alexios II of Trebizond. They married around 1300, although the Byzantine emperor Andronikos II, Alexios's guardian, had wanted him to wed a daughter of Nikephoros Choumnos and pressed the patriarch to annul the match; the patriarch refused, as Jiajak was already reported to be pregnant. Her sons Andronikos III and Basil each wore the Trapezuntine crown, and her daughter Anna Anachoutlou ruled Trebizond as empress in 1341–1342. Alexios died in 1330; the date of Jiajak's own death is unrecorded.
zh: 贾贾克·贾克利是格鲁吉亚公主，萨姆茨赫阿塔贝格贝卡一世·贾克利之女，特拉比松皇帝阿莱克修斯二世的皇后。两人约于1300年成婚；阿莱克修斯的监护人、拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡二世本想让他娶尼基弗鲁斯·胡姆诺斯之女，还要求牧首宣布婚姻无效，但牧首以贾贾克据称已有身孕为由拒绝。她的儿子安德洛尼卡三世与瓦西里先后成为特拉比松皇帝，女儿安娜·阿纳卓特鲁于1341—1342年以女皇身份统治特拉比松。阿莱克修斯于1330年去世，贾贾克本人的卒年史籍无载。

en: Natela Jaqeli was a princess of Samtskhe, a daughter of Prince Beka I Jaqeli, and queen consort of Georgia as the wife of King Demetrius II. She gave birth to George, the future King George V, later called the Brilliant. After the Mongols executed Demetrius in 1289, the young boy was raised at his grandfather Beka I's court in Samtskhe, and he later returned from there to rule Georgia. Natela died after 1289.
zh: 娜特拉·贾克利是萨姆茨赫王公贝卡一世·贾克利之女，作为格鲁吉亚国王德米特里二世的妻子成为王后。她生下了后来被称为“辉煌者”的格奥尔基五世。1289年蒙古人处死德米特里后，年幼的格奥尔基被交由外祖父贝卡一世在萨姆茨赫的宫廷抚养，日后才从那里返回格鲁吉亚执政。娜特拉于1289年以后去世。

en: Qvarqvare I Jaqeli (1298–1361) was a Georgian prince and atabeg of Samtskhe, the southern highland province ruled by the Jaqeli family. He was the son of Atabeg Sargis II and a grandson of Beka I Jaqeli. When his father died in 1334, Qvarqvare submitted to King George V the Brilliant and received Samtskhe from him as atabeg; the act ended the separate course the province had followed under Mongol Ilkhanid overlordship since 1266 and reunited it with the Georgian crown. He ruled until his death in 1361, when his son Beka II succeeded him.
zh: 克瓦克瓦雷一世·贾克利（1298—1361）是格鲁吉亚王公、萨姆茨赫的阿塔贝格，该南方山地省份自1266年起在伊尔汗国宗主权下与格鲁吉亚王国分离。他是阿塔贝格萨尔基斯二世之子、贝卡一世之孙。1334年父亲去世后，他向格奥尔基五世“辉煌者”称臣，由国王任命为萨姆茨赫阿塔贝格，使该省重归格鲁吉亚王权。他统治至1361年去世，其子贝卡二世继位。

en: Sargis I Jaqeli (died 1285) was the first sovereign prince of Samtskhe and founder of the Jaqeli principality in southwestern Georgia. As spasalar, or constable, of Samtskhe he served King David VII and in December 1260 led eight thousand rebels against the Mongol general Arghun Aqa near Tashiskari. In 1266 Samtskhe gained crown-land status under direct Mongol suzerainty, virtually detaching it from the Georgian crown; Sargis became its sovereign prince in 1268. Late in life he took the monastic name Saba at Sapara Monastery and was succeeded by his son Beka I.
zh: 萨尔吉斯一世·贾克利（1285年卒）是萨姆茨赫第一位独立王公，也是格鲁吉亚西南部贾克利政权的奠基人。他曾任萨姆茨赫的军事长官，效力于大卫七世国王，1260年12月率八千起义军在塔希斯卡里附近迎战蒙古将领阿儿浑·阿合。1266年，萨姆茨赫成为蒙古汗廷直属的王畿领地，实际上脱离格鲁吉亚王权；1268年萨尔吉斯成为独立王公。晚年他在萨帕拉修道院出家，法名萨瓦，死后由其子贝卡一世继位。

en: Sargis II Jaqeli (1271–1334) was prince of Samtskhe from 1308 until his death, the son of Beka I Jaqeli. During his father's reign he commanded the Samtskhe army against Anatolian Turkoman raiders under Azat Mousa, checking them near Vashlovani in the 1290s and expelling them from the Meskhetian lands around 1303. After Beka's death in 1308 he succeeded to the principality, and his nephew King George V the Brilliant of Georgia named him Amirspasalar and Atabeg of the kingdom. His son Qvarqvare succeeded him.
zh: 萨尔吉斯二世·贾克利（1271—1334）是1308年至去世在任的萨姆茨赫王公，贝卡一世·贾克利之子。父亲在位时，他曾统率萨姆茨赫军队迎战阿扎特·穆萨率领的安纳托利亚土库曼袭掠者，1290年代在瓦什洛瓦尼附近阻截敌军，约1303年将其逐出梅斯赫季亚地区。1308年贝卡去世后他继位，他的外甥、格鲁吉亚国王“辉煌者”格奥尔基五世封他为王国的大将军与阿塔贝格。他死后由儿子夸尔克瓦列继位。

en: Alexander Glebovich (died 1313), eldest son of Gleb Rostislavich, was grand prince of Smolensk. He first held Mstislavl from 1278 and may have ruled Smolensk while his uncle Fyodor the Black tarried in the Golden Horde; in 1297 the townsmen made him their prince, and Fyodor failed to dislodge him the next year. In 1300 he and his brother Roman were defeated at Dorogobuzh by their cousin Andrey Mikhailovich of Vyazma, and one of his sons was killed. In 1303 Moscow seized Mozhaysk. After Oleg Romanovich of Bryansk died, Alexander installed his son Vasily as prince of Bryansk. He died in 1313, succeeded by his son Ivan.
zh: 亚历山大·格列博维奇（?—1313）是格列布·罗斯季斯拉维奇的长子、斯摩棱斯克大公。他自1278年起领有姆斯季斯拉夫尔，在叔父“黑者”费奥多尔滞留金帐汗国期间可能统治过斯摩棱斯克；1297年斯摩棱斯克市民拥立他为大公，次年费奥多尔未能将他赶走。1300年，他与兄弟罗曼在多罗戈布日被堂兄弟、维亚济马的安德烈·米哈伊洛维奇击败，他的一个儿子战死。1303年，莫斯科夺取莫扎伊斯克。布良斯克王公奥列格·罗曼诺维奇死后，亚历山大把儿子瓦西里扶上布良斯克公位。他于1313年去世，儿子伊万继位。

en: Davyd Rostislavich (1140–1197), fourth son of Rostislav Mstislavich of Kiev, was prince of Smolensk from 1180 until his death. After holding Novgorod, Torzhok, Vitebsk and, from 1167, Vyshhorod, he fought in the 1169 sack of Kiev and the nine-week defence of Vyshhorod in 1173. In 1176 the Cumans defeated him near Rostovets, a reverse recalled in The Tale of Igor's Campaign. His Smolensk reign brought campaigns against the Cumans and the Olgovichi, the 1191 transfer of Saints Boris and Gleb's relics to Smyadyn, and defeat near Vitebsk in 1196. He died a monk in April 1197.
zh: 达维德·罗斯季斯拉维奇（1140—1197）是基辅大公罗斯季斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇的第四子，1180年起任斯摩棱斯克王公，直至去世。他早年先后据有诺夫哥罗德、托尔若克、维捷布斯克，1167年起领有维什哥罗德，曾参与1169年攻陷基辅之役，并在1173年坚守维什哥罗德，顶住长达九周的围攻。1176年他在罗斯托韦茨附近被波洛韦茨人击败，《伊戈尔远征记》提到了这场败仗。他统治斯摩棱斯克期间屡与波洛韦茨人及奥利戈维奇一派作战，1191年将圣鲍里斯与格列布的遗骸移至斯米亚德尼修道院，1196年在维捷布斯克附近兵败。1197年4月，他出家后不久去世。

en: Davyd Igorevich (c. 1058–1112) was a Volhynian prince, son of Igor Yaroslavich and grandson of Yaroslav the Wise. Left fatherless as an izgoi, he seized Tmutarakan in 1081 and held it two years, then blockaded the Dnieper mouth until Grand Prince Vsevolod granted him Dorogobuzh in 1084; he received Volhynia in 1086. The 1097 congress of Liubech confirmed Volhynia to him, but for arresting and blinding Vasilko of Terebovlia the 1100 congress of Uvetichi deprived him of Vladimir, granting him Buzhsk, Ostrog and other towns; he soon received Dorogobuzh as well. He founded Davyd-Gorodok and died at Dorogobuzh in May 1112.
zh: 达维德·伊戈列维奇（约1058—1112）是沃伦王公，伊戈尔·雅罗斯拉维奇之子、智者雅罗斯拉夫之孙。父亲早逝后他成为被夺位的王公，1081年袭取特穆塔拉干并据守两年，随后率众封锁第聂伯河口，直到基辅大公弗谢沃洛德于1084年将多罗戈布日封给他；1086年他又得到沃伦。1097年柳别奇会议确认沃伦归他所有，但他因逮捕并刺瞎捷列博夫利王公瓦西里科·罗斯季斯拉维奇，在1100年维塔切夫会议上被剥夺弗拉基米尔，改获布日斯克、奥斯特罗格等城，不久又得到多罗戈布日。他修建了达维德-戈罗多克，1112年5月死于多罗戈布日。

en: Gleb Rostislavich (died 1278) was prince of Smolensk from the 1240s, a son of Rostislav Mstislavich, who is considered the ancestor of the thirteenth- and fourteenth-century Smolensk princes. He probably succeeded around 1249 after Vsevolod Mstislavich died. In 1270 he joined the Vladimir grand prince Yaroslav Yaroslavich's campaign against Novgorod. In 1274 he joined a campaign against Lithuania organized by Golden Horde khan Mengu-Timur, reaching Novgorodok-Litovsky and then marching, on Tatar orders, against Lev Danilovich of Galicia; the campaign marked Smolensk's submission to the Horde, and the first Tatar census followed in 1275. Gleb died in 1278 and was succeeded by his brother Mikhail.
zh: 格列布·罗斯季斯拉维奇（?—1278）是1240年代起在位的斯摩棱斯克王公、罗斯季斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇之子，其父被视为13至14世纪斯摩棱斯克王公一系的始祖。他大约在1249年弗谢沃洛德·姆斯季斯拉维奇死后继位。1270年，他随弗拉基米尔大公雅罗斯拉夫·雅罗斯拉维奇远征诺夫哥罗德。1274年，他参加金帐汗国汗王忙哥帖木儿组织的攻打立陶宛的远征，一直进抵诺夫哥罗多克，又奉鞑靼人之命转攻加利西亚王公列夫·丹尼洛维奇；史家一般认为此役标志着斯摩棱斯克臣服于金帐汗国，1275年汗国又在斯摩棱斯克进行了第一次人口清查。格列布死于1278年，由其弟米哈伊尔继位。

en: Igor Yaroslavich (c. 1036–1060) was a younger son of Yaroslav the Wise of Kiev and Ingegerd of Sweden. Under his father's testament of 1054 he received the Volhynian principality, but in 1057, after his brother Vyacheslav died in Smolensk, the senior Yaroslavichi transferred Igor to the Smolensk throne and gave Volhynia to their nephew Rostislav Vladimirovich. He died in 1060 aged about twenty-four, leaving the young sons Davyd and Vsevolod, who were ruled izgoi and barred from succeeding him. His wife came from the comital house of Orlamünde.
zh: 伊戈尔·雅罗斯拉维奇（约1036—1060）是基辅大公雅罗斯拉夫（智者）与瑞典的英格戈尔德之子。按1054年父亲的遗嘱，他领有沃伦公国；1057年其兄维亚切斯拉夫在斯摩棱斯克去世后，几位当权的雅罗斯拉维奇将他调往斯摩棱斯克，沃伦改封给侄子罗斯季斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇。他于1060年去世，年仅约24岁，留下达维德、弗谢沃洛德两个年幼的儿子；二子被定为出位王公，不得继承他的公位。他的妻子出身奥拉明德伯爵家族。

en: Ivan Aleksandrovich (died 1359) was grand prince of Smolensk, succeeding his father Alexander Glebovich in 1313. His brother Dmitry of Bryansk disputed the throne and besieged Smolensk with Tatar aid in 1334 before making peace. As local princes drifted with their lands toward Moscow, Ivan allied in 1339 with Gediminas of Lithuania and stopped paying tribute to the Golden Horde; in 1340 Öz Beg Khan's army failed to storm Smolensk. In 1348 Smolensk regiments fought for Lithuania against the Livonian Order at the Strėva, but a Muscovite campaign in 1351 forced Ivan to renounce the alliance. He died in 1359.
zh: 伊万·亚历山德罗维奇（?—1359）是斯摩棱斯克大公，1313年继父亲亚历山大·格列博维奇之后登上公位。他的兄弟布良斯克王公德米特里与其争位，1334年在鞑靼人援助下围攻斯摩棱斯克，最终兄弟和解。随着各地王公带着土地转投莫斯科，伊万于1339年与立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯结盟，不再向钦察汗国纳贡；1340年月即别汗的大军未能攻克斯摩棱斯克。1348年，斯摩棱斯克军队在斯特雷瓦河一役中助立陶宛对抗利沃尼亚骑士团，但1351年莫斯科的远征迫使伊万放弃了这一同盟。他于1359年去世。

en: Konstantin Davidovich (c. 1184–1218) was a Smolensk Rurikid, the younger son of Davyd Rostislavich of Smolensk. When his father died in 1197, he was entrusted to his uncle Rurik Rostislavich in the Kyiv land, who presumably granted him an appanage, though no chronicle names his throne. The Polish chronicler Jan Długosz records that he joined the Rostislavichi campaign against Lithuania in 1207, while Rus sources otherwise pass over his career. The chronicles enter his death under 1217/1218. Later genealogical tradition makes him ancestor of the princes of Fomin and Berezuysk through a son Yuri.
zh: 康斯坦丁·达维多维奇（约1184—1217/1218）是斯摩棱斯克系留里克王公、达维德·罗斯季斯拉维奇的幼子。1197年父亲临终时将他托付给身居基辅之地的叔父留里克·罗斯季斯拉维奇，后者大约封给了他一块领地，但编年史没有记载具体是哪一处公位。波兰编年史家扬·德乌戈什记载，他参加了1207年罗斯季斯拉维奇诸王公讨伐立陶宛的远征，罗斯史料对他其余的活动则几无着墨。编年史在1217/1218年条下记录了他的去世。后世的谱系传统称，福明与别列祖伊斯克的王公是他的后裔，其一支始祖为其子尤里。

en: Mstislav Davidovich (baptized Fyodor; died 1230) was prince of Smolensk from 1219, the son of Davyd Rostislavich. He campaigned against Lithuania in 1207 and in 1217 defeated Lithuanian raiders ravaging the country around Polotsk. In 1219, when Vladimir Rurikovich moved from Smolensk to Ovruch, Mstislav took the Smolensk throne. Smolensk regiments fought at the Battle of the Kalka River in 1223, and his reign saw the conclusion of Smolensk's trade treaty with Riga and Gotland. He died in 1230 and was succeeded by his son Rostislav, though two years later his cousin's son Sviatoslav Mstislavich seized the city with Polotsk aid.
zh: 姆斯季斯拉夫·达维多维奇（教名费奥多尔，?—1230）是达维德·罗斯季斯拉维奇之子，1219年起任斯摩棱斯克王公。1207年他参加讨伐立陶宛的远征，1217年又击败在波洛茨克一带劫掠的立陶宛人。1219年弗拉基米尔·留里科维奇从斯摩棱斯克转封奥夫鲁奇，姆斯季斯拉夫登上斯摩棱斯克公位。1223年，斯摩棱斯克军队参加了卡尔卡河战役；他在位期间，斯摩棱斯克与里加和哥得兰缔结了通商条约。他于1230年去世，子罗斯季斯拉夫继位，但两年后堂侄斯维亚托斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇借波洛茨克之兵夺取了斯摩棱斯克。

en: Rostislav Mstislavich (born 1189; died in or after 1240/1249) was a Smolensk Rurikid, son of Mstislav Davidovich, and ancestor of the later Smolensk princely line. He took the Smolensk throne after his father's death in 1230 but was expelled in 1232 by his cousin Sviatoslav Mstislavich, who came with an army of Polotsk princes. Some accounts identify him with the Rostislav who entered Kiev in 1239 during the Mongol invasion, after Mikhail Vsevolodovich fled to Hungary, and claimed the grand-princely title; others identify that prince as a son of Mstislav Romanovich the Old. Daniel of Galicia soon drove the claimant out and installed his own voivode Dmytro in Kiev. Rostislav's sons Gleb, Mikhail and Fyodor the Black later all ruled Smolensk.
zh: 罗斯季斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇（1189年生，卒于1240/1249年或之后）是斯摩棱斯克系留里克王公、姆斯季斯拉夫·达维多维奇之子，被视为13至14世纪斯摩棱斯克王公一系的始祖。1230年父亲死后他据有斯摩棱斯克公位，1232年被率领波洛茨克诸侯军队前来的堂亲斯维亚托斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇驱逐。一些说法认为他就是1239年进入基辅并自称大公的罗斯季斯拉夫：当时蒙古入侵，米哈伊尔·弗谢沃洛多维奇已逃往匈牙利；另一些研究则认为这位王公是姆斯季斯拉夫·罗曼诺维奇（老者）之子。加利西亚的丹尼尔很快将这位争位者赶走，派自己的长官德米特里镇守基辅。他的儿子格列布、米哈伊尔和“黑者”费奥多尔后来都统治过斯摩棱斯克。

en: Stanislav Vladimirovich (c. 984/987–probably before 1015) was a younger son of Vladimir the Great of Kyiv. The later Nikon Chronicle records that around 988 he received Smolensk as his appanage, making him its first Rurikid prince; he is also the only pre-Mongol Rurikid known to have borne the name Stanislav. Chronicles mention him solely in lists of Vladimir's sons, third from the last, and preserve no deeds of his. He probably died before his father, who died in 1015.
zh: 斯坦尼斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇（约984/987—约1015年前）是基辅大公弗拉基米尔一世的幼子之一。据后世的《尼康编年史》记载，他约在988年受封斯摩棱斯克，成为当地第一位留里克家族王公，也是蒙古入侵前留里克家族中唯一名叫斯坦尼斯拉夫的人。史书只在弗拉基米尔诸子名单中提到他，列倒数第三，没有留下任何事迹。他很可能先于1015年去世的父亲而亡。

en: Vyacheslav Yaroslavich (1036–1057) was a younger son of Yaroslav the Wise of Kyiv and Ingegerd of Sweden. On Yaroslav's death in 1054 he received the Principality of Smolensk in the division of the Rurikid lands, but he ruled there for only three years before he died. Almost nothing else is recorded of him. He left a son, Boris Vyacheslavich, who in 1077 laid claim to the Principality of Chernigov during the wars between Yaroslav's sons and was killed fighting in 1078.
zh: 维亚切斯拉夫·雅罗斯拉维奇（1036—1057）是基辅大公“智者”雅罗斯拉夫与瑞典的英格戈尔德的幼子之一。1054年雅罗斯拉夫去世、诸子分割留里克家族领地时，他分得斯摩棱斯克公国，但仅统治三年便去世。史籍对他的其他事迹几乎毫无记载。他留下儿子鲍里斯·维亚切斯拉维奇；1077年雅罗斯拉夫诸子交战期间，鲍里斯对切尔尼戈夫公国提出继承权，并于1078年战死。

en: Johann Clare (died 5 May 1344), born to a burgher family of Thorn in Prussia, was a Teutonic Order priest who became a canon of Samland in 1294 and cathedral dean in 1301. After Bishop Siegfried of Regenstein died in 1310 the chapter unanimously elected him, but quarrels with the archbishop of Riga and the Curia delayed his appointment until Pope John XXII provided him to the see in 1319. From 1320 he sought to recover church rights and lands seized by the order, securing only part of his claims in 1322. He oversaw construction of the new Königsberg Cathedral on the Kneiphof and promoted German settlement until his death in 1344.
zh: 约翰·克拉雷（？—1344年5月5日）出身于普鲁士托伦老城的市民家庭，是条顿骑士团神父，1294年成为萨姆兰教士团成员，1301年任主教座堂总铎。1310年主教西格弗里德·冯·雷根施泰因去世后，教士团一致推选克拉雷接任，但他与里加大主教及教廷的争执使任命久拖不决，直到1319年教皇约翰二十二世才正式将教区授予他。1320年起，他向骑士团追讨被侵占的教会权利与地产，1322年只实现了部分诉求。他主持在柯尼普霍夫岛修建新的柯尼斯堡主教座堂，并推动德意志移民定居，1344年卒于柯尼斯堡。

en: Rajanarayana Sambuvarayar was a Tamil chief of the Sambuvarayar family who became an independent ruler of Tondaimandalam, the northern Tamil country, as the Hoysala and Pandya kingdoms crumbled in the early fourteenth century. From 1337 he issued records in his own regnal years, styling himself Sakalalokachakravarti, and held Kanchi with his fortress at Padaiveedu. Around 1350–1351 a Vijayanagara army led by Vira Savanna defeated him, then restored him to his throne as a Vijayanagara vassal. He died around 1362, after which renewed Vijayanagara campaigns destroyed Sambuvaraya power and annexed Tondaimandalam.
zh: 罗阇那罗延·三补缚罗耶尔是三补缚罗耶尔家族的泰米尔首领，14世纪初曷萨拉与潘地亚王国衰微之际，他成为通达曼达拉姆（泰米尔北部）的独立统治者。自1337年起，他以自己的王年发布铭文，自称“世间转轮王”，领有甘吉布勒姆，并以波代维杜为要塞。约1350—1351年，维拉·萨万纳率领毗奢耶那伽罗军队将他击败，随后又扶他复位，作为毗奢耶那伽罗的附庸。他约于1362年去世，此后毗奢耶那伽罗再度用兵，消灭三补缚罗耶尔的势力，吞并通达曼达拉姆。

en: Sang Nila Utama, a prince of Palembang, is portrayed in the Malay Annals as the founder of the Kingdom of Singapura. He married Wan Sri Bini, a princess of Bintan. The annals relate that he spotted Temasek across the sea while hunting on Bintan; in 1299, sailing there, he was caught in a storm and cast his crown into the sea before reaching the island. There a strange beast was identified by his minister as a lion, an omen that led him to build a city and name the island Singapura, Sanskrit for Lion City, taking the title Sri Tri Buana. He ruled until his death in 1347 and was succeeded by his son Sri Wikrama Wira.
zh: 桑·尼拉·乌他玛原是巨港的王子，《马来纪年》称他为新加坡王国的建立者。他迎娶宾丹岛公主婉·室利·比妮。据该书记载，他在宾丹岛狩猎时望见海对面的淡马锡；1299年前往该岛途中，他遭遇风暴，将王冠投入大海后才得以登陆。他在岛上见到一头异兽，大臣指认为狮子，他视为吉兆，便在此筑城，并以梵语“狮子城”之意将岛屿命名为新加坡拉，自己采用室利·特里·布瓦纳的尊号。他于1347年去世，其子室利·威格拉玛维拉继位。

en: Sri Wikrama Wira, eldest son of Sang Nila Utama, was the second Raja of Singapura, ruling from 1347 to 1362. Known before his accession as Raja Kecil Besar, he married Nila Panjadi, a princess from India. His reign saw the first Siamese attempt to subdue the island: as the Malay Annals relate, a fleet of seventy junks besieged it, an episode recorded by the Chinese traveller Wang Dayuan in 1349. The fortified city held out until Chinese ships appeared and the Siamese withdrew. Majapahit, expanding across the archipelago under Gajah Mada, was the next threat. After Hayam Wuruk took its throne in 1350, he sent an envoy demanding submission; Sri Wikrama Wira refused and answered with a message threatening to shave the Javanese king's head if he came. The Javanese fleet of 180 warships met 400 Singaporean ships off the coast, and after three days of fighting, inexperienced at sea, it was routed.
zh: 室利·威格拉玛维拉是桑·尼拉·乌他玛的长子，新加坡王国第二任拉惹，1347至1362年在位。他即位前名为拉惹·克奇尔·勿刹，娶印度公主尼拉·潘贾迪为妻。他在位时，暹罗首次试图征服该岛：据《马来纪年》记载，一支拥有70艘大船的舰队围攻此地，中国旅行家汪大渊于1349年在《岛夷志略》中记录了此事。设防坚固的城池坚守不退，直到中国船只出现，暹罗人才撤围。接着，在加查·马达统领下四处扩张的满者伯夷成了下一个威胁。1350年哈奄·武禄继位后，派使者要求新加坡臣服；室利·威格拉玛维拉拒绝，还回话威胁说，如果爪哇王敢来，就剃光他的头。爪哇的180艘战舰与新加坡的400艘战船在海岸交锋三日，不谙水战的爪哇人溃败而逃。

en: The Malay Annals call Wan Sri Bini a princess of Bentan on Bintan Island, daughter of Queen Permaisuri Iskandar Syah. She married Sang Nila Utama, founder of Singapura, and bore his sons Sri Wikrama Wira and Raja Kechil-Muda.
zh: 据《马来纪年》记载，宛·室利·比妮是宾坦岛本坦国女王伊斯干达沙的女儿。她嫁给新加坡拉的建国者桑·尼拉·乌他玛，生下斯里·维克拉玛·维拉和拉惹·吉兹尔-穆达两个儿子。

en: Sogai (died 1296) was a Mongol prince of the Ilkhanate, the son of Hulagu's son Yoshmut. In 1295 he commanded one of the armies of his cousin Ghazan during the campaign that overthrew the Ilkhan Baydu near Qazvin and placed Ghazan on the throne. When the Chagatai khan Duwa invaded Khorasan late that year, Sogai was sent against him but deserted, convinced the expedition was a plot by the emir Nawruz. He was seized and executed on Ghazan's orders in 1296.
zh: 唆海（？—1296）是伊儿汗国的蒙古宗王，为旭烈兀之子玉疏木忒之子。1295年，堂兄合赞起兵推翻伊儿汗拜都，唆海统领一军参加加兹温附近的战事，助合赞夺取汗位。同年末，察合台汗笃哇入侵呼罗珊，唆海奉命迎击，却因怀疑此行是异密捏吾鲁兹设下的圈套而弃军逃走。1296年，合赞下令将他处死。

en: Söse was a Mongol Borjigin prince, son of Mingqan Ke'un and great-grandson of Ariq Böke. He is known only from genealogical records as the father of Arpa Ke'un, who seized the Ilkhanid throne of Persia in 1335.
zh: 索塞是出身阿里不哥一系的蒙古孛儿只斤贵族，为米因罕之子、成吉思汗之孙阿里不哥的曾孙。其名仅见于谱系记载：他是阿儿巴之父，后者于1335年夺得波斯的伊儿汗国汗位。

en: Blas de Lezo (1689–1741) was a Spanish admiral born near San Sebastián. Entering the navy in 1701, he lost his left leg at Vélez-Málaga in 1704, his left eye at the defence of Toulon in 1707 and the use of his right arm at the Siege of Barcelona in 1714. He served in the Pacific from 1720 to 1728, having reached Callao in Peru with two captured French frigates. He helped recapture Oran from the Ottomans in 1732. In 1741 he defended Cartagena de Indias with only a few thousand men against Edward Vernon's British fleet of nearly 200 ships and twenty-seven thousand troops, ultimately forcing the British to withdraw. He died of typhus four months after the victory.
zh: 布拉斯·德莱索（1689—1741）是出生于圣塞瓦斯蒂安附近的西班牙海军上将。他1701年入伍，1704年在贝莱斯-马拉加海战中失去左腿，1707年在守卫土伦时失去左眼，1714年在巴塞罗那围城战中右臂致残。他带着两艘缴获的法国护卫舰抵达秘鲁的卡亚俄，1720至1728年在太平洋服役。1732年他协助从奥斯曼帝国手中收复奥兰。1741年，他以数千之众守卫卡塔赫纳-德印第亚斯，抵御爱德华·弗农麾下近200艘舰船、2.7万人的英国舰队，最终迫使英军撤退。获胜四个月后，他死于斑疹伤寒。

en: Francisco de Goya (1746–1828), born at Fuendetodos in Aragon, was Spain's leading painter. Trained in Saragossa and Madrid, he designed tapestry cartoons for the royal palace, became a court painter in 1786 and first court painter in 1799, portraying the royal family of Charles IV. An illness in 1793 left him deaf, and his art turned dark and critical: the Caprichos, the Nude Maja, the Disasters of War etchings of the Peninsular War and The Third of May 1808. He remained in Madrid during the war. In 1819–1823 he painted the Black Paintings on the walls of his house. In 1824 he went into exile at Bordeaux, where he died in 1828.
zh: 弗朗西斯科·德·戈雅（1746—1828）生于阿拉贡的丰德托多斯，是当时西班牙首屈一指的画家。他在萨拉戈萨和马德里学画，为王宫设计挂毯画稿，1786年成为宫廷画家，1799年成为首席宫廷画家，为卡洛斯四世王室画像。1793年一场重病使他失聪，此后画风变得阴暗而富有批判色彩，代表作有《奇想集》《裸体的马哈》、记录半岛战争的版画《战争的灾难》和《1808年5月3日》。战争期间他留在马德里。1819—1823年，他在马德里近郊住所“聋人之家”的墙面上创作了《黑色绘画》。1824年他流亡波尔多，1828年在当地去世。

en: Ignatius of Loyola (1491–1556) was a Basque nobleman's son raised at the castle of Loyola in Gipuzkoa. He served as a page to the treasurer of Castile before taking up arms. A cannonball shattered his leg at the Battle of Pamplona in 1521; during his long recovery at Loyola, reading the lives of Christ and the saints, he underwent a spiritual conversion. He set down his method of prayer in the Spiritual Exercises (1548). With six companions he founded the Society of Jesus in Paris and became its first Superior General in 1541; the Jesuits pursued missions and teaching, and became a leading force of the Counter-Reformation. He was canonized in 1622.
zh: 依纳爵·罗耀拉（1491—1556）是吉普斯夸罗耀拉城堡长大的巴斯克贵族子弟。他曾在卡斯蒂利亚财政官手下担任侍童，后来投身军旅。1521年，他在潘普洛纳战役中被炮弹炸断腿；在罗耀拉漫长养伤期间，他阅读基督与圣徒的传记，经历了心灵的转变。他把自己的祈祷方法写成《神操》（1548年）。他与六名同伴在巴黎创立耶稣会，1541年出任首任总会长；耶稣会从事传教与教育，后来成为反宗教改革的重要力量。他于1622年被封圣。

en: John of the Cross (1542–1591), born Juan de Yepes y Álvarez, was a Spanish Carmelite mystic and poet. He entered the Carmelite Order in 1563 and studied theology and philosophy at Salamanca. Ordained in 1567, he met Teresa of Ávila and helped found the Discalced Carmelites, restoring the order's austere primitive rule. On 2 December 1577 opponents of the reform seized him at Ávila and imprisoned him at Toledo under weekly lashings; he composed much of his Spiritual Canticle there before escaping in August 1578. His verses and treatises, including Dark Night of the Soul, are classics of Spanish mysticism. Canonized in 1726, he became a Doctor of the Church in 1926.
zh: 十字若望（1542—1591），原名胡安·德·耶佩斯·阿尔瓦雷斯，是西班牙加尔默罗会的神秘主义者与诗人。他于1563年加入加尔默罗会，在萨拉曼卡学习神学与哲学。他于1567年晋铎，同年结识阿维拉的德兰，协助创立赤脚加尔默罗会，恢复修会严苛的原始会规。1577年12月2日，反对改革的会士在阿维拉将他拘捕，囚禁于托莱多，每周受鞭笞；他在那里写成《灵歌》的大部分，于1578年8月越狱。他的诗篇与论著，包括《心灵的黑夜》，是西班牙神秘文学的经典。他于1726年被封圣，1926年被列为教会圣师。

en: Miguel de Cervantes (1547–1616) was Spain's greatest novelist, born at Alcalá de Henares. In 1569 he moved to Rome, where he worked in a cardinal's household. In 1570 he enlisted as a Spanish infantryman and was twice shot through the chest and left hand at Lepanto in 1571, losing the use of his left arm. In 1575 Barbary pirates captured him and he spent five years as a captive in Algiers until ransomed in 1580. He later worked as a purchasing agent and tax collector while writing: La Galatea appeared in 1585, the first part of Don Quixote in 1605, the Novelas ejemplares in 1613, and the second part of Don Quixote in 1615. He died at Madrid in 1616.
zh: 米格尔·德·塞万提斯（1547—1616）是西班牙最伟大的小说家，生于埃纳雷斯堡。1569年他前往罗马，在一位枢机家中任职。1570年他加入西班牙步兵，1571年在勒班陀战役中胸部与左手两处中弹，左臂从此残废。1575年巴巴里海盗将他俘虏，他在阿尔及尔被囚五年，1580年才靠赎金获释。此后他一边担任采购员和税吏一边写作：《伽拉泰亚》1585年问世，《堂吉诃德》第一部1605年刊行，《训诫小说集》1613年出版，《堂吉诃德》第二部则于1615年刊行。1616年他于马德里去世。

en: Francisco de Quevedo (1580–1645) was a Spanish nobleman, satirist and poet of the Baroque. Born in Madrid and educated at Alcalá, he followed the court to Valladolid in 1601 and studied theology there. He won fame for vitriolic verse and prose satire, above all the picaresque novel El Buscón; his conceptismo made him Góngora's lifelong rival. Service with the Duke of Osuna earned him the Order of Santiago in 1618, but Osuna's fall saw him exiled in 1620. Back at court under Philip IV, he became royal secretary in 1632, only to be arrested in 1639 and held in a León convent until 1643; broken in health, he died in 1645.
zh: 弗朗西斯科·德·戈维多（1580—1645），西班牙巴洛克时期的贵族、讽刺作家与诗人。他生于马德里，在阿尔卡拉求学，1601年随宫廷迁至巴利亚多利德，在那里研习神学。他以辛辣的诗文讽刺闻名，代表作是流浪汉小说《骗子外传》；他的“概念派”文风使他与贡戈拉终身为敌。他为奥苏纳公爵效力，1618年获圣雅各骑士团身份，但1620年奥苏纳失势后他遭到放逐。腓力四世即位后他重返朝中，1632年成为国王秘书，却在1639年被捕，囚禁于莱昂的修道院直至1643年；获释时身体已经垮掉，1645年去世。

en: Teresa of Ávila (1515–1582) was a Carmelite nun and a leading Spanish mystic of the Counter-Reformation. She entered the Carmelite Convent of the Incarnation at Ávila, where she read works on contemplative prayer and experienced religious ecstasies. In 1562 she founded the convent of Saint Joseph in Ávila under a strict rule of poverty and prayer, and together with John of the Cross she established the Discalced Carmelites, separated from the old order by papal decree in 1580. Her works The Way of Perfection and The Interior Castle guide the soul through contemplation toward God; the latter describes its progress through seven mansions. She died at Alba de Tormes, was canonized in 1622, and in 1970 became the first female Doctor of the Church.
zh: 亚维拉的德兰（1515—1582）是加尔默罗会修女，也是西班牙反宗教改革时期的重要神秘主义者。她进入阿维拉的加尔默罗会降生修院，研读默观祈祷的著作，并经历宗教神魂超拔。1562年，她在阿维拉创立圣若瑟隐修院，恪守贫穷与祈祷的严规；又与十字若望一同建立赤足加尔默罗会，该会于1580年凭教宗诏书与旧会分立。她的《全德之路》《灵心城堡》以默观引导灵魂趋近天主，后者以七重居所描绘灵魂的进程。她于1582年逝于阿尔瓦-德托梅斯，1622年被封圣，1970年成为首位女性教会圣师。

en: Túpac Amaru II (1738–1781), born José Gabriel Condorcanqui near Cusco, was kuraca of Surimana, Pampamarca and Tungasuca and a mule trader who claimed descent from the last Incas of Vilcabamba. Educated in Cusco, he inherited his father's chieftainship and transported goods and minerals by mule. When the colonial authorities ignored his petitions against indigenous tribute and the mining mita, he seized the corregidor Antonio de Arriaga on 4 November 1780 and executed him on 10 November. His rebellion spread from Peru into Upper Peru. On 16 November he decreed the abolition of slavery, the first such measure in Spanish America. Betrayed after failing to take Cusco, he was beheaded and quartered in the main square on 18 May 1781.
zh: 图帕克·阿马鲁二世（1738—1781）原名何塞·加夫列尔·孔多尔坎基，生于库斯科附近，是苏里马纳、潘帕马卡和通加苏卡的土著酋长，也是赶骡商人，自称是比尔卡班巴末代印加王的后裔。他在库斯科受教育，继承父亲的酋长职位，以骡队运送货物与矿产。殖民当局对他反对土著贡赋和矿山米塔劳役制的请愿置之不理，他遂于1780年11月4日逮捕地方长官安东尼奥·德·阿里亚加，11月10日将其处死。他发动的起义从秘鲁蔓延到上秘鲁。11月16日，他颁布废除奴隶制的法令，为西属美洲首例。攻打库斯科失败后他被部下出卖，1781年5月18日在库斯科武器广场被斩首并肢解。

en: Diego Rodríguez de Silva y Velázquez (baptized 6 June 1599 – 6 August 1660) was the leading painter of the Spanish Golden Age. Born in Seville, he was apprenticed to Francisco Pacheco in 1611 and married his teacher's daughter Juana in 1618. He first won notice with kitchen scenes such as Old Woman Frying Eggs (1618), marked by realism and dramatic lighting. Summoned by Philip IV's minister Olivares, he painted the king in August 1623, settled in Madrid and became court painter. His works include The Surrender of Breda (1634–1635) and the Rokeby Venus, and he twice travelled to Italy. Las Meninas (1656) crowned his career, and he died in Madrid in 1660.
zh: 迭戈·罗德里格斯·德·席尔瓦·委拉斯开兹（1599年6月6日受洗—1660年8月6日）是西班牙黄金时代最杰出的画家。他生于塞维利亚，1611年起师从弗朗西斯科·帕切科，1618年迎娶老师的女儿胡安娜。他早年以《煎鸡蛋的老妇》（1618）等厨房场景画崭露头角，画作以写实和富有戏剧性的光线为特色。他应腓力四世的大臣奥利瓦雷斯之召入宫，1623年8月为国王画像，随后定居马德里成为宫廷画家。代表作有《布雷达之降》（1634—1635）和《镜前的维纳斯》，并曾两度前往意大利。1656年的《宫娥》是其创作生涯的巅峰之作。1660年，他在马德里去世。

en: Welf VI (1115–1191), third son of Duke Henry IX of Bavaria, inherited the Welf family lands in Swabia around Ravensburg while his elder brothers took Bavaria and the church. Through his wife Uta he disputed the inheritance of Calw after her father's death in 1131. In 1152 his nephew, Emperor Frederick Barbarossa, enfeoffed him with the duchy of Spoleto and the margraviate of Tuscany, founding the Italian line of the Welf dynasty. He campaigned with Barbarossa in Italy; his only son Welf VII contracted an epidemic illness and died at Siena during the retreat in 1167. He later surrendered his Italian states to the emperor and was buried at the Premonstratensian Steingaden Abbey he had founded.
zh: 韦尔夫六世（1115—1191）是巴伐利亚公爵亨利九世的第三子，继承了家族在施瓦本以拉芬斯堡为中心的领地，长兄们则分得巴伐利亚或进入教会。妻子乌塔的父亲于1131年去世后，他为卡尔夫的继承权发生争执。1152年，他的外甥、皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨将斯波莱托公国和托斯卡纳藩侯领地封给他，由此开创韦尔夫家族的意大利支系。他随巴巴罗萨出征意大利，独子韦尔夫七世染上疫病，于1167年撤军途中死于锡耶纳。他后来将意大利领地交还皇帝，死后葬于他本人创建的普雷蒙特雷会施泰因加登修道院。

en: Welf VII (c. 1135–1167), only son of Welf VI and Uta of Calw, managed the family's Italian domains while his father remained in Swabia. From 1154 he accompanied his cousin Emperor Frederick Barbarossa on his Italian campaigns, and in 1160 the emperor made him duke of Spoleto. He figured prominently in his father's feud with Hugh of Tübingen, which came to a head in 1164–1166 and was settled by the emperor. In 1167 he took part in Barbarossa's siege of Rome against Pope Alexander III; after the city fell a devastating epidemic swept the imperial army, and he died of it at Siena on 12 September. He was buried at Steingaden Abbey in Bavaria.
zh: 韦尔夫七世（约1135—1167）是韦尔夫六世与卡尔夫的乌塔的独子，父亲留居施瓦本时，由他打理家族的意大利领地。自1154年起，他随表兄、皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨远征意大利，1160年被皇帝封为斯波莱托公爵。他是父亲与蒂宾根的休之间纷争的核心人物，这场纷争于1164至1166年达到高峰，最终由皇帝调停。1167年，他参加巴巴罗萨围攻罗马、讨伐教皇亚历山大三世的战事；罗马陷落后，一场瘟疫在皇军中蔓延，他于9月12日在锡耶纳病死，葬于巴伐利亚的施泰因加登修道院。

en: Khun Luang Pha Ngua, later King Borommarachathirat I (c. 1311–1388), was a lord of the Suphannaphum clan and the elder brother of King Ramathibodi I's queen. When Ramathibodi founded Ayutthaya in 1351, he appointed Pha Ngua to rule Suphan Buri. After Ramathibodi died in 1369 his son Ramesuan took the throne, but within a year Pha Ngua forced him to abdicate and was crowned himself, the first Ayutthayan king of the Suphannaphum dynasty. He reigned eighteen years and died in 1388; his young son Thong Lan ruled barely a week before Ramesuan returned from Lavo and seized power.
sources: https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/สมเด็จพระบรมราชาธิราชที่_1
zh: 波隆摩罗阇一世（约1311—1388），即坤銮帕娃，是素攀那蓬家族的领主，也是拉玛铁菩提一世王后的兄长。1351年拉玛铁菩提建立阿瑜陀耶后，派他出镇素攀武里。1369年拉玛铁菩提去世，王子拉梅萱继位，不到一年便被他逼迫退位，他由此加冕，成为阿瑜陀耶素攀那蓬王朝的第一位国王。他在位十八年，1388年去世；幼子东兰继位仅一周，拉梅萱便从华富里返回，夺回王位。

en: Phraya Uthong was, by Thai chronicle tradition, the ruler of the city of Uthong in Suphannabhum before Ayutthaya was founded. He was the father of Borommarachathirat I and gave a daughter in marriage to Ramathibodi I, the founder of Ayutthaya.
sources: https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/แคว้นสุพรรณภูมิ
zh: 披耶乌通是泰国编年史传统中阿瑜陀耶建国以前素攀那蓬境内乌通城的统治者。他是波隆摩罗阇一世之父，并将女儿嫁给阿瑜陀耶的建立者拉玛铁菩提一世。

en: This unnamed princess of the Suphannaphum clan was a younger sister of King Borommarachathirat I (Khun Luang Pha Ngua). She married King Ramathibodi I, founder of Ayutthaya, and was mother of Ramesuan, whose rivalry with his uncle shaped the succession after Ramathibodi died in 1369.
sources: https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/สมเด็จพระราเมศวร
zh: 这位素攀那蓬家族的无名公主是波隆摩罗阇一世（坤銮帕娃）的妹妹。她嫁给阿瑜陀耶立国君主拉玛铁菩提一世，是拉梅萱王之母。拉玛铁菩提1369年去世后，她的儿子与舅父帕娃之间的竞争影响了王位继承。

en: A daughter of King Loe Thai of Sukhothai (r. 1298–1323), she married Khun Luang Pha Ngua, ruler of Suphan Buri, who seized the Ayutthaya throne as King Borommarachathirat I in 1370. The marriage linked the Phra Ruang and Suphannaphum dynasties.
zh: 她是素可泰帕銮王朝国王乐泰（1298—1323年在位）之女，嫁给素攀武里的统治者坤銮帕哇；后者于1370年夺取阿瑜陀耶王位，称波罗马拉贾一世。这桩联姻将帕銮王室与素攀王室联结在一起。

en: Elisabeth of Katzenelnbogen (died 25 May 1383), a daughter of Count William I of Katzenelnbogen, married Count Walram of Sponheim-Kreuznach on 9 August 1330 and was the mother of the last ruling Kreuznach count, Simon III.
zh: 卡岑埃尔恩博根的伊丽莎白（1383年5月25日卒）是卡岑埃尔恩博根伯爵威廉一世之女，1330年8月9日嫁给施蓬海姆-克罗伊茨纳赫伯爵瓦尔拉姆，是末代克罗伊茨纳赫执政伯爵西蒙三世之母。

en: John I, called the Lame (c. 1245–1290), was count of the Further County of Sponheim, ruling from Kreuznach. He succeeded his father Simon I in 1265 and in the same year married Adelaide of Leiningen-Landeck, daughter of Count Emich IV. He later had to partition the inheritance with his brothers Henry and Eberhard, who founded the Sponheim-Bolanden and Sponheim-Neef lines; mediation settled the division in 1277. A feud followed when Henry sold Böckelheim Castle to the archbishop of Mainz against John's pre-emption right, and in 1279 John was defeated at Sprendlingen. He was buried at Pfaffen-Schwabenheim.
zh: 约翰一世，绰号“瘸子”（约1245—1290），是前施蓬海姆伯国伯爵，以克罗伊茨纳赫为统治中心。1265年父亲西蒙一世去世后他继位，并于同年娶埃米希四世之女、莱宁根-兰德克的阿德海德为妻。后来他不得不与弟弟亨利和埃伯哈德分割祖产，二人分别开创施蓬海姆-博兰登与施蓬海姆-内夫支系，分割于1277年经调解达成。此后亨利不顾他的先买权，把伯克尔海姆城堡卖给美因茨大主教，双方结仇；1279年，约翰在施普伦德林根的野战中战败。他葬于普法芬-施瓦本海姆的修道院教堂。

en: John II, called the Lame (c. 1270–1340), was a count of the Sponheim-Kreuznach line. From 1290 he ruled the front County of Sponheim jointly with his brother Simon II, and by 1300 they had divided it along the Soonwald forest, John keeping the southern part around Bad Kreuznach. He backed anti-king Frederick the Fair and feuded with Archbishop Baldwin of Trier, and after 1330 received town charters from Emperor Louis IV and bought or rebuilt castles including Koppenstein. He died on 11 March 1340 and was buried at Pfaffen-Schwabenheim, his lands passing to his nephew Walram.
zh: 约翰二世，绰号“跛子”（约1270—1340），是施蓬海姆家族克罗伊茨纳赫支系的伯爵。1290年起，他与兄长西蒙二世共同统治前施蓬海姆伯国；约1300年，兄弟二人以索恩瓦尔德为界瓜分伯国，约翰领有以巴特克罗伊茨纳赫为中心的南部。他支持对立国王美男子腓特烈，与特里尔大主教巴尔杜因·冯·卢森堡结仇交战。1330年后，他从皇帝路易四世手中取得城市特许状，又购入、重建了科彭施泰因等多座城堡。1340年3月11日他去世，葬于普法芬-施瓦本海姆，领地传给侄子瓦尔拉姆。

en: John (1312–1348) was a younger son of Count Simon II of Sponheim-Kreuznach and a brother of Count Walram, bearing the title count of Sponheim.
zh: 约翰（1312—1348）是施蓬海姆-克罗伊茨纳赫伯爵西蒙二世的幼子、伯爵瓦尔拉姆之弟，领有施蓬海姆伯爵头衔。

en: Simon II (c. 1270–1336) was a count of the Sponheim-Kreuznach line. After his father John I died in 1290, he ruled the front County of Sponheim with his brother John II; around 1300 they divided it, Simon taking the northern part around Kastellaun. He granted Kastellaun city rights in 1305 and built the Old Nahe Bridge at Kreuznach about 1300. His feud with Archbishop Baldwin of Trier dominated his later years: Baldwin captured Sprendlingen and besieged Kastellaun in 1320–1321. Simon died in 1336 and was buried in the church he built there, succeeded by his son Walram.
