zh: 西蒙二世（约1270—1336）是施蓬海姆家族克罗伊茨纳赫支系的伯爵。1290年父亲约翰一世去世后，他与弟弟约翰二世共同统治前施蓬海姆伯国；约1300年两人瓜分伯国，西蒙分得卡斯特劳恩一带的北部。他于1305年授予卡斯特劳恩城市权，约1300年在克罗伊茨纳赫修建了纳厄河老桥。他晚年与特里尔大主教巴尔杜因·冯·卢森堡连年结仇：1320至1321年，巴尔杜因攻占施普伦德林根并围攻卡斯特劳恩。1336年西蒙二世去世，葬于他在卡斯特劳恩所建的教堂，儿子瓦尔拉姆继位。

en: Simon III (born after 1330; died 30 August 1414) was the last ruling count of the Sponheim-Kreuznach line and, through marriage, count of Vianden. The only son of Count Walram, he married Maria of Vianden in 1348, bringing the county of Vianden to his house. In 1371 he was captured and held for years until a heavy ransom freed him. His son Walram died in 1382, and the male line of the Kreuznach counts ended with Simon's death. Simon died in 1414 and was buried in Kreuznach's parish church; his daughter Elisabeth married Count Engelbert III of the Mark.
zh: 西蒙三世（1330年后生，1414年8月30日卒）是施蓬海姆家族克罗伊茨纳赫支系的末代执政伯爵，并因婚姻得到菲安登伯爵头衔。作为伯爵瓦尔拉姆的独子，他于1348年娶菲安登的玛丽亚，菲安登城与伯国由此并入克罗伊茨纳赫支系。1371年他兵败被俘，囚禁数年，靠支付巨额赎金才获释。其子瓦尔拉姆1382年早逝，克罗伊茨纳赫支系男嗣在西蒙去世后断绝。1414年西蒙三世去世，葬于克罗伊茨纳赫城区教堂的唱诗班席；女儿伊丽莎白嫁给马克伯爵恩格尔贝特三世。

en: Walram (c. 1305–1380) was a count of the Sponheim-Kreuznach line, the eldest son of Simon II. On 9 August 1330 he married Elisabeth of Katzenelnbogen. He first succeeded his father in the northern half of the divided front county, and when his uncle John II died without legitimate issue in 1340, Walram reunited the whole County of Sponheim-Kreuznach, choosing Kreuznach and its Kauzenburg Castle as his residence. His rule was marked by numerous feuds with neighbouring lords. He died early in 1380 and was buried beside his forebears at Pfaffen-Schwabenheim, succeeded by his only son, Simon III.
zh: 瓦尔拉姆（约1305—1380）是施蓬海姆家族克罗伊茨纳赫支系的伯爵，西蒙二世的长子。1330年8月9日，他娶卡岑埃尔恩博根的伊丽莎白为妻。他最初继承父亲分得的前伯国北半部；1340年叔父约翰二世无嫡子而终，瓦尔拉姆重新统一整个施蓬海姆-克罗伊茨纳赫伯国，并以克罗伊茨纳赫及城中的考岑堡为居所。他在位期间与周边领主纷争不断。1380年初他去世，安葬在普法芬-施瓦本海姆的祖先墓旁，独子西蒙三世继位。

en: Gerhard von Ehrenberg (d. 1363), born into a Kraichgau knightly family, served in Emperor Louis IV's chancellery before being elected bishop of Speyer in 1336 with imperial backing. Louis granted his see privileges in 1338, and Gerhard supported him militarily, switching to Charles IV only after Louis died. He rebuilt Speyer's burned Augustinian monastery, furnished the cathedral sacristy and freed the bishopric from debt, although he could not prevent the Jewish pogroms of 1349. He died in 1363 and was buried in Speyer Cathedral.
zh: 格哈德·冯·埃伦贝格（？—1363）出身克莱希高的骑士家族，曾在皇帝路易四世的官厅任职，1336年在皇帝支持下当选施派尔主教。1338年路易向其主教区颁赐特权，格哈德则以军事支持回报，直到路易去世后才转而效忠查理四世。他重建了被焚毁的施派尔奥古斯丁修道院，为施派尔主教座堂添置圣器室陈设，并清偿了主教区的债务，但未能阻止1349年的屠犹骚乱。他于1363年去世，葬于施派尔主教座堂。

en: Abd al-Razzaq ibn Fazlallah was a landowner of Bashtin near Sabzavar in Khurasan who founded the Sarbadar state. Oppressed by the taxation of Ala al-Din Muhammad, governor under the Ilkhanid claimant Togha Temur, he killed a government official in 1337 and raised a revolt in the mountains. His followers defeated the forces sent against them, raided caravans and seized Sabzavar in the summer of 1337. He ruled with the title of amir and struck coins in his own name, but in 1338 he was stabbed to death by his brother Wajih al-Din Masud, who succeeded him.
zh: 阿卜杜勒-拉扎克·伊本·法兹卢拉是呼罗珊萨卜泽瓦尔附近巴什廷的地主，也是萨尔毕道朗政权的建立者。伊利汗国位的争夺者脱合帖木儿派总督阿拉丁·穆罕默德横征暴敛，他于1337年杀死一名税官，在山中举兵起事。部众击败前来围剿的军队、劫掠商队，于1337年夏攻占萨卜泽瓦尔。他以埃米尔之号统治，并用自己的名字铸币；1338年，他在一场争执中被兄弟瓦吉赫丁·马斯乌德刺死，马斯乌德随即接管了萨尔毕道朗。

en: Atmaz Han was a son of Sarukhan Bey, founder of the Saruhanid principality at Manisa.
zh: 阿特马兹·汗是马尼萨萨鲁汗侯国开国君主萨鲁汗贝伊之子。

en: Devlet Han was a son of Sarukhan Bey, founder of the Saruhanid principality at Manisa. His son Yaqub Bey held Demirci, where a mosque was built in Yaqub's name in 1407–1408.
zh: 德夫莱特·汗是马尼萨萨鲁汗侯国开国君主萨鲁汗贝伊之子。他的儿子雅各布贝伊据有德米尔吉，1407—1408年当地有一座以雅各布名义修建的清真寺。

en: Idris Bey was a son of Sarukhan Bey, founder of the Saruhanid principality centered on Manisa.
zh: 伊德里斯贝伊是萨鲁汗贝伊之子，其父建立了以马尼萨为中心的萨鲁汗侯国。

en: Fakhr al-Din Ilyas Bey (d. 1362) succeeded his father Sarukhan as the second ruler of the Saruhanid beylik in 1345, ruling from Manisa. He stayed on good terms with the neighboring beyliks and with the Genoese-held port of Phocaea. In 1358, during the Byzantine siege of Phocaea over the kidnapped Ottoman prince Halil, Ilyas pretended to aid the emperor while plotting to seize him at a hunt; the emperor arrested him instead, and his wife paid a ransom to free him. He died in 1362 and was succeeded by his son Ishak, governor of Menemen.
zh: 法赫尔丁·伊利亚斯贝伊（？—1362）于1345年继承父亲萨鲁汗贝伊之位，是萨鲁汗侯国第二代贝伊，以马尼萨为都。他与邻近的诸贝伊国以及热那亚人占据的福西亚港大体保持友好。1358年，拜占庭为解救被俘的奥斯曼王子哈利勒而围攻福西亚，伊利亚斯佯装出兵相助皇帝，却密谋在一次狩猎中将其拘捕；结果反被皇帝拿下，最后由他的妻子支付赎金才得获释。他于1362年去世，时任梅内门长官的儿子伊沙克继位。

en: İshak Bey, honorifically Muzafferüddin İshak, was the third ruler of the Saruhanid beylik at Manisa. The son of Fahrüddin İlyas Bey, he succeeded his father after 1362 and reigned until his death in 1388. In 1366 he ordered the building of Manisa's Great Mosque by the architect Emet bin Osman, to which a madrasa was added beside it in 1378. On his death his son Hızır Şah took the throne, while his other son Orhan took refuge with the Ottomans.
zh: 伊沙克贝伊，尊号穆扎费鲁丁·伊沙克，是定都马尼萨的萨鲁汗贝伊国第三位统治者。他是法赫鲁丁·伊利亚斯贝伊之子，1362年之后继位，统治到1388年去世。1366年，他下令由建筑师埃梅特·本·奥斯曼修建马尼萨大清真寺，1378年寺旁又增建一所伊斯兰学校。他死后儿子赫泽尔沙继位，另一个儿子奥尔汉则投奔奥斯曼人。

en: Orhan was a son of Sarukhan Bey, founder of the Saruhanid principality at Manisa, and a brother of Suleyman and Ilyas.
zh: 奥尔汗是马尼萨萨鲁汗侯国开国君主萨鲁汗贝伊之子，苏莱曼与伊利亚斯的兄弟。

en: Sarukhan Bey (c. 1300–1346) was the Turkmen founder of the Saruhanid principality centered on Manisa in western Anatolia. A former emir under the Seljuk sultans, he campaigned against Byzantine lands and in 1313 seized Thyatira, modern Akhisar, and then Manisa, building an independent realm that passed to his descendants. In 1336 he allied with Emperor Andronikos III Palaiologos and supported him at the Genoese-held sieges of Mytilene and Phocaea, but in 1341 his fleet was repulsed near Gallipoli while raiding toward Constantinople. He died in 1345 or 1346, soon after his eldest son Suleyman died of illness in 1345.
zh: 萨鲁汗贝伊（约1300—1345/1346）是土库曼出身的萨鲁汗侯国开国君主，立国于西安纳托利亚的马尼萨。他原在塞尔柱苏丹麾下任埃米尔，后进攻拜占庭领土，于1313年攻占推雅推喇（今阿克希萨尔），随后又取马尼萨，建立起独立政权并传给子孙。1336年他与拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡三世·巴列奥略结盟，出兵协助围攻热那亚人占据的米蒂利尼和福西亚；1341年他派舰队奔袭君士坦丁堡，却在加里波利附近被击退。1345年长子苏莱曼病逝后，他也在1345或1346年离世。

en: Suleyman Bey was the eldest son of Sarukhan Bey, founder of the Saruhanid principality at Manisa. In 1345 he answered the call of the Byzantine emperor John VI Kantakouzenos and, together with the Aydinid ruler Umur Bey, crossed into Thrace on the emperor's side. He fought in the campaign that crushed the independent Bulgarian warlord Momchil near Didymoteicho in June 1345. Soon after that battle Suleyman fell ill and died; his father died the next year, grief-stricken at his loss.
zh: 苏莱曼贝伊是马尼萨萨鲁汗侯国开国君主萨鲁汗贝伊的长子。1345年，他应拜占庭皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯之召，与艾登侯国君主乌穆尔贝伊一同渡海进入色雷斯，为皇帝作战。1345年6月，他参加了在季季莫蒂霍附近剿灭割据军阀莫姆奇尔的战役，战后不久便染病身亡；他的父亲因丧子之痛，也在次年离世。

en: Temir Han, also written Timur Han, was a son of Sarukhan Bey, founder of the Saruhanid principality at Manisa. He and his brother Suleyman both died before their father, who was succeeded in 1346 by another son, Ilyas.
zh: 帖木儿汗（一译铁木尔汗）是马尼萨萨鲁汗侯国开国君主萨鲁汗贝伊之子。他与兄弟苏莱曼都先于父亲去世，1346年由萨鲁汗的另一个儿子伊利亚斯继位。

en: Hushang (r. 1372–1382) was the last Shirvanshah of the Kasranid line, succeeding his father Kavus, under whom Shirvan had become a Jalayirid vassal. Raised a hostage at the court of the Jalayirid sultan Shaykh Uways, he was released when his father died. He kept minting coins in the names of his Jalayirid overlords and avoided battle when Shah Mansur invaded Shirvan in 1375 during Shah Shoja Mozaffari's Azerbaijani campaign. The poet Arif Ardabili dedicated his masnavi Farhad and Shirin to him. In 1382 Hushang was killed by his subjects; his cousin Ibrahim I succeeded him, opening the Darbandi line.
zh: 胡尚（1372—1382年在位）是科斯兰支系的末代希尔万沙，继父亲卡夫斯而立；在卡夫斯治下，希尔凡已沦为札剌亦儿王朝的属国。胡尚自幼在札剌亦儿苏丹谢赫·乌韦斯的宫廷中当人质，父亲去世后才获释。他继续以札剌亦儿宗主的名义铸币；1375年沙·舒贾·穆扎法尔远征阿塞拜疆、沙·曼苏尔奉命进攻希尔凡时，他避不决战。诗人阿里夫·阿尔达比勒把自己的玛斯纳维叙事诗《法尔哈德与希琳》献给他。1382年胡尚被臣民所杀，堂弟易卜拉欣一世继位，开启了德尔本特支系。

en: Kavus I was the 32nd Shirvanshah, ruling first alongside his father Kayqubad I and alone from about 1348. He defied the Chobanid Malek Ashraf and in 1347 took shelter in Shirvan's castles; he then invited the Golden Horde khan Jani Beg, who captured Tabriz and killed Malek Ashraf. He fought Akhi Juq at Mughan in 1357 and twice occupied Tabriz, but after the Jalayirid Shaykh Uways besieged Shamakhi he accepted vassalage and left his son Hushang a hostage until 1372. A patron of poets, Kavus died in 1372.
zh: 卡夫斯一世是第32代希尔万沙，先与父亲凯库巴德一世共治，约1348年起独掌大权。他抗拒楚邦的马立克·阿什拉夫，1347年退入希尔凡的城堡；随后请来金帐汗札尼别，札尼别攻占大不里士并杀死马立克·阿什拉夫。1357年他在木干与阿希·朱克交战，又两度占领大不里士；但札剌亦儿的谢赫·乌韦斯围攻沙马基后，他被迫称臣，把儿子胡尚留作人质直到1372年。卡夫斯礼遇诗人，于1372年去世。

en: Kayqubad I was the 31st Shirvanshah, a son of Farrukhzad II, whose long reign was spent under Chobanid overlordship and may have begun as early as 1317. When the Chobanid ruler Malek Ashraf demanded a daughter of the Shirvanshah in marriage, Kayqubad's son and co-ruler Kavus refused. After Malek Ashraf invaded in the winter of 1347, father and son took shelter in Shirvan's strong castles. Kayqubad disappears from the sources soon afterwards and probably died between 1348 and 1356. The Keygubad Mosque is held to have been built on his order.
zh: 凯库巴德一世是第31代希尔万沙，法鲁赫扎德二世之子，在位时间很长，长期处于楚邦王朝的宗主权之下，可能早在1317年即已即位。楚邦统治者马立克·阿什拉夫求娶希尔万沙的女儿，凯库巴德之子、共治者卡夫斯予以拒绝。1347年冬马立克·阿什拉夫入侵，父子退入希尔凡设防坚固的城堡。此后凯库巴德不再见于记载，可能在1348至1356年间去世。凯库巴德清真寺被认为是他下令修建的。

en: Cho Ton (趙暾, 1307–1380) was a Goryeo civil official born at Yongjin, a son of Cho Yanggi, the second Ssangsŏng commandant, younger brother of Cho Rim and uncle of the fourth commandant, Cho Sosaeng. He had submitted to Goryeo under King Ch'ungsuk and won the king's favor. When Goryeo retook Ssangsŏng in 1356, his nephew detained him, but Ton escaped, joined Yu In-u, and with Yi Cha-ch'un opened the gates to the Goryeo army. In 1359 his mission to coax Sosaeng into surrender failed, and he later escorted King Kongmin to Andong during the Red Turban invasion.
zh: 赵暾（1307—1380）是高丽后期文臣，龙津人，汉阳赵氏出身，第二代双城总管赵良琪之子，第三代总管赵琳之弟、第四代总管赵小生的叔父。忠肃王时他归附高丽，深得忠肃王宠爱。1356年高丽收复双城时，侄子赵小生将他拘押，赵暾逃脱后投奔柳仁雨，并与李子春等从内部打开城门，引高丽军入城。1359年他招抚赵小生失败，红巾军入侵时又护送避难安东的恭愍王。

en: Cho Hwi (died 1273), a local strongman of Yongjin-hyŏn on Goryeo's northeastern frontier, rebelled against Goryeo in 1258 when the Mongols invaded the Hwaju region. With T'ak Ch'ŏng he killed the frontier military commissioner Sin Chipp'yŏng, surrendered the lands north of Hwaju, and in January 1259 was made General Superintendent of the new Mongol Ssangsŏng Prefecture. He led Mongol attacks on Goryeo forts until his death, when his son Cho Yanggi succeeded him; his heirs held Ssangsŏng until Goryeo retook it in 1356.
zh: 赵晖（？—1273）是高丽东北边境龙津县的土著豪强。1258年蒙古军侵袭和州地区时，他与卓青一同起兵叛离高丽，杀害东北面兵马使慎执平等官员，献出和州以北土地，1259年正月被蒙古任命为新设双城总管府的总管。此后他屡次引导蒙古军攻打高丽城堡，死后由其子赵良琪袭职；赵氏子孙割据双城近百年，直到1356年被高丽收复。

en: Cho Inbyŏk (1330–1393) was a military commander of the late Goryeo dynasty from the Hanyang Cho clan, whose forebears had governed Ssangseong for the Yuan. In 1356 he and his father Cho Ton helped Goryeo retake the Ssangseong General Government Office. He fought the Red Turban invaders in 1361 and helped crush Kim Yong's rebellion in 1363. In 1372 he defeated raiders under Hobaldo at Kaju and ambushed Japanese pirates near Hamju, beheading at least seventy men. Married to a sister of Yi Sŏng-gye, he became Internal Prince Yongwŏn after the Joseon founding in 1392.
zh: 赵仁壁（1330—1393）是高丽末期武臣，本贯汉阳，其先辈世袭元朝双城总管府总管。1356年，他与父亲赵暾协助高丽收复双城总管府。1361年红巾军入侵时他从军作战，1363年又参与平定金镛之乱。1372年，他在家州击败胡拔都所部，又在咸州一带伏击倭寇，斩首至少七十级。他娶朝鲜开国君主李成桂之妹贞和公主为妻，1392年朝鲜开国后受封龙原府院君。

en: Cho Rim (趙琳) was the third hereditary commandant of the Yuan dynasty's Ssangsŏng Prefecture in the former Goryeo northeast. He was the eldest son of the second commandant Cho Yanggi, elder brother of Cho Ton, and father of the fourth commandant, Cho Sosaeng.
zh: 赵琳是元朝双城总管府的第三代世袭总管，该府设于原高丽东北面。他是第二代总管赵良琪的长子、赵暾之兄、第四代总管赵小生之父。

en: Cho Sosaeng (趙小生, died 1362) was the fourth hereditary commandant of the Yuan Ssangsŏng Prefecture at Hwaju, succeeding his father Cho Rim. When Goryeo sent Yu In-u against Ssangsŏng in 1356, Sosaeng detained his uncle Cho Ton, suspecting collusion, and resisted with the chiliarch Tak To-gyŏng. After Ton escaped and the townspeople surrendered, he fled to the Jurchen lands. Ton's 1359 pardon mission failed, and in 1362 he brought in the Yuan general Naghachu; Yi Sŏng-gye routed them at Taltan-dong near Hongwŏn, and later that year the Jurchen darughachi and commandant killed Sosaeng and Tak To-gyŏng.
zh: 赵小生（？—1362）是元朝双城总管府第四代世袭总管，驻于和州，袭其父赵琳之职。1356年高丽派柳仁雨攻打双城，赵小生疑心叔父赵暾暗通高丽，将他拘押，与千户卓都卿合力抵抗。赵暾逃脱、城中百姓归降后，他逃往女真之地。1359年赵暾前来招抚失败，1362年他引来元将纳哈出入侵，李成桂在洪原附近的达旦洞将其击溃；同年，女真的达鲁花赤与总管将赵小生和卓都卿杀害。

en: Cho Yanggi (1260–?) succeeded his father Cho Hwi as the second General Superintendent of Ssangsŏng Prefecture, the Mongol-ruled border administration carved from northeastern Goryeo. In 1281 he sailed as a deputy commander under Kim Panggyŏng in the Yuan invasion of Japan, and the entire army returned safely; he then campaigned against the Hamdan people and sent his captives to the Yuan court at the age of twenty-one. His daughter became the later wife of Yi Ch'un, grandfather of Yi Sŏnggye, founder of Joseon. His elder son Cho Rim inherited Ssangsŏng, while his second son, Cho Ton, sided with Goryeo when it retook the prefecture in 1356.
zh: 赵良琪（1260—？）承袭父亲赵晖之职，出任双城总管府第二任总管。双城总管府是蒙古从高丽东北疆土划出的边境统治机构。1281年元朝征伐日本，他以副将身份随金方庆出征，全军平安返回；回师后又讨伐含旦部，将俘虏解送元朝，时年二十一岁。其女赵氏嫁给朝鲜太祖李成桂的祖父李椿（后被追尊为度祖）为继室。长子赵琳承袭总管之职，次子赵暾则在1356年高丽收复双城时归附高丽。

en: Barnim III (c. 1300–1368) was a Griffin duke of Pomerania-Stettin. He became his father Otto I's co-regent in 1320 and fought the Margraviate of Brandenburg, beating its forces near Prenzlau in 1329 and making peace at Lippehne in 1333. Emperor Louis IV recognized Pomerania-Stettin's imperial immediacy in 1338 and Charles IV confirmed it in 1348, when Barnim conquered the eastern Uckermark while backing the False Waldemar. In 1351 he defeated the Mecklenburgers at Schoppendamm near Loitz; he was also the first Griffin to style himself Duke of the Kashubians. He ruled alone from 1344 until 1368.
zh: 巴尔尼姆三世（约1300—1368），绰号“大帝”，是格里芬家族的波美拉尼亚-斯德丁公爵。他1320年成为父亲奥东一世的共治者，在波美拉尼亚-勃兰登堡战争中于1329年在普伦茨劳附近击败勃兰登堡军，1333年缔结利珀内地方和约。1338年皇帝路易四世承认波美拉尼亚-斯德丁直属帝国，1348年卡尔四世又亲自予以确认；同年他借支持假瓦尔德马之机攻占东乌克马克。1351年他在洛伊茨附近的朔彭达姆击败梅克伦堡军队，也是首位自称卡舒比亚人公爵的格里芬家族成员。他1344年起单独执政，直至1368年去世。

en: Elisabeth of Schwerin (died 1318 or 1319), a daughter of Count Niklot I of Schwerin, was the second wife of Otto I, Duke of Pomerania-Stettin, and the mother of his successor Barnim III. She was buried at Stettin.
zh: 什未林的伊丽莎白（1318或1319年卒）是什未林伯爵尼克洛特一世之女，波美拉尼亚-斯德丁公爵奥东一世的第二任妻子，生有继位者巴尔宁三世，葬于斯德丁。

en: Otto I (1279–1344) was the youngest, posthumous son of Duke Barnim I of Pomerania. His half-brother Bogislaw IV ruled during his minority; after their brother Barnim II died, the Treaty of Stettin in 1295 split the duchy, leaving Otto with Pomerania-Stettin and Bogislaw with Pomerania-Wolgast. Otto drew close to Brandenburg, buying the Bernstein land from Margrave Waldemar in 1315 and occupying much of the Uckermark during the Brandenburg succession crisis after 1319. From 1320 he ruled with his son Barnim III, and in 1338 Emperor Louis IV recognized Pomerania-Stettin's imperial immediacy at Frankfurt. He died in December 1344.
zh: 奥东一世（1279—1344）是波美拉尼亚公爵巴尔尼姆一世最小的遗腹子。他幼年时由异母兄博吉斯瓦夫四世独掌政权；兄弟巴尔尼姆二世死后，1295年的《斯德丁条约》将公国一分为二，奥东分得波美拉尼亚-斯德丁，博吉斯瓦夫分得波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特。奥东起初亲近勃兰登堡，1315年从藩侯瓦尔德马手中购得贝恩施泰因领地，并在1319年后的勃兰登堡继承危机中占据乌克马克大部。1320年起他与儿子巴尔尼姆三世共治，1338年皇帝路易四世在法兰克福帝国会议上承认波美拉尼亚-斯德丁直属帝国。他于1344年12月去世。

en: Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah, a soldier of Sistani origin, served the Delhi Sultanate and became governor of Satgaon in southern Bengal. After 1338 he ruled Satgaon independently, then took Lakhnauti in 1342 and Sonargaon in 1352, unifying Bengal into an independent sultanate with its capital at Pandua. His armies raided Nepal in 1346 and sacked Kathmandu, then invaded Orissa and Kamarupa and took Guwahati. When Firuz Shah Tughluq invaded in 1353, he withstood a siege at Ekdala and recovered his realm. He died in January 1358 and was buried at Hajipur, founding the Ilyas Shahi dynasty.
zh: 沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯·沙阿出身锡斯坦，在德里苏丹国军中崛起，后被任命为南孟加拉萨特冈的总督。1338年后他在萨特冈自立，随后于1342年攻取拉克瑙提、1352年攻占索纳尔冈，将孟加拉三地统一为独立的苏丹国，定都潘杜阿。1346年他率军攻入尼泊尔，劫掠加德满都，又入侵奥里萨与迦摩缕波，夺取古瓦哈提。1353年菲鲁兹沙·图格卢克来攻，他在埃克达拉坚守拒围，最终收复全境。1358年1月他去世，葬于哈吉普尔，开创了伊利亚斯·沙希王朝。

en: Alonso Meléndez de Guzmán (c. 1300–1342) was a Leonese noble, son of Pedro Núñez de Guzmán and Juana Ponce de León and brother of Eleanor of Guzmán, Alfonso XI's mistress. Knighted in the Order of the Banda at the king's coronation in 1332, he was imposed as master of the Order of Santiago in August 1338 by Alfonso XI's intervention, setting aside the order's election to hold the post for his infant nephew Fadrique Alfonso. He relieved Siles in 1339, fought at Río Salado in 1340 and was entrusted with the defence of the frontier in 1341. He died of illness during the siege of Algeciras on 14 September 1342.
zh: 阿隆索·梅伦德斯·德·古斯曼（约1300—1342）是莱昂贵族，佩德罗·努涅斯·德·古斯曼与胡安娜·庞塞·德·莱昂之子，阿方索十一世情妇埃莉诺·德·古斯曼的兄长。1332年国王加冕时他被授为绶带骑士团骑士；1338年8月，阿方索十一世亲自干预，推翻骑士团自己的选举结果，将他安插为圣地亚哥骑士团团长，替年幼的外甥法德里克·阿方索占位。1339年他解锡莱斯之围，1340年参加里奥萨拉多战役，1341年受命负责边防。1342年9月14日，他在阿尔赫西拉斯围城战期间病逝。

en: María de la Cerda (1305–before 1355), lady of Villafranca de Valcárcel, was a daughter of Alfonso de la Cerda, called the Disinherited, and married Alfonso Meléndez de Guzmán, grand master of the Order of Santiago.
zh: 玛丽亚·德·拉·塞尔达（1305—1355年前）是比利亚弗兰卡·德·巴尔卡塞尔女领主，为“被剥夺继承权者”阿方索·德·拉·塞尔达之女，嫁与圣地亚哥骑士团大团长阿方索·梅伦德斯·德·古斯曼。

en: Agnes II of Donzy (c. 1205–1225) was the daughter of Hervé IV, Baron of Donzy, and Mahaut de Courtenay, heiress to the counties of Nevers, Auxerre and Tonnerre. In 1217 she was married to Philip, eldest son of the future Louis VIII, who died the next year. In 1221 she married Guy II of Châtillon, Count of Saint-Pol, and after her father's death in 1222 her mother associated her with the rule of Nevers, Auxerre and Tonnerre. Her children by Guy were Gaucher and Yolande, and she died in 1225.
zh: 阿格内丝·德·栋济（约1205—1225）是栋济男爵埃尔韦四世与库尔特奈的玛蒂尔达之女，玛蒂尔达是讷韦尔、欧塞尔、托内尔三伯国的女继承人。1217年，她嫁给未来的法王路易八世的长子菲利普，男童次年夭折。1221年她改嫁圣波勒伯爵居伊二世·德·沙蒂永；1222年父亲去世后，母亲让她共同管理讷韦尔、欧塞尔和托内尔。她与居伊生有戈谢和约兰德，于1225年早逝。

en: Walter III of Châtillon (in French Gaucher III) was the second son of Guy II of Châtillon and Alix of Dreux. He joined the Third Crusade in 1189, fought at Acre, Arsuf and Jaffa, and in 1191 succeeded his brother as lord of Châtillon. In 1196 he married Elisabeth, heiress of Saint-Pol, becoming count in 1205. He served Philip Augustus in Normandy, on the Albigensian Crusade and at the Battle of Bouvines in 1214, where his charges through the enemy line were celebrated by the chronicler William the Breton. He died at the siege of Toulouse in November 1219.
zh: 沙蒂永的沃尔特三世（法语作戈谢三世）是沙蒂永的居伊二世与德勒的阿莉克斯的第二子。1189年他参加第三次十字军东征，转战阿卡、阿尔苏夫和雅法，1191年继其兄成为沙蒂永领主。1196年他迎娶圣波勒的女继承人伊丽莎白，于1205年成为圣波勒伯爵。他曾在诺曼底、阿尔比十字军和1214年布汶战役中为法王腓力·奥古斯特效力，在布汶反复冲透敌阵的事迹被编年史家布列塔尼的威廉传颂。1219年11月，他死于图卢兹围城战。

en: Guy IV of Châtillon, known as Guy II of Saint-Pol (c. 1197–1226), was the eldest son of Walter III of Châtillon and Elizabeth, heiress of Saint-Pol. He inherited the county on his father's death in 1219, though his mother held power until 1223. In 1221 he married Agnes II, Countess of Nevers, with a papal dispensation for their kinship; she died in 1225, leaving Yolande and Walter. In 1226 he joined Louis VIII's Albigensian Crusade and on 8 August led the main assault on Avignon, where a stone from the walls killed him. The county reverted to his mother.
zh: 沙蒂永的居伊四世，称圣波勒的居伊二世（约1197—1226），是沙蒂永的沃尔特三世与圣波勒女继承人伊丽莎白的长子。1219年父亲死后他继承伯国，但实权直到1223年才由母亲交出。1221年，他在获得教皇对血亲婚姻的特许后，娶讷韦尔女伯爵阿涅丝二世为妻；阿涅丝于1225年去世，留下约兰德和沃尔特两个孩子。1226年他随路易八世参加阿尔比十字军，8月8日率军主攻阿维尼翁，被城上投下的石块击中身亡，圣波勒伯国随后重归其母。

en: Guy III of Châtillon, Count of Saint-Pol (born after 1226, died 12 March 1289), was the second son of Count Hugh I of Blois and Marie of Avesnes. He received Saint-Pol in 1248, while his elder brother John took Blois. In 1255 he married Matilda of Brabant, and governed Artois as regent until 1265, when his stepson Robert II of Artois came of age. He joined Louis IX on the Eighth Crusade in 1270 and Philip III's Aragón Crusade in 1284–1285. At Worringen in 1288 he fought beside his nephew John I of Brabant and captured the Count of Guelders and the archbishop of Cologne. He was buried at Cercamp Abbey.
zh: 沙蒂永的居伊三世，圣波勒伯爵（1226年后生，1289年3月12日卒），是布卢瓦伯爵于格一世与阿韦纳的玛丽的次子。1248年父亲去世后，他领有圣波勒，兄长约翰则继承布卢瓦。1255年他迎娶布拉班特的玛蒂尔德，此后以摄政身份治理阿图瓦至1265年继子阿图瓦的罗贝尔二世成年。1270年他随路易九世参加第八次十字军东征，1284—1285年又随腓力三世进行阿拉贡十字军。1288年在沃林根，他与外甥布拉班特公爵约翰一世并肩作战，俘获海尔德伯爵和科隆大主教，死后葬于塞尔康修道院。

en: Guy IV of Châtillon-Saint-Pol (born after 1254, died 6 April 1317), second son of Count Guy III and Matilda of Brabant, received the County of Saint-Pol from his brother Hugh II in 1292. His half-brother was Robert II, Count of Artois, and Charles of Valois was his son-in-law. Philip the Fair made him grand butler of France in 1296, and as governor of Flanders he commanded the rearguard at Courtrai in 1302. At Mons-en-Pévèle in 1304 he shared in the victory and was credited with saving the king's life; both Philip IV and Louis X made him a testamentary executor. He married Marie of Brittany in 1292 and was buried at Cercamp Abbey in 1317.
zh: 居伊·德·沙蒂永-圣波勒（1254年后生，1317年4月6日卒）是圣波勒伯爵居伊三世与布拉班特的玛奥的次子，1292年从兄长于格二世手中受封圣波勒伯国。他与阿图瓦伯爵罗贝尔二世是同母异父兄弟，瓦卢瓦的查理则是他的女婿。1296年，美男子腓力任命他为法兰西大司酒；任佛兰德总督期间，他在1302年惨败的科特赖克战役中指挥后军。1304年蒙斯昂佩韦勒之战中，他被认为促成胜利并救了腓力四世一命，后来更受腓力四世和路易十世双双指定为遗嘱执行人。他1292年娶布列塔尼的玛丽为妻，1317年去世，葬于塞尔康修道院。

en: Guy V of Châtillon, Count of Saint-Pol from 1344 to 1360, was the son of John of Saint-Pol and Jeanne de Fiennes. He married Jeanne of Luxembourg, lady of Pernes. A commander in the Hundred Years' War, he served as royal lieutenant against the English in Picardy and fought at Crécy in 1346 beside his uncle Robert de Fiennes, called Moreau. In 1358 he helped suppress the Jacquerie and campaigned against the partisans of Charles the Bad of Navarre, taking part in the eight-month siege that recovered Saint-Valery from the Navarrese. King John II had been held in London for four years; the Treaty of Brétigny in 1360 ended his captivity, but hostages guaranteed his ransom. Guy was one of them, with his brother-in-law Guy of Luxembourg and his nephew Waleran III of Luxembourg, and by one account he died of plague soon after reaching London. He left no children, so his sister Mathilde inherited Saint-Pol.
zh: 沙蒂永的居伊五世于1344至1360年任圣波勒伯爵，是圣波勒伯爵让与让娜·德·菲耶讷之子。他娶佩尔讷女领主卢森堡的让娜为妻。作为百年战争中的将领，他以王室代理官的身份在皮卡第同英军作战，1346年与舅父罗贝尔·德·菲耶讷（人称莫罗）一同参加克雷西战役。1358年，他参与镇压扎克雷起义，并同纳瓦拉国王恶人查理的党羽作战，参加了历时八个月的圣瓦勒里围城战，从纳瓦拉人手中收复该城。国王约翰二世已在伦敦被囚四年；1360年《布雷蒂尼条约》结束了他的囚禁，但须交出人质担保赎金。居伊便是人质之一，同去的有妹夫居伊·德·卢森堡和外甥瓦勒朗三世·德·卢森堡；据一种记载，他抵达伦敦不久便死于瘟疫。他没有子嗣，圣波勒伯国由其妹玛蒂尔德继承。

en: John of Châtillon, Count of Saint-Pol (died 1344), was the eldest son of Guy IV of Châtillon and Marie of Brittany, and held the county from 1317. He was a first cousin of Duke John III of Brittany and Queen Joan I of Navarre. In December 1329 he married Jeanne de Fiennes, daughter of John, baron of Fiennes, and Isabelle de Dampierre; her brother Robert de Fiennes later became constable of France. John served Philip VI of Valois in the king's campaigns against Edward III of England at the outset of the Hundred Years' War, the war in which his son Guy V would fight beside that uncle at Crécy. When John died the county passed to Guy V, and after Guy's death without children it went, through John's daughter Mathilde and her husband Guy of Luxembourg, Count of Ligny, to the Luxembourg-Ligny family.
zh: 沙蒂永的让是圣波勒伯爵（1344年卒），为沙蒂永的居伊四世与布列塔尼的玛丽的长子，自1317年起领有伯国。他与布列塔尼公爵让三世及纳瓦拉女王胡安娜一世是表亲。1329年12月，他迎娶菲耶讷男爵让与伊莎贝尔·德·当皮埃尔之女让娜·德·菲耶讷；她的兄弟罗贝尔·德·菲耶讷后来出任法兰西王室统帅。百年战争爆发之初，他随瓦卢瓦的腓力六世出征，与英格兰国王爱德华三世作战；日后，他的儿子居伊五世将同这位舅父一起在克雷西作战。让去世后，伯国传给居伊五世；居伊无嗣而终，伯国又经让的女儿玛蒂尔德及其丈夫利尼伯爵居伊·德·卢森堡，转入卢森堡—利尼家族。

en: Jeanne de Fiennes (1307–1353), daughter of John I of Fiennes and Isabelle of Flanders, married John of Châtillon, Count of Saint-Pol, in 1319. Her children were Guy V of Saint-Pol and Mahaut, wife of the Count of Ligny; she later married Jean de Landas.
zh: 让娜·德·菲耶讷（1307—1353）是让一世·德·菲耶讷与佛兰德斯的伊莎贝拉之女，1319年嫁给圣波勒伯爵让·德·沙蒂永。她的子女是圣波勒的居伊五世和嫁给利尼伯爵的玛奥，后来她改嫁让·德·朗达斯。

en: Mahaut de Châtillon (1335–1378), daughter of John, Count of Saint-Pol, and Jeanne de Fiennes, married Guy of Luxembourg, Count of Ligny, in 1354 and inherited Saint-Pol on her brother Guy V's death in 1360.
zh: 玛奥·德·沙蒂永（1335—1378）是圣波勒伯爵让与让娜·德·菲耶讷之女，1354年嫁给利尼伯爵居伊·德·卢森堡，1360年其兄居伊五世死后继承圣波勒伯国。

en: Marie de St Pol, Countess of Pembroke (c. 1303–1377), was a daughter of Guy IV of Châtillon, Count of Saint-Pol, and Marie of Brittany, and a great-granddaughter of Henry III. In 1321 she married in Paris Aymer de Valence, Earl of Pembroke, and was widowed in June 1324; the marriage was childless. With her wealth she founded Pembroke College, Cambridge. Edward III exempted her from the 1337 seizure of alien lands, but Charles V confiscated her French estates in 1372. She died in March 1377 and was buried at Denny Abbey in the habit of a Franciscan nun.
zh: 玛丽·德·圣波勒，彭布罗克伯爵夫人（约1303—1377），是圣波勒伯爵居伊四世·德·沙蒂永与布列塔尼的玛丽之女，按母系为英格兰国王亨利三世的曾外孙女。1321年她在巴黎嫁给彭布罗克伯爵艾默·德·瓦朗斯，1324年6月丧夫，两人没有子女。她以财富创办了剑桥大学彭布罗克学院。爱德华三世在1337年没收外邦人地产时将她豁免，但1372年查理五世没收了她在法兰西的领地。她于1377年3月去世，葬于丹尼修道院，下葬时身着方济各会修女的会服。

en: Marie of Brittany (1268–1339), also called Marie de Dreux, was the daughter of John II, Duke of Brittany, and Beatrice of England, and a granddaughter of King Henry III. In 1292 she married Guy IV of Châtillon, Count of Saint-Pol. Her son John succeeded as Count of Saint-Pol; her daughter Mahaut married Charles of Valois; and another daughter, Marie, Countess of Pembroke, founded Pembroke College, Cambridge. Marie died in May 1339.
zh: 布列塔尼的玛丽（1268—1339），又称德勒的玛丽，是布列塔尼公爵让二世与英格兰的比阿特丽斯之女、英格兰国王亨利三世的外孙女。1292年她嫁给圣波勒伯爵居伊四世·德·沙蒂永。儿子让后来袭封圣波勒伯爵；女儿玛奥嫁给瓦卢瓦的查理；另一个女儿玛丽成为彭布罗克伯爵夫人，创办了剑桥大学彭布罗克学院。她于1339年5月去世。

en: Winrich de Pomerio was prince-abbot of the Imperial Abbey of Stavelot-Malmedy in the Ardennes from 1334 to 1343.
zh: 温里希·德·波梅里奥于1334至1343年担任阿登地区的帝国修道院斯塔沃洛-马尔梅迪的亲王院长。

en: Agnes von Hardegg (died 27 May 1371) was the daughter of Burchard I of Hardegg, Burgrave of Magdeburg. In 1347 she married Albert, Duke of Strzelce in Silesia, and bore him a daughter, Elisabeth.
zh: 阿格内丝·冯·哈德格（1371年5月27日卒）是马格德堡城主哈德格的布尔夏德一世之女。1347年她嫁给西里西亚的斯切尔采公爵阿尔伯特，生有一女伊丽莎白。

en: Albert of Strzelce (born after 1300, died c. 1370–1375) was the youngest son of Bolko I, Duke of Opole. After their father died in 1313, Albert and his brother Bolko II ruled Opole jointly until 1323, when Albert received Strzelce. In 1326 he granted town rights to Strzelce and patronised the Cistercian monastery at Jemielnica, and from 1327 his duchy was held as a fief of the Bohemian crown. In 1347 he married Agnes, daughter of Burgrave Burchard I of Magdeburg; their only child Elisabeth married Władysław the White of Gniewkowo. He was buried at Jemielnica.
zh: 斯切尔采的阿尔伯特（1300年后生，约1370—1375年卒）是奥波莱公爵博尔科一世的幼子。父亲于1313年死后，他与兄长博尔科二世共同统治奥波莱，1323年阿尔伯特分得斯切尔采，成为独立的斯切尔采公爵。1326年他向斯切尔采颁授城市法，并资助耶梅尔尼察的西多会修道院；1327年起，他的公国成为波希米亚王冠的封地。1347年他娶马格德堡城主布尔夏德一世之女阿格内丝为妻，独女伊丽莎白嫁给了格涅夫科沃公爵“白者”瓦迪斯瓦夫。他去世后葬于耶梅尔尼察修道院。

en: Ban Mueang was the second king of Sukhothai and a son of its founder Si Inthrathit and Queen Sueang. He succeeded his father around 1270, and the Ram Khamhaeng Inscription, carved in 1292, describes him as the elder brother whom Ram Khamhaeng served faithfully before inheriting the throne. He died around 1279 or 1280 and was succeeded by Ram Khamhaeng. A chronicle records his son Ngua Nam Thum, who later ruled Sukhothai.
zh: 班孟是素可泰王国第二代国王，开国君主室利膺陀罗铁与王后森之子，约1270年继位。1292年刻成的兰甘亨碑称他是兰甘亨的兄长，兰甘亨在继承王位前一直忠心事兄。约1279或1280年班孟去世，兰甘亨继位。据编年史记载，其子威南童后来也做了素可泰国王。

en: Li Thai, known posthumously as Maha Thammaracha I, was king of Sukhothai from about 1347 until his death in 1368. The son of King Loe Thai, he ruled Si Satchanalai as upparat, or viceroy, before taking the throne. A devout Theravada Buddhist, he built Wat Phra Si Rattana Mahathat at Phitsanulok and wrote the Trai Phum Phra Ruang, a treatise on Buddhist cosmology and the duties of a righteous king, regarded as the first major Buddhist text composed in Thai. He was succeeded by his son Lue Thai.
zh: 立泰，后世称昙摩罗阇一世，约1347年至1368年在位，是素可泰王国帕銮王朝的君主。他是国王乐泰之子，继位前曾以王储身份出镇塞差那莱。他虔诚信奉上座部佛教，在彭世洛兴建帕·西·拉丹那玛哈他寺，并撰成《帕銮三界》，讲述佛教宇宙观与国王的为政之德，被视为第一部以泰文写成的重要佛教论著。他去世后由其子卢泰继位。

en: Loe Thai was the fourth king of Sukhothai, succeeding his father Ram Khamhaeng around 1298. The tributaries his father had won broke away: Uttaradit, the Lao kingdoms of Luang Prabang and Vientiane, Hanthawaddy in 1319 and southern Suphan Buri, while U Thong rose in the south. Around 1312 he launched an expedition against Champa. A devout Buddhist, he reproduced Sri Lankan Buddha footprints and bore the title Dhammaraja. He died in 1323, and the throne passed to his cousin Ngua Nam Thum.
zh: 乐泰是素可泰帕銮王朝第四代国王，约1298年继承其父兰甘亨的王位。父亲征服的属国相继叛离：程逸以及佬人的琅勃拉邦、万象脱离，1319年勃固独立，南方的素攀武里也告脱离，乌通在南方崛起。约1312年他远征占城。乐泰笃信佛教，仿制了数个锡兰佛足印，因而有“法王”达磨罗阇的称号。他于1323年去世，王位落入堂兄弟威南童之手。

en: Ngua Nam Thum was a king of Sukhothai of the House of Phra Ruang. The Jinakalamali chronicle makes him a son of King Ban Mueang, which would make him a nephew of Ram Khamhaeng and a cousin of Loe Thai, whom he followed on the throne around 1323. Probably around 1340 or 1341 he named Loe Thai’s son Li Thai his heir and ruler of Si Satchanalai. The Wat Pa Mamuang inscriptions record that in 1347 or 1348 Li Thai marched on the capital, forced his way into the palace and killed his enemies before taking the throne as Mahathammaracha I. One historian suggested that Ngua Nam Thum died that year and that Li Thai seized the throne before the late king’s son could succeed him.
zh: 威南童是素可泰王国帕銮王朝的国王，据《胜者纪年》记载为国王班孟之子，由此可知他是兰甘亨的侄子、乐泰的堂兄，约于1323年继乐泰之后即位。约1340或1341年，他立乐泰之子立泰为王储，由立泰兼领是塞差那莱。据帕玛蒙寺碑铭记载，1347或1348年立泰率军进逼王都素可泰，闯入王宫，诛杀仇敌后登基，称摩诃昙摩罗阇一世。一位历史学者认为威南童在那年去世，立泰在其子继位之前夺取了王位。

en: Ram Khamhaeng the Great (c. 1239–1298) was the third king of Sukhothai, ruling from 1279 in its golden age. His kingdom is thought to have extended its sway to Vientiane in the east, Nakhon Si Thammarat in the south and the Mon lands in the west. From 1282 he sent embassies to Yuan China, which brought the ceramic techniques of Sangkhalok ware. In 1283 he created the Thai alphabet from Khmer and related scripts and made Theravada Buddhism the state religion. His inscription of 1292 is the earliest Thai text. He died around 1298, succeeded by his son Loe Thai.
zh: 兰甘亨大帝（约1239—1298）是素可泰第三代国王，1279年即位，在位时是素可泰的鼎盛期。有人推测他的王国势力曾扩展到东方的万象、南方的洛坤和西方的孟人之地。1282年起他多次遣使元朝，带回了宋加洛陶器的烧造技术。1283年，他参照高棉文等文字创制泰文字母，又确立上座部佛教为国教。1292年的兰甘亨碑是现存最早的泰文文献。约1298年去世，其子乐泰继位。

en: Si Inthrathit (1188–1270), born Bang Klang Hao, was the founder and first king of the Sukhothai Kingdom. As chief of Bang Yang, a western outpost of the Khmer Empire, he joined Khun Pha Mueang of Mueang Rat in rebelling against Angkor in 1238, defeating the Khmer general Khlon Lamphong and seizing Sukhothai. Crowned under the Sanskrit name Si Inthrathit, he was honoured as Phra Ruang, a title borne by his dynasty. His son Ram Khamhaeng defeated a Khmer prince in elephant combat at Tak. On his death in 1270 his second son Ban Mueang succeeded him.
zh: 室利膺陀罗铁（1188—1270）原名邦克朗豪，是素可泰王国的开国君主。他原是高棉帝国西陲邦扬的首领，1238年与孟拉首领坤波孟起兵反抗吴哥，击败高棉大将柯伦喃蓬，夺取素可泰。他登位后取梵语王号室利膺陀罗铁，因受泰人爱戴而获帕銮称号，其王朝遂称帕銮王朝。其子兰甘亨在达城骑象击败高棉王子。1270年他去世后，次子班孟继位。

en: Prabu Ajiguna Wisesa, also named Sang Mokteng Kiding, was a maharaja of the united Sunda and Galuh realm in western Java. As the son-in-law of King Prabu Lingga Dewata, he succeeded to the throne in 1333 and ruled from Kawali until about 1340. He moved the royal court from Pakuan, now Bogor, to Kawali in the Ciamis region, which remained the kingdom's capital until 1482. Sundanese chronicles record that his son Prabu Ragamulya Luhur Prabawa followed him as king.
zh: 阿吉古纳维塞萨，又名桑·莫克滕·基丁，是西爪哇巽他与加卢统一王国的摩诃罗阇。他是国王普拉布·林加·德瓦塔的女婿，于1333年继位，在卡瓦利统治至约1340年。他将王庭从帕库安（今茂物）迁至查米斯地区的卡瓦利，此后卡瓦利作为王国都城一直沿用到1482年。巽他编年史记载，其子普拉布·拉加穆利亚·卢胡尔·普拉巴瓦随后继位。

en: Suqu Sechen was a 12th-century Mongol of the Barlas tribe and a paternal ancestor of Timur. The Secret History of the Mongols mentions him once: in 1190 he and his son Qarachar led one of two Barlas delegations to the assembly that proclaimed Temüjin ruler of the Mongols. Later Timurid works made him a great-grandson of Tumanay Khan, an ancestor of Genghis Khan, and the chief of Erdemchi Barlas' twenty-nine sons. They call him a trusted adviser of Yesugei who foretold the infant Temüjin's greatness and died days after Yesugei in 1171, conflicting with the Secret History's 1190 assembly.
zh: 速忽赤臣是12世纪巴鲁剌思部的蒙古人，也是14世纪征服者帖木儿的父系先祖。《蒙古秘史》只提到他一次：1190年，他与儿子哈剌察儿率领巴鲁剌思人的两支代表团之一，参加推举铁木真为蒙古人首领的部落大会。后世帖木儿朝著作称他是成吉思汗先祖屯必乃汗的曾孙、亦儿占赤二十九子中最出众者；还说他是也速该信任的谋臣，曾预言襁褓中的铁木真前途无量，于1171年也速该死后数日去世，与《秘史》所载他出席1190年大会相矛盾。

en: Suri was a Mongol prince of the Chete tribe, son of Baba Bahadur and father of Togha Temür. He died in 733 AH (1332–1333), while Togha Temür was serving the Ilkhan Abu Sa'id in western Iran; his son was then ordered to Khorasan.
zh: 苏里是蒙古切特部宗王，巴巴·巴哈杜尔之子、脱合帖木儿之父。他于伊斯兰历733年（1332—1333）去世，当时脱合帖木儿正在伊朗西部侍奉伊儿汗不赛因，其子随后奉命前往呼罗珊。

en: Hajji Taghay was the second ruler of the Sutayids, a Mongol dynasty founded by his father, Emir Sutay, a commander of Ilkhan Ghazan that held Diyar Bakr and the Jazira. When Sutay died in 1332, Hajji Taghay inherited his fiefs around Amid. He led the dynasty through the collapse of Ilkhanate rule, repeatedly fighting the Oirat tribes and allying himself with the Jalayirids. In 1343 he was killed by his own nephew, Ibrahimshah, who rose against him with Chupanid backing.
zh: 哈吉·塔盖是速台王朝的第二代统治者；这个蒙古王朝由其父、伊儿汗合赞麾下的异密速台建立，领有迪亚巴克尔与杰济拉。1332年速台去世，哈吉·塔盖继承了他在阿米德一带的封地。在伊儿汗国统治瓦解之际，他屡次与卫拉特诸部交战，并与札剌亦儿王朝结盟。1343年，他被自己的侄子易卜拉欣沙杀害，后者是在楚邦王朝支持下起兵反叛的。

en: Ibrahimshah was the third ruler of the Sutayid Mongols of Diyar Bakr. In 1343, with Chupanid support, he killed his uncle Hajji Taghay and seized the family's fiefs around Amid. He first served the Chupanid Malek Ashraf, but in 1345 transferred his allegiance to the rival Ilkhanid claimants Suleyman Khan, Sati Beg and her son Surgan. Malek Ashraf defeated him at Aladagh near Lake Van, yet he held power until his death from a stroke in 1350, after which the Sutayids lost their Iraqi lands.
zh: 易卜拉欣沙是迪亚巴克尔速台蒙古人的第三代统治者。1343年，他在楚邦王朝支持下杀死叔父哈吉·塔盖，夺取了阿米德一带的家族封地。他起初依附楚邦王朝的马利克·阿什拉夫，1345年转而效忠与之对立的伊儿汗位争夺者苏莱曼汗、撒迪别及其子苏尔甘。马利克·阿什拉夫在凡湖附近的阿拉达格将他击败，但他仍掌握政权，直至1350年中风而死；此后速台人丧失了他们在伊拉克的领地。

en: Sutay (died 1332) was a Mongol emir and former stable master who rose under Ghazan fighting Nawruz's revolt from 1289 to 1294. He helped crush Sulamish's rebellion in Anatolia, winning the decisive battle near Akşehir in 1299, and took part in the Mongol raids into Palestine. He fought in Öljaitü's Gilan campaign of 1307 and in 1312 was appointed viceroy of Diyar Bakr. Dismissed in 1316, he was restored in 1319 after keeping clear of Irinjin's revolt. He held Diyar Bakr until his death in 1332. His descendants, the Sutayids, made their rule there hereditary after the Ilkhanate dissolved.
zh: 速台（？—1332）是蒙古异密，原为掌管马厩的侍从，在合赞汗麾下因1289至1294年征讨纳兀鲁思之乱而起家。他参与平定阿纳托利亚的苏拉米什叛乱，1299年在阿克谢希尔附近赢得决战，后来又参加了蒙古军对巴勒斯坦的袭掠。他随完者都参加1307年的吉兰战役，1312年被任命为迪亚巴克尔总督。1316年他被解职，1319年因没有卷入伊林真叛乱而官复原职。他一直领有迪亚巴克尔，直到1332年去世。伊儿汗国解体后，他的后裔速台王朝使对该地的统治变为世袭。

en: Hasso von Wedel-Schivelbein, called Hasso the Elder (died 1352 or 1354), was a Pomeranian noble and Vogt of the Neumark. Succeeding his father Wedego von Wedel as lord of Schivelbein in 1324, he is attested as Vogt of the Neumark in 1327 and 1347, and in 1345 represented Margrave Louis at the Berlin diet. As lord of Schivelbein he raised the town walls, built the castle mill and founded the church of Saint Mary in 1338. During the conflict with the False Waldemar he apparently sympathized with the pretender for a time, and was succeeded by his underage son Hans.
zh: 哈索·冯·魏德尔-希费尔拜因，人称“老哈索”（1352或1354年卒），是波美拉尼亚贵族、诺伊马克（新马尔克）的地方长官（福格特）。1324年，他继父亲韦德戈·冯·魏德尔之后成为希维德温领主；1327和1347年两度以诺伊马克地方长官身份见于记载，1345年代表藩侯路易出席柏林邦议会。作为希维德温领主，他加高城墙、修建城堡磨坊，并于1338年兴建圣母教堂。在与“伪瓦尔德马”的纷争中，他似乎曾一度同情这位僭位者，死后由年幼的儿子汉斯继位。

en: Wedego von Wedel (died 1324) was a Pomeranian knight and court marshal of the Wedel family. He served Margrave Waldemar of Brandenburg from 1304, fought at the 1308 capture of Danzig and was his chamberlain by 1316. From 1317 to 1322 he was court marshal to Wartislaw IV of Pomerania. At Pentecost 1319 he bought Schivelbein in the Neumark from Waldemar at Eberswalde, with high and low justice. He led Pomerania's 1321 Uckermark campaign and in 1324 submitted with the Neumark estates to Margrave Louis of Wittelsbach. He died that year at Uchtenhagen, leaving Schivelbein to his son Hasso.
zh: 韦德戈·冯·魏德尔（？—1324）是魏德尔家族出身的波美拉尼亚骑士和宫廷元帅。1304年起侍奉勃兰登堡侯爵瓦尔德马，参加了1308年攻占但泽之役，1316年已任侯爵的财政主管。1317至1322年担任波美拉尼亚公爵瓦季斯瓦夫四世的宫廷元帅。1319年五旬节，他在埃伯斯瓦尔德从瓦尔德马手中购得新马克的希维德温领地，享有高低裁判权。1321年他统率波美拉尼亚军队发起收复乌克马克的战役；1324年随新马克各等级归顺维特尔斯巴赫家族的路易侯爵，同年卒于乌希滕哈根，希维德温由其子哈索继承。

en: Agnes of Habsburg (1257–1322), born at Rheinfelden, was a daughter of King Rudolph I of Germany and Gertrude of Hohenberg. On 24 October 1273, her father's coronation day at Aachen, she married Duke Albert II of Saxony, who had cast his vote for Rudolph, sealing the Ascanian–Habsburg alliance. When Saxony was partitioned in 1296 she became Duchess of Saxe-Wittenberg, and after Albert's death in 1298 she was regent for her minor son Rudolf I until 1302. She died at Wittenberg on 11 October 1322.
zh: 哈布斯堡的阿格内丝（1257—1322）生于莱茵费尔登，是德意志国王鲁道夫一世与霍恩堡的格特鲁德之女。1273年10月24日，即父亲在亚琛加冕之日，她嫁给萨克森公爵阿尔布雷希特二世——阿尔布雷希特刚在选举中投票支持鲁道夫，这桩婚事就此结成阿斯坎尼家族与哈布斯堡家族的同盟。1296年萨克森瓜分后，她成为萨克森—维滕贝格公爵夫人；1298年丈夫去世后，她为年幼的儿子鲁道夫一世摄政，直到1302年。1322年10月11日，她在维滕贝格去世。

en: Agnes of Lindow-Ruppin (18 December 1314 – 9 May 1343) was the daughter of Count Ulrich I of Lindow-Ruppin and Adelheid of Schladen. After the death in 1329 of her first husband, Lord Henry II of Mecklenburg, she married Duke Rudolf I of Saxe-Wittenberg as his third wife in 1333. She bore Rudolf's youngest son and successor Wenceslas I, later Elector of Saxony, and a daughter Helena. Agnes died at Wittenberg in 1343.
zh: 林多-鲁平的阿格尼丝（1314年12月18日—1343年5月9日）是林多-鲁平伯爵乌尔里希一世与施拉登的阿德尔海德之女。1329年第一任丈夫梅克伦堡领主海因里希二世去世后，她于1333年成为萨克森-维滕贝格公爵鲁道夫一世的第三任妻子。她生下鲁道夫一世的幼子、后来的萨克森选帝侯文策尔一世，以及女儿海伦娜。阿格尼丝于1343年在维滕贝格去世。

en: Albert I (c. 1175–1260), younger son of Duke Bernhard III of Saxony, inherited the Saxon duchy in 1212 when his father's lands were divided, while his elder brother Henry took Anhalt. He supported Emperor Otto IV against the Hohenstaufen and on 22 July 1227 commanded the imperial left flank at the Battle of Bornhöved, confirming his lordship over the counts of Schauenburg and Holstein. He quarrelled with and imprisoned Ludolph, Prince-Bishop of Ratzeburg. Albert died at Lehnin Abbey on 7 October 1260; in 1296 his son Albert II and the three sons of his late son John I partitioned Saxony into Lauenburg and Wittenberg.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特一世（约1175—1260）是萨克森公爵伯恩哈德三世的幼子，1212年父亲的领地在诸子间分割，他分得萨克森公国，兄长亨利取得安哈尔特。他支持皇帝奥托四世对抗霍亨斯陶芬家族，1227年7月22日在博恩赫费德战役中指挥帝国军左翼，由此确认了对绍恩堡与荷尔斯泰因诸伯爵的宗主权。他还与拉策堡采邑主教卢道夫反目，将其囚禁。1260年10月7日，阿尔布雷希特在莱宁修道院去世；1296年，他的儿子阿尔布雷希特二世与已故的约翰一世的三个儿子把萨克森分为劳恩堡与维滕贝格两部分。

en: Albert II (c. 1250–1298), a son of Duke Albert I of Saxony and Helen of Brunswick, ruled the Duchy of Saxony jointly with his elder brother John I from 1260 and later with John's sons. At the 1273 royal election he supported Rudolph of Habsburg and married Rudolph's daughter Agnes. In 1292 he cast the Saxon vote for Adolf of Nassau, and he acquired the counties of Brehna in 1290 and Gommern in 1295. The partition of 1296 left him Saxe-Wittenberg, founding the Wittenberg Ascanian line. He died near Aken on 25 August 1298.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特二世（约1250—1298）是萨克森公爵阿尔布雷希特一世与不伦瑞克的海伦之子，1260年起与兄长约翰一世共同统治萨克森公国，后来又与约翰的诸子共治。1273年的国王选举中他支持哈布斯堡的鲁道夫，并娶鲁道夫之女阿格内丝为妻。1292年他代表萨克森投票给拿骚的阿道夫，1290年与1295年又先后取得布雷纳伯国和戈门伯国。1296年瓜分领地后，他领有萨克森—维滕贝格，开创了维滕贝格阿斯坎尼支系。1298年8月25日，他在阿肯附近去世。

en: Elisabeth of Saxe-Wittenberg (died around 1353) was a daughter of Elector Rudolf I by his first wife, Judith of Brandenburg. On 22 June 1344 she married Waldemar I, Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst, and bore him six children, including his successor Waldemar II.
zh: 萨克森-维滕贝格的伊丽莎白（约1353年卒）是选帝侯鲁道夫一世与第一任妻子勃兰登堡的尤塔之女。1344年6月22日，她嫁给安哈尔特-采尔布斯特亲王瓦尔德马一世，为他生下六个子女，其中包括继承人瓦尔德马二世。

en: Elisabeth of Hesse (died 30 May 1373) was a daughter of Otto I, Landgrave of Hesse, and Adelheid of Ravensberg. Before 8 May 1336 she married the future Elector Rudolf II of Saxe-Wittenberg. Their only recorded daughter, also named Elisabeth, died young in 1353.
zh: 黑森的伊丽莎白（1373年5月30日卒）是黑森领地伯爵奥托一世与拉文斯贝格的阿德尔海德之女，1336年5月8日前嫁给后来的萨克森选帝侯鲁道夫二世。两人唯一见于记载的女儿伊丽莎白于1353年夭折。

en: Elisabeth of Saxony (died 3 March 1341) was a daughter of Duke Albert II of Saxony and Agnes of Habsburg, and a sister of Elector Rudolf I of Saxe-Wittenberg. She was reportedly married to Obizzo III d'Este, lord of Ferrara.
zh: 萨克森的伊丽莎白（1341年3月3日卒）是萨克森公爵阿尔布雷希特二世与哈布斯堡的阿格尼丝之女、萨克森-维滕贝格选帝侯鲁道夫一世的姐妹，据称嫁给了费拉拉领主奥比佐三世·德·埃斯特。

en: Jutta of Brandenburg, also called Brigitte (died 9 May 1328), was a daughter of Margrave Otto V of Brandenburg and the first wife of Rudolf I, Duke of Saxe-Wittenberg, whom she married in 1298. Her sons included Rudolf II and Otto.
zh: 勃兰登堡的尤塔（又名布里吉特，1328年5月9日卒）是勃兰登堡藩侯奥托五世之女，1298年嫁给萨克森—维滕贝格公爵鲁道夫一世，是他的第一任妻子，生子鲁道夫二世、奥托等。

en: Kunigunde of Poland (c. 1295–1331 or 1333) was a Piast princess, daughter of Władysław I the Elbow-high, crowned King of Poland at Kraków in 1320, and Jadwiga of Kalisz; her siblings included Casimir III the Great. She first married Bernard, Duke of Świdnica, bearing him five children, among them Bolko II and Henry II of Świdnica. Left a widow in 1326, she married secondly, in 1328, Rudolf I, Duke of Saxe-Wittenberg and future Elector of Saxony, by whom she had one son, Mieszko. She died at Wittenberg on 9 April 1331 or 1333.
zh: 波兰的库妮根德（约1295—1331或1333年）是皮亚斯特家族的公主，1320年在克拉科夫加冕的波兰国王“矮子”瓦迪斯瓦夫一世与卡利什的雅德维加之女，卡齐米日大帝的姐妹。她先嫁希维德尼察公爵伯纳德，为他生了五个子女，包括波尔科二世和希维德尼察的亨利二世。1326年丧夫后，她于1328年再嫁萨克森—维滕贝格公爵、后来的萨克森选侯鲁道夫一世，生子梅什科。1331年或1333年4月9日，她在维滕贝格去世。

en: Miesko of Saxe-Wittenberg (c. 1330–1350) was the only son of Elector Rudolf I by his second wife Kunigunde, daughter of King Władysław I the Elbow-high of Poland. He married a woman named Eudoxia.
zh: 萨克森-维滕贝格的梅什科（约1330—1350）是选帝侯鲁道夫一世与第二任妻子库妮贡德的独子，库妮贡德是波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫一世（矮子）之女；他娶名为叶夫多基娅的女子为妻。

en: Otto of Saxe-Wittenberg (died 30 March 1350) was a younger son of Elector Rudolf I and Judith of Brandenburg. He married Elisabeth, daughter of Duke William II of Brunswick-Lüneburg. Their son Albert was invested with the Principality of Lüneburg by Emperor Charles IV in 1369.
zh: 萨克森-维滕贝格的奥托（1350年3月30日卒）是选帝侯鲁道夫一世与勃兰登堡的尤塔之子。他娶不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵威廉二世之女伊丽莎白为妻，两人的儿子阿尔布雷希特于1369年被皇帝查理四世封为吕讷堡亲王。

en: Otto of Saxony (died 1349) was a younger son of Duke Albert II of Saxony and his wife Agnes of Habsburg, and a younger brother of Elector Rudolf I of Saxe-Wittenberg. He married Lucia of Dalmatia.
zh: 萨克森的奥托（1349年卒）是萨克森公爵阿尔布雷希特二世与妻子哈布斯堡的阿格尼丝之子、萨克森-维滕贝格选帝侯鲁道夫一世的弟弟，娶达尔马提亚的露琪亚为妻。

en: Rudolf I (c. 1284–1356) ruled Saxe-Wittenberg from 1298, under his mother Agnes of Habsburg's regency until 1302. As Saxon elector he voted for Henry of Luxembourg in 1308 and backed Frederick the Fair in the double election of 1314; after Frederick's defeat at Mühldorf in 1322 he reconciled with Emperor Louis IV and backed the Declaration of Rhense in 1338. The only elector at Charles IV's 1346 coronation, he received the Altmark in 1347; the Golden Bull of 1356 confirmed him as Elector of Saxony. He founded Wittenberg's All Saints' Monastery and died on 12 March 1356.
zh: 鲁道夫一世（约1284—1356）自1298年起统治萨克森-维滕贝格，1302年之前由母亲哈布斯堡的阿格尼丝摄政。作为萨克森选帝侯，他在1308年投票支持卢森堡的亨利，1314年双重选举中支持表亲美男子腓特烈；1322年腓特烈在米尔多夫战败后，他与皇帝路易四世和解，并参与促成1338年的《伦斯声明》。他是唯一出席1346年查理四世加冕礼的选帝侯，1347年获封阿尔特马克；1356年《金玺诏书》确认他为萨克森选帝侯。他在维滕贝格创立诸圣修道院，1356年3月12日去世。

en: Rudolf II (c. 1307–1370), eldest son of Rudolf I and Judith of Brandenburg, was Elector of Saxony from 1356. He fought for Philip VI at Crécy in 1346, leading the German auxiliaries after John of Bohemia fell, and received a thorn said to be from Christ's Crown of Thorns for Wittenberg's All Saints' Church. He upheld his electorate against Saxe-Lauenburg claims. The award of Lüneburg to his nephew Albert in 1369 opened the Lüneburg War of Succession. Nearly blind late in life, Rudolf died on 6 December 1370 without sons and was succeeded by his brother Wenceslas I.
zh: 鲁道夫二世（约1307—1370）是鲁道夫一世与勃兰登堡的尤塔的长子，1356年起任萨克森选帝侯。1346年他在克雷西为法王腓力六世作战，波希米亚国王约翰战死后接统德意志援军，并获赠一根据称取自基督荆棘冠冕的荆棘，安置于维滕贝格诸圣堂。他维护选帝侯地位，抵制萨克森-劳恩堡一支的主张。1369年吕讷堡被判给其侄阿尔布雷希特，引发吕讷堡继承战争。鲁道夫晚年近乎双目失明，1370年12月6日去世，无子，由弟弟文策尔一世继位。

en: Wenceslas I (c. 1337–1388), son of Rudolf I by his third wife Agnes of Lindow-Ruppin, succeeded his brother Rudolf II as Duke and Elector of Saxe-Wittenberg in 1370. As elector he helped elect Wenceslas IV of Bohemia King of the Romans in 1376 and stood by Charles IV. The emperor invested Wenceslas and his nephew Albert with Brunswick-Lüneburg, but their claim failed in the Lüneburg War of Succession; Wenceslas was defeated at Winsen an der Aller in 1388. He died suddenly on 15 May 1388 during the siege of Celle, amid rumours of poison.
zh: 文策尔一世（约1337—1388）是鲁道夫一世与第三任妻子林多-鲁平的阿格尼丝之子，1370年继兄长鲁道夫二世之后成为萨克森-维滕贝格公爵兼选帝侯。作为选帝侯，他在1376年参与选立波希米亚的瓦茨拉夫四世为罗马人的国王，始终站在查理四世一边。皇帝将不伦瑞克-吕讷堡封授给他和侄子阿尔布雷希特，但他们的主张在吕讷堡继承战争中失败，文策尔于1388年在阿勒尔河畔温森战败。1388年5月15日，他在策勒围城战期间暴病而亡，时人怀疑他是被毒杀。

en: Agnes of Austria (c. 1315/1322–1392) was the second daughter of Duke Leopold I of Austria and Catherine of Savoy. After her father died in 1326 she grew up under the guardianship of her uncles Frederick the Fair and Albert II. On 1 June 1338 she married Bolko II the Small, Duke of Świdnica, a match directed against the Luxembourg kings of Bohemia; the marriage was apparently childless. When Bolko died in 1368 his will left her Świdnica, Jawor and Lwówek as her dower. She ruled them until her death at Świdnica on 2 February 1392 and was buried at Grüssau Abbey, after which the duchies passed to the Bohemian crown.
zh: 奥地利的阿格尼丝（约1315/1322—1392）是奥地利公爵利奥波德一世与萨伏依的卡特琳的次女。1326年父亲去世后，她由叔父“美男子”腓特烈和阿尔布雷希特二世监护长大。1338年6月1日，她嫁给希维德尼察公爵博尔科二世（“小个子”），这场联姻针对的是波希米亚的卢森堡王室；两人显然没有子女。1368年博尔科去世，依遗嘱将希维德尼察、雅沃尔和卢武韦克作为遗孀产留给她。她统治这些领地至1392年2月2日在希维德尼察去世，葬于克热舒夫修道院，此后这些公国并入波希米亚。

en: Bernard of Świdnica (c. 1291–1326), a son of Bolko I the Strict and Beatrix of Brandenburg, succeeded his father in 1301 under the regency of his uncle Herman of Brandenburg until 1305. After partitions with his brothers he kept Świdnica for himself in 1322. His sister Beatrix married Louis IV of Bavaria, and in 1310 Bernard himself married Kunigunde, daughter of Władysław I the Elbow-high of Poland. He fought at Mühldorf in 1322 and joined the Teutonic Knights against Lithuania, then died on 6 May 1326 and was buried at Grüssau Abbey. His son Bolko II the Small succeeded.
zh: 希维德尼察的伯纳德（约1291—1326）是“严厉者”波尔科一世与勃兰登堡的贝阿特丽克丝之子，1301年父亲去世后继位，由舅父勃兰登堡的赫尔曼摄政至1305年。经过与诸弟的几次瓜分，他在1322年独占希维德尼察。他的姐妹贝阿特丽克丝嫁给巴伐利亚的路易四世，他本人则于1310年娶波兰“矮子”瓦迪斯瓦夫一世之女库妮根德。1322年他参加米尔多夫战役，又随条顿骑士团进攻立陶宛。1326年5月6日他去世，葬于克热舒夫修道院，其子“小个子”波尔科二世继位。

en: Bolko II the Small (c. 1312–1368) ruled Świdnica from 1326, the last independent Silesian duke of the Piast dynasty. When King John of Bohemia forced the other Silesian Piasts to pay homage in 1329–1331, Bolko refused and preserved his sovereignty through Poland, Hungary and the Habsburgs. He married Agnes of Austria in 1338 and helped form the anti-Bohemian league of 1345. He gained Jawor in 1346 and Lusatia in 1364. Bolko died on 28 July 1368 and was buried in Grüssau Abbey; his widow held the lands until 1392, when they passed to Bohemia.
zh: 博尔科二世（“小个子”，约1312—1368）自1326年起统治希维德尼察，是皮亚斯特王朝最后一位独立的西里西亚公爵。1329至1331年，波希米亚国王约翰迫使其他西里西亚皮亚斯特王公向他效忠，博尔科拒不臣服，借波兰、匈牙利与哈布斯堡保住了公国主权。他于1338年娶奥地利的阿格尼丝，并参与促成1345年的反波希米亚同盟。他于1346年取得雅沃尔，1364年取得卢萨蒂亚。博尔科于1368年7月28日去世，葬于克热舒夫修道院，其遗孀领有这些领地直至1392年，领地随后并入波希米亚。

en: Anund Gårdske, or Anund from Russia, is known only from Adam of Bremen's chronicle, which names him king of part of Sweden around 1070. Summoned from Garðaríki, the Scandinavian name for Kievan Rus' — perhaps from Aldeigjuborg — he was a Christian who refused to perform the public sacrifice to the Norse gods, presumably at Uppsala, and was deposed at the thing. One of several claimants after King Stenkil, he left the assembly rejoicing to be found worthy of disgrace for Christ.
zh: 阿农德·戈尔德斯克意为“来自罗斯的阿农德”，仅见于亚当·冯·不来梅的教会史。据该书记载，约1070年他在瑞典一部分地区称王。他从加尔达里克——斯堪的纳维亚人对基辅罗斯的称呼，可能是阿尔德吉尤堡——被召回瑞典；作为基督徒，他拒绝向北欧诸神举行公共献祭，地点可能在乌普萨拉，因而在议事会上被废黜。他是国王斯滕克尔死后争夺王位的诸人之一，离开会场时还为自己配得上为基督受辱而欢喜。

en: Anund Jacob (c. 1008–c. 1050), son of Olof Skötkonung, was made co-ruler c. 1019 and sole king in 1022, taking the Norse name Anund in place of his baptismal name Jakob. Surnamed Kolbränna, the Coal-burner, for burning opponents' houses, he promoted Christianity with missionaries from Hamburg-Bremen and minted coin at Sigtuna. To check Danish hegemony he backed Norway's Olaf II against Cnut the Great and fought at the sea battle of Helgeå in 1026; he later supported Magnus I's claim to Norway and also backed his brother-in-law Yaroslav the Wise in Kiev. He died c. 1050, leaving the throne to half-brother Emund the Old.
zh: 阿农德·雅各布（约1008—约1050）是奥洛夫·舍特康努格之子，约1019年被瑞典议会立为共治者，1022年成为唯一国王；他受洗时取名雅各布，瑞典人为他取了诺斯名字阿农德。他绰号“烧煤者”，因惯于焚烧反对者的房屋而得名。他任用汉堡—不来梅大主教区派遣的传教士推广基督教，并继续在锡格蒂娜铸币。为遏制丹麦霸权，他支持挪威的奥拉夫二世对抗克努特大帝，参加了1026年的黑尔格河海战；他后来支持马格努斯一世争取挪威王位，也支持身在基辅的姐夫智者雅罗斯拉夫。他约于1050年去世，王位由异母兄长“老人”埃蒙德继承。

en: Axel Oxenstierna (1583–1654) was Sweden's Lord High Chancellor from 1612 to 1654 and architect of its modern state. An Uppland nobleman, he joined the Privy Council in 1609 and traveled to Copenhagen in 1610 in a failed attempt to prevent war. On taking office he faced wars against Denmark, Poland-Lithuania and Russia; he made peace with Denmark at Knäred in 1613. As Gustavus Adolphus's chief minister he governed Livonia and Swedish-held Prussia, securing the Truce of Altmark in 1629. After the king fell at Lützen in 1632, he led Sweden's war effort in Germany as head of Queen Christina's regency and framed the Instrument of Government of 1634. He also created Sweden's county administration, dying in office in 1654.
zh: 埃克塞尔·乌克森谢纳（1583—1654）自1612年至1654年任瑞典首相，是瑞典现代国家体制的缔造者。他出身乌普兰贵族，1609年进入枢密院，1610年赴哥本哈根试图阻止战争，却未能成功。就任首相时，他面临与丹麦、波兰立陶宛和俄国的战争；1613年他在克内勒德与丹麦议和。作为古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫的首席大臣，他治理利沃尼亚和瑞典占领的普鲁士，于1629年达成《阿尔特马克停战协定》。1632年国王在吕岑阵亡后，他作为克里斯蒂娜女王摄政政府的首脑主持瑞典在德意志的战事，并制定了1634年的《政府约法》。他还创立了瑞典的郡级行政体系，1654年卒于任上。

en: Birger Jarl (c. 1210–1266), jarl of Sweden and head of the House of Bjälbo, married Ingeborg, sister of King Erik Eriksson, and received the title of jarl in 1248. Russian chronicles name him as the commander defeated by Alexander Nevsky at the Battle of the Neva in 1240. Erik's Chronicle records that he led the Second Swedish Crusade into Finland, subduing the pagan Tavastians and forcing them to convert to Christianity. The expedition's date is disputed, with scholars placing it either around 1249–1250 or in 1238–1239. When his young son Valdemar was elected king in 1250, Birger governed the kingdom as regent. Tradition credits him with founding Stockholm in 1252. He died at Jälbolung on 21 October 1266.
zh: 比尔耶尔伯爵（约1210—1266）是瑞典的雅尔、比耶尔博家族的首领，娶国王埃里克·埃里克松之妹英格堡为妻，1248年受封雅尔。俄罗斯编年史称他是1240年涅瓦河之战中败于亚历山大·涅夫斯基的瑞军统帅。《埃里克编年史》记载，他率领瑞典第二次十字军东征进入芬兰，征服信奉异教的塔瓦斯蒂亚人，迫使他们皈依基督教。东征的年代存在争议，学者分别将其定于约1249—1250年或1238—1239年。1250年幼子瓦尔德马尔被拥立为国王，比尔耶尔以摄政身份执掌国政。相传他于1252年建立斯德哥尔摩，1266年10月21日在耶尔博伦去世。

en: Birger Magnusson (c. 1280–1321) became King of Sweden in 1290, when his father Magnus Ladulås died leaving the ten-year-old under the regency of Torkel Knutsson. His reign was torn by feud with his brothers Dukes Erik and Valdemar, who imprisoned him during the Håtuna games in 1306. Released in 1308, he sought aid in Denmark, but had to give up the royal domain in exchange for other territories. He took his revenge at the Nyköping Banquet of 1317, seizing the dukes, who died in captivity; Erik's Chronicle says they were starved to death in Nyköping Castle. Their supporters drove him into Danish exile in 1318. His son Magnus was executed in 1320, and Birger died in Denmark after 31 May 1321.
zh: 比尔耶尔·马格努松（约1280—1321）于1290年成为瑞典国王：父亲马格努斯·拉杜洛斯去世时他年仅十岁，由托克尔·克努特松摄政。他的统治始终被与弟弟埃里克、瓦尔德马尔两位公爵的争斗撕裂，1306年他在“霍图纳游戏”中被两弟囚禁。1308年获释后，他向丹麦求援，却不得不放弃王室领地，换取其他地区。他在1317年的尼雪平宴会上拘捕两位公爵，二人死于囚禁中；《埃里克编年史》称他们在尼雪平城堡被饿死。公爵们的支持者于1318年将他逐往丹麦流亡。他的儿子马格努斯于1320年被处决，比尔耶尔则于1321年5月31日之后在丹麦去世。

en: Blanche of Namur (1320–1363), daughter of John I, Marquis of Namur, and Marie of Artois, became queen of Sweden and Norway through her marriage to King Magnus Eriksson. Magnus travelled to Namur to propose in June 1334, and the wedding was celebrated in October or November 1335, possibly at Bohus Castle; Blanche received Tunsberg in Norway and Lödöse in Sweden as wedding fiefs and was crowned in Stockholm in July 1336. Her brothers Robert and Louis came with her to Sweden and entered the king's service. In 1353 she exchanged Tunsberg for Bohus and other fiefs. Active and conspicuous in politics as well as at court, she became one of the best-known medieval queens of Sweden and Norway, the subject of many stories and songs; the Swedish nursery rhyme about a horse named Blanka is remembered as hers. Her sons were Eric XII of Sweden and Haakon VI of Norway. She died in 1363.
zh: 那慕尔的布兰奇（1320—1363）是那慕尔侯爵约翰一世与阿图瓦的玛丽之女，因嫁给国王马格努斯·埃里克松成为瑞典与挪威王后。1334年6月，马格努斯亲赴那慕尔求婚，婚礼于1335年10月或11月举行，地点可能是布胡斯城堡。布兰奇得到挪威的滕斯贝格和瑞典的勒德瑟作为婚后封地，1336年7月在斯德哥尔摩加冕。她的兄弟罗贝尔和路易随她来到瑞典，为国王效力。1353年她用滕斯贝格换取布胡斯等封地。她在朝廷内外都十分活跃而醒目，成为瑞典与挪威中世纪最知名的王后之一，留下许多故事与歌谣；瑞典那首讲小马名叫布兰卡的童谣，据传与她有关。她的儿子是瑞典的埃里克十二世和挪威的哈康六世。她于1363年去世。

en: Canute I, born Knut Eriksson (before 1150–1195/96), was son of the murdered Saint Erik. After his father's murder in 1160 he fled, returning to slay King Karl Sverkersson at Visingsö on 12 April 1167. He defeated rival claimants Kol and Burislev by c. 1173 and ruled all Sweden, aided by jarl Birger Brosa. After c. 1180 he minted Sweden's first coinage in generations and made a trade treaty with Henry the Lion. In 1187 Sigtuna was reportedly burned in an attack from across the Baltic. He died in 1195/96 and was buried at Varnhem Abbey.
zh: 克努特一世（1150年前—1195/96年），全名克努特·埃里克松，是遇刺身亡的圣埃里克之子。1160年父亲被杀后他流亡国外，回国后于1167年4月12日在维辛瑟岛杀死国王卡尔·斯渥克尔松。经过与王位竞争者科尔和布里斯莱夫多年交战，他到1173年才成为全瑞典的国王。在雅尔比耶·布罗萨辅佐下，他约1180年恢复了中断数代的王室铸币，并与萨克森的狮子亨利签订商约。据记载，1187年锡格蒂娜遭波罗的海对岸来袭者焚毁。他于1195/96年善终，葬于瓦恩海姆修道院。

en: Canute II, called Knut the Tall (Knut Långe, died 1234), was a Swedish noble of the House of Bjälbo, probably a great-grandson of Saint Erik and a councillor to the young Eric XI. After Eric was overthrown following the Battle of Olustra in 1229, Canute became king and was recognized by 1231. Laws from his reign barred creditors from entering debtors' homes without an official and required the king to hold judicial reviews at least every third year. He died in 1234, having endowed Sko Abbey in Uppland in 1220, and was buried there; Eric XI then regained the throne.
zh: 克努特二世，绰号“高个子”（克努特·霍尔姆松，？—1234），是瑞典比耶博家族贵族，或为圣埃里克的曾孙，也是幼年埃里克十一世的摄政会议成员。1229年奥卢斯特拉战役后，埃里克被废黜，克努特成为国王，至迟于1231年获得承认。他在位时修订的法律规定，无官员在场债主不得进入债户家中，并要求国王至少每三年巡视司法一次。他于1234年去世；1220年他曾在乌普兰的斯库捐地建院，死后葬于斯库修道院，埃里克十一世随后复位。

en: Charles VII (Karl Sverkersson, c. 1130–1167), son of Sverker the Elder, held Götaland after his father's murder in 1156 while Eric IX ruled in Svealand. In 1161 he killed his rival Magnus II at Örebro and was recognized as king of Sweden. His short reign saw the first Swedish archbishopric established at Uppsala, Stefan becoming its first archbishop. A Swedish attack on Ladoga in 1164 was shattered by Novgorod. On 12 April 1167 he was slain on Visingsö by backers of Knut Eriksson, who took the throne; his son Sverker later became king.
zh: 查理七世（即卡尔·斯渥克尔松，约1130—1167）是老斯韦克之子。1156年父亲遇刺后，埃里克九世取得王位，他仍保有约塔兰。1161年，他在厄勒布鲁杀死争位者马格努斯二世，被承认为瑞典国王。他在位时间不长，却见证了乌普萨拉大主教区设立、斯特凡出任首任大主教。1164年瑞典人进攻拉多加，被诺夫哥罗德击溃。1167年4月12日，他在维辛索被克努特·埃里克松的支持者杀害，克努特继位；他的儿子斯韦克后来也成为国王。

en: Emund the Old, also called the Bad (died c. 1060), was a son of Olof Skötkonung by his Slavic co-wife Edla and succeeded his half-brother Anund Jacob c. 1050. Baptized but lukewarm in the faith, he defied the Archbishopric of Bremen by keeping his own bishop, Osmundus, consecrated in Poland, and turned Bremen's envoys away from an assembly in the mid-1050s. His son Anund perished on an eastern expedition, and drought brought famine in 1056. Emund died c. 1060, the last king of the old Swedish dynasty; Stenkil, possibly his son-in-law, succeeded him.
zh: 埃蒙德，世称“老人”，又称“恶人”（？—约1060），是奥洛夫·舍特康努格与斯拉夫妾侍厄德拉之子，约1050年继异母弟阿农德·雅各布之后为王。他虽受洗却对信仰冷淡，坚持留用在波兰祝圣的主教奥斯蒙德，与汉堡—不来梅大主教区对抗，在1050年代中期的一次集会上拒见不来梅使节。他的儿子阿农德在东征中丧命，1056年又逢旱灾歉收。埃蒙德约于1060年去世，是古老瑞典王朝的末代国王；继位的斯滕克尔可能是他的女婿。

en: Eric IX, called Saint Erik (c. 1125–1160), ruled Sweden from about 1156 as founder of the House of Erik. Legend credits him with leading the first Swedish crusade to Finland, persuading the English bishop Henry of Uppsala to evangelize the Finns, and codifying the laws known as King Erik's Law. On Ascension Day, 18 May 1160, after hearing Mass near Uppsala, he was set upon by rebels backing the Danish prince Magnus Henriksson, stabbed and beheaded. Venerated as a martyr, he became Sweden's patron saint; his son Canute I took the throne in 1167.
zh: 埃里克九世（约1125—1160），世称圣埃里克，约1156年起统治瑞典，是埃里克王朝的开创者。后世传说称他率领第一次瑞典十字军东征芬兰，劝说英格兰籍的乌普萨拉主教亨利留在当地传教；他还主持编纂了后世所称的“国王埃里克法典”。1160年耶稣升天节（5月18日），他在乌普萨拉附近做完弥撒后遭到拥立丹麦王子马格努斯·亨里克松的叛军袭击，被刺杀并斩首。他后被尊为殉道者与瑞典主保圣人，其子克努特一世于1167年夺取王位。

en: Erik Magnusson (c. 1282–1318), second son of King Magnus Ladulås, was Duke of Södermanland and rival of his brother King Birger. He held lands in all three Scandinavian kingdoms, helped force the execution of Torkel Knutsson in 1306, and that same year seized Birger at the Håtuna games. In 1309 he fought the kings of Norway and Denmark; peace at Helsingborg divided Sweden between Birger and his brothers, giving Erik several provinces. In 1312 he married Ingeborg, daughter of King Haakon V of Norway; their son Magnus, born in 1316, later ruled both Sweden and Norway. At the Nyköping Banquet on 10–11 December 1317 Birger arrested Erik and his brother Valdemar, who died in the dungeon of Nyköping Castle, apparently starved.
zh: 埃里克·马格努松（约1282—1318）是马格努斯·拉杜洛斯国王的次子，受封南曼兰公爵，也是长兄比耶国王的主要对手。他的领地横跨斯堪的纳维亚三个王国，1306年促成托克尔·克努特松被处死，同年又在“霍图纳游戏”中拘捕比耶。1309年他与挪威及丹麦国王交战；赫尔辛堡和议将瑞典分给比耶和他的兄弟，埃里克得到数个地区。1312年他娶挪威国王哈康五世之女英格堡为妻，1316年所生之子马格努斯后来同时统治瑞典与挪威。1317年12月10日至11日夜的尼雪平宴会上，比耶逮捕了埃里克与弟弟瓦尔德马尔，二人死于尼雪平城堡的地牢，一般认为是被饿死的。

en: Eric the Victorious (Erik Segersäll, c. 945–c. 995) was the first independently attested Swedish king, ruling in Uppland from c. 970. His epithet comes from the Battle of Fýrisvellir near Uppsala, where saga tradition says he defeated his nephew Styrbjörn the Strong, who invaded with Danish and Jomsviking support. The chronicler Adam of Bremen wrote that Eric invaded Denmark in alliance with Poland's Bolesław, drove out Sweyn Forkbeard and briefly ruled there; a Swedish and Danish fleet also raided Stade in Saxony. Baptized in Denmark but later back among the old gods, he probably founded Sigtuna and died c. 995, leaving his son Olof Skötkonung the throne.
zh: 胜利者埃里克（埃里克·塞格塞尔，约945—约995）是第一位有独立史料佐证的瑞典国王，约970年起在乌普兰立国。他的绰号来自乌普萨拉附近的菲里斯维利尔战役：据萨迦记载，他在那里击败了率丹麦军与约姆斯维京人来犯的侄子“强者”斯图尔比约恩。编年史家不来梅的亚当记载，埃里克与波兰的波列斯瓦夫结盟入侵丹麦，一度驱逐八字胡斯文并在当地称王，一支瑞典和丹麦舰队还劫掠了萨克森的施塔德。他本是异教徒，在丹麦接受洗礼后又重奉旧神，可能是锡格蒂娜的建立者。他约于995年去世，王位传给儿子奥洛夫·舍特康努格。

en: Eric X (Erik Knutsson, c. 1180–1216), son of Canute I, claimed the Swedish throne against Sverker Karlsson. Three brothers fell at Älgarås in 1205; Eric fled to Norway, returned in 1208 and defeated Sverker at Lena, then slew him at Gestilren in July 1210. Later that year he married Rikissa, sister of Valdemar II of Denmark, and in November became the first Swedish king known to be crowned. Pope Innocent III confirmed his rule in 1216. He died suddenly on Visingsö on 10 April 1216 and was buried at Varnhem Abbey; his posthumous son later ruled as Eric XI.
zh: 埃里克十世（本名埃里克·克努特松，约1180—1216）是克努特一世之子，向斯渥克尔二世争夺瑞典王位。1205年，他的三个兄弟战死在艾尔加罗斯，埃里克逃往挪威；1208年他回国，在莱纳击败斯渥克尔，又于1210年7月在耶斯蒂尔伦将其击杀。同年晚些时候，他迎娶丹麦国王瓦尔德马二世的妹妹里基莎，11月成为第一位有记载的受加冕瑞典国王。1216年教皇英诺森三世确认了他的统治。1216年4月10日他在维辛瑟岛暴卒，葬于瓦恩海姆修道院，遗腹子后来继位为埃里克十一世。

en: Eric XI (Erik Eriksson, 1216–1250), surnamed the Lisp and Lame, was the posthumous son of Eric X and Rikissa of Denmark. He became king at six in 1222, was overthrown by Knut Långe at Olustra in 1229 and fled to Denmark, returning after Knut's death in 1234. He ruled in the shadow of his jarls Ulf Fase and brother-in-law Birger Jarl, husband of his sister Ingeborg. In 1247 a Folkung rising was crushed at Sparrsätra and Holmger Knutsson beheaded. Eric died on 2 February 1250, the last of the House of Erik; Birger Jarl's son Valdemar became king.
zh: 埃里克十一世（本名埃里克·埃里克松，1216—1250），绰号“口吃与跛子”，是埃里克十世与丹麦公主里基莎的遗腹子。1222年约翰一世去世后，年仅六岁的他被拥立为王；1229年在奥卢斯特拉战败后被克努特二世废黜，逃往丹麦，1234年克努特死后回国复位。朝政先后由雅尔乌尔夫·法瑟和姐夫雅尔比耶主持，后者娶了他的姐姐英格堡。1247年福尔孔党叛乱在斯帕尔斯特拉被镇压，霍尔姆耶·克努特松被斩首。埃里克于1250年2月2日去世，是埃里克王朝末代国王；雅尔比耶之子瓦尔德马被立为王。

en: Håkan the Red (Swedish: Håkan Röde) was a Swedish king who ruled for roughly five years in the second half of the 11th century, one of the rival claimants after the death of Stenkil. Later tradition makes him a son of Stenkil, born and buried at Levene in Västergötland; his epithet first appears in the king list attached to the Westrogothic law around 1200. Sources place him variously after Halsten and beside the short-reigned Anund Gårdske. When he died around 1079, Halsten and Inge the Elder emerged as rulers. The historian Adolf Schück argued that the pagan king Blot-Sweyn was Håkan under another name.
zh: 红色霍坎于11世纪后半叶统治瑞典约五年，属斯滕克尔死后争夺王位的诸人之一。后世相传他是斯滕克尔之子，生于西约特兰的莱韦内并葬在当地；“红色”这一绰号最早见于约1200年成书的《西约塔兰法》所附国王名录。诸史料对其世序说法不一，或将他列在哈尔斯滕之后，或与在位短暂的阿农德·戈尔德斯克并列。约1079年他去世后，哈尔斯滕与老英格成为统治者。历史学家阿道夫·舒克认为，异教国王布洛特-斯文可能是红色霍坎的另一个名字。

en: Halsten Stenkilsson, son of Stenkil, was king of Sweden for a few years after 1067, following the civil war of 1066 in which the two rival Erics killed one another. Adam of Bremen records that he was soon driven out in favour of the Christian Anund Gårdske. He may later have ruled Västergötland with his brother Inge the Elder, since a papal letter of 1081 from Gregory VII addresses two kings, A and I. The king list of the Westrogothic law remembers him as courteous and a fair judge. He was the father of Philip and Inge the Younger.
zh: 哈尔斯滕是斯滕克尔之子。1066年斯滕克尔死后的内战中，两个埃里克同归于尽，哈尔斯滕便于1067年后做了几年瑞典国王。不来梅的亚当记载，他不久即被废黜，取而代之的是基督徒阿农德·戈尔德斯克。他后来可能与弟弟老英格在西约特兰共治，因为教皇额我略七世1081年的一封信曾致信两位并称A与I的国王。《西约塔兰法》所附国王名录称赞他彬彬有礼、断案公允。他是菲利普和小英格的父亲。

en: Bridget of Sweden (c. 1303–1373) was a Swedish mystic and founder of the Bridgettine Order. Born Birgitta Birgersdotter to a noble family of Uppland, she married the lawspeaker Ulf Gudmarsson of Östergötland in 1316 and bore eight children. They made a pilgrimage to Santiago de Compostela in 1341. After her husband died in 1344 she devoted herself to visions and care of the poor. From 1350 she lived in Rome, seeking papal approval for a new order and the pope's return from Avignon; Urban V confirmed its rule in 1370 for Vadstena Convent. She urged church reform and died after her Jerusalem pilgrimage, was canonized in 1391 by Boniface IX, and became a patron saint of Europe.
zh: 瑞典的彼济达（约1303—1373）是瑞典神秘主义者、彼济达修会的创办人。本名贝尔吉塔·比耶尔斯多特的她出身乌普兰贵族家庭，1316年嫁给东约特兰的执法官乌尔夫·古德马尔松，生下八个子女。1341年夫妇二人赴圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉朝圣。1344年丈夫去世后，她潜心于神视异象并济助穷人。1350年她定居罗马，为新修会寻求教廷批准，并呼吁教宗从阿维尼翁返回；1370年教宗乌尔班五世批准了瓦斯泰纳修会的会规。她呼吁教会改革，在赴耶路撒冷朝圣后于罗马去世，1391年由教宗卜尼法斯九世封圣，后成为欧洲的主保圣人之一。

en: Inge the Elder, son of Stenkil, was king of Sweden from before 1080 until his death around 1110, his power resting on the Geatic provinces of Västergötland and Östergötland. A stern Christian, he refused to perform the pagan blót at Uppsala and was driven into exile, the Swedes choosing Blot-Sweyn as king. After three winters he returned from Västergötland, surprised Sweyn in his house and slew him, restoring Christianity. Around 1100, with Queen Helena, he founded Vreta Abbey near Linköping, Sweden's first nunnery. He died about 1110 and was followed by his nephews Philip and Inge the Younger.
zh: 老英格是斯滕克尔之子，约1080年前成为瑞典国王，直到约1110年去世，势力主要依靠西约特兰和东约特兰。他是坚定的基督徒，拒绝在乌普萨拉举行异教献祭，被瑞典人流放，众人拥立布洛特-斯文为王。在西约特兰度过三年后他回师突袭，在住所击杀布洛特-斯文，恢复基督教。约1100年，他与王后海伦娜在林雪平附近兴建弗列塔修道院，即瑞典第一座女修道院。他约1110年去世，王位由侄子菲利普和小英格继承。

en: Inge the Younger, son of Halsten and nephew of Inge the Elder, was king of Sweden from about 1110, ruling with his brother Philip until Philip's death in 1118 and then alone. He may already have died when Sigurd the Crusader invaded Småland in the Kalmar Crusade of 1123. The regnal list of the Westrogothic law records that he died in Östergötland by a poisoned drink, a tale later attached to his queen, Ulvhild Håkansdotter. With his death around 1125 the House of Stenkil ended, and the crown passed to the family of Sverker the Elder.
zh: 小英格是哈尔斯滕之子、老英格的侄子，约1110年成为瑞典国王，先与兄长菲利普共治，1118年菲利普死后独自统治。1123年挪威国王西居尔一世在卡尔马十字军中兴兵侵入斯莫兰时，他可能已经去世。据《西约塔兰法》所附国王名录记载，他在东约特兰饮下毒酒身亡，后来有传说把下毒之事归于王后乌尔夫希尔德·哈康斯多塔。约1125年他去世后斯滕克尔王朝绝嗣，王位转入老斯韦克一系。

en: Johan Anders Jägerhorn (1757–1825) was a Finnish nobleman and major in the Swedish army, born near Helsinki when Finland belonged to Sweden. He founded and led the secret Walhalla order at the Suomenlinna fortress. In 1788 he joined the Anjala conspiracy, a group of officers opposing Gustav III's war with Russia; Jägerhorn himself advocated Finnish sovereignty. Condemned to death for treason, he was exiled to Hamburg, where he put Irish rebels in touch with France before the 1798 rising. After two years in the Tower of London (1799–1801), he returned home and sat as a noble delegate at the 1809 Porvoo Diet that established the autonomous Grand Duchy of Finland.
zh: 约翰·安德斯·耶格霍恩（1757—1825）是芬兰贵族、瑞典军队少校，出生于赫尔辛基附近，当时芬兰尚属瑞典。他在芬兰堡创立并领导秘密结社瓦尔哈拉会。1788年他参加安亚拉阴谋，一批军官反对古斯塔夫三世对俄开战；耶格霍恩本人主张芬兰拥有主权。他以叛国罪被判死刑，随后流亡汉堡，在当地为爱尔兰起义者与法国牵线，时值1798年爱尔兰起义前夕。他在伦敦塔被囚禁两年（1799—1801），之后返回芬兰，作为贵族代表出席1809年波尔沃议会，这次会议确立了自治的芬兰大公国。

en: Johan Sverkersson, or John I (c. 1201–1222), was the son of King Sverker II and Ingegerd Birgersdotter. While he was still an infant in 1202, his father gave him the title held by his grandfather Jarl Birger Brosa. After Erik Knutsson died in 1216, the Swedish aristocracy made the teenage Johan king against the Pope's wishes. Crowned in 1219, he confirmed and enlarged his father's privileges for the bishops. A Swedish expedition against the Estonians in his reign ended in disaster. He died unmarried and childless of illness on Visingsö on 10 March 1222 and was buried at Alvastra.
zh: 约翰·斯渥克尔松（即约翰一世，约1201—1222）是斯渥克尔二世与英格耶德·比尔耶斯多塔之子。1202年他尚在襁褓，父亲便把外祖父雅尔比尔耶·布罗萨的头衔授给他。1216年埃里克·克努特松去世后，瑞典贵族不顾教皇意愿拥立少年约翰为王。1219年加冕后，他确认并扩大了父亲给予主教们的特权。他在位期间，瑞典远征爱沙尼亚以惨败告终。1222年3月10日，他在维辛索病逝，未婚无嗣，葬于阿尔瓦斯特拉。

en: Jöran Persson (c. 1530–1568), King Eric XIV of Sweden's most trusted counselor, was the Sala-born son of a priest. After studying at Wittenberg in the 1550s he served Gustav I and then Prince Eric, and was raised to the nobility when Eric took the throne in 1560. He headed the king's network of spies and was widely resented for his influence over Eric. As prosecutor and the king's representative in the royal court he had a role in sentencing; the court passed some 300 death sentences while he served. In 1563 he crushed the revolt of Duke John of Finland and confined him at Gripsholm, and after the Sture murders of 1567 he defended the killings. After Eric's deposition in 1568 he was arrested and executed.
zh: 约兰·佩尔松（约1530—1568）是瑞典国王埃里克十四世最信任的谋臣，生于萨拉，父亲是当地牧师。1550年代他在维滕贝格求学，回国后先后效力古斯塔夫一世与埃里克王子，1560年埃里克即位时被封为贵族。他掌管国王的间谍网络，因对埃里克的影响力而广遭反感。他在王室法庭兼任检察官和国王代表，参与量刑；他任职期间，法庭判处约300人死刑。1563年他镇压芬兰公爵约翰的叛乱，将其囚禁于格里普斯科尔摩城堡；1567年斯图雷谋杀案后，他又为这些杀戮开脱。1568年埃里克被废黜后，他被捕并处决。

en: Knut Jonsson (died between 1345 and 1347) was a Swedish knight of the Aspenäs family, the son of Johan Filipsson. Appointed lawspeaker of Östergötland in 1310, he kept the post for nearly four decades. He held high office across a change of king, sitting on the council of Birger Magnusson and then of Magnus Eriksson, who was elected in 1319 to keep his uncle Birger from returning, and rose to drots, the highest secular office in the realm. He is last attested in 1345 and was dead by 1347. Eighteenth- and nineteenth-century writers sometimes called him Knut Jonsson Blå, tying him to the legendary Joar Blå, a descent no source supports.
zh: 克努特·约恩松（1345至1347年间去世）是出身阿斯彭奈斯家族的瑞典骑士，父亲为约翰·菲利普松。1310年他受命担任东约特兰执法官，在任近四十年。国王换人之后，他仍居高位，先后位列比耶·马格努松与马格努斯·埃里克松两位国王的参政会，后者于1319年被推举为王，为的是不让叔父比耶复位；克努特最终升任全国最高世俗职务德勒茨。1345年的文献中仍有关于他的记载，1347年前已经去世。18、19世纪的作者有时称他为‘蓝色克努特·约恩松’，把他同传说中的蓝色约阿尔联系起来，但没有史料支持这一谱系。

en: Magnus Gabriel De la Gardie (1622–1686) was a Swedish statesman and soldier, the Reval-born son of Field Marshal Jacob De la Gardie. He fought in the 1643 Torstenson War and became Queen Christina's favorite, married the future Charles X Gustav's sister and joined the Privy Council in 1647. In 1653 he lost Christina's favor and left court, but returned to public life when his brother-in-law became king in 1654. Twice Governor-General of Livonia, he held three great offices: Treasurer, Chancellor and Steward. As Lord High Chancellor from 1660 he led Charles XI's regency and championed the French alliance. The defeat at Fehrbellin in 1675 and the Great Reduction of 1680 destroyed his power; he died in 1686.
zh: 马格努斯·加布里埃尔·德拉加尔迪（1622—1686）是瑞典政治家、军人，生于雷瓦尔，父亲是陆军元帅雅各布·德拉加尔迪。他参加了1643年的托尔斯滕松战争，后成为克里斯蒂娜女王的宠臣，娶后来的卡尔十世之妹为妻，并于1647年进入枢密院。1653年他失去女王宠信，离开宫廷；1654年妻兄即位后，他重返政坛。他两度出任利沃尼亚总督，曾先后担任财政大臣、首相和最高法官三大要职。1660年起任首相，主导卡尔十一世幼年时的摄政政府，力主与法国结盟。1675年费尔贝林战败与1680年的大收回使他权势尽失，他于1686年去世。

en: Magnus Eriksson (1316–1374) was three years old when Swedish nobles elected him king at Mora in July 1319, to keep his uncle Birger Magnusson from returning to power. In August Norway acknowledged him too, as the grandson of Haakon V, and two crowns sat on one child. His declaration of majority in 1331 provoked a Norwegian noble rising, which submitted in 1333. In 1332 he bought Scania from Duke Johan of Holstein; the purchase raised taxes and brought war with Denmark, whose King Valdemar renounced the province in 1343 and took it back in 1360. In 1335 he outlawed thralldom for Christian-born children, and his reign gave Sweden its first countryside law code and the mining charters of Norberg and Falun. Critics such as Bridget of Sweden called him weak and ruled by favourites. In 1364 nobles led by Bo Jonsson Grip brought in Albert of Mecklenburg, who was crowned king. Magnus withdrew to Norway, where his son Haakon had reigned since 1355, and drowned in a shipwreck on 1 December 1374.
zh: 马格努斯·埃里克松（1316—1374）三岁时，瑞典贵族于1319年7月在穆拉推举他为王，为的是不让他的叔父比耶·马格努松复位；8月，挪威也承认他是国王，因为他是哈康五世的外孙。两顶王冠就这样落在一个孩子头上。1331年他被宣布成年，引发挪威贵族起事，叛乱者于1333年归顺。1332年，他从霍尔施泰因公爵约翰手中买下斯科讷；这次购买推高了税负，也招来对丹麦的战争，丹麦国王瓦尔德马于1343年放弃该地，1360年又夺了回去。1335年他禁止让基督教父母所生的子女为奴；在他治下，瑞典有了第一部通行乡村的法典，并颁下诺尔贝里和法伦的采矿特许状。瑞典的布丽吉特等批评者斥他软弱、受宠臣摆布。1364年，以博·约恩松·格里普为首的贵族引来梅克伦堡的阿尔布雷希特，后者加冕为王。马格努斯退居挪威，其子哈康自1355年起在那里为王。1374年12月1日，他在一场海难中溺亡。

en: Magnus I, called the Strong (Magnus Nilsson, c. 1106–1134), was the son of Denmark's King Niels and Margaret, daughter of Sweden's Inge the Elder. After his cousin Inge the Younger died in the 1120s, he claimed Sweden through his mother and won recognition from the Geats of Götaland, after the Swedes' king Ragnvald Knaphövde was murdered. In 1127 he married Richeza of Poland, daughter of Bolesław III, and helped conquer Rügen in 1130. In 1131 he had Canute Lavard killed, sparking civil war in Denmark. He fell to Eric Emune at Fotevik in Scania on 4 June 1134.
zh: 马格努斯一世，世称“强人”（马格努斯·尼尔松，约1106—1134），是丹麦王子，父亲为丹麦国王尼尔斯，母亲是瑞典国王老英格之女玛格丽塔。1120年代表亲小英格死后，他以母系血统要求瑞典王位，在瑞典人选出的国王拉格瓦尔德被杀后得到约塔兰约特人的承认。1127年他迎娶波兰公爵波列斯瓦夫三世之女里切扎，并于1130年协助其征服吕根岛。1131年他派人杀死王位竞争者克努特·拉瓦德，引发丹麦内战。1134年6月4日，埃里克二世在斯科讷的福特维肯战役中将他击杀。

en: Magnus II (Magnus Henriksson, c. 1130–1161) was a Danish lord descended from the royal houses of Sweden and Denmark: his mother Ingrid Ragvaldsdotter was a granddaughter of Sweden's Inge I and his father Henrik Skatelår descended from Sweyn II of Denmark. The chronicler Saxo Grammaticus implicates him in the murder of King Sverker the Elder in 1156, and Saint Erik's legend blames him for the ambush that killed Erik at Östra Aros on 18 May 1160. He then ruled most of Sweden for about a year, but was defeated and killed by Karl Sverkersson at Örebro in 1161.
zh: 马格努斯二世（马格努斯·亨里克松，约1130—1161）是丹麦贵族，拥有瑞典和丹麦的王室血统：母亲英格丽·拉格瓦尔德斯多塔是瑞典国王老英格的孙女，父亲亨里克·斯卡德洛是丹麦国王斯文二世的后裔。编年史家萨克索·格拉玛提库斯指称他参与了1156年谋杀国王斯渥克尔一世一事，圣埃里克的传说也把1160年5月18日在埃斯特拉罗斯伏击并杀死埃里克的罪责归于他。此后他统治瑞典大部分地区约一年，1161年在厄勒布鲁被卡尔·斯渥克尔松击败并杀死。

en: Magnus Ladulås (c. 1240–1290), second son of Birger Jarl, was King of Sweden from 1275 until his death. On his father's death in 1266 he inherited the title of Duke of Sweden and received Nyköping Castle. In 1275, backed by King Eric Klipping of Denmark, he rebelled with his brother Erik against their elder brother King Valdemar and defeated him at the Battle of Hova on 14 June, being elected king at the Stones of Mora the following month. In 1276 he married Helvig of Holstein. He lost provinces in Götaland to Valdemar in 1277, recovered them around 1278 and added the title King of the Goths. He died on 18 December 1290, leaving his ten-year-old son Birger to rule under the regency of Torkel Knutsson.
zh: 马格努斯·拉杜洛斯（约1240—1290）是比尔耶尔伯爵的次子，1275年至1290年担任瑞典国王。1266年父亲去世后，他继承瑞典公爵头衔并得到尼雪平城堡。1275年，他在丹麦国王埃里克五世支持下，与弟弟埃里克起兵反对长兄瓦尔德马尔国王，6月14日在霍瓦之战中将其击败，次月在穆拉石阵被拥立为王。1276年他娶荷尔斯泰因的海尔维格为妻。1277年他被迫将约塔兰的部分地区让给瓦尔德马尔，约1278年将其收复，并加上“哥特人之王”的头衔。1290年12月18日他去世，十岁的儿子比耶在托克尔·克努特松摄政下继位。

en: Mikael Agricola (c. 1510–1557) was a Finnish Lutheran clergyman and reformer, regarded as the father of literary Finnish. Born at Pernå in Swedish-ruled Finland, he studied at Viborg and became a scribe in the bishop's office at Turku. From 1536 he studied at Wittenberg under Martin Luther and Philipp Melanchthon. He began translating the New Testament into Finnish in 1537 and returned to Turku as rector of the cathedral school in 1539. His New Testament, Se Wsi Testamenti, appeared in 1548; his prayer books and hymns also helped establish written Finnish. In 1554 he was consecrated bishop of Turku without papal approval. He died in 1557 while returning from Moscow, where he had helped negotiate the Treaty of Novgorod.
zh: 米卡埃尔·阿格里科拉（约1510—1557）是芬兰路德宗神职人员和宗教改革家，被誉为芬兰书面语之父。他生于当时属瑞典的芬兰佩尔诺，在维堡求学后到图尔库的主教办事处任书记。1536年起，他在维滕贝格师从马丁·路德与菲利普·梅兰希通。1537年他开始将《新约》译成芬兰语，1539年返回图尔库担任座堂学校校长。他的《新约》译本于1548年刊行，祈祷书与赞美诗也帮助奠定了芬兰语的书面规范。1554年，他未经教皇批准被祝圣为图尔库主教。1557年，他在赴莫斯科协助谈判《诺夫哥罗德条约》返程途中去世。

en: Olof Skötkonung (c. 980–1022), son of Eric the Victorious, succeeded his father as king of Sweden around 995. He is the first Swedish king known to have ruled both the Swedes and the Geats, and he minted Sweden's first coins at Sigtuna. Baptized in 1008, he fostered Christianity while leaving the pagan cult tolerated. In 1000 he and his ally Sweyn Forkbeard of Denmark destroyed the fleet of Olaf Tryggvason at the Battle of Svolder and divided Norway, Olof receiving Trøndelag and Bohuslän. He died in 1022, leaving the crown to his son Anund Jacob.
zh: 奥洛夫·舍特科农（约980—1022）是胜利者埃里克之子，约995年继承父位为瑞典国王，也是已知第一位同时统治斯韦尔人与约特人的国王，并在西格图纳铸造了瑞典最早的钱币。他于1008年受洗，扶持基督教，同时容许异教祭祀继续存在。1000年，他与盟友丹麦国王八字胡斯文在斯沃尔德海战歼灭奥拉夫·特里格瓦松的舰队，瓜分挪威，奥洛夫分得特伦德拉格和布胡斯兰。他于1022年去世，王位传给儿子阿农德·雅各布。

en: Philip Halstensson, son of Halsten and nephew of Inge the Elder, was king of Sweden from about 1105 or 1110 until 1118, ruling jointly with his younger brother Inge the Younger after their uncle's death. The regnal list of the Westrogothic law calls him a good king, but almost nothing else is recorded of his reign; the Hervarar saga says he ruled only briefly and married Ingegerd, daughter of the Norwegian king Harald Hardrada. He was probably buried beside his brother at Vreta Abbey near Linköping.
zh: 菲利普是哈尔斯滕之子、老英格的侄子，约1105或1110年老英格死后，与弟弟小英格共治瑞典，直到1118年去世。《西约塔兰法》所附国王名录称他为贤君，但关于其统治几乎没有别的记载；《赫瓦拉尔萨迦》说他在位时间不长，娶了挪威国王哈拉尔·哈德拉德的女儿英格耶德。他很可能与弟弟一同葬在林雪平附近的弗列塔修道院。

en: Stenkil (died 1066) became king of Sweden around 1060, succeeding the childless Emund the Old, whose daughter he married, and founding the dynasty that bears his name. Probably rooted in Västergötland, where long tradition placed him at Levene, he was a devout Christian who worked with the bishops sent from Hamburg and Bremen, yet refused to let them destroy the pagan temple at Uppsala for fear of a revolt. His reign saw fighting against Harald Hardrada of Norway. When he died in 1066, about the time of Hastings, his sons Halsten and Inge the Elder later held the throne.
zh: 斯滕克尔（？—1066）约于1060年继承无嗣的厄蒙德·斯莱姆成为瑞典国王，并娶了厄蒙德的女儿，由此开创以他命名的王朝。他的根基可能在西约特兰，传说中居于莱韦内。作为虔诚的基督徒，他与汉堡和不来梅派来的主教合作，却因害怕异教徒暴动而坚决不许他们拆毁乌普萨拉神庙。他在位期间曾与挪威国王哈拉尔·哈德拉德交战。1066年黑斯廷斯战役前后，斯滕克尔去世，其子哈尔斯滕与老英格后来相继登上王位。

en: Sverker the Elder (c. 1100–1156), of non-royal birth, became king of Sweden around 1130 after Stenkil's line ended and founded the House of Sverker, rival of the House of Erik for the next century. In 1142 a Swedish fleet entered the Gulf of Finland, breaking the long peace with Novgorod. When Sweyn III of Denmark invaded Småland in 1153, Sverker avoided battle until winter and peasant resistance forced the Danes out. He later allied with Denmark's Canute V and Valdemar. On Christmas Day 1156 he was murdered at Alebäck bridge near Alvastra; his son Charles later became king of Sweden.
zh: 老斯韦克（约1100—1156）出身非王族，约1130年斯滕克尔王朝绝嗣后成为瑞典国王，开创斯韦克王朝；此后一个世纪，该家族与埃里克家族交替争夺王位。1142年，一支瑞典舰队驶入芬兰湾，打破了与诺夫哥罗德的长期和平。1153年丹麦国王斯文三世入侵斯莫兰，斯韦克避战不出，丹麦人最终在寒冬和乡民抵抗下败退；他随后与丹麦争位者卡努特五世、瓦尔德马结盟。1156年圣诞节，他在阿尔瓦斯特拉附近的阿勒拜克桥遇刺身亡；其子查理后来成为瑞典国王。

en: Sverker the Younger, or Sverker II (before 1167–1210), was the son of King Karl Sverkersson of Sweden and grew up in Denmark after his father was killed in 1167. Chosen king in 1196, he issued a charter of church privileges in 1200, the oldest surviving document of its kind in Sweden, and married Ingegerd, daughter of Jarl Birger Brosa. In 1205 he defeated the sons of Knut Eriksson at Älgarås, but in 1208 Erik Knutsson overthrew him at the Battle of Lena. Returning with Danish backing, Sverker was killed at the Battle of Gestilren on 17 July 1210.
zh: 斯渥克尔二世（小斯渥克尔松，1167年前—1210）是瑞典国王卡尔七世之子，1167年父亲遇害后在丹麦长大。1196年他被拥立为瑞典国王，1200年颁布教会特权状，这是瑞典现存最早的同类文件；他还娶了雅尔比尔耶·布罗萨之女英格耶德。1205年，他在艾尔加罗斯击败克努特·埃里克松诸子，但1208年于莱纳之战被埃里克·克努特松打败推翻。他在丹麦支持下回国争位，1210年7月17日战死于耶斯蒂尔伦之战。

en: Valdemar Birgersson (1239–1302) of the House of Bjälbo, eldest son of Birger Jarl and Ingeborg Eriksdotter, was elected King of Sweden in 1250 after his uncle Erik Eriksson died, and crowned at Linköping in 1251. Birger Jarl ruled as regent until 1266. Valdemar married Sofia of Denmark in 1260, but his affair with her sister Jutta in 1272 forced a pilgrimage to Rome. On 14 June 1275 his brother Magnus Ladulås defeated and deposed him at Hova. He briefly held Götaland in 1277, was imprisoned in Nyköping Castle in 1288, and died on 26 December 1302.
zh: 瓦尔德马尔·比耶松（1239—1302）出身比耶尔博家族，是比耶尔·雅尔与英格堡·埃里克斯多塔的长子。1250年舅父埃里克·埃里克松去世后，他被推举为瑞典国王，1251年在林雪平加冕；因年幼，由父亲比耶尔·雅尔摄政，直到1266年其父去世。1260年他娶丹麦的索菲娅为妻，1272年又与索菲娅之妹尤塔私通，为此被迫赴罗马朝圣。1275年6月14日，弟弟马格努斯·拉杜洛斯在霍瓦战役中将他击败并废黜。1277年他一度据有约塔兰，1288年被囚禁在尼雪平城堡，1302年12月26日去世。

en: Valdemar Magnusson (c. 1282–1318), third son of King Magnus Ladulås of the House of Bjälbo, was made Duke of Finland at his brother Birger's coronation in 1302. With his brother Erik he warred against King Birger: the Håtuna capture of 1306 and the Peace of Helsingborg in 1310 left the realm divided between the king and the two dukes, and in 1315 Valdemar took the east, including Stockholm and the Finnish strongholds Åbo and Tavastehus, holding court on Öland. In Oslo in 1312 he married Ingeborg of Norway. Seized with Erik at the Nyköping Banquet on 10 December 1317, he died in Nyköping Castle in 1318.
