zh: 瓦尔德马尔·马格努松（约1282—1318）是瑞典国王马格努斯·拉杜洛斯的第三子，属比耶尔博家族，1302年在兄长比耶尔加冕时受封芬兰公爵。他与兄长埃里克联手同国王比耶尔交战：1306年在“霍图纳游戏”中俘虏国王，1310年的《赫尔辛堡和约》将王国划分为国王与两位公爵的领地；1315年，他分得东部领地，包括斯德哥尔摩以及芬兰的奥布、塔瓦斯泰胡斯据点，并把宫廷设在厄兰岛。1312年他在奥斯陆娶挪威的英格堡为妻。1317年12月10日，他与埃里克在“尼雪平宴会”上被比耶尔拘捕，1318年死于尼雪平城堡的囚所。

en: Huldrych Zwingli (1484–1531) led the Reformation in Switzerland. Born on 1 January 1484 in Wildhaus, Toggenburg, he studied at Vienna and Basel under Erasmian humanism and was a parish priest before becoming people's priest at Zurich's Grossmünster in 1519. There he began preaching through the Gospel of Matthew and later the whole New Testament. He attacked Lenten fasting in 1522, clerical celibacy, images and the Mass, introducing a Reformed communion liturgy in 1525 and making Zurich a model Protestant city. He formed an alliance of Reformed cantons against the Catholic cantons. At Marburg in 1529 he and Luther could not agree over the Eucharist. After a failed 1531 blockade of the Catholic cantons, they attacked Zurich and Zwingli fell at Kappel on 11 October.
zh: 乌利希·慈运理（1484—1531）是瑞士宗教改革的领袖。他于1484年1月1日生于托根堡山谷的维尔德豪斯，曾在维也纳和巴塞尔求学，受伊拉斯谟式人文主义熏陶，担任堂区神父后于1519年出任苏黎世格罗斯明斯特教堂的民众神父。他在那里开始连续讲解《马太福音》，后来讲遍《新约》。他在1522年抨击大斋期斋戒，随后攻击神职独身、圣像与弥撒，1525年推行改革派圣餐礼仪，使苏黎世成为新教城市的典范。他联合改革派诸州，与天主教诸州对立。1529年马尔堡会谈上，他与路德未能就圣餐问题达成一致。1531年对天主教诸州的粮食封锁失败，对方突袭苏黎世，慈运理于10月11日在卡佩尔阵亡。

en: Theophrastus Bombast von Hohenheim (1493–1541), born at Einsiedeln in the Swiss canton of Schwyz, called himself Paracelsus and became a revolutionary physician of the German Renaissance. His father, a physician, taught him medicine, botany and mineralogy. After his doctorate at Ferrara around 1516 he travelled Europe as an army surgeon. He was called to the sickbed of the Basel printer Johann Froben. In 1527 he became city physician of Basel, where he lectured in German rather than Latin and publicly burned Avicenna's Canon. Quarrels with the faculty and magistrates drove him out in 1528. He wandered through Germany and Switzerland, writing treatises that grounded medicine in observation, chemistry and mineral remedies, and died at Salzburg in 1541.
zh: 特奥夫拉斯图斯·邦巴斯特·冯·霍恩海姆（1493—1541）生于施维茨州的艾恩西德恩，自称帕拉塞尔苏斯，是德意志文艺复兴时期具有革命色彩的医生。他的父亲是一名医生，教授他医学、植物学和矿物学。约1516年他在费拉拉取得博士学位，随后周游欧洲，当过军医。他应召为巴塞尔印刷商约翰·弗罗本诊病。1527年他出任巴塞尔城市医生，用德语而非拉丁语讲学，并当众焚毁阿维森纳的《医典》。他与教授会和市政当局冲突不断，1528年被迫离开巴塞尔，此后辗转德意志与瑞士各地著书立说，主张医学应以观察、化学和矿物药物为基础，1541年在萨尔茨堡去世。

en: Gunzelin III (died 1274) inherited the County of Schwerin in 1228 from his father Henry I, ruling under his mother Audacia's regency. After the Battle of Bornhöved, the captive Duke Otto I of Brunswick confirmed Gunzelin as holder of the fiefs Schwerin held from Brunswick. In 1230 he was betrothed to Margaret, daughter of Henry Borwin II of Mecklenburg, and married her in 1241. With his mother he founded Zarrentin Abbey in 1246, and in 1267 he became patron of the Archbishopric of Riga. When he died in 1274, his sons Helmold III and Niklot I split the county into Schwerin and Wittenburg lines.
zh: 贡采林三世（？—1274）于1228年继承父亲亨利一世的什未林伯国，由母亲奥达恰摄政。博恩赫沃德之战后，被俘的不伦瑞克公爵奥托一世确认贡采林持有什未林从不伦瑞克领受的封地。1230年，他与梅克伦堡侯爵海因里希·博尔温二世之女玛格丽特定亲，1241年成婚。1246年，他与母亲共同创立察伦廷修道院；1267年他成为里加大主教区的庇护人。1274年他去世后，儿子黑尔莫尔德三世与尼克洛特一世瓜分伯国，形成什未林与维滕堡两支。

en: Henry III of Schwerin (died 1344), son of Count Helmold III, was born no earlier than 1289. Until 1307–1310 he ruled jointly with his elder brother Gunzelin V, who died childless, leaving Henry the greater part of the county with Schwerin, Neustadt and Marnitz, while kinsmen held Boizenburg and Wittenburg. In 1316 he married Elisabeth, daughter of Count Adolf VI of Holstein-Schauenburg. Henry died between 7 June and 16 December 1344 without children, the last of the elder line of Schwerin counts, and his lands passed to Nicholas II and Otto I.
zh: 什未林的海因里希三世（1344年卒）是伯爵赫尔莫尔德三世之子，不早于1289年出生。1307至1310年以前，他与长兄贡采林五世共治；长兄无嗣而终后，他领有伯国大部，辖什未林、诺伊施塔特和马尔尼茨诸城，博伊岑堡和维滕堡则在亲族手中。1316年，他娶荷尔斯泰因-绍恩堡伯爵阿道夫六世之女伊丽莎白为妻。海因里希于1344年6月7日至12月16日之间去世，无嗣，是什未林伯爵长系的最后一人，其领地转归尼古劳斯二世和奥托一世。

en: Helmold III (before 1228 – c. 1296) was the son of Count Gunzelin III of Schwerin and Margaret of Mecklenburg. On his father's death in 1274 he inherited the Schwerin portion of the divided county, ruling Schwerin, Neustadt and Marnitz. He married three times; his wives included a daughter of Adolf I of Dannenberg and, from 1264, Margaret of Schleswig. His son by the first marriage, Gunzelin V, succeeded him in 1296, while Henry III, his son by Margaret, later held Boizenburg and Crivitz. Helmold last appears in a charter of 25 August 1295 and was dead by May 1296.
zh: 黑尔莫尔德三世（1228年前—约1296）是什未林伯爵贡采林三世与梅克伦堡的玛格丽特之子。1274年父亲去世后，他继承被瓜分的伯国中的什未林部分，领有什未林、诺伊施塔特和马尔尼茨。他一生三次结婚，妻子包括丹嫩贝格的阿道夫一世之女，以及1264年迎娶的石勒苏益格的玛格丽特。第一次婚姻所生之子贡采林五世于1296年继位，他与玛格丽特所生之子亨利三世后来领有博伊岑堡和克里维茨。黑尔莫尔德最后见于1295年8月25日的文书，1296年5月前已去世。

en: Niklot I (c. 1250–1323) was the youngest son of Count Gunzelin III of Schwerin and Margaret of Mecklenburg. When his father died in 1274, the brothers divided the county and Niklot received Wittenburg, founding the Schwerin-Wittenburg line. He married Elisabeth, daughter of Count John I of Holstein-Kiel, and after her death Miroslawa, daughter of Duke Barnim I of Pomerania. His son Gunzelin VI succeeded as count at Wittenburg, while his daughter Anastasia married Duke Waldemar IV of Schleswig and then Count Gerhard IV of Holstein-Plön. Niklot died in 1323.
zh: 尼克洛特一世（约1250—1323）是什未林伯爵贡采林三世与梅克伦堡的玛格丽特的幼子。1274年父亲去世后，诸子瓜分伯国，尼克洛特得到维滕堡，开创什未林-维滕堡支系。他先娶荷尔斯泰因-基尔伯爵约翰一世之女伊丽莎白，妻子死后又娶波美拉尼亚公爵巴尔尼姆一世之女米罗斯拉娃。其子贡采林六世继位为维滕堡伯爵，女儿阿纳斯塔西娅先嫁石勒苏益格公爵瓦尔德马四世，后嫁荷尔斯泰因-普伦伯爵格哈德四世。尼克洛特于1323年去世。

en: Agnes of Schwarzburg-Blankenburg (died 13 April 1399) was a daughter of Count Gunther IX of Schwarzburg-Arnstadt and Elizabeth of Hohnstein. In 1366 she married Herman IV of Henneberg-Aschach, with a papal dispensation in 1369; their son was Frederick I. She was buried at Frauenroth Abbey.
zh: 施瓦茨堡-布兰肯堡的阿格妮丝（卒于1399年4月13日）是施瓦茨堡-阿恩施塔特伯爵君特九世与霍恩施泰因的伊丽莎白之女。1366年她嫁给亨讷贝格-阿沙赫伯爵赫尔曼四世，1369年获教宗特恩，子为腓特烈一世，葬于弗劳恩罗特修道院。

en: Elizabeth of Schwarzburg-Blankenburg was a daughter of Count Gunther IX of Schwarzburg-Arnstadt, the anti-king of 1349, and Elizabeth of Hohnstein. She became a nun at Ilm Abbey near Arnstadt, where she is documented from 1367 to 1378, and died around 1380.
zh: 施瓦茨堡-布兰肯堡的伊丽莎白是施瓦茨堡-阿恩施塔特伯爵君特九世（1349年的对立国王）与霍恩施泰因的伊丽莎白之女。她在阿恩施塔特附近的伊尔姆修道院出家，1367—1378年间见于记载，约1380年去世。

en: Elisabeth of Schwarzburg-Blankenburg (b. c. 1327) was a daughter of Count Henry VII (X) of Schwarzburg-Blankenburg and Elisabeth of Weimar-Orlamünde. She became a nun at Ilm convent, where she is documented from 1339 to 1365.
zh: 施瓦茨堡-布兰肯堡的伊丽莎白（约1327年生）是施瓦茨堡-布兰肯堡伯爵海因里希七世（十世）与魏玛-奥拉明德的伊丽莎白之女，在伊尔姆修道院当修女，1339至1365年间有文献可考。

en: Elisabeth of Hohnstein (c. 1302–1380) was the daughter of Count Henry IV of Hohnstein-Klettenberg. By 9 September 1331 she was married to Count Günther XXI of Schwarzburg-Blankenburg, the future anti-king, and bore him a son, Henry XIII, and four daughters, Sophia, Agnes, Elisabeth and Mechtild. When Günther died at Frankfurt in June 1349 after renouncing the crown, Elisabeth survived him by more than thirty years as countess dowager, and died around 4 April 1380.
zh: 霍恩施泰因的伊丽莎白（约1302—1380）是霍恩施泰因-克莱滕贝格伯爵海因里希四世之女。1331年9月9日之前，她已嫁给施瓦茨堡-布兰肯堡伯爵、后来的对立国王京特尔二十一世，生下儿子海因里希十三世以及索菲、阿格尼丝、伊丽莎白、梅希蒂尔德四个女儿。1349年6月京特尔放弃王位后在法兰克福去世，伊丽莎白作为伯爵遗孀又活了三十多年，于1380年4月4日前后亡故。

en: Elisabeth of Weimar-Orlamünde (c. 1308–1363) was the daughter of Count Otto IV of Weimar-Orlamünde and Catherine of Hesse. Before 5 June 1321 she married Count Henry VII (X) of Schwarzburg-Blankenburg, who ruled Blankenburg and half of Arnstadt. Their children were Henry IX, Günther XI, Jutta, who married a count of Mansfeld, and Elisabeth, a nun at Ilm. Her husband died on pilgrimage to Jerusalem before March 1338, leaving her a dowager countess. She died after 26 February 1363 and was buried at Saalfeld.
zh: 魏玛-奥拉明德的伊丽莎白（约1308—1363）是魏玛-奥拉明德伯爵奥托四世与黑森的卡塔琳娜之女。1321年6月5日之前，她嫁给施瓦茨堡-布兰肯堡伯爵海因里希七世（十世），后者统治布兰肯堡和半个阿恩施塔特。两人的子女有海因里希九世、京特尔十一世、嫁给曼斯费尔德伯爵的尤塔，以及在伊尔姆出家的伊丽莎白。丈夫在1338年3月前前往耶路撒冷朝圣时亡故，她成为伯爵遗孀。她于1363年2月26日之后去世，葬于萨尔费尔德。

en: Günther von Schwarzburg (1304–1349), count of Schwarzburg-Blankenburg, was a younger son of Count Henry VII and Christine von Gleichen. By 1331 he was married to Elisabeth of Hohnstein, by whom he had five children. A diplomat of Emperor Louis IV, he led the Wittelsbach party after Louis's death in 1347. On 30 January 1349 four electors chose him at Frankfurt as anti-king against Charles IV, whose army routed Günther's forces at Eltville. By the Treaty of Eltville (26 May 1349) he renounced the crown; he died at Frankfurt on 14 June 1349 and was buried in Frankfurt Cathedral.
zh: 施瓦茨堡的京特尔（1304—1349），施瓦茨堡-布兰肯堡伯爵，是伯爵海因里希七世与格莱申的克里斯蒂娜较年幼的儿子。1331年他已与霍恩施泰因的伊丽莎白成婚，两人育有五个子女。作为皇帝路易四世麾下的外交官，他在1347年路易死后成为维特尔斯巴赫一派的领袖。1349年1月30日，四名选侯在法兰克福推举他为对抗查理四世的对立国王，但其军队在埃尔特维勒被查理击溃。依1349年5月26日的《埃尔特维勒条约》，他放弃王位，并于1349年6月14日在法兰克福去世，葬于法兰克福大教堂。

en: Gunther XI of Schwarzburg-Blankenburg (9 September 1331 - 6 June 1368) was a son of Count Henry VII, who died on pilgrimage to Jerusalem in 1338, and Elizabeth of Weimar-Orlamunde. Before June 1347 he married Elizabeth of Hohnstein-Sondershausen. He ruled half of Arnstadt and, from 1356, Sondershausen, and in June 1367 he held Belitz as a pledge lord. He died in 1368 and was buried in the Liebfrauenkirche at Arnstadt, leaving sons Henry XIV and Gunther XVI.
zh: 君特十一世·冯·施瓦茨堡-布兰肯堡（1331年9月9日—1368年6月6日）是伯爵亨利希七世与魏玛-奥拉明德的伊丽莎白之子，其父1338年在前往耶路撒冷朝圣途中去世。1347年6月前，他娶霍恩施泰因-松德斯豪森的伊丽莎白。他领有半个阿恩施塔特，1356年起又入主松德斯豪森，1367年6月受质领有贝利茨。他于1368年去世，葬于阿恩施塔特圣母教堂，遗子亨利希十四世与君特十六世。

en: Henry VI, also numbered Henry VII (before 1285–1324), ruled Schwarzburg-Blankenburg, which he inherited from his father Count Henry V; his mother was Sophie of Halych, daughter of King Daniel of Galicia. In 1290 he received Blankenburg, adding Wachsenburg, Stadtilm and half of Arnstadt in 1306 and Saalfeld in 1323. He was guardian of his nephew Margrave Frederick the Serious of Meissen. His son by Christina of Gleichen, Günther XXI, was elected King of Germany at Frankfurt in 1349 against Charles IV. Henry died on 11 November 1324 on campaign in Brandenburg and was buried in Berlin's Grey Monastery.
zh: 亨利六世（亦被排作亨利七世，1285年前—1324）统治施瓦茨堡-布兰肯堡，伯国袭自父亲亨利五世；母亲是加利奇国王丹尼尔之女索菲娅。1290年他领有布兰肯堡，1306年又得到瓦克森堡、施塔特伊尔姆和半个阿恩施塔特，1323年再得萨尔费尔德。他曾担任外甥、迈森藩侯严肃者腓特烈的监护人。他与格莱辛的克里斯蒂娜所生之子京特尔二十一世于1349年在法兰克福被选为德意志国王，与查理四世争位。1324年11月11日，亨利在勃兰登堡行军期间去世，葬于柏林灰衣修士修道院。

en: Henry VII (X), count of Schwarzburg-Blankenburg (c. 1298–1338), was the elder son of Count Henry VI and Christine von Gleichen, and elder brother of the anti-king Günther XXI. From his father's death in 1324 he ruled Blankenburg, he held half of Arnstadt from 1326, and he held pledged Rudolstadt from 1334. Before 5 June 1321 he married Elisabeth, daughter of Count Otto IV of Weimar-Orlamünde; their children included Henry IX, Günther XI and Jutta. Last documented in 1336, he died on pilgrimage to Jerusalem before 4 March 1338. His widow survived until 1363 and was buried at Saalfeld.
zh: 海因里希七世（十世），施瓦茨堡-布兰肯堡伯爵（约1298—1338），是伯爵海因里希六世与格莱申的克里斯蒂娜的长子，也是后来的对立国王京特尔二十一世之兄。1324年父亲死后他统治布兰肯堡，1326年起领有半个阿恩施塔特，1334年以典当方式取得鲁多尔施塔特。1321年6月5日之前，他娶魏玛-奥拉明德伯爵奥托四世之女伊丽莎白为妻，子女包括海因里希九世、京特尔十一世和尤塔。他最后见于1336年的文献，在前往耶路撒冷朝圣途中于1338年3月4日之前亡故。其遗孀活到1363年，葬于萨尔费尔德。

en: Henry IX (XII), called the Younger (c. 1325–1372/73), was the elder son of Count Henry VII (X) of Schwarzburg-Blankenburg and Elisabeth of Weimar-Orlamünde. On 24 February 1338 he married Agnes of Hohnstein-Sondershausen. He held Schlotheim, Rudolstadt and Frankenhausen from 1340, half of Arnstadt from 1343, and Blankenburg with Saalfeld from 1346, adding Sondershausen and Ehrenstein in 1356. He sat as imperial judge (Hofrichter) in 1363–1365 and served as captain of the Altmark in 1366. He died between 21 May 1372 and 4 December 1373.
zh: 海因里希九世（十二世），绰号“年轻者”（约1325—1372/1373），是施瓦茨堡-布兰肯堡伯爵海因里希七世（十世）与魏玛-奥拉明德的伊丽莎白的长子。1338年2月24日，他与霍恩施泰因-松德斯豪森的阿格尼丝成婚。他自1340年起领有施洛特海姆、鲁多尔施塔特和弗兰肯豪森，1343年起领有半个阿恩施塔特，1346年起领有布兰肯堡与萨尔费尔德，1356年又取得松德斯豪森和埃伦施泰因。1363至1365年他任宫廷法官，1366年任阿尔特马克长官。他于1372年5月21日至1373年12月4日之间去世。

en: Jutta of Schwarzburg-Blankenburg was a daughter of Count Henry VII of Schwarzburg-Blankenburg and a sister of Counts Henry IX and Gunther XI. She married Count Albert I of Mansfeld (died 1361-1362), appears in charters in 1357, and died around 1358-1361, leaving Elizabeth and Lutrud.
zh: 施瓦茨堡-布兰肯堡的尤塔是伯爵亨利希七世之女，伯爵亨利希九世、君特十一世的姊妹。她嫁给曼斯费尔德伯爵阿尔布雷希特一世（卒于1361—1362年），见于1357年的记载，约1358—1361年间去世，遗有伊丽莎白、卢特鲁德二女。

en: Sophie of Schwarzburg-Blankenburg was the daughter of Count Gunther IX, who was elected anti-king against Charles IV in January 1349 and died at Frankfurt that June, and Elizabeth of Hohnstein. In November 1353 she married Count George of Kafernburg, a union dissolved despite a papal dispensation. Before November 1357 she married Frederick of Orlamunde-Lauenstein, later Count Henry XI of Stolberg, and finally John II of Schwarzburg-Wachsenburg. She is last documented in 1394 and 1395.
zh: 施瓦茨堡-布兰肯堡的索菲是伯爵君特九世与霍恩施泰因的伊丽莎白之女；君特九世于1349年1月被推举为与查理四世对立的对立国王，同年6月在法兰克福去世。1353年11月，她嫁给凯弗恩堡伯爵格奥尔格，这场婚姻虽获教宗特恩仍被解除。1357年11月前，她改嫁奥拉明德-劳恩施泰因的腓特烈，其后又嫁给施托尔堡伯爵亨利希十一世，最后嫁给施瓦茨堡-瓦克斯堡的约翰二世。她最后见于1394—1395年的文书。

en: Godfrey of Sayn (c. 1290 – 18 October 1327) was the eldest son of Count John II of Sayn and Elizabeth of Hesse, daughter of Landgrave Henry I of Hesse. From 1314 he ruled alongside his father, and in November 1324 he succeeded as Count of Sayn. In 1324 King Louis the Bavarian allowed him to fortify Friedewald in the Westerwald. His wife Matilda of the Mark died before 1327, and Godfrey himself died on 18 October that year, after only three years ruling alone.
zh: 赛恩的戈弗雷（约1290—1327年10月18日）是赛恩伯爵约翰二世与黑森方伯亨利一世之女伊丽莎白的长子。1314年起他与父亲共同执政，1324年11月继位为赛恩伯爵。1324年，国王巴伐利亚人路易准许他在韦斯特林山的弗里德瓦尔德修筑城防。他的妻子马克的玛蒂尔达先于他去世，戈弗雷本人也在1327年10月18日去世，独自执政仅三年。

en: John II of Sayn (c. 1270 – 23 November 1324) was the son of Count Godfrey I of Sponheim-Sayn and Jutta of Isenburg. His father died on 31 October 1283 and he inherited the County of Sayn the following year; his brother Engelbert I took Homburg and founded the Sayn-Homburg line. His heir Godfrey was born to his wife Elizabeth, daughter of Landgrave Henry I of Hesse, and he also left a younger son, John. John II ruled Sayn until his death in November 1324.
zh: 赛恩伯爵约翰二世（约1270—1324年11月23日）是施蓬海姆-赛恩伯爵戈弗雷一世与伊森堡的尤塔之子。父亲于1283年10月31日去世，他次年继承赛恩伯国；弟弟恩格尔贝特一世分得洪堡，开创赛恩-洪堡支系。继承人戈弗雷为妻子、黑森方伯亨利一世之女伊丽莎白所生，他还有幼子约翰。约翰二世统治赛恩，直至1324年11月去世。

en: John III of Sayn (born c. 1313, died after 1360) was Count of Sayn from 1324 to 1359. After his father John II died in 1324, his kinsman Godfrey II was co-ruler until 1327. He married Elizabeth of Julich and was father of John IV.
zh: 塞恩的约翰三世（约1313年生，1360年后卒）于1324—1359年任塞恩伯爵。其父约翰二世1324年去世后，亲族戈特弗里德二世共同执政至1327年。他娶于利希的伊丽莎白，是约翰四世之父。

en: Burtel Orbelian, called the Long-Lived, ruled the Orbelian principality of Syunik from about 1300 to 1349, succeeding his father Elikum. He reunited the divided Orbelian lands and served as commander-in-chief of the Armenian and Georgian armies. Syunik prospered under him: the architect Momik built the churches of Areni (1321) and Spitakavor (1322) and the two-storey Burtelashen mausoleum church at Noravank (1339). In the 1340s the Ilkhanids made him governor-amir of their capitals Sultaniya and Tabriz. After he died around 1349, succession strife weakened Syunik, and his line was called the Burtelians.
zh: 绰号“长寿者”的布尔特尔·奥尔别良约于1300—1349年统治奥尔别良家族的休尼克侯国，继承其父埃利库姆之位。他重新统一分裂的家族领地，并任亚美尼亚与格鲁吉亚军队的最高统帅。他治下休尼克经济繁荣、文化活跃：建筑师莫米克修建了阿雷尼教堂（1321年）、斯皮塔卡沃尔教堂（1322年）以及诺拉旺克的双层陵寝教堂布尔泰拉申（1339年）。1340年代，伊儿汗国任命他为都城苏丹尼耶与大不里士的城官埃米尔。他约1349年去世后，继承人内讧削弱了侯国，他这一支被称为布尔特尔派。

en: Aleksandr Vasilyevich (died 1331) was Prince of Suzdal from 1309, when he succeeded his father Vasily, and Grand Prince of Vladimir from 1328. In 1327 he joined Ivan I of Moscow in Ozbeg Khan's punitive expedition against Tver after its anti-Tatar uprising, and the city was sacked. The khan rewarded him in 1328 with the grand princely title, shared with Ivan: Aleksandr received Vladimir while Ivan took Novgorod and Kostroma. In 1329 he campaigned against the fugitive prince of Tver sheltered in Pskov. He died in 1331 and his brother Konstantin inherited Suzdal.
zh: 亚历山大·瓦西里耶维奇（？—1331）自1309年父亲瓦西里去世后成为苏兹达尔王公，1328年起任弗拉基米尔大公。1327年特维尔爆发反鞑靼人起义，他随莫斯科王公伊凡一世参加月即别汗下令的征讨，特维尔城遭到洗劫。1328年，大汗以大公封号作为奖赏，由他与伊凡分治：他得到弗拉基米尔，伊凡得到诺夫哥罗德和科斯特罗马。1329年，他又参与讨伐逃到普斯科夫避难的特维尔王公。1331年他去世后，弟弟康斯坦丁继承苏兹达尔。

en: Konstantin Vasilyevich (died 1355), a younger son of Prince Vasily of Suzdal, succeeded his brother as prince of Suzdal in 1331. Exploiting strife at the Golden Horde's capital Sarai, he secured Nizhny Novgorod and Gorodets, and in 1350 moved his seat to Nizhny Novgorod as grand prince of Nizhny Novgorod-Suzdal, extending his rule over Mordvin lands with Russian colonists. After Simeon of Moscow died in 1353, he contested the grand princely throne with Ivan II, backed by Novgorod, but the khan granted the patent to Ivan. He made peace with Moscow in 1355 and died the same year.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/康斯坦丁·瓦西里耶维奇_(苏兹达尔)
zh: 康斯坦丁·瓦西里耶维奇（？—1355）是苏兹达尔王公瓦西里之子，1331年继兄长之后成为苏兹达尔王公。他利用金帐汗国首都萨莱的内乱取得下诺夫哥罗德和戈罗杰茨，1350年把驻地迁往下诺夫哥罗德，成为下诺夫哥罗德—苏兹达尔大公，并向莫尔多瓦人的土地扩张、迁入罗斯拓殖者。1353年莫斯科的谢苗死后，他在诺夫哥罗德支持下与伊凡二世争夺大公之位，但汗将册封诰命给了伊凡。1355年他与莫斯科修好，同年去世。

en: Mikhail Andreevich was Prince of Suzdal from 1279, a son of Andrey Yaroslavich of Suzdal. The Nikon Chronicle records that he held Gorodets until 1279, when the death of his elder brother Yury brought him the Suzdal throne. In 1303 he joined Andrey Alexandrovich of Gorodets, then grand prince of Vladimir, at the consecration of a church in Vologda. In 1305, after marrying a Tatar princess in the Golden Horde, he returned to Russia and punished the people of Nizhny Novgorod who had killed the late grand prince's boyars. He died that same year.
zh: 米哈伊尔·安德烈耶维奇是1279年起的苏兹达尔王公，安德烈·雅罗斯拉维奇之子。据《尼康编年史》记载，他此前领有戈罗杰茨，1279年兄长尤里去世后才登上苏兹达尔公位。1303年，他与时任弗拉基米尔大公的戈罗杰茨王公安德烈·亚历山德罗维奇一同在沃洛格达参加教堂祝圣仪式。1305年，他在金帐汗国娶一位鞑靼公主为妻，返回罗斯后惩治了下诺夫哥罗德杀害已故大公波雅尔的居民。他于同年去世。

en: Vasily (died 1309) was Prince of Suzdal from 1305 to 1309. The Nikon Chronicle mentions him only in the entry for his death, calling him Vasily Mikhailovich, while older genealogical books list him as a son of Andrey Yaroslavich. His sons Alexander and Konstantin both became princes of Suzdal, and the question of his parentage bears on the history of the Suzdal, Gorodets and later Nizhny Novgorod-Suzdal principalities and on the origins of the Shuysky princely house.
zh: 瓦西里（？—1309）是1305至1309年在位的苏兹达尔王公。《尼康编年史》仅在1309年他去世的条目下提到他，称他为瓦西里·米哈伊洛维奇，而更早的谱系书则把他记作安德烈·雅罗斯拉维奇之子。他的两个儿子亚历山大和康斯坦丁后来都成为苏兹达尔王公；他的父系归属关系到苏兹达尔、戈罗杰茨及后来的下诺夫哥罗德—苏兹达尔大公国的历史，也关系到舒伊斯基王公家族的起源。

en: Yury Andreevich (c. 1250–1279) was the eldest son of Andrey Yaroslavich, Prince of Suzdal, and a nephew of Alexander Nevsky. On his father's death in 1264 he inherited Suzdal, though Gorodets had been assigned elsewhere. In 1267 his uncle, Grand Prince Yaroslav Yaroslavich of Tver, placed him as viceroy in Novgorod, where he spent most of his career. He was one of the Russian commanders at the Battle of Rakovor in 1268 against the Livonian knights and Danes, and in 1269 drove the Germans away from Pskov. He died on 8 March 1279 and was buried in Suzdal, leaving no children.
zh: 尤里·安德烈耶维奇（约1250—1279）是苏兹达尔王公安德烈·雅罗斯拉维奇的长子，亚历山大·涅夫斯基的侄子。1264年父亲去世后他继承苏兹达尔，但戈罗杰茨已被封给他人。1267年，叔父特维尔王公雅罗斯拉夫·雅罗斯拉维奇大公任命他为诺夫哥罗德总督，他大半生都在那里度过。1268年，他是拉科沃尔战役中迎战利沃尼亚骑士团与丹麦人的罗斯军指挥者之一，1269年又把日耳曼人逐出普斯科夫。1279年3月8日他去世，葬于苏兹达尔，无嗣。

en: Gabriele Tadino (c. 1476–1543) was an Italian soldier and military engineer born near Bergamo. He entered Venetian service in 1508 and in 1513 took charge of Crema's fortifications. In 1522 he helped defend Rhodes against the Ottomans as superintendent of the Order's fortresses, losing his right eye to an arquebus shot while inspecting them. In 1532 he commanded imperial artillery at Vienna when Suleiman's army turned back. He had met Niccolò Tartaglia as a child at Brescia in 1512; his friend later dedicated his Euclid translation to him. Titian portrayed him in 1538 in the black robe of a Hospitaller knight. He died at Venice in 1543.
zh: 加布里埃尔·塔迪诺（约1476—1543）是意大利军人与军事工程师，生于贝加莫附近。1508年他加入威尼斯军队，1513年主持克雷马筑城。1522年，他以医院骑士团要塞总监身份协助守卫罗得岛、抵御奥斯曼人，在视察工事时被火绳枪子弹击中，失去右眼。1532年他指挥帝国炮兵驻守维也纳，苏莱曼的大军最终撤退。他于1512年在布雷西亚结识年幼的尼科洛·塔尔塔利亚，后者把欧几里得译作题献给他。1538年提香为他画像，画中他身着医院骑士的黑袍。1543年他在威尼斯去世。

en: Curátame Uanacaze was a Purépecha cazonci in the Lake Pátzcuaro basin, credited with founding the lakeside town of Erongarícuaro in 1324.
zh: 库拉塔梅·瓦纳卡泽是帕茨夸罗盆地的普雷佩查卡松奇，据记载于1324年建立湖畔城镇埃龙加里夸罗。

en: The wife of Pauácume II, lord of Pátzcuaro, was an island woman from Jarácuaro in Lake Pátzcuaro and the mother of Tariácuri, founder of the Purépecha state. Her name was not recorded.
zh: 保阿库梅二世之妻是帕茨夸罗湖岛上哈拉夸罗地方的女子，也是普雷佩查国家建立者塔里亚库里的母亲，其名字没有流传下来。

en: Pauácume II of the Uanacaze clan was lord of Pátzcuaro in the fourteenth century and an axamiecha, a sacrificing priest of the fire god Curicaueri. He married a woman of Jarácuaro and was the father of Tariácuri, dying when his son was still small.
zh: 保阿库梅二世·瓦纳卡泽是14世纪帕茨夸罗的首领，出身瓦纳卡泽氏族，兼任火神库里考埃里的献祭祭司。他娶哈拉夸罗女子为妻，是塔里亚库里之父，在儿子尚幼时便已去世。

en: Pauácume Uanacaze was an early Purépecha cazonci in the Lake Pátzcuaro basin. The Relación de Michoacán records that he succeeded his father Sicuirancha, who died aged about ninety, and that his reign opened a stable period of five successive cazoncis.
zh: 保阿库梅·瓦纳卡泽是帕茨夸罗盆地早期的普雷佩查卡松奇。据《米却肯纪事》记载，他在年约九旬的父亲西奎兰查去世后继位，其统治开启了连续五位卡松奇在位的稳定时期。

en: Tariácuri (fl. c. 1350–1390), whose name means 'strong wind' in Purépecha, is traditionally hailed as the founder of the Purépecha state and is credited with raising it from a single city-state to the dominant power of the region. Son of Pauacume II, lord of Pátzcuaro, he was born into the uacúsecha clan, one of the most powerful families of the lake basin. Tradition tells that the sun god Curicaueri, the clan's patron, sent him in a dream to build a unified Purépecha state. He allied the towns Urichu, Erongarícuaro, Pechátaro and Jarácuaro, then expanded to the southwest and across the whole Pátzcuaro basin. The record was not all victories: enemies from Curinguaro once attacked his homeland and drove his nephews to flight, a setback he overcame. After his death the domain was divided, his son Hiquingaje taking Pátzcuaro and his nephews Tangaxoan and Hiripan Tzintzuntzan and Ihuatzio, who kept up his alliance and his expansion.
zh: 塔里亚库里（约1350—1390年在世），普雷佩查语名字意为“强风”，相传为普雷佩查国家的缔造者，被认为把一座城邦发展成了称霸一方的势力。他是帕茨夸罗首领保阿库梅二世之子，出身湖盆地区最有权势的家族之一、统治氏族瓦库塞查。传说该氏族的守护神太阳神库里考埃里在梦中派他去建立统一的普雷佩查国家。他联合乌里奇、埃龙加里夸罗、佩查塔罗和哈拉夸罗诸城，再向西南扩张，进而控制整个帕茨夸罗湖盆地。他的战绩并非一帆风顺：来自库林瓜罗的敌人曾进攻他的家园，迫使侄子们出逃，但这一挫折被他克服。他去世后，疆土分给后人：儿子伊金加赫得帕茨夸罗，侄子坦加肖安和伊里潘分别得钦聪灿与伊瓦齐奥，他们沿袭他的做法，保持联盟并继续扩张。

en: Uápeani Uanacaze was a Purépecha cazonci in the Lake Pátzcuaro basin. The Relación de Michoacán records him leading warriors against Ziranzirancámaro, lord of Zacapu, who drove them back to the Bajío.
zh: 瓦佩阿尼·瓦纳卡泽是帕茨夸罗盆地的普雷佩查卡松奇。《米却肯纪事》记载，他率军攻打萨卡普首领西兰西兰卡马罗，战败后被逐回巴希奥地区。

en: Tartu was a Mongol prince of the Golden Horde, the eldest son of Toqoqan and a grandson of Batu Khan; he never occupied the throne, but his son Talabuga became khan of the Golden Horde in 1287.
zh: 塔儿秃是金帐汗国的蒙古宗王，托托罕的长子、拔都汗之孙；他本人从未登上汗位，但其子兀剌不花于1287年成为金帐汗国的汗。

en: Tatar was a Mongol prince of the Golden Horde, the son of Terval, seventh son of Jochi, and father of Nogai Khan. He died while serving under Hulagu, after which his son Nogai inherited Terval's frontier appanage.
zh: 塔塔儿是金帐汗国的蒙古宗王，术赤第七子土斡耳之子、那海汗之父。他在旭烈兀麾下服役时去世，其子那海承袭了土斡耳的边疆封地。

en: Gunzelin VI of Schwerin (died 1327) was the eldest son of Count Nikolaus I of Schwerin-Wittenburg. In 1305 he held a canon's post as cantor of Schwerin Cathedral, but he had returned to secular life by 1312, and after his father's death he was named ruling count at Wittenburg on 30 March 1323. He married Richardis, heiress of Count Otto IV of Tecklenburg; through this match their son Nikolaus inherited the County of Tecklenburg. Gunzelin died between May and August 1327, succeeded at Wittenburg by his son Otto I.
zh: 什未林的贡采林六世（1327年卒）是什未林—维滕堡伯爵尼古劳斯一世的长子。1305年他在什未林主教座堂担任唱经长，至迟于1312年已回归世俗身份；父亲死后，他于1323年3月30日成为在维滕堡执政的伯爵。他娶泰克伦堡伯爵奥托四世的女继承人里查迪斯为妻，他们的儿子尼古劳斯因此继承了泰克伦堡伯国。贡采林于1327年5月至8月间去世，维滕堡由其子奥托一世继承。

en: Nicholas I (c. 1300–c. 1368), son of Gunzelin VI of Schwerin and Richardis of Tecklenburg, inherited Tecklenburg-Ibbendüren, Lingen and Cloppenburg from his uncle Otto V in 1328, founding the Tecklenburg-Schwerin line; Adolf von der Mark acted as his guardian until 1330. He campaigned against the Frisians and rival knights, lost territory to the bishop of Osnabrück in 1350 but took Iburg in 1354 and gained Rheda in 1365. After inheriting Schwerin in 1357, he sold it to Mecklenburg in 1358. Pope Urban V excommunicated him in 1364.
zh: 尼古劳斯一世（约1300—约1368）是什未林伯爵贡策林六世与泰克伦堡的理夏迪丝之子，1328年从叔父奥托五世手中继承泰克伦堡—伊本迪伦、林根和克洛彭堡，开创泰克伦堡—什未林支系，1330年前由阿道夫·冯·德·马克摄政。他征讨弗里斯兰人和敌对骑士，1350年失地于奥斯纳布吕克主教，1354年攻取伊堡，1365年取得雷达。他1357年继承什未林，1358年将其卖给梅克伦堡，1364年被教皇乌尔班五世处以绝罚。

en: Hobanle is named in Leelkase tradition as the fourth king of the Tanade, an ancient Darod dynasty of northeastern Somalia founded by Mahamed Aw Maki. In that king-list he follows Dirir and precedes Adnan; no dates or deeds survive.
zh: 霍班勒在莱勒卡塞部族传统中列为塔纳德王朝第四代国王；该王朝是索马里东北部古老的达鲁德人王朝，开创者为穆罕默德·阿乌·马基。王系中他位列迪里尔之后、阿德南之前，生卒与事迹均无记载。

en: Taj al-Din Chelebi, in Turkish Emir Tacettin, was the founder and first bey of the Taceddinid principality based at Niksar in northeastern Anatolia. He inherited his lands from his father Doghan Shah in 1346 or 1348, at first ruling under Eretnid suzerainty. In 1379 he repelled attacks on Niksar by the Eretnid vizier Kadi Burhan al-Din and ceased paying tribute, and on 8 October that year he married Eudokia, daughter of Emperor Alexios III of Trebizond, at Oeneon. Defeated by Kadi Burhan al-Din in 1381, he died fighting on 24 October 1386, and his son Mahmud succeeded him.
zh: 塔杰丁·切莱比在土耳其语中称埃米尔·塔杰丁，是安纳托利亚东北部以尼克萨尔为中心的塔杰丁王朝的建立者和第一代贝伊。1346或1348年，他继承父亲多甘沙的领地，起初奉埃尔特纳王朝为宗主。1379年，他击退埃尔特纳维齐尔卡迪·布尔汉丁对尼克萨尔的进攻，停止纳贡；同年10月8日，他在伊内翁与特拉布宗皇帝阿莱克修斯三世之女埃夫多基亚成婚。1381年他被卡迪·布尔汉丁击败，1386年10月24日战死，其子马哈茂德继位。

en: Dadı Bey was a Teke ruler of Antalya in the mid-fourteenth century, the son and successor of Sinanüddin Hızır Bey. He was followed on the throne by Mübarizeddin Mehmed Bey, who was ruling when the Cypriots took Antalya in 1361.
zh: 达迪贝伊是14世纪中期统治安塔利亚的泰凯贝伊，锡南丁·赫泽尔贝伊之子并继其父之位；他之后由穆巴利兹丁·穆罕默德贝伊继位，1361年塞浦路斯攻占安塔利亚时在位者已是后者。

en: Muhammad Bey (died c. 1328) was a son of Yunus Bey, founder of the Teke branch of the Hamidid dynasty at Antalya. In 1317 he supported the Ilkhanid commander Demirtaş when the latter seized and executed his uncle Dündar Bey, lord of the Hamidid beylik, and received Antalya and its district as his reward. After Yunus died he ruled Antalya as the senior Teke bey while his brother Hızır governed Korkuteli. By 1332, when Ibn Battuta visited Antalya, Hızır had succeeded to the city.
zh: 穆罕默德·贝伊（约1328年卒）是泰凯贝伊国开国者尤努斯·贝伊之子，泰凯王室是据有安塔利亚的哈米德王朝一支。1317年，他支持伊儿汗国将领德米尔塔什擒杀伯父、哈米德贝伊敦达尔，并因此受封安塔利亚及周边地区。尤努斯死后，他作为长支泰凯贝伊统治安塔利亚，弟弟赫泽尔治理科尔库泰利。1332年伊本·白图泰到访安塔利亚时，赫泽尔已接替其位。

en: Sinanüddin Hızır Bey was the Antalya ruler of the Teke branch of the Hamidid dynasty, a son of its founder Yunus Bey. While his father and elder brother Mahmud reigned, he governed Korkuteli, where in 1319 he built the Emir Sinaneddin Medrese. After Mahmud handed their uncle Dündar to the Chobanid Timurtash and fled to Cairo around 1327, Hızır restored and strengthened the Antalya beylik. In 1332 the Genoese Doria found him holding twelve cities, twenty-five towers and eight thousand cavalry, and around the same time Ibn Battuta visited the ailing sultan at Antalya. His son Dadı Bey succeeded him.
zh: 锡南丁·赫泽尔贝伊是哈米德王朝泰凯支系统治安塔利亚的贝伊，为支系开创者云努斯贝伊之子。父亲和兄长马哈茂德在位时，他出镇科尔库泰利，并于1319年在当地修建埃米尔·锡南丁经学院。约1327年，马哈茂德把叔父丁达尔交给楚班家族的铁木尔塔什后逃奔开罗，赫泽尔于是复兴并巩固了安塔利亚贝伊国。1332年，热那亚人多里亚见到他治下有十二座城池、二十五座塔楼和八千骑兵；大约同时，伊本·白图泰在安塔利亚拜访了患病的他。他死后由其子达迪贝伊继位。

en: Yunus Bey was a younger son of İlyas Bey, founder of the Hamidid beylik, and brother of Feleküddin Dündar. After the Hamidids seized Antalya between 1308 and 1319, Dündar enfeoffed him with the city, and Yunus ruled as its emir, becoming the first prince of the Teke beylik, conventionally dated to 1321. A medrese inscription of 1319 attests that his son Hızır, whose laqab was Sinan al-Din, was at Korkuteli. Yunus had died by 1324, when his son Mahmud Bey succeeded him in Antalya.
zh: 优努斯贝伊是哈米德贝伊国建立者伊利亚斯贝伊较年幼的儿子之一、费莱凯丁·丁达尔之弟。哈米德家族于1308至1319年间夺取安塔利亚后，丁达尔将该城封给他，优努斯遂以埃米尔身份统治此城，成为通常认定始建于1321年的泰凯贝伊国第一代君主。1319年的一处经文法学院铭文，可证其子希兹尔当时在科尔库特利，希兹尔的称号为锡南丁。优努斯于1324年前去世，其子马哈茂德贝伊在安塔利亚继位。

en: Temüge Otchigin (c. 1168–1246), youngest brother of Genghis Khan and fourth son of Yesugei, bore the title Otchigin, guardian of the family hearth. With his mother Hö'elün he ruled the Mongol heartland while his brothers campaigned, and at the 1206 coronation they received the largest share of land and people. Genghis authorised him to kill the ambitious shaman Teb Tengri in a wrestling match. After Ögedei died in 1241, Temüge tried to seize the throne while Güyük was away on the western campaign, but the regent Töregene blocked him. When Güyük was elected in 1246, Temüge was executed.
zh: 铁木哥斡赤斤（约1168—1246）是成吉思汗的幼弟、也速该第四子。作为幼子，他拥有“斡赤斤”称号，意为家业与炉灶的守护者。他与母亲诃额仑在诸兄出征时主持蒙古腹地，1206年开国分封时，母子分得的土地与属民最多。成吉思汗授意他在一场角抵中杀死野心勃勃的萨满帖卜腾格里。1241年窝阔台死后，他乘贵由西征在外之机企图夺取汗位，被摄政脱列哥那阻止；1246年贵由当选大汗后，铁木哥被处死。

en: Temür Buqa was a Yuan imperial prince, a grandson of Kublai Khan and son of Aurughchi, Prince of Xiping. In the last Zhiyuan years, unrest in Ü-Tsang took him there at his father's head with Mongol and Tibetan troops; he set up seven postal stations in Ü and four in Tsang, garrisoned to secure the roads. In 1296 he crushed a rising at Jiezhou in the Yuan region of Tibet, now in Gansu, and in 1297 he was enfeoffed as Prince Zhenxi Wujing with a gilded silver camel-seal, holding the Tibetan lands as his hereditary appanage. His seat stood at modern Songduo in Qinghai.
zh: 铁木儿不花是元朝宗室，忽必烈之孙、西平王奥鲁赤之子。至元末年乌思藏不宁，他奉父命率蒙古军与吐蕃军前往讨伐，并在乌思设立七个驿站、后藏设立四个驿站，驻军保障道路与边口安全。1296年他率军讨平吐蕃阶州之乱，阶州位于今甘肃；1297年他受封镇西武靖王，获赐驼纽镀金银印，以吐蕃各地为世袭领地，镇西府设在朵哥麻思算木多，即今青海互助松多一带。

en: Temür (1265–1307), called Öljeyitü Khan and posthumously Emperor Chengzong of Yuan, was a grandson of Kublai Khan and the third son of Crown Prince Zhenjin. In 1287 he campaigned with his grandfather against the rebel prince Nayan, and in 1293 he was put in charge of the Karakorum region. After Kublai's death he was enthroned at Shangdu in 1294 as the second Yuan emperor. His reign brought nominal suzerainty over the rival Mongol khanates, respect for Confucian scholarship, and the abandonment of invasions of Japan, Burma and Đại Việt. He died in 1307 without a surviving heir.
zh: 铁穆耳（1265—1307），号完泽笃汗，庙号成宗，是忽必烈之孙、皇太子真金第三子。1287年他随祖父征讨叛王乃颜，1293年受命镇守哈剌和林一带。忽必烈死后，他于1294年在上都即位，成为元朝第二位皇帝。在位期间，各蒙古汗国在名义上承认其宗主地位，朝廷尊崇儒学，并放弃了远征日本、缅甸和大越的计划。1307年他去世，没有留下在世的继承人。

en: Tenshō Shūbun was a Zen monk and the founding master of Chinese-style suiboku ink painting in Muromachi Japan. Active in Kyoto from around 1403 and associated with Shōkoku-ji, he studied under the émigré painter Josetsu and modelled his landscapes on the Song masters Xia Gui and Ma Yuan. His style bridged the work of earlier Japanese painters who closely imitated Chinese models and that of later artists who developed a Japanese style. He directed the Ashikaga shoguns' court painting bureau and in 1423 joined the mission to Joseon Korea. Later he oversaw Shōkoku-ji's buildings and grounds. In the 1440s he taught the young Sesshū, his most celebrated pupil. His best-known painting was Reading in a Bamboo Grove. He died around 1444–1450.
zh: 天章周文是日本室町时代的禅僧，也是日本汉派水墨山水画的奠基者。他约于1403年起在京都作画，长住相国寺，师从渡日画僧如拙，山水取法宋代夏圭、马远。他的画风处于早期日本画家紧密模仿中国范本与后来的画家发展日本风格之间。他主持足利幕府的画院，并于1423年随遣朝使团出使李氏朝鲜，后来管理相国寺的建筑与庭园。1440年代，他收少年雪舟为徒，雪舟后来成为他最负盛名的弟子。他最著名的作品是《竹斋读书图》。他约于1444至1450年间去世。

en: Acolnahuacatl (died 1366), also called Acolnahuacatzin, was the Tepanec tlatoani of Azcapotzalco, probably a son of King Xiuhtlatonac. He married Cuetlaxochitzin, daughter of the Chichimec leader Xolotl, and their son was Tezozomoc, the future master of the Valley of Mexico. The chronicler Chimalpain dates his rule from 1302 to 1366, though some historians place his death in 1371. In 1318 his Tepanecs attacked the Mexica of Chapultepec and raised their tribute.
zh: 阿科尔纳瓦卡特（？—1366），又称阿科尔纳瓦卡钦，是特帕内卡人城邦阿斯卡波察尔科的特拉托阿尼，可能是王休特拉托纳克之子。他娶奇奇梅克首领索洛特尔之女奎特拉索奇钦为妻，两人的儿子便是日后称雄墨西哥谷地的特索索莫克。编年史家奇马尔潘记其在位为1302—1366年，也有学者把他的去世定在1371年。1318年，他的特帕内卡军队进攻查普尔特佩克的墨西加人并加重贡赋。

en: Cuetlaxochitzin was a daughter of Xolotl, the Chichimec ruler of Tenayuca, and the wife of Acolnahuacatl, king of the Tepanec city of Azcapotzalco. Their son was Tezozomoc, who built Azcapotzalco into the dominant power in the Valley of Mexico.
zh: 奎特拉索奇钦是奇奇梅克统治者、特纳尤卡之主索洛特尔之女，嫁给特帕内克城邦阿斯卡波察尔科国王阿科尔纳瓦卡特尔；其子是将阿斯卡波察尔科建成墨西哥谷霸主的特索索莫克。

en: Tezozomoc Yacateteltetl (c. 1320–1426) ruled the Tepanec city-state of Azcapotzalco from around 1370 until his death and built it into the dominant power in the Valley of Mexico. A son of King Acolnahuacatl and Cuetlaxochitzin, daughter of the Chichimec ruler Xolotl, he set sons of his on the thrones of neighboring cities, among them Coyoacán, Tlacopan and Tlatelolco. In 1403 he approved the election of Tenochtitlan's king Huitzilihuitl and gave him his daughter Ayauhcihuatl in marriage, over the opposition of his son Maxtla. Defeated by Texcoco's ruler Techotlalatzin, he sought peace, but renewed the war against his successor Ixtlilxochitl I, whom he defeated in 1419, seizing the city. The colonial chronicler Alva Ixtlilxochitl called him a cruel tyrant, so old that he was carried about swaddled in feathers and slept between two braziers. After he died in 1426 his son Tayatzin succeeded him, but Maxtla seized power.
zh: 特索索莫克·亚卡特特尔特尔（约1320—1426）自约1370年起统治特帕内克人的城邦阿斯卡波察尔科，直至去世，并将其建成墨西哥谷的霸主。他是国王阿科尔纳瓦卡特尔与奇奇梅克统治者索洛特尔之女奎特拉索奇钦之子，把自己的儿子安插到邻近城市的王位上，其中有科约阿坎、特拉科潘和特拉特洛尔科。1403年，他认可维奇利维特尔当选特诺奇蒂特兰国王，并不顾儿子马克斯特拉的反对，将女儿阿约西瓦特尔嫁给他。他被特斯科科之主特乔特拉拉钦击败后求和，后来又与其继任者伊斯特利尔索奇特尔一世交战，于1419年将其击败并夺取该城。殖民时期编年史家阿尔瓦·伊斯特利尔索奇特尔称他为残酷的暴君，说他年老到要用羽毛包裹着抬来抬去，夜里睡在两个大火盆之间。他1426年死后，儿子塔亚钦继位，但马克斯特拉夺取了权力。

en: The Ternatan chronicle recorded by François Valentijn makes Boheyat I the eldest son of Kolano Sidang Arif and ruler of Ternate from 1347 to 1350. He succeeded after Tolu-ma-lamo's death and was remembered as good-natured and mild. In the second year of his reign he went blind, and in 1350 he died of illness after only three years on the throne, leaving a son born to a Javanese woman. His brother Ngolo-ma-Caya then succeeded him.
zh: 据法兰坦记录的特尔纳特编年史，博赫亚特一世是科拉诺西丁·阿里夫的长子，1347—1350年为特尔纳特统治者。他在托卢·马拉莫死后继位，史称性情温厚、为政宽和。即位第二年他双目失明，1350年病死，在位仅三年，留下一子，为一名爪哇女子所生。其弟恩戈洛·玛·卡亚随后继位。

en: Gapi Baguna I was the youngest son of Kolano Sidang Arif and kolano of Ternate from 1372 to 1377. Unlike his warlike brothers Ngolo-ma-Caya and Gapi-ma-lamo, the chronicle of François Valentijn depicts him as a peacemaker who settled the feuds of the Malukan kingdoms through marriage alliances. His son married a daughter of the king of Jailolo and later inherited Jailolo itself, while Gapi Baguna's two daughters were wedded at Tidore, the elder to its ruler Hasan Syah and the younger to his brother Rampala. He died in 1377.
zh: 加皮·巴古纳一世是科拉诺西丁·阿里夫的幼子，1372—1377年任特尔纳特的科拉诺。与好战的兄长恩戈洛·玛·卡亚、加皮·马拉莫不同，法兰坦的编年史把他描绘成议和者，以联姻平息马鲁古诸国的仇怨。他的儿子娶贾伊洛洛国王之女，后来并继承了贾伊洛洛；两个女儿则嫁往蒂多雷，长女配国王哈桑·沙阿，幼女配其弟兰帕拉。他于1377年去世。

en: Gapi-ma-lamo, the fourth son of Kolano Sidang Arif, became kolano of Ternate in 1359 after his brother Momole. François Valentijn's chronicle portrays him as a warlike ruler who fought long wars against Jailolo and Tidore and later fell out with Bacan as well. Makassarese and Javanese followers supported him, and although he conquered no new lands, his standing among the Malukan kings was high and he kept every enemy at bay. After a thirteen-year reign he died in 1372, and his youngest brother Gapi Baguna succeeded him.
zh: 加皮·马拉莫是科拉诺西丁·阿里夫的第四子，1359年继其兄莫莫勒成为特尔纳特的科拉诺。法兰坦的编年史把他写成好战之君：他长期与贾伊洛洛、蒂多雷交战，后来又同巴占反目。他麾下有望加锡人和爪哇人相助；虽然没有开拓新土，但他在马鲁古诸王中威望很高，令敌国不敢来犯。他在位十三年，1372年去世，幼弟加皮·巴古纳继位。

en: Ternatan tradition, as recorded by the chronicler Valentijn, names Kalabata the fourth Kolano of Ternate, succeeding his father Siale in 1298. A weak and pleasure-loving king, he kept his throne through his brothers, who defeated foreign enemies and rebels for him. He then came to fear their prowess and poisoned the three ablest; the survivors fled to Tidore under chief Malonga's protection. Two died in exile and the rest returned only when Kalabata died in 1304. He left sons including Komalo and Patsaranga-ma-lamo.
zh: 据编年史作者瓦伦丁记录的特尔纳特传说，卡拉巴塔是特尔纳特第四任科拉诺，1298年继其父西亚勒即位。他为人软弱、贪图享乐，全靠诸弟击败外敌与叛民才保住王位。后来他忌惮诸弟的勇武，毒杀了其中最出色的三人；余者逃往蒂多雷，受酋长马隆加庇护，两人死于流亡，剩下的人直到1304年卡拉巴塔去世才返回。他留下科马洛、帕察兰加-马拉莫等儿子。

en: The Ternatan chronicle recorded by François Valentijn makes Momole the second son of Kolano Sidang Arif and an elder brother of Ngolo-ma-Caya. He was brought up by the grandees of the kingdom and succeeded Ngolo-ma-Caya as kolano in 1357. His short reign over the spice island saw no recorded wars or deeds, for he was sickly throughout and died in 1359 after only two years. Some accounts said a Makassarese concubine had poisoned him, and his brother Gapi-ma-lamo then took the throne.
zh: 法兰坦记录的特尔纳特编年史把莫莫勒记作科拉诺西丁·阿里夫的次子、恩戈洛·玛·卡亚之兄。他由王国的显贵们抚养长大，1357年继恩戈洛·玛·卡亚成为科拉诺。他统治这座香料之岛时间很短，史书没有留下征战或政绩：他体弱多病，仅两年后便于1359年去世。一说他是被一名望加锡籍妃嫔毒死的。其弟加皮·马拉莫随后继位。

en: Ngolo-ma-Caya, a son of Kolano Sidang Arif, ruled Ternate as kolano from 1350 to 1357. Valentijn's chronicle describes him as a brave warrior who learned some Arabic through an Arab settler and was reputed a holy man able to summon spirits and angels, who bathed with him in the Ake-Sibu stream. His Arab companion also taught the Ternatans to build better ships; with these Ngolo-ma-Caya sailed to the Sula Islands, subdued them and placed his son Hamed as governor over Taliabu. He died in 1357 after seven years' rule.
zh: 恩戈洛·玛·卡亚是科拉诺西丁·阿里夫之子，1350—1357年任特尔纳特的科拉诺。法兰坦的编年史称他作战勇猛，随一名阿拉伯侨民学了些阿拉伯语，并被视为能役使精灵与天使的圣人，相传精灵与天使曾与他在阿克-西布溪中沐浴。那阿拉伯人还教特尔纳特人造出更好的船；恩戈洛·玛·卡亚率船队远征苏拉群岛并将其征服，以其子哈米德镇守塔利阿布。他在位七年后于1357年去世。

en: Patsaranga-ma-lamo, a son of Kalabata, succeeded his brother Komalo as Kolano of Ternate in 1317, when he was already about fifty years old. The Ternatan grandees first made him promise that the throne would pass to a brother or a side-line kinsman. Mild and well liked, he nevertheless conquered two villages on Makian Island in 1321. When he tried to make his son Komalo Bangsa heir despite his oath, the Ternatans deposed him in 1322 and placed his sister's son Sidang Arif Malamo on the throne.
zh: 帕察兰加-马拉莫是卡拉巴塔之子，1317年继其兄科马洛之位成为特尔纳特科拉诺，时年约五十岁。特尔纳特贵族先要他许诺，王位今后传给兄弟或旁支亲属。他性情温和、颇受爱戴，并于1321年攻取马基安岛上的两座村庄。但他违背誓言，企图立儿子科马洛·邦萨为继承人，特尔纳特人遂于1322年将他废黜，改立其外甥西丁·阿里夫·马拉莫。

en: The unnamed daughter of Ternate kolano Kalabata and sister of kings Komalo and Patsaranga-ma-lamo was, by Ternatan king-list tradition, the mother of Sidang Arif Malamo, who ruled Ternate from 1322 to 1331.
zh: 特尔纳特科拉诺卡拉巴塔之女、科马洛与帕查朗加—马拉莫两王的姐妹，名字失载；按特尔纳特王统传说，她是1322年至1331年在位的西当·阿里夫·马拉莫的母亲。

en: Sidang Arif Malamo (died 1331), a nephew of Patsaranga-ma-lamo through a sister, was made Kolano of Ternate after the deposition of 1322. His reign drew Javanese and Arab merchants to the island for the clove trade, and commerce flourished; rival Tidore and Bacan appointed kings of their own to compete. The four rulers of Maluku met on Moti Island and swore a bond, ranking Jailolo first and Ternate second. Through his friendship with foreign traders he gained wide knowledge, earning the name Sidang Arif, meaning wise master. He died in 1331 leaving five sons.
zh: 西丁·阿里夫·马拉莫（1331年卒）是帕察兰加-马拉莫的外甥，1322年帕察兰加被废后被拥立为特尔纳特科拉诺。他在位期间，许多爪哇人和阿拉伯人为丁香贸易而来，商业兴盛；与之竞争的蒂多雷和巴占也各自拥立国王。马鲁古四国君主在莫蒂岛会盟立约，议定地位以贾伊洛洛为首、特尔纳特次之。他因与外商交游而见闻广博，得名“西丁·阿里夫”，意为睿智的主人。他于1331年去世，留下五个儿子。

en: The Ternatan chronicle preserved by François Valentijn names Syah Alam as kolano, or king, of the spice island of Ternate from 1332 to 1343. A son of Patsaranga-ma-lamo, he was enthroned after his cousin Paji-ma-lamo was murdered. Around 1334, when the people of Makian killed two Ternatan seafarers, Syah Alam invaded the island, subdued it and kept it under Ternatan rule. He died in 1343 after an honourable reign, leaving three sons and four daughters, and was succeeded by his brother Tolu-ma-lamo.
zh: 据法兰坦保存下来的特尔纳特编年史，希亚赫·阿拉姆于1332—1343年任香料之岛特尔纳特的科拉诺，即国王。他是帕察朗加·马拉莫之子，在堂兄弟帕吉·马拉莫遇刺后登位。约1334年，马基安岛居民杀死两名特尔纳特航海者，希亚赫·阿拉姆发兵征服该岛并将其长期占有。他于1343年去世，在位时称贤德，身后留下三子四女，由其弟托卢·马拉莫继位。

en: Tolu-ma-lamo, a son of Patsaranga-ma-lamo, became kolano of Ternate in 1343 after his brother Syah Alam. The chronicle recorded by François Valentijn calls him a troublesome ruler: he was the first to break the peace bond of the four Malukan kings. Nuruddin of Tidore and Sidang Hasan of Bacan then attacked and took Makian, but in 1346 Tolu-ma-lamo recovered the whole island and wounded Nuruddin, who later died of his injury, before raiding coastal villages of Bacan. He later took to opium and died in 1347, leaving a son, Komalo Pulu.
zh: 托卢·马拉莫是帕察朗加·马拉莫之子，1343年继其兄希亚赫·阿拉姆成为特尔纳特的科拉诺。法兰坦记录的编年史说他惹是生非：他率先破坏了马鲁古四王之间的盟约。蒂多雷的努鲁丁与巴占的西丁·哈桑联手攻占马基安岛，但托卢·马拉莫于1346年收复全岛，努鲁丁负伤而死；他又乘胜袭掠巴占的沿海村庄。晚年他吸食鸦片，1347年去世，留下儿子科马洛·普卢。

en: Bolesław of Cieszyn (c. 1331/32–1356) was a Piast prince, the second son of Casimir I, Duke of Cieszyn, and his wife Euphemia, daughter of Trojden I of Czersk-Warsaw. Destined for the Church so that the small duchy would not be divided again, he joined the Kraków cathedral chapter in 1349 through King John of Bohemia's patronage and later became a canon of Wrocław. In 1353 Emperor Charles IV made him his personal chaplain and provost of All Saints' Church at Prague Castle. He died in Prague on 23 July 1356.
zh: 切申的博莱斯瓦夫（约1331/32—1356）是皮亚斯特王朝切申支系的王公，切申公爵卡齐米日一世与切尔斯克-华沙公爵特洛伊登一世之女欧菲米娅的次子。为使狭小的公国不再被分割，他自幼被安排投身教会。1349年经波希米亚国王约翰举荐，他成为克拉科夫主教座堂法政牧师，后来又任弗罗茨瓦夫法政牧师。1353年，皇帝查理四世任命他为私人神父兼布拉格城堡诸圣教堂教长。1356年7月23日，他在布拉格去世。

en: Euphemia (c. 1310 – after 1374) was a Piast princess of Masovia, daughter of Trojden I, Duke of Czersk and Warsaw, and Maria of Halych. In 1324 she married Casimir I, Duke of Cieszyn, and bore nine children, including Władysław and Przemysław I Noszak.
zh: 欧菲米娅（约1310年—1374年后）是马佐夫舍皮亚斯特家族的公主，切尔斯克和华沙公爵特罗伊登一世与加利西亚的玛丽亚之女。1324年她嫁给切申公爵卡齐米日一世，生有九名子女，包括瓦迪斯瓦夫和普热梅斯瓦夫一世·诺萨克。

en: Casimir I (1280/1290–1358), second son of Mieszko I, became Duke of Cieszyn in 1315. At first close to King Władysław I of Poland, he switched sides after Lithuanian raids in 1321–1324 and swore homage to John of Bohemia at Opava in February 1327, holding Cieszyn as a hereditary fief. He bought Siewierz in 1337 and secured half of Bytom with Gliwice and Toszek in 1357. He ringed Cieszyn with walls, promoted town life and married Euphemia of Masovia, who bore him nine children. He died in 1358 and was buried in the Dominican church.
zh: 卡齐米日一世（1280/1290—1358）是梅什科一世的次子，1315年成为切申公爵。他起初亲附波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫一世，1321—1324年立陶宛人寇境后转而倒向波希米亚，1327年2月在奥帕瓦向波希米亚国王约翰行臣服礼，以世袭封臣身份领有切申。1337年他购入谢维日，1357年取得半个贝托姆以及格利维采、托谢克等地。他为切申修筑城墙，扶持城市发展，并娶马佐夫舍的欧菲米娅，生有九名子女。他于1358年去世，葬于多明我会教堂。

en: Mieszko I (1252/1256–1314/1315), eldest son of Władysław of Opole-Racibórz, was the first Piast duke of Cieszyn. After ruling Racibórz jointly with his brother Przemysław from 1282, he received Cieszyn, Oświęcim and Zator in the 1290 partition, and promoted colonization by granting town rights to Cieszyn, Oświęcim and Zator. He tied his fate to Bohemia, swearing homage to Wenceslaus II in 1292 and attending his coronation at Gniezno in 1300. His daughter Viola Elisabeth married Wenceslaus III in 1305, but the young king's murder in 1306 ended Mieszko's ambitions, and his sons took over the duchy.
zh: 梅什科一世（1252/1256—1314/1315）是奥波莱-拉齐布日公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫的长子，也是切申皮亚斯特支系的开创者。1282年起他与弟弟普热梅斯瓦夫共治拉齐布日，1290年分封后获得切申、奥斯威辛和扎托，并积极推行殖民、授予切申、奥斯威辛和扎托城市镇权。他与波希米亚结盟，1292年向瓦茨拉夫二世宣誓效忠，1300年出席其在格涅兹诺的加冕。1305年其女维奥拉·伊丽莎白嫁给瓦茨拉夫三世，但年轻国王1306年遇刺，梅什科的雄心随之落空，公国由儿子们接管。

en: Przemyslaus I Noszak (1334–1410) was a Piast duke who ruled Cieszyn from 1358, after his elder brothers' early deaths made him Casimir I's chief heir. From 1355 he served Emperor Charles IV at Prague and became a leading diplomat: he went on a mission to Paris in 1380 and helped arrange Anne of Bohemia's marriage to Richard II of England. Under Wenceslaus IV he governed Bohemia in 1386 and acted as vicar in Germany. His eldest son was murdered in 1406 in a feud with Jan II of Racibórz, and he died in May 1410.
zh: 普热梅斯瓦夫一世·诺萨克（1334—1410）是皮亚斯特王朝的公爵，两位兄长早逝后，他作为卡齐米日一世的主要继承人，于1358年起统治切申。自1355年起，他在布拉格侍奉皇帝查理四世，成长为重要的外交官：1380年出使巴黎，并促成波希米亚的安妮与英王理查二世联姻。瓦茨拉夫四世在位时，他于1386年摄政波希米亚，并出任德意志地区摄政官。1406年，他的长子在与拉齐布日公爵约翰二世的仇杀中遇害。1410年5月，普热梅斯瓦夫去世。

en: Władysław of Cieszyn (1325/1331–1355) was the eldest son of Duke Casimir I of Cieszyn and Euphemia of Masovia. Destined for the Church, he became a close companion of Charles IV of Bohemia and attended the Bohemian court from 1347. Early in 1354 Charles named him a court judge, and in 1355 he joined the Italian expedition and witnessed the imperial coronation in Rome on 5 April. Last documented on 15 May, he died at Pisa later that month; poisoning has been suggested as the cause. He was buried in Pisa Cathedral.
zh: 切申的瓦迪斯瓦夫（1325/1331—1355）是切申公爵卡齐米日一世与马佐夫舍的欧菲米娅的长子，被安排走教会之路，成为波希米亚国王查理四世的亲信，1347年起出入波希米亚宫廷。1354年初查理任命他为宫廷法官；1355年他随驾远征意大利，4月5日在罗马亲历皇帝加冕大典。他最后见于5月15日的文书，当月晚些时候在比萨去世；有人推测他死于投毒。他葬于比萨大教堂。

en: Albert of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (born c. 1284, died after 1341) was a son of Duke Henry I of Brunswick-Grubenhagen and Agnes of Meissen. He joined the Teutonic Order, following his uncle Luther von Braunschweig.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特·冯·不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根（约1284年生，1341年后去世）是不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根公爵海因里希一世与迈森的阿格尼丝之子，追随叔父路德·冯·不伦瑞克加入条顿骑士团。

en: Dietrich von Altenburg was the 19th Grand Master of the Teutonic Knights, leading the order from 1335 until his death in 1341. He joined the Order in 1307 and became Grand Marshal in 1331, reviving the war with Władysław I of Poland; after the Battle of Płowce the Order held Kuyavia and Dobrzyń Land. The 1335 Congress of Visegrád, brokered by John of Bohemia, agreed that Poland would regain Kuyavia and Dobrzyń while the Order kept Pomerelia, but Polish nobles protested. In 1339 the Roman Curia ordered the Order to surrender the disputed lands, though the Pope did not approve the judgement. As Grand Master Altenburg rebuilt the Order's castles and, at Marienburg, the church and its main tower, and finished the Chapel of Saint Anne. He died of illness at Thorn in October 1341, on his way to negotiate with Poland, and was the first Grand Master buried in the chapel; peace came only in 1343.
zh: 迪特里希·冯·阿尔滕堡是条顿骑士团第19任大团长，1335年至1341年去世前在任。他1307年加入骑士团，1331年出任大统帅，重启与波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫一世的战事；普沃夫采战役之后，骑士团占有库亚维亚和多布任地区。1335年的维谢格拉德会议在波希米亚的约翰斡旋下商定：波兰收回库亚维亚和多布任，骑士团保留波美雷利亚；但波兰贵族反对这一安排。1339年罗马教廷判令骑士团交出争议土地，但教皇没有批准判决。出任大团长后，他修建骑士团的城堡，并在马林堡重建圣母教堂及其主塔，建成圣安娜礼拜堂。1341年10月，他前往托伦与波兰谈判，在当地病逝，是首位葬于该礼拜堂的大团长；和平直到1343年才实现。

en: Luther von Braunschweig (c. 1275–1335), a younger son of Duke Albert I of Brunswick-Lüneburg, was the 18th Grand Master of the Teutonic Knights from 1331 until his death. First recorded as a Teutonic Knight in 1295, he held the commandries of Gollub, Marienburg and Christburg, founded Gilgenburg in 1326 and established the commandry of Osterode in 1329. Elected Grand Master in 1331 while the Polish–Teutonic War continued, he promoted settlement and church-building; the Battle of Płowce was fought that September. He extended Marienburg Castle and in 1333 attended the consecration of Königsberg Cathedral. A patron of letters, he had Peter of Dusburg's chronicle translated into German, and died on 18 April 1335.
zh: 路德·冯·不伦瑞克（约1275—1335）是不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵阿尔布雷希特一世较年幼的儿子，1331年起任条顿骑士团第18任大团长，直至去世。他作为条顿骑士首次见于1295年的记载，历任戈卢布、马林堡和克里斯特堡行政长官，1326年建立吉尔根堡，1329年设立奥斯特罗德辖区。1331年波兰—条顿战争仍在继续时他当选大团长，推动殖民与教堂建设；同年9月发生了普沃夫采战役。他扩建马林堡城堡，并于1333年出席柯尼斯堡主教座堂的祝圣礼。他奖掖学术，命人将杜伊斯堡的彼得所撰编年史译成德语，1335年4月18日去世。

en: Peter of Dusburg (German: Peter von Dusburg; died after 1326) was a priest-brother of the Teutonic Order and its foremost chronicler. In 1324, probably in Königsberg, Grand Master Werner von Orseln commissioned him to write the order's history. The resulting Chronicon terrae Prussiae described the order and the Old Prussians in the 13th and early 14th centuries. Completed by 1326, it expanded on a Latin author's now-lost account of the early Prussian Crusade; that version was later revised to include events through 1330. Whether Peter came from Duisburg or the Dutch town of Doesburg is disputed. From 1331 to 1335 Nikolaus von Jeroschin translated his chronicle into Middle High German for Grand Master Luther von Braunschweig.
zh: 杜伊斯堡的彼得（德语：彼得·冯·杜斯堡，1326年后去世）是条顿骑士团的神父修士，也是该团最重要的编年史家。1324年，他可能在柯尼斯堡受大团长维尔纳·冯·奥尔塞恩委托撰写骑士团历史，成书《普鲁士土地编年史》，记述了13世纪及14世纪初的骑士团和古普鲁士人。他在一位拉丁文作者现已佚失的早期普鲁士十字军征战记述基础上扩写，于1326年前完成，其后这一版本又增补了直至1330年的事件。其籍贯究竟是杜伊斯堡还是荷兰城镇杜斯堡，学界尚有争议。1331至1335年，尼古劳斯·冯·耶罗欣受大团长路德·冯·不伦瑞克之命，将此书译成中古高地德语。

en: Werner von Orseln (c. 1280–1330), a noble from near Frankfurt, served the Teutonic Order as Komtur of Ragnit from 1312 and Grand Komtur at Malbork from 1314. Exiled with his patron, Grand Master Karl von Trier, during an internal coup, he returned in 1319 and restored discipline. On 6 July 1324 the chapter elected him Grand Master. He built castles and towns, set up the Grand Master's chancellery, commissioned Peter von Dusburg's chronicle and fought Poland over Pomerelia, ordering the conquest of Kujavia and Dobrzyń Land in 1327. In November 1330 the brother Johann von Endorf stabbed him to death after a reprimand.
zh: 维尔纳·冯·奥瑟尔恩（约1280—1330）出身法兰克福附近的贵族家庭，1312年起任条顿骑士团拉格尼特城堡的长官，1314年起任马尔堡的大总管。骑士团发生内讧时，他随庇护者大团长卡尔·冯·特里尔一同被逐，1319年返回并恢复团内秩序。1324年7月6日，骑士团全会选举他为大团长。他修建城堡与城镇、设立大团长文书处、委托编写彼得·冯·杜伊斯堡的编年史，并为争夺波美雷利亚与波兰交战，1327年下令征服库亚维亚和多布任地区。1330年11月，团员约翰·冯·恩多夫因遭训斥将他刺死。

en: Adelheid von Griessenberg was a daughter of Lütold von Griessenberg. Around 1324 she married Count Diethelm V von Toggenburg, killed at Grynau in 1337, and later Konrad III von Fürstenberg-Wartenburg. She died in 1371 or 1372, leaving two daughters, Agnes and Clementia.
zh: 阿德莱德·冯·格里森贝格是吕托尔德·冯·格里森贝格之女，约1324年嫁给1337年战死于格里瑙的吐根堡伯爵迪特黑尔姆五世，后改嫁康拉德三世·冯·菲尔斯滕贝格-瓦滕堡，1371或1372年去世，留有阿格内丝、克莱门蒂娅两女。

en: Agnes von Toggenburg was a daughter of Count Diethelm V von Toggenburg, killed at Grynau in 1337, and his wife Adelheid von Griessenberg. She died on 13 October 1383.
zh: 阿格内丝·冯·吐根堡是1337年战死格里瑙的吐根堡伯爵迪特黑尔姆五世与妻子阿德莱德·冯·格里森贝格的女儿，于1383年10月13日去世。

en: Clementia von Toggenburg was the younger daughter of Count Diethelm V, killed at Grynau in 1337, and Adelheid von Griessenberg, from whom she inherited Griesenberg in 1371. Before 15 November 1367 she married the knight Heinrich I von Hewen and died after 28 February 1405.
zh: 克莱门蒂娅·冯·吐根堡是1337年战死格里瑙的伯爵迪特黑尔姆五世与阿德莱德·冯·格里森贝格的幼女，1371年从母亲处继承格里森贝格，1367年11月15日前嫁给骑士海因里希一世·冯·赫文，1405年2月28日以后去世。

en: Diethelm I of Toggenburg (c. 1150–1205/1207) is the earliest count of the dynasty whose line can be traced, possibly first attested in 1176. He may have married Guta of Rapperswil between 1180 and 1195, though she may instead have been the wife of the next Diethelm. If she was his wife, she brought the county of Uznach and the upper March around Grynau into the marriage, and around 1200 the couple shared in the inheritance of several neighbouring lordships, including Alt-Rapperswil, while under pressure from St. Gallen Abbey, the bishops of Constance and the counts of Kyburg. His sons Diethelm II and Friedrich I survived him, and the comital title is documented from 1209.
zh: 吐根堡的迪特黑尔姆一世（约1150—1205/1207）是该家族世系可考的最早一位伯爵，可能在1176年已见记载。他可能于1180至1195年间娶拉珀斯维尔的古塔为妻，但古塔也可能是下一代迪特黑尔姆的妻子。若她是他的妻子，便为他带来了乌茨纳赫伯国及格里瑙所在的上马尔希；约1200年，夫妇二人又分得阿尔特-拉珀斯维尔等多处邻近领主的遗产，同时承受着圣加仑修道院、康斯坦茨主教和基堡伯爵的压力。他身后留下迪特黑尔姆二世、腓特烈一世两子；家族的伯爵头衔1209年始见于文献。

en: Diethelm II of Toggenburg (c. 1180–1235) succeeded his father Diethelm I as count and is attested in documents from 1209. St. Gallen chronicle tradition accuses him of having his younger brother Friedrich I murdered at Rengerswil Castle near Wängi in 1226, in order to seize the town Wil and Alt-Toggenburg. In the ensuing conflict with St. Gallen Abbey the Toggenburgs lost Wil, Alt-Toggenburg, Lütisburg and Uznaberg. Between 1226 and 1228 he founded the Hospitaller commandery of Tobel on the Way of St. James, richly endowed and later the family burial place. His son Kraft I succeeded him.
zh: 吐根堡的迪特黑尔姆二世（约1180—1235）继其父迪特黑尔姆一世为伯爵，1209年起见于文献。圣加仑修道院的编年史称，他于1226年指使人在文吉附近的伦格斯维尔城堡杀害弟弟腓特烈一世，企图夺取维尔城和老吐根堡。在随后与圣加仑修道院的冲突中，吐根堡家族丧失了维尔、老吐根堡、吕蒂斯堡和乌茨纳贝格。1226至1228年间，他在圣雅各朝圣路上创建了产业丰厚的医院骑士团托贝尔辖区，后来成为家族墓地。其子克拉夫特一世继位。

en: Diethelm V von Toggenburg (died 1337) ruled as Count of Toggenburg from 1315, when his father Frederick IV fell fighting the Swiss at the Battle of Morgarten. Around 1324 he married Adelheid, daughter of Lütold von Griessenberg, who bore him two daughters, Agnes and Clementia. On 21 September 1337 he was killed at the Battle of Grynau, fighting in the noble coalition led by Johann I von Habsburg-Laufenburg against the imperial city of Zurich; Johann was slain in the same fight.
zh: 迪特黑尔姆五世·冯·吐根堡（？—1337）于1315年其父腓特烈四世在莫尔加滕战役中与瑞士人作战战死后，继任吐根堡伯爵。约1324年，他娶吕托尔德·冯·格里森贝格之女阿德莱德，生有两女阿格内丝和克莱门蒂娅。1337年9月21日，他在格里瑙之战中阵亡，此战是约翰一世·冯·哈布斯堡-劳芬堡率领的贵族联盟与帝国城市苏黎世之间的交战，约翰本人也在同一场战斗中被杀。

en: Friedrich III was count of Toggenburg from 1249 until his death on 17 January 1309, succeeding his father Kraft I. His son Friedrich IV fell while serving in Duke Leopold of Austria's army at Morgarten in 1315.
zh: 腓特烈三世于1249年继其父克拉夫特一世成为吐根堡伯爵，1309年1月17日去世。其子腓特烈四世1315年随奥地利公爵利奥波德的军队战死于莫尔加滕。

en: Frederick IV (before 1286 – 15 November 1315) ruled as count of Toggenburg, a county in what is now the Swiss canton of St. Gallen, from 1309. In 1313 he bought Wildenburg Castle near Baar. He married Ita von Homberg, of the comital house of Frohburg, who bore him sons Frederick V and Diethelm V. In November 1315 he rode with Duke Leopold I of Habsburg against the Swiss Confederates and was killed on 15 November at the Battle of Morgarten, when men of Schwyz ambushed Leopold's column beside Lake Ägeri.
zh: 腓特烈四世（1286年前—1315年11月15日）是托根堡伯爵，其伯国位于今瑞士圣加仑州，1309年起统治。1313年，他购入巴尔附近的维尔登堡城堡。他娶弗罗堡伯爵家族的伊塔·冯·洪贝格为妻，生子腓特烈五世与迪特赫尔姆五世。1315年11月，他随哈布斯堡公爵利奥波德一世出征瑞士邦联，11月15日在莫尔加滕战役中战死：施维茨人在埃格里湖畔伏击了利奥波德的队伍。

en: Kraft I of Toggenburg, son of Diethelm II, spent his years as count trying to recover the rights and estates his family had lost to St. Gallen Abbey after the feud of 1226. From 1244 to 1249 he took part in fighting as far afield as Lyon and Alsace. He is probably the minnesinger Count Kraft of Toggenburg whose songs were preserved in the Codex Manesse. He was reportedly killed in 1254 by a retainer named Locher, because Kraft had allegedly slain Locher's brother; genealogical tables variously date his death to 1249 or 1254. His son Friedrich III succeeded him.
zh: 吐根堡的克拉夫特一世是迪特黑尔姆二世之子，他任伯爵期间一直试图夺回家族在1226年仇杀后丧失于圣加仑修道院的权利与地产。1244至1249年，他参与战事，兵锋远至里昂和阿尔萨斯。他很可能就是诗作被收入《马内塞手抄本》的吟唱诗人“吐根堡的克拉夫特伯爵”。据传他于1254年被侍从洛赫尔杀死，原因据称是克拉夫特杀了洛赫尔的兄弟；谱系书对其卒年则有1249与1254两说。其子腓特烈三世继位。

en: Boniface I of Montferrat (c. 1150–1207) became marquis of Montferrat in 1192, after his brother Conrad, king of Jerusalem, was killed. He fought the neighbouring communes of Asti and Alessandria and in 1194 helped lead Emperor Henry VI's expedition to Sicily. His court was also known for its patronage of troubadours, including Raimbaut de Vaqueiras. In 1201 he replaced the late Theobald of Champagne as leader of the Fourth Crusade. Diverted to Constantinople, the army sacked the city in 1204; the Venetians blocked his election as Latin emperor, so he founded the Kingdom of Thessalonica and was crowned king in 1205. In 1205 he married Margaret of Hungary, widow of Emperor Isaac II Angelos. On 4 September 1207 he died in a Vlach ambush, his head sent to Tsar Kaloyan of Bulgaria.
zh: 蒙费拉托的波尼法乔一世（约1150—1207）在其兄、耶路撒冷国王康拉德遇害后，于1192年继任蒙费拉托侯爵。他与邻近的阿斯蒂和亚历山德里亚城邦交战，1194年协助统率皇帝亨利六世的西西里远征。他的宫廷还以赞助吟游诗人闻名，其中包括兰博·德·瓦凯拉斯。1201年，他接替去世的香槟伯爵蒂博，出任第四次十字军领袖。十字军转攻君士坦丁堡，于1204年洗劫该城；威尼斯人阻挠他当选拉丁皇帝，他便于1205年建立帖撒罗尼迦王国并加冕为王。同年他迎娶匈牙利的玛格丽特，即皇帝伊萨克二世·安格洛斯的遗孀。1207年9月4日，他在弗拉赫人的伏击中身亡，首级被送往保加利亚沙皇卡洛扬处。

en: Demetrios Angelos Doukas (born c. 1220) was the youngest son of Theodore Komnenos Doukas and Maria Petraliphaina. On his brother John's death in 1244 he succeeded as ruler of Thessalonica, and the Nicaean emperor John III Vatatzes confirmed him with the title of Despot. Young and dissolute, he won little loyalty from the city's leading families, who conspired to hand Thessalonica to Nicaea. In 1246 Nicaean troops were admitted through a gate and the city was annexed. Demetrios surrendered through his sister Irene's intercession and was exiled to the fortress of Lentiana in Bithynia, where he probably died.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/德米特里奥斯·安格洛斯·杜卡斯
zh: 德米特里奥斯·安格洛斯·杜卡斯（约1220年生）是狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯与玛利亚·佩特拉丽菲娜的幼子。1244年其兄约翰去世，他继位统治塞萨洛尼基，尼西亚皇帝约翰三世确认他的继承权并授予“专制君主”头衔。他年少放荡，不受城中名门拥戴，后者密谋把塞萨洛尼基献给尼西亚。1246年，尼西亚军队经内应开门入城，塞萨洛尼基被吞并；德米特里奥斯经姐姐伊琳娜求情投降，后被流放至比提尼亚的伦蒂亚纳要塞，可能在那里去世。

en: John Komnenos Doukas (c. 1214–1244), eldest son of Theodore Komnenos Doukas and Maria Petraliphaina, was captured with his family by Tsar Ivan Asen II at Klokotnitsa in 1230 and freed in 1237, when his sister Irene married the Bulgarian tsar. His blinded father then ousted his brother Manuel from Thessalonica and installed John as ruler. In 1239 Manuel returned with Nicaean support and took Thessaly, a loss Theodore and John accepted. John used the imperial title by 1241, when Ivan Asen's death deprived Thessalonica of Bulgarian protection. In 1242 John III Doukas Vatatzes of Nicaea marched on the city and forced John to drop the imperial title, accept the rank of despot and recognize Nicaean suzerainty. John showed little talent for governing and was said to have wished to become a priest. He died in 1244 and was succeeded by his brother Demetrios.
zh: 约翰·科穆宁·杜卡斯（约1214—1244）是狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯与玛丽亚·佩特拉利法伊娜的长子。1230年，他与家人在科洛特尼察战役中被保加利亚沙皇伊凡·阿森二世俘虏，1237年因姐姐伊琳娜嫁给沙皇而获释。失明的父亲随后从叔父曼努埃尔手中夺取帖撒罗尼迦，立约翰为统治者。1239年，曼努埃尔在尼西亚支持下返回并占领色萨利，狄奥多尔和约翰接受了这一损失。约翰至迟于1241年使用帝号；当年伊凡·阿森去世，帖撒罗尼迦失去了保加利亚的庇护。1242年，尼西亚皇帝约翰三世·杜卡斯·瓦塔策斯进军该城，迫使约翰放弃帝号，接受专制公头衔并承认尼西亚的宗主权。约翰缺乏治理才能，据称希望成为神父；他于1244年去世，其弟季米特里奥斯继位。

en: Theodore Komnenos Doukas (born 1180–1185, died c. 1253) was a Greek prince of imperial descent who took power in Epirus after his half-brother Michael I died in 1215. After the Fourth Crusade captured Constantinople in 1204, he had served Theodore I Laskaris in Nicaea before joining Michael in Epirus. He captured the Latin emperor Peter of Courtenay in 1217 and took Thessalonica in 1224, crowning himself emperor there in rivalry with Nicaea. In 1230 Tsar Ivan Asen II of Bulgaria defeated and captured him at the Battle of Klokotnitsa; Theodore was blinded during his captivity. Freed in 1237, he ruled Thessalonica through his sons John and Demetrios until Nicaea annexed the city in 1246, and he died in Nicaean exile around 1253.
zh: 狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯（1180—1185年生，约1253年卒）是出身科穆宁皇室的希腊王公，1215年在同父异母兄长米哈伊尔一世死后接管伊庇鲁斯。1204年第四次十字军攻占君士坦丁堡后，他曾在尼西亚为狄奥多尔一世·拉斯卡里斯效力，后来到伊庇鲁斯投奔米哈伊尔。1217年他俘获拉丁皇帝库特奈的彼得，1224年攻取帖撒罗尼迦并在此加冕为帝，与尼西亚帝国争锋。1230年，保加利亚沙皇伊凡·阿森二世在科洛特尼察战役中将他击败俘获；他在囚禁期间被刺瞎双目。1237年获释后，他先后借儿子约翰和季米特里奥斯之名统治帖撒罗尼迦，直到1246年尼西亚吞并该城；约1253年，他死于尼西亚的流放之中。

en: Brian Ruadh Ó Briain (died 1277), a younger son of Conor na Siudane, succeeded his father as King of Thomond in 1268. In 1270 he attacked the Anglo-Norman colonists north of the Shannon and stormed Clare Castle. In 1275 his nephew Toirdhealbhach, backed by the MacNamaras, drove him from Clonroad, and Brian allied himself with Thomas de Clare, to whom the English crown granted all Thomond in January 1276. Defeated by Toirdhealbhach at Moygressan in 1277, he was soon afterwards hanged by de Clare at Bunratty. His sons Donnchadh and Domnall carried on his Clann Briain line.
zh: 布莱恩·鲁阿·奥布赖恩（？—1277）是康纳·纳·修丹较年幼的儿子，1268年继其父为托蒙德国王。1270年他进攻香农河以北的盎格鲁-诺曼殖民者，攻克克莱尔城堡。1275年，侄子托伊尔德爾巴赫在麦克纳马拉氏支持下把他赶出克朗罗德，布莱恩遂与托马斯·德·克莱尔结盟；1276年1月，英格兰王室将整个托蒙德封赐给德·克莱尔。1277年他在莫伊格雷桑被托伊尔德爾巴赫击败，不久被德·克莱尔在本拉提处以绞刑。其子唐查德与多姆纳尔延续了“克朗·布莱恩”一系。

en: Conor na Siudane Ua Briain (died 1268), son of Donnchadh Cairbreach, ruled Thomond as English colonisation advanced: Robert de Musegros received Tradraige and the castles of Clare and Bunratty were built in 1249–1253. Through yearly tribute Conor kept the rest of his kingdom, and in 1257 he and his son Tadhg nearly expelled the English entirely. In 1268, campaigning in the Burren, he was slain fighting Conor Carrach O'Loughlin at the wood of Siudan, the place that gave him his epithet. Buried at Corcomroe Abbey, where his stone effigy survives, he was succeeded by his son Brian Ruadh.
zh: 康纳·纳·修丹·奥布赖恩（？—1268）是唐查德·凯尔布雷赫之子，他统治托蒙德期间英格兰人的渗透显著加剧：罗贝尔·德·米斯格罗斯获得特拉德里格，1249—1253年又建起克莱尔和本拉提两座城堡。康纳以缴纳年贡保住了王国的其余地区，并于1257年与儿子塔格几乎把英格兰人尽数驱逐。1268年他进军巴伦作战，在修丹林地与康纳·卡拉赫·奥洛克林交战时被杀，其绰号“纳·修丹”即得自这处地点。他葬于科科姆罗修道院，院内的石像保存完好；死后由儿子布莱恩·鲁阿继位。

en: Diarmait Cléirech Ó Briain (died 1 June 1313), surnamed the Clerk, was the son of Donnchad mac Briain and grandson of Brian Ruadh. In 1311, after the death of King Donnchad mac Toirdhealbhach, Richard de Clare imposed him as king of Thomond and had him inaugurated at Magh Adhair. William de Burgh, who backed the rival claim of Muircheartach Ó Briain, resisted him, and de Clare's plan to partition the kingdom was rejected by both sides. Diarmait died suddenly on 1 June 1313 and was buried in the Franciscan church, leaving Thomond to renewed civil war.
zh: 迪尔梅德·克莱尔雷赫·奥布赖恩（？—1313年6月1日），绰号“教士”，是唐查德·麦克·布莱恩之子、布莱恩·鲁阿之孙。1311年国王唐查德·麦克·托伊尔德爾巴赫死后，理查·德·克莱尔把他立为托蒙德国王，并在马格·阿代尔为他举行即位仪式。威廉·德·伯格支持其对手穆伊尔赫尔塔赫·奥布赖恩，起而抵制；德·克莱尔瓜分王国的方案也被双方拒绝。1313年6月1日迪尔梅德暴卒，葬于方济各会教堂，身后托蒙德再陷内战。

en: Diarmait mac Toirdelbaig Ó Briain, anglicised Dermot O'Brien, was a son of Toirdhealbhach Mór, king of Thomond. In 1317 he crushed the rival Clann Briain faction at Corcomroe, securing the kingship for his brother Muircheartach. Under a pact agreed with the MacNamara in 1336, he succeeded Muircheartach in 1343, but the MacNamara soon deposed him in favour of Brian Bán. Restored after Brian's murder in 1350, he ruled until his nephew Mathghamhain deposed him in 1360. He died in 1364 and was buried with the Franciscan friars at Ennis.
zh: 迪尔梅特·麦克·托伊尔德巴赫·奥布莱恩（英语化为德莫特·奥布莱恩）是托蒙德国王托伊尔德巴赫·莫尔之子。1317年，他在科科鲁瓦击溃敌对的布莱恩支派，为其兄弟穆尔切尔特赫夺下王位。根据1336年与麦克纳马拉家族达成的协议，他于1343年继承穆尔切尔特赫，但麦克纳马拉家族很快将他废黜，改立布莱恩·班。1350年布莱恩遇刺后他复位，1360年被侄子马特加曼废黜。他于1364年去世，葬在恩尼斯的方济各会修道院。

en: Domnall Mór Ua Briain (died 1194), third son of Toirdhealbhach mac Diarmada, became King of Thomond in 1168 after his brother's death. He submitted to Henry II of England at Cashel in 1171 but kept fighting the Norman invaders of southwest Ireland, crushing a Cambro-Norman army at the Battle of Thurles in 1175 and retaking Limerick in 1176. In 1185 he defeated the forces of Prince John in the Suir valley. He founded Holy Cross Abbey in 1180 and Kilcooly Abbey in 1184, both Cistercian houses, and died in 1194, regarded as the last king of Munster.
zh: 多姆纳尔·莫尔·奥布赖恩（？—1194）是托伊尔德爾巴赫·麦克·迪尔马达的第三子，1168年其兄死后成为托蒙德国王。1171年他在卡舍尔向英格兰国王亨利二世臣服，但仍继续抗击入侵爱尔兰西南部的诺曼人：1175年在瑟勒斯战役中大破坎布里亚-诺曼军队，1176年收复利默里克，1185年在舒尔河谷击败约翰王子的部队。他于1180年建立圣十字修道院、1184年建立基尔库利修道院，二者均为西多会修道院；他于1194年去世，被视为最后一位芒斯特国王。

en: Domnall mac Brian Ruadh Ó Briain, known as Donald O'Brien of Ara, was a younger son of Brian Ruadh. He married Mairéad Nic Mathghamhna and fathered Donnchad mac Domnaill and Brian Bán, both later kings of Thomond.
zh: 多姆纳尔·麦克·布莱恩·鲁阿·奥布赖恩，又称阿拉的唐纳德，是布莱恩·鲁阿的幼子。他娶玛蕾德·尼克·马武纳，生子唐查德·麦克·多姆纳尔与布莱恩·班，二人后来都成为托蒙德国王。

en: Donnchadh Cairbreach Ó Briain (died 1242), a son of Domnall Mór, became King of Thomond after his father's sons fought over the succession. In the 1210s he founded Ennis Friary as penance for his feud with his brother Muircheartach Finn. When the MacConmara and Ó Cuinn clans revolted, he crushed them with Norman help from his brother-in-law de Burgh, paying for it by granting Limerick and surrounding lands to the colonists; Thomond was thereby reduced to the area of modern County Clare behind the Shannon. He died in 1242.
zh: 唐查德·凯尔布雷赫·奥布赖恩（？—1242）是多姆纳尔·莫尔之子，在父亲的儿子们争夺继承权之后成为托蒙德国王。1210年代，他为与兄弟穆伊尔赫尔塔赫·芬的争斗忏悔，建立了恩尼斯修道院。麦克纳马拉氏族与奥奎因氏族起兵反叛，他借助姻亲德·伯格和其他诺曼人的力量将其镇压，作为回报把利默里克及周边土地授予殖民者，托蒙德因此被压缩到香农河以西、相当于今克莱尔郡的范围。他于1242年去世。

en: Donnchad mac Briain Ó Briain (died 1284), eldest son of Brian Ruadh, claimed Thomond after his father's execution by Thomas de Clare in May 1277. In 1278 he and his brothers raided de Clare's lands and sacked Quin, but the civil war against their cousin Toirdhealbhach Mór forced them back into de Clare's alliance. In 1280 de Clare imposed a partition, giving western Thomond to Donnchad and the east to Toirdhealbhach; fighting soon resumed. In 1284 Donnchad was betrayed by his own men and killed while bathing in the Fergus near Clare Castle. His son was Diarmait Cléirech Ó Briain.
zh: 唐查德·麦克·布莱恩·奥布赖恩（？—1284）是布莱恩·鲁阿的长子。1277年5月其父被托马斯·德·克莱尔处死后，他起而争夺托蒙德。1278年，他与诸弟袭掠德·克莱尔的领地，洗劫昆奇，但与表亲托伊尔德爾巴赫·莫尔的内战迫使他们重新与德·克莱尔结盟。1280年，德·克莱尔强行瓜分托蒙德，西部归唐查德、东部归托伊尔德爾巴赫，战火很快重燃。1284年，唐查德被亲信出卖，在克莱尔城堡附近的弗格斯河中沐浴时遇害。其子是迪尔梅德·克莱尔雷赫·奥布赖恩。

en: Donnchad mac Domnaill Ó Briain (anglicized Donough O'Brien; died 17 August 1317), son of Domnall mac Brian Ruadh, succeeded his cousin Diarmait Cléirech as king of Thomond in 1313 and led the Clann Briain against their kinsman Muircheartach Ó Briain, whom he expelled in 1314. He backed Edward Bruce's invasion of Ireland and was among the defeated at Athenry in 1316. After Richard de Clare withdrew his support he fled to Connacht. On 17 August 1317 he was killed near Corcomroe Abbey fighting Muircheartach's brother Diarmait.
zh: 邓肯·麦克·多姆纳尔·奥布赖恩是多姆纳尔·麦克·布赖恩·鲁阿之子，1313年继堂亲迪亚尔米德·克莱莱赫为托蒙德国王，率布莱恩支派对抗族亲缪尔切塔赫·奥布赖恩，并于1314年将其驱逐。他支持爱德华·布鲁斯入侵爱尔兰，1316年在阿坦赖战败。理查·德·克莱尔撤去支持后，他逃往康诺特。1317年8月17日，他在科尔科姆鲁修道院附近与缪尔切塔赫之弟迪亚尔米德交战时被杀。

en: Donnchad mac Toirdelbaich Ó Briain (anglicized Donough O'Brien; died 1311), eldest son of Toirdelbach Mór Ó Briain, succeeded his father as king of Thomond in 1306. He led the Clann Turlough with the backing of William Liath de Burgh, while Richard de Clare championed his cousin Diarmait Cléirech. On 20 May 1311 their factions fought near Bunratty, where de Burgh was captured. Donnchad fled but was run down and killed by his cousins near Corcomroe Abbey later that year.
zh: 邓肯·麦克·图尔洛夫·奥布赖恩是图尔洛夫·莫尔·奥布赖恩的长子，1306年继其父为托蒙德国王。他率领图尔洛夫支派，得到“灰发”威廉·德·伯格支持；理查·德·克莱尔则拥立他的堂亲迪亚尔米德·克莱莱赫。1311年5月20日，两派在本拉提附近交战，德·伯格被俘。邓肯出逃，同年晚些时候在科尔科姆鲁修道院附近被族兄弟追及杀害。

en: Muircheartach Ó Briain (died 1343), anglicised Murtogh O'Brien, was a younger son of Toirdhealbhach Mór Ó Briain. He became King of Thomond in 1317 after his cousin Donnchad lost Richard de Clare's support and fled to Connacht; Donnchad's followers were cut down at Corcomroe in August. When Richard de Clare invaded with Normans and his rival Mahon O'Brien, Muircheartach joined his ally Conor O'Dea and routed them at Dysert O'Dea on 10 May 1318, where de Clare was killed, ending Norman power in Thomond. He ruled until his death in 1343.
zh: 穆尔切塔赫·奥布莱恩（？—1343，英语化写作默托格·奥布莱恩）是托伊尔代尔巴赫·莫尔·奥布莱恩较年幼的儿子之一。1317年，他的堂兄唐纳德失去理查·德克莱尔的支持，逃往康诺特，穆尔切塔赫随后成为托蒙德国王；唐纳德的部众于8月在科科姆罗之战中被剿灭。理查·德克莱尔带着诺曼军队与他的对手马洪·奥布莱恩来犯时，穆尔切塔赫联合盟友康纳·奥代，于1318年5月10日在迪塞特奥代之战中大破敌军，德克莱尔兵败身死，诺曼人在托蒙德的势力就此终结。他一直统治到1343年去世。

en: Étaín, daughter of MacGorman of Ibrickane, standard-bearer to King Muircheartach Ó Briain, became the king's wife and mother of his known sons Mathghamhain Maonmhaighe and Toirdhealbhach Maol.
zh: 埃坦是国王穆尔切塔赫·奥布莱恩的掌旗官、伊布里克伦的麦克戈尔曼之女，后来嫁给国王，生下见于记载的两个儿子马塔曼和托伊尔代尔巴赫。

en: Tadhg Cael Uisce Ó Briain (c. 1230–1259) was the eldest son of Conor na Siudane Ua Briain and tánaiste, or heir-designate, of Thomond. He took his byname from the conference of Cael Uisce, which he attended as his father's representative and where he refused to acknowledge Brian Ua Néill as High King of Ireland. He married Fionnuala of the O'Brien kindred, and died in 1259 before his father, leaving a young son, Toirdhealbhach Mór, whose descendants led the Clann Tadhg claim to Thomond.
zh: 塔格·凯尔·维什·奥布赖恩（约1230—1259）是康纳·纳·修丹·奥布赖恩的长子，担任托蒙德的塔奈斯特，即指定继承人。他曾代表父亲出席凯尔·维什会议，并在会上拒绝承认布莱恩·奥尼尔为爱尔兰至高王，其绰号“凯尔·维什”便得自这次会议。他娶奥布赖恩同族的菲纽阿拉为妻，1259年先于父亲去世，留下年幼的儿子托伊尔德爾巴赫·莫尔；他的后人以“克朗·塔格”之名争夺托蒙德。

en: Toirdhealbhach Maol Ó Briain, anglicised Turlough O'Brien, was a son of Muircheartach, king of Thomond. After his brother Mathghamhain's death in 1369 he claimed the kingship against his nephew Brian Sreamhach, ruling in rivalry for decades. In 1375, allied with Ulick Burke of Clanricard, he briefly drove Brian out of Thomond and occupied the kingship, but Brian recovered his lands the same year. Toirdhealbhach then retired under English protection in the Pale, where he died of plague in 1398.
zh: 托伊尔德巴赫·麦尔·奥布莱恩（英语化为塔拉·奥布莱恩）是托蒙德国王穆尔切尔特赫之子。1369年其兄马特加曼死后，他与侄子布莱恩·斯雷瓦赫争夺王位，对峙长达数十年。1375年，他联合克兰里卡德的乌利克·伯克，一度将布莱恩逐出托蒙德并登上王位，但布莱恩同年便收复领地。托伊尔德巴赫随后退入英格兰人控制的佩尔地区受其庇护，于1398年死于瘟疫。

en: Toirdhealbhach Mór Ó Briain (c. 1250–1306), son of Tadhg Cael Uisce, made himself King of Thomond by deposing his uncle Brian Ruadh in 1276. When Brian returned with Thomas de Clare's backing, Toirdhealbhach rallied his cousin William de Burgh and the MacNamara and O'Dea clans and overthrew their combined army in 1277. His long struggle with de Clare, who then backed Brian's son Donnchadh until the latter drowned in 1284, became the subject of the epic Caithréim Thoirdhealbhaigh. He ruled until his death in 1306, when his son Donnchadh succeeded him.
zh: 托伊尔德爾巴赫·莫尔·奥布赖恩（约1250—1306）是塔格·凯尔·维什之子，1276年废黜叔父布莱恩·鲁阿，自立为托蒙德国王。布莱恩在托马斯·德·克莱尔支持下反扑时，他集结表亲威廉·德·伯格以及麦克纳马拉、奥戴两氏族的兵力，于1277年击败二人联军。德·克莱尔随后又扶持布莱恩之子唐查德与他对抗，直到唐查德于1284年溺亡；这场长期较量成为史诗《托伊尔德爾巴赫战记》的主题。他统治至1306年去世，由其子唐查德继位。

en: Andrea I Thopia (died c. 1340 at Naples) belonged to the Thopia, an Albanian family that by 1340 held much of the land between the Mati and Shkumbin rivers. In 1338 he inherited the County of Mat from Tanush Thopia. His fall came through a marriage. King Robert of Naples had promised a natural daughter to a ruler in the Morea and sent her to Greece by way of Durrës; in the port she met Andrea, and the two fell in love and married without the king's consent. Robert never accepted the defiance. Years later he invited the couple to Naples on a pretext of reconciliation and had them executed. Their two sons, George and Karl, survived in Albania. Karl rose to be Prince of Albania and could claim kinship with a royal house through his mother, yet fought the Angevins all his life, unable to forgive the killing of his parents.
zh: 安德烈亚一世·托皮亚（约1340年卒于那不勒斯）出身阿尔巴尼亚的托皮亚家族，该家族到1340年已控制马蒂河与什昆宾河之间的大片土地。1338年，他从塔努什·托皮亚手中继承马蒂伯国。他的败亡源于一桩婚事。那不勒斯国王罗贝尔曾把一个私生女许给摩里亚的一位统治者，并送她取道都拉斯前往希腊；在港口，她遇到安德烈亚，两人相爱成婚，事先并未得到国王同意。罗贝尔始终不肯接受这种冒犯。数年后，他以和解为借口邀请夫妇二人前往那不勒斯，并处决了他们。两个儿子乔治和卡尔留在阿尔巴尼亚幸免于难。卡尔后来成为阿尔巴尼亚亲王，凭母系血统可以声称与王室有亲缘关系，却终生与安茹王朝为敌，无法原谅父母被杀。

en: Hélène of Anjou was a natural daughter of Robert the Wise, king of Naples, who promised her in marriage to a ruler in the Morea. While passing through Durrës on her way to Greece, she met the Albanian noble Andrea I Thopia, and the two married without the king's consent. Their sons were Karl and Gjergj Thopia. Refusing to accept the match, Robert lured the couple to Naples on the pretext of reconciliation and had them executed there around 1342. The boys survived in Albania, and Karl later ruled as prince of Albania.
zh: 安茹的埃莱娜是那不勒斯国王“智者”罗贝托的非婚生女儿，原本被许配给摩里亚的一位统治者。她途经都拉斯前往希腊时，结识了阿尔巴尼亚贵族安德里亚一世·托皮亚，二人未经国王同意便结了婚，生下卡尔·托皮亚和捷尔吉·托皮亚两子。罗贝托拒不承认这门婚事，以和解为借口把夫妇二人诱到那不勒斯，于约1342年将他们处死。两个儿子留在阿尔巴尼亚幸免于难，卡尔后来成为阿尔巴尼亚君主。

en: Karl Thopia (c. 1339–1388) was the son of Andrea I Thopia and Hélène, an illegitimate daughter of King Robert of Naples; Robert had both parents executed, and Karl and his brother George grew up at Krujë. In 1358 he won a spectacular victory at Acheloos over Nikephoros II Orsini, Despot of Epirus, who fell in the fight, and from then on styled himself Princeps Albaniae. He took Angevin Durrës in 1368 lost it in 1376 and recovered it in 1383; Pope Gregory XI named him Grand Count of Albania in 1374. At the monastery of St John Vladimir near Elbasan, a trilingual inscription of 1381 has him claim descent from the blood of a French king. When his rival Balsha II seized Durrës in 1385, Thopia and other nobles called in Ottoman troops, who killed Balsha at Savra. He died in January 1388, leaving the princedom to his son Gjergj.
zh: 卡尔·托皮亚（约1339—1388）是安德烈亚一世·托皮亚与埃莱娜之子，埃莱娜是那不勒斯国王罗贝尔的私生女；罗贝尔处死了他的父母，卡尔与兄弟乔治在克鲁亚长大。1358年，他在阿切洛奥斯一役大胜伊庇鲁斯专制君主尼基弗鲁斯二世·奥尔西尼，对方战死，此后他以拉丁称号“阿尔巴尼亚元首”自称。他于1368年夺取安茹治下的都拉斯，1376年失守，1383年收复；1374年教皇格列高利十一世封他为“阿尔巴尼亚大伯爵”。他在埃尔巴桑附近的圣约翰·弗拉迪米尔修道院，1381年的希腊文、拉丁文、塞尔维亚文三语铭文中，他自称出自一位法兰西国王的血脉。1385年，对手巴尔沙二世攻占都拉斯，托皮亚与其他贵族请来奥斯曼军队，在萨夫拉击杀巴尔沙。1388年1月去世，把亲王国传给儿子乔治。

en: Tanusio Thopia was an Albanian count under the Angevins, holding lands in the Mat region. His family, one of the most powerful in Angevin Albania, had been named in a document of 1274 and then vanishes from the record until 1329, when Tanusio appears as one of the counts of Albania; in 1338 Angevin records call him Count of Matia. He served the Princes of Taranto, Philip I and Robert, and the Dukes of Durazzo, John and Charles. The Thopia, who had turned from Orthodoxy to Catholicism, held much of the land between the Mati and Shkumbin rivers by 1340. A later tradition relayed by Karl Hopf makes Andrea I Thopia his son or brother: Andrea abducted and married a natural daughter of King Robert of Naples and was executed with her. That would make Tanusio the grandfather or great-uncle of Karl Thopia, later Prince of Albania.
zh: 塔努西奥·托皮亚是安茹王朝治下的阿尔巴尼亚伯爵，领地在马蒂地区。他的家族是安茹治下阿尔巴尼亚势力最大的家族之一，1274年的文件提到过它，此后直到1329年才再见于记载，那一年塔努西奥被称为阿尔巴尼亚的众伯爵之一；1338年安茹王朝的档案称他为马蒂伯爵。他先后效力于塔兰托亲王腓力一世、罗贝尔，以及都拉斯公爵约翰和查理。托皮亚家族由东正教改宗天主教，到1340年已控制马蒂河与什昆宾河之间的大片土地。卡尔·霍普夫转述的后世传说称安德烈亚一世·托皮亚是他的儿子或兄弟：安德烈亚劫走并娶了那不勒斯国王罗贝尔的一个私生女，最终与她一同被处死。这样，塔努西奥便是后来的阿尔巴尼亚亲王卡尔·托皮亚的祖父或伯祖父。

en: John I Doukas (c. 1231–1289) was an illegitimate son of Michael II Komnenos Doukas, Despot of Epirus, who ruled Thessaly from 1268 until his death. In 1259 he led Vlach troops before his defection to Michael VIII Palaiologos at Pelagonia helped the Nicaeans crush the allies. Returning to his father and brother, he helped them recover Epirus and Thessaly. He became the emperor's foremost Greek opponent: he rejected the Union of the Churches, sheltered its enemies and allied with the Duchy of Athens and Charles of Anjou, while imperial armies failed to subdue him. Michael VIII made him sebastokrator around 1272. He died in 1289, leaving Thessaly to his sons Constantine and Theodore.
zh: 约翰一世·杜卡斯（约1231—1289）是伊庇鲁斯专制君主米哈伊尔二世·科穆宁·杜卡斯的私生子，约1268年起统治色萨利直至去世。1259年，他率领瓦拉几亚军队，随后在佩拉戈尼亚战役中倒戈投奔米哈伊尔八世·帕里奥洛格斯，帮助尼西亚军队击溃联军。此后他回到父兄一边，协助他们收复伊庇鲁斯和色萨利。他成为皇帝最主要的希腊人对手：他抵制东西方教会联合，庇护联合派的敌人，与雅典公国和安茹的查理结盟，帝国军队始终无法征服他。约1272年米哈伊尔八世授予他“至尊者”头衔。1289年他去世，把色萨利留给儿子君士坦丁和狄奥多尔。

en: John II Doukas (c. 1293–1318) ruled Thessaly from 1303 until his death. Succeeding his father Constantine Doukas young, he was given Guy II de la Roche, Duke of Athens, as regent by the Thessalian magnates. From 1306 the Catalan Company ravaged Thessaly for three years, but on coming of age in 1308 John rejected Athenian overlordship and reasserted his authority. Guy's successor Walter hired the Catalans against John, but they turned on Walter and killed him in 1311. John then faced opposition from local magnates. In 1315 he married Irene Palaiologina, an illegitimate daughter of Emperor Andronikos II, and drew closer to Byzantium. He died in 1318 without heirs, and the Catalans and local magnates such as Stephen Gabrielopoulos divided his lands.
zh: 约翰二世·杜卡斯（约1293—1318）1303年起统治色萨利直至去世。他幼年继承父亲君士坦丁·杜卡斯的领地，色萨利贵族推举雅典公爵居伊二世·德拉罗什担任摄政。1306年起，加泰罗尼亚公司蹂躏色萨利达三年之久；1308年约翰成年，拒绝雅典的宗主权，逐步恢复了自己的权威。居伊的继任者瓦尔特雇用加泰罗尼亚人对付约翰，他们却转而攻击瓦尔特，于1311年将其杀死。约翰随后面临本地大贵族的反对。1315年，他迎娶拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡二世的私生女伊琳娜·帕里奥洛吉娜，向拜占庭靠拢。1318年他无嗣而终，领地被加泰罗尼亚人和斯特凡诺斯·加夫里洛普洛斯等本地大贵族瓜分。

en: Constantine Doukas (c. 1276–1303) was the second son of John I Doukas, sebastokrator of Thessaly, by Hypomone. He succeeded his father around 1289 while still underage, ruling under the regency of Anna Palaiologina Kantakouzene and sharing power with his brother Theodore Angelos until Theodore's death around 1299. Invested as sebastokrator around 1295, he fought on against Nikephoros of Epirus and the Angevins, seizing dowry fortresses in 1295 and losing most of them in a 1296 truce; fighting flared again in 1301. He died in 1303 and was succeeded by his son John II Doukas.
zh: 君士坦丁·杜卡斯（约1276—1303）是色萨利至尊者约翰一世·杜卡斯与希波莫尼的次子，约1289年继其父之位，因未成年由安娜·巴列奥略娜·坎塔库泽内摄政，并与弟弟狄奥多尔·安格洛斯共同执政，直至狄奥多尔约1299年去世。约1295年他受封至尊者，继续与伊庇鲁斯的尼基弗鲁斯及安茹同盟作战，1295年夺取多座嫁妆要塞，1296年依停战协定丧失大部，1301年战事又起。他于1303年去世，其子约翰二世·杜卡斯继位。

en: Manuel Komnenos Doukas (c. 1187–c. 1241) was a son of the sebastokrator John Doukas and brother of Theodore Komnenos Doukas of Epirus. After Theodore's defeat and capture at Klokotnitsa in 1230, Ivan Asen II of Bulgaria allowed Manuel to rule Thessalonica as despot. In 1235 he joined the Nicaean and Bulgarian siege of Constantinople. He was driven from Thessalonica in 1237 and fled to Nicaea, but returned with Nicaean support in 1239 to seize Larissa and Pharsalos, ruling Thessaly until his death around 1241.
zh: 曼努埃尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯（约1187—约1241）是至尊者约翰·杜卡斯之子，伊庇鲁斯的狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯之弟。1230年其兄在克洛科特尼察战败被俘后，保加利亚的伊凡·阿森二世允许他以专制君主身份统治塞萨洛尼基。1235年，他参加尼西亚与保加利亚联军围攻君士坦丁堡。1237年他被逐出塞萨洛尼基，逃往尼西亚；1239年在尼西亚支持下返回，夺取拉里萨和法萨卢斯，统治色萨利，约1241年去世。

en: Stephen Gabrielopoulos (died 1332/1333) was a Byzantine magnate and semi-independent ruler in western Thessaly. After the death of John II Doukas without a male heir in 1318, Byzantine troops occupied northern Thessaly and the Catalans entered the south. Amid the collapse of Thessaly's principality, Gabrielopoulos turned to Constantinople: between 1318 and 1325 he acknowledged the emperor's suzerainty and received the court title of sebastokrator. As the emperor's de facto governor he ruled a broad domain stretching from Trikala to Kastoria, including the fortresses of Stagoi, Phanarion, Damasis and Elasson. After his death his heirs quarrelled, drawing in Byzantine and Epirote armies, and his lands soon passed under direct imperial rule.
zh: 斯特凡诺斯·加夫里洛普洛斯（1332/1333年卒）是拜占庭的大贵族，也是色萨利西部半独立的统治者。1318年约翰二世·杜卡斯去世，没有留下男性继承人，拜占庭军队占领色萨利北部，加泰罗尼亚人进入南部。色萨利君主国土崩瓦解之际，加夫里洛普洛斯转而投靠君士坦丁堡：1318年至1325年间他承认拜占庭皇帝的宗主权，获授“至尊者”的宫廷头衔。他作为皇帝事实上的总督，统治着从特里卡拉到卡斯托里亚的广阔领地，据点包括斯塔吉、法那里翁、达马西斯和埃拉松等要塞。1332或1333年他死后，继承人彼此争权，招来拜占庭与伊庇鲁斯的军队，他的领地不久便被帝国直接管辖。

en: Theodore Angelos (c. 1278–c. 1299) was the third son of John I Doukas, sebastokrator of Thessaly, by Hypomone. When his father died around 1289 he and his older brother Constantine were still underage and ruled under the tutelage of Anna Palaiologina Kantakouzene, Theodore serving as Constantine's co-ruler. In 1295 the Byzantine emperor granted him the title sebastokrator. A planned marriage to Theophano, daughter of Leo II of Armenia, came to nothing, and he was defeated in battle by the Byzantine general Michael Doukas Glabas Tarchaneiotes. He died around 1299.
zh: 狄奥多尔·安格洛斯（约1278—约1299）是色萨利至尊者约翰一世·杜卡斯与希波莫尼的第三子。约1289年父亲去世时，他与兄长君士坦丁均未成年，由安娜·巴列奥略娜·坎塔库泽内监护；他作为君士坦丁的共治者统治色萨利。1295年，拜占庭皇帝授予他至尊者头衔。他原定迎娶亚美尼亚国王莱翁二世之女狄奥法诺，婚事最终落空；他在战场上被拜占庭将领米哈伊尔·杜卡斯·格拉巴斯·塔尔哈尼奥特斯击败，约1299年去世。

en: Berthold Vitzthum zu Apolda was a Thuringian knight of the ministerial Vitzthum family. Early in the fourteenth century he and his brother Dietrich, who died in 1337, founded its Apolda and Roßla branches; Berthold, ancestor of the Vitzthum zu Apolda line, died in 1335.
zh: 贝特霍尔德·菲茨图姆·楚·阿波尔达是图林根菲茨图姆家臣家族的骑士。14世纪初，他与卒于1337年的兄弟迪特里希分别开创了家族的阿波尔达支与罗斯拉支；贝特霍尔德是菲茨图姆·楚·阿波尔达一支的始祖，卒于1335年。

en: Khatsun Namkha Lekpa Gyaltsen (1305–1343) was a Sakya ruler of the Khon family under the Yuan dynasty, and he held the seat just as the school's hold on Tibet began to loosen. His father Zangpo Pal, a nephew of Phagpa, had presided over Sakya rule at its height. After Zangpo Pal died in 1324, the imperial preceptor Kunga Lotro Gyaltsen, Namkha Lekpa's elder brother, divided the brothers among four palace branches, and Namkha Lekpa headed the Zhitog.
