Made State Preceptor (guoshi) in 1325, he kept the post until 1341, though it carried a more local reach than the imperial preceptorship. Under him Sakya failed to put down revolts, and the rival Phagmodrupa gained control of much of the plateau. He died in 1343 and was succeeded by his brother Jamyang Donyo Gyaltsen; his son Kunga Rinchen later became the sixteenth Sakya Trizin.
zh: 阔尊南喀勒贝洛追坚赞（1305—1343），通称囊卡来巴，是元朝时昆氏家族的萨迦派法主，他接掌法座时，萨迦对西藏的统治正开始松动。其父达尼钦波桑波贝是八思巴的侄子，在位时萨迦的统治达到鼎盛。1324年桑波贝去世，囊卡来巴的兄长、帝师贡噶洛追坚赞把诸弟分为四个拉章，囊卡来巴领细脱拉章。1325年他受封“国师”，任职至1341年；国师职权较帝师更侧重地方。他在位期间，萨迦未能有效平定叛乱，敌对的帕木竹巴掌握了高原上的大片地区。1343年他去世，法主之位由弟弟嘉央屯月坚赞继承；其子衮噶仁钦后来成为第十六代萨迦法王。

en: Zangpo Pal (1261–1323) was abbot-ruler of Sakya, leading Tibetan see under the Yuan. Nephew of Phagpa and son of Yeshe Jungne, he was exiled by Kublai Khan to a southern Chinese island after his legitimacy was questioned. When his cousin died in 1287, Kublai passed over Zangpo Pal and entrusted the Sakya estates to the Sharpa family. Temür Khan recalled him in 1296; he reached Sakya in 1298 and took full abbot-ruler power in 1306. Named State Preceptor in 1311, he fathered thirteen sons, including Kunga Lotro Gyaltsen, appointed imperial preceptor in 1314. His reign was peaceful, but in 1322 his sons were divided into four palace branches, sowing the rivalries that weakened Sakya before his death in 1323.
zh: 达尼钦波桑波贝（1261—1323）是元朝治下西藏首席教派萨迦派的萨迦法王。他是八思巴的侄子、意希迥乃之子，因身世受到质疑，被忽必烈汗流放到华南沿海的一座岛上。1287年他的堂兄去世后，忽必烈没有让他继承，而是把萨迦的领地交给夏尔巴家族。1296年铁穆耳汗将他召回，他于1298年抵达萨迦，1306年正式接任萨迦法王全权。1311年他受封“国师”，共育有十三子，其中贡噶洛追坚赞于1314年被任命为帝师。他在位时藏地大体安定，但1322年儿子们被划分为四个拉章支系，埋下内争的种子，削弱了萨迦，他于1323年去世。

en: Adelaide of Brunswick-Grubenhagen (1285–18 August 1320) was the daughter of Duke Henry I of Brunswick-Grubenhagen and Agnes of Meissen. On 15 September 1315 she married at Innsbruck Henry of Carinthia, the deposed king of Bohemia, roughly twenty years her senior, who sought an heir and stronger alliances. She bore the empty title of queen of Bohemia but never visited the kingdom. Her children were a daughter Adelaide, born in 1317, and Margaret, born in Tyrol in 1318, the future Countess of Tyrol. She died in 1320 without producing a male heir.
zh: 不伦瑞克—格鲁本哈根的阿德莱德（1285—1320年8月18日）是不伦瑞克—格鲁本哈根公爵亨利一世与迈森的阿格尼丝之女。1315年9月15日，她在因斯布鲁克嫁给被废黜的波希米亚国王、克恩滕公爵亨利；新郎年长约二十岁，希望借这桩政治婚姻巩固同盟并得到继承人。她拥有波希米亚王后的空头衔，却从未到过波希米亚。她的子女有1317年出生的女儿阿德莱德，以及1318年生于蒂罗尔、后来成为蒂罗尔女伯爵的玛格丽特。她于1320年去世，没有产下男性继承人。

en: Agnes of Hohenberg was a daughter of Count Albert II of Hohenberg-Rotenburg. She married Albert of Gorizia-Tirol, a son of Count Meinhard II of Tyrol; their daughter Margaret married Frederick IV, Burgrave of Nuremberg.
zh: 霍恩贝格的阿格尼丝是霍恩贝格-罗滕堡伯爵阿尔布雷希特二世之女，嫁给蒂罗尔伯爵迈因哈德二世之子阿尔布雷希特，两人的女儿玛格丽特后来嫁给纽伦堡城堡伯爵腓特烈四世。

en: Albert II of Gorizia-Tyrol (c. 1266–30 April 1292) was a son of Count Meinhard II of Gorizia-Tyrol and Elisabeth of Bavaria. His father entrusted him with duties as vogt and marked him out to share the family's Tyrolean and Carinthian inheritance with his brothers Otto, Louis and Henry. Around 1281 he married Agnes of Hohenberg, daughter of Count Albert II of Hohenberg-Rottenburg. Their daughter Margaret married Burgrave Frederick IV of Nuremberg. Albert died before his father in late April 1292, so he never took part in the joint rule that began in 1295.
zh: 格尔茨—蒂罗尔的阿尔布雷希特二世（约1266—1292年4月30日）是格尔茨—蒂罗尔伯爵迈因哈德二世与巴伐利亚的伊丽莎白之子。父亲委派他以福格特（地方长官）的身份承担一些事务，并指定他与兄弟奥托、路易、亨利共同继承家族在蒂罗尔和克恩滕的产业。约1281年，他迎娶霍亨贝格—罗滕堡伯爵阿尔布雷希特二世之女阿格尼丝；女儿玛格丽特后来嫁给纽伦堡城堡伯爵腓特烈四世。他于1292年4月下旬先于父亲去世，未能参加1295年开始的兄弟共治。

en: Euphemia (c. 1281–1347) was a Piast princess, daughter of Henry V the Fat, Duke of Legnica, and Elisabeth of Greater Poland. In 1297 she married Otto III of the House of Gorizia, who ruled as Duke of Carinthia and Count of Tyrol jointly with his brothers. Their four daughters included Anna, who married the Count Palatine Rudolf II, and Elisabeth, wife of King Peter II of Sicily. As Otto left no son at his death in 1310, his brother Henry inherited Carinthia and Tyrol. Euphemia outlived him by decades and died in June 1347.
zh: 欧费米娅（约1281—1347）是皮雅斯特家族的公主，莱格尼察公爵“胖子”亨里克五世与大波兰的伊丽莎白之女。1297年，她嫁给格尔茨家族的奥托三世；奥托与诸兄弟共同统治克恩滕公国和蒂罗尔伯国。她生下四个女儿，其中安娜嫁给行宫伯爵鲁道夫二世，伊丽莎白嫁给西西里国王彼得二世。1310年奥托去世时没有儿子，其弟亨利继承克恩滕和蒂罗尔。欧费米娅在丈夫死后又活了数十年，于1347年6月去世。

en: Henry (Heinrich von Kärnten, c. 1265–1335) of the House of Gorizia was the younger son of Count Meinhard II of Tyrol. He inherited Tyrol and Carinthia in 1295, initially ruling with his brothers Otto and Louis, and backed his brother-in-law Albert I of Habsburg at the Battle of Göllheim in 1298. After marrying the Přemyslid princess Anne in 1306 he was elected king of Bohemia, but Albert's troops drove him out. He was elected again in 1307 after the death of Albert's son Rudolf. In 1310 John of Luxembourg invaded Bohemia and took Prague, forcing Henry to withdraw to his Alpine lands. His daughter by Adelaide of Brunswick was Margaret Maultasch; on his death in 1335 the Habsburgs seized Carinthia.
zh: 亨利（德语名海因里希·冯·克恩滕，约1265—1335）出身格尔茨家族，是蒂罗尔伯爵迈因哈德二世的幼子。1295年他继承蒂罗尔和克恩滕，起初与兄弟奥托和路易共同统治；1298年他在格尔海姆战役中支持姐夫哈布斯堡的阿尔布雷希特一世。1306年他迎娶普热米斯尔王朝的安娜，被推举为波希米亚国王，却被阿尔布雷希特的军队逐出。1307年阿尔布雷希特之子鲁道夫去世后，他再次当选国王。1310年卢森堡的约翰入侵波希米亚并攻取布拉格，亨利被迫退回阿尔卑斯领地。他与不伦瑞克的阿德莱德之女即玛格丽特·莫尔塔施；1335年他去世后，哈布斯堡家族夺取了克恩滕。

en: John Henry of Luxembourg (1322–1375), Czech Jan Jindřich, was the younger son of King John of Bohemia and brother of Emperor Charles IV. In 1330 he married Margaret, heiress of Tyrol, and ruled the county with her from 1335. In 1341 Margaret, backed by the Tyrolean nobility, drove him out and had the marriage annulled in 1349. Charles IV then enfeoffed him with Moravia, where as margrave from 1349 he founded the Moravian line of the House of Luxembourg, holding court at Brno. A loyal imperial diplomat, he died at Brno in 1375.
zh: 卢森堡的约翰·海因里希（捷克语作扬·因德日赫，1322—1375）是波希米亚国王约翰之子、皇帝查理四世之弟。1330年他娶蒂罗尔女继承人玛格丽特，1335年起与她共同统治蒂罗尔。1341年，玛格丽特在蒂罗尔贵族支持下将他驱逐，并于1349年废止婚姻。查理四世随后把摩拉维亚封给他：1349年起任藩侯的他以布尔诺为都城，开创了卢森堡家族的摩拉维亚支系。他长年为兄长充当外交使节，1375年卒于布尔诺。

en: Louis of Gorizia-Tyrol (c. 1268–1305) was a son of Duke Meinhard of Carinthia and Elisabeth of Bavaria, and a younger brother of Otto III. On Meinhard's death in 1295 he inherited the Duchy of Carinthia and the County of Tyrol jointly with his brothers, and was appointed Vogt, or secular advocate, of the Bishops of Trent. He died in 1305, before his brother Otto, and the joint rule passed to Otto and their youngest brother Henry VI.
zh: 格尔茨—蒂罗尔的路易（约1268—1305）是克恩滕公爵迈因哈德与巴伐利亚的伊丽莎白之子，奥托三世的弟弟。1295年迈因哈德去世后，他与兄弟们共同继承克恩滕公国和蒂罗尔伯国，并被任命为特伦托主教的福格特，即世俗代理人。他于1305年先于其兄奥托去世，共治之责落到奥托与幼弟亨利六世身上。

en: Margaret, called Maultasch (1318–1369), was the last Countess of Tyrol from the House of Gorizia and the only surviving child of Duke Henry of Carinthia. In 1330 she was married to John Henry of Luxembourg; the two disliked each other from the start. Habsburgs and Wittelsbachs had agreed to carve up Tyrol, but the Tyroleans refused, and only the Peace of Enns in 1336 let her take up her inheritance. On the night of 1 November 1341 she and her Tyrolean councillors barred the gates of Tyrol Castle to her husband, back late from a hunt. In 1342 she married Margrave Louis of Brandenburg without a divorce, drawing excommunication from Pope Clement VI. When her son Meinhard III died in 1363, she ceded Tyrol to the Habsburg Rudolf IV of Austria and lived out her years in Vienna, kept away from Tyrol. She died in 1369, four days after the Wittelsbachs gave up their claim at Schärding.
zh: 绰号“莫尔塔施”的玛格丽特（1318—1369）是格尔茨家族末代蒂罗尔女伯爵，也是克恩滕公爵亨利唯一活下来的孩子。1330年她嫁给卢森堡的约翰·海因里希，两人从一开始就互相厌恶。哈布斯堡家与维特尔斯巴赫家本已议定瓜分蒂罗尔，但蒂罗尔人不肯，直到1336年的恩斯和约，她才得以接掌继承的土地。1341年11月1日夜里，丈夫打猎晚归，她与蒂罗尔的顾问们把蒂罗尔城堡的大门关在他面前。1342年，她在未离婚的情况下改嫁勃兰登堡藩侯路易，因此被教皇克雷芒六世处以绝罚。1363年儿子迈因哈德三世去世，她将蒂罗尔让给哈布斯堡家族的奥地利公爵鲁道夫四世，在维也纳度过余生，不得再回蒂罗尔。1369年维特尔斯巴赫家在舍尔丁和约中放弃对蒂罗尔的要求，四天后她去世。

en: Meinhard II (c. 1238–1295) of the House of Gorizia ruled Gorizia and Tyrol with his brother Albert from 1258, receiving Tyrol when they divided them in 1271. As boys, the brothers had been held hostage at Hohenwerfen until their father's death in 1258. By marrying Elisabeth of Bavaria, widow of Conrad IV, he became stepfather of Conradin. He accompanied Conradin on his Italian campaign in 1267, then sought new allies after his execution. He allied with Rudolf of Habsburg, fought at the Marchfeld against Ottokar II of Bohemia in 1278, and in 1286 received Carinthia in fief. He built Tyrol, founding Stams Abbey, minting the Groschen and issuing a vernacular Tyrolean Landrecht. He died at Greifenburg; his daughter Elisabeth became German queen, his son Henry succeeding in Carinthia and Tyrol.
zh: 格尔茨家族的迈因哈德二世（约1238—1295）自1258年起与弟弟阿尔贝特共同统治格尔茨和蒂罗尔，1271年瓜分领地时分得蒂罗尔。兄弟二人幼时曾在霍亨韦尔芬被扣为人质，直到父亲于1258年去世。他娶了康拉德四世的遗孀、巴伐利亚的伊丽莎白，因此成为康拉丁的继父。1267年他陪同康拉丁远征意大利，康拉丁被处死后他转而寻找新的盟友。他与哈布斯堡的鲁道夫结盟，1278年在马希费尔德之战中对抗波希米亚国王奥托卡二世，1286年受封克恩滕公国。他经营蒂罗尔，创立施塔姆斯修道院，铸造格罗申银币，颁布用方言写成的《蒂罗尔邦法》。他在格赖芬堡去世；女儿伊丽莎白成为德意志王后，儿子亨利继位统治克恩滕和蒂罗尔。

en: Otto III of Carinthia (c. 1265–25 May 1310) was a son of Duke Meinhard of Carinthia and Elisabeth of Bavaria. When Meinhard died in 1295, Otto inherited the Duchy of Carinthia and the County of Tyrol, ruling jointly with his brothers Louis and Henry VI. He fixed the border with the Bishopric of Brixen at the confluence of the Adige and Avisio, and in 1305 expanded the market at Gries against bishop-controlled Bolzano. In 1297 he married Euphemia of Legnica, who bore him four daughters. He died without male issue and was succeeded by Henry VI.
zh: 克恩滕的奥托三世（约1265—1310年5月25日）是克恩滕公爵迈因哈德与巴伐利亚的伊丽莎白之子。1295年迈因哈德去世后，他继承克恩滕公国和蒂罗尔伯国，与弟弟路易和亨利六世共治。他与布里克森教区划定边界，以阿迪杰河与阿维肖河交汇处为界；1305年扩建格里斯的市场，与主教控制的博尔扎诺竞争。1297年他迎娶莱格尼察的尤菲米娅，生有四个女儿。他没有男性继承人，死后由亨利六世继位。

en: Kumaran Iyakan Manikandan ruled the Kerala kingdom of Thekkumkur around 1300 and was mentioned in the Tiruvalla copper plates.
zh: 库马拉·伊亚坎·马尼坎丹约于1300年统治喀拉拉的特昆库尔王国，蒂鲁瓦拉铜板提及了他。

en: Abu Hammu Musa I (died 1318) was the fourth Zayyanid sultan of Tlemcen and a son of Sultan Abu Said Uthman. He succeeded his brother Abu Zayyan I on 15 April 1308, when the kingdom was exhausted by the long Marinid siege of its capital. Continuing his brother's efforts to restore Zayyanid power, he pacified the Banu Tujin and Maghrawa tribes and re-established control over Bejaia and Constantine. He strengthened the kingdom's fortifications and halted Marinid expansion near Oujda. While maintaining a strong army, he paid little attention to his subjects' material and intellectual needs. His harsh treatment of his son Abu Tashufin proved fatal: in 1318 the prince had him assassinated and seized the throne.
zh: 阿布·哈穆·穆萨一世（？—1318）是特莱姆森第四任宰扬王朝苏丹，苏丹阿布·赛义德·奥斯曼之子。1308年4月15日，他继兄长阿布·扎扬一世即位，当时王国正因首都长期遭马林王朝围攻而疲敝。他延续兄长恢复宰扬王朝权力的努力，平定巴努·图津和迈格拉瓦部落，重新控制贝贾亚和君士坦丁。他加固王国城防，并在乌季达一带遏制了马林王朝的扩张。他维持强大的军队，却很少关心臣民的物质与学术需求。他苛待儿子阿布·塔舒芬，最终招来杀身之祸：1318年，王子派人将他刺杀并夺取王位。

en: Abu Tashufin I (c. 1295–1337), born Abd al-Rahman, was the Zayyanid sultan of Tlemcen, who in 1318 took the throne by overthrowing and killing his father Abu Hammu Musa I. In 1329 he marched east into Ifriqiya, captured Algiers, beat the Hafsids at the Battle of er-Rais and occupied their capital, Tunis. Next came a Marinid–Hafsid alliance, sealed by the marriage of a Hafsid princess to the Marinid sultan Abu al-Hasan, and it turned against him. The allies besieged Tlemcen from 1335, and Abu Tashufin was killed during the siege in 1337. Abu al-Hasan held the city until 1348, when Abu Tashufin's sons Abu Said Uthman and Abu Thabit retook it. In his capital he had founded the Tashfiniya Madrasa, among the best-known schools sponsored by the Zayyanids, who were the first to patronise madrasas in their part of the Maghreb.
zh: 阿布·塔舒芬一世（约1295—1337）本名阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼，是特莱姆森的宰扬王朝苏丹，1318年废杀父亲阿布·哈穆·穆萨一世夺取王位。1329年他东征伊夫里奇亚，攻占阿尔及尔，在赖斯战役中击败哈夫斯王朝并占领其首都突尼斯。随后出现的是马林与哈夫斯两个王朝的联盟，哈夫斯公主嫁给马林苏丹阿布·哈桑，巩固了这一联盟，矛头转向了他。盟军从1335年起围攻特莱姆森，阿布·塔舒芬于1337年在围城期间被杀。阿布·哈桑占据该城至1348年，才被阿布·塔舒芬的儿子阿布·赛义德·奥斯曼与阿布·萨比特夺回。他曾在都城修建塔舒芬尼亚经学院，是宰扬王朝资助的最著名学府之一；宰扬王朝是马格里布这一带最早资助修建经学院的王朝。

en: Kayin Ba (1253–1342) was a commoner who made himself master of Toungoo. Born an athi east of the Paunglaung river, he joined the founders of Toungoo in 1279 and rose from prison keeper to mayor, winning his name by adopting a Karen orphan girl. In 1317 he backed Thawun Nge's seizure of the governorship, and Toungoo came through a siege by its overlord Pinya. After Thawun Nge died in 1324 his powers were curtailed, but in 1325 King Thihathu of Pinya died and his sons Uzana I and Kyawswa I fought over the throne. The seventy-two-year-old killed the young governor Saw Hnit and took power. Uzana accepted his nominal submission and sent no punitive army. For seventeen years Kayin Ba ruled like a sovereign, repairing irrigation, drawing in settlers and keeping 150 war elephants. He died in 1342 aged eighty-nine; the chronicles call him min, lord. His son-in-law Letya Sekkya succeeded him, and Toungoo broke from Pinya in 1358.
zh: 迦因拔（1253—1342）是一名平民，最终成了东吁的主人。他生于邦朗河以东，出身阿梯家庭，1279年投效东吁的建立者，从狱吏一路升任市长，并因收养一名克伦族孤女而得名。1317年，他支持苏温恩格夺取总督之位，东吁挺过了宗主彬牙的围攻。1324年苏温恩格去世后，他的权力被削减；1325年彬牙国王梯诃都去世，两个儿子乌兹那一世与觉苏瓦一世争夺王位。七十二岁的迦因拔杀死年轻总督苏尼特，夺取了权力。乌兹那接受了他名义上的臣服，没有出兵讨伐。此后十七年，迦因拔像独立君主般统治东吁，修治水利、招徕移民，坐拥150头战象。1342年他去世，享年八十九岁，编年史尊他为“敏”，即主公。他的女婿莱蒂亚·塞基亚继任，东吁于1358年脱离彬牙。

en: Maravarman Kulasekara Pandyan I (r. 1268–1308) succeeded his father Sundara Pandya as the paramount king of the Pandya realm, sharing rule with royal kinsmen; Marco Polo, who visited his wealthy country, called him the eldest of five brother kings. In 1279 he overthrew Rajendra III, the last Chola, and his Hoysala ally Ramanatha, ending Chola rule. His four decades brought peace and prosperity, temple building, and trade through ports such as Kulasekharapatnam. Muslim chroniclers say his son Sundara Pandya killed him, opening the Pandyan civil war of 1308–1323.
zh: 摩拉跋摩·俱罗施佉罗·潘地亚一世（1268—1308年在位）继承其父孙陀罗·潘地亚，成为潘地亚的最高国王，并与其他王族成员共同治国；曾到访其富庶国土的马可·波罗称他为“五兄弟王中最年长者”。1279年，他攻灭末代朱罗王拉金德拉三世，并击败其曷萨拉盟友罗摩那陀，终结了朱罗王朝。他在位约四十年，国泰民安、广建寺庙，俱罗施佉罗帕特南等港口贸易繁盛。据穆斯林史家记载，他最终被儿子孙陀罗·潘地亚所弑，随后爆发1308—1323年的潘地亚内战。

en: Sundara Pandya was the legitimate younger son of the Pandya emperor Maravarman Kulasekhara I at Madurai. When his father died in 1308 his half-brother Vira took the throne, but Sundara seized it in 1309, opening the Pandya civil war. In 1311 Malik Kafur of Delhi overran the kingdom while Sundara avoided battle and lost Madurai. Restored in 1312 and defeated again, he held the south-east from 1314 with Delhi troops under Khusro Khan as a Delhi vassal. In 1323 he and the Kakatiya king Prataparudra II were beaten by Ulugh Khan, and he died around 1327.
zh: 孙陀罗·潘地亚是定都马杜赖的潘地亚皇帝摩罗伐摩·库拉塞卡拉一世的嫡出幼子。1308年父王死后，庶兄毗罗继位，孙陀罗于1309年夺位，潘地亚长期内战由此爆发。1311年德里大将马利克·卡富尔大举来犯，孙陀罗避不决战，马杜赖失守。他一度于1312年复位，旋即战败；1314年借胡斯劳汗率领的德里军队占据王国东南部，向德里称藩。1323年，他与卡卡提亚国王普拉塔帕鲁陀罗二世联手，仍被乌卢格汗击败；约1327年，孙陀罗去世。

en: Vira Pandya was the favoured illegitimate elder son of the Pandya emperor Maravarman Kulasekhara I. He succeeded around 1308 but was overthrown by his half-brother Sundara in 1309, and the brothers' war split the Pandya kingdom. In 1311 Malik Kafur's Delhi army reached his headquarters at Birdhul, destroyed a temple there and raided Madurai. Vira gained the upper hand while Sundara held the south-east with Delhi backing. He lost northern Sri Lanka in 1323, warred on the new Ma'bar Sultanate with Hoysala allies from 1325, lost Madurai in 1335, and was finally defeated and killed around 1345.
zh: 毗罗·潘地亚是潘地亚皇帝摩罗伐摩·库拉塞卡拉一世得宠的庶长子。约1308年继位，1309年被异母弟孙陀罗推翻，兄弟内战使潘地亚王国分裂。1311年，马利克·卡富尔的德里军队抵达他的大本营比尔杜尔，摧毁了当地一座寺庙，又攻入马杜赖。毗罗逐渐占得上风，孙陀罗则靠德里支持保有东南一隅。1323年他丧失斯里兰卡北部，1325年起联合霍伊萨拉人同新兴的马巴尔苏丹国交战，1335年丢失马杜赖，最终约1345年兵败身亡。

en: Alberto Castelbarco was a Trentino nobleman, a son of the Veronese condottiero Guglielmo Azzone Castelbarco, lord of Ala and Avio in the bishopric of Trent, and of Tommasina Gonzaga, daughter of Ludovico I Gonzaga of Mantua.
zh: 阿尔贝托·卡斯泰尔巴科是特伦蒂诺贵族，特伦托主教区阿拉、阿维奥领主、维罗纳雇佣兵首领古列尔莫·阿佐内·卡斯泰尔巴科与曼托瓦卢多维科一世·贡扎加之女托马西娜之子。

en: Aldrighetto Castelbarco was a Trentino nobleman, one of six children of the condottiero Guglielmo Azzone Castelbarco of Ala and Avio and his wife Tommasina Gonzaga of Mantua.
zh: 阿尔德里盖托·卡斯泰尔巴科是特伦蒂诺贵族，阿拉和阿维奥领主古列尔莫·阿佐内·卡斯泰尔巴科与曼托瓦的托马西娜·贡扎加所生六名子女之一。

en: Guglielmo Azzone Castelbarco, often called Azzone, was a fourteenth-century condottiero of the Castelbarco family, vassals of the bishop of Trent, and lord of Ala, Avio and Brentonico in the Vallagarina. The son of Federico Castelbarco and Beatrice di Castelcorno, he married Tommasina Gonzaga, daughter of Ludovico I of Mantua, in 1319. A loyal follower of the Scaligeri, on 16 August 1328 he led Veronese troops in the expulsion of the Bonacolsi from Mantua. In 1333 he hosted the future Emperor Charles IV at Avio Castle.
zh: 古列尔莫·阿佐内·卡斯泰尔巴科（常称阿佐内）是14世纪的雇佣军将领，出身特伦托主教的封臣卡斯泰尔巴科家族，领有拉加里纳山谷的阿拉、阿维奥和布伦托尼科。他是费代里科·卡斯泰尔巴科与贝阿特丽切·迪·卡斯泰尔科诺之子，1319年在曼托瓦娶曼托瓦领主卢多维科一世·贡扎加之女托马西娜·贡扎加。他忠心事奉斯卡利杰家族，1328年8月16日率领维罗纳军队参与将博纳科尔西家族逐出曼托瓦的行动，1333年在阿维奥城堡款待后来的皇帝查理四世。

en: Azzone Francesco Castelbarco (c. 1327–1410) was the last lord of the Dossomaggiore branch of his house, holding Avio, Ala and Brentonico in the bishopric of Trent. In January 1388 Bishop Albert of Ortenburg enfeoffed him with Castel San Giorgio near Ala after the Rovione line died out. On 7 July 1410, the year of his death, he made his will at Avio, providing that if his only heir Ettore died the vicariates would pass to the Republic of Venice. When Ettore died in 1411 Venice occupied the lands, beginning the era of the Four Vicariates.
zh: 阿佐内·弗朗切斯科·卡斯泰尔巴科（约1327—1410）是卡斯泰尔巴科家族多索马焦雷支系的末代领主，据有特伦托主教区的阿维奥、阿拉和布伦托尼科。1388年1月罗维奥内支系绝嗣后，主教阿尔贝托·迪·奥尔滕堡将阿拉附近的圣乔治城堡封赐给他。1410年7月7日，即他去世的同年，他在阿维奥立下遗嘱：若唯一继承人埃托雷亡故，各代牧领地即转交威尼斯共和国。1411年埃托雷死后，威尼斯接管这些土地，四代理官区时代由此开始。

en: Franceschina Castelbarco was one of the six children of Guglielmo Azzone Castelbarco, lord of Ala, Avio and Brentonico in the bishopric of Trent, and Tommasina Gonzaga, daughter of Luigi I Gonzaga, first lord of Mantua.
zh: 弗兰切斯基娜·卡斯泰尔巴科是古列尔莫·阿佐内·卡斯泰尔巴科与托马西娜·贡扎加的六个子女之一；父亲据有特伦托主教区的阿拉、阿维奥和布伦托尼科，母亲是首任曼托瓦领主卢多维科一世·贡扎加之女。

en: Francesco Leone Castelbarco was a fourteenth-century Trentino nobleman, the son of Guglielmo Azzone Castelbarco, lord of Ala and Avio, and of Tommasina Gonzaga of the ruling house of Mantua.
zh: 弗朗切斯科·莱昂内·卡斯泰尔巴科是14世纪特伦蒂诺贵族，阿拉和阿维奥领主古列尔莫·阿佐内·卡斯泰尔巴科与曼托瓦统治家族的托马西娜·贡扎加之子。

en: Giancarlo Castelbarco was a Trentino nobleman and a son of Guglielmo Azzone Castelbarco, the Scaliger condottiero who held Ala, Avio and Brentonico, and of Tommasina Gonzaga, daughter of Ludovico I of Mantua.
zh: 詹卡洛·卡斯泰尔巴科是特伦蒂诺贵族，为效忠斯卡利杰里家族、领有阿拉、阿维奥和布伦托尼科的雇佣兵首领古列尔莫·阿佐内·卡斯泰尔巴科，与曼托瓦卢多维科一世之女托马西娜·贡扎加之子。

en: Guglielmo Azzone Castelbarco (born c. 1301) was lord of Ala, Avio and Brentonico in the bishopric of Trent and a condottiero loyal to the Scaligeri of Verona. Son of Federico Castelbarco and Beatrice Castelcorno, he was nephew of the condottiero Guglielmo Castelbarco il Grande (died 1320). In 1319 he married at Mantua Tommasina Gonzaga, daughter of Ludovico I, first lord of Mantua and one of the Veronese dynasty's most important Italian allies, a match that shows how highly the Scaligeri camp valued him. On 16 August 1328 he led a band of armed Veronese into Mantua and took part in the expulsion of the Bonacolsi, helping bring the Gonzaga to power. Faithful to the imperial cause, in 1333 he hosted Charles of Luxembourg, emperor from 1355, in his castle of Avio. He and Tommasina had six children. His tomb, first set in the castle's chapel of Sant'Antonio Abate, now stands in the church at Loppio.
zh: 古列尔莫·阿佐内·卡斯泰尔巴科（约1301年生）是特伦托主教区阿拉、阿维奥和布伦托尼科的领主，也是效忠维罗纳斯卡利杰里家族的雇佣兵首领。他是费代里科·卡斯泰尔巴科与贝阿特丽切·卡斯泰尔科尔诺之子，雇佣兵首领“大”古列尔莫·卡斯泰尔巴科（卒于1320年）的侄子。1319年，他在曼托瓦迎娶托马西娜·贡扎加，她是首任曼托瓦统治者卢多维科一世之女，而贡扎加家族是维罗纳王朝在意大利最重要的盟友之一；这门亲事说明斯卡利杰里阵营对他的看重。1328年8月16日，他率领一队维罗纳武装进入曼托瓦，参与驱逐博纳科尔西家族，助贡扎加家族上台。他忠于神圣罗马帝国，1333年在阿维奥城堡接待了卢森堡的查理，此人1355年成为皇帝。他与托马西娜生有六名子女。他的墓椁最初安放在城堡的圣安东尼·阿巴特礼拜堂，现存于洛皮奥的教堂。

en: Nicolò da Bruna (Nikolaus von Brünn), born in Brno, was prince-bishop of Trent from 1338 to 1347. He was dean of Olomouc and chancellor to Charles, Margrave of Moravia. In 1336 Charles went to the Tyrol as guardian of the young counts, his brother John Henry and Margaret, and Nicolò followed. After Bishop Henry of Metz died that October, Charles had Nicolò named his successor, confirmed by the pope in 1338. He ended the war between the noble houses of the Non and Sole valleys, recovered fiefs usurped by the Castelbarco and commissioned an enlarged Codex Wangianus. Habsburg schemes against the Luxembourgs in the Tyrol then wrecked his position: in 1341 Margaret repudiated her husband, who fled with Nicolò to Aquileia, and in 1342 she married Louis of Bavaria, whose father, the emperor, took control of the bishopric. Charles, by then emperor, won back Trent and Nicolò's fiefs in 1347, but Nicolò died at Nicolsburg in Moravia that November without returning.
zh: 尼科洛·达·布鲁纳（德语称尼古劳斯·冯·布林）生于布尔诺，1338至1347年任特伦托采邑主教。他原为奥洛穆茨座堂主任司铎，兼任摩拉维亚藩侯查理的掌玺官。1336年，查理前往蒂罗尔，做年少伯爵——他的弟弟约翰·亨利和玛格丽特——的监护人，尼科洛随行。同年10月，特伦托主教梅斯的亨利去世，查理让尼科洛接任，1338年获教皇确认。任内他平息了农河谷与索莱河谷贵族家族间的战争，收回被卡斯泰尔巴科家族侵占的封地，并主持编纂增补版《万吉安努斯法典》。随后，哈布斯堡家族设法把卢森堡家族逐出蒂罗尔，他的处境随之崩塌：1341年玛格丽特拒绝了丈夫，后者与尼科洛一同逃往阿奎莱亚；1342年她嫁给巴伐利亚的路易，路易的父亲、皇帝夺取了主教领地。已成为皇帝的查理于1347年夺回特伦托和尼科洛的封地，尼科洛却于同年11月在摩拉维亚的尼科尔斯堡去世，未能回去。

en: Tode Mongke (died 1287) was a son of Toqoqan and a grandson of Batu Khan who ruled the Golden Horde from 1280 to 1287. After Berke's death in 1267 he was a candidate, but the Jochid elite chose his brother Mengu-Timur; he only took the throne with the backing of the powerful commander Nogai. He converted to Islam in 1283 and left warfare to Nogai, who raided Lithuania and Poland, while backing Andrey of Vladimir against Nogai's client Dmitry. In 1287 Nogai forced him to abdicate in favor of Talabuga, and he died the same year.
zh: 脱脱蒙哥（?—1287）是托托罕之子、拔都汗之孙，1280至1287年为金帐汗国的汗。1267年别儿哥死后他本是汗位候选人之一，但术赤系贵族选择了他的兄弟忙哥帖木儿；后来凭借权臣那海的支持，他才得以称汗。他于1283年皈依伊斯兰教，战事多委于那海（其军队袭掠立陶宛与波兰），在罗斯诸公国问题上却与那海对立，支持弗拉基米尔的安德烈反对德米特里。1287年那海迫使他退位，改立兀剌不花，他本人也于同年死去。

en: Toghrilcha was a Mongol prince of the Golden Horde, a son of the khan Mengu-Timur. He was among the Genghisid princes who deposed the khan Tode-Mengu in 1287. Later he fell out with Toqta, who had seized the throne in 1291; Toqta had him executed, married his widow, and drove his young son Öz Beg into exile, either in Khwarazm or among the Circassians. That son returned after Toqta's death to rule the Golden Horde as Öz Beg Khan from 1313 to 1341.
zh: 秃黑里勒察是金帐汗国的蒙古宗王，汗王忙哥帖木儿之子。他参与了1287年推翻汗王脱脱蒙哥的行动。后来他与1291年夺取汗位的脱脱反目，被脱脱处死；脱脱纳娶他的遗孀，并将他年幼的儿子月即别放逐到花剌子模或切尔克斯人地区。月即别在脱脱死后归来，于1313至1341年统治金帐汗国。

en: Talabuga (died 1291), son of Tartu and great-grandson of Batu, was khan of the Golden Horde from 1287 to 1291. In 1285 he joined Nogai's disastrous raid on Hungary, afterwards plundering the allied Galician lands. Backed by Nogai, he deposed Tode Mongke in 1287 and took the throne; his reign saw raids on Poland and border clashes with the Ilkhanate. In 1291 Nogai lured him into an ambush and had him strangled, raising Toqta to the throne.
zh: 兀剌不花（?—1291，又译秃剌不花）是塔儿秃之子、拔都的曾孙，1287至1291年任金帐汗国的汗。1285年，他随那海攻打匈牙利，惨败而回，回师后又劫掠本为盟友的加利奇诸地。1287年，他在那海支持下废黜脱脱蒙哥登位，在位期间出征波兰，并与伊儿汗国多次发生边境冲突。1291年，那海设伏将他诱擒并绞杀，改立脱脱为汗。

en: Tolui (c. 1191–1232) was the youngest son of Genghis Khan and Börte, reckoned the finest warrior of their four sons. He fought in the invasion of Jin China from 1211, and in 1221 Genghis sent him to conquer Khorasan, where he took Merv, Nishapur and Herat amid great massacres. When Genghis died in 1227 Tolui, as youngest son, served as regent until Ögedei's enthronement in 1229. He campaigned against the Jin with Ögedei in 1230–1232 and died late in 1232 in unclear circumstances. By his wife Sorghaghtani Beki he fathered Möngke, Kublai, Hulagu and Ariq Böke.
zh: 拖雷（约1191—1232）是成吉思汗与孛儿帖的幼子，被视为四个嫡子中最善战者。1211年起他随军攻金；1221年成吉思汗命他攻取呼罗珊，他连克木鹿、你沙不儿、也里诸城，屠戮甚重。1227年成吉思汗去世后，他依幼子守灶的传统监国摄政，直至1229年窝阔台即位。1230至1232年他随窝阔台再征金朝，1232年末死因不明。其妻唆鲁禾帖尼为他生下蒙哥、忽必烈、旭烈兀、阿里不哥四子。

en: Jeanne I of Chalon-Tonnerre (1300–26 October 1360) was countess of Tonnerre, daughter of William of Chalon, count of Auxerre and heir of Tonnerre, and Eleanor of Savoy. After her father died in 1304, her mother became regent of the property of Jeanne and her brother John. In June 1321 she married Robert of Burgundy, son of Duke Robert II and Agnes of France; but the marriage was childless and Robert died in October 1334. John ceded some of his rights to the county in 1335. Dying in an epidemic, she left Tonnerre to her brother by will and was buried at Cîteaux.
zh: 沙隆-托内尔的让娜一世（1300—1360年10月26日）是托内尔女伯爵，为欧塞尔伯爵、托内尔指定继承人沙隆的纪尧姆与萨伏依的埃莱奥诺尔之女。其父1304年去世后，母亲摄政管理她与弟弟让的财产。1321年6月，她嫁给勃艮第公爵罗贝尔二世与法兰西的阿涅丝之子罗贝尔·德·勃艮第；婚姻无嗣，她于1334年10月守寡。1335年，让让出了部分伯国权利。她在一场瘟疫流行中去世，立下遗嘱将托内尔归还弟弟，葬于西多修道院。

en: Margaret of Burgundy (1250–1308), second daughter of Odo, Count of Nevers, and Maud of Dampierre, inherited Tonnerre in 1262. In 1268 she married Charles of Anjou, king of Sicily, and was also queen of Albania from 1272 and titular queen of Jerusalem from 1277. The Sicilian Vespers of 1282 left her queen only of Naples. Widowed in 1285, she withdrew to her castle of Tonnerre with Margaret of Brienne and Catherine of Courtenay, titular empress of Constantinople. The three lived in prayer and charity, and she founded the Hospice of the Fontenilles. She also sold the lordship of Torigny in Normandy. She died on 4 September 1308 and was buried in the hospice, leaving her lands to her great-nephew John II of Chalon-Auxerre.
zh: 勃艮第的玛格丽特（1250—1308）是讷韦尔伯爵厄德与当皮埃尔的莫德的次女，1262年继承托内尔伯国。1268年她嫁给西西里国王安茹的查理，成为王后；1272年起成为阿尔巴尼亚王后，1277年起又成为名义上的耶路撒冷王后。1282年西西里晚祷之后，她的头衔只剩下那不勒斯王后。1285年守寡后，她与布列讷的玛格丽特及名义上的君士坦丁堡女皇库尔特奈的凯瑟琳一同退居托内尔城堡。三人以祈祷和施舍度日，她还创立了丰特尼耶济贫院，并出售诺曼底的托里尼领地。她于1308年9月4日去世，葬在济贫院内，领地留给侄孙沙隆-欧塞尔的约翰二世。

en: Robert of Burgundy (1302–1334) was a younger son of Duke Robert II of Burgundy and Agnes of France, grandson of King Louis IX. In June 1321 he married Joan I of Chalon, countess of Tonnerre, becoming her count consort; their marriage was childless.
zh: 罗贝尔·德·勃艮第（1302—1334）是勃艮第公爵罗贝尔二世与法兰西的阿格妮丝的儿子，为法王路易九世的外孙。1321年6月，他娶托内尔女伯爵让娜一世·德·沙隆，成为她的伯爵配偶；两人没有子嗣。

en: Toqoqan (c. 1220s–1256/1259) was a Mongol prince of the Golden Horde, a son of its founder Batu Khan and a great-grandson of Genghis Khan. He held his own appanage while the Ulus of Jochi took shape after the Mongol campaign in the west, and the Persian chronicler Rashid al-Din names him in his genealogies. Though Toqoqan never reigned, his sons by Köchü Khatun, Mengu-Timur and Tode Mongke, both became khans of the Golden Horde, while his eldest son Tartu was the father of Khan Talabuga.
zh: 托托罕（约1220年代—1256/1259）是金帐汗国的蒙古宗王，为汗国建立者拔都之子、成吉思汗曾孙。在蒙古西征之后术赤兀鲁思形成之际，他领有自己的份地，波斯史家拉施特哀丁在其谱系中记载了他。托托罕本人从未称汗，但他与忽出哈敦所生的儿子忙哥帖木儿、脱脱蒙哥都做过金帐汗，长子塔儿秃则是可汗秃剌不花之父。

en: Toqta (died 1312), a son of Mengu-Timur and great-grandson of Batu, was khan of the Golden Horde from 1291 to 1312. Placed on the throne by Nogai after Talabuga's fall, he at first ruled as Nogai's client, then rebelled; defeated in 1297, he crushed Nogai at the Kagamlyk river around 1300, reuniting the steppe from the Volga to the Don. In 1304 he accepted the Yuan emperor's nominal overlordship. Angered by the Genoese slave trade, he arrested Italian merchants at Sarai and besieged Caffa, which the defenders burned in 1308. He died in 1312 preparing a campaign against Russia.
zh: 脱脱（?—1312）是忙哥帖木儿之子、拔都的曾孙，1291至1312年为金帐汗国的汗。兀剌不花倒台后，他由那海扶上汗位，起初形同那海的附庸，随后起兵反抗；1297年先败，约1300年在卡加梅雷克河击溃那海，重新统一从伏尔加河到顿河的草原。1304年，他在全蒙古和议中承认元朝皇帝的名义宗主权。因不满热那亚人的奴隶贸易，他在萨莱拘捕意大利商人并围攻卡法，守军于1308年焚城。1312年，他在筹备征讨罗斯诸王公时死去。

en: Torquemada's chronicle names Catoxcan as the eighth of the nine semi-legendary Totonac lords who ruled at Mizquihuacan after 690. He succeeded Tlaixehuatenitztli and, like his predecessors, was remembered as reigning eighty years in peace.
zh: 托尔克马达的《印第安君主制》把卡托克坎列为690年后统治米斯基瓦坎的九位半传说托托纳克首领中的第八位，继特拉伊塞瓦特尼斯特利之后在位，相传像前任一样太平统治了八十年。

en: Torquemada records Ixquahuitl as a semi-legendary Totonac lord of Mizquihuacan who fought his co-ruler and brother Nahuacatl, dividing their people and exposing them to the Chichimecs; Ixquahuitl then left for Ocotlan and ruled at Xoxopanco.
zh: 据《印第安君主制》，伊斯卡维特尔是米斯基瓦坎半传说的托托纳克首领，与共同执政的兄长纳瓦卡特交战，族人因而分裂，遭奇奇梅克人侵占；他离开故地前往奥科特兰，后统治肖肖潘科。

en: Torquemada records Nahuacatl as a semi-legendary Totonac lord of Mizquihuacan who ruled jointly with his brother Ixquahuitl. They betrayed and fought one another, dividing their people; Nahuacatl left for another province, and the Chichimecs took over the Totonac lands.
zh: 据《印第安君主制》，纳瓦卡特是米斯基瓦坎半传说的托托纳克首领，与弟弟伊斯卡维特尔共同执政。兄弟彼此背叛、交战，族人因而分裂；纳瓦卡特离开故地前往另一省，奇奇梅克人则占据了托托纳克之地。

en: Alexios I Megas Komnenos (c. 1182–1222) founded the Empire of Trebizond with his brother David. A grandson of the Byzantine emperor Andronikos I and son of Manuel Komnenos and Rusudan of Georgia, he seized Trebizond in April 1204 with support from his aunt, Queen Tamar of Georgia, as the Fourth Crusade took Constantinople. While David conquered western Pontic lands, Alexios held Trebizond against a Seljuk siege around 1205. In 1214 the Turks captured him defending Sinope; he was freed after the city surrendered and he became Sultan Kaykaus I's vassal. The loss cut Trebizond off from direct contact with Nicaea and other Greek lands. He died on 1 February 1222, leaving the throne to his son-in-law Andronikos.
zh: 阿历克塞一世·梅加斯·科穆宁（约1182—1222）与弟弟大卫共同建立了特拉比松帝国。他是拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡一世之孙、曼努埃尔·科穆宁与格鲁吉亚的鲁苏丹之子，1204年4月趁第四次十字军攻占君士坦丁堡之际，在姨母格鲁吉亚女王塔玛丽支持下夺取特拉比松。大卫征服了本都西部的土地，阿历克塞则在约1205年顶住塞尔柱人的围攻。1214年，他在保卫锡诺普时被突厥人俘虏，直到该城投降、他向苏丹凯考斯一世称臣后才获释。锡诺普的失陷切断了特拉比松与尼西亚及其他希腊地区的直接联系。他于1222年2月1日去世，女婿安德洛尼卡继位。

en: Alexios II Megas Komnenos (1282–1330), elder son of John II and Eudokia Palaiologina, became emperor of Trebizond in 1297 at fourteen and ruled when the empire was at its peak. Around 1300 he married Jiajak Jaqeli, daughter of the atabeg of Samtskhe, without the consent of his guardian and uncle Andronikos II. The patriarch refused Andronikos' request to annul the marriage. In 1301–1302 he routed Turkoman raiders who had sacked Kerasous and captured their general. He checked the Genoese by treaties in 1314 and 1316 and granted Venice equal privileges in 1319. After Sinopite pirates burned Trebizond, he built the harbour sea walls in 1324. He died of plague on 3 May 1330, succeeded by Andronikos III.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿历克塞二世_(特拉比松帝国)
zh: 阿历克塞二世·梅加斯·科穆宁（1282—1330）是约翰二世与欧多基娅·巴列奥略吉娜的长子，1297年十四岁时成为特拉比松皇帝，在位时帝国正值鼎盛。约1300年，他未经监护人兼舅父安德洛尼卡二世同意，迎娶萨姆茨赫阿塔贝格之女佳佳克·贾凯利。牧首拒绝了安德洛尼卡解除婚姻的请求。1301或1302年，他击溃洗劫凯拉苏斯的土库曼袭掠者，俘获其将领。他通过1314和1316年的条约遏制热那亚人，又于1319年给予威尼斯同等特权。锡诺普海盗焚毁特拉比松后，他于1324年修建港口海墙。1330年5月3日死于鼠疫，安德洛尼卡三世继位。

en: Alexios III Megas Komnenos (1338–1390) ruled Trebizond from 1349 until his death. The son of Emperor Basil and his second wife Irene, he was raised at the Byzantine court after Basil died in 1340, until John VI Kantakouzenos sent him to Trebizond in 1349 to replace the deposed Michael. Crowned in January 1350, he married Theodora Kantakouzene in 1351, defeated the rebel megas doux Niketas Scholares at Kerasous and Kenchrina, and survived an aristocratic ambush in 1363. Marriage alliances with Turkmen neighbors and Georgia secured his reign; he died in 1390 and was succeeded by his son Manuel III.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿历克塞三世_(特拉比松帝国)
zh: 阿历克塞三世·梅加斯·科穆宁（1338—1390）自1349年起统治特拉比松，直至去世。他是皇帝瓦西里与第二任妻子伊琳娜之子，1340年瓦西里死后在拜占庭宫廷长大，1349年约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯派他前往特拉比松，取代被废黜的米哈伊尔。他于1350年1月加冕，1351年娶狄奥多拉·坎塔库泽努斯，在凯拉苏斯和肯奇里纳击败叛军大都督尼基塔斯·斯霍拉里斯，并于1363年躲过一次贵族伏击。他通过与土库曼邻邦和格鲁吉亚联姻巩固统治，1390年去世，其子曼努埃尔三世继位。

en: Andronikos I Gidos (died 1235) ruled the Empire of Trebizond from 1222, the only emperor unrelated by blood to its founder Alexios I, whose daughter he married. He may earlier have been the Nicaean general who defeated the Latin allies of David Komnenos in 1206. After the Seljuk governor of Sinope seized a Trapezuntine ship and raided Perateia, Andronikos sent a fleet against Sinope. In 1224 he led the defense of Trebizond against a Seljuk siege until a storm scattered the attackers; the captured sultan agreed to end Trebizond's vassalage, tribute and military obligations. After Andronikos backed the Khwarazmshah Jalal al-Din against the Seljuks in 1230, Trebizond became a vassal once more. He died in 1235 and John I succeeded him.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/安德洛尼卡一世_(特拉比松帝国)
zh: 安德洛尼卡一世·吉多斯（？—1235）自1222年起统治特拉比松帝国，是唯一与开国皇帝阿历克塞一世没有血缘关系的皇帝，但他娶了阿历克塞一世之女。他可能就是1206年击败大卫·科穆宁旗下拉丁盟友的那位尼西亚同名将领。塞尔柱人的锡诺普总督扣押特拉比松船只、劫掠佩拉提亚后，安德洛尼卡派舰队袭击锡诺普。1224年，他指挥特拉比松抵御塞尔柱人的围攻，一场暴风雨击溃敌军，被俘的苏丹同意解除特拉比松的附庸关系、贡赋和军役。1230年他支持花剌子模沙札兰丁对塞尔柱人作战，战败后特拉比松重新沦为附庸。他于1235年去世，约翰一世继位。

en: Andronikos II Megas Komnenos (c. 1240–1266) was the eldest son of the Trapezuntine emperor Manuel I by his first wife Anna Xylaloe, and succeeded his father as emperor in 1263. The chronicler Michael Panaretos records that Manuel had chosen him for the throne and that he reigned for three years. The chief event of his rule was the loss of Sinope to the Seljuk Turks under Mu'in al-Din Suleyman, the Pervane, in the summer or autumn of 1265, giving the Turks a major Black Sea port. He died prematurely in 1265 or 1266.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/安德洛尼卡二世_(特拉比松帝国)
zh: 安德洛尼卡二世·梅加斯·科穆宁（约1240—1266）是特拉比松皇帝曼努埃尔一世与首任妻子安娜·克西洛洛的长子，1263年继承父位为帝。编年史家米哈伊尔·帕纳雷托斯记载，曼努埃尔亲自选定他继位，他共在位三年。其统治期间最重大的事件是1265年夏或秋，锡诺普被穆因丁·苏莱曼（佩尔瓦内）率领的塞尔柱突厥人攻占，突厥人由此获得黑海上的一个重要港口。1265或1266年，他早逝身亡。

en: Andronikos III Megas Komnenos (died 8 January 1332), eldest son of Alexios II and Jiajak Jaqeli, was emperor of Trebizond from October 1330 after a five-month interregnum following his father's death. Panaretos gives his reign fifteen months. One of his first acts was to kill his two younger brothers George Azachoutlou and Michael Achpougas; another brother, Basil, escaped to Constantinople. Like his father, he died of bubonic plague, on 8 January 1332, and his young son Manuel II succeeded him.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/安德洛尼卡三世_(特拉比松帝国)
zh: 安德洛尼卡三世·梅加斯·科穆宁（？—1332）是阿历克塞二世与佳佳克·贾凯利的长子，父亲去世后经历五个月空位期，于1330年10月成为特拉比松皇帝，帕纳雷托斯记载他在位十五个月。他即位后的首批举动之一是处死两个弟弟乔治·阿扎胡特卢和米哈伊尔·阿赫普加斯，另一个弟弟巴西尔逃到君士坦丁堡。与父亲一样，他于1332年1月8日死于腺鼠疫，幼子曼努埃尔二世继位。

en: Anna Anachoutlou (died 3 September 1342), eldest daughter of Alexios II, spent most of her life as a nun while two brothers and a nephew reigned in quick succession. After Basil's death in 1340 his widow Irene Palaiologina, an outsider to the Grand Komnenos line, took the throne. In July 1341 Anna escaped her convent and rallied the provinces: Laz and Zan tribesmen and Georgian soldiers, who may have been mercenaries or troops sent by King George V. On 17 July she entered Trebizond unopposed and was crowned empress, Irene having abdicated days earlier. Nobles who preferred a male heir turned to her uncle Michael, but when he landed with Byzantine troops the Laz beat them and Anna imprisoned him. She defeated an Aq Qoyunlu raid in 1342, yet the Scholarioi clan and other nobles still deposed and strangled her on 3 September. Michael's son John III took the city next day, and her supporters were purged.
zh: 安娜·阿纳胡特卢（？—1342）是阿历克塞二世的长女，大半生在修道院中度过，其间两位兄弟和一个侄子先后短暂在位。1340年瓦西里去世后，他的遗孀艾琳·巴列奥略吉娜这个大科穆宁家族的外人登上皇位。1341年7月，安娜逃出修道院，召集各地的拉兹人、赞人和格鲁吉亚士兵；后者可能是雇佣兵，也可能由格奥尔基五世派遣。7月17日，她兵不血刃进入特拉比松，加冕为女皇，艾琳数日前已退位。一些贵族更愿拥立男性继承人、她的叔父米哈伊尔，但米哈伊尔带着拜占庭军队登陆后，被拉兹人击败，安娜将他囚禁。1342年她击退白羊王朝的袭掠，斯科拉里奥伊家族等贵族仍将她废黜，于9月3日勒死；次日米哈伊尔之子约翰三世占领该城，她的支持者随后遭到清洗。

en: Basil Megas Komnenos (died 6 April 1340), younger son of Alexios II and Jiajak Jaqeli, ruled Trebizond from 1332, in the middle of a long civil war among its great nobles. When his brother Andronikos III took the throne in 1330 and killed two of their brothers, Basil was in Constantinople and escaped. Invited home after Andronikos's death, he deposed the child Manuel II in August 1332 and purged the boy's supporters, but the official he appointed, John the Eunuch, revolted for Manuel. The revolt was crushed and Manuel was killed in 1333, probably on Basil's orders. The city came to hate Basil: when a solar eclipse was read as divine wrath, the crowd forced him into the citadel. In 1334 he married Irene Palaiologina, illegitimate daughter of the Byzantine emperor Andronikos III Palaiologos, but took a mistress also named Irene, marrying her around 1339. He died on 6 April 1340, apparently poisoned by his wife, who at once seized the throne.
zh: 瓦西里·梅加斯·科穆宁（？—1340）是阿历克塞二世与佳佳克·贾凯利的幼子，自1332年起统治特拉比松，当时帝国正陷于大贵族之间的长期内战。1330年兄长安德洛尼卡三世登位并杀害了两个兄弟，瓦西里恰在君士坦丁堡，躲过一劫。安德洛尼卡死后他被迎回，于1332年8月废黜幼帝曼努埃尔二世，清洗其支持者，但他任命的宦官约翰却为曼努埃尔起事。叛乱被镇压，曼努埃尔于1333年被杀，可能是瓦西里下的命令。城中人对瓦西里日益痛恨：一次日食被当成天怒，民众把他逼进了内城堡。1334年他迎娶拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡三世·巴列奥略的私生女伊琳娜·巴列奥略，但又纳了一位同名的情妇，约1339年与她结婚。1340年4月6日他死去，疑遭妻子毒杀，后者随即夺取皇位。

en: Eudokia Palaiologina (c. 1265–1302), third daughter of Michael VIII Palaiologos and Theodora Vatatzes, married John II Megas Komnenos in Constantinople in 1282 and bore him two sons, Alexios II and Michael. After John died she returned in 1298 to her brother Andronikos II's court with Michael. Andronikos planned to wed her to Stefan Uroš II Milutin of Serbia as a peace bargain, but she refused; the king instead married Andronikos' daughter Simonida. Andronikos also wanted Alexios to annul his Georgian marriage and marry a court official's daughter. In 1301 Eudokia won leave for Trebizond, supposedly to make Alexios II annul his marriage; instead she told him to keep his wife. She died on 18 September 1302.
zh: 欧多基娅·巴列奥略吉娜（约1265—1302）是米哈伊尔八世·巴列奥略与狄奥多拉·瓦塔采斯的第三个女儿。1282年，她在君士坦丁堡嫁给约翰二世·梅加斯·科穆宁，生下阿历克塞二世和米哈伊尔两个儿子。约翰死后，她于1298年带着米哈伊尔回到兄长安德洛尼卡二世的宫廷。安德洛尼卡打算把她嫁给塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·乌罗什二世·米卢廷以换取和平，被她拒绝；国王后来迎娶了安德洛尼卡的女儿西莫尼达。安德洛尼卡还想让阿历克塞解除与格鲁吉亚妻子的婚姻，迎娶一位宫廷官员之女。1301年，欧多基娅获准前往特拉比松，名义上是去劝说阿历克塞二世解除婚姻，到后却让儿子留住妻子。1302年9月18日去世。

en: George Megas Komnenos (c. 1255 – after 1284), elder son of Manuel I and Irene Syrikaina, succeeded his half-brother Andronikos as emperor of Trebizond in 1266 and ruled fourteen years. A boy at his accession, he first ruled through a regent and was the first Trapezuntine emperor styled Megas Komnenos. Charles of Anjou wrote to him in 1266 or 1267, though George's response is unknown. After Michael VIII Palaiologos accepted church union at Lyons in 1274, anti-unionist refugees cast George as Orthodoxy's champion and pressed him to seek the throne of Constantinople. In June 1280 his officials betrayed him on Mount Taurezion and captured him. In 1284 he failed to seize Trebizond from his brother John II, then vanished from the sources.
zh: 乔治·梅加斯·科穆宁（约1255—1284年后）是曼努埃尔一世与艾琳·西里凯娜的长子，1266年继异母兄安德洛尼卡之后成为特拉比松皇帝，在位十四年。他即位时年幼，起初由摄政治理，也是第一位使用“梅加斯·科穆宁”称号的特拉比松皇帝。安茹的查理于1266或1267年致信给他，乔治如何答复已无从得知。1274年米哈伊尔八世·巴列奥略在里昂接受教会合并后，反对合并的流亡者把乔治奉为东正教的捍卫者，并推动他争夺君士坦丁堡皇位。1280年6月，他在陶雷齐翁山被部下出卖俘获。1284年他试图从弟弟约翰二世手中夺取特拉比松，失败后便从史料中消失。

en: Helen Megale Komnene (died 1366) was a Trapezuntine princess, probably a daughter of Emperor Basil of Trebizond, and the first wife of King Bagrat V of Georgia. The Georgian Chronicles record her name as Elene but say little of her origin. She bore Bagrat two sons, the future king George VII and a David otherwise unknown, and died in 1366 during an outbreak of plague, likely a recurrence of the Black Death, that swept Georgia in those years. A year later Bagrat married Anna, a daughter of Alexios III of Trebizond.
zh: 海伦娜·梅加利·科穆宁（？—1366）是特拉比松帝国公主，可能是皇帝瓦西里之女，格鲁吉亚国王巴格拉特五世的第一任王后。格鲁吉亚编年史以埃莱奈之名记载她，但对其出身着墨甚少。她为巴格拉特生下两子，即后来的国王吉奥尔基七世和另一位史载无多的大卫。1366年，她在席卷格鲁吉亚的一场瘟疫中去世，这场瘟疫可能是黑死病的再度暴发。一年后，巴格拉特续娶特拉比松皇帝阿历克塞三世之女安娜。

en: John I Komnenos Axouch (c. 1214–1238) was Emperor of Trebizond from 1235, the eldest son of the empire's founder Alexios I and Theodora Axouchina. When Alexios died in 1222 the crown passed to his son-in-law Andronikos I Gidos, and John succeeded only on Andronikos' death. Little is recorded of his three-year reign. In 1238 he died playing tzykanion, the polo-like game of the Byzantine nobility, after falling from his horse and being trampled. His heir Ioannikios was confined to a monastery, and John's brother Manuel I became emperor.
zh: 约翰一世·科穆宁·阿克苏霍斯（约1214—1238）是特拉比松帝国皇帝，1235年即位。他是开国皇帝阿历克塞一世与狄奥多拉·阿克苏希娜的长子；1222年父亲去世后，皇位由女婿安德洛尼卡一世·吉多斯继承，直到1235年安德洛尼卡去世他才登基。他三年统治的事迹记载很少。1238年，他在玩拜占庭贵族流行的马球游戏茨卡尼翁时坠马，被马践踏而死。继承人约安尼基奥斯被送入修道院，弟弟曼努埃尔一世继位。

en: John II Megas Komnenos (c. 1262–1297), youngest son of Manuel I and Irene Syrikaina, became emperor of Trebizond in June 1280 after his brother George was seized by his officials. In 1281 he rejected Michael VIII Palaiologos' demand to abandon the title Emperor of the Romans. After Papadopoulos led a revolt that seized the citadel and held John prisoner, he married Michael's daughter Eudokia Palaiologina. He retained the imperial dignity, but replaced the Roman title with Emperor and Autocrat of all the East, the Iberians and the Transmarine Provinces. In 1284 he foiled George's attempt to regain the throne. John and his eldest son Alexios appeared together on coins. John died on 16 August 1297 and was succeeded by Alexios II.
zh: 约翰二世·梅加斯·科穆宁（约1262—1297）是曼努埃尔一世与艾琳·西里凯娜的幼子，1280年6月在其兄乔治被部下扣押后成为特拉比松皇帝。1281年，他拒绝米哈伊尔八世·巴列奥略放弃“罗马人的皇帝”头衔的要求。帕帕多普洛斯发动叛乱，占领城堡并囚禁约翰；此后约翰迎娶米哈伊尔之女欧多基娅·巴列奥略吉娜。他保留皇帝地位，但以“全东方、伊比利亚人及海外行省的皇帝与独裁者”取代罗马人皇帝的称号。1284年，他挫败乔治复位的企图。他与长子阿历克塞的肖像共同出现在钱币上。1297年8月16日约翰去世，阿历克塞二世继位。

en: John III Megas Komnenos (c. 1321–1362) was emperor of Trebizond from 4 September 1342 to 3 May 1344. Son of Michael Megas Komnenos and Acropolitissa, he was raised in Constantinople, where the Scholarioi leader Niketas Scholares brought him to claim the throne. With three Genoese galleys and a popular rising, he stormed it that September; the deposed empress Anna Anachoutlou was strangled after his coronation. His dissolute reign ended in May 1344, when Niketas freed his captive father and deposed him. Exiled first to St Sabas, then Adrianople, he escaped about 1357 and died at Sinope in 1362.
zh: 约翰三世·梅加斯·科穆宁（约1321—1362）于1342年9月4日至1344年5月3日任特拉比松皇帝。他是米哈伊尔·梅加斯·科穆宁与阿克罗波利提莎之子，在君士坦丁堡长大；斯霍拉里斯派首领尼基塔斯·斯霍拉里斯把他接来争夺皇位。凭借三艘热那亚桨帆船和一场民众起义，他在当年9月攻占特拉比松，被废的女皇帝安娜·阿纳胡特卢在他加冕后被勒死。1344年5月，尼基塔斯释放他遭囚禁的父亲并将他废黜，他放荡昏庸的统治就此结束。他先后被关押于圣萨瓦斯修道院和阿德里安堡，约1357年逃脱，1362年死于锡诺普。

en: Irene Palaiologina (c. 1315 – after 1341) was an illegitimate daughter of the Byzantine emperor Andronikos III. In 1335 she married Emperor Basil of Trebizond, who divorced her in 1339 for a mistress also named Irene. On 6 April 1340 she probably had Basil poisoned and seized the throne in a palace coup, becoming Trebizond's second reigning empress. Her position was insecure, since she was not a member of the ruling Komnenos dynasty; she sent Basil's second wife and sons to Constantinople, where her father could watch over them. Civil war followed, and rumours that she had taken a lover sparked rioting. Her appeal to her father for a husband went unanswered when Andronikos died in June 1341. On 17 July 1341 Anna Anachoutlou took Trebizond; Irene was deposed and sent to Constantinople.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/特拉比松的伊琳娜·巴列奥略
zh: 伊琳娜·巴列奥略（约1315—1341年后）是拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡三世的私生女，1335年嫁给特拉比松皇帝瓦西里。瓦西里后来与同名情人相好，于1339年与她离婚。1340年4月6日，她疑似毒杀瓦西里，通过宫廷政变夺取皇位，成为特拉比松帝国第二位女皇帝。她并非统治特拉比松的科穆宁家族成员，地位不稳，便把瓦西里的第二任妻子和儿子送往君士坦丁堡，由父亲看管。随后内战爆发，她有情人的传闻又引起骚乱；她请求父亲为她另择丈夫，安德洛尼卡三世却在1341年6月去世，未能答复。1341年7月17日，安娜·阿纳卓特鲁攻占特拉比松，伊琳娜被迫退位，被送回君士坦丁堡。

en: Irene of Trebizond (died c. 1382) rose from Emperor Basil's mistress to bigamous wife, and then to power behind a boy emperor. She bore Basil two sons, Alexios and John, before he married her in 1339; the Patriarch of Constantinople protested, a Byzantine writer called her a courtesan, and the Trapezuntine chronicler called her a lady of Trebizond. Basil died in April 1340, and rumour blamed the discarded empress Irene Palaiologina, who seized power at once and sent Irene and her sons to Constantinople. Alexios is not mentioned again. When John VI Kantakouzenos won the Byzantine civil war, he and Niketas Scholares backed John's bid, and in 1349 the thirteen-year-old took the throne as Alexios III. Irene ran the regency against the Doranites family, whose revolt failed within six months, and in 1352 accompanied her son against John Tzanichites. She was last recorded at a great-grandson's baptism in 1382.
zh: 特拉比松的艾琳（约1382年卒）从皇帝瓦西里的情妇做到重婚的妻子，又成为少年皇帝背后的掌权者。1339年瓦西里娶她之前，她已为他生下阿历克塞和约翰两个儿子；君士坦丁堡牧首提出抗议，一位拜占庭史家称她为娼妓，特拉比松编年史作家则称她是特拉比松的淑女。1340年4月瓦西里去世，传言说是被弃的皇后艾琳·巴列奥略吉娜所害；她随即夺权，把艾琳母子送往君士坦丁堡，阿历克塞此后不再见于记载。约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯赢得拜占庭内战后，与尼基塔斯·斯科拉里斯一同支持约翰争位，十三岁的约翰于1349年登基，即阿历克塞三世。艾琳主持摄政，对付多拉尼特家族——该家族的叛乱在半年内即告失败；1352年她又随儿子出征约翰·詹尼奇特斯。她最后一次见于记载是1382年出席曾孙的洗礼。

en: Komnene, whose first name is unrecorded, was a daughter of Alexios I Megas Komnenos, founder of the Empire of Trebizond, and Theodora Axouchina. She married Andronikos Gidos, who succeeded her father as emperor in 1222; her brothers John I and Manuel I later ruled Trebizond.
zh: 科穆宁娜（名字失载）是特拉比松帝国开国皇帝阿历克塞一世·梅加斯·科穆宁与狄奥多拉·阿克苏希娜之女。她嫁给安德洛尼卡·吉多斯，后者于1222年继承皇位；她的兄弟约翰一世与曼努埃尔一世后来都做了特拉比松皇帝。

en: Manuel I Megas Komnenos (died March 1263), a son of Alexios I, succeeded his elder brother John I in 1238 and ruled Trebizond over a strip of the southern Black Sea coast. The chronicler Michael Panaretos praised him as his line's greatest and most fortunate general, though his reign saw a great fire ravage Trebizond in January 1253. In 1254 he retook Sinope from the Sultanate of Rum, forty years after its loss, and between 1250 and 1260 rebuilt the Hagia Sophia monastery in Trebizond. After Michael VIII Palaiologos recovered Constantinople in 1261, Manuel refused to renounce the imperial title. He died in March 1263; four of his children later ruled Trebizond.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/曼努埃尔一世_(特拉比松帝国)
zh: 曼努埃尔一世·梅加斯·科穆宁（？—1263）是阿历克塞一世之子，1238年继兄长约翰一世之后统治特拉比松，领有黑海南岸的狭长地带。编年史作家帕纳雷托斯盛赞他是家族中最伟大、最幸运的统帅，但他在位期间，1253年1月的一场大火重创了特拉比松城。1254年，他从罗姆苏丹国手中收复失守四十年的锡诺普，并于1250至1260年间在特拉比松重建圣索菲亚修道院。1261年米哈伊尔八世·巴列奥略收复君士坦丁堡后要求他放弃皇帝头衔，被他拒绝。1263年3月他去世，其四名子女后来先后统治特拉比松。

en: Manuel II Megas Komnenos (c. 1324–1333), the son of Andronikos III, became emperor of Trebizond at the age of eight in January 1332. On 30 August 1332 his army defeated an invasion by Bayram Beg, Emir of Chalybia, at Asomatos. Three weeks later his uncle Basil returned from Constantinople and deposed him after a reign of eight months. A failed revolt led by the megas doux John in February 1333 prompted Basil to order the boy's execution, making Manuel the only deposed Trapezuntine emperor to be put to death.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/曼努埃尔二世_(特拉比松帝国)
zh: 曼努埃尔二世·梅加斯·科穆宁（约1324—1333）是安德洛尼卡三世之子，1332年1月八岁时成为特拉比松皇帝。1332年8月30日，他的军队在阿索马托斯击败哈利比亚埃米尔贝拉姆贝格的入侵。三周后，他的叔父瓦西里从君士坦丁堡返回，将在位八个月的他废黜囚禁。1333年2月，大公爵约翰发动的叛乱失败，瓦西里随即下令将这个男孩处死，他也成为唯一一位被废后遇害的特拉比松皇帝。

en: Michael Megas Komnenos (c. 1288–after 1355) was a younger son of Emperor John II of Trebizond and Eudokia Palaiologina. Raised in Constantinople, he married Acropolitissa, daughter of Constantine Acropolites, and fathered John III. In July 1341 he claimed the throne in Trebizond, but the nobles imprisoned him at Limnia. Freed by Niketas Scholares, he was crowned emperor on 3 May 1344, deposed his son John III, and reigned until Niketas toppled him on 13 December 1349. Forced into a monastery, then exiled to Constantinople, he was released in 1355 and failed to regain Trebizond, dying there soon after.
zh: 米哈伊尔·梅加斯·科穆宁（约1288—1355年后）是特拉比松皇帝约翰二世与欧多基娅·巴列奥略吉娜较年幼的儿子。他在君士坦丁堡长大，娶君士坦丁·阿克罗波利特斯之女阿克罗波利提莎为妻，生子约翰三世。1341年7月他前往特拉比松争位，却被贵族囚禁在利姆尼亚。后来他被权贵尼基塔斯·斯霍拉里斯释放，1344年5月3日加冕为帝，废黜儿子约翰三世，统治到1349年12月13日被尼基塔斯推翻。他被迫出家，随后被送往君士坦丁堡，1355年获释后试图夺回特拉比松未果，最终死在该城。

en: Theodora Megale Komnene (before 1253 – after 1285) was a daughter of the Trapezuntine emperor Manuel I by Rusudan, a Georgian princess. In 1284, with the backing of David VI Narin, king of Imereti, she seized the crown from her half-brother John II and ruled as empress for about a year. She struck her own silver aspers and bronze nomismas, the only reigning empress of Trebizond known to have coined money. John II soon defeated her and recovered the throne, after which she went into exile in her mother's Georgia.
zh: 狄奥多拉·梅加利·科穆宁（1253年前—1285年后）是特拉比松皇帝曼努埃尔一世与格鲁吉亚公主鲁苏丹之女。1284年，她在伊梅雷蒂国王大卫六世·纳林的支持下，从异母弟约翰二世手中夺取皇位，以女皇身份统治约一年。她在位时铸造了自己的银币阿斯普和铜币诺米斯马，是已知唯一一位铸币的特拉比松在位女皇。不久约翰二世击败她、重登皇位，她随后流亡到母亲的故乡格鲁吉亚。

en: Syed Shah Nasiruddin was a Sufi saint and military commander who helped spread Islam in Bengal. He left Baghdad after the Mongols sacked the city in 1258, settled in Bengal, joined the Suhrawardiyya order, and rose to be Sipah Salar, or army commander, of Sultan Shamsuddin Firoz Shah. In 1303 he led the third expedition against Gour Govinda of Sylhet, which triumphed after Shah Jalal and his followers joined. Dispatched against neighboring Taraf, whose ruler Achak Narayan had executed a qadi, he occupied the country and was appointed governor, founding a hereditary ruling line, and was later buried at Murarband.
zh: 赛义德·沙阿·纳西尔丁是14世纪初推动伊斯兰教在孟加拉传播的苏非圣徒与军事统帅。1258年蒙古人攻陷巴格达后他离开该城，辗转来到孟加拉，加入苏哈拉瓦迪教团，后来成为孟加拉苏丹沙姆斯丁·菲鲁兹沙的军队统帅（西帕赫·萨拉尔）。1303年，他率军第三次征讨锡尔赫特的高尔·戈宾达，在沙阿·贾拉勒及其弟子加入后攻克其地。随后他被派往邻邦塔拉夫——其统治者阿查克·纳拉扬处死了一名卡迪——占领该国并受任总督，其家族此后世袭统治当地。他死后葬于穆拉尔班德。

en: Baldwin of Luxembourg (c. 1285–1354) was the youngest son of Count Henry VI of Luxembourg. He studied in Paris, and in 1307 Trier's cathedral chapter elected him archbishop, a vote void for his youth; Pope Clement V consecrated him in 1308. He inherited a debt-laden see and steadied it with a French-style administration and the Rhine and Moselle tolls his brother Henry granted him. He helped win the crown of the Romans for Henry VII in 1308 and went with him to Rome for the imperial coronation of 1312. He later backed his nephew John of Bohemia and his great-nephew Charles IV in 1346, and held that the electors alone choose the king, a principle the Golden Bull of 1356 later fixed in law. In 1328 troops of Loretta of Sponheim captured him on the Moselle; he was freed after paying ransom and making concessions. He built the Balduinbrücke at Koblenz and ruled Trier until his death.
zh: 鲍德温·冯·卢森堡（约1285—1354）是卢森堡伯爵亨利六世的幼子。他曾在巴黎求学；1307年特里尔主教座堂会议选他为大主教，但因他年纪太轻，这次选举并不有效，1308年由教皇克雷芒五世为他祝圣。他接手的是一个负债累累的大主教区，靠仿照法国的官署制度，以及兄长亨利给他的莱茵河与摩泽尔河关税收入稳住了局面。他在1308年促成兄长亨利七世当选罗马人的国王，并随其前往罗马参加1312年的皇帝加冕礼。后来他又扶持侄子波希米亚的约翰和1346年的侄孙查理四世，并主张只有选帝侯才有权选出国王，这一原则后来被1356年的《金玺诏书》写入法律。1328年，施蓬海姆的洛雷塔派兵在摩泽尔河上俘获他，他付出赎金并作出让步后才获释。他在科布伦茨修建了鲍德温桥，统治特里尔直至去世。

en: Agnes de Grandson was a daughter of Peter II of Grandson and Blanche of Savoy-Vaud, and the wife of Baron Peter III von Turn, the Valais noble whose lands included Frutigen; their son Anton was the last of his line in the Valais.
zh: 阿格内丝·德·格朗松是沃的皮埃尔二世·德·格朗松与萨伏依-沃的布朗什之女，嫁给兼领弗鲁蒂根的瓦莱贵族彼得三世·冯·图恩；他们的儿子安东是家族在瓦莱的最后一位代表。

en: Anton von Turn, in French Antoine de la Tour, was the last baron of the Valais house of Turn, holding Niedergesteln and Frutigen. Succeeding his father Peter III around 1356, he clashed with Bishop Witschard Tavelli of Sion: he seized Granges Castle in 1364, and in 1375 his men murdered the bishop at Seta. The upper Valais districts rose and drove Anton and his family into exile in Savoy, which bought his Valais estates. He sold his Lauterbrunnen lands in 1395 and the lordship of Frutigen to Bern in 1400, and died in 1405, the last of his line.
zh: 安东·冯·图恩是图恩家族末代男爵，领有下格施泰尔恩和弗鲁蒂根。约1356年继父亲彼得三世之后，他与锡永主教维查德·塔韦利一再冲突：1364年夺取格朗日城堡，1375年其随从在塞塔堡杀害了这位主教。瓦莱上游各教区起事，将安东全家逐往萨伏依，萨伏依伯爵买下他在瓦莱的产业。他于1395年卖掉劳特布伦嫩的地产，1400年把弗鲁蒂根领地卖给伯尔尼，1405年去世，家族就此绝嗣。

en: Aymon II von Turn, also spelled Aymo (c. 1240–1276), was a baron of the leading Valais noble house seated at the Gestelnburg above Niedergesteln, and the son of Gerold I. On his father's death he inherited the vicedominatus, the bishop's temporal advocacy, of Conthey. His sister Nantelma, widow of Rudolf von Raron, brought the family her late husband's estates at St. Niklaus and Zermatt. Aymon headed the house from 1265 until his death in 1276, when his son Peter II succeeded him.
zh: 艾蒙二世·冯·图恩（亦拼作艾莫，约1240—1276）是瓦莱望族图恩家族的男爵，府第在下格施泰尔恩上方的盖斯特尔恩堡，为格罗尔德一世之子。父亲去世后，他继承了孔泰的主教世俗代理权。他的妹妹南特尔玛是鲁道夫·冯·拉龙的遗孀，将亡夫在圣尼克劳斯和采尔马特的产业带入家族。艾蒙于1265年起执掌家族，1276年去世，其子彼得二世继位。

en: Johann I von Turn (c. 1280–1324), son of Peter II, ruled the Valais barony from the Gestelnburg. By his marriage to Elisabeth von Wädenswil he acquired the Bernese Oberland lordships of Frutigen and Mülenen. In 1311 he served as imperial vicar of Como, from 1315 to 1317 he acted as Landvogt, the temporal deputy, of the bishop of Sion, and in 1322 he was imperial governor at Milan. His brother Aymo was bishop of Sion from 1323 to 1338. Johann died in 1323 or 1324, and his son Peter III succeeded him.
zh: 约翰一世·冯·图恩（约1280—1324）是彼得二世之子，从盖斯特尔恩堡统治瓦莱男爵领地。他娶伊丽莎白·冯·韦登斯维尔为妻，由此获得伯尔尼高地的弗鲁蒂根和米莱嫩两处领地。1311年他任帝国驻科莫代理人，1315至1317年担任锡永主教的世俗事务代理，1322年又任帝国驻米兰总督。他的弟弟艾蒙于1323至1338年担任锡永主教。约翰于1323或1324年去世，其子彼得三世继位。

en: Peter II von Turn (c. 1260–1308), son of Aymon II, was the first of his house to style himself baron of Niedergesteln at the Gestelnburg in the Valais. In 1291 he served the counts of Savoy as Landvogt, or governor, of the Waadt. He led the Valais nobility in revolt against Bishop Boniface de Challant of Sion, but after their defeat on the Sustmatten near Leuk in 1296 he made his peace with the bishop in 1299. He ruled until his death in 1308 and was followed by his son Johann.
zh: 彼得二世·冯·图恩（约1260—1308）是艾蒙二世之子，也是家族中第一个自称下格施泰尔恩男爵的人，府第在瓦莱的盖斯特尔恩堡。1291年，他受萨伏依伯爵之命担任沃州行政长官。他率领瓦莱贵族起兵反抗锡永主教博尼法斯·德·沙朗，但1296年在勒克附近的苏斯特马滕战败后，于1299年与主教和解。他统治至1308年去世，其子约翰继位。

en: Peter III von Turn, in French Pierre V de la Tour, headed the leading noble house of the Valais from the Gestelnburg, with estates reaching into the Bernese Oberland including Frutigen. Succeeding his father Johann I around 1324, he sold Laupen to Bern, his rights at Mülenen to the lords of Weissenburg in 1341, and his Lauterbrunnen valley tenants to Interlaken Abbey in 1346. In 1349 his family first feuded with the family of Bishop Witschard Tavelli of Sion; the war drew in Count Amadeus VI of Savoy, whose troops burned Sion in 1353. Peter died about 1356 and was followed by his son Anton.
zh: 彼得三世·冯·图恩是瓦莱首屈一指的男爵世家首领，府第在盖斯特尔恩堡，领地远达伯尔尼高地，包括弗鲁蒂根。约1324年继父亲约翰一世之后，他把劳彭卖给伯尔尼，1341年将米莱嫩的权益卖给魏森堡家族，1346年又把劳特布伦嫩谷地的依附农民卖给因特拉肯修道院。1349年他的家族与锡永主教维查德·塔韦利的家族首次发生争斗，随之而来的战争把萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥六世卷入，萨伏依军队于1353年焚毁锡永。彼得约1356年去世，其子安东继位。

en: Muhammad ibn Thabit ibn Ammar was a head of the Banu Thabit, the clan that ruled fourteenth-century Tripoli. Ibn Khaldun records that after the townspeople killed the Hafsid governor, Muhammad, son of their shaykh Thabit ibn Ammar, was set over Tripoli in 1326 or 1327 and ruled on his own account for about twenty years; the Hafsids of Tunis kept only the right to name the city's qadi. His domains ran from Tripoli to Gabes and the Jabal Nafusa, and he invaded and annexed Jerba, which the Hafsids retook in 1347 or 1348.
zh: 穆罕默德·伊本·萨比特·伊本·阿马尔是14世纪在的黎波里自立的部族班努·萨比特的首领。史家伊本·赫勒敦记载：市民杀死哈夫斯王朝派来的总督后，于1326或1327年拥立他们的谢赫萨比特·伊本·阿马尔之子穆罕默德，此后他独揽的黎波里大权约二十年，突尼斯的哈夫斯王朝仅保留任命城中卡迪之权。班努·萨比特的势力从的黎波里延伸到加贝斯和奈富塞山；穆罕默德还攻占并吞并杰尔巴岛，该岛于1347或1348年被哈夫斯人夺回。

en: Thabit ibn Ammar was the shaykh of the Banu Ammar, also called the Banu Thabit, the clan that gave fourteenth-century Tripoli its ruling dynasty. The chronicler Ibn Khaldun records that in 1326–1327 a group killed the Hafsid governor Muhammad ibn Abi Imran and installed Thabit's son Muhammad over Tripoli. Muhammad governed the city independently for nearly twenty years, with Hafsid authority greatly diminished.
zh: 萨比特·伊本·阿马尔是巴努·阿马尔（又称巴努·萨比特）家族的谢赫，14世纪统治的黎波里的王朝即以该家族命名。伊本·赫勒敦记载，1326至1327年，一伙人杀死哈夫斯总督穆罕默德·伊本·阿比·伊姆兰，拥立萨比特之子穆罕默德统治的黎波里。穆罕默德独掌该城近二十年，哈夫斯王朝的权威大为削弱。

en: Thābit ibn Muḥammad was a ruler of the Banū Thābit, the dynasty that governed fourteenth-century Tripoli. An Arabic account names him its first ruler after the townspeople expelled the Ḥafṣid governor Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿImrān in 1323. The Banū Thābit continued to recognize Ḥafṣid suzerainty while acting as autonomous lords over Tripolitania. Their power stretched from Tripoli toward Gabès and the Nafusa Mountains. In 1354–1355 the Genoese seized Tripoli, and Thābit died in 1355.
zh: 萨比特·伊本·穆罕默德是巴努·萨比特王朝的一位统治者，该家族在14世纪统治的黎波里。一种阿拉伯文记载称，1323年城中居民驱逐哈夫斯王朝总督穆罕默德·伊本·阿比·伊姆兰后，他成为该王朝的首位统治者。巴努·萨比特名义上仍奉哈夫斯为宗主，实则作为割据的领主掌控的黎波里塔尼亚，势力从的黎波里延伸到加贝斯和奈富塞山一带。1354至1355年热那亚人攻占的黎波里，萨比特于1355年去世。

en: Andrei Konstantinovich was the youngest son of Prince Konstantin of Obolensk and a Tarusa-Obolensk appanage prince. After his father's death in 1368 he fled with his brothers to serve Moscow. His sons founded the Dolgorukov, Shcherbatov and Trostensky princely houses.
zh: 安德烈·康斯坦丁诺维奇是奥博连斯克王公康斯坦丁的幼子，也是一位塔鲁萨—奥博连斯克分封王公。1368年父亲死后，他随兄长逃往莫斯科服役。他的儿子们开创了多尔戈鲁科夫、谢尔巴托夫和特罗斯坚斯基三个王公家族。

en: Ivan Konstantinovich Obolensky was an appanage prince of Obolensk and a son of Prince Konstantin, whom the chronicles also call Ivan of Tarusa. After his father's death at Lithuanian hands in 1368, Ivan and his brothers entered the service of Grand Prince Dmitry Donskoy of Moscow while retaining lands in Obolensk. He marched with Dmitry against Tver in 1375 and, with his brother Semyon, fought at the Battle of Kulikovo in 1380. His six children founded the numerous branches of the Obolensky princely house, prominent in Moscow's boyar aristocracy.
zh: 伊凡·康斯坦丁诺维奇·奥博连斯基是奥博连斯克的分封王公，康斯坦丁之子，编年史中也称他为“塔鲁萨的伊凡”。1368年父亲被立陶宛人杀害后，伊凡与兄弟们投奔莫斯科大公德米特里·顿斯科伊，同时保留了在奥博连斯克的领地。他随德米特里参加了1375年征讨特维尔之役，又与兄长谢苗一同参加1380年的库利科沃战役。他的六个子女繁衍出奥博连斯基王公家族的众多支系，该家族在莫斯科波雅尔贵族中地位显赫。

en: Konstantin Yuryevich was the appanage prince of Obolensk, a holding of the Tarusa principality, and the ancestor of the Obolensky princes. Genealogies make him a descendant of the semi-legendary Yury of Tarusa, son of Mikhail of Chernigov. In the 1360s he may have joined other rulers of the Upper Oka lands in an alliance against Lithuania. In November 1368, during Algirdas of Lithuania's first campaign against Moscow, the Lithuanians stormed Obolensk and killed Prince Konstantin. His sons Semyon, Ivan and Andrei then entered the service of Dmitry Donskoy.
zh: 康斯坦丁·尤里耶维奇是塔鲁萨公国的分封王公、领有奥博连斯克，也是奥博连斯基王公家族的始祖；谱系称他是切尔尼戈夫王公米哈伊尔之子、半传说人物尤里·塔尔乌斯基的后裔。1360年代，他可能与上奥卡地区的其他统治者结成对立陶宛的同盟。1368年11月，立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯第一次征伐莫斯科期间，立陶宛军队攻破奥博连斯克，康斯坦丁被杀。他的儿子谢苗、伊万和安德烈随后投奔德米特里·顿斯科伊。

en: Semyon Konstantinovich Obolensky was the eldest of the three sons of Prince Konstantin of Obolensk and an appanage prince of the Obolensk line. In 1368, after his father was killed and his father's lands were seized by the Lithuanians, Semyon and his brothers Ivan and Andrei went to Moscow to serve Grand Prince Dmitry Ivanovich, later called Donskoy. He took part in Dmitry's campaign against Tver in 1375 and fought in the Battle of Kulikovo in 1380.
zh: 谢苗·康斯坦丁诺维奇·奥博连斯基是奥博连斯克王公康斯坦丁三个儿子中的长子，属奥博连斯克分封王公一支。1368年父亲被杀、领地被立陶宛人夺取后，谢苗与弟弟伊万、安德烈前往莫斯科，投奔后来被称为“顿斯科伊”的德米特里·伊万诺维奇大公。他参加了1375年德米特里征伐特维尔的战役，并于1380年参加库利科沃战役。

en: Yury Mikhailovich, known in genealogies as Yury of Tarusa, is the semi-legendary progenitor of the Tarusa branch of the princes of Chernigov. Pedigrees name him a son of Mikhail Vsevolodovich of Chernigov, the grand prince of Kiev executed by the Mongols in 1246, and make him prince of Tarusa on the Oka. From his sons, later genealogies list Vsevolod, Konstantin, Semyon and Ivan, descend the Obolensky, Volkonsky, Dolgorukov and Baryatinsky princely houses. Modern scholarship, judging from his descendants' dates, places him in the first half of the fourteenth century.
zh: 尤里·米哈伊洛维奇，谱系中称尤里·塔尔乌斯基，是切尔尼戈夫王公塔鲁萨支系半传说中的始祖。谱系书记载他是1246年被蒙古人处死的切尔尼戈夫王公、基辅大公米哈伊尔·弗谢沃洛多维奇之子，领有奥卡河畔的塔鲁萨。后世谱系列出弗谢沃洛德、康斯坦丁、谢苗和伊凡等诸子，奥博连斯基、沃尔孔斯基、多尔戈鲁科夫、巴里亚京斯基等王公家族都出自他们一系。现代学者据其后人的生卒年代推算，认为他生活在14世纪上半叶。

en: Biaquino II da Camino (c. 1180 – by 1227) was an Italian nobleman and soldier of the Trevisan da Camino family, the son of Gabriele II da Camino and Engelenda. Left fatherless while still a child, he and his brothers were raised by guardians during a difficult period for their house. In 1218 he appears as podestà of Belluno. He then joined the Fifth Crusade, fitting out a galley at his own expense that was named the Biaquina. After making his will he sailed from Venice and died in the Holy Land before 1227, never returning home.
zh: 比亚奎诺二世·达·卡米诺（约1180—1227年前）是特雷维索显贵达·卡米诺家族的贵族军人，为加布里埃莱二世·达·卡米诺与恩格伦达之子。他幼年丧父，与兄弟们由监护人抚养成人，时值家族多事之秋。1218年，他出任贝卢诺的最高行政官。此后他参加第五次十字军东征，自费装备了一艘桨帆船，该船以他的名字命名为“比亚奎纳号”。他立下遗嘱后从威尼斯启程，于1227年之前客死圣地，再未还乡。

en: Biaquino III da Camino (c. 1205 – July 1274) was a Trevisan noble, son of Guecellone IV and father of Gherardo III da Camino. A supporter of the Guelphs, he lost his family's lands in 1233 over the murder of the podestà Marino Dandolo. With Alberico da Romano he helped subdue Treviso in 1239 and served as its podestà in 1241–1243. He fought the Ghibelline Ezzelino da Romano and Frederick II, helping defend Parma against the emperor in 1247. He acted as mediator for the patriarch of Aquileia and received a renewed grant of rights over Cadore. After reconciling his kin in 1259, he joined Treviso's Council of Three Hundred in 1263, paving the way for his son's signoria.
zh: 比亚奎诺三世·达·卡米诺（约1205—1274年7月）是特雷维索贵族，圭切洛内四世之子、盖拉尔多三世之父。他支持归尔甫派，1233年因波德斯塔马里诺·丹多洛遇刺一事丧失家族封地。1239年，他与阿尔贝里科·达·罗马诺联手迫使特雷维索屈服，并于1241—1243年出任该城波德斯塔。他同吉伯林派的埃泽利诺·达·罗马诺与腓特烈二世作战，1247年参与保卫帕尔马，抵御皇帝。他为阿奎莱亚牧首斡旋，作为回报重新获得卡多雷的权利。1259年他促成族人和解，1263年进入特雷维索三百人会议，为儿子日后建立个人统治铺平了道路。

en: Biaquino VI da Camino (1269 or 1270 – before 1317) was the second son of Guecellone VI and Beatrice Bonaparte of the da Camino house. Left fatherless in 1272, he grew up beside his elder brother Tolberto III, with whom he received the seignory of Oderzo in 1285. In 1291 the brothers conspired against their cousin Gherardo III and, on failing, fled to Venice. They later settled a dispute with the patriarch of Aquileia, who lifted an interdict on their lands and recognised their lordship. In 1312 Biaquino led troops for Padua against Cangrande della Scala; he and Tolberto probably helped organise the December revolt that ended da Camino rule in Treviso. His only surviving son Guecellone VIII is named in Tolberto's 1317 will.
zh: 比亚奎诺六世·达·卡米诺（1269或1270—1317年前）是圭切洛内六世与贝阿特丽切·波拿巴的次子，出身特雷维索的达·卡米诺家族。1272年父亲去世后，他在兄长托尔贝托三世的荫庇下长大，1285年与兄长一同受封奥德尔佐的统治权。1291年，兄弟二人密谋反对堂兄盖拉尔多三世，事败后投奔威尼斯。此后他们与阿奎莱亚牧首解决争端，牧首解除对他们领地的禁令并承认其统治权。1312年，比亚奎诺率军协助帕多瓦对抗坎格兰德·德拉·斯卡拉；他与托尔贝托可能参与策划了当年12月终结达·卡米诺家族在特雷维索统治的叛乱。托尔贝托1317年的遗嘱提及比亚奎诺唯一尚存的儿子圭切洛内八世。

en: Gabriele II da Camino (1145–1186) was an Italian nobleman of the Marca Trevigiana, son of Guecellone II and Sofia di Colfosco. He fought in Frederick Barbarossa's imperial coalition, and in summer 1177 joined his father at Venice for the peace with the Lombard League. After the coalition's defeat he had to acknowledge the communes' authority: he took citizenship at Conegliano in 1179 and swore as a Treviso citizen in 1183, accepting its jurisdiction over his estates. He died around 1186 at about forty, shortly after his father, leaving young sons led by Guecellone IV.
zh: 加布里埃莱二世·达·卡米诺（1145—1186）是特雷维索边疆区的意大利贵族，圭切洛内二世·达·卡米诺与索菲亚·迪·科尔福斯科之子。他加入腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的帝国阵营，1177年夏随父亲赴威尼斯，出席巴巴罗萨与伦巴第联盟的和谈。帝国阵营战败后，他不得不承认城市公社的权威：1179年取得科内利亚诺市民身份，1183年又被迫宣誓成为特雷维索市民，接受该城对自己全部领地的管辖权。他约1186年去世，年约四十，与父亲卒年相距不远，留下以圭切洛内四世为首的一群幼子。

en: Gherardo III da Camino (c. 1240 – 1306), son of Biaquino and India da Camposampiero, was the most outstanding lord of the Trevisan da Camino family. He received the seignory of Feltre and Belluno from their bishop in 1266. As a Guelph leader, he joined Padua and other cities in an alliance against Verona in 1278, then expelled the Ghibellines from Treviso on 15 November 1283, after which he was elected capitano generale. A tyrannical but efficient ruler, he boosted Treviso's economy and patronised arts and feasts, hosting Dante Alighieri at his court. His later years saw repeated plots, the last in 1305 by his son Rizzardo, and he died in 1306.
zh: 盖拉尔多三世·达·卡米诺（约1240—1306）是比亚奎诺与印第亚·达·坎波桑皮耶罗之子，被视为特雷维索达·卡米诺家族最杰出的统治者。1266年，他从主教手中获得费尔特雷和贝卢诺的统治权。作为归尔甫派领袖，他于1278年联合帕多瓦等城对抗维罗纳，又于1283年11月15日把吉伯林派逐出特雷维索，随后当选总揽全权的统领。他为政专断却高效，提振了特雷维索的经济，又赞助艺术与宴乐，曾在宫廷接待但丁。晚年谋叛不断，1305年儿子里扎尔多也参与其中，他最终于1306年去世。

en: Guecellone IV da Camino (c. 1177–c. 1236), eldest son of Gabriele II, was orphaned at nine and raised under guardians. In 1191 he swore loyalty to Treviso's podesta Ezzelino II da Romano; the Guelph da Camino and Ghibelline da Romano long rivaled over the Marca Trevigiana. In 1195 the patriarch of Aquileia invested him and his brothers with Camino, Motta and Cessalto castles, and in 1211 they bought Oderzo, Fregona, Costa and Soligo from the bishop of Belluno, becoming the church's avogari. He is regarded as the ancestor of the family's so-called upper branch, although modern historians consider its supposed division of lands with his brother Biaquino in 1233 fictitious.
zh: 圭切洛内四世·达·卡米诺（约1177—约1236）是加布里埃莱二世的长子，约九岁丧父，在监护人照管下长大。1191年，他向特雷维索新任波德斯塔埃泽利诺二世·达·罗马诺宣誓效忠；此后亲圭尔夫派的达·卡米诺家族与亲吉伯林派的达·罗马诺家族长年争夺特雷维索边疆区的霸权。1195年，阿奎莱亚牧首将卡米诺、莫塔、切萨尔托三座城堡封授给他和他的兄弟；1211年他们又从贝卢诺主教手中买下奥德尔佐、弗雷戈纳、科斯塔和索利戈，并出任该教会的代理人。他被视为家族所谓“上支”的始祖，但现代史家认为他于1233年与弟弟比亚奎诺分家产的说法是虚构的。

en: Guecellone VI da Camino (1243–1272) was an Italian nobleman of the da Camino family, born at Farra di Soligo near Treviso, the son of Tolberto II. The commune of Treviso, urged on by Ezzelino III da Romano, disputed his possession of the family fortress as it sought influence along the Piave. Little inclined to war, Guecellone negotiated a settlement: he kept the castle, while its keep became a Trevisan garrison. He died at Treviso in 1272. In 1285 his widow, Beatrice Bonaparte, recovered several confiscated fiefs and redeemed the county of Castelnuovo for their son Tolberto.
zh: 圭切洛内六世·达·卡米诺（1243—1272）是达·卡米诺家族的意大利贵族，1243年生于特雷维索附近的法拉迪索利戈，为托尔贝托二世之子。特雷维索城邦在埃泽利诺三世·达·罗马诺怂恿下，意图把势力扩展到皮亚韦河流域，因而对他拥有家族堡垒的权利提出异议。圭切洛内并不好战，最终谈成一项协议：他保留城堡本身，城堡主塔则成为特雷维索的驻军据点。1272年他在特雷维索去世。1285年，其遗孀贝阿特丽切·博拿巴帕特收回了若干被没收的封地，并为他们的儿子托尔贝托从科内利亚诺赎回新堡伯国。

en: Guecellone VII da Camino (died August 1324), son of Gherardo III and Chiara della Torre, was the last da Camino lord of Treviso. Destined for the Church, he took power when his brother Rizzardo IV was assassinated on 12 April 1312. He restored Guelph policy, renounced the imperial vicariate and reinstated the communal institutions abolished under his father. He allied with Padua against Cangrande della Scala, then defected to Cangrande through a marriage pact. On 14–15 December 1312 the Trevisans revolted and sacked his palace; Guecellone escaped over the walls to Serravalle. His later attempts to recover Treviso failed, and he died at Serravalle in August 1324.
zh: 圭切洛内七世·达·卡米诺（?—1324年8月）是盖拉尔多三世与基娅拉·德拉·托雷之子，达·卡米诺家族在特雷维索的最后一位统治者。他原本准备进入教会，1312年4月12日兄长里扎尔多四世遇刺后接管大权。他恢复归尔甫派政策，放弃帝国代理人头衔，并恢复了父亲废除的市政制度。他先与帕多瓦结盟对抗坎格兰德·德拉·斯卡拉，后又通过婚约倒向坎格兰德。1312年12月14日至15日夜，特雷维索市民暴动并洗劫他的宫邸，圭切洛内缒城而逃，退守塞拉瓦莱。他此后收复特雷维索的尝试均告失败，1324年8月死于塞拉瓦莱。

en: Rizzardo IV da Camino (1274–1312) was an Italian condottiero and lord of Treviso. Knighted at Rovigo in 1295 by Marquis Azzo VIII d'Este, he succeeded his father Gherardo III in 1306. He long led the family's expansion into Friuli: in 1309 he escorted the patriarch of Aquileia back to Udine and extorted the title of captain general, only to be driven out by a citizen uprising. In 1311 he joined the Ghibellines and became imperial vicar under Henry VII, alienating Venice. In April 1312 he was stabbed at chess in his palace and died a week later.
zh: 里扎尔多四世·达·卡米诺（1274—1312）是意大利佣兵首领兼特雷维索领主。1295年，他在罗维戈由费拉拉侯爵阿佐八世·德斯特册封为骑士，1306年继承父亲格拉尔多三世之位。他长期主持家族向弗留利扩张：1309年他护送阿奎莱亚牧首返回乌迪内，逼取了弗留利总兵头衔，却被市民起义赶走。1311年他倒向皇帝派，从亨利七世手中接受帝国代牧之职，因而失去威尼斯的信任。1312年4月5日，他在宫中柱廊下棋时被刺客刺伤，七天后死去。

en: Tolberto II da Camino (1218–1256), a son of Biaquino II, belonged to the lower branch of the da Camino lords of Treviso. His father died in the Holy Land on the Fifth Crusade; left fatherless in infancy, he and his elder brother Guecellone were raised by their uncle Tolberto, a judge in Treviso, and forced from the city as boys after the rise of the Ghibelline Ezzelino III da Romano. While his brother sided with Alberico da Romano, Tolberto joined Ezzelino and married his kinswoman Agnese de' Guidotti. He later defrauded his nephews under his guardianship, though his descendants carried on the line.
zh: 托尔贝托二世·达·卡米诺（1218—1256）是特雷维索达·卡米诺家族“下支”的意大利贵族，为比亚奎诺二世之子，其父在第五次十字军东征期间死于圣地。他幼年丧父，与兄长圭切洛内被托付给在特雷维索当法官的同名叔父；圭多勒派的埃泽利诺三世·达·罗马诺得势后，兄弟二人年少时被迫离开该城。兄长投奔阿尔贝里科·达·罗马诺，托尔贝托却依附埃泽利诺，并娶其亲属阿涅塞·德·圭多蒂为妻。他后来侵吞了受其监护的侄子们的财产，但家族支脉正是由他的后代延续。

en: Aonghus mac Conchobhair Ó Domhnaill was the eldest son of Conchobar O'Donnell and the tenth O'Donnell chief, king of Tyrconnell from 1343 to 1352. After his uncle Niall murdered Conchobar in 1342 and ruled for a year, Aonghus drove Niall out in 1343 and was proclaimed Ó Domhnaill. His uncle continued to dispute the lordship until another brother, Maghnus Meabhlach, killed Niall at Inis-Saimer in 1348, leaving Aonghus secure as chief. He died in 1352, after which his uncle Feidhlimidh and brother Seán fought over the succession.
zh: 安格斯·麦克·康乔巴尔·奥唐奈是康乔巴尔·奥唐奈的长子、奥唐奈家族第十代首领，1343至1352年任蒂康奈尔国王。1342年他的叔父尼尔杀害了他的父亲康乔巴尔并夺位，仅在位一年，1343年安格斯将尼尔驱逐，被拥立为奥唐奈之主。尼尔仍不断争位，直到1348年另一个兄弟马格努斯·梅夫拉赫在伊尼什萨默尔将尼尔杀死，安格斯的首领地位才得以稳固。他于1352年去世，此后叔父费利姆与弟弟肖恩为继承人大动干戈。

en: Conchobar mac Aodha Ó Domhnaill was the eighth O'Donnell chief and king of Tyrconnell from 1333. He succeeded his father Aodh, who died after taking the monk's habit on Inis-Saimer and was buried at Assaroe Abbey, but first had to defeat the claim of his younger brother Art, whom he killed in battle. As lord of Cenél Conaill he ruled over lower Connacht, Fermanagh and Inishowen. In 1342 his brother Niall attacked him at night in his fortress of Murbhach and killed him, seizing the kingship.
zh: 康乔巴尔·麦克·艾德·奥唐奈是奥唐奈家族第八代首领，自1333年起任蒂康奈尔国王。他继承了在伊尼什萨默尔岛出家后去世、葬于阿萨罗修道院的父亲艾德，继位之初还击败了弟弟阿特的争位，并在战斗中将其杀死。作为科内尔之王，他统治着下康诺特、弗马纳和伊尼什欧文。1342年，他的弟弟尼尔夜袭他的城堡穆尔巴赫，将他杀死并夺取王位。

en: Feidhlimidh mac Aodha Ó Domhnaill was a son of Aodh O'Donnell and the eleventh O'Donnell chief, ruling Tyrconnell as king from 1352 in rivalry with his nephew Seán mac Conchobhair. When his nephew Aonghus died in 1352, Feidhlimidh seized the kingship, but Seán contested it for years. In 1355 his son and heir Donnchadh was killed at the court of the Maguire king of Fermanagh while trying to abduct his host's daughter Gormlaith. In 1356 Feidhlimidh was killed by his nephew Seán, who then took the lordship unopposed.
zh: 费利姆·麦克·艾德·奥唐奈是艾德·奥唐奈之子、奥唐奈家族第十一代首领，自1352年起与侄子肖恩·麦克·康乔巴尔争立，对峙中任蒂康奈尔国王直至1356年。1352年侄子安格斯去世后，费利姆夺取王位，肖恩则长年与他争夺。1355年，他的儿子兼继承人唐查德在弗马纳的马圭尔王廷上，试图强抢主人之女戈尔姆莱斯时被杀。1356年，费利姆被侄子肖恩所杀，肖恩随后无可争议地取得首领之位。

en: Hugh O'Donnell (Irish: Aodh mac Domhnaill Óic; died 1333) was king of Tyrconnell. He succeeded in 1281 after his father Donnell Óg O'Donnell was killed at the battle of Disert-da-chrioch against the O'Neills and the English of Ulster. In 1290 his brother Turlogh, backed by Scottish MacDonald gallowglass, deposed him, but Hugh recovered the kingship the next year when an invasion by the Earl of Ulster threw Turlogh's regime into confusion. He ruled until 1333, dying in the monk's habit and was buried at Assaroe Abbey. His son Connor succeeded him.
zh: 休·奥唐奈（爱尔兰语名艾·麦克·多姆纳尔·奥伊格，?—1333）是蒂康奈尔国王。1281年，他的父亲多姆纳尔·奥格·奥唐奈在迪瑟特—达—克里奥赫战役中对抗奥尼尔家族与阿尔斯特英军时战死，他随后继位。1290年，其兄弟图尔洛在苏格兰麦克唐纳家族加洛格拉斯佣兵的支持下将他废黜；次年阿尔斯特伯爵入侵，图尔洛政权陷入混乱，休趁机复位。他一直统治到1333年，临终前穿上修士袍，葬于阿萨罗修道院，其子康纳继位。

en: Niall mac Aodha Ó Domhnaill was the third son of Aodh O'Donnell and the ninth O'Donnell chief, king of Tyrconnell from 1342 to 1343. In 1342 he surprised his elder brother Conchobar at night in the Murbhach fortress, killed him and had himself proclaimed head of the Ó Domhnaill clan. He ruled only a year before his eldest nephew, Aonghus mac Conchobhair, drove him out and took the kingship. In 1348 Niall was killed by another brother, Maghnus Meabhlach, in the harbour of Inis-Saimer.
zh: 尼尔·麦克·艾德·奥唐奈是艾德·奥唐奈的第三子、奥唐奈家族第九代首领，1342至1343年任蒂康奈尔国王。1342年，他夜袭穆尔巴赫城堡，杀死兄长康乔巴尔，自立为奥唐奈氏族首领。但他仅在位一年，就被长侄安格斯·麦克·康乔巴尔驱逐，王位旁落。1348年，尼尔在伊尼什萨默尔岛的港口被另一个兄弟马格努斯·梅夫拉赫杀死。

en: Seán O'Donnell (Seoán mac Conchobhair Ó Domhnaill) was a son of Conchobar O'Donnell, king of Tyrconnell, who was killed in 1342. After his brother Aonghus was slain in 1352, Seán led his followers against their uncle Feidhlimidh, who had succeeded to the kingship. Feidhlimidh and his son were probably captured in 1356 and killed by Seán in 1357. Seán ruled until 1359, when Cathal Óg O'Connor of Sligo seized power. When Cathal died in 1362, Seán returned. In 1369 Pilib Maguire led a fleet against him to avenge a vassal's death. Seán and his son were killed at Assaroe monastery in 1380.
zh: 肖恩·奥唐奈是蒂康奈尔国王康乔巴·奥唐奈之子，其父于1342年被杀。1352年其兄安古斯被杀后，肖恩率追随者对抗继位的叔父费利米德。费利米德及其子可能于1356年被俘，1357年被肖恩杀害。肖恩统治至1359年，斯莱戈的卡瑟尔·奥格·奥康纳夺取政权。1362年卡瑟尔死后，肖恩复位。1369年，皮利布·马圭尔为给一名附庸复仇，率舰队进攻肖恩。1380年，肖恩与儿子在阿萨罗修道院被杀。

en: Pace da Vedano, also called Pasquale, was a Dominican friar who served as bishop of Trieste from 18 May 1330 until his death on 12 August 1341. On 17 May 1332 he performed the first documented consecration of Trieste's eleventh-century Romanesque basilica of San Silvestro, later known as the Cristo Salvatore. His see's Istrian holdings were a standing source of trouble. One of them, the castle of Sipar, had been occupied by the Bratti family, who placed themselves under the protection of Capodistria. In 1333 Pace enfeoffed it to Andrea Dandolo, podestà of Trieste and later doge of Venice. Dandolo handed it back to the Bratti, reigniting the dispute, which ended only when Pope Innocent VI ordered the castle restored to the Trieste church.
zh: 帕切·达·韦达诺（又译帕斯夸莱，?—1341年8月12日）是多明我会修士，1330年5月18日至1341年去世任的里雅斯特主教。1332年5月17日，他为的里雅斯特十一世纪的罗曼式圣西尔维斯特堂（后称救世主堂）主持了有文献可考的首次祝圣礼。该教区在伊斯特拉的领地一向纠纷不断，其中的西帕尔城堡被布拉蒂家族占据，这个家族还投靠卡波迪斯特里亚寻求庇护。1333年，帕切把城堡封授给时任的里雅斯特波德斯塔、后来成为威尼斯总督的安德烈亚·丹多洛。丹多洛却把城堡交还布拉蒂家族，争端再起，直到教皇英诺森六世下令把城堡归还的里雅斯特教会才告结束。

en: Quinatzin, also called Quinatzin Tlaltecatzin (traditional dates 1252–1331), is named in the native annals preserved by Alva Ixtlilxochitl and the Codex Xolotl as the first tlatoani of the Acolhua city of Texcoco. His line ran from the chieftain Xolotl through Nopaltzin to his father Tlotzin Pochotl, which made him the fourth holder of the Chichimec title Chichimecateuctli, 'lord of the Chichimecs'. His forebears had ruled from Tenayuca; once elected, Quinatzin moved the seat to Texcoco, leaving Tenayuca a place of secondary importance and making Texcoco the centre of Acolhua power. By his wife Cuauhcihuatzin, a noblewoman of Huexotla, he fathered his successor Techotlalatzin and was grandfather of Ixtlilxochitl I.
zh: 基纳特辛（全名基纳特辛·特拉尔特卡钦，传世生卒1252—1331）据阿尔瓦·伊斯特利尔索奇特尔所录本地编年史与《索洛特尔法典》记载，是阿科尔瓦城邦特斯科科的第一位特拉托阿尼。他的世系从首领索洛特尔经诺帕尔钦传到父亲特洛钦·波乔特尔，因此他是第四位拥有奇奇梅卡首领称号奇奇梅卡特库特利（“奇奇梅卡人之主”）的统治者。先辈都在特纳尤卡执政；他当选后把都城迁往特斯科科，让特纳尤卡退居次要，使特斯科科成为阿科尔瓦人的权力中心。他的妻子是韦克索特兰贵族妇女夸乌齐瓦钦，生子继承人特乔特拉拉特辛，孙子即伊斯特利尔索奇特尔一世。

en: Techotlalatzin (c. 1323–1409) was tlatoani of the Acolhua city-state of Texcoco from 1357 or 1377 until his death, succeeding his father Quinatzin. The native annals gathered by Torquemada and Alva Ixtlilxochitl present him as the first Acolhua ruler to embrace the culture of the Valley of Mexico, adopting Nahuatl at his court. He built a small Acolhua domain on the eastern shore of Lake Texcoco, though within the orbit of Tezozomoc of Azcapotzalco, the Tepanec ruler whose city dominated the Valley. One account has Tezozomoc declaring war on him, being defeated and suing for peace. He married Tozquentzin, daughter of Acolmiztli of Coatlichan. His son Ixtlilxochitl I inherited the throne and the quarrel: Tezozomoc defeated and killed him in 1419 and seized Texcoco.
zh: 特乔特拉拉特辛（约1323—1409）是阿科尔瓦城邦特斯科科的特拉托阿尼，1357年或1377年继承父亲基纳特辛之位，统治直至1409年去世。托尔克马达与阿尔瓦·伊斯特利尔索奇特尔等人辑录的本地编年史把他记作首位接纳墨西哥谷地文化的阿科尔瓦统治者，他在宫廷中采用纳瓦特尔语。他在特斯科科湖东岸建起一块不大的阿科尔瓦领地，但始终处在阿斯卡波察尔科的特帕内克首领特索索莫克的势力笼罩之下，后者的城邦称雄谷地。一种记载称，特索索莫克曾向他宣战，战败后求和。他娶夸特利昌的阿科尔米斯特利之女托斯肯钦。他的儿子伊斯特利尔索奇特尔一世继承了王位，也继承了这场争端：1419年，特索索莫克击败并杀死了他，夺取特斯科科。

en: Godfrey II (Gottfried II, died 1369) was Count Palatine of Tübingen, the son of Count Palatine William II and Heilika of Eberstein. Deep in debt and in conflict with Count Ulrich of Württemberg, he was forced at Emperor Louis IV's bidding to sell the city of Tübingen to Ulrich for twenty thousand gold hellers on 5 December 1342. In 1357 he sold Böblingen, Dagersheim, Darmsheim and his share of the Schönbuch to Ulrich's sons Eberhard and Ulrich. Through his wife Clara of Freiburg he inherited the lordship of Lichteneck and founded the Tübingen-Lichteneck line of counts.
zh: 戈特弗里德二世（1369年去世）是蒂宾根行宫伯爵，行宫伯爵威廉二世与艾伯施泰因的海莉卡之子。他负债累累，又与符腾堡伯爵乌尔里希交恶，在皇帝路易四世的责令下，于1342年12月5日以两万金赫勒的价格把蒂宾根城卖给乌尔里希。1357年，他又将伯布林根、达格斯海姆、达姆斯海姆及其在舍恩布赫的份额卖给乌尔里希的儿子埃伯哈德和乌尔里希。他凭借妻子弗赖堡的克拉拉继承了利希特内克领地，开创了蒂宾根-利希特内克伯爵支系。

en: William II (died 1327) was Count Palatine of Tübingen and Count of Tübingen-Böblingen, the son of Count Palatine Gottfried I and Elisabeth of Fürstenberg. He married Heilika of Eberstein and was the father of Count Palatine Gottfried II, who sold Tübingen to Württemberg in 1342.
zh: 威廉二世（?—1327）是蒂宾根行宫伯爵兼蒂宾根—伯布林根伯爵，为行宫伯爵戈特弗里德一世与菲尔斯滕贝格的伊丽莎白之子，娶艾伯施泰因的海莉卡为妻。其子戈特弗里德二世继位后于1342年将蒂宾根卖给符腾堡。

en: Tugh Temür (1304–1332), Jayaatu Khan or Emperor Wenzong of Yuan, was the second son of Külüg Khan. Banished to Hainan in 1320, he became Prince of Huai at Jiankang. After Yesün Temür's death El Temür enthroned him at Dadu in October 1328, and he won the War of the Two Capitals against Ragibagh. In February 1329 he abdicated for his elder brother Kusala, regaining the throne that September after Kusala's suspicious death. A poet and calligrapher, he founded the Kuizhangge Academy in 1329 and sponsored the Jingshi Dadian compendium while El Temür held real power. He died in 1332.
zh: 图帖睦尔（1304—1332），号札牙笃汗，庙号文宗，曲律汗次子。1320年英宗将他流放海南岛，后来他被泰定帝封为怀王，出居建康。1328年泰定帝死后，燕帖木儿在大都拥立他为帝，他在两都之战中战胜阿剌吉八。1329年2月他让位于长兄和世㻋，同年9月和世㻋暴死后重新登基。他擅长诗文书法，1329年开设奎章阁学士院，并敕修大型政书《经世大典》，但实权掌握在燕帖木儿手中。他于1332年去世。

en: Tughluq, recorded in Chinese sources as Aru, was a Yuan prince of Yunnan and a great-grandson of Kublai Khan. In 1334 Toghon Temür made him prince of Yunnan; a Mongol inscription of 1340 at Kunming's Qiongzhu Temple preserves his decree.
zh: 秃忽鲁，汉文史料作阿鲁（又作脱鲁），元朝宗室、云南王，忽必烈曾孙。1334年元顺帝任命他为云南王，出镇云南；昆明筇竹寺所存1340年蒙文《云南王藏经碑》记载了他颁布的令旨。

en: Tumbinai, called Tumbinai Setsen, was khan of the Borjigin Mongols at the turn of the twelfth century, when the Mongol tribes first began to grow in power. He was the son of Baishinkhur Dogshin and grandson of Kaidu Khan. Faced with the strength of the Khitan-led Liao dynasty of northern China, he acknowledged its overlordship and paid tribute to the Liao emperor. On his death around 1130 his son Khabul succeeded him, united the tribes into the Khamag Mongol confederation and became its first khan; another son, Khaduli, was the ancestor, through the Barlas line, of Timur.
zh: 敦必乃（又称敦必乃薛禅）是12世纪之交的蒙古孛儿只斤氏可汗，当时蒙古诸部的势力刚开始壮大。他是拜姓忽儿之子、海都汗之孙。面对中国北方契丹人所建辽朝的威势，他向辽帝称臣纳贡。约1130年他去世后，儿子合不勒继位，统一诸部组成蒙兀国联盟，成为第一位可汗；另一个儿子哈笃里的后裔则经巴鲁剌思一脉生出了帖木儿。

en: Abu Hafs Umar II was a son of the Hafsid caliph Abu Yahya Abu Bakr II. In 1342 the old caliph had named another son, Ahmad, as his heir and secured the backing of his son-in-law, the Marinid sultan Abu al-Hasan of Fez. When the caliph died in October 1346, Umar, who happened to be in Tunis, had himself proclaimed caliph first. Ahmad marched up from the south and took the city, but Umar killed him, and his other brothers too. It bought him only months. In spring 1347 Abu al-Hasan, as guarantor of the succession and Umar's own brother-in-law, invaded Ifriqiya and met almost no resistance. Accounts of Umar's end differ: one says he fled Tunis, was captured near Gabès and executed in August 1347, while others place his death in 1349.
zh: 阿布·哈夫斯·欧麦尔二世是哈夫斯王朝哈里发阿布·叶海亚·阿布·伯克尔二世之子。1342年，老哈里发指定另一个儿子艾哈迈德为继承人，并取得女婿、非斯的马林王朝苏丹阿布·哈桑的支持。1346年10月哈里发去世时，恰好身在突尼斯的欧麦尔抢先自立为哈里发。艾哈迈德从南方进军，夺取了突尼斯城，却被欧麦尔杀死，其他兄弟也未能幸免。这只换来数月的王位。1347年春，作为继承秩序担保人的阿布·哈桑（他也是欧麦尔的姻亲）入侵伊夫里奇亚，几乎未遇抵抗。关于欧麦尔之死，记载并不一致：一种说法称他逃出突尼斯，在加贝斯附近被俘，于1347年8月处决，另一些记载则称他死于1349年。

en: Abu Ishaq Ibrahim II (1336–1369), a son of Abu Yahya Abu Bakr II, was Hafsid caliph of Tunis from 1350 to 1369. In 1350 the chamberlain Ibn Tafragin overthrew Ibrahim's brother al-Fadl and placed the thirteen-year-old prince on the throne, holding real power for fourteen years. The realm was split: rival Hafsid branches controlled Constantine and Béjaïa, and Constantine fought Tunis from 1351 to 1356.
