The Marinid sultan Abu Inan Faris seized Tunis in 1357 and Ibrahim fled, until Arab revolts drove the Moroccans out and he returned. He rebuilt the walls of Tunis, and only Ibn Tafragin's death in 1364 let him rule for himself. He died in 1369, aged thirty-two. His son Khalid II, a boy of ten or twelve, inherited a court of quarrelling factions, and in 1370 the Hafsid ruler of Constantine occupied Tunis.
zh: 阿布·易司哈格·易卜拉欣二世（1336—1369）是阿布·叶海亚·阿布·伯克尔二世之子，1350—1369年担任突尼斯的哈夫斯王朝哈里发。1350年，宫廷总管伊本·塔夫拉金推翻他的兄弟法德勒，将年仅十三岁的他扶上王位，此后十四年独掌实权。王国已经分裂：哈夫斯家族的敌对支系分别控制君士坦丁和贝贾亚，君士坦丁于1351—1356年间与突尼斯交战。马林王朝苏丹阿布·伊南·法里斯于1357年攻占突尼斯，易卜拉欣出逃，直到阿拉伯部落起义把马林人赶走后才返回。他主持重建突尼斯城墙，直到1364年塔夫拉金去世才得以亲政。他于1369年去世，终年三十二岁。继位的儿子哈立德二世只有十岁或十二岁，朝中派系争斗不休，1370年君士坦丁的哈夫斯统治者占领了突尼斯。

en: Abu al-Abbas Ahmad I al-Fadl was a son of the Hafsid caliph Abu Yahya Abu Bakr II, who appointed him governor of Bona. He came to power after the dynasty had lost Tunis. In 1347 the Marinid sultan Abu al-Hasan, who had married a daughter of Abu Yahya, invaded Ifriqiya and overran it, ending the brief reign of Ahmad's brother Umar II. The occupation soured: an Arab tribal revolt defeated the Marinid army in 1348, and further rebellions forced Abu al-Hasan to leave Tunis for the west. In December 1349 a coalition of Hafsid nobles led by the sheikh Ibn Tafragin proclaimed Ahmad caliph, restoring Hafsid rule in Tunis. It lasted only months: displeased with him, Ibn Tafragin deposed him in 1350 in favour of his younger brother Abu Ishaq Ibrahim II, and Ahmad died the same year.
zh: 阿布·阿拔斯·艾哈迈德一世·法德勒是哈夫斯王朝哈里发阿布·叶海亚·阿布·伯克尔二世之子，父亲在世时他担任博纳总督。他是在王朝丢掉突尼斯之后上台的。1347年，娶了阿布·叶海亚之女的马林王朝苏丹阿布·哈桑入侵伊夫里奇亚并占领全境，终结了艾哈迈德之兄欧麦尔二世数月的统治。占领很快失去人心：1348年阿拉伯部落起义击败马林军队，各地叛乱接连而起，迫使阿布·哈桑离开突尼斯向西撤退。1349年12月，谢赫伊本·塔夫拉金率领哈夫斯贵族拥立艾哈迈德为哈里发，在突尼斯恢复哈夫斯王朝的统治。这只维持了数月：塔夫拉金对他不满，1350年将他废黜，改立其弟阿布·易司哈格·易卜拉欣二世，艾哈迈德于同年死去。

en: Abu-l-Baqa Khalid an-Nasr (1283–1311) was a Hafsid prince who ruled Béjaïa after his father Abu Zakariyya Yahya III. In 1307 the scholar Ramon Llull was imprisoned by the qadi for six months before Abu-l-Baqa released and expelled him. Seeking to end the division of the Hafsid family, he agreed with Abu Asida Muhammad II of Tunis that the survivor would inherit the other's realm. When Abu Asida died in 1309, however, the sheikhs raised Abu Yahya Abu Bakr ash-Shahid instead. Abu-l-Baqa crushed his rival in seventeen days and seized Tunis. Revolts followed in Constantine, led first by his cousin and then by his brother. His harsh rule cost him the support of Tunisian notables, and in 1311 he surrendered to his brother and was assassinated.
zh: 阿布·巴卡·哈立德·纳绥尔（1283—1311）是哈夫斯王朝王公，继其父阿布·扎卡里亚·叶海亚三世成为贝贾亚统治者。1307年，学者拉蒙·柳利被卡迪囚禁六个月，随后阿布·巴卡将他释放并驱逐出境。为结束哈夫斯家族的分裂，他与突尼斯的阿布·阿西达·穆罕默德二世约定，两人中后死者继承对方的领地。但1309年阿布·阿西达死后，城内谢赫却另立阿布·叶海亚·阿布·伯克尔·沙希德。阿布·巴卡用十七天击溃对手、攻占突尼斯。君士坦丁随即爆发叛乱，先由他的堂亲领导，后来由其兄弟领导。他统治严苛，失去突尼斯显贵的支持；1311年他向兄弟投降，仍遭刺杀。

en: Ibn Tafragin (died 1364) was an Almohad sheikh and chamberlain who dominated the Hafsid state in the mid-fourteenth century. Around 1330 he reached the highest offices under Caliph Abu Yahya Abu Bakr II, and as chief chamberlain from 1343 he pushed for closer ties with the Marinids of Fez. Their sultan Abu al-Hasan was the caliph's son-in-law and, since annexing Tlemcen in 1337, the Hafsids' immediate western neighbour. A succession struggle in 1346 cost Ibn Tafragin his office, but he favoured the Marinid invasion of 1347. Abu al-Hasan's mistakes in governing forced him out in 1349, and power passed to the Almohad sheikhs, of whom Ibn Tafragin was the most influential. In December 1349 he raised Abu al-Abbas Ahmad al-Fadl to the caliphate, fell out with him and deposed him the next year. He installed the child Abu Ishaq Ibrahim II and ruled in his name until his death in 1364.
zh: 伊本·塔夫拉金（？—1364）是穆瓦希德派谢赫、宫廷总管，在14世纪中叶掌控哈夫斯朝政。约1330年，他在哈里发阿布·叶海亚·阿布·伯克尔二世治下升任最高职务，1343年起任首席宫廷总管，力主与非斯的马林王朝加强关系。马林苏丹阿布·哈桑是哈里发的女婿，1337年吞并特莱姆森后，成了哈夫斯王朝紧邻的西方邻国。1346年的继位之争使塔夫拉金丢了官职，但他仍支持1347年马林人的入侵。1349年阿布·哈桑因治理失当被迫撤出，权力落入穆瓦希德谢赫们手中，塔夫拉金是其中最有势力的一个。1349年12月，他拥立阿布·阿拔斯·艾哈迈德·法德勒为哈里发，却与其不和，次年将其废黜。他改立年幼的阿布·易司哈格·易卜拉欣二世，以其名义执政，直至1364年去世。

en: Abu Yahya Abu Bakr II (died 19 October 1346) was the Hafsid caliph of Ifriqiya from 1318, a son of Abu Zakariyya Yahya III, emir of Béjaïa. He seized Béjaïa in 1312 and entered Tunis in early 1318 after the fall of the ruler al-Lihyani. He put down repeated revolts until 1332 and ended yearly Zayyanid raids from Tlemcen by allying with the Marinids of Fez, whose heir Abu al-Hasan married his daughter. In 1335 he retook Djerba from the Sicilians and built up corsair fleets in Hafsid ports. His son Abu Hafs Umar succeeded him.
zh: 阿布·叶海亚·阿布·贝克尔二世（1346年10月19日去世）是1318年起统治伊夫里奇亚的哈夫斯王朝哈里发，贝贾亚埃米尔阿布·扎卡里亚·叶海亚三世之子。他于1312年夺取贝贾亚，1318年初在统治者利赫亚尼倒台后进入突尼斯。他接连平定叛乱直至1332年，又通过与非斯的马林王朝结盟，结束了特莱姆森扎扬王朝的连年进犯，马林王朝储君阿布·哈桑娶了他的女儿。1335年他从西西里人手中收复杰尔巴岛，并在哈夫斯诸港建立海盗船队，死后由其子阿布·哈夫斯·奥马尔继位。

en: Abu Zakariya Yahya was a Hafsid prince, a son of Caliph Abu Yahya Abu Bakr II, and the father of Abu Abdullah Muhammad, who ruled Béjaïa as emir from 1348 with Marinid support.
zh: 阿布·扎卡里亚·叶海亚是哈夫斯王朝王公、哈里发阿布·叶海亚·阿布·伯克尔二世之子；他的儿子阿布·阿卜杜拉·穆罕默德于1348年在马林王朝支持下成为贝贾亚埃米尔。

en: Abu Zakariya Yahya III (c. 1260–1301) was the Hafsid emir who made Béjaïa independent of Tunis. A son of the caliph Abu Ishaq Ibrahim I, he fled to Tlemcen after his family's overthrow in 1283 but established himself at Béjaïa soon after. In 1285 he revolted with Arab tribal support and seized the western Hafsid lands including Constantine, and in 1286 he attacked Tunis itself; repulsed, he fled south and seized Gabès. Around 1290 he annexed the Zab, and in 1300 he repulsed a Marinid siege of Béjaïa. He died in 1301 and was succeeded by his son Abu-l-Baqa Khalid.
zh: 阿布·扎卡里亚·叶海亚三世（约1260—1301）是使贝贾亚脱离突尼斯独立的哈夫斯埃米尔。他是哈里发阿布·伊沙克·易卜拉欣一世之子，1283年家族被推翻后逃往特莱姆森，不久便在贝贾亚立足。1285年，他在阿拉伯部落支持下起兵，夺取了包括君士坦丁在内的哈夫斯西部领土；1286年他进攻突尼斯，受挫后南逃并夺取加贝斯。约1290年他兼并扎布地区，1300年又击退马林王朝对贝贾亚的围攻。他于1301年去世，其子阿布·巴卡·哈立德继位。

en: Al-Fadl was a Hafsid prince, a son of Caliph Abu Yahya Abu Bakr II and brother of Abu Ishaq Ibrahim II. His family lost Tunis in 1347 to the Marinid sultan Abu al-Hasan, who invaded Ifriqiya. The occupation did not last: the Black Death ravaged Hafsid lands in 1349, Marinid rule was unpopular, and rebellions forced Abu al-Hasan to leave Tunis by ship in December. Early in 1350 Hafsid notables proclaimed Al-Fadl, then based at Béjaïa, as caliph. His reign lasted only months: in July the chamberlain Ibn Tafragin returned to Tunis, raised Ibrahim II in his place and put Al-Fadl to death. Ibn Tafragin then governed in the young Ibrahim's name.
zh: 法德勒是哈夫斯王朝王公，哈里发阿布·叶海亚·阿布·伯克尔二世之子，与阿布·易司哈格·易卜拉欣二世是兄弟。1347年，马林王朝苏丹阿布·哈桑入侵伊夫里奇亚，他的家族失去突尼斯。占领并未持久：1349年黑死病席卷哈夫斯领地，马林人的统治不得人心，叛乱迫使阿布·哈桑于12月乘船离开突尼斯。1350年初，哈夫斯贵族拥立当时身在贝贾亚的法德勒为哈里发。他仅在位数月：同年7月，宫廷总管伊本·塔夫拉金返回突尼斯，改立易卜拉欣二世，并将法德勒处死。此后塔夫拉金以年幼的易卜拉欣之名执政。

en: Fatima was a Hafsid princess, daughter of Abu Yahya Abu Bakr II of Ifriqiya, who married the Marinid ruler Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Othman to seal an alliance against Tlemcen.
zh: 法蒂玛是哈夫斯王朝公主、伊夫里奇亚统治者阿布·叶海亚·阿布·伯克尔二世之女，嫁给马林王朝苏丹阿布·哈桑·阿里·本·奥斯曼，以联姻缔结对抗特莱姆森的同盟。

en: Ibrahim Bey was a son of Alaeddin Pasha by the daughter of Balad, a grandson of Osman I and nephew of Sultan Orhan I. One of Alaeddin's five sons, he is recorded with one son and one daughter.
zh: 易卜拉欣贝伊是阿拉丁帕夏与巴拉德之女所生五子之一，奥斯曼一世之孙、奥尔汗一世之侄。谱系记载他有一子一女。

en: Muhammad Abu al-Dhahab (c. 1735–1775), whose name means father of gold, was a Circassian-born mamluk emir and the chief general of Ali Bey al-Kabir, strongman of Ottoman Egypt. He crushed a revolt in Upper Egypt in 1769, seized the Hejaz in 1770, and with the Palestinian ruler Zahir al-Umar conquered much of Syria and took Damascus. He then turned against Ali Bey, overthrew him in 1773, and ruled Egypt as regent. In 1775 he campaigned again in Palestine but died suddenly of the plague, leaving power to his mamluks Murad Bey and Ibrahim Bey. During the Russo-Turkish War, Ali Bey declared Egypt independent and sought to restore the Mamluk Sultanate.
zh: 穆罕默德·阿布·扎哈卜（约1735—1775），名字意为“黄金之父”，是出身切尔克斯的马木留克埃米尔，后成为奥斯曼埃及强人阿里贝伊麾下的首席将领。1769年他镇压上埃及的叛乱，1770年攻取汉志，又与巴勒斯坦统治者扎希尔·欧麦尔联手，征服叙利亚大部并拿下大马士革。随后他回师反对阿里贝伊，于1773年将其推翻，以摄政身份统治埃及。1775年他再度出征巴勒斯坦，却猝死于鼠疫，权力由他的马木留克穆拉德贝伊和易卜拉欣贝伊继承。俄土战争期间，阿里贝伊宣布埃及独立，试图恢复马木留克苏丹国。

en: Aşıkpaşazade (c. 1400–after 1484), born Dervish Ahmed near Amasya, pen name Aşıkî, was an early Ottoman historian and a dervish of the Vefai order. The great-grandson of the poet Aşık Pasha, he grew up in a Sufi lodge, studied in Anatolian towns, made the hajj in 1437 and spent time in Egypt. He campaigned with the Ottoman army in the Balkans, fighting at Kosovo in 1448 and at the conquest of Constantinople. He also witnessed the circumcision festivities of Mehmed II's sons Mustafa and Bayezid. Late in life he wrote the Tevarih-i Al-i Osman, a vernacular chronicle of the Ottoman dynasty drawing heavily on his own experience; he was still writing in 1484.
zh: 阿什克帕夏扎德（约1400—1484年后），本名德尔维什·艾哈迈德，笔名阿什基，生于阿马西亚附近，是奥斯曼早期历史学家、韦法伊教团的苦行僧。他是诗人阿什克帕夏的曾孙，自幼在道堂长大，曾在安纳托利亚各城求学，1437年赴麦加朝觐，并在埃及停留。此后他随军征战巴尔干，参加了1448年的科索沃之战和君士坦丁堡攻城战，还见证了穆罕默德二世之子穆斯塔法和巴耶济德的割礼庆典。晚年他撰写《奥斯曼家族编年史》，以亲身经历为基础，用通俗土耳其语记述奥斯曼王朝，1484年仍在写作。

en: Ahmed Karamanli (1686–1745) was an Ottoman cavalry officer of Janissary origin who founded the Karamanli dynasty of Tripolitania. As Ottoman control weakened, Tripoli endured civil war and governors who rarely held office for a year. In the 1711 Karamanli coup he murdered the Ottoman governor and seized power, then persuaded the Porte to confirm him as pasha and make the governorship hereditary in his family. Tripoli thereafter acted as an effectively independent kingdom, paying only nominal tribute. He enriched it through corsair raids on Mediterranean shipping; states seeking to protect their vessels paid him tribute. He extended his rule over Fezzan and Cyrenaica before his death in 1745.
zh: 艾哈迈德·卡拉曼利（1686—1745）是奥斯曼骑兵军官，出身耶尼切里，建立了的黎波里塔尼亚的卡拉曼利王朝。随着奥斯曼控制力减弱，的黎波里陷入内战，总督鲜有人能在任一年。1711年，他在政变中杀死奥斯曼总督、夺取政权，随后说服高门承认他为帕夏，并将总督之位改为家族世袭。此后的黎波里仅在名义上纳贡，实际已是独立王国。他靠在地中海航路进行海盗劫掠充实财源，寻求保护船只的国家向他缴纳贡金。他在1745年去世前把统治扩展到费赞和昔兰尼加。

en: Nedîm (c. 1681–1730), pen name of Ahmed Efendi, was the most celebrated Ottoman lyric poet of the Tulip Period, favored at Ahmed III's court by Grand Vizier Nevşehirli Ibrahim Pasha. Rejecting the didactic style of the Nabi school, he wrote fresh, vernacular, often playful love lyrics and brought the folk song forms türkü and şarkı into Divan poetry, founding the manner contemporaries called Nedîmâne. He taught at several madrasas, translated historical works, and served as chief librarian and the sultan's boon companion. He died in 1730; accounts of his death differ, but one says he fell from his roof while fleeing the Patrona Halil rebellion.
zh: 奈迪姆（约1681—1730），本名艾哈迈德埃芬迪，是郁金香时期最负盛名的奥斯曼抒情诗人，在艾哈迈德三世宫廷中受到大维齐尔内夫谢希尔利·易卜拉欣帕夏的庇护。他反对纳比一派说教式的诗风，以清新、口语化、时而戏谑的爱情诗闻名，并把民间歌谣体裁引入迪万诗歌，开创了时人所称的“奈迪姆风格”。他曾在多所经学院执教，翻译历史著作，还担任首席图书馆长和苏丹的清客。他于1730年去世，死因众说纷纭；一种说法称他在躲避帕特罗纳·哈利尔叛乱时从自家屋顶坠亡。

en: Alaeddin Pasha (c. 1281–1331) was a son of Osman I, founder of the Ottoman beylik, by Rabia Bala Hatun, and a half-brother of Orhan. Historians disagree over which brother was older, but Orhan, the better warrior, took the leadership. Later Ottoman princes would fight over succession; Alaeddin submitted without dispute, and the brothers stayed on good terms for life. Tradition portrays him as a stay-at-home trained in state affairs, whom Orhan trusted as adviser; he asked for and received the village of Fodrā. In 1328 or 1329, congratulating Orhan on taking İzmit, he proposed three reforms: silver coinage in the sultan's name, an official dress for officials, a cap of white felt, and an army divided into commanded units with a wartime infantry levy. The infantry scheme failed because the soldiers lacked training. He lived piously and founded mosques, including the Alaeddin Bey Cami in Bursa, finished in 1335. He died in 1331 and lies in Osman I's tomb there.
zh: 阿拉丁帕夏（约1281—1331）是奥斯曼贝伊国创立者奥斯曼一世与拉比娅·巴拉哈屯之子、奥尔汗的异母兄弟。史家对兄弟二人谁年长看法不一，但善战的奥尔汗接过了领导权。后来的奥斯曼王子常为继承权相争，阿拉丁却毫无争议地臣服，兄弟终生和睦。相传他性情安静、留守后方，受过政务训练，是奥尔汗信任的谋臣；他向奥尔汗请求并获赐福德拉村。1328或1329年，他为奥尔汗攻取伊兹密特道贺时提出三项改革：以苏丹名义铸造银币、为官员规定统一官服（白毡帽）、将军队改编为由军官统辖的分队并设立战时步兵征召。由于士兵缺乏训练，步兵方案最终失败。他生活虔诚，修建多座清真寺，包括1335年落成的布尔萨阿拉丁贝伊清真寺。1331年他去世，葬于布尔萨的奥斯曼一世陵中。

en: Ali Bey al-Kabir (1728–1773), known in Turkish as Bulutkapan, the Cloud-Catcher, was a mamluk of Georgian origin who became shaykh al-balad, the effective strongman of Ottoman Egypt. He held the office in 1760–1766, survived exile, and returned to power in 1767. In 1769 he openly defied Istanbul, striking coins in his own name, ending the annual tribute, and conquering the Hejaz and Syria in 1770–1771. His revolt collapsed when his trusted general Abu al-Dahab turned against him; he was defeated near Cairo and died in captivity in May 1773. In 1753 or 1754 he led the annual pilgrimage caravan to Mecca, attacking Bedouin tribes along its route.
zh: 阿里贝伊（1728—1773），土耳其语绰号“捕云者”，是出身格鲁吉亚的马木留克，最终以“城市长老”之位成为奥斯曼埃及的实际强人。他于1760—1766年担任此职，遭流放后又在1767年重新掌权。1769年他公开对抗伊斯坦布尔，以自己的名义铸币、停缴年贡，并于1770—1771年征服汉志与叙利亚。后来他最信任的将领阿布·扎哈卜倒戈，他在开罗附近兵败被俘，1773年5月死于囚中。1753年或1754年，他率领一年一度的麦加朝觐商队，沿途袭击贝都因部族。

en: Asporça Hatun (died after 1362) was a Byzantine Greek noblewoman and the first legal wife of Sultan Orhan. She married Orhan around 1310 and bore him two sons, including Ibrahim Bey born that year, and two daughters, Selçuk and Fatma. Osman I esteemed her and granted her the revenues of numerous villages. In September 1323 she founded a waqf endowing her lands to her descendants, the oldest surviving Ottoman document. Her son Ibrahim was executed by Murad I in 1362, and she was buried in Orhan's tomb in Bursa.
zh: 阿斯波尔恰可敦（1362年后去世）是拜占庭希腊贵族女子，也是苏丹奥尔汗的第一位正妻。她约在1310年嫁给奥尔汗，生下同年出生的易卜拉欣贝伊等两个儿子，以及塞尔柱、法蒂玛两个女儿。奥斯曼一世很看重她，把许多村庄的收入赐给她。1323年9月她设立瓦克夫，把自己土地的收入留给后代，这是现存最早的奥斯曼文书。1362年她的儿子易卜拉欣被穆拉德一世处死，她本人死后葬于布尔萨的奥尔汗陵墓。

en: Ayşe Hatun was a daughter of Alaeddin Pasha, the son of Osman I and brother of Sultan Orhan I, by his wife the daughter of Balad. She was a granddaughter of the Ottoman founder, with two sisters, Taci Hatun and Pasha Hatun.
zh: 艾谢·哈屯是阿拉丁帕夏与妻子巴拉德之女的女儿，奥斯曼一世的孙女、奥尔汗一世的侄女，姐妹为塔吉·哈屯与帕夏·哈屯。

en: Cinci Hoca, meaning the hoca of jinn, was the epithet of Karabaşzade Hüseyin Efendi, an Ottoman witch doctor born in Safranbolu. Kösem Sultan brought him to the palace to treat the mentally troubled Sultan Ibrahim, and the sultan's favor raised him high: in 1643 he became kadi of Galata and in 1644 kazasker of Anatolia, promotions that enraged the ulama. After Ibrahim was deposed in 1648, Grand Vizier Sofu Mehmed Pasha seized his fortune and exiled him toward Damascus; when he railed against the vizier on the road, he was arrested and executed at Mihalcık. Mehmed IV had succeeded Ibrahim, and the vizier needed money for the soldiers' customary accession bonuses.
zh: 金吉·霍贾（意为“精灵的霍贾”）是卡拉巴什扎德·侯赛因埃芬迪的绰号，他是出生于萨夫兰博卢的奥斯曼巫医。柯塞姆苏丹把他召入宫中，为精神失常的易卜拉欣苏丹治病。凭借苏丹宠信，他于1643年出任加拉塔卡迪，1644年升任安纳托利亚军政法官，这些任命激起乌理玛阶层强烈不满。1648年易卜拉欣被废后，大维齐尔索菲·穆罕默德帕夏抄没其家产，将他流放大马士革；途中他在米哈尔哲克抨击大维齐尔，随即被捕处死。穆罕默德四世继承了易卜拉欣的皇位，大维齐尔需要钱支付士兵惯例的即位赏银。

en: Çoban Bey (1283–1337) was an Ottoman prince, a son of Osman I, founder of the Ottoman state. He fought in the long campaign that ended with the conquest of Bursa in 1326 and built a mosque in the captured city. His tomb lies in Bursa's Umurbey quarter, named after him, where the ruins of a madrasa endowed in his name also survive.
zh: 乔班·贝伊（1283—1337）是奥斯曼王子，奥斯曼国家开国者奥斯曼一世之子。他参加了1326年攻克布尔萨的长期战事，并在这座夺取的城市修建了一座清真寺。他的陵墓位于布尔萨以他命名的乌穆尔贝伊街区，附近还存有以他名义修建的经学院遗址。

en: Enderûnlu Fâzıl (c. 1757–1810) was an Ottoman poet born Hüseyin in Acre or Safed, a grandson of the Palestinian strongman Ẓāhir al-ʿUmar. After his family's revolt against the Ottomans collapsed in 1776, he was taken to Constantinople and schooled in the Enderun palace academy, from which he was expelled in 1783, possibly over love affairs. He spent several years in poverty before Sultan Selim III made him a bey and waqf administrator. His satirical verse brought exile to Rhodes in 1799, where he went blind. Allowed to return to Constantinople, he continued writing poetry for the imperial elite. He is remembered for his erotic poetry books Hubanname and Zenanname, the latter banned in the Ottoman Empire. He died in 1810 and was buried in Eyüp.
zh: 恩德伦卢·法齐勒（约1757—1810）是奥斯曼诗人，原名侯赛因，生于阿卡或萨法德，是巴勒斯坦强人扎希尔·欧麦尔的孙子。1776年家族反抗奥斯曼的叛乱失败后，他被带往君士坦丁堡，在恩德伦宫廷学校受训，1783年被逐，可能与风流韵事有关。他贫困度日数年，后来塞利姆三世封他为贝伊、任命为瓦合甫管理人。讽刺诗作使他于1799年被流放罗得岛，并在那里失明。获准返回君士坦丁堡后，他继续为帝国精英写诗。他以色情诗集《美少年书》和《女子书》闻名，后者在奥斯曼帝国遭禁。1810年他去世，葬于埃于普。

en: Ertuğrul Gazi (died c. 1280) was a Turkish marcher lord on the Byzantine frontier and the father of Osman I, founder of the Ottoman dynasty; a coin struck under Osman calls himself Osman son of Ertuğrul. Ottoman tradition, written down over a century later, makes him a Kayı chieftain who entered the service of the Seljuk sultan Kayqubad I. For fighting the Byzantines he received lands at Karaca Dağ and later the frontier town of Söğüt, which became the first Ottoman capital under Osman. He died at Söğüt around 1280, where his tomb remains an Ottoman shrine.
zh: 埃尔图鲁尔加齐（?—约1280）是拜占庭边境上的突厥边疆领主，也是奥斯曼王朝创立者奥斯曼一世之父；奥斯曼时期铸有一枚钱币，铭文自称“埃尔图鲁尔之子奥斯曼”，可证他确有其人。据一个多世纪后才成书的奥斯曼传统说法，他是卡耶部首领，曾投效鲁姆塞尔柱苏丹凯库巴德一世，因对拜占庭作战而获赐卡拉贾达格之地，后来又得到边境城镇瑟于特。瑟于特在奥斯曼治下成为奥斯曼人最初的都城。约1280年他卒于瑟于特，当地其陵墓成为奥斯曼的圣地。

en: Esmâ Ibret Hanim (1780 – c. 1830) was an Ottoman calligrapher and poet, born in Istanbul, the only child of palace official Ahmed Ağa. Her father showed her early writing to friends, who were astonished to learn that his daughter had produced it. From the age of ten she trained at the Sheikh Murad Dervish Lodge, mastering the sülüs-nesih script in the tradition of Hâfiz Osman, and received the title İbret at sixteen. Her master Mahmud Celaleddin Efendi, at first unwilling to teach a woman, accepted her after seeing her work and later married her. A hilye she presented to Sultan Selim III and his mother earned her a grant of 500 kuruş and a daily allowance. She was buried beside her husband in Istanbul.
zh: 埃斯玛·伊布雷特·哈内姆（1780—约1830）是奥斯曼女书法家、诗人，生于伊斯坦布尔，是宫廷官员艾哈迈德阿加之独女。父亲曾将她早年的字迹展示给友人，众人得知出自他女儿之手后十分惊讶。她十岁起在谢赫·穆拉德德尔维希道堂习字，宗法哈菲兹·奥斯曼的苏鲁斯—纳西赫字体，十六岁获“伊布雷特”称号。她的老师马哈茂德·贾拉莱丁·埃芬迪起初不愿收女弟子，见到她的作品后改变主意，后来更与她成婚。她进献给塞利姆三世及其母亲的一幅希利耶为她赢得500库鲁什的赏金和每日津贴。她葬在伊斯坦布尔丈夫的墓旁。

en: Fatma Hatun (1284–1347), born in Söğüt, was a daughter of Osman I, founder of the Ottoman beylik, and a sister of Sultan Orhan. She died in Bursa in 1347 and was buried in the türbe of Ertuğrul in Söğüt.
zh: 法蒂玛·哈屯（1284—1347）生于瑟于特，是奥斯曼贝伊国创立者奥斯曼一世的女儿、苏丹奥尔汗的姐妹。她于1347年在布尔萨去世，葬于瑟于特的埃尔图鲁尔陵。

en: Fatma Hatun was a daughter of Orhan I and his first wife Asporça Hatun, a Byzantine noblewoman. Her full siblings included Ibrahim Bey, governor of Eskişehir, and Selçuk Hatun, wife of the Aydınid prince Süleyman Bey. She was buried in her father's tomb at Bursa.
zh: 法特玛·哈屯是奥尔汗一世与首位妻子、拜占庭贵族出身的阿斯波尔恰·哈屯之女。她的同母兄弟有埃斯基谢希尔总督易卜拉欣贝伊，同母姐妹塞尔柱·哈屯嫁给艾登王朝的苏莱曼贝伊。她死后葬于布尔萨的奥尔汗陵寝。

en: Fitnat Hanım (died 1780) was the pen name of Zübeyde, regarded as the foremost woman poet of the Ottoman Divan school. Born in Istanbul into a family of religious scholars, she was the daughter of Ebu İshakzade Mehmet Esad Efendi, şeyhülislam under Mahmud I. Her grandfather İshak Efendi and brother Mehmed Şerif Efendi were both scholars and poets. Her marriage to Derviş Mehmet Efendi, a kazasker of Rumeli, proved unhappy and stifled her writing. Admired in the capital's literary circles, she exchanged poems with Grand Vizier Koca Ragıp Pasha. Some of her poems were translated into Western languages in the nineteenth century, when the poet Muallim Naci called her the queen of poets.
zh: 菲特娜特·哈内姆（？—1780）是女诗人祖贝达的笔名，被视为奥斯曼迪万诗派最重要的女诗人。她生于伊斯坦布尔的宗教学者世家，父亲是马哈茂德一世时期的谢赫伊斯兰埃布·伊沙克扎德·穆罕默德·埃萨德埃芬迪，祖父伊沙克埃芬迪和兄长穆罕默德·谢里夫埃芬迪都是学者兼诗人。她嫁给鲁米利亚的卡兹阿斯克尔，即军事法官，德尔维什·穆罕默德埃芬迪，婚姻并不幸福，束缚了她的创作。她在首都文坛备受推崇，曾与大维齐尔科贾·拉格普帕夏唱和。她的部分诗作在19世纪被译成西方语言，同一世纪的诗人穆阿利姆·纳吉称她为“诗人女王”。

en: François Baron de Tott (1733–1793) was a French officer of Hungarian descent who became a key Ottoman military reformer. He went to Constantinople in 1755 as secretary to the French ambassador, his uncle Vergennes, learning Turkish and gathering information on the Crimean Khanate. He served as consul in Crimea from 1767, working to turn the Tatars against Russia. During the Russo-Turkish War of 1768–1774 the Porte tasked him with defending the Dardanelles. He built a howitzer foundry and mobile artillery units, fortified the Bosphorus, and began the naval science course that grew into the Ottoman naval school. After the French Revolution he moved to Switzerland and later returned to Hungary, where he died in 1793.
zh: 弗朗索瓦·德·托特男爵（1733—1793）是匈牙利裔法国军官，曾受奥斯曼政府聘请改革军队。他1755年随叔父、法国大使韦尔热讷前往君士坦丁堡担任秘书，学习土耳其语并搜集克里米亚汗国的情报。1767年起他任驻克里米亚领事，策动鞑靼人对抗俄国。1768—1774年俄土战争期间，奥斯曼政府委托他防守达达尼尔海峡。他修建榴弹炮铸造厂、组建机动炮兵部队，加固博斯普鲁斯海峡防务，并开设海军科学课程，为后来的奥斯曼海军学校奠定基础。法国大革命后他移居瑞士，后来回到匈牙利，于1793年在那里去世。

en: Fülan Bey (born before 1281) was a son of Osman I by Fülane Hatun. After Ertuğrul's peace with Seljuk sultan Kaykhusraw III, he was raised at the Seljuk court. His sons Ahmed, Bayad and Halil left descendants recorded under Bayezid I.
zh: 富兰·贝伊（1281年前出生）是奥斯曼一世与芙拉内·可敦之子。埃尔图鲁尔与塞尔柱苏丹吉亚苏丁三世·凯胡斯鲁议和后，他在塞尔柱宫廷长大。其子艾哈迈德、巴亚德、哈利勒的后裔到巴耶济德一世时仍有记载。

en: Hâfiz Osman (1642–1698), born in Istanbul, was one of the most celebrated Ottoman calligraphers. Trained by Derviş Ali and Suyolcuzade Mustafa Eyyubi in the tradition of Şeyh Hamdullah, and patronised by Köprülü Fazıl Mustafa Pasha, he belonged to the Sünbüliye dervish order. He revitalised Ottoman calligraphic scripts and created the classical layout for the hilye, a calligraphic depiction of the Prophet Muhammad's appearance and character based on the hadith, which became the empire-wide standard. He taught penmanship to the future sultans Mustafa II and Ahmed III. His Qur'ans and hilyes are preserved in the Topkapı Palace collections, and he died in Istanbul on 3 December 1698.
zh: 哈菲兹·奥斯曼（1642—1698），生于伊斯坦布尔，是奥斯曼帝国最负盛名的书法家之一。他师承德尔维什·阿里与苏约尔库扎德·穆斯塔法·埃尤比，上承谢赫·哈姆杜拉的传统，受到克普吕吕·法泽尔·穆斯塔法帕夏的庇护，属于苏恩布利耶托钵僧教团。他革新了奥斯曼书法字体，还为“希利耶”——依据圣训以书法表现先知穆罕默德外貌与品格的图样——确立了经典版式，成为通行全帝国的标准。他曾教授后来成为苏丹的穆斯塔法二世与艾哈迈德三世书法。他抄写的《古兰经》和希利耶作品现藏于托普卡帕宫，他本人于1698年12月3日在伊斯坦布尔去世。

en: Halil Bey (c. 1347–1362) was an Ottoman prince, the only son of Sultan Orhan by his Byzantine wife Theodora Kantakouzene, daughter of Emperor John VI. In 1357 pirates seized him near İzmit and carried him to Phocaea, whose governor held him for a ransom of a hundred thousand hyperpyra. Orhan paid in 1358 and promised to end his raids on Byzantine lands and abandon Matthew Kantakouzenos. In 1359 Halil married his cousin Irene, young daughter of Emperor John V Palaiologos. After Orhan's death, his half-brother Murad I had him executed in 1362.
zh: 哈利勒贝伊（约1347—1362）是奥斯曼王子，为奥尔汗贝伊与拜占庭公主塞奥多拉·坎塔库泽努斯（皇帝约翰六世之女）唯一的儿子。1357年，海盗在伊兹密特附近将他掳走，押到福西亚，当地总督将他扣押，索要10万枚海佩伦金币赎金。1358年，奥尔罕付清赎金，并承诺停止袭掠拜占庭领土、不再支持马修·坎塔库泽努斯。1359年，哈利勒迎娶表亲——皇帝约翰五世·帕里奥洛格斯年幼的女儿伊琳娜。奥尔罕死后，他于1362年被异母兄穆拉德一世处死。

en: Hamid Bey (c. 1288–1329) was an Ottoman prince, the son of Osman I and Rabia Bala Hatun, daughter of Sheikh Edebali. He appears with his brothers among the witnesses of an early Ottoman waqf charter and was buried at Söğüt.
zh: 哈米德·贝伊（约1288—1329）是奥斯曼王子，奥斯曼一世与谢赫·艾德巴利之女拉比雅·芭拉可敦之子。他与兄弟们一同列名于一份早期奥斯曼瓦克夫文书的证人之中，葬于瑟于特。

en: Ḥassan Pasha (1657–1723) was a Georgian-origin Ottoman commander who founded the Mamluk dynasty of Iraq. A veteran of the wars against Iran, he was appointed vali of Baghdad on 16 June 1704 with a mandate to restore order. He subdued the unruly Arab and Kurdish tribes, curbed the Janissaries by raising Georgian and Circassian Mamluk troops, and remitted regular revenues to Istanbul. In 1705 he visited Karbala, ordered its channels cleaned and restored a caravanserai on the road to Najaf. He built schools and mosques, including the renewal of the Abbasid al-Sarai Mosque. He died in 1723 and was buried in al-A'dhamiyya; his son Ahmad Pasha succeeded him, and the Mamluk regime lasted until 1831.
zh: 哈桑帕夏（1657—1723）是格鲁吉亚裔奥斯曼将领，伊拉克马穆鲁克政权的建立者。他曾在对伊朗的战争中长期征战，1704年6月16日被任命为巴格达总督，受命恢复秩序。他平定作乱的阿拉伯和库尔德部落，编练格鲁吉亚和切尔克斯马穆鲁克军队以压制耶尼切里，按时向伊斯坦布尔解缴税款。1705年他到访卡尔巴拉，下令清理水渠，并修复通往纳杰夫路上的一座商队驿站。他兴建学校、修缮清真寺，包括翻修阿拔斯时代的萨拉伊清真寺。他1723年去世，葬于阿宰米耶，其子艾哈迈德帕夏继任，开创的马穆鲁克政权一直延续到1831年。

en: Hizir Bey was one of the five sons of Alaeddin Pasha, a son of Osman I, by his wife the daughter of Balad. He was a nephew of Sultan Orhan I and had children.
zh: 赫泽尔贝伊是阿拉丁帕夏与妻子巴拉德之女所生五子之一，奥斯曼一世之孙、奥尔汗一世之侄。他有子嗣。

en: İbrahim Bey (c. 1310–1362) was the eldest son of Sultan Orhan by his Byzantine-born wife Asporça Hatun. In the waqf his mother founded in September 1323, the oldest surviving Ottoman document, he was named administrator of her landed endowments. He later served as governor of Eskişehir. After Orhan's death in 1362, he and his sons were put to death on the order of his half-brother, the new sultan Murad I, and he was buried in Osman I's tomb in Bursa.
zh: 易卜拉欣贝伊（约1310—1362）是奥尔汗苏丹与其出身拜占庭贵族的妻子阿斯波尔恰·哈顿的长子。1323年9月其母设立瓦克夫——现存最早的奥斯曼文书——时，指定他管理赐地收入。他后来出任埃斯基谢希尔总督。1362年奥尔汗死后，他与诸子被异母弟、新苏丹穆拉德一世下令处死，葬于布尔萨的奥斯曼一世陵墓。

en: İbrahim Müteferrika (1674–1745) was an Ottoman diplomat, scholar and printer. Born into a Hungarian Unitarian family in Kolozsvár in Transylvania, he converted to Islam and served the Sublime Porte as a diplomat. Hebrew presses had long operated in the empire when, in 1726, he petitioned Sultan Ahmed III for leave to print non-religious books in Arabic script. With the court's firman he opened Istanbul's first Muslim-run press using movable Arabic type. Over two decades he issued twenty-three volumes, beginning with a Turkish-Arabic dictionary and including an atlas and works of history and science. He died in Istanbul in 1745.
zh: 易卜拉欣·穆特费里卡（1674—1745）是奥斯曼帝国的外交官、学者与印刷家。他出生于特兰西瓦尼亚科洛兹堡的一个匈牙利人一位论派家庭，后改宗伊斯兰教，在高门担任外交官。帝国境内的希伯来文印刷所已存在许久，1726年他奏请艾哈迈德三世苏丹准许以阿拉伯字母印制非宗教书籍。凭借宫廷颁布的敕令，他在伊斯坦布尔开办了第一家由穆斯林经营、使用阿拉伯文活字的印刷所。此后约20年间他印行了23卷书，第一部是土耳其语—阿拉伯语词典，其余包括地图集以及历史与科学著作。他于1745年在伊斯坦布尔去世。

en: İlyas Bey was a son of Pazarlı Bey and a grandson of Osman I. His brother was Murad Bey.
zh: 伊利亚斯贝伊是帕扎尔利贝伊之子、奥斯曼一世之孙，他的兄弟是穆拉德贝伊。

en: Imadaddin Nasimi (c. 1369–c. 1419) was an Azerbaijani Turkic poet and the foremost voice of Hurufi mysticism. In Tabriz he became a disciple and successor of Fazlallah Astarabadi, founder of the Hurufi movement. After Astarabadi was executed, Nasimi carried the doctrine through Anatolia, where he was rejected at Bursa and by the Sufi Haji Bayram Veli, before settling in Aleppo. There his Persian and Azerbaijani divans won him many followers and the hostility of Sunni ulama; around 1418–19 the Mamluk sultan al-Mu'ayyad Shaykh had him executed as a heretic, and he was buried at an Aleppo dervish lodge. His poetry conveyed Hurufi teachings, in which sacred knowledge rested on letters and the divine was revealed in the human face.
zh: 伊马达丁·纳西米（约1369—约1419）是阿塞拜疆突厥裔诗人，胡鲁菲神秘主义最重要的代言人。他在大不里士成为胡鲁菲运动创始人法兹拉拉·阿斯塔拉巴迪的弟子和继承人。阿斯塔拉巴迪被处死后，纳西米辗转安纳托利亚传播其教义，在布尔萨和苏菲圣徒哈吉·巴伊拉姆·韦利处都遭拒绝，最后落脚阿勒颇。在那里，他的波斯语和阿塞拜疆语诗集为他赢得众多信众，也招致逊尼派乌理玛的敌视；约1418—1419年，马木留克苏丹穆艾叶德·谢赫将他以异端罪名处死，葬于阿勒颇的一座苦行僧道堂。他以诗歌传播胡鲁菲教义：这一教义以文字为神圣知识的基础，认为人脸显现神性。

en: Kadızade Mehmed Efendi (1582–1635) was an Ottoman Islamic preacher born in Balıkesir and the founder of the Kadızadeli movement. As a young man he tried to join a Sufi brotherhood but rejected its teachings and turned to preaching. His powerful rhetoric made him famous, and in 1631 he was appointed preacher at the Hagia Sophia mosque in Istanbul, where he blamed the empire's disorders on deviation from the Sharia and roused crowds against the Sufi orders. He backed Murad IV's tobacco ban. When challenged that God had not forbidden tobacco or coffee, he argued that the ruler's prohibition was sufficient. He died in Istanbul in 1635, leaving a movement that shaped Ottoman religious politics for decades.
zh: 卡迪扎德·穆罕默德埃芬迪（1582—1635）是奥斯曼帝国的伊斯兰宣教师，生于巴勒克埃西尔，为卡迪扎德派运动的创始人。他年轻时曾试图加入苏菲教团，却因反对其教义转而从事宣教。他凭借雄辩的言辞声名鹊起，于1631年被任命为伊斯坦布尔圣索菲亚清真寺的宣教师，在任上他将帝国的乱象归咎于背离沙里亚法，并煽动信众反对苏菲教团。他坚决支持穆拉德四世的禁烟令；有人指出真主并未禁止烟草和咖啡时，他认为统治者的禁令已足以禁止它们。他于1635年在伊斯坦布尔去世，其发起的运动在此后数十年深刻影响了奥斯曼的宗教政治。

en: Kasım Bey was a son of Sultan Orhan. He died young in 1346 and was buried in Bursa.
zh: 卡西姆贝伊是奥尔汗苏丹之子，1346年早逝，葬于布尔萨。

en: Kemal Reis (c. 1451–1511), born Ahmed Kemaleddin in Manisa, was an Ottoman privateer and admiral, and the paternal uncle of the cartographer Piri Reis, who accompanied him on many important expeditions. In 1487 Bayezid II sent him to support the Nasrid emir of Granada; he raided Málaga and the Andalusian coast and between 1490 and 1492 ferried fleeing Muslims and Jews to Ottoman lands. He later commanded fleets against Venice and the Knights of St. John. In 1507 he carried oars and cannon to Egypt for the Mamluk sultan's struggle against the Portuguese; in 1509 he assaulted Rhodes. In early 1511, while escorting a supply convoy to Egypt, he perished with twenty-seven ships in a Mediterranean storm.
zh: 凱末爾·雷斯（约1451—1511），本名艾哈迈德·凯末尔丁，生于马尼萨，是奥斯曼帝国的私掠船长与海军将领，也是制图师皮瑞·雷斯的叔父，皮瑞曾随他参加多次重要远航。1487年，巴耶济德二世派他支援格拉纳达的纳斯尔王朝埃米尔，他袭击马拉加和安达卢西亚海岸，并在1490至1492年间把出逃的穆斯林和犹太人运往奥斯曼领土。此后他率舰队同威尼斯和圣约翰骑士团作战。1507年，他将船桨和火炮运到埃及，供马穆鲁克苏丹对抗葡萄牙人；1509年，他进攻罗得岛。1511年初，他在护送补给船队前往埃及时，与27艘船一同葬身于地中海风暴。

en: Kemankeş Kara Mustafa Pasha (1592–1644) was an Ottoman commander and grand vizier. Born to an Albanian family at Vlorë, he rose through the Janissary corps and was famed as an archer; his epithet Kemankeş means bow-puller. Deputy commander in 1634, he became Agha of the Janissaries in 1635 and Kapudan Pasha, the grand admiral, later that year. He fought at the capture of Baghdad in 1638, and after the grand vizier died during the siege, Murad IV appointed him as his successor. Under Sultan Ibrahim he concentrated power in his own hands, until a palace faction led by Kösem Sultan secured his dismissal and his execution on 31 January 1644.
zh: 凯曼凯什·卡拉·穆斯塔法帕夏（1592—1644）是奥斯曼帝国的军事统帅与大维齐尔。他出身于发罗拉的阿尔巴尼亚人家庭，在禁卫军中崛起，以箭术闻名，绰号“凯曼凯什”意为拉弓手。他于1634年成为禁卫军副指挥官，1635年升任禁卫军阿迦，同年晚些时候出任卡普丹帕夏，即海军大元帅。他参加了1638年攻取巴格达之役，大维齐尔在围城期间阵亡后，穆拉德四世任命他继任。在易卜拉欣苏丹在位期间他总揽朝政，最终以柯塞姆苏丹为首的宫廷派系促成他被解职，并于1644年1月31日被处决。

en: Kılıç Bey was a son of Alaeddin Pasha by the daughter of Balad, a grandson of Osman I and nephew of Sultan Orhan I. He was one of Alaeddin's five sons and is recorded as having children of his own.
zh: 克勒奇贝伊是阿拉丁帕夏与巴拉德之女所生五子之一，奥斯曼一世之孙、奥尔汗一世之侄。谱系记载他留有子嗣。

en: Koca Mehmet Ragıp Pasha (1698–1763) was an Ottoman statesman, diplomat and poet. His father Şevki Mustafa was an Ottoman bureaucrat, and his epithet Koca meant great or giant. After serving as a treasury official in Baghdad he joined the delegation that made the Treaty of Belgrade in 1739, became reis ül-küttab, the empire's chief scribe, in 1740, and governed Egypt from 1744 to 1748, when local troops forced him to step down. Appointed grand vizier in 1757, he served Sultans Osman III and Mustafa III for six years, reforming finance and administration and keeping the empire neutral in the Seven Years' War. Married to Princess Saliha Sultan, he exchanged verses with the poetess Fıtnat Hanım, and died in Istanbul on 8 April 1763.
zh: 科贾·穆罕默德·拉格普帕夏（1698—1763）是奥斯曼帝国的政治家、外交官与诗人。他的父亲谢夫基·穆斯塔法是奥斯曼官员，他的绰号“科贾”意为伟大或巨人。他曾在巴格达担任财政官，1739年作为奥斯曼代表团成员参与签订《贝尔格莱德条约》，1740年升任“雷斯·库塔布”，即帝国首席文书，1744至1748年出任埃及总督，后因当地军队的压力而卸任。1757年他被任命为大维齐尔，侍奉奥斯曼三世与穆斯塔法三世两任苏丹达六年，整顿财政与行政，并使帝国在七年战争期间保持中立。他娶萨利哈苏丹公主为妻，本人也作诗，曾与女诗人菲特娜特·哈内姆唱和。他于1763年4月8日在伊斯坦布尔去世。

en: Mahmud Celaleddin Efendi (c. 1750–1829) was an Ottoman calligrapher. Born in Dagestan in the Caucasus, he moved to Istanbul as a boy with his father. He left his teacher Abdullatif Efendi after a disagreement over style and taught himself by studying the work of the great seventeenth-century master Hâfiz Osman, developing strong, assured versions of the sülüs and naskh scripts. He left monumental inscriptions at the Eyüp Sultan imaret and the tomb of Mihrişah Sultan, and Sultan Abdülmecid was his pupil. At first he doubted that the young Esmâ Ibret Hanim had written the samples shown to him; after investigating, he accepted her as a student and later married her. He died in Istanbul in 1829.
zh: 马哈茂德·杰拉勒丁埃芬迪（约1750—1829）是奥斯曼帝国书法家。他生于高加索的达吉斯坦，幼年随父亲迁居伊斯坦布尔。他最初师从阿卜杜勒·拉蒂夫埃芬迪，因风格不合而中止学业，此后主要靠研习17世纪大师哈菲兹·奥斯曼的作品自学，形成了刚健沉稳的苏卢斯与纳斯赫字体风格。他为艾郁普苏丹清真寺的施粥场和米赫丽莎苏丹陵留下了多处纪念性铭文，苏丹阿卜杜勒-迈吉德也曾是他的学生。他起初怀疑呈给他的书法样本并非年轻的埃斯玛·伊卜雷特·哈内姆所写，经查证后收她为徒，后来与她成婚。他于1829年在伊斯坦布尔去世。

en: Malhun Hatun (died after 1326), also called Mal Hatun, was the first wife of Osman I, founder of the Ottoman dynasty, and the mother of his successor, Orhan. Long tradition, following the Ottoman chroniclers, made her the daughter of Sheikh Edebali, but a 1324 endowment deed issued by Orhan names his mother as Mal Hatun, daughter of an Umar or Ömer Bey. She was probably buried in the family mausoleum around Osman's tomb at Bursa, in one of its unidentified sarcophagi, having lived into the late 1320s.
zh: 玛尔可敦（?—1326年后）又译玛尔·哈通，是奥斯曼王朝创立者奥斯曼一世的第一位妻子，也是继位者奥尔汗的生母。奥斯曼史官历来传说她是谢赫·埃德巴利之女，但奥尔汗于1324年为一座德尔维希修道院颁发的捐赠地契写明，其母名玛尔·哈通，是厄梅尔贝伊之女。她可能活到1320年代末，葬在布尔萨奥斯曼陵墓周围的家族墓园里，具体棺椁已不可考。

en: Sedefkar Mehmed Agha (c. 1540–1617) was an Ottoman architect and the last pupil of the great master builder Mimar Sinan. Recruited through the devshirme in 1563, he spent twenty years working mother-of-pearl inlay, which earned him the name Sedefkar, before joining Sinan's architectural office. He completed the Muradiye Mosque at Manisa after 1586 and in 1606 was appointed chief imperial architect. From 1609 to 1616 he built his masterpiece, the Sultan Ahmed Mosque in Istanbul, known as the Blue Mosque. He died in Istanbul in 1617.
zh: 赛德夫哈尔·穆罕默德阿加（约1540—1617）是奥斯曼建筑师、建筑大师米马尔·希南最后的学生。1563年他通过德夫希尔梅被征募，从事螺钿镶嵌二十年，由此得到“赛德夫哈尔”之名，后来进入希南的建筑事务所。1586年后，他主持完成了马尼萨的穆拉迪耶清真寺，1606年被任命为首席宫廷建筑师。1609至1616年，他建成自己的代表作——伊斯坦布尔的苏丹艾哈迈德清真寺，即蓝色清真寺。1617年，他在伊斯坦布尔去世。

en: Mehmed Tahir Ağa was an Ottoman architect and chief imperial architect, mimarbaşı, under Mustafa III. At the age of twelve he accompanied his father on campaigns against Russia and Austria under Mahmud I. First appointed chief architect in 1761, he headed the palace builders three times between 1761 and 1784 and was one of the masters of the Ottoman baroque style. During Mustafa III's great building campaign in Istanbul he led the reconstruction of the Fatih Mosque, designed the sultan's tomb and planned mosques and fortress repairs across the empire. In 1788, under Abdülhamid I, he supervised bridge works near Fethül İslam on the Austrian campaign, and died in 1788.
zh: 穆罕默德·塔希尔阿迦是奥斯曼帝国建筑师，穆斯塔法三世时期的首席宫廷建筑师，即米马尔巴舍。马哈茂德一世在位时，他12岁便随父参加对俄国和奥地利的战役。他于1761年首次受命出任首席建筑师，此后三度担任，任期都在1761至1784年之间，是奥斯曼巴洛克风格的代表建筑师之一。在穆斯塔法三世于伊斯坦布尔大兴土木期间，他主持重建法提赫清真寺，设计苏丹的陵寝，并筹划帝国各地的清真寺与要塞修缮。1788年，他在阿卜杜勒-哈米德一世治下，于对奥地利的战争中督办费特赫伊斯兰附近的桥梁工程，并于同年去世。

en: Melek Hatun was a daughter of the Ottoman prince Melik Bey, a son of Osman I. Historian Vedat Turgut identified her as the Paşa-Melek Hatun who married Murad, son of Sultan Orhan, and suggested that her father was known as Kızıl Murad. Orhan gave the villages of Koçi and Adaöyük to Kızıl Murad's son, and they passed to Paşa-Melek. She made them a family waqf and later directed their revenues to the Gazi Murad hospice. Her grandson Murad held the property before it passed out of the family's control.
zh: 梅莱克·哈屯是奥斯曼王子梅利克贝伊之女，其父是奥斯曼一世之子。历史学家韦达特·图尔古特认为她就是嫁给奥尔汗苏丹之子穆拉德的帕夏-梅莱克·哈屯，并推测其父又称克孜勒·穆拉德。奥尔汗把科奇和阿达厄于克两村赐给克孜勒·穆拉德之子，两村后来转到帕夏-梅莱克名下。她将其立为家族瓦克夫，后来规定收入拨归加齐·穆拉德济贫院。她的孙子穆拉德曾掌管这份产业，后来产业脱离了家族控制。

en: Mihrî Hatun (1456/1460–c. 1506), born Mihrünnisa in Amasya, was one of the earliest Turkish women poets whose name survives, together with Zeynep Hatun. Her father was a qadi who wrote verse under the pen name Belayi. She spent most of her life in or near Amasya and joined the literary circle of Şehzade Ahmed, son of Bayezid II. She was reputed to have fallen in love several times, though her loves were said to have been chaste; she never married. Her witty, polished qasidas and ghazals of love and gallantry won renown in her own lifetime, and later readers called her the Sappho of the Ottomans.
zh: 米赫里·哈屯（1456/1460—约1506），本名米赫伦尼萨，生于阿马西亚，是与宰娜卜·哈屯齐名、名字流传至今的最早一批土耳其女诗人之一。她的父亲是一名卡迪，曾以贝拉伊为笔名写诗。她一生大部分时间住在阿马西亚或附近，加入了巴耶济德二世之子艾哈迈德王子的文学圈子。相传她曾多次坠入爱河，但这些感情都是纯洁的；她终身未嫁。她所作的颂诗和加泽尔情诗机智而精巧，在世时即享有盛名，后世读者称她为奥斯曼人的萨福。

en: Mimar Sinan (c. 1488/1490–1588), born near Kayseri, the son of a stonemason, became a Janissary military engineer, building fortifications, roads, bridges and aqueducts on the sultans' campaigns. Conscripted into Ottoman service in 1512, he built ships for the army to cross Lake Van during the Persian campaign of 1535. Around the age of fifty he was made chief royal architect, and for nearly fifty years served Suleiman the Magnificent, Selim II and Murad III. Over three hundred major buildings are attributed to him, including the Süleymaniye Mosque in Istanbul, the Selimiye Mosque in Edirne and the bridges at Büyükçekmece and Višegrad; his pupils later built the Sultan Ahmed Mosque and the Stari Most. He died in Istanbul in 1588.
zh: 米马尔·希南（约1488/1490—1588）生于开塞利附近，父亲是石匠。他被征入耶尼切里军团，成长为军事工程师，在历代苏丹的征战中修筑工事、道路、桥梁和渡槽。1512年他被征入奥斯曼军队，1535年波斯战役中，他造船供军队横渡凡湖。年约五旬时，他被任命为皇家首席建筑师，先后侍奉苏莱曼大帝、塞利姆二世和穆拉德三世近五十年。他名下有三百多座重要建筑，包括伊斯坦布尔的苏莱曼尼耶清真寺、埃迪尔内的塞利米耶清真寺，以及大切克梅杰桥和维舍格勒桥；他的弟子后来设计了苏丹艾哈迈德清真寺和莫斯塔尔古桥。1588年，他在伊斯坦布尔去世。

en: Mimar Sinan (c. 1488/1490–1588) was chief architect of the Ottoman Empire. A stonemason's son from Ağırnas near Kayseri, he was conscripted into Ottoman service in 1512 and learned engineering as a Janissary officer on campaign. In 1535 he built ships for the army to cross Lake Van during the Persian campaign. Suleiman the Magnificent named him chief royal architect around the age of fifty. He held the post under three sultans and designed more than three hundred monuments, among them Istanbul's Süleymaniye Mosque, the great domed Selimiye Mosque at Edirne, which he called his masterpiece, and the Sulaymaniyya Takiyya that introduced the Ottoman style to Damascus. He died in Istanbul in 1588 and lies buried beside the Süleymaniye.
zh: 米马尔·希南（约1488/1490—1588）是奥斯曼帝国的首席建筑师。他是开塞利附近阿伊尔纳斯一名石匠之子，1512年被征入奥斯曼军队，以耶尼切里军官身份在征战中掌握了工程技艺。1535年波斯战役中，他造船供军队横渡凡湖。约五旬时，他被苏莱曼大帝任命为皇家首席建筑师。他历事三任苏丹，设计了三百多处纪念性建筑，包括伊斯坦布尔的苏莱曼尼耶清真寺、埃迪尔内巨穹顶的塞利米耶清真寺（他自称的毕生杰作），以及把奥斯曼建筑风格引入大马士革的苏莱曼尼耶建筑群。1588年他在伊斯坦布尔去世，葬在苏莱曼尼耶清真寺旁。

en: Moses Hamon (c. 1490–1554), born in Granada, was the son of Joseph Hamon and fled with him to Constantinople, where he became personal physician to Suleiman the Magnificent, accompanying the sultan on every campaign. Versed in Arabic, Turkish and Persian, he patronised Jewish learning, printed Hebrew books in Constantinople as early as 1515 and founded a school led by Joseph Taitazak. After a blood libel against the Jews of Amasya around 1545, he persuaded Suleiman to reserve such charges for the royal court. In 1546 he paid for the printing of Persian and Arabic translations of the Pentateuch, and he was often called on to settle disputes within the empire's Jewish communities.
zh: 摩西·哈蒙（约1490—1554）生于格拉纳达，是约瑟夫·哈蒙之子，随父亲逃到君士坦丁堡，后来成为苏莱曼大帝的贴身御医，随苏丹参加每一次远征。他通晓阿拉伯语、土耳其语和波斯语，襄助犹太学术，早在1515年便在君士坦丁堡印制希伯来文书籍，还出资创办了由约瑟夫·泰塔扎克主持的学校。约1545年阿马西亚的犹太人遭血祭诬陷后，他促使苏莱曼下令此类指控只能由御前法庭审理。1546年，他出资印行《摩西五经》的波斯语和阿拉伯语译本，还常受委托调处帝国犹太人社群内部的纠纷。

en: Mehmed Bey was a son of Alaeddin Pasha and his wife the daughter of Balad, a grandson of Osman I and nephew of Sultan Orhan I. He was one of Alaeddin's five sons, and genealogical records give him one son and one daughter.
zh: 穆罕默德贝伊是阿拉丁帕夏与妻子巴拉德之女之子，奥斯曼一世之孙、奥尔汗一世之侄，阿拉丁五个儿子之一。谱系记载他有一子一女。

en: Köprülü Mehmed Pasha (c. 1575–1661) was an Albanian-born Ottoman statesman and founder of the Köprülü dynasty of grand viziers. He rose through imperial service to pasha rank, governing Trebizond from 1644 and later the provinces of Eğri, Karaman and Anatolia. In September 1656 Valide Sultan Turhan appointed him grand vizier amid naval defeat and court plots, granting him sweeping powers. The Venetian blockade of the Dardanelles had cut off supplies to Ottoman forces in Crete. In 1657 he suppressed a cavalry revolt in Constantinople and broke the blockade, reopening the sea route. He purged corrupt officials and campaigned in Transylvania in 1658. He died in Edirne in 1661, having secured the vizierate for his son Fazıl Ahmed.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/科普魯律·穆罕默德帕夏
zh: 科普鲁律·穆罕默德帕夏（约1575—1661）是阿尔巴尼亚裔奥斯曼政治家，科普鲁律大维齐尔世家的开创者。他在帝国体制内逐步升迁至帕夏，1644年出任特拉布宗总督，其后又历任埃格里、卡拉曼和安纳托利亚总督。1656年9月，皇太后图尔汗在海军惨败、宫廷谋叛之际任命他为大维齐尔，授以全权。威尼斯对达达尼尔海峡的封锁已切断奥斯曼军队在克里特的补给。1657年，他镇压了君士坦丁堡的骑兵叛乱，又打破海峡封锁，重新开通海上补给线。他整肃贪官，1658年出征特兰西瓦尼亚。1661年他卒于埃迪尔内，死前把大维齐尔之位传给儿子法兹尔·艾哈迈德。

en: Murad I (29 June 1326 – 15 June 1389), called Hüdavendigâr, was the son of Orhan and Nilüfer Hatun. His elder half-brother Süleyman Pasha died in 1357, and Murad succeeded their father as Ottoman ruler in 1362. In the 1360s he took Adrianople for his capital, brought much of the Balkans under Ottoman rule, and forced the rulers of Serbia and Bulgaria and the Byzantine emperor John V to pay tribute. He split his realm into Anatolian and Rumelian provinces and formed the Janissary corps. At the Battle of Kosovo in 1389 he was assassinated by the Serbian noble Miloš Obilić.
zh: 穆拉德一世（1326年6月29日—1389年6月15日），绰号许达文迪加尔，是奥尔汗与尼鲁佛·哈顿之子。1357年，他的异母兄苏莱曼帕夏去世；1362年，他继承父位，成为奥斯曼统治者。1360年代，他攻克阿德里安堡并定都于此，随后将巴尔干大部分土地纳入奥斯曼统治，迫使塞尔维亚、保加利亚的君主和拜占庭皇帝约翰五世纳贡。他把国土划分为安纳托利亚与鲁米利亚两省，并组建了禁卫军。1389年，他在科索沃战役中被塞尔维亚贵族米洛什·奥比利奇刺杀。

en: Murad Arslan, also recorded as Melik Bey (c. 1290–1336), was a son of the Ottoman founder Osman I. Melik, meaning king, may have been a title, since sources variously call him Arslan or Murad Arslan. On 12 March 1324 he was listed among the witnesses of his brother Orhan's Mekece endowment charter, one of the oldest surviving Ottoman documents, together with the princes Çoban, Hamid and Pazarlı. He had a daughter, Melek Hatun.
zh: 穆拉德·阿尔斯兰，亦称马利克·贝伊（约1290—1336），是奥斯曼开国者奥斯曼一世之子。“马利克”源自阿拉伯语“国王”，可能只是称号，故史料中他的名字又作阿尔斯兰或穆拉德·阿尔斯兰。1324年3月12日，他与乔班、哈米德、帕扎鲁等王子一同作为证人，列名于兄长奥尔汗颁布的梅凯杰瓦克夫文书，这是现存最古老的奥斯曼文书之一。他有一女梅莱克可敦。

en: Nilüfer Hatun (died around 1363 or around 1380) was a Greek-born concubine of Sultan Orhan and the mother of Murad I. She entered Orhan's harem in 1325, converted to Islam and received the name Nilüfer, and in 1326 she gave birth to Murad. After 1331 she moved with her son to Iznik. When Murad succeeded Orhan in March 1362, she became the Ottoman Empire's first Valide Hatun. She commissioned an imaret, a hammam and a caravanserai, and was buried in Orhan's tomb in Bursa; Murad built the Nilüfer Hatun Imaret at Iznik in 1388.
zh: 尼吕费尔可敦（约1363年或约1380年去世）是苏丹奥尔汗的希腊裔妾室，穆拉德一世之母。她于1325年进入奥尔汗后宫，皈依伊斯兰教并得名尼吕费尔，1326年生下穆拉德，1331年后随儿子迁居伊兹尼克。1362年3月穆拉德继位后，她成为奥斯曼帝国第一位瓦利德可敦，即太后。她下令修建了施粥所、浴场和商队客栈，死后葬于布尔萨的奥尔汗陵墓；1388年穆拉德在伊兹尼克为纪念她修建了尼吕费尔可敦施粥所。

en: Orhan Ghazi (c. 1281–1362), son of Osman I, was the second Ottoman ruler and the first to call himself sultan, reigning from 1323/24 to 1362. He turned his father's frontier principality into the conqueror of most of northwestern Anatolia: Bursa fell in 1326 and became his capital, Andronikos III was beaten at Pelekanon in 1329, and Nicaea and Nicomedia were taken in 1331 and 1337, along with the lands of the Karasids and the Ahis of Ankara. The Byzantine civil wars then worked greatly in his favour. In 1346 the regent John VI Kantakouzenos gave him his daughter Theodora and used Ottoman warriors against the empress dowager's party, letting them loot Thrace. After the 1354 Gallipoli earthquake Orhan's son Süleyman occupied the town, securing a strong bridgehead in Europe. Ibn Battuta called him the greatest of the Turcoman kings and the richest in wealth, lands and forces. Orhan died in March 1362 and was succeeded by Murad I.
zh: 奥尔汗·加齐（约1281—1362）是奥斯曼一世之子，奥斯曼第二位统治者，也是第一位自称苏丹的统治者，1323/24年至1362年在位。他把父亲的边境小国变成了征服安纳托利亚西北大部的力量：1326年攻克布尔萨并定为都城，1329年在佩莱卡农击败安德洛尼卡三世，1331年和1337年先后攻取尼西亚与尼科米底亚，卡勒西家族和安卡拉的阿希人的领地也被并入。随后的拜占庭内战对他大为有利。1346年，摄政约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯把女儿狄奥多拉嫁给他，并调奥斯曼战士对付皇太后一派，任其劫掠色雷斯。1354年加利波利大地震后，其子苏莱曼占领该城，为奥斯曼人在欧洲取得一处稳固的桥头堡。伊本·白图泰称他是土库曼诸王中最伟大、财富领地兵力最盛的一位。1362年3月奥尔汗去世，穆拉德一世继位。

en: Osman I (c. 1254–1323/1324), called Osman Ghazi, succeeded his father Ertuğrul around 1281 as bey of the tiny Söğüt frontier principality. He married Rabia Bala, daughter of Sheikh Edebali, and Malhun Hatun, mother of his successor Orhan. With the collapse of the Seljuk Sultanate of Rûm he made himself an independent ruler in Bithynia, traditionally from 1299. His victory over the Byzantines at Bapheus in 1302 laid open the Bithynian countryside. He blockaded Bursa, which fell to Orhan in 1326. He founded the Ottoman dynasty.
zh: 奥斯曼一世（约1254—1323/1324），人称加齐·奥斯曼，约1281年继父亲埃尔图鲁尔成为瑟于特边境小酋邦的贝伊。他娶了谢赫·艾德巴利之女拉比雅·芭拉，以及继承人奥尔汗之母玛尔可敦。随着鲁姆塞尔柱苏丹国瓦解，他在比提尼亚自立为独立统治者，传统上以1299年为建国之年。1302年他在巴菲乌斯击败拜占庭军队，打开了比提尼亚乡村。他围困布尔萨，布尔萨于1326年被奥尔汗攻克。他是奥斯曼王朝的开国之君。

en: Osmanzâde Tâib (c. 1659–1724), real name Ahmed, was an Ottoman Divan poet born in Istanbul, son of a Süleymaniye foundation official. He served as a medrese teacher and judge but won fame above all for his satires and odes; Sultan Ahmed III granted him the title reîs-i şâirân, head of the poets. Influenced by the poet Nabi, he also wrote Hadikatü'l-Vüzera on the grand viziers and Hadikatü'l-Müluk on the Ottoman sultans. His sharp tongue proved fatal: for a jest mocking the governor of Egypt, he was poisoned on the governor's orders in Cairo on 25 May 1724. He also translated or adapted works by other authors, and wrote a history of the first twenty-four Ottoman sultans.
zh: 奥斯曼扎德·塔伊布（约1659—1724），本名艾哈迈德，是出生于伊斯坦布尔的奥斯曼迪万诗人，父亲是苏莱曼尼耶基金会的文书。他曾任经学院教师和卡迪，尤以讽刺诗与颂诗闻名；艾哈迈德三世曾下敕书授予他“诗人之首”的称号。他受诗人纳比影响，还撰有《维齐尔之园》与《君王之园》两部传记，分别记述历代大维齐尔和奥斯曼苏丹的生平。他言辞尖刻，最终因此丧命：因取笑埃及总督，1724年5月25日在开罗被总督下令毒杀。他还翻译或改编其他作者的作品，并撰写了奥斯曼王朝前二十四位苏丹的历史。

en: Paşa Hatun was one of the three daughters of Alaeddin Pasha, son of Osman I and half-brother of Sultan Orhan, by his wife, the daughter of a certain Balad.
zh: 帕夏·哈顿是阿拉丁·帕夏与其妻（巴拉德之女）所生的三个女儿之一；阿拉丁是奥斯曼一世之子、奥尔汗苏丹的异母兄弟。

en: Pazarlı Bey (born 1285) was a son of Osman I, founder of the Ottoman beylik, and a general under his brother Orhan. He had at least two sons, İlyas and Murad, and at least two daughters, and was buried at Ertuğrul's türbe in Söğüt.
zh: 帕扎尔勒贝伊（1285年生）是奥斯曼贝伊国创立者奥斯曼一世之子，在其兄弟奥尔汗麾下任将领。他至少有伊利亚斯和穆拉德两个儿子以及两个女儿，葬于瑟于特的埃尔图鲁尔陵。

en: Patrona Halil (c. 1690–1730) was an Albanian-born Janissary from a village near Bitola, veteran of mutinies at Niš and Vidin. In September 1730, angered by new taxes, wartime shortages, and the extravagance of the Tulip Period court, he rallied artisans, shopkeepers, and Janissaries at Constantinople's Bayezid Square. The swelling revolt forced Sultan Ahmed III to execute Grand Vizier Ibrahim Pasha and then abdicate in favor of Mahmud I. For weeks Halil dominated the capital, but on 25 November 1730 the new sultan had him murdered at the palace; his followers were then massacred and the uprising crushed. He had led the Vidin mutiny in 1720; in the capital he worked in petty trade and as a bath attendant.
zh: 帕特罗纳·哈利尔（约1690—1730）是出生于比托拉附近村庄的阿尔巴尼亚裔耶尼切里，曾参加尼什和维丁的兵变。1730年9月，出于对新税、战时物资匮乏以及郁金香时期宫廷奢靡之风的愤怒，他在君士坦丁堡的巴耶济德广场召集手工业者、小商贩和耶尼切里起事。叛乱声势不断壮大，迫使艾哈迈德三世处死大维齐尔易卜拉欣帕夏，随后退位，由马哈茂德一世继位。哈利尔一度控制首都数周，但1730年11月25日，新苏丹在宫中将他诱杀，其追随者随后遭屠戮，叛乱终被镇压。他于1720年领导维丁兵变，来到首都后从事小买卖，也在浴室工作。

en: Piri Reis (c. 1465/1470–1553), born Muhiddin Piri at Gallipoli, was an Ottoman corsair, admiral and cartographer. He sailed with his uncle Kemal Reis, helping bombard the forces besieging Málaga in 1487, raiding the Spanish coast and commanding a ship in the Ottoman–Venetian wars. After his uncle's death he drew his celebrated world map of 1513. He blockaded Alexandria during the 1517 conquest of Egypt and presented the map to Selim I; his nautical atlas the Kitab-ı Bahriye was dedicated to Suleiman the Magnificent. As Indian Ocean fleet commander he fought the Portuguese in the Red Sea, but after retreating from the siege of Hormuz he was beheaded in 1553.
zh: 皮瑞·雷斯（约1465/1470—1553），本名毛希丁·皮里，生于加里波利，是奥斯曼帝国的私掠船长、海军将领和制图师。他早年随叔父凱末爾·雷斯出海，1487年协助炮击围攻马拉加的军队，劫掠西班牙沿海，并在奥斯曼—威尼斯战争中指挥自己的战船。叔父死后，他绘出著名的1513年世界地图。1517年征服埃及时，他封锁亚历山大港，并将地图献给塞利姆一世；他的航海图集《航海书》则题献给苏莱曼大帝。晚年他任印度洋舰队总司令，在红海同葡萄牙人作战，但在围攻霍尔木兹撤退后，于1553年被斩首。

en: Rabia Bala Hatun (died 1324) was the second wife of Osman I, founder of the Ottoman dynasty, and the daughter of Sheikh Edebali, the influential Sufi sheikh who was Osman's mentor and girded him with the sword of a gazi. Her marriage to Osman bound the brotherhood of the Akhıs to his rising beylik; central records list the village of Kozağaç near Bilecik among her marriage property. She was the mother of Alaeddin Ali Pasha, an adviser to Orhan. She died at Bilecik in January 1324 and was buried beside her father in the tomb complex built there by Orhan.
zh: 拉比娅·巴拉·哈通（?—1324）是奥斯曼王朝创立者奥斯曼一世的第二位妻子，为有影响力的苏菲谢赫埃德巴利之女；埃德巴利是奥斯曼的导师，曾为他佩上加齐之剑。这场婚姻使阿赫兄弟会与新兴的奥斯曼侯国结成一体，官方档案还把比莱吉克附近的科扎阿奇村记在她的聘产之中。她是阿拉丁·阿里帕夏的生母，阿里帕夏后来担任奥尔汗的谋臣。1324年1月她在比莱吉克去世，葬在当地奥尔汗所建、其父谢赫·埃德巴利的陵寝建筑群内，与父亲相伴。

en: Şahi Çelebi was one of the five sons of Alaeddin Pasha and the daughter of Balad, a grandson of Osman I and nephew of Sultan Orhan I. He is recorded with one daughter.
zh: 沙希·切莱比是阿拉丁帕夏与巴拉德之女所生五子之一，奥斯曼一世之孙、奥尔汗一世之侄。谱系记载他有一个女儿。

en: Salomon, also rendered Süleyman Bey, was a son of the Ottoman prince Savcı Bey, a younger son of Osman I, and a nephew of Sultan Orhan.
zh: 萨洛蒙又作苏莱曼贝伊，是奥斯曼王子萨夫哲贝伊之子；萨夫哲是奥斯曼一世的幼子、奥尔汗苏丹的弟弟。

en: Savcı Bey was a son of Osman I, founder of the Ottoman beylik, and a brother of Sultan Orhan. He fathered at least one son, Süleyman Bey, and after his death was buried in the türbe of Ertuğrul in Söğüt.
zh: 萨夫吉贝伊是奥斯曼贝伊国创立者奥斯曼一世之子、苏丹奥尔汗的兄弟。他至少有一个儿子苏莱曼贝伊，死后葬于瑟于特的埃尔图鲁尔陵。

en: Murad Bey was a son of Pazarlı Bey and a grandson of Osman I. His brother was İlyas Bey.
zh: 穆拉德贝伊是帕扎尔利贝伊之子、奥斯曼一世之孙，他的兄弟是伊利亚斯贝伊。

en: Selçuk Hatun was a daughter of Sultan Orhan by his wife Asporça Hatun, a Byzantine noblewoman. She married Süleyman Bey, a son of Mehmed Bey of the Aydınid dynasty of western Anatolia.
zh: 塞尔丘克·哈顿是奥尔汗苏丹与其出身拜占庭贵族的妻子阿斯波尔恰·哈通之女，嫁给了安纳托利亚西部艾登王朝穆罕默德贝伊之子苏莱曼贝伊。

en: Şerefullah Bey was an Ottoman prince, a son of Sultan Orhan by his consort Asporça Hatun, a woman of Byzantine birth, and a brother of İbrahim Bey and Selçuk Hatun.
zh: 谢雷富拉贝伊是奥斯曼王子，为奥尔汗贝伊与出身拜占庭的配偶阿斯波尔恰哈屯之子，是易卜拉欣贝伊与塞尔丘克哈屯的兄弟。

en: Sheikh Celal, called Bozoklu from his native Bozok, later Yozgat, was an Ottoman Alevi preacher in Anatolia who gave his name to the Celali rebellions. In 1519, under Selim I, he led landless peasants, villagers burdened by heavy taxes, dispossessed sipahi cavalrymen and sekban irregulars in revolt around Tokat, drawing support from Shia-leaning Turkmen stirred by Safavid agitation. The rising, the first Celali rebellion, was bloodily suppressed within the year, and Ottoman writers later applied Celal's name to the Anatolian rebel movements of the following century.
zh: 谢赫·杰拉里因出身博佐克（今约兹加特）而被称为博佐克卢，是安纳托利亚的奥斯曼阿列维派传教士，杰拉里叛乱便得名于他。1519年塞利姆一世在位时，他率领无地农民、不堪重税的乡民、失去封地的西帕希骑兵和塞克班非正规军，在托卡特附近举事，并从受萨非王朝鼓动、亲什叶派的土库曼人中争取支持。这场首次杰拉里叛乱一年内即被血腥镇压，后来奥斯曼史家把杰拉里的名字用来称呼此后一个世纪里的安纳托利亚反叛运动。

en: The unnamed wife of Alaeddin Pasha, son of the Ottoman founder Osman I, was a daughter of a man called Balad. She bore Alaeddin five sons, including Kılıç and Hizir, and three daughters, among them Taci, Ayşe and Paşa Hatun.
zh: 她是奥斯曼王朝开创者奥斯曼一世之子阿拉丁帕夏的妻子，姓名失载，仅知是一个名叫巴拉德的人的女儿。她为阿拉丁生下克勒奇、赫泽尔等五个儿子，以及塔吉、阿依谢、帕夏三个女儿。

en: Süleyman Pasha (c. 1306–1357) was Orhan's son and heir presumptive, and the commander who carried the Ottomans across into Europe; his deeds earned him the title Ghazi and the name Conqueror of Rumelia. In Anatolia he led the capture of Nicaea in 1331, the Karasid principality in 1335 and Nicomedia in 1337, and his father made him governor of the conquered lands. The turning point came after the earthquake of 1354 wrecked Gallipoli and he occupied it. In 1355 he crossed the Dardanelles and seized Bolayır, Tekirdağ, İpsala and Malkara, and the settlements he planted there became bases for further conquest in Thrace. In the lands he governed he built mosques, madrasas, caravanserais and schools. He died in 1357 after falling from his horse while hunting with a falcon, and was buried at Bolayır, though he had already built a mausoleum near Bursa.
zh: 苏莱曼帕夏（约1306—1357）是奥尔汗之子、法定的继承人选，也是率领奥斯曼人渡海进入欧洲的统帅，因战功被尊为加齐，号称“鲁米利亚的征服者”。在安纳托利亚，他率军于1331年攻取尼西亚、1335年攻灭卡勒西贝伊国、1337年攻取尼科米底亚，父亲任命他为所有征服地的总督。转折出现在1354年：地震重创加利波利，他随即占领该城。1355年他渡过达达尼尔海峡，攻占博拉伊尔、泰基尔达、伊普萨拉和马尔卡拉，他在那里建立的定居点成为进一步征服色雷斯的基地。他在所辖地区修建清真寺、经学院、商队驿站和学校。1357年他骑马狩猎，架鹰时坠马而死，葬于博拉伊尔，尽管他早已在布尔萨附近为自己修好陵墓。

en: Taci Hatun was a daughter of Alaeddin Pasha and his wife the daughter of Balad, a granddaughter of Osman I and niece of Sultan Orhan I. The genealogies list her with two sisters, Ayshe Hatun and Pasha Hatun.
zh: 塔吉·哈屯是阿拉丁帕夏与妻子巴拉德之女的女儿，奥斯曼一世的孙女、奥尔汗一世的侄女。谱系中她与两个姐妹艾谢·哈屯、帕夏·哈屯并列。

en: Taqi al-Din Muhammad ibn Ma'ruf (1526–1585), born in Damascus, was an Ottoman astronomer and polymath. After studying theology and the rational sciences in Damascus and Cairo, he taught in the madrasas and served as a qadi. In 1551 he described a steam-driven device for turning a roasting spit. He later settled in Constantinople, where he became chief astronomer to the sultan in 1571. Under Murad III he built the Constantinople observatory and used instruments including mechanical clocks to observe the great comet of 1577. The observatory was completed in 1579 and demolished only months later. He wrote more than ninety works on astronomy, optics, clocks and mechanics and died in 1585.
zh: 塔基丁·穆罕默德·伊本·马鲁夫（1526—1585）生于大马士革，是奥斯曼帝国的天文学家和博学家。他先在大马士革和开罗研习经学与理性科学，后在经学院任教，并担任卡迪。1551年，他记述了一种用蒸汽带动烤肉叉转动的装置。此后他定居君士坦丁堡，1571年成为苏丹的首席天文学家。在穆拉德三世治下，他主持修建君士坦丁堡天文台，并用机械钟等仪器观测了1577年的大彗星。天文台1579年建成，仅数月后即被拆毁。他著有九十多部关于天文、光学、钟表和机械的著作，于1585年去世。

en: Yusuf Ağa (died 1691) was the Kızlar Ağası, chief black eunuch of the imperial harem, under Sultan Mehmed IV and one of the most powerful figures in the palace. His office supervised the imperial religious endowments for Mecca and Medina and had close ties to Egypt. After the failed Siege of Vienna in 1683 he joined the enemies of Grand Vizier Kara Mustafa Pasha, helping bring about his downfall and execution. When Mehmed IV was deposed in 1687 after defeat in the Holy League war, Yusuf Ağa's estates were seized and he was exiled to Egypt, where he died in 1691.
zh: 优素福·阿迦（？—1691）是穆罕默德四世苏丹在位时的吉兹拉阿迦，即帝国后宫的黑人宦官总管，也是宫中最有权势的人物之一。该职位负责监督麦加和麦地那的帝国宗教基金，并与埃及有密切联系。1683年维也纳之围失败后，他加入大维齐尔卡拉·穆斯塔法帕夏的政敌之列，促成其倒台并处决。1687年穆罕默德四世因神圣同盟战争战败而被废黜，优素福·阿迦的家产被抄没，本人被流放埃及，最终于1691年死于该地。

en: Zahir al-Umar al-Zaydani (1689/1690–1775) was the sheikh of the Arab Zayadina clan who became the effectively independent ruler of northern Palestine under Ottoman suzerainty. He took Tiberias in 1730, added Safed and Nazareth by around 1740, and in 1750 made Acre his capital, growing rich on the cotton trade with France and rebuilding the city. He invited Christian and Jewish immigrants, helping the towns under his rule to grow. Allied with Ali Bey of Egypt against the governor of Damascus, he seized Sidon and Jaffa in 1771, at his peak holding the coast from Jaffa to Sidon. Driven from Acre in March 1775, he soon returned, but an Ottoman fleet finally took the city and killed him in August.
zh: 扎希尔·欧麦尔·扎伊达尼（1689/1690—1775）是阿拉伯扎伊达纳部族的谢赫，在奥斯曼宗主权下成为北巴勒斯坦事实上的独立统治者。他1730年夺取太巴列，约1740年拿下萨法德与拿撒勒，1750年定都阿卡，靠与法国的棉花贸易致富并重建该城。他招引基督徒和犹太移民，促进辖下城镇发展。他与埃及的阿里贝伊结盟对抗大马士革总督，1771年攻取西顿和雅法，极盛时控制从雅法到西顿的海岸。1775年3月他被逐出阿卡，不久便重返该城；8月奥斯曼舰队最终攻陷阿卡并将他杀死。

en: Andrei Ivanovich (died 1223) was a prince of Turov from the Turov line of the Rurik dynasty, son of Prince Ivan Yuryevich. He married a daughter of Mstislav Romanovich, grand prince of Kiev. In 1223 he marched with the allied Rus princes against the Mongols at the Kalka River. The fortified camp on the right bank where he stood was taken, and he was captured together with his father-in-law. The Mongols crushed the captive princes beneath the planks of their victory feast, and Andrei perished there.
zh: 安德烈·伊万诺维奇（？—1223）是留里克王朝图罗夫支系的图罗夫王公，王公伊万·尤里耶维奇之子，娶基辅大公姆斯季斯拉夫·罗曼诺维奇之女。1223年，他随罗斯诸王公联军在迦勒迦河迎击蒙古军队。他据守的右岸设防营地被攻破，本人与岳父一同被俘。蒙古人把被俘王公压在庆功宴的木板之下，安德烈就此殒命。

en: Danylo Ostrozky was a Ruthenian knyaz, probably prince of Turaŭ, who became the first prince of Ostroh and founder of the Ostrozky house. His ancestry is disputed; one reconstruction identifies his parents as Prince Dmytro and Yelizaveta. In 1344 he called in Tatars to fight for Galicia during the Galicia–Volhynia Wars. Later he joined Liubartas of Galicia–Volhynia, received Ostroh and rebuilt its ruined castle. He was prince of Kholm in 1352–1366, signed the Liubartas–Polish boundary charter in 1366 and died before 1376.
zh: 达尼洛·奥斯特罗兹基是罗斯王公，相传受封图罗夫，是见于史籍的第一位奥斯特罗格王公、奥斯特罗兹基家族始祖。他的出身存在争议，一种谱系考证认为其父母是德米特里王公与叶莉扎维塔。1344年，在加利西亚-沃伦战争中，他召来鞑靼人为争夺加利西亚而战。后来他投奔加利西亚-沃伦的柳巴尔塔斯，受封奥斯特罗格并重建被毁的城堡。1352—1366年他任海乌姆王公，1366年在柳巴尔塔斯与波兰的划界文书上署名，1376年前去世。

en: Dmitry Yurievich was a Rurikid prince of the Turov-Pinsk line, a son of Yuri Vladimirovich of Pinsk. Genealogies make him a hypothetical prince of Turov around 1300; Davyd Dmytrovych of Horodets, who married a daughter of Grand Duke Algirdas, is thought to be his son.
zh: 德米特里·尤里耶维奇是留里克王朝图罗夫—平斯克支系王公，平斯克王公尤里·弗拉基米罗维奇之子。谱系推测他约在1300年前后任图罗夫王公；娶立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯之女的达维德·德米特里耶维奇被认为是他的儿子。

en: Gleb Yuryevich (c. 1150–1195) was a son of Yuri Yaroslavich of Turov and Anna Vsevolodovna. The chronicles call him prince of Dubrovitsa from 1182. In 1183 he took part in Grand Prince Sviatoslav Vsevolodovich's victorious Polovtsian campaign, and in 1187 Rurik Rostislavich sent him to Suzdal to escort Verkhuslava, daughter of Vsevolod the Big Nest, as bride for his son Rostislav. When his elder brother Sviatopolk died in 1190, Gleb succeeded to the Turovo-Pinsk principality and ruled until his death.
zh: 格列布·尤里耶维奇（约1150—1195）是图罗夫王公尤里·雅罗斯拉维奇与安娜·弗谢沃洛多芙娜之子。编年史自1182年起称他为杜布罗维察王公。1183年，他参加基辅大公斯维亚托斯拉夫·弗谢沃洛多维奇获胜的征伐波洛伏齐人之役；1187年，留里克·罗斯季斯拉维奇派他前往苏兹达尔，为儿子罗斯季斯拉夫迎娶弗谢沃洛德三世（大窝）之女韦尔胡斯拉娃。1190年兄长斯维亚托波尔克去世后，格列布继领图罗夫—平斯克公国，统治到去世。

en: Ivan Yuryevich was a prince of Turov, a son of Yuri Yaroslavich of Turov and Anna, daughter of Prince Vsevolodko of Goroden. The chronicles first name him in 1167–1168, when he joined the other princes of Rus in campaigns against the Polovtsians raiding Byzantine merchant caravans on the Dnieper, and he campaigned against them again in 1170. That same year he helped Mstislav Izyaslavich recover the Kievan throne from which Andrey Bogolyubsky had expelled him. His later fate is unrecorded.
zh: 伊万·尤里耶维奇是图罗夫王公，图罗夫的尤里·雅罗斯拉维奇与格罗德诺王公弗谢沃尔德科之女安娜的儿子。编年史首次提到他是在1167—1168年间：他与罗斯诸王公一同征伐在第聂伯河劫掠拜占庭商队的波洛伏齐人；1170年他再度出征。同年，他帮助姆斯季斯拉夫·伊贾斯拉维奇夺回被安德烈·博戈柳布斯基废黜的基辅公位。此后他的下落不见记载。

en: Semyon Yurievich was prince of Turov from the late thirteenth century into the 1320s, the last prince of Turov known to the sources. After his reign the principality was absorbed into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.
zh: 谢苗·尤里耶维奇是13世纪末至1320年代的图罗夫王公，也是见于记载的最后一任图罗夫王公；他身后图罗夫公国被并入立陶宛大公国。

en: Sviatopolk Yuryevich (c. 1144–1190), son of Yuri Yaroslavich of Turov and Anna Vsevolodovna, was prince of Pinsk from 1168 and prince of Turov from 1170, when he succeeded his elder brother Ivan. In 1157 Yaroslav Osmomysl sent him to Yuri Dolgoruky to request the captive prince Ivan Berladnik. He joined the great Polovtsian campaign of 1168, backed Mstislav Izyaslavich against Andrey Bogolyubsky and changed sides in 1173. He ruled Turov for twenty years and was followed by his brother Gleb; his sons Vladimir and Rostislav later held Pinsk.
zh: 斯维亚托波尔克·尤里耶维奇（约1144—1190）是图罗夫王公尤里·雅罗斯拉维奇与安娜·弗谢沃洛多芙娜之子，1168年起任平斯克王公，1170年继兄长伊万之后成为图罗夫王公。1157年，他受雅罗斯拉夫·奥斯莫梅斯尔派遣，向尤里·多尔戈鲁基索取被囚的王公伊万·贝尔拉德尼克。他参加了1168年对波洛伏齐人的大征伐，支持姆斯季斯拉夫·伊贾斯拉维奇对抗安德烈·博戈柳布斯基，1173年又倒向安德烈一方。他统治图罗夫二十年，死后由弟弟格列布继位；其子弗拉基米尔和罗斯季斯拉夫后来领有平斯克。

en: Vladimir Sviatopolkovich (died 1228) was a Rurikid prince, the eldest son of Sviatopolk Yuryevich of Turov. First recorded as prince of Pinsk in 1204, he joined Vsevolod Chermny's alliance against Rurik Rostislavich in 1207. After his cousin Andrei Ivanovich of Turov was killed at the Kalka River in 1223, Vladimir united the Turov and Pinsk thrones, ruling Turov from June that year until his death. When he died in 1228, Andrei's son Yuri took Turov, while Vladimir's brother Rostislav received Pinsk.
zh: 弗拉基米尔·斯维亚托波尔科维奇（？—1228）是留里克王公，图罗夫王公斯维亚托波尔克·尤里耶维奇的长子。1204年史料首次记载他为平斯克王公；1207年他加入弗谢沃洛德·切尔姆内反对留里克·罗斯季斯拉维奇的同盟。1223年他的堂兄图罗夫王公安德烈·伊万诺维奇战死于迦勒迦河后，弗拉基米尔将图罗夫与平斯克两座公位合于一身，自当年6月起统治图罗夫直至去世。1228年他死后，安德烈之子尤里得到图罗夫，他的弟弟罗斯季斯拉夫得到平斯克。

en: Vyacheslav Yaropolchich (died 13 December 1104) was the younger son of Yaropolk Izyaslavich, prince of Volhynia, and probably held a small appanage in Volhynia or the Turov land. In 1097 he fought for Grand Prince Sviatopolk Izyaslavich against Davyd Igorevich and the Rostislavichi in the wars over Volhynia. In 1103 he joined Sviatopolk and Vladimir Monomakh's great steppe campaign against the Polovtsians, and he died the following year.
zh: 维亚切斯拉夫·雅罗波尔科维奇（?—1104年12月13日）是沃伦王公雅罗波尔克·伊贾斯拉维奇的幼子，可能领有沃伦或图罗夫地区的小块封邑。1097年，在争夺沃伦的战争中，他为大公斯维亚托波尔克·伊贾斯拉维奇作战，讨伐达维德·伊戈列维奇和罗斯季斯拉维奇家族。1103年，他参加斯维亚托波尔克与弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫对波洛伏齐人的大草原征伐，次年去世。

en: Yaropolk Iziaslavich (died 22 November 1086) was a son of Grand Prince Iziaslav I of Kiev and Gertruda, daughter of Mieszko II of Poland. During his father's exile in the 1070s he sought support at the courts of the German emperor and Pope Gregory VII. He followed his father back to Kiev in 1077. In 1078 his uncle Grand Prince Vsevolod made him prince of Turov and Volhynia. Having fallen out with Vsevolod and his son Vladimir Monomakh, he fled to Poland in 1085, returned the next year and was reconciled with Vladimir. In November 1086 he was murdered on a journey to Zvenigorod by a retainer named Neradets and was buried in the church of Saint Peter in Kiev, which he had endowed.
zh: 亚罗波尔克·伊贾斯拉维奇（1086年11月22日卒）是基辅大公伊贾斯拉夫一世与波兰国王梅什科二世之女格特鲁德之子。1070年代父亲流亡期间，他前往德意志皇帝和教皇格列高利七世的宫廷争取支持，1077年随父返回基辅。1078年，叔父基辅大公弗谢沃洛德封他为图罗夫和沃伦王公。他与弗谢沃洛德及其子弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫交恶，1085年逃往波兰，次年返回，与弗拉基米尔和解。1086年11月，他在前往兹韦尼哥罗德途中被侍从涅拉杰茨杀害，归葬基辅他所资助的圣彼得教堂。

en: Yuri Andreevich (died late in the thirteenth century) was prince of Turov, a son of Andrei Ivanovich, who was killed at the Kalka River in 1223. Still underage then, he let Vladimir Sviatopolkovich rule Turov until 1228, when he took the throne. During his reign Lithuania pressed from the north and Galicia-Volhynia from the west, and in the winter of 1241 the Mongols sacked and destroyed Turov. After a battle against the Mongols in 1246 he kept his throne, though the principality slipped into vassalage. His son Semyon succeeded him.
zh: 尤里·安德烈耶维奇（13世纪后期卒）是图罗夫王公，1223年战死于迦勒迦河的安德烈·伊万诺维奇之子。因当时年幼，图罗夫先由弗拉基米尔·斯维亚托波尔科维奇统治，1228年他才登位。他在位期间，北方的立陶宛与西方的加利奇—沃伦公国不断施压，1241年冬蒙古军队攻陷并摧毁了图罗夫城。1246年与蒙古军交战后他保住了公位，公国却逐渐沦为附庸。他死后由其子谢苗继位。

en: Yury Yaroslavich (born before 1112, died c. 1168), a son of Yaroslav Sviatopolkovich of Volhynia, founded the Turov-Pinsk branch of the Rurikids. From about 1142 he ruled Pinsk and Turov in several separate periods. In 1157, after the death of Yuri Dolgorukiy, he seized Turov, which Dolgorukiy's son Boris had held. Grand Prince Izyaslav Davydovich besieged Turov in 1157 and again in 1159, allied with Mstislav of Volhynia, but failed to take it. In 1162 Grand Prince Rostislav of Kiev, having quarrelled with Mstislav, made peace with Yury to guard against an attack on Kiev or Smolensk. At his death his sons split the Turov-Pinsk principality into appanages.
zh: 尤里·雅罗斯拉维奇（1112年前生，约1168年卒）是沃伦的雅罗斯拉夫·斯维亚托波尔科维奇之子，留里克王朝图罗夫—平斯克支系的始祖。自约1142年起，他先后多次统治平斯克和图罗夫。1157年，他乘尤里·多尔戈鲁基去世之机，从多尔戈鲁基之子鲍里斯手中夺取图罗夫。基辅大公伊贾斯拉夫·达维多维奇于1157年围攻图罗夫，1159年又联合沃伦的姆斯季斯拉夫再度来攻，均未能破城。1162年，基辅大公罗斯季斯拉夫与姆斯季斯拉夫交恶，为防尤里袭击基辅或斯摩棱斯克而与其议和。他死后，诸子将图罗夫—平斯克公国瓜分为若干封邑。

en: Aleksandr Mikhailovich (1301–1339), son of Mikhail of Tver, became prince of Tver and grand prince of Vladimir in 1326. After Tver's citizens massacred the Tatar retinue of the baskak Shevkal on 15 August 1327, Özbeg Khan sent Ivan I of Moscow with fifty thousand Tatars to sack the city, and Aleksandr lost his throne. After years of exile in Pskov and Lithuania he was pardoned at Sarai and returned to Tver in 1338, but on 28 October 1339 Özbeg had him and his son Fyodor executed, ending a 35-year struggle with Moscow's princes for the grand principality of Vladimir.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/亚历山大·米哈伊洛维奇
zh: 亚历山大·米哈伊洛维奇（1301—1339）是特维尔王公米哈伊尔之子，1326年成为特维尔王公兼弗拉基米尔大公。1327年8月15日，特维尔市民歼灭鞑靼税使舍夫卡尔的扈从，月即别汗派莫斯科的伊凡一世率五万鞑靼军队洗劫该城，亚历山大失去大公公位。他在普斯科夫和立陶宛流亡多年后于萨莱获赦，1338年返回特维尔，1339年10月28日与儿子费奥多尔一同被月即别汗处死，他与莫斯科诸王公之间长达35年的弗拉基米尔大公位之争随之结束。

en: Konstantin Mikhailovich (1306–1346) ruled Tver in the years when it lost its long contest with Moscow. The third son of Mikhail of Tver, he was held captive in Sarai after the Mongols executed his father in 1318, until he was ransomed for 2000 rubles; in 1320 he married Sophia, daughter of Yury of Moscow. When the 1327 uprising against the Tatars drove his brother Aleksandr out, he and his younger brother Vasily came back to a devastated Tver and began gathering its people. In 1328 he obtained the khan's yarlyk and ruled quietly under the close watch of Ivan I of Moscow, his wife's uncle, accompanying him on campaigns and trips to the Horde. After Aleksandr was executed in 1339, Konstantin ruled again. A quarrel with Aleksandr's son Vsevolod took him to the Horde for judgment, but he died in 1346 before the trial began, and Vsevolod took the throne.
zh: 康斯坦丁·米哈伊洛维奇（1306—1346）执掌特维尔的年月，正是这个公国在同莫斯科的长期角逐中败下阵来的时期。他是特维尔大公米哈伊尔的第三子。1318年父亲被蒙古人处死后，他被扣在萨赖，后以2000卢布赎出；1320年娶莫斯科王公尤里之女索菲娅为妻。1327年反鞑靼起义迫使兄长亚历山大逃离，他与幼弟瓦西里回到满目疮痍的特维尔，开始召集百姓。1328年，他从汗廷取得封诰，此后在莫斯科王公伊凡一世（其妻的叔父）的严密监视下安静执政，随伊凡出征，并同往金帐汗国。1339年亚历山大被处死后，他再度执政。他与亚历山大之子弗谢沃洛德失和，赴金帐汗国受审，却于1346年在开审前去世，弗谢沃洛德继承公位。

en: Mikhail Aleksandrovich (1333–1399) was a son of Aleksandr Mikhailovich of Tver and grew up in Pskov after his father's flight there in 1327. He became prince of Tver in 1368 and, allied with his brother-in-law Algirdas of Lithuania, was the last Tver ruler seriously to challenge Moscow for leadership of the Russian lands. In 1370, 1371 and 1375 he obtained the khan's yarlyk as grand prince of Vladimir, but Dmitry Donskoy defeated him in 1375 and forced him to recognize Moscow's supremacy. He ruled Tver until his death on 26 August 1399.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/米哈伊尔·亚历山德罗维奇_(特维尔大公)
zh: 米哈伊尔·亚历山德罗维奇（1333—1399）是特维尔大公亚历山大·米哈伊洛维奇之子，1327年其父流亡后在普斯科夫长大。1368年他成为特维尔统治者，与姐夫立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯结盟，是最后一位能与莫斯科争夺罗斯领袖地位的特维尔王公。他于1370、1371和1375年三次从金帐汗国取得弗拉基米尔大公告令，却始终压不垮德米特里·顿斯科伊；1375年德米特里兵临特维尔，他被迫承认莫斯科的领袖地位。他统治特维尔直至1399年8月26日去世。

en: Mikhail Yaroslavich (1271–1318) became prince of Tver in 1285 and was named grand prince of Vladimir in 1304 after receiving his patent from the khan of the Golden Horde. His reign was dominated by his feud with Yury of Moscow. In December 1317 he defeated Yury at Bortenevo and captured his wife, a sister of Uzbeg Khan; when she died in custody, his enemies charged him with her murder. Summoned to Sarai, he was executed on 22 November 1318. The Russian Church later canonized him for meeting certain death meekly.
zh: 米哈伊尔·雅罗斯拉维奇（1271—1318）于1285年成为特维尔王公，1304年获金帐汗国可汗颁授诰命，成为弗拉基米尔大公。他统治的主线是与莫斯科王公尤里的长期争斗：1317年12月他在博尔捷涅沃击败尤里，俘获的尤里之妻是乌兹别克汗的妹妹；她在拘押中死去，给了政敌指控的口实。米哈伊尔被召往萨莱，于1318年11月22日被处死。俄罗斯东正教会后来追封他为圣徒，以嘉其坦然赴死。

en: Uliana Aleksandrovna (c. 1325–1391) was a princess of Tver, the daughter of Aleksandr Mikhailovich and Anastasia of Galicia. After her father and brother were executed at the Golden Horde in 1339, she grew up at the court of her brother-in-law Simeon of Moscow. In 1349 she married Grand Duke Algirdas of Lithuania as his second wife. She bore him many children, including Jogaila, the future king of Poland, and in 1370 persuaded Algirdas to campaign against Moscow in support of her brother Mikhail of Tver. After Algirdas died in 1377 she held Vitebsk under his will.
zh: 乌莉安娜·亚历山德罗芙娜（约1325—1391）是特维尔公主，亚历山大·米哈伊洛维奇与加利西亚的阿纳斯塔西娅之女。1339年父亲和兄长在金帐汗国被处死后，她在姐姐玛丽亚的丈夫、莫斯科的西梅翁宫廷中长大。1349年，她嫁给立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯，成为其第二任妻子，生下众多子女，包括后来的波兰国王约盖拉；1370年，她说服阿尔吉尔达斯出兵，帮助兄长米哈伊尔对抗莫斯科。阿尔吉尔达斯于1377年去世后，她按其遗嘱领有维捷布斯克。

en: İlyas Bey was the fourteenth-century ruler of the Tavas beylik in southwestern Anatolia, lying between the Germiyan, Aydın and Menteşe lands; under him the people of Tavas were attached to the Mevlevi order. In 1365 the beylik was absorbed by Menteşe.
zh: 伊利亚斯贝伊是14世纪安纳托利亚西南部塔瓦斯侯国的统治者，治下民众信奉梅夫拉维教团。塔瓦斯地处格尔米扬、艾登与门泰谢之间，1365年被门泰谢侯国兼并。

en: Áed Findliath, the fair-grey (died 20 November 879), son of Niall Caille, was king of Ailech and became high king of Ireland in 862. He defeated the Norse at Glenn Foichle in 856, destroyed their settlements on Lough Foyle in 866, and burned their northern longphorts while Amlaíb and Auisle campaigned in Scotland. In 868 he routed the men of Brega, Leinster and the foreigners at Cell Ua nDaigri, where Flann of Brega fell. He invaded Leinster in 870 and 874, died at Druim Inasclainn in 879, and left a son Niall Glúndub, ancestor of the O'Neills.
zh: 绰号“灰发者”的艾德·芬德利阿（？—879年11月20日）是尼尔·卡耶之子，曾任艾莱赫国王，并于862年成为爱尔兰高王。他屡次击败诺斯人：856年在格伦福伊尔击败诺斯人，866年摧毁他们在福伊尔湖畔的定居点，又趁安莱夫与奥伊斯尔出征苏格兰之机焚毁其北方据点。868年，他在凯尔乌纳伊格里击溃布雷加人、伦斯特人与外族的联军，布雷加的弗兰战死。他于870年和874年两度入侵伦斯特，879年在德鲁姆伊纳斯克兰去世；其子尼尔·格伦杜布是奥尼尔家族的祖先。

en: Affric Ní Néill was a daughter of Aodh Ó Néill. She married Henry Aimhréidh Ó Néill, a son of Niall Mór and ancestor of the Sliocht Énri, and the Four Masters record her death in 1389.
zh: 阿芙里克·奥尼尔是艾·奥尼尔之女，嫁给尼尔·莫尔之子、斯利赫特·恩里一支始祖亨利·埃姆里·奥尼尔；《四大师编年史》记载她于1389年去世。

en: Áed in Macáem Tóinlesc (died 1177) founded O'Neill power in Tír Eogain. After High King Muirchertach Mac Lochlainn was killed in 1166, Áed was proclaimed king of Tír Eogain near Dungannon with the backing of Donnchad Ua Cerbaill, king of Airgíalla. In 1167 High King Ruaidrí Ua Conchobair divided the province between Áed and Niall Mac Lochlainn. As Ruaidrí's vassal Áed brought three thousand men to the 1174 siege of Norman-held Trim. He was killed by Máel Sechlainn Mac Lochlainn in 1177, leaving his son Áed Méith to entrench O'Neill rule.
zh: 艾德·安·马凯姆·托因莱斯克（？—1177）奠定了奥尼尔家族在蒂尔欧文的势力。1166年爱尔兰高王穆尔切塔赫·麦克洛克林败亡后，他在阿尔吉亚拉国王邓查德·乌阿·采尔拜尔支持下，于邓甘嫩附近被拥立为蒂尔欧文国王。1167年，高王鲁艾德里·奥康诺将蒂尔欧文分给他和尼亚尔·麦克洛克林。作为鲁艾德里的封臣，他于1174年率三千人参与围攻诺曼人占据的特里姆。1177年他被梅尔·塞克兰·麦克洛克林杀害，其子艾德·梅思后来巩固了奥尼尔家族的统治。

en: Aodh Méith Ó Néill (died 1230), son of Áed in Macáem Tóinlesc, made himself king of Tír Eoghain amid the chaos after the Norman conquest of eastern Ulster. From 1199 he raided John de Courcy's port of Larne and forced the Fir Manach and Cenél Conaill to submit. He weathered invasions by Hugh de Lacy and the Gall-Gaidhil of Galloway, brought aid to King John at Carrickfergus in 1210, and in 1224 blocked a royal army at the Fews of Armagh. He died in 1230 with O'Neill power entrenched; the Clandeboye O'Neills descend from him.
zh: 艾德·梅思·奥尼尔（？—1230）是艾德·安·马凯姆·托因莱斯克之子，在诺曼人征服东阿尔斯特后的乱局中成为蒂尔欧文国王。1199年起，他袭击约翰·德·库西的港口拉恩，并迫使菲尔马纳和基内尔康纳尔臣服。他抵挡住休·德·拉西与加洛韦的盖尔-盖尔人入侵，1210年曾率军赴卡里克弗格斯支援英格兰国王约翰，1224年又在阿尔马的菲乌斯挡住王师。他于1230年去世，奥尼尔家族的权势由此稳固；克兰德博伊的奥尼尔家族即其后裔。

en: Hugh Boy Ó Néill, Irish Aed Buide, the Fair (died 1283), son of Domhnall Óg, was the last king of Ailech and eponym of the Clandeboye O'Neills. After Brian Chatha an Dúna fell at Down in 1260 he took the kingship, expelling his brother Niall Cúlanch, who had seized it in 1261. He married Eleanor, cousin of Earl Walter de Burgh, whom he acknowledged as overlord in 1269. In 1281 he and Thomas de Mandeville killed Donnell Óg O'Donnell at Desertcreat. In 1283 he was killed by Brian MacMahon of Airgíalla and Gilla Ísa O'Reilly.
zh: 休·博伊·奥尼尔（爱尔兰语作艾德·布德，意为“金发者”，？—1283）是多姆纳尔·奥格之子、最后一位拥有艾莱赫王号的统治者，也是克兰德博伊奥尼尔家族的得名始祖。1260年布莱恩·查哈·安·杜纳在唐恩战死后他取得王位，并驱逐了1261年篡位的兄弟尼亚尔·库兰纳。他娶阿尔斯特伯爵沃尔特·德·伯格的表妹埃莉诺，1269年承认伯爵为宗主。1281年他与托马斯·德·曼德维尔在德瑟特克里特击杀多姆纳尔·奥格·奥唐奈。1283年他被阿尔吉亚拉的布莱恩·麦克马洪和吉拉·伊萨·奥赖利杀害。

en: Aodh Reamhar (Hugh the Stout) was king of Tír Eoghain in 1345–1364. The fourth son of Domhnall O'Neill, he came forward after three of his brothers were killed between 1318 and 1325. In 1339 he led a great army into Tír Chonaill, and in 1345 a fleet on Lough Neagh and the justiciar d'Ufford's aid let him overcome his Clandeboye rival Henry O'Neill and seize the kingship. He defeated Oriel and Fermanagh in 1354. When he died in 1364 the Four Masters called him the best of the Irish of his age, and his son Niall Mór succeeded him.
zh: 艾·鲁尔（绰号“壮汉休”）在1345—1364年间任蒂尔埃奥甘国王。他是多姆纳尔·奥尼尔的第四子，三个兄弟在1318至1325年间先后被杀后，他崭露头角。1339年他率大军攻入蒂尔康奈；1345年，他凭借内伊湖舰队与爱尔兰总督达福德的援助，击败克兰德博伊的对手亨利·奥尼尔，夺得王位。1354年他击败奥里尔与弗马纳的人马。1364年他去世时，《四大师编年史》称他为同时代爱尔兰人中最杰出者，其子尼尔·莫尔继位。

en: Gormfhlaith O'Donell was a daughter of the O'Donnell king of Tír Conaill and the wife of Aodh Reamhar Ó Néill, king of Tír Eoghain. The Irish annals record her death in 1358, and her son Niall Mór succeeded Aodh Reamhar as king in 1364.
zh: 戈姆弗莱思·奥唐奈是蒂尔康奈奥唐奈尔王之女，嫁给蒂龙国王奥德·鲁瓦尔·奥尼尔。爱尔兰编年史记载她于1358年去世，其子尼尔·莫尔在1364年继其父为王。

en: Brian Ó Néill, called Brian Chatha an Dúna (c. 1220–14 May 1260), ruled Tír Eoghain from 1238 and was acknowledged high king of Ireland in 1258. The son of Niall Ruadh, he crushed the Meic Lochlainn at the battle of Camergi in 1241, ending their long rivalry with the O'Neills. In 1253 he raided the Norman-held Iveagh, and in 1258 was inaugurated King of the Gael at Caoluisce on Lough Erne, receiving hostages from O'Connor and O'Brien. In 1260 he attacked the Normans at Downpatrick and fell at the battle of Drumderg; his head was sent to Henry III.
zh: 布莱恩·奥尼尔，世称“邓恩之战的布莱恩”（约1220—1260），自1238年起统治蒂尔欧文，1258年被承认为爱尔兰高王。他是尼亚尔·鲁阿之子，1241年在卡默吉之战剿灭麦克洛克林家族，结束了该家族与奥尼尔家族的长期争斗。1253年他劫掠诺曼人占据的伊韦阿，1258年在厄恩湖畔的考尔卢斯凯被拥立为“盖尔人之王”，奥康诺与奥布莱恩均送来人质。1260年他进攻唐帕特里克的诺曼人，战死于德拉姆德格之战，首级被送往亨利三世处。

en: Brian Ó Néill was a son of Aodh Reamhar, king of Tír Eoghain. The annals call him a general sage at his death, which the Annals of Ulster record in 1351 and the Four Masters date to 1354.
zh: 布莱恩·奥尼尔是蒂尔埃奥甘国王艾·鲁尔之子。编年史称他学识渊博：《阿尔斯特编年史》记他于1351年去世，《四大师编年史》则将其卒年系于1354年。

en: Brian Ó Néill (c. 1265–1295) was a king of Tír Eoghain and the son of Hugh Boy Ó Néill. In 1291, after his uncle Niall Cúlánach was killed by the deposed king Donnell Ó Néill, Brian secured the kingship with the aid of the de Mandeville and Bisset vassals of Earl Richard Óg de Burgh. He ruled with Norman backing until 1295, when Donnell defeated him and his Norman allies at the battle of Creeve. Brian was killed in the fighting. His son Henry later became king and founded the lordship of Clandeboye.
zh: 布莱恩·奥尼尔（约1265—1295）是蒂尔欧文国王、休·博伊·奥尼尔之子。1291年，他的叔父尼亚尔·库兰纳被废王多姆纳尔·奥尼尔杀死后，布莱恩借助阿尔斯特伯爵理查德·奥格·德·伯格麾下德·曼德维尔和比塞特两姓封臣的力量登上王位。他依靠诺曼人的支持统治，1295年多姆纳尔在克里夫之战击败他和他的诺曼盟军，布莱恩战死。其子亨利后来成为国王，并创立了克兰德博伊领地。

en: Conchobar Beg (died 1201), also called Conchobar Becc, was a Mac Lochlainn claimant to the kingship of Tír Eoghain. In 1201 the Cenél nEógain deposed their king Áed Méith Ó Néill and elected Conchobar in his stead. He raided Tír Enda and went to war with Eignechán Ua Domnaill of Tír Conaill, whose fleet had put in at Gaeth-in-Chairrgin. In the ensuing fight his horse was wounded under him; unhorsed, he was killed by the Cenél Conaill, who held him to account for plundering the shrine of Saint Colum Cille.
zh: 小康纳（？—1201），爱尔兰语名作康乔巴尔·贝克，是麦克·洛克林家族争夺蒂龙王位的人。1201年，欧文后裔废黜国王艾德·梅斯·奥尼尔，推举康纳继位。他出兵劫掠蒂伦达，又与率舰队进抵盖斯-凯尔金的蒂尔康奈尔领主埃格内汉·奥唐奈交战。混战中他的坐骑受伤，他落马后被蒂尔康奈尔人杀死，对方要他为此前劫掠圣高隆巴圣龛一事偿命。

en: Cú Uladh Ó Néill of Tyrone was killed in 1325 by the sons of Niall mac Brian Ó Néill.
zh: 蒂龙的库利·奥尼尔于1325年被尼尔·马克·布赖恩·奥尼尔的儿子们杀害。

en: Domnall Mac Lochlainn (died 1241) was the last Mac Lochlainn king of Tír Eoghain. In 1232 he raided Tír Conaill with English and Irish allies. In 1234 he killed the reigning king, Domnall Óc Ó Néill, and seized the kingship, but was deposed in 1238. He won power back after the battle of Carnteel in 1239, where Domnall Tamhnach Ó Néill fell. In 1241 Brian Ó Néill and Máelsechnaill Ó Domhnaill defeated and killed him at Caimeirge; ten of his kindred died with him, and the kingship passed permanently to the Ó Néill.
zh: 多姆纳尔·麦克·洛克林（？—1241）是麦克·洛克林家族最后一位蒂龙国王。1232年，他联合英格兰与爱尔兰盟友进犯蒂尔康奈尔。1234年他杀死在位国王小多姆纳尔·奥尼尔，夺取王位，却于1238年被废；1239年他在坎蒂尔战役后重夺权力，多姆纳尔·塔夫纳赫·奥尼尔在该战中阵亡。1241年，布赖恩·奥尼尔与梅尔塞赫纳尔·奥唐奈在凯梅尔格战役击败并杀死他，他的十名族人一同战死，王位从此永久转入奥尼尔家族。

en: Domnall Ua Lochlainn (1048–1121), son of Ardgar, became king of Ailech in 1083 as leader of the Cenél nEógain, opening his reign with the traditional inaugural cattle-raid against the Conaille Muirthemne near Dundalk. From 1101 to 1119 he contested the high kingship of Ireland with his great southern rival, Muirchertach Ua Briain of Munster; his jurists argued that a king who could lead his army through all Ireland unbeaten was high king with opposition. He died at Derry on 10 February 1121, in the thirty-eighth year of his reign, and the northern annals styled him over-king of Ireland.
zh: 多姆纳尔·洛赫兰（1048—1121）是阿尔德加尔之子，1083年成为阿利赫国王、欧文族群的首领，并以传统的即位劫掠开场，率军洗劫邓多克一带的康纳尔-穆瑟姆内人，夺走大批牛群。1101至1119年间，他与南方劲敌、明斯特的穆尔切赫塔克·奥布赖恩争夺爱尔兰至高王权；他的法学家主张，能率军穿行全爱尔兰而不败者，便是“有反对者的至高王”。1121年2月10日他在德里去世，时为在位第三十八年，北方编年史称他为爱尔兰共主。

en: Domnall ua Néill (c. 920–980) was High King of Ireland from 956. A grandson of Niall Glúndub and son of Muirchertach mac Néill of the northern Uí Néill, he became co-king of Ailech with his brother Flaithbertach on his father's death in 943 and took the high kingship after Congalach Cnogba died in 956. A ruler credited with military reforms later associated with Brian Boru, he long warred against Amlaíb Cuarán, Norse king of Dublin and husband of his sister. In 980 he abdicated into Armagh monastery, where he died soon after, the last of his line to hold the high kingship.
zh: 多姆纳尔·乌阿·尼尔（约920—980年）于956年至980年担任爱尔兰至高王。他是尼尔·格伦杜布之孙、北部乌伊·尼尔家族的穆尔赫塔赫·麦克·尼尔之子，943年父亲去世后与兄弟弗莱赫贝尔塔赫同为阿利赫国王，956年孔加拉赫·克诺格巴死后成为至高王。他治国有方，推行的军事改革后来被归于布莱恩·博鲁；在位期间大部分时间都在与娶了他妹妹的都柏林诺斯国王奥拉夫·库兰交战。980年他退位进入阿马修道院，不久后去世，也是其家族最后一位至高王。

en: Domhnall Ó Néill was an O'Neill prince who contested Tír Eoghain with Niall Mór after 1364. With the Clann-Donnell gallowglasses he marched against Niall in 1366, and in 1370 gave hostages and renounced the lordship for a share of lands.
zh: 多姆纳尔·奥尼尔是奥尼尔家族王公，1364年后与尼尔·莫尔争夺蒂尔埃奥甘王位。1366年他联合克兰-多纳尔的重铠雇佣兵进军讨伐尼尔，1370年交出人质、放弃王位之争，换得封土。

en: Donnell Ó Néill (c. 1245–1325), son of Brian Chatha an Dúna, was king of Tír Eoghain on and off from 1283. Earl Richard Óg de Burgh twice deposed him for his kinsmen Niall Cúlánach and Brian, but in 1295 Donnell slew Brian at Creeve and retook the kingship. In 1314 he invited Edward Bruce to Ireland, and in 1317 sent Pope John XXII a Remonstration denouncing English rule and hailing Bruce king of Ireland. Deposed after Bruce's defeat, he later regained power and died at Lough Laoghaire in 1325.
zh: 多姆纳尔·奥尼尔（约1245—1325）是布莱恩·查哈·安·杜纳之子，自1283年起几度成为蒂尔欧文国王。阿尔斯特伯爵理查德·奥格·德·伯格两度废黜他，改立他的宗族亲属尼亚尔·库兰纳和布莱恩；1295年，多姆纳尔在克里夫之战击杀布莱恩，夺回王位。1314年他邀请爱德华·布鲁斯进军爱尔兰，1317年又向教皇约翰二十二世上书，谴责英格兰人的统治、拥戴布鲁斯为爱尔兰国王。布鲁斯败亡后他一度被废，后又复位，1325年在洛赫莱里去世。

en: Domhnall Óg Ó Néill (died 1234) was king of Tír Eoghain and the son of Aodh Méith. When Aodh Méith died in 1230, Domhnall succeeded him despite opposition from the Meic Lochlainn, whose claimant Muirchertach mac Muirchertaig was backed by part of the Cenél nEógain. After four years of rule he was killed in 1234 by Domhnall mac Muirchertaig Mac Lochlainn, who seized the throne. His sons Hugh Boy and Niall Cúlanch later fought each other for the kingship.
zh: 多姆纳尔·奥格·奥尼尔（？—1234）是蒂尔欧文国王、艾德·梅思之子。1230年艾德·梅思去世后，他不顾麦克洛克林家族的反对继位，该家族的争夺者穆尔切塔赫·麦克穆尔切蒂得到部分基内尔欧文人的支持。在位四年后，他于1234年被多姆纳尔·麦克穆尔切塔赫·麦克洛克林杀害，王位亦被篡夺。他的儿子休·博伊和尼亚尔·库兰纳后来为争夺王位互相攻伐。

en: Muirchertach Mac Lochlainn (died 1166), grandson of Domnall Ua Lochlainn, was king of Tír Eoghain and high king of Ireland from about 1156, succeeding Toirdelbach Ua Conchobair. He saw off Ruaidrí Ua Conchobair's bid to overthrow him in 1159, but never broke the resistance of the Cenél Conaill and the Ulaid. In 1166 he swore to the Bishop of Armagh to keep a truce with Ulaid, then seized and blinded its king, Eochaid Mac Duinn Sléibe. His allies deserted him, and he was cut down with sixteen of his followers; contemporaries read his death as Saint Patrick's vengeance.
