zh: 穆尔切赫塔赫·麦克·洛克林（？—1166）是多姆纳尔·洛赫兰之孙、蒂龙国王，约于1156年继塔伊尔代尔巴赫·奥康纳之后成为爱尔兰至高王，直至去世。1159年他挫败了罗里·奥康纳推翻他的企图，却始终压服不了蒂尔康奈尔人与乌拉德人。1166年他向阿马主教宣誓遵守与乌拉德的休战，随后却擒获并弄瞎乌拉德国王埃奥凯德·麦克·敦·斯莱贝。盟友立刻弃他而去，他与十六名随从一同被杀；时人把他的死视为圣帕特里克的报应。

en: Niall Cúlánach Ó Néill (c. 1231–1291), whose nickname means of the long back hair, was a son of Domhnall Óg and three times king of Tír Eoghain. In 1261 he took the kingship from his brother Hugh Boy but was badly defeated by Donnell Óg O'Donnell and expelled in 1262; he later ruled Inishowen. In 1286 Earl Richard Óg de Burgh deposed Donnell Ó Néill and installed Niall, who lost power in 1290 and was restored in 1291. Donnell killed him later that year, after which de Burgh enthroned Hugh Boy's son Brian.
zh: 尼亚尔·库兰纳·奥尼尔（约1231—1291，绰号意为“蓄长发者”）是多姆纳尔·奥格之子，曾三度成为蒂尔欧文国王。1261年他从兄弟休·博伊手中夺取王位，同年被多姆纳尔·奥格·奥唐奈重创，1262年遭到驱逐；后来他成为伊尼什欧文的统治者。1286年阿尔斯特伯爵理查德·奥格·德·伯格废黜多姆纳尔·奥尼尔，改立尼亚尔；他1290年失位，1291年复位，同年便被多姆纳尔杀死，德·伯格随后改立休·博伊之子布莱恩。

en: Niall Glúndub mac Áeda (died 919) was king of the Cenél nEógain and, from 916, High King of Ireland. A son of Áed Findliath, his mother was Máel Muire, daughter of Kenneth MacAlpin, king of Scots. He succeeded his brother as king of Ailech in 911, and after the death of High King Flann Sinna in 916 he took the high kingship and revived the traditional Óenach Tailteann gathering. He fought the Norse Uí Ímair as they reoccupied Dublin, and fell with twelve chieftains against Sihtric Cáech at the Battle of Islandbridge on 14 September 919.
zh: 尼尔·格伦杜布（？—919年）是凯内尔·欧文部族的国王，916年起成为爱尔兰至高王。他是艾德·芬德利思之子，母亲为苏格兰国王肯尼思·麦卡尔平之女梅尔·穆雷。911年，他接替兄长成为阿利赫国王；916年至高王弗兰·辛纳去世后继任至高王，并恢复了传统的泰尔廷集会。他率军抵抗重新占据都柏林的诺斯人伊瓦尔家族，于919年9月14日的岛桥战役中被西特里克·凯赫击败，与十二名酋长一同战死。

en: Niall Mór O'Neill was king of Tír Eoghain in 1364–1397, succeeding his father Aodh Reamhar. In 1375 he crushed the Anglo-Irish at Downpatrick, reducing the Earldom of Ulster to the country around Carrickfergus and restoring O'Neill power east of the Bann. In 1395 he did homage to Richard II during the king's Irish expedition, despite Roger Mortimer's claim to Ulster. A patron of poets who hailed him as king of Tara, he abdicated in 1397 and died in 1398. The Annals of Ulster style him high-king of Ulster and claimant to the kingship of Ireland.
zh: 尼尔·莫尔·奥尼尔在1364—1397年任蒂尔埃奥甘国王，继父艾·鲁尔而立。1375年他在唐帕特里克大破英爱联军，将阿尔斯特伯爵领压缩到卡里克弗格斯一带，恢复了奥尼尔家族在班恩河以东的势力。1395年英王理查二世远征爱尔兰时，他不顾罗杰·莫蒂默对阿尔斯特的权利主张，向理查二世称臣行效忠礼。他庇护诗人，被颂扬为“塔拉之王”；1397年退位，1398年去世。《阿尔斯特编年史》称他为阿尔斯特至高王、爱尔兰王位的要求者。

en: Niall Ruadh Ó Néill, whose nickname means the Red, was a son of Áed in Macáem Tóinlesc and briefly king of Tír Eoghain in 1230. By Nuala, daughter of High King Ruaidrí Ua Conchobair, he fathered Brian Chatha an Dúna, later high king of Ireland.
zh: 尼亚尔·鲁阿·奥尼尔（绰号意为“红发者”）是艾德·安·马凯姆·托因莱斯克之子，1230年曾短暂担任蒂尔欧文国王。他娶高王鲁艾德里·奥康诺之女努阿拉，生子布莱恩·查哈·安·杜纳，后者后来成为爱尔兰高王。

en: Agnes of Bavaria (1335–1352) was a daughter of Emperor Louis IV and Margaret of Hainaut, born in Munich into the Wittelsbach dynasty. Raised among the Poor Clares, she refused a noble marriage arranged by her relatives and instead took the veil. Frail throughout her short life, she died as a nun on 11 November 1352. Her reputation for piety endured, and the cause for her beatification was opened on 21 February 1705.
zh: 巴伐利亚的阿格尼丝（1335—1352）是神圣罗马帝国皇帝路易四世与埃诺的玛格丽特之女，生于慕尼黑，属维特尔斯巴赫家族。她在贫穷修女会的修女中间长大，拒绝了亲属为她安排的贵族婚姻，选择出家。她一生体弱，1352年11月11日以修女身份早逝。她虔诚的名声流传下来，教廷于1705年2月21日为她启动宣福程序。

en: Albert I Wittelsbach (1336–1404), third son of Emperor Louis IV, was a younger son expecting at best an appanage, yet came to rule Holland, Hainaut, Zeeland and Bavaria-Straubing. When his brother William went mad, the 22-year-old Albert became regent in 1358; trade improved, though the Hook and Cod factions simmered. He succeeded William as count in 1389, having married his daughters into leading houses: Margaret to John the Fearless of Burgundy, Joanna to King Wenceslaus. The worst crisis of his reign began with a murder. His mistress Aleid van Poelgeest, a Cod partisan resented for her political influence, was killed at The Hague on 22 September 1392 by Hook nobles. Albert hunted down the Hooks with sword and fire, and his son William, fearing for his safety, left for Hainaut. His last years went to campaigns against the Frisians, never fully conquered. After he died in 1404 the Burgundian match brought his lands to Margaret's son Philip.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/阿爾布雷希特一世_(巴伐利亞)
zh: 阿尔布雷希特一世·维特尔斯巴赫（1336—1404）是皇帝路易四世的第三子，本是至多指望分得一份附属领地的幼子，后来却统治荷兰、埃诺、泽兰和巴伐利亚-施特劳宾。兄长威廉发疯后，年仅二十二岁的他于1358年出任摄政；贸易有所发展，鱼钩派与鳕鱼派的纷争仍未平息。1389年他继威廉为伯爵，此前已让女儿们嫁入显赫家族：玛格丽特嫁给勃艮第的无畏者约翰，约翰娜嫁给国王文策尔。他在位期间最严重的危机始于一桩谋杀：他的情妇阿莱德·范·普尔赫斯特属鳕鱼派，因政治影响力招致怨恨，1392年9月22日在海牙被鱼钩派贵族杀害。阿尔布雷希特以刀火追剿鱼钩派，逐一攻取其城堡；其子威廉担心自身安全，出走埃诺。晚年他连年征讨弗里斯兰人，始终未能完全征服。1404年他去世，勃艮第联姻最终使他的领地归入玛格丽特之子腓力名下。

en: Anna of Bavaria (c. 1326–1361), daughter of the Emperor Louis IV and Margaret of Hainaut, married John I, Duke of Lower Bavaria, in Munich on 18 April 1339, and was widowed when the young duke died in December 1340.
zh: 巴伐利亚的安娜（约1326—1361）是皇帝路易四世与埃诺的玛格丽特之女，1339年4月18日在慕尼黑嫁给下巴伐利亚公爵约翰一世，1340年12月年幼的公爵去世，她就此守寡。

en: Beatrice of Świdnica (1290–1322) was a Piast princess, daughter of Duke Bolko I of Jawor-Świdnica and Beatrice of Brandenburg. After her father died in 1301, her uncle Herman of Brandenburg was her guardian until her brother Bernard took power in 1305. Bernard arranged her marriage to Louis IV of Upper Bavaria in 1308. She bore six children, three surviving to adulthood: Matilda, Louis V the Brandenburger and Stephen II. In October 1314 Louis was elected German king in rivalry with Frederick of Austria, making Beatrice a rival queen to Frederick's wife Isabella. She died in Munich in August 1322.
zh: 希维德尼察的贝翠丝（1290—1322年）是西里西亚皮亚斯特家族的公主，亚沃尔-希维德尼察公爵布尔科一世与勃兰登堡的贝翠丝之女。1301年父亲去世后，由舅父勃兰登堡藩侯赫尔曼监护，直到1305年兄长贝尔纳德掌权。贝尔纳德安排她在1308年嫁给上巴伐利亚公爵路易四世。她生有六个子女，仅三人长大成人：玛蒂尔德、勃兰登堡人路易五世和施特凡二世。1314年10月，路易在与奥地利的腓特烈并立相争的情况下当选德意志国王，贝翠丝也成为与腓特烈之妻伊莎贝拉并列的对立王后。1322年8月，她在慕尼黑去世。

en: Dietrich von Parsberg was a Bavarian nobleman of the Parsberg ministerial family, whose seat was Parsberg Castle in the Upper Palatinate. Around 1300 his brother Konrad, protonotary of Duke Rudolf I of Upper Bavaria, secured for Dietrich and their brother Heinrich the two offices of Viztum, the duke's deputies who each administered roughly half of Upper Bavaria. When Rudolf I lost his struggle with his brother Louis IV, the Parsberg brothers lost their leading positions after 1310; Dietrich thereafter served the victorious Louis IV.
zh: 迪特里希·冯·帕尔斯贝格出身巴伐利亚侍臣贵族帕尔斯贝格家族，家族居城是上普法尔茨的帕尔斯贝格城堡。约1300年，他的兄长、上巴伐利亚公爵鲁道夫一世的首席书记官康拉德，安排迪特里希与兄弟海因里希出任公爵治下仅有的两名代理人，两人分管上巴伐利亚约一半的领地。鲁道夫一世在与弟弟路易四世的争斗中失败后，帕尔斯贝格兄弟于1310年后失去要职，迪特里希此后转而为获胜的路易四世效力。

en: Elisabeth of Bavaria (1329–1402) was a daughter of Emperor Louis IV and Margaret II of Hainaut. On 22 November 1350 she married Cangrande II della Scala, who became lord of Verona in 1352; the marriage was childless, and in 1359 Cangrande was murdered by his brother Cansignorio. In 1362 she married Ulrich, son and heir of Count Eberhard II of Württemberg, by whom she had the future Count Eberhard III. Ulrich fell at the Battle of Döffingen on 23 August 1388 before he could succeed. Elisabeth died in Stuttgart on 2 August 1402.
zh: 巴伐利亚的伊丽莎白（1329—1402）是皇帝路易四世与埃诺女伯爵玛格丽特二世之女。1350年11月22日，她嫁给坎格兰德二世·德拉·斯卡拉，后者于1352年成为维罗纳领主；这段婚姻没有子嗣，1359年坎格兰德被其兄弟坎西尼奥里奥刺杀。1362年，她改嫁符腾堡伯爵埃伯哈德二世之子兼继承人乌尔里希，生下后来的伯爵埃伯哈德三世。乌尔里希于1388年8月23日在德芬根战役中阵亡，未能继位。伊丽莎白1402年8月2日卒于斯图加特。

en: Johannes Hake, called Johann von Göttingen (c. 1280–1349), was one of the most famous physicians of his age. After studying medicine in Paris and teaching it at Montpellier, he served as doctor to Emperor Louis IV, Baldwin of Trier, King John of Bohemia and Pope Benedict XII, and in 1331 he wrote the poison treatise De cautela a venenis. Made bishop of Verden in 1331 and translated to Freising in 1341, he spent most of his later years at the papal court in Avignon. He died probably on 3 October 1349 and was buried in Avignon.
zh: 约翰内斯·哈克，人称“哥廷根的约翰”（约1280—1349），是当时最负盛名的医生之一。他在巴黎学医、在蒙彼利埃教授医学，曾为皇帝路易四世、特里尔的巴尔杜因、波希米亚国王约翰和教皇本笃十二世诊治，1331年撰写了一部论述如何防备毒物的专著。他1331年出任费尔登主教，1341年调任弗赖辛主教，晚年多在阿维尼翁教廷度过。他可能于1349年10月3日去世，葬于阿维尼翁。

en: Jutta of Świdnica (1285/1287–1320) was a Piast princess, eldest daughter of Duke Bolko I of Świdnica and Beatrix of Brandenburg. Around 1297 she married Duke Stephen I of Lower Bavaria, remaining in Silesia until about 1299 because of her age. Stephen ruled Lower Bavaria from 1290 and died at Landshut in 1310, leaving her with five children. Their sons Henry XIV and Otto IV succeeded as dukes; one daughter married Otto of Austria and another Count Henry II of Gorizia. Jutta died in September 1320 and was buried beside her husband in Seligenthal Abbey at Landshut.
zh: 希维德尼察的尤迪特（1285/1287—1320年）是皮亚斯特家族的公主，希维德尼察-亚沃尔公爵布尔科一世与勃兰登堡的贝阿特丽克丝的长女。约1297年她嫁给下巴伐利亚公爵施特凡一世，因年幼直到约1299年才离开西里西亚。施特凡自1290年起统治下巴伐利亚，1310年死于兰茨胡特，留给她五个孩子。儿子亨利十四世和奥托四世成为公爵；一个女儿嫁给奥地利的奥托，另一个嫁给格尔茨伯爵亨利二世。尤迪特于1320年9月去世，葬在兰茨胡特的塞利根塔尔修道院，与丈夫合葬。

en: Louis II Wittelsbach (1229–1294) ruled Upper Bavaria and the Rhenish Palatinate from the 1255 partition of the Wittelsbach lands that left Lower Bavaria to his brother Henry XIII. In 1256 he had his wife Maria of Brabant beheaded for suspected adultery and founded Fürstenfeld Abbey in expiation. In 1257 he and Henry repelled an invasion by Ottokar II of Bohemia. During the Interregnum he backed the Hohenstaufen Conradin, was excommunicated in 1266, escorted him as far as Verona in 1267 and inherited Swabian lands after his execution in 1268. He helped elect Rudolf of Habsburg in 1273 and fought beside him when Ottokar was defeated and killed at Dürnkrut in 1278. He died at Heidelberg in 1294.
zh: 路易二世·维特尔斯巴赫（1229—1294）在1255年维特尔斯巴赫家族领地分割后获得上巴伐利亚和莱茵行宫伯爵领，其弟亨利十三世分得下巴伐利亚。1256年他以涉嫌通奸为由将妻子布拉班特的玛丽亚斩首，后修建菲斯滕费尔德修道院赎罪。1257年，他与亨利共同击退波希米亚国王奥托卡二世的入侵。大空位时期他支持霍亨斯陶芬家族的康拉丁，1266年被开除教籍，1267年护送康拉丁至维罗纳，1268年康拉丁被处死后继承了他在施瓦本的部分领地。他于1273年助力选出哈布斯堡的鲁道夫，并于1278年在迪恩克鲁特战役中与鲁道夫并肩作战，奥托卡战败身亡。1294年，他卒于海德堡。

en: Louis IV Wittelsbach (1282–1347), called the Bavarian, was Holy Roman Emperor from 1328 and the last Bavarian to wear the German crown until 1742. Elected King of the Romans in 1314 in a disputed double election against his Habsburg cousin Frederick the Fair, he defeated and captured Frederick at Mühldorf in 1322; the rivals later reconciled. The French Pope John XXII excommunicated him over his claim to rule without papal approval, so Louis marched to Rome, was crowned emperor in 1328, and backed an antipope against John. His court at Munich became a refuge for Franciscan dissidents fleeing Avignon, William of Ockham among them. Brandenburg came to his house in 1323, he became Duke of Lower Bavaria in 1340, and in 1345 his wife Margaret inherited Hainaut, Holland and Zeeland, bringing those counties under his rule. He died on 11 October 1347.
zh: 路易四世·维特尔斯巴赫（1282—1347），绰号“巴伐利亚人”，1328年起任神圣罗马皇帝，也是直到1742年为止最后一位登上德意志王位的巴伐利亚人。1314年他在与哈布斯堡表亲美男子腓特烈的双重选举争议中当选罗马人的国王，1322年在米尔多夫战役击败并俘获腓特烈，二人后来和解。法国籍教皇约翰二十二世因他不经教皇认可便行使皇权而开除其教籍，路易遂进军罗马，于1328年加冕为帝，并拥立对立教皇与约翰抗衡。他在慕尼黑的宫廷成了逃离阿维尼翁的方济各会异见者的庇护所，奥卡姆的威廉便是其中之一。1323年勃兰登堡归入他的家族，1340年他成为下巴伐利亚公爵，1345年妻子玛格丽特继承埃诺、荷兰和泽兰，这些伯国也由他统治。1347年10月11日，他去世。

en: Louis VI (1328–1365) was called the Roman because he was born in Rome in 1328, while his father, Louis IV, was there to be crowned emperor. He became Duke of Upper Bavaria in 1347. Expecting the Polish crown through his marriage to Cunigunde, daughter of Casimir III, he yielded Holland and Hainaut to his brothers William and Albert in 1349. In 1351 he took Brandenburg from his half-brother Louis V in exchange for sole rule of Upper Bavaria. There he faced the False Waldemar, an impostor backed by several cities and by Charles IV until the Wittelsbachs came to terms with the emperor, and he had to drop claims in Mecklenburg and Pomerania. The Golden Bull of 1356 confirmed him as prince-elector. Childless by both wives, and at odds with his brother Stephen II over the Bavarian inheritance, he and his brother Otto V promised Brandenburg to Charles IV in 1364. He died in Berlin in 1365.
zh: 路易六世·维特尔斯巴赫（1328—1365）绰号“罗马人”，因1328年生于罗马、时值其父路易四世在那里加冕为皇帝而得名。1347年起他任上巴伐利亚公爵。他期望通过与波兰卡齐米日三世之女昆尼贡德的婚姻取得波兰王位，于1349年将荷兰和埃诺让给弟弟威廉和阿尔布雷希特。1351年，他以单独统治上巴伐利亚为条件，从异母兄路易五世手中换得勃兰登堡。在那里他遭到伪瓦尔德马的挑战，这个冒名者得到若干城市和皇帝查理四世的支持，直到维特尔斯巴赫家族与皇帝达成和解；他还不得不放弃在梅克伦堡和波美拉尼亚的权利主张。1356年的《金玺诏书》确认其选帝侯地位。两任妻子均无子嗣，他又与兄弟斯特凡二世为巴伐利亚继承权失和，遂与弟弟奥托五世于1364年允诺由查理四世继承勃兰登堡。1365年他卒于柏林。

en: Margaret II of Avesnes (1311–1356), daughter of Count William I of Hainaut, married Emperor Louis IV of Bavaria in 1324 and was crowned Holy Roman Empress in Rome in 1328. When her brother William II fell at Warns in 1345, Louis declared Hainaut, Holland and Zeeland his wife's possessions. She bought the support of the towns of Holland and Zeeland, where a woman's right to inherit was doubted, with economic privileges. After seven months she was called back to Germany, and when Louis died in 1347 she resigned her lands to her son William for an allowance. He withheld it, she took back her rights in 1350, and the Hook and Cod wars began between her supporters and his. Edward III won a naval battle for her off Veere in 1351, but weeks later her side was crushed at Vlaardingen, and in 1354 she settled, keeping Hainaut for life. She died in 1356, leaving William the whole inheritance.
zh: 玛格丽特二世·德·阿韦讷（1311—1356）是埃诺伯爵威廉一世之女，1324年嫁给皇帝巴伐利亚人路易四世，1328年在罗马加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇后。1345年，其兄威廉二世在瓦恩斯战死，路易宣布埃诺、荷兰与泽兰是妻子的领地。荷兰和泽兰当时对女性继承权存疑，她向两地城镇授予经济特权以赢得支持。七个月后，她被召回德意志，1347年路易去世，她让位于儿子威廉，换取津贴。威廉拒付，1350年她收回权位，支持她的“鱼钩派”与支持威廉的“鳕鱼派”由此爆发内战。1351年，爱德华三世在费勒外海为她赢得一场海战，数周后她这一方却在菲拉尔丁根惨败；1354年双方议和，她保留埃诺至终老。1356年她去世，整个遗产由威廉继承。

en: Margaret of Bavaria (1325–1374) was the eldest daughter of Emperor Louis IV and Margaret II, Countess of Hainaut. In 1351 at Buda she married Stephen, Duke of Slavonia, youngest son of King Charles I of Hungary. When Stephen died in 1354, she ruled Slavonia, Croatia and Dalmatia as regent for their infant son John, the heir presumptive to Hungary and Poland. She remarried Gerlach von Hohenlohe in 1356, but during that year's war with Venice the Hungarian crown ended the duchy's autonomy and removed her from power. John died in 1360, and Margaret died in 1374.
zh: 巴伐利亚的玛格丽特（1325—1374）是皇帝路易四世与埃诺女伯爵玛格丽特二世的长女。1351年，她在布达嫁给匈牙利国王查理一世的幼子、斯拉沃尼亚公爵斯特凡。1354年斯特凡去世后，她以摄政身份为幼子约翰统治斯拉沃尼亚、克罗地亚和达尔马提亚，约翰被视为匈牙利和波兰的推定继承人。1356年她改嫁格拉赫·冯·霍恩洛厄，但在同年匈牙利与威尼斯的战争中，匈牙利王室取消了公国的自治权，将她罢免。约翰于1360年夭折，玛格丽特卒于1374年。

en: Matilda of Habsburg (1253–1304) was the eldest daughter of King Rudolf I of Germany and Gertrude of Hohenberg. On 24 October 1273 at Aachen she became the third wife of Louis II the Strict, Duke of Upper Bavaria and Count Palatine of the Rhine; the marriage linked the rising Habsburgs with the Wittelsbach dynasty. Her children included Rudolf I of Bavaria and the future Emperor Louis IV, born in 1282. After Louis II died in 1294, she ruled Upper Bavaria as regent for her young son until 1301. She died at Munich on 23 December 1304.
zh: 哈布斯堡的玛蒂尔达（1253—1304）是德意志国王鲁道夫一世与霍恩堡的格特鲁德的长女。1273年10月24日，她在亚琛成为上巴伐利亚公爵兼莱茵行宫伯爵“严厉者”路易二世的第三任妻子，这桩婚姻把崛起的哈布斯堡家族与维特尔斯巴赫家族联系在一起。她的子女包括巴伐利亚公爵鲁道夫一世和1282年出生的未来皇帝路易四世。1294年路易二世去世后，她为幼子摄政上巴伐利亚，直到1301年，1304年12月23日死于慕尼黑。

en: Michael of Cesena (c. 1270–1342) was the Franciscan minister general whose defense of apostolic poverty broke with Pope John XXII and carried him into the emperor's camp. Born at Cesena, he studied theology in Paris and taught at Bologna before his election as minister general in 1316. At first he sided with the pope in suppressing the Spiritual Franciscans, but in 1322 the Perugia chapter endorsed his teaching that Christ and the apostles owned no property, and John XXII condemned it. Summoned to Avignon in 1327 and forbidden to leave, Michael fled in 1328 with William of Ockham and was taken to Pisa, where he found protection with Emperor Louis IV, himself in conflict with the pope. Excommunicated, he was deposed by the Paris chapter of 1329, and in 1331 the Perpignan chapter expelled him and sentenced him to life imprisonment. He stayed in Munich until his death in 1342; he was officially rehabilitated in 1359.
zh: 切塞纳的迈克尔（约1270—1342）是方济各会总会长，因捍卫使徒守贫而与教皇约翰二十二世决裂，最终投奔皇帝一方。他生于切塞纳，在巴黎研习神学，后在博洛尼亚任教，1316年当选总会长。起初他站在教皇一边压制方济各会灵修派，但1322年佩鲁贾总会通过了他的主张，认定基督与使徒不蓄私产，约翰二十二世则谴责这一教义。1327年迈克尔被召至阿维尼翁，并被禁止离开；1328年他与奥卡姆的威廉一同出逃，被送到比萨，在同样与教皇对立的皇帝路易四世处得到庇护。他被开除教籍，1329年被巴黎总会免职，1331年佩皮尼昂总会又将他逐出修会，判处终身监禁。此后他一直留在慕尼黑，1342年死于当地，1359年正式获平反。

en: Rudolf I Wittelsbach (1274–1319) succeeded his father Louis II in 1294 as Duke of Upper Bavaria and Count Palatine of the Rhine and married Mechtild, daughter of King Adolf of Nassau. He supported Adolf at Göllheim in 1298, where the king was killed. His reign was overshadowed by his brother Louis IV: besieged at Heidelberg in 1301, Rudolf accepted Louis as co-regent. He voted for Henry VII in 1308 and accompanied him to Italy in 1310, but returned amid disputes with Louis. The brothers fought a civil war and made peace at Munich in 1313. He voted for the Habsburg Frederick the Fair in 1314 and yielded rule to Louis in 1317. The 1329 Treaty of Pavia granted the Palatinate to his sons Rudolf II and Rupert I and grandson Rupert II, establishing their branch of the dynasty.
zh: 鲁道夫一世·维特尔斯巴赫（1274—1319）1294年继承父亲路易二世，任上巴伐利亚公爵兼莱茵行宫伯爵，并娶德意志国王、拿骚的阿道夫之女梅希蒂尔德。1298年他在格尔海姆支持阿道夫作战，国王在战斗中身亡。他的统治笼罩在与弟弟路易四世的争斗中：1301年海德堡被围，他被迫接受路易为共同摄政。1308年他投票支持亨利七世，1310年随其远征意大利，却因与路易的争端而返回。兄弟二人兵戎相见，1313年在慕尼黑议和。1314年他投票支持哈布斯堡的美男子腓特烈，1317年将统治权让给路易。1329年的《帕维亚条约》将普法尔茨授予其子鲁道夫二世、鲁普雷希特一世和孙子鲁普雷希特二世，确立了他们的家族支系。

en: Stephen II (1319–1375), second son of Emperor Louis IV, ruled as duke of Bavaria from 1347. After the 1349 partition he governed Holland and Lower Bavaria-Landshut with his brothers William I and Albert I, keeping only Lower Bavaria-Landshut after 1353. He joined Charles IV's Italian expedition in 1354, inherited Upper Bavaria in 1363 and invaded Tyrol, then renounced it to the Habsburgs at the Peace of Schärding in 1369. His feud with Louis VI the Roman helped lose the Wittelsbachs Brandenburg. He died at Landshut on 13 May 1375 and was buried in Munich's Frauenkirche.
zh: 斯特凡二世（1319—1375）是皇帝路易四世的次子，1347年起任巴伐利亚公爵。1349年诸兄弟瓜分领地后，他与兄弟威廉一世、阿尔布雷希特一世共同统治荷兰与下巴伐利亚—兰茨胡特，1353年后仅保下巴伐利亚—兰茨胡特。1354年他随查理四世远征意大利，1363年继承上巴伐利亚并入侵蒂罗尔，最终于1369年依《谢尔丁和约》将蒂罗尔让给哈布斯堡家族。他与路易六世“罗马人”的反目，使维特尔斯巴赫家族丢掉了勃兰登堡。1375年5月13日他卒于兰茨胡特，葬于慕尼黑圣母教堂。

en: Stephen III (1337–1413), called the Magnificent, was the eldest son of Duke Stephen II of Bavaria and Elizabeth of Sicily. From 1375 he ruled Bavaria jointly with his brothers, until the 1392 partition gave him Bavaria-Ingolstadt, where he founded the Ingolstadt line of the Wittelsbachs. He repeatedly fought his brothers and nephews over their shares, supported King Rupert against the Luxemburgs, and backed the failed Munich citizens' uprising of 1403. His daughter Isabeau married Charles VI of France. A final bid to reconquer Tyrol in 1410 failed, and he died at Niederschönenfeld in 1413.
zh: 斯特凡三世（1337—1413），人称“豪华者”，是巴伐利亚公爵斯特凡二世与西西里的伊丽莎白的长子。1375年起他与兄弟共同统治巴伐利亚；1392年公国分裂，他分得巴伐利亚-因戈尔施塔特，开创维特尔斯巴赫家族的因戈尔施塔特支系。他为领地份额一再与兄弟和侄子交战，支持国王鲁普雷希特对抗卢森堡家族，并支持1403年失败的慕尼黑市民起义。其女伊萨博嫁给法国国王查理六世。1410年他最后一次试图夺回蒂罗尔，仍告失败，1413年死于尼德舍嫩费尔德。

en: William Wittelsbach (1330–1389), second son of Emperor Louis IV and Margaret of Hainaut, was Duke of Bavaria-Straubing and Count of Holland, Hainaut and Zeeland. His rule began as a war with his own mother. When the nobles of Holland called Margaret back in 1350, the Cod league formed behind William in May and the Hook league in September, and civil war followed. Her brother-in-law Edward III came to her aid, yet William won at Zwartewaal in 1351, weeks after losing the naval battle of Veere. In 1354 she recognised him as Count of Holland and Zeeland, and her death in 1356 left him Hainaut as well. A chronicler remembered him as distant and inscrutable, with a single confidant. He returned from England in 1357 and lost his reason, killing one of his knights, Gerard van Wateringe. His brother Albert became regent in 1358, and William spent his last three decades confined at Le Quesnoy.
zh: 威廉·维特尔斯巴赫（1330—1389）是皇帝路易四世与埃诺的玛格丽特的次子，任巴伐利亚-施特劳宾公爵，兼荷兰、埃诺和泽兰伯爵。他的统治从与亲生母亲的战争开始。1350年荷兰贵族请玛格丽特回国，当年5月鳕鱼派在威廉身边结盟，9月鱼钩派随之成立，内战爆发。玛格丽特的妹夫爱德华三世出面相助，但1351年威廉在费勒海战失利几周后，又在兹瓦尔特瓦尔获胜。1354年母亲承认他为荷兰和泽兰伯爵，1356年她去世，埃诺也归他所有。有编年史家记他疏远难测，只有一位亲信。1357年他从英格兰返回后精神失常，亲手杀死骑士赫拉德·范·瓦特灵厄。1358年起由弟弟阿尔布雷希特摄政，威廉余生的三十年被囚禁在勒凯努瓦城堡。

en: William of Ockham (c. 1287–1347) was an English Franciscan philosopher and theologian, trained at Oxford, whose commentary on the Sentences and works on logic made him a leading nominalist thinker; he gives his name to Occam's razor, the principle of parsimony. In 1324 he was summoned to Avignon to answer for the Sentences commentary, and there he was drawn into the dispute over apostolic poverty. At the request of the Franciscan Minister General Michael of Cesena he studied the bulls in which Pope John XXII rejected the order's doctrine, and sided with Michael. On 26 May 1328 he slipped away from Avignon with Michael and other dissidents, and was excommunicated on 6 June. They took refuge in Munich under Emperor Louis IV, himself at odds with the pope. For years Ockham wrote to defend imperial power against the papacy and to have John and his successors deposed. He died at Munich in April 1347, shortly before the Black Death reached the city.
zh: 奥卡姆的威廉（约1287—1347）是英格兰方济各会哲学家、神学家，曾在牛津受教，所著《箴言书》评注与逻辑学著作使他成为唯名论的代表人物；以他命名的“奥卡姆剃刀”是著名的思维经济原则。1324年，他被召至阿维尼翁，为自己的《箴言书》评注作答辩，并在那里卷入使徒守贫之争。应方济各会总会长切塞纳的迈克尔之请，他研读了教皇约翰二十二世驳斥本会教义的诏书，站在迈克尔一边。1328年5月26日，他与迈克尔等异见者悄悄逃离阿维尼翁，6月6日被开除教籍。他们在同样与教皇不睦的皇帝路易四世庇护下避居慕尼黑。此后多年，威廉著书维护皇权、对抗教权，并要求罢黜约翰及其继任者。1347年4月，他死于慕尼黑，不久之后黑死病传到该城。

en: Albert II of Hohenlohe-Uffenheim (c. 1250–1312) was a Franconian nobleman, lord of Hohenlohe and Uffenheim-Speckfeld, and the eldest son of Godfrey of Hohenlohe-Uffenheim and Elisabeth of Zollern, daughter of the burgrave of Nuremberg. On 7 November 1289 he married Adelaide of Berg-Schelklingen. At a Nuremberg tournament in 1290 his lance struck Louis of Bavaria, son of Duke Louis the Strict of Upper Bavaria, who died of the wound ten days later. Albert ruled the Uffenheim line until 1312; his son Louis succeeded him, and two younger sons became bishops of Bamberg and Würzburg.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特二世·冯·霍恩洛厄-乌芬海姆（约1250—1312年）是法兰克尼亚贵族、霍恩洛厄与乌芬海姆-施佩克费尔德领主，为乌芬海姆的戈特弗里德与纽伦堡城堡伯爵之女伊丽莎白·冯·措伦的长子。1289年11月7日，他娶阿德尔海德·冯·贝格-舍尔克林根为妻。1290年在纽伦堡的骑士比武中，他的长矛刺中巴伐利亚的路德维希——上巴伐利亚公爵“严厉者”路德维希之子，路德维希十天后伤重而死。阿尔布雷希特统治乌芬海姆支系直至1312年，子路德维希继位，另有两个幼子分别成为班贝格与维尔茨堡主教。

en: Godfrey I of Hohenlohe (c. 1190–1254 or 1255) was a Franconian nobleman, knight and poet in Staufer service. Eldest son of Henry of Hohenlohe, he ruled the family lands around Weikersheim from about 1215 and joined Emperor Frederick II's court in 1220, escorting his bride Isabella of Jerusalem to Italy in 1225. Rewarded for loyalty against the rebel King Henry VII, he received Langenburg Castle in 1235 and the county of Romagna. From 1237 to 1246 he led young King Conrad IV's privy council, effectively governing the empire north of the Alps, and fought at Frankfurt in 1246.
zh: 霍恩洛厄的戈特弗里德一世（约1190—1254或1255年）是效命于霍亨斯陶芬王朝的法兰克尼亚贵族、骑士与诗人。他是海因里希·冯·霍恩洛厄的长子，约1215年起统辖魏克斯海姆一带的家族领地，1220年起追随皇帝腓特烈二世，1225年护送皇帝的未婚妻、耶路撒冷的伊莎贝拉前往意大利。他因忠于皇帝、对抗叛王亨利七世而受赏，1235年获朗根堡城堡，并受封罗马涅伯爵。1237至1246年，他主持幼王康拉德四世的枢密会议，实际执掌阿尔卑斯山以北的帝国政务，1246年参加了法兰克福战役。

en: Kraft I of Hohenlohe-Weikersheim (c. 1240–19 December 1313) was a Franconian nobleman and knight, a son of Godfrey I through whom all Hohenlohe lines living after 1412 descend. First documented in 1256, he consolidated the family estates around Weikersheim, Langenburg and Öhringen, acquired Ingelfingen c. 1275 and inherited Röttingen in 1290. During the Interregnum he served the bishop of Würzburg and fought at the Cyriakus Battle on 8 August 1266. From 1273 he served King Rudolf of Habsburg, joining the 1276 Vienna campaign and fighting in Rudolf's victory over Ottokar of Bohemia on the Marchfeld on 26 August 1278.
zh: 霍恩洛厄-魏克斯海姆的克拉夫特一世（约1240—1313年12月19日）是法兰克尼亚贵族与骑士，戈特弗里德一世之子，1412年以后仍存续的各支霍恩洛厄家族都出自他一系。他最早于1256年见于文书，任内把家族领地逐步集中到魏克斯海姆、朗根堡和厄林根一带，约1275年购得英格尔芬根，1290年继承勒廷根。大空位时代，他效力于维尔茨堡主教，1266年8月8日参加了齐里亚库斯战役。1273年起他效力于国王鲁道夫·冯·哈布斯堡，随军参加1276年的维也纳远征，并在1278年8月26日的马希费尔德战役中助鲁道夫击败波希米亚国王奥托卡。

en: Ludwig von Hohenlohe (died 1356) was the eldest son of Albert II, Lord of Hohenlohe-Uffenheim, and Adelaide of Berg-Schelklingen. He succeeded as lord of Hohenlohe-Uffenheim-Speckfeld in Franconia and married Elizabeth of Nassau. He died between February and August 1356.
zh: 路德维希·冯·霍恩洛厄（？—1356）是霍恩洛厄-乌芬海姆领主阿尔布雷希特二世与阿德海德·冯·贝格-舍尔克林根的长子，袭为法兰克尼亚的霍恩洛厄-乌芬海姆-施佩克费尔德领主，娶拿骚的伊丽莎白为妻，于1356年2月至8月间去世。

en: Ulaghchi Khan (died 1257) was the third ruler of the Golden Horde, succeeding Sartaq Khan for less than a year in 1257. A direct descendant of Batu, he was either Sartaq's son or younger brother. The great khan Möngke nominated him while he was still a child, and Batu's senior widow Boraqchin governed as regent. Ulaghchi died before he could rule in person, and the throne passed to Batu's brother Berke. The historian H. H. Howorth instead claimed that Ulaghchi abdicated in Berke's favour. Berke later had Boraqchin executed for treason after she sought Hulagu's protection.
zh: 乌剌黑赤汗（?—1257）是金帐汗国第三位统治者，1257年继撒里答之位，在位不足一年。他是拔都的直系后裔，或为撒里答之子，或为其弟。大汗蒙哥册立他时，他年纪尚幼，由拔都的长妻博剌克真摄政。乌剌黑赤未及亲政便死去，汗位传给拔都之弟别儿哥；历史学家何渥思则认为乌剌黑赤将汗位让给了别儿哥。博剌克真后来因向旭烈兀寻求庇护，被别儿哥以叛国罪处死。

en: Ulman Stromer (1329–1407) was a Nuremberg merchant and councillor, son of the trader Heinrich Stromer. Trained in Barcelona, Genoa, Milan and Kraków, he began recording family, business and political events in his notebook in 1360. He took over the family wholesale house with his brothers in 1370 and ran a trade network from Barcelona to Riga and the Sea of Azov. A councillor from 1371, in the Cities' War of 1387 to 1389 he brought Nuremberg into the Swabian-Rhenish League against Burgrave Frederick V. In 1390 he converted the Gleissmühle on the Pegnitz into the first paper mill north of the Alps, bringing Italian papermakers north. He died of plague in 1407.
zh: 乌尔曼·施特罗默（1329—1407）是纽伦堡商人和市政议员，商人海因里希·施特罗默之子。他曾在巴塞罗那、热那亚、米兰和克拉科夫学徒，1360年开始在手记中记录家族、商业和政治事件。1370年他与兄弟接掌家族批发商号，经营的贸易网络西起巴塞罗那，东迄里加与亚速海。1371年起担任市政议员，在1387至1389年的城市战争中使纽伦堡加入施瓦本—莱茵城市同盟，对抗城堡伯爵腓特烈五世。1390年，他把佩格尼茨河畔的格莱斯磨坊改造成阿尔卑斯山以北第一座造纸坊，并从意大利请来造纸工匠。1407年他死于鼠疫。

en: Elizabeth de Burgh (1332–1363), fourth Countess of Ulster, was born at Carrickfergus Castle, the only child of William Donn de Burgh, Earl of Ulster, and Maud of Lancaster. Her father's murder in 1333 left her countess at eleven months, while de Burgh kinsmen seized the family's Irish lands in the Burke Civil War. She married Edward III's son Lionel of Antwerp at the Tower of London in 1342; Geoffrey Chaucer was her page. Their daughter Philippa, born in 1355, inherited Ulster and married Edmund Mortimer. She died in Dublin in 1363 and was buried at Bruisyard Abbey, Suffolk.
zh: 伊丽莎白·德·伯格（1332—1363）是第四代阿尔斯特女伯爵，生于卡里克弗格斯城堡，为第三代阿尔斯特伯爵威廉·唐·德·伯格与兰开斯特的莫德的独女。1333年父亲遇刺后，年仅11个月的她继承伯爵爵位，而德·伯格亲族趁伯格内战实际占有了家族在爱尔兰的领地。1342年她在伦敦塔嫁给爱德华三世之子安特卫普的莱昂内尔，杰弗里·乔叟曾做她的侍童。独女菲莉琶1355年出生，后继承阿尔斯特并嫁给埃德蒙·莫蒂默。1363年她在都柏林去世，葬于萨福克郡的布鲁西亚德修道院。

en: Joan de Burgh (c. 1300–1359), daughter of the 2nd Earl of Ulster, married Thomas FitzJohn, 2nd Earl of Kildare, and after his death in 1328 John Darcy, 1st Baron Darcy de Knayth. She mothered Maurice, 4th Earl of Kildare, and Elizabeth, Countess of Ormond.
zh: 琼·德·伯格（约1300—1359）为第二代阿尔斯特伯爵之女，先嫁第二代基尔代尔伯爵托马斯·菲茨约翰，1328年丧夫后改嫁第一代克奈斯的达西男爵约翰·达西；子莫里斯为第四代基尔代尔伯爵，女伊丽莎白为奥蒙德伯爵夫人。

en: Richard Óg de Burgh, 2nd Earl of Ulster, called the Red Earl, was the most powerful Anglo-Norman noble in Ireland of his age, succeeding his father Walter in 1271. In 1294 John FitzGerald, Earl of Kildare, seized him and held him prisoner at Lea Castle until the Irish parliament procured his release. Although his daughter Elizabeth married Robert the Bruce, he campaigned in Scotland for Edward I. He was defeated by Edward Bruce at Connor in 1315, but recovered Ulster after Bruce fell at Faughart in 1318. He died at Athassel Priory on 29 July 1326.
zh: 理查·奥格·德·伯格，第二代阿尔斯特伯爵，人称“红发伯爵”，1271年承袭父位，是当时爱尔兰最有权势的盎格鲁-诺曼贵族。1294年，基尔代尔伯爵约翰·菲茨杰拉德将他擒获，关押在利城堡，直到爱尔兰议会出面才使他获释。尽管女儿伊丽莎白嫁给了罗伯特·布鲁斯，他仍为爱德华一世出征苏格兰。1315年他在康纳被爱德华·布鲁斯击败，但1318年布鲁斯战死于福哈特后，他重新控制了阿尔斯特。1326年7月29日他在阿瑟尔修道院去世。

en: Walter de Burgh, 1st Earl of Ulster (c. 1210–1271), was an Irish peer of the House of Burgh and the second son of Richard Mór de Burgh, Lord of Connacht. He succeeded to his father's Connacht lands in 1243, and in 1263 was created Earl of Ulster after the de Lacy earldom reverted to the crown. In 1270 he and the justiciar Walter de Ufford were defeated at Áth an Chip by Aedh mac Felim Ua Conchobair. He died in Galway on 28 July 1271 and was succeeded by his son Richard Óg, the Red Earl.
zh: 沃尔特·德·伯格，第一代阿尔斯特伯爵（约1210—1271），是出身伯格家族的爱尔兰贵族，康诺特领主理查·莫尔·德·伯格的次子。1243年他承袭父亲在康诺特的领地；德·拉西家族的阿尔斯特伯爵领地收归王室后，他于1263年受封第一代阿尔斯特伯爵。1270年，他与爱尔兰总督沃尔特·德·厄福德在阿汉基普被艾德·麦克·费利姆·奥康纳击败。1271年7月28日他在戈尔韦去世，爵位由其子“红发伯爵”理查·奥格继承。

en: William Donn de Burgh (1312–1333), grandson of Richard Óg de Burgh, inherited the earldom of Ulster and was also lord of Connacht. Summoned to the English parliament in 1327, he became Lieutenant of Ireland in March 1331. In February 1332 he had his cousin Walter Liath de Burgh starved to death at Greencastle. In revenge Walter's kin murdered William near Carrickfergus in June 1333, led by Richard de Mandeville. His death plunged the de Burghs into the Burke Civil War. His infant daughter Elizabeth by Maud of Lancaster later married Lionel of Antwerp, son of Edward III.
zh: 威廉·唐·德·伯格（1312—1333）是第二代伯爵理查德·奥格·德·伯格之孙，承袭阿尔斯特伯爵爵位，同时领有康诺特。他于1327年获召出席英格兰议会，1331年3月被任命为爱尔兰总督。1332年2月，他在福伊尔湖畔的格林卡斯尔将表亲沃尔特·利亚斯·德·伯格饿死。沃尔特的亲族随即报复：1333年6月，威廉在卡里克弗格斯附近被杀，刺杀由理查德·德·曼德维尔主导。他的死使德·伯格家族陷入伯克内战。他与兰开斯特的莫德所生的幼女伊丽莎白后来嫁给英王爱德华三世之子安特卫普的莱昂内尔。

en: Brian Ó Máille was a son of Domnall Ruadh Ó Máille, King of Umaill, and is named with his brothers Cormac and Tadhg in the O'Malley genealogy recorded by Knox. After his father died in 1337 the chiefship passed to his cousin's line.
zh: 布莱恩·奥马利是乌梅尔国王多姆纳尔·鲁阿德·奥马利之子，在诺克斯记录的奥马利谱系中与兄弟科马克、泰格并列。1337年父亲死后，首领之位转入他堂亲一系。

en: Cormac Ó Máille was a son of Domnall Ruadh Ó Máille, King of Umaill. The Annals of the Four Masters record that on St Martin's Night (11 November) 1337 he and his father were slain by Clann-Merrick and other Englishmen during the Burke Civil War.
zh: 科马克·奥马利是乌梅尔国王多姆纳尔·鲁阿德·奥马利之子。《四大师年鉴》记载，1337年圣马丁之夜（11月11日），在伯克内战中，他与父亲一同被梅里克家族及其他英格兰人杀害。

en: Diarmait Ó Máille was a son of Brian mac Domnall and brother of Domnall Ruadh Ó Máille, King of Umaill. The genealogy recorded by Knox names him as father of Eoghan mac Diarmait, ancestor of every later chief of Umaill.
zh: 迪尔梅德·奥马利是布莱恩·麦克·多姆纳尔之子、乌梅尔国王多姆纳尔·鲁阿德·奥马利的弟弟。诺克斯记录的奥马利谱系把他记为欧文·麦克·迪尔梅德·奥马利之父，后来的历代乌梅尔首领都出自欧文一系。

en: Domnall Ruadh Ó Máille (died 11 November 1337) ruled Umaill, the Ó Máille seafaring kingdom around Clew Bay in what is now County Mayo, during the 1330s. A son of Brian mac Domnall, he had at least three sons, Cormac, Brian and Tadhg. The Burke Civil War brought warfare to Connacht, and on St Martin's Night 1337 he and his son Cormac were slain by Clann-Merrick and other Englishmen. His own line soon lost the chiefship to the descendants of his nephew Eoghan mac Diarmait.
zh: 多姆纳尔·鲁阿德·奥马利（？—1337）在1330年代统治奥马利家族的海上王国乌梅尔，其地在今梅奥郡克鲁湾一带。他是布莱恩·麦克·多姆纳尔之子，至少有科马克、布莱恩和泰格三个儿子。伯克内战把战火带到康诺特，1337年圣马丁之夜，他与儿子科马克被梅里克家族及其他英格兰人杀害。他的直系后裔不久失去首领之位，权力落入其侄欧文·麦克·迪尔梅德一系。

en: Eoghan mac Diarmait Ó Máille was a fourteenth-century member of the Ó Máille family, son of Diarmait and nephew of Domnall Ruadh Ó Máille, King of Umaill. After his uncle and cousin Cormac were killed in the Burke Civil War in 1337, Eoghan's branch displaced the descendants of Domnall Ruadh. He had twelve recorded sons, among them Diarmait and Domnall, and every later chief of Umaill traced descent from him.
zh: 欧文·麦克·迪尔梅德·奥马利是14世纪的奥马利家族成员，迪尔梅德之子、乌梅尔国王多姆纳尔·鲁阿德·奥马利之侄。1337年叔父与堂兄弟科马克在伯克内战中被杀后，欧文一系取代了多姆纳尔·鲁阿德的后裔。他有十二个见载的儿子，其中包括迪尔梅德和多姆纳尔，后来的历代乌梅尔首领都出自他。

en: Sadhbh Ní Mháille, anglicized Sive O'Malley, was a daughter of the O'Malley chief Diarmuid mac Owen Ó Máille. She married Edmond Albanach de Burgh, founder of the Mayo Bourkes, and their son Thomas became the second Mac William Íochtar in 1375.
zh: 西芙·奥马利是梅奥奥马利家族酋长迪尔梅德·麦克·欧文·奥马利之女，嫁给梅奥伯克家族的奠基人埃德蒙·阿尔巴纳赫·德·伯格；其子托马斯于1375年成为第二代北麦克威廉。

en: Tadhg Ó Máille was a son of Domnall Ruadh Ó Máille, King of Umaill, named with his brothers Cormac and Brian among the king's three sons in the O'Malley genealogy recorded by Knox.
zh: 泰格·奥马利是乌梅尔国王多姆纳尔·鲁阿德·奥马利之子，在诺克斯记录的奥马利谱系中与科马克、布莱恩并列为国王的三个儿子。

en: Bonconte I da Montefeltro (c. 1170–1241/2) was an imperial nobleman of the House of Montefeltro and its first count of Urbino. On 31 January 1226, Emperor Frederick II made Bonconte and his brother Taddeo counts of Urbino with the agreement of Pope Honorius III. A staunch Ghibelline, he attended the imperial diet at Ravenna in 1226. Urbino did not accept its new counts until 1233–1234, with help from the imperial rector in Romagna and the people of Rimini. Bonconte aided Ravenna against Faenza of the Lombard League in 1235–1236, and served repeatedly as podestà of Città di Castello, apparently seeking to become its effective lord. He was at the siege of Faenza in December 1240 and died the next year or in early 1242.
zh: 布翁孔特一世·达·蒙特费尔特罗（约1170—1241/1242）是蒙特费尔特罗家族的帝国贵族，也是该支系首任乌尔比诺伯爵。1226年1月31日，皇帝腓特烈二世在教宗洪诺留三世同意下，册封布翁孔特及其兄弟塔代奥为乌尔比诺伯爵。作为坚定的吉伯林派，他于1226年出席拉文纳帝国议会。直到1233—1234年，在罗马涅帝国长官与里米尼人的帮助下，乌尔比诺才接受新伯爵。布翁孔特于1235—1236年协助拉文纳对抗伦巴第同盟城市法恩扎，并多次出任卡斯泰洛城的行政长官，显然意图成为该城的实际领主。1240年12月他随军围攻法恩扎，于次年或1242年初去世。

en: Bonconte Montefeltro was a son of Galasso Montefeltro, who was appointed imperial vicar of the county of Urbino in 1348, and a brother of Paolo and Nolfo Montefeltro.
zh: 邦孔特·蒙特费尔特罗是加拉索·蒙特费尔特罗之子、保罗与诺尔弗的兄弟；加拉索于1348年被任命为乌尔比诺伯爵领的帝国代官。

en: Federico I da Montefeltro (c. 1250–1322) was a Ghibelline condottiere and count of Urbino, eldest son of Guido I. As podestà of Arezzo he defeated the Guelphs of Florence and Siena at Cennina in 1303. He formed the League of the Friends of the March with his cousin Speranza in 1305, drawing several towns of the Marche into the alliance. He defeated the Malatesta in 1307 and as podestà of Pisa conquered Ancona in 1309. Emperor Henry VII named him captain-general of the Italian contingents of the imperial army in 1310. He retook Urbino and Fano from the papalists in 1317. During a popular revolt in Urbino, he surrendered and begged for mercy, but he and his son Guido were killed on 26 April 1322.
zh: 费德里科一世·达·蒙特费尔特罗（约1250—1322）是吉伯林派雇佣军首领、乌尔比诺伯爵，圭多一世的长子。任阿雷佐行政长官期间，他于1303年在琴尼纳击败佛罗伦萨与锡耶纳的圭尔夫派。1305年他与堂兄斯佩兰扎组建“马尔凯之友同盟”，吸纳了马尔凯的数个城镇。1307年他击败马拉泰斯塔家族，1309年任比萨行政长官并攻占安科纳。1310年皇帝亨利七世任命他为帝国军中意大利部队的总指挥。1317年他从教宗派手中夺回乌尔比诺和法诺。乌尔比诺爆发民变时，他投降并请求宽恕，但仍于1322年4月26日与儿子圭多一同被杀。

en: Federico II Paolo Novello da Montefeltro (died c. 1370) was count of Urbino from 1364 until his death. He was the son of Nolfo da Montefeltro and Margherita Gabrielli, daughter of Cante Gabrielli, lord of Gubbio. In 1360 he fought against the papal army led by Anichino di Bongardo. He married Teodora Gonzaga, daughter of the condottiero Ugolino Gonzaga, and had four sons. His son Antonio II succeeded him as count of Urbino.
zh: 费德里科二世·保罗·诺韦洛·达·蒙特费尔特罗（约1370年去世）自1364年起任乌尔比诺伯爵，直至去世。他是诺尔弗·达·蒙特费尔特罗与古比奥领主坎泰·加布里埃利之女玛格丽塔·加布里埃利之子。1360年，他与阿尼基诺·迪·邦加尔多率领的教宗军队作战。他娶雇佣军首领乌戈利诺·贡扎加之女特奥多拉·贡扎加为妻，生有四子。其子安东尼奥二世继任乌尔比诺伯爵。

en: Galasso Montefeltro was a son of Federico I Montefeltro and was appointed imperial vicar of the county of Urbino in 1348. He left five children: Nolfo, Paolo, Guittone, Bonconte and Agnese.
zh: 加拉索·蒙特费尔特罗是费德里科一世·蒙特费尔特罗之子，1348年被任命为乌尔比诺伯爵领的帝国代官。他留下五个子女：诺尔弗、保罗、圭托内、邦孔特和阿涅塞。

en: Gentile Brancaleoni was the wife of Guido II da Montefeltro, known as Novello, Count of Urbino; they had no children.
zh: 真蒂莱·布兰卡莱奥尼是乌尔比诺伯爵圭多二世·达·蒙特费尔特罗的妻子；圭多又称诺韦洛，二人没有子女。

en: Ghidda Malaspina was one of three daughters of Spinetta Malaspina, called the Great, lord of Fosdinovo in Lunigiana, and of his wife Beatrice Visconti, daughter of Matteo I Visconti of Milan.
zh: 吉达·马拉斯皮纳是卢尼贾纳福斯迪诺沃领主斯皮内塔·马拉斯皮纳（绰号“伟人”）与米兰马泰奥一世·维斯孔蒂之女贝阿特丽切·维斯孔蒂的三个女儿之一。

en: Guido I da Montefeltro (1223–1298), nicknamed the Old, was a Ghibelline military leader and count of Montefeltro, son of Montefeltrano II. In 1275 he led the Romagna Ghibellines to victory over the Guelphs at Ponte San Procolo and defeated the Malatesta of Rimini at Raversano, driving them from Cesena. As captain of Forlì he directed the city's defence against the papal siege of 1282–1283. Forlì eventually fell, and most of Romagna submitted to papal control; Guido accepted Pope Honorius IV's authority in 1286. Excommunicated in 1288, he captained Pisa's Ghibellines against Florence. Reconciled in 1296, he joined the Franciscans and died at Ancona in 1298.
zh: 圭多一世·达·蒙特费尔特罗（1223—1298），绰号“老者”，是蒙特费尔特罗伯爵、吉伯林派军事领袖，蒙特费尔特拉诺二世之子。1275年，他率领罗马涅的吉伯林派在圣普罗科洛桥击败圭尔夫派，又在拉韦尔萨诺战胜里米尼的马拉泰斯塔家族，将其逐出切塞纳。作为弗利统领，他指挥该城在1282—1283年抵御教宗军队围攻。弗利最终陷落，罗马涅大部归服教宗；圭多于1286年接受教宗洪诺留四世的权威。1288年他被开除教籍，转而统领比萨的吉伯林派对抗佛罗伦萨。1296年他与教会和解并加入方济各会，1298年在安科纳去世。

en: Guido II da Montefeltro, known as Novello, was a Ghibelline condottiero and count of Urbino, son of Count Federico I. When his father was killed in the Urbino revolt of 26 April 1322, he took refuge in Gubbio; in 1323 he returned to Urbino with his brother Nolfo after two years of papal rule. He ruled as count of Urbino from 1324 to 1360 and in 1341 served the Florentines against Lucca. He married Gentile Brancaleoni, who bore him no children.
zh: 圭多二世·达·蒙特费尔特罗，绰号“诺韦洛”，是雇佣军首领、乌尔比诺伯爵，费德里科一世之子。1322年4月26日父亲在乌尔比诺民变中遇害后，他逃往古比奥避难；教宗控制乌尔比诺两年后，他于1323年随兄弟诺尔弗一同回城。1324至1360年他担任乌尔比诺伯爵，1341年曾为佛罗伦萨效力，对卢卡作战。他娶真蒂莱·布兰卡莱奥尼为妻，身后没有子嗣。

en: Guittone Montefeltro was a son of Galasso Montefeltro, imperial vicar of Urbino, and a brother of Nolfo, Paolo and Bonconte Montefeltro.
zh: 圭托内·蒙特费尔特罗是乌尔比诺帝国代官加拉索·蒙特费尔特罗之子，是诺尔弗、保罗和邦孔特的兄弟。

en: Margherita Gabrielli was a daughter of Cante Gabrielli, the Guelph condottiero who ruled Gubbio. She married Nolfo da Montefeltro, count of Urbino, and was the mother of his successor, Federico II.
zh: 玛格丽塔·加布里埃利是古比奥统治者、圭尔夫派雇佣军首领坎特·加布里埃利之女，嫁给乌尔比诺伯爵诺尔弗·达·蒙特费尔特罗，生子费德里科二世。

en: Margherita da Montefeltro was a daughter of Count Galasso da Montefeltro and Allegrezza da Monteverde of Fermo, and mother with Guido Napolitano of Chiavello de Clavellis, who became lord of Fabriano.
zh: 玛格丽塔·达·蒙特费尔特罗是加拉索·达·蒙特费尔特罗伯爵与费尔莫的阿莱格雷扎·达·蒙泰韦尔德之女，她与圭多·纳波利塔诺所生的基亚韦洛·德·克拉韦利斯成为法布里亚诺领主。

en: Montefeltrano II da Montefeltro (died 1255) was an Italian condottiero of the Ghibelline House of Montefeltro and the son of Bonconte I, first count of Urbino. He fought for Philip of Swabia in Sicily, defending the Hohenstaufen claims there, and was rewarded by both Philip and Emperor Frederick II; in 1216 he was confirmed in possession of Montefeltro. From his father's death in 1242 he ruled Urbino as its lord and held the counties of Montefeltro and Pietrarubbia. He died in 1255, shortly after Pope Innocent IV, and was succeeded by his son Guido I.
zh: 蒙特费尔特拉诺二世·达·蒙特费尔特罗（？—1255）是吉伯林派蒙特费尔特罗家族出身的意大利佣兵首领，乌尔比诺首任伯爵布翁孔特一世之子。他曾在西西里为士瓦本的腓力作战，维护霍亨斯陶芬家族在当地的权益，因而得到腓力与皇帝腓特烈二世的奖赏；1216年，他对蒙特费尔特罗的领有权得到确认。1242年父亲死后，他作为领主统治乌尔比诺，并领有蒙特费尔特罗和彼得拉鲁比亚伯国。他于1255年去世，时值教宗英诺森四世死后不久，其子圭多一世继立。

en: Nolfo Montefeltro was a son of Galasso Montefeltro, imperial vicar of Urbino, and a brother of Paolo Montefeltro. He was still living after 1420. His son Guido was alive after 1480, and his granddaughter Ludovica married Bernardino de' Bulgarelli, count of Marsciano.
zh: 诺尔弗·蒙特费尔特罗是乌尔比诺帝国代官加拉索·蒙特费尔特罗之子、保罗·蒙特费尔特罗的兄弟，1420年后仍在世。其子圭多1480年后尚存，孙女卢多维卡嫁给马夏诺伯爵贝尔纳迪诺·德·布尔加雷利。

en: Paolo Montefeltro was a son of Galasso Montefeltro, imperial vicar of Urbino, and belonged to the Guelph party. In 1364 he was associated in the government of Urbino together with his cousins Galasso, Antonio II and Nolfo II, ruling with them until 1369. He afterwards held the castle of Uffogliano jointly with the same cousins. Having fallen into extreme poverty, he was recommended to the papal curia by Cardinal Anglico, legate in Italy. His two sons, Federico and Agostino, died without issue.
zh: 保罗·蒙特费尔特罗是乌尔比诺帝国代官加拉索·蒙特费尔特罗之子，属圭尔夫派。1364年，他受堂兄弟加拉索、安东尼奥二世和诺尔弗二世推举，共同执掌乌尔比诺政权，直至1369年。此后他又与这几位堂兄弟共同领有乌福利亚诺城堡。他晚年陷入赤贫，由教皇驻意大利使节安格利科枢机举荐给罗马教廷。他的两个儿子费德里科和阿戈斯蒂诺均无后而终。

en: Nolfo da Montefeltro (born Sighinolfo; c. 1290–1364), son of Federico I, whom the townspeople killed in a revolt, was count of Montefeltro from 1323 to 1360. In 1323, as a Ghibelline leader in the Marche, he beat the papal commander Ferrantino Malatesta and retook Urbino; his first act as lord was to have his father's enemies killed. In 1333 he became an adviser to John of Bohemia and a captain of the papal army. He took Borgo San Sepolcro and the fortress of San Leo, and as a condottiero occupied Lucca for Pisa in 1342. In 1348 he commanded Venice's army against the counts of Gorizia and was made imperial vicar of Urbino. In 1351 Giovanni Visconti, lord of Milan, hired him, and in 1352 he took Cagli. Then the papal commander Albornoz arrived to reconquer the fractured Papal States and pushed him back in 1354. Nolfo made peace and ruled as papal vicar until his death.
zh: 诺尔弗·达·蒙特费尔特罗（原名西吉诺尔福，约1290—1364）是1323至1360年的蒙特费尔特罗伯爵，其父费德里科一世在城中民众的叛乱里被杀。1323年，作为马尔凯的吉伯林派首领，他击败教宗军队将领费兰蒂诺·马拉泰斯塔，收复乌尔比诺，掌权后的第一件事就是处死父亲的仇敌。1333年他成为波希米亚的约翰的顾问和教宗军队统领。他并入了圣塞波尔克罗镇和圣莱奥要塞，1342年作为佣兵队长替比萨占领卢卡。1348年他统率威尼斯军队对抗戈里齐亚伯爵，同时获任乌尔比诺帝国代牧。1351年米兰领主乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂雇用了他，1352年他攻取卡利。随后，奉命收复四分五裂的教宗国的教宗将领阿尔沃诺斯到来，于1354年将他击退。议和后，他以教宗代牧身份统治直至去世。

en: Guy of Avesnes (c. 1253–1317), younger son of John I of Avesnes and Adelaide of Holland, was bishop of Utrecht from 1301 to 1317, appointed through his brother John II, count of Hainaut and Holland. In 1304, while leading Flemish troops against his brother, he was captured at the Battle of Duiveland; in his absence the Fresingen seized power in Utrecht with guild support and fixed their privileges in the Gildenbrief. He subdued the city in 1305, though it retained considerable autonomy, and granted town privileges to Amsterdam in 1306. He sought compromise among the factions of the Sticht and Utrecht. He attended the Council of Vienne in 1311 and was buried in Utrecht Cathedral after his death on 23 May 1317.
zh: 阿凡斯内的居伊（约1253—1317）是阿凡斯内的约翰一世与荷兰的阿德莱德较年幼的儿子之一，1301至1317年任乌得勒支主教，因其兄、埃诺与荷兰伯爵约翰二世之力而获任命。1304年他率佛兰德斯军队与其兄作战，在德伊夫兰战役中被俘；他不在期间，弗雷辛根派在行会支持下夺取乌得勒支政权，并以《行会书简》确认行会特权。1305年他制服该城，但该城仍保持很大自治权；1306年他授予阿姆斯特丹城市特权。他寻求调和施蒂赫特与乌得勒支的各派。1311年他出席维埃纳公会议，1317年5月23日去世，葬于乌得勒支主教座堂。

en: Jan van Diest (died 1340) was bishop of Utrecht from 1322 to 1340. Born into a noble Brabantine family, he became provost of Cambrai before William III of Holland and Reginald II of Guelders backed him for the see; when the Utrecht chapters elected Jan van Bronkhorst instead, Pope John XXII annulled the election and consecrated van Diest at Avignon. His rule was marked by debt, nepotism and dependence on the two counts, who in 1331 even planned to partition the Sticht until local resistance saved the independence of the see. He was buried in the Dom Church of Utrecht.
zh: 扬·范·迪斯特（？—1340）于1322年至1340年任乌得勒支主教。他出身布拉班特贵族家庭，曾任康布雷总铎，后在荷兰伯爵威廉三世和海尔德伯爵雷诺二世支持下谋求主教之位；乌得勒支各教士团另选了扬·范·布龙克霍斯特，教皇约翰二十二世宣布选举无效，并在阿维尼翁亲自为他祝圣。他任内债务高筑、任人唯亲，完全受制于两位伯爵；1331年两伯爵甚至签约瓜分主教国，全靠当地民众抵抗才保住其独立。他死后葬于乌得勒支大教堂。

en: Basalawarmi (died January 6, 1382), Prince of Liang, was the son of Bolot and a great-great-grandson of Kublai Khan. He held Yunnan for the Yuan; after the court fled north in 1368 he stayed loyal to the Northern Yuan. In 1364 Dali troops helped him repel an invasion from the Ming Xia state, and in 1374 he executed the Ming envoy Wang Wei. In 1381 the Hongwu Emperor sent Fu Youde, Lan Yu and Mu Ying against him and crushed his army. On January 6, 1382, he had his wife drowned in Dian Lake and killed himself.
zh: 把匝剌瓦尔密（1382年1月6日卒），梁王，孛罗之子、忽必烈的玄孙。他为元朝镇守云南；1368年元廷北逃后，他仍效忠北元。1364年，他依靠大理军队击退明夏政权的进攻，1374年又处死明朝使臣王祎。1381年，洪武帝派傅友德、蓝玉、沐英率军征讨，击溃其部众。1382年1月6日，他将妻子驱入滇池溺死，随后自尽。

en: Sébastien Le Prestre de Vauban (1633–1707) was the foremost military engineer of Louis XIV's France. After serving the rebel prince of Condé during the Fronde he was captured in 1653, joined the royal army, and became ingénieur du roi in 1655. After the war with Spain, he fortified newly acquired towns including Dunkirk. He directed the sieges of Maastricht (1673) and Luxembourg (1684), remodelled more than a hundred fortresses from Dunkirk to the Alps, and girdled France's northern frontier with his ceinture de fer. Louis XIV made him a marshal of France in 1703, the first engineer honoured. His last tract, La Dîme royale, proposed a single tax on all estates and was destroyed by royal decree.
zh: 塞巴斯蒂安·勒普雷斯特·德·沃邦（1633—1707）是路易十四时代法国首屈一指的军事工程师。投石党乱期间，他先在叛王孔代亲王麾下效力，1653年被俘后转入王军，1655年成为国王御用工程师。对西班牙的战争结束后，他加固了包括敦刻尔克在内的新占城镇。他指挥了1673年马斯特里赫特围城战和1684年卢森堡围城战，改建了从敦刻尔克到阿尔卑斯的上百座要塞，并以“铁腰带”堡垒群拱卫法国北部边境。1703年，路易十四封他为法国元帅，他也是首位获此殊荣的工程师。晚年所著《王家什一税》主张向所有等级征收统一赋税，后来被王室下令销毁。

en: Algirdas (c. 1296–1377), a son of Gediminas, became prince of Vitebsk through his marriage to its ruling princess, Maria. In 1345 he and his brother Kęstutis deposed their brother Jaunutis, and Algirdas became grand duke of Lithuania, ruling the east while Kęstutis guarded the west. In 1362 he shattered the Golden Horde at the Battle of Blue Waters and extended Lithuanian rule to the Black Sea. He marched on Moscow in 1368, 1370 and 1372 without taking the city. He died in May 1377 and was cremated with his horses in pagan rites, leaving the throne to Jogaila.
zh: 阿尔吉尔达斯（约1296—1377）是格迪米纳斯之子，因迎娶维捷布斯克女公爵玛丽亚而领有维捷布斯克。1345年，他与兄弟科斯图提斯合谋废黜弟弟尧努蒂斯，阿尔吉尔达斯即位为立陶宛大公，主理东部，科斯图提斯镇守西疆。1362年，他在蓝水之役击溃金帐汗国，把立陶宛的势力扩展到黑海。1368、1370、1372年他三次进军莫斯科，却始终未能破城。1377年5月他去世，按多神教仪轨与战马一同火葬，大公之位传给约盖拉。

en: Andrei of Polotsk (c. 1325–1399), eldest son of Grand Duke Algirdas and Maria of Vitebsk, ruled Polotsk from 1342 and Pskov until 1348. He campaigned against the Livonian Order and joined his father's marches on Moscow in 1368 and 1370. When Algirdas died in 1377, the throne passed to his half-brother Jogaila. Andrei contested it, fighting for Dmitry of Moscow at Kulikovo in 1380 and later allying with the Teutonic Order against the Union of Krewo. Captured at Polotsk in 1387, he was imprisoned in Poland and later fell fighting the Tatars at the Vorskla River in August 1399.
zh: 波洛茨克的安德烈（约1325—1399）是立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯与维捷布斯克的玛丽亚的长子，1342年起统治波洛茨克，并领有普斯科夫至1348年。他长年在西疆与利沃尼亚骑士团作战，又在1368和1370年随父亲进军莫斯科。1377年阿尔吉尔达斯去世后，大公之位传给了他的异母弟约盖拉。安德烈起兵争位，1380年在库里科沃之战中投身莫斯科的德米特里一方，后来又联合条顿骑士团反对克雷沃联合。1387年他在波洛茨克被俘，囚禁于波兰，获释后于1399年8月在沃尔斯克拉河与鞑靼人作战时阵亡。

en: Briachislav Vasilkovich (died after 1241) was a Vitebsk-line prince who ruled Vitebsk from about 1221 and Polotsk from about 1232, probably a son of Vasilko Bryacheslavich and a daughter of Davyd of Smolensk. Tradition credits him with founding three churches in Polotsk in 1203, dedicated to Holy Wisdom, Saints Boris and Gleb, and Paraskeva Pyatnitsa. In 1239 the chronicles show the future Alexander Nevsky marrying his daughter at Polotsk. He was still ruling Polotsk after 1241.
zh: 布里亚奇斯拉夫·瓦西里科维奇（1241年后卒）是维捷布斯克支系王公，约1221年起统治维捷布斯克，约1232年起统治波洛茨克；一般认为他是瓦西里科·布里亚奇斯拉维奇与斯摩棱斯克的达维德之女的儿子。相传他于1203年在波洛茨克修建三座教堂，分别奉献给圣索菲亚、圣徒鲍里斯与格列布、帕拉斯克娃·皮亚特尼察。1239年编年史记载，后来的亚历山大·涅夫斯基在波洛茨克娶他的女儿。1241年后他仍居于波洛茨克公位。

en: Bryachislav Vasilkovich (died after 1186) was a Polotsk-branch Rurikid who held Iziaslavl and twice ruled Vitebsk. Around 1159 Prince Rogvolod Borisovich of Polotsk granted him Iziaslavl, which he held with his brother Volodsha, until the Glebovichi princes of Minsk captured the brothers, imprisoning Volodsha and holding Bryachislav in chains; Rogvolod freed Bryachislav in 1160. In 1162 he joined the Polotsk princes' campaign to Slutsk against Vladimir Mstislavich of Dorogobuzh, and in 1180, ruling Vitebsk, he fought at Drutsk for the Kiev prince Svyatoslav Vsevolodovich.
zh: 布里亚奇斯拉夫·瓦西里科维奇（1186年后卒）是留里克王朝波洛茨克支系王公，领有伊贾斯拉夫尔，并两度统治维捷布斯克。约1159年，波洛茨克王公罗格沃洛德·鲍里索维奇把伊贾斯拉夫尔封给他，他与兄弟沃洛德沙共治；明斯克的格列波维奇家族俘虏二人，将沃洛德沙投入牢房，把布里亚奇斯拉夫锁起来，罗格沃洛德于1160年将他救出。1162年他随波洛茨克诸王公进军斯卢茨克，讨伐多罗戈布日王公弗拉基米尔·姆斯季斯拉维奇；1180年他统治维捷布斯克期间，在德鲁茨克为基辅大公斯维亚托斯拉夫·弗谢沃洛多维奇作战。

en: Constantine (died c. 1390), by tradition a son of Algirdas of Lithuania, was a Gediminid prince and founder of the Czartoryski family. He led a Lithuanian banner at the Battle of Blue Waters in 1362, which broke the Golden Horde and won Podolia for Lithuania. Made the first prince of Podolia and ruling from Smotrych, he struck his own coinage bearing Saint George. After Jogaila accepted the Union of Krewo in 1385, Constantine withdrew to Hungary, where he died between 1388 and 1392. His sons Hlib, Gregory and Vasyl founded the Czartoryski line.
zh: 康斯坦丁（约1390年卒）按传统说法是立陶宛的阿尔吉尔达斯之子，格迪米纳斯家族王公，恰尔托雷斯基家族的始祖。1362年，他率领一支立陶宛部队参加蓝水之役，此战击溃金帐汗国，为立陶宛夺得波多利亚。他成为首任波多利亚王公，驻跸斯莫特里奇，并铸造了带有圣乔治像的钱币。1385年约盖拉接受克雷沃联合后，康斯坦丁退往匈牙利，于1388—1392年间在当地去世。他的儿子格列布、格里戈里和瓦西里开创了恰尔托雷斯基家族一系。

en: Davyd Sviatoslavich (died 1173) was a prince of Vitebsk and a son of Svyatoslav Vseslavich of Polotsk. Hagiography records him accompanying his sister Euphrosyne of Polotsk on her pilgrimage to Jerusalem between 1162 and 1169. He is thought to have fathered Prince Boris Davydovich.
zh: 达维德·斯维亚托斯拉维奇（1173年卒）是维捷布斯克王公，波洛茨克王公斯维亚托斯拉夫·弗谢斯拉维奇之子。据载他于1162至1169年间随姐姐波洛茨克的叶夫罗西尼娅前往耶路撒冷朝圣，一般认为他是鲍里斯·达维多维奇之父。

en: Dmitry of Bryansk, or Dmitry the Elder (1327–1399), was the second son of Algirdas of Lithuania and Maria of Vitebsk. In 1356 his father took Bryansk from Smolensk and enfeoffed him with it. He repulsed Dmitry Donskoy's attack in 1370 and witnessed the Treaty of Lyubutsk in 1372. After Algirdas died in 1377, he backed his brother Andrei of Polotsk against Jogaila, withdrew to Moscow in 1379 and fought at Kulikovo in 1380. Reconciled with Jogaila in 1388, he returned to Bryansk and fell beside Andrei at the Vorskla River in 1399. His son Michael founded the Trubetskoy family.
zh: 布良斯克的德米特里，又称德米特里长老（1327—1399），是立陶宛的阿尔吉尔达斯与维捷布斯克的玛丽亚的次子。1356年，父亲从斯摩棱斯克手中夺取布良斯克，将此地封给他。1370年他击退德米特里·顿斯科伊的进攻，1372年见证了柳布茨克和约。1377年阿尔吉尔达斯去世后，他支持兄长波洛茨克的安德烈对抗约盖拉，1379年退往莫斯科，1380年参战库里科沃之战。1388年他与约盖拉和解，回到布良斯克，1399年与安德烈一同战死于沃尔斯克拉河。其子米哈伊尔是特鲁别茨科伊家族的始祖。

en: Iziaslav Bryachislavich (died c. 1264) was a Vitebsk-line Rurikid, a son of Bryachislav Vasilkovich of Polotsk. Vitebsk prince lists suggest that he ruled from 1232 to 1262 and again in 1264, after Konstantin Bezruky's brief tenure. His son Iziaslav died in 1265.
zh: 伊贾斯拉夫·布里亚奇斯拉维奇（约1264年卒）是维捷布斯克支系王公，波洛茨克王公布里亚奇斯拉夫·瓦西里科维奇之子。王公列表推定他1232至1262年及1264年统治维捷布斯克，其间公位一度属康斯坦丁·别兹鲁基。其子伊贾斯拉夫1265年卒。

en: Maria of Vitebsk (c. 1300–c. 1346), also called Maria Yaroslavna, was the only child and heir of Yaroslav Vasilkovich, the last prince of Vitebsk. Around 1318 she married Algirdas, a son of Grand Duke Gediminas of Lithuania, and through her inheritance the Principality of Vitebsk passed to the Gediminids. She bore Algirdas at least five sons, among them Andrei of Polotsk, Dmitry of Bryansk and Constantine, all baptized in the Orthodox rite; their descendants included the Trubetskoy, Czartoryski and Sanguszko princely houses. After her death Algirdas took as his second wife Uliana of Tver.
zh: 维捷布斯克的玛丽亚（约1300—约1346），又称玛丽亚·雅罗斯拉夫娜，是维捷布斯克末代王公雅罗斯拉夫·瓦西里科维奇的独女与继承人。约1318年，她嫁给立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯之子阿尔吉尔达斯，维捷布斯克公国也因她的继承关系转入格迪米纳斯家族手中。她为阿尔吉尔达斯生下至少五个儿子，其中包括波洛茨克的安德烈、布良斯克的德米特里和康斯坦丁，诸子皆受东正教洗礼，后裔中有特鲁别茨科伊、恰尔托雷斯基、桑古什科等王公世家。她去世后，阿尔吉尔达斯续娶特维尔的乌丽亚娜。

en: Mikhail Konstantinovich was prince of Vitebsk from the 1270s to the 1280s. He was a son of Konstantin Bezruky, prince of Polotsk and Vitebsk, and a brother of Yuri, prince of Rzhev, Fominsk and Berezuy. In an undated letter written between 1271 and 1289, the aldermen and citizens of Riga accused him of unfair judgments against Riga merchants and of coercive dealings with them. Mikhail died before 1307.
zh: 米哈伊尔·康斯坦丁诺维奇于1270年代至1280年代任维捷布斯克王公，是波洛茨克兼维捷布斯克王公康斯坦丁·别兹鲁基之子，尔热夫、福明斯克与别列祖伊王公尤里的兄弟。里加的市政官与全体市民致书米哈伊尔，指责他对里加商人裁判不公，并对他们施以胁迫。信件没有注明日期，写于1271至1289年间。米哈伊尔于1307年之前去世。

en: Roman Vyacheslavich (died after 1165) was a Polotsk-branch Rurikid prince of Vitebsk. Tatishchev records that in 1165 Davyd Rostislavich of Smolensk took Vitebsk for himself and gave Roman the Polotsk appanage towns of Vasilev and Krasny instead. He has no other chronicle mentions.
zh: 罗曼·维亚切斯拉维奇（1165年后卒）是波洛茨克支系的维捷布斯克王公。据塔季谢夫记载，1165年斯摩棱斯克的达维德·罗斯季斯拉维奇占取维捷布斯克，改把波洛茨克境内的瓦西列夫与克拉斯尼两城封给他。此外史书再无记载。

en: Svyatoslav Vseslavich (Christian name Georgy; died after 1129) was a Rurikid prince of Polotsk, one of the younger sons of Vseslav Briachislavich. When the Polotsk land was divided on his father's death in 1101, he may have received Vitebsk; some historians infer this from his grandsons' rule there. A lead seal of his has been found at Kukenois. His daughter Predslava became the monastic saint Euphrosyne of Polotsk. In 1129 Mstislav Vladimirovich of Kiev campaigned against Polotsk, captured Svyatoslav with his brothers and exiled them to Constantinople, where all trace of him is lost.
zh: 斯维亚托斯拉夫·弗谢斯拉维奇（教名格奥尔基，1129年后去世）是波洛茨克的留里克王公，弗谢斯拉夫·布里亚奇斯拉维奇的幼子之一。1101年父亲去世后波洛茨克领地被诸子瓜分，他可能分得维捷布斯克；一些历史学家根据他的孙辈曾在此统治作出这一推断。他的一枚铅印在库克伊诺斯出土。他的女儿普列德斯拉瓦出家后成为波洛茨克的圣欧福新。1129年，基辅的姆斯季斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇征讨波洛茨克，将他与诸兄弟俘获并流放君士坦丁堡，此后便下落不明。

en: Vasilko Bryacheslavich (died after 1209, around 1221 by tradition) was prince of Vitebsk from 1186, a son of Bryachislav Vasilkovich. In 1180 he fought beside his father at the Olegovichi siege of Drutsk. In 1186 he took the Vitebsk throne with backing from his father-in-law Davyd of Smolensk, supported by Vseslav Rogvolodovich of Drutsk, Vasilko Volodarevich of Logozhsk and a Novgorod force. In 1209 Grand Prince Vsevolod the Big Nest of Vladimir married Vasilko's daughter Liubava as his second wife. His son Bryachislav succeeded him.
zh: 瓦西里科·布里亚奇斯拉维奇（1209年后卒，通常作约1221年）自1186年起任维捷布斯克王公，是布里亚奇斯拉夫·瓦西里科维奇之子。1180年他随父亲参加奥尔加维奇家族对德鲁茨克的围攻。1186年，他在岳父斯摩棱斯克的达维德支持下取得维捷布斯克公位，德鲁茨克的弗谢斯拉夫·罗格沃洛多维奇、洛戈日斯克的瓦西里科·沃洛达列维奇和诺夫哥罗德军队也出手相助。1209年，弗拉基米尔大公弗谢沃洛德·尤尔耶维奇（大窝）续娶他的女儿柳巴瓦。其子布里亚奇斯拉夫继位。

en: Vasilko Bryacheslavich (died 1297) was a Polotsk-line Rurikid prince of Vitebsk, probably a son of Bryachislav Vasilkovich. Prince lists place him ruling Vitebsk in 1280—1297. A later genealogy makes him the grandfather of Maria of Vitebsk, wife of Algirdas of Lithuania from 1318.
zh: 瓦西里科·布里亚奇斯拉维奇（1297年卒）是维捷布斯克的波洛茨克支系留里克王公，可能为波洛茨克王公布里亚奇斯拉夫·瓦西里科维奇之子，王公列表记其1280至1297年在位。据后世谱系，其孙女玛丽亚1318年嫁立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯。

en: Vyacheslav, called Vyachko, Sviatoslavich (died 1167 or 1173) was a prince of Vitebsk, the son of Svyatoslav Vseslavich and Sofia Vladimirovna, a daughter of Vladimir Monomakh. In 1129 the grand prince of Kiev arrested the Polotsk princes and exiled them to Byzantium; Vyachko and his kinsman Vasilko returned only in 1131 or 1132. He occupied the Vitebsk throne in 1162. Around 1167 he escorted his sister Euphrosyne of Polotsk on her pilgrimage, and she tonsured his two daughters. His last chronicle appearance, also in 1167, found him aiding Novgorod alongside Prince Volodar of Minsk.
zh: 维亚切斯拉夫（昵称维亚奇科）·斯维亚托斯拉维奇（1167或1173年卒）是维捷布斯克王公，斯维亚托斯拉夫·弗谢斯拉维奇与弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫之女索菲娅·弗拉基米罗芙娜之子。1129年基辅大公拘捕波洛茨克诸王公，将他们放逐到拜占庭，维亚奇科与同族瓦西里科直到1131或1132年才返回。他于1162年登上维捷布斯克公位。约1167年他护送姐姐波洛茨克的叶夫罗西尼娅朝圣，后者为他的两个女儿剃度出家。史书最后一次提到他也在1167年：他与明斯克王公沃洛达里一同援助诺夫哥罗德。

en: Vseslav Vasilkovich (died c. 1186) was a Polotsk-branch Rurikid prince who held Vitebsk from 1132 and Polotsk. In 1162, after Rogvolod Borisovich of Drutsk fled his defeat by Volodar Glebovich of Minsk, the Polotsk veche invited Vseslav to rule. Married to a daughter of Roman Rostislavich of Smolensk, he leaned on Smolensk support and handed Vitebsk to Davyd Rostislavich in 1164. Volodar drove him out in 1167, but Smolensk intervention restored him. He campaigned against Novgorod in 1170 and against Drutsk around 1180, his last chronicle mention.
zh: 弗谢斯拉夫·瓦西里科维奇（约1186年卒）是留里克王朝波洛茨克支系王公，1132年起领有维捷布斯克，亦曾统治波洛茨克。1162年，德鲁茨克王公罗格沃洛德·鲍里索维奇被明斯克的沃洛达里·格列波维奇击败出逃，波洛茨克韦彻遂邀请弗谢斯拉夫入主。他娶斯摩棱斯克王公罗曼·罗斯季斯拉维奇之女，倚仗斯摩棱斯克支持，1164年把维捷布斯克交给达维德·罗斯季斯拉维奇。1167年他被沃洛达里逐走，靠斯摩棱斯克出兵复位；1170年随军征讨诺夫哥罗德，约1180年合攻德鲁茨克，此后史书不再记载他。

en: Vyacheslav Rostislavich was a Polotsk-branch Rurikid prince, a son of Rostislav Vseslavich of Lukoml. Genealogies make him the husband of a daughter of Grand Prince Vyacheslav Vladimirovich of Kiev and the father of Roman Vyacheslavich, who ruled Vitebsk until 1165.
zh: 维亚切斯拉夫·罗斯季斯拉维奇是波洛茨克支系的留里克王公，卢科姆利王公罗斯季斯拉夫·弗谢斯拉维奇之子。谱系载他娶基辅大公维亚切斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇之女，子罗曼·维亚切斯拉维奇于1165年前统治维捷布斯克。

en: Yaroslav Vasilkovich is a putative prince named in the Genealogy of the Princes of Vitebsk as the last appanage prince of Vitebsk, who died in 1320. The chronicle, compiled no earlier than the sixteenth century, relates that he had no sons and in 1318 married his daughter Maria to the Lithuanian prince Algirdas, legitimizing Lithuanian rule over Vitebsk. The principality gradually lost its independence and in 1393 became the Vitebsk Voivodeship of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.
zh: 雅罗斯拉夫·瓦西里科维奇是一位存在存疑的王公，《维捷布斯克王公谱系》记他为维捷布斯克末代封邑王公，卒于1320年。这部不早于16世纪编成的谱系称，他没有儿子，便于1318年将女儿玛丽亚嫁给立陶宛王公阿尔吉尔达斯，使立陶宛对维捷布斯克的统治获得合法性。维捷布斯克公国逐渐失去独立，于1393年成为立陶宛大公国的维捷布斯克省。

en: Alix of Brittany (1297–1377) was a daughter of Arthur II, Duke of Brittany, and Yolande de Dreux. In 1320 she married Bouchard VI of the House of Montoire, count of Vendôme and Castres, and was his countess until his death in 1354. Their children included John VI, who succeeded to Vendôme, Peter, killed at Poitiers in 1356, Bouchard, lord of Segré, and Eleanor, who married Roger-Bernard, count of Périgord. Alix then lived another twenty-three years as dowager countess, until her death in 1377, outliving her son John and seeing the county pass to her granddaughter Catherine.
zh: 布列塔尼的阿莉克丝（1297—1377）是布列塔尼公爵阿蒂尔二世与德勒的约兰德之女。1320年，她嫁给蒙图瓦尔家族的旺多姆兼卡斯特尔伯爵布沙尔六世，在1354年丈夫去世前一直担任伯爵夫人。她的子女包括承袭旺多姆的约翰六世、1356年战死于普瓦捷的皮埃尔、塞格雷领主布沙尔，以及嫁给佩里戈尔伯爵罗歇-贝尔纳的埃莱奥诺尔。此后她作为伯爵遗孀又度过了二十三年，1377年去世，历经儿子约翰六世早逝，看着伯国传到孙女凯瑟琳手中。

en: Bouchard of Vendôme, lord of Segré, was a younger son of Count Bouchard VI of Vendôme and Alix of Brittany. While his brother John VI inherited the county, he received the Angevin border lordships of Segré, Feuillet, La Ventrouze and La Bigottière. Around 1350 he married Marguerite of Beaumont-Brienne, sister of the last viscounts of Beaumont and heiress of Le Lude and Martigné-Ferchaud, which she brought to him. Their son John carried on the Vendôme-Segré line, which kept Le Lude until 1429.
zh: 旺多姆的布沙尔是旺多姆伯爵布沙尔六世与布列塔尼的阿莉克丝较年幼的儿子，领有塞格雷。兄长约翰六世承袭伯国，他则获得安茹边境的塞格雷、费耶、拉旺特鲁兹、拉比戈蒂耶尔等领地。约1350年，他娶博蒙-布里耶纳的玛格丽特为妻；她是末代博蒙子爵的姊妹，又是勒吕德与马蒂涅费尔绍的女继承人，把这些领地带给了夫家。其子让延续了旺多姆-塞格雷支系，该支系保有勒吕德直至1429年。

en: Bouchard V de Vendôme (c. 1230–1271) ruled the county of Vendôme from 1249 as head of the Montoire-Vendôme dynasty, succeeding his father Peter. He married Marie de Roye, daughter of Raoul II de Roye, who bore him his heir Jean V. A loyal vassal of Charles I of Anjou, king of Naples, he fought in Charles's campaigns in Hainaut, Italy and Sicily. Bouchard joined Louis IX on the crusade to Tunis in 1270 and died there of plague in 1271. His body was returned to Vendôme and buried in the collegiate church of Saint-Georges in the castle.
zh: 布沙尔五世·德·旺多姆（约1230—1271）出身蒙图瓦尔—旺多姆家族，1249年继承父亲皮埃尔的爵位，成为旺多姆伯爵。他娶鲁瓦的拉乌尔二世之女玛丽·德·鲁瓦为妻，继承人让五世即其所出。作为那不勒斯国王安茹的查理一世的忠实封臣，他随军参加了查理在埃诺、意大利和西西里的战事。1270年他随路易九世参加十字军远征突尼斯，1271年在当地死于瘟疫，遗体运回旺多姆，葬于城堡中的圣乔治协同教堂。

en: Bouchard VI de Vendôme (c. 1290–1354), count of Vendôme and lord of Castres, was the son of John V and Eleanor of Montfort. He married Alice, daughter of Duke Arthur II of Brittany; their son John VI succeeded him, and their daughter Éléonore married Roger-Bernard, Count of Périgord. In 1320 he sold his minting rights to King Philip V, and in 1329 a treaty with Guy de Châtillon, count of Blois, fixed the border between their counties and reduced the enclaves along it. In November 1353 he was sent on a military mission to Flanders, and in the winter of 1354 on a diplomatic mission to Charles the Bad, king of Navarre. He died on 26 February 1354 and was buried in the collegiate church of Saint-Georges at Vendôme.
zh: 布沙尔六世·德·旺多姆（约1290—1354）是旺多姆伯爵、卡斯特尔领主，让五世与埃莉诺·德·蒙福尔之子。他娶布列塔尼公爵阿蒂尔二世之女阿丽丝为妻；两人的儿子让六世继承了爵位，女儿埃莱奥诺尔则嫁给佩里戈尔伯爵罗歇·贝尔纳。1320年，他把铸币权卖给国王腓力五世；1329年，他与布卢瓦伯爵居伊·德·沙蒂永缔约，划定了两个伯爵领之间的边界，并减少了沿线的飞地。1353年11月，他被派往佛兰德执行军事任务；1354年冬又出使纳瓦拉国王恶人查理。1354年2月26日他去世，葬于旺多姆的圣乔治协同教堂。

en: Éléonore de Montfort was the daughter of Philippe II de Montfort, lord of Castres, and Jeanne de Lévis-Mirepoix. Around 1285 she married Jean V, Count of Vendôme, bringing him the lordship of Castres in Albigeois; Jean preferred to reside there, and the counts of Vendôme thereafter held Castres. Her children included Bouchard VI, who succeeded his father in Vendôme and Castres in 1315, and Jeanne, who married Henri IV de Sully. She was still living after 1338.
zh: 埃莉诺·德·蒙福尔是卡斯特尔领主腓力二世·德·蒙福尔与让娜·德·莱维斯-米尔普瓦之女。约1285年，她嫁给旺多姆伯爵让五世，将阿尔比日瓦的卡斯特尔领地带入婚姻；让五世偏好居住于此，旺多姆伯爵家族此后兼领该地。她的子女包括1315年继承旺多姆与卡斯特尔的布沙尔六世，以及嫁给亨利四世·德·叙利的让娜。1338年后她仍在世。

en: Guy de Montfort (died 31 January 1228) was a French crusader, lord of Castres, and younger son of Simon III de Montfort and Amicie de Beaumont. He took part in the Third Crusade from 1188 and joined the Fourth in 1202, but after Zara he refused the Byzantine bargain and sailed to the Holy Land, where he married Helvis of Ibelin in 1204 and ruled Sidon as regent until 1210. Back in France he fought in the Albigensian Crusade, besieging Montségur without success in 1212 and fighting at Muret in 1213. At Toulouse in 1218 he was wounded, and his brother Simon was killed while coming to his aid. Guy was killed at the siege of Varilhes in 1228.
zh: 居伊·德·蒙福尔（1228年1月31日卒）是法兰西十字军将领、卡斯特尔领主，西蒙三世·德·蒙福尔与阿米斯·德·博蒙较年幼的儿子之一。他1188年参加第三次十字军东征，1202年又参加第四次东征；在扎拉之后，他拒绝了拜占庭方面的交易，自行渡海前往圣地，1204年娶伊贝林的埃尔维斯为妻，并摄政西顿领地直至1210年。回到法兰西后，他投入阿尔比十字军，1212年围攻蒙塞居尔未果，1213年在米雷作战。1218年在图卢兹，他负伤后兄长西蒙前来救援时阵亡。居伊于1228年在围攻瓦里勒时阵亡。

en: Helvis of Ibelin (after 1178–1214) was the elder daughter of Balian of Ibelin and Maria Komnene, widow of King Amalric of Jerusalem, and half-sister of Queen Isabella I. During Saladin's siege of Jerusalem in 1187 she was escorted to safety in Tripoli. Her father negotiated the city's surrender and joined the family there; they then went to Tyre, where they supported Conrad of Montferrat. In 1190 she married Reginald, lord of Sidon, soon after his release from captivity. They had a son Balian, and she was widowed in 1202. King Aimery gave her hand to Guy of Montfort in 1204, and their son Philip became lord of Tyre.
zh: 埃尔维斯·德·伊贝林（1178年后—1214）是伊贝林的贝里昂与耶路撒冷前王后玛丽亚·科穆宁娜的长女，也是女王伊莎贝拉一世同母异父的妹妹。1187年萨拉丁围攻耶路撒冷时，她被送往的黎波里避难。她的父亲谈判交出耶路撒冷后在的黎波里与家人会合，随后全家前往提尔，支持蒙费拉的康拉德。1190年，她嫁给刚获释不久的西顿领主雷纳德，生子贝里昂，并于1202年丧夫。1204年，国王艾默里将她许配给蒙福尔的居伊，二人的儿子腓力后来成为提尔领主。

en: John IV of Montoire (Jean IV de Vendôme; died 1240) was a French baron who became the first count of Vendôme from the House of Montoire-Vendôme. The son of Peter II of Montoire and Agnes of Vendôme, he inherited Montoire and succeeded as count of Vendôme in 1217, ruling until 1239 or 1240. By his wife Eglantine he had several children, including Peter, who succeeded him as count, Geoffrey, lord of Lavardin, John, lord of Saint-Laurent-des-Mortiers, and the daughters Matilda, Agnes and Honorine.
zh: 蒙图瓦尔的约翰四世（即旺多姆的约翰四世，1240年卒）是法兰西男爵，也是蒙图瓦尔-旺多姆家族的首任旺多姆伯爵。他是蒙图瓦尔的彼得二世与旺多姆的阿涅丝之子，继承蒙图瓦尔后于1217年继位为旺多姆伯爵，统治至1239或1240年。他与妻子埃格朗蒂娜生有多名子女，包括继任伯爵的彼得、拉瓦尔丹领主若弗鲁瓦、圣洛朗德莫尔捷领主约翰，以及女儿玛蒂尔德、阿涅丝和奥诺琳。

en: John V de Vendôme (c. 1260–1315) of the House of Montoire inherited the county of Vendôme from his father Bouchard V in 1271. In 1282 he campaigned in Apulia in the service of Charles I of Anjou during the wars after the Sicilian Vespers. Through his marriage to Eleanor of Montfort, daughter of Philip of Montfort, lord of Castres, he inherited Castres in 1300 after the death of her brother John, along with the county of Squillace in the kingdom of Naples. He spent most of the rest of his life at Castres. He split the Vendômois into Upper and Lower Vendôme, making Montoire chief town of the latter and encouraging its development. His son Bouchard VI succeeded him.
zh: 让五世·德·旺多姆（约1260—1315）出身蒙图瓦尔家族，1271年继承父亲布沙尔五世的旺多姆伯爵领。1282年，他在西西里晚祷战争期间为安茹的查理一世出征普利亚。他娶卡斯特尔领主蒙福尔的腓力之女埃莉诺·德·蒙福尔为妻，1300年妻兄让去世后，他凭此继承卡斯特尔领地，以及那不勒斯王国境内的斯奎拉切伯国，此后余生大多住在卡斯特尔。他将旺多穆瓦分为上旺多姆与下旺多姆两部分，以蒙图瓦尔为后者的首邑，推动了这座城镇的发展。其子布沙尔六世继位。

en: John VI of Vendôme (died February 1364), son of Bouchard VI and Alix of Brittany, succeeded as count of Vendôme and Castres in 1354. He lived chiefly at Castres, which King John II raised to a county in 1356 for his loyalty to the Valois. He fought and was captured at Poitiers the same year. In 1362 English and Gascon routiers seized Vendôme and captured his wife Joan of Ponthieu; he paid a ransom to recover the town. He died in February 1364 famed for his sanctity. By Joan he left Bouchard VII and Catherine, who brought Vendôme to the Bourbons.
zh: 旺多姆的约翰六世（1364年2月卒）是布沙尔六世与布列塔尼的阿莉克丝之子，1354年承袭旺多姆与卡斯特尔伯爵之位。他主要住在卡斯特尔，因效忠瓦卢瓦王室，法王约翰二世于1356年将卡斯特尔领地升格为伯国；同年他在普瓦捷战役中被俘。1362年，英格兰与加斯科涅流兵攻占旺多姆，俘虏了他的妻子蓬蒂约的让娜；他支付赎金收回了城池。1364年2月他去世，时人以圣徒之名相称。他与让娜留下布沙尔七世和女儿凯瑟琳，凯瑟琳后来把旺多姆带入波旁家族。

en: Jeanne de Vendôme was a daughter of Bouchard VI, count of Vendôme, and Alix of Brittany. She married Renaud, lord of Brétancourt, and died on 29 November 1395.
zh: 让娜·德·旺多姆是旺多姆伯爵布沙尔六世与布列塔尼的阿历克丝之女，嫁与布列坦库尔领主雷诺，于1395年11月29日去世。

en: Philip II of Montfort (1225–1270) was a French nobleman, the son of Philip I of Montfort, lord of Tyre, and Eleanor of Courtenay. He joined Charles of Anjou's conquest of the Kingdom of Sicily and shared command of the first battalion with Hugh of Mirepoix at the Battle of Benevento in 1266. Afterwards he was given forces to protect the Papal States, then led Angevin troops into Sicily and crushed the revolt that ended in the sack of Augusta. Created count of Squillace, he inherited Castres on his father's death in March 1270, while his half-brother John received their father's possessions in the Levant. He then joined Louis IX's Eighth Crusade and died at Tunis on 24 September 1270.
zh: 菲利普二世·德·蒙福尔（1225—1270）是法兰西贵族，为提尔领主菲利普一世·德·蒙福尔与埃莱奥诺尔·德·库特奈之子。他参加安茹的查理征服西西里王国的战争，1266年在贝内文托战役中与于格·德·米尔普瓦共同指挥前锋营。战后他受命率军保护教宗国，继而率安茹军队进入西西里岛，镇压叛乱，最终洗劫奥古斯塔。他受封斯奎拉切伯爵，1270年3月父亲死后继承卡斯特尔，而同父异母兄弟约翰获得了父亲在黎凡特的领地。随后他加入路易九世的第八次十字军东征，1270年9月24日死于突尼斯。

en: Peter of Vendôme (c. 1200–1249) was count of Vendôme from 1240 until his death, the son of Count John IV and Eglantine of Palluau. He married Joan of Mayenne, lady of La Chartre-sur-le-Loir and daughter of Juhel III of Mayenne, and had four children, including his successor Burchard V and Geoffrey, lord of La Chartre-sur-le-Loir. Their son Peter entered the Church and studied at Bologna, where he died young; another son, John, was lord of Saint-Laurent-des-Mortiers. Peter joined King Louis IX on the Seventh Crusade and died in Cyprus on 25 March 1249 before the campaign reached Egypt. His body was taken home and buried in the collegiate church of Saint-Georges at Vendôme.
zh: 旺多姆的彼得（约1200—1249）是1240年至去世时的旺多姆伯爵，伯爵约翰四世与帕吕奥的埃格朗蒂娜之子。他娶马耶讷的朱埃尔三世之女、卢瓦河畔拉沙特尔女领主马耶讷的让娜为妻，生有四个子女，包括继任伯爵的布沙尔五世和卢瓦河畔拉沙特尔领主若弗鲁瓦。他们的儿子彼得进入教会，赴博洛尼亚求学并早逝；另一子约翰是圣洛朗德莫尔捷领主。彼得随国王路易九世参加第七次十字军东征，1249年3月25日死于塞浦路斯，此时大军尚未抵达埃及。他的遗体被运回，安葬在旺多姆的圣乔治协同教堂。

en: Peter of Vendôme was a son of Count Bouchard VI of Vendôme and Alix of Brittany, and a brother of Count John VI.
zh: 旺多姆的皮埃尔是旺多姆伯爵布沙尔六世与布列塔尼的阿莉克丝之子、约翰六世伯爵的兄弟。

en: Alix de Joinville was the daughter of Guillaume de Joinville and Béatrice de Brienne and heiress of Briquenay and Vénizy in Champagne. Before 16 April 1331 she married Jean II de Sarrebruck-Commercy, sire of Commercy; her sons Simon II and Jean III later ruled Commercy-Château-Haut.
zh: 阿历克丝·德·茹安维尔是纪尧姆·德·茹安维尔与贝亚特丽斯·德·布里耶纳之女，香槟地区布里克奈与沃尼济的女继承人，1331年4月16日前嫁给科梅尔西领主约翰二世；儿子西蒙二世、约翰三世后来相继统治科梅尔西上堡。

en: Guillaume de Sarrebruck-Commercy (died 1366 or 1370) was a son of Jean II de Sarrebruck-Commercy and Alix de Joinville. He was a knight and held his mother's Champagne lordship of Briquenay.
zh: 纪尧姆·德·萨尔布吕肯-科梅尔西（1366年或1370年卒）是约翰二世与阿历克丝·德·茹安维尔之子，受封骑士，领有其母传下的香槟地区布里克奈领地。

en: Jean III de Sarrebruck-Commercy (died 28 April 1384 or 1385) was a son of Jean II and Alix de Joinville and sire of Commercy-Château-Haut. He had first chosen the Church and in 1352 is styled a canon of Toul and Verdun, but inherited Commercy when his brother Simon II died childless in 1355. On 27 March 1358 he married Marie d'Arcelles, lady of Méry-sur-Seine. Their sons were Simon III, sire of Commercy, Jean, bishop of Verdun and later of Châlons, and Amé I, ancestor of the later Saarbrücken-Commercy line.
zh: 萨尔布吕肯-科梅尔西的约翰三世（1384年或1385年4月28日卒）是约翰二世与阿历克丝·德·茹安维尔之子，科梅尔西“上堡”领主。他起初选择教会道路，1352年时身兼图勒与凡尔登的法政牧师；1355年兄长西蒙二世无嗣而终，他遂继承科梅尔西。1358年3月27日，他娶塞纳河畔梅里女领主玛丽·达尔塞勒，诸子中有科梅尔西领主西蒙三世、历任凡尔登与沙隆主教的让，以及后世萨尔布吕肯-科梅尔西支系的先祖阿梅一世。

en: Simon II (or V) de Sarrebruck-Commercy (died 1355) was a son of Jean II and Alix de Joinville and held Commercy-Château-Haut as sire of Commercy. In 1344 he settled with his cousin Jean IV the long-delayed partition of the inheritance of Jean I, taking the keep of Commercy, half the town and a long list of villages, mills and woods, while justice and the town walls remained shared between the two branches. He died without children in 1355, and his lands passed to his brother Jean III.
zh: 萨尔布吕肯-科梅尔西的西蒙二世（一称五世，？—1355）是约翰二世与阿历克丝·德·茹安维尔之子，领有科梅尔西“上堡”，称科梅尔西领主。1344年，他与堂兄弟约翰四世完成拖延已久的约翰一世遗产分割：他取得科梅尔西主堡、半个城区以及大批村庄、磨坊和林地，司法权与城墙则由两支共有。他于1355年无嗣而终，领地传给兄弟约翰三世。

en: Agnes von Leiningen (died 7 August 1346), daughter of Count Friedrich IV von Leiningen, married Count Georg I von Veldenz and was mother of Heinrich II and Friedrich I von Veldenz. Her brother Emich von Leiningen served as bishop of Speyer from 1314 to 1328.
zh: 阿格尼丝·冯·莱宁根（1346年8月7日卒）是莱宁根伯爵弗里德里希四世之女，嫁费尔登茨伯爵格奥尔格一世，生亨利二世、弗里德里希一世；其兄弟埃米希于1314—1328年任施派尔主教。

en: Agnes of Veldenz (1258–1277) was the heiress of Count Gerlach V and Elisabeth of Zweibrücken. She married Henry I of Hohengeroldseck, bringing him the County of Veldenz in 1270.
zh: 阿格内丝·冯·费尔登茨（1258—1277）是格拉赫五世与茨韦布吕肯的伊丽莎白的女继承人，嫁与霍亨盖罗尔茨埃克的亨利希一世，于1270年将费尔登茨伯国带给他。

en: Emicho was a Rhineland count of the Emichones kindred, holding Kyrburg and Schmidtburg and attested in charters from 1086 to 1113. Genealogies name him the father of Gerlach I, first count of Veldenz. He may have been the same man as Emich of Flonheim, who raised a host for the People's Crusade in the spring of 1096 and in May led the massacre of the Jewish community of Mainz, the worst of the Rhineland massacres. The crusader's army marched on toward Hungary but broke up after clashes with the Hungarians, and he returned home in disgrace.
zh: 埃米希是埃米希奥内家族的莱茵兰伯爵，领有基尔堡与施密特堡，1086至1113年间见于文书记载。谱系记载称他是首任费尔登茨伯爵格拉赫一世的父亲。他可能就是弗隆海姆的埃米希，后者于1096年春为平民十字军聚众起兵，并于5月主谋了对美因茨犹太社区的屠杀，这是莱茵兰屠杀中最惨烈的一起。这位十字军领袖的军队继续向匈牙利进发，却在与匈牙利人的冲突中溃散，他蒙羞返乡。

en: Georg I von Veldenz (died 1347), son of Heinrich I von Hohengeroldseck and Agnes von Veldenz, inherited the County of Veldenz in 1298 through his mother's line. From at least 1309 he served the Empire as royal Landvogt in the Speyergau, residing at Germersheim, and from 1321 held an imperial castle-fief at Kaiserslautern. In 1315 King Louis IV allowed him to fortify Meisenheim and grant it town rights, and he enlarged Schloss Veldenz. He married Agnes von Leiningen; their son Heinrich II succeeded him, while another son, Friedrich I, died as early as 1327.
zh: 格奥尔格一世·冯·费尔登茨（？—1347）是霍恩格罗尔德塞克的亨利一世与费尔登茨的阿格尼丝之子，1298年沿母系继承费尔登茨伯国。至迟自1309年起，他出任帝国的施派尔高皇家地方长官，驻节盖默斯海姆；1321年起又在凯泽斯劳滕持有帝国城堡封地。1315年，国王路易四世准许他在迈森海姆筑城并授予城市权，他还扩建了费尔登茨城堡。他娶阿格尼丝·冯·莱宁根，儿子亨利二世继位，另一子弗里德里希一世已于1327年先逝。

en: Gerlach I (died 1146), attested from 1112, was the first count of Veldenz and founder of its elder line, a son of Count Emicho of Kyrburg. He married Cecilia, daughter of Louis the Springer.
zh: 格拉赫一世（卒于1146年）1112年起受记载，是费尔登茨首任伯爵与长系开创者，基尔堡伯爵埃米希之子，娶路德维希·德·施普林格之女采齐莉亚。

en: Gerlach II (died 1189) succeeded his father Gerlach I as count of Veldenz in 1146, and was in turn succeeded by his son Gerlach III.
zh: 格拉赫二世（卒于1189年）1146年继其父格拉赫一世成为费尔登茨伯爵，后由其子格拉赫三世继位。

en: Gerlach III (died 1214) was count of Veldenz from 1189. He married a daughter of the Raugrave Emicho II of Baumburg and was succeeded by his son Gerlach IV.
zh: 格拉赫三世（卒于1214年）自1189年起任费尔登茨伯爵，娶鲍姆堡伯爵埃米希二世之女，由其子格拉赫四世继位。

en: Gerlach IV ruled Veldenz from 1220 to 1240 and had died by 30 April 1245. He married Beatrix of Kyrburg, daughter of Wildgrave Conrad II, and was succeeded by his son Gerlach V.
zh: 格拉赫四世于1220至1240年统治费尔登茨，1245年4月30日前已去世；他娶伯爵康拉德二世之女基尔堡的贝阿特丽克丝，子格拉赫五世继位。

en: Gerlach V (died between July 1259 and 13 September 1260) was the last count of Veldenz of the elder line, ruling from 1254. He married Elisabeth of Zweibrücken and was succeeded by his daughter Agnes.
zh: 格拉赫五世（卒于1259年7月至1260年9月13日之间）自1254年统治费尔登茨，是长系末代伯爵，娶茨韦布吕肯的伊丽莎白，由女儿阿格内丝继承。

en: Heinrich II von Veldenz (c. 1300–1378) was the second son of Count Georg I and Agnes von Leiningen. On 15 January 1330 he married Agnes von Sponheim, daughter of Count Simon II von Sponheim-Kreuznach. His elder brother Friedrich I died in 1327, and Heinrich inherited the County of Veldenz after Georg I died in 1347. When Friedrich's unmarried son Georg II died in 1377, most of his branch's property passed to Heinrich. Heinrich died in 1378; he was the father of Heinrich III, his successor, and of Agnes, Adelheid and Elisabeth.
zh: 亨利二世·冯·费尔登茨（约1300—1378）是伯爵格奥尔格一世与阿格尼丝·冯·莱宁根的次子。1330年1月15日，他娶施蓬海姆-克罗伊茨纳赫伯爵西蒙二世之女阿格尼丝·冯·施蓬海姆。兄长弗里德里希一世于1327年去世，1347年格奥尔格一世去世后，亨利继承费尔登茨伯国。1377年，弗里德里希之子格奥尔格二世未婚而亡，其家支的大部分财产归亨利所有。亨利于1378年去世，由儿子亨利三世继位，另有女儿阿格尼丝、阿德尔海德和伊丽莎白。

en: Heinrich I von Geroldseck (c. 1252, died 1296–1298) was a son of Walter I von Geroldseck, lord of Hohengeroldseck, and Heilika von Malberg. When the Veldenz comital family died out in the male line with Count Gerlach V around 1259, Heinrich married Gerlach's heiress Agnes von Veldenz, and from 1270 styled himself count of Veldenz, founding the Geroldseck dynasty of the county. By Agnes he fathered Georg I, who succeeded him, and Walram, bishop of Speyer from 1328 until his death in 1336. His own brother Walter served as bishop of Strasbourg.
zh: 亨利一世·冯·格罗尔德塞克（约1252—1296/1298）是霍恩格罗尔德塞克领主瓦尔特一世·冯·格罗尔德塞克与海莉卡·冯·马尔贝格之子。1259年前后伯爵格拉克五世去世，费尔登茨家族男系绝嗣，亨利遂娶格拉克的女继承人阿格尼丝·冯·费尔登茨，并自1270年起自称费尔登茨伯爵，开创该伯国的格罗尔德塞克王朝。阿格尼丝所生的格奥尔格一世继位，另一子瓦尔拉姆于1328年起任施派尔主教，1336年去世；他的兄弟瓦尔特则曾任斯特拉斯堡主教。

en: Adriana Borromeo was probably the first wife of the Venetian nobleman Giovanni Gradenigo, later the 56th doge of Venice.
zh: 阿德里安娜·博罗梅奥可能是威尼斯贵族、后来的第五十六任总督乔瓦尼·格拉代尼戈的第一任妻子。

en: Agnese Dandolo was a Venetian noblewoman, wife of Pietro Zeno, called the Dragon, and mother of Carlo Zeno and his siblings Nicolò, Antonio, Lorenzo, Marino, Marchesina and Cattaruzza.
zh: 阿格内丝·丹多洛是威尼斯贵族妇女，嫁给绰号‘龙’的彼得罗·泽诺，育有卡洛、尼科洛、安东尼奥、洛伦佐、马里诺、马尔凯西娜和卡塔鲁扎等子女。

en: Agnese Ruggieri (born c. 1295) was the sister of Bonaccorso Ruggieri and the wife of Rolando de' Rossi, signore of Parma from 1328 to 1335. Her sons Giacomo and Bertrando inherited his lordships after his death in 1345.
zh: 阿格内丝·鲁杰里（约1295年生）是博纳科尔索·鲁杰里的姐妹，嫁给1328至1335年担任帕尔马僭主的罗兰多·德·罗西。罗兰多1345年去世后，她的儿子贾科莫与贝尔坦多继承了他的领地。

en: Albano Morosini may have been a son of Marino Morosini and a brother of Marco and Paolo Morosini and of Michele Morosini, who became doge of Venice in 1382.
zh: 阿尔巴诺·莫罗西尼可能是马里诺·莫罗西尼之子，也是马尔科、保罗以及1382年出任威尼斯总督的米凯莱·莫罗西尼的兄弟。

en: Alessio Cornaro, son of Andrea Cornaro, baron of Scarpanto, was a Venetian feoffee in Crete. With his father he seized Karpathos and Kassos from Genoa's Moresco clan in 1306, and after Andrea's death he and his brothers succeeded to the family's Aegean islands.
zh: 阿莱西奥·科尔纳罗是斯卡尔潘托男爵安德烈亚·科尔纳罗之子、威尼斯在克里特的封臣。1306年他随父亲从热那亚莫雷斯科家族手中夺取卡尔帕索斯岛和卡索斯岛；父亲去世后，他与兄弟继承了家族在爱琴海的岛屿。

en: Almorò Gradenigo, also called Ermolao, was a Venetian nobleman and a son of Doge Bartolomeo Gradenigo. In 1339 an agreement among the Gradenigo, Dandolo and Falier families secured Bartolomeo's election, and at the Giants' Staircase Almorò, the youngest of the ducal councillors, placed the crown on his father's head and, as the doge's laudatory biography tells it, wept with emotion. After the doge's death in 1342, which ended the favours he had arranged for his sons, the Major Council barred a living doge's brothers, sons and nephews from public office. In the autumn of 1350 Almorò was one of five patricians who escorted and watched over King Louis I of Hungary, Venice's rival for Dalmatia, as he crossed Venetian territory on his way back from Naples. In 1356 he sat among the forty-one electors who chose Giovanni Dolfin as doge.
zh: 阿尔莫罗·格拉代尼戈（又名埃尔莫拉奥）是威尼斯贵族，总督巴托洛梅奥·格拉代尼戈之子。1339年，格拉代尼戈、丹多洛和法列罗三家达成协议，促成巴托洛梅奥当选；在巨人阶梯上，作为最年轻的总督顾问，阿尔莫罗亲手为父亲戴上冠冕，据一部颂扬这位总督的传记记载，他当时感动落泪。1342年总督去世，为诸子谋官的好处就此终止，大议会禁止在任总督的兄弟、儿子和侄子担任公职。1350年秋，阿尔莫罗是五名贵族之一，在威尼斯在达尔马提亚的对手、匈牙利国王拉约什一世从那不勒斯返程途经威尼斯领土时，护送并监视其行程。1356年，他跻身选举乔瓦尼·多尔芬为总督的四十一名选举人之列。

en: Alvica Gradenigo was a Venetian noblewoman, a granddaughter of Doge Pietro Gradenigo and the daughter of Nicolo Gradenigo and Fiordelise; she is already named in her grandfather's will in 1309. By 1335 she had married Marino Falier as his second wife, becoming dogaressa when he took office in 1354. After Falier was executed for his coup attempt in April 1355, the Council of Ten cleared her of complicity and returned her dowry of 4000 lire. During a long widowhood she traded and lent money, dying between February 1387 and January 1388 as one of the richest women in Venice.
zh: 阿尔维卡·格拉代尼戈是威尼斯贵族女性，总督彼得罗·格拉代尼戈的孙女，尼科洛·格拉代尼戈与菲奥迪莉塞之女，1309年已在祖父的遗嘱中被提及。1335年前她嫁给马里诺·法列罗为续弦，1354年法列罗就职时成为总督夫人。1355年4月法列罗因政变未遂被处决后，十人团认定她未参与阴谋，发还其4000里拉嫁妆。漫长寡居期间她经商放贷，于1387年2月至1388年1月间去世，已是威尼斯最富有的女性之一。

en: Andrea Contarini (c. 1300–1382) had twice avoided the dogeship before 25 of 41 electors chose him as Venice's sixtieth doge on 20 January 1368; he accepted only when told the alternative was perpetual exile and the confiscation of his goods. Early on he waged war on Trieste, and in 1372 the Republic exposed a poison plot hatched by the Carraresi lords of Padua. His dogeship was defined by the War of Chioggia against Genoa. After the defeat off Pola on 7 May 1379 the Genoese seized Chioggia; Contarini liquidated his fortune to fund the war and, though nearly eighty, took command of some of the ships. The imprisoned admiral Vettor Pisani was released on 18 August 1379 and given the last forty galleys, and Chioggia was retaken on 24 June 1380. The Peace of Turin in 1381 cost Venice Dalmatia, Treviso, Conegliano and Tenedos. He died on 5 June 1382.
zh: 安德烈亚·孔塔里尼（约1300—1382）曾两度躲过总督之位，1368年1月20日，41名选举人中有25人投票选他，他得知拒绝的代价是终身流放和没收家产，才接受任命，成为威尼斯第六十任总督。执政之初他对的里雅斯特开战，1372年共和国又揭破了帕多瓦的卡拉雷西家族领主策划的投毒阴谋。他任内的决定性事件是对热那亚的基奥贾战争。1379年5月7日威尼斯舰队在波拉外海战败，热那亚人攻占基奥贾；孔塔里尼变卖家产充作军饷，年近八旬仍亲自统率部分战船。被囚的海军将领维托尔·皮萨尼于1379年8月18日获释，受命指挥最后的四十艘桨帆船，1380年6月24日基奥贾收复。1381年《都灵和约》使威尼斯丢掉达尔马提亚、特雷维索、科内利亚诺和泰内多斯。他于1382年6月5日去世。

en: Andrea Cornaro was a son of Marco Cornaro, the 59th doge of Venice. He served the Republic as chancellor and was employed on diplomatic missions.
zh: 安德烈亚·科尔纳罗是第59任威尼斯总督马可·科尔纳罗之子，曾担任威尼斯共和国文书长，并奉命执行外交使命。

en: Andrea Dandolo (30 April 1306 – 7 September 1354) was a Venetian noble from one of the republic's oldest families, which had already given it three doges. He probably studied law at Padua and was made procurator of St Mark's around 1328, at twenty-two, despite votes cast against his youth. He was elected the fifty-fourth doge on 4 January 1343, still in his thirties. A friend and correspondent of Petrarch, he had the Pala d'Oro of St Mark's restored in 1343–1345, gathered the republic's treaties into the Liber Albus and Liber Blancus, and wrote the Chronica Extensa, a chronicle of Venice from its origins to 1280 that later historians copied almost wholesale. The Black Death of 1348 may have taken half of Venice, Zara and Capodistria rose in revolt, and a war with Genoa filled his last four years. He died in 1354, before it ended, and was buried in St Mark's Baptistery.
zh: 安德烈亚·丹多洛（1306年4月30日—1354年9月7日）出身威尼斯最古老的家族之一，该家族已出过三位总督。他可能在帕多瓦学习过法律，约1328年二十二岁时被选为圣马可行政长官，尽管有人因他年轻而投反对票。1343年1月4日，他还不到四十岁，就当选第五十四任总督。他是彼特拉克的朋友和通信对象；1343—1345年主持修复圣马可大教堂的黄金祭坛屏，把共和国的条约汇编为《白皮书》与《白册》，并撰写了记述威尼斯起源至1280年历史的《详编编年史》，后世史家几乎都转抄此书。1348年的黑死病可能夺走了威尼斯一半的人口，扎拉和卡波迪斯特里亚相继叛乱，对热那亚的战争则占据了他生命的最后四年。他于1354年去世，战争尚未结束，葬于圣马可洗礼堂。
