With his brother Bertrando he lent the debt-ridden cathedral chapter of Parma 1071 gold florins in all, while their uncle Ugolino was bishop; in 1365 the chapter gave the brothers the lands of San Secondo in compensation. On 2 January 1367, Bertrando having died, Giacomo was enfeoffed with San Secondo with Ugolino's approval. In 1368 the inhabitants swore him fealty as they had to his predecessors, a sign that Rossi power there was already rooted. He later founded an ecclesiastical benefice. In his will of August 1370 he left the county to his nephew Bertrando the younger, though his own son Rolando held it de facto until 1389.
zh: 贾科莫·德·罗西（？—约1370）是罗兰多·德·罗西与阿涅塞·鲁杰里之子。父亲统治帕尔马的计划落空后，罗西家族退而经营一块小得多的领地，贾科莫成了这块领地的首任伯爵。他与兄弟贝特朗多次向债台高筑的帕尔马主教座堂教务会借款，总额1071金弗罗林，时任主教是他们的叔父乌戈利诺；1365年，教务会把圣塞孔多的土地抵给兄弟二人作补偿。1367年1月2日，贝特朗已去世，乌戈利诺批准贾科莫受封圣塞孔多。1368年当地臣民向他宣誓效忠，措辞一如对他的前任，可见罗西家族的权力在当地早已扎根。他后来设立了一份教会圣俸。1370年8月他立下遗嘱，把伯国传给侄子小贝特朗，但他自己的儿子罗兰多实际统治该地直到1389年。

en: Giberto da Fogliano (c. 1280–c. 1372), son of Niccolò da Fogliano and Caterina della Scala, was a condottiero who spent much of his life trying to win back Reggio nell'Emilia. In 1328 his family drove out the governor appointed by Pope John XXII, and when Louis the Bavarian came down into Italy Giberto sided with the Ghibellines and became imperial vicar of Reggio. In 1335 the city passed to the Gonzaga, who spared the family's property, and he withdrew to Verona to serve the Scaligeri. He was captured defending Treviso for Mastino II in 1336 and freed three years later. In 1344, backed by Obizzo III d'Este and the Scaligeri, he besieged Reggio but fell into Gonzaga hands, and they tore down many of his buildings in revenge. A new attempt in 1354 failed. He then backed the Visconti, but their 1369 truce again went against him, and he was imprisoned with his family, probably dying in 1372.
zh: 吉贝托·达·福利亚诺（约1280—约1372）是雇佣兵首领，尼科洛·达·福利亚诺与卡泰丽娜·德拉·斯卡拉之子，一生大半在设法夺回雷焦艾米利亚。1328年，福利亚诺家族把教皇约翰二十二世任命的总督逐出雷焦；巴伐利亚人路易南下意大利时，吉贝托站到吉伯林派一边，出任雷焦的皇帝代理人。1335年雷焦转入贡扎加家族之手，对方保全了福利亚诺家的财产，他退居维罗纳，效力于斯卡拉家族。1336年，他为马斯蒂诺二世防守特雷维索时被俘，三年后获释。1344年，他在奥比佐三世·埃斯特和斯卡拉家族的支持下围攻雷焦，却落入贡扎加家族手中，对方为泄愤拆毁了他的许多建筑。1354年他再度尝试，仍告失败。此后他倒向维斯孔蒂家族，但1369年的休战对他又是不利，他与家人一同被囚，约1372年去世。

en: Joanna of Swabia (c. 1280–1352) was the daughter of Conrad of Antiochia, a Hohenstaufen baron and grandson of Emperor Frederick II, by Beatrice Lancia, daughter of the grand marshal Galvano Lancia. While travelling to Germany to marry a nobleman she had never met, she stopped at Verona as guest of her sister Constance, wife of Bartolomeo I della Scala. Cangrande I della Scala fell in love with her and married her in 1308. The marriage was childless, though Cangrande left several illegitimate children. She died at Verona in 1352.
zh: 施瓦本的乔万娜（约1280—1352）是安条克的科拉多之女；科拉多出身霍恩施陶芬家族，是皇帝腓特烈二世的孙子，母亲贝亚特里切·兰恰是王国大元帅加尔瓦诺·兰恰之女。她在前往德意志、准备嫁给一位素未谋面的贵族途中，在维罗纳停留，做客于姊妹科斯坦扎家中，科斯坦扎是巴尔托洛梅奥一世·德拉·斯卡拉之妻。坎格兰德一世·德拉·斯卡拉对她一见倾心，于1308年娶她为妻。两人没有生育，坎格兰德只留下数名私生子。乔万娜于1352年在维罗纳去世。

en: Giovanni Castracani degli Antelminelli was a legitimate son of Castruccio Castracani, Ghibelline lord of Lucca, by his wife Pina de' Streghi.
zh: 乔瓦尼·卡斯特拉卡尼·德利·安泰尔米内利是卢卡吉伯林派领主卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼与妻子皮娜·德·斯特雷吉的婚生子。

en: Giovanni II Castracani (born c. 1337 at Lucca) was a son of Valeriano Castracani, a Lucchese cavalry commander who led some thousand horsemen for the Visconti of Milan in 1356, and a grandson of Castruccio Castracani, the Ghibelline duke of Lucca.
zh: 乔瓦尼二世·卡斯特拉卡尼（约1337年生于卢卡）是瓦莱里亚诺·卡斯特拉卡尼之子、吉伯林派卢卡公爵卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼之孙；其父瓦莱里亚诺是卢卡骑兵将领，1356年曾率约千名骑兵为米兰维斯孔蒂家族作战。

en: Giovanni da Correggio (died c. 1363) was an Italian nobleman and condottiero, son of Giberto III da Correggio of Parma and Maddalena Rossi, who held the signorie of Correggio and Guastalla. In 1341 he was taken prisoner at Parma when his brothers drove out the Scaligeri. After quarrelling with his brother Guido he was forced to cede Castelnuovo in 1344. He then entered Este service, was captured by Feltrino Gonzaga, and was released only in 1345. He died around 1363, leaving a son Antonio, who served the Visconti as a knight.
zh: 乔瓦尼·达·科雷焦（1363年前后卒）是意大利贵族与佣兵首领，帕尔马领主吉贝尔托三世·达·科雷焦与马达莱娜·罗西之子，领有科雷焦与瓜斯塔拉。1341年，他的兄弟们将斯卡拉家族逐出帕尔马，他也在该城被俘。他与兄弟圭多反目，于1344年被迫割让卡斯泰尔诺沃。此后他转投埃斯特家族效力，被费尔特里诺·贡扎加俘虏，直到1345年才获释。约1363年去世，留下一子安东尼奥，后者成为效力维斯孔蒂家族的骑士。

en: Guecello Tempesta (c. 1288–1338) was a Trevisan noble and avogaro of the bishop of Treviso, leader of the city's pro-Scaliger faction. In 1327, after two years in exile, he survived an assassination attempt at a wedding in Treviso, raised mercenaries at his stronghold of Noale and seized the city, executing his rivals. He surrendered Treviso to Cangrande I della Scala in 1329, fought for the Scaligeri and was podestà of Verona in 1329–1330. Switching sides in 1337, he took Venetian command between the Piave and the Brenta, but died in 1338, after which Venice dismantled his signoria.
zh: 圭切洛·滕佩斯塔（约1288—1338）是特雷维索贵族、特雷维索主教府的阿沃加罗（教会产业代管人），也是城中亲斯卡拉派的领袖。1327年，在流亡两年后，他在特雷维索一场婚礼上躲过刺杀，退据据点诺阿莱招募雇佣军，随后控制城市并处死反对者。1329年他把特雷维索献给坎格兰德一世·德拉·斯卡拉，此后为斯卡拉家族作战，1329至1330年任维罗纳行政长官。1337年他转投威尼斯，获得皮亚韦河与布伦塔河之间军队的指挥权，但于1338年去世，威尼斯随后解散了他的领主权。

en: Guecellone VIII da Camino (after 1285–1332) was a knight, the son of Biaquino VI da Camino and Genoese noblewoman Auriola Grimaldi. In 1315 he served the commune of Treviso, and from 1318 he served Venice for a thousand ducats a year, becoming lord of Oderzo. He fought the Scaligeri expanding into the March of Treviso and was imprisoned in Verona. In 1326 he tried to seize the castles of Motta and Camino from his cousin Biaquino VII, causing a long lawsuit. He died in January or February 1332, leaving sons Gherardo V and Rizzardo VII by Beatrice da Prata.
zh: 圭切洛内八世·达·卡米诺（1285年后—1332）是一名骑士，比亚奎诺六世·达·卡米诺与热那亚贵妇奥廖拉·格里马尔迪之子。1315年他效力于特雷维索公社，1318年起为威尼斯服役，年俸一千达克特，并成为奥德尔佐领主。他抵抗斯卡拉家族向特雷维索边区扩张，曾被俘虏关押在维罗纳。1326年，他试图从堂兄弟比亚奎诺七世手中夺取莫塔和卡米诺城堡，引发长期诉讼。他于1332年1月或2月去世，与妻子贝阿特丽切·达·普拉塔生有儿子格拉尔多五世和里扎尔多七世。

en: Guido Savina da Fogliano was a son of Giberto da Fogliano, who long fought for the lordship of Reggio Emilia. He married Camilla da Canossa, and their son Carlo, born around 1350, became a prominent condottiero in the wars between the Visconti, the Terzi and the Este for Reggio. In 1373 Guido Savina made a pact with Bernabò Visconti, lord of Milan, who confirmed his jurisdiction over his lands. He died in 1379.
zh: 圭多·萨维纳·达·福利亚诺是吉贝尔托·达·福利亚诺之子，其父长期争夺雷焦艾米利亚的统治权。他娶卡米拉·达·卡诺萨为妻；儿子卡洛约生于1350年，后来成为维斯孔蒂、泰尔齐与埃斯特三家争夺雷焦战事中的著名将领。1373年，圭多·萨维纳与米兰君主贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂订立盟约，后者确认了他对自己领地的司法权。他于1379年去世。

en: Jacopino della Scala (12th century–after 1248) was a Veronese wool merchant and politician, father of the first Scaliger lords of Verona. A grandson of Balduino della Scala, he held no noble titles and no great fortune. Known as an able and respected politician inclined to peace, he became imperial vicar of Ostiglia and podestà of Cerea. By his first wife Margherita Giustiniani he had a son Manfredo, bishop of Verona from 1241 to 1256, and by his second wife Elisa Superbi he fathered Mastino I and Alberto I, the first Scaliger lords of Verona, as well as Bocca and Guido.
zh: 雅各皮诺·德拉·斯卡拉（12世纪—1248年后）是维罗纳的羊毛商人与政治家，斯卡拉家族最早几代维罗纳之主的父亲。作为巴尔杜伊诺·德拉·斯卡拉之孙，他没有贵族头衔，也无丰厚家产。他是一位有才干、有威望且倾向和平的政治家，出任过奥斯蒂利亚的皇帝代理人和切雷阿的波德斯塔。他与第一任妻子玛格丽塔·朱斯蒂尼亚尼生有曼弗雷多（1241—1256年任维罗纳主教），与第二任妻子埃莉萨·苏佩尔比生有马斯蒂诺一世、阿尔贝托一世、博卡和圭多，其中马斯蒂诺与阿尔贝托后来成为斯卡拉家族最早的维罗纳之主。

en: Leonardina della Torre was a noblewoman of the della Torre house of Friuli. As a child she was betrothed to Tolberto IV da Camino, son of Rizzardo VII, to seal peace with Pagano della Torre, patriarch of Aquileia. Her son was Gherardo VII da Camino.
zh: 莱昂纳尔迪娜·德拉·托雷出身弗留利的权贵家族德拉·托雷家族。她幼年即被许配给里扎尔多七世之子托尔贝托四世·达·卡米诺，以与阿奎莱亚宗主教帕加诺·德拉·托雷和解，其子为盖拉尔多七世·达·卡米诺。

en: Luigi da Fogliano was a son of Giberto da Fogliano, the Reggian nobleman who contended for the lordship of Reggio Emilia. He died in 1344.
zh: 路易吉·达·福利亚诺是争夺雷焦艾米利亚统治权的雷焦贵族吉贝尔托·达·福利亚诺之子，1344年去世。

en: Maddalena de' Rossi was a Parmese noblewoman, daughter of Guglielmo de' Rossi and Donella da Carrara of Padua. She married Gherardo V da Camino, a lord of the feudal family of the March of Treviso. When Gherardo died around 1349, Maddalena became guardian of their young son Guecellone IX; her charter records that the family had by then recovered Portobuffolé, Motta, Oderzo and its other fiefs seized by the Scaligeri.
zh: 马达莱娜·德·罗西是帕尔马贵族女子，为古列尔莫·德·罗西与帕多瓦的多内拉·达·卡拉拉之女。她嫁给特雷维索边区封建家族的盖拉尔多五世·达·卡米诺。约1349年盖拉尔多去世后，马达莱娜成为幼子圭切洛内九世的监护人；她立下的一份文书表明，家族此时已收复被斯卡拉家族夺走的波尔托布福莱、莫塔、奥德尔佐等采邑。

en: Mastino I della Scala, born Leonardino, was the son of Jacopino della Scala and founder of Scaliger rule in Verona. A Ghibelline follower of Ezzelino III da Romano, he became podestà of Verona in 1259 and capitano del popolo from 1262, controlling the commune through its offices without a lordly title. From 1261 to 1269 he headed the merchants' house, overseeing the city's production and commerce. In 1264 his troops took Lonigo and Montebello, and he won Veronese trading rights on the Adige from Venice. He also made peace with Mantua. Backing Conradin in 1267 earned him excommunication, lifted after Cathars were burned in the Arena. He was assassinated in Verona in October 1277 and succeeded by his brother Alberto I.
zh: 马斯蒂诺一世·德拉·斯卡拉本名莱奥纳尔迪诺，是雅各皮诺·德拉·斯卡拉之子，也是斯卡拉家族在维罗纳统治的奠基人。作为吉伯林派领袖埃泽利诺三世·达·罗马诺的追随者，他于1259年成为维罗纳最高行政长官，1262年起任人民领袖，不靠单一领主头衔而通过多个官职控制全城。1261至1269年，他掌管商人之家，监督城内的生产与贸易。1264年，他的军队攻取洛尼戈和蒙特贝洛，又从威尼斯争取到维罗纳人在阿迪杰河的通商权。他还与曼托瓦议和。1267年他支持康拉丁而被开除教籍，后来在竞技场烧死清洁派信徒后才解除。1277年10月他在维罗纳遇刺，其弟阿尔贝托一世继位。

en: Mastino II della Scala (1308–1351), son of Alboino I and Beatrice da Correggio, ruled Verona jointly with his brother Alberto II after Cangrande I died in 1329, but held the real power. He gave up his father's cautious balancing for conquest: he fought John of Bohemia at Palazzolo in April 1332, took Brescia that year, and won Parma and Lucca in 1335. Florence, Venice and other cities formed a league against him, and by 1337 Milan under the Visconti, the Este, the Gonzaga and the Papal States had joined it. In 1338 he stabbed his cousin Bartolomeo, bishop of Verona, in public. In February 1339 Lodrisio Visconti's mercenaries, whom he backed against Milan, lost at Parabiago, and Emperor Louis IV mediated a peace that left him only Verona and Vicenza. He died in Verona on 3 June 1351 and lies in the Scaliger Tombs by Santa Maria Antica.
zh: 马斯蒂诺二世·德拉·斯卡拉（1308—1351）是阿尔博伊诺一世与贝阿特丽切·达·科雷焦之子。1329年坎格兰德一世去世后，他与兄长阿尔贝托二世共同执掌维罗纳，实权却在他手里。他抛开父亲谨慎的均势政策，转向扩张：1332年4月在帕拉佐洛与波希米亚的约翰作战，同年夺取布雷西亚，1335年又拿下帕尔马和卢卡。佛罗伦萨、威尼斯等城市结盟对付他，到1337年，米兰的维斯孔蒂、埃斯特、贡扎加家族和教皇国也加入同盟。1338年，他当众刺死堂兄弟、维罗纳主教巴尔托洛梅奥。1339年2月，他支持的洛德里西奥·维斯孔蒂的雇佣兵在帕拉比亚戈败给米兰，皇帝路易四世随后出面调停，他只保住维罗纳和维琴察。1351年6月3日他在维罗纳去世，葬于老圣玛利亚教堂旁的斯卡拉陵墓。

en: Matteo da Fogliano was a son of Giberto da Fogliano, lord of Reggio Emilia, and a man-at-arms. He died in 1342.
zh: 马泰奥·达·福利亚诺是雷焦艾米利亚领主吉贝尔托·达·福利亚诺之子，是一名军人，1342年去世。

en: Orlando Castracani (born c. 1332) was a son of the Lucchese man-at-arms Arrigo Castracani and a grandson of Castruccio Castracani, the Ghibelline duke of Lucca. He was born at Verona while his family lived in exile after the collapse of its rule over Lucca.
zh: 奥兰多·卡斯特拉卡尼（约1332年生）是卢卡军人阿里戈·卡斯特拉卡尼之子、吉伯林派卢卡公爵卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼之孙。他出生于维罗纳，当时家族对卢卡的统治已经崩溃，全家流亡在外。

en: Pietro Dal Verme (c. 1300–1357) was a Veronese condottiero and diplomat, the founder of his family's fortunes, who rose with the Scaligers. A trusted officer of Cangrande della Scala, he was knighted after the taking of Padua in 1328. From 1329 to 1337 he governed newly won Treviso as podestà, a hard post of strained relations with Venice, in which he opposed excessive Scaliger taxation. In 1337 the Venetian–Florentine league overran the Scaliger strongholds one by one; he held Monselice, the last of them, for a year, and his garrison killed the league's commander Pietro de' Rossi. In August 1338 he gave up the starving town, riding out armed under Scaliger banners with his men and the townspeople unharmed. Captured when Lucca fell to Pisa in 1342, he backed Fregnano della Scala's failed coup in 1354 and was exiled with his sons. He died at Brescia in 1357, and the break left his house free to build its own power.
zh: 彼得罗·达尔·韦尔梅（约1300—1357）是维罗纳的雇佣兵首领与外交官，随斯卡拉家族崛起，奠定了达尔·韦尔梅家族的基业。作为坎格兰德·德拉·斯卡拉信任的将领，他在1328年攻占帕多瓦后受封骑士。1329—1337年，他出任新攻占的特雷维索的波德斯塔；这是个难做的职位，要应付与威尼斯的紧张关系，他还反对斯卡拉家族过度征税。1337年威尼斯与佛罗伦萨的联盟接连攻克斯卡拉家族的据点，他守住了最后一处蒙塞利切，坚持了一年，守军还杀死了联盟统帅彼得罗·德·罗西。1338年8月，他交出饥饿的城镇，全副武装、打着斯卡拉旗号骑马出城，部下和居民安然无恙。1342年卢卡落入比萨之手时他被俘；1354年他支持弗雷尼亚诺·德拉·斯卡拉的未遂政变，与儿子们一同被放逐。他于1357年卒于布雷西亚，这次决裂也让他的家族得以自立门户，另起炉灶。

en: Pietro della Scala (c. 1330–1393) was an illegitimate son of Mastino II della Scala, lord of Verona. On 3 December 1350 he was consecrated bishop of his native city, and in that office he worked to restore the Church property and rights that Cansignorio della Scala had taken from the clergy. After the Scaligeri lost Verona in 1387, Gian Galeazzo Visconti persuaded Pope Urban VI to move him to Lodi. Driven from Lodi by the Visconti in 1390, he took refuge in Mantua, where he died in 1393. He left three natural sons.
zh: 彼得罗·德拉·斯卡拉（约1330—1393）是维罗纳领主马斯蒂诺二世·德拉·斯卡拉的私生子。1350年12月3日，他被祝圣为故乡维罗纳的主教，任内致力于收回被坎西尼奥里奥·德拉·斯卡拉夺走的教产与权利。1387年斯卡拉家族失去维罗纳后，吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂说服教皇乌尔班六世将他调往洛迪。1390年他被维斯孔蒂家族逐出洛迪，避居曼托瓦，1393年在当地去世。他留下三个私生子。

en: Redondello dalle Carceri (also called Rotondello) was a Veronese nobleman, brother of Ravano dalle Carceri, the triarch of Negroponte, and of Enrico, bishop of Mantua. He is recorded as podestà of Verona in 1210 and was also named podestà of Mantua.
zh: 雷东代洛·达莱·卡尔切里（一作罗通代洛）是维罗纳贵族，内格罗蓬特三头统治者拉万·达莱·卡尔切里与曼托瓦主教恩里科的兄弟。史料载他1210年出任维罗纳的波德斯塔，也曾被任命为曼托瓦的波德斯塔。

en: Rizzardo VI da Camino, called Rizzardo Novello (late 13th century – 12 September 1335), was an Italian condottiero, the son of Guecellone VII da Camino and Mabilia di San Bonifacio. Under an accord with the Scaligeri he married Verde, daughter of Alboino della Scala. After the Scaligeri took Feltre and Belluno in 1321 and occupied Serravalle in 1324, he recovered his domains in 1329. He later invaded western Friuli, taking Sacile in 1333, but Patriarch Bertrando of Aquileia defeated him and revoked his fiefs. Mortally wounded by the Friulians, he died at Serravalle, leaving three daughters.
zh: 里扎尔多六世·达·卡米诺，人称‘小里扎尔多’（13世纪末—1335年9月12日），是意大利佣兵首领，圭切洛内七世·达·卡米诺与马比利亚·迪·圣博尼法乔之子。根据家族与斯卡拉家族的协议，他娶了阿尔博伊诺·德拉·斯卡拉之女维尔德。1321年斯卡拉家族夺取费尔特雷和贝卢诺，1324年占领塞拉瓦莱，他于1329年收复领地。后来他入侵西弗留利，1333年攻占萨奇莱，但阿奎莱亚牧首贝尔坦多击败他并剥夺其封地。他被弗留利人重伤，死在塞拉瓦莱，只留下三个女儿。

en: Rizzardo VII da Camino (1290s–before 1358), son of Guecellone VIII and Beatrice da Prata, belonged to the lower branch of the Caminesi, a great feudal family of the Trevisan March. With his brother Gherardo V he stood high at Treviso, and after 1327 the two drifted from the Scaligeri towards Venice. When Rizzardo VI of the upper branch died in 1335 without male heirs, the brothers claimed his inheritance against his widow Verde della Scala, sister of the Scaliger lords of Verona, and in 1337 occupied Serravalle. Alarmed by their rise, Bishop Francesco Ramponi of Ceneda then offered the family's fiefs to Venice on forged documents. Rizzardo's plot against the bishop failed in 1340, and the brothers divided their lands. On 7 October 1345, with Venice mediating, the bishop invested them with castles at Ceneda and they entered the Venetian patriciate. By Stilichia d'Onigo he left Tolberto IV and Caterina, who wed Bertoldo I d'Este.
zh: 里扎尔多七世·达·卡米诺（1290年代—1358年前）是圭切洛内八世与贝阿特丽切·达·普拉塔之子，属于特雷维索边区大封建家族卡米诺家的“下支”。他与兄弟盖拉尔多五世在特雷维索颇有声望，1327年之后两人渐渐疏远斯卡拉家族、靠近威尼斯。1335年，“上支”的里扎尔多六世去世，没有男性继承人，兄弟二人便与其遗孀、维罗纳斯卡拉家族领主们的姐妹韦尔德·德拉·斯卡拉争夺遗产，1337年占领塞拉瓦莱。忌惮他们崛起的切内达主教弗朗切斯科·兰波尼，随即凭伪造文书把该家族的封地献给威尼斯。1340年，里扎尔多反对主教的密谋失败，兄弟二人瓜分了领地。1345年10月7日，在威尼斯斡旋下，主教在切内达将各城堡封给兄弟二人，他们也进入威尼斯贵族阶层。他与斯蒂利基亚·迪·奥尼戈生有托尔贝托四世和卡特琳娜，卡特琳娜后嫁与贝托尔多一世·埃斯特。

en: Simon da Correggio (died 1344) was an Emilian condottiero, son of Giberto III da Correggio and Elena Malaspina, and lord of Correggio and Guastalla. In 1323 he took the Guelph side under Cardinal Bertrando del Poggetto when Piacenza was seized from the Visconti, then changed sides and fought for Cangrande I della Scala against Padua. Driven out of Parma by the Rossi in 1329, he returned with Scaliger help in 1331 and in 1341 made himself, with his brothers, lord of Parma. He died in 1344, leaving a daughter Jacopina, wife of Ubertino da Carrara of Padua.
zh: 西莫内·达·科雷焦（？—1344）是艾米利亚雇佣军首领，吉贝托三世·达·科雷焦与埃莱娜·马拉斯皮纳之子，科雷焦和瓜斯塔拉的领主。1323年他站在圭尔夫派一边，在枢机主教贝尔特兰多·德尔·波杰托麾下参加从维斯孔蒂手中夺取皮亚琴察的战事；随后改换阵营，为坎格兰德一世·德拉·斯卡拉攻打帕多瓦。1329年他被罗西家族逐出帕尔马，1331年靠斯卡拉家族之助返回，1341年与兄弟们一同成为帕尔马领主。他于1344年去世，女儿雅各皮娜嫁给了帕多瓦领主乌贝尔蒂诺·达·卡拉拉。

en: Stilichia d'Onigo was the daughter of Guglielmo d'Onigo of Treviso and the wife of the nobleman Rizzardo VII da Camino. She bore him two children, Tolberto IV da Camino and Caterina, who married Bertoldo I d'Este.
zh: 斯蒂利基娅·德·奥尼戈是特雷维索的古列尔莫·德·奥尼戈之女，嫁与贵族里扎尔多七世·达·卡米诺。她为丈夫生下托尔贝托四世·达·卡米诺与卡特琳娜两个孩子，卡特琳娜后来嫁给贝托尔多一世·德·埃斯特。

en: Taddea da Carrara (c. 1304–1375) was the daughter of Jacopo I da Carrara, lord of Padua, and Elisabetta Gradenigo, whose father was the Venetian doge Pietro Gradenigo. In 1328 she married Mastino II della Scala, lord of Verona and Lucca, sealing the Scaliger-Carrara alliance, and bore him seven children. Her sons Cangrande II, Cansignorio and Paolo Alboino each ruled Verona, while her daughter Beatrice Regina married Bernabò Visconti and Verde married Niccolò II d'Este of Ferrara. She died in 1375.
zh: 塔代亚·达·卡拉拉（约1304—1375）是帕多瓦领主雅各布一世·达·卡拉拉与伊丽莎白·格拉代尼戈之女，外祖父是威尼斯总督彼得罗·格拉代尼戈。1328年她嫁给维罗纳与卢卡领主马斯蒂诺二世·德拉·斯卡拉，以婚姻巩固斯卡拉家族与卡拉拉家族的同盟，并为丈夫生下七个子女。她的儿子坎格兰德二世、坎西尼奥里奥和保罗·阿尔博伊诺都曾统治维罗纳，女儿贝亚特里切·雷吉娜嫁给贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂，维尔德嫁给费拉拉的尼科洛二世·德·埃斯特。她于1375年去世。

en: Tolberto IV da Camino (died 1360) was a nobleman of the March of Treviso, the son of Rizzardo VII da Camino and Stilichia di Onigo. While he and Leonardina della Torre were still children, their marriage was arranged to seal reconciliation between his father and her kinsman Pagano della Torre, patriarch of Aquileia. By 1358 he was lord of Solighetto, his family having recovered part of the lands lost in its quarrels with Venice and the bishop of Ceneda. That year Treviso's Council of Three Hundred called him to serve as a judge. He died in 1360.
zh: 托尔贝托四世·达·卡米诺（？—1360）是特雷维索边区贵族，里扎尔多七世·达·卡米诺与斯蒂利基亚·迪·奥尼戈之子。他还是孩童时便与莱奥纳尔迪娜·德拉·托雷订婚，以此促成父亲与女方亲族、阿奎莱亚牧首帕加诺·德拉·托雷和解。到1358年，他已是索利盖托的领主，此前家族收回了在与威尼斯和切内达主教的争执中丧失的部分领地。同年，特雷维索三百人委员会召他担任法官。他于1360年去世。

en: Uguccione della Faggiola (c. 1250–1319) was a Ghibelline condottiero who became virtual lord of Pisa and Lucca. A former podestà of Arezzo and imperial vicar in Genoa for Henry VII, he took power in Pisa in 1313 and sacked Lucca in 1314 with his protégé Castruccio Castracani. On 29 August 1315 he crushed the Florentine Guelphs and their Angevin allies at Montecatini, aided by a contingent of German cavalry. Driven out of Pisa in 1316 after resentment of his authoritarian rule and heavy taxes, he served Cangrande I della Scala as podestà of Vicenza and died of malaria on 1 November 1319 during the siege of Padua.
zh: 乌古乔内·德拉·法焦拉（约1250—1319）是吉伯林派雇佣兵首领，曾实际统治比萨与卢卡。他早年任阿雷佐的波德斯塔，又任皇帝亨利七世派驻热那亚的皇帝代理人，1313年入主比萨，1314年在门生卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼协助下洗劫卢卡。1315年8月29日，他凭借一支德意志骑兵的协助，在蒙特卡蒂尼击溃佛罗伦萨圭尔夫派及其安茹盟友。1316年比萨人不满他的专断统治和沉重赋税，将他驱逐；他遂效力于坎格兰德一世·德拉·斯卡拉，出任维琴察的波德斯塔，1319年11月1日在帕多瓦围城战期间死于疟疾。

en: Valeriano Castracani was a son of Castruccio Castracani, lord of Lucca. Still a boy when his father died in 1328, he was driven from Lucca with his brothers after the Guelf restoration and became a condottiero. In 1356 he led about a thousand cavalry for Bernabò Visconti against the anti-Visconti league in the Reggio country, but was beaten at San Polo d'Enza on 6 February. Later that year, on 14 November, he led the Milanese skirmishers whose feigned retreat drew Count Lando's company into the trap at Casorate, giving the Visconti a decisive victory.
zh: 瓦莱里亚诺·卡斯特拉卡尼是卢卡领主卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼之子。1328年父亲去世时他尚年幼，在圭尔夫派复辟后与兄弟们一同被逐出卢卡，此后成为雇佣军首领。1356年，他率约一千骑兵为贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂效力，在雷焦地区与反维斯孔蒂联盟作战，2月6日败于圣波洛登扎；同年11月14日，他率领米兰骑兵小队佯败，把兰多伯爵的佣兵团引入卡索拉泰的伏击圈，助维斯孔蒂军取得决定性胜利。

en: Verde della Scala was the daughter of Alboino I della Scala, lord of Verona, by his first wife Caterina Visconti. In 1316 she married Rizzardo VI da Camino, lord of Treviso, and bore him three daughters: Caterina, Ricciarda, who married Andrea Pepoli of Bologna, and Beatrice, who married Aldobrandino III d'Este. Her children thus carried the Camino line into the houses of Bologna and the Este. After Rizzardo's death she was married again in 1340, to Ugolino Gonzaga, future co-lord of Mantua, to keep the Scaligers' alliances with the powers of the day. She died in Mantua that same year without children by Gonzaga, and was buried in the cathedral of St Peter.
zh: 维尔德·德拉·斯卡拉是维罗纳领主阿尔博伊诺一世·德拉·斯卡拉与第一任妻子卡泰丽娜·维斯孔蒂之女。1316年，她嫁给特雷维索领主里扎尔多六世·达·卡米诺，生下三个女儿：卡泰丽娜、里恰尔达和贝阿特丽切；里恰尔达嫁给博洛尼亚的安德烈亚·佩波利，贝阿特丽切嫁给阿尔多布兰迪诺三世·德埃斯特。卡米诺家的血脉就这样进入了博洛尼亚和埃斯特两家。里扎尔多死后，为维持斯卡拉家族与当时各大势力的同盟，她于1340年改嫁未来的曼托瓦共治领主乌戈利诺·贡扎加。同年她在曼托瓦去世，未与贡扎加留下子嗣，葬于圣彼得大教堂。

en: Zonfredo Nogarola was a Veronese nobleman of the Nogarola family. He was the father of Bailardino Nogarola (c. 1270–1340), who served the della Scala lords of Verona as diplomat, podestà and condottiero.
zh: 宗弗雷达·诺加罗拉是维罗纳诺加罗拉家族的贵族。他是拜拉尔迪诺·诺加罗拉（约1270—1340）之父，后者以外交官、城市长官和佣兵首领身份效力于维罗纳领主德拉·斯卡拉家族。

en: Veronica Franco (c. 1546–1591) was a Venetian poet and a cortigiana onesta, an honoured courtesan whose humanist learning gave her access to Venice's leading literary circles. As a girl she received a humanist education from her brother's tutor. Briefly married as a teenager to the physician Paolo Panizza, she was listed among Venice's principal courtesans in 1565 and joined Domenico Venier's literary salon. She published two books, Terze rime in 1575 and Lettere familiari a diversi in 1580. After she left Venice during the plague of 1575, her home and possessions were looted and she lost much of her wealth. Charged with witchcraft before the Inquisition in 1577, she successfully defended herself, but spent her last years in poverty, dying in 1591.
zh: 韦罗妮卡·佛朗哥（约1546—1591）是威尼斯诗人，也是一名“体面的交际花”，凭借人文修养出入威尼斯的上流文学圈。她年幼时从兄弟的家庭教师那里接受了人文教育。她十几岁时曾短暂嫁给医生保罗·帕尼扎，1565年被列入威尼斯名妓名录，后加入多梅尼科·韦涅尔的文学沙龙。她出版了两部作品：1575年的《三韵集》和1580年的《致众人书信集》。1575年鼠疫期间她离开威尼斯，住宅和财物遭劫，损失了大部分财富。1577年她被宗教裁判所以施行巫术的罪名起诉，亲自辩护后指控被撤销；晚年陷入贫困，于1591年去世。

en: Henry II of Vianden (died 1337) was the last male of his house. Son of Count Philip II, he held the county from 1315 or 1316 jointly with his sister Adelaide, wife of Count Otto II of Nassau, and also had a lordship under his uncle Gerard V of Jülich. In 1335 or 1336 he married Marie of Namur, daughter of John I, Marquis of Namur. In 1337 he set out for the Holy Land by way of Cyprus with his brother-in-law Philip III of Namur, but at Famagusta their conduct was so dissolute that the townspeople killed them and their companions. Both were buried in the town's Franciscan church. Henry's infant daughter Marie inherited Vianden; in 1417 her daughter Elisabeth gave up her rights to Engelbert I of Nassau-Dillenburg, a grandson of Adelaide, who became Count of Vianden.
zh: 亨利二世（卒于1337年）是菲安登家族的最后一位男性。他是伯爵腓力二世之子，自1315或1316年起任菲安登伯爵，与嫁给拿骚伯爵奥托二世的姐姐阿德莱德共同治理，并在舅父于利希的格哈德五世之下领有一块领地。1335或1336年，他娶那慕尔侯爵约翰一世之女、那慕尔的玛丽为妻。1337年，他偕妻子的兄弟那慕尔的腓力三世取道塞浦路斯前往圣地，却在法马古斯塔因一行人行为放纵，被当地人连同同伴一起杀死。两人葬于当地方济各会教堂。亨利年幼的女儿玛丽继承了菲安登；1417年，玛丽之女伊丽莎白把权利让给阿德莱德的孙子、拿骚—迪伦堡的恩格尔贝特一世，后者成为菲安登伯爵。

en: Maria of Vianden (1337–1400), posthumous daughter of Count Henry II, inherited the County of Vianden at birth. In 1348 she married Simon III, Count of Sponheim-Kreuznach, who ruled Vianden in her right.
zh: 菲安登的玛丽（1337—1400）是伯爵亨利二世的遗腹女，出生即继承菲安登伯国。1348年她嫁给斯蓬海姆-克罗伊茨纳赫伯爵西蒙三世，由后者以她的名义统治。

en: Marie de Namur (1322 – before 1353) was a daughter of John I, Marquis of Namur, and Marie of Artois, and a sister of Blanche of Namur, queen of Sweden. In 1335 or 1336 she married Count Henry II of Vianden, who was murdered at Famagusta in September 1337; their daughter Maria inherited Vianden and married Simon III of Sponheim. In 1340 Marie married Theobald of Bar, lord of Pierrepont, by whom she had two more daughters, Yolande and Elisabeth.
zh: 那慕尔的玛丽（1322—1353年前）是那慕尔侯爵约翰一世与阿图瓦的玛丽之女，瑞典王后那慕尔的布朗什的姐妹。1335或1336年，她嫁给菲安登伯爵亨利二世；亨利于1337年9月在法马古斯塔遇害，二人的女儿玛丽亚后来继承菲安登，嫁给斯蓬海姆的西蒙三世。1340年，玛丽改嫁巴尔的蒂博（皮埃尔蓬领主），又生有约兰德和伊丽莎白两个女儿。

en: Bhavana Sangama, also called simply Sangama, was a chieftain of a pastoralist shepherd community in the Karnataka country, remembered above all as the father of the founders of the Vijayanagara Empire. He married Maravve Nayakiti, daughter of Kampili Deva Raya, king of Kampili, and elder sister of Prince Kumara Rama. His five sons were Harihara, Bukka, Kampa, Marappa and Muddappa; the eldest two, Harihara and Bukka, went on to found Vijayanagara in 1336.
zh: 巴瓦纳·桑迦摩又简称桑迦摩，是卡纳塔克地区一个游牧牧人社群的首领，最主要的身份是毗奢耶那伽罗帝国开创者们的父亲。他娶剑毕离国王坎皮利·提婆·罗耶之女、库马拉·拉马王子的姐姐马拉夫·那雅吉蒂为妻。他有五个儿子：哈里哈拉、布卡、坎帕、马拉帕和穆达帕；其中长子哈里哈拉与布卡后来于1336年开创了毗奢耶那伽罗帝国。

en: Bukka Raya I (died 1377), a son of Bhavana Sangama of the Sangama dynasty, ruled the Vijayanagara Empire from 1356, succeeding his brother Harihara I. By 1360 he had conquered the Shambuvaraya kingdom of Arcot and the Reddis of Kondavidu and annexed Penukonda. In 1371 his son Kumara Kampana overthrew the Sultanate of Madurai, and Vijayanagara arms reached Rameswaram. By 1374 Bukka held the upper hand against the Bahmani Sultanate in the Tungabhadra-Krishna doab, took Goa, and forced Jaffna and the Zamorin of Calicut to pay tribute. He died in February 1377 and was followed by his son Harihara II.
zh: 布卡一世（1377年去世）是桑迦摩王朝婆伐那·桑迦摩之子，1356年继其兄哈里哈拉一世之后统治毗奢耶那伽罗帝国。到1360年，他征服阿尔果德的尚布瓦罗耶王国和孔达维杜的雷迪人，并吞并佩努孔达地区。1371年，其子库马拉·坎帕纳推翻马杜赖苏丹国，兵锋南下抵达勒梅斯沃勒姆。到1374年，布卡在通加巴德拉—克里希纳河河间地对巴赫马尼苏丹国占据上风，夺取果阿，并迫使贾夫纳和卡利卡特的扎莫林纳贡。他于1377年2月去世，其子哈里哈拉二世继位。

en: Harihara I (1306–1355), also called Hakka, was the eldest son of Bhavana Sangama and founder of the Vijayanagara Empire, ruling from 18 April 1336 until his death. With his brothers, above all Bukka, he built his power in the Tungabhadra valley and erected a fort at Barkuru on the west coast. After the Hoysala king Veera Ballala III died in 1343, he absorbed the Hoysala territories and extended his rule to Konkan and the Malabar coast; a 1346 inscription styles him lord between the eastern and western seas. He died on 20 November 1355 and was succeeded by Bukka.
zh: 哈里哈拉一世（1306—1355）又名哈卡，是巴瓦纳·桑迦摩的长子、毗奢耶那伽罗帝国的开创者，自1336年4月18日起统治该国，直至去世。他与诸弟——尤其是布卡——在栋格珀德拉河谷建立势力，并在西海岸的巴尔库鲁修建堡垒。1343年霍伊萨拉国王维拉·巴拉拉三世死后，他吞并霍伊萨拉的领土，把统治扩展到孔卡纳和马拉巴尔海岸；1346年的一则铭文称他为“东西两洋之间”的统治者。1355年11月20日他去世，由布卡继位。

en: Kampilideva was the second and last king of the Kampili kingdom, succeeding his father Singeya Nayaka III in 1300. With his son Prince Kumara Rama he fought repeated wars against the Kakatiyas of Warangal, the Hoysalas and the Delhi Sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq. In 1327/1328 Tughlaq's armies invaded the kingdom, one of the last independent Hindu states in southern India. When defeat became certain the royal women performed jauhar, and Kampilideva and Kumara Rama fell fighting. Their kingdom's fall preceded the rise of the Vijayanagara Empire under Harihara and Bukka.
zh: 坎比梨德瓦是剑毕离王国第二任也是末代国王，1300年继承父亲辛吉亚·纳亚卡三世。他与王子库马拉·罗摩连年征战，对手包括瓦朗加尔的卡卡提耶王朝、曷萨拉王朝和德里苏丹穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克。1327/1328年，图格鲁克的大军入侵这个南印度最后残存的独立印度教王国之一。败局已定之际，宫中妇女行乔哈尔仪式自焚殉国，坎比梨德瓦与库马拉·罗摩战死沙场。剑毕离亡国后，诃里诃罗与布卡兄弟建立的毗奢耶那伽罗帝国随之兴起。

en: Maravve Nayakiti was a princess of the Kampili kingdom, daughter of King Kampilideva and elder sister of Prince Kumara Rama. She married the chieftain Bhavana Sangama and was the mother of Harihara I and Bukka Raya I, who founded the Vijayanagara Empire.
zh: 马拉夫·那雅吉蒂是剑毕离王国的公主，国王坎皮利·提婆·罗耶之女、库马拉·拉马王子的姐姐。她嫁给首领巴瓦纳·桑迦摩，是毗奢耶那伽罗帝国开创者哈里哈拉一世与布卡·拉亚一世的母亲。

en: Singeya Nayaka III ruled the Kampili kingdom until 1300, when he was succeeded by his son Kampilideva.
zh: 辛吉亚·纳亚卡三世统治剑毕离王国至1300年，随后由儿子坎比梨德瓦继位。

en: Vittorino da Feltre (1378–1446), born Vittorino Rambaldoni in Feltre, was an Italian humanist and a celebrated Renaissance teacher. After studying and teaching at Padua, he was summoned by Gianfrancesco I Gonzaga, marquis of Mantua, to educate his children. There he founded a boarding school, La Casa Gioiosa, the House of Joy, where noble sons and daughters and poor pupils taught free of charge studied Greek, Latin, mathematics, music and religion alongside physical exercise. He lived with his students, adapted teaching to their abilities and needs, and added field trips to the curriculum. His methods drew students such as Federigo da Montefeltro and made the school a model copied across Europe. He died in Mantua in 1446.
zh: 费尔特雷的维多里诺（1378—1446），本名维多里诺·兰巴尔多尼，生于费尔特雷，是意大利人文主义者、文艺复兴时期最负盛名的教师之一。他在帕多瓦求学并任教，后应曼托瓦侯爵詹弗朗切斯科一世·贡扎加之聘教导侯爵子女。他在当地创办寄宿学校“欢乐之家”，贵族子女与免收学费的贫家子弟同堂学习希腊文、拉丁文、数学、音乐、宗教及体育。他与学生共同生活，按他们的能力与需要调整教学，并在课程中加入实地游学。他的教学法吸引了费德里科·达·蒙特费尔特罗等学生，使学校成为全欧效仿的典范。1446年他卒于曼托瓦。

en: Aymar I of Poitiers (c. 1115–1163) was the first count of Valentinois from the Poitiers dynasty. Around 1135 he acquired the county through his marriage to Rixende, possibly the sister or natural daughter of Eustache, bishop of Valence, the first prelate to style himself bishop and count of Valentinois. In 1157 the Emperor Frederick Barbarossa granted temporal lordship over thirteen parishes to another bishop of Valence, Odon de Crussol, who then also claimed the comital title. Aymar's son William I succeeded him around 1160.
zh: 普瓦捷的艾马尔一世（约1115—1163）是普瓦捷王朝的首任瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵。约1135年，他通过与里克桑德联姻取得伯国；里克桑德可能是瓦朗斯主教厄斯塔什的姊妹或私生女，而厄斯塔什是首位兼称瓦朗斯主教与瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵的高级教士。1157年，皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨把十三个堂区的世俗管辖权授予瓦朗斯主教奥东·德·克吕索勒，后者遂也自称伯爵。约1160年，其子威廉一世继位。

en: Aymar II de Poitiers (c. 1180–1250) was count of Valentinois, around Valence on the Rhône. Son of William I of Poitiers and Béatrix d'Albon, he succeeded around 1189 and in June that year received the Diois in fief from Raymond V of Toulouse. Around 1195–1196 he took part in an Occitan poetic debate with the troubadours Perdigon and Raimbaut de Vaqueiras. He backed Toulouse in the Albigensian Crusade; in 1217 Simon IV de Montfort's crusaders invaded the Valentinois and besieged Crest, which Aymar defended before making peace. He married Philippa de Fay, who brought wide Vivarais lands. His son William predeceased him, and his grandson Aymaret, the future Aymar III, ran the county from 1239.
zh: 艾马尔二世·德·普瓦捷（约1180—约1250）是瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵，领有罗讷河畔瓦朗斯一带。他是纪尧姆一世·德·普瓦捷与贝亚特丽丝·达尔邦之子，约1189年袭位，同年6月从图卢兹伯爵雷蒙五世手中受封迪瓦。约1195—1196年，他与行吟诗人佩尔迪贡和雷姆博·德·瓦凯拉斯参加了一场奥克语诗歌辩唱。他在阿尔比十字军战争中支持图卢兹；1217年西蒙四世·德·孟福尔率领十字军入侵瓦朗蒂努瓦、围攻克雷，艾马尔据城防守，随后议和。他娶菲利普·德·费为妻，妻子带来维瓦赖的大片封地。其子纪尧姆先他而亡，孙子艾马雷即后来的艾马尔三世，自1239年起执掌伯国。

en: Aymar III de Poitiers, called Aymaret (1226–1277), was count of Valentinois and Diois, the only son of William II of Poitiers and Flotte de Royans and grandson of Aymar II. After his father died in 1226 his guardianship sparked a feud between his mother and Aymar II, settled through the bishop of Valence. He ran the county from around 1239 but took the comital title only in 1250. A land exchange with the lords of Pouzin brought him into conflict with his grandfather in 1239. He repeatedly fought the bishops of Valence over tolls at Crest, joined Louis IX's Eighth Crusade in 1270, and died in 1277 at Rochemaure, succeeded by his son Aymar IV.
zh: 艾马尔三世·德·普瓦捷，别称艾马雷（1226—1277），是瓦朗蒂努瓦与迪瓦伯爵，纪尧姆二世·德·普瓦捷与弗洛特·德·鲁瓦扬的独子，艾马尔二世之孙。1226年父亲去世后，他的监护问题引发母亲与艾马尔二世的冲突，由瓦朗斯主教出面调解。他约自1239年起管理伯国，但直到1250年才使用伯爵头衔。1239年，他与普赞领主交换土地，引发了与祖父的冲突。他因克雷的通行税一再与瓦朗斯主教交战，1270年参加路易九世发动的第八次十字军，1277年卒于罗什莫尔，由其子艾马尔四世继位。

en: Aymar IV of Poitiers (c. 1250–1329), count of Valentinois and Diois, was the son of Aymar III and Sibylle de Beaujeu. A minor at his father's death in 1277, he inherited many Vivarais castles. In July 1280 he did homage to King Philip III for the county of Die beyond the Rhône, and in 1326 acknowledged them as fiefs of King Charles IV. His first wife, Hippolyte of Burgundy, dame of Saint-Vallier, married in 1270, bore his successor Aymar V; his second, Marguerite of Geneva, to whom he was betrothed in 1288, mothered Anne and Catherine. He died in October 1329.
zh: 普瓦捷的艾马尔四世（约1250—1329）是瓦朗蒂努瓦与迪瓦伯爵，艾马尔三世与西比勒·德·博热之子。1277年父亲去世时他尚未成年，继承了维瓦赖的多处城堡。1280年7月，他就罗讷河对岸的迪瓦伯国向法王腓力三世行臣服礼；1326年又承认这些城堡为法王查理四世的封邑。他于1270年娶圣瓦利耶女领主、勃艮第的伊波利特，生下继承人艾马尔五世；1288年与日内瓦的玛格丽特订婚，后来娶她为续妻，生安娜与凯瑟琳。他于1329年10月去世。

en: Aymar VI de Poitiers, called le Gros (1322–1374 or 1376), inherited Valentinois and Diois after his father Louis I fell at Auberoche in 1345. As governor of the Dauphiné from 1349 to 1355 he handled the cession of Faucigny to the Count of Savoy. In 1369 he held Taulignan for four months against Olivier du Guesclin's Bretons. Childless with his wife Alix de Beaufort, he made his cousin Louis II his heir in 1371. In 1372 his brother-in-law Pope Gregory XI named him rector of the Comtat Venaissin. He was buried at Bonlieu abbey.
zh: 艾马尔六世·德·普瓦捷，绰号“胖子”（1322—1374/1376），在父亲路易一世1345年战死欧贝罗什后继承瓦朗蒂努瓦和迪瓦。1349至1355年他任多菲内总督，任内处理将福西尼割让给萨伏依伯爵一事。1369年，他在托利尼昂坚守四个月，抵御奥利维耶·德·盖克兰的布列塔尼人。他与妻子阿利克斯·德·博福尔无嗣，1371年立堂亲路易二世为继承人。1372年，他的姻兄弟教皇格列高利十一世任命他为沃奈桑伯爵领地总督。死后他葬于邦略修道院。

en: Aimar de Poitiers, son of Amé de Poitiers and Jeanne of Savoy, made his will at Crest on 3 November 1355, naming his son or, failing one, Count Aymar VI as heir; that day he gave the count castles including Saint-Vallier, Taulignan and Clérieu.
zh: 艾马尔·德·普瓦捷是阿梅·德·普瓦捷与萨伏依的让娜之子。1355年11月3日他在克雷立遗嘱，指定儿子为继承人，无子则由艾马尔六世伯爵继承；同日他将圣瓦利耶、托利尼昂和克莱里约等城堡赠给伯爵。

en: Aymar VI de Poitiers, called the Fat (1322–1374 or 1376), was count of Valentinois and Diois, son of Louis I of Poitiers. He was lieutenant of the last independent dauphin of Viennois, then governed the Dauphiné for France from 1349 to 1355; the new dauphin, Charles, disliked his handling of the cession of Faucigny to Savoy and had him fined. Seeking some independence between the Empire and the French crown, he won from Emperor Charles IV the honorary title of imperial vicar-general in the kingdom of Arles. In 1369 his town of Taulignan withstood a four-month siege by Olivier du Guesclin's Bretons. He married Alix Roger de Beaufort, niece of Clement VI, and in 1372 her brother Gregory XI made him rector of the Comtat Venaissin, hoping the childless count's lands might pass to the Church. Aymar had so willed them in 1366, but in 1371 he named his cousin Louis II instead. He was buried at Bonlieu Abbey.
zh: 艾马尔六世·德·普瓦捷，绰号“胖子”（1322—1374/1376），是瓦朗蒂努瓦与迪瓦伯爵，路易一世·德·普瓦捷之子。他曾任最后一位独立的维埃纳王太子的代理人，1349至1355年又代表法国治理多菲内；新任王太子查理不满他处置福西尼割让给萨瓦一事，判他缴纳罚金。他想在帝国与法国王室之间保持一点独立，便从皇帝查理四世那里得到阿尔勒王国帝国代理总督的荣誉头衔。1369年，他的托利尼昂城顶住奥利维耶·德·盖克兰麾下布列塔尼人长达四个月的围攻。他娶克雷芒六世的侄女阿莉克斯·罗歇·德·博福尔为妻，1372年其妻之弟额我略十一世任命他为沃奈桑伯爵领地行政长官，期望这位没有子嗣的伯爵的领地日后归于教会。艾马尔1366年的遗嘱确实这样安排，但1371年他改立堂弟路易二世为继承人。他葬于邦略修道院。

en: Amé de Poitiers (died 1349 or 1350), son of Count Aymar IV of Valentinois and Marguerite of Geneva, was seigneur of Saint-Vallier and Clérieu. In 1330 he married Jeanne of Savoy, daughter of Philip I of Piedmont, and left a son Aimar and four daughters.
zh: 阿梅·德·普瓦捷（1349或1350年卒）是瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵艾马尔四世与日内瓦的玛格丽特之子，圣瓦利耶和克莱里约领主，1330年娶皮埃蒙特领主菲利波一世之女萨伏依的让娜，留有一子艾马尔和四个女儿。

en: Aymar V de Poitiers (c. 1271–1339/40), count of Valentinois and Diois, was the eldest son of Aymar IV and Hippolyte of Burgundy. He succeeded in 1329 at about sixty, and a later historian judged him weak and fond of pleasure. He did not carry on the old fight with the bishop of Valence: at the pope's request he made peace at Avignon in April 1332, ending his family's long quarrel with the Church. His last years went on the Clérieu inheritance, which his brother William and Humbert II, dauphin of Viennois, also claimed. Arbitration favored Aymar in December 1336, but the dauphin would not accept it, and after a suit that reached the pope, Aymar did liege homage to him at Chabeuil in April 1338. He married Marie de Viennois and then Sibylle des Baux. His will of August 1339 named his son Louis heir; he died soon after at Baix, in 1339 or 1340, and was buried at Crest.
zh: 艾马尔五世·德·普瓦捷（约1271—1339/1340）是瓦朗蒂努瓦与迪瓦伯爵，艾马尔四世与勃艮第的伊波利特的长子。1329年继位时他已年近六十，后世一位史家说他性格软弱、耽于享乐。他没有延续同瓦朗斯主教的旧争，而是应教宗之请，于1332年4月在阿维尼翁议和，结束了家族与教会的长期纷争。晚年的大事是克莱里约的继承权，他的弟弟纪尧姆和维埃纳王太子安贝尔二世也主张权利。1336年12月的仲裁对艾马尔有利，但王太子拒不接受；官司打到教宗面前，1338年4月艾马尔在沙伯伊向王太子行了效忠臣服礼。他先后娶维埃纳的玛丽与西比勒·德·博。1339年8月的遗嘱立其子路易为继承人，不久后于1339年底或1340年初在拜克斯去世，葬于克雷斯特。

en: Charles de Poitiers (1330/1331–after 18 March 1410), eighth son of Count Aymar V of Valentinois and Sibylle des Baux, was seigneur of Clérieux and Saint-Vallier. In July 1358 his nephew Count Aymar VI enfeoffed him with Saint-Vallier and Mirabel in return for liege homage. When his brother Henri, bishop of Troyes, died in 1370, Charles claimed his inheritance rights and styled himself the natural heir to Valentinois, long disputing the county with his nephew Louis II. By his wife Simone de Méry he founded the Saint-Vallier line from which Diane de Poitiers later descended; his son Louis succeeded him in 1410.
zh: 夏尔·德·普瓦捷（1330/1331—1410年3月18日后）是瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵艾马尔五世与西比耶·德·博的第八子，克莱里约和圣瓦利耶领主。1358年7月，其侄伯爵艾马尔六世以效忠臣服为条件，将圣瓦利耶和米拉贝尔封赐给他。1370年其兄特鲁瓦主教亨利去世，夏尔继承其权利，自称瓦朗蒂努瓦的天然继承人，与侄儿路易二世长期争夺伯国。他与妻子西蒙娜·德·梅里开创圣瓦利耶支系，迪安娜·德·普瓦捷即出自该支；1410年其子路易继其位。

en: Henry of Poitiers was the fighting bishop of the Poitiers-Valentinois house, son of Count Aymar V of Valentinois and Sibylle des Baux. Appointed bishop of Gap in 1349, he was driven out in 1350: a Poitiers bastard, Hault-de-Cœur, had murdered Ismidon de Montauban, a kinsman of the previous bishop Dragonnet, and the angry townspeople sacked his palace. A settlement let him return, until Clement VI transferred him to Troyes in 1353. There he proved a brave warrior. Robert Knolles had burned the castle of Aix-en-Othe and was about to seize Troyes when Henry routed him. In 1358–1359 he defeated and captured Eustace d'Aubrecicourt on the plain of Nogent-sur-Seine, where the captain had been plundering a country Froissart called his ‘chamber’. Henry died at Troyes on 25 August 1370.
zh: 普瓦捷的亨利是普瓦捷-瓦朗蒂努瓦家族的善战主教，瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵艾马尔五世与西比勒·德·博之子。1349年他被任命为加普主教，1350年被逐出该城：普瓦捷家族的私生子奥尔德克尔杀死了前任主教德拉戈内的亲属伊斯米东·德·蒙托邦，愤怒的市民洗劫了他的宫邸。双方达成协议后他得以返回，直到1353年被克雷芒六世调往特鲁瓦。在特鲁瓦，他以勇武著称：罗伯特·诺尔烧毁艾克斯昂奥特城堡、正要夺取特鲁瓦时，被他击溃；1358—1359年，他在塞纳河畔诺让的平原上击败并俘虏了厄斯塔什·多布雷西古，这名队长一直在当地劫掠，傅华萨称那片地方是他的“房间”。1370年8月25日，亨利卒于特鲁瓦。

en: Eustache was count of Valence and may have been related to the house of Poitiers-Valentinois. A charter of March 1138 records his brother Guillaume, provost of Valence, relinquishing rights in favour of the Templars of Richerenches with Count Eustache's consent.
zh: 厄斯塔什是瓦朗斯伯爵，可能与普瓦捷-瓦朗蒂努瓦家族有亲。1138年3月的一份特许状记载，他的兄弟、瓦朗斯教务长纪尧姆在伯爵厄斯塔什同意下，向里什朗什的圣殿骑士团放弃了权利。

en: William I of Poitiers (Guillaume de Poitiers) was the son of Count Aymar I. Around 1155 he married Beatrice, daughter of Guigues IV, count of Albon, allying his house with the Dauphins of Vienne. He is first attested as count of Valentinois in 1158. In 1163 he did homage to the bishop of Die for Suze and Gigors in the Diois, renewing it in 1165. At Arles on 30 June 1178 he attended the coronation of Frederick Barbarossa, winning imperial privileges including the Rhône toll between Valence and Montélimar. He died after 4 May 1187 and was succeeded by his son Aymar II.
zh: 纪尧姆·德·普瓦捷是艾马尔一世伯爵之子。约1155年，他娶阿尔邦伯爵吉格四世之女贝阿特丽切，与维埃纳的太子家族结盟。1158年，他首次以瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵身份见于记载。1163年，他为迪瓦境内的叙兹和日戈尔城堡向迪城主教行臣服礼，1165年再次确认封臣关系。1178年6月30日，他在阿尔勒出席腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的加冕礼，获得帝国特权，包括在瓦朗斯与蒙泰利马尔之间的罗讷河设卡征税之权。他于1187年5月4日之后去世，其子艾马尔二世继位。

en: William II of Poitiers (31 January 1202 – c. 1227) was the only son and heir of Aymar II, count of Valentinois, and Philippe de Fay. In 1217 his father made peace with Simon de Montfort during the Albigensian Crusade and promised William to Simon's daughter Amicie, but the marriage never took place. Around 1224 he married Flotte de Royans, heiress of Saint-Nazaire-en-Royans, who bore him a son, the future Aymar III. In March 1225 he endowed the abbey of Léoncel, styled count of Valentinois. He died before his father, leaving a disputed guardianship over his infant heir.
zh: 普瓦捷的威廉二世（1202年1月31日—约1227年）是瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵艾马尔二世与菲利帕·德·费的独子和继承人。1217年，其父在阿尔比十字军期间与西蒙·德·孟福尔议和，许诺让威廉迎娶西蒙之女阿米西，但婚事终未达成。约1224年，他娶圣纳泽尔-昂鲁瓦扬的女继承人弗洛特·德·鲁瓦扬，生子即后来的艾马尔三世。1225年3月，他以瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵的名义向莱翁塞尔修道院捐赠。他先于父亲去世，年幼继承人的监护权引发家族争端。

en: William of Poitiers was a noble of obscure origins and father of Aymar I, the first count of Valentinois from the Poitiers dynasty. Around 1135 his son acquired the county through marriage, and the later Poitiers counts of Valentinois descended from William.
zh: 普瓦捷的威廉出身不详，是普瓦捷家族首任瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵艾马尔一世之父。约1135年，其子因联姻获得瓦朗蒂努瓦伯国，此后的瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵皆为威廉的后裔。

en: William of Poitiers (1309–1374) was destined for the Church, one of three sons of Count Aymar V of Valentinois and Sibylle des Baux who became bishops; his brothers Otto and Henry held Verdun and Troyes. A Cluniac monk, he became prior of La Charité-sur-Loire in 1339 and was elected bishop of Langres, a duke-bishopric, in 1345. He took part in the wars, serving in King John II's army in 1353. In 1354 the captains Jean and Thibaud de Chauffour appeared before Langres in arms to seize and plunder it, and the bishop was accused of conspiring with them to hand the city to the English; he obtained absolution. While still a monk he had fathered several children by different women, and as bishop he legitimized four of them. He died on 6 September 1374.
zh: 普瓦捷的纪尧姆（1309—1374）自幼被安排走教会的道路，是瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵艾马尔五世与西比勒·德·博三个出任主教的儿子之一，他的兄弟奥托和亨利分别任凡尔登和特鲁瓦的主教。他本是克吕尼派修士，1339年任卢瓦尔河畔拉沙里泰修道院长，1345年当选朗格勒公爵兼主教。他参与战事，1353年随法王约翰二世的军队作战。1354年，佣兵队长让·德·肖福尔和蒂博·德·肖福尔带兵兵临朗格勒，意图夺城劫掠，主教被控与二人勾结、企图把城献给英格兰人，后来获得赦免。他当修士期间与多名女子生有子女，成为主教后把其中四人合法化。1374年9月6日去世。

en: Hippolyte of Burgundy (c.1254–1283), also called Polie, was lady of Saint-Vallier and the daughter of Hugh of Chalon, Count of Burgundy, and Adelaide I. In 1270 she married Aymar IV de Poitiers, Count of Valentinois and Diois, linking the counts palatine of Burgundy with the Valentinois house. Her sons included Aymar V, who succeeded as count in 1329, Guillaume, lord of Saint-Vallier, and Louis, bishop of Metz. She made her will on 28 September 1283 and died soon after; Aymar became engaged to his second wife in 1288, after her death.
zh: 勃艮第的伊波莉特（约1254—1283），又名波莉，是圣瓦利耶女领主、勃艮第伯爵沙隆的于格与阿德莱德一世之女。1270年，她嫁给瓦朗蒂努瓦兼迪瓦伯爵艾马尔四世·德·普瓦捷，使勃艮第行宫伯爵家族与瓦朗蒂努瓦诸侯联姻。她的儿子中，艾马尔五世于1329年继位为伯爵，纪尧姆成为圣瓦利耶领主，路易则出任梅斯主教。1283年9月28日她立下遗嘱，不久后便去世；她去世后，艾马尔于1288年与第二任妻子订婚。

en: Jeanne of Savoy-Achaia, daughter of Philip I of Piedmont, married Amé de Poitiers, son of Count Aymar IV of Valentinois, on 22 May 1330. Her daughter Marguerite became dame de Taulignan, and she was living in November 1355.
zh: 萨伏依-亚该亚的让娜是皮埃蒙特领主菲利波一世之女。1330年5月22日，她嫁给瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵艾马尔四世之子阿梅·德·普瓦捷，生女为托利尼昂女领主玛格丽特，1355年11月仍在世。

en: Louis I de Poitiers (died 21 October 1345), son of Count Aymar V of Valentinois and Sibylle des Baux, succeeded his father as count of Valentinois in 1339. In the 1345 Gascon campaign he led some seven thousand French troops and besieged the English garrison of Auberoche, east of Périgueux. On 21 October Henry of Grosmont, Earl of Derby, surprised his camp at supper in an evening assault and routed the French army; Louis died of his wounds. By his wife Marguerite de Vergy he left a son, Aymar VI, and a daughter, Marguerite.
zh: 路易一世·德·普瓦捷（1345年10月21日去世）是瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵艾马尔五世与西比耶·德·博之子，1339年继父位为瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵。1345年加斯科涅战役中，他率约七千法军围攻佩里格以东、由英军驻守的欧贝罗什城堡。10月21日，德比伯爵格罗斯蒙特的亨利趁法军用晚饭时夜袭营地，法军全线崩溃，路易伤重而死。他与妻子玛格丽特·德·韦尔吉留有一子艾马尔六世和一女玛格丽特。

en: Marguerite de Poitiers was the daughter of Count Louis I of Valentinois and Marguerite de Vergy. She married Guichard de Beaujeu, seigneur of Perreux, was widowed by February 1356, and was still living in June 1380. Her son Édouard II later ruled Beaujeu.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·普瓦捷是瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵路易一世与玛格丽特·德·韦尔吉之女，嫁给佩勒领主吉沙尔·德·博热，1356年2月已守寡，1380年6月仍在世，其子爱德华二世后来统治博热。

en: Marguerite de Poitiers, dame de Taulignan, was daughter of Amé de Poitiers, lord of Saint-Vallier and Clérieu, and Jeanne of Savoy-Achaia. She married Geoffroi de Bressieu, had a daughter Jeanne, made her will on 11 July 1380, and died after.
zh: 托利尼昂女领主玛格丽特·德·普瓦捷是圣瓦利耶与克莱里约领主阿梅·德·普瓦捷与萨伏依-亚该亚的让娜之女，嫁若弗鲁瓦·德·布勒西厄，生女让娜，1380年7月11日立遗嘱后去世。

en: Marguerite de Vergy, dame de Vadans, was the wife of Louis I de Poitiers, Count of Valentinois, and mother of his successor Aymar VI and of Marguerite, who married Guichard VIII de Beaujeu. She was still living in July 1357.
zh: 瓦当女领主玛格丽特·德·韦尔吉是瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵路易一世·德·普瓦捷之妻，生有继位的艾马尔六世和嫁给吉沙尔八世·德·博热的玛格丽特，1357年7月仍在世。

en: Otto of Poitiers was a son of Count Aymar V of Valentinois and Sibylle des Baux, whose father meant him for the Church. The will of 1339 left him Montmeyran Castle only until he held benefices worth 500 livres a year, and in 1342 he ceded his rights to his brother Louis, their father's successor. After serving as abbot of Saint-Pierre de Châlons, he was elected bishop of Verdun in 1350 and held the see only about fifteen months. In 1351 contagious disease killed a great many people in Verdun and left him disgusted with the bishopric. He resigned it to Hugues de Bar for a pension of 1300 florins and returned to the papal court at Avignon. He died around 1352.
zh: 普瓦捷的奥托是瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵艾马尔五世与西比勒·德·博之子，父亲有意让他走教会的道路。1339年的遗嘱把蒙梅朗城堡留给他，条件是等他领到年收入500里弗尔的圣职后就要归还；1342年他把权利让给兄长路易，也就是父亲的继承人。他曾任沙隆圣伯多禄修道院院长，1350年当选凡尔登主教，在任仅约十五个月。1351年传染病在凡尔登夺去许多人的生命，他因此厌倦了这个主教职位，以1300弗罗林年金为条件把职位让给于格·德·巴尔，回到阿维尼翁教廷，约1352年去世。

en: Sibylle des Baux (died 1360) was the daughter of Bertrand des Baux, first Angevin count of Avellino, and married Aymar V de Poitiers, count of Valentinois and Diois, as his second wife; the two were first cousins. Her husband dowered her with the Vivarais castles of Chalancon, Gluiras and Durfort, and Upie in the Valentinois, though Upie was taken back in his will of 1339. She bore his heir Louis I, the bishops Guillaume of Langres, Henri of Troyes and Otton of Verdun, and other children. Widowed in 1339 or 1340, she died in 1360.
zh: 西比勒·德·博（？—1360）是首任安茹系阿韦利诺伯爵贝特朗·德·博之女，后嫁给表兄、瓦朗蒂努瓦与迪瓦伯爵艾马尔五世·德·普瓦捷为续弦。丈夫把维瓦赖的沙朗松、格吕伊拉、迪尔福三座城堡以及瓦朗蒂努瓦的于皮作为嫁资授予她，又在1339年的遗嘱中收回于皮。她生下继承人路易一世，以及朗格勒主教纪尧姆、特鲁瓦主教亨利、凡尔登主教奥托等子女。她于1339年底或1340年初丧偶，1360年去世。

en: Andrey II Yaroslavich (c. 1222–1264) was a son of Yaroslav II Vsevolodovich of Vladimir. In 1242 he fought beside his brother Alexander Nevsky at the Battle on the Ice. In 1249 he became grand prince of Vladimir under a Mongol jarlig, and in 1250–1251 married Ustynia, daughter of Daniel of Galicia. Refusing to renew his investiture at Sarai, he challenged the Golden Horde, was routed near Pereslavl by Sartak's general Nevryuy in 1252, and fled to Sweden. Pardoned in 1255, he held Suzdal, Nizhny Novgorod and Gorodets until his death; the Shuysky princely house descended from him.
zh: 安德烈二世·雅罗斯拉维奇（约1222—1264）是弗拉基米尔大公雅罗斯拉夫二世·弗谢沃洛多维奇之子。1242年，他与兄长亚历山大·涅夫斯基并肩参加了楚德湖冰上激战。1249年，他凭蒙古人的敕书成为弗拉基米尔大公；1250至1251年娶加利奇王公丹尼尔之女乌斯季妮娅。他拒绝前往萨莱重申臣属、对抗金帐汗国，1252年在佩列亚斯拉夫尔附近被撒里答麾下将领涅夫留击败，逃亡瑞典。1255年获赦后，他领有苏兹达尔、下诺夫哥罗德和戈罗杰茨直至去世，俄罗斯的叔伊斯基王公家族即其后裔。

en: John Tristan (8 April 1250 – 3 August 1270) was a Capetian prince, the fourth son of King Louis IX of France and Marguerite of Provence. He was born at Damietta during the Seventh Crusade, and his mother named him Tristan amid the crisis of Louis's capture by the Egyptians. Betrothed in 1258, he married Yolande of Burgundy, countess of Nevers, in 1266, ruling Nevers, Auxerre and Tonnerre in her right, and in 1268 received the county of Valois as his appanage. He died of dysentery at Tunis on the Eighth Crusade in August 1270, childless; Valois reverted to the crown.
zh: 让·特里斯坦（1250年4月8日—1270年8月3日）是卡佩王朝的法兰西王子，法王路易九世与普罗旺斯的玛格丽特的第四子。他生于第七次十字军期间的达米埃塔；在父亲被埃及人俘虏的危局中，母亲为他取名特里斯坦。他1258年订婚，1266年与讷韦尔女伯爵勃艮第的约朗德成婚，以妻权统治讷韦尔、欧塞尔和托内尔，1268年受封瓦卢瓦伯国为封邑。第八次十字军时他随父出征，1270年8月在突尼斯患痢疾去世，没有子嗣，瓦卢瓦伯国收归王室。

en: Belforte Belforti was a nobleman of the Guelph Belforti family of Volterra. He was the father of Ranieri Belforti, bishop of Volterra from 1301, and of Ottaviano Belforti, who in 1340 made himself lord of the city.
zh: 贝尔福特·贝尔福蒂是沃尔泰拉归尔夫派贵族贝尔福蒂家族的成员。其子拉涅里·贝尔福蒂于1301年出任沃尔泰拉主教，另一子奥塔维亚诺·贝尔福蒂于1340年成为沃尔泰拉的僭主。

en: Belforte Belforti was a son of Ottaviano Belforti of Volterra and was excommunicated with his father after Ottaviano seized power in 1340.
zh: 贝尔福特·贝尔福蒂是沃尔泰拉的奥塔维亚诺·贝尔福蒂之子；1340年奥塔维亚诺夺取政权后，贝尔福特与父亲一同遭到绝罚。

en: Benedetto Belforti, son of Ottaviano Belforti, was pleban of Castelfalfi near Volterra. After his uncle Bishop Ranieri died in 1320 he sought the see, but refusing to surrender Berignone castle to the elected bishop Rainuccio Allegretti, he was defeated and exiled in 1321.
zh: 贝内德托·贝尔福蒂是奥塔维亚诺·贝尔福蒂之子，任卡斯泰尔法尔菲的本堂神父。1320年叔父、主教拉涅里去世后他谋求继任，因拒绝把贝里尼奥内城堡交给当选主教拉伊努乔·阿莱格雷蒂，于1321年战败流亡。

en: Bernardo Belforti was a Guelph nobleman of Volterra, a son of Belforte di Ranieri and brother of Bishop Ranieri and of the signore Ottaviano Belforti. After Ottaviano died in the Black Death summer of 1348, the priors in office and three Belforti designated by Ottaviano were entrusted on 4 August with urgent measures to address the deaths of many officials: Bernardo, Ottaviano's son Roberto, and their cousin Franco di Dino. The arrangement gave way in practice to the ascendancy of Ottaviano's sons, including Bernardo's nephew Bocchino.
zh: 贝尔纳多·贝尔福蒂是沃尔泰拉的圭尔夫派贵族，贝尔福泰·迪·拉涅里之子，主教拉涅里与领主奥塔维亚诺的兄弟。1348年黑死病肆虐之夏，奥塔维亚诺病死；8月4日，在任行政官与由奥塔维亚诺指定的三名贝尔福蒂受托处理大量官员死亡后的紧急事务，三人分别是贝尔纳多、奥塔维亚诺之子罗贝托及他们的堂兄弟佛朗哥·迪迪诺。实际上，奥塔维亚诺的儿子们后来占据了主导地位，其中包括贝尔纳多的侄子博基诺。

en: Bocchino Belforti (Paolo Belforti, called Bocchino), eldest son of Ottaviano, became co-lord of Volterra in 1348 and soon ruled alone, since his brother Roberto lacked the ability to govern. He had joined his father at the 1340 siege of Berignone and was excommunicated with him. Chronicler Matteo Villani called his harsh rule tyranny. Volterra lay between Guelph Florence and Ghibelline Pisa, and Bocchino balanced the two: he married Bandecca de' Rossi of a leading Florentine family, allied with Pisa's anti-Florentine faction, and in May 1349, after Volterra sheltered that faction's exiled leaders, repulsed a surprise Pisan night assault. In 1361 a feud with the sons of his cousin Francesco over Monteveltraio fortress brought Florentine soldiers against him. Judging Florence the stronger, he secretly agreed to sell the signory to Pisa for thirty-two thousand gold florins. The citizens learned of it, rose and seized him on 5 September, and he was beheaded in the Piazza dei Priori on 10 October 1361.
zh: 博基诺·贝尔福蒂本名保罗·贝尔福蒂，是奥塔维亚诺的长子，1348年成为沃尔泰拉的共同领主，兄弟罗贝托无力治理，他很快独掌大权。1340年他曾随父亲围攻贝里尼奥内，并与父亲一同遭到绝罚。编年史家马泰奥·维拉尼称其苛政为暴政。沃尔泰拉夹在圭尔夫派的佛罗伦萨与吉伯林派的比萨之间，博基诺在两者间周旋：他娶了佛罗伦萨名门之女班代卡·德·罗西，与比萨的反佛罗伦萨派结盟；沃尔泰拉庇护了该派被逐的首领后，他于1349年5月击退比萨人的夜间突袭。1361年，他因蒙特韦尔特拉约要塞与堂兄弟弗朗切斯科的儿子们争斗，招来佛罗伦萨士兵；他自忖不敌，暗中同意以三万二千金弗罗林把领主权卖给比萨。市民得知后起兵，于9月5日将他抓获，1361年10月10日他在执政官广场被斩首。

en: Filippo Belforti (1319–1358), son of Ottaviano Belforti, became bishop of Volterra in 1348, the year his brothers were confirmed as the city's lords, and held the see until his death. The bishops' old imperial powers over the city had become theoretical, and the diocese was poor. After consecration at Avignon he returned in 1350 to nearly exhausted Montieri silver mines and a shortage of priests, and taxed his clergy to cope. In 1352 he sold the disputed castle of Montecastelli to the commune for sixteen thousand livres. In 1355 he attended Emperor Charles IV's coronation in Rome and won confirmation of the see's jurisdiction and privileges, and he protested when Volterra's envoys swore allegiance to the emperor, a right he claimed for the bishop. Even so, no real temporal power returned. He held a diocesan synod in 1356, issued synodal constitutions, completed the city hospital, and died at Volterra on 20 August 1358.
zh: 菲利波·贝尔福蒂（1319—1358）是奥塔维亚诺·贝尔福蒂之子，1348年，也就是他的兄弟们获确认为城市领主的那一年，出任沃尔泰拉主教，直到去世。主教们早年得自皇帝的统治权力此时只剩名义，教区也很穷。他在阿维尼翁晋牧，1350年返回时，蒙蒂耶里银矿几近枯竭，神父短缺，他只得向神职人员征收特别税。1352年他把争议中的蒙特卡斯泰利城堡以一万六千里弗尔卖给公社。1355年他赴罗马参加皇帝查理四世的加冕礼，使教区的管辖权与特权获得确认；沃尔泰拉使者向皇帝宣誓效忠时，他提出抗议，主张这项权利属于主教。即便如此，主教并未重获实际的世俗权力。1356年他召开教区会议、颁布教区会宪，又建成了城市医院，1358年8月20日在沃尔泰拉去世。

en: Musciattino Belforti, also recorded as Musciatto, was a Volterran noble, son of Belforte Belforti and brother of the signore Ottaviano. In February 1346 his brother dubbed him a knight together with the other men of the Belforti house.
zh: 穆夏蒂诺·贝尔福蒂（一作穆萨托）是沃尔泰拉贵族，贝尔福泰·贝尔福蒂之子，领主奥塔维亚诺的兄弟。1346年2月，奥塔维亚诺将他和贝尔福蒂家族的其他男丁一同封为骑士。

en: Ottaviano Belforti (c. 1275–1348), son of Belforte Belforti, was a nobleman of Volterra, a commune long split between his family and the Allegretti faction. In 1315 he served as ambassador to Florence. He backed his brother Bishop Ranieri against the Allegretti, and when Rainuccio Allegretti became bishop, the Belforti lost the fight and fled the city. After years in exile he was podestà of Bologna in 1337–1338. Returning in 1340, he won a civil war against Rainuccio and besieged him in the castle of Berignone. The castle fell, and Ottaviano and his family were excommunicated. He ruled Volterra as capitano generale until the city gave itself to Walter of Brienne in 1342. When Walter fled Florence, Ottaviano regained power in August 1343 and reshaped the government so that a Belforti sat on its supreme council by right. In 1348 he secured the bishopric for his son Filippo and the signory for his sons Bocchino and Roberto, dying that July.
zh: 奥塔维亚诺·贝尔福蒂（约1275—1348）是沃尔泰拉贵族，贝尔福泰·贝尔福蒂之子；这座公社长期分裂为他的家族与阿莱格雷蒂派两方。1315年他出使佛罗伦萨。他支持担任主教的兄弟拉涅里对抗阿莱格雷蒂派，拉伊努乔·阿莱格雷蒂出任主教后，贝尔福蒂家族败北，逃出城去。流亡多年后，他于1337至1338年任博洛尼亚的波德斯塔。1340年他返回沃尔泰拉，在内战中击败拉伊努乔，并将他围困在贝里尼奥内城堡。城堡陷落后，奥塔维亚诺及其家族遭到绝罚。他以军事统帅身份统治沃尔泰拉，1342年城市归顺布里耶纳的戈蒂埃。戈蒂埃逃离佛罗伦萨后，奥塔维亚诺于1343年8月重新掌权，并改组政府，使贝尔福蒂家族在最高议事机构中拥有当然席位。1348年他使儿子菲利波出任主教，使其子博基诺与罗贝托获得领主地位，同年7月去世。

en: Piero Belforti, also called Pietro, was a son of Ottaviano Belforti of Volterra and was excommunicated with his father after Ottaviano seized power in 1340.
zh: 皮耶罗·贝尔福蒂又名彼得罗，是沃尔泰拉的奥塔维亚诺·贝尔福蒂之子；1340年奥塔维亚诺夺取政权后，皮耶罗与父亲一同遭到绝罚。

en: Rainuccio degli Allegretti (died 1348), of one of Volterra's leading families, was bishop of Volterra from 1321. Once parish priest at Morba and, from 1315, vicar-general to Bishop Ranieri Belforti, he was elected by the cathedral chapter in December 1320 and confirmed by John XXII in February 1321. He set out at once to win back church lands that private holders had usurped. The commune answered by exiling his father and condemning other relatives. In 1322 he withdrew to Casole d'Elsa, where he opened a mint and excommunicated the Volterrans who had sent troops against the castle of Berignone. He was back in the city by late 1323 and held a pastoral visitation of his diocese in 1325–1328, among the earliest in Tuscany. In 1340 Ottaviano Belforti, who had already clashed with him, took power in Volterra and expelled him and his family. He spent his last years moving between the castles he still controlled, and died in 1348.
zh: 拉伊努乔·德利·阿莱格雷蒂（卒于1348年）出身沃尔泰拉名门，1321年起任沃尔泰拉主教。他曾任莫尔巴的本堂神父，1315年起担任主教拉涅里·贝尔福蒂的副主教，1320年12月由座堂会议选为继任者，1321年2月获约翰二十二世批准。上任之初，他就着手收回被私人侵占的教会地产。沃尔泰拉公社的回应是流放他的父亲，并对其他亲属定罪。1322年他避居卡索莱代尔萨，在那里开设造币厂，并对派兵围攻贝里尼奥内城堡的沃尔泰拉人处以绝罚。1323年底前他回到城中，于1325—1328年巡视教区，是托斯卡纳最早的牧区视察之一。1340年，早与他不和的奥塔维亚诺·贝尔福蒂掌握了沃尔泰拉的权力，将他及其家人驱逐。此后他辗转于自己仍控制的城堡之间，1348年去世。

en: Ranieri Belforti (c. 1278–1320) was bishop of Volterra from a Guelph noble family, son of Belforte and brother of Ottaviano, the city's future lord. A cathedral canon, he was made bishop by Pope Boniface VIII on 22 December 1301 and consecrated the following January. He worked to rebuild the diocese's estates, bargained with the commune and Florence, and in 1305 became counselor to Robert of Anjou to settle diocesan debts. A vicar administered the diocese for three years during his service to Robert. Opposing Emperor Henry VII of Luxembourg, he lost his imperial fiefs. In 1319 factional strife drove the Belforti into exile, and he died in Florence on 26 November 1320.
zh: 拉涅里·贝尔福蒂（约1278—1320）出身圭尔夫派贵族家庭，曾任沃尔泰拉主教，是贝尔福泰之子、沃尔泰拉未来统治者奥塔维亚诺之兄。他本是大教堂法政牧师，1301年12月22日被教皇卜尼法斯八世任命为主教，次年1月接受祝圣。他致力于重建教区产业，与公社和佛罗伦萨方面谈判，1305年为解决教区债务出任罗贝尔·德·安茹的顾问。任职期间，他让一名代理人管理教区三年。他与皇帝亨利七世对立，被剥夺全部帝国封地。1319年党争把贝尔福蒂家族放逐，1320年11月26日他卒于佛罗伦萨的主教宫邸。

en: Roberto Belforti was a son of Ottaviano Belforti, the first signore of Volterra. Knighted with his kinsmen in February 1346 and a former podestà of Perugia (1345), he married Gemma, daughter of messer Gaddo Cavalcanti of Libbiano. On 4 August 1348, amid the plague, Roberto, Bernardo and Franco Belforti, designated by Ottaviano, were entrusted alongside the priors with urgent measures following the deaths of many officials. Roberto and his brothers Bocchino and Filippo came to exercise power in Volterra. After a long pilgrimage to the Holy Land, in 1355 he led Volterra's homage to Emperor Charles IV at Pisa.
zh: 罗贝托·贝尔福蒂是沃尔泰拉首任领主奥塔维亚诺·贝尔福蒂之子。他1345年任佩鲁贾的波德斯塔，1346年2月与族人一同受封骑士，又娶利比亚诺的加多·卡尔瓦坎蒂之女杰玛为妻。1348年8月4日，瘟疫肆虐期间，由奥塔维亚诺指定的罗贝托、贝尔纳多和佛朗哥·贝尔福蒂与在任行政官一起受托处理大量官员死亡后的紧急事务。罗贝托与兄弟博基诺和菲利波后来在沃尔泰拉掌握了实权。赴圣地长途朝圣归来后，他于1355年率领沃尔泰拉使团在比萨向皇帝查理四世臣服。

en: Bernard de Ventadour (c. 1293–c. 1384) succeeded his father Eble VIII as viscount of Ventadour in 1329 and became count in 1350. From 1339 he served in Philip VI's wars under the Duke of Normandy and the Count of Armagnac, and in 1346 obtained the châtellenies of Croc and Saint-Agnan for a small payment. That year the countess Joan of Dreux died aged nine months, and he seized Montpensier and Aigueperse; the king recognised him as heir for ten thousand florins. From 1355, under John II, he sat on the royal council at a yearly salary of two thousand livres. In 1382, with the consent of his son Robert, he sold Montpensier to the king's son John, Duke of Berry. It came in 1416 to Marie of Berry, wife of John I de Bourbon.
zh: 贝尔纳·德·旺塔杜尔（约1293—约1384）1329年继承父亲埃布勒八世，任旺塔杜尔子爵，1350年升为伯爵。1339年起，他在诺曼底公爵和阿马尼亚克伯爵麾下参加腓力六世的战争，1346年以少量代价取得克罗克和圣阿尼昂城堡区。同年，年仅九个月的德勒女伯爵让娜夭折，他夺取蒙庞西耶和艾格佩尔斯，并向国王支付一万弗罗林，换得国王承认他为继承人。1355年起他在约翰二世治下入御前会议，年俸两千里弗尔。1382年，他经儿子罗贝尔同意，把蒙庞西耶卖给国王之子贝里公爵约翰；1416年，这块领地传给了贝里的玛丽，她是约翰一世·德·波旁之妻。

en: Ebles I of Ventadour (c. 1034–1096) was a younger son of Archambaud II, viscount of Comborn, and Rothberge of Rochechouart. Around 1059–1060 the partition of the Comborn inheritance gave him the eastern lands that became the viscounty of Ventadour, and he was the first of his line to settle there, building the castle of Ventadour and founding the priories of Moustier-Ventadour, Meymac and Bonnesaigne. By his wife Almodie of Montberon he was the father of Ebles II, called the Singer, a troubadour and patron of Bernart de Ventadorn. Ebles I died in 1096.
zh: 旺塔杜尔的埃布勒一世（约1034—1096）是孔博恩子爵阿尚博二世与罗什舒瓦尔的罗特贝尔格较年幼的儿子。约1059至1060年，孔博恩领地析分，他获得东部土地，即后来的旺塔杜尔子国，并成为家族中首位定居于此的人；他修建旺塔杜尔城堡，还创办了穆捷-旺塔杜尔、梅马克和博讷赛涅几座小修道院。他与蒙贝龙的阿尔莫迪所生之子埃布勒二世号称‘歌者’，是行吟诗人，也是贝尔纳·德·旺塔杜尔的庇护人。埃布勒一世于1096年去世。

en: Eble II of Ventadorn (after 1086–1155) was viscount of Ventadour in the Limousin, son of Eble I and Almodis de Montberon. The contemporary chronicler Geoffrey of Vigeois praised him as Ebolus cantator, a singer who gave great pleasure with his songs, and although none of his verses survive he is often called the first Provençal troubadour, an influence on William IX of Aquitaine and Bernart de Ventadorn. By his wife Alix, daughter of Guillaume de Montluçon, he fathered Eble III and Guillaume, lord of Ussel. He died at Montecassino in 1155.
zh: 埃布勒二世·德·旺塔杜尔（1086年后—1155）是利穆赞的旺塔杜尔子爵，埃布勒一世与阿尔莫迪斯·德·蒙贝龙之子。同时代编年史家维茹瓦的若弗鲁瓦称他为“歌者埃布卢斯”，说他的歌声给人带来极大愉悦；他的诗作无一传世，却常被视为最早的普罗旺斯特罗巴杜尔，影响过阿基坦的威廉九世与贝尔纳·德·旺塔杜尔。他娶蒙吕松的纪尧姆之女阿莉克斯，生子埃布勒三世和于塞尔领主纪尧姆，1155年在蒙特卡西诺去世。

en: Eble III of Ventadorn (died 1170) was viscount of Ventadour in the Limousin, son of Eble II, the singer, and Agnes de Montluçon. He is remembered as the patron and protector of the troubadour Bernart de Ventadorn. In 1148 he married Marguerite de Turenne, daughter of Viscount Raymond of Turenne, by whom he had a daughter, Matabrune; the marriage ended before 1150. He then married Alais, daughter of William VI of Montpellier, who bore him his heir Eble IV. He died in 1170.
zh: 埃布勒三世·德·旺塔杜尔（？—1170）是利穆赞的旺塔杜尔子爵，“歌者”埃布勒二世与阿涅丝·德·蒙吕松之子。他以庇护特罗巴杜尔贝尔纳·德·旺塔杜尔而闻名。1148年他娶蒂雷纳子爵雷蒙之女玛格丽特·德·蒂雷纳，生女玛塔布吕娜，这段婚姻于1150年前结束；此后他娶蒙彼利埃的威廉六世之女阿莱斯，生下继承人埃布勒四世，1170年去世。

en: Eble IV, also called Archambaud I, was viscount of Ventadour in the Limousin. He was the son of Eble III of Ventadour and Adelaide, daughter of William VI of Montpellier. Eble married Sybille de la Faye, daughter of Raoul de Châtellerault, grand seneschal of Aquitaine and a confidant of Eleanor of Aquitaine. The marriage produced eight children, and their son Eble V succeeded him as viscount. Eble IV died after 1214.
zh: 埃布洛四世（又称阿尔尚博一世）是利穆赞的旺塔杜尔子爵，旺塔杜尔的埃布洛三世与蒙彼利埃的纪尧姆六世之女阿代拉伊德之子。他娶阿基坦大总管、阿基坦的埃莉诺亲信拉乌尔·德·沙泰勒罗之女西比勒·德·拉费为妻，二人育有八名子女，其子埃布洛五世后来继任子爵。埃布洛四世于1214年之后去世。

en: Eble V was viscount of Ventadour, the son of Eble IV and Sybille de la Faye, and great-grandson of Eble the Singer, a precursor of the troubadours. His first wife was Marie de Limoges, daughter of Adhémar Boson, viscount of Limoges; their daughter Alixène married Guillaume de Mercœur. In 1186 he married Marguerite de Turenne, celebrated as the trobairitz Maria de Ventadorn, patron of troubadours. Their son Eble VI inherited the viscounty. Eble V died shortly after 1236.
zh: 埃布洛五世是旺塔杜尔子爵，埃布洛四世与西比勒·德·拉费之子，也是游吟诗人先驱“歌者”埃布洛的曾孙。他先娶利摩日子爵阿代马尔·博松之女玛丽·德·利摩日，女儿阿利克塞娜嫁给纪尧姆·德·梅克尔。1186年，他续娶蒂雷纳的玛格丽特，即以女游吟诗人和游吟诗人保护者闻名的旺塔杜尔的玛丽亚；其子埃布洛六世后来继承子爵之位。埃布洛五世于1236年后不久去世。

en: Eble VI of Ventadorn (c. 1210–1265) was viscount of Ventadour, the son of Eble V and the trobairitz Marie de Ventadour, herself a patron of troubadours. He married Delphine de La Tour d'Auvergne, and in 1247 did homage to King Louis IX. By Delphine he left a son, Hélie, who succeeded him as Eble VII, and daughters Isabelle and Marie. He died shortly before 12 June 1265.
zh: 埃布勒六世·德·旺塔杜尔（约1210—1265）是旺塔杜尔子爵，埃布勒五世与女特罗巴杜尔、特罗巴杜尔庇护者玛丽·德·旺塔杜尔之子。他娶拉图尔-多弗涅的德尔菲娜为妻，1247年向国王路易九世行臣服礼。他与德尔菲娜生子埃利，即继位的埃布勒七世，还有女儿伊莎贝尔和玛丽，于1265年6月12日前不久去世。

en: Eble VII was viscount of Ventadour, the son of Eble VI and Dauphine de la Tour. He married Blanche de Châteauneuf, and their son Hélie succeeded him as viscount. He died before 1297.
zh: 埃布洛七世是旺塔杜尔子爵，埃布洛六世与多菲内·德·拉图尔之子。他娶布朗什·德·沙托讷夫为妻，儿子埃利后来继任子爵。他于1297年之前去世。

en: Eble VIII was viscount of Ventadour from 1323, succeeding his father Hélie. Son of Hélie and Marguerite de Beaujeu, he married Mathe de Comborn without issue. He died around 1328, and Bernard de Ventadour succeeded to the viscounty in 1329.
zh: 埃布洛八世自1323年起任旺塔杜尔子爵，继父埃利之位。他是埃利与玛格丽特·德·博热之子，娶马特·德·孔博尔为妻，没有子嗣。他约于1328年去世，1329年由旺塔杜尔的贝尔纳继任子爵。

en: Hélie de Ventadour was viscount of Ventadour, son of Eble VII and Blanche de Châteauneuf. About 1290 he married Marguerite de Beaujeu, who bore him seven children, including his successor Bernard and Guy, bishop of Cambrai and Vabres. He died in 1320.
zh: 埃利·德·旺塔杜尔是旺塔杜尔子爵，埃布勒七世与布朗什·德·沙托讷夫之子。约1290年他娶博热的玛格丽特，育有七名子女，包括继承人贝尔纳和历任康布雷、瓦布尔主教的居伊，1320年去世。

en: Marguerite de Beaumont was a daughter of Robert de Brienne, vicomte de Beaumont-au-Maine, and Marie de Craon. In 1338 she married Bernard de Ventadour, who ruled Ventadour from 1329 and became its first count in 1350; their son Robert later succeeded as count.
zh: 玛格丽特·德·博蒙是曼恩地区博蒙子爵罗贝尔·德·布里耶纳与玛丽·德·克朗之女。1338年，她嫁给1329年起统治旺塔杜尔、1350年成为首任旺塔杜尔伯爵的贝尔纳；其子罗贝尔后来承袭伯爵之位。

en: Andrew (Ukrainian: Andrii Yuriiovych, died 1323), son of King Yuri I of Galicia, ruled Galicia-Volhynia jointly with his brother Lev II from 1308, holding Volodymyr while Lev sat in Halych. The brothers fought Grand Duke Gediminas of Lithuania over Berestia and Dorohychyn while allying with King Władysław I of Poland and the Teutonic Order. In 1320 Andrew exempted merchants of Toruń and Kraków from tolls in Ruthenian lands. He and Lev died in 1323 fighting the Lithuanians or Mongol-Tatars, possibly near Berestia, ending the Romanovichi line; his daughter Euphemia married Gediminas's son Liubartas.
zh: 安德烈（乌克兰语名安德里·尤里耶维奇，？—1323）是加利奇国王尤里一世之子，1308年起与其兄弟列夫二世共治加利奇-沃伦，他驻跸沃洛德米尔，列夫坐镇加利奇。兄弟二人一面为别列斯季亚和德罗吉钦同立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯交战，一面与波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫一世及条顿骑士团结盟。1320年，安德烈下诏允许托伦和克拉科夫的商人在罗斯土地免税通商。1323年，他与列夫在抗击立陶宛人或蒙古-鞑靼人的战斗中身亡，可能战死于别列斯季亚附近，罗曼诺维奇嫡系就此断绝；其女欧费米娅嫁给格迪米纳斯之子柳巴尔塔斯。

en: Bolesław Jerzy II, also called Yuri II Boleslav (c. 1305–1340), was the Piast son of Trojden I of Masovia and Maria, daughter of Yuri I of Galicia. In 1323–1325 he succeeded his Rurikid maternal uncles as ruler of Galicia and Volhynia, also acquiring Belz. Born a Catholic, he adopted Orthodoxy to win over his boyars, granted city rights to Volodymyr (1324) and Sanok (1339), and in 1327 allied with the Teutonic Order. In 1331 he married a daughter of Gediminas. Poisoned by boyars in April 1340 without an heir, his death opened the long Galicia–Volhynia Wars.
zh: 博莱斯瓦夫·耶日二世，又称尤里二世·博莱斯拉夫（约1305—1340），是马佐夫舍公爵特洛杰登一世与加利奇的尤里一世之女玛丽亚的儿子，属皮亚斯特家族。1323—1325年，他继留里克家族的舅父之后成为加利奇和沃伦的统治者，又取得贝尔兹领地。他生为天主教徒，为争取波雅尔而改宗东正教；1324年和1339年先后赐予沃洛德米尔和萨诺克城市权，1327年与条顿骑士团结盟。1331年，他娶格迪米纳斯之女为妻。1340年4月他被波雅尔毒杀且无子嗣，其死引发了漫长的加利奇-沃伦战争。

en: Daniel Romanovich (1201–1266) was the son of Roman the Great and Anna-Euphrosyne, daughter of the Byzantine emperor Isaac II Angelos. Only four when his father died in 1205, he was exiled and raised at the Hungarian court. He fought the Mongols at the Kalka River in 1223 and saw Kiev fall while under his governor in 1240. He reunited Galicia after his victory at Yaroslav in 1245, and in 1246 had to accept Golden Horde overlordship at Sarai. In 1253 a papal envoy crowned him king of Ruthenia, and in 1256 he founded Lviv, named after his son Lev.
zh: 丹尼尔·罗曼诺维奇（1201—1266）是罗曼大帝与拜占庭皇帝伊萨克二世·安格洛斯之女安娜-欧芙洛绪涅之子。1205年父亲去世时他年仅四岁，被迫流亡，在匈牙利宫廷长大。他1223年在迦勒迦河与蒙古人作战，1240年基辅在他所派长官镇守下落陷。1245年，他在雅罗斯瓦夫取胜后重新统一加利西亚，1246年又被迫在萨莱接受金帐汗国的宗主权。1253年，教皇特使为他加冕，称罗斯国王；1256年他建立利沃夫，城名取自其子列夫。

en: Dmytro Dedko (died 1349) was a Galician boyar who emerged as ruler of the Kingdom of Ruthenia after Bolesław Jerzy II died in 1340. At first he acknowledged the overlordship of Casimir the Great of Poland and ruled as royal starosta, but he soon turned against the Polish garrisons and, with Lithuanian and Tatar support, raided the Lublin region in the winter of 1340–1341 until defeated on the Vistula. In 1341 he wrote to Toruń seeking to restore trade with Halych. He died in 1349, after which Casimir occupied Halych with the Golden Horde's consent.
zh: 德米特罗·德科（？—1349）是加利西亚的波雅尔显贵，1340年博莱斯瓦夫·耶日二世死后成为罗斯王国的实际统治者。他起初承认波兰国王卡齐米日大帝的宗主权，以王室地方长官身份执政，但很快起兵反对波兰驻军，并在立陶宛和鞑靼人支持下于1340—1341年冬攻入卢布林地区，最终在维斯瓦河战败。1341年，他致书托伦，希望恢复与加利奇的贸易。他于1349年去世，卡齐米日随即在金帐汗国同意下占领加利奇。

en: The Lithuanian princess Euphemia was a daughter of Grand Duke Gediminas and sister of Aldona Anna, queen of Poland. In 1331 she married at Płock Bolesław Jerzy II, Piast prince of Halych-Volhynia, adopting Catholicism; the match tied Gediminas to the south-western Rus principality.
zh: 立陶宛公主欧费米娅是立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯之女、波兰王后阿尔东娜·安娜的姐妹。1331年她在普沃茨克嫁给加利奇-沃伦的皮亚斯特王公博莱斯瓦夫·耶日二世并皈依天主教，使格迪米纳斯与西南罗斯联姻结盟。

en: Euphemia of Kuyavia (c. 1265–1308) was a Piast princess, daughter of Casimir I of Kuyavia and Euphrosyne of Opole, and sister of Władysław I the Elbow-high, later king of Poland. She married Yuri I of Galicia-Volhynia and became his queen consort. Her four children included Andrew and Lev II, who both ruled Galicia-Volhynia and died in 1323, Maria, wife of Trojden I of Masovia, and Anastasia, wife of Aleksandr Mikhailovich of Tver. Euphemia died on 18 March 1308, a month before her husband.
zh: 库亚维的欧菲米娅（约1265—1308）是皮亚斯特家族的公主，库亚维公爵卡齐米日一世与奥波莱的欧芙洛绪涅之女，也是后来的波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫一世的姐妹。她嫁给加利西亚—沃里尼亚的尤里一世，成为王后。她的四个子女包括1323年同年去世的加利西亚—沃里尼亚君主安德烈和列夫二世、嫁给马佐夫舍的特罗伊登一世的玛丽亚，以及嫁给特维尔的亚历山大·米哈伊洛维奇的安娜斯塔西娅。欧菲米娅于1308年3月18日去世，比丈夫早一个月。

en: Leo I (c. 1228–1301) was the elder son of Daniel of Galicia and Anna, daughter of Mstislav the Bold. He fought at Yaroslav in 1245 and in 1247 married Constance, daughter of Béla IV of Hungary. Inheriting Galicia in 1264, he moved his capital from Halych to Lviv, named for him by his father. He allied with Nogai Khan's Mongols to raid Poland and lost Black Ruthenia to Lithuania. He died around 1301 with Galicia-Volhynia at its height, and his son Yuri I succeeded him.
zh: 列夫一世（约1228—约1301）是加利西亚的丹尼尔与大胆的姆斯季斯拉夫之女安娜的长子。他参加了1245年的雅罗斯瓦夫战役，1247年娶匈牙利国王贝拉四世之女康斯坦丝为妻。1264年继承加利西亚后，他把都城从哈利奇迁至利沃夫，这座城正是父亲以他的名字建立的。他与那海汗和蒙古人结盟袭掠波兰，在与立陶宛的战争中失败并失去黑罗斯。他约于1301年去世时，加利西亚—沃里尼亚正值鼎盛，其子尤里一世继位。

en: Mstislav Sviatopolkovich was a Rurikid prince, apparently the eldest son of Sviatopolk II Iziaslavich of Kiev, born to a mistress. In 1099 his father seized Volodymyr-Volynskyi from David Igorevich and installed Mstislav as its prince. David soon returned and besieged the town, and on 12 June 1099 Mstislav was struck by an arrow while standing on the city walls and died. Accounts from the Kyiv Caves Monastery portray his death as vengeance for the monks Theodore and Basil, whom he had killed over hidden Varangian treasure.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/姆斯季斯拉夫·斯维亚托波尔科维奇
zh: 姆斯季斯拉夫·斯维亚托波尔科维奇是留里克家族王公，一般认为是基辅大公斯维亚托波尔克二世·伊贾斯拉维奇与情妇所生的长子。1099年，其父从达维德·伊戈列维奇手中夺取弗拉基米尔-沃伦斯基，立他为当地王公。达维德很快回师围城，1099年6月12日，姆斯季斯拉夫在城墙上被箭射中身亡。基辅洞窟修道院的记载将他的死写成报应：他曾为夺取瓦良格人的窖藏而害死修士费奥多尔与瓦西里。

en: Roman Mstislavich, called the Great (1152–1205), son of the Kyivan prince Mstislav Iziaslavich and Agnes of Poland, ruled Novgorod in 1168–1170 and then inherited Volhynia. He seized Halych in 1188 but was driven out by Béla III of Hungary; in 1199 he took Galicia again, uniting it with Volhynia. He curbed the Galician boyars, twice defeated the Cumans and captured Kyiv. In 1205 he invaded Poland and was killed at the Battle of Zawichost by the forces of Leszek the White, leaving his young sons Daniel and Vasylko.
zh: 罗曼·姆斯季斯拉维奇（1152—1205），即罗曼大帝，是基辅大公姆斯季斯拉夫·伊贾斯拉维奇与波兰的阿格尼丝之子，1168—1170年任诺夫哥罗德王公，随后继承沃里尼亚。他于1188年攻取哈利奇，却被匈牙利国王贝拉三世赶走；1199年再次占领加利西亚，将其与沃里尼亚合并为统一公国。他压制加利西亚波雅尔贵族，两度击败波洛伏齐人，并攻占基辅。1205年他入侵波兰，在扎维霍斯特战役中被莱谢克一世的军队杀死，留下幼子丹尼尔和瓦西里科。

en: Rostislav Vladimirovich (c. 1038–1066), baptized Mikhail, was a landless Rurikid izgoi prince, son of Vladimir of Novgorod and grandson of Yaroslav the Wise. His father died before Yaroslav, costing Rostislav his claim to Kiev, and he had no appanage for five years after Vladimir's death. He held Volhynia and Galicia from 1057, and tradition makes his wife Anna a daughter of King Béla I of Hungary. In 1064, aided by Vyshata, he seized Tmutarakan on the Black Sea, was expelled by Svyatoslav of Chernigov, and then returned to subdue the Circassian Kasogi. Alarmed by his rise, Byzantine Chersonesos had him poisoned on 3 February 1066. He left three sons, Rurik, Volodar and Vasilko.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/罗斯季斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇
zh: 罗斯季斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇（约1038—1066），教名米哈伊尔，是留里克王朝的无地王公（伊兹戈伊），诺夫哥罗德王公弗拉基米尔·雅罗斯拉维奇之子、智者雅罗斯拉夫之孙。父亲先于雅罗斯拉夫去世，使罗斯季斯拉夫失去了基辅继承权；父亲死后五年间，他没有得到采邑。1057年起他领有沃伦和加利奇亚，相传妻子安娜是匈牙利国王贝拉一世之女。1064年他在维沙塔帮助下夺取黑海之滨的特穆塔拉干，先被切尔尼戈夫的斯维亚托斯拉夫逐走，随后回城，征服了切尔克斯人的卡索格部。克森尼索的希腊人忌惮他坐大，派使者于1066年2月3日将他毒杀。他留下留里克、沃洛达尔和瓦西尔科三个儿子。

en: Vsevolod Vladimirovich (983/984 – before 1013) was the first Rurikid prince of Volhynia, a son of Vladimir the Great of Kiev by his wife Rogneda of Polotsk and younger brother of Izyaslav of Polotsk. In 987 or 988 his father gave him the newly annexed Volhynian land as his appanage, and in 988 the town of Volodymyr was founded as its capital while his retinue was stationed nearby at Variazh. By 1013 he was dead and Volhynia had passed to Sviatopolk of Turov, who married a daughter of Bolesław the Brave of Poland.
zh: 弗谢沃洛德·弗拉基米罗维奇（983/984—1013年前）是留里克王朝的第一位沃伦王公，基辅大公弗拉基米尔大帝与波洛茨克公主罗格涅达之子、波洛茨克王公伊贾斯拉夫之弟。987或988年，父亲将新并入的沃伦土地封给他作领地；988年沃洛德米尔建城，成为公国都城，他的亲兵队驻扎在附近的瓦里亚日。到1013年他已去世，沃伦落入图罗夫王公斯维亚托波尔克之手，后者并娶了波兰统治者勇敢者波列斯瓦夫之女。

en: Yuri I (24 April 1252–1308), son of Leo I of Galicia and Constance of Hungary, was prince of Belz from 1264 until he succeeded his father in 1301, reuniting all the lands of Galicia-Volhynia with his capital at Volodymyr. His long reign was mostly peaceful and prosperous, though Poland retook the Lublin region and Hungary seized part of Transcarpathia. He married Euphemia of Kuyavia, sister of Władysław I of Poland, and in 1303 secured from Patriarch Athanasius I of Constantinople the creation of the Orthodox Metropolis of Halych. On his death his sons Andrew and Leo II succeeded jointly.
zh: 尤里一世（1252年4月24日—1308）是列夫一世与匈牙利的康斯坦丝之子，1264年起任贝尔兹王公，1301年父亲去世后继位，重新统一加利西亚—沃里尼亚全境，定都弗拉基米尔-沃伦斯基。他在位长久，国内大体和平、经济繁荣，但波兰收复了卢布林地区，匈牙利夺取了外喀尔巴阡的一部分。他娶波兰的瓦迪斯瓦夫一世之妹、库亚维的欧菲米娅为妻，并于1303年促成君士坦丁堡牧首阿塔纳修斯一世设立哈利奇都主教区。他死后，儿子安德烈和列夫二世共同继位。

en: Johannes Hake, called John of Göttingen (c. 1280–1349), was a German physician and churchman from a Göttingen council family. He taught medicine at Montpellier from 1314 and served as personal physician to Emperor Louis the Bavarian, Archbishop Baldwin of Trier, King John of Bohemia and Pope Benedict XII; in 1331 he dedicated his treatise on poisons, De cautela a venenis, to John. That same year the pope named him the first directly appointed bishop of Verden, though he mostly stayed at Avignon and ruled through vicars. Transferred to Freising in 1341, he died at Avignon in October 1349.
zh: 约翰内斯·哈克，人称哥廷根的约翰（约1280—1349），出身哥廷根的市政官家族，是德意志医生兼教士。他自1314年起在蒙彼利埃教授医学，曾任皇帝路易四世、特里尔大主教巴尔杜因、波希米亚国王约翰以及教皇本笃十二世的御医；1331年，他把论述如何防备毒物的专著《防毒须知》题献给约翰。同年，教皇直接任命他为费尔登主教，他是当地首位由教皇直接任命的主教，但他多居阿维尼翁，靠代牧治理教区。1341年他被调往弗赖辛，1349年10月在阿维尼翁去世。

en: Conrad of Brunswick-Lüneburg (c. 1246 – 15 September 1300) was the youngest son of Duke Otto the Child and a Welf prince who became bishop of Verden. After his father's death in 1257 he first ruled jointly with his brothers Albert and John. Provost of Bremen Cathedral from 1259, he became cathedral custodian at Hildesheim in 1266 or 1267. He was postulated to the see of Verden in 1269 and confirmed as bishop in 1285. He rebuilt the fire-damaged Verden Cathedral and prevailed over his brother in a dispute over the Lüneburg saltworks. From 1277 he guarded Welf interests as guardian of his nephew Otto the Strict. In 1288 Duke Albert II of Saxony granted counties to his bishopric, enlarging it considerably.
zh: 康拉德·冯·不伦瑞克-吕讷堡（约1246—1300年9月15日）是韦尔夫家族诸侯、公爵“孩童”奥托的幼子，后来成为费尔登主教。1257年父亲去世后，他先与兄长阿尔布雷希特和约翰共同执政。他自1259年起任不来梅大教堂主祷司铎，1266年或1267年成为希尔德斯海姆座堂司库；1269年被推举为费尔登主教，1285年获确认。他重建了毁于火灾的费尔登主教座堂，在吕讷堡盐场的争执中胜过兄长。1277年起，他担任侄子“严厉者”奥托的监护人，维护韦尔夫家族利益。1288年萨克森公爵阿尔布雷希特二世将数处伯国转交其教区，使领地大为扩张。

en: Jeanne de Montfort (c. 1255–1293), daughter of Philip II of Montfort, Lord of Castres, and Jeanne de Lévis, was twice married into princely houses. In 1268 she wed her cousin Guigues VI of Albon, Count of Forez, and after his death in 1278 ruled Forez as regent for their three-year-old son John I until 1290. Her donations to religious orders and distribution of food to the poor won her esteem as regent. In 1283 she married Louis of Savoy, Baron of Vaud, becoming baroness of Vaud and bearing ten children, including Louis II. The lords of Beaujeu appear to have given her Brégnier-Cordon Castle on the occasion of this marriage. She was buried at Hautecombe Abbey.
zh: 让娜·德·蒙福尔（约1255—1293）是卡斯特尔领主腓力二世·德·蒙福尔与让娜·德·莱维之女，两度嫁入望族。1268年她嫁给表兄、福雷伯爵吉格六世·达尔邦；1278年丈夫去世后，她为年仅三岁的儿子让一世摄政，直到1290年。她向修会捐赠、向贫民分发粮食，因而作为摄政者受到称道。1283年她改嫁沃男爵路易·德·萨伏依，成为沃男爵夫人，育有十个子女，其中包括路易二世。博热领主似乎在这次婚姻之际将布雷尼耶-科尔东城堡赠予了她。她身后葬于上库姆修道院。

en: Fyodor Svyatoslavich (c. 1300 – c. 1356), son of the Bryansk prince Svyatoslav Glebovich, was a Rurikid prince of the Smolensk line who held Rzhev and ruled Vyazma from about 1339 to 1341. He first appears in 1314 serving Yury Danilovich of Moscow and led Muscovite troops against Tver in 1314 and 1316, later served Gediminas of Lithuania, acting as his envoy to Novgorod in 1326. After Algirdas's campaign of 1341 he lost Vyazma, entered Moscow service as governor of Volok, and in 1345 married his daughter Eupraxia to Grand Prince Simeon the Proud.
zh: 费奥多尔·斯维亚托斯拉维奇（约1300—约1356）是布良斯克王公斯维亚托斯拉夫·格列博维奇之子，属留里克王朝斯摩棱斯克支系，领有勒热夫，并于约1339至1341年统治维亚济马。史书首次提到他是1314年，他在莫斯科王公尤里·达尼洛维奇麾下效力，并于1314和1316年率领莫斯科军队进攻特维尔；此后他转投立陶宛的格迪米纳斯，1326年作为其使节前往诺夫哥罗德。1341年阿尔吉尔达斯出征后他失去维亚济马，改仕莫斯科，出任沃洛克长官，并于1345年将女儿叶夫普拉克西娅嫁给大公骄傲的谢苗。

en: Basarab I, called the Founder (c. 1270–1352), was the voivode who took Wallachia out of Hungarian overlordship. A charter of 1324 names him a vassal of Charles I of Hungary; by 1325 another calls him disloyal, and he held the Banate of Severin and raided southern Hungary. In July 1330 he marched to help Bulgaria's Michael Shishman against Serbia and shared the defeat at Velbazhd. Charles then invaded to take back the border lands Basarab held, and refused his offer of 7,000 silver marks, tribute and a son sent to court. But the king's army, starving on the march toward Curtea de Argeș, had to accept an armistice, and on 9–12 November 1330 the Wallachians shot arrows and hurled rocks from the cliffs of a narrow Carpathian pass, nearly annihilating it; Charles barely escaped. Hungarian suzerainty ended there. Curtea de Argeș lay in ruins, and Basarab moved his seat to Câmpulung. His dynasty ruled Wallachia for two centuries.
zh: 巴萨拉布一世（约1270—1352），绰号“开创者”，是使瓦拉几亚摆脱匈牙利宗主权的沃伊沃德。1324年的一份特许状称他是匈牙利国王查理一世的臣属，1325年的另一份特许状已称他背弃王权；他掌控塞维林巴纳特，并袭扰匈牙利南部。1330年7月，他出兵援助保加利亚的米哈伊尔·希什曼进攻塞尔维亚，在维尔巴日德与盟军一同战败。查理随即入侵，要收回巴萨拉布占据的边境领地，拒绝了他提出的7000银马克、岁贡和送一子入宫的条件。国王的大军在前往库尔泰亚-德-阿尔杰什的途中饥饿难行，被迫休战；1330年11月9日至12日，瓦拉几亚人却在喀尔巴阡山南麓的狭窄隘口，从崖上射箭投石，几乎将王军全歼，查理仅以身免。匈牙利的宗主权就此终结。库尔泰亚-德-阿尔杰什已成废墟，巴萨拉布把驻地迁往肯普隆格。他的王朝统治瓦拉几亚达两个世纪。

en: Marghita, or Margareta, was the wife of Basarab I, the voivode whose victory at the Battle of Posada in 1330 made Wallachia independent. Her name survives in a Câmpulung diptych commemorating Io Basarab voivode and his wife, Marghita. The Franciscan Chronicle credits a Catholic princess Margareta with founding the Dominican monastery at Câmpulung, and local tradition tells of a Margareta who built a church there and drowned herself after her husband, the legendary Radu Negru, destroyed it. She was the mother of Basarab's successor Nicholas Alexander and of Theodora, wife of Ivan Alexander of Bulgaria.
zh: 玛尔吉塔（又作玛格丽塔）是瓦拉几亚督军巴萨拉布一世之妻；巴萨拉布在1330年的波萨达之战中获胜，使瓦拉几亚赢得独立。肯普隆格的一份追思名簿记有督军伊万·巴萨拉布与其妻玛尔吉塔，她的名字因此留存。《方济各会编年史》把肯普隆格的多明我会修道院归于一位名叫玛格丽塔的天主教公主；当地传说则称一位玛格丽塔在当地修建教堂，教堂被其丈夫、传说中的黑公拉杜拆毁后投水自尽。她是继位者尼古拉·亚历山大之母，女儿狄奥多拉嫁给了保加利亚的伊凡·亚历山大。

en: Maria Lackfi (died before 1343) was the first wife of Nicholas Alexander, voivode of Wallachia, and probably came from a Bosnian or Balkan Orthodox elite family. She was the mother of Vladislav I, called Vlaicu, who ruled Wallachia from 1364, of Voislav (died 1366), and of Elisabeth (died 1370), who married Ladislaus of Opole. She was probably buried at Câmpulung.
zh: 玛丽亚·拉克菲（1343年前去世）是瓦拉几亚沃伊沃尼古拉·亚历山大的第一任妻子，可能出身波斯尼亚或巴尔干的东正教显贵家族。她是1364年起统治瓦拉几亚的弗拉迪斯拉夫一世（即弗拉伊库）、沃伊斯拉夫（1366年卒）和伊丽莎白（1370年卒，嫁给奥波莱的拉迪斯劳）的母亲，可能葬于肯普隆格。

en: Nicholas Alexander (c. 1300–1364), son of Basarab I, was the second voivode of Wallachia and is best known for founding the Orthodox Metropolis of Ungro-Wallachia in 1359. He became his father's co-ruler about 1344, the summer Louis I of Hungary marched into Transylvania, and went to the king to swear loyalty and head off a campaign against Wallachia. After Basarab's death in 1351 or 1352 he ruled alone. He at first resisted Hungarian pressure, but in 1354, threatened by the Golden Horde, he recognised Louis's suzerainty, admitted Catholic missions and let the Saxon merchants of Brașov pass duty-free; a 1355 agreement restored Severin to him. In 1359 he cast off Hungarian overlordship. Two of his daughters married into the Bulgarian and Serbian ruling houses. He died on 16 November 1364 and was buried at Câmpulung, his epitaph calling him the great and sole ruler, son of great Basarab. His son Vladislav I succeeded him.
zh: 尼古拉斯·亚历山大（约1300—1364）是巴萨拉布一世之子，瓦拉几亚第二任沃伊沃德，最为人知的事迹是1359年创立东正教的温格罗-瓦拉几亚都主教区。约1344年他开始与父亲共同执政，那年夏天匈牙利国王拉约什一世率军开进特兰西瓦尼亚，他前往觐见国王，宣誓效忠，以免匈牙利出兵瓦拉几亚。1351或1352年巴萨拉布去世后，他独自执政。他起初抵制匈牙利的压力，但1354年在金帐汗国的威胁下承认拉约什一世的宗主权，允许天主教会传教，并让布拉索夫的萨克森商人免税通行；1355年的协议使塞维林重归他手。1359年，他摆脱匈牙利宗主权。他的两个女儿分别嫁入保加利亚与塞尔维亚的统治家族。1364年11月16日他去世，葬于肯普隆格，墓志铭称他为伟大的唯一统治者、伟大巴萨拉布之子。儿子弗拉迪斯拉夫一世继位。

en: Thocomerius, also called Tihomir, was the father of Basarab I, the first independent voivode of Wallachia; a charter of King Charles I of Hungary of 26 November 1332 names Basarab as his son. Romanian scholars make him a local ruler south of the Carpathians from about 1290 to 1310, possibly Bărbat's successor in Oltenia, while his name is read either as Slavic Tihomir or as Cuman Toq-tämir. The Styrian chronicler Ottokar may describe him as the Wallachian lord who in 1307 imprisoned the captured King Otto of Hungary and then fell ill; Basarab may have succeeded him as a local ruler around 1310.
