zh: 托科梅留斯（又译蒂霍米尔）是瓦拉几亚第一位独立沃伊沃德巴萨拉布一世的父亲；1332年11月26日匈牙利国王查理一世的特许状称巴萨拉布为其子。罗马尼亚学者认为，约1290至1310年间他是喀尔巴阡山以南的地方统治者，可能在奥尔泰尼亚继巴尔巴特而立；其名字一说为斯拉夫语的蒂霍米尔，一说为库曼语的托克帖木儿。施蒂利亚编年史家奥托卡尔笔下，那位于1307年囚禁被俘匈牙利国王奥托、随后病倒的“瓦拉几亚领主”，可能就是他；巴萨拉布或于约1310年继他成为当地统治者。

en: Vlad III, called the Impaler (1428/31–1476/77), was voivode of Wallachia and son of Vlad II Dracul. As a boy he and his brother Radu were hostages at the Ottoman court. He seized the throne in 1448 and ruled again from 1456, purging rival boyars and impaling Transylvanian Saxon captives. In 1462 he defied Sultan Mehmed II, impaled his envoys and nearly captured the sultan in the Night Attack at Târgoviște. Many of his followers deserted to Radu, and Vlad sought Hungarian aid but was imprisoned by Matthias Corvinus. Held from 1463 to 1475, he regained Wallachia with Hungarian and Moldavian help in 1476 and was killed fighting soon after.
zh: 弗拉德三世，绰号“穿刺公”（1428/31—1476/77），是瓦拉几亚大公，弗拉德二世·德拉库尔之子。他少年时与弟弟拉杜一同被留作奥斯曼宫廷的人质。1448年他首次夺位，1456年再度统治瓦拉几亚，任内清洗敌对的波雅尔贵族，并将从特兰西瓦尼亚撒克逊人处俘获的俘虏处以穿刺之刑。1462年他公然对抗苏丹穆罕默德二世，穿刺其使者，并在特尔戈维什泰夜袭中险些生擒苏丹。许多追随者转而投奔拉杜，弗拉德向匈牙利求援，却被马加什·科韦努斯囚禁。1463至1475年间他身陷囹圄，1476年在匈牙利和摩尔达维亚援助下重夺瓦拉几亚，不久便战死。

en: Vladislav I, called Vlaicu Vodă, was voivode of Wallachia from 1364 until his death in 1377, succeeding his father Nicholas Alexander of the Basarab dynasty. Around 1365 he became the first Wallachian ruler to mint his own silver coins. In 1366 he accepted Louis I of Hungary as overlord and received Severin and Făgăraș. He later fought the Hungarians and briefly occupied Vidin in 1369 before submitting to Louis again. In 1369 he defeated a Turkish army allied with Bulgaria, securing Wallachia's Danube frontier for years. He also backed Nicodemus of Tismana in founding the Vodița and Tismana monasteries.
zh: 弗拉迪斯拉夫一世，人称弗拉伊库·沃达，1364年至1377年去世任瓦拉几亚沃伊沃德，继承父亲、巴萨拉布王朝的尼古拉·亚历山大之位。约1365年，他成为首位铸造本国银币的瓦拉几亚统治者。1366年，他承认匈牙利国王拉约什一世为宗主，受封塞维林和弗格拉什。此后他与匈牙利人交战，1369年一度占领维丁，随后再次向拉约什臣服。1369年，他击败与保加利亚结盟的土耳其军队，使瓦拉几亚的多瑙河边境多年无虞。他还支持蒂斯马纳的尼科季姆创建沃迪察修道院和蒂斯马纳修道院。

en: Gerad Ibrahim was the third Garaad, or sultan, of the Warsangali dynasty on the Somali coast around Las Qoray. Son of Gerad Hamar Gale and grandson of the founder Gerad Dhidhin, he ruled from 1328 to 1340, when Gerad Omer succeeded him.
zh: 格拉德·易卜拉欣是拉斯霍雷一带索马里海岸瓦桑加利王朝的第三任加拉德（苏丹），格拉德·哈马尔·加莱之子、开国者格拉德·迪丁之孙，1328至1340年在位，由格拉德·奥马尔继位。

en: Otto II von Wolfskeel (died 23 August 1345) was prince-bishop of Würzburg from 1333. Born in Würzburg into a Franconian ministerialis family, his father had commanded Marienberg Fortress. In 1333 the cathedral chapter split between Otto and Emperor Louis IV's secretary Hermann Hummel von Lichtenberg; Otto sought the backing of Pope John XXII and fled to Metz, only returning after Lichtenberg's sudden death in 1335, when he was elected unanimously. He added Kitzingen and Gemünden to the bishopric, ringed Marienberg with a new wall, founded thirteen parishes and created the office of vicar general.
zh: 奥托二世·冯·沃尔夫斯克尔（1345年8月23日卒）1333年起任维尔茨堡采邑主教。他生于维尔茨堡的法兰克尼亚武士家族，父亲曾执掌马林贝格要塞。1333年，主教座堂议会在他与皇帝路易四世的秘书赫尔曼·胡梅尔·冯·利希滕贝格之间分裂，奥托求得教皇约翰二十二世支持并避走梅斯，直到1335年利希滕贝格暴死后才返回并获一致推举。他为教区取得基青根和格明登等地，为马林贝格修筑新城墙，还设立十三座新堂区并首创副主教一职。

en: Adelaide of Cleves (born c. 1275), daughter of Count Dietrich VII of Cleves and Margaret of Guelders, married Count Henry IV of Waldeck in 1304. Her children included his successor Otto II and Elisabeth, wife of Count John of Nassau-Hadamar.
zh: 克莱沃的阿德莱德（约1275年生）是克莱沃伯爵迪特里希七世与海尔德的玛格丽特之女，1304年嫁给瓦尔代克伯爵亨利四世，生子继位者奥托二世和嫁与拿骚-哈达马尔伯爵约翰的伊丽莎白。

en: Adolf I (died 3 October 1270) founded the County and House of Waldeck. A younger son of Count Henry I of Waldeck-Schwalenberg, he was a cleric at Aroldessen until his uncle Hermann I left him Waldeck in 1224; after ruling jointly with his brother Volkwin IV, he took the Eder lands in the 1228 partition. He secured Korbach, backed anti-kings Henry Raspe and William of Holland against the Hohenstaufen, serving William as justiciar in Westphalia in 1251 to 1256, gained Wildungen in 1263 and fought at Zülpich in 1267. His son Henry predeceased him, so his grandson Adolf II succeeded.
zh: 阿道夫一世（？—1270年10月3日）是瓦尔代克伯国与瓦尔代克家族的实际开创者。他是瓦尔代克-施瓦伦贝格伯爵亨利一世的幼子，本在阿罗尔德森担任神职，1224年叔父赫尔曼一世将瓦尔代克留给他后还俗，与兄长福尔克温四世共治，1228年分家时取得埃德尔河沿岸的土地。他巩固了科尔巴赫，作为霍亨施陶芬家族的反对者支持对立国王亨利·拉斯佩和荷兰的威廉，1251至1256年出任威廉在威斯特伐伦的宫廷法官，1263年取得维尔东根，1267年参加曲尔皮希战役。其子亨利先他而死，由孙子阿道夫二世继位。

en: Adolf II (c. 1258–1302) was the eldest son of Count Henry III of Waldeck and succeeded his grandfather Adolf I as ruling count in 1270. After he failed to marry Sophia of Hesse, a family treaty of 1275 gave the county to his brother Otto I, and Adolf entered the Church. He became a canon at Liège and cathedral provost in Trier and Utrecht. In 1301 Pope Boniface VIII appointed him prince-bishop of Liège, where he reconciled clergy and burghers and captured the castle of Myrwar. He died in December 1302, rumoured poisoned by the moneylenders he had persecuted.
zh: 瓦尔代克的阿道夫二世（约1258—1302）是瓦尔代克伯爵亨利三世的长子，1270年继祖父阿道夫一世之后执掌瓦尔代克伯国。他未能娶到黑森的索菲娅，家族遂依条约于1275年把伯国交给其弟奥托一世，阿道夫则出家为教士，先后担任列日大教堂法政牧师以及特里尔、乌得勒支的教务长。1301年，教皇卜尼法斯八世任命他为列日采邑主教；他在任内调解了教士与市民的冲突，攻下米尔瓦尔城堡。1302年12月他去世，有传言称他是被自己打击的高利贷者毒杀。

en: Armgard of Waldeck was a daughter of Count Henry IV of Waldeck and Adelaide of Cleves. She married Conrad VI, Lord of Diepholz, and became the mother of his successor Johann II and of Anna von Diepholz.
zh: 瓦尔代克的阿姆加德是瓦尔代克伯爵亨利四世与克莱沃的阿德莱德之女，嫁给迪普霍尔茨领主康拉德六世，生子嗣位的约翰二世和安娜·冯·迪普霍尔茨。

en: Dietrich von Waldeck (c. 1316–25 June 1355) was a son of Count Henry IV of Waldeck and Adelaide of Cleves who followed a clerical career. He studied canon law at Orléans, held a prebend at Cologne from 1336 and at Münster from 1338, and became cathedral cantor at Münster in 1344. After resigning in 1346 he was reinstated by Pope Clement VI, received a Mainz prebend the same year, and on 24 July 1348 was sworn in as cathedral provost of Münster, an office he held until 1353.
zh: 迪特里希·冯·瓦尔代克（约1316—1355年6月25日）是瓦尔代克伯爵亨利四世与克莱沃的阿德莱德之子，选择了教士道路。他在奥尔良学习教会法，1336年起在科隆领有圣俸，1338年又在明斯特获得圣俸，1344年出任明斯特主教座堂唱诗班领唱。1346年他辞去职务，同年被教皇克雷芒六世复职并在美因茨获得圣俸；1348年7月24日他宣誓就任明斯特主教座堂主铎，任职至1353年。

en: Elisabeth of Waldeck (c. 1309 – before 22 June 1385) was a daughter of Count Henry IV of Waldeck and Adelaide of Cleves. By 1331 she was married to Count John of Nassau-Hadamar, whose rule ran from 1334 until his death early in 1365. She bore John ten children, including his immediate successors as counts, Henry and Emich III, Anna, who married Rupert VII of Nassau-Sonnenberg, and Elisabeth, abbess of the imperial abbey of Essen. She died before 22 June 1385.
zh: 瓦尔德克的伊丽莎白（约1309—1385年6月22日前）是瓦尔德克伯爵亨利四世与克莱沃的阿德尔海德之女。她不迟于1331年嫁给1334年起统治拿骚-哈达马尔的伯爵约翰，约翰于1365年初去世。她共生有十个子女，包括先后继任伯爵的亨利和埃米希三世、嫁给拿骚-索南贝格的鲁普雷希特七世的安娜，以及埃森帝国修道院的女院长伊丽莎白。她于1385年6月22日前去世。

en: Henry III of Waldeck (c. 1225–1267) was the eldest son of Count Adolf I, co-ruling Waldeck in his father's lifetime. With his father and his brother Widukind, bishop of Osnabrück, he backed Landgrave Henry I of Hesse against Bishop Simon of Paderborn and Corvey Abbey for the north Hessian borderlands. He married Mechtild of Cuyk-Arnsberg, daughter of Count Gottfried III of Arnsberg and heiress of Wewelsburg. He died in 1267, three years before his father; his sons Adolf II and Otto I succeeded as counts, and his daughter Adelaide married Simon I of Lippe.
zh: 瓦尔代克的亨利三世（约1225—1267）是伯爵阿道夫一世的长子，在父亲生前即参与共同统治瓦尔代克伯国。他与父亲及弟弟、奥斯纳布吕克主教维杜金德一同支持黑森方伯亨利一世，同帕德博恩主教西蒙和科尔维修道院争夺黑森北部边境地带。他娶阿恩斯贝格伯爵戈特弗里德三世之女、韦韦尔斯堡的女继承人梅希蒂尔德·冯·屈克-阿恩斯贝格。1267年他先其父三年而死；其子阿道夫二世与奥托一世相继担任伯爵，女儿阿德莱德嫁给利珀的西蒙一世。

en: Henry IV (c. 1282–1348) ruled Waldeck from 1305 to 1344. Son of Count Otto I and Sophie of Hesse, he served the Archbishops of Mainz as Amtmann in northern Hesse and the Eichsfeld. From 1306 his building of Wetterburg Castle caused a long feud with Archbishop Henry II of Cologne, who occupied Marsberg, until both sides accepted joint ownership in 1325. In 1315 he and Count William of Arnsberg divided the County of Rüdenberg, and Emperor Louis IV made him protector of Dortmund. He retired in 1344 after arranging an undivided succession and died in 1348.
zh: 亨利四世（约1282—1348）1305年至1344年统治瓦尔代克。他是伯爵奥托一世与黑森的索菲之子，作为美因茨大主教的地方官管辖北黑森和艾希斯费尔德。1306年起因修建韦特堡城堡，他与科隆大主教亨利二世长期交恶，科隆方面一度占领马斯贝格，双方最终于1325年约定共有该城堡。1315年，他与阿恩斯贝格伯爵威廉瓜分吕登贝格伯国；皇帝路易四世又任命他为多特蒙德的庇护人。1344年他在安排好领地不可分割的继承方案后退隐，1348年去世。

en: Henry V of Waldeck, who died after 1349, was the third son of Count Henry IV of Waldeck and Adelaide of Cleves. The county passed to his eldest brother Otto II, while Henry, like his second brother Dietrich, entered the Church. He held clerical prebends at Cologne and Minden and became provost of Minden Cathedral.
zh: 瓦尔德克的亨利五世（卒于1349年后）是瓦尔德克伯爵亨利四世与克莱沃的阿德尔海德的第三子。伯国由长兄奥托二世继承，亨利则与次兄迪特里希一样投身教会，在科隆和明登领有圣俸，后出任明登主教座堂教长。

en: Mechthild of Waldeck was a daughter of Count Henry IV of Waldeck and Adelaide of Cleves.
zh: 瓦尔德克的梅希蒂尔德是瓦尔德克伯爵亨利四世与克莱沃的阿德尔海德之女。

en: Otto I (c. 1262–1305), youngest son of Henry III of Waldeck, inherited the county in 1275–1276 by marrying Sophia, daughter of Landgrave Henry I of Hesse, displacing his elder brother Adolf II. Expanding against Cologne, he fought for John I of Brabant in the Limburg Succession War, destroyed Hallenberg and shared the victory at Worringen (1288), gaining Volksmarsen, half of Kugelsburg and Canstein Castle. He acquired Nordenau in 1298 and served Mainz as bailiff of Eichsfeld from 1303. Captured in a feud near Heiligenstadt in 1305, he was strangled.
zh: 奥托一世（约1262—1305）是瓦尔代克的亨利三世的幼子。依照家族约定，他于1275—1276年娶黑森领地伯爵亨利一世之女索菲娅，取代兄长阿道夫二世继承瓦尔代克伯国。他继续向西对抗科隆大主教：在林堡继承战争中支持布拉班特公爵约翰一世，摧毁哈伦贝格，并在1288年沃林根战役获胜后取得福尔克马森、半个库格尔斯堡和坎施泰因城堡，1298年又购得诺德瑙城堡。1303年起他担任美因茨大主教区在艾希斯费尔德的地方长官，1305年在海利根施塔特附近的一场仇杀中被俘，随后被绞死。

en: Otto II (before 1307–1369) was Count of Waldeck from 1344 until his death, having co-ruled with his father Henry IV since 1332. Around 1339 he married Matilda, daughter of Duke Otto III of Brunswick-Lüneburg. In 1349 Emperor Charles IV enfeoffed him with Waldeck as an imperial county. When his father-in-law died without male heirs, Otto claimed Lüneburg, but the emperor awarded only a heavy indemnity that was never paid. In 1357 the Archbishop of Mainz mortgaged his share of the lordship of Itter to Otto, and in 1358 Otto founded a Hospitaller hospital at Niederwildungen. He died in 1369 amid war with Mainz and Hesse.
zh: 奥托二世（1307年前—1369）1344年至去世任瓦尔代克伯爵，此前自1332年起便与父亲亨利四世共同执政。约1339年，他娶不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵奥托三世之女玛蒂尔德为妻。1349年，皇帝查理四世将瓦尔代克作为帝国伯国册封给他。岳父无男嗣而死后，奥托主张继承吕讷堡，但皇帝只判给他一笔巨额补偿金，且始终未获支付。1357年美因茨大主教将其持有的伊特领地份额抵押给奥托，1358年奥托又在尼德维尔东根创办医院骑士团医院。1369年，他在与美因茨和黑森的交战中去世。

en: Albert I, Count of Werdenberg-Heiligenberg (died c. 1365), was the youngest son of Count Hugo II and Euphemia of Ortenburg. First documented in 1308, he was named by Emperor Louis the Bavarian imperial bailiff around Lake Constance and over Uri, Schwyz and Unterwalden. In 1344 the advocacy over the future Appenzell and the neighbourhood of Saint Gall Abbey was pledged to him, and in 1347 he acquired the imperial advocacy of the Rhine Valley and Altstätten as pledges. After feuds with Austria in 1355 and Montfort-Feldkirch in 1360, the latter settled through his son Albert II's coup on Lake Constance, he died around 1365.
zh: 韦尔登贝格-海利根贝格伯爵阿尔布雷希特一世（约1365年卒）是伯爵雨果二世与奥滕堡的尤菲米娅最小的儿子，1308年首次见于文献。皇帝路易四世（巴伐利亚人）任命他为博登湖周边及乌里、施维茨、翁特瓦尔登的帝国地方长官。1344年，日后的阿彭策尔地区及圣加仑修道院邻近地带的代官之职抵押给他；1347年他又取得莱茵河谷帝国代官职及阿尔特施泰滕的抵押权。他在1355年与奥地利交战、1360年与蒙特福特-费尔德基希交战，后一战因子阿尔布雷希特二世在博登湖发动突袭而得以体面收场；他约于1365年去世。

en: Hugo II (died 1305 or 1309), called the One-Eyed, was count of Werdenberg-Heiligenberg, only son of Hugo I and Mechtild of Neuffen, and a loyal follower of the Habsburgs. In 1281 he escorted King Rudolf I's daughter Clementia to Naples to marry Charles Martel of Anjou. In April 1292 he relieved Winterthur for Duke Albert I, then helped storm Wil after a two-month siege, where Albert knighted him. He fought at Göllheim in 1298, when Albert took the crown from Adolf of Nassau, and attended the Aachen coronation. Married to Euphemia of Ortenburg, he is last documented in July 1305.
zh: 雨果二世（卒于1305或1309年），绰号“独眼”，是韦尔登贝格—海利根贝格伯爵，雨果一世与诺伊芬的梅希蒂尔德的独子，也是哈布斯堡家族的忠实追随者。1281年，他护送国王鲁道夫一世之女克莱门蒂娅前往那不勒斯，与安茹的卡洛·马特洛成婚。1292年4月，他替公爵阿尔布雷希特一世解救温特图尔之围，随后又参与围攻维尔，在两个月后将其攻克，并在维尔城外受阿尔布雷希特册封为骑士。1298年他参加格尔海姆战役——阿尔布雷希特在此从国王拿骚的阿道夫手中夺得王冠——并出席亚琛加冕礼。他娶奥滕堡的尤菲米娅为妻，1305年7月最后一次见于记载。

en: Catherine of Habsburg-Kyburg (c. 1290 – after 1342) was a daughter of Count Hartmann I of Neu-Kyburg and Elizabeth of Freiburg. She was married to Count Albert I of Werdenberg-Heiligenberg and was the mother of his three sons, Albert II, Hartmann and Rudolf.
zh: 哈布斯堡-基堡的卡塔琳娜（约1290—1342年后）是新基堡伯爵哈特曼一世与弗赖堡的伊丽莎白之女，嫁给韦尔登贝格-海利根贝格伯爵阿尔布雷希特一世，生有阿尔布雷希特二世、哈特曼和鲁道夫三个儿子。

en: Albert I is the first attested count of Wernigerode. He appears in 1103 at Haimar near Hildesheim, was called comes Adelbertus de villa Heymbere in 1117, and on 18 October 1121 witnessed a charter of Bishop Reinhard of Halberstadt as Adelbertus comes de Wernigerode. On 13 November 1130 King Lothar III made him Vogt of Drübeck Abbey near Ilsenburg, and he also held the advocacy of Ilsenburg Abbey. He is last recorded on 5 December 1141. His sons were Bertold, who died in 1126, and Ludolf, last heard of after 1156.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特一世是见于记载的第一代韦尼格罗德伯爵。他于1103年首次出现在希尔德斯海姆附近的海马尔，1117年被称作“海马尔村的阿德尔伯特伯爵”，1121年10月18日以“韦尼格罗德的阿德尔伯特伯爵”之名在哈尔伯施塔特主教赖因哈德的一份特许状上联署。1130年11月13日，国王洛泰尔三世任命他为伊尔森堡附近德吕贝克修道院的保护官，他还兼任伊尔森堡修道院的保护官。他最后一次见于记载是1141年12月5日。其子有1126年先他而逝的贝尔托德，以及1156年后仍有记载的卢多尔夫。

en: Albert II was count of Wernigerode in the northern Harz, attested in charters from 1134 to 1165. He was the son of Count Bertold of Wernigerode, who died in 1126, and a grandson of Albert I, the family's first count. With his wife Adelaide of Lüchow, last recorded after 1157, he had a single son, Albert III, who appears as count of Wernigerode from 1173 and held the advocacy, or Vogtei, of Drübeck Abbey. Albert II was still living after 1179.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特二世是北哈尔茨的韦尼格罗德伯爵，1134至1165年间见于特许状记载。他是1126年去世的韦尼格罗德伯爵贝尔托德之子、家族第一代伯爵阿尔布雷希特一世之孙。他的妻子是吕肖的阿德尔海德（1157年后仍有记载），两人只有一个儿子阿尔布雷希特三世；后者自1173年起以韦尼格罗德伯爵身份出现，并担任德吕贝克修道院的保护官。阿尔布雷希特二世在1179年后仍在世。

en: Albert III ruled as count of Wernigerode from 1173 until after 1214 and, like his predecessors, served as Vogt of Drübeck Abbey. He was the only son of Count Albert II and Adelaide of Lüchow, and married a daughter of Burchard II of Querfurt, burgrave of Magdeburg. His sons divided the family's counties and advocacies: Conrad I held the Ambergau with the Drübeck Vogtei and Gebhard I the Derlingau and Nordthüringgau, while another son, Albert, became cathedral provost of Magdeburg in 1239. A daughter, Kunigunde, married Count Bernard II of Wölpe after 1215.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特三世自1173年至1214年后担任韦尼格罗德伯爵，并与先辈一样出任德吕贝克修道院保护官。他是伯爵阿尔布雷希特二世与吕肖的阿德尔海德的独子，娶马格德堡城堡伯爵布尔夏德二世·冯·奎尔富特之女为妻。他的儿子们分割了家族的诸伯国与保护官职位：康拉德一世获得安贝高和德吕贝克保护官一职，格布哈德一世获得德林高与北图林高，另一子阿尔布雷希特则于1239年出任马格德堡大教堂教务长。女儿库妮贡德于1215年后嫁给弗尔珀伯爵伯恩哈德二世。

en: Albert V (also numbered IV), born around 1244, was count of Wernigerode in the northern Harz from 1268 to 1319, ruling a county held as a fief of the margraves of Brandenburg. He was the son of Conrad II and Oda of Regenstein. By his first, unnamed wife he had his heir Conrad III, who before 1315 married Helen, daughter of Duke John I of Brunswick-Lüneburg, and a daughter Oda, married in 1303 to Count Burchard V of Mansfeld. His second wife came from the house of Barby. Albert is last documented after 8 June 1320.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特五世（一称四世）约1244年出生，1268至1319年任北哈尔茨的韦尼格罗德伯爵，统治着一块作为勃兰登堡边疆伯爵采邑的领地。他是康拉德二世与雷根施泰因的奥达之子。他与姓名不详的第一任妻子生有继承人康拉德三世——后者在1315年前娶不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵约翰一世之女海伦娜——以及女儿奥达，奥达于1303年嫁给曼斯费尔德伯爵布尔夏德五世。他的第二任妻子出身巴尔比家族。阿尔布雷希特最后一次见于记载是1320年6月8日之后。

en: Gebhard I, the third son of Count Albert III of Wernigerode and nephew of Bishop Conrad of Querfurt, is attested from 1217 as count in the Derlingau and Nordthüringgau, ruling the Wernigerode lands until 1269. In 1268 the county lost its imperial immediacy and became a fief of the Ascanian margraves of Brandenburg, a step taken to secure protection against the dukes of Brunswick. He married Luitgard, last recorded in 1259; their son Conrad II succeeded him, a daughter Hedwig became prioress of Marienberg near Helmstedt, and Wilburg married Hermann von Werberg. Gebhard died after 14 July 1270.
zh: 格布哈德一世是韦尼格罗德伯爵阿尔布雷希特三世的第三子，也是奎尔富特的主教康拉德的外甥，1217年起受封为德林高和北图林高的伯爵，统辖韦尼格罗德领地直至1269年。1268年，韦尼格罗德伯国失去帝国直属地位，成为阿斯坎尼家族勃兰登堡边疆伯爵的采邑，此举本是为抵御不伦瑞克公爵而寻求庇护。他娶1259年仍有记载的卢伊特加德为妻；其子康拉德二世继位，女儿海德维希成为黑尔姆施泰特附近马林贝格修道院的副院长，维尔堡则嫁给赫尔曼·冯·韦尔贝格。格布哈德于1270年7月14日后去世。

en: Helen of Brunswick-Lüneburg was a daughter of Duke John I of Brunswick-Lüneburg and Liutgard of Holstein. She married Count Conrad III of Wernigerode, whom her son Conrad IV succeeded in 1339.
zh: 不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的海伦是不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵约翰一世与荷尔斯泰因的柳特加德之女，嫁给韦尼格罗德伯爵康拉德三世；其子康拉德四世于1339年继位。

en: Conrad I was a son of Count Albert III of Wernigerode. He is attested between 1217 and 1252 as count in the Ambergau and Vogt, or lay advocate, of Drübeck Abbey, and was still living after 1253. His wife Hedwig died in 1252.
zh: 康拉德一世是韦尼格罗德伯爵阿尔布雷希特三世之子。1217至1252年间，他以安贝高伯爵和德吕贝克修道院保护官的身份见于记载，1253年后仍在世。他的妻子海德维希卒于1252年。

en: Conrad II, son of Gebhard I and Luitgard, is attested as count of Wernigerode from 1254 to 1293. In 1268 the county became a fief of the margraves of Brandenburg. He married Oda of Regenstein, daughter of Count Siegfried I of Regenstein and Sophie, daughter of Prince Henry I of Anhalt; she died on 28 August 1283. Their children included Albert V, who succeeded as count, Frederick II, Henry III, and Luitgard, who married Count Siegfried IV of Blankenburg in February 1289. Conrad died on 1 June 1298.
zh: 康拉德二世是格布哈德一世与卢伊特加德之子，1254至1293年间以韦尼格罗德伯爵身份见于记载。1268年，伯国成为勃兰登堡边疆伯爵的采邑。他娶雷根施泰因的奥达为妻；奥达是雷根施泰因伯爵齐格弗里德一世与安哈尔特亲王亨利一世之女索菲的女儿，卒于1283年8月28日。两人的子女包括继位为伯爵的阿尔布雷希特五世、腓特烈二世、亨利三世，以及1289年2月嫁给布兰肯堡伯爵齐格弗里德四世的卢伊特加德。康拉德于1298年6月1日去世。

en: Conrad III, Count of Wernigerode, ruled the Harz county from 1297, initially alongside his father Albert V, until his death in 1339. He married Helen, a daughter of Duke John I of Brunswick-Lüneburg. In 1338 he granted land at Neustadt whose income was to maintain the chaplain of the chapel on the Harzburg. With his son Conrad IV he bound himself by a service treaty to Bishop Henry III of Hildesheim, in the bishop's long conflict over the Hildesheim see.
zh: 韦尼格罗德伯爵康拉德三世自1297年起统治哈茨山区的韦尼格罗德伯国，最初与父亲阿尔布雷希特五世共治，直至1339年去世。他娶不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵约翰一世之女海伦为妻。1338年，他捐出新城一带的土地，收入用于供养哈茨堡山上小堂的驻堂神父。他还与儿子康拉德四世以服役契约效力于希尔德斯海姆主教亨利三世，卷入后者围绕希尔德斯海姆主教座的长期纷争。

en: Conrad IV, Count of Wernigerode (c. 1306 – after 24 June 1373), was the son of Count Conrad III and Helen of Brunswick-Lüneburg and is documented as count from 1325. In 1343 he acquired from the counts of Regenstein a share of their county, a fief of Halberstadt. Around the middle of the century he founded in Wernigerode the Hospital of Saint George, whose chapel was first documented in 1347. Like his father he served Bishop Henry III of Hildesheim by treaty. His wife Elisabeth of Hohnstein was mother of Henry IV, the last count.
zh: 韦尼格罗德伯爵康拉德四世（约1306—1373年6月24日后）是伯爵康拉德三世与不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的海伦之子，1325年起以伯爵身份见于记载。1343年，他从雷根施泰因伯爵手中购得该伯国的一部分，作为哈尔伯施塔特的封邑。14世纪中叶，他在韦尼格罗德创办圣乔治济贫院，其附属小堂于1347年首次见于文献。他与父亲一样以契约效力于希尔德斯海姆主教亨利三世。妻子霍恩施泰因的伊丽莎白是末代伯爵亨利四世的母亲。

en: Francis Kübel was a Cistercian monk from Eger who had studied in Paris and served as abbot of Waldsassen Abbey from 1337 to 1349. His abbacy was marked by the decline and indebtedness of the house: in 1341 he sold the town of Redwitz, granted to the abbey by Emperor Louis the Bavarian in 1339, to the city of Eger, and in 1348 Rüdiger von Sparneck bought the Schönbach lands. After dissident monks elected Nikolaus Heckel as a rival abbot, a visitor from Morimond annulled the election, but Kübel himself had to resign in 1349. He died about twenty years later.
zh: 弗朗茨·屈贝尔是出身海布的西多会修士，曾在巴黎求学，1337年至1349年任瓦尔德萨森修道院院长。他在任时修道院日益衰败、债台高筑：1341年，他把皇帝路易四世（巴伐利亚人）1339年赠予修道院的雷德维茨城卖给海布城；1348年，吕迪格·冯·施帕内克购得申巴赫领地。不满的修士另选尼古劳斯·黑克尔为院长，莫里蒙修道院派来的巡察使推翻了这次选举，但屈贝尔本人也被迫于1349年退位，约二十年后去世。

en: Sir Edmund Mortimer (1376–1409), a younger son of the Earl of March and great-grandson of Edward III through Lionel of Antwerp, held a crown claim. He supported Henry Bolingbroke despite his own elder brother Roger's stronger claim through Lionel. After Roger was killed in Ireland in 1398, Edmund protected the interests of his young nephew, the new Earl of March. Fighting for Henry IV against Owain Glyndŵr, he was captured at Bryn Glas on 22 June 1402. When the king forbade his ransom and seized his estates, Mortimer turned rebel: in November 1402 he married Glyndŵr's daughter Catrin and promised to restore Richard II or crown his nephew the Earl of March. In 1405 he joined the Tripartite Indenture with Glyndŵr and Northumberland. He died in the siege of Harlech Castle in 1409.
zh: 埃德蒙·莫蒂默爵士（1376—1409）是马奇伯爵年纪较小的儿子，通过安特卫普的莱昂内尔成为爱德华三世的曾孙，本人拥有英格兰王位继承权。尽管兄长罗杰通过莱昂内尔一支拥有比亨利·博林布鲁克更强的继承权，埃德蒙仍支持亨利。1398年罗杰在爱尔兰阵亡后，他维护年幼侄子、即新任马奇伯爵的利益。他曾为亨利四世征讨欧文·格兰道尔，却在1402年6月22日的布林格拉斯之战中被俘。国王禁止为他赎身并没收其地产，莫蒂默于是转投叛军：1402年11月他娶格兰道尔之女卡特琳为妻，许诺复辟理查二世或拥立其侄马奇伯爵为王。1405年他与格兰道尔、诺森伯兰共同订立三分契约。1409年，他在哈莱克城堡围城期间死去。

en: Ednyfed ap Tudur was one of the six sons of Tudur ap Goronwy of the Penmynydd family. He drowned in 1382 while crossing a river in Kent together with his elder brother Goronwy Fychan, newly made constable of Beaumaris Castle.
zh: 埃德尼韦德·阿普·都铎是彭迈尼德家族都铎·阿普·戈伦韦六子之一。1382年，他与新任博马里斯城堡总管的兄长戈伦韦·费汉一同在肯特渡河时溺亡。

en: Goronwy Fychan ap Tudur (died 22 March 1382) was a soldier and administrator, the eldest son of Tudur ap Goronwy and a leading man of the Tudors of Penmynydd on Anglesey. He married Myfanwy Fychan, heroine of a famous Welsh love poem, and was the patron of leading bards of the day and a close associate of Richard II. Four days after he was made constable of Beaumaris Castle, one of the few Welshmen to hold the post, he and his brother Ednyfed drowned crossing a river in Kent. He was buried at Llanfaes friary.
zh: 戈伦韦·费汉·阿普·都铎（1382年3月22日卒）是军人兼行政官，为都铎·阿普·戈伦韦的长子、安格尔西彭迈尼德都铎家族的头面人物。他娶了著名威尔士爱情诗的女主人公迈范维·费汉，本人则是当时一流诗人的赞助人，并与理查二世过从甚密。他被任命为博马里斯城堡总管，是少数出任该职的威尔士人之一，仅四天后便与兄弟埃德尼韦德在1382年渡过肯特一条河流时双双溺亡。他葬于兰法伊斯修道院。

en: Goronwy ap Tudur Hen (died 1331) was Lord of Penmynydd in Anglesey and the son of Tudur Hen. Like his father he served the English crown, fighting in Edward II's Scottish campaigns, including the invasion that ended in defeat at Bannockburn in 1314. He remained loyal to Edward II until the king's murder in 1327, and held office as a yeoman and forester of Snowdon. He died in 1331 and was buried at Llanfaes Friary near Bangor. Through his son Tudur he was a forebear of Owen Tudor and the royal House of Tudor.
zh: 戈伦韦·阿普·都铎·亨（？—1331）是安格尔西岛彭米尼德的领主，老都铎之子。和父亲一样，他为英格兰王室效力，随爱德华二世征讨苏格兰，包括1314年以英军惨败告终的班诺克本战役。他始终忠于爱德华二世，直到1327年国王遇害，本人担任斯诺登的约曼与林务官。他于1331年去世，葬于班戈附近的兰韦斯修道院。通过其子都铎，他是欧文·都铎与都铎王室的先祖。

en: Gruffudd Fychan (early fourteenth century – 1369) was Lord of Glyndyfrdwy and Cynllaith Owain in Powys and a descendant of the princes of Powys Fadog of the Royal House of Mathrafal, with a claim to their hereditary title. He served Richard Fitzalan, Earl of Arundel, as steward of the lordship of Oswestry and keeper of Ellesmere. By his wife Elen, daughter of Thomas ap Llywelyn, he was the father of Owain Glyndŵr, who in 1400 raised the great Welsh revolt and claimed the title Prince of Wales. Gruffudd died in 1369 and was buried at Llanasa.
zh: 格鲁菲兹·沃汉（14世纪初—1369年）是波伊斯境内格林杜弗德维与辛莱思·欧文的领主，身为马斯拉法尔王族后裔、波伊斯·法多格诸侯的子孙，对其世袭头衔享有继承权。他为阿伦德尔伯爵理查德·菲茨艾伦效力，任奥斯沃斯特里领地总管和埃尔斯米尔看守官。妻子埃伦是托马斯·阿普·卢埃林之女，生子欧文·格林杜尔——后者于1400年发动威尔士大起义，自称威尔士亲王。格鲁菲兹于1369年去世，葬于拉纳萨。

en: Hawys Gadarn, Hawys the Strong (c. 1291–c. 1350), was the heiress of the Welsh marcher lordship of Powys, daughter of Owain ap Gruffudd and granddaughter of its prince Gruffudd ap Gwenwynwyn. When her brother Gruffudd ab Owain died in 1309, she inherited the lordship and within weeks married John Charlton, a Shropshire knight in Edward II's household. Her uncle Gruffudd ap Gruffudd challenged her claim under Welsh custom, and in 1312, backed by Thomas, earl of Lancaster, besieged the couple in Welshpool castle; the quarrel lasted until his death in 1332. Sixteenth-century antiquaries first recorded her epithet.
zh: 绰号“刚毅者”的哈维斯（约1291—约1350）是威尔士边区波伊斯领地的女继承人，为欧文·阿普·格鲁菲德之女、波伊斯王公格鲁菲德·阿普·格温温之孙女。1309年其兄格鲁菲德·阿普·欧文去世，她继承领地，并在数周内嫁给爱德华二世宫廷中的什罗普郡骑士约翰·查尔顿。其叔格鲁菲德·阿普·格鲁菲德依威尔士习惯法争夺继承权，1312年在兰开斯特伯爵托马斯支持下把夫妇俩围困在威尔士浦城堡，纷争一直持续到他1332年去世。“刚毅者”这一绰号最早见于16世纪博古学者的记载。

en: Hywel ap Goronwy (died c. 1366) was a canon of Bangor and brother of Tudur ap Goronwy of Penmynydd. After the 1345 killing of Henry Shalford near his Bangor house, he was jailed at Launceston but released without charge.
zh: 海韦尔·阿普·戈伦韦（约1366年卒）是班戈法政牧师，彭迈尼德的都铎·阿普·戈伦韦的兄弟。1345年亨利·沙尔福德在他班戈住所附近被杀后，他被囚禁于朗塞斯顿，但未被定罪即获释。

en: Maredudd ap Tudur (died c. 1406) was a Welsh soldier and nobleman of the Penmynydd family on Anglesey, the youngest of the six sons of Tudur ap Goronwy. He served as sewer of Anglesey before 1392 and as esquire to the Bishop of Bangor in 1404. With his brothers Rhys and Gwilym he supported their cousin Owain Glyndŵr's revolt against Henry IV from 1400, though less prominently; the family lost most of its lands as a result. His son Owain anglicised his name to Owen Tudor and became grandfather of Henry VII.
zh: 梅雷迪思·阿普·都铎（约1406年卒）是安格尔西彭迈尼德家族的威尔士军人与贵族，为都铎·阿普·戈伦韦六子中最幼者。1392年前他曾任安格尔西侍宴官，1404年任班戈主教的侍从。1400年起，他与兄弟里斯、格威利姆一同支持表亲欧文·格林杜尔反抗亨利四世，但作用不如此二兄弟突出，家族也因此丧失大部分土地。其子欧文把名字英语化为欧文·都铎，后来成为亨利七世的祖父。

en: Owain Glyndŵr (c. 1354–c. 1416) was a Welsh nobleman descended from the princes of Powys. A dispute with his English neighbour Reginald de Grey sparked a national rising in 1400, and Glyndŵr was acclaimed Prince of Wales that September. English penal laws against the Welsh deepened unrest and widened support for his revolt. By 1404 he controlled most of Wales, held a parliament at Machynlleth and received French aid; his 1406 Pennal Letter planned Welsh universities and laws. Harlech and Aberystwyth fell in 1409. He refused two royal pardons and fought on with guerrilla tactics until vanishing from the record in 1412; never captured, he died in hiding about 1416 and became a Welsh folk hero.
zh: 欧文·格林杜尔（约1354—约1416）是出身波伊斯王公后裔的威尔士贵族。他与英格兰邻居雷金纳德·德·格雷发生纠纷，于1400年引发全民族起义，同年9月被拥立为威尔士亲王。英格兰针对威尔士人的惩罚性法律加深了动荡，扩大了对起义的支持。到1404年他已控制威尔士大部，在马汉莱斯召开议会，并获得法国援助；1406年的《彭纳尔信》提出了兴建威尔士大学、恢复威尔士法律的计划。1409年哈莱克与阿伯里斯特威斯城堡陷落。他两次拒绝王室赦免，以游击战术继续抵抗，1412年后从史料中消失；他从未被俘，约1416年死于藏匿之中，后来成为威尔士的民间英雄。

en: Rhys ap Tudur (died 1412) was a Welsh nobleman of the Penmynydd family who twice served as sheriff of Anglesey under Richard II and joined the king's Irish expedition of 1398. In 1400 he backed his cousin Owain Glyndŵr's revolt against Henry IV. With his brother Gwilym he infiltrated and seized Conwy Castle in 1401, and later liaised with Henry Percy before Percy's 1403 rising. Outlawed in 1406, Rhys was captured and executed at Chester in 1412. The bard Gruffydd Gryg mourned his death in verse.
zh: 里斯·阿普·都铎（1412年卒）是彭迈尼德家族的威尔士贵族，曾在理查二世治下两度担任安格尔西郡长，并参加1398年国王的爱尔兰远征。1400年他支持表亲欧文·格林杜尔反抗亨利四世的起义。1401年，他与兄弟格威利姆潜入并夺取康威城堡，其后又在亨利·珀西1403年举事前与其联络。1406年他被宣布为法外之徒，1412年被俘并在切斯特处决。诗人格鲁菲兹·格里格曾赋诗哀悼他的死。

en: Tudur ap Goronwy, called Tudur Fychan (c. 1310–1367), was a Welsh landowner and royal officer on Anglesey, head of the Tudors of Penmynydd. He served Edward III in the French campaign of 1337. In 1345 he led the men who killed Henry Shalford, the Prince of Wales's representative in North Wales, near his brother Hywel's house in Bangor. Both brothers were jailed, Tudur at Chester, but released without charge and held their lands again by 1352. Buried at Llanfaes friary, he was mourned by the bard Iolo Goch. His son Maredudd was Owen Tudor's father.
zh: 都铎·阿普·戈伦韦，又称小都铎（约1310—约1367），是安格尔西岛的威尔士地主与王室官员，为彭迈尼德都铎家族的首领。1337年他随爱德华三世的英军出征法兰西。1345年，他率众在兄弟海韦尔位于班戈的住所附近杀死威尔士亲王在北威尔士的代表亨利·沙尔福德。兄弟二人均被下狱，都铎关在切斯特，但未被定罪即获释，1352年已重新保有祖传地产。他葬于兰法伊斯修道院，诗人约洛·戈赫曾作挽歌悼念。其子梅雷迪思是欧文·都铎之父。

en: Tudur Hen, also called Tudur ap Goronwy (died 1311), was a Welsh landowner of Penmynydd in Anglesey, son of Goronwy ab Ednyfed, seneschal of Gwynedd under Llywelyn ap Gruffudd. After Edward I conquered Wales he held lands granted by the English crown, yet joined the revolt of Madog ap Llywelyn in 1294 and submitted only after it failed. He restored the Franciscan friary at Bangor and was buried there on 11 October 1311. Through his son Goronwy he was an ancestor of Owen Tudor and of the royal House of Tudor.
zh: 老都铎，又称图德尔·阿普·戈伦韦（？—1311），是安格尔西岛彭米尼德的威尔士地主，父亲是格温内思王公卢埃林·阿普·格鲁菲德的宫廷总管戈伦韦·阿普·埃德纳韦德。爱德华一世征服威尔士后，他领有英格兰王室封赐的土地，却在1294年参加马多格·阿普·卢埃林的叛乱，直到失败后才归顺。他重修班戈的方济各会修道院，1311年10月11日安葬于此。通过其子戈伦韦，他是欧文·都铎以及都铎王室的先祖。

en: Frederick I (died 25 July 1365) was Count of Weimar-Orlamünde of the Ascanian line, son of Count Herman IV and lord of Weimar, Wiehe, Buch and Schönwerde. In 1322 he married Elisabeth, daughter of Friedrich Klemm and widow of Otto II of Anhalt. He was the last count to rule the county in his own right; his successor and brother Hermann VI held it as a fief of the Wettin margraves of Meissen. His children included Mechthild, wife of Count Henry the Elder of Hohnstein, and a son, Frederick III the Younger.
zh: 弗里德里希一世（1365年7月25日卒）是阿斯坎尼支系的魏玛-奥拉明德伯爵，伯爵赫尔曼四世之子，领有魏玛、维厄、布赫与申韦德。1322年，他娶弗里德里希·克莱姆之女、安哈尔特的奥托二世遗孀伊丽莎白为妻。他是最后一位自主统治该伯国的伯爵，继位的兄弟赫尔曼六世以迈森韦廷藩侯封臣的身份领有其地。他的子女包括嫁给霍恩施泰因伯爵老亨利的梅希蒂尔德，以及儿子小弗里德里希三世。

en: Frederick III the Younger (died after 1381) was the only son of Count Frederick I of Weimar-Orlamünde and his wife Elisabeth, widow of Otto II of Anhalt.
zh: 小弗里德里希三世（1381年后卒）是魏玛-奥拉明德伯爵弗里德里希一世与其妻、安哈尔特的奥托二世遗孀伊丽莎白的独子。

en: Helene of Nuremberg (c. 1307 – after 1374) was a Hohenzollern burgravine, the eldest daughter of Burgrave Frederick IV of Nuremberg and Margaret of Görz-Tyrol, and sister of Burgrave John II. About 1321 she married Count Otto of Weimar-Orlamünde, bearing him a son, Frederick of Orlamünde, and a daughter, also named Helene. After Otto's death she married, between 1341 and 1346, Count Henry of Schwarzburg-Blankenburg, by whom she had Henry and Sophie. Through both marriages she held the rank of countess.
zh: 海伦·冯·纽伦堡（约1307年—1374年后）是霍亨索伦家族的城堡伯爵之女，纽伦堡城堡伯爵腓特烈四世与戈里齐亚-蒂罗尔的玛格丽特的长女，也是城堡伯爵约翰二世的姐姐。约1321年，她嫁给魏玛-奥拉明德伯爵奥托，生有儿子奥拉明德的腓特烈和同名女儿海伦。奥托死后，她于1341至1346年间改嫁施瓦茨堡-布兰肯堡伯爵亨利，又生亨利和索菲。凭借两次婚姻，她都保有伯爵夫人身份。

en: Herman II (c. 1184–1247) was the youngest son of Siegfried III and Sophie of Denmark and ruled Weimar-Orlamünde jointly with his brother Albert II after 1206. His long feud with the Ludovingian landgraves of Thuringia went badly: Landgrave Herman I captured him at Weimar Castle in 1214, and Louis IV later took up arms against the brothers. Despite this pressure Herman refounded Weimar as a town and established the Cistercian nunnery at Oberweimar. He married Beatrix of Andechs-Merania, heiress of Plassenburg, and died on 27 December 1247.
zh: 赫尔曼二世（约1184—1247）是西格弗里德三世与丹麦的索菲的幼子，1206年后与兄长阿尔布雷希特二世共同统治魏玛-奥拉明德。他与图林根的卢道温格家族领地伯爵长期结仇，处境不利：1214年领地伯爵赫尔曼一世在魏玛城堡将他俘获，路德维希四世后来也对兄弟二人动兵。尽管压力不断，他仍把魏玛改建为城市，并创立上魏玛的西多会修女院。他娶普拉森堡的继承人安代克斯-梅拉尼亚的贝阿特丽克丝为妻，1247年12月27日去世。

en: Herman I (c. 1130–1176) founded the Weimar-Orlamünde branch of the House of Ascania, a son of Albert the Bear and Sophie of Winzenburg. During his father's lifetime he was entrusted with the family's administration in Thuringia, and he appears in documents as count from 1167. In his feud with Landgrave Louis III of Thuringia, Weimar Castle was destroyed in 1174. He died on 19 October 1176, and his son Siegfried III succeeded him.
zh: 赫尔曼一世（约1130—1176）是阿斯坎尼家族魏玛-奥拉明德支系的始祖，大熊阿尔布雷希特与温岑堡的索菲之子。父亲在世时，他即受命管理家族在图林根的事务，1167年起以伯爵身份见于文书。在与图林根领地伯爵路德维希三世的争斗中，魏玛城堡于1174年被毁。他于1176年10月19日去世，其子西格弗里德三世继位。

en: Herman IV, in another numbering Herman V (died 1319), was a count of Weimar-Orlamünde and a son of Otto III. After their father's death in 1285 he ruled the county jointly with his brother Otto IV and is documented as lord of Weimar and Schönwerde. In 1290 he married Mechthild, daughter of Count Frederick of Rabenswalde and Elisabeth of Mansfeld. Of his nine children his son Frederick followed him as count, while another son, John, became a Teutonic Order commander at Weimar. His epitaph is in the chapel of St. Elizabeth at Naumburg.
zh: 赫尔曼四世（另一种计数法作五世，？—1319）是魏玛-奥拉明德伯爵，奥托三世之子。1285年父亲死后，他与兄弟奥托四世共同治理伯国，文书中称魏玛和申韦德的领主。1290年他娶拉本斯瓦尔德伯爵腓特烈与曼斯费尔德的伊丽莎白之女梅希蒂尔德为妻。他共有九个子女，儿子腓特烈后来继任伯爵，另一子约翰则成为条顿骑士团魏玛辖区的司令官。他的墓志铭保存在瑙姆堡的伊丽莎白小堂。

en: Otto III, sometimes numbered Otto IV (1244–1285), was an Ascanian count of Weimar-Orlamünde, the son of Herman II and Beatrix of Andechs-Merania. In 1248 he and his elder brother Herman III inherited the Franconian estates of their maternal uncle, Otto II of Merania; the partition left Otto with Weimar, Rudolstadt and Plassenburg and Herman with Orlamünde. On 28 December 1279 he founded Himmelkron Abbey. He married Agnes of Truhendingen, died in June 1285 and was buried in the abbey's collegiate church.
zh: 奥托三世（部分计数法作奥托四世，1244—1285）是阿斯坎尼家族的魏玛-奥拉明德伯爵，赫尔曼二世与安代克斯-梅拉尼亚的贝阿特丽克丝之子。1248年，他与兄长赫尔曼三世继承了舅父梅拉尼亚的奥托二世在弗兰肯的领地；分家后奥托分得魏玛、鲁多尔施塔特和普拉森堡，赫尔曼分得奥拉明德。1279年12月28日他创立希默尔克龙修道院。他娶特鲁亨丁根的阿格尼丝为妻，1285年6月去世，葬于该院的协同教堂。

en: Otto IV, in some sources numbered Otto VI (born before 1279, died 1318), was count of Weimar-Orlamünde, the son of Otto III and Agnes of Truhendingen. Before 14 December 1296 he married Countess Adelaide of Käfernburg, who bore his heir, Otto VI. After her death he took a second wife in 1308, Catherine of Hesse, a daughter of Landgrave Henry I of Hesse; their daughter Elizabeth married Count Henry X of Schwarzburg. Otto died between 15 May and 20 August 1318.
zh: 奥托四世（部分史料作奥托六世，1279年前生，1318年卒）是魏玛-奥拉明德伯爵，奥托三世与特鲁亨丁根的阿格尼丝之子。1296年12月14日之前，他娶克费恩堡的伯爵小姐阿德尔海德为妻，继承人奥托六世即出自此婚。妻子死后，他于1308年续娶黑森领地伯爵亨利一世之女卡塔琳娜，女儿伊丽莎白后来嫁给施瓦茨堡伯爵亨利十世。奥托于1318年5月15日至8月20日之间去世。

en: Otto VI, also counted Otto VII (1297–1340), was the last Ascanian count of Weimar-Orlamünde at the Plassenburg, son of Count Otto IV and Adelheid of Kevernburg and grandson of Otto III, founder of Himmelkron Abbey. He married Kunigunde of Leuchtenberg, but the marriage remained childless; legend nevertheless made her the model of the Hohenzollern White Lady who killed her two children. In 1337 Otto made an inheritance agreement with Burgrave John of Nuremberg. By his death in 1340, he had borrowed four thousand pounds of hellers from John against the Plassenburg, which passed to the Hohenzollern burgraves.
zh: 奥托六世（又按另一计数法称奥托七世，1297—1340）是阿斯坎尼家族的魏玛-奥拉明德伯爵，也是普拉森堡的末代该家族伯爵，为伯爵奥托四世与克弗恩堡的阿德尔海德之子、希默尔克龙修道院创立者奥托三世之孙。他娶洛伊希滕贝格的库妮贡德为妻，但婚姻无子嗣；传说仍把她当作霍亨索伦家白衣夫人的原型，称她杀死了自己的两个孩子。1337年，奥托与纽伦堡城堡伯爵约翰订立继承协议。他于1340年去世时，已向约翰以普拉森堡为担保借得四千磅赫勒，城堡随后转入霍亨索伦家族的城堡伯爵之手。

en: Siegfried III (c. 1155–1206) ruled as count of Weimar-Orlamünde from 1172. The son of Herman I and grandson of Albert the Bear, he backed the Hohenstaufen emperors like his Ascanian kinsmen and stood with the princes against Henry the Lion until the Welf duke's overthrow in 1180. He married Sophie, a daughter of King Valdemar I of Denmark, and spent long periods at the Danish court. He died in 1206, leaving two sons, Albert II and Herman II.
zh: 西格弗里德三世（约1155—1206）自1172年起统治魏玛-奥拉明德伯国。他是赫尔曼一世之子、大熊阿尔布雷希特之孙，和阿斯坎尼家族的其他亲属一样支持霍亨斯陶芬皇朝的皇帝，与众诸侯共同敌对狮子亨利，直到1180年这位韦尔夫公爵被推翻。他娶丹麦国王瓦尔德马一世之女索菲为妻，并曾长期居留丹麦。他于1206年去世，留下阿尔布雷希特二世与赫尔曼二世两子。

en: Barnim IV (1325 – 22 August 1365) was a duke of Pomerania-Wolgast from the House of Griffin, the second son of Duke Wartislaw IV. He was barely a year old when his father died in 1326, and he and his brothers Bogislaw V and Wartislaw V ruled jointly, first under guardianship and from 1341 in person. In 1348 Emperor Charles IV granted him imperial immediacy. He married Sophie of Werle, daughter of John II of Werle; their sons Wartislaw VI and Bogislaw VI took part in the 1368 partition of Pomerania-Wolgast after his death.
zh: 巴尔尼姆四世（1325—1365年8月22日）是格里芬家族的波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特公爵，为瓦尔齐斯瓦夫四世的次子。1326年父亲去世时他年仅一岁，与兄长博吉斯拉夫五世、弟弟瓦尔齐斯瓦夫五世共治公国，初由监护人摄政，1341年起亲政。1348年，皇帝查理四世授予他帝国直辖地位。他娶瓦尔勒领主约翰二世之女索菲为妻，两人的儿子瓦尔齐斯瓦夫六世与博吉斯拉夫六世在他死后参与了1368年对波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特的分割。

en: Bogislaw V (c. 1318 – 23 April 1374), called the Great, was the eldest son of Duke Wartislaw IV of Pomerania-Wolgast. He and his brothers Barnim IV and Wartislaw V succeeded in 1326 and, from 1341, ruled jointly. In 1343 he married Elisabeth, daughter of Casimir III of Poland, allying with Poland against the Teutonic Order, and in 1362 he married Adelheid of Brunswick-Grubenhagen. His daughter Elisabeth became the wife of Emperor Charles IV in 1363. The 1368 partition after Barnim's death gave Bogislaw Farther Pomerania around Stolp, now Słupsk, thereafter Pomerania-Stolp.
zh: 博吉斯拉夫五世（约1318—1374年4月23日），人称“大帝”，是波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特公爵瓦尔齐斯瓦夫四世的长子。1326年父亲去世后，他与弟弟巴尔尼姆四世、瓦尔齐斯瓦夫五世一同继位，自1341年起共同亲政。1343年，他迎娶波兰国王卡齐米日三世之女伊丽莎白，与波兰结盟对抗条顿骑士团；1362年续娶不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的阿德尔海德。他的女儿伊丽莎白于1363年嫁给皇帝查理四世。1368年，巴尔尼姆死后的领地分割使博吉斯拉夫获得斯武普斯克一带的后波美拉尼亚，即后来的波美拉尼亚-斯武普斯克。

en: Borko of Łobez (Polish Borko z Łobza, died probably 1287) was a Pomeranian magnate of the Slavic noble house of Borcke and served as castellan of Kołobrzeg from 1251 to 1255. Before 1271 he came to the lands along the middle Rega with his sons John, James and Nicholas. The family settled the region, whose lands were probably granted by Duke Barnim I. Between 1260 and 1270 James commissioned a castle on the Rega at Resko. In 1280 Borko and his sons established Resko under Magdeburg law.
zh: 沃贝兹的博尔科（波兰语作博尔科·兹·沃布扎，约1287年卒）出身斯拉夫渊源的波美拉尼亚博尔克贵族家族，1251至1255年担任科沃布热克城督。1271年之前，他与儿子约翰、雅各布和尼古劳斯来到雷加河中游地区。家族在此开拓定居，这些土地可能由巴尔尼姆一世公爵赐予。1260至1270年间，雅各布在雷斯科的雷加河畔建造城堡。1280年，博尔科与儿子们按照马格德堡法建立雷斯科城镇。

en: Jakobus (Jakob Borke) was a member of the old Pomeranian noble family von Borcke. A charter of 1338 names him among the Borcke kinsmen appearing with the old knight Borke in Farther Pomerania.
zh: 雅各布斯（雅各布·博尔克）出身波美拉尼亚古老的博尔克贵族家族。1338年的一份文书把他与老骑士博尔克等家族成员并列，记载为在后波美拉尼亚活动的博尔克族人。

en: Wartislaw IV (before 1290–1326), the only son of Bogislaw IV, succeeded as duke of Pomerania-Wolgast in 1309. In 1317 Margrave Waldemar of Brandenburg-Stendal enfeoffed him with the lands of Schlawe and Stolp. After Waldemar died in 1319 Wartislaw became guardian of the young heir Henry II and sought control of Brandenburg, until Emperor Louis IV granted the margraviate to his own son in 1323. An inheritance treaty with his uncle Wizlaw III of Rügen in 1321 brought the Rügen principality to Wolgast in 1325, sparking a succession war with Mecklenburg that ended only in 1328, after Wartislaw's death.
zh: 瓦季斯瓦夫四世（1290年前—1326）是波吉斯瓦夫四世的独子，1309年继位为波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特公爵。1317年，勃兰登堡-施滕达尔藩侯瓦尔德马将施拉韦和斯武普斯克两地封给他。1319年瓦尔德马死后，他成为年幼继承人亨利二世的监护人，试图掌控勃兰登堡，但皇帝路易四世于1323年将该藩侯国封给了自己的儿子。1321年他与舅父吕根亲王维茨拉夫三世签订继承条约，1325年吕根亲王国并入沃尔加斯特，由此引发与梅克伦堡的继承战争；战争直到他死后的1328年才结束。

en: Wartislaw V (c. 1 November 1326 – 1390) was the youngest, posthumous son of Duke Wartislaw IV of Pomerania-Wolgast, born months after his father's death on 1 August 1326. From 1341 he ruled jointly with his brothers Bogislaw V and Barnim IV, but always stood in their shadow. After Barnim died in 1365, the succession quarrel drew in Emperor Charles IV and ended in civil war; the settlements of 1368 and 1372 left Wartislaw with the Land of Neustettin, now Szczecinek. He died unmarried in 1390 and was probably buried at Pudagla monastery.
zh: 瓦尔齐斯瓦夫五世（约1326年11月1日—1390）是波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特公爵瓦尔齐斯瓦夫四世的遗腹子和最年幼的儿子，在父亲于1326年8月1日去世数月后出生。自1341年起，他与兄长博吉斯拉夫五世、巴尔尼姆四世共同执政，但始终处在两位兄长的阴影之下。1365年巴尔尼姆死后，继承权之争演变为内战，皇帝查理四世也介入调停；1368年和1372年的分割使瓦尔齐斯瓦夫分得诺伊施泰丁（今什切青内克）领地。他于1390年去世，终身未娶，可能葬于普达格拉修道院。

en: Matthias Gallas (1588–1647), Count of Campo and Duke of Lucera, was born in Trento and first served Spain and the Catholic League, fighting at Stadtlohn in 1623. In the War of the Mantuan Succession he won at Villabuona and sacked Mantua in 1630, then became one of Wallenstein's foremost generals and helped engineer Wallenstein's removal in 1634. Chief architect of the Imperial victory at Nördlingen later that year, he three times served as acting supreme commander. In 1637 he drove the Swedes back to the Baltic coast, but in 1644 they cut off his supplies and he lost almost his entire army. He died in Vienna in April 1647 after a failed operation.
zh: 马蒂亚斯·加拉斯（1588—1647），坎波伯爵、卢切拉公爵，生于特伦托，早年先后为西班牙和天主教联盟作战，参加了1623年的施塔特洛恩战役。曼图亚继承战争期间，他于1630年在维拉布奥纳获胜并纵兵洗劫曼图亚，此后成为华伦斯坦麾下最重要的将领之一，参与策划了1634年罢黜华伦斯坦的行动。同年，他是帝国军在讷德林根取胜的主要谋划者之一，此后曾三次代理帝国军队最高统帅。1637年他将瑞典军队逼退至波罗的海沿岸；1644年瑞军却切断他的补给，他几乎损失了整支军队。1647年4月，他在维也纳因手术失败去世。

en: Ottavio Piccolomini (1599–1656), of the Sienese Piccolomini, kinsmen of Popes Pius II and III, enlisted as a Spanish pikeman and rose to imperial field marshal in the Thirty Years' War. He fought at the White Mountain in 1620 and became captain of Wallenstein's personal guard in 1627. During the Mantuan War he served as soldier and diplomat, and was held hostage at Ferrara until 1631 to guarantee the peace. At Lützen in 1632 five horses were shot under him; he helped overthrow Wallenstein in 1634. He earned his marshal's baton at Nördlingen, defeated the French at Thionville in 1639 and became Duke of Amalfi, and in 1648 took command and helped negotiate the peace at Westphalia. He died in Vienna in August 1656 after falling from a horse.
zh: 奥塔维奥·皮科洛米尼（1599—1656）出身锡耶纳的皮科洛米尼家族，与教皇庇护二世、庇护三世同族。他少年时加入西班牙军队当长矛兵，后在三十年战争中官至帝国陆军元帅。他参加了1620年的白山战役，1627年成为华伦斯坦的亲卫队长。曼图亚战争期间，他兼任军人与外交官，后为保证和约在费拉拉被扣为人质，直至1631年。1632年他在吕岑奋战，座骑五次被击毙；1634年参与推翻华伦斯坦的密谋。他在讷德林根赢得元帅权杖，1639年在蒂永维尔击败法军，受封阿马尔菲公爵；1648年出任军队总司令并参与斡旋威斯特伐利亚和约。1656年8月他在维也纳坠马后去世。

en: Albrecht von Wallenstein (1583–1634) was a Bohemian nobleman who became supreme commander of Emperor Ferdinand II's armies in the Thirty Years' War after converting to Catholicism in 1606. Marriage to a wealthy widow brought him substantial estates, and he acquired lands confiscated from the defeated Bohemian rebels. In 1625 he raised an army of fifty thousand men at his own expense, routed the Protestants at the Dessau Bridge in 1626, and was made Duke of Friedland. Dismissed in 1630, he was recalled after Swedish victories and checked Gustavus Adolphus at the Alte Veste in 1632. Secret peace talks in 1633 led the emperor to brand him a traitor, and on 25 February 1634 he was murdered at Eger.
zh: 阿尔布雷希特·冯·华伦斯坦（1583—1634）是波希米亚贵族，1606年改宗天主教，后成为神圣罗马帝国皇帝斐迪南二世军队的最高统帅，是三十年战争中的核心人物。他与一位富有的寡妇结婚，得到大批地产，又获得从战败的波希米亚叛军手中没收的土地。1625年他自筹军费组建了一支五万人的大军，1626年在德绍桥击溃新教军队，受封弗里德兰公爵。1630年他被解职，在瑞典接连取胜后又被起用，1632年在阿尔特韦斯特阻击古斯塔夫二世。1633年他秘密议和，被皇帝宣布为叛贼，1634年2月25日在埃格尔遇刺身亡。

en: Bernard II (c. 1320–1382) was the youngest son of John II, Lord of Werle-Güstrow, and Matilda of Brunswick-Grubenhagen. After their father's death in 1337 his elder brother Nicholas III ruled alone, but from 1339 to 1347 the brothers governed Werle jointly. By the partition of 14 July 1347 Bernard received Werle-Waren, which he ruled until his death. In 1341 he married Elisabeth, daughter of John the Mild of Holstein-Plön. When John IV of Werle-Goldberg died in 1374, Bernard also took over that lordship, joining Werle-Waren and Werle-Goldberg under his hand. He is last attested alive on 16 January 1382.
zh: 贝尔纳德二世（约1320—1382）是维尔勒-居斯特罗领主约翰二世与不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根的玛蒂尔德的幼子。1337年父亲去世后，兄长尼古拉三世先独自统治，1339至1347年间兄弟二人共同执政。1347年7月14日瓜分领地，贝尔纳德获得维尔勒-瓦伦并统治至终。1341年，他娶荷尔斯泰因-普伦的“温和者”约翰之女伊丽莎白为妻。1374年维尔勒-戈尔德贝格领主约翰四世去世，贝尔纳德又接管该领地，将维尔勒-瓦伦与维尔勒-戈尔德贝格合于一手。1382年1月16日是他最后一次被记载为在世。

en: Adelheid of Wittgenstein (died between 1357 and 1362) was the daughter of Count Siegfried III of Wittgenstein and Margareta von Schönecken. In 1359 her brother Count Werner IV and then her father died, ending the male line of the Wittgenstein counts and leaving Adelheid as heiress of the county. She was married to Salentin von Sayn-Homburg, who took possession of Wittgenstein in 1361 and founded the House of Sayn-Wittgenstein. Her son John IV later ruled the county.
zh: 阿德莱德·冯·维特根斯坦（？—1357至1362年间）是维特根斯坦伯爵西格弗里德三世与玛加丽塔·冯·舍内肯之女。1359年，她的兄弟维尔纳四世与父亲先后去世，维特根斯坦伯爵家族男嗣断绝，她成为伯国的女继承人。她嫁给赛恩-霍姆堡的萨伦廷，后者于1361年取得维特根斯坦伯国，开创赛恩-维特根斯坦家族。她的儿子约翰四世后来统治该伯国。

en: Siegfried II of Wittgenstein (died c. 1360) ruled the County of Wittgenstein from 1312 and was a sought-after mediator between Hesse, the archbishops of Mainz and the Nassau counts. In 1319 he married Margarethe von Schöneck; in 1322 he gained a share in Berleburg and entered the fief service of Mainz. He joined King John of Bohemia's Prussian campaign in 1337 and enlarged his county with estates such as Merenberg and Girkhausen. His only son Werner IV died childless before him, so the county passed through his daughter Adelheid, wife of Salentin von Sayn, founding the House of Sayn-Wittgenstein.
zh: 维特根斯坦的西格弗里德二世（约1360年去世）自1312年起统治维特根斯坦伯国，是黑森、美因茨大主教与拿骚诸伯之间抢手的调停人。1319年他娶玛加丽特·冯·舍内克为妻；1322年取得贝勒堡的份额，并成为美因茨大主教的封臣。1337年他随波希米亚国王约翰参加征讨普鲁士的远征，又通过取得梅伦贝格、格克豪森等地产扩大了伯国。他唯一的儿子维尔纳四世先他而死且无子嗣，伯国遂经女儿阿德尔海德——萨伦丁·冯·赛恩之妻——转手，由此开创赛恩-维特根斯坦家族。

en: Widekind III was a count of Wittgenstein of the House of Battenberg, the son of Count Siegfried I and Ida of Arnsberg-Rietberg. His sister Irmgard served as abbess of Essen and later of Herford. He ruled from Wittgenstein Castle above Laasphe, and in 1295 he entered a fief relationship with the Archbishop of Cologne.
zh: 维德金德三世是维特根施泰因伯爵，出身巴滕贝格家族，为齐格弗里德一世伯爵与阿恩斯贝格-里特贝格的伊达之子。他的姐妹伊尔姆加德先后担任埃森和黑尔福德的女修院院长。他驻跸拉斯佩上方的维特根施泰因城堡执政，1295年与科隆大主教建立封君封臣关系。

en: Werner IV of Wittgenstein was the only son of Count Siegfried II and Margarethe von Schöneck. He remained childless and probably died before his father around 1359, so the County of Wittgenstein passed to his sister Adelheid, wife of Salentin von Sayn.
zh: 维特根斯坦的维尔纳四世是伯爵西格弗里德二世与玛加丽特·冯·舍内克的独子。他没有留下子嗣，约1359年时可能已先于父亲去世，维特根斯坦伯国因此由他的姊妹阿德尔海德——萨伦丁·冯·赛恩之妻——继承。

en: Eberhard II the Quarrelsome (1315–1392), eldest son of Ulrich III and Sophie of Pfirt, was Count of Württemberg from 1344. He and his brother Ulrich IV ruled jointly until Eberhard defeated his push to partition the county; Ulrich renounced power on 1 May 1362. Eberhard spent his reign fighting the Swabian Free Imperial Cities, with battles at Altheim in 1372, Reutlingen in 1377 and Döffingen in 1388, where his son Ulrich was killed. The wars confirmed the independence of the cities, yet he added Böblingen and Calw to Württemberg. He died in Stuttgart on 15 March 1392.
zh: 埃伯哈德二世（1315—1392），绰号“争吵者”，是乌尔里希三世与普菲尔茨的索菲的长子，1344年起任符腾堡伯爵。他先与弟弟乌尔里希四世共同执政，乌尔里希要求瓜分伯国未果，于1362年5月1日放弃权位。埃伯哈德在位期间长期与施瓦本的帝国自由城市作战，经历1372年阿尔特海姆、1377年罗伊特林根和1388年德芬根诸役，他的儿子乌尔里希在德芬根战死。战争虽确认了城市的独立地位，他仍为符腾堡夺得伯布林根和卡尔夫。1392年3月15日，他卒于斯图加特。

en: Eberhard I (1265–1325), posthumous son of Count Ulrich I, was born in Stuttgart and succeeded his half-brother Ulrich II as count of Württemberg in 1279, ruling personally from 1280. He resisted King Rudolph I's attempt to rebuild the Duchy of Swabia and defeated the Hohenbergs after 1291. In 1298 King Albert I made him vogt of Lower Swabia, which he used to entrench his holdings, and after the 1314 double election he played Louis IV and Frederick the Fair off against each other to buy up Swabian towns. He made Stuttgart his capital and was buried in its Stiftskirche.
zh: 埃伯哈德一世（1265—1325）生于斯图加特，出生时父亲乌尔里希一世已去世。1279年他继异母兄乌尔里希二世之后成为符腾堡伯爵，1280年开始亲政。他抵制国王鲁道夫一世重建施瓦本公国的企图，1291年鲁道夫死后对霍亨贝格家族作战获胜。1298年，国王阿尔布雷希特一世任命他为下施瓦本地方长官，他借这一职务巩固领地。1314年双重国王选举后，他在路易四世与美男子腓特烈之间周旋，借机购入施瓦本的城镇。他定斯图加特为都城，死后葬于当地的协同教堂。

en: Sophie of Pfirt (died 25 March 1344), daughter of Count Theobald I of Pfirt in Alsace, married Ulrich III, Count of Württemberg. Her sons Eberhard II and Ulrich IV succeeded their father in 1344.
zh: 索菲·冯·普菲尔茨（？—1344年）是阿尔萨斯的普菲尔茨伯爵特奥巴尔德一世之女，嫁给符腾堡伯爵乌尔里希三世。她的儿子埃伯哈德二世与乌尔里希四世于1344年继承父位。

en: Ulrich III (1286/1291–1344) was Count of Württemberg from 1325 until his death. He negotiated a treaty with King Frederick the Fair in 1319 and steered Württemberg through the rivalry between Frederick and Emperor Louis IV, binding the county closely to the Empire. Through pacts and purchases he enlarged his lands, notably acquiring Markgröningen in 1336 and Tübingen in 1342 together with gains in Alsace. He married Sophie of Pfirt and died on 11 July 1344 in Alsace, buried in the Stiftskirche in Stuttgart; his sons Eberhard II and Ulrich IV succeeded him.
zh: 乌尔里希三世（1286/1291—1344）自1325年起担任符腾堡伯爵，直至去世。他于1319年与国王“美男子”腓特烈缔约，并在腓特烈与皇帝路易四世的争斗中周旋，使符腾堡与帝国紧密结盟。他通过盟约与购地扩张领地，最著名的是1336年取得马克格勒宁根、1342年取得蒂宾根，并在阿尔萨斯有所斩获。他娶普菲尔茨的索菲为妻，1344年7月11日卒于阿尔萨斯，葬于斯图加特修道院教堂，由儿子埃伯哈德二世与乌尔里希四世继位。

en: Ulrich IV (after 1315–1366) was Count of Württemberg in name from 1344, ruling jointly with his elder brother Eberhard II after the death of their father Ulrich III. Overshadowed by the more forceful Eberhard, he pressed from 1352 to divide the county, possibly at the urging of his wife Katharina of Helfenstein, whom he married before 1350. Emperor Charles IV instead backed Eberhard and confirmed Württemberg indivisible, and Ulrich renounced the government on 1 May 1362 in return for castles including Hohenneuffen. He died there, childless, on 24 or 26 July 1366.
zh: 乌尔里希四世（1315年后—1366）在父亲乌尔里希三世于1344年去世后，名义上与兄长埃伯哈德二世共同担任符腾堡伯爵。他在强势的兄长面前相形见绌，自1352年起谋求瓜分伯国，这或许是受妻子黑尔芬施泰因的卡塔琳娜（两人1350年前成婚）怂恿。皇帝查理四世却支持埃伯哈德，确认符腾堡不可分割；乌尔里希遂于1362年5月1日退出执政，换取霍恩诺伊芬等城堡。1366年7月24或26日，他在霍恩诺伊芬城堡去世，没有子嗣。

en: Ulrich of Württemberg (died 1 November 1315) was the eldest son of Count Eberhard I and a half-brother of Count Ulrich III. He married Mechthild of Hohenberg, had a daughter Agnes, and died before his father.
zh: 符腾堡的乌尔里希（1315年11月1日卒）是埃伯哈德一世伯爵的长子、乌尔里希三世的异母兄，娶霍亨贝格的梅希蒂尔德，生有一女阿格妮丝，先于父亲而死。

en: Zhang Shicheng (1321–1367), born Zhang Jiusi, was a salt smuggler from northern Jiangsu and a chief rival of Zhu Yuanzhang. In 1353 he led his fellow salt workers in revolt against oppressive government, taking Taizhou and Gaoyou, and in 1354 proclaimed the state of Zhou with the era name Tianyou. He also took Yangzhou, a salt-trading centre on the Grand Canal. In 1356 he seized Suzhou as his capital and ruled the wealthy, salt-rich Yangtze delta, a major grain-producing region. In 1357 he accepted Yuan titles and shipped grain north; in 1363 he declared himself King of Wu. Zhu's army took Suzhou in October 1367 after a ten-month siege; captured, Zhang died in Nanjing.
zh: 张士诚（1321—1367），原名张九四，苏北盐贩出身，是朱元璋的主要对手之一。1353年，他率领盐工反抗官府压迫，连下泰州、高邮；1354年建立周国，年号天佑。他还攻占了大运河上的盐业重镇扬州。1356年，他攻取苏州并定都于此，统治富庶而盛产食盐的长江三角洲，这里也是重要的产粮区。1357年他接受元朝封号，由海路向北方运粮；1363年自称吴王。朱元璋的大军围攻十个月，于1367年十月攻破苏州；张士诚被俘，死于南京。

en: David Fyodorovich was prince of Yaroslavl from 1299 until his death in 1321, a son of Prince Fyodor Rostislavich the Black. The Russian Orthodox Church venerates him among the pious princes: his relics, with those of his father and his brother Konstantin, were discovered under the last ruling prince of Yaroslavl and laid in the Spassky Monastery. He divided his lands between his sons Vasily, called the Terrible, who took Yaroslavl, and Mikhail, who received Mologa.
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ダヴィド・フョードロヴィチ
zh: 大卫·费奥多罗维奇是雅罗斯拉夫尔王公，1299年至1321年去世时在位，为费奥多尔·罗斯季斯拉维奇（绰号“黑人”）之子。俄罗斯正教会将他尊为虔诚王公圣徒：他的遗骨与父亲及弟弟康斯坦丁的遗骨在雅罗斯拉夫尔末代当政王公时期被一同发现，安奉于雅罗斯拉夫尔的救世主修道院。他把封邑分给两个儿子：绰号“威严者”的瓦西里得到雅罗斯拉夫尔，米哈伊尔分得莫洛加。

en: Fyodor Rostislavich, called the Black (1233–1299), was the third son of Rostislav Mstislavich and prince of Smolensk and Yaroslavl. Around 1260 he married the Yaroslavl princess Anastasia, and later, after her death, a khan's daughter at the Golden Horde, returning with a yarlyk to rule Yaroslavl. He fought with the Horde against the Yasses in 1277–1278 and took Smolensk in 1279. He joined the 1293 Tatar raid under Dyuden that ravaged fourteen northeastern Rus cities. He died a monk at Yaroslavl in 1299 and was canonized in 1467 with his sons David and Konstantin, the first Yaroslavl saints.
zh: 费奥多尔·罗斯季斯拉维奇，绰号“黑者”（1233—1299），是罗斯季斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇的第三子，曾任斯摩棱斯克与雅罗斯拉夫尔王公。约1260年他娶雅罗斯拉夫尔公主阿纳斯塔西娅，后来妻子去世，他在金帐汗国续娶汗王之女，带着汗王的敕书返回雅罗斯拉夫尔执政。1277—1278年他随汗国出征雅西人，1279年取得斯摩棱斯克。1293年他参加金帐汗国将领图丹统率的入侵，东北罗斯十四座城市遭劫掠。1299年他在雅罗斯拉夫尔出家修行后去世；1467年他与儿子达维德、康斯坦丁一同被封圣，是雅罗斯拉夫尔最早的圣徒。

en: Vasily Davidovich, called the Fearsome Eyes, ruled as Prince of Yaroslavl from 1321 until he died in the winter of 1345, succeeding his father David Fyodorovich. After marrying Yevdokiya, daughter of Ivan Kalita of Moscow, in 1330, he nonetheless rejected the overlordship of Moscow and styled himself grand prince of Yaroslavl. In 1339 he fought off a five-hundred-man detachment Kalita sent to seize him en route to the Golden Horde. In 1340 the khan awarded the grand princely title to Simeon of Moscow, and Vasily had to submit; after his death Yaroslavl fragmented into appanages under Muscovite control.
zh: 瓦西里·达维多维奇，绰号“怒目”，1321年继父达维德·费奥多罗维奇之后成为雅罗斯拉夫尔王公，直至1345年冬去世。1330年，他娶莫斯科王公伊凡·卡利塔之女叶夫多基娅为妻，却拒不承认莫斯科的宗主权，自称雅罗斯拉夫尔大公。1339年，他在前往金帐汗国途中击退卡利塔派来抓捕他的五百人队伍。1340年，汗将大公之号封给莫斯科的谢苗，瓦西里被迫臣服。他死后，雅罗斯拉夫尔分裂为众多小领地，落入莫斯科的控制之下。

en: Yevdokiya Ivanovna (died 1342) was a daughter of Ivan I Kalita, prince of Moscow, and his first wife Helena of Smolensk. In 1330 her father gave her in marriage to Vasily Davidovich, the prince of Yaroslavl known as the Fearsome Eyes. The match did not win Kalita a loyal vassal: Vasily continued to challenge Moscow for years. Yevdokiya bore him three sons, Vasily, Gleb and Roman, and died in 1342, three years before her husband.
zh: 叶夫多基娅·伊万诺夫娜（？—1342）是莫斯科王公伊凡一世·卡利塔与首任妻子斯摩棱斯克的叶莲娜之女。1330年，父亲将她嫁给雅罗斯拉夫尔王公、绰号“怒目”的瓦西里·达维多维奇。这场联姻并未为卡利塔换来忠顺的附庸，瓦西里此后仍长年与莫斯科抗衡。叶夫多基娅为他生下瓦西里、格列布、罗曼三个儿子，于1342年去世，比丈夫早逝三年。

en: Ranganadha Yadavaraya was a ruler of the Yadavaraya dynasty of the Chandragiri region near Tirupati. An inscription on a Tirumala temple records his sixteenth regnal year in 1354–1355, and another of his inscriptions records a gift to a monastery at Thiruvottriyur.
zh: 兰伽那陀·亚达瓦拉亚是蒂鲁帕蒂附近钱德拉吉里地区亚达瓦拉亚王朝的统治者。蒂鲁马拉一座神庙的铭文载有其在位第十六年，即1354—1355年；他的另一则铭文记载了向蒂鲁沃特里尤尔一座寺院的施舍。

en: Al-Afdal al-Abbas (r. 1363–1377) was a Rasulid sultan of Yemen who succeeded his father al-Mujahid Ali. He moved against extortion by port officials: wintering in Aden, he gave robes of honour to ship captains and abolished new levies imposed by tax collectors, and merchants spread word of his justice across the Indian Ocean. A scholar-ruler, he compiled a multilingual dictionary defining terms in Arabic, Persian, Turkic, Greek, Armenian and Mongolian. He died in 1377 and was followed by his son al-Ashraf Isma'il.
zh: 阿夫达尔·阿拔斯（1363—1377年在位）是也门拉苏尔王朝苏丹，1363年继承父亲穆贾希德·阿里。他整治港口官吏的勒索：在亚丁过冬时，他向船长赐予礼服、废除税吏新设的捐税，商人遂把他的公正传遍印度洋沿岸。他又是学者型君主，曾编纂多语辞典，用阿拉伯语、波斯语、突厥语、希腊语、亚美尼亚语和蒙古语解释词条。1377年他去世后，儿子阿什拉夫·伊斯玛仪继位。

en: Al-Malik al-Ashraf Umar II (c. 1242–1296) was the third Rasulid sultan of Yemen and a scholar of mathematics, astronomy, agriculture, veterinary science and medicine. The eldest son of al-Muzaffar Yusuf I, he led a raid on Hajjah in 1266, governed the family lands at al-Mahjam and was put in charge of the highland city of Sanaa. He succeeded his father in 1295 but reigned for only 21 months before his death in 1296, leaving the throne to his younger brother al-Mu'ayyad Da'ud.
zh: 阿什拉夫·欧麦尔二世（约1242—1296）是也门拉苏尔王朝第三任苏丹，兼通数学、天文、农学、兽医与医学。他是穆扎法尔·优素福一世的长子，1266年领兵攻打哈杰，后出掌家族在迈赫杰姆的封地，并受命统辖高原名城萨那。1295年父亲去世后继位，但仅在位21个月，便于1296年去世，王位传给其弟穆艾亚德·达乌德。

en: Al-Mansur Umar, born Umar ibn Ali ibn Rasul, founded the Rasulid Sultanate of Yemen. In 1229 the last Ayyubid prince al-Mas'ud left the country and entrusted him with its government. He first ruled in the Ayyubids' name, but in 1235 the Abbasid caliph recognized him as sultan under the title al-Malik al-Mansur. Coins were struck and Friday prayers said for him across Yemen. From Ta'izz he campaigned into the Hijaz, took Mecca and extended his sway toward Hadhramaut, and built madrasas and mosques. In 1249 he was killed by his own mamluks at al-Janad and succeeded by his son Yusuf.
zh: 曼苏尔·欧麦尔原名欧麦尔·伊本·阿里·伊本·拉苏尔，是也门拉苏尔苏丹国的缔造者。1229年，也门末代阿尤布王公迈斯欧德离开也门，把政务托付给他。他起初以阿尤布王朝的名义统治，1235年获阿拔斯哈里发的敕书，承认为苏丹，上尊号“马利克·曼苏尔”。也门全境以他的名义铸币，并在周五聚礼中为他祈祷。他以塔伊兹为都城出兵汉志，攻占麦加，势力一直延伸到哈德拉毛，并修建了多所宗教学校和清真寺。1249年，他在贾纳德被自己的马穆鲁克杀害，其子优素福继位。

en: Al-Malik al-Mu'ayyad Da'ud ibn Yusuf was the fourth Rasulid sultan of Yemen. A younger son of al-Muzaffar Yusuf I, he came to the throne in 1296 after the death of his brother al-Ashraf Umar II and ruled until 1321. Two daughters of Umar II were married to sons of Da'ud, binding the two branches of the ruling house. On his death in 1321 he was succeeded by his own son.
zh: 穆艾亚德·达乌德·本·优素福是也门拉苏尔王朝第四任苏丹，穆扎法尔·优素福一世之子。1296年其兄阿什拉夫·欧麦尔二世去世后，他登上王位，统治至1321年。欧麦尔二世的两个女儿分别嫁给达乌德的儿子，王室两支由此结为姻亲。1321年达乌德去世，由其子继位。

en: Al-Mujahid Ali ibn Dawud was the fifth sultan of the Rasulid dynasty of Yemen, ruling from 1321 to 1363 after his father al-Mu'ayyad Dawud. His long reign saw the Zaydi imams seize Sanaa in 1324, confining Rasulid power to the southern highlands and the Tihamah. In 1350, while on pilgrimage at Mecca, he was seized by the Egyptian Mamluks and held captive in Egypt for a year. He reformed taxation by assessing land tax on the average yield of several years. He died in 1363 and was succeeded by his son al-Afdal Abbas.
zh: 穆贾希德·阿里·本·达乌德是也门拉苏尔王朝第五位苏丹，1321年继父穆艾耶德·达乌德之位，统治至1363年。在他漫长的统治期内，宰德派伊玛目于1324年夺取萨那，拉苏尔政权被压缩到南部高原与帖哈麦低地。1350年，他在麦加朝觐时被埃及马穆鲁克人俘获，押往埃及囚禁一年。他推行税制改革，按数年的平均产量核定土地税。1363年他去世，由儿子阿夫达勒·阿拔斯继位。

en: Al-Malik al-Muzaffar Yusuf I (1222–1295) was the second Rasulid sultan of Yemen. Born in Mecca, he succeeded his assassinated father al-Mansur Umar at Zabid in 1249. During his 46-year reign the sultanate reached its apogee: he secured the Tihamah and the southern highlands, repeatedly defeated the Zaydi imams and briefly occupied Sanaa, and made Taiz a second royal seat. He built Red Sea trade with India and China, and after the Mongol fall of Baghdad in 1258 laid claim to the caliphal title through his hold on Mecca. His son Umar II succeeded him.
zh: 穆扎法尔·优素福一世（1222—1295）是也门拉苏尔王朝第二任苏丹，生于麦加，1249年其父曼苏尔·欧麦尔遇刺后在宰比德继位。他在位46年，王朝臻于鼎盛：他控制提哈迈低地与南部高原，屡次击败栽德派伊玛目并一度占领萨那，又以塔伊兹为另一座都城。他在红海发展同印度和中国的贸易；1258年蒙古人攻陷巴格达后，他凭对麦加的控制自称哈里发。其子欧麦尔二世继位。

en: Yesugei (c. 1134–1171), called Baghatur, was a Borjigin chieftain of the Khamag Mongol confederation and father of Genghis Khan. A grandson of Khabul Khan through Bartan Baghatur, he ruled the confederation in all but name after Hotula Khan died. With his brothers he abducted Hö'elün from her Merkit husband Chiledu; she bore Temüjin, Qasar, Hachiun and Temüge. He helped his blood-brother Toghrul defeat his uncle Gurkhan. In 1171, after betrothing the nine-year-old Temüjin to Börte of the Khongirad, Tatars poisoned him at a wayside feast, and he died at home three days later.
zh: 也速该（约1134—1171），号称把阿秃儿，是蒙古孛儿只斤氏贵族、合不勒汗之孙（父为把儿坛把阿秃儿），也是成吉思汗之父。忽图剌汗死后，他虽未称汗，却实际统领合木黑蒙古诸部。他在兄弟帮助下从蔑儿乞人赤列都手中劫走诃额仑，后者生下铁木真、合撒儿、合赤温、铁木哥。他曾助安答脱斡邻勒击败其叔父古尔汗。1171年，他为九岁的铁木真与弘吉剌部的孛儿帖订下婚约，归途中塔塔尔人在宴席上对他下毒，他回家三天后死去。

en: Yesün Temür (1293–1328), the Taiding Emperor, was the son of Gammala and a great-grandson of Kublai Khan. In 1302 he succeeded his father as Prince of Jin on the Mongolian steppe. After the 1323 Nanpo coup killed Emperor Yingzong, he was enthroned on the Kherlen River that October and then executed the conspirators who had elevated him. He honoured Confucianism publicly while entrusting government to Muslim and steppe officials, reorganized the provinces into eighteen departments and barred Tibetan lamas from China proper. He died at Shangdu in August 1328; his young son Ragibagh was overthrown within months.
zh: 也孙铁木儿（1293—1328），即泰定帝，甘麻剌之子、忽必烈曾孙。1302年他在蒙古草原袭封晋王。1323年南坡之变中元英宗遇弑，他于当年十月在克鲁伦河畔即位，随后又处死了拥戴他上台的弑君者。他表面尊崇儒学，实际政务多委付穆斯林与草原出身的大臣，将全国划为十八道，并禁止吐蕃僧人进入汉地。1328年8月他死于上都，幼子阿剌吉八继位后仅数月即被推翻。

en: Yesünto'a (died 1251) was the third son of Mutukan and a grandson of Chagatai Khan. He represented the Chagatai family at Güyük Khan's coronation in August 1246. After Möngke seized the great khanate in 1251, he joined the Ögedeid princes Shiremun and Naqu in a plot to resist the new khan; the conspiracy was broken by the chief judge Mengeser, and Yesünto'a was seized on his arrival, tried and executed. His son Baraq ruled the Chagatai ulus from 1266 to 1271, and the later khan Duwa was Baraq's son.
zh: 也孙脱（？—1251年）是抹土干第三子、察合台之孙。1246年8月，他作为察合台家族的代表出席贵由汗的登基大典。1251年蒙哥登上大汗之位后，他与窝阔台系宗王失烈门、脑忽密谋对抗新汗；事情败露，最高断事官忙哥撒儿查办此案，也孙脱稍后抵达即遭逮捕，审判后被处死。他的儿子八剌于1266—1271年统治察合台汗国，后来的笃哇汗就是八剌之子。

en: Yi Bang-gwa (1357–1419), posthumously King Jeongjong, was the second king of Joseon and the second son of its founder, Yi Seong-gye. A career officer who fought beside his father in the last Goryeo campaigns, he became king in 1398 after his younger brother Yi Bang-won's coup killed Crown Prince Yi Bang-seok and Jeong Do-jeon in the First Strife of Princes, driving Taejo to abdicate. Bang-won had promoted Bang-gwa, then the eldest surviving son, as successor. He moved the court back to Gaegyeong the same year. When Yi Bang-won defeated Yi Bang-gan in the Second Strife of Princes in 1400, Jeongjong named him crown prince and abdicated months later. He died in 1419.
zh: 李芳果（1357—1419），死后庙号定宗，是朝鲜王朝第二代国王、开国君主李成桂的次子。他是职业武将，长年随父在高丽末年的各条战线上征战。1398年，弟弟李芳远发动第一次王子之乱，诛杀世子李芳硕与重臣郑道传，李成桂被迫退位。李芳远此前推动当时在世的长子李芳果继位；李芳果同年将朝廷迁回旧都开京。1400年，李芳远在第二次王子之乱中击败李芳干，李芳果立其为世子，数月后禅位，于1419年去世。

en: Yi Seong-gye (1335–1408) was the founder of the Joseon dynasty. A Goryeo general famed for defeating Red Turban invaders, Mongol remnants and Japanese pirates, he was ordered in 1388 to invade the Ming-held Liaodong Peninsula. The order followed a Ming demand for northern Goryeo territory, which his rival Choe Yeong used to argue for invasion. At Wihwa Island on the Amnok River Yi turned his army back, seized the capital Gaegyeong and eliminated Choe. In 1392 he deposed Goryeo's last king and took the throne, naming his dynasty Joseon in 1393 and establishing its capital at Hanseong in 1394. After his sons fought the First Strife of Princes in 1398, he abdicated and died in 1408.
zh: 李成桂（1335—1408）是朝鲜王朝的开国君主。他本是高丽将领，以击退红巾军、蒙古残余势力和倭寇著称。1388年，他奉命进攻明军驻守的辽东半岛：此前明朝索取高丽北部领土，他的政敌崔莹借此主张出兵。李成桂却在鸭绿江边的威化岛回师，攻占国都开京，铲除崔莹。1392年，他废黜高丽末代国王自立，1393年定国号为朝鲜，1394年定都汉城。1398年王子们爆发第一次王子之乱后，他退位，于1408年去世。

en: Yi Sun-sin (1545–1598) was a Joseon Korean admiral. After passing the military examination in 1576, he campaigned against Jurchen raiders on the northern border. In 1583 he lured them into battle and captured their chief; rivals later framed him for desertion, and he was tortured and imprisoned, then reinstated. As Left Naval Commander of Jeolla from 1591 he developed the armored turtle ship, and during the Japanese invasions of 1592–1598 he won every battle he fought, including Hansan Island and Myeongnyang, where 13 Korean ships routed over 130 Japanese vessels. Recalled after a second disgrace in 1597, he was killed by a gunshot at Noryang on December 16, 1598. His wartime journal is known as the Nanjung Ilgi.
zh: 李舜臣（1545—1598）是朝鲜王朝的水师名将。1576年武科及第后，他在北部边境征讨袭扰的女真人。1583年，他诱敌出战并俘获其首领；后来遭同僚诬陷临阵脱逃，被拷打下狱，其后官复原职。1591年起任全罗左道水军节度使，主持研制装甲龟船。1592—1598年壬辰倭乱期间，他指挥的海战无一败绩，闲山岛、鸣梁两役皆捷；鸣梁一役以13艘战船击溃130余艘日舰。1597年他再度遭谗去职，被重新起用后，于1598年12月16日在露梁海战中中炮身亡。他留下的战争日记名为《乱中日记》。

en: Yoshmut (c. 1234–18 July 1271) was an Ilkhanate prince, one of the three eldest sons of Hulagu, born to his Khitan concubine Nogachin Aghachi. From 1253 he accompanied his father and his brother Abaqa on the campaign that destroyed the Nizari state in Persia. He afterwards governed Arran and Azerbaijan as viceroy. He was remembered for a fiery temper that made him unpopular with the army, and he died on 18 July 1271; his descendant Ilyas later reigned briefly as the Ilkhan Suleiman Khan.
zh: 玉疏木忒（约1234—1271）是伊儿汗国宗王，旭烈兀三个年长的儿子之一，母亲是出身契丹的妾室诺嘎真·阿合赤。1253年起，他随父亲和阿八哈参加攻灭波斯尼扎里耶派政权的战事，后来出任阿兰与阿塞拜疆总督。他性情暴躁，在军中不得人心，于1271年7月18日去世；他的后裔伊勒牙思后来曾以速来蛮汗之名短暂出任伊儿汗。

en: Dmitry Svyatoslavich (before 1228–1269) was prince of Yuryev-Polsky from 1252 to 1267 and the only son of Grand Prince Svyatoslav Vsevolodovich of Vladimir by his wife Evdokia Davydovna, a princess of Murom. The chronicles first mention him in 1238 among the princes who survived Batu's invasion; a hagiography of the princes of Yuryev suggests that he and his father were then in Novgorod. In 1250 he accompanied his father to the court of the Golden Horde, and in 1255 he joined Alexander Nevsky's campaign against Novgorod. He took monastic vows in 1267 and died in 1269, buried in the Archangel Monastery at Yuryev.
zh: 德米特里·斯维亚托斯拉维奇（1228年前—1269）于1252至1267年担任尤里耶夫-波利斯基王公，是弗拉基米尔大公斯维亚托斯拉夫·弗谢沃洛多维奇与穆罗姆公女叶夫多基娅·达维多芙娜的独子。编年史首次提到他是在1238年，称他是躲过拔都入侵的王公之一；一部尤里耶夫诸公的圣传推测他与父亲当时身在诺夫哥罗德。1250年他随父亲前往金帐汗国宫廷，1255年参加亚历山大·涅夫斯基讨伐诺夫哥罗德的战役。1267年他剃度出家，1269年去世，葬于尤里耶夫的大天使修道院。

en: Ivan Dmitrievich, a conjectural prince of Yuryev-Polsky, is held by historians to have been a son of Prince Dmitry Svyatoslavich, ruling the appanage after him, and father of Yaroslav Ivanovich, named prince of Yuryev in 1340.
zh: 伊万·德米特里耶维奇是推测中的尤里耶夫-波利斯基王公，学者认为他是德米特里·斯维亚托斯拉维奇王公之子，在其父死后掌管该领地，也是1340年见于记载的尤里耶夫王大雅罗斯拉夫·伊万诺维奇之父。

en: Yaroslav Ivanovich was a prince of Yuryev-Polsky mentioned in 1340.
zh: 雅罗斯拉夫·伊万诺维奇是1340年被提及的尤里耶夫-波利斯基王公。

en: Babusha (died 1330) was a Naiman princess, the daughter of Princess Shouning and wife of Khutughtu Khan Kusala, Emperor Mingzong of Yuan, whom she married before he took the throne; their son Rinchinbal briefly reigned as emperor in 1332. She is recorded as endorsing Hu Sihui's dietary compendium Yinshan Zhengyao, presented to the court in 1330. After her husband's death she accused Empress Budashiri, wife of Jayaatu Khan Tugh Temür, of plotting against him. In retaliation Budashiri had her executed later that year, clearing the way for her own son Aratnadara's succession.
zh: 八不沙（？—1330）出身乃蛮部，是寿宁公主之女，在元明宗和世瓎（忽都笃汗）即位前嫁给他为妻，二人的儿子懿璘质班曾在1332年短暂登基。据载她曾赞许忽思慧于1330年进献宫廷的饮食著作《饮膳正要》。丈夫死后，她指责元文宗图帖睦尔的皇后卜答失里曾图谋加害明宗，卜答失里遂于同年将她处死，为自己的儿子阿剌忒纳答剌继位扫清道路。

en: Bayan Khutugh (1324–1365) was a Khongirad noblewoman, the daughter of Bolod Temür, who became the second empress of Toghon Temür, last Yuan emperor. His first empress, Danashiri, daughter of the minister El Temür, was deposed and put to death in Dadu in 1335 for her part in her brother's failed rebellion. Only in 1337 did the emperor marry again, and Bayan Khutugh was enthroned as empress on 18 April at the age of thirteen. The History of Yuan praises her as frugal, free of jealousy and strict in observing ritual, in pointed contrast to the emperor's favoured concubine Lady Ki, who bore him a son in 1339 and overshadowed the empress at court. She died on 8 September 1365 aged forty-two; Lady Ki looked over the plain, worn clothes left among her things and laughed, asking how an empress could wear such dress.
zh: 伯颜忽都（1324—1365）出身弘吉剌部，是孛罗帖木儿之女，元朝末帝妥懽帖睦尔的第二任皇后。皇帝的第一任皇后答纳失里是权臣燕帖木儿之女，1335年因其兄谋反失败而被废，在大都被处死。直到1337年，皇帝才再次成婚，伯颜忽都于4月18日册立为后，时年十三岁。《元史》称她节俭、不妒忌、谨守礼法，与深受皇帝宠爱、1339年为他生下一子的奇氏形成鲜明对照，奇氏在宫中盖过了皇后的风头。1365年9月8日伯颜忽都去世，终年四十二岁；奇氏翻看她遗物中朴素破旧的衣服，笑着问皇后怎能穿这样的衣服。

en: Bayan of the Merkid (1280–1340) was a Mongol general and the dominant minister of the late Yuan court. He won distinction campaigning against Kaidu from 1299 and the title Baturu in 1307, and as governor of Henan he helped enthrone Tugh Temür in 1328, becoming left chancellor. After supporting Toghon Temür's accession in 1333, he had the sons of his rival El Temür executed in 1335 and placed his nephew Toqto'a among his trusted officials to watch the emperor. He became grand chancellor in 1339, abolished the Confucian examinations and curtailed Han officials; he is said to have once urged the emperor to kill Han bearing the common surnames Zhang, Wang, Liu, Li and Zhao. Historians describe him as a traditionalist bent on preserving Mongol ways. In 1340 Toqto'a ousted him with the emperor's backing while he was hunting, and Bayan died on his way into exile that same year.
zh: 伯颜（1280—1340）是元朝后期权倾一时的蒙古蔑儿乞部将领与大臣。他自1299年随军讨伐海都，以军功于1307年获“拔都儿”称号；1328年任河南行省平章政事时全力迎立怀王图帖睦尔（元文宗），升任中书左丞相。1333年他拥立妥懽帖睦尔（元顺帝）即位，1335年奏诛政敌燕铁木儿诸子，任用侄子脱脱等亲信，并派脱脱监视皇帝。1339年他进大丞相，废除科举、排挤汉官；相传他还曾建议皇帝杀掉张、王、刘、李、赵这些大姓的汉人。史家称他是力图保存蒙古旧俗的守旧派。1340年，脱脱趁他出猎时奉皇帝之旨将他罢黜，他同年死于流放途中。

en: Empress Gi (1315–1369), born to a bureaucratic family in Haengju, Goryeo, was sent to the Yuan court as a tribute girl in 1333 and became the favoured consort of Toghon Temür. After bearing the future Ayushiridara in 1339, she was made secondary empress in 1340 and wielded much of the dynasty's power through her eunuch Park Bul-hwa. When King Gongmin of Goryeo killed her brother Ki Ch'ŏl in 1356, her punitive army was routed at the Yalu. She became primary empress in 1365, fled the Ming advance in 1368, and died at Yingchang in 1369.
zh: 奇皇后（1315—1369）出生于高丽幸州（今韩国高阳）的一个官宦家庭，1333年作为贡女被送入元朝宫廷，成为妥懽帖睦尔（元顺帝）宠爱的妃子。1339年她生下后来的爱猷识理答腊，1340年被立为第二皇后，通过宦官朴不花掌握了朝廷的实权。1356年高丽恭愍王诛杀其兄奇辙并灭其家族，她派出的征讨军队在鸭绿江一带被击败。1365年她正位中宫，1368年在明军进逼下北逃，1369年死于应昌。

en: Jinzhier was a Merkid Mongol officer of the early Yuan dynasty who commanded the imperial guard in the Longfu empress dowager's palace. He was the father of the powerful ministers Bayan and Majartai and was posthumously honoured as Zhongyi.
zh: 谨只儿是元朝前期蒙古蔑儿乞部军官，任隆福太后宫中宿卫统领。他是元末权臣伯颜、马札儿台兄弟之父，身后谥忠懿。

en: Khutughtu Khan Kusala (22 December 1300–30 August 1329), temple name Emperor Mingzong, was the eldest son of Khayishan, Emperor Wuzong. Khayishan had made his brother Ayurbarwada heir on condition that he later pass the succession to Kusala. Instead, Ayurbarwada made his own son Shidebala heir, and in 1316 Kusala was relegated to Yunnan; after a failed revolt in Shaanxi he fled to the Chagatai Khanate. After the War of the Two Capitals in 1328 he returned with Chagatayid backing and enthroned himself north of Karakorum on 27 February 1329; his brother Tugh Temür abdicated in his favour. Kusala made Tugh Temür his heir and appointed his own followers to high office. Four days after a banquet with Tugh Temür at Ongghuchad he died suddenly, widely believed poisoned by the strongman El Temür.
zh: 忽都笃汗和世㻋（1300年12月22日—1329年8月30日），庙号明宗，是元武宗海山的长子。海山曾立弟弟爱育黎拔力八达为储君，条件是他日后传位和世㻋。爱育黎拔力八达却改立己子硕德八剌为储君，1316年将和世㻋徙往云南；和世㻋在陕西举事失败后西逃察合台汗国。1328年两都之战后，他借察合台系宗王之力东归，于1329年2月27日在和林之北即位，其弟图帖睦尔让位。和世㻋立图帖睦尔为皇储，并任命自己的追随者担任要职。然而在王忽察都与图帖睦尔宴饮相见仅四天后，他便暴卒，世人多认为是权臣燕帖木儿将他毒死。

en: Mailaiti (died 3 June 1320) was a noblewoman of the Qarluq people around Almaliq, descended from the Qarluq ruler Arslan Khan; her father was Temuder. In 1316 the Mongol prince Qoshila, later Khutughtu Khan and Emperor Mingzong, fled west after his failed uprising and passed through her lands. She became his wife. She died on 3 June 1320 after giving birth to her son Toghon Temür, the future last Yuan emperor. In 1336 her son posthumously honoured her as Empress Zhenyu Huïsheng.
zh: 迈来迪（？—1320年6月3日）是阿力麻里一带的罕禄鲁氏（即哈剌鲁、葛逻禄）贵族女子，郡王阿儿厮兰（狮子汗）的后裔，父亲名帖木迭儿。1316年，周王和世㻋（后来的元明宗）举兵失败后西行，经过其地。迈来迪后来成为他的妃子。1320年6月3日，她生下妥欢帖睦尔（即元朝最后一位皇帝元顺帝）后去世。1336年，元顺帝追封她为贞裕徽圣皇后。

en: Majartai (1285–1347), a Merkid Mongol, was the younger brother of the grand councillor Bayan and the father of Toqto'a. He began as a retainer of Emperor Wuzong and then of the future Renzong, and went on to hold civil and military posts. In 1327, as an investigating censor in Shaanxi, he gave his own wealth to feed the poor in a famine. When Emperor Taiding died in 1328, he raised troops for the Shangdu court against Emperor Wenzong in Dadu; Shangdu lost, and only Bayan's merits saved him from punishment. In 1337, with Bayan dominating the court, he declined a princely title and went to guard the northern frontier. After Bayan's fall in 1340 he became right chancellor but resigned through illness the same year; in 1341 he was made prince of Zhong while his son Toqto'a took the chancellorship. Slandered in 1347, he was exiled to Gansu and died there.
zh: 马札儿台（1285—1347），蒙古蔑儿乞氏，权臣伯颜之弟、脱脱之父。他先扈从元武宗，后侍奉皇太子（日后的元仁宗），此后历任文武要职。1327年任陕西行台治书侍御史，适逢关陕饥荒，他捐出私财赈济贫民。1328年泰定帝去世后，他在陕西起兵响应上都一方，对抗大都的元文宗；上都兵败，他获罪，因兄长伯颜有功才得免。1337年伯颜专权，他辞谢王爵，出镇北边。1340年伯颜被黜，他出任中书右丞相，当年即因病辞位；1341年封忠王，右丞相之位由儿子脱脱接任。1347年遭谗毁，被安置甘肃，同年病逝。

en: Rinchinbal (1 May 1326–14 December 1332), temple name Emperor Ningzong, was the second son of Khutughtu Khan Kusala, Emperor Mingzong, and a younger brother of Toghon Temür. His mother was the Naiman empress Babusha. After his father's death in 1329 he was made Prince of Fu and kept at court by his uncle Tugh Temür, Emperor Wenzong. When Wenzong died in 1332 his widow Budashiri, honouring his deathbed wish to restore Kusala's line, had the six-year-old boy enthroned on 23 October rather than recall the exiled Toghon Temür. Rinchinbal reigned barely seven weeks and died on 14 December 1332.
zh: 懿璘质班（1326年5月1日—1332年12月14日），庙号宁宗，是元明宗和世㻋的次子，妥懽帖睦尔的弟弟，母亲是乃蛮氏皇后八不沙。1329年父亲死后，他被叔父元文宗图帖睦尔封为鄜王，养在宫中。1332年文宗去世，皇后卜答失里遵照其临终还位于明宗一脉的遗愿，没有迎回流放的妥懽帖睦尔，而将年仅六岁的懿璘质班于10月23日扶上皇位。他在位仅七周左右，便于1332年12月14日夭折。

en: Toghon Temür (25 May 1320–23 May 1370), temple name Emperor Huizong, was the last Yuan emperor of China and, at 35 years, its longest-reigning after Kublai Khan. Eldest son of Kusala, Emperor Mingzong, he was born during his father's exile in Central Asia and was himself banished to Goryeo and then Guangxi. After his younger brother Rinchinbal died in 1332, El Temür delayed his enthronement until 1333. His early reign was controlled by powerful ministers, including Bayan, who suspended the civil service examinations; in 1340 he ousted Bayan with the help of Bayan's nephew Toqto'a, who restored the examinations and finished the official histories of the Liao, Jin and Song. Floods, fiscal crisis and the Red Turban Rebellion from 1351 shattered Yuan power, and in 1354 he dismissed Toqto'a. When Zhu Yuanzhang's Ming armies took Dadu in 1368, he fled to the steppe, where his court kept claiming the imperial title. Mongolian chronicles preserve a poem in which he mourns the lost capital. He died at Yingchang in 1370.
zh: 妥懽帖睦尔（1320年5月25日—1370年5月23日），庙号惠宗，是元朝在中原的末代皇帝，在位35年，是忽必烈之后在位最久的元朝皇帝。他是元明宗和世㻋的长子，生于父亲流亡中亚期间，自己也先后被流放高丽和广西。1332年弟弟懿璘质班去世后，燕帖木儿延迟他的即位，直到1333年他才登基。即位初年朝政由权臣把持，其中伯颜停罢科举；1340年他借伯颜之侄脱脱之力罢黜伯颜，脱脱恢复科举，并修成辽、金、宋三部正史。水患、财政危机和1351年爆发的红巾军起义动摇了元朝统治，1354年他罢免了脱脱。1368年朱元璋的明军攻占大都，他北遁草原，朝廷继续主张皇帝名号。蒙古编年史保存着一首诗，诗中他哀悼失去的都城。他于1370年卒于应昌。

en: Toqto'a (1314–1356), courtesy name Dayong, was a Merkid aristocrat and the most powerful minister of the late Yuan court. Given a Confucian education, he joined his father Majartai and the young emperor Toghon Temür in March 1340 in shutting his uncle Bayan out of the capital while Bayan was hunting; Bayan was exiled, and Toqto'a took his office as grand councillor that November. From 1343 he directed the compilation of the histories of the Liao, Jin and Song, treating all three as legitimate dynasties. He resigned in 1344 and was recalled in 1349, the emperor saying that among men there was Toqto'a, among horses the Frankish horse. In 1351 he set 200,000 men to work on the Yellow River to reopen the Grand Canal, then took the field against the Red Turbans and retook Xuzhou in 1352. In 1354, with Gaoyou about to fall, court rivals had him dismissed; he was exiled to Yunnan and poisoned in January 1356.
zh: 脱脱（1314—1356），字大用，蔑儿乞氏，是元朝末年最有权势的大臣。他受儒学教育，1340年3月与父亲马札儿台一同协助年轻的元顺帝，趁伯父伯颜出城打猎时将他拒之城外，伯颜随即被流放；同年十一月，脱脱接任中书右丞相。1343年起，他主持纂修辽、金、宋三史，将三朝并列为正统。1344年他辞职，1349年被召回，元顺帝说：“人中有脱脱，马中有佛郎国马。”1351年他征发二十万民夫治理黄河，意在重开大运河，随后率军讨伐红巾军，1352年收复徐州。1354年，高邮眼看就要攻下，朝中政敌使他被罢黜；他流放云南，1356年1月被毒杀。

en: Yusufshah was a Mongol Ilkhanid prince, one of the sons of Yoshmut, himself a son of Hulagu. He is named only in genealogical sources. The puppet Ilkhan Suleiman Khan, raised to the throne in 1339, descended from Yoshmut's line.
zh: 优素福·沙是伊儿汗国的蒙古宗王，为旭烈兀之子约什穆特之子，其名仅见于谱系记载。1339年被拥立为傀儡伊儿汗的速来蛮，即出自约什穆特一系。

en: Ahmad ibn Yusuf al-Muzni was the last emir of Biskra in the Zab, the eastern Algerian oasis state ruled by his Banu Muzni family since 1279. His father Yusuf and grandfather Mansur had governed the oases and Bedouin tribes of the region under loose Hafsid suzerainty. Ahmad fought repeated wars against the Hafsid sultans. In 1371 and 1372 the historian Ibn Khaldun stayed at Biskra as the guest of its Muzni lord. Finally the Hafsid sultan Abu Faris Abd al-Aziz II sent his armies against Ahmad, destroying the emirate in 1402.
zh: 艾哈迈德·本·优素福·穆兹尼是扎卜地区比斯克拉的最后一位埃米尔。自1279年起，他的巴努·穆兹尼家族便统治着阿尔及利亚东部这片绿洲；他的父亲优素福和祖父曼苏尔曾在哈夫斯王朝松散的宗主权下管治当地诸绿洲与贝都因部落。艾哈迈德在位期间屡次与哈夫斯苏丹交战。1371至1372年，史学家伊本·赫勒敦曾在比斯克拉居留，受到当时穆兹尼统治者的款待。最终哈夫斯苏丹阿布·法里斯·阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹二世发兵攻打艾哈迈德，于1402年攻灭了这个埃米尔国。

en: Al-Faḍl ibn ʿAlī ibn Muznī was an Arab chieftain of the Banu Muzni, a Hilali tribe of the Zab in eastern Algeria. He backed the Hafsid prince Abū Isḥāq Ibrāhīm when he rose against his brother Caliph al-Mustanṣir and followed him into exile in al-Andalus. After Abū Isḥāq seized power, al-Faḍl in 1279 became ruler of Biskra and the Zab, founding the Muzni emirate. In 1284 or 1285 he left Biskra on business and was killed, and his son Manṣūr succeeded him.
zh: 法德勒·本·阿里·本·穆兹尼是扎卜地区（今阿尔及利亚东部）阿拉伯希拉勒部族巴努·穆兹尼的首领。哈夫斯王族阿布·易司哈格·易卜拉欣起兵反对其兄哈里发穆斯坦绥尔时，法德勒起兵相助，事败后随他流亡安达卢西亚。阿布·易司哈格掌权后，法德勒于1279年成为比斯克拉与扎卜的统治者，建立穆兹尼埃米尔国。1284或1285年，他从比斯克拉外出办事时被杀，其子曼苏尔继位。

en: Manṣūr ibn al-Faḍl, also called Manṣūr ibn Muznī, succeeded his murdered father as emir of Biskra and the Zab in 1284 or 1285. He ruled the oasis city with the backing of the Hafsid sultans of Béjaïa against the bedouin tribes of the region. From 1318 to 1337 the Dhawawida and Riyāḥ Arabs of the Zab, led by the sheikh Saʿāda and supported by the Zianids of Tlemcen, waged a long rising against him, and in 1329 the Banu Muzni again swore allegiance to the Hafsids. His son Yūsuf succeeded him.
zh: 曼苏尔·本法德勒，又称曼苏尔·本·穆兹尼，于1284或1285年继被杀的父亲之位，成为比斯克拉与扎卜的埃米尔。他在贝贾亚哈夫斯王朝的支持下统治这座绿洲城市，压制当地贝都因部族。1318至1337年，扎卜的达瓦维达与里亚赫阿拉伯人由谢赫萨阿达领导、并得到特莱姆森扎扬王朝支持，长期起兵反抗他；1329年，巴努·穆兹尼重新向哈夫斯王朝宣誓效忠。他死后由其子优素福继位。

en: Yūsuf ibn Manṣūr was an emir of Biskra and the Zab of the Banu Muzni dynasty. He inherited the emirate from his father Manṣūr ibn al-Faḍl, and was succeeded by his son Aḥmad ibn Yūsuf, under whom the Hafsids overthrew the Muzni emirate in 1402.
zh: 优素福·本·曼苏尔是穆兹尼王朝统治比斯克拉与扎卜的埃米尔。他从父亲曼苏尔·本法德勒手中继承埃米尔国，后由其子艾哈迈德·本·优素福继位；1402年，哈夫斯王朝正是在艾哈迈德当政时攻灭了穆兹尼埃米尔国。

en: Henry IV the Faithful (c. 1292–1342), eldest son of Henry III of Głogów, ruled Żagań from 1309, first jointly with his brothers. In 1310 he married Matilda, daughter of Margrave Herman of Brandenburg, but the alliance did not save the family's Greater Poland lands, which Władysław I the Elbow-high had largely seized by 1314. The 1321 partition made him sole duke of Żagań, and in 1329 he had to do homage to John of Luxembourg, King of Bohemia. He died at Żagań on 22 January 1342 and was succeeded by his son Henry V of Iron.
zh: 亨里克四世（忠诚者，约1292—1342）是格沃古夫公爵亨里克三世的长子，1309年起与诸弟共同统治扎甘。1310年，他娶勃兰登堡藩侯赫尔曼之女玛蒂尔达，但这层同盟未能保住家族在大波兰的领地，到1314年这些土地大多被瓦迪斯瓦夫一世（矮子）夺取。1321年的分家使他成为扎甘唯一的公爵，1329年又被迫向波希米亚国王卢森堡的约翰称臣。1342年1月22日，他在扎甘去世，其子亨里克五世（铁人）继位。

en: Henry V the Iron (c. 1319–1369), the only son of Henry IV the Faithful, became duke of Żagań in 1342 and spent his reign recovering lands lost by his father. In 1344 he accepted Bohemian vassalage from King John of Luxembourg in exchange for half of Głogów, taking possession in 1349. As a loyal vassal he attended Emperor Charles IV's Roman coronation in 1355, and in 1356 he joined a diplomatic mission to Constantinople and a pilgrimage to Palestine. In 1363 his daughter Hedwig married King Casimir III of Poland. He went blind in 1367 and died in 1369.
zh: 亨里克五世（铁人，约1319—1369）是亨里克四世（忠诚者）的独子，1342年成为扎甘公爵，毕生致力于收复父亲时代失去的领地。1344年，他以向卢森堡的约翰称臣为条件换得半个格沃古夫，1349年正式接管。作为忠诚的附庸，他1355年出席皇帝查理四世的罗马加冕礼，1356年随外交使团前往君士坦丁堡并赴巴勒斯坦朝圣。1363年，其女雅德维加嫁给波兰国王卡齐米日三世。他1367年双目失明，1369年去世。

en: Abu al-Muzaffar al-Hasan ibn Sulaiman, called Abu al-Mawahib (father of gifts), ruled the Kilwa Sultanate from 1310 until his death in 1333. A grandson of al-Hasan ibn Talut, founder of the Yemeni Mahdali dynasty, he was studying in Aden when his father died, so his brother Daud held the throne for two years before yielding it to him. His reign made Kilwa prosperous: he expanded copper coinage, uniquely minted gold coins, built the Husuni Kubwa palace and likely Husuni Ndogo, and reconquered Mafia island from the Shirazi. Husuni Kubwa served as a royal warehouse and trading centre, though it remained unfinished at his death. Ibn Battuta visited and recorded his generosity, including a gift of his own robes to a poor man.
zh: 阿布·穆扎法尔·哈桑·伊本·苏莱曼，绰号阿布·穆瓦希布（意为“馈赠之父”），1310年至1333年去世时统治基尔瓦苏丹国。他是也门裔马赫达利王朝建立者哈桑·伊本·塔卢特之孙；父亲去世时他正在亚丁求学，其弟达乌德先继位，两年后让位给他。他在位期间基尔瓦臻于富庶：推广铜币，也是唯一铸造过金币的基尔瓦统治者；修建胡苏尼库布瓦宫，胡苏尼恩多戈也很可能出自其手；并从设拉子王朝手中收复马菲亚岛。胡苏尼库布瓦兼作皇家仓库和贸易中心，但他去世时仍未完工。伊本·白图泰曾到访，记下了他的慷慨，包括他将自己的衣袍赠给穷人。
