en: Al-Hasan ibn Talut al-Mahdali was the founder of the Mahdali dynasty, a family of Yemeni Arab sayyids who ruled the Kilwa Sultanate. In 1277 he seized power by force, overthrowing Kilwa's Shirazi rulers, and reigned for about eighteen years, earning in the Kilwa chronicle a reputation as an excellent knight. He began the minting of copper coins at Kilwa, a program continued by his successors, and during his rule his grandson, the future sultan al-Hasan ibn Sulaiman, was sent to study in Aden. He died around 1294 and was succeeded by his son Suleiman.
zh: 哈桑·伊本·塔卢特·马赫达利是马赫达利王朝的开创者，该王朝出身也门阿拉伯圣裔，统治基卢瓦苏丹国。1277年，他以武力夺权，推翻基卢瓦的设拉子系统治者，在位约十八年，《基卢瓦编年史》称他是一位出色的骑士。他开创了基卢瓦的铜币铸造，后继者延续了这一铸币事业；他在位时，孙子、后来的苏丹哈桑·伊本·苏莱曼被送往亚丁求学。他约于1294年去世，儿子苏莱曼继位。

en: Daud ibn Suleiman, son of Sultan Suleiman ibn al-Hasan of the Mahdali dynasty, was twice sultan of Kilwa. When his father was murdered in 1308, his brother al-Hasan ibn Sulaiman had already been proclaimed ruler but was away on pilgrimage in Mecca; Daud held the throne in his brother's name for two years, then stepped down voluntarily on his return. After al-Hasan died in 1333, Daud ascended again, this time ruling in his own right for about twenty-four years, until around 1357.
zh: 达乌德·伊本·苏莱曼是马赫达利王朝苏丹苏莱曼·伊本·哈桑之子，曾两度登上基卢瓦王位。1308年父亲遇刺时，他的兄弟哈桑·伊本·苏莱曼已被拥立为君，却正在麦加朝觐；达乌德以兄弟的名义执政两年，待其归来后主动让位。1333年哈桑去世，达乌德再度即位，这次以自己的名义统治约二十四年，直至约1357年。

en: Daud ibn Sulaiman was a sultan of Kilwa from the Yemeni Mahdali dynasty, which had supplanted the Shirazi line, a son of Sultan Sulaiman ibn al-Hasan and brother of al-Hasan ibn Sulaiman, called Abu al-Mawahib, the father of gifts. When their father died around 1308 while al-Hasan was away on the pilgrimage to Mecca, Daud was placed on the Kilwa throne. He ruled for two years, then voluntarily stood down when his brother returned. Al-Hasan's reign made Kilwa rich: he minted gold coins, the only Kilwan ruler known to do so, began the palace of Husuni Kubwa, and earned the traveller Ibn Battuta's praise for his generosity. When al-Hasan died in 1333, Daud became sultan a second time and took over a prosperous city and an unfinished palace.
zh: 达乌德·伊本·苏莱曼是基尔瓦苏丹，出身取代设拉子王朝的也门裔马赫达利王朝，是苏丹苏莱曼·伊本·哈桑之子，也是人称“赠礼之父”的阿布·穆瓦希布·哈桑·伊本·苏莱曼的兄弟。约1308年父亲去世时，哈桑正在前往麦加朝觐途中，达乌德被拥立登上基尔瓦王位。他在位两年，兄长归来后便主动让位。哈桑在位期间基尔瓦富庶一时：他铸造金币，是已知唯一铸过金币的基尔瓦统治者，开建胡苏尼·库布瓦宫，旅行家伊本·白图泰也称赞他慷慨。1333年哈桑去世后，达乌德再度成为苏丹，接手了一座繁荣的城市和一座未完工的宫殿。

en: Suleiman ibn al-Hasan, called al-Mat'un, was sultan of Kilwa from 1294 to 1308, succeeding his father al-Hasan ibn Talut, founder of the Mahdali dynasty. The Kilwa chronicle recorded by João de Barros in the sixteenth century gives him a reign of fourteen years, ending when conspirators murdered him as he came out of a mosque. His partisans at once proclaimed his son al-Hasan ibn Sulaiman sultan, but as the heir was away on pilgrimage in Mecca, the throne was held temporarily by another son, Daud, until al-Hasan returned.
zh: 苏莱曼·伊本·哈桑，又称马图恩，于1294年至1308年担任基卢瓦苏丹，继承父亲、马赫达利王朝开创者哈桑·伊本·塔卢特之位。据若昂·德·巴罗斯在16世纪记录的《基卢瓦编年史》，他在位十四年，最终在走出一座清真寺时被密谋者杀害。他的党羽随即拥立其子哈桑·伊本·苏莱曼为苏丹，但继承人当时正在麦加朝觐，王位便由另一个儿子达乌德暂掌，直到哈桑归来。

en: Huijatoo, recorded under his Zapotec calendar name Eleven Water ‘Stone Rain’, was a Zapotec king of Zaachila who died in 1386 and was the son of Ozomatli, called Three Alligator.
zh: 惠哈图是扎奇拉的萨波特克国王，萨波特克历名为十一水‘石雨’，于1386年去世；其父欧索玛特里的历名为三鳄。

en: Ozomatli, recorded under his Zapotec calendar name Three Alligator ‘Smooth Eagle’, was a Zapotec king of Zaachila who died in 1361 and was the father of Huijatoo, whose calendar name was Eleven Water ‘Stone Rain’.
zh: 欧索玛特里是扎奇拉的萨波特克国王，萨波特克历名为三鳄‘滑鹰’，于1361年去世；其子惠哈图的历名为十一水‘石雨’。

en: Zhenjin (1243–1286), a son of Kublai Khan and Chabi Khatun, was the Yuan dynasty's first crown prince. The Zen monk Haiyun gave him his name, meaning true gold. Made Prince of Yan in 1261, he was formally named heir in 1273. Tutored by Han Confucian scholars such as Yao Shu and Dou Mo, he befriended the Tibetan lama Phagpa. In 1285 a censor proposed that Kublai abdicate in his favour, enraging the old emperor; Zhenjin died fearful and ill on 5 January 1286, before ever reigning. His son Temür succeeded Kublai and posthumously honoured him as Emperor Yuzong.
zh: 真金（1243—1286）是忽必烈与察必皇后之子，元朝首位皇太子。他出生时由禅僧海云取名，意为“真金”。1261年受封燕王，1273年正式册立为皇太子。他师从姚枢、窦默等汉族儒士，又与吐蕃喇嘛八思巴交好。1285年，有御史上奏请忽必烈禅位于真金，忽必烈大怒，真金忧惧成疾，于1286年1月5日去世，终生未及即位。其子铁穆耳继位后追尊他为裕宗皇帝。

en: Bolko II of Ziębice (1 February 1300 – 11 June 1341), fourth son of Bolko I the Strict, rejected a Church career and received Ziębice as an independent duchy from his brother Bernard in 1322. That year he joined a Teutonic campaign against Lithuania. He robbed the Henryków and Kamieniec monasteries and was excommunicated in 1329 for attacking a papal legate's suite. In 1335 he defeated a Bohemian force, but in June 1336 did homage to the king of Bohemia. Debt forced him to pledge town after town, until only Ziębice remained, where he died in 1341.
zh: 波尔科二世（津比采，1300年2月1日—1341年6月11日）是波尔科一世（严厉者）的第四子，起初被安排走教会道路，但1322年从兄长贝尔纳德手中分得津比采，成为独立公爵。同年他随条顿骑士团远征立陶宛。他因财政困窘与教会冲突，劫掠亨里库夫和卡缅茨修道院，1329年又因袭击教皇使节随从而被开除教籍。1335年他击败一支波希米亚军队，但1336年6月仍向波希米亚国王称臣。债务迫使他逐座抵押城镇，最后只剩津比采本城，1341年在此去世。

en: Bonne, also called Guta or Judith (died 1342), was duchess of Ziębice as the wife of Bolko II. She may have been of Savoyard origin and the widow of a Hungarian magnate of the Csák family. By November 1321 she had married Bolko. She bore him his heir Nicholas the Small and a daughter Margareta, later a nun at Strzelin. She died in 1342 and was buried beside her husband in the Cistercian abbey at Henryków.
zh: 博内（又名古塔或尤迪特，?—1342）是津比采公爵波尔科二世的妻子。她可能出身萨伏依，也可能是一位恰克家族匈牙利豪强的遗孀。1321年11月前，她已嫁给波尔科，为他生下继承人小米科瓦伊和女儿玛格丽塔，玛格丽塔后来在斯特热林出家。她于1342年去世，与丈夫合葬于亨里库夫的熙笃会修道院。

en: Adelheid of Ziegenhain (died 1388), a daughter of Count John I and Lukardis of Nidda, married Count Henry II of Truhendingen in 1333. The marriage was dissolved before 1360, and she entered the women's collegiate foundation at Kaufungen as a canoness; in September 1360 she renounced her parental inheritance in favour of her brother Gottfried VII. She became provost in 1374 and was elected abbess in 1378. During her term the cloister and south transept of the collegiate church were renewed around 1379. She is last documented in 1384 and died in 1388.
zh: 阿德尔海德·冯·齐根海恩（?—1388）是齐根海恩伯爵约翰一世与卢卡迪斯之女，1333年嫁给特鲁亨丁根伯爵海因里希二世。这段婚姻在1360年前以离婚告终，阿德尔海德遂进入考夫恩根女子教士团，成为女教士；1360年9月，她放弃应继承的父母遗产，让与兄长戈特弗里德七世。1374年她任修院教长，1378年当选院长。在她任内，约1379年修院回廊和教堂南侧耳堂得到翻修。关于她的记载最晚见于1384年，她于1388年去世。

en: Engelbert II of Ziegenhain (1329–1341) was a younger son of Count John I of Ziegenhain and Nidda and of Lukardis, heiress of the County of Nidda. He was married to Isengard of Eppstein and was intended to inherit Nidda, but his early death in 1341 at about the age of twelve prevented it. His elder brother Gottfried VII, who had first been destined for the church, eventually succeeded to both Ziegenhain and Nidda when John I died in 1359.
zh: 齐根海恩的恩格尔贝特二世（1329—1341）是齐根海恩与尼达伯爵约翰一世与尼达女继承人卢卡迪斯年纪较小的儿子。他娶埃普施泰因的伊森加德为妻，原定继承尼达伯国，但1341年年约12岁便早逝，未能如愿。他的兄长戈特弗里德七世本已准备走教会道路，最终在约翰一世于1359年去世后继承了齐根海恩与尼达两伯国。

en: Godfrey VI (1262–1304) became Count of Ziegenhain in 1272 at the age of ten, ruling at first under his mother Hedwig's regency. In 1274 he was betrothed to Mechthild, daughter of Landgrave Henry I of Hesse, whom he married in 1282. As a Mainz burgmann at Amöneburg he fought against his future father-in-law and was defeated with Archbishop Werner at Fritzlar in 1280. In 1288 he fought for Duke John I of Brabant at the Battle of Worringen against Cologne. He died on 30 November 1304, leaving his minor son John under Mechthild's regency until 1309.
zh: 戈特弗里德六世（1262—1304）于1272年十岁时继为齐根海恩伯爵，先由母亲黑德维希摄政。1274年他与黑森方伯亨利一世之女玛蒂尔德订婚，1282年成婚。作为美因茨派驻阿默内堡的城堡武士，他曾与未来的岳父为敌，1280年随大主教维尔纳在弗里茨拉尔战败；1288年，他在沃林根战役中为布拉班特公爵约翰一世作战，对抗科隆。1304年11月30日他去世，幼子约翰继位，由玛蒂尔德摄政至1309年。

en: Gottfried VII (died before 8 November 1372), eldest son of Count John I, ruled Ziegenhain and Nidda from 1359, having already received Nidda, Gemünden and Staufenberg as co-ruler under his father. Like earlier counts he tacked between Hesse and Mainz: in 1344 he and his father sold Mainz a quarter of the castle and town of Nidda and their associated rights, then allied with Hesse months later. He reorganized the county into six administrative offices. In 1370 he became captain of the League of the Star, a coalition against Hessian expansion, and died in 1372 during the ensuing Star War. By his wife Agnes of Falkenstein he fathered his successor Gottfried VIII.
zh: 戈特弗里德七世（?—1372年11月8日前）是齐根海恩伯爵约翰一世的长子，1359年起统治齐根海恩与尼达；此前他在父亲生前作为共治者，已受封尼达、格明登和施陶芬贝格。和历代伯爵一样，他在黑森与美因茨之间周旋：1344年他与父亲将尼达城堡、城镇及附属权益的四分之一卖给美因茨，数月后又与黑森结盟。他将伯国重组为六个行政区。1370年，他出任“星辰同盟”的军事首领，该同盟是贵族对抗黑森扩张的联合，1372年他在随后的“星辰战争”期间去世。他与妻子法尔肯施泰因的阿格妮丝生下继承人戈特弗里德八世。

en: John I (died 15 December 1359) was count of Ziegenhain from 1304 and high advocate of Fulda Abbey until 1344. In 1311 he married Lukardis, heiress of Count Engelbert I of Nidda, and in 1333, after her line ended, he merged Nidda with Ziegenhain, reuniting the counties divided in 1258. Caught between Hesse and the archbishopric of Mainz, he steered a careful balancing course; in 1323 the future Emperor Louis IV enfeoffed him with the castle and town of Nidda as an imperial fief. He secured his lands by building or extending castles such as Schönstein and Schwarzenborn, and under him the county reached its greatest prosperity.
zh: 约翰一世（?—1359年12月15日）自1304年起任齐根海恩伯爵，1304至1344年还担任富尔达修道院的高级保护人。1311年，他娶尼达伯爵恩格尔贝特一世的女继承人卢卡迪斯为妻；1333年尼达一脉绝嗣，他将尼达并入齐根海恩，使1258年分裂的两个伯国重新合一。夹在黑森与美因茨大主教区之间，他奉行谨慎的平衡策略，1323年后来的皇帝路德维希四世将尼达城堡和城镇作为帝国采邑封赐给他。他修建或扩建申施泰因、施瓦岑博恩等城堡巩固领地，在他治下伯国达到鼎盛。

en: Conrad of Ziegenhain, a younger son of Count John I of Ziegenhain, is known only as a canon of the Neumünster collegiate church at Würzburg in 1345.
zh: 康拉德·冯·齐根海恩是齐根海恩伯爵约翰一世的小儿子之一，史料仅记载他在1345年任维尔茨堡新明斯特牧师会教堂的法政神父。

en: Mechthild of Hesse (c. 1267–1332), daughter of Landgrave Henry I, married Count Gottfried VI of Ziegenhain by 1283. When Gottfried died in 1304 their underage son Johann became count and Mechthild acted as regent until marrying Philip III of Falkenstein-Munzenberg in 1309.
zh: 黑森的梅希蒂尔德（约1267—1332）是黑森伯爵海因里希一世之女，1283年前嫁给齐根海因伯爵戈特弗里德六世。1304年丈夫去世后，年幼的儿子约翰继位，她以摄政身份掌政，至1309年改嫁法尔肯施泰因-明岑贝格伯爵腓力三世为止。

en: Sophie of Ziegenhain, a daughter of Count John I of Ziegenhain and Lukardis of Nidda, married Duke Albert IV of Saxe-Lauenburg in 1341 and was the mother of a daughter also named Sophie.
zh: 索菲·冯·齐根海恩是齐根海恩伯爵约翰一世与卢卡迪斯之女，1341年嫁给萨克森-劳恩堡公爵阿尔布雷希特四世，生有一女，亦名索菲。

en: Zeyd, also called Zeydo, was a Kurdish chieftain and a grandson of Sheikh Hasan Zerraki. In 1335 he captured the castle of Buat near Farqin, the ancient Mayyafariqin, and founded the Kurdish Principality of Zirqan in the hills north of Mardin.
zh: 扎伊德，一作扎伊多，是库尔德首领、谢赫·哈桑·兹拉基之孙。1335年，他攻占法尔金（即古城玛亚法里钦，今锡尔万）附近的布阿特城堡，在马尔丁以北的山地建立库尔德人的齐尔坎公国。

en: Rudolf Brun (1290s–1360) led Zürich's guild revolution of 1336 and became the city's first independent mayor. Since 1234 an aristocratic council had governed Zürich, and its mayor was named by the abbess of the Fraumünster. Brun sat on that council from 1332, then overthrew it in June 1336 with the help of the craftsmen. His constitution balanced old power against new: twenty-six councillors, thirteen from the former patriciate and thirteen guild masters, with the mayoralty reserved to himself for life. In 1337 he beat his exiled opponents at Grynau. In 1349 he led a massacre of Zürich's Jews and took much of the spoils. In 1350 he crushed a noble coup, arrested Count Johann II of Rapperswil and destroyed Rapperswil Castle. In 1351 Zürich joined the Swiss Confederacy. His regime cut back the influence of the Grossmünster and Fraumünster monasteries, which had dominated the city throughout the Middle Ages, and he ruled the council until his death.
zh: 鲁道夫·布伦（1290年代—1360）领导了1336年的苏黎世行会革命，成为这座城市第一位独立市长。自1234年起，苏黎世由贵族议会统治，市长由圣母大教堂女院长任命。布伦自1332年起担任市议员，1336年6月借手工业者之力推翻了这个议会。新宪法在旧权力与新势力之间求得平衡：议会共二十六席，旧贵族十三席，十三个行会的会长十三席，市长之职由他终身担任。1337年，他在格里瑙战役击败流亡的政敌。1349年，他主导了对苏黎世犹太人的屠杀，并占有大部分掠夺所得。1350年，他镇压贵族政变，逮捕其首领拉珀斯维尔伯爵约翰二世，摧毁拉珀斯维尔城堡。1351年，苏黎世加入瑞士邦联。他的统治削弱了大教堂与圣母大教堂两座修道院的影响，它们在整个中世纪一直主宰着这座城市；他掌控市议会直至去世。

en: Simon II (died 1311 or 1312) was Count of Zweibrücken from December 1308, when he succeeded his father Count Walram I, whose eldest son he was by Agnes of Vaudémont. He was married to Agnes of Saarbrücken, who bore him two children, Walram and Agnes. He died between autumn 1311 and summer 1312, leaving a small son, Walram II, whose mother acted as regent until about 1327.
zh: 西蒙二世（？—1311或1312）于1308年12月继父亲瓦拉姆一世之位成为茨魏布吕肯伯爵，他是瓦拉姆一世与沃代蒙的阿格尼丝的长子。他娶萨尔布吕肯的阿格尼丝为妻，生有瓦拉姆与阿格尼丝两个孩子。他在1311年秋至1312年夏之间去世，幼子瓦拉姆二世继位，由其母摄政至约1327年。

en: Walram II (c. 1298–1366) was count of Zweibrücken and imperial governor in Lorraine. His father Simon II died young, so his mother Agnes of Saarbrücken was regent until about 1327. In 1333 he settled his inheritance dispute with Zweibrücken-Bitsch in a final partition treaty. He backed Charles IV against the rival king Günther of Schwarzburg, and the king made Zweibrücken a town in 1352 and, at the Nuremberg Diet of 1356, named Walram imperial governor in Lorraine, a post he held until 1364. He enlarged the county; his son Eberhard II was its last count.
zh: 瓦尔拉姆二世（约1298—1366）是茨魏布吕肯伯爵，兼任皇帝驻洛林的帝国长官。其父西蒙二世早逝，母亲萨尔布吕肯的阿格妮斯摄政至约1327年。1333年，他以一份最终分割条约解决了与茨魏布吕肯-比奇一系的继承争端。他支持查理四世对抗对立国王施瓦茨堡的金特，查理遂于1352年将茨魏布吕肯升格为城市，又在1356年的纽伦堡帝国议会上任命他为驻洛林的帝国长官，他在任至1364年。他扩大了伯国领地；其子埃伯哈德二世是末代茨魏布吕肯伯爵。

en: Najm al-Din, called Bashak, was amir of the Zarzariyya, a Kurdish tribe between Hakkari and Lake Urmia that was most likely a branch of the Hadhbani. Around the mid-fourteenth century al-Umari names him the tribe's ruling amir, holding Mazkard district and the heights above Ushnu.
zh: 纳杰姆丁，人称巴沙克，是泽尔扎里部的埃米尔。该库尔德部族居于哈卡里与乌尔米耶湖之间，很可能是赫兹班尼部的一支。14世纪中叶欧麦里记载，他是该部在位的埃米尔，领有马兹卡德与俯瞰乌什努的高地。
